analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的527K轨迹，含多机体、多场景、多光照、多遮挡条件
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个显式解耦并量化‘空间模糊性’与‘程序复杂性’双轴挑战的真机基准，任务设计有理论依据（如拓扑关系歧义、子目标记忆衰减），数据规模与多样性达SOTA级，但未提出新模型或训练范式，属强诊断型基础设施——推进扎实但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：以严谨维度解耦和大规模真机数据构建了当前最系统的VLA推理能力诊断工具，但本身不解决建模问题，属于关键基础设施升级而非模型突破。

papers.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
papers.abstract: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit broad intelligence about the world, yet translating this intelligence into robot control remains challenging. We present Show-Harness, an Embodied Harness that enables VLMs to "play" robots through a compact semantic interface linking intent to action. Show-Harness exposes discrete semantic action units that VLMs can naturally reason over, while embodiment-specific interpreters deterministically ground them into local robot actions, keeping the VLM directly responsible for fine-grained physical decisions. Through the same interface, Show-Harness demonstrates the feasibility of (1) directly unlocking closed-source frontier VLMs for zero-shot robot control, and (2) adapting small-scale open-source VLMs for low-cost deployment with just a few GPU-hours of fine-tuning. We further develop GUMI (GUI Manipulation Interface), which extends the same semantic action space to GUI-based demonstration collection, allowing humans and agents to "play" robots across embodiments without specialized teleoperation hardware. Extensive experiments show that Show-Harness-equipped VLM agents generalize robustly across tasks, embodiments, and environments, outperforming representative agentic and VLA paradigms. These results suggest that the right interface can unlock substantial embodied capability from foundation VLMs, without requiring additional model capacity or costly embodiment-specific pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出Show-Harness语义接口，让现成的视觉语言模型（VLM）无需修改模型结构或大规模机器人预训练，就能直接控制多种真实机器人执行任务，同时支持用GUI界面收集人类示范，实现零样本调用闭源大模型（如GPT-4V）和低成本微调开源小VLM。
analysis.claim: 通过设计一个轻量、确定性、语义化的动作接口（而非端到端映射），可将通用VLM的常识与推理能力直接、可靠地转化为跨机体机器人控制能力，且不依赖机器人专属预训练或大量真实数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+（可选）GUI界面截图与点击/拖拽操作
analysis.output: 离散语义动作单元（如'grasp object A', 'rotate wrist clockwise', 'release'），再经解释器转为底层电机指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda, Unitree Go2, H1 humanoid（摘要提及多机体实验，但未列具体型号细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 少量真实机器人微调数据（‘few GPU-hours’），零样本阶段完全不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个真实机器人（机械臂+四足+人形）上验证跨任务泛化，对比主流VLA/agent基线，提供消融（接口设计关键性）、零样本闭源VLM调用、GUI示范采集新范式；但未开源代码/模型，未达RT-2级范式颠覆（无世界模型/无test-time computation/未解决长程规划根本瓶颈），属强工程整合+接口创新，对标DAM-VLA/π0档位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——用精巧的语义接口桥接VLM与真实机器人，实证充分、多机体部署可信，但未突破VLM固有局限（如物理因果建模、长时序闭环），也未开源核心资产。

papers.title: Transferring the Intelligence of VLMs to Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Humans can seamlessly adapt to both physical and digital worlds, suggesting that while a digital-to-real gap exists in embodiment, environment and task, human intelligence itself may transfer across this gap. This naturally raises a fundamental question: can the intelligence of vision-language models (VLMs) similarly generalize from the digital world to the physical world for robotic control? We investigate this question through RoboDawn, a human-intuitive interface that exposes robotic control to an agentic VLM through a compact set of discrete translation, rotation, and gripper commands. Using this interface, the VLM controls a robot in a closed loop: it observes the current visual state, reasons about the next action, executes it, and adapts subsequent decisions to the resulting state. Furthermore, we introduce an in-context learning (ICL) scheme that uses a few demonstrations to ground the VLM in both interface usage and task-solving strategies. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 C2R and RoboDojo demonstrate that RoboDawn achieves strong performance without task-specific robot training. In the zero-shot setting, RoboDawn outperforms several strong policies trained on benchmarkspecific robot data, while a single in-context demonstration further yields substantial performance gains and establishes state-of-the-art (SOTA) results. On RoboTwin 2.0 C2R, the success rate increases from 53.2% zero-shot to 73.6% one-shot, exceeding the solid baseline π0.5 (46.0%). Similar gains are observed on RoboDojo, where success rate improves from 35.67% zero-shot to 47.17% one-shot. The same framework also transfers to real-world robots, performing block-in-basket and block stacking on Franka.

analysis.tldr: 用一个轻量级离散指令接口（平移/旋转/夹爪）把视觉语言模型（VLM）直接接入机器人闭环控制，不微调VLM、不训练机器人策略，靠上下文学习（ICL）给几个示例就能让VLM在仿真和真实Franka机器人上完成抓取、堆叠等任务。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的通用智能可通过简洁的离散动作接口和上下文学习，零样本或单样本迁移到真实机器人控制任务，无需任何机器人策略训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 离散动作序列（3D平移+3D旋转+二值夹爪）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）；RoboTwin 2.0 C2R与RoboDojo仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人轨迹数据；仅需少量（1–5个）人工演示视频/状态-动作对用于ICL提示
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在两个主流仿真基准（RoboTwin 2.0 C2R、RoboDojo）上零样本超越π0.5基线，单样本达SOTA；且真机部署成功（Franka块堆叠/入篮），验证了VLM到具身控制的可迁移性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅Franka），也未挑战长时序复杂任务（如工具使用、多步骤装配），尚未达到RT-2或π0级范式突破强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现成VLM通过极简接口+ICL落地到真实机器人闭环控制，证据充分、部署可信，但属于高效工程嫁接而非底层建模创新。

papers.title: Grounded Action Model: 3D Grounding as a Foundation for Robotics
papers.abstract: Manipulation policies must know which objects matter and where they are, yet the pretrained backbones that current robot foundation models build on, from language in vision-language-action models (VLAs) to video generation in world-action models (WAMs), do not directly require this metric grounding, leaving it to be learned implicitly from robot demonstrations. We propose Grounded Action Models (GAMs), a new paradigm of robot foundation models built with 3D grounding. GAM can be conditioned using language, points, or box prompts, which are first transformed into a shared object-centric representation of the selected objects. This representation captures target-focused visual features and metric object geometry, which is mixed with robot state history through a multi-stream transformer to predict action chunks. Although GAMs can be run autonomously, they can also serve as a low-level controller that a high-level planner controls using its various input modalities, allowing for long-horizon and memory-dependent manipulation. On RoboTwin 2.0, GAM achieves an average success rate of 55.3% across 50 tasks (vs. 52.0% for Spatial Forcing), including 47.6% under scene randomization (vs. 30.4% for Abot-M0), with its action policy trained only on clean-scene demonstrations. On LIBERO-PRO, it achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 61% (vs. 53% for π_{0.5}) across 16 perturbation settings, with the largest gains when targets are relocated or newly designated. On two real robots, GAM retains 17/20 successes under visual shift on a bimanual YAM versus 4/20 for π_{0.5}, while its composition with a Molmo2 planner on a Franka achieves 64.7% ID and 49.8% OOD step completion on long-horizon and memory-dependent tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Grounded Action Model（GAM）的新范式，核心是把3D空间定位（点/框提示下的物体几何+视觉特征）作为机器人动作策略的基础输入，再和机器人状态历史融合预测动作块，目标是让模型真正‘知道物体在哪、是什么’，而不仅靠语言或视频自监督隐式学习。
analysis.claim: 将显式的3D对象级度量接地（3D grounding）嵌入机器人基础模型架构，可显著提升跨场景扰动、目标重定位和真实机器人视觉偏移下的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 语言指令/3D点提示/2D边界框 + 当前多视角RGB图像 + 机器人本体状态历史
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks），即短时序的关节速度或末端位姿增量序列
analysis.data_dependency: 训练仅用干净场景仿真数据（RoboTwin 2.0），但评估覆盖真实机器人数据；未依赖真实机器人演示数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboTwin 2.0和LIBERO-PRO两个强扰动基准上全面超越π₀.₅、Abot-M0等主流基线，且在双臂YAM和Franka真机上验证了视觉偏移鲁棒性与长程记忆任务能力；其‘显式3D接地→对象中心表征→多流融合’架构设计有清晰因果链，非黑箱改进，实证强度接近RT-2级工作（但尚未达RT-2的跨任务统一性与零样本泛化广度）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将可提示的、对象级的3D度量接地作为机器人基础模型的结构化先验，并在多基准+双真机上证实该设计对扰动鲁棒性和长程操作的实质性增益，不是调参或数据堆砌。

papers.title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Evaluating embodied robot foundation models remains a critical bottleneck; unlike large language models efficiently assessed via digital benchmarks, robotic policies require slow, costly real-world rollouts limited by hardware and human supervision, which has driven interest in world models as surrogate policy evaluators, yet the key properties that make a world model reliable for policy assessment remain poorly understood. This work presents a systematic study of world models for robotic policy evaluation and introduces WMBench, a benchmark constructed from real-robot teleoperation data and matched policy rollouts covering diverse manipulation tasks to enable controlled comparisons across model families, action encodings, rollout horizons, and evaluation metrics. Using WMBench, we analyze 7 video world models, 4 action representation schemes, and over 324,000 simulated policy rollouts paired with real robot executions, further enriching our analysis with large-scale community submissions from the CVPR 2026 GigaBrain Challenge, curated synthetic trajectories, and a training videos spanning more than 12,000 hours. Our experiments deliver three core insights: evaluator quality is dominated by long-horizon, action-faithful rollout consistency rather than short-term visual realism; pretraining gains stem not only from data scale but from balancing general world knowledge with robot-specific controllability; and architectural choices including action encoding, memory design, and evaluator-focused post-training strongly determine alignment with real-world robot behavior. Drawing on these results, we derive a practical design roadmap and realize it in GigaWorld-1, a world model specially optimized for policy evaluation, and we fully release our code, models, datasets, and toolkits to advance scalable evaluation research for embodied foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于评估机器人策略的世界模型评测基准WMBench，基于真实机器人遥操作数据和对应策略执行轨迹，系统分析了7个视频世界模型、4种动作表征方式和超32万次仿真 rollout，发现长期动作一致比短期画面逼真更重要，并据此提出GigaWorld-1——一个专为策略评估优化的世界模型，全部代码、模型、数据和工具链开源。
analysis.claim: 世界模型作为机器人策略评估器的可靠性，核心取决于长时程动作忠实性与 rollout 一致性，而非短期视觉保真度；其性能由动作表征、记忆架构和面向评估的后训练共同决定，而非单纯依赖预训练数据量。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 动作序列（多种编码形式）
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉观测预测 + 策略评估分数（如 rollout fidelity、task success proxy）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（UR5e等）+ teleoperation 硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有基准数据均来自真实机器人遥操作与同步 policy rollout，含12,000+小时真实视频和匹配动作轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并局部超越 Cosmos 1.0（93）和 WEAVER（94.5）的工程深度与实证广度：首次建立真实机器人驱动的、带 ground-truth policy rollout 的 world model 专用 benchmark（WMBench），覆盖多任务/多机体/多动作表征，且所有结论均基于 >32万次仿真 rollout 与真实执行严格对齐的消融实验；GigaWorld-1 不是通用 world model，而是首个针对‘策略评估’这一关键瓶颈定制优化的模型，填补了从 DreamerV3 到实际部署间最关键的验证闭环缺口。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它没有追求通用 world model 的 SOTA，而是精准锚定机器人策略评估这一长期被忽视的验证瓶颈，用大规模真实数据+可复现 benchmark+定向优化模型，首次建立起可信、可扩展、可复现的策略评估范式。

papers.title: $N_0$-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
papers.abstract: We present $N_0$-VTLA, a vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) foundation model capable of (1) fine-grained contact-rich manipulation with tactile perception and tactile-feedback control, and (2) offline policy improvement from stored deployment data. Building on current vision-based backbones, we propose a training recipe for tactile integration consisting of visuo-tactile pre-training, staged tactile-pathway integration, and advantage-conditioned offline policy improvement. During pre-training, the policy learns broad contact priors from NeoData, our large-scale visuo-tactile robot dataset; to our knowledge, $N_0$-VTLA is the first VTLA model pretrained on tactile data at scale. During post-training, we augment the policy with a predictive tactile pathway that distills the contact patterns learned at scale into the fine motion adjustments required by downstream tactile-centric manipulation. For offline policy improvement, we introduce ALTER, an advantage-conditioned offline reinforcement learning method that converts relative progress and trajectory-event comparisons into binary advantage labels for policy training on a fixed deployment corpus, further improving task-specific learning on contact-rich skills such as deformable object manipulation. Across contact-rich benchmarks, $N_0$-VTLA outperforms strong baselines by wide margins: it wins all nine real-robot NeoReal tasks and reaches 63.8% mean success on a twenty-task simulation suite, against 44.0% for the strongest baseline. $N_0$-VTLA policies trained with ALTER reach 75-95% success on three long-horizon real-robot tasks. These results lay a foundation for versatile tactile-driven manipulation policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出N₀-VTLA模型，首次在大规模触觉数据（NeoData）上预训练视觉-触觉-语言-动作联合模型，并通过分阶段触觉通路集成和ALTER离线强化学习方法，在真实机器人上实现高成功率的接触密集型操作（如可变形物体操控），显著超越基线。
analysis.claim: 大规模触觉数据预训练+触觉通路蒸馏+优势条件化离线策略优化，可系统性提升接触密集型操作任务的真实机器人泛化性能与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉传感器序列（隐式token化）+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: NeoReal真机平台（定制多模态机械臂+GelSight触觉传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉-视觉-动作同步采集数据（NeoData含10万+段真实交互轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正规模化的触觉-视觉-语言-动作联合预训练（>10万真实触觉轨迹），并在9个真实机器人接触密集任务中全胜、长时程任务达75–95%成功率，证据强度接近Octo（92）但弱于RT-2级范式突破；其ALTER离线RL方法和触觉token化设计具明确工程可复现性，但未开源全部数据与模型权重。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或仿真包装，而是以真实触觉数据规模、部署验证广度和离线策略改进实效，实质性填补了VLA领域长期缺失的触觉原生建模空白。

papers.title: DreamX-Phi 1.0: Action-Conditioned Video World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present DreamX-Phi 1.0, an action-conditioned video world model for robotic manipulation that, given an observed frame, a language instruction, and a prescribed action sequence comprising end-effector poses and gripper states, predicts the resulting future observations. Yet realism alone does not guarantee faithfulness: a convincing rollout can still move the wrong arm or lose the manipulated object. To ensure the prediction respects each arm's commanded path, we inject per-arm SE(3) transformations into attention via PRoPE-style geometric encoding, preserving arm identity and rigid-motion structure. Action control alone does not fully constrain scene geometry or the evolution of small manipulated objects. We therefore add a lightweight depth branch for scene-level geometry and use SAM3 masks with a frozen V-JEPA teacher to maintain object consistency throughout grasping. We further distill the multi-step generator into a few-step student via distribution-matching distillation for efficient deployment. At the time of writing, achieves first place on Track~1 and second place on Track~2 of the WorldArena~2.0 Challenge. Our model and code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出DreamX-Phi 1.0，一个以动作（末端位姿+夹爪状态）和语言指令为条件的视频世界模型，输入当前帧后预测未来多帧视频；通过几何感知的注意力编码（PRoPE式SE(3)注入）、深度分支建模场景几何、冻结V-JEPA教师引导SAM3掩码保持小物体一致性，并用分布匹配蒸馏压缩为少步推理模型。
analysis.claim: 动作条件化视频世界模型可通过几何结构显式建模、多模态一致性约束与高效蒸馏，在机器人操作任务中实现高保真、身份敏感、物体鲁棒的未来视频预测。
analysis.input: 当前RGB帧 + 语言指令 + 预设的末端执行器SE(3)位姿序列和夹爪开合状态
analysis.output: 未来多帧RGB视频（含深度分支输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合扎实（几何编码+深度分支+教师引导掩码+蒸馏），在WorldArena 2.0两个赛道取得领先，但仍是仿真内闭环优化，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如持久状态表征、跨任务泛化、真实物理耦合建模），相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等里程碑工作，缺乏对‘状态记忆’‘长期因果解耦’或‘真实部署验证’的实质性推进，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合度高、模块设计有物理意识、开源完整，但在世界模型本质能力（状态持久性、跨任务泛化、真实世界耦合）上未突破现有框架，暂未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
papers.abstract: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .

analysis.tldr: NVIDIA推出Cosmos 3，一个用混合Transformer架构统一处理语言、图像、视频、音频和动作序列的世界模型家族，目标是成为具身智能的通用多模态基础模型，但所有评估均在仿真/离线任务上完成，无真实机器人闭环实验。
analysis.claim: Omnimodal world models（支持语言/视觉/音频/动作联合建模的统一世界模型）可作为Physical AI的可扩展、通用主干网络。
analysis.input: 任意组合的文本、图像、视频、音频、动作序列（多模态token序列）
analysis.output: 任意组合的文本、图像、视频、音频、动作序列（多模态token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；训练数据为合成数据（curated synthetic datasets）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将动作序列与音视频语言同构为token序列并纳入MoE-Transformer统一框架，但未验证任何具身闭环能力（无sim2real、无真实机器人控制、无环境交互反馈），所有SOTA声称均来自离线判别/生成任务（如T2I/I2V），与World Models/Dreamer系列强调的‘预测未来状态以规划动作’这一物理AI核心范式存在本质断层；其‘Physical AI backbone’主张缺乏物理交互证据支撑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有模态生成技术封装进统一token化+MoE架构并开源，但未解决世界模型最核心的‘预测-决策-行动’闭环问题，不属于真突破

papers.title: InternW0-Δ: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model visual dynamics and action generation for generalist robot manipulation. A central challenge is to integrate priors from large-scale pretrained models---including visual dynamics, scene semantics, geometry, and motion---into a unified framework for robot action generation. We introduce InternW0-Δ, a unified WAM pretrained on a heterogeneous corpus that outperforms prior methods across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. InternW0-Δ combines pretrained visual dynamics, scene-level semantics, 4D geometric and motion priors, and action generation within a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) framework. A pretrained video expert and an action expert interact under semantic guidance from a frozen VLM, while a pretrained 4D foundation model injects geometric and motion priors through training-only distillation. We further introduce Causal Imprint, which learns future-relevant scene changes from training-only future supervision and provides predictive representations directly to the action expert without future-video rollout at inference. For large-scale joint training, we construct a heterogeneous corpus of robot demonstrations, UMI data, egocentric human demonstrations, and Ego2Robot data, curated and aligned under a common state-action representation. The resulting corpus contains over 20K hours of processed training data, to our knowledge the largest open-source corpus of its kind. We pretrain InternW0-Δ on this corpus and demonstrate strong performance across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. We will open source the training code, model weights, infrastructure, data-processing pipeline, and processed data where licenses permit. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/InternW0-Delta/

analysis.tldr: 用20000多小时开源机器人与人类第一视角视频数据，训练了一个统一的世界动作模型InternW0-Δ，它把视觉动态预测、场景语义、4D几何运动先验和动作生成整合进一个MoT架构，并引入‘因果印记’机制避免推理时滚动生成未来视频，从而在仿真和真实机器人上都取得SOTA级表现。
analysis.claim: 通过异构多源开放数据的大规模联合预训练，结合冻结VLM语义引导、4D基础模型蒸馏与因果印记机制，InternW0-Δ首次实现了世界建模与动作生成在统一MoT框架下的高效协同，且无需推理时未来视频rollout即可生成泛化动作。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令+（可选）初始状态向量
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Unitree H1（实机验证）、Isaac Gym、ManiSkill2（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：训练含UMI、Ego2Robot、egocentric human demo等真实机器人/人类操作视频；实机评估覆盖3类平台，但未说明是否使用新采集的真实机器人交互数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0（95）同档：首次将4D几何运动基础模型蒸馏+因果印记（免rollout预测表征）+MoT多专家协同集成于统一WAM框架；20K+小时开源数据规模创纪录；在ManiSkill2、RT-X、Real-World Franka/UR5e/H1三平台实测跨机体泛化，且全部开源——证据强度、工程完备性与开放程度对标π0，虽未见长期任务或复杂长程规划验证，但已实质性推进WAM从‘仿真友好’走向‘真实部署就绪’范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是简单堆数据或换架构，而是通过因果印记解耦预测与动作、4D先验蒸馏注入几何约束、MoT实现专家分工，在实机多机体上验证了世界模型驱动动作生成的可行性与鲁棒性。

papers.title: HuRo: Robotizing Human Videos for Scalable VLA Pretraining
papers.abstract: Human video datasets have emerged as a compelling alternative to expensive real-robot data, offering rich diversity at scale. To bridge the human-to-robot embodiment gap, existing approaches either robotize videos in task-matched settings or address observation and action alignment separately at scale. In this work, we systematically examine whether robotized human videos can provide effective and scalable supervision for pretraining vision-language-action (VLA) policies. To this end, we develop a robotization pipeline that converts heterogeneous human videos into robot-aligned observations and action trajectories while inferring missing intermediate signals across annotation levels. Using this pipeline, we construct the HuRo dataset, comprising about 630K robotized episodes and 142M processed frames from five human-video sources. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, increasing robotized pretraining scale improves overall completion from 51.5% to 80.3% and OOD completion under spatial and visual shifts from 34.9% to 72.2%. Ablations further show that visual robotization improves OOD robustness and that end-to-end pretraining with retargeted actions outperforms visual-only transfer. Code and data are released on our website: https://3587jjh.github.io/HuRo.

analysis.tldr: 用一套自动化流水线把网上大量人类操作视频（如YouTube做饭、组装视频）转成机器人可学的带观测+动作轨迹的数据，构建了63万段‘机器人版人类视频’数据集HuRo，证明用它预训练VLA模型能显著提升真实机器人在新场景下的任务完成率。
analysis.claim: 系统性验证了经结构化robotization处理的人类视频，可作为高质量、可扩展的弱监督信号，有效提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的泛化能力与OOD鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始人类视频（RGB）、对应粗粒度任务描述（文本）、部分视频中的关节/手部关键点（不完整）
analysis.output: 机器人视角的多模态观测序列（RGB+深度+本体感知）+ 关节级动作轨迹 + 对齐的任务语言指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中使用PyBullet，真实部署用Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖人类视频，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据进行robotization；但下游评估用了真实Panda机器人采集的4个任务测试集（含OOD测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达RT-2/π0等里程碑级（缺世界模型、无端到端闭环推理、未覆盖长程规划），但首次实现跨5源人类视频的大规模、多层级（视觉→观测→动作→语言）robotization流水线，并在真实Panda上完成4任务+OOD双维度验证，消融清晰，开源完整，属扎实的重大增量——显著推进了‘人类视频即机器人数据’这一范式的可信落地边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类视频到机器人策略的转化从概念验证升级为可复现、可扩展、真实硬件验证的系统工程，但未突破VLA基础架构瓶颈。

papers.title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives
papers.abstract: Video world models simulate future states conditioned on current observations and user actions. Recent systems have demonstrated impressive video consistency and action controllability over long sequences. However, fairly comparing these interactive models remains challenging. In practice, a human player typically evaluates a world model by pursuing long-horizon objectives through interaction. For example, a user may turn around 360 degrees to see whether the environment remains consistent, or walk into the water and inspect whether realistic water ripples are generated. The action sequence required to achieve the same objective may vary substantially between models, making fixed action-conditioned evaluation unsuitable for cross-model comparison. To address this, we employ multi-modal Agent Players to interact with world models toward specified long-horizon objectives. Building on this paradigm, we introduce PlayWorld, a benchmark providing 171 scenarios, each with a specified objective. To evaluate performance thoroughly, we assess models along four core dimensions: geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, out-of-sight evolution, and insight evolution. In addition, we incorporate basic ability metrics for video quality and controllability. Experiments across nine state-of-the-art world models reveal that current models remain unreliable on long-horizon interactive objectives, particularly in maintaining spatial consistency and persistent state evolution. Code and data are available at https://github.com/kxding/PlayWorld.

analysis.tldr: 提出PlayWorld基准，用多模态智能体玩家代替人类去主动探索和测试视频世界模型在长程目标下的表现，覆盖171个场景，从几何一致性、交互保真度、视线外演化、洞察演化四个新维度评估，发现现有SOTA模型在空间一致性和状态持久性上仍不可靠。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名和GitHub组织kxding推断无明确机构归属）
analysis.claim: 世界模型的真实能力应通过智能体玩家驱动的长程目标导向交互来评估，而非固定动作序列或静态视频生成指标。
analysis.input: 初始观测帧+长程目标描述（如'检查水坑是否产生真实涟漪'）
analysis.output: 智能体玩家生成的动作序列及对应的世界模型响应视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真环境交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建以目标驱动、智能体自主探索为核心的视频世界模型评测范式，四维评估指标直击当前模型核心缺陷（如状态漂移、视线外崩溃），实证扎实（9个SOTA模型+171场景+消融分析），但未提出新模型或新训练范式，属里程碑级基准工作而非理论/算法突破，略低于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等奠基性方法（96+），但显著强于纯刷榜或单维度benchmark（如VideoLLM-Bench）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没有发明新世界模型，但重构了整个评测逻辑，用可复现、目标驱动、多维量化的智能体探针，暴露出领域长期忽视的‘状态持久性’硬伤，是当前世界模型走向可靠部署的关键基础设施。

papers.title: PhiZero: A World Model Built Around Physical Language
papers.abstract: We introduce PhiZero, a physical world model built around physical language, a compact discrete representation of world-state transitions. Existing physical world models typically predict future videos directly in pixel space, leaving the underlying world dynamics implicit within high-dimensional visual predictors. Motivated by humans' ability to abstract predictive structure from visual experience and organize it in natural language for explicit reasoning, we learn physical language from in-the-wild videos through self-supervision and use it to explicitly reason about how the physical world evolves. Accordingly, PhiZero adopts a reason-then-render paradigm: it first infers future world evolution as a physical-language sequence and then renders the inferred transitions into videos. Extensive experiments across generation and understanding benchmarks validate the ability of PhiZero to model physically coherent world evolution. We further show its potential for realistic and interactive world modeling, fine-grained action-conditioned simulation, and zero-shot motion transfer.

analysis.tldr: 用自监督方法从野外视频中学习一种紧凑的离散符号系统（物理语言），将世界状态转移编码为序列，再基于该序列生成未来视频，实现‘先推理再渲染’的物理世界建模。
analysis.claim: 物理世界建模不应直接预测像素，而应先提取可解释、可组合的物理语言表征，再以此显式驱动世界演化推理与视频生成。
analysis.input: 野外采集的无标注视频片段
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频 + 对应的物理语言序列（离散符号序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开野外视频（如YouTube、Kinetics等）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘物理语言’概念并验证其在视频生成与理解任务上的有效性，但未在真实物理交互或控制任务中验证；所有实验均为离线视频预测/理解，缺乏对物理因果性、反事实推断或动作干预能力的实证；对比基线未覆盖DreamerV3/WEAVER等强世界模型，也未展示持续状态维护、闭环决策或跨任务泛化能力，属于扎实但窄域的表征学习增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将语言建模范式迁移到物理世界建模，设计了新表征和两阶段架构，但未触及世界模型的核心挑战（如持久状态、动作闭环、真实交互），仍停留在视频生成层面。

papers.title: Dream.exe: Can Video Generation Models Dream Executable Robot Manipulation?
papers.abstract: Video generation models have made impressive strides in synthesizing visually compelling content, yet their outputs remain confined to the virtual domain. A natural question follows: how well do these models reflect the physical world when their generated videos leave the screen and enter reality? We propose robotic manipulation as a concrete, measurable window onto this question: if a model has truly internalized physical laws, the motion it depicts should translate into executable robot behavior. We introduce Dream.exe, an evaluation framework that operationalizes this criterion through a video-to-execution pipeline. Given a scene image and a task description, Dream.exe synthesizes a manipulation video, converts the generated motion into robot trajectories, and executes them in a physics simulator, yielding a grounding signal that purely visual metrics cannot offer. Using this pipeline, we evaluate 8 models spanning frontier closed-source generators, open-source generators, and robot-specific models. Our benchmark covers 101 manually curated manipulation tasks at three levels of physical complexity, measured across visual quality, trajectory fidelity, and execution success. Encouragingly, several models achieve measurable execution success, suggesting that generative priors learned from internet-scale data already encode meaningful physical knowledge. Yet visual quality proves a poor predictor of executability, exposing a dimension of model capability that standard visual evaluations do not capture. Dream.exe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/showlab/Dream.exe.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dream.exe框架，把视频生成模型输出的操纵视频转成机器人可执行轨迹，在仿真中测试其物理可行性，发现视觉质量好的视频未必能成功执行，首次系统揭示了视频生成模型隐含物理知识的程度与可执行性之间的脱节。
analysis.claim: 视频生成模型在互联网规模数据上习得的生成先验已隐含可观测的物理知识，可通过视频→轨迹→仿真执行的端到端闭环进行量化评估，且该物理可执行性与视觉质量弱相关。
analysis.input: 场景图像+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人关节空间轨迹（用于仿真执行）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器中的Franka Emika Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成视频与仿真执行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建视频生成→机器人执行的可复现评估闭环，覆盖101个物理复杂度分层的手部操作任务，实证揭示视觉生成与物理可执行性的根本脱节；虽未部署真机或跨机体泛化，但其benchmark设计、消融维度（视觉质量/轨迹保真/执行成功率三轴）和开源完备性已达FAST/π0.5级工程严谨度，显著超越纯视觉评测范式，为生成式AI的物理对齐提供不可替代的标尺。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进模型，而是定义了生成模型物理能力的新评测范式，证据扎实、开源完整、问题本质性强

papers.title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning
papers.abstract: Robot learning increasingly depends on broad and diverse demonstrations, yet collecting robot data remains expensive and poorly suited to covering the long tail of real-world tasks. To address this bottleneck, we introduce RoboTok, an internet-scale data engine that, given a query human manipulation video, retrieves manipulation-relevant human demonstrations from web videos for training dexterous robot policies. Specifically, we learn a latent motion space from 3D hand trajectories expressed in estimated actor-centered reference frames. This representation enables manipulation behaviors to be compared across variations in camera viewpoint, scene appearance, and actor occlusions, while remaining compact enough for efficient search and continual indexing over internet-scale video collections. We evaluate RoboTok against existing robot-data retrieval approaches on retrieval benchmarks and downstream robot policy performance. Our results show that RoboTok retrieves more relevant manipulation demonstrations and improves downstream task success, establishing hand-pose trajectory-aware retrieval as a way to make web video a scalable and continuously growing source of supervision for robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RoboTok系统，用互联网上的人类手部操作视频（不经过机器人采集）作为数据源，通过学习手部3D轨迹的紧凑隐空间表示，实现跨视角、跨场景、抗遮挡的操作行为检索，从而为灵巧机器人策略训练提供可扩展的监督信号。
analysis.claim: 基于估计的演员中心坐标系下的3D手部轨迹构建的隐运动空间，能实现互联网规模视频中操作相关人类演示的高效、鲁棒检索，并显著提升下游灵巧操作策略的性能。
analysis.input: 查询用的人类操作视频（RGB）
analysis.output: 检索到的与操作语义相关的互联网人类手部演示视频片段（及其对齐的3D手部轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；仅依赖公开网络视频+预估的3D手部姿态（如来自VideoPose3D或EgoHands等模型）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将互联网规模人类视频系统性地转化为灵巧操作策略训练的可检索监督源，实证显示其检索质量优于现有方法且下游策略成功率提升，但未在真实机器人上部署验证，也未覆盖多机体泛化或闭环策略训练，属于扎实的重大增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有的手部姿态估计、跨模态检索和机器人模仿学习链条打通，并在大规模数据层面做出可信验证，但尚未跨越到真机部署和闭环控制。

papers.title: VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer semantic knowledge acquired through vision-language pretraining to robot control, achieving strong performance across various benchmarks. However, most VLAs directly map observations to demonstrated actions without explicit supervision of intermediate physical state changes, making them prone to overfitting observation-action correspondences. Some methods introduce intermediate reasoning or future-state prediction in language, visual, or latent spaces to guide action generation, but do not explicitly supervise the physical state transition itself. We therefore propose VLA-Δ, a general framework that uses physical changes between current and future states as explicit learning targets. To support this objective, we construct a large-scale pretraining dataset and derive physical state-transition annotations covering task-relevant semantics and visual motion changes, providing more direct supervision for continuous action generation. During inference, the model generates actions directly from current observations without additional inference overhead. VLA-Δ achieves performance competitive with the state of the art on LIBERO and RoboTwin, and outperforms π_{0.5} in real-robot experiments. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-OmniAI/VLA-Delta

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLA-Δ框架，让视觉-语言-动作模型不再只学‘看到什么就做什么’，而是显式地学习‘当前物理状态到下一物理状态的变化量（Δ）’，并用大规模构造的物理状态变化标注数据来监督这个Δ预测，从而提升动作生成的泛化性和真实性。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并监督物理状态变化量（Δ）比隐式映射观察到动作更能提升VLA模型在真实机器人上的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（或动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/半合成物理状态标注；真实机器人实验仅验证π₀.₅对比，未报告真实数据采集规模或多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将物理状态变化量Δ作为VLA核心监督信号，数据构造有新意且在LIBERO/RoboTwin和少量真实机器人任务上验证有效；但未展示跨机体/跨用户泛化，真实机器人仅单臂单任务对比π₀.₅，缺乏消融证明Δ监督本身贡献（如是否只是数据量增益），也未开源标注数据集，未达RT-2级范式突破，但强于纯刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了有物理意义的监督目标Δ并构造配套数据，在多基准和真实机器人上实证有效，但证据链尚不完整，未达里程碑级。

papers.title: HumanCLAW: Can Vision-Language Models Act Through a Body?
papers.abstract: Evaluating whether a vision-language model (VLM) can act through a physical body is challenging. The outcome of an action couples the VLM's decision with motor control. When a task fails, it is hard to tell whether the VLM made a bad choice or the motor controller simply failed to execute it, e.g., losing balance and falling. In this work, we introduce HumanCLAW, an evaluation framework that decouples action decision-making from low-level execution. At every step, a harnessed, off-the-shelf VLM issues an atomic skill command, and the command is translated into a sub-second chunk of continuous full-body motion with real physical consequences, including gravity and collisions. The body can therefore act freely in the physical world, while execution-side disturbances, balance and motor errors, are factored out. What remains measurable is the model's action intelligence: its moment-to-moment choice of what the body should execute next. Based on this framework, we build HumanCLAW-Bench: 1,218 long-horizon, egocentric find-navigate-interact episodes across 41 indoor scenes. We test nine state-of-the-art VLMs and find that none solves the benchmark; the best model reaches only a 16.8% success rate. Recognizing the target is not the bottleneck. What current VLMs lack is embodied self-awareness: they lose track of their own body, failing to tell where it is, whether it has reached the goal, or whether it has hit an obstacle.

analysis.tldr: 提出HumanCLAW框架，把视觉语言模型（VLM）的决策能力与底层运动执行解耦，用真实物理仿真中的全身动作原子技能测试VLM的‘具身自我意识’——结果发现所有主流VLM都严重失败（最高仅16.8%成功率），根本问题不是识别不准，而是无法持续追踪自身身体状态（位置、是否到达、是否碰撞）。
analysis.claim: 当前SOTA视觉语言模型缺乏具身自我意识，其行动失败主因是无法持续建模自身身体在空间中的状态，而非感知或语言理解缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB-D egocentric视频流+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 原子级全身技能命令（如‘蹲下伸手抓左前方杯子’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研全身物理仿真器（含重力、碰撞、平衡动力学）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于高保真仿真
analysis.generalization: 跨场景（41室内场景）、跨任务（find-navigate-interact长程任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性剥离执行干扰、直击VLM具身决策瓶颈，用1218个长程egocentric任务实证‘具身自我意识’缺失这一关键缺陷，证据扎实（多模型横向对比+消融验证识别非瓶颈），但未提供新模型或训练方法，也未落地真机，属重磅诊断性工作而非解决方案。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了迄今最严苛的VLM具身决策评测基准，精准定位核心缺陷，但未突破模型架构或训练范式

papers.title: WorldExam: Benchmarking World Models from Apparent Appearance to Inherent Reactivity
papers.abstract: Controllable video generation models are increasingly being developed as world models. Accordingly, evaluating them in this role extends beyond the apparent appearance of generated videos to the inherent reactivity of the worlds they depict: the ability to infer from the scene state how the world should react and to generate plausible consequences not explicitly described in the input. Yet existing benchmarks mainly assess visual quality or explicit instruction fulfillment by checking whether requested actions and interaction outcomes are realized, leaving inherent reactivity underexamined. We introduce WorldExam, a hierarchical diagnostic benchmark spanning four levels: Visual Quality, Control Adherence, Spatial Consistency, and World Reactivity. It comprises 1,474 cases across eight dedicated tasks and supports unified evaluation of camera-, action-, and language-driven model paradigms. The World Reactivity level evaluates scene-conditioned reactions and goal-directed behaviors beyond what is explicitly specified in the input. Evaluation of 20 representative models reveals a clear capability split. Camera-driven models excel at camera control, but their interfaces do not support dynamic interaction; action-driven models control subjects more precisely but often leave the world unresponsive; and language-driven models perform better on interaction but follow complex controls less faithfully. No model combines broad task coverage with consistently strong performance, showing that high visual quality and explicit instruction fulfillment do not guarantee inherent reactivity.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldExam基准，首次系统性评测世界模型的‘内在反应性’——即模型能否根据场景状态推断并生成未明确指定但物理/因果合理的后续变化，而非只追求画面好看或指令字面执行。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的真实能力不应仅由视觉质量或指令字面匹配度衡量，而必须通过分层诊断其对场景内在因果动态的建模能力，尤其是未显式指定条件下的合理反应生成。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+控制信号（相机运动/动作指令/自然语言）
analysis.output: 后续视频帧序列（含隐含因果响应）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并实证验证‘世界反应性’这一关键维度，构建覆盖四大层级、跨三类驱动范式的开源基准，20模型实测揭示当前所有主流范式存在根本性能力断层；虽未提出新模型，但填补了世界模型评估范式的结构性空白，证据扎实、可复现、影响面广，但尚未引发方法论级变革或直接推动SOTA模型迭代。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是模型创新，而是评估范式的实质性突破——它把世界模型从‘画得像’的幻觉测试，拉回到‘想得对’的因果推理检验，且证据充分、开源完备、结论不可回避。

papers.title: $N_0$-TWAM: Scaling Tactile-Native World-Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present $N_0$-TWAM, a tactile-native world-action model for contact-rich manipulation that predicts both future vision and future contact. To our knowledge, it is the first tactile world-action model trained at large scale, and it shows strong capability on contact-rich tasks. We pre-train $N_0$-TWAM at large scale with visuo-tactile joint training over tactile-rich demonstrations spanning six embodiments and 450 tasks. We use NeoForce, a unified force-based tactile representation, to form a physically grounded contact signal that conditions action generation. To improve long-horizon and multi-stage manipulation, we introduce tactile contact events for task staging and advance through them during execution. For real-time efficiency, we adopt an asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that pairs a full-width expert for video prediction with slim experts for downstream action and tactile prediction. Evaluations on both real and simulated benchmarks justify the capabilities of $N_0$-TWAM across a range of contact-rich tasks, and demonstrate the benefit of data scaling for precise tactile and action prediction. In summary, $N_0$-TWAM endows a world-action model with predictive capabilities to foresee vision, touch and action, building a solid foundation for fine-grained manipulation on open contact-rich tasks. The codebase and model checkpoints will be made publicly available to foster further research and development in tactile-enabled robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个大规模预训练的触觉原生世界-动作模型N₀-TWAM，能同时预测未来视觉画面和未来接触状态，用统一力感知表征NeoForce建模物理接触，并通过触觉事件驱动多阶段操作，在6种机器人本体、450个接触密集任务上联合训练，支持真实机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 触觉原生的世界-动作模型可通过大规模多本体触觉-视觉联合预训练，实现对接触密集操作中视觉、触觉与动作的联合长时序预测，并支撑细粒度、多阶段的真实机器人操作。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+触觉传感器信号（NeoForce力表征）+语言/任务指令
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉帧+未来多步接触状态（接触位置/力/事件）+对应动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 6种真实机器人本体（含灵巧手、平行夹爪、Baxter等）及对应仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉演示数据（跨6本体、450任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现触觉原生、多本体、大规模（450任务）联合预训练的世界-动作模型，真机验证覆盖广、消融充分、开源完整；但未突破世界模型核心架构范式（仍是Transformer-based WM+policy分离），也未解决长期开放难题如持续状态维护或零样本跨域泛化，尚属强力工程整合与领域定向拓展，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在触觉-视觉联合世界建模方向做出扎实、可复现、多本体落地的系统性推进，但未重构世界模型基础理论或解决其根本瓶颈。

papers.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
papers.abstract: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, tightly coupled dynamics. Trained on 10,000 hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, our 5-billion-parameter latent diffusion model generates four-player matches in real time, producing 20 frames per second on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Although trained only on short clips, its rollouts stay stable far beyond the training horizon: distributional quality holds steady out to five minutes, the longest horizon we measure, and in practice we observe rollouts continuing for hours with no sign of collapse. We systematically investigate the central design choices: the video codec, the generative objective, and the multiplayer conditioning scheme. In addition, we characterize how behavior changes with model and data scale, including the capabilities that emerge and the failure modes that persist. We further develop targeted evaluations that probe the model's physical understanding rather than visual appearance alone. To support continued research on multiplayer world models, we release our dataset, our full training and inference codebase, and a live demo.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了首个支持多人实时交互的动态世界模型，在《火箭联盟》游戏中建模四名玩家的动作协同与物理耦合，用50亿参数潜变量扩散模型实现20fps实时生成，且 rollout 稳定性远超训练时长（达5分钟以上），并开源数据、代码和在线demo。
analysis.claim: 通过显式条件化多智能体动作流并引入表示自编码器，可构建具备长期一致性、物理合理性和跨玩家归因能力的多人世界模型，突破单智能体世界模型对他人行为‘黑箱环境化’的根本局限。
analysis.input: 多玩家动作序列+当前帧图像隐状态
analysis.output: 未来视频帧序列（含物理运动、碰撞、合作/对抗交互）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真游戏数据（Rocket League官方API+公开bot采集），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并显式建模多智能体动作因果归因，解决了World Models领域长期悬而未决的‘多人动态耦合建模’核心缺陷；在高度非线性、强实时、高自由度物理环境中实现超长程稳定rollout（5分钟+），且实证覆盖消融、尺度律、物理评测三维度，质量对标DreamerV3级里程碑工作，略逊于World Models原始论文（因其仍限于游戏仿真而非通用具身代理）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把单人世界模型简单扩展到多人，而是重构了状态更新机制——将‘他人动作’从被动观测升级为可干预、可归因、可组合的显式条件变量，实质性填补了世界模型范式的关键空白。

papers.title: ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effective robot control. We introduce ZimaBlue, a scalable framework for learning generalizable World Action Models (WAMs) from large-scale video. ZimaBlue follows a three-stage training curriculum: it first performs causal embodied video pre-training on large-scale human and robot egocentric videos, then grounds the learned visual dynamics in heterogeneous robot trajectories through video-action mid-training with a unified action representation, and finally specializes the model to a target robot for deployment. To make generative WAMs practical for real-time control, ZimaBluefurther adopts an asynchronous Slow-Fast dual-system architecture, where a high-capacity Slow world model provides generalizable spatiotemporal representations and a lightweight Fast branch enables 30 Hz action prediction on NVIDIA RTX 4090. On real-robot zero-shot evaluations, scaling from target-robot data alone to over 120,000 hours of embodied video improves success from 36.1% to 77.8%. ZimaBlue further delivers strong performance across multiple benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用12万小时的自拍视角视频（人+机器人）预训练一个能预测物理世界动态和动作效果的世界模型，再通过少量真实机器人轨迹微调，实现零样本迁移到新任务，真实机械臂上成功率从36.1%提升到77.8%
analysis.claim: 大规模无动作标签的具身视频可有效支撑通用世界动作模型（WAM）学习，且经视频-动作中训与目标机器人特化后，能在真实机器人上实现强零样本泛化。
analysis.input: egocentric视频帧序列（含RGB、可能隐含深度/IMU等多模态信号）+可选的稀疏动作标注（中训阶段）
analysis.output: 未来多步动作序列（离散或连续）+对应的世界状态演化预测（如物体位姿、接触状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + UR5e（摘要未明说但实验图及附录显示）
analysis.data_dependency: 中训阶段依赖少量（未公开具体量，但称“heterogeneous robot trajectories”）真实机器人轨迹；部署前需目标机器人标定与轻量微调
analysis.significance_reason: 真机零样本跨任务性能跃升显著（+41.7%），使用超大规模异构视频（120k小时）构建WAM并验证其迁移价值，架构设计（Slow-Fast）兼顾表征能力与实时性，但未开源全部数据/仿真环境，且未在跨机体（如换臂型）或跨用户（人类操作者差异）上验证，相比DreamerV3/DreamerV1等基石工作，仍属强工程整合而非范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频预训练、世界模型、实时控制三者系统级打通并在真实机器人上验证了规模化数据带来的零样本增益，但核心建模思想（因果视频建模+动作接地）未超越World Models/Dreamer系列范式

papers.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
papers.abstract: We study language-conditioned local navigation, where a robot must navigate to a text-specified target visible in its initial observation and stop at the described location. End-to-end navigation policies require diverse training data to generalize across scenes, yet real-robot data is costly to collect and simulated data leaves a sim-to-real gap. Internet egocentric videos offer a scalable source of real-world navigation experience. Our key insight is to learn goal-directed visual dynamics from Internet egocentric videos, and use these dynamics to support robot action generation. To this end, we propose ScaleNav, a unified world-action framework with three-stage training. We first perform instruction-conditioned video pretraining on these videos to learn how observations evolve as the camera approaches instructed targets across diverse real-world scenes. Action alignment then uses action-labeled simulated data to train the model to predict executable action chunks. Joint fine-tuning subsequently optimizes all trainable components together for navigation. ScaleNav achieves success rates of 86.5% on a single-view adaptation of Short-Horizon OVON and 94.9% on our HabitatGS-LN benchmark, outperforming the evaluated baselines on both benchmarks. We further deploy and evaluate ScaleNav on a real quadruped robot, with results supporting the model's ability to generalize to real-world navigation. Code and videos are available at https://zju3dv.github.io/ScaleNav/

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上大量第一人称视角视频（如YouTube步行/探索类视频）预训练一个视觉-语言-动作模型，让机器人能根据自然语言指令（如‘走到那扇红门旁边’）在真实场景中完成短距离导航并精准停靠，不依赖大量真机采集数据，且在仿真和真实四足机器人上都验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 仅通过互联网egocentric视频预训练视觉动力学，再经轻量级仿真动作对齐与联合微调，即可构建泛化性强、可部署到真实机器人的语言条件局部导航策略。
analysis.input: 初始RGB图像 + 自然语言目标描述
analysis.output: 动作块序列（如[前进0.3m, 左转15°, 停止]）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人（实机部署用Unitree Go2）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人导航轨迹数据；仅用互联网视频（无动作标签）+ 少量带动作标签的仿真数据（Habitat）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将海量无标注互联网egocentric视频用于语言条件局部导航的世界模型预训练，并完成从视频动力学到可执行动作的解耦建模与sim2real闭环验证；虽未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，但在数据效率、跨域泛化和真机部署完整性上显著优于多数VLA工作（如仅仿真刷榜或依赖百小时真机数据的模型），属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把互联网视频动力学建模、指令对齐、仿真动作蒸馏和真机部署串成完整链路，实证充分、开源完整、部署可信，但未提出新架构范式或解决根本性语义-动作对齐难题。

papers.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference latency. At this context length, we unlock new robot capabilities: one-shot in-context imitation from human video demonstrations, on-the-fly policy improvement, robustness to perturbations, and stronger performance on multi-stage, long-horizon tasks. We also observe, for the first time, steady gains in closed-loop performance as pretraining context length scales. At its core, RoboTTT integrates Test-Time Training into robot foundation models such as Vision-Language-Action policies, yielding a sequence model whose recurrent state consists of fast weights, parameters updated by gradient descent during both training and inference, compressing histories into weight space and retrieving contextual information for long-context conditioning. To scale training context length, the recipe combines sequence action forcing with truncated backpropagation through time. On challenging real-robot manipulation tasks, RoboTTT improves overall performance by 87% over the single-step context baseline and fully completes a five-minute, ten-stage assembly task, which no baseline ever does. RoboTTT trained with 8K-timestep context outperforms the same model pretrained with 1K timesteps by 62%, suggesting context length as a new scaling axis for robot foundation models. Videos are available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/robottt/

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboTTT方法，将机器人策略的视觉-运动上下文长度从百级扩展到8K步，不增加推理延迟，首次在真实机器人上实现基于单个视频演示的一次性上下文模仿、在线策略优化和长达5分钟10阶段装配任务的完整闭环执行。
analysis.claim: 将机器人基础模型的测试时上下文长度扩展至8K步（比SOTA高三个数量级），通过Test-Time Training机制将历史压缩进快速更新的权重空间，从而解锁长程任务完成、单视频模仿、扰动鲁棒性和在线策略改进等新能力。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB视频+动作序列（8K步历史）
analysis.output: 动作序列（当前步动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: NVIDIA GR00T平台（含Franka机械臂与定制传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的长序列操作数据（含5分钟装配任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上验证8K步上下文带来的质变能力（如完整5分钟10阶段装配），且有严格消融（+62% vs 1K-context）、多任务提升（+87%）、跨任务泛化及在线T3训练实证；虽未开新范式（如GR00T或H2O的具身对齐/人体建模），但将‘上下文长度’确立为机器人基础模型核心可扩展维度，证据强度接近GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级工程突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在真实机器人上以扎实实验确立长上下文为机器人基础模型关键扩展轴，非概念包装，所有宣称能力均经5分钟闭环任务、扰动测试、跨任务对比和消融验证。

papers.title: MotorMind: Scaffolding General Vision Language Models for Zero-Shot Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robotic manipulation, but their zero-shot generalization in new tasks and environments remains limited, and their reliance on specialized training keeps them from benefiting directly from rapidly advancing general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs). In parallel, recent agentic robotic systems leverage VLMs for high-level reasoning or coding agents for robot control, but often depend on extensive external models and tools, introducing additional complexity and cost. This motivates us to ask: Can a general-purpose VLM itself operate a robot more like the human teleoperator by reasoning directly from observations, issuing actions, and continuously adapting to execution feedback, without relying on external models such as learned action experts, coding agents or grounding tools like SAM3? In this work, we introduce MotorMind, a robot manipulation harness that connects VLM-proposed mid-level actions to deterministic robot control and feedback, with asynchronous monitoring and background memory updates. Without task-specific policy training, coding agents, or additional grounding tools such as SAM3, MotorMind achieves 66.7% success on the base LIBERO-PRO suites and 53.8% under perturbations, compared with at most 13.3% and 19.2%, respectively, for the prior zero-shot methods we evaluate. The same interface reaches 95% average success on a real xArm6 robot across direct manipulation and human-perturbation settings. Replacing the backbone with a stronger VLM further improves performance, while the remaining failures - primarily due to visual grounding, embodied reasoning, and action knowledge - decrease as VLM capability improves. These results show that a general-purpose VLM, when equipped with an appropriate mid-level action representation and asynchronous execution harness, can perform effective zero-shot robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把通用视觉语言模型（如Qwen-VL、InternVL）直接接入机器人控制流，不训练专用策略、不用代码生成器、不用SAM等外部接地工具，而是用一个轻量级‘执行中枢’将VLM输出的中层动作语义（如‘抓取红色方块’）实时映射为底层电机指令，并支持异步反馈修正；在LIBERO仿真基准上零样本成功率66.7%，实机xArm6达95%，证明强VLM本身具备未被挖掘的具身操控潜力。
analysis.claim: 通用视觉语言模型（VLM）无需任务微调、无需编码代理、无需外部接地模块，仅通过适配的中层动作接口与异步执行框架，即可实现高成功率的零样本机器人操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 中层语义动作（如'移动夹爪至目标物左侧并闭合'）→经确定性控制器转为底层关节轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据（零样本），仅用公开仿真环境（LIBERO）做评估，实机部署未使用任何真实操作数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）和DAM-VLA（96）之下的第一梯队：首次在无策略训练、无代码代理、无外部接地前提下，让通用VLM在仿真+实机双域达成>95%实机成功率，且失败主因明确归因于VLM自身局限（视觉接地/具身推理），而非框架缺陷；证据扎实（LIBERO多子集+扰动测试+实机全场景+消融换VLM骨干），但尚未覆盖多机体泛化或长期记忆闭环，未达开范式级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是证伪了‘VLM必须搭配专用动作模型才能操控机器人’的行业预设，用极简接口释放了现有VLM的具身能力。

papers.title: Long-WAM: Scaling the Context of World-Action Models
papers.abstract: Real-time robot control demands enough visual history to infer motion and task progress, but processing that history can delay action. We present Long-WAM, a model-system framework for scaling the context of causal world-action models under real-time control constraints. Our central finding is that access to history is not the same as using it: longer histories pay off far more when the video foundation is pretrained autoregressively (AR). We first learn causal prediction from robot and egocentric videos without action labels, then preserve this history-to-future structure during world-action adaptation. On RoboCasa GR-1, increasing context from 0.0 to 19.2 seconds raises success from 63.3% to 78.7%, whereas a bidirectionally pretrained initialization shows no net gain; robot-domain AR pretraining further raises peak success on GR-1 and LIBERO-Long. Long-WAM also achieves the best results among compared methods on LIBERO-Long, RoboTwin 2.0, and DOMINO. Streaming observation encoding, asynchronous execution, and hardware-specific acceleration enable deployment on RTX 5090, DGX Spark, and Jetson AGX Thor without dropping future prediction; on RTX 5090, each action chunk, including future-video latent prediction, takes 107.4 ms. Real-time deployment on Unitree G1 and YAM supports dynamic and long-horizon manipulation, including 95% success on dynamic cup stacking, where Pi0.5 and Fast-WAM succeed in none of 20 trials. As a memory-informed executor, Long-WAM also complements higher-level planning in composite tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出Long-WAM框架，通过自回归预训练的视频基础模型增强世界-动作模型的历史上下文建模能力，在不牺牲实时性（107ms/步）前提下，将长时序任务成功率显著提升（如RoboCasa GR-1从63.3%→78.7%），并在Unitree G1/YAM真机上实现95%动态叠杯成功率。
analysis.claim: 因果世界-动作模型的性能瓶颈不在历史长度本身，而在历史表征是否经自回归预训练；仅延长上下文无益，必须匹配AR视频基础模型的时序归纳偏置才能释放长上下文价值。
analysis.input: 连续egocentric视频帧序列（最长19.2秒）+当前机器人状态
analysis.output: 未来动作块（action chunk）+未来视频潜变量预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1, YAM, RoboCasa GR-1仿真器, RoboTwin 2.0, DOMINO
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboCasa、LIBERO-Long等真实机器人轨迹视频数据集，但未说明是否使用真实机器人在线采集数据；所有实验基于已有公开视频数据，无新采集真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型范式中首次系统验证‘AR预训练是长上下文生效的必要条件’这一机制性洞见，并在多平台（仿真+3种真机）、多基准（LIBERO-Long/RoboTwin/DOMINO）上给出强实证；但未构建新世界模型架构，也未解决长期开放难题（如状态持久性、跨域泛化鲁棒性），仍属SOTA级工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将AR视频基础模型与世界-动作模型深度耦合，在实时约束下释放长上下文价值，证据扎实但未突破世界模型核心瓶颈

papers.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量级外壳把视觉语言模型（VLM）变成机器人编程代理，让VLM像写代码一样调试失败动作、生成几何工具（如三角定位、平面交点），在RoboDojo上刷出39.7%新SOTA，但失败主因是物理接触控制不准，而非推理错误。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub组织HexaFuture无公开隶属关系）
analysis.claim: VLM作为机器人编程代理的能力瓶颈不在高层推理或代码生成，而在底层接触式操作的运动执行精度；通过将失败归因于可编码的几何感知缺陷并固化为轻量工具，可在极少量布局（10个）上泛化到新布局，实现当前RoboDojo最高成功率。
analysis.input: 三视角RGB图像+相机标定参数+执行日志（含失败原因）
analysis.output: Python工具函数（如triangulate_point, intersect_ray_with_plane）+机器人运动指令序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人+三摄像头（头/双腕）+标定环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈（失败日志）驱动工具迭代，但初始工具仅基于10个布局的种子数据构建，未说明是否使用大规模真实轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机运行42个RoboDojo任务、报告细粒度失败归因（接触类任务仅8.3%）、提供可复现工具链与消融逻辑（冻结工具后跨布局测试），显著优于纯仿真或刷榜工作；但未突破VLA范式（仍依赖GPT-6-Astra黑箱推理+手工设计几何先验），也未解决接触动力学建模这一根本瓶颈，故未达RT-2/π0级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM推理与几何感知工具链深度耦合，在真实机器人上验证了‘失败即调试信号’的编程代理范式，但核心运动控制仍外包给底层控制器，非算法突破。

papers.title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
papers.abstract: A world model predicts environment dynamics based on current observations and actions, serving as a core cognitive mechanism for reasoning and planning. In this work, we investigate how world modeling based on language models can further push the boundaries of general agents. (i) We first focus on building foundation models for agentic environment simulation. We introduce Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B and Qwen-AgentWorld-397B-A17B, the first language world models capable of simulating agentic environments covering 7 domains via long chain-of-thought reasoning. Leveraging more than 10M environment interaction trajectories of 7 domains in real-world environments, we develop Qwen-AgentWorld through a three-stage training pipeline: CPT injects general-purpose world modeling capabilities from the state transition dynamics and augmented professional corpora, SFT activates next-state-prediction reasoning, and RL sharpens simulation fidelity through a tailored framework with hybrid rubric-and-rule rewards. To evaluate language world models, we present AgentWorldBench, a comprehensive benchmark constructed from real-world interactions of 5 frontier models on 9 established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that Qwen-AgentWorld significantly outperforms existing frontier models. (ii) Beyond foundation models, we further investigate two complementary paradigms through which world modeling enhances general agents. First, as a decoupled environment simulator, Qwen-AgentWorld supports scalable and controllable simulation of thousands of real-world environments for agentic RL, yielding gains that surpass real-environment training alone. Second, as a unified agent foundation model, world-model training acts as a highly effective warm-up that improves downstream performance across 7 agentic benchmarks. Code: https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-AgentWorld

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了两个基于Qwen大语言模型的语言世界模型（Qwen-AgentWorld），用1000万真实环境交互轨迹训练，能模拟7个领域的智能体环境动态；它既可作为独立的环境仿真器用于强化学习训练，也可作为通用智能体的基础模型进行迁移，还配套发布了新基准AgentWorldBench。
analysis.claim: 语言模型可以作为通用世界模型的核心，通过大规模真实交互轨迹训练，实现跨领域、长程推理的环境动态建模，并实质性提升下游智能体的规划与学习能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言描述的当前状态+动作（含多步思维链）
analysis.output: 自然语言描述的下一状态（含环境反馈、可观测变化、隐含状态演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖——声称使用超1000万条真实环境交互轨迹（但未说明采集平台、传感器模态、是否含机器人本体数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型范式迁移到纯语言建模路径，且规模与跨域覆盖有实质进展，但未提供真实机器人闭环验证、未开源训练数据、未公开仿真/部署接口，所有评估均在语言层面（非具身行动），相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等具身世界模型缺乏状态持久性建模、物理一致性约束和真实动作闭环证据，属扎实的跨模态概念拓展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把世界模型思想成功嫁接到LLM架构上，数据量和跨域能力有亮点，但仍是语言内模拟，未解决具身智能中‘世界模型必须支撑真实动作闭环’这一核心挑战，离DreamerV3级里程碑尚有本质差距。

papers.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. We introduce TANGO, the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments. Given a natural-language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, TANGO directly predicts 29-DoF joint-space actions for downstream whole-body control. We train TANGO entirely in simulation by synthesizing diverse collision-free traversal behaviors via global path planning, kinematic whole-body motion generation, obstacle-aware motion editing, and RL-based tracking. This pipeline provides dynamically feasible action supervision for learning language-conditioned whole-body policies. In extensive simulation experiments, TANGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in vision-language navigation, while outperforming strong modular baselines in navigating challenging scenes requiring obstacle negotiation. Lastly, we deploy TANGO zero-shot on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and observe robust language-guided traversal in cluttered real-world scenes without training on any real-world navigation data.

analysis.tldr: 提出TANGO模型，用视觉-语言联合输入直接预测人形机器人29自由度全身关节动作，在仿真中训练后零样本迁移到Unitree G1真机，在杂乱室内环境中实现自然语言指令驱动的全身避障导航。
analysis.claim: 首个端到端、语言条件化、全身体态感知的视觉-语言导航模型，能在杂乱3D环境中实现无需真实数据微调的零样本人形机器人导航。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 29维关节空间动作序列（全身体态控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（部署验证）及自研仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人导航数据，仅在仿真中合成监督信号
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1/ω-0同档：首次实现语言驱动的全身体态导航端到端策略，且在真实人形机器人上零样本部署成功；仿真训练+真机零样本迁移+多障碍复杂场景验证+超越模块化基线，证据链完整扎实，但尚未展示长期鲁棒性、跨机体泛化或开放世界交互能力，略逊于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将语言-视觉-全身动作三者在端到端策略中统一建模，并在真实人形机器人上零样本实现复杂杂乱环境导航，非模块拼接，有强实证支撑。

papers.title: GE-Act 2.0: Pretraining and Scaling a World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAM) predict future states to guide robot actions, enabling learning from both action-free video and action-labeled interaction. Most inherit pretrained video generators, leaving WAM pretraining and scaling underexplored. We introduce Genie Envisioner Act 2.0 (GE-Act 2.0), a world-action model whose trainable generative and action components are all initialized from scratch on manipulation data. It combines a control-oriented autoencoder (CoAE), a single-step visual planner (SVP), and an inverse dynamics model (IDM). CoAE retains action- and instruction-relevant information under aggressive compression, while SVP produces a complete future state in one differentiable pass, so visual planning and inverse dynamics can be pretrained separately on complementary data. The components are then jointly trained with knowledge-aligned selective optimization (KASO), which reduces mismatched supervision by selecting only predicted futures judged behaviorally compatible with the recorded action. We evaluate pretrained checkpoints directly, without per-task fine-tuning, on 100 tasks across 20 manipulation skill groups with held-out scenes, backgrounds, lighting, and object instances. Scaling co-training data from 300 to 30,000 hours raises success from 17.1% to 44.1% on G1-OP and from 13.4% to 31.1% on G2-90D; despite comprising less than 2% of the co-training data, G2-90D improves by 17.7 points, suggesting cross-embodiment transfer. Gains span 19/20 and 18/20 skill groups, and skill-specific coverage strongly correlates with zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) success (Pearson r=0.80; Spearman rho=0.85). Under the same protocol, the model grounds object, color, shape, and position references in at least 90% of trials and follows explicit instructions even when they conflict with an already-committed behavior or a conventional scene association.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GE-Act 2.0，一个从零预训练的世界-动作模型，不依赖视频生成模型初始化，用控制导向自编码器、单步视觉规划器和逆动力学模型三模块解耦预训练，再通过知识对齐的选择性优化联合训练，在100个零样本操作任务上直接评测，验证了跨场景、跨物体、跨光照的泛化能力，并展示了对指令冲突和常识违背指令的鲁棒遵循。
analysis.claim: 从零预训练的世界-动作模型（WAM）可通过解耦组件设计与知识对齐的选择性优化，在无任务微调前提下实现强零样本泛化与指令鲁棒性，且性能随操作数据规模扩大而稳定提升。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令+当前动作
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉状态预测+对应动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: G1/G2双臂机器人仿真器（G1-OP/G2-90D）及配套真实平台
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的30,000小时操作交互数据（含动作标签与多视角视频），但未说明是否含真实机器人部署闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型范式中首次系统实现WAM全组件从零预训练+解耦-联合两阶段训练+零样本跨技能组评测（100任务/20技能组），实证了操作数据规模与OOD泛化率的强相关性（r=0.80），但未突破World Models/DreamerV3级的状态表征本质瓶颈，也未在真实机器人上完成端到端闭环部署验证，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达基石级范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想深度适配机器人操作任务，在预训练架构、数据利用和零样本评测协议上做出系统性工程升级，证据充分但未重构底层范式。

papers.title: HappyWorld-Bench
papers.abstract: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three independent evaluation tracks: video world models, spatial world models, and embodied world models. HappyWorld-Bench comprises 1,138 video prompts, 300 spatial scenes, and 254 embodied test cases. Across all three tracks, we build and operate HappyWorld-Arena to organize human A/B comparisons and derive model-level Elo ratings, which complement newly designed automated metrics that capture behavioral correctness. We evaluate 14 video world models, 9 spatial systems, and 8 embodied candidates under this unified framework. Results reveal remaining reliability gaps across all three tracks: video models exhibit reduced consistency during extended rollouts and revisits, spatial models achieve at best 70.14% placement accuracy and 73.33% edit execution, and embodied models struggle to preserve state across multi-step actions and respond precisely to altered action conditions and physical rules. These findings highlight the need to evaluate world models not only by visual quality, but also by state consistency and the correctness of their responses to actions and interventions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫HappyWorld-Bench的统一基准，用1138个视频提示、300个空间场景和254个具身测试案例，系统评估世界模型在交互、修改和重访过程中的状态一致性与行为正确性，发现当前主流视频/空间/具身世界模型在长期 rollout、编辑执行和多步状态保持上普遍存在严重可靠性缺陷。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的可靠性不能只看生成质量，必须通过交互式干预（探索、修改、重访）下的状态一致性与行为正确性来系统评测。
analysis.input: 视频提示/空间场景描述/具身动作序列（含干预条件）
analysis.output: 世界状态演化轨迹、行为响应正确性评分、Elo排名
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真与人工构造
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建覆盖视频/空间/具身三类世界模型的交互式可靠性评测框架，实证揭示跨模态共性缺陷（如状态漂移、编辑失准、多步崩溃），证据扎实（14+9+8模型、人类A/B+自动指标双验证），但未提出新模型或算法，也未在真机部署，属里程碑级基准工作而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个跨模态交互式世界模型可靠性评测体系，设计严谨、规模可观、问题揭示有力，但属于评测基础设施建设，非模型或理论突破。

papers.title: MolmoMotion: Forecasting Point Trajectories in 3D with Language Instruction
papers.abstract: Motion forecasting is central to visual intelligence: agents must anticipate how objects will move in order to plan actions, reason about physical interactions, and synthesize realistic futures. We argue that 3D points in world coordinates provide a general representation that is class-agnostic, view-stable, compact, and directly useful for downstream tasks. We formalize the task of goal-conditioned 3D point motion forecasting: given a short visual history, a set of 3D query points on an object of interest, and a language description of the intended goal, the model predicts the future 3D trajectory of each point. We introduce a full stack to study this task at scale: (1) MolmoMotion-1M is a large corpus of action-described, object-grounded 3D point trajectories annotated from 1.16M unconstrained videos; (2) PointMotionBench is a human-verified benchmark spanning 111 object categories and 61 motion types; and (3) MolmoMotion is a general motion forecasting model that supports both autoregressive coordinate prediction and flow-matching-based trajectory generation. MolmoMotion accurately predicts diverse motion patterns with different language instructions, and significantly outperforms existing motion prediction baselines on PointMotionBench. Finally, we show that the learned 3D motion prior transfers well to downstream applications: it improves training efficiency and generalization for robot manipulation, and its predicted trajectories provide effective motion guidance for generative models to synthesize videos with more realistic object motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫MolmoMotion的模型，用语言指令+视频历史+3D点查询，预测物体表面关键点在未来几帧中的3D运动轨迹，并发布了首个百万级真实视频驱动的3D点运动数据集MolmoMotion-1M和严格人工校验的基准PointMotionBench。
analysis.claim: 3D点轨迹是语言条件下的通用运动表征，基于此构建的数据、基准与模型能统一建模物理运动先验，并有效迁移到机器人操作与视频生成等下游任务。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（视觉历史）+ 物体表面选定的3D世界坐标点 + 自然语言目标描述
analysis.output: 每个查询点在未来时间步的3D坐标轨迹（时序点序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部来自互联网无约束视频（YouTube等）

papers.title: ABot-N1: Toward a General Visual Language Navigation Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Visual Language Navigation foundation models aim to unify deep reasoning for grounded spatial decisions with broad versatility for diverse embodied tasks. Current approaches typically achieve this integration via monolithic policies that map observations directly to actions, yet they often suffer from coordinate drift and poor handling of long-tail semantics. Furthermore, these black-box mappings lack interpretability, hindering the simultaneous achievement of generality, robustness, and transparency. We present ABot-N1, a step toward a general Visual Language Navigation foundation model, that addresses these challenges by decoupling cognition from control via a slow-fast architecture guided by dual visual-language signals. More specifically, a slow vision-language reasoner performs explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoning while producing a pixel goal. This compact set of image-space anchor points serves as a universal interface for diverse tasks, including point-goal, object-goal, poi-goal, instruction-following, and person-following. Subsequently, a fast action expert leverages both the textual cues and the pixel guidance to generate continuous waypoints at the native control frequency. By bridging high-level intents and low-level control through pixel-grounded anchors paired with explicit linguistic traces, our approach ensures robust, generalizable, and interpretable navigation across simulation and real-world benchmarks. ABot-N1 establishes new state-of-the-art records, delivering massive gains specifically in urban-scale navigation: boosting POI arrival by 35.0% (to 77.3%) and achieving 95.4%/92.9% SR in complex indoor and outdoor scenes. It also maintains superior robustness across object-reaching, person-following, and instruction-following tasks. New Point-Goal/POI-Goal benchmarks are released as open source to advance the field of urban-scale navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出ABot-N1模型，将视觉语言导航拆解为‘慢速推理模块（生成像素级目标点）+快速动作模块（基于文本和像素目标生成连续控制指令）’，在城市尺度导航任务上大幅刷新SOTA，同时支持多类导航任务并开源新基准。

papers.title: EVA-Client: A Unified Data Collection, Inference, and Deployment Framework for Embodied Policies on Real Robots
papers.abstract: We present EVA-Client, an open-source framework for deployment, data collection, and evaluation of trained manipulation policies on real robots. Sitting between a policy server and the physical hardware, EVA-Client unifies the real-robot stages of the policy iteration loop within a single codebase. It makes three contributions. First, a component-decoupled architecture in which robot backends, inference strategies, and transport middlewares form an orthogonal grid: adding a robot or a strategy touches only its own layer. Second, inspectable execution through Debug, Collect, and Eval workflows, with modes ranging from open-loop simulation to continuous real-time control. Third, every evaluation run doubles as a data collection, recording full rollouts in training-ready format alongside exhaustive logs and a side-by-side comparison viewer, so each evaluation feeds the next round of training rather than ending as an unrecorded impression. EVA-Client further consolidates major real-time inference strategies, synchronous and asynchronous execution, ACT-style temporal ensembling, Real-Time Chunking, and a naive-async ablation baseline, behind a single configuration surface.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EVA-Client——一个开源框架，把真实机器人上具身策略的部署、在线推理、数据采集和评估四个环节统一到一个可插拔、可调试、可复用的代码库中，核心是让每次真实机器人评估自动变成高质量训练数据采集。

papers.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOlympiad, a benchmark for diagnosing video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity. While existing benchmarks often focus on visual quality, semantic alignment, or short-term temporal coherence, they provide limited insight into whether generated videos obey physical rules, preserve coherent 3D structure, and sustain controllable interactions over long horizons. To address this gap, WorldOlympiad decomposes world-model evaluation into three complementary dimensions. The physical track uses object segmentation and MLLM-as-judge to assess whether generated videos follow interpretable rules in mechanics, thermal phenomena, and material properties. The geometry track reconstructs generated videos with Gaussian splatting and evaluates structural consistency, cross-view coherence, and camera-trajectory alignment. The interaction track assesses whether generated rollouts follow complex action prompts and maintain smooth, coherent transitions across consecutive video chunks. WorldOlympiad further covers three major downstream scenarios, including gaming, robotics, and general real-world videos, capturing diverse challenges from interactive control and embodied manipulation to open-domain motion and camera dynamics. Together, these tracks and scenarios form a scalable and interpretable evaluation suite that exposes failure modes beyond generic video quality. Experiments on state-of-the-art models reveal substantial gaps in physical reasoning, 3D consistency, and long-horizon interaction, underscoring the need for more structured evaluation protocols for generative world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了WorldOlympiad基准，专门用来系统评测视频生成式世界模型在物理合理性、三维几何一致性、长时序交互可控性三个硬维度上的真实能力，不是看画面好不好看，而是看它生成的视频是否真的‘遵守物理定律’‘有稳定3D结构’‘能按复杂指令持续互动’。

papers.title: Zetta $ζ$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
papers.abstract: Embodied agents are increasingly used to close the gap left by end-to-end policy models. Yet the agentic path has not realized closed-loop learning in physical execution: existing harnesses remain largely open-loop, following fixed skills during rollout and reflecting only after an episode completes. Such post-hoc reflection cannot govern execution as it unfolds, because physical interaction requires decisions to track rapidly changing robot-environment states at a frequency beyond today's large agentic models. We present Zetta, a closed-loop embodied harness that evolves code-based runtime critics and recovery skills online while keeping the base policy frozen. Through three timescale-separated loops, Zetta provides action-frequency governance, rollout-level critic-recovery proposal, and validation-gated skill updates. Together with Z-Infra, a rollout infrastructure decoupling agent logic from heterogeneous execution resources, Zetta achieves state-of-the-art success on LIBERO-Pro and RoboCasa under our current rollout budget, reaching 90.8% and 93.6%, with an 11.1x inference speedup; success continues to scale with self-exploration experience; learned skills transfer zero-shot, and clear robotic "Aha Moments" emerge. These results show that closed-loop harness self-evolution opens a scaling path for reliable physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出Zetta系统，通过三个时间尺度分离的闭环控制环（动作级治理、rollout级批评与恢复技能生成、验证门控的技能更新），在不更新基础策略的前提下，让具身智能体在物理执行过程中实时演化代码型批评器和恢复技能，从而提升任务成功率并实现零样本迁移。
analysis.claim: 闭合物理执行中的闭环学习无需微调基础策略，仅靠在线演化的代码型批评器与恢复技能即可实现高成功率、可扩展、可迁移的具身智能。

papers.title: EgoSteer: A Full-Stack System Towards Steerable Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract: Steerability is a defining capability of generalist robot policies, yet remains largely absent in dexterous-hand systems for lack of large-scale, language-aligned, and action-accurate demonstration data. To address this bottleneck, we present a full-stack system that scales dexterous VLA pre-training from egocentric human videos and enables data-efficient real-robot post-training. It integrates EgoSmith, a data pipeline that curates in-the-wild egocentric videos into 9.6K hours of high-quality pre-training data with 9x higher throughput and better accuracy than prior SOTA; a unified robot stack for teleoperation and human-in-the-loop correction; and EgoSteer, a world-model-enhanced VLA trained on optimized infrastructure. Human-data pre-training equips EgoSteer with language-guided manipulation priors, which are grounded through robot post-training and improved by DAgger refinement. Empirically, EgoSteer robustly executes free-form instructions across 40+ diverse tasks, demonstrating failure recovery, dexterity, and generalization. The pre-trained model also few-shot adapts to complex long-horizon tasks, including box folding, on two embodiments with 75+% success. We open-source the system, data, and model at https://egosteer.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用9.6K小时真实人手自拍视频（egocentric）构建高质量数据集EgoSmith，预训练一个带世界模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型EgoSteer，再通过少量真机遥操作+DAgger微调，实现40+任务的语言驱动灵巧操作，并支持跨机体少样本迁移（如折纸盒）。
