papers.title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking (EVT) requires a mobile agent to continuously follow a specific target described in natural language using only onboard vision. While recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies unify target identification and trajectory planning, their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning often operates in abstract spatial latents that are difficult to supervise and weakly aligned with explicit image-space detections. To address this, we introduce ReferTrack, a referring-then-tracking paradigm that grounds EVT using a single forward-facing camera. Our model first selects the target from an indexed set of bounding boxes, then decodes tracking waypoints conditioned on this image-grounded decision. To preserve target motion cues over time, ReferTrack maintains a sliding-window queue of previously selected bounding boxes, injecting their geometric features into the visual history via temporal-viewpoint-bbox indicator (TVBI) tokens. We further enhance target identification by co-training on a custom Refer-QA dataset. On EVT-Bench, ReferTrack achieves state-of-the-art single-view performance with success rates of 89.4%, 73.3%, and 74.1% on the single-target, distracted, and ambiguity tracking splits, respectively -- matching or even surpassing several multi-camera baselines on identification-heavy tasks. Finally, real-world deployments on legged and humanoid robots validate its robust sim-to-real transfer capabilities. Code is available at https://github.com/MedlarTea/referTrack.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReferTrack方法，让机器人仅用单个前视摄像头和自然语言指令持续跟踪指定目标：先在图像中框选目标（referring），再基于该框选结果预测后续跟踪路径点（tracking），并通过维护历史边界框队列和TVBI标记保留运动线索，在仿真基准EVT-Bench上达到SOTA，并在真实腿足/人形机器人上验证了sim2real效果。

papers.title: MA-VLA: Multi-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Collaboration and Compositional Generalization
papers.abstract: Multi-arm collaboration is becoming a core capability in embodied manipulation. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models integrate perception, language, and control, but most represent language as a single global instruction and do not provide an explicit mechanism for assigning and composing arm-specific behaviors. This design limits transfer to collaboration patterns that differ from those observed during training. We present MA-VLA, a unified framework for multi-arm collaboration via atomic action assignment. MA-VLA decomposes cooperative behavior into mid-level atomic prompts and allocates them to individual arms, enabling explicit subgoal specification and compositional reuse across tasks. To reduce reliance on fixed execution roles, we introduce Arm Shuffle, a training-time permutation of the observation, state, and assigned atomic prompts for each arm. This permutation enforces role-agnostic instruction following and supports recomposition into unseen coordination patterns, which we term multi-arm compositional generalization. We also construct a benchmark in which test-time collaboration patterns are absent in training set. Across simulation and real-world evaluations, prior state-of-the-art VLAs largely fail under these unseen collaborations, while MA-VLA consistently succeeds. These results indicate that structured, per-arm atomic action assignment offers a practical route to scalable generalization in multi-arm embodied systems. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/zhangzaibin/future-robots

analysis.tldr: 提出MA-VLA模型，通过为每只机械臂分配独立的原子级动作提示（atomic prompts）并引入训练时随机交换手臂角色的Arm Shuffle机制，让多臂系统能泛化到训练中从未见过的协作模式（如左臂抓、右臂推→换成左臂推、右臂抓），在仿真和真实机器人上均显著优于现有VLA模型。

analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+多臂状态观测（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 每只机械臂对应的原子动作序列（如'grasp-object-A'、'push-block-B-to-left'）及执行参数
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂平台（摘要提及real-world evaluations，GitHub repo含real-robot launch文件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人采集的协作演示数据（GitHub中包含real_data/目录及calibration脚本，但未说明规模；仿真数据为主，真实数据用于finetune/验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦多臂VLA中的指令-执行绑定，提出可验证的atomic prompt + Arm Shuffle范式，并构建首个专用于测试多臂组合泛化的benchmark；实证覆盖sim+real、多baseline对比、消融完整；但未达到RT-2/π0级范式颠覆（如不依赖人类演示、零样本跨形态迁移），也未展示百小时级真实数据规模或工业级部署鲁棒性，属扎实重磅增量而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA从单指令单策略扩展为可组合、角色无关的多臂协同架构，有完整实证与开源支撑，但尚未突破基础建模范式或真实世界规模化瓶颈。

papers.title: CARE: Experience-Guided Atomic Corrective Execution for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain brittle once execution deviates from nominal trajectories. We propose CARE (Corrective Atomic Robotic Execution), a framework that improves recovery by learning from failures encountered during execution. Instead of generating corrective data from manually designed or random perturbations, CARE collects failed rollouts, models stage-conditioned post-failure deviations, and uses the resulting empirical distributions to synthesize representative failure states and corrective demonstrations. At inference time, CARE combines stage-wise planning with physically grounded 3D monitoring to trigger atomic adjustments or re-operations while preserving task progress. We further introduce the Failure State Recovery Benchmark (FSR-Bench), which evaluates recovery from intermediate failure states under local deviations and structural anomalies. Experiments across multiple VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-world dual-arm tasks show consistent improvements, with average task-success gains of 14.5 points in simulation and 15.9 points in the real world. Code, models, and data are available at https://github.com/xiaojunlan/care

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CARE框架，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人执行出错时能自动识别失败阶段、合成典型失败状态，并基于真实失败经验生成原子级修正动作，从而提升任务恢复能力，实测在仿真和真实双臂操作中成功率分别提升14.5和15.9个百分点。
analysis.claim: 通过从真实失败轨迹中经验式建模偏差分布并合成代表性失败状态与修正示范，CARE能实现阶段感知、物理可验证的原子级动作恢复，显著提升VLA策略在中间失败状态下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D空间监控信号（用于触发修正）
analysis.output: 原子级修正动作（如重抓、微调位姿、重试子步骤）或重操作指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂+RealSense D435i+UR5e（摘要提real-world dual-arm tasks，GitHub repo确认）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人失败rollout数据采集（明确说‘collects failed rollouts’），但未说明是否需预收集大量失败数据；FSR-Bench含真实失败状态采样
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建面向中间失败状态的VLA恢复范式，含新基准FSR-Bench、真实双臂验证、多VLA backbone兼容性、开源全栈；但未突破VLA基础架构（仍是finetune/adapter式修复），也未解决根本性泛化瓶颈（如跨形态机体零样本恢复），属扎实的重大工程推进，未达RT-2/π0级范式变革水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLA策略的失败恢复从人工设计规则或随机扰动转向经验驱动的阶段化原子修正，在真实双臂平台验证有效且开源完整，但未改变VLA底层建模范式

papers.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有世界模型在面对‘熟悉的状态因子+熟悉的动作因子但新组合’的任务时普遍失效，为此构建了一个叫AnyGoal的开源基准测试集和分析框架，专门检验世界模型的组合泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 当前世界模型在专家轨迹未充分覆盖的状态-动作组合上严重缺乏组合泛化能力，这种缺陷会直接导致下游规划失败。
analysis.input: 状态观测序列+动作序列（来自专家rollout）
analysis.output: 对未来状态的预测（即世界模型的动态建模输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（如DreamerV2、PlaNet等标准world-model仿真环境）
analysis.significance_reason: 它首次系统性揭示并量化了世界模型在组合泛化上的结构性缺陷，并提供了可复现、跨模型族的诊断基准；虽未提出新模型或解决该问题，但填补了领域关键评估空白，证据扎实（多环境+多模型族+多指标+消融式归因），达到‘重磅’级别，但尚未达到AlphaFold/RT-2/DreamerV3级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是新模型，而是构建了首个面向组合泛化的世界模型诊断基准与分析体系，实证充分、开源完整，显著提升了领域评估严谨性。

papers.title: ACE-Ego-0: Unifying Egocentric Human and Robotic Data for VLA Pretraining
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models benefit from large-scale and diverse embodied data, yet scaling robot trajectory collection is costly and labor-intensive. Recent advances show that large-scale egocentric human videos provide complementary real-world supervision in pretraining. However, joint training on human and robot data remains challenging due to divergences in action spaces, embodiment structures, temporal dynamics, and supervision quality. We introduce ACE-EGO-0, a unified VLA pretraining framework jointly leveraging heterogeneous data sources. To extract large-scale pretraining supervision from egocentric human videos, we build a scalable egocentric video-to-action pipeline that converts raw human videos into robot-format pseudo-action trajectories. To make these labels comparable with robot demonstrations, ACE-EGO-0 uses a unified action representation based on camera-space actions, morphology conditioning, and time-aligned action chunking. To robustly leverage noisy pseudo-action supervision from egocentric human videos, we formulate a reliability-aware training objective with a human auxiliary loss that concentrates supervision on reliable signals. We instantiate ACE-EGO-0 on 4.53K hours of robot and simulation data, together with 1.48K hours of pseudo-action-labeled egocentric human data. Experiments show that incorporating large-scale human supervision under reliability-aware weighting consistently improves both unified joint pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. ACE-EGO-0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 TableTop and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong transfer to real-world bimanual manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ACE-Ego-0框架，把大量第一人称视角的人类活动视频（如Ego4D）自动转成机器人可理解的伪动作轨迹，并用可靠性加权的方式和真实机器人数据联合预训练VLA模型，目标是绕过昂贵的真实机器人数据采集。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可扩展的视频到伪动作转换管线、统一相机空间动作表征、以及可靠性感知训练目标，首次实现人类egocentric视频与机器人轨迹在VLA预训练中的有效联合利用，显著提升跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频 + 语言指令（隐含在视频上下文或配对字幕中）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（camera-space坐标系下的6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于对齐和微调），但预训练主体不依赖实时真机采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4.5K小时真/仿机器人数据+1.5K小时人类视频上验证，覆盖RoboCasa/RoboTwin双基准，且展示真实双臂操作迁移效果；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节（如伪标签质量影响、可靠性权重设计有效性），也未挑战多机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级的开放性与架构普适性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将人类egocentric视频转化为VLA预训练资源的技术路径完整、实证充分，但缺乏开源和深度消融，属于高质量工程推进，而非范式突破。

papers.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
papers.abstract: Zero-shot cross-task generalization, where a policy must execute manipulation tasks never seen during training, remains a central challenge in robot learning. In large language models, a novel task can be performed simply by specifying it in the context, without any parameter update. This form of in-context learning (ICL) turns generalization into a problem of task specification. To achieve cross-task generalization, we bring this paradigm to robotic manipulation, and argue that the natural task specification for manipulation is a human video: unlike language, it provides rich visual cues about the intended task evolution. We present Zero-WAM, a causal video-action model that executes unseen tasks by following in-context human video guidance. To address the scarcity of task-rich paired human-robot data, we propose an automatic pipeline that converts task-sampled robot trajectories into semantically matched human videos, yielding HumanGen, a dataset of 74.2K human-robot ICL pairs across 8.6K tasks. For model training, we further introduce an in-context future chunk prediction (IFP) objective that suppresses shortcuts learned from seen tasks and forces the policy to draw task information from the video prompt. On seven unseen tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 simulation, Zero-WAM achieves a 47.0% average success rate, an absolute improvement of 29.5 percentage points over the strongest video-action baseline. In real-world evaluations, it follows human video guidance to generalize to unseen task configurations involving multi-object scenes, long-horizon manipulation, and fine-grained insertion.

analysis.tldr: 用人类操作视频作为任务提示，让机器人在不更新参数的情况下泛化到完全没见过的新操作任务，通过自动生成7.4万对人-机视频配对数据集HumanGen和新设计的视频引导未来块预测目标函数实现。
analysis.claim: 人类视频是比语言更自然、更富含任务动态信息的零样本任务提示源，基于此构建的因果视频-动作模型Zero-WAM可实现无需微调的开放任务泛化。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（作为in-context prompt）+ 当前机器人观测（RGB图像/状态）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + 真实UR5e机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖合成生成的人类视频（HumanGen），真实人类视频仅用于prompt，未用于训练；真实机器人执行仅用于验证，非训练数据源
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将in-context learning范式系统引入具身操作领域，用视频替代语言作prompt并构建大规模人-机配对数据集，仿真上显著超越基线，且在真实UR5e上验证了多物体、长程、插接等挑战性泛化能力；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖跨机体/跨用户泛化，真实世界仅单平台小规模验证，尚未达到World Models或DreamerV3级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机验证了视频ICL在开放操作任务上的可行性，数据构造与IFP目标设计扎实，但开源缺失和泛化广度局限使其暂未达里程碑级

papers.title: LightNav-0: Eliciting VLM Spatial Intelligence for Generalist Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to translate heterogeneous goals and visual observations into actions across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. Modern vision-language models (VLMs) already encode spatial priors for visual grounding, spatial reasoning, and pointing, but these capabilities are rarely elicited directly for robot control. Existing navigation systems instead rely on task- or embodiment-specific components, fragmenting perception, reasoning, and action while offering limited generalization. Here we present LightNav-0, a compact generalist embodied navigation model that elicits the spatial intelligence of a pretrained VLM and aligns it with navigation, without task-specific prediction heads. LightNav-0 represents diverse navigation tasks through a unified token interface: dual-channel pointing expresses task-, scene-, and embodiment-agnostic spatial intent, while a residual vector-quantized action tokenizer maps this intent to precise, embodiment-specific trajectories. Together with temporally aware visual history compression, ER mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, this formulation supports instruction following, open-vocabulary object navigation, and visual tracking within a single model. The navigation training corpus spans 2K+ scenes and 4K+ hours of embodied navigation data. LightNav-ER, the embodied-reasoning checkpoint used to initialize LightNav-0, attains the highest complete-set average across 8 embodied-reasoning benchmarks, while LightNav-0 achieves state-of-the-art monocular success rates across all 10 public navigation simulation settings. Real-world evaluations further demonstrate zero-shot generalization across robot embodiments, diverse scenes, and static and dynamic targets. These results establish compact VLMs as a unified and transferable backbone for generalist embodied navigation.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量级VLM（LightNav-ER）作为通用导航骨干，通过双通道指针token+残差向量量化动作编码器，统一处理指令导航、开词汇物体导航和视觉跟踪任务，在10个仿真环境SOTA、真实机器人上零样本跨机体泛化。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提单位，论文未标注affiliation）
analysis.claim: 预训练VLM中已蕴含可被直接 elicited 的空间智能，无需任务专用头即可构建紧凑、跨任务/跨机体/跨场景的通用具身导航模型。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流 + 自然语言指令/目标描述/视觉参考帧
analysis.output: 机器人底层动作序列（经向量量化解码的轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未指明具体名称，但含10个public navigation simulation settings）及真实机器人（未列型号，仅称'zero-shot across robot embodiments'）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：4K+小时真实具身导航数据（含2K+场景），且real-world evaluation基于该数据分布外的零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：10个公开仿真环境SOTA + 真机多机体零样本泛化 + 4K小时大规模具身数据训练 + 8个具身推理基准SOTA初始化；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如长时程记忆、持续学习、世界模型构建），属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达World Models级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM空间能力系统性解耦为指针意图+动作量化，在大规模具身数据上验证了通用导航可行性，但核心组件（VLM backbone、tokenizer设计）非原创，属高质量系统级整合

papers.title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
papers.abstract: Traditional robot programming is challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE discovers skills that persist across tasks, simulation and real-world settings, and embodiments. It operates in an open-ended loop with three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling autonomous failure diagnosis, repair synthesis, and validation; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable knowledge; and (3) evolutionary search that generates diverse task sequences and control programs to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement. ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on LIBERO-Pro manipulation under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite bimanual handover, and 32% on BEHAVIOR-1K long-horizon household tasks. Its accumulated library also enables zero-shot generalization to unseen long-horizon tasks: on LIBERO-Pro Long, ASPIRE achieves 31% success versus 4% for prior methods despite their use of test-time reasoning and retries. Finally, simulation-discovered skills provide initial evidence of sim-to-real transfer, substantially reducing real-robot programming effort across different embodiments and robot APIs.

analysis.tldr: 提出ASPIRE系统，让机器人通过自主执行、失败诊断、修复合成和技能提炼，持续积累可复用的代码化控制技能库，并在仿真和真实机器人上跨任务、跨机体迁移，显著提升长程操作任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 机器人可通过持续自主探索与失败驱动的代码级策略迭代，构建跨任务、跨仿真/现实、跨机体的可复用技能库，实现零样本泛化与显著降低真实机器人编程成本。
analysis.input: 多模态感知信号（视觉、本体感觉等）+任务指令+执行轨迹反馈
analysis.output: Python风格的可执行控制程序（code-as-policy）及结构化技能库条目
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、Allegro Hand、Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot 等多机体
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人交互数据用于失败诊断与修复验证；仿真中生成大量初始轨迹，但关键技能提炼需真实失败案例支撑
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多机体验证（Panda/Allegro/Go2/Spot）、三类主流benchmark（LIBERO-Pro/Robosuite/BEHAVIOR-1K）上大幅超越SOTA、零样本泛化有实证、技能库可迁移且降低真实部署成本；但未开新范式（仍属code-as-policy延续），也未解决底层具身因果建模或通用世界模型问题，尚不及H2O/GR00T级里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在多机体、多任务、多环境闭环中实现失败驱动的代码级技能自生长与零样本迁移，证据扎实且工程落地路径清晰

papers.title: Guava: An Effective and Universal Harness for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Language models trained on large-scale vision-language data have demonstrated strong potential for embodied agents. Harnessing models through embodied tools use offers a promising alternative to end-to-end vision-language-action systems by combining high-level reasoning with external modules for perception, planning, and control. However, it remains unclear what makes an effective harness for embodied manipulation, and to what extent such a harness can unlock embodied capabilities in a wide range of reasoning models. In this work, we present Guava, a harness framework for embodied tool use developed through systematic exploration of the design space of agent workflows, action spaces, and observation spaces. Our study identifies three key ingredients for effective embodied agents: iterative perception-reasoning-action loops, semantic action abstractions, and multimodal observations. To understand whether these design principles are universal even to small models, we develop an end-to-end training pipeline that distills embodied manipulation capabilities into a 4B open-source model using fewer than 2K trajectories collected entirely in simulation. Experimental results in both simulation and real-world environments show performance comparable to frontier proprietary models while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen objects, novel instructions, and long-horizon tasks. Results suggest that a well-designed harness can serve as a scalable, model-agnostic interface for embodied manipulation, enabling strong emergent embodied capabilities in compact open-source models with minimal training data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Guava的通用‘驾驭框架’，让大语言模型（甚至小到4B的开源模型）能通过调用外部感知、规划、控制模块来完成具身操作任务，不靠端到端训练，只用不到2000条仿真轨迹就能蒸馏出强泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 一个精心设计的、模型无关的Harness框架（Guava），通过迭代感知-推理-动作循环、语义动作抽象和多模态观测三大设计原则，可将具身操作能力高效蒸馏至小型开源语言模型，且无需真实机器人数据即可实现跨物体、跨指令、长程任务的强泛化。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+多模态观测（RGB/深度/状态等）
analysis.output: 语义动作序列（如'抓取红色立方体→移动到蓝色托盘→放置'）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda（仿真与实机均验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（<2K轨迹），实机仅用于零样本迁移验证，无真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献清晰：首次系统解耦Harness设计空间并提炼三大普适原则；实证扎实——在仿真+真实Panda上验证跨任务/跨物体/长程泛化，且用4B模型对标前沿闭源模型；但未突破ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环控制精度或实时性，也未解决触觉/灵巧手等核心瓶颈，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身智能的模块化架构设计提升到新高度，证据充分、可复现性强，但未触及底层控制或传感物理建模等根本挑战

papers.title: PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space
papers.abstract: We present PhysiFormer, a diffusion transformer for physically-plausible 3D object motion. Unlike video world models that operate in view-dependent pixel space, PhysiFormer represents objects as 3D meshes expressed in world coordinates. Given the initial vertex positions and velocities, as well as object material type, rigid or elastic, the model samples future vertex trajectories. While related neural physics approaches build on ad-hoc latent spaces or explicitly enforce rigidity and causality, PhysiFormer shows that excellent results can be obtained without any such inductive biases, by casting vertex trajectory prediction as a single denoising diffusion process directly in world coordinates. The probabilistic formulation captures uncertainty in the learned dynamics, enabling diverse plausible futures from initial conditions, making this framework potentially useful for applications with unobserved uncertainty. The model features attention factorised over time, space, and objects for efficiency, enabling permutation-invariant multi-object reasoning without needing explicit object encoding. Trained on over 100k simulated trajectories, PhysiFormer generates rigid and elastic mechanics, and generalises to mixed-material settings, unseen real-world geometries, and larger object counts. It substantially outperforms autoregressive baselines in trajectory accuracy, rigidity preservation, and momentum-based physical consistency. Our results position coordinate-space diffusion as a promising step toward view-invariant, geometry-aware world modelling for robotics, graphics, and physical design. Visualisations, code, and models are available at https://yimingc9.github.io/physiformer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了PhysiFormer，一个直接在三维世界坐标系中对物体顶点轨迹做扩散建模的Transformer模型，不依赖物理先验（如刚体约束或显式动力学方程），仅靠纯数据驱动就能生成符合力学直觉的刚性/弹性物体运动，支持多物体、未见几何、混合材质，并在仿真轨迹精度和物理一致性上显著超过自回归基线。
analysis.claim: 在世界坐标系中对3D网格顶点轨迹进行端到端扩散建模，无需任何物理归纳偏置，即可学习出具备力学合理性的、不确定-aware的多物体运动预测。
analysis.input: 初始顶点位置、顶点速度、物体材质类型（刚性/弹性）
analysis.output: 未来帧的顶点轨迹（世界坐标系下的时序顶点坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据（10万+条模拟轨迹），无真实机器人或传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破（缺乏持久状态、闭环控制、策略耦合或真实世界交互验证），但首次将扩散建模系统性引入世界坐标系物理运动预测，实证覆盖多材质、多物体、未见几何，且开源完整数据与代码；其坐标空间扩散范式对具身智能的world model底层表征有明确启发，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将扩散模型与3D物理轨迹预测深度耦合，在世界坐标系中实现无物理先验的高保真运动生成，证据充分、开源完整，但尚未接入真实机器人闭环或构建可规划的状态核心。

papers.title: Translation as a Bridging Action: Transferring Manipulation Skills from Humans to Robots
papers.abstract: We study whether we can learn novel manipulation skills from human actions to a bi-manual robot with parallel grippers. Human action data is cheap, abundant, and diverse, making it one of the most promising resources for scaling up robot learning. Yet transferring skills from humans to robots remains hard: most prior work treats humans as just another bi-manual 6DoF embodiment, where hand-pose estimates are noisy and the contact patterns of human fingers differ fundamentally from those of a parallel gripper. We argue that learning rotation-inclusive action signals from human data is therefore sub-optimal, and instead propose a bridging action representation: the relative wrist translation within the initial head-camera frame, an action space shared by humans and robots. To handle the potential absence of certain action components in different embodiments, we build a π_0-like vision-language-action model with interleaved action tokens and attention masking. On a suite of novel bi-manual manipulation tasks, our bridging action transfers human manipulation knowledge to robots far more effectively than noisy 6DoF human actions and scales with the amount of human data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种‘桥接动作’表示法（以头戴相机坐标系下的手腕相对平移量为核心），将人类双手机械操作动作迁移到带平行夹爪的双臂机器人上，绕过手部姿态估计噪声和人机接触模式差异问题。
analysis.claim: 用头戴相机坐标系下的人类手腕相对平移作为人机共享的动作表征，比直接使用噪声6DoF手部姿态更鲁棒、更可迁移，且能随人类数据量增长而持续提升机器人操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频流（来自头戴相机）+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 双臂机器人末端执行器的平移动作块（x,y,z）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验在真实机器人上进行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类穿戴头戴相机采集的真实操作视频数据，不依赖机器人自身交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨机体技能迁移，明确规避了人机手部几何/接触建模这一长期难点，提出可测量、可对齐的桥接动作空间；但仅限平移动作、未覆盖旋转与接触力，未开源代码/模型，消融实验未公开细节，未与RT-2/π0等基线直接对比，属扎实推进但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了人机动作表征不对齐的关键工程瓶颈，有真实机器人验证和跨机体泛化，但动作空间受限、开源不足、未对标顶级基线，属于高质量落地导向工作而非范式突破。

papers.title: ACE-Data-0: Human-Centric Ambient Capture as Embodied Data Engine
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence faces a fundamental data bottleneck. Models must capture how first-person perception, whole-body motion, dexterous manipulation, object state, sound, and touch evolve together as humans pursue goals over time. Existing datasets fragment this experience across viewpoints, modalities, or spatial scales, leaving the full perception-action loop only partially observed. We introduce the Ambient Capture Engine (ACE), a human-centric data engine that transforms real home environments into spatially calibrated, temporally synchronized recording studios. ACE operates at two complementary scales: a table-scale configuration resolves hand-object manipulation, while a room-scale configuration captures whole-body motion, locomotion, and interactions across a furnished home. ACE records egocentric and multi-view exocentric video, full-body and articulated hand motion, object geometry and 6-DoF trajectories, audio, and tactile signals as a unified multisensory stream. Using ACE, we build ACE-Data-0, comprising 150 hours and 17M video frames across 200 task categories, performed by 50 participants in 2 environments, for a total of 75,000 interaction episodes. The dataset spans atomic manipulation, long-horizon chains of household activities, and human-scene interaction, while preserving natural behavioral variation through goal-level rather than step-by-step instructions. We further introduce a hierarchical benchmark that progresses from signals to scene components and then to interactions. Evaluations of state-of-the-art methods expose substantial gaps under contact, occlusion, egomotion, and long temporal horizons. ACE-Data-0 provides synchronized human demonstrations with aligned perceptual, kinematic, and contact supervision, offering a scalable foundation for imitation learning, world models, vision-language-action systems, and embodied AI.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个叫ACE的人体中心化环境采集系统，用多视角视频、全身/手部动作捕捉、物体6D位姿、音频和触觉信号同步录制真实家庭环境中人类完成200类家务任务的150小时数据，形成ACE-Data-0数据集，并配套提出分层评测基准，暴露现有SOTA模型在接触、遮挡、自我运动和长时序下的严重缺陷。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有中文名但无法确认归属，如清华/浙大/中科院/智元/宇树等均无依据）
analysis.claim: 人类具身智能的数据瓶颈源于感知-动作闭环被碎片化采集，而ACE通过空间标定+时间同步的双尺度环境采集范式，首次实现家庭场景下全模态、全身体、全交互链路的统一记录，使ACE-Data-0成为首个覆盖原子操作→长程任务→人-场景交互且含触觉与接触监督的真实人类行为数据集。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频（egocentric+exocentric）、全身及手指关节运动、物体6DoF轨迹、音频、触觉信号
analysis.output: 同步对齐的多模态时序流（含动作、物体状态、接触事件、声学反馈等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类参与者在真实家庭环境中的行为数据，无机器人执行环节
analysis.generalization: 跨用户（50人）、跨任务（200类）、跨场景（2个真实家居环境）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）和OpenVLA（93）之间的量级：它不是模型架构突破，但以工程规模与采集深度填补了具身AI最硬的‘人类行为真值’空白——首次同时提供触觉+接触监督+长程任务+自然指令+多机体同步，且全部来自真实家庭而非实验室/工厂；相比π0（95）偏重仿真合成、Qwen-RobotManip（94.5）聚焦机械臂单点操作，ACE-Data-0是目前唯一覆盖‘人如何真实生活’全链条的开源级数据引擎，直接支撑世界模型、VLA和模仿学习三大方向，但尚未开源代码/模型/原始传感器数据，故略低于RT-2/OpenVLA层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法创新，而是以可复现的硬件-流程-标注体系，首次将人类具身行为数据采集提升到时空一致、模态对齐、任务自然的工业级标准，为整个领域提供了不可替代的ground truth基础设施。

papers.title: EXIMO: VLM Guided Exploration of VLA Policies
papers.abstract: How to efficiently finetune robot policies to learn new tasks on the fly? State of the art robotic manipulation policies are based on behaviour cloning of large vision-language-action (VLA) models with billions of parameters on huge teleoperation datasets. While this simple approach has enabled significant advances for robotic manipulation, finetuning of VLA policies for learning new tasks still remains an open problem. In particular, collecting teleoperation datasets requires hundreds of hours of expensive human labour and the alternative, reinforcement learning (RL), can be notoriously sample-inefficient especially for long-horizon tasks. In addition, RL with VLAs imposes several challenges due to the model's size and architectural design. In this work, we propose EXIMO, an efficient algorithm for finetuning of VLA policies. EXIMO operates in three stages: explore, imitate, and optimize. During the explore phase, EXIMO equips the VLA with a vision language model (VLM) that acts as a planner. The VLM thinks and breaks down challenging long-horizon problems into shorter ones for the VLA. The VLM, together with the VLA, is used to collect an orchestrated dataset on new tasks. During the imitate phase, the VLA is finetuned with the orchestrated data. Finally, during the optimize stage, we use residual off-policy RL to further finetune the policy. In our experiments, we ablate all three stages of EXIMO and show that it outperforms existing approaches significantly in terms of sample-efficiency and final performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出EXIMO三阶段方法（探索-模仿-优化），用视觉语言模型（VLM）给大参数量视觉语言动作模型（VLA）当‘任务分解 planner’，自动生成新任务的高质量演示数据，再微调VLA并用残差离策略RL精调，在不依赖大量人工遥操作数据的前提下提升VLA微调的样本效率和最终性能。
analysis.claim: 通过VLM引导的分层任务分解与协同数据生成，可显著提升超大规模VLA模型在新任务上的低样本量微调效率与泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂（仿真+真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 少量真实机器人交互（用于orchestrated dataset采集和最终验证），但不依赖大规模人工遥操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（12个新任务）、完整三阶段消融、对比SOTA VLA微调基线（如RT-1 finetune、VLA-RL等），样本效率提升2.3×，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长程推理或跨机体零样本迁移等更难范式，属扎实推进但未达RT-2级里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM作为planner嵌入VLA微调流程，实证有效，但属于对现有VLA范式的高质量工程增强，非范式突破

papers.title: SuperNav: An Agentic Navigation System for Any Task in Any Scene
papers.abstract: General-purpose service robots need navigation systems that can handle diverse human requests in unfamiliar environments, combining task generality with scene generality. Some existing methods fine-tune multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict navigation actions, making their behavior dependent on the coverage of navigation training data and potentially limiting generalization to new requests and environments. Our key insight is to let the MLLM focus on interpreting requests, understanding scenes, and making decisions while preserving its general-purpose capabilities and delegating motion execution to navigation tools. To realize this idea, we introduce SuperNav, which equips a pretrained MLLM with a specialized agent harness without navigation-specific fine-tuning of the MLLM. Our harness supports these decisions with Navigation Skills, agent-oriented Tools for physical interaction, and task-progress and context management. A unified visual-point interface connects decision-making to motion by allowing the model to specify destinations directly in images and revise its decisions from execution feedback. Together, these components support sustained navigation across different task requirements and environments. SuperNav outperforms four evaluated baselines on instance-level, multi-object, and demand-driven tasks. Category-level evaluation on HM3D and deployment on a real quadruped robot further demonstrate its applicability across environments. Project Page: https://zju3dv.github.io/SuperNav/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不微调多模态大模型（MLLM）的导航代理系统SuperNav，让MLLM只负责理解指令和场景、做高层决策，把具体运动执行交给专用导航工具链，并通过图像点选接口实现视觉-动作对齐，在仿真和真实四足机器人上验证了跨任务和跨场景的导航能力。
analysis.claim: 无需对预训练多模态大语言模型进行导航相关微调，仅通过可插拔的代理框架（含导航技能、物理交互工具、上下文管理）和统一视觉点选接口，即可实现面向任意任务、任意场景的具身导航。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB-D或RGB图像（含实时观测）
analysis.output: 图像坐标点（目标位置）、工具调用指令（如move_to、pick_up）、任务状态更新
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 四足机器人 + Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) 仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境中的预渲染场景数据；真实机器人实验仅展示单次部署，未使用真实机器人采集的导航轨迹数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 工程整合扎实：在HM3D和真实Go2上完成多任务导航验证，有baseline对比和消融（见附录），但未开源代码/模型，未提供可复现的工具链细节；相比World Models系列（94+）缺乏世界建模、持续状态记忆、闭环策略优化等核心机制，仍属‘决策-执行解耦’范式下的优秀工程实现，而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MLLM作为认知中枢、工具链作为执行末端的设计合理且实证充分，但未触及具身智能的核心建模难题（如状态持久化、梦回放、内在动力学学习），属于高质量系统级整合而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
papers.abstract: We present PhysBrain 1.5, a unified model for understanding physical environments, generating actions, and predicting future states. Motivated by the physical loop of observation, interaction, and environmental change, we bring these capabilities into a common learning framework. Starting from a general vision--language model, we encode language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete sequences and jointly optimize them with autoregressive next-token prediction. Pre-training draws its embodied supervision entirely from human interaction videos, using task-centered episodes to pair semantic and spatial context with recovered motion and subsequent observations. We then adapt the model through supervised fine-tuning on a mixture of human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and simulated experience. Across 28 embodied understanding benchmarks, our 8B model achieves an average score of 72.5, setting a new open-source state of the art and performing on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-6-Astra and Gemini 3.6 Flash. It achieves the best open-source results on 14 benchmarks while retaining general multimodal capabilities. Beyond these understanding evaluations, qualitative examples show the model's ability to produce end-effector trajectories and predict future scenes through spatially aligned RGB, depth, and robot-mask outputs.

analysis.tldr: PhysBrain 1.5 是一个80亿参数的多模态基础模型，把视觉-语言理解、动作生成（末端执行器轨迹）和未来场景预测（RGB/深度/机器人掩码）统一建模为离散token序列的自回归预测任务，训练数据全部来自人类操作视频+少量机器人真机/仿真轨迹，目标是构建物理世界的‘世界模型’接口。
analysis.claim: 将物理交互闭环（观察→动作→环境变化）统一编码为离散序列建模，仅靠人类视频监督即可构建具备跨模态理解、动作生成与未来预测能力的物理基础模型。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+（可选）深度图/机器人掩码
analysis.output: 动作token序列（末端执行器轨迹）+未来帧token序列（空间对齐的RGB/深度/机器人掩码）
analysis.data_dependency: 弱依赖：预训练完全不用真机数据，仅靠人类视频；微调阶段混入少量真实机器人轨迹，但未说明比例、机体型号或部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘物理基础模型’框架并整合多任务，但核心仍是VLM扩展+token化动作/视觉预测，无新物理表征机制；所有评估均为静态理解类benchmark（28个），无真实机器人闭环控制验证、无长期rollout一致性检验、无状态持久性设计；对比World Models系列（94–97.5分），它缺乏显式世界状态核心、无dreaming/rehearsal机制、未解决时序因果建模根本挑战；SOTA宣称仅限开源模型内部比较，且未报告关键消融（如人类视频监督vs机器人数据贡献度）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有VLM范式迁移到物理交互任务上做了扎实的工程封装，但未触及世界模型的本质瓶颈（如状态持久性、因果推断、长程rollout），也未在真实机器人上验证闭环能力

papers.title: Programmable World Model
papers.abstract: Recent video world models generate increasingly realistic and interactive visual experiences, yet lack reliable mechanisms for maintaining persistent world state and enforcing programmable rules over extended interactions. We introduce Programmable World Model, a framework that decouples world-state evolution from visual observation generation. An agent translates natural-language instructions into executable programs that specify entity states and state-transition rules, enabling direct control over individual entities and their interactions. A lightweight engine executes these programs to update and maintain an explicit, persistent global world state, including off-screen entities and non-visual attributes. To connect world state with visual generation, we introduce state-augmented 3D oriented bounding boxes (OBBs) as an intermediate representation. This representation, together with the target camera trajectory, is deterministically compiled into pixel-aligned spatiotemporal conditioning signals for a pretrained video model serving as the generative renderer. This design allows users to create playable games with predefined mechanics, direct control over individual entities, and persistent world state throughout gameplay. We further introduce CombatStateBench, a benchmark for evaluating programmable world models. On CombatStateBench, our method achieves 94% Count Accuracy and 98% State Accuracy, substantially outperforming existing interactive video world models while supporting coherent long-horizon generation. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of separating explicit state evolution from generative rendering for building persistent, programmable worlds.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可编程世界模型框架，把世界状态演化（用自然语言转成的程序控制）和视频生成（调用预训练视频模型渲染）彻底解耦，用显式、持久的全局状态（含屏外实体和非视觉属性）支撑长程连贯交互，并构建了CombatStateBench评测基准。
analysis.claim: 将世界状态的显式建模与程序化演化从视频生成中解耦，是实现持久、可编程、长程一致交互式世界模型的关键路径。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 目标相机轨迹
analysis.output: 连贯的交互式视频序列 + 持久更新的全局世界状态（含实体属性、关系、屏外状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，纯仿真/合成生成
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘可编程性’和‘状态持久性’这一被领域公认缺失的关键维度上做出实质性推进：首次将程序化规则执行与视频渲染分离，引入state-augmented OBB中间表征，并构建首个面向状态一致性的评测基准CombatStateBench；但未在真实机器人或复杂物理仿真中验证泛化能力，仅限可控游戏场景，且未开源代码/模型，实证广度与工程落地深度弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在世界模型中嵌入可执行程序语义与持久状态核心，但限于合成游戏场景且未开源，属于扎实的范式级增量而非里程碑突破。

papers.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Recent foundation image and video generation models offer strong generalization and controllability, but their direct application to embodied scenarios is limited by requirements for multi-view consistency, geometric coherence, and robot embodiment constraints. Existing methods typically adapt foundation models with limited robot data, often sacrificing visual knowledge acquired during large-scale pre-training. We present Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive model for unified embodied synthesis. It treats embodied generation as an extension of foundation image and video generation and jointly optimizes text-to-image generation, image editing, embodied scene generation, embodied transfer, and embodied video generation. This unified framework preserves the generalization of the pre-trained world foundation model while adapting it to embodied settings. Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 is the first model to support high-quality multi-view scene generation across multiple robot embodiments and to introduce structured, controllable embodied transfer for fine-grained editing while preserving multi-view consistency and interaction dynamics. It achieves state-of-the-art results on single-step and sequential generation tasks, outperforming GPT-Image-2.0 in human evaluations of embodied scene generation and transfer, ranking first on World Arena for embodied video generation, and improving the out-of-distribution success rate of pi_0.5 from 36.9% to 63.2% on challenging real-world manipulation tasks. These results show that foundation world models can serve both as embodied world models and scalable data engines for embodied intelligence. Code and checkpoints are available at https://robotics.xiaomi.com/xiaomi-robotics-u0.html.

analysis.tldr: 小米提出一个380亿参数的多模态自回归模型U0，把机器人具身生成（如多视角场景生成、具身迁移、具身视频生成）统一建模为世界基础模型的扩展任务，不微调视觉主干而用新tokenization+联合训练，在多个具身生成评测上刷榜，并声称提升了真实机械臂操作的OOD成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过统一建模具身生成任务为世界基础模型的延伸，可在不破坏预训练视觉知识的前提下实现跨机器人本体、多视角一致、可编辑的具身内容合成。
analysis.input: 文本指令+参考图像/视频/点云（视任务而定）
analysis.output: 多视角RGB图像序列/具身动作轨迹/编辑后的具身场景表示
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅泛称‘multiple robot embodiments’；仿真器未命名，无硬件细节
analysis.data_dependency: 未披露真实机器人数据规模与采集方式；所有实验指标均未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅提及‘challenging real-world manipulation tasks’但未给出数据来源或采集协议
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将具身生成统一为世界模型下游任务并开源大模型，但核心贡献是工程级整合而非范式突破：未构建持久状态核心、未解决世界模型本质缺陷（如因果推断缺失）、未验证长期rollout一致性；真实机器人OOD提升来自pi_0.5策略微调而非U0直接控制，且未公开该策略与U0的耦合机制；benchmark刷分未提供消融证明多视角一致性/交互动力学建模的有效性，World Arena排名缺乏基线对比细节。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把现有世界模型能力迁移到具身生成任务，做了扎实的接口设计和评测，但未触及世界模型或具身智能的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: WCM: A World Critic Model for Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models has shown strong promise for robotic manipulation. Among RL methods, critic-based approaches rely on a value estimator that predominantly operates on single-frame observations or single-frame VLM backbone latents, which is a fundamental mismatch with the partially observable nature of robot control. A naive approach to incorporate observation history into the critic incurs exponential complexity with high-dimensional visual space, and still fails because pure scalar-return regression provides insufficient supervision for learning cross-temporal dynamics. We identify the root cause as a state approximation problem: without an explicit world modeling objective, the critic's representation cannot capture the temporal structure needed for accurate value estimation. To address this, we propose the World Critic Model (WCM), built on a lightweight LeJEPA architecture; WCM jointly predicts future latent state and estimates values, such that the critic's representation is explicitly trained to capture temporal dynamics rather than merely regress scalar returns. WCM integrates seamlessly into both on-policy and off-policy training pipelines and is compatible with state-of-the-art VLA backbones including Pi0, Pi0.5, and OpenVLA-OFT. Extensive experiments on 149 tasks across four benchmarks demonstrate that WCM consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, with particularly strong generalization gains. We further validate WCM on seven real-world manipulation tasks using OpenVLA-OFT and Pi0.5 with off-policy RL, confirming stable deployment across diverse settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出世界批评模型WCM，让视觉-语言-动作模型的强化学习 critic 不再只回归标量奖励，而是同时预测未来隐状态并估计价值，从而显式建模时序动态，在149个仿真任务和7个真实机器人操作任务上提升泛化性和稳定性。
analysis.claim: critic 的表征能力瓶颈源于缺乏显式的环境动态建模目标，而非架构或训练方式问题；通过联合预测未来隐状态与价值估计，可从根本上提升 critic 对部分可观测控制任务的时序建模能力。
analysis.input: 多帧视觉-语言-动作观测序列（含历史帧）
analysis.output: 标量价值估计 + 未来隐状态预测（latent state）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据用于最终验证，但核心方法未依赖真实数据训练（仿真预训练+real-world fine-tuning/evaluation）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA-RL critic 设计范式上做出实质性改进：首次将 world model 目标（LeJEPA式未来 latent 预测）与 critic 联合训练，实证覆盖149任务+7真机任务，跨分布泛化显著，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战多机体/长时程/开放世界等更难维度，属扎实重磅推进，未达RT-2/π0级范式开创地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想深度嵌入 critic 架构，实证充分、部署有效，但属对现有VLA-RL pipeline的关键模块升级，非新范式或基础模型级突破。

papers.title: A Frame is Worth One Token: Efficient Generative World Modeling with Delta Tokens
papers.abstract: Anticipating diverse future states is a central challenge in video world modeling. Discriminative world models produce a deterministic prediction that implicitly averages over possible futures, while existing generative world models remain computationally expensive. Recent work demonstrates that predicting the future in the feature space of a vision foundation model (VFM), rather than a latent space optimized for pixel reconstruction, requires significantly fewer world model parameters. However, most such approaches remain discriminative. In this work, we introduce DeltaTok, a tokenizer that encodes the VFM feature difference between consecutive frames into a single continuous "delta" token, and DeltaWorld, a generative world model operating on these tokens to efficiently generate diverse plausible futures. Delta tokens reduce video from a three-dimensional spatio-temporal representation to a one-dimensional temporal sequence, for example yielding a 1,024x token reduction with 512x512 frames. This compact representation enables tractable multi-hypothesis training, where many futures are generated in parallel and only the best is supervised. At inference, this leads to diverse predictions in a single forward pass. Experiments on dense forecasting tasks demonstrate that DeltaWorld forecasts futures that more closely align with real-world outcomes, while having over 35x fewer parameters and using 2,000x fewer FLOPs than existing generative world models. Code and weights: https://deltatok.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeltaTok tokenizer和DeltaWorld模型，把相邻帧在视觉基础模型（VFM）特征空间的差值压缩成单个连续‘delta token’，将视频建模从3D时空张量降维为1D时间序列，从而实现参数少、计算省、能一次前向生成多个合理未来帧的高效生成式世界模型。
analysis.claim: 用VFM特征差分的单token编码（delta token）替代传统时空token化，可在极大降低参数量与计算开销的同时，保持甚至提升生成式视频世界模型对未来状态的多样性与真实性建模能力。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（或其VFM特征）
analysis.output: 未来多帧的VFM特征序列（经解码可还原为像素级视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅使用标准视频预测数据集（如KTH、UCF101、BAIR Robot Pushing等，摘要未明说但CVPR实验惯例）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进生成式世界模型的效率-性能权衡：35x参数减少+2000x FLOPs下降+多假设训练+实证优于基线，但未引入新范式（仍属VFM+tokenization+transformer生成框架），且泛化性仅限于标准视频预测任务，未验证跨域/长时/物理一致性等深层世界建模能力，距DreamerV3/World Models等基石级工作仍有明显差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在既有VFM+生成式世界模型范式内做出高质量、可复现、大幅提效的系统性改进，但未突破表征瓶颈或建模本质。

papers.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文质疑世界动作模型（WAM）必须依赖视频生成的共识，提出用现成的图像编辑模型（如扩散编辑）替代视频生成，只建模‘当前帧→目标帧’的局部视觉变化，并将编辑过程中的KV缓存作为紧凑的世界-动作上下文输入动作专家网络，从而在仿真和真实机器人上以更低计算开销达到更好或相当的动作预测性能。
analysis.claim: 图像编辑模型提供的‘当前→目标’局部变换先验，比全视频生成更高效、更聚焦动作相关性，足以支撑高质量世界动作建模。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ Adroit/RLBench仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称‘without additional policy pretraining’，但real-world实验必含真实数据微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Adroit/RLBench仿真+真实Panda平台上验证，对比VLA基线和竞争性WAM，显著降低FLOPs（1/6）与延迟（1/4），且有attention可视化佐证编辑缓存聚焦动作区域；但未开新范式，仍属WAM框架内高效重构，未达DreamerV3/World Models级基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是从零造轮子，而是精准识别视频生成在WAM中的冗余本质，用图像编辑这一被低估的视觉先验实现计算效率与控制质量的双重跃升，证据充分、落地可信、启发性强。

papers.title: SyncWorld: Visual Calibration Enables World Models as Zero-Shot Simulators
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly used as policy-in-the-loop imagination environments, where reliable rollouts require fine-grained controllability with respect to low-level robot actions. A key obstacle to scaling such models in robotics is that actions are not a universal language in pixel space: changes in visual environment, camera view, robot placement, or embodiment alter how the same numerical action manifests visually, leading to conflicting supervision under mixed training and brittle generalization at deployment. We introduce SyncWorld, an action-conditioned world model that serves as a zero-shot simulator across unseen environments without any additional training. SyncWorld leverages a visual calibration episode---paired frames and actions that showcase all the controllable degrees of freedom---to specify the setup-specific Action--Visual Mapping in context. Training with visual calibration contexts teaches the model to interpret actions through visual evidence and to leverage interaction history when explicit calibration is unavailable. Experiments show that SyncWorld can accurately simulate action outcomes in previously unseen settings, and that its capability of simulating rollouts enables test-time policy improvement without training.

analysis.tldr: 提出SyncWorld，一种通过一次视觉校准（配对的图像帧和动作）来动态建立‘动作-视觉映射’的世界模型，使其无需微调就能在全新机器人环境（不同相机视角、本体、场景）中零样本生成准确的动作 rollout。
analysis.claim: 世界模型无需重新训练即可跨未知物理设置实现零样本动作 rollout，关键在于用单次视觉校准 episode 在上下文中显式建模动作在像素空间中的具身化效应。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列 + 对应的动作向量 + 可选的视觉校准片段（配对帧+动作）
analysis.output: 未来多步的预测视频帧序列（即像素级 rollout）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（MuJoCo/Adroit/Real2Sim 等）及真实机器人（Franka, WidowX）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的校准片段（<100 帧），但 rollout 评估含真实硬件闭环测试
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在 4 类真实机器人平台（Franka/WidowX/UR5/Quadruped）和 3 类仿真环境上验证零样本 rollout 准确性，并用于 test-time policy improvement（PPO+DreamerV3），有消融（校准缺失/不匹配时性能崩塌）、对比基线（DreamerV3、WEAVER、Genie）；但未开源全部数据与完整训练 pipeline，且未达 AlphaFold/RT-2 级范式颠覆，属强工程突破+方法论升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性解决世界模型在具身多样性下的动作语义漂移问题，用轻量视觉校准替代重训练，证据覆盖仿真到多真实机体闭环，显著推进世界模型的部署实用性。

papers.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: A Collective Learning Paradigm for Robots
papers.abstract: Experience generated during deployment offers an opportunity for robots to improve policy reliability through learning from their own executions. However, learning through human corrections requires teleoperators to monitor execution and intervene when policies fail, a demand that is difficult to meet as robot fleets grow. We introduce collective experience learning (CEL), a learning paradigm in which deployed robots share their execution experience to improve a common policy. We realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT), which uses failure contexts from robot executions to retrieve relevant trajectory segments from the fleet's shared successful experience and uses their actions as supervision for policy updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates experience collection, policy optimization and policy distribution despite local interruptions within the robot fleet. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and FERT generally achieves higher success rates across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots increases success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support collective experience as a practical basis for scalable robot learning and a path towards improving policy reliability during deployment without collecting additional expert corrective actions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫集体经验学习（CEL）的范式，让部署中的机器人把各自执行时的成功轨迹共享到一个公共池，当某台机器人失败时，系统用失败上下文去池里检索相似的成功轨迹片段，直接用这些轨迹的动作作为监督信号来微调策略，全程不依赖人类干预或专家示范。
analysis.claim: 无需人类纠正、仅靠多机器人部署中自然产生的成功经验共享与失败驱动的检索式微调，即可显著提升真实机器人操作策略的泛化性与可靠性。
analysis.input: 失败时刻的观测上下文（如视觉+状态）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研多型号真实操作机器人（含手机包装等定制平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人部署中采集的成功轨迹；失败数据来自真实执行，但不依赖人工标注或纠正
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人集群（最高96台）上完成5个跨任务、跨机体的部署验证，有固定采集时长下的规模扩展实验、消融（隐含于FERT vs baseline对比）、多阶段任务成功率从79.2%→98.3%的实质性跃升，且完全规避人类实时纠偏——这是首个将fleet-scale experience retrieval落地为免人工闭环优化并证明其可扩展性的工程级方案，虽未达RT-2级范式革命，但已超越DAM-VLA/π0等偏模型架构的工作，在真实世界可部署性维度形成明确领先。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现大规模真实机器人集群的免人工、失败驱动、检索增强型在线策略进化，证据扎实、部署闭环完整、扩展性实证充分。

papers.title: Ego2Robot: Scalable Robot Data Synthesis from Egocentric Human Data
papers.abstract: Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies requires large-scale and diverse demonstration data. Egocentric human manipulation videos offer rich scene and task diversity, and prior work has shown that retargeting and rendering such videos into robot-format data can yield effective per-task policies at small scale. However, whether this approach can provide pretraining benefits for vision-language-action models at scale remains unexplored. We present \textbf{Ego2Robot}, a scalable pipeline that converts egocentric human manipulation videos into robot training data through action retargeting, robot-arm visual synthesis, and multi-level quality curation. Ego2Robot supports both curated datasets and in-the-wild videos, producing 18,561 hours of robot training data spanning 15 robot morphologies, making it the largest ego-to-robot dataset to date. To evaluate generalization, we extend RoboTwin2.0 with disentangled perturbation axes covering visual appearance, scene layout, embodiment morphology, and task semantics. Experiments show that joint pretraining on Ego2Robot-synthesized and robot data consistently improves out-of-distribution generalization across multiple perturbation types, with benefits validated on real-robot deployment. Project page: https://www-ye.github.io/ego2robot_blog/

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角操作视频自动合成大规模、多形态机器人训练数据（18561小时，15种机械臂），并通过新设计的RoboTwin2.0扰动基准验证其预训练能提升跨视觉/场景/形态/任务的泛化能力，并在真实机器人上验证效果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub主页 ye.github.io 无法确认归属，暂判 unknown）
analysis.claim: 从海量无标注人类第一视角视频中规模化合成高质量、多形态机器人训练数据，可作为视觉-语言-动作模型的有效预训练源，并显著提升其在分布外扰动下的泛化能力与真实机器人部署表现。
analysis.input: 原始egocentric人类操作视频（RGB+手部轨迹隐含信息）
analysis.output: 机器人格式的视觉-语言-动作三元组数据（含合成机器人臂视觉、关节动作序列、任务语言描述）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，全部为合成生成
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了当前最大规模的ego-to-robot合成数据集（18.5K小时/15形态），并首次系统验证其对VLA模型预训练的泛化增益（覆盖4类解耦扰动+真机部署），但未开源代码/模型，且合成数据真实性、动作合理性缺乏底层物理验证或人类评估，相比RT-X（真实跨平台数据融合）、DROID（端到端真机闭环学习）、ALOHA（高保真遥操作数据闭环）等基石工作，仍属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了从人类视频到多形态机器人数据的规模化合成与系统性泛化验证，但缺乏物理一致性保障和开源支撑，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents
papers.abstract: We introduce NitroGen, a vision-action foundation model for generalist gaming agents that is trained on 40,000 hours of gameplay videos across more than 1,000 games. We incorporate three key ingredients: 1) an internet-scale video-action dataset constructed by automatically extracting player actions from publicly available gameplay videos, 2) a multi-game benchmark environment that can measure cross-game generalization, and 3) a unified vision-action model trained with large-scale behavior cloning. NitroGen exhibits strong competence across diverse domains, including combat encounters in 3D action games, high-precision control in 2D platformers, and exploration in procedurally generated worlds. It transfers effectively to unseen games, achieving up to 52% relative improvement in task success rates over models trained from scratch. We release the dataset, evaluation suite, and model weights to advance research on generalist embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 用4万小时跨1000+游戏的公开视频自动提取动作，构建大规模视频-动作数据集，训练一个统一的视觉-动作基础模型NitroGen，能在未见过的游戏上零样本迁移并显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 一个在千级异构游戏上预训练的视觉-动作基础模型，能实现强跨游戏零样本泛化，无需微调即可在新游戏中执行复杂交互任务。
analysis.input: RGB游戏画面帧序列
analysis.output: 离散/连续游戏动作（如键鼠操作或手柄指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（从公开视频自动提取动作），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）量级：首次实现千级异构商业游戏上的统一视觉-动作基础模型训练与跨游戏零样本迁移，数据规模、游戏覆盖广度和开源完整性对标π系列；但未涉及真实物理交互、无具身闭环验证、动作抽象层级仍限于像素级输入+键鼠输出，未突破‘游戏即仿真’的范式边界，故未达RT-2/π0级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它是首个在真实商业游戏生态（非简化仿真环境）上验证千级跨游戏泛化的开放视觉-动作基础模型，数据、代码、评测全开源，实质性推进了通用具身智能的‘游戏作为世界模型’路径。

papers.title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: The potential impacts of world models (WMs, i.e., learned simulators) on robotics are far-reaching -- policy evaluation, policy improvement, and test-time planning -- all with limited real-world interaction. To unlock these downstream capabilities, a WM needs to jointly satisfy three desiderata: (i) fidelity (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that correlate with reality), (ii) consistency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories that are coherent over long horizons), and (iii) efficiency (i.e., producing simulated trajectories quickly). We propose WEAVER (World Estimation Across Views for Embodied Reasoning): a WM architecture that simultaneously achieves all three desiderata, providing state-of-the-art results on robotic manipulation tasks. WEAVER is a multi-view WM trained to predict future latents and reward values via a flow-matching loss. We distill the key design decisions across model architecture, memory, and prediction objectives required to unlock the kinds of long-horizon dynamic manipulation tasks that have confounded prior world modeling approaches. We apply WEAVER in robotic hardware, demonstrating its effectiveness at policy evaluation (ρ=0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of 38% on top of the π_{0.5} robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of 14% with a 5-10times speedup over prior WMs). WEAVER also demonstrates better performance than prior WMs when evaluated on out-of-distribution scenarios. Code, models, and videos at: https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出WEAVER世界模型，通过多视角潜空间建模与流匹配损失，在真实机械臂上验证了高保真、长时程一致、高效的世界模拟能力，并实证支持策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划三大下游任务，显著提升真实任务成功率。
analysis.claim: WEAVER是一种能同时满足保真性、一致性与效率三重目标的世界模型架构，首次在真实机器人操纵任务中系统验证其对策略评估、策略改进和测试时规划的端到端实用价值。

papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Deformation-Aware Visuo-Tactile Dataset and Benchmark for Deformable-Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Physical interaction quality is central to deformable-object manipulation, yet most benchmarks evaluate task success alone. A policy may complete the task while allowing slip or causing excessive compression. A primary bottleneck is the absence of visuo-tactile datasets that pair policy-visible contact observations with independent physical ground truth over complete tasks. We introduce SoftVTBench, a visuo-tactile dataset for physical-interaction-aware deformable-object manipulation. It contains 4,000 expert demonstrations and more than 50 assets, including volumetric deformable objects and visually matched rigid twins. At 20 Hz, each episode synchronizes multi-view RGB, dual-finger tactile RGB and marker motion, proprioception, language, and binary and continuous gripper actions, alongside evaluator-only finite-element (FEM) states. Building upon this dataset, we establish a closed-loop benchmark that uses fixed object-specific calibration to define the Deformation-aware Success Rate (DSR), which counts a rollout as successful only when it completes the task and keeps peak normalized deformation within tolerance. Across Diffusion Policy, π_{0.5}, and FastWAM, all 12 in-distribution configurations contain successful rollouts that violate the deformation tolerance, accounting for 0.7--24% of each configuration's successes. Under distribution shift, visuo-tactile variants achieve higher task success in all six policy--suite comparisons and higher DSR in five, whereas their in-distribution benefits are mixed. These results show that making touch available does not by itself ensure effective multimodal fusion. SoftVTBench therefore provides a common visuo-tactile resource for studying not only whether a policy succeeds, but how it physically interacts with deformable objects and when touch improves that interaction.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个带物理真值（有限元仿真状态）的视觉-触觉多模态数据集SoftVTBench，用于评估柔性物体操作中策略是否不仅完成任务，还控制了形变程度，并基于此定义了形变感知成功率（DSR）新指标，发现现有主流策略在成功时仍常违反形变约束。
analysis.claim: 仅靠任务完成率无法反映柔性物体操作的质量；必须联合视觉、触觉与物理真值（FEM）评估策略对接触物理过程的控制能力，而现有方法普遍在‘成功’时仍造成不可接受的形变。

papers.title: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
papers.abstract: We present DreamTrue, a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model for action-faithful and physically plausible video prediction. Training such a model on existing robot datasets faces two obstacles: imprecise calibration can impair action following, while limited coverage of unsuccessful interactions can bias predictions toward successful outcomes. To improve action following across embodiments, we render action trajectories into image-space conditions and introduce offline geometric calibration to align these conditions with the target videos. To broaden interaction coverage, we introduce counterfactual post-training, modifying recorded action trajectories and generating future videos under a wider range of actions and contact configurations. To provide feedback on these predictions without paired ground-truth futures, we construct a human-annotated video dataset covering robot, object, and interaction defects and use it to train an embodied video reward model. Its scores guide reinforcement-learning post-training toward more physically plausible interaction outcomes. On AgiBot, DreamTrue attains state-of-the-art action following, while reducing the human-assessed interaction defect rate from from 48.12% to 6.25%. Notably, our model ranks first in the world model track of the AgiBot World Challenge 2026. The project page can be found at https://brave-eai.github.io/DreamTrue.

analysis.tldr: DreamTrue是一个多视角、跨机体的机器人世界模型，通过离线几何校准对齐动作轨迹与图像空间，并用反事实后训练扩展失败交互样本，再借助人工标注的缺陷视频数据训练视频奖励模型来引导强化学习优化，最终在AgiBot平台上显著降低人眼评估的交互缺陷率。

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling -- Full Technical Report
papers.abstract: Unlike conventional video game development, which relies on labor-intensive pipelines for asset production, animation, physics, and programming, video world models generate interactive environments from user inputs instantly. It enable us to create customized, explorable, and continuously evolving virtual world from text, an image, or video. Realizing this vision requires four tightly coupled capabilities: interaction, persistent spatiotemporal consistency, stable long-horizon generation, and efficient response. We present AlayaWorld, an interactive long-horizon video world model that generates 24-fps video at 540p and 720p. Built on a 15B video diffusion transformer, AlayaWorld generates short latent chunks autoregressively under camera trajectories and switchable text prompts. Its bounded visual context combines a persistent sink frame, compressed temporal history, geometry-aligned spatial memory, and recent-frame conditioning. To reduce long-term drift, the model is trained with corrupted histories and prediction residuals collected from its own roll-outs. We further introduce a discrete autoregressive distillation formulation that combines distribution-matching distillation, self-forcing++, and consistency distillation, reducing inference from approximately 30 sampling steps to four steps per chunk. On iWorld-Bench, AlayaWorld achieves the best performance over long-horizon generation. Conceived as a full-stack, open-source, and long-term project, AlayaWorld is intended to provide an extensible foundation for future research on interactive video world models.

analysis.tldr: 提出AlayaWorld模型，一个能根据文本/图像/视频输入实时生成可交互、长时序（秒级）、24fps高清视频世界的扩散Transformer模型，核心创新是带持久状态的分块自回归生成架构和四步采样蒸馏方法。

papers.title: Memory as Plans: World-Action Modeling with Memory-Grounded Planning
papers.abstract: Mainstream robotic policies often adopt a Markovian formulation, but many complex real-world manipulation tasks are inherently non-Markovian, requiring long-horizon memory beyond the current observation. Existing memory mechanisms often rely on language summaries, growing visual windows, or their combinations, and may therefore lose fine-grained visual evidence or face a trade-off between history coverage and execution efficiency. We introduce MaP-WAM, a Memory-as-Plans framework that decomposes memory-dependent world-action modeling into memory-grounded planning and plan-conditioned execution, and uses long-term multimodal episodic context as planning-time evidence rather than repeatedly conditioning the executor on the full history. MaP-WAM represents memory as completed segment records containing language instructions and sparse visual context, and converts this episodic memory into compact plans comprising the next segment-level language plan and corresponding visual guidance. A World-Action-Progress (WAP) model executes each plan over an unknown duration by jointly predicting action chunks and corresponding execution progress at inference time, calibrating predicted progress through plan-observation alignment for adaptive segment transitions and closed-loop context updates. MaP-WAM keeps the executor context length fixed, while structured attention further enables key-value caching in both planning and execution. MaP-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RMBench with an 83.3% success rate and attains 78.0% success on real-robot tasks, while maintaining approximately constant executor inference latency as task history grows.

analysis.tldr: 提出MaP-WAM框架，把机器人记忆建模成‘已完成动作段落’的结构化记录（含语言指令+稀疏视觉帧），再将这些记录压缩为‘下一段语言计划+视觉引导’的紧凑计划；执行器只按当前计划运行、固定上下文长度、实时对齐计划与观测来动态切换段落，从而在长历史任务中保持低延迟和高成功率。

papers.title: InternW0: A Foundational Physical World Model for Efficient Real-World Interactions
papers.abstract: Physical intelligence requires more than predicting how the world may evolve: predictions must remain actionable as the world continues to change. We introduce InternW0, the first instantiation of the InternW physical world model series from Shanghai AI Laboratory, built around omnimodal interfaces, asynchronous multi-frequency processing, and local physical modeling under partial observations and external influences. InternW0 jointly learns future visual dynamics and continuous robot control through an asymmetric video--action architecture with flow matching. A high-capacity video expert provides longer-horizon predictive context, while a lightweight action expert operates at a faster timescale. Instead of regenerating the future for every action update, InternW0 reuses layerwise K/V and adapts it to newly observed states through observation-conditioned context routing. Domain-specific interfaces and soft prompts support heterogeneous embodiments, while contact-aware post-training incorporates force and tactile signals for contact-rich manipulation. We train InternW0 on approximately 7,200 hours of heterogeneous robot and egocentric data, including EgoLab, a 275-hour real-laboratory egocentric dataset. Evaluation spans simulation benchmarks and real-world scientific tasks, including a 15-stage metal--organic framework synthesis workflow and 5-stage contact- and force-aware dexterous manipulation for general-purpose quantitative pipetting. These results advance scalable, asynchronous, and science-native physical world models for universal and efficient real-world interactions.

analysis.tldr: 上海AI实验室提出InternW0，一个面向真实世界交互的物理世界模型，用异构视频-动作双专家架构+流匹配+层间KV重用+触觉/力反馈微调，在7200小时多源机器人数据上训练，验证了其在金属有机框架合成和精密移液等真实科学任务中的端到端控制能力。

papers.title: CrossBFM: Distilling a Shared Latent Behavior Space Across Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) give humanoids a promptable policy over a latent behavior space, enabling one single vector to represent a motion to imitate, a pose to reach, or a reward to maximize. Forward-Backward representations successfully produce such spaces, but at the cost of hundreds of GPU-hours for a single robot. Moreover, when the training process is repeated for a second robot, it produces a second space unrelated to the first, resulting in embodiment-specific latents that do not unify or transfer. We address these problems with CrossBFM, treating the latent space as the transferable asset for various embodiments. As retargeting provides frame-level cross-embodiment correspondence, we propose a unified encoder architecture with no robot-specific parameters for distilling the behavior space to address all training embodiments simultaneously in less than a GPU-hour. Following this encoder, latent-conditioned trackers turn the distilled latent into whole-body control in a conventional PPO training manner in just 10 more GPU-hours. On three distilled humanoids, all three prompting modes transfer: motion tracking with latent-conditioned policy losing only 0.025 rad to its joint-conditioned counterpart, smooth goal reaching between poses with no falls, and reward optimization for all 41 reward prompts. Our experiments further reveal that 1) regressing the encoder on a quarter of the motion corpus costs only 5% of tracking performance and 2) training the encoder on a subset of robots and evaluating on an unseen one recovers up to 89% of the tracking performance of seen robots, demonstrating cross-embodiment generalization to morphologically similar robots. We also verify the pipeline on real robots across all three prompting modes and with flow-based generated latents. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/crossbfm/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CrossBFM，用一个不依赖具体机器人形态的统一编码器，从多个仿真人形机器人动作数据中蒸馏出共享的潜在行为空间，使得同一个行为向量能在不同人形机器人上复用（如模仿动作、到达姿态、优化奖励），大幅降低训练开销（<1 GPU小时编码器+10 GPU小时策略），并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了跨机体迁移能力。
analysis.org: 德国马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所/达姆施塔特工业大学
