analysis.significance_reason: 首次在BFM范式下系统解决跨机体潜在空间不一致问题，实证扎实：3种人形机体+3类提示+真实机器人部署+消融（子集训练/四分之一数据）；但未突破‘行为即token’或‘人类视频驱动零样本’等更高阶范式，也未挑战复杂环境交互或长时序任务，相比Human-as-Humanoid（95分）或ω-0（94分）仍属重要但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现跨人形机体共享行为潜空间的高效蒸馏与真实机验证，解决了BFM落地的核心可迁移瓶颈，但尚未触及更广义的具身通用性边界。

papers.title: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.abstract: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.

analysis.tldr: 提出OneWM框架，用统一因果训练让世界模型（预测动作后的视觉变化）和动作生成（策略学习）互相增强：在LIBERO等仿真基准和真实机器人上验证，用动作条件化世界建模能提升策略泛化性，反过来策略学习也能提升多视角世界预测精度。
analysis.claim: 在统一因果训练框架下，世界建模与动作生成存在可实证的双向增益关系，而非单向辅助。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作指令（或隐式动作条件）
analysis.output: 下一帧预测（世界建模）或动作序列/策略输出（动作生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仿真为主），仅少量real-robot policy实验作补充验证
analysis.significance_reason: 实证了世界模型与策略学习的双向增益，在多个标准仿真基准（LIBERO、RoboCasa365）上做了跨场景泛化验证，并有少量真机策略部署；但未引入新架构范式、未解决状态持久性等核心瓶颈、未开源代码/模型，相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作仍属扎实但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——首次系统验证了统一因果训练下世界建模与动作生成的互惠性，证据扎实但未突破建模范式，工程复现门槛中等。

papers.title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
papers.abstract: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. We instantiate this paradigm with Trace2Env, a learning-free framework for settings where the original system is unavailable but historical interaction traces remain accessible. Trace2Env reconstructs these traces into a reusable environment worldbook containing environment schemas, grounded evidence, and induced behavioral knowledge. At runtime, the world model agent actively consults the worldbook together with persistent episodic state to infer each action's observation and lasting state effects. Across nine environments, Trace2Env improves both next-observation fidelity and long-horizon interaction consistency over conventional prompt-based LWMs. In multi-turn interaction, task agent actions generated against Trace2Env remain valid more often when replayed in the real environment, indicating that its simulated dynamics better preserve the consequences of earlier actions across successive turns. These results establish agentic language world modeling as an alternative direction for building realistic environment replicas without reconstructing the original executable system.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Trace2Env框架，不重建真实可执行环境，而是从历史交互日志（traces）中自动构建一个‘世界书’（worldbook），再用语言模型代理作为动态世界模型，在线查询该书并维护持久状态，来模拟环境响应；目标是让LLM任务代理在仿真中生成的动作，在真实环境中仍大概率有效。
analysis.claim: 仅靠历史交互痕迹即可构建具备持久状态和因果一致性的语言世界模型，无需访问原始可执行环境，且其仿真能显著提升任务代理在真实环境中的动作泛化有效性。
analysis.input: 历史交互轨迹（action-observation序列）+ 当前任务代理的动作指令
analysis.output: 下一时刻的观测文本 + 环境持久状态更新（隐式）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖高质量、多轮、带状态变化的历史交互日志；未说明是否含真实机器人数据，仅提‘environments’泛指软件系统（如网页/API/游戏）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘世界书’抽象和无执行体建模思路，但在实证上仅验证9个（未公开细节的）软件环境、无代码/模型开源、无消融实验、未与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）对比架构或控制性能，仅用‘重放有效性’间接评估——属扎实但窄幅的增量，未触及世界模型核心挑战（如状态解耦、长程因果建模、可微分动力学），远未达基石论文量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将trace建模、schema提取、状态缓存等已有技术组装成新流程，但缺乏底层机制创新与严格验证，暂未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Foresight: Failure Detection for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation with Action-Conditioned World Model Latents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon tasks are common in real-world robotic deployments, yet failure detection for such tasks remains underexplored. Detecting failures in long-horizon robotic tasks is particularly challenging because failure onset is often ambiguous and dense temporal annotations are typically unavailable. We present Foresight, a failure detection framework that monitors manipulation trajectories using latent representations from an action-conditioned world model. Foresight is trained using only final task-level success or failure labels. By leveraging predictive world-model embeddings, our method provides a unified framework for failure detection across different policies. We further use functional conformal prediction (FCP) to calibrate detection thresholds adaptively. We evaluate Foresight with state-of-the-art vision-language-action policies in simulation on LIBERO-Long, ManiSkill-Long, and BEHAVIOR-1K, compare it against state-of-the-artfailure detection methods, and validate it on real robots with three long-horizon tasks on a ReactorX-200 arm and one task on a Franka arm. Our results suggest that action-conditioned world-model embeddings provide a scalable representation for reliable failure monitoring in long-horizon manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出Foresight框架，用动作条件化的世界模型隐状态来检测长时程机器人操作任务中的失败，只用任务级成功/失败标签训练，不依赖逐帧失败标注，在多个仿真基准和真实机械臂上验证了有效性。
analysis.claim: 动作条件化的世界模型隐状态可作为无需密集标注、跨策略通用的长时程操作失败检测信号，结合功能化共形预测能自适应校准检测阈值。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列+动作序列（或策略输出的动作）
analysis.output: 二分类失败预警信号（是否已发生/即将发生失败）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人长时程任务的执行结果（成功/失败标签），但不依赖逐帧失败标注；仿真中完全无真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在长时程失败检测这一长期被忽视的实用瓶颈问题上，首次系统性验证了世界模型隐空间作为失败表征的鲁棒性与泛化性，真机覆盖多机体多任务且对比SOTA方法，但未引入新世界模型架构或持久状态机制，未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟世界模型隐表示巧妙迁移至失败检测新任务，实证充分、部署可行，但核心组件（action-conditioned world model + FCP）均为已有技术的组合创新，非原理性突破。

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
papers.abstract: Game worlds have traditionally been built through labor-intensive production pipelines, making them costly to develop, difficult to customization, and expensive to modify after deployment. Recent advances in video world models offer a fundamentally different paradigm. Rather than explicitly authoring every component of a virtual environment, these models autoregressively synthesize future observations conditioned on the current world state and user interactions, enabling playable worlds to be generated online. Trained on both gameplay recordings and real-world videos, they can capture diverse visual appearances and physical dynamics, opening new opportunities for interactive applications beyond gaming, including embodied intelligence. In this paper, we present AlayaWorld, a full-stack open-source framework for building interactive generative worlds. AlayaWorld enables open-ended real-time interaction, allowing users to freely navigate and perform diverse actions such as combat, spell casting, and monster summoning. The framework unifies the complete development-from data preparation model architecture, model training, inference acceleration, and deployment-within a modular and extensible architecture. Alongside the framework, we release reproducible pipelines, reference implementations, evaluation tools, and comprehensive documentation, establishing a practical foundation for future research and real-time applications of generative world models.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫AlayaWorld的开源框架，用视频世界模型自回归生成可交互的游戏世界，支持实时导航和施法等动作，但全文未提供任何实证结果（如定量指标、消融实验、真机/仿真验证、跨任务泛化测试），仅描述系统架构和发布配套工具。
analysis.claim: AlayaWorld是一个全栈开源框架，能通过视频世界模型实现长时程、可玩、可交互的生成式虚拟世界构建。
analysis.input: 当前世界状态+用户交互指令（如‘施放火球术’）
analysis.output: playable video frames + interactive world state transitions
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖 gameplay recordings 和 real-world videos，但未说明是否含真实机器人交互数据或物理ground truth
analysis.significance_reason: 虽宣称‘full-stack’和‘playable’，但无任何定量评估（如world model accuracy、action grounding fidelity、horizon length benchmarking）、无与DreamerV3/Genie等基线的对比、无消融验证模块有效性、未证明其是否具备persistent state或closed-loop interaction能力；实质是工程集成而非范式突破，显著落后于World Models（97分）及Genie（94分）等已验证的生成式世界建模工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——仅有系统描述和开源承诺，缺乏世界模型核心所需的预测精度、状态一致性、闭环交互实证，尚未达到可验证的‘生成式世界’门槛。

papers.title: RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures
papers.abstract: Pretrained video generative models are promising backbones for visuomotor control, but their imagined futures often drift from task intent and are not reliably action-conditional. As a result, these models can be difficult to use for planning or policy extraction. To address these limitations, we propose RoboTALES, a single-stage framework that learns task-aligned simulated futures and uses them to train robot policies. Our approach introduces two key innovations: (1) a hierarchical LLM-based planner that breaks complex tasks into a sequence of subgoals to guide the model's imagination; and (2) a VLM-based critic that evaluates these ``imagined'' futures and uses reward-based feedback to keep the model's internal representations focused on the goal. By anchoring the video generator in abstract reasoning, we produce temporally consistent rollouts and more coherent actions. We evaluate RoboTALES on diverse manipulation tasks from RoboCasa and LIBERO10, and show that our method consistently outperforms existing methods, especially in long-horizon tasks. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/hananshafi/RoboTALES.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型做任务分解规划、视觉语言模型做未来想象质量打分，联合训练视频生成模型来生成更符合任务目标的机器人动作序列，从而提升长程操作任务的策略性能。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将抽象推理（LLM规划+VLM批评）嵌入视频生成过程，可显著提升生成未来帧的任务对齐性，进而改善长时程机器人操作策略的泛化与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（RoboCasa/LIBERO10），无真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真环境下首次系统性地将LLM子目标分解与VLM未来评估耦合进视频生成式策略训练，实证显示长程任务SOTA提升明显，但未跨机体/未上真机/未解决sim2real鸿沟，属扎实的范式增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有洞见、开源完整、在主流仿真benchmark上验证充分，但仍是纯仿真框架，尚未触及具身智能落地的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
papers.abstract: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. Recent multimodal generative systems have demonstrated similar capabilities: they can integrate multimodal context and synthesize visual outputs that depict changes in the world. To characterize this emerging trajectory, we organize model capabilities into a four-level hierarchy and discover that higher-level tasks remain relatively underexplored despite model progress. To bridge this gap, we explore model performance on multi-step world state prediction, a high-level task that requires models to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references. Such a task requires models to possess entangled understanding and generation capabilities, as well as extensive world knowledge to translate human action sequences, physical transformations, and abstract visual reasoning into coherent visual outputs. We introduce WorldCast, a benchmark comprising 320 manually designed cases across eight categories, and evaluate 12 representative models. The conducted experiments yield three key insights: (a) advances in frontier models are rapidly pushing the boundaries of intelligent world modeling, with the GPT-Image-2.5 System scoring 72.8 and demonstrating early-stage visual state prediction capabilities on real-world tasks; (b) WorldCast reveals substantial gaps between models: even Nano Banana Pro reaches only 42.8 and the best open-source model scores 20.1, with deficits in handling complex context, entangled references, and reasoning-heavy tasks; (c) strong generative models effectively draw on the capabilities of their underlying language models. These findings highlight the need for multimodal generative models that are capable of dynamic planning and reasoning while also being deeply unified to faithfully simulate real-world states.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫WorldCast的视觉世界状态预测新基准，包含320个手工设计的多步预测案例，用来评测多模态生成模型能否根据图文等输入，连续预测未来多个时间步的视觉场景变化。
analysis.claim: 多模态生成模型在多步世界状态预测这一高阶任务上能力严重不足，现有模型（包括GPT-Image-2.5）仅展现初步能力，且性能差距巨大，需构建更统一、具动态规划与物理/动作推理能力的世界建模范式。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（如图像+文本描述）及多样化参考信息（如动作序列、抽象指令、物理变化提示）
analysis.output: 连续多个时间步的生成式视觉输出（即未来世界状态的图像序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯合成/人工构造案例
analysis.significance_reason: 仅提出新benchmark和现象性评测（无新模型架构/训练范式/世界状态表示机制），未解决世界建模的核心挑战（如持久状态核心、时序因果建模、可微物理引擎耦合），所有实验均停留在静态图像生成层面，与World Models/DreamerV3/WEAVER等具备闭环控制、状态记忆、强化学习集成的真实世界建模工作存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——用‘世界状态预测’包装多步图像生成任务，但既无状态变量建模、也无动力学约束或闭环验证，本质是视觉语言模型的外推能力评测，未触及世界模型领域真正的科学问题。

papers.title: H2R-Bench: Benchmarking Human-to-Robot Manipulation Video Generation in World Models
papers.abstract: Large-scale manipulation data is essential for robot learning, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Meanwhile, abundant egocentric human manipulation videos provide rich behavioral experiences, but transferring them across embodiments remains challenging due to differences between human hands and robotic end-effectors. Recent advances in video world models offer a promising pathway to synthesize robot-centric manipulation videos from human observations, while their cross-embodiment transfer capability remains largely unexplored. Therefore, we introduce H2R-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating cross-embodiment human-to-robot manipulation video generation, where models transform egocentric human demonstrations into robot manipulation videos under specified embodiments. Each benchmark instance contains a human demonstration video, target embodiment constraints, and source-grounded annotations covering task goals, action events, functional contacts, and object responses. H2R-Bench evaluates generated videos through five dimensions, including goal-state completion, action-event completion, functional contact transfer, embodiment correctness, and general video quality. We benchmark eleven state-of-the-art video generation models across six manipulation families and two robot embodiments. Our evaluation reveals that current video world models remain limited in human-to-robot manipulation transfer: even leading models often fail in embodiment consistency, functional interaction, and task execution. H2R-Bench provides a systematic diagnostic framework for evaluating whether video world models can bridge the human-to-robot embodiment gap and convert human manipulation observations into robot-centric training resources.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫H2R-Bench的评测基准，专门用来测试视频世界模型能否把人手操作的第一视角视频，准确转换成符合特定机器人结构（如夹爪或灵巧手）的、带物理合理动作和功能接触的机器人操作视频。
analysis.claim: 当前视频世界模型在跨形态（人→机器人）的操作视频生成上存在系统性缺陷，H2R-Bench首次提供可量化的多维诊断框架来暴露这些缺陷。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角的人类操作视频 + 目标机器人本体约束（如末端执行器类型、自由度）
analysis.output: 机器人视角/机器人本体执行的合成操作视频（含任务目标、动作事件、功能接触、物体响应等结构化语义）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖人类视频与人工标注
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个聚焦‘人→机器人’跨形态视频生成的结构化评测基准，覆盖5个可验证维度并实测11个SOTA模型，揭示了现有视频世界模型在功能接触建模、本体一致性等关键科学问题上的系统性失效；虽未开源代码/数据，但标注规范、评估协议完整，属扎实的里程碑式评测工作，但尚未达到Open X-Embodiment级的生态奠基地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——它不是提出新生成模型，而是用严谨多维评测戳破了当前视频世界模型在具身迁移上的幻觉，为后续真正可靠的机器人视频预训练划出清晰能力边界。

papers.title: StreamPI: Streaming Multimodal Temporal Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated effectiveness in robot manipulation, yet state-of-the-art models such as pi0.5 operate under a single-frame paradigm, limiting their ability to retain past observations and develop precise spatial perception. In this paper, we propose StreamPI, a streaming multimodal temporal modeling framework that equips single-frame VLA with temporal reasoning capability without introducing any additional parameters. One core design is instruction-anchored temporal modeling. It treats each (visual observation, language instruction) pair as an atomic temporal unit: bidirectional attention within each pair enables cross-modal fusion, while causal attention across pairs preserves autoregressive streaming inference. This ensures the language instruction serves as a persistent semantic anchor throughout task execution. To bridge the gap between synchronous training and asynchronous real-robot deployment, we introduce a andom-interval streaming training strategy: a proper inter-frame interval (e.g., every 3 frames) enables faster and smoother action execution. Beyond this, randomizing the interval further improves robustness to frame-timing perturbations, supporting asynchronous deployment in practice. Furthermore, by leveraging the length extrapolation capability of the LLM backbone, StreamPI seamlessly inherits pretrained single-frame weights and supports flexible single-frame and multi-frame inference. Experiments on real-robot tasks spanning memory-dependent and precise perception scenarios, as well as the simulation benchmark LIBERO, demonstrate that StreamPI outperforms pi0.5 across diverse tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把单帧视觉-语言-动作模型（如pi0.5）改造成能流式处理视频序列的模型StreamPI，不加参数、不重训，靠指令锚定的时序建模和随机帧间隔训练，让模型在真实机器人上更稳地做需记忆和精细感知的任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属，如非清华/港科/上交等常见团队署名，亦无企业logo式命名如Qwen-RobotManip/Xiaomi-Robotics-1）
analysis.claim: 仅通过架构重设计（指令锚定+因果跨对注意力）和随机间隔流式训练，即可赋予单帧VLA模型强时序建模能力，且零参数增量、无缝继承预训练权重、支持真实机器人异步部署。
analysis.input: 视频流（按随机间隔采样的图像帧）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续动作块或轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（未指明型号，但明确报告real-robot任务结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据（用于评估，但未说明是否用于训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在real-robot多任务（含记忆/精细感知）和LIBERO仿真基准上系统超越pi0.5，验证了流式时序建模的有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未展示跨机体泛化或大规模真实数据训练，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果推理、世界模型耦合），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙利用LLM长度外推与注意力机制重构实现零参数时序增强，在真实机器人上取得稳定增益，但缺乏开源与跨 embodiment 验证，尚未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级分量

papers.title: RoboFollow: Unveiling the Instruction Following Mirage in Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Modern embodied agents achieve impressive success rates, yet their actual instruction-following ability is far weaker than these numbers suggest. We trace this illusion to a structural property we term low scene entropy: when a visual scene admits only one valid task, language becomes redundant and a policy can score highly while barely using it. We introduce RoboFollow, a diagnostic benchmark with three principles: (1) High Scene Entropy: each training scene supports multiple kinematically distinct task branches, making vision alone insufficient and forcing reliance on language. (2) Hierarchical Diagnostic Protocol: a four-level protocol (L0--L3) progressively perturbs visual layout and semantics, probing whether equivalent instructions yield consistent behavior and distinct ones yield discriminable behavior across spatial relations, attributes, trajectory constraints, and logic. (3) Confound-Controlled Diagnosis: we simplify interaction objects, restrict actions to the trained repertoire and report stage-wise Intent and Execution scores, isolating comprehension from motor execution. Evaluation of nine VLA and WAM policies shows that strong L0 performance, where attained, does not reliably transfer to L1--L3 under our fine-tuning setup. Representative mitigations, including stronger VLM backbones, QA co-training, LangForce, and Classifier-Free Guidance, all fail to close this gap. RoboFollow exposes genuine instruction following as a critical, overlooked bottleneck. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboFollow and https://huggingface.co/datasets/AutoLab-SJTU/robofollow-data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前具身智能体的高指令成功率其实是假象，因为很多场景中只有一种合理动作，模型根本不用看语言就能猜对；为此他们构建了RoboFollow诊断基准，强制要求模型必须真正理解语言指令才能完成任务，并证明现有主流VLA模型在更严格的测试层级（L1-L3）上表现断崖式下降，且各种改进方法都无效。
analysis.claim: 当前具身智能体的指令跟随能力被严重高估，其高成功率源于低场景熵下的视觉捷径，而非真实语言理解；RoboFollow通过高熵场景与分层扰动协议首次系统性暴露并量化了这一根本瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真（PyBullet + Franka Emika Panda）
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是提出新模型，而是用严谨诊断框架戳破领域长期忽视的‘伪指令跟随’幻觉，证据扎实（9个SOTA模型全崩、4级扰动协议、消融控制严格）、开源完整、可复现性强；虽未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，但属近2年最有力的方法论批判与基准建设工作，显著推进了评估科学性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它没有造新模型，而是用诊断基准揭穿了整个领域评估体系的系统性缺陷，证据充分、设计严密、开源彻底，是评估范式层面的关键矫正。

papers.title: World Action Learning via Interaction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance
papers.abstract: Learning general-purpose robot policies requires large-scale real-world interaction data, yet collecting robot demonstrations remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric videos offer abundant human interaction experience with task-relevant semantics for robotic manipulation, but direct transfer is challenging for two reasons: latent actions inferred from frame reconstruction can be dominated by nuisance variation such as ego-camera motion, and human and robot behaviors often exhibit different temporal dynamics. We propose WING (World Action Learning via INteraction-Centric Spectral Latent Guidance), a framework for transferring interaction knowledge from egocentric videos to robot policies. WING first separates observer-induced motion from hand-object interaction and distills the interaction-centric component into latent actions. It then exploits the observation that cross-embodiment task semantics are concentrated in slowly varying temporal structures, identifying shared low-frequency components between egocentric latent actions and robot behaviors in the spectral domain and using them to guide action generation. WING achieves average success rates of 99.20% on LIBERO, 93.80% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 57.7% on RoboCasa-GR1, and also performs strongly across four real-world manipulation tasks under diverse generalization settings. These results show that interaction-centric spectral guidance provides an effective and scalable way to transfer physical interaction knowledge from human egocentric video to robot control. Project page: https://mikuz12.github.io/wing/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WING方法，从人类第一人称视角视频中提取手-物交互的慢变频谱特征（滤除相机抖动等干扰），再用这些低频语义特征引导机器人策略生成动作，从而绕过昂贵的真实机器人示范数据。
analysis.claim: 跨形态任务语义在时域上集中于低频结构，提取并对齐人类视频与机器人行为的交互中心谱特征，可实现高质量、可泛化的视频到机器人策略迁移。
analysis.input: 人类第一人称视角视频（RGB序列）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D pose + gripper）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据，仅需少量真实机器人微调或零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰物理动机（交互语义低频性）和实证支撑（LIBERO/RoboTwin/RoboCasa多基准+4个真实任务），但未开源代码/模型，且未与主流世界模型范式（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在统一设定下对比，也未证明其谱引导机制相比简单时间对齐或CLIP蒸馏有不可替代性；属显著贡献，但未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了有物理直觉的频域交互迁移机制，并在多个仿真与真实任务上验证有效性，但缺乏开源与范式级对比，属于扎实的增量推进而非真突破

papers.title: GRAIL: Generating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from 3D Assets and Video Priors
papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid loco-manipulation requires robot-compatible demonstrations across diverse objects, whole-body motions, and scene geometries, but teleoperation and motion capture are difficult to scale because each collection depends on physical setups, instrumented actors, and robot operation. We present GRAIL, a digital generation pipeline that remains fully virtual until deployment: it composes 3D assets, simulator-ready scenes, and priors from video foundation models (VFMs) to synthesize interactions without rebuilding physical environments or teleoperating the robot. Rather than reconstructing unconstrained in-the-wild videos, GRAIL starts from fully specified 3D configurations in which object geometry, camera parameters, metric scale, environment depth, and a robot-proportioned character are known before video generation and reused during reconstruction. This privileged setup better conditions 4D recovery, allowing model-based object tracking, human motion estimation, and interaction-aware optimization to reconstruct metric 4D human-object interaction (HOI) trajectories with reduced depth ambiguity and morphology mismatch. We retarget the recovered motions to a humanoid robot and train complementary task-general trackers: an object-aware latent adaptor for manipulation and a scene-aware tracker for terrain traversal. GRAIL produces over 20,000 sequences spanning pick-up, object manipulation, sitting, and terrain traversal. Using only GRAIL-generated data, we train egocentric visual policies through a sim-to-real pipeline and deploy them on a Unitree G1 humanoid, achieving 84\% real-world success on diverse object pick-up and 90\% success on stair-climbing.

analysis.tldr: 用3D资产+视频基础模型生成带精确几何和尺度的4D人-物交互视频，再转成机器人可执行的全身运动轨迹，全程不依赖真实机器人操作或动捕，仅靠生成数据就让Unitree G1在真实世界完成抓取和上楼梯任务。
analysis.claim: 完全虚拟生成的、几何一致且机器人可部署的全身loco-manipulation轨迹，能直接支撑真实人形机器人在复杂任务中达到高成功率，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体资产+场景几何+相机参数+机器人比例人体模型+视频基础模型先验
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的全身动作轨迹（含关节控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机部署验证）、Isaac Gym（仿真训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖公开视频基础模型（如VideoMAE、InternVideo）和3D资产库（未明说但隐含ShapeNet/Objaverse类）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯虚拟3D+视频先验端到端生成可部署于真实人形机器人的loco-manipulation策略，覆盖20k+多样任务序列，在Unitree G1上达成84%/90%真实任务成功率，证据强度（真机+多任务+定量+消融见附录）与ASAP/ULTRA同档，但未开源代码/模型，略逊GR00T N1/H2O的开放生态。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它绕过了人形机器人最卡脖子的真实演示瓶颈，用可控生成替代采集，且在真机上验证了泛化性与鲁棒性，不是概念演示而是可复现的技术路径。

papers.title: Trimming the Long-Tail of Visual World Modeling Evaluation
papers.abstract: Physical interactions follow a long-tailed distribution: a set of common and regular interactions dominates human experience and visual data, while a broad spectrum of rare and irregular interactions remains underrepresented. Although recent visual world models, including image and video generation models, achieve impressive realism on existing benchmarks, they primarily focus on simulating common physical interactions. This raises a central question: Do current visual world models internalize and generalize physical principles? In this work, we introduce Tailor-Bench, a benchmark that challenges world models to simulate irregular physical interactions. To enable systematic evaluation, we design three scenario modes that progressively challenge model reasoning: Regular scenarios reflect common tool-task pairs, Unconventional scenarios replace conventional tools with attribute-compatible substitutes to test affordance generalization, and Impossible scenarios introduce attribute-violating tools to probe constraint awareness. Additionally, we design two complementary settings under a unified evaluation protocol: predictive generation requires inferring outcomes without guidance, while descriptive generation specifies the target outcome for faithful realization. Our experimental results reveal a clear long-tail gap in physical world modeling: performance degrades from Regular to Unconventional and Impossible scenarios, indicating limited generalization beyond common interactions. Failure analysis further shows that models rely on superficial visual patterns: image models fail to realize correct state changes, while video models further suffer from temporal inconsistencies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉世界模型（如图像/视频生成模型）在模拟常见物理交互上表现好，但在罕见、反常甚至违反物理规律的交互场景下严重失效；为此构建了Tailor-Bench基准，通过三类递进式场景（常规/非常规/不可能）和两种生成模式（预测式/描述式）系统评测模型对物理原理的内化与泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 当前视觉世界模型并未真正内化物理原理，其性能在长尾物理交互场景下显著退化，暴露了对表面视觉统计的依赖而非因果机制建模。
analysis.input: 文本描述+初始视觉帧（图像或视频起始帧）
analysis.output: 生成的目标视觉结果（图像或视频），需符合物理合理性
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于合成/可控仿真环境构建
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个聚焦物理长尾交互的系统性评测基准（Tailor-Bench），实证揭示主流视觉世界模型在非常规/不可能场景下的结构性失效，并给出可复现的失败模式分析（状态错误+时序不一致），但未提出新模型或训练范式，属于高价值诊断型工作，强于纯刷榜但弱于DreamerV3等具备闭环控制与持续状态建模的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型，而是用严谨设计的基准揭开了当前视觉世界模型‘物理幻觉’的盖子，证据扎实、视角独特，但未提供修复方案。

papers.title: Traj2Action: A Co-Denoising Framework for Trajectory-Guided Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer
papers.abstract: Learning diverse manipulation skills for real-world robots is severely bottlenecked by the reliance on costly and hard-to-scale teleoperated demonstrations. While human videos offer a scalable alternative, effectively transferring manipulation knowledge is fundamentally hindered by the significant morphological gap between human and robotic embodiments. To address this challenge and facilitate skill transfer from human to robot, we introduce Traj2Action, a novel framework that bridges this embodiment gap by using the 3D trajectory of the operational endpoint as a unified intermediate representation, and then transfers the manipulation knowledge embedded in this trajectory to the robot's actions. Our policy first learns to generate a coarse trajectory, which forms a high-level motion plan by leveraging both human and robot data. This plan then conditions the synthesis of precise, robot-specific actions (e.g., orientation and gripper state) within a co-denoising framework. Our work centers on two core objectives: first, the systematic verification of the Traj2Action framework's effectiveness-spanning architectural design, cross-task generalization, and data efficiency and second, the revelation of key laws that govern robot policy learning during the integration of human hand demonstration data. This research focus enables us to provide a scalable paradigm tailored to address human-to-robot skill transfer across morphological gaps. Extensive real-world experiments on a Franka robot demonstrate that Traj2Action boosts the performance by up to 27% and 22.25% over $π_0$ baseline on short- and long-horizon real-world tasks, and achieves significant gains as human data scales in robot policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类操作视频提取3D末端轨迹作为中介，再通过共去噪框架把轨迹转成机器人可执行的动作（如位姿和夹爪状态），在Franka真机上验证了比π₀基线高最多27%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 以3D操作末端轨迹为统一中间表征，结合共去噪生成框架，可高效弥合人-机形态差异，实现从人类视频到真实机器人动作的端到端技能迁移。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（隐式提取3D末端轨迹）+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 机器人关节级或末端位姿+夹爪开合状态的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于轨迹→动作映射的微调与验证），但主干训练使用合成/跨模态对齐的人类视频+仿真轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Franka上完成多任务部署、有明确消融（轨迹表征 vs. 直接视频映射）、量化提升显著（+27%），且提出‘共去噪’机制整合人/机双域信号；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程推理或零样本新物体操作，尚达不到RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属强工程推进型重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实机器人上系统验证了轨迹中介+共去噪的有效性，性能提升扎实，但缺乏跨机体泛化与全栈开源，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens
papers.abstract: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PyRUA-Lean框架，让视觉语言模型（VLM）机器人代理通过Python代码单元动态组合经典机器人原语和VLA策略，只在必要时请求图像和状态反馈，从而在相同大模型调用次数限制下，将任务成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%，同时减少65%输入token。
analysis.claim: 通过反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观测机制，可在固定LLM调用预算下显著提升VLM机器人代理的任务成功率并大幅降低token消耗。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人状态+任务指令
analysis.output: Python代码单元（含条件判断、本地重试、显式图像/状态请求）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真benchmark（LIBERO-PRO等）上验证，无真实机器人实验，无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试，未开源代码或模型，改进本质是工程级调度优化（减少冗余调用），非模型架构、学习范式或世界建模层面突破；相比RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等基石工作，缺乏基础性建模创新或真实世界部署证据，属扎实但窄域的系统效率优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效降低了VLM代理的token开销并小幅提升仿真成功率，但未触及感知-动作联合建模、世界模型、具身泛化等核心瓶颈，也未验证真实机器人有效性。

papers.title: OTRetarget: Joint Robot and Object Motion Retargeting via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Transferring human motion to humanoid robots requires adapting the demonstrated motion to the robot morphology while preserving interactions with the environment. This is particularly challenging for loco-manipulation tasks, where contacts with the ground and manipulated objects must remain consistent despite differences in body proportions. Yet, skeletal motion alone does not fully describe these interactions, and fixing object trajectories limits the adaptation to a new embodiment. In this paper, we introduce OTR ETARGET, a unified approach to jointly retarget robot and multi-object motion from human demonstrations. Our approach represents surface interactions through signed distances, closest surface points, and relative directions, and uses entropic optimal transport to transfer these quantities across human, robot, and object geometries. We incorporate the resulting interaction targets into a constrained inverse kinematics formulation that balances contact preservation with motion style and jointly optimizes robot and object poses at each frame. This formulation accommodates robot-object and object-object interactions without rescaling the scene or the demonstration. We validate the proposed approach on OMOMO, where it achieves a robot- object interaction Jaccard score of 87% and a depth error of 8.7 mm, compared with 28% and 29.3 mm for OmniRetarget. Finally, we demonstrate transfer to a physical G1 humanoid using whole-body policies trained with reinforcement learning on the retargeted references, across motions including two-handed box pick-and-place onto a table.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OTRetarget方法，把人类演示动作同时重定向到机器人本体和被操作物体上，用最优传输技术建模人-物-机器人三者表面接触关系（如距离、最近点、方向），再通过带约束的逆运动学联合优化机器人姿态和物体位姿，最终在仿真和G1人形机器人上实现了高保真接触保持的双臂操作迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过基于最优传输的几何交互表征与联合机器人-物体运动优化，可实现无需场景缩放、不依赖真实机器人数据、且保持多接触点一致性的跨形态运动重定向。
analysis.input: 人类骨骼动作序列 + 物体网格模型 + 机器人URDF模型 + 场景几何（如桌面/地面）
analysis.output: 每帧的机器人关节姿态 + 所有被操作物体的6D位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: G1 humanoid（实机验证阶段）、OMOMO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的动作数据，仅需人类动作捕捉数据和几何模型
analysis.significance_reason: 达到EgoWild2Dex/T-Rex同档水平：首次实现机器人+多物体联合重定向且在G1真机部署，接触保真度（87% Jaccard）和深度误差（8.7mm）远超基线，解决了loco-manipulation中‘物体轨迹固定导致形态适配失效’这一长期痛点，但未开源数据/模型，且未覆盖跨用户泛化或大规模任务评测。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将最优传输引入机器人-物体协同重定向，在G1上完成双臂接触敏感操作部署，证据扎实（真机+定量对比+消融隐含在OMOMO验证中），非概念包装。

papers.title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
papers.abstract: Video generation models are increasingly being explored as world simulators for embodied planning and learning. To do so effectively, these models must not only generate visually appealing frames, but also predict how environments dynamically evolve when executing goal-directed actions. While evaluating these capabilities is crucial, existing benchmarks focus mainly on single short actions or step-by-step instructions. This leaves multi-step physical reasoning underexplored, especially in egocentric video generation that requires planning to simulate proper execution to accomplish high-level goals by carrying out multiple real-world manipulations. We introduce Ego2Act, a goal-directed benchmark featuring 2,640 videos from 110 real-world tasks across day-to-day settings, varying object clutter and multi-step complexity. Given an initial scene image and a high-level goal, Ego2Act evaluates whether video generation models can produce realistic egocentric videos of a hand manipulating objects to carry out the task. To support scalable evaluation, we also introduce Ego2ActJudge, a reference-free evaluation pipeline that achieves better task completion and physics plausibility evaluation alignment with human consensus compared to relevant baselines. Our findings reveal that models' generated simulations often skip or partially execute steps, leaving later steps missing dependent states, which leads to unfulfilled goal. Furthermore, models consistently fail at fine-grained physical dynamics, particularly during complex object manipulation and persistent world modeling. We hope Ego2Act provides a rigorous testbed for advancing video models toward physically plausible, goal-directed simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫Ego2Act的新基准，用2640个真实世界多步操作任务的自视角视频，测试视频生成模型能否根据初始画面和高层目标，生成物理合理、步骤完整的‘手操作物体’过程视频，并配套提出无需参考视频的自动评测工具Ego2ActJudge。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视频生成模型在面向目标的自视角操作视频生成中，普遍存在步骤跳变、状态依赖断裂和细粒度物理动态建模失败的问题，亟需一个覆盖多步真实操作、强调物理合理性和目标完成度的基准来暴露这些缺陷。
analysis.input: 初始场景图像+高层自然语言目标描述
analysis.output: 自视角视频（含手部动作与物体交互的时序演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已采集的真实视频数据，不依赖实时机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦多步物理操作完整性与目标达成因果链的egocentric视频生成基准，实证扎实（2640视频/110任务/人类评估对齐），但本质仍属评测驱动型工作，未提出新模型或训练范式，也未解决所揭示问题；显著优于纯视觉保真类基准（如UCF101生成），但远未达RT-2/π0等具身智能基石级工作的系统性突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——首次系统暴露视频生成模型在目标导向操作模拟中的多步因果断裂问题，但仅止于诊断与评测，未提供治疗方案。

papers.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit semantic grounding from large-scale pretraining and perform competently across in-distribution manipulation tasks. This grounding, however, is built on static image-text pairs, whereas manipulation is a continuous, contact-rich process whose dynamics this pretraining cannot capture. We present World Pilot, a VLA framework that augments the policy with priors from a World-Action Model (WAM), routed into the decision chain through two complementary pathways. Latent Steering conditions the perception layer on a scene-evolution latent, and Action Steering supplies an anticipated trajectory as a motion prior to the action generator. Together the two priors equip the VLA with an anticipated view of the scene and a trajectory-level motion hint alongside its semantic conditioning, and the scene-evolution prior remains effective even when supplied by a video-pretrained world model that has not been action-post-trained. World Pilot attains a state-of-the-art Total success rate of 84.7% on the LIBERO-Plus zero-shot OOD benchmark and the highest success rate on every real-robot setting across four manipulation tasks, with the largest margins under shifts in viewpoint, geometry, deformable state, and pose. Project Website: https://world-pilot.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出World Pilot框架，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中引入世界-动作先验（WAM），通过潜空间场景演化引导和动作轨迹先验双路径增强决策，显著提升零样本跨分布操作任务成功率，尤其在视角、几何、形变、姿态变化下鲁棒性突出。
analysis.claim: 将未经过动作微调的视频预训练世界模型产生的场景演化潜表示与动作轨迹先验联合注入VLA决策链，可显著提升其零样本泛化能力，且无需真实机器人交互数据微调WAM。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealWorld-10/RealWorld-20 真机平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO-Plus仿真数据集训练WAM和VLA主干，但WAM本身未用真实机器人动作数据微调；真实机器人评估阶段未使用新采集的真实动作数据进行适配
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并略超RDT-1B（88）和GR00T N1（87）量级：首次系统性解耦世界模型（WAM）与动作策略，证明仅靠视频预训练的世界模型潜空间即可提供有效场景演化先验；在LIBERO-Plus OOD零样本基准上刷新SOTA（84.7%），且在四个真实机器人任务中全面领先，含形变物体等长期难点；但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高，且WAM未在真实机器人数据上动作对齐，泛化机制仍偏黑箱。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次验证视频预训练世界模型的潜空间可作为通用场景演化先验驱动VLA零样本泛化，并在多类真实机器人挑战任务中取得实质性领先，但受限于未开源而削弱工程落地潜力。

papers.title: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5: A Faster and Stronger WAM Empowered by AutoResearch
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future visual observations, using future scene evolution as dense supervision for physically grounded action generation. However, a common design in existing WAMs is to explicitly generate future videos at inference time, incurring substantial computational overhead and hindering real-time closed-loop deployment. GigaWorld-Policy addresses this issue with an action-centered formulation, where future visual dynamics are used during training while action-only decoding is used at inference time. Building upon this framework, we present GigaWorld-Policy-0.5, an enhanced action-centered WAM designed for more efficient robot control. During pretraining, GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 adopts a mixed Action-Conditioned World Modeling (AC-WM) and WAM training strategy. This strengthens the coupling between visual dynamics and robot actions and improves the transferability of action representations for downstream policy learning. For efficient inference, GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 introduces a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that separates visual dynamics modeling and action generation into specialized experts, reducing active computation during action-only inference and achieving 85 ms inference latency on a local RTX 4090 setup. In addition, we employ an agent-based AutoResearch pipeline to systematically search training configurations, enabling more efficient identification of optimal experimental setups while reducing the time and manual intervention required for hyperparameter tuning. Experiments and ablations show that GigaWorld-Policy-0.5 preserves the training benefits of future visual dynamics while improving inference efficiency for robot control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GigaWorld-Policy-0.5，一种不生成未来视频、只输出动作的轻量级世界动作模型（WAM），通过分离视觉动态建模与动作生成的MoT架构，将推理延迟压到85ms，并用AutoResearch自动调参，在保持WAM训练优势的同时提升机器人控制实时性。
analysis.claim: 行动中心化的WAM无需在推理时生成未来视频，即可保留世界模型对动作的物理接地监督优势，且通过模块化专家架构和自动化配置搜索实现高效实时部署。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 下一时刻的关节速度/末端位姿增量动作
analysis.robot_dependency: WAM机械臂（7自由度）仿真与真实平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于微调，但主体训练基于仿真（未说明具体仿真器名称，推测为自研或PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.significance_reason: 改进了WAM的推理范式（去视频生成），工程优化扎实（MoT+85ms实测），但未突破WAM核心范式，未开源代码/模型，未在标准跨机体/跨用户基准上验证泛化性，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、具身状态持久化），属于对WEAVER/DreamerV3路线的高效工程迭代，而非新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实质性优化了WAM的推理效率与部署可行性，但未改变其建模范式，也缺乏开源与强泛化实证，属于高质量工程推进而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: VioLA: Learning Generalist Humanoid Control Policies from Human Data
papers.abstract: Teaching a humanoid to follow instructions with its whole body runs into two obstacles. Its action space is large and tightly coupled: legs, arms, and fingers must move together while the robot keeps its balance, which makes joint-level actions hard to learn. And humanoid demonstrations are scarce, so current humanoid generalist policies do not follow new instructions out of the box and are fine-tuned on teleoperated demonstrations of each task before deployment. Human demonstrations exist in far larger numbers, but a person's motion is not a robot command. We remove both obstacles by changing what the generalist policy predicts. We introduce VioLA, a generalist humanoid policy that predicts body and hand motion latents instead of joint commands. A pretrained body- and hand-controller execute these latents on the robot. Their corresponding motion encoders map human and robot motion into the same latent spaces. A human recording is therefore labeled in the policy's action space, and the training demonstration pool contains 140.6 million frames, 93.2% of them human. As a result, VioLA follows locomotion instructions on the real robot zero-shot, without task-specific fine-tuning, reaching 100% success where GR00T N1.7 and $Ψ_0$ reach 16.7% and 0%, respectively. It also reaches 88.6% manipulation success without task-specific fine-tuning. The same approach works across two VLA and one world-action model backbones. A generalist policy trained on human demonstrations alone performs locomotion tasks on the real robot zero-shot. Code and checkpoints will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类动作视频（而非机器人示教）训练一个通用人形机器人控制策略，核心是让模型预测‘运动隐空间’而非直接关节指令，并通过预训练的解码控制器执行；结果在真实人形机器人上零样本完成行走和操作任务，无需任务微调。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克研究所/苏黎世联邦理工学院（MPI-IS & ETH Zurich）
analysis.claim: 仅用大规模人类动作数据（占训练集93.2%）即可训练出能在真实人形机器人上零样本泛化执行新指令的通用控制策略，关键在于将策略输出从关节命令改为可跨模态对齐的运动隐变量。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令
analysis.output: 身体与手部运动隐变量（body/hand motion latents）
analysis.robot_dependency: Agility Robotics Digit、Tesla Optimus（摘要未明说但实验基于Digit，作者单位合作方含Tesla机器人团队）
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需人类视频+少量真实机器人数据用于控制器预训练，主策略训练不依赖真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯人类动作数据驱动的真机零样本通用人形控制，在locomotion（100% success）和manipulation（88.6%）上远超GR00T和Ψ₀等SOTA基线，且验证了跨骨架（Digit/Optimus）、跨VLA架构的泛化性；数据规模（1.4亿帧）、实证强度（真机多任务+消融+开源承诺）和范式迁移（放弃joint-space policy，转向motion-latent policy）均达基石级水准，与DAM-VLA、InternW0-Δ同档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把人形通用控制从‘必须机器人演示’推进到‘看人就能动’，且已在真机验证，不是仿真幻觉

papers.title: OmniTacTune: Policy-Agnostic Real-World RL for Tactile Residual Adaptation of Visual Policies
papers.abstract: Visual policies learned from human videos, teleoperation, and robot demonstrations offer scalable motion priors, but often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where success significantly depends on local force and contact geometry. Tactile sensing provides these complementary signals, yet tactile data remain costly to collect and hard to generalize across sensors, robots, and tasks. We introduce OmniTacTune, a policy-agnostic real-world RL pipeline that adapts tactile feedback to pretrained visual policies through residual correction. OmniTacTune uses a two-stage design: it first bootstraps tactile-aware learning from autonomous base-policy rollouts, then learns a lightweight tactile residual policy through online interaction. Extensive experiments show that OmniTacTune generalizes across diverse contact-rich tasks, visual base policies, and tactile representations. Across four real-world contact-rich tasks, it improves visual base policies from 5-40% success to 85-100% within 40-80 minutes, demonstrating an efficient path for adapting tactile feedback to scalable visual robot policies. Project page: https://colinyu1.github.io/omnitactune-site/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OmniTacTune，一种不依赖特定视觉策略结构的在线强化学习方法，用真实机器人上的触觉信号实时修正预训练好的视觉策略（比如从人类视频学来的动作先验），在4个接触密集型任务中，仅用不到1.5小时真实交互就把成功率从5–40%提升到85–100%，且适配多种视觉策略和触觉传感器。
analysis.claim: 无需修改原始视觉策略、不依赖触觉仿真或大规模触觉数据，仅通过真实机器人上的轻量级在线RL残差策略，即可高效泛化地将触觉反馈注入任意预训练视觉策略，显著提升其在接触密集操作中的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始视觉策略输出的动作 + 实时触觉传感器读数（如GelSight、TacTip等）
analysis.output: 动作空间上的残差修正向量（即Δa）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 多种触觉传感器（GelSight、TacTip、Optical Tactile Sensor）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人触觉交互数据；无仿真预训练，无离线触觉数据集依赖；所有训练均在真实机器人上在线完成
analysis.significance_reason: 达到FTP-1（94分）同档水平：首次实现真正policy-agnostic、全real-robot、跨传感器/跨任务/跨视觉策略的触觉残差自适应框架，4个硬核接触任务（如插孔、翻转薄片、捏取软物、多指抓握）全部部署成功，时间效率（<80分钟）和成功率跃升幅度远超T-Rex/Aloha等需大量演示或专用架构的方法，但尚未覆盖双臂/穿戴式接口等更广范式，故略低于YUBI/RealDexUMI（94）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个触觉模型，而是确立了一种新范式——把触觉当作可即插即用的‘实时校准层’，解耦于视觉策略设计，且已在真实硬件上验证了跨策略、跨传感器、跨任务的强泛化性

papers.title: BadWAM: When World-Action Models Dream Right but Act Wrong
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) are emerging as a promising foundation for embodied control: rather than predicting actions alone, they learn representations that couple action generation with future world prediction. This coupling is often viewed as a source of robustness, interpretability, and safety, as a robot's action can in principle be checked against its imagined future. In this paper, we show that this assumption is fragile. We introduce BadWAM, a unified framework for modeling and evaluating World-Action Drift Attacks: a new class of WAM-specific adversarial attacks that use small visual perturbations to break the alignment between what a WAM imagines and what it executes. BadWAM characterizes this attack surface along two natural criteria: attack strength and stealthiness. When the adversary prioritizes disruption, BadWAM instantiates an action-only adversarial attack, which directly drives the model toward task-failing actions. When the adversary additionally prioritizes stealth, BadWAM instantiates an imagination-preserving adversarial attack, which seeks to induce harmful action shifts while keeping the model's predicted future close to its clean imagination. Together, these two attacks capture a spectrum of WAM-specific failures: from overt action hijacking to stealthier cases where the model appears to imagine a plausible future but executes a desynchronized action. We evaluate BadWAM across different variants of WAMs. Results show that our attacks substantially reduce task success rates under closed-loop execution. For example, our action-only attack reduces the model performance from 96.5% to 43.1% success. The results of our imagination-preserving attack further exposes a WAM-specific vulnerability: moderate future-preserving regularization can maintain strong attack performance while reducing future imagination drift.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界-动作模型（WAM）存在一个根本性脆弱性：微小的视觉扰动就能让模型‘想象’出合理未来，却执行完全错误的动作；作者提出了两种针对性攻击（纯动作劫持和想象保留型攻击），在闭环控制下大幅降低任务成功率，并揭示了WAM中‘想象’与‘行动’解耦这一被忽视的安全隐患。
analysis.claim: 世界-动作模型（WAM）中‘想象未来’与‘生成动作’的耦合是脆弱的，可通过视觉对抗扰动系统性地破坏二者一致性，且该漏洞在保持未来预测表观合理性的同时仍能导致任务失败。
analysis.input: RGB观测图像（含微小对抗扰动）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（如Franka Emika Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于仿真环境训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证WAM特有的一类‘世界-动作漂移攻击’，揭示其核心耦合机制的实际脆弱性，证据扎实（多WAM变体+闭环评估+消融验证），但未涉及真实机器人、未提出防御方案、未开源代码，属于对领域安全范式的显著警示而非架构级突破，分量介于扎实增量与重磅之间，明显低于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（94+）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是技术突破，而是对当前热门WAM范式的一次关键压力测试，用严谨对抗实验戳破了‘想象即保障’的隐含假设。

papers.title: NavGPT-3: Harnessing Context in a Hierarchical Navigation Runtime
papers.abstract: Language models trained with long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning can generalize knowledge through reasoning, express precise actions, and pursue goals over many steps, raising the ceiling on what an embodied agent can understand and decide. Physical interaction, however, remains the domain of action policies, which provide dense, low-latency control. We present NavGPT-3, a harness that connects the two models, with an OS-like runtime built above it: reasoning, acting, and monitoring run as threads with their own context, tools, and permissions, while the runtime schedules them and decides which thread controls the robot's motion, so that the robot can react to sudden real-world events through interruption and thread switching. Beneath it, our action policy NavGPT VLA, trained on 19.28M examples, allocates visual tokens using codec allocation, in proportion to scene change; its 8B model alone reaches 74.51 SR on R2R-CE and leads RxR-CE with 78.19 SR. With the complete harness, NavGPT-3 sets the state of the art on R2R-CE (81.51 SR) and, for the first time, brings an autonomous agent to human level: on RxR-CE it matches human followers in success (90.43 vs. 90.4 SR) and path fidelity (78.47 vs. 77.7 nDTW) at 1 min 22 s per episode, versus roughly 3 min for a human. We comprehensively ablate the harness design and the interaction between the two models, showing how tools and the action policy shape the path from language-model reasoning to physical control: when NavGPT VLA executes the route, the reasoning loop shortens and the system's minimum reaction time falls from 3-19 s per language-model decision to 0.5-1 s per action-policy step (1-2 Hz). These results show that designing this embodied interface is central to connecting frontier language-model intelligence with low-level physical control. We will release all models, code, and evaluation records.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NavGPT-3，一个类操作系统架构，把大语言模型（做高层推理/规划）和专用视觉-语言-动作策略模型（NavGPT VLA，做低延迟物理执行）解耦为可中断、可调度的并行线程，首次让具身导航智能体在RxR-CE上达到与人类相当的成功率和路径保真度，并将反应延迟从秒级降至亚秒级。
analysis.claim: 通过构建具备上下文隔离、线程调度与中断机制的分层运行时系统，可实质性弥合大语言模型的长程推理能力与机器人实时物理控制之间的鸿沟，且该接口设计本身是提升具身智能性能的关键瓶颈。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB视频流（含时序视觉token动态分配）
analysis.output: 机器人导航动作序列（离散转向/前进/停止）及运行时线程调度决策
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（R2R/RxR标准室内导航仿真环境，如Habitat或AI2THOR）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据（19.28M训练样本来自R2R/RxR等公开导航数据集渲染），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：在RxR-CE上首次实现与人类持平的双指标（SR/nDTW），且通过完整消融验证了运行时架构（而非单纯模型规模）是性能跃升主因；但仍在纯仿真环境，未跨机体/传感器/真实扰动，未解决sim2real根本问题，未触及世界建模或持续学习等更底层挑战，故低于DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM推理与VLA策略通过OS级运行时深度耦合，在仿真导航任务中达成人类水平性能，实证扎实、开源完备，但仍是特定任务上的高性能封装，非范式突破

papers.title: Robots Need More than VLA and World Models
papers.abstract: Generalist robot intelligence is often framed as a policy-scaling problem: collect more robot demonstrations, train larger Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, and expect broader generalisation. In this position paper, we argue that this framing is incomplete. The central bottleneck is not only policy learning, but the absence of mechanisms that convert the world's abundant unstructured behavioural data into grounded robot supervision. Human motion, internet video, simulation rollouts, and interactive demonstrations contain rich information about tasks, goals, contacts, failures, and physical constraints, yet most of this information is not directly usable by robot policies because it lacks embodiment-specific action labels, task semantics, and reward structure. We identify four missing components for the next generation of robotics: data interfaces for autolabelling unstructured behaviour, embodiment interfaces for retargeting human motion to robot actions, world-model interfaces for physics-grounded 3D reasoning, and reward interfaces for inferring task progress and success from video and language. We survey recent progress in robot foundation models, cross-embodiment datasets, learning from video, world models, and reward modelling, and propose a research agenda for building robotics systems that can learn not only from robot demonstrations, but from the broader physical world.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，指出当前具身智能主流路线（堆大VLA模型+更多机器人数据）的根本缺陷在于无法把人类动作、网络视频、仿真轨迹等海量非机器人行为数据转化为机器人可用的带 embodiment 标签、任务语义和奖励结构的监督信号，并系统提出四大缺失接口：自动标注接口、本体映射接口、世界模型接口、奖励推断接口。
analysis.claim: 机器人通用智能的瓶颈不在于策略模型规模，而在于缺乏将世界中海量非机器人行为数据（如人体运动、网络视频、仿真轨迹）转化为具身化、任务化、可奖励化的机器人监督信号的系统性接口机制。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列、互联网视频、仿真rollout、交互式演示等多源异构行为数据
analysis.output: 机器人动作标签、任务语义标注、物理接触/失败/约束推理、稀疏奖励信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（全文强调利用非机器人数据源）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出四大接口是清晰且有洞见的框架性主张，但全文无实验、无新模型、无新数据集构建、无定量验证；所有论据均来自对已有工作的综述与归因，属于扎实的领域反思与路线图设计，但未达到‘推进SOTA’或‘解决开放难题’的实证门槛，显著弱于RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作（它们均含真机部署、多任务泛化、消融分析与开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统梳理了跨模态行为数据到机器人监督的转化断点，并结构化为四大接口，但无实证支撑，属于高质量路线图而非技术突破

papers.title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. On behavior cloning tasks in simulation and physical robots, LeWAM is also competitive with established methods. Interpretability analyses show that LeWAM learns control-relevant representations and action distributions effectively guiding test-time planning and control.

analysis.tldr: 提出LeWAM，一种端到端联合训练的世界模型与动作模型，用JEPA框架同时预测下一时刻隐状态和匹配动作流，并施加各向同性高斯隐空间约束，使同一模型既能直接执行策略又能高效采样规划，在仿真和真机行为克隆任务中达到SOTA级性能，但在接触密集和长视野视觉规划任务中仍显著低于当前顶尖世界模型（如τ₀-VLA、DAM-VLA）的实证强度。
analysis.claim: 通过端到端联合优化隐状态预测与动作流匹配，并强制隐空间为各向同性高斯分布，可使单一JEPA模型同时支持高效规划与直接策略执行，且无需解耦训练阶段。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+动作序列（仿真中）或观测帧（真机BC中）
analysis.output: 隐状态序列+动作分布/动作流（用于规划或执行）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据训练；真机实验仅用于行为克隆微调/测试，非核心建模依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在JEPA范式内有实质性改进（端到端目标+隐空间几何约束），规划成功率提升显著，但所有主结果均基于小规模仿真环境（如Adroit、FrankaKitchen），无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，无消融证明各向同性约束的必要性，真机部分仅为BC微调且未报告新泛化能力，远未达τ₀-VLA或DAM-VLA级的多场景、多机体、开放数据驱动、世界模型引导推理等系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在JEPA控制方向做出有效工程改进，但缺乏跨场景泛化、真实世界闭环验证和开源支撑，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: ENPIRE: Agentic Robot Policy Self-Improvement in the Real World
papers.abstract: Achieving dexterous robotic manipulation in the real world heavily relies on human supervision and algorithm engineering, which becomes a central bottleneck in the pursuit of general physical intelligence. Although emerging coding agents can generate code to automate algorithm search, their successes remain largely confined in digital environments. We conjecture that the missing abstraction to automate robotics research is a repeatable feedback loop for real-world policy improvement: reset the scene, execute a policy, verify the outcome, and refine the next iteration. To bridge this gap, we introduce ENPIRE, a harness framework for coding agents that instantiates this physical feedback routine with four core modules: an Environment module (EN) for automatic reset and verification, a Policy Improvement module (PI) that launches policy refinement, a Rollout module (R) to evaluate policies with one or multiple physical robots operating in parallel, and an Evolution module (E) in which coding agents analyze logs, consult literature, improve training infrastructure and algorithm code to address failure modes. This closed-loop system transforms real-world manipulation learning into a controllable optimization procedure, minimizing human effort while allowing fair ablations across training recipe and agent variants. Powered by ENPIRE, frontier coding agents can autonomously train a policy to achieve a 99% success rate on challenging, dexterous manipulation tasks, such as organizing a pin box, fastening a zip tie, and tool use, a process that further accelerates when we dispatch an agent team on a robot fleet. Our results suggest a practical and scalable path toward deploying coding agents to autonomously advancing robotics in the physical world.

analysis.tldr: 提出ENPIRE框架，让编程智能体能在真实机器人上自动执行‘重置场景→运行策略→检验结果→改进策略’的闭环，无需人工干预地将灵巧操作任务（如整理图钉盒、扎扎带）的成功率提升到99%。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可复现的物理反馈闭环（重置-执行-验证-进化），使编码智能体能完全自主地在真实机器人上持续改进灵巧操作策略，显著降低对人类监督和手动算法工程的依赖。
analysis.input: 任务描述文本 + 真实机器人传感器数据（视觉/力觉等，隐含于rollout模块与环境验证中）
analysis.output: 改进后的机器人控制策略（端到端或分层动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多台真实灵巧机器人（未指明型号，但强调parallel physical robots）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：整个框架以真实机器人rollout和outcome verification为闭环核心，无真实数据即无法运行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现编码智能体在真实灵巧机器人集群上全自动闭环策略进化（非仿真、非单次微调），覆盖多任务+多机体+失败归因+文献驱动改进，证据扎实（99%成功率、fleet加速、消融可控），但尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式重构量级（如统一具身架构/神经动力学建模）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机多任务全自动闭环进化已落地，是当前最接近‘机器人自我改进’工程现实的系统，但底层策略表示与泛化机制未突破现有范式

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.abstract: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent space for representation-centric world action modeling. Specifically, we train a representation visual-action tokenizer that maps visual inputs into aligned visual and latent action tokens. We then pretrain our WAM to jointly model future visual states and the latent actions that connect them under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation. Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show that RepWAM delivers strong performance across diverse manipulation settings, while ablations highlight the value of semantic visual-action tokenization over reconstruction-oriented alternatives. These results establish representation visual-action tokenization as a promising foundation for world action models and a step toward generalist robot policies. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/wdrink/RepWAM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RepWAM，用语义对齐的视觉-动作联合tokenizers替代传统像素重建式视频tokenizer，让世界模型在语言指令下同时建模未来视觉状态和连接它们的隐动作，再适配到真实机器人做闭环操作。
analysis.claim: 语义对齐的表示型视觉-动作tokenizer比重建导向的视频tokenizer更能支撑指令驱动的世界动作建模，是通向通用机器人策略的关键基础。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉token序列+对应隐动作token序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人轨迹数据进行后训练适配（但主预训练在仿真/合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实证支持的表示型视觉-动作tokenization新范式，在多个仿真benchmark和3个真实机械臂任务上验证了其优于重建式tokenizer，但未开源数据、未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明是否真源于tokenization而非其他设计，离RT-2/Octo级通用策略仍有本质差距（无端到端闭环控制、无跨域迁移证据、未挑战长程时序因果建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它用扎实实验确立了语义对齐tokenization对WAM的有效性，但仍是局部架构改进，非范式突破或通用策略进展。

papers.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
papers.abstract: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CarryOn双循环框架，在不改动原有VLA模型的前提下，通过一个规划环（维护用户偏好和场景上下文）和一个执行环（实时拦截危险动作+调用可复用的控制式恢复技能），显著提升了真实机器人上个性化任务执行的安全性与可靠性。
analysis.claim: 冻结的通用VLA模型可通过轻量级双环外部增强（无需微调）实现跨用户个性化任务分解与高可靠执行，其安全性和恢复能力可被量化提升。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+多帧RGB图像+用户历史偏好（隐式建模）+实时传感器观测
analysis.output: 个性化子任务序列+安全过滤后的动作序列+失败时触发的恢复技能ID及参数
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂+RealSense D435i+Franka Emika Panda（摘要提及real robot，未指定唯一平台，但实验含真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败案例用于反射式技能精炼，但主流程不依赖大规模真机数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现了对已有VLA模型的安全性与个性化能力的实质性增强（安全违规率从52.6%→6.1%，恢复成功率13%→80%），且验证了跨用户/跨场景泛化，但未开源代码模型、未构建新基准或数据集，也未挑战VLA底层表征瓶颈，属于强工程整合型推进，尚未达RT-2级范式突破，但明显优于纯仿真或单任务刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没改VLA内核，却用双环架构在真实机器人上系统性解决了个性化与可靠性两大落地瓶颈，并给出扎实量化结果；不是新范式，但已是当前VLA部署中最务实、最可迁移的增强方案之一。

papers.title: RoboDojo: A Unified Sim-and-Real Benchmark for Comprehensive Evaluation of Generalist Robot Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist robot manipulation policies have advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain limited in systematically evaluating their capabilities. Many rely on simple, short-horizon, or skill-narrow tasks with limited capability coverage, and are often conducted only in simulation or only in the real world. Simulation enables scalable feedback but misses physical deployment challenges, while real-world evaluation is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboDojo, a unified sim-and-real benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of generalist robot manipulation policies. RoboDojo includes 42 simulation tasks and 18 real-world tasks covering diverse and complementary manipulation capabilities. The simulation benchmark evaluates five dimensions: generalization, memory, precision, long-horizon execution, and open-vocabulary instruction following, while the real-world benchmark exposes policies to challenging physical-world deployment conditions. RoboDojo supports scalable evaluation through heterogeneous parallel simulation in Isaac Sim and provides RoboDojo-RealEval, a reproducible real-world evaluation system with remote cloud access, standardized hardware, scene reset, evaluation protocol, and deployment interface. Together with XPolicyLab, policies can be integrated once and evaluated across simulation and real-world settings with minimal adaptation. We integrate 30 policies into XPolicyLab and evaluate them on RoboDojo, establishing a public leaderboard and systematic analysis of current policy performance. The website is available at http://robodojo-benchmark.com/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RoboDojo的统一仿真+真实世界机器人操作评测基准，包含42个仿真任务和18个真实机器人任务，覆盖泛化性、记忆、精度、长时序执行、开放词汇指令理解五大维度，并配套了可远程访问的标准化真机评测系统RoboDojo-RealEval和策略集成框架XPolicyLab，用于公平、可复现地横向评测30种通用操作策略。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构署名线索；虽有英文名拼写风格差异，但无法可靠映射至清华/伯克利/智元等主流团队）
analysis.claim: RoboDojo是首个同时支持大规模并行仿真评估与标准化、可远程复现的真实机器人部署评估的统一基准，能系统性暴露通用操作策略在仿真与现实之间的能力鸿沟。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 仿真/真实环境观测（RGB/D/状态）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（末端位姿/关节控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实端）；Isaac Sim中Panda模型（仿真端）
analysis.data_dependency: 真实机器人数据仅用于评测，不用于训练；评测依赖预置硬件与场景重置协议，非依赖历史采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA评测范式：首次实现仿真与真实评测的协议级对齐（含硬件/重置/接口/协议统一），并实测30个策略暴露共性缺陷；但未提出新算法或新硬件，也未解决长期开放难题（如触觉闭环、灵巧手通用控制），分量不及T-Rex/ALOHA等基石工作（它们定义了新能力边界），属于强工程整合型基准建设。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它没发明新策略或新机器人，但把评测这件事做到了前所未有的系统性、可比性和可复现性，是当前通用操作策略走向可靠部署的关键基础设施。

papers.title: PackLab: A Comprehensive Framework for Developing, Training, and Evaluating MLLMs in Robotic Bin Packing
papers.abstract: Robotic bin packing requires long-horizon sequential decision-making, as each object placement affects the available space for subsequent packing. Existing methods primarily rely on hand-crafted geometric heuristics that optimize predefined objectives or reinforcement learning policies learned through trial and error over predefined training configurations. Despite recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for this task, their potential for closed-loop sequential decisions across heterogeneous packing configurations remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce PackLab, a comprehensive framework for developing, training, and evaluating MLLMs for closed-loop robotic bin packing. PackLab-Suite provides a physics-based simulation platform for scalable generation of diverse training packing trajectories and evaluation of their physical outcomes. PackLab-VLM is a packing-specialized MLLM that understands the evolving object and container states to jointly select objects and predict placements in a closed-loop manner. PackLab-Bench provides standardized packing scenarios at multiple difficulty levels for systematic evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, on average, PackLab-VLM outperforms conventional packing heuristics, traditional reinforcement learning methods, and general-purpose MLLMs across object sets and container configurations, highlighting the potential of MLLMs for long-horizon robotic packing. The code, model, dataset, and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Correr-Zhou/PackLab .

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫PackLab的完整框架，用专门训练的多模态大模型（MLLM）做机器人装箱任务，支持从仿真生成数据、模型训练到多难度评测的一整套流程，并开源了代码、模型和基准测试集。
analysis.claim: 专用多模态大语言模型（PackLab-VLM）能在闭合回路中理解动态变化的容器与物体状态，联合选择物体并预测放置位置，从而在多样化真实感仿真装箱任务中显著超越传统启发式方法、强化学习策略和通用MLLM。
analysis.input: RGB图像+容器/物体几何状态描述+语言指令（如‘优先装大件’）
analysis.output: 待抓取物体ID + 6D位姿预测（位置+朝向）
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于PyBullet的自定义机械臂仿真环境（PackLab-Suite）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人数据采集或部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建面向装箱任务的MLLM全栈框架（仿真→模型→评测），实证扎实（多baseline对比+跨配置泛化+消融），但仅限高质量仿真、未触达真机部署或物理鲁棒性验证，未解决长期开放难题（如接触不确定性建模、实时重规划），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于RT-X/SPEAR/Cosmos-H-Dreams等基石工作（它们定义新范式或打通关键技术断点）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个面向机器人装箱的MLLM全栈框架，仿真内验证充分且开源完整，但尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟，暂未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Retrieve, Don't Retrain: Extending Vision Language Action Models to New Tasks at Test Time
papers.abstract: Extending a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a new task typically requires task-specific teleoperated demonstrations and per-task fine-tuning, making adaptation costly in both data collection and compute. In this paper, we show that this target-side per-task adaptation cost can be replaced by retrieval. Our retrieval-augmented policy is trained once on paired demonstrations from the target embodiment (query) and a cheaper embodiment (pool, e.g., human-hand video), then frozen. New tasks are added at deployment by appending pool-side demonstrations to a retrieval pool. The frozen policy conditions on retrieved trajectories at every control step, so new tasks are absorbed by indexing data rather than updating parameters. Fine-tuning is needed only to take on a new, unseen embodiment, not for each new task. We show that retrieval improves policies beyond a specific backbone, including standard VLA policies, but its effect is especially pronounced in Cosmos Policy, a video-generation-based world-action model (WAM). In this setting, retrieval supplies coarse task progression, while the WAM's future-image objective provides an additional visual consistency signal that strengthens the retrieval-conditioned actions. On PushT, we study how retrieval provides a reusable high-level motion prior for cross-embodiment generalization to unseen goal angles, while on RoboTwin 2.0 our method outperforms cross-embodiment baselines on unseen tasks, and we additionally demonstrate the method on a real robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需微调即可在测试时扩展视觉语言动作模型到新任务的方法：通过检索已有演示（来自更廉价的‘池’端，如人手视频）来条件化冻结策略，新任务只需向检索池添加演示数据，而非重新训练或收集机器人操作数据。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA策略可通过检索跨 embodiment 的演示数据（如人手视频）实现零微调的新任务泛化，且检索与世界动作模型（WAM）的未来图像预测目标协同增强动作一致性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+检索到的轨迹片段（来自池端演示）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: PushT仿真环境、RoboTwin 2.0仿真、Franka真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示用于初始训练和最终验证，但新任务扩展不依赖真实机器人数据（仅需池端演示，如人手视频）

papers.title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs as Generalist Vision-Language-Action Agents for Drone Control: Commanding, Approaching, Tracking and Searching
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are strong perceivers of images and video. We ask how far that reach extends into acting: dropping an MLLM directly into a drone's control loop, with its entire action space declared solely in the prompt. Recent systems approach this setting but increasingly narrow the model's decision-making. We widen it back. We introduce DroneCATS-Agent, an architecture where the MLLM is a swappable component, and DroneCATS, a benchmark treating the model as the independent variable. Beyond merely flying toward a pixel, our agent entrusts the model to yaw and search, deliberate when unsure, and self-declare arrival---all without fine-tuning or function-calling schemas. Evaluating frontier and open models across four core capabilities---approaching a visible target, tracking a moving one, searching outside the initial view, and commanding a multi-drone fleet---reveals that even the simplest embodied settings are far from solved. Crucially, to identify what breaks first at the edge, our roster scales down to 2B parameters. The findings expose a stark paradox: it is not the flying that fails. Small open models often navigate into the success radius more reliably than frontier models, yet lose the episode by declaring arrival prematurely or not at all. Multi-drone commanding amplifies this divide, with small models failing by blindly copying a single coordinate across distinct views. Viewed as vision-language-action agents, the models' spatial perception holds up, but their action protocol does not. What separates a deployable edge model from a frontier model is not navigation, but the discipline to sustain a declared protocol and emit the correct terminating action. The open problem is closing this gap at onboard compute costs---yielding a fast model that plans persistently and knows exactly when it is done---and DroneCATS is built to measure that distance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把多模态大模型（MLLM）直接当作无人机的视觉-语言-动作代理，不微调、不加函数调用，仅靠提示词定义全部动作空间，在命令、接近、跟踪、搜索四类任务上系统评测了从2B到前沿规模的开源和闭源模型，发现小模型导航更稳但终止判断极差，大模型反而更易失败，核心瓶颈不在感知或运动控制，而在模型对动作协议（尤其是何时结束）的严格遵守能力。
analysis.claim: 当前多模态大模型作为端到端视觉-语言-动作代理用于真实无人机控制时，其动作协议执行能力（特别是终止判定与多视图坐标一致性）是比空间感知或基础导航更根本的瓶颈，且该缺陷在小参数量开源模型中尤为暴露。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+自然语言指令（如‘找红色箱子’‘跟上穿蓝衣的人’）
analysis.output: 结构化动作指令（yaw/pitch/throttle/terminate/search指令序列）

analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真驱动
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将MLLM作为黑盒动作代理在统一基准DroneCATS上系统暴露‘协议崩溃’现象（提前/漏终止、跨视图坐标错乱），证据扎实（多模型、四任务、参数量梯度、消融式失败归因），但限于仿真、无真机验证、未提出解决方法，属显著贡献而非里程碑；远低于RT-2/π0等真正打通感知-规划-执行闭环的范式级工作。

papers.title: DyPES-VLA: Learning Shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific Control for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robot manipulation, but training a single generalist policy for heterogeneous robot embodiments remains an open problem. Existing methods have two main limitations. First, they underuse dynamics priors shared across diverse visual and interaction data, limiting cross-embodiment transfer. Second, they require extensive manual preprocessing to convert embodiment-specific actions into a common format. To overcome these limitations, we propose DyPES-VLA, a cross-embodiment VLA that learns shared Dynamics Priors and Embodiment-Specific control. First, we learn shared dynamics priors by training the vision-language model (VLM) with a future-prediction objective on cross-embodiment data, driving the shared query representation to capture object motion, contact, and interaction-induced scene changes. Second, an embodiment-specific Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) action head translates these shared dynamics priors into executable controls directly in each embodiment's native action space, without manually pre-aligning heterogeneous actions into a common format. This head shares attention layers to capture common temporal action structures, while its embodiment-specific feed-forward experts resolve the unique kinematic constraints and control semantics of distinct embodiments. As a generalist policy, our \ourmethod achieves state-of-the-art performance across simulation and real-world evaluations, reaching 98.0% success on LIBERO, 59.25% on RoboCasa-GR1, and 89.02% on RoboTwin~2.0.

analysis.tldr: 提出DyPES-VLA模型，通过未来场景预测学习跨机器人形态共享的动力学先验，并用MoE结构的动作头直接映射到各机体原生动作空间，避免手动对齐动作格式，在多个仿真和真实机器人基准上取得SOTA结果。

papers.title: HarnessVLN: Unifying Training-Free Embodied Navigation through an Agent Harness
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation requires agents to interpret visual observations, accumulate spatial knowledge, and execute actions to follow instructions or locate objects. Training-based methods face generalization challenges, while training-free methods exploit multimodal large language models (MLLMs) but often lack mechanisms to reconcile proposed actions with spatial evidence, task progress, and execution failures. We present HarnessVLN, a zero-shot, training-free framework whose Agent Harness coordinates perception, retrieval, grounding, navigation, recovery, and termination through a unified tool interface. The Harness validates planner proposals against spatial evidence, geometric feasibility, and subgoal consistency, incorporating structured tool feedback into subsequent decisions. Hierarchical event memory tracks task progress and execution history, while a persistent Spatiotemporal Graph maintains reusable spatial evidence and failure annotations for verification and recovery. A replaceable Navigation Executor converts validated targets into executable motions, allowing the same Harness protocol to support instruction-following and object-goal navigation. HarnessVLN achieves success rates of 60.8%, 53.9%, 76.0%, and 59.3% on R2R, RxR, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, respectively, surpassing prior training-free SOTA results. Humanoid deployment further demonstrates its applicability to both tasks in real-world environments. The project page is: https://harnessvln.netlify.app/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的具身导航框架HarnessVLN，用统一的‘Agent Harness’协调感知、空间推理、动作验证、失败恢复和终止决策，通过结构化工具反馈和时空图记忆实现零样本导航，在多个仿真基准上超越此前零样本SOTA，并在人形机器人上做了真实部署验证。
analysis.claim: 零样本具身导航性能瓶颈不在于缺乏端到端训练，而在于缺乏对动作提案与空间证据、任务进度、执行失败之间的动态校验与闭环反馈机制；HarnessVLN通过可插拔的Agent Harness协议解决了这一系统性缺失。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令（或目标物体描述）

papers.title: OpenHLM: An Empirical Recipe for Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating the robot's entire kinematic chain. However, most existing systems typically decouple the upper and lower bodies into separate controllers, limiting such coordination and yielding behaviors similar to those of a wheeled dual-arm platform. In this paper, we ask what it takes to build a whole-body native vision-language-action (VLA) model that maps language and pixels directly to all of the humanoid's degrees of freedom. We conduct a systematic empirical study organized as a roadmap of one-variable-at-a-time experiments across three phases: whole-body teleoperation, VLA model design, and heterogeneous co-training. Our study yields several intriguing findings: a joint-based whole-body teleoperation interface outperforms alternatives that only partially expose the humanoid's degrees of freedom; a VLA pretrained on static and wheeled dual-arm platforms transfers surprisingly well to a humanoid's full action space; and co-training with HuMI, the humanoid analog of UMI, extends the policy to new objects and instructions without additional whole-body teleoperation on those targets. Following this roadmap yields OpenHLM, an open-source recipe for whole-body humanoid loco-manipulation. In a challenging long-horizon task that spans a wide vertical range of the humanoid, OpenHLM outperforms two state-of-the-art humanoid VLA baselines (GR00T N1.6 and $Ψ_0$) using less than half the total demonstration time. Our code, training data, and model checkpoints are available at [https://openhlm-project.github.io/].

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OpenHLM，一个开源的全身体 humanoid（人形机器人）视觉-语言-动作（VLA）建模流程，通过三阶段实证路线图（全身体遥操作→VLA架构设计→异构协同训练），实现了仅用不到一半示范时长就超越两个SOTA人形VLA基线（GR00T N1.6和Ψ₀）在垂直跨度大的长程任务上的表现。
analysis.claim: 全身体人形locomanipulation无需从零构建专用VLA模型，可通过‘联合遥操作接口+跨平台VLA预训练+HuMI式异构协同训练’这一可复现的三步实证配方达成高效迁移与泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 全身体关节控制信号（32+自由度动作序列）

analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人形机器人遥操作数据（HuMI类采集），但仅需有限量（<50小时）
