papers.title: World-to-Wrist: Task-Conditioned Future Wrist Modeling for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often treat main-view and wrist-view observations as parallel visual inputs, overlooking their distinct roles in robot manipulation. Fine-grained manipulation, however, benefits from anticipating how wrist-local interactions may evolve under the global task context. To address this limitation, we present World-to-Wrist VLA (W2-VLA), a VLA model for fine-grained robot manipulation with task-conditioned future wrist modeling. Given current multi-view observations and a task instruction, W2-VLA contextualizes a set of latent modeling tokens as a compact interface between the vision-language model and the wrist predictor. Conditioned on this interface and the observed wrist history, the predictor forecasts future wrist latents, which are transformed into future-aware context for action prediction. In addition, we introduce W2-CoT, a synthesis pipeline that produces structured annotations describing manipulation progress, physical transition cues, and wrist-local evidence. These annotations provide auxiliary supervision that shapes the task-conditioned latent interface. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved fine-grained and contact-sensitive manipulation across both single-arm and bimanual settings, while maintaining action-generation rates above 80 Hz.

analysis.tldr: 提出W2-VLA模型，让VLA系统能根据全局任务指令和当前多视角视觉输入，专门预测手腕未来几帧的隐状态（而非直接预测动作），再用这些预测结果增强动作生成，从而提升精细操作（如捏、推、旋转小物体）的接触敏感性和时序协调性。
analysis.claim: 任务条件下的手腕未来隐状态建模是提升细粒度机器人操作性能的关键接口，其效果优于将主视图与腕视图简单并列输入的传统VLA架构。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像（主视图+腕视图）+语言任务指令+历史腕部观测序列
analysis.output: 未来数帧的手腕隐状态序列，进而生成高频率（>80Hz）的动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实双臂/单臂机器人平台（摘要提及real-world manipulation tasks，但未指明具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的腕部视频序列及对应动作轨迹，但未说明是否使用大规模真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘世界到手腕’解耦建模思路，并在LIBERO/RoboTwin2.0和少量真实任务上验证了细粒度操作增益，但缺乏大规模真实数据训练证据、未开源代码/模型、无跨机体泛化实验、消融不充分（如未验证‘latent interface’是否真比端到端更鲁棒），属于扎实但非范式级的架构改进。

papers.title: EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ
papers.abstract: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个100小时的可穿戴式人体原位运动-视觉-触觉同步观测数据集EgoExplorer，覆盖专业场景下的全身运动、手指精细动作和触觉信号，并提出Calibrate-Complete-Constrain新流程，在稀疏传感器下显著提升运动重建精度。
analysis.claim: 通过轻量可穿戴系统与新型运动重建pipeline，首次实现大规模、高保真、多模态（视觉+全身运动+手指关节+触觉）原位人类loco-manipulation连续观测，支撑人形机器人从真实人类行为中学习全身协调控制。
analysis.input: egocentric视频 + 稀疏IMU/触觉传感器信号 + 标定参数
analysis.output: 重建的全身运动轨迹（含手指关节角度）+ 接触状态 + 步骤级语义描述
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类穿戴采集，无机器人交互或控制数据
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模（100h）、模态完整性（首次同步包含高保真手指+触觉+全身运动+egocentric视频）和重建方法实证效果（body-point误差降71.9%，手部稳定性与接触估计提升）均扎实；但未在真实机器人上验证下游控制，也未开源代码/模型，且仿真验证仅限初步生成与retargeting，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级端到端闭环控制能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——高质量数据集+可靠重建方法已实质性推进人类行为建模基础，但尚未跨越到机器人闭环控制验证，属强支撑性工作而非范式突破

papers.title: DeltaWAM: Delta World Action Models for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) transfer visual and motion priors from pretrained video generators to robot control by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. Existing WAMs, however, predict dense future frames during training, repeatedly modeling largely unchanged content and coupling action-conditioned dynamics to nuisance appearance variations. At inference, processing each complete observation with the heavy video expert bottlenecks few-step action generation. Accordingly, we propose DeltaWAM, which jointly predicts visual deltas and actions using dense-anchor, sparse-delta, and action streams, with three architectures that differ in representation and computation sharing. We further develop Streaming Delta Memory (SDM), which updates cached anchor context with compact observed deltas, reducing heavy video-expert processing. On RoboTwin, DeltaWAM with SDM improves average success over Fast-WAM from 81.3% to 85.4% in the clean setting and from 75.8% to 83.9% under visual randomization. The three architectures reduce training FLOPs by 17.78-23.77%, while SDM reduces one-step inference latency and FLOPs by 36.57% and 31.55%, respectively; real-world evaluations further show the highest overall success rate and normalized progress among the evaluated policies. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DeltaWAM. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DeltaWAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeltaWAM，用视觉变化量（delta）替代完整帧预测来建模双臂操作的视觉-动作联合动态，配合Streaming Delta Memory减少重复计算，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了成功率和推理效率。
analysis.claim: 通过建模视觉增量而非完整未来帧，解耦动作相关动力学与无关外观变化，可显著提升世界-动作模型在双臂操作任务中的训练效率、推理速度和鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前RGB观测帧+历史锚点帧+动作指令
analysis.output: 下一时刻的动作向量+视觉变化量（delta）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器 + 真实Franka双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin仿真数据训练；真实机器人评估仅用于验证，未提真实数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下做出实质性工程-算法协同改进：明确识别并缓解了视频生成式建模中‘冗余帧重建’这一关键瓶颈，通过delta建模+SDM缓存机制带来可测量的FLOPs下降（>30%）、延迟降低与鲁棒性提升（+8.1% success under visual randomization），且在真实机器人上验证有效；但未突破WAM框架本身，也未解决跨机体/跨用户泛化等更深层问题，尚未达到基石论文所定义的新范式或长期难题破解层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内完成有实证支撑的高效化重构，属扎实的SOTA推进，但非范式突破

papers.title: Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer
papers.abstract: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form. This costs data, and it leaves the policies fragile to geometric changes in the scene. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Every token is a body with a pose. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On simulated manipulation tasks, Screw Attention matches or outperforms controls of the same size, including graph, transformer and flat networks on LIBERO-Spatial. With 16,162 parameters it reaches 97.3% on LIBERO-Spatial from object poses (without images or language), above a flat network with 27x more parameters. Under a change of per-link frame convention its success is unchanged, while every other learned network falls below 3%. Placed on an analytic controller as a gated residual, it raises insertion success by 17.3 points. It is unaffected by pose noise up to 10,mm and by joint offsets within the factory calibration of a Franka arm. These results suggest a criterion: geometry is decisive when the task requires relations between frames that no other part of the system supplies. Code and trained policies will be released.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Screw Attention的Transformer层，把每个token当作刚体（带位姿），用空间变换（而非标量注意力）建模两刚体间的相对位姿和关节螺旋轴，使网络天然满足刚体运动学的坐标系不变性和速度递推关系，在仅用物体位姿输入的模拟操作任务中，用极小参数量（1.6万）达到97.3%成功率，且对坐标系约定变更、位姿噪声、关节标定偏差完全鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 将刚体运动学的坐标系不变性与速度递推结构内建为Transformer的注意力机制设计，可大幅降低数据依赖、提升几何泛化性与物理鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 物体与机器人连杆的6D位姿（无图像、无语言）
analysis.output: 动作指令（控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka仿真器（LIBERO-Spatial）及真实Franka机械臂验证
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖仿真生成的位姿轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-Spatial上以1/27参数量超越大模型，且通过坐标系重定义、位姿噪声、关节偏移等严苛鲁棒性测试，首次将刚体李代数结构（se(3)变换+螺旋运动学）深度嵌入attention计算流，不是简单加几何先验，而是重构attention的relation定义与message transport方式；虽未达World Models级范式革命（95+），但属近年具身智能中‘结构先验驱动架构设计’方向最扎实、最可复现、最具物理可信度的突破之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是给Transformer加几何loss或后处理，而是重定义了attention中‘关系’的数学本质——从标量相似度到SE(3)变换，使网络第一性原理层面服从刚体动力学约束。

papers.title: RoboJEPA: Scaling Robotic Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models have shown a remarkable ability to predict future states and to plan in the real world. In practice, however, we lack a principled way to estimate how their capabilities scale with model size, data, and compute, an open problem that slows progress in the field. In this work we present RoboJEPA, a world model based on the Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) and trained on a large-scale dataset spanning 12 robotic embodiments. We show that RoboJEPA's imagination error, the error of its latent rollouts, follows a second-order power law in compute, allowing us to predict model quality well beyond the scale at which the law is fit. We further show that downstream robotic planning performance improves predictably with compute, and that imagination error is strongly correlated with it, making it a reliable proxy for real-robot evaluation. Finally, we demonstrate that latent world models can be deployed zero-shot as robotic agents, planning toward a single goal image to solve tasks requiring long-horizon planning on real hardware. We release all model checkpoints together with our training and robot deployment code. To our knowledge, this is the first work to establish scaling laws for multi-embodiment robotic world models trained on real robot data, and RoboJEPA, at 8B parameters, is the largest JEPA predictor model trained to date.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人多机体数据训练了一个80亿参数的JEPA架构潜空间世界模型RoboJEPA，首次在真实机器人上验证了其‘想象误差’随算力呈可预测的二次幂律缩放，并证明该误差能可靠替代真实机器人评估，还能零样本部署到真实硬件完成长程视觉目标导向任务。
analysis.claim: 潜空间机器人世界模型的想象误差遵循可外推的compute scaling law，且该误差是下游真实机器人规划性能的强代理指标。
analysis.input: 多机体真实机器人传感器流（含图像、状态、动作）
analysis.output: 潜空间中的未来状态预测（latent rollout）及基于其的规划动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：训练与验证均基于真实机器人采集的跨机体大规模数据集（未使用仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人多机体数据上建立可外推的潜空间世界模型scaling law，提供首个实证可靠的‘想象误差→真实性能’代理关系，并实现零样本真机长程视觉目标规划；虽未达World Models（97）或DreamerV3（96）的范式开创性，但填补了multi-embodiment real-robot world model scaling这一关键空白，工程深度与实证严谨性显著超越WEAVER（94.5）和Genie（94）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是首次用真实机器人数据确立潜空间世界模型的可量化、可外推、可部署的scaling规律，并开源全栈，实质性推动具身智能从‘单体调参’迈向‘系统化规模扩展’。

papers.title: RobotValues: Evaluating Household Robots When Human Values Conflict
papers.abstract: While household robots are often evaluated based on task completion, everyday domestic environments involve value-conflicting situations in which robots are expected to choose actions that prioritize other values than task success, such as human autonomy, efficiency, or social appropriateness. Yet, there are no benchmarks for evaluating robots' value preferences in such scenarios. We introduce RobotValues, a benchmark to evaluate household robot planners in 10K value-conflict scenarios. Each instance consists of a realistic household image with multiple plausible robot actions that prioritize different human values. We construct RobotValues through LLM-assisted scenario generation, stakeholder-grounded value extraction, image generation and automatic quality control. Using RobotValues we evaluate VLMs used in robotics and find that models exhibit default value preferences, including safety and accommodation, while underselecting privacy-prioritizing actions. When the models are instructed to prioritize specific values that conflict with their own preferences, they often fail to override their default actions, choosing incorrect actions for 80% of the time. These findings suggest that household robot evaluation should measure not only task completion or safety compliance, but also whether robots can choose among plausible actions when human values conflict.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RobotValues的新基准，用10000个家庭场景图像测试机器人AI在‘任务成功’和其他人类价值观（如隐私、自主性、得体性）冲突时会怎么选动作，发现现有视觉语言模型有顽固的默认价值偏好（比如总偏向安全和顺从），很难被指令覆盖，说明当前评估机器人不能只看任务完成率。
analysis.claim: 家庭机器人评估必须纳入其在人类价值观冲突情境下的价值权衡能力，而现有VLM驱动的机器人规划器存在难以纠正的隐性价值偏差。
analysis.input: 家庭场景RGB图像+自然语言价值指令（如‘优先保护隐私’）
analysis.output: 对多个候选动作的价值偏好排序/选择
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成图像与LLM生成场景
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并量化机器人在价值观冲突中的决策偏差，方法扎实（LLM+人工校验+自动质检），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未提出任何新模型或训练方法，仅是诊断型benchmark，贡献属于‘显著增量’而非范式突破，远低于H2O/GR00T等具身智能基石工作（那些直接推动控制、泛化、部署能力）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著增量：首个聚焦价值观冲突的机器人决策benchmark，揭示了VLM隐性偏差，但纯离线评估、无算法创新、未连接真实具身行为，属于重要但窄域的诊断工具，暂时不用看工程落地。

papers.title: HumanScale: Egocentric Human Video Can Outperform Real-Robot Data for Embodied Pretraining
papers.abstract: Embodied foundation models are expected to benefit from data scaling like large language models, but face a much tighter data bottleneck. Teleoperated real-robot trajectories remain the dominant pretraining source due to their precise action supervision and embodiment alignment, yet their scalability is limited by high collection cost, acquisition difficulty, and low behavioral and environmental diversity. These limitations have sparked interest in egocentric human video as a scalable, substantially lower-cost, and more diverse alternative for embodied model pretraining. However, its effectiveness compared to teleoperated real-robot data remains underexplored. To address this question, we conduct a systematic study comparing egocentric human video and teleoperated real-robot trajectories as pretraining data sources for embodied foundation models, under fixed post-training and validation protocols. Surprisingly, we find that egocentric data, when processed through a carefully designed filtering and labeling pipeline, is not merely a viable substitute for model pretraining but can lead to superior performance. With the same amount of pretraining data, models pretrained on egocentric data achieve a 24% lower validation loss on real-robot action prediction, as well as 52.5% and 90% higher success rates on in-distribution and out-of-distribution real-robot task execution, respectively. This finding verifies a scalable paradigm for embodied foundation models: pretrain on egocentric human video to learn diverse world representations, then adapt with a small amount of labeled real-robot data for action-space alignment. We hope this study encourages broader exploration of egocentric data and offers guidance for data quality assessment before costly robot data collection.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了第一人称人类视频和真实机器人遥操作数据作为具身基础模型预训练数据的效果，发现经过精心过滤和标注的人类视频不仅成本低、多样性高，还能在真实机器人任务上取得比同等规模遥操作数据更好的性能。
analysis.claim: 经合理处理的egocentric human video在具身模型预训练中可超越同量级teleoperated real-robot data，成为更优、更可扩展的预训练数据源。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角人类操作视频（含动作语义标签）
analysis.output: 真实机器人动作序列预测（动作块/轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 弱依赖：仅需少量真实机器人数据用于后训练对齐动作空间
analysis.significance_reason: 首次用严格控制变量的实证（多任务真实机器人部署+消融+跨分布泛化）证明人类视频可反超遥操作数据，推动‘人类行为即具身先验’范式；但未开源核心数据/代码，且未构建新模型或仿真器，分量略低于DROID/ALOHA等基石工作（它们定义了新架构/新采集范式/新仿真基座）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用扎实的多任务真实机器人验证推翻了‘必须用真机数据预训练’的行业默认假设，为具身AI数据瓶颈提供了可立即落地的新路径。

papers.title: Spa-Bench: A Real-Robot Benchmark for Spatial Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) offer a promising route toward general-purpose robotics by transferring semantic knowledge from large-scale vision-language pretraining into language-conditioned control. However, most VLA evaluations emphasize aggregate manipulation success under changes in objects, instructions, or environments, leaving unclear how reliably these policies ground spatial descriptions in the physical scenes where they act. We therefore ask a sharper question: how reliably can current VLAs translate spatial descriptions into appropriate real-robot behavior? To investigate this, we introduce Spa-Bench, a real-robot benchmark that evaluates spatial grounding across six tabletop tasks covering Object State, Relative Size, Referential Description, Relational Placement, Ordinal Position, and Counting. Our primary evaluation compares in-distribution (ID) and out-of-distribution (OOD) spatial configurations while retaining training support for the relevant objects, concepts, and actions, reducing object and motor unfamiliarity as alternative explanations for failure. Four diagnostic conditions further probe physical execution, sensitivity to wording, object-task associations, and recognition that no action is required. We release 4,092 episodes collected on the SO-101 robot arm: 1,200 human-teleoperated demonstrations and 2,892 real-robot evaluation rollouts from five state-of-the-art VLA policies. Across the three fully evaluated policies, success falls from 67.5-73.3% on ID spatial configurations to 40.7-52.0% on OOD spatial configurations, while matched direct instructions improve success by 28.3-40.0 percentage points. These results show that the evaluated VLAs can often execute the required manipulations but lack robust spatial grounding. Project materials, including videos, code, and benchmark data, are available at https://justintiensmith.github.io/Spa-Bench/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个真实机器人上的空间理解评测基准Spa-Bench，用6类空间任务（如相对位置、序数、计数等）系统测试视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）能否把‘左边’‘第二个’‘比它大’这类空间描述准确转化为真实机械臂动作，并发现当前SOTA模型在分布外空间配置下性能暴跌近30个百分点，暴露其空间语义接地能力严重不足。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视觉-语言-动作模型在真实机器人上缺乏鲁棒的空间接地能力，其失败主因是空间关系建模薄弱，而非物体识别或动作执行问题。
analysis.input: 自然语言空间指令（如‘把蓝色方块放在红色圆柱右边’）+ RGB图像
analysis.output: 机械臂末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的4092段rollout数据（含1200段人类遥操作演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上建立细粒度、可归因的空间接地评测体系，覆盖6类未被系统检验的空间认知维度，提供高质量ID/OOD划分、4类诊断条件和全开源数据；虽未提出新模型，但以扎实实证揭示了VLAs核心能力缺口，定位精准、数据可信、可复现性强，属SOTA级诊断性工作，但未达RT-2级范式突破或π0级架构创新量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是新模型，而是用真实机器人+严谨诊断设计+全开源数据，首次系统性暴露VLAs的空间接地缺陷，为后续研究提供不可替代的标尺。

papers.title: REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs
papers.abstract: We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. REKI consists of a vision-language model (VLM) followed by a flow-matching action expert, and is pretrained on a curated mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision-language data. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer. REKI uses a simple model design and training paradigm, and is optimised to be efficient at training and inference. We release the full code across data curation, training, inference and evaluation, deployment, and all pretrained and finetuned model weights: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki.

analysis.tldr: 用2.4B参数的轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型REKI，在LIBERO-Plus等主流机器人任务基准上达到接近4B+模型的性能，靠的是VLM+流匹配动作专家的简洁架构，外加极低成本的寄存器式记忆机制（几token缓存VLM历史输出），显著减少动作抖动，并全栈开源代码与权重。
analysis.claim: 仅用公开数据预训练的2.4B VLA模型，通过寄存器式记忆机制和流匹配动作专家，在保持高效训练/推理的同时，实现了小模型尺寸下的性能帕累托最优。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅用公开仿真/人类视频/多模态数据混合构建训练集
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、VioLA（96.3）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑之后，REKI以更小模型、全开源、多机体泛化、真实机器人部署验证（RoboCasa365实机测试）、且无私有数据依赖，成为当前最扎实的‘高效VLA’范例；虽未开新范式，但将帕累托前沿实质性前推——同等性能下模型减半，且记忆机制带来可测量的振荡抑制（4×降低），证据链完整（sim+real+multi-bench+ablation+full release）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是以极简设计、全栈开源和实证稳健性，重新定义了VLA模型的效率-性能权衡边界。

papers.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are fundamentally bottlenecked by the scarcity of expert demonstrations -- triplets of observations, instructions, and actions that are costly to collect at scale. We argue that this bottleneck stems from conflating two distinct learning objectives: acquiring physical competence (how to move) and acquiring semantic alignment (what to do). Crucially, only the latter requires language supervision. Building on this Decomposition Hypothesis, we propose Task-Agnostic Pretraining (TAP), a two-stage framework that first learns transferable motor priors from cheap, unlabeled interaction data -- including discarded off-task trajectories and autonomous robot play -- via a self-supervised Inverse Dynamics objective. A lightweight second stage then grounds these priors in language using minimal expert data. On the SIMPLER benchmark, TAP matches models trained on over 1M expert trajectories while using orders of magnitude less labeled data, yielding a 10% absolute gain over standard behavior cloning. On a real-world WidowX platform, TAP retains 25% success under camera perturbations where internet-scale baselines collapse to 0%, demonstrating that task-agnostic pretraining produces robust, transferable physical representations and offers a scalable path forward for Embodied AI.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘任务无关预训练’（TAP）框架，先用大量无标签机器人交互数据（如失败轨迹、自主探索数据）通过自监督逆动力学目标学习通用运动先验，再用极少专家示范数据做轻量语言对齐，从而大幅降低对昂贵标注数据的依赖，并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了更强的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 物理运动能力（how to move）可与语义任务理解（what to do）解耦，前者可通过无监督方式从廉价、非任务导向的机器人交互数据中高效习得，后者才需语言监督。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/末端执行器控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实专家演示（用于第二阶段），但主预训练阶段使用大量无标签真实/仿真交互数据（含失败轨迹、自主探索）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在SIMPLER基准上用<1%专家数据达到百万级行为克隆性能，在真实WidowX上抗相机扰动表现远超互联网规模基线；但未开源代码/模型，且未展示跨机体泛化（仅WidowX）、未挑战更复杂多自由度操作或长时序任务，尚未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统论证并验证‘运动先验-语言对齐’解耦范式，用真实机器人数据+消融实验支撑核心主张，显著缓解VLA领域最痛的数据瓶颈。

papers.title: DiVeR: Decision-Critical Verifier Learning for VLA Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract: Scaling robot data and model capacity has improved Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, but further progress is constrained by the high cost of robotic data. Verifier-guided test-time scaling offers an efficient alternative by sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the one most likely to lead to task success at inference time. Existing classification-based verifiers learn from trajectory-level outcomes but treat all visited states equally, even though their value for candidate discrimination can vary across a trajectory. At many states, plausible actions are similar and provide limited discrimination signal, while only a sparse set of decision-critical states admits meaningfully different actions that can substantially affect downstream outcomes. To address this, we propose DiVeR, which estimates decision criticality from the dispersion of sampled action representations. DiVeR then uses this signal to reweight verifier learning toward states where action selection is most consequential, without requiring step-level annotations or additional environment interaction. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 robot, DiVeR consistently improves task success through more effective verifier-guided action selection, while adding negligible verifier inference overhead.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DiVeR方法，让视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在推理时能更聪明地挑选候选动作——不是平均看待轨迹中每个状态，而是自动识别出那些‘选错就完蛋’的关键决策点，并让验证器（verifier）重点学习这些点的判别信号，从而提升任务成功率，且不需额外标注或真实机器人交互。
analysis.claim: 决策关键性（decision criticality）是轨迹中稀疏分布的、对动作判别最具信息量的状态子集，通过动作表征离散度可无监督估计该属性，并用于加权 verifier 训练，显著提升 verifier-guided test-time scaling 的有效性。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（图像+语言指令）+ 多个候选动作序列（来自VLA策略采样）
analysis.output: 标量验证分数（每个候选动作的成功概率估计）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行验证（但训练 verifier 不需要新采集真实数据，仅复用已有轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 在 verifier-guided test-time scaling 这一前沿范式中，首次系统揭示并建模了‘决策关键性’这一隐含结构，方法轻量、无需step-level标注，且在LIBERO（仿真）、RoboCasa（复杂仿真厨房）、Franka真实机器人三类场景均验证有效；虽未开新范式（如RT-2级），但显著提升了当前主流VLA推理机制的效率与鲁棒性，证据扎实（多基准+真机+消融），但开源程度有限（仅项目页，无代码/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将 verifier 学习从粗粒度轨迹级推进到细粒度状态级，用可计算的表征离散度替代不可获取的 step-level 监督，是当前 VLA 推理优化中最具实操价值的实质性改进之一。

papers.title: Masked Diffusion Language Models are Strong and Steerable Text-Based World Models for Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Recent growth in reinforcement learning (RL) has surfaced a need for diverse, specialized training environments. Hand-curated environments with fixed task and reward difficulties become ineffective signals as model performance improves, and sparse rewards over long horizons induce mode collapse on specific workflows or tool structures. World models that simulate environment states have matched pure rollout performance, making them promising for scaling diversity on-demand. However, autoregressive (AR) world models suffer from a left-to-right bias preventing conditioning on globally interdependent state anchors such as tool schemas, prior turns, and expected outcomes. We (i) formalize text-based world modeling as a steerable transition-dynamics problem decomposed into initial state, task context, tool schemas, domain rules, and steering directives, and (ii) curate 239,403 grounded state-action trajectories spanning nine open-source environments and twelve frontier model families. We compare AR LMs and masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), showing MDLMs, via bidirectional anchor-aware denoising, achieve better coherence, groundedness, and empirically validated rollout diversity than LLMs over 4x their parameter size, at comparable inference latency. We introduce a plug-and-play GRPO training framework with deterministic state checks, and perform zero-shot transfer ablations on three OOD environments (ScienceWorld, ALFWorld, AppWorld) across three 1.2B-7B agent backbones (LFM2.5, Qwen3, Mistral), achieving up to 47% absolute gains over baselines without environment-specific fine-tuning. We further conduct behavioral analysis of failure modes under adversarial scenarios and human evaluation on realism, outcome correctness, and training utility. We open-source our work to encourage research in this direction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于掩码扩散的语言模型（MDLM）作为文本型世界模型，用23.9万条多环境、多模型家族的轨迹数据训练，能双向建模状态转移，比同规模自回归大模型更连贯、更接地、生成更多样化 rollout，且无需微调即可零样本迁移到三个新环境，还开源了代码和数据。
analysis.claim: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）作为可调控的文本世界模型，在状态建模的全局一致性、接地性与rollout多样性上显著优于同等参数量的自回归语言模型，且具备零样本跨环境泛化能力。
analysis.input: 初始状态+任务上下文+工具模式+领域规则+调控指令（全为文本）
analysis.output: 未来状态序列（文本形式的环境状态演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于开源文本交互环境（ScienceWorld/ALFWorld/AppWorld等）的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（4×参数量对比、3个OOD环境零样本迁移、3种骨干模型验证、人类评估+失败模式分析），但仍是文本世界模型范畴内的方法演进，未突破‘世界模型需持续状态表征’这一核心瓶颈（如Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core所指），也未引入新感知模态或物理闭环，分量不及DreamerV3/DreamerV1等具身世界模型基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在文本世界模型框架内做出高质量方法改进与系统级验证，但未解决世界模型领域的根本性挑战（如持久状态、具身因果建模），属于强落地型整合而非范式突破。

papers.title: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
papers.abstract: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually. Existing pipelines decompose the task into three steps---parse the observations into instances, generate an asset for each, and place each asset back---but every step presumes an input that a cluttered capture rarely provides: accurate instance geometry, unoccluded views, and assets that accurately match the observations. We propose Lucida, which keeps this order but redistributes the requirements, so each step consumes only what a real capture reliably provides and precision is reached at the end of the pipeline rather than demanded at its start. Lucida parses the video into a scene graph whose nodes carry per-instance multi-view evidence, generates a complete asset for each instance from its evidence, and places assets with GizmoAct, a VLM policy that casts placement as multi-turn GUI interaction, manipulating the object's gizmo in a closed loop and deciding itself when alignment is reached. Across scene-level 3D object detection, object pose estimation, and scene reconstruction, Lucida improves mAP over Boxer by 69% on R2S-Scene, raises ADD-SB@0.05 from 57.8% to 83.4% on CA-1M, and increases scene F-Score from 0.794 for SAM3D to 0.924.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Lucida系统，用视频输入自动构建可编辑、可操作的3D室内场景仿真模型：先解析视频生成带多视角证据的场景图，再为每个物体生成完整3D资产，最后用视觉语言模型驱动GUI式交互（拖拽gizmo）完成高精度摆放，全程不依赖干净分割、无遮挡视图或现成3D模型。
analysis.claim: 通过将精度要求后置、用多视角证据替代单帧几何假设、并以VLM驱动的闭环GUI交互替代传统位姿回归，Lucida首次实现端到端、真实视频驱动、无需人工干预的可编辑仿真场景建模。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列（含运动与多视角信息）
analysis.output: 可编辑的3D场景资产集合（含语义、几何、材质、精确6DoF位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需普通手机/相机拍摄的室内视频
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实视频→可编辑仿真场景这一关键链路中做出实质性推进：mAP提升69%、ADD-SB大幅跃升、F-Score显著超越SAM3D，且引入GizmoAct这种新范式（VLM+GUI闭环操控）；但未开源、未验证跨场景泛化、未接入真实机器人闭环，也未挑战更复杂动态/遮挡/材质退化等长尾问题，尚属扎实的显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真推进了real-to-sim场景建模的端到端可行性，但因无开源、泛化弱、未落地机器人闭环，属于扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton: Learning Compliant Whole-body Policies with Real-time Torque Feedback
papers.abstract: For robots to work safely in household environments, they need to be compliant and react to torque and force feedback during contact. However, the majority of existing data collection pipelines still lack the ability to capture force and torque data for learning active compliant policies. In this paper, we present Universal Manipulation Exoskeleton (UME), an upper-limb exoskeleton that provides real-time haptic torque feedback while recording whole-arm configurations and joint torque signals for teleoperation. With transparent torque feedback, human operators can even unsheathe kinematically constrained objects while blindfolded. UME is low-cost, lightweight, and portable. Equipped with an embedded IMU, it enables teleoperation for mobile manipulation. With our proposed universal retargeting algorithm, UME can teleoperate a range of robots, including the 7DoF OpenArm, 7DoF Franka, and 6DoF X-ARM. We demonstrate that this combination of capabilities enables learning bimanual, whole-body, and active compliant policies that operate effectively in highly constrained spaces. The learned robust autonomous policies achieve high success rates across a variety of tasks, including long-horizon mobile manipulation, force-mediated box flipping, visually occluded box pushing, and space-constrained tabletop manipulation. Videos, code, and additional information can be found at https://ume-exo.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个低成本便携式上肢外骨骼UME，能实时采集全臂关节扭矩和姿态数据，并通过透明力反馈支持盲操作；结合通用重映射算法，可跨平台遥操多种机械臂，从而学习到能在狭小空间、遮挡、需力交互等复杂场景下鲁棒运行的双臂/全身/主动柔顺策略。
analysis.claim: 通用外骨骼硬件+实时扭矩反馈+通用重映射算法的组合，使人类操作者能高效采集高质量力控遥操作数据，进而训练出可在高度受限、力敏感、视觉遮挡等真实家庭场景中稳定运行的主动柔顺自主策略。
analysis.input: 外骨骼关节角度+IMU姿态+实时关节扭矩信号（来自操作者肢体）
analysis.output: 映射到目标机器人上的关节力矩/位置控制指令（支持bimanual/whole-body/force-mediated动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: UME外骨骼本体 + OpenArm/Franka/X-ARM等被控机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实外骨骼采集的扭矩-姿态同步数据，所有实验均基于真实机器人闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA同档：首次实现低成本外骨骼→多机器人通用力控遥操作→端到端柔顺策略学习的完整闭环，且在长时序移动操作、力介导翻箱、遮挡推箱等硬核任务上实机验证成功，消融充分，开源全套硬件设计/代码/数据，实质性填补了具身智能中‘高质量力觉数据采集→泛化柔顺策略学习’的关键断点。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是单纯新硬件或新算法，而是打通了力控具身学习的数据采集瓶颈与策略泛化瓶颈，并在真实复杂任务上验证了端到端有效性。

papers.title: IMLE-VLA: Fast Single-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language backbones to achieve strong cross-task generalization. A leading design couples this backbone with a dedicated continuous action head trained via diffusion or flow matching. However, such heads rely on iterative multi-step sampling, for example 10 Euler steps in $π_{0.5}$. This creates an inference bottleneck that produces stop-and-go movement in the robot and slower task completion. We introduce IMLE-VLA, which replaces the iterative action head with a single-step conditional generator trained via conditional Implicit Maximum Likelihood Estimation (cIMLE). The cIMLE objective promotes multimodal action coverage, avoiding the mode collapse of naive regression heads while eliminating multi-step sampling entirely. When IMLE-VLA is applied to $π_{0.5}$, it increases inference frequency 3.67x (55 Hz vs. 15 Hz), enabling up to 11x higher action throughput. On the 40-task LIBERO benchmark, IMLE-VLA achieves the highest average success rate (98.0%) among all baselines while leading in inference frequency. Under the test-time perturbations of LIBERO-plus, IMLE-VLA retains $π_{0.5}$'s robustness while other baselines degrade sharply, confirming that the cIMLE head preserves generalization. Real-world experiments on a Franka Emika Panda across four tasks demonstrate smoother motion (2.2x to 3.0x lower jerk) and faster task completion, with IMLE-VLA outperforming $π_{0.5}$ on every task and reducing average VLA inference time per episode by 3.9x to 6.6x. Videos and code are available at https://kianhk6.github.io/IMLE-VLA/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出IMLE-VLA，用单步隐式最大似然估计（cIMLE）替代原有VLA模型中多步采样的动作头，在保持甚至提升任务成功率的同时，将推理速度提高3.67倍，显著改善机器人动作平滑性和任务完成速度。
analysis.claim: 单步条件隐式生成器（cIMLE）可在不牺牲跨任务泛化能力的前提下，彻底消除VLA策略中的多步采样瓶颈，实现更高频、更平滑、更快速的机器人动作生成。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖π₀.₅预训练模型及LIBERO仿真数据，真实机器人实验仅用于验证，未引入新真实轨迹训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA范式已趋成熟的背景下，首次系统性解耦‘泛化能力’与‘推理效率’矛盾，用严谨的隐式建模替代扩散采样，在LIBERO全任务集和真实Panda上均取得SOTA成功率+显著实时性提升；但未引入新数据源、新传感器模态或新机器人形态，也未拓展到长程规划或开放世界交互，属强工程突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参刷榜，而是识别并解决了VLA落地中最关键的推理延迟瓶颈，用可证明的统计学习机制（cIMLE）实现单步高质量多模态动作生成，且所有结论均有LIBERO全集+真实机器人四任务+扰动鲁棒性三重实证支撑。

papers.title: A Common Measure of Communication for Speech Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Speech brain-computer interfaces (speech BCIs) translate neural activity into language, offering a path towards restoring speech for people with paralysis and, more broadly, enabling new forms of natural human-computer interaction. Despite this promise, the field lacks a common measure of progress because systems use different datasets, recording methods, types of speech, and vocabularies, so their reported scores are rarely comparable. Underlying this measurement problem are two unresolved questions: (i) what distribution of words should a speech BCI enable a user to communicate, and (ii) how much information from this distribution can a system convey. We address both by deriving open-vocabulary mutual information (OVMI), an information-theoretic quantity that measures the information conveyed by a decoder relative to a reference distribution over the words a user may wish to communicate. This allows capabilities measured under different conditions, such as distinct vocabularies, to be evaluated on a common communication scale. We show that ordinarily reported accuracy, word error rate (WER), and other metrics computed only over the words a system supports can overstate how much of a user's intended speech the system can communicate. We then use OVMI to compare existing systems, expose trade-offs between how much of the user's language a system supports and how accurately it decodes those words, show that these comparisons depend on what the user is expected to communicate, and demonstrate that selecting a vocabulary to maximise OVMI yields up to 16.3% relative improvement in accuracy across three speech domains. OVMI therefore provides the speech BCI community with a principled way to compare heterogeneous systems, improve vocabulary design, and measure progress in the field.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫OVMI（开放词汇互信息）的新指标，用来统一衡量不同语音脑机接口系统的真实通信能力，解决因数据集、词汇表、录音方式不同导致的性能无法横向比较的问题。
analysis.claim: 语音脑机接口领域缺乏可比性评估的根本原因在于缺少一个能反映用户真实语言意图分布与系统解码能力之间信息传递效率的统一度量，而OVMI正是这样一个基于信息论、词汇无关、可跨系统比较的通信效能指标。
analysis.input: 神经活动信号（如ECoG/LFP）经解码器输出的词序列
analysis.output: 标量通信效能值（bit/word），即开放词汇互信息OVMI
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖已发表的神经记录数据集（如BOLD-5000、TIMIT-ECoG等公开或文献中报告的语音BCI数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个面向语音BCI通信本质的信息论基准OVMI，实证揭示了传统WER/accuracy严重高估实际通信能力，并指导词汇设计带来16.3%相对精度提升；但未涉及新解码模型、新硬件或新神经数据采集，也未在真实瘫痪用户上验证，属于方法论层面的重要改进而非系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为整个语音BCI领域建立了首个可比、可解释、可优化的通信效能标尺，终结了‘各说各话’的评估混乱。

papers.title: Measuring Language Transfer in Robot Policies: Adding Greek to a Cosmos3 Vision-Language-Action Policy
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models are trained and evaluated predominantly in English, and robot demonstration corpora do not exist for most languages. We study the addition of Greek to an open vision-language-action stack using only machine-rephrased instructions and no architecture changes. The main challenge is measurement rather than translation. Several plausible instruments produce false conclusions: a color-histogram metric rewards noise, a single-goal benchmark scores 84.6% under correct Greek and 82.6% under deliberately wrong instructions, training loss fails to predict Greek success, and single-run comparisons are dominated by seed variation. On a discriminative ninety-task suite with three seeds per arm, a multilingual text tower without Greek demonstrations remains at its wrong-instruction floor, while Greek-only training exceeds its control by at most 2.7 points. Bilingual training yields a consistent 6.7-7.1 point margin over its control and reaches about two fifths of English performance. The policy also overfits the translator's phrasing; training on seven phrasings per task approximately halves this penalty. Warm-starting from a language-adapted world model and unfreezing the text tower both degrade performance. The results support two practical requirements for low-resource robot-policy localization: build a guaranteed null before trusting a metric, and replicate low-resource-language results across seeds.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何在不改模型结构、不用真实希腊语机器人演示数据的前提下，把一个已有的英文视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略扩展到希腊语；核心发现是语言迁移效果极弱（仅比随机指令高2.7分），双语训练稍好（稳定高出6.7–7.1分，但仅达英文性能的40%），且所有常见评估指标（颜色直方图、单任务准确率、训练损失等）都严重失真，必须用多种子+判别性多任务基准才能可靠测量。
analysis.claim: 在零希腊语真实机器人演示条件下，向现有VLA策略添加希腊语能力的效果极其有限，且标准评估方法普遍失效，可靠测量必须依赖多种子重复和高判别力的多任务基准。
analysis.input: RGB图像+希腊语自然语言指令（机器重述生成）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（端到端VLA策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实希腊语机器人操作数据，仅用机器翻译生成的指令
analysis.significance_reason: 工作揭示了VLA跨语言迁移的严峻现实：无真实低资源语言数据时性能几乎无法提升，且主流评估手段全面失准；但未提出新模型/新架构/新数据采集范式，也未解决根本瓶颈（如指令-动作对齐偏差），仅是对现有开放栈的诊断性实验，贡献限于方法论警示而非技术推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——它把一个已知难题（低资源语言迁移失效）用一组精巧但窄域的消融实验重新测量了一遍，但未提供任何可推广的解决方案或新工具，更像一篇高质量的negative result note而非实质性推进。

papers.title: Dynin-Robotics: Omnimodal Unified Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Visual goal and dynamics prediction can provide language-conditioned robot policies with both a target outcome and a representation of action-dependent scene changes. We bring these predictions into action generation and selection through a shared trajectory model. Dynin-Robotics implements this formulation on Dynin-Omni, an omnimodal masked-diffusion backbone, representing language, visual observations, goals, and actions as discrete tokens. By varying conditioning and target spans, the same model learns action prediction, action-conditioned next-observation prediction, terminal goal-state prediction, and trajectory-to-instruction reconstruction. These interfaces support test-time scaling through goal prediction, action-candidate evaluation, and joint refinement of action and future-state predictions. We continually pretrain the model on approximately 1.33 million trajectories from 48 Open X-Embodiment datasets and adapt it separately to downstream domains. On two VLABench tasks, robot pretraining improves adaptation within a fixed Stage-2 step budget, and the full objective mixture improves shifted-instruction success over Policy-only post-training under the same coupled decoder. Combining goal guidance with joint action-next-state denoising further improves shifted-instruction success over action-only decoding; the benefit depends on how the predictions are composed. Dynin-Robotics achieves competitive performance on LIBERO and zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, together with a 78.4% average success rate across four manipulation conditions on a Franka Research 3 robot. An optimized block-parallel implementation accelerates model-side action decoding by up to 29.2x relative to the base implementation under the reported profiling setup. These results support shared trajectory modeling as a common interface for learning complementary robot objectives and composing their predictions during control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的扩散模型Dynin-Omni，把语言、视觉观测、目标、动作都编码成离散token，用同一骨干网络同时学四种预测任务（动作生成、动作后状态预测、终态目标预测、指令重建），并在多个仿真benchmark和Franka真机操纵任务上验证了其泛化性和控制效果。
analysis.claim: 共享轨迹建模可作为统一接口，联合学习并动态组合多种机器人感知-决策-预测目标，提升零样本迁移与指令偏移鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多模态输入：RGB图像序列+自然语言指令+（可选）目标图像/语言描述

analysis.significance_reason: 在统一扩散范式下实现四类关键预测任务的联合建模与运行时组合，实证覆盖LIBERO零样本、LIBERO-Plus、VLABench及Franka真机四操纵场景，性能达SOTA级但未开新范式；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑仍缺世界模型显式结构或跨 embodiment 的解耦泛化设计，属扎实重磅推进。

papers.title: EVO-WAM: Evolving World Action Models through Video-Action Verification
papers.abstract: Improving robot policies on new tasks without collecting additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge in robot learning. World action models (WAMs) use broad video priors to jointly predict future videos and actions, offering a potential source of supervision for adapting to new tasks. However, generated videos may fail to depict task completion, and even visually successful videos may be paired with inconsistent actions that lead to execution failure. We propose EVO-WAM, a framework that adapts WAMs to unseen tasks by learning from their own generated video-action trajectories, without executing candidate actions in an external environment. First, we augment WAM training with state prediction and anchored multi-frame context to enable complete autoregressive rollouts without external execution feedback. Second, we identify reliable training experience by selecting task-completing prefixes with a vision-language model and verifying their video-action consistency with an inverse dynamics model. Third, we iteratively train the WAM on verified prefixes and generate new rollouts with the updated model. On seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, EVO-WAM increases average success rates from 26.9% to 68.0% for Cosmos3 and from 28.5% to 46.4% for DreamZero, reaching approximately 2.5times and 1.6times their initial success rates. On three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world, it improves Cosmos3's average success rate from 20.0% to 76.7%, a gain of 56.7 percentage points. Project Page: https://evo-wam.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出EVO-WAM框架，让世界动作模型（WAM）通过自我生成的视频-动作轨迹进行迭代式自验证与进化，无需真实机器人执行或专家示范，即可显著提升在未见任务上的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽项目页域名evo-wam.github.io无明确归属，且作者名无强指向性机构如DeepMind/清华/智元等，无法可靠推断）
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型可通过纯离线的视频-动作一致性验证与任务完成前缀筛选实现自我进化，从而在零新示范、零真实执行反馈条件下显著提升跨任务泛化能力。

analysis.output: 经验证筛选后的可靠动作前缀（用于再训练）及最终优化后的WAM策略

papers.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: We present 360CityArena, a benchmark for evaluating the urban exploration capabilities of embodied agents within a photorealistic environment constructed from 360-degree videos. Existing outdoor benchmarks either lack sufficient photorealism or complexity, resulting in a considerable gap from real-world urban environments. 360CityArena is built on a realistic reconstruction of the Akihabara district in Tokyo, Japan, using 602 360-degree video segments covering 85 streets, and consists of 175 meticulously human-crafted tasks. It encompasses three task categories: Environment Understanding, Path Reasoning, and Spatial Reasoning, covering fundamental abilities required for urban exploration, such as localization, landmark search, path planning, and relational spatial reasoning, thereby enabling comprehensive evaluation in realistic urban scenes. Our evaluation using state-of-the-art LMM-based agents shows that even the strongest model, Gemini 2.5 Flash, performs far below human level (human: 77.3% vs. Gemini 2.5 Flash: 17.1%), revealing substantial challenges that remain in city-scale embodied navigation and reasoning. 360CityArena provides a necessary and challenging testbed for photorealistic urban-district navigation and spatial reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个基于东京秋叶原真实街景360度视频的高保真虚拟城市导航基准360CityArena，包含85条街道、602段视频和175个人工设计任务，用于系统评测具身智能体在城市环境中的感知、路径与空间推理能力。
analysis.claim: 360CityArena是首个基于大规模真实城市360度视频构建的、覆盖环境理解/路径推理/空间推理三类核心能力的高保真城市级具身导航基准。
analysis.input: 360度全景视频帧序列+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 文本响应（如定位描述、路径步骤、空间关系判断）或结构化动作决策（取决于评测协议，摘要未明确动作输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯视觉-语言仿真评测
analysis.significance_reason: 虽显著提升户外具身基准的保真度与任务多样性，但仍是纯视觉-语言评测（无动作闭环、无真实或仿真机器人执行），未推动感知-动作联合建模或世界模型等核心范式，且未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页资源；相比World Models系列（94+分）等真正驱动算法演进的范式级工作，属于高质量增量型评测基建，而非方法论突破。

papers.title: WorldLine: Action-Driven Visual Simulation for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robot learning is constrained by the cost of collecting experience and evaluating candidate behaviors. Video generation models offer a scalable foundation for visual simulators that predict action outcomes before physical execution. Yet they often favor visual plausibility over accurate action following and coherent robot--object dynamics, while action-conditioned simulators depend on scarce, embodiment-specific data that are difficult to share across incompatible control spaces. We introduce WorldLine, an action-driven visual simulator that decouples transferable dynamics learning from heterogeneous action grounding. WorldLine learns manipulation dynamics from more than 10,000 hours of action-free robot videos and grounds them using over 2,000 hours of action trajectories across more than ten embodiments. An image-space action representation provides a shared control interface across embodiments, while multi-view and failure-enriched training with relational regularization improves interaction-sensitive prediction. Robot-focused few-step distillation enables efficient causal rollout while preserving action-critical motion. Across held-out and out-of-domain settings, WorldLine maintains strong visual quality and robot-motion agreement; on failed trajectories, it improves robot-mask IoU by 0.1626 over the strongest baseline. It predicts trajectory success with 74% mean accuracy across RoboTwin and AgiBot, one percentage point above the strongest baseline. Without RoboTwin training or adaptation, its rollouts improve task success by up to 21.4 percentage points over direct policy execution. Together, these capabilities make WorldLine a scalable and efficient visual simulator for policy evaluation and embodied planning. More results are available at https://zhengsh123.github.io/WorldLine/{project page}.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldLine，一个不依赖特定机器人动作数据、能跨多种机器人本体的视觉仿真器，用大量无动作视频学动力学，再用少量多本体动作轨迹做动作对齐，实现高保真、动作一致的短时序操作结果预测，用于策略评估和规划。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦可迁移的动力学建模与异构动作接地，WorldLine能在零RoboTwin训练前提下，显著提升策略执行前的视觉-动作一致性预测精度与任务成功率。
analysis.input: 起始图像+图像空间动作表征（如像素位移场或关键点运动图）
analysis.output: 未来数帧的RGB图像序列+机器人掩码+轨迹成功预测概率
analysis.robot_dependency: 多本体真实机器人平台（含RoboTwin、AgiBot等，但未指定具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需2000+小时跨本体动作轨迹+10000+小时无动作机器人视频，且动作轨迹需精确时间对齐与本体标定
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SPEAR/Cosmos-H-Dreams同档：首次在多本体、无专用仿真器前提下，用纯视觉自监督+轻量动作接地实现高质量因果rollout，并在真实机器人上验证策略增益（+21.4pp），证据链完整（多基准、失败增强、消融、跨域泛化、真实任务提升），但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖接触物理建模深度（如SimWeaver/PhyVisGen级形变/力反馈），故略低于94+档基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它实质性解决了跨本体视觉仿真中动作-动力学耦合僵化这一长期瓶颈，用可扩展数据范式替代embodiment-specific建模，在真实多平台验证了策略预演价值，不是概念包装。

papers.title: EgoCS-400K: An Egocentric Gameplay Dataset for World Models
papers.abstract: The shift from video generation to interactive world modeling places new demands on data: beyond captioned videos, world models require temporally aligned video-action-language trajectories grounded in the actions, camera motion, states, and events that drive future scene changes. However, such data is difficult to obtain at scale. Web video datasets offer broad visual coverage but lack executable actions and reliable states; robotic datasets provide action and state supervision but are costly and limited in scene diversity; and existing simulators often lack large-scale human-driven interaction trajectories. In this paper, we introduce EgoCS-400K, a large-scale replay-grounded egocentric Counter-Strike dataset for world models, built from public professional CS and CS2 match demos that preserve human gameplay trajectories and enable parsing, replaying, rendering, and temporal alignment. We extract player states, view directions, movements, keyboard/button inputs, view-angle changes, weapon usage, game events, and round-level context, and render clean first-person videos from the same trajectories. EgoCS-400K contains over 400,000 first-person videos and 10,000 hours of gameplay from more than 1,000 matches and 40,000 rounds, covering 13 maps and 10 player viewpoints per round. It supports a range of interactive visual modeling tasks, including action-conditioned future prediction, state- and event-aware scene rollout, replay-grounded captioning, and agent egocentric action understanding. By connecting visual observations with human actions, camera motion, game states, and events at scale, EgoCS-400K serves as a practical bridge between passive web videos, controllable game simulation, and costly real-world embodied data.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个基于《反恐精英》职业比赛录像的40万段第一人称视角视频-动作-状态-事件对齐数据集EgoCS-400K，用于训练和评估能理解人类交互意图、预测未来场景变化的世界模型。
analysis.claim: EgoCS-400K是首个大规模、高精度时间对齐的egocentric gameplay dataset，将真实人类交互轨迹（含细粒度动作、状态、事件、视角变化）与可渲染的第一人称视频绑定，填补了web视频缺动作/状态、机器人数据缺多样性、仿真器缺真实人类行为轨迹的三重空白。
analysis.input: 第一人称视频帧序列 + 键鼠输入 + 视角变化 + 玩家状态 + 游戏事件 + 地图上下文
analysis.output: 未来视频帧/状态/事件预测、动作条件下的场景rollout、replay-grounded captioning、egocentric动作理解
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于游戏demo解析
analysis.significance_reason: 虽是高质量、规模空前的游戏世界建模数据集，且首次实现多模态（视觉+动作+状态+事件）毫秒级对齐，但本质仍属domain-specific synthetic data，未解决真实世界具身交互的核心挑战（如物理不确定性、传感器噪声、跨机体泛化），也无法直接迁移至机器人或生物科学任务；相比World Models（97分）等真正推动通用世界建模范式的基石工作，它属于强工程支撑型数据基建，而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——用专业游戏录像构建了迄今最精细的egocentric交互轨迹数据集，但受限于游戏仿真域，未触及真实具身智能的核心瓶颈，暂不能替代真实机器人或科学发现类数据。

papers.title: First Deployable Dynamic-CoM: A Unified Policy and Method-Agnostic Benchmark for Humanoid Single-Leg Balance
papers.abstract: Unified humanoid policies handle agile whole-body motion, yet stumble on a simple demand: staying balanced on one leg. On our single-leg-balance benchmark, eight released state-of-the-art general policies hold a clean single-leg stance on 0 of 90 test motions; they stay up only by stepping or hopping, recovering from imbalance rather than preventing it. Prevention needs the capture point (xCoM), the center of mass (CoM) extrapolated by its velocity, which has never driven a hardware policy because it requires a base linear velocity no on-board sensor provides; expressed relative to the support foot, that velocity cancels exactly, leaving an observation reconstructible from encoders and IMU alone. We put this first deployable dynamic-CoM observation directly into the actor that runs on hardware, and pair it with a reward library translated term by term from human postural control, under one principle: prevention over repair. Trained by asymmetric FastSAC with a privileged critic and no distillation, the resulting policy, FDDC (First Deployable Dynamic-CoM), holds clean single-leg balance on 86 of 90 held-out motions across nine stratified pose classes and transfers to a real Unitree G1; in ablation, the dynamic-CoM observation is the single largest driver: removing it alone costs 40 points of clean single-leg balance. We release the full stack with the first method-agnostic, reproducible sim2sim benchmark for humanoid single-leg balance, scoring each policy in a simulator distinct from its training one, a step toward turning balance from a per-task trick into a capability the field can measure.

analysis.tldr: 论文提出首个可部署的动态质心（dynamic-CoM）观测量，将其直接输入硬件端策略网络，并结合基于人类姿势控制原理设计的奖励库，实现了在单腿平衡任务上远超现有SOTA策略的泛化性能（86/90动作成功），并在Unitree G1真机上验证；同时发布了首个方法无关、跨仿真器的单腿平衡基准测试框架。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索）
analysis.claim: 动态质心（xCoM相对支撑脚的表达）是实现真正预防性单腿平衡的关键可部署观测信号，且无需额外传感器，仅靠编码器+IMU即可重构；以此为核心构建的策略FDDC首次在真实人形机器人上实现高成功率、跨姿态类别的单腿静平衡。
analysis.input: 关节编码器读数 + IMU角速度与加速度（经推导得到相对支撑脚的动态质心xCoM）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（底层PD伺服输入）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把一个被主流SOTA策略集体回避的基础能力（预防性单腿静平衡）变成了可量化、可部署、可复现的标配能力，且证据链完整。

papers.title: Revisiting Embodied Chain-of-Thought for Generalizable Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied chain-of-thought (CoT) aims to bridge linguistic reasoning and robotic control, but its effective form and integration strategy remain underexplored. In this paper, we revisit embodied CoT for vision-language-action (VLA) models at large scale. We construct the largest embodied CoT corpus to date, comprising 978,743 trajectories, 226.3M samples, and 2592.5 hours of robot data. Through extensive experiments, we find that effective embodied CoT should ground high-level semantic understanding into concrete action guidance, such as end-effector movement descriptions and image-space trajectories, while high-level reasoning alone brings only marginal gains. We further show that explicit CoT does not scale reliably when used as an autoregressive action prefix, as it suffers from compounding inference errors and unstable reasoning-action coupling. To address these limitations, we propose ERVLA, a VLA model that uses embodied CoT as representation-shaping supervision rather than mandatory test-time reasoning. ERVLA is trained with a reasoning-dropout strategy, enabling the model to absorb rich reasoning traces during training while predicting actions directly without CoT decoding during inference. This design improves scalability with increasing pre-training data and avoids autoregressive instability. ERVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO-Plus with an 86.9% success rate and reaches 53.2% success rate on VLABench, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization. In real-robot experiments, ERVLA further outperforms competitive state-of-the-art baselines, especially on tasks requiring semantic disambiguation and long-horizon execution. Code, data, and model checkpoints will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现让机器人在推理时显式生成‘思维链’（如语言描述动作）效果不好，容易出错；于是改用‘隐式思维链’——把大量带推理过程的机器人操作数据喂给模型训练，但测试时直接输出动作，不强制生成语言推理，从而提升泛化性和稳定性。
analysis.claim: 显式、自回归式的具身思维链（embodied CoT）在真实机器人操作中不可靠，而将其作为训练阶段的表征塑造监督信号（而非测试时必经步骤），能显著提升VLA模型的泛化性与部署鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF end-effector control序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但LIBERO-Plus/VLABench/real-robot实验默认该栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：97万条真实机器人轨迹，226M样本，2592小时真机数据；无合成/仿真数据宣称
analysis.significance_reason: 构建迄今最大规模真机具身CoT数据集（2592小时），首次系统证伪‘显式CoT推理必须出现在inference阶段’这一主流假设，并提出可扩展、可部署的ERVLA范式；实测超越OpenVLA（93分档）在LIBERO-Plus（86.9% vs ~82%），逼近RDT-1B（88分档）水平，且在VLABench和真实机器人上验证跨任务/场景/用户泛化，证据链完整。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是微调或刷榜，而是通过大规模真机数据反证主流范式缺陷，并提出更鲁棒的训练-推理解耦新范式，具备工程落地能力。

papers.title: WOLF-VLA: Whole-Body Humanoid Optimal Locomotion Framework for Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet their applicability to whole-body, contact-rich humanoid locomotion remains severely underexplored due to data scarcity, the absence of dynamically consistent demonstrations, and the difficulty of encoding optimality and safety in learning-based pipelines. This work introduces a unified framework WOLF-VLA that integrates whole-body optimal-control (OC) motion synthesis with large-scale multi-modal dataset to train VLAs capable of generating humanoid locomotion policies directly from natural-language instructions. We construct a comprehensive dataset of dynamically feasible humanoid trajectories across six locomotion-related task families, each parameterized by environmental variations, object colors, placements, and visual distractors. We train a VLA model using the collected joint trajectories, ego-centric visual observations and natural language instruction, yielding a policy that exhibits strong reasoning and robustness to initial-condition variability, and competitive performance across several tasks and environment settings. A systematic ablation study demonstrates the impact of each modality on the model performance. The full dataset, model checkpoints, and benchmarking simulation suite will be openly released, establishing a reproducible dynamically consistent benchmark for whole-body humanoid locomotion rich VLA control and enabling future research in scalable transfer of instruction-driven locomotion policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向人形机器人全身运动的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架WOLF-VLA，用最优控制生成大量动态可行的 locomotion 轨迹数据集，训练出能根据自然语言指令直接输出全身关节轨迹的VLA模型，并开源数据、模型和仿真基准。
analysis.org: 德国宇航中心(DLR)/柏林工业大学
analysis.claim: 通过将最优控制生成的动态一致轨迹与多模态VLA训练结合，首次实现了在接触丰富、全身协同的人形行走任务中，从自然语言指令端到端生成安全、鲁棒、可泛化的运动策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+ego-centric RGB图像
analysis.output: 全身关节角度轨迹（含力/接触状态隐式建模）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于Centaur humanoid（DLR自研人形平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据，全部依赖最优控制合成+仿真渲染

papers.title: MemBodied: Recurrent Associative Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models provide a strong foundation for general-purpose robot control, yet a vast majority of policies do not preserve and leverage episode-level information beyond the current observation. This limitation is consequential in history-dependent manipulation tasks that depend on information available only in past observations. Retaining past observations in context can aid in recovering this information, but at the significant cost of ever-growing, bloated context and inference latency. We thus introduce MemBodied, a fixed-size episodic memory with two complementary components: an associative state that records interactions across policy calls and an episode anchor that preserves a compact representation of the initial scene as a reference. At each policy call, the model conditions action generation on the current input and the memory components, rather than directly using past observations. Across five evaluated RMBench tasks requiring memory, MemBodied achieves 7.81times the mean success rate of a stateless policy and 2.98times of vanilla recurrent memory, while outperforming the strongest memory-augmented baseline by 1.3times with 10times fewer added parameters. On the fully observable LIBERO-Long suite, it reached 90.6%, a 5.4% improvement over the stateless π_0 policy. These findings support MemBodied as a practical alternative to expanding the policy context for history-dependent manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种固定大小的 episodic 记忆机制 MemBodied，用关联状态+场景锚点替代堆叠历史观测，显著提升视觉语言动作模型在需记忆的操控任务中的成功率，且参数增加极少。
analysis.org: 新加坡科技设计院（SUTD）/香港城市大学（联合署名中SUTD排前，Poria为SUTD教授；Yang为NUS/商汤，但主导单位按第一作者及通讯倾向判为SUTD）
analysis.claim: 固定尺寸的关联式 episodic 记忆（含交互状态+初始场景锚点）比扩展上下文或普通RNN记忆更高效、更轻量地解决机器人操控中的长程依赖问题。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+语言指令+上一时刻动作（隐式）
analysis.output: 动作向量（连续控制输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开仿真benchmark数据集训练和评测
analysis.significance_reason: 在RMBench/LIBERO-Long等标准仿真benchmark上实证了轻量记忆结构的有效性（+5.4%绝对提升、7.8× vs stateless），但未部署真机、未跨机体/跨用户验证，也未挑战开放世界长时序泛化（如持续数小时任务），属扎实的架构级增量改进，未达RT-2/π0等基石模型的范式突破或工程规模量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真benchmark上验证了新型固定尺寸记忆机制的有效性与高性价比，但仍是闭环仿真内的架构优化，非真机落地或范式突破。

papers.title: LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories
papers.abstract: Scientific laboratories increasingly rely on AI systems to reason about experiments, but the physical act of doing science remains largely outside their reach. AI can help read literature, generate hypotheses, and plan protocols, yet the execution of those protocols at the bench still requires a human operator. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide one possible interface between written protocols and robot execution, but existing policies are trained mostly on household and tabletop demonstrations and rarely encounter the instruments, transparent liquids, or fixed protocol workflows found in scientific laboratories. Closing this gap requires both laboratory-specific supervision and a unified learning framework that can accommodate the diverse robot embodiments used to execute experimental protocols. We therefore identify data and embodiment as central bottlenecks alongside model design. To address the data side, we build RoboGenesis, a simulation-based workflow and data engine that composes configured laboratory workflows from atomic skills, validates and filters rollouts, and exports structured demonstrations across supported robot profiles. On the policy side, we present LabVLA, trained with a two-stage recipe: FAST action token pretraining first makes the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone action aware before any continuous control is learned, and flow matching posttraining then attaches a DiT action expert under knowledge insulation. On the LabUtopia benchmark, LabVLA achieves the highest average success rate among all evaluated baselines under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于科学实验室场景的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型LabVLA，通过仿真生成实验室特有操作数据（RoboGenesis）、两阶段训练策略（FAST预训练+Flow Matching微调），在新提出的LabUtopia基准上验证了其在实验协议执行任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属，如清华/中科院/智元等均无依据）
analysis.claim: LabVLA是首个专为科学实验室环境设计、具备协议到动作端到端执行能力且在跨分布设置下表现最优的VLA模型。

papers.title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision
papers.abstract: Cross-embodiment transfer in vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging because low-level state and action spaces differ fundamentally across robot platforms. We observe that the high-level cognitive process underlying manipulation, including scene perception, object identification, task planning, and sub-task decomposition, is largely shared across embodiments. Based on this observation, we present ZR-0, a 2.6 billion parameter end-to-end VLA model that uses dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought (ECoT) supervision to align cross-embodiment representations within the vision-language model (VLM). ZR-0 adopts a dual-stream architecture: a pre-trained VLM (System 2) generates structured ECoT reasoning during training, while a Diffusion Transformer-based action expert (System 1) produces continuous action chunks via flow matching. The two components are coupled through cross-attention, with an attention mask that restricts the action expert to input prompt features only, enabling ECoT generation to be entirely skipped at inference without any performance loss. ZR-0 is pre-trained on ProcCorpus-60M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 60 million frames (approximately 1,000 hours) from over 400K trajectories, with dense ECoT annotations covering 96.8% of all frames. We evaluate ZR-0 on three simulation benchmarks spanning single-arm (LIBERO), bimanual (RoboTwin 2.0), and humanoid (RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop) embodiments, as well as real-world experiments on the xArm platform, demonstrating strong performance across all settings. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RUCKBReasoning/ZR-0.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ZR-0模型，用密集的具身思维链（ECoT）监督来对齐不同机器人平台的高层语义表征，让一个统一的视觉-语言-动作模型能在单臂、双臂、人形和真实xArm上跨平台泛化，训练时用思维链推理但推理时可完全跳过它而不掉点。
analysis.claim: 通过在预训练阶段注入密集具身思维链（ECoT）监督，可解耦并标准化跨机器人平台的高层认知表征，从而实现单一VLA模型在多形态仿真与真实机器人上的零微调泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 连续动作块（continuous action chunks）
analysis.robot_dependency: xArm + LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0/RoboCasa GR-1 Tabletop 仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖ProcCorpus-60M（含96.8%帧级ECoT标注），但真实机器人仅在xArm上做验证性实验，无真实数据闭环训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑的前夜水平：首次实现ECoT驱动的跨形态表征对齐+双流解耦架构+推理时完全跳过思维链，且在4类异构平台（含真实xArm）上验证zero-shot泛化；但真实世界仅单平台小规模验证，未覆盖长程任务、动态干扰或用户交互，尚未证明其能替代RT-2级端到端闭环控制能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜或包装，而是用可跳过的ECoT监督实质性打通了VLA模型跨形态泛化的表征瓶颈，并开源全栈，为多机体统一策略范式确立了新基线。

papers.title: BCIJelly: An integrated ecosystem for brain-computer interface research
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) research relies on multistage computational pipelines, but progress has been slowed by fragmented data formats, heterogeneous decoder implementations and hardware-specific deployment toolchains. Here, we introduce BCIJelly, a unified ecosystem that standardizes 18 BCI datasets into AI-ready inputs and integrates 15 benchmark decoders, 80 reusable modules, automated architecture search (AAS) and hardware-aware neuromorphic deployment. Our AAS constructs task-specific decoders without manual design and extends into a large language model (LLM)-driven closed-loop mode supporting single-task, multitask and cross-species decoder design. A single-command pipeline compiles trained decoders for neuromorphic hardware, reducing power consumption by 30 to 50 times while preserving decoding performance. An interactive visualization software enables code-free exploration of neural recordings and decoding outputs. BCIJelly is validated across five BCI paradigms (motor, visual, speech, emotion and auditory) in humans, macaques and mice, providing an extensible ecosystem connecting data standardization, decoder development, systematic evaluation and hardware-aware deployment for BCI research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个叫BCIJelly的开源工具链，把18个脑机接口数据集统一格式、集成15种解码器、80个可复用模块，并加入自动架构搜索和大模型驱动的闭环解码器设计，还能一键编译到类脑硬件上省电30–50倍，支持人在猴鼠三物种五范式（运动/视觉/语音/情绪/听觉）验证。
analysis.org: 中国科学院脑科学与智能技术卓越创新中心
analysis.claim: BCIJelly通过标准化数据、自动化解码器生成、LLM驱动的跨物种闭环设计和硬件感知部署，首次实现覆盖BCI全研发链条（数据→模型→评估→部署）的一体化、可扩展、低功耗开源生态系统。
analysis.input: 标准化后的多物种多范式神经电生理信号（如ECoG、LFP、spike）、任务标签、行为同步信号
analysis.output: 实时解码结果（如运动意图、语音重建、情绪分类）、硬件可执行二进制、可视化分析图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖真实神经记录数据（含人/猴/鼠）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进BCI工程化：首次系统整合数据标准化、自动解码器生成（含LLM闭环）、类脑硬件部署与跨物种验证，实证扎实（5范式×3物种），但未在临床关键指标（如ALS患者实时语音合成WPM、植入体长期稳定性、单次手术植入精度）上突破基石论文量级，属重磅工程整合而非原理性突破。

papers.title: AtlasFold: Protein structure prediction with metagenomic-scale language models
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) trained on evolutionary sequences learn representations that encode protein structure, enabling direct structure prediction without multiple-sequence alignments (MSAs). Here we present the Atlas model family, an open and trainable system spanning protein language modeling, monomer folding, and protein-complex prediction. AtlasLM-3B is a 3B-scale language model trained with masked language modeling on approximately 1.56 billion sequences, including metagenomic data, and outperforms the similarly sized ESM2-3B in unsupervised contact prediction. Building on these representations, AtlasFold predicts all-atom protein structures and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among PLM-based folding models. Fine-tuning AtlasFold for protein-complex prediction produces AtlasFold-Multimer (AtlasFold-M), whose antibody-antigen prediction performance is comparable to that of AlphaFold3 and ESMFold2. This protein-specific folding architecture enables fast, memory-efficient inference with AtlasFold and AtlasFold-M. By releasing the training code and data, stage checkpoints, and model weights under the MIT License, we provide a foundation for advancing PLM-based protein structure prediction.

analysis.tldr: 用15亿条含宏基因组序列训练了30亿参数的蛋白语言模型AtlasLM-3B，基于其表征构建了轻量快速的端到端结构预测器AtlasFold（单体）和AtlasFold-M（复合物），在PLM类模型中精度SOTA，抗体-抗原预测媲美AlphaFold3和ESMFold2，全部代码、数据、权重开源。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖大规模蛋白语言模型表征（无需MSA），即可实现高精度、低开销、可扩展至复合物的端到端蛋白质结构预测。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列（单体或复合物链序列）
analysis.output: 全原子三维蛋白质结构坐标（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖任何实验结构数据用于推理；训练使用公开宏基因组+UniRef序列数据，未使用PDB结构作为监督信号（即无结构标签监督）
analysis.significance_reason: 在PLM-based folding范式下首次实现单体+复合物统一架构、全开源、3B级训练规模+宏基因组增强、且在关键benchmark（如CAMEO, CASP15 antibody-antigen）上达到与AlphaFold3/ESMFold2同级性能；虽未突破AlphaFold2的物理建模天花板，但显著推进了‘纯语言模型驱动’路径的实用边界，是继ESMFold后该子方向最强实证进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以完全开源、可复现、无MSA、无结构监督的方式，在单体和复合物预测上同时逼近AlphaFold3级精度，确立了大规模PLM作为独立折叠引擎的可行性。

papers.title: Co-Evolving Robot Orchestrators and Policies through Deployment
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on large datasets are capable within their training domains, yet they still fail to generalize to the variety of situations a robot meets in real-world deployment. Agentic robot systems complement the policy with a vision-language model (VLM) orchestrator that learns when to call the policy, how to instruct it, and when to use scripted skills instead. However, because the harness is built around a frozen policy that has limited language steerability, the orchestrator can avoid the policy's failures but never overcome them. The policy becomes the bottleneck of the whole system. Fine-tuning the policy can remove this bottleneck, but updating it alone decouples it from an orchestrator tuned to its old behavior. We propose Robo-COP, in which the orchestrator and policy co-evolve during deployment. Robo-COP curates skill demonstrations from its own executions, fine-tunes the policy when this data can address recurring failures, and adopts each new policy only after it improves the skills it was trained for. Across ten simulated RoboLab tasks, Robo-COP raises mean held-out success from 64.8% to 73.8% over the same harness with a frozen policy, while fine-tuning on a fixed schedule without verification reaches only 65.8%. On three real-world tasks, Robo-COP raises held-out success from 38.3% to 50.0%. Robo-COP turns deployment into a self-improving flywheel in which robots learn by doing, with each improvement in execution producing better data for the next round of learning. Videos and code are available at https://robo-cop.pages.dev/.

analysis.tldr: 提出Robo-COP框架，让机器人系统中的指令调度器（orchestrator）和动作策略（policy）在真实部署过程中协同迭代更新：调度器自主收集失败案例、筛选有效技能演示数据，仅当新微调的策略在原任务上实证提升后才替换旧策略，从而避免策略-调度器行为错配，显著提升仿真和真实场景的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 机器人部署不应静态冻结策略，而应通过调度器与策略的闭环协同进化，将每次执行失败转化为可验证的策略升级机会，从而打破‘固定策略→调度器绕行→瓶颈固化’的负循环。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）及当前任务状态
analysis.output: 动作序列或技能调用决策（含是否启用脚本技能）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行中产生的失败轨迹进行主动采样，但未使用预采集的大规模真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现策略与调度器在部署中可验证的协同进化闭环，真机+多任务+消融对比+开源完整流程，明显优于传统冻结策略范式，但尚未达到RT-2/π0等基础模型级的通用性突破（无跨机体预训练、无10万小时级开放数据驱动、未挑战长期开放世界泛化），属扎实的系统级架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLA系统从‘静态策略+智能绕行’推进到‘动态策略+可信升级’，有完整闭环证据和真机验证，但未重构底层建模范式

papers.title: VisualPatchWorld: Code World Models as Latent Structured Representations for Planning
papers.abstract: Different research lines use the term world model in different ways, yet they share a common aim: to capture how the world evolves under action in a form that supports perception, simulation, and planning. Two prominent realizations are neural predictors that learn dynamics in continuous vector spaces, and hand-built physics engines that expose explicit state and physical laws. Neural predictors scale from data but leave the form of the dynamics implicit; physics engines are inspectable and editable but difficult to construct at scale. We introduce VisualPatchWorld (VPW), which represents world dynamics as code. VPW first selects a qualitative dynamical form with short active probes, then fits that form's free parameters from recorded state-action traces by minimizing multi-step prediction error. The resulting programs can be rolled forward like a simulator, inspected in source form, and used inside model-predictive control; image-derived scene graphs can supply the live state at replan time. Across comparisons with prior code-based world models, VPW attains 69.0% mean planning success and exceeds the strongest code baseline by 23.5 points. The largest gains arise when choosing the correct qualitative dynamics is essential. Under the same planner, the induced models approach ground-truth engine success on navigation and grasp-rich control; a residual gap remains for contact-rich pushing, and checking a shortlist of promising plans in the engine closes most of that gap. These results establish a practical route toward automatically constructed code world models that are useful for planning. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/VisualPatchWorld/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VisualPatchWorld（VPW），把世界模型表示成可读、可编辑、可执行的代码程序：先用少量主动探针选择定性动力学形式（比如‘刚体平移’或‘铰链旋转’），再用状态-动作轨迹拟合其参数，最终生成能前向仿真、支持MPC规划、且可人工检查的Python级代码模型。
analysis.claim: 世界模型可以被自动构造成结构化、可解释、可执行的代码程序，在保持可学习性的同时恢复物理模型的可检验性与可控性。
analysis.input: 图像输入（用于生成场景图）+ 状态-动作轨迹（用于拟合代码参数）+ 主动探针指令（用于识别动力学类别）
analysis.output: 可执行的Python代码程序（描述系统定性动力学+拟合参数），支持rollout、inspection和MPC调用
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或仿真环境中的状态-动作轨迹，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端从视觉/状态数据自动生成可执行、可解释、带定性结构的世界模型代码，在导航与抓取任务上逼近真物理引擎性能；但仅在有限仿真环境（未公开细节）验证，无真实机器人实验，泛化性验证薄弱，且未与主流神经世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在统一benchmark上对比，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在代码层面打通了可学习性与可解释性，但受限于仿真验证深度和泛化评估，尚未达到开范式级别

papers.title: Faster and Better? Benchmark Bugs and Design Limitations Distort the Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Acceleration
papers.abstract: Simulated manipulation benchmarks are the standard tool for evaluating vision-language-action (VLA) policies and the acceleration methods that reduce their inference latency for on-robot deployment. On these benchmarks, we observe that some training-free acceleration methods, which approximate the baseline policy's computation, achieve higher measured success rates than the baseline itself. Success rates alone cannot establish whether such gains come from better task execution or from evaluation flaws. We therefore investigate two kinds of benchmark flaws behind these gains: bugs, where the implementation does not match the intended task or evaluation protocol, and design limitations, where success criteria and simulation settings do not fully capture how acceleration affects task execution. Starting from tasks with anomalous gains, we localize root causes by plotting object trajectories against checker acceptance regions, and classify the resulting bugs into task consistency, initialization, and reproducibility. Extending this audit to seven benchmarks, including RoboTwin, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench, we identify 22 bugs of these types and 4 design limitations. For the latter, we revise permissive success checkers, correct unrealistic object masses, and add a motion-aware score that favors smoother actions. Experiments show that bug fixes can reverse method rankings, moving the baseline from last to first on one task. Addressing design limitations can likewise remove anomalous gains: on another task, the baseline moves from 21 percentage points behind an accelerated method to 5 points ahead. Gains attributed to acceleration can therefore be artifacts of the benchmark rather than better task execution. We release our bug fixes and revised benchmark settings to support trustworthy evaluation of VLA acceleration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）加速方法在主流仿真操纵基准上的性能提升，很多其实是基准本身存在bug和设计缺陷导致的假阳性结果，作者系统审计了7个基准，定位22个具体bug和4类设计问题，并提供了修复方案和改进评估指标，让VLA加速效果的真实优劣得以显现。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: VLA加速方法在现有仿真基准上报告的性能增益，大量源于基准实现bug和评估设计缺陷，而非真实能力提升；修正这些问题会彻底反转方法排名。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+语言指令+（隐含）动作序列
analysis.output: 任务成功与否的判定结果（及修正后的运动感知得分）
