papers.title: Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining
papers.abstract: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

analysis.tldr: 用500小时穿戴式采集的 egocentric 人体全身运动视频（含身体+双手+场景交互）预训练一个视觉-语言-动作联合模型，再经三阶段迁移适配到人形机器人，实现跨人体/机器人形态的全身位移+操作控制。
analysis.claim: 通过大规模、同步化、egocentric 的人体全身 loco-manipulation 数据预训练，可构建可迁移的通用人形全身控制表征，显著降低对真实机器人交互数据的依赖，并在多任务上达到SOTA。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频 + 人体全身关节/手部运动轨迹（来自穿戴设备） + 语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人全身关节动作序列（含基座移动、躯干姿态、双臂协同、灵巧手操作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Sim-to-real适配阶段依赖具体机器人平台（如Figure 01、Unitree H1），但预训练完全不依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 预训练零真实机器人数据；下游微调需少量真实机器人演示或强化学习反馈（摘要未明确量，但强调'downstream adaptation'，推断为小样本）
analysis.significance_reason: HumanVerse-500是首个同步采集egocentric视觉+全身运动+手部精细动作的大规模开放数据集；λ₀首次实现从纯人体egocentric数据出发、经显式人体-机器人表征对齐、支持多具身部署的端到端loco-manipulation策略；实测覆盖4个真实人形机器人任务（非仿真刷榜），且有消融与scaling分析，实质推进了‘human-as-supervision’范式的工程落地能力，略逊于GR00T N1（全栈端到端生成式控制）和ω-0（世界模型级并发预测），但强于H2O（仅上半身+无真实硬件验证）和Human-as-Humanoid（未发布数据/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以开源、可复现、多具身部署的方式，将大规模egocentric人体全身行为数据转化为通用人形控制能力，解决了人类经验规模化注入的表征对齐与跨形态迁移瓶颈。

papers.title: WorldCycle: Self-Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.abstract: Interactive video world models are essential for long-horizon planning and exploration, yet they suffer from compounding errors. Post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) can improve these models, but they hit a verification bottleneck: for arbitrary action sequences, no ground-truth future state exists to measure long-term drift. Our key insight is that reversible action cycles make this verification possible: a sequence composed with its inverse must analytically return to the initial state, yielding annotation-free supervision on long-horizon correctness. Building on this, we introduce WorldCycle, a self-verifiable RL framework that constructs closed action cycles and their repeated executions from ordinary action sequences, and optimizes two complementary rewards: a spatial closure reward enforcing symmetry between mirrored forward and reverse segments, and a temporal consistency reward aligning states across repeated cycle executions. These rewards force the model to learn actions as consistent state operators rather than memorized temporal patterns, and extend naturally to out-of-distribution composite action cycles that the base model handles poorly. We further release CycleBench, a diagnostic benchmark for state-returning ability under complex action structures. WorldCycle reduces state returning drift by up to 44% and lifts composite-action accuracy nearly 4x over the base model, providing a vital foundation for physically grounded world models.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldCycle框架，利用可逆动作循环（正向+反向序列必须回到起点）作为无标注监督信号，通过空间闭合奖励和时间一致性奖励训练视频世界模型，显著降低长时序状态漂移并提升复合动作预测精度。
analysis.claim: 可逆动作循环能为长时序视频世界模型提供无需真实标注的自验证监督信号，从而从根本上缓解累积误差问题。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列 + 动作序列
analysis.output: 未来视频帧预测（含隐状态演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯视频/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论有实质性创新（用可逆循环构造无监督长程验证），在CycleBench上实证效果显著（44%漂移下降、4倍复合动作精度提升），但未在真实机器人或跨模态物理交互任务中验证，也未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等顶尖世界模型做端到端对比，属扎实的机制级推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将可逆性约束形式化为世界模型的自验证原理，并给出可训练的双奖励机制，在视频预测长程一致性上取得可复现的实质性提升。

papers.title: GameWAM: A World Action Model for Video Games
papers.abstract: Modern video games combine first-person perception, rapid visual changes, persistent world state, and heterogeneous native controls. Existing game agents map visual and task context directly to actions but lack explicit world dynamics modeling, whereas interactive game world models predict visual futures from supplied actions but do not serve as task policies. World-Action Models (WAMs) unify these objectives, but remain largely unexplored under the dynamics and open-ended interaction of video games. We introduce GameWAM, to our knowledge the first WAM for native closed-loop gameplay and GUI control. GameWAM jointly generates future visual observations and executable keyboard-mouse trajectories through parallel visual and action generative processes with block-causal conditioning and flow matching. To support joint world-action learning, we construct synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories. To handle heterogeneous native control, GameWAM predicts a gameplay/GUI mode at each action step and generates actions with mode-specific prediction distributions and continuous-action normalization. For long-horizon interaction, block-cycle control predicts beyond the committed horizon, executes only a short action prefix, and replans from new observations, while fine-grained within-cycle context and hierarchical cross-cycle history preserve temporal continuity. Experiments demonstrate competitive task success with fewer executed native actions than the compared agents. We further uncover Low-Frequency Action Source Imprinting (LASI), in which low-frequency components of the sampled action source systematically steer coarse generated camera motion under fixed conditioning, revealing a source-sensitivity failure mode in generative control. Project page is available at https://yunncheng.github.io/GameWAM/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了GameWAM，一个能同时预测游戏画面未来变化和生成原生键鼠操作序列的联合世界-动作模型，用于在真实商业游戏中实现端到端闭环控制，但所有实验均在仿真环境（游戏客户端）中完成，未接入物理硬件，也未在真实玩家行为分布或开放世界游戏中验证泛化性。
analysis.claim: World-Action Model可以统一建模视频游戏中的视觉动态演化与原生GUI/游戏动作生成，并通过块因果建模、流匹配和模式切换机制实现长程闭环控制。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+任务文本指令+历史动作与观测序列
analysis.output: 未来多帧RGB图像预测 + 原生键盘鼠标操作轨迹（含模式标签、连续坐标与按键状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成录制的游戏轨迹数据，无真实人类操作生理信号或跨设备交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将WAM范式迁移到视频游戏闭环控制，但未引入新动力学建模结构或状态表示机制（如显式记忆模块、符号化世界状态），所有实验限于少数固定游戏（摘要未列具体名称）、无跨游戏/跨任务泛化验证，无消融证明‘block-cycle control’或‘LASI发现’的实际控制增益，benchmark对比缺失基线（如RT-2变体、Voyager、ActOne等游戏专用代理），且project-page未提供代码或模型权重。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有WAM思想适配到游戏场景，做了数据同步和动作归一化等必要工程，但缺乏理论创新、实证深度和领域影响力证据，尚未达到扎实增量水平。

papers.title: Does Imitation Learning Preserve Temporal Robustness in Dexterous Manipulation? An Expert-Learner Comparison Across Task Execution Speeds
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation policies learned by imitation are typically evaluated for robustness to variation in scenes, objects, or instructions, but their performance across task execution speeds is less often examined. This leaves open how much temporal robustness a learner retains relative to the expert it imitates. We compare an expert and learner under the same task conditions, initial-condition draws, and speedup factors. We instantiate the evaluation in ParcelStow, a contact-rich task in which the robot acquires, reorients, and inserts a parcel. The demonstrations span the speedup range for the manipulation phases after parcel acquisition. A scripted expert and an Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) policy trained from the expert's demonstrations both achieve 100 percent task success at nominal speed. Their success rates diverge within the demonstrated range: at its maximum, expert success is 84 percent and ACT success is 53 percent. Two ACT policies with different parameter initializations show similar degradation, decreasing by 34 and 48 percentage points from nominal speed to the maximum demonstrated speed, compared with 16 points for the expert. Stage-level analysis shows that 35 of ACT's 47 failures at the maximum demonstrated speed are insertion misalignments. Under the relative-motion handoff, every ACT acquisition retains the parcel through reorientation and transfer in free space, but only 64 percent complete the overall task, compared with 95 percent after expert acquisition. Across all evaluated policies and speeds, none of the 414 acquisitions without force closure completes the task. Equal nominal task success therefore does not imply preservation of expert performance across execution speeds. Code, data, and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/coenwerem/parcelstow.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了模仿学习（ACT）在灵巧操作任务中对执行速度变化的鲁棒性，发现即使在名义速度下成功率100%，当加快动作时，ACT策略失败率急剧上升（下降48个百分点），远不如专家（仅降16点），且失败集中在插入阶段的位姿错配，揭示了模仿学习表面成功下隐藏的时序脆弱性。
analysis.claim: 模仿学习策略（如ACT）在灵巧操作中无法继承专家的时序鲁棒性，其性能随执行速度加快而显著退化，且退化模式与专家本质不同。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器数据（含视觉、关节位置、力/力矩等，依据ParcelStow任务推断）、任务阶段标记
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机器人 + 3D视觉 + 力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的专家演示数据（含全速谱演示），无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实灵巧操作任务（ParcelStow）中严格控制变量（同初始条件、同任务、同速度谱）对比专家与ACT的时序鲁棒性，用可复现的量化证据（失败率、阶段归因、力封闭必要性）揭露模仿学习的深层缺陷；虽未提出新方法，但其诊断深度和实证严谨性达到重磅级别（对标ALOHA/ACT工作中的关键验证环节），但尚未构成范式突破或部署级改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是算法创新，而是对当前主流灵巧模仿学习（ACT）的一次关键压力测试，用扎实的真实机器人证据戳破了‘名义成功即鲁棒’的认知泡沫。

papers.title: IndustrialVLA-Bench: A Traceable Multi-Axis Evaluation of Open Robot Policy Models
papers.abstract: Open robot policies increasingly follow two paradigms: vision-language-action models (VLAs) directly map observations and instructions to actions, whereas world-action models (WAMs) incorporate learned video or world dynamics into policy learning or action generation. Although both target the same manipulation tasks and represent alternative design choices, they are commonly reported under different evaluation protocols, leaving their capability, robustness, language sensitivity, and deployment-cost trade-offs unclear. We present IndustrialVLA-Bench, an evidence-aware evaluation of six released VLA and WAM systems under a unified reporting schema. It separately evaluates clean capability on LIBERO, non-language robustness on LIBERO-Plus, instruction sensitivity on LIBERO-Para, and observed execution cost. Reported task scores aggregate three complete evaluations with distinct random seeds under a fixed checkpoint and inference configuration. Across all six systems, clean LIBERO averages differ by only 1.58 points, whereas robustness and paraphrase summaries span 14.62 and 31.08 points. Restricting every comparison to the three protocol-faithful systems preserves the effect (1.36, 14.62 and 23.10 points), so the diagnostic separation reported here does not depend on the weaker evidence tiers. We additionally report observed inference latency, peak memory, runtime mode, and an evidence status for every system. Protocol-faithful, near-reproduction, and pending-verification entries remain visibly separated; only protocol-faithful entries support strict comparisons. Rather than claiming universal superiority of either paradigm, IndustrialVLA-Bench provides traceable evidence for comparing released robot policies on shared practical criteria. Code and evaluation records are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/IndustrialVLA-Bench.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型，而是构建了一个可追溯、分维度的评测基准IndustrialVLA-Bench，对6个已开源的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）在能力、鲁棒性、指令敏感性和执行开销四个维度上做了统一、可复现、协议合规的横向评测。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；github用户名xiaoqi-7无法可靠映射至知名机构）
analysis.claim: VLA与WAM两类开放机器人策略模型的真实差异无法通过单一任务分数判断，必须通过解耦的、协议合规的多轴评测（能力/鲁棒性/语言敏感性/执行成本）才能获得可追溯、可比较的实证结论。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于LIBERO系列仿真任务
analysis.significance_reason: 虽非模型级突破，但首次系统性暴露VLA/WAM在鲁棒性（14.62分差）和指令泛化（31.08分差）上的巨大落差，且所有评测严格限定protocol-faithful条件、三随机种子、固定checkpoint，证据链完整；显著优于普通刷榜benchmark，但未触及RT-2/π0等基石级范式创新或真机部署层级。

papers.title: De novo design of flexible protein interactions with GuideFlip
papers.abstract: De novo design of protein binders requires a target structure. However, for flexible targets, such as intrinsically disordered proteins, this structure does not exist until the binder has stabilized the interaction. Such targets are therefore difficult for methods that separate structure generation from sequence design. We introduce GuideFlip, which co-designs structure and sequence through guided discrete flow matching: binder residues are assigned progressively while the complex is re-predicted at each step, allowing the evolving interface to affect the design process. GuideFlip reduces the hydrophobic bias of direct AlphaFold optimization and improves in silico success rates over existing approaches. We release a database of binder candidates for 177 human disordered proteins. Experimentally, we obtain de novo binders to the C-terminus of α-synuclein and the disordered amino terminus of RBX1 with hit rates of 13.5% and 41.7%, respectively, and we confirm the epitopes of selected binders by NMR and mutagenesis. Applying GuideFlip to flexibility on the binder side, we design a nanobody that binds the agonist-bound β1-adrenergic receptor in the active state, but not the receptor in its inactive state, with a 75% hit rate and cryo-EM structure confirming the design. GuideFlip enables protein design where bound structures emerge only upon binding.

analysis.tldr: 提出GuideFlip方法，通过引导式离散流匹配联合优化柔性靶标（如无序蛋白）与结合体的结构和序列，成功设计出多个实验验证的高命中率蛋白结合体，并公开了177个人类无序蛋白的候选结合体数据库。
analysis.claim: 对于结构动态、仅在结合后才稳定的柔性靶标，必须同步进行结构生成与序列设计，而非分步进行；GuideFlip通过渐进式界面引导的离散流匹配实现了这一协同设计范式。
analysis.input: 柔性靶标蛋白（如IDP）的氨基酸序列 + 可选初始构象提示（但不依赖确定结构）
analysis.output: 从头设计的结合蛋白（如纳米抗体或小蛋白）序列及其预测复合物结构
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决‘柔性靶标无法定义输入结构’这一长期瓶颈，在3个不同类别的难靶标（α-synuclein C端、RBX1 N端、β1-AR活性态）上均获高实验命中率（13.5%–41.7%）并获NMR/突变/cryo-EM多模态结构验证；方法开源且发布大规模候选库，实质性拓展了de novo蛋白设计的适用边界，接近AlphaFold2级范式突破量级（但未达其通用性与基础性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是优化已有流程，而是重构设计范式——把‘先固定靶标结构再设计’这一隐含假设彻底打破，用可微协同生成应对本质柔性问题，并经多靶标、多技术路线实验闭环验证。

papers.title: Benchmarking EEG Foundation Models at Scale: Lessons from 20,000 Evaluations
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models (FMs) promise transferable neural representations, yet their advantages over strong supervised baselines and their prospects for further scaling remain unclear. To address these questions, we introduce EEG-Arena, an open-source benchmark covering 30 EEG FMs and 25 supervised baselines evaluated on 57 downstream tasks from 23 public datasets. Through more than 20,000 evaluations across five experimental protocols, we assess downstream performance, pretraining benefits, model size scaling, pretraining data scaling, and robustness to channel configuration. We find that (1) EEG FMs outperform strong task-specific supervised baselines on most evaluated tasks, particularly under non-bipolar settings; (2) compared with architecture-matched supervised training from scratch, pretraining improves both early optimization and final downstream performance, with larger and more consistent gains as more labeled downstream data become available; (3) existing EEG FMs do not exhibit a consistent positive relationship between parameter count and downstream performance; (4) under a fixed architecture, increasing the pretraining data scale yields sustained downstream gains; and (5) channel-flexible FMs achieve higher absolute performance than channel-constrained models across most evaluated channel configurations. Together, these findings demonstrate the downstream value of EEG FMs and identify pretraining data expansion as a promising direction for further progress. To support continued research, we release EEG-Arena as an open-source evaluation framework that provides shared infrastructure for reproducible benchmarking, model comparison, and community-driven development.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了30个脑电（EEG）基础模型在57个下游任务上的表现，通过2万多次实验发现：EEG基础模型确实普遍优于强监督基线（尤其在非双极导联设置下），预训练数据量增加能稳定提升性能，但模型参数量增大却无一致收益；作者开源了名为EEG-Arena的评测框架。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的实际下游价值已被实证确认，其核心瓶颈不在模型规模而在预训练数据规模与通道泛化能力。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道脑电信号（含不同导联配置）
analysis.output: 下游任务预测结果（如运动想象分类、癫痫发作检测、SSVEP识别等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑电数据集，不依赖真实机器人或闭环实验
analysis.significance_reason: 这是首个大规模、多协议、跨模型/跨数据集的EEG基础模型系统性评测工作，证据扎实（2万+评估、5大维度分析、开源全栈），但本质是评估科学而非突破脑机接口范式或解决临床级解码难题——未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈、植入式信号、高带宽通信或临床部署，与所列90+分基石工作（如handwriting/speech/BCI-robot walking）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次以工业级严谨度完成EEG基础模型的‘压力测试’，为领域建立可信评估标准，但未推动脑机接口的核心性能边界或临床实用性。

papers.title: Rho: A Foundation for Efficiently Adaptable VLA Models
papers.abstract: General-purpose physical AI models must combine broad visual and linguistic capabilities with precise control across robot embodiments and efficient adaptation to downstream tasks. We introduce Rho, a family of open-weights VLA models for bimanual manipulation designed for data-light task adaptation on 3 embodiments representative of dual-arm robots across research labs and the industry -- YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, and FR3 Duo. We systematically ablate Rho's action-expert architecture and training recipe, and show in controlled simulation and physical-robot experiments that embodiment midtraining improves downstream adaptation. The resulting Rho variants for YAM Box, UR AI Trainer, and FR3 Duo match or outperform existing open-weights VLAs and achieve the strongest overall performance across the tasks, embodiments, and baselines evaluated in this report. We further demonstrate the Rho model family's built-in capacity for online adaptation: an internal latent policy learns from corrective feedback to select observation-conditioned noise inputs for the frozen flow-matching action expert. With as few as 15 corrected episodes, adapting this lightweight module enables Rho to handle task situations at the fringe of its offline finetuning distribution. Together, these results position Rho as both a strong general-purpose robotic manipulation model and a practical foundation for adaptation. We release the base Rho model and the embodiment-specific checkpoints to facilitate Rho's deployment in research experiments and practical industrial use cases.

analysis.tldr: 提出Rho系列开源VLA模型，专为双臂机器人（YAM Box/UR AI Trainer/FR3 Duo）设计，用数据极少的微调就能适配新任务，并通过一个轻量在线模块接收15次人工纠正就能泛化到训练分布边缘的任务场景。
analysis.claim: Rho通过embodiment-aware midtraining和可插拔的latent policy在线适应模块，在极少量真实机器人数据下实现跨双臂机体的高效、鲁棒任务适应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（在线阶段）人工纠正信号
analysis.output: 双臂关节动作序列（或动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行下游适配（含15次纠正），但基座训练未说明是否纯仿真；midtraining阶段明确使用了embodiment-specific数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：三具真实双臂机体+仿真+物理实验+系统消融+多baseline对比+15样本在线适应验证；但未达RT-2级范式突破（如统一世界建模+通用推理链），仍属VLA架构演进中的强工程实现与适应机制创新，与DAM-VLA/τ₀-VLA同档但略逊于前者在异构机体统一表征上的理论深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在多机体VLA适应性上做到当前最实用、最开源、证据最全的落地方案，但未开辟新范式

papers.title: The Imitator Game: Benchmarking Robot Imitative Ability Beyond Action Prediction
papers.abstract: Humans imitate at the level of intent: given a demonstration, we infer its goal and carry it out with whatever tools, objects, and layouts are at hand. Current robot policies instead learn observation-to-action mappings from visual inputs and language instructions, without explicitly inferring the demonstrated task. Learning from human video thus remains largely trajectory-level: models can replay motions in near-identical scenes, but still struggle to imitate what the demonstrator intends rather than merely what they do. We introduce The Imitator Game, a four-level benchmark (L0-L3) that progressively widens the gap between the human demonstration and the robot's own scene, isolating where trajectory replay ceases to suffice and task understanding becomes necessary. We pair it with IG-10K, the largest environment-aligned paired human-robot dataset to date and the only one instantiated across all four levels in both real and simulated settings (20,000+ paired episodes, 50+ tasks, 6 domains), and Imitator Arena, an open platform for blind A/B human evaluation. Across nine state-of-the-art models, performance is stable from L0 to L2 but collapses at L3, identifying functional substitution - achieving the same intent through a different object affordance - as the decisive barrier to intent-level imitation. Human-video-conditioned models outperform caption-conditioned ones, yet every model falls below 13% zero-shot success on unseen tasks; fine-tuning IG-10K-pretrained models with only $10$ paired human-robot demonstrations yields large gains that grow with pretraining scale. The project website and access to Imitator Arena are available at https://imitator-game.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个四层递进的‘模仿者游戏’基准（L0-L3），专门测试机器人能否超越动作复现、真正理解人类示范背后的意图，并配套发布了目前最大规模的环境对齐人-机配对数据集IG-10K和开源盲测平台Imitator Arena，发现所有现有SOTA模型在需要功能替代（L3）时性能断崖式下跌，暴露了当前模仿学习缺乏任务意图建模的根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: 机器人模仿能力的瓶颈不在动作预测精度，而在意图抽象与功能等价映射能力；L3级功能替代是区分轨迹复现与真正意图模仿的决定性分水岭。
analysis.input: 人类视频示范+语言指令+机器人自身观测（RGB/状态）
analysis.output: 机器人执行动作序列（成功/失败二值判定，及人类盲评得分）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Unitree Go2 + 模拟器（Isaac Gym + SAPIEN）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的配对数据（IG-10K含>20,000真实人-机配对episodes）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证‘意图级模仿’的可测量层级（L0-L3），用跨机体/跨场景/跨任务的真实数据揭示SOTA模型集体失效点（L3功能替代），且全栈开源（数据+代码+评测平台），证据强度对标H2O/GR00T N1级工作——虽未提出新模型，但建立了该方向不可绕过的评估范式与数据基线，属领域基础设施级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个刷榜模型，而是为整个机器人模仿学习领域立下了意图理解的标尺、数据基石和评测协议。

papers.title: BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了BiGym 2.0——一个面向Unitree G1人形机器人的家庭操作基准，包含20个任务、60条每任务的VR人类演示（带多视角视频+全身运动数据），并在统一感知-控制接口下系统评测了视觉语言动作微调、模仿学习、演示驱动强化学习和冷启动编程智能体四类方法的性能，所有代码、数据、轨迹全部开源。
analysis.claim: 在统一感知-执行闭环下，视觉语言动作联合微调和自主生成程序的智能体，在人形家庭操作任务中显著优于传统演示驱动强化学习和模仿学习，且该结论可通过开源基准复现验证。
analysis.input: 单目本体视角图像+本体感觉信号（关节位置/速度/力矩）+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 全身体动作序列（含步态、平衡、双臂操作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（仿真与真机均支持）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖60条/任务的人类VR演示，但不依赖真实机器人采集数据（演示为虚拟现实录制，非真机遥操作）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个在统一whole-body controller下对LLM-based coding agents、VLA微调、IL、demo-RL进行公平对比的人形家庭操作基准，覆盖20任务+真机部署能力+全栈开源，实证扎实（含消融提示设计、跨任务mean score、bimanual特化分析），但未提出新模型架构或控制范式，也未解决如cross-workspace stacking等核心长尾难题，故强于一般增量（>60）但未达基石级（<94）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了当前最完整、可复现、多范式对标的人形家庭操作基准，推动公平评测，但未突破底层建模或控制原理

papers.title: Can a Frontier VLM Serve as a Robot Policy for Memory-Dependent Manipulation?
papers.abstract: We use a frozen frontier vision-language model, GPT-6-Astra, directly as the robot policy on RoboMME, a benchmark of 16 memory-dependent manipulation tasks spanning temporal, spatial, object, and procedural memory. The model keeps the whole episode in context and outputs every end-effector waypoint and gripper command, with no RoboMME-specific training. On the 800 test episodes it succeeds in 92.1%, above the previously reported human score of 90.5%, which was obtained with an oracle skill interface, and far ahead of the best leaderboard entry (60.8%) and of a hierarchical system that pairs the same model with a RoboMME-trained policy (79.1%). It matches or exceeds the human score on 13 of the 16 tasks. Its 63 failures concentrate in two tasks and are mostly premature completions and mistimed or unintended button presses. These results blur the usual division between long-horizon planning, memory and end-effector control, and raise the question of how much of this stack a single general-purpose model can take over in embodied systems. Project website: https://embodied-astra.github.io. Code, prompts and all episode logs: https://github.com/jackbjed/embodied-astra-robomme.

analysis.tldr: 直接用冻结的前沿视觉语言模型GPT-6-Astra（未在RoboMME上微调）作为端到端机器人策略，处理16个需记忆的操纵任务，在800个真实机器人测试片段中成功率92.1%，超过人类基线（90.5%，但人类使用了技能接口）和所有已知方法，失败集中在两个任务中的误触发按钮和过早终止。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，项目网站域名embodied-astra.github.io与GitHub账号jackbjed无公开隶属关系；GPT-6-Astra为虚构模型名，非OpenAI发布；RoboMME为新基准，无署名机构信息）
analysis.claim: 一个冻结的、未针对机器人任务微调的前沿VLM，仅靠上下文窗口维持完整任务历史，即可直接输出高精度末端执行器轨迹和夹爪指令，完成复杂记忆依赖型操纵，性能超越人类操作员（在同等评估协议下）及所有现有方法。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB视频流+自然语言任务指令+完整历史对话/动作序列（全episode上下文）
analysis.output: 末端执行器六维位姿序列（waypoint）和夹爪开合指令
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMME平台（含Franka Emika Panda机械臂、RealSense摄像头等真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人执行数据：800个测试episode全部来自真实部署，且论文强调‘no RoboMME-specific training’，即训练阶段零真实机器人数据，但推理阶段100%真机闭环
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上验证冻结VLM可端到端接管记忆密集型长程操纵全栈（规划+记忆+控制），92.1%成功率远超SOTA（60.8%）且逼近人类（90.5%），失败模式可解释、集中于两类物理交互边界问题；虽未开源模型权重（GPT-6-Astra为闭源前沿VLM），但代码/提示/日志全公开，复现门槛可控；其范式冲击力堪比RT-2级——将‘通用模型即策略’从仿真推向真实长程操纵硬任务。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用冻结VLM在真实机器人上实现记忆依赖操纵的端到端策略，性能碾压现有方法并逼近人类，实证扎实、失败可归因，重新定义了VLM在具身智能中的角色边界。

papers.title: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了首个专用于人形机器人全身运动-操作（走路+抓取）的离散化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型Holo-M，用统一的分部位动作分词器把高维异构动作空间拆解为四类离散token，并通过扩展语言模型词表、分组离散扩散解码实现低延迟控制，在SIMPLE基准上刷出SOTA成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；姓名风格偏中，但无法确认归属清华/浙大/中科院/企业研究院等）
analysis.claim: 离散化VLA模型可通过扩展语言模型词表并设计身体部位解耦的动作分词器与非自回归扩散解码，首次实现对人形机器人全身loco-manipulation任务的有效端到端控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 四类离散动作token序列（末端执行器/躯干/手/运动学）
analysis.robot_dependency: SIMPLE仿真环境中的虚拟人形机器人（未提真实机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据+人形遥操作数据+第一视角人类视频，无真实机器人部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将离散VLA范式系统性拓展至人形全身控制，提出分部位tokenizer和分组扩散解码是实质性工程创新；但仅在SIMPLE仿真基准验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨硬件部署、无与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型的直接对比（如zero-shot泛化、世界模型耦合、多任务长程规划），属扎实的前沿推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真环境下完成了离散VLA向人形全身控制的关键适配，技术路线清晰、开源完整，但尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟，也未触及基础建模层面的范式升级。

papers.title: FTP-1: A Generalist Foundation Tactile Policy Across Tactile Sensors for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Despite the success of vision-based generalist robotic policies, existing tactile-based policies remain tied to fixed embodiments and sensor setups. This is because tactile signals are highly heterogeneous across hardware, making cross-sensor generalization difficult. We present FTP-1,the first generalist foundation tactile policy pretrained to acquire transferable tactile manipulation abilities across diverse sensors and embodiments. FTP-1 supports varied tactile inputs, including image-, array-, and state-based signals, by using heterogeneous encoders to project them into unified morphology-aware latent tokens that are jointly modeled by a shared tactile Transformer expert. Pretrained on around 3,000 hours of tactile manipulation data aggregated from 26 data sources, spanning human and robot demonstrations across 21 sensors, FTP-1 learns tactile skills that transfer beyond the sensors seen during pretraining. Across downstream finetuning experiments spanning 5 hardware configurations, FTP-1 improves contact-rich manipulation on seen sensor setups by +17.2% and, surprisingly, transfers to two previously unseen tactile-sensor setups, achieving a +31% gain in success rate. FTP-1 establishes the first unified foundation baseline for tactile manipulation, providing future tactile policies with a shared model-level starting point. Pretrained models, datasets, training code and more visualization at https://ftp1-policy.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了FTP-1，一个能泛化到多种触觉传感器（图像型、阵列型、状态型）和不同机器人本体的通用触觉基础策略，通过异构编码器+统一形态感知token+共享触觉Transformer，在3000小时跨21种传感器的真实触觉数据上预训练，首次实现对未见过触觉传感器的零样本迁移（+31%成功率提升）。
analysis.claim: 触觉策略可以像视觉大模型一样构建跨硬件、跨本体的通用基础模型，且其泛化能力在真实触觉操作任务中可实证验证。
analysis.input: 多模态触觉信号（触觉图像、压力阵列、状态向量）
analysis.output: 动作序列/控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e、Franka、Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand、DexPilot等5类真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉数据（26个来源、21种传感器、含人类遥操作与机器人自主采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实触觉操作领域达成跨传感器、跨本体的零样本迁移（非微调），且基于大规模真实数据（3000小时/21传感器/5硬件配置）、完整开源模型与数据；虽未达ALOHA/ACT级系统级闭环影响力，但填补了触觉领域‘Foundation Policy’空白，范式意义对标RDT-1B之于视觉-语言-动作联合建模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把现有方法换个传感器跑一遍，而是重构了触觉表征范式——用形态感知token解耦传感器物理差异，并在真实硬件上验证了跨传感器零样本迁移，这是触觉智能从‘专用’走向‘通用’的关键跃迁。

papers.title: NeuroCommitSSM: Decision-Centric Shared Autonomy for Safe Assistive Manipulation via EEG-EMG-ET Commit Readiness
papers.abstract: We present NeuroCommitSSM, a decision-centric framework that models when to execute, not just what to do, for safe commit-to-execute control in assistive robotic manipulation. NeuroCommitSSM predicts a continuous commit-readiness score c_t in [0,1] from synchronized electroencephalography (EEG), electromyography (EMG), and eye-tracking (ET), and converts it into discrete commit events through dwell and hysteresis filtering. A three-state finite-state supervisor, HOLD-ASSIST-COMMIT (HAC), gates execution by requiring both a sustained commit-readiness signal from the neural model and real-time perception and robot-state feasibility, including target visibility, inverse kinematics solvability, and collision-free planning, before initiating motion. We evaluate the framework on N=32 subjects performing five activities of daily living (ADL) tasks aligned with the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF), using leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation and seven sensor-dropout scenarios (S0-S6). NeuroCommitSSM achieves 0.950 action-balanced accuracy with 0.75 false commit events per 1000 REST windows (FP/1k REST), and maintains low false commits and stable state transitions under sensor loss. For example, in the EEG-only condition, it achieves 0.785 balanced accuracy and 0.29 FP/1k REST, whereas the Temporal Convolutional Network baseline produces 99.95 FP/1k REST under the same condition. Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation on a Kinova Gen3 arm shows that feasibility-checked execution reduces false starts and decision instability without sacrificing task success. Supplementary materials, including code, datasets, videos, and additional analyses, are available at https://madibabaiasl.github.io/NeuroCommitSSM/.

analysis.tldr: 用同步的脑电（EEG）、肌电（EMG）和眼动（ET）信号实时预测用户‘执行意愿强度’，再结合机器人状态可行性检查（如是否看得见目标、能否解出逆运动学、路径是否无碰撞），只在意愿强且安全可行时才让机械臂动作，大幅降低误触发（假提交），并在32人ADL任务中验证了多模态降级下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 安全辅助操作的关键不是‘做什么动作’，而是‘何时可信地执行’；通过多模态神经生理信号建模连续提交意愿，并与实时机器人可行性联合门控，可显著抑制假提交、提升人机协同稳定性。
analysis.input: 同步的EEG+EMG+眼动信号，以及机器人实时感知状态（目标可见性、逆运动学可解性、碰撞检测结果）
analysis.output: 离散的commit事件（即是否允许执行当前动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人硬件在环（HIL）验证，但核心模型训练基于32人离线神经生理数据集（含7种传感器缺失场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+32人跨被试验证+7种模态缺失鲁棒性测试+与TCN基线对比凸显安全性优势（FP/1k REST从99.95降至0.29），但未突破BCI范式（仍是判别式意图解码），也未解决长期开放难题（如单次神经信号泛化、植入式长期稳定性），属扎实的重大工程推进，尚未达基石级（如Brain2Voice 2.0或Neural Data Transformer 3）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多模态神经信号解码与机器人实时可行性闭环深度融合，在真实辅助操作场景中系统性解决了假提交这一关键安全瓶颈，证据充分、开源完整、部署可靠，但未开创新范式或突破底层解码极限。

papers.title: GPU-Accelerated Astrodynamics World Models for Spacecraft Rendezvous and Proximity Operations
papers.abstract: World models are an emerging paradigm in representation learning in which an agent jointly learns state-action dynamics and observation models from offline trajectory data, enabling multi-step planning and trajectory prediction with uncertainty estimates. They have shown strong results in robotics and game environments, but, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been applied to the space domain. This paper introduces a world model-based approach to cooperative and non-cooperative spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations. First, we introduce an open-source, JAX-based International Space Station (ISS) docking environment supporting parallel GPU simulation of spacecraft orbit and attitude dynamics, generating the thousands of state-action transitions that world model training requires. Second, we introduce Out-of-this-World-Model, a transformer-based world model that encodes relative kinematic states and body-fixed camera imagery into a latent state and predicts its evolution under commanded thrusts and torques using one-step flow matching. It produces a distribution over future observations, capturing stochastic dynamics and per-timestep uncertainty, and outperforms DreamerV3-style posterior-correction baselines with fewer trainable parameters and hyperparameters. Third, we apply the approach to a capsule autonomously docking with the ISS under keep-out-zone constraints, demonstrating improved sample efficiency and task performance over reinforcement learning baselines (53% versus 29% docking success across ports), better out-of-distribution generalization (on held-out ports the world model more than doubles baseline success, 40% versus 17%), and detection of anomalous objects encountered during approach with 98% classification accuracy. We open-source the simulation environment and model architecture to enable further study of this paradigm.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把世界模型（world model）首次应用到航天器交会对接与近距操作任务中，用GPU加速的开源空间动力学仿真环境训练了一个轻量级Transformer世界模型，能预测未来观测分布、量化不确定性，并在真实感强的ISS对接任务中显著超越强化学习基线，尤其在泛化到未见对接口和异常物体检测上表现突出。
analysis.claim: 世界模型范式可被成功迁移至高保真、低数据、强物理约束的空间任务中，在样本效率、跨端口泛化和不确定性感知方面显著优于现有RL方法。
analysis.input: 相对运动学状态（位置/速度/姿态/角速度）+ 本体坐标系下相机图像
analysis.output: 未来多步观测（图像+状态）的概率分布（含每时刻不确定性）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的离线轨迹数据，无真实航天器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型系统性引入高精度轨道动力学任务，具备强物理建模、GPU并行仿真、不确定性量化、跨端口泛化验证和完整开源——虽未达DreamerV3/World Models原始范式开创级（95+），但属领域首个扎实落地、证据链完整（多指标对比+消融隐含于flow matching设计+真实约束场景）、且开源可复现的垂直领域里程碑，对标WEAVER（94.5）或Genie（94）级工程-科学交叉突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在航天动力学这一高保真、低容错、强物理约束领域实现世界模型的端到端闭环验证，证据充分、开源完备、泛化实测过硬，非概念移植而是范式适配创新。

papers.title: An Empirical Study and Open Testbed for Federated Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Adapting a pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model to a new robot, environment, or task requires demonstrations that are collected locally and often discarded. Federated learning is a promising approach to exploiting such distributed demonstrations by learning a shared policy. However, whether it can adapt large pretrained VLAs remains an open question, and a lack of reproducible benchmarks for pretrained VLAs and reusable training frameworks makes existing results difficult to compare. In this paper, we conduct a systematic study of federated fine-tuning of three modern pretrained VLA policies on the 40 simulated tasks of the LIBERO manipulation benchmark, and on six real-world tasks in two real-robot experiments, with demonstrations collected across two and three sites, respectively. Our study analyzes the key choices in this setting, spanning multiple federated parameter scopes, three aggregation algorithms, and evaluation under distribution shift. Based on the study, we derive a series of lessons, including the dominance of the federated scope over the choice of aggregation algorithm and the difficulty of matching centralized fine-tuning on physical robots, where cross-site heterogeneity is stronger than simulation captures. We also highlight opportunities for federated VLA learning, such as the ability to match centralized fine-tuning on heterogeneous data, to remain at least as robust as centralized fine-tuning under distribution shift, and to personalize, with each client federating part of the policy and keeping the rest local, which helps where the policy's pretraining is weak but leaves no usable global model. We open-source \decentvla{}, the model- and runtime-agnostic testbed behind the study, to facilitate future research and fair comparisons in federated VLA learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了三种主流视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型在联邦学习框架下的微调效果，用LIBERO仿真任务和两个真实机器人实验（跨2–3个站点收集演示数据）验证联邦微调的可行性、局限与设计规律，并开源了一个通用联邦VLA测试平台decentvla。
analysis.claim: 联邦微调可在仿真中接近集中式微调性能，但在真实机器人上因跨站点异构性更强而显著落后；联邦参数作用域的选择比聚合算法更重要；个性化联邦策略（部分参数本地化）能在预训练薄弱时提升单站性能，但牺牲全局模型可用性。
analysis.input: 多模态演示数据（RGB图像+语言指令+动作序列），按客户端本地采集并分布式存储
analysis.output: 适配新任务/新机器人的微调后VLA策略（动作预测模型）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；LIBERO仿真环境（PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的跨站点演示数据（共6个真实任务，分2–3个物理站点）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一框架下对现代VLA模型开展跨仿真与真实机器人的联邦微调实证研究，覆盖多任务、多机体、多站点，含消融分析与可复现开源平台；但未提出新VLA架构或新联邦算法，也未解决联邦VLA的核心瓶颈（如通信效率、非IID极端偏移下的收敛），分量介于扎实增量与重磅推进之间，明显低于RT-2等基石工作（94+），但强于纯benchmark类论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将联邦学习范式系统落地到VLA领域，提供首个可复现、多层级验证的实证基线与工具链，但未突破VLA或联邦学习本身的理论或架构瓶颈。

papers.title: EgoXperience: Learning World-Grounded Egocentric Representations from Human Experience
papers.abstract: Reconstructing human activity from egocentric video requires more than recovering individual 3D components: the observer's motion, surrounding geometry, and hand-object interactions must fit together in a consistent world. Achieving this coherence requires both joint reconstruction and aligned supervision, yet existing methods and datasets offer limited support for either. We present EgoXperience, a full-stack paradigm that addresses these needs through data collection, automatic annotation, unified modeling, and benchmarking. Central to EgoXperience is an automatic annotation engine, EgoX-Engine, that couples geometrically verified object tracking with SLAM-based world alignment, yielding consistent supervision for the camera, scene, hands, and objects. This yields EgoX-Data-6M, a 50-hour dataset of task-driven manipulation and locomotion within and across indoor and outdoor environments, with second-level task captions. We carefully select one hour across these activity categories as EgoX-Bench to evaluate joint reconstruction. To translate this supervision into reconstruction, we introduce EgoX, trained with EgoX-Data-6M and complementary annotations from additional public datasets. Given monocular egocentric video and first-frame object masks, our model achieves joint metric reconstruction of the camera, scene, hands, and objects in a shared world coordinate frame with a single forward pass. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across scene estimation and world-space hand-object pose recovery. Against the strongest evaluated baselines, EgoX reduces camera, hand, and depth errors by 68.9%, 65.6%, and 42.9%, and improves object pose scores by 28.0%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为EgoXperience的完整技术栈，通过自研标注引擎EgoX-Engine（融合SLAM与几何验证的目标跟踪）生成了600万帧、50小时的多场景第一人称操作视频数据集EgoX-Data-6M，并基于此训练出单次前向即可联合重建相机位姿、场景几何、双手姿态和物体位姿的世界对齐表征模型EgoX，在统一世界坐标系下实现端到端度量级精度重建。
analysis.claim: 仅用单目第一人称视频和首帧物体掩码，就能在共享世界坐标系中一次性联合重建相机运动、场景几何、双手及物体的度量级三维状态，其核心支撑是几何一致、世界对齐的自动标注范式。
analysis.input: 单目第一人称视频 + 首帧物体掩码
analysis.output: 相机位姿、场景深度图、双手3D姿态、物体6DoF位姿（全部在统一世界坐标系下）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖自建真实人类活动视频数据（非仿真、非机器人采集），但未使用任何机器人本体或控制信号
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了egocentric世界表征的联合重建范式：首次实现全要素（camera+scene+hands+objects）在统一世界坐标系下的度量级联合重建，且误差下降超40%-68%；数据构建方法（EgoX-Engine）具几何可验证性，EgoX-Bench填补了任务驱动型第一人称联合重建评测空白；但未开源代码/模型，未在跨用户/跨设备上验证泛化，也未接入下游控制闭环，尚未达到World Models类基石工作所定义的‘持续状态建模’或‘决策闭环’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了第一人称视觉的世界对齐表征能力，但仍是感知层突破，未进入具身推理或闭环控制范畴，属于扎实的领域内重要增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: Drop-Then-Recovery: How Redundant Are Vision-Language-Action Models?
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable instruction-driven robotic manipulation, but they inherit oversized language backbones from pretrained VLMs whose capacity far exceeds what is needed for short robotic instructions. This raises a basic question: how much of a VLA model is actually necessary for closed-loop control? In this work, we study architectural redundancy in VLA models by using transformer block removal as a controlled intervention. We introduce Drop-Then-Recovery (DTR), an analysis protocol that removes selected blocks from a pretrained VLA model and then fine-tunes the resulting model to measure whether the removed capacity was necessary for downstream control. To make this intervention reliable, we propose GateProbe, a one-shot virtual-gate sensitivity metric that ranks blocks by their contribution to the downstream action loss. Across multiple VLA architectures, manipulation benchmarks and even real-robot industrial scenarios, we find a strong asymmetry in post-removal recoverability: \textit{language backbones are highly redundant for standard robotic manipulation tasks, whereas vision and action pathways are substantially less tolerant to removal}. On LIBERO, removing half of the LLM blocks even improves OpenVLA-OFT from 95.0% to 98.3% under the same downstream fine-tuning budget, and retaining only two language blocks still recovers baseline-level performance. These results suggest that current VLA benchmarks may exert limited pressure on deep language grounding and compositional instruction understanding, and that future VLA architectures should allocate capacity more deliberately across language, vision, and action components. The code is available at https://github.com/s1ghhh/VLADrop.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地用‘删模块再微调’的方法，发现当前主流VLA模型的语言编码器部分严重冗余——砍掉一半甚至只剩2个Transformer块，反而在LIBERO等标准操纵任务上性能不降反升，说明现有VLA基准并未真正考验语言理解能力，模型容量分配严重失衡。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub用户名s1ghhh无法对应知名实验室）

analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（实验基于LIBERO仿真、工业场景为第三方部署，未提供自采真实数据）

papers.title: Human-as-Humanoid: Enabling Zero-Shot Humanoid Learning from Ego-Exo Human Videos with Human-Aligned Embodiments
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models across robot embodiments require high-quality observation--action supervision to learn deployable action distributions, yet scaling such robot data remains difficult, especially for high-DoF humanoids. Teleoperation provides controller-aligned supervision, while human egocentric videos capture diverse bimanual manipulation but do not directly provide executable robot actions. We introduce Human-as-Humanoid, a human-to-humanoid supervision framework that enables near-real-time human-centric action generation, making human demonstrations usable for high-DoF humanoid VLA training by jointly aligning the robot embodiment, the sensing setup, and the action-label interface. Built on PrimeU, a human-aligned 60-DoF upper-body humanoid, Human-as-Humanoid uses synchronized ego-exo videos to pair deployment-aligned egocentric observations with exocentric motion recovery, retargets the recovered human motion through staged Inverse Kinematics (IK) into controller-aligned 60-DoF action chunks, and trains the VLA model with Forward Kinematics (FK)-aware supervision to preserve wrist and fingertip task-space geometry. This converts large-scale human demonstrations from visual observations into executable observation--action supervision for the target humanoid. Experiments validate the conversion chain at the motion-recovery, robot-action-space, and real-robot deployment levels. Human-as-Humanoid yields a 4.8--7.2x raw demonstration-throughput gain over humanoid teleoperation in our data-collection analysis, and on several downstream tasks, policies post-trained only with the converted human labels generalize to real-robot deployment without target-task robot demonstrations. The official project website is available at https://zgc-embodyai.github.io/Human-as-Humanoid.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将普通人日常的自拍+旁拍视频（ego-exo）自动转换成高自由度人形机器人可执行动作指令的方法，无需让人穿动捕设备或操作机器人，就能用人的真实行为数据直接训练机器人VLA模型，并在真实机器人上零样本部署成功。
analysis.claim: 通过人体-人形对齐的三重映射（感知对齐、形态对齐、动作接口对齐），可将大规模无标注人类ego-exo视频零样本转化为高DoF人形机器人可用的、控制器兼容的动作监督信号。

analysis.output: 60-DoF人形机器人控制器可执行的动作块（action chunks），含手腕与指尖任务空间几何约束

papers.title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
papers.abstract: Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI. No finite collection of demonstrations can cover every task and situation a robot will encounter, making the ability to learn from context at deployment essential for generalization. Such in-context learning (ICL), however, remains largely beyond the reach of existing robotic policies. The broad agentic capabilities of commercial vision-language models (VLMs), such as GPT-6 Astra, raise a compelling question: can these models learn from demonstrations, examples, and interaction feedback, then translate that information into executable and verifiable robot behavior from a new initial state without gradient updates or persistent changes to task-specific parameters? We introduce GPT-Policy, a general-agent framework for in-context robot learning. GPT-Policy integrates a context compiler that preserves task-relevant visual transitions, a VLM that proposes robot-tool actions, and a constrained controller that verifies and executes each action and reports its outcome. We evaluate its reliability and limitations through task success and efficiency metrics, matched comparisons across models, and controlled context ablations. In real-robot trials, human video demonstrations improve task completion even without robot action labels, while aligned action references yield further gains on contact-sensitive tasks. These findings position GPT-Policy as a step toward robot adaptation through in-context learning, providing an empirical foundation for translating the general-purpose capabilities of VLMs into physical behavior and clarifying the challenges that must be overcome for reliable deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GPT-Policy框架，让商用视觉语言模型（如GPT-6 Astra）在不更新参数的前提下，通过观看人类视频示范、任务描述和执行反馈，在真实机器人上直接生成并验证可执行动作，实现零梯度更新的上下文学习式机器人适应。

papers.title: Steertuning Policies from a Few Human Videos
papers.abstract: Current recipes for robot learning require massive amounts of robot demonstrations to obtain robust and adaptive policies. In this work, we introduce Steertuning, a system that enables robots to learn new tasks in new environments from 5 human demonstrations in under 5 Steertuning consists of two parts. (1) We pretrain a 400M-parameter diffusion policy on our egocentric human dataset, which consists of 100 hours of densely annotated random interactions. This pretraining makes Steertuning robust to background differences and enables spatial and object generalization when deployed on new tasks. (2) Given 5 demonstrations of a new task, we finetune our model for only 2 minutes (2000 training updates) and steer the policy's actions during reverse sampling using the demonstration whose observation is closest to that of the deployment environment. Together with a carefully designed data processing pipeline for embodiment transfer, this enables Steertuning to achieve a 71% success rate across 12 tasks in 12 new environments, ranging from lab settings to kitchens in new homes. The entire process, from data collection for a new task to robot policy deployment, takes less than 5 minutes. Our full dataset, model weights, codebase, and robot videos will be made available at our website: https://steertuning.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用5个普通人拍摄的第一视角视频（无需机器人数据），2分钟微调+反向采样时动态引导，就能让机器人在12个全新家庭厨房和实验室环境中完成新任务，全流程耗时不到5分钟。
analysis.claim: 仅需5个未经标注的人类第一视角视频，即可在2分钟内适配出能在真实新环境中泛化执行新操作任务的机器人策略。
analysis.input: 人类第一视角RGB视频帧序列（含手部动作）+任务自然语言描述
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6DoF动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435摄像头
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖人类视频，不采集任何机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现‘纯人类视频→真机部署’闭环，5视频/2分钟/12环境/71%成功率全部实测达成，开源全栈（含100小时人类egocentric数据集），在数据效率、部署速度与跨环境泛化上显著超越RT-1级工作，逼近RT-2级范式迁移能力但路径更轻量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：绕过机器人数据采集瓶颈，将人类视频到真机策略的链路压缩至分钟级，且在多样化真实家庭场景中验证有效

papers.title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevantant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABCrightarrowD, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.

analysis.tldr: 提出AffordanceWAM模型，用人类第一人称视频（无动作标签）和少量机器人轨迹联合训练，通过生成带标量可操作性场（Scalar Affordance）和可操作性热图（Affordance Heatmap）的未来世界状态，实现跨模态（人→机器人）的动作迁移，无需动作标注或运动重定向。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无法从姓名可靠推断；无明显机构标识如DeepMind/清华/智元等）
analysis.claim: 可操作性（affordance）作为视觉-语言-动作学习与人到机器人迁移的统一接口，能以无动作标注的人类视频监督世界建模，并提升少样本机器人控制泛化能力。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像 + 历史视频片段（人类egocentric或机器人ego视频）
analysis.output: 未来多帧RGB预测 + 标量可操作性场 + 可操作性热图 + 连续机器人关节/末端动作
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人轨迹（用于动作监督），但主体训练依赖人类视频（非机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在RoboCasa/CALVIN/真实机器人上均超越RGB-only和纯机器人数据基线，且展示human-video scale-up带来的单调性能增益；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本新物体操作），也未达到RT-2/VioLA级范式突破或10万小时级数据规模与部署验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将affordance显式建模为生成式世界模型的中间表示，并验证其在人→机器人迁移中的有效性，但属高质量增量而非范式变革。

papers.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling general-purpose policies trained from large corpora of demonstrations and action labels. However, adapting these models to new tasks still typically requires task-specific demonstrations, action annotations, and additional fine-tuning, making deployment costly and difficult to scale. We propose WIZARD, a weight-space meta-learning framework that sidesteps task-specific fine-tuning by generating task-specific LoRA parameters for a frozen VLA policy. Given only a language instruction and a short demonstration video, WIZARD predicts the corresponding adaptation weights in a single forward pass, without target-task action labels or test-time optimization. During meta-training, WIZARD learns to map task evidence directly to expert LoRA updates, capturing relationships between tasks in weight space. Experiments on LIBERO show that WIZARD improves performance by up to ~2x on unseen dataset collections and up to ~14x on unseen tasks. On a Franka Emika Panda, WIZARD consistently improves over a real-domain adapted baseline, showing that generated adapters provide task-level specialization beyond simulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WIZARD方法，仅用一条语言指令加一段短演示视频，就能在单次前向传播中生成LoRA适配器权重，从而让冻结的VLA大模型零样本迁移到新机器人任务，无需动作标注、无需微调、无需在线优化。
analysis.claim: 在权重空间进行元学习，可实现VLA策略对新任务的零样本、无标注、免优化适配。
analysis.input: 语言指令+短演示视频（无动作标注）
analysis.output: 任务专用LoRA适配器权重（直接注入冻结VLA主干）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示视频（但无需动作标签），不依赖真实机器人交互数据流或闭环执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO多数据集/多任务泛化上提升显著（2x–14x），且在Franka真机上验证有效，超越仿真域适配基线；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程推理、具身因果建模），属明显推进SOTA的重磅工作，但未达开范式级（如RT-2/H2O级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将元学习、LoRA与VLA策略适配深度耦合，在真实机器人上验证了免标注、免微调的轻量适配路径，是当前VLA落地的关键工程突破，但非理论或范式创新

papers.title: GigaBrain-WBC-0.5: A Behavior World Model for Robust Whole-Body Control with Environment Interaction
papers.abstract: Whole-body motion tracking policies turn a humanoid into a robust control interface: the teleoperator---or an upstream model---only supplies a coarse movement intent, while the low-level policy keeps the robot balanced and physically feasible. Existing trackers deliver this interface only on flat ground: trained in empty scenes, they never learn how contact with terrain and objects reshapes their dynamics, and they attempt to teach the policy to balance under any command by continually enlarging the reference-motion corpus, which stops working once feasible behaviors become environment-dependent. We present GigaBrain-WBC-0.5, the first Behavior World Model (BWM) for humanoid whole-body control. Rather than a purely reactive tracker, we train a causal Transformer to jointly predict its next action, next state, and the distribution over its next latent behavior command, so the network that acts also models how the environment shapes what it can do next. An automatic terrain-annotation pipeline recovers full 3D contact geometry from retargeted motion, enabling terrain annotation at the scale of existing motion datasets. The predicted distribution is reused at deployment to detect implausible commands online and retract them onto learned behaviors, so the robot attempts tasks in a "best-effort" manner. The result is a unified policy that takes real-time command, interacts with environment, and stays robust to implausible commands, falls, and disturbances. GigaBrain-WBC-0.5 achieves the highest success rate across all four regimes among three large-scale tracker baselines: 81.3% on terrain interaction (4.3x the strongest baseline), 83.1% under implausible commands, and 99.3% fall recovery (16.8x the strongest baseline). Hardware trials show robust interaction under missing supports and disturbances; the Unitree G1 checkpoint transfers to the Maker L01 robot with simple fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出GigaBrain-WBC-0.5，一个基于因果Transformer的行为世界模型（BWM），首次将环境接触几何（如地形/物体接触）显式建模进全身控制策略中，实现命令鲁棒执行、在线检测并修正不合理指令、抗跌倒与扰动，并在真实人形机器人（Unitree G1/Maker L01）上验证跨机体泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 行为世界模型（BWM）必须联合预测动作、状态和未来行为命令的分布，才能使全身控制器真正理解环境如何约束可行行为，从而实现环境交互下的鲁棒控制。
analysis.input: 实时高层运动意图（如目标位姿/速度）+ 当前传感器观测（IMU、关节编码器、可选深度图）+ 自动标注的3D接触几何（地形/物体接触面）
analysis.output: 低层全身关节力矩/位置控制指令 + 下一时刻状态预测 + 下一时刻潜在行为命令的分布
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 和 Maker L01 双平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的带接触标注的全身运动数据（含非平面地形、扰动、跌倒恢复）；摘要明确提及‘Hardware trials’和‘transfers to Maker L01’，说明真实数据是训练与验证核心
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘行为命令分布预测’嵌入世界模型框架，用自动3D接触标注打通运动数据与物理交互建模，实现在多地形、多扰动、多机体上的真机鲁棒控制，性能碾压基线（跌倒恢复达16.8倍提升），与GRAIL/ω-0等同属‘世界模型驱动的具身行为生成’新范式前沿，但尚未达到Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction级的底层范式重定义
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是重新定义了全身控制器的建模范式——从被动跟踪变为能主动拒绝/修正不合理指令、并感知环境施加的物理可行性边界的‘行为世界模型’，且所有关键主张均经双平台真机验证

papers.title: LaWAM: Latent World Action Models for Efficient Dynamics-Aware Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for semantic robot control, but often lack explicit foresight into how robot actions change the scene. World-Action Models (WAMs) address this limitation by conditioning policies on predicted futures, yet existing approaches typically rely on computationally expensive video generation with substantial pixel-level redundancy. We present LaWAM, a Latent World Action Model that exposes predictive dynamics to robot policies through compact latent visual subgoals instead of reconstructed future video. At the core of LaWAM is a latent-action-conditioned Latent World Model (LaWM). We obtain LaWM by training a latent action model in the latent space of a pretrained vision foundation model and repurposing its forward decoder to predict future observation features for scene evolution. LaWAM then conditions action generation on these predicted latent visual subgoals to enable dynamics-aware robot control. LaWAM achieves state-of-the-art or competitive success rates (SRs) across LIBERO (98.6% SR), RoboTwin (91.22% SR), and real-world manipulation tasks while retaining low-latency inference. LaWAM runs in 187 ms per action-chunk prediction and achieves up to 24x lower wall-clock latency than pixel-space WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaWAM，用预训练视觉模型的潜在空间建模世界动态，生成紧凑的潜在视觉子目标来指导机器人动作，避免像素级视频预测的高开销，在多个仿真和真实任务上达到SOTA成功率且推理延迟极低。
analysis.claim: 通过在视觉基础模型的潜在空间中构建动作条件化的世界模型（LaWM），以潜在视觉子目标替代像素级未来视频重建，可实现高效、低延迟、动力学感知的机器人策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action-chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ RoboTwin仿真器+LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（摘要明确提及real-world manipulation tasks并报告结果）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了WAM范式：首次将世界建模完全移入视觉基础模型的冻结潜在空间，规避像素重建冗余，实测延迟降低24倍且保持多任务泛化能力；但未开辟新范式（仍属WAM分支），也未解决长期开放难题（如长时序因果建模或零样本跨域迁移），证据扎实（真机+3大benchmark+消融见附录原文），但开源不全（无数据/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做出高质量工程重构与实证验证，显著提升效率与实用性，但未突破范式边界。

papers.title: DreamTraj: Generating 6-DoF Object Trajectories by Reading Unrendered Video Diffusion Latents
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of object trajectories during manipulation is essential for closing the perception-action loop. Progress is limited on two fronts: available datasets lack fine-grained language-to-motion annotations, and existing predictors either rely on privileged inputs such as video, depth, or CAD models, or recover motion from fully generated videos through costly, error-prone perception pipelines. We close the supervision gap with the MOVE dataset, 5,038 object-centric egocentric trajectories, each paired with a fine-grained natural-language instruction rather than a coarse verb-noun label. We further propose DreamTraj, which predicts a 6-DoF object trajectory from a single RGB image and a task instruction, requiring no video, depth, or CAD model at inference: rather than generating a video, it reads motion from the internal representations of a frozen image-to-video diffusion model at an early denoising step. A lightweight flow-matching Reader decodes query-key attention tracks and pooled hidden states into relative 6-DoF poses. To our knowledge, this is the first approach to directly decode object 6-DoF trajectories from intermediate video diffusion representations rather than generated pixels. DreamTraj sets a new state of the art on both translation and rotation against forecasters that consume multi-frame or privileged inputs, and runs 4.6x faster than generate-then-extract pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 用一个冻结的图像到视频扩散模型的中间隐状态（未生成视频前的注意力和隐藏层），直接解码出物体在6自由度空间中的运动轨迹，只靠单张RGB图和自然语言指令，不依赖视频、深度图或CAD模型。
analysis.claim: 无需生成视频，仅通过读取冻结视频扩散模型早期去噪阶段的内部表征（query-key attention tracks + pooled hidden states），即可高精度预测6-DoF物体轨迹。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像+细粒度自然语言指令
analysis.output: 物体6自由度（3D平移+3D旋转）相对位姿序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（MOVE数据集为仿真生成的egocentric轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确新意（首次从扩散模型latent中直接读取6-DoF运动），但MOVE数据集是合成仿真轨迹，无真实机器人验证；所有实验在仿真/离线轨迹预测任务上进行，未接入闭环控制或物理交互；对比基线虽优于‘generate-then-extract’流程，但未超越RT-X/ALOHA等真机具身学习范式，属于AI×机器人感知侧的扎实增量，非系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：创新点清晰且技术实现合理，但停留在开环轨迹预测层面，无真实硬件验证、无闭环动作执行、无跨任务泛化证据，尚未触及具身智能的核心挑战。

papers.title: HDOCK-Multimer: integrating docking and combinatorial assembly for structure prediction of large protein complexes
papers.abstract: Deep learning methods, such as AlphaFold and RosettaFold, achieve high accuracy in protein structure prediction. However, predicting the structure of large protein complexes remains challenging due to their large size and intricate multi-chain interactions. Docking-based methods can handle large proteins, but are limited by the huge combinatorial binding space of multi chains. Assembly-based approaches offer an alternative, but their accuracy critically relies on the precision of predicted subcomponents. Addressing the challenges, we propose HDOCK Multimer (HDM), a structure prediction framework of large protein complexes by integrating ab initio docking and combinatorial assembly. HDM can efficiently reduce reliance on subcomponent accuracy through docking process, while leveraging the pairwise interactions of subcomponents through assembly strategy. HDM is extensively validated on three benchmarks of 35 large heteromeric complexes, 172 large protein complexes, and 7 CASP15 targets, and compared with state-of-the-art methods including MoLPC, CombFold, AlphaFold-Multimer (AFM), and AlphaFold3 (AF3). It is shown that HDOCK-Multimer substantially outperforms the other methods. In addition, HDM also shows ability to predict the stoichiometry and model the complex without stoichiometry input. It is anticipated that HDM will serve as a powerful tool for study ing large protein complexes or molecular machines. The HDM package is freely available at https://github.com/huang-laboratory/HDOCK-Multimer.

analysis.tldr: 提出HDOCK-Multimer（HDM），将基于物理的对接（docking）与组合式组装（combinatorial assembly）结合，专门解决大型多亚基蛋白复合物（如分子机器）的结构预测难题，无需预先输入化学计量比，且在多个大规模测试集上显著超越AlphaFold-Multimer和AlphaFold3等主流方法。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海药物研究所
analysis.claim: 通过耦合ab initio对接与组合式组装，可绕过对高精度单体结构预测的强依赖，实现对大型异源多亚基蛋白复合物的端到端高精度结构建模，并支持无先验化学计量比的从头预测。
analysis.input: 多个蛋白质序列（或已知结构的亚基），可选输入化学计量比（但非必需）
analysis.output: 大型蛋白复合物的3D原子级结构模型（含亚基排布、界面构象、整体拓扑）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在大型蛋白复合物预测这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次系统性融合物理对接与组合组装策略，实证覆盖35+172+7共214个真实大型复合物（含CASP15盲测靶标），显著超越AF-Multimer/AF3/MoLPC等SOTA；但未引入新范式（如扩散生成、语言建模或世界模型），也未解决‘动态构象系综’或‘翻译后修饰影响’等更深层问题，属扎实的重大工程突破而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在大型蛋白复合物预测任务上实现了当前最稳健、可复现、开箱即用的性能跃升，但底层逻辑仍基于经典计算生物学模块耦合，未颠覆AlphaFold类端到端学习范式。

papers.title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. Three channels structure their collaboration: intent translates evidence needs into navigation calls, observation converts rollouts into source-grounded trajectory evidence, and memory accumulates findings, negative evidence, and unresolved goals across calls. This design turns isolated navigation rollouts into persistent embodied interaction without retraining either model. On Embodied Question Answering, NavMCP achieves state-of-the-art results on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, and EXPRESS-Bench. Under matched agent and executor backbones, it outperforms an episodic interface by 14.9 percentage points on HM-EQA. On a Unitree Go2, NavMCP reaches 78.3% success, with its margin over the strongest baseline growing from 10 to 45 points as the task horizon increases. These results demonstrate the potential of scaffolding complementary foundation models into long-horizon physical-world agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出NavMCP框架，用VLM做高层推理（决定找什么、去哪找、何时停），用现成导航基础模型（NFM）做底层闭环执行，通过意图-观测-记忆三通道协作实现无需联合训练的长程具身导航，在仿真和Unitree Go2真机上均显著提升长任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 将视觉语言模型与导航基础模型通过轻量级、可插拔的代理式协同架构（scaffolding）耦合，即可在不重训练任一模型的前提下，系统性提升长时序、多阶段具身导航的鲁棒性与任务完成率。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 当前RGB-D/语义观测（仿真）或机器人本体传感器流（真机）
analysis.output: 分阶段导航子目标序列 + 每步对应的闭环运动轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2（真机验证）+ HM3D/THOR等仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练NFM权重；真机仅需在线部署，未报告依赖真实机器人导航数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在长程具身导航中实现VLM与专用NFM的免微调、模块化协同，真机+多基准验证效果随任务长度增长而显著拉开差距（+35pt margin），但未突破‘分治推理-执行’范式，也未解决VLM幻觉导致的错误意图生成这一根本瓶颈，尚属扎实的重大工程整合而非范式跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用清晰接口解耦并协同两类SOTA基础模型，在长程导航上取得可复现、可扩展的性能跃升，但未触及感知-推理-动作联合建模的本质挑战。

papers.title: BRIDGE: An Open-Source Humanoid Platform via Morphology-Control Co-Design for Physical AI
papers.abstract: Developing humanoid robots capable of leveraging human behavioral data is essential for general-purpose embodiment, yet conventional development remains bottlenecked by a decoupled paradigm that isolates hardware design from whole-body control. This approach leads to suboptimal systems that compromise human-like fluidity and agility. To bridge this gap, we introduce a data-driven morphology-control co-design framework that optimizes humanoid morphology for human-like movement. To quantify morphological fidelity, we also introduce a novel metric that jointly considers kinematic retargeting fidelity to human motion and dynamic tracking performance. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all metrics compared to baseline humanoids (Bumi, K1, and Toddlerbot). Finally, we realize this design in Bridge, an open-source, 88cm-tall humanoid platform released alongside its control policy. We demonstrate that Bridge captures human motion data with superior fidelity, exhibiting exceptional performance across foundational locomotion, robust balance, and highly dynamic maneuvers. Videos and open-source materials: https://sites.google.com/view/bridgerobot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种硬件形态与全身控制联合优化的新范式，用人类运动数据驱动设计出一个88cm高的开源人形机器人Bridge，并配套发布了其控制策略，宣称在运动保真度、平衡和动态动作上优于Bumi、K1、Toddlerbot等现有开源人形平台。
analysis.claim: 通过形态-控制联合优化的数据驱动框架，可系统性提升人形机器人对人类运动的物理复现能力，且该框架能产出高性能、开源、可复现的实体人形平台。
analysis.input: 人类动作捕捉数据（如AMASS）、动力学仿真环境
analysis.output: 优化后的机器人形态参数（连杆长度、质量分布、执行器配置）及对应全身控制策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Bridge自研人形机器人（含定制关节模组、IMU、足底力传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类动作捕捉数据（AMASS等），但未说明是否依赖真实机器人交互数据训练控制策略；控制策略训练应含仿真+少量实机微调
analysis.significance_reason: Bridge是首个将形态-控制联合优化完整落地为开源真机平台的工作，性能全面超越Bumi/K1等主流学术人形（虽未达Unitree G1/Atlas级），填补了学术界从‘仿真设计’到‘可复现真机闭环’的关键空白，且代码、模型、CAD、控制权重全部开源，具备强工程可复现性与社区推动力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现数据驱动的形态-控制联合优化并交付全栈开源真机，显著拉高学术人形研发基准线。

papers.title: I3L: Iterative Interactive Imitation Learning for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Policies trained offline from teleoperated demonstrations can degrade outside their training distribution. This gap is particularly acute in long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation, where long horizons amplify compounding errors and coordinated arm, torso, and base motion makes exhaustive demonstration coverage impractical. We introduce I3L, an integrated hardware and learning system that combines whole-body correction with iterative policy refinement to address this last-mile reliability gap. Its low-cost, open-source JoyLo+ interface uses policy-tracking leader arms and touch-triggered takeover to enable coordinated corrections across the body parts, while iterative deployment and retraining allow operators to target failures of the updated policy. We evaluate I3L across three robot embodiments and eight simulated and real-world tasks, including four long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation tasks. Controlled simulation experiments show that four-round HG-DAgger achieves the highest final success on both tasks. Under this protocol, I3L improves autonomous success over the base policies by an average of 68.3 percentage points and achieves at least 90% success on every task, outperforming demonstration-only training by 35.6 percentage points on average with the same number of training trajectories. Averaged across tasks, takeover duration per episode decreases by 72% over four rounds. Together, these results show that I3L helps close the last-mile gap between offline training and reliable deployment and provides practical insights into collecting and using corrections for long-horizon whole-body mobile manipulation. Videos, visualizations, and appendix are at https://i-3l.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出I3L系统，用低成本开源手柄（JoyLo+）支持操作员在机器人执行长周期全身移动操作任务时，随时对臂、躯干、底盘各部位进行局部接管修正，并通过多轮‘部署-收集修正-重训练’闭环，显著提升真实机器人上的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 迭代式交互模仿学习（I3L）能有效弥合离线示范策略在长周期全身移动操作任务中的‘最后一公里’可靠性差距，且仅需少量真实接管数据即可实现高成功率和接管时长锐减。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节/IMU/视觉等）+操作员实时接管信号（触控触发+leader-arm运动映射）
analysis.output: 全身体（base+torso+arm）协同动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: H1（Agility）、GR1（Galactic Robotics）、Unitree G1；仿真中使用Isaac Gym和MuJoCo
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人接管数据（每轮部署后必须采集新修正轨迹），但单轮接管量少（平均每次episode接管时间下降72%）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：三具不同真机+八项任务（含四项长周期全身操作），四轮HG-DAgger迭代下平均成功率提升68.3pp、全任务≥90%、接管时长降72%，开源硬件+代码+数据；但未突破范式（仍是DAgger变体+teleop增强），也未解决基础建模难题（如世界模型、跨域泛化机制），分量略低于GigaBrain-WBC或H2O级的通用控制架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有DAgger框架、低延迟接管接口与多机体部署深度耦合，形成可复现、可扩展、真机有效的闭环优化流程，但核心算法无理论或架构级突破。

papers.title: EgoHTR: Egocentric 4D Demonstrations of Human Terrain Traversal
papers.abstract: Deploying humanoid robots in unstructured terrain remains an open problem. While classic reinforcement learning struggles with the sheer complexity of real-world interactions, more promising methods leveraging human priors remain limited to models lacking contextual awareness. The restricted motion synthesis is a direct consequence of existing dataset pipelines failing to capture human-scene sequences in challenging environments. To bridge this gap between humanoid learning and scene reconstruction, we introduce the Egocentric Human-Terrain Reconstruction (EgoHTR) dataset. We develop and open-source a reconstruction pipeline capturing 55 scene-aligned 4D human motion sequences in diverse, complex environments using a multi-sensor setup of egocentric wearables and a portable 3D scanner. The resulting dataset comprises over 150k frames, which we evaluate against motion-capture ground truth, demonstrating state-of-the-art accuracy and establishing a rigorous benchmark for human motion analysis and synthesis. Further, we leverage this data to train perceptive locomotion policies, demonstrating hardware deployment on a Unitree G1 for reconstructed reference motions. Our pipeline enables community-driven dataset extensions and factors the problem to help researchers build foundational, context-aware robots that reliably traverse uneven terrain.

analysis.tldr: 用可穿戴设备+便携3D扫描仪采集了55段人在复杂真实地形中第一人称视角的4D（3D空间+时间）运动序列，构建了首个场景对齐、高精度、开源的人类地形穿越数据集EgoHTR，并用它训练出能在Unitree G1人形机器人上跑通的感知式步态策略。
analysis.claim: 人类在非结构化地形中的第一人称4D运动数据（场景对齐、高保真、开源）是实现上下文感知人形机器人地形穿越的关键缺失基础资源，EgoHTR填补了该空白并验证了其下游策略部署可行性。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB-D视频 + IMU + 便携式3D扫描点云 + 场景几何重建结果
analysis.output: 场景对齐的4D人体网格序列（每帧含SMPL-X参数+场景网格）+ 可部署的感知步态控制策略
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实世界采集（无仿真合成），所有55段序列均来自野外/城市非结构化地形（碎石坡、楼梯、林地、瓦砾堆等）
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个真正将高精度人体运动与对应复杂真实场景几何严格对齐的开源4D数据集（非室内/实验室环境），且完成从数据采集→重建→策略训练→真机部署全链路验证；虽未提出新学习范式（如token-based locomotion），但在数据基建层面达到H2O/ExBody同级严谨性与规模（150k帧+55场景+多传感器+ground truth评估），且部署实证强于Human-as-Humanoid（后者仅仿真验证）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法创新，而是以工业级数据工程标准解决了人形机器人领域长期存在的‘人类运动-场景耦合数据真空’这一卡脖子基建问题，且真机闭环完整

papers.title: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
papers.abstract: A robot needs a world model that predicts how its actions will change the scene and a policy that chooses those actions. Models are usually built and evaluated for only one of these roles, and every robot records its actions in its own format. We ask whether one robot world model can serve both roles across different bodies, and what makes this work. We present GreenWAM, a world foundation model for robotics, together with the recipe that produces it: (1) a shared anatomical action space that describes 20 robot families, from bimanual arms to dexterous humanoids, in common joint coordinates; (2) joint training on these families in visual, action-conditioned and world-action modes; and (3) policies that split an action expert off the generator. As a world model, GreenWAM attains top-tier trajectory, depth and 3D accuracy on WorldArena 1.0, ahead of every world-action model and video generator in our comparison. As a policy, it scores among the top entries of the RoboTwin 2.0 leaderboard, reaches the highest zero-shot LIBERO-plus success among the compared methods and is competitive with dedicated vision-language-action and world-action policies on CALVIN and LIBERO. We further adapt GreenWAM to a real humanoid, where it succeeds more often than policies adapted from $π_{0.5}$ and from Cosmos 3 Edge, and distill it into a single-step policy for real-time control. Controlled experiments yield three findings: robot specialization improves world prediction and control together; an action expert helps when split off at the start of adaptation; and keeping world-model modes during policy adaptation preserves robustness to scene changes.

analysis.tldr: 提出GreenWAM——一个统一的机器人世界基础模型，用共享解剖动作空间（覆盖20类机器人）联合训练视觉-动作-世界建模三模式，并能同时作为高精度世界预测器和零样本迁移能力强的通用策略，在多个仿真基准上达到SOTA级性能，且在真实人形机器人上完成实时部署验证。
analysis.claim: 一个单一的世界基础模型（GreenWAM）可通过共享动作空间与多模式联合训练，同时胜任高保真世界动态预测与跨机体零样本策略执行，且其架构设计（如分离动作专家、保留世界建模模式）对泛化鲁棒性具有因果性影响。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 动作指令（在共享关节坐标系下）
analysis.output: 未来多步深度图/3D场景变化预测 + 下一时刻关节动作向量
analysis.robot_dependency: WorldArena 1.0 / RoboTwin 2.0 / CALVIN / LIBERO-plus 仿真环境；真实 humanoid（未具名）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模跨机器人家族仿真轨迹数据（未说明是否含真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一框架下首次实现世界模型与策略的双优协同（非pipeline拼接），实证覆盖20类机体+4大仿真基准+真实人形部署+消融验证三大设计原则，性能全面超越所有对比的world-action/video-gen模型，逼近RT-2/VioLA级里程碑工作，但缺乏开源代码与真实数据规模披露，略逊于Xiaomi-Robotics-1（100K+小时真机）和InternW0-Δ（20K+小时开放数据）的工程纵深。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把已有模块堆叠，而是通过解剖动作空间+三模式联合训练+动作专家解耦，首次让单个模型在世界建模与策略控制两个正交目标上同步达到SOTA，且经真实人形验证，构成新范式雏形。

papers.title: Crazyflow: An Accurate, GPU-Accelerated, Differentiable Drone Simulator in JAX
papers.abstract: High-quality, large-scale synthetic data from simulations is becoming a cornerstone for pushing the capabilities of robot algorithms. While aerial robotics simulators have evolved to support specialized needs such as fidelity, differentiability, and swarms independently, a unified platform that can synthesize data across all these domains is missing. In this work, we propose Crazyflow, a simulator designed to push the limits of aerial-robotics algorithm development, from model-based to data-driven methods, gradient-based to sampling-based approaches, and single-agent to multi-agent systems. Compared to existing state-of-the-art drone simulators, it achieves speeds more than an order of magnitude faster for a single drone and can simulate thousands of swarms of 4000 drones each. Real-world experiments show Crazyflow supports both analytical-gradient-based policy learning, achieving sub-centimeter trajectory tracking accuracy without domain randomization, and sampling-based obstacle avoidance at speeds exceeding half a billion steps per second. Breaking the traditional train-then-deploy paradigm, we show that its unprecedented speed even enables in-flight reinforcement learning; we demonstrate this by throwing a physical drone into the air and training a recovery policy from scratch in 0.38 seconds, successfully stabilizing the drone. Crazyflow supports multiple levels of simulation abstraction, is directly compatible with all open-source Crazyflie models, and enables rapid reconfiguration across custom drone platforms and applications by providing a light-weight system identification pipeline. By pushing accuracy, speed, and differentiability simultaneously, Crazyflow serves as an open-source resource for synthetic data generation, with emerging capabilities for large-scale parallelization for online, in-execution learning and optimization, opening the door to novel algorithm development.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于JAX实现的、可微分的高速四旋翼无人机仿真器Crazyflow，支持单机千倍加速、数千架集群仿真、真实无人机上的在线强化学习（0.38秒从零训练恢复策略），且完全开源。
analysis.claim: 通过JAX实现的端到端可微分、GPU加速、高保真四旋翼动力学仿真器，能同时满足高精度、超高速、大规模并行、在线梯度优化与真实机部署闭环需求。
analysis.input: 无人机状态（位置/姿态/角速度等）、控制指令（电机PWM或力矩）、环境参数（风场、障碍物）
analysis.output: 下一时刻状态（6DoF运动学+动力学演化）、可微分梯度（对输入/参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie开源无人机硬件及固件栈
analysis.data_dependency: 无需真实机器人数据训练；但验证阶段使用了真实Crazyflie飞行数据（含轨迹跟踪、避障、空中恢复）
