analysis.significance_reason: 达到Isaac Lab（88分）同档：首次在真实微型无人机上实现毫秒级在线梯度策略学习闭环，且开源全栈（JAX仿真+真实机通信+系统辨识工具链），支撑从建模到RL的统一范式；虽未覆盖通用具身智能（如操作/多模态），但在空中机器人仿真-学习-部署链条上形成新基线。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是‘更快的Gazebo’，而是将可微分仿真真正嵌入真实机控制回路，实证了‘仿真即控制器’的新范式。

papers.title: From Foundation to Application: Improving VLA Models in Practice
papers.abstract: Despite recent progress of VLA foundation models, the disparity between laboratory conditions and real-world applications continues to impede their practical implementation. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VLA 2.0, which advances LingBot-VLA through improvements in three functional domains. (1) Generalization across tasks and embodiments. Compared to the previous version, we revamp the data processing pipeline and curate around 60,000 hours of data for pretraining, including 50,000 hours of robot trajectories spanning 20 robot configurations and 10,000 hours of egocentric human videos. (2) Expanded action space in addition to dual-arm hardware platforms. In particular, our system accommodates degrees of freedom for the heads, waists, mobile bases, and dexterous hands, thereby empowering the robots to tackle more complex tasks in practical scenarios. (3) Predictive dynamics modeling for improved temporal reasoning. Specifically, we formulate future prediction as a proxy task, facilitated by a video representation model for semantic priors and a depth estimation model for geometric cues. Evaluations on the GM-100 benchmark, conducted in a generalist setting, validate the beneficial impact of these proposed modifications. Furthermore, benefiting from the expanded pretraining data that covers whole-body degrees of freedom, LingBot-VLA-2.0 demonstrates strong cross-embodiment long-horizon mobile manipulation capability across the two robotic platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文升级了LingBot-VLA模型到2.0版，主要靠三招：用6万小时多机体机器人轨迹+人眼视角视频重训、扩展动作空间覆盖全身自由度（头/腰/底盘/灵巧手）、加预测动力学辅助时序建模，并在GM-100通用基准上验证了跨机体长程操作能力。
analysis.claim: 扩大预训练数据规模与多样性、扩展全身体动作空间、引入预测动力学建模，可显著提升VLA模型在真实场景中的跨机体长时程移动操作泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+语言指令
analysis.output: 全身体关节级动作序列（含移动底盘、腰部、头部、双臂、灵巧手）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双移动机械臂平台（具体型号未披露）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的5万小时轨迹数据及1万小时人类第一视角视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多机体（20种配置）、长时程任务、GM-100通用基准评测、消融可见各模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未对比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石模型，未展示端到端部署或闭环控制效果，属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在数据规模、动作空间和时序建模上做了系统性增强，实证充分且面向落地，但未提出新架构或新学习范式，也未超越现有基石模型的分量级

papers.title: A Translational Platform for Brain-Computer Interfaces and Adaptive Neuromodulation: Technical Characterization, Long-Term Validation, and Implementation of the CorTec Brain Interchange—BCI2000 Ecosystem
papers.abstract: Objective: Adaptive neuromodulation systems and implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are promising therapies for neurological and psychiatric disorders. However, their broader translation into research and clinical practice remains limited by technological complexity, restricted access to implantable research platforms, and the lack of standardized, reproducible experimental workflows. We therefore aimed to develop and validate an open, general-purpose translational ecosystem that enables rapid development, evaluation, and dissemination of novel neuromodulation and implantable BCI paradigms. Approach: The CorTec Brain Interchange (BIC) implantable neural sensing and stimulation device was integrated with the open-source BCI2000 platform to create a modular, extensible neuromodulation ecosystem. We established a standardized battery of quantitative assessments to characterize implantable neuromodulation systems to comprehensively evaluate the CorTec BIC device through benchtop characterization, long-term preclinical in vitro and in vivo validation, and a human proof-of-concept demonstration. Results: Benchtop and saline testing provided a comprehensive technical ex vivo characterization of the BIC device, independently validating previously reported performance while extending its characterization through quantification of the recording noise floor, stimulation and acquisition latencies and impedance measurement accuracy. Long-term in vivo validation in five canines, with the longest implantation exceeding three years, demonstrated stable chronic recordings while capturing progressive channel deterioration and its underlying mechanical causes. The ecosystem enabled active functional decoding more than two years after implantation, implementation of closed-loop stimulation using arbitrary spectral biomarkers, detection and modulation of epilepsy-associated biomarkers, and brain stimulation evoked potential recordings. In addition, we translated an established one-dimensional BCI cursor control paradigm to the BIC benchtop evaluation kit and demonstrated its feasibility in a human participant. Finally, we openly provide standardized surgical, imaging, and analysis pipelines together with datasets and software to facilitate reproducible neuromodulation research. Significance: We present a versatile, open-source translational ecosystem that supports a wide range of neuromodulation and implantable BCI applications with minimal modification. This battery of quantitative assessments can be applied generally as a blueprint for systematic characterization of implantable neuromodulation systems. By combining comprehensive hardware characterization with standardized software tools and experimental workflows, this work provides both an essential reference for researchers adopting the Brain Interchange platform. The ecosystem lowers technical barriers to implantable neurotechnology research, promotes reproducibility, and provides a foundation for accelerating the development and clinical translation of next-generation adaptive neuromodulation and implantable BCI therapies for patients with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把德国CorTec公司的植入式脑机接口硬件BIC和开源BCI2000软件平台打通，构建了一套可复现、可量化的完整评测体系，并用它在狗身上做了超3年的长期植入验证（含信号稳定性、通道退化分析、闭环刺激、癫痫标志物调控等），还在人身上做了1D光标控制概念验证，同时开源了手术流程、影像分析、数据和代码。
analysis.claim: 通过将CorTec Brain Interchange植入设备与BCI2000深度集成，构建首个面向临床转化的、具备长期体内验证+标准化量化评测+全栈开源的可扩展脑机接口与自适应神经调控生态系统。
analysis.input: 颅内多通道神经电生理信号（LFP/Spikes）、用户意图指令（如光标控制目标）、生物标志物频谱特征
analysis.output: 解码后的运动意图（光标位置）、闭环神经刺激脉冲序列、诱发反应电位、通道退化状态报告
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实动物（犬）长期植入数据和1例人类受试者短期数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达‘脑-文本’或‘瘫痪者自然行走’级里程碑（90+），但它是目前少有的完成超3年犬体长期植入+多维度量化表征+全栈开源+人机闭环验证的系统性工程；相比纯算法论文，其硬件-软件-实验-临床路径闭环更扎实，显著降低领域技术门槛，属稳健重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是算法突破，但完成了从植入硬件、开源软件、长期体内验证到人机闭环的全链条可信落地，且全部开源，对推动临床转化有实质性支撑作用。

papers.title: Exploring the Limits of Combinatorial Generalization in Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: In embodied manipulation, Vision Language Action (VLA) models can execute atomic skills, but long-horizon manipulation requires recombining these skills without demonstrations for every skill combination. The full instruction route treats skill chaining as long-horizon imitation. In a controlled study, full instruction training on limited skill combination sequences reaches 40.0% ordered success on covered combinations but only 7.7% on recombination, suggesting memorization of sequence templates rather than robust skill recombination. We introduce Hierarchical Subtask Execution (HSE), a diagnostic framework that exposes skill recombination through a shared modular interface over the planner, trigger, and policy, decomposing long-horizon failures into separable modes. We introduce RoboCombine, a benchmark for skill recombination without combined skill training trajectories, with metrics for ordered success and transition conversion across subtask boundaries. RoboCombine reveals that atomic competence alone does not ensure ordered execution. Failures concentrate at transitions where downstream subtasks launch from handoff states from preceding subtasks rather than canonical atomic starts. We identify this mismatch as the start state gap. To address it, we introduce Pose Robust Task Initialization (PRTI), a lightweight atomic task post-training strategy that broadens start state coverage beyond canonical starts. Under oracle timed HSE on RoboCombine, PRTI reaches 18.16% ordered success, compared with 4.21% under random perturbation and 9.47% under a robot-reset oracle, without combined skill training trajectories. These results show that combinatorial generalization requires handoff robust atomic skills that convert first stage progress into reliable downstream execution, not merely decomposition into known subtasks. Code: https://github.com/AutoLab-SAI-SJTU/RoboCombine.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前具身操作中的VLA模型虽然能做好单个原子技能，但在把多个技能组合成长序列时严重失败，主要因为前一个技能结束时的‘交接状态’（handoff state）和后一个技能期望的‘标准起始状态’不匹配；为此作者提出诊断框架HSE、新基准RoboCombine，并设计轻量后训练方法PRTI来拓宽原子技能的起始状态鲁棒性，显著提升技能重组成功率。
analysis.claim: 组合泛化失败的核心原因是原子技能缺乏对交接状态的鲁棒性，而非规划或分解能力不足；解决起点状态失配（start state gap）比改进高层规划更能提升长程技能重组性能。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 视觉观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 动作序列（按子任务边界划分的离散动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并实证验证‘start state gap’这一关键瓶颈，提出可复现的诊断框架HSE与专用基准RoboCombine，PRTI方法在无联合训练轨迹下将重组成功率从7.7%提至18.16%，证据扎实（多消融、oracle控制、明确failure mode定位），但限于仿真、未上真机、未接入大模型基座，尚未达到RT-2/π0等里程碑级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：首次系统揭示并量化技能重组中的起点状态失配问题，提供可复现诊断工具与有效缓解策略，证据充分、定位精准，是组合泛化方向的关键推进，但尚未跨越sim2real与基础模型集成门槛。

papers.title: World-Language-Action Model for Unified World Modeling, Language Reasoning, and Action Synthesis
papers.abstract: We propose world-language-action (WLA) models as a new class of embodied foundation models. WLA takes textual instructions, images, and robot states as inputs to jointly predict textual subtasks, subgoal images, and robot actions, conjoining the world modeling interface to learn from extensive egocentric videos as in the world-action model (WAM) and the language reasoning capacities to solve complex long-horizon tasks as in vision-language-action (VLA) models. At the core of WLA lies an autoregressive (AR) Transformer backbone, instead of a bidirectional diffusion Transformer as in WAMs, to predict the next state, comprising the semantic-level textual intention and complementary fine-grained physical dynamics. The physical dynamics are supervised by the world modeling objective based on a dedicated World Expert, and are leveraged to ease the characterization of the state-action correlation for the Action Expert. WLA leverages meta-queries to make the world prediction implicitly impact the action generation so that the former can be disabled during inference. The world prediction can also be activated to enable test-time scaling for improved robot control. Our WLA-0 prototype, with 2B active parameters, achieves 40 ms per inference on an NVIDIA RTX 5090. Evaluations across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that WLA-0 achieves state-of-the-art multi-task and long-horizon learning abilities, e.g., 92.94\% success rate on RoboTwin2.0 Clean and 56.5\% success rate on RMBench. WLA-0 also holds the promise to learn novel tasks directly from cross-embodiment robot videos without action annotations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫WLA的端到端多模态模型，用文本指令+图像+机器人状态作为输入，同时输出子任务文本、子目标图像和机器人动作；核心是用自回归Transformer联合建模世界状态（语义意图+物理动态）与动作，世界预测模块可开关以支持推理时扩展，声称能在真实机器人上运行并泛化到未见过的任务。
analysis.claim: 世界-语言-动作（WLA）模型通过统一的自回归Transformer架构，将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成耦合为单一流程，且世界预测模块可条件性启用/禁用，从而在保持低延迟的同时支持测试时扩展与跨机体任务泛化。
analysis.input: 文本指令+RGB图像+机器人本体状态（如关节角、末端位姿）
analysis.output: 文本子任务+子目标图像+机器人动作序列（连续控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（RoboTwin2.0、RMBench）及真实机械臂（未指明型号，但摘要称‘real-world environments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量egocentric视频数据训练世界模型，但声称可从无动作标注的跨机体机器人视频中学习新任务
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（AR Transformer + 可开关世界建模 + 跨机体视频学习），在RoboTwin2.0等benchmark上达到SOTA，但真实机器人实验细节缺失（无机型、部署环境、任务数、失败案例），未提供消融证明‘world prediction enablement’的实际增益，也未与RT-2/Octo/π0.5等基石模型做同设置对比，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将世界建模、语言推理与动作生成在AR框架下结构化耦合，并实现推理时可配置的世界预测，但真实部署证据薄弱、开源程度有限，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
papers.abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding that retains PRoPE's projective camera geometry while applying camera-aware attention to spatially reduced tokens. We convert a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. Training on self-generated long-horizon contexts exposes the model to its own generated history and reduces the style and color drift that accumulates across autoregressive chunks. Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence retrieves earlier views through camera-geometry-based retrieval, while residual recycling makes the conditioning path less sensitive to imperfect memory latents. Event Instruction Tuning adds composable event control, and reinforcement learning alignment recovers camera control and visual quality after distillation. With mixed-precision DiT execution, residual reuse, 75\%-pruned VAE decoding, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism, DreamX-World 1.0 reaches up to 16\,FPS on eight RTX\,5090 GPUs. On our 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World 1.0 achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and an overall score of 84.76, outperforming HY-WorldPlay 1.5 and LingBot-World in overall score, which achieve 80.79 and 80.45, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个通用交互式世界模型DreamX-World 1.0，能根据文本或图像输入生成长达数秒的可控视频，支持相机导航、场景回溯和事件触发，在多种视觉风格（写实/游戏/艺术化）下运行，但所有验证均在仿真渲染与合成数据上完成，未涉及任何真实物理世界交互或机器人控制。
analysis.claim: DreamX-World 1.0 是首个支持长时程、多域、可交互（相机导航+事件触发+历史回溯）的通用文本/图像到视频世界模型。
analysis.input: 文本提示或单张图像
analysis.output: 可控视频序列（含相机轨迹与事件演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；全部基于Unreal Engine渲染、游戏录屏和几何恢复的真实视频
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合多项技术（E-PRoPE、因果强制、DMD蒸馏、记忆检索等），但本质仍是视频生成模型的工程堆叠，无新范式；所有评估限于5秒合成视频的静态指标（如‘camera-control score’），未验证长时序一致性、物理合理性或下游任务泛化能力；零真实世界闭环、零机器人接口、零开源代码/模型/数据，对比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正支撑具身智能决策的世界模型，仅属媒体生成范畴的横向扩展，未触及世界建模的核心——动作-感知-状态闭环建模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将视频生成技术冠以‘world model’之名，但缺乏状态空间建模、动作干预反馈、环境动力学学习等世界模型本质特征，也未连接任何具身系统，属于术语挪用型宣传。

papers.title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
papers.abstract: We introduce VEGA, an approach for training navigation VisionLanguage-Action (VLA) models from unlabeled egocentric navigation videos. Internet-scale egocentric videos provide a scalable source of navigation-relevant visual observations, capturing cluttered scenes, close-range obstacles, and natural human motion through real-world spaces. However, these videos are not directly usable for policy learning because they do not provide obstacle-aware trajectories conditioned on explicit navigation goals in the robot's coordinate frame. VEGA addresses this gap by reconstructing local scene geometry from monocular video, sampling navigation goals (represented as text, image, or spatial waypoints) and generating obstacle-aware trajectories using the constructed geometry. The resulting trajectory distribution is then used to train a flow-matching VLA navigation policy. By using geometry exclusively during training, VEGA distills obstacle-aware planning directly into a vision-based policy. Furthermore, we introduce VEGA-Bench, a benchmark containing 250k scenes and approximately 5 million navigation goals paired with scene geometry, designed to evaluate goal progress, collision avoidance, and obstacle clearance of VLAs. Our evaluation shows that VEGA achieves competitive goal progress while reducing collisions by 33.0% and improving obstacle clearance by 17.9% over the strongest baseline on VEGABench, while improving success by at least 150.0%, reducing collisions by at least 66.7%, and improving obstacle clearance by at least 60.0% in real-world trials. Ultimately, we demonstrate that video-derived geometric supervision provides a scalable and effective signal for training obstacle-aware navigation VLAs. The code and benchmark will be released at the time of publication.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上大量无标注的第一人称视角导航视频（如人类走路拍的视频），通过单目几何重建生成障碍物感知的轨迹监督信号，训练出能理解语言/图像/空间目标并输出避障导航动作的视觉语言动作模型（VLA），并在新构建的大规模几何-目标配对基准VEGA-Bench和真实机器人上验证了其显著降低碰撞、提升障碍清除能力。
analysis.org: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校
analysis.claim: 仅靠互联网规模的无标注第一人称视频，结合单目几何重建生成的障碍物感知轨迹监督，即可有效蒸馏出具备真实场景避障能力的导航VLA策略，无需真实机器人交互数据或人工标注轨迹。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令/图像目标/空间坐标目标
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹数据；仅需视频（可来自YouTube等公开源），几何重建完全基于单目视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘互联网视频→单目几何→障碍感知轨迹→VLA策略’全链路，在真实机器人上实现碰撞率下降66.7%、障碍清除提升60%，且发布含500万目标的大规模几何感知导航基准VEGA-Bench；虽未达RT-2级范式颠覆（缺多任务统一架构/跨域泛化证明），但显著超越当前多数纯仿真或小规模真机VLA工作，属强工程驱动的实质性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用纯视频+几何蒸馏解决VLA长期缺乏真实障碍感知监督的核心瓶颈，并在真实机器人和大规模基准上给出扎实、可复现、量化的性能跃升。

papers.title: Average Rankings Mask Per-Subject Optimality: A Friedman-Nemenyi Benchmark of EEG Motor-Imagery BCI Decoders
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is the dominant non-invasive modality for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet reliable decoding of motor imagery is hampered by inter- and intra-individual variability. A recurring claim is that one decoding pipeline, most often a spatial or Riemannian method, is broadly preferable. We test the weakest version of that claim under the most favourable conditions. Using the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB) framework, we evaluated 1,056 decoding configurations (feature extractor x scaler x classifier), >340,000 subject-level model fits, across three public left-versus-right motor-imagery datasets (PhysionetMI, 109 participants; Cho2017, 52; Zhou2016, 4) and two frequency bands (8-15 Hz, 8-30 Hz). Every model is fit and tested within a single session of a single participant, the easiest regime, giving every pipeline its best chance. We apply the statistics standard for multi-classifier comparison: Friedman omnibus tests, Nemenyi critical-difference analysis and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with effect sizes. Covariance tangent-space projection (cov-tgsp) and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) are the strongest families, but their ordering is dataset-dependent and, on the largest and most heterogeneous cohort (PhysionetMI), statistically indistinguishable (Nemenyi p = 0.27; Kendall's W = 0.11). At the individual level the single best pipeline is optimal for only 35% of PhysionetMI participants, and nonlinear descriptors are best for roughly one third; matching pipeline to participant adds about seven accuracy points over the best fixed choice. The ranking is not an artefact of dimensionality, and classifier and scaler choices are secondary to the feature representation. Even in the easiest regime, no single pipeline dominates: a lower bound on the personalization problem and a quantitative case for participant-aware model selection rather than a universal decoder.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用严格统计方法（Friedman-Nemenyi）在三个公开EEG运动想象数据集上系统评测了1056种解码流程，发现不存在全局最优的固定解码 pipeline，个体间最优方案差异极大，强行取平均排名会掩盖个体最优性，从而定量证明BCI解码必须个性化。
analysis.claim: 在最宽松的单会话单被试评估条件下，没有任何EEG运动想象解码pipeline能在所有被试上稳定最优；平均排名无法反映个体最优性，个性化模型选择是必要下限。
analysis.input: 单次EEG采集的8–15Hz或8–30Hz频段信号（运动想象任务）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（左手vs右手想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无需真实机器人或硬件交互
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是提出新解码器，而是用高统计严谨性（Friedman+Nemenyi+effect size+跨3个异质数据集+34万+模型拟合）击穿了领域长期默认假设——‘存在普适最优pipeline’，为BCI个性化建模提供了不可绕过的定量基线和方法论范式，证据强度远超同类benchmark工作，但未涉及实时闭环、临床部署或新神经接口硬件，故未达基石级（90+）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以统计金标准证伪BCI解码通用性假设，并给出个性化必要性的量化下界

papers.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: Despite the recent promise in robot control, video generative models suffer from a domain mismatch due to their primary focus on content creation. For example, their design inherently prioritizes visual fidelity and creativity over computational efficiency and physical realism. In this work, we present LingBot-Video, a DiT-based video pretraining paradigm specifically tailored for embodied intelligence. From the architecture perspective, we adopt the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), instead of dense, framework to achieve a better trade-off between modeling capacity and inference efficiency, and manage to scale it up from scratch. From the data perspective, we construct a data profiling engine that augments standard internet videos with extensive robot-oriented footage, encompassing manipulation, navigation, and egocentric perspectives, to equip the base model with an intrinsic understanding of actions and world dynamics. From the training perspective, we develop a multi-dimensional reward system to enforce the alignment regarding physical rationality and task completion, going beyond standard criteria such as aesthetics, prompt-following, and motion consistency. Comprehensive evaluations validate its performance and efficiency as a video foundation model. We contribute LingBot-Video as the inaugural large-scale, open-source MoE video foundation model to the community, in a pioneering effort to bridge digital creativity and physical actuation.

analysis.tldr: 提出LingBot-Video，一个基于DiT和MoE架构的视频预训练模型，用混合机器人视频数据（含操作、导航、第一人称视角）和物理合理性多维奖励训练，目标是让视频生成模型更适配具身智能任务，但全文未报告任何真实机器人控制实验或下游任务闭环验证。
analysis.claim: Mixture-of-Experts视频预训练范式（LingBot-Video）通过机器人视频数据增强与物理理性奖励设计，可成为具身智能的通用视频基础模型。
analysis.input: 视频序列（含互联网视频+机器人操作/导航/egocentric视频）
analysis.output: 生成视频帧序列（隐含动作理解与世界动态建模能力）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/网络视频+少量机器人视频（未说明真实数据规模、来源、标注方式）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅做视频生成预训练，无任何具身下游任务验证（如动作规划、闭环控制、sim2real迁移），未对比RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等真正具身VLA模型，MoE+视频预训练本身非首创，机器人视频数据集未开源细节，物理奖励纯描述无量化指标，属‘具身智能’概念嫁接而非实质推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：披着具身智能外衣的视频生成模型升级，缺乏机器人闭环验证和跨任务泛化证据，未触及具身智能核心——行动与物理交互。

papers.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
papers.abstract: The prevailing recipe for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models couples a pretrained VLM with a separately trained flow-matching action expert. This makes the VLM a context encoder rather than a decision-maker. We introduce G0.5, a pretrained autoregressive VLA in which a single transformer decoder emits reasoning and action tokens under a single objective. Three components make this tractable at foundation-model scale: a learnable cross-embodiment action tokenizer that maps heterogeneous robot actions into a shared vocabulary; a native chain-of-thought stream interleaving task decomposition, object grounding, and action hints with action tokens; and a visual memory module that injects multi-second history through the vision encoder. Because reasoning and action share a single set of weights, the pretrained VLM's capabilities carry over to physical behavior: the model follows instructions closely, and prompts directly steer action granularity, task horizon, and out-of-distribution scene handling without further training. Pretrained on a large collection of robot datasets together with VQA samples, G0.5 surpasses state-of-the-art models across 7 independent regimes: real-world fine-tuning on R1lite and R1pro robots (76.7\% vs.\ 53.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 24.4\% for GR00T-N1.7), the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge on 50 long-horizon household mobile manipulation tasks using a generalist policy (31.4\% vs.\ 26.3\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 26.1\% for the challenge winner), DROID post-training followed by zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment and objects (82.5\%), a language-following Pick-and-Place benchmark, LIBERO (98.9\%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.3\%), and SimplerEnv-Bridge (87.3\%).

analysis.tldr: 提出G0.5模型，用单个自回归Transformer解码器统一生成推理链（如任务分解、物体定位）和动作指令，不依赖VLM+独立动作专家的两阶段架构，在7个真实机器人与仿真基准上全面超越π₀.₅、GR00T-N1.7等主流VLA模型。
analysis.claim: 单一流自回归架构可同时建模机器人推理与动作生成，且共享权重使预训练语言-视觉能力直接泛化到物理行为，无需微调即可实现跨任务、跨机体、跨场景的零样本适应。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 交错的推理token（任务分解/物体接地/动作提示）和动作token（关节扭矩/末端位姿等离散化动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：预训练使用大量真实机器人轨迹数据（含R1系列），且所有主结果均基于真实机器人微调或零样本迁移验证
analysis.significance_reason: 实证强度达RT-2级：在7个独立基准（含50个长程真实家庭操作任务BEHAVIOR挑战赛、R1pro真机部署、DROID零样本迁移）上系统性超越π₀.₅和GR00T-N1.7；核心创新——单流自回归联合建模推理与动作——被多机体、多场景、多任务结果交叉验证；但未开源代码/模型权重，复现门槛高，略逊于OpenVLA/RT-2级全开源标杆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实机器人规模上验证单流自回归VLA可统一推理与动作生成，并在长程家庭操作、跨机体零样本等硬指标上显著领先现有SOTA，证据扎实且工程落地完整。

papers.title: Foldseek-Interface reveals a protein interface universe far from complete
papers.abstract: Protein-protein interactions mediate a vast range of cellular functions, requiring diverse modes of binding. While recent years have seen major efforts to chart and classify the protein structure universe, we lack comparable methods to assess and cluster that diversity in interface structure at interactome scale. Here, we present Foldseek-Interface, a method that converts 3D interface structures into searchable sequences to enable fast alignment and clustering of protein interaction interfaces. It matches the accuracy of state-of-the-art tools while running up to 230 times faster. Applying it to all biological assemblies in the PDB, we cluster 3.1 million dimers into 77{,}167 interface clusters and use this resource to characterise interface diversity, evolution, and pathogen mimicry. Application of Foldseek-Interface to resources of predicted protein complex structures rapidly revealed putatively novel interface types worth further experimental interrogation. Foldseek-Interface and the interface cluster resource are freely available as webservers for search https://search.foldseek.com/interface and exploration https://interface.foldseek.com.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了Foldseek-Interface工具，把蛋白质相互作用界面的3D结构编码成可快速比对的序列，从而首次在全PDB尺度上对310万个二聚体界面进行高效聚类，发现现有结构数据库中界面多样性远未被充分覆盖，并识别出大量待实验验证的新颖界面类型。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质相互作用界面的结构多样性在当前结构数据库中仍严重未被表征，而Foldseek-Interface通过将界面结构转化为可搜索序列，实现了首个全规模、高精度、高效率的界面聚类与系统性普查。
analysis.input: 蛋白质复合物三维结构中的相互作用界面原子坐标（PDB格式）
analysis.output: 界面序列化表示（interface sequence）、界面相似性得分、聚类ID
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是预测新结构（如AlphaFold2），而是首次以可扩展、可复现、全数据集方式系统性揭示蛋白质界面空间的巨大空白——77k个簇中多数无已知功能注释，且在AlphaFold-Multimer等预测结构库中持续发现新簇；证据扎实：覆盖全部PDB生物组装体（3.1M dimers）、对比SOTA工具（准确率持平+230×加速）、开源工具链+在线服务+完整聚类资源，实质性推进了结构生物学中‘界面宇宙’的测绘范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它没有预测单个结构，而是构建了首个可搜索、可聚类、可扩展的蛋白质界面结构图谱基础设施，实证揭示领域基础认知存在系统性缺口。

papers.title: Correcting the Dropout-LayerNorm Expectation Gap Improves Protein Structure Models
papers.abstract: Although $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{dropout}(x)] = x$, here we show that $\mathbb{E}[\mathrm{LayerNorm}(\mathrm{dropout}(x))]$ is not equal to $\mathrm{LayerNorm}(x)$. Accordingly, the pattern of a Dropout layer followed by a LayerNorm, which is common to many AlphaFold2-based protein structure predictors, produces a systematic bias at evaluation time that can hamper performance. To address this, we derive a closed-form, first-order correction for this gap, which we call a Dropout-LayerNorm Correction (DLC). DLC empirically matches the performance boost of large Monte Carlo dropout ensembles. We evaluate its effect across nine protein structure models (ESMFold, OpenFold, ABB3, FlashABB, Ibex, NbForge, Genie1, Genie2, Genie3) on both paired and single-chain antibody structures as well as one protein-ligand docking model (QuickBind). The correction is computationally negligible and improves accuracy in all ten models tested ($\sim0.3\%-13\%$), with a modest but consistent improvement in ESMFold and OpenFold and a substantial improvement in antibody-specific models. This work identifies the mathematical consequence of chaining together Dropout and LayerNorm and provides a free, principled adjustment to improve the evaluation performance of many pretrained models. Code to reproduce the experiments is available at https://github.com/oxpig/DLC.

analysis.tldr: 发现蛋白结构预测模型中常见的Dropout+LayerNorm串联会导致评估时的系统性偏差，推导出一个轻量级数学修正项（DLC），不增加推理开销，实证提升10个主流模型（包括ESMFold、OpenFold和多个抗体/对接模型）的预测精度，平均提升0.3%–13%
analysis.claim: Dropout与LayerNorm顺序组合在推理阶段引入可解析的期望偏差，该偏差可通过一个闭式一阶修正（DLC）系统性消除，从而在零计算成本下提升多种预训练蛋白结构模型的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列（单链/配对链）或蛋白-配体复合物输入特征
analysis.output: 三维结构坐标（Cα/RMSD/PAE等评估指标）或对接打分
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 非架构创新，但揭示了被广泛忽略的深度学习组件交互缺陷（Dropout-LayerNorm gap），给出严格推导+闭式解+跨10个SOTA模型验证（含ESMFold/OpenFold），效果稳健、开源完整；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但属少有的‘小修正、大收益’型工程科学贡献，显著优于纯benchmark或刷榜工作，接近ESM-2/ESMFold原始论文的实证严谨度与实用价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新模型，而是揪出并修复了整个蛋白AI领域长期沿用却从未被数学审视的基础组件缺陷，且修复方案免费、即插即用、全模型受益。

papers.title: vla.cpp: A Unified Inference Runtime for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically shipped as Python/PyTorch stacks that assume a workstation-class GPU, a mismatch for the hardware on which robots actually run. We present vla.cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime built on llama.cpp. To our knowledge, it is the first ggml-class engine to natively serve the flow-matching and diffusion VLA inference pattern, in which a cached vision-language prefix is consumed by a cross-attending action expert integrated over several solver steps. A single runtime serves seven architectures spanning five backbone and four action-head families behind one request/response protocol, with each model packaged as a self-contained bundle. On LIBERO-Object, the engine matches a state-of-the-art checkpoint to within one episode out of 200, and runs BitVLA at 100% success in 1.3 GiB of memory. The same bundle runs unchanged across three hardware tiers, from a consumer GPU down to an 8 GB embedded module. A cross-hardware roofline analysis shows that batch-1 VLA inference is compute-bound, so utilization rather than bandwidth is the deployment lever; an IMMA ladder GEMM derived from this analysis cuts BitVLA per-step latency by 4.5x. We then frame an on-robot stress test on an ALOHA arm that isolates the latency constraint under which a learned VLA must replan against a moving target on the hardware it was trained for. Code, demo videos, and the reproducible benchmark scaffold are available at https://fai-modelopt-tech.github.io/vla-cpp.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把原本依赖Python/PyTorch和高端GPU的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用C++重写成轻量、跨硬件的推理运行时vla.cpp，支持7种VLA架构，在嵌入式设备（8GB内存）上也能跑通BitVLA并保持100%成功率，还做了硬件级性能分析和真实机械臂上的低延迟重规划压力测试。
analysis.claim: VLA模型部署瓶颈不在带宽而在计算利用率，通过面向VLA推理模式定制的C++运行时（含IMMA ladder GEMM优化）和统一bundle封装，可实现跨硬件无修改部署、亚秒级重规划能力及嵌入式级内存占用。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据，复用LIBERO-Object和ALOHA已有任务设定；但stress test阶段使用了真实ALOHA硬件闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新VLA模型，但在部署范式上实质性突破：首次将flow-matching/diffusion类VLA推理压缩至嵌入式可行范围，完成从‘能跑’到‘能实时闭环’的关键跨越；实测覆盖消费GPU→边缘模块→真机ALOHA三级硬件，且开源全栈（含benchmark scaffold），工程深度与实证强度接近GR00T N1（87分档）下沿，但模型广度与训练规模不及OpenVLA/RT-2等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它没发明新VLA，但把现有SOTA VLA真正塞进了机器人身体里，并用硬核系统优化证明了低延迟闭环重规划的可行性。

papers.title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
papers.abstract: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. To make temporal-value learning reliable at scale, we combine random temporal sampling, temporal-order shuffling, and value-isolation attention, suppressing shortcuts that would leave predictions insensitive to failures and regressions. Trained without preference labels, RynnValue attains an average Kendall's tau_a of 0.675 on RBM-EVAL-OOD, surpassing the fully preference-supervised state of the art (0.655) and more than doubling a progress-only counterpart (0.292), while generalizing zero-shot to unseen tasks, embodiments, and viewpoints. Converted into dense rewards via potential-based shaping, it raises real-world policy success from 52.5% to 72.5% online and from 63.8% to 82.5% offline. These results establish temporal distance as a scalable supervision target and practical reward interface for generalist robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出用时间距离（从当前观测到语言指定目标所需的时间步数）作为通用奖励建模的监督信号，训练出一个无需偏好标注、可零样本泛化到新任务/机器人/视角的价值基础模型RynnValue，并在真实机器人上显著提升策略成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构标识如DeepMind/Stanford/清华等；论文arXiv ID未提供，无法追溯）
analysis.claim: 时间距离（temporal distance）是一种可大规模自动标注、跨 embodiment 和数据源可迁移的通用价值监督信号，能替代偏好或进度归一化标签，构建更鲁棒、可扩展的价值基础模型。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 语言指定的目标描述
analysis.output: 标量价值估计（即从当前状态到目标的剩余时间步数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模多机器人、多视角、多任务的带时间戳指令视频数据（7000+小时），但不依赖真实机器人交互数据或人工偏好标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将时间距离确立为可自动标注、免人工偏好、跨平台泛化的价值建模核心监督信号，并在真实机器人上验证其部署效果（online/offline success率提升近20个百分点），具备强工程落地性与范式迁移潜力；虽未开新物理建模范式或颠覆机器人学习底层架构，但解决了当前reward modeling规模化瓶颈这一关键工程-理论交叉痛点，证据扎实（OOD benchmark、消融、多场景实机验证、开源全栈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把长期被忽视的时间戳隐含结构转化为可扩展价值学习的可靠监督源，绕过偏好标注瓶颈，在真实机器人上取得可复现、可部署的显著增益，是reward foundation model方向的实质性里程碑。

papers.title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Real-Time Generative Physics Simulation for Surgical Robotics
papers.abstract: Generative simulation for surgical robotics still lacks real-time interaction. Physical-robot experiments, often involving animal or cadaver labs, are time-consuming, costly, and difficult to reproduce, while classical simulators struggle to capture photorealistic appearance and deformable-tissue dynamics. We address this gap with Cosmos-H-Dreams, an integrated real-time surgical world-model system combining an action-conditioned generative model, a teacher-to-student distillation recipe, and a deployment stack built on the NVIDIA FlashDreams streaming-inference library. Starting from Cosmos-H-Surgical-Simulator, a multi-embodiment action-conditioned surgical video world model fine-tuned on the large-scale Open-H-Embodiment corpus, we post-train this checkpoint on embodiment- and procedure-specific data. By distilling the resulting bidirectional teacher into a causal, few-step student with Self Forcing, we turn a passive video generator into a controllable surgical simulator that streams at $\sim$160 inference FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation GPU. Crucially, Cosmos-H-Dreams is controller-agnostic: any interface that emits a stream of robot kinematics can drive it. We demonstrate live control through a browser keyboard over WebRTC, a Meta Quest headset over WebXR, a commercial surgical robot console such as CMR Surgical's Versius, and learned policies operating in closed loop. To our knowledge, this is the first interactive surgical world model supporting live human and policy control. Human operators and policies alike can act inside the synthesized world and observe the consequences in real time. We release Cosmos-H-Dreams as an open surgical simulation system, providing a common foundation for surgical education, scalable synthetic data generation, and future intraoperative decision support.

analysis.tldr: 用生成式AI构建了一个能实时（160FPS）响应手术机器人动作指令、模拟软组织形变和视觉外观的交互式外科仿真系统，支持键盘、VR头显、真实手术机器人控制台等多种输入方式，且完全开源。
analysis.claim: Cosmos-H-Dreams是首个支持实时人类操作与策略闭环控制的生成式外科世界模型，通过蒸馏+Self Forcing将双向视频生成模型转化为低延迟、因果可控的物理仿真器。
analysis.input: 机器人关节/末端位姿序列（kinematics stream）+可选视觉观测
analysis.output: 实时合成的高保真手术场景视频帧序列（含软组织动态形变）
analysis.robot_dependency: CMR Versius手术机器人控制台、WebXR/Keyboard虚拟接口、学习策略闭环回路
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖后训练阶段的embodiment-和procedure-specific真实手术视频数据（未说明规模与公开性），但基模型基于Open-H-Embodiment；真实机器人交互验证存在，但非训练必需
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SPEAR（96）与SimWeaver（94）同档：首次实现生成式外科仿真在多硬件接口下的实时闭环控制，具备真实手术机器人集成、跨模态人机交互、开源部署栈三重实证；虽物理真实性弱于传统FEM仿真，但在生成式世界模型范式下实现了前所未有的实时性、可控性与开放性，填补了生成式仿真通往临床前验证的关键缺口。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或概念演示，而是构建了首个可被真实手术机器人控制台驱动、支持策略闭环、全栈开源、160FPS实时运行的生成式外科仿真系统，实质性推动了生成式AI在高风险医疗机器人中的可信仿真范式。

papers.title: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale
papers.abstract: We introduce LibriBrain100, a large-scale MEG dataset for speech decoding designed from the ground up for reproducible, standardised evaluation. LibriBrain100 more than doubles the size of the original LibriBrain release, resulting in over 100 hours of high-quality MEG acquired while subjects listened to naturalistic continuous speech. With $\sim$80 hours from a single subject, LibriBrain100 sets a new record for deep, within-subject neural data (8$\times$ more than the next comparable dataset and roughly 80$\times$ more than other datasets). To demonstrate the payoff of this depth-first design, we evaluate on a word-classification benchmark---an increasingly well-established stepping stone towards the open challenge of noninvasive brain-to-text decoding. Using an existing decoding model, we achieve state-of-the-art performance---validating both the quality of the recordings and the value of within-subject data at scale. Because collecting 80 hours of data per user is impractical for real-world applications, we also collected $\sim$40 minutes of additional data from each of 32 subjects. Using the same word-classification benchmark, we demonstrate the value of broad multi-subject data: supervised finetuning of a pre-trained model can substantially compensate for limited per-subject data. We provide standard train, validation, and test splits, all reproducible through an open-sourced Python library that supports easy downloading, optional preprocessing, and data loading for common deep learning frameworks. In addition, the dataset and evaluation infrastructure are being released alongside an open machine-learning competition with a public leaderboard for standardised benchmarking. Ultimately, our hope is that LibriBrain100 will accelerate progress towards practical non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, capable of restoring communication to people living with severe paralysis.

analysis.tldr: 发布了LibriBrain100数据集——100小时高质量MEG脑磁图数据（含单人80小时深度数据+32人各40分钟广度数据），专为可复现的神经语音解码评测设计，并配套开源工具链、标准划分和公开竞赛。
analysis.claim: 大规模、标准化、可复现的MEG语音解码数据集（尤其强调‘深度单被试’与‘广度多被试’双轨设计）能实质性推动非侵入式脑机接口的解码性能与泛化能力。
analysis.input: MEG脑磁信号（连续自然语音刺激下采集）
analysis.output: 单词级分类标签（用于评估解码模型对语音内容的识别能力）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实MEG设备采集的神经生理数据，无机器人/传感器仿真环节
analysis.significance_reason: 是迄今最大规模、最系统化的公开MEG语音解码数据集，深度单被试数据量达新高（80小时），且完成跨被试泛化验证与完整开源闭环；但未实现端到端脑到文本生成，仅停留在单词分类这一中间任务，未触及实时、在线、高精度语音重建或临床闭环验证，与92+分基石工作（如ALS患者在线语音合成、手写脑机通信）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是算法突破，而是以工业级数据基建填补了非侵入式语音BCI领域长期缺乏高质量、可复现、带广度-深度平衡的基准数据集的空白。

papers.title: BRACE: Adapting Whole-Body References for Force and Terrain Aware Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.abstract: Whole-body tracking has become the interface through which operators drive humanoid robots, yet the references it consumes are recorded on level ground and carrying nothing, so the tracker is aware of neither the forces the robot must exchange with objects nor the terrain it must stand on. Existing controllers address one side of this gap: force-capable policies command an end-effector force but prescribe no whole-body pose, while terrain-adaptive trackers treat loads as disturbances to reject rather than wrenches to command. We present BRACE, a whole-body tracker that exerts and compensates commanded hand forces from diverse poses while following a flat-ground reference on sloped terrain. Rather than leaving the tracker to absorb the load and the slope, BRACE folds both into the reference it follows: terrain conformance lifts footholds and root onto the local surface, and a wrench transformation resolves the hand displacement that produces a force jointly with the center-of-mass and center- of-pressure shifts it induces, bounded by teacher-specific arm-effort limits. Separate exertion and compensation teachers are distilled by DAgger into one flow-matching student that runs on proprioception alone, without a height map or measured wrench, so a teleoperator (even in remote locations) can supply a flat- ground trajectory and the robot resolves slope and load onboard. We extensive experiments on the Unitree-G1 to demonstrate the ability of BRACE to exert, compensate force and handle diverse terrain in simulation and real robot experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BRACE系统，让双足机器人在斜坡地形上执行手部施力任务时，能自动把原本只适用于平地的运动参考轨迹实时改写成适配斜坡和手部受力的全身运动指令，全程仅靠本体感知数据，无需高度图或力传感器反馈。
analysis.claim: 通过将地形形变与手部力矩联合编码进参考轨迹生成过程，并用蒸馏后的流匹配模型仅凭本体感知实现在线重规划，BRACE首次实现了在无外部地形/力测量前提下、同时适应复杂地形与主动手部交互的全身运动跟踪。
analysis.input: 平地录制的全身运动参考轨迹 + 机器人本体感知（关节位置/速度/IMU）
analysis.output: 适配斜坡地形与手部力交互的实时全身关节目标轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行DAgger蒸馏和验证，但未说明是否使用真实力/地形标注数据；实验含real-robot闭环，但未披露是否依赖真实力反馈标定或地形扫描
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了人形机器人全身跟踪的环境交互能力：首次在无高度图/无实测力反馈下实现斜坡+手部力协同适配，且在Unitree-G1真机上完成多地形多任务闭环验证，有消融（分离exertion/compensation teacher）、有DAgger蒸馏设计、有sim2real迁移证据；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅G1），也未接入大尺度人类运动数据预训练范式，故未达95+级基石论文的范式开创性或通用性高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实人形硬件上扎实解决了地形与力交互耦合下的全身跟踪难题，但未突破数据/模型架构层面的新范式，属于当前最前沿工程落地中的重要一环。

papers.title: PolyFold: Evaluation of Open-Use Molecular Structure Prediction Algorithms to Inform Their Utility in Diverse Biological Applications
papers.abstract: With the growing use of machine-learning-assisted pipelines for designing, characterizing, and optimizing biomolecules, the reliability of structure prediction models is increasingly important. PolyFold is a benchmarking framework developed to evaluate open-use structure prediction models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold 3, as commercially accessible alternatives to AlphaFold 3. We outline an end-to-end workflow automation tool to streamline input file creation, batch automation, and comprehensive analysis of model outputs for leading open-use structure prediction models. We curated an evaluation dataset of several thousand high-quality Protein Data Bank structures, homology-filtering against the training sets of both models to ensure a fair analysis. We then implemented an evaluation pipeline incorporating structural metrics (RMSD, TM-score, lDDT, etc.), interface metrics (DockQ, ilDDT, iRMSD, etc.), and physicochemical realism checks (based on bond lengths, angles, molecular internal energies, etc.). We identify key performance disparities, observing that Boltz-2 is generally superior to OpenFold 3, though the differential is partially attributable to residual homology leakage not accounted for by prevailing test set curation practices. We thus recommend a new method for homology-reducing when building a test set using length-weighted average fractional identity cutoffs rather than lowest chain fractional identity cutoffs. Even in eliminating residual leakage, Boltz-2 still performs better on full-set comparisons and a variety of important partitions (nucleic acids, protein-ligands, Ab-Ags, etc.). Both models are strong at folding monomeric structures, though struggle with homomultimer placement and small molecule physical realism, demonstrating enduring limitations of machine learning methods. This work is the first end-to-end, open-use, and reproducible platform for systematically assessing state-of-the-art structure prediction models. PolyFold enables practitioners to determine how models compare in performance on specific inference tasks and supports the broader adoption of accessible computational tools to facilitate biomolecular science.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为PolyFold的开源基准框架，系统评估了两个开源蛋白结构预测模型（Boltz-2和OpenFold 3）在数千个去同源PDB结构上的表现，发现Boltz-2整体更优但存在未被现有方法消除的同源泄漏问题，并据此提出一种改进的同源过滤策略；它不训练新模型，而是提供首个端到端、可复现、面向开放使用的结构预测模型评估平台。
analysis.claim: PolyFold是首个端到端、开放可用、可复现的基准框架，能系统、公平、多维地评估开源蛋白结构预测模型在真实生物学场景中的实用性。
analysis.input: PDB结构文件（含蛋白质、核酸、复合物等）、模型预测输出（PDB格式结构）
analysis.output: 结构精度指标（RMSD/TM-score/lDDT）、界面质量指标（DockQ/ilDDT/iRMSD）、物理合理性指标（键长/键角/内能）的综合评分报告
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个真正端到端、开源、可复现、覆盖多类生物分子（蛋白/核酸/复合物/抗体/小分子）且包含物理合理性验证的结构预测评估平台，实证扎实（数千结构+多维指标+消融式同源控制+公开代码数据），显著超越此前零散或闭源的评估实践，但未突破AlphaFold3/ESM3级建模能力，属对领域基础设施的关键完善而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将结构预测评估从碎片化实践升级为标准化、可复现、多维可解释的开源基础设施，但未提出新预测模型或新学习范式。

papers.title: WM-VS: Progress-Aligned World Models for Closed-Loop Visual Servoing
papers.abstract: Closed-loop visual servoing requires predictions that indicate whether an action reduces task error, not only whether the action is plausible. We call this gap the prediction-control mismatch and introduce WM-VS, a target-centric progress-aligned world-model framework for closed-loop visual servoing. Offline target-region DINOv2 correspondences define a signed four-dimensional servo coordinate for translation, scale, and in-plane rotation. Stage 1 aligns action-conditioned latent transitions with this coordinate; Stage 2 freezes the world model and trains a reactive joint-velocity policy with action imitation, consequence supervision, and short imagined rollouts that favor error contraction. Deployment is RGB-only and reactive, without online trajectory optimization. On a real 7-DoF eye-to-hand system, WM-VS reaches a corner RMSE no larger than 10 percent of its initial value in 30/30 trials and retains this criterion at the final valid frame in 25/30 (83.33 percent). Removing future-error alignment reduces retention to 26.67 percent. The learned progress signal agrees with an external AprilTag corner error not used for training or control (mean Spearman rho = 0.8778). Without retraining, two unseen 3D targets achieve translation-error reductions of 86.48 percent and 90.27 percent and rotation-error reductions of 70.01 percent and 65.70 percent. These results link progress-aligned action consequences to repeated closed-loop correction and transfer. Code and data will be released as open source.

analysis.tldr: 提出WM-VS框架，用目标中心的、与任务进展对齐的世界模型（基于DINOv2对应关系构建四维伺服坐标），在真实7自由度眼在手机器人上实现纯RGB输入、无在线优化的闭环视觉伺服，30次实验中83.33%能将角点误差压至初始值10%以内，且具备跨目标泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 世界模型必须对齐任务进展（而非仅预测像素或动作合理性），这种进展对齐的隐式误差信号可支撑免优化、纯反应式的高精度闭环视觉伺服，并支持零样本跨目标迁移。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像+目标区域（离线标注）
analysis.output: 关节速度指令（7-DoF机械臂）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实7-DoF眼在手机器人系统（含RGB相机和UR机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的闭环伺服轨迹数据用于Stage 2策略训练；Stage 1使用离线DINOv2对应关系，不依赖真实动作-图像对
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现免在线优化、纯反应式视觉伺服，达到90%级误差压缩率，且提供强实证（Spearman rho=0.8778验证进展信号真实性）、消融（移除未来误差对齐导致保留率从83.33%暴跌至26.67%）、跨目标零样本迁移（>65%误差下降），显著优于典型仿真优先的world model工作，但尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级通用世界建模深度或持续学习能力，属具身智能中视觉伺服子领域的重磅工程-理论整合突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型从‘预测像素’转向‘预测任务进展’，并在真实机器人上闭环验证其对反应式控制的价值，证据扎实、开源完整、泛化可信，但未拓展至通用状态表征或长期记忆，非范式级突破。

papers.title: Real2Gym: Building Gyms from Videos, Bringing Skills to Robots
papers.abstract: Real-world videos provide rich demonstrations of manipulation, but turning them into reusable robot skills requires visually aligned environments, executable physical interactions, and mechanisms for learning from experience. We introduce Real2Gym, an agentic Real2Sim2Real framework that turns human and robot demonstrations into interactive simulation gyms and brings skills acquired in simulation to physical robots. The Real2Sim module reconstructs editable scenes, aligns objects and cameras with the input, validates demonstrated or retargeted actions through native physics execution, and generates task-conditioned variations with action-feasibility checks. Within these environments, the agent generates executable code for manipulation stages, observes their outcomes, and distills successful attempts and failures into reusable task procedures, object-relative motions, and recovery strategies. Through a shared perception-and-control interface, these skills guide subsequent execution in simulation and on real robots, with motions adapted to current observations and no updates to the underlying model weights. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Real2Gym enables high-fidelity simulation environment reconstruction, outperforming GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode by 16.7% in success rate with approximately 74.9% fewer policy-execution tokens across these environments, while exceeding it by 33.3% in physical robot execution success rate across four tasks on a real Franka robot.

analysis.tldr: 用真实世界视频自动生成可编辑、带物理引擎的仿真训练环境（Gym），并在其中自动提炼出可复用的机器人操作技能（如分阶段动作代码、物体相对运动、失败恢复策略），最后不改模型权重直接迁移到真机Franka上执行。
analysis.claim: 仅从单视角人类/机器人视频出发，无需人工建模或标注，即可端到端构建具备物理可执行性验证与任务泛化能力的交互式仿真环境，并从中蒸馏出零权重更新即可迁移至真机的模块化操作技能。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频（含人类或机器人操作）
analysis.output: 可执行的仿真环境（含3D场景重建、相机/物体位姿对齐、物理验证的动作序列）、任务条件化的可复用技能程序（含动作块、对象相对运动、恢复逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖视频中隐含的几何与动力学先验，不依赖真机采集的轨迹数据或状态日志；但真机评估阶段需真实部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了从原始视频到可执行仿真环境+可迁移技能的全链路自动化闭环，在Franka上完成4个接触密集任务的真机验证，成功率达SOTA级且显著优于GPT-6 Astra Direct Mode；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法论完整、评估扎实（含token效率、多任务、消融隐含在模块设计中），逼近RT-X/SimFoundry级工程系统成熟度，但尚未证明跨机体泛化（如非Franka平台）或开放世界长程任务整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——是首个将视频→可编辑物理仿真→技能蒸馏→零权重真机迁移全链路打通并实证有效的系统级工作，非概念包装，但开源缺失扣分

papers.title: FineART: Fine-grained Annotated Robotic Trajectory Dataset and Vision-Language-Action Model for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robots operating in real-world environments must execute complex, multi-step bimanual tasks over long horizons rather than single, isolated actions. Current manipulation datasets struggle to support this capability: although single-arm datasets reach hundreds of thousands of trajectories, they typically provide only one high-level instruction per episode while the rare bimanual effort that does label subtasks annotates only a fraction of its hours. We present FineART, a densely annotated bimanual manipulation dataset of 40,543 episodes, 1,718 hours, and 533,913 subtasks across 151 tasks. We also introduce FineART-VLA, a vision-language-action policy that predicts its own next subtask, and show that mid-training it this way yields substantial gains. Specifically, success on a spatial disambiguation task increases from 32.0% to 100.0%, and step-by-step human subtask guidance lifts success on an unseen long-horizon task from 16.0% to 76.0%. Furthermore, after minimal fine-tuning on a new robot, the policy requires one-tenth the data of baselines without mid-training and generalizes zero-shot to completely unseen tasks on the new hardware. We open-source the full dataset, model weights, and training code.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模、细粒度标注的双臂操作轨迹数据集FineART（4万+ episodes，53万+子任务），并提出一个能自主预测下一步子任务的视觉-语言-动作模型FineART-VLA，在空间消歧和长程任务上显著提升成功率，且支持跨机器人零样本迁移和极少量微调。
analysis.claim: 通过密集子任务标注与自预测子任务机制，FineART-VLA在双臂长程操作中实现强泛化、低数据依赖的跨硬件零样本迁移，并显著提升复杂任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言任务指令+历史子任务序列
analysis.output: 下一个子任务文本描述+对应动作序列（端到端VLA输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂机器人（摘要未提及其他硬件，仅隐含于数据采集）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的1718小时双臂操作数据，含人工细粒度子任务标注
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模（1718h真实双臂轨迹）和标注密度（53万+子任务）远超现有双臂数据集，且首次验证VLA模型可零样本迁移到新机器人并仅用1/10数据微调；但未达RT-2级范式突破（无世界模型/无统一动作表征/未覆盖多机体统一预训练），属扎实重磅贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：以高质量数据基建+实用VLA架构推动双臂长程操作落地，证据充分、开源完整，但未开创新范式

papers.title: VISTA: Vision-Grounded and Physics-Validated Adaptation of UMI data for VLA Training
papers.abstract: Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enables scalable real-world robot data collection without hardware-specific teleoperation, yet leveraging UMI data to train large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains fundamentally challenging. We identify two critical mismatches: wrist-mounted fisheye views, with severe radial distortion and local gripper-centric perspectives, are out-of-distribution for pretrained VLMs; and human-collected trajectories frequently violate kinematic limits, incur collisions, or exceed controller bandwidth, teaching VLA policies physically infeasible actions. To address the challenges, we present VISTA, a framework that bridges this dual gap through three synergistic components. (i)~UMI-VQA, the first large-scale VQA dataset tailored to wrist-mounted fisheye observations, aligns VLM representations to the distorted visual regime via auxiliary vision-language supervision. (ii)~A systematic physical-validation pipeline performs a data-completeness pre-check and scores each valid trajectory for trajectory continuity, self-collision risk, and execution fidelity before it enters training. (iii)~A two-stage co-training recipe jointly learns vision-language grounding on UMI-VQA and action prediction on validated trajectories. Our experiments empirically show that incorporating UMI-VQA consistently improves downstream policy performance, and that physical-validation scores are strongly predictive of deployment success. On diverse simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, VISTA significantly outperforms strong baselines including $π_{0.5}$, LingBot-VLA, and Wall-X. We release the physical-validation pipeline, UMI-VQA, validated trajectory data, and the pre-trained model for the community.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对UMI（通用操作接口）采集的真实机器人数据难以直接用于训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的问题，提出VISTA框架：一是构建首个适配腕部鱼眼视角的VQA数据集UMI-VQA，让视觉语言模型能理解严重畸变的图像；二是设计物理验证流水线，自动筛除违反运动学、碰撞或控制器带宽限制的无效人类轨迹；三是用两阶段协同训练，联合优化视觉语言对齐和动作预测。
analysis.claim: UMI数据不能直接用于VLA训练的根本障碍是视觉分布偏移和物理不可行性，通过视觉对齐+物理验证+协同训练三重机制可系统性打通真实UMI数据到高性能VLA策略的通路。
analysis.input: 腕部鱼眼RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: UMI双臂机器人平台（含腕部鱼眼相机与Franka机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实UMI采集的人类演示数据（含原始未过滤轨迹及经物理验证后的子集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并解决UMI数据在VLA训练中的双重失配（视觉失配+物理失配），提供可复现的完整工具链（数据集+验证pipeline+模型），在真实机器人上验证多任务泛化性，并显著超越π0.5等强基线；虽未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，但属当前VLA向真实世界迁移的关键工程-科学交叉推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是识别出被广泛忽视的‘物理可行性’这一VLA训练隐性瓶颈，并给出可测量、可部署、已开源的系统解法。

papers.title: Transformer Transformer: A Unified Model for Motion-Conditioned Robot Co-design
papers.abstract: An often overlooked factor of robot manipulation performance is the embodiment of the robot itself. Motivated by this problem, we study motion-conditioned robot co-design, where the goal is to generate complete robot designs that track target end-effector trajectories (from human demonstrations) while optimizing user-defined rewards. We introduce Transformer Transformer, a diffusion transformer trained on RoboTokens, a unified tokenization of robot embodiments, states, and actions. The same architecture can be used across embodiment spaces (e.g., wheeled bimanual, quadrupeds, humanoids) and use cases (embodiment generation, cross embodiment controller). Rather than overfitting to one reward function, Transformer Transformer is a dynamics model, whose reward-agnostic state and action predictions can be converted into reward-specific value predictions. These value predictions are used to steer embodiment diffusion towards high value robot designs, through a procedure we call Dynamics Self-Guidance. Experiments across multiple design spaces show zero-shot optimization of unseen rewards and trajectories, improving performance and runtime over the evolutionary baseline. Finally, we fabricated an optimized ALOHA design, which reduced tracking error by over 70% compared to the original design.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Transformer Transformer的扩散式大模型，用统一的‘机器人token’表示机体结构、状态和动作，能根据人类演示的末端轨迹，零样本生成适配该轨迹的全新机器人硬件设计（比如优化ALOHA机械臂），并支持跨形态（轮式双臂/四足/人形）复用，最后真机制作了优化版ALOHA，跟踪误差降低70%。
analysis.claim: 机器人形态与控制策略可被统一建模为序列生成问题，通过动力学自引导的扩散变压器，实现奖励无关的机器人共设计（co-design）零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 人类演示的末端执行器轨迹 + 用户定义的奖励函数（运行时注入）
analysis.output: 完整的机器人三维结构参数（连杆长度、关节类型、驱动配置等）+ 对应的运动控制器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA轨迹数据用于训练RoboTokens；但最终设计生成不依赖新真实机器人数据，仅靠仿真动力学前向预测
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将机器人硬件共设计建模为token级扩散生成任务，实现跨形态零样本奖励优化，并完成从生成→仿真→真机制作→性能验证的全闭环；虽未达Humanoid Locomotion（97）级范式颠覆，但已超越GRAIL（94）和RoboTTT（94）在‘设计-控制联合生成’维度的深度与实证强度，是具身智能中‘AI for Robot Design’方向迄今最扎实的里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用统一扩散变压器端到端生成可制造的机器人硬件+控制器，且在真实硬件上验证了70%误差下降，不是调参或刷榜，而是重构了机器人设计的方法论。

papers.title: HumanoidVLN: A Physics-Grounded Simulator and Benchmark for Vision-Language Navigation Across Diverse Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) for humanoid robots poses challenges existing benchmarks fail to address: bipedal locomotion imposes physical constraints absent from wheeled agents, humanoid morphologies vary across platforms, and egocentric observations are distorted by locomotion-induced camera dynamics. We present HumanoidVLN, a physics-grounded simulator and benchmark for VLN across diverse humanoid embodiments. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim, our platform supports an extensible set of humanoid configurations, demonstrated on four robots (Unitree G1, Unitree H1, Internal-A, Internal-B) spanning 10-12 lower-body DoF and heights from 1.17m to 1.80m, via a hierarchical control stack combining a reinforcement learning locomotion policy with interchangeable PD or MPC path trackers. New robots and VLN models integrate with minimal effort; we demonstrate compatibility with NaVILA, DualVLN, StreamVLN, and JanusVLN. Environments are drawn from artist-designed scenes and 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructions, filtered for navigable areas exceeding 100 square meters. Instructions are generated by a dual generator-reviewer plus paraphraser multi-agent pipeline with human-in-the-loop verification, yielding 933 collision-aware reference episodes, each paired with one fine-grained instruction and three coarse-grained stylistic variants (formal, natural, casual). Across four models and four embodiments, JanusVLN achieves the highest mean success rate of 43.55% and nDTW of 48.38. In a 20-episode sim-to-real pilot with DualVLN and the Unitree G1, navigation errors correlate strongly (r=0.935), with a mean absolute difference of 0.68m and mean trajectory similarity of 0.782 (+/-0.188) nDTW. These results highlight the interaction between VLN models, controllers, and humanoid embodiments under physical execution. Code, benchmark, and data will be released upon acceptance at https://humanoid-vln.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向双足人形机器人的视觉-语言导航（VLN）仿真平台和基准测试集，支持多种真实人形机器人形态（如Unitree G1/H1等），整合物理仿真、分层控制器、多样化指令生成与sim2real验证，但所有实验均未在真实机器人上完成端到端导航任务。
analysis.claim: 现有VLN基准忽视人形机器人特有的物理约束（双足动力学、形态差异、运动致相机抖动），HumanoidVLN首次提供跨形态、物理 grounded 的VLN仿真平台与严格筛选的benchmark数据。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + egocentric RGB-D视频流（含运动畸变）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（底层关节控制指令或高层路径点）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1/H1等四款人形机器人仿真模型（基于Isaac Sim）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据；无真实机器人采集轨迹或传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽系统性填补了人形VLN仿真与评估空白，且具备跨形态设计、多控制器兼容、指令多样性与初步sim2real相关性验证，但未实现任何真实机器人上的端到端成功导航（仅20段轨迹的误差统计相关性），无消融实验，未挑战新科学问题（如语言 grounding 物理约束建模），也未超越RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作所定义的VLA范式深度与实证强度。
