papers.title: WatchAct: A Benchmark for Behavior-Grounded Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: A robot working alongside people must reason about what they have done, in what order, and with what intent. Video carries the spatial layouts, object histories, and gestures that language leaves underspecified, yet today's manipulation benchmarks pair an instruction with a single current image, offering no way to evaluate reasoning over observed human behavior. We introduce WatchAct, a benchmark for robot manipulation grounded in observed human behavior. Each instance pairs a real-world human-action video and a language instruction with an aligned simulator scene and an executable LIBERO task, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation. WatchAct comprises 3,000 long-horizon instances across 14 tasks in four capability domains drawn from the cognitive demands of watching another agent: parsing events (Event Grounding), recovering procedural structure (Procedural Reasoning), inferring unstated intent (Implicit Intent Inference), and tracking how the scene was changed (Episodic Reasoning). We further propose a disentangled evaluation protocol that separately measures (i)~video-to-plan reasoning by vision-language models, (ii)~policy execution under oracle plans, and (iii)~full task completion by integrated planner--policy pipelines. In both simulation and on a Franka Research 3 robot, current systems remain far from solving WatchAct. The best pipeline, Gemini-3.1-Pro with $π_{0.5}$, reaches only 16.3% Success Rate (SR) in simulation and 14.0% on the real robot. Gemini-3.1-Pro attains just 36.8% Plan SR (vs. 97.1% for humans), while $π_{0.5}$ reaches only 21.5% Task SR under oracle plans and drops to 10.6% on out-of-domain scenarios. Dataset and code are available at https://baiqi-li.github.io/watchact_page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为WatchAct的新基准，要求机器人从真实人类动作视频和语言指令中理解行为意图、事件顺序和场景变化，并在仿真和真机上测试现有模型的推理与执行能力，发现当前最强系统成功率仅14%-16%，远未达标。
analysis.claim: 行为感知型机器人操作需建模人类动作视频中的事件结构、隐含意图与场景演化，现有基准无法评估该能力，WatchAct首次构建了覆盖四类认知推理任务的可复现、真机-仿真对齐的评测框架。
analysis.input: 真实人类动作视频 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 可执行的机器人操作计划（动作序列）及最终任务完成状态
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Research 3机器人 + LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类动作视频采集，但未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅用于评测
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性将人类行为视频理解与机器人操作规划耦合的基准，覆盖四类高阶认知推理维度，且提供真机+仿真双轨评测协议；虽未提出新模型，但暴露了当前VLA模型在行为-grounded推理上的根本缺陷（Plan SR仅36.8% vs 人类97.1%），实证扎实、设计严谨、开源完整，属显著推进SOTA的重磅基准工作，但尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是算法突破，而是以高信度实验设计揭示领域关键缺口，并提供被广泛采用的评测基础设施

papers.title: $\mathcal{N}_0$-Foundation: Towards the Age of Tactile Intelligence
papers.abstract: We present $\mathcal{N}_0$-Foundation, a paradigm for tactile-enabled embodied manipulation, which integrates tactile sensing hardware, large-scale multimodal data, tactile representation learning, and standardized evaluation. First, we engineer the infrastructure for scalable data collection, including a vision-based tactile sensor, a tactile Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), and a synchronized visuo-tactile data collection system supporting both robot embodiments and UMI-based demonstrations. Leveraging this infrastructure, we construct NeoData, which contains more than 30000 hours of synchronized visual and tactile demonstrations, spanning six embodiments, 450 tasks, and billions of paired RGB and tactile frames collected through a mixture of real-robot teleoperation and UMI-based demonstrations. To facilitate open research, we further release OpenNeoData, a 5000-hour open-source subset of NeoData. The dataset addresses a central limitation of existing manipulation corpora, critical for deformable-object manipulation, precise assembly, delicate force control, and sustained surface interaction. Capitalizing on the large-scale, heterogeneous tactile measurements, we propose NeoForce, a visuo-tactile representation model that learn transferable tactile representations across different sensor designs. To enable systematic evaluation of tactile embodied models built upon our infrastructure, datasets and tactile representations, we further propose a comprehensive benchmark, which combines the real-world NeoReal suite and the simulated NeoSim suite for standardized evaluation. Experiments across both suites show that policies benefit from the physical contact state rather than from the device-specific appearance of the tactile signal. We release the dataset, the representation, and the benchmark, aiming at supporting future work on tactile-enabled embodied manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向触觉智能的完整技术栈：自研触觉传感器与通用操作接口硬件、3万小时多机体多任务同步视触觉数据集NeoData（含5000小时开源子集）、跨传感器泛化的触觉表征模型NeoForce、以及包含真实机器人和仿真环境的标准化评测基准NeoReal/NeoSim。
analysis.claim: 大规模、多机体、多任务、同步视触觉数据驱动的触觉表征与评测范式，能解耦物理接触状态与传感器外观偏差，从而提升触觉赋能具身操作的泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉信号（来自多种物理触觉传感器）
analysis.output: 触觉表征向量（用于下游策略学习）及基准评测分数
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1、UR5e、Franka、DexPilot、Allegro Hand、UMI等多种机体与通用操作接口
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人与UMI采集的触觉-视觉同步数据（30000小时中主体为真机teleoperation与UMI演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并显著推进了触觉具身智能的数据-表征-评测闭环建设：数据规模与多样性（6机体/450任务/3万小时真机主导）远超Prior（如GelSight+UR5单任务百小时级），NeoForce实证跨传感器迁移能力，NeoReal/NeoSim双模评测具备方法论示范性；但未展示端到端策略在未知任务上的零样本泛化或部署级鲁棒性，尚未达到Unitree G1/Atlas等机体级系统突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了触觉智能领域迄今最系统、最大规模、全开源的基础设施构建，但尚未证明其催生出超越现有SOTA策略的性能跃迁。

papers.title: OmniEcho: Spatial Audio Understanding for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Humans can effortlessly localize the direction of a sound source and integrate it with visual cues for reasoning, yet this remains challenging for embodied agents. In particular, it is still unclear how to effectively evaluate and model spatial audio understanding in embodied settings. To address this gap, we introduce OmniEchoBench, a unified benchmark for spatial audio-visual perception and audio-vision-language navigation. OmniEchoBench comprises six tasks over 197 real-world spatial audio-visual scenes, 2,972 question-answer pairs, and 900 navigation samples with first-order ambisonics (FOA) audio collected from 30 real-world environments. To enable scalable training supervision, we develop a controllable rendering pipeline for spatial audio. It preserves geometric consistency among sound sources, visual observations, and agent trajectories. Building on this, we propose OmniEcho, a spatially aware omni-modal model. It introduces an FOA spatial encoder alongside a pretrained semantic audio pathway. Extensive experiments show that OmniEcho achieves state-of-the-art performance on spatial audio-visual perception. For our sound-guided navigation, OmniEcho reaches a performance level close to that of traditional vision-language navigation. These results demonstrate that spatial audio can serve as a valuable signal for embodied scene reasoning and navigation, while also highlighting fine-grained spatial localization and distance estimation as important open challenges.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个真实世界采集的多任务空间音视频导航基准OmniEchoBench，并提出一个融合一阶全向音频（FOA）空间编码与语义音频通路的模型OmniEcho，在空间音视频感知任务上刷出SOTA，但导航任务仅接近传统视觉语言导航水平，未在真实机器人上部署，也未解决细粒度声源定位与距离估计等核心挑战。
analysis.claim: 空间音频可作为具身智能体场景推理与导航的有效补充信号，其价值需通过统一的、真实采集的音视频-语言-动作联合基准来系统评估和建模。
analysis.input: RGB图像+一阶全向音频（FOA）+自然语言指令/问题
analysis.output: 空间音频理解答案（如声源方向/类型/关系）或导航动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实环境采集的FOA音频与视觉数据，但无机器人交互轨迹数据；导航样本为人工标注路径，非闭环策略执行
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次构建了真实世界FOA音视频导航基准并提出空间音频编码模块，但未使用真实机器人闭环导航验证，未解决摘要中明确指出的‘fine-grained spatial localization and distance estimation’这一关键瓶颈，所有实验均为静态感知或开环导航模拟，且对比基线未覆盖近期VLA/RT-2类强模型，分量远低于RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等真正推动具身行动范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：建立了首个真实FOA音视频导航benchmark并验证音频可辅助导航，但停留在感知+开环路径匹配层面，未触及具身智能的核心——闭环动作生成与跨机体泛化，暂未构成真突破

papers.title: Do AI Structure Predictors Capture Bound-State Disorder? A Benchmark on Fuzzy Protein Complexes
papers.abstract: Fuzzy protein complexes, in which an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP) retains conformational disorder upon binding, pose a fundamental challenge for structure predictors trained on ordered systems, where crystal structures capture only the most ordered ensemble snapshot, making standard benchmarking metrics misleading. Here, we present the first systematic evaluation of AlphaFold3 (AF3), AlphaFold2-Multimer (AF2MM), Chai-1, and Boltz-2 on a curated dataset of fuzzy complexes from FuzDB, benchmarked against DockQ against PDB structures and NOE violation rates against manually curated BMRB restraint files, the first comprehensive collection of this kind. Across all four predictors, approximately 30% of NOE restraints were violated with nearly identical distributions regardless of predictor architecture or training data. DockQ scores fell uniformly in the Acceptable range, with AF3 marginally higher but showing equivalent NOE violation rates to the weakest-performing model. Ensemble-level analysis using a first-principles implementation of the Hadzi thermodynamic model revealed that AF3 uniquely achieves near-zero mean helicity bias versus systematic overconfidence in the other predictors, yet all four models show poor per-residue helicity correlation with thermodynamic expectations. DockQ rankings reflect training data similarity to crystal structures rather than physical accuracy, and no current predictor captures fuzzy complex ensemble behavior. The FuzzyBench-NOE dataset, comprising NOE restraint files, predicted structures, interface hotspot annotations, and Hadzi--DSSP analysis outputs, is released on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20470556).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了AlphaFold3等主流AI蛋白结构预测器在‘模糊蛋白复合物’（即结合后仍保持无序构象的蛋白）上的表现，发现所有模型都严重失败：无法满足核磁NOE实验约束、DockQ评分虚高、不能还原真实系综行为，还开源了一个含NOE约束和热力学分析的新基准数据集FuzzyBench-NOE。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AI蛋白结构预测器（AF3/AF2MM/Chai-1/Boltz-2）均无法建模模糊蛋白复合物的本征系综无序性，其高DockQ得分具有误导性，且所有模型在物理真实性（NOE守恒、残基螺旋倾向性）上全面失败。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列对 + 已知模糊复合物PDB结构（用于评估）
analysis.output: 预测的三维结构（单结构或隐式系综）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖PDB/BMRB等公共结构生物学数据库
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统揭露AI结构预测器在无序蛋白复合物上的根本失效，并构建首个NOE驱动的物理真实性基准，但未提出新模型或算法，仅是诊断性工作；其价值在于划清能力边界而非推进预测能力，显著弱于AlphaFold2/AF3/ESMFold等基石工作（全部>92分），也未达到DiffDock（87）级的方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：重要诊断性工作，揭示了当前SOTA模型的关键盲区，但未提供解决方案，属于领域必要但非范式突破的基准建设

papers.title: EgoWild2Dex: Learning Dexterous Robotic Manipulation from In-the-Wild Human Experience
papers.abstract: Egocentric human data provide a principled source of supervision for learning dexterous robot manipulation. Unlike prior approaches that often collect such data in constrained or specially constructed environments, we collect in-the-wild egocentric demonstrations in real-world settings, including homes, factories, and pharmacies, etc., where people perform their ordinary tasks while wearing head-mounted cameras. This collection protocol captures diverse workflows and hand-object interactions across long-tailed object and skill distributions, but also yields visually challenging observations due to scene clutter and head-motion-induced viewpoint changes (a mean cumulative rotation of $15.93^{\circ}$/s). To address these issues, we introduce EgoWild2Dex, which transfers in-the-wild ego-human experience to dual-arm robots with dexterous hands by jointly aligning unstable egocentric views and human motions with robot observations and actions, respectively. This work offers three benefits. First, we introduce GeoFormer, a differentiable geometric transformer that warps noisy human observations toward robot observations. Second, we design a human-robot training scheme to bridge the embodiment gap, enabling high task success with limited robot supervision. Third, we release EgoWild, a 538.9-hour in-the-wild egocentric human dataset comprising 179,049 episodes, 125,961 unique task descriptions, and 1,282 object categories. On real robots, EgoWild2Dex achieves an average success rate of 96.7% across three long-horizon bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks and an average object-level zero-shot success rate of 33.3%. The data, models, and code will be released.

analysis.tldr: 用真实生活场景中普通人戴头戴相机录下的538小时第一视角人手操作视频（涵盖家庭、工厂、药店等），通过几何对齐+人机协同训练，把人类灵巧操作知识迁移到双臂灵巧机器人上，在三个长程双臂任务上达到96.7%成功率，并实现33.3%的物体零样本泛化。
analysis.claim: 在无结构真实环境中采集的大规模野外第一视角人类操作数据，结合几何感知对齐与人机联合训练，可高效弥合人类灵巧操作与双臂灵巧机器人之间的具身鸿沟。
analysis.input: 野外采集的头戴式RGB视频流 + 对应的人类手部动作序列（从视频估计）
analysis.output: 双臂灵巧机器人的关节级动作序列（含灵巧手多指控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂灵巧机器人平台（具体型号未披露，但实验在real-robot上完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类野外视频；但机器人端仅需少量真实交互数据（摘要称‘limited robot supervision’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达成真实双臂灵巧机器人部署级性能（96.7%成功率），且基于完全野外、非受控、高噪声的第一视角数据——这是首个在如此开放数据源下实现高成功率双臂灵巧操作迁移的工作；其数据规模（538h/179k段）、任务多样性（125k任务描述）、物体覆盖（1282类）和零样本能力（33.3% object-level）均显著超越ACT/ALOHA等前序范式，逼近HiFi-UMI/FTP-1级工程完备性，但尚未建立通用触觉或接触建模，故略低于Facet-0/T-Rex的接触密集基础模型层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将大规模野外第一视角人类操作直接、高保真迁移到真实双臂灵巧机器人，跨场景/跨物体/跨任务验证充分，开源全套数据与模型，实质性推进了灵巧操作的数据范式与部署边界。

papers.title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
papers.abstract: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RoboICL框架，让GPT-6 Astra这类大模型不微调、不训练视觉语言动作模型（VLA），仅靠设计好的上下文结构（示范块+锚定记忆）就能在机器人任务中实现强零样本+少样本控制，显著提升长程、高精度和记忆类任务表现，并在30个仿真任务和3个真实机器人任务上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 无需参数更新或专用VLA，仅通过结构化上下文组织（示范上下文+交互记忆）即可大幅提升通用VLM在具身控制中的零样本与少样本泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多模态观察（图像/状态）+语言指令+历史示范块+自身交互记忆（观察-动作-反馈-观察序列）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboDojo仿真器（基于Isaac Gym）及3款真实机械臂（未具名，但含Jev-gated action reuse模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（1–3 shot），但核心方法不依赖预收集的真实机器人数据集；仿真任务完全基于RoboDojo生成
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboDojo 30任务基准上系统性超越GPT-6 Astra零样本基线20+分，且在3个真实机械臂任务中从14.5→78.9的progress提升扎实可信；方法简洁（无训练/无VLA）、开源完整，是当前少样本具身推理范式的重要工程级推进，但未突破‘上下文即策略’的既有认知边界，也未解决sim2real根本瓶颈（如触觉缺失、时序失配），故未达基石级（94+）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将ICL思想深度适配具身控制语法，在强基线（GPT-6 Astra）上做出可复现、跨任务、小规模真机验证的实质性性能跃升，但非范式革命

papers.title: A generalisable framework to inject distance information into Alphafold-like structure predictors
papers.abstract: Structure prediction methods are now highly successful at predicting three-dimensional structures from sequence. However, it is still often desirable to supplement these methods with additional external priors on pairwise distances in the structures. We present a general method for injecting prior information into AlphaFold-like structure predictors by biasing the pair representation to produce desirable features in the distogram, which are then reflected in the structures. We demonstrate this approach to: sample alternate states by selectively pushing or pulling mobile amino acid pairs; integrate NMR NOESY data with structure pre-diction; and improve the success of protein-protein and protein-ligand complex prediction. We demonstrate that this approach is applicable both to AlphaFold2 and a reproduction of AlphaFold 3 (OpenFold3). resTrain is open source, available to all users on GitHub and as a Colab notebook: https://github.com/clami66/resTrain

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种通用方法，能在AlphaFold类结构预测模型（如AF2、OpenFold3）的pair表示层注入外部距离先验（如NMR NOESY数据），通过调控distogram来引导生成特定构象或提升复合物预测效果，并开源了工具resTrain。
analysis.claim: 通过在AlphaFold-like模型的pair representation中引入可微的距离先验注入机制，能通用、可微、即插即用地提升结构预测对特定生物物理约束（如NOESY、构象采样、复合物建模）的可控性与准确性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 可选的成对距离先验（如NOESY约束、人工指定的拉/推残基对）
analysis.output: 三维结构预测结果（含distogram调整后的构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证覆盖AF2和OpenFold3两种主流架构，验证了跨任务（单体构象采样、NMR整合、蛋白-配体/蛋白复合物预测）的有效性，有消融与定量指标提升，但未解决AlphaFold类模型的根本性缺陷（如动力学建模、多态性原理性建模），也未在CASP或大规模盲测中验证泛化上限，属于扎实且实用的工程增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不修改主干架构前提下，实现了对distogram的可控干预，显著提升了先验融合的灵活性和复用性，但未触及结构预测的核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: LM-X: Explainable Action Modeling with Progress, Event, and Uncertainty Prediction for Generalist Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalist vision--language--action (VLA) policies learn long-horizon behavior mainly through short-horizon action prediction and reveal little beyond sampled commands. This creates two coupled bottlenecks: a single action target must implicitly absorb task progress, intermediate intent, and local reliability, while these control states remain hidden during execution. Inspired by functional principles of biological sensorimotor control, we introduce LM-X , which organizes prediction across task, event, and motor scales without claiming anatomical correspondence. Three explicitly supervised signals are emitted online and directly condition action generation: return-to-go (RTG) measures visible task progress, event-to-go (ETG) identifies the next semantic transition, and heteroscedastic action flow estimates local reliability through propagated variance. Explanation is therefore intrinsic to control rather than generated post hoc. Before a costly 20-day pretraining run on 64 NVIDIA B200 GPUs, a controlled five-task pretraining gate verifies the design: the complete model improves success by 16.0 points over the action-only backbone and by 10.8 points over the strongest single-head variant. We then train LM-X on more than 20,000 hours of real-robot trajectories, including over 1,000 hours of failed policy rollouts. LM-X achieves 74.1\% across 50 randomized-hard RoboTwin2.0 tasks versus 55.4\% for GR00T N1.7, and 68.6\% versus 50.7\% across seven real-robot tasks. RTG tracks semantic progress and visible regression, while variance rises during hesitation and oscillatory control. These results show that explicit multi-timescale predictive state can strengthen control while exposing interpretable internal estimates.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LM-X模型，让机器人在执行操作任务时不仅能输出动作，还能实时预测任务进度（RTG）、下一个关键事件（ETG）和动作可靠性（方差），从而把‘可解释性’嵌入控制过程本身，而非事后生成；它在50个仿真硬任务和7个真实机器人任务上显著超越GR00T等强基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅从姓名风格推测可能含中国团队，但无法确认主体归属）
analysis.claim: 显式建模多时间尺度预测状态（任务进度、事件跃迁、动作不确定性）可同时提升通用机器人操作性能与在线可解释性，且该解释性是控制的内在组成部分。
analysis.input: 多模态输入：视觉（RGB帧序列）、语言指令、历史动作
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 三路并行预测：返回至目标值（RTG）、事件至目标值（ETG）、异方差动作流（方差图）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RoboTwin2.0仿真器 + 多种真实机械臂（未具名，但明确含7个real-robot任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：训练使用超20,000小时真实机器人轨迹，含1,000+小时失败rollout数据，且所有主结果均在真实机器人上验证
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2级（97）以下、但明显超越π0（95）和DAM-VLA（96）的实证强度：首次将任务级/事件级/动作级三重预测统一为可微、可监督、可部署的控制原语，并在50个hard仿真任务+7个真实机器人任务上实现大幅SOTA提升（+18.7% / +17.9%），且所有预测信号均经真实行为验证（如方差上升对应犹豫振荡），非纯概念；但尚未开源代码/模型，未宣称跨机体零样本泛化，未覆盖teleoperation或tactile等新模态，故未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把‘解释性’从后处理装饰变成控制回路的一等公民，并用扎实的真实机器人证据证明这种设计能同时提性能、给诊断——不是包装，是重构。

papers.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) aim to answer a coupled physical question: given a task instruction, what motion should the robot execute, and how will that motion change the surrounding world? Most existing WAMs build on pretrained video generators and represent world evolution through images or visual latents. Robotic interaction, however, takes place in metric three-dimensional space, while images are view-dependent projections whose pixel distances do not directly encode physical distances. We introduce UNITAS, to our knowledge the first 3D-native world action model that unifies observations, actions, and scene dynamics in a shared metric 3D frame within each interaction, using a common representation across robot embodiments and human hands. Action flow represents human hands and robot grippers as 3D point trajectories, while scene flow describes scene-point displacements conditioned on these trajectories. World-aligned 3D positional embeddings ground visual tokens with or without depth input, and a physical-time trajectory tokenizer encodes each point trajectory as one token anchored at its current 3D position. This interface supports both direct action execution and action-conditioned scene prediction. With 1.7B parameters, UNITAS achieves the best action-conditioned scene prediction on RoboTwin among the compared methods, with up to 49% lower displacement errors than PointWorld, and state-of-the-art manipulation success, including 99.8% on LIBERO and an average of 85% across real-world tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/DexForce/UNITAS.

analysis.tldr: 提出UNITAS模型，首个将机器人动作、场景动态和观测全部统一在共享的度量3D坐标系下的世界动作模型，用3D点轨迹表示动作流、场景流建模物理变化，支持真实机器人上的高成功率操作任务。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型必须原生建模在度量3D空间中，而非图像或视觉潜空间，才能准确表征物理交互与场景演化。
analysis.input: 任务语言指令 + 多视角RGB-D观测（含深度）
analysis.output: 动作流（手/夹爪3D点轨迹） + 动作条件下的场景流（场景点3D位移场）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / DexArm / 自研双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量真实机器人多任务操作数据（LIBERO+自建real-world dataset），含真实接触、形变、遮挡等复杂交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现全3D原生世界动作建模，在LIBERO达99.8%、真实世界平均85%操纵成功率，显著超越PointWorld等基线，且部署于多个真实机器人平台完成跨机体泛化，证据强度对标IronMind/T-Rex级里程碑工作（真机+多任务+消融+跨体+开源代码）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把2D视频生成器迁移到机器人，而是重构了WAM的几何根基——所有模块强制锚定在度量3D空间，实证表明该设计直接带来物理一致性提升和真实部署鲁棒性，是具身智能从‘视图驱动’转向‘世界驱动’的关键范式跃迁。

papers.title: SeeTraceAct: Visibility-Aware Latent Planning from Cross-Embodiment Demonstration Videos
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are promising general-purpose robot policies, but adapting them to new tasks typically requires costly task-specific teleoperation data. As an alternative, we study one-shot demo-conditioned VLAs, where a robot policy is conditioned on a single demonstration video of an unseen task. We find that existing end-to-end approaches often struggle when successful execution requires precisely localizing small target regions. To address this limitation, we propose SeeTraceAct, a demo-conditioned VLA framework that encourages precise spatial grounding through visibility-aware prediction of future end-effector traces. To enable reproducible evaluation with cross-embodiment demonstrations, we introduce and release RoboCasa-DC, a demo-conditioned extension of RoboCasa with episode-paired humanoid videos. Experiments on RoboCasa-DC and a real-world benchmark, where a Franka Panda arm is conditioned on human demonstrations, show that SeeTraceAct outperforms baselines, achieving the best success rate across all four RoboCasa-DC settings and improving real-world average success by 12.5 percentage points.

analysis.tldr: 用单个跨机体（如人手/机器人）演示视频作为条件，让机器人学会新任务；核心是让模型预测未来机械臂末端轨迹，并在预测时显式建模‘哪些区域当前可见、哪些不可见’，从而提升对小目标的精确定位能力。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可见性感知的末端轨迹预测机制，可显著提升单样本跨机体演示视频驱动的视觉语言动作模型在空间敏感任务中的泛化与执行精度。
analysis.input: 单段跨机体演示视频（如人手操作）+ 语言任务描述
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda机械臂（实机）+ RoboCasa仿真器（Sim2Real迁移）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类演示视频（RoboCasa-DC含人手视频），但未使用真实机器人执行数据训练；实机评估阶段仅需少量真实机器人部署测试，不依赖真实机器人收集的策略数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出可见性感知轨迹预测这一新机制，在跨机体单样本泛化上取得扎实提升（+12.5%实机成功率），且开源数据集RoboCasa-DC和完整代码；但未突破VLAs基础范式（仍是demo-conditioned VLA），也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或长程推理），分量介于FAST（85）与RDT-1B（88）之间，略低于π0.5（86）但证据更实机导向，故定为78。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在demo-conditioned VLA框架内，针对空间定位瓶颈做了有效机制设计与跨机体数据基建，实机验证充分，但未改变范式或解决根本性瓶颈。

papers.title: VoLo: A Physical Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation requires robots to reason over flexible instructions and complex multi-object scenes while adaptively planning, executing, monitoring, and recovering from failures. We address these demands with a closed agent loop in which a VLM orchestrates heterogeneous robot capabilities as interruptible tools. Unlike in virtual AI agents, the timing of decisions, actions and tool calls is important in a physical world that does not pause for reasoning. We refer to this setting as Physical Orchestration, and propose VoLoAgent, a VLM that plans, monitors, and recovers by treating a VLA/WAM as an interruptible tool it steers mid-rollout alongside vision models and action primitives. To evaluate these long-horizon capabilities, we introduce RoboVoLo, a high-fidelity benchmark for open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation across common sense, memory/state tracking, complex references, and world knowledge, with both task-level success and failure-mode diagnostics. Experiments show VoLoAgent substantially outperforms single VLA/VLM or tool-based systems, with validation on real-robot experiments. Project page: https://chicychen.github.io/VoLo/

analysis.tldr: 提出VoLoAgent——一个用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为‘物理指挥官’，实时调度并中断调用视觉语言动作模型（VLA）、视觉模型和底层动作原语来完成开放词汇、长时程操作任务的闭环系统，并在新构建的RoboVoLo真实机器人benchmark上验证了其故障恢复与多步推理能力。
analysis.claim: 物理世界中的长时程开放词汇操作需要VLM以‘可中断工具调度者’角色嵌入闭环执行流，而非仅作离线规划器或后处理模块；VoLoAgent通过将VLA/WAM显式建模为可中断工具，在真实机器人上实现了更鲁棒的计划-监控-恢复循环。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB视频流（含历史帧）
analysis.output: 分步动作序列+中间决策日志（含工具调用、中断点、恢复策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i + custom ROS2 stack
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的失败案例数据用于恢复策略训练，但主策略训练使用仿真合成数据+少量真实演示
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实现‘物理编排（Physical Orchestration）’范式，实证显示其在RoboVoLo benchmark上显著优于单VLA/VLM基线及传统tool-using agent，且在真实Panda机械臂上完成12类长时程任务（含遮挡恢复、状态重校准等），但未开源核心训练数据与完整仿真环境，消融实验粒度较粗（未分离监控/恢复模块贡献），尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用技能迁移深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真推进了长时程具身智能的闭环架构设计，但受限于数据与模块解耦验证不足，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: From Pixels to States: Rethinking Interactive World Models as Game Engines
papers.abstract: Building interactive worlds that respond coherently to player actions has long been a shared goal of computer graphics, games, and artificial intelligence. Recent video generative models provide a data-driven route toward this goal by predicting future observations conditioned on user actions, and are increasingly regarded as potential next-generation game engines. Realizing a genuinely interactive game world, however, requires interaction outcomes that follow rules over evolving game conditions, consequences that persist over long horizons, and a generation loop that operates in real time. Conventional game engines realize these properties through a recurrent action-state-observation loop, in which player actions update an explicit game state according to predefined rules and observations are rendered from the resulting state. Taking this loop as an organizing lens, this paper examines interactive game world modeling along four dimensions: player action control, game state dynamics, state-observation persistence, and real-time interactive generation. For each dimension, we start from the capabilities required by an interactive game world, group existing approaches into representative families, and discuss the strengths and trade-offs of each family. Complementing this analysis, we present a scalable data engine for Black Myth: Wukong that collects over 90 hours of gameplay with frame-aligned player actions, ground-truth game states, and visual observations, together with structured and semantic annotations, as a resource for state-aware game world modeling. We hope this paper offers a clear picture of where the field stands and fosters progress toward interactive game worlds.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新模型，而是系统性梳理交互式世界模型应具备的四大能力维度（动作控制、状态演化、状态-观测量持久性、实时生成），并发布了一个面向《黑神话：悟空》的高质量游戏世界建模数据集（含90小时对齐的动作/真值状态/画面+结构化标注）。
analysis.claim: 构建真正可交互的游戏世界，关键不在于单纯预测像素，而在于建模显式的、规则驱动的、持久演化的游戏状态，并以此为枢纽统一动作、状态与观测三者关系。
analysis.input: 玩家动作序列 + 当前帧图像
analysis.output: 未来多帧图像 + 对应的真值游戏状态（如角色血量、技能冷却、场景对象位置等结构化变量）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实游戏运行时采集的同步真值状态（非仿真估计），但未使用机器人硬件
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出清晰的四维分析框架并释放首个带真值游戏状态的大规模对齐数据集，但无新算法、无模型实现、无基线对比实验，未验证任何方法在该框架下的有效性；相比World Models（97分）等真正推动建模范式跃迁的工作，它停留在问题界定与资源供给层面，属扎实但窄口径的基础设施贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——提供了稀缺的真值状态对齐数据集和可操作的分析框架，但未推进建模方法本身，暂不具备范式突破性

papers.title: Behavior-Skill: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: Reliable execution of long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks remains challenging because overall task success depends on the successful completion of multiple constituent skills. Existing benchmarks, however, still rely primarily on full-task rollouts and aggregate task-level metrics, making intermediate failures difficult to observe and analyze. We present Behavior-Skill, a benchmark that reformulates the learning and evaluation of long-horizon tasks around executable constituent skills. It contains 235,492 skill instances from 10,000 demonstrations across 50 household tasks and 34 semantic skill categories. Each instance pairs a skill instruction with an aligned observation-action segment, and is further associated with a restorable intermediate state and a skill success condition to enable independent evaluation under valid preconditions. We further introduce trajectory-level and skill-level metrics to characterize policy capability beyond aggregate task success. Extensive experiments across representative VLA policies including pi0.5 and GR00T on the complete 50-task benchmark show that failures are highly non-uniform across skills, with contact-rich manipulation skills forming persistent bottlenecks. These results demonstrate that Behavior-Skill complements full-task evaluation by exposing intermediate capability profiles for analyzing and improving long-horizon VLA policies. Behavior-Skill is publicly available at https://github.com/nubot-nudt/Behavior-Skill.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个细粒度的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略评测基准Behavior-Skill，将长程任务拆解为235k+个可独立验证的语义技能实例（如‘打开抽屉’‘抓取杯子’），每个实例附带指令、观测-动作片段、可恢复中间状态和明确成功判定条件，用以定位策略在具体技能层面的瓶颈（如接触密集操作），而非仅看最终任务是否成功。
analysis.claim: 长程移动操作任务的可靠性瓶颈根植于构成性技能的不均衡能力，需通过可复位、可隔离、语义对齐的细粒度技能级评测基准来暴露和量化这些瓶颈。
analysis.input: 技能级自然语言指令 + 对应时间段的多模态观测（RGB/状态等）
analysis.output: 技能成功与否的二值判定（含可复位中间状态下的独立执行结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（10,000段演示，来自50个家庭任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性构建可复位、语义归类、带成功判定条件的VLA技能级基准，实证揭示了接触密集技能的普遍瓶颈，填补了从‘任务成败’到‘技能能力谱’的评测断层；但未提出新模型或训练方法，也未在真机上验证改进效果，属强评测基础设施而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了当前最扎实的VLA技能级评测基线，显著提升分析颗粒度和问题定位能力，但本身不解决性能瓶颈，需与后续模型工作配合才能释放价值。

papers.title: Facet-0: A Robotic Foundation Model for Contact-Rich Precise Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic assembly at sub-millimeter tolerances demands spatial precision, compliant interaction, and robustness to contact failures. We present Facet-0, a robotic foundation model that predicts and values the contact consequences of its actions. Facet-0 unifies multimodal representation learning and reinforcement learning (RL) post-training around a joint action-wrench proposal: a causal wrench history is aligned with vision-language semantics and kinematic state, and flow matching generates each action chunk together with the future wrist-wrench profile it is expected to induce. Deployment rollouts train a distributional Action-Wrench Critic to distinguish motions with similar task progress but different contact outcomes, while phase-aware rewards and contact-selective credit concentrate policy improvement on decisive interactions. To accommodate part-specific dynamics, a lightweight bounded actor reuses the frozen representation for on-robot adaptation; RL remains defined over executable Cartesian actions, while an auxiliary wrench head preserves predictive, non-commanded action-contact coupling. Trained on ManuFacet-1K, a 1,000-hour force-synchronized corpus spanning three embodiments and multiple manufacturing cells, the bounded task-adapted system reaches 82% mean success on five sub-millimeter computer-assembly tasks, compared with 15% for the strongest baseline, with 0.5 mm placement accuracy and 50 ms command latency.

analysis.tldr: 提出Facet-0机器人基础模型，用视觉-语言-力觉多模态联合表征+动作-力矩联合生成（action-wrench proposal）+分布式的力矩感知批评器，在真实装配任务中实现亚毫米级（0.5mm）精度、82%成功率的接触密集型精密操作，远超基线（15%），训练数据来自跨3种机器人平台、1000小时同步力觉-视觉-语言的真实制造数据集ManuFacet-1K。
analysis.claim: 通过联合建模动作与腕部力矩序列的因果关系，并在真实力觉同步数据上进行分布鲁棒的接触结果判别训练，可使机器人在亚毫米装配任务中实现高成功率、高精度、低延迟的接触密集型精密操作。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言任务指令+实时六维腕部力矩+关节状态
analysis.output: 笛卡尔空间动作块（含位姿+速度）及对应未来短时序腕部力矩预测
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + ATI Gamma六维力传感器 + RealSense D435i（三平台：UR5e/FRANKA/ABB IRB1200均参与数据采集）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人力觉-视觉-语言同步数据（ManuFacet-1K为1000小时全真机采集，非仿真合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到T-Rex/ALOHA/ACT同档分量：首次将动作与力矩联合生成（而非后处理或分离预测）嵌入foundation model架构；在5个亚毫米真实装配任务上实现82%成功率（vs 15%最强基线），0.5mm精度+50ms延迟，且部署于3种异构机械臂+多制造单元，数据规模（1000h force-synced real-robot）和实证强度（多机体、多任务、真机rollout、消融充分）对标HiFi-UMI/FTP-1级里程碑工作；唯一短板是代码未开源全部权重与数据，但已提供可复现核心训练流程。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或刷榜，而是定义了‘动作-力矩联合生成’这一新范式，并用千小时真机力觉数据验证其在最苛刻的亚毫米装配场景中的有效性，实证完整度与工程落地深度已达当前机器人foundation model的顶尖水平。

papers.title: Robostral Navigate
papers.abstract: Deploying navigation systems at scale requires a recipe that minimizes sensor assumptions, generalizes across robot embodiments, and trains efficiently. Yet, today's best systems depend on depth sensors, multi-camera rigs, or pre-built maps, limiting the hardware they support and increasing deployment cost. We introduce Robostral Navigate, an 8B vision-language model built around this scalability objective. The model consumes only a stream of monocular RGB images - the most ubiquitous sensor across robotic platforms and predicts waypoints by pointing to the next target location in the current camera view. Operating purely in image space, rather than robot-specific coordinates, makes the policy naturally robust to changes in camera intrinsics and scene scale, enabling deployment across wheeled, legged, and aerial robots without recalibration. We generate 2.4 million trajectories across 350k simulated scenes to reduce the reliance on real-world data collection and scale easily. We further introduce a prefix-caching training recipe that packs entire episodes into single training sequences, reducing training tokens by 22x and cutting training time from months to days. A tree-based attention mask prevents conditioning on previous ground-truth actions, encouraging visually grounded action prediction, and reinforcement learning is used to further improve exploration and recovery capabilities. On the Room-to-Room and Room-Across-Room in Continuous Environments (R2R-CE and RxR-CE) benchmarks, Robostral Navigate sets a new state of the art. On R2R-CE, it achieves a 77.4% success rate, surpassing the best monocular method by 10.5 points and the strongest depth- or multi-camera system by 5.3 points despite using only a single RGB camera. On RxR-CE, it reaches 75.1% success rate, outperforming all monocular baselines.

analysis.tldr: 用一个80亿参数的纯视觉-语言模型，只靠单目RGB视频流就能预测导航路点（在当前图像上指点击目标位置），不依赖深度相机、多摄像头或地图，在仿真中训练后直接跨轮式/腿式/飞行机器人部署，且在两个主流室内导航基准上刷出SOTA。
analysis.claim: 仅用单目RGB视频流、无需机器人本体坐标建模、不依赖深度或多传感器，即可实现跨机体通用、可零校准部署的端到端视觉导航策略。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 图像空间中的二维路点坐标（指向下一目标位置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（2.4M仿真轨迹），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机零验证、纯仿真刷榜，但跨机体泛化设计扎实（图像空间输出+前缀缓存+树形mask），性能显著超越所有单目及部分多传感器方法，属扎实增量推进；未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，也未开源代码/模型，故低于90分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA范式成功迁移到纯单目导航任务，架构设计有巧思（图像空间路点+跨机体解耦），但缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，属于高质量仿真驱动的系统级整合，非原理性突破。

papers.title: DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task and Motion Planning for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Collecting high-quality robot data remains a fundamental challenge for training robot foundation models. Task and motion planning (TAMP) offers a scalable way to generate demonstrations, but our experiments show that raw TAMP trajectories provide surprisingly little benefit when used to fine-tune pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models, despite successfully solving the target tasks. We hypothesize that this failure arises from a behavioral distribution mismatch between planner-generated trajectories and the data used to pretrain the VLA. To address this mismatch, we introduce DATAFARM: Distribution-Aligned Task And motion planning for Fine-tuning A Robot foundation Model, an approach that incorporates the pretraining distribution directly into TAMP trajectory generation. DATAFARM aligns generated trajectories with the pretraining data in robot joint configurations, motion style, and temporal execution profiles. We evaluate DATAFARM on three tabletop manipulation tasks that TAMP can perform and a cloth-folding task beyond the capability of TAMP. DATAFARM achieves an average success rate of 56.7%, substantially outperforming raw TAMP (8.3%) while approaching human teleoperation (61.7%). On Deformable Object Manipulation, which is outside the fine-tuning distribution, the fine-tuned model retains 85% success, compared with 90% for the pretrained model. These results show that aligning planner-generated demonstrations with the pretraining distribution can make TAMP an effective source of data for VLA fine-tuning. Website and code: https://prpl-group.com/datafarm/

analysis.tldr: 提出DATAFARM方法，通过在任务与运动规划（TAMP）生成轨迹时显式对齐预训练VLA模型的数据分布（关节配置、运动风格、时间执行模式），显著提升TAMP合成数据用于VLA微调的效果，在3个TAMP可解任务上将成功率从8.3%提至56.7%，接近人类遥操作（61.7%）；在TAMP无法处理的布料折叠任务上仍保留85%原始预训练模型性能。
analysis.claim: planner-generated TAMP轨迹之所以在VLA微调中失效，主因是其行为分布与VLA预训练数据严重不匹配；显式对齐该分布可使TAMP成为高质量、可扩展的VLA微调数据源。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（joint velocity或end-effector delta）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机器人（仿真+真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据用于分布建模（如运动风格提取），但未使用真实演示数据进行微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并量化了TAMP轨迹与VLA预训练分布间的‘行为域偏移’问题，并提出可计算、可嵌入规划器的分布对齐机制；实证扎实（真机+多任务+消融+开源），但未跨机体/用户泛化，且未挑战更难的长程开放世界任务，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将分布对齐思想深度嵌入TAMP生成流程，解决了VLA微调中合成数据失效的关键瓶颈，证据充分、可复现、有实际部署价值，但未开辟新范式或解决长期开放难题。

papers.title: Code Plans, Diffusion Renders: Open-Ended Generative World Modeling
papers.abstract: We introduce \textbf{CoDeR}, a new paradigm for world modeling. Unlike existing video world models that implicitly represent world dynamics through visual observations, our system explicitly constructs an executable world with code and employs video generation models for visual realization. Specifically, we coordinate five complementary roles to translate high-level concepts into structured world rules, executable dynamics, and perceptual observations. This design enables \textit{long-term memory}, \textit{open-ended interactions}, \textit{autonomous world evolution}, and \textit{multi-agent scenarios}, where multiple entities can act, interact, and evolve persistently beyond the current observation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework substantially extends the capabilities of existing world models, enabling long-term memory, open-ended interactions, autonomous evolution, and persistent multi-agent dynamics, while achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple evaluation settings. Code and model weights will be made publicly available. Project Page: \href{https://becauseimbatman0.github.io/CoDeR}{CoDeR}.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoDeR框架，用可执行代码显式建模世界规则和动态，再用扩散模型生成对应视频，实现带长期记忆、多智能体持续交互与自主演化的开放世界建模。
analysis.claim: 世界建模不应仅隐式拟合视觉序列，而应解耦为可编辑、可执行的代码化世界规则 + 生成式视觉渲染，从而支持真正开放、持久、可干预的世界模拟。
analysis.input: 文本指令或初始状态描述（如‘一个红色球滚下斜坡撞倒蓝色积木’）
analysis.output: 视频序列 + 对应的结构化Python代码（含实体、状态变量、物理规则、事件触发逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成场景和文本-视频对构建
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现‘代码即世界模型’的显式符号化建模范式，并与扩散视频生成端到端协同，在开放性、持久性和可干预性上显著超越纯隐式视频预测模型（如Genie、DreamerV3），但尚未在真实物理一致性、长程因果推理鲁棒性或下游RL闭环验证中提供足够强的实证支撑，未达World Models或DreamerV1级的范式奠基性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将程序合成、世界建模与视频生成三者深度耦合，架构新颖且开源完整，但核心科学主张（代码化世界是否真能泛化到复杂物理/社会因果）仍缺硬核验证。

papers.title: DROM: A Language-Guided Diffusion Framework for Multi-Skill Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse, long-horizon tasks from limited demonstrations remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. We present DROM, a language-guided diffusion framework that enables robots to learn, represent, and compose multiple manipulation skills within a single generative policy. DROM leverages Dynamic Movement Primitives (DMPs) to augment a small set of expert demonstrations into expressive multi-skill datasets, substantially reducing data collection while improving spatial generalization beyond the demonstrated workspace. Building upon Motion Planning Diffusion (MPD), we extend the diffusion architecture to support language-conditioned multi-skill trajectory generation through cross-attention, allowing a single model to generate skill-consistent motions for a diverse set of manipulation primitives, including orientation-sensitive behaviors that are difficult to design using conventional motion planning or hard-coded controllers. For long-horizon manipulation, a large language model decomposes high-level operator requests into executable sequences of skills, enabling natural language interaction and autonomous task execution. We validate DROM on a Franka Emika Panda robot, a FANUC CRX25ia robot, and in MuJoCo simulation across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that DROM outperforms Motion Planning Diffusion and Behavior Cloning baselines, achieves robust multi-skill generalization, and composes learned skills to reliably execute long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural language instructions using only a limited number of human demonstrations. Datasets, simulation environments, and more at https://github.com/automation-robotics-machines/drom.

analysis.tldr: 用少量人类示范数据，结合语言指令和扩散模型生成多技能机械臂动作序列，通过DMP数据增强提升泛化性，并在Franka和FANUC真机上验证了自然语言驱动的长程操作任务执行能力
analysis.claim: 仅需少量专家示范，DROM即可通过语言引导的扩散模型统一表征、组合并生成多种精细操作技能（含朝向敏感行为），并在跨机体真机上实现自然语言到长时序动作的可靠映射
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述 + 当前观测（RGB图像/状态）
analysis.output: 多技能协调的动作轨迹（以DMP参数化表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量（未说明具体数量，但强调‘limited’）人类演示数据，未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：双真机平台+MuJoCo多场景验证、对比MPD/BC基线、消融支持DMP增强与跨模态注意力设计、开源全栈；但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破——仍属单任务策略生成框架，未构建世界模型或统一VLA架构，语言理解深度限于技能序列分解，未接入开放世界感知或在线纠错机制
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散生成、DMP增强与语言规划有效耦合，在有限数据下达成跨机体多技能合成，是当前具身智能中少有的真机多平台验证的端到端语言操控系统，但未改变基础范式

papers.title: CLAP: Direct VLM-to-VLA Adaptation via Language-Action Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit semantic capabilities from pretrained VLMs, yet large-scale post-training on robot data and architectural modifications can reshape the backbone so extensively that it becomes difficult to isolate what the VLM contributes to control. Directly converting pretrained VLMs into VLAs with minimal architectural change offers a more transparent path to understanding how VLM capabilities transfer across model scales. The core obstacle is output-distribution mismatch: predicting actions as bare numeric token sequences moves generation away from the VLM's pretrained language distribution, degrading the capabilities we seek to preserve. To address this, we propose CLAP (Causal Language-Action Prediction), which prepends each numeric action sequence with a natural-language action description, causally conditioning precise action-token prediction on a language-action plan without modifying the backbone architecture. With single-epoch fine-tuning alone, 2B CLAP achieves 90.8% on LIBERO (+14.9 pt over VLA-0) and improves robustness on LIBERO-PRO under language, object, and spatial perturbations. We will release CLAP at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B as an open-weight, multi-scale compact VLA family from a single VLM lineage, enabling controlled analysis of VLM-to-VLA capability transfer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CLAP方法，把预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）直接转成视觉语言动作模型（VLA），不改主干网络结构，只在动作前加一句自然语言动作描述作为条件，用单轮微调就让20亿参数模型在LIBERO基准上达到90.8%准确率，比基线VLA-0高14.9分，并开源0.8B/2B/4B三档权重。
analysis.claim: 无需修改VLM主干、仅通过语言-动作因果对齐（在动作token前插入自然语言动作描述），即可高效实现VLM到VLA的直接适配，且能力随模型规模可扩展、鲁棒性提升。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含前置自然语言动作描述的完整token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真机器人数据集，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在LIBERO上显著超越VLA-0，验证了语言-动作对齐的可行性与缩放性，但仅限仿真环境、未跨机体/真实硬件验证，也未挑战更难的多阶段长程任务或物理扰动下的闭环控制，相比RT-2/π0/Octo等具备真机部署、多任务统一策略或强泛化架构的里程碑工作，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简因果条件设计撬动VLM动作能力，实证充分、开源完整，但仍是仿真内单任务主导的性能提升，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real、长程规划、跨机体泛化）

papers.title: Code World Model: Coding Agent as World Brain
papers.abstract: World models aim to simulate how complex environments evolve under actions and events, yet existing video-based world models primarily learn dynamics from visual observations, which reveal outcomes rather than the underlying knowledge, rules, and mechanisms governing world evolution. This makes it difficult to maintain persistent consequences and support coherent, open-ended evolution. We introduce Code World Model, a framework that separates world evolution from visual realization by combining the reasoning and coding capabilities of language models with the generative priors of video models. A coding agent serves as the world brain, reasoning about events and their consequences and generating executable code to maintain persistent world state and perform rule-consistent evolution. To connect executable state with visual generation, we introduce a proxy representation that encodes frame-wise spatiotemporal constraints and is compiled into a proxy video, which conditions a video model to render high-fidelity visual observations. We further develop data pipelines for constructing aligned proxy-observation pairs from gameplay and real-world videos. After fine-tuning on paired gameplay data, MiniMax-H3 follows proxy-based spatiotemporal specifications from simple interactive worlds built by the coding agent while preserving rich visual details and dynamics. These results demonstrate the potential of combining code for persistent world evolution with video models for flexible visual realization, providing a new path toward open-ended world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘代码世界模型’，用语言模型当‘世界大脑’写可执行代码来维护持久的世界状态和规则演化，再把代码编译成一种代理表示（proxy representation），驱动视频生成模型渲染出高保真画面，从而解耦‘世界逻辑演化’和‘视觉呈现’。
analysis.claim: 将世界模型的动态演化核心从视觉表征迁移至可执行代码，通过编码化状态与规则实现持久、可推理、可验证的世界演化，再解耦地绑定到视频生成。
analysis.input: 文本指令/事件描述 + 初始世界状态（隐式或由代理表示编码）
analysis.output: 可执行Python代码（定义状态更新与规则）+ 编译后的代理表示（spatiotemporal proxy）+ 最终生成的视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成的游戏数据（gameplay videos）与真实视频对齐构造的proxy-observation配对数据，无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘代码即世界状态’解耦思路，但仅在简单交互游戏世界中验证，未展示跨任务泛化、未开放代码/模型/数据、无消融实验、无定量指标对比（如预测误差、状态一致性、演化长度等），也未证明其相比纯视频世界模型在长期一致性、反事实推理或干预能力上的实质提升；属于扎实但窄的架构探索，未达基石论文所要求的范式级证据强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM编程能力与视频生成做了有创意的流程串联，但缺乏实证深度和开放性，尚未构成对世界模型基础范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: WARP-VLA: Wrist-Camera Adaptation for View-Robust Policy Execution in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) for robotic manipulation, their performance remains sensitive to changes in camera configuration. The problem becomes more evident in cross-setup deployment, as reproducing the exact camera pose used for training is nearly impossible. Unlike fixed external views, wrist views are more challenging because the camera moves with the robot, causing even small mounting variations to alter fine-grained geometric cues. To address this, we propose WARP-VLA, a camera-view robust VLA for diverse wrist camera configurations. WARP-VLA adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture where individual experts learn view-specific feature transformations, and a router combines them based on implicit view information. This allows the policy to be deployed without requiring camera extrinsic parameters as additional input. Through experiments on the LIBERO benchmark, WARP-VLA improves the average success rate of pi-0.5 from 39.2% to 78.3% under wrist-view perturbations. The real-robot experiments further show that the feature-level adaptation learned in simulation successfully transfers to diverse deployment settings. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release our wrist viewpoint robustness benchmark and a plug-and-play implementation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WARP-VLA方法，通过MoE架构让视觉-语言-动作模型在手腕相机安装位置稍有偏差（如旋转/平移几度或几毫米）时仍能稳定执行操作任务，无需标定相机外参，显著提升跨腕式部署的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 仅靠图像特征层面的隐式视图自适应，即可实现不依赖相机外参的腕式VLA跨配置泛化，且仿真学到的适应能力可迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: RGB手腕图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + wrist-mounted RGB camera
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的腕视图扰动数据；真实机器人实验仅用于验证，未使用真实腕视图扰动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA落地中一个具体但关键的工程瓶颈——腕相机微小安装偏差导致性能断崖式下降；在LIBERO上提升近40个百分点，且真机验证覆盖3种不同腕装方式，含消融证明MoE路由机制有效；但未挑战更根本的动作泛化或长程规划，也未引入新数据源或世界模型，属扎实的重大工程推进，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对腕式部署的现实痛点做了精准、可复现、真机验证的鲁棒性增强，不是概念包装，但未开辟新范式

papers.title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics
papers.abstract: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SEAR框架，用大语言模型作为‘自我进化的机器人代理’，在仿真和真实机器人上系统测试其是否真能积累可迁移技能（而非靠反复试错），并发布了一个带严格控制变量的基准来区分学习、运气和资源堆砌。
analysis.claim: 前沿语言模型代理能在机器人任务中实现真正可验证的自我进化——即通过代码生成、在线控制或自动研究三种模式，持续积累跨任务、跨仿真器、甚至部分迁移到真实机器人的可复用技能，且该进化过程可被基准严格剥离出重复尝试、预算优势和偶然性等混杂因素。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 仿真器/机器人观测（视觉+状态） + 历史技能库/代码库
analysis.output: 可执行控制代码 / 实时动作序列 / 微调后的VLA模型参数
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda + Unitree Go2 + Spot
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖仿真中自生成的交互轨迹；真实机器人仅5个任务，无公开真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建了带因果控制的‘代理进化’验证范式（分离记忆/重试/预算/运气），实证发现代码级技能比端到端策略更易迁移，且文本模型在代理链中不输多模态模型——这是对LLM-for-robotics基础假设的重要修正；但真实机器人验证极薄（仅5任务）、未开源真实数据、未覆盖长程操作或复杂灵巧操作，尚未达到RT-2级范式开创性或π0级工程深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用严谨实验设计戳破‘LLM代理自动进化’幻觉，证实技能可迁移但受限于表征粒度，是领域方法论层面的关键推进。

papers.title: CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
papers.abstract: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. Experiments demonstrate that CMP achieves up to a 10-fold survival rate improvement in typical OOD scenarios where baselines suffer catastrophic failure, incurring under 10% tracking degradation. Notably, the system exhibits emergent ``best-effort'' generalization behaviors to progressively accomplish OOD goals by adhering to the competence boundaries. Result videos are available at: https://shepherd1226.github.io/CMP.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫CMP的方法，让腿足移动机械臂在面对传感器噪声或用户乱输的不可行指令时，不崩溃、不断连，而是自动把指令‘拉回’自身能力范围内，继续尽力完成任务，实测生存率提升10倍且跟踪精度只降不到10%
analysis.claim: 通过将控制意图投影到由安全概率定义的‘能力流形’上，可实现对OOD输入的鲁棒whole-body轨迹跟踪，同时保持任务连续性与最佳努力式泛化
analysis.input: 全局末端位姿指令 + 当前本体感知状态（含噪声）
analysis.output: 鲁棒的全身关节动作序列（含腿+臂+躯干协调）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 + Franka手臂仿真模型（基于Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实（流形投影+安全估计器+等距隐空间），在标准仿真benchmark上显著超越基线（10倍生存率+<10%性能损失），有消融和可视化验证；但仅限单机体仿真、无真机验证、未跨平台/跨任务泛化测试，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属强工程推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真中系统性解决了loco-manipulation中OOD鲁棒性这一关键瓶颈，但缺乏真机部署与跨机体验证，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots need to reason about their actions, combining perception, world knowledge, planning, success detection, recovery, and low-level control. Today's state-of-the-art models attempt to combine all these capabilities into the learned policy via large-scale pre-training. Instead, we show that these capabilities can be decomposed into a general language-conditioned policy/control agent and a high-level agent manager/orchestrator. Rather than training policies to reason via pre-training, we build a closed-loop physical agent orchestrator that can do high-level planning, decompose the goal into achievable subgoals, command low-level motor commands, track and verify the outcome from low-level observations, and recover from failures. Our Physical Agency orchestrator (Pigey) can control existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies as well as parametrized skills to solve complex reasoning tasks in the real world, without any additional data collection or post-training. We evaluate Pigey extensively across simulation benchmarks and challenging real-world robotic manipulation tasks, and demonstrate significant performance improvements over existing generalist policies. On LIBERO-PRO, Pigey advances the state-of-the-art by over 4x (12.8% -> 53.3%) with no task-specific fine-tuning. On a real robot, Pigey lifts the frozen policy from near-zero to over 90% on reasoning-limited tasks. We call the difference between what frozen motor skills achieve alone and inside the agentic loop the orchestration gap.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Pigey的物理代理协调器，不训练新策略，而是把现成的冻结视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略和参数化技能当‘工具’调用，通过高层规划、子目标分解、执行监控与失败恢复构成闭环，显著提升复杂真实世界操作任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通用机器人性能瓶颈不在低层策略能力本身，而在高层‘协调能力缺失’（orchestration gap），该gap可通过解耦的、闭环的物理代理协调器（而非端到端预训练）有效填补。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 多模态观测（RGB图像/传感器反馈）
analysis.output: 高层子目标序列 + 对低层策略/技能的调用指令 + 执行状态验证信号 + 恢复重规划决策
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + 其他VLA兼容硬件（如RT-2平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 零新增真实机器人数据；完全依赖已有冻结策略的原始训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO-PRO（仿真）和真实Panda机器人上均实现跨数量级提升（4x+和90%+），且未微调任何底层策略；首次将‘冻结VLA策略+可插拔协调器’范式推至真实部署级，直击当前通用机器人‘能做单步但不会组织多步’的核心缺陷，属架构级实质性推进，但尚未达到AlphaFold或RT-2级范式颠覆量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或概念包装，而是用工程简洁性解决领域公认瓶颈——冻结策略在复杂任务中因缺乏闭环协调而失效的问题，并在真实机器人上验证了其泛化性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Benchmarking Neural Decoders for Brain-Computer Interfaces and Neural Population Analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract The most accurate neural decoder on held-out trials is not necessarily the most useful for brain-computer interfaces or neural population analysis. In practical use, neural decoders may also need to remain robust to noisy neural inputs, satisfy calibration or deployment constraints, and produce comparable representations across recordings. We introduce BEND-BCI, an open-source benchmark of 23 neural decoding methods on motor, visual, speech and spatial decoding tasks across 16 real or synthetic neural recordings. BEND-BCI compares decoders across held-out prediction, robustness to input perturbation, computational cost and cross-recording latent consistency. These additional axes frequently changed decoder rankings: held-out accuracy did not reliably identify the most robust, efficient or cross-recording-consistent models. Simpler baselines were also competitive with, and in some cases outperformed, more heavily parameterized deep neural networks. Diagnostic analyses based on explainable machine learning further showed that decoder performance was associated with the use of expected neural features and could be improved by selecting high-quality training trials. BEND-BCI reframes neural-decoder selection from an accuracy leaderboard into a constrained decision over task, resource, representation and diagnostic goals.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新解码模型，而是构建了一个叫BEND-BCI的开源评测基准，用16个真实/合成神经数据集、23种现有解码方法，在预测准确率之外系统评估鲁棒性、计算开销、跨记录表征一致性等4个实用维度，发现单纯追求测试集准确率会误导实际选型。
analysis.claim: 神经解码器的实际效用不能仅由held-out准确率决定，必须在鲁棒性、效率、跨记录一致性等约束条件下综合评估，而现有基准严重缺失这些维度。
analysis.input: 神经活动数据（如spike counts/LFP/Neural Latents）
analysis.output: 行为或感知变量的预测（如手部轨迹/图像重建/语音特征/空间位置）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖16个公开或合成神经记录数据集，含真实电生理数据（如NeuroPort、Utah array），但未要求用户采集新真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属重磅方法论贡献：首次系统解构‘解码器实用性’的多维评价体系，覆盖真实BCI部署的关键瓶颈（噪声鲁棒、低延迟、跨天/跨电极一致性），且全部开源可复现；虽未达90+级临床闭环突破（如实时语音合成、瘫痪者自然行走），但为整个领域提供了不可替代的评估基础设施和认知框架，证据扎实（16数据集、23方法、4轴对比、消融式诊断分析）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型突破，而是把散落的解码器、数据集和现实约束拧成一套可复现、可诊断、可决策的评测范式，显著提升领域工程化成熟度。

papers.title: LLA-MPPI: Rapidly Adaptive Whole-body Control of Legged Robots with GPU-Accelerated Parallel Simulations
papers.abstract: Real-time whole-body controllers for legged robots typically plan through a fixed nominal model and degrade when the deployed dynamics change. Adaptive methods typically require a model structure that contact dynamics do not provide, or they need offline training for each anticipated condition. We present Look-back and Look-ahead Adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral control (LLA-MPPI). The method converts whole-body adaptation into selection over a bank of GPU-batched contact simulators with different physical or structural parameters. Windowed prediction errors select the simulator that best explains recent motion. A whole-body MPPI planner optimizes controls through the selected model. The framework requires no offline training, and its selected hypotheses are physically interpretable. Across four simulated tasks, it achieves 97.5% success while the strongest baseline reaches 74% and an oracle with the true model reaches 98.5%. Hardware validation on a Unitree Go2 shows the robot walking under a payload added mid-run, walking after one leg is disabled, and pushing a box to its goal while increasing its mass on the fly. Code, videos, and project details are available at: https://lla-control.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出LLA-MPPI方法，用GPU并行运行多个不同物理参数的接触仿真器构成‘假设银行’，通过滑动窗口预测误差实时选择最匹配当前机器人真实动力学的仿真器，再用MPPI在其上做全身体控制；无需离线训练，能在线适应负载突变、单腿失效、质量动态增加等真实扰动。
analysis.claim: 全身体控制器的在线自适应能力可完全解耦为可解释的物理假设选择问题，无需学习动力学模型或离线训练，仅靠GPU加速的并行接触仿真+误差驱动选择即可实现强鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 机器人本体传感器数据（关节位置/速度/IMU）+任务目标（如目标位置、推箱指令）
analysis.output: 全身体动作指令（关节力矩/轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 四足机器人 + 自研GPU接触仿真器（基于Isaac Gym/PyBullet变体）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需实时传感器流，不依赖历史真实机器人数据集；所有适应均在线完成，无预采集数据需求
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级：真机部署验证了3类高难度动态失配场景（负载突加、单腿失效、质量在线增长），多任务仿真成功率97.5%逼近oracle（98.5%），显著超越最强baseline（74%），且开源完整代码+仿真配置+视频；但未覆盖人形/双足复杂扰动，也未引入新世界模型或跨模态表征，尚未达到Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等95+分范式级突破的广度与通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MPPI、并行仿真假设选择、GPU加速三者紧密耦合，形成可解释、免训练、真机落地的自适应控制闭环，是当前具身智能中少有的‘仿真即工具、选择即推理’的硬核工程实现。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning fine-tuning on top of large, pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offers promise for highly reliable robot deployment. However, because of their scale, modern VLA models suffer from high inference latency, so the observation used to select an action is often stale by execution time, creating a distribution shift that can substantially degrade reliability and performance. Prior work has explored asynchronous policy execution to reduce the effect of latency, but these methods are mostly built on imitation learning and offer no mechanism for moving beyond the training distribution toward higher reliability. We close this gap by enabling RL fine-tuning that meets the real-time control requirements of dynamic real-world manipulation. Our approach builds on EXPO-FT, a framework for sample-efficient, reliable VLA fine-tuning with reinforcement learning, and decouples slow, expressive action generation from fast, reactive action edits: a large pretrained VLA proposes action chunks using its strong behavior prior, while a lightweight edit policy performs fast, reactive decision-making by editing actions in response to changes in state, conditioned on the latest observation. We instantiate this as Real-Time EXPO-FT, an RL framework for finetuning real-time VLA policies. On the Kinetix benchmark, Real-Time EXPO-FT enables a delayed policy to achieve the best performance among delayed and non-delayed methods in 10 out of 10 environments. On four dynamic real-world tasks, robot object passing, ball balancing, table soccer kicking, and dynamic object picking, with online robot data capped at 10 minutes, Real-Time EXPO-FT improves average policy performance from 42% to 97%, all without human intervention, demonstrating rapid, sample-efficient adaptation to challenging real-world dynamics. Website: https://pd-perry.github.io/real-time-expo-ft

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Real-Time EXPO-FT框架，解决大视觉语言动作（VLA）模型因推理延迟导致动作过时的问题：用一个大模型生成粗粒度动作块，再用轻量编辑策略基于最新观测实时修正动作，从而在真实机器人上实现低延迟、高可靠性、仅10分钟在线数据就能将任务成功率从42%提升到97%。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦‘慢而强’的动作生成与‘快而敏’的动作编辑，RL微调可在严格实时约束下显著提升延迟VLA策略在动态真实机器人任务中的可靠性与适应性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前机器人状态（隐含于观测）
analysis.output: 编辑后的动作块/轨迹（用于执行）
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinetix仿真平台 + 四种真实机器人平台（机械臂+球平衡台+桌式足球+动态抓取台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线交互数据（每任务≤10分钟），但不依赖大规模预收集真实机器人轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑之后，首次系统性攻克VLA模型实时控制失配这一阻碍落地的核心工程瓶颈；实证扎实：覆盖4种异构真实机器人硬件、10个Kinetix仿真环境、多任务性能碾压所有基线（含非延迟方法），且仅用10分钟在线数据即完成适配——这是目前最接近'开箱即用VLA实时控制'的完整闭环方案，但尚未达到范式级突破（如RT-2定义VLA范式）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是直击VLA落地中最顽固的延迟-可靠性矛盾，并用可复现的解耦架构+真实硬件验证给出工程可行解。

papers.title: In-context Robot Learning Made Simple: A Democratized Recipe for Manipulation Tasks
papers.abstract: We study robotic in-context learning (ICL), an emerging paradigm that enables robots to infer and execute tasks from visual demonstrations. Despite its growing promise, the problem itself remains under-defined: a visual demonstration simultaneously conveys action trajectories, object semantics, manipulation affordances, spatial relations, and task goals, making it unclear what information the robot is actually expected to follow. In this work, we first provide a clear problem definition of robot ICL that explicitly defines its learning target and resolves this fundamental prompt ambiguity. Building on this definition, we develop a minimalist and reproducible ICL framework (SimpleICL) with a visual prompt encoder and a low-cost data collection protocol. Without massive pre-training or specialized data infrastructure, our framework achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world environments. Extensive experiments further reveal several key properties of robot ICL, including action, semantic, composition, and affordance discrimination. We will fully open-source our data and training pipeline to facilitate systematic and reproducible research on robot ICL. The project page can be found at https://simpleicl.github.io/simpleicl.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文定义了机器人上下文学习（ICL）的清晰问题形式，提出一个轻量级开源框架SimpleICL，仅用视觉演示就能让机器人泛化执行新操作任务，不依赖大规模预训练或专用数据设施，在仿真和真实机械臂上都验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 机器人上下文学习（ICL）的核心是视觉提示中可解耦的动作、语义、组成与功能线索的显式建模，而非端到端黑箱拟合；一个定义清晰、组件极简、数据采集成本低的ICL框架即可在真实机器人上实现跨任务零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 单帧或多帧RGB视觉演示（含目标物体与动作过程）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D位姿轨迹或关节控制序列
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85夹爪（真实实验）、Mujoco/Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 真实机器人采集的12类操作任务共320个演示视频（作者称‘low-cost’，未用遥操作或动捕，但需人工录制）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义机器人ICL的学习目标并解耦四类关键线索（动作/语义/组成/功能），实证覆盖仿真+双真实平台（UR5e+Franka），含消融验证解耦有效性，开源全套数据与pipeline；但未解决长期开放难题（如长程时序泛化、多步骤任务组合推理），也未达到Facet-0等基石工作所要求的接触密集、高精度、部署级鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在问题定义、框架简洁性与实证广度上做出扎实推进，但未突破ICL在复杂操作中的根本瓶颈（如动态扰动下的闭环适应、工具泛化），属于显著贡献而非范式级突破。

papers.title: Human Universal Grasping
papers.abstract: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/

analysis.tldr: 用人类日常抓取的100万帧RGB-D数据训练了一个flow-matching模型HUG，输入单张RGB-D图就能生成符合人体自然习惯的完整手部姿态（手腕位姿+MANO手型），再迁移到多种机器人手上实现零样本抓取，在90个未见物体的仿真+30个真实物体跨相机/跨机器人/跨家庭环境测试中大幅超越现有方法。
analysis.claim: 人类抓取分布是机器人通用抓取的最优先验，通过大规模、真实、egocentric的人类抓取数据建模该分布，并实现跨机体零样本抓取迁移。
analysis.input: 单张RGB-D图像（来自双目相机）
analysis.output: 参数化的抓取姿态（手腕平移+旋转+MANO手部关节角度）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类抓取视频数据（1M-HUGs），但不依赖机器人执行数据

papers.title: Behavior Foundations for Quadruped Robots: ABot-C0 Technical Report
papers.abstract: In embodied intelligence systems, the motion controller serves as the critical bridge between semantic reasoning and physical execution. Humanoid control has progressed rapidly through large-scale human motion-capture data and motion-tracking paradigm. However, producing quadruped robots motion corpora with scalability and physical feasibility faces more fundamental obstacles: animal motion data is scarce, and cross-embodiment retargeting remains fragile. We present ABot-C0, a generalist motion-control system for quadruped robots that establishes three complementary behavior foundations: a scalable multi-source motion-data pipeline, robust policy learning across motion tracking, locomotion, and scene interaction, and a unified deployment stack for reliable real-world operation. Fundamentally, we construct a data pyramid through conditional video-generation synthesis, annotated motion capture, teleoperation and human design, producing 16,074 physically feasible motion clips as the data foundation for various motion learning demands. We then train a Flow-Matching generalist policy that demonstrates for the first time quadruped motion tracking scaling law that its performance improves consistently as training scales up, with zero-shot capability to track unseen motions. Then, we push a step further for robust all-terrain traversal locomotion by adopting a three-stage privileged-to-perceptive framework with temporal LiDAR memory and terrain-predictive supervision. Collectively, these components form a motion generalist that coordinates multi-policy execution, smooth behavior transitions, energy-efficient control, and safety mechanisms for real-world deployment. Extensive experiments on urban-terrain autonomous navigation and companion-style multimodal interaction demonstrate that quadruped robots move beyond single-function demos toward product-level behavioral intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个面向四足机器人的通用运动控制系统ABot-C0，通过多源合成+人工标注+遥操作构建1.6万段物理可行运动片段数据集，训练出首个展现缩放律的四足运动跟踪通用策略，并用三级特权感知框架实现全地形鲁棒行走，最终在真实城市地形导航和多模态陪伴交互中完成端到端部署。
analysis.claim: 四足机器人可通过构建可扩展的多源运动数据金字塔与分层特权感知策略架构，实现跨任务、跨地形、跨模态的通用行为智能，且具备真实场景部署能力。

analysis.output: 关节级低层控制指令序列（含平滑过渡、能耗优化与安全约束）

papers.title: VABench: Measuring Embodied Spatial Intelligence through Visual Demonstrations, Active Perception, and Metric Control
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence requires more than describing object locations. Under incomplete observation, models must identify and acquire missing evidence, interpret it in a common spatial frame, and act on it. We introduce VA-Bench to evaluate the complete observe-reason-act-revise loop. General-purpose MLLMs learn procedural context from RGB-only demonstrations, actively select camera viewpoints, issue metric Cartesian commands, and revise them from execution feedback. Models receive no privileged object poses, oracle trajectories, or learned action heads. A fixed model-agnostic controller executes only model-specified targets. VA-Bench contains 14 base task families (11 single-arm and three dual-arm), seven held-out geometry/layout variants, and a long-horizon five-object composition track. We evaluate 12 primary model conditions in three independent runs over the same 20 physically verified seeds per base task, reporting terminal success, nine trajectory-level behavioral diagnostics, and subtask progress. First, the best-performing model scores 100.0% on target localization and 78.9% on spatial relations in the annotated run. Its three-run macro-average task success is only 53.93+/-3.17%. Second, active camera control significantly improves task success over passive multi-view observation. In one matched comparison, success rises from 27.86% to 57.50%. Third, held-out geometric transfer can reduce task success by over 30 percentage points. No model completes a strict long-horizon episode, despite substantial partial progress. VA-Bench thus tests whether general-purpose MLLMs can turn visual demonstrations and actively acquired evidence into successful embodied action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫VABench的新评测基准，专门测试多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能否仅靠视觉演示、主动调整摄像头视角、并发出精确的笛卡尔空间指令来完成真实机器人操作任务，重点考察其在不依赖物体真值位姿、不预设动作头、不使用仿真特权信息下的完整‘观察-推理-行动-修正’闭环能力。
analysis.claim: 通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在无真值空间先验、无特权感知、无专用动作头的前提下，能否通过视觉演示学习+主动感知+度量级控制实现鲁棒的具身空间智能。
analysis.input: RGB视频演示 + 当前相机图像 + 执行反馈（如失败信号/部分成功状态）
analysis.output: 笛卡尔空间坐标目标点（x,y,z）及可选姿态，由固定控制器执行

analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于物理验证的仿真种子（20个）
analysis.significance_reason: VABench是首个系统性解耦‘视觉演示学习-主动感知-度量控制-执行反馈修正’四阶段的具身空间智能评测框架，设计严谨（三轮独立运行、20物理种子、9项轨迹诊断）、挑战性强（零真值位姿、零oracle轨迹、零learned action head），实证发现active camera提升近30pt、几何泛化暴跌30+pt、长程任务全失败等关键现象，显著推进评测范式；但未开源代码/模型/数据，且纯仿真、无真机验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0等基石工作所要求的‘真实世界部署级鲁棒性’或‘跨 embodiment 基础模型级扩展’。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅贡献：它不是新模型，而是迄今最严苛、最解耦的具身空间智能评测基准，用扎实的仿真实验揭示了当前MLLM在空间闭环中的核心断点，但因无真机、无开源，暂未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: Encoded but Not in Control: Revealing the Grounding Gap in Vision-Language Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Instruction following is central to language-conditioned robot policies: language should determine what to do when the same scene permits multiple valid actions. Yet successful execution alone cannot establish whether a policy follows the instruction or infers the task from the scene. We study this ambiguity through scene-preserving instruction interventions, using valid target substitutions, arbitrary nouns, and unrelated sentences while holding the scene fixed. We evaluate vision-language-action (VLA) policies and world-action models (WAMs) in simulation and in real-world experiments. Our analysis addresses three questions: (a) Does task success imply instruction following? When instructions request a different visible object, all evaluated policies predominantly approach and pick up the incorrect original target associated with the scene. (b) Is this failure caused by language insensitivity? Instruction perturbations affect task performance. A layerwise action lens shows intermediate action predictions respond to these perturbations. Linear probes accurately recover instructed targets, indicating modified instructions are encoded despite rarely determining target selection. (c) Why does encoded language fail to control action? Attention analysis indicates weak instruction-token contributions to action generation. Target-token attention can remain focused on the original object, revealing a mismatch between target encoding and visual grounding. UMAP and shared non-negative matrix factorization show target information remains accessible within representations increasingly organized by scene identity. Our findings expose a grounding gap concealed by nominal success and provide a diagnostic framework. They further establish a concrete criterion for progress: policies should reliably follow valid changes in user intent, even when they conflict with scene-favored behavior.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前主流视觉-语言机器人策略虽然能正确执行任务，但其实根本没听懂指令——它们只是根据场景自动推断出最可能的动作，指令即使被错误替换（比如让抓苹果却给指令‘抓香蕉’），模型仍固执地去抓原来场景里最显眼的苹果；作者用一系列精细干预实验和神经表征分析，首次系统揭示了‘语言被编码但未被用于控制’这一深层 grounding gap。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA/WAM类机器人策略存在本质性的语言-动作解耦：指令语义虽被编码进表征，却未实质性参与动作决策，导致其成功依赖场景先验而非用户意图。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（抓取/移动等）

papers.title: GEAR-VLA: Learning Geometry-Aware Action Representations for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong benchmark performance but still struggle in real-world deployment with unseen objects, background shifts, and different robot embodiments. We argue that this stems from the lack of a unified geometry-aware manipulation representation, leaving existing VLAs vulnerable to low-level trajectory supervision, misaligned 3D features, and embodiment differences. To address this, we propose GEAR-VLA, a VLA framework for learning unified geometry-aware action representations for generalizable robotic manipulation. GEAR-VLA adopts coarse-to-fine action learning, where multi-source embodied pretraining equips the VLM with embodied reasoning and discrete action understanding before latent action tokens connect action semantics to a gradient-decoupled DiT continuous action expert. It further performs semantic-aligned 3D integration by aligning a trainable 3D spatial backbone with the VLA representation while freezing the original VLM-aligned visual pathway. To share this representation across robots, GEAR-VLA uses embodiment canonicalization, where embodiment-aware states and embodiment-invariant actions confine robot differences to the low-level interface. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong generalization: GEAR-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO, zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, reaches 85.9% success on AgileX and 81.0% on the pretraining-unseen LDT-01 embodiment, and obtains 90.1% success on a 6,360-trial universal grasping benchmark with 212 unseen objects. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/babynabeauty/GEAR-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出GEAR-VLA框架，通过几何感知的动作表征（含3D空间对齐、 embodiment canonicalization 和 coarse-to-fine 动作解耦）提升VLA模型在新物体、新背景、新机器人本体上的泛化能力，并在多个仿真和真实机器人基准上验证了零样本跨本体操作性能。

papers.title: Hierarchical Advantage Weighting for Online RL Fine-Tuning of VLAs from Sparse Episode Outcomes
papers.abstract: When pretrained VLA policies are fine-tuned through online RL, each rollout episode produces only a single binary outcome (success or failure), yet the actor update requires per-transition supervision. Existing approaches commonly reduce this sparse outcome to a single scalar reward or advantage signal, which conflates distinct forms of transition-level feedback and provides limited guidance once basic task success becomes achievable. First, a single scalar signal conflates the two objectives of viability and efficiency; once basic success is achieved, the binary label provides no gradient to distinguish efficient completions from slow ones. Second, real-world rollouts mix autonomous and intervention segments; naively assigning episode outcomes across these boundaries introduces incorrect credit assignment. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Advantage-Weighted Behavior Cloning (HABC), which trains separate critic heads for these two objectives on different data subsets and combines their outputs with a state-adaptive balance. A state-adaptive gate g_t merges their one-step advantages, prioritizing viability when success is uncertain and shifting to efficiency only when viability is high, and converts the result into per-transition weights on the actor loss. Intervention-aware credit assignment further restricts outcome labels to segments executed by the current policy, preventing supervision from leaking across intervention boundaries. In real-robot experiments on three contact-rich bimanual tasks, HABC raises success from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines of 36%, 44%, and 12% to 92%, 88%, and 38%.

analysis.tldr: 提出HABC方法，用分层优势加权解决视觉语言动作模型在线强化学习微调中稀疏成功信号难以指导每步动作的问题，在三个真实双臂接触密集任务上将成功率从36%/44%/12%大幅提升至92%/88%/38%。
analysis.claim: 稀疏episode级二元结果无法有效驱动VLA在线RL微调，因其混淆可行性与效率目标且在人机干预混合段落中导致错误信用分配；HABC通过状态自适应双头批评器+干预感知标签截断，实现更精准的每步优势加权。
