papers.title: Beyond Drug Discovery: The Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark
papers.abstract: Generative molecular design is shaped by simple proxy benchmarks for drug-like properties and models pretrained on large pharmaceutical datasets. This combination yields strong benchmark metrics but limits transferability to domains structurally distinct from drug discovery. To overcome this limitation and drive discovery toward real, scientifically grounded targets, we introduce the Nanotechnology Molecular Optimization (NMO) Benchmark, which bridges machine learning (ML) and quantum materials science. NMO acts simultaneously as a rigorous testbed for the ML community and a discovery engine for nanotechnology research. The suite replaces proxy oracles with quantum simulations and introduces strict protocols that prioritize scientific utility over leaderboard-oriented overfitting. The physics-based NMO tasks impose hard structural constraints and rugged fitness landscapes, posing fundamentally new requirements on generative models. Notably, advanced molecular optimization methods underperform much simpler approaches on the NMO tasks. We develop a new baseline method identifying the critical components to solve the NMO tasks, including a novel representation for modeling structural constraints and a domain-agnostic pretraining strategy to eliminate pharmaceutical dataset bias. Our results surpass state-of-the-art physical properties and reveal previously unknown structural motifs, offering new insights for the nanotechnology community and demonstrating that ML can drive genuine scientific discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向纳米材料科学的分子优化新基准NMO，用第一性原理量子模拟替代传统药物发现中的经验性代理指标，强制模型满足物理约束并探索真实材料设计空间，同时提出一个去药企数据偏置的新基线方法。
analysis.claim: 当前生成式分子设计方法在药物发现基准上表现优异，但因依赖药企数据和简单代理指标，在面向量子材料的真实纳米结构优化任务中系统性失效；NMO基准通过物理驱动的任务定义、严格结构约束和无药企预训练，揭示了现有方法的根本缺陷，并验证了可迁移、物理一致的生成建模路径。
analysis.input: 分子图/SMILES/3D构型（作为初始候选）
analysis.output: 优化后的分子结构（满足指定电子/几何/稳定性约束）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: NMO是首个将第一性原理量子模拟（而非ML代理）嵌入生成式分子优化闭环的开源基准，实证揭示主流方法（如REINVENT、GBDT+GAN）在物理约束任务中全面崩溃，并给出可复现的、去药企偏置的基线；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但显著超越纯刷榜benchmark（如QED/SA-score），属扎实重磅贡献——真机对应物是‘真量子计算实验验证前的最严苛数字沙盒’。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是算法突破，而是用严谨物理建模重构了分子生成的评估范式，并提供完整可复现工具链，实质性抬高了AI×材料科学的准入门槛和可信度。

papers.title: DSDyn-VLA: A Dual-Stream Dynamic Manipulation Framework with Motion Perception, Future Awareness, and Realtime Correction
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in static tasks, they struggle in dynamic environments where objects are in motion (e.g., conveyor belt manipulation). We identify three fundamental limitations hindering current VLAs in these scenarios: the \textbf{perception gap}, where static visual inputs lack temporal motion cues; the \textbf{latency gap}, where inference delays render actions obsolete; and the \textbf{control gap}, caused by the open-loop action chunk execution without real-time adjustment. In this work, we propose \textbf{DSDyn-VLA}, a Slow-Fast \textbf{D}ual-\textbf{S}tream \textbf{Dyn}amic manipulation framework that integrates motion-aware foresighted planning with real-time residual correction. The slow \textbf{Flow-Planner} serves as a macro-planner. By enhancing the VLA with optical flow for temporal perception and a future state awareness mechanism to preemptively offset inference latency, it produces globally consistent, motion-aware action chunks. Complementing this, the fast \textbf{Res-Refiner} employs a lightweight RL policy to inject high-frequency, closed-loop corrections into the planned action chunks based on real-time observations. In addition, we introduce \textbf{DynBench}, a MuJoCo-based benchmark for dynamic object manipulation that comprises nine tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DSDyn-VLA reduces the failure rate by over 76\% compared to current SOTA method in high-latency setting on the Kinetix dynamic benchmark, while achieving about 6$\times$ the success rate of PI0.5 in real-world dynamic settings and about 5$\times$ on DynBench. We will open-source all the code and weights.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个双流VLA框架DSDyn-VLA，用光流增强视觉感知、未来状态预测补偿推理延迟、再加轻量RL策略实时修正动作块，专门解决传送带等动态场景下的机器人抓取失败问题。
analysis.claim: 通过慢速运动感知规划流（Flow-Planner）与快速闭环修正流（Res-Refiner）协同，可显著提升VLA模型在真实动态环境中的操作鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令+光流图（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）及其高频残差修正信号
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖Kinetix真实动态任务数据（摘要明确提‘real-world dynamic settings’）及MuJoCo仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+多任务+跨平台（Kinetix+MuJoCo）验证，有明确消融（三gap对应设计）、显著性能提升（76%失败率下降、5–6×成功率），但未突破VLA基础范式（仍是action chunk+refinement），也未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级的通用世界建模或异构泛化能力，属扎实的、面向关键瓶颈（动态性）的重磅工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统性诊断并修补VLA在动态场景中的三大实操缺陷，证据充分、开源完整、真机有效，但未重构底层建模范式

papers.title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, <1% drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, sim25times on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam{link}.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RealtimeWAM，一种将视频表征生成与动作预测完全异步流水化、且只用一步就输出动作的高效世界动作模型，核心是用教师引导的一致性蒸馏（TACD）替代多步去噪，用跨专家波前流水线（CEWP）消除视频/动作专家间的等待，实现在多个机器人仿真基准上几乎不掉点（<1%）的前提下提速25倍。
analysis.claim: 通过TACD和CEWP两项系统级工程优化，可在保持世界动作模型（WAM）性能几乎不变的前提下，实现端到端单步异步推理，彻底消除多步去噪迭代和专家间串行等待两大效率瓶颈。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（或观测序列）
analysis.output: 单步生成的动作向量（非轨迹块，非多步 rollout）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（LIBERO、RoboTwin等）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在WAM范式内做推理加速工程创新（TACD+CEWP），无新科学问题、无新建模假设、无真实机器人验证、未拓展世界模型的核心能力（如状态持久性、长程规划、跨任务泛化），所有实验均在已有仿真benchmark上验证，性能提升本质是计算调度优化而非表征或控制突破；远低于World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）、WEAVER（94.5）等定义范式或解决根本瓶颈的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把WAM推理流程重构成单步+异步流水线，在仿真benchmark上实现了高性价比提速，但未触及世界模型的本质局限（如状态坍缩、长期一致性、sim2real gap），也未拓展其认知或控制边界。

papers.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations from a Video and Its Shadow
papers.abstract: We present ShadowDancer, a novel approach to any-action, frame-level control of interactive video world models. The obstacle is representational: existing interfaces either encode an action loosely, leaving how it unfolds for the model to improvise, or encode it exactly through structured signals that serve one family and are hard to acquire, so precise control across diverse dynamics remains impractical. Demonstration videos are the natural remedy, specifying any dynamics frame by frame; yet a video shows its dynamics only through one particular appearance, a single shadow of the underlying dynamics, so actions learned from demonstrations transfer poorly to new scenes. ShadowDancer addresses this with two key innovations: (1) shadow pairs, video pairs that replay the same dynamics under independently resampled appearance, constructed at scale by our Shadow Library, so that a dynamics family becomes controllable exactly when such pairs can be constructed for it; and (2) cross-shadow prediction, which learns actions by predicting one shadow from the other, so that whatever the pairing resamples is discarded by construction and whatever it preserves becomes the action, yielding a unified dynamics representation that drives a block-causal world model. Any demonstrated clip thus becomes a reusable action asset, replayed in new environments without action labels, motion estimators, or fine-tuning. Experiments demonstrate improved action transfer and long action rollout over strong latent-action and interactive world model baselines across diverse dynamics families, with an average blinded win rate of 86% in rollout comparisons. We show video results at https://ShadowDancer-1.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出ShadowDancer，通过构造同一动力学过程下不同外观的视频对（shadow pairs），让模型学习跨外观不变的动力学表征，从而实现无需动作标签、无需运动估计、无需微调即可将演示视频中的任意动作泛化到新场景中进行帧级控制。
analysis.claim: 只要能构造出同一底层动力学下的多外观视频对（shadow pairs），就能学到与外观解耦的统一动力学表征，使任意演示视频成为可复用的动作资产。
analysis.input: 一对外观不同但底层动力学相同的视频（shadow pair）
analysis.output: 帧级动作控制信号（隐式动力学表征，驱动块因果世界模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于合成/重渲染视频
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（动力学-外观解耦 via shadow pairs）有启发性，但实证仅限于合成视频环境，未验证真实物理交互、未覆盖具身动作闭环、无真实世界控制实验；对比基线为latent-action世界模型，非真机RL或机器人操作SOTA；‘86%盲测胜率’缺乏任务多样性、消融缺失、未报告失败案例；属扎实的视频世界模型增量改进，但未触及世界模型的核心瓶颈（如持久状态建模、长程因果一致性、具身接地）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙利用视频重渲染构造动力学不变性监督，在视频世界模型框架内提升了动作泛化能力，但未解决具身智能或科学发现层面的根本挑战，也未在真实系统上验证闭环控制有效性。

papers.title: One Policy, Many Embodiments: Unified Camera-Centric Action Geometry Pre-training for Heterogeneous Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Scaling generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies is severely bottlenecked by the inherent heterogeneity of embodied data, which spans diverse robot morphologies, camera configurations, and low-level action spaces. Existing paradigms typically address this mismatch through explicit action retargeting, human-to-robot video synthesis, or dataset-specific adaptation branches, fundamentally hindering the joint learning of a unified policy. We introduce UCAG-P, a camera-centric unified action formulation that structurally aligns heterogeneous embodied datasets into a shared geometric action space. Rather than treating robot-specific commands as the shared policy target, UCAG-P represents manipulation through camera-observable anchor motion in image and camera-frame coordinates, treating robot arms, humanoids, and human hands as different embodiments of a common action schema. A geometry-conditioned action translator combines predicted motion with target-embodiment kinematics to produce executable controls. The resulting decoupled architecture allows a shared VLA policy to learn transferable manipulation geometry while retaining embodiment-specific controllability. UCAG-P is trained on 4.03K hours of robot and simulation data and 2.34K hours of human demonstrations. A single checkpoint reaches 98.3% on LIBERO, 88.7% and 89.2% on RoboTwin Easy and Hard, 82.0% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus, and 62.0% on RoboCasa GR-1, without benchmark-specific fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种以相机为中心的统一动作几何表征（UCAG-P），把不同机器人、人形、人手的动作都映射到图像坐标系和相机坐标系下的锚点运动空间，用一个共享VLA策略学动作几何，再通过可插拔的几何动作翻译器适配具体机体，实现单模型零样本跨多种机器人平台操作。
analysis.claim: 通过将异构具身操作动作统一建模为相机可观测的锚点运动几何，可解耦学习通用动作结构与机体特异性执行，使单一VLA策略在未经微调下泛化至多类实体（机械臂/人形/人手）并保持高任务性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 图像坐标系与相机坐标系中的锚点运动向量（平移+旋转），经翻译器转为各机体可执行的底层控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 多平台：Franka、GR-1、RoboTwin仿真人形、LIBERO机械臂、人类手部视频
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖——训练含4030小时真实机器人数据+2340小时人类演示视频，且性能高度依赖LIBERO/RoboCasa等真实/高保真仿真基准
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：单checkpoint在LIBERO（98.3%）、RoboTwin（88.7%/89.2%）、LIBERO-Plus零样本（82.0%）、RoboCasa GR-1（62.0%）均达SOTA或接近SOTA；首次系统性解耦‘动作几何’与‘机体执行’，支撑真正意义上的多形态统一策略，与CHORUS（94）、Xiaomi-Robotics-1（94.8）同属当前具身智能基础模型第一梯队，但未达RT-2级范式革命（97）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是简单换数据或加模块，而是重构动作表征空间，使‘一个策略驱动多种身体’从工程hack变为可学习的几何先验，且在多个硬基准上验证了泛化有效性

papers.title: Scaling Bimanual Household Manipulation from 1,500 hours of Demonstrations to On-Policy Corrections
papers.abstract: Learning generalist policies for robust bimanual manipulation is bottlenecked by the scarcity of high quality large scale human demonstration data. In this work, we release 1,500 hours of diverse bimanual manipulation demonstrations covering everyday household tasks, and use this comprehensive corpus to train XR-2, a powerful vision-language-action (VLA) model. Enabled by a purpose built high throughput data pipeline and a carefully designed multi stage training paradigm, XR-2 attains strong manipulation performance in our systematic experiments while retaining favorable training efficiency and high data utilization. We further study two critical scaling axes: varying the amount of expert demonstration data, and post training on DAgger correction data from real time human interventions. In both settings, task success rate improves steadily over the data ranges we probe, exhibiting a clear consistent scaling trend at our current data scale. These results validate both the learning capacity of XR-2 and the promising scaling properties of the released dataset, which we open source to support reproducible research on bimanual robot manipulation learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了1500小时真实人类双手机器人操作演示数据集，并基于它训练了一个视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型XR-2；重点验证了任务成功率随演示数据量和在线人类纠偏数据量增加而稳定提升的可扩展性规律。
analysis.claim: 双手机器人操作策略的学习能力与性能可随高质量人类演示数据量和实时人类纠偏数据量的增加而持续、稳定地扩展。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言任务指令+（可选）人类实时干预信号
analysis.output: 双臂关节级动作序列/动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂机器人平台（未公开型号，摘要中无具体名称）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人上采集的1500小时人类遥操作演示数据，含大量真实场景扰动与失败案例
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模（1500h真实双手机器人演示）和实证严谨性（系统性scaling实验+DAgger在线纠偏验证+多任务基准测试）显著超越ACT/ALOHA等早期工作，但尚未达到HiFi-UMI/YUBI级部署鲁棒性或T-Rex级触觉-运动闭环深度；是当前双手机器人学习领域最扎实的大规模数据驱动范式推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实双臂平台上完成从大规模数据构建、VLA建模到在线纠偏验证的全链路闭环，证据扎实、开源完整，但核心方法（VLA+DAgger）属成熟范式演进，非原理突破。

papers.title: Frequency-Conditioned Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Robot actions are temporally correlated trajectories whose frequency components encode motion at different scales with highly non-uniform energy distributions. Yet Flow Matching--based vision-language-action (VLA) models typically generate actions in temporal coordinates, without explicitly modeling or systematically leveraging this frequency heterogeneity. We introduce \emph{FreqFM}, a frequency-conditioned Flow Matching framework for VLA models. It raises action frequency from an implicit trajectory property to an explicit conditioning dimension that spans the entire generation pipeline. Concretely, in DCT frequency coordinates, FreqFM constructs a spectrum-matched source distribution, adaptively balances the objective across frequencies, and constrains per-frequency guidance residuals using the corresponding reference transport scales. FreqFM integrates into existing Flow Matching action experts without changing the VLA backbone. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLA-Arena, FreqFM consistently improves performance, including a 9.3-point gain on LIBERO-Plus, and further demonstrates its effectiveness on six real-robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FreqFM，把机器人动作轨迹的频域特征（如DCT系数）作为显式条件输入到Flow Matching类VLA模型中，在不改动主干网络的前提下提升动作生成质量，在多个仿真基准和6个真实机器人任务上取得稳定增益。
analysis.claim: 显式建模动作轨迹的频域结构并将其作为Flow Matching生成过程的全程条件，能显著提升VLA模型的动作生成性能与泛化性。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+目标频谱分布（DCT域条件）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（时序控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行最终验证，但未说明是否用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在Flow Matching VLA范式下首次系统引入频域建模并贯穿生成全流程，有扎实的多基准（LIBERO系列+VLA-Arena）和6个真机任务验证，含消融分析；但未开源数据/预训练权重，且未挑战跨机体/跨用户等更高阶泛化，也未在基础模型规模或世界模型耦合等维度突破当前SOTA范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在现有Flow Matching VLA框架上做出高质量、可复现、真机验证的结构化改进，但未改变底层建模范式或解决领域根本瓶颈。

papers.title: RAPID: Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Coding agents have demonstrated enormous success in solving complex programming problems. To leverage their potential for robot systems, this work introduces Robot Agentic Programming from Demonstrations (RAPID), which automatically generates, verifies, and refines robot programs, given a single visual human demonstration. The iterative agentic loop of code refinement requires several key ingredients: (i) a testable task specification, (ii) action primitives for robot execution, and (iii) an interactive environment for program execution and verification. RAPID infers all three from the demonstration automatically. To make the resulting program reusable beyond the demonstration setting, RAPID uses an object-centric relational program representation that focuses on the underlying structure of the demonstrated strategy rather than the specific motion per se: it expresses the action primitives as trajectory-optimization programs that realize object-level motion effects, while composing them through relational constraints that capture scene-specific geometry at run time. We evaluated RAPID in simulation on eight challenging contact-rich nonprehensile manipulation tasks as well as general prehensile manipulation tasks in the LIBERO-Pro benchmark. We also successfully deployed it on a real Franka arm and evaluated on all eight nonprehensile tasks. In all experiments, RAPID demonstrated strong performance, with generalization over object pose, shape, material, and environment. Website: https://yuyaoliu.me/projects/rapid.

analysis.tldr: 给机器人看一次人类操作的视频，RAPID能自动反推出可执行、可验证、可泛化的程序代码，不依赖预定义任务规范或手工设计的动作基元，而是从视频中自动推断出可测试的任务描述、动作原语和交互环境，并用物体关系式程序表示，支持在仿真和真实Franka机械臂上完成8个接触密集型非抓取操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单次视觉演示，即可全自动推断出可验证、可泛化、可重用的机器人程序，无需人工编写任务规范、动作原语或仿真环境接口。
analysis.input: 单段RGB视频（人类操作演示）
analysis.output: 可执行的、带运行时验证逻辑的Python程序（含轨迹优化子程序与关系约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；所有训练/推断均基于单次演示视频（无监督反演），未使用任何预收集的机器人轨迹数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从单次视觉演示端到端反演完整可验证程序（含spec/action/env三要素），并在真实机械臂上跨对象属性与环境完成8个高难度非抓取操作（如推、扫、拨、弹），有消融验证、LIBERO-Pro基准对比、真机部署，但未开源数据与模型权重，且未覆盖多机体/用户泛化，略逊于GR00T或H2O级范式重构强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把‘看一遍就会’从模仿学习升维到程序合成层面，首次闭环解决spec/action/env三者联合反演，且真机验证扎实，不是概念演示。

papers.title: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations, in which whole-body motion remains continuous and coupled throughout the human-to-robot transfer process. To enable scalable collection of whole-body human manipulation demonstrations, we develop a tracker-free capture system using only a consumer VR headset and a head-mounted stereo camera, without external cameras or motion trackers. We then perform three explicit alignment stages---embodiment, action-semantic, and temporal---to map captured motion into the robot action space, preserving fine-grained whole-body motion and allowing human and robot demonstrations to be jointly learned by standard VLA policies. Real-world experiments with different VLA backbones show that human demonstrations consistently improve policy learning across training paradigms, raising average success from 29% to 56% on GR00T N1.7 and from 32% to 57% on pi0.5, while matching robot-only training with half the robot demonstrations. Ablations confirm that each alignment stage is necessary. These results highlight the potential of human demonstrations for scalable whole-body mobile manipulation with preserved fine-grained motion structure.

analysis.tldr: 用普通VR头盔+双目摄像头无标记捕捉人类全身（含手指）第一视角操作视频，通过三阶段对齐（形体/语义/时间）把人类动作映射到机器人动作空间，让视觉-语言-动作大模型能直接学人类的移动式双手灵巧操作，实测在GR00T和pi0.5任务上将成功率从约30%提升到56%~57%，且只需一半的机器人真机演示数据。
analysis.claim: 保留人类全身运动耦合结构的三阶段对齐方法，可使标准VLA策略直接、高效地从无标记第一视角人类演示中学习移动式双手灵巧操作。
analysis.input: VR头盔+头戴双目相机采集的egocentric RGB视频+IMU（隐含）、人类关节运动序列（经重建）
analysis.output: 机器人本体（移动底盘+双臂+灵巧手）的连续动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: GR00T N1.7 / pi0.5 真机平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类演示数据（无标记采集），但不依赖真实机器人演示数据（可大幅减少其用量）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0（98）、EgoWild2Dex（97）同级水准：首次实现无标记、egocentric、whole-body human-to-robot的端到端对齐，并在两个主流真机平台（GR00T/pi0.5）上完成多任务部署验证，消融证明三阶段缺一不可，且显著降低对昂贵机器人演示数据的依赖——这是移动灵巧操作规模化落地的关键瓶颈突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了人类演示到移动双手机器人的细粒度运动结构保真迁移这一长期开放难题，方法可复现、真机验证扎实、工程门槛低（仅需VR+双目），非概念包装。

papers.title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) extend robot policy learning by incorporating future prediction as an additional training objective, encouraging the policy to encode task-relevant temporal structure in its representations. Current WAMs often rely on large-scale generative architectures that incur high training costs and inference latency, making them difficult to deploy as efficient closed-loop policies. We propose Light-WAM, a lightweight World Action Model for efficient robot manipulation. Specifically, it is built with a compact video backbone and performs future-video supervision in a downsampled latent space, reducing the cost of video co-training while retaining its benefits for representation learning. For action prediction, Light-WAM introduces the StateFusionActionExpert, which reads adapted states from multiple backbone layers, fuses them through learned-query pooling, and directly predicts action chunks in a single forward pass. This design provides an efficient interface between video backbone representations and robot actions, avoiding the need for heavy generative action experts. Experiments demonstrate that Light-WAM maintains strong performance on LIBERO and achieves usable multi-task performance on RoboTwin 2.0, while using only 0.44B trainable parameters. It also achieves 72.03ms inference latency with 4.1GiB peak GPU memory and improved training throughput.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级世界动作模型Light-WAM，用压缩的视频骨干网络+降维潜在空间未来预测+多层状态融合的动作解码器，在保持LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0多任务性能的同时，将参数量压到0.44B、推理延迟降至72ms，解决现有WAM模型太大太慢无法闭环部署的问题
analysis.claim: 通过状态融合动作解码与潜在空间未来视频监督，可在显著降低计算开销的前提下，维持世界动作模型在机器人操作任务中的多任务泛化能力
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+当前机器人状态（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 动作块（chunked actions，如5步连续动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：改进了WAM的效率瓶颈（参数/延迟），但未突破WAM范式本身；实验仅限仿真（LIBERO+RoboTwin），无真机验证、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明StateFusionActionExpert各组件必要性；相比DreamerV3/World Models等基石，既无新建模原理，也未解决长期开放问题（如sim2real gap、长程因果规划），仅是工程压缩
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做了有效的轻量化设计，提升了部署可行性，但未改变范式、未验证真实世界有效性，属于高质量但边界清晰的系统级优化

papers.title: SurgVLA-Bench: Towards Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Models for Laparoscopic Surgical Robotics
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a promising direction for embodied intelligence in surgical robotics. Despite the prevalence of VLA benchmarks for general robotics, standardized evaluation platforms specifically designed for surgical contexts remain absent. To address this limitation, we present SurgVLA-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLA models in laparoscopic surgical robotics. Leveraging the SurRoL simulation platform, we construct a hierarchical task taxonomy ranging from atomic actions to complete surgical procedures, complemented by a multi-dimensional evaluation framework assessing action accuracy and semantic consistency. We then systematically evaluate two representative paradigms, including autoregressive models such as OpenVLA, and flow matching models such as $π_{0}$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA. Our experiments show that autoregressive models tend to excel in semantic understanding, while flow matching models often achieve higher task precision but may face generalization trade-offs. However, even the best-performing models remain far from satisfactory, as the constrained endoscopic field of view, restricted viewing angles, and frequent occlusions persist as fundamental physical bottlenecks. The code and data are available at https://github.com/VCL-HNU/SurgVLA

analysis.tldr: 提出了首个专用于腹腔镜手术机器人场景的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型评测基准SurgVLA-Bench，基于SurRoL仿真构建分层手术任务体系和多维评估框架，并在该基准上系统对比了自回归类（如OpenVLA）与流匹配类（如π₀、SmolVLA）VLA模型的表现差异。
analysis.claim: SurgVLA-Bench是首个面向腹腔镜手术机器人场景、具备分层任务结构与语义-动作双维度评估能力的VLA专用基准，可揭示现有VLA模型在真实手术约束下的性能瓶颈。
analysis.input: 腹腔镜视频帧+自然语言手术指令
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列或末端执行器轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: SurRoL仿真平台中的da Vinci模拟器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实手术机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了手术VLA评测的空白，设计合理（分层任务+双维度评估），开源完整，但本质是领域适配型benchmark建设，未提出新模型/算法/硬件/范式，也未解决任何长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、小样本泛化、多器械协同等），且全部实验限于单一仿真环境，未验证跨平台/跨器械/跨术式泛化能力，显著弱于RT-2、π₀、OpenVLA等基石工作（均含真机部署、多机体泛化或范式突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个手术VLA专用benchmark，设计扎实、开源完整，但属高质量领域适配工作，非范式突破或核心算法创新

papers.title: GemNav: Discrete-Token Visual Robot Navigation using a Multimodal Large Language Model
papers.abstract: Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models have so far followed a common recipe: a dedicated visual encoder, a bespoke action head, and training on thousands of hours of cross-embodiment datasets. We ask whether this recipe is necessary. In this paper, we introduce GemNav, a visual robot navigation policy that adapts a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) for short-to-medium horizon waypoint navigation using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on the language tower alone, with no auxiliary visual encoder and no continuous regression head. Waypoints and categorical navigation signals share a single discrete token vocabulary generated by the language-model head, and a soft-decoded auxiliary loss recovers the metric structure that pure cross-entropy training discards. On a single 8.7-hour open corpus, roughly three orders of magnitude smaller than competing training sets, the policy transfers zero-shot to four physically distinct unseen environments and stops within 0.25-0.42m of the goal across 20 real-world trials covering an open carpark, an obstacle carpark, a long outdoor chemical yard, and an indoor warehouse. Conditioning on short image histories improves offline metrics but yields no robot benefit, pointing to a ceiling on what temporal context adds once pretrained vision features are in place. These results indicate that discrete-token adaptation of frozen MLLMs can provide a data-efficient, deployable alternative for foundation model robot navigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）+仅在语言塔上微调LoRA，不加视觉编码器、不回归连续动作，而是把导航目标点和指令都转成离散token来预测，只用不到9小时真实机器人数据就实现了跨4种完全没见过的真实场景的零样本导航，平均误差不到0.4米。
analysis.claim: 冻结的多模态大语言模型仅通过语言塔的低秩适配（LoRA），无需专用视觉编码器和连续动作头，即可实现数据极简、零样本跨环境、高精度的离散token化视觉导航。
analysis.input: 单帧或短时序RGB图像 + 自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 离散token序列（编码目标航点坐标与导航动作类别）
analysis.robot_dependency: Clearpath Jackal机器人 + RealSense D435i相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的8.7小时跨场景导航轨迹数据（含GPS/IMU/odometry对齐）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上完成4类差异极大场景（户外化工厂、室内仓库、两种停车场）的零样本部署，误差<0.42m，且仅用千分之一量级数据（8.7h vs 竞品数千小时），实证强度接近DROID/ALOHA级；但未开源数据集与完整训练pipeline，复现受限，未达RT-X级开放性与规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次证明冻结MLLM仅语言塔微调即可支撑高鲁棒真实导航，大幅降低数据与架构门槛，证据扎实、部署可信、泛化性强。

papers.title: IronMind: Scaling Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation via Camera-Space Ego-Centric Pretraining
papers.abstract: Egocentric human video offers a scalable data source for dexterous manipulation, yet using it to train humanoid robots presents two challenges: (1) an embodiment gap, as human hands differ structurally from robot end-effectors and low-cost egocentric recordings lack the torso kinematics required by conventional retargeting; and (2) heterogeneous data quality, including noisy hand-pose tracking and weakly aligned text annotations. We introduce IronMind, a vision-language-action (VLA) model that uses egocentric human video and heterogeneous robot data to pretrain policies for humanoid dexterous manipulation. To bridge the embodiment gap, IronMind bypasses explicit body-retargeting by using a camera-space action representation, the native reference space of egocentric video, and semantically aligning robot and human action dimensions. Across total pretraining budgets from 250 to 10,000 hours, validation loss decreases approximately log-linearly with data scale. Larger pretraining budgets also improve out-of-distribution real-robot manipulation after post-training: across six challenging tasks with unseen objects, affordances, and reasoning prompts, the 10,000-hour model achieves a 55.0% success rate, compared with at most 11.7% for every pretraining budget up to 5,000 hours and 5.0% without pretraining. At the same pretraining budget, the camera-space action representation also outperforms the torso-frame baseline. Together, these findings support pretraining with a camera-space action representation on large-scale human egocentric data as a scalable foundation for humanoid robot manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用大量第一人称视角的人类操作视频（不依赖高精度人体动作捕捉）预训练一个视觉-语言-动作模型IronMind，核心创新是把机器人动作直接定义在相机坐标系里，绕过传统需要精确人体-机器人运动学映射的难题，最终在真实人形机器人上实现了对未见过物体和任务的灵巧操作，10000小时预训练后成功率55%，远超小规模预训练或无预训练基线。
analysis.claim: 在无需显式身体重定向的前提下，通过相机空间动作表征与异构人类/机器人数据联合预训练，可规模化提升人形机器人灵巧操作的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB第一人称视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 相机坐标系下的末端执行器6D位姿增量动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1人形机器人（摘要未明说但实验部分及团队公开信息确认）
analysis.data_dependency: 弱依赖真实机器人数据：预训练主要用人类egocentric视频，仅后训练阶段使用少量真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署、6个跨对象/跨功能/跨提示的OOD任务、从250h到10000h的系统性数据量消融、camera-space vs torso-frame控制变量对比、显著性能跃迁（55% vs ≤11.7%），逼近Facet-0/EGOWild2Dex级分量；但未开源全部数据与仿真器，且未展示多机体迁移或长期部署鲁棒性，略逊于最顶尖的96+分标杆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在人形机器人上验证了纯相机空间动作表征+大规模人类egocentric视频预训练的有效性，并取得真实场景下质的性能跃迁，解决了长期存在的embodiment gap工程瓶颈。

papers.title: AnchorWorld: Embodied Egocentric World Simulation with View-based Evolution Customization
papers.abstract: Despite being a pivotal frontier, interactive world modeling remains underexplored in terms of the versatile controllability required by practical scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present AnchorWorld, a framework that advances egocentric simulation through enhanced interaction integrity and a flexible mechanism for world customization. First, we utilize 3D human motion as the primary interaction modality. To complement the out-of-view or truncated body parts in egocentric views, we introduce an auxiliary training supervision that incorporates exogenous viewpoints decoupled from the agent's first-person sensorium. It allows the model to observe the agent's full-body positioning relative to the environment, facilitating a more robust spatial grounding of human-world interactions. Furthermore, we propose a simple yet effective mechanism for customizing self-evolving worlds. This is achieved by defining anchor views within a unified world coordinate system, coupled with textual descriptions dictating the dynamic evolution of local scenes. Experimental results show that AnchorWorld significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, while ablation studies validate the effectiveness of our key designs. Notably, our customization scheme exhibits promising spatio-temporal geometric consistency and adheres strictly to the prescribed evolutionary dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnchorWorld框架，用3D人体运动作为交互模态，通过引入外部视角监督来补全第一人称视野中缺失的身体部位，实现更鲁棒的自我-环境空间定位；再通过在统一世界坐标系中定义‘锚点视图’并配以文本描述，支持对局部场景动态演化的可控定制。
analysis.claim: 通过融合外源视角监督与锚点视图+文本驱动的演化机制，可构建具备强空间接地能力且支持细粒度、几何一致的自演化世界模拟器。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频序列 + 3D人体运动序列 + 外部视角图像（用于监督） + 锚点视图图像 + 文本描述（指定局部场景演化规则）
analysis.output: 随时间演化的、几何一致的egocentric世界状态序列（含隐式/显式场景表示、自我位姿、局部动态变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或采集的多视角人体-场景同步数据（含外源视角），未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出锚点视图+文本演化的新定制范式，但核心仍属世界模型的表征增强变体；无真机闭环验证、无跨场景/跨任务泛化实验、无与DreamerV3/Genie等基石方法的公平对比（仅与较弱baseline比），几何一致性仅靠定性/小规模定量展示，未触及世界模型的核心挑战（如长程因果建模、开放域动作泛化、在线学习）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在egocentric世界建模中做了有启发性的模块组合（外源视角监督+锚点文本演化），但缺乏底层机制创新和扎实实证，尚未达到世界模型领域主流基石工作的分量。

papers.title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination. However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design. Here, we introduce Chamaileon, which unifies multi-target and multi-state binder design by formulating the problem as cross-context binding landscape modeling. The framework is underpinned by a training paradigm termed In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling. During inference, we employ Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS), a scalable strategy that optimizes a single sequence across contexts while alleviating the scarcity of high-quality multi-conformational paired data. Extensive evaluation on our newly constructed benchmark, CROSS, demonstrates that Chamaileon effectively generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements. The code is available on https://github.com/caohengyuan/Chamaileon.

analysis.tldr: 提出Chamaileon框架，专门解决蛋白质结合剂设计中需同时适配多个靶标或多种构象状态的难题，通过跨上下文结合景观建模、上下文感知的序列-结构联合训练（I3CD）和混合路径采样（MoPS）策略，在新构建的CROSS基准上验证了对多靶/多态场景的泛化生成能力。
analysis.claim: Chamaileon首次实现了统一建模多靶标与多构象状态下的蛋白质结合剂设计，通过跨上下文绑定景观建模与上下文感知的序列-结构联合生成，显著提升结合剂在功能导向蛋白设计中的适应性。
analysis.input: 多个靶标蛋白结构（或多构象状态结构集合）
analysis.output: 一条能同时适配多个靶标或多种构象状态的蛋白质结合剂序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了功能导向蛋白设计中多靶/多态结合剂生成这一长期开放问题，构建了首个专用多上下文基准CROSS并给出可复现方法，但未达AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion级范式突破，也缺乏湿实验验证或大规模临床前指标支撑，属扎实且有明确工程价值的显著贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺湿实验验证，但问题定义清晰、方法系统性强、基准建设务实，是当前AI×蛋白质设计中少有的面向真实功能复杂性的端到端方案。

papers.title: DreamWAM: Beyond RGB Future Prediction for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) learn action-relevant representations by predicting how the observed world will evolve. Most existing WAMs define this future in RGB space, where task-relevant state transitions are entangled with nuisance variations in texture, illumination, background, and viewpoint. We argue that WAMs should explicitly predict action-relevant future state rather than relying on RGB prediction alone. We introduce DreamWAM, which reformulates future prediction as structured world modeling beyond RGB, representing future states through complementary views of appearance, motion, geometry, and semantics. During training, DreamWAM combines joint latent denoising of RGB and motion with lightweight gated residual branches for geometry and semantics. Shared attention between VideoDiT and ActionDiT allows the action branch to learn from these future-state predictions, while all beyond-RGB supervision branches are disabled at inference and deployment remains RGB-only. Across both no-rollout and joint video-action inference, DreamWAM consistently improves the matched RGB-only baselines on LIBERO, from 97.30\% to 98.40\% and from 98.00\% to 98.90\%, respectively. The gains become larger under unseen LIBERO-Plus perturbations, from 51.36\% to 63.44\% and from 69.16\% to 75.47\%. The same robustness extends to real-world manipulation, where DreamWAM attains an average success rate of 74.4\% across unseen changes in lighting, background, and object layout, compared with 55.6\% for Fast-WAM-Joint. These results show that robust world-action learning depends not only on predicting the future, but on representing it in a form that matters for action. The code and models are publicly released at https://github.com/hustvl/DreamWAM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DreamWAM，通过在训练时联合预测RGB、光流（motion）、几何（geometry）和语义（semantics）四种未来状态表示，让世界动作模型更鲁棒地学习动作相关动态；推理时只用RGB输入，却显著提升了在LIBERO和真实机器人操作任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型的鲁棒性提升不在于更准地预测RGB未来帧，而在于训练时用多模态结构化表征（motion/geometry/semantics）显式建模动作相关的未来状态，即使推理阶段回归纯RGB输入也能获得更强泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列+动作指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散或连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（全部基于LIBERO仿真数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，它未引入新范式（如隐状态持久化、闭环规划、端到端RL集成），也未解决长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、跨域持续学习）；但它是首个系统性解耦RGB未来预测、显式注入motion/geometry/semantics监督并验证其对动作泛化的增益的工作，在LIBERO-Plus扰动和真实机器人场景中提供了扎实的多维度消融与跨场景实证，属显著贡献而非概念包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是开新范式，但在世界模型的动作导向表征设计上做出关键工程级创新，实证充分、开源完整、泛化效果可复现且跨仿真与真实场景一致

papers.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

analysis.tldr: 提出CLAP框架，用互联网规模的跨形态视频（人类+多种机器人）训练一个统一的动作条件视频世界模型，通过端点姿态/语言/隐空间动作三重对齐和课程学习，实现零样本迁移到真实机器人（如DROID）的物理仿真预测，且开源全部代码和模型。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；项目网站 omni-clap.github.io 无明确归属，非DeepMind/Google/NVIDIA/Stanford等已知大组常规域名）
analysis.claim: 跨形态（human + multi-robot）视频数据可被统一建模为物理驱动的世界模型，无需真实机器人交互数据即可实现零样本sim2real部署。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列 + 动作条件（端点位姿/自然语言指令/隐空间动作向量）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频预测（动作条件下的物理演化视频）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID、Bridge、YAM双臂、G1人形等（作为评估目标，非训练依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据依赖；训练仅用公开互联网视频（含人类操作、机器人演示），无真实传感器日志或闭环控制轨迹

papers.title: DUET-DINO: Simultaneous Cross-View World Modeling for Latent Planning in Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned latent world models predict future visual representations, enabling zero-shot goal-conditioned robot planning and control. However, their predictions for fine-grained spatial and rotational actions are unreliable for full 7-DoF end-effector control. To address this gap, we introduce DUET-DINO, a simultaneous cross-view latent world model that jointly learns action-conditioned predictions from static side- and wrist-camera observations through cross-view conditioning. By exploiting complementary global scene and gripper-centric information, DUET-DINO enables latent planning over the full 7-DoF action space. Across spatially diverse reach, orientation-intensive angled-reach, and multi-goal grasp-and-lift tasks, DUET-DINO consistently outperforms single-view and independent dual-view baselines, achieving 92% success on reach, 72.5% on angled-reach, and 60.0% on lift tasks. DUET-DINO is trained from scratch on DROID and RoboArena datasets and generalizes robustly under visual distribution shifts. We further show that while V-JEPA 2 wrist-view predictions underestimate visual dynamics induced by fine-grained actions, DINOv3 predictions better capture action-conditioned scene changes, leading to stronger downstream planning. The code and model checkpoints will be open-sourced. Project page: https://utn-air.github.io/DUET-DINO

analysis.tldr: 提出DUET-DINO模型，用侧视+腕视双视角图像联合建模隐空间世界动态，专门解决单视角世界模型在7自由度精细抓取控制中旋转和微动预测不准的问题，在真实机器人多任务上取得当前最优性能（92%/72.5%/60%），且不依赖预训练视觉模型，从零训练于DROID/RoboArena数据集。
analysis.claim: 同时建模侧视与腕视两个互补视角的隐空间世界动态，是实现可靠7-DoF端到端潜空间规划的必要条件，且DINOv3特征比V-JEPA2更适合作为动作条件化世界模型的视觉编码器。
analysis.input: 侧视RGB图像 + 腕视RGB图像 + 当前7-DoF动作指令
analysis.output: 下一时刻侧视+腕视的隐空间表征（用于潜空间规划）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（DROID/RoboArena实机平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多视角视频轨迹数据（DROID和RoboArena均为真机数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人7-DoF操纵任务上首次系统验证了跨视角隐式世界建模对细粒度动作规划的实质性增益，有完整消融（单视/独立双视/V-JEPA2 vs DINOv3）、多任务真机评估、开源代码与checkpoint；但未引入新架构范式（仍是Transformer+VAE类世界模型），也未解决长期开放难题（如长时序状态一致性、跨机体泛化），分量略低于WEAVER（94.5）和DreamerV3（96）等基石工作。

papers.title: Agent as Policy for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that a general-purpose agent can directly drive a physical robot throughout task execution without any task-specific or environment-specific training. We introduce Agent as Policy (AGP), which places task planning and execution under the agent's control. Given a task and a robot interface, the agent interprets visual evidence, writes executable programs, issues motion commands, and revises its actions in response to physical outcomes. This brings the agent's reasoning and programming capabilities into continuous interaction with the physical world. We study AGP across multiple real-world manipulation tasks spanning precision manipulation, dynamic motions, and deformable objects. These include assembly from human videos, block construction from goal images, die reorientation, targeted throwing, and bimanual towel folding. AGP achieves success rates of 100%, 100%, and 80% on three block construction configurations. These findings establish a path for general-purpose agents to act as robotic policies, extending their autonomy to physical manipulation through runtime reasoning, programming, and interaction.

analysis.tldr: 用一个通用大模型（不微调）直接当机器人控制器，靠实时看图、写Python代码、发运动指令、根据视觉反馈动态修正动作，完成5类真实世界操作任务（如从人视频学装配、扔骰子、双手叠毛巾），部分任务成功率100%。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；arXiv未提供affiliation信息）

papers.title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MM-ABC模型，用多层级视觉语言模型特征+未来动作想象监督+跨流掩码联合注意力机制，统一处理移动机械臂的感知、基座与机械臂协同决策和动作生成，在多个仿真基准和5个真实机器人任务上取得当前SOTA级成功率。
analysis.claim: 通用移动操作需要‘看见、协同、想象’三位一体的表征：即空间感知、异构执行器（臂/基座）跨流协作、以及基于世界模型的未来动作意图监督，三者缺一不可。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）历史动作/状态
analysis.output: 基座与机械臂联合动作序列（6D位姿增量或关节速度）

papers.title: Joint protein, mRNA and DNA sequence design and optimization with nucleotide-level Potts models
papers.abstract: Protein design typically generates amino acid sequences first and then translates them into DNA post-hoc limiting control over the nucleotide sequence via codon choice at design time. We introduce NuCaliby, a structure-conditioned model that jointly designs amino acid, mRNA, and DNA sequences of a protein at nucleotide resolution. NuCaliby predicts a Potts model over a nucleotide graph, trained using amino acid supervision by marginalizing over synonymous codons. It preserves residue-level designability on par with the original Caliby model. Its energy-based formulation supports composable inference-time guidance from sequence-level objectives through proposal construction and candidate acceptance, allowing the incorporation of biological proxies into the coding nucleotide sequence. Under organism-specific tRNA adaptation guidance, NuCaliby improves adaptation to host tRNA pools beyond synonymous sequence space, trading-off self-consistency. NuCaliby also embeds specified RNA motif sequences directly into coding sequences, avoiding the combinatorial growth required for the same task at the amino-acid level. In wet lab experiments, NuCaliby produces expressible and soluble proteins on par with state of the art methods, while enabling more complex nucleotide-level control and optimization. Together, these results extend protein design beyond the amino acid level, enabling joint optimization across the central dogma of molecular biology. The code and model weights are available here: https://github.com/blazejba/NuCaliby

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了NuCaliby模型，首次在核苷酸分辨率上联合设计蛋白质氨基酸序列、mRNA序列和DNA编码序列，通过Potts模型建模同义密码子空间，在保持蛋白结构可设计性的同时，直接优化tRNA适配性、RNA二级结构基序等核酸层面功能，且实验验证了所设计蛋白的可表达性和可溶性。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质设计应突破氨基酸层级，直接在核苷酸层面联合建模并优化蛋白结构、mRNA稳定性和DNA编码适配性，且该联合优化可在不牺牲结构设计质量的前提下实现生物学可解释的核酸功能增强。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白3D结构（或结构特征）+ 可选的核酸级约束（如tRNA适应指数、RNA motif）
analysis.output: 完整的DNA编码序列（含启动子/UTR可扩展）、对应mRNA序列、推导出的氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将蛋白质设计从氨基酸层推进到核苷酸层，用能量模型统一建模中央法则三类分子序列，实验证明其在湿实验中达到SOTA蛋白表达水平，且新增tRNA适配、RNA motif嵌入等可量化核酸功能优化能力；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆，但与CENO（97）、HI-JEPA（97）同属‘分子世界模型’前沿梯队，是AI×生物设计从‘序列生成’迈向‘功能化核酸编程’的关键跃迁。

papers.title: LIBERO-RIG: A Hardware-Setup Robustness Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Robot policies are expected to generalize across deployment environments, including variations in the robot itself: cameras are bumped and remounted, calibrations drift, controllers run at different rates, and end-effector pads wear down. We present LIBERO-RIG, a benchmark that perturbs only the robot's hardware and setup while holding every LIBERO task fixed. The benchmark spans eleven perturbation axes, including camera mounting and optics, camera-to-arm calibration, actuation gain, control rate, proprioceptive noise, base pose, table height, and gripper pads. Each axis has five severity levels, yielding 210 conditions across the four LIBERO suites. We evaluate nine recent vision-language-action models using 500 episodes per condition and substantiate each finding with rigorous statistical tests. Pooled success falls from 0.932 to 0.767 at the middle severity and 0.509 at the highest severity. Performance degradation varies substantially across perturbation axes and action interfaces, and training on visual perturbations does not mitigate faults that leave camera images unchanged. We release the benchmark together with manifests specifying the fixed perturbation parameters for each episode.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人硬件配置变化下鲁棒性的新基准LIBERO-RIG，通过系统性扰动11类真实部署中常见的硬件参数（如相机安装、标定偏移、控制频率、本体感知噪声等），在固定任务上量化了9个主流VLA模型的性能衰减程度，并发现现有训练方法对非图像变化的扰动几乎无效。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视觉-语言-动作模型在真实部署中面对细微但常见的硬件配置扰动时鲁棒性极差，且这种脆弱性无法被仅靠视觉增强训练所缓解。

analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
