papers.title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
papers.abstract: Generalist policies can learn a wide range of skills from diverse robot datasets. In order to solve or improve on challenging news tasks, we need a way to infer and invoke the appropriate actions from the policy's rich behavioral prior, especially when directly commanding the policy fails. We focus on flow matching generalists and propose Flow Reversal Steering (FRS): a method that takes suboptimal but ``reasonable'' actions, finds their latent noises by passing them through the flow policy in reverse, and maps them to nearby generalist action modes. We evaluate FRS across many simulated and real-world manipulation settings. First, FRS can turn coarse semantic guidance from humans or vision-language models (VLMs) into corresponding good robot actions, improving zero-shot control. These gains can be distilled with behavioral cloning by training an auxiliary policy to output noises that the generalist maps to good actions -- showing up to 95% absolute task success rate boosts in under a minute of training. Finally, FRS enables policy improvement by bootstrapping reinforcement learning with semantic knowledge, improving on several tasks that standard RL fails to improve on.

analysis.tldr: 提出Flow Reversal Steering（FRS）方法，利用已训练好的flow-matching通用机器人策略的反向流映射，将人类或视觉语言模型给出的粗糙语义指令（如‘推杯子’）转化为高质量动作，显著提升零样本控制效果，并能快速蒸馏成新策略或引导强化学习改进难任务。
analysis.claim: 通过反向流映射将粗粒度语义输入精准锚定到通用策略的高概率动作模态，实现无需微调的零样本语义控制与策略自增强。
analysis.input: 粗粒度语义指令（文本）或VLM生成的动作建议（非精确轨迹）
analysis.output: 通用策略输出的动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5、Allegro Hand等多平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据训练基础flow generalist，但FRS本身不需新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: FRS在多真实机器人平台上验证了语义到动作的零样本泛化能力，具备跨机体/跨任务/跨场景实证，且提供可蒸馏的噪声映射机制和RL引导路径；虽未开源全部数据与模型权重，但代码完整、实验设计扎实、消融充分，实质性推进了通用策略的可控性瓶颈，但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或OpenVLA级开放生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性破解flow-based通用策略的语义可控性难题，用可逆流结构实现零样本指令接地，在真实硬件上达成高成功率且支持策略自进化

papers.title: A Few Words Go a Long Way: Language Guided Robot Policy Synthesis
papers.abstract: While vision-language-action models have demonstrated impressive zero-shot manipulation capabilities, they remain fundamentally black box policies that are difficult to interpret, adapt, or correct when they inevitably fail. In this work, we propose ARCHITECT, a framework that treats robot policy acquisition as an interactive program synthesis task. ARCHITECT leverages the reasoning capabilities of LLM coding agents to synthesize modular robot programs that utilize a suite of perception and control tools. Unlike end-to-end models where distribution shift leads to unpredictable, cascading failures, our modular architecture allows users to isolate failures and localize feedback at the level of abstraction required. We introduce an iterative process where a human supervisor provides natural language corrections to steer the policy. These corrections are grounded in the policy code by program execution traces and distilled into a persistent skill library, a form of long-term in-context learning which enables the agent to accumulate a repertoire of reusable, interpretable behaviors. In a benchmark evaluation on a Franka Panda robot, ARCHITECT outperforms state-of-the-art VLA models and program synthesis baselines on complex, long-horizon tasks, including articulated object manipulation and cloth folding. Our results demonstrate that the synthesized skill library enables the system to transfer to novel tasks with decreasing human intervention, providing a steerable and data-efficient alternative to black-box robot learning. Website: https://robo-architect.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出ARCHITECT框架，把机器人策略学习变成用大模型写可解释、可调试的模块化程序，人类用自然语言反馈修正代码，逐步构建可复用的技能库，在Franka机械臂上验证了比现有VLA模型更强的长程任务泛化和人机协同效率。
analysis.claim: 将机器人策略获取重构为交互式程序合成任务，通过LLM生成可解释、可编辑、可累积的模块化技能程序，实现人类自然语言反馈驱动的持续策略演进。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 程序执行轨迹（含感知与控制工具调用日志） + 人类自然语言纠错反馈
analysis.output: 可执行的Python机器人程序（含感知模块调用、运动规划、状态判断等结构化逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行轨迹用于程序合成与反馈 grounding，但未说明是否需预收集大规模真实数据；训练LLM agent时可能使用合成/仿真数据，但评估完全基于真机
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机上系统实现‘自然语言→可执行程序→人类反馈→技能库迭代’闭环，显著优于VLA基线（非刷榜，而是解决其不可解释、难调试、难修正的根本缺陷），证据扎实（多复杂长程任务+消融+真机部署+技能迁移递减干预），但尚未跨机体验证，也未开源代码/模型，未达RT-2级范式革命，属重磅工程-认知双突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个端到端VLA模型，而是用程序合成范式实质性破解了黑箱策略的可控性难题，在真机上证明了人类反馈可高效转化为可复用、可推理的技能知识。

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Embodiment Dependence in Visuomotor Policies
papers.abstract: Visuomotor policies observe both the task scene and the acting embodiment, allowing embodiment-specific visual cues to influence action prediction. We study this phenomenon as visual embodiment dependence (VED) and show, through cue-conflict interventions across representative policies, that visible robot configuration can become a shortcut to task progress. Rather than eliminating VED, we argue that it should be structured around embodiment information that supports control and generalization. We realize this through embodiment canonicalization in 3D point clouds, replacing the original embodiment with a canonical end-effector representation (CER) that preserves control-relevant geometry while abstracting embodiment-specific morphology. Its editable form further enables configuration-decorrelation augmentation for unfamiliar robot configurations. Experiments show that embodiment canonicalization substantially improves human-to-robot policy transfer without robot demonstrations, while simply removing the embodiment is insufficient without preserving control-relevant geometry. We further find that CER itself can become a configuration shortcut when robot configuration becomes decoupled from task progress; configuration-decorrelation augmentation mitigates this failure mode and restores robust recovery without sacrificing performance on seen configurations. Together, these results show that robust visuomotor learning benefits from structuring, rather than removing, visual embodiment information. Project website: https://tonyfang.net/ved

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉运动策略会偷懒地依赖机器人自身可见形态（比如机械臂姿态）作为任务完成的捷径，于是提出用3D点云中的‘规范末端执行器表示’（CER）替代原始机器人形态，既保留控制所需几何信息，又剥离具体机体形态，再配合配置解耦增强来防止CER本身变成新捷径，最终在不使用任何真实机器人演示数据的情况下显著提升人类动作到机器人策略的跨机体迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 视觉运动策略不应消除对机器人形态的视觉依赖，而应将其结构化为控制相关、形态无关的规范表示（CER），并辅以配置解耦增强，才能实现鲁棒的跨机体泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+3D点云（含原始机器人形态）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated UR5 / simulated Jaco（仿真为主，少量真实Franka验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据；仅用仿真中生成的合成轨迹和人类动作视频（Ego4D/EPIC-KITCHENS）做监督
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了可解释、可编辑的‘规范末端执行器表示’（CER）这一新抽象范式，实证表明其比简单移除形态输入或端到端黑盒迁移更有效；在无真实机器人演示前提下实现跨机体迁移，且开源代码/模型/数据；但未覆盖多任务长程操作、未部署于复杂动态环境、未与RT-2/π0等foundation model级方法直接对标，属扎实的范式改进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将‘视觉形态依赖’从需规避的缺陷重构为可设计的控制接口，并给出几何可解释、可编辑、可增强的实现路径，解决了跨机体模仿学习中长期存在的形态捷径问题。

papers.title: EnvDreamer: Large-Scale Multimodal-to-Environment Generation for Embodied AI
papers.abstract: Large datasets and high capacity models have accelerated progress in vision and language. This work introduces a platform aimed at bringing comparable gains to embodied learning, world models, and robotics. We present EnvDreamer, a framework that uses large language and vision language models to generate Unreal Engine 5 environments for embodied AI and robot training. EnvDreamer enables sampling of large, diverse, interactive, customizable, and validator passed virtual environments for training and evaluation across navigation, interaction, and manipulation. We illustrate the platform with a large set of generated scenes and simple baselines. Policies trained on EnvDreamer generated environments, without explicit mapping or human task supervision, achieve competitive results on multiple embodied benchmarks spanning navigation, rearrangement, and manipulation. EnvDreamer also supports image-conditioned reconstruction for real-to-sim studies. Finally, we release EnvDreamer-20k, a dataset of 20,000 validator passed environments with task programs, scene graphs, trajectories, and metadata to support reproducible benchmarking.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型和多模态模型自动生成大量符合任务要求的Unreal Engine 5虚拟环境，用于具身AI训练和评测，不依赖人工建模或真实机器人数据，同时发布20k个带程序、场景图、轨迹的验证通过环境数据集。
analysis.claim: 通过多模态大模型驱动的端到端环境生成，可规模化产出高质量、可交互、带语义结构的虚拟世界，替代人工构建，支撑具身智能的泛化训练与无监督策略学习。
analysis.input: 文本指令（含任务描述）或RGB图像（用于real-to-sim重建）
analysis.output: Unreal Engine 5可运行的3D环境（含材质、物理、交互对象、场景图、任务程序）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有环境均为生成式合成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现LLM+VLM驱动的端到端、可验证、大规模、带程序语义的3D环境生成，并实证支持多任务策略训练；但未在真实机器人上部署，未解决world model的核心状态持久性或闭环规划问题，也未超越DreamerV3/WEAVER等在模型架构或控制性能上的实质突破，属强工程整合+数据范式创新，尚未达基石级理论/算法突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把多模态大模型能力系统性迁移到虚拟环境生成管线，显著降低仿真构建门槛，但未触及具身智能核心控制或世界建模的本质瓶颈。

papers.title: Filling the Missing Puzzle: Integrating Interaction and Evolutionary Information to Enhance Protein Fitness Prediction in Inverse Folding
papers.abstract: Protein inverse folding, which infers compatible amino acid sequences from a given backbone structure, is central to rational protein design. Current methods rely largely on sequence recovery rate as the evaluation metric, emphasizing structural compatibility but seldom addressing function. Yet functional activity depends on the proper network of non-covalent interactions-protein-ligand contacts being a prime example. We argue that function-oriented protein design is governed by three complementary constraints: structural, interaction, and evolutionary, none of which are handled in a unified manner by existing pretrained models. To bridge this gap, we introduce zPolaron, a graph neural network built on protein-ligand complexes for functional protein design. zPolaron represents residues and ligand atoms as a heterogeneous graph and jointly encodes structural, interaction, and evolutionary information by fusing physical-interaction-enhanced graph representations with ESM-2 embeddings. Across multiple fitness prediction benchmarks, zPolaron outperforms all baselines, with gains evident across structural, interaction, and evolutionary dimensions. Wet-lab experiments further confirm its utility in functional enzyme screening and design: the optimized CalA6-D205A-S160G mutant achieves a 17.84-fold improvement in activity, while the CalB-I121M mutant yields a 1.91-fold increase. Together, these results show that integrating interaction and evolutionary information fills the missing puzzle of inverse folding, enhancing protein fitness prediction beyond structural compatibility. zPolaron is available at https://github.com/zelixirSH/zPolaron.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出zPolaron模型，把蛋白质-配体相互作用信息和进化信息整合进图神经网络，用于提升逆折叠任务中的功能适配性（即蛋白活性）预测，不再只看结构恢复率，并在多个计算基准和湿实验中验证了其对酶活性提升的有效性。
analysis.claim: 整合结构、相互作用与进化三重约束的图神经网络zPolaron，能显著提升逆折叠任务中蛋白功能适配性（fitness）的预测精度，并在真实酶改造中实现可测量的活性提升。
analysis.input: 蛋白质主链结构 + 配体三维构象 + 进化序列信息（MSA或ESM-2嵌入）
analysis.output: 氨基酸序列适配性打分（fitness prediction），即该序列在给定结构+配体环境下实现高功能活性的概率/程度
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将配体相互作用图建模与进化嵌入融合进逆折叠框架，并在多个计算基准+两个湿实验突变体上验证功能提升（17.8×和1.9×），证据扎实；但未开新范式（仍属ESM+GNN增强路线），也未解决长期开放难题（如通用de novo结合口袋设计），尚未达到AlphaFold2/ESMFold级基础突破，但明显强于多数纯计算刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在ESM+GNN主流范式内完成高质量多源信息融合与湿实验闭环验证，是当前AI×蛋白质设计中少有的‘算得准、改得对’的扎实工作。

papers.title: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
papers.abstract: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Prompteina，首个能直接根据自然语言描述（如‘一个能结合GM2A的柔性α螺旋富集蛋白’）生成全原子精度蛋白质三维结构的AI模型，并在15/18结构指标、20个结合靶标中的13个上超越基线，还实验验证出9个真实结合GM2A的新蛋白，最强者KD=107 nM。
analysis.org: 华盛顿大学/DeepMind（联合署名含David Baker实验室与Pang Wei Koh/Hanna Hajishirzi团队；Baker为通讯作者且主导实验验证，DeepMind贡献NLP与对齐方法；按权重和实证主导性取 华盛顿大学）
analysis.claim: 自然语言可作为高效、通用、可扩展的蛋白质结构生成条件接口，无需为每种设计目标定制输入编码器，且能驱动高质量、可实验验证的de novo蛋白设计。
analysis.input: 自然语言描述（涵盖全局结构特征、残基级性质、功能意图等）
analysis.output: 全原子分辨率的蛋白质三维结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据；依赖计算生成+实验验证的配对文本-结构数据（Prompteina-Data含1.8M结构+50M+文本），但真实实验仅用于最终验证（GM2A），非训练必需
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现自然语言到全原子蛋白结构的端到端生成，并完成从计算设计→湿实验验证（9个新binders，KD达107 nM）的闭环；其语言接口范式跳出了传统基于物理约束/模板/多任务头的工程化设计框架，与AlphaFold2之于结构预测、ESMFold之于快速折叠同属‘接口层革命’，虽未达AlphaFold2级基础性（因仍依赖Proteina-Complexa底座），但已超越HI-JEPA/CENO等世界模型类工作在生物分子设计上的实证深度与应用落地强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把语言模型套在蛋白上刷榜，而是重构了蛋白设计的人机接口，且用严苛的湿实验（无先验binders的GM2A靶点）证实了该接口能产出真正可用的新分子。

papers.title: EBench: Elemental Diagnosis of Generalist Mobile Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: We present EBench, a simulation benchmark that diagnoses generalist mobile manipulation policies beyond a single success-rate scalar. EBench comprises 26 diverse and challenging manipulation tasks annotated along 5 capability dimensions and 4 generalization dimensions. We evaluate state-of-the-art generalist manipulation models including π_0, π_{0.5}, XVLA, and InternVLA-A1, and reveal that models with near success rates exhibit strikingly different capability profiles: π_{0.5} achieves the highest test success rate and the best train--test retention, whereas InternVLA-A1 dominates mobile manipulation but collapses on dexterous tasks, and XVLA exhibits strengths on a disjoint set of atomic skills compared to other policies. Beyond capability profiling, EBench analyzes the generalization ability from 4 representative perspectives, identifying the impact of different distribution shift factors. The results reveal strengths and weaknesses of models behind an overall score. We hope this benchmark offers a broad set of diagnostic signals to guide iteration on generalist manipulation models.

analysis.tldr: 提出EBench——一个面向通用移动操作策略的细粒度诊断型仿真基准，不只看整体成功率，而是从5种能力维度和4种泛化维度拆解26个任务的表现，揭示不同SOTA模型（如π₀.₅、InternVLA-A1）在能力谱上的显著差异。
analysis.claim: 通用移动操作策略不能仅用单一成功率评估；需通过多维能力剖面与泛化视角进行元素级诊断，才能暴露模型真实强项与缺陷。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 仿真环境观测（RGB/状态等，未明说但属标准VLA设定）
analysis.output: 任务完成与否的二元判定 + 各能力/泛化维度的细粒度得分
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性解构通用操作策略能力谱的诊断型基准，设计严谨（26任务+5+4维度），实证充分（对比4个主流VLA模型并发现反直觉现象），但纯仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码/模型，且未推动新方法或架构，属于显著贡献而非里程碑——比RT-X/DROID等基石低一档（它们定义了数据、训练范式或真机部署），但高于普通刷榜benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但提供了当前最系统的诊断工具，能有效戳破‘高成功率=强通用性’的幻觉，对模型迭代有明确指导价值。

papers.title: What Matters in Humanoid General Motion Tracking? An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Humanoid general motion tracking requires policies that can follow diverse whole-body references while maintaining balance. Building such policies involves many practical design choices, and their individual effects are often hard to assess. We address this issue with an empirical study of common modeling and training factors used in recent humanoid motion-imitation pipelines. To make the study controlled and reproducible, we developed YAHMP, an open-source modular framework for training, evaluating, and deploying whole-body motion tracking policies on the Unitree G1. Within YAHMP, we define a nominal configuration and compare variants that differ in motion-command representation, observation history, action representation, actuation profile, hand-force randomization during training, and training approach. We evaluate the resulting policies on a test set of retargeted human motions and compare the nominal policy with TWIST2 as an external baseline trained on the same motion set. The results distinguish choices with clear tracking effects from choices that mainly change actuation effort, training complexity, or physical interaction capability. Finally, we deploy YAHMP policies zero-shot on the real Unitree G1, demonstrating diverse whole-body motion tracking, balance under external perturbations, and forceful interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地测试了人形机器人全身运动跟踪策略中多个关键设计选择（如动作表示、观测历史、力控随机化等）对跟踪精度、平衡能力、交互力等指标的实际影响，并在Unitree G1真机上零样本部署验证效果。
analysis.org: 未知作者机构，摘要未提所属单位，作者名无明显知名实验室/企业标识
analysis.claim: 在人形机器人通用运动跟踪中，不同建模与训练选择对运动跟踪性能、执行效率和物理交互能力的影响存在显著分化，其中部分选择仅影响执行开销或鲁棒性，而非跟踪精度本身。
analysis.input: 运动参考序列（retargeted human motion）+ 当前本体感知（关节状态、IMU、足底力等）
analysis.output: 全身关节目标动作（torque或position-level控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真训练数据，但最终在真实G1上零样本部署；未说明是否使用真实机器人采集的数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证研究：覆盖6类关键设计变量、真机零样本部署、多维评估（跟踪误差/力控/扰动鲁棒性）、开源框架YAHMP+完整复现流程；但未提出新算法范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如跨机体泛化、长时序一致性），贡献属于高质量工程验证与设计指南层级，略低于RT-2/π0等里程碑，但强于多数纯仿真刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不发明新模型，而是用严谨对照实验厘清了人形运动跟踪中哪些设计真有用、哪些只是调参幻觉，且全部落地到真机，是当前具身智能领域稀缺的‘可信赖工程知识’产出。

signals.venue: HAL (Le Centre pour la Communication Scientifique Directe)

papers.title: $π\mathbf{R}^2$: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist manipulation policies increasingly take the form of action-chunking flow policies built on large pretrained backbones. Such chunks run open-loop, so the policy cannot react to sensory input arriving mid-execution, sacrificing \emph{reactivity}. Replanning more often would restore it, but the perception-to-action pipeline (a large backbone plus multiple denoising steps) is too slow: this \emph{latency} forbids frequent replanning and leaves committed actions stale, making such policies ill-suited for dynamic, closed-loop control. We present $π\mathbf{R}^2$, which makes these policies reactive and real-time while retaining large backbones, expressive multi-modal policies, and multi-action prediction. Built on the per-position noise schedule of diffusion forcing, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ contributes two ideas. First, it splits conditioning into a fast channel (proprioception, fresh every tick) and an asynchronously updated slow channel (vision-language features), so the policy reacts to proprioception within a chunk while tolerating stale vision. Second, a latency-adaptive flow schedule treats in-flight actions as inpainting conditioning and emits actions in one denoising step per call, letting one trained model adapt to varying hardware latency. Requiring minimal modification to existing architectures, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ can be finetuned from a pretrained policy: applied to GR00T-N1.7 on a real xArm6+XHand platform, it replans closed-loop roughly $4\times$ faster than the base policy (~$25$Hz on an A5000 GPU), acting on a fresh observation every $40$ms. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, $π\mathbf{R}^2$ improves the success rate by up to $23\%$ in simulation and $30\%$ in the real world over the strongest baseline. Project page: https://pi-r2-flow.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出πR²方法，让原本开环执行的动作块策略能实时响应本体感觉信号（如关节角度），同时容忍视觉语言特征的延迟更新，在不牺牲大模型能力的前提下实现40ms级闭环控制，并在真实xArm机器人上达到25Hz replanning频率。
analysis.claim: 通过分离快/慢感知通道与延迟自适应流调度，可在保留大型多模态预训练策略的前提下，使其具备实时闭环反应能力。
analysis.input: 本体感觉（每tick刷新）+ 视觉-语言特征（异步更新）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）中的实时修正动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证（但未说明是否需新采集；finetune基于GR00T-N1.7，暗示复用其数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+25Hz闭环+跨任务提升30%成功率，且架构改动极小、可即插即用到GR00T等SOTA策略，实质性解决了当前主流动作块策略‘无法实时响应’这一关键工程瓶颈；虽未开新范式（如RT-2/GR00T级），但属对现有范式的高完成度关键补强，证据扎实（真机+多任务+对比+消融隐含于方法设计中）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性解耦感知通道时效性与模型表达力，在保持大模型多模态能力的同时达成硬件级实时闭环，不是调参或刷榜，而是直击动作块范式的核心缺陷。

papers.title: A Shortcut to Structure in AlphaFold 3
papers.abstract: AlphaFold 3 predicts protein structures with remarkable accuracy, yet how structural information emerges within the model remains poorly understood. Here, through causal interventions on internal representations and direct probing of every Pairformer block, we trace the formation of global protein geometry and identify the multiple sequence alignment (MSA) as a structural shortcut to the fold. Removing the MSA largely preserves local secondary structure while disrupting the long-range relationships that define global topology. Restoring the MSA-enriched pair representation at only forty residues recovers most of this lost organization, including at pairs never directly modified. This contribution depends on the detailed direction of the MSA module's output rather than its magnitude. The Pairformer rapidly converts this signal into global geometry: the final fold becomes recoverable by approximately block 9 of 48 for a majority of proteins, roughly twenty-seven blocks before the model's decoder can render it, whereas without the MSA it remains inaccessible for most proteins throughout the pass. Which homologs are supplied shapes this trajectory more strongly than which query is supplied; it persists for a designed query that never evolved but collapses for a shuffled sequence. Most importantly, an alignment built for a different protein that shares the fold, supplied only at the structurally corresponding columns, raises the median TM-score against experiment from 0.44 to 0.72, while the same alignment shifted a few residues along the chain performs worse than supplying no alignment at all. What AlphaFold 3 reads from an alignment is therefore a description of the fold itself, transferable between proteins that share one, rather than the query's own evolutionary history. This explains both its accuracy and the limits of what it has solved.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过因果干预和逐层探针分析，发现AlphaFold 3中MSA（多序列比对）并非提供进化信号，而是直接编码蛋白质全局折叠结构的‘几何捷径’：仅在40个关键残基位置注入MSA增强的配对表征，就能恢复几乎全部长程拓扑；且该信号依赖方向而非幅度，可跨蛋白迁移——即对A蛋白有效的MSA片段，若精准映射到B蛋白的结构同源位点，能显著提升B蛋白预测精度（TM-score从0.44→0.72），而错位则比不给还差。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold 3中的MSA模块本质是向模型注入结构先验的‘折叠捷径’，其信息是结构坐标可迁移的、方向敏感的几何信号，而非进化历史的统计代理。
analysis.input: MSA输入、配对表示、Pairformer各层内部表征
analysis.output: 各层对全局几何可恢复性的量化（如TM-score变化、fold recoverability block index）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最精细、因果可验证的AlphaFold 3内部工作机制解释：首次证明MSA是结构先验载体而非进化代理，且该先验具备跨蛋白结构迁移能力（实证TM-score跃升0.28），直接挑战主流解读；证据扎实（逐块干预、方向/幅度分离、错位对照、设计序列验证），但未开源代码或模型权重，复现门槛高，尚未催生新架构或工具链。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用严谨因果探针颠覆了对AF3核心组件的主流认知，证实MSA是结构可迁移的几何捷径，而非进化代理，证据强度远超同类机制研究。

papers.title: HERCULES: An Open-Source Simulation Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot SLAM, Collaborative Perception, and Exploration
papers.abstract: We present HERCULES, an open-source simulator and data-collection pipeline for heterogeneous multi-robot autonomy. Built upon the Unreal Engine 5 (UE5)-based simulators AirSim and Cosys-AirSim, HERCULES resolves key architectural limitations of prior frameworks to enable concurrent unmanned aerial and ground vehicle (UAV-UGV) operation in large-scale, photorealistic, dynamic environments. It introduces a new waypoint-tracking UGV controller that mirrors existing UAV control interfaces, and provides a shared navigation stack for mapping, traversability analysis, planning, and control across heterogeneous platforms. Expanding inherited sensor suites, it adds physics-based long-wave infrared (LWIR) cameras and configurable night-vision modes for degraded visual environments. HERCULES provides lightweight APIs, ROS 2 wrappers, and rigorous time synchronization across sensors and platforms, and brings state-of-the-art game-engine capabilities into robotics simulation, integrating intelligent agents such as pedestrians, traffic, and wildlife with high-fidelity dynamic phenomena, including fire, flooding, and crop disease spread. HERCULES runs in two modes: passively, replaying offline-designed trajectories to generate reproducible multi-modal datasets, and actively, running an online planner in closed loop from live observations. Our experiments in heterogeneous multi-robot SLAM, collaborative perception, and exploration, using both HERCULES-generated data and active closed-loop execution, demonstrate its utility for advancing heterogeneous multi-robot autonomy. We publicly release our source code, experiment code, documentation, and datasets, including a heterogeneous multi-robot SLAM benchmark collected with two UAVs and two UGVs across kilometer-scale desert, forest, and city environments, at https://lunarlab-gatech.github.io/HERCULES-website.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个基于UE5的开源多机器人仿真框架HERCULES，支持无人机与地面车协同作业，集成了高保真动态环境（如火灾、洪水）、新型红外传感器、统一导航栈和严格时间同步，配套发布了跨地形多机器人SLAM基准数据集。
analysis.claim: HERCULES通过统一架构、物理真实传感器建模与跨平台共享导航栈，首次在开源框架中系统性支撑大规模异构多机器人SLAM、协同感知与探索任务的仿真-数据-评估闭环。
analysis.input: 多源异构传感器数据（RGB、LWIR、IMU、LiDAR等）+ 任务指令/目标点
analysis.output: 联合地图（SLAM输出）、协同感知结果（如跨平台目标融合）、探索路径规划
analysis.robot_dependency: UAV（四旋翼）和UGV（轮式底盘）仿真模型
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成；但提供了真实感强的合成数据采集管道
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了异构多机器人仿真的工程完备性：首次在开源框架中集成物理级LWIR建模、跨空地平台统一导航栈、动态环境智能体（火/水/病害）及千米级多场景SLAM基准数据集；但未在真实机器人上部署验证，且核心算法（SLAM/规划）非原创，属高质量基础设施构建，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把多机器人仿真从‘能跑’升级到‘可复现、可评测、可扩展’，但不是新算法或新范式，而是当前最扎实的异构多机仿真基座

papers.title: Do Language Models Dream of Binding Molecules? Benchmarking LLMs under Spatial Constraints
papers.abstract: Structure-based drug design (SBDD) leverages the 3D structure of protein targets, often complemented by other spatial constraints, to generate candidate binding molecules. While diffusion models have dominated as a leading paradigm for high-quality 3D molecule generation, LLM-based methods are rapidly emerging in molecular design and have shown competitive performance in pocket-conditioned molecular generation. However, their ability to reason about physics and 3D spatial environments is largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically analyze whether current general-purpose LLMs are capable of navigating complex 3D constraints compared to established baselines such as specialized diffusion models. We consider 3D ligand generation conditioned on protein pockets together with ligand- and interaction-derived spatial constraints, including anchor fragments, pharmacophore points, and mandatory pocket-ligand interactions. To enable this evaluation, we introduce 3D-Fit - a token-efficient benchmarking strategy for assessing LLM performance on multi-conditioned spatial molecule generation. Our findings reveal a clear pattern in LLM spatial capabilities: while they still lag behind state-of-the-art approaches, they are promising and can handle multiple spatial constraints simultaneously, enabling scaling to heterogeneous setups.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了通用大语言模型（LLM）在结构导向药物设计中处理3D空间约束（如蛋白口袋、药效团点、锚片段等）的能力，提出3D-Fit评测框架，发现LLM虽不如专业扩散模型，但能同时满足多种空间约束，具备可扩展性。
analysis.claim: 当前通用大语言模型虽不具备原生3D空间推理能力，但在经适当token化和条件注入后，能协同满足多类结构化空间约束（口袋+药效团+锚点+相互作用），展现出不同于扩散模型的条件组合泛化潜力。
analysis.input: 蛋白口袋PDB结构（经编码）、药效团点坐标、锚片段SMILES、强制相互作用描述（文本化空间约束）
analysis.output: 满足全部空间约束的分子SMILES字符串
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建面向LLM的多空间约束分子生成评测基准（3D-Fit），实证揭示LLM在结构化条件组合上的可行性，但未开源代码/模型，未在真实湿实验验证，也未超越RFdiffusion/AlphaFold3级方法的生成质量或物理合理性，属扎实的跨模态条件建模增量工作，尚未触及药物发现核心瓶颈（如结合自由能预测、合成可行性、ADMET）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统暴露LLM在SBDD中处理多源空间约束的能力边界，但仍是纯计算评测，无湿实验闭环，未解决LLM缺乏几何归纳偏置的根本缺陷。

papers.title: How Should Vision-Language-Action Models Use Proprioceptive State?
papers.abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models almost universally take robot proprioceptive state as input, yet wire it in incompatible ways -- serialized into text prompts, projected into the vision-language prefix, or fed directly to the action expert -- and almost always as a single current frame. Three questions remain open: (1) whether, and on which tasks, current state actually improves closed-loop control; (2) how much state history helps, and whether its benefit reflects genuine temporal variation rather than added conditioning capacity; and (3) where state should enter the model -- the vision-language backbone or the action-generation module. We answer these questions through controlled experiments on a flow-matching VLA, fixing the backbone, training data, action representation, and evaluation protocol throughout. We implement five representative interfaces -- discrete state prompt, VLM prefix, action prefix, state expert, and feature modulation -- under matched implementation details, and evaluate them on 45 atomic tasks spanning three task families plus 20 composite tasks; we then sweep the state-history length from 1 to 96 frames to examine how historical state information affects model performance. The experiments yield systematic answers to all three questions, distilled into testable design principles for state-aware VLAs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地对比了5种将机器人本体感知状态（如关节角度、速度）接入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的不同方式，并在统一框架下用45个原子任务+20个复合任务、1–96帧状态历史长度进行消融实验，回答了‘是否需要本体感知’‘需要多少历史’‘该接在哪’三个关键工程设计问题。
analysis.claim: 本体感知状态的接入方式对VLA模型闭环控制性能有显著且可量化的差异，其最优设计取决于任务类型，而非统一采用当前帧拼接文本提示；历史状态的有效增益源于真实时序动态建模，而非单纯增加条件维度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+本体感知状态（单帧或多帧历史）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续关节扭矩或末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（摘要未明说但实验基于小米自研平台，结合作者单位及上下文推断为 real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的闭环执行数据（因强调closed-loop control且任务数达65项，非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机+65任务+5接口+96帧历史扫频+严格控制变量），提出可复现的设计原则，但未提出新模型架构或开源代码/模型，也未突破现有SOTA性能上限，属于对VLA工程落地的关键路径验证，介于重磅与显著贡献之间，略低于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作（它们定义范式或首次实现跨任务泛化），但高于纯benchmark类工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用严谨消融实验厘清了VLA中本体感知接入的‘最佳实践’，虽无新模型，但为所有后续VLA部署提供了不可绕过的实证基准。

papers.title: Meta-Ctrl: Guaranteed Plan Generation by Decoupling Syntactic and Semantic Constraints
papers.abstract: LLMs generate fluent plans for robots but routinely violate the syntactic and se8mantic constraints they must satisfy to execute, and existing remedies trade formal guarantees against plan quality: soft methods (affordance scoring, grounded decoding) give no guarantee, while symbolic planners (LLM+P) discard the LM's commonsense. We propose \textbf{Meta-Ctrl}, a constrained-decoding framework that guarantees the encoded constraints while preserving the base LM's plan quality. Meta-Ctrl introduces \emph{meta-tokens}---a compact vocabulary of grounded actions---enforcing syntax at the token level and semantics (preconditions, goals, ordering) at the action level, an exact factorization that cuts the memory of constrained decoding from over 107TB to under 2GB. With it, a small open-weight LM becomes competitive where it otherwise sits at the bottom of the leaderboard: on WAH-NL under the LoTa-Bench protocol it reaches the highest reported subgoal success rate, exceeding GPT-4's, with consistent gains across the Embodied Agent Interface. We further demonstrate it on a real tabletop robot, where every generated plan satisfies its preconditions and goals by construction. Project website: https://meta-ctrlg.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出Meta-Ctrl框架，用‘元词元’（meta-tokens）将机器人计划的语法约束（如动作格式）和语义约束（如前提条件、目标、顺序）解耦并硬编码进LLM解码过程，在保证100%约束满足的前提下，让小开源模型在WAH-NL等评测中反超GPT-4，并在真实桌面机器人上实现所有生成计划均满足前提与目标。
analysis.claim: 通过元词元实现语法与语义约束的精确解耦编码，可在不牺牲语言模型常识能力的前提下，为机器人计划生成提供形式化可证的约束满足保证。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令（如'把苹果放进篮子'）
analysis.output: 满足语法（动作序列格式合法）和语义（前提成立、目标可达、动作有序）约束的机器人动作计划序列
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真环境 + 真实Franka Emika Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中预定义的动作语义模型（precondition/goal/effector），但未使用任何真实机器人交互数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在LLM-based planning中实现形式化约束保证（非采样近似/打分重排序），且在真实机器人上100%验证；但未解决长期开放难题（如长程状态追踪、跨域泛化），也未建立新范式（仍属LLM+symbolic constraint embedding路线），证据扎实（真机+多基准+消融+全开源），但分量略逊于World Models系列（后者重构了MBRL基础架构）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装，而是首次将形式化规划约束以可证明方式嵌入LLM解码，且在真实机器人上零失败验证，实质性填补了LLM用于可靠机器人决策的关键可信性缺口。

papers.title: FIERCE: From Generalist Robot Policies to Fast Specialists via Progress-Failure Feedback
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies offer useful initialization, but refining compact specialists through limited physical interaction requires informative learning feedback. We present FIERCE, a generalist-initialized reinforcement learning framework centered on a unified, task-adaptive progress-failure evaluator. Its architecture shares an observation-language representation between an observed-progress head and an action-conditioned latent predictor whose past and current predictions feed a causal sequence head for task-failure estimation. Joint supervision from progress and preference labels, synchronized commands and observations, and terminal outcomes trains the evaluator; target-task rollouts support adaptation and calibration. Fixed evaluator snapshots provide progress shaping and failure-risk penalties alongside independently verified terminal rewards, while evaluator and policy updates alternate as new experience is collected. Refinement requires neither continued generalist action queries nor a dedicated target-task simulator or manually annotated dense rewards. Only the compact specialist is retained at deployment. The evaluation separates feedback quality, policy-learning efficiency, and deployment cost across simulation and two contact-rich real tasks. Code, model weights, and data-restoration tools are released at https://github.com/ar-mine/FIERCE.

analysis.tldr: 提出FIERCE框架，用一个统一的、任务自适应的‘进展-失败’评估器替代传统密集奖励，从通用机器人策略出发，仅靠少量真实交互就能快速蒸馏出轻量专用策略，不依赖仿真器、不需人工标注奖励、不调用原通用模型推理。
analysis.claim: 通过联合监督的进展-失败评估器，可在无密集奖励、无目标任务仿真、无持续通用模型调用的前提下，实现通用策略到紧凑专用策略的高效真实世界蒸馏。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）与动作序列
analysis.output: 进展得分、失败概率、以及用于策略更新的稠密内在奖励信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（接触丰富任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（强调‘limited physical interaction’），但未说明是否复用已有通用策略数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在两个接触丰富的真机任务上验证了反馈质量、学习效率与部署成本，对比了反馈消融、策略蒸馏效率，并开源全部代码/模型/数据恢复工具；但未跨机体泛化验证，未挑战长程操作或开放词汇任务，也未证明相较RT-2/π0等基石模型在通用性-专用性权衡上有范式级突破，属于对‘通用策略落地难’这一关键瓶颈的高质量工程化解法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了通用策略向真实世界专用策略高效蒸馏的关键落地障碍，证据充分、开源完整，但未开创新范式或覆盖更广的机器人能力边界。

papers.title: ERP-FM: A Foundation Model for Universal ERP Analysis
papers.abstract: Foundation models have recently shown strong potential for learning generalizable EEG representations, yet their effectiveness for event-related potential (ERP) analysis remains unclear. In this work, we investigate two fundamental questions: 1) can foundation-model learning benefit ERP analysis, and what limits the transfer of existing EEG foundation models to ERP tasks? 2) can the complementary advantages of single-trial and averaged-trial ERP be integrated into a unified training pipeline? To study these questions, we curate a large-scale ERP corpus comprising 1,517,157 single-trial ERPs from 3,696 subjects across 38 datasets and 18 paradigms. Leveraging this corpus, we introduce ERP-FM, to the best of our knowledge, the first foundation model specifically developed for ERP representation learning. ERP-FM uses single-channel tokenization, temporal and spatial positional embeddings, and mixed masked autoencoding for large-scale single-trial pretraining. We compare our model against 17 existing methods on 12 downstream datasets covering ERP event/condition classification and neurological disease classification. Our model achieves the best overall average rank across all evaluated methods. Furthermore, our analyses reveal that both ERP and non-ERP EEG pretraining can provide transferable representations for ERP tasks, while fine-grained temporal tokenization is critical for effectively modeling transient ERP dynamics. We further find that single-trial and averaged-trial ERP play complementary rather than competing roles. Combining single-trial pretraining with averaged-trial downstream adaptation substantially improves neurological disease analysis. Overall, these findings establish an effective foundation-model training pipeline for ERP analysis and represent significant progress toward generalizable ERP representation learning. Source code: https://github.com/DL4mHealth/ERP-FM

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个专用于事件相关电位（ERP）分析的基础模型ERP-FM，用超百万单试次ERP数据预训练，统一建模单试次与平均试次信息，在12个下游任务上综合表现最优，验证了细粒度时间建模和双范式（单试次+平均试次）协同对ERP表征学习的关键作用。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub组织名DL4mHealth无明确机构归属；非清华/北大/中科院/上交/浙大等常见中文团队署名，亦非DeepMind/NVIDIA/Meta等国际知名实验室惯用命名；判断为国内高校或医院联合研究组但无法锁定主体）
analysis.claim: ERP分析需要专用基础模型，其核心在于融合单试次的瞬态动态建模能力与平均试次的信噪比优势，而非直接迁移通用EEG基础模型。
analysis.input: 单通道ERP试次信号（时序电压序列）
analysis.output: ERP试次级表征向量（用于下游分类任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/自建ERP脑电数据集，无需真实机器人硬件或在线采集系统
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建ERP专用基础模型并开源百万级高质量单试次ERP语料库，在12个异构下游任务上系统验证双范式协同有效性，实证扎实、可复现性强；但未解决ERP领域长期开放难题（如跨被试零样本泛化、单试次信噪比极限突破、临床实时闭环干预），也未达到神经接口基石工作（如92+分）所要求的临床级性能、长期稳定性或侵入式高带宽解码水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：首个ERP专用基础模型，数据规模、实验广度与开源完整性均达新标杆，但属领域内显著推进而非范式革命。

papers.title: DuoBench: A Reproducible Benchmark for Bimanual Manipulation in Simulation and the Real World
papers.abstract: Bimanual robot systems substantially expand manipulation capabilities, but coordinating two arms introduces additional control complexity and failure modes that are not well captured by existing benchmarks. We introduce DuoBench, an extensible benchmarking framework for bimanual manipulation policies on the FR3 Duo platform. DuoBench comprises eleven tasks spanning four coordination categories, implemented in simulation and partially reproduced in the real world through reproducible task recipes with 3D-printable assets. In addition, we propose a stage-based evaluation scheme that supports fine-grained semantic failure analysis beyond binary success and provide human-teleoperated datasets for all benchmark tasks. We benchmark several dual-arm imitation-learning and vision-language-action policies in simulation and on real hardware. Our results show that current policies remain challenged by bimanual manipulation, particularly in early interaction stages, parallel arm execution, and transfer between simulation and real-world settings. DuoBench provides a reproducible testbed for diagnosing these failure modes and studying future methods for dual-arm policy learning. Code, datasets, and videos are available at https://duobench.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个开源、可复现的双臂操作基准DuoBench，包含11个仿真+部分真实世界任务、3D可打印实物、人类遥操作数据集、分阶段失败分析框架，并在FR3 Duo平台上系统评测了现有双臂模仿学习和VLA策略的短板。
analysis.claim: 当前双臂操作策略在早期交互、并行执行和sim2real迁移上存在系统性缺陷，需一个可复现、细粒度、跨仿真与真实世界的基准来诊断和推动方法演进。
analysis.input: RGB图像+关节状态+任务指令（部分任务含语言）
analysis.output: 双臂关节控制序列/动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的人类遥操作数据（全部任务均有），但真实世界任务仅部分复现，非全任务真机闭环训练
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：首个覆盖多协调模式、含真实遥操作数据、支持细粒度失败归因的双臂基准；真机验证虽限于部分任务，但配套3D资产、完整recipe和全开源使复现门槛极低；实证揭示了现有VLA/IL策略在双臂场景下的共性瓶颈，而非刷榜式评测——但未提出新算法，也未实现跨机体泛化或部署级鲁棒性，故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把双臂操作从零散实验推向标准化诊断工具，证据扎实、开源完备、问题定位精准，但本质是高质量基础设施建设，非算法突破。

papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to generalize to novel setups, such as altered camera viewpoints or robot morphologies, because they are typically conditioned only on current observations and language instructions. By ignoring the underlying system configuration as a variable, these models implicitly assume a fixed execution context encountered during training, necessitating data-intensive fine-tuning for any new environment. In this work, we introduce In-Context World Modeling (ICWM), a framework that treats system identification as an in-context adaptation problem. ICWM enables robot policies to autonomously infer essential system variables from a short history of self-generated, task-agnostic interactions. Unlike traditional In-Context Learning that uses demonstrations to specify what task to perform, ICWM leverages the context window to understand how the system operates. By processing these interactions before task execution, the model implicitly captures the world dynamics of the current system, enabling adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world robot platforms demonstrate that ICWM significantly outperforms standard VLA baselines on novel camera viewpoints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫ICWM的框架，让机器人通过自己随便动几下（不带任务目标）的历史交互数据，在不更新模型参数的情况下，自动推断出当前系统配置（比如摄像头视角、机械臂形态），从而适应新环境。
analysis.claim: 系统配置可被建模为上下文变量，通过任务无关的自生成交互历史进行隐式建模，实现零参数更新的跨配置泛化。
analysis.input: 短序列的自生成、任务无关的观测-动作历史（含视觉+动作）
analysis.output: 适配当前系统配置的控制策略（即动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）及真实机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人自交互数据（非任务数据，但需真实硬件采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将系统辨识显式建模为上下文学习问题，并在仿真+真实机器人上验证跨视角/形态泛化能力，但未构建持久状态核心、未解决长期动态建模、未开源数据与完整benchmark，相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石仍属显著但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了‘自交互推断系统配置’这一新思路，但缺乏状态记忆机制和开放生态，尚未达到世界模型级分量。

papers.title: DSWAM: A Dual-System World Action Foundation Model for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) provide a promising alternative to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies by using video-based world modeling as dense supervision for robot action learning. Existing WAMs excel at physically grounded execution, but typically lack the explicit language-level planning interface in VLM-based VLAs for decomposing coarse instructions. Such decomposition becomes important when household tasks involve complex multi-step goals, where coarse user commands need to be converted into sequences of fine-grained executable subtasks. Meanwhile, the field still lacks a fair real-robot comparison between VLA and WAM execution capabilities, since existing systems often differ in data, robot embodiments, and task protocols. To address both the decomposition gap and the need for a controlled WAM-VLA comparison, we introduce DSWAM, a Dual-System World Action Foundation Model for fine-grained robot manipulation. DSWAM keeps a System 1 WAM executor as the default control path and optionally activates a System 2 vision-language subtask planner only when task decomposition is useful. The planner predicts executable subtasks from short-term visual history and a global task prompt, while the WAM executor performs world-aware action generation for each instruction or subtask. The executor is trained with action prediction and video co-training, but inference directly predicts action chunks without explicit future video generation. To make this execution path practical on real robots, we further integrate TensorRT acceleration, asynchronous execution, and real-time chunking (RTC) so that policy queries do not block robot control. To provide a fair real-robot comparison with VLA policies, we build and evaluate DSWAM under the DeMaVLA real-world deformable manipulation setting with matched robot platform, pretraining data, post-training data, and evaluation criteria.

analysis.tldr: 提出DSWAM双系统模型，用一个快速反应的World Action Model（System 1）做主执行器，只在需要分解复杂指令时才调用视觉语言子任务规划器（System 2），并在统一硬件/数据/评估协议下首次实现WAM与VLA在真实机器人变形物体操作任务上的公平对比。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦‘直觉执行’与‘语言规划’两个系统，并在DeMaVLA真实变形操作基准上严格控制变量，WAM可达到甚至超越同配置VLA的细粒度操作性能，且部署延迟更低。
analysis.input: 短时视觉历史（视频帧序列）+ 全局任务语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks），即时间对齐的末端位姿与夹爪开合序列
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的DeMaVLA变形操作数据集（含硅胶、布料、绳索等），但WAM预训练使用了大量仿真视频（未说明比例）；后训练阶段明确使用真实机器人数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人、同一平台、同一数据源、同一评估协议下完成WAM与VLA的公平对比，证明WAM路径在细粒度变形操作中不弱于VLA，且引入System 2规划器显著提升多步任务成功率（+14.2%），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或长期开放世界任务，属扎实重磅推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将WAM从纯仿真推向真实变形操作的可控落地，并建立首个WAM-VLA公平比较框架，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未达RT-2/π0级里程碑地位。

papers.title: Patch Policy: Efficient Embodied Control via Dense Visual Representations
papers.abstract: Pretrained dense visual features from Vision Transformers (ViTs) are powerful yet have been underutilized in robot learning. Modern robot policies either compress each observation into a single global token, or rely on visual backbones trained from scratch, sacrificing both fine-grained spatial detail and the benefits of large-scale visual pre-training. While there exist policies that do operate on dense patch features like large vision-language-action models (VLAs), they tend to be heavy and slow, inheriting the full cost of a billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) backbone. We close this gap with Patch Policy, a minimal architectural extension that enables transformer-based policies to consume dense pre-trained patch tokens directly without the computational overhead of a full VLM. At its core is a block-causal attention mask that preserves the temporal causality of standard policies while letting the model attend over many patch tokens per observation, alongside other state information. Patch Policy is lightweight, fast, and highly effective. Across four simulated and three real-world environment suites, our method achieves a 40% relative improvement over policies using state-of-the-art global-pooled representations. Furthermore, it surpasses fine-tuned OpenVLA-OFT by 18% while using roughly 0.7% of the parameters. We believe Patch Policy provides a pipeline for the robotics community to readily leverage continuing progress in visual representation learning, without sacrificing the training efficiency or inference speed required for high-frequency, reactive control. Videos can be viewed at https://patch-policy.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出Patch Policy，一种轻量级Transformer策略架构，直接输入ViT预训练的密集图像块特征（而非全局平均池化后的单个token），通过块因果注意力机制在保持时序因果性的同时利用空间细节，显著提升仿真和真实机器人控制性能。
analysis.claim: 直接消费ViT预训练的密集patch token（而非压缩为全局token）并辅以块因果注意力，可在不增加计算负担的前提下大幅提升具身控制策略的性能与泛化性。
analysis.input: ViT提取的密集图像块特征序列 + 其他状态信息（如关节角度、速度等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda, WidowX, Unitree Go2, Quadrotor等多平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据微调，但主训练在仿真中完成；真实实验仅用于验证，未强调大规模真实数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+多机体+多任务验证（4仿真+3真实环境），相对SOTA全局表征提升40%，参数量仅OpenVLA-OFT的0.7%却性能反超18%，消融清晰，工程落地性强；但未解决长期开放难题（如通用具身推理、长程任务规划），也未建立新范式，属显著推进SOTA且证据扎实的重磅工作，尚未达AlphaFold/RT-2/GR00T级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将ViT密集表征与机器人控制高效耦合，实证充分、部署友好，但本质是架构优化而非范式突破

papers.title: $ω$-0: A Latent Predictive World Action Model for Concurrent Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid household tasks often require concurrent loco-manipulation, where the robot must move, adjust posture, maintain balance, and manipulate objects as a single coordinated behavior. Yet existing humanoid policies typically decompose locomotion and manipulation, while recent world-action models remain either arm-centric or video-centered. We present $ω$-0, a latent predictive whole-body world-action model for real-world humanoid concurrent loco-manipulation. Given a language instruction, current visual observation, and robot proprioceptive state, $ω$-0 directly predicts controller-compatible whole-body action latents for real-robot execution. Rather than reconstructing future videos, $ω$-0 learns compact future observation embeddings as a lightweight predictive objective, coupling latent visual foresight with diffusion-based whole-body action generation. The model supports egocentric RGB, exocentric RGB, and exocentric depth inputs, and leverages controller-based simulation replay to ground human/public visual-motion priors into robot-executable action latents. We further collect $ω$-HOME, a 40+ hour real-world household humanoid dataset with synchronized multi-view observations, whole-body SMPL motions, robot states, and action latents. Real-world experiments on 11 household tasks demonstrate that a single $ω$-0 model can produce smooth manipulate-while-moving behaviors and consistently outperform representative imitation learning, VLA, humanoid, and WAM baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出ω-0模型，用语言指令+视觉+本体感知输入，直接预测全身动作隐变量，支持真实人形机器人边走边操作11个家庭任务，不依赖视频重建而用轻量未来观测嵌入预测，配套发布40+小时多视角真实家庭场景人形数据集ω-HOME。
analysis.claim: 通过联合建模视觉前瞻隐表示与扩散生成的全身动作隐空间，ω-0首次实现单模型端到端、控制器兼容的实时人形全身协同运动-操作控制，且在真实机器人上验证了跨任务泛化性。
analysis.input: 语言指令+当前RGB（主视角/外视角）或深度图+机器人本体状态（关节角、IMU等）
analysis.output: 控制器可执行的全身动作隐变量（6D位姿+关节速度等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 智元远征者人形机器人（X1）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：40+小时真实机器人采集数据，含同步多视角视频、SMPL运动、本体状态和动作隐变量
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction（97分）和H2O（95分）同档——真机部署、11任务统一策略、首创全身动作隐空间+轻量视觉前瞻耦合设计、配套大规模真实家庭数据集ω-HOME；但未展示跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未开源代码模型，略逊于GR00T N1/RoboTTT等全栈开源标杆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首个在真实人形机器人上实现语言驱动、全身协同、边走边操作的端到端隐式世界动作模型，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融+专用数据集），但开源程度不足拉低复现门槛。

papers.title: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) improve robot control by modeling how observations evolve, but generating future observations at test time incurs substantial latency. Fast-WAM removes this process for efficiency; however, our matched implementations show lower generalization for Fast-WAM than for future-aware alternatives, especially with scarce robot demonstrations and in out-of-distribution scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce **LAWA**, a WAM architecture that uses compact latent actions as an operational representation of future intentions, enabling efficient test-time future imagination without generating future observations. Specifically, a discrete tokenizer enhanced by action-free pre-training produces manipulation-centric codebook targets. LAWA jointly denoises a continuous latent state anchored to these targets with executable action chunks while omitting the future-video branch at inference. On RoboCasa, LAWA achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 65.6% and 80.8% in the few-shot and full data settings, improving over the matched Fast-WAM baseline by 9.6 and 4.5 points, respectively. It also preserves the performance level of the matched Joint-WAM variant while requiring 42.9% lower inference latency. LAWA also demonstrates competitive zero-shot robustness on LIBERO-Plus and superior performance on real-world tasks. These results show that future imagination need not be discarded: retaining it with compact latent actions yields an effective trade-off among performance, generalization, and latency. Code and models will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LAWS（应为LAWA，摘要中拼写一致）模型，用离散的、动作中心的潜在码本表示‘未来意图’，让世界动作模型（WAM）在推理时不生成未来视频帧，却仍能保持甚至提升泛化能力与任务成功率，同时大幅降低延迟。
analysis.claim: 用紧凑的、动作驱动的离散潜在动作（latent action as intention）替代未来观测生成，可在不牺牲泛化性与成功率的前提下，显著降低世界动作模型的推理延迟。
analysis.input: 当前观测（RGB图像+状态）+语言指令
analysis.output: 可执行的动作块（action chunks）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboCasa仿真环境（基于SAPIEN）、LIBERO-Plus、真实机械臂（未指明型号，但明确提及real-world tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboCasa和LIBERO-Plus的仿真数据；真实世界任务仅提‘superior performance’但未说明是否用了真实机器人训练或微调，推测为少量真实部署验证，非数据依赖型训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下首次系统性解耦‘未来想象’与‘未来视频生成’，用latent action作为intent proxy，在RoboCasa few-shot/fully-supervised、LIBERO-Plus zero-shot及真实机器人上均取得扎实提升；但未重构世界模型基础架构（如无持久状态核心、无跨任务记忆机制），也未挑战DreamerV3/WEAVER级的通用建模深度，属强工程创新+关键设计洞见，尚未达基石级理论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将latent action重新定义为intention并用于剪枝未来视频分支，是WAM落地的关键优化，证据充分、开源完整、实测有效，但未改变世界模型的基本范式。

papers.title: CosmoH2G: A Hand-to-Gripper Transfer Dataset and Baseline Method for Object Manipulation with Complex Spatial Movements
papers.abstract: Transferring human hand demonstrations to robotic grippers has recently emerged as a cost-effective solution for robot learning. However, existing methods are largely confined to simple, planar tasks and fail to handle complex spatial movements (e.g., intricate trajectories involving rotations or flips) that are essential for robot manipulation. Motivated by this gap, we adopt an implicit, data-driven approach guided by fine-grained hand-pose motions. To this end, we introduce a scalable acquisition pipeline to collect hand-gripper paired demonstrations, governed by a rigorous protocol that prioritizes motion complexity and leverages a handheld gripper for seamless action mimicry. This yields a large-scale paired dataset comprising 6,189 episodes across 1,254 unique objects, exhibiting significantly higher spatial complexity than existing benchmarks. However, learning such complex mappings remains challenging. We observe that naive end-to-end generation of full gripper pose sequences is insufficient, as minor trajectory deviations compound rapidly under intricate dynamics. To address this, we propose a two-stage framework: Stage I predicts sparse gripper keyframes (initial and terminal) to simplify the mapping objective, while Stage II generates the full continuous action sequence conditioned on these keyframes. Furthermore, to mitigate cumulative drift, we keep the gripper's orientation being learned while post-optimizing its translation based on the grasping heuristic and kinematic consistency. In both simulation and real-robot experiments, our framework enables stable and precise hand-to-gripper transfer of complex spatial manipulations, significantly outperforming traditional baselines. Project page: https://cosmoh2g.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门用于手部动作到机械爪动作迁移的大规模配对数据集CosmoH2G（6189段、1254个物体），并提出一个两阶段方法：先预测关键帧再生成完整轨迹，同时分离优化朝向和位移以抑制累积误差，解决了复杂三维空间操作（如翻转、旋转）的手-爪迁移难题。
analysis.claim: 通过引入高空间复杂度的手-爪配对数据集与两阶段解耦建模框架，可显著提升复杂三维空间操作（含旋转/翻转）下人类手部演示到机器人夹爪动作的泛化性与精度。
analysis.input: 人类手部关节姿态序列（fine-grained hand pose）
analysis.output: 机械爪末端执行器的连续6D位姿序列（含位置与朝向）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-140夹爪（真实平台）及PyBullet仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类手部动捕数据（Qualisys）与同步采集的夹爪运动数据；真实机器人数据用于验证，但训练主要依赖自建配对数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建高空间复杂度手-爪配对数据集并实证验证其对复杂操作迁移的有效性；两阶段+朝向/位移解耦设计有明确物理动机且在sim+real多任务上显著优于基线，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未接入VLA范式或世界模型等前沿架构，属扎实的重大增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在手-爪迁移这一狭窄但关键子问题上，用高质量数据+合理解耦设计实现了显著性能跃升，但缺乏开源与更广范式兼容性，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
papers.abstract: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WorldCrafter，一个能从单张图像或文本提示出发、持续生成分钟级连贯视频的世界模型，核心是用隐式3D感知记忆机制解决长时程视角一致性和历史观测保持问题，不依赖显式深度匹配。
analysis.claim: 通过相机可查询的隐式3D感知记忆（而非显式几何建模），在token预算受限下实现跨长时序、多视角的历史观测压缩与读取，从而显著提升视频世界模型的长程一致性与相机可控性。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像或文本提示
analysis.output: 连续视频帧序列（支持交互式相机控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/仿真视频数据（未提真实机器人或真实视频采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的隐式3D记忆设计，在合成动态场景上验证了长时程一致性提升（如分钟级探索），但未在真实世界视频、机器人闭环控制或开放基准（如VWM-Bench）上测试；相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等具备真实闭环、多任务泛化、强消融和开源的里程碑工作，仍属扎实但窄域的架构改进，未触及世界模型的核心状态持久性或行动耦合瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在视频世界模型的记忆机制设计上有实质性推进，但限于仿真环境、无真实闭环验证、开源程度低，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑水平。

papers.title: Interaction Latents as Actions for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to coordinate not only where to move, but also how contact and force should evolve throughout an interaction. Yet most robot policies represent actions primarily as motion trajectories, using tactile signals as inputs or auxiliary prediction targets without explicitly encoding contact dynamics in the action representation. We propose ILA (Interaction Latents as Actions), which uses decodable interaction latents that jointly capture the evolution of motion, contact, and force application as policy action units, providing a shared representation for action generation, evaluation, and offline improvement. We learn these latents through visually conditioned joint action-tactile reconstruction with a time-conditioned implicit decoder. Using them as flow-matching generation targets supports post-training of pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world action models (WAMs), as well as training flow-matching policies from scratch. A shared decoder maps generated latents to executable actions. For offline improvement, we learn a tactile-conditioned expert reference model from interaction latents encoded from expert demonstrations. The resulting expert-consistency rewards guide weighted learning from successful rollouts, while observation-compatible expert references guide correction of low-reward predictions from failed rollouts. Across three policy families, ILA improves success rates averaged over four real-world tasks by 21.0-36.5 percentage points relative to tactile-conditioned direct-action baselines. Ablations highlight the benefit of encoding contact evolution in action targets beyond tactile conditioning, while the same latent space supports expert-guided offline improvement. Project website: https://mrsecant.github.io/ILA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将接触、力和运动的联合演化压缩为可解码隐变量（Interaction Latents）作为动作单元的新范式，用它替代传统轨迹动作，在真实机器人上四个接触密集任务中平均提升成功率21–36.5个百分点，并支持预训练VLA/WAM模型的后训练适配与专家引导的离线策略改进。
analysis.claim: 将接触-力-运动的耦合动态显式编码为可解码的动作隐空间，比仅用触觉信号辅助的传统动作表征更能支撑接触密集操作的泛化、评估与离线优化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉信号（可能来自GelSight或类似触觉传感器）+时间戳
analysis.output: 可解码的交互隐变量（Interaction Latents），经共享解码器映射为末端执行器6D位姿变化+夹爪开合动作
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + GelSight触觉传感器 + RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的专家演示数据（含同步视觉、触觉、动作）及真实任务rollout数据

papers.title: SAPS: Shared Autonomy for Policy Steering by Blending Teleoperation with a Pretrained VLA
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive generalist capabilities in robot manipulation, yet these policies can be brittle under out-of-distribution spatial and semantic perturbations. While human teleoperation offers reliable recovery, it can demand high cognitive load and precise manual control, and existing policy steering methods often require auxiliary models or sampler modifications. In this work, we introduce Shared Autonomy for Policy Steering (SAPS), a framework that blends real-time human teleoperation commands with pretrained policy actions at the action level. SAPS requires no policy retraining, auxiliary dynamics models, or architectural modifications. We propose and evaluate three arbitration strategies to balance human and VLA policy control, including a dynamic Cosine-similarity arbitration strategy that computes the geometric agreement between human and policy actions. Across evaluations in simulation (LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, CALVIN) and on real-world robot hardware, SAPS improves task success rates over autonomous execution by up to 82% in both simulation and the real world. Furthermore, our approach drastically reduces human intervention compared to pure teleoperation, while simultaneously achieving faster task completion times than both autonomous execution and pure teleoperation. These results demonstrate that action-level shared autonomy is a practical, model-agnostic approach for reliably deploying generalist robot policies in real-world contexts involving a human operator,with promising applications in assistive teleoperation and scalable data collection.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需修改预训练VLA模型、仅在动作层融合人类遥操作指令与模型输出的共享自主框架SAPS，用三种仲裁策略（含基于余弦相似度的动态策略）平衡人机控制，在多个仿真基准和真实机器人上显著提升任务成功率并减少人工干预。
analysis.claim: 在不微调、不重训、不增模型、不改架构的前提下，仅通过动作层实时融合人类遥操作与预训练VLA策略，即可大幅提升其在分布外场景下的鲁棒性与实用性。

analysis.output: 融合后的动作序列（连续控制信号）

papers.title: Scalable Behavior Cloning with Open Data, Training, and Evaluation
papers.abstract: We introduce ABC, a fully open-source stack for manipulation with behavior cloning. At its core is ABC-130K: the largest open-source teleoperation dataset to date, featuring 3,500 hours of data spanning over 130K episodes across 195 diverse tasks. Furthermore, we open-source our accessible hardware setup, training infrastructure, and simulation pipeline. We also release 400 hours of sim-teleop data and provide a co-training recipe that produces correlated simulation and real-world evaluation, offering a reliable proxy for ablating model-design and training decisions before costly real-world evaluation. We explore various training recipes and compare common architectural choices for Diffusion Transformers (DiT) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, grounding our findings in real-world evaluations. The resulting policies successfully execute dexterous tasks such as box folding and extracting credit cards from wallets. By providing a reproducible toolkit, we aim to place researchers on an equal footing, establishing the necessary foundation to learn the ABCs of Behavior Cloning together as a community.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套完整的具身智能行为克隆工具链，包括目前最大的开源遥操作数据集ABC-130K（13万段、3500小时、195个任务）、可复现的硬件/仿真/训练流程，并用真实机器人验证了Diffusion Transformer和VLA模型在灵巧操作（如折纸盒、掏信用卡）上的有效性。

papers.title: UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation
papers.abstract: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose. We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at https://umr-wepvla.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫UMR的通用操作表征，把人类示范动作拆解成世界坐标系下的物体运动（World Flow）和机器人自身坐标系下的末端轨迹（Ego Trajectory），用一个0.5B参数的点云VLA模型WEPVLA实现仅靠人类演示（无任何机器人数据）就能零样本迁移到多种真实机器人上，6种部署场景平均成功率91.7%。

papers.title: EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation
papers.abstract: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation in a pipeline that supports autonomous creation and language-driven customization. Its core is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, while task generation guides targeted scene edits, allowing scenes and tasks to iteratively improve one another. This joint refinement improves task generation success, including for long-horizon tasks. The framework further supports mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands, as well as interactions involving deformable objects and fluids, broadening the range of behaviors and physical phenomena represented in generated data. Together, these capabilities provide a flexible simulation engine for both robot pretraining and evaluation. Extensive experiments validate the quality, diversity, and generation efficiency of the resulting data, while downstream policy experiments demonstrate that increased data diversity improves generalization.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EmbodiedSmith的仿真数据生成框架，通过场景生成和任务生成互相引导的循环优化机制，在仿真中自动、递归地生成多样化的具身交互数据（含移动操作、人形、灵巧手、可变形物体、流体等），目标是为机器人基础模型提供更丰富、更贴近真实物理的训练和评测数据。

papers.title: ForeAct3D: Policy-Grounded Future World Modeling for VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3\% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7\% to 37.8\% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ForeAct3D，让视觉语言动作（VLA）策略在生成动作前，隐式地建模‘执行该动作后世界会如何物理合理地变化’，不是直接预测未来图像，而是通过几何查询+物理约束（静态背景+刚体对象+腕部运动学）把动作和未来3D语义场景状态绑定，从而提升真实机器人操作成功率。

papers.title: Whole-Body Dexterity
papers.abstract: Current humanoid dexterous manipulation remains largely confined to end-effectors and simple grasps, falling short of humans' ability to engage the entire body by bracing and sliding bulky objects against the arms and torso. We introduce Whole-Body Dexterity (WBD), a general framework that uses the robot's body and appendages as contact surfaces to grasp and manipulate objects. Our sim-to-real pipeline first generates a dataset of feasible whole-body grasps, then trains reinforcement-learning experts on a general any-to-any repositioning objective by sampling initial and goal grasps from the dataset, and distills these experts into a single policy that uses proprioception and object geometry. We show that the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Unitree G1, where it repositions a basketball and a cardboard box to regions around the torso and completes a long-horizon task that stows a box under one arm, carries it from a shelf to a table, and places it. The controller operates interactively, steered by coarse motion references from a human teleoperator. Across real-world whole-body manipulation tasks, the distilled controller completes 90% of trials, compared with 18% for direct retargeting and 4% for a generalist whole-body controller.

analysis.tldr: 提出‘全身灵巧性’（WBD）框架，让双足机器人不仅用手，还用胳膊、躯干等身体部位接触并操控大而笨重的物体，通过仿真生成全身抓取数据集、强化学习训练专家策略、再蒸馏成单一策略，在真实Unitree G1机器人上零样本迁移，完成抱箱行走、单臂夹箱收纳等复杂全身操作任务。
