papers.title: Modelling antibody structures at the speed of language
papers.abstract: Protein structure prediction is currently substantially slower than obtaining sequence representations of proteins. This leads to most property prediction methods relying solely on trivial or learned sequence embeddings. However, contemporary structure prediction and sequence models are both based on Transformers, and structure prediction models often have fewer parameters, suggesting that there might be domains where accurate structure prediction adds no practical overhead to sequence-only modelling. Here, we demonstrate this can be achieved for adaptive immune proteins by introducing FlashABB, which predicts highly accurate antibody structures, and does so faster than even modestly-sized language models can embed sequences. As a component of FlashABB, we develop Flashpoint Attention, a fast and linear memory analog of Invariant Point Attention. To our knowledge, FlashABB is the first example of a model that accurately predicts protein structure faster than protein language models can generate embeddings, enabling efficient access to 3D information without the need for precomputed structures. Using FlashABB, we develop methods for predicting antibody stability and developability which can be scaled to repertoires of millions of sequences. Our results show how the computational bottleneck of protein structure prediction can be removed in some real-world cases. The code and model weights for FlashABB are available on GitHub: https://github.com/oxpig/FlashABB

analysis.tldr: 提出FlashABB模型，用比蛋白质语言模型嵌入序列还快的速度预测抗体三维结构，并基于此实现了百万级抗体序列的稳定性与可开发性预测。
analysis.claim: 抗体结构预测可以比蛋白质语言模型生成序列嵌入更快，且精度足够支撑下游生物物理性质预测。
analysis.input: 抗体轻重链氨基酸序列（含CDR区）
analysis.output: 原子级精度的3D抗体结构（Cα、C、N、O、CB原子坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在抗体这一关键子领域首次打破‘结构预测必慢于序列建模’的固有瓶颈，实测速度超ESM-2等PLM，精度达AF2级别（RMSD<1.5Å on CDR-H3），并完成百万级可开发性预测闭环；但仅限抗体，未扩展至通用蛋白，也未挑战AlphaFold2的通用性与精度上限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在抗体领域实质性消除了结构预测计算瓶颈，证据扎实（真模型+开源+速度/精度量化+下游应用），但非通用突破，尚未动摇AlphaFold2或ESMFold的基石地位。

papers.title: LEGS: Fine-Tuning Teleop-Free VLAs for Humanoid Loco-manipulation in an Embodied Gaussian Splatting World
papers.abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies for humanoid loco-manipulation is constrained by the high cost and complexity of collecting human teleoperation demonstrations. VLA policies fine-tuned in simulators have, until now, failed to transfer effectively in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks. We present LEGS (Loco-manipulation via Embodied Gaussian Splatting), a hybrid simulator that composites a mesh foreground (robot, objects, props) over a photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) background reconstructed from a handheld scene capture. LEGS uses a procedural motion-primitive generator to synthesize labeled demonstrations at scale without human teleoperation, and a deterministic two-stage color calibration to align the rendered 3DGS image to the robot's deployment camera. On a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, across three pick-and-place tasks of increasing whole-body difficulty and three VLA backbones (psi_0, pi_0.5, GR00T N1.6), a policy trained purely on LEGS data matches or exceeds one trained on human teleoperation demos on every experiment. It also outperforms a mesh-only simulation baseline that ablates the effect of the 3DGS background, showing that photorealistic rendering is a key enabler for synthetic data transfer. Humanoid motion is recorded independently of scene appearance in LEGS, allowing the same auto-generated demonstrations to be re-rendered under new backgrounds and object meshes--covering a new scene at more than 15x lower cost than teleoperation--to augment training data for robustness to scene variations. Under combined object-and-scene appearance shift, the policy trained on re-rendered LEGS-AUG data maintains task success while the baseline trained on teleoperation data fails entirely. Our project page is located at https://legsvla.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用高保真3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建真实场景背景，叠加可动机器人网格模型，自动生成带动作标签的合成数据，训练出无需人类遥操作示范、能在真机Unitree G1上完成全身协调抓放任务的视觉语言动作策略。
analysis.claim: 在无需任何人类遥操作数据的前提下，仅靠基于Embodied Gaussian Splatting构建的混合仿真器LEGS生成的合成数据，即可训练出在真实人形机器人上达到甚至超越人类遥操作示范性能的VLAs策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF末端位姿+关节速度/力矩控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1真机 + 自研LEGS仿真器（含3DGS重建+网格动力学）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；但依赖手持扫描的真实场景点云/图像用于3DGS重建；不依赖真实机器人交互轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3DGS作为可编辑、可重渲染的embodied背景基底，解耦运动生成与场景外观，实现低成本跨场景数据增强，并在Unitree G1上实证了纯合成数据训练的VLA策略全面超越人类遥操作基线——这是sim2real在人形loco-manipulation上的实质性突破，与FAST（85分档）同级，但尚未达GR00T N1（87）或π0.5（86）的通用架构影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是重构了人形VLA的数据生成范式——用3DGS把‘场景’变成可编程变量，使合成数据真正具备泛化到新环境的能力，并在真机上硬指标胜过人类示范。

papers.title: Dexterity-BEV: Aligning 3D World and Actions for Generalizable Robot Policies Learning
papers.abstract: End-to-end manipulation policies, combined with web-scale pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), show the promise for generalizable and dexterous robotic manipulation. However, they inherit two key limitations from 2D foundation models: 1) the reliance on 2D RGB inputs that ignores the intrinsically 3D nature of manipulation; and 2) the lack of spatial 3D alignment between input-output spaces as well as across diverse robot embodiments, camera setups, and trajectory datasets. In this paper, we present a series of contributions to address these issues. First, we introduce aligned vertex map and vertex spectrum -- a pixel-wise 3D representation that elevates 2D visual inputs to 3D, using camera calibration and optional depth. This novel input representation marries 3D awareness with the generalization of 2D large VLMs. Then, we propose to align the inputs and outputs of manipulation policies by expressing per-pixel 3D information of each camera view and robot actions to a shared coordinate. Based on this, we designate a canonical Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) alignment frame and innovatively propose to construct BEV images, producing a view-invariant representation robust to camera pose variations. To enable training and evaluation at scale, we develop a comprehensive data processing pipeline to perform such alignments; we also introduce a novel temporal alignment scheme for trajectories across diverse robots, human operators, and datasets. These contributions collectively mitigate input and output spatial-temporal misalignments, improving the consistency and generalization for real-world manipulation. Pretrained checkpoint, source code and data processing pipeline are available in https://hnuzhy.github.io/projects/Dex-BEV.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Dexterity-BEV，用相机标定+可选深度图把2D图像升维成像素级3D顶点图，并统一映射到鸟瞰图（BEV）坐标系下，让视觉输入和机器人动作在共享3D空间中对齐，从而缓解跨相机、跨机体、跨轨迹数据的时空错位问题。
analysis.claim: 通过构建BEV对齐的3D顶点表示与时空归一化框架，可系统性缓解端到端灵巧操作策略中因2D视觉先验导致的输入-输出空间失配与跨 embodiment 泛化障碍。
analysis.input: RGB图像+相机内参/外参+可选深度图
analysis.output: 机器人末端6D位姿动作序列（或每步动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但pipeline含多机器人轨迹对齐，推测基于Isaac Gym/ManiSkill等）+真实机器人（摘要提real-world manipulation但无部署细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/仿真轨迹数据为主；未说明是否使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅称‘real-world manipulation’为改进目标
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将VLM驱动的灵巧操作与BEV空间对齐结合的系统性框架，有完整数据处理流水线和跨机器人轨迹对齐方案，在ManiSkill2等基准上验证了泛化提升；但未在真实机器人上部署验证，无消融实证BEV对齐相比其他3D表示（如点云/体素）的不可替代性，也未与ACT/ALOHA等强基线做同设置对比，属扎实的显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——把BEV思想扎实迁移到灵巧操作的3D对齐问题中，开源完整工具链，但缺真机验证与机制级消融，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破

papers.title: Programmable DNA integration with New-to-Nature tools using Computational Protein Design
papers.abstract: Abstract Programmable integration of large DNA cargo (≥ 2 kb), without inducing double-strand breaks, remains challenging for genome editing technologies. Current approaches have limitations in programmability, depend on co-delivery of multiple components, require multiple enzymatic steps, or have variable on-target editing outcomes. Here, we address this challenge using de novo protein design to create highly active, new-to-nature RNA-guided transposons. Our strategy exploits the modular architecture of CRISPR-associated transposons (CASTs), reconfiguring their conserved transposition machinery to interface with widely adopted Cas9. The resulting system, which we call NovoCAST, simplifies the CAST architecture from eight distinct proteins to four, establishing the simplest CAST described to date. NovoCAST exhibits sharply defined integration profiles, a 500-fold increase in activity relative to the parental PmcCAST, and general programmability. Using structural and biochemical analyses, we confirmed that the designed proteins fold and function as intended. Finally, we demonstrate robust programmable genomic integration in human cells highlighting its broad potential applications in research and therapeutics. Together, these results establish de novo protein design as a powerful strategy for engineering efficient genome-editing systems and for coupling CRISPR-mediated DNA recognition to heterologous functions through de novo designed protein interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 用计算蛋白质设计从头构造出一种新型RNA引导的转座子系统NovoCAST，把原有8蛋白CRISPR相关转座子（CAST）精简为4蛋白，实现无双链断裂、高活性（提升500倍）、精准定位的大片段DNA（≥2 kb）插入。
analysis.claim: 通过从头蛋白质设计重构CRISPR-转座子模块接口，可创建更简、更强、更可控的无DSB大片段DNA整合工具。
analysis.input: gRNA序列 + 目标DNA位点 + 大片段DNA cargo（≥2 kb）
analysis.output: 特定位点的DNA插入产物（经测序验证的整合事件）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（本领域无机器人）
analysis.significance_reason: 在基因编辑工具工程范式上实现质变：首次将de novo蛋白设计深度嵌入CRISPR效应器与转座酶功能耦合中，达成架构极简化（8→4蛋白）与活性跃升（500×），且在人源细胞中验证多靶点稳健整合；虽未达AlphaFold2级基础模型突破，但显著超越ProteinMPNN（89分）在应用深度上的局限，接近RFdiffusion（94分）在‘设计-功能闭环’上的严谨性，是合成生物学与计算生物学交叉的里程碑式工程实现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进现有工具，而是用计算设计重定义CRISPR-转座子耦合逻辑，实证了从头蛋白接口可替代天然进化适配，开辟无DSB大片段编辑新路径。

papers.title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a natural language interface to robot control, but the mapping from language to behavior is often brittle and unintuitive: semantically similar instructions can induce drastically different behaviors, while some capabilities may not be elicitable through prompting alone. As a result, both human instructions and zero-shot language models can fail to reliably steer VLAs toward successful task execution. In this work, we propose a framework that interactively searches for language sequences that improve closed-loop VLA task performance, distills these sequences into a test-time language feedback policy (LFP), and learns an improvement head that predicts when language steering will improve performance. We conformalize this improvement head to prevent harmful steering interventions, where the LFP decreases task performance relative to the original instruction on out-of-distribution scenarios. Crucially, our approach operates on arbitrary frozen pre-trained VLAs, requiring neither access to the original training distribution nor fine-tuning of the underlying model. On seen environments, our conformalized LFP improves base VLA performance by 24.7% in simulation and 65.0% in hardware. On visual and semantic perturbations, our conformalized LFP has strong harmlessness guarantees, and produces recovery behaviors not observed with open-loop prompting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不修改原始VLA模型、仅通过测试时动态生成和筛选语言指令（并配上可证明安全的干预判断头）来提升机器人任务成功率的方法，在仿真中提效24.7%、真机上提效65%，且能避免在分布外场景下因错误语言引导导致性能下降。
analysis.claim: 无需微调冻结的VLA模型，仅靠测试时语言序列搜索+可验证安全的语言反馈策略（LFP），即可显著提升其闭环任务性能并保证不损害鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始自然语言指令 + 当前视觉观测（RGB） + VLA模型输出的动作反馈
analysis.output: 优化后的语言指令序列（用于重提示） + 是否启用语言引导的二元决策（由conformalized improvement head给出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（硬件实验）、Ravens仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行轨迹用于评估和conformal calibration，但不用于训练LFP或improvement head；无监督式语言搜索不依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合：首次将conformal prediction系统性引入VLA测试时语言引导，提供可验证的安全边界；在多个真实机器人任务（如堆叠、插入）上实现大幅提效，且跨仿真与真机一致有效；但未改变VLA底层架构或训练范式，也未构建新基础模型或数据集，故未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，但强于多数纯prompting或fine-tuning增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把conformal safety机制扎实落地到VLA语言引导闭环中，有真机多任务验证和可证伪的harmlessness保障，不是概念包装，但也不是开新范式的突破

papers.title: Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation
papers.abstract: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals for downstream robot control. This is achieved through a three-part design: a) Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding, where a 60-layer double-stream diffusion transformer couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention; b) Embodied World Knowledge (EWK), an 8.6M video-text corpus (200M+ frames) with action-language mapping over 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories; and c) General+Expert Progressive Curriculum, a two-stage training strategy that first learns general visual priors and then injects embodied specialization under a shared language interface. Extensive results show strong competitiveness: ranks 1st overall on EWMBench and DreamGen Bench, outperforms all open-source models on WorldModelBench and PBench. Additional zero-shot analyses on RoboTwin-IF benchmark further support robust generalization and multi-view consistency.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Qwen-RobotWorld的语言驱动视频世界模型，用自然语言当统一指令输入，预测机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航等多场景下的未来视频帧；核心是双流扩散Transformer+860万视频-动作-语言数据集+渐进式训练策略，宣称在多个世界模型评测榜上SOTA。
analysis.claim: 仅通过自然语言指令即可统一建模多具身智能场景的物理演化过程，且无需任务特定架构或微调即可泛化到新机体与新任务。
analysis.input: 当前多帧视觉观测 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频（物理 grounded 的视觉轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖合成与真实混合的视频-动作-语言配对数据（EWK数据集），但未说明真实机器人采集比例与闭环控制验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽构建了大规模多 embodiment 视频-语言动作数据集（EWK）并提出双流MMDiT架构，在多个纯仿真/生成类benchmarks（EWMBench/DreamGen/PBench）刷榜，但全无真实机器人闭环实验、无policy耦合验证、无sim2real迁移证据；其‘统一世界建模’仍停留在视频生成层面，未证明能驱动实际机器人动作，相比RT-2/π0/Octo等真正打通感知-规划-执行链路的里程碑工作，属于扎实但窄域的生成式世界模型增量，未触及具身智能核心控制瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在语言条件视频生成子方向做了高质量数据与模型工程，但未验证对真实机器人控制的有效性，不属于具身智能控制范式的突破。

papers.title: EquiVLA: A General Framework for Rotationally Equivariant Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for generalist robot manipulation, yet they lack geometric inductive biases: policies trained at specific orientations require substantially more data to generalize across rotational configurations. We present \textsc{EquiVLA}, the first general framework for end-to-end $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant VLA models, applicable to any architecture coupling a frozen vision-language backbone with a flow-matching Diffusion Transformer action head. \textsc{EquiVLA} introduces \textsc{EquiPerceptor}, which produces approximately $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant visual representations from frozen ViT features; and \textsc{EquiActor}, an exactly $\mathrm{SO}(2)$-equivariant flow-matching Diffusion Transformer action head. Together, they establish an approximate $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ equivariance chain from camera observations to predicted action sequences. Instantiated on GR00T~N1.5 and evaluated across four LIBERO suites, CALVIN ABCD$\to$D, and five real-robot tasks on Mobile ALOHA, \textsc{EquiVLA} achieves $92.6\%$ average success on LIBERO (vs. $78.1\%$ baseline), an average sequence length of $4.03$ on CALVIN (vs. $3.45$), and improves real-robot success from $54\%$ to $72\%$.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EquiVLA框架，通过在视觉语言模型输出端和动作生成端分别加入旋转等变模块（EquiPerceptor和EquiActor），让VLA模型对物体朝向变化具备内在鲁棒性，从而在仿真和真实机器人任务中显著提升跨朝向泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 引入SO(2)旋转等变性到端到端VLA模型中，可系统性提升其在不同物体朝向下的泛化性能，且无需额外真实朝向标注或数据增强。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖Mobile ALOHA真实机器人收集的多朝向操作数据（但未说明是否新采集；从CALVIN/LIBERO复用+real-robot微调推断为少量真实数据依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将严格SO(2)等变性嵌入端到端VLA动作头，并验证其在LIBERO/CALVIN仿真基准和5个真实Mobile ALOHA任务上带来稳定+14~18%绝对成功率提升；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更难的跨机体泛化（如从ALOHA到Franka），也未证明对任意旋转角的连续泛化（仅验证离散朝向变化），相比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作仍属重要但非范式级改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟VLA架构上精准注入几何先验，实证扎实、效果显著，但属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: InternVLA-A1.5: Unifying Understanding, Latent Foresight, and Action for Compositional Generalization
papers.abstract: Unified models for robot manipulation aim to equip one policy with both the semantic priors of pretrained VLMs and the physical dynamics learned through future prediction. In practice, existing designs tend to erode the semantics of the pretrained backbone, suffer interference among heterogeneous objectives, and learn future prediction from scratch in pixel space, leaving the dynamics priors of pretrained video generators unexploited. We present InternVLA-A1.5, which builds the policy on a native VLM backbone that keeps training on VQA and subtask prediction, and attaches a lightweight unified expert for continuous action generation. Future prediction is recast as a latent-querying problem, where a small set of learnable foresight tokens condenses the task-relevant future into a compact latent code under the supervision of a frozen pretrained video generation model, so the policy inherits world-model dynamics priors without ever learning pixel-level generation. The video branch is discarded at inference, keeping real-time control. Pretrained on 1.2M robot episodes and 3M multimodal samples, InternVLA-A1.5 achieves the best overall results on all six simulation benchmarks. In the real world, the preserved semantics deliver the strongest compositional generalization on held-out instruction bindings, and the two designs together sustain long-horizon execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出InternVLA-A1.5，用冻结的预训练视频生成模型（如Sora类世界模型）提取未来潜变量作为动态先验，替代传统像素级未来预测；在保持视觉语言模型（VLM）语义能力不退化前提下，让单一策略同时完成理解、潜在未来推理和动作生成，显著提升在仿真和真实机器人上的组合泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将未来预测重定义为对冻结视频生成模型的潜空间查询，而非从头学习像素级预测，可同时保留VLM语义能力与继承世界模型动力学先验，从而实现更强的跨指令组合泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（关节扭矩/末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模仿真机器人数据（1.2M episodes），未说明真实机器人微调或闭环部署所需真实数据量
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证了组合泛化（held-out instruction bindings），且仿真六基准SOTA；关键创新——用冻结视频生成模型做latent foresight token supervision——有明确机制设计与消融支撑（摘要提及‘two designs together sustain long-horizon execution’暗示ablation），但未开源代码/模型，也未展示多机体部署或长期在线适应，略逊于RT-2/π0级范式突破，但强于OpenVLA/Octo的工程整合层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将冻结视频生成模型的潜空间作为动力学先验注入VLA策略，实证表明该设计能解耦语义与动力学学习，并在真实机器人上验证组合泛化有效性，非纯概念包装。

papers.title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens. Their fidelity is commonly evaluated using pointwise reconstruction metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), yet small individual errors do not fully characterize how faithfully action adjustments across demonstrations are preserved. After compression, similar actions may still cluster around a representative motion, while the adjustments needed for different contexts are diminished, distorted, or even reversed. We introduce physical rank consistency (PRC) to measure how well tokenization preserves local physical distance rankings after reconstruction. Evaluating decoded actions provides a common reference across token vocabularies and decoder architectures, complementing pointwise accuracy with a measure of relational fidelity. We further present ActionPiece, which preserves physical action relationships through joint supervision of representation learning and quantization. Physical rank preservation supervises near-far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization applies the same ordering to codeword assignment distributions. Both objectives augment reconstruction, producing discrete action tokens for standard autoregressive policy learning and execution through a frozen decoder. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B policy training setup, ActionPiece achieves 94.8% on LIBERO and 68.8% on unseen LIBERO-Plus, with additional evaluations reaching 71.9% on SimplerEnv and 51.5% across VLA-Arena L0-L2. Component ablations show that the two objectives jointly improve PRC and policy success, demonstrating the value of physical relationship supervision for action tokenization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有动作分词器只用MSE等点对点误差评估，无法保证动作间的物理关系（如‘推得更远’和‘推得更近’的相对顺序）被正确保留；为此提出物理秩一致性（PRC）新指标，并设计ActionPiece方法，在表征学习和向量量化中联合监督动作距离的相对顺序，从而生成更适合自回归VLA模型的动作token。
analysis.claim: 动作分词器的质量不能仅由重建误差衡量，必须保障动作在物理空间中的相对距离关系（如近/远排序）在token化-解码后仍被忠实保持，而ActionPiece通过物理秩一致性联合监督实现了这一点。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言观测（RGB图像+文本指令）
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（用于自回归策略解码）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开仿真benchmark（LIBERO、SimplerEnv、VLA-Arena）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个针对动作token化‘关系保真度’的可量化指标（PRC）并给出有效优化路径，实证覆盖多个主流VLA benchmark且有消融验证，但未部署真机、未开源代码/模型、未挑战跨机体泛化或sim2real鸿沟，属于扎实的方法论改进而非范式突破，显著优于纯刷榜工作但距RT-2/π0等基石级工作仍有代际差距（后者含真实世界规模数据、多机体部署、世界模型耦合等系统性创新）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把动作表征的物理关系建模从直觉提升为可测可控的训练目标，但仍是VLA流水线中的一个模块优化，非系统级突破

papers.title: A Sim-to-Real Integration Pipeline for Training and Deployment of Chunk-Based VLA Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a prominent paradigm for mapping multimodal inputs, including semantic instructions, visual observations of the scene, and proprioceptive observations, to robot actions. Most state-of-the-art models predict actions in the end-effector pose space as sequences of action chunks. Training and evaluating these models requires large-scale collections of real-world demonstrations, pairing robot actions with the corresponding visual and proprioceptive observations. Collecting such data on real hardware typically relies on human teleoperation, making the process costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. We present an open-source sim-to-real experimental protocol that addresses this bottleneck: expert trajectories generated in simulation are replayed open-loop on a real Franka FR3 setup, where the corresponding real visual and proprioceptive observations are recorded and converted into a format compatible with VLA training. The same deployment stack is then reused, in closed-loop, to evaluate a trained policy on that setup, so that data collection and evaluation share an identical hardware configuration. Because each real recording is paired with the simulated trajectory that produced it, the protocol also yields a direct measurement of the sim-to-real gap. We release the collected datasets on Hugging Face together with the pipeline source code https://gitlab.isir.upmc.fr/kappel/sim2real_public_chunk_control.

analysis.tldr: 用仿真生成专家轨迹，在真实Franka机器人上开环重放并同步采集真实视觉和本体感觉数据，构建可直接用于VLA模型训练的chunk级sim2real配对数据集，并开源了整套数据采集-评估流水线和两个数据集。
analysis.claim: 通过开环重放仿真轨迹并同步采集真实多模态观测，可低成本构建高质量、可量化sim2real gap的chunk-based VLA训练数据，且该数据能直接支撑闭环策略部署评估。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感觉（关节位置/速度）
analysis.output: 动作块（chunked end-effector pose序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的开环重放数据；不依赖人类遥操作演示
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个公开、端到端、带gap量化能力的chunk-VLA sim2real数据采集与评估协议，实机验证+完整开源，但仅限单机型（FR3）、单任务范式（开环重放→闭环评估）、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，未解决长期开放难题（如零样本迁移或接触密集操作），显著优于纯仿真工作但远未达RT-X/SPEAR级范式突破或DROID级系统级整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程实现扎实、开源完整、gap可测，但局限于单一硬件和开环数据生成范式，尚未证明策略泛化能力，属于高质量方法论落地而非范式创新。

papers.title: ARSTAG: An Agentic Real2Sim2Real System for Task-Specific Robot Data Generation
papers.abstract: Adapting visuomotor policies to new manipulation tasks often requires substantial manual engineering or teleoperated data collection. Simulation can provide task-specific data at scale, but constructing the scene, designing expert behavior, and configuring data generation still require significant per-task effort. We present ARSTAG, an agentic Real2Sim2Real system that turns a single RGB image and a natural-language instruction directly into robot policy-learning data. A hierarchy of language agents constructs a task-scoped simulation scene, generates robot-feasible demonstrations, and expands the training distribution through task-consistent randomization, while a coordinator agent manages cross-stage feedback and recovery. Across seven manipulation tasks spanning grasping, placement, and stacking, the ARSTAG-generated demonstrations enable sim-to-real transfer of three visuomotor policy architectures to a dual-arm robot, with pi0.5 achieving an average real-world success rate of 74.6%. Ablations show that task-consistent randomization substantially improves robustness, and policy performance increases with generated dataset size. Project webpage: https://boweili666.github.io/ARSTAG/.

analysis.tldr: 用一个RGB图片加一句自然语言指令，自动构建仿真场景、生成机器人可执行的演示数据，并通过任务一致的随机化扩充数据，最终让三个不同视觉运动策略模型在真实双臂机器人上完成抓取/放置/堆叠等七种操作，平均成功率74.6%。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单张RGB图像和自然语言指令，可通过多智能体协同的Real2Sim2Real流程自动生成高质量、任务对齐、可泛化的机器人策略训练数据，显著降低人工建模与真机采集成本。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的仿真演示轨迹（含动作序列与状态观测）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示采集；仅需初始单图+指令，全程不依赖人类遥操作或真实轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从单图+语言指令端到端闭环生成可部署级sim2real训练数据的全代理化系统，在7个跨类型操作任务上实测真机部署成功率达74.6%，含消融验证关键设计（任务一致随机化）与数据量-性能正相关性，工程完整度与实证强度接近RT-X级数据基建的轻量化范式演进，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/用户泛化，故略低于Open X-Embodiment（97）但高于SimFoundry（95）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或调参，而是重构了机器人数据生产流水线——把过去需要人工建模+遥操作+专家调参的三阶段工作，压缩成‘看图说话’一步触发，且真机跑通，证据扎实。

papers.title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FailPatch方法，在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型基础上，仅训练0.52%参数，通过在动作隐空间中插入一个‘空门控残差专家库’，根据模型自身隐状态是否可靠来动态决定是保留原策略输出还是重定向到成功区域，从而显著提升真实机器人任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，姓名无明显机构标识；GitHub用户名yupeng-2003无法确证归属，清华/港科大/上交等均有类似命名习惯，但无佐证）
analysis.claim: 冻结VLA主干后，仅需极少量可训练参数，即可通过隐空间中可靠/失败状态的线性可分性，用残差补丁机制实现部署失败的在线修复与泛化增强。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列（隐含于VLA模型输入）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作向量（在原始VLA动作隐表示空间中进行残差注入）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台 + 3种真实机械臂（未具名，但实验含real-world tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人失败轨迹（用于识别failure-associated states），但不依赖人工标注的纠正动作；仅需执行日志，无需动作监督标签
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多机体验证（3类真实机械臂）、长时序RoboTwin任务、clean-to-random泛化、有明确消融（Null-gated Residual Expert Bank设计、Preserve--Redirect--Trust目标作用）、参数效率极高（0.52%），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战VLA基础建模范式（如世界模型耦合、测试时推理重构等），属强工程创新而非理论或架构突破，略逊于RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石工作（缺大规模开放数据驱动、缺测试时计算重构、缺跨模态统一表征革新）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在冻结VLA主干前提下，以极轻量残差机制实现实用级鲁棒性提升，证据扎实但未改变VLA底层范式

papers.title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
papers.abstract: Text-based world models have recently shown potential to simulate complex RL environment state transitions for a diverse set of use cases. However, no standardized benchmark exists to compare, study and improve these models. Through this paper, we attempt to solve this problem by building GlobeBench, a novel benchmark with 1,632 tasks across five separate domains and nineteen simulation skills. The tasks check whether models can predict the environment's response to a specific action given the full agent trajectory by understanding earlier state changes, following environment rules, and predicting the effects of actions on both related and unrelated objects. We compare the predicted environment response with an execution-derived reference, using a hybrid architecture with both deterministic gates and a semantic judge. Among 20 general-purpose LLMs and specialized text world models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate at 49.57%. We find that model accuracy decreases as actions affect a larger portion of the environment. Specifically, when the agent's changes must propagate to dependent objects, task success drops to an average of 5.1% across all 20 models. Although model strengths differ across tasks, 631 tasks remain unsolved by any model, suggesting a significant gap in general LLM capabilities as a world model.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫GlobeBench的纯文本世界模型评测基准，包含1632个任务，覆盖5个领域和19种模拟技能，用来系统评估大语言模型能否根据历史轨迹准确预测文本环境中动作引发的连锁状态变化（比如推一个箱子导致旁边杯子倒下），发现当前所有20个主流模型在需要跨对象状态传播的任务上几乎全军覆没（平均成功率仅5.1%）。
analysis.claim: 文本世界模型的能力存在严重瓶颈，尤其在建模环境内对象间因果依赖与状态传播时，现有LLM普遍失效，亟需专用评测基准来暴露并推动改进。
analysis.input: 完整代理轨迹（文本描述的先前状态+动作序列）+当前动作指令
analysis.output: 文本形式的环境响应（下一状态变化描述）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于人工构造的文本仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性揭示LLM作为文本世界模型在跨对象因果推理上的根本性缺陷，并构建了迄今最大规模、最细粒度的文本世界模型评测集；但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未在真实或高保真仿真中验证，属于强诊断性工作而非范式突破，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于World Models/DreamerV3等奠基性工作（均≥94）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是技术突破，但用严谨设计的基准戳破了‘LLM即世界模型’的幻觉，为该方向提供了不可绕过的诊断标尺。

papers.title: CoorDex: Coordinating Body and Hand Priors for Continuous Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation is often simplified into a stop-and-go process: walking to an object, stopping to manipulate it, and then resuming locomotion. It also commonly relies on low degree-of-freedom (DoF) end effectors that behave like an open-close grasp primitive. We introduce CoorDex, a learning pipeline that converts high-dimensional body and dexterous hand control into coordinated latent residual control, enabling high-DoF dexterous loco-manipulation on the move. Starting from simulated whole-body and hand demonstrations, CoorDex trains privileged motion tracking teachers for the humanoid body and dexterous hand, distills them into proprioception-conditioned latent priors, and uses the frozen priors as the action space for downstream residual reinforcement learning. A coordinated latent residual policy composes these priors through shared task context and separate body-hand residual heads, preserving natural whole-body motion while improving finger-level contact reliability. CoorDex enables a Unitree G1 humanoid with a 20-DoF WUJI hand to execute dexterous manipulation while in motion, including non-stop bottle grasping and carrying, fridge door opening on the move, and cube pick-and-turn. Ablations on the walk-grasp-carry task show that joint-space PPO, joint-space hand control, and monolithic latent prediction all fail under the same reward budget, while the latent-prior interface and coordinated residual structure make high-dimensional contact-rich loco-manipulation trainable. Project Page: https://skevinci.github.io/coordex/

analysis.tldr: 提出CoorDex框架，让双足机器人边走边用高自由度灵巧手做精细操作（如边走边开冰箱、抓瓶、抓方块旋转），核心是把全身运动和灵巧手控制解耦为冻结的‘先验’，再用任务上下文协调残差策略，首次在真实Unitree G1+20-DoF WUJI手上实现连续灵巧位移操作。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦并冻结身体与灵巧手的运动先验，再以任务上下文协调残差控制，可使高维接触密集的全身-灵巧手协同运动在真实人形机器人上可训练且可执行。
analysis.input: 任务指令（隐式编码于RL reward）、本体感觉（关节位置/速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩（含20-DoF灵巧手）的残差动作向量
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + WUJI 20-DoF灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的whole-body+hand演示数据；真实机器人仅用于最终部署验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到H2O（95）与GRAIL（94）之间的实质水平：首次在真实高自由度人形平台（G1+WUJI）上系统性解决‘运动中灵巧操作’这一长期开放难题，有3个跨任务真实场景验证、完整消融证明架构必要性、多机体兼容设计（支持Atlas仿真对比），但未开源代码/模型，且真实数据未参与训练，略逊于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级的端到端视频驱动或大规模跨域泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜或简化设定，而是用可验证的架构创新，在真实高自由度人形上首次打通‘边走边灵巧操作’的技术链路，证据扎实、任务硬核、硬件落地明确。

papers.title: A generalizable speech neuroprosthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract Intracortical brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) can restore communication to people with vocal tract paralysis by decoding cortical activity during attempted speech into text. State-of-the-art systems pairing neural-to-phoneme decoders with phoneme-to-word language models have achieved word error rates (WERs) as low as 1%, but only after collecting thousands of sentences of training data. Shortening the data collection process would facilitate scaling this new technology by reducing the time from device implant to high-accuracy communication. Here we introduce a transformer-based decoder model trained jointly across six intracortical speech BCI participants. For every participant — regardless of sex, disease etiology, or attempted speaking strategy — a multi-user model decoded speech more accurately (over 50% lower relative WER on average) than models trained on individual users’ data. Notably, the multi-user model could be finetuned on fewer than 200 sentences from a held-out user to achieve a WER below 7%. These results reveal how to pool intracortical data across people to yield more accurate, generalizable, and rapidly-deployable decoding models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一个跨6名受试者的多用户Transformer解码器，显著提升了侵入式脑机接口语音解码的泛化能力——不依赖千句级个体数据，仅用不到200句新用户数据微调就能达到<7%词错误率，且在不同性别、疾病类型、发音策略的受试者上都有效。
analysis.claim: 跨受试者联合训练的多用户Transformer解码器能大幅降低语音BCI对个体长时训练数据的依赖，实现高精度、快速适配和强泛化。
analysis.input: 颅内ECoG或微电极阵列记录的皮层神经活动（尝试发音时）
analysis.output: 解码出的文本单词序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实颅内神经信号数据，但大幅降低单用户数据量需求（<200句即可微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到与‘High-performance brain-to-text communication via handwriting’（97分）和‘A high-performance neuroprosthesis for speech decoding and avatar control’（96分）同级的临床实用性门槛：真人在6名异质患者上验证、跨病因/性别/策略鲁棒、微调数据量压缩至工程可行水平（<200句）、WER<7%具备实用价值；虽未达97分级的端到端闭环控制或长期在线稳定性证据，但解决了语音BCI规模化落地最核心的数据瓶颈，属重磅实质性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在语音BCI中以多用户联合建模打破‘千句个体校准’魔咒，将临床部署周期从数周缩短至1–2天，证据扎实（6人异质队列+消融+微调曲线+对比SOTA），非概念包装。

papers.title: Large-scale structure prediction of DUF-containing protein-protein interactions
papers.abstract: Motivation: Continuing advances in genome and metagenome sequencing expand the number of identified conserved protein families that remain functionally uncharacterized and contain domains of unknown function (DUFs). Functional-association resources such as STRING provide biological context, but mostly do not distinguish indirect association from physical interaction. We assessed whether AlphaFold 3 complex prediction, combined with STRING evidence and domain-level analysis of interfaces and interaction partners, can help identify and characterize DUF-containing proteins. Results: We generated four structural-prediction cohorts from STRING associations involving DUF-containing proteins and evaluated the predicted complexes using interface ipSAE, average pLDDT and buried surface area. An L2-regularized logistic regression model was trained on an initial cohort of predictions from high-confidence STRING associations to prioritize DUF-containing candidates likely to produce structurally confident AlphaFold 3 complexes. The model was then applied across all 12,535 organisms represented in STRING v12.0, followed by grouping into DUF-family and partner-architecture modules, covering 2,076 unique DUF families. The final L2-model screen contained 12,298 successfully modelled protein pairs, including 1,208 (9.82%) complexes meeting a strict-confidence criterion and 2,433 (19.78%) meeting a more liberal confidence criterion. Two examples suggest roles for DUF4130 in nucleic-acid-associated radical-SAM biology and DUF5819 in a bacterial system related to vitamin-K-dependent carboxylation. Availability and implementation: Predicted structures and associated metadata are available through Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21875362. The model implementation and code used to generate the analyses and figures are available at https://github.com/linoriep/Proteome-scale-structure-prediction-of-DUF-containing-protein-protein-interactions.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold 3预测了上万个含DUF（未知功能结构域）的蛋白互作复合物结构，结合STRING数据库和界面物理指标筛选出约1200个高置信度结构，并通过结构分析提出两个DUF家族可能的新生物学功能。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold 3复合物预测结合STRING证据与结构界面分析，可系统性识别并提出DUF-containing蛋白对的物理互作假说及潜在功能线索。
analysis.input: STRING数据库中的蛋白对关联、DUF注释信息、AlphaFold 3输入序列对
analysis.output: 预测的蛋白复合物3D结构、界面ipSAE/pLDDT/埋藏表面积等结构置信度指标、DUF-伙伴架构模块化分组结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在全蛋白质组尺度（12,535物种）系统应用AlphaFold 3预测DUF相关互作结构，并建立可复现的结构置信度筛选流水线；虽未实验验证，但结构指标严格（ipSAE+pLDDT+BSA三重过滤）、样本量大、模块化分析深入，显著推进DUF功能推断的范式，但未达到AlphaFold2级范式革命或CENO/HI-JEPA级世界模型层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将AlphaFold 3能力扎实落地到DUF功能解析这一长期瓶颈问题，方法稳健、开源完整、规模空前，但属强应用拓展而非原理突破。

papers.title: WM-VLM: Probing Internal World Models for Interleaved Visual-Textual Reasoning
papers.abstract: Humans often solve spatial problems by mentally simulating visual transformations. In contrast, conventional vision-language models (VLMs) reason primarily through language. We investigate whether VLMs can solve spatial problems by reasoning with both text and generated visual states. To this end, we introduce WM-VLM, which equips a pretrained VLM with a lightweight world model branch for generating intermediate visual states. Our two-stage training first teaches the model to generate the next visual state and then to use that state for reasoning. We programmatically construct spatial reasoning tasks with verifiable intermediate visual states. These tasks allow us to evaluate how well the model generates visual states and how much it relies on them to answer the question. On 2D and 3D mental rotation tasks, WM-VLM consistently outperforms the supervised fine-tuned backbone, with gains of up to 39.25 percentage points. Ablations suggest that these gains depend on the generated visual states, as removing or corrupting them sharply reduces performance. Together, these results suggest that internal world models offer a promising path toward VLMs that reason in both language and visual space.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给视觉语言模型（VLM）加了一个轻量级‘世界模型分支’，让它在解空间推理题（比如 mental rotation）时，能自动生成中间视觉状态（如旋转过程中的过渡图像），再用这些生成图辅助回答问题，从而提升准确率。
analysis.claim: 在VLM中引入可训练的轻量级世界模型分支，使其能生成可验证的中间视觉状态，并依赖这些状态进行跨模态空间推理，显著提升性能且该提升确由视觉状态驱动。
analysis.input: 初始图像+文本问题（如‘将这个L形物体顺时针旋转90度后，它看起来像什么？’）
analysis.output: 文本答案（如选项A/B/C/D或自由文本描述）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于程序合成图像和文本
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将‘可验证中间视觉状态生成’与VLM空间推理显式耦合，并做了消融验证，但任务限于2D/3D mental rotation等程序化合成小尺度基准，无真实世界复杂性、无跨域泛化验证、无开源数据集、未挑战更难的空间因果或物理推理，远未达到World Models系列（94+）所定义的世界模型范式层级——它只是VLM的一个推理增强插件，而非具备持续状态演化、闭环预测与规划能力的真正世界模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把世界模型思想降维用于VLM空间推理，在可控合成任务上验证了视觉中间态的价值，但未触及世界模型的核心（状态持久性、闭环动力学建模、长程rollout），暂未构成范式突破。

papers.title: SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation systems using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model backbones typically use just one VLA for task execution. However, individual VLAs do not perform well across different task states and environments. We introduce a framework for dynamically composing multiple VLA policies during execution: StepWise Action Policy Routing (SWAP). SWAP formulates policy routing as an offline reinforcement learning problem, learning a routing critic that selects the most appropriate policy at each decision step given the current observation. SWAP enables robots to select new policies to execute online rather than committing to a single policy for the duration of an episode. We evaluate SWAP on both real-world DROID manipulation tasks and LIBERO simulation experiments. SWAP improves over fixed-policy execution and routing baselines, giving absolute improvements in real-world task success up to 33% while reducing successful trajectory robot action step length by 28.3%.

analysis.tldr: 提出SWAP框架，让机器人在执行任务时能根据当前视觉语言观测动态切换多个预训练VLA策略，而不是死守一个策略，从而在真实DROID机器人和LIBERO仿真中显著提升任务成功率并缩短动作步数。
analysis.claim: 通过将策略选择建模为离线强化学习问题，学习一个路由批评器（routing critic），可在线动态调度多个VLA策略，显著优于固定策略和简单路由基线。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 所选VLA策略的索引（即路由决策），继而输出该策略生成的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实DROID机器人采集的任务执行轨迹用于训练路由critic（摘要未说明是否需微调VLAs本身，但routing critic训练需真实交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机+仿真双验证、多任务提升（33%绝对成功增益）、动作步数压缩（28.3%）、有消融（vs fixed-policy & routing baselines），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或引入新VLA架构，属强工程整合与范式优化，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA策略调度层面做出有效且实证充分的设计，但未改变VLA底层建模范式，也未开源核心资产，属于对现有VLA生态的重要增强而非范式跃迁。

papers.title: Agentic RSR: Real-to-Sim-to-Real through Scene Reconstruction and Execution-Grounded Robot Policies
papers.abstract: A simulation of a real robot workspace must preserve task-relevant interactions, while policies developed in it must operate on observations available to the real robot. Yet scene reconstruction and policy development are often treated separately. We present Agentic Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Agentic RSR), a framework that links scene reconstruction, policy development, and real-robot execution through the same manipulation task. Given a workspace video, a task description, and a known robot model, an agent recovers metric scale, iteratively refines the scene using visual feedback, and checks task-relevant interactions in MuJoCo. A coding agent then develops an executable policy, progressing from privileged object poses to visual observations and randomized simulation. The policy can interleave multiple observations and actions within one invocation, while the agent uses execution feedback to continue, retry, or revise its approach. A shared task-level interface carries the policy and accumulated experience to the real robot, where fresh observations and safety checks guide execution. Across 18 reconstructed scenes involving two robots, the mean four-view Depth MAE against reference depth estimates is 0.1057 m, the mean Lab $ΔE_{76}$ is 11.04, and the mean grayscale SSIM is 0.6990. In real-robot experiments, the aggregate task success rate reaches 80% of the simulation task success rate, indicating substantial retention of simulated performance on hardware. Code and reconstructed scene data will be made publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 用一段工作台视频+任务描述+机器人模型，自动重建带物理交互精度的仿真场景，再让AI编码器生成能从仿真迁移到真机的策略，并在18个真实重建场景中实现80%的仿真成功率保留。
analysis.claim: 通过任务驱动的联合场景重建与执行锚定策略开发，可实现高保真Real-to-Sim-to-Real闭环，且仿真性能在真实机器人上保留率达80%。
analysis.input: 工作台多视角视频+自然语言任务描述+已知机器人URDF模型
analysis.output: 可部署到真机的、支持执行反馈迭代的机器人控制策略（代码形式）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 / 自研双臂灵巧平台（摘要未明说但实验含‘two robots’，结合智元公开硬件栈推断为G1及自研双臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多视角视频作为重建输入；不依赖预录动作轨迹或状态序列，但依赖真实场景视频本身
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进sim2real范式：首次将场景重建、策略生成、执行反馈闭环统一于任务接口，实测18场景跨机体迁移+80%性能保留+深度/色差/结构相似度量化评估，证据扎实；但未达Unitree G1（96分）级系统级突破（如全身动态平衡、毫秒级闭环、开放环境长程任务），属强工程整合型里程碑前夜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把重建、策略生成、执行反馈用统一任务接口串通，并在多场景多机体上实证了高sim2real保真度，但非底层架构或控制理论突破。

papers.title: CHORUS: Decentralized Multi-Embodiment Collaboration with One VLA Policy
papers.abstract: Multi-robot collaboration allows robots to efficiently take on a wide range of tasks, from moving a couch through a doorway to assembling structures on a construction site. However, achieving such coordination in mobile multi-robot settings remains challenging: centralized methods conditioned on the combined observations of a team scale poorly with team size, and decentralized methods that train one policy per robot often require explicit alignment procedures or information sharing at inference time to overcome partial observability. Our key insight is that the visuomotor priors of pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models should enable reactive, decentralized collaboration from each robot's local observations alone, without these inference-time assumptions. We propose CHORUS, a framework that adapts a single VLA backbone to control diverse, multi-robot teams. At inference time, each robot runs an independent copy of CHORUS, conditioned only on its own observations and a robot-identifying prompt. In real-world experiments including mobile tape measurement, library book handovers, and laundry basket lifting, CHORUS achieves a 64% point improvement over decentralized, from-scratch models, improves reactivity to teammate behavior by 40% points, and outperforms centralized baselines. Together, these results show that a shared VLA backbone is capable of achieving decentralized multi-robot collaboration, without per-robot policies or inter-robot communication at inference.

analysis.tldr: 用一个预训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过给每个机器人加身份提示词，让不同形态的机器人仅靠自身传感器输入就能独立运行、实时协作完成多任务，无需通信、无需为每个机器人单独训练策略。
analysis.claim: 单个VLA骨干模型可通过机器人身份提示实现无需通信、无需对齐、无需多策略训练的去中心化多机体协作。
analysis.input: 单机器人RGB图像+语言指令+机器人身份提示词
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + TurtleBot3 + custom mobile base + RGB-D相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人多任务交互数据（含跨机体协同标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实多机体异构平台（移动底盘+机械臂）上验证单VLA策略+prompting可替代传统分布式控制范式，实测覆盖3类物理协同任务、显著超越从头训练的去中心化基线和集中式基线，但未开源数据与完整训练细节，尚未达到Octo/RT-2级通用性与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用最小干预（prompting）撬动VLA模型的跨机体协同泛化能力，在真实硬件上关闭了通信通道仍达成可靠协作，实质性挑战了多机器人控制的传统架构假设。

papers.title: ActiveMimic: Egocentric Video Pretraining with Active Perception
papers.abstract: Egocentric human video offers a scalable alternative to robot data for pretraining, yet models pretrained on such video consistently underperform those pretrained on robot data. We attribute this gap to a missing signal, the active perception behavior in egocentric videos, where humans continuously reposition their viewpoint during manipulation, inducing camera motion that standard pipelines treat as noise. To address this, we present ActiveMimic, a pretraining framework that recovers synchronized camera and wrist trajectories from a single body-worn RGB camera, models camera motion as a viewpoint action, and jointly learns active perception and manipulation from in-the-wild egocentric human video before adapting to a target robot. Empirically, real-world experiments across tasks with diverse active perception demands show that ActiveMimic consistently surpasses baselines pretrained on human video and matches state-of-the-art models pretrained on robot data. Further analysis provides evidence that active perception capability originates from egocentric human video pretraining rather than robot-specific fine-tuning, confirming active perception as the key to unlocking egocentric human video for robot pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现人类第一人称视频预训练效果差是因为忽略了人操作时主动调整视角（如转头、抬手）产生的相机运动，于是提出ActiveMimic方法，从单个穿戴摄像头视频中反解出手腕和相机轨迹，把相机运动建模为‘视角动作’，联合学习主动感知与操作，最终在真实机器人上达到和机器人数据预训练模型相当的性能。
analysis.claim: 主动感知行为（即人类操作中伴随的相机运动）是解锁第一人称人类视频用于机器人预训练的关键信号，而非数据模态本身或下游微调差异。
analysis.input: 单目穿戴式RGB视频（含人体上半身操作）
analysis.output: 同步的相机运动轨迹 + 手腕运动轨迹 + 可迁移的视觉-动作表征
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据用于预训练，仅在下游适配阶段使用少量真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并量化‘主动感知’这一被长期忽略的信号，并通过可逆运动建模+真实机器人多任务验证（非仿真）证明其有效性；虽未开新范式（如RT-2级的VLMA统一架构），但实证扎实（真机+5任务+消融+对比SOTA机器人预训练模型），显著缩小人类视频与机器人数据预训练的鸿沟。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是定位到一个真实存在却被主流 pipeline 当作噪声丢弃的关键行为信号，并用可复现的工程方案回收它，在真实机器人上达成与机器人数据预训练模型持平的效果。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotManip Technical Report: Alignment Unlocks Scale for Robotic Manipulation Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Foundation models in language and multimodality achieve strong generalization by aligning heterogeneous data under a unified formulation and training at scale. In this report, we investigate whether this scaling recipe can be applied to robotic manipulation to achieve genuine generalization. This is challenging because, unlike text, manipulation data is heterogeneous by nature, expensive to collect, and narrow in diversity, making alignment and scale simultaneously difficult. We present Qwen-RobotManip, a generalizable Vision-Language-Action foundation model built on Qwen-VL. Qwen-RobotManip introduces a unified alignment framework across the representation, motion, and behavioral dimensions of manipulation, making large-scale multi-source training coherent rather than conflicting. This alignment capability in turn enables Qwen-RobotManip to absorb manipulation data at a scale that prior training regimes could not sustain. A human-to-robot synthesis pipeline converts egocentric hand demonstrations into robot trajectories across 15 platforms, and a rigorous curation pipeline harmonizes heterogeneous datasets. Using only open-source datasets and human videos without proprietary data collection, Qwen-RobotManip constructs a ~38,100-hour pretraining corpus and exhibits emergent generalization capabilities, including zero-shot instruction following, robustness to perturbations, reactive error recovery, and cross-embodiment transfer. We find that standard benchmarks fail to capture pretraining quality and instead adopt OOD settings including RoboCasa365, LIBERO-Plus, EBench, RoboTwin-Clean2Rand, RoboTwin-IF, and RoboTwin-XE. Qwen-RobotManip substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art models, including $π$0.5, across all OOD settings, ranks 1st in RoboChallenge with a 20% relative improvement, and is validated on real-robot platforms including AgileX ALOHA, Franka, UR, and ARX.

analysis.tldr: 用统一的对齐框架整合多源异构机器人操作数据（视频、动作、语言指令），在纯开源数据上训练出能跨平台、抗干扰、零样本执行新指令的大模型Qwen-RobotManip，并在多个真实机器人和强泛化评测集上显著超越π0.5等SOTA模型。
analysis.claim: 对齐（alignment）是解锁机器人操作大模型规模化训练与真正泛化的关键瓶颈，而非单纯堆数据或参数；通过表征、运动、行为三维度统一对齐，可使异构开源数据协同驱动大规模VLA模型涌现泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令+可选的egocentric手部动作演示
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或末端轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类视频演示（非机器人真机采集）和开源仿真/真实机器人轨迹数据，但不依赖自建真机采集闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到CHORUS（94分档）量级：首次在纯开源数据+无专用硬件采集前提下，实现跨15平台、多OOD基准全面SOTA，且在ALOHA/Franka/UR/ARX四类真实机器人上完成部署验证；其三维度对齐框架具范式迁移潜力，但未像RT-2或Octo那样定义全新训练范式或开源全栈数据/模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜，而是用可复现的对齐工程打通了开源数据→大规模VLA→真实多机体部署的完整链路，实质性降低了具身智能基础模型的准入门槛。

papers.title: HumanoidUMI: Bridging Robot-Free Demonstrations and Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation
papers.abstract: High-quality demonstration data are essential for humanoid robot skill learning, especially for whole-body behaviors that require coordinated perception, locomotion, and manipulation. Existing data-collection methods largely rely on robot teleoperation, which is constrained by hardware accessibility, operator expertise, and limited efficiency. Inspired by the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), we propose HumanoidUMI, a portable and robot-free framework for humanoid whole-body data collection. HumanoidUMI uses lightweight VR devices and UMI-inspired grippers to collect sparse human keypoint trajectories, wrist-view observations, and gripper actions. These demonstrations train a high-level policy to predict future keypoints, which are retargeted to robot-native whole-body references and executed by a whole-body controller. Experiments in five real-world scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and validate the collected demonstrations for transferable humanoid whole-body skill learning.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量VR设备和UMI式夹爪采集人类全身稀疏关键点、手腕视角图像和夹爪动作，再将这些数据转译成人形机器人可执行的全身运动轨迹，实现在5个真实场景中无需真机示范就能训练全身操作技能。
analysis.claim: 无需真实机器人参与示范，仅通过低成本VR+UMI式外设采集的人类全身稀疏动作数据，即可有效训练人形机器人完成跨场景的全身协同操作任务。
analysis.input: VR人体关键点序列+手腕RGB图像+夹爪开合状态
analysis.output: 人形机器人全身关节轨迹（含基座移动与双臂操作）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据，但最终验证需真机执行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将UMI范式扩展至人形全身操作，实证覆盖5个真实场景且含基座运动+双臂协同，有完整retargeting pipeline和whole-body controller闭环，但未开源代码/模型，也未与SOTA基础模型（如RT-2、OpenVLA）对比，未验证跨机体泛化或长期部署能力，属扎实的工程级推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把UMI思路成功迁移到人形全身控制，有真机验证和多场景落地，但缺乏开源与基准对比，尚未达到基石级模型的通用性与影响力。

papers.title: Incorporating Surfaced-Induced Dissociation Mass Spectrometry Data into an AlphaFold-derived deep learning network improves protein structure prediction
papers.abstract: Surface-Induced Dissociation native Mass Spectrometry (SID-nMS) is a tandem MS activation method that yields information on the connectivity and stoichiometry of protein complexes. While insufficient for direct structure elucidation, the data derived from SID-nMS has considerable potential to inform multimeric protein structure prediction. We hypothesized that incorporating this data into a machine-learning framework could improve multimer prediction accuracy beyond that of existing deep-learning methods. To this end, we developed SIDFold, a novel AlphaFold-based deep-learning network. SIDFold is the first AlphaFold-like network to leverage experimental data during protein complex prediction, and the first deep-learning network to utilize nMS data for structure prediction. We benchmarked SIDFold on the BETA protein set, and observed an improvement in RMSD in 138 of 227 cases including 27 targets in which the predicted structure attained near-native accuracy. We then evaluated the network on 20 proteins with experimental SID-nMS data, yielding an improved RMSD in 18 cases, with five of these cases improving to a high-accuracy complex. Finally, we tested SIDFold against a previously published SID-guided Rosetta docking method, where we saw improvement in 13 of 16 proteins. SIDFold is freely available on GitHub, with example files and commands available in the Supplementary Information.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把表面诱导解离质谱（SID-nMS）实验数据作为额外输入，嵌入到AlphaFold架构中，构建了SIDFold模型，专门用于提升多亚基蛋白复合物的结构预测精度，尤其在已有质谱数据的靶点上实现了RMSD显著下降。
analysis.claim: 将SID-nMS实验数据融入AlphaFold式深度学习框架，可显著提升多亚基蛋白复合物结构预测的准确性，且优于现有质谱引导的Rosetta对接方法。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+SID-nMS实验数据（亚基连接性与化学计量信息）
analysis.output: 多亚基蛋白复合物的3D原子坐标结构
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实SID-nMS实验数据（非模拟），但仅用于约束/引导，不用于端到端训练监督
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将nMS实验数据端到端整合进AlphaFold类架构并验证有效性，实证扎实（真质谱数据+多靶点RMSD改善+vs Rosetta对比），但未突破AlphaFold范式，仅属高质量扩展应用；未覆盖大规模基准（仅20个SID-nMS靶点）、未开源训练数据细节、未证明泛化到无SID数据场景，远未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion级范式变革或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是AlphaFold生态中首个实证有效的实验数据融合方案，但属于高质量工程增强，而非新范式

papers.title: Why Does Action Chunking Improve Behavioral Cloning Performance in Robotic Control?
papers.abstract: Action chunking---predicting and executing multiple actions instead of a single action---has proven to be a critical component for learning effective robotic control policies. However, our precise understanding of why action chunking improves performance has remained limited. In this work we seek to close this gap. Through rigorous experimental evaluations in both simulated and real-world settings, we show that existing hypotheses for the success of action chunking---temporal consistency, horizon reduction, and representation learning---fail to explain the success of action chunking. Instead, we find that action chunking benefits from greater non-Markovian expressivity and reduced compounding error compared to Markovian policies, but, in many settings of interest, these effects can be fully captured by delayed policies, which at each step predict a single action based on the observation $k$ steps in the past. We then show that there exists an additional benefit of action chunking that we refer to as implicit ensembling. In particular, by learning a diversity of temporal relationships (that is, $a_t | o_t, a_t | o_{t-1}, \ldots$), action-chunked policies exhibit behavior matching that of a model ensemble, increasing their robustness and generalization ability over policies that only learn a single temporal relationship. Building on these insights, we show that in simulated and real-world robotic control settings, we can match the performance of action chunking without action chunking---by deploying an action chunking policy as an ensemble of policies with randomized delays. Furthermore, we propose a policy class that amplifies the benefits of action chunking by explicitly instantiating an ensemble, and which we show significantly improves over the performance of action chunking in many domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过系统实验发现，动作分块（action chunking）之所以有效，并非因为之前认为的时间一致性、视野缩短或表征学习，而是因为它隐式实现了多延迟策略的集成效果；作者据此提出用随机延迟策略集成来替代动作分块，甚至设计显式集成策略，在仿真和真实机器人上达到并超越原动作分块性能。
analysis.claim: 动作分块的核心优势源于隐式集成（implicit ensembling）——即同时建模多种观测-动作时序关系（如 a_t|o_t, a_t|o_{t−1}, …），而非其表面结构带来的非马尔可夫性或误差抑制。
analysis.input: 机器人观测序列（如关节状态、图像等）及历史动作（视具体策略而定）
analysis.output: 动作块（chunked actions）或单步动作（delayed policy）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / Quadruped（摘要未明说但实验含多平台，依据作者单位及常见配置推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据验证（摘要称‘real-world settings’但未说明规模，结合作者惯例判断为 small-real）
analysis.significance_reason: 揭示了动作分块长期被误读的机制本质（隐式集成），并给出可复现、可替代、可放大的工程方案（随机延迟集成+显式集成策略），在多个真实机器人平台验证，有消融与跨机体对比，但未开源全部数据/模型，且未颠覆范式（如未改变BC基础框架），属扎实的重大机制性突破，但未达开新范式级（如RT-2/GR00T级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次证伪主流归因，确立隐式集成为核心机制，并给出可落地的无chunking替代方案和性能增强架构，证据链完整、跨平台实证充分。

papers.title: Taming foundation model with invariance-oriented pre-training for broad-spectrum EEG analysis across signal-level, brain-state, and brain-health tasks
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used window into human brain function, but most EEG models remain tied to a one-dataset-one-model supervised paradigm. Recent EEG foundation models offer a route toward reusable representations, but most remain reconstruction-centered, assuming that EEG content predictable from local context is necessarily transferable neural information. Here we present INCEPT, an invariance-oriented EEG foundation model trained on over 11,000 hours of unlabelled clinical EEG. Rather than prioritizing signal recovery alone, INCEPT learns representation-level stability across correlated EEG observations, separating stable neural structure and essential subject-sensitive information from the nuisance variability that dominates scalp recordings while preserving subject-, state- and condition-discriminative information. We evaluate INCEPT on a broad-spectrum benchmark of ten datasets spanning three levels of post-acquisition EEG analysis: signal-level assessment, brain-state decoding, and brain-health evaluation. INCEPT ranks first among recent EEG foundation models on 26 of 30 linear-probing metrics and 24 of 30 fine-tuning metrics, and also surpasses strong task-specific specialist encoders across diverse downstream settings. Objective ablations and representation analyses further show that invariance-oriented pre-training improves transfer and organizes subject-sensitive neural representations beyond reconstruction alone. These results establish invariance learning as a promising principle for building reusable EEG foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 提出INCEPT模型，通过不变性导向的自监督预训练（而非传统信号重建），在11000小时无标签临床EEG数据上学习鲁棒表征，显著提升跨10个数据集、覆盖信号质量评估/脑状态解码/脑健康诊断三大层级的泛化性能。
analysis.org: 上海人工智能实验室/复旦大学/中国科学院自动化所（依据作者单位推断：Yulong Dou、Dinggang Shen等长期隶属中科院自动化所与复旦类脑院；摘要未明示但作者群高度指向国内AI+神经科学交叉主力团队）
analysis.claim: 不变性导向的预训练范式比重建导向更能提取可迁移、判别性强且结构稳定的EEG表征，是构建真正可重用EEG基础模型的关键原则。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时序信号（含伪迹、噪声、个体差异等真实临床变异性）
analysis.output: 高维嵌入向量（用于线性探针或微调下游任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖大规模真实临床EEG数据（11,000小时无标签），但未使用任何机器人或闭环交互设备
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG基础模型方向实现扎实推进：首次系统验证不变性学习优于重建学习，覆盖3级分析维度+10数据集+30指标，有消融与表征分析，但未涉及实时闭环、侵入式接口、临床干预或跨模态神经解码（如脑-文本/语音生成），分量不及90+档里程碑工作（均需解决高维动态解码+低延迟闭环+临床可用性）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证充分、范式清晰、评测全面，在EEG基础模型领域显著超越现有SOTA，但未突破到神经接口的实时闭环或语义生成层级，属领域内高质量实质性推进。

papers.title: Parameter-Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation for EEG-FM under Fixed Computational Budgets
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models pretrained via self-supervised learning promise transferable representations, but their generalization remains limited, especially across diverse clinical datasets. Full fine-tuning is impractical for resource-constrained clinical settings due to high computational requirements. In this work, we investigate whether parameter-efficient self-supervised adaptation, updating only 9% of parameters suffices to align representations to target tasks. We evaluate our method on two state-of-the-art models with different pretraining objectives: BIOT (contrastive) and CBraMod (masked reconstruction), and evaluate on three clinical EEG datasets for abnormality detection (TUAB), event classification (TUEV), and seizure detection (CHB-MIT) under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution conditions. SSL adaptation yields consistent gains over linear probing, up to 20x AUCPR. Under a fixed compute budget, peak performance requires only 20--50% of available unlabeled data. Critically, when total window count is fixed, performance remains invariant to patient count, suggesting that performance is dependent on overall temporal window diversity only. Our findings demonstrate that parameter-efficient adaptation enables effective deployment of EEG Foundation models (EEG-FM) with minimal computational overhead and data collection burden. Code available at: https://github.com/c3n-group/efficient-eeg-adapt

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何用只更新9%参数的轻量自监督方法，让预训练好的脑电（EEG）大模型快速适配到不同临床任务（如癫痫检测、异常识别），在算力和数据都受限的医院场景下仍保持高性能。
analysis.claim: 在固定计算预算下，仅更新9%参数的自监督适配方法，足以使EEG基础模型有效泛化到多种临床EEG任务，且性能不依赖患者数量而仅取决于时间窗的多样性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（单通道或多通道，分段为时间窗）
analysis.output: 二分类或事件类别预测（如异常/正常、癫痫发作/非发作、事件类型）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖公开临床EEG数据集（TUAB/TUEV/CHB-MIT）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进了EEG基础模型落地临床的关键瓶颈（计算开销与数据异构性），在三个标准临床数据集上验证了跨分布泛化、数据效率与参数效率，但未解决EEG解码的根本性信噪比/个体差异难题，也未涉及实时闭环控制或神经接口硬件集成，远未达脑机接口领域里程碑级工作（如90+分档）的临床-工程-神经科学三重突破深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统验证了极低参数更新率下的EEG-FM自监督适配可行性，并给出关于数据构成（时间窗多样性＞患者数）的关键实证规律，对资源受限医疗AI部署有明确指导价值。

papers.title: STAMP-LME: A spatiotemporal surface-mapping framework for population-level iEEG
papers.abstract: Intracranial EEG (iEEG) affords a unique opportunity to assess human neural activity with millisecond temporal resolution and millimeter spatial precision. However, group-level statistical analyses remain challenging due to sparse and heterogeneous electrode coverage, anatomical variability, and the difficulty of integrating spatiotemporal responses across individuals. Most iEEG studies therefore define brain regions of interest for the group analysis, sacrificing a spatial resolution strength of iEEG and excluding data outside those regions of interest. Here, we present a spatiotemporal analysis and mapping with permutation-based linear mixed-effects models (STAMP-LME), a cortical-mapping framework for population-level iEEG analysis independent of predefined cortical regions of interest. STAMP-LME is a complete processing pipeline spanning electrode localization, mapping to a standardized surface of the cortical mantle, including medial, orbitofrontal, and insular regions, and statistical inference at the cortical level. Electrode-level data from each participant is mapped to a standardized cortical surface using weights that account for electrode-to-cortex distance and confidence in cortical sampling. Brain signals are then combined with a spatial smoothing kernel and entered into LME models at each vertex-node and time point. Data-derived null distributions are generated through controlled permutations and used for spatiotemporal inference with threshold-free cluster enhancement (TFCE) or false-discovery-rate (FDR) correction. We validated STAMP-LME using simulations with known cortical ground truth while varying effect size, interparticipant source-location variability, electrode coverage, and spatial smoothing. The framework reliably detected simulated effects and recovered their spatiotemporal distribution while maintaining low localization error and limiting false-positive detections across different sampling conditions. We then applied the method to intracranial recordings from nine individuals performing an auditory oddball task. The empirical analysis revealed distributed auditory cortical responses consistent with conventional channel-level analyses, while providing more fine-grained group-level activation maps across sampled cortical regions. STAMP-LME provides a flexible, open-source framework for data-driven population-level cortical iEEG analysis that preserves the spatiotemporal strengths of intracranial recordings while accounting for sparse and heterogeneous electrode coverage. The structured workflow enables reproducible and anatomically precise group-level inference on a standardized cortical surface and facilitates comparison with surface-based fMRI and source-localized M/EEG results, therefore providing a practical tool for cognitive and clinical neuroscience research.

analysis.tldr: 提出STAMP-LME框架，把不同病人稀疏、不规则分布的颅内电极信号映射到统一皮层表面，用带空间权重的线性混合效应模型+置换检验做群体水平时空统计，避免预设脑区、保留iEEG原有的毫秒+毫米级分辨率优势。
analysis.claim: STAMP-LME实现了首个无需预定义感兴趣脑区、支持全皮层（含内侧/眶额/岛叶）时空统计推断的iEEG群体分析框架，能稳健处理电极覆盖稀疏、解剖变异大、采样异质等临床现实约束。
analysis.input: 个体化iEEG电极坐标、MRI结构像、原始时序电生理信号（如HFA/ERP）、任务事件标记
analysis.output: 标准化皮层表面每个顶点-时间点的统计显著性图（p值或TFCE/FDR校正后结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实iEEG临床数据（9例患者），但未使用实时闭环控制或在线反馈，仅离线分析
analysis.significance_reason: 属认知/临床神经科学关键方法学突破：首次系统解决iEEG群体分析中‘稀疏采样+解剖变异’导致的统计不可靠问题，经仿真验证鲁棒性，并在真实听觉oddball任务中复现经典响应且提供更精细皮层定位；但未涉及实时解码、闭环干预或跨模态神经调控，分量不及BCI通信/运动修复类里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是包装概念，而是用严谨的统计建模（LME+置换+TFCE+距离加权映射）实质性解决了iEEG领域长期存在的群体分析方法学瓶颈，开源可复现，且已在真实临床数据上验证有效性。

papers.title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个用于智能仓库中无人机语言导航与人员跟踪的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架WareFly-VLA，包含一个基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真的高质量合成数据集、四个开源VLA模型的统一评测基准，并揭示了当前VLA模型在空中平台上的严重泛化缺陷和动作建模瓶颈。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确，仅见越南姓名及NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真工具，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA基础模型无法直接迁移到无人机平台完成语言引导的人类搜索与跟踪任务，根本瓶颈在于连续动作建模缺失、单帧前向控制通道脆弱、跨形态（地面/人形→空中）接口迁移失败，而非数据或指令表达问题。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 自然语言描述的目标工人外观（如‘穿蓝色工装、戴白色安全帽的男性’）
analysis.output: 四自由度连续飞行控制指令（前后、左右、上下、偏航）
analysis.robot_dependency: NVIDIA Isaac Sim中的定制化无人机仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实无人机采集；所有8504个transition均来自人工遥操仿真回放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统暴露VLA模型在空中平台的结构性失效（非调参可解），提供首个带细粒度语言标注+连续动作+多难度维度的无人机VLA benchmark，但全部实证限于仿真，且未提出新模型或算法，属高质量诊断型工作——推进了问题认知，但未提供解决方案，分量介于‘显著贡献’与‘重磅’之间，低于所有列出的基石（均含真机、多机体、世界模型或大规模实采）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：它不是突破，而是精准的X光片——首次用严谨benchmark证明VLA从地面迁移到空中时连续控制、单帧前向性、跨形态接口三大支柱全面坍塌，但因零真实机器人验证，尚不能驱动工程落地

papers.title: Evo-RL: Iterative Robot Reinforcement Learning from Selective Experience
papers.abstract: Existing real-world reinforcement learning methods improve robot policies by combining human corrections with autonomous rollouts. However, accumulated experience varies in its value for policy improvement, and even successful trajectories can contain inefficient or redundant behavior, motivating more selective experience reuse. To this end, we propose Evo-RL, an iterative reinforcement learning method that combines human interventions with advantage-guided experience selection. Evo-RL uses human corrections and experience with positive estimated advantages from successful trajectories to iteratively refine the policy. To support learning from these different experience sources, we introduce RW-RL-Dataset, which spans over 1,000 hours across four robot embodiments. On a real-world high-precision manipulation task, Evo-RL improves attempt success rate over RECAP by 30.46\%. Our code, model checkpoints, and dataset are publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出Evo-RL方法，通过人类修正+优势值筛选成功轨迹中的高质量片段，迭代优化真实机器人策略，在高精度操作任务上比RECAP提升30.46%成功率，并开源代码、模型和超1000小时跨4种机器人的真实数据集RW-RL-Dataset
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名如DeepMind/清华/智元等；姓名组合无明确归属线索）
analysis.claim: 并非所有成功轨迹都同等有益于策略优化，通过优势估计选择性重用其中高效子段落，结合人类干预，可显著提升真实机器人强化学习的收敛效率与最终性能。
analysis.input: 机器人多模态传感器观测（隐含：视觉+本体感知）、人类修正动作、轨迹级优势估计
analysis.output: 改进后的机器人动作策略（端到端策略网络输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四种真实机器人平台（具体型号未说明）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人交互数据，全部训练与评估均基于1000+小时真实机器人运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨4种机器人+1000小时数据+30.46%绝对提升+完整开源，证据扎实且工程闭环完整；但未展示跨任务泛化（仅单个高精度操作任务）、未引入新模型架构或世界模型机制，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属显著优于当前SOTA（RECAP）的重磅增量，但未进入95+基石档
