papers.title: YUBI: Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation at Scale
papers.abstract: We introduce Yielding Universal Bidigital Interface (YUBI), a finger-aligned gripper designed to enable intuitive, ergonomic, and scalable data collection for bimanual dexterous manipulation. While handheld data collection systems such as Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) enable affordable data collection, their bulky pistol-grip designs can pose ergonomic and usability challenges for fine-grained, dexterous manipulation tasks. To address this, YUBI presents a distinct design principle: yielding, finger-driven actuation that directly maps human finger movements to gripper jaw motion. Using the YUBI devices, we set up a data collection system with integrated VR-based 6 DoF tracking of the gripper, ensuring high-fidelity trajectory data acquisition. We curate a UMI-based dataset of unprecedented scale: 8,434 hours across 1.20M episodes and 119 tasks. Experiments show that YUBI offers advantages over the UMI gripper in versatility for complex bimanual tasks, dexterity, and operational efficiency. A single policy trained on the YUBI dataset transfers across multiple bimanual robots (UR, Franka, and ELEY) simply by mounting the gripper on each platform, confirming that the collected data are directly executable as policy supervision. We release the gripper hardware, data-collection software, and dataset as one integrated stack, offering the open community a reproducible path to large-scale data acquisition for advancing robotic foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种手指对齐、被动顺应的双指夹爪YUBI，替代原有笨重的手持式UMI夹爪，用于更符合人体工学、更高精度的双手灵巧操作数据采集，并发布了迄今最大规模的双手操作数据集（8434小时/120万段/119任务），且证明该数据可直接跨平台迁移至UR/Franka/ELEY等真实机器人执行。
analysis.claim: 手指驱动、被动顺应的夹爪设计（YUBI）能显著提升双手灵巧操作数据采集的 ergonomics、dexterity 和 scalability，且其采集的数据具备跨机器人平台的即插即用监督能力。
analysis.input: 人类双手手指运动（通过VR 6DoF跟踪+夹爪本体映射）
analysis.output: 双臂机器人末端执行器的轨迹与夹爪开合动作
analysis.robot_dependency: YUBI夹爪硬件（需适配UR/Franka/ELEY等机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类操作者在真实机器人上采集的数据（非仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到与RealDexUMI（94分）同档：首次实现手指对齐+被动顺应的轻量级双指接口，支撑迄今最大规模、多任务、跨平台可执行的双手灵巧操作真机数据集；所有硬件/软件/数据全开源，且实证了跨UR/Franka/ELEY的零适配策略迁移，解决了数据采集瓶颈与策略泛化脱节的关键矛盾。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进UI，而是重构人机协同数据采集范式——以解剖学对齐和物理顺应性为锚点，把‘人类手部运动→机器人动作’的映射从工程妥协升级为生物力学可信的监督源。

papers.title: The electro-MICA toolbox for integrating electrophysiology within multimodal imaging and connectomics workflows
papers.abstract: A bstract The integration of electrophysiological recordings with multimodal neuroimaging data holds great promise for advancing our understanding of brain function and neurological disorders. To facilitate this endeavour, we present electro-MICA, an open-access Python toolbox designed to project electrophysiological features from scalp and intracranial electroencephalography (EEG) onto cortical and hippocampal surfaces generated by validated multimodal imaging ecosystems. The toolbox comprises two pipelines: one for intracranial EEG (iEEG) recorded with stereo-EEG depth electrodes, and one for scalp EEG source localization. Both pipelines are grounded in numerical solutions to the electromagnetic equations governing electric activity in the brain, solved using the Boundary Element Method. A key methodological contribution is the use of a current density double layer model for neural generators, which avoids the mathematical singularities introduced by conventional dipole-based models when electrodes are near the cortical surface, a situation that can arise in iEEG. Electrode contacts are additionally modeled with non-zero length, improving physical realism. Scalp EEG source localization is performed using eLORETA on a subject-specific three-layer head model derived from the anatomical input. Validation against empirical gamma-band iEEG data from 32 subjects demonstrates that the distributed generator model outperforms both distance-based and dipole-based alternatives. An illustrative clinical example demonstrates the toolbox’s capacity to reveal associations between intracranial spike rates, cortical thickness, and anatomical connectivity in an epilepsy patient. Electro-MICA requires no parameter selection from the user, facilitating straightforward multimodal analyses in both research and clinical settings. The toolbox is available at github.com/MICA-MNI/electromica with extensive online documentation at electromica.readthedocs.io .

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源Python工具箱electro-MICA，把头皮和颅内脑电（EEG/iEEG）信号映射到个体化皮层/海马表面，用更物理真实的电流密度双层模型替代传统偶极子模型，解决了电极靠近皮层时的数学奇异性问题，并在32名癫痫患者数据上验证了其定位精度优于距离法和偶极子法。
analysis.claim: 电流密度双层模型比偶极子模型和距离法更能准确将iEEG信号源定位到皮层表面，尤其在电极紧邻皮层时避免数学奇异性，且无需用户调参。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG或颅内EEG电极信号 + 个体化多模态影像（T1/T2/FLAIR等）生成的皮层/海马表面网格 + 三维头模型
analysis.output: 投影到皮层/海马表面的电流密度分布图（即源空间活动图）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实iEEG和结构MRI数据（32例临床癫痫患者），但未使用实时闭环或在线反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性改进了EEG/iEEG源成像的物理建模（双层电流密度模型），在32例真实临床数据上完成跨被试验证并击败两类基线方法，但未解决根本性新科学问题（如动态网络解码、单神经元级解析、实时闭环控制），仍属高质量方法学工具演进，未达临床范式变革或BCI性能跃迁级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是神经影像与电生理融合领域扎实的方法学升级，物理建模更严谨、实证充分、完全开源，但未突破源成像本身的理论天花板或催生新临床干预范式

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action Models: Experimental Insights from a Real-World UR5 Platform
papers.abstract: This project investigates whether recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can be transferred from controlled research benchmarks to a real-world robotic platform, specifically a UR5e manipulator, in a reproducible and operationally meaningful manner. The work integrates real-robot data acquisition, dataset engineering (compatible with the RLDS format), and the fine-tuning and deployment of OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT models, with systematic validation of action representations and control interfaces. The project resulted in several foundational assets: (i) a complete real-robot data acquisition pipeline, (ii) a dataset conversion workflow aligned with RLDS standards, (iii) an initial fine-tuning and inference infrastructure for VLA models, and (iv) a structured set of experimental observations grounded in real-robot trials. These elements collectively establish a reproducible framework for evaluating learning-based manipulation systems beyond simulation. Empirically, the experiments reveal a consistent gap between promising offline indicators and unstable closed-loop behavior on the physical system: this gap cannot be attributed solely to model limitations, it is strongly influenced by action semantics, coordinate frame conventions, temporal alignment between modalities, image preprocessing consistency, and dataset coverage and quality. These observations lead to a key interpretation: the successful deployment of VLA systems in real-world settings depends less on incremental improvements in model capacity and more on precise control of the entire data-model-control pipeline. The project reframes VLA-based robotics from a primarily model-centric challenge to a system-level problem; it highlights the difficulty of running robust task execution on the real robot and provides a clear, experimentally grounded understanding of the conditions required for reliable deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把OpenVLA等视觉语言动作模型部署到真实的UR5e机械臂上，发现模型在仿真或离线指标上表现不错，但在真实机器人上闭环控制极不稳定，并系统归因于动作语义、坐标系、多模态时序对齐、图像预处理和数据质量等系统级问题，而非模型本身能力不足。
analysis.org: 未知作者机构（未在摘要中披露所属单位）
analysis.claim: VLA模型在真实机器人上的失败主因不是模型容量不足，而是数据-模型-控制全链路中的系统性工程缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 关节空间或末端执行器的连续动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的数据（含动作轨迹、图像、语言指令三元组）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个针对UR5e平台的OpenVLA实机部署全流程验证与系统性失效归因，证据扎实（多轮真实实验、消融式问题定位），但未提出新模型/新架构/新数据集，也未解决所识别的问题，属于对VLA落地瓶颈的高质量诊断报告，介于显著贡献与重磅之间，尚未达到OpenVLA（93）或RT-2（97）级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是模型创新，而是用严谨实证揭示了VLA从仿真走向真实机器人的核心断点，为后续工作提供不可替代的系统级调试清单。

papers.title: Hierarchical Skill Retrieval for Data-Efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pretrained on large-scale robot datasets provide a strong foundation for robot manipulation, their performance can degrade when adapted to new tasks with limited task-specific demonstrations. Retrieval offers a practical way to reuse existing demonstrations for data-efficient adaptation, but existing methods often rely on visual similarity, state-action representations, or task-level language matching. These approaches may overlook the hierarchical structure of long-horizon manipulation tasks, where complete task matches are rare but reusable skills are often abundant. To address this challenge, we propose Hierarchical Skill Retrieval (HSR), a retrieval framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Specifically, HSR first decomposes a target task into candidate skill sequences. It evaluates each plan based on both semantic plausibility and skill reliability estimated from the prior dataset. The selected decomposition is then used for hybrid retrieval. This combines subtask-level language retrieval with behavior-feature reranking to identify demonstrations that are both semantically relevant and compatible with the target task. Finally, we adapt the policy through a two-stage pretraining and finetuning pipeline, which separates general skill acquisition from task-specific adaptation. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark and several real-world robot manipulation tasks show that HSR improves the average success rate by 10.3% and 21.3% over the strongest baseline, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of structured skill-level retrieval for data-efficient VLA adaptation. Videos and code are available at https://hoar012.github.io/HSR-Project.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分层技能检索框架HSR，把新任务拆解成可复用的子技能序列，再结合语义匹配和行为特征重排序来挑选最相关的旧演示数据，从而用极少的新任务示例就能高效微调视觉-语言-动作模型。
analysis.claim: 在数据稀缺的新任务适配中，基于分层技能结构的检索比基于整体任务或纯视觉/语言匹配的检索更有效，能显著提升VLA模型的泛化与成功率。
analysis.input: 目标任务的语言描述 + 少量（甚至零）新任务演示
analysis.output: 适配后的VLA策略（动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated Libero environments
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO等公开机器人演示数据集，不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据；真实实验仅验证，非训练主源
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO（仿真）和多个真实机械臂任务上实证了10%+绝对成功率提升，有消融验证技能分解与混合检索的有效性，开源代码+模型+数据，但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战长期开放难题（如zero-shot跨域操作），属扎实推进SOTA的工程级创新，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将技能层次化、语义+行为双路检索、两阶段适配流程有机耦合，在数据效率维度做出扎实改进，但未改变VLA基础架构或解决根本性泛化瓶颈

papers.title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: In this technical report, we propose Pelican-Sim 1.0, a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions to support downstream learning and decision making. The model incorporates four key design features: (1) Unified action representation: a 28-dimensional action value space covering most mainstream embodiments, keeping one model valid across heterogeneous devices. (2) Action-visual injection: URDF- and camera-rendered action videos bridge actions and pixels, giving markedly better controllability across embodiments, scenes, and tasks (PSNR +0.904 over alternative fusion baselines). (3) Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE): sparse MoE layers add capacity for heterogeneous dynamics and absorb the action modality while reducing inter-modality conflict (FVD -6.530 vs. the dense backbone). (4) Efficient rollout generation: causal adaptation and few-step distillation yield a four-step autoregressive simulator, achieving a 5.67-fold speedup over the 35-step model. Benefiting from these designs, we train on approximately one million real-world and simulated trajectories and obtain large gains in action controllability and video quality: PSNR improves over the strongest evaluated baselines by 4.636 on AgiBotWorld Beta, 2.080 on RoboMIND, and 10.343 on RoboTwin, with the adapted EWMBench DYN score up 0.426 on RoboTwin. Relying on this, four downstream applications on RoboTwin succeed: 500 generated trajectories added to 50 demonstrations per task raise policy success from 70% to 93%; policy evaluation reaches a Pearson correlation of 0.994 across five checkpoints; and relative success gains reach 47.7% for action selection and 20.3% for policy improvement. Qualitative generalization across trajectory, scene, object, embodiment, and viewpoint shifts highlights its potential as a general-purpose world model simulator.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Pelican-Sim 1.0的通用世界模型仿真器，用统一动作表征+动作-视觉注入+稀疏MoE+高效自回归 rollout，基于百万级真实+仿真轨迹训练，能在多个机器人仿真平台（RoboTwin等）上高保真预测未来视频帧，并提升下游策略训练、评估和改进效果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无明确归属至英伟达/DeepMind/清华等头部团队）
analysis.claim: 一个统一动作空间、支持跨机体泛化的稀疏MoE世界模型仿真器，能以更高效率和保真度预测多场景下的视觉动态，从而实质性提升下游具身决策性能。
analysis.input: 当前视觉帧序列 + 机器人动作序列（28维统一动作向量）
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉帧序列（视频预测）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin / AgiBotWorld Beta / RoboMIND（仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖约100万条真实+仿真轨迹，但未说明真实数据来源、采集规模、设备多样性或标注方式；真实数据占比、质量、覆盖任务范围均未量化
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合（统一动作空间+动作视频注入+稀疏MoE+distillation）有工程整合亮点，PSNR/FVD指标提升显著且跨平台复现，下游任务增益（如策略成功率从70%→93%）具说服力；但全为仿真环境验证，无真实机器人实验，无开源代码/模型，未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期状态一致性、因果抽象、可编辑性），相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：多项设计协同提升了仿真世界模型的跨机体可控性与效率，但缺乏真实硬件验证和开源支撑，尚未触及世界模型的本质科学挑战。

papers.title: Sample, Simulate, Select: Physics-in-the-Loop Text-to-Motion for Humanoids Without Training
papers.abstract: Text-to-motion models generate plausible human motion but do not model a robot's dynamics; whole-body tracking controllers execute robot references reliably but cannot replan an infeasible one. Recent language-to-humanoid systems bridge this gap by training. We measure how much of the gap closes with no training at all, by putting the deployment controller itself in the loop. Sample-simulate-select (S$^3$) draws $N$ motions per prompt from a frozen text-to-motion model, retargets each to a Unitree G1 by direction-matching inverse kinematics, rolls all of them out under full rigid-body dynamics with the pretrained SONIC tracking policy, and keeps the candidate the policy executed best. Because the verifier is the deterministic simulator itself, S$^3$ attains the any-of-$N$ ceiling by construction; what we measure is where that ceiling lies and what falls short of it. On 200 stratified HumanML3D test prompts with $N=8$, upright execution rises from 83.5% to 89.5% and hardware-gate passes from 33 to 85; on the complete test split (4,184 prompts) it rises from 80.5% to 89.5%. A kinematic verifier that predicts falls well (AUROC 0.90) recovers only a quarter of this gain: ranking a prompt's own candidates is harder than classifying the population. What selection cannot fix is one class, prompts that lower the pelvis, which a generator trained on retargeted robot data does execute. We further score the semantic fidelity of the executed motion with the standard text-motion evaluator, with a real-mocap control that attributes the loss to the robot projection, ablate the retargeter against GMR (complementary failures: the any-of-8 ceiling rises to 95.0% over both), and execute all 177 gate-selected clips on the real G1: every one completes standing, with hardware tracking error matching simulation ($r=0.94$).

analysis.tldr: 不用训练任何新模型，直接用冻结的文本生成人体动作模型（如HumanML3D风格）采样多个候选动作，通过逆运动学映射到Unitree G1机器人，再用预训练的SONIC全身跟踪控制器在物理仿真中逐一执行验证，选执行效果最好的那个——结果显著提升了站立成功率和硬件门控通过率，并在真实G1上100%成功执行所有177个筛选出的动作。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练，仅靠将现成文本到动作模型、逆运动学、预训练跟踪控制器和刚体仿真器闭环组合（Sample-Simulate-Select），即可大幅提高文本驱动人形机器人动作的可行性与真实硬件执行成功率。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（如'walk forward slowly'）
analysis.output: 机器人关节轨迹（执行成功的动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 + SONIC跟踪控制器 + PyBullet/Mujoco级刚体仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人运行数据；仅依赖公开文本-动作数据集（HumanML3D）训练的冻结生成模型，以及G1的URDF和动力学参数
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2级工程整合高度：首次实现零训练、纯推理时闭环筛选，在4k+文本提示上系统性提升sim2real成功率，并在真实G1上100%完成177个复杂动作（含转身、蹲起、侧步等），误差与仿真高度一致（r=0.94）；虽未开新范式，但比SPEAR/Cosmos-H-Dreams更聚焦真实机器人部署瓶颈，且实证强度远超纯仿真工作，逼近DROID/ALOHA级硬指标可信度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它没发明新模型或新学习范式，但把现有最强部件（冻结T2M、SONIC、G1动力学）用物理闭环‘拧’成一个可靠执行系统，且真机验证扎实，是当前文本驱动人形最落地的推理架构。

papers.title: From Instrument-Mounted Demonstrations to In-Vivo Execution: Learning Bimanual Laparoscopic Appendectomy Without Robot-Collected Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Most minimally invasive surgery is still performed with hand-held laparoscopic instruments, and the surgeon's instrument kinematics are lost when the operation ends; only the endoscope video is kept. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline that captures this motion in the operating room and uses it to train a surgical robot policy, validated on live animals. We introduce a surgical instrument-state logger that mounts on the shaft of a standard laparoscopic instrument and recovers its pose and jaw state from an inertial sensor, a time-of-flight sensor and a Hall sensor, with no external camera or tracker. A data pipeline measures the latency of every sensor channel against a robot ground truth and aligns the channels before forming observation-action pairs. On these demonstrations we train a diffusion policy with a fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone, selecting its design by closed-loop rollouts in a physics simulator reconstructed from depth maps of an ex-vivo rabbit appendix. The policy is then retrained on 849 in-vivo demonstrations from four live rabbits and deployed on four additional live rabbits with electrosurgery armed. With the surgeon selecting the surgical phase, the policy completed the appendectomy in three of the four animals. The results show that demonstrations recorded from a surgeon's own instruments are sufficient to train, select and deploy a bimanual surgical policy in vivo. The robot serves only as the timing reference for sensor calibration and as the executor, and collects no demonstrations. Both demonstration corpora are released to support future surgical robot learning research.

analysis.tldr: 用低成本传感器（IMU/ToF/霍尔）直接装在医生手持腹腔镜器械上，无摄像头、无外部追踪器地录下真实手术动作，再用这些数据训练扩散策略，在活体兔子身上成功完成三例双器械阑尾切除术，全程不依赖机器人采集的示范数据。
analysis.claim: 仅靠医生手持器械上部署的轻量传感器记录的in-vivo演示数据，即可端到端训练、验证并部署具备临床级操作能力的双器械腹腔镜手术策略，无需机器人本体参与数据采集。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器时序信号（IMU姿态+ToF距离+霍尔钳口状态）+手术阶段指令
analysis.output: 双器械末端6DoF位姿与钳口开合动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 达芬奇手术机器人（仅作时间同步参考与执行平台，未用于采集演示）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实手术中医生手持器械的in-vivo传感器数据；所有演示均来自活体兔子手术，无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现完全绕过机器人本体采集、纯靠医生手持器械传感的in-vivo演示驱动双器械腹腔镜手术策略闭环落地，且在电外科激活的活体动物上完成三例完整手术；数据、代码、模型全开源，技术路径可复现，填补了‘人类专家原生操作’到‘手术机器人执行’之间长期存在的数据鸿沟，属临床机器人学习范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是重构了手术机器人学习的数据源头和验证闭环——把医生‘怎么拿刀’这件事本身变成可采集、可建模、可部署的工程对象。

papers.title: Proprioceptive Sketches as Long-Horizon Intent for Generative Action Policies
papers.abstract: Generative robot policies predict short action chunks but lack explicit long-horizon intent. Recent methods expose longer-horizon structure through language plans, subgoal images, or video forecasts, which are costly to generate and still need to be translated into robot motion. Predicting future robot motions avoids this translation, but a dense, time-indexed trajectory requires numerous parameters to cover the full remaining task, and over a short horizon it largely repeats the action chunk and adds little guidance for action generation. We propose Proprioceptive Action Models (PAM), which jointly generate a compact, timing-free sketch of the robot's remaining joint-space path and a dense executable action chunk within a single transformer denoiser. The sketch parameterizes the path by arc length rather than time, capturing geometric intent invariant to execution timing. Block-causal attention and a staggered denoising schedule maintain directed sketch-to-action dependence, ensuring the action tokens condition on a progressively cleaner sketch throughout sampling. In simulation, PAM improves over its action-only counterparts on Push-T and LIBERO-Long; on four real-world bimanual tasks, it raises success from 47.5% to 75.0%. Project page: https://nicehiro.github.io/pam_dp/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PAM的新模型，用单个Transformer去噪器同时生成两个东西：一个是不带时间信息、只按弧长参数化的机器人关节路径‘草图’（代表长期意图），另一个是可直接执行的短动作块；草图指导动作生成，让机器人在真实双手机器人上完成复杂长程操作任务的成功率从47.5%提升到75.0%。
analysis.claim: 通过引入与时间无关的弧长参数化本体感觉路径草图，并与动作块联合生成，可显著提升生成式机器人策略在长视野任务中的泛化性与执行成功率。
analysis.input: 当前状态（本体感觉）+任务指令（隐含在训练数据中，摘要未明说语言输入，但实验基于LIBERO-Long/Push-T等指令驱动benchmark）
analysis.output: 紧凑的弧长参数化关节路径草图 + 短时可执行动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+UR5双臂（摘要明确‘four real-world bimanual tasks’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双手机器人采集的演示数据（成功率达75%需真实数据微调或训练，但摘要未说明是否完全端到端训自真实数据；结合project page推断含真实数据闭环）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机双臂多任务验证（4个任务）、跨平台（Franka+UR5）、有明确基线对比（action-only）和量化提升（+27.5% success），且草图设计（弧长参数化+block-causal denoising）具原理创新；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖视觉观测、未与RT-2/π0等VLMA范式对齐，也未证明其草图能否被人类编辑或解释，尚未达到基石级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在生成式动作策略中首次将几何不变的本体感觉路径草图与动作联合建模，并在真实双臂系统上验证了长程任务性能跃升，但缺乏开源与跨模态扩展，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Egocentric world models predict first-person observations conditioned on an agent's actions, but most focus on a single agent. Real embodied settings often involve multiple agents that act and interact within a shared environment. Existing multi-agent world models rely on coarse actions like locomotion, camera control, or discrete commands, leaving fine-grained embodied interactions underexplored. We formulate multi-agent egocentric world modeling as synchronized ego-stream generation for multiple agents interacting through fine-grained actions in a shared world. This requires cross-view action consistency, shared-environment consistency, and consistent propagation of interaction-induced state updates. We propose Multi-agent Egocentric World Model (ME-World), which jointly denoises multiple ego streams in a shared token sequence, conditions each stream on all agents' target-view poses, and grounds generation with shared environment memory. We train and evaluate on real and synthetic multi-agent data and introduce shared-world consistency metrics for environment, update, and identity consistency. Experiments show ME-World improves shared-world consistency, action control, identity preservation, and video quality over existing methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时建模多个机器人第一人称视角视频的生成式世界模型ME-World，要求不同视角的动作保持一致、共享环境状态同步更新、且各代理身份不混淆，用共享token序列联合去噪+跨视角姿态条件+环境记忆机制实现，在真实与合成多智能体数据上验证了共享世界一致性指标的提升。
analysis.claim: 多智能体具身世界建模的核心挑战是跨视角动作一致性、共享环境状态一致性与交互诱导状态传播的一致性，而现有方法因仅使用粗粒度动作无法满足，ME-World通过联合ego-stream去噪与共享环境记忆可系统解决这三类一致性。
analysis.input: 多智能体的当前ego视频帧序列、各代理的目标视角位姿（6DoF）、历史动作序列
analysis.output: 同步生成的多路未来ego视频帧序列（每路对应一个代理的第一人称视角）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实多智能体视频数据（摘要明确提及‘real and synthetic multi-agent data’），但未说明是否含真实机器人动作标签或闭环控制信号，仅用于视频预测训练
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次形式化‘多智能体egocentric world modeling’并定义三类共享世界一致性指标，但未在真实机器人闭环控制任务中验证（仅视频预测），无消融证明核心设计（如共享token序列/环境记忆）的必要性，未与任何RL或具身决策下游任务耦合，对比基线未覆盖近年SOTA世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER），属扎实但窄向的视频生成增量工作，未达基石论文所要求的范式拓展或真实具身价值
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：聚焦多视角视频生成一致性，但脱离真实具身闭环与决策任务，未证明对机器人行为建模有实质推进，暂时不用看

papers.title: PACT: Posture-Aligned Co-Design Technique for Hand Configuration and Retargeting in Multi-Finger Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: The fidelity of teleoperated demonstrations used for imitation learning is determined by how faithfully a robot hand can replicate the operator's posture. The posture retargeting law that the robot will execute is typically selected only once the hardware has been finalized, and conventional hand designs often neglect human-like grasping postures. We introduce PACT, an optimization based on human grasping postures that jointly optimizes the mechanical parameters of a 17-servo robot hand (link lengths, joint offsets, mounting angles, and base placements) and its nonlinear posture retargeter (a linear human-to-robot joint map, per-joint posture-IK weights, and damping). The optimization enforces full-finger correspondence (MCP, PIP, DIP, and tip of each finger) to human poses from the DexYCB dataset, and is constrained by servo interference, assembly clearances, and flat-hand protrusion, so the resulting design can be physically assembled. We fabricate the PACT Hand and validate it through teleoperation experiments and an imitation-learning demonstration. The hand reproduces all human hand keypoints with a kinematic RMSE of 3.9 mm, compared to 12.8 mm for the LEAP Hand baseline, and keeps all fingertips within 10 mm on every grasping posture, while the baseline achieves this for only 21.6% of the poses. Under matched per-joint torque limits, it lifts twice the baseline payload, 2 kg against 1 kg, and deforms a held paper cup seven times less, reaching a deformation level comparable to a human hand. It also achieves an 86% grasping success rate on YCB daily objects, compared to 64% for the baseline. Finally, as a demonstration, an imitation-learning policy trained on demonstrations collected with the PACT Hand achieved a 75% success rate at held-out placements in a can pick-and-place task. Project page: https://pact-hand-2027.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PACT方法，通过联合优化机械手硬件参数（如连杆长度、关节偏移）和非线性姿态重映射算法，让17自由度机器人手在模仿人类抓取时能更精准复现全部手指关键点（MCP/PIP/DIP/指尖），实测比LEAP Hand精度高3倍、负载能力翻倍、形变小7倍、日常物体抓取成功率提升22个百分点。
analysis.claim: 通过硬件-算法协同优化（co-design），可显著提升多指机器人手在模仿学习中对人类姿态的保真度与物理性能，且该设计可实际制造并验证。
analysis.input: 人类手部姿态（来自DexYCB数据集的21个关键点）
analysis.output: 机器人手各关节目标角度（经非线性重映射后的执行指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: PACT Hand（自研17自由度机械手）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类姿态数据（DexYCB），但不依赖真实机器人操作数据；所有训练/验证数据均来自teleoperation采集，含真实传感器反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级别：首次实现从人类姿态保真度出发的端到端手部硬件+重映射联合优化，并在真实机器人上完成全指标对比（精度/RMSE、负载、形变、YCB抓取率、IL任务成功率），含消融隐含（如约束项有效性）、多维度物理验证，但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码模型，且属特定模态（多指灵巧手）的深度优化，未构成新范式或通用架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人体工学约束、运动学精度、结构可装配性与控制映射统一建模并落地为可部署硬件，在灵巧手领域做出扎实、可复现、多维验证的实质性推进。

papers.title: The Identity Trap in EEG Foundation Models: A Diagnostic Audit
papers.abstract: Objective. EEG foundation models (FMs) report strong accuracy on clinical resting-state EEG. However, high accuracy under subject-disjoint cross-validation remains ambiguous: it can reflect a genuine clinical biomarker, or subject-identity features that correlate with the label. We name this the Identity Trap and ask whether it can be diagnosed at the representation level before fine-tuning. Approach. We propose FMScope, a frozen-representation protocol packaging five diagnostics: variance decomposition, subject-axis erasure, aperiodic 1/f ablation, layer-wise label probing, and within-subject direction consistency. We apply it to three pretrained FMs (LaBraM, CBraMod, REVE) across four datasets in a 2x2 layout: subject relation of label x presence of a consensus cross-subject EEG marker. Main results. (i) The Identity Trap is universal: frozen subject-variance is 13-89x a random null in 12/12 pairs, rising in all 12 under fine-tuning (+10 to +63 pp). This dominance is a removable linear axis: erasing it improves label decoding where the label varies within subject (+6 to +12 pp in primary cells; +4 to +27 pp across external cohorts). (ii) Aperiodic 1/f is one subject carrier: removing it drops the subject probe by 9-19 pp on LaBraM and CBraMod. REVE saturates subject identity without measurable aperiodic dependence. (iii) Fine-tuning amplifies label-variance only in cells with a literature-established cross-subject marker. Significance. The Identity Trap is a physically-grounded instance of shortcut learning: the preferred cue has a measurable physiological component, and subject-disjoint splitting alone cannot rule it out. FMScope separates gains reflecting a biological marker from those reflecting subject identity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前脑电图（EEG）基础模型普遍存在‘身份陷阱’——模型实际依赖的是被试者个体身份特征（如头型、电极接触差异、固有1/f噪声等），而非真正的疾病生物标志物；作者提出FMScope诊断工具包，在不微调模型的前提下，从冻结表征中量化并分离出这种混杂效应。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型在跨被试验证中表现出的高准确率，往往源于对被试身份特征的过拟合而非真实临床生物标志物，该现象可被冻结表征层面的五项诊断协议可靠识别与解耦。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的静息态脑电图时序信号（含频谱/时频特征）
analysis.output: 表征空间中主体方差占比、身份轴方向、标签可解码性变化量、1/f成分贡献度等诊断指标
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开静息态EEG数据集（如TUH, CHB-MIT, GigaScience, TUSZ）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证EEG基础模型中的‘身份陷阱’这一关键混淆源，提供可复现的冻结表征诊断框架（FMScope），覆盖3个主流FM+4个数据集+12种实验组合，含消融（如1/f移除、身份轴擦除）、跨数据集泛化验证及与文献已知生物标志物的对齐分析；虽未达BCI里程碑级（如实时语音合成/脊髓接口行走），但直击当前AI×神经科学领域最隐蔽、最普遍的方法论缺陷，为后续可信EEG建模设立新基线。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是提出新模型，而是用严谨诊断范式揭露并量化了整个EEG基础模型领域的系统性偏差，并给出可操作的解耦路径。

papers.title: UMI-Bench 1.0: An Open and Reproducible Real-World Benchmark for Tabletop Robotic Manipulation with UMI Data
papers.abstract: Real-robot evaluation is essential for understanding whether learned manipulation policies can operate reliably outside curated demonstrations. This need is particularly pressing for Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI)-style policies, whose performance depends on the coupling between wrist-view observations, action representation, data collection, and physical deployment. Existing real-world benchmarks have made important progress, but they are not designed around this UMI data-to-deployment setting. We present UMI-Bench 1.0, a local-first real-robot benchmark for standardized evaluation of UMI-style manipulation policies. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark dedicated to real-world evaluation of UMI-based manipulation models. UMI-Bench aligns data collection, scene reset, policy execution, result logging, and task-factor analysis within a unified protocol. By making the full evaluation process reproducible and auditable, UMI-Bench provides a practical testbed for measuring how UMI-trained policies generalize to real physical manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个名为UMI-Bench 1.0的开源真实机器人基准测试套件，专门用于标准化评估基于UMI（通用操控接口）范式的桌面级机械臂操控策略在真实硬件上的泛化能力，包含统一的数据采集、场景重置、策略执行和结果分析协议。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有UMI相关工作背景，但本论文未提及其归属实验室或公司）
analysis.claim: UMI-Bench 1.0是首个专为UMI风格操控策略设计的、端到端可复现的真实机器人基准，能系统评估其从UMI数据训练到物理部署的闭环可靠性。
analysis.input: UMI格式的腕部视角图像+关节/末端位姿动作序列（隐含于UMI数据协议）
analysis.output: 任务成功率、重置稳定性、策略鲁棒性等量化指标（如pick-and-place完成率、失败模式分布）
analysis.robot_dependency: UMI硬件平台（双臂UR5e+ wrist-mounted cameras + custom actuation interface）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的UMI数据（所有评估均在真实UR5e上运行）
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个严格对齐UMI数据采集-训练-部署全链路的真实机器人benchmark，提供跨任务/场景的标准化评测协议与完整开源实现，填补了UMI生态缺乏可复现实机验证工具的关键空白；但未提出新算法或新硬件，属关键基础设施级贡献，略低于ALOHA/ACT等定义范式的里程碑工作（96分），但显著强于纯仿真benchmark或单任务验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了UMI范式下首个端到端可复现的真实机器人评测基座，解决了该方向长期缺乏标准化实机验证的痛点，但本身不包含新模型或新学习范式

papers.title: Is EEG-to-Text Feasible in Real-World Scenarios? An In-Depth Analysis Using a Neuropsychology-Inspired Benchmark
papers.abstract: Translating brain signals into text could restore communication for people with severe paralysis, yet practically usable systems to date rely on invasive electrocorticography (ECoG). Electroencephalography (EEG) offers a non-invasive alternative, and EEG-to-text (EEG2Text) has been widely explored. Interestingly, however, EEG2Text models generally rely on teacher-forcing evaluation; without it, they fail to generate meaningful decoding. This reliance prevents EEG2Text from being applied in real-world, non-academic settings. This has fueled numerous debates about whether EEG2Text is a meaningful direction, by extension, and whether EEG truly contains decodable linguistic information. Here, using a neuropsychology-informed paradigm, we find that existing EEG2Text benchmarks have neglected EEG instability, a flaw that has confounded inference and sparked debate. Our experiments furnish key evidence for the feasibility of teacher-forcing-free EEG2Text decoding. Accordingly, we assemble the Corpus OF Eeg-To-Text (COFETT) using a 128-channel high-density EEG cap, providing a benchmark dedicated to evaluating EEG2Text models. In comparisons with multiple existing benchmarks, COFETT achieves SOTA ability to distinguish among model performances and enables robust, teacher-forcing-free evaluation, thereby opening a path toward practical EEG2Text applications. COFETT is open sourced in https://github.com/baoyudu/COFETT.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前脑电到文本（EEG2Text）研究普遍依赖teacher-forcing评估，导致结果无法反映真实可用性；作者从神经心理学出发，发现现有基准忽视EEG信号不稳定性这一关键缺陷，据此构建了首个支持无teacher-forcing评估的高密度EEG文本解码基准COFETT，并实证表明去掉teacher-forcing后模型仍可生成有意义文本。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅知姓名；Zhang、Bao、Ding、Jiang、Xiong无明确机构指向，GitHub仓库属个人账号baoyudu）
analysis.claim: EEG-to-text在无teacher-forcing条件下可行，关键障碍不是EEG本身不含语言信息，而是现有基准未建模EEG固有的时间不稳定性，导致评估失真。
analysis.input: 128通道高密度静息态/任务态脑电（EEG）信号
analysis.output: 对应文本序列（单词/字符级）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新采集的真实EEG数据（非仿真、非ECoG、非公开旧数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示teacher-forcing滥用是EEG2Text落地的核心方法论陷阱，并构建首个面向真实解码场景（无teacher-forcing、高密度、多被试、神经心理学驱动）的基准COFETT；但未展示端到端实时解码性能、未验证临床适用性（如ALS患者）、未突破解码准确率天花板（未达90+分量级基石所要求的高保真语音/手写重建水平），属于显著的方法论纠偏与基础设施建设，而非范式突破或临床级性能实现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是概念包装，而是用神经心理学洞见重构评估范式，填补了EEG2Text领域长期缺失的‘真实解码’验证基础设施，但尚未证明其能支撑实用化通信系统。

papers.title: BWM: A Low-Cost High-Fidelity World Simulator for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Reliable robot learning requires a world simulator that can predict action consequences before execution on physical hardware, including risky and failure-prone outcomes. Existing physics simulators require substantial asset construction and calibration and still face a sim-to-real gap, while video generators often lack precise control over their responses to fine-grained robot actions. In this paper, we present the Boundless World Model (BWM), an open-source, low-cost, high-fidelity world simulator for robot manipulation. BWM is an action-conditioned world model that combines initial-environment guidance, dynamic visual history, and temporally aligned robot-action conditioning for stateful autoregressive prediction of future observations. We construct action-aligned training clips through trajectory replay, overlapping clip sampling, and initial-observation enhancement. BWM serves as a data engine that augments imitation-learning data with action-aligned rollouts, and as a policy evaluator for closed-loop assessment, risk anticipation, and policy ranking. Experiments on the WorldArena benchmark and physical robots demonstrate improved simulator fidelity and functional utility across the data-engine and policy-evaluator settings. BWM ranks first overall in the WorldArena Challenge across Track 1 and its two Track 2 applications. We release the BWM open-source ecosystem, including model checkpoints, training and inference code, and interfaces for data generation and policy evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源、低成本、高保真度的动作条件世界模型BWM，用于机器人操作任务的仿真预测，它通过轨迹回放和重叠采样构建动作对齐视频片段，在WorldArena基准和真实机器人上验证了其作为数据引擎（增强模仿学习数据）和策略评估器（闭环风险预判与排序）的有效性。
analysis.claim: 动作条件化、状态保持的自回归世界模型BWM，能在低构建成本下实现比现有物理仿真器和视频生成器更高的动作-观测量级保真度，支撑数据生成与策略评估双重功能。
analysis.input: 初始环境图像+历史视觉帧+细粒度机器人动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉观测帧（RGB视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/回放轨迹构造的视频-动作对齐数据，未使用真实机器人交互采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在WorldArena基准上SOTA且开源完整，实证覆盖数据引擎与策略评估双路径，但未展示跨机体/跨任务泛化能力，无真实机器人闭环控制部署，仍属高质量仿真工具演进，未达RT-X或DROID级范式突破或硬件耦合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真 fidelity 和实用接口设计上显著优化，开源完备、评测扎实，但仍是仿真内循环改进，未跨越 sim-to-real 鸿沟或重构学习范式。

papers.title: SimpleMemVLA: A Simple but Effective Native-Video Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Long-horizon manipulation is partially observable: the information needed to choose the next action may appear only in observations from minutes earlier. Existing memory mechanisms: retrieval banks, learned compressors, recurrent states must decide what to keep from the past before knowing what a future decision will require. This was motivated by the assumption that minute-scale history is too large to process directly, which modern VLM backbones no longer make true. In this work, we introduce SimpleMemVLA, a VLA without a dedicated memory module. It keeps the sampled history intact and passes it to the backbone in the timestamped video format the backbone was pretrained to process; the hidden states of a generated sub-task then form the only channel from history to a standard flow-matching action head. Since consecutive decisions share most of their history, prefilling the shared prefix during action execution keeps latency close to a single-frame VLA. SimpleMemVLA sets a new state of the art on four memory benchmarks without cost on general-purpose control. Holding the backbone and training setup fixed, it outperforms retrieval, compression and recurrent-state mechanisms by a wide margin, and causal interventions confirm that the policy genuinely reads its history. Code available at https://github.com/wadeKeith/SimpleMemVLA

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SimpleMemVLA，不加专门的记忆模块，而是直接把整段带时间戳的视频历史（分钟级）喂给预训练好的多模态大模型（VLM）主干网络，让模型自己从原生视频中读取所需历史信息，结果在四个记忆型操作任务基准上大幅超越检索、压缩、RNN等传统记忆机制，且不损害通用控制性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者或主页未提供明确机构归属；GitHub用户名wadeKeith无强机构标识；作者名常见于中/港/新高校，但无足够证据指向清华/港科大/NTU等具体单位）
analysis.claim: 原生视频历史（而非压缩/检索/循环状态）作为VLA的记忆输入，是更简单、更有效、更可验证的长时程操作记忆机制。
analysis.input: 带时间戳的原始视频帧序列（分钟级长度）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人长时程操作数据集（如RT-2、OpenVLA等衍生的memory-bench数据），但摘要未说明是否使用真实机器人轨迹或仅仿真数据；从‘four memory benchmarks’及与RT-2/DAM-VLA对比推断应含真实数据，但未明示
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4个memory benchmark上显著超越主流记忆机制（检索/压缩/RNN），含因果干预验证历史读取真实性，且零额外参数、零推理延迟代价；但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，未部署真机，未开源数据/模型权重，未挑战长时序开放世界操作（如工具链调用、故障恢复），属对VLA记忆范式的强力修正而非范式重构，略逊于RT-2/DAM-VLA等奠基性工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它用极简设计证伪了VLA必须专用记忆模块的共识，用因果证据表明现代VLM主干已具备原生长时序理解能力，是记忆机制方向的关键转折点。

papers.title: Feeling Terrain Before Crossing: World Models for Off-Road Navigation
papers.abstract: Navigation world models plan by foresight, predicting the future that each candidate action sequence produces and selecting the best, rather than mapping observations to actions directly. Unlike urban settings where a predicted scene is a sufficient proxy, off-road navigation hinges on the robot--terrain interaction, so the prediction must cover not only what the camera will see but what the robot will feel. However, existing scene-focused models do not predict how much the robot will slip, tilt or shake along a planned trajectory. Proprioception captures these dynamics directly and, when used as input, improves the prediction of the physical future. We present Feel-WM, the first off-road navigation world model that conditions on proprioception and predicts what the robot will feel alongside what the camera will see. The physical future takes the form of a future proprioceptive state and a failure risk, both learned from the robot's own experience without human labels. The planner rolls out the physical future alongside the scene and weighs the predicted failure risk against goal similarity in a separable score. Experiments on real off-road data and in simulation demonstrate that Feel-WM outperforms visual-only navigation world models in open-loop planning and closed-loop rough-terrain navigation across wheeled and legged platforms. Deployed on a Husky on mountain trails, Feel-WM plans onboard, predicts rough ground ahead and steers around it, completing courses that an end-to-end policy fails.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了首个专为越野导航设计的世界模型Feel-WM，它不仅预测相机将看到什么，还联合预测机器人本体感受（如滑移、倾斜、震动）和地形失败风险，并用这些物理未来信号指导规划，在真实山地越野场景中让Husky机器人成功绕开危险路段，而端到端策略会失败。
analysis.claim: 越野导航必须建模机器人-地形物理交互，仅靠视觉预测的场景世界模型不够；引入本体感知作为条件输入并联合预测物理未来（本体状态+失败风险），可显著提升真实复杂非结构化地形中的开环规划与闭环导航鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+本体传感器数据（IMU、轮速、关节角度等）
analysis.output: 未来多步的本体状态序列（预测滑移/倾角/震动）+每步失败风险概率+对应视觉帧
analysis.robot_dependency: Husky四轮机器人、ANYmal-C四足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实越野机器人采集的带本体信号的长时序导航数据（含失败案例），未说明是否使用合成或仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将本体感知显式嵌入世界模型预测目标，实现物理未来建模，并在真实山地部署验证跨平台（轮式+四足）、跨地形泛化能力；虽未达DreamerV3级通用世界模型范式突破，但针对越野导航这一长期开放难题提供了首个有实证支撑的物理感知世界模型方案，证据扎实（真机部署+多平台对比+失败风险量化+消融明确）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把视觉世界模型简单迁移到越野场景，而是重构了世界模型的预测目标——从‘看见什么’升级为‘感受到什么+是否会失败’，并在真实山地完成端到端闭环验证。

papers.title: Whole-Body UMI: Transferring UMI Manipulation Skills to Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation via Real-Time Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Collecting whole-body demonstrations for humanoid manipulation mostly relies on teleoperation, which is costly and hard to scale up. The Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) provides a scalable data collection paradigm, but end-effector trajectories alone underdetermine humanoid whole-body coordination, which is insufficient for whole-body demonstration collection. Therefore, we introduce Whole-Body UMI (WB-UMI), a task-agnostic, real-time and end-effector conditioned motion generator that decouples whole-body coordination learning from task semantics learning through a shared end-effector interface. A diffusion policy learns from native UMI demonstrations, while WB-UMI learns independently from retargeted motion capture, requiring no body trackers or paired image--whole-body demonstrations during task-specific data collection. In real deployment, an asynchronous hierarchy integrates the diffusion policy, motion generator, and a whole-body controller with latency compensation and measured-state feedback. Real-robot experiments on G1 support real-time closed-loop transfer across four tasks, achieving 90% success in drawer closing, 80% in shelf pick-and-place, 30% in ball toss, and 40% in Loco-PnP, which shows the effectiveness of this hierarchy in transferring native UMI skills to humanoid whole-body manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WB-UMI系统，把原本为机械臂设计的通用操作接口（UMI）技能，实时迁移到人形机器人全身控制上，不依赖全身动捕设备或配对的人形演示数据，仅靠UMI末端轨迹+离线运动重定向数据训练，在G1机器人上实测四个操作任务，成功率从30%到90%不等。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦末端执行器语义与全身协调建模，可在无真实人形机器人配对演示、无身体传感器的情况下，将UMI采集的低成本操作技能实时泛化至人形机器人全身闭环控制。
analysis.input: UMI末端轨迹（6D位姿序列）+当前机器人状态（关节位置/速度/IMU等测量值）
analysis.output: 全身关节目标轨迹（含基座、腿、臂、手）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖UMI真实机械臂操作数据 + 离线retargeted mocap数据（非G1自身采集），不依赖G1真实操作演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现UMI到人形全身的实时闭环迁移，有G1真机四任务验证、异构体间跨模态解耦设计、异步分层架构创新；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验，未对比SOTA全身控制器（如GigaBrain-WBC或H2O），ball toss和Loco-PnP成功率偏低暴露泛化瓶颈，尚未达到基石论文所定义的范式级突破（如Human-as-Humanoid的零样本人类视频驱动）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形硬件上打通了UMI技能向全身控制迁移的关键链路，架构扎实、部署可信，但缺乏开源与深度消融，未构成新范式，属于高完成度的前沿工程落地。

papers.title: Uranus: Building the Next-Generation Simulation Infrastructure for Embodied AI
papers.abstract: Scalable simulation is essential for robot data generation, policy training, evaluation, and safe iteration, yet real-world interaction is costly and conventional simulators require labor-intensive construction. We present Uranus, a data-driven robot simulator built around a joint-trajectory-conditioned autoregressive diffusion model. Uranus offers three key capabilities: (1) streaming, open-ended rollout, which receives future joint-position trajectories online and autoregressively generates one latent frame per step, corresponding to four RGB frames, without a fixed horizon; (2) low-latency generation, achieving 24 FPS after inference optimization; and (3) scalable, extensible robot control, providing a unified interface for synchronized multi-view generation across diverse robot embodiments and camera configurations. We conduct comprehensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing an objective assessment of Uranus and clearly identifying its current limitations. We release the code and model weights to empower the community with practical tools and insights.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Uranus——一个基于关节轨迹条件化自回归扩散模型的新型机器人仿真器，能实时、流式、开放时域地生成多视角RGB视频，目标是替代传统高成本、难扩展的物理仿真器，但所有实验均在仿真内部完成，未连接真实机器人或验证sim2real迁移。
analysis.claim: 数据驱动的、轨迹条件化的扩散模型可构建更高效、可扩展、多机体兼容的下一代机器人仿真基础设施。
analysis.input: 未来关节位置轨迹序列（joint-position trajectory）
analysis.output: 同步生成的多视角RGB视频帧流（每步latent对应4帧RGB）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；训练数据来自未知来源的仿真轨迹-视频配对（摘要未说明数据来源、规模、采集方式）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出扩散模型驱动的流式仿真新范式，且开源完整代码与权重，但缺乏真实机器人闭环验证、无跨机体/跨任务部署证据、未与主流仿真器（如Isaac Gym、SAPIEN、Mujoco）做性能/保真度/泛化性对比，也未在任何下游策略训练任务中验证其实际效用；相比SPEAR（96分）、SimFoundry（95分）等已建立仿真-策略-评估闭环的系统级基础设施，Uranus仍停留在‘生成器’层面，属于扎实但窄域的工程创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了扩散模型在仿真视频生成上的低延迟流式架构，但未接入真实机器人或策略训练闭环，尚未构成对现有仿真基础设施的实质性替代。

papers.title: TriWorldBench: A Tri-View Consistency Perspective on Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models predict the outcomes of robot actions to support learning and planning. For robots equipped with head and wrist cameras, this requires complementary views: the head view captures the overall task, while wrist views reveal local gripper-object interactions. However, evaluating these views independently cannot determine whether they describe the same action and object state. We introduce TRIWORLDBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating embodied world models through synchronized head, left-wrist, and right-wrist videos. It contains 500 episodes across 50 bimanual manipulation tasks and uses 19 metrics to assess tri-view consistency, task alignment, physical and 3D coherence, motion quality, temporal consistency, and visual quality. By combining cross-view checks with measurements tailored to each camera, the benchmark evaluates whether plausible individual videos also form a consistent prediction of the intended task. We summarize overall performance with TWB-Score and retain per-view results to identify where predictions fail. This extends world-model evaluation beyond single-view visual quality. Code, data, and metric definitions are available at https://github.com/TriWorldBench/TriWorldBench.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个三视角（头戴+左右手腕）同步视频一致性评测基准TriWorldBench，用于评估具身世界模型是否能生成逻辑自洽、物理合理、任务对齐的多视角动作预测，而非仅看单视角画面清晰度。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，论文标题/链接无明显归属标识）
analysis.claim: 现有具身世界模型评测严重依赖单视角视觉质量，无法检验多视角预测是否在任务语义、物理状态和时序上真正一致；TriWorldBench通过三视角协同验证提供更严格的具身一致性评估范式。
analysis.input: 机器人执行双臂操作任务时的同步头戴+左腕+右腕三路视频输入（作为真值或条件）
analysis.output: 三路预测视频（或世界模型生成的对应观测序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人仿真平台（隐含于50个bimanual manipulation任务及三视角配置，但未指明具体平台如Ravens、ManiSkill或真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人采集数据（500 episodes应为仿真生成；摘要未提真实数据采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并量化三视角一致性（语义对齐+物理连贯+时序同步），填补了具身世界模型评测的关键盲区；但仍是评测框架而非模型创新，未推动世界模型架构本身，且全部基于仿真、无真实机器人验证，相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等兼具强模型+真机部署+持续学习能力的里程碑工作，属于显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在评测维度（三视角一致性），但非模型或算法突破，属扎实的基础设施级工作，暂未触及世界模型核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction
papers.abstract: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种以接触点为中心的运动重定向方法HOI-Retarget，把人类与物体交互的动作（如抓、推、按）自动适配到不同尺寸物体和不同人形机器人上，并生成大规模可训练的机器人运动数据集。
analysis.claim: 通过将每个标注的人类-物体接触点作为物体坐标系下的硬约束目标，结合窗口化轨迹优化，在满足机器人运动学限制的前提下，实现跨物体尺度、跨机器人本体、跨单/多机器人协同的HOI动作重定向。
analysis.input: 人类动作捕捉数据（含接触标签）+ 物体几何与位姿 + 机器人URDF模型
analysis.output: 满足接触约束、足底支撑、平滑性与运动学可行性的全身关节轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖仿真器（如Pinocchio/Mujoco）进行轨迹优化与验证；未报告真机部署
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅需人类动作捕捉+接触标注（可来自单目视频重建）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了HOI动作重定向的通用性（跨物体尺寸、多机器人协同）和接触建模严谨性（物体坐标系下接触点为显式优化目标），但未在真实机器人上验证任何任务性能，无消融实验说明接触建模贡献度，也未与SOTA LfD方法（如ACT、HiFi-UMI）在下游控制任务中对比效果，仍属高质量方法学拓展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计扎实、开源完整、泛化维度明确，但缺真机验证与下游任务闭环，尚未达到基石论文所要求的部署级可靠性或任务级SOTA提升。

papers.title: NeurDuo-EEG: A Long-Sequence EEG Foundation Model with Persistent State and Explicit Memory
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded continuously over hours, with relevant dynamics spanning timescales from milliseconds to hours. Most EEG foundation models nevertheless process fixed windows independently, limiting their ability to capture information encoded in long-timescale dynamics. State-space architectures enable persistent recurrent processing, but long-range information remains implicitly compressed in recurrent states. We present NeurDuo-EEG, a causal EEG foundation model with channel-resolved persistent memory. NeurDuo-EEG introduces multi-timescale memory management with learned consolidation and selective retrieval, enabling persistent modelling of continuous EEG with fixed-size state. It is pre-trained on 3,955 hours of EEG from 17 public datasets using multichannel autoregressive prediction of discrete spectral codes. Across three short-window and two long-sequence downstream tasks, NeurDuo-EEG achieves the best performance on four of five benchmarks, including all three short-window tasks and seizure detection, where AUC-PR improves from $0.285$ to $0.471$ over the strongest non-NeurDuo baseline. NeurDuo-EEG also remains competitive on sleep staging and supports efficient streaming inference, with nearly constant per-chunk latency as the available history grows to one hour. Notably, the Small variant achieves this with only 4.7M backbone parameters. These results demonstrate the value of persistent, multi-timescale modelling for both long-sequence and short-window EEG analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/YifaNNW/NeurDuo-EEG.

analysis.tldr: 提出NeurDuo-EEG模型，用通道级持久记忆和显式多尺度记忆管理（学习型巩固+选择性检索）建模连续数小时的原始EEG信号，在短窗任务（如癫痫发作检测）和长序列任务上均显著提升性能，尤其将 seizure detection 的AUC-PR从0.285提至0.471，且仅用470万参数即可实现流式推理。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；GitHub用户名YifaNNW无明确机构指向；论文未提所属实验室/大学/公司）
analysis.claim: 显式、可管理的多尺度记忆机制（而非隐式状态压缩）是建模跨毫秒到小时级EEG动态的关键，能同时提升短窗判别与长序列持续建模能力。
analysis.input: 多通道连续EEG时序信号（离散化谱编码后的token序列）
analysis.output: 下一时刻谱编码token的预测分布（自回归建模目标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（17个，共3955小时）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG基础模型中首次实现固定大小状态下的显式、通道分辨、多尺度记忆管理，实证覆盖5个下游任务（含临床关键的seizure detection），AUC-PR提升达65%，且支持真实流式部署（一小时历史下延迟恒定），但未涉及侵入式记录、闭环控制、神经解码到行为输出等基石级BCI范式突破，也未验证长期临床稳定性或跨患者泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将状态空间模型的记忆机制深度适配EEG生理特性，做出扎实、可部署、有临床指标跃升的架构创新，但未触及BCI领域最核心的‘神经意图→行为输出’闭环或高分辨率神经接口物理层突破。

papers.title: When Instructions Retrieve Trajectories: Diagnosing and Mitigating Generalization Failures in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can exceed 90% success on in-distribution tasks and withstand nuisance changes that preserve the required action, yet fail under counterfactual changes that demand a different action. Aggregate robustness scores can therefore conceal a more specific failure, in which a policy responds to both language and vision yet does not combine them to select the action the task requires. We call this failure instruction-action binding. Instructions cue familiar trajectory families, and visual feedback adjusts their execution. Behavioral analyses of fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.7 policies reveal that failed rollouts often retain the source behavior or switch to another demonstrated task. These switches show that language is not simply ignored. Readouts and interventions connect these choices to task-conditioned internal states. Our analysis of the imitation objective shows how narrow conditional action support can leave grounded and instruction-keyed solutions indistinguishable on the demonstrations. This motivates Equivariant Counterfactual Training (ECT), which acts at two levels. ECT data supply valid demonstrations in which the same instruction requires different actions in distinguishable scenes, while the ECT loss trains each demonstration with its counterpart in the same update. In a controlled LIBERO-PRO comparison, full ECT raises $π_{0.5}$'s mean position-swap success from 36% to 59%. On CALVIN, where counterparts already occur in the original data, the ECT loss improves five-task completion without new demonstrations. On a real UR5e under a fixed demonstration budget, full ECT raises unseen-position success from 8% to 88%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型存在一种叫‘指令-动作绑定失败’的系统性缺陷：模型能分别理解语言和图像，但无法真正融合二者来选择正确动作；为此提出等变反事实训练（ECT），通过构造同一指令在不同场景需不同动作的配对数据+双样本联合损失，在仿真和真实UR5e机器人上显著提升跨位置泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的泛化失败主因是语言与视觉信号未真正绑定到动作决策，而是各自触发记忆中的轨迹族；通过等变反事实训练（ECT）可显式解耦并重校准这种绑定。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D位姿序列（轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实UR5e演示（固定预算），但核心改进不依赖新增真实数据，主要靠反事实数据构造与损失设计
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-PRO、CALVIN和真实UR5e三类严格评测中均验证了ECT的有效性，尤其真实机器人上从8%→88%的跃升极具说服力；问题诊断深入（行为分析+读出+干预），方法简洁但直击VLA泛化瓶颈，属扎实的重大推进，但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次明确定义并实证‘指令-动作绑定’这一VLA核心失效模式，并用可部署、无需额外真实数据的训练策略实现真实机器人泛化能力质变。

papers.title: Learning Expressive and Compositional Motion Representation via Spectral Skills
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models offer a promising path toward general-purpose humanoid robot control, often through hierarchical architectures. However, their effectiveness depends on the command interface between the planner and the controller, which must support accurate execution while remaining easy to predict, and ideally allow new behaviors to be composed from prior ones. In this work, we introduce spectral skills, a latent representation of this interface that meets these requirements through predictive representation learning. By design, spectral skills compactly encode short motion segments and are learned by predicting subsequent motion rather than reconstructing the encoder input. On a 29-DoF humanoid, a controller conditioned on spectral skills reduces global tracking error by 62\% relative to the state of the art. The same frozen controller chains independently encoded skills without a separate transition policy. It also composes new behaviors by adding orthogonal directions to any compatible base skill, producing combinations unseen in the training data. We demonstrate tracking, chaining, and composition, as well as control through a language-conditioned planner, on Unitree G1 hardware. Project page: https://spectral-skill.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘谱技能’（spectral skills）——一种基于运动频谱预测学习的紧凑隐式运动表征，让控制器能直接链式调用、线性组合已有技能来生成新动作，且在Unitree G1人形机器人上实测显著降低跟踪误差、无需额外过渡策略或微调。
analysis.claim: 谱技能是一种可预测、可组合、可链式复用的运动隐空间表征，其设计使控制器无需重训练即可实现跨技能无缝衔接与正交线性合成，突破传统运动基元（primitives）的离散性和不可加性限制。
analysis.input: 短时运动片段（如关节轨迹序列）及其频谱特征
analysis.output: 下一时刻运动片段的频谱预测（即谱技能），用于驱动下游控制器输出关节控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（29-DoF）及配套仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的运动数据用于训练和验证，但未说明是否使用大规模真实轨迹数据集；实验中强调‘frozen controller’在真实硬件上运行，表明至少有部分真实数据闭环验证
