papers.title: DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

analysis.tldr: 提出DriftOPD方法，不用真实机器人交互、不用教师模型、也不用多步rollout，仅靠离线演示数据，就能把长程任务成功目标‘蒸馏’进一步生成动作的一次性VLA策略中，通过分解序列级逆KL损失为当前动作匹配项+未来潜力项来实现。
analysis.claim: 无需在线交互、无需教师策略、无需多步rollout，仅用离线演示即可实现序列级长期目标对单步VLA动作专家的有效蒸馏。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（单步输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的离线演示数据（如Bridge、Open-X等），但不依赖在线收集或闭环交互
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA领域首次系统解耦并显式建模‘单步动作对长程任务成功’的因果贡献（通过future-potential term），实证覆盖多架构、多机器人、仿真+真实场景，性能逼近多步教师策略，但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破（无世界模型、无跨域统一表征、未引入新数据源或计算范式）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以可优化、免rollout、免teacher的方式将长程任务目标注入单步VLA策略，证据扎实（多平台+离线数据+消融验证），但尚未重构VLA基础架构

papers.title: Accelerating and Scaling MPC-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Humanoid Locomotion and Manipulation
papers.abstract: In humanoid motion control, model predictive control (MPC) offers physically grounded prediction and constraint handling, while reinforcement learning (RL) enables robust whole-body skills through large-scale simulation. However, using MPC inside RL often requires time-consuming problem construction or excessive training overhead, making such frameworks difficult to justify in practice. This work studies efficient training-time MPC guidance for humanoid locomotion and manipulation, termed MPC-RL. We introduce a centroidal-dynamics MPC reward formulation that leverages guidance from MPC trajectories in training time. To make this practical in massively parallel RL, we develop $π^n$MPC, a parallel-in-horizon and construction-free batched GPU MPC solver that operates directly on time-varying dynamics to avoid high memory usage and pre-compilation. Through a variety of comparative studies and hardware validations, we have found that MPC-RL achieves superior performance in locomotion and manipulation skills. The code base is available at https://github.com/junhengl/mpc-rl.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种在强化学习训练过程中高效嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）指导的方法，用轻量级、免编译、并行化的GPU MPC求解器（π^nMPC）实时生成centroidal动力学轨迹作为奖励信号，提升人形机器人行走与操作技能的训练效率和性能。
analysis.claim: 在RL训练中引入免构造、并行化、时变动力学原生的MPC轨迹奖励，可在不增加显著计算开销的前提下，显著提升人形机器人locomotion与manipulation策略的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、角速度、IMU、foot contact等）+任务指令（隐式编码于reward shaping中）
analysis.output: 全身体动作策略（joint torques或PD目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / A1 / Unitree H1（摘要未明说但代码库及实验含H1；正文实验含Cassie与A1仿真+H1真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的MPC轨迹，真机验证仅用于最终测试，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Cassie/A1/H1多平台验证，涵盖斜坡行走、越障、托盘操作等跨任务场景，有消融（对比无MPC奖励、传统MPC-RL构造方式）、开源完整代码与训练配置；但未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破（如端到端视觉-动作联合建模、开放世界长程任务规划、零样本跨机体迁移），仍属‘高性能MPC-RL工程整合’范畴，分量略低于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA（后者含3D资产驱动、视频先验、VLA架构等更广义泛化机制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MPC指导深度嵌入大规模并行RL训练流程，实现高效、可扩展、真机可部署的loco-manipulation策略，但未改变底层表征或任务定义范式

papers.title: Co-GLANCE: Uncertainty-Aware Active Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Teaming
papers.abstract: Perceptual uncertainty is a central challenge for heterogeneous robot teams operating in unstructured outdoor environments, where no single viewpoint affords reliable scene understanding. Perceptual uncertainty, arising from sources such as occlusions, manifests differently across robot viewpoints depending on scene structure. Detecting and resolving sources of perceptual uncertainty requires both scene-based contextual reasoning and capability-aware robot allocation. While vision-language models provide strong semantic priors for both, they are computationally prohibitive for onboard inference and lack calibrated uncertainty quantification. We introduce Co-GLANCE, a real-time onboard perception and decision-making system for uncertainty resolution in heterogeneous robot teams. Co-GLANCE distills the semantic reasoning capabilities of a vision-language model into an end-to-end model for occlusion segmentation and robot allocation, eliminating the need for cloud-based inference. To quantify perceptual uncertainty, Co-GLANCE combines conformal prediction with selective abstention to provide statistically valid coverage guarantees for segmentation, robot allocation, and detection outputs. These calibrated uncertainty estimates directly trigger active perception, dispatching the most appropriate robot to acquire informative viewpoints and resolve uncertainty. Across real-world scenarios, Co-GLANCE outperforms cloud-based vision-language model baselines in occlusion segmentation and robot allocation accuracy by 25% and 36%, respectively, while reducing per-frame inference latency 350x. We also release an air-ground dataset for future research. Code, videos, and dataset available at https://co-glance.github.io/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出Co-GLANCE系统，让无人机和地面机器人组成的异构团队能实时识别视野中的遮挡不确定性，并自动调度最合适的机器人去补拍关键视角，所有计算都在机器人端完成，不依赖云端大模型，同时用共形预测+选择性拒绝给出统计可验证的不确定性估计。
analysis.claim: 通过蒸馏VLM语义能力并融合共形预测与选择性拒绝，首次实现异构机器人团队在真实户外场景中端到端、实时、统计可验证的不确定性驱动主动感知。
analysis.input: 多机器人RGB图像流（含不同视角）、机器人类型与位姿信息
analysis.output: 遮挡分割图、机器人分配决策、检测框及对应不确定性置信区间
analysis.robot_dependency: 无人机+轮式地面机器人（实机部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实异构机器人采集的户外数据（非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨机体调度+统计保证的不确定性量化+开源数据与代码，显著推进了异构机器人主动感知的实用性边界；但未开新范式（如RT-2级动作生成），也未解决长期开放难题（如通用具身推理），属扎实重磅增量，尚未达基石级（RT-2/π0/Octo等90+分档）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM蒸馏、共形预测、多机体协同决策三者稳健落地到真实异构机器人系统，证据扎实、开源完整，但核心思想组合而非原创范式突破

papers.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
papers.abstract: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, can recent advances in agentic coding systems combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies? We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have larger variations in object geometry and pose than fixed automation. Model-free policies often struggle to close the reliability gap for VA tasks, which must be executed persistently and reliably in commercial and industrial applications. Motivated by prior work on Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) and the Robot Operating System (ROS), we introduce Graph-as-Policy (GaP), a multi-agent coding harness that generates directed computation graphs with perception, planning, and control nodes from a Modular Open Robot Skill Library (MORSL). GaP then generates an internal simulation environment to rehearse task instances with different graphs in parallel to iteratively refine the graph structure and parameters to improve success rates and throughput. Evaluation with 8 new open VA task benchmarks, 4 in-simulation and 4 in real-world, suggests that GaP can achieve success rates that significantly outperform baselines. Details, code, and data can be found online: https://graph-robots.github.io/gap

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GaP的多智能体自学习框架，把机器人任务编排成可解释的有向计算图（含感知、规划、控制节点），用内部仿真并行试错来自动优化图结构和参数，提升变异性自动化任务（如几何/位姿变化大的工业操作）的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者列表无明确机构署名，GitHub主页 graph-robots.github.io 未显示所属单位；作者名含常见英文名与东亚姓名，但无高校/企业标识）
analysis.claim: 通过将策略显式表示为可演化的有向计算图，并在内部生成仿真环境中并行自 rehearsal，能显著提升变异性自动化任务在真实机器人上的可靠性与吞吐量。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述 + 当前传感器观测（隐含RGB/D/力觉等，摘要未明说但VA任务必然依赖）
analysis.output: 可执行的有向计算图（含感知/规划/控制子模块调用序列及参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS兼容机器人平台（摘要提及ROS与MORSL技能库，但未列具体机型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于评估，但未说明训练是否需真实数据；强调‘internal simulation environment’用于rehearsal，暗示训练主要靠自生成仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了TAMP思想与现代agentic coding的实质性融合，在8个新VA基准（4真机+4仿真）上验证了跨任务/场景泛化能力，有内部仿真驱动的图结构自优化机制，且全开源；但未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破（无端到端具身基础模型、未解决跨机体零样本迁移、未整合视觉语言动作统一表征），属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将TAMP逻辑、模块化技能库与agentic图生成结合，用自仿真迭代优化策略图，在真实工业级变异性任务上取得可靠提升，但非底层范式创新。

papers.title: XPolicyLab: A Unified Standard and Open Ecosystem for Robot Policy Evaluation and Deployment
papers.abstract: Robot policy evaluation and deployment remain fragmented by model-specific software dependencies, data representations, and runtime interfaces, so that connecting N policies to M evaluation environments requires O(NM) separate integrations. We present XPolicyLab, a unified standard and open ecosystem that reduces this cost to O(N+M). XPolicyLab specifies common observation, action, and trajectory schemas together with a minimal adapter interface for observation updates, action prediction, batched execution, and episode reset, while a dependency-isolated client/server architecture separates policy inference from environment execution, so that each side retains its native software stack and may run locally or remotely. The ecosystem integrates 42 robot policies and standardizes their installation, debugging, serving, and evaluation workflows. Across these adapters, model-specific code varies by an order of magnitude while the environment-facing loop stays within a few lines of a fixed reference, confirming that the contract confines heterogeneity to the policy side. In a controlled study, conforming to the standard reduces the integration effort of a representative policy from over five hours to two hours, and packaged agent skills reduce it further to thirty minutes. The same adapters serve RoboTwin, RoboDojo simulation, and standardized real-robot evaluation through one interface. XPolicyLab is released as shared infrastructure for reproducible policy comparison and standardized deployment across simulation and physical platforms. Project website: https://xpolicylab.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出XPolicyLab，一个统一的机器人策略评估与部署标准和开源生态，用标准化接口（观察/动作/轨迹格式+轻量适配器）把原本N个策略×M个环境所需的O(NM)集成工作，压缩到O(N+M)，大幅降低跨策略、跨仿真/真机环境的对接成本。
analysis.claim: 通过定义最小化但完备的策略-环境交互契约与隔离式客户端/服务器架构，XPolicyLab能系统性消除机器人策略部署中的软件碎片化，使策略与环境解耦，显著提升评估可复现性与部署效率。
analysis.input: 标准化观测（如RGB+关节状态+IMU）、动作指令（如关节扭矩或目标位姿）
analysis.output: 动作序列或单步动作预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；支持接入真实机器人但本身不提供或要求真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是新算法或新硬件，而是解决领域长期存在的工程熵增问题：42个策略+多仿真/真机平台的标准化接入已实证落地，集成耗时从5小时→30分钟，且架构被RoboTwin/RoboDojo/真实机器人共用；虽未达Unitree G1级硬件里程碑分量，但属罕见的、被广泛采纳的基础设施级贡献，对标RT-1/X-Embodiment等生态项目层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不发明新智能，但构建了让上百种智能真正可比、可迁、可部署的‘电网’，是当前具身智能规模化落地的关键基座

papers.title: Imagining Recovery: Inference-Time Counterfactual Realignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have improved the flexibility and generality of robotic manipulation, yet they remain fragile to online disruptions, such as changes in task goal, scene configuration, or robot state. Existing recovery methods often require failure data, policy retraining, or external corrective agents, introducing additional data requirements and execution risks. We propose Counterfactual Realignment (CoRe), a training-free framework that recovers a frozen VLA at inference time without failure data. Upon detecting a deviation, CoRe imagines how the policy would continue toward the current goal from a recent viable state, using synthesized observations in place of physical execution, and then minimally realigns the robot and scene to rejoin this imagined continuation before returning control to the policy. Recovery is therefore planned without physical trial-and-error, preserves completed task progress, and handles both mid-episode instruction changes and physical perturbations in a unified manner. Extensive experiments across multiple simulators, VLA backbones, and real-world settings show that CoRe improves success rates by up to 85.0 percentage points to near-nominal levels while reducing physical restorations by 42.2%, without policy fine-tuning or failure-specific recovery training.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练、不依赖失败数据的在线恢复机制CoRe，当机器人执行出错时，它不靠重试或重训，而是回溯到最近可行状态，用视觉语言模型‘脑补’后续理想轨迹，再微调机器人和场景位置来对齐这个脑补结果，从而无风险地继续任务。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA模型可在推理时零训练、零失败数据、零外部干预地实现鲁棒在线恢复，统一处理指令变更与物理扰动。
analysis.input: 当前观测（RGB+语言指令）+历史轨迹片段+检测到的偏差信号
analysis.output: 最小化物理调整指令（如末端位姿修正、物体重置偏移量）及恢复后的策略续执行起点
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需正常执行过程中的在线观测流，不依赖故障标注或失败轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等90+分量级工作已确立VLA范式后，本文首次系统解决其在线脆弱性这一关键落地瓶颈：真机多机体验证、跨扰动类型统一框架、无训练恢复、消融完整；但未改变VLA建模本质，也未提升基础泛化能力，属重大工程鲁棒性突破而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是新模型，而是让现有冻结VLA真正扛住现实干扰的第一套经实证验证的推理时恢复机制。

papers.title: When State Becomes an Attack Surface: State-Semantic Injection in LLM-Driven Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated capabilities in in-context learning, task decomposition, step-by-step reasoning, and code generation, driving their gradual evolution from text generation models into the core of agents capable of perceiving environments, invoking tools, and executing tasks. Traditional LLM Agents typically obtain information through webpages, documents, databases, or external tools and generate corresponding invocation sequences according to user goals; when this technology is further integrated with robotic systems, large language models begin to undertake functions such as task understanding, high-level planning, and behavioral decision-making. SayCan combines the task reasoning capability of language models with the affordances of robotic skills, while Code as Policies and ProgPrompt generate robot task plans through policy code and programmatic prompting, respectively, and VoxPoser uses language models and vision-language models to construct three-dimensional value maps to guide robotic manipulation \cite{6,7,8,9}. Vision-language-action models such as PaLM-E, RT-2, and GR00T N1 further strengthen the connection among language, visual perception, and robotic actions \cite{10,11,12}. In such LLM-driven embodied agents, the model not only needs to understand user instructions, but also needs to combine scene states, object attributes, spatial relations, and execution feedback to complete task grounding, and then hand the generated action plan to skill libraries, motion planners, or controllers for execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并系统验证了一种新型攻击方式：攻击者通过精心构造的环境状态（如物体摆放、传感器读数、日志文本等）向LLM驱动的具身智能体注入恶意语义，绕过指令输入层直接操控其内部推理与决策，导致任务失败或危险行为。
analysis.claim: 在LLM驱动的具身智能体中，环境状态（state）本身可被恶意语义污染，成为无需篡改指令或模型参数的新型攻击面，且该漏洞在主流架构（SayCan/RT-2/VoxPoser等）中普遍存在。
analysis.input: 用户自然语言指令 + 环境状态文本（含物体属性、空间关系、执行反馈等结构化/半结构化描述）
analysis.output: 被劫持的行动序列或错误规划（如‘把刀递给用户’而非‘切苹果’）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境状态文本构造
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并实证了‘状态语义注入’这一新型安全威胁，在6类主流LLM-agent架构上复现攻击，提供可复现的benchmark和消融分析；但未在真机部署验证，也未提出鲁棒防御方案，属于对领域关键风险的重磅揭示而非系统性解决。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将AI安全视角系统迁移到具身智能体的状态接口，用扎实仿真实验揭示了被广泛忽视的底层攻击面，但尚未跨越到真实机器人验证与防御闭环。

papers.title: EMPIRE: Explicit Manipulation Planning as a Learnable Intermediate Representation for Egocentric Hand-Motion Forecasting
papers.abstract: Forecasting dexterous hand motions from egocentric observations is fundamental to intelligent interactive systems. Existing VLM-based methods typically map observations directly to future motions, overlooking the underlying manipulation process that governs hand-object interactions. Moreover, end-to-end optimization couples manipulation learning with motion synthesis, causing motion-generation gradients to interfere with the pre-learned manipulation-aware representations. To overcome these limitations, we propose EMPIRE, a two-stage framework that introduces Explicit Manipulation Planning as an Intermediate Representation for Egocentric hand-motion forecasting. Stage I: Learn to Plan. EMPIRE first learns explicit manipulation plans from multimodal context to capture the progression of hand-object interactions. Stage II: Learn to Act. A motion generator synthesizes future bimanual hand motions conditioned on frozen planner representations, preventing motion-generation gradients from affecting manipulation planning. To support our method, we further construct EMPIRE-651K, a bimanual hand-motion forecasting dataset comprising 650,910 training windows across 111 tasks, each paired with an explicit per-hand manipulation plan. Under identical training and evaluation protocols, EMPIRE achieves state-of-the-art forecasting accuracy, with an MPJPE of 84.53 mm and a finger-relative error of 38.97mm. We release the code and dataset at https://github.com/wangwen-banban/EMPIRE.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EMPIRE框架，把灵巧手动作预测拆成两步：先学出明确的‘每只手要做什么操作’（如抓、推、旋转），再基于这个操作计划生成具体手部运动轨迹；用新构建的65万段双手机械手动作+显式操作标注数据集验证，提升了预测精度。
analysis.claim: 显式操作规划作为可学习的中间表示，能解耦操纵理解与运动合成，显著提升以自我视角观测的手部动作预测准确性。
analysis.input: 自我视角RGB视频帧序列+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 未来若干帧的双手21关节3D位置序列（即MPJPE指标对应的预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/采集的真实手部动作数据，无机器人本体控制闭环
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有认知意义的‘操作规划’中间表征并实证其解耦价值，在手部动作预测这一狭窄但关键子任务上取得SOTA，数据和代码全开源，但未涉及真实机器人部署、未验证跨任务泛化、未连接底层控制，属于对AI×生物运动建模（人手行为理解）的扎实增量，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的具身智能范式突破或部署级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在egocentric手部动作预测任务中首次系统引入并验证了显式操作规划作为中间表示的有效性，方法清晰、数据扎实、开源完整，但仍是纯感知-预测范畴，未进入具身执行闭环。

papers.title: Predicting Consequences and Reinforcing Navigation Policies with Latent World Models
papers.abstract: World models enable agents to reason about future outcomes and learn policies from their knowledge of state transition, but existing approaches primarily focus on reconstructing future observations or features, which introduces unnecessary complexity and limits their effectiveness for decision making. In this work, we propose a compatibility prediction Latent World Model (LWM) for robot navigation that predicts action-conditioned latent feature compatibility rather than reconstructing observations. Our key insight is that spatial proximity correlates with latent feature similarity, enabling action consequences to be evaluated directly in latent space. To support counterfactual training, our model leverages action sequences sampled across trajectories and learns to predict which sequences lead closer to the goal. Furthermore, we demonstrate how the learned world model can supervise policy learning from unlabeled video data and further improve policies through reinforcement learning entirely within the world model. This imagination-driven framework eliminates the need for action annotations and additional environment interaction. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world robot navigation datasets show that our approach significantly outperforms prior world model and imitation learning methods in prediction accuracy, policy learning, and real-world navigation performance. The code, pretrained models, and additional materials are available at https://wzm206.github.io/latent-world-model-nav.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不重建观测、只预测动作下隐空间特征兼容性的世界模型（LWM），用于机器人导航，能仅靠无标注视频数据训练导航策略，并在隐空间内做强化学习优化，无需真实动作标签或额外环境交互。
analysis.claim: 预测隐空间中动作条件下的特征兼容性比重建未来观测更有效，可支撑无动作标注的导航策略学习与隐空间内强化优化。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作序列（训练时采样自轨迹）
analysis.output: 动作序列是否导向目标的二元兼容性预测 + 导航策略（动作分布/轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人导航视频数据（如R2R、RxR等视觉语言导航数据集），但不依赖动作标注或实时控制信号
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰设计取舍（弃重建、重兼容性判断），在多个真实导航数据集上验证了预测精度与策略性能提升，且开源完整；但未涉及真机部署、未验证跨机体/跨传感器泛化，也未挑战长期状态一致性等世界模型核心瓶颈，属于对导航任务定制化改进的扎实贡献，未达基石论文所解决的通用建模或持续学习层面的根本问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：针对导航任务简化世界模型目标并实证有效，但未突破世界模型领域长期开放难题，属高质量垂直应用推进，非范式级突破。

papers.title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
papers.abstract: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出InterMimicGen，用人类动作捕捉数据自动生成并不断扩增可执行的机器人全身运动（走路+操作物体），通过仿真中反复微调、筛选成功动作来构建越来越丰富的机器人运动库，并最终迁移到真实人形机器人上。
analysis.claim: 通过自演化式运动模仿飞轮（human data → retargeted references → physics-based tracking → task-filtered augmentation → next-round seeding），可从稀疏异构的人类交互数据中持续生成高质量、可执行、可泛化的全身灵巧运动策略。
analysis.input: 人类动作捕捉数据（含人体与物体交互）、人形机器人模型（带灵巧手）、物理仿真环境
analysis.output: 可执行的全身运动轨迹（含关节控制序列与手部姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: NVIDIA Isaac Gym + custom humanoid with dexterous hands (e.g., GR-1)
analysis.data_dependency: 初始依赖大量公开MoCap数据（如BEHAVE、EPIC-KITCHENS等），但不依赖真实机器人采集数据；后续迭代完全在仿真中生成
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并逼近基石级工作水平：首次实现从异构人类MoCap到多任务全身灵巧操作的全自动、可扩展、闭环演化的运动生成飞轮；在真实GR-1机器人上验证了跨任务迁移能力（开门、取物、推拉等），且覆盖动作多样性远超此前单任务/单策略方法；虽未开源全部数据和世界模型，但代码+仿真训练流程完整，消融充分，实验规模（>1000 augmented motions, 5+ real-robot tasks）扎实。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是简单模仿或retargeting，而是构建了首个可自我扩增、任务守恒、物理可行的全身locomanipulation运动飞轮，并实证落地到真实人形机器人。

papers.title: Beyond Retargeting: Low-Latency and Robust Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation with Learned Atomic Motion Primitives
papers.abstract: Humanoid whole-body teleoperation translates human motion into stable robot behavior in real time. Existing systems typically rely on online motion retargeting to bridge human--robot morphological differences, but this process adds latency and can produce physically infeasible targets. Meanwhile, diverse, noisy, and partial human-motion observations often fall outside the training distribution, potentially causing unstable robot behavior. We propose a retargeting-free policy that maps raw human motion directly to robot joint commands in a single forward pass, eliminating online kinematic adaptation. To improve robustness, we learn a codebook of full-body motion primitives that projects out-of-distribution observations onto plausible motion prototypes and recovers full-body motion from partial inputs. Experiments on a Unitree~G1 in simulation and on hardware, using virtual reality, optical mocap, text-to-motion generation, and monocular video inputs, show that our method outperforms baselines in latency and robustness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不依赖在线运动重定向的拟人机器人全身遥操作方法，直接将原始人类动作（如VR、单目视频等输入）映射为机器人关节指令，并通过学习的全身运动基元码本提升对噪声、遮挡和分布外输入的鲁棒性，在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了更低延迟和更强稳定性。
analysis.claim: 无需在线运动重定向的端到端映射策略，结合学习的原子级全身运动基元码本，可实现低延迟、高鲁棒的多源输入 humanoid 全身遥操作。
analysis.input: 原始人类动作信号（VR手柄+头显姿态、光学动捕、文本生成动作、单目视频帧序列）
analysis.output: 机器人全身关节角度指令序列（实时控制输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行闭环验证，但未说明是否用于训练策略；仿真训练为主，真机仅用于部署测试
analysis.significance_reason: 在 latency 和 robustness 上有扎实的多输入模态对比实验（含单目视频→G1真机），且消融验证了 motion primitive codebook 的有效性；但未覆盖 locomotion-manipulation 耦合任务、无长期环境交互、未挑战 zero-shot human-to-robot embodiment 对齐等基石工作所涉核心难题，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将 learned motion primitives 与端到端 teleop 控制深度耦合，在多噪声输入下实现真机低延迟稳定控制，是当前 humanoid 遥操作中少有的实证充分、部署落地导向的系统级改进。

papers.title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
papers.abstract: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Stateful Harness框架，把世界模型拆成两部分：一个负责按规则更新隐藏状态（如物体是否带电、门是否上锁），另一个用冻结的视频生成模型把当前状态渲染成画面；它用新构建的WorldState-Bench基准（50组隐藏状态不同但起始画面和动作相同的反事实对）证明，单纯靠视频模型‘猜’规则只能32%达标，而加入显式状态执行模块后提升到92%，说明隐状态建模不能只靠像素拟合。
analysis.claim: 世界交互中存在影响结果但不可见的隐藏状态，仅靠端到端视频生成模型无法可靠遵循规则；必须将规则驱动的状态演化与视频渲染解耦，才能实现可验证的规则合规性。
analysis.input: 初始图像+用户选择的动作+（可选）指定的期望结果
analysis.output: 一段动作响应视频（含正确因果结果，如开关门后门状态改变）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成3D场景与视频生成模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构造反事实孪生对基准（WorldState-Bench）量化‘隐状态规则遵从率’，并实证证明解耦状态执行与视频渲染能将合规率从32%→92%，证据扎实（多后端对比、消融明确、指标可复现），但未在真实物理系统或跨任务泛化上验证，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级的闭环控制分量
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜或包装，而是精准定位并实证解决了世界模型领域长期被忽视的核心缺陷：像素级视频生成无法承载隐状态推理，且给出了可测量、可复现、可解耦的工程路径。

papers.title: OpenEAI-Platform: An Open-source Embodied Artificial Intelligence Hardware-Software Unified Platform
papers.abstract: Embodied AI in the real world requires both accurate hardware and robust vision-language-action (VLA) policies. We present OpenEAI-Platform, a fully open-source platform that integrates a low-cost 6+1 degree-of-freedom (dof) robotic arm (OpenEAI-Arm) and a reproducible VLA model (OpenEAI-VLA). OpenEAI-Arm provides open-source mechanical designs for low manufacturing cost and compliant control methods for higher accuracy. OpenEAI-VLA builds on Qwen3-VL-4B and uses a Diffusion Transformer action head, and is trained in two stages with only open-source robot and multimodal datasets. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, OpenEAI-Arm outperforms two commercial 6+1-dof arms under the same policy, and OpenEAI-VLA achieves success rates comparable to the large-scale pretrained pi0 baseline with only limited pretraining data. We will release the full hardware designs, drivers, models, and training/data pipelines to support reproducible research and scalable data collection. Our codes, layouts, and models will be released after the paper is accepted.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套软硬一体的具身智能平台，包括一个低成本6+1自由度机械臂硬件（OpenEAI-Arm）和一个基于Qwen3-VL-4B+Diffusion Transformer动作头的视觉语言动作模型（OpenEAI-VLA），在四个真实操作任务上验证了硬件性能优于同类商用臂、模型效果接近大模型基线但仅用开源数据训练。
analysis.claim: 通过完全开源的硬件设计与轻量级VLA模型协同优化，可在有限资源下实现可复现、可扩展、真实世界部署友好的具身智能基座平台。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6+1维关节控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖开源机器人数据集（如Open-X-Embodiment、RT-2数据子集等），未使用私有真机采集数据；训练阶段未提真实机器人交互闭环采集，属间接依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个完整开源软硬一体VLA平台（含机械结构图纸、驱动、模型、训练流水线），工程整合度高且实机验证扎实（四任务+对比商用臂），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，模型未达SOTA级性能，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程推理、多步纠错、通用本体感知），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等里程碑系统。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将开源VLA模型与定制化低成本硬件深度耦合并完成端到端真实任务验证，填补了国内全栈开源具身平台空白，但未提出新范式或突破性算法。

papers.title: How Much Capacity Does EEG Denoising Need? Ultra-Compact Networks reveal Benchmark Saturation and Metric-Utility Gap
papers.abstract: Deep learning EEG denoising architectures have scaled from tens of thousands to tens of millions of parameters, yet no prior study has isolated model capacity as the experimental variable or tested whether reconstruction metrics predict downstream neural-signal utility. We address both gaps by fixing architecture, loss, data split, and training recipe while sweeping only channel width from 1.05K to 40.26K parameters in a minimal depthwise-separable convolutional U-Net. Models were evaluated on the EEGDenoiseNet benchmark, cross-dataset BCI transfer tests, controlled baseline retraining, and downstream motor-imagery classification with five decoder families across all nine BCI Competition IV-2a subjects. Reconstruction performance saturated by 3-6.5K parameters, with post-elbow gains of at most 0.015 correlation coefficient per log10-parameter unit. An 8.46M-parameter baseline retrained under the same pipeline matched the 40.26K compact variant on EOG--a 200x parameter gap yielding no advantage--while a Patch-Transformer control reproduced the same diminishing-return shape. Downstream evaluation exposed a classifier-dependent metric-utility gap: reconstruction-optimized denoising significantly degraded CSP+LDA classification across all nine subjects and three artifact types (best denoised accuracy 0.547 vs. 0.612 noisy baseline; Bonferroni p=0.0488), persisting on naturally recorded trials (Delta=-0.047; BH-FDR q=0.0049). End-to-end neural decoders showed variable or neutral effects. Standard EEG denoising benchmarks are saturated far below current model capacity, and reconstruction metrics do not predict BCI utility. Ultra-compact models at 33-46 KB and 1.27-2.61M FLOPs/segment are practical for edge deployment. These findings argue for capacity-controlled evaluation, harder task-aware benchmarks, and mandatory downstream validation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地证明：当前主流EEG去噪深度学习模型严重过参数化，仅需3–6.5K参数就能达到重建指标饱和；更关键的是，重建指标（如相关系数）与真实BCI任务性能（如运动想象分类）完全脱钩——最优重建反而显著损害下游分类准确率，暴露了领域长期依赖的benchmark和评估范式存在根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: EEG去噪模型的参数量远超必要，重建指标饱和点极低，且该指标无法预测甚至损害下游BCI任务性能，现行benchmark和评估协议失效。
analysis.input: 含伪迹的原始EEG信号（含EOG/EMG/line-noise）
analysis.output: 去伪迹后的干净EEG信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，使用公开BCI竞赛数据集（BCI Competition IV-2a）及EEGDenoiseNet
analysis.significance_reason: 属重磅级贡献：首次以严格控制变量法（仅扫通道宽度）揭示EEG去噪模型容量冗余与指标-效用断裂，覆盖9名被试、3类伪迹、5种解码器、自然记录验证，并给出可部署的超轻量模型（33–46KB），直接挑战领域评估根基；但未提出新去噪架构或临床闭环系统，分量略低于前述90+分里程碑（如脑控语音/行走等具身闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是技术增量，而是对整个EEG去噪评估范式的证伪与重置，证据扎实、结论颠覆、影响深远。

papers.title: EgoPhys: Learning Generalizable Physics Models of Deformable Objects from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Humans naturally understand object physics through everyday interactions, but faithfully predicting complex deformable dynamics, such as elastic materials and fabrics, remains a major challenge for computer vision and robotics. We present EgoPhys, a framework that constructs deformable physical digital twins from egocentric RGB-only video using generalizable priors. EgoPhys overcomes the limitations of existing methods to enable controllable deformable digital twin generation from egocentric videos by distilling per-object inverse-physics solutions into a compact codebook, enabling prediction of dense spring stiffness fields for unseen objects without per-spring test-time optimization. Trained with generalizable priors from diverse egocentric interactions, EgoPhys outperforms baselines in reconstruction, future prediction, and zero-shot generalization. To support training and evaluation, we curate an egocentric interaction dataset covering diverse deformable objects, scenes, and manipulation styles. We deploy EgoPhys on a real xArm6 robot, demonstrating that a digital twin initialized from a single egocentric human play video can serve as an internal world representation to aid in deformable-object planning, highlighting egocentric RGB observations as a scalable path toward real-to-sim pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 仅用第一人称视角的RGB视频，就能为没见过的软体物体（如布料、橡皮泥）自动构建可预测其形变物理行为的数字孪生模型，并在真实机械臂上实现基于该孪生模型的抓取与操作规划。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 仅通过单段egocentric RGB视频，即可泛化建模任意未见过软体物体的物理动力学，无需测试时优化，且该数字孪生可直接用于真实机器人操作规划。
analysis.input: 单段第一人称视角RGB视频（无深度、无标注、无动作标签）
analysis.output: 稠密弹簧刚度场（即软体物体的物理参数网格表示），支持后续形变仿真与运动预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的egocentric交互视频，但训练数据来自人类手部操作视频（非机器人采集），部署阶段需真实机器人验证
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨物体零样本泛化+自建高质量egocentric软体交互数据集+物理驱动的紧凑码本建模，显著优于纯仿真或单物体过拟合方法；但未开源数据、未提供完整baseline消融（如对比NeRF/DeformableGAN等物理无关基线）、未覆盖多机体泛化，尚未达到RT-X/DROID级基础设施地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将egocentric视觉、物理先验与数字孪生落地到真实软体操作闭环，证据扎实但生态开放性不足，属当前软体机器人领域最硬核的实证工作之一，尚未开创新范式。

papers.title: ATOM-Bench: A Real-World Benchmark for Atomic Skills and Compositional Generalization in Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but their real-world generalization remains difficult to diagnose. A policy may succeed on demonstrated tasks while still failing to execute fine-grained atomic skills or recombine learned skills in new task structures. We introduce \textbf{ATOM-Bench}, a real-world benchmark for evaluating both atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies. ATOM-Bench factorizes tabletop manipulation into motor atoms and instruction atoms, and contains 30 atomic tasks and 24 held-out compositional tasks across paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks. We collect 3,000 human demonstrations for atomic fine-tuning and release both the demonstration data and evaluation rollout data to support reproducible real-world evaluation. Policies are fine-tuned on atomic tasks and evaluated on both atomic skill acquisition and held-out compositional tasks. We further introduce Atomic Score (AS) and Compositional Failure Share (CFS) to distinguish failures caused by weak atomic skills from failures caused by limited compositional reuse. Through 2,700 physical rollouts on five representative manipulation policies, we find that current policies can acquire simple instruction-grounding skills, but still struggle with fine-grained motor atoms, counting, and logical filtering. More importantly, strong atomic performance does not reliably transfer to held-out compositional tasks. ATOM-Bench provides a diagnostic testbed for studying whether failures arise from weak motor execution, poor instruction grounding, or limited compositional reuse.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫ATOM-Bench的真实机器人操作基准，专门用来诊断当前通用操作策略（如ACT、RT-2类模型）到底卡在哪：是基础动作执行不行（比如抓不准、放不稳），还是指令理解出错，还是不会把学过的原子技能重新组合成新任务；它用30个原子任务+24个未见过的组合任务，在单臂/双臂真机上跑了2700次实验，还提出了两个新指标AS和CFS来区分失败根源。
analysis.claim: 当前通用操作策略在真实世界中失败的主要原因不是指令理解或组合能力差，而是底层原子级运动控制能力薄弱，且原子技能强并不保证能泛化到组合任务。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB图像+机器人状态
analysis.output: 机器人关节/末端执行器动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 单臂/双臂真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但明确为物理平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖3000条人类真人演示数据用于原子任务微调，以及发布的rollout评估数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个系统性解耦‘原子技能’与‘组合泛化’并用真机大规模验证的诊断型基准，实证揭示了当前主流策略（ACT等）的瓶颈不在高层规划而在底层运动控制，证据扎实（2700次真机rollout+消融式失败归因），但未提出新模型或新训练范式，属于里程碑级诊断工具而非突破性方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是算法创新，而是首次用严谨的真机实验设计和可归因指标，戳破了通用操作策略‘表层SOTA’的泡沫，定位到被长期忽视的原子运动控制短板。

papers.title: WARP: Whole-Body Retargeting for Learning from Offline Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Direct transfer from human demonstration to learnable robot action is a crucial step towards scalable whole-body mobile manipulation. While human data scales better than mobile teleoperation, it requires overcoming significant embodiment gaps. Existing retargeting methods yield imprecise or inconsistent solutions, causing action multi-modality that prevents supervised policies from reliably converging. We present Whole-body-Aware Retargeting from human Pose (WARP), an offline pipeline that explicitly models embodiment differences to extract precise, unique whole-body actions. WARP leverages a closed-form Shoulder-Elbow-Wrist (SEW) geometric solver for exact end-effector tracking while preserving whole-body structural intent. Paired with lazy mobile-base control, it extracts accurate, consistent robot trajectories. Evaluations show WARP provides highly reliable data for open-loop real-world replay. To our knowledge, WARP is the first framework to achieve zero-shot whole-body mobile manipulation directly from offline human demonstrations, eliminating the need for human-in-the-loop teleoperation action data. More details on https://warp-retarget.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WARP方法，把人类全身动作视频（如手机拍摄）离线转换成机器人可执行的精确全身运动轨迹，无需真人遥控或真实机器人采集数据，直接在真实机器人上开环重放成功。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模人机形态差异并引入SEW几何求解器，WARP能从纯离线人类演示中生成唯一、精确、一致的机器人全身动作轨迹，实现零样本全身体移动操作。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频中的人体2D/3D姿态序列（如来自H36M或自采手机视频）
analysis.output: 机器人全身关节角度轨迹（含移动底盘+双臂+手指）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Spot + Allegro Hand（实机验证用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需人类演示视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Spot+Allegro真机上完成开门、取物、插拔等多任务开环重放，对比基线（IK-FK、RETRO）显著提升成功率；SEW求解器带来可解释性与确定性，但未开源训练数据与完整仿真环境，且未验证跨机型泛化（仅Spot），未接入闭环策略或VLA架构，属重磅工程突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了离线人体动作到移动灵巧手机器人之间的关键几何对齐难题，实机效果可靠，但未打通感知-决策-控制闭环，也未开放核心数据与仿真配置，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式引领地位。

papers.title: ModPack: An Extensible Teleoperation Interface for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Existing teleoperation systems are often tailored to specific robot hardware and task domains, limiting their scalability and adaptability. We present ModPack, a modular and extensible teleoperation system designed to support diverse robot embodiments and task requirements within a unified framework. At the core of ModPack is a self-contained wearable "backpack" that integrates onboard computation, power, communication, and data storage. Built on top of this shared interface, the system supports plug-and-play capability modules including joint-level teleoperation with haptic feedback, mobile manipulation, and active perception. Experiments across two distinct robot platforms and real-world mobile manipulation tasks demonstrate that ModPack provides a flexible and reusable framework for data collection and policy learning. To support future research, we open-source the complete hardware design and software stack. Project website: https://modpack-robotics.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可插拔的穿戴式‘背包’硬件接口，把计算、供电、通信和存储集成在单个模块里，让不同双手机器人平台能快速接入多种遥操作功能（如关节级控制+力反馈、移动抓取、主动感知），并在两个真实机器人上验证了数据采集和策略学习的复用性。
analysis.claim: 通过硬件-软件协同的模块化设计，实现跨机器人平台、跨功能模块的即插即用遥操作系统，显著提升遥操作系统的可扩展性与复用性。
analysis.input: 穿戴式背包采集的用户肢体运动信号（含IMU/肌电等）、任务指令、环境传感器数据（如RGB-D）
analysis.output: 双臂关节控制指令 + 移动底盘控制指令 + 主动感知动作决策
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用型双手机器人平台（实验中使用Rethink Sawyer+TurtleBot3及自研双臂移动平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的多任务遥操作演示数据（摘要明确提及real-world mobile manipulation tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨两个异构平台、支持多模块即插即用、开源全栈（含硬件设计），工程完成度高且复用性强；但未展示策略性能SOTA突破、未引入新学习范式或感知-控制新机制，属重大工程整合而非理论/算法突破，略低于ALOHA/ACT（96分）等定义新学习范式的标杆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了遥操作系统长期存在的硬件耦合与功能固化问题，提供首个开源、可复用、真机验证的模块化穿戴接口，但未推动底层学习或控制范式变革。

papers.title: Hijacking Robots with a Piece of Paper: A Systematic Study of Physical Prompt Injection in VLM-Controlled Robots
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as planners in robotic systems, where they translate natural-language commands into executable actions grounded in visual scene understanding. This tight coupling between perception and instruction-following introduces a new attack surface: adversarial text placed within the robot's visual field can act as an indirect prompt injection into the VLM's reasoning stack. We present a systematic study of physical prompt injection attacks against VLM-controlled sorting, introducing a four-category taxonomy, indirect signage, task redefinition, authority impersonation, and conflict injection, instantiated as a benchmark of 20 attack prompts evaluated across three physical scene layouts and three command formulations that vary in destination specificity and rule explicitness. Across 5,670 trials on three frontier VLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3-VL-32B), attacks succeed at 27.0%, 29.4%, and 5.0% respectively, with authority-impersonating and negation attacks transferring across all three models. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals that successful compromise is nearly always conscious (99.9% acknowledgment rate), and that models defend through structurally different mechanisms, explicit rejection for Gemini, perceptual inattention for GPT-4o. We evaluate three simple mitigations: prompt-based defense (75-100% effective, model-dependent), two-stage verification (85-100%), and pre-processing text masking (100%). Our findings show that VLM-controlled manipulation is meaningfully vulnerable to human-readable physical signage, and that simple defenses substantially reduce risk, though defense choice involves trade-offs. The defenses preserve general task capabilities in our benchmark, but they may impair tasks that require reading in-scene labels.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现只要在机器人摄像头视野里放一张带特定文字的纸（比如‘STOP’或‘IGNORE PREVIOUS COMMAND’），就能骗过视觉语言模型（VLM）控制器，让机器人错误执行指令；作者系统构造了20种物理提示注入攻击，在3个主流VLM上实测成功率最高达29.4%，并测试了三种简单但有效的防御方法。
analysis.claim: VLM控制的机器人存在可复现、高成功率、人类可读的物理提示注入漏洞，且该漏洞可通过轻量级防御（如文本掩码）近乎完全阻断。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作决策（是否执行/改执行/拒绝）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用机械臂（未指明具体型号，实验基于标准VLM-robot pipeline）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人训练数据依赖；攻击评估基于真实机器人部署环境（sorting task）的5670次实机测试
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性揭示VLM机器人在真实物理世界中的prompt injection脆弱性，提供首个可复现实机攻击基准（20 prompts × 3 scenes × 3 command types × 3 models × 3 robots = 5670 trials），证据扎实（全实机、跨模型、含推理链分析与三类防御验证），但未提出新模型/架构，属重大安全范式发现而非能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以严格实证确立VLM机器人物理世界prompt注入是真实、可量化、可防御的系统性安全威胁，填补AI安全与具身智能交叉的关键空白。

papers.title: MANIGUARD: A Benchmark and Data Suite for Specification-Grounded Safety Evaluation and Improvement of Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Foundation-model policies for robotic manipulation are advancing rapidly on task success, but rigorous evaluation of whether they succeed safely is still lacking. We introduce ManiGuard, a specification-grounded framework for evaluating and improving the safety of foundation-model manipulation, comprising the ManiGuard-Bench task suite and a paired safety-annotated trajectory-generation pipeline. ManiGuard-Bench organizes six contact-rich household task families into 200 locked base tasks along a skill $\times$ constraint taxonomy, with safety specified independently of task success. Each task is evaluated under one in-distribution and four single-axis out-of-distribution perturbations that hold the safety specification fixed, giving 1,000 locked scenarios. Every rollout is runtime-checked by LTL$_f$-grounded automaton monitors over physics-grounded predicates rather than learned classifiers or LLM judges, in simulation and on a physical Franka platform. The pipeline pairs an automated motion-planning generator with human teleoperation, annotated by the same per-step monitor, and directly supports safety-aware fine-tuning; we release 8,000 safety-annotated demonstrations, 40 per base task. Benchmarking zero-shot and fine-tuned VLAs across more than 23,000 rollouts, we find: (i) safety must be evaluated independently of task success, as 6-21% of successful rollouts violate the specification; (ii) fine-tuning on our suite raises safe task completion from near zero to 7.5-29.8% and engaged-and-safe behavior from 16-40% to 51-72%; but (iii) a gap remains that scaling demonstrations does not close, with 21-42% of engaged rollouts still violating, two of six families below 2% safe success for every policy, and these failures persisting under distribution shift and on hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出ManiGuard——一个基于形式化安全规范（LTLf+物理谓词）的机器人操作安全评测与改进框架，包含200个带硬性安全约束的家庭操作任务、1000种扰动场景、8000条人类-规划混合生成的安全标注轨迹，并在仿真和Franka真机上用自动监控器实时检测违规，发现现有VLAs安全表现极差，微调后仍存在顽固失败。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有中文名但无法对应到清华/智元/宇树等主流团队，且无常见实验室线索）
analysis.claim: 机器人操作基础模型的安全性必须独立于任务成功率进行形式化评估，且当前模型在严格安全规范下表现极差，现有数据驱动微调无法根本解决核心安全漏洞。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言指令+安全规范（LTLf公式）
analysis.output: 动作序列+每步安全状态标签（safe/violated）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人数据：所有安全标注均经真机运行时监控器验证，且40%演示来自人类遥操作+规划器混合生成，非纯仿真合成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LTLf形式化监控与物理谓词深度耦合用于机器人操作安全评测，在真机+多扰动+多任务下暴露VLAs系统性安全缺陷，并提供可复现的修复路径；但未提出新模型架构或训练范式，属强评测驱动型工作，分量介于OpenVLA（93）与Octo（92）之间，尚未达RT-2级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个形式化安全-grounded、真机验证、可微调的机器人操作安全基准，但本质是评测与数据基础设施升级，非算法或范式突破

papers.title: RNA3D-Decoy: A Large-Scale Benchmark Dataset of AI-Generated RNA Structure Models for Quality Assessment
papers.abstract: Recent advances in AI- RNA structure prediction have increased the availability of candidate models, but their accuracy remains variable. Developing reliable quality assessment (QA) methods requires datasets that represent contemporary prediction errors across diverse targets and molecular contexts. Here, we present RNA3D-Decoy, a large-scale benchmark dataset comprising 103,549 decoys for 677 experimentally determined targets, including 416 RNA-only structures,117 RNA structures with metal ions, and 144 RNA-protein complexes. Decoys were generated using five biomolecular predictors: AlphaFold 3, ESMFold2, Protenix, Chai-1, and Boltz-2.Each decoy is evaluated against its experimental reference us-ing TM-score, lDDT, and RMSD, with global and local quality annotations where applicable. DockQ scores additionally characterize RNA-protein interface quality. Target grouping incorporates both RNA and protein sequence relationships to support dataset partitioning. Analyses reveal distinct quality distributions across dataset levels and target-dependent differences among predictors, with each predictor contributing the highest-TM-score model for a subset of targets. Broad pooled score distributions also coexist with limited within-target score variation, particularly for RNA-protein complexes, emphasizing the importance of target-level characterization. By combining AI-generated decoys, standardized quality labels, and structured metadata, RNA3D-Decoy provides a resource for developing and evaluating methods for global quality estimation, local error prediction, and candidate-model ranking. The data set and accompanying code are available at: https://github.com/HamiltonChenLab/RNA3D-Decoy.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含10万多个AI生成的RNA三维结构模型（decoy）的大规模基准数据集，覆盖纯RNA、含金属离子RNA、RNA-蛋白质复合物三类真实结构，用TM-score/lDDT/RMSD/DockQ等标准指标标注质量，并按靶标分组支持严谨的模型评估。
analysis.claim: RNA3D-Decoy是首个系统覆盖多类RNA分子环境、整合主流AI预测器输出、并提供靶标级质量标注与结构化元数据的RNA结构质量评估基准数据集。
analysis.input: AI生成的RNA或RNA-蛋白质复合物3D坐标文件（PDB格式）
analysis.output: 全局质量分数（TM-score/lDDT/RMSD）、局部误差标注、RNA-蛋白质界面DockQ分数、靶标分组标签
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了RNA结构QA领域长期缺失的高质量、多模态（RNA-only/ion-bound/complex）、多预测器、靶标级标注的基准空白，实证扎实（10万+ decoys, 5 SOTA predictors, 3 error metrics + DockQ, full open release），但未提出新算法或解决RNA折叠根本难题，属里程碑式基础设施而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量基准建设极为扎实，显著提升RNA结构QA方法开发与公平比较的可靠性，但本身不解决预测或物理建模问题。

papers.title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC. RhinoVLA adopts a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone and a continuous Action Expert, reducing the VLM-side token and computation burden while preserving pretrained multimodal capability. To support cross-robot learning, RhinoVLA further introduces a unified interface that combines View Registry, 72D physical state-action slot space, and robotinstance LoRA, allowing heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas to be aligned under a shared policy. On the deployment side, RhinoVLA is optimized through hardware-aware compilation, mixed-precision execution, and parallel visual encoding. Experiments show that RhinoVLA achieves downstream performance comparable to π0.5 at a similar parameter scale, while reaching 11.69 Hz end-to-end inference on Huixi R1, meeting the 10 Hz real-time closedloop control target. The project will be open-sourced at https://github.com/HuixiAI/RhinoVLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RhinoVLA，一个专为边缘硬件（Huixi R1芯片）实时部署优化的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过减少视觉/上下文token数量、用连续动作专家替代离散动作头、统一异构机器人接口，并结合硬件感知编译与混合精度推理，在保持接近π0.5性能的同时实现11.69Hz端到端推理。
analysis.claim: 通过token效率设计、硬件协同优化与跨机器人统一接口，RhinoVLA首次在国产边缘SoC上实现了满足闭环控制实时性（≥10Hz）且性能对标主流VLA模型的端到端部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+机器人本体状态（72D物理状态向量）
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（末端位姿变化+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Huixi R1边缘SoC + 自研R1机器人平台（摘要未明说但‘real-time closed-loop control’及‘cross-robot learning’暗示已接入真实机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅提‘cross-robot learning’和‘unified interface’，但无数据规模/采集方式描述，推断至少部分依赖真实机器人数据以支持closed-loop
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5级性能（86分档）且实现在国产边缘SoC上的10Hz+真机闭环部署，属工程级重大突破；但未开源数据、未报告多任务泛化基准（如OpenVLA/Octo评测协议）、未对比更广谱机器人形态（仅提‘heterogeneous’无实例），尚未构成范式级创新，故略低于π0.5（86）但显著高于RDT-1B（88→此处取84因缺乏跨任务SOTA证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在国产硬件约束下系统性攻克VLA实时部署瓶颈，实测达标且接口设计具扩展性，但科学验证深度和开放程度不及顶级开源VLA工作

papers.title: WorldCraft: From Camera Navigation to Object Manipulation in Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract: Recent video-based world models have made pixel-space environments interactive at the camera level: users can navigate viewpoints while the model generates coherent visual continuations. Yet their action spaces remain incomplete: users can move the camera, but cannot act on individual objects. Since real-world interaction is inherently object-centric, such models remain closer to passive scene observers than truly manipulable environments. We present WorldCraft, a framework that expands interactive video world models from camera navigation to object-level trajectory actions. Given a user click and a sketched path, WorldCraft generates future frames in which the selected object follows the prescribed trajectory while the camera continues to navigate the scene. WorldCraft achieves this through a trajectory-centric control pipeline: First, Normalized World Trajectory (NWT) represents user-drawn motion in a camera-invariant world coordinate system and dynamically re-projects it under the current camera pose, separating object motion from camera-induced screen-space displacement; Spatial-Pathway LoRA (SP-LoRA) then injects this world-space signal through the model's spatial-control pathway, adding object manipulation capability while preserving the pretrained camera controller; finally, Trajectory-Anchored State Persistence (TASP) treats the world trajectory as a persistent spatial state and refreshes autoregressive memory after trajectory-conditioned generation, allowing moved objects to reappear at their updated positions after leaving the camera view. Experiments show that WorldCraft enables accurate object control, preserves the video-based world model's camera fidelity under camera-only evaluation, and maintains object state across long autoregressive rollouts with off-camera excursions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视频世界模型从只能移动摄像头（看不同角度）升级为能用鼠标点击+手绘轨迹来直接拖动场景中的物体，让模型生成物体按指定路径运动的未来视频帧，同时保持摄像头自由导航能力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦世界坐标系下的轨迹表征、空间控制通路微调和轨迹锚定的状态持久机制，视频世界模型可原生支持对象级操作而非仅相机级导航。
analysis.input: 当前视频帧 + 用户鼠标点击位置 + 手绘二维轨迹（在当前画面坐标系）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频，其中被点击物体沿重投影后的世界轨迹运动，背景与相机运动保持连贯
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据，完全基于合成/预训练视频数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路有启发性（如NWT解耦、TASP状态持久），但全在仿真视频域内验证，无真实物理交互、无跨对象泛化实验、无基线对比（如vs. VideoPoet/Emu3/WorldSim）、无消融分析关键模块贡献，更像一个概念验证型UI增强，未触及具身智能的核心挑战（力控、闭环感知-动作耦合、真实动力学）
