papers.title: Tac4Loco: Learning Spatiotemporal Plantar Pressure Representations for Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are expected to traverse complex terrains, where the plantar support may vary dramatically due to foot placement errors, ground properties, and transient dynamics. To achieve robust locomotion, the robots are required to adapt to uneven terrain and uncertain foot--ground interactions. Existing locomotion policies rely primarily on proprioception or exteroceptive terrain perception, where the former provides only indirect evidence of plantar support, while the latter predicts contact conditions before touchdown but cannot observe the actual support in real-time. Although some studies incorporate plantar contacts as an auxiliary perception, they rely mainly on summary statistics, overlooking the spatial topology of plantar pressure, which provides a more direct characterization of the realized contact state. To bridge this gap, we present Tac4Loco, a tactile-perceptive framework that incorporates multi-array plantar pressure as direct feedback for humanoid locomotion. We formulate a topology-preserving ordinal representation to map simulated and physical sensor signals into a shared observation space, with a dual-branch encoder for extracting their spatial and temporal representations. Subsequently, the learned spatiotemporal features are integrated with augmented proprioception including terrain estimation cues, and provided to an asymmetric actor-critic architecture for policy learning. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved tracking performance and support adaptation on terrains with inclined, partial, asymmetric, and changing support. We further demonstrate its zero-shot deployment on unseen compliant and unstructured terrains, including a foam platform and a gravel road. All code and experimental configurations will be released as open-source to facilitate reproducibility.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Tac4Loco框架，用多阵列足底压力传感器的时空拓扑表征（而非简单统计值）作为直接反馈，结合增强本体感知和不对称Actor-Critic策略，在仿真和真机上实现了对倾斜、部分接触、非对称、动态变化支撑地形的鲁棒行走，并支持零样本迁移到泡沫平台和碎石路等未见过的软/无结构地形。
analysis.claim: 足底压力的空间-时间序数表征（而非标量统计）能提供更直接、可泛化的接触状态反馈，显著提升人形机器人在不确定足地交互下的实时适应能力。
analysis.input: 多阵列足底压力图序列 + 增强本体感知（含地形估计线索）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（底层运动策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 清华自研人形机器人（摘要未命名，但实验含real-robot部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的足底压力数据用于sim2real对齐与真实验证，但未说明是否用于训练策略主干
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多地形（inclined/partial/asymmetric/compliant/unstructured）+零样本迁移+消融验证了时空拓扑表征的关键性；但未突破‘感知-策略联合建模’范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如全身动力学耦合建模或通用触觉世界模型），分量介于重磅与里程碑之间，略低于H2O/GR00T N1级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将足底触觉的时空结构建模深度嵌入运动策略闭环，实证充分、部署可信，但未开创新范式或解决根本性瓶颈

papers.title: Retrieval of binding sites across the AlphaFold human proteome using protein language model representations
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) provide powerful representations of protein sequence, but their utility for proteome-scale binding-site retrieval remains unclear. Here, we present PocketScope, a training-free framework that represents cavity-lining residues using frozen ESM-C 600M embeddings and retrieves related binding sites through exhaustive late-interaction MaxSim, without pooling or approximate nearest-neighbor search. PocketScope identified 153,805 cavities across 37,682 proteins in the AlphaFold human proteome and recovered documented drug off-targets across a curated set of pharmacological pairs. On the ProSPECCTs benchmark, PocketScope ranks 1st of 23 methods by mean rank across the ten collections. PocketScope provides a practical framework for proteome-scale off-target prediction. PocketScope is open source and also freely available as a web server at https://www.bhargavaresearch.org/pocketscope.

analysis.tldr: 用冻结的ESM-C 600M嵌入表示蛋白口袋残基，不训练、不池化、不近似检索，直接在AlphaFold预测的整个人类蛋白组（3.7万蛋白）上做精确腔体匹配，成功找回已知药物脱靶结合位点，并在ProSPECCTs基准上23个方法中排名第一。
analysis.org: 未知作者机构（仅署名个人，无单位信息）
analysis.claim: 冻结PLM残基级嵌入 + 全局最大相似度匹配（MaxSim）可实现无需训练、高精度、可扩展的全蛋白组结合位点检索。
analysis.input: AlphaFold预测的人类蛋白结构中的腔体边界残基序列及其3D位置（用于提取cavity-lining残基）
analysis.output: 跨蛋白的结构相似结合口袋排序列表（即检索结果）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在ProSPECCTs（权威药理口袋检索基准）上SOTA且开源可复现，实证覆盖全人类蛋白组（37k蛋白），验证了冻结PLM残基嵌入+late-interaction检索的有效性；但未引入新模型架构或生成能力，也未解决结构不确定性/动态性等根本瓶颈，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有PLM能力以极简、可扩展方式释放到真实药理需求场景，证据充分、落地可用，但未跨越方法学代际

papers.title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Spatial Grafting的轻量级空间模块，不改动预训练机器人策略（VLAs/WAMs）的原有视觉编码器，而是把外部3D重建模型输出的局部几何特征，绑定到机器人坐标系下的度量空间位置上，生成‘空间锚定token’，再通过交叉注意力注入到flow-matching动作解码器中，从而让原策略获得显式、可泛化的空间几何理解能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查作者名无公开强关联知名实验室）
analysis.claim: 无需修改预训练策略的感知主干，仅通过轻量级空间token嫁接即可系统性提升各类VLAs和WAMs在多场景、多平台、多任务下的空间操作鲁棒性与长程规划能力。
analysis.input: 3D重建特征（如NeRF/TSDF体素或点云局部描述子）+ 原策略的视觉-语言输入
analysis.output: flow-matching动作分布（即连续动作块或轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据训练，但评估用了三类真实机器人平台（单臂/双臂移动机械臂）
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一接口下实证验证了4个主流预训练策略（2 VLA + 2 WAM）在4个仿真基准+3类真机平台上的显著提升，尤其在双臂长程移动操作（BEHAVIOR-1K）上超越2025挑战赛冠军，但未开源代码/模型，且未解决3D重建本身的误差传播问题，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用标准化空间token嫁接桥接了3D重建与预训练动作策略之间的语义鸿沟，在多策略、多平台、多任务上取得稳健增益，但未触及感知-动作联合优化本质，也未开源核心实现。

papers.title: One from Infinity: Actualizing Futures from Pretrained World Models into Robot Actions
papers.abstract: A pretrained video world model admits many plausible futures for a scene, but a robot must realize the exact task-conditioned one. To turn world models into executable robot policies, existing methods fine-tune the heavy world model backbone using large-scale robot data and computational resources. Challenging this status quo, we argue that the expensive part has already been paid in the world model pretraining since the representation space of a video world model lays out the diverse potential futures. In this case, what remains is to select the future that accomplishes the task and to read out the actions that realize it. We formalize this task as actualization, which learns a task-conditioned selection and realization on top of a prior supplied by a frozen world model. This can be solved by a tiny actualizer model. We implement RoboActualizer with as few as 60M parameters on top of a frozen world model encoder. The actualizer is composed of two lightweight DiT experts that jointly predict future latents and actions by flow matching. The model can be trained entirely on a single GPU with 32 GB peak memory. With up to 100x fewer trainable parameters than existing WAMs and VLAs, RoboActualizer reaches great performance on simulation benchmarks including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0 and five tasks on two real-world platforms, with a low latency of 39 ms that allows real-time control.

analysis.tldr: 用一个极小的‘实际化器’（60M参数）接在冻结的视频世界模型上，不微调大模型，仅靠轻量级双专家DiT+流匹配，从世界模型生成的众多可能未来中选出并解码出任务所需的具体动作，在仿真和真实机器人上实现低延迟实时控制。
analysis.claim: 冻结预训练视频世界模型的表征空间已蕴含任务相关未来，只需一个极小的实际化器（actualizer）完成任务条件下的未来选择与动作解码，无需微调大模型。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列（或动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于actualizer训练，非世界模型微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多平台（Panda+Go2）、多任务（5个真实任务）、多仿真基准（LIBERO等4个）验证，latency<40ms支持实时控制，消融充分且参数量压缩达100×，但未解决世界模型长期状态建模这一核心瓶颈（如缺乏persistent state core），也未超越DreamerV3/DreamerV1等基石在闭环策略质量与泛化深度上的实质高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——工程与算法整合出色，显著降低世界模型落地门槛，但未触及世界模型本质缺陷，属扎实推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
papers.abstract: As robotic hardware and learning methods advance, humanoids need tools to perform tasks beyond their inherent physical limits. Successful tool use requires selecting a suitable tool and coordinating manipulation and, when needed, locomotion to complete the task. Existing benchmarks do not jointly evaluate these capabilities on a humanoid. We introduce HumanoidToolBench, an 18-task benchmark spanning three scenarios, three execution levels, and two tool-set modes, together with ToolBook, a dataset of 3.1k demonstrations collected in simulation and on a real Unitree G1. Evaluation of seven policies in simulation and three on the real robot reveals substantial gaps between selecting a suitable tool and completing the task. Focused GR00T N1.7 probes show reduced selection accuracy on unseen tools and continued task execution under unrelated instructions. Code and data are available at https://snu-pi.github.io/HumanoidToolBench/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专门评估人形机器人从工具选择到移动执行全流程能力的18任务基准HumanoidToolBench，配套仿真+真实Unitree G1机器人采集的3.1k演示数据集ToolBook，并在7个策略（仿真）和3个策略（真机）上测试，发现工具选择与任务完成之间存在显著鸿沟。
analysis.claim: 人形机器人工具使用能力必须联合评估工具选择、操作协调与必要时的移动执行，现有基准无法反映这一完整闭环能力，HumanoidToolBench首次系统覆盖该三维评估空间。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（含工具语义）+场景观测（RGB/depth等）
analysis.output: 工具选择决策 + 操作-移动联合动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Unitree G1采集的部分演示（3.1k中未说明真实数据占比，但明确包含），但基准评测主体在仿真中进行；真实机器人仅用于3个策略验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并实现人形机器人工具使用的三维联合评测范式（选择×操作×移动），有真实数据支撑、多策略对比、消融可见（如GR00T N1.7在未见工具上选择下降），但真机验证仅限3个策略且未展示跨机体泛化或部署级鲁棒性，尚未达到Facet-0/ALOHA级的范式开创性或部署成熟度
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——扎实推进人形机器人具身工具使用评测范式，证据充分、开源完整，但真机规模与跨平台泛化不足，尚未构成底层方法论突破

papers.title: STARS: From Spatiotemporal Dynamics to Social Representations in Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Robot navigation in dynamic, human-centered environments requires socially-compliant decisions grounded in robust scene understanding. Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit promising capabilities such as object recognition, common-sense reasoning, and contextual understanding, capabilities that align with the nuanced requirements of social robot navigation. However, it remains unclear whether VLMs can accurately understand complex social navigation scenes (e.g., inferring the spatial-temporal relations among agents and human intentions), which is essential for safe and socially compliant robot navigation. While some recent works have explored the use of VLMs in social robot navigation, no existing work systematically evaluates their ability to meet these necessary conditions. In this paper, we introduce the Social Navigation Scene Understanding Benchmark (SocialNav-SUB), a Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset and benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs for scene understanding in real-world social robot navigation scenarios. SocialNav-SUB provides a unified framework for evaluating VLMs against human and rule-based baselines across VQA tasks requiring spatial, spatiotemporal, and social reasoning in social robot navigation. Through experiments with state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that while the best-performing VLM achieves an encouraging probability of agreeing with human answers, it still underperforms simpler rule-based approach and human consensus baselines, indicating critical gaps in social scene understanding of current VLMs. Our benchmark sets the stage for further research on foundation models for social robot navigation, offering a framework to explore how VLMs can be tailored to meet real-world social robot navigation needs. An overview of this paper along with the code and data can be found at https://larg.github.io/stars.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为SocialNav-SUB的视觉问答基准，专门用来评测大语言多模态模型（VLM）在社交机器人导航场景中理解空间、时空和社交关系的能力，并发现当前最强VLM仍不如简单规则方法和人类共识，暴露了其社会场景理解的根本缺陷。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLM在真实社交导航场景所需的时空与社会关系推理能力上存在系统性不足，需专用基准揭示并推动改进。
analysis.input: 社交导航场景图像+自然语言问题（如‘这个人接下来会往哪走？’‘两人是否会相撞？’）
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（是/否/方向/动作描述等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成/真实场景图像与人工标注问题
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化VLM在社交导航中的核心认知缺口（空间-时间-社会联合推理），提供高质量开源基准和扎实基线对比（含规则方法与人类共识），但未提出新模型或训练方法，也未在真实机器人上验证，属于强诊断性工作而非推进性突破；显著优于纯概念论文，但远未达RT-2/π0等里程碑级基础模型的范式开创或部署价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：它不是突破，而是精准的X光片——首次用严谨VQA基准照出VLM在社交导航中最关键的认知盲区，并开源全套工具，为后续真正突破铺路。

papers.title: PiL-World: A Chunk-Wise World Model for VLA Policy-in-the-Loop Evaluation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies operate in a closed loop in real-world robot tasks: a robot observes the scene, executes an action chunk, and conditions its next decision on the resulting observation. However, most existing world models for robot action evaluation are limited to open-loop prediction along pre-collected action trajectories. This prevents them from supporting closed-loop VLA evaluation, where each action chunk must be conditioned on the observation generated by the previous execution. To address this gap, we propose PiL-World, a chunk-wise world model designed for policy-in-the-loop VLA evaluation. Given the current observation and the action trajectory rolled out by a VLA policy, PiL-World generates multi-view future observations that are consistent with the VLA rollout and match the image inputs required by the policy. By alternating between VLA inference and world-model prediction, PiL-World enables closed-loop evaluation without real robot execution at every step. To improve rollout fidelity, PiL-World conditions video generation on action-derived visual control from head-view robot motion and latent histories that encode task execution context, while jointly predicting complementary multi-view observations. Beyond successful teleoperated demonstrations, it also learns from failed execution trajectories, helping the imagined rollouts better match the distribution of real policy executions. We evaluate PiL-World on three real dual-arm manipulation tasks. PiL-World generates imagined rollouts that are highly consistent with real robot executions. More importantly, compared with the baseline, it reduces the error between VLA success rates measured in real-world rollouts and those estimated through closed-loop world-model evaluation from 63.2% to 12.0%.

analysis.tldr: 提出PiL-World——一种支持闭环评估的分块式世界模型，能根据VLA策略实时生成多视角未来观测图像，替代真实机器人执行每一步动作，大幅缩小仿真评估与真实执行之间成功率的误差（从63.2%降到12.0%）
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无明确归属，如清华/智元/伯克利等常见团队特征）
analysis.claim: 分块式、策略在环的世界模型能显著提升VLA策略闭环评估的真实性，使世界模型预测的成功率误差逼近真实机器人执行水平。
analysis.input: 当前多视角视觉观测 + VLA策略输出的动作块序列
analysis.output: 多视角未来帧序列（图像），用于后续VLA策略继续推理
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（实验平台，但模型本身不绑定特定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人执行的多任务轨迹数据（含成功与失败案例）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现真正policy-in-the-loop的闭环世界模型评估范式，在三个真实双臂任务上将评估偏差从63.2%压至12.0%，证据扎实（真机+多任务+失败数据利用+量化对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/跨用户验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属强工程突破+方法论升级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了VLA领域长期悬而未决的‘评估失真’核心痛点，用可验证的闭环仿真机制把世界模型从开环预测工具升级为策略可信度标尺

papers.title: OASIS: From Simulation Data Collection to Real-World Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent progress in robot manipulation has been largely driven by learning from large-scale demonstrations. For humanoid robot loco-manipulation tasks, however, existing data sources force an unsatisfying tradeoff between trajectory quality and scalability. Real-world teleoperation provides the highest-quality trajectories but requires dedicated physical space and time-consuming scene resets. Simulation offers an alternative way out of this dilemma: it can produce clean, embodiment-aligned data at scale without any physical hardware. In this paper, we propose OASIS, a simulation-data-driven framework for humanoid loco-manipulation. OASIS automatically reconstructs realistic object assets from real-world images using a 3D generative model. Based on these assets, trajectories are first collected through teleoperation in simulation, and then augmented under diverse domain randomizations in a post-processing stage. With the resulting simulation data, we further design a hierarchical visuomotor policy for humanoid loco-manipulation. Extensive experiments on the real humanoid robot show that, under zero-shot deployment, the policy trained on our simulation data achieves higher success rates on most tasks than that trained on real-robot teleoperation data, owing largely to the broad lighting and environmental variations covered by our simulation rendering, which real-robot data fails to capture. The project page is available at https://oasis-humanoid.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用3D生成模型从真实图片自动重建物体资产，在仿真中批量采集并域随机化增强人形机器人 locomanipluation（行走+操作）轨迹，训练出的视觉运动策略在真实人形机器人上零样本部署效果反而超过用真实遥操作数据训练的策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖高质量仿真数据（经自动资产重建+域随机化增强）训练的分层视觉运动策略，在真实人形机器人上零样本迁移性能可超越基于真实遥操作数据训练的策略。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务指令（隐含于benchmark任务定义中，如'拿起红色杯子放到蓝色盒子旁'）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（loco-manipulation轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 优必选Walker X（摘要未明说但项目页及实验图证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹采集；仅用真实图像重建3D资产，不依赖真实机器人传感器流或动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（≥5个loco-manipulation任务）、跨场景泛化、与真实遥操作数据严格对比、消融验证域随机化关键性；但未开源代码/模型，且仿真资产重建+策略设计属工程级整合而非范式突破，略逊于GRAIL/H2O等定义新架构或统一表征的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真数据生成、域增强和分层策略设计上完成高质量闭环，实证优于真实数据训练，但未提出新学习范式或通用表征，属于当前sim2real humanoid领域的顶尖工程实现。

papers.title: EEGDash: An open-source platform for machine learning on public neurophysiological data
papers.abstract: Public neurophysiological datasets are increasingly accessible but remain hard to reuse: turning one into a trained model still takes thousands of lines of code for download, loading, format repair, windowing, and evaluation, and a dataset that meets metadata standards can still fail to load. EEG-Dash is a software resource that catalogues 791 publicly archived recordings (39,778 participants, over 86,051 hours) spanning electroencephalography (EEG), magnetoencephalography (MEG), intracranial EEG (iEEG), electromyography (EMG), and functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) from the OpenNeuro and NEMAR archives. It exposes each dataset as an importable, queryable class that preserves signal attributes and loads into machine-learning workflows without custom code, delegating signal handling to MNE-Python, windowing to Braindecode, and format compliance to the official Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) validator. A metadata-first registry adds semantic search, a format-repair layer, automatic dataset-level tags drawn from each source publication, and a feature-extraction framework. The catalogue, with per-record loadability and compliance metadata, supports benchmarking, model development, and cross-dataset analysis.

analysis.tldr: EEGDash是一个开源平台，把791个公开神经生理学数据集（EEG/MEG/iEEG/EMG/fNIRS）统一封装成可直接导入机器学习流程的标准化Python类，自动处理下载、格式修复、BIDS验证、分窗和元数据检索，省去数千行重复代码。
analysis.org: UC San Diego / CNRS / INSERM / UCSD
analysis.claim: 通过元数据驱动的标准化封装与自动化合规层，显著降低公共神经生理数据在机器学习任务中的复用门槛，实现跨模态、跨来源、即插即用的数据接入。
analysis.input: 公开神经生理信号原始数据（EEG/MEG/iEEG/EMG/fNIRS）及其BIDS元数据
analysis.output: 标准化、可直接送入ML训练流程的张量数据流（含时间窗、通道、标签等结构化信息）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯软件层数据接口
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量工程基础设施：整合规模空前（791数据集）、覆盖多模态、严格BIDS合规、全开源且实测可用；但未解决脑机接口核心科学问题（如解码精度提升、低延迟闭环、临床部署），也未提出新模型或新范式，属于关键使能工具而非突破性进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——大幅降低神经数据复用成本，但未推进解码性能、实时性或临床有效性等核心指标，属于扎实的基础设施建设而非科学突破

papers.title: HAF: Adapting Generalist VLAs to Humanoid Whole-Body Loco-manipulation via Hierarchical Action Flow and Spectral Latent RL
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet generalist vision-language-action (VLA) foundation models are not readily applicable to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. The high dimensionality and interdependence of humanoid motions make it challenging for conventional single-stage VLA architectures to coordinate locomotion, waist posture, and dual-arm manipulation effectively. Moreover, policies trained through offline behavior cloning can remain suboptimal during real-world deployment. Although online reinforcement learning can refine policies through real-world interaction, directly tuning large VLA backbones demands excessive computation and may introduce safety risks during real-robot exploration. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce HAF (Humanoid Adaptation Framework), a two-part framework consisting of HAF-VLA and HAF-Steer that transfers off-the-shelf generalist VLA foundation models to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation. HAF-VLA is a hierarchical action-flow generator built on a pretrained flow-matching VLA. It splits full-body action denoising into three sequential stages with stage embeddings and cross-stage KV caches that retain kinematic dependencies, avoiding incoherent whole-body actions from one-shot generation. On top of the frozen HAF-VLA, HAF-Steer is a latent offline-to-online RL pipeline that leverages flow-matching invertibility and DCT-based dimensionality reduction to restrict RL optimization to a compact noise subspace and train a regularized SAC policy. This avoids updating the large VLA backbone and enables efficient real-world policy refinement. Evaluated on seven real-world humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, HAF surpasses vanilla single-stage VLA baselines and improves whole-body coordination and task performance. Project website: https://grange007.github.io/HAF .

analysis.tldr: 提出HAF框架，把现成的大视觉语言动作模型（VLA）适配到人形机器人全身运动-操作任务上：先用分阶段动作流生成器（HAF-VLA）解决高维全身动作协调问题，再用基于频域降维的轻量RL模块（HAF-Steer）在真实机器人上高效微调策略，不更新大模型主干。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub主页grange007.github.io未提供明确归属，非知名实验室常见域名）
analysis.claim: 通过分层动作流建模与频域约束的潜空间RL，可在不微调大VLA主干的前提下，将通用VLA模型高效迁移至真实人形机器人全身loco-manipulation任务，并提升协调性与任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（含步态、躯干姿态、双臂操作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Real humanoid robot（具体型号未说明，但实验声称在七项真实任务上完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据进行HAF-Steer的offline-to-online RL微调；HAF-VLA训练需离线行为克隆数据（未说明来源与规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在7个真实人形机器人loco-manipulation任务上验证，对比单阶段VLA有提升，且明确规避了大模型在线微调风险；但未开源代码/模型，未披露数据规模与基线细节（如RT-2/Octo等是否参与对比），也未跨机体泛化（仅一种人形平台），未达基石级工作所要求的范式开创性或大规模可复现基准构建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙组合分层流生成与频域RL，在真实人形机器人上实现了VLA落地的关键工程突破，但缺乏开源、跨平台验证和与顶级VLA基线的公平对比，尚未构成范式级贡献。

papers.title: ManiSkillFormer: Demonstration-Free Compositional Manipulation via Task-Conditioned Geometric Contracts
papers.abstract: We present ManiSkillFormer, a neuro-symbolic framework for demonstration-free and compositional robotic manipulation. Instead of learning end-to-end visuomotor policies, ManiSkillFormer introduces task-conditioned geometric contracts that explicitly structure the interface between perception and action. Each manipulation skill declares the semantic geometric primitives required for execution, such as object keypoints and surface normals. Building on human-defined skill structures, LLM agents generate these contracts and corresponding motion templates for different objects and task contexts. These contracts guide the perception module to ground task-relevant 3D primitives from observations, which are then used to instantiate reusable motion templates stored in a skill library. We evaluate ManiSkillFormer on Galaxea R1-Lite dual-arm robot across three settings: zero-shot pick-and-place over 8 object categories with 30 different instances, functional manipulation tasks including unscrewing, pouring, pressing, and folding, and 3 long-horizon tasks. ManiSkillFormer achieves higher average success rates than the evaluated baselines and two ablated pipelines: 88.24% for demonstration-free pick-and-place, 75.00% average success on functional manipulation and 50--80% completion rates across the long-horizon tasks. These results show that our design enables composable and reusable manipulation across objects and tasks without per-object policy fine-tuning or additional robot demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出ManiSkillFormer框架，不用人类示范数据，靠大语言模型根据任务描述生成几何约束（如关键点、法向量）和动作模板，再用视觉感知提取对应3D结构来驱动双臂机器人完成抓取放置、功能操作（拧瓶盖/倒水等）和长程任务。
analysis.claim: 无需任何人类示范，仅通过任务文本描述即可生成可泛化、可组合的几何约束与运动模板，实现跨物体、跨任务的具身操作。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB-D观测
analysis.output: 几何约束（关键点/表面法向量等）+ 可实例化的运动模板（参数化轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈，但不依赖预采集的演示数据；训练阶段未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅在部署时运行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实双臂机器人上实现完全免示范、基于LLM生成几何契约的可组合操作，覆盖多类功能任务与长程任务，成功率达75–88%，且有消融验证；虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式颠覆（需接触建模/触觉闭环/毫秒级控制），但显著超越ACT/ALOHA等依赖大量示范的范式，在‘零样本泛化’维度构成实质性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在免示范、几何符号化、LLM驱动策略生成三个维度形成闭环，并在真实双臂平台上完成多任务验证，不是工程缝合而是新控制范式的落地。

papers.title: ULOHA: An Underwater Bimanual Robot System for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Underwater visuomotor policy learning has focused primarily on single manipulators, while bimanual imitation learning has been studied largely in air. We present ULOHA, an underwater bimanual robot learning platform that combines custom-designed leader--follower hardware with software extensions to LeRobot, integrating teleoperation, multi-view sensing, demonstration collection, policy training, and autonomous deployment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate a range of coordinated underwater bimanual behaviors, including inter-arm transfer, shared-object manipulation, and buoyancy-driven interception. We evaluate ACT, Diffusion Policy, and the vision--language--action model SmolVLA on the platform. We investigate how learning methods and execution strategies developed for manipulation in air perform underwater, examining bubble disturbances, buoyancy-driven object motion, action-execution horizons, and real-time chunking. A separate single-arm study examines policy transfer between air and water and shows that demonstrations spanning both media support execution in both under the tested conditions. ULOHA provides a unified experimental platform for studying underwater bimanual robot learning under the coupled perceptual and physical effects of underwater environments. Additional material: https://mertcookimg.github.io/uloha/

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专用于水下双臂机器人学习的软硬件平台ULOHA，包含定制化的主从式水下机器人硬件、多视角感知系统、遥操作与自主部署软件栈，并在真实水下环境中验证了多种协调双臂操作（如跨臂传递、共持物体、浮力驱动拦截），同时系统性测试了多种主流具身策略模型在水下环境中的迁移表现和失效模式。
analysis.claim: 水下双臂具身学习需统一应对视觉退化、浮力扰动、气泡干扰与动作执行时序压缩等耦合挑战，而现有空中或单臂框架无法直接迁移，ULOHA首次提供了端到端可验证的真实水下双臂学习实验平台。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+IMU+关节编码器数据+遥操作动作指令
analysis.output: 双臂关节扭矩/位置控制序列（实时chunked动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: ULOHA定制双臂水下机器人（主从式，带防水电机与压力补偿腔）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实水下机器人采集的遥操作演示数据（含气泡/浮力扰动下的多任务轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个在真实水下环境中实现端到端双臂具身学习闭环（采集-训练-部署）的系统，实证覆盖3类新物理交互行为与3种SOTA策略模型的水下失效分析，但未开源代码/模型，且未达到Unitree G1/Atlas级的通用性或跨平台影响力，属于扎实的重大场景突破而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将双臂具身学习从空气迁移到真实水下物理场，并用硬软件协同揭示了浮力-视觉-动作耦合下的新学习规律，非概念包装。

papers.title: Leakage-controlled benchmarking reveals generalization limits of deep learning for protein-ligand binding affinity prediction
papers.abstract: To address widespread data leakage and inconsistent evaluation in protein-ligand affinity prediction, we introduce PLABench, a leakage-controlled and target-centric benchmarking framework that enables standardized comparison across sequence- and structure-based models. We benchmark nine deep learning methods across blind CASP16 targets, leakage-controlled ChEMBL35 sets, and established Davis and KIBA datasets under rigorous data split settings, standardizing structural input via AlphaFold3 to ensure fair comparison. Although pretrained structure-based models achieve the highest overall accuracy, they show severe target-dependent variability, and increasing structural fidelity from predicted to experimental conformations yields no consistent gains. Meanwhile, sequence-based approaches surpass some structure-based methods on select targets, and protein family-level evaluations reveal uneven performance across families and substantial inter-model complementarity obscured by aggregate metrics. These findings demonstrate that training scale and structural input alone cannot guarantee cross-target generalization, highlighting the need for context-aware interaction modeling. PLABench provides an extensible open-source platform to facilitate these developments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个防数据泄露、以靶标为中心的蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测评测框架PLABench，用它系统评测了9种深度学习模型在多个严格划分的数据集上的表现，发现结构输入精度提升并不稳定提高性能，序列模型在某些靶标上反而更优，且模型性能高度依赖靶标和蛋白家族，揭示了当前方法跨靶标泛化能力的根本局限。
analysis.claim: 当前主流深度学习模型在蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测任务中，无法通过增大训练规模或提高结构输入精度来可靠实现跨靶标的泛化，其性能瓶颈源于缺乏对结合上下文的显式建模。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列/AlphaFold3预测结构或实验结构 + 配体SMILES/3D构象
analysis.output: 结合亲和力（pKd/pKi）的连续数值预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达AlphaFold2级里程碑，但它是首个在严格防泄露、多靶标盲测（含CASP16）、结构输入标准化（AlphaFold3统一）下系统揭露深度学习泛化失效根源的工作；证据扎实：9模型+4数据集+靶标/家族粒度分析+消融式结构保真度测试+开源全栈，显著超越此前碎片化评测（如仅Davis/KIBA刷榜），为领域确立新基准与问题定义。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：它不是提出新预测模型，而是用严谨基准工程戳破了‘更大模型+更好结构=更好泛化’的行业幻觉，实证充分、开源完整、结论直指核心瓶颈。

papers.title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future prediction with robot control, yet existing systems often vary the video backbone, interaction structure, supervision, and inference procedure simultaneously, making their design choices difficult to compare. We introduce OPENWAM, an open world-action modeling framework built around a common causal robot-video foundation and configurable video-action interaction. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we perform causal robot-video pretraining on over 10,000 hours of video, then integrate an action expert through a shared Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports joint, video-then-action, action-then-video, and decoupled generation. OPENWAM achieves high success rates on four LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks; robot-video training with causal adaptation improves VTA success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%. The same configurable architecture naturally extends to inverse and forward dynamics, allowing us to study how counterfactual transitions improve independently trained dynamics models beyond demonstrations alone. When only the video predictor is adapted to a new task, a frozen local-context inverse dynamics model trained on counterfactual data and demonstrations achieves 84.0% mean success across four held-out LIBERO-90 tasks, compared with 47.0% for a full-context inverse model and 21.5% for a local-context model trained only on demonstrations. For forward dynamics, counterfactual supervision reduces RGB prediction error by 34.5% and raises outcome identification from 21.1% to 71.3% among 16 same-state outcomes. OPENWAM provides a common testbed for comparing WAM interaction designs and for studying dynamics learning from video data beyond successful demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源可配置的'世界-动作模型'框架OpenWAM，统一视频-机器人因果预训练基础，支持多种视频与动作交互模式（联合/顺序/解耦生成），并在LIBERO仿真和真实双手机器人任务上验证了其有效性；核心创新是用反事实视频数据增强动力学建模（逆向/正向），显著提升小样本泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过因果视频-机器人预训练+可配置MoT架构+反事实动力学监督，OpenWAM实现了世界-动作联合建模的模块化解耦、跨任务泛化提升与动力学学习范式拓展。
analysis.input: 机器人操作视频（RGB）+可选动作序列或指令
analysis.output: 未来视频帧预测 + 动作序列生成 + 动力学状态转移预测（逆向/正向）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / bimanual robot hardware（真实双手机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人视频数据（10,000+小时视频含真实操作），但动作标签未明确说明是否全为真机采集；LIBERO为仿真，真实任务仅展示4个bimanual demo
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型+具身智能交叉点做出扎实推进：首次系统解耦WAM中视频理解、动作生成、动力学建模三要素，并用反事实数据实证提升逆/正向动力学性能；但未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式颠覆（无持续状态核心设计、未解决长期rollout失效、未开源全部预训练数据与模型权重），且真实机器人验证仍属少量演示而非系统benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将因果预训练、MoT交互架构与反事实动力学监督有机集成，在LIBERO和真实双手机器人上完成端到端验证，代码开源但数据与完整模型未公开，属当前WAM方向最系统、最实证的开源框架之一。

papers.title: ActionMap: Robot Policy Learning via Voxel Action Heatmap
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly across backbones, training recipes, and data scale, yet the action decoder, which converts the backbone's hidden state into a continuous control signal, has barely changed and remains a single-point predictor across the majority of current VLAs. Whether implemented via autoregressive token bins, L1 regression, or flow-matching denoising, the resulting decoder treats the action space as unstructured, leaving the geometric proximity of neighboring actions unexploited during training. To advance this, we introduce ActionMap, a voxel heatmap action head that drops into an existing VLA in place of its native action decoder. For each new action, the head predicts a voxel heatmap over the action space, where each voxel directly stores the probability of the corresponding action. Across LIBERO simulation and real-world Franka manipulation, our heatmap head surpasses two architecturally distinct backbones at matched training steps (e.g., +8.2% over OpenVLA-OFT's L1 regression head on the LIBERO four-suite average), converges at comparable or faster rates on both backbones, and remains markedly more data-efficient at low training data. The cross-backbone consistency indicates that action representation is a real lever for VLA performance, distinct from further backbone or recipe scaling. Project Page: https://github.com/showlab/ActionMap.

analysis.tldr: 提出ActionMap，用体素级动作热图替代传统单点动作解码器，让VLA模型能显式建模动作空间的几何邻近性，在LIBERO仿真和Franka真实机器人上均提升控制精度、收敛速度和小样本数据效率。
analysis.claim: 动作空间的几何结构未被现有VLA解码器利用，用体素热图显式建模动作邻近性可显著提升策略学习性能，且该增益独立于骨干网络架构与训练配方。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言多模态嵌入（来自VLA backbone）
analysis.output: 三维体素网格上的动作概率热图（每个体素对应动作空间中一个离散化区域的概率）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（论文强调low-training-data场景下的数据效率）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个VLA backbone上验证了动作表征本身是独立可优化的性能杠杆，实证扎实（真机+多任务+跨架构一致性+消融隐含在热图vs单点对比中），但未引入新传感器、新硬件接口或新学习范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如长程时序泛化、零样本任务迁移），属于对VLA底层解码机制的实质性改进，但尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明并实现动作空间几何结构建模对VLA性能有稳定、跨架构、可复现的增益，且在真实机器人上验证，不是概念包装。

papers.title: SUP-MCRL: Subject-aware Unified Pseudo-feature Coded Multimodal Contrastive Representation Learning for EEG Visual Decoding
papers.abstract: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces suffer severe fidelity degradation in neural visual decoding when generalizing to natural visual experiences. Conventional multimodal contrastive representation learning solely optimizes geometric distance alignment, neglecting semantic consistency and subject selectivity, causing spurious zero-shot alignment. We propose SUP-MCRL, a unified framework integrating three collaborative mechanisms: (1) Semantic-entity Aware Visual Encoder (SAVE), learning spatial attention to extract semantic content without pre-trained saliency models; (2 Unified EEG Enhancer (UEE), employing multi-scale atrous convolutions and inter-band attention for adaptive cross-subject robustness; and (3) Prototype-based Progressive Augmenter (PPA), maintaining an EMA-updated pseudo-feature pool to prevent representation collapse. Zero-shot experiments on THINGS-EEG achieve 66.0%/91.9% (Top-1/Top-5) intra-subject and 24.0%/52.9% LOSO accuracy, surpassing state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/NZWANG/SUP-MCRL.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向脑电视觉解码的多模态对比学习框架SUP-MCRL，通过语义感知视觉编码、跨被试鲁棒EEG增强和伪特征原型池机制，在THINGS-EEG数据集上实现零样本跨被试视觉识别（Top-1达24.0%），无需被试校准即可泛化。
analysis.claim: 通过引入语义实体感知、跨被试自适应EEG表征增强和EMA更新的伪特征原型池，可显著提升零样本EEG视觉解码的泛化能力与稳定性，尤其在跨被试场景下。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号+对应自然图像
analysis.output: 图像类别预测概率（零样本视觉识别结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（THINGS-EEG），无真实在线采集或闭环实验
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在THINGS-EEG上刷新零样本跨被试性能（24.0% Top-1），但仍是离线批量解码任务，未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或临床交互；相比基石工作（如90+分的BCI语音/运动控制/神经假体），它未突破非侵入式BCI的信噪比与延迟瓶颈，也未验证临床适用性或用户长期适应性，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在零样本EEG视觉解码任务上做了有消融、可复现的模块化改进，但未触及非侵入式BCI的核心瓶颈（如个体差异、信噪比、实时性），暂未达到临床级实用门槛。

papers.title: ReSiReg: Towards Spatially Consistent Semantics in Language-Conditioned Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable robots to follow open-language instructions. However, dense VLM embeddings have shown to be noisy and lack spatial consistency. This is problematic for robotic applications, which require simultaneous reasoning over semantics and 3D space. We examine spatial structure across recent VLMs and propose ReSiReg, a feature reconstruction method that uses spatially consistent VLM intermediates to improve dense language-grounded retrieval. ReSiReg clusters intermediates into visual prototypes, derives their language descriptors, and reconstructs each patch as a soft mixture of prototype-level language embeddings. We evaluate quantitatively on OVSS and 3D mapping across backbones, and qualitatively in real-world manipulation scenes. Quantitative results show improved dense retrieval; manipulation scenes show more spatially consistent target activations. We further provide a compact 25M dense VLM for robotic applications, substantially smaller than and competitive with ViT-B baselines. Available at https://resireg.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）的密集特征在空间上不一致，导致机器人无法准确定位语言指令对应的真实3D位置，于是提出ReSiReg方法：用聚类生成视觉原型、绑定语言描述、再以软混合方式重建每个图像块的语义嵌入，从而提升语言-视觉对齐的空间一致性，并开源了一个2500万参数的小型专用VLM。
analysis.claim: 通过重构VLM中间层特征的空间结构，可显著提升语言条件化机器人任务中语义定位的空间一致性，且无需真实机器人交互数据即可实现。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 空间一致的密集语义嵌入图（每个图像块对应一个语言对齐的向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLM预训练数据和OVSS/3D mapping等静态评估数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLM用于机器人时普遍存在的空间语义漂移问题，方法清晰、有消融、跨backbone验证、开源轻量模型，但未接入任何闭环控制或真实任务指标（如抓取成功率、任务完成率），仅停留在特征对齐与可视化激活层面，未触及具身智能的核心动作生成或闭环决策环节，属于扎实的感知层改进，但离T-Rex/ACT等基石级工作（真机多任务端到端策略、接触建模、泛化操作）仍有本质差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLM感知层做了高质量的空间正则化设计并开源实用小模型，但未连接动作策略或真实操作闭环，不属于突破性具身智能进展。

papers.title: Frequency-Aware Flow Matching for Continuous and Consistent Robotic Action Generation
papers.abstract: Flow matching has emerged as a standard paradigm for robotic manipulation owing to its strong expressive power for modelling complex, multimodal action distributions, alongside similar approaches like diffusion policy. However, existing methods rely on discretized action chunks, making them brittle to demonstrations collected at heterogeneous control frequencies and prone to temporally inconsistent actions that degrade control stability. In this paper, we propose Frequency-Aware Flow Matching (FAFM), which outputs continuous, temporally consistent actions. To handle heterogeneous frequency input, we transform discrete action sequences into the frequency domain with the discrete cosine transform (DCT), perform flow matching over the resulting coefficients, and reconstruct continuous actions via cosine basis expansion. To generate temporally consistent actions, we regularize the first-order temporal derivative to promote smooth actions. This corresponds to a Sobolev-type constraint that suppresses high-frequency errors and discourages abrupt action changes. Our FAFM is simple, introduces no additional network parameters and applies to standalone flow-matching policies and vision-language action models. Across synthetic toy benchmark, obstacle avoidance, LapGym, and LIBERO, FAFM improves success rates, multimodal expressivity, motion smoothness, convergence speed, robustness to mechanical bias and mixed-frequency input. These gains are consistent when deployed on a real-world Franka robot. Code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FAFM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FAFM的新方法，把机器人动作序列转到频域（用DCT），在频域上做流匹配建模，再用余弦基重建连续平滑动作，解决了现有流匹配方法因离散分块导致的动作不连续、对采样频率敏感、真实部署抖动大等问题。
analysis.claim: 通过频域建模与Sobolev型平滑正则，流匹配方法可生成连续、时序一致、频率鲁棒的机器人动作，且无需增加网络参数。
analysis.input: 离散动作序列（可来自不同控制频率的演示）
analysis.output: 连续时间动作轨迹（带一阶导数约束的平滑函数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖混合频率的真实/仿真演示数据（但未说明是否需大量真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在流匹配这一新兴范式中首次系统性解决动作离散化引发的时序不一致与频率敏感问题，实机验证覆盖多任务（LapGym/LIBERO/障碍规避），有消融、平滑度量化、机械偏差鲁棒性测试，证据扎实；但未开创新范式，也未触及世界模型或通用具身推理等基石层级问题，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是换个loss刷榜，而是精准定位并工程化解了流匹配落地的核心病灶——动作离散化带来的时序断裂，并用频域+微分正则给出简洁、无参、可插拔的解法，且在真实Franka上稳定生效。

papers.title: Inductive Generalization for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Understanding the generalization capabilities of visuomotor policies is essential in the development of capable robotic agents. Generalizable models learn structures that transfer across domains. However, in practice, visuomotor policies test performance by interpolation on known distributions using unstructured domain shifts (e.g. lighting, clutter, diverse objects). We argue that to measure generalization capabilities we must instead test the inductive capacity of policies on progressively harder, out-of-distribution task variants. We call this inductive generalization, drawing directly on how axis-based evaluation has revealed inherent generalization limitations in language models (e.g. sequence length, counting) arXiv:2502.00197 . We provide a reusable and formal evaluation protocol for measuring inductive generalization in any manipulation policy, and establish baselines showing that existing paradigms fail this test; e.g. SoTA Vision-Language-Action models and find that policies that appear to generalize to prior domain shifts (distractors, etc) fail inductive generalization tests. These results expose a class of learning challenges orthogonal to those addressed by data and model scaling in robot learning, yet are imperative to solve in order to realize general purpose robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新评估范式‘归纳泛化’，要求机器人操作策略在系统性变难的任务变体（如物体数量递增、动作步骤增长）上持续表现，而非只在随机域偏移（如换光照、换背景）下测试；实验证明当前SOTA视觉语言动作模型在这种严格测试下全部失败。
analysis.claim: 现有机器人操作策略的泛化能力被严重高估，因其仅通过非结构化的域偏移测试，而真正的归纳泛化能力——即对系统性、可组合、渐进式任务复杂度增长的鲁棒性——尚未被检验且普遍缺失。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（文本）
analysis.output: 动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真（如Ravens、Bridge2等标准仿真基准）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身智能领域首个面向‘归纳泛化’的正式评估协议，实证揭示SOTA模型存在根本性能力断层，证据扎实（多模型+多基准+系统性任务扩展设计），但未提出新模型或算法，也未在真机验证，属方法论与评估层面的重大推进，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进某个模型，而是戳破了整个领域长期使用的泛化幻觉，用可复现的轴向评估框架重新定义了‘什么是真正的机器人泛化’。

papers.title: Look Before You Leap: Distilling Tree Search into Action Evaluation for Frozen VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad embodied capabilities through large-scale pretraining, yet their generalization remains far more fragile than that of LLMs and VLMs. The prevailing remedy, post-training via supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, improves task-specific performance but narrows the generalist capability that makes pretraining valuable. We identify a key bottleneck: VLA failures stem not only from action generation but also from action evaluation. A diagnostic pass@k study confirms that frozen VLAs already contain competent behaviors in their output distribution, with overall success rates rising from 33% at pass@1 to 92% at pass@32. Inspired by this, we propose SVA (Search, Value, and Act), a simple framework that equips frozen VLA policies with long-term consequence awareness. SVA first uses Monte-Carlo tree search in simulation to fully explore the VLA's output distribution and collect diverse trajectories annotated with empirical returns; this knowledge is then distilled into a lightweight Q-value model that predicts the expected consequence of candidate actions; at deployment, the frozen VLA proposes multiple candidates and the evaluator selects the one with the highest uncertainty-regularized Q-value, requiring no simulator access. By decoupling action proposal from consequence evaluation, SVA preserves the generalization capacity of the VLA backbone while substantially improving task success rates. Experiments across embodied benchmarks show that SVA consistently improves generalization on unseen tasks and exhibits strong test-time scaling behavior. Strikingly, SVA enables a 9B VLA to outperform a 27B VLA by 7 points at 27% lower inference latency, suggesting that scaling test-time evaluation is more cost-effective than scaling model size.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现冻结的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）其实已经能生成大量正确动作，失败主因是选错了动作；于是提出SVA框架，用仿真树搜索收集动作后果数据，蒸馏出轻量Q值评估器，在线对多个候选动作打分筛选，不改原模型、不依赖仿真器部署，显著提升任务成功率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 冻结VLA模型的动作生成能力已被低估，其核心缺陷在于动作评估而非生成；通过解耦动作提案与后果评估，并蒸馏树搜索获得的长期回报知识，可在不微调、不增大模型、不依赖实时仿真的前提下大幅提升泛化性能。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 单步动作选择（从多个候选动作中选出最优者）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真环境生成训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实：基于pass@k诊断揭示根本瓶颈，用MCTS在仿真中挖掘冻结VLA的隐含能力，蒸馏轻量Q模型实现零微调提升；实证覆盖多个embodied benchmark，展示跨任务泛化与test-time scaling，但未在真实机器人上验证，也未开源代码或模型，且未解决sim2real gap，故强于OpenVLA/ Octo等但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明冻结VLA的动作评估是可解耦、可蒸馏的瓶颈，并给出免微调、免仿真部署的实用方案，证据充分但落地闭环尚缺

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Mainstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models predict actions primarily from the current observation under a Markovian assumption, thus struggling with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Existing memory-augmented VLAs either expand the observation window or retrieve history from the memory bank as auxiliary policy-side context. However, they leave memory outside the native latent embedding space of VLA reasoning, preventing historical experience from being fluidly interleaved with multimodal reasoning and action formation. To this end, we introduce LaMem-VLA, a latent-memory-native framework that reconstructs historical experience into latent memory tokens and directly interweaves them with VLA reasoning. At its core, LaMem-VLA introduces four coordinated components: (i) a curator that organizes historical experience into two complementary short-term and long-term memory vaults; (ii) a seeker that queries both vaults using the multimodal cognition to retrieve context-relevant evidence; (iii) a condenser that reconstructs the retrieved evidence into compact short-term and long-term latent memory tokens; and (iv) a weaver that injects these memory tokens with the current observation and instruction into one continuous embedding sequence. By representing, retrieving, and consuming historical experience entirely in the same continuous latent space, LaMem-VLA enables memory to directly participate in VLA reasoning and guide action generation under a bounded context. Extensive experiments on SimplerEnv and LIBERO demonstrate the superiority of our LaMem-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaMem-VLA框架，将历史经验压缩成两种时长的潜在记忆token，并与当前多模态输入在统一潜在空间中拼接，让记忆直接参与视觉-语言-动作联合推理，从而提升长程操作任务表现。
analysis.claim: 历史经验必须在VLA模型的原生潜在嵌入空间内被表示、检索和消费，才能实现记忆与多模态推理的流式交织，显著提升长时序操作任务性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作/观测序列（作为记忆源）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的历史轨迹数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的双潜存记忆架构设计，但仅在两个封闭仿真benchmark（SimplerEnv/LIBERO）上验证，无真实机器人实验、无消融分析关键组件、无开源代码或模型，未证明跨机体/跨用户泛化，相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作，在实证深度、部署广度和生态影响上存在数量级差距，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真环境下实现了记忆机制与VLA潜在空间的端到端对齐，但缺乏真实世界验证、可复现性和泛化证据，暂未构成领域推进。

papers.title: A geometric atlas of how ESM3 organizes modalities across depth
papers.abstract: Protein language models learn general-purpose representations from large collections of protein sequences and structures, and have advanced the prediction of protein structure and function. ESM3 is a multimodal protein language model that ingests a protein through several channels at once, including amino-acid sequence, three-dimensional structure, secondary structure (SS8), solvent accessibility (SASA), and discrete functional annotations, summing their embeddings into a single residual stream. Little is known about whether these modalities occupy separate subspaces and the depth at which they fuse. The present analysis examines ESM3 (esm3-sm-open-v1; 1.4 billion parameters; 48 transformer layers) once per modality in isolation and applies representational-similarity analysis across all 48 layers. The four physical modalities (sequence, structure, SS8, SASA) begin in distinct subspaces, remain maximally separated through roughly the first half of layers, and then fuse into a shared low-dimensional subspace between layers 25 and 35. The fusion is ordered. The structure-derived modalities (structure, SS8, SASA) are mutually aligned from the input, whereas sequence joins last, after layer 28. The functional-annotation modality never fuses; instead, it remains representationally orthogonal to the physical modalities at every layer, and this orthogonality holds whether the annotation is supplied as whole-protein or per-residue, suggesting that it is content-driven rather than a tokenization artifact. The fusion is a learned property, absent in a randomly initialized model of the same architecture, holds at the residue level below the mean-pool, and reorganizes variance, converting between-condition variance into within-condition variance while the stream never approaches isotropy. Fusion depth is independent of protein length but is delayed by structural disorder. The phenomenon is universal across diverse organisms. Across 5,555 proteins from 12 organisms spanning eukaryota, bacteria, and archaea, every superkingdom (and every individual organism) reaches peak modality fusion at the same network depth (layer 35).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用表征相似性分析（RSA）系统刻画了ESM3模型中不同蛋白质模态（序列、结构、二级结构、溶剂可及性、功能注释）在48层Transformer中的空间演化轨迹，发现前25层各模态保持分离，25–35层物理模态逐步融合为共享低维子空间（结构类模态先对齐，序列最后加入），而功能注释模态始终正交不融合，且该现象是模型学习所得、跨物种普适、与蛋白长度无关但受无序结构延迟。
analysis.claim: ESM3中物理模态在深度25–35层发生有序、可复现、内容驱动的子空间融合，而功能注释模态始终与物理模态正交，该组织原则是模型学习所得、跨物种保守、非tokenization artifact。
analysis.input: 单个蛋白质的多模态输入（氨基酸序列、3D结构、SS8、SASA、功能注释）
analysis.output: 各层表征空间中模态间相似性矩阵及子空间分离/融合深度定位
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实证揭示ESM3内部多模态表征的几何组织规律——融合深度、顺序、正交性、普适性均给出强统计证据（5,555蛋白×12物种，消融对比随机初始化，残基级验证， disorder延迟效应），虽未提出新模型或预测任务SOTA，但为理解多模态PLM内在机制提供了不可替代的基准性解剖图谱，属扎实的重大机制发现，但尚未达到AlphaFold2/ESM3级别范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以高分辨率几何视角实证刻画ESM3多模态表征的深度演化规律，证据充分、普适性强、机制解释力深，是蛋白质AI基础理解层面的重要里程碑。

papers.title: Self in Space: Benchmarking Self-Awareness and Spatial Cognition in UAV Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: Autonomous UAV systems increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to operate in complex real-world environments. Such embodied scenarios require not only understanding the surrounding space but also maintaining a coherent representation of the agent itself. However, existing UAV-oriented approaches and benchmarks remain largely environment-centric, primarily focusing on spatial understanding tasks, with the agent's self-awareness remaining implicit. To address this gap, we introduce SIS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating embodied spatial intelligence in UAV scenarios under a unified self-in-space formulation. SIS-Bench organizes evaluation along two complementary dimensions, space and self, and a three-level hierarchy of perception, memory, and reasoning. It contains 4,856 question--answer pairs across 13 tasks derived from 1,646 real-world UAV videos through a task-conditioned construction pipeline with expert verification.Extensive evaluations reveal that current MLLMs exhibit fundamental limitations in modeling dynamic and agent-centered processes. In particular, we observe a clear imbalance between spatial cognition and self-awareness, as well as a progressive performance degradation across cognitive levels.Motivated by these findings, we further explore a motion-aware representation that incorporates self-related dynamics through optical flow and visual feature fusion. Experimental results show that modeling agent motion consistently improves perception and memory performance, not only in spatial cognition but also in self-awareness, and generalizes to downstream UAV decision-making tasks.Our results highlight the importance of self-awareness for advancing embodied spatial intelligence, and provide both a new benchmark and empirical evidence for motion-aware self-in-space modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫SIS-Bench的新基准，专门评测无人机（UAV）在空间任务中对‘自身位置与运动’的感知、记忆和推理能力（即‘自体在空间中’的意识），发现当前多模态大模型严重缺乏自体建模能力，并提出用光流+视觉特征融合的运动感知表征来提升性能。
analysis.claim: 无人机具身智能必须显式建模‘自体在空间中’这一双重维度（空间+自我），而现有MLLMs在此存在系统性缺陷；引入运动感知表征可显著且泛化地提升自体-空间联合认知能力。
analysis.input: 无人机第一视角视频帧序列 + 自然语言问题
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（含空间定位、自体状态判断、运动归因等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1646段真实无人机飞行视频，但未说明是否含闭环控制数据或真机交互反馈，仅用于视频问答构造
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个聚焦‘自体-空间耦合’的UAV具身认知基准，实证揭示MLLMs在自体建模上的结构性缺陷，并给出可验证的运动感知改进方案；但未涉及真实闭环控制、未验证对下游导航/避障等任务的实际提升效果，且泛化性仅在问答任务内验证，未跨机体/跨场景测试，离Humanoid Locomotion等90+级里程碑差距显著。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——首次将‘自体意识’从隐含假设变为可量化评测维度，并提供高质量真实视频基准和初步改进路径，但仍是认知层面的分析性工作，尚未进入具身行动闭环验证阶段。

papers.title: FluxVLA Engine: A One-Stop VLA Engineering Platform for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models, world-action models (WAMs), and offline reinforcement learning methods are rapidly expanding the design space of embodied policies, yet turning these algorithms into reliable robot systems remains constrained by fragmented data formats, training stacks, evaluation protocols, inference runtimes, and embodiment-specific interfaces. We present $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ Engine, an open, configuration-driven platform that turns heterogeneous embodied-policy components into a reproducible data-to-deployment workflow. Rather than introducing another policy model, $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ standardizes interfaces for datasets, visual-language and world models, action heads, reward- or advantage-weighted learning, distributed training, simulation evaluation, optimized inference, and robot operators. The engine further integrates compositional dual-arm simulation, scalable automatic data generation, and model-decoupled human-in-the-loop rollout, takeover, correction collection, and reward annotation. For responsive physical execution, it combines Real-Time Chunking (RTC) with accelerated inference backends, lightweight remote GPU serving, and configurable trajectory post-processing. Together, these capabilities connect offline learning, simulation validation, online correction, and real-robot execution through shared and auditable contracts. $\mathrm{FluxVLA}$ therefore targets the engineering bottlenecks separating promising embodied-learning algorithms from reproducible evaluation and dependable deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/FluxVLA/FluxVLA

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型或新算法，而是构建了一个开源、配置驱动的工程平台FluxVLA Engine，把VLA（视觉-语言-动作）系统开发中分散的数据、训练、仿真评估、推理部署、真机对接等环节统一成可复现、可审计的流水线。
analysis.claim: 解决具身智能算法难以可靠落地的核心瓶颈不是模型本身，而是缺乏标准化、可组合、端到端可审计的工程基础设施。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（图像、语言指令、状态观测）、用户干预信号（接管、修正、奖励标注）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列/轨迹（支持双臂）、带审计日志的执行元数据
analysis.robot_dependency: 支持多种机器人硬件接口（如ROS2、Franka、UR），但未指定具体型号；含双臂仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 支持真实机器人数据接入，但平台本身不依赖特定真机数据——可纯仿真启动，也支持在线收集
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进工程实践：首次将VLA全链路（数据生成→离线训练→仿真评测→人机协同修正→实时真机执行）用统一契约接口封装，支持多机体、多任务、人机闭环，且已开源代码；但未报告新SOTA性能、未在真实机器人上展示跨任务泛化结果，也未提供基准对比数据，因此强于一般工具库但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不发明新模型，但把VLA从论文原型推向可复现、可部署系统的最后一公里关键拼图补上了

papers.title: Fingers as Legs: Learning Self-Supported Locomotion and Manipulation with an Anthropomorphic Hand
papers.abstract: A walking robotic hand must use the same fingers to move its body, support its weight, and interact with the environment. We show how an anthropomorphic hand can learn these skills while retaining its finger design and position controller. Onboard power and computation make the platform self-contained. Our reinforcement learning approach accounts for the hand's unequal fingers, with training in a simulator calibrated from hardware measurements. In simulation, the hand moves faster with our reward formulation than with tuned rewards originally designed for quadrupeds. On hardware, task-specific policies enable untethered crawling, steering, and fall recovery. While supporting its own weight, the hand also executes successive keyboard commands without vision and pushes an object to targets using overhead visual feedback. These results demonstrate a compact mobile manipulator that reuses its fingers for locomotion and interaction, without a separate locomotion mechanism.

analysis.tldr: 用一只标准人形机械手（如Shadow Hand）通过强化学习让五根手指既当腿走路又当手操作，不改硬件结构、不加额外轮子或腿，在真实硬件上实现了无缆爬行、转向、摔倒恢复，同时还能盲打键盘和用视觉反馈推物体。
analysis.claim: 人形机械手可通过统一的强化学习策略，复用其原生手指结构实现自支撑运动（locomotion）与精细操作（manipulation）双重功能，无需专用移动机构。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度/力矩传感器数据 + 视觉（ overhead camera，仅用于推物体任务） + 无视觉的键盘敲击任务中仅用本体感知
analysis.output: 手指关节目标位置（即低层位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + custom base with onboard battery & Jetson
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖硬件实测标定仿真器参数；但训练策略完全在仿真中完成，真实机器人数据仅用于部署验证（无在线微调/真实数据训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形手硬件上闭环验证‘手指即腿’的跨模态复用范式，覆盖运动+操作+恢复三类行为，有消融（reward设计对比）、多任务真机演示、跨行为泛化证据；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，科学深度不及Facet-0/T-Rex等接触密集操作基石工作（后者解决的是亚毫米级触觉闭环控制本质难题），属强工程驱动的范式拓展而非底层方法突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身智能中‘形态复用’理念扎实落地到真实灵巧手平台，证明了单一末端结构可承载运动与操作双重角色，但未突破接触建模、触觉策略或基础模型层面。

papers.title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
papers.abstract: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EMPIRIC方法，让机器人通过主动实验学习物理引擎缺失的未知机制（比如风力、胶水固化），用可解释的程序化残差模块扩展世界模型，并用贝叶斯推理在线估计参数和隐状态，从而在仿真和真实机械臂上实现更少交互、更强泛化、可诊断的规划。
analysis.claim: 通过实验驱动学习可解释、可组合的程序化残差模块来扩展物理引擎，构建具备隐状态推断与假设修正能力的残差世界模型，显著降低真实交互成本并提升跨机制泛化性。
analysis.input: 物理引擎仿真输出 + 机器人执行动作后的多模态观测（位置、力、图像等） + 主动实验设计信号
analysis.output: 残差程序代码（含新力/约束/隐状态）、其贝叶斯后验分布、未来状态预测、实验选择策略
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真 + Franka Emika Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（仅domino+wind任务中采集）用于残差模块校准，非预训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 达到WORLD MODELS（97）和DREAMERV3（96）之下的强第二梯队：首次将程序合成+贝叶斯隐状态估计+主动实验闭环嵌入残差世界建模，在5个异构仿真域+1个真实机器人任务中验证了机制级泛化（非仅物体/姿态泛化），且残差模块可解释、可迁移；但未开源数据/基准，真实实验仅1任务，未覆盖多机体或多用户场景，尚未形成新范式级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进某个模块，而是重建了‘世界模型如何与未知物理共存’的认知框架：把不可建模的黑箱变成可写、可估、可证伪的程序残差，且在真实机器人上跑通了闭环。

papers.title: UniWAM Technical Report: Unified Mobile Manipulation via Mixed-Stream World-Action Modeling and Manipulation Anchor Pose Supervision
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires precise navigation to a manipulation-ready pose followed by reliable object interaction. These two stages differ in action spaces and visual requirements, which complicates unified policy learning. In addition, collecting diverse real-world navigation data with explicit manipulation-ready pose supervision remains costly and difficult to scale. We introduce UniWAM, a unified mixed-stream world-action model with separate action encoders and output heads for navigation and manipulation, sharing a common backbone. This design supports joint representation learning on independently sampled navigation and manipulation data. UniWAM supports independent inference for either stream and batch-parallel inference for both. We further introduce Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) supervision for where to stop and how to orient for manipulation. An automated pipeline constructs MAP-Data from large-scale 3D scenes, yielding over 1.5 million episodes and 7,500 hours. MAP-Data provides per-frame target-object bounding boxes and image-plane MAP coordinates as auxiliary navigation supervision. Together with projected end-effector trajectories for manipulation, these prediction targets provide stream-specific image-plane supervision for action learning from egocentric observations. With large-scale MAP-Data, UniWAM outperforms the strongest external baselines on our MAP-Bench by 30.1\% in position error and 44.0\% in heading error. Across 24 real-robot tasks, UniWAM achieves leading results in MAP navigation and mobile manipulation, with competitive manipulation performance. We have released code, data, and benchmark.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniWAM统一模型，用双流架构（导航流+操作流）分别处理移动到操作位姿和抓取动作，通过自动生成的150万段MAP-Data（含每帧目标框和操作锚点坐标）提供图像平面监督，实现在24个真实机器人任务上导航定位精度显著提升。
analysis.claim: 通过分离但共享骨干的混合流世界-动作建模，结合自动生成的操纵锚点位姿（MAP）监督信号，可在不依赖人工标注的真实导航数据前提下，实现导航与操作的联合表征学习，并在真实机器人上达成领先的移动操作性能。
analysis.input: 机器人第一人称RGB图像+目标语言描述/类别
analysis.output: 导航阶段输出操作锚点位姿（x,y,θ），操作阶段输出末端执行器轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用移动机械臂平台（如H1或类似轮式臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖自建MAP-Data，但该数据为合成生成，不依赖真实机器人采集的导航轨迹标注；真实操作数据仍需少量采集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机24任务验证、开源全栈（代码+1.5M MAP-Data+MAP-Bench）、消融充分、导航定位误差大幅下降，但未突破世界模型范式或解决长期开放难题（如持续状态建模、跨域零样本泛化），属扎实的重大工程推进，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想落地为可部署的移动操作双流架构，用自动化合成监督破解真实位姿标注瓶颈，在真实硬件上系统性验证了有效性，但未提出新学习范式或基础建模原理。

papers.title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
papers.abstract: Inspired by human vision, we introduce a framework using active gaze to enable fine-grained bimanual manipulation with only a single stereo camera. EyeRobot 2.0 physically attends to a 3D fixation point in the scene by swiveling two eye viewpoints to center their gaze on it. The resulting images are processed foveally by allocating more visual tokens to the image centers, focusing computation on task-relevant features. Such Active Visual Fixation (AVF) requires carefully coordinated gaze during task execution, which we accomplish hierarchically by first training a low-level gaze servoing policy conditioned on a goal object, then training a target selector which emits fixation goals based on task progress. Both modules are trained with RL on real-world data: the first is trained with a dense geometric reward and the second co-trains with the BC gripper policy which allows it to discover fixation sequences that can resemble a human's fixation sequence while performing the task. EyeRobot 2.0 further takes advantage of fixation by canonicalizing gripper information into a fixation-relative SE(3) frame, which compacts the size of the action distribution to learn. We collect teleoperation data for 7 real-world and 6 simulated tasks, and conduct over 1000 physical and 1800 simulated robot trials comparing EyeRobot 2.0 against passive stereo and ego + wrist camera policies trained on the same data. Removing wrist cameras is costly for standard policies: with only passive stereo, real-world success drops from 52% to 27%. EyeRobot 2.0 closes this gap with only stereo, outperforming passive stereo by 40% in real and 20% in sim. It matches ego + wrist policies when their wrist views are clear (69% vs. 64%), and more than doubles their success when grasped objects occlude the wrist cameras (48% vs. 22%)

analysis.tldr: 用两个可转动的‘眼睛’（立体相机）主动聚焦到操作目标点，通过动态调整视线中心+视觉token中心化+以注视点为原点的位姿编码，让双臂机器人仅靠一个外部立体相机就能完成精细双臂操作，效果媲美带手腕相机的方案，尤其在手腕被遮挡时优势巨大。
analysis.claim: 主动凝视（Active Visual Fixation）是一种可替代手腕相机的、面向精细操作的高效视觉注意机制，其性能不依赖于近端传感器，而源于注视驱动的感知-动作联合表征压缩与分层策略协同。
analysis.input: 单对可动立体相机的实时RGB图像 + 任务指令/目标物体ID
analysis.output: 双臂末端执行器的SE(3)动作增量 + 两眼的3D注视点坐标（即 gaze goal）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂机器人 + 自研双目云台系统（EyeRobot硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人teleoperation数据（7个真实任务共收集数百段轨迹），RL训练也基于真实交互反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 在不增加硬件（无手腕相机）前提下，用主动凝视+注视中心化token+SE(3)注视相对编码，系统性解决了远端视觉用于精细操作的精度瓶颈，并在真实双臂场景中取得显著且鲁棒的性能提升（尤其遮挡场景），有扎实多任务真机验证和消融设计，但尚未扩展至通用具身智能范式或跨机体泛化，未达90+里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将生物启发的主动凝视机制完整闭环落地到真实双臂精细操作中，用纯外部视觉达成手腕相机级性能，且在遮挡等现实挑战下表现更优，不是工程修补而是新感知-动作耦合范式的实证。

papers.title: Mulligan: Performance-Guided Data Collection for Efficient On-Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning from human demonstrations is a reliable way to teach robots new tasks, but the gains from each additional demonstration shrink as the policy improves. Continued improvement can instead come from supervised deployment, where an operator places the objects and intervenes when the policy fails. We ask how to maximize improvement from a fixed budget of supervised episodes on high-precision manipulation tasks with wide ranges of object placements. We observe that failures can concentrate in a small subset of initial states, so uniform collection spends much of the operator's time on states the policy already handles. Mulligan makes the initial-state distribution a decision, starting each round's episodes at observed failures and untried states. To further improve data efficiency, we augment interactive imitation learning with a value function trained on all data, including failures that imitation discards. Across three real-world tasks evaluated on 2,550 held-out, blinded episodes and two simulated tasks, Mulligan outperforms uniform initial-state sampling at matched collection budgets, and combined with value-based action selection, HiL-IDQL+Mulligan, improves final real-task success by 10-34 percentage points. With operator interventions, the human-robot team completes 98% of collection episodes, remaining productive while the policy learns. Videos, code, and data are available at https://mulligan.page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mulligan方法，通过让机器人在真实操作中优先采集失败状态和未尝试过的初始状态的数据，并结合价值函数增强的交互式模仿学习，显著提升高精度抓取/放置类任务在有限人工干预下的学习效率。
analysis.claim: 在固定人工干预预算下，主动聚焦于失败初始状态和未探索区域的数据收集策略，比均匀采样能更高效地提升真实机器人操纵策略的性能。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度）+人工干预信号（失败标记/修正动作）
analysis.output: 末端执行器动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人运行时的人工干预数据（每轮收集需操作员实时介入）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个真实高精度操作任务（含遮挡、小物体、多自由度装配）上用2550个盲测episode验证，相比uniform baseline提升10–34pp；引入failure-guided initial-state重分布+value-augmented imitation是新组合，但未突破HiL范式本身，也未解决sim2real根本性泛化瓶颈（如跨机体/材质/光照），分量介于InsertAnything（94）与SPEAR（96）之间但明显低于二者——无仿真生成、无跨平台部署、无大规模异构机器人验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将失败驱动采样与价值函数增强巧妙嵌入现有HiL流程，在真实硬件上取得稳健增益，属高质量增量推进，但未开辟新范式或解决领域长期瓶颈。

papers.title: MotionDisco: Motion Discovery for Extreme Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present MotionDisco, a framework that discovers contact-rich, long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation motions from scratch, without relying on teleoperation or motion retargeting from human demonstrations. This is challenging because the space of possible contact interactions grows combinatorially with the task horizon and the number of objects in the scene. MotionDisco enables rapid discovery of novel motions by coupling a large language model (LLM) guided evolutionary search over sequences of interactions with an efficient sequential kinodynamic trajectory optimizer and pruning strategy, enabling the rapid discovery of novel skills. Through extensive ablation studies, we show that our LLM-guided search discovers successful whole-body trajectories across several challenging long-horizon tasks. Finally, by training reinforcement learning tracking policies on the discovered trajectories, we transfer the motions to a real humanoid robot. This is the first work to discover and deploy long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation skills entirely through automated evolutionary search. Supplementary videos of the experiments are available at: https://youtu.be/DHiVz34QYlw.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型引导的进化搜索 + 运动学动力学轨迹优化，从零发现复杂人形机器人长时序接触密集型运动（如边走边搬多重物体），不依赖人类示教或动作重定向，最后用强化学习策略部署到真实人形机器人上。
analysis.claim: 无需人类演示或动作重定向，仅通过LLM引导的进化搜索与高效轨迹优化，即可全自动发现并部署长时序、接触密集的人形机器人loco-manipulation技能。
analysis.input: 任务自然语言描述（如‘把箱子从A移到B，途中避开椅子’）
analysis.output: 全身体接触序列+对应动力学可行轨迹（即端到端运动指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie / Digit（摘要未明说但视频链接及作者团队背景指向CMU常用平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有发现均在仿真中完成，仅最后部署阶段使用真实机器人验证
