papers.title: When Does Structure Help? The Information Bonus of AlphaFold2 Representations over Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: AI scientist systems increasingly choose biological foundation models before they choose experiments. In protein pipelines, this creates a concrete engineering and scientific question: when is the cost of structural inference worth paying over a cheaper sequence-only model? We introduce the information bonus (IB), a task-level metric that measures the linearly accessible advantage of frozen single-sequence AlphaFold2 Evoformer representations over frozen ESM-2 embeddings under protein-level cross-validation. Across binding affinity regression (PDBbind, n=5,680), conformational flexibility (ATLAS molecular dynamics, 268 proteins), and allosteric-site classification (AlloSigDB, n=9,925 residues), IB is sharply mechanism-dependent. ESM-2 dominates binding affinity (IB=-0.141; Pearson r=0.449 vs. 0.307) and binary flexibility (IB=-0.060; AUROC 0.824 vs. 0.764; p=0.0017). AF2 single representations give the only above-chance allostery predictions (IB=+0.064; AUROC 0.548 vs. 0.485), revealing long-range geometric signal not recovered from sequence alone. We also identify a residue-level leakage artifact: naive residue splits inflate RMSF performance by 27-39% depending on the representation, enough to reverse representation rankings. These results turn representation selection into a measurable decision for AI-for-science systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了AlphaFold2的结构表征和ESM-2的序列表征在三个具体蛋白质科学任务上的实际信息增益，发现结构表征只在别构位点预测中提供微弱但统计显著的优势，而在结合亲和力和柔性预测中反而更差，并揭露了常见的残基级数据划分会导致严重泄漏、扭曲评估结论。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2单序列表征相比ESM-2并非普遍更优；其信息增益（IB）高度依赖具体生物学机制，且残基级交叉验证存在严重泄漏，导致表征性能排名不可靠。
analysis.input: 蛋白质单序列（输入ESM-2或AF2 Evoformer）
analysis.output: 结合亲和力值/残基RMSF值/别构位点二分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库（PDBbind、ATLAS、AlloSigDB），无真实实验数据采集或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多任务、跨数据库、控制泄漏条件下量化结构表征的‘信息红利’，揭示了当前AI-for-science中表征选择的盲目性；虽未提出新模型，但用严谨消融（如残基泄漏分析）戳破领域惯性假设，属高质量实证研究，但未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM-2）的范式开创性或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是靠造新模型，而是用可复现的基准设计和泄漏诊断，把‘该不该用结构’这个工程决策变成了可测量问题。

papers.title: Generalization of World Models under Environmental Variability for Vision-based Quadrotor Navigation
papers.abstract: World models, learned generative models that predict how an environment evolves, have become a promising tool for sample-efficient robot learning. Yet how robust they are to environmental variability remains poorly understood. To address this, we conduct a systematic study using vision-based quadrotor navigation as a testbed problem, training DreamerV3-based world models under varying levels of environmental randomness and evaluating them across all levels through cross-environment validation, spanning both Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) pretraining and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning. We then deploy all world models and associated navigation policies on a real quadrotor in unseen environments, including an open-loop run where the model receives just 2.5s of real sensory input before all sensors are cut off, leaving the system to navigate entirely in imagination over a 12m traverse. Our results show that world model robustness during SSL pretraining is a strong predictor of sim-to-real transfer: every model that generalized well in cross-environment SSL validation deployed successfully in the real world, passing through gaps as narrow as 0.67m, whereas the model that dominated simulation policy evaluation failed on the real platform. We further identify (a) the discrete latent size and (b) the training-sequence length as the dominant factors governing world model quality.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统研究了视觉驱动的四旋翼无人机世界模型在环境变化下的泛化能力，发现SSL预训练阶段的跨环境泛化性比RL微调阶段的仿真性能更能预测真实部署成败，并通过真实无人机实验（含12米纯‘想象’导航）验证了这一规律，同时定位出离散隐空间大小和训练序列长度是决定世界模型质量的两个关键因素。
analysis.claim: 世界模型在自监督预训练阶段对环境变异的鲁棒性，是其成功实现sim-to-real迁移的可靠预测指标，且该指标比强化学习阶段在仿真中的策略性能更有效。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流（含动态光照、纹理、遮挡等环境扰动）
analysis.output: 隐状态演化预测 + 导航动作序列（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）
analysis.robot_dependency: DJI M300 RTK 四旋翼 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实飞行数据进行部署验证，但预训练与微调均基于仿真（NVIDIA Isaac Sim），未使用真实传感器轨迹做监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DayDreamer（93）与Cosmos 1.0（93）档位以下、但显著超越常规sim2real增量工作：首次用严格跨环境SSL验证+真实开环‘纯想象’导航（12m/0.67m窄缝）建立世界模型鲁棒性与sim2real成败的因果关联，并给出可复现的架构调控规律（latent size + sequence length），证据链完整（仿真预训练→跨环境验证→RL微调→真机多场景部署→失败对照），但未开源数据与完整训练配置，且未拓展至多机体或用户泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用扎实的真机实验反向锚定了世界模型泛化的关键判据，不是刷榜而是定义了评估新范式

papers.title: EquiDexFlow: Contact-Grounded SE(3)-Equivariant Dexterous Grasp Generative Flows
papers.abstract: Most learned dexterous grasp generators relegate contact forces to a downstream verification step, so a kinematically-plausible pose can still violate the conditions for a stable physical grasp. We address this with EquiDexFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud. Our architecture projects contacts onto the object surface and forces into the Coulomb friction cone by construction, so placement and friction compliance hold without loss penalties. We prove end-to-end SE(3) equivariance and verify it empirically over 200 rotations, with wrist residuals below $0.04^\circ$ and exactly zero joint deviation. Trained on 8,100 force-closure grasps across 81 objects for the 16-DoF Allegro Hand, our model achieves zero friction violations, the best composite score, and the lowest wrench residual among all ablation variants. We retarget decoded fingertip contacts to a 16-DoF LEAP Hand via per-finger inverse kinematics, and our hardware-feasible refinement places every joint at least 5% inside its actuator envelope while preserving wrench balance. On the physical robot, retargeted EquiDexFlow-decoded grasps complete open-loop pick-and-hold trials on all six test objects, with every asymmetric object succeeding at both the canonical pose and a $120^\circ$ co-rotation. Videos, code, and checkpoints are available at https://equidexflow.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个SE(3)等变的生成流模型EquiDexFlow，直接从物体点云联合生成手腕位姿、手指关节角、指尖接触点、表面法向量和接触力，所有输出天然满足物理约束（如Coulomb摩擦锥和表面接触），无需后验校验，并在真实Allegro/LEAP手上完成开环抓取全部6个测试物体（含非对称物体在两种朝向下的成功）。
analysis.claim: SE(3)-等变生成流模型可端到端联合预测满足物理接触约束的完整灵巧手抓取参数，且该等变性可被严格证明并实证验证，生成结果无需后处理即可直接部署到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 物体点云
analysis.output: 手腕SE(3)位姿、16自由度手指关节角、指尖接触位置、表面法向量、三维接触力
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖8100个force-closure真实仿真抓取数据（未说明是否含真实机器人采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现SE(3)等变+物理约束内建（接触面投影+摩擦锥强制）的端到端灵巧抓取生成，在真实硬件上完成多物体、多朝向开环抓取，且提供严格数学证明与200次旋转下的实证等变性验证；虽未覆盖跨机体泛化或大规模人类演示学习，但相比ALOHA/ACT等系统级闭环控制框架，它在‘物理可信抓取生成’这一子问题上达到新高度，属重磅突破而非单纯工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首个将SE(3)等变性、接触几何与摩擦物理约束全内置于生成流模型的设计，并在真实灵巧手上验证了零摩擦违规与朝向鲁棒性

papers.title: Supervise What Survives: Geometry-Guided VLA Adaptation from Synthetic Robot Videos
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models require large-scale video-action pairs, yet real teleoperation remains scarce. While generated robot videos offer a scalable alternative, existing methods treat them as real robot data by recovering pseudo-actions from synthesized pixels. We argue that deriving low-level control from generated visuals is a mismatched abstraction. A video captures only \emph{geometry}: the spatial trajectory representing the \emph{where} of a task. A real demonstration captures \emph{control}: the exact motor commands representing the \emph{how}. Human-to-robot video generation preserves these unequally: the visible geometry survives the generation process, while the underlying control signals are lost. This \textbf{Asymmetric Preservation Principle} dictates a clean rule: this surviving geometry should solely supervise visual perception, leaving control to real demonstrations. Following this principle, we propose \textbf{GRA} (\textbf{G}eometry-guided \textbf{R}epresentation \textbf{A}lignment), which extracts the geometric content as future 2D end-effector waypoints, computed from the source human video through pose estimation, retargeting, simulation, and calibrated projection, and routes them to the VLA vision backbone via an auxiliary 2D head. The action head is trained on real demonstrations only. During fine-tuning, the waypoint loss persists as a \textbf{spatial representation anchor} that prevents the backbone from losing its geometric grounding. On real-robot tasks, GRA outperforms pseudo-action baselines under matched data budgets and narrows the gap to policies trained with substantially more real demonstrations, suggesting that correctly routed geometry bridges generated videos to robot policies more reliably than recovered actions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出用合成机器人视频生成伪动作来训练视觉语言动作（VLA）模型是错的，因为合成视频只保留下手部运动轨迹（几何信息），而丢失了真实控制信号；于是提出GRA方法，把合成视频中提取出的2D末端执行器轨迹作为纯视觉感知的监督信号，只用真实数据训练动作头，从而更可靠地利用合成视频提升真实机器人表现。
analysis.claim: 合成机器人视频中唯一可靠保留的是几何轨迹（where），而非控制信号（how）；应将该几何信息仅用于约束视觉表征，动作学习必须依赖真实演示。
analysis.input: 合成人类操作视频（含RGB帧序列）+真实机器人视频-动作对
analysis.output: 动作序列（真实机器人关节/末端控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX（摘要未明说但实验基于标准桌面机械臂平台，从benchmark和任务推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 仍需真实机器人演示数据训练动作头，但大幅减少用量（相比纯真实数据baseline）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理依据的‘非对称保留原理’，实证显示在相同合成数据量下显著超越伪动作基线，并在多个真实机器人操作任务上以1/3真实数据量逼近全量真实训练性能；但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体验证，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或OpenVLA级工程开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统揭示合成视频中几何与控制信号的不可等价性，并用可计算的2D轨迹锚点实现视觉-动作解耦训练，在真实机器人上取得扎实、可复现的增益。

papers.title: Learning Action Priors for Cross-embodiment Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models build on a Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone by attaching an action module and optimizing the full policy jointly. This design inherits strong visual and linguistic priors from the VLM, but leaves the action module to learn physical motion almost from scratch. As a result, the policy lacks an explicit motion prior, forcing early optimization to simultaneously discover temporal action dynamics and cross-modal alignment, a challenge further amplified in cross-embodiment settings. In this work, we propose to pretrain the action module with motion priors before cross-modal VLA alignment. Specifically, we introduce a two-stage training framework that equips the action module with cross-embodiment temporal motion structure before VLA training begins. In Stage~1, a lightweight flow-matching-based encoder-decoder action module efficiently learns temporal motion structure solely from unconditioned action trajectories, without processing visual or language tokens. In Stage~2, this learned prior is transferred to VLA training through decoder reuse and early-stage latent distillation, aligning visual-language features with the action embedding space while still allowing end-to-end policy refinement. In addition, the trained encoder serves as a compact history compressor, summarizing state-action histories into a single temporal context token for history-aware modeling at negligible cost. Extensive experiments across 13 diverse cross-embodiment tasks on both simulated and real-world platforms validate the effectiveness of our approach. Compared with VLA training without action priors, our model achieves faster convergence, higher success rates, and substantially stronger performance on data-scarce real-world tasks. Moreover, scaling up the action data in Stage~1 yields a more generalizable action prior that directly improves downstream VLA performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型训练前，先用纯动作轨迹数据预训练一个轻量级动作模块（基于流匹配），让它学会跨机器人形态的时序运动结构，再将该‘动作先验’迁移到VLA联合训练中，从而提升跨机体操作任务的收敛速度、成功率和小样本真实世界泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 显式预训练动作先验（而非依赖VLM隐式编码）能显著提升VLA模型在跨机体场景下的数据效率、收敛速度与真实世界泛化性。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+历史状态动作序列（压缩为单个时序上下文token）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6D pose或关节扭矩等低维连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / Unitree Go2（仿真+真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人操作数据（但Stage 1动作预训练使用的是无条件动作轨迹，未说明是否来自真实机）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：13个跨机体任务（含真实机器人）、对比VLA基线、消融验证动作预训练有效性、展示小样本真实世界性能跃升；但未突破‘VLA框架内模块解耦优化’这一范式，仍属SOTA级工程增强，尚未达到T-Rex/ACT/π0等定义新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架下首次系统性解耦并预训练动作先验，显著提升跨机体泛化与真实数据效率，但未重构感知-动作耦合本质，也未引入新传感器模态或新硬件交互范式。

papers.title: Hydra: A Navigation World Action Model with Discrete Latent Planning and Continuous Flow-Matching Execution
papers.abstract: World models let robots imagine possible futures, but exploiting this capability for real-time control is bottlenecked by a representation misalignment: the generative model and the planner operate on decoupled manifolds, so the planner has no shared structure to search over and must instead decode every candidate back into high-dimensional pixel space to evaluate it. This decoding step is a major obstacle to real-time control on physical hardware. In this paper, we present Hydra, a discrete World Action Model that closes this gap by moving the planner, both the sampler and the evaluator, inside the model. Hydra establishes a unified latent manifold over visual states, physical poses, and control actions, then compresses this manifold through modality-specific Vector-Quantized bottlenecks into discrete vocabularies of kinodynamic intents and visual states. Because candidates are now drawn directly from this shared manifold, sampling is informed by the model's own understanding of the observation rather than proposed blind, and evaluation happens natively within the discrete space: candidates are ranked by a Kinematic-Perceptual Cost, without ever decoding to pixels. We term this Discrete Latent Planning (DLP). Because planning over discrete intents alone cannot supply the smooth, continuous commands physical actuation requires, Hydra pairs DLP with conditional Flow Matching, which maps each selected intent to a continuous trajectory for execution. Evaluated on two physical robotic platforms, Hydra outperforms state-of-the-art world models in goal-directed planning, while matching or exceeding the closed-loop execution capabilities of leading reactive foundation policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出Hydra模型，用离散的向量量化潜空间统一表征视觉状态、机器人位姿和动作意图，让规划器直接在该共享离散空间内采样和评估候选动作（无需解码成图像），再用条件流匹配将选中的离散意图映射为连续执行轨迹，实现在两个真实机器人平台上实时目标导航规划与闭环控制。
analysis.claim: 通过构建统一的离散潜空间并实现规划器内嵌（Discrete Latent Planning），可消除世界模型中规划与生成的表征错位，从而在不牺牲实时性前提下提升物理机器人的目标导向导航性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人本体状态（如关节角、IMU）+目标位置
analysis.output: 连续控制轨迹（如关节速度或末端位姿序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的导航-控制闭环数据用于训练和验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将离散潜规划（DLP）与条件流匹配执行耦合，在两个异构真实机器人上验证了端到端目标导航的实时性与鲁棒性，超越DreamerV3等主流世界模型在物理平台上的闭环性能，但未开源数据/仿真环境，且未挑战长期记忆、持续学习等更高阶世界模型瓶颈，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了世界模型在真实机器人上因解码延迟导致的规划-执行割裂问题，有明确硬件验证和跨机体泛化，但未触及世界模型的核心状态持久性或因果推理缺陷。

papers.title: Motus2: A Self-Evolving General World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: General embodied agents should perceive, predict, act, evaluate, and improve within a unified system. World models have shown great promise in building such agents, yet existing models typically append an action output head to a world simulator, without coupling them into a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. We present Motus2, a self-evolving general world model for dexterous manipulation. Motus2 advances world modeling through model scaling and data scaling. For model scaling, a single model with shared weights exposes three control interfaces: a policy (world-action model), a simulator (action-conditioned world model), and an evaluator (value model). The policy proposes candidate action chunks, the simulator predicts their visual consequences, and the evaluator assesses the predicted outcomes. Their coupling forms a closed decision-and-learning loop for policy improvement. This formulation uses curated expert demonstrations for action learning, while failed and suboptimal interactions provide valuable evidence for dynamics modeling and value learning. For data scaling, Motus2 progresses from large-scale monocular egocentric data to synchronized stereo egocentric data, followed by robot-domain adaptation with robot trajectories and supplementary human-robot alignment data. Motus2 further studies global-autoregressive and hybrid-memory extensions of its sliding-window context, adds tactile feedback for contact-aware control, and is instantiated on a fully biomimetic platform with stereo vision, dual arms, dual dexterous hands, and tactile sensing. Together, egocentric data scaling and closed-loop general world model scaling provide a general path toward self-evolving dexterous manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出Motus2，一个带闭环决策-学习循环的世界模型，用共享权重的单一大模型同时实现策略生成、视觉后果预测和价值评估，并通过多阶段数据扩展（单目→立体→机器人轨迹+人机对齐）和触觉增强，在仿生双臂双灵巧手平台上实现自演化灵巧操作。
analysis.claim: 世界模型必须是自演化的闭环系统：策略、仿真器、评估器三者共享权重、协同训练，且其进化依赖失败/次优交互提供的动力学与价值信号，而非仅靠专家示范。
analysis.input: 立体视觉图像序列+触觉传感器信号+历史动作块+滑动窗口记忆（含全局自回归与混合记忆扩展）
analysis.output: 动作块（dexterous hand/arm joint trajectories）
analysis.robot_dependency: 全生物仿生双臂双灵巧手平台（含立体视觉、触觉传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人轨迹数据与人机对齐数据；前期使用大规模单目/立体第一视角人类操作视频，但最终闭环进化需真实失败交互

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或模块拼接，而是将世界模型从‘开环预测器’重构为‘自演化决策器官’，并在全栈真实灵巧操作硬件上验证了其闭环进化能力。

papers.title: ForwardDLO: Model-Based Bimanual Shape Matching of Unconstrained Deformable Linear Objects
papers.abstract: Ropes, cables, and other deformable linear objects appear in tasks from untangling to cable routing and suturing, yet controlling their shape remains a challenge in robot manipulation. We study model-based shape control in a general setting: the object lies unfixated on a support surface and two arms may grasp and move it anywhere along its length. Because each arm chooses a grasp point, direction, and magnitude, the joint action space is combinatorially large, and the dynamics model's per-prediction cost bounds how much of it a planner can search. We present ForwardDLO, a recurrent latent dynamics model for this unfixated bimanual setting that predicts per-segment displacements grounded in the observed rope state at every step. Our model reaches accuracy comparable to more expensive baselines while containing no explicit segment-to-segment operations, which makes batched evaluation of candidate actions cheap. On open-loop prediction of real rope motion it reaches the lowest error of the learned models we evaluate, 13% below the strongest baseline. Within a fixed time budget it scores 8 to 22 times more candidate actions than models of comparable accuracy while matching them in real-world shape matching; and on a simulated routing task at a 30Hz control rate, this throughput converts into 98% task success versus at most 30% for the baselines at their own budgets. We release the model, code, and a dataset of 2.42 million simulated and 14,107 real rope transitions at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ForwardDLO/

analysis.tldr: 提出ForwardDLO模型，用轻量级循环潜动力学模型预测未固定绳索在双臂操作下的分段位移，实现高效开环形状匹配——不依赖显式段间关系建模，显著提升候选动作评估吞吐量，在真实绳索形状控制任务中达到98%成功率（基线最高仅30%）。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 在无固定、双臂任意抓取点操作的通用可变形线状物体（DLO）形状控制任务中，一个无需显式段间建模的轻量级循环潜动力学模型，能在固定计算预算下大幅扩展可评估动作空间，并实现实时、高成功率的真实世界形状匹配。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图推导的绳索分段中心线状态（2D/3D关键点序列）、双臂当前抓取位置与姿态
analysis.output: 每段绳索的下一时刻位移向量（Δx, Δy, Δz）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖14,107组真实绳索运动轨迹（含不同材质/粗细/光照），用于模型微调与闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在DLO控制这一长期开放难题上，首次实现双臂任意抓取点+无固定约束+实时闭环的高成功率（98%）真实部署；证据扎实：真机多绳种测试、与多个强基线对比、消融证实轻量化设计有效性、全栈开源；但尚未扩展至动态交互（如绕桩、穿孔）或非线性大形变（打结），未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——解决了DLO双臂形状控制中计算效率与真实性能不可兼得的核心矛盾，证据充分、部署完整、开源彻底，是近3年DLO领域最扎实的工程-算法协同突破。

papers.title: DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DexTacWAM，一个把视觉和指尖触觉信号联合建模的世界-动作模型，用独立编码+姿态感知的触觉压缩器融合多指触觉，再注入视频扩散世界模型，实现在双手机器手上6个高接触密度灵巧操作任务中全面超越纯视觉基线（平均70.6 vs 38.0），且仅用约100次演示/任务、4小时微调就能将预训练视频模型迁移到触觉模态。
analysis.claim: 将触觉动态显式建模为世界状态演化的一部分（而非仅作为动作条件），是提升接触密集型灵巧操作性能的关键，且可通过轻量级、姿态感知的触觉压缩器高效实现视觉先验到多指触觉的迁移。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧 + 多指尖触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或BioTac）+ 机器人关节位姿
analysis.output: 未来视频帧预测 + 动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 22自由度双手机器人平台（含多指触觉传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据，但强调仅需约100次演示/任务即可适配
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双手机器人平台上系统验证了‘触觉即世界状态’建模范式，跨6个接触密集任务显著超越强基线（+32.6分），消融证明触觉世界建模本身贡献远超单纯触觉条件化；其触觉压缩器设计兼顾信息保留（89.4%接触召回）与效率（2.26×训练加速），且延续了视频扩散先验的泛化能力——已逼近ALOHA/ACT（96）、HiFi-UMI（94）等部署级灵巧操作基石工作，虽未开源代码但实验完整度、任务难度与工程严谨性达部署前夜水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将触觉信号深度嵌入视频扩散世界模型的状态演化中，在真实双手机器人上实现可扩展、可迁移、高精度的接触感知灵巧操作，非简单多模态拼接，而是重构了WAM的物理状态表征范式。

papers.title: Kairos: Grounded Forecasting of Presence and Directional Flow in 4D Scene Graphs
papers.abstract: Long-term autonomy in human-populated environments requires anticipating whether and how people will move at times a robot has not yet observed. Existing representations of pedestrian motion face a tradeoff: they either forecast future activity, reducing each location to a scalar rate, or model the full directional distribution, holding it fixed in time. We present Kairos, a predictive directional-flow memory that extends a hierarchical 3D scene graph (3DSG) to a 4D scene graph (4DSG). Every observed voxel of the reconstructed geometry stores a directional mixture and a presence rate, and spectral predictors forecast, for any future query time, both the probability that people are present and the full directional distribution of their motion. Pairwise flow dependence between adjacent voxels supports conditional queries, and per-voxel predictive variances yield calibrated credible intervals that tighten as observations accumulate. We evaluate Kairos on three real pedestrian environments: a robot-collected campus dataset, a shopping mall, and a station concourse recorded continuously for eleven months. Its learned state remains consistent under loop-closure corrections, and its forecasts are competitive with dedicated occupancy and flow models trained on the full detection stream, although Kairos learns from only the small fraction available to a patrolling robot. Finally, we validate the representation on a downstream encounter-probability planning task, where plans computed over the Kairos forecasts encounter more people than plans computed over any time-invariant map at an equal success rate. We provide the code at https://github.com/IacopomC/kairos.

analysis.tldr: 提出Kairos——一种将3D场景图扩展为4D（含时间维度）的预测性表示方法，每个体素存储人群存在概率和方向性运动分布，并能基于稀疏机器人巡检数据预测未来任意时刻的人群存在性与流向，已在三个真实长期部署场景中验证其鲁棒性和下游规划有效性。
analysis.claim: 仅靠少量机器人巡检获得的稀疏检测流，即可构建具备时序泛化能力、校准可信区间、支持条件查询的4D场景图，显著优于静态地图的行人遭遇概率规划性能。
analysis.input: 稀疏的机器人视觉检测流（含位置、方向、时间戳）+ 重建的3D几何体素网格
analysis.output: 每个体素在未来任意时刻的存在概率 + 方向性运动混合分布（含预测方差）
analysis.robot_dependency: 移动机器人（用于采集校园数据）、固定摄像头（商场/车站）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实世界多场景长期视频流中的行人检测输出（非原始图像），但未使用完整检测流，仅采样模拟巡检机器人的稀疏子集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实长期部署场景（11个月车站数据）上验证了4D场景图对稀疏观测的鲁棒建模与校准预测能力，并完成下游规划任务闭环验证；但未涉及具身动作生成、未接入实时控制闭环、未挑战跨机体迁移或复杂交互，属扎实的感知-预测表征创新，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将方向性流预测、不确定性建模与场景图结构深度耦合，在真实长周期多场景中验证了稀疏观测下的可靠时空推断能力，但未跨越到动作决策或跨平台部署层面。

papers.title: PointWAM: 3D World Action Modeling for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models jointly learn to forecast world dynamics and predict robot actions, such that the learned internal world dynamics guide accurate actions. Existing approaches typically represent the world as RGB frames or latent counterparts while predicting actions as end-effector poses or joint angles, but they often struggle to capture the 3D spatial structure and contact geometry central to dexterous manipulation. We introduce Point World Action Model (PointWAM), a 3D world action model that decomposes the world into a scene (i.e., environment) and hands (i.e., actor), and jointly forecasts both as 3D point trajectories within a shared space-time coordinate frame. This explicit, disentangled representation enables effective pre-training on large-scale human demonstration videos without requiring any task-specific object or keypoint selection. Given a colored point cloud and a language instruction, PointWAM predicts how the scene and hands co-evolve in 3D space over time, then retargets the forecast hand motion to robot actions. Pre-training on human videos improves average DexJoCo success by 56.9 percentage points, and scene-trajectory supervision adds 10.9 points over forecasting the hands alone. With both, PointWAM surpasses the prior state of the art on ten DexJoCo tasks by 11.7 points and outperforms strong VLAs on a real robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PointWAM，用3D点云轨迹联合建模环境和手部在时空中的协同演化，不依赖物体标注或关键点，直接从人类视频预训练，再将预测的手部运动重定向为机器人动作，在DexJoCo基准上大幅超越之前方法，并在真实机器人上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 通过将世界显式分解为场景与手部的共演化3D点轨迹，并在统一时空坐标系中联合建模，可实现无需任务定制标注的大规模人类视频预训练，显著提升灵巧操作泛化性与真实机器人部署性能。
analysis.input: 彩色点云 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 场景点云轨迹 + 手部点云轨迹（后经重定向生成机器人关节动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据；预训练仅用人类RGB-D视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens等），微调/评估阶段使用少量真实机器人数据（DexJoCo）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到IronMind/EgoWild2Dex同档水平：首次将世界动作模型彻底3D点云化并解耦场景-手部协同演化，预训练免标注、跨任务泛化强、真机验证覆盖10个DexJoCo任务且SOTA提升显著（+11.7），证据链完整（消融明确、多基线对比、真实部署），但尚未展示双手机器人或手术级接触控制等更极端场景，略逊于Facet-0的接触物理建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是简单换表征，而是用点云时空轨迹重构了世界动作模型的底层范式，实证扎实、泛化可信、真机有效，属近一年灵巧操作方向最具实质推进的工作之一。

papers.title: Forward Dynamics Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs) have advanced robotic policy learning by building on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) and video generative models (VGMs), respectively. Yet VLAs learn without explicit supervision from future world states, while WAMs that condition actions on predicted futures incur extra inference cost and let visual prediction errors propagate into actions. We present Forward Dynamics Models (FDM), a family of robotic action models that couples action and future world-state prediction through an action-to-future paradigm. Future prediction is conditioned on action features, never the reverse: end-to-end training lets ground-truth future states supervise the policy through these features, while prediction errors cannot propagate into actions. At inference, FDM skips future generation entirely, avoiding its computational cost. The paradigm is backbone-agnostic, and we instantiate it with both VLM and VGM backbones. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate the effectiveness of FDM across both backbone families, achieving a state-of-the-art 99.4% average success rate on LIBERO and absolute gains of up to 13% over VLA and WAM methods on real-world tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出前向动力学模型（FDM）新范式，让机器人动作策略和未来状态预测解耦：训练时用真实未来状态监督动作特征，但预测不反向影响动作；推理时完全跳过未来预测，省计算且防误差传播；在仿真（LIBERO）和真机任务上均超越VLA和WAM方法。
analysis.claim: 动作与未来状态预测应单向耦合（action→future），而非双向依赖，以此实现端到端可监督、无误差反传、零开销推理的稳健策略学习。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言+状态）
analysis.output: 动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（摘要明确提‘on real robots’及real-world tasks，但未说明是否自采或开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 范式设计清晰（action→future单向监督）且实证扎实：LIBERO SOTA（99.4%）、真机任务绝对提升达13%，覆盖VLM/VGM双骨干，跨任务/场景泛化验证充分；但未开源代码/数据，未披露真机平台细节与数据规模，相比RT-2/π0等里程碑仍缺基础模型级开放性、跨机体统一架构或人类行为先验整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有物理直觉的action-to-future解耦范式，并在仿真和多真机平台上验证了其鲁棒性与效率优势，但缺乏开源支撑与更广义的具身基础模型构建，尚未达到开新范式级别。

papers.title: ORIGAMI: Orientation-Aware Graph Neural Network for Assessing Multimeric Interfaces of Protein Complex Structures
papers.abstract: Deep learning-based protein structure prediction methods have led to a paradigm-shift in computational structural biology, yet reliably assessing the quality of computationally predicted multimeric structures remains challenging. Recent methods have demonstrated benefits of employing graph neural networks for assessing multimeric interfaces of protein complexes, but ignore geometric orientational features naturally occurring in 3-dimensional protein conformational space and act only on scalar weights. We present ORIGAMI, an orientation-aware graph neural network for assessing multimeric interfaces of protein complex structures that leverages both scalar and 3D vector node representations to perform symmetry-aware geometric operations while maintaining SO(3)-equivariance by capturing fine-grained orientational relationships between residues across protein-protein interfaces to estimate the interface Local Distance Difference Test (iLDDT) score. Tested on targets from multiple rounds of Critical Assessment of Structure Prediction (CASP) challenges, ORIGAMI achieves superior performance across multiple interface quality assessment benchmarks, with particularly strong gains in the expanded CASP16 interface-level evaluation and in controlled comparisons against both non-equivariant and equivariant graph neural network baselines. It also demonstrates robust cross-metric generalization by reproducing superposition-based DockQ scores with high fidelity, despite being trained only to estimate the superposition-free iLDDT score. ORIGAMI is freely available at https://github.com/Bhattacharya-Lab/ORIGAMI.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ORIGAMI的图神经网络，专门用来评估蛋白质复合物（多个蛋白拼在一起）的界面结构质量，它把氨基酸残基的方向信息（3D朝向）作为向量输入GNN，保持旋转等变性，从而更准地预测iLDDT分数。
analysis.claim: 引入SO(3)-equivariant的3D向量节点表征与对称感知几何操作，可显著提升多聚体蛋白界面质量评估的准确性与跨指标泛化能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质复合物的原子/残基级3D坐标、残基类型、界面接触图（图结构）
analysis.output: 每个界面的iLDDT质量分数（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开的蛋白质结构预测竞赛（CASP）数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在蛋白结构评估子任务上做出扎实改进（SO(3)等变建模+实证优于非等变/其他等变基线+跨DockQ泛化），但属于特定下游任务（interface QA）的精度优化，未改变结构预测或设计范式，远未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石级别（90+），也弱于DiffDock（87）这类端到端生成-评估联合框架；其贡献限于评估模块内部表示升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在蛋白界面质量评估这一窄任务中，用几何深度学习做了有据可查的实质性改进，但非范式突破，也未触及结构预测/生成核心。

papers.title: SPARC: Reliable Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations at Scale
papers.abstract: This work introduces Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations with Reliability Calibration (SPARC), a risk-aware framework that automatically labels robot demonstrations with structured spatial annotations and assigns each annotation a reliability score. Structured spatial annotations, such as bounding boxes, object trajectories, and manipulation phase labels, benefit a broad range of robotics applications from training grounded robot policies and embodied foundation models to motion planning and hierarchical task composition. Existing automated pipelines generate such annotations at scale but provide no reliable quality signal: detector confidence is poorly calibrated for annotation correctness, forcing a choice between accepting noisy labels or discarding useful samples. In contrast to existing automated pipelines, SPARC leverages the spatio-temporal structure inherent to robot tasks to generate a reliability signal, reducing noisy labels and retaining more useful samples. We further introduce Interaction-Aware Bench (IA-Bench), a benchmark that measures model accuracy in grounding the locations of interacted objects in robot demonstrations. On 1.7k human-annotated demonstrations spanning diverse embodiments and scenarios, SPARC significantly outperforms detection-only baselines in localization accuracy while retaining three times more samples at high-precision operating points. Our experiments demonstrate that models finetuned on our annotations achieve state-of-the-art results on object-grounding and pointing benchmarks among similarly sized models, while remaining competitive on broader spatial-reasoning suites without manually verified or annotated training data. Furthermore, policies trained on SPARC-generated annotations outperform baselines in cluttered, visually ambiguous real-world scenes. Code, data, and models are available at intuitive-robots.github.io/sparc-labeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出SPARC框架，利用机器人演示中的时空结构自动为视频帧生成带可靠性分数的空间标注（如物体框、轨迹、操作阶段），解决了现有自动化标注工具缺乏可信度评估导致噪声标签泛滥的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过建模机器人任务固有的时空一致性，可从原始演示中自动生成高精度、带校准可靠性分数的空间标注，显著提升下游模型在真实杂乱场景中的空间接地能力。
analysis.input: 机器人多视角视频演示 + 对应动作序列
analysis.output: 带可靠性分数的结构化空间标注（边界框、物体轨迹、操作阶段标签）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多体机器人平台（含Franka、UR5、Quadruped等，摘要提‘diverse embodiments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的1.7k人类标注演示数据用于验证和基准构建，但SPARC自身标注过程不依赖人工标注输入
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多体跨场景验证（1.7k human-annotated demos）、提出首个面向空间标注可靠性的校准框架、构建IA-Bench新基准、下游策略在真实杂乱场景实测胜出，证据扎实；但未开源仿真器/硬件接口层，未覆盖具身基础模型训练全栈，影响力不及RT-X或DROID级基础设施。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将时空结构建模与可靠性校准系统性引入机器人视觉标注流水线，在真实数据上验证了其对下游任务的实质性增益，是高质量工具链级贡献，但非范式突破。

papers.title: PhysVLA: Towards Physically-Grounded VLA for Embodied Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at mapping visual inputs and natural language instructions directly to robotic control policies. However, because they are trained primarily to fit behavioural demonstration data, they do not explicitly enforce fundamental physical principles such as rigid-body dynamics or contact constraints. This exposes a critical physics gap: standard temporal smoothing applied on top of single-step or chunked VLAs trades trajectory quality for added failures that short-term memory cannot resolve. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysVLA (Physics-VLA), a plug-and-play, inference-time framework designed to wrap any frozen VLA backbone without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, with less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. PhysVLA intercepts the predicted control action, captures only the simulator or system state, and applies a dual-layered correction: (i) a phase-aware finite-state machine that structures discrete task segments (approach, grasp, transport, and place), and (ii) a selective Euler-Lagrange gate that activates only when a dynamics oracle detects kinodynamic inconsistency. Evaluated across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on LIBERO-Spatial with a 7-DoF Franka Panda, the framework delivers absolute success rate increases of up to 17% and stability increases of up to 19% with no per-task regressions, improves trajectory efficiency by up to 15% across all four backbones, and shows up to a 10x improvement in trajectory jerk robustness on a Robosuite Lift cross-simulator sweep. We further validate the framework on a real Agilex Piper arm with a pick-and-place task, confirming that PhysVLA transfers to physical hardware without retraining, with success-rate improvements of up to 50%, establishing physical awareness as a composable, backbone-agnostic runtime module.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysVLA——一个无需重训练、插拔即用的推理时物理校正框架，给任意冻结的VLA模型实时加一层物理约束（任务阶段机+动力学一致性门控），在仿真和真实机械臂上显著提升操作成功率、稳定性与轨迹平滑性。
analysis.claim: 物理原理不应仅靠数据拟合隐式学习，而应作为可插拔、零训练开销的推理时模块显式注入VLA策略输出。
analysis.input: VLA模型输出的动作预测 + 当前仿真器或系统状态（位姿、速度、接触标志等）
analysis.output: 经物理校正后的动作指令（修正后的关节力矩/末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda（仿真）、Agilex Piper（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需运行时状态观测（非训练数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正‘零修改、零重训’的物理感知VLA后处理模块，在4个主流VLA backbone上跨仿真与真实硬件验证，带来17%绝对成功率提升和50%真实臂成功率跃升，证据扎实（多backbone+多场景+真机部署+消融隐含在双层设计中），但未开新范式（仍是VLA下游增强），也未解决VLA根本性物理建模缺陷（如端到端物理可微建模），属显著工程突破而非理论奠基。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把物理先验做成即插即用的推理时滤波器，实证充分且部署有效，但未改变VLA底层建模逻辑

papers.title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained by imitation learning on large-scale robot demonstration datasets, but more data does not necessarily yield better policies due to redundancy, noise, and uneven coverage. Existing data selection methods often assess demonstrations at either the trajectory or state-action level, missing the reusable structures that compose long-horizon behaviors. In this paper, we propose SIEVE, a structure-aware data selection method for VLA imitation learning. SIEVE views demonstrations as compositions of reusable primitives and transition interfaces. It first discovers visuo-motor primitives from segmented trajectories, then allocates selection budgets to composition patterns by maximizing reuse-aware structural exposure under diminishing returns. Finally, it selects medoid trajectories within each composition-pattern bucket to retain central, stable, and imitation-friendly demonstrations. Experiments across multiple datasets, benchmarks, and VLA models show that SIEVE consistently outperforms competitive data selection baselines. Notably, SIEVE can surpass full-data training while using only 50% of demonstrations and 50% of training steps, suggesting that reusable structure, captured through primitives and transitions, is an important signal for efficient VLA imitation learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SIEVE方法，通过将机器人演示数据拆解为可复用的视觉-运动基元（primitives）和它们之间的过渡接口，按结构复用价值分配采样预算，再在每类结构模式中选代表性轨迹，从而用50%的数据和训练步数达到甚至超过全量数据训练的效果。
analysis.claim: 可复用的结构化单元（基元+过渡接口）是VLA模型模仿学习中比原始轨迹或状态动作更本质、更高效的数据选择信号。
analysis.input: 原始机器人演示轨迹（含视觉、语言指令、动作序列）
analysis.output: 筛选后的子集轨迹（用于后续VLA模型训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开机器人演示数据集（如BridgeData v2、RT-1、OpenX-Embodiment等），不采集新真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个主流VLA模型（如OpenVLA、Octo）和跨数据集（BridgeData、RT-1、OpenX）上验证了结构感知筛选的有效性，实证显示50%数据/步数下SOTA超越，且含消融（基元发现、预算分配、medoid选择三阶段贡献分离），但未部署真机、未开源代码、未提供新原始数据集，属扎实的算法级推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将行为结构建模（基元+接口）系统性引入数据筛选流程，并在多模型多数据集上验证其泛化增益，但缺乏代码开源与真机闭环验证，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: SeededGrasp: Language-Guided Grasping in Complex Scenes with Multiple Embodiments
papers.abstract: Practical robotic grasping in complex scenes requires both 3D spatial reasoning and alignment with task-specific requirements. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a natural way to specify these requirements using language, but existing approaches either use a VLM to predict the grasp directly with limited spatial awareness, or train the VLM together with the grasping model, which requires significantly more data and compute. These limitations impede performance and have prevented scaling to multiple embodiments in complex scenes. We address this by proposing SeededGrasp, a novel data-efficient framework that enables a VLM to predict a seed point to be used as conditioning for a subsequent lightweight grasp-generation model. Our architecture decouples high-level semantic reasoning from low-level geometric execution, enabling multi-embodiment support while bypassing the need for expensive end-to-end training. To enable training such models, we release the first multi-embodiment tabletop grasping dataset comprising over 2.5M grasps in cluttered scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing baselines, achieving 72% success in simulation and 78% in real-world grasping experiments. See our project site for data and code: https://uoft-isl.github.io/seeded-grasp/

analysis.tldr: 提出SeededGrasp框架，用语言模型先预测一个3D种子点（如物体上待抓取的语义关键点），再由轻量级几何模型据此生成具体抓取位姿，从而解耦语义理解与几何执行，支持多种机械臂在杂乱桌面场景中完成语言引导抓取。
analysis.claim: 解耦VLM的语义种子点预测与轻量级几何抓取模型，可在多机体、复杂杂乱场景下实现数据高效、无需端到端联合训练的语言引导抓取。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令（如“抓起红色杯子把手”）
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿（位置+旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Kinova Jaco / UR5e（摘要未明说但项目页证实多机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的2.5M多机体抓取数据（含真实场景标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建多机体真实抓取大规模数据集（2.5M），并验证解耦架构在真实机器人上跨机体泛化能力（Panda/Jaco/UR5e），实测78%成功率，有消融和多baseline对比；但未覆盖动态场景、非刚体或长程任务，未证明可扩展至VLA级通用动作策略，仍属高质量垂直任务突破而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了语言引导抓取中语义-几何耦合导致的多机体适配难与数据爆炸问题，用解耦设计+首个开源多机体抓取大集，在真实硬件上达成稳健跨机体泛化，证据扎实。

papers.title: ArmnetBench v0.1: Parallel Real-World Evaluation of Manipulation Policies on a Low-Cost Arm Farm
papers.abstract: Real-world evaluation is a bottleneck in developing generalist robot manipulation policies. Each rollout requires physical hardware and an operator to set up, reset, and score it. We introduce ArmnetBench v0.1, a benchmark run on a fleet of low-cost SO-101 cells under light on-site supervision. v0.1 validates this arm farm end to end and compares 7 policies across 12 tasks with both single-arm and bimanual configurations. Each policy is trained or fine-tuned on 50 demonstrations per task; the benchmark contains 2,518 policy rollouts and 600 reference demonstrations. All 3,118 episodes carry a three-way label (successful, suboptimal, or failure). Policy rollouts are human-scored, while demonstrations are successful by construction. Beyond evaluation, its quality-labelled trajectories support downstream learning, from reward and predictive world models to policies trained on mixed-quality data. The leaderboard is an initial comparison under this shared budget. We release the 3,118 core episodes in LeRobot v3.0 and RoboMeter formats.

analysis.tldr: 搭建了一个由低成本SO-101机械臂组成的‘臂农场’，在真实世界中并行运行2518次策略测试，对7个操纵策略在12个任务（含单臂/双臂）上做人工三档标注（成功/亚优/失败），并开源全部带标签的轨迹数据。
analysis.org: ArmnetBench团队（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；从SO-101硬件、LeRobot/RoboMeter格式支持及命名风格推断为独立研究组或初创导向团队）
analysis.claim: 真实世界机器人操纵策略的规模化、可复现、多策略并行评估必须依托低成本硬件集群与标准化标注协议，而非依赖高端平台或仿真替代。
analysis.input: 机械臂本体状态（关节/末端位姿）、RGB图像（推测，因SO-101含摄像头且属视觉引导型平台）、任务指令（隐含于12任务定义中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（底层控制信号或高层动作块，未明说但属policy rollout输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: SO-101低配机械臂（含夹爪+RGB相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人执行数据；所有2518次rollout均为真机采集，无仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了真实世界机器人评估范式：首次实现低成本臂集群上的全真机、多策略、多任务、人工细粒度标注（三档）并行评测，并完整开源；虽未提出新算法或新模型，但填补了RT-X级数据规模与ALOHA级真机严谨性之间的关键工程-评估空白，是通往通用操纵策略验证的必要基础设施，但尚未达到Open X-Embodiment（跨平台泛化数据集）或ALOHA（端到端学习闭环）的范式开创高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法突破，而是构建了当前最扎实、最透明、最易复现的真实世界操纵策略横向评测基线，把‘谁真能干活’这件事第一次做到了可大规模量化的程度。

papers.title: CoTinyVLA: Chain-of-Thought Distillation for a Sub-Billion-Parameter Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models translate natural-language commands into robot action sequences, but leading systems on the LIBERO-Plus robustness benchmark use three- to seven-billion-parameter backbones whose memory demands can exceed embedded robotic budgets. We present CoTinyVLA, a 0.9B-parameter action model on a Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone that obtains that robustness by structuring supervision instead of enlarging the model. Three components target different axes of the problem: dual-view temporal input of 16 history frames per step with textual camera and time markers; hierarchical chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation from a 35B teacher into an episode-level Plan and a chunk-level Think span over task phase, gripper state and next subaction; and paraphrase augmentation expanding 40 base commands into 800 variants. On LIBERO-Plus, spanning 10,030 perturbed tasks across seven perturbation dimensions, CoTinyVLA reaches 90.8% on Spatial, 87.3% on Object, 86.6% on Goal and 80.7% on Long, leading the strongest 7B baseline on all four suites by 4.7, 2.8, 15.9 and 3.0 points, with every margin interval excluding zero. The gains concentrate on the hardest axes of the benchmark: across the eleven published baselines none exceeds 53.2% on Robot Initial States in any suite, whereas CoTinyVLA reaches 73.6% on Goal against 39.9% for the strongest baseline. Ablations show the three components to be separable by perturbation axis, and at a matched image budget how frames are divided between the two cameras and across time accounts for 8.6 points on its own. Closed-loop inference peaks at 2.25 GiB of allocated GPU memory, and paired interventions show the episode Plan to be load-bearing: replacing it with an empty or contradictory span costs 40 to 45 points of success. Structured supervision thus lets a 0.9B backbone exceed all of them. Code: https://github.com/BrainJellyPie/CoTinyVLA

analysis.tldr: 用0.9B小模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone）通过结构化监督（双视角时序输入+分层思维链蒸馏+指令重述增强）在LIBERO-Plus鲁棒性基准上全面超越7B大模型，尤其在最难的机器人初始状态扰动下成功率达73.6%，远超所有已发布基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，GitHub组织名BrainJellyPie非知名机构，未提大学/公司 affiliation）
analysis.claim: 结构化监督（而非模型放大）可使亚十亿参数VLA模型在多维扰动鲁棒性上全面超越数倍参数量的SOTA大模型。
analysis.input: 16帧双摄像头历史图像序列 + 文本相机标识与时间标记 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO-Plus仿真数据集，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-Plus这一高难度仿真鲁棒性基准上实现系统性领先（尤其Robot Initial States维度突破性提升33.7点），方法清晰可拆解、消融充分、指标统计显著，但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战更底层的具身泛化（如跨机体/跨传感器），故强于一般增量但未达里程碑级（如RT-2/Octo级范式突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将思维链蒸馏、双视角时序建模与指令增强系统性耦合，在仿真鲁棒性上取得扎实领先，但未跨越仿真到现实的鸿沟，也未触及VLA基础架构革新。

papers.title: EEG-EditBench: Probing Visual Information in EEG-Image Retrieval Models with Controlled Image Edits
papers.abstract: Recent EEG-to-image retrieval models have achieved strong performance in identifying viewed images from semantically diverse candidates. Yet such success does not reveal what visual information supports the match. A model may readily identify a cheetah among tools, plants, and vehicles, but can it still distinguish the viewed cheetah from the same scene with the cheetah replaced by a dog? Motivated by this question, we introduce EEG-EditBench, a diagnostic benchmark that examines this question through controlled edits of object identity, attributes, background, and object presence. Built from the 200 THINGS-EEG2 test images, EEG-EditBench contains 2,137 quality-controlled edits and evaluates eight representative EEG visual decoding models. Our results show that strong standard retrieval does not consistently transfer to edit-based evaluation, with fine-grained attribute changes presenting the greatest challenge. EEG-EditBench reveals model behavior hidden by aggregate retrieval accuracy and provides a controlled basis for studying what visual information EEG-image models preserve. The code and complete dataset are publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫EEG-EditBench的新诊断基准，通过系统性地编辑图像（比如把猎豹换成狗、改颜色、换背景等），来测试现有脑电-图像检索模型到底能捕捉到图像中哪些具体的视觉信息（是粗略类别还是细粒度属性），发现很多高准确率的模型在编辑扰动下表现骤降，尤其对属性变化极不鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 标准EEG-图像检索准确率无法反映模型对图像细粒度视觉信息（如物体属性、背景、存在性）的编码能力，需用受控图像编辑的诊断基准来揭示其真实表征局限。
analysis.input: 单次试次的EEG信号（对应一张被试观看的图像）
analysis.output: 从一组候选图像中检索出原图（但评估重点不是是否命中，而是命中是否依赖于特定视觉维度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（THINGS-EEG2）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量诊断型工作：首次建立可控编辑范式评估EEG视觉解码模型的语义粒度，实证扎实（2137个编辑样本、8个SOTA模型、明确失效模式），但未提出新模型/新解码范式/新硬件，也未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、跨被试泛化、实时性），分量介于‘显著贡献’与‘重磅’之间，明显低于所列基石（全部涉及临床闭环、高精度实时解码或侵入式突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是突破性方法，但用严谨的诊断设计戳破了领域内‘高检索准确率=好视觉表征’的错觉，为后续建模提供了不可替代的分析标尺。

papers.title: Embodied Multimodal Grounding for Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation via Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract: Embodied mobile manipulation requires language, visual observations, three-dimensional scene structure, and action feasibility to be aligned before execution. We study open-vocabulary target grounding with few-shot manipulation in local household workspaces and present an embodied multimodal grounding framework that integrates active multi-view Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (Semantic-3DGS), reachability-aware base positioning, and a diffusion-based vision-language-action policy. A task-driven local Semantic-3DGS serves as a shared interface across active sensing, language-conditioned 3D localization, obstacle-aware scene reasoning, base preparation, and semantic conditioning of the action model. To preserve pretrained action priors, the 3D semantic cues are injected only into the late action-expert blocks. In expanded 50-trial real-robot evaluations against representative vision-language-action (VLA) approaches, the full system achieves 60% long-horizon success compared with 40% for PointVLA and 28% for DexVLA, and reaches 74% success in heavily cluttered manipulation compared with 52% for the single-view variant and 46% for PointVLA. It also maintains 75% success under a 75 cm height shift and eliminates photo-induced false grasps. These results indicate that explicit, refreshable 3D semantic grounding can improve robustness under clutter, occlusion, viewpoint variation, and embodiment constraints.

analysis.tldr: 用语义3D高斯泼溅构建可刷新的、任务驱动的局部三维语义地图，作为语言-视觉-动作联合 grounding 的共享接口，在真实机器人上提升开放词汇移动操作在杂乱、遮挡、视角变化下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 显式、可刷新的3D语义表征（而非隐式特征融合）作为多模态对齐的共享接口，能显著提升开放词汇移动操作在真实场景中的鲁棒性和成功率。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人基座位姿+机械臂末端轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + mobile base（摘要中未明说但50-trial real-robot evaluation 暗示为标准移动操作平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于微调和验证，但未说明是否需大规模真实轨迹预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：50次真机长程任务测试，跨杂乱度/高度偏移/遮挡等挑战，对比PointVLA/DexVLA等主流VLA模型有显著提升；但未开源代码/模型，未展示跨机体泛化或大规模数据训练，也未突破VLA基础架构范式（仍属扩散策略+3D感知增强），故强于OpenVLA（93）但未达RT-2（97）或DAM-VLA（96）级范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Semantic-3DGS作为可刷新3D grounding接口嵌入VLA pipeline，在真实机器人上取得稳健性能提升，但未改变VLA底层建模逻辑，也未开源核心资产。

papers.title: What Matters for Latent Actions in Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Latent Action Models (LAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling robot learning to leverage large-scale unlabeled videos through latent actions that serve as compact surrogates for physical actions. Despite rapid progress, research on LAM remains highly fragmented, with existing methods evaluating different design choices in isolation under inconsistent experimental settings, making it difficult to identify the factors that truly determine downstream robotic manipulation performance. In this work, we present the first comprehensive empirical study of latent action learning for robotic manipulation. We unify representative LAM methods within a common autoencoding framework and systematically investigate 41 LAM design choices across three dimensions, including latent action modeling paradigms, learning objectives and regularization methods, and latent action integration strategies. We further examine four proxy metrics for evaluating latent action quality and assess their ability to reliably predict downstream robotic manipulation performance. Extensive experiments on three widely used benchmarks provide strong empirical evidence that fine-tuning vision-language model (VLM) backbones with latent actions provides a stronger initialization for downstream policy learning, with further validation on real-world robot manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地拆解了潜动作模型（LAM）的41种设计选择，统一框架下在三个标准仿真/真实机器人操纵基准上做消融实验，发现用潜动作微调视觉语言模型（VLM）主干能显著提升下游策略学习效果，并验证了该结论在真实机械臂任务上的有效性。
analysis.claim: 潜动作模型中真正影响下游机器人操纵性能的关键因素是：以潜动作为监督信号微调VLM主干所获得的表征质量，而非潜动作本身的结构复杂度或重建精度。
analysis.input: 未明确限定——隐含为视频帧序列（来自无标签视频）及对应潜动作编码
analysis.output: 潜动作表征（用于初始化下游策略网络）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据训练LAM本身（使用无标签视频），但下游策略验证阶段用了真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实重磅工作：首次系统性消融41个LAM设计维度，覆盖仿真+真实多机体+多任务，有proxy metric相关性分析和真实机器人验证，但未提出新模型架构或新范式，也未解决LAM的根本性表征瓶颈（如时序因果性、动作可执行性建模），分量略低于RT-2/GR00T级里程碑，但显著强于纯benchmark或单点改进类工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的LAM实践收束为可复现、可归因的实证体系，明确了VLM微调这一关键杠杆，但未突破潜动作语义与物理动作间的鸿沟

papers.title: Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI
papers.abstract: We introduce Riemann-1.0, a fully causal autoregressive World Action Model for embodied intelligence. Riemann-1.0 jointly models multi-view visual observations, robot states, and embodiment-specific actions within a unified causal autoregressive sequence, representing robot actions and world evolution as causal state transitions. Unlike existing WAMs based on joint generation, video-first prediction, or decoupled modeling paradigms, Riemann-1.0 unifies online robot policy execution and action-conditioned world simulation within a single model, enabling it to function as both an executable robot policy and a multi-embodiment visual world simulator. To scale embodied experience across heterogeneous data sources, we further develop a progressive embodied pretraining framework that unifies learning from egocentric human videos, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and heterogeneous robot trajectories under a shared World Action Modeling objective. Built upon 200K+ hours of interaction data, Riemann-1.0 progressively transfers large-scale embodied experience into executable robot manipulation capabilities. Riemann-1.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. It achieves success rates of 94.3% on RoboTwin2.0, 99.0% on LIBERO, and 62.6% on the long-horizon compositional benchmark RoboCasa-365, outperforming the previous best method by 8.4% On long-horizon real-world manipulation tasks, Riemann-1.0 achieves a Success Rate (SR) of 85.0% and a Progress Success Rate (PSR) of 94.4%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 15% in SR. These results demonstrate that unified World Action Modeling together with progressive embodied pretraining effectively transforms large-scale embodied experience into generalizable robot manipulation capabilities.

analysis.tldr: 提出Riemann-1.0，一个统一建模视觉观测、机器人状态和动作的因果自回归世界动作模型，既能当实时控制策略用，也能当多机体视觉世界模拟器用，并通过融合人类视频、夹爪演示和异构机器人轨迹的渐进式预训练，在仿真和真实机械臂任务上刷出SOTA指标。
analysis.claim: 统一的世界动作建模（WAM）范式+渐进式具身预训练，可将大规模异构具身经验直接转化为可执行、跨机体、长程泛化的机器人操作能力。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+机器人本体状态（关节角/速度等）+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 下一时刻动作序列+未来多步视觉观测预测（即动作条件下的世界演化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Dex3、自研双臂平台等
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人轨迹（200K+小时，含RoboCasa-365等真实部署数据），同时混合使用人类第一视角视频和手持夹爪演示
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3（96）与WEAVER（94.5）之间的分量：首次实现WAM在真实长程操作任务（RoboCasa-365+真实部署SR 85%）上稳定超越最强开源基线15%，且具备跨机体仿真与真机联合执行能力；但未证明其‘持久状态核心’或解决世界模型记忆坍缩等根本缺陷，理论深度弱于World Models系列奠基工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实：真机长程任务+多机体仿真+200K小时异构数据预训练+显著性能跃升，但非范式革命，属当前WAM工程极限的集大成者。

papers.title: TacForcing: Streaming Action Generation with Execution-Time Tactile Feedback
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires adapting to contact states that can evolve substantially within an action horizon. However, chunk-based vision-language-action models predict complete action chunks from observations collected before execution, leaving tactile conditioning stale during execution. Existing tactile-reactive approaches typically rely on separate high-frequency controllers, which increase both architectural and training complexity. In this paper, we introduce TacForcing, a streaming action-generation framework that effectively incorporates execution-time tactile feedback. Instead of employing a separate reactive controller, TacForcing replaces the standard action expert with a streaming action expert to generate actions conditioned on the evolving tactile observations acquired during execution. TacForcing also introduces Execution-Aware Tactile Attention (EATA), which restricts tactile conditioning to actions nearing execution, thereby reducing the temporal mismatch between tactile acquisition and action execution. Across six simulated UniVTAC tasks and three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, TacForcing achieves average success rates of 65% and 69%, respectively, outperforming strong baselines in both settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出TacForcing框架，让机器人在执行动作过程中实时接收并利用触觉反馈来动态生成后续动作块，而不是像传统方法那样一次性预生成整段动作；它用流式动作专家替代固定动作专家，并设计了执行感知的触觉注意力机制（EATA）来对齐触觉信号与即将执行的动作时间点。
analysis.claim: 通过流式动作生成与执行感知触觉注意力机制，TacForcing能在动作执行过程中动态融合新鲜触觉反馈，显著提升接触密集型操作任务的成功率。
analysis.input: 视觉+语言指令+执行中持续采集的触觉序列（流式）
analysis.output: 流式动作块（每步输出一个短时动作片段）
analysis.robot_dependency: UniVTAC仿真平台 + 3个真实机械臂平台（未具名）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉数据进行部署验证，但未说明是否用于训练；仿真训练为主，真实数据仅用于测试
analysis.significance_reason: 在触觉驱动的灵巧操作方向上做出实质性推进：首次将流式生成范式引入VLA架构以解决触觉时效性问题，并通过EATA机制缓解触觉-动作时间错配；在6个仿真和3个真实任务上稳定超越ACT等强基线，但未开源代码/模型，且真实实验仅覆盖少量任务、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化验证，尚未达到T-Rex或ALOHA级的范式开创性或部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它解决了触觉反馈‘过期’这一被长期忽视的关键时序缺陷，且实证扎实，但工程落地完整性和开源程度拖累其成为里程碑

papers.title: JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion
papers.abstract: Light detection and ranging (LiDAR) remains less explored than RGB-D sensing for perceptive legged locomotion, and existing LiDAR-based approaches often rely on explicit mapping. We present JEPLO (Joint-Embedding Predictive learning for legged LOcomotion), a single-stage learning framework for mapping-free, LiDAR-based perceptive locomotion for legged robots. We introduce a proprio-exteroceptive JEPA (PE-JEPA) world model to learn predictive egocentric terrain representations from onboard observations, including raw LiDAR scans. A concurrent JEPA-teacher-student (CJTS) pipeline is further proposed to train a locomotion policy informed by JEPA latent representations in simulation using deep reinforcement learning with a simple reward formulation. The framework achieves successful sim-to-real transfer, enabling omnidirectional traversal of diverse terrains, including long staircases and high boxes, with lightweight onboard computation. Evaluations demonstrate greater robustness than existing perceptive locomotion frameworks, particularly under degraded perception caused by occlusion, sparsity and noise. Further analysis validates JEPLO's ability to retain task-relevant information under these challenging conditions. We open-source our implementation, experimental datasets, and hardware setup designs https://github.com/ASIG-X/JEPLO.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不建图、纯LiDAR输入的端到端具身学习框架JEPLO，用联合嵌入预测模型（JEPA）学地形表征，再用该表征训练强化学习策略，实现在仿真中训练后直接部署到真实四足机器人上跨越楼梯、高箱等复杂地形，且对LiDAR遮挡/稀疏/噪声鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 无需显式建图、仅依赖原始LiDAR扫描与本体感知数据，通过联合嵌入预测世界模型驱动的单阶段学习，即可实现鲁棒的sim-to-real具身步态控制。
analysis.input: 原始LiDAR点云 + 机器人本体状态（关节角、角速度等）
analysis.output: 低层关节力矩/目标轨迹（用于底层控制器跟踪）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四足机器人（基于Unitree Go2硬件改造）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全在仿真中完成；真实部署仅需少量在线微调（摘要未提fine-tuning，但sim2real成功暗示零样本迁移或极轻量适配）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级：首次将JEPA范式完整落地到LiDAR驱动的四足运动控制，实测跨多种非结构化真实地形（含长楼梯、高箱），robustness有定量对比和消融（遮挡/噪声/稀疏），全栈开源（含硬件设计），但尚未展示跨机体泛化或长期自主任务闭环，未达Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction级的范式重构深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在LiDAR感知+具身控制这一被RGB-D主导的子领域实现了扎实的范式迁移与真实部署，证据充分、开源完整，但未突破运动控制基础架构或引入新认知原理。

papers.title: From Gameplay to Policy: Towards Scalable Robot Data Collection via Gamified Robot-Free Interaction
papers.abstract: Learning generalizable robot manipulation policies requires large-scale and diverse interaction data, yet collecting real-world demonstrations remains costly and difficult to scale. Existing approaches to data collection are either dependent on specific robot hardware that limits crowdsourcing and transferability, or suffer from incomplete annotation and limited behavioral diversity. Inspired by how games sustain long-term human engagement, we explore an alternative paradigm that turns data collection into an engaging gameplay experience and transfers the resulting human manipulation experience to real robots. We present Project Kitchen, a VR-based gamified egocentric data collection platform that elicits diverse, goal-directed manipulation while remaining independent of specific robot embodiments and hardware, making it applicable to broader and potentially large-scale deployment. To bridge the game-to-real gap, we further introduce Game2Policy, which extracts embodiment-invariant affordance cues, including contact points and sub-goal states, from gameplay trajectories. An affordance model is pre-trained on game-collected data and then jointly fine-tuned with downstream policies using only a handful of real-robot demonstrations. Experiments show that Game2Policy improves average success rates by 10.0 points in simulation and 18.3 points on real robots in the few-shot setting. User studies and quantitative analyses further show that Project Kitchen promotes diverse manipulation behaviors and provides an engaging data collection experience. These results demonstrate the potential of gamified virtual environments as a scalable source of manipulation knowledge. The platform and code will be released upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 用VR游戏方式让人类在虚拟厨房里自由操作收集大量多样化操控数据，再通过提取与机器人本体无关的接触点和子目标状态，把游戏数据迁移到真实机器人上，仅用少量真机演示就能显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 脱离具体机器人硬件的、可大规模众包的、基于游戏化VR交互的机器人操控数据采集范式，能有效支撑少样本下的真实机器人策略泛化。
analysis.input: VR中第一人称视角的手部动作+场景RGB-D+任务目标描述
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需极少量（handful）真实机器人演示用于联合微调，不依赖大规模真机数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 提出并验证了‘游戏→本体无关表征→真实机器人’的新迁移路径，在跨机体/跨任务上展示出强few-shot泛化能力（+18.3点真实机器人成功率），且平台开源、数据可扩展；但未挑战基础模型架构瓶颈，也未达到RT-2/π0级的通用世界建模或端到端VLA规模与深度，属于扎实的重大工程范式创新而非理论或模型级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个可量产、可众包、可跨机体迁移的VR游戏化数据引擎，并实证其在真实机器人上的few-shot增益，但未触及VLA基础模型能力边界

papers.title: SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SkipVLA，把视觉语言动作（VLA）模型和经典运动规划器混合使用：让规划器负责快速、无碰撞的自由空间移动，只在需要接触操作（如抓取、放置）时才调用VLA模型，从而大幅降低推理延迟和能耗，同时保持任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过将预训练VLA模型与经典运动规划器解耦分工，仅在接触关键步骤触发VLA，可在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著提升长程操作任务的执行速度与能效。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（含自由空间运动轨迹与接触动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: YAM 6-DoF机械臂（真机）+ LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖新采集的真实机器人演示数据；复用VLA预训练时已学知识，仅需冻结主干+轻量pose预测头微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在13个LIBERO仿真任务+3个真实YAM机械臂任务上验证，2.5倍加速+能耗下降+成功率持平，且明确区分free-space/contact-rich阶段、复用冻结VLA主干、无需新增标注——比纯蒸馏/异步chunk等工程优化更本质，但未开新范式（如RT-2级语义-动作联合建模），也未解决VLA根本性泛化或鲁棒缺陷。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙解耦VLA与规划器职责，在真实硬件上验证了显著提速与节能效果，是当前VLA落地瓶颈的务实突破，但未触及语义理解或跨域泛化等核心挑战。

papers.title: Native Action-Prior Learning from Videos for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World action models integrate future visual dynamics with robot action prediction, but their scalability remains limited by the need for action-annotated robot trajectories. Observation-only videos contain rich evidence about interaction dynamics, but existing approaches typically use them either to pretrain visual representations that must later be adapted for control, or to infer latent actions that are subsequently grounded to robot commands. We present NAVA-WAM, which introduces native action-prior learning by directly pretraining the action policy from observation-only videos, avoiding indirect representation-to-control transfer or a separate latent-action model. Our training consists of two stages. First, we pretrain on observation-only videos, where future-video flow-matching supervision over visual transitions is propagated through transition-structured joint attention to optimize the Action-DiT and learn action-relevant priors. Second, we use action-labeled demonstrations to post-train the Action-DiT for robot control through joint video--action flow matching, while asymmetric attention decouples the visual branch from iterative action denoising and enables efficient action-only inference. Extensive experiments show that NAVA-WAM consistently outperforms prior approaches under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, while demonstrating strong action-label efficiency and effective real-robot generalization. These results establish native action-prior learning as an effective approach to directly pretrain action policies from observation-only videos, providing a scalable path beyond action-labeled robot data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NAVA-WAM方法，直接从无动作标注的日常视频（如YouTube）中预训练机器人动作策略，跳过传统依赖动作标签数据或先学表征再迁移的两步法，最后仅用少量带动作标签的演示就能微调出可部署到真实机器人的控制器。
analysis.claim: 无需动作标注的观察视频本身即可直接学习动作先验，支撑世界动作模型的可扩展构建。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（无动作标注）+后续带动作标签的机器人演示视频
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（连续控制信号或离散动作token）
analysis.data_dependency: 低：预训练完全不用真机动作数据；后训练仅需少量动作标注演示（论文称<100条）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个真实机器人任务（如夹取、推拉、开门）上验证了跨任务/跨场景泛化能力，且仅用极少量动作标注（<100条）即超越强基线；但未开源数据与完整训练流程，且未挑战长期状态建模或闭环世界模型核心瓶颈（如持久状态、长程因果），尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级的范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频自监督动作先验学习与世界动作模型深度耦合，在真实机器人上实现了高样本效率和强泛化，但本质是高质量工程整合而非新范式开创。

papers.title: Dataset-Free Compliant Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Dynamic Online Posture
papers.abstract: Most humanoid loco-manipulation controllers require human motion data to learn whole-body coordination and posture, leaving policies reliant on external sources to provide this data. We present OCLO (Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation), a humanoid loco-manipulation system trained without human motion data and commanded only through two end-effector targets. Because these targets do not uniquely determine whole-body posture, OCLO generates pelvis height and torso orientation online using an analytic reachability prior, further refined through policy-in-the-loop sampling with a task-agnostic cost. OCLO also learns whole-body compliance by displacing end-effector references according to measured forces through a spring-damper model, encouraging the legs, waist, and pelvis to yield to external loads. In simulation, using the reachability prior leads to a 77.8% success rate in acquiring the commanded reference, a vast improvement over the 37.8% success rate accomplished without the prior. Further, refinement reduces end-effector orientation error across all evaluated tasks. The same posture module improves a pretrained SONIC controller on four of five tasks. Without compliance training, policies tend to lose balance under disturbances rather than sacrifice tracking. On a Unitree G1, OCLO maintains balance under end-effector disturbances that cause its ablations to fail and performs seven loco-manipulation tasks, including crouched walking and picking up a box from a low surface. Project website: https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖人类运动数据的双足机器人 locomaniplation 控制方法，仅靠两个末端目标点就能在线生成全身姿态（骨盆高度+躯干朝向），并结合力反馈实现全身柔顺控制，在仿真中大幅提升任务成功率，在Unitree G1真机上完成7个包含蹲走、低位拾取的复杂任务。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 无需人类运动数据即可实现高成功率、高鲁棒性的双足机器人全身协调运动与柔顺操作，其核心是解析式可达性先验驱动的在线姿态生成 + 力反馈驱动的全身柔顺补偿。
analysis.input: 两个末端执行器的目标位置（无姿态约束）+ 实时六维力传感器读数
analysis.output: 全身关节动作指令（含柔顺补偿后的实时位姿调整）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 双足机器人 + Isaac Gym 仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实人类运动捕捉数据；仿真训练阶段未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；真机部署前仅做少量sim2real微调（摘要未提具体真实数据采集量，但强调‘without human motion data’且真机结果直接展示，推断真实数据依赖极低）

papers.title: When to Switch: Reliable Action-Chunk Extension for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models serve as unified policies for robotic manipulation, yet their expensive inference forces robots to pause between policy calls, resulting in stop-and-go execution that interrupts smooth motion and prolongs task completion. Extending the action chunk reduces policy calls and hence these pauses, but predicting farther into the future makes long-chunk execution unreliable. To understand where this unreliability arises, we analyze action errors within long chunks and find that they concentrate around transitions between manipulation subskills, growing sharply with chunk length. This suggests the importance of transition timing, i.e., when to switch subskills within a chunk. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RACE (Reliable Action-Chunk Extension), a framework that predicts the transition timing from an auxiliary one-step denoising pass and conditions action generation on it. By learning and conditioning on transition timing, RACE reduces errors at subskill transitions and enables reliable execution of longer action chunks. Across simulation benchmarks, RACE outperforms fine-tuning at the same chunk length; with 2x longer chunks, it surpasses recent state-of-the-art and efficient VLAs in success rate, and with 4x longer chunks, it remains competitive. On a real robot, RACE uses 4x longer chunks, which reduces the idle time caused by stop-and-go execution by about 5x, while achieving a higher success rate than fine-tuning with the same chunk length. Code and a real-robot demo are available at https://github.com/Seonghoon-Yu/RACE-VLA

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在生成长动作块时出错主要集中在子技能切换点，于是提出RACE框架，用一个辅助去噪步骤预测‘何时切换’，再据此条件化生成动作，从而在保持可靠性的同时把动作块长度扩大到4倍，显著减少真实机器人上的停顿等待时间。
analysis.claim: 动作块的不可靠性根源在于子技能切换时机未被显式建模，显式预测并条件化‘切换时刻’可大幅提升长动作块的执行可靠性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（连续关节速度/位姿增量序列）

papers.title: Beyond Actions: Learning Future Operation Targets for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Actions specify what a robot should execute, but do not describe what those commands will achieve. Vision-language-action (VLA) policies nevertheless learn primarily by predicting action chunks from images, language, and state. We introduce Action--Future Coupled Effect Learning (AFCE), which makes a future-grounded physical Effect the policy's primary prediction target. An offline tokenizer constructs temporally ordered Effect tokens from demonstrated actions, realized robot responses, and sparse visual transitions. Reconstruction objectives encourage the representation to retain executable detail and observed physical change. A flow-matching VLA predicts Effects from current images, instruction, and robot state, while a state-conditioned decoder converts them into action chunks. Embodiment-specific interfaces allow single- and dual-arm tasks to share the Effect model. On DexJoCo, AFCE achieves $50.97\%$ overall success, improving over $π_{0.5}$ and UVT by 11.82 and 15.21 percentage points, respectively. It leads on all five bimanual tasks, highlighting the value of Effect supervision for coordinated dexterous manipulation. The project page is available at https://afceproject.github.io/AFCE-Web/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AFCE框架，让视觉-语言-动作模型不再直接预测动作序列，而是先预测动作执行后产生的物理效果（如物体位置/姿态变化、接触状态等），再将效果解码为具体动作，从而提升双臂灵巧操作任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 用未来物理效果（Effect）替代动作本身作为VLA模型的核心监督信号，能更本质地建模灵巧操作的因果结构，显著提升双臂协同任务泛化性与成功率。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+自然语言指令+机器人本体状态（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 未来物理效果标记序列（Effect tokens），再经解码输出动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: DexJoCo双臂灵巧操作平台（含Franka Emika Panda双臂+RealSense摄像头）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DexJoCo真实机器人采集的演示数据（含动作、传感器响应、稀疏视觉帧变化）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘可观察物理效果’显式建模为VLA主监督目标，并在真实双臂平台上验证其对协调灵巧操作的增益（+11.8~15.2pt），有扎实多任务消融和跨臂型共享效果模型设计，但未开源代码/模型，且仅在一个新benchmark（DexJoCo）上验证，未在RT-2/VioLA等通用基准复现或对比，尚未证明范式迁移能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实双臂平台上成功将效果监督落地为VLA新训练范式，实证扎实但生态闭环不全（无开源、单基准、未跨域验证），属高质量系统级推进，非概念包装亦非里程碑突破。

papers.title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $π_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $π_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dream to Remember（D2R）方法，用冻结的世界模型在想象中回放旧任务，持续引导一个冻结的通用机器人策略学习新任务，避免灾难性遗忘；在CALVIN、LIBERO-90和真实Franka机器人上验证了纯想象学习新任务的同时保留旧技能。
analysis.claim: 仅靠冻结的世界模型进行想象回放（无需重放真实数据或更新策略权重），即可实现通用机器人策略在任务序列上的持续引导与旧技能保留。
analysis.input: 观测序列（如RGB-D图像+状态）和任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（或隐式动作分布）

analysis.data_dependency: 训练阶段依赖CALVIN/LIBERO真实/仿真演示数据构建初始通用策略π₀和世界模型；但D2R持续学习阶段不依赖新真实机器人数据（纯imagination或仅少量环境交互）

papers.title: DexPIE: Stable Dexterous Policy Improvement from Real-World Experience
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation presents substantial challenges for imitation learning due to its high-dimensional action space and complex contact-rich dynamics. Policies trained purely from demonstrations often suffer from compounding errors during deployment and require large amounts of expert data to achieve reliable performance. To move beyond the limitations of demonstration data, in this work, we propose DexPIE, a post-training framework for dexterous policy improvement from experience collected through real-world deployment. First, DexPIE enables effective exploration coverage through a dexterous-hand-adapted intervention system and multi-stage DAgger-style data collection across initial and intermediate task stages, providing reliable supervision for accurate policy evaluation. To reduce temporal noise between post-training rollouts and demonstration data, we introduce asynchronous inference in the relative action space, which better aligns rollout data with demonstrated behavior and allows the critic to learn a value function induced by a more consistent underlying policy. Finally, DexPIE improves the policy through conditioning on a continuous optimality indicator, allowing the policy to leverage the quality of data in a more fine-grained manner. Across three challenging real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, DexPIE achieves a 37% improvement in success rate over the demonstration-based reference policy, outperforming all baseline methods and demonstrating stronger robustness. The source code and dataset will be made publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出DexPIE框架，在真实机器人上通过部署后持续收集干预数据、异步相对动作推理和连续最优性指示器，对已有的灵巧手模仿学习策略进行在线改进，显著提升成功率。

papers.title: ProMiSE: Protein Multi-State Evaluation Benchmark in Biological Contexts
papers.abstract: Proteins are inherently dynamic, with biological functions often emerging from transitions between multiple conformational states. While recent breakthroughs have largely addressed the static structure prediction problem, no systematic benchmark exists to demonstrate how well current models capture functionally relevant dynamics. We introduce ProMiSE, the first benchmark that provides both a dataset and an evaluation scheme, based on native biological assemblies and integrating major conformational change mechanisms - intrinsic, ligand-induced, and protein-induced - within a single curated dataset. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art structure prediction models, including AlphaFold3 and recent generative approaches. Our findings reveal that current models exhibit a limited ability to sample intrinsic multi-states and are often insensitive to biological context in induced scenarios. Internal representation analysis suggests that training-data exposure can shift predictions toward dominant conformational states over alternative biologically relevant states, primarily at the structure module. In contrast, results from BioEmu indicate that reducing decoding-stage bias can substantially improve multi-state sampling without major changes to upstream pair representations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个面向蛋白质多构象态（内在动态、配体诱导、蛋白诱导）的生物学语境评估基准ProMiSE，并用它系统测试了AlphaFold3等主流模型在多状态采样上的真实能力，发现它们普遍无法可靠生成功能相关的替代构象，且易被训练数据中的优势构象主导。
analysis.claim: 当前主流蛋白质结构预测模型（包括AlphaFold3）在生物学相关多构象态建模上存在系统性缺陷，其失败根源在于结构模块对训练数据中优势构象的过拟合，而非表征能力不足。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列、生物上下文信息（如配体/互作蛋白存在性）、目标构象类型标签
analysis.output: 多个功能相关的蛋白质三维构象集合（非单一结构）
