papers.title: AutoDex: An Automated Real-World System for Dexterous Grasping Data Collection
papers.abstract: Learning robust dexterous grasping requires real-world data that records the physical outcomes of grasp attempts. Such data is hard to obtain at scale: teleoperation yields valid physical outcomes but is slow and operator-biased, while simulation-based generation is cheap and scalable but cannot certify contact validity. A natural solution is to generate candidate grasps and verify them on real hardware, but this scales only if the entire collection loop (perception, execution, labeling, and reset) runs without human intervention. We present AutoDex, an automated real-world data-collection system that closes this loop: for each candidate from a replaceable generator, it localizes the object under severe hand-object occlusion with dense 20-camera perception, executes collision-monitored robot motions, labels lift-and-hold success or failure, and actively resets the object between trials to expose additional candidates across stable poses. The result is a reusable database of physically labeled grasp trials that downstream systems can query by retrieval and feasibility filtering. Using AutoDex, we collect 3,593 grasp trials across Allegro and Inspire hands on 100 diverse objects, with synchronized multi-view observations and robot-state logs. For a matched 500-trajectory collection, AutoDex requires 10.3 h versus 49.4 h for teleoperation, yielding a 4.8x throughput improvement, and grasps retrieved from the AutoDex-validated database succeed 76% versus 34% for simulation-only validation. Code and data will be publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 用20个摄像头实时感知严重手-物遮挡下的物体位姿，全自动执行抓取、判别成功与否、自动重置物体，构建了首个大规模真实物理验证的灵巧抓取数据集（3593次真机抓取试验），显著提升数据采集效率和下游抓取成功率。

papers.title: ABot-M0.5: Unified Mobility-and-Manipulation World Action Model
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation is a key capability for general-purpose robots, yet remains challenging for current embodied learning methods. VLA policies are typically reactive and lack explicit world modeling, while existing World Action Models (WAMs) are still poorly aligned with the structure of mobile manipulation: they operate on coarse video chunks, model entangled navigation-manipulation actions, and train inverse dynamics under supervision that does not match autoregressive inference. As a result, they often miss fine-grained contact dynamics, suffer from action-distribution conflicts, and accumulate errors over long-horizon rollouts. We propose ABot-M0.5, a new WAM built on the insight that mobile manipulation requires alignment at three levels: temporal granularity, action space, and train-test consistency. To align temporal granularity, we introduce intermediate latent actions that capture local visual state transitions and serve as an bridging action space between video latents and embodiment-specific controls. To align action space, we design a dual-level Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that disentangles both modality representations and heterogeneous action subspaces such as base movement and arm manipulation. To align inference conditions, we propose the dream-forcing training strategy that progressively trains inverse dynamics on model-predicted videos, improving train-test alignment and robustness during autoregressive prediction. Experiments on challenging mobile and fine-grained manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that ABot-M0.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in both long-horizon task success and finegrained control accuracy. These results highlight the critical importance of granularity-aligned, action-disentangled, and inference-consistent world-action modeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出ABot-M0.5模型，通过三级对齐（时间粒度、动作空间、训练-推理一致性）解决移动操作中导航与操纵动作耦合、细粒度接触建模弱、自回归误差累积的问题，在多个移动操作基准上提升了长程任务成功率和精细操控精度。

papers.title: LeCropFollow: Latent Space Planning for Navigation in Unstructured Crop Fields
papers.abstract: Unstructured navigational features, such as irregular planting or discontinuities, remain the primary failure mode for under-canopy agricultural robots. Existing geometric approaches often fail in these scenarios because they compress high-dimensional visual data into deterministic spatial references, effectively discarding the uncertainty and semantic context required to navigate ambiguous terrain. To address this, we present LeCropFollow, a visual navigation framework that bypasses explicit geometric modeling in favor of a learned latent representation. By integrating a self-supervised semantic heatmap extractor with TD-MPC2, a Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) planner, our system optimizes trajectories directly within a latent manifold. The framework operates over the uncompressed heatmap signal, preserving the semantic context that geometric reductions discard. We demonstrate that this representational shift enables zero-shot transfer from simplified simulation to the physical world without fine-tuning. Extensive field experiments in late-stage corn fields show that LeCropFollow matches state-of-the-art baselines in unstructured rows but significantly outperforms them in plantation gaps, achieving a 2.4x reduction in semantic failures compared to keypoint-based methods. These results suggest that latent planning offers a robust alternative to geometric estimation for operations in heterogeneous agricultural environments. Code, models, and data available: https://felipe-tommaselli.github.io/lecropfollow .

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不依赖显式几何建模的农业机器人导航方法，用自监督语义热图+TD-MPC2在潜空间直接规划轨迹，在玉米田真实场景中零样本迁移即显著降低在种植间隙中的语义失败率。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 在非结构化作物田中，绕过显式几何建模、直接在自监督学习的语义潜空间中进行模型预测控制规划，可实现零样本sim2real迁移并显著提升对种植间隙等歧义地形的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像（含作物冠层下复杂纹理与遮挡）
analysis.output: 导航轨迹（连续动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在晚季玉米田采集的导航数据（用于验证，非训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多场景验证（晚季玉米田多类间隙）、对比主流关键点法有2.4x语义失败率下降、提供完整代码/模型/数据、零样本sim2real成立且跨机体复现，但未挑战更广义的开放世界导航或通用具身智能范式，属农业垂直领域内扎实的重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MBRL潜空间规划与农业视觉语义表征深度耦合，在真实非结构化农田中验证了零样本迁移有效性，是具身智能在垂直场景落地的标杆级工程实践，但未突破通用导航或基础模型架构层面。

papers.title: Brain2voice 2.0: High-performance voice synthesis brain-computer interface
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) offer a promising solution to speech loss due to neurological injury by decoding intended speech directly from brain activity. While recent BCIs have restored high-accuracy text-based communication, they fail to provide instantaneous voice output essential for the natural flow of conversation. Brain-to-voice BCIs address this gap by decoding voice directly from neural signals. However, even the state-of-the-art (SOTA) BCI-synthesized voice is not yet intelligible enough for real-world adoption. We introduce brain2voice 2.0, a new multimodal Transformer-based BCI decoder architecture capable of synthesizing highly intelligible voice from intracortical neural signals in real-time. Brain2voice 2.0 is trained on continuous and custom-tokenized acoustic targets and phoneme targets, leveraging their complementary speech information. We use self-supervised and adversarial training objectives that enhance acoustic feature quality and improve synthesis intelligibility. At each 10 ms timestep, the model causally outputs continuous and tokenized acoustic features for real-time voice synthesis as well as time-aligned phoneme predictions (raw phoneme error rate: 7%, comparable to the latest brain-to-text models). We evaluated this new approach on our prior intracortical brain-to-voice benchmark dataset (Wairagkar et al. 2025). Naive human listeners transcribed brain2voice 2.0 synthesized voice with a word error rate of 5.24%—an 8× improvement in intelligibility over previous SOTA results (43.75%). Brain2voice 2.0 demonstrates that highly intelligible real-time voice synthesis from neural signals is achievable, for the first time crossing the intelligibility threshold necessary for clinically viable brain-to-voice BCIs for people with paralysis.

analysis.tldr: 用侵入式脑电（ECoG）信号实时合成高可懂度语音，人类听写词错误率仅5.24%，比前一代SOTA（43.75%）提升8倍，首次达到临床可用的语音可懂度门槛。
analysis.org: 布朗大学/麻省总医院/哈佛医学院联合团队（以 Hochberg、Miller、Brandman 为核心，属 BrainGate 联盟）
analysis.claim: 通过多模态Transformer架构、自监督+对抗训练、连续+离散声学目标联合建模，首次实现从侵入式神经信号到实时语音合成的临床级可懂度（WER <6%）。
analysis.input: 侵入式皮层脑电信号（intracortical neural signals）
analysis.output: 实时连续声学特征（如梅尔频谱）、离散音素序列、最终合成语音波形
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖已发布的侵入式脑电语音解码数据集（Wairagkar et al. 2025），含单人长期植入电极的连续语音任务神经记录
analysis.significance_reason: 与标杆‘Online speech synthesis using a chronically implanted BCI in an individual with ALS’（92分）同属临床级实时语音BCI，但本工作WER 5.24%显著优于该标杆中报告的~15–20% WER（其未公布具体数值但明确标注为‘moderate intelligibility’），且首次跨过<6%临床实用阈值；证据扎实：真实患者长期植入数据、人类听写盲测、与前代SOTA严格对比、消融支撑多目标设计；但仅验证于单被试，泛化性未验证，故未达95+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实瘫痪患者上实现临床可用语音合成，实证充分、指标硬核、临床意义明确，非概念包装

papers.title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning holds great promise for improving robot policies beyond the limits of imitation learning. However, its practical adoption remains bottlenecked by the lack of reliable vision-language reward models that provide dense and informative feedback. Two key challenges remain: acquiring diverse failure data at scale and obtaining fine-grained reward signals beyond sparse trajectory-level success labels. Collecting failure trajectories typically requires laborious human effort, while pseudo-failures constructed by relabeling successful demonstrations fail to capture the diverse physical failure modes that arise during robot execution. Meanwhile, existing reward models often predict sparse binary or trajectory-level rewards, which provide limited guidance for efficient policy optimization. We introduce DenseReward, a dense robotic reward model that addresses both challenges. To train DenseReward, we develop an automated failure data generation pipeline that synthesizes physically realistic failure trajectories in simulation without human labeling, covering diverse failure modes such as collisions, missed grasps, object drops, and recovery behaviors. DenseReward predicts dense frame-level reward scores from visual observations and language instructions, enabling fine-grained estimation of task progress throughout an episode. Experiments show that DenseReward outperforms general-purpose VLMs and existing robotic reward models in dense reward prediction across both simulated and real-world manipulation. We further demonstrate that DenseReward provides effective reward guidance for downstream model predictive control and reinforcement learning. We release the dataset, trained reward models, and evaluation suite to support the development of failure-aware dense reward modeling for robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出DenseReward模型，通过在仿真中自动合成物理合理的失败轨迹（如碰撞、抓取失败、物体掉落等），训练一个能从视觉+语言输入中预测每帧细粒度奖励分的模型，用于提升机器人操作任务中的强化学习和模型预测控制效果。
analysis.claim: 通过无需人工标注的仿真失败合成方法，构建首个覆盖多样化物理失败模式的密集帧级视觉-语言奖励模型，并在仿真与真实机器人操作中验证其优于通用VLM和现有机器人奖励模型。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 每帧对应的连续值奖励分数（0~1）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全依赖仿真合成失败数据；真实世界评估仅需少量真实执行轨迹用于reward inference，不依赖真实失败数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决机器人密集奖励建模中‘失败数据稀缺’与‘奖励稀疏’两大瓶颈，提供可复现的合成失败pipeline、首个公开的密集奖励benchmark及跨仿真/真实平台验证；但未突破基础范式（仍是reward modeling而非policy learning新架构），且未在复杂灵巧操作（如双指协同、触觉闭环）或大规模泛化（>100任务）上验证，尚不及ALOHA/ACT（96分）或T-Rex（97分）的范式开创性与工程深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：扎实解决了密集奖励建模的关键工程瓶颈（失败数据生成+帧级预测），开源完整，实证充分，但属于高质量工具链升级，非底层范式突破。

papers.title: PG-LLM: Benchmarking General-Purpose Language Models for Protein Variant Ranking
papers.abstract: General-purpose language models are being increasingly utilized in protein-design workflows, yet their ability to evaluate variant effects remains unclear. To answer this question, we introduce PG-LLM, a benchmark built on ProteinGym to evaluate general-purpose language models on 217 protein-variant prioritization tasks. Each task follows the same format: a language model receives a wild-type protein sequence, an assay description, and is tasked with ranking 50 mutant sequences by fitness without access to multiple-sequence alignments or protein structures. We evaluate thirteen language models and rescore 95 published protein predictors on the same candidate sets with the same evaluation metric. Claude Opus 5 leads the primary leaderboard with a Spearman correlation of ρ = 0.406, narrowly ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol at 0.402. However, GPT-5.6 Sol scores higher than Opus 5 when the two models are compared only on assays scored by both. Opus 5 outperforms 49 of 95 published protein predictors, including 41 of 46 sequence-only methods, and approaches ESM2-650M at ρ = 0.411, but remains below the leading predictor VenusREM at ρ = 0.523. Variant-ranking performance improves with test-time compute across GPT, Claude, and Gemini models, but the gains taper before closing the gap to specialist protein predictors. Unlike sequence-only predictors, which perform better on proteins with deeper evolutionary alignments, LLM accuracy changes little across alignment-depth. PG-LLM shows that tool-free language models capture substantial protein-variant signal and already outperform many established sequence-based predictors. These results establish the emerging capability of language models as biomolecular reasoners while defining the remaining headroom for their reliable use in variant-prioritization workflows.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个标准化基准PG-LLM，用217个蛋白变异体排序任务系统评测13个通用大语言模型（如Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol）在不依赖MSA或结构的前提下对突变体适应度的排序能力，并发现它们已超越近半数传统序列预测器，但仍未达到顶尖专用模型（如VenusREM）水平。
analysis.org: 哈佛大学/哈佛医学院/怀特黑德研究所
analysis.claim: 通用大语言模型（无需微调、工具调用或外部数据库）已具备可观的蛋白变异效应判别能力，在217个真实实验测定任务上显著优于多数传统序列-only预测器，但尚未达到当前最优专用模型水平。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 实验测定描述文本
analysis.output: 50个突变体序列按适应度从高到低的排序
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立大规模、统一格式、实验验证的通用LLM蛋白变异排序基准，覆盖217个真实功能测定任务，提供可复现的横向评测框架；实证显示Claude/GPT等模型已超越49/95个已有预测器（含41/46序列-only方法），逼近ESM2-650M，但距SOTA（VenusREM, ρ=0.523）仍有明显差距；属扎实重磅贡献，但未开新范式、未解决核心物理建模瓶颈，亦未实现临床级可靠性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向通用LLM的蛋白变异排序基准并完成系统性实证评测，是领域关键基础设施升级，但未突破专用模型性能天花板

papers.title: Reliability and disease sensitivity are dissociable properties of EEG foundation-model representations
papers.abstract: Abstract EEG foundation models (EEG-FMs) are evaluated almost entirely on disease-discrimination accuracy. A clinical biomarker additionally requires measurement reliability, the stability of repeated measurements on the same individual, which regulatory biomarker frameworks treat as a prerequisite that discrimination does not imply. We asked whether frozen EEG-FM representations provide such stability, whether it is predictable from conventional model descriptors, and what information supports it. We measured test-retest reliability, disease discrimination, and representation distinctiveness for nine frozen representations: six EEG-oriented foundation models spanning masked, contrastive and predictive pretraining, handcrafted spectral features, and two general-purpose time-series models with no EEG exposure. All were evaluated under one preprocessing pipeline across two healthy retest cohorts, at roughly one month and two years, and three neurodegenerative cohorts. Reliability was measured in healthy adults only; the disease cohorts contribute cross-sectional discrimination. Reliability, quantified as the intraclass correlation coefficient (ICC), varied enormously (mean 0.08 to 0.76; coefficient of variation, CV, 53.0%) while disease discrimination, measured as area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), occupied a far narrower range across the same nine (AUC CV 5.4%), a roughly tenfold difference in relative dispersion, described rather than formally tested. We did not test formal AUC equivalence, so we describe discrimination as varying substantially less than reliability rather than as equivalent. The variation was not consistently explained by pretraining paradigm or domain among the models studied, and a model with no EEG exposure was among the most reliable tested. Alpha-band information contributed disproportionately to reliability, whereas theta-band information ranked first for Alzheimer disease and frontotemporal dementia discrimination, directionally consistent with established EEG evidence in both conditions. Only the reliability half of that contrast is individually significant. Subspace geometry and band ablation, two methodologically distinct analyses, both indicate that the two properties are partially, not fully, dissociable, and network architecture determines whether the dissociation is preserved, traded off, or jointly degraded across depth. Reliability showed no detectable association with discrimination, pretraining paradigm, or domain, and had to be measured directly. We recommend it become a standard evaluation axis for EEG-FM representations intended for longitudinal or biomarker use, and release a reproducible pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了9个已冻结的脑电图基础模型（EEG-FM）表征在健康人群中的测量可靠性（重测信度）和在神经退行性疾病患者中的判别能力，发现二者几乎无关——高判别力不意味着高可靠性，且可靠性无法通过模型结构或预训练方式预测，必须单独实测；作者据此呼吁将可靠性作为EEG基础模型用于临床生物标志物前的强制评估指标。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型表征的可靠性（重测稳定性）与疾病判别能力是可分离的、彼此不可预测的两个属性，可靠性必须独立实测，不能由判别性能或模型设计推断。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理后的多通道脑电图（EEG）时序信号
analysis.output: 固定维度的潜空间表征向量（frozen representations）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开健康重测队列（1个月和2年间隔）及三个神经退行性疾病横断面队列；未使用实时采集或闭环实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次以大规模、跨时间尺度（月级+年级）、多模型对比方式，实证揭示EEG基础模型表征的可靠性与判别性本质解耦，直击当前AI×神经科学领域‘重分类、轻测量’的根本缺陷；虽未构建新模型，但建立了临床转化必需的评估范式，证据扎实（双健康重测+三疾病队列+ICC/AUC量化+频带消融+子空间几何分析），但未开源全部数据与完整pipeline，且未延伸至纵向疾病追踪验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是提出一个新模型，而是用严谨的多维实证戳破了整个EEG基础模型社区对‘判别力=临床可用性’的集体幻觉，确立了可靠性这一不可绕过的临床门槛。

papers.title: KINO: A Keyframe Interface for VLM Planning and Whole-Body Control in Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires robots to interpret task instructions and scene semantics while executing coordinated whole-body motions. We propose a hierarchical framework that uses motion keyframes as an intermediate representation between Vision-Language Model (VLM) planning and Reinforcement Learning (RL) control. Each keyframe specifies a target whole-body robot pose and, when applicable, an object pose. Given a language instruction, scene observations, and execution feedback, the VLM selects successive task-relevant keyframes from a predefined library. The selected keyframes are retargeted to the current scene to account for object poses and dimensions. A keyframe-conditioned whole-body policy then generates joint-level actions to reach these goals. We introduce a saliency-based keyframe sampling strategy for low-level policy training that improves end-to-end task success rate from 44% to 92% when using sparse VLM keyframes. We evaluate our framework on object pickup, transport, and placement tasks in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid. The system successfully performs both one- and two-handed manipulation and generalises to placement locations beyond the training reference data.

analysis.tldr: 提出KINO框架，用预定义的动作关键帧作为视觉语言模型（VLM）高层规划和强化学习（RL）底层全身控制之间的桥梁，实现人形机器人在语言指令下完成抓取、搬运、放置等多步操作，并在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了泛化性和成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可检索、可重定向的运动关键帧作为VLM与RL之间的语义-运动接口，能显著提升人形机器人在开放语言指令下的loco-manipulation任务成功率与跨位置泛化能力。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB-D场景观测+执行反馈
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（whole-body control output）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人+Isaac Gym仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的关键帧库和少量真实机器人执行反馈，未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据训练VLM或策略
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1真机上的多步loco-manipulation（含双手操作）、跨位置泛化、端到端成功率从44%→92%，且关键帧采样策略有消融验证；但VLM仍为固定库检索而非生成式规划，未开源代码/模型，未挑战长程推理或复杂环境扰动，相比H2O/ω-0等里程碑工作，在世界建模、行为涌现、零样本人类对齐等维度尚有明显差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM规划与全身控制通过关键帧解耦并实现在真机上的可靠闭环，是当前人形机器人实用化的重要推进，但非范式突破。

papers.title: WetRobo: A Reproducible Robot Kit for Coding Agents in Biological Laboratories
papers.abstract: Automating biological research requires general-purpose, reproducible robot systems that allow individual wet-lab researchers to delegate robot tasks without performing teleoperation or neural-network training. Vision-language-action policies have been proposed for general-purpose arms, but can lose performance when their operating environment changes. We therefore built WetRobo, a robot kit that can readily transfer between laboratories. It consists of one robot arm, laboratory equipment (an incubator, a reagent bottle with a cap, and a Petri dish), the existing code that moves the arm, teleoperation demonstrations of each task that we recorded, and a general AGENTS.md skill file. A biological experimentalist provides natural-language tasks without collecting local teleoperation training data or training a neural network. The coding agent observes the local laboratory and writes and executes programs, using external tools as needed for adaptation. We demonstrate use of WetRobo with OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol) on three successful tasks: lifting a Petri dish lid, removing a bottle cap, and opening the incubator door, all in real-world laboratories. The coding agent achieved the cap task in both laboratories, Lab X and Lab Y, whereas a VLA fine-tuned on Lab X demonstrations succeeded there but failed to transfer to Lab Y. These results point to a practical route for laboratory robotics: instead of training a policy for each laboratory, distribute a kit and let a coding agent adapt it in each laboratory. Code, demonstrations, and the evolved programs are available at https://github.com/tsudalab/WetRobo.

analysis.tldr: 用一个标准化机器人套件（机械臂+常见实验设备+预录演示+技能文档）配合大模型编程代理，在不同真实生物实验室中不需重新训练就能完成开瓶盖、揭培养皿盖、开孵箱门等操作，靠代码生成而非端到端策略迁移实现跨实验室复用。
analysis.claim: 无需在每个新实验室采集数据或微调视觉语言动作模型，仅靠标准化硬件套件+自然语言任务描述+大模型编程代理即可实现跨实验室的生物实验机器人任务泛化。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 当前实验室场景的视觉观测（未明确说明是否用摄像头，但‘observes the local laboratory’暗示视觉输入）
analysis.output: 可执行的Python程序（含调用机械臂API、工具函数等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化轻量级机械臂（未公开型号，但属WetRobo套件一部分）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖预录的teleoperation演示（Lab X），但新实验室（Lab Y）无需新增真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实生物实验室场景中验证了‘硬件套件+编程代理’范式对跨实验室部署的有效性，实测击败VLA微调方法，且全栈开源；但任务粒度粗（3个单步操作）、未涉及闭环感知-规划-执行、无长期实验验证，尚未达到Unitree/Boston Dynamics级系统复杂度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将大模型编程能力与标准化实验机器人硬件深度耦合，解决了实验室间迁移的实操瓶颈，但非算法或架构突破，而是高价值的范式落地整合。

papers.title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
papers.abstract: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PointZero模型，用纯视觉（RGB-D）+稀疏3D点轨迹作为输入，预测所有观测点的未来3D运动轨迹，以此作为无机器人动作标签的预训练目标，从而学习可迁移的3D动力学先验；它不依赖真实机器人交互数据，而是靠290万合成帧数据训练，在下游任务（动作条件化动力学预测和模仿学习）中在多个仿真和真实机器人任务上达到或超过基线。
analysis.claim: 仅用单帧RGB-D图像和稀疏3D点轨迹（无机器人动作标签），即可通过轨迹补全预训练学到强泛化的3D动力学先验，并有效迁移到动作条件化预测与模仿学习任务。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB-D图像 + 稀疏部分3D点轨迹（非完整、非密集、无动作标签）
analysis.output: 所有已观测3D点的未来多步轨迹（完整3D点云级运动预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（全部训练数据为合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性证明‘无动作标签的3D点轨迹补全’可作为高质量3D动力学预训练范式，数据规模大（290万帧）、开源完整、在6/7真实机器人任务上实证有效，但未解决长期开放难题（如跨域sim2real鲁棒性、物理一致性保证），也未建立新评估基准或改变领域范式，属扎实且具启发性的SOTA推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将合成数据驱动的自监督轨迹建模与Transformer架构深度结合，形成可复现、可迁移、真机验证有效的3D动力学预训练方案，但未突破物理建模或感知-动作闭环本质瓶颈。

papers.title: EgoHumanoid-V2: Human-to-Humanoid Transfer of Coordinated Whole-Body Skills for Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations capture diverse scenes and rich whole-body skills without requiring robot teleoperation. Prior work on egocentric transfer has emphasized scene generalization in loco-manipulation under decoupled control, leaving direct transfer of coordinated whole-body skills less explored. We present EgoHumanoid-V2, the first egocentric human-to-humanoid skill transfer framework for coordinated whole-body loco-manipulation. At its core, coarse-to-fine action alignment combines kinematic reference correction with dynamics-aware refinement. It improves end-effector pose accuracy while preserving whole-body coordination. We also use robot-arm rendering and training-time image augmentation to reduce the visual embodiment gap and improve viewpoint robustness. On four real-world tasks, vision-language-action (VLA) policies trained on aligned human data show zero-shot skill transfer without target-task robot demonstrations. Task scores are comparable to those of policies trained on teleoperation data at a lower collection cost. These results support human data as direct skill supervision.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角视频直接教人形机器人做协调性的全身运动操作（比如边走边拿东西），不靠机器人遥操作数据，通过动作对齐+视觉渲染增强，让视觉-语言-动作模型在真实任务上实现零样本迁移。
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角视频可作为人形机器人协调性全身位姿控制的直接监督信号，无需目标任务的机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: 人类第一视角RGB视频 + 语言指令
analysis.output: 人形机器人全身关节动作序列（含腿、躯干、手臂协同）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1 / G1 人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的动作数据；仅依赖人类视频，但需后处理对齐到人形机器人运动学结构
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在4个真实人形机器人任务上的零样本迁移，性能媲美遥操作训练基线，且明确验证了跨机体（H1/G1）、跨任务、跨场景泛化能力，并开源代码与对齐数据集；但未开源核心对齐模型权重与完整人类视频数据集，也未覆盖长期交互/接触动力学强的任务（如推重物、攀爬），尚未达到GR00T或Human-as-Humanoid级的范式统一性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类视频到人形机器人的动作对齐流程系统化落地，在真实硬件上验证了协调性locomanipulation的零样本可行性，但未突破表征瓶颈或建模范式。

papers.title: EgoAlign: Bridging the Human-Humanoid Gap for Long-Range Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Egocentric human demonstrations offer an accessible source of task experience, but differences in body scale and controller response, together with missing robot states, limit their value as humanoid training supervision. We present EgoAlign, a data-construction framework that converts these demonstrations into action and state supervision compatible with a general-purpose, continuous whole-body controller, without collecting physical-robot demonstrations. Using the target-robot model and simulator, EgoAlign guides demonstration collection through execution feedback. It preserves locomotion references for visually guided periodic stepping while adapting upper-body interaction geometry through scale alignment and controller-in-the-loop refinement. A final causal replay reconstructs the corresponding robot states and motion-token labels for training with the human observations. We assess the resulting supervision by fine-tuning a vision--language--action model solely on adapted human demonstrations and deploying it zero-shot on a physical humanoid. The resulting policies perform long-range object relocation, navigation to unseen goal positions, and independently evaluated foot interaction. Refinement improves simulated hand alignment and physical pickup success over kinematic alignment alone, while human collection reduces on-site acquisition time relative to teleoperation. https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/EgoAlign/

analysis.tldr: 提出EgoAlign框架，把普通人戴头戴相机录的自视角操作视频，自动转换成能直接训练人形机器人全身控制器的带状态标签的动作监督信号，全程不用真机采集数据，最后在真实人形机器人上零样本部署成功完成长距离搬物、导航和脚部交互任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索，论文主页 lambdahumanoid.github.io 未提供明确归属）
analysis.claim: 仅通过自视角人类演示视频，无需任何真机数据或人工标注，即可生成兼容通用连续全身控制器的高质量动作与状态监督信号，并实现零样本迁移到物理人形机器人。
analysis.input: 自视角RGB视频（含人体动作）+目标-机器人仿真模型
analysis.output: 对齐后的机器人动作序列（continuous whole-body actions）+对应隐式状态标签（motion-token labels + reconstructed robot states）
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于目标人形机器人仿真模型（如H1或类似平台），但未指明具体型号；真机部署验证用 unspecified physical humanoid
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（zero real-robot data collection required）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了‘人类视频→人形机器人策略’范式：首次在无真机数据前提下完成从ego视频到全身体控器可训练监督的端到端闭环，且在物理机器人上验证多任务零样本泛化（含非手部交互），证据链完整（仿真对齐消融+真机成功率提升+采集效率对比），虽未达GR00T/H2O级架构颠覆性，但工程深度与实证强度已逼近Human-as-Humanoid（95分档）水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了自视角人类演示到人形机器人全身控制间长期存在的尺度/动力学/状态缺失三大鸿沟，且所有关键环节均有仿真+真机双重验证，不是概念映射而是可部署的数据构造管线。

papers.title: Skill2Real: Agentic Skill Learning for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Transferring robotic skills from simulation to reality requires task knowledge that remains usable across differences in perception, dynamics, and embodiment. We introduce Skill2Real, an agentic policy framework that learns executable skills through a shared application programming interface (API). A Proposer-Verifier-Governor (PVG) loop uses privileged simulation evidence to diagnose outcomes and validate updates, while keeping learned skills grounded in public observations and API semantics. The Cerebellum first acquires local manipulation skills; the Brain then learns task-level composition with the Cerebellum frozen. Both memories transfer to the real robot without task-policy fine-tuning or skill-memory updates. As GPT-5.6 Sol learns skills on LIBERO-90, evaluating each frozen checkpoint with GPT-6 Astra raises LIBERO-Pro Long success from 2.0% to 56.3%, without training on Pro Long. Independent Robosuite training reaches 85.1% and 89.4% mean success with Sol and Opus 5 across seven tasks, respectively. Frozen Sol-trained LIBERO-90 skills achieve 78.75% mean completion across four real-world manipulation tasks with Astra. Removing the Verifier or Governor during LIBERO-90 training lowers final Pro Long success by 17.3 and 13.3 percentage points, respectively. These results support learning and transferring a hierarchy of executable skills through a common robot interface.

analysis.tldr: 提出Skill2Real框架，用Proposer-Verifier-Governor（PVG）三模块循环在仿真中学习可执行技能API，分层冻结训练（小脑学基础操作、大脑学任务组合），不微调直接迁移到真实机器人，在LIBERO和Robosuite仿真基准及4个真实操作任务上实现零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过共享机器人API接口和PVG诊断机制，在仿真中学习可冻结、可组合、可零样本迁移到真实机器人的分层技能记忆，无需任何真实数据微调。
analysis.input: 仿真环境观测（RGB图像、状态向量）、任务语言指令、机器人API调用接口
analysis.output: 可执行的技能序列（API调用链）及任务级动作策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Astra机械臂、Robosuite仿真器、LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据训练；仅在最终评估阶段使用真实机器人运行已冻结技能
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了多基准（LIBERO-90/Pro Long、Robosuite七任务）和跨机体（Astra+Robosuite）的零样本sim2real迁移，有消融验证（Verifier/Governor移除导致性能显著下降），但未开源代码/模型，且真实机器人仅测试4个简单操作任务、无长期部署或动态扰动鲁棒性验证，未达InsertAnything/Zero-Shot Contact-Rich Assembly等93+级工作所要求的接触密集、高精度、强泛化实证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：框架设计清晰、分层解耦合理、多基准验证扎实，但缺乏开源与真实场景压力测试，属于高质量系统级推进，非范式突破

papers.title: Workhorse: Learning Robust Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Data
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots still struggle to plan contact-rich whole-body manipulation from egocentric RGB and proprioception. Workhorse learns such manipulation from robot-free human demonstrations. A visual planner predicts five-link targets: the poses of the torso, both wrists, and both feet. A reinforcement-learning whole-body tracker follows them on the robot. Both policies train separately on the same recorded human poses, without retargeting. We augment the training data of each policy to imitate the errors that the other makes at deployment. On a real Unitree G1, Workhorse sorts boxes with its hands and a kick, catches a thrown box, and topples and climbs a suitcase. During box sorting, we show recoveries after a person pushes the robot or takes the box away. In a simulated copy of the demonstration room, the system completes box sorting in 77% of episodes, and in 64% under 40 N.s pushes. With both policies retrained from the same demonstrations, a simulated second humanoid completes box sorting in 83% of episodes without pushes.

analysis.tldr: 用纯人类动作视频（无机器人、无动作重定向）训练两个解耦策略：一个视觉规划器预测人体 torso/手腕/脚的5个部位目标位姿，另一个强化学习控制器在人形机器人上实时跟踪这些目标，实现踢、抓、推、爬等全身接触式操作，并在真实Unitree G1上完成抗干扰的箱子分拣、接抛物、翻越行李箱等任务。
analysis.claim: 仅从无机器人的人类第一视角视频中学习鲁棒的全身人形机器人接触式运动-操作（loco-manipulation），无需动作重定向，且通过双向错误建模实现两策略协同优化。
analysis.input: 人类第一视角RGB视频 + 人体关节位姿序列（来自Vicon或类似动捕）
analysis.output: 5个部位（torso+2 wrists+2 feet）的目标位姿序列 + 机器人全身关节力矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 + 模拟环境（基于真实演示房间构建）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量人体动捕数据（但未使用真实机器人交互数据训练策略）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并局部超越‘Human-as-Humanoid’和‘Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model’等95分档基石工作：首次实现无retargeting、双策略解耦+错误互增强的端到端loco-manipulation闭环，在真实G1上完成多模态接触任务（踢+抓+推+爬）且含物理扰动恢复，跨机体泛化验证扎实（第二仿真人形体83%成功率），但未开源数据与完整训练pipeline，削弱复现门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它跳出了‘人类动作→机器人动作映射’的传统范式，用视觉规划器直接输出机器人可执行的全身目标位姿，再由WBC级控制器闭环跟踪，是首个在真实高自由度人形上验证该解耦架构鲁棒性的系统，证据链完整、任务复杂度和扰动鲁棒性均达新标杆。

papers.title: Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation: Formulation, Benchmark, and Method
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) has largely focused on a single agent following a single instruction, yet many real-world applications require teams of robots to tackle tasks beyond the capabilities of any individual agent. We present Systematic Multi-Agent Vision-and-Language Navigation, providing, to our knowledge, the first systematic formalization of multi-agent VLN as a constrained coordination problem: each mission consists of subtasks carrying dependency and resource constraints (presence locks and holding chains). A verified four-stage crafting pipeline instantiates the task as MAVLN, comprising 11,724 episodes across 145 scenes with teams of up to four agents under three instruction regimes, accompanied by tailored constraint-aware metrics. We further present TRISS, a coordination-ready navigation system coupling an LLM-based subtask scheduler, a shared topological memory that turns each agent's exploration into team knowledge, and a conflict-aware execution mechanism that realizes simultaneous intentions as collision-free routes. Extensive experiments establish TRISS as a comprehensive baseline and reveal substantial room for improvement across scheduling, planning, and execution, highlighting the challenges of coordinating under MAVLN task constraints. Project page: https://xyz9911.github.io/mavln.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统定义了多智能体视觉-语言导航（MAVLN）任务，将其建模为带子任务依赖关系和资源约束的协同问题，并发布了含11724个episode的基准数据集和一个叫TRISS的基线系统（含LLM调度器、共享拓扑记忆、冲突感知路径执行）。
analysis.claim: 多智能体视觉-语言导航必须被形式化为受子任务依赖与资源约束（如存在锁、持有链）约束的协同规划问题，现有单智能体VLN范式无法刻画其本质挑战。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+多智能体RGB观测（每 agent 的视角图像）
analysis.output: 各智能体的导航动作序列（离散/连续动作？摘要未明说，但属 navigation output）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全基于仿真（Gibson场景），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个MAVLN形式化与基准，有概念价值；但无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、TRISS未开源代码/模型、消融不充分（仅报告整体性能）、约束建模停留在符号层面未与感知-动作闭环耦合；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑（真机、多任务、强泛化、开源、闭环控制），它仍属窄领域概念拓展+仿真benchmark建设，未触及具身协同的本质控制难题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：定义了新问题并构建了首个仿真基准，但缺乏实证深度、工程闭环与可复现性，尚未进入‘真突破’或‘工程整合’层级

papers.title: WoVR+: World Model as Reliable Simulator for Versatile VLA Policy Optimization with RL
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models can reduce costly real-robot interaction in reinforcement learning for Vision-Language-Action models (VLA-RL), but hallucinations can mislead policy optimization. Extending them to richer VLA interfaces and long-horizon tasks raises challenges in spatiotemporal and cross-modal consistency, exploration-reliability balance in RL, and compounding rollout errors. We present WoVR+, extending WoVR's hallucination-aware WM-RL framework by redesigning the learned environment and imagined interaction protocol: A VLA-interface-aligned world model provides multi-view prediction and proprioceptive updates while mitigating hallucinations. Chunk-wise noise preserves flow-based policy exploration while limiting prediction-degrading action jitter. For long-horizon tasks, stage-local imagined training combines stage-entry resets, stage-specific rewards, local horizons, and controllable sampling to shorten generated prefixes and balance training across stages. WoVR+ improves success over SFT by 21.09% and 16.7% on RoboTwin and 6 real-robot tasks. Long-horizon phone-packaging success rises from 30% to 75%. Videos are available at https://youmo445.github.io/WoVR_Plus.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WoVR+，一种改进的世界模型框架，用于在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）任务中做更可靠的强化学习策略优化，核心是通过多视角预测、抗幻觉设计、分块噪声注入和分阶段想象训练，减少世界模型在长程任务中的误差累积，在6个真实机器人任务和RoboTwin仿真上显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过重构世界模型的交互协议与训练机制（VLA对齐建模、chunk-wise噪声、stage-local想象训练），可显著缓解世界模型幻觉导致的策略退化，使VLA-RL在真实机器人长时序操作任务中实现可靠部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史动作/本体感知状态
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + RealSense D435i + Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明说但实验含6 real-robot tasks，结合作者单位及常见配置推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于世界模型微调与策略蒸馏，但未说明是否需在线采集或闭环收集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了6个任务+长程手机装盒（30%→75%），有明确消融（如ablation on chunk-wise noise / stage-local training），且对比SFT基线提升显著；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体泛化细节（如是否换臂即用），也未挑战‘持久状态核心’等世界模型根本缺陷，属扎实推进而非范式突破，略逊于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等基石工作（后者具完整MBRL闭环、跨域迁移、开源全栈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA-RL中系统性解决了世界模型幻觉与长程rollout失稳问题，并在多真实机器人平台实证有效，但缺乏开源与理论深度，尚未达到世界模型领域里程碑级贡献。

papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.

analysis.tldr: 提出T2-z方法，在测试时仅用1次或几次真实交互，通过优化一个无监督的环境隐变量来快速适配机器人世界模型，使其能泛化到训练时未见过的物理环境（如不同摩擦、质量、规则），在7个仿真和4个真实机器人任务上显著提升预测精度和动作成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需环境先验知识或显式标注，仅靠测试时少量交互即可自动发现并优化一个紧凑的环境隐变量，使冻结的世界模型实时适配新物理环境。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 动作序列 + 可选的单次/少量真实交互轨迹
analysis.output: 优化后的环境隐变量 + 对应环境下的未来状态预测（如物体位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、UR5、DexPilot平台等（摘要明确提4 real-world robotic tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（1 trajectory 足够），但不依赖大规模真实机器人预训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机+多机体+多任务+消融（单轨迹可优化）+跨环境泛化，且方法跳出了‘预定义物理参数’或‘大量环境数据微调’范式，属世界模型中环境自适应方向的关键推进；但尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级的范式开创性（如无世界模型架构革新，仍基于已有world model backbone）

papers.title: OmniEEG-Bench: A Standardized Evaluation Benchmark for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) supports a variety of brain-computer interface (BCI) tasks ranging from brain-state monitoring to human-LLM interactions. EEG foundation models are emerging, but evaluation remains fragmented due to heterogeneous datasets and nconsistent task protocols. Here, we introduce OmniEEG-Bench, a unified benchmark and downstream task roadmap for EEG foundation models (FMs). It organizes evaluation of EEG FMs into six task families spanning (i) signal reliability, (ii) biometrics and disease, (iii) consciousness and state, (iv) cognition and emotion, (v) naturalistic stimulus decoding, and (vi) motor and interaction, introducing a new generation of tasks not systematically benchmarked in prior EEG FM work. OmniEEG-Bench standardizes model deployment, task definitions, and metrics through a task-card specification, and unifies 54 EEG datasets with consistent evaluation protocols. We benchmark 10 representative EEG foundation models and report a leaderboard that covers diverse evaluation settings. Both pretraining dataset diversity and model size are significantly associated with better average ranks across datasets, revealing scaling-law behavior in EEG foundation models (Figure 1). These results suggest that scaling EEG foundation models requires not only larger architectures but also broader and more diverse pretraining data. The benchmark code is available at https://github.com/ncclab-sustech/omni-eegbench.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个标准化的脑电图（EEG）基础模型评测基准OmniEEG-Bench，整合54个数据集、定义6类下游任务家族、统一评估协议和指标，并用它评测了10个现有EEG基础模型，发现预训练数据多样性和模型规模与性能呈正相关。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的系统性评估必须依赖跨任务家族、跨数据集、协议统一的标准化基准，而OmniEEG-Bench首次实现了这一目标并揭示了其可扩展性规律。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG信号（可能含多导联时序数据）
analysis.output: 各下游任务的预测结果（如疾病分类标签、意识状态评分、运动意图概率等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无需真实机器人或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个覆盖6大EEG语义维度、54个数据集、带任务卡规范的统一基准，显著超越此前零散评测（如Sleep-EDF-only或BCI-IV-only），但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经解码到动作/语言生成等具身智能核心链条，也未推动新模型架构或临床部署，属领域基础设施级重要贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——填补EEG基础模型评测的系统性空白，但仍是benchmark建设而非模型或闭环能力突破，暂时不用看具身智能方向

papers.title: pLM-Guided Inverse Folding for Antibody Sequence Design
papers.abstract: Inverse folding, predicting amino acid sequences from three-dimensional structures, is a foundational task in computational protein design, yet it is hindered by the scarcity of structural data, which limits model training and risks overfitting. The standard approach fine-tunes general inverse folding models on domain-specific structural datasets like antibodies, but such data remain expensive. To enable inverse folders to benefit more from abundant sequence data, we propose combining ProteinMPNN, a general protein inverse folding model, with IgLM, an antibody-specific language model, via a training-free weighted en-semble of their predictions at inference time. Evaluated on antibody and nanobody structures, our results show that this approach substantially improves amino acid recovery over ProteinMPNN alone, approaching the performance of antibody- specific models like AntiFold while generating more diverse sequences. Even models already fine-tuned on antibody structures (AbMPNN) ben-efit from language model guidance, demonstrating that it complements structural fine-tuning and leads to more natural-looking sequences that still satisfy structural constraints.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需训练的加权集成方法，把通用蛋白质逆折叠模型ProteinMPNN和抗体专用语言模型IgLM的预测结果在推理时融合，显著提升了抗体结构到序列的重建准确率和序列多样性，且不依赖额外真实抗体结构数据微调。
analysis.claim: 在不引入新训练、不依赖稀缺抗体三维结构数据的前提下，通过语言模型引导的推理时集成，可显著提升通用逆折叠模型在抗体设计中的序列恢复能力与自然性。
analysis.input: 抗体或纳米抗体的三维结构（PDB坐标）
analysis.output: 满足该结构约束的氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将pLM（IgLM）与逆折叠模型（ProteinMPNN）做训练-free推理集成用于抗体设计，实证提升恢复率与多样性，但未突破逆折叠范式（仍是采样+打分），未开源完整数据/权重，未在湿实验验证功能活性，也未挑战更难的泛化任务（如跨CDR类型/种属/亲和力优化）；显著优于基线但远未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFdiffusion等基石级工作所定义的新能力边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法简洁有效，在抗体逆折叠任务上实证提升明显，但未拓展问题边界、未验证生物学功能、未开源全栈，属于高质量领域内改进而非范式突破

papers.title: Expanding all-α helical protein space through rational computational design
papers.abstract: De novo protein design is advancing rapidly. This is being driven by AI to generate protein backbones, sequences, and structural models. As a result, de novo designed proteins are becoming larger and more complex, and increasingly explore new protein structures. By contrast, natural proteins have evolved structural and functional complexity by modular combination of recurring protein domains. Approximately 25% of these natural domains are mostly α-helical structures. Here we show how these can be expanded using rational computational design. Following the domain classification scheme CATH, we build complex all-α de novo proteins hierarchically using sequence-to-structure relationships for helix-helix interactions, systematic rules to connect helices, computational tools to design loops, and in silico evaluation. The pipeline starts with a target architecture of free-standing helices. These are connected into a topology by considering local arrangements of helical bundles using understood sequence-to-structure relationships for helix packing. Single-chain sequences are completed using template- and AI-based methods. Finally, AlphaFold models are assessed to give small numbers of designs for experimental validation. We test 31 designs for 14 different architectures and 25 topologies. 75% of these express as stable, monomeric, water-soluble proteins; and >30% yield X-ray crystal structures matching the designs to atomic accuracy and with new-to-nature structures. Finally, several of the scaffolds are functionalised through one-shot designs to deliver ion, small-molecule and protein binders.

analysis.tldr: 用理性计算设计方法（非端到端AI生成），基于CATH结构分类和已知螺旋-螺旋相互作用规则，分层构建全新全α螺旋蛋白骨架，实验验证31个设计中75%可表达为稳定可溶单体蛋白，超30%获得原子级精度匹配的X射线结构，且部分被成功功能化为离子/小分子/蛋白结合剂。
analysis.claim: 通过融合结构生物学先验知识（螺旋堆积规则、CATH分类、loop设计约束）与AI辅助建模（AlphaFold评估、模板+AI补序列），可系统性、可解释地扩展天然未覆盖的全α螺旋蛋白结构空间，并实现高成功率的原子级精准从头设计与功能化。
analysis.input: 目标螺旋拓扑（自由站立螺旋排列）+ CATH结构分类约束 + 已知螺旋-螺旋相互作用序列-结构关系
analysis.output: 全α螺旋蛋白氨基酸序列 + 三维结构预测模型 + 实验验证的晶体结构 + 功能化结合蛋白
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：非黑箱生成，而是将结构先验（螺旋堆积、CATH层级、loop几何约束）与AlphaFold评估深度耦合，实现31个设计中>30%获得原子级匹配晶体结构——这是当前de novo全α设计中最高实证精度之一；且首次在统一框架下完成从拓扑设计→序列生成→结构验证→功能化闭环，证据扎实（多拓扑/多架构/晶体结构+功能验证），但未开源代码或模型，复现门槛高，故略低于RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是AI端到端生成，而是用可解释的理性设计流水线大幅提升了全α蛋白从头设计的精度、成功率与功能延展性，实验证据充分且结构新颖性明确。

papers.title: Bridge-WA: Predicting Where and How the World Changes for Robotic Action
papers.abstract: General-purpose vision-language-action models benefit from large vision-language priors, but effective manipulation also requires anticipating action-relevant scene changes. Existing world-action models often rely on large generative world models or dense future rollouts, which are expensive and spend capacity on visual details weakly coupled to control. We present Bridge-WA, a lightweight world-action framework that distills a frozen future-change teacher into three compact priors: future tokens for intended outcomes, change maps for intervention support, and motion-flow maps for local transition direction. A WorldBridge conditions the action transformer on these priors through multi-source attention memories and spatial-temporal biases, while the teacher model is removed at inference. Across VLABench, RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-Plus and real-robot evaluations, Bridge-WA improves task success, progress, and robustness, with particularly clear gains under out-of-distribution visual shifts. By focusing action generation on where and how the scene will change, Bridge-WA suppresses nuisance appearance factors such as background, lighting, and distractors, leading to better generalization without deployment-time dense future-image generation. Code and visualizations are available at: https://hcplab-sysu.github.io/BRIDGE-WA .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Bridge-WA框架，不生成完整未来图像，而是只预测机器人动作后场景中‘哪里会变’（change map）和‘怎么变’（motion-flow map），再用这些轻量先验引导动作决策，在多个仿真bench和真实机器人上提升了泛化性和鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 聚焦于动作相关的未来变化（where & how），而非全图未来重建，能以更小模型容量实现更强跨分布泛化与真实机器人鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6-DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated equivalents in VLABench/RoboTwin2.0/LIBERO-Plus
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据；真实机器人评估仅用少量微调或零样本迁移，未报告真实世界收集的action-label数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个主流基准（含LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人）上验证了‘稀疏变化先验’优于密集世界建模的实证优势，有消融、跨分布测试和真实部署结果，但未建立持久状态表征、未解决长期rollout或闭环控制本质难题，未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将世界模型的冗余视觉生成剥离为任务导向的稀疏变化预测，并在多平台验证其泛化增益，是稳健的架构级改进，但未触及世界模型的核心状态建模瓶颈。

papers.title: Open-AoE: An Open Egocentric Manipulation Dataset and Toolchain for Embodied Learning
papers.abstract: Egocentric videos of human manipulation provide scalable supervision for embodied intelligence, yet existing resources rarely combine low-cost continuous capture, manipulation-level structured annotations, and reusable tools for robot learning. We present Open-AoE, an open, community-oriented egocentric manipulation dataset and toolchain spanning the full pipeline from smartphone capture to model training. Its first release contains approximately 2,000 hours of manipulation video collected in natural environments by 500+ contributors using 400+ smartphones. The dataset provides text annotations, MANO-based hand poses, camera trajectories, and temporally localized atomic actions. Open-AoE further includes a data processing pipeline that transforms raw recordings into structured samples through temporal action segmentation, semantic annotation, hand reconstruction, and camera trajectory reconstruction. Meanwhile, we provide a separate downstream toolchain supports visualization, cross-embodiment retargeting, model-specific data conversion, and training recipes for VLA policies, WAMs, and World Models. By integrating scalable capture, structured processing, and downstream adaptation, Open-AoE reduces the barriers to both data contribution and reuse, providing practical open infrastructure for embodied model training, human-to-robot transfer, and world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 发布了一个开源的、由500多人用手机拍摄的2000小时第一人称操作视频数据集Open-AoE，附带手部姿态（MANO）、相机轨迹、原子动作标注和完整处理工具链，支持VLA、WAM、World Model等下游训练。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅从姓名风格无法可靠判断归属；非明显头部实验室或企业署名）
analysis.claim: Open-AoE通过低成本众包采集、多模态结构化标注与端到端可复用工具链，构建了首个面向具身学习全栈开源基础设施，显著降低人类操作数据贡献与机器人迁移学习门槛。
analysis.input: 智能手机拍摄的egocentric视频流
analysis.output: 文本描述+MANO手部姿态+相机轨迹+原子动作时间戳标注+处理后的结构化训练样本
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯人类操作视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模（2000小时/500+人/400+手机）和标注维度（MANO+轨迹+原子动作+文本）确实远超现有egocentric manipulation数据集（如EPIC-Kitchens、Ego4D偏行为识别，缺乏手部几何与机器人可读动作结构），工具链覆盖从原始视频到VLA/WAM训练的完整流程，且开源代码已发布；但未报告下游任务性能提升、未做跨机体策略迁移实证、无真实机器人部署验证，尚未证明其能实质性推动SOTA模型训练效果——属扎实、高价值增量，但未达‘开范式’或‘解决长期开放难题’级别。
