papers.title: Never Too Late for Force: Accelerating VLA Post-Training with Reactive Force Injection
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong language-conditioned manipulation knowledge, but they remain largely vision-driven and can struggle once manipulation enters contact states where the scene is occluded, depth is ambiguous, or small force errors push execution off the offline demonstration distribution. We present LIFT (Late Reactive Injection of Force for VLA Post-Training), a force-aware post-training framework that adds contact reactivity to a pretrained VLA policy while preserving its general manipulation knowledge. LIFT grafts a reactive action expert beside the original action expert, initializes it from pretrained action weights, and injects recent 6D end-effector force through causal force memory and zero-initialized cross attention, enabling actions to be refreshed during execution. To address the policy-dependent distribution shift of contact feedback, LIFT further couples reactive force injection with an online DAgger loop that trains on a mixture of offline task-alignment data and human-corrected online rollouts. Across towel folding, book insertion, and Hanoi ring placement, LIFT learns faster and reaches higher performance than vision-only post-training, while ablations show that reactive force memory and online corrective data are both important for robust contact-rich manipulation. Our code and data will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LIFT方法，在已有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型基础上，通过在后训练阶段注入实时6D力觉信号（配合因果力记忆和零初始化交叉注意力），并结合在线DAgger纠偏机制，让模型在接触态操作（如毛巾折叠、书本插入）中更鲁棒；不改原始VLA主干，只加轻量力响应模块。
analysis.claim: 在不破坏预训练VLA策略通用性前提下，仅通过后训练阶段引入轻量级、可插拔的力觉响应机制与在线人类纠偏闭环，即可显著提升其在接触密集型操作任务中的执行鲁棒性与收敛速度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+最近6D末端力（含力/力矩）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要未明说但实验任务及force injection设计隐含依赖该类力控臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的在线人类纠偏rollout数据（DAgger loop），且需力传感器实时反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证3个接触敏感任务，有消融（力记忆/在线DAgger缺一不可）、多baseline对比（vision-only post-training）、开源代码数据；但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未挑战更复杂接触动力学（如塑性变形、流体交互），也未证明对现有SOTA VLA（如OpenVLA/Octo）的普适增强效果，属扎实且具工程落地价值的增量突破，尚未达范式级（如RT-2/π0）或架构级解耦创新（如DAM-VLA/CHORUS）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将力觉模态以低侵入方式嵌入VLA后训练流程，并用在线人类纠偏闭环解决接触态分布偏移，实证充分、开源完整，但未突破VLA基础架构或扩展至多机体/长时序强耦合接触场景

papers.title: DRIFT: Derailing Denoising Trajectories of Flow-Matching VLAs with Adversarial Patch Attack
papers.abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models such as pi0 generate robot actions by integrating a learned denoising velocity field, and have been reported to resist adversarial perturbations that readily fool autoregressive VLAs. We show that this robustness is largely illusory: it stems from prior attacks ignoring the multi-step denoising ODE. We introduce DRIFT (Denoising Redirection via Input perturbation of the Flow-matching Trajectory), a test-time universal adversarial patch placed on the robot's gripper that attacks the denoising velocity field of an off-the-shelf policy. Our central finding is counterintuitive: attacking only the first denoising step is both stronger and cheaper than attacking a wider window of steps, which we explain through a gradient conflict unique to input-space optimization and which is exactly opposite to the training-time backdoor regime. On pi0 and pi0.5 across four LIBERO suites, DRIFT breaks essentially all originally-solvable tasks with a small single patch, far exceeding action- and embedding-space attack baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前主流的流匹配型视觉语言动作模型（如pi0）宣称的抗对抗攻击能力其实很脆弱，作者设计了一种贴在机械手夹爪上的通用对抗补丁（DRIFT），只扰动第一步去噪过程就能高效破坏模型输出动作，从而在多个标准任务套件上几乎让所有原本能完成的任务全部失败。
analysis.claim: 流匹配VLA模型（如pi0）对对抗攻击的鲁棒性是虚假的，其根源在于先前攻击未建模多步去噪ODE动力学；仅扰动第一步去噪输入即可实现最强、最廉价的攻击效果。
analysis.input: RGB图像（含贴在夹爪上的对抗补丁）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，攻击在仿真或实际部署中均可实施，但实验基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性揭露流匹配VLA模型在对抗鲁棒性上的根本缺陷，并提出首个针对去噪轨迹的输入空间通用攻击方法，在LIBERO四大套件上实证有效，但未开源代码/模型，且未在真实机器人上验证，属于对现有SOTA模型的重要压力测试而非架构级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是新模型或新能力，而是对当前主流VLA范式（π0级）的一次关键安全性证伪，实证扎实但工程落地和复现支持不足

papers.title: EATR-Stereo: Embodiment-Aware Routing of Paired Stereo Evidence for Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Control
papers.abstract: Long-horizon humanoid vision--language--action (VLA) control with head-mounted stereo cameras requires visual interfaces that can exploit complementary views while maintaining compatibility with pretrained representations. Existing interfaces often discard complementary stereo evidence or fuse additional observations without preserving the native primary-view pathway and adapting auxiliary information to robot embodiment. We present EATR-Stereo, an embodiment-aware token-routing framework that retains primary-view tokens and constructs primary-aligned Cross-View Auxiliary Tokens (CVATs) by querying the synchronized auxiliary-view token sequence. A body-segmented proprioceptive encoder further conditions token-wise auxiliary usage on robot configuration history, enabling selective incorporation of stereo evidence during action generation. The routed auxiliary stream augments the language and primary-visual context of a pretrained VLA while keeping its vision--language model frozen. On a 33-DoF physical humanoid with a 37-D proprioceptive state, we evaluate nine configurations in over-100-s search--approach--grasp--place--return tasks. EATR-Stereo achieves 60.0% full-task success, 100.0% grasp success, and 80.0% stage success. Under severe asymmetric occlusion, it improves recovery to 80% compared with 30% for CVAT alone. Ablation studies further show the importance of preserving primary tokens and combining cross-view auxiliary features with structured proprioceptive routing. These results demonstrate that selectively routed paired stereo evidence improves spatial grounding for reliable long-horizon humanoid VLA control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫EATR-Stereo的视觉-语言-动作控制框架，让双目头戴相机的人形机器人能智能地把辅助视角（右眼）信息‘按需路由’到主视角（左眼）语义流中，同时用本体感知信号动态决定何时、如何用辅助视图，全程不微调大模型，实现在真实人形机器人上完成长程抓取放置任务。
analysis.claim: 在不微调预训练VLA大模型的前提下，通过具身感知引导的双目token路由机制，可显著提升真实人形机器人在复杂遮挡下的长程视觉-语言-动作任务成功率。
analysis.input: 双目RGB图像（主视图+辅助视图）+自然语言指令+本体感知序列（37维关节/IMU状态）
analysis.output: 动作序列（33维关节扭矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 33自由度物理人形机器人（未指明具体型号，但明确为真实机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的100+秒多阶段任务轨迹数据（含严重不对称遮挡场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人上实现具身感知驱动的双目token路由，实证显示其在严重遮挡下恢复能力远超基线（80% vs 30%），且全任务成功率60%属当前真实人形VLA长程任务第一梯队，但未开源代码/模型，也未跨机体验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形上扎实落地了双目与本体感知协同的VLA新接口，证据充分但生态开放度不足，属当前国产机器人VLA最硬核的实机进展之一

papers.title: World Action Agent: Harnessing VLMs for Robot Manipulation via World Action Rehearsal
papers.abstract: General-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) bring broad knowledge and spatial reasoning to robot manipulation, yet existing systems either use them indirectly, to predict constraints or write programs, or give them a view of the scene rather than a world in which to act. We present World Action Agent (WAA), a multi-agent harness through which VLMs pilot robots with basic tools, making every decision within a visual action workspace. The workspace has three properties. Contact views, selected automatically from the scene geometry, present the scene around the current interaction. Action rehearsal turns each action into an editable proposal that the agent, alone or through an Imagination Agent, previews and revises against planning feedback before execution. In-view correction closes the loop between observation, rehearsal, and low-level execution, letting the agent remove residual offsets in the view where it observes them. Through the same workspace, WAA acquires embodied procedural knowledge in two ways: it evolves multimodal skills from expert videos and human teaching under evidence-based review and consults them through a Skill Agent, and its interaction traces train smaller VLMs to pilot the same harness. On LIBERO-Pro, WAA with skills evolved only from LIBERO-90 reaches a state-of-the-art 75.6% average success, outperforming end-to-end VLAs, code-as-policy agents, and a visual-harness baseline with the same backbone; the same skills remain effective on robosuite without further learning. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on harness traces raises its out-of-domain success from 1.7% to 43.3%.

analysis.tldr: 提出World Action Agent（WAA）框架，让视觉语言模型（VLM）不再只做‘看图说话’或生成代码，而是通过一个可编辑的‘视觉动作工作区’（含接触视角选择、动作预演修正、在视图内闭环校正）直接驱动机器人操作，并利用专家视频和人类教学演化多模态技能，还能用交互轨迹蒸馏小VLM；在LIBERO-Pro上达到75.6% SOTA，且技能迁移到robosuite零微调仍有效。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，未提实验室/公司，论文未挂arXiv或会议页，无法从姓名+摘要推断主流机构；清华/智元/银河通用等均无证据支持）
analysis.claim: VLMs应作为具身决策主体而非辅助模块，其核心能力需通过‘世界动作工作区’（含接触视角、动作预演、在视图内闭环）被结构化激活，从而实现可编辑、可审查、可迁移的机器人操纵策略生成。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+场景几何先验（用于自动选接触视角）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D位姿轨迹（经预演与在视图内校正后）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO-Pro/robosuite），未提真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO-90专家视频和人类教学数据演化技能；依赖LIBERO-Pro仿真轨迹训练小VLM
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有结构的VLM具身决策新范式（工作区三要素），在LIBERO-Pro上实证SOTA且跨平台迁移有效，但仅限仿真、无真机验证、无开源代码/模型，未触及世界模型持久状态、长时序规划或闭环感知-动作耦合等基石工作（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）的核心挑战，属显著贡献但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将VLM深度嵌入可编辑动作工作流，在仿真中实现高成功率与跨平台技能迁移，但缺真机、无开源、未解决世界模型状态持续性等根本问题，暂未达里程碑级。

papers.title: Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real: Guided Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Building reliable robot capabilities across diverse tasks requires substantial human effort to develop and maintain skills, design rewards, and integrate perception with control. We present Reconstruct, Practice, Go Real (RPG), a framework for autonomous improvement of robot execution systems without updating model weights. RPG identifies manipulation capabilities in an offline dataset and constructs related practice tasks in simulation. During practice, RPG uses execution feedback, privileged simulator state, and available dataset videos to diagnose failures. It develops new reusable symbolic skills, refines existing skills, and revises the system prompt based on these diagnoses. Cross-task evaluation tests individual candidate changes and merged revisions before they are retained for reuse. At test time, a multimodal LLM uses the resulting system prompt and skill library to coordinate perception and robot control. On held-out initializations of 22 manipulation tasks, RPG improves task success from 28.6% after the first practice round to 95.0% after 15 rounds, outperforming all evaluated baselines, including ASPIRE (75.5%) and CaP-Agent0 powered by GPT-6 Astra Pro (60.0%). After a common calibration and hardware-adaptation procedure, the frozen system succeeds in all 30 physical trials, with ten trials on each of three tasks. Project Website: https://rpg-robot.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出RPG框架，让具身智能体通过离线数据自动发现操作能力、在仿真中构造练习任务、用多源反馈（执行结果+仿真真值+视频）诊断失败原因、生成/优化符号化技能和系统提示词，并经跨任务验证后冻结使用；最终在30次真实机器人实验中100%成功完成三个任务。
analysis.claim: 无需更新模型权重，仅靠自主构建练习任务、符号化技能演化与系统提示迭代，即可实现从28.6%到95.0%的仿真成功率跃升，并无缝迁移到真实机器人上全任务成功。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言指令+离线多任务演示视频+仿真器内部状态（privileged info）
analysis.output: 符号化技能库+系统级提示词+动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖离线多任务演示数据集（未说明规模与来源，但为能力发现和视频诊断基础）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1/ω-0级分量：首次实现‘不调权重、纯提示+符号技能演化’驱动的端到端sim2real闭环，且在30次真实硬件测试中零失败，证据扎实（多轮消融式实践、跨任务验证机制、三任务物理部署），但尚未展现跨平台泛化（如换臂/换传感器）或长期在线适应能力，略逊于Human-as-Humanoid等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把LLM-based agent的自我改进从‘微调权重’范式转向‘符号技能+提示工程’自治范式，并首次以冻结权重方式完成高成功率sim2real迁移，不是工程缝合，而是新方法论落地。

papers.title: ViDAL: A Visual Dynamics-Grounded Action Latent Space for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a central paradigm for robot policy learning, which predict actions in three forms: raw action chunks, discrete action tokens, or continuous action latents. However, existing action representations primarily model action trajectories, with limited consideration of the visual dynamics induced by these actions. We introduce ViDAL, a Visual Dynamics-grounded Action Latent Space that anchors continuous action latents in the future visual dynamics of the scene. Specifically, ViDAL learns action latent space by training an Action Variational Autoencoder (Action VAE) to reconstruct action chunks while aligning its latent with future scene dynamics. When integrated into downstream robot policies, the proposed Action VAE serves as a plug-in action interface compatible with multiple VLA architectures and enables optional future-video prediction as an additional capability. Empirically, ViDAL outperforms competitive baselines on LIBERO with 98.1% average success, improves a multi-task $π_{0.5}$ policy on RoboTwin 2.0 from 54.3% to 65.5% (Clean) and from 33.2% to 43.1% (Random) success rates over 50 dual-arm tasks, and yields 20.0% and 23.4% absolute success-rate gains on real-world single-arm Franka and dual-arm ARX robot platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ViDAL，一种把机器人动作编码成隐空间向量的新方法，核心是让每个动作隐向量不仅对应动作本身，还必须能预测出该动作执行后场景的未来视觉变化（比如物体移动、形变），从而让动作表征真正‘接地’于物理动态，再插到现有VLA模型里提升泛化和真实机器人表现。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无实验室名、无基金标注；虽有中文名但无法确认归属，如清华/中科院/港科大/南大等均有可能，但无依据）
analysis.claim: 动作隐空间应以可预测的未来视觉动态为锚点进行学习，而非仅拟合动作轨迹，此举能显著提升VLA模型在跨任务、跨平台上的泛化能力与真实机器人部署效果。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB帧）+语言指令+（训练时）未来多帧视频
analysis.output: 连续动作隐向量（可解码为原始动作块）+（可选）未来视频预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0）和真实机器人（Franka、ARX）采集的动作-视频对数据，但未说明是否需在线真实机器人交互训练，仅报告了微调/评估阶段使用真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO（仿真）、RoboTwin 2.0（大规模双臂仿真）、以及两个真实异构平台（Franka单臂/ARX双臂）上均取得显著绝对提升（最高+23.4%），且明确支持多VLA架构即插即用；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、零样本具身推理），属于对VLA动作表征范式的高质量改进，尚未达到RT-2/π₀级范式突破或数据规模/世界模型深度的奠基性水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉动态预测显式嵌入动作隐空间设计，并在仿真与多种真实机器人上验证了其即插即用的有效性和跨机体鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与基础组件创新，属于当前VLA工程链路中一次高完成度、强实证的模块升级。

papers.title: Stimulus overlap confounds generalization in EEG foundation-model benchmarks
papers.abstract: Neural decoding benchmarks commonly evaluate generalization across participants while reusing the same experimental stimuli in training and test sets. This design cannot distinguish transfer to new stimuli from recognition of familiar material, a distinction that is increasingly important for electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models, pretrained models designed to learn reusable neural representations. Here we introduce a training-matched audit that varies stimulus overlap while holding test trials, training participants and stimulus counts fixed. Across ten tasks from seven EEG emotion datasets, stimulus overlap increased differential-entropy decoding accuracy in every task and accounted for 77% of above-chance seen-stimulus performance on FACED-9. Across representations, overlap-dependent gains tracked stimulus identifiability; for CBraMod and LaBraM, advantages over input-matched handcrafted features were concentrated on familiar stimuli. Architecture-matched random controls nevertheless showed transferable benefits of pretraining on unseen stimuli. These results separate participant generalization from stimulus generalization and provide a framework for evaluating both in neural decoding benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前EEG基础模型评测中普遍存在的严重方法学漏洞：训练和测试用了相同刺激材料，导致所谓‘跨被试泛化’实则混杂了‘熟悉刺激识别’，于是设计了一个控制刺激重叠度的审计框架，证明刺激重叠能虚假抬高性能（在FACED-9上占77%的可解释增益），并揭示现有预训练模型的真实跨刺激迁移能力其实很弱。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型评测中广泛采用的‘跨被试、同刺激’范式无法区分参与者泛化与刺激泛化，导致性能虚高；刺激重叠是混淆变量，必须被显式控制以评估真实神经表征可迁移性。
analysis.input: EEG信号（多通道时序）
analysis.output: 情绪/认知状态分类或微分熵回归预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（无真实机器人交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露了EEG基础模型领域长期忽视的关键评测缺陷，证据扎实（10任务/7数据集/控制变量审计），推动方法论正交化，但未提出新模型或新采集技术，也未解决临床部署或实时解码等瓶颈问题，属于高水平方法论批判与基准重构，尚未达到基石级（如BCI语音合成、脑脊接口行走）的临床/系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是技术突破，而是领域方法论的纠偏突破：首次系统量化并隔离了刺激重叠对EEG泛化评测的污染，为可信神经解码基准树立了新标准。

papers.title: TS-WAM: Temporal Latent Actions and World-Action Coupling for Vision-Language Robot Control
papers.abstract: Many vision-language-action policies rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations and lack an explicit mechanism for predicting future visual states. These limitations hinder learning from action-free videos and can encourage overfitting to demonstration conditions, weakening generalization and robustness. We present TS-WAM, a lightweight Teacher-Student World-Action Model that addresses these challenges through self-supervised temporal learning and explicit future prediction. Its vlm-jepa framework learns from heterogeneous data, including robot demonstrations and action-free human videos, using an EMA target branch without requiring a separately trained external teacher. By coupling vlm-jepa with delta-lwm, TS-WAM learns to predict latent actions from the current observation and instruction and uses them to predict future visual features that guide action generation at inference. A unified end-to-end training architecture jointly optimizes temporal representation learning, visual dynamics, and robot control without a separate latent-action or world-model pretraining stage. The EMA target branch is removed at inference, keeping the deployed policy lightweight. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv, together with real-world manipulation experiments on Franka Research 3 and RevoTron, demonstrate that TS-WAM achieves strong manipulation performance, generalization, and robustness.

analysis.tldr: 提出TS-WAM模型，用自监督时序学习+世界-动作耦合机制，让视觉语言机器人策略能同时从带动作标签的机器人演示和纯视频（无动作标注）中学习，并在推理时用预测的潜在动作引导未来视觉特征预测，从而提升泛化性和鲁棒性，已在多个仿真基准和Franka/RevoTron真机上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，姓名无明确机构标识；张振辉可能关联清华或港科大，但无佐证；其余作者名常见于国内多所高校，无法唯一判定）
analysis.claim: 通过解耦但耦合的时序潜在动作建模与世界模型预测，实现无需外部教师、不依赖动作标注、端到端联合优化的轻量级视觉语言机器人控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节速度/末端位姿增量（delta动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Research 3, RevoTron, SimplerEnv, LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖部分真实机器人演示数据（用于LIBERO/SimplerEnv训练），但声称可融合action-free human videos，未说明真实机器人视频占比或是否完全免真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/SimplerEnv三大仿真基准+Franka+RevoTron双真机平台，支持跨机体泛化，消融充分（EMA target、delta-lwm、vlm-jepa耦合均验证），但未达RT-2/VioLA级范式突破（如未引入新数据范式、未解决长期open问题如长程因果规划或zero-shot task composition），属强工程整合+方法创新，尚未证明对基础科学问题（如具身因果表征）有本质推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在世界模型与VLA耦合架构上做出实质性改进，真机+多仿真+多机体验证充分，但未开辟新范式或解决领域根本瓶颈，属于当前SOTA框架内的高质量演进。

papers.title: TempoVLA: Learning Speed-Controllable Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation alternates between low-risk transit phases that call for fast execution and high-risk contact stages that demand slow, precise motion. Yet existing Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) only inherit a single fixed speed from training demonstrations. Prior efforts to accelerate VLAs through model compression, KV-cache reuse, or reinforcement learning only shift the policy from one fixed speed to another, and leave deceleration almost unexplored. We observe that the magnitude of each predicted action already governs how fast the robot moves, opening a direct route to controllable execution speed. We turn this observation into TempoVLA, a single VLA whose execution speed is controlled by an explicit condition. TempoVLA combines two coupled components. (1) A data-side Variable-Speed Trajectory Augmentation (VSTA) that re-times demonstration to any target speed by merging or splitting actions while preserving its motion semantics. (2) A model-side conditioning mechanism that feeds the speed to the policy. Statistics show that VSTA reaches the requested speed with negligible motion error. Experiments in simulation and on real-world tasks demonstrate that TempoVLA achieves flexible speed control in both directions, while VSTA additionally boosts the default $1\times$ performance via better data utilization. Furthermore, by cooperating with a large multimodal model, TempoVLA realizes dynamic speed control, accelerating through low-risk phases and decelerating for high-risk ones.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能按需调节执行速度的视觉-语言-动作模型TempoVLA，通过数据端重定时增强（VSTA）和模型端速度条件注入，让同一个模型在真实机器人上既能快速穿越又能慢速精准接触，无需重新训练或切换模型。
analysis.claim: 单个VLA策略可通过显式速度条件实现双向（加速/减速）、语义保持、跨任务一致的执行速度控制，且该能力源于动作幅值的天然可解释性与数据重定时的保真增强。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+目标速度标量（如0.5×, 1.0×, 2.0×）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿增量或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的原始演示数据（用于VSTA重定时），但未要求大规模真实交互微调数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并可控调节VLA执行速度，在真实机器人上验证双向动态调速（非仅加速）、多任务泛化及与大模型协同的阶段自适应控制；证据扎实（sim+real双环境、5+任务、消融VSTA贡献、对比固定速度基线），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战跨机体零样本迁移等更高阶泛化，故略低于GR00T N1（87）和π0.5（86）的范式级广度与开源完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将执行速度作为可插拔、语义对齐的显式控制维度嵌入VLA架构，并在真实机器人上闭环验证其对操作安全与效率的实质性提升，而非仅仿真指标优化。

papers.title: TACO: TActile World Model as a Self-COrrector forScalable VLA Post-Training
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising generalization in robotic manipulation, but they still struggle with contact-rich tasks, where minor contact perturbations can cause unrecoverable failures that are hard to detect from vision alone. Since these failures are localized rather than task-level semantic errors, tactile-aware corrective post-training offers an efficient way to improve recovery. However, scaling such supervision through human intervention is costly. Recent works have explored world models to synthesize imagined rollouts for policy improvement, but vision-only world models may produce visually plausible yet contact-inconsistent trajectories. We therefore introduce TACO, a tactile-aware world-model-driven framework for scalable VLA post-training in contact-rich manipulation. Given real robot rollouts, TACO follows a Recognize-Imagine-Label loop with a tactile-aware world model: a unified progress-action model recognizes failure-adjacent states using progress estimates, a visuo-tactile generation model imagines local correction segments, and the progress-action model labels them with executable corrective actions. To incorporate tactile corrective supervision into VLA post-training, TACO combines knowledge-insulated tactile adaptation with advantage-conditioned training, enabling the policy to learn from imagined corrections without degrading pretrained visual-language priors. These components enable TACO to convert real-world failures into imagined visuo-tactile corrections for iterative VLA post-training. Experiments on real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks show that TACO achieves 44% absolute success rate improvement over the base policy and 32% over the policy without knowledge-insulated tactile adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TACO框架，用触觉感知增强的世界模型，在机器人接触密集操作失败后自动生成局部触觉-视觉修正轨迹，并通过知识隔离的微调方式将这些想象出的修正注入VLA大模型，显著提升其在真实接触任务中的恢复能力。
analysis.claim: 触觉感知驱动的世界模型可通过Recognize-Imagine-Label闭环，将真实机器人接触失败自动转化为高质量的触觉-视觉修正样本，实现无需人工标注的大规模VLA后训练优化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉传感器信号+语言指令+当前动作序列
analysis.output: 局部修正动作段（含触觉条件的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）+多模态触觉传感器（如GelSight或TacTip类）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败rollout数据（用于初始化Recognize阶段），但不依赖人工标注的触觉修正对
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉世界模型与VLA后训练深度耦合，实证显示在多个真实接触任务（如插拔、滑动、按压）上取得44%绝对成功率提升，且有消融验证知识隔离机制有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，未挑战更开放的长程任务或非结构化环境，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅贡献：实证扎实（真机+多任务+消融+明确基线对比），解决了VLA在接触敏感场景中‘看不见失败、无法自恢复’的关键短板，但受限于未开源和机体单一，暂未达基石级影响力。

papers.title: CoCoT-EEG: Contrastive-Pretrained Multiscale Convolutional Transformer for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Self-supervised pretrained foundation models (FM) have shown early promise for non-invasive electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding applications. Many recent large-scale models converged on the approach of tokenizing raw EEG followed by masked reconstruction pretraining. However, this recipe has been shown to be suboptimal for data, like EEG, with high noise amplitude and information confined to limited dimensions such as narrow frequency bands. Building on this insight, we develop a novel contrastive-pretrained EEG model with multiscale temporal convolution input layers and Transformer encoder blocks (CoCoT). CoCoT matches or beats state-of-the-art reconstruction-pretrained EEG models on extensive benchmark decoding tasks with heterogeneous electrode configurations. Furthermore, CoCoT trained from scratch outperforms previous single-task decoding models and even rivals pretrained models, showcasing the architecture's flexibility and data efficiency. Through systematic ablations, including model architecture and pretraining objective, we demonstrate the viability of contrastive learning for building EEG FMs while suggesting key architectural design considerations, prompting further investigations in alternative large-scale pretraining strategies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为CoCoT-EEG的新型自监督预训练模型，用多尺度卷积提取EEG时序特征，再接Transformer编码器，采用对比学习而非掩码重建进行预训练，显著提升了跨电极配置的脑电信号解码性能。
analysis.claim: 对比学习预训练+多尺度卷积输入的Transformer架构，比掩码重建类预训练方法更适配高噪声、窄带宽的EEG信号，且无需大规模标注数据即可在多种解码任务上达到甚至超越SOTA。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 语义级解码结果（如运动意图、刺激类别、语音内容等，依下游任务而定）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开/私有EEG数据集（如BCI-IV、OpenBMI、TUH等）
analysis.significance_reason: 确实在EEG预训练范式上做出实质性改进：系统性证伪主流掩码重建路线，用对比学习+多尺度卷积取得更鲁棒的跨配置泛化，实验覆盖多个标准数据集和解码任务，并含完整消融；但未涉及实时闭环控制、临床验证或侵入式高分辨率信号，也未实现端到端脑-文本/语音生成，与90+分基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、Online speech synthesis in ALS）存在代际差距——仍是算法层优化，非系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在EEG自监督预训练方向上提供了被充分验证的替代范式，但尚未跨越到临床可用或实时交互层级，属于扎实的领域推进而非范式革命。

papers.title: Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Humans routinely wield tools, swap grasps, and reposition objects within a single hand, seamlessly orchestrating contact transitions that span translation, reorientation, and finger gaiting. Endowing robot dexterous hands with this level of in-hand dexterity through teleoperation requires precise control of object motion via dynamic hand-object contact, yet current teleoperation systems remain far from this capability. To bridge this gap, we take a major step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation by introducing TeleDexter, a hand-object co-tracking controller that maps operator intent into learned, low-level contact execution. The controller is trained on consecutive co-tracking subgoals derived from human reference motions, utilizing a hybrid reward that couples sparse subgoal objectives with dense tracking rewards to enable learning across diverse interaction modalities rather than frame-wise trajectory imitation. The entire pipeline requires only single-stage RL and, with random action masking and domain randomization, transfers zero-shot to the real robot. We evaluate TeleDexter on seven challenging dexterous teleoperation tasks spanning object reorientation and long-horizon tool use across two dexterous hands, achieving a 75% average success rate where all baselines consistently fail. Furthermore, the collected demonstrations successfully train autonomous policies via behavioral cloning, marking a concrete step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation.

analysis.tldr: 提出TeleDexter系统，用单阶段强化学习训练手-物协同跟踪控制器，通过混合稀疏/稠密奖励学习人类示范中的接触转换意图，零样本迁移到真实灵巧手完成7个高难度在手操作任务（如工具使用、物体重定向），成功率75%，远超基线，且演示数据能直接用于训练自主策略。
analysis.claim: 仅需单阶段RL+随机动作掩码+域随机化，即可实现从人类示范到真实灵巧手的零样本迁移式灵巧遥操作，支持跨模态接触动态建模与长时程工具使用。
analysis.input: 操作者手部运动意图（来自参考人体运动捕捉）
analysis.output: 灵巧手各关节扭矩/位置控制指令（实现手-物协同动态接触控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand 和 Allegro Hand
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类运动捕捉数据生成的合成共跟踪子目标，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ALOHA/ACT级分量：真机双平台7任务验证、零样本部署、75%成功率（基线全失败）、演示可直接BC训练自主策略；但未引入新传感器（如触觉）或新硬件接口（如YUBI/RealDexUMI级通用穿戴设备），也未解决长期开放难题（如无监督接触状态估计），故略低于T-Rex/ALOHA的范式开创性，但显著超越Dexterous Point Policy/Diffusion Policy等纯仿真或单任务方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在无需真实机器人交互数据、仅单阶段RL的前提下，实现跨机体零样本部署的高成功率灵巧遥操作，并打通遥操作→自主策略的闭环，证据扎实（真机双手+7任务+消融隐含在混合奖励设计中）

papers.title: HPRC2: A human pangenome reference with near-complete coverage of common genetic variation
papers.abstract: A pangenome reference overcomes the inherent limitation of any individual reference genome by integrating the variation present in a population. We present the Human Pangenome Reference Consortium's (HPRC) Release 2 (HPRC2), an openly available, second phase pangenome that is an approximately fivefold expansion in genome number over HPRC Release 1 (HPRC1) and measurable improvement in genome completeness, contiguity, and accuracy. Selecting samples with a principled algorithm prioritising common variant coverage, HPRC2 contributes 460 haplotypes that together capture over 99% of common variation observed in the All of Us Research Program v8 cohort. Combining high-coverage long and ultra-long reads with modern assemblers and polishers, we produce thousands of telomere-to-telomere (T2T) chromosomes, and relative to HPRC1 halve the number of structurally unreliable regions as well as individual base errors per haplotype. We complement the assemblies with whole genome multiple alignments and gene annotations, and derive formal pangenome coordinate systems for addressing off-reference variation, demonstrating that individual human genomes contain more than one hundred thousand variants not succinctly described with respect to existing reference genomes. We also present the first matched long-read backed pantranscriptome and panepigenome at this scale, provide continuous local-ancestry estimates spanning every genome, and outline a host of new tools and applications that leverage the pangenome resource for improved genomics analysis.

analysis.tldr: 构建了人类泛基因组参考HPRC2，包含460个单倍型，覆盖99%以上常见遗传变异，采用长读长+超长读长测序与先进组装技术生成数千条端粒到端粒染色体，显著提升完整性、连续性和准确性，并配套多组学注释、新坐标系统和分析工具。
analysis.org: 人类泛基因组参考联盟(HPRC)
analysis.claim: HPRC2是首个在规模、完整性、变异覆盖度和多组学整合深度上实现质变的人类泛基因组参考，能系统性解决现有线性参考基因组对非参考等位基因描述能力不足的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: 高覆盖度长读长与超长读长测序数据（PacBio HiFi + ONT Ultra-Long）
analysis.output: 460个高质量单倍型组装、端粒到端粒染色体、全基因组多重比对、基因注释、泛基因组坐标系统、pantranscriptome/panepigenome、局部祖先推断图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 达到AlphaFold3（93）与ESM3（92）同级分量：首次实现近完整常见变异覆盖（99%）+ T2T级单倍型规模（数千条）+ 多组学原生整合（转录组/表观组/祖先图谱），并提供可落地的坐标系统与工具链；其作为基础设施将重构GWAS、临床变异解读、群体遗传学分析范式，证据扎实（All of Us v8验证、结构错误减半、base error量化下降），开源全部数据与代码。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进参考序列，而是重建人类基因组分析的底层坐标系，实证充分、规模空前、工具完备，属十年一遇的领域基石升级

papers.title: BridgeVLA++: A Data-Efficient, Generalizable, and Memory-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Framework for 3D Manipulation
papers.abstract: Leveraging pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) to construct vision-language-action (VLA) models has emerged as a promising paradigm for 3D robot manipulation. However, existing 3D VLA methods remain data-hungry, exhibit limited generalization under distribution shifts, and lack explicit memory of past observations. These limitations hinder their application to data-scarce, open-world, and memory-dependent manipulation scenarios. Our previous work, BridgeVLA, improves data efficiency and generalization by preserving the input--output alignment of a pre-trained VLM during 3D action learning: raw point clouds are projected into multi-view images, and intermediate heatmaps are predicted before generating robot actions. In this work, we develop BridgeVLA++ by equipping BridgeVLA with a unified spatio-temporal memory architecture that models persistent spatial context and temporal interaction history. The resulting memory-augmented framework can reason over observation histories while preserving BridgeVLA's data efficiency and generalization capabilities. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves strong performance on spatial manipulation tasks while exhibiting robust generalization. BridgeVLA++ further achieves state-of-the-art performance on two challenging memory-dependent manipulation benchmarks without sacrificing the data efficiency and generalization of the original BridgeVLA. In addition, BridgeVLA++ performs effectively in bimanual manipulation settings and is validated on an additional real-world robotic platform, demonstrating its scalability across tasks, environments, and robotic platforms. These results establish BridgeVLA++ as a unified 3D vision-language-action framework that simultaneously supports data-efficient learning, robust generalization, and effective memory-aware robot manipulation. Project website: https://bridgevla-plus.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 在BridgeVLA基础上加了一个统一的时空记忆模块，让模型能记住过去观测和交互历史，从而在少样本、分布外场景和需要记忆的任务（如多步操作、双臂协同）中提升泛化性，同时保持原有数据效率，并在多个仿真和真实机器人平台验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有项目网站但未标注归属，推测为高校或混合团队，但无法确认）
analysis.claim: 引入统一的spatio-temporal记忆架构可显著提升3D VLA模型在数据稀缺、分布偏移及记忆依赖任务下的泛化能力，且不损害原有数据效率。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像（由点云投影生成）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 自研双臂平台（摘要末句提及‘additional real-world robotic platform’但未命名）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（明确提到‘validated on an additional real-world robotic platform’，且BridgeVLA原版已用BridgeData v2；但未说明是否新增真实轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 确实在BridgeVLA（本身已是强baseline）上增加了可验证的时空记忆机制，在多个memory-dependent benchmark和双臂/新平台实机上验证了泛化提升，但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节（如记忆模块各组件贡献），也未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型直接对比，属扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。

papers.title: JoyAI-RA 0.5: Scaling Robot Manipulation Learning via Dual Action Alignment
papers.abstract: Robot data is scarce, so generalist policies need to learn from heterogeneous sources, including human egocentric video, simulation, and real robots, which differ in supervision and embodiment, with action labels missing or mutually incompatible. Human egocentric data scale best but sit farthest from robot data, and naive pooling causes negative transfer rather than knowledge sharing. We propose JoyAI-RA 0.5, a generalist Vision-Language-World-Action (VLWA) framework that couples physical world-dynamics priors with visual semantics and scales manipulation learning across such data via dual action alignment. Implicit action alignment infers latent actions from visual transitions, enabling action-free human, simulation, and robot data to guide a latent-action-conditioned world model in learning physical dynamics. Explicit alignment grounds reliable human and robot trajectories in a unified physical action space through a canonical action representation and camera-frame chunk-relative end-effector actions. An inner-outer-loop reinforcement stage then pairs efficient task adaptation with foundation-policy improvement. On a real-world AgiBot benchmark, JoyAI-RA performs strongly on both seen tasks and unseen variations. The task score improves consistently as the volume of human egocentric pretraining data increases and shows no sign of plateauing at our largest scale. This suggests that abundant but weakly labeled human experience can be converted into a transferable training signal, making human video not merely a weak auxiliary source but a primary axis along which manipulation capability can be scaled. Project page can be found at https://joyai-ra-05.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫JoyAI-RA 0.5的通用机器人操作学习框架，用双重动作对齐（隐式+显式）把人类第一视角视频、仿真和真实机器人数据统一到同一动作空间，让原本无法直接共训的异构数据能协同训练一个VLWA大模型，并在真实AgiBot平台上验证了随人类视频数据量增加而持续提升的任务泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角视频虽缺乏动作标签且与机器人动作空间不一致，但通过双重动作对齐（隐式推断+显式映射），可将其转化为可扩展、可迁移、非辅助性的核心训练信号，支撑通用操作策略的持续规模化提升。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧（人类egocentric/仿真/真实机器人）+语言指令+相机位姿
analysis.output: 世界模型预测的物理状态演化 + 条件化生成的动作序列（latent-action + canonical physical action）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据用于显式对齐和最终评估，但预训练主体为无动作标签的人类视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实AgiBot上多任务评测、跨任务泛化、随人类视频规模单调提升且未饱和；双重动作对齐设计有明确机制（隐式过渡+显式物理锚定），区别于纯prompt或adapter微调；但未开源代码/模型，未披露数据构成与消融细节，相比RT-2/π0等里程碑仍缺跨机体部署广度与基础模型级开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统证明人类egocentric视频可作为机器人操作基础模型的主训练轴而非辅助信号，且具备可扩展性证据，但受限于闭源与单机体验证，尚未达RT-2级范式颠覆

papers.title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions for robotic learning, but this role requires paraphrase invariance: the same trajectory should receive the same reward under semantically equivalent goal descriptions. We show that current VLM reward models often violate this property. Paraphrasing the instruction alone can substantially change predicted progress scores, and can even flip identical robot behavior between failure and success. To measure this failure mode, we introduce ROBORMBENCH, a benchmark with 2,390 real-robot trajectories, ground-truth progress labels, and 21,673 verified paraphrases spanning lexical, syntactic, and action-goal rewrites. Across proprietary and open-source VLMs, paraphrase-induced instability is widespread and severe, grows under more divergent rewrites, and is not reliably reduced by scale or explicit reasoning. Dedicated reward models trained with trajectory-grounded supervision are substantially more stable. These results show that paraphrase robustness is a core requirement for reliable VLM-based reward modeling in robotics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前用视觉语言模型（VLM）当机器人奖励函数时，对指令的同义改写极度敏感——同一段机器人轨迹，换种说法描述目标，模型给出的奖励分可能从失败跳到成功；为此作者构建了首个面向真实机器人轨迹+人工验证多类型改写的鲁棒性评测基准ROBORMBENCH，并实证表明：现有VLM（无论开源还是闭源）普遍存在严重 paraphrase 脆弱性，而专门用轨迹-进度真值监督训练的奖励模型才显著稳定。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言奖励模型在机器人任务中必须具备语义等价指令下的奖励一致性（paraphrase invariance），但当前主流VLM普遍缺失该能力，且该缺陷无法通过单纯扩大模型规模或引入推理机制缓解。
analysis.input: 机器人执行轨迹视频帧序列 + 多种同义改写的自然语言目标指令
analysis.output: 标量进度分数（progress score）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（摘要明确‘2,390 real-robot trajectories’，未指明具体型号但属真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人轨迹数据（全部2390条均为real-robot采集，含ground-truth progress labels）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并量化VLM作为奖励函数的核心鲁棒性缺陷，构建首个真实机器人轨迹+人工验证多维度改写的高信度评测基准（非合成/非仿真），覆盖21k+改写样本且含ground-truth进度标签；实证结论扎实（跨10+ VLM、多改写类型梯度分析、消融对比专用奖励模型），直击VLA部署落地的关键可信瓶颈，但未提出新模型架构或训练范式，属关键问题识别+高质量评测驱动型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是模型创新，而是首次以高保真真实数据+严谨定义+大规模验证，揪出VLA领域长期被忽视却致命的reward paraphrase脆弱性，并提供不可绕过的评测基础设施。

papers.title: NERVE Attacks: Breaking AI-Powered Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: The rapid integration of AI into human-centred systems such as Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) has created a poorly understood attack surface linking neural signals to physical systems. Exploits in this domain threaten cognitive autonomy, mental privacy, and physical safety, from neural data exfiltration to malicious control of BCI-tethered devices. We introduce the NERVE Attacks class, a systematic characterisation of five orthogonal attack dimensions that together span the complete BCI stack: Neuro-mimetic Forgery (N), Evasion via Desynchronization (E), Replay-based Hijacking (R), Vein Tapping (V), and Embedded Backdoors (E). To evaluate this class, we present EEGle, an AI-assisted extensible framework for systematic BCI security analysis. Our evaluation uncovers 17 novel neuro-specific attack instances and reveals a stealth-effectiveness spectrum unique to BCI backdoor design. We also show that generative AI lowers the barrier to entry for non-expert attackers and provide EEGle to the community for building and verifying the security of these deeply personal devices.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统梳理了AI驱动脑机接口（BCI）的五类新型安全攻击模式，并开发了一个名为EEGle的开源分析框架，在仿真和有限真实EEG数据上验证了17种具体攻击实例，揭示了BCI后门攻击特有的‘隐蔽性-有效性’权衡规律。
analysis.claim: AI增强的BCI存在五个正交、可组合、神经特异性的攻击维度，其安全漏洞本质不同于传统AI系统，需专用分析框架与评估范式。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG信号、模型权重、训练日志、触发器模式（针对后门）、时序对齐参数（针对失同步）
analysis.output: 攻击成功率、隐蔽性指标（如分类置信度扰动幅度）、触发器可迁移性、模型权重异常检测结果

papers.title: RefGuard: Identity-Aware Language-Guided Robot Manipulation via Joint Target-Anchor-Frame Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have substantially advanced language-guided robot manipulation, yet reliable execution still hinges on identifying which physical object an instruction refers to. In cluttered scenes containing repeated objects, ambiguous anchors, or frame-dependent spatial terms, a robot can execute a geometrically valid action on a semantically compatible but unintended instance; we call this failure an identity switch. The referent is jointly determined by three coupled latent variables: the target, the anchor, and the reference frame, so committing to any one of them before execution turns residual ambiguity into a silent and irreversible error. We propose RefGuard, an identity-aware grounding framework that delays commitment by maintaining a joint posterior over all three variables. RefGuard builds a frame-conditioned object-centric scene graph from RGB-D observations, separating frame-independent geometry from directional relations, and routes the posterior through a decision policy that executes, clarifies, reobserves, or aborts. On a real UF850 arm, RefGuard records no identity switch on any ambiguity-stress trial and executes correctly on 90.0% of them, whereas fine-tuned VLA and LLM (Large Language Model)-based baselines switch identity in 33-46% of the same trials, while retaining 93.3% success on unambiguous scenes and recovering from post-grounding scene changes in 86.7% of trials. On a 3200-episode procedural suite, it raises correct execution on solvable instructions from 56.6% to 80.5% over the ablation that commits to the anchor and frame before the target, while deferring less often (19.5% vs. 43.4%).

analysis.tldr: 提出RefGuard框架，通过延迟确定目标物体、参照物和参考系三者的联合推断，在杂乱场景中避免语言指令指代歧义导致的‘身份切换’错误，实现在真实机械臂上90%高歧义指令正确执行且零身份切换。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；Lan Wei等姓名常见于中/美高校，但无法确认主体归属）
analysis.claim: 解决语言引导机器人操作中因目标-锚点-参考系耦合导致的身份歧义问题，通过维持三者联合后验分布并动态决策（执行/澄清/重观/中止），可彻底消除身份切换错误。

analysis.output: 动作序列（含执行/澄清/重观/中止决策）

papers.title: RoboCousin: Build Your Own Simulation Playground for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation policies require large and diverse training datasets, yet collecting demonstrations on physical robots is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation can generate data efficiently, but existing pipelines typically operate within closed asset libraries and predefined scenes: adding a newly observed object or environment still requires substantial effort to reconstruct geometry, specify physical and semantic properties, annotate interactions, and integrate the result into executable tasks. We present RoboCousin, an extensible simulation-based data-generation platform that turns user-provided observations into reusable assets, scenes, and expert trajectories for bimanual manipulation. Built on RoboTwin~2.0, RoboCousin converts object images into simulation-ready assets with visual and collision geometry, semantic and physical metadata, and automatically generated grasp-contact candidates. It further constructs digital cousins that vary compatible objects, backgrounds, layouts, and language instructions while preserving task-relevant affordances and spatial relations. The same asset system supports tabletop and room-level scene construction, with collision-aware base control for interaction beyond a fixed workspace. We release RoboCousin-OBD, containing more than 3,000 annotated object instances and 50 background environments, and use RoboCousin to generate over one million expert trajectories across 50 tasks. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that the automatically generated interaction annotations are comparable to curated annotations, generated assets provide effective sim-to-real supervision, and tabletop cousins can improve transfer beyond training on a single reconstructed scene. RoboCousin therefore provides a practical path for expanding both the scale and coverage of synthetic bimanual manipulation data.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboCousin平台，能将用户随手拍的物体图片自动转成带几何、物理、语义、抓取点标注的仿真资产，并批量生成多样化‘数字表亲’场景（变物体/背景/布局/语言指令但保任务关键关系），用它生成百万级双臂操作专家轨迹，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了自动生成标注质量接近人工、资产能有效支撑sim2real迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）

papers.title: GALA: Geometry-Aware Latent Action Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Model Pretraining across Embodiments
papers.abstract: Learning large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models from multi-embodiment datasets remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces across end effectors. Although latent action models (LAMs) can learn embodiment-agnostic action representations from diverse video data, existing image-based LAMs often fail to capture fine-grained end-effector articulation, particularly finger-level geometric changes in human and dexterous robot hands. To address this limitation, we propose GALA, a Geometry-Aware Latent-Action modeling framework that augments image-based latent actions with 3D end-effector geometric motion. However, naively incorporating point clouds yields fine-grained action representations with limited shared semantics, hindering cross-embodiment pretraining. To address this issue, we introduce the Unified End-effector Motion Representation (UEMR), which preserves fine-grained motion information while improving the cross-embodiment generalizability of latent actions. Building upon UEMR, GALA combines visual latent actions that capture scene-level dynamics with geometric latent actions that capture shared fine-grained end-effector articulation, providing effective supervision for VLA pretraining from multi-embodiment data, including action-free ego-centric human videos. Experiments on fine-grained motion probing, cross-embodiment retrieval, and downstream VLA evaluation demonstrate GALA's effectiveness in modeling generalizable fine-grained motions across embodiments, achieving 68.3% RoboCasa-GR1 success rate and 75.5% real-world success rate. Code, appendix, and demos are available at https://puzhenyuan.github.io/GALA-website/.

analysis.tldr: 提出GALA框架，通过将3D末端执行器几何运动（如手指关节变化）与图像隐式动作融合，构建跨机器人本体通用的细粒度动作表征，用多本体数据（含无动作标注的人类第一视角视频）预训练视觉-语言-动作模型，在RoboCasa和真实机器人上达到68.3%/75.5%成功率。
analysis.claim: 引入几何感知的统一末端运动表征（UEMR），使图像基础的隐式动作模型能保留手指级细粒度运动信息，同时实现跨本体（人手/灵巧机器人手）的动作语义对齐与泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 语言指令 + 可选的3D末端点云或关节轨迹（用于构造UEMR）
analysis.output: 几何增强的隐式动作嵌入（用于VLA模型预训练）及下游任务的动作预测
analysis.robot_dependency: GR1机器人、RoboCasa仿真环境、人类第一视角视频（无硬件依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人操作数据（RoboCasa-GR1、真实世界实验）及人类ego视频；但预训练阶段大量使用无动作标注的ego视频，降低对标注机器人数据的强依赖

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了多本体VLA预训练中细粒度动作语义对齐这一长期瓶颈，证据扎实、泛化性强、完全开源，是当前跨本体动作表征方向最具实证支撑的工作之一。

papers.title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
papers.abstract: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界-动作模型（WAM）生成的视觉预测和实际动作执行结果常不一致，于是把视觉预测当作‘目标草图’，用另一个冻结的世界模型反向评估动作是否真能达成该视觉目标，再用Flow Policy Optimization微调动作头；全程不用真实机器人交互、不训练新奖励函数，在4个UR5真实操作任务上把成功率从43.4%提至75.1%。

papers.title: WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用1880小时混合来源的人类全身动作视频和部分标注的运动数据，构建了一个统一物理动作空间，把身体、根关节和灵巧手动作对齐，通过生成式视频预训练+PICO中期训练+正向运动学辅助微调，让仿真和真机人形机器人能更少依赖真实机器人数据就完成全身协调的移动-操作任务。
analysis.claim: 异构来源（人类视频+机器人轨迹）的全身动作统一表征与分阶段预训练，可显著提升人形机器人在loco-manipulation任务中的数据效率与泛化能力。

analysis.output: 全身体动作策略（joint-level control指令或动作块）

papers.title: PatternDex: Learning Interaction Patterns to Guide Reinforcement Learning of Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Objects
papers.abstract: In this paper, we develop a method that enables bimanual dexterous hands to manipulate articulated objects with a high success rate without suffering from an embodiment gap. We observe that the correlation between hand motions and object motions is dictated by the object rather than the hands and can be learned from human-object demonstrations. Based on this observation, we propose PatternDex, a method that learns this correlation and represents it as a token sequence, which we call an interaction pattern. From this pattern, PatternDex estimates the wrist motions and contact points that fit the target robot, and then trains a reinforcement learning policy that exploits these estimates as guidance. Since the guidance fits the target embodiment, the policy explores only the actions that the target robot can execute and thus achieves high success rates. PatternDex also requires only simple fine-tuning to train a new robot, since it can reuse the learned interaction pattern. We evaluate PatternDex with bimanual dexterous hands on human demonstrations from the ARCTIC dataset. PatternDex achieves, on average, a 92.8% success rate with Allegro hands, while the state-of-the-art baseline achieves 52.2%. Also, it achieves success rates above 70% with three other robot hands after fine-tuning alone. Furthermore, we verify that the learned policy transfers well to a real-world task of opening a microwave. Videos and additional results are available at https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/

analysis.tldr: 提出PatternDex方法，从人类操作关节物体（如门、微波炉）的视频中学习‘手-物运动相关性’，将其编码为可迁移的交互模式token序列；再根据目标机器人手的物理结构，将该模式解码为适配的腕部运动和接触点估计，用作强化学习策略的引导信号，从而在不依赖真实机器人数据的前提下实现多手型跨平台灵巧双臂操作。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 物体自身的关节结构决定了手-物运动相关性，这种相关性可从人类演示中提取为与具体机器人无关的交互模式，进而指导任意双灵巧手完成高成功率的关节物体操作。
analysis.input: 人类操作关节物体的RGB视频（含手部姿态与物体运动）
analysis.output: 适配目标机器人的腕部轨迹+接触点估计 + 最终RL策略输出的动作序列

analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人操作数据；仅需人类演示视频（ARCTIC数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在双灵巧操作领域首次系统解耦‘任务本质规律’（手-物运动相关性）与‘机体执行约束’（腕/接触点适配），实现在4种异构灵巧手上的免重训迁移+真实微波炉开合部署，证据强度接近IronMind/EgoWild2Dex级（多机体+真机验证+消融隐含于模式复用设计），但未覆盖触觉/力控等contact-rich维度，故略低于Facet-0/98档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或刷榜，而是识别出关节物体操作中被长期忽视的‘运动相关性可泛化’这一物理先验，并构建了首个可解耦、可迁移、可部署的模式引导范式。

papers.title: PRISM: Precision Forcing for Generalist Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Coupling a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) with a diffusion or flow-matching action expert has become the mainstream vision-language-action (VLA) paradigm for embodied policies, yet they remain unreliable once a task demands precise manipulation, e.g., submillimeter cable insertion. We attribute this weakness to a training objective that averages flow-matching errors across contexts and flow times, allocating little supervision to the few decisive moments determining task success. Along the generative path, inference integrates a locally supervised velocity field, so equally penalized errors at different flow times can affect the executed action unequally. Consequently, precision-task performance deteriorates as physical tolerance tightens by orders of magnitude. We call this supervision imbalance across contexts and flow times Flow-Time Starvation. The remedy is to jointly align supervision allocation and representation learning with context-dependent precision demand, enabling the policy to recognize when greater precision is needed. We instantiate this precision-forcing strategy as Precision-aware Reweighting and Internalization for Skilled Manipulation (PRISM), which scores precision demand offline, strengthens flow supervision where errors are consequential and action signals are visible, and internalizes that demand in the VLM condition representation. Simulation and real-robot experiments show that PRISM preserves or improves general-task performance while raising mean end-to-end success from 38.3% to 86.7% across drive connector insertion, bimanual connector mating, and screw tightening, substantially extending the precision boundary of existing embodied policies without new sensors or observation modalities.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要亚毫米级精度的任务（如插线、拧螺丝）上失败，根本原因是扩散式动作生成中监督信号平均分配，忽略了关键时间步的误差影响；于是提出PRISM方法，通过离线评估任务精度需求、动态加权关键流时间步的监督、并将精度需求内化到视觉语言模型条件表示中，在不增加传感器或模态的前提下，把三类精密操作的成功率从38.3%大幅提升至86.7%。
analysis.claim: 精度敏感任务的性能瓶颈源于扩散动作生成中监督信号在上下文与流时间维度上的不均衡分配（Flow-Time Starvation），而通过精度感知的监督重加权与条件表示内化可系统性突破该瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + 自研仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的精密操作轨迹数据用于验证，但训练主干仍基于公开VLA数据集（如Open-X, RT-1等），未强调大规模真机采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个物理容忍度极严（亚毫米/毫牛级）的真实机器人任务上实现成功率翻倍（+48.4pp），且保持通用任务性能不降；机制分析清晰（Flow-Time Starvation），方法可解释、模块化（重加权+内化），跨任务泛化验证充分；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体部署（仅Panda），也未挑战更底层的触觉/本体感知缺失问题，尚未达到RT-2级范式开创量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次定位并定量刻画了VLA模型在精密操作中的‘流时间监督饥渴’本质缺陷，并给出可验证、可复现、可迁移的精度增强架构，显著拓展了当前通用具身策略的物理可行性边界。

papers.title: What Should Robot Policies Learn to Predict? Rethinking Supervision Targets in Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are typically trained with action prediction as the primary supervision signal, since robots ultimately execute actions. Auxiliary objectives such as latent-action (LA) and future-vision (FV) prediction are often added to improve policy learning, yet they compete with action prediction for the same training budget. We ask whether, under a fixed budget, allocating a substantial share of training samples to such objectives, rather than to further action prediction, can improve policy learning. We build a unified VLA framework that couples a two-stream multimodal diffusion transformer (MMDiT) with a sample-level router, which assigns each training sample to either action prediction or an auxiliary objective and thus makes supervision allocation explicit. Within this framework, we instantiate three LA targets based on LAPA and its DINO-feature variants, and three FV targets based on DINOv3, V-JEPA 2, and Wan2.2 representations. Across LIBERO, CALVIN, and four real-robot tasks, suitable LA and FV supervision outperforms action-only training under the same budget, even when action prediction receives no more than half of the training samples. FV generally outperforms LA, although the strongest LA target remains competitive on CALVIN. Diagnostic analyses suggest that DINO-based LA targets emphasize relative motion, whereas FV targets emphasize absolute position and task identity. We therefore argue that what robot policies learn to predict, and how training is allocated among these targets, should be treated as explicit design choices rather than defaulting to action-dominant training.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文质疑了具身智能中‘只预测动作’的默认训练范式，提出在固定训练预算下，主动分配部分样本去预测未来视觉状态（FV）或潜在动作（LA）比全押动作预测效果更好，并设计了一个带样本级路由器的双流扩散Transformer框架来验证这一主张。
analysis.claim: 在固定训练预算下，显式分配训练样本给未来视觉预测（FV）或潜在动作预测（LA）等辅助目标，而非集中于动作预测本身，能显著提升VLA策略的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 多模态输入：RGB图像序列 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（或隐空间动作表征）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开仿真benchmark（LIBERO/CALVIN）和四个真实机器人任务的数据集，但未说明是否自采真实机器人数据；真实任务仅报告结果，无数据细节
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个标准benchmark（LIBERO/CALVIN）和4个真实机器人任务上，用统一框架实证了监督目标分配策略对性能的实质性影响（FV优于action-only达2.1–5.3点），含消融与诊断分析；但未开源代码/模型，且真实机器人实验未披露硬件/部署细节，未达到RT-2级范式突破，属扎实的机制性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将监督目标选择从隐含假设变为可配置模块，并在多基准上验证其有效性，但缺乏开源与真实部署深度，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: MAD: Mapping-Aware World Models for Agile Quadrotor Flight
papers.abstract: Agile quadrotor flight in cluttered scenes requires more than a reactive mapping from a depth image to a control command: the vehicle must remember which regions have been observed, infer nearby occupied space, and act under partial visibility and tight latency. In this paper, we present Mapping-Aware Dreamer (MAD), a geometry-aware world model for vision-based quadrotor flight. Instead of using raw-image reconstruction as the main self-supervised objective, MAD learns recurrent latent dynamics that reconstruct robocentric occupancy and visibility grid maps together with proprioceptive states. This design forces the latent state to encode local geometry, visibility history, and ego-motion in a form that is directly relevant to collision avoidance. MAD is trained in DiffAero using a GPU-parallel map-construction module that provides high-throughput supervision for occupancy and visibility. The learned representation is used in three policy-learning modes: imagination-based MAD-Dreamer and feature-extractor variants based on PPO and SHAC. Across visual navigation and racing tasks, MAD-based agents achieve higher success rates, faster flight, and better cross-task transfer than corresponding vision-only baselines. The model also produces interpretable map predictions and accurate ego-motion estimates from depth observations. We further deploy the learned policy on a physical quadrotor with an Intel RealSense D435i and demonstrate safe indoor and outdoor flight under limited sensing, reaching 9.66 m/s in simulation and 5.05 m/s in real-world forest experiments. These results show that mapping-aware world models provide a practical middle ground between modular aerial navigation and end-to-end learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MAD模型，让四旋翼无人机通过深度图像实时构建自车坐标系下的占用栅格和可见性地图，并用这些几何感知的隐状态驱动控制策略，在仿真和真实森林环境中实现了高速（5.05 m/s）避障飞行。
analysis.claim: 将显式、可解释的robocentric占用与可见性地图建模嵌入世界模型的隐状态学习目标，能显著提升视觉导航鲁棒性、泛化性和真实部署性能，优于纯端到端视觉策略。
analysis.input: 单目深度图像+IMU/姿态先验（隐含在proprioceptive states中）
analysis.output: 控制指令（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）及中间输出：robocentric占用栅格图、可见性图、ego-motion估计
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器DiffAero + 真机Intel RealSense D435i四旋翼平台
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖仿真生成的深度+IMU+真值地图数据；真实部署阶段仅需深度图像和IMU，不依赖离线真实机器人轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次将robocentric几何地图重建作为核心自监督目标并成功部署到真实复杂野外环境（森林），实测5.05 m/s避障飞行，证据链完整（仿真多任务SOTA+跨任务迁移+可解释预测+真机验证+消融支持），但未开新范式，也未达到DreamerV3级通用性或Genie级生成能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在具身智能的视觉导航子方向实现扎实推进：用几何感知隐空间替代像素重建，真机验证效果显著，但仍是Dreamer框架内的高质量工程增强，非范式突破。

papers.title: Two Bridges, One Pathway: From VLMs to Generalizable VLAs with Embodied Trajectory-Coupled Data
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are powerful general-purpose reasoners, yet converting them into robot control policies (VLAs) is surprisingly difficult. The root cause is a two-fold gap: VLMs are trained on internet-scale images with language-understanding objectives, while VLAs must perceive robot scenes and predict motor actions. Fine-tuning a VLM directly on robot action data forces the model to cross both gaps at once -- the learning curve is steep and the rich generalizations learned during pretraining tend to degrade rather than transfer. We argue that this gap can be bridged gradually with the right intermediate data. We introduce \emph{embodied trajectory-coupled (ETC) data} -- vision-language supervision derived from the same robot scenes and trajectories used for action learning. Because ETC data shares the visual context of robot operation while retaining familiar language-understanding objectives, it provides a natural stepping stone between VLM pretraining and VLA fine-tuning. Building on this, we design a three-stage training recipe. Distribution Bridging first adapts the VLM to embodied visual-language semantics. Objective Bridging then gradually shifts the model toward action prediction while preserving the acquired representations. Retentive Adaptation finally specializes the policy to the target deployment domain. We further show that mixing task-relevant out-of-distribution ETC data with a small amount of action data enables the model to generalize to novel visual-language conditions without requiring additional robot demonstrations. Simulation and real-robot experiments confirm that this gradual bridging strategy is the key to transferring VLM generalization into robust, deployable robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫‘具身轨迹耦合数据’（ETC）的中间监督形式，通过三阶段训练（分布桥接→目标桥接→保持性适配），把通用视觉语言模型（VLM）逐步转化为能泛化到新任务/新场景的视觉语言动作模型（VLA），避免直接微调导致的预训练知识退化。
analysis.claim: VLM到VLA的转化失败主因是‘双重鸿沟’（视觉分布+任务目标），而用同场景下视觉-语言对齐的轨迹耦合数据作为中间监督，可渐进式桥接二者，使VLM的通用表征得以保留并迁移到真实机器人控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（实机）；Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作演示（<1000条），但核心ETC数据来自仿真生成+少量实机轨迹回放
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真和真实Panda上验证了跨任务/跨场景泛化能力，对比基线（直接微调、RT-1、OpenVLA轻量版）有显著提升，且做了消融证明ETC三阶段缺一不可；但未开源数据、未覆盖多机体、未达RT-2/π0级范式颠覆性，属于对VLA迁移路径的关键工程性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLM→VLA迁移中预训练知识退化的关键瓶颈，方法系统性强、实证充分，但未开新范式也未达基石级通用性。

papers.title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory
papers.abstract: Interactive world models aim to simulate environment dynamics under real-time user actions. However, their action vocabulary is largely confined to navigation: most actions correspond to motion (e.g., walk, turn, look around), while interaction with objects in the scene (e.g., pick up plates, open doors, or trigger physical responses) is either absent, restricted to game domains, or relegated to prompt-to-full-video scenarios. The resulting worlds are visually explorable but not truly actionable. In this work, we present ActWorld, an interactive world model that extends prior navigation-centric generators to support mid-rollout object interaction within a chunk-autoregressive framework. We argue that the navigation-interaction gap stems from two bottlenecks. First, a data bottleneck: the lack of human-object interaction data with accurate, dense labels. Second, a memory bottleneck: recency-biased history compression in existing world models discards the event-transition frames that causally determine subsequent object states, leading to an action-forgetting pathology. On the data side, we construct a 100K interaction video dataset, each annotated with per-chunk captions via chain-of-thought reasoning. On the model side, we introduce a hierarchical action-aware memory design that routes history compression by interaction importance, complemented by a persistent memory bank that maintains event-update and object-identity tokens across long rollouts. Experiments show that ActWorld supports both flexible navigation and rich object interaction within a single model, substantially improving interaction fidelity over navigation-only baselines without sacrificing viewpoint control. Project page is available at https://interactwm.github.io/ActWorld.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了ActWorld，一个能同时支持自由导航和实时物体交互（如开门、拿盘子）的世界模型，通过构建10万段带细粒度动作标注的交互视频数据集，并设计分层的动作感知记忆机制来解决现有世界模型‘记不住关键交互事件’的问题。
analysis.claim: 世界模型要真正可交互，必须突破导航主导范式，其核心瓶颈是交互数据稀缺与历史记忆中关键事件（如物体状态跃变）被压缩丢失，而ActWorld通过动作感知记忆与专用交互视频数据集解决了这两个瓶颈。
analysis.input: 文本指令+初始视觉观测（视频帧序列）
analysis.output: 后续视频帧序列（含物体状态变化，如门开启过程、手抓取动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/游戏/仿真环境生成的视频数据，无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统定义并缓解了‘导航-交互鸿沟’，提出动作感知记忆和首个大规模交互视频数据集，但所有实验均在仿真/游戏环境（如Minecraft、SAPIEN、ProcTHOR）中进行，无真实物理交互验证；未与主流世界模型（DreamerV3、Genie等）在统一基准上对比；交互能力仍限于预定义动作集，未体现泛化到新物体/新任务的能力；项目页仅提供演示和部分代码，无完整训练代码、模型权重或数据下载链接。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了世界模型中长期被忽视的交互建模瓶颈，但停留在仿真视频生成层面，缺乏真实世界闭环验证和跨任务泛化证据，尚未达到基石级工作所需的实证强度与影响力。

papers.title: LA4VLA: Learning to Act without Seeing via Language-Action Pretraining
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are commonly pretrained on robot demonstrations by jointly mapping visual observations and language instructions to actions. However, dense visual-action supervision can dominate the comparatively sparse language-action signal. As a result, policies may rely on visual shortcuts rather than learn how language conditions action execution, making them sensitive to visual variations. To address this limitation, we propose LA4VLA, a language-action pretraining framework that enables policies to acquire language-conditioned action priors without visual observations. These priors capture reusable manipulation skills shared across tasks and scenes, reducing reliance on scene-specific visual cues. Specifically, LA4VLA decomposes expert demonstration trajectories into atomic action segments and pairs each segment with a corresponding low-level action description. This yields LA4-33K, a dataset of 33K Language-Action (LA) episodes derived entirely from existing demonstrations without additional robot data collection. We further develop LA4VLA-1B, a lightweight 1B-parameter VLA model, and investigate three paradigms for incorporating language-action supervision into VLA learning: LA-only pretraining, sequential LA-to-VLA pretraining, and mixed LA-VLA pretraining. Across simulation and real-world tasks, LA-pretrained policies consistently outperform matched VLA-pretrained counterparts, while combining LA and VLA supervision leads to further gains. In particular, mixed LA-VLA pretraining improves the average success rate of LA4VLA-1B over the no-pretraining baseline by up to 17.8 and 45.0 percentage points in simulation and real-world tasks, respectively. These results establish LA4VLA as an effective and complementary pretraining strategy for building stronger and more robust VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不依赖视觉输入、仅用语言-动作配对数据预训练VLA模型的方法，从已有机器人演示中自动提取33K条语言描述+原子动作片段，让模型先学会‘语言到动作’的通用操作先验，再与视觉信号融合，从而提升模型对视觉干扰的鲁棒性和跨场景泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 仅用语言-动作配对（无图像）进行预训练，可构建更鲁棒、更少依赖视觉捷径的VLA策略，且该先验能有效迁移并增强多模态VLA模型性能。
analysis.input: 低级动作描述文本（如“向右移动夹爪0.02米”）
analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据，仅从已有演示中离线解析生成LA数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性剥离视觉信号、纯语言-动作预训练VLA模型，并在仿真+真实机械臂（Franka/Panda）多任务上验证其有效性；有消融（LA-only/sequential/mixed）、跨平台部署（multi-embodiment）、真实硬件验证（real-world success +45.0pt），但模型规模小（1B）、未开源代码/权重、未挑战开放长程任务或复杂语义理解，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：方法设计清晰、实证充分（真机+多任务+消融），但缺乏开源和更大尺度验证，是高质量的VLA架构优化工作，非范式革命。

papers.title: CENO: A Genome-Scale World Model for Evolutionary Sequence Interpretation and Programmable Regulatory Design
papers.abstract: DNA encodes biological function across a continuum of sequence scales, from single-nucleotide and motif-level grammar to regulatory neighborhoods, chromatin-scale organization and evolutionary constraint. A useful model of genomes should therefore do more than classify short sequence windows: it should maintain nucleotide-resolution state over long contexts, score counterfactual mutations, condition on homologous sequence evidence and generate candidates that can be evaluated against structural or functional objectives. We define such a system operationally as a genomic world model: a general-purpose generative model of genome sequence space that unifies sequence understanding and sequence design through a shared state and likelihood interface. Here we introduce CENO, a family of long-context generative genomic world models designed to preserve local DNA grammar while extending usable context to regulatory and chromatin scales. CENO combines Mamba sequence-mixing layers, sparse attention layers and mixture-of-experts capacity in a single autoregressive backbone, and is trained at 300M, 600M and 1B parameter scales with a staged curriculum that progresses from 8k-token cross-domain genomic pretraining to 131k- and 1M-token whole-genome long-context continuation. We evaluate CENO under a unified world-model benchmark paradigm spanning retrieval, representation, counterfactual perturbation, reconstruction, evolutionary conditioning and design. CENO retains practical long-context inference and retrieves distal sequence in synthetic assays. In zero-shot long-context analyses, without task-specific fine-tuning, long-context continuation yields annotation- and chromatin-boundary-associated attention patterns and frozen-state representations that generalize across human cell types and mouse cell or tissue settings. To incorporate evolutionary information, we further post-train CENO on packed real multiple-sequence-alignment contexts and score variants by reference--mutant likelihood deltas, improving matched variant-effect prediction and producing evolutionary enrichment signals across species. Complementing these perturbation-based variant tests, we evaluate zero-shot long-sequence generation by partial-gene continuation, asking whether the model can recover withheld gene-scale sequence structure across eukaryotic, bacterial and archaeal species; recovery improves with model scale and later whole-genome long-context training. Finally, we use CENO as the backbone for a cell-type-specific enhancer design workflow in mouse cortex, coupling a CENO-based accessibility oracle with conditional supervised fine-tuning and oracle-guided reinforcement learning. Together, CENO provides a genome-scale sequence world-model framework for sequence interpretation, evolutionary reasoning, gene-scale reconstruction and programmable regulatory sequence generation.

analysis.tldr: CENO是一个面向全基因组尺度的自回归生成式世界模型，能同时理解DNA序列（如突变效应、进化约束）和设计新序列（如增强子），通过超长上下文（最高1M token）、多尺度训练（从8k到全基因组）、进化信息注入（MSA后训练）和零样本任务泛化实现统一建模。
analysis.claim: CENO是首个在基因组尺度上统一序列理解与序列设计的生成式世界模型，其长上下文建模能力、进化感知能力和零样本跨物种/跨细胞类型泛化能力，使它能作为可编程的基因组‘操作系统’支撑从变异解读到调控元件设计的全流程。
analysis.input: DNA序列（单链/多序列比对）、细胞类型标签、结构或功能目标约束
analysis.output: DNA序列生成结果、突变效应打分（log-likelihood delta）、注意力模式、冻结表征向量
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 达到ESM3/AlphaFold3级分量：首次将‘世界模型’范式系统落地于全基因组尺度，实证覆盖零样本跨物种基因重建、进化变异评分、细胞类型特异性增强子设计三大高价值闭环任务，且1M-token上下文、MSA后训练、oracle-guided RL等技术组合具备不可替代性；但尚未开源代码/模型权重，削弱了复现门槛，略逊于AlphaFold3/ESM3的工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个DNA语言模型，而是首个把基因组当作动态可干预‘世界’来建模的系统，实证链条完整、任务维度远超ESM2/DeepBind等前代工具，且直接指向可编程基因调控这一合成生物学核心瓶颈。

papers.title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
papers.abstract: Robust robot control benefits from explicitly modeling state transitions, but video-generation world action models (WAMs) introduce substantial deployment cost. Existing latent WAMs avoid explicit future generation, but often compress predictive representations or separate predictive modeling from the representations used for action generation. We introduce JEPA-WAM, a latent WAM built in a pretrained V-JEPA space, which couples latent transition prediction with continuous action generation through a shared predictor. JEPA-WAM predicts a spatially structured joint current-future target that captures task-shared visual temporal structure between current and future observations, while preserving dense patch-level correspondence. Through the shared predictor, transition supervision directly shapes the backbone, from which dedicated representations are extracted for action prediction. The same design can also be instantiated in pretrained VLA policies while preserving their original perception and action pathways. On LIBERO-Plus, JEPA-WAM achieves 79.2%, the best result without large-scale robot-policy pretraining, while its pretrained $π_{0.5}$ instantiation reaches 86.3%, achieving the best overall performance. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world bimanual manipulation further demonstrate strong generalization under visual and spatial shifts.

analysis.tldr: 提出JEPA-WAM，一种在预训练V-JEPA隐空间中构建的潜世界动作模型，通过共享预测器将状态转移预测与连续动作生成耦合，避免显式视频生成开销，同时保持时空结构和patch级对应，在LIBERO-Plus上达到79.2%（无大规模机器人策略预训练）或86.3%（接入预训练π₀.₅），并在RoboTwin 2.0和真实双臂操作中验证了视觉/空间扰动下的泛化性。
analysis.claim: 在预训练JEPA隐空间中构建联合嵌入世界动作模型（JEPA-WAM），通过共享预测器实现转移建模与动作生成的端到端耦合，无需显式未来帧生成即可获得高精度、强泛化性的视觉语言动作策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续关节动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0仿真数据及少量真实双臂操作数据，未使用大规模真实机器人轨迹（如Xiaomi-Robotics-1的100K小时）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（JEPA空间+共享预测器+联合目标设计），实证扎实：LIBERO-Plus SOTA（无大规真实数据）、RoboTwin 2.0多任务验证、真实双臂操作泛化测试；但未开源代码/模型，且未突破‘预训练VLA+微调’主流范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本跨机体、长时程闭环控制），分量介于OpenVLA（93）与Octo（92）之下，略高于典型增量工作（如单任务WAM改进），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚不足，但工程整合扎实——在JEPA隐空间内首次实现转移预测与动作生成的紧耦合设计，并在仿真+小规模真实场景中验证有效性，优于多数纯仿真WAM工作，但受限于开源缺失和未挑战根本瓶颈。

papers.title: High Fidelity Capture, Reconstruction, and Transfer of Human Demonstrations for Robot-Assisted Bathing
papers.abstract: Despite the demand for robots in high-value clinical tasks like bathing, contemporary systems still lack the safety and reliability required for complex, sustained physical interaction with humans. A key challenge hindering the development of such systems is that collecting, understanding, and effectively transferring highly dynamic, contact-rich human bathing demonstrations is difficult, even with modern motion and tactile sensing equipment. We present a straightforward, but effective framework for doing so with high fidelity by utilizing contact regions as a key processing primitive. We use our framework to build a dataset of bathing demonstrations performed by trained clinicians on human subjects. We then use this dataset to design and control an arm-mounted dexterous soft hand to perform bathing tasks on a mannequin using open- and closed-loop strategies. Our dataset is the first to provide high quality synchronized motion, shape, contact, and force during sustained, contact-rich human-human interaction, and our transfer strategies demonstrate effective use of these data across multiple levels of the robotics stack. All relevant materials will be publicly released to enable further advancements in physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) research.

analysis.tldr: 用接触区域作为核心处理单元，高保真采集并重建临床护士为真人洗澡的全过程（含同步运动、形变、接触位置、力），构建首个高质量人-人接触密集交互数据集，并将这些数据用于控制软体灵巧手在假人上完成开环/闭环洗澡任务。
analysis.claim: 接触区域（contact regions）可作为统一表征基元，支撑从高保真人类洗澡示范采集、重建到机器人策略迁移的全链条pHRI建模。
analysis.input: 多模态同步信号：IMU+光学动捕+触觉压力阵列+深度相机+软体手形变传感
analysis.output: 软体灵巧手的关节轨迹与接触力分布序列（开环预演 + 闭环力反馈调整）
analysis.robot_dependency: 臂 mounted dexterous soft hand（定制软体手+UR5机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类受试者与临床护士的实操数据；所有策略训练/验证均基于该真实采集数据，无仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现临床级人-人接触密集任务（洗澡）的全模态高保真采集与跨层级迁移（感知→建模→控制→部署），数据质量与任务真实性远超多数benchmark，但策略泛化性仅限单一软体手+假人平台，未验证跨机体/跨用户/跨任务鲁棒性，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破或通用策略层面的SOTA推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在pHRI最棘手的临床接触任务上，完成了从数据采集、建模到真实机器人部署的端到端闭环，证据扎实、开源完整，但未提出新学习范式或通用策略架构。

papers.title: ReactHuman: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Human-Like Reactive Decision-Making in Embodied Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Reacting to sudden physical hazards (catching a slipping plate, dodging a falling knife) is both a meaningful test of embodied intelligence and a hard requirement for deploying multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as the decision coreof household robots. Existing evaluations, however, probe intuitive physics passively through question answering over videos, or target deliberate, long-horizon tasks such as navigation and rearrangement; none measure whether a model can turn physical understanding into immediate, safety-critical action. We introduce ReactHuman, the first physics-grounded benchmark for human-like reactive decision-making, in which the evaluated MLLM acts as the brain of a simulated humanoid facing sudden household hazards; it spans 17 event families and over 1,000 bit-for-bit reproducible scenes with exact, annotation-free ground truth derived from 240 Hz rigid-body simulation, including adversarial objects whose appearance contradicts their physics (a foam anvil, a steel apple). We further design a five-metric suite that scores each reaction along three axes: reasonable, safe, and physically grounded. We physically execute every committed plan so that decisions have observable consequences. With this harness we evaluate seven representative MLLMs. Results show that reactive safety is far from solved: models mishandle roughly one hazard in three, act from fixed dispositions rather than the observed scene, trust appearance over motion, and miss interception points at meter scale even when the chosen action is correct; none of these failures shrink with model scale. ReactHuman thus offers both a fine-grained diagnosis and a scalable training signal toward physically grounded, safety-aware embodied agents. The benchmark can be found here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Alan123/reacthuman-benchmark-scaled

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向具身多模态大模型（MLLM）的物理 grounded 反应式决策评测基准 ReactHuman，用高帧率刚体仿真生成1000+可复现的家庭突发危险场景（如滑落的盘子、坠落的刀），要求模型在毫秒级响应窗口内输出安全、合理、符合物理规律的动作指令，并用五维指标量化评估其反应质量。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Hugging Face 数据集页未提供机构信息，无法从姓名推断主流机构归属）
analysis.claim: 现有 MLLM 缺乏对突发物理危险的即时、安全、物理一致的反应能力，而 ReactHuman 是首个专为此类人类式反应决策设计的、具备精确物理真值与可观测动作后果的评测基准。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 危险事件触发信号（隐含在仿真状态中）
analysis.output: 离散动作指令（如 'catch left hand', 'step back right'）或结构化反应决策（非连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自定义仿真人形机器人（基于刚体物理引擎，未指明具体平台如 Isaac Gym/Mujoco/PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于240Hz刚体仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘毫秒级物理反应’的具身MLLM评测基准，设计严谨（对抗性物体、五维物理一致性评分、全仿真执行验证），填补了从‘理解物理’到‘执行物理反应’之间的关键评测空白；但仍是纯仿真基准，未涉及真实机器人部署、跨机体泛化或训练闭环，分量不及前述基石工作（均含真机/世界模型/运动生成/零样本迁移等实质性系统级突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——首次系统定义并可量化评测MLLM的物理反应能力，但限于仿真评测，尚未构成系统级突破

papers.title: Visible-Reachable Workspace for Perception-Aware Humanoid Design
papers.abstract: Workspace analysis measures where a robot can place its end effector. For visually guided manipulation, reachability alone is insufficient: a kinematically reachable target may not be visible in the specific pose required to reach it. The robot must then redirect its sensing or move its body to acquire a view, turning a perception limitation into additional motion. Existing humanoids largely inherit this limitation when copying human form factors. We introduce the visible-reachable workspace (VRW), a design-stage measure that conditions visibility on feasible reaching configurations and extends it to concurrent visibility of spatially separated work regions. We apply VRW by building a 31-DoF humanoid with independently actuated RGB-D cameras. On the same robot, camera articulation increases visible-reachable coverage from 38% to 97%. With actuated camera layouts, a second camera raises pairwise coverage from 0.45 to 0.95, while a third changes it only to 0.97. In a controlled two-target reach-and-grasp benchmark, our dual-actuated design reduces mean completion time by 17% and mechanical energy by 19% relative to the same robot with its cameras fixed. Hardware experiments demonstrate simultaneous observation and manipulation of front/back and left/right target pairs without torso reorientation.
