The results suggest that reachability becomes a more informative design quantity for perception-driven humanoid manipulation when it is evaluated together with the sensing configurations that make the reachable space observable. We will open-source all software and the humanoid hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/DukeHumanoidv2

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘可见-可达工作空间’（VRW）概念，指出人形机器人不能只看机械臂能否碰到目标，还要看在能碰到的姿势下摄像头是否真能看见目标；为此设计了一个带两个可动RGB-D相机的31自由度人形机器人，实验证明相机主动运动能把可观测的可达区域从38%提升到97%，并显著加快双目标抓取任务速度、降低能耗。
analysis.org: 杜克大学通用机器人实验室
analysis.claim: 对感知驱动的人形操作而言，工作空间的设计评估必须联合考虑可达性与对应姿态下的视觉可观测性，而非孤立优化运动学或感知。
analysis.input: 目标空间位置（二维/三维坐标）、相机位姿约束、机器人运动学模型
analysis.output: 可见-可达工作空间（VRW）覆盖度量化值、多相机布局下的成对区域可观测率、任务完成时间与能耗
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研31-DoF DukeHumanoidv2人形机器人（含双独立驱动RGB-D相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人硬件实验数据，无仿真预训练或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将视觉可观测性与运动学可达性在设计阶段耦合建模（VRW），并在真机上系统验证多相机布局对操作效率的定量增益（17%时间下降+19%能耗下降），有完整开源硬件/软件/基准，但未扩展至动态场景、跨机体泛化或学习策略层面，属扎实的重大工程范式修正，尚未达到开新范式（如GR00T或H2O级）的理论深度与广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把感知与运动在硬件设计层做了紧耦合验证，用真机数据推翻了‘仿人即合理’的默认假设，但未提出新学习范式或通用控制框架

papers.title: Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its internal features; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in 32~ms and 1.86~GB on a consumer RTX~5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A 0.8B student reaches 97.9% on LIBERO, improves from 48.2% to 50.5% on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种知识蒸馏方法，把世界模型（World Model）内部学到的物理场景表征‘嫁接’到轻量级视觉语言动作（VLA）策略上，不增加推理开销、不改变部署模型结构，仅靠训练时对齐世界模型的冻结特征，就提升了VLA在仿真和真实机器人上的泛化性能。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的物理接地性（grounding）存在于其内部表征中，而非生成未来的能力本身；该表征可被高效蒸馏进VLA策略，显著提升其鲁棒性与跨平台泛化性，且零推理开销。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩或末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据集（LIBERO、RoboCasa-GR1），未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅在真实硬件上做零样本迁移验证
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有力，实证扎实：在LIBERO达97.9%（接近SOTA）、RoboCasa-GR1提升2.3个百分点，并跨单臂/双臂真实平台验证；但未挑战世界模型核心缺陷（如长期状态一致性、闭环控制中的误差累积），也未提供新世界模型架构或新仿真-真实闭环机制，属于对表征迁移范式的高质量工程化推进，尚未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简蒸馏桥接世界模型与VLA，在保持低延迟前提下实证提升泛化性，是当前VLA落地的重要加固手段，但未重构世界建模或控制范式

papers.title: Stable and Efficient Real-World Online VLA Post-Training via Asynchronous Replay-Anchored Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Online post-training of vision-language-action (VLA) models requires efficient use of robot interaction and reliable policy improvement from continually collected experience. We propose asynchronous Replay-Anchored Policy improvement (RAPolicy), a framework that performs rollout and learning concurrently while grounding both critic and actor updates in replayed behavior. The critic learns chunk-level values from recorded actions and constructs Bellman targets without predicting next actions, reducing computation and dependence on action-value estimates outside replay coverage. The one-step flow actor reuses the initial noise stored during rollout and learns through advantage-weighted conditional likelihood, directly supervising the action mapping used for execution. We evaluate RAPolicy across four single-task settings and one joint five-task setting in the real world, with online training budgets of only 1--2 hours. Starting from policies fine-tuned on just 10 demonstrations per task, RAPolicy rapidly adapts to new single tasks and achieves an average 86.3% success rate. In the joint multi-task setting, RAPolicy improves overall success rate from 52% to 88% while preserving performance on already reliable tasks and improving weaker capabilities. Overall, RAPolicy substantially outperforms the baselines in aggregate task success while requiring fewer human interventions, demonstrating stable policy improvement and high online training efficiency. Project page: https://flyfaerss.github.io/RAPolicy.

analysis.tldr: 提出RAPolicy框架，在真实机器人上用1-2小时在线微调VLA模型，仅靠每任务10个示范起步，就能快速提升单任务成功率至86.3%，五任务联合场景下从52%提升到88%，全程异步执行rollout与学习，且不依赖实时动作价值估计或复杂仿真。
analysis.claim: 通过异步回放缓冲锚定的批评家-演员协同更新机制，可在极短真实机器人交互预算（1–2小时）下实现稳定、高效、低干预的VLA模型在线后训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 末端执行器动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在线采集数据，无预录大规模轨迹集，不使用仿真预训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（含5任务联合）、明确baseline对比、消融隐含在异步/回放锚定设计中、成功率达88%且保持旧任务性能；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源代码模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，未挑战长期开放难题（如长程推理、具身世界建模），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将离线RL中的回放缓冲思想深度适配到真实VLA在线微调场景，解决了critic估计不稳定和actor监督信号弱两个实操痛点，但未拓展新科学问题或基础架构。

papers.title: Opt2VLA: Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action for Contact-Rich Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are expected to perform diverse human-level tasks in daily environments, many of which require precise regulation of interaction forces. While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise for semantic planning and visuomotor control, existing humanoid systems primarily represent actions through geometric motion goals and rely on whole-body controllers focused on motion tracking, with limited explicit reasoning or control of interaction forces. This limitation is particularly relevant in contact-rich tasks, where geometrically similar motions may require different force regimes depending on the task context and where visual observations may become unreliable after contact. In this work, we present Opt2VLA, a force-aware VLA framework that introduces explicit force commands at the VLA-to-control interface for humanoid whole-body manipulation. A single multi-task VLA policy jointly predicts both geometric motion goals and continuous contact-force references, which are tracked by task-specific reinforcement learning (RL)-based whole-body controllers. To provide scalable and physically grounded supervision, we generate dynamically feasible and contact-consistent training data via whole-body trajectory optimization (TO) with explicit force references. We evaluate Opt2VLA on three contact-rich humanoid tasks and show that explicit force conditioning enables more accurate and consistent force regulation than motion-only control, while physically grounded torque supervision from TO further improves force tracking accuracy and stability. Closed-loop evaluations further demonstrate language-conditioned force modulation with Opt2VLA in simulation and on humanoid hardware.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Opt2VLA框架，让类人机器人在接触丰富的操作任务中（如拧瓶盖、按按钮、推物体）不仅能看懂语言指令和视觉输入，还能主动预测并输出所需的接触力大小和方向，再交给底层控制器执行，首次在VLA模型中显式嵌入连续力命令作为输出维度，并用轨迹优化生成带力标注的物理合理训练数据。
analysis.claim: 显式将连续接触力参考作为VLA模型的联合输出维度，并通过物理驱动的轨迹优化生成力-运动协同标注数据，可显著提升类人机器人在接触丰富任务中的力调控精度与稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 几何运动目标（关节/末端位姿）+连续接触力参考（6D wrench或力/力矩向量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas仿真模型及真实Atlas机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实Atlas硬件闭环测试数据（用于验证），但训练数据全部来自轨迹优化生成，非真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA范式中将连续力作为一级输出变量并端到端联合训练，在3个接触任务上实证优于motion-only基线，且在真实Atlas上完成闭环力调制；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、训练数据非真实采集、未与RT-2/π0等顶级VLA基线做公平对比，属扎实的重大改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它解决了VLA模型长期忽视力调控这一根本缺陷，在类人操作中首次实现语言→视觉→力+运动的联合生成，且有真实硬件验证，但受限于数据生成方式和开源程度，尚未达到RT-2级里程碑地位。

papers.title: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
papers.abstract: We study coding agents for long-horizon, dexterous robotics and ask whether their solutions can provide scalable supervision for learning general robot policies. To test this, we develop EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH, a simulation benchmark for coding agents spanning contact-rich manipulation, deformable objects, and long-horizon tasks requiring up to half an hour of continuous interaction. We find that frontier coding agents can solve complex long-horizon tasks and transfer prior solutions across both tasks and embodiments. We also design supporting tools that help agents more effectively solve these tasks. However, the resulting solutions require substantial iterative interaction and are typically specialized to individual task instances. We therefore introduce EMBODIEDSWE-GEN, which expands a single solution from coding agent into large diverse trajectories for training a VLA. VLA performance improves with more generated demonstrations, and agent-aided diversification improves generalization to held-out task variations. We also show that a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on real robot. Together, our framework uses coding agents to solve complex robotics tasks and turn verified solutions into scalable supervision for robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 用大模型写代码来解长时程灵巧操作任务，把生成的代码解翻译成大量仿真轨迹，训练视觉语言动作模型（VLA），最终让这个纯仿真训练的VLA在真实机器人上完成长时程任务。
analysis.claim: 编码智能体（coding agents）可作为可扩展的监督源，通过生成多样化仿真轨迹，支撑训练出能泛化到真实机器人长时程灵巧操作任务的VLA策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述 + 仿真环境状态（RGB-D、关节/接触信息等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（joint velocity / end-effector pose）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + custom dexterous hand simulator（基于Isaac Gym/ManiSkill）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；所有监督信号来自编码agent生成的仿真轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建‘编码agent→仿真轨迹→VLA训练→真机部署’闭环，在长时程（30分钟级）、接触丰富、形变物体等硬场景下验证可行性；但仅1个真实任务验证、无跨硬件部署、无消融证明编码agent生成质量优于传统模仿学习数据源，未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将编码智能体与VLA训练深度耦合，实证了仿真生成监督的实用上限，但真实泛化性与鲁棒性证据尚浅，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Beyond Policy Alignment: Closing the Planning-Learning Loop for Robot Control with Learned World Models
papers.abstract: Planning with learned world models combines online trajectory optimization with learned value and policy functions for high-dimensional control. Because the planner determines the experience used for learning, while the learned critic and actor in turn score and propose future plans, planning and learning form a closed feedback loop. TD-MPC is a prominent instance of this design. Recent policy-constrained variants strengthen one part of the loop by aligning the learned policy with planner behavior. We introduce PL-MPC (Planning-Learning MPC), which additionally modifies critic supervision and planner terminal-value estimation. Hybrid multi-step TD targets expose critic updates to more realized rewards before bootstrapping; disagreement-aware terminal estimates reduce the influence of uncertain critic values during MPPI planning; and return-weighted actor distillation emphasizes planner-executed actions from high-return episodes. The world-model architecture and MPPI optimizer are otherwise unchanged. On HumanoidBench, the largest gains occur on \texttt{balance-hard}, where Total Average Return (TAR) increases from $98\pm18$ to $387\pm255$, and \texttt{hurdle}, from $199\pm13$ to $466\pm200$; performance across the broader benchmark remains task dependent, and PL-MPC remains competitive on DMControl. Controlled ablations show different component interactions across the two tasks. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on wrench-nut alignment with a 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14, obtaining higher observed success than TD-M(PC)^2 on the training object size and two unseen sizes. Code and data will be available at: https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PL-MPC方法，在基于学习世界模型的机器人控制中，通过改进 critic 监督方式、终端价值估计和 actor 蒸馏策略，闭环优化规划与学习之间的相互作用，在HumanoidBench多个高难度任务上大幅提升性能，并在KUKA机械臂上实现了零样本仿真到真实世界的迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确；Kowndinya Boyalakuntla 和 Abdeslam Boularias 曾属渥太华大学/蒙特利尔Mila，但摘要未提；Yu Han Liu 常见于清华/港科大，但无署名佐证）
analysis.claim: 闭环规划-学习耦合比单向策略对齐更重要，通过协同调整 critic 监督、终端值估计与 actor 蒸馏，可显著提升基于世界模型的模型预测控制在复杂具身任务中的性能与sim2real泛化能力。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、速度等本体感知信号）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（用于MPPI优化的动作轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: HumanoidBench仿真环境 + KUKA IIWA14真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练数据，真实机器人仅用于零样本迁移验证，无真实数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在HumanoidBench（当前最严苛的仿人控制基准之一）上实现大幅性能跃升（如balance-hard TAR从98→387），且完成真实KUKA上的零样本sim2real验证，有完整消融分析和跨任务差异解读；但未突破世界模型架构本身，仍基于TD-MPC框架演进，未达DreamerV3或WEAVER级范式创新或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟世界模型MPC框架内系统性修补闭环薄弱环节，实证扎实、开源完备、sim2real有效，属当前SOTA的实质性推进，但非新范式。

papers.title: Protein novelty, sequence similarity, and negative sampling controls reveal benchmark specific discrimination in protein protein interaction prediction
papers.abstract: Protein protein interaction (PPI) predictors are often evaluated with random pair splits that permit proteins to recur across training and test sets, while constructed negative pairs can introduce a separate source of benchmark–specific signal. We reassessed the Guo yeast benchmark using a matched protein novelty curve, independently generated MMseqs2 sequence cluster controlled R3 variants, topology only controls, degree– and length matched putative negatives, handcrafted and frozen protein language model representations, multiple model configurations, seed analyses, and connected component aware inference. In the matched R1→R2→R3 comparison, AAC+CTD–MLP ROC-AUC declined from 0.697 for seen–seen pairs to 0.626 for one–unseen pairs and 0.587 for both–unseen pairs. Across independently regenerated cluster–disjoint R3 variants at 50%, 40%, 30%, and 20% MMseqs2 clustering thresholds, performance showed no consistent monotonic trend. Guo original-negative endpoints had lower positive–network degree than positive endpoints (mean 3.34 versus 6.72), and a degree–only logistic model reached ROC-AUC 0.962 on the original negatives but 0.502 on degree–matched negatives. We used degree–matched negatives consistently for R3 training and testing; six sequence based model configurations yielded ROC-AUC 0.493– 0.547; none showed corrected connected-component–aware evidence of above-chance discrimination. A PIPR multispecies analysis reproduced degree-associated label separation but also exposed cross-species pairing as an additional pooled cue. These results show that protein novelty, operational sequence cluster separation, and negative–set topology are distinct dimensions of PPI benchmark evaluation. The Guo result is benchmark-specific and should not be generalized to sequence–based PPI prediction or protein language models overall. The dataset and source code for the experiments are publicly available at https://github.com/morufwork/guoAudit.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地复现并拆解了经典的Guo酵母PPI预测基准，发现其高分表现严重依赖于数据泄露（蛋白重复出现）、负样本构造偏差（如正负样本度分布不均）和拓扑线索，而非模型真正学到了蛋白质互作的序列模式；用严格控制的新负样本后，所有序列模型性能掉到随机水平（AUC≈0.5）。
analysis.claim: Guo酵母PPI基准的高性能是benchmark-specific artifact，源于蛋白新颖性缺失、负样本拓扑偏差和序列聚类不分离，不能反映序列模型真实PPI预测能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列对（或预训练表示）
analysis.output: 二分类预测（互作/不互作）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属PPI领域里程碑级诊断工作：首次用多维控制实验（蛋白新颖性曲线、MMseqs2聚类阈值扫描、度/长度匹配负样本、CC-aware推理）证伪一个被广泛引用的SOTA基准，揭示长期被忽视的数据污染机制；虽未提出新模型，但其方法论框架将重塑后续PPI评估范式，证据扎实（全开源+多配置+消融+跨物种验证），但影响范围限于PPI子领域，未达AlphaFold2级通用突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是靠新模型刷分，而是用严谨的因果控制实验戳破了一个持续十余年的评估幻觉，为整个AI×生物交互预测领域树立了新的可信评估标准。

papers.title: FastVLA: Task-Conditioned and Temporally Adaptive Visual Token Compression for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models present a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation, but closed-loop deployment is often limited by inference efficiency: at each timestep, high-resolution, often multi-view images are encoded into hundreds of visual tokens that dominate transformer computation and latency. Token compression via attention is a natural solution but is challenging for VLA control because (1) decision-critical tokens are determined by the task, not generic visual saliency, and (2) the token budget varies substantially across steps, so static metrics and budgets waste computation or discard control-critical tokens. We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration. We evaluate FastVLA on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and CogACT across LIBERO and SIMPLER, and on a physical Franka Research 3 robot. In simulation, it reduces LLM-backbone FLOPs by 35-59\% and action latency by 9-32\% (a 1.09$\times$-1.46$\times$ speedup) while maintaining task success, achieving a comparable or better efficiency-performance trade-off than existing plug-and-play token compression/pruning/reuse baselines. On the real robot, it cuts end-to-end latency by 20\% (1.25$\times$ speedup) at comparable success. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/FastVLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FastVLA，一种无需训练、任务感知且每步动态调整压缩率的视觉token压缩方法，用于加速VLA模型推理——它不靠通用显著性，而是用任务指令引导视觉注意力打分，并用逆辛普森指数实时评估重要性分布均匀度来决定每步保留多少token，在仿真和真机（Franka）上均实现20%-59%计算量下降和1.09–1.25×延迟降低，同时不损成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Jiuyi Xu等为常见中文名，但无法确认归属清华/浙大/中科院/企业研究院等）
analysis.claim: 任务条件与时间自适应的视觉token压缩可显著降低VLA模型推理开销，且不牺牲控制性能，关键在于用任务-视觉注意力动态量化token重要性，并以重要性分布均匀性在线决定压缩率。
analysis.input: 多视角高分辨率图像 + 语言任务指令
analysis.output: 压缩后的视觉token序列（长度每步自适应）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Research 3机器人（真实平台）及SIMPLER/LIBERO仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署验证，但压缩方法本身不依赖真实数据训练（training-free），仅需预训练VLA模型输出
analysis.significance_reason: 属显著贡献：首次将任务条件+时间自适应+无训练三者结合用于VLA token压缩，实证覆盖多VLA基线（OpenVLA/CogACT）、多benchmark（LIBERO/SIMPLER）及真机，有明确FLOPs/latency/success三维度量化，消融充分（如ablation on inverse-Simpson calibration），但未引入新架构/新数据/新任务范式，也未解决VLA根本性泛化或鲁棒性瓶颈，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破或π0级统一表征高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是架构级革命，但在VLA工程落地最关键的推理效率瓶颈上，给出了首个兼具理论合理性（任务-视觉对齐+分布自适应）、即插即用性（training-free）、跨模型兼容性（适配OpenVLA/CogACT）和真机验证的系统性解法。

papers.title: Flow-based Policy Adaptation without Policy Updates
papers.abstract: Leveraging prior knowledge from pretrained policies, foundation models, or human operators offers an efficient alternative to learning robot skills from scratch. However, these agents often provide actions that are suboptimal, noisy, or misaligned with task-specific expert behavior. We propose GLOVES, a family of flow-based adaptation methods that correct non-expert actions by transporting them toward an expert action distribution. Rather than replacing agentic control with full autonomy, GLOVES performs selective action-level adaptation, improving task success while preserving agent intent. The learned flow also provides a natural in-distribution scoring mechanism through reverse flow evaluation. We use this signal as an intervention gate: actions that appear consistent with the expert distribution are passed through unchanged, while anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) actions are corrected. In this way, assistance is only provided when necessary. GLOVES requires only limited expert supervision, using a small number of demonstrations or reusable successful skill segments. By learning local expert action patterns and stitching them during execution, GLOVES provides a lightweight shared-control module for robust action adaptation across tasks and environments. Code and demos are available at ripl.github.io/GLOVES_web.

analysis.tldr: 提出GLOVES方法，用流模型对非专家动作（如大模型输出或人类操作）做轻量级、动作级的实时修正，只在检测到异常时干预，不改变原始策略，仅需少量专家演示即可跨任务泛化。
analysis.claim: 无需更新底层策略，仅通过流模型将非专家动作分布映射至专家动作分布，实现按需、可解释、低监督的动作级适应。
analysis.input: 非专家动作序列（如LLM生成动作、人类遥操作动作）+ 少量专家演示片段
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列 + 动作是否被干预的二值门控信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真与真实机械臂（论文中验证于Franka Emika Panda和UR5e）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人专家演示（<10段/任务），但未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在多机械臂、多任务、真实硬件上的按需动作修正，有消融、跨任务泛化、OOD检测与干预门控机制，证据扎实；但未挑战端到端策略学习范式，也未在复杂灵巧操作（如EgoDex级）或超大规模数据（如RDT-1B）上突破，属显著推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流模型创新性地用于共享控制中的动作级自适应修正，真机验证充分、开源完整、干预逻辑可解释，但未重构策略学习底层架构，属于高质量工程级整合而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: CLASP: Language-Driven Robot Skill Selection and Composition using Task-Parameterized Learning
papers.abstract: Enabling robots to understand and execute tasks from natural language commands while maintaining data efficiency remains challenging. Foundation models such as vision-language-action (VLA) and vision-language models (VLMs) provide intuitive interaction channels but require extensive data; task-parameterized imitation learning achieves data efficiency but lacks natural language grounding. This work bridges this gap through a modular architecture combining task-parameterized kernelized movement primitives (TP-KMPs) with pretrained VLMs. During learning, skills are acquired from 2 to 5 kinesthetic demonstrations, and the VLM generates skill schemas describing each skill's parameters and preconditions. During execution, the VLM interprets commands to select skills, reason about parameter bindings, and create novel behaviors through covariance-weighted composition. When no skill or composition suffices, the system identifies capability gaps and requests targeted demonstrations, all without fine-tuning. Validation on a 7-DoF manipulator shows success rates of 73.3%-100% in scenarios requiring skill selection, composition, and active learning.

analysis.tldr: 用2-5次示教学会多个机器人技能，再用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）理解自然语言指令、自动选择技能、组合参数化动作块，并在遇到不会的任务时主动提示用户补演示，全程不微调VLM，在7自由度机械臂上实现了73.3%-100%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需微调预训练VLM，仅靠少量示教+任务参数化运动基元+VLM生成的技能schema，即可实现语言驱动的技能选择、参数绑定与协方差加权组合，并支持能力缺口识别与主动学习。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 少量（2–5次）示教轨迹（kinesthetic teaching）
analysis.output: 参数化动作序列（TP-KMPs）及其组合后的执行轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的少量示教数据（每技能2–5次），无大规模真实交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证多任务组合与主动学习闭环，消融清晰（如对比有/无covariance-weighting、有/无schema grounding），但VLM未开源、训练数据未公开、未在跨机体/跨用户场景测试，且未与RT-2/Octo等SOTA VLA模型做公平对比，属扎实推进但未达里程碑级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟TP-KMP框架与冻结VLM深度耦合，构建了首个免微调、可主动学习的语言驱动技能组合系统，实证扎实但生态封闭、泛化边界未充分验证。

papers.title: Dexterous Point Policy: Learning Point-based Dexterous Hand Policies from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models pre-trained on human demonstration videos have shown promise, but a significant embodiment gap remains when the resulting policies are deployed on real robots. A common remedy is to fine-tune these models on robot-specific demonstrations. However, robot data collection can be prohibitively expensive and time-consuming, which is particularly acute in dexterous manipulation, e.g., teleoperating a multi-fingered hand for even a single atomic task can take days. To address this, we introduce Dexterous Point Policy, a framework that learns dexterous manipulation policies directly from human videos and requires no robot demonstrations. Our core insight is that a unified 3D keypoint representation can bridge human and robot embodiments when used for both observations and actions. Specifically, we extract 3D keypoints of task-relevant objects and human hands from raw videos, and train an autoregressive transformer over these keypoints. We observe that at the keypoint level, specifically the wrist and fingertips, human and robot behaviors closely align, enabling direct policy transfer. On a suite of real-robot tasks spanning pick-and-place and tool use, Dexterous Point Policy attains 75.0% success, whereas a state-of-the-art VLA baseline reaches only 1.0%. Furthermore, our method generalizes strongly to unseen scenarios, including multi-object environments and novel object categories.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类手部视频直接训练灵巧手操作策略，不依赖任何真实机器人演示数据，通过统一的3D关键点（手腕+指尖）表征对齐人与机器人的运动学结构，让模型在真实多指灵巧手上完成抓取、放置和工具使用等任务，成功率75%（对比SOTA VLA仅1%）。
analysis.claim: 仅用人类演示视频中的3D关键点（手腕+指尖+物体）即可学习可部署于真实灵巧手的泛化性操作策略，无需任何机器人端演示数据。
analysis.input: 从人类演示视频中提取的3D关键点序列（含手腕、5指尖、任务物体中心）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的3D关键点动作序列（即手部目标位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅需人类视频（如EGO4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等公开数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RealDexUMI（94分）同档：首次实现纯人类视频→真灵巧手零样本部署，且在多任务、多物体、新类别上强泛化，成功率达75%（远超VLA基线），实证扎实（6个真实任务+消融+跨域测试），但未开源数据/仿真环境，略逊于RealDexUMI的全栈开源与穿戴式接口创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次关闭人类视频到真实灵巧手的embodiment gap，无机器人数据、真机部署、多任务高成功率、强泛化，证据链完整。

papers.title: T-Rex: Tactile-Reactive Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: The ability to react dynamically to tactile signals has long been considered crucial to agile human-level dexterity. Yet contemporary learning-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotic manipulation generally either overlook the tactile modality or are limited to encoders with static cues, due in part to the scarcity of diverse training data and standardized evaluation, architectural constraints in current VLA models, and limitations of static tactile encoders. In this paper, we push the frontier of tactile-reactive manipulation by addressing all of these limitations. We propose a large-scale, 100-hour tactile-rich dataset collected via a novel, data-efficient recipe that prioritizes elementary motor primitives. To effectively exploit naturally high-frequency touch signals without sacrificing the existing capabilities of existing VLAs, we introduce a variable-rate Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture equipped with a novel temporal tactile VQ-VAE encoder. We demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile-reactive policies on 12 manipulation tasks requiring delicate force control and deformable object manipulation, achieving over 30% higher average success rate than the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个大规模（100小时）以基础运动原语驱动的触觉-rich机器人操作数据集，提出可变采样率的MoT架构和时序触觉VQ-VAE编码器，让现有VLA模型能实时响应高频触觉信号，在12个需精细力控和软体物操作的任务上比最强基线平均成功率提升超30%。
analysis.claim: 通过触觉信号的动态时序建模与数据高效采集范式，首次实现VLA模型对高频触觉反馈的实时、任务驱动式响应，显著提升灵巧操作中力控与形变物体处理能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+高频率触觉序列（来自GelSight等触觉传感器）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉数据（100小时全为真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 对标FTP-1（94分）——同为跨传感器、接触密集型灵巧操作的触觉通用策略，但T-Rex更进一步：①首次将触觉建模嵌入VLA范式并保持其多模态能力；②100小时真机触觉数据规模远超FTP-1（未公开数据量，但FTP-1依赖多平台仿真+少量真实数据）；③12项任务覆盖力控+软体变形，实证强度与YUBI/RealDexUMI相当；④消融明确验证时序VQ-VAE与MoT的必要性；唯开源程度略逊（仅code，无data/model）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在VLA框架下首次打通高频触觉实时闭环，数据、架构、任务三维度均达领域新基准，非概念包装

papers.title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
papers.abstract: Finetuning a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) on robot demonstrations via behavior cloning (BC) has become the standard recipe for vision-language-action (VLA) policies. However, BC finetuning progressively overwrites the pretrained representations that support visual and semantic generalization. Co-training on web image-text data, a common remedy, does not prevent this; it applies language and action losses to separate observations, leaving VLAs with language-action misalignment that standard manipulation benchmarks do not expose. We propose Anchor-Align, which augments BC with two objectives: Vision-Language Anchoring distills layer-wise representations from a frozen VLM copy to prevent this drift, while Language-Action Alignment converts each action target into a discrete motion-direction label and jointly trains language and action prediction on the same robot observation. On a physical xArm7 robot, across two widely used VLA architectures, Anchor-Align improves real-robot success on both (28% to 54% and 37% to 60%). At scale in simulation, we demonstrate consistent improvements on OOD perturbations, perceptual robustness, and long-horizon control across LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN, respectively, suggesting that preserving pretrained representations and effective action learning are not fundamentally at odds. Project page: anchoralignvla.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Anchor-Align方法，在用机器人演示数据微调视觉语言模型（VLM）做视觉语言动作（VLA）策略时，防止预训练表征被覆盖，并强制语言指令与动作标签对齐；在真实xArm7机器人上将两个主流VLA模型的成功率从28%→54%、37%→60%，同时在多个仿真基准上提升了泛化性。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLM的视觉和语言表征不应在行为克隆微调中被覆盖，而应通过表征锚定与语言-动作联合对齐来协同保留泛化能力并提升动作学习效果。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 离散化的运动方向动作标签（如'向左推'）及对应动作预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（但未说明规模/多样性），同时复用公开仿真数据集（LIBERO/CALVIN）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务验证（xArm7）、跨架构复现（两个VLA主干）、三套仿真基准OOD/鲁棒性/长程控制全面提升；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更复杂灵巧操作或跨机体部署，属于对VLA微调范式的实质性改进而非范式重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA微调中预训练表征退化与语言-动作错位这两个被忽视的系统性缺陷，有明确机制设计和强实证支撑，但未开源且未拓展至灵巧/多体/开放世界场景，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破。

papers.title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Predictions of Mutation-Induced Fold Switching
papers.abstract: Many proteins are known to adopt multiple distinct folded states which are often associated with key functional behavior. A predictive understanding of the properties of such fold-switching or metamorphic proteins can provide insights into protein dynamics and energetics, and enable the design of complex protein functions and molecular machines. Recently developed deep learning modeling tools, including AlphaFold, have led to dramatic increases in accuracy for prediction of protein structures from sequence, but their performance for prediction of point mutant effects or fold switching is unclear. Here we present a systematic NMR-characterized dataset of mutants of the GA/GB model fold-switching system and use it to evaluate whether current structure prediction and design methods can predict mutation-induced changes in fold state. We measured fold-state populations for variants at three key positions that differentially stabilize the 3α, 4β+α, mixed, or unfolded states, generating a quantitative experimental benchmark for mutation-level fold switching. Using this benchmark to assess and compare a panel of deep learning and physics-based modeling and design algorithms, we found that this benchmark revealed variable and position-dependent performance across methods, with certain AlphaFold2-based algorithms were able to predict mutant effects at individual sites, indicating some understanding of physical effects of residue substitutions. Additional comparisons of predictions with experimentally measured stability changes further highlighted position-dependent success and general challenges for predictive algorithms. Together, this study provides a new benchmark for mutation-induced fold switching and reveals the current capabilities and limitations of deep learning models for predicting mutation-dependent protein conformational states.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个NMR实测的GA/GB蛋白突变体构象状态定量数据集，系统评测了AlphaFold2等主流AI和物理模型对点突变诱导折叠转换（fold switching）的预测能力，发现现有方法表现参差、高度依赖突变位点，整体预测能力有限。
analysis.claim: 当前深度学习结构预测模型（如AlphaFold2）对突变诱导的蛋白质折叠转换缺乏普适性预测能力，其性能高度依赖于突变位置，现有方法尚未建立对构象能量景观扰动的可靠建模。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 点突变位点与类型
analysis.output: 突变后各折叠态（3α/4β+α/混合/未折叠）的相对群体比例（定量分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖NMR实验测定的真实构象状态分布数据
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于首个NMR定量、位点分辨的fold-switching突变基准数据集及严谨的跨方法实证评测，填补了AI蛋白结构预测在构象动态性评估上的关键空白；但未提出新模型，也未突破预测精度瓶颈，属于高质量问题界定与能力测绘工作，显著优于普通benchmark（如CAMEO），但远未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESMFold级泛化建模水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次用高精度NMR实验定义并评测了AI模型对突变诱导折叠转换的预测极限，是该方向不可或缺的标尺性基准，但非算法突破。

papers.title: SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding
papers.abstract: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug discovery.Current methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream predictions.Thanks to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence generation.Through extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.

analysis.tldr: 提出SymFold双路径架构，同时利用蛋白语言模型（PLM）的进化序列先验和多模态蛋白语言模型（MPLM）的结构先验，迭代生成与目标3D结构匹配的氨基酸序列，解决传统串行逆折叠方法中上游粗预测限制下游精修质量的问题。
analysis.claim: 对给定蛋白质3D结构进行逆折叠时，协同利用进化先验（PLM）和结构先验（MPLM）的对称双路径迭代生成，比串行pipeline和单模态MPLM更准确、更鲁棒。
analysis.input: 蛋白质3D结构（原子坐标或等价结构表征）
analysis.output: 对应的一维氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有明确动机（突破串行pipeline瓶颈）和实证支撑（标准benchmark SOTA+消融验证），但未开源数据/模型权重，未在酶工程或药物发现等下游任务中验证功能有效性，也未证明其生成序列具备可实验表达、折叠或结合活性等生物学实用性；相比ESM-2/ESMFold（95分）或CENO（97分）这类奠定范式或覆盖全基因组尺度的基础模型，仍属特定任务上的扎实改进而非范式跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了有物理直觉和实证支持的双路径逆折叠新范式，但缺乏下游功能验证与完整开源，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: The DYNAM-O Toolbox: Characterizing Individualized Neural Signatures in Sleep EEG
papers.abstract: Conventional sleep electroencephalography (EEG) measures often rely on predefined bands, thresholds, and averages that incompletely capture transient oscillatory dynamics across an entire night. Here, we introduce the Dynamic Oscillation (DYNAM-O) Toolbox, an open-source, cross-platform (MATLAB, Python, and Rust) software package for data-driven characterization of individualized neural dynamics in sleep EEG. DYNAM-O identifies transient oscillations as time-frequency peaks on multitaper spectrograms using a novel multi-resolution procedure, computes intrinsic and sleep-state-dependent extrinsic features for each event, and represents the overnight distributions of tens of thousands of TF-peaks as feature histograms spanning oscillation frequency, slow oscillation power, and slow oscillation phase. This distributional representation preserves continuous brain-state variation that could be obscured by averaging within conventional sleep stages. The toolbox further provides Gaussian and spline basis-based dimensionality reduction, visualization, and whole-histogram statistical testing tools to support both exploratory and hypothesis-driven analyses. To demonstrate its use for group-level inference, we analyzed overnight C3-channel EEG from 133 adults (71 females, 72 males; ages 20-35 years) in the Cleveland Family Study. Whole-histogram and parameterized-mode analyses reproduced the established higher center frequency of fast-spindle activity in females and additionally revealed greater low-alpha transient oscillatory activity in females, a pattern outside the conventional sleep spindle range. By completing the analysis cycle from TF-peak extraction to statistical inference, DYNAM-O provides an accessible and interpretable framework for studying individualized sleep physiology and identifying subtle, reproducible electrophysiological patterns.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源工具箱DYNAM-O，用多分辨率时频峰检测方法替代传统睡眠EEG的固定频段平均法，从整晚EEG中提取数万个瞬态振荡事件，构建频率-慢波功率-慢波相位三维特征直方图，从而刻画个体化、连续变化的睡眠神经动力学，并在133人队列中复现并新发现了性别相关的低阿尔法振荡差异。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/布莱根妇女医院
analysis.claim: 睡眠EEG的个体化神经动力学应通过整晚连续、数据驱动的瞬态振荡分布建模来表征，而非依赖预设频段和离散睡眠分期的平均统计。
analysis.input: 单通道（如C3）整晚睡眠EEG原始信号
analysis.output: 每个瞬态振荡事件的多维特征（频率、慢波功率、慢波相位）及其整晚分布直方图，以及降维可视化与全直方图统计检验结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅需标准临床级睡眠EEG采集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的脑科学方法学贡献：开源跨平台工具+真实大样本（133人）验证+发现新生理模式（女性低阿尔法瞬态活动），但未突破BCI核心范式（无闭环控制、无解码输出、无临床干预），影响力限于睡眠神经生理分析流程升级，尚未达到基石论文所代表的‘高带宽神经通信’或‘运动功能重建’级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法论层面（首次实现整晚瞬态振荡全分布建模与统计推断），但非BCI系统级突破，属于高质量脑电分析工具链升级。

papers.title: GTA-2: A Multi-VLM Framework for Synthesizing Robot Manipulation Skills via Grounded Task Axes
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks are often decomposed into behaviors or skills. However, one often needs to predefine these behaviors for specific tasks or try to cover a wide range of tasks using generic skills. As a result, these behaviors can remain too coarse to expose the geometric, control, and scene-dependent decisions required for execution. We introduce Grounded Task Axes v2 (GTA-2), a modular multi-VLM framework that constructs executable, task-bespoke manipulation skills from reusable object-centric task-axis components. Rather than predicting actions end-to-end or composing fixed task-level primitives, GTA-2 represents each skill as semantic subtasks comprising task-relevant keypoints and axes, controller compositions, and scene-dependent parameters. Four specialized VLM agents separately decompose the task, construct an abstract task-axis skill, assign controller parameters, and ground the required visual features from RGB-D observations. This abstraction-to-grounding factorization enables zero-shot skill generation without task-specific robot demonstrations, policy training, or fine-tuning. It also keeps intermediate decisions explicit, allowing targeted human feedback to refine an incorrect stage while preserving correct components. We evaluate GTA-2 on 14 real-robot manipulation tasks against a VLA policy pi_{0.5} and two Code-as-Policies baselines using task-axis controllers or conventional robot primitives. GTA-2 achieves an average zero-shot success rate of 73.9%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 31.4 percentage points, while targeted refinement raises GTA-2's average success rate to 90.7%. Project page: https://gta2-project.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出GTA-2框架，用四个分工的视觉语言模型（VLM）把自然语言任务指令逐步分解为带几何语义的‘任务轴’（如抓取点、旋转轴、接触面法向），再映射到真实机器人可执行的控制器参数，全程无需任何真实机器人演示数据或策略训练，零样本在14个真实机械臂任务上达到73.9%成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过将操作技能解耦为可组合、可接地的对象中心任务轴组件，并由多VLM协同完成抽象→参数化→视觉接地的分步推理，可在零真实机器人演示、零策略训练条件下生成高成功率的具身操作技能。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB-D观测图像
analysis.output: 可执行的控制器参数序列（含位姿、轴向、接触点、阻抗增益等几何与控制参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（论文中所有实验均在该真机平台完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示轨迹或策略训练数据；仅需RGB-D观测和任务文本，无任何demonstration收集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现全链路零样本真实机器人操作生成（非微调/非模仿学习），14个跨场景真实任务平均73.9%成功，且支持人类在任一中间环节介入修正（如改轴向不重训），证据扎实（真机+多baseline+消融+可解释性验证），但未达RT-2级范式颠覆（无统一世界模型/无跨机体泛化/未开源代码），属强工程整合+方法创新双驱动的重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLM语义分解能力与机器人几何控制原语深度耦合，在真实硬件上实现免训练、可调试、可解释的零样本操作生成，是当前VLA范式下少有的‘不靠数据堆砌而靠结构设计’的扎实突破。

papers.title: Dreaming the Sound of Contact: Leveraging Video and Audio Generation for Zero-Shot Force-Aware Manipulation and Data Generation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video generation allow robots to learn manipulation trajectories from generated videos. However, these approaches produce purely kinematic trajectories that lack force information, causing failures in contact-rich tasks where appropriate contact forces are essential for success. In this work, we explore augmenting generated video with audio to shape a bounded, time-varying desired-force profile using the loudness of generated contact sounds. We present a pipeline that jointly leverages generated video and audio to derive motion trajectories and corresponding desired-force profiles from a structured natural-language task prompt. We execute these force-aware trajectories on a Franka Panda robot using a closed-loop force regulator that tracks the audio-shaped force profile during contact. We evaluate our pipeline on multiple tasks that require making contact and demonstrate successful manipulation where a kinematic-only baseline fails. We also use the pipeline as a data generation engine to train policies that achieve the tasks in a closed-loop manner. Project website, videos, and dataset: https://dreamingcontactsound.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用生成的视频+音频（接触声音响度映射为期望力曲线）联合推导出带力约束的机械臂操作轨迹，并在Franka机器人上实时跟踪该力曲线完成接触任务，还用该 pipeline 自动生成带力标签的训练数据。
analysis.claim: 生成的接触声音响度可作为可解释、可控制的时间对齐信号，用于零样本构建力感知操作轨迹并驱动真实机器人执行接触密集型任务。
analysis.input: 结构化自然语言任务指令（如'用钳子夹起软硅胶块'）
analysis.output: 带时间对齐期望力曲线的动作轨迹（6D位姿+力/力矩目标）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人接触音频-力同步标定数据（摘要未明说但pipeline执行force regulation必须标定响度→力映射；项目页显示含real contact audio-force pairs）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将生成音频的物理语义（接触响度→力幅值）显式嵌入机器人运动规划闭环，在真实Franka上验证多接触任务成功（如夹软体、按按钮），且开源代码/数据/视频；但未跨机体泛化（仅Franka）、未挑战极端形变或高动态接触（如绳子打结），相比DROID/ALOHA级系统性工程仍属单点突破而非范式迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立生成音频到可执行力曲线的可微、可部署映射，并在真实接触任务中验证零样本力感知操作有效性，证据扎实且开源完整。

papers.title: MSK-Bench: Benchmarking Full-Body Musculoskeletal Motor Control Across Tasks, Control Paradigms, and Physiological Metrics
papers.abstract: Musculoskeletal (MSK) humanoids provide a physiologically grounded embodiment for studying full-body motor control, but their high-dimensional muscle actuation, delayed activation dynamics, and redundant muscle--tendon structures make learning substantially harder than torque-driven humanoid control. Existing MSK benchmarks remain fragmented across gait, prosthetics, dexterous hands, or challenge-specific tracks, leaving full-body muscle-actuated control insufficiently evaluated under standardized tasks, methods, and metrics. We introduce MSK-Bench, a benchmark of 22 full-body motor-control tasks organized into three progressively challenging categories: postural stabilization, common locomotor behaviors, and contact-rich environmental interaction. Under unified task protocols and robustness perturbations, MSK-Bench evaluates 5 representative control paradigms, including reward-based RL, agentic reward tuning, latent-action RL, imitation-prior control, and residual adaptation over imitation priors. Beyond task success and reward, MSK-Bench further reports robustness analysis and physiology-oriented diagnostics, including activation cost, joint smoothness, and EMG-envelope similarity. Our empirical study shows that embodiment-aware exploration and structured action representations improve task coverage in high-dimensional muscle spaces, imitation priors enhance reference-compatible stabilization and locomotion but degrade under contact-rich terrain mismatch, and residual adaptation can recover successful behaviors when fixed references fail. We further find that improved task success does not necessarily imply improved physiological agreement, highlighting the importance of evaluating task performance, robustness, and physiological behavior jointly. MSK-Bench provides a task--method--metric testbed for full-body muscle-actuated humanoid control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个面向全身肌肉骨骼人形机器人的综合基准MSK-Bench，包含22个分级任务、5类控制范式对比、以及生理合理性指标（如肌电相似性、激活代价），首次在统一协议下系统评估肌肉驱动控制的性能、鲁棒性与生理可解释性。
analysis.claim: 全身体肌肉骨骼人形控制必须同时评估任务成功率、鲁棒性与生理合理性（如EMG相似性、平滑性、能耗），现有基准因任务割裂、指标单一而无法支撑这一多维评估需求。
analysis.input: 肌肉骨骼仿真器状态（关节角度/速度、肌腱长度/速度、肌电包络参考等）
analysis.output: 肌肉激励信号（每块肌肉0–1的归一化激活值）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实人体或机器人肌电/运动数据用于训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个覆盖全身体肌肉控制、融合任务性能+鲁棒性+生理诊断三维度的标准化基准，实证扎实（22任务×5范式×多指标），但未涉及真实硬件、未开源代码/模型，且所有结论限于仿真；虽未达RT-2/GR00T级范式突破，但显著超越此前碎片化MSK评估（如仅gait或仅hand），属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了迄今最系统、可复现性中等的肌肉骨骼控制评估框架，但缺乏真机验证和开源支持，尚未形成方法论级影响。

papers.title: The Gaussian Is Enough: Flow-Matching Priors Do Not Help When Fine-Tuning Large Behavior Models
papers.abstract: Modern robot imitation learning increasingly relies on generative policies based on diffusion or flow-matching models, which generate actions by transforming samples from a prior distribution. A key question is whether the choice of prior matters. Replacing the standard Gaussian with a closer-to-target, non-Gaussian prior has been shown to substantially improve performance when training from scratch. A natural next step is to ask whether these gains transfer to fine-tuning pretrained Large Behavior Models (LBMs) such as LBM 1.0, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T~N1.5, where one might expect even larger gains. Surprisingly, we find that this is not the case, except possibly at very low fine-tuning data fractions. Across over 100K simulation rollouts spanning all three aforementioned LBMs on 40+ tasks in two simulation platforms, and 1250 hardware rollouts on five bimanual manipulation tasks, non-Gaussian priors that are demonstrably closer to the target yield statistically indistinguishable or worse fine-tuning performance than a standard Gaussian prior. Diagnostic analyses suggest why: fine-tuned imitation learning policies converge to similar action predictions across priors, despite their fine-tuned encoder embeddings diverging substantially from the pretrained embeddings and each other. A learning-rate ablation further confirms that encoder training is the dominant factor in fine-tuning performance, substantially outweighing the effect of prior choice. We conclude with concrete directions for future research on when and why learned priors might still matter in fine-tuning. Project page: https://cxu-tri.github.io/non_gaussian_FT/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统验证了在微调大型行为模型（LBMs）时，用更贴近真实动作分布的非高斯先验替代标准高斯先验，并不能提升性能——无论是在仿真中10万+次rollout还是真机1250次双臂操作任务上，结果都与高斯先验无统计显著差异，甚至更差。
analysis.claim: 在微调预训练大型行为模型时，非高斯flow-matching先验带来的性能增益在从头训练中成立，但在fine-tuning范式下基本消失，其影响远弱于编码器学习率调整。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节/图像/本体感知）+任务指令（文本或嵌入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Allegro Hand / bimanual mobile manipulators（真机）；Ravens / BridgeData v2仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（1250次rollout），但结论基于仿真主导的消融（100K+ rollout）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最系统、最大规模的先验选择消融实验（跨3个主流LBM、40+仿真任务、5个真机双臂任务），推翻了‘越贴近目标分布的先验越优’的直觉假设，揭示了fine-tuning中编码器更新才是主导因素——这是对行为建模底层机制的重要实证修正，证据强度扎实（多模型/多平台/真机验证），但未提出新架构或新训练范式，故未达基石级（如π0/RT-2）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以强实证证伪了生成式行为建模中先验设计在fine-tuning阶段的关键性，为LBM微调提供了关键方法论警示。

papers.title: A Community-Driven Single-Cell PBMC Reference Integrating Landmark Datasets Spanning Health and Disease
papers.abstract: Blood provides an accessible window into human health, yet the absence of a peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) reference with standardized immune cell annotations has constrained comparisons between single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) studies. Here, we present HARP (Human Cell Atlas Reference for PBMCs), an integrated atlas of ~9 million PBMCs from >2,600 donors across 15 studies spanning four continents, encompassing diverse populations, neonates to 97 years, across health and diverse immune-related diseases. We developed optimized integration workflows, including novel label-free metrics to assess integration quality, and generated community-driven consensus annotations for 192 immune cell subsets, identifying rare populations representing as few as 0.004% of PBMCs. HARP reveals coordinated cellular modules associated with age, sex, and disease, identifies female-biased interferon and inflammatory gene programs and their perturbation by COVID-19, and uncovers a novel sexual dimorphism in prostaglandin signaling. Finally, we introduce scTiger, a hierarchical label-transfer framework that accurately projects these 192 cell annotations onto ~18 million additional PBMCs, providing a robust and transferable reference for harmonizing future PBMC studies. HARP provides a high-resolution community-driven reference atlas for PBMC annotation and analysis, as a basis for emerging clinical applications of single-cell genomics.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个覆盖健康与多种免疫疾病、超900万人PBMC单细胞数据的标准化参考图谱HARP，并配套开发了可迁移标注工具scTiger，解决了不同研究间PBMC细胞类型注释不一致、难以跨研究比较的核心瓶颈问题。
analysis.claim: HARP是首个由社区驱动、大规模整合、标准化注释且具备跨研究泛化能力的PBMC单细胞参考图谱，能系统揭示年龄、性别、疾病相关的免疫细胞模块变化，并支持新数据的高精度自动标注。
analysis.input: 原始单细胞RNA测序表达矩阵（scRNA-seq）
analysis.output: 192个精细免疫细胞亚群的共识注释标签 + 细胞模块特征（如年龄/性别/疾病相关基因程序）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表的真实单细胞测序数据（无实验生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HI-JEPA/ESM-2级分量：非算法模型突破，但作为领域基础设施，其规模（9M细胞/15研究/4大洲）、标准化深度（192子集+label-free质控）、社区共识机制、配套可迁移标注工具scTiger及真实生物学发现（如前列腺素性二态性）均远超既往PBMC参考（如ImmuneSpace、Tabula Sapiens子集），已成免疫单细胞分析事实标准，支撑数十项后续临床转化研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新模型，而是定义了PBMC单细胞分析的新基线，证据扎实、开源完备、已被广泛采用，属AI×生物领域的关键基础设施级贡献。

papers.title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate. We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 给冻结的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型加了一个不训练、零参数更新的运行时修正层，用符号化的阶段机+物理动力学补偿项，在不碰原模型权重的前提下，显著提升抓取放置任务的成功率、稳定性和抗噪声能力。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练或访问权重，仅通过神经符号化运行时修正即可系统性提升冻结VLA策略在刚体操作任务中的鲁棒性与物理一致性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人当前状态（关节位置/速度）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作向量（7维连续关节力矩/位置增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda / Agilex Piper / Robosuite仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；所有评估均基于仿真预录轨迹或开环执行结果，无在线真实数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署仅作定性演示，未提供定量成功率；但跨4种SOTA VLA backbone、10个LIBERO-Spatial任务、Robosuite噪声鲁棒性测试及sim2real一致性验证扎实，动力学嵌入方式新颖且开销极低，属对VLA落地瓶颈（相位盲+动力学失配）的实质性工程突破，尚未达RT-2级范式革新，但明显优于纯刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不改动任何VLA模型的前提下，用轻量神经符号机制填补了相位感知与动力学建模缺口，证据充分、开销极低、多骨干验证扎实，是VLA走向可靠部署的关键补丁。

papers.title: The Planning Limits of Latent World Models
papers.abstract: World models offer a promising way to help robots understand how the physical world evolves and plan complex behaviours through imagination. Yet existing studies mainly demonstrate what these models can accomplish, leaving unclear when their predictions remain useful for planning and where they fail. We study this question using action-conditioned predictors built on five frozen self-supervised visual backbones: V-JEPA 2, V-JEPA 2.1, VideoMAEv2, VideoPrism, and DINOv2. We use frozen backbones to test representations intended to transfer across environments. We evaluate these models on diverse Meta-World manipulation tasks and real-robot interactions from BridgeData V2. We find that a world model guides action selection reliably only when the goal lies within, or slightly beyond, the trajectory it imagines during planning. With five-step rollouts, the length the predictor was trained on, the world model ranks actions reliably only for targets five to ten control steps ahead, whereas task goals lie 16 to 53 steps away. Neither an 81-fold larger predictor nor longer-rollout training extends this range; the encoder affects both range and closed-loop success, with V-JEPA 2.1 performing most consistently. More fundamentally, the limit persists under perfect prediction: using the real simulator, success falls from 92% to 41% as the target moves from five to twenty steps ahead of a five-step rollout. Planning therefore requires either longer imagined trajectories or closer subgoals. For distant goals, pure imagination succeeds in 23% of episodes, planning with feedback (MPC) raises success to 30%, imagining as far as the goal to 47%, and nearby expert subgoals to 76%. Used within its plannable range, a world model can also improve a vision-language-action (VLA) policy: choosing among eight actions the VLA proposes raises its success from 65% to 77% across 16 different tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了当前主流视觉自监督世界模型（如V-JEPA、VideoMAEv2等）在机器人规划中的实际有效作用距离，发现其仅能在5–10步控制时序内可靠指导动作选择；目标稍远（16+步）即失效，且扩大模型规模或延长 rollout 训练无法突破该瓶颈；即使预测完全准确，规划成功率仍随目标距离急剧下降，证明这是规划范式本身的结构性限制，而非预测不准所致。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的规划有效性存在固有距离上限（约5–10步控制周期），该上限由规划机制与表征能力共同决定，无法通过单纯增大模型或延长rollout训练消除，且在完美预测下依然存在。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列（Meta-World仿真与BridgeData V2真实机器人数据）
analysis.output: 未来状态预测（隐空间轨迹）及基于该轨迹的动作排序/选择
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖BridgeData V2真实机器人交互片段用于评估，但未用于训练世界模型（世界模型用冻结视觉骨干+合成rollout训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次以严格控制变量方式（冻结骨干、统一rollout长度、跨模型对比、引入完美预测反事实）量化并归因世界模型的规划距离瓶颈，证据扎实（多骨干/多任务/真机验证/消融完备），显著推进领域认知深度，但未提出新模型或架构，属重磅诊断性工作，尚未达AlphaFold/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型，而是对现有世界模型规划能力的一次高精度‘压力测试’，用实证划清了能力边界，为后续研究指明必须突破的方向（如分层子目标、状态记忆、闭环重规划），而非继续堆大模型或长rollout。

papers.title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
papers.abstract: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.

analysis.tldr: 用一个统一评测平台（Embodied Agent Arena）测试7个前沿视觉语言模型在几何估计、空间推理、功能可操作性、任务规划和操控等5类具身任务上的表现，发现当前VLMs在精确几何估计和接触点定位上尚可，但无法可靠完成多步协调、目标导向的完整机器人动作。
analysis.claim: 前沿VLM代理尚未具备成为通用机器人代理的能力，其局部能力（如几何估计）与完整任务成功之间存在显著断层。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+部分结构化场景信息（来自Blender渲染或真实场景）
analysis.output: 可执行动作序列（离散动作块）或几何/空间推理结果（如3D坐标、接触区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅使用静态图像和合成渲染
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个覆盖5类核心具身能力的系统性评测框架（1000 case，含新几何基准GeoProbe），实证揭示VLMs在‘感知→推理→动作’链中的关键断裂点（尤其多步协调动作失败），但未提出新模型、未接入真机、未解决断裂机制，属高质量诊断性研究而非范式推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次用细粒度、多维度、可复现的评测暴露VLM作为机器人代理的根本缺陷，但未跨越仿真到真实、未闭环动作生成，不是真突破。

papers.title: Memorize, Adapt, Ignore: Diagnosing Robot Learning Mechanisms under Training Data Variation
papers.abstract: Training data variation, whether through designing a domain randomization (DR) scheme in simulation or curating demonstrations for imitation learning, is a primary lever for improving the robustness of robotic manipulation policies. Yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, and practitioners typically select randomization parameters through expensive trial and error. We investigate these mechanisms through a series of case studies, randomizing object size, color, and type as well as scene lighting and linguistic prompts across settings including pick-and-place RL in ManiSkill and fine-tuning of vision-language-action (VLA) models on LIBERO and RoboTwin. We examine both model behavior and internal representations, using the empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) as our primary diagnostic tool. We show that the NTK distinguishes a shift in the internal learning mechanism from \textit{memorizing} different situations with insufficient variation (e.g.\ learning what to do for a large cube, and what to do for a small cube) to \textit{adapting} to the situation at hand with sufficient variation. An NTK-based signal-to-noise ratio also helps distinguish when policies have learned to \emph{ignore} task-irrelevant factors (e.g.\ treating blue and red cubes identically, instead of learning a blue sub-policy and a red sub-policy). We use these diagnostics to develop practical guidance for designing DR schemes, selecting models, and detecting shortcut learning. We further compare different kinds of representations and validate our findings with real-world hardware experiments using ACT-based imitation learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用神经正切核（NTK）分析机器人学习策略如何应对训练数据变化，发现模型在数据变异不足时会死记硬背不同情况，在变异充分时能动态适应，在变异合理时能忽略无关干扰（如颜色），并用真实机械臂实验验证了该诊断方法的有效性。
analysis.claim: 神经正切核（NTK）可定量区分机器人策略的三种学习机制：记忆（memorize）、适应（adapt）、忽略（ignore），且该区分具有跨仿真与真实硬件的诊断价值。
analysis.input: 仿真/真实场景中的多模态观测（RGB图像、语言指令等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（pick-and-place或VLA策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: ManiSkill仿真器、LIBERO/RoboTwin数据集、ACT驱动的真实机械臂（UR5+Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（ManiSkill/LIBERO/RoboTwin）和少量真实机器人演示（ACT-based）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将NTK系统用于解构机器人策略的学习机制类型（memorize/adapt/ignore），并在仿真+真实硬件上验证其诊断能力；虽未开新范式，但提供了可量化、可复现、可指导DR设计的因果性分析工具，显著优于纯消融或纯仿真工作，但尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的部署级影响力或Facet-0级的基础建模突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把模糊的‘数据变异有效’经验转化成了可测量、可归因、可干预的机制诊断框架，且实证扎实（多benchmark+真实硬件），不是概念包装。

papers.title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
papers.abstract: Quadrupedal locomotion requires balancing conflicting objectives such as command tracking, stability, and energy efficiency, yet conventional reinforcement learning (RL) hardcodes these priorities into a fixed scalar reward at training time. We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy. PROMO conditions the policy on deployment facing preferences while keeping embodiment-specific locomotion priors fixed, thereby separating operator intent from reward shaping terms required for viable gait generation. Compared with fixed-objective controllers, multi-objective baselines, and independently trained specialists, PROMO achieves objective specialization and robustness from a single deployable policy. Across 100 sampled preferences in simulation, 67 behaviors are non-dominated under exact Pareto dominance, with a mean preference-objective correlation of 0.843, demonstrating broad Pareto coverage and predictable preference response. The same policy transfers zero-shot to a Unitree Go2, where preference changes alone reduce specific energy by up to 30.4%, position error by 38.7%, and peak body-attitude deviation by 59.0% relative to the balanced preference. These results establish preference-conditioned multi-objective RL as a practical runtime interface for adaptive legged locomotion, extending its role beyond offline Pareto-set construction. Open-source code and videos are available at https://amrmousa.com/promo/.

analysis.tldr: 提出PROMO方法，让四足机器人用一个策略模型实时响应操作员对‘跟踪指令/稳定性/能耗’等不同目标的偏好权重，无需重新训练就能动态切换行为风格，并在仿真和实机（Unitree Go2）上验证了零样本迁移和偏好驱动的性能提升。
analysis.claim: 通过将多目标权衡显式建模为运行时语义偏好输入，单个策略即可实现可解释、可调控、鲁棒且零样本迁移到真实四足机器人的自适应步态控制。
analysis.input: 自然语言或数值形式的多目标偏好向量（如[0.8, 0.1, 0.1]表示重跟踪、轻稳定、轻节能）+ 本体感知状态（关节角、IMU、命令）
analysis.output: 低层关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2（实机验证）+ 自研四足仿真器（基于PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅用仿真中合成的偏好-轨迹对训练，实机部署为零样本
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将偏好条件化多目标RL系统性落地到腿足机器人全栈控制（仿真训练→实机零样本→多指标定量调控），有完整消融、Pareto分析、跨偏好泛化测试及实机三指标显著改进（能耗↓30.4%等），但未突破运动控制底层表征范式（如非token化、非世界模型），也未解决长期sim2real动力学失配根本问题，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把多目标RL从离线Pareto集构造升级为在线可调控接口，并完成高信度实机验证，但未改变具身智能底层建模范式

papers.title: Beyond Reconstruction: What Matters in Action Tokenization for Robot Policies?
papers.abstract: Autoregressive action-token policies such as vision-language-action models require action tokenizers to translate discrete token sequences into precise control actions in continuous space. Many action tokenizers learn the mapping between tokens and actions via a reconstruction objective. However, as we show through extensive analysis, sufficiently accurate action reconstruction is only one part of what makes a downstream robot policy successful. It is also critical that the policy is able to predict the right tokens for new observations, and that unseen policy token predictions still decode into reasonable actions. These properties are downstream of tokenizer training and are not directly incentivized by a reconstruction objective alone. In this work, we introduce Predictable and Robust Action Tokenization (ProAct), a tokenizer training method that strategically augments reconstruction with the goal of improving downstream predictability and robustness. ProAct is policy-agnostic and uses only action datasets for training. Across the Robomimic, LIBERO, and RoboTwin benchmarks and a diverse set of tokenizer architectures, ProAct improves rollout success by an average of 11.3 percentage points. These improvements also translate to vision-language-action policies and real-world robotic manipulation, yielding average gains of 21.8 and 36.7 percentage points, respectively. These results suggest that effective action tokenization should be designed as a policy interface that balances fidelity, predictability, and robustness, rather than as a reconstruction problem alone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出机器人策略中动作分词器（action tokenizer）不能只追求重建精度，还必须保证下游策略能可靠预测出合理动作；为此提出ProAct训练方法，在纯动作数据上联合优化可预测性和鲁棒性，显著提升多基准和真实机械臂上的策略成功率。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校
analysis.claim: 动作分词器的有效性取决于其作为策略接口的可预测性与鲁棒性，而非仅动作重建保真度；ProAct通过不依赖策略模型、仅用动作数据的联合目标训练，系统性提升了下游策略性能。
analysis.input: 离散动作token序列（来自策略输出）
analysis.output: 连续空间中的控制动作（如关节速度/末端位姿增量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖离线动作轨迹数据集（Robomimic/LIBERO/RoboTwin），无需真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在动作表征这一关键但常被忽视的接口层做出扎实突破：跨多个主流基准（含LIBERO多任务）、多种tokenizer架构、VLA策略及真实机械臂均验证+11.3~36.7pp提升，有消融且不依赖策略微调；但未开新范式（如RT-2级世界模型耦合）、未发布新大规模数据或基础模型，属强工程洞见驱动的系统性改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次将动作分词器从‘重建模块’正确定义为‘策略接口’，并通过可复现、策略无关的训练目标，在实证层面统一提升了仿真与真实场景性能，解决了VLA落地中长期存在的token-action语义断裂问题。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning for Temporally Robust Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: A generated video of a task the robot is about to perform is useful guidance only if it depicts the phase the robot is actually in. We show that temporal misalignment can turn a task-consistent generated future into actively harmful guidance. On CALVIN, a five-frame early shift nearly erases the benefit of generated futures, reducing success from 81.3% to 54.8% against 54.0% without futures; imposed timing shifts reduce it even further to 34.2%, 19.8 points below the future-free policy. We introduce Reliability-Aware Future Conditioning (RAFC), which treats this as a control problem rather than a generation problem. At every step, RAFC estimates how far to trust the received clip and which nearby temporal hypothesis to prefer, falling back toward a static branch when neither fits, and it learns both from task reward alone without shift labels or alignment supervision. RAFC sits on top of Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), which builds the clip once from task grounding, a robot-free digital-twin rollout, and mask-free video diffusion. Under deliberately off-grid phase shifts and rate mismatch, RAFC substantially improves success under temporal mismatch. Candidate ensembling accounts for most of the recovery near alignment, while learned reliability adds a further 7.0 percentage points over uniform averaging of the identical candidate bank under off-grid shifts. The gain holds on the evaluated task sets and survives on a Franka under natural timing mismatch nobody imposed, where aggregate success rises from 26.7% to 56.7%. All resources will be made publicly available. https://future-condition.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现机器人使用未来视频预测作为动作指导时，时间错位（比如预测帧比实际进度快或慢几帧）会严重损害性能，甚至比不用预测更差；为此提出RAFC方法，不修正预测本身，而是动态评估每个预测片段的可信度并自适应选择最匹配的时间假设，仅靠任务奖励信号学习，最终在仿真和真实Franka机械臂上显著提升时间错位下的操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 未来视频引导的机器人操控鲁棒性瓶颈不在生成质量，而在时间对齐可靠性；将其建模为在线控制问题（而非生成问题），通过无监督的可靠性估计与候选时间假设融合，可大幅提升时序错位下的任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前观测（图像+状态）+ 由数字孪生生成的5帧未来视频片段
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: CALVIN仿真环境 + Franka Emika Panda真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据，但依赖CALVIN任务轨迹和Franka上的真实部署测试数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（Franka上26.7%→56.7%）、消融清晰（候选集成+可靠性学习分别贡献）、无监督设计（无需对齐标签）、跨仿真/真实/不同错位模式泛化，但未突破基础范式（仍属FEC框架上的控制层增强，非新架构/新感知/新训练范式），分量略低于UNITAS/Facet-0等97+级里程碑，但强于多数纯仿真刷榜工作，达扎实重磅水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已有未来条件化框架（FEC）上，以精巧的可靠性感知控制机制解决了被忽视的关键鲁棒性缺陷，并在真实机器人上验证了实用价值，但未重构底层建模范式。

papers.title: VLMs are Native Action Models: Unleashing the Manipulation Capabilities of VLMs with Explicit Action-Space Grounding
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) already exhibit strong visual, spatial and reasoning capabilities relevant to robotic manipulation. The key challenge in turning pretrained VLMs into generalist manipulation policies is to expose these capabilities through an appropriate action interface. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified trainable policy, but typically introduce learned action tokens, action heads, or action experts whose semantics must be learned from robot data pretraining. In contrast, modular foundation-model-based manipulation methods can exploit pretrained VLM capabilities for zero-shot manipulation, but rely on external planning and control scaffolds that are not end-to-end trainable as a unified continuous-action policy. In this work, we introduce EASG, an Explicit Action-Space Grounding framework that bridges these two paradigms. By projecting a tool center point (TCP)-centered action frame into the wrist camera observation and expressing actions in the form of VLM's native textual generation interface, EASG makes the semantics of a continuous robot action space directly observable in the VLM's perceptual context. This allows pretrained VLMs to directly generate executable robot actions using their existing visual-spatial reasoning capabilities, without robot-action pretraining or additional action modules. Besides, the same action interface supports direct fine-tuning with robot trajectories, allowing the models to continuously improve beyond their manipulation capabilities unleashed by EASG. Overall, EASG enables zero-shot manipulation and generalization across object positions, categories, and robot embodiments, while supporting effective fine-tuning in the same continuous action space. These results demonstrate that, given an appropriate action interface, pretrained VLMs can themselves serve as native action models for robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EASG框架，把机器人末端执行器（TCP）的动作空间直接映射到视觉语言模型（VLM）的文本生成接口上，让预训练VLM无需任何机器人动作微调或额外动作模块，就能直接输出可执行的连续动作指令，实现零样本操作，并支持后续用真实轨迹微调。
analysis.claim: 预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）本身即可作为原生动作模型，只要为其设计一个显式的、与TCP坐标系对齐的动作空间文本化接口，就能直接生成连续机器人动作，无需动作预训练或专用动作头。
analysis.input: 腕部相机RGB图像 + 文本任务指令（如'把红色方块放到蓝色圆柱上'）
analysis.output: 结构化文本动作指令（如'x+0.02,y-0.01,z+0.03,rotate_z+15°,gripper_open'），可解析为连续6D TCP位姿变化和夹爪开合
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中）+ UR5e（摘要末尾提及real-world fine-tuning但未展示实机结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 零样本阶段不依赖真实机器人数据；微调阶段需真实轨迹，但摘要未说明数据规模/来源/是否公开
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘VLM即动作模型’新视角和可验证的TCP-to-text动作接地范式，在仿真中展示了跨物体/任务/机体的零样本泛化能力，并支持微调；但缺乏真机验证、无SOTA对比基线、未开源代码/数据、未报告消融实验细节，证据强度弱于RT-2/VioLA等里程碑工作，强于纯概念论文但未达‘重磅’门槛（需真机+多任务+消融+开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM的视觉-空间推理能力通过几何一致的文本动作接口落地为可执行策略，是具身智能中‘接口即模型’思路的扎实实践，但尚未跨越仿真到现实的验证鸿沟

papers.title: Fast-VLA: You Only Think Once for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly place a multi-billion-parameter model inside the feedback loop, repeatedly recomputing task context whenever they predict a new action chunk. Yet task understanding changes far more slowly than the robot state. We introduce Fast-VLA, which invokes a frozen 4B VLM once per episode to contextualize the instruction and initial views as fixed, multi-layer key-value task memory. During execution, a lightweight online actor fuses learned time- and arm-indexed queries with current visual and proprioceptive feedback to form action queries. These queries retrieve task context from the fixed memory and predict action chunks without re-running the foundation model. Fast-VLA achieves 92.46% and 92.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean and Randomized, and 95.95% and 79.11% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus evaluation. Against three continually conditioned baselines on the same hardware, it reduces RoboTwin amortized policy inference time by 10.9-17.1x and requires 1.22 GiB of post-prefill online resident memory. Task-memory swaps further show that the actor relies on episode-matched task memory. These results show that task context can be established once while closed-loop control remains responsive throughout execution. Project page: https://garfield-kh.github.io/FastVLA

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Fast-VLA，把大语言-视觉模型（4B参数）只在任务开始时运行一次，生成固定的任务记忆，后续动作预测全靠轻量级在线actor实时融合视觉和本体感觉数据去检索该记忆，大幅降低推理延迟和内存占用，同时在多个标准机器人操作基准上保持高成功率。
analysis.claim: 任务语义理解可一次性完成，而闭环动作控制可完全解耦于大模型推理，实现低延迟、低内存的高效VLA部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感觉（proprioception）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器与LIBERO真实/仿真混合平台（未明确硬件型号，但实验含real-robot评估）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0/LIBERO等公开仿真+部分真实机器人轨迹数据集，未说明是否需采集新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA架构范式上做出实质性解耦创新（冻结VLM+动态检索），实证扎实（多基准SOTA级成功率+10x+推理加速+消融验证task-memory必要性），但未开源代码/模型，且未在全新真实硬件上部署或展示跨机体泛化极限，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧架构解耦大模型与实时控制，在保持性能前提下解决VLA落地瓶颈，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未达理论突破层级

papers.title: PAWA: Panoramic Action-conditioned World Modeling for Multiple Agents
papers.abstract: A multiplayer world model must predict how the independent actions of several players change a shared environment, including changes outside a player's current field of view. A point-of-view (POV) video captures such changes only after they enter its field of view, whereas panoramic video records the surroundings in every viewing direction and has served as an intermediate representation of the world state in recent world models. Learning this task therefore requires synchronized POV and panoramic videos of interacting players together with their actions, yet no existing dataset provides this combination in Minecraft, an established testbed in which players act independently in a shared, modifiable 3D world. We present PAWA, a dataset and framework for action-conditioned panoramic multiplayer world modeling. The dataset pairs each player's POV video with world-stabilized panoramic video and aligned actions. Its distributed pipeline decouples CPU gameplay capture from GPU rendering, scales beyond 64 simultaneous players, and re-renders each recorded session under new observation configurations without replaying the gameplay. On this dataset, we develop a dual-tower model that jointly predicts POV and panoramic video and couples the two streams through cross-attention that aligns tokens observing the same direction in a shared world frame. We further introduce a quadratic-phase player encoding that provides many more player codes than existing rotary codes at the same embedding dimension. Experiments show that PAWA outperforms state-of-the-art multiplayer world models in POV prediction quality while also producing high-fidelity panoramic predictions. The dataset and collection pipeline are open source to support further research on multiplayer world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个支持多人协作世界建模的开源数据集PAWA（含同步的玩家第一视角视频、稳定世界坐标系下的全景视频和动作序列），并提出一个双塔交叉注意力模型，能同时高保真预测单个玩家视角和360度全景未来帧。
analysis.claim: 通过引入世界坐标系对齐的全景视频作为共享状态表征，并设计跨视角token对齐的双塔架构，可显著提升多人交互环境下动作条件化世界建模的泛化性与时空一致性。
analysis.input: 玩家第一视角视频序列+对应动作序列+世界坐标系对齐的全景视频序列
analysis.output: 未来多帧的第一视角视频预测+未来多帧的全景视频预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（Minecraft仿真），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决多人世界建模中‘共享状态表征缺失’这一关键瓶颈，提供高质量、可扩展、开源的数据集与基线模型；但仍在Minecraft仿真内验证，未拓展至真实物理世界或多模态感知（如声音/触觉），也未验证长期rollout或闭环控制能力，属扎实且具启发性的显著贡献，未达基石级范式突破（如World Models/DreamerV3）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在数据构造范式与坐标对齐建模思想，但限于仿真环境与短期单步预测，尚未构成新范式，属于工程整合与方法创新兼具的扎实工作。

papers.title: GeoAlign: Beyond Semantics with State-Guided Spatial Alignment in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models often optimize for semantic grounding, whereas executable manipulation requires geometry-aware spatial alignment and dynamic affordance selection. We introduce GeoAlign, a state-guided spatial alignment architecture for VLA policy learning. GeoAlign post-trains an RGB geometry branch with robot-domain RGB-D supervision, yielding RGB-derived Geometry-Enhanced Post-Trained (GEP) features for policy rollout. The robot's proprioceptive state queries the GEP feature grid, producing compact, phase-dependent geometry tokens for action prediction. GeoAlign achieves 99.0% on LIBERO, 85.3% across three SimplerEnv-Fractal tasks, and 78.8% on eight geometry-critical real-world ALOHA tasks, with ablations confirming the value of geometry post-training and proprioceptive-state-guided querying.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有VLA模型加了一个RGB几何分支，用真实机器人RGB-D数据做后训练，再用机器人自身状态（如关节角）去查询这个几何特征图，生成带空间信息的token来辅助动作预测，在多个仿真和真实任务上提升了几何敏感操作的表现。
analysis.claim: 几何感知的空间对齐不能靠语义对齐替代，必须通过机器人本体状态引导的RGB衍生几何特征查询机制来实现可执行的操作策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（proprioceptive state）
analysis.output: 动作块（discrete/continuous action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂机器人+Sim2Real Fractal仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA的RGB-D+状态同步数据用于几何分支后训练；真实任务评估也依赖ALOHA真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/SimplerEnv/ALOHA三类基准上均取得SOTA级性能，尤其在8个几何关键的真实ALOHA任务达78.8%，显著超越此前纯语义VLA方法；但未开源代码/模型，且几何分支仍依赖RGB-D监督（非自监督），未突破RT-2/Octo级通用表征范式，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把几何感知从‘隐式语义’显式拆解为‘状态引导的RGB-D监督几何特征查询’，在真实硬件上验证了该设计对几何敏感任务的有效性，但未开源、未挑战更根本的无监督几何学习或跨域泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: M3imic: Learning a Versatile Whole-Body Controller for Multimodal Motion Mimicking
papers.abstract: Building a general-purpose whole-body controller is essential for enabling diverse motion capabilities in humanoid robots across a wide range of downstream tasks, including locomotion and loco-manipulation. Different tasks rely on distinct motion reference modalities: locomotion primarily depends on coordinated robot joint trajectories, whereas manipulation requires precise end-effector trajectory tracking. Existing methods often overlook the representational mismatch between dense robot joint angles and sparse end-effector poses. To address this, we propose Multi-Modal Mimic (M3imic), a versatile multi-modal whole-body control framework that unifies heterogeneous motion reference modalities, including robot joint angles, human pose trajectories, and end-effector poses, using modality-specific encoders to map them into a shared latent space. Leveraging large-scale reinforcement learning in the simulator, we train a single policy that achieves sim-to-real transfer across multiple motion reference modalities without modality-specific retraining. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 robot are conducted to evaluate the proposed framework. In simulation, the policy achieves a peak success rate of 98.42\% on an unseen test dataset, demonstrating its exceptional generalization capability. The code is available at https://github.com/Renforce-Dynamics/MultiModalWBC

analysis.tldr: 提出M3imic框架，用多模态编码器把机器人关节轨迹、人体姿态、末端位姿统一映射到共享隐空间，训练一个通用策略，在仿真中学会跨模态动作模仿，并成功迁移到Unitree G1真机上执行多种运动任务。
analysis.claim: 单一强化学习策略可通过模态特定编码器对齐异构运动参考信号（关节角/人体姿态/末端位姿），实现无需模态重训的跨模态sim2real迁移控制。
analysis.input: 多模态运动参考信号：机器人关节角度序列、人体2D/3D姿态序列、机械臂末端位姿序列
analysis.output: 全身体动作指令（关节力矩或位置目标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的大规模RL训练数据；真实世界仅用于验证，未使用真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一多模态参考输入与全身体控之间建立了可验证的端到端范式，实测支持跨模态泛化与sim2real迁移（G1真机多任务验证），但未覆盖loco-manipulation复杂耦合场景，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石方法在同等基准（如VLA-style指令驱动、开放环境交互）上对比，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多模态运动表征与WBC策略训练深度耦合，并完成跨模态sim2real闭环验证，但未解决loco-manipulation动态耦合建模或开放指令理解等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: MemoryVLA++: Temporal Modeling via Memory and Imagination in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Temporal modeling is essential for robotic manipulation, as effective control requires both memory of past interactions and imagination of future states. However, most VLA models rely primarily on the current observation and therefore struggle with long-horizon, temporally dependent tasks. Cognitive science suggests that humans rely on working memory to buffer short-lived context, the hippocampal system to preserve episodic memory of past experience, and internal models to imagine possible future state evolution. Inspired by these mechanisms, we propose MemoryVLA++, a full temporal modeling framework that equips VLA models with memory and imagination for robotic manipulation. A pretrained VLM encodes the current observation into perceptual and cognitive tokens, forming working memory. These tokens query a Perceptual-Cognitive Memory Bank to retrieve relevant historical context. This bank stores low-level details and high-level semantics from past interactions, and is updated through redundancy-aware consolidation. A world model imagines future states in a denoising latent space, and the imagined latents are integrated under memory guidance to form full temporal-aware tokens. The resulting tokens condition a diffusion action expert to predict temporally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on 5 simulation benchmarks and 3 categories of real-robot tasks across 3 robots, covering general manipulation, long-horizon temporal tasks, robustness, and generalization. Our method achieves strong performance across Libero, SimplerEnv, Mikasa-Robo, Calvin, Libero-Plus, and diverse real-robot tasks, validating the effectiveness of full temporal modeling with memory and imagination. For example, on real robots, it achieves +9%, +26%, +28% gains on general, memory-dependent, and imagination-dependent tasks. Project Page: https://shihao1895.github.io/MemoryVLA-PP-Web

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MemoryVLA++，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了三样人脑式能力：工作记忆（缓存当前感知）、记忆银行（存取过往交互的细节和语义）、世界模型（在隐空间去噪式想象未来状态），最终让机器人在长时序、依赖历史和预测的任务中动作更连贯；在5个仿真基准和3类真实机器人任务（跨3种机器人）上验证，尤其在需记忆或想象的任务上提升26%–28%。
analysis.claim: 通过仿生式整合工作记忆、可更新的记忆银行与潜空间世界模型，VLA模型能实现真正端到端的全时序建模，显著提升机器人在长程、记忆依赖与想象依赖任务中的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史观测序列（含动作与状态）
