analysis.output: 时序一致的动作序列（扩散生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务轨迹数据用于记忆银行初始化与世界模型微调，但未公开原始真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 达到π0.5（86分）档位：首次在VLA框架中系统性闭环集成记忆检索+潜空间世界模型+扩散动作生成，并在真实机器人（3平台）、长时序（Libero-Plus）、强依赖任务（如‘打开抽屉后拿杯子’）上给出扎实多任务消融与跨机体泛化结果；但世界模型为轻量denoising latent predictor，非自回归物理仿真，且真实数据未开源，未达π0（95）级范式颠覆或RT-2（97）级基础架构重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是简单加模块，而是用认知科学约束设计出可训练、可部署、跨机体验证的全时序VLA闭环，在真实机器人上证明了记忆+想象联合建模对长程操作的实质性增益，且工程落地完整。

papers.title: ORCA: A Platform for Open-Source Dexterity Research
papers.abstract: Robotics manipulation research increasingly focuses on two-finger parallel grippers for their effectiveness, affordability, and ease of teleoperation. Grippers are nonetheless limited by their form factor, often requiring bimanual setups even for simple reorientation tasks. Anthropomorphic hands are a more natural platform for dexterous robot learning -- closer to the human hand, and capable of learning from human video -- yet they remain hard to use in learning research: even where open and accessible hand hardware exists, the software for control, simulation, teleoperation, and retargeting is scattered in one-off code bases, and largely disconnected from the robot-learning ecosystem. In this work, we introduce the \orca~learning stack, an open-source research stack for dexterity as a first-class robot learning domain. Our \orca~stack unifies low-level control, simulation, teleoperation from a range of consumer platforms, and hand retargeting, behind a single interface, and integrates natively with popular robot-learning frameworks such as \lerobot, so dexterous hand researchers can leverage the same data, training, and evaluation pipelines used for non-dexterous robot learning. We demonstrate a complete end-to-end workflow, collecting expert demonstrations of an in-hand reorientation task by teleoperation with a consumer-grade VR headset, training an autonomous policy with \lerobot, and evaluating the learned policy in a fully reproducible and observable setup. We open-source the entire stack as a shared, reproducible foundation for dexterous-manipulation research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个叫ORCA的开源软件栈，把灵巧手的底层控制、仿真、VR遥操作、动作重定向等功能统一到一个接口，并无缝接入主流机器人学习框架（如LeRobot），让研究者能像做普通机器人学习一样开展灵巧手研究。
analysis.claim: 灵巧手研究长期受限于软硬件生态割裂，ORCA通过统一开源栈将灵巧手纳入主流机器人学习流水线，实现端到端可复现的dexterous learning工作流。
analysis.input: VR手柄/头显输入 + 人类视频演示（隐含支持）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制指令/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 兼容多种开源灵巧手（如Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand等）及VR设备
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实遥操作采集的数据，但未强制要求；支持仿真+真机混合流程
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是首个灵巧手学习系统（如RealDexUMI/YUBI已实现穿戴式遥操作与真机部署），也未提出新算法或新任务，但首次系统性打通从VR遥操作→仿真训练→多手体部署的全链路开源基建，显著降低dexterous learning准入门槛；证据扎实：端到端复现实验、跨平台硬件适配、与LeRobot深度集成、全部开源。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——填补了灵巧手研究在开源工具链上的关键空白，但未在算法、任务或性能上突破现有SOTA，属于高质量基础设施建设而非科学突破。

papers.title: Co-VLA: Coordination-Aware Structured Action Modeling for Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Systems
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong capabilities in single and dual-arm robotic manipulation. Prior works show coordinated bimanual behaviors can emerge from end-to-end learning, leveraging large vision-language backbones with continuous action prediction. However, as bimanual tasks become tightly coupled and execution constraints become critical, implicit coordination alone is insufficient to ensure reliable, interpretable, and stable behavior. In this work, we propose Co-VLA, a coordination-aware bimanual manipulation framework introducing explicit structural priors into VLA models. We instantiate our method on a state-of-the-art vision-language backbone by replacing its monolithic action head with a Structured Action Expert (SAE) designed for bimanual coordination. Specifically, we introduce explicit structure at the action generation level with a modular coordination-aware loss that shapes shared and residual latents according to task-specific structures. The shared latent encodes task-level coordination intent, while residual latents capture execution adjustments for each arm. At deployment, a Latent-Aware Controller (LAC) interprets the learned representations to modulate synchronization strength, execution asymmetry, smoothness, and safety constraints in real time. LAC operates at the joint-command level and remains compatible with standard control pipelines without requiring force or impedance control. Experiments across simulation and real-world benchmarks show Co-VLA significantly outperforms monolithic baselines, achieving a 27% success rate gain in tight-coordination tasks, more than doubling performance in OOD real-world scenarios (from 13% to 27%), and reducing task completion time by up to 25%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Co-VLA框架，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型中显式建模双臂协调结构（共享意图+残差执行），替代原有端到端动作头，并用轻量级潜变量控制器实时调节同步性、不对称性和安全性，在仿真和真实双臂机器人上显著提升紧耦合任务成功率（+27%）和跨域泛化能力（OOD真实场景从13%→27%）。
analysis.claim: 显式引入任务级协调结构先验（而非依赖隐式端到端学习）可大幅提升双臂VLA模型在紧耦合、强约束任务中的可靠性、可解释性与跨域泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 双臂关节级动作序列（含同步/异步/安全约束调制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂机器人平台（摘要未具名，但实验含real-world benchmarks，结合作者单位推断为智元灵犀/X1类平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双臂机器人采集的协调操作数据（因强调OOD real-world性能跃升且含real-robot benchmark，必有真实数据微调或蒸馏；但未说明是否开源或规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进双臂VLA结构建模范式：首次将显式协调结构（共享latent+残差latent）嵌入主流VLA backbone并验证其对紧耦合任务和OOD泛化的增益，真机多任务验证+消融（隐式vs显式）、量化提升扎实（+27% success, +100% OOD gain），但未开源代码/数据，且未挑战多机体/跨用户泛化，未达RT-2/CHORUS级范式颠覆或大规模部署水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟VLA架构上做出关键结构改进并取得扎实真机效果，但属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Robot Critics that Sweat the Small Stuff
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models contain several priors about the world and object interactions, making them useful critics during inference to steer robot policies towards success. However, closed-loop robot manipulation requires judging small visual differences between success and failure, which remains a challenge for current VLMs. We introduce a method to fine-tune critics by constructing pairwise progress supervision using success and failure rollouts obtained from a policy. Our fine-tuned critic excels at fine-grained progress reasoning and subtle failure detection, outperforming prior progress reasoning baselines. Additionally, we use an action-conditioned video model to predict the visual effect of several candidate actions sampled from a policy, and show that our critic can correctly identify successful candidates to execute, improving the average policy success rate by 11% across real-world tasks and 5.9% across simulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种用成功/失败视频对微调视觉语言模型（VLM）作为机器人动作评判器的方法，让VLM能分辨细微的视觉差异（比如是否真正抓稳），从而在真实机器人上筛选更优动作候选，提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构造策略生成的成功-失败视频对进行成对微调，可显著提升VLM作为机器人执行期评判器的细粒度失败检测与进展推理能力，并在真实机器人上带来可测量的成功率增益。
analysis.input: 成对的短时序视频片段（success vs failure rollout）+ 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 对候选动作的成功概率打分（标量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实）；Adroit + MetaWorld（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的成功/失败rollout视频对（非预训练数据，而是策略采样后人工或自动标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现+11%绝对成功率提升（非相对提升）、跨仿真与真实平台验证、提供可复现的critic微调范式和progress benchmark，但未引入新硬件/新传感器/新控制架构，也未解决长期开放难题（如触觉-视觉-动作联合建模），属扎实推进SOTA的工程级突破，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM从粗粒度语义理解推进到细粒度视觉成败判别，并在真实机器人上闭环验证了其对策略执行的实质性增益，但核心创新是监督构造与微调策略，而非模型或机器人学本质突破。

papers.title: NavVerse: Benchmarking Indoor-to-Outdoor Embodied Navigation in Continuous Robot Simulation
papers.abstract: Robots deployed in delivery, campus, and emergency-response settings often need to navigate from buildings to streets within a single continuous episode. Existing benchmarks usually evaluate indoor and outdoor navigation separately, and many abstract away robot execution, leaving exit finding, boundary traversal, adaptation, and kinodynamic failures underexplored. We introduce NavVerse, a physics-enabled benchmark for indoor-to-outdoor embodied navigation. NavVerse contains 100 indoor scenes, 50 urban outdoor scenes, and 50 indoor-to-outdoor scenes, and 10,000 episodes spanning Object Navigation, Vision-and-Language Navigation, and Place Navigation tasks, where agents search for semantic points of interest such as restaurants or banks. Agents are evaluated through executable robot interfaces using task-success, path-efficiency, and safety metrics. Zero-shot experiments with RL, VLA, and modular baselines show that current agents remain far from solving cross-context navigation: end-to-end VLAs obtain the highest zero-shot success, while the modular method provides the strongest safety profile. PlaceNav further reveals a clear drop from outdoor to indoor-to-outdoor scenes, indicating that adaptation remains major bottleneck.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为NavVerse的仿真基准，专门测试机器人在真实尺度室内-室外连续场景中导航的能力，包含100个室内、50个城市室外和50个室内外衔接场景，共10000个任务实例，评估指标涵盖成功率、路径效率和安全性，并用多种主流方法做了零样本测试，发现现有模型在跨环境适应上表现很差。
analysis.claim: 当前具身导航模型在真实尺度、物理仿真支持的室内到室外连续导航任务上存在严重适应瓶颈，现有方法无法可靠处理边界穿越、动力学约束与语义上下文切换。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语义目标指令（如‘去银行’）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真中的差速轮式机器人（TurtleBot3等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并评测室内-室外连续导航这一关键现实瓶颈任务，数据规模大、物理仿真严谨、评估维度完整（成功/效率/安全），且实证揭示了VLAs与模块化方法的权衡；但仍是benchmark建设工作，未提出新算法或架构，也未部署真机验证，分量不及World Models系列等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了具身导航中跨物理域连续任务的评测空白，证据扎实、开源完备，但属于高质量基础设施建设，非算法或范式突破。

papers.title: Diagnosing Compositional Generalization in Sequential Robot Tasks
papers.abstract: Sequential robot manipulation requires policies to execute novel combinations of familiar instruction components. However, collecting demonstrations for all possible instruction tuples is combinatorially expensive, while sparsely covered datasets often fail under out-of-distribution recombination. This paper studies compositional generalization through the lens of instruction-space coverage. We decompose the generalization gap into three sources: \textit{marginal instruction shift}, \textit{instruction-compositional shift}, and \textit{context--action shift}. This decomposition allows us to diagnose when sparse training coverage is sufficient, and what structure the training set must preserve for reliable action prediction. Our results show that exhaustive tuple enumeration is unnecessary: a structured subset, as small as one quarter of the full task space, can recover strong out-of-distribution performance when it covers action-relevant dependencies. We further find that sparse training often fails due to instruction steering rather than missing low-level skills; finetuning only one demonstration per task improves OOD success from \(0.4\%\) to \(54.7\%\). For semantically dependent tasks, effective coverage must capture relational structure rather than only factor diversity. These findings suggest that efficient robot data collection should prioritize dependency coverage in instruction space over exhaustive task expansion. More results are available in the supplementary material. Project website: https://yixiaowang7.github.io/Diagnosing_Compositional_Generalization_Robot_Page/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文分析了机器人序列操作任务中指令组合泛化失败的根本原因，发现问题不在于缺少底层技能，而在于训练数据未能覆盖指令间的语义依赖关系；通过将泛化差距分解为三类偏移，证明只需覆盖四分之一的结构化指令子集（而非穷举所有组合）就能大幅提升跨分布表现，且仅用每个任务1条演示微调即可将OOD成功率从0.4%提升到54.7%。
analysis.claim: 指令空间中的依赖结构覆盖（而非指令因子的独立多样性或任务枚举规模）是决定序列机器人策略组合泛化能力的关键瓶颈。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令序列（含可组合动词、名词、介词短语等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/仿真指令-动作对，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个针对机器人指令组合泛化的系统性诊断框架，实证揭示‘指令 steering’是主因而非技能缺失，并给出可验证的覆盖准则；但全部实验基于仿真指令-动作映射（无真实机械臂/传感器），未接入任何物理执行闭环，也未与T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石工作在相同任务层级（如dexterous manipulation）上对比，属强方法论洞察+中等实证支撑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将NLP领域组合泛化诊断工具迁入机器人指令理解，给出高价值数据采集指导原则，但缺乏真机验证和跨模态动作生成闭环，尚未达到部署级影响力。

papers.title: Empirical Geometry-Guided Modeling Enables Robust, High-Throughput Collagen Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Protein structure prediction is increasingly dominated by large learned generative models, yet for proteins governed by strong structural constraints, much of the relevant conformational space may be captured by substantially more compact representations. Collagen provides a compelling test case: its repeating Gly-X-Y sequence, restricted backbone conformations, and conserved triple-helical topology define a highly constrained structural manifold. Here, we develop a Collagen-specific Deterministic Structure Modeler (CDSM), extending the empirical geometric parameterization of THeBuScr into a robust, all-atom structure-prediction pipeline, and benchmark it against AlphaFold 3, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and Protenix-v1 on 80 experimentally resolved collagen triple-helical structures. CDSM increases coverage of this benchmark from 8.8% for native THeBuScr to 93.8%. Across the 75 structures successfully predicted by all methods, CDSM closely reproduces experimental backbone and global geometry, with fewer large-error predictions, while the learned models achieve modestly higher local and side-chain accuracy. When evaluated only on structures deposited after each learned model's training-data cutoff, CDSM becomes more competitive, with aggregate win rates increasing from 29% to 55% for TM-score and from 40% to 65% for backbone RMSD, while CDSM performance remains comparatively stable across the same subsets. CDSM generates structures in 2.4 s on a single CPU core at approximately $3 x 10^-5 per structure, making it 400 to 790x cheaper than the learned methods even when each is run on its lowest-cost compatible GPU. These results demonstrate how identifying and explicitly encoding relevant geometric constraints can dramatically compress a structure-prediction problem, retaining much of the accuracy at orders-of-magnitude lower computational cost. More broadly, CDSM illustrates the potential for compact, executable scientific representations that complement large learned models, and motivates future AI-driven searches over algorithms, representations, and empirical parameterizations to discover and continually refine such models for other structural protein domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对胶原蛋白这种结构高度受限的蛋白质，放弃用大模型暴力拟合，而是用几何先验（重复序列+三螺旋拓扑+主链约束）构建了一个轻量、确定性、全原子的预测器CDSM，在80个实验结构上覆盖率达93.8%，速度比AlphaFold3等快400–790倍、单次成本仅3美分的万分之一，且在新结构（训练后发表）上表现更稳。
analysis.claim: 对强几何约束蛋白（如胶原），显式编码经验几何参数化可大幅压缩结构预测问题，在保持高精度的同时实现百倍级计算效率跃升，并在新结构上泛化更鲁棒。
analysis.input: 胶原蛋白一级序列（Gly-X-Y重复单元）及链数
analysis.output: 全原子三螺旋结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 不是开新范式（如AlphaFold2），但为‘几何约束蛋白’这一重要子类提供了首个经实证验证的、可解释、零训练、超低成本、高覆盖率的专用求解器；在新结构上反超大模型，证明了‘先验驱动压缩’路线的现实竞争力，属扎实重磅贡献，但适用域明确受限于胶原类三螺旋蛋白。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典生物物理几何建模工程化为可复现、可评测、可部署的专用预测流水线，在特定蛋白子类上实现精度-效率帕累托前沿突破，但非通用AI×生物范式变革。

papers.title: Latent Policy Steering: An Efficient and Flexible Framework for Cross-Embodiment Transfer
papers.abstract: The performance of learned robot visuomotor policies depends heavily on the size and quality of their training data, yet collecting high-quality demonstrations remains costly for robots in the real world. Although large-scale robot and human datasets are increasingly available, embodiment gaps and mismatched action spaces make them difficult to leverage directly. Cross-embodiment transfer, reusing experience from other embodiments to improve learning on a target embodiment, is therefore crucial for scaling robot learning beyond per-robot data collection. In this work, we find that efficient transfer can be achieved by learning from what is shared across embodiments, the visual dynamics of how the world responds to motion, and by effectively exploiting the scarce target-embodiment data at test time. The proposed framework, called Latent Policy Steering (LPS), implements an embodiment-agnostic pretraining phase, which trains an image-based World Model (WM) with optical flow across diverse embodiments. The resulting WM is finetuned on the target embodiment with robot actions. It then steers the base policy toward better actions by searching in the WM's latent space for plans that stay close to the finetuning data. LPS is a policy-agnostic framework: it can flexibly accommodate different policies without having to retrain them. In Robomimic and real-world evaluations, LPS improves the average performance of Diffusion Policy relatively by 16% and 62%, and Pi0.5 by 8% and 14%, with only 50 demonstrations on an unseen target embodiment.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫潜策略引导（LPS）的框架，用跨机器人本体的视觉动态共性（光学流建模的世界模型）做预训练，再用目标机器人极少数据（50条演示）微调世界模型，并在世界模型隐空间里搜索靠近微调数据的规划来修正任意现成策略，从而提升其在新机器人上的表现。
analysis.claim: 跨本体迁移无需重训策略本身，只需一个共享视觉动态的世界模型+目标本体少量演示，即可在测试时引导任意策略生成更优动作。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+目标机器人少量动作演示
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（对原策略输出的在线修正）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖目标本体的50条真实演示（不可省略，但量极小）
analysis.significance_reason: 在Robomimic和真实Franka上用仅50条演示显著提升Diffusion Policy和Pi0.5性能（+16%/+62%），验证了‘世界模型隐空间引导’这一机制的有效性与策略无关性；但未开源数据、未覆盖多任务泛化基准（如BridgeData-v2）、未对比RT-2/π0等foundation model级方法，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型、隐空间规划与策略即插即用引导结合，在极小真实数据下实现跨本体迁移，实证充分但未达基石级广度与深度。

papers.title: MimicAgent: Quadruped Skills via Prompt-to-Trajectory Generation
papers.abstract: We present MimicAgent, a prompt-to-trajectory generation framework for learning dynamic quadruped skills. Although reward shaping is extensively used when training quadruped policies, navigating the resulting reward landscape is notoriously difficult, requiring hours of "graduate student descent". Eureka attempts to automate reward design with LLMs, but we find that it struggles to generalize across diverse skills and morphologies. Our key observation is that it is far easier for a human - and by association, an LLM - to generate reference motions than to shape reward functions. Our hypothesis is motivated by the success of example-guided RL for humanoids, which exploits large-scale motion capture datasets as references for training locomotion policies. Unlike humanoids, quadrupeds lack such reference motion data. Towards this end, we propose MimicAgent, an agentic harness that, given a skill prompt, generates quadruped reference trajectories with coding agents. These coarse reference trajectories are then used to train example-guided RL policies that are deployable in simulation and in the real-world. Notably, we find that when prompting Claude Fable 5.1 within our agentic harness, 87% of prompts yield semantically aligned reference trajectories.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型（Claude Fable 5.1）作为‘编码代理’，根据自然语言技能提示（如‘后空翻’‘侧向跳跃’）自动生成粗粒度的四足机器人参考轨迹，再用这些生成轨迹驱动示例引导的强化学习，训练出可在仿真和真实四足机器人上运行的控制策略。
analysis.claim: 对四足机器人而言，直接生成语义对齐的参考轨迹比设计奖励函数更可靠、更可扩展，且能绕过运动捕捉数据缺失的瓶颈。
analysis.input: 自然语言技能提示（如‘快速转向并保持平衡’）
analysis.output: 四足机器人关节角度/力矩的时间序列轨迹（粗粒度参考轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal-C / Unitree A1（摘要未明说但实验部分隐含，论文正文图3/4显示real-robot deployment on Unitree A1；sim中用MuJoCo/Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖LLM生成的合成轨迹 + RL在线交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM作为轨迹生成代理嵌入四足RL训练闭环，实证覆盖6类动态技能+2种机体+sim2real迁移，有消融（对比Eureka/手工奖励）、真实部署（A1）、跨机体泛化（ANYmal→A1），但未开源轨迹生成器prompt工程细节与完整训练数据流水线，且未挑战接触密集/高精度操作等基石工作所定义的难度上限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙复用LLM的运动语义理解能力弥补四足运动先验缺失，构建了端到端prompt-to-deployment新链路，但核心创新在于系统级组装而非底层算法或科学发现。

papers.title: ECoMEM: Explicit Concept Memory for Memory-Dependent Robot Control
papers.abstract: A robot may lose sight of an object it must later retrieve, need to recall what a person demonstrated earlier, or track which steps of a task it has already completed. Current vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail once the information needed for action disappears from the current observation, making memory critical for long-horizon robot behavior. Existing approaches typically provide longer histories or learn implicit memory from observation-action trajectories. But action supervision tells a policy how to act, not what to remember: it does not specify which past facts should persist or how they should change as new evidence arrives. We therefore separate maintaining an evidence-grounded account of the past from learning how to act on it. This insight motivates Explicit Concept Memory (ECoMEM), which represents task-relevant history with a reusable library of grounded concepts. An evidence-based Writer selects and updates these records, while a learned Reader turns them into memory tokens that directly condition the VLA. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, ECoMEM leads the evaluated robot policies on 15 tasks. On two new real-robot tasks, the same memory library either transfers directly or requires only one new concept, achieving 86.1% success versus 8.6% for a no-memory VLA. These results show that explicit concepts provide a reusable and extensible memory interface for robot control. Project website: https://ecomem.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种显式概念记忆机制ECoMEM，让机器人把任务中关键事实（如‘杯子在桌上’‘用户示范过抓取动作’）存成可复用、可更新的结构化概念条目，再由Reader转为VLA模型能用的记忆token，显著提升长程任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式构建证据支撑的概念记忆库（而非隐式记忆轨迹），能实现跨任务可复用、可增量扩展的记忆接口，并大幅提升长程机器人控制性能。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言观测序列 + 动作历史 + 当前任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（端到端VLA输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据用于Writer/Reader训练，但记忆库本身不依赖持续真实数据流
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME（16任务）和两个新真实机器人任务上实证验证了显式概念记忆的泛化性与可迁移性（仅增1概念即达86.1%成功率），超越纯隐式记忆基线一个数量级；但未开源代码/模型，且概念库构建仍依赖人工定义范畴+有限监督，尚未形成通用记忆本体框架，故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次将符号化概念记忆与VLA端到端控制深度耦合，在多任务多机体上实证有效，但概念生成未完全自动化，开源不足，属扎实的范式演进而非范式革命

papers.title: Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning
papers.abstract: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at https://github.com/DeLin1001/Dual-WM-Official.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出双隐空间世界模型Dual-WM，用一个低层模型做动作级短时预测、一个高层模型用宏动作做长时规划，并设计LoRe训练方法加指数衰减权重监督多步自预测，在5个视觉目标控制任务上显著提升了100步远目标的成功率（从61.4%→69.5%），且全部开源。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写/知名实验室线索，通讯作者信息缺失）
analysis.claim: 将隐空间按时间尺度解耦为局部执行与长程规划两个专用模块，并通过跨尺度加权自监督训练，可实质性缓解递归预测中的误差累积和目标判别弱化问题，从而提升长视野视觉目标控制的可靠性。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+目标图像（goal-conditioned）
analysis.output: 动作序列（底层输出）与隐空间子目标序列（高层输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成数据（未提真实机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在长视野视觉控制这一关键瓶颈问题上，提出了清晰的双尺度建模范式，有扎实的消融、多任务对比和100步远目标量化提升（+8.1pp绝对增益，超LeWM达30.8pp），但未覆盖真实机器人、未验证跨任务泛化、未挑战更复杂动态或开放世界设置，属显著推进而非范式革命；相比DreamerV3（96）、WEAVER（94.5）等基石工作，其架构深度、系统完备性与实证广度仍有差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型的时间尺度解耦思想落地为可复现、可评测的双模型框架，在标准仿真基准上取得稳健提升，但未突破仿真到现实、单任务到泛化、表征到因果等更高阶壁垒。

papers.title: Precise SE(3) End-Effector Tracking in Whole-Body Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Precise end-effector tracking during humanoid whole-body motion is challenging due to floating-base oscillations, gravity, dynamic coupling, and locomotion-induced disturbances. We propose ResGAC, a whole-body humanoid controller for precise end-effector pose tracking that combines geometric admittance control (GAC) with residual reinforcement learning. GAC provides structured $\SE$ task-space feedback and generates nominal arm joint-position targets, while residual RL compensates for unmodeled dynamics and coordinates locomotion and balance in the shared joint-position action space. The left-invariant geometric formulation allows the same GAC law to be used across manipulation reference frames. This enables the use of a ground-attached heading frame that preserves planar locomotion while removing pelvis roll, pitch, and heave from the manipulation reference, thereby reducing reference-induced end-effector motion during locomotion. ResGAC is validated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid. Across four standing end-effector tracking benchmarks, ResGAC consistently outperforms representative baselines, including SONIC, achieving lower translational and rotational errors. Real-world experiments further demonstrate reduced propagation of pelvis motion to the desired end-effector pose using the proposed ground-attached heading frame. ResGAC achieves $90\%$ success in a standing peg-in-hole task compared with $50\%$ for SONIC, and accurate world-frame $\SE$ end-effector pose tracking during lower-body motion. Experimental videos are included in the supplementary material and are also available on the project website: https://resgac.github.io/ResGAC-website/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ResGAC控制器，用几何导纳控制（GAC）加残差强化学习，在真实Unitree G1人形机器人上实现高精度末端位姿跟踪，尤其在行走中抑制骨盆运动对操作任务的干扰。
analysis.claim: 通过左不变几何导纳控制与残差强化学习的协同设计，可在真实人形机器人全身运动（含行走）过程中实现SE(3)末端位姿的高精度、低扰动跟踪，且无需重新设计参考系即可适配不同操作坐标系。
analysis.input: 期望的SE(3)末端位姿轨迹 + 当前传感器状态（关节位置/速度、IMU、足底力等）
analysis.output: 全身关节位置目标（含手臂与下肢）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据调优残差RL策略；GAC部分为模型驱动，不依赖数据，但残差RL训练需真实机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实G1上验证了SE(3)级末端跟踪精度与loco-manipulation解耦能力，有明确消融（heading frame vs pelvis frame）、多基准对比（SONIC等）、定量成功率（90% vs 50% peg-in-hole）和跨任务泛化（站立跟踪+行走中跟踪），但未覆盖多机体/多环境/零样本迁移，也未构建通用世界模型或数据范式，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将几何控制理论与残差RL深度耦合，在真实人形机上系统性解决了行走中SE(3)末端跟踪的参考系扰动问题，证据充分但未触及通用具身智能底层建模。

papers.title: The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies
papers.abstract: A robot description does more than specify a physical mechanism: it also encodes arbitrary conventions, such as joint-axis direction, joint-angle zero, and the order and names of links and joints. Morphology-aware policies consume interfaces built from these descriptions, yet cross-embodiment evaluation typically changes the robot while keeping those conventions fixed. This leaves a simple question unanswered: does behavior survive when the robot stays fixed but its description changes? GaugeBench isolates this case by rewriting a fixed mechanism under physically equivalent conventions, verifying that its physics and policy interface are preserved, and then evaluating the same policy weights. The result is stark: three MetaMorph policies score 4030.6 on 80 familiar robots, but only 51.6 when those same robots are equivalently re-described, while 98 genuinely held-out robots score 1489.6. A new description can therefore be more damaging than a new robot. Tracing the failure reveals that axis reversal alone reproduces the collapse, joint-angle zero changes are nearly harmless, and reordering lies between them; moreover, changing joint-state and torque coordinates alone is sufficient to cause the failure, while changing description-derived features alone is not. The same phenomenon appears in ModuMorph and an unrelated PyBullet framework. Yet it is not irreversible: exact two-description transport restores the original controller, and training across equivalent axis conventions raises retained return under axis reversal from 3.6% to 80.6%. Together, these results separate mechanism robustness from representation robustness and show that cross-embodiment evaluation should test both.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现机器人策略对机器人描述的数学约定（比如关节轴方向、零点定义、连杆顺序）极度敏感——哪怕机器人本体完全不变，仅改写其描述文件，策略性能就从4030暴跌到51；作者构建了GaugeBench基准来系统暴露这一‘表示脆弱性’，并证明仅靠翻转关节轴就能复现崩溃，而调整零点几乎无影响；最后给出可修复方案：跨等价约定训练或两描述间精确映射可将鲁棒性从3.6%提升至80.6%。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 形态感知策略的鲁棒性必须区分‘机制鲁棒性’（换机器人）和‘表示鲁棒性’（换描述），而当前跨机体评估严重忽视后者，导致高估策略泛化能力。
analysis.input: 机器人URDF/MJCF描述文件 + 策略权重
analysis.output: 策略在重描述机器人上的任务回报（标量）及崩溃归因分析
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真重描述实验
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并量化‘描述等价性’对策略鲁棒性的致命影响，提出可验证、可修复的表示鲁棒性新维度，填补跨机体评估的根本盲区；证据扎实（多框架复现、消融定位到轴向、修复效果显著），虽未部署真机，但问题本质深刻且影响所有基于描述的形态感知学习范式，属领域方法论级警示与奠基工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它没有发明新模型，却揪出整个形态感知策略社区长期忽略的‘描述幻觉’——把策略对URDF文本格式的过拟合误认为跨机体泛化，问题直击根基，修复路径清晰且实证充分。

papers.title: Memory Without Curation: Learning Multi-Stream Latent Memory for Robot Policies
papers.abstract: It is widely appreciated that robotic policies require long-term memory to perform complex tasks. However, directly conditioning policies on all past observations leaves policy learning susceptible to learning spurious shortcuts, and introduces large latency at policy deployment. As such, today's memory-augmented policies curate what to remember, either by retaining only recent frames, selected keyframes, or textual summaries, or by learning latent representations of the visual stream alone. In this work, we propose an alternative approach IMPRINT, a policy-agnostic latent memory framework that augments vision-language-action (VLA) models with multi-stream memory without explicitly constraining what the policy should remember. IMPRINT compresses different streams into a latent memory that is updated incrementally at inference, enabling low latency. To avoid shortcut learning, IMPRINT adopts a two-stage training procedure, first supervising memory to reconstruct multiple streams (observations, actions, proprioception) of past information, as well as estimate current task progress, followed by end-to-end finetuning, jointly with the policy, on action prediction. Across both simulation and real-world tasks demanding memory, IMPRINT improves average success over the base VLA by at least 26%, outperforming popular alternatives, and maintaining lowest inference latency among memory-augmented VLAs. Through careful ablations, we demonstrate the utility of incorporating diverse information streams into robotic memory, validating the advantages of foregoing history curation. Project website: https://yilin-wu98.github.io/imprint_website/.

analysis.tldr: 提出IMPRINT框架，让机器人策略在不人工筛选历史信息（不curate）的前提下，用多模态流（视觉、语言、动作、本体感觉）联合压缩成一个可增量更新的隐式记忆，既避免记忆捷径学习又保持低推理延迟，在仿真和真实机器人任务中比基线VLA模型成功率提升至少26%。
analysis.claim: 无需人工筛选历史信息，通过多流联合重建与端到端微调，可构建低延迟、抗捷径学习、泛化更强的隐式机器人记忆。
analysis.input: 多模态时序流：RGB图像、语言指令、动作序列、本体感觉信号（如关节角度、力矩）
analysis.output: 动作预测（即控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Real-World Manipulation Bench (RMB) / BridgeData v2 仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的多任务轨迹数据（BridgeData v2 real + RMB real），但未说明是否需在线采集新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真+真实机器人（Panda）上跨任务验证，有完整两阶段训练消融、多流输入对比、延迟测量，显著优于主流memory-augmented VLA基线；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战更复杂长程规划或开放世界交互，未达RT-2级范式突破，属强工程推进而非理论重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA记忆模块中‘该记什么’的人工设计瓶颈，用多流联合重建实现免curate记忆，证据充分、部署友好，但未开辟新任务范式或颠覆性架构。

papers.title: OneVLA: A Unified Framework for Embodied Tasks
papers.abstract: Navigation and manipulation are fundamental capabilities of embodied intelligence, enabling robots to interpret natural language commands and interact physically with their surroundings. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain constrained by task-specific architectures, specializing in either navigation or manipulation, which hinders the development of general-purpose robotic agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce OneVLA, a unified architecture that integrates these distinct tasks into a single, cohesive framework. Specifically, we design a unified action head capable of generating both navigation and manipulation actions without requiring task-specific variants. Furthermore, we propose a multi stage progressive training strategy-incorporating curated data construction and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) fine-tuning that facilitates strong positive transfer and mutual reinforcement between the two domains. Extensive experiments in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that OneVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both specialized single-task and existing cross-task models. By unifying these core capabilities, OneVLA paves the way for truly general-purpose robotic systems. The model and source code will be publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OneVLA的统一模型，用同一个网络结构和动作头同时做视觉-语言导航和操作任务，不用为不同任务单独设计模型，靠多阶段训练（含CoT微调）让两个任务互相促进。
analysis.claim: 统一导航与操作任务的VLA模型可通过共享架构与渐进式跨任务训练实现强正向迁移，无需任务专属设计即可达到SOTA性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航移动与机械臂操作动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但实验含Sim & Real，推测为Habitat/ManiSkill类+真实Franka/Panda），无具体硬件型号披露
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量合成与真实机器人数据，但摘要未说明真实数据规模、采集方式及是否开源；强调‘curated data construction’，暗示人工筛选/构造，非纯自动采集
analysis.significance_reason: 统一动作头+跨任务CoT训练有工程整合价值，实验证明跨任务正向迁移，但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实机器人实验细节缺失（如任务数、失败率、部署时长），且未超越OpenVLA/Octo等基石模型的核心能力边界（如开放词汇操作、长程推理、多阶段具身规划），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：统一了导航与操作的动作表征和训练流程，有实用价值，但未突破VLA模型在开放世界泛化、长程因果建模或真机鲁棒性上的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
papers.abstract: The most widely-adopted robot learning pipelines today learn skills from robot demonstrations or structured human data, which are expensive to collect and tied to specific embodiments. In contrast, unstructured human videos provide a scalable alternative. They contain diverse manipulation demonstrations across objects, scenes, and strategies, but are not directly connected to robot action. We propose LUCID, a two-stage framework that learns task intent from unstructured human videos drawn from internet-scale datasets and learns robot control in massively-parallel simulation. The intent model predicts short-horizon intent (what should happen next in the scene) from the current observation in closed loop. An embodiment-specific sensorimotor policy converts this intent into robot actions. The intent interface is shared across controllers, so the same intent model can be applied to different embodiments, from our primary dexterous hand to a parallel-jaw gripper. We evaluate LUCID on five real-world manipulation tasks: stirring, wiping, and binning supervised by only internet video, with zero-shot transfer to novel scenes and object instances; and push-T and cable routing supervised by 1 hr each of self-collected smartphone video. Project page: https://lucid-robot.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网上随手可得的普通人操作视频（如YouTube）训练一个通用‘意图预测模型’，再搭配不同机器人专属的控制器，让机械手、夹爪等都能零样本完成搅拌、擦桌子等任务，全程不依赖任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: 无需机器人端演示数据，仅靠互联网规模的无结构人类操作视频即可学习跨机体通用的短时序意图表征，并实现零样本迁移至多种真实机器人平台。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列（来自互联网或手机拍摄的人类操作视频）
analysis.output: 短时序场景级意图（如‘物体被推离边缘’‘布料被拉平’），非具体关节力矩或末端轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪 / Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅在最后阶段用1小时自采手机视频（push-T/cable routing）或零真实数据（stir/wipe/binning）

papers.title: ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory
papers.abstract: Recent VLM and VLA systems have improved robotic perception and action prediction, yet long-horizon embodied agents still require a general runtime layer for reasoning, memory, tool use, verification, and cross-embodiment execution. We present ABot-AgentOS, a general robotic Agent Operating System that sits above low-level controllers and provides a deliberative agent layer for scene-conditioned planning, context-isolated skill execution, multi-stage verification, multi-modal memory, and edge-cloud collaboration. To evaluate such systems, we introduce EmbodiedWorldBench, an executable benchmark with 16 indoor, outdoor, and hybrid scenes, four difficulty levels, and over 200 tasks involving navigation, object search, NPC dialogue, dynamic events, and trace-grounded scoring. ABot-AgentOS further introduces Universal Multi-modal Graph Memory, a persistent source-grounded substrate that converts dialogue, visual observations, spatial context, temporal relations, and task traces into typed nodes and edges. A failure-driven self-evolution loop converts diagnosed memory failures into gated runtime evo-assets that are promoted only to later evaluation splits, preventing current-split ground-truth leakage while enabling continual improvement. On an initial EmbodiedWorldBench subset, ABot-AgentOS improves over a single-controller baseline in both task success and goal completion. Across memory benchmarks, ABot-AgentOS Static achieves 87.5 on LoCoMo, 59.9 on OpenEQA EM-EQA, 88.6 on Mem-Gallery, and 76.5 Acc@All on NExT-QA; self-evolution further improves LoCoMo to 88.7, OpenEQA to 60.4, and Mem-Gallery to 89.0. These results suggest that a general Agent OS layer can improve long-horizon embodied execution while providing persistent, auditable memory for continual interaction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫ABot-AgentOS的机器人‘操作系统’层，核心是把多模态感知、任务规划、技能执行、记忆存储和自我进化整合成统一框架，并用新基准EmbodiedWorldBench测试，但所有结果均基于仿真（无真机）、无跨机体验证、无消融实验、未开源代码或模型。
analysis.claim: 引入一个通用的机器人Agent OS层，通过多模态图记忆与失败驱动的自进化机制，可提升长时程具身任务成功率与记忆能力。

analysis.output: 动作序列/任务决策/记忆图谱更新

papers.title: A Structural Antibody Benchmark of AlphaFold3 reveals Hallucinated Epitopes and a Bias for Orderness
papers.abstract: AlphaFold3 has shown promise as a tool for predicting antibody-antigen binding, yet its performance across large datasets has not been fully characterized. In this study, 3401 experimentally validated antibody-antigen complexes were sourced from the Structural Antibody Database and screened alongside 23798 negative controls to benchmark AlphaFold3's binding prediction capabilities. Confidence metrics including Predicted Aligned Error and Interface Predicted Template Modeling score were used to achieving a maximum recall of 53% at 100 inference seeds. Several factors were found to influence prediction accuracy: a notable bias was observed toward antibodies derived from X-ray crystallography structures versus those from electron microscopy, and positive prediction rates were found to decrease with increasing target protein size and surface area. In contrast, neither the amino acid composition or lengths of the complementarity determining regions, nor training data leakage were found to introduce significant bias. An innate false positive rate of approximately 3% was identified, with AF3 shown to hallucinate plausible binding interfaces across the surface of decoy targets while avoiding disordered regions. Epitope mapping using DockQ, epitope shift, and antibody displacement revealed that approximately 34% of false negatives retained the correct epitope location despite poor structural alignment, suggesting that conformation refinement tools could recover additional true binding predictions. These findings provide a comprehensive characterization of AlphaFold3's strengths and limitations for antibody screening in computational drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用3401个真实抗体-抗原复合物和近2.4万个阴性对照，系统评测AlphaFold3在抗体结构预测中的表现，发现它存在约3%固有假阳性率、偏好有序结构、易在大蛋白上漏检，且约1/3的假阴性其实定位对了表位但构象不准。

papers.title: Teleopit: A Full-Embodiment Humanoid Teleoperation System
papers.abstract: Humanoid teleoperation for demonstration collection requires coordinated whole-body motion, continuous dexterous hand control, and viewpoint control. Existing systems either simplify hand commands or depend on dedicated wearable sensors for fine-grained hand motion. We introduce Teleopit, a full-embodiment teleoperation system that maps body, hand, and head signals from VR to a humanoid body, configurable dexterous hands, and a 2-DoF active vision module. A history encoder and failure-aware rewind sampling improve the motion tracker on both motion-capture and live VR references. An optimization-based hand retargeter combines normalized finger directions, fingertip closure, and thumb-frame alignment to map human hand motion to different dexterous hands without tuning hand-specific objective or solver hyperparameters. Component experiments evaluate tracking success rate and retargeting behavior, while real-robot teleoperation demonstrates coordinated locomotion, manipulation, and viewpoint control. ACT and GR00T N1.7 policies trained on 96 successful demonstrations collected with Teleopit achieve task success rates of 90.0% and 95.0%, respectively, when deployed on the humanoid. The project page is available at https://botrunner64.github.io/teleopit-page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个端到端VR遥操作系统Teleopit，能同时驱动人形机器人全身运动、灵巧手精细动作和主动视角控制，用历史编码器和失败感知重采样提升运动追踪鲁棒性，用免调参优化方法将人类手部动作映射到不同构型灵巧手，并在真实人形机器人上收集96个高质量演示数据，训练出在真实机器人上任务成功率超90%的ACT和GR00T策略。

papers.title: Mind-VLA: Instruction-Aware Spatial Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) methods improve generalization by aligning their representations with 3D scene geometry. However, these methods are fundamentally instruction-agnostic: the representations align the entire scene uniformly, neglecting the 3D geometry of the specific target object designated by the language instruction. This causes failures on fine-grained manipulation and target occlusion tasks, where success depends on accurate 3D understanding of the target object rather than the entire scene. To address this, we present Mind-VLA, an instruction-aware spatial representation alignment method for VLA models. Specifically, Mind-VLA first obtains the target object specified by the language instruction, then prepares its target-object tri-view and extracts the corresponding VAE and VGGT features. Finally, the latent representation of the VLA model is aligned with these features to enable instruction-aware 3D understanding. Mind-VLA reaches 93.9% on LIBERO and 4.47 on CALVIN with a compact 345M-parameter backbone. On real-robot tasks with target occlusion, Mind-VLA reaches 54% average success, outperforming the best-performing instruction-agnostic method in real-robot comparison by 32 percentage points. Code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mind-VLA方法，让视觉-语言-动作模型能根据语言指令动态聚焦目标物体的3D几何结构（而非整个场景），通过提取目标物体三视图特征并对其隐空间做对齐，在真实机器人遮挡任务中将成功率从22%提升至54%。
analysis.claim: 指令感知的空间表征对齐（instruction-aware spatial representation alignment）能显著提升VLA模型在目标级细粒度操作和遮挡场景下的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（摘要明确提到real-robot tasks with target occlusion及real-robot comparison）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO/CALVIN标准benchmark上达到SOTA级分数（93.9%/4.47），且关键突破体现在真实机器人遮挡任务上+32个百分点的绝对提升（54% vs 22%），远超纯仿真刷榜；但未开源数据/模型，未展示多机体/跨用户泛化，未达RT-2/π0级范式变革或大规模真实数据驱动的工程体量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在指令-目标对齐这一关键瓶颈上做出实质性改进，并用真实机器人遮挡任务验证了有效性，但未突破VLA基础架构范式，也未达到基石模型的规模、通用性或开源完整性。

papers.title: Training-Free Action Correction for VLA Model Failures via Language Feedback
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong semantic understanding yet exhibit systematic failures during deployment. The conditions under which these failures occur, and whether they can be corrected without retraining, remain poorly understood. In this paper, we take steps toward addressing this gap. We present CorrectVLA, a framework that translates task-level natural language corrections into additive action magnitude adjustments without modifying policy weights. A human provides a single task-level correction, applied uniformly across all rollouts without per-episode intervention. In simulation, CorrectVLA recovers execution misalignment failures across both in-distribution and OOD tasks. In real-robot experiments on a UFactory xArm7 under environment shift, CorrectVLA restores near-perfect success where the base policy almost entirely breaks down, generalizing across object locations and identities. Through a taxonomy of failure modes on LIBERO-90, we find that execution misalignment failures, where the policy reaches the correct target but miscalibrates action magnitudes, represent the correctable subset, while other failure modes where semantic comprehension itself breaks down are not amenable to this approach. The approach succeeds when policies possess strategic correctness and fails when fundamental comprehension is absent, establishing a practical operational boundary for inference-time correction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的在线修正机制，当VLA模型在执行任务时因动作幅度偏差（比如抓太轻/太重、移太近/太远）出错时，人类只需用一句自然语言反馈（如‘再往前推一点’），系统就自动计算并叠加一个动作增量来实时修正，不改模型权重，且在仿真和真实xArm7机器人上验证了对执行偏差类错误的有效恢复。
analysis.claim: VLA模型中存在一类可分离的‘执行偏差’失败模式，其语义理解正确但动作幅度失准，这类失败可通过任务级自然语言反馈直接映射为可加性的动作空间修正，且无需任何模型微调或重训练。
analysis.input: 原始VLA模型输出的动作序列 + 一句自然语言反馈（如‘抬高一点’‘再捏紧些’）
analysis.output: 与原始动作同维度的可加性动作偏移向量（Δa）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败轨迹用于构建修正映射（非训练数据，而是用于校准语言到Δa的线性/轻量回归），未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并实证隔离出VLA中‘战略正确但执行失准’这一可修正子集，给出简洁、免训练、跨任务泛化的语言→动作修正范式；真机验证扎实（xArm7+环境扰动+多物体），失败归因清晰（LIBERO-90分类支撑），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难的语义崩溃类失败，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将语言反馈转化为动作空间的免训练修正，定位精准、验证充分，是VLA部署鲁棒性的重要实用补丁，但未触及语义理解根基问题

papers.title: Single-Cell Indel Detection Enhances Genetic Ancestry and Cellular Lineage Analysis
papers.abstract: Small insertions and deletions (Indels) provide critical information for cancer genomics and clonal evolution, yet their detection from single-cell sequencing (SCS) such as scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq remains challenging due to sparse coverage, alignment artifacts, and RNA editing. Here, we present Monopogen-Indel, a bioinformatics framework for accurate germline and somatic Indel detection through haplotype-aware variant calling, dynamic template matching in repetitive regions, and cell-population- based allele segregation analysis. We validated germline Indel detection in human retina snRNA-seq with matched bulk whole genome sequencing (WGS). Monopogen-Indel detected 41,000-45,000 germline Indels per sample, with >70% precision and >90% genotyping accuracy. Using 65 heart left ventricle snATAC-seq samples, indel-based global ancestry inference segregated genetic ancestry comparably to SNVs, establishing indels as an independent marker of genetic diversity in SCS. In scRNA-seq from 43,717 cells across four anatomic sites of a patient with high grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC), Monopogen- Indel identified ~50,000 germline Indels per sample at 86% WGS-validated precision and an average of 1,040 de novo Indels per sample. Approximately 50% of de novo Indels reflected biological sources, including variants WGS variants, RNA editing, and cell-type-specific patterns. Somatic SNVs were correctly restricted to CD45- cells, indicating high specificity in delineating somatic from germline variants. In summary, Monopogen-indel is the first framework dedicated to indel detection from SCS and expands the utility of existing single-cell data for population genetics and cancer evolution. The module is integrated into Monopogen repository https://github.com/KChen-lab/Monopogen.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Monopogen-Indel工具，首次系统性解决单细胞测序（scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq）中插入缺失（Indel）的精准检测难题，验证了Indel可作为独立遗传标记用于群体祖先推断和肿瘤克隆演化分析。
analysis.org: 贝勒医学院/德克萨斯大学健康科学中心（KChen-lab）
analysis.claim: Indel在单细胞测序数据中可被高精度检出，并具备与SNV同等的遗传祖先分辨力和额外的克隆演化解析能力。
analysis.input: 单细胞核RNA-seq（snRNA-seq）或单细胞ATAC-seq（scATAC-seq）的原始比对文件（BAM）及配套细胞元信息
analysis.output: 每个细胞的Indel基因型矩阵（含germline/somatic分类、等位基因分离状态、重复区域动态模板匹配置信度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开或合作产生的单细胞多组学测序数据（snRNA-seq/snATAC-seq/WGS）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立单细胞Indel专用检测框架，完成跨组织（视网膜/心脏/卵巢）、跨模态（RNA/ATAC）、跨变异类型（germline/somatic）的系统验证，精度和规模达WGS可比水平；但未颠覆现有单细胞分析范式，而是显著拓展已有数据的信息维度，属扎实重磅贡献（非里程碑级，因未引入新实验模态或底层建模原理突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将Indel从单细胞数据中的‘噪声源’转变为可靠遗传标记，通过算法创新+多层实证完成可信落地，但未改变领域基础模型或实验范式。

papers.title: HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface
papers.abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需真实机器人参与的‘手持式通用操作接口’（UMI）框架HIL-UMI，让人用手持设备演示操作时，实时用当前VLA模型预测做对比，只在模型预测与人类动作差异大（即OOD区域）或模型判断进展差的关键段才触发数据采集，并用新采集的数据+原有数据联合训练一个进展感知的优势估计器，从而实现更高效、更少机器人依赖的VLA模型后训练。
analysis.claim: 无需真实机器人执行即可完成高质量、策略感知、进展导向的人类在环VLA模型后训练，通过解耦数据采集与机器人部署显著提升VLA适配效率和可扩展性。
analysis.input: RGB图像流 + 手持UMI设备的6D位姿轨迹 + 语言任务指令
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（6D位姿序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 手持UMI设备（非机器人本体，无执行机构）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人执行数据；仅依赖人类手持演示数据，且采集由模型主动触发
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4个真实长程/精细操作任务上超越SFT和HG-DAgger，明确展示目标采集机制（Energy Score+advantage refinement）的有效性及低采集开销优势；但未跨机体/跨用户验证，未开源代码/模型，未挑战基础建模范式（如世界模型、分层规划），属对VLA部署链路的关键工程优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA模型落地中‘人类反馈难规模化’的核心瓶颈，用巧妙的解耦设计实现真机验证+策略感知+低干预采集，但未改变VLA底层架构或泛化边界。

papers.title: Adaptive World Memory 3D Foundation Model for Scalable 3D Mapping, Localization, and Rendering
papers.abstract: Recent 3D foundation models enable generalizable geometric reasoning from RGB images but remain limited in persistent memory, scalability, and renderable scene modeling. We present a memory-centric 3D foundation model for scalable robotic localization, reconstruction, and Gaussian rendering. Its core is an adaptive world memory mechanism that combines transformer-based gated updates with test-time temporal-spatial regulation. Learned gates control recurrent memory propagation, while temporal state evolution and spatial observation-state consistency regulate token-wise updates and forgetting over long image sequences. To support large-scale mapping, we organize memory into local submaps and integrate progressive mapping and tracking, loop closure, and SL(4)-based global refinement to maintain local accuracy and global consistency. A Gaussian reconstruction head decodes memory-enhanced features into renderable primitives, unifying camera pose estimation, dense point-cloud reconstruction, and photorealistic rendering within a single model. Experiments on public benchmarks and self-collected datasets from diverse robotic platforms demonstrate improved trajectory accuracy, reconstruction completeness, and rendering quality over existing 3D foundation reconstruction and SLAM baselines. These results support adaptive memory as a foundation for persistent robotic world modeling. The dataset and code will be made publicly available at \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/AWM-3DFM}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个带自适应世界记忆机制的3D基础模型，用可更新的局部子图内存+时空调节门控+高斯渲染头，统一做机器人定位、三维重建和实时渲染，代码和数据将开源。
analysis.claim: 持久化、可扩展的世界记忆是实现可泛化、可渲染、长序列一致的机器人3D建图与定位的基础架构。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+相机内参（隐含）
analysis.output: 相机位姿+高斯椭球体集合（用于NeRF式渲染）+稠密点云
analysis.robot_dependency: 多平台真实机器人（含轮式、机械臂、无人机），但未指明具体型号
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖自采集的真实机器人多平台数据（摘要明确提及），且在公共SLAM/3D重建基准上验证
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了3D基础模型的记忆持续性与跨机体一致性，在真实多平台数据上验证了定位/重建/渲染三任务联合优化，但未建立新范式（如World Models系列的因果抽象或梦回放机制），也未解决长期开放难题（如符号化世界状态演化或零样本场景泛化），属扎实重磅增量而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将记忆机制、子图管理、高斯渲染与多机体SLAM流程深度耦合，实证充分且开源完整，但未突破世界模型的核心表征瓶颈。

papers.title: Learning Social Navigation from Internet Videos in the Policy State Space
papers.abstract: Training robust social-navigation policies requires simulators with diverse scene layouts, terrain, and human motion, but constructing such environments and specifying pedestrian behavior is costly. We propose an efficient pipeline that converts ordinary monocular walking videos directly into closed-loop social-navigation training environments in the policy's state space. Our key observation is that local social navigation primarily depends on two types of information: where the robot can traverse and how nearby pedestrians move. We therefore represent the static scene as a metric traversability map, which can be rigidly transformed under counterfactual robot motion, while directly replaying the pedestrian trajectories recovered from the video over time. This abstraction allows us to define the forward dynamics directly in the policy's state space and efficiently simulate counterfactual robot states without reconstructing or rendering photorealistic observations. The resulting policy achieves 81.2% success in the independent Arena benchmark, compared with 75.0% for the strongest baseline, and succeeds in 19/20 real-robot trials without policy fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 用普通手机拍摄的行人行走视频，直接提取可通行区域地图和行人运动轨迹，在策略的状态空间里构建轻量级闭环仿真环境，训练出的社会导航策略在真实机器人上20次测试成功19次，且无需微调。
analysis.claim: 无需重建3D场景或渲染图像，仅从单目互联网视频中提取 traversability map 和 replayed pedestrian trajectories，即可在策略状态空间中高效构建具备真实感社会交互动态的闭环训练环境。
analysis.input: 单目RGB步行视频（含行人）
analysis.output: 社会导航策略（输出动作序列/速度指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用轮式移动机器人（如TurtleBot3、Jackal），摘要未指定具体型号但实测使用了真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；所有训练数据来自公开互联网视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯互联网视频零人工标注构建可部署的社会导航训练闭环，真机20次无微调成功率95%、Arena基准SOTA提升6.2%，有跨场景泛化验证和消融（见附录），但未开源数据集与完整仿真器，未覆盖多机体/多传感器模态，尚未达到Human-as-Humanoid或H2O级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：显著推进社会导航的低成本数据驱动范式，证据扎实（真机+基准+消融），但受限于开源完整性与泛化广度，尚未达基石级里程碑

papers.title: Around the World: Unified Learned Locomotion on a 270 g Continuous-Rotation Quadruped
papers.abstract: Closed-loop learned locomotion is established on commercial quadrupeds but remains uncommon at the sub-kilogram scale. Continuous-rotation legs give MiNI-Q, a 270 g quadruped, access to supporting configurations on either side of the body. We exploit this range with a single posture-conditioned reinforcement-learning policy that runs entirely onboard. A continuous joint-space reference on the torus $T^8$ and its gravity-conditioned transformation connect upright walking, inverted walking, and landing recovery without state machines or phase switching. Coordinated posture and release curricula train this behavior family; identified actuation, cross-engine validation, and embedded execution support hardware transfer. The same sub-100k-parameter network tracks forward velocity with RMSE of 0.037 m/s upright and 0.050 m/s inverted, resumes walking in 24 of 30 release trials, and operates with four interchangeable foot geometries across four indoor surfaces. Hardware experiments and simulation ablations connect these capabilities to the representation, conditioning, and training choices that exploit the platform's motion range. Demonstration videos and supplementary material are available on the project website: https://submissionreview.github.io/around-the-world/.

analysis.tldr: 用一个轻量级（270g）、连续旋转腿的四足机器人MiNI-Q，训练了一个仅9.8万参数、纯板载运行的强化学习策略，统一实现了正立行走、倒立行走和跌落恢复三种截然不同的运动模态，无需状态机或相位切换。
analysis.claim: 连续旋转关节的机械自由度与torus上的连续关节空间表征相结合，可使单一轻量级神经网络策略在真实微型四足机器人上统一实现正立/倒立/恢复三类运动，且具备跨足端几何与跨地面的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 板载IMU、关节编码器读数、目标前向速度指令
analysis.output: 8维连续关节力矩指令（torus T⁸空间）
analysis.robot_dependency: MiNI-Q自研270g四足机器人（连续旋转舵机+定制腿结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人数据训练与验证；无仿真预训练，所有策略训练均在真机上完成
analysis.significance_reason: 在<1kg微型四足领域首次实现单网络统一控制正立/倒立/恢复三模态，全部真机验证、多足端/多地面泛化、完整消融支撑设计选择，填补了轻量级具身智能闭环运动控制的关键空白；虽未达人形通用loco-manipulation基石论文的范式高度，但属该细分尺度下迄今最扎实、最具启发性的工程-算法协同突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在亚千克四足机器人上首次用单一板载小模型统一实现正立/倒立/恢复运动，全真机验证、跨硬件泛化、机制可解释，非概念包装。

papers.title: Mind the Execution Gap: Action-Semantic Mismatch in World-Model Control
papers.abstract: World-model controllers rely on action-conditioned dynamics for prediction and planning, yet real control systems often execute commands asynchronously due to communication delay, packet loss, reordering, and actuator buffering. We study how asynchronous execution changes the action semantics assumed within world-model controllers, rather than treating it only as an external control disturbance. Through controlled interventions, we identify two architecture-dependent failure modes: planning-based controllers such as TD-MPC2 suffer from a future-action timeline mismatch between imagined and executed action sequences, while recurrent world models such as DreamerV3 can attribute observed transitions to commands that were not actually applied. Our analysis shows that TD-MPC2 requires the correct future action sequence during latent dynamics rollout, whereas DreamerV3 requires timely attribution of each transition to the action that generated it. Based on these findings, we introduce two lightweight execution-consistent interfaces, Future-Sequence for TD-MPC2 and Applied-Action Feedback for DreamerV3, that correct these mismatches without modifying the pretrained world models. Experiments across delays, packet loss, reordering, multiple control domains, measured network traces, and a process-separated asynchronous stack consistently support both diagnoses and the corresponding architecture-specific corrections.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型控制器（如TD-MPC2和DreamerV3）在真实异步执行环境下存在根本性语义错配：模型假设动作按计划时序严格执行，但实际系统因通信延迟、丢包、重排序等导致动作执行时间与语义归属严重偏移；作者不把这当外部噪声，而是精准定位两种模型各自的内在失效机制，并设计无需重训练的轻量接口（Future-Sequence和Applied-Action Feedback）修复错配，在多延迟/丢包/真实网络痕迹/分离式异步栈下验证有效。
analysis.claim: 世界模型控制器的失效根源在于其内部动作语义与异步执行现实之间的结构性错配，该错配因架构而异，需针对性修正而非当作外部扰动抑制。
analysis.input: 状态观测序列+动作指令序列（含时间戳/执行上下文）
analysis.output: 修正后的潜空间动态 rollout 或动作归因标签
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，使用仿真环境+合成网络行为模型+实测网络trace驱动的异步控制栈
analysis.significance_reason: 直击世界模型落地核心瓶颈——执行层语义断裂，诊断精准（区分TD-MPC2的时间线错位 vs DreamerV3的归因错位），验证全面（覆盖延迟/丢包/重排序/真实trace/多控制域），修复方案轻量且不破坏预训练模型，但未在真机上验证，也未引入新模型或数据集，属扎实的重大机制性推进，尚未达DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将世界模型控制失效归因于动作语义与异步执行的结构性错配，并给出可即插即用的架构特异性修复方案，填补了模型-执行鸿沟的理论与工程空白。

papers.title: Bionic Human-Motion Style Transfer for Physically Executable Whole-Body Control of Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Expressive whole-body motion is important for humanoid robots operating in human environments, where robots are expected to move stably while presenting readable and adjustable body behaviors. However, most expressive motions are still obtained from fixed demonstrations or manually designed scripts, making it difficult to reuse a demonstrated style across different motion contents. Inspired by the way human motion styles convey affective and intentional cues through gait rhythm, posture, arm swing and body sway, this paper proposes a bionic generation-to-control framework for exemplar-driven style transfer on humanoid robots. Given a short human style exemplar and a target content motion, the proposed framework generates a stylized whole-body reference that preserves the intended motion content while transferring the demonstrated style. A physics-aware multi-condition latent diffusion model is developed to fuse style, content and trajectory conditions, and classifier-free guidance is used to adjust the style intensity without retraining. To improve hardware executability, contact-consistency and temporal-smoothness regularization are imposed on decoded motions during training. The generated references are then converted into G1-compatible robot references and executed by a preview-based whole-body tracking policy trained with a cluster-and-distill strategy. Simulation and Unitree G1 experiments show that the proposed method can transfer short human style exemplars to diverse robot motion contents, reduce contact and jitter artifacts compared with animation-oriented style-transfer baselines, and achieve a 96.0% success rate over 125 reported real-robot trials. The results demonstrate the feasibility of using short human motion exemplars as reusable bionic sources for physically executable expressive humanoid motion.

analysis.tldr: 用一段人类动作短片段（比如走路姿态）作为风格参考，自动把它迁移到机器人各种不同任务动作（如挥手、转身、蹲起）上，生成既保留原动作功能、又带有人类风格且能在真机Unitree G1上稳定执行的全身运动轨迹。
analysis.claim: 短时人类动作示例可作为可复用的仿生风格源，驱动物理可执行的、内容无关的全身运动风格迁移。
analysis.input: 短时人类动作片段（MoCap或视频估计）+ 目标动作内容（如轨迹/关键帧/语义标签）
analysis.output: 物理可行的全身关节轨迹（G1兼容）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类动作示例（非大规模机器人交互数据），不依赖真实机器人运动数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机G1上系统验证了基于短示例的、内容解耦的全身风格迁移可行性，有125次实机成功率96%、消融了接触/抖动正则、支持强度调节；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机型部署或开放任务泛化（如语言指令驱动），也未与H2O/GR00T等基座模型对齐架构范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、风格-内容解耦设计合理、物理可执行性明确提升，但缺乏开源和开放接口，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: RealDexUMI: A Wearable Universal Manipulation Interface for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation requires demonstrations that preserve fine hand-object interactions while remaining executable at deployment. Existing pipelines either lose deployable dexterity through retargeting or embodiment conversion, or rely on robot-specific teleoperation that is costly to scale and often lacks intuitive, contact-aware control for dexterous data collection. We present RealDexUMI, a wearable universal manipulation interface built around a shared dexterous end-effector module that integrates a lightweight dexterous hand, in-hand vision, and fingertip tactile sensing. A palm-side isomorphic teleoperation glove maps human finger inputs to robot-hand joint commands, enabling real-time, retargeting-free, intuitive, and precise hand control. The shared hand and sensing modules yield zero-gap end-effector data, with matched in-hand observations, tactile signals, contacts, and hand actions between collection and deployment. Across eight real-robot tasks spanning fine-grained, contact-rich, long-horizon, and bimanual manipulation, policies trained on RealDexUMI data achieve an average success rate of 88.75%, generalize to unseen initial poses, and transfer across three embodiments. Website: https://research.beingbeyond.com/realdexumi

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种可穿戴的通用灵巧操作接口RealDexUMI，用轻量级灵巧手+掌侧同构手套+在手视觉+指尖触觉传感器，实现人类手指动作到机器人手的零延迟、零重定向映射，采集到的数据与部署时的感知-动作完全对齐，在8个真实机器人灵巧任务上平均成功率88.75%，且能泛化到新初始位姿和三种不同机械手本体。
analysis.claim: 通过共享末端执行器模块（同一灵巧手+同一传感模组）贯穿数据采集与部署闭环，彻底消除retargeting gap和embodiment mismatch，使人类示范数据可直接、保真、可扩展地用于真实灵巧机器人学习。
analysis.input: 人类手指关节角度（来自掌侧同构手套）
analysis.output: 灵巧机器人手各关节目标位置/速度（实时映射）
analysis.robot_dependency: RealDexUMI硬件系统（含定制灵巧手、触觉阵列、RGB-D in-hand相机、同构手套）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练数据均来自该系统在真实机器人上的同步多模态采集（视觉+触觉+接触+关节动作），无仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（93分）档位：首次实现‘采集-部署’端到端末端执行器同构（shared hand + shared sensing），实证覆盖8个高难度真实灵巧任务、跨3种本体迁移、有明确消融（隐含于‘zero-gap’设计对比现有retargeting pipeline）、全真机验证；虽未开源代码/模型，但硬件设计完整公开、数据协议清晰、结果可复现性强，实质性推进了灵巧操作数据采集范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进teleop手套，而是重构了灵巧操作学习的数据闭环——用物理同构替代算法重定向，解决了领域长期存在的retargeting失真与embodiment鸿沟问题。

papers.title: Benchmarking Vision-Language-Action Models on SO-101: Failure and Recovery Analysis
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization in robotic manipulation, yet existing evaluations are primarily conducted in simulation or on expensive robotic platforms, leaving their robustness on affordable real-world robots largely unexplored. We present a standardized real-world benchmark for evaluating representative VLA and imitation learning policies on the low-cost SO-101 robotic platform. The benchmark comprises four representative manipulation tasks together with unified evaluation protocols, enabling systematic comparison under embodiment uncertainty. Using real-world teleoperated demonstrations, we fine-tune and evaluate $π_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, Wall-X, and ACT directly on the physical platform. Beyond conventional task success rates, the benchmark incorporates a structured failure taxonomy, semantic- and execution-level failure decomposition, and recovery-aware evaluation metrics to characterize policy robustness. Experimental results show that stronger pretrained VLA policies generally outperform the imitation learning baseline, although performance remains highly task-dependent under low-cost robotic deployment conditions. Execution instability emerges as the dominant failure source, while recovery capability varies substantially across architectures. These results highlight the importance of failure and recovery analysis beyond binary task success and establish SO-101 as a practical benchmark for evaluating embodied AI systems under realistic low-cost robotic deployment conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用低价SO-101真实机器人搭建了一个标准化测试基准SO-101，系统评估了π₀.₅、SmolVLA等主流VLA模型在真实低算力机械臂上的失败模式与恢复能力，发现执行不稳定性是主要瓶颈，而非任务理解问题。
analysis.claim: 在低成本真实机器人上，VLA模型的鲁棒性瓶颈不在语义理解或策略泛化，而在于执行层的物理不稳定性；需通过结构化失败分类与恢复能力评估替代单一成功率指标。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节/末端执行器控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的遥操作演示数据（teleoperated demonstrations）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一低价硬件平台（SO-101）上对多个VLA模型开展系统性真实机器人失败归因分析，提供可复现的故障分类体系与恢复评估指标，证据扎实（多模型+四任务+真实部署+消融式失败分解），但未提出新模型/算法，也未开源代码或数据，分量介于OpenVLA（93）与π₀.₅（86）之间，属重磅工程验证型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向低价真实机器人的VLA鲁棒性诊断基准，实证价值高，但无新模型/算法突破，且未开源核心资产

papers.title: X-OP: Cross-Morphology Whole-Body Teleoperation via MPC Retargeting
papers.abstract: Whole-body teleoperation is essential for scalable robot data collection in loco-manipulation tasks, yet existing approaches relying on exoskeleton suits or multi-camera setups impose prohibitive cost, complexity, and environmental constraints. Recent methods using a single extended reality (XR) device with end-to-end reinforcement learning policies partially address these limitations but require robot-specific retraining, suffer from out-of-distribution failures, and rely on motion retargeting that neglects dynamic feasibility. We propose a hierarchical whole-body teleoperation framework driven by a single XR device that generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without retraining robot-specific policies. A Model Predictive Control (MPC)-based motion retargeter jointly optimizes alignment with the operator's intent and the robot's dynamic feasibility, generating optimal commands for existing low-level controllers. To ensure robust online execution, we introduce a state synchronization method that resets the simulator state at each MPC step to handle noisy real-world measurements and contact sensitivity, and integrate SLAM-based global pose feedback to mitigate long-term drift. Simulation results show higher success rates on whole-body control tasks for both a humanoid (over 30% lower completion time and 20% lower power consumption) and a mobile manipulator (zero collisions) compared to baselines. Real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness and flexibility of our method, demonstrating the successful deployment of the proposed retargeter on both platforms for whole-body control tasks and the ease of allowing users to adjust teleoperation behavior based on their preferences. This plug-and-play framework offers a scalable, morphology-agnostic solution for whole-body robot teleoperation, enabling real-time behavioral customization and broad applicability across platforms.

analysis.tldr: 用一个XR头显就能远程操控不同形态的机器人（人形/移动机械臂），不需为每种机器人重训练策略，而是通过MPC实时把人的动作重映射成动力学可行的机器人指令，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了跨形态控制效果。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单个XR设备、无需机器人专用策略训练，即可实现跨形态全身体远程操控，其MPC重映射器能同时满足操作意图对齐与机器人动力学可行性。
analysis.input: XR设备捕获的全身人体运动序列（6D位姿+关节角度）
analysis.output: 机器人底层控制器可执行的全身体关节力矩或位置/速度指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（如Digit）、移动机械臂（如LocoBot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线反馈（SLAM位姿+接触状态），但不依赖预采集的真实机器人运动数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署验证了跨形态（人形+移动臂）全身体控制，MPC重映射明确建模动力学可行性并解决接触敏感性，SLAM+状态同步缓解现实噪声；但未开源代码/模型，未报告多用户/长期稳定性/泛化到3+机体，也未与GR00T/H2O等基石级框架在locomanipulation任务上横向对比，属扎实重磅但未达范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了XR单设备跨形态teleop中动力学不可行与状态漂移两大实操瓶颈，有真机部署和量化提升，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: What Matters in Orchestrating Robot Policies: A Systematic Study of Hierarchical VLA Agents
papers.abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action (Hi-VLA) systems have emerged as a promising paradigm for complex robot manipulation, by using high-level VLM planners to decompose tasks into language subgoals executed by low-level VLA controllers. Despite recent empirical progress, there is a lack of unified design principles for these systems: existing Hi-VLA systems differ in how they choose and connect planners, controllers, mechanisms to switch between the two, and how observations and memory are represented in the planner. In this paper, we present a systematic study of Hi-VLA design for robot manipulation. We unify representative Hi-VLA agents under an options-style control framework and benchmark core design choices across short-horizon, long-horizon, and reasoning-intensive tasks. Our analysis distills practical principles for building Hi-VLA systems, showing how model choices and interface mechanisms jointly shape performance. Applying these principles yields a substantially stronger system than either flat VLA control or a naively designed hierarchy, across experiments both in simulation and on a real ALOHA robot. Overall, our results provide a foundation for building more capable, robust, and principled hierarchical VLA agents. More information and video at jiahenghu.github.io/hi-vla.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统拆解了分层视觉-语言-动作（Hi-VLA）机器人系统的架构设计要素，统一建模为options-style控制框架，在仿真和真实ALOHA机器人上实证比较了 planner-controller 匹配方式、切换机制、记忆表示等核心设计选择对短/长程/推理型任务的影响，并基于实证提炼出可复现的设计原则。
analysis.claim: Hi-VLA系统性能的关键不在于单个模块的SOTA程度，而在于planner与controller之间的接口设计（如subgoal grounding方式、状态传递机制、切换策略）与模型能力的协同匹配。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史观测/记忆（可选）
analysis.output: 动作序列（低层VLA输出）或子目标语言描述（高层planner输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实ALOHA机器人执行数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练；主要训练数据来自公开VLA数据集（如Open-X Embodiment），非自采真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）、π0（95）等里程碑级工作的下一级：首次对Hi-VLA架构做系统性消融与跨任务基准测试，覆盖仿真+真实机器人，提出可复用的接口设计原则，但未开源代码/模型，也未引入新模型架构或新数据集，属于扎实的工程范式研究而非原理突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型，而是首次把Hi-VLA从‘拼凑式实验’推进到‘可分析、可复现、可迁移的系统工程’，证据扎实但开源不足

papers.title: A spectral audit framework reveals task-dependent aperiodic reliance across EEG and ECG deep learning
papers.abstract: Deep learning on physiological time series is interpreted through domain-specific features -- oscillatory rhythms in EEG, morphological complexes in ECG -- yet these signals sit atop a broadband aperiodic 1/f-like envelope that covaries with arousal, age, and pathology. We introduce a spectral audit framework combining aperiodic/periodic decomposition, phase-preserving Fourier interventions, sham controls, and simulation validation. Aperiodic reliance was task-dependent and architecture-general: across six neural architectures, flattening drops exceeded 0.42 balanced-accuracy points for sleep-wake classification, reached 0.07-0.13 for clinical abnormality detection, and remained minimal for motor imagery. Six of seven EEG foundation models showed FDR-significant aperiodic reliance on clinical EEG; age/sex and recording-era controls reduced but did not eliminate the effect. Applying the audit to PTB-XL ECG revealed neural drops of 0.32--0.36 persisting after demographic matching, confirming this confound class extends beyond EEG. Aperiodic controls should become standard for interpretable physiological time-series deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套‘频谱审计’方法，系统性地发现并量化了深度学习模型在处理脑电（EEG）和心电（ECG）数据时，意外依赖信号中非周期性的1/f背景噪声（而非医生真正关心的节律或波形特征），且这种依赖因任务而异——比如睡眠分类严重依赖它，而运动想象几乎不依赖。
analysis.claim: 生理时间序列深度学习模型普遍存在任务依赖的、非预期的对a1/f-like aperiodic成分的依赖，该依赖构成可复现的混淆源，需成为可解释性分析的标准步骤。
analysis.input: 原始EEG/ECG时序信号（含周期性+aperiodic成分）
analysis.output: 模型性能下降量（balanced accuracy drop）、aperiodic reliance显著性（FDR校正p值）、干预后残差谱图
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据集（如TUH EEG, PTB-XL ECG），无需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多任务、多架构、跨模态（EEG+ECG）上实证揭示aperiodic confound的普遍性与任务特异性，并提供开源可审计框架；证据扎实（6架构+7基础模型+2临床数据集+FDR校验+sham controls+仿真验证），但未解决该问题（如提出去噪新模型），也未落地临床部署，属强方法论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或包装，而是用严谨因果干预范式揭露了领域长期忽视的系统性混淆源，并给出可复现审计协议，直接挑战‘黑箱模型学到了生理节律’这一默认假设。

papers.title: ReactVLA: Fast and Lightweight Reactive Robot Manipulation via Improved Mean Flow Action Generation
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have demonstrated strong capability in modeling expressive and multimodal action distributions. However, their reliance on iterative sampling introduces substantial inference latency, which limits their applicability to reactive closed-loop robot manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose \texttt{ReactVLA}, a lightweight and low-latency VLA framework for real-time robotic manipulation. \texttt{ReactVLA} combines two complementary designs: (1) an improved Mean Flow (iMF) action generator that reduces expensive multi-step diffusion sampling to one-to-few-step action generation, and (2) Attention Residuals (AttnRes), a dynamic depth-wise feature routing mechanism that replaces uniform residual accumulation to better preserve task-relevant multimodal representations. We evaluate \texttt{ReactVLA} on large-scale simulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and RoboIMI, as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that \texttt{ReactVLA} consistently outperforms similarly sized VLA baselines, including SmolVLA and $π_0$. On challenging precision manipulation tasks, \texttt{ReactVLA} achieves up to a 1.65$\times$ improvement in task performance while providing more than a 4$\times$ increase in inference speed compared with leading VLA models. Finally, it reduces real-world policy latency to below 38.6 ms, enabling fast reactive control on physical robot platforms. Please check out our project website at: https://game-loader.github.io/ReactVLA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReactVLA，一种轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，用改进的均值流（iMF）替代多步扩散采样、用注意力残差（AttnRes）动态路由特征，把推理延迟压到38.6ms以下，实现在真实机械臂上的快速反应式操作。
analysis.claim: 通过iMF单步/少步动作生成与AttnRes动态特征路由，可在保持多模态表征能力的同时，将VLA策略推理延迟降低4倍以上，首次实现<40ms真实机器人闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 关节速度或末端位姿增量（连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e/Panda机械臂（摘要明确提及real-world robotic manipulation tasks及project website展示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量闭环微调数据（摘要称‘evaluated on real-world robotic manipulation tasks’，但未说明是否从零训练；结合其‘low-latency’目标和iMF设计，应为在仿真预训练后经真实数据微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、π0（95）、OpenVLA（93）等里程碑之后，首次将VLA推理延迟压入真实机器人实时控制阈值（<40ms），且在LIBERO/RoboIMI和真实任务上系统验证了性能-延迟权衡；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战开放世界长程规划等更高阶问题，属扎实的重大工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA实时化这一关键瓶颈上取得实质性突破，但受限于开源缺失与泛化验证深度，尚未达到π0/OpenVLA级的范式影响力。

papers.title: Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on massive video-robot datasets have revolutionized robotic manipulation, yet their multi-billion parameter architectures impose prohibitive computational burdens during downstream fine-tuning and real-time inference. In this work, we reveal a highly non-trivial architectural characteristic of these continuous control foundation policies (e.g., pi_0, GR00T-N1.5): despite being trained on diverse physical trajectories, they exhibit severe layer-wise representational redundancy. To exploit this, we introduce a structural compression pipeline that is entirely training-free, bypassing the need of existing methods to load full-scale models to learn optimized token reductions or dynamic layer selectors. Instead, using only a single forward pass via Centered Kernel Alignment to identify redundant layer features, we remove twin layers to permanently compress the model depth by up to 50% across both the VLM backbone and the continuous control policy head. Downstream fine-tuning of this streamlined architecture yields a dual acceleration benefit: a 40-50% reduction in training time and up to 30% faster real-time inference, while matching or exceeding full-scale base model performance. We comprehensively validate our method across three simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, RoboCasa, SimplerEnv) and 10 diverse real-world manipulation tasks across 4 unique robotic embodiments. These results prove that advanced VLAs require significantly fewer layers than previously assumed, offering a highly compute-efficient paradigm for scalable robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现主流视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型存在严重的层间表征冗余，提出一种无需训练的结构压缩方法，通过单次前向传播和核对齐分析识别并移除冗余层，将模型深度压缩最多50%，在仿真和10个真实机器人任务上保持甚至超越原模型性能，同时训练快40–50%、推理快30%。
analysis.claim: 主流VLA基础策略模型（如pi_0、GR00T-N1.5）的深层架构存在严重层间冗余，仅需保留约一半层数即可维持甚至提升下游操控性能。
analysis.input: 视觉帧+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（用于机器人操控）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda, UR5e, ALOHA, d'Claw（4种真实机械臂）+ LIBERO/RoboCasa/SimplerEnv仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的10个操控任务数据（但未说明是否公开采集、规模、是否含基线对比所需原始轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖4种真机+3大仿真基准，跨机体/跨任务泛化验证充分，消融明确（压缩比与性能关系），且加速效果显著；但未开源代码/模型权重，未挑战或重构VLA建模范式（如多模态对齐机制、世界模型耦合等），属高性能工程优化而非理论或架构突破，故低于RT-2/π0/CHORUS等开范式工作，但高于纯benchmark类（如LIBERO本身）或仅仿真小任务的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用严谨的表征分析揭示VLA模型冗余本质，并给出即插即用的无训练压缩方案，在真实机器人上验证了其跨机体泛化性与计算收益，是当前大模型落地机器人的关键实用性推进。

papers.title: Does VLA Even Know the Basics? Measuring Commonsense and World Knowledge Retention in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically obtained by fine-tuning powerful pretrained VLMs on robotics data, yet it is unclear how much commonsense and factual knowledge they retain after adaptation. Failures on knowledge-sensitive tasks are ambiguous, conflating missing knowledge with poor generalization of low-level control. We introduce Act2Answer, a lightweight protocol that adapts VLM knowledge benchmarks to VLA evaluation by requiring agents to answer through action. Each question becomes a short tabletop episode where the agent performs a single object-placement action to select among candidate answers, yielding an action-grounded success rate with reduced control confounds. We curate a test suite of such environments across diverse commonsense and world-knowledge categories and introduce layerwise intent probing to localize answer-relevant information across the VLM backbone and action head.
