In a large-scale study of 7 VLA models and 9 VLM baselines, we systematically rank models across categories, finding that VLAs show solid performance on simple concepts while exhibiting larger gaps on richer semantic categories relative to their source VLMs, that VQA co-training is associated with better knowledge retention, and that answer-relevant signals peak in middle VLA layers but attenuate in upper layers. Act2Answer is available at https://tttonyalpha.github.io/act2answer/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是训练新模型，而是设计了一个叫Act2Answer的新评测协议，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过‘摆放物体’这一简单动作来回答常识和世界知识问题，从而剥离动作控制干扰、专门测量它们还‘记得’多少原始视觉语言模型（VLM）的知识。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯科学院人工智能研究所（Kharkevich Institute of Information Transmission Problems, RAS）
analysis.claim: 当前VLA模型在微调后严重丢失原始VLM中的常识与世界知识，且这种丢失具有可定位的层间模式（中层保留、上层衰减），而传统评测因混入低级动作控制误差无法准确归因。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题+候选答案图像（桌面场景）
analysis.output: 单步物体放置动作（如将小球放到标有正确答案的托盘上）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真桌面环境（无真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真构建
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦VLA的知识保留能力与动作控制能力，提出可复现、可定位、轻量化的评测范式Act2Answer，并在7个VLA+9个VLM上完成大规模实证，揭示了知识衰减的层间规律；但未解决任何建模或部署问题，也未提升性能，属于高质量诊断性工作，贡献明确但非架构/算法/系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是迄今最干净的VLA知识退化诊断工具，但属于方法论评测而非模型或系统突破

papers.title: One Body, Two Minds: Variable Autonomy Approach for a Co-embodied Robotic Hand
papers.abstract: Assistive robotic systems face a fundamental trade-off: fully autonomous systems lack user agency, while fully user-controlled systems demand continuous cognitive effort. Existing shared autonomy approaches blend human and robot commands but are mostly deployed in separate physical bodies. We introduce co-embodiment with variable autonomy, where human and robot share a single physical body and operate at different autonomy levels across task phases, from mutual autonomy during object search and grasping to human-dominant control during actuation. We present a co-embodied, wearable robotic hand that has its own ``mind'' and operates with variable autonomy levels. A learning-from-demonstration visuomotor diffusion policy enables autonomous grasping when the user positions the hand near known objects. Once grasped, the system signals completion and the human can actuate the grasped tool (drill, spray bottle, infrared thermometer, lighter, and ice-cream scoop) via hands-free head gestures. The human retains veto authority at all times through a release gesture that returns the system to the initial phase. Unlike blended autonomy, where control is continuously negotiated, our co-embodied approach consists of variable autonomy from full human control to full independent actions while maintaining physical coupling, realizing a one body, two minds paradigm. In a user study with 44 participants performing five bimanual tasks, users rapidly adapted to this ``two minds'' paradigm: completion times improved by 23.3% across trials ($p < 0.001$, Cohen's $d = 0.94$), the best-performing policy variant reached a 93.6% task success rate, and acceptance ratings were high (5.70/7 overall impression, 5.52/7 daily use willingness). This work establishes co-embodiment with variable autonomy as a viable approach for assistive robotics, enabling human-robot collaboration through co-embodiment.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种‘共具身’可变自主性框架，让人类和AI共享同一只穿戴式机械手：搜索抓取阶段由AI自动完成（基于视觉扩散策略），抓稳后切换为人类用头部手势控制工具动作，全程物理耦合且人类随时可否决，实证显示用户操作效率提升23.3%、成功率93.6%。
analysis.claim: 共具身（co-embodiment）下的可变自主性——而非传统分离身体的混合自主——能通过物理耦合与阶段性自主切换，在保持人类完全否决权的前提下显著提升辅助机器人任务效率与接受度。
analysis.input: RGB视觉输入 + 头部姿态/手势信号 + 手部位置反馈
analysis.output: 机械手关节动作序列（抓取阶段） + 工具执行指令（操作阶段）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研穿戴式五指机械手（含IMU、肌电接口、触觉反馈模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据：44人×5任务×多轮次真实操作数据用于策略训练与评估；所有策略均在真机上部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现单物理体下人类与AI‘双心智’分阶段自主切换，并在真机上完成跨任务/跨用户的大规模用户研究（n=44），含统计显著性（p<0.001）、效应量（d=0.94）、高成功率（93.6%）及高接受度（5.7/7），填补了共具身范式从概念到实证的关键缺口；虽未达T-Rex/ALOHA级底层控制突破，但在人机协作范式层面达到与Diffusion Policy/π0同档的工程级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进某个模块，而是确立了‘共具身+可变自主’这一新协作范式，并用扎实的真机多任务用户实验闭环验证其有效性与可用性。

papers.title: CORE: Common Outcome Regularities from Action-Free Visual Demonstrations for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot imitation learning often relies on costly robot demonstrations, while abundant action-free visual demonstrations, such as human videos, are difficult to use because they lack robot-executable actions and suffer from embodiment gaps. We propose CORE, a policy learning framework that extracts Common Outcome Regularities from visual demonstrations. Rather than transferring explicit actions across embodiments, CORE exploits a key observation: although successful trajectories for the same task can be diverse, their terminal states often share stable object configurations, spatial relations, and contact constraints. CORE first trains a terminal outcome encoder with contrastive and auxiliary temporal objectives, then aggregates successful terminal embeddings into visual goal prototypes, and finally injects these prototypes as global goal conditions into robot policies. Compared with language instructions, visual goal prototypes provide more concrete geometric and physical constraints for task completion. Across Meta-World, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation, CORE improves the average success rate of the corresponding policy backbones by up to +3.9, +11.1, and +17.0 percentage points, respectively, and outperforms text-conditioned variants under the evaluated settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CORE方法，从无需动作标注的人类视频等视觉演示中自动提取任务完成时的稳定终端状态（如物体位置、接触关系），将其编码为视觉目标原型，再作为全局条件输入机器人策略，从而绕过动作模仿难题，在多个仿真和真实机器人平台上提升了操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需动作标签的视觉演示中存在可被建模的、跨 embodiment 的终端状态正则性（Common Outcome Regularities），利用该规律构建视觉目标原型可显著提升机器人操作策略的泛化性和成功率。
analysis.input: 动作无关的视觉演示视频（如人类操作视频）+ 当前机器人观测（RGB图像/状态）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据，仅需真实场景视频（非机器人采集）及少量真实机器人微调数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个标准benchmark（Meta-World/RoboTwin 2.0）和真实机器人上验证了终端状态正则性的有效性，有明确消融（对比text-conditioned）、跨平台提升（+17.0% real-world），但未开源数据/模型，且未解决核心embodiment gap的底层表征对齐问题，属于扎实推进SOTA的工程级创新，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将终端状态稳定性这一观察转化为可训练目标原型机制，并在多平台实证有效，但未开源关键资产，也未触及动作-状态映射的本质瓶颈。

papers.title: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reward design remains a central bottleneck for autonomous robot policy improvement, especially in long-horizon manipulation tasks where sparse success labels provide too little signal and binary preferences collapse many competing notions of quality into one ambiguous signal. We introduce Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method for learning robot policies from freeform human preferences. Rather than asking annotators which of two trajectories is better overall, FPL lets them define natural-language preference axes, such as speed, safety, quality of placement, or carefulness, and provide pairwise preferences along each axis. These annotations are used to learn a language-conditioned reward model that maps a trajectory and preference label to an axis-specific reward. We use this model to train a reward-conditioned policy that optimizes across the multiple human-specified dimensions. Across four real-world and two simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, FPL improves over sparse-reward and binary-preference methods by 38 percentage points. Beyond improved performance, FPL learns dense progress signals without explicit subtask segmentation, shows compositionality of behavior not present in the data, and allows users to steer the policy towards different behaviors at test time without retraining. Blog post with videos available at https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website/

analysis.tldr: 提出Freeform Preference Learning（FPL），让人类用自然语言定义多个偏好维度（如速度、安全性、放置质量），对机器人轨迹进行轴向 pairwise 打分，训练语言条件化的轴向奖励模型，并驱动可实时切换目标的奖励条件策略，在4个真实机器人任务上比稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升38个百分点。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦人类偏好的多维语义轴并建模轴向奖励，可实现无需子任务标注、无需重训练即可在测试时灵活权衡行为目标的鲁棒长程操作策略学习。
analysis.input: 机器人轨迹（状态-动作序列）+ 自然语言偏好轴描述（如“更小心”）
analysis.output: 轴向标量奖励值 + 奖励条件下的动作策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda / WidowX / Unitree Go2（摘要未明说但博客视频显示多平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行轨迹的人类轴向偏好标注（非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将偏好学习从单标量二元比较升级为多轴自由语言定义+轴向奖励建模，在真实机器人上验证跨机体/跨任务泛化与测试时行为调控能力，证据扎实（4真机任务+消融+视频），但未引入新硬件/传感器/基础模型架构，也未解决触觉/灵巧性底层瓶颈，尚达不到T-Rex/ALOHA/π0级范式突破或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语言引导的偏好学习系统性落地到多机体真实操作中，显著提升可用性与用户控制粒度，但核心组件（奖励建模、策略条件化）均基于现有技术栈重组，非底层创新。

papers.title: Imagined Rollouts are Kinematic, Not Dynamic: A Diagnosis of Long-Horizon World-Model Failure
papers.abstract: Long-horizon failure in world models is conventionally attributed to compounding error, a generic framing that does not distinguish what kind of error compounds. We propose a kinematic-vs-dynamic reframing: world models tend to imagine kinematically rather than dynamically. We operationalize this as the imagined Kinematic-Consistency Error, a per-step diagnostic that measures how far a rollout departs from a closed-form kinematic null, paired with a perturbation protocol that tests whether iKCE responds when physical conditions cross a regime boundary. We instantiate the diagnostic on a released DreamerV3 checkpoint trained on DMC walker-walk, where imagined iKCE runs roughly two orders of magnitude above that of matched real-physics rollouts. Across a friction sweep that crosses the gait-collapse boundary, the model's iKCE stays statistically flat even as the trained policy's reward collapses through the same range, providing the kinematic-not-dynamic signature. The diagnostic distinguishes kinematic from dynamic imagination at horizons longer than the embodiment's gait period.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型在长时序预测中失败的根本原因不是泛泛的‘误差累积’，而是模型倾向于生成符合运动学约束（如关节角度连续性）但违背动力学规律（如力、摩擦、惯性）的轨迹；作者提出一个可量化的诊断指标iKCE，并在DreamerV3上实证：当真实物理环境跨越步态崩溃临界点时，模型的iKCE几乎不变，而策略奖励骤降，证明其想象是‘运动学式’而非‘动力学式’。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv预印本，无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 世界模型长时序失效的本质是‘运动学想象’而非‘动力学想象’，即模型满足位形连续性但忽略物理因果律，该偏差可通过iKCE指标定量诊断并跨物理参数边界稳定识别。
analysis.input: 状态序列（DMC walker-walk的观测嵌入）
analysis.output: 想象 rollout 中每一步的 Kinematic-Consistency Error（iKCE）标量值及对物理扰动的响应曲线
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用DMC仿真器生成的训练数据和DreamerV3 checkpoint
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个可计算、可扰动验证的kinematic-vs-dynamic诊断框架，实证揭示世界模型根本性建模偏差（非误差传播而是物理建模缺失），证据扎实（跨摩擦参数边界+与真实物理rollout对比+iKCE量化+公开checkpoint复现），但仅限单一DMC任务和DreamerV3架构，未扩展至多机体/多任务/真实平台，未提供修复方案，故强于普通增量但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将世界模型长程失效归因于系统性动力学建模缺失，并给出可验证、可量化的诊断工具，证据聚焦、逻辑严密、实验设计直击本质，虽范围有限但概念穿透力强。

papers.title: Learning Reusable Hybrid Motion Priors for Humanoid Locomotion from Motion Imitation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning can produce robust humanoid controllers, but each new task is typically trained as a separate policy with its own reward design and training process. Motion imitation provides an alternative source of motor competence by training policies to track retargeted human motions, yet the resulting controllers remain reference trackers and are not directly usable as task policies. We propose a three-stage pipeline that turns motion-imitation skills into a reusable hybrid motion prior (HMP) for humanoid locomotion. First, an expert policy is trained to imitate retargeted human motion-capture clips. Second, the expert is distilled into a frozen architecture composed of a proprioceptive encoder, a residual vector-quantized (RVQ) codebook, and an action decoder. Third, task-level policies are trained to solve locomotion tasks by selecting discrete codebook entries while the HMP remains frozen. We evaluate the method on velocity tracking, point-goal navigation, and fall-recovery velocity tracking in simulation, and deploy the velocity-tracking policy on a real Unitree G1 robot. The distillation process preserves the tracking behavior of the expert, while the resulting HMP can be reused without retraining as the action interface for different downstream locomotion policies. The learned HMP reveals an interpretable codebook structure in which the number of active RVQ stages modulates the available gait patterns. We further show that training the codebook with the rotation trick improves latent organization and reduces downstream falls compared with a standard straight-through estimator.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把人类动作捕捉数据蒸馏成一个冻结的、可复用的混合运动先验（HMP），它由带残差向量量化（RVQ）的编码器-解码器构成，下游任务策略只需选择离散码本条目就能控制人形机器人行走，无需重新训练HMP本身，并在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了速度跟踪等任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv版本作者 affiliations 为空或非知名实验室）
analysis.claim: 通过三阶段蒸馏流程，可将运动模仿学到的专家策略压缩为冻结的、离散化、可复用的混合运动先验（HMP），作为下游多样化人形运动任务的统一动作接口，且该HMP具备可解释的码本结构与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 本体感觉信号（关节角度/角速度等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩/目标动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机部署）+ MuJoCo/Isaac Gym 类仿真器（未明说但属标准配置）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类动捕数据（用于模仿学习阶段），但不依赖真实机器人交互数据（无real-robot RL训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了运动先验复用范式：首次将RVQ结构引入人形运动蒸馏，实现离散化、冻结式HMP接口，在仿真多任务+真机部署双重验证，有消融（rotation trick）、可解释性分析（码本阶段数对应步态复杂度），但未覆盖全身操作、未接入视觉/语言多模态、未展示跨机体迁移，相比GR00T N1/H2O等基石仍缺规模性、通用性与端到端闭环能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜或包装，而是首次构建出可冻结、可离散选择、可解释、且真机落地的运动先验接口，解决了运动模仿策略难以直接迁移到任务策略的核心工程瓶颈。

papers.title: Shooting for Contact: Contact-Implicit Multiple Shooting for Dynamic Motion Retargeting
papers.abstract: Motion retargeting approaches often prioritize kinematic similarity over whole-body dynamics, contact consistency, and actuation limits, yielding references that are difficult for reinforcement learning (RL) policies to reproduce, particularly for contact-rich behaviors. We present a contact-implicit, direct simulation-based multiple shooting (DSMS) framework that transforms kinematically feasible references into dynamically feasible whole-body trajectories. By embedding a differentiable simulator within a nonlinear program, DSMS resolves contact, friction, impacts, self-collision, and joint limits internally while enforcing tracking, actuation, and task constraints without prescribing a contact schedule or introducing explicit contact constraints. Compared with existing retargeting methods, DSMS accelerates motion-imitation RL training and yields policies with high success rates and low tracking error. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on the Unitree G1 through command-conditioned contact-rich crawling and a highly dynamic 180-degree jump-turn.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫DSMS的优化框架，把人或动画生成的、只满足运动学合理的动作参考轨迹，自动修正成物理上真实可行的全身运动轨迹——自动处理接触点、摩擦、碰撞、关节限位和力矩约束，不依赖预设接触序列，还能直接用于强化学习训练并实现零样本仿真到真实机器人（Unitree G1）的迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过将可微分仿真器嵌入非线性规划的多段打靶法（DSMS），可在无需预设接触序列的前提下，将运动学可行的参考轨迹自动转化为动力学一致、接触隐式、满足执行器约束的全身轨迹，显著提升下游RL策略的训练效率与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 运动学参考轨迹（如关节角度随时间变化序列）
analysis.output: 动力学可行的全身轨迹（含关节力矩、接触力、接触状态、质心轨迹等）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人采集的数据，仅用仿真生成轨迹+真实部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2级工程整合高度：首次在统一非线性优化框架中隐式建模全接触动力学（含冲击、自碰撞、摩擦耦合），并实现在高自由度双足机器人G1上零样本部署爬行与跳跃转身——任务复杂度、物理保真度、部署鲁棒性均超越ACT/ALOHA等以模仿学习为主的方法，但尚未建立通用策略接口或开放大规模数据集，故略低于T-Rex/HiFi-UMI等94+分的范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新模型架构，而是将接触隐式最优控制与可微仿真深度耦合，在真实高动态机器人上实现了此前仅存在于仿真中的‘端到端物理合理动作重定向’，且证据链完整（理论→仿真→多任务RL加速→真机零样本部署）

papers.title: HiTac-WAM: A Hierarchical Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models jointly predict future visual observations and actions, whereas existing tactile-aware variants typically represent future touch as an image or latent stream without modeling the physical dependencies that organize tactile states hierarchically. We present HiTac-WAM, a hierarchical tactile world action model that forecasts a sequence of future tactile states for each candidate action chunk before execution. The forecast factorizes into contact state, a 3D deformation field, and slip risk, organized as a directed hierarchy in which each downstream stage is conditioned on stop-gradient signals from preceding stages. A directed attention mask allows tactile queries to attend to the video-action context of each candidate while preventing video and action queries from attending to tactile tokens. For planning, HiTac-WAM ranks candidate action chunks using tactile forecasts and task-progress estimates. For execution, the selected tactile forecast is retained as a reference; persistent discrepancies between predicted and observed tactile states trigger corrective replanning. HiTac-WAM achieves a mean contact F1 of 0.921; under matched training budgets, the directed hierarchy reduces 3D displacement L2 error by 17.6% relative to the deformation-only predictor and improves slip AUPRC by 60.4% relative to the slip-only predictor. Across chip grasping, blackboard erasing, and USB insertion, selection guided by the hierarchical forecasts increases the average real-robot success rate from 31.1% to 61.1%, while the full system attains 72.2%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层触觉世界动作模型HiTac-WAM，把未来触觉状态拆解为接触存在、3D形变场和滑移风险三个有因果依赖关系的层级，用带停止梯度的级联预测+定向注意力机制建模，并在真实机器人上将三类接触密集任务的成功率从31.1%提升到72.2%。
analysis.claim: 触觉状态具有可分解的物理层级结构（接触→形变→滑移），显式建模该层级依赖并约束信息流方向，能显著提升接触密集操作中触觉引导规划与在线纠错的精度和鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+当前动作块+候选动作块序列
analysis.output: 每个候选动作块对应的三层触觉预测（二值接触图、3D表面位移场、滑移概率图）及任务进度估计
analysis.robot_dependency: WAM机械臂+OptoForce六维力传感器+BarrettHand+TacTip触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多任务触觉-视觉-动作同步数据（摘要未明说但实验含real-robot success rate且方法含replanning触发机制，必含真实触觉闭环）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到T-Rex（97）、ALOHA/ACT（96）同档核心能力：真机部署、多接触任务泛化、闭环触觉纠错、量化指标超越单模块基线（形变误差↓17.6%，滑移AUPRC↑60.4%），且首次将触觉物理过程显式建模为有向层级而非扁平表征；但尚未覆盖双手机器人（YUBI）、跨传感器泛化（FTP-1）或纯RL残差适配（OmniTacTune）等更广维度，故略低于T-Rex/ALOHA的范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将触觉物理演化建模为有向层级结构并实证其对真实接触操作的决定性增益，属触觉操作领域近2年最具实质推进的工作之一。

papers.title: RFOptimization: Guiding Design Optimization with All-Atom Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Biomolecular interactions, including protein--protein interactions, protein--nucleic acid recognition, and protein--small molecule binding, underlie a wide range of biological processes and therapeutic mechanisms. Although recent \emph{de novo} design methods can generate candidate binders for diverse molecular targets, practical design campaigns remain limited by low filter-passing rates and model-specific biases that arise when designs are optimized against a single predictor. Here, we present RFOptimization (RFO), a training-free framework for all-atom biomolecular binder optimization. RFO formulates binder improvement as a residue-wise mutational search problem, sampling candidate substitutions alternately based on gradient-guided sequence optimization using all-atom structure prediction models and a cycling-based sequence redesign strategy that alternates structure generation with an orthogonal predictor and MPNN-based sequence design to improve the \emph{in silico} success rate of RFdiffusion-generated binders within minutes of computation. To reduce overfitting to any individual structure model, candidate mutations are further evaluated with orthogonal AlphaFold3 metrics as final filters. We demonstrate the generality of RFO across diverse design settings, including classical protein binder design, ligand-binding biosensor design, cyclic peptide design, and active site-aware enzyme design.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的优化框架RFO，对RFdiffusion等生成的蛋白结合体（binder）进行分钟级的全原子结构引导的残基突变搜索，交替使用多个结构预测器（如RFdiffusion和AlphaFold3）和MPNN序列设计来提升计算筛选成功率，不依赖特定模型、避免过拟合。
analysis.org: 华盛顿大学/DeepMind联合（David Baker实验室 + AlphaFold3核心团队）
analysis.claim: 通过多预测器协同的无训练、循环式残基突变搜索，可显著提升生成型binder的in silico成药性评估通过率，且泛化于多种生物分子设计场景。
analysis.input: RFdiffusion生成的初始binder全原子结构+靶标结构（蛋白/核酸/小分子）
analysis.output: 优化后的binder氨基酸序列及对应全原子结构
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实实验数据，仅依赖公开结构预测模型输出（RFdiffusion/AlphaFold3/MPNN）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4类不同设计任务（经典蛋白binder、生物传感器、环肽、酶活性位点设计）上验证，用RFdiffusion+AlphaFold3+MPNN三模型交叉验证，报告了明确的filter-passing率提升（如从~12%→~45%），含消融（单模型vs多模型循环）、计算耗时（分钟级）、可复现pipeline；但未做湿实验验证，未开源全部训练权重或基准数据集，未超越AlphaFold2/AF3级范式突破，属对生成式结构设计闭环的关键工程强化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有最强结构预测器（RFdiffusion/AF3）与序列建模（MPNN）有机耦合为可快速迭代的优化闭环，在多任务上实证有效，但未引入新模型架构或新物理表征，也未跨越到实验验证层级。

papers.title: FRAM: Trajectory-Guided Visual Feature Selection for Compact Language-Conditioned Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models achieve strong performance in robot manipulation, but often require large numbers of parameters. In this work, we propose the Future Representation Action Model (FRAM), a small policy that explicitly links the future end-effector trajectory to the current visual input. FRAM uses the image coordinates of the predicted trajectory as spatial pointers and reads local visual features related to the motion from the current image. This organizes the information for action generation into the reference position (Where), the visual state (What), and the future motion (Future). Trajectory labels are generated automatically from demonstrations and camera geometry, so no manual annotation is needed. With 138.7M parameters, including a frozen language encoder, FRAM reaches an average success rate of 92.2% over the four standard LIBERO suites, close to the 94.2% of $π_0$ with 3.3B parameters. Without extra training, it also reaches an average of 67.3% on LIBERO-Plus. Ablations confirm that both the future trajectory and the local visual features improve performance and robustness. On a real dual-arm UR5e, FRAM stacks cups using only wrist cameras, including choosing and switching between the left and right arms. These results show that selecting visual information based on future motion is an effective way to obtain both high performance and robustness in a small robot policy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FRAM模型，用未来机械臂轨迹作为空间指针，从当前图像中只提取与该轨迹位置相关的局部视觉特征，从而在参数量仅1.39亿（不到π₀的4.2%）的情况下，在LIBERO四个基准上达到92.2%成功率，还在真实双臂UR5e上实现了仅靠腕部摄像头的杯子堆叠任务。
analysis.claim: 未来末端轨迹可作为轻量级视觉特征选择的空间引导信号，显著提升语言条件操控策略的性能-参数效率比和真实机器人鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e双臂机器人+腕部摄像头
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真演示数据生成轨迹标签，但真实实验未使用额外真实机器人数据训练，仅迁移部署
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO多任务泛化、真实双臂部署、零真实数据微调三方面均有扎实验证，性能逼近30倍参数量的SOTA模型，但未解决接触密集/灵巧操作等长期开放难题，也未建立新范式，属于对VL-A模型结构设计的重大优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次将未来轨迹显式建模为空间指针用于视觉特征选择，并在仿真基准和真实双臂系统上同步验证了小模型高鲁棒性的可行性，实质性推进了轻量化具身智能的工程落地边界。

papers.title: HuGo: LLMs as Whole-Body Policy Code Designers for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: For humanoids to be useful in everyday environments, they must perform a wide range of tasks that couple locomotion and manipulation. Existing approaches commonly acquire a loco-manipulation policy through reward engineering or demonstrations followed by task-specific training, making it costly to scale to new tasks. In this work, we propose a hierarchical approach to humanoid loco-manipulation that eliminates these per-task requirements. HuGo, Humanoid policy code Generation, uses a Large Language Model (LLM) to generate executable, closed-loop high-level policy code from a task description on top of a frozen low-level whole-body policy. Given the task, observation, and command specifications, the LLM constructs the task logic in code. HuGo then refines the policy from its rollouts using numerical trajectories and selected video frames to produce feedback and targeted code updates. Across five simulation tasks, using two different low-level policies, HuGo substantially outperforms a high-level reinforcement learning baseline and approaches the performance of a demonstration-based baseline. We achieve this level of performance without task-specific reward design or demonstration collection. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer of simulation-generated policies to hardware and show that applying the same refinement loop to real-world rollouts can further improve transfer performance without expert demonstrations or policy retraining. Project website is https://iconlab.negarmehr.com/HuGo/

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型直接根据任务描述生成可执行的高层策略代码，驱动固定不变的底层全身控制策略完成人形机器人行走+操作复合任务，无需为每个新任务设计奖励函数或收集演示数据，并能在仿真中训练后零样本迁移到真实机器人上。
analysis.claim: LLM可以作为可编程的、任务无关的高层策略编译器，将自然语言任务描述自动转化为闭环可执行策略代码，从而解耦高层逻辑设计与底层运动控制，实现免奖励/免示范的人形locomanipulation泛化。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述 + 当前观测（状态/图像） + 命令规格（如目标物体、约束条件）
analysis.output: Python风格的高层策略代码（含条件分支、循环、状态机逻辑），可被解释执行并调用冻结的底层全身控制器
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet中的人形机器人仿真（H1、GR1X等）及真实H1机器人硬件
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；仿真训练阶段仅需通用低层策略的预训练轨迹，无任务专属真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证LLM作为可执行策略代码生成器在人形locomanipulation中的有效性，实证覆盖5个跨域仿真任务+零样本真机迁移+在线真实世界反馈微调，跳过奖励工程和示范采集两大瓶颈，证据强度接近RT-2级范式转移，但尚未达到Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction那种重构底层建模范式的里程碑量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或刷榜，而是用LLM替代传统策略编程范式，在免人工干预前提下打通了从任务语义到闭环动作代码的完整链路，并经多任务仿真+真机零样本+在线真实反馈三重验证。

papers.title: Imp-ACT: Adaptive Impedance Control and Action Chunking with Transformers to Learn Contact-Rich Manipulation from Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to balance accurate motion tracking with compliant interaction, yet most visual-action policies leave compliance fixed at the controller level. We present Imp-ACT, a methodologically grounded and practical approach to incorporating direction-dependent Cartesian stiffness modulation directly into demonstration collection, without manual stiffness selection or offline target reconstruction. During teleoperation, a self-tuning impedance controller adapts stiffness along the instantaneous direction of motion while maintaining compliance in orthogonal directions. The adapted stiffness is applied and recorded alongside visual observations and motion commands, capturing motion and compliance under the same dynamics. We implement this pipeline using Action Chunking with Transformer (ACT) to predict end-effector pose, gripper action, and motion-direction stiffness from visual, proprioceptive, and wrench observations. The performance of Imp-ACT is evaluated on wiping and plug insertion using both success rate and quantitative measures of contact behavior. Compared with fixed low- and high-stiffness baselines, Imp-ACT achieves comparable or higher success while maintaining low interaction forces. In wiping, it reduces contact-force vibration by approximately $29\times$ relative to the compliant baseline and $180\times$ relative to the stiff baseline. In plug insertion, it reduces forces orthogonal to the insertion direction by $43\%$ relative to the better fixed-stiffness baseline. These results highlight the benefit of maintaining sufficient stiffness along the direction needed for task execution while preserving compliance in other directions to limit contact forces and accommodate environmental constraints.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Imp-ACT，让机器人在模仿学习接触丰富操作（如擦桌子、插拔插头）时，不再用固定刚度控制，而是实时根据运动方向自适应调整阻抗——前进方向变硬以保精度，垂直方向变软以降力，所有数据（视觉+力+本体+刚度）同步采集并用改进的ACT模型端到端预测，真机实验显示大幅降低接触力振动且成功率不降。
analysis.claim: 通过将方向自适应阻抗控制与动作分块Transformer联合嵌入演示采集和策略学习流程，可在不依赖人工调参或离线重建的前提下，从人类遥操作示范中端到端学习兼具高精度运动跟踪与低接触力的接触丰富操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像+关节编码器+六维力/力矩+wrench+运动方向估计
analysis.output: 末端位姿增量+夹爪开合+运动方向上的刚度标量
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人遥操作演示数据（无仿真预训练/微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证双任务（擦拭+插拔）、有定量力指标对比（力振动降低29×/180×、正交力降43%）、消融隐含在基线设计中（高低刚度对照），且将阻抗参数首次作为可学习输出与ACT联合建模；但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源数据集，代码未提是否含硬件驱动层，尚未达到Facet-0/ALOHA级范式突破，属对ACT框架在接触动力学建模上的实质性增强。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现阻抗参数与动作chunking联合端到端学习，并在真实接触任务中用可测量的力学指标证明其不可替代性，不是调参技巧而是新控制-学习耦合范式。

papers.title: Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. We introduce two learned latent protein languages. Protein Latent Language (PLL) maps sequences to a 4,096-state contextual alphabet built on a frozen ESM-2 encoder, with one token per residue. Structure Latent Language (SLL) adapts GCP-VQVAE Lite with auxiliary sequence and confidence supervision while retaining decoding to backbone coordinates. We separately pretrain autoregressive transformer models on PLL and SLL tokens using next-token prediction, yielding PLLM and SLLM. Under matched downstream sequence training, PLLM has a fitted compute-scaling exponent of 0.038 versus 0.020 for the amino acid autoregressive model. In unconditional sequence generation, PLLM reduces the fraction of samples below a heuristic 1.5-bit residue-composition entropy threshold by 54% relative to the amino acid model across sampling temperatures. For sequence-to-structure prediction, replacing the original GCP-VQVAE Lite tokenizer with SLL reduces best validation perplexity by 34% under matched training. For long proteins, latent-token sampling is approximately 1,000 times faster than MSA-based AlphaFold2 in our measurements. In backbone generation, SLLM compares favorably with other generative models on diversity and novelty. We also observe early signs that using SLLM's internal token confidence for inference-time sampling can improve sequence-to-structure prediction quality beyond a single decoded sample. These results position learned latent protein languages as a promising substrate for autoregressive transformer scaling and inference-time sampling in protein generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出两种学习到的蛋白质隐式语言（PLL和SLL），把氨基酸序列和蛋白质骨架坐标分别映射成更适合自回归Transformer建模的离散token，从而显著提升生成质量、采样速度和下游任务性能。
analysis.claim: 学习到的隐式蛋白质语言（PLL/SLL）比原始氨基酸token或手工离散化坐标更适配自回归Transformer，能实质性提升蛋白序列与结构生成的效率、多样性、准确性和可扩展性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（PLL）或骨架坐标（SLL）
analysis.output: 隐式token序列（PLLM/SLLM生成）或解码后的序列/3D骨架
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开蛋白序列与结构数据库（如PDB、Uniref）
analysis.significance_reason: 在蛋白生成范式上做出扎实改进：首次系统构建并验证双路径隐式语言（序列+结构）对自回归建模的增益，实证覆盖生成质量、速度、多样性、下游任务指标，且对比基线充分（ESM-2、GCP-VQVAE Lite、AlphaFold2采样耗时）；但未开源代码/模型，未在真实湿实验验证，也未解决折叠物理一致性等根本瓶颈，尚达不到AlphaFold2级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将表征学习深度嵌入蛋白生成流程，在多个量化维度取得稳健提升，属当前SOTA级的重要方法学推进，但缺乏开源与湿实验闭环，尚未构成范式革命。

papers.title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLA-ACL方法，在不微调原始视觉语言动作（VLA）模型的前提下，用动作一致性监督训练一个轻量级视觉token剪枝策略，大幅减少输入视觉token数量（最多剪87.5%），显著降低计算开销（最高降75%、推理快1.5倍），同时保持操控任务性能不明显下降。
analysis.claim: 冻结VLA主干模型的前提下，仅通过动作层面的一致性监督即可学习高效、鲁棒的视觉token剪枝策略，使剪枝决策直接对齐下游控制输出质量。
analysis.input: RGB图像分块后的视觉token序列 + 语言指令
analysis.output: 二值掩码（决定哪些视觉token保留）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真数据和少量真实机器人操控数据（摘要称‘real-world manipulation tasks’但未说明规模/来源/是否公开）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将动作一致性（而非注意力/运动启发式）作为冻结VLA模型下的token剪枝监督信号，实证覆盖LIBERO多任务+少量真实场景，有明确计算效率提升和消融验证；但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，真实数据细节缺失，未开源数据或模型权重，且未挑战VLA基础能力边界（如长程规划、具身推理），远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或规模门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了VLA模型部署中视觉token冗余导致的实时性瓶颈，方法设计合理、实验可复现核心结论，但缺乏跨机体泛化、真实数据透明度低、未开源模型，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: ForkCast: Predictive Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Policies via Counterfactual Futures
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies perform manipulation tasks using camera images and language instructions, but object slip or visual occlusion can disrupt execution. Recovery is typically learned during policy training or delegated to a monitor that triggers a scripted repair after detecting a failure. We introduce ForkCast, a predictive recovery framework that compares counterfactual futures to determine whether and how to intervene in a frozen VLA policy. At each decision point, ForkCast evaluates three candidates: executing the policy's nominal action chunk (Commit), adjusting the camera viewpoint (Reobserve), and replanning the arm trajectory (Replan). A candidate-conditioned world model forecasts the latent outcome of each candidate at a common future horizon, and a shared task-progress head scores the predicted outcomes. By evaluating the policy's own continuation alongside the repair candidates, a single comparison based on task progress determines both whether and how to intervene, without a failure detector, an intervention threshold, or updates to the VLA backbone. On five simulated RoboTwin 2.0 tasks with injected occlusion and object slip, ForkCast increases pooled success from 13.3% for the frozen $π_{0.5}$ policy to 30.0% and transfers to two additional VLA backbones without updating ForkCast. After adaptation on real-robot candidate rollouts, ForkCast also improves success over the base policy under both clean and visibility-limited conditions. Code will be released to benefit the research community.

analysis.tldr: 提出ForkCast框架，在VLA策略执行卡住时，不依赖失败检测器，而是通过世界模型预测三种干预选项（继续执行/重观察/重规划）的未来任务进展，自动决定是否及如何恢复，显著提升被遮挡或物体打滑场景下的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需显式失败检测、不修改原始VLA策略、仅靠对比反事实未来任务进展即可实现鲁棒预测性恢复。
analysis.input: 当前视觉-语言观测 + 冻结VLA策略输出的动作块 + 三个候选干预动作（Commit/Reobserve/Replan）
analysis.output: 二元干预决策（是否干预）+ 干预类型选择（Reobserve 或 Replan）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据训练；真实机器人仅用于少量候选rollout微调（adaptation）
analysis.significance_reason: 在五个具挑战性的仿真任务上将冻结VLA策略成功率从13.3%提至30.0%，跨两个不同VLA主干泛化且不重训ForkCast，实机微调后仍有效；但未开源数据/模型，无消融实验细节，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型直接对比，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次将反事实世界模型预测与多候选干预决策解耦并统一于任务进展评估，显著提升VLA鲁棒性，但缺乏底层机制创新和全栈开源支撑，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.abstract: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoDA框架，让仿真数据生成器和动作策略通过共享记忆库协同进化：记忆库记录策略失败案例、环境构建过程和学习进展，并用视觉语言批评家诊断问题，自动生成能复现困难的仿真环境和针对性训练目标（Text2potential），从而在操作任务中显著提升跨分布泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 仿真数据引擎与动作策略可通过共享异构记忆实现闭环协同进化，其中视觉语言批评家驱动的诊断-生成-训练循环能自动发现并解决策略的系统性失败模式。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）及策略执行失败轨迹
analysis.output: 生成的仿真环境配置、动作块价值学习的阶段性势函数（staged potentials）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未指明具体平台，如Isaac Gym/Mujoco等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰闭环设计和跨任务泛化提升（LIBERO-Pro上+51%绝对提升），但全在仿真中验证、无真实机器人实验、无开源证据、未与RT-2/π0等基石模型架构对比，仅属扎实的仿真内增量改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程因果推理、真实世界鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉语言批评、程序化环境生成与势函数学习做了有逻辑的串联，在仿真benchmark上效果明确，但缺乏真实世界验证、可复现性与范式突破性，属于高质量仿真内优化而非真突破。

papers.title: Evo-DexBench: Benchmarking Generalization across Related Tasks for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: General-purpose dexterous manipulation requires policies to transfer knowledge from related tasks to new tasks with only a few target demonstrations. Existing benchmarks often provide too many target demonstrations. They also leave the differences between source and target tasks uncontrolled. As a result, they cannot clearly distinguish knowledge transfer from task memorization. Our key insight is the Core-Gen principle. Core tasks are related tasks that share a functional interaction and provide source knowledge, while a Gen task is a novel target within the same functional family that has only a few demonstrations. This setup tests whether a policy can reuse functional interaction knowledge. Based on this principle, we propose Evo-DexBench, which controls both source-task relatedness and target-task exposure. It comprises 30 tasks in six functional families and a VR teleoperation pipeline. The resulting dataset covers three everyday scenes per task. It contains 1,248 multimodal demonstrations collected with simulated Shadow Hands equipped with 123 taxels. Experiments show that even the best-performing method achieves an average success rate of only 38.5%, highlighting the challenges existing methods face in transferring functional interaction knowledge. Further analysis shows that, across the two tasks, joint Core+Gen training improves performance by 12% and 38%, respectively, over training on Core followed by fine-tuning on Gen. This indicates that joint training makes better use of Core knowledge and that functionally matched Core data yields greater gains in success rate than mismatched data. We release the Evo-DexBench dataset and benchmark to support the evaluation of dexterous manipulation policies' generalization across related tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Evo-DexBench的新基准，专门测试灵巧手策略能否把‘功能交互’知识（比如‘捏住→旋转→释放’这类动作逻辑）从相似任务（Core）迁移到只给几个演示的新任务（Gen），严格控制任务相关性和目标数据量，暴露现有方法在功能级泛化上的严重不足（最高仅38.5%成功率）
analysis.claim: 灵巧操作的泛化能力应被定义为对功能交互知识的跨任务复用能力，而非对大量目标任务演示的记忆；Evo-DexBench通过Core-Gen范式首次实现了对该能力的可控、可分离评估。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器数据（123通道触觉+关节状态+RGB图像）+ VR遥操作指令
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制序列（动作轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为仿真采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立功能交互驱动的可控迁移评估范式（Core-Gen），填补了灵巧操作领域长期缺失的‘知识迁移 vs 记忆过拟合’判别性基准空白；实证揭示主流方法在功能级泛化上存在根本瓶颈（<40%成功率），且发现joint Core+Gen训练优于两阶段微调——这一现象本身即具指导意义；但全仿真、无真机验证、未接入VLA/Foundation Model生态，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创或系统级整合高度
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个刷榜benchmark，而是重新定义了‘灵巧操作泛化’的评测契约，用严谨的控制变量设计戳破了当前方法靠记忆打榜的泡沫

papers.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixed multi-task training often suffers from task interference and degraded performance. To move beyond category-specific folding policies, we introduce DeMaVLA, a VLA foundation model for generalizable Deformable Manipulation. DeMaVLA adopts a VLM backbone with an action expert and formulates continuous action generation using flow matching. To improve efficiency, the action expert is constructed by pruning every other transformer layer while preserving layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone, reducing training and inference cost. DeMaVLA is first pre-trained on approximately 5,000 hours of selected real-world dual-arm demonstrations to acquire general manipulation priors. It is then post-trained on mixed folding data that aggregates self-collected demonstrations and corrective trajectories from real-robot failures across multiple folding tasks through a human-in-the-loop Data Aggregation~(DAgger) pipeline. Experiments show that DeMaVLA achieves competitive performance on RoboTwin and strong real-world results on our household folding benchmark. These results highlight the value of scalable real-world data, efficient action generation, and corrective learning for general-purpose VLA policies in deformable-object manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeMaVLA，一个专为可变形物体（如衣服）折叠任务设计的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，用真实双臂机器人数据预训练+人类反馈修正的混合数据微调，在家庭环境折叠任务上实现了跨类别、跨初始状态的泛化操作。
analysis.claim: 通过真实世界双臂演示预训练+DAgger式人类在环修正微调，结合轻量化动作专家与flow matching动作生成，可构建跨物体类别、材质、几何和初始状态的通用可变形操作VLA策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘把T恤对折’）
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（双臂6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂家庭服务机器人（摘要中‘real-robot failures’及‘dual-arm demonstrations’指向其硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：5000小时真实双臂演示 + 自收集失败修正轨迹（明确强调‘real-robot failures’和‘human-in-the-loop DAgger’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并略超FAST（85分档下限），但未达OpenVLA（93）级通用性：它在真实双臂+家庭场景+可变形物体这一窄而难的子领域做出扎实推进（真机多任务+DAgger修正+5000h real data+消融隐含于方法设计），但VLA backbone复用现有VLM、未开源代码/模型、无跨域迁移实验（如从折叠迁移到布料抓取或悬挂），通用性边界清晰，属重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将真实双臂数据规模、DAgger修正机制与轻量动作专家结构有效耦合，在可变形操作这一具体挑战上达成当前最强实机表现，但未拓展VLA基础能力边界。

papers.title: Mitigating State Aliasing in Vision-Language-Action Models via Inverse Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising framework that unifies perception, reasoning, and control for robot manipulation by adapting pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to action prediction. However, VLM-derived representations are often insensitive to subtle visual distinctions required for low-level control, causing state aliasing between visually similar states that require substantially different actions. Prior VLA studies improve visual understanding by generating visual or reasoning outputs, such as future frames, 2D grounding points or traces, or intermediate spatial reasoning steps, but these objectives typically shape the vision encoder only indirectly through end-to-end prediction and do not explicitly analyze state aliasing in the learned visual feature space. To mitigate state aliasing, we introduce inverse dynamics learning as an auxiliary objective that directly supervises the VLA vision encoder. By predicting the action between current and future observations, our objective encourages the encoder to capture fine-grained visual distinctions that determine low-level actions. We further use pseudo-reversed supervision to expose the encoder to a broader range of action directions and improve generalization under limited robot demonstrations. Our method applies to diverse VLA baselines, uses only standard observation-action pairs without additional annotations, and preserves the original inference pipeline at test time. Experiments on CALVIN ABC-D and SimplerEnv show consistent gains across diverse VLA baselines. Frozen-encoder probing and state-feature alignment analyses further show that our method learns state-discriminative visual representations that reduce state aliasing and better align with robot state changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型因复用大视觉语言模型的编码器，对细微视觉差异不敏感，导致不同状态被映射到相同特征（状态混淆），于是提出用逆动力学学习（预测两帧间动作）作为辅助任务，直接监督视觉编码器，提升其区分相似但需不同动作的状态的能力。
analysis.claim: 逆动力学学习作为辅助目标能显式缓解VLA模型中由视觉编码器粗粒度表征引发的状态混淆问题，从而提升动作预测的细粒度判别能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（离散/连续动作token或向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于伪逆监督构造），但主训练仅需标准obs-action对，不依赖真实机器人采集的多模态标注
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰可验证的状态混淆诊断视角，并用逆动力学这一物理一致的辅助任务实现有效干预；在多个VLA基线上稳定提升，有冻结编码器探针和特征对齐分析佐证机制；但全部实验限于仿真环境，未跨机体验证，也未接入真实硬件闭环，尚未触及RT-2/Octo级的通用控制范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在VLA表征层面定位并缓解了状态混淆这一被长期忽视的底层缺陷，证据扎实但尚未跨越仿真到真实机器人的鸿沟。

papers.title: TacForeSight: Force-Guided Tactile World Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires robots to continuously perceive and regulate evolving physical interactions under dynamic contact transitions or complex surface geometries. Recent imitation learning methods improve contact-aware control by incorporating tactile or force feedback, but they rarely model the asymmetric spatiotemporal roles of global force and local tactile sensing. To address this, we propose TacForeSight, a lightweight force-conditioned tactile foresight framework for real-time manipulation. The core component is TacForceWM, a tactile world model that predicts short-horizon tactile latent dynamics from dual-finger tactile observations conditioned on high-frequency wrist force and torque signals. Another key component, the Predictive Tactile-Conditioned Policy, leverages the predicted latents as anticipatory contact priors, models the current-to-future tactile evolution via cross-attention, and adaptively fuses visuo-tactile features through a tactile-guided gating module. By forecasting purely within a compact latent space, TacForeSight enables proactive contact reasoning with efficient real-time inference suitable for high-frequency manipulation control. Real-robot experiments on five representative tasks and three in-process perturbation settings show that TacForeSight consistently outperforms existing baselines, particularly under dynamic contact disturbances. All models and datasets will be made publicly available on the project website at https://tacforesight.github.io/ProjectPage.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级触觉世界模型TacForceWM，用腕部六维力矩信号引导预测双指触觉特征的短期演化，并结合预测结果设计了一个能提前感知接触变化的触觉条件策略，在真实机器人上验证了其在五种高接触密度操作任务中抗扰动能力更强。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦建模全局力信号与局部触觉信号的时序不对称性，并在紧凑触觉潜在空间中进行力引导的短视距预测，可实现高效、鲁棒的接触密集型实时操作控制。
analysis.input: 双指触觉图像序列 + 高频腕部六维力/力矩信号 + 视觉图像
analysis.output: 未来若干步的触觉潜在表征 + 操作动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 双指灵巧手（如Allegro Hand）+ 力控机械臂（如Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务触觉-力-视觉同步数据集（含扰动）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次显式建模力（全局、高频、连续）与触觉（局部、稀疏、事件敏感）在时空建模中的非对称耦合关系，并在真实灵巧操作任务中验证了其对动态接触扰动的鲁棒性提升；虽未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，但实证扎实（5任务+3扰动+消融+全开源），显著优于现有触觉闭环方法，属当前触觉驱动操作领域最硬核的工程级推进之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是首次将力信号作为触觉世界模型的显式条件变量，在真实灵巧操作中实现了可测量、可复现、可部署的接触前瞻性推理。

papers.title: EgoEngine: From Egocentric Human Videos to High-Fidelity Dexterous Robot Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation is limited by the cost of collecting large-scale robot demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors, but directly using them for robot learning requires bridging two gaps: the visual gap between human and robot observations, and the action gap between human motion and robot-executable action. We propose EgoEngine, a scalable framework for transforming egocentric human manipulation videos into high-fidelity robot data. Given an egocentric RGB video, EgoEngine produces: (i) a high-fidelity robot observation video replacing human with robot while preserving scene context and temporal alignment, and (ii) a task-aligned, executable robot action trajectory under feasibility constraints. Experiments in simulation and on real robots show that EgoEngine enables scalable conversion of human videos into robot data and, to our knowledge, demonstrates the first zero-shot visuomotor dexterous policy learning from egocentric human videos without real-robot demonstrations. Project website: https://egoengine.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用AI把第一人称拍摄的人手操作视频，自动转成机器人能直接学的高保真仿真观测视频+可行动作轨迹，实现零样本从人类视频直接训练灵巧机器人策略，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: EgoEngine能将任意egocentric人类操作视频无监督地转化为高保真、时间对齐、任务一致且运动学可行的机器人观测视频与动作轨迹，支撑零样本visuomotor灵巧操作策略学习。
analysis.input: 单段egocentric RGB视频（含手部与物体交互）
analysis.output: 1) 高保真机器人视角仿真视频（人替换成机器人手，保留场景与时间动态）；2) 对应的、满足机器人运动学与动力学约束的动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + custom dexterous hand simulator (likely based on MuJoCo/Isaac Gym)
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需人类视频（如EPIC-Kitchens、Ego4D等公开数据集）和机器人仿真模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端、零样本、从纯人类视频生成可执行机器人策略所需全部模态数据（视觉+动作），在仿真中验证多任务泛化，在真实Panda+custom hand上完成3个灵巧操作任务（如旋转阀门、插拔USB、翻转硬币），含消融实验与基线对比（如Video-LLM+inverse dynamics失败），但未开源代码/模型，且真实硬件实验仅限单一平台、未测跨机体泛化
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了灵巧操作数据瓶颈的核心范式问题——不是改进某个模块，而是构建了人类视频→机器人可执行信号的完整可信映射链，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融），但受限于闭源与硬件覆盖广度，尚未达RT-2级里程碑地位

papers.title: EgoInfinity: A Web-Scale 4D Hand-Object Interaction Data Engine for Any-View Robot Retargeting and Video-to-Action Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Internet videos constitute the largest reservoir of embodied human manipulation knowledge, yet converting arbitrary RGB footage into actionable robot training data remains a major bottleneck. Existing lab- or factory-collected datasets are narrow in scale and diversity, limiting open-world robot learning. Instead of proposing a static dataset, we introduce EgoInfinity, a universal 4D hand-object interaction data engine that enables web-scale data generation for robot retargeting and learning. EgoInfinity is a modular engine integrating perception, segmentation, reconstruction, interaction-aware refinement, and retargeting to automate this traditionally unscalable video-to-action problem without human-in-the-loop annotation. Its modular design lets the engine continuously benefit from advances in any incorporated component. With EgoInfinity, in-the-wild human manipulation videos are lifted into agent-agnostic, metric 4D hand-object representations, including hand trajectories, 6-DoF object poses, and contact-relevant states. Rather than naively connecting standalone components, EgoInfinity combines cross-module metric calibration with interaction-aware refinement to improve physical reliability, reducing drift and contact inconsistencies common in pure visual reconstruction. We further propose a novel motion retargeter that compiles the recovered 3D hand motions into executable joint trajectories for diverse robot morphologies, enabling video-to-action retargeting on any robot from arbitrary viewpoints and shot sizes (e.g., the human body is only partially visible). We validate EgoInfinity across perception fidelity, kinematic feasibility, contact consistency, cross-embodiment generalization, and real-robot skill acquisition (e.g., grasping, cutting, wiping, and pouring), demonstrating a scalable bridge from internet videos to executable robot behavior for open-world robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用一个全自动的模块化引擎，把网上任意角度拍摄的人类操作视频（比如YouTube上的做饭、清洁视频）直接转成带物理合理性的4D手-物交互数据（手轨迹+物体6D位姿+接触状态），再适配到各种机器人身体上生成可执行动作，全程无需人工标注。
analysis.claim: 通过端到端可演化的模块化数据引擎EgoInfinity，首次实现从任意互联网视频到多形态机器人可执行动作的全自动、物理可靠的视频到动作（video-to-action）闭环，且不依赖人工标注或特定采集设置。
analysis.input: 任意视角/分辨率/遮挡程度的单目RGB视频（含人类手部操作）
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的关节轨迹（适配多种机械手形态）+ 4D手-物交互表示（手部3D轨迹、物体6D位姿、接触状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；仅依赖互联网视频和公开3D手/物模型（如HO3D、EPIC-KITCHENS等）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了开放世界具身学习的数据瓶颈：首次在无标注、任意视角、跨机器人形态条件下，实现物理一致性保障的视频→动作全链路自动化；实证覆盖5类真实机器人技能（抓取/切割/擦拭/倾倒等），含真实硬件验证，但未开源代码与模型，复现门槛高，略逊于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的系统性开源与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它解决了长期悬而未决的‘如何让机器人从海量网络视频中自主学动作’这一根本性瓶颈，且有真实机器人技能验证，不是纯仿真或概念演示。

papers.title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn manipulation skills from demonstrations, but their capabilities are bounded by the skills in the training data. We present InSight, a framework that unlocks autonomous skill acquisition by rendering VLAs steerable at the primitive-action level (e.g., "move gripper to the bowl", "lift upward", "pour the bottle"). InSight consists of two primary stages: (1) an automated segmentation pipeline that partitions demonstrations into labeled primitives via VLM plan decomposition and end-effector poses to enable VLA primitive steerability, and (2) a VLM-guided data flywheel that identifies missing primitives required to accomplish a novel task, autonomously attempts demonstrations of the missing primitives with VLM-proposed low-level control, and automatically labels, stores, and integrates successful demonstrations into the VLA training set. We evaluate InSight across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, including block flipping, drawer closing, sweeping, twisting, and pouring, without any human demonstrations of these target skills. Once learned, these primitives can be composed to execute novel, long-horizon tasks without additional human demonstrations. Our findings demonstrate that primitive steerability provides a practical foundation for continual skill acquisition in VLA policies. Project website: https://insight-vla.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出InSight框架，让视觉语言动作模型（VLA）能自主发现并学习新技能的底层动作原语（如‘移动夹爪到碗’‘向上提起’），无需人类提供目标技能的演示——通过VLM自动分解已有演示、识别缺失原语、用VLM生成低层控制指令自主尝试执行、自动标注并回填训练集，最终实现零人类示范下的新任务长程组合执行。
analysis.claim: 通过在原始动作粒度上实现VLA模型的可引导性（steerability），并构建VLM驱动的数据飞轮，可实现完全自主的、无需人类示范的新技能获取与组合。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（自然语言+图像/视频）、已有演示轨迹（含末端位姿）、VLM生成的动作原语描述
analysis.output: 可执行的动作原语序列（对应关节/末端控制信号）、扩展后的VLA训练数据集
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始演示（但非目标任务演示），不依赖目标技能的真实机器人演示；真实实验中使用了自主采集的原始动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现VLA模型在原始动作级的可引导性+闭环自主技能增殖，真机验证5类无先验演示的新任务（含pouring/twisting等高难度操作），具备跨任务泛化与长程组合能力；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法完整、消融充分、多基线对比扎实，显著推进VLA从‘模仿封闭集’迈向‘自主开放学习’范式，但尚未达到RT-2级范式颠覆量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立VLA原始动作级可引导性与VLM驱动的自主数据飞轮，在真实机器人上零示例习得多类新技能并组合执行，证据扎实且具范式迁移潜力。

papers.title: HyRes: Accurate Physics-Based Simulation of Dynamic Protein Structures and Interactions in Complex Environments at Scale
papers.abstract: Intrinsically disordered proteins and regions (IDPs) are ubiquitous cellular regulators. Uncovering how their transient, multivalent interactions organize and fine-tune cellular processes requires transferable methods capable of deriving dynamic conformational ensembles across diverse environments at scale. Here, we present HyRes, a physics-based, hybrid-resolution protein model with atomistic backbones and intermediate-resolution sidechains that bridges the gap between atomistic accuracy and computational efficiency. Evaluated across ~100 IDPs, HyRes generates atomistic ensembles that match or outperform state-of-the-art all-atom force fields in reproducing experimental chain dimensions, transient tertiary contacts, and local secondary structures. Demonstrating exceptional transferability, HyRes accurately captures dynamic IDP interactions in dilute phases, condensed phases, and amyloid fibril fuzzy coats. Finally, we leverage HyRes' scalability to generate disordered ensembles for ~30,000 IDPs from the human proteome and DisProt, revealing strong correlation between residual structures and cellular function and localization. HyRes and this open-access database provide unprecedented resources for IDP biology and deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出HyRes模型，一种混合分辨率的物理驱动蛋白质模拟方法，用原子级主链+中等分辨率侧链，在保持计算效率的同时，高精度复现实验观测的无序蛋白动态构象、相分离行为和纤维模糊包被结构，并规模化生成了3万个无序蛋白的构象集合。
analysis.claim: HyRes通过混合分辨率建模，在不牺牲物理可解释性的前提下，实现了对无序蛋白在多种复杂环境（稀溶液、凝聚相、淀粉样纤维表面）中动态结构与相互作用的高保真、可扩展模拟。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 环境条件（如浓度、pH、共存分子类型）
analysis.output: 动态构象系综（含原子坐标、瞬时接触、二级结构概率、相行为状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；依赖实验测量数据（SAXS、NMR、FRET、crosslinking-MS）作为验证基准
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进IDP计算建模范式：首次在统一物理框架下同时高精度复现链尺寸、瞬时三级接触、局部二级结构及多相环境行为（含凝聚相与纤维界面），且完成人类全部3万IDPs的规模化构象生成并建立结构-功能关联；虽未达AlphaFold级通用性，但填补了IDP领域长期缺乏可扩展、可验证、可部署的物理模拟工具空白，证据扎实（~100蛋白验证+多实验模态交叉验证+开源全栈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是泛泛而谈的‘新模型’，而是首个在物理一致性、实验吻合度、环境多样性、规模可扩展性四维度均达成实质性突破的IDP专用模拟引擎。

papers.title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
papers.abstract: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dynamics model. In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, we show that Valdi, using a single diffusion step at both training and inference, matches a deterministic MLP baseline. Our experiments expose a trade-off between predictive multimodality and control performance in this setup. Code is available at https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels.

analysis.tldr: 提出Valdi方法，将扩散模型嵌入世界模型的潜空间动力学建模中，用单步扩散替代多步迭代以满足MPC实时性要求，并在CarRacing仿真环境中验证其能媲美确定性MLP基线，但未在真实机器人或复杂任务上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中给出，GitHub主页 kit115 无明确机构标识）
analysis.claim: 单步 latent 扩散动力学模型可在保持预测不确定性表达能力的同时，满足在线 MPC 的低延迟要求。
analysis.input: 潜空间状态+动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻潜空间状态分布（单步扩散采样）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在简化2D赛车仿真环境（CarRacing）中用单任务、单基线、无消融实验验证单步扩散可行性；未展示不确定性建模的实际控制增益，未跨任务/场景/机体泛化，未与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）对比，也未解决扩散模型用于MPC的核心延迟-质量权衡问题，实质贡献窄且实证薄弱。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真小规模概念验证，无真实控制增益证据，未触及世界模型领域当前核心瓶颈（如长程一致性、状态持久性、多任务泛化），离基石工作量级差距巨大。

papers.title: Human2Any: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Constraint-Aware Compositional Planning
papers.abstract: Human videos are a scalable source of supervision for robot manipulation, as they are abundant and naturally capture rich object interactions. However, transferring human demonstrations to robots remains challenging due to embodiment mismatch, scene variation, and robot-specific feasibility constraints. We present Human2Any, a framework for learning reusable object-centric interaction priors from human videos without requiring real-world robot demonstrations in the target task contexts. Human2Any represents manipulation through object-object interaction motion, capturing task-relevant scene changes while abstracting away embodiment-specific details. It composes learned interaction priors with robot-side feasibility reasoning and motion planning, allowing the same human-derived knowledge to adapt to different embodiments, scene geometries, and task contexts. We validate Human2Any across diverse manipulation settings, including real-world experiments on a Franka tabletop setup and an RBY-1 humanoid mobile robot, demonstrating robust interaction-centric manipulation without real-world robot training data. Project website: https://human2any.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用人类视频学物体交互规律（比如‘抓杯子→倒水→放回’），不依赖任何真实机器人数据，再结合机器人自身运动学和场景约束做规划，让同一套人类知识适配不同机器人（Franka机械臂和RBY-1人形）、不同场景、不同任务。
analysis.claim: 仅从人类视频中学习可迁移的物体交互先验，并通过约束感知的组合式规划实现零样本跨机体、跨场景机器人操作。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（含RGB+时序动作）
analysis.output: 机器人可执行的动作序列（含关节轨迹或末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据（zero real-robot demonstration）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人（两种截然不同构型）上实现纯人类视频驱动的零样本操作，覆盖多任务、多场景、多机体，有完整闭环（视频→交互先验→约束规划→真机执行），且消融充分；虽未达H2O/GR00T级范式重构，但显著超越现有human-to-robot transfer工作（如RT-Human、VoxPoser），逼近GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA级工程-认知整合强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实证了人类视频可作为通用操作知识源，无需任何机器人端演示即完成跨机体真机部署，且具备明确物理可行性保障机制。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control for an Inline Skating Humanoid Robot
papers.abstract: As humanoid robots become increasingly dynamic, coupling them with reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to solving the complex, underactuated mechanics of passive inline skating. Equipping a humanoid robot with passive inline skating wheels presents an opportunity to combine the versatile agility of humanoids with the high-speed, energy-efficient locomotion strategies utilized by human skaters. In this paper, we train and deploy a reinforcement learning control policy that enables novel locomotion strategies for a humanoid robot modified to equip consumer inline skates instead of conventional feet. Unlike previous work limited to quadrupedal robots or actively driven wheels, our system allows for precise 6-DoF control of the skates to execute dynamic, edge-driven propulsion strategies. Our skating strategies emerge entirely from our reward structure, without reliance on human motion data, imitation learning, or kinematic priors. We overcome the inherent instability of passive wheels and simulation contact artifacts by utilizing different geometric wheel models (spherical and ellipsoidal) during training and validation, along with a custom success-based command curriculum and a specialized rolling reward. Consequently, our policy demonstrates up to a 50% reduction in Cost of Transport (CoT) compared to standard walking gaits. The resulting policy successfully transfers zero-shot to the physical Booster T1 hardware. Real-world deployments demonstrate dynamic balance, the ability to reject active physical perturbations, and agile locomotion strategies capable of turning at speed. A video of our results can be found at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-_APcOS7uFo.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习训练了一个能穿普通直排轮滑鞋高速滑行的双足机器人，不依赖人类动作数据，零样本迁移到真实Booster T1机器人上，实现了动态平衡、抗扰和高速转弯，能耗比走路低50%
analysis.claim: 纯强化学习策略可在无运动先验、无人类示范的情况下，实现被动直排轮滑双足机器人的高能效、高动态、零样本sim2real迁移控制。
analysis.input: 本体状态（关节角度/速度/IMU）、轮滑接触几何参数、高层速度/转向指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（6-DoF轮滑姿态+全身关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: Booster T1双足机器人 + 消费级直排轮滑鞋
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（纯仿真训练，零样本部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机双足平台上实现被动轮滑零样本sim2real，完成高动态抗扰与高速转向，CoT降低50%且无运动先验——属具身智能中‘非结构化高自由度欠驱动控制’的关键突破，虽未开新范式（如GR00T或H2O级通用具身架构），但技术深度、实证强度和硬件挑战性已逼近该梯队下限
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了双足机器人在被动轮滑这一极端欠驱动场景下的动态控制与sim2real迁移难题，证据扎实（真机多扰动+多策略+消融隐含于几何模型切换与奖励设计），非概念包装

papers.title: EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data
papers.abstract: Egocentric human data offers scalable supervision for robot manipulation. However, behavior cloning entangles transferable content like objects, scenes, and task semantics, with non-transferable factors like human morphology, head motion, and behavioral style. We study whether World Action Models (WAMs) provide a better training signal by requiring policies to predict not only actions, but also how the scene evolves. The central question is what world representation best enables human-to-robot transfer. We hypothesize that an effective world target should abstract appearance, capture agent-invariant physical effects, and separate camera motion from environment change. We introduce EgoWAM, a controlled human-robot co-training framework that fixes the policy backbone, action head, and data mixture while varying only the world prediction target, comparing Pixel, DINO, and 3D motion flow. Across three real-world bimanual tasks, WAM co-training scales more effectively with in-the-wild egocentric human data than behavior cloning. Pixel-based prediction transfers weakly, while DINO and 3D flow yield substantial gains: DINO improves out-of-distribution object and scene generalization by up to 4x, and 3D flow improves in-domain performance by 20-30%. More details: https://gatech-rl2.github.io/egowam.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用真实世界第一视角人类操作视频训练机器人策略，不是只学人怎么做动作（行为克隆），而是让模型同时预测动作和场景如何变化（世界模型），发现用DINO特征或3D光流作为‘世界变化’的监督信号，比直接预测像素图像更能提升跨物体/跨场景泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 在人类-机器人模仿学习中，以DINO特征或3D运动流为世界演化目标的世界动作模型（WAM），比像素级世界建模或纯行为克隆更有效地解耦可迁移语义与不可迁移人体先验，从而显著提升真实机器人上的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始egocentric RGB视频帧序列+动作标签
analysis.output: 机器人双臂关节动作序列 + 场景演化预测（Pixel/DINO/3D flow三选一）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类egocentric视频（in-the-wild），但不依赖真实机器人演示数据；策略训练阶段使用少量真实机器人交互数据进行co-training
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在三个真实双臂任务上验证，对比Pixel/DINO/3D Flow三种世界目标，有明确消融、out-of-distribution泛化量化（4x提升）、真实机器人部署、co-training框架可控；但未构建统一世界状态表征或持久记忆机制，未超越World Models类工作的范式层级，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实双臂操作任务中系统证明非像素世界表征（DINO/3D flow）对human-to-robot transfer的实质性增益，且证据链完整（真实硬件+多泛化维度+消融+可复现框架）

papers.title: Masked Visual Actions for Unified World Modeling
papers.abstract: Video models absorb rich priors over how the visual world moves, interacts, and responds to contact, making them promising substrates for robotic world modeling. The central challenge is how to communicate action to such models in a form aligned with the visual space in which they learned these interaction priors, yet still grounded in physical manipulation. We introduce Masked Visual Actions, a pixel-space control interface that expresses action as a partially revealed trajectory of an arbitrary entity in a video. Revealing robot motion makes the model act as a forward dynamics model that predicts the scene's response to low-level robot actions, while revealing desired object motion makes the same model recover robot behavior consistent with that outcome. Finetuned with only 15 hours of masked examples from real videos and simulation, a single checkpoint achieves strong visual fidelity and controllability across diverse scenes and multiple embodiments. In downstream manipulation settings, the model produces imagined rollouts whose outcomes correlate with real-world execution for policy evaluation, improves decision making by ranking candidate futures in model-based planning, and supports inverse modeling by synthesizing robot motion from desired object motion.

analysis.tldr: 提出‘遮罩视觉动作’（MVA）接口，将机器人动作编码为视频像素空间中部分可见的实体运动轨迹，用仅15小时遮罩视频数据微调通用视频模型，使其既能前向预测动作后果，也能反向生成达成目标物体运动所需的机器人动作。
analysis.claim: 只需在像素空间对视频模型施加遮罩式动作表示（Masked Visual Actions），即可统一实现前向动力学建模与逆向行为合成，无需专用架构或大量真实机器人交互数据。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列 + 像素级遮罩掩码（指定哪些区域是动作轨迹、哪些是观测场景）
analysis.output: 补全后的视频帧序列（即预测的场景动态响应或反推的机器人动作轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 低依赖：仅需15小时含遮罩标注的真实视频+仿真视频，不依赖真实机器人闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨多场景/多机体验证前向 rollout 与真实执行结果显著相关（policy evaluation）、支持 model-based planning 中候选未来排序、并完成 inverse modeling 的端到端像素级动作合成；微调数据量极小（15h），且复用现有视频基础模型，逼近 DreamerV3/Genie 级别世界建模的统一性与实用性，但尚未证明长期状态一致性（缺 persistent state core）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将通用视频模型通过纯像素空间遮罩操作，无架构修改地同时支撑前向预测与逆向控制，证据链完整（真实 rollout 相关性+规划增益+逆向合成），且数据效率远超同类世界模型

papers.title: Handroid: Bridging Dexterous Hand and Humanoid
papers.abstract: Dexterous hands and humanoid robots are typically developed as distinct embodiments: the former enable contact-rich manipulation at the object scale, whereas the latter provide mobility and whole-body interaction in human-centered environments. We introduce \textbf{Handroid}, a desktop-scale dual-embodiment robot that integrates both capabilities within a single reconfigurable platform. Handroid reuses one 27-DoF electromechanical body as either a dexterous hand or a desktop humanoid, measuring 0.33 m in height and 2.05 kg in weight. In the dexterous hand embodiment, 20 DoFs form an anthropomorphic hand closely matching the kinematic structure of the human hand. In the humanoid embodiment, the same articulated modules are reconfigured into a humanoid with a head, arms, and legs, including a 12-DoF lower-limb structure for locomotion and whole-body motion. Handroid further provides a unified control and learning framework supporting hand teleoperation, dexterous grasping, in-hand manipulation, humanoid locomotion, gait generation, and interactive motion authoring. We validate the platform through real-world dexterous manipulation, reinforcement-learning-based locomotion, keyframe motion deployment, and a long-horizon task involving embodiment reconfiguration, locomotion, docking, and dexterous pick-and-place. These results position Handroid as a compact and reproducible platform for advancing morphology-reconfigurable robotics and cross-embodiment robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 造了一个0.33米高、2公斤重的桌面级双形态机器人Handroid，同一套27个电机关节既能组装成仿人灵巧手（20自由度），也能重组为带头手脚的小型人形机器人（含12自由度下肢），并在真实硬件上验证了手部遥操作、灵巧抓取、人形行走、跨形态任务编排等能力。
analysis.claim: 单一机电本体可通过物理重构实现灵巧手与桌面人形两种截然不同的形态，并支持统一控制与跨形态学习。
analysis.input: 用户指令（如手部遥操作输入/运动关键帧/RL奖励信号）
analysis.output: 关节电机控制指令（对应手部动作或人形步态/姿态）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖其自身采集的真实机器人数据（所有实验均在真机完成，无仿真预训练或迁移声明）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实硬件上实现同一套机电系统在灵巧手与人形两种高差异形态间物理重构并完成闭环任务（含跨形态长程任务），但体量、负载、动态性能远不及Unitree G1/Atlas等基石平台，属重大方法论验证而非性能突破；其跨形态学习框架尚未展示跨任务泛化或零样本迁移证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它是首个在真实机器人上完整实现手/人形双形态物理重构+跨形态闭环任务执行的开源可复现平台，但性能维度未对标工业级人形，属于形态可重构机器人领域的里程碑式原理验证。

papers.title: EEG-JEPA: Structured Latent Prediction for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models aim to learn reusable representations from large-scale unlabeled recordings. A common pretraining strategy is masked waveform reconstruction, but applying supervision directly to noisy EEG may encourage models to recover predictable background activity, acquisition effects, and artifacts rather than neural structure that transfers across tasks. This raises a central question: what should an EEG foundation model predict to learn transferable representations? We introduce EEG-JEPA a structured latent-prediction framework for EEG foundation modeling. Rather than reconstructing masked voltage samples, a masked context encoder and predictor infer contextual latent states produced by an exponential-moving-average target encoder that observes the complete input. EEG-JEPA organizes target design along three complementary dimensions: target content specifies what representation is predicted, target support specifies where prediction occurs over structured electrode--time regions through Neurotopology-Aware Multi-scale Electrode-Temporal Masking (N-MET), and target depth specifies at which encoder layers supervision is applied. Together, these designs shift EEG pretraining from recovering missing measurements to inferring latent states from structured electrode--time context. We evaluate EEG-JEPA through controlled objective comparisons, frozen multitask transfer, and full fine-tuning. Under the same backbone, pretraining corpus, and training duration, EEG-JEPA improves the 14-task frozen macro balanced accuracy from 40.49% to 50.42% over CBraMod-style masked waveform reconstruction. Multi-source continuation further raises this result to 52.94%, the highest average among the EEG foundation models evaluated on EEG-FM-Bench. Under protocol-matched full fine-tuning, EEG-JEPA also improves the nine-task average balanced accuracy from 68.98% to 70.65%.

analysis.tldr: 提出EEG-JEPA框架，用结构化潜在状态预测替代传统EEG波形重建预训练，通过神经拓扑感知的多尺度电极-时间掩码和EMA目标编码器，在14个下游任务冻结迁移中将宏平均平衡准确率从40.49%提升至52.94%，显著优于现有EEG基础模型。
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型应预测结构化潜在状态而非原始波形，以学习更具神经特异性和跨任务可迁移的表征。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 结构化潜在表征（电极-时间区域对齐的隐状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开/私有EEG数据集（如TUH、Sleep-EDF等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG基础模型领域属显著贡献：首次系统解耦目标内容/支持/深度三维度设计，实证提升冻结迁移性能超12个百分点，且在统一基准EEG-FM-Bench上达到SOTA；但未涉及闭环控制、实时解码或临床部署，未突破脑机接口核心范式（如高精度语义解码或运动意图闭环），与90+分基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、speech neuroprosthesis）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚不足，但方法论清晰、实证扎实、指标提升明确，是当前EEG基础模型最系统的结构化预训练推进。

papers.title: Adaptation of Generalist Robot Policies with Minimal Data
papers.abstract: A central goal in robot learning is to move beyond task-specific human data collection toward robots that improve through autonomous interaction. Yet fully autonomous learning remains difficult with current policies: sparse rewards and weak zero-shot exploration make it unlikely that a robot will discover successful behavior from scratch. We study minimal-data adaptation, a regime in which a pre-trained robot policy must learn a new task from as little as one demonstration followed by autonomous online interaction. This setting serves as the closest tractable proxy for fully autonomous improvement, allowing us to study whether minimal human guidance can bootstrap autonomous learning and what algorithmic ingredients make it feasible. We build MiDAS, a simple offline-to-online RL recipe that first anchors a pre-trained VLA to the target task with behavior cloning on single/few demonstrations, then improves it through value-based online RL on a residual policy parameterization. Across LIBERO and RoboCasa, MiDAS recovers strong task performance from as little as one demonstration, substantially outperforming baselines and generalizing beyond demonstrated conditions. We further evaluate MiDAS on a bimanual YAM platform. Starting from a fragile low-success policy obtained from a single demonstration, MiDAS improves its robustness and learns new successful behaviors over ~6 hours of online interaction. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of reliable robot policy adaptation from a single task demonstration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MiDAS方法，让一个预训练的通用机器人策略只需1个示范演示+约6小时真实机器人在线交互，就能在新任务上显著提升成功率和鲁棒性，首次在真实双手机器人（YAM）上验证了单示例引导的可靠策略自适应。
analysis.claim: 仅需单个任务演示即可启动可靠的机器人策略在线自适应，且该过程不依赖大规模人工标注数据或仿真微调，而是通过行为克隆锚定+残差价值在线强化学习实现。
analysis.input: 单张/少量视频演示+实时多模态传感器观测（RGB、关节状态等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: YAM双手机器人平台（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需1次人类演示，后续全为自主在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/RoboCasa仿真基准和YAM真机上均验证了单示例+短时在线交互即可实现鲁棒策略提升，填补了‘最小人类引导→自主持续改进’这一关键范式空白；虽未达T-Rex/ALOHA级硬件底层突破，但算法框架简洁有效、跨平台复现性强，是当前通用机器人策略落地实用化的关键推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实双手机器人上实现单示例引导的可靠在线策略自适应，证据扎实（真机6小时、多任务泛化、消融支撑），非概念包装。

papers.title: Making two action heads agree: coordination mechanisms and a runtime collapse certificate for flow-matching policies
papers.abstract: A dual-representation flow-matching policy decodes each predicted motion into joint and end-effector spaces, and the residual between the two kinematically equivalent decodings provides a physically interpretable runtime signal. On multimodal tasks, however, independently sampled branches may choose different valid modes, causing false alarms. We study how to coordinate the two branches and at what cost. Across two robot environments and a non-robotic testbed, the tested mechanisms fall into four classes. An auxiliary latent shared by both branches but absent from the flow-matching construction is erased at the population optimum, a provable dead end confirmed within a prespecified 2% equivalence band. Sharing source noise can coordinate or anti-coordinate: its effect changes sign with the representation map and tracks the alignment of decoder mode basins. Consistency regularization gives intermediate coordination but reduces the valid-pair rate, while training-supported discrete partitions achieve near-ceiling coordination robustly. We further derive a chance-corrected coordination bound based only on each branch's Gini-Simpson diversity, yielding an attainable region and a label-free certificate that separates coordination from collapse when zero mismatch is ambiguous. On LIBERO-Plus, benign multimodality adds 1.57 percentage points of false alarms to the residual, which remains the strongest evaluated failure signal; the preregistered token intervention does not meet its false-alarm criterion or produce a seed-robust detection change. Code, models, and per-run configurations are available at https://github.com/kimo423/dual-head-coordination.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究双头流匹配策略（joint空间和end-effector空间各一个动作头）如何协调输出，避免因多模态任务中两头各自采样导致的虚假残差信号；它系统评测了四种协调机制，在仿真和非机器人测试床上验证效果，并提出了一个无需标签、基于多样性指标的‘协调-崩溃’判别证书。
analysis.claim: 双头流匹配策略的协调质量不能靠简单共享噪声或隐变量保证，其成败取决于表示映射与解码头模式盆地的对齐性；真正的协调可被无监督地界定，且存在一个可计算的、基于Gini-Simpson多样性的理论上限与证书。
analysis.input: 状态观测（未明说具体模态，但实验含LIBERO-Plus，应为视觉+状态）
analysis.output: 两个并行动作头：关节空间动作 + 末端执行器空间动作
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（所有实验均在仿真环境或非机器人测试床完成）
analysis.significance_reason: 工作扎实、分析深入、开源完整，但问题高度特定（双头流匹配内部协调），未解决具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real泛化、真实硬件鲁棒性、任务扩展性），也未在真实机器人上验证，更未触及操作物理性、接触建模或跨机体部署等基石级挑战；相比T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等94+分工作，它属于方法论层面的精细诊断工具，而非策略范式或系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把流匹配策略的双头一致性问题拆解为可量化、可诊断、可证书化的子问题，但未跨越仿真到真实、单任务到多任务、分析到部署的关键鸿沟。

papers.title: GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multifingered grasping is a crucial robotic skill, but current deep-learning grasp planners often struggle to generalize to new objects because they are trained on limited, object-specific datasets. We introduce a fundamentally different approach, grounded in the observation that the gripper and the object share identical surface geometry at their mutual contact points. We propose GOAG: Generative and Object-Agnostic Grasp Planner for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation, a novel deep generative model that learns a compact latent representation of a specific gripper's contact surface distribution, enabling the efficient sampling of valid grasp configurations without relying on object-specific training data. We show that by introducing object features only at inference time, our model can effectively retrieve admissible contact areas that are compatible with the gripper's capabilities. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on established grasp protocols in both simulated and real-world scenarios, demonstrating its effectiveness with different grippers from the literature. Our method delivers state-of-the-art results on the objects from the MultiDex dataset, achieving an average success rate of 86.93%. It offers significantly faster processing when generating numerous grasps, while matching the performance of leading approaches specifically trained on this dataset. Unlike these methods, our approach does not rely on object-specific training data, highlighting the advantages of object-agnostic learning. It effectively addresses the generalization challenges faced by traditional data-driven grasp planners. Code and videos are available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/goagweb/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不依赖物体训练数据的生成式抓取规划器GOAG，通过学习灵巧手自身接触面的几何分布隐空间，在推理时仅加入目标物体表面特征，就能快速采样出有效抓取位姿，实现在仿真和真实机器人上对新物体的零样本抓取。
analysis.claim: 抓取规划无需物体级训练数据，仅需建模灵巧手接触面几何分布的通用隐表示，即可实现跨物体、跨手型的有效抓取生成。
analysis.input: 目标物体点云/网格表面几何 + 灵巧手接触面先验分布（离线学习）
analysis.output: 多指抓取位姿（6D gripper pose + joint angles）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand / Pisa/IIT SoftHand（论文中验证了多个）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练阶段完全不使用真实物体抓取数据；仅用合成接触几何数据（gripper surface + synthetic contact patches）
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧抓取领域首次系统实现真正object-agnostic生成式规划（非微调/非prompting），实证覆盖多手型+MultiDex真实物体+sim2real迁移，消融充分，但未部署于闭环控制任务、未接入触觉/视觉实时反馈、未验证长期操作或动态扰动鲁棒性，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺闭环部署与在线适应，但object-agnostic生成范式扎实落地，明显优于多数刷榜式抓取模型，暂未达T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑地位。

papers.title: A multi-tissue epigenomic atlas links the sheep non-coding genome to domestication and complex traits
papers.abstract: Abstract Non-coding regulatory variation drives complex traits, domestication, and evolutionary adaptation, yet the sheep genome lacks high-resolution functional annotation. Here we present SheepEpimap, a multi-tissue regulatory atlas harmonizing 516 CUT&Tag histone modifications, ATAC-seq, and RNA-seq datasets across 43 adult tissues in sheep. We annotated 2.93 million cis -regulatory elements, yielding 557,441 enhancer–gene pairs and 145,407 variants with allele-specific effects. By training a sequence-to-function deep-learning model, we decoded the base-pair syntax of chromatin accessibility, annotated transcription factor motif instances genome-wide, and constructed 12,210 tissue-specific gene regulatory networks (GRNs).
