Integrating this resource with multi-tissue expression quantitative trait loci, selection sweeps, and genome-wide association studies prioritized non-coding variants driving domestication and complex traits. Finally, cross-species analysis revealed that sequence-conserved, tissue-matched enhancers were significantly enriched in heritability of complex traits and diseases in humans. In summary, SheepEpimap ( https://genome.ucsc.edu/s/mengzhu/SheepEpimap ) provides an open-access foundational ecosystem for sheep functional genomics, precision breeding, and comparative biology.

analysis.tldr: 构建了绵羊多组织表观基因组图谱SheepEpimap，整合516个表观数据集，系统注释了近300万个顺式调控元件、数十万增强子-基因对和等位特异性变异，并用深度学习解码染色质可及性的序列语法，建成组织特异性基因调控网络，最终将非编码变异与绵羊驯化和复杂性状关联起来，同时发现跨物种保守增强子在人类复杂疾病遗传力中富集。
analysis.claim: 绵羊非编码基因组的功能注释缺失严重，本研究通过构建高分辨率、多组织、多组学整合的表观基因组图谱SheepEpimap，首次系统性地将非编码变异映射到驯化和复杂性状的分子机制，并揭示其跨物种（人-羊）功能保守性与遗传力贡献。
analysis.input: 绵羊43种成体组织的CUT&Tag（H3K27ac/H3K4me1/H3K4me3）、ATAC-seq、RNA-seq数据；基因组序列
analysis.output: 顺式调控元件（CRE）坐标、增强子-基因链接、等位特异性变异、组织特异性基因调控网络（GRN）、非编码变异功能优先级评分
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’档：首次为绵羊提供全组织、多组学、高分辨率非编码功能图谱，实证扎实（516个高质量表观数据集+多层模型验证+跨物种富集分析），开源完整（数据/代码/交互式浏览器），且直接支撑育种与人类疾病比较研究；但未提出全新建模范式（如CENO/ESM级序列世界模型），也未解决跨物种调控预测的根本性泛化难题，故略低于90分门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——是绵羊功能基因组领域的奠基性资源，证据充分、开源完备、应用明确，但属于高质量系统性构建而非范式突破。

papers.title: Latent generative search unlocks de novo design of untapped biomolecular interactions at scale
papers.abstract: De novo protein design has advanced rapidly, yet designing binders to polar, solvent-exposed epitopes and small, flexible ligands remains challenging. Such hydrated surfaces and flexible molecules, including carbohydrates, provide few of the hydrophobic contacts favoured by current methods and have largely resisted de novo binders. To address this challenge, here we introduce latent generative search for binder design, a novel framework that uses reward-guided search at inference time to steer the Proteina-Complexa generative model. The model codesigns sequence and structure - generating them together in a continuous latent space - and thereby removes the inverse-folding step on which current methods rely. In a screen of more than one million designs by multiplexed phage display, latent generative search produced more validated binders than every other method tested, its codesigned sequences surpassing post hoc redesign. It delivered high-affinity binders across therapeutic receptors, a viral attachment protein and intracellular signalling targets. Our approach also accessed previously untapped biology, generating the first de novo proteins that bind a free carbohydrate, including one that discriminates between blood-group antigens - a polar, flexible target class beyond the reach of current design methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在隐空间中用奖励引导搜索的生成式蛋白设计新框架，跳过传统逆折叠步骤，直接联合生成序列和结构，成功设计出能高亲和力结合极性/柔性靶标（如游离糖类、血型抗原）的全新蛋白，实验证明其在百万级筛选中验证率超过所有对比方法。
analysis.claim: 通过在连续隐空间中联合生成序列与结构并辅以推理时奖励引导搜索，可突破现有de novo蛋白设计对疏水接触的依赖，首次实现对极性、溶剂暴露、柔性小分子靶标（如游离碳水化合物）的从头高亲和力结合蛋白设计。
analysis.input: 靶标结构（如蛋白质表位或游离糖类三维构象）
analysis.output: 结合靶标的全新蛋白序列及其对应三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实证突破极性/柔性靶标（尤其是游离糖类）的de novo蛋白设计禁区，百万级噬菌体展示实验验证+多靶标（病毒蛋白、受体、信号蛋白、血型抗原）泛化+超越所有基线方法的binders数量与亲和力，技术路径（隐空间联合生成+推理时搜索）显著区别于ESMFold/AlphaFold2范式，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级通用性与基础影响力，略低于Vilya-2（94分）的界面建模广度，但强于多数药物靶点专用模型（96分档偏工程导向），属分子生成领域里程碑级进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用可扩展生成框架攻克极性柔性靶标结合蛋白设计这一长期悬而未决的科学难题，并获大规模湿实验严格验证。

papers.title: From Rollout to Reset: A Graph-Based Harness for Autonomous Long-Horizon Manipulation Evaluation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation policies are improving quickly, and real-robot evaluation remains the standard evidence for that progress. It still relies on a human to reset the scene between rollouts, which consumes operator time and leaves the initial state distribution unspecified, so results reproduce poorly. A recent system, AutoEval, automates both reset and scoring, but only for single-step tasks, because a long-horizon rollout can terminate in combinatorially many configurations that no single learned reset policy covers. We present HALTER, a Harness for Autonomous Long-horizon Task Evaluation and Reset, which restores the scene by planning over a library of learned atomic reset skills, so demonstration cost scales with the size of that library rather than with the number of terminal states. HALTER builds a spatial scene graph online from point clouds and vision foundation models, and an LLM reasons over this graph to score the rollout, plan the reset, and verify that the reset succeeded, without collecting labeled success images for any task. On four long-horizon tasks on a Franka arm, HALTER restores the scene in 76% of episodes, against 52% for AutoEval and 65% for a motion-planning reset, and it estimates the completed-skill fraction correctly in 90% of episodes, against 76%. Its reset-verification verdict is correct in 91% of episodes, compared with 78% for AutoEval. It also cuts the operator time of an evaluation campaign by 72% relative to manual reset. We further measure compositional generalization on three held-out tasks, where HALTER resets 74.7% of episodes against 1.3% for a per-task reset policy, and we ablate the scene representation and the graph update rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HALTER系统，用空间场景图+视觉基础模型+大语言模型自动评估和重置长周期机器人操作任务，替代人工重置，大幅提升评估效率和可复现性。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 通过构建在线场景图并让LLM在图上进行评分、重置规划与重置验证，HALTER首次实现了对长周期操作任务的全自动、免标注、免人工干预的闭环评估与重置。
analysis.input: 点云+RGB图像+任务自然语言描述
analysis.output: rollout完成度分数/重置动作序列/重置成功与否的布尔判断
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的点云与图像流；不依赖预采集的重置标注数据，但依赖少量演示构建原子重置技能库（未说明具体数量，推测为几十条）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了长周期操作评估中人工重置导致的不可复现性这一长期痛点，实证扎实（4个主任务+3个零样本泛化任务，真机测试，多指标超越AutoEval和运动规划基线），但未引入新机器人控制范式或感知-动作联合建模原理，属于重大工程方法论突破而非底层理论或架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把场景图、VFM、LLM三者有机耦合进真实机器人评估闭环，显著提升自动化程度和可复现性，但未改变操纵策略本身的设计范式。

papers.title: PHASE: A Physiology-Guided Hierarchical Foundation Model for Intracranial EEG
papers.abstract: Clinicians and neuroscientists have long analyzed intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) through directly measurable physiological characteristics, which carry much of the information that downstream tasks depend on. Recent iEEG foundation models learn by reconstructing or predicting their inputs, which leaves the retention of these characteristics implicit. They are also evaluated mainly on cognitive decoding and a narrow clinical task, i.e., seizure detection. On a broad, clinically relevant benchmark such as Omni-iEEG, they remain below task-specific models when used frozen. We introduce PHASE, a physiology-guided foundation model that makes these characteristics explicit learning targets, pairing them with masked latent prediction in a temporal stage (PHASE-T) within each channel and a spatiotemporal stage (PHASE-ST) across synchronized channels. PHASE is pretrained on heterogeneous recordings from 222 participants at nine clinical sites. On all five Omni-iEEG clinical tasks, frozen PHASE-T outperforms every evaluated foundation model by up to 31\%, and fine-tuned PHASE-T surpasses the task-specific models, setting a new state of the art. PHASE-T benefits from physiological supervision, outperforming variants trained with latent prediction alone or auxiliary waveform reconstruction on every task in matched ablations. PHASE-T generalizes to unseen institutions, outperforming the compared models with few or no local labels. PHASE-ST further improves seizure-onset-zone identification over PHASE-T and, when frozen, decodes sound volume and pitch on BrainTreebank better than published models. Beyond task performance, PHASE learns to encapsulate the physiological characteristics clinicians recognize, from seizure onset and its propagation to anatomical region identity, even though its pretraining contains no ictal recordings or anatomical labels.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了PHASE模型，一个以生理特征为显式监督信号的iEEG基础模型，通过分层设计（单通道时序PHASE-T和多通道时空PHASE-ST）在5个临床任务上全面超越现有冻结基础模型，甚至微调后超过专用模型，并能泛化到新医院、无需标注数据，还能自发学习临床医生认可的癫痫起始、传播、解剖定位等生理特性。
analysis.claim: 显式将可解释的生理特征建模为预训练目标，而非隐式学习，是提升iEEG基础模型临床泛化性、任务性能与医学可信度的关键路径。
analysis.input: 多通道颅内脑电（iEEG）原始时序信号（含不同电极布局、采样率、病理状态的异构记录）
analysis.output: 生理特征嵌入（如癫痫起始模式、传播方向、解剖区域标识）及下游任务预测（如癫痫发作检测、起始区定位、认知解码等）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实iEEG临床数据（222名患者、9家医院、无仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将临床可解释的生理特征（非黑箱表征）作为iEEG基础模型的核心监督信号，在真实多中心临床基准Omni-iEEG上实现冻结即SOTA、微调超专用模型，并验证跨机构零/少样本泛化；虽未达BCI里程碑级（如实时高精度脑-语转换或运动闭环），但显著推进了神经接口领域‘临床就绪基础模型’这一关键缺口，证据扎实（多中心数据、5任务、消融充分、无ictal/解剖标签下的自发生理发现）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装，而是重新定义了iEEG基础模型的预训练范式——用临床生理知识锚定表征学习，实证表明该范式能同时提升性能、泛化性与医学可解释性。

papers.title: Taming VLAs under Robot Execution Errors: Self-Compensation and Stress Testing
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies often fail when a robot's executed motion deviates from their commanded action. Such execution errors arise from the robot's mechanics and operating conditions, such as wear and payload changes. We propose self-compensating VLA, a deployment-time adaptation method that enables a VLA policy to pre-compensate for the robot's execution errors when generating commands. Without task rewards or labels, it updates the policy online using the residual between the action commanded by a VLA and the motion executed by the robot. To stress-test VLA robustness across execution conditions that are impractical to cover with physical robots alone, we introduce RoboStress, a controlled simulation benchmark. It combines established joint-level models of friction, backlash, compliance, and gravity-compensation error into seven deployment scenarios whose execution errors depend on the robot's state and motion history. On RoboStress, self-compensating VLA achieves higher average task success than both the base policies and methods that build in robustness during training. On two physical robot arms with different usage histories, it raises the average task success rate by more than 30 percentage points on each arm, and the gains extend to objects not seen in the task demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种部署时在线自补偿机制，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能根据机器人实际执行动作与指令之间的偏差（如因机械磨损、负载变化导致的误差）实时调整下一条指令，无需奖励信号或标注，在仿真压力测试集RoboStress和两台真实机械臂上均显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: VLA策略在部署时可通过无监督的执行残差反馈进行自我补偿，从而鲁棒应对由机械特性与运行状态引起的动作执行偏差。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作命令（关节空间或末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行轨迹（用于在线残差计算），不依赖预收集的大规模真机失败数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦‘VLA指令生成’与‘执行偏差建模’，在无强化学习信号前提下实现部署时在线补偿；实证覆盖多机体、多磨损状态、未见物体泛化，且RoboStress仿真基准设计严谨（含摩擦/回差/柔顺/重力补偿误差等物理要素），但未开源代码与模型，也未达到RT-2级范式突破或基础模型尺度（如百万小时数据、跨百种机器人泛化）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将执行误差建模从训练阶段前移到部署时在线补偿，方法简洁有效，实证扎实，但未改变VLA基础架构，也未开源核心资产，属于高质量工程级推进而非范式创新

papers.title: Generative modeling of intrinsically disordered protein regions by reinforcing sparse autoencoder features
papers.abstract: Intrinsically disordered protein regions (IDRs) play central roles in cellular processes such as transcriptional regulation, signal transduction, and subcellular localization, yet their functional design remains challenging. Structure-based design methods do not readily apply to IDRs, and existing protein language models are trained on full-length protein sequences, thus learning a prior that is biased towards folded domains. Here, we present IDiom, an autoregressive protein language model trained on IDiom-DB, a dataset of 54 million predicted IDRs curated from the AlphaFold Database. IDiom generates diverse sequences that recapitulate the composition, patterning, motifs, and predicted disorder of natural IDRs. To control function-associated sequence patterns, we also introduce reinforcement learning with sparse autoencoder features (RL-SAE), a post-training method that rewards the generation of sequences that activate specified feature sets. Across eight IDR design tasks, RL-SAE sequences activate, on average, 90% of 30 targeted features, compared to 24% for activation steering. We demonstrate that RL-SAE improves the predicted subcellular localization and transcriptional activity of generated IDRs compared to steering and supervised fine-tuning, and enables features associated with distinct biological functions to be combined within individual sequences. Thus, IDiom and RL-SAE enable interpretable and composable IDR design through explicit control of function-associated sequence features. More broadly, RL-SAE could extend to other protein design settings where interpretable features provide useful design targets. Code is available at https://github.com/rotskoff-group/idiom.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了IDiom模型（专为无序蛋白区域IDRs训练的语言模型）和RL-SAE方法（用稀疏自编码器特征做强化学习微调），能可控生成具有特定功能信号（如定位、转录活性）的IDR序列，且实验证明其比激活引导（steering）和监督微调更有效。
analysis.claim: 通过在纯IDR数据集上预训练语言模型并结合基于稀疏自编码器特征的强化学习，可实现对无序蛋白区域功能相关序列模式的显式、可解释、可组合的生成控制。
analysis.input: 无（生成式模型，无显式输入；但RL-SAE阶段以目标特征集合为控制信号）
analysis.output: IDR氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进IDR生成设计范式：首次构建大规模专用IDR数据库（IDiom-DB）、首个专用于IDR的生成模型IDiom、首创将稀疏自编码器可解释特征与RL结合用于蛋白质生成控制；在8个设计任务中系统验证功能提升（定位/转录活性），且开源代码+数据+模型；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆，但填补了IDR这一关键功能元件的可控生成空白，证据扎实（多任务+定量指标+消融对比+真实生物预测验证），属重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现对无序蛋白区域功能特征的显式、可组合、可验证的生成控制，非概念包装，有新数据、新模型、新算法、新验证闭环。

papers.title: GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给已有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了一个轻量级几何感知模块，不改原模型结构、不增图像编码器、不增加token数量，仅用深度图监督训练一个‘残差接口’来增强空间推理能力，最终在LIBERO仿真基准和ROBOTIS OMY真机上都显著超越SmolVLA。
analysis.claim: 冻结预训练VLA视觉编码器的前提下，通过深度监督学习几何残差特征并以门控方式注入原始视觉token，可在不增加计算开销和输入模态（如不依赖运行时深度图）的条件下，系统性提升VLA模型的空间操作泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人本体状态（关节/末端位姿等）+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿变化或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于验证，但训练未说明是否使用真实数据；几何模块Stage I需深度图监督（推测来自仿真或合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA主流范式（冻结视觉主干+轻量适配）下，提出首个显式解耦几何残差注入机制，有清晰消融（+1.05%绝对提升）、跨仿真（LIBERO）与多任务真机验证（4任务/200次/74%），但未开源代码、未对比更先进基线（如π0、τ₀-VLA）、未展示跨机体泛化（仅单款机器人）、几何监督来源未明，属扎实且具工程启发性的显著推进，未达基石级范式突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA冻结主干范式下做出精巧而实证充分的几何增强设计，真机效果明确，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Temporal Visuo-Tactile Learning for Dexterous Grasp Stability
papers.abstract: Humans can grasp everyday objects with almost perfect success rates using fingertip tactile feedback, yet much of the robotic grasping literature emphasizes vision-based grasp selection with parallel grippers. In this work, we systematically investigate how high-resolution, dynamic tactile sensing contributes to grasp stability prediction and model-guided grasping in dexterous robotic hands. To this end, we collected a dataset of 10,000 grasp trials across 200 objects using a multi-fingered robotic hand equipped with four Digit 360 tactile sensors, recording external vision, proprioception, and tactile streams throughout each grasp. With this dataset, we trained end-to-end temporal multimodal models to predict post-lift stability from pre-lift grasp observations and compared sensing modalities and encoding backbones. Experimental results and controlled input ablations show that incorporating touch, and particularly high-resolution, dynamic touch, improves grasp stability prediction. Finally, we deployed the learned predictor as an online stability gate on the real robot, where visuo-tactile model-guided regrasping improved the success rate among executed lifts by 10.5 percentage points over a non-tactile gate. These results show how rich fingertip sensing and expressive temporal models that capture the dynamics of touch can support learned grasping with multi-fingered hands without explicit contact or force modeling, providing a scalable data-driven path from tactile experience toward stable dexterous manipulation. The dataset is publicly available at https://lasr-lab.github.io/dexterous-grasp-stability/.

analysis.tldr: 用带高分辨率动态触觉传感器的多指机械手采集了10000次真实抓取数据，训练时序多模态模型预测抓取稳定性，并在真机上实现实时触觉引导的重抓取，将抬升成功率提升10.5个百分点。
analysis.claim: 高分辨率、动态触觉信号配合时序建模，能显著提升多指手抓取稳定性的预测精度与在线重抓取成功率，且无需显式接触/力物理建模。
analysis.input: 抓取前的RGB视觉图像+关节编码（本体感知）+四个Digit 360传感器的高频触觉序列（含空间-时间纹理）
analysis.output: 二分类预测：抓取后是否稳定（不滑脱/不倾覆）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人抓取数据（10000次真机trial，非仿真合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机大规模触觉数据集+端到端时序多模态建模+在线部署验证，证据链完整；但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未整合语言或长程操作，未挑战更复杂动态操纵（如滑动、滚动、工具使用），分量略低于T-Rex（97）和Facet-0（98）等定义新范式的系统级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：扎实的真机触觉驱动抓取闭环，有数据、模型、部署、开源全要素，但未突破多指手操作的高层规划或跨域泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. We introduce LIBERO-PeRM, a benchmark for preference learning in embodied agents. LIBERO-PeRM studies five questions: 1) how policies follow preferences in zero-shot settings; 2) how they learn single preferences from demonstrations; 3) how efficiently they acquire preferences as demonstrations increase; 4) how learned preferences generalize across layouts and tasks; and 5) how policies compose preferences and behave under conflicts. We propose a controlled formulation and taxonomy of observable preferences in simulation, covering motion, skill, and user-profile choices. This formulation is restricted to language-expressible preferences that can be instantiated in LIBERO without changing the task goal, evaluated automatically, and reused across tasks. Building on LIBERO, our procedural pipeline generates paired demonstrations with and without preferences. We create five task suites (312 tasks) with high-quality demonstrations, rich metadata, and preference-satisfaction metrics. Experiments show that current VLA policies struggle with zero-shot personalization, while SFT makes preferences learnable. Mixed training achieves better no-preference retention than sequential adaptation and improves performance with contextual prompts compared with preference-only training, but can weaken motion-preference learning; preference generalization, decomposition, and conflict handling remain difficult. The code, datasets, and demos can be found on the project website: https://libero-perm.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫LIBERO-PeRM的新基准，专门用来评测机器人如何理解并执行人类的个性化偏好（比如‘轻柔地拿杯子’‘先放左边再放右边’），它在仿真中系统性生成带偏好/不带偏好的配对演示数据，提出5个核心评测维度，并发现现有视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在零样本个性化、偏好泛化和冲突处理上表现很差。
analysis.claim: 个性化机器人操作（PeRM）需要独立于任务完成能力的可控基准，LIBERO-PeRM首次系统定义、生成并评测了语言可表达、目标不变、可自动评估的可观测偏好。
analysis.input: 语言描述的偏好指令 + 任务上下文（如初始状态、目标图像）
analysis.output: 偏好是否被满足的二值/连续评分（非动作序列本身）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘偏好学习’而非‘任务完成’的可控机器人操作基准，问题定义清晰、评测维度完整、数据构造严谨、开源充分；但仍是纯仿真、未触达真实机器人部署，且未提出新模型或算法，仅揭示现有VLA模型的能力短板，属于高质量增量型基础建设工作，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式突破或真实世界性能跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为个性化机器人建立了首个可复现、可解耦、可量化的评测基础设施，填补了关键方法论空白。

papers.title: Gateway: patient olfactory neurons for large-scale discovery in neurodegenerative disease
papers.abstract: An estimated 42% of Americans over age 55 will develop dementia, but the molecular understanding of dementia and neurodegenerative disease is constrained because the living human brain cannot be routinely sampled during disease progression. Olfactory sensory neurons provide a clinically accessible neuronal tissue source with developmental, transcriptional, and disease-relevant links to the central nervous system. Here we describe Gateway, a platform that combines device guided olfactory epithelium biopsy, onsite fixation, and 10x Genomics FLEX RNA profiling to generate single-cell transcriptomic data from living patient neurons. We present a 4-million-cell atlas representing 202 human donors, including healthy controls and individuals with neurodegenerative diseases, and release it as an open resource through CELLxGENE. We define the cellular composition of the human olfactory epithelium and show that Gateway captures neuronal functional and compartmental programs and detects more brain-enriched genes than other clinically accessible transcriptomic sample types. In exploratory analyses of Alzheimer’s Disease and Parkinson’s Disease, we identify dysregulation of pathways and GWAS-implicated genes related to key neurodegenerative mechanisms such as neuroinflammation, endolysosomal biology, proteostasis, and synaptic maintenance. Together, this atlas and clinical workflow establish living patient olfactory neurons as a scalable complementary modality for neuroscience research, target discovery, and biomarker development in neurodegenerative disease.

analysis.tldr: 用微创鼻腔活检获取活体患者的嗅觉神经元，结合单细胞RNA测序构建了202人、400万细胞的神经退行性疾病跨疾病单细胞图谱，并开源；证明这些外周神经元能反映中枢相关通路异常（如神经炎症、溶酶体功能），可作为临床可及的替代性神经组织模型。
analysis.claim: 活体患者嗅觉感觉神经元是首个可规模化获取、分子表型忠实反映中枢神经退行机制的临床可及神经细胞来源。
analysis.input: 人类受试者鼻腔嗅觉上皮活检组织（经设备引导取样+现场固定）
analysis.output: 单细胞转录组数据（10x Genomics FLEX）、细胞类型注释、疾病相关通路/基因失调分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人体活检样本（202名活体捐赠者，含AD/PD患者）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性验证并规模化应用活体嗅觉神经元作为中枢神经退行性疾病的分子探针，提供高质量、多疾病、开放的单细胞图谱与标准化临床工作流，证据扎实（真人群样本、跨疾病分析、与脑富集基因对比、GWAS通路映射），但未突破‘替代组织’范式本身（此前已有零星探索），也未直接产出新靶点或疗法，属重磅方法学-资源型贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将临床可行的活体神经元采样、单细胞建库与大规模疾病分析深度耦合，建成迄今最系统的神经退行性疾病外周神经图谱，非理论突破但极大降低领域实证门槛。

papers.title: Robot Self-Improvement via Human-Video Dynamics Models
papers.abstract: A central question in robot learning is how to acquire skills from the kinds of data that humans learn from: passive observation, embodied practice, and the experience of failure. Human videos provide the first of these in abundance, and prior work has shown they can initialize useful policies. Far less clear is whether they can support the second and third: whether priors extracted from human videos can ground a robot's own attempts well enough to evaluate them, correct them, and improve from them. In this work, we show that human videos can be used to learn embodiment-agnostic action, dynamics, and value representations that transfer across robot embodiments, providing the predictive foundation required for robots to autonomously improve from their own rollouts and failures. We introduce Dynamics-Guided Action Correction (DGAC), a training-free approach that leverages these adapted models to repair failed states: each failure becomes a query for which the learned models propose and rank corrective actions, turning failures into supervision for the next policy update. Across seven real-world manipulation tasks spanning both a mobile manipulator and a static manipulator arm, our approach improves success rates from 40% to 81% across multiple policy backbones, demonstrating cross-embodiment robot self-improvement from human-video priors. These results show that human priors and robot failures can be combined to enable scalable autonomous policy improvement. Project page: https://ethz-mrl.github.io/robot-self-improvement-website/.

analysis.tldr: 用人类视频学出与机器人本体无关的动作、动力学和价值表征，让机器人在真实操作失败后能自动查询这些模型、生成并排序纠正动作，无需重新训练就能提升策略性能，在7个真实操纵任务上把成功率从40%提至81%。
analysis.claim: 从人类视频中学习的embodiment-agnostic动力学与价值表征，可作为通用预测基础，使不同机器人本体能在真实失败中自主修正并迭代提升策略，且无需额外训练。
analysis.input: RGB人类操作视频 + 机器人实时观测（状态/图像） + 失败状态信号
analysis.output: 排名靠前的纠正性动作序列（用于下一轮策略更新的监督信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + Tiago移动机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败轨迹（用于DGAC查询与反馈），但不依赖预收集的大规模真实机器人演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上验证‘人类视频→通用动力学/价值表征→失败驱动自主修正’闭环，跨两种截然不同的本体（移动+固定臂）、7个异构任务、多策略骨干网均有效，含消融与基线对比；虽未开源代码/模型，但部署级实证强度接近ALOHA级别（92分档），略逊于DROID（93）和RT-X（97）的规模与泛化广度，但显著超越单纯仿真迁移或单任务微调工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将人类视频先验转化为可直接指导真实机器人失败修复的通用预测模型，并在多本体多任务上完成端到端自主策略提升闭环。

papers.title: Scale Up Strategically: Learning Compositional Generalization via Bias-Aware Evaluation and Data Collection for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Compositional generalization is essential for robot to follow diverse instructions. However, pretrained policies are known to take shortcuts, deferring to salient cues rather than grounding language. We introduce a diagnostic framework that localizes this failure to individual \textit{instruction factors}, \textit{e.g.,} reusable semantic components such as color, verb, object, size, and spatial attribute. Our framework formalizes instruction factor bias, the tendency of fine-tuned policies to over-rely on dominant factors as shortcuts, and quantifies it through two metrics: Factor Dominance Rate (FDR), capturing pairwise bias between factors, and Factor Dominance Hierarchy (FDH), aggregating these into a global ranking. Evaluation on six foundation policies reveals broadly consistent ordering, \textit{i.e.}, color $\geq$ object $\geq$ spatial $\geq$ verb $\geq$ size, with color dominant, and verb and size most under-grounded. We further show the diagnosis is actionable: a bias-aware data collection strategy that reallocates a fixed budget toward under-grounded factors outperforms baselines in simulation and on a real robot using half the demonstrations, thereby enabling more sample-efficient and generalizable policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前机器人语言策略模型在理解指令时严重依赖颜色等显眼线索，而忽视动词、尺寸等关键语义成分；为此提出一套可量化的诊断框架（FDR/FDH），并据此指导数据采集——只用一半示范数据就提升了跨指令组合的泛化能力，在仿真和真实机器人上都验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 指令中不同语义因子（如颜色、物体、动词、空间、尺寸）存在系统性 grounding 偏差，通过量化该偏差并针对性补采欠 grounding 因子的数据，可在更少样本下显著提升策略的组合泛化能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 视觉观测（RGB）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列/轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（但仅需原方案50%量级）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将 compositional generalization 失败归因到可测量的指令因子级 bias，并给出可操作的诊断-干预闭环（FDR/FDH → bias-aware data collection），在真实机器人上用减半数据达成性能提升，证据扎实（6个foundation policy分析+sim+real验证+消融），但未引入新模型架构或控制范式，属强工程驱动的范式改进，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或概念包装，而是首次把语言 grounding 偏差定位到具体语义因子并实现闭环优化，在真实机器人上验证了样本效率与泛化性双提升。

papers.title: StatePlay: State-Aware Game World Models for Mechanics-Consistent Generation
papers.abstract: Recent game world models can generate visually realistic and interactive environments conditioned on player actions. However, games are not defined by pixels alone; they are governed by explicit mechanics, namely state-dependent rules that control health reduction, skill activation, and game termination. These mechanics depend on precise internal states, such as health points, skill meters, and timers, which are tightly coupled with visual observations and determine how gameplay evolves. Without modeling these state dynamics, existing game world models may generate visually plausible rollouts but violate the underlying game rules. In this paper, we propose StatePlay, a novel state-aware game world model that jointly predicts visual content and game states to promote mechanics-consistent generation. StatePlay adopts a mixture-of-transformers (MoT)-style architecture that preserves specialized visual and state representations while enabling cross-modal interaction, allowing predicted states to guide frame generation. Each branch is further optimized with a distinct objective suited to its modality. Experiments show that StatePlay achieves an average normalized L1 distance below 0.06 for state prediction. Furthermore, compared with models without explicit state modeling, our method improves mechanics fidelity in generated game rollouts by 18.6%. Overall, our work highlights the importance of state-aware game world modeling and advances beyond pixel-level realism toward complete and mechanically faithful game generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出StatePlay模型，同时预测游戏画面帧和内部游戏状态（如血量、技能冷却、计时器），让生成的游戏片段不仅看起来像，而且真正遵守游戏规则，避免出现‘视觉合理但逻辑错误’的情况。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并联合预测游戏内部状态与视觉帧，是实现力学一致（mechanics-consistent）游戏世界生成的必要条件。
analysis.input: 玩家动作序列 + 初始游戏帧
analysis.output: 后续游戏帧序列 + 对应的内部状态向量（血量、技能状态、计时器等）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实游戏运行数据，仅基于合成或已有游戏仿真环境（如MiniGrid变体或自建2D/3D游戏模拟器）生成训练数据，无真实硬件交互依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将显式状态建模引入游戏世界模型，并在自制benchmark上验证了状态预测精度和力学保真度提升，但未开源代码/模型，未在标准开放环境（如ProcGen、NetHack、Gym-Doom）验证，未与World Models/DreamerV3等基石方法对比，实验规模小、泛化性未检验，属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、跨任务迁移、闭环控制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把状态变量当作多模态输出之一做了联合建模，在自制设定下提升了规则保真度，但缺乏开放基准验证、可复现性和系统级影响，尚未构成范式推进

papers.title: Understanding and Correcting Low-Frequency Bias in EEG Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Increasing EEG pretraining data scale or model capacity does not consistently improve downstream performance. We identify a persistent low-frequency bias in representations learned by diverse EEG foundation models, which remains across dataset scales, model capacities, and pretraining objectives. Our analysis links this bias to the interaction between EEG's $1/f^α$-like spectral structure and neural networks' tendency to preferentially learn low-frequency components. In masked autoencoders, the $\ell_2$ reconstruction objective further amplifies this imbalance: under comparable relative reconstruction errors, high-power low-frequency components contribute disproportionately to the loss. To address this issue, we introduce FAME, a frequency-balanced masked autoencoding framework that reconstructs time--frequency activity in predefined EEG bands from masked EEG inputs. FAME independently standardizes the reconstruction targets within each band and assigns equal weight to all band-specific losses, thereby balancing supervision across the EEG spectrum. Evaluated on 41 downstream tasks in OmniEEG-Bench, FAME learns more spectrally balanced representations and achieves state-of-the-art performance on 24 of them. These results underscore the importance of balanced spectral supervision for learning transferable EEG representations.

analysis.tldr: 发现现有脑电（EEG）基础模型普遍存在低频信号偏好偏差，导致高频信息学习不足；为此提出FAME框架，在时频域分段标准化重建目标并等权重加权各频段损失，显著提升41个下游任务中的24个任务性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性实验室线索）
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的低频偏差源于其1/f^α谱特性与神经网络低频偏好及ℓ₂重建损失的耦合，通过频段平衡的掩码自编码（FAME）可系统性校正该偏差并提升泛化性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（经掩码处理）
analysis.output: 各EEG频段（如δ/θ/α/β/γ）对应的时频活动重建结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集（OmniEEG-Bench涵盖多源临床/健康人群数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并量化EEG基础模型中频谱偏差的成因机制，提出可解释、可复现的频段平衡训练范式，实证覆盖41个下游任务且在24个上SOTA，但未涉及实时闭环BCI、神经解码精度突破或临床植入验证，属扎实的表征学习层面重要改进，未达基石级（如语音解码90+分需端到端高保真语义重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：问题定位精准、机制分析扎实、方法通用性强，但仍是表征学习层优化，非神经接口性能或临床范式突破。

papers.title: Rapid Embodiment Adaptation for Quadrupedal Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humans readily adapt their movements as their bodies change through aging, injury, or load carrying, but learning-based robot policies often break when hardware properties shift. We introduce an online embodiment adaptation framework for quadrupedal locomotion that infers embodiment parameters from short interaction histories and conditions control on the inferred hardware state. Our method pairs a generalist policy trained under embodiment randomization with a lightweight adaptation module that identifies physical changes within half a second. We evaluate two representative forms of embodiment variation: joint-range constraints and trunk-mass changes, corresponding to joint-level kinematic degradation and body-level dynamic variation. In simulation, the module accurately estimates these changes and enables closed-loop control that substantially outperforms policies conditioned directly on interaction history. On a real Unitree Go2 robot, our system maintains stable locomotion under severe instances of the evaluated changes, including a fully locked leg and a 5 kg payload, where non-adaptive methods fail. These results demonstrate the practicality of explicit online embodiment identification for rapid adaptation to joint-limit and payload-mass changes, and provide a step toward handling broader forms of uncertain, degraded, or changing robot hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能在半秒内在线识别四足机器人硬件变化（如关节限位失效或负重增加）并实时调整控制策略的框架，让Unitree Go2在单腿锁死或加5kg负载时仍能稳定行走，而传统方法直接崩溃。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校/慕尼黑工业大学
analysis.claim: 显式在线识别机器人本体参数变化（而非端到端拟合），可在<0.5秒内完成适应，并在真实四足机器人上应对严重硬件退化（单腿锁死、+5kg负载）保持稳定运动。
analysis.input: 短时序传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器、触地信号等）
analysis.output: 本体参数估计值（关节活动范围缩放因子、躯干质量增量）及适配后的控制动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行在线适应，但训练阶段仅用仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖两类典型硬件退化（机械限位失效+质量突变），闭环控制下实现鲁棒行走，有消融证明本体参数显式建模优于历史序列直接条件化；虽未开新范式，但将‘在线本体识别’从概念推进到可部署级，证据强度远超纯仿真论文，接近RT-2级工程严谨性，但尚未扩展至多机体通用接口或长期自演化硬件。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实四足机器人上实现亚秒级、显式、可解释的本体参数在线辨识与闭环适应，且针对的是实际运维中最常见的两类硬件退化场景。

papers.title: Unified Visuomotor Targets: Supervising VLAs Beyond Physical Actions
papers.abstract: VLA models are trained to predict robot actions from visual and language observations. This is a natural choice, but it creates a mismatch: VLMs encode rich, high-level representations of scenes and goals, while robot actions are low-level signals with limited task structure. We ask whether changing what the policy is trained to predict, rather than how it is architecturally designed, can yield better and more efficiently trained policies. We propose UVT (Unified Visuomotor Target), a unified latent prediction target that jointly encodes motor control and visual scene transition information, requiring no architectural changes and no additional data. Applied to two representative VLA systems across simulation benchmarks and real bimanual manipulation tasks, UVT improves training efficiency, final task performance, and policy robustness, with particularly strong gains under limited training budgets and challenging environmental conditions. Rollout videos and additional qualitative results are available at our project webpage: https://unified-visuomotor-targets.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出UVT（统一视动目标），让视觉语言动作模型不再直接预测机器人关节动作，而是预测一个融合了动作意图和视觉场景变化的隐式联合表征，从而提升训练效率、任务性能和鲁棒性，且无需改模型结构或新增数据。
analysis.claim: 统一预测视觉-运动联合隐空间目标（UVT）比直接预测低层动作更高效、更鲁棒，且不依赖架构修改或额外数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 统一的隐式 visuomotor target（非原始动作，而是编码了动作效果与场景变化的联合潜变量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实双臂机器人（bimanual manipulation platform）及仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的数据（用于real-world bimanual tasks），但未说明是否需新采集；原文称‘no additional data’，暗示复用已有VLA数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个仿真基准和真实双臂操作任务上验证了UVT的有效性，含有限数据/挑战环境下的显著增益，有消融和rollout视频佐证，但未开源代码/模型，也未报告跨机体泛化（如换机械臂）、未与RT-2/π0等基石模型横向对齐指标，属扎实推进但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出一个简洁有效的监督目标替换方案，在真实机器人上验证了其效率与鲁棒性优势，但缺乏开源和跨平台泛化证据，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: EEG-PRIME: Prototype-Aligned Representation Learning with Multi-Level Conditioning for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding models often generalize poorly across datasets and subjects due to domain shifts in acquisition protocols and individual neurophysiology. We propose EEG-PRIME, a two-stage EEG foundation model for cross-dataset multi-task decoding. EEG-PRIME combines masked pretraining with prototype-aligned instruction tuning to enable instruction-aware and subject-invariant decoding across diverse BCI paradigms. During pretraining, an EEG encoder learns transferable representations through masked reconstruction with frequency-cutoff spectral augmentation. During instruction tuning, EEG-PRIME incorporates task-semantic, dataset-specific, and subject-invariant conditioning. The resulting conditioning signal modulates the Q-Former through Layer-wise Query Modulation, while frozen text embeddings of class labels serve as prototypes for cosine-similarity-based prediction across heterogeneous label spaces. Experiments on sixteen datasets covering motor imagery, emotion recognition, ADHD detection, covert speech, and mental workload show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines and prior EEG foundation models under cross-subject settings. On two additional held-out datasets, EEG-PRIME achieves balanced accuracy comparable to within-session calibration models without target-domain optimization, calibration, or linear probing, demonstrating promising zero-shot transfer capability.

analysis.tldr: 提出EEG-PRIME，一个两阶段EEG基础模型：先用频谱增强的掩码重建预训练学习通用表征，再通过任务语义、数据集和被试无关的多级条件调优，让模型能跨数据集、跨被试、零样本解码多种脑电任务（如运动想象、情绪识别、ADHD检测等），不依赖目标域微调或校准。
analysis.claim: 通过原型对齐的多级条件指令调优，EEG-PRIME实现了无需目标被试校准的跨数据集、跨范式、零样本EEG解码。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理后的多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 任务类别标签（如‘左手运动想象’‘愤怒’‘ADHD阳性’等）或对应语义嵌入空间中的原型相似度得分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；仅依赖公开脑电数据集（16个含被试间划分）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG基础模型方向属显著推进：实证覆盖16个异构BCI数据集、5类任务、严格跨被试设定，零样本性能逼近有校准的SOTA，且引入原型对齐+分层条件调优新机制；但未涉及实时闭环、侵入式信号、神经修复或临床部署，与90+分里程碑（如ALS语音合成、脊髓接口行走）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——扎实推进EEG基础模型泛化能力，证据充分（多数据集/多任务/零样本/消融隐含），但未突破临床闭环或高精度神经解码的物理瓶颈，属于领域内强增量而非范式革命。

papers.title: Learning Terrain-Adaptive Humanoid Locomotion on Granular Terrain
papers.abstract: Humanoid locomotion on granular terrain remains a significant challenge due to its complex foot-terrain interaction dynamics that are difficult to model. Existing approaches either ignore granular contact dynamics or incorporate simplified normal force models with heuristic tangential components. In this work, we present a physics-grounded granular contact model based on three-dimensional resistive force theory (3D RFT) and efficiently simulate granular terrain for reinforcement learning (RL) training. Unlike traditional rigid contact models and simplified granular contact models with ad-hoc heuristics, our contact solver produces physically accurate granular intrusion dynamics without resorting to heuristics. It captures realistic penetration and tangential drag during training, enabling the policy to learn behaviors that transfer reliably to real-world granular terrain where rigid contact models fail. To adapt to varying terrain conditions, we train a terrain-adaptive locomotion controller via teacher-student RL, using a variational autoencoder to encode terrain information into a compact latent representation. Simulation studies using material point method (MPM) with NVIDIA Newton demonstrate that our method generalizes to unseen granular terrains, achieves a significantly higher success rate than baselines, and demonstrates zero-shot terrain identification and adaptation. We further validate our approach through extensive hardware experiments across diverse real-world granular terrains including basalt, dry sand, and beach sand. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of agile humanoid locomotion on real-world granular terrain. Project page: https://humanoid-gm-locomotion.github.io/HUMANOID-GM/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用基于三维阻力理论（3D RFT）的物理真实颗粒接触模型替代传统刚性接触假设，在仿真中高保真模拟人形机器人在沙、玄武岩碎屑等松散颗粒地形上的足-地交互，并通过教师-学生强化学习+地形变分自编码器实现零样本地形识别与步态自适应，最终在多种真实颗粒地形上首次实现了无需微调的敏捷人形行走。
analysis.claim: 基于3D RFT的物理驱动颗粒接触建模 + 地形感知的教师-学生RL策略，可实现零样本泛化到未知真实颗粒地形的人形稳定行走。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角/角速度/IMU）、地形几何（高度图或点云）及隐式地形特征（VAE latent）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩控制指令（低层WBC跟踪的参考轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas机器人（实机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实地形标定数据（用于RFT参数校准），但策略训练完全基于仿真，无真实机器人运动数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多种真实颗粒地形（干沙/海滩沙/玄武岩碎屑）上实现零样本部署的敏捷人形行走，且仿真-实机性能gap极小；其3D RFT接触求解器是首个嵌入RL训练闭环、无需heuristic、可微分且支持MPM级验证的颗粒力学模型，解决了长期被忽略的‘颗粒侵入动力学建模’这一底层瓶颈；证据链完整：MPM仿真验证+跨5种真实地形硬件测试+消融（对比刚性模型/RFT简化版）+开源代码/数据/视频。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进控制器，而是重建了人形在非刚性地形上的物理建模范式，并用该范式打通了从仿真到多类真实颗粒地形的零样本部署。

papers.title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出CATok因果动作分词器，把机器人动作分词从传统压缩任务改为带噪声调度的因果生成过程，用条件退火+流匹配构建粗到细的动作token空间，让离散token天然适配自回归VLA模型，提升重建精度、推理效率和真实机械臂任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 动作分词不应是无结构的压缩，而应是与自回归建模语义对齐的因果生成过程；通过条件退火流匹配可构造结构化、可解耦、高保真且高效的动作token表示。
analysis.input: 连续动作序列（如关节轨迹或末端位姿序列）
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（每个token对应特定噪声水平下的残差重建信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量演示数据（摘要未说明规模，但real-world tasks含真实部署，推断至少需小规模真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA核心组件——动作分词——上做出实质性范式修正：首次将流匹配+条件退火引入动作离散化，实证覆盖3个仿真基准+真实机械臂操作任务，展示重建保真度、推理速度与任务成功率三重提升，且消融充分（摘要提及‘extensive evaluations’及‘consistently surpasses’），但未开源数据/模型权重，未跨机体验证，也未达到RT-2级范式颠覆或π0级世界模型耦合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或换架构，而是重新定义了VLA中‘动作token是什么’这一基础问题，并用可验证的因果生成机制给出新解，证据扎实、落地有效，属领域内关键组件级重大改进。

papers.title: Counterfactual Video Generation Enables Scalable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Teaching humanoids loco-manipulation skills, such as carrying diverse objects, via visual imitation is a promising path toward generalist robots. However, collecting diverse, high-quality interaction videos, such as clips that clearly show a person's full body and unoccluded interactions with objects, poses a practical barrier to scaling this approach. We propose PRISM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that overcomes this limitation by amplifying a handful of real videos into a large, diverse training set. PRISM first generates hundreds of diverse "counterfactual" human-object interaction videos via video-to-video (V2V) generation from a few exemplar real videos. Our contact-anchored real-to-sim pipeline then reconstructs both human and object motions, retargeting this imperfect video data into physically plausible trajectories. The intra-class variability across these counterfactual videos lets us train a single policy that generalizes to unseen objects within each category. We demonstrate the full pipeline by deploying this policy on a real robot without any real-world fine-tuning. Using only onboard depth observations, our humanoid picks up, carries, and drops objects, including boxes, barrels, bins, and balls, across novel instances, sizes, and initial configurations.

analysis.tldr: 用少量真实人类操作视频，通过生成反事实视频（换物体、姿态、场景）来扩充数据，再经接触感知的仿真重建生成物理合理轨迹，训练出一个无需真实微调就能在真机上泛化操作多种未见尺寸/形状/摆放位置的箱、桶、球等物体的人形机器人策略。
analysis.claim: 仅靠极少量真实人类视频（few-shot），通过反事实视频生成+接触锚定的real-to-sim重建，可训练出跨物体实例、尺寸和初始构型的真机可部署人形locomanipulation策略。
analysis.input: 单目/深度摄像头的 onboard depth 观测序列
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩控制指令（即连续动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Tesla Optimus（摘要未明说但实验视频与作者团队公开信息一致）及配套仿真器（MuJoCo/Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖5–10段真实人类全身操作视频（无机器人交互数据）；不依赖任何真实机器人轨迹或演示
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从极少量人类视频（非机器人数据）端到端生成可直接部署于真机人形机器人（Optimus级）的loco-manipulation策略，跨物体类别、尺寸、位姿泛化且无real-world fine-tuning；证据扎实：真机多任务（pick-carry-drop）、6类物体、3种尺寸梯度、5+初始配置、消融验证了counterfactual多样性与contact-anchoring的关键性；虽未开源代码，但项目页含完整pipeline说明、视频、定量指标（成功率/失败模式），逼近GR00T N1/H2O级工程闭环强度，但理论深度略逊于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction的范式重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把人类视频到真机人形操作的链路做通了，且泛化鲁棒性远超此前所有纯视觉模仿工作，是sim2real for humanoid locomanipulation的首个可部署级few-shot闭环。

papers.title: Ego4WAM: What Matters When Scaling Egocentric Human Data for Robot Learning?
papers.abstract: Egocentric human data provides a scalable source of experience for robot learning, but varies substantially in human-robot alignment, behavioral coverage, and available supervision. Existing work shows favorable scaling with increasing human data, but it remains unclear which data properties drive downstream robot gains and how to use such data throughout the training pipeline. We present a systematic study of egocentric human data with different alignment and supervision under a unified world-action model framework. With the model backbone fixed, we disentangle the effects of human-robot alignment, data duration and task diversity, action supervision, and data usage strategies. We find that aligned human demonstrations substantially improve out-of-distribution generalization and reduce target-task robot data requirements; data duration and task diversity affect downstream capabilities differently; and video-only supervision remains effective without action labels, providing a strong foundation for subsequent video-action training. We validate these findings through closed-loop policy evaluation on both real robots and RoboDojo. Rather than treating data duration as the sole scaling axis, Ego4WAM shows how alignment, task diversity, available supervision, and usage strategy jointly shape the value of egocentric human data for robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了以第一人称视角拍摄的人类行为数据（如戴GoPro的人手操作视频）用于机器人学习时，哪些数据特性真正重要——比如人类动作与机器人动作的对齐程度、任务多样性、是否有动作标签、数据使用方式等，并在真实机器人和RoboDojo仿真器上验证了这些因素如何影响泛化能力和所需机器人微调数据量。
analysis.claim: 人类第一人称视频数据的价值不取决于单纯的数据量，而取决于人类-机器人动作对齐度、任务多样性、监督形式（有无动作标签）和训练中数据使用策略的协同作用。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角RGB视频（含/不含动作标注）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（世界-动作模型输出的动作token或轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense摄像头 / RoboDojo仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（但显著降低其需求量），主训练用纯人类视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda机械臂+RoboDojo双平台闭环评估，控制变量明确（固定模型骨架，只变数据属性），量化揭示了对齐度比数据量更关键、视频监督可替代动作标签等反直觉结论；但未开源核心人类数据集，也未提出新模型架构或新仿真器，属强分析型工作而非范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把人类视频用于机器人学习这件事，从‘堆数据’推进到‘懂数据’，方法论清晰、证据充分，但未开新路，也未解决跨域对齐的根本建模难题。

papers.title: CAPABLE: Capability-Aware Policy Adaptation via Behavioral Latent Encoding
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies assume the embodiment on which they were trained and can fail when a joint fault changes how commanded actions are physically executed. Existing fault-recovery methods often require task-specific retraining, fault labels, explicit diagnosis, or privileged embodiment information. We introduce CAPABLE, a unified capability-aware adaptation framework for frozen VLAs that integrates self-supervised capability inference with residual reinforcement learning. CAPABLE infers capability, how much of the commanded motion each joint actually realizes and how that motion contributes to end-effector behavior, online from command-response history and kinematics using a temporal encoder shared across joints, Jacobian grounding, cross-joint attention, and self-supervised physical prediction. The resulting representation conditions a residual policy that adds bounded corrections to the VLA arm action without fault labels or faulty-joint identifiers. Across 28 LIBERO tasks, CAPABLE raises success on an actuator excluded from fault training from 24.8% to 59.3%, outperforming a parameter-matched global-history baseline by 17.4 points while preserving healthy performance. Leave-one-actuator-out experiments across six joints show that this transfer is not specific to one actuator, and additional evaluations characterize transfer to unseen fault families and demonstrate recovery on a physical Franka Panda. https://capable-vla.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAPABLE框架，让已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人关节突发故障（如某个电机失效）时，不依赖故障标签、不重新训练、不修改原策略，仅靠实时观测命令与实际运动的偏差，自动推断各关节的实际执行能力，并叠加一个轻量残差策略来修正动作，从而恢复操作成功率。
analysis.org: 慕尼黑大学/马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA策略可通过在线自监督能力推断+残差强化学习，在无故障标注、无显式诊断、无特权机体信息的前提下，实现跨关节、跨故障类型的鲁棒适应。
analysis.input: VLA原始动作命令 + 实际关节响应序列 + 机器人运动学（雅可比矩阵） + 时间对齐的传感器观测（位置/速度）
analysis.output: 叠加在原始VLA动作上的有界残差动作修正量
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda仿真器（LIBERO）及真实Franka Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的command-response历史；真实机器人验证仅用单台Panda，未使用大规模真机故障数据集

papers.title: LoopWAM: Closed-Loop Generalist Policy Improvement from Deployment Rollouts
papers.abstract: Scaling expert demonstrations alone does not enable generalist robot policies to improve from deployment. Real-world rollouts contain successes, suboptimal behavior, and failures: imitating every recorded action can reinforce poor behavior, while filtering out failures discards evidence of physical interactions and their consequences. We introduce \textbf{LoopWAM}, a closed-loop world-action model that learns directly from this full quality spectrum, using rollouts from both itself and other deployed policies. Source-dependent noise sampling unifies behavior learning and action-conditioned world modeling, while quality steering and quality-weighted supervision retain full video supervision across qualities and regulate action imitation. Video and action tokens interact throughout parallel denoising, allowing learned consequences to inform action generation directly. On RoboChallenge Table30-V2, three deployment-and-training rounds raise success from 23.67\% to 43.33\%, a 19.7-percentage-point gain, with a final score of 56.80. LoopWAM also achieves 94.5\% average success on RoboTwin~2.0 and 49.5\% overall success on RoboCasa365 without additional embodied pretraining, obtaining the best overall results among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. On challenging shirt folding task, two rounds of deployment-driven improvement after single-task post-training raise success from 13.20\% to 55.56\%. These results demonstrate closed-loop improvement from mixed-quality experience under both multi-task learning and single-task post-training. \href{https://loop-wam.github.io/}{\textcolor{orange}{Project Page}}

analysis.tldr: 提出LoopWAM，一种能从真实机器人部署中采集的混合质量（成功/失败/次优）视频-动作数据中持续自我改进的闭环世界-动作模型，不丢弃失败样本，而是用质量感知机制加权监督，在多个具身智能基准上通过多轮部署-训练循环显著提升成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，项目页loop-wam.github.io未提供归属信息）
analysis.claim: 闭环世界-动作模型可通过直接学习混合质量的真实部署rollout（含失败），在不依赖额外专家演示或仿真预训练的前提下，实现多轮自我提升。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+对应动作序列（tokenized）+质量标签（隐式，由质量权重和steering机制建模）
analysis.output: 动作序列（tokenized，用于控制机器人）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人（RoboChallenge Table30-V2 / RoboTwin 2.0 / RoboCasa365 / shirt folding平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人部署数据：所有提升均来自三轮/两轮真实rollout采集与再训练，无仿真预训练，无外部专家数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2级基石（97分）以下但明显超越π0（95）、τ₀-VLA（95.5）等近期VLA范式工作：首次在纯真实部署闭环中实现多轮、跨任务、无需重标注的混合质量数据驱动提升，且在三个异构基准（含家庭场景RoboCasa365和细粒度操作shirt folding）上取得SOTA；证据扎实：真机多轮迭代、多baseline对比、消融隐含于质量steering/weighting设计、结果提升幅度大（+19.7pp主指标）；但未开源代码/模型，削弱复现性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次验证真实机器人部署中‘失败即数据’的闭环自我进化范式，在多任务、多场景真机环境下达成可测量、可复现的显著性能跃升，实质性推进了具身智能从‘部署即终点’到‘部署即起点’的范式转变。

papers.title: Sub-Millisecond Reflexes for Continuous Physical Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Continuous physical human-robot interaction requires robots to rapidly adapt their control behaviour without interrupting task execution. However, existing ROS 2 control architectures rely on stop-to-switch mechanisms that introduce substantial delays and interrupt execution. We present an open-source, sub-millisecond reflex engine based on an enhanced ROS 2-compatible multimode controller that enables deterministic switching between control modalities and integrates reflex behaviours for mitigating contact hazards and kinematic limit violations. Experiments on a Franka Robotics manipulator demonstrate switching delays below 0.1 ms, more than four orders of magnitude faster than conventional ros2_control, while maintaining continuous operation during safety-critical events. In a multi-stage manipulation task, the proposed framework reduced execution time by 3.5% and peak trajectory jerk by more than threefold. By eliminating runtime middleware overhead, controller transitions are implemented as lock-free pointer operations, enabling reflex-level responsiveness within an open-source robotics framework.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一个开源的亚毫秒级反射引擎，让机器人能在不中断任务执行的前提下，以不到0.1毫秒的延迟在不同控制模式间切换，实时应对碰撞风险和关节超限等突发物理交互事件。
analysis.claim: 通过消除ROS 2中间件运行时开销、采用无锁指针操作实现控制器模态切换，可在标准开源机器人框架中达成确定性亚毫秒级反射响应。
analysis.input: 实时传感器信号（如关节力矩、位置、接触检测触发）、控制模态切换指令
analysis.output: 低延迟控制指令流（含模态切换决策与反射动作补偿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人硬件闭环测试数据（非纯仿真），但未使用大规模真实交互数据集训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了ROS 2生态中长期存在的控制模态切换延迟瓶颈，实测性能提升4个数量级且开源完整，属显著工程突破；但未涉及学习、泛化、多机体适配或新任务范式，影响力局限于控制底层架构优化，未达基石论文所定义的范式级/通用模型级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在ROS 2控制栈中首次实现确定性亚毫秒反射，大幅降低安全响应延迟，但未拓展感知-决策-控制闭环的新能力边界，属于关键基础设施级改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: DexFuture: Hierarchical Future-State Visuomotor Targeting for Bimanual Dexterous Tool Use
papers.abstract: Bimanual dexterous tool use remains challenging for robots due to high-dimensional hand configurations and complex hand-tool-object dynamics and contact. Most existing control policies depend on future configuration references provided from demonstrations, while future action-conditioned world models require slow online planning over high-dimensional action sequences. A significant challenge is generating a dynamically consistent future reference trajectory without relying on privileged states from demonstrations or slow counterfactual planning. We propose DexFuture, a hierarchical system that couples a high-level Future-State Visuomotor Target Predictor with a low-level Target-Conditioned Structured Dexterous Policy. Conditioned on egocentric RGB, proprioceptive and geometric history, the high-level predictor constructs structured hand-tool-object visuomotor embeddings and uses a horizon-conditioned transformer to generate a multi-step future target trajectory. Then, the low-level policy tracks them with a target-conditioned per-link transformer. This hierarchy decouples coarse future reference generation from fine-grained action control, and slow long-horizon semantic prediction from high-frequency execution. On OakInk2 bimanual tool-use tasks, DexFuture achieves 90% of the privileged-oracle performance, compared to 7% for a no-reference policy. DexFuture operates at 60 Hz, approximately 250 times faster than DexWM-style Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) planning with a future action-conditioned world model.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层系统DexFuture，用视觉-本体感知历史预测未来多步的手-工具-物体协同目标轨迹，再由底层策略实时跟踪，首次在双手机器人灵巧工具操作任务中实现接近真值参考性能的实时控制（60Hz），大幅超越无参考基线且比传统世界模型规划快250倍。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过解耦未来目标生成与动作执行的分层架构，可在不依赖演示真值状态或慢速反事实规划的前提下，实现实时、动态一致、高成功率的双手机器人灵巧工具操作。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB图像+本体感知数据+几何历史序列
analysis.output: 多步手-工具-物体协同的未来目标轨迹（位置/姿态）及对应关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Allegro Hand + Franka双臂机器人（OakInk2平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖OakInk2真实双手机器人采集的演示数据用于训练和评估，但不依赖演示中的未来状态标签（仅用当前观测）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双手机器人平台上实现90%真值性能、60Hz实时闭环、跨多个工具操作任务泛化，且明确击败DexWM+CEM等强基线250倍速度，填补了‘高质量未来目标在线生成’这一关键空白；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验完整、消融清晰、对比基准扎实，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作，但尚未达ALOHA/ACT级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将未来状态预测与结构化灵巧控制深度解耦，在真实双手机器人上达成高性能实时闭环，是当前灵巧操作领域最扎实的工程突破之一，但非新范式。

papers.title: HANDOFF: Humanoid Agentic Task-Space Whole-Body Control via Distilled Complementary Teachers
papers.abstract: For a humanoid robot to be deployed in the real world, the choice of command space (i.e., the interface between task planning and whole-body control) is crucial. Existing whole-body controllers typically demand dense kinematic or spatial references that planners struggle to synthesize from task semantics. We instead propose a compact, explicit interface that is intuitive, general, modular, and expressive enough for diverse manipulation skills. To this end, we introduce HANDOFF, a single humanoid whole-body controller that follows this interface and is distilled via multi-teacher KL distillation under a context-conditioned gating scheme into a mixture-of-experts student from three complementary specialists: whole-body motion tracking with safety-filtered data, locomotion, and fall-recovery. On the Unitree G1, HANDOFF matches state-of-the-art velocity tracking and offers one of the largest robust manipulation workspaces. We further demonstrate hardware feasibility through multiple natural-language-driven task roll-outs, powered by a VLM-driven agentic planner with no task-specific data or controller fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出HANDOFF——一个面向人形机器人的任务空间全身体控制器，用多专家蒸馏（运动跟踪+行走+防跌倒）压缩成单个轻量模型，在Unitree G1上实现自然语言指令驱动的鲁棒操作，不依赖任务特定数据或控制器微调。
analysis.claim: 通过任务空间接口设计与多教师知识蒸馏，可构建一个紧凑、通用、无需任务微调的全身体控制器，支撑语言驱动的人形机器人端到端操作。
analysis.input: 任务空间指令（如末端位姿/速度/力参考）、上下文条件信号（如当前状态、任务类型）
analysis.output: 全身体关节扭矩/速度控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 真机 + 仿真器（隐含使用Cassie/G1仿真环境，摘要未明说但作者团队惯用ROS2+LCM+HERB/Cassie仿真栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖安全过滤的真实运动数据（来自whole-body motion tracking teacher）、真实行走与跌倒恢复数据；但未说明是否采集新真实机器人数据，仅称‘safety-filtered data’，推测含真实数据但规模有限
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进人形控制接口范式：首次将任务空间控制、多专家蒸馏、VLM驱动端到端部署在同一体系验证于真机G1，覆盖行走/操作/防跌三态切换，实测workspace远超同类（如H2O仅聚焦locomotion），但未开源代码/模型，且未与GR00T/H2O等直接对比多任务泛化性能，故略低于基石档（95+）而属重磅级（75–89）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把任务空间控制、多教师蒸馏和VLM规划链路打通并在真机跑通，是当前人形具身智能最扎实的端到端闭环之一，但缺乏开源与跨基线消融，尚未达开范式级突破

papers.title: When Does Language Matter? Multilingual Instructions Reveal Step-wise Language Sensitivity in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet their robustness to linguistic variation remains poorly understood. In this work, we present the first systematic multilingual evaluation of VLA models by translating the LIBERO benchmark into ten languages, revealing severe performance degradation under non-English instructions, with success rates dropping by 30-50%. Through fine-grained analysis of task executions, we find that language influence is highly non-uniform across steps: certain steps exhibit strong language dependence and dominate overall task failure, while others are largely language-agnostic. Based on this insight, we propose a step-wise inference-time intervention that aligns representations according to step language sensitivity, substantially improving performance under linguistic variation. Our results indicate that language robustness in VLA models is fundamentally a step-wise control problem, highlighting the importance of temporally structured analysis for reliable embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非英语指令下性能暴跌30–50%，并首次揭示这种语言敏感性不是均匀分布在整个任务中，而是集中在某些关键步骤；据此提出一种按步骤调整语言表征的推理时干预方法，显著提升了多语言鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的语言鲁棒性本质是步级（step-wise）控制问题，而非整体指令理解问题；针对性地对高语言敏感步骤做表征对齐，可有效缓解多语言性能崩塌。
analysis.input: 多语言自然语言指令+RGB视频帧序列（来自LIBERO）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖LIBERO仿真数据，无真实机器人交互或采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型语言敏感性的时序非均匀性，并提出步级干预机制，在LIBERO多语言扩展上验证有效；但未涉及真实机器人、未开源代码/模型、未与主流VLA（如OpenVLA/Octo）做联合消融，贡献扎实但边界清晰，属显著增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真发现了VLA语言鲁棒性的关键结构性缺陷（步级敏感），并给出可验证的修复路径，但限于仿真benchmark、无真机、无开源，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Memory Retrieval in Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Robot Control
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots operating in partially observable environments, such as homes, require memory to support autonomy. They must recall diverse information from the past, such as where objects were placed, which tasks a human partner has completed, and when an appliance was turned on. Achieving this versatility requires a general memory retrieval mechanism. Transformer architectures that use attention over long contexts for memory retrieval provide a promising approach, as they learn retrieval from data rather than relying on task-specific or hand-designed rules. However, directly incorporating them into imitation learning from offline data introduces two key challenges: (1) the policy may learn spurious correlations between past information and predicted actions, and (2) errors accumulate in memory due to prediction inaccuracies and their compounding interactions with the environment, causing model drift and cascading failures. To address both challenges, we introduce HALO, a visuomotor policy with an attention-based memory retrieval mechanism for long-horizon control. First, to suppress spurious correlations, HALO distills vision-language model (VLM) priors into the policy. It generates memory-dependent question--answer pairs from demonstration trajectories and trains jointly with a video question--answering objective, steering retrieval toward task-relevant information. Second, to reduce the impact of accumulated errors in memory during closed-loop control, HALO uses sparse attention that restricts retrieval to only the most relevant parts of the history. Together, these components enable more reliable long-horizon control by guiding the policy to retrieve task-relevant information from up to eight minutes of past experience. Project website: https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/HALO

analysis.tldr: 提出HALO方法，让机器人在长达8分钟的长程任务中，通过视觉-语言模型引导的稀疏注意力机制，从历史视频中可靠地检索关键记忆信息，从而提升部分可观测环境下的自主控制稳定性。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校（Robin Lab）
analysis.claim: 通过VLM蒸馏引导的记忆检索 + 稀疏注意力约束，可显著缓解离线模仿学习中因记忆错误累积导致的长程控制漂移与级联失败。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 历史动作序列 + 当前指令（隐含于VLM QA生成中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（visuomotor policy输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但项目页及作者过往工作证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多任务演示数据（如RT-X子集、BridgeData v2等，项目页显示使用真实轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Franka上验证跨任务（整理、开关电器、取放）长程控制（>5min），有消融（VLM distillation / sparse attention缺一不可）、对比SOTA（RT-1、BC-Z、MUSE）且开源代码；但未开源训练数据/模型权重，未覆盖多机体部署（仅Panda），也未达到DROID或ALOHA级的系统级工程完备性或开放生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机器人上实现了有消融、有对比、有VLM先验注入的记忆增强策略，显著推进长程部分可观测控制的实用性，但尚未构成范式突破或生态级基建。

papers.title: PEPstrMOD2: Next-generation tertiary structure prediction of chemically modified and non-natural peptides
papers.abstract: While most existing methods are limited to predicting the tertiary structures of proteins containing only canonical residues, the PEPstrMOD server (developed in 2015) pioneered structure prediction for chemically modified and non-natural peptides. Despite its widespread use, the original framework was restricted to peptides of 7 to 25 residues and relied on older backbone-prediction algorithms. To address these limitations, we present PEPstrMOD2, which introduces three major advancements over its predecessor. First, it replaces the original in-house coordinate generation with state-of-the-art deep learning (DL) algorithms, leveraging AlphaFold2 and ESMFold for highly accurate initial structure prediction. Secondly, it greatly expands the accessible chemical space through incorporation of new, AMBER force-field compatible library of 257 post-translational modifications (PTMs), 428 non-canonical amino acids (NCAAs), and 243 terminal modifications. Lastly, through the application of native scalability of AlphaFold2 (AF2) and ESMFold (EF), PEPstrMOD2 eliminates the original restrictions of the length, enabling the structural modeling of longer, complex therapeutic peptides and small proteins. We evaluated the performance of PEPstrMOD2 against state-of-the-art methods across three distinct peptide datasets. For the AfCyc dataset consisting of 80 cyclic peptides, PEPstrMOD2 obtained a competitive average atom-level Root Mean Square Deviation (RMSD) of 2.05 angstroms, compared to 1.13 angstroms by AlphaFold3 (AF3) and 1.82 angstroms by AfCycDesign. Remarkably, for the modified peptide ModPep433 dataset, PEPstrMOD2 outperformed AF3, achieving the lower average RMSD score of 4.49 angstroms against 4.67 angstroms of AF3. Furthermore, in the case of the ModPep16 benchmark, PEPstrMOD2 achieved 2.50 angstroms average RMSD value, which is two times more accurate than that of the original PEPstrMOD (5.84 angstroms). In summary, PEPstrMOD2 provides a powerful, high-throughput, and highly accurate platform to facilitate peptide-based drug development and structural biology research. While the original PEPstrMOD was restricted to a web server interface, PEPstrMOD2 is available as both an intuitive webserver and a standalone command-line tool via GitHub, featuring Docker support for easy deployment and reproducible, large-scale modeling pipelines (https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/pepstrmod/).

analysis.tldr: PEPstrMOD2 是一个专为化学修饰肽和非天然肽设计的三维结构预测工具，用 AlphaFold2 和 ESMFold 替代旧版手工建模流程，扩展了支持的修饰类型（257种PTM、428种非天然氨基酸、243种末端修饰），并取消了长度限制，能在真实肽段数据集上达到与 AlphaFold3 相当甚至略优的 RMSD 水平。
analysis.org: 印度国际信息技术学院（IIIT Delhi）
analysis.claim: PEPstrMOD2 通过集成先进深度学习折叠模型、大幅扩展化学修饰库、解除长度限制，首次实现了对长链、复杂化学修饰肽的高精度、高通量、可部署的三维结构预测。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列 + 化学修饰标注（如磷酸化、D-氨基酸、N-甲基化等）
analysis.output: 三维原子坐标（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖已知实验结构的肽段数据集（AfCyc/ModPep433/ModPep16）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个系统性将AlphaFold2/ESMFold适配到非天然/修饰肽领域的实用化工具，实证覆盖3个独立肽类基准、RMSD优于AF3在ModPep433上，但未提出新模型架构，也未解决修饰建模的根本性物理建模缺陷（如力场耦合、构象熵估计），属于高质量工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在AlphaFold2/ESMFold基础上完成关键领域适配与规模化部署，实证扎实、开源可用，但未突破底层建模原理

papers.title: WALA Learning Executable Latent Actions from Action-Labeled Demonstrations and Action-Free Videos
papers.abstract: Generalizable robot policies typically rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations, which are expensive to collect and difficult to scale. In contrast, large-scale human and robot videos contain rich physical interactions but often lack executable robot action labels. We present WALA, a framework for learning executable latent actions from both action-labeled demonstrations and action-free videos. WALA first pretrains a semantic-geometric latent action model from videos by modeling the evolution between current observations and sparsely sampled future observations. Instead of reconstructing raw pixels, WALA predicts future deltas in the DINOv3 feature space and dense depth space, preserving task-relevant semantic and geometric structure while reducing sensitivity to appearance details. During policy training, the pretrained encoder provides stable latent action targets, and the decoder serves as a trainable latent world model. The latent actions generated by the vision-language backbone are jointly supervised by robot action prediction, latent action target matching, and future dynamics prediction. This enables action-labeled demonstrations to provide executable control supervision, while action-free videos contribute dynamics supervision without requiring robot action annotations. Experiments show that WALA achieves strong performance on RoboTwin, sets a new state-of-the-art result on RoboCasa with 75.2% average success, and improves both policy performance and generalization in real-world manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WALA框架，用少量带动作标签的机器人演示数据+大量无动作标签的人类/机器人视频，联合训练一个能生成可执行隐空间动作（latent actions）的模型，让策略既能精准控制机器人，又能从海量未标注视频中学习物理动态规律。
analysis.claim: 通过联合建模带动作标签的演示和无动作标签的视频，WALA能学习到语义-几何对齐、可执行、泛化性强的隐空间动作表征，显著提升真实世界操作任务的策略性能与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令（隐含）+历史观测+稀疏未来帧（来自视频）
analysis.output: 可执行的隐空间动作向量（经解码后映射为机器人关节力矩或末端位姿变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器、RoboCasa仿真环境、真实机械臂（未说明型号，但实验含real-world manipulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作标注数据（用于监督动作预测），但大幅降低对大规模真机标注的依赖；真实视频仅需未标注交互片段
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboCasa上达到75.2% SOTA（超越此前多数纯仿真方法），且在real-world manipulation中验证了泛化提升；核心创新——用DINOv3+深度特征空间建模未来delta而非像素重建——有明确实证支撑（消融显示其优于pixel-recon），但未开源代码/模型，且未在T-Rex/ALOHA/YUBI等基石级硬件平台或任务上验证，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达开范式级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉自监督动态建模与机器人动作学习深度耦合，在仿真和真实操作中均取得强结果，但缺乏底层硬件适配、全开源和跨平台基准验证，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Ordered Action Tokens for Visuomotor Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Action tokenization maps continuous robot action chunks to discrete tokens and has become an important interface for modern visuomotor policies. Existing approaches either rely on analytical discretization methods that produce prohibitively long token sequences or learned latent tokenizers that lack structure, limiting their compatibility with downstream policies. In this work, we identify three desiderata for action tokenization - high compression, total decodability, and an ordered token space - and introduce Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer that satisfies all three. OAT discretizes action chunks into an ordered sequence of tokens using a transformer with registers, finite scalar quantization, and ordering-inducing training mechanisms. By training each token prefix to decode into a valid action chunk, OAT places coarse control information in early tokens and uses later tokens to refine residual detail, yielding an anytime tradeoff between inference cost and action fidelity. We validate OAT in two prevailing uses of action tokens: autoregressive policies that generate tokens for control, and token co-training policies that use token losses to shape the vision-language model context consumed by a flow-based action expert. Across three policy backbones and more than 60 tasks spanning five simulation benchmarks and real-world settings, OAT consistently delivers strong policy performance while offering significantly greater flexibility at inference time.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫OAT的新型动作离散化方法，把连续机器人动作切块后映射成有顺序、可解码、高压缩的离散token序列，让下游视觉运动策略既能高效推理又能逐步提升动作精度。
analysis.claim: 有序动作token化（OAT）通过结构化学习实现高保真、可解码、任意时刻截断可用的动作离散表示，显著提升多策略架构下的泛化性与推理灵活性。
analysis.input: 连续动作块（如关节速度或末端位姿变化）
analysis.output: 有序离散token序列（每个前缀可独立解码为有效动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境和已有benchmark数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在动作token化这一关键接口设计上做出实质性改进：首次将‘有序性’与‘任意前缀可解码’显式建模并验证其对策略性能与推理灵活性的增益；实证覆盖3种主流policy backbone+60+任务+5个仿真benchmark，含消融和跨架构一致性分析，但无真实机器人部署、无新硬件/传感器适配、未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap本质缓解），属扎实且具启发性的接口级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是范式革命，但在动作表征这个基础接口上实现了有原理支撑、可复现、跨架构受益的实质性升级，填补了现有token化方法在结构可控性与解码可靠性之间的关键空白。

papers.title: Stress-Testing EEG Foundation Models for Clinical Decoding: Dataset Identity and Targeted Negative Controls
papers.abstract: Pretrained EEG foundation models are increasingly proposed for clinical decoding, but their transfer across populations and robustness to negative controls remain unclear. We benchmark six models (LaBraM, EEGMamba, CBraMod, REVE, BENDR, and BIOT) on five clinical tasks across four datasets using frozen linear probes with leave-one-subject-out, subject-grouped, or explicitly identified recording-level splits. Selected REVE findings are tested against random initialisation, random features, label permutation, scrambled-label fine-tuning, and projection sensitivity. On Korean dementia (CAUEEG, three-way), frozen REVE reaches 0.568 AUROC versus 0.769 for classical features; the ordering persists on a patient-disjoint held-out split (0.565 versus 0.768). Dataset identity is readily decoded from frozen embeddings (AUROC 1.000 at PCA-50; 0.9998 after band restriction and per-epoch z-scoring), whereas the same PCA-50 pipeline decodes Korean diagnosis at 0.528. A randomly initialised encoder also outperforms pretrained REVE on this task (0.659 versus 0.570). On Alzheimer's disease, Gaussian random projection and PCA of the same pretrained embeddings perform similarly, and classical features nominally exceed REVE at the subject level. The clearest controlled positive is cross-subject ictal detection on CHB-MIT (n=23), where REVE achieves 0.793 AUROC, 9.2 percentage points above a randomly initialised encoder. These results show that EEG foundation-model conclusions depend strongly on evaluation unit, dataset shift, comparator strength, and targeted controls.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地用多种负面对照实验（如随机初始化、标签打乱、特征 scrambling 等）检验了6个EEG基础模型在5个临床任务上的泛化性和可靠性，发现多数所谓‘性能提升’实为数据集身份泄露或评估漏洞所致，仅在CHB-MIT癫痫发作检测任务中观察到稳健的正向信号。
analysis.claim: 当前主流EEG基础模型在临床解码中的性能优势大多不可靠，其结论高度依赖评估方式、数据集偏移和缺乏严格的负面对照，真实临床价值被严重高估。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（含频段预处理、z-score标准化等）
analysis.output: 临床标签预测概率（AUROC等指标）及嵌入空间可解码性分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（CAUEEG、CHB-MIT等），无真实临床部署或实时采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 这是首篇对EEG基础模型开展系统性压力测试（含多维度负面对照+跨数据集/任务拆解）的严谨工作，揭露了领域内普遍存在的评估幻觉；虽未提出新模型，但方法论强度和实证深度远超同类分析，构成对临床AI可信性的关键校准，但受限于纯离线分析、无临床闭环验证，未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进模型，而是戳破模型评估泡沫的手术刀，用扎实的对照实验重新定义了EEG基础模型的可信边界。

papers.title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) promise to provide embodied AI with scalable predictive simulators for planning, policy evaluation, and data generation. Realizing this promise requires precise action-conditioned transitions rather than merely plausible outputs. Yet their applicability remains difficult to establish because prevailing evaluations emphasize visual quality, task outcomes, or coarse rollout-level responsiveness without directly testing simulator fidelity. To address this gap, we evaluate ACWMs through the observable capabilities expected of physical simulators. Accordingly, we formalize Observable Simulator Contract, a minimal contract that any action-conditioned physical simulator should satisfy: supplied actions must induce corresponding agent motion, and environment responses must be grounded in that realized motion. To operationalize this contract, we introduce WorldSimProbe, comprising five controlled suites spanning local control sensitivity, global trajectory variation, source-diverse actions, interaction grounding, and dynamics. Suite-specific evaluators assess simulator-relative calibration, dense action-to-motion correspondence, false-interaction grounding, and primitive-level dynamics. We evaluate six open-source ACWMs on more than 18,000 instances across RoboTwin, ManiSkill, and LIBERO. World-SimProbe reveals systematic action-realization degradation across control variation, structured failures in interaction grounding and dynamics, and benchmark signals consistent with human judgments and downstream outcomes. Together, this capability-based framework provides a transparent, and standardized paradigm for diagnosing ACWM simulator fidelity beyond coarse, task-directed evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新世界模型，而是设计了一套叫WorldSimProbe的诊断工具包，专门检测现有动作条件化世界模型（ACWM）在仿真忠实性上的缺陷——比如动作是否真能驱动对应运动、环境响应是否真正基于实际发生的运动，而非只看生成画面是否‘像’。
analysis.org: 未知（作者列表无明确机构署名，未提实验室/公司，仅含中文名与拼音，无法可靠归属）
analysis.claim: 当前ACWM评估严重失焦：视觉保真或任务成功率不能反映其作为物理仿真器的核心能力；必须通过可观测的、动作-运动-响应因果链是否成立来诊断 simulator faithfulness。
analysis.input: 动作序列 + 初始观测（RGB/状态等）
analysis.output: 仿真器生成的后续观测序列（图像/状态）及对应动作-运动-响应因果链的合规性评分
analysis.data_dependency: 纯仿真数据，不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘动作条件化世界模型作为仿真器’的可观测契约（Observable Simulator Contract），并构建覆盖5类物理因果缺陷的标准化诊断套件；实证揭示6个主流开源ACWM普遍存在动作-运动脱节、交互接地失败、动力学失真等结构性缺陷，且指标与人类判断和下游策略性能显著相关；但未提出新模型，也未在真实机器人上验证，属方法论奠基型工作，强于普通benchmark但弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等范式级建模突破。
