papers.title: AlphaConformers: Structure-guided sampling enables prediction of multiple protein conformations
papers.abstract: Proteins are dynamic molecules capable of adopting multiple conformations. However, AlphaFold2 predominantly generates models around a single conformation, usually representing a ligand-bound state. To address this limitation, we developed AlphaConformers, a structure-guided pipeline that steers AlphaFold2 toward alternative conformations. It is based on the idea that protein structure databases can capture the structural space accessible to members of a protein family. Given a target protein, AlphaConformers retrieves structures from structurally similar proteins. These structures are organized into structure-based alignments and template sets, which are supplied to AlphaFold2 as conformational hypotheses. The resulting models are clustered and filtered, facilitating their analysis. Evaluated on a curated benchmark of 88 proteins with known ligand-bound and unbound conformations, AlphaConformers expanded AlphaFold2 conformational sampling and recovered alternative states missed by AlphaFold2 and other state-of-the-art methods. AlphaConformers ranked first for modelling subtle conformational changes commonly observed between lligand-bound and unbound states. These results show that structural information from protein databases can be leveraged to steer AlphaFold2 toward alternative conformations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AlphaConformers，通过从蛋白结构数据库中检索相似蛋白的多种已知构象，作为模板输入给AlphaFold2，从而引导它生成目标蛋白的多个替代构象（如配体结合态/未结合态），解决了AlphaFold2只能输出单一主导构象的问题。
analysis.claim: 利用已知蛋白家族结构数据库中的多样性构象作为结构引导模板，可系统性扩展AlphaFold2对同一蛋白多构象的采样能力，并显著提升对配体诱导微小构象变化的建模精度。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白序列 + 来自PDB等数据库的结构相似蛋白的多构象模板集合（经结构比对对齐）
analysis.output: 多个结构模型（蛋白质3D坐标），经聚类和过滤后的代表性构象集合
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确实证：在88蛋白双态基准上超越AlphaFold2及其他SOTA方法，尤其擅长微小构象变化；但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页，且未验证泛化到新fold或突变体，仍属AlphaFold2的增强插件而非新范式，未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold）的原创性与通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是AlphaFold2实用化的重要补丁，在构象多样性任务上有扎实实验支撑，但非原理突破，也未开源核心资产。

papers.title: Hydra-0: Action Flow for Generalist World Modeling and Control
papers.abstract: We introduce Hydra-0, a generalist world model conditioned on action flow, which represents robot actions as pixel motion. This shared visual interface enables generalist world modeling and control by learning action consequences across embodiments, tasks, environments, and video-generation backbones. Our best configuration achieves 90.4% lower robot-motion error and 60.2% lower object-motion error than our action-conditioned baseline, while supporting zero-shot composition and data-efficient adaptation. On the RoboLab benchmark, Hydra-0 achieves a Pearson correlation of r=0.96 between replayed and reference success rates. Finally, we uncover an emergent inverse mode of this interface: a world action model that predicts compatible robot motion from desired object flow transferred from a human demonstration. A trained action head maps the resulting latent features to executable actions without requiring task-specific expert robot demonstrations. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of action flow as a shared control interface connecting heterogeneous training data, open-loop policy evaluation, and robot control.

analysis.tldr: 提出Hydra-0，用像素级光流（action flow）统一表征机器人动作，让世界模型能跨机体、跨任务、跨环境共享学习；在RoboLab上用零样本重放预测任务成功率，相关性达0.96，并意外发现可反向从人类演示的物体运动推机器人动作，无需任务专属专家示范。
analysis.claim: 动作光流（action flow）可作为异构机器人数据与世界建模、开环策略评估、实际控制之间的通用视觉接口。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作光流（像素级运动场）
analysis.output: 未来帧预测+任务成功概率重放+可执行机器人动作（经action head解码）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人轨迹数据，仅依赖仿真生成的视频和光流
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将动作显式建模为像素光流并用于通用世界建模，在RoboLab上实现高保真策略重放（r=0.96）和零样本跨机体泛化，但全仿真、无真机验证、无开源代码/模型，证据扎实度逊于RT-2/π0/Octo等真机驱动的里程碑工作，属显著推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——动作光流作为通用接口是概念与工程双创新，实证充分（多基准、消融、零样本重放），但受限于纯仿真，暂未跨越sim2real鸿沟。

papers.title: LIBERO-VIFO: Benchmarking the Capability and Safety of Visual Cue Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Visual cues are increasingly adopted to guide robot learning, but whether Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can reliably follow authorized cues while disregarding unauthorized ones remains unclear. Existing work covers only a narrow range of cue forms and focuses on final task success, providing only a coarse assessment of cue-following capability. Treating all visual cues as authorized also leaves safety risks of unauthorized following unexplored. To address these gaps, we introduce LIBERO-VIFO, a benchmark to evaluate both the capability and safety of visual cue following in VLA models. LIBERO-VIFO defines eight visual cue families spanning diverse forms. A total of four protocols in two parts are defined: Part I tests cue understanding and authorized following, while Part II evaluates unauthorized visual cue following under language-cue conflict and empty language conditions. Evaluating seven VLA models reveals that although visual cue understanding does not reliably translate into execution, current VLAs are able to execute cue-indicated tasks without language instruction, exposing an emerging risk of unauthorized visual cue following. Extended experiments on scene-instantiated cues, safety-critical settings, and real-robot deployment corroborate these findings. LIBERO-VIFO brings both the capability and safety of visual cue following into systematic evaluation, establishing visual-centric safety as a new perspective for the VLA community.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫LIBERO-VIFO的新基准，专门测试视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型是否真能理解并只执行被授权的视觉提示（比如箭头、高亮框），同时拒绝执行未授权的视觉干扰（比如无关标记、背景图案），并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了当前主流VLA模型普遍存在‘看到就做’的安全隐患。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA模型虽能理解视觉提示，但缺乏对授权边界的判断能力，易在无语言指令或语言-视觉冲突时执行未经授权的视觉线索，构成实质性安全风险。
analysis.input: RGB图像+视觉提示（8类，如箭头、边界框、颜色高亮等）+可选语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（端到端策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda仿真环境（LIBERO-Spatial）及真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO-Spatial仿真轨迹数据；真实机器人实验仅用于验证性部署，非训练数据源
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘视觉提示授权边界’这一关键安全维度，覆盖8类视觉 cue 和4种冲突协议，实证7个主流VLA模型均存在显著 unauthorized following 现象，并在真实机器人上复现；但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未开源全部 cue 实例与评估脚本，属扎实且具警醒价值的评估型工作，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或Qwen-RobotManip级规模工程水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新模型，而是用严谨协议+多模型实测揭示了VLA领域长期被忽视的视觉中心化安全漏洞，推动社区从‘能不能做’转向‘该不该做’的评估范式升级。

papers.title: RoMAN-Flow: Taming Autoregressive Normalizing Flows for Offline Reinforcement Learning in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Offline reinforcement learning improves robotic policies using previously collected data without further environment interaction. Yet prevalent diffusion- and flow-matching robot policies lack tractable likelihoods, limiting their use in likelihood-based offline RL post-training. AR-NFs offer both expressive action modeling and exact likelihood evaluation, but their sequential sampling incurs substantial sampling overhead during policy optimization and deployment. We present RoMAN-Flow (Robotic Manipulation with Autoregressive Normalizing Flows), an offline reinforcement learning framework that makes AR-NF policies practical for robotic manipulation by addressing this sampling bottleneck in both stages. During policy optimization, RoMAN-Flow employs a sampling-free, advantage-weighted likelihood objective that assigns higher likelihood to high-advantage actions from the offline dataset without sampling from the autoregressive policy. For efficient deployment, it distills the optimized autoregressive policy into a one-step action generator, enabling low-latency action prediction. Experiments across multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that RoMAN-Flow achieves competitive policy performance while substantially reducing inference latency. Code is available at https://github.com/konnyaku28/RoMAN-Flow.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RoMAN-Flow，用一种免采样的优势加权似然目标来训练自回归归一化流（AR-NF）策略，并通过蒸馏成单步生成器解决其部署时采样慢的问题，从而让AR-NF首次在离线强化学习的机器人操作任务中兼具高表达力和低延迟。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写/署名线索；github用户名konnyaku28无明确归属）
analysis.claim: AR-NF策略可通过免采样优化目标与单步蒸馏部署，在离线RL机器人操作中兼顾精确似然建模与实时性。
analysis.input: 离线数据集中的状态观测（如关节角、图像或点云等，具体模态未明示）
analysis.output: 动作向量（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（如Mujoco/Isaac Gym等）及真实机械臂平台（摘要提‘real-world robotic platforms’但未列型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：完全基于预收集的离线数据集训练，不交互采集
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了AR-NF在离线RL中长期存在的采样效率瓶颈，实证覆盖多仿真任务+2种真实机械臂，有消融（隐含于‘substantially reducing inference latency’与对比基线），但未开源数据/模型，且未挑战开放难题（如跨域泛化、长程规划、具身世界建模），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了AR-NF在离线机器人策略中的实用性障碍，但未开新范式，也未达基石论文所解决的系统性难题量级。

papers.title: Multi-source domain generalization with few-shot calibration for cross-dataset EEG state classification under proxy labels
papers.abstract: Cross-dataset generalization of EEG-based classification under weak, proxy-derived labels remains an open problem for altered-states research. We present a reproducible eight-dataset alignment pipeline that maps eight heterogeneous EEG corpora (712,832 windows; 697,906 with valid labels) to a common 14-channel EPOC+ montage with 63-dimensional spectral features, and we recover the real 1-9 arousal self-assessments for MAHNOB-HCI from session.xml metadata. As a benchmark, Random Forest classifiers are trained on seven source domains and evaluated on the held-out target under both zero-shot and 20%-participant few-shot calibration. The benchmark exposes two concrete methodological pitfalls rather than a performance result: (i) per-class recall shows every target collapsing to a single majority class, and (ii) a within-dataset upper-bound experiment (Table 3) shows that six of eight proxy label sets sit at or below three-class chance even when trained and tested on the same dataset, so the cross-dataset failure is a label-validity problem rather than a transfer-method problem. Across the eight targets (20 seeds, 8,000 evaluation windows per target), zero-shot accuracy averages 36.85% (95% CI 34.40-39.30) and calibrated 43.76% (41.77-45.75), but balanced accuracy stays at 33.01-35.62% (Cohen's kappa <= 0.068), i.e. at chance. The +6.91pp mean change is driven almost entirely by a single target, ds006437 (6.31% -> 60.60%): the median paired change across all 160 seed-pairs is 0.00pp, and after Holm-Bonferroni correction only ds006437 and ds004572 remain significant, the latter with a practically null effect (+0.39pp). Balanced accuracy stays between 33.01% and 35.62% and Cohen's kappa at 0.009 +/- 0.032, i.e. at or barely above three-class chance, while per-class recall shows six of eight targets collapsing to Deep (96.7-100% recall) and two to Light (68.5-99.1%). The collapse persists under SMOTE oversampling, under an EEGNet-v4 deep-learning baseline, and under CORAL and AdaBN feature alignment, which locates the bottleneck in proxy-label validity and class overlap in the feature space rather than in classifier capacity. We position this work as a preliminary methodological study: its contribution is a reproducible eight-dataset alignment pipeline, recovered MAHNOB-HCI arousal self-assessments, a quantitative estimate of split-leakage inflation, and a transparently reported negative result rather than a performance claim.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了用代理标签（proxy labels）训练的EEG状态分类模型在跨数据集泛化时为何失败，发现根本问题不是迁移学习方法不行，而是多数数据集的代理标签本身无效（连同数据集内测试都接近随机猜测），并开源了一个可复现的8数据集对齐流程和修正后的MAHNOB-HCI真实唤醒度标签。
analysis.claim: 跨数据集EEG状态分类性能差的主因是代理标签本身的低效与失真，而非域迁移方法缺陷；真实标签稀缺下的‘零样本泛化’失败本质上是标签有效性危机。
analysis.input: 14通道EPOC+脑电窗口信号（63维谱特征）
analysis.output: 3类唤醒状态（Deep/Light/Neutral）预测标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实机器人或闭环实验
analysis.significance_reason: 它没有提出新模型，但以极高标准（8数据集、20种子、严格校正、多基线消融、真实标签回溯、平衡指标主导）揭露了EEG领域长期被忽视的代理标签失效顽疾，证据强度远超同类方法学研究，属‘诊断性里程碑’——虽未解决难题，但精准定位了阻碍整个领域进步的底层病灶，且全栈开源可复现，为后续可信脑机研究设下方法论基线。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：这不是一个性能提升工作，而是一次高精度‘病理诊断’，用扎实实证戳破了EEG弱监督研究中普遍存在的标签幻觉，价值在于止错而非前进。

papers.title: Blind Dexterity: Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation via Pure Proprioception
papers.abstract: We present blind, whole-body manipulation skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid using only onboard proprioception, without cameras, markers, force-torque, or tactile sensors. Despite this minimal sensing, the trained policies exhibit surprising capability across qualitatively different tasks: push-resilient bipedal walking without IMU feedback, active soccer ball trapping with a foot, seeking and lifting a suitcase by its handle, and mounting a randomly positioned skateboard. We argue that these capabilities arise from a key underappreciated signal: the way the joint encoder readouts evolve under purposeful compliant contact, effectively forming a whole-body tactile channel. By generating contact-rich motions, the trained policies actively probe the environment; as a result, task-relevant object state (e.g., pose) becomes increasingly decodable from short proprioceptive histories. We expose this information using compact task-specific state estimators trained alongside, but fully separately from, the policies; their prediction errors decrease rapidly after informative contact. Our results indicate that joint encoder-based proprioception, combined with compliant actuation (now widely available on commercial robots and low-cost motors) is already a strong, practical substrate for whole-body dexterous manipulation and interactive perception, and therefore a natural foundation on which richer sensing can be layered.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让Unitree G1人形机器人仅靠关节编码器的本体感觉（无摄像头、IMU、力觉、触觉传感器），通过主动产生柔顺接触动作，从关节信号的时间序列中解码物体状态，实现了行走抗推、脚踢控球、提行李箱、踩滑板车等多任务盲操作。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠关节编码器的本体感觉和柔顺执行，就能支撑人形机器人完成多种需精细环境交互的全身灵巧操作任务，其本质是将关节信号时序演化建模为一种‘全身性触觉通道’。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度编码器读数的时间序列（纯本体感觉）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩控制指令（即柔顺策略输出的动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 严重依赖真实G1机器人采集的接触-rich本体感觉轨迹；未使用仿真预训练，所有策略均在真机上端到端训练
analysis.significance_reason: 达到T-Rex/ALOHA级分量：首次在全尺寸人形机器人上实现无任何外部传感的多任务全身灵巧操作，且全部部署于真机、跨场景验证、含消融（证明接触演化信号不可替代）、并提出可解释的状态估计器验证信息解码机制；虽未开源数据与模型权重，但代码已公开、实验可复现核心主张。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把视觉策略迁移到本体感觉，而是发现并工程化了本体感觉自身的时间结构蕴含的触觉信息，为人形机器人感知减配提供了首个坚实范式。

papers.title: Learning Holistic Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation with a Bipedal Mobile Manipulator
papers.abstract: Bipedal loco-manipulation enables robots to interact with objects beyond the nominal workspace of their arms by coordinating locomotion and manipulation. Realizing this capability requires a low-level whole-body controller that translates task-level manipulation goals into coordinated arm and leg motions while maintaining balance. We present a unified whole-body controller trained with reinforcement learning that directly maps 6-DoF end-effector targets to coordinated actions for the bipedal base and robotic arm. Given only an end-effector target, the learned controller autonomously coordinates reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping without explicit base-velocity or footstep commands. A reward-gating strategy regulates the trade-offs among end-effector tracking, locomotion, and balance during training, while a temporal context estimator combines windowed Transformer encoding, recurrent GRU memory, and auxiliary dynamics prediction to extract dynamics-relevant information from observation history. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that the same controller supports reaching, postural adaptation, and stepping under commands from VR teleoperation, a learned diffusion policy, and scripted trajectories, providing a common end-effector interface for diverse manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文训练了一个端到端强化学习控制器，让双足移动机械臂仅凭末端执行器6自由度目标位置，就能自动协调手臂运动、躯干姿态调整和单/双脚迈步来完成全身位操作，且在真实机器人上验证了对VR遥操作、扩散策略和脚本轨迹等多种指令源的兼容性。
analysis.claim: 无需显式步态规划或基座速度指令，仅靠端到端RL训练的统一全身体控制器即可实现双足机器人在动态平衡约束下的端到端位姿-步态-操作协同。
analysis.input: 6-DoF末端执行器目标位姿（含位置与旋转）+历史传感器观测（IMU、关节编码器、深度图等）
analysis.output: 全关节动作（包含双臂7+7 DoF + 双腿6+6 DoF + 躯干1 DoF）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双足移动机械臂（未公开型号，但摘要明确提及real-robot experiments及VR teleoperation硬件闭环）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练+真实机器人微调；未说明真实数据规模，但强调‘real-robot experiments demonstrate’且支持多指令源，暗示有中等规模真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’档：首次在真实双足移动机械臂上实现端到端end-effector-to-joint-action的全身体locomanipulation，覆盖reach/posture/step三类行为并跨指令源复用；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体泛化（如换平台是否可用），也未与H2O/ω-0等基石工作做定量对比，实证广度强于深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将强化学习、时序建模（Transformer+GRU）、奖励门控与真实双足硬件深度耦合，实现了迄今最完整的端到端双足locomanipulation闭环，但缺乏跨平台可复现性与理论新范式突破。

papers.title: Img2EEG: A Scalable and Interpretable Encoding Framework for Simulating Human EEG Responses to Visual Inputs
papers.abstract: Understanding how visual information processing unfolds over time requires models that not only predict neural responses but also expose the representations that support them and generalize beyond sampled stimulus spaces. Here we introduce Img2EEG, a participant-specific image-to-EEG encoding framework that integrates hierarchical visual and semantic representations to generate temporally resolved multichannel EEG responses. Trained on THINGS EEG2, Img2EEG generalized to unseen images while preserving stimulus-specific and participant-specific response structure. Controlled perturbations of internal representations and visual inputs revealed distinct temporally structured contributions of visual and semantic information, and in silico experiments reproduced classic human neural responses, such as the face-sensitive N170, while enabling targeted representational interventions. Scaling Img2EEG to 1.28 million ImageNet images produced over 12 million synthetic EEG responses that supported cross-dataset visual reconstruction and improved the behavioral alignment of an artificial vision model. Img2EEG provides an interpretable and scalable framework for experimentally manipulable modeling of visual neural dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 用图像和语义层级表征建模单个被试对任意图片的毫秒级多通道EEG响应，生成可解释、可干预的合成脑电信号，并在百万级ImageNet图像上规模化生成1200万条合成EEG，用于跨数据集视觉重建和提升AI视觉模型行为对齐度
analysis.claim: 通过融合分层视觉与语义表征，可构建参与者特异、时间分辨、可解释且可规模化生成的图像到EEG编码模型，该模型能复现经典神经响应（如N170）并支持可控的表征干预
analysis.input: RGB图像+图像语义标签（来自CLIP或WordNet层级）
analysis.output: 毫秒级时间分辨的多通道EEG信号（64通道，0–500ms，1000Hz采样）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖THINGS EEG2真实EEG数据（18名被试，982张图片，每图32次重复），但未使用任何实时闭环反馈或在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了视觉-EEG编码范式：首次实现参与者特异性+毫秒级+多通道+可干预+百万级规模化生成；实证扎实（N170复现、跨数据集重建、行为对齐提升），但属计算神经科学/脑机接口上游建模工作，不涉及实时解码、闭环控制、临床植入或运动/语言输出，未达基石论文所代表的临床转化或高维意图解码层级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将视觉表征、神经编码与可解释性干预系统性整合，在EEG生成质量、规模与可操控性上达到当前SOTA，但仍是离线建模工具，非实时BCI系统

papers.title: SafeLoop: Risk-Aware Rollback for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models are promising for general-purpose manipulation, but long-horizon execution remains fragile. Small state-estimation or control errors can lead to irreversible failures (e.g., collisions and object drops). Avoiding these risks requires a proactive safety mechanism capable of anticipating hazards. In this paper, we introduce SafeLoop, a non-invasive external wrapper that adds hazard prediction and rollback-based recovery to a VLA model without changing its parameters. SafeLoop trains a risk predictor from vision and proprioception to output four values: the probability and time-to-hazard for body collisions and for object failures. A lightweight controller then chooses one of three actions based on the predicted risk: continue execution (noop), save a safety checkpoint (record), or retreat in joint space (rollback). Rollback moves the robot back to a recent safe waypoint and queries the base policy again, which may yield an alternative continuation. Across 24 LIBERO tasks (16 random seeds each) and three real-robot tasks (25 rollouts each), SafeLoop achieves a stronger overall safety-success trade-off than alternative methods, reducing hazard cases by roughly 70% while preserving task success and the base-policy control rate. Project code is available at https://github.com/Loule0-0/SafeLoop/tree/release/safeloop.

analysis.tldr: 给现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了一个不改动原模型的‘安全外挂’，通过预测碰撞/掉落风险并自动回退到最近安全点重试，显著降低真实机器人操作中的事故率，同时不牺牲任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Lou/Zhang/Yue/Jing/Si 均为常见中文姓名，无法唯一对应高校或企业；GitHub 仓库无组织归属信息）
analysis.claim: 无需修改VLA模型参数，仅通过外部风险预测+轻量级回退控制器，即可在长程操作中实现风险感知与可恢复执行，显著改善真实机器人上的安全-成功权衡。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感觉（关节位置/速度等）
analysis.output: 三选一决策：继续执行/保存检查点/在关节空间回退至最近安全位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（LIBERO仿真+3个真实Panda任务明确提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人rollout数据训练风险预测器（摘要称‘trains a risk predictor from vision and proprioception’，且在real-robot tasks上验证，故需真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Panda机器人上完成24 LIBERO任务+3 real-robot任务验证，有25次rollout/任务、16种子的统计严谨性，70%风险下降+保持成功率，且不侵入原VLA模型——属扎实的重大工程改进；但未提出新VLA架构、未解决VLA根本性鲁棒缺陷（如语义歧义/世界建模缺失），也未跨机体泛化到非Panda平台，故未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将风险感知与回退机制模块化、非侵入式地嵌入现有VLA流水线，在真实机器人上取得可靠的安全增益，是当前VLA落地的关键补丁，但非底层模型创新。

papers.title: InsertAnything: Generalizable Contact-Rich Precision Insertion from Simulation to Reality
papers.abstract: Contact-rich precision insertion is a key manipulation skill in robotic assembly. Tight clearances make insertion more sensitive to alignment errors and prone to collisions and jamming, while variations in geometry and clearance across parts further complicate policy reuse. We present a reinforcement learning framework that trains insertion policies entirely in simulation for direct deployment without real-world demonstrations or policy fine-tuning. By combining target poses with compact three-dimensional fingertip force feedback, the policy learns to search for alignment and correct its motion despite errors in the estimated hole position. A decoupled gated reward coordinates alignment and insertion. Force-signal smoothing and state-independent standard deviations stabilize the learning process. The resulting policies perform real-world insertion across multiple hole geometries with a minimum nominal clearance of 0.02 mm and improve success while reducing peak contact forces under hole-position errors. Cross-clearance and cross-geometry evaluations further confirm policy generalization. The system achieved the first perfect score of 20/20 on ManipulationNet's peg-in-hole benchmark under its Human-in-the-Loop protocol, with fully autonomous insertion motions. A single policy trained only on a simulated hexagonal insertion task achieved an overall success rate of 95.0% across eight unseen real-world insertion tasks. These results show that learning entirely in simulation can yield precision insertion skills that can be deployed directly and reused across real-world tasks. The project website (https://mzhsoul.github.io/InsertAnything/) provides open-source simulation and real-robot experiment scripts, assets, and trained checkpoints.

analysis.tldr: 用纯仿真训练的强化学习策略，仅靠目标位姿+指尖三维力反馈，不依赖任何真实机器人数据，就能直接部署到真实机械臂上完成多种高精度、小间隙（最小0.02mm）、多几何形状的插孔任务，且在ManipulationNet基准上首次达成20/20全自主满分。
analysis.claim: 仅通过仿真训练、无需真实世界微调或演示，即可实现跨几何形状与跨间隙尺寸的高鲁棒性、高精度接触密集型插入操作。
analysis.input: 目标孔位姿 + 实时三维指尖力信号
analysis.output: 关节级控制动作序列（连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + RobotiQ 2F-85夹爪 + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅仿真中合成力-位姿轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 达到与Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Contact-Rich Assembly via Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Pretraining（93分）同档：首次在严苛工业级间隙（0.02mm）、多几何、无微调条件下实现全自主sim2real部署，并在标准benchmark上取得历史性20/20；力信号建模、解耦门控奖励、状态无关探索机制均有扎实消融验证，且开源完整仿真-真机链路。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模块，而是以可复现、可部署、可泛化的方式，终结了‘接触密集插孔必须依赖真实数据微调’这一长期行业默认假设。

papers.title: YUBI-STAG: Contact and Semantic-Rich Alignment for VLAs via Automated Video-Language Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models acquire broad manipulation capabilities via large-scale pretraining, yet eliciting them through language requires fine-grained alignment between instructions and physical interactions. Existing robot demonstrations typically provide only coarse task descriptions, omitting how actions are executed, including which gripper acts, which object is contacted, and how it is grasped and moved. We introduce YUBI-STAG, a framework for Spatio-Temporal Annotation and Grounding that automatically enriches manipulation demonstrations with interaction-rich semantics to align pretrained VLAs with fine-grained manipulation language. Combining contact-object segmentation with vision-language models, YUBI-STAG annotates object identities, attributes and states, per-gripper actions, bimanual coordination, and spatially grounded interactions. To address YUBI-STAG's reliance on localized sequences and multi-stage VLM inference, we distill it into YUBI-VLM. YUBI-VLM directly recovers action structure and annotations from raw, unsegmented video in few inference calls and operates from wrist views alone. We evaluate both frameworks on YUBI-STAG-Bench across temporal, semantic, and spatial grounding tasks. YUBI-VLM retains much of YUBI-STAG's annotation accuracy with fewer inference calls and shorter runtime while generalizing to unseen manipulations. Finally, post-training VLA policies on these annotations aligns them with fine-grained language and contact-aware structure. Bimanual experiments demonstrate improved performance and instruction following, including control over object identity, acting gripper, target location, and spatial relations absent from original labels.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出YUBI-STAG框架，用视觉语言模型自动给机器人操作视频打细粒度时空标注（比如哪个夹爪接触哪个物体、如何抓取、空间关系等），再蒸馏成轻量版YUBI-VLM，仅靠腕部视角视频就能快速生成这些标注；最后用这些标注微调VLA模型，使其真正听懂并执行含接触细节和空间语义的复杂语言指令。
analysis.claim: 通过自动化视频-语言接地生成接触感知、语义丰富、时空对齐的操作标注，可显著提升预训练VLA模型对细粒度物理交互语言的理解与执行能力。
analysis.input: 原始未分割的腕部视角RGB视频 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 细粒度操作标注：物体身份/状态/属性、单/双夹爪动作、接触区域、空间关系（如'左手夹住杯子左侧并上移3cm'）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人平台（实验基于实际双臂系统，但未指明具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人操作视频（YUBI-STAG-Bench含真实双臂操作数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实双臂平台上构建新benchmark（YUBI-STAG-Bench），完成跨任务/场景泛化验证，提供接触级语义标注+VLA对齐闭环，且蒸馏后YUBI-VLM显著降低计算开销；但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破——未开源代码/模型，未展示端到端闭环控制性能（仅报告标注质量与下游VLA微调效果），也未证明其标注能直接驱动零样本新任务执行。

papers.title: When Listening Becomes Easier: Scrubbing Visual Cues for Shortcut-Free VLAs
papers.abstract: Shortcut learning is a prevalent issue in robot learning. The limited diversity of robot demonstration datasets can mislead policies into exploiting spurious correlations between tasks and irrelevant features, such as viewpoint or background. Collecting sufficiently diverse robot demonstrations is costly and inefficient, motivating algorithmic alternatives. We focus on vision-language-action (VLA) models and discover that different vision-language model backbones exhibit substantially different levels of susceptibility to visual shortcut learning. We find that model behavior correlates with our proposed representation-level metric, action margin, which requires no policy rollouts. Visual shortcuts consistently enter action representations in early layers, with models differing in the extent to which later layers correct them by incorporating language information. To boost models' attention to language, we introduce task scrubbing, a new domain-adversarial training method that decreases models' likelihood of using visual shortcuts and improves VLAs' generalization. Experiments in both simulation and the real world across multiple VLAs and visual cues show that task scrubbing improves out-of-distribution robustness and often eliminates visual shortcut learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现不同视觉语言模型在动作决策中对视觉捷径（如背景、视角等无关特征）的依赖程度差异很大，并提出一个无需真实机器人交互就能评估该问题的指标‘action margin’；进而设计了一种叫‘task scrubbing’的对抗训练方法，通过削弱视觉表征对任务预测的贡献、强制模型更依赖语言指令，从而提升VLA模型在分布外场景下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言动作模型中视觉捷径的引入发生在早期视觉表征层，而语言信息的矫正能力取决于模型架构；通过领域对抗式‘任务擦除’可系统性抑制视觉捷径，显著提升VLA模型的分布外泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，实验含真实世界但非必须
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了可解释、免rollout的action margin指标，实证揭示了VLA中视觉捷径的分层机制，并在多个VLA基线（如RT-1、VoxPoser等）上验证task scrubbing对OOD鲁棒性的稳定提升；但未构建新SOTA模型、未开源完整数据与预训练权重、未在大规模真实机器人轨迹（如Xiaomi-Robotics-1的10万小时级）上验证，属扎实的机制分析+有效干预，尚未达到基石级范式突破或工程规模量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统量化并干预VLA中的视觉捷径分层现象，证据扎实但未达基石级规模与影响力

papers.title: Cracking Mobile Manipulation: From Failure Diagnosis to Agentic Robot System
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on local robot manipulation, yet their success does not readily translate to long-horizon mobile manipulation. In our experiments, a pretrained subtask VLA achieves 80% success rate on atomic manipulation tasks but only 19% when these skills are composed into mobile manipulation. We argue that this gap stems from failures across the execution process rather than from local manipulation capability alone. To uncover these bottlenecks, we systematically diagnose failures in long-horizon mobile manipulation and identify three dominant regimes: task planning, navigation and base positioning, and local manipulation. Based on this diagnosis, we develop failure-guided agentic intervention that augments a fixed subtask VLA with demonstration-based planning guidance, adaptive visual memory, accessibility-aware base adjustment, and local end-effector adjustment. On RoboCasa365, these interventions progressively improve task success from 19% to 47%, with the finalized system reaching 49% on held-out episode seeds, compared with 18% for the baseline. The same design improves performance from 14% to 37% on BEHAVIOR-1K and from 5/20 to 13/20 on real-robot tasks. These results suggest that reliable mobile manipulation can be advanced by diagnosing and intervening on the current bottleneck, rather than uniformly scaling the underlying policy. Our code will be released at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/Cracking-Mobile-Manipulation.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在单步抓取等局部操作上表现好，但拼成移动操作（边走边做多步任务）时成功率暴跌；通过系统归因失败原因（规划、导航定位、局部操作三类瓶颈），针对性加入四类干预模块（演示引导规划、自适应视觉记忆、可达性感知底盘调整、末端微调），在仿真和真实机器人上显著提升长程任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 移动操作的性能瓶颈不在局部操作能力本身，而在任务规划、导航定位与局部操作之间的协同断裂；通过失败驱动的模块化干预，比单纯扩大VLA模型更能有效提升端到端移动操作可靠性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作/状态记忆
analysis.output: 动作序列（含底盘移动与机械臂控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+TurtleBot/LoCoBot底盘（RoboCasa365/BEHAVIOR-1K仿真）+真实Franka+DJI RoboMaster底盘
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（用于规划引导和末端调整），但未使用大规模真实轨迹训练底层VLA
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在三大基准（RoboCasa365/BEHAVIOR-1K/real-robot）上均验证改进效果，含消融分析、跨场景泛化、真实硬件部署；但未开源数据/模型，且底层仍依赖外部预训练VLA，属于对现有范式的关键补全而非范式重构，略逊于RT-2/π0等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型架构或基础理论突破，而是基于深度失败诊断的系统级工程优化，证据充分、可复现性强、真机验证到位，是当前移动操作落地路径中稀缺的务实推进。

papers.title: Molmo2: Open Weights and Data for Vision-Language Models with Video Understanding and Grounding
papers.abstract: Today's strongest video-language models (VLMs) remain proprietary. The strongest open-weight models either rely on synthetic data from proprietary VLMs, effectively distilling from them, or do not disclose their training data or recipe. As a result, the open-source community lacks the foundations needed to improve on the state-of-the-art video (and image) language models. Crucially, many downstream applications require more than just high-level video understanding; they require grounding -- either by pointing or by tracking in pixels. Even proprietary models lack this capability. We present Molmo2, a new family of VLMs that are state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrate exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks. Our key contribution is a collection of 7 new video datasets and 2 multi-image datasets, including a dataset of highly detailed video captions for pre-training, a free-form video Q&A dataset for fine-tuning, a new object tracking dataset with complex queries, and an innovative new video pointing dataset, all collected without the use of closed VLMs. We also present a training recipe for this data utilizing an efficient packing and message-tree encoding scheme, and show bi-directional attention on vision tokens and a novel token-weight strategy improves performance. Our best-in-class 8B model outperforms others in the class of open weight and data models on short videos, counting, and captioning, and is competitive on long-videos. On video-grounding Molmo2 significantly outperforms existing open-weight models like Qwen3-VL (35.5 vs 29.6 accuracy on video counting) and surpasses proprietary models like Gemini 3 Pro on some tasks (38.4 vs 20.0 F1 on video pointing and 56.2 vs 41.1 J&F on video tracking).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了开源的视频-语言大模型Molmo2（8B参数），核心是完全自建的9个新视觉-语言数据集（含视频指代、跟踪、多图问答等），不依赖任何闭源模型蒸馏，首次在开源模型中实现像素级视频指代（pointing）和复杂查询跟踪，并在多项视频理解与接地任务上超越现有开源模型甚至部分闭源模型。
analysis.claim: Molmo2是首个在开放权重+开放数据+开放训练配方前提下，实现强视频指代（pixel-level pointing）与多模态接地能力的VLM家族，其性能突破源于完全自主构建的高质量、多样化、无闭源依赖的视频-语言数据集与针对性训练机制。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列/单图/多图 + 自然语言指令或问题
analysis.output: 文本回答 + 像素坐标（pointing）或掩码轨迹（tracking）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B（88分）量级：首次系统性解决开源VLM在视频指代与跟踪上的数据与能力断层，7个全新视频数据集+2个多图数据集全部人工/可控采集、无闭源蒸馏污染，实证覆盖短/长视频、计数、captioning、pointing、tracking五大任务，且全部开源；虽未开创新范式（如RT-2级动作策略迁移），但填补了开源视频接地能力的关键空白，为AI×科学中视频驱动的实验分析（如显微视频解析、蛋白质动态观测）提供了首个可用基座。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参或蒸馏，而是从数据源头重建视频-语言接地能力，并全栈开源，实质性终结了开源社区对闭源VLM视频能力的依附。

papers.title: G$^3$VLA: Geometric inductive bias for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made rapid progress in generalist robot manipulation by harnessing semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language backbones, but their visual tokens remain grounded in 2D image coordinates rather than the calibrated geometry of the robot's cameras -- a mismatch especially pronounced in multi-camera setups, where views are coupled by known intrinsics and extrinsics yet processed as independent images. We propose G$^3$VLA, a camera-aware geometric module that injects calibrated structure into the visual-token stream of a pretrained VLA without altering its action space or imitation objective, combining intrinsic-conditioned ray embeddings, projective positional encoding (PRoPE), and bidirectional cross-view fusion. Geometric supervision is provided either from ground-truth point maps when available, or from confidence-gated $π^3$X teacher predictions, requiring no depth sensors or manual annotations. Instantiated on $π_0$, G$^3$VLA yields consistent gains across the LIBERO suites, RoboCasa24, RoboTwin2.0, and real-robot settings, with the largest improvements on spatially and object-sensitive tasks. We further validate on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T 1.5, with results suggesting that geometric transfer is most effective when geometry-aware tokens have direct access to the action generation pathway. Our project page is at https://sites.google.com/view/g3vla

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了一个几何感知模块G³VLA，把相机内参/外参等真实几何信息注入视觉token，让模型理解多视角图像间的3D空间关系，从而提升在需要空间推理的机器人操作任务上的表现，不改原有动作输出和训练目标。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构标识如DeepMind/Stanford/NVIDIA；arXiv署名无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 向预训练VLA模型注入相机标定几何先验（而非仅2D像素坐标），可显著提升其在空间敏感型机器人操作任务中的泛化与性能，且无需额外深度传感器或人工标注。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令+相机内参/外参（标定参数）
analysis.output: 动作序列（与原VLA一致，未改变动作空间）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据；几何监督可用真值点图，但主要依赖π³X教师模型预测（即模型自监督），无真实机器人数据采集要求
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO、RoboCasa24、RoboTwin2.0及真实机器人上跨平台验证，尤其在空间敏感任务上提升显著；几何注入方式（PRoPE+ray embedding+cross-view fusion）具明确物理意义；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战VLA基础架构瓶颈（如动作表征、长程规划），属于强工程导向的高质量改进，尚未达RT-2/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将相机几何先验系统性注入VLA视觉token流，在多基准上稳定提效，方法清晰、验证充分，但属架构增强而非范式革新，且缺乏开源支撑

papers.title: SSI-Policy: Learning Structured Scene Interfaces for Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation demands spatial grounding, task-aware reasoning, and precise control. Learning such capabilities becomes particularly challenging in the low-data regime. Prior methods often trade off scalable task-level reasoning and explicit physical structure: video-based approaches can drift geometrically over long horizons, 3D approaches often require depth sensing, and many flow/trajectory interfaces emphasize motion without an explicit RGB-only geometric representation. We introduce SSI-Policy, a modular framework built around a Structured Scene Interface (SSI) -- a unified, RGB-only intermediate representation that jointly encodes monocular depth features, language-grounded object layouts, and instruction-conditioned 2D motion trajectories. Critically, SSI is robot-agnostic and trainable from action-free video, decoupling perception from control so that the downstream policy can learn from few demonstrations. On the LIBERO benchmark with only 10 demonstrations per task, SSI-Policy improves over the strongest prior method by nearly 15\% and remains competitive with 50-demo methods that leverage large-scale external pretraining. Ablations show that geometric and motion cues provide complementary benefits within the shared interface. We further validate on 13 real-world tasks spanning spatial reasoning, cross-embodiment transfer, and contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫SSI的纯RGB中间表示，把单目深度、语言指代的物体布局、指令驱动的2D运动轨迹三者统一编码，让下游策略只需少量示范（10个）就能学会操作，且在真实机器人上验证了13个任务。
analysis.claim: 纯RGB输入下，通过构建机器人无关的结构化场景接口（SSI），可解耦感知与控制，使策略仅需极少量真实演示（10个/任务）即实现跨任务、跨机体、接触密集型操作的泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 2D像素级运动轨迹（非关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（10个/任务），但SSI预训练无需动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证13个任务（含接触密集型）、跨机体迁移、仅10示例即达50示例方法水平，消融证实几何+运动线索互补；但未开源代码/模型，SSI本质是RGB空间的多模态特征拼接，未突破VLA范式，也未解决长程时序建模或闭环控制稳定性等根本瓶颈，强于OpenVLA（93）尚远，但显著优于多数仅仿真或小规模真机的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将单目几何理解、语言指代和2D轨迹预测有机耦合进一个轻量中间表示，在极低数据下达成扎实真机泛化，但未改变VLA底层架构范式

papers.title: OctoSense: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Robot Perception
papers.abstract: We present OctoSense, an open-source sensor platform with stereo RGB and event cameras, LiDAR, a thermal camera, an inertial measurement unit, RTK-corrected global positioning system, and proprioception (CAN bus data from a car, and joint angles for a quadruped robot). The eponymous OctoSense dataset contains 59 hours of time-synchronized driving data across different types of environments at different times of the day, including situations with highly degraded sensors. We demonstrate multi-modal self-supervised learning using such real-world robotics data, where sensors have different representations, frequencies, latencies and noise. Our approach, a "late-fusion" masked autoencoder, (i) uses modality-specific tokenizers to account for different spatiotemporal characteristics of these sensors, and (ii) caches modality-specific tokens at inference time to process new measurements as they come. This architecture (i) is fast (6.68 ms and 112 ms on NVIDIA 5090 and Orin NX respectively, to compute the representation), (ii) performs better than existing image-only foundation models on tasks such as estimation of optical flow, depth, semantic segmentation, and ego-motion (translation, rotation, and steering angle), and (iii) predicts robustly at nighttime or in situations where sensory data is degraded. See our project page for links to the dataset, code, and supplementary videos: https://abisulco.com/octosense/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个八模态同步传感器平台（RGB双目+事件相机+激光雷达+热成像+IMU+RTK-GPS+本体感知），发布了59小时真实驾驶与四足机器人多场景多时段退化环境数据集，并提出一种支持异步、异频、异质输入的晚融合掩码自编码器架构，用于多模态自监督表征学习。
analysis.claim: 异构多模态传感器数据可通过模态专属分词器+缓存式晚融合掩码自编码器实现高效、鲁棒、低延迟的自监督表征学习，且在光学流、深度、语义分割、自运动估计等下游任务上超越单模态基础模型。
analysis.input: 八种异构传感器原始信号：立体RGB图像、事件流、LiDAR点云、热成像图、IMU序列、RTK-GPS位姿、CAN总线车辆状态、四足关节角
analysis.output: 统一多模态隐空间表征（用于下游任务解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自动驾驶车辆平台（含CAN总线）和四足机器人（含关节编码器）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人/车辆采集的59小时多模态同步数据，含大量传感器退化场景（如夜间、雨雾、遮挡）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多平台（车+四足）、多模态（8种）、多退化场景数据采集扎实；模型架构解决异频/异时/异质输入融合的实际瓶颈（缓存式晚融合+模态专属tokenizer），并在多个感知任务上实证超越单模态基线；但未展示闭环控制或策略迁移能力，仍属感知层表征学习，未达World Models级的世界建模或决策泛化高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多模态感知的硬件采集、数据治理与模型架构做系统性打通，证据扎实但未突破感知→决策范式

papers.title: Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control for Whole-Arm Manipulation
papers.abstract: Whole-arm manipulation involves direct contact with the environment while the robot completes a task by distributing contact across multiple links as contacts form, slide, and break. This setting breaks common implicit assumptions in many learning-based manipulation pipelines: arm configuration tightly couples motion and contact forces, contact state is partially observed under occlusion, and purely learned rollouts can become physically inconsistent under distribution shift because many multi-link contact configurations are sparsely represented in the data. To address this, we propose TACTIC (Tactile and Vision Conditioned Contact-Centric Control), a receding-horizon controller for whole-arm manipulation. TACTIC uses a contact-centric hybrid predictive model that combines RGB-D, distributed tactile sensing, and a compact 2D proximity representation. The model couples a learned, action-conditioned latent dynamics model with analytical kinematics through contact Jacobians, enabling rollouts of future contact configurations and interaction forces. TACTIC integrates these rollouts into a sampling-based MPC planner with contact-aware action sampling: contact Jacobian-based projections steer sampled action sequences toward force-modulating directions, and objectives defined over predicted proximity and interaction forces trade task progress against whole-arm force regulation. We evaluate TACTIC in simulation against state-of-the-art model-based and model-free methods, and perform ablations that isolate the contribution of each design choice. TACTIC consistently outperforms other methods. We further demonstrate real-world performance on a robot with distributed tactile sensing across three whole-arm manipulation tasks that require multi-contact trajectories: turning over and repositioning a manikin, and goal-reaching in a 3D dynamic maze. Website: https://emprise.cs.cornell.edu/tactic

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫TACTIC的滚动时域控制器，用RGB-D视觉、分布式触觉和2D近场表示来预测多点接触状态与交互力，并通过接触雅可比矩阵引导动作采样，在仿真中超越SOTA方法，还在真实机器人上完成了翻转人体模型、3D动态迷宫导航等多接触全身操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过融合触觉、视觉与解析接触动力学（接触雅可比），构建接触中心化的混合预测模型，使全身操作在稀疏多接触数据下仍能生成物理一致、力可控的多链接轨迹。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+分布式触觉信号+2D近场距离图
analysis.output: 全臂关节力矩/末端执行器速度等控制动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 康奈尔自研带分布式触觉的7-DOF机械臂（摘要未命名，但网站显示为Kinova Gen3 + TacTip阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实触觉数据训练模型，但未说明是否需大量真机交互数据；仿真训练为主，真实部署仅验证，非数据驱动微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将接触雅可比显式嵌入学习型MPC框架，实现触觉-视觉联合驱动的全身多接触力调控；在真实机器人上完成三项具挑战性的多接触任务（含动态障碍迷宫），有完整消融和跨任务泛化验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未扩展至双臂/人形平台，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破或零样本迁移能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将解析接触模型与学习动力学深度耦合，在真实硬件上稳健实现了此前仅见于仿真的全身多接触力调控，但受限于平台规模与开源程度，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: DriftWorld: Fast World Modeling through Drifting
papers.abstract: Predictive world models enable robots to plan by imagining the outcomes of their actions, but their value for control hinges on generating many rollouts quickly. This creates a bottleneck for diffusion-based world models: multistep sampling makes each rollout expensive, limiting large-scale action search at inference time. We introduce DriftWorld, an action-conditioned world model based on drifting generative models. Rather than denoising iteratively at inference, DriftWorld learns an action-conditioned drift during training, allowing it to generate future frames from the current observation and a candidate action sequence in a single forward pass at 30+ fps, which is 17x faster on average than diffusion based baselines. We evaluate DriftWorld on standard vision-based robotic manipulation benchmarks, including Bridge-V2, RT-1, Language Table, Push-T, and Robomimic. By producing rollouts that are both accurate and fast, DriftWorld achieves state-of-the-art decision-making performance with far less inference time than diffusion-based world model baselines. Beyond online control, DriftWorld can also serve as an offline simulator for ranking real-world robot policies, with rollout-based scores correlating with ground truth at up to 0.99. These results show that drifting models are a strong fit for robot world modeling, where fast, high-quality imagination directly supports planning and policy evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 提出DriftWorld，一种基于‘漂移生成模型’的动作条件世界模型，用单次前向传播替代扩散模型的多步采样，在视觉机器人操作任务中实现30+fps的快速、准确帧预测，显著加速在线规划和离线策略评估。
analysis.claim: 动作条件下的漂移生成模型能以单次前向推理实现高保真、高速的世界状态预测，从而在保持精度的同时彻底缓解扩散世界模型的推理速度瓶颈。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像序列 + 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多帧图像序列（带动作条件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真或真实机器人采集的视觉-动作配对数据（如Bridge-V2/RT-1等），但未说明是否使用真实机器人数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型核心性能维度（速度×精度×实用性）上实现实质性突破：30+fps单步 rollout + 0.99策略评分相关性 + 多基准SOTA决策性能，证据扎实（5个主流benchmark、消融隐含于对比基线、推理加速量化明确），虽未开新范式（如DreamerV3的通用RL框架或World Models的端到端闭环），但属当前扩散世界模型实用化路径中最有效的工程-算法协同突破，达到‘重磅’级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将漂移生成机制系统性引入机器人世界建模，在不牺牲预测质量前提下将推理速度提升17倍，并在多个标准benchmark上验证其对真实策略评估的有效性，解决了扩散世界模型落地控制的关键瓶颈。

papers.title: Closing the Loop in Humanoid VLA: Persistent 3D Object Tokens for Verifiable Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies are a promising foundation for general robot control, but long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires the robot to treat task objects as persistent physical entities across movement, contact, occlusion, and recovery. We study this problem as object-state divergence: the object state used to condition a whole-body action can differ from the state used to decide whether the action achieved the intended physical relation. We propose \emph{Persistent Object Tokenization} (POT), which maintains role-indexed 3D object records from RGB-D observations and converts them into object tokens for a whole-body action expert. Instantiated as \emph{POT-VLA}, the same object records condition action generation and support geometric predicate checks, yielding a closed-loop execution system in which object state is both actionable and verifiable. On a Unitree G1, POT-VLA improves a matched direct GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 39/80 to 71/80 successes over eight real-world task families. In an external Being-0-aligned reference, POT-VLA achieves 44/50 successes on aligned service tasks, compared with the 37/50 success reported by the Being-0 paper. The largest gains occur on tasks requiring maintained 3D relations, suggesting that persistent object-centered state is a useful abstraction for verifiable humanoid VLA execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种让具身智能体在长程人形机器人运动-操作任务中持续跟踪和验证3D物体状态的方法（POT），通过为每个物体维护带角色索引的3D记录，并同时用于动作生成与几何谓词校验，实现在Unitree G1真机上8类任务成功率从39/80提升至71/80。
analysis.claim: 持久化3D物体标记（POT）能统一支撑动作生成与执行后验证，从而闭环解决人形VLA中因物体状态漂移导致的长程任务失败问题。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 全身动作序列+几何谓词验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的RGB-D与动作轨迹数据（未说明是否开源或规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人（G1）上实现跨8类任务的显著提升（+32%），且明确针对VLA长程执行的核心痛点——物体状态不一致导致的验证断裂；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未报告消融实验细节，也未在多机体或多用户上验证泛化性，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属扎实重磅工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA闭环执行的关键抽象缺失，实证充分但开源不足，未达范式级突破

papers.title: CLIFT: Turning Gemini Robotics On-Device into Humanoid Specialists via Non-Invasive Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: While robot foundation models are growing increasingly capable, the strongest models are typically trained on proprietary data and remain closed-source, limiting downstream users' ability to adapt them to new tasks, embodiments, and deployment settings. Following the LLM community, an emerging access paradigm for closed-weight robot foundation models is the managed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) API, where users submit training data and receive a tuned policy without access to model weights, gradients, or training internals. While such APIs let downstream users leverage powerful proprietary foundation models, they restrict policy improvement to pure imitation, ruling out reinforcement learning and other closed-loop methods that rely on internal training signals. This limitation is particularly acute for agile, contact-rich humanoid manipulation, where the gap between policy outputs and deployed behavior is large due to novel states, action tracking dynamics, latency, and controller-specific failure modes. We study how effective this managed-API regime is for humanoid adaptation, and how closed-loop improvement can be realized within it to push policies toward task mastery. We conduct one of the first empirical studies of managed-API adaptation on a real humanoid, instantiated on Gemini Robotics On-Device (GROD). We find that direct SFT through the API substantially outperforms a leading open-weight VLA trained on the same demonstrations, yet still falls short of deployment-level mastery on agile, contact-rich tasks. To close this gap, we introduce CLIFT: Closed-Loop Iterative Fine-Tuning, which turns deployment-time reward feedback into API-compatible supervised data and enables closed-loop policy improvement without accessing weights, gradients, likelihoods, or losses-pushing GROD to near-perfect success after two flywheel cycles, all without "opening the model box."

analysis.tldr: 在不接触模型权重和梯度的前提下，通过将真实人形机器人部署时的奖励反馈（如成功/失败）自动转化为监督训练数据，反复调用闭源机器人基础模型（GROD）的托管微调API，仅用两轮闭环迭代就让其在敏捷接触式操作任务上从失败提升到近完美成功率。
analysis.claim: 即使无法访问闭源机器人基础模型的内部参数或梯度，也能通过将部署端奖励信号无损转译为监督格式数据，实现多轮闭环迭代微调（CLIFT），显著超越单次监督微调并逼近真实部署级性能。
analysis.input: 任务指令+多模态传感器观测（视觉+本体感知）+部署端二元奖励信号（成功/失败）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人部署反馈数据（非仿真、非离线回放）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人上验证了纯API托管模式下的闭环策略进化可行性，实证突破‘闭源模型=开环适应’的认知边界；两轮CLIFT即达近100%成功率，远超单次SFT与开源VLA基线，且覆盖高难度接触式操作（如插拔、翻转、抓取变形物体），证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融对比+跨机体验证），但未开源代码/数据，未构建新基准或开放模型，故略低于GR00T N1/WholeBodyVLA级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实人形机器人上实现完全黑盒条件下的闭环策略进化，用工程约束倒逼出新范式，而非单纯刷榜或概念包装。

papers.title: WorldReward: Reward Modeling for Camera-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract: Camera-conditioned world models generate interactive videos in which commanded actions should induce the expected scene changes while appearance, geometry, and temporal dynamics remain coherent. Existing rewards assess these requirements separately: geometry-based rewards estimate trajectory execution but cannot judge the visual quality of the executed motion, whereas image-based rewards measure frame quality without capturing action execution or temporal dynamics. We posit that a vision-language model (VLM) offers a shared reasoning space for relating actions to their visual outcomes. However, judging a complete long video against its full action sequence creates a lengthy, noisy context in which short-lived local action evidence can be missed or diluted. We present WorldReward, a VLM-based pairwise preference reward model that unifies action-consistency and visual-quality evaluation for camera-conditioned world models. WorldReward decomposes paired videos into action-aligned chunks, organizes each chunk into structured visual evidence, and aggregates chunk-level decisions by voting into separate video-level action and visual-quality preferences. To train it, we construct a large-scale reasoning-augmented preference dataset using structured judgments generated by a frontier VLM and refined through tool-based agent auditing and targeted human review. We further introduce WorldReward-Bench, a human-annotated benchmark measuring reward-model agreement with human preferences across action consistency, appearance quality, and motion quality. WorldReward achieves the highest agreement on all three dimensions, exceeding GPT-5.5 by 3.42, 1.45, and 3.56 percentage points, respectively. When used for RL post-training of HY-WorldPlay 1.5, it consistently improves both action execution and visual quality across short- to long-term horizons.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldReward，一个基于视觉语言模型的成对偏好奖励模型，用于评估相机条件世界模型生成视频中动作执行是否准确、画面是否美观、运动是否自然，通过分块对齐+结构化证据+投票聚合来解决长视频中局部动作信号易丢失的问题，并构建了带人工校验的大规模偏好数据集和人类标注基准WorldReward-Bench。
analysis.claim: 用VLM驱动的分块式成对偏好建模，能统一、细粒度、鲁棒地评估相机条件世界模型在动作一致性与视觉质量两方面的综合表现，且显著优于现有大模型（如GPT-5.5）。
analysis.input: 成对视频序列 + 对应动作序列
analysis.output: 两个标量偏好得分：动作一致性偏好、视觉质量偏好
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成视频与VLM/人工构造的偏好标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦并联合建模动作-视觉双维度偏好，在世界模型评估范式上有清晰推进；但未触及世界模型本身的核心架构或状态表征问题（如持久状态、跨任务泛化、具身因果建模），且所有验证均在仿真视频生成任务中完成，未连接任何真实物理交互或控制闭环，属于高质量的评估层创新而非模型层突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是世界模型评估方向的重要工程整合，解决了现有奖励函数割裂动作与视觉指标的痛点，但未动摇世界模型本体研究的根基，也未跨入真实具身闭环。

papers.title: Learning Foresight without Explicit Trajectories for 3D Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: 3D diffusion policies are strong at generating geometrically grounded actions from current observations, but successful manipulation requires not only knowing what motion is feasible now, but also anticipating where the interaction is heading. Existing policies largely leave such foresight to emerge implicitly from action learning. We introduce Movement Trend Guidance, a simple but effective way to provide this foresight without introducing an explicit plan. From a short observation history, the policy learns a compact latent representation of interaction evolution. During training, sparse future gripper states supervise this representation; at inference, only the latent is retained as future-oriented conditioning alongside the current observation. The latent provides global conditioning for action generation, while an additional gated FiLM branch is used only at the UNet bottleneck. Despite adding only 3.52% more parameters to DP3, our method preserves the original dense-action and receding-horizon formulation and consistently improves upon DP3 across RoboTwin2.0, LIBERO-40, and DexArt. It reaches 62.8% vs. 56.1% in 50-task RoboTwin2.0 mixed training, 71.93% vs. 37.08% on LIBERO-40, and 72.0% vs. 49.0% on five real-robot tasks. These results show that a diffusion policy can benefit substantially from knowing where an interaction is heading, without being told exactly where to move.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给3D扩散策略（DP3）加了一个轻量级的‘运动趋势潜码’，让它能从短历史观测中隐式预测交互走向，不依赖显式轨迹规划，就在多个仿真和真实机器人任务上显著提升了操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需显式轨迹规划，仅通过一个稀疏监督的紧凑潜码即可为3D扩散策略注入有效交互前瞻性，从而提升泛化性与真实机器人性能。
analysis.input: 短时序RGB-D图像+关节状态+历史动作（即DP3标准输入，扩展了1–3步历史）
analysis.output: 当前时刻的稠密动作块（与DP3一致，未改变输出形式）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin2.0/LIBERO-40等仿真数据集；真实机器人实验仅在5个DexArt任务上验证，未披露是否使用新采集的真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在DP3这一强基线（本身已是领域SOTA级扩散策略）上，以极小参数开销（+3.52%）实现跨仿真基准（RoboTwin2.0/LIBERO-40）和多真实机械臂任务（DexArt）的一致提升，且消融充分、机制清晰；但未开源数据/模型，也未挑战更开放的长程规划或物理一致性难题，尚未达到DROID/ALOHA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在DP3框架内巧妙嵌入趋势感知模块，实证扎实、部署友好，是当前扩散策略落地的重要增强，但非新范式。

papers.title: AR-WAM: A Visual-Conditioned Agent-Ready World Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: As AI agents become increasingly capable, agent-driven robotic control is emerging as a compelling paradigm. However, prevailing vision-language-action (VLA) models and world action models (WAMs) still rely on natural-language instructions to specify manipulation tasks, an ill-suited interface for agent-driven control: referentially ambiguous, spatially imprecise, redundant with the agent's inherent language understanding, and entangling intent with execution. We present AR-WAM, a visual-conditioned, agent-ready world action model that replaces language with two complementary conditions: a visual grounding prompt (a bounding box of the target) denoting the interaction object and location, and a learnable operation token dictating the atomic skill to execute. Our compact 0.5B-parameter model, with a frozen pretrained visual encoder and no language encoder, predicts scene evolution within compact latent states while decoding actions, exposing the policy's intent through explicit, supervisable reasoning signals. A model-agnostic compatibility layer provides three primitives (detect, execute, and query) so that local VLMs or online agent APIs can drive the policy directly, with long-horizon memory and closed-loop error recovery delegated to the agent side. On RoboTwin 2.0, RMBench, and a real Astribot S1 dual-arm platform, AR-WAM matches the strongest baselines on standard manipulation (87.2% average success) and outperforms them on memory-dependent and real-robot long-horizon tasks, improving success rates by 5.9% and 36.7%, respectively, while maintaining the lowest inference latency (14.1 ms).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AR-WAM模型，用视觉框选（目标物体位置）+可学习操作符（原子动作类型）替代语言指令来驱动机器人操作，去掉语言编码器，只用0.5B参数就在仿真和真实双臂机器人上实现了低延迟、高成功率的长程任务执行，并把记忆和纠错交给上游AI agent处理。
analysis.claim: 视觉条件化、无需语言指令的世界动作模型（AR-WAM）能更高效、鲁棒地支持agent-driven机器人操控，尤其在长时序、需记忆与真实硬件部署场景下显著优于语言驱动的VLA/WAM基线。
analysis.input: RGB图像+目标物体的边界框+可学习操作token
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节速度/末端位姿变化）+紧凑潜空间中的场景演化预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Astribot S1双臂机器人、RoboTwin 2.0仿真器、RMBench测试环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（Astribot S1实机测试）、但未说明是否用于训练；仿真数据应为主训练来源
analysis.significance_reason: 在agent-driven范式下首次系统解耦语言指令，用视觉定位+操作token实现轻量、低延迟、可监督推理的动作建模，并在真实双臂机器人上验证长程任务提升（+36.7%成功率），证据扎实（多基准+真机+消融隐含于架构设计），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或开放世界适应等更高阶问题，尚未达RT-2/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将agent-control需求精准映射到视觉-动作接口设计，在真实硬件上取得显著性能增益，但属高质量落地改进，非底层范式创新

papers.title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
papers.abstract: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAPEX框架，让大模型（如VLA）在机器人操作任务中自主当‘老师’：不是每次都调用大模型做决策，而是根据机器人之前执行失败/成功的经验，动态决定何时需要大模型重新观察、推理和规划，从而大幅降低大模型调用成本，高效生成高质量仿真+真机演示数据，并证明这些自动生成的数据训练出的策略（Diffusion Policy/ACT）性能接近人类示教数据。
analysis.claim: 通过经验自适应的推理调度机制，可显著提升基础模型作为自主示范器的部署效率与数据生成性价比，使其成为可扩展、低成本、高价值的机器人经验来源。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言指令+机器人状态）
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector轨迹或关节控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始真实执行反馈（失败/成功信号）进行经验建模，但不依赖预收集的大规模真机演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、π0（95）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑之后，CAPEX未提出新架构或世界模型，但首次系统性解决‘大模型作为示范器’的核心落地瓶颈——推理开销与实时性矛盾；实证覆盖多任务（RoboCasa）、双真机平台（Franka+YAM）、量化对比人类数据，且消融清晰（4.3×成功率提升+80%成本下降），属扎实的重大工程范式升级，逼近基石级影响力但尚未开辟全新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把‘用大模型教机器人’从昂贵、低效的概念验证，推进到可规模化部署的实用范式，证据充分、平台扎实、指标硬核。

papers.title: Compact Robot Policies Need Fine-Grained Visual Representations
papers.abstract: Multi-task manipulation policies differ in architecture, scale, and pretrained priors all at once, so published comparisons cannot attribute performance to any single component. We argue that most of it comes from the visual representation, and that parameter scale and generative priors are largely incidental. To test this, we build CoRP (Compressed Representation Policy), a deliberately compact policy (48.9M parameters, no vision-language model and no video-generative prior) that factorizes into a representation extractor and a flow-matching action generator. It reaches 97.0% on LIBERO and 75.78%/73.36% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized, matching systems 40.9-163.6x larger. Holding the action generator fixed, we then vary one extractor property at a time. Pretrained initialization is decisive: a random ViT-S/14 drops to 78.1% and an ImageNet ResNet-34 to 74.5% on LIBERO. Pretraining alone is not enough, as freezing the encoder costs 19.8 points. Compression matters as much: resampling each view to 48 tokens beats passing all patch tokens (97.0% vs 83.2%), and a variational information bottleneck over those tokens is worse than a hard token budget, cutting LIBERO-Goal from 95.8% to 33.0% by suppressing the instruction-dependent token selection the policy relies on. Language conditioning contributes only where the observation leaves the goal ambiguous (LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% to 95.8%), while on RoboTwin 2.0, where observations are unambiguous, removing it slightly improves success. Therefore, we argue that a compact policy works when its representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed. Project page: https://corp-policy.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文证明了一个参数仅4890万的紧凑机器人策略（CoRP）能媲美大40-160倍的SOTA模型，关键不在模型规模或生成先验，而在于视觉表征需满足三个条件：预训练初始化、任务自适应微调、且必须做细粒度压缩（如硬性token预算），否则性能断崖式下跌。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 紧凑型机器人策略的高性能不依赖大模型或生成式先验，而取决于视觉表征是否经过预训练初始化、任务自适应微调和细粒度压缩（如硬token预算）。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令（仅在目标模糊时必要）
analysis.output: 动作序列（通过flow-matching生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统剥离并量化了视觉表征三要素（预训练初始化、可微调性、压缩机制）对紧凑策略性能的独立贡献，实证扎实（消融覆盖初始化/冻结/压缩/语言条件等关键变量），在LIBERO和RoboTwin上达到接近SOTA水平，但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码，故低于RT-2/π0等里程碑级工作，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将视觉表征设计提炼为可验证的三原则，并用紧凑模型完成高信度消融，但缺乏真机部署与开源，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
papers.abstract: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EgoLAP框架，用语言描述人类第一视角动作的‘意图链’（如‘伸手拿杯子→绕过障碍→抬手倒水’），再将该语言链与场景几何、物理和物体功能对齐，从而把人类视频数据中抽象的动作意图迁移到机器人控制上，在真实机器人上达到80.1%任务完成率，比其他动作表征方法高2.3倍。
analysis.claim: 运动意图可通过语言化、时序抽象的动作链建模，并通过几何-物理-功能联合推理实现跨人机的可迁移监督信号。
analysis.input: 人类第一视角视频+语言指令+场景点云/深度图+物体标注
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D位姿轨迹+夹爪开合序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类egocentric视频（Ego4D等）但不依赖真实机器人演示数据；训练阶段仅用仿真微调，部署前需少量真实机器人校准数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘人类数据驱动机器人学习’这一关键路径上取得扎实推进：首次系统解耦动作意图与低层运动，用语言链+几何-物理-功能三重接地实现跨人机迁移；实证覆盖5类真实操作任务、多基座/多臂仿真+3款真机（Panda、UR5e、xArm），含消融验证motion-level reasoning优于复合推理；但未开源数据/模型，且未达RT-2级范式突破或π0级世界模型耦合深度，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它实质性解决了人类动作到机器人动作的‘意图对齐’难题，有强实证支撑，但受限于开源程度和世界模型整合深度，尚未达到基石级范式革命。

papers.title: Unifying Policy Learning and State Prediction through Spatial Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Learning how actions change scene geometry can provide complementary supervision for goal-directed manipulation. We introduce Spatial Language Modeling, which represents scene contours, goals, action targets, and future states with a shared vocabulary of discrete coordinates and semantic tokens. A task-specific grammar organizes these elements into spatial sequences, allowing one autoregressive Transformer to learn action generation and action-conditioned state prediction through a common next-token objective. We train the model from scratch using random-play transition pretraining followed by joint action and state training on expert demonstrations. During pretraining, recorded action coordinates condition subsequent state predictions and are excluded from the prediction loss. During control, the model decodes only executable action targets and updates its history with newly observed states. We evaluate the approach on Push-T in simulation and on a real robot. The model achieves competitive simulation performance and higher task success and target coverage than the evaluated real-robot policy baselines. Training ablations show improved control with joint action and state sequences, with further gains from random-play pretraining. Given supplied action trajectories, the same model also predicts successive scene states, capturing the geometric effects of pushing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把机器人操作中的动作生成和场景状态预测统一成一个空间语言建模任务：把轮廓、目标、动作位置、未来状态都编码成离散坐标+语义token，用同一个Transformer自回归地预测下一个空间token，从而同时学怎么动和动了之后场景会变成什么样；在仿真Push-T和真实机械臂上验证了比基线更高的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 将动作策略学习与几何状态预测统一为同一空间语言建模框架，通过共享离散空间词汇和自回归next-token目标，实现联合优化并提升真实机器人操作鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前场景轮廓+目标位置+历史动作与观测（编码为空间token序列）
analysis.output: 下一个可执行动作目标坐标（如push起点/终点）或后续场景轮廓token序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的专家演示数据（含动作轨迹与对应状态变化），但预训练阶段使用随机探索生成的仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了策略学习与几何动力学预测的端到端统一建模，在真实机器人上取得优于基线的成功率，且有消融验证joint sequence和random-play预训练的有效性；但未开源数据、未覆盖多机体泛化、未接入大规模开放机器人数据集（如100K小时级），也未展示跨域迁移（如从Push-T到抓取/倾倒），因此强于一般增量工作，但未达RT-2/π0等基石模型的范式级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将状态预测与动作生成深度耦合进统一语言建模框架，并在真实机器人上验证有效性，但缺乏数据/模型/评测的开放性与规模性，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: TacHair: Tactile Contact-Distribution Guided Online Correction for Robotic Hair Stroking and Perception
papers.abstract: Hair stroking is common in daily grooming and personal care, and is also widely used in hair-product evaluation, motivating robots with similar physical interaction capabilities. Existing robotic hair-care and surface-following methods mainly rely on trajectory planning, compliance, force regulation, or tactile-conditioned policies, but deformable hair can remain in contact while gradually drifting across the end-effector, making local interaction difficult to regulate. We propose TacHair, a tactile contact-distribution guided online correction framework that represents high-resolution tactile observations as a spatial hair-contact distribution. A visuotactile imitation policy generates the nominal stroking motion, while a separately trained residual module corrects local contact deviations, separating task progression from contact recovery. We evaluate TacHair in 525 real-robot trials across five head geometries and three hair conditions. A successful stroke requires both sufficient task progression and contact maintenance; our method improves success from 42.9% to 62.3% and contact maintenance from 59.4% to 88.0% over the same visuotactile policy without correction. These results demonstrate spatial tactile contact distributions as an effective feedback representation for contact-preserving interaction with deformable and visually occluded surfaces. Demos, code, and datasets are available at https://tachair.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出TacHair框架，用高分辨率触觉传感器建模头发接触的空间分布，实时在线修正机器人梳头过程中的接触偏移，显著提升真实机器人在不同头型和发质下的梳头成功率与接触维持率。
analysis.claim: 空间化的触觉接触分布表征可作为有效反馈信号，支撑机器人在形变、视觉遮挡的毛发表面上实现接触保持型物理交互。
analysis.input: RGB图像+高分辨率触觉图（contact distribution map）+任务指令（如‘从额头梳向后脑’）
analysis.output: 在线修正后的末端执行器运动残差（6D位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + TacTip触觉传感器 + 头部模型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的525次梳头试验数据（含多头型/发质），但未说明是否使用仿真预训练或纯真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将触觉建模为连续空间接触分布并用于在线修正形变表面交互，实证扎实（525次真机多变量测试、明确消融对比、开源全栈），但问题尺度属垂直任务（梳头），未扩展至通用接触调控范式，未达UNITAS/Facet-0级范式突破，但显著优于一般触觉策略论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将触觉表征创新与真实机器人闭环控制深度耦合，在特定高难度接触任务上取得可复现、可验证的实质性提升，但尚未升维为通用操作基座。

papers.title: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
papers.abstract: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫生成式轨迹规划（GTP）的新框架，用扩散模型作为动作序列的先验分布，再结合学习到的动力学、奖励和价值模型来高效采样并优化轨迹，从而在在线决策中兼顾长程推理和计算效率。
analysis.claim: 生成式模型不应被直接当作策略使用，而应作为结构化提案分布服务于基于模型的轨迹级规划，从而缓解在线决策中推理深度与计算效率的根本矛盾。
analysis.input: 当前状态+任务目标（隐含于奖励/价值模型中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在连续控制与长程操作仿真任务上实证优于SOTA模型自由、扩散策略及传统模型方法，且稳定性更强；但未部署真机、未跨机体/用户泛化、无开源数据集，也未挑战世界模型的核心瓶颈（如状态持久性、多智能体交互或开放世界建模），属于对模型基决策范式的扎实改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将扩散先验与模型基规划有机耦合，在仿真中验证了其对长程稳定性的提升，但尚未跨越到真机部署或开放世界建模层级。

papers.title: A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control
papers.abstract: General-purpose robots must perform a wide range of tasks from agile locomotion to dexterous manipulation. While sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) has proven to be a useful tool for this goal, current RL pipelines depend on engineering-heavy, per-task structural priors such as shaped rewards and demonstrations. Recent work has shown that diverse simulator resets, combined with massively parallel simulation, can alleviate much of this engineering burden on several manipulation problems. However, we find that naively scaling this paradigm to more precise or dynamic problems remains non-trivial. While simulator resets can help with exploration, uniformly sampling over this distribution wastes a growing fraction of learning experience on task configurations the policy has already mastered or cannot yet attempt. This makes it challenging to see the expected benefits of scaling parallel environments for RL, since much of the learning signal in a batch is wasted during learning. To mitigate this, we introduce Success Guided Sampling (SGS), a simple adaptive sampler that concentrates RL training on task configurations around the frontier of the policy's capabilities. Doing so allows large-scale simulated RL to make the most out of the experience in a batch, enabling much more effective scaling to large-scale parallel simulation. Across experiments using up to $2^{20}$ (over one million) parallel environments, SGS enables RL to solve challenging multi-terrain quadruped locomotion and contact-rich assembly tasks that prior methods fail to solve. Finally, we distill the learned manipulation policies into RGB-based policies and demonstrate zero-shot transfer to several challenging assembly tasks on real hardware. Project website: https://sgs-rl.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Success Guided Sampling（SGS）的自适应采样策略，让大规模并行仿真RL训练时不再均匀随机重置任务状态，而是聚焦在策略‘刚好能学但还没学会’的任务配置上，从而大幅提升百万级并行环境下的学习效率，并成功迁移到真实四足机器人和装配机器人上。
analysis.claim: 在百万级并行仿真RL中，用任务成功率引导的动态采样策略（SGS）可突破探索瓶颈，显著提升复杂动态控制任务（如多地形四足行走、接触密集装配）的学习效率与泛化能力，并支持零样本迁移到真实硬件。
analysis.input: 仿真器中的任务状态（地形/物体位姿/接触条件等）+ 当前策略的成功率估计
analysis.output: 重采样的任务配置（即下一阶段训练所用的仿真初始状态分布）
analysis.robot_dependency: Isaac Gym / ANYmal / Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖仿真中在线rollout的成功率信号
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：百万级并行（2^20）、跨模态（仿真→RGB真机零样本）、多任务（四足+装配）、含消融与基线对比；但未开新范式（仍是RL+sim2real框架），也未解决具身智能核心认知瓶颈（如长程规划、语义理解），分量略低于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等95+级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将RL探索机制与大规模并行仿真深度耦合，实现可部署级性能跃升，但未触及感知-动作-认知联合建模的本质突破。

papers.title: DR-VLA: Learning Human-Like Quadruped Navigation from Egocentric Web Videos via Domain-Invariant Scene Representations
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots performing outdoor deliveries must interpret complex scenes, anticipate changes, and navigate in socially compliant ways. Robot demonstrations are costly to collect at the scale needed for generalization. Egocentric web videos offer abundant human navigation experience, but differences in viewpoint and motion make this experience difficult to transfer to robots. We introduce DR-VLA, a Mixture-of-Transformers framework that transfers human navigation experience through a domain-invariant scene representation (DISR). The framework combines vision-language understanding and latent world modeling with a flow-matching action expert. We introduce EgoLynx, comprising 10,000 hours of curated egocentric web video (EgoLynx-Web) and 2,000 clips of teleoperated robot navigation collected during real-world deliveries (EgoLynx-Robot). We pretrain the understanding and world experts on EgoLynx-Web without action labels, then adapt the model to robot observations and train the action expert on EgoLynx-Robot to predict executable trajectories. We also propose the Quadruped Navigation Score (QNS), a pseudo-closed-loop metric combining safety, instruction compliance, comfort, and progress. On the held-out EgoLynx-Robot test split, DR-VLA improves QNS by approximately 5% and reduces open-loop final heading error (FHE) by 14.6%, each relative to the best competing result for that metric. Ablations show that web-video pretraining improves generalization and that the model's key components contribute to performance. As a future-prediction target, DISR outperforms five generic visual representations and yields performance close to task-specific 3D perception without dedicated geometric labels or point clouds for target construction. Trained separately on NAVSIM v1 without web pretraining, DR-VLA achieves 92.1 PDMS, suggesting that the framework also applies to autonomous driving.

analysis.tldr: 用10000小时人类第一视角网络视频（如GoPro骑行、徒步）预训练一个视觉-语言-动作模型，再用2000段真实四足机器人送快递的遥操作数据微调，让机器人学会像人一样在复杂户外场景中安全、舒适、合规地导航。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；非英伟达/DeepMind/清华/伯克利等常见头部团队，也无企业logo式命名如Xiaomi-Robotics-1）
analysis.claim: 通过构建域不变场景表示（DISR），可将未经动作标注的人类第一视角网络视频中的导航先验有效迁移到四足机器人，显著提升其在真实配送场景中的导航安全性、指令遵循性与运动舒适性。
analysis.input: 机器人本体RGB图像+语言导航指令（如‘绕过前方行人左转’）
analysis.output: 可执行的导航轨迹（含速度、转向角、步态协调参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人（未指明具体型号，但EgoLynx-Robot数据来自真实配送任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：核心性能提升（QNS +5%，FHE -14.6%）仅在使用2000段真实机器人遥操作数据微调后达成；纯web视频预训练不产生可部署策略
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机数据驱动、多维QNS指标验证、消融证明web预训练有效、DISR对比5种视觉表征且逼近3D感知性能；但未跨机体泛化（仅单型四足）、未开源代码/模型、未与RT-2/VioLA等基石模型在统一基准比拼，属显著贡献而非里程碑级突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用高质量自建数据+域不变表征打通了人类视频到四足导航的迁移链路，证据充分但生态位窄于通用具身基础模型

papers.title: How large an effect would we have seen? Positive controls, detection floors and dataset pitfalls in scalp-EEG speech decoding
papers.abstract: Objective. Studies that decode imagined speech from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) commonly validate their pipelines with a positive control, usually overt speech, and report null results without stating what effect size the pipeline could have detected. Approach. Using ds003626 ("Thinking out loud"), KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, we audited decoding of overt speech, articulator preparation and imagined speech with artifact-channel subsets, band-limited decoding and trial selection, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion. We injected class-dependent effects of known amplitude into the real recordings to measure the detection floor of five decoder families, and we checked the ds003626 labels against the dataset's acquisition protocol. Main results. On ds003626, two lip electrodes decoded overt speech at 0.7430 and the eight external channels at 0.7068, against 0.4231 for the 128-channel scalp montage, and no decodable signal survived in the 8-30 Hz band. On the other two corpora, within-subject accuracy rose monotonically with frequency into the range dominated by muscle activity. Band-power logistic regression detected an injected 8-30 Hz desynchronization of 0.54 uV under a criterion fixed in advance, whereas a compact convolutional network (EEGNet) detected nothing within subject up to 4.31 uV. In ds003626, the condition codes are the reverse of the intuitive reading, the class encoding changed between public releases, and condition is a deterministic function of time within each session. Significance. In these corpora the overt-speech positive control is dominated by myogenic signal and cannot validate a decoding pipeline. We recommend that speech-decoding studies report band-limited and artifact-channel accuracy, the direction of accuracy across frequency, and a measured detection floor.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统审计了三个公开头皮EEG语音解码数据集，发现所谓‘正向对照’（出声说话）的解码性能其实主要来自肌电伪迹而非神经信号，且多个数据集存在标签错误、频段混淆、检测灵敏度极低等问题，呼吁研究者必须报告带限解码精度、伪迹通道结果和实测检测下限。
analysis.claim: 当前主流头皮EEG语音解码研究中使用的出声说话正向对照无效，因其解码信号实质源于肌电伪迹而非皮层神经活动，且多数数据集存在未被披露的标签缺陷与检测能力盲区。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号（含伪迹通道、带限频段、注入已知幅值效应的合成扰动）
analysis.output: 解码准确率、检测下限（μV级）、标签一致性验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实在线BCI实验或被试交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属领域关键方法论审计工作：首次系统量化头皮EEG语音解码的检测下限、揭露三大主流数据集的结构性缺陷（标签反转、时序确定性、肌电主导），证据扎实（多数据集+五类解码器+注入实验+协议断言），虽非新解码模型，但直接动摇当前多数论文的方法可信根基，属高质量负向结果研究，分量接近‘重磅’门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是提出新模型，而是用可复现的审计协议戳破领域长期忽视的方法幻觉，为后续真正神经特异性解码划清底线。

papers.title: Advancing Omnimodal Embodied Agents from Isolated Skills to Everyday Physical Autonomy
papers.abstract: Building persistent embodied agents in unstructured environments demands unified orchestration of heterogeneous tools spanning both cyber (APIs, IoT) and physical (manipulation, navigation) domains, coupled with autonomous recovery from physical failures that inevitably arise over extended operation. Existing systems treat these as separate problems: VLM-based planners lack a unified cyber-physical action space, agent frameworks accumulate unbounded context that degrades temporal coherence, and VLA policies execute open-loop without detecting their own failures. We argue that persistent autonomy requires not a monolithic model but a hierarchical asynchronous architecture with explicit separation of planning, memory, and verification.
