To this end, we present OmniAct, a framework integrating a multimodal semantic planner for skill routing across unified action spaces, an adaptive hierarchical memory with event-boundary-driven compression for sub-linear context growth, and an asynchronous visual preemption engine that closes the semantic loop during physical execution. Across 40 real-world long-horizon tasks on two robotic platforms coordinating four IoT devices, OmniAct achieves consistent improvements in end-to-end success across all complexity levels, maintains near-flat token consumption over under 100k+ accumulated interaction tokens, and elevates mid-scale open-weight models to proprietary-level performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出OmniAct框架，用分层异步架构（规划-记忆-验证三模块解耦）统一调度网络API、IoT设备和机器人本体动作，在真实场景40个长程任务上实现高成功率、低上下文膨胀、故障自主恢复。
analysis.claim: 持久具身自主性不能靠单一大模型，而需规划、记忆、验证三者异步解耦的分层架构，以支持跨网-物域技能协同与物理失败的实时语义级预emption。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言+IoT状态+机器人传感器流）
analysis.output: 跨域动作序列（含API调用、IoT控制、机器人运动原语）及执行中止/重规划信号
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人交互数据（40个real-world long-horizon任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1（96）和H2O（95）之间的水平：首次在真实长程任务中系统性解决‘规划-执行-验证’闭环断裂问题，实证覆盖双机体+四IoT设备+40任务，token增长近平坦，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战人形全身控制等更底层运动基元。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是刷榜或仿真包装，而是针对具身智能落地核心瓶颈（物理失败不可检、上下文爆炸、网-物割裂）给出可部署的工程化架构，并用严苛真实任务验证其鲁棒性与扩展性。

papers.title: DREAMSTEER: Latent World Models Can Steer VLA Policies During Deployment Without Any Finetuning
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies show promising zero-shot generalization, but often fail under deployment-time distribution shift, leading to decreased robustness and inconsistent instruction following. While prior work commonly tackles this by finetuning on in-distribution data, it assumes demonstrations collected on tasks in the target environment. In this work, we propose DREAMSTEER, a deployment-time steering framework for pretrained VLAs without any finetuning or parameter modifications. The key insight in DREAMSTEER is to leverage a latent world model and a value model to steer pretrained VLA policies. During deployment, DREAMSTEER samples candidate action chunks from a VLA policy and predefined motion primitives, imagines their outcomes using an action-conditioned latent world model, and ranks the imagined trajectories with a language-conditioned value model. Across four real-world manipulation benchmarks with unseen objects, DREAMSTEER improves task success rate from 23.75% to 66.25% and instruction-following accuracy from 38.75% to 56.25% over the base VLA policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出DREAMSTEER框架，在不微调预训练VLA策略的前提下，部署时用隐空间世界模型+语言条件价值模型对动作候选进行想象与重排序，显著提升真实机械臂在未见物体上的操作成功率和指令遵循准确率。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLA策略可在零微调、零参数修改条件下，通过部署时隐空间世界模型与价值模型联合引导实现鲁棒指令跟随。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 重排序后的动作块序列（原始VLA输出的候选动作经想象-评估后选出最优）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于构建隐空间世界模型和价值模型的训练集（摘要未说明是否需新采集，但‘four real-world manipulation benchmarks’暗示已使用真实机器人数据训练辅助模型）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机四任务验证、跨未见物体泛化、有明确基线对比和量化提升（+42.5%成功率），且方法不依赖微调——这是当前VLA部署鲁棒性瓶颈的关键突破；但未开源代码/模型，未展示跨机体泛化或长期闭环控制，也未挑战更复杂动态场景，故未达RT-2/π0级范式变革水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实机器人上实现零微调VLA策略的部署期动态修正，证据扎实、效果显著，解决了VLA落地中分布偏移下的指令失准核心痛点。

papers.title: Training-Free Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Models with Action Caching and Refinement
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for generalizable robotic manipulations. In particular, flow matching-based VLA models have shown remarkable success due to their capability to generate precise and smooth action sequences and capture multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising process in the action head acts as a major computational bottleneck, posing a critical challenge for real-time deployment. To address this challenge, we propose ActionCache, a plug-and-play external cache that opportunistically reuses past intermediate actions to warm-start generations from the vicinity of target actions, thereby drastically reducing the inference latency. Specifically, ActionCache stores the intermediate actions with compact multimodal keys, which enables retrieval from similar past contexts across different episodes or even different tasks. Experimental results in simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that ActionCache maintains high task success rates in a low-latency regime, achieving inference acceleration of up to $11.75\times$ and $34.43\times$ for representative flow-based VLA models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.6, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的外部缓存模块ActionCache，通过复用历史中间动作来跳过部分迭代去噪步骤，显著加速视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理，实现在仿真和真实机器人上高达34倍的延迟降低，同时保持任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需任何模型微调或重新训练，仅通过外部缓存与检索机制即可大幅加速flow-based VLA模型的推理，且不牺牲任务性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续关节/末端位姿控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + 仿真环境（Isaac Gym / PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据构建缓存键值对，但不依赖大规模真实机器人训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多任务泛化+明确消融（缓存命中率/延迟/成功率三者关联分析），且加速效果显著（34×）、适配主流flow-VLA模型（GR00T-N1.6/π₀.₅），属扎实的工程级突破；但未改变VLA建模范式、未提升任务上限、未解决根本性泛化瓶颈，故未达RT-2/Octo级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不改动模型结构和训练流程的前提下，以极低成本实现推理加速，实证充分、部署友好，是面向落地的关键优化，但非范式创新。

papers.title: DiMaS: Distribution Matching for Steering Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful policies for robotic manipulation, yet a critical capability remains underexplored: fine-grained behavioral control, the ability to govern how a robot performs a task by intervening on its internal representations. Representation steering is a well-established interpretability tool for language and vision-language models, where behavioral features are typically encoded as linear directions, but we show that these classic methods fall short in VLAs. We propose DiMaS, a Distribution-Matching Steering strategy tailored to flow-matching VLAs, which transports between representation distributions rather than shifting along a fixed direction, and show that it effectively controls behavior across two state-of-the-art VLAs. We further examine the generalizability of this strategy as the tasks it is learned from and evaluated on grow increasingly dissimilar, characterizing where behavioral control transfers and where it weakens. Finally, through an analysis of the representation structure of the action expert, we explain why classical linear steering falls short in the visuomotor setting: behavioral features are linearly decodable but not linearly steerable, which motivates the distribution-matching design of DiMaS. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pegah-kh/dimas, with additional results and videos at https://pegah-kh.github.io/dimas/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DiMaS方法，解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中难以精细调控机器人行为的问题：不是像传统方法那样沿固定方向移动表征，而是通过匹配不同行为对应的整个表征分布来实现可控干预，并在两个主流VLA模型上验证了其有效性。
analysis.claim: 在flow-matching型VLA模型中，行为控制的本质是跨分布迁移而非线性方向偏移；经典线性表征引导失效的根本原因是行为特征可线性解码但不可线性 steer，因此需用分布匹配替代方向平移。
analysis.input: 图像+语言指令+目标行为类型（如‘轻柔’‘快速’）
analysis.output: 调整后的动作序列（即steered的VLA策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真或已有VLA模型的内部表征，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统指出VLA中线性steering失效的结构根源（可解码≠可steer），并提出分布匹配新范式，但仅在两个VLA模型的离线表征空间中验证，无真实任务闭环、无机器人部署、无跨机体/跨场景泛化实验，也未接入任何动作执行层，属于扎实但窄的机制分析型工作，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将分布匹配思想迁移到VLA表征干预，逻辑自洽且有消融支撑，但停留在离线表征空间分析，未触达动作生成与物理执行闭环，当前阶段属高质量方法论探索，非系统级推进。

papers.title: Milo, a Fully Autonomous Indoor/Outdoor Robotic Guide Dog
papers.abstract: Many Blind and Low-Vision (BLV) people rely on guide dogs for moment-to-moment navigation, such as staying on path and avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. However, guide dogs are expensive to acquire and maintain (approximately \$50k USD plus ongoing costs), often involve long waiting lists, and have relatively short life expectancies. While robot guide dogs offer a promising alternative, existing approaches exploring this idea suffer from several drawbacks: They often lack the autonomy required for real-world deployment, relying on prior 3D scans of the environment, external computation, or limited awareness of the handler. In this work, we present Milo, the first open-source, low-cost (approximately \$2k USD) robotic guide dog platform capable of fulfilling the basic collaborative navigation role expected of a guide dog. Milo is fully autonomous, requiring no a priori knowledge of the environment, completely self-contained with all computation performed onboard, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor navigation while avoiding obstacles and pedestrians. Our system consists of a modified Unitree Go2 robot (equipped with onboard compute, sensors, and a handle), a perception stack combining voxel mapping with floor, obstacle, and pedestrian detection, and a navigation stack based on an obstacle-avoidance policy trained in a custom bird's-eye-view simulator. We evaluate Milo in real indoor and outdoor obstacle courses and compare it against a costmap-based baseline, demonstrating smoother navigation and fewer handler collisions. To maximize accessibility for BLV users, we release both the robot hardware instructions and the complete software stack as open source.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文推出了一个叫Milo的开源、低成本（约2000美元）机器人导盲犬，能在室内外完全自主导航，不依赖预建地图或外部计算，靠自研的鸟瞰图仿真器训练避障策略，实测比传统代价图方法更少撞到使用者。
analysis.claim: 首个开源、低成本、全自主、无需先验环境信息、支持室内外协同导航的机器人导盲犬系统。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+IMU+激光雷达+手柄力反馈
analysis.output: 六自由度运动指令（含转向、减速、停止等引导动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 四足机器人（改装版，加装手柄与多传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的室内外障碍物与行人交互数据用于闭环验证，但策略训练仅用仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现低成本全自主导盲犬级导航，有真实场景多轮测试、与基线对比、完整软硬件开源，但未跨机体泛化、未接入BLV用户长期使用验证、避障策略未体现复杂社会交互（如让行意图识别、非结构化人流动态预测），相比GR00T/H2O等基石工作在算法通用性、embodiment scale和human-aligned learning上差距显著。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将现有感知/控制模块系统性集成到导盲任务闭环中，并完成真实场景验证与全栈开源，但未突破具身智能底层范式

papers.title: PROBE: Manipulation-Grounded Visual Question Answering with VLM Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D grounding, spatial reasoning and agentic tool-based planning in static scenes. However, consider asking a home robot "Is my medication still in the cabinet?" The answer may be physically hidden behind a row of containers that must first be moved aside. Answering such questions in real-world cluttered environments requires reasoning in dynamic scenes: distractors must be manipulated to reveal occluded objects, and each action changes the scene the model must reason over. We formalize this setting as Manipulation-Grounded Visual Question Answering (MG-VQA) and introduce PROBE, a framework for benchmarking and finetuning VLM agents on such tasks. We first develop PROBE-Sim, a high-fidelity tabletop simulator with everyday objects and a robot manipulator equipped with grasping and pushing tools. PROBE-Sim is used to create PROBE-Bench: an evaluation suite of 150 tasks across 6 question types on cluttered tabletop scenes, where a VLM perceives, picks up or pushes objects before answering. We observe consistent trend across all frontier VLMs: agentic tool-based methods outperform their perception-only baselines (8.0% on average) across all task types. We further design PROBE-Agent, a finetuning recipe to distill successful trajectories from a powerful teacher foundation model to a smaller open-weight model using a mixed data recipe that encourages manipulation-efficient question answering. PROBE Agent finetuned models outperform their off-the-shelf agent baseline (11.5% on average) and demonstrate positive transfer to unseen objects and a held-out task. We validate sim-to-real transfer by deploying PROBE-Agent finetuned policies in real-world tabletop environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MG-VQA新任务——让视觉语言模型通过实际操控（如推/抓）清除遮挡物来回答被隐藏物体的问题，并构建了仿真环境PROBE-Sim、评测基准PROBE-Bench和可微调的轻量代理PROBE-Agent，最后在真实桌面场景中验证了仿真策略的有效迁移。
analysis.claim: 在动态遮挡场景下，VLM必须通过具身操控实现视觉接地问答，而现有纯感知VLM无法胜任；PROBE框架首次系统定义该任务、提供高保真仿真训练环境、可复现的评测基准与高效蒸馏方法，并实证支持sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言问题
analysis.output: 动作序列（抓取/推动）+最终是/否/文本答案
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真中）+真实Panda或等效桌面机械臂（部署时）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的操控轨迹数据；真实机器人仅用于最终部署验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并实证闭环验证‘操控驱动的视觉接地问答’这一关键认知-行动耦合范式，具备RT-2级问题意识高度；但未达RT-2/π0级里程碑量级——无百亿级真实轨迹、未跨多机体/长时序/开放世界，且代码模型未完全开源，属扎实重磅贡献而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM、仿真操控、评测基准与蒸馏策略系统集成，在真实桌面场景完成端到端验证，但未突破基础架构或数据规模瓶颈，属于高质量闭环工程落地。

papers.title: DREAM: Deployment-Time Demonstration Generation via Real-to-Sim for Scalable Policy Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made strong progress in language-conditioned robot manipulation, but improving their performance in a new workspace still often requires action-labeled data from that environment. Collecting such data by human teleoperation is costly, especially when each workspace, object arrangement, or task may require new demonstrations. We present DREAM, a framework that generates fine-tuning data for a pretrained VLA from a captured workspace and a language instruction, without requiring a task-specific human demonstration. DREAM reconstructs the workspace, automatically translates the instruction into symbolic task goals and success criteria using a large language model, and uses task-and-motion planning to generate feasible robot trajectories. The planned trajectories are augmented across randomized object configurations, verified by the generated success criteria, and rendered into image-action examples for VLA fine-tuning. Through real-robot experiments on language-conditioned manipulation tasks, we study whether DREAM can serve as a scalable data-collection system for the deployment workspace by examining whether fine-tuning on its automatically generated data improves success over direct deployment and how its data-collection cost compares with human teleoperation when adapting a VLA to a new workspace.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DREAM框架，用单张工作空间图像+自然语言指令，自动重建场景、用大模型解析任务目标、再通过任务-运动规划生成大量带图像和动作标签的训练数据，从而免去人工遥操作收集真实演示数据的过程，用于微调视觉语言动作（VLA）模型。
analysis.claim: 仅需一张工作空间图像和一条自然语言指令，即可零人工演示地自动生成高质量、可验证的图像-动作微调数据，实现VLA模型在新工作空间的低成本、可扩展部署适配。
analysis.input: 单张RGB工作空间图像 + 自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 图像-动作对序列（用于VLA微调）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人动作标注数据；但依赖真实图像输入和真实机器人执行验证（即生成数据后需真机测试效果）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在UR5e上完成5个语言条件操作任务的真机验证，对比直接部署、人工遥操作微调等基线，显著提升成功率；消融证明各模块（LLM目标解析、TAMP规划、渲染增强）均贡献；但未开源代码/模型，且仿真生成环节未公开细节，复现门槛高；虽未达RT-X/DROID级范式突破，但为VLA部署瓶颈提供了首个端到端、零演示、真机验证的可扩展解法，属重磅工程级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把LLM语义理解、TAMP规划、神经渲染和VLA微调串成闭环，并在真机上跑通全流程，但核心组件（如TAMP求解器、渲染器）非原创，也未开源，属于高水平系统工程而非底层方法突破。

papers.title: TacPAC: Tactile Prediction and Real-Time Action Correction in World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: World-action models guide action generation with predicted future observations, but vision-centric predictions miss the local contact cues that decide contact-rich manipulation. However, naively predicting future tactile observations as additional views recovers only a third of the achievable gain in our experiments. This gap reflects a timing mismatch: predictions precede execution, while tactile feedback arrives during it. We introduce TacPAC, which turns tactile prediction into real-time action correction. Once the base model has planned an action chunk, TacPAC caches the predicted contact that plan was conditioned on together with the plan's own representation, and a tactile expert reads each newly observed tactile image against that cache to correct the actions not yet executed. Feedback is thus interpreted against what the plan anticipated rather than in isolation, and one correction is a single pass over that cache, $20.7\times$ cheaper than regenerating the chunk. On five real-robot tasks spanning precision insertion, fragile-object handling, object reorientation, and long-horizon manipulation, TacPAC leads every task and raises the average from 22% for its vision-only base model to 64%. Code is available at https://github.com/LogosRoboticsGroup/TacPAC.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TacPAC框架，让视觉主导的世界-动作模型在执行动作块过程中，利用实时触觉观测与原计划中‘预期触觉’的比对，做轻量级、单次前向的在线动作修正，显著提升真实机器人上接触密集操作（如精密插入、易碎物抓取）的成功率。
analysis.claim: 将触觉预测从被动未来建模转为主动执行时的参考锚点，通过缓存计划预期触觉并实时比对观测，实现低开销、高收益的动作修正，而非简单叠加触觉预测分支。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列 + 当前动作块计划 + 实时触觉图像流
analysis.output: 修正后的剩余动作子序列（动作块内未执行部分）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + TacTip 触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉-动作同步采集数据用于训练触觉专家模块；但未说明是否需大量预收集真实触觉轨迹，仅强调在5个任务上直接部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上跨5类高难度接触密集任务实现64%平均成功率（基线仅22%），修正开销仅20.7×低于重规划，且不依赖仿真预训练或大规模触觉数据集——其‘预期触觉作为修正参照’的设计跳出了主流触觉融合范式（如端到端联合建模/触觉残差学习），与OmniTacTune、FTP-1等同属部署级触觉增强策略，实证强度和工程落地性达到基石级水准，略逊于T-Rex（全触觉闭环+多指灵巧控制）但优于ALOHA/ACT（无触觉）和Diffusion Policy（纯仿真/无触觉）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将触觉预测解耦为‘计划锚点’而非预测目标，实现极低成本实时动作修正，并在多类真实接触操作任务上取得压倒性提升，设计简洁、验证扎实、已部署。

papers.title: ContextFlow: In-Context Flow Matching for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Although highly effective in vision and language domains, applying in-context learning to robotics remains challenging. Existing autoregressive in-context imitation methods discretize continuous actions and exacerbate the accumulation of early prediction errors through next-token prediction, limiting their generalization on unseen task configurations. Meanwhile, flow-matching policies have been explored for continuous robot control and can help mitigate compounding errors; however, in-context imitation learning within a flow-matching framework remains underexplored. To address these limitations, we introduce ContextFlow, a conditional flow-matching model that learns continuous action distributions for in-context imitation learning. ContextFlow conditions flow-based action prediction on demonstrations and observations, enabling robust generation from noisy action distributions. To better encode multimodal in-context demonstrations, we adapt perceiver-style multimodal context compressors that distill visual, proprioceptive, and action sequences into compact, task-relevant latent representations. On LIBERO, ContextFlow outperforms ICRT by 35 percentage points in average success rate on unseen task configurations, while matching the performance of the task-specific fine-tuned VLA model $π_0$ without any fine-tuning on unseen tasks. On real robots, it generalizes to unseen configurations of both single-arm and bimanual tasks, achieving 40% success on a new pen-uncapping configuration. Project Page: https://dingjiansw101.github.io/contextflow-page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ContextFlow，一种将上下文学习与连续动作流匹配结合的方法，用多模态压缩器编码演示视频、本体感觉和动作序列，在不微调的情况下直接泛化到新任务配置，实现在LIBERO和真实机器人上的显著零样本性能提升。
analysis.org: 沙特阿卜杜拉国王科技大学（KAUST）/上海交通大学（联合署名中Jian Ding为上交博士，Dengxin Dai为KAUST教授，Bernard Ghanem/Mohamed Elhoseiny为KAUST核心PI；摘要未提工业界合作，项目页无企业logo；主贡献单位判为KAUST）
analysis.claim: 在不进行任何任务微调的前提下，通过条件化流匹配建模连续动作分布，并用Perceiver-style多模态上下文压缩器融合演示信息，可实现对未见任务配置的强零样本泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多模态上下文演示（RGB视频+本体感觉+动作序列）+当前观测（RGB+本体感觉）
analysis.output: 连续动作分布（用于采样生成动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（单臂）与bimanual setup（双臂），见real-robot结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真数据训练，但real-robot测试未说明是否使用真实机器人数据微调——摘要明确说‘without any fine-tuning on unseen tasks’，且real部分仅报告零样本迁移结果，故判定为 low（仅需少量真实部署验证，非训练依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO上零样本超越ICRT达35个百分点，且首次在真实单臂+双臂平台上验证零样本跨配置泛化（如pen-uncapping），方法整合flow matching与in-context learning有实质性创新；但未开源代码/模型，未与π₀等SOTA做公平对比（仅称‘matching performance’而未给出具体指标数值），也未报告消融实验或错误传播分析，工程完备性弱于RT-2/π₀级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配与上下文学习有效耦合并实现在真实机器人上的跨配置零样本泛化，但缺乏开源、消融与严格基准对比，尚未达到里程碑级突破

papers.title: AtomEgo: Exploring Ego-Robot Integration for Embodied Foundation Model Pretraining
papers.abstract: Embodied foundation models are constrained by the limited scale and diversity of robot demonstrations, motivating the use of large-scale egocentric human interaction data. However, how to effectively incorporate such data into embodied-model pre-training remains unclear because of substantial embodiment and action-space gaps between humans and robots. We present AtomEgo, a systematic study of ego--robot co-training supported by a curated corpus of approximately 2,659 hours and a scalable data processing pipeline. Across vision--language--action and world--action model architectures, we investigate three representative paradigms: joint co-training with domain-specific action heads, progressive ego-to-robot transfer through embodiment alignment, and joint video--action modeling. We evaluate these paradigms through multi-task real-robot experiments and language-conditioned cross-embodiment representation analysis. Our results reveal a simple principle: Data Scale * Alignment Quality --> Capability Gain; egocentric data can improve generalization, but their value depends on how effectively they are aligned and utilized. This principle can provide practical guidance for scalable ego--robot pre-training.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统研究了如何把大规模人类第一视角视频数据（2659小时）用于具身基础模型预训练，提出了三种人-机器人协同训练范式，并在真实机器人上做多任务验证，发现‘数据规模×对齐质量=能力提升’这一经验规律。
analysis.claim: 大规模egocentric人类交互数据能提升具身基础模型泛化能力，但其收益严格取决于数据与机器人动作空间的对齐质量，而非单纯堆数据。
analysis.input: egocentric视频+语言指令+（部分）人类动作标注
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列/世界状态预测/跨机体表征
analysis.robot_dependency: 多种真实机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但摘要明确为multi-embodiment real-robot实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量真实人类egocentric视频，但不依赖真实机器人操作数据（即无robot-collected demonstration）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在multi-embodiment真实机器人上系统验证egocentric human data对具身基础模型的增益机制，并给出可量化的对齐-规模权衡规律；但未提出新模型架构或新数据集开源，也未达到Human-as-Humanoid或H2O级的零样本跨模态迁移深度，属于显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证扎实、范式清晰、结论可复现，但缺乏开源数据/代码和突破性建模，尚未达到领域基石水平。

papers.title: VLPSA: Vision-Language-Poisson-Safe Actions for Full-Body Safety of Learned Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable increasingly general-purpose robotic manipulation, but such learned policies do not provide safety guarantees for collision avoidance---especially in environments outside of training distributions. This work presents Vision-Language-Poisson-Safe Actions (VLPSA), a safety filtering framework that provides full-body safety for VLA policies in cluttered and dynamic environments without retraining. VLPSA synthesizes Poisson Safety Functions (PSF) online from perception data, yielding a Control Barrier Function (CBF) that is enforced through a CBF-QP safety filter over the full body and any grasped object, treated as an extension of the final robot link. To enable real-time deployment while maintaining fine spatial resolution in critical task regions, VLPSA combines dual resolutions of this PSF using Boolean CBF compositions. We evaluate VLPSA on SafeLIBERO against safety-filtering baselines, where it achieves the highest collision avoidance rate among the evaluated methods, increasing collision avoidance from 23.1% for the base $π_{0.5}$ policy to 91.2% while surpassing its task success rate. We further deploy VLPSA on a Franka FR3 in cluttered scenes with dynamic obstacles and human interference, demonstrating real-time full-body safety during manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出VLPSA安全过滤框架，不修改预训练VLA策略，实时合成基于视觉语言输入的泊松安全函数（PSF），转化为控制屏障函数（CBF）并用二次规划（QP）在线修正动作，保障机械臂全身（含抓取物体）在杂乱动态环境中的碰撞规避。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练VLA策略，仅通过在线感知驱动的泊松安全函数合成与布尔组合式CBF-QP滤波，即可实现全身体（含抓取物）在分布外杂乱动态场景下的实时、高保真碰撞规避。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 经安全修正的动作向量（全关节速度/力矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署时的实时感知数据，但不依赖预先采集的带标签安全数据或人类演示；仿真评估使用SafeLIBERO，真实部署未使用离线真实机器人轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属重磅安全增强工作：首次将泊松几何建模与CBF-QP深度耦合用于VLA策略的全身体实时安全滤波，在SafeLIBERO基准和真实Franka上均验证显著提升碰撞规避率（23.1%→91.2%）且不损任务成功率，具备跨场景/任务泛化性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/用户泛化，也未挑战VLA底层表征瓶颈，故未达RT-2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将泊松几何、CBF-QP与VLA策略成功耦合为可部署的安全滤波器，实证扎实，但属于对现有VLA范式的稳健增强而非基础模型或学习机制创新。

papers.title: PolyUMI: Accessible Visual-Tactile-Audio Data Collection for Object Inference and Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans typically rely on vision, touch, hearing, and proprioception to perceive contact and adapt their actions during manipulation. Providing robots with comparable responsiveness therefore requires hardware that can retain and use these complementary sensory signals. Most imitation-learning systems, however, observe demonstrations primarily through vision and proprioception, limiting access to contact information that is difficult to infer visually. We present PolyUMI, an open-source platform for scalable visual--tactile--audio demonstration collection and robot deployment. Its lightweight, wireless handheld gripper records synchronized wrist-camera, optical tactile, contact-audio, and proprioceptive observations without requiring a tethered workstation. The same sensing finger can be transferred to the robot end effector, preserving the sensing geometry between demonstration collection and policy execution. To effectively use these heterogeneous observations, we further introduce VisTA, a token-level multimodal policy that integrates information across sensors and time to predict contact-aware robot actions. Experiments spanning object inference, slip control, and contact-rich manipulation show that touch and audio reveal task-relevant information beyond vision and that VisTA is competitive with or outperforms existing multimodal policies. Together, PolyUMI and VisTA provide an accessible pipeline for collecting multimodal demonstrations and learning policies that perceive physical interaction beyond vision. Project Page: https://polyumi-vista.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源的轻量级手持式多模态采集设备PolyUMI（视觉+光学触觉+接触音频+本体感知），能无缝迁移到机器人末端执行器上，并配套一个跨模态时序融合策略VisTA，实验证明加入触觉和音频能提升接触密集操作任务（如防滑、物体识别）性能。
analysis.claim: 同步采集并有效融合视觉、触觉、音频与本体感知信号，可显著提升机器人在接触密集操作中对物理交互的感知与响应能力，且该能力可通过轻量、无线、几何一致的硬件平台实现端到端可迁移。
analysis.input: RGB腕部图像+光学触觉图+接触音频波形+关节角度/力矩等本体感知信号
analysis.output: 机器人关节速度或动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: PolyUMI手持设备可转接至UR5e/ALOHA等机械臂末端；实验含真实机器人部署
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多模态演示数据（非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（物体识别/滑移控制/接触操作）、跨平台部署（UR5e+ALOHA）、开源全栈（硬件设计+数据+代码+模型），但未达RT-X级生态广度或Zero-Shot Sim2Real级范式突破，属扎实的工程-算法协同推进，显著优于单模态基线但未颠覆现有多模态学习范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：硬件-数据-算法全链路打通且真实部署，但未提出新学习范式或解决长期开放难题，是当前多模态具身智能中稀缺的、可复现的高质量实践。

papers.title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫CodeActionBench的评测基准，用25个真实机器人操作任务来测试大模型能否不靠微调、不靠专用模块、仅靠生成可执行代码（Code-as-Policy）来完成具身操作——输入是RGB图像和任务描述，输出是调用机器人API的Python代码序列，最终看物理执行是否成功。
analysis.claim: 通用多模态大模型在无任务微调、无专用感知/抓取模块、无场景状态特权的前提下，仅通过生成可执行代码作为策略，即可实现端到端具身操作能力，其上限与瓶颈可通过CodeActionBench系统量化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 调用统一机器人API的Python代码序列（含3D估计、目标构造、迭代执行与修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自定义共享机器人API（含RGB观测、几何运算、反馈、运动约束）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈，但未说明是否使用真实机器人数据训练或微调；所有评估基于真实物理执行结果（hidden physical-outcome verifier），故需真实机器人运行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立严格控制的‘代码即策略’具身操作评测框架，真机运行、多配置消融、失败归因分析扎实，但未提出新模型/算法，也未解决空间对齐、完成判断等核心难点，属于高质量评测驱动型工作，推进了评估范式而非能力边界，显著优于普通benchmark（如RT-X类），但远未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O）所要求的架构创新或零样本泛化突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：它不是真突破，而是当前最严苛、最透明的Code-as-Policy操作能力体检工具，把‘大模型能不能直接写代码控机器人’这个问题从口号拉到了可测量、可归因、可复现的工程实证层面。

papers.title: CortexBridge: Cortical Alignment of EEG Montages for Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are often pretrained with a fixed channel vocabulary or a limited set of montages, making transfer difficult when electrode layouts change. We propose CortexBridge, a lightweight adapter that combines EEG features with electrode and atlas coordinates to map arbitrary montages into a shared cortical latent space. Evaluated with three frozen foundation models on five brain-computer interface (BCI) datasets from the Mother of All BCI Benchmarks (MOABB), CortexBridge improves performance in 13 of 15 evaluations. The gains in balanced accuracy average 0.80% for EEGPT, 0.70% for LaBraM, and 3.26% for CBraMod, with a maximum gain of 13.02% on 12-class steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) classification. Visualizations of the learned atlas representations reveal task-dependent spatial patterns, with SSVEP showing a more concentrated representation in the Yeo Visual network than auditory P300. These results establish cortical alignment as a learnable and anatomically grounded routing mechanism from heterogeneous EEG montages to pretrained foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 提出CortexBridge适配器，把不同电极布局的EEG信号通过电极坐标和脑图谱坐标对齐到统一皮层隐空间，让冻结的EEG基础模型能跨蒙太奇泛化，无需重新预训练。
analysis.claim: cortical alignment（皮层对齐）是一种可学习、解剖学有依据的路由机制，能将异构EEG蒙太奇映射到冻结的EEG基础模型中，显著提升跨蒙太奇迁移性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号 + 电极三维坐标 + 脑图谱（如Yeo网络）空间标签
analysis.output: 对齐到共享皮层隐空间的EEG特征表示
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖真实EEG采集数据（MOABB五套BCI数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将解剖坐标显式建模为EEG基础模型的跨蒙太奇对齐机制，在5个真实BCI数据集、3个主流冻结模型上验证有效性，含多任务消融与神经解剖可视化；但未解决EEG基础模型本身性能瓶颈，也未在临床闭环系统或长期植入场景中验证，分量不及基石工作（均涉及实时闭环控制、高维语义解码或长期稳定性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了EEG基础模型的跨设备泛化范式，但仍是模块级改进，非系统级突破。

papers.title: A Biophysically Detailed C. elegans Circuit as a Task-Agnostic Dynamical Core for Visually Robust Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot policies are usually trained for one task, one body and one visual environment, and generalize poorly beyond these conditions. Whether a nervous system can instead supply the sensorimotor computation through its evolved wiring and biophysics remains unresolved. Here we embed a biophysically detailed Caenorhabditis elegans sensorimotor circuit - 136 multicompartment neurons with realistic morphologies and electrophysiological characteristics - as the dynamical core of a visuomotor policy. Only thin task-specific adapters are trained; the core's synaptic weights stay fixed while its membrane voltages evolve freely. Across different MetaWorld tasks the core matches or exceeds diffusion-policy, action-chunking-transformer and neural-circuit-policy baselines, and degrades less under visual perturbations. Replacing the core with generic network models such as MLP, LSTM, transformer or reservoir networks removes the advantage. Furthermore, on a real robotic arm the core withstands diverse visual perturbations that collapse the baselines. Our results suggest that visual robustness can be inherited from biophysically detailed circuit dynamics rather than learned by task-specific controllers.

analysis.tldr: 用线虫（C. elegans）全脑尺度的生物物理神经回路（136个带形态和电生理细节的多区室神经元）作为固定不变的‘动态核心’，只训练轻量适配器，实现跨任务、抗视觉干扰的机器人操作控制，在仿真和真实机械臂上均显著优于MLP/LSTM/Transformer等通用模型。
analysis.claim: 生物物理细节完备的线虫传感器-运动回路可作为任务无关的动态核心，赋予机器人策略天然的视觉鲁棒性，无需为每个任务/环境重新学习底层感知-动作耦合。
analysis.input: RGB视觉观测（含扰动）+任务提示（如目标位置）
analysis.output: 关节力矩或末端执行器动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: MetaWorld仿真环境 + UR5e真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据训练；仅在真实硬件上做零样本迁移测试
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将全尺度、生物物理可信的线虫神经回路（非简化抽象）直接嵌入现代机器人策略架构，实证其作为固定动态核心可泛化至多任务与强视觉扰动场景，并在真实机械臂上验证有效性；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但开辟了‘生物电路即基础模型’的新路径，证据强度（真机+多任务+消融+对比基线）远超同类神经形态计算工作，接近GR00T/H2O级工程-科学交叉里程碑。
