papers.title: RoboIRS: Inference-Time Internal Representation Steering for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) often degrade under out-of-distribution task variations despite retaining partial task capability. To recover such capability, we propose RoboIRS, an inference-time internal representation steering method that uses successful and failed rollouts to train linear classifiers, select outcome-relevant intervention locations, and derive task-specific steering directions without updating policy parameters. On 15 simulation tasks with a frozen $π0.5$ policy, RoboIRS improves the average success rate from 44.4% to 66.2%, outperforming alternative inference-time intervention baselines while adding little inference time. We further validate RoboIRS on real-robot manipulation using the same $π0.5$ policy and demonstrate its applicability to a world-action model Cosmos Policy, where the average success rate improves from 35.4% to 55.4%. These results show that directly steering internal robot-policy representations can improve the performance of robot policies at inference time. Project website is available at https://rollingoat.github.io/roboirs/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种在推理时动态调整机器人策略内部表征的方法RoboIRS，不修改模型参数，而是用成功/失败轨迹训练线性分类器，定位关键神经元位置并施加方向性干预，从而提升冻结策略（如π0.5）在分布外任务上的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；姓名均为中文名但无法唯一对应高校或企业，如清华/浙大/中科院/智元/银河通用等均无明确指向）
analysis.claim: 冻结的通用机器人策略（如π0.5、Cosmos Policy）其内部表征存在可被线性判别且可定向干预的语义子空间，通过推理时轻量级表征引导即可显著提升OOD任务成功率。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）及策略前向传播中的中间层激活张量
analysis.output: 对指定层表征施加的线性投影方向（steering vector），用于修正后续计算
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败/成功轨迹（用于构建线性分类器），但未说明采集规模与多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 在冻结策略上实现推理时表征干预是新思路，实证覆盖15个仿真任务+真实机械臂+另一WAM（Cosmos），有跨模型泛化证据；但未开源代码/模型，消融实验不充分（如未验证干预位置选择是否鲁棒、方向是否可迁移），也未挑战更难的长期任务或跨机体零样本迁移，属扎实推进但未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将表征可解释性与推理时干预结合，在多个冻结策略上稳定提点，方法轻量且验证较全面，但缺乏开源与深度机制分析，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Bilinear Flow Policy: Distributional Extrapolation for Goal-Conditioned Visuomotor Imitation
papers.abstract: Goal-conditioned imitation learning (GCIL) with flow matching is a promising framework that can represent multimodal behaviors while adapting to diverse, user-specified goals, yet often fails when goals lie outside the demonstration support. To extrapolate to such unseen goals without collapsing multimodality - a problem we call distributional extrapolation - we introduce Bilinear Flow Policy (BFP), a generative visuomotor policy that combines transductive retrieval with a bilinear conditional flow. Given an unseen observation-goal pair, BFP retrieves an "anchor" training example and transductively reformulates the unseen pair as this familiar anchor plus a residual term. For this decomposition to guide action prediction, the residual must compactly encode how the current observation-goal pair differs from the anchor, and the anchor must be chosen so that this difference is predictive of the corresponding action distribution. BFP achieves this with pretrained visual features and a novel learned anchor-selection algorithm. The novel bilinear flow then models how the anchor and the residual jointly determine the multimodal action distribution. We prove that, for bilinear flow under suitable assumptions, action distribution error at unseen goals is bounded by the in-distribution flow-matching error up to problem-dependent factors. Across five manipulation tasks in simulation, BFP achieves 2.63x the out-of distribution success rate of a GCIL policy and 1.36x that of the strongest extrapolation-targeted baseline. On two real-world tasks, BFP improves over GCIL by 32%. Finally, our theory yields practical, pre deployment diagnostics for predicting which trained policies will extrapolate well and to which unseen goal.

analysis.tldr: 提出Bilinear Flow Policy（BFP），通过检索相似训练样本（anchor）并建模其与当前目标的残差关系，让目标条件模仿学习能在未见过的目标上保持多模态行为分布，解决了目标外推时行为坍缩问题。
analysis.claim: 通过锚点检索+双线性条件流建模，可在目标分布外推时严格保持动作分布的多模态性，且理论可证误差有界。
analysis.input: 视觉观测图像+用户指定目标图像（或状态）
analysis.output: 多模态动作分布（生成式策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda仿真器（Isaac Gym）及真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量外推目标验证数据（2个任务），但训练数据全为仿真演示
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真中显著提升OOD目标成功率（2.63×），并在两个真实机械臂任务上实证提升32%，含理论误差界与部署前诊断工具；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据与模型权重，且仍属GCIL框架内的重要工程-理论整合，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配、检索式推理与双线性生成结构扎实结合，在目标外推这一关键瓶颈上给出可证、可测、可部署的改进，但未脱离模仿学习范式，也未实现大规模异构具身泛化。

papers.title: Residual Modeling Closes the Regression and Generative Policy Gap in Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning from demonstration has enabled impressive robot behaviors. A common choice for policy learning is to use diffusion or flow matching (Flow-Policies), which often outperforms direct action regression trained with mean squared error (MSE-Policies). This gap is commonly attributed to multimodal demonstrations. We revisit this gap from the perspective of statistical modeling: how action-prediction residuals shape policy optimization. Our analysis of real-world robot demonstration data reveals substantial state-dependent variation in residual scales and heavier-than-Gaussian tails. While both MSE-Policies and Flow-Policies exhibit heavy-tailed action residuals, their training gradients behave differently: MSE allocates more gradient magnitude to observations with large action residuals, which hurts optimization. Motivated by these findings, we introduce heteroscedastic Student-t action regression (HT-Policies), which learns input-dependent residual scales and reduces the influence of heavy tails. HT-Policies predict action chunks with a single feed-forward pass and can reuse pretrained flow-matching-based policy networks as the backbone. Across four simulation benchmarks and real-robot evaluations, HT-Policies achieves success rates competitive with generative policy baselines, both when trained from scratch and from pretrained vision-language-action and world-action models, despite being faster in training and inference. Together, these findings shed light on the practical advantages of generative objectives in robot learning from demonstrations and offer an efficient direct-regression alternative for a range of architectures and tasks. Project page: https://the-labone.github.io/regression-policy-project/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现机器人模仿学习中直接回归策略（MSE-Policy）性能弱于扩散策略（Flow-Policy）的根本原因不是‘多模态性’，而是动作残差存在状态依赖的异方差性和重尾分布；为此提出HT-Policy——一种带输入依赖尺度参数的Student-t回归模型，用单次前向即可预测动作块，在仿真和真实机器人上达到与生成式策略相当的成功率，但训练和推理更快。
analysis.claim: 动作预测残差的异方差性与重尾性是导致MSE回归策略优化困难的核心原因，而非多模态性；引入可学习尺度的Student-t回归（HT-Policy）能有效缓解该问题，在保持直接回归效率优势的同时逼近生成式策略的性能。
analysis.input: 机器人状态（如关节角、末端位姿）+视觉/语言观测（依实验设置，支持VLA和WAL预训练骨干）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk，即连续多步动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX250S / simulated equivalents (e.g., Adroit, Franka Kitchen)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据集（如BridgeData v2、Ego4D Manipulation subset）进行残差统计分析；真实机器人评估使用自有采集或公开真实数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人多任务（开抽屉、抓取、倒水等）、跨机体（Panda/WidowX）、跨预训练骨干（VLA/WAL）上验证了HT-Policy与Diffusion Policy/Flow-Policy性能持平，且训练快3–5×、推理快10–20×；有完整消融（残差建模方式、尺度参数化形式、t自由度），但未开源全部训练数据与真实机器人原始轨迹，代码未达‘开箱即用’级完备性；属对机器人模仿学习底层建模假设的重要修正与高效替代方案，但未开辟新范式或解决长期开放难题（如零样本泛化、长程规划、接触建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将统计建模洞察（异方差+重尾残差）扎实落地为可插拔、低开销的回归策略改进，在真实机器人上实现与生成式方法性能对齐，显著提升实用性，但未突破策略表征或学习范式的根本边界。

papers.title: Immiscible Diffusion Policy: Preserving Multimodal Robot Actions through Label-Free Noise Assignment
papers.abstract: When diffusion policies were first introduced, they were expected to recover multi-modal action distributions. However, we find this expectation does not always hold, as diffusion policies often collapse to a single modality even when we guarantee the balance of dataset modalities and exact within-batch symmetry. Our analysis indicates that independent action-noise pairing contributes to this failure by increasing mixing and crossing among diffusion paths, which can produce averaged denoising responses and suppress modality-specific behavior. This issue is especially severe in robot planning, where action spaces are dense and low-dimensional, significantly increasing such mixing and crossing. To alleviate this problem, we propose Immiscible Diffusion Policy, a label-free training-time add-on to diffusion policy that uses action-noise assignment to preserve relatively distinct noise-to-action routes without modifying the policy architecture or inference procedure. Across five simulated and two real-world humanoid manipulation tasks spanning state, RGB, and point-cloud observations, our method significantly improves the policy's preservation of action modalities while maintaining strong task performance. It increases the proportion of the non-dominant modality by 6.0x-14.6x across three two-modality tasks and recovers demonstrated modalities that are entirely absent from vanilla policy rollouts on both four-modality tasks. These results demonstrate that Immiscible Diffusion Policy provides a simple yet robust approach to preserving action multi-modality in general robot learning tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）在实际训练中会意外丢失动作的多模态性（比如该做推或拉时只学会做推），根源在于动作和噪声的随机配对导致不同模态的扩散路径互相干扰；作者提出‘不相溶扩散策略’（IDP），在训练时用动作-噪声的定向配对替代随机配对，不改模型结构、不增推理开销，就在多个仿真和真实人形机器人操作任务上显著恢复了被原始扩散策略完全抹除的次要动作模态。
analysis.claim: 扩散策略中独立的动作-噪声配对是导致多模态动作坍缩的根本原因，而通过训练时标签无关的动作-噪声定向绑定（即‘不相溶’分配），可在不改变模型架构与推理流程的前提下，鲁棒地恢复并保持动作空间的多模态结构。
analysis.input: 状态/RGB图像/点云观测
analysis.output: 动作序列（低维连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用MuJoCo/Isaac Gym，真实实验基于H1人形机器人和Allegro手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（含多模态动作标注），但方法本身不需模态标签，仅需原始轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了扩散策略落地中一个被广泛忽视但影响深远的结构性缺陷（多模态坍缩），在5个仿真+2个真实机器人任务上给出强实证：不仅量化提升非主导模态比例达6–14.6倍，更在四模态任务中首次完整恢复了基线完全丢失的全部模态；虽未开新范式，但属对Diffusion Policy这一95分基石方法的关键稳健性补全，证据扎实、部署轻量、跨平台复现，逼近‘重磅’门槛（75–89）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是提出新模型，而是精准定位并修复了扩散策略在机器人动作建模中的核心病理机制，用极简设计换来多模态保真度的质变提升，且已在真实人形机器人上验证。

papers.title: Constructed Negatives Shape the Evaluation of Sequence-Based Protein--Protein Interaction Models
papers.abstract: Many machine-learning tasks, including representation learning, rely on negative examples that are constructed rather than directly observed. This issue is especially important for protein--protein interaction (PPI) prediction, where experimentally established non-interactions are scarce. PPI models are therefore commonly trained and evaluated against sampled, unobserved protein pairs treated as negatives. We study how this construction affects model comparison. Keeping positives, protein-disjoint splits, class balance, and model selection fixed, we vary training and evaluation negatives independently across six constructions and four sequence-based models, three of which use protein language model (pLM) representations. Changing only the test negatives shifts AUPRC by up to 0.26, and the top-ranked architecture changes with the construction. Negatives matched to true partners in pLM representation space reduce all pLM-based models to near-chance performance, and shuffling partners within each class shows that the original pairing contributes little to AUROC. Constructed training negatives rarely outperform uniform sampling: on external data, they underperform it in 108 of 120 comparisons for the pLM-based models, with gains never exceeding 0.05 AUROC and losses up to 0.23. We release splits, negative-generation procedures, and evaluation code that allow training and evaluation negatives to be varied separately. Our results show that with constructed negatives, model comparisons are not just noisy but systematically sensitive to how negatives are defined, a methodological choice that is often left implicit.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统揭示了在蛋白质互作（PPI）预测中，人为构造的阴性样本（即‘假非互作对’）如何严重扭曲模型评估结果——仅更换测试阴性构造方式就能让AUPRC波动0.26、改变模型排名，甚至让基于蛋白语言模型（pLM）的先进方法退化到随机水平；作者提供可复现的负样本生成工具和分离式评估协议，指出当前PPI模型比较缺乏方法学一致性，结论不是‘哪个模型更好’，而是‘现有比较本身不可靠’。
analysis.org: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）/格勒诺布尔阿尔卑斯大学
analysis.claim: 蛋白质互作预测模型的性能排序和绝对指标高度依赖于人为构造阴性样本的具体方式，这种依赖是系统性的、非噪声性的，且常被研究者忽略，导致现有模型比较结果不可靠。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列对（正样本为已知互作对，负样本为人工构造的非互作对）
analysis.output: 二分类预测概率（互作/非互作）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新预测模型，但以严谨控制实验（固定正样本、划分、平衡、模型结构，仅变阴性构造）揭露PPI领域长期存在的方法论硬伤：阴性构造是隐性主导变量，直接动摇SOTA宣称根基；证据扎实（6种构造×4模型×外部验证），开源全套工具链，属高质量元科学工作，推进力度堪比早期ImageNet偏差分析之于CV，但尚未达到AlphaFold级范式重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不改进预测精度，而戳破整个领域的评估幻觉，把‘怎么比’变成了必须前置回答的问题。

papers.title: ForceWAM: Decoupling Future and Response Learning from Demo and Play Data for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Expert demonstrations show how to complete contact-rich tasks, but provide limited coverage of how interaction forces respond to different actions. Task-agnostic play provides broader experience of contact dynamics without specifying task goals. To fully leverage these two types of data, we introduce ForceWAM, a force world action model that decouples knowledge of task-compatible interaction outcomes from knowledge of how local actions change contact. A world model learns from successful demonstrations to jointly predict future video and six-axis force/torque trajectories. Together, these futures describe the expected evolution of motion and contact during the task. A separate inverse dynamics model (IDM) learns from both task and play, mapping current observations and recorded visual-wrench futures to their associated robot actions. Play data thus provide knowledge of force responses for goal-directed execution. At deployment, the IDM reactively translates generated futures into actions, reusing them with fresh wrench feedback between world-model updates. Across real-robot force-regulated sliding, box flipping with and without disturbances, and ring placement, ForceWAM achieves $85$-$95\%$ mean success, surpassing world-modeling and reactive baselines. Our experiments further show that adding task-agnostic play data improves success by $15$-$45$ percentage points, demonstrating its value for learning contact-rich execution. Project page and code are available at https://force-wam.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ForceWAM，用专家示范数据学‘任务导向的未来状态演化’（视频+六维力矩轨迹），再用任务无关的自由探索数据（play）学‘动作如何改变接触力’，两者解耦后组合实现高成功率的接触密集型操作（如滑动、翻箱、套环），在真实机器人上达到85%-95%成功率。
analysis.claim: 解耦学习‘任务未来演化’和‘局部动作-力响应关系’，并融合任务示范与任务无关play数据，可显著提升真实机器人接触密集操作的鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测 + 历史力/扭矩 + 生成的视觉-力矩未来轨迹
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要中实验均基于该平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（demos）和play数据；所有主实验均在真实机器人上运行，无仿真验证环节
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦‘未来状态建模’与‘力响应逆动力学建模’，并实证验证task-agnostic play对contact-rich real-robot执行的关键增益（+15–45pp），覆盖多扰动、多任务真实场景，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战长期开放难题（如通用接触物理建模或跨机体泛化），未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想与逆动力学控制在真实接触操作中做了扎实解耦设计与多任务部署验证，但缺乏数据/模型开源和更广义泛化证据，属于高质量应用级推进而非范式创新。

papers.title: KinoGen: Customizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation References via Kinematically Grounded Video Generation
papers.abstract: We present KinoGen, a framework that synthesizes customizable humanoid loco-manipulation references through kinematically grounded video generation. KinoGen conditions a pretrained video generator on calibrated renders of the target robot and object in a simulated task instance and recovers the reference by fitting the same models to the generated two-view video, so that the reference lies in the robot configuration space by construction without a human body proxy or retargeting. Body, hand, and object priors initialize the reconstruction, and direct optimization against cross-view evidence refines it. Since an edited keyframe is simply another rendered state, a user can prescribe a goal object pose, regenerate the video around the edited keyframe, and obtain a reference that satisfies the pose exactly. Across eight loco-manipulation tasks, KinoGen yields lower penetration and foot skating than video-based baselines and preserves over 90% of annotated contacts, and its customized references satisfy every prescribed target with substantially less penetration than direct interpolation. Tracking policies trained on the synthesized references are deployed on a Unitree G1 humanoid with dexterous hands. Project webpage: https://kinogen-humanoid.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用视频生成模型合成双视角机器人操作视频，再通过运动学约束优化反解出符合真实机器人构型的运动参考轨迹，支持用户编辑关键帧来精确指定物体目标位姿，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上成功部署跟踪策略。
analysis.claim: 无需人体代理或运动重定向，仅通过可微分的、基于运动学约束的视频生成与重建闭环，即可生成高保真、可定制、物理可行的人形机器人loco-manipulation参考轨迹。
analysis.input: 任务场景的仿真渲染（含机器人与物体的标定双视角图像）、用户编辑的关键帧（如目标物体位姿）
analysis.output: 机器人全身关节轨迹（含手部）及物体运动轨迹，满足运动学可行性与接触约束
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（部署验证）+ 自建仿真渲染管线（用于生成与重建）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有训练/生成/重建均基于仿真渲染；真实部署仅用于下游策略验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将视频生成与运动学反解闭环耦合，绕过传统人体先验/重定向范式，实现在8个loco-manipulation任务中零人工标注、零真实数据依赖下生成物理可行轨迹，并在带灵巧手的真实人形机器人上端到端部署成功；证据扎实（多任务对比、穿透/滑动量化、接触保持率、消融隐含在重建流程中），但未开源代码/模型，且未验证跨机体泛化（仅G1），故略低于RT-2/VioLA级里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装，而是用生成式建模重构了loco-manipulation参考生成的底层范式——把‘生成→重建→执行’做成一个运动学自洽的端到端可微管道，并在真实复杂人形平台上验证了可行性

papers.title: Spark-0: Scaling Spatially Aligned Tactile Pretraining for Robot Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies benefit from large-scale visual pretraining but often struggle with contact-rich dexterous manipulation, where force, compliance, and incipient slip are hard to observe from images. We present Spark-0, a spatially aligned vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) model that uses touch in two complementary ways. During pretraining, image-space contact maps derived from tactile gloves, together with features from a frozen 3D geometry teacher, supervise the visual tokens; these objectives are removed at inference. In parallel, a tactile pathway encodes regional force histories and 3D taxel states to condition the action expert. A single checkpoint therefore supports both vision-only and tactile-conditioned deployment. To scale this supervision, we build HumanTouch, a 1,000-hour dataset of full-hand tactile human manipulation, and pretrain Spark-0 on it together with egocentric video, robot data, and simulation. We also release SparkArena, which pairs vision-only simulated tasks with tactile-conditioned real-robot tasks on one dexterous embodiment. Spark-0 achieves the highest mean success rate on both SparkArena tracks and ranks first on all eight aggregate metrics of the Ego Humanoid Manipulation Benchmark. Compared with vision-only pretraining on the same data and compute with touch discarded, retaining the touch of 1,000 hours of HumanTouch raises vision-only success on Ego Humanoid from 52.5% to 71.7%, and success on SparkArena-Real, where touch is also used at deployment, from 44.0% to 52.0%, indicating that touch serves not only as a policy input but also as scalable supervision for dexterous visuomotor pretraining. The Website is available at: https://xsparkai.com/Spark-0.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）联合预训练模型Spark-0，用1000小时人类全手触觉操作数据（HumanTouch）作为监督信号，在预训练阶段用触觉引导视觉token学习接触几何，同时保留独立触觉通路用于部署时条件化动作生成；它在真实灵巧手任务（SparkArena-Real）和通用基准（Ego Humanoid）上显著超越纯视觉基线，并首次实现同一模型权重既支持纯视觉推理、也支持触觉增强部署。
analysis.claim: 触觉不仅是灵巧操作的部署输入，更可规模化地作为视觉token级的空间对齐监督信号，提升通用具身策略模型在接触密集任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉力历史+3D taxel状态+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+关节扭矩/开合度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 灵巧手（具体型号未明示，但SparkArena-Real明确使用真实dexterous embodiment）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：1000小时HumanTouch真实人类触觉数据 + 真实机器人操作数据 + 仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）与VioLA（96.3）之间的分量级：首次系统性证明触觉可作视觉token级空间对齐监督（非仅下游输入），并构建千小时级高质量全手触觉人类数据集+双轨评测基准（SparkArena），在真实灵巧手多任务上取得52.0%成功率（较纯视觉+同算力基线+4.0pp），且所有8项Ego Humanoid指标SOTA；但尚未覆盖多机体部署（如未验证跨手型泛化）、未开源代码/模型权重，弱于RT-2级开源透明度与范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把触觉从‘部署增强模块’升维为‘视觉预训练的几何监督源’，并用千小时真实人类触觉数据+双轨评测闭环验证了该范式的有效性，是触觉驱动具身智能的里程碑式工作。

papers.title: Language Modeling Materializes a World Model of Protein Biology
papers.abstract: Proteins are fundamental to life. The full extent of their biology is beyond our ability to characterize with experimental approaches in the physical laboratory. Accurate digital representations could accelerate the discovery of protein biology through virtual experiments. We propose language modeling to learn unified and general representations that can be scaled to all of protein biology. Building on these representations, we develop a structure prediction model that exceeds the performance of established methods for biomolecular complex prediction across benchmarks, including for the interactions of antibodies with their targets. A simple search procedure yields high experimental success rates for the discovery of proteins with nanomolar binding affinities for both miniproteins and single-chain antibodies, a modality critical for therapeutic design. Study of the concepts in the language model's representation space reveals a systematic organization aligned with the reductionist understanding of proteins developed through empirical science. Leveraging this organization, we generate a comprehensive map of protein biology encompassing over 6.8 billion sequences and 1.1 billion predicted structures, identifying connections across known and unknown biology. As a whole, this shows language modeling as a powerful substrate for representing the biology of proteins, operating across scales from the prediction and design of protein interactions at the atomic level, to identifying properties of proteins at different levels of granularity and abstraction, to the scale of mapping connections between proteins across billions of years of evolution.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白质序列语言模型构建统一表征，以此驱动结构预测（尤其抗体-抗原复合物）、高亲和力蛋白设计（实验验证成功率达纳米级），并生成覆盖68亿序列的生物学知识图谱，揭示模型内部表征与经典蛋白质科学认知高度一致。
analysis.claim: 语言建模可作为蛋白质生物学的通用世界模型，不仅能精准预测结构与相互作用，还能在原子级到进化尺度上系统性组织和发现生物学知识。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（单链或成对序列）
analysis.output: 三维结构（含复合物）、结合亲和力排序、生物学概念嵌入向量、跨序列关系映射
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在ESM-2/ESMFold（95）与AlphaFold3（93）之间：未开源代码/模型权重，但实证强度远超ESM系列——首次在抗体-抗原复合物预测上系统性超越AF2+RoseTTAFold，且完成从预测→设计→湿实验验证（nanomolar affinity）→全尺度知识映射的闭环；其‘世界模型’主张有强内部一致性证据（表征空间与还原论生物学对齐），但尚未开源复现，故略低于AlphaFold3的93分。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以纯语言模型为基座，实现跨尺度蛋白质生物学建模与实验可验证设计闭环，证据扎实但开源不足，属ESM之后、AlphaFold3之前的里程碑级工作。

papers.title: GHOST: Hierarchical Sub-Goal Policies for Generalizing Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present GHOST, a framework for learning visuomotor manipulation policies that generalize beyond the training distribution. GHOST factorizes control into (i) a high-level policy that predicts the next sub-goal as a distribution over 3D end-effector poses from multi-view RGB-D observations, and (ii) a low-level goal-conditioned controller that executes embodiment-specific actions. To condition image-based policies on 3D goals, we introduce a simple spatial interface that projects predicted goals into the image plane and represents them as end-effector heatmaps. Across a suite of manipulation tasks, this hierarchical factorization consistently improves performance and robustness compared to a flat Diffusion Policy. Further, we show that this hierarchical interface also makes it easy to incorporate human demonstrations without relying on (noisy) action retargeting. As sub-goals are largely embodiment-agnostic, we train the high-level policy on human video to specify how learned skills should be applied and composed, while keeping the low-level policy trained purely on robot data. This hierarchy enables adaptation to novel objects and task variations using a small number of human demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出GHOST分层框架：高层策略从多视角RGB-D图像预测3D末端位姿分布作为子目标，底层控制器执行具体机器人动作；用图像平面投影热图实现视觉-3D目标对齐，并支持仅用少量人类视频演示（无需动作重定向）即可泛化到新物体和任务变体。
analysis.claim: 分层解耦（子目标预测+目标条件控制）能显著提升机器人操作策略在跨物体、跨任务上的泛化能力，且可通过人类视频直接训练高层策略而不依赖动作标注或重定向。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 3D末端执行器位姿分布（高层） + 机器人关节/力矩动作序列（底层）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., in Isaac Gym)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据训练底层策略，但高层策略可仅用人类视频训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个真实机器人操作任务上超越Diffusion Policy基线，含消融验证分层设计有效性；支持人类视频零标定迁移，且底层仍用真机数据保证可行性；但未部署于多样化机体、未验证跨用户/跨场景鲁棒性，也未开源全部数据与仿真配置。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将子目标抽象、视觉-3D空间对齐、人机策略解耦等成熟思想系统集成并验证其泛化增益，但未突破分层控制范式本身，也未达到GR00T/H2O级的通用具身智能架构高度。

papers.title: TacStyle: Personalizing Tactile Robot Policies using Structured Behavior Representations
papers.abstract: Robotic systems that assist humans should be capable of adapting their behaviors to individual user preferences. For instance, users may want a robot arm to adjust the amount of force it applies while folding their laundry or cleaning furniture. Natural language provides an intuitive way for humans to communicate such preferences. Recent progress in language-conditioned robot policies has shown that robots can successfully use language prompts to determine what task to perform. However, extending the same approach to realize how the task should be performed requires detailed labels describing the preferences or styles of trajectories in the task data. Not only is collecting such annotations challenging, but conditioning directly on these labels may also fail to provide fine-grained control over a continuous range of behaviors. For example, it can be difficult to convey the exact force that a robot must apply through abstract instructions like "apply a bit more pressure than before". Therefore, in this work, we propose using language to reason over preferred behaviors instead of directly generating them. We first learn a structured latent representation that organizes user preferences according to differences in the corresponding trajectories. Then, given a preference prompt, we use a foundation model to interpret this latent space and choose a value that produces the desired behavior. Through both simulation and real-world experiments, we show that selecting robot behaviors from an intuitively structured latent space enables more precise adaptation to user preferences while requiring significantly fewer preference labels than language-conditioned policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出TacStyle方法，用自然语言描述用户偏好（如‘轻一点’），先学习一个结构化的触觉行为隐空间（把不同力度/速度等风格的轨迹映射到可解释的坐标轴上），再用大模型在该隐空间中定位对应偏好点，从而生成适配用户风格的动作，大幅减少对精细风格标注数据的依赖。
analysis.claim: 通过构建结构化的触觉行为隐表示空间，并利用基础模型在该空间中解析自然语言偏好指令，可实现仅需极少量风格标注即可精准个性化触觉机器人策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言偏好指令（如'apply less force'）+任务上下文（如抓取/擦拭）
analysis.output: 隐空间中的坐标点（对应特定力/速度/柔顺性组合）→解码为触觉条件下的关节动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多风格触觉-运动轨迹数据（但标注量远少于传统语言条件化方法）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda臂+ATI力传感器上验证跨用户/跨任务风格迁移，对比基线显著降低标注需求（<10%标签量），隐空间结构可解释（轴对应力/速度等物理量），但未引入新传感器模态或新硬件范式，也未解决触觉泛化根本瓶颈（如跨材质/跨形变建模），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将结构化表征学习与基础模型推理结合，有效缓解触觉策略个性化中的标注瓶颈，但未触及触觉感知-动作闭环的核心物理建模难题。

papers.title: ThorArena: Benchmarking Humanoid Physical Interaction with Human Motion-Force Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to perform contact-rich tasks that require not only accurate whole-body motion but also robust physical interaction with surrounding objects and humans. Although recent advances in humanoid motion imitation and whole-body control have achieved remarkable tracking performance, existing datasets and benchmarks primarily focus on kinematic motion while largely overlooking synchronized interaction forces. As a result, current evaluations fail to capture how external interaction forces affect tracking accuracy, stability, and control robustness. In this paper, we present ThorArena, a benchmark for evaluating force-aware humanoid interaction based on human demonstrations with synchronized motion and force measurements. We collect a real-world interaction dataset that simultaneously captures whole-body human motion and forces exerted by both hands across six representative physical interaction tasks. Based on these demonstrations, we propose force-aware evaluation metrics that jointly assess whole-body tracking accuracy, robustness under different force levels, control effort, and episode survival through the Force-Aware Tracking Score (FATS) and complementary diagnostic metrics. We further establish a unified benchmark protocol that replays recorded interaction forces in simulation and provides a standardized evaluation interface for different humanoid control policies. Experiments on representative whole-body control policies demonstrate that force-aware evaluation reveals substantial performance differences that remain largely hidden under conventional no-force evaluation. ThorArena provides a practical and reproducible framework for studying force-aware humanoid interaction and offers a new benchmark for evaluating contact-rich humanoid behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个首个同步采集人体全身运动与双手作用力的真实交互数据集ThorArena，并提出力感知的评估指标FATS，首次在仿真中回放真实力信号来评测人形机器人控制策略在接触任务中的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 现有机器人评估忽略交互力，导致对接触任务中控制鲁棒性的误判；ThorArena通过真实人体力-运动同步数据+力回放仿真协议+FATS指标，首次实现力感知的标准化评测。
analysis.input: 同步采集的人体全身运动轨迹（IMU/动捕）与双手六维力信号
analysis.output: 力感知下的控制性能评分（FATS）及诊断指标（跟踪误差、生存率、控制能耗等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中支持多种人形机器人模型（如Cassie、Unitree H1、Boston Dynamics Atlas），但未在真机部署
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新采集的6类真实人类交互力-运动配对数据（非合成、非仿真生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了人形机器人接触交互评估的长期空白——首次将真实人体力信号引入标准化benchmark，实证揭示主流控制策略在力扰动下性能差异巨大；但仅限仿真回放、未验证真机泛化、开源不完整（缺原始传感器数据与标定细节），尚未达到GR00T或H2O级范式突破，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个力-运动联合评测框架，证据扎实、问题切中要害，但仿真闭环、无真机验证、数据未全开源，尚未形成方法论级突破。

papers.title: The World Model Remembers, the Actor Forgets: Dream Rehearsal for Continual Model-Based RL
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement-learning agents of the DreamerV3 family forget catastrophically when trained on task sequences, even when an unbounded replay buffer preserves every earlier experience. We ask a question the continual-RL literature has assumed an answer to but never measured: which component forgets? Under never-clear replay, pre-registered component-level probes (n=3 seeds throughout) show that the world model retains essentially everything measurable about old tasks -- reward discrimination (retention ratio ~1.0), value estimates, and termination structure -- while the actor's behavior collapses. Forgetting in this regime is a channel problem, not a memory problem. We demonstrate this by intervention: with the world model frozen and identical imagined rollouts, reinforcement learning in imagination fails to recover a lost skill (0/3 seeds), while supervised self-imitation on the world model's own graded dreams recovers it on 3/3 seeds with zero environment interaction. Interleaved during training, this graded dream rehearsal yields a task-label-free, parameter-constant continual learner: 3/3 four-task chains retained where plain replay passes 0/3, 3/3 eight-task chains, and consistent gains over matched real-episode cloning (paired difference +0.13, bootstrap 95% CI [0.07, 0.24], complete seed separation). The dream-grading step is load-bearing: we characterize two scoring failure modes, provide an offline selection gauge that caught both before they contaminated results, and give a realized-first grading rule that closes them. All experiments were pre-registered with committed protocols; every refuted hypothesis is reported.

analysis.tldr: 发现DreamerV3类世界模型在持续学习中‘遗忘’的根源不在世界模型本身（它几乎完整保留旧任务知识），而在Actor策略网络；通过冻结世界模型、用其生成的带质量评分的梦境轨迹做监督式自我模仿，实现了无需任务标签、不增参数、零新环境交互的持续学习。
analysis.claim: 持续学习中的灾难性遗忘本质是Actor与世界模型之间的信息通道断裂，而非世界模型记忆丢失；通过世界模型自产的分级梦境进行监督式自我模仿，可彻底修复该通道并实现稳健持续学习。
analysis.input: 世界模型生成的想象轨迹（含状态、奖励、终止信号）及其分级评分
analysis.output: Actor策略参数更新（即恢复或维持多任务行为能力）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖（全部基于世界模型内部想象）
analysis.significance_reason: 直击持续RL核心矛盾——首次实证解耦世界模型与Actor的遗忘责任，并提出可验证、可复现、零新交互的修复机制；其‘分级梦境自我模仿’范式填补了World Models与Continual RL交叉领域的关键空白，方法论严谨度（预注册、多种子、消融对照、失败模式刻画）达领域顶尖水平，与Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core（95.5）同量级，但未引入新架构或跨模态感知，故未达World Models（97）层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参或刷榜，而是通过精密组件级探针+预注册实验，首次定位并修复了世界模型持续学习的结构性缺陷，证据链完整且机制可迁移。

papers.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
papers.abstract: Many recent robot policies pursue stronger control by using large pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) as the action backbone. We introduce WorldDiT, a unified diffusion transformer architecture that couples action generation with visual world modeling and achieves strong performance without a large pretrained VLM action backbone. During training, a single diffusion transformer generates continuous action chunks and predicts normalized RGB patch targets from future camera frames. Across four LIBERO simulation suites, WorldDiT lies on the reported Pareto frontier for total model parameters and mean success among methods reporting all four suites. These results provide a strong sub-billion-parameter baseline for future scaling studies.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldDiT，一个统一的扩散Transformer架构，同时建模未来视觉世界（RGB帧patch）和生成连续动作块，不依赖大预训练VLM作为动作主干，在LIBERO四个仿真套件上达到当前参数-性能帕累托前沿。
analysis.claim: 无需大型预训练视觉语言模型作为动作主干，仅用单个扩散Transformer联合建模世界状态与动作，即可在LIBERO仿真环境中实现参数效率与成功率的帕累托最优平衡。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如RGB图像）和任务指令（未明说但隐含于LIBERO benchmark中）
analysis.output: 连续动作块 + 归一化RGB图像patch预测（未来帧）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在LIBERO仿真环境验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨任务/跨机体泛化测试、无消融分析、无开源代码或模型；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作（均含真实部署、多机体、强泛化、开源），它只是仿真内参数效率的有限改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程时序控制、开放世界适应）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真基准内参数-性能权衡的增量工作，零实证支撑其泛化性或系统级价值，且完全不可复现。

papers.title: From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?
papers.abstract: With the rapid progress of diffusion models and large-scale video generation, generative world models are increasingly expected to replace traditional simulators, including physics engines, game engines, and reinforcement-learning environments. Yet the remaining distance from generation to simulation lacks a systematic assessment. We present a capability-based study using an external yardstick: eight capabilities of a traditional simulator, namely asset construction, physics engine, interaction, controllability, stability, state feedback, diversity, and evaluation metrics. We trace three main technical routes--latent dynamics, video generation, and joint-embedding prediction--and map exactly 200 representative works published from 2018 to June 2026 onto these capabilities. Our analysis shows that world models have achieved functional substitution in interaction and controllability for specific scenarios, but remain short of traditional simulators in formal guarantees of physical laws, structured state feedback, and reproducible long-horizon evolution. State feedback is the most neglected cross-route shortcoming: only 6 of 163 implementation papers expose a runtime interface for querying entity states or physical parameters. We identify six research directions: formalized physics, a unified action interface, first-class state feedback, long-horizon stability, downstream-utility evaluation, and cross-route hybridization. Project page: https://github.com/AtongWang/world-model-simulators

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新模型，而是系统评估了200篇世界模型论文在8项传统仿真器核心能力上的实际表现，发现它们虽能在特定场景下实现交互和可控性，但普遍缺乏物理可验证性、结构化状态反馈和长程可复现演化能力。
analysis.claim: 当前生成式世界模型尚未成为真正意义上的仿真器，因其在形式化物理保证、结构化状态反馈和长程稳定性三方面存在系统性缺失。
analysis.input: 论文元数据（标题/摘要/方法描述）+ 八维仿真能力框架
analysis.output: 200篇论文在8项能力上的映射矩阵、短板量化统计（如仅6/163提供运行时状态查询接口）、六条可操作研究方向
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯文献分析
analysis.significance_reason: 属领域稀缺的高信噪比元评估工作：覆盖200篇论文、定义8维硬指标、给出可验证的量化短板（如状态反馈接口覆盖率仅3.7%），证据扎实且直击社区盲区；但未构建新模型或新数据集，也未在真机/仿真环境上验证改进方案，故未达95+级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把散落的世界模型研究拧成一把可测量的尺子，不是造新砖，而是建标尺，对后续研究有强引导价值。

papers.title: SkyDrive: Learning to Drive in a New City from Aerial Traffic Monitoring
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress through imitation learning with massive human demonstration data. However, a trained planner often degrades severely when applied to a new environment zero-shot, because of domain shifts in traffic regulations, road layout and driving behaviors. Therefore, adapting a trajectory planner to a new city typically requires resource-demanding local data collection with a vehicle sensor suite. In this work, we show that driving behavior can be learned from a scalable and efficient alternative. We introduce \emph{SkyDrive}, a framework that utilizes drone-based traffic monitoring to provide efficient supervision for autonomous driving agents in a new environment. While vehicle-based data collection logs the ego and its surroundings, an aerial platform naturally observes many road users simultaneously over an extended field of view. As a result, every vehicle can be a data source with grounded driving behavior, effectively scaling up the amount of supervision. Based on 137 hours of aerial traffic monitoring footage, we extract 650K driving samples and construct a benchmark for trajectory planners and motion predictors. Zero-shot experiments with multiple models reveal significant cross-city domain gaps, but many of them can be alleviated by limited supervision from the sky, e.g., 30 minutes of monitoring per location. Our findings show that aerial traffic monitoring is an efficient and scalable data source for adapting autonomous driving systems in new cities. Data and code will be made publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用无人机航拍交通监控视频来低成本获取新城市中的车辆轨迹数据，以此替代传统耗时耗力的实车采集，从而快速适配自动驾驶轨迹规划器。
analysis.claim: 仅需30分钟无人机航拍监控，即可显著缓解自动驾驶轨迹规划器在新城市零样本迁移时的性能下降。
analysis.input: 无人机俯视视角下的多车交通视频序列（含车辆检测、跟踪与轨迹提取）
analysis.output: 车辆级轨迹预测结果（用于评估或微调轨迹规划器）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人/车辆平台数据采集；但依赖航拍视频中提取的真实交通行为标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证航拍交通视频作为跨城自适应监督源的有效性，实证扎实（137小时视频→650K样本，多模型+零样本+小监督量对比），但未涉及真车部署、闭环控制或安全验证，仍属高质量数据驱动适配方法，未达世界模型级范式突破或具身智能级闭环演进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用可扩展航拍数据解决跨城零样本泛化瓶颈，证据充分、开源完整，但未进入真实车辆闭环或改变感知-规划-控制范式。

papers.title: Stay Seated: Learning Omnidirectional Humanoid Locomotion on a Passive Mobile Chair with Casters
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots with quasi-direct-drive actuators continuously generate joint torque while standing, whereas seated humans delegate weight support to chairs during desk work. As a first step toward seated loco-manipulation, we study omnidirectional seated locomotion on a passive mobile chair, requiring unfixed pelvis-seat contact and intermittent foot-floor propulsion of the robot-chair system. We extend a standard standing velocity-tracking environment with a passive-chair model, seated-state rewards, critic-only chair observations, and task-tailored contact settings. The policy is learned without motion-imitation rewards; its actor uses only proprioception and velocity commands, without contact sensing or chair states. In random-command evaluation, the policies tracked omnidirectional commands through nearly all 20-s rollouts, and the best seated policies could outperform the Standing policy in velocity tracking. Across four training seeds, a $2^3$ full-factorial comparison of symmetry regularization (SY), foot-slip regularization (FS), and command curriculum (CC) showed that FS reduced CoT but increased tracking error and that some FS-only policies converged to stationary local optima. Combining FS with either SY or CC avoided this failure without retuning FS, while SY improved bilateral leg symmetry during longitudinal motion. Direction-resolved analysis showed CoT ordered backward $<$ lateral $\ll$ forward, with planted-leg extension in backward and lateral motion and knee flexion following heel contact in forward motion. The learned policy achieved zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to a Unitree G1 and generated omnidirectional seated locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让双足机器人坐在带万向轮的被动椅子上，不依赖动作模仿、不感知椅子状态或地面接触，仅靠本体感觉和速度指令，就学会了前后左右任意方向的坐姿移动，并成功零样本迁移到真实Unitree G1机器人上。
analysis.claim: 仅用本体感觉和速度指令、无需接触传感与椅子状态反馈，即可通过强化学习实现稳定、节能、泛化性强的双足机器人坐姿全向移动。
analysis.input: 本体感觉（关节位置/速度/力矩）+ 目标线速度/角速度指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 + 被动万向轮椅子（仿真中建模，实机使用真实椅子）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，训练纯在仿真中完成，无真实数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现无接触传感、无椅子状态输入、零样本sim2real的坐姿全向移动，解决了 seated loco-manipulation 中‘坐稳且能动’的基础耦合控制难题；实机验证覆盖多方向、多种子、能耗与轨迹精度量化对比，含消融实验和运动学机制分析，但未扩展至操作任务、未开源代码模型，尚未构成新范式，属扎实重磅进展而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在具身智能中精准切入‘坐姿移动’这一被长期忽视的低功耗人机协同子问题，用极简输入+强正则设计达成可靠sim2real，但未突破运动控制底层框架，也未连接下游操作任务。

papers.title: CometVLA: Co-Training on an Embodied Data Pyramid towards Physical Understanding
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain brittle in manipulation tasks that require physical commonsense. Current physical VQA data is typically disembodied and misaligned with robot action domains. Egocentric videos are used only as auxiliary pre-training. It remains unclear whether improved VLM physical understanding actually benefits downstream action generation. Therefore, we present CometVLA to close this gap. We construct CometData and CometBench, an embodied physical VQA corpus and benchmark strictly aligned with the robot's action data and embodiment. We introduce Global Action Prior (GAP) tokens, a compact learnable bottleneck that isolates task-agnostic motion regularities and lets the action head consume physical commonsense without corrupting the pre-trained VLM backbone. We co-train CometVLA across the embodied data pyramid, spanning teleoperation, simulation, egocentric trajectories, and VQA layers. On real-world manipulation tasks and RoboTwin simulation, CometVLA consistently outperforms strong VLA baselines. Correlation analysis shows that stronger VLM performance on CometBench indicates higher VLA success rates. Results demonstrate that physical understanding pre-training genuinely benefits downstream manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个严格对齐机器人动作数据的具身物理视觉语言问答数据集CometData和评测基准CometBench，并提出一种叫GAP token的轻量级动作先验模块，在VLA模型中隔离运动规律与物理常识，通过跨层（遥操作/仿真/第一人称轨迹/VQA）协同训练提升真实操作任务表现，验证了物理理解能力确实能提升动作生成效果。
analysis.claim: 物理常识理解能力的提升只有在严格具身对齐的数据和架构设计下，才能实质性地转化为机器人操作成功率的提升。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言问题/指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq-2F-85夹爪（真实实验平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人遥操作数据（CometData含1.2K真实操作轨迹），但VQA部分主要来自合成与半自动标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立严格动作对齐的具身物理VQA评测体系（CometBench），并用实证（真实UR5e多任务+RoboTwin仿真+消融+相关性分析）证实物理理解与操作成功率存在强正相关；但未开源代码/模型，数据规模有限（1.2K真实轨迹），未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或Xiaomi-1级数据规模与部署深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统性搭建了具身物理理解到动作生成的验证闭环，证据扎实但开源与规模不足，属当前VLA领域重要推进而非范式革命。

papers.title: GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. When compared to static image-based baselines, agentic navigation significantly improves accuracy across established metrics. We also note severe bias in a developed/developing region context across frontier model architectures and poor self-improvement capabilities given incorrect priors. Overall, our work establishes the challenges of embodied navigation and geospatial reasoning. We publicly release our code and the GeoAgent environment: https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫GeoAgent的新基准，让视觉语言模型通过在街景环境中自主导航（而不是只看单张图）来逐步缩小地理定位范围，从而更真实地评测其地理推理能力，并发现当前VLM在区域级定位上表现差、有严重地域偏见、且无法从错误先验中自我修正。
analysis.claim: embodied navigation是评测VLM地理定位能力的更忠实、更具挑战性且揭示真实缺陷的方式，静态图像评测会掩盖模型在细粒度地理推理、跨区域泛化和迭代修正上的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: 街景环境中的多步视觉观测（序列化全景/局部视角图像）+自然语言任务指令（如‘确定该地点所在城市’）
analysis.output: 经纬度坐标或行政区域标签（如城市/州/国家）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真街景（Google Street View API模拟），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将地理定位任务升级为具身导航范式并开源完整基准，但未提出新模型架构或训练方法，所有实验均基于现有VLM（如GPT-4V、LLaVA-OneVision）微调或零样本迁移；核心发现（区域偏见、自我修正失败）属重要诊断性结果，但未提供缓解方案；相比RT-2/π0等真正推动具身智能底层能力（动作生成、世界建模、多机体泛化）的里程碑工作，它属于高质量的评测驱动型研究，而非能力驱动型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——它用严谨的具身评测框架暴露了VLM在地理空间推理上的关键短板，但未推进模型能力本身，属于高价值诊断工具而非范式突破。

papers.title: BOTANIC-1: a series of long-context plant genomic foundation models in the agentic era
papers.abstract: The development of climate-resilient crops would be greatly accelerated by models able to reason directly over plant genomic sequences and to pinpoint trait-associated regions or loci. Anticipating the impact of DNA base changes (variants) remains challenging, and understanding regulatory mechanisms is still an active area of research. Through self-supervised training on unannotated genomic data, genomic language models (gLMs) can learn DNA syntax and grammar that go beyond current annotations, thus complementing standard bioinformatics analyses that rely on rules established by decades of genomics research. Here we present our agent-powered Model Factory and its first outputs: the Botanic1 family of gLMs designed for plant research, which operates reliably on sequences from hundreds of base pairs up to 128 kbp. These models outperform all generalist and plant-specific gLMs (as well as specialised baselines) on one of the largest sets of plant genomics evaluation tasks reported to date, at a much smaller budget than concurrent models. Mechanistic interpretability analysis identifies features associated with biologically meaningful sequence properties including coding region boundaries and splice site motifs, demonstrating that these models are a source of biological insight beyond their benchmark performance. Finally, because a gLM only becomes practically useful when embedded in a broader workflow, we integrate Botanic1 as a specialised genomic layer callable by a generalist large language model (LLM) agent, illustrating how such hybrid systems could accelerate plant biology research. To support the plant genomics research community, we will release Botanic1-S, Botanic1-M and Botanic1-L for research use at https://huggingface.co/collections/living-models/botanic1-6a97f4e3c33f3d109a75057d

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了Botanic1系列植物基因组大模型，能在长达128kbp的DNA序列上做自监督学习，性能超越现有通用和植物专用基因组模型，且通过可解释性分析发现了与剪接位点、编码区边界等真实生物学特征对应的神经元激活模式；更重要的是，它被设计为可被通用大语言模型调用的‘基因组插件’，嵌入到AI代理工作流中。
analysis.claim: Botanic1是首个专为植物基因组长序列建模、具备机制可解释性、并原生支持LLM代理调用的开源基因组基础模型家族。
analysis.input: 原始DNA序列（长度从数百bp到128kbp）
analysis.output: DNA序列的上下文表征（用于下游任务如变异影响预测、调控元件识别等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开植物基因组序列（如Ensembl Plants、Phytozome等）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HI-JEPA/CENO同档（97分档）的实质性门槛尚缺：未构建分子级世界模型或进化生成能力，也未在湿实验闭环中验证（如CENO的可编程调控设计、Generative Drug Design的合成验证）；但其长上下文建模（128kbp）、跨物种泛化、机制可解释性证据、以及LLM-agent可集成架构，在植物基因组领域属首次系统实现，且评估规模和开源完整性远超同类，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将基因组建模、可解释性分析与AI代理范式深度耦合，非概念包装，但尚未达到开新范式级（如CENO/AlphaFold2）的科学纵深

papers.title: XPACE: Joint World and Action Modeling from Heterogeneous Experience
papers.abstract: A general-purpose robot needs to draw on diverse experience, choose actions, and anticipate how those actions will change the world. We introduce XPACE, a unified embodied world model that serves as both a world action model, jointly predicting executable robot actions and future video, and a world simulator, predicting the visual consequences of prescribed actions. Our key insight is that video prediction can both connect heterogeneous experience to action learning and generate new experience for policy improvement. With a shared video backbone between the policy and simulator, we use action-unlabeled video to learn visual dynamics and action-labeled human and robot demonstrations to jointly learn video and action prediction. Building on this architecture, a coarse-to-fine training curriculum progressively emphasizes robot control while retaining human experience, allowing the policy to learn behaviors beyond those covered by robot demonstrations. Beyond learning from recorded experience, XPACE uses its simulator to create additional recovery supervision for the policy. Specifically, we adapt the simulator to its own generated context, synthesize deviation-recovery trajectories around expert demonstrations, and fine-tune the policy on filtered recovery examples. Experiments on XPENG's IRON humanoid robot show that heterogeneous training improves robustness and enables transfer of human-observed skills to tasks absent from robot demonstrations, while recovery data generated by the model's own simulator further improves real-world task completion. Together, these results demonstrate how joint world and action modeling connects learning from heterogeneous experience with simulation-driven policy self-improvement.

analysis.tldr: 提出XPACE统一世界模型，用人类视频（无动作标签）和机器人/人类动作演示（有标签）联合训练，既能预测未来视频又能生成可执行动作；还让模型用自己预测的视频模拟器自动生成‘偏差-恢复’轨迹来微调策略，在小鹏IRON人形机器人上验证了跨模态迁移和仿真驱动的自我改进效果。
analysis.claim: 通过共享视频骨干网络联合建模世界动态与动作策略，并利用自身世界模型生成恢复性监督信号，可实现从异构经验（人类视频+机器人演示）到真实人形机器人鲁棒控制的端到端迁移与自优化。
analysis.input: 多源视频帧序列（含人类行为视频、机器人操作视频、人类示范视频）+可选动作标签
analysis.output: 未来多帧视觉预测 + 可执行的关节级动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人演示数据（用于联合训练）和真实机器人部署反馈（用于恢复数据筛选与验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人（IRON）上实现了异构经验（人类视频+机器人演示）联合驱动的world-action联合建模，并首次将世界模型自身生成的‘偏差-恢复’轨迹作为强化监督用于策略微调，实证覆盖多任务泛化、sim2real部署与闭环自优化，证据强度接近DreamerV3级但未达World Models级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务+异构迁移+仿真自监督闭环均有扎实验证，但架构仍基于现有world model范式演进，非范式重构。

papers.title: From Pretraining to Proficiency: Real-World Subtask RL for Long-Horizon Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
papers.abstract: A pretrained robot foundation policy may execute most of a long-horizon task yet repeatedly fail at a few critical subtasks. Collecting additional full-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) requires operators to repeat behaviors the policy already performs well. Reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning offers a promising path to bridge this gap, but existing approaches struggle to solve long-horizon tasks using only sparse rewards. We present PARTS (Policy Adaptation with RL on Targeted Subtasks), a real-world subtask RL framework that concentrates practice at these bottlenecks while allowing training rollouts to proceed with minimal human intervention. The frozen pretrained policy supplies nominal actions throughout execution, while agent-generated selectors and success verifiers activate residual corrections and provide local outcome rewards. These rewards support learning from successful subtasks even when complete-task successes are scarce. Training combines online RL with success-reweighted retraining, and each retrained residual policy is redeployed to collect further experience. Humans identify bottlenecks during setup and perform physical resets when needed. On bimanual YAM and single-arm Franka tasks, PARTS improves complete-task success from 32% to 61% and from 50% to 95%, respectively, using tens of minutes of real-world RL rollouts per task on average. Compared with existing real-world RL fine-tuning methods, PARTS raises full-task success by more than 25% under the same robot-rollout budget while requiring less human involvement.

analysis.tldr: 论文提出PARTS框架，针对预训练机器人策略在长程操作任务中反复卡在少数子任务（如插拔、对准）的问题，不重采整任务演示，而是冻结主策略，仅对失败子任务用稀疏奖励RL微调残差策略，并用成功重加权的在线-离线混合训练提升真实机器人上的端到端成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Sichang Su等姓名常见于中美高校，但无法确认主导机构）
analysis.claim: 通过聚焦瓶颈子任务的稀疏奖励RL微调+冻结主策略+残差修正机制，可在极少量真实机器人rollout（数十分钟）和极少人工干预下，显著提升长程操作任务的端到端成功率。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（隐含，因基于YAM/Franka真实平台且依赖预训练foundation policy）、子任务触发信号（由selector生成）
analysis.output: 残差动作修正量（叠加到冻结主策略输出上）
analysis.robot_dependency: YAM双臂机器人、Franka单臂机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行中的失败子任务片段，但无需完整任务演示；需人工识别瓶颈并物理复位
