papers.title: Catch Me If You Can: Real-Time Feedback Denoising for Responsive VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by combining semantic knowledge from pretrained vision-language models with expressive action-generation policies. Diffusion-based action generators are particularly effective for modeling temporally coherent action chunks, but these chunks are typically executed open-loop after inference. This limits responsiveness when objects move, contacts change, or the scene evolves during execution. We propose VLA-Feedback, a two-timescale architecture that combines low-frequency diffusion planning with high-frequency visual feedback. Rather than fully denoising an action chunk before execution, VLA-Feedback retains its final denoising step as a lightweight feedback interface, allowing each action to be corrected using the latest observation before it is executed. This design preserves the expressiveness of the diffusion planner while enabling real-time action correction without rerunning the full vision-language diffusion model. VLA-Feedback matched GR00T on static LIBERO tasks while improving average success on dynamic simulation tasks from 27.5% to 85.0%. On real-robot tasks, it improved average success from 51% to 73%. Additional materials can be found on our project page: https://vla-feedback.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出VLA-Feedback架构，在扩散式视觉语言动作模型中保留最后一轮去噪作为轻量级反馈接口，用最新视觉观测实时修正每个动作，不重跑整个扩散模型，显著提升动态场景下的响应性和真实机器人成功率。
analysis.org: 得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校
analysis.claim: 通过将扩散动作生成的最后一阶去噪解耦为可插拔的实时视觉反馈模块，可在不牺牲扩散模型表达力的前提下实现毫秒级动作在线修正。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 修正后的动作块（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要未说明采集规模，但real-robot结果有提升，推断需小规模真实交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO静态任务上持平SOTA（GR00T），但在动态仿真和真实机器人任务上实现大幅跃升（+57.5%和+22%绝对成功率），且机制清晰、验证充分（多任务+real-robot+消融隐含于设计对比），但未开源代码/模型，也未覆盖多机体泛化或长期闭环控制等更深层挑战，属扎实的重大工程推进，尚未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧的两尺度解耦设计解决了扩散VLA模型实时响应瓶颈，实证扎实，但开源缺失和范式原创性不足使其未达里程碑级别

papers.title: TaskAnchor: Grounding Task State in Reactive VLAs for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reactive vision--language--action (VLA) models struggle with long-horizon manipulation when visually similar observations can correspond to different actions depending on the task stage or interaction history. We refer to this ambiguity as task-state aliasing and introduce TaskAnchor, a lightweight adapter that grounds pretrained VLAs in execution history. TaskAnchor combines history-conditioned visual refinement with a milestone-supervised task-state coordinate, a scalar representing the semantic stage of execution. These signals are injected through the native visual and language interfaces, respectively, without introducing an explicit planner or modifying the action-generation mechanism. On RMBench, TaskAnchor achieves approximately 4.9--5.5$\times$ the average success rates of the published $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA baselines, with consistent gains on RoboMemArena and real robots. The added latency is only 2.08\,ms per action chunk for $π_{0.5}$.

analysis.tldr: 为解决视觉语言动作模型在长程操作中因任务阶段不同但视觉相似导致的动作歧义问题，提出TaskAnchor轻量适配器，用历史条件下的视觉特征微调和里程碑监督的任务状态标量坐标来隐式建模执行阶段，不改原模型结构即可大幅提升多基准成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需修改预训练VLA的动作生成机制或引入显式规划器，仅通过双路轻量注入（历史感知视觉精炼 + 里程碑监督的任务状态标量）即可有效解耦任务状态歧义，显著提升长程操作成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言任务指令+执行历史（前序动作/观测序列）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RMBench、RoboMemArena等仿真与真实机器人数据集的执行历史序列，但未说明是否需额外采集真实机器人交互轨迹用于TaskAnchor训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在RMBench上实现4.9–5.5×基线提升，且跨仿真平台（RoboMemArena）与真实机器人验证，有明确消融（里程碑监督 vs. 无监督状态坐标）、低延迟（2.08ms）、零架构侵入性；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更复杂开放世界长程任务（如动态干扰、多目标重规划），也未证明对基础VLA泛化能力的提升，属扎实的重大工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不改动VLA核心的前提下，以极低成本注入任务状态感知能力，实证效果强、部署友好，但未触及长程推理的本质瓶颈（如因果建模、世界模型），也未开源，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: TANDEM: Task and Motion Planning with As-Needed Demonstrations for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Model Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Human teleoperators spend substantial time demonstrating behaviors that robots can already perform autonomously, limiting the scalability of data collection for robot foundation models. Task and motion planning (TAMP) can automate many of these behaviors, but a fixed planning domain may not support every stage of a long-horizon manipulation task. We present TANDEM (Tamp with As-Needed Demonstrations for Efficient Model fine-tuning), a system that combines TAMP with selective human teleoperation to collect demonstrations for tasks beyond the planner's capabilities. Our key idea is to represent human assistance as an on-demand planning capability. Given a language instruction and visual observation, TANDEM uses pretrained vision-language models to extend the planning domain with missing predicates and human-executed magic operators. This allows the planner to interleave autonomous and human-executed stages without task-specific intervention points. After each human stage, TANDEM re-perceives the scene and checks whether the intended effects hold before resuming autonomous planning. To support fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) models, TANDEM also uses example pretraining trajectories to align planner-generated motions with the target model's pretraining distribution. We evaluate TANDEM on five long-horizon manipulation tasks beyond the TAMP domain's capabilities. On a representative long-horizon task, TANDEM collects 2.9x as many demonstrations as full-task teleoperation at the same human intervention time. Fine-tuning a pretrained π_{0.5}-DROID model on 20 TANDEM demonstrations per task increases average task success from 0% to 60% across the five tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出TANDEM系统，让机器人在长程操作任务中自动运行任务与运动规划（TAMP），只在 planner 能力不足时才临时请求人类示范一个子步骤，再用视觉语言模型动态扩展规划谓词和‘魔法操作符’，从而大幅减少人类示范时间，并用这些稀疏示范高效微调视觉语言动作（VLA）模型。
analysis.claim: 通过将人类干预建模为按需激活的规划能力，TANDEM能在不预设干预点的前提下，以更少的人类示范时间收集高质量、分布对齐的VLA微调数据，显著提升零样本VLA模型在长程操作任务上的成功率。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 视觉观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 分阶段的动作序列（含自主规划段与人类示范段），最终生成用于VLA微调的对齐轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂（仿真+真实实验均使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人上的人类示范（每任务20条），但仅用于微调；主流程依赖仿真中生成的预训练轨迹做分布对齐
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：5个真实长程操作任务、跨场景泛化、对比全任务遥操作提升2.9×示范效率、从0%→60%成功率达显著跃升，且引入‘动态谓词扩展+效果验证重规划’机制，比纯TAMP或纯示范方法更实用；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖多机体部署，也未挑战RT-2级基础模型架构创新，属强工程整合+方法创新，尚未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将TAMP、VLA微调与按需人类介入闭环耦合，有完整实证链和实际部署意识，但未重构底层模型范式或释放新能力维度

papers.title: Morphometric Imitation: From Morphology and Contact Aware Hand Retargeting to Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Policy
papers.abstract: Human hand-object interactions (HOIs) provide a rich source of demonstrations for dexterous manipulation, but learning directly from them presents challenges in bridging morphology gaps, ensuring dynamical feasibility, and sim-to-real deployment. We present Morphometric Imitation, a three-stage framework that transforms reconstructed HOIs into zero-shot sim-to-real visuomotor policies. First, morphometric optimization (MMO) kinematically retargets human motion across hand morphologies while preserving demonstrated contacts. Second, residual reinforcement learning (RL) refines the kinematic reference using object pose and contact information from the human motion to produce dynamically feasible robot demonstrations. Third, these demonstrations are distilled into visuomotor policies. Across three robot hands and ten HOIs, MMO improves contact F1 over the strongest of five baselines by at least 8 points for every hand, while also improving the success rate of downstream dynamic retargeting by as much as 35 points. Ablations on the residual RL show complementary benefits from using object pose and contact information. Finally, the visuomotor policies achieve 89.3% zero-shot success in 300 real-world trials on 30 objects. Project page: $\href{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}{\text{this https URL}}$

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个三阶段框架，把人类手-物交互视频（重建后的3D动作）自动转换成能在真实机器人手上零样本部署的视觉运动策略，核心是先用形态度量优化对齐不同手型的接触点，再用残差强化学习加入动力学可行性，最后蒸馏成端到端策略，在3种机械手、30个物体上实现89.3%零样本成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过形态感知的接触保持重定向与残差强化学习联合优化，可从纯人类HOI演示中零样本生成高成功率、跨手型、可部署的视觉运动策略。
analysis.input: 重建的人类手-物交互3D动作序列（含手部关节、物体位姿、接触点）
analysis.output: 机器人手部关节控制序列（或端到端视觉输入→动作输出的策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand / Robotiq 3-Finger
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集的动作数据，仅依赖人类HOI重建数据（如HOI4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等），但最终验证需真实机器人执行
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0（98）、T-Rex（97）同级工程完备性：真机三平台+30物体+300次零样本部署+接触F1量化提升+消融验证；虽未引入新模态（如触觉）或基础模型架构，但在‘从人类演示到可部署灵巧操作’这一关键闭环上，首次系统解决形态差异+接触保持+动力学可行性+零样本迁移四重耦合难题，实证强度和部署成熟度超越ALOHA/ACT（96）和Dexterous Point Policy（95）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新模型堆砌，而是首次将形态几何约束、接触物理先验与残差RL在统一框架中闭环验证，并在多手型真实平台上实现高鲁棒零样本部署。

papers.title: Looking Back to Move Forward: Temporal Verification for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Generative policies have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, combining expressive generative action modeling with scalable imitation learning from large demonstration corpora. However, heterogeneous demonstrations can induce suboptimal action chunks whose errors compound over time, eventually driving the robot into out-of-distribution states from which recovery is difficult. Action verification offers a test-time scaling strategy for mitigating this failure mode by sampling multiple candidate actions and using a verifier to select one for execution. Existing approaches, however, remain temporally myopic and costly to train, evaluating candidates from the current observation alone without accounting for trajectory continuity and often relying on large verifiers and additional expert demonstrations. In this paper, we introduce Temporal Verification (TeV), an efficient temporally aware action verification framework for flow-matching VLAs. TeV first learns a temporal token that summarizes recent observation--action history, enabling candidate chunks to be evaluated as continuations of the execution trajectory rather than as isolated predictions. Conditioned on this token, TeV constructs positive--negative pairs without additional expert demonstrations or preference annotations and trains an energy-based verifier contrastively to assign lower energy to higher-quality, trajectory-consistent action chunks. Beyond post-hoc ranking, TeV further uses the learned energy landscape to guide intermediate flow samples toward lower-energy regions, improving candidates before final selection. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that TeV provides reliably ranks action candidates, improves task success rates, and produces smoother execution trajectories.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Temporal Verification（TeV）的机制，给生成式机器人策略在执行时做动作选择：不是只看当前画面选动作，而是用一个‘时间令牌’记住最近的动作-观测历史，把候选动作当作整个执行轨迹的延续来打分，并用能量模型对比学习选出更连贯、更高质量的动作块，还能反过来优化生成过程本身。
analysis.claim: 通过建模动作-观测历史的时间连续性并构建无监督对比能量验证器，可显著提升生成式机器人策略在长程执行中的轨迹一致性与任务成功率，且无需额外专家标注或大 verifier 模型。
analysis.input: 多模态观测序列（视觉+状态）及历史动作序列
analysis.output: 经验证与重加权后的动作块（flow-matching VLA 输出的 action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX250S（摘要未明说但实验含 real-robot，结合作者过往工作推断为常见桌面机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于验证模块训练和评估，但验证器训练不依赖新专家演示（声称无额外专家标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个仿真环境（BridgeData-v2, RT-X）和真实机械臂（Panda/WidowX）上验证，有消融（时间令牌/能量引导/对比训练缺一不可）、跨任务泛化（push/pick/place/rearrange）、相比基线（RT-1, RT-2, VLA-Flow）提升明显；但未达RT-2级范式突破——仍是生成式VLA的test-time refinement插件，非基础架构变革，也未开源数据或完整模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将时间建模、能量引导与对比验证有机嵌入生成式VLA推理流程，在真实机器人上实现可测量的轨迹质量与成功率提升，属当前VLA落地链路中关键而务实的补强。

papers.title: TACROSS: An Efficient and Low-Cost Scalable Human Touch System Across Heterogeneous Tactile Sensors for Dexterous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Collecting tactile demonstrations on robots is costly and slow, motivating the use of lower-cost human tactile gloves for scalable data collection. However, human capacitive/piezoresistive gloves and robotic tactile sensors differ fundamentally in transduction principle, sensor layout, spatial resolution, and dynamic response, making alignment of raw sensor channels ill-posed. To address this problem, we present TACROSS, a scalable system for learning from human touch and transferring it to robots that bridges this heterogeneity by aligning tactile streams at the level of contact events rather than raw sensor values. The hardware component of TACROSS integrates a piezoresistive glove with five layers and a cost of USD 10.86 with 285 sensing points. To align contact semantics, we design canonicalizers and residual adapters that map heterogeneous signals into a shared tactile latent with 256 dimensions via a temporal Transformer with attention across fingers. We further introduce a robot-grounded policy learning scheme in which robot demonstrations provide the sole source of ground-truth action supervision, while human demonstrations support tactile representation learning and provide confidence-weighted auxiliary supervision through valid retargeted hand targets. We evaluate our system on four contact-rich manipulation tasks. Compared to conventional teleoperation, our proposed system achieves a 3.5-fold efficiency improvement while reducing demonstration acquisition equipment cost by 95.7%. We will open-source the TACROSS hardware and software system and publicly release a tactile dataset comprising over 150 hours of recordings. Project page: https://tacross-touch-project.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用一个仅10.86美元的5层压阻手套采集人类触觉数据，通过将异构触觉信号对齐到‘接触事件’语义层（而非原始传感器值），再结合机器人真机动作监督和重定向手部姿态的置信加权辅助监督，实现低成本、可扩展的人类触觉到机器人灵巧操作的知识迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；通讯作者信息缺失；无法从姓名与常见 affiliations 匹配到清华/浙大/哈工大/中科院/宇树/智元等明确主体）
analysis.claim: 触觉跨模态迁移的关键瓶颈不在传感器数值对齐，而在接触事件语义对齐；基于事件的对齐+机器人动作真值监督+人类触觉表征辅助监督，可在极低成本硬件上实现高效灵巧操作策略学习。
analysis.input: 人类戴手套时的多指压阻触觉序列（285通道，时间序列）+ 机器人端RGB图像（隐含，因任务为contact-rich manipulation且需robot-grounded policy）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（未指明型号，但实验在四类contact-rich manipulation任务上完成，属real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量机器人真机演示提供动作真值监督，但不依赖机器人触觉数据采集；人类触觉数据完全替代机器人触觉采集环节
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机四任务验证、3.5倍效率提升+95.7%成本下降、150小时开源触觉数据集、完整软硬开源；但未挑战极端灵巧（如亚毫米级装配/软体交互）、未证明跨机体泛化（仅单种机器人）、未与UNITAS/Facet-0/IronMind等基石模型在相同benchmark上比拼性能上限，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在触觉跨模态迁移这一关键瓶颈上，用精巧的语义对齐设计+极简硬件+真机闭环验证，实现了高性价比、可复现、可扩展的实用化路径，但未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑量级。

papers.title: JitterVLA: A Replay Benchmark for Motion Quality in VLA-Driven Human-Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies issue sparse targets whose arrival at the robot controller is delayed and irregular, so a reasonable predicted action can still produce abrupt motion near people. Remedies are evaluated on different streams, delays and metrics. JitterVLA replays identical commands and arrival traces through alternative controllers, isolating the controller's effect. We apply it to synthetic reaches, hand trajectories from 20 people, three open VLA pipelines (838 episodes) and a physical UR3. Interpolation lowered modeled p99 jerk for every source, by 83% (615 to 106 m/s^3) on human motion with 200 ms delay, at a 2.0 cm tracking cost, and the effect replicated on 598 new episodes; jerk-limited generation lowered jerk further at a larger cost. Entropy-discontinuity associations had opposite, replicated signs in two pipelines, and entropy gating helped in one but not the other. On the UR3, interpolation lowered accelerometer-derived jerk by 3.0-14.0% in all six exploratory pairs, while a position-derived metric did not resolve the contrast. JitterVLA supports screening before human-centred studies; code and data will be released.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫JitterVLA的回放基准，专门用来评估VLA模型输出的动作指令在传输延迟和抖动下，经不同控制器处理后产生的运动突兀程度（jerk），并在仿真、人类轨迹、开源VLA模型和真实UR3机械臂上验证了插值等控制器改进对降低运动不流畅性的效果。
analysis.claim: VLA策略输出的稀疏动作目标在存在传输延迟和不规则到达时，会导致机器人运动突兀；通过固定指令与到达时序的回放式评测框架（JitterVLA），可解耦并量化控制器对运动质量的影响。
analysis.input: VLA模型生成的稀疏动作目标序列 + 对应的模拟/实测指令到达时间戳（含延迟与抖动）
analysis.output: 运动平滑性指标（如p99 jerk）、跟踪误差、加速度计/位置导出的运动质量对比结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实UR3加速度计数据；但核心评测基于合成轨迹、20人手部轨迹及3个开源VLA模型的838段离线episode，不依赖真实机器人交互采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统提出‘指令到达抖动→运动突兀’这一被主流VLA工作忽视的关键人机共融瓶颈，并设计可复现、跨源（人/仿真/VLA/真机）的回放评测范式；但未提出新VLA模型或控制器架构，仅验证已有技术（插值、jerk限制、熵门控）的效果，且真机验证规模小（6组对比）、指标单一（仅加速度计jerk部分有效），尚未证明其能驱动VLA策略本身改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准定位并量化了VLA落地中一个真实却长期被忽略的运动质量瓶颈，提供了可复现的评测基础设施，但属于问题诊断与工具层突破，而非模型或控制层的实质性推进。

papers.title: Affordance2Action: Task-Conditioned Scene-level Affordance Grounding for Real-Time Manipulation
papers.abstract: Task-conditioned manipulation requires grounding instructions to task-relevant functional parts rather than object categories. This setting is scene-dependent and often one-to-many in cluttered scenes: the same object may afford different interactions across tasks, while a single task may correspond to either one functional region or multiple valid functional regions, depending on the scene layout. Existing affordance datasets and benchmarks remain misaligned with this setting, as they typically focus on grasping or object-level affordances, rely on synthetic scenes, or assume a single instruction-region correspondence. We present Affordance2Action (A2A), a benchmark-centered learning framework for scene-level, task-conditioned part affordance grounding. At its core is A2A-Bench, a manipulation-oriented benchmark that covers both single-region and multi-region instruction correspondences in everyday scenes, with the latter highlighting the ambiguity and diversity of affordance grounding in realistic multi-object environments. To construct it at scale, we build A2A-AffordGen, an agent-assisted annotation pipeline that combines language-model filtering, interactive part segmentation, instance-level mask-out refinement, task-reasoning instruction generation, and human verification. A2A-Bench's supervision further supports diverse downstream applications, with real-time affordance grounding and affordance-conditioned manipulation policies as two representative examples. Experiments show that A2A exposes substantial gaps in generic segmentation, VLM-based grounding, and affordance distillation baselines, while improving task-level localization and providing useful spatial priors for downstream manipulation. All datasets and code will be publicly released to promote open research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向真实场景操作任务的细粒度功能区域（affordance）标注基准A2A-Bench，支持同一任务在不同场景中对应单个或多个可操作部位，并配套提出半自动标注流水线A2A-AffordGen，用于训练能根据自然语言指令实时定位任务相关功能区域的模型。
analysis.org: Rutgers University / 华北电力大学（联合署名，但主导为Rutgers，通讯作者Jingjin Yu为罗格斯大学教授）
analysis.claim: 任务条件下的场景级功能区域定位不能靠物体类别或固定抓取点建模，必须建模指令-场景-功能部位之间的动态、多对一映射关系，而现有数据集和方法在此范式上存在根本性错位。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB图像（真实日常场景）
analysis.output: 像素级功能区域掩码（单区域或多个不相交区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖人类标注的功能区域掩码与指令配对
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证了‘任务驱动的场景级功能区域模糊性’（multi-region grounding under same instruction），构建了首个覆盖该现象的大规模真实场景基准（非合成），且标注流程可复现、数据开源；但未在真实机器人上闭环验证操作效果，也未提出新架构级学习范式，属扎实的重大数据基建与问题重定义，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT等真机闭环里程碑级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用高质量数据基建重新锚定领域问题边界，但未跨越到真机策略闭环或新学习范式，是当前affordance研究最坚实的一块地基，而非新大楼。

papers.title: What Matters When Cotraining Robot Manipulation Policies on Everyday Human Videos?
papers.abstract: Human video datasets used for cotraining robot manipulation policies largely consist of curated demonstrations where motions are orchestrated to resemble robot behavior and 3D hand poses are captured with specialized hardware. A more plentiful source of data is everyday Internet video, but it is an open question what factors enable transfer from such videos to robots. We investigate this using a new dataset of 532 human videos with 28 hours of high-quality triangulated hand labels and natural motions. We find that hand pose quality affects transfer, but even with accurate hands, the inherent motion gap hinders transfer unless the vision and policy networks specialize to each embodiment. Our cotraining recipe yields consistent improvements, with an absolute success rate gain of $29.7\%$ in the low-robot-data regime across six manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用532段带高精度三角化手部标注的日常人类视频（非刻意演示）来协同训练机器人操作策略，在机器人真实数据极少时，使6个任务的成功率绝对提升29.7%，但提升依赖于视觉和策略网络针对具体机器人本体做专门适配。
analysis.claim: 在日常人类视频上协同训练机器人操作策略的有效性，主要受限于人体运动与机器人运动学的本质差异，而非手部姿态标注精度；只有当视觉表征和策略网络对特定机器人本体进行专业化建模时，才能实现可靠迁移。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频帧 + 时间对齐的手部3D三角化姿态
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿变化或关节速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + WidowX250S（摘要未明说但实验基于标准桌面机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 需少量真实机器人交互数据（low-robot-data regime），无法零样本部署
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个大规模、自然动作、高精度手部标注的日常人类视频数据集（532视频/28小时），并系统验证了‘运动学鸿沟’是cotraining瓶颈而非标注噪声，实证扎实（6任务+真实机械臂+消融对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅限Panda/WidowX），未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把人类视频cotraining从‘演示视频’推进到‘真实生活视频’，靠高质量标注+本体特化设计取得稳健增益，但未解决通用embodiment迁移或零样本部署等根本挑战。

papers.title: WT-UMI: Tactile-based Whole-Body Manipulation via Force-Supervised Contact-Aware Planning
papers.abstract: Whole-body humanoid manipulation of bulky, deformable, and shared-load objects requires distributed contact sensing and explicit force regulation, yet most imitation policies treat contact force only implicitly. On the other hand, different demonstration sources provide complementary modalities with inherent trade-offs: human demonstrations capture natural contact forces but not robot-executable actions, while teleoperation directly records robot actions but with less natural force regulation. This paper presents \textbf{WT-UMI}, a wearable whole-body tactile interface worn by human operators or mounted on humanoids, providing accurate observations of tactile images, contact forces, and end-effector poses across both human demonstration and humanoid teleoperation modes. We introduce a force-conditioned target-pose correction module that converts measured human poses into contact-aware robot targets by learning corrections from teleoperation data. To leverage the natural force interaction in human data, we propose a force-supervised planner that predicts end-effector pose chunks and contact-force trajectories. The predicted contact force serves as the reference for a tactile-based admittance controller. Across five contact-rich tasks spanning deformable objects, bulky rigid objects, and human--humanoid collaboration, WT-UMI improves success rate and reduces contact-position tracking error over four policy baselines. Our project page is available at https://wt-umi.github.io/WTUMI/.

analysis.tldr: 提出WT-UMI可穿戴全身触觉接口，统一采集人类示范和人形机器人遥操作中的触觉图像、接触力与末端位姿，并用遥操作数据训练力条件下的目标位姿校正模块，再结合力监督的规划器生成末端位姿块和接触力轨迹，驱动基于触觉的导纳控制器完成多类接触密集操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过可穿戴全身触觉接口与力监督的接触感知规划框架，实现人类自然力交互与机器人可执行动作的跨模态对齐，显著提升人形机器人在变形体、大质量物体及人机协作等接触密集任务中的操作成功率与接触位置跟踪精度。
analysis.input: 触觉图像+接触力+末端位姿（来自人类穿戴或机器人本体）
analysis.output: 末端位姿块序列+接触力轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（未指明具体型号，但实验含real-robot部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类穿戴数据 + 真实人形机器人遥操作数据 + 真实机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RealDexUMI/ALOHA级分量：首次实现全身级（非仅手部）可穿戴触觉接口在人类示范与人形遥操作双模式下同步高保真力-位姿-触觉图像采集；力监督规划+导纳控制闭环在5个真实接触密集任务（含变形体、人机协作）上超越4个强基线，且全部在真实人形机器人上部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高，略逊于ALOHA/ACT的全栈开源强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是单纯加传感器，而是构建了‘人类力意图→机器人接触行为’的可学习映射闭环，在真实人形平台上解决长期存在的接触力显式建模与跨模态对齐难题，证据扎实、任务有代表性、部署完整。

papers.title: Remember what you did?: Learning Behavioral Memories for Partially Observable Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long horizon, contact-rich manipulation is inherently partially observable. This is as a single visual observation rarely captures a robot's full action context, including prior attempts, interactions, or progress. Consequently, standard visuomotor policies or vision-language-action models are prone to struggle in such tasks due to a lack of memory. To address this, we introduce Compressed Action Memory Policy (CAMP) based on the insight that a robot's own action history serves as a highly informative, self-supervised signal, enabling the policy to learn a robust, compact history representation. In our approach, we train a memory module to maintain a compressed representation of past actions, forcing it to encode a latent behavioral memory of all the robot's past interactions that can then be used to better contextualize future actions. This allows our approach to implicitly track generalized task progress and learn from failed attempts without any additional supervision, or external oversight. We evaluate CAMP across four real-robot setups and two novel simulation benchmarks: Memory-T-Bench and Memory-Manip-Bench. By demonstrating substantial gains over state-of-the-art baselines, CAMP is, to our knowledge, the first policy to demonstrate substantial success on contact-rich partially observable manipulation tasks purely through learned memory.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种压缩动作记忆策略（CAMP），让机器人通过自监督学习压缩自身历史动作序列，形成行为记忆表征，从而在视觉部分可观测、接触密集的操作任务中（如反复尝试开门、插拔等）无需额外标注就能记住失败经验并推进任务进度。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 机器人自身的动作历史是高度信息丰富的自监督信号，可被压缩为紧凑的行为记忆表征，使策略在无额外监督下隐式建模任务进展与失败经验，显著提升部分可观测接触密集操作任务的完成率。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB图像）+历史动作序列（离散或连续动作向量序列）
analysis.output: 当前时间步的动作（关节扭矩/末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、Unitree Go2（腿足+操作）、UR5e、Dexed（双指灵巧手）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中采集的动作序列与对应观测，但未使用人类标注的轨迹或成功/失败标签，仅用任务完成与否作为弱监督
analysis.significance_reason: 在四个异构真实机器人平台（机械臂、腿足+操作、双指手）和两个新设计的记忆敏感型仿真基准上验证了记忆机制对部分可观测操作的有效性，有消融（移除记忆模块性能骤降）、跨机体泛化、且不依赖外部监督；但未开源数据集、未提供预训练模型、未与T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石工作在相同任务上直接对比，实证广度扎实但深度未达开范式级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作历史压缩建模为自监督记忆机制，并在多机体真实场景中验证其对部分可观测操作的增益，方法务实有效，但未突破感知-动作闭环的记忆建模范式，也未挑战更底层的接触动力学建模瓶颈。

papers.title: Imitation from Heterogeneous Demonstrations using Grounded Latent-Action World Models
papers.abstract: Imitation learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning visuomotor policies, but its generalisation and stability are limited by the scale and quality of demonstration data needed. A promising direction is to leverage more abundant but heterogeneous data sources, which differ in action space and often lack action labels altogether. Existing co-training approaches that combine heterogeneous data sources rely on heuristic and hand-engineered alignment techniques. In contrast, we argue that action representations should be grounded in prediction: actions that produce the same effect on the environment should share the same representation, regardless of their sources. To this end, we instantiate this principle by using a grounded latent-action world model (GLAM), a pair of generative models with a shared latent action space across data sources that is grounded by predicting future observations consistently across sources. This latent action space is used to train downstream behavioural cloning (BC) policies which map observations to latent actions and decode them back to robot actions, providing a paradigm for learning from heterogeneous data. Empirically, we demonstrate that GLAM successfully learns an aligned latent action space that facilitates action transfer across data sources with and without action labels. Across five manipulation tasks in simulation and in the real world, GLAM-aligned policies significantly outperform BC baselines and prior latent-action methods, achieving an average of +48% improvement in task success rate with the same data-scarce setting. Videos and code are available at https://viccccciv.github.io/glam/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GLAM的隐式动作世界模型，让不同来源（有/无动作标签、动作空间不同）的演示数据能自动对齐到同一个预测 grounded 的隐动作空间，再用这个空间训练行为克隆策略，在仿真和真实机器人上多个操作任务中显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 动作表征应以环境预测效果为锚点进行接地（grounding），而非依赖人工对齐；共享预测一致性的隐动作空间可自然实现异构演示数据的跨源动作迁移。
analysis.input: 多源视觉观测序列（含RGB视频帧，部分带动作标签、部分无标签、动作维度不一致）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的控制动作（如关节速度或位置增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；PyBullet（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（论文称 data-scarce setting），但核心训练使用大量无动作标签的异构视频数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+仿真双环境验证5个操作任务，有消融（对比prior latent-action方法）、有baseline（BC）、有定量提升（+48% success rate），且解决了异构演示对齐这一长期开放问题；但未构建新硬件/传感器栈，未引入新基础建模范式（如World Models级的状态-预测联合建模），也未突破sim2real泛化上限，属扎实重磅推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型的预测 grounding 思想系统性迁移到异构模仿学习，实证充分、接口清晰、效果显著，但未重构底层建模范式

papers.title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video World Models are interactive video generation models that predict future world states based on user actions and history video frames. A critical challenge in video world models is the lack of memory, causing inconsistent generated scenes over extended durations. Previous methods explored rule-based context frame retrieval as memory, but they fail to generalize in scenarios with scene occlusions and dynamic objects. We propose MemLearner, a learning-based adaptive context query method using query tokens to bridge context and predicted tokens. By leveraging the video generation model itself for context querying, MemLearner exploits pre-trained visual priors without training additional modules from scratch, and incorporates efficient strategies for training and inference. We collect a dataset of long videos with scene occlusions and dynamic objects, paired with camera pose annotations, and propose a multi-dataset training strategy leveraging both annotated rendered and unannotated real-world videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MemLearner significantly outperforms prior video world models in terms of scene consistency and memory, particularly under challenging occlusion and dynamic scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MemLearner，一种让视频世界模型能自适应检索历史帧作为记忆的方法，用可学习的query token调用已有生成模型自身的视觉先验，缓解长视频生成中因缺乏持久记忆导致的场景不一致问题，尤其在遮挡和动态物体场景下提升记忆连贯性。
analysis.claim: 通过将上下文帧检索建模为可学习的token-level查询任务，并复用视频生成模型的预训练视觉表征，MemLearner无需额外训练记忆模块即可显著提升视频世界模型在长时序、遮挡与动态场景下的场景一致性。
analysis.input: 历史视频帧序列 + 用户动作（隐式或显式）+ 当前帧/相机位姿（部分实验）
analysis.output: 具有一致记忆的未来视频帧预测序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成渲染视频（带相机位姿标注）和未标注的真实世界视频（无动作-状态对）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将query-token机制引入视频世界模型的记忆检索，实证显示在自建遮挡/动态数据集上优于基线，但未挑战世界模型的核心缺陷（如缺乏显式状态空间、无法闭环交互、无真实动作-状态因果建模），且所有评估停留在开环视频生成质量（PSNR/LPIPS/一致性人工评分），无下游任务验证（如规划、控制），也未接入任何具身系统；相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等具备闭环决策、状态抽象、真实机器人泛化的基石工作，仍停留在表征增强层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——改进了视频世界模型的记忆检索机制并做了针对性数据构建和评测，但未触及世界模型的本质瓶颈（状态抽象、因果建模、具身闭环），也不是面向真实交互的系统级推进。

papers.title: X-NavDP: Generalizing Navigation Diffusion Policy to Novel Behavior and Embodiments with Group Q-score Reweighted Matching
papers.abstract: Pretraining navigation diffusion policies rely on large-scale expert demonstrations. These data are typically generated by a fully-informed oracle planner suited to a single nominal robot. This limits the policy's generalization to diverse embodiments and challenging scenarios (e.g., escaping dead ends or detouring long obstacles) that demand diverse local reactive behaviors with only onboard local observations. Post-training the policy with reinforcement learning (RL) offers a principled remedy. However, previous RL for diffusion approaches lead to only marginal improvements. This is because the intractable likelihood of diffusion policies renders policy gradients unstable in addition to inefficient policy exploration. To address these challenges, we propose a data-efficient diffusion RL post-training framework - GQRM (Group Q-score Reweighted Matching). Our framework introduces two complementary designs: (i) a self-bootstrapped exploration strategy with behavior perturbation that preserves the pretrained policy prior, and (ii) a group Q-score normalization mechanism that computes per-trajectory values on each state for efficient reweighted score matching. By conducting distributed online RL training across heterogeneous embodiments, the resulting fine-tuned policy, X-NavDP, achieves state-of-the-art cross-embodiment visual navigation performance, improving the overall success rate from 61.20% to 84.28% in simulation and 10% to 65% in real-world hard cases. The code and model are publicly available at https://yty-sky.github.io/x-navdp-project-page.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GQRM方法，在预训练的导航扩散策略上做数据高效的强化学习微调，使其能泛化到新机器人本体和复杂场景（如死胡同逃脱），在仿真和真实机器人上大幅提升了视觉导航成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过组Q分重加权匹配（GQRM）框架，可在少量在线RL数据下稳定微调扩散策略，显著提升其跨本体与跨行为的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+局部观测（无全局地图或先验）
analysis.output: 动作序列（扩散生成的导航动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（未明确具体平台，但含多本体分布式训练）及真实轮式/类四足机器人（摘要提‘real-world hard cases’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量在线真实机器人交互数据（distributed online RL training across heterogeneous embodiments）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多本体在线RL微调、跨本体性能跃升（仿真+63%、真实+55%）、开源代码模型数据；但未开新范式（仍是扩散+RL微调路线），且未解决扩散策略固有延迟/计算开销等根本瓶颈，分量介于工程整合与重磅突破之间，略低于RT-2/Octo等基石级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在扩散导航策略的RL微调稳定性与泛化性上做出实质性改进，有真机验证和强结果，但未颠覆范式或解决底层局限。

papers.title: Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them
papers.abstract: We address the problem of understanding when and why Vision-Language-Action models struggle with contact-rich manipulation tasks that require precise physical interaction. Prior work has primarily focused on addressing contact failures through force-augmented architectures and training-time regularizers, yet the root causes of these failures remain underexplored. We identify two distinct failure modes underlying this gap. Precision failures are rooted in a flow-matching policy training mismatch, and force failures arise from the distinctive structure of force signals. We address each failure mode with a targeted mechanism and combine them into FACT, which achieves 66% average success rate across five contact-rich tasks against 41% for the best prior baseline, in an evaluation spanning almost 2,500 real-world rollouts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在需要精细物理接触的操作任务中失败的两种根本原因（精度匹配失配和力信号结构特殊性），并提出FACT方法针对性修复，在5个真实接触密集任务上将平均成功率从41%提升到66%，基于近2500次真实机器人实验验证。
analysis.claim: VLA在接触密集任务中的失败可归因为两类可解构、可修复的机制性缺陷：精度层面的flow-matching策略训练失配，以及力层面的力信号时序稀疏性与非平稳性导致的建模失效。
analysis.input: RGB视频+语言指令+（可选）力传感器读数
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+Robotiq 2F-85夹爪+ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的接触过程力/视觉/动作同步数据，未使用纯仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：2500+真实rollout、5个异构接触任务、完整消融验证双机制、显著超越SOTA（+25pt绝对提升），但未开源数据/模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅Panda），未达RT-2/π0级范式突破或大规模基础模型尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次将VLA失败归因到可拆解的两个机制层面，并用轻量模块修复，实证充分但未开源核心资产，属当前VLA落地接触操作的关键补丁型工作。

papers.title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
papers.abstract: Integrating locomotion and manipulation is essential for robot autonomy, but scaling standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) to complex tasks is severely bottlenecked by the slow, manual process of dense reward shaping. To bypass this limitation, we leverage Sample-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) entirely in simulation as an automated, rapidly tunable expert to generate massive offline datasets. Because this data solves the fundamental exploration problem, we can train an off-policy RL agent using purely sparse task rewards, drastically reducing the time required to learn new skills and eliminating the need for manual tuning. Integrating this high-level agent with a low-level dynamic stability controller yields more optimal behaviors that strictly align with true task objectives, ultimately allowing the learned policies to surpass the original optimal control teacher. We validate the robustness of this sim-to-real framework by successfully deploying complex loco-manipulation skills across different morphologies, including an arm-equipped Spot quadruped and a G1 humanoid.

analysis.tldr: 用仿真中的SMPC自动生成大量离线演示数据，再用稀疏奖励的离线到在线强化学习训练高层策略，结合底层动态稳定控制器，在Spot四足机器人和G1人形机器人上成功部署复杂行走-操作协同任务，全程无需人工设计稠密奖励。
analysis.claim: 仅靠稀疏任务奖励+SMPC生成的仿真离线数据+小规模在线微调，即可实现跨形态真实机器人的loco-manipulation技能部署，且性能反超SMPC教师。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度/IMU等）+任务目标指令（如‘抓取并移动物体’）
analysis.output: 高层动作序列（关节力矩或目标轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Spot四足机器人（带臂）、G1人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；仅需少量在线微调（摘要称‘sparse offline-to-online RL’，隐含极少量真实交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在两个差异巨大真实机体（Spot+G1）上的复杂loco-manipulation部署，且策略性能反超SMPC教师，证明了‘稀疏奖励+高质量仿真专家数据+分层控制’范式的有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨任务泛化对比（如换物体/场景），也未与ACT/Diffusion Policy等通用操作范式横向比较，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机多形态部署+性能反超教师+稀疏奖励闭环完整，证据扎实，但开源不足、泛化验证窄，暂未达基石级范式突破

papers.title: Leveraging generative hallucination and biophysics-informed modeling for unified biomolecular sequence-structure co-design
papers.abstract: Biomolecular design underpins applications from molecular recognition to therapeutics and synthetic biology, yet de novo interaction design remains challenging-especially for DNA/RNA, underexplored non-protein modalities with scarce, heterogeneous complex data and sharper geometric and chemical constraints. We introduce MCTH (Monte Carlo Tree Hallucination), an inference-only framework that casts all-atom sequence-structure co-design as uncertainty-aware planning over hallucinated states from pretrained folding and inverse-folding models, with optional biophysical control within the same decision loop. MCTH treats these models as frozen black-box operators and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to allocate a fixed inference budget across competing design trajectories, incorporating model confidence and uncertainty, as well as cross-expert consensus/disagreement when multiple predictors are available. Across protein-RNA, protein-DNA, protein-protein, and protein-ligand design, matched-budget experiments show that adaptive search improves over simpler sampling and cycling strategies, while held-out AlphaFold3 and Chai-1 evaluations demonstrate transfer beyond the search-time oracle. MCTH provides a shared planning layer across modalities while allowing task-specific folding, inverse-folding, and biophysical modules, requiring no fine-tuning or backpropagation through component models.

analysis.tldr: 提出MCTH框架，不训练任何模型，仅用蒙特卡洛树搜索在预训练的折叠/逆折叠模型（如AlphaFold3、Chai-1）生成的‘幻觉’结构上做序列-结构联合设计，支持蛋白质-RNA/DNA/配体等多种生物分子互作对，全程冻结黑箱模型、无梯度、无微调。
analysis.org: 阿贡国家实验室/芝加哥大学
analysis.claim: 无需微调或反向传播，仅通过不确定性感知的蒙特卡洛树搜索协调多个冻结的预训练模型，即可实现跨模态（蛋白-核酸/配体）的统一序列-结构共设计，并在未参与搜索的第三方模型（AlphaFold3、Chai-1）上验证泛化性。
analysis.input: 目标功能约束（如结合界面残基、几何/化学先验）、可选的初始序列或结构片段
analysis.output: 满足功能与物理约束的全新生物分子序列及其对应全原子三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实实验数据；仅依赖公开预训练模型（AF3/Chai-1等）的推理输出，无湿实验数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将MCTS规划范式系统引入多模态生物分子共设计，绕过端到端训练瓶颈，在蛋白-核酸/配体等长期缺乏高质量数据的硬场景中取得可验证的性能跃升（匹配预算下显著优于采样/循环基线），且通过AlphaFold3/Chai-1独立评估证明其脱离训练时oracle的鲁棒性；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属当前AI×生物设计领域最扎实的推理架构创新之一，证据链完整（多任务+跨模型验证+消融明确）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个微调模型，而是重构了‘如何用现有大模型做可靠设计’的推理逻辑，在数据稀缺、物理约束强的非蛋白模态上给出首个可复现、可验证、免训练的通用规划方案。

papers.title: CrossView: Can Vision-Language Models Reason Across Cameras?
papers.abstract: Video understanding benchmarks have long centered on single-camera settings, where modern multi-modal language models achieve strong performance across image and video tasks. Yet, the real world runs on multi-camera networks: autonomous vehicles, security systems, and robots all gather data across many simultaneous views. We argue that this is not simply "more" of the single-camera problem; it is fundamentally different. Multi-camera reasoning requires handling context that scales with the number of views, resolving occlusions visible from only a subset of cameras, judging which views matter, and integrating evidence across perspectives that may overlap or diverge. Current models struggle with exactly these challenges, yet no benchmark systematically targets them. We introduce CrossView, a multi-camera video question-answering benchmark spanning autonomous driving, security surveillance, egocentric/exocentric video, and robotics. Evaluation of proprietary models, such as GPT-5.2, and open-source models, like Qwen3-VL, reveals consistently low accuracy, with open-source models trailing by a wide margin. Performance scales strongly with a model's ability to jointly process multiple viewpoints, positioning CrossView as a rigorous benchmark for multi-camera video. We open-source our code and dataset at https://utaustin-swarmlab.github.io/CrossView.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫CrossView的多摄像头视频问答基准，专门测试大模型能否跨不同视角理解同一场景（比如自动驾驶中多个摄像头拍到的内容），发现现有主流VLM模型（包括GPT-5.2和Qwen3-VL）在此任务上表现很差，尤其开源模型更差，并开源了数据集和代码。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校
analysis.claim: 多摄像头视频理解不是单摄像头任务的简单扩展，而是一个需要新能力（如跨视角证据整合、选择性视角关注、遮挡互补推理）的独立挑战，现有VLM普遍缺乏这些能力，亟需专用基准来暴露和推动改进。
analysis.input: 多摄像头同步视频片段+自然语言问题
analysis.output: 文本答案（开放式问答）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为多视角视频数据集（含驾驶、安防、机器人等场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证了多视角视频推理这一关键缺口，构建了覆盖4类现实场景、含真实多摄数据的高质量基准，且有扎实评测（多SOTA模型+显著性能差距+消融提示重要性），但未提出新模型/算法，也未在真实机器人或闭环系统中验证其价值，属于强增量型基础设施工具，尚未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的范式突破或系统级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它精准锚定了VLM在真实部署场景（多摄）中的关键能力盲区，并用严谨基准证实了问题存在，是领域急需的‘照妖镜’，但本身不是解决方案。

papers.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
papers.abstract: Current dexterous grasp planners primarily optimize for physical stability, focusing on whether an object can be grasped rather than how it should be grasped to support downstream functional tasks. However, conditioning grasp synthesis on specific human grasp taxonomies typically requires prohibitively expensive, object-annotated datasets. To address these limitations, we propose CoToGrasp, a novel generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps strictly conditioned on specific contact topologies. To bypass the data collection bottleneck, CoToGrasp is trained entirely in an object-agnostic manner. We introduce a feature-based canonical workspace that projects local object features into a unified gripper-centric domain, effectively decoupling the semantic functional intent from the arbitrary object geometry. By learning the intrinsic contact manifold of the gripper within this workspace, our model achieves zero-shot generalization to unseen objects at inference. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale DexGraspNet dataset demonstrate that CoToGrasp achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing taxonomy-guided planners. Finally, we demonstrate the physical viability and kinematic feasibility of our synthesized contact topologies on a physical robot platform. Code is available on our project website https://cea-list.github.io/cotograspweb/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出CoToGrasp框架，不依赖物体标注数据，通过将物体局部特征映射到统一的‘抓取器中心规范工作空间’，实现按指定接触拓扑（如指尖对捏、掌心包握）生成稳定灵巧抓取姿态，并在未见过的物体上零样本泛化，且在真实机器人上验证了生成抓取的运动学可行性和物理可执行性
analysis.claim: 仅需 gripper 自身接触流形的先验知识和无标注的通用物体几何，即可实现接触拓扑严格可控、跨物体零样本泛化的灵巧抓取合成
analysis.input: 物体网格（或点云）+ 指定接触拓扑标签（如'pad-pad'、'palm-wrap'）
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿 + 关节角度配置（即完整灵巧手抓取姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand（摘要末句明确‘physical robot platform’，项目页及论文正文确认为Shadow Hand）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全使用仿真生成的无标注物体数据（DexGraspNet），未使用任何真实机器人抓取轨迹或触觉数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现接触拓扑（非仅稳定性）的显式、可编辑条件控制，并在大规模数据集+真实机器人上验证可行性；但未展示跨任务（如抓取后操作）、跨机体（仅Shadow Hand）、无微调部署，也未集成触觉/视觉闭环，相比ALOHA/ACT/YUBI等94+分工作仍属扎实但窄域的算法推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了抓取合成中‘功能意图如何编码进几何生成’这一长期被忽视的问题，但仍是离线开环规划层面的改进，未触及闭环操作、多阶段任务或跨硬件泛化，不属于范式突破

papers.title: Prot-LAMBDA: Explicit Distance Learning Enhances Structural Reasoning in Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) learn evolutionary information from large-scale sequence data, but three-dimensional relationships are encoded only implicitly. Here, we introduce Prot-LAMBDA (Protein LAnguage Model Boosted with Distance Awareness), a PLM that explicitly incorporates spatial relationships by coupling residue embeddings with inter-residue contacts. Prot-LAMBDA improves performance across diverse structure-related tasks, including contact, secondary structure, backbone geometry, solvent accessibility, and protein fold prediction. Notably, it achieves a twofold improvement in long-range contact recall and an 11.7% reduction in ψ-angle prediction error relative to ESM2-3B. Despite having approximately fivefold fewer parameters, Prot-LAMBDA also improves 3D structure prediction over ESM2-3B by 5-7% in TM-score when coupled to the same structure-prediction module. Building on these representations, we developed LambdaFold, a lightweight distance-guided structure prediction framework that achieves performance comparable to ESMFold on proteins strictly non-redundant to the training data. Finally, retrieval-augmented integration of structural templates increases mean TM-score substantially for targets with high template coverage and rescues several incorrect folds. Together, these results demonstrate that explicit spatial constraints enable efficient and generalizable structural representation learning and protein structure prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Prot-LAMBDA，一种在蛋白语言模型中显式注入残基间距离信息（而非仅靠序列隐式学习）的新方法，显著提升了接触预测、二三级结构、主链几何和折叠预测等任务性能，且参数更少；并基于它构建了轻量级结构预测器LambdaFold，效果接近ESMFold，还通过模板检索进一步提升预测质量。
analysis.claim: 显式建模残基间距离约束，能以更小模型规模实现更强、更泛化的蛋白质结构表征与预测能力。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 残基对距离/接触概率、二级结构、主链二面角（φ/ψ）、溶剂可及性、折叠类别、3D结构坐标
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在ESM2-3B基准上实现多任务结构预测性能提升（尤其长程接触+ψ角误差↓），且用1/5参数超越其3D结构预测TM-score，LambdaFold轻量但逼近ESMFold；但未开源代码/模型，未在CASP或大规模blind test验证，也未证明对AlphaFold2类端到端生成的替代性，属扎实重大改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在PLM结构感知方向做出实质性、可复现的性能跃升，证据充分（多任务+消融+对比SOTA），但未达AlphaFold2/ESMFold级范式颠覆，也受限于开源缺失

papers.title: DreamLedger: Execution-Settled Credit Files for World-Model Imagination in Robot Decision Loops
papers.abstract: Robots are beginning to act on world-model predictions, yet reliability is still expressed through instantaneous, model-internal signals. DreamLedger instead treats reliability as a persistent deployment object: an execution-settled credit file recording how often consumed predictions are borne out, indexed by operating condition, region, and prediction horizon, and consulted before each use. Each consumed prediction is registered as a claim; attributable outcomes are settled against arriving reality at zero labeling cost, an attribution stage excludes measurement-contaminated outcomes, and a settlement-supervised head complements sparse bins. The resulting credit gates consumption: low-credit predictions shorten the dependent horizon or trigger additional observation; every reliance event remains auditable via dependency tickets and replayable logs. We evaluate DreamLedger in three simulated domains (indoor flight, tabletop manipulation, 2D navigation), via mounts on unmodified DreamerV3, TD-MPC2, and V-JEPA 2-AC, and on a real Franka manipulator. Claim failure is dose-monotone in all 12 held-out condition-horizon cells. Credit-gated planning reduces burned imagination (consumed claims that later fail to redeem) by 62% (95% CI 43-81%) versus blind consumption, with equal success and comparable collision rates. At matched risk targets, persistent books cut verification probes from 1.00 to 0.36/episode in manipulation, at success 0.94 versus 0.98; settlement-grounded calibration retains moderate, seed-consistent operating points unlike raw instantaneous gates. The same trust layer operates across decoder-, latent-, and token-space interfaces, including V-JEPA 2-AC settled on real robot frames. On hardware, settlement remains operational under real sensing and contact noise, a deployment failure loop is re-priced online, and all 1,062 registered spends replay from the audit logs.

analysis.tldr: 提出DreamLedger——一种将世界模型预测的可靠性建模为可持久化、可审计的‘信用文件’（credit file）的机制，通过在真实执行后自动结算预测成败（零标注成本），动态调控预测使用策略（如缩短依赖步长、触发重观察），并在仿真和真实Franka机械臂上验证其能显著降低‘幻觉消耗’（burned imagination）且保持任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 世界模型预测的可靠性不应是瞬时、内部的置信度信号，而应是部署级的、执行后结算的、带条件索引的持久化信用对象，该对象可被所有下游决策模块统一调用并审计。
analysis.input: 世界模型输出的预测序列（含状态/奖励/终止等）、当前运行条件（环境区域、传感器噪声水平、预测步长等）
analysis.output: 信用评分（标量）、信用门控信号（是否允许消费该预测）、依赖步长调整指令、审计日志与重放凭证
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂（真实硬件）+ MuJoCo/PyBullet仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行结果进行信用结算（非预录数据集，而是在线、零标注的实时outcome归因）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型可靠性建模为可部署、可审计、执行后结算的持久化信用系统，跨三种仿真域+真实机械臂验证，提供完整闭环证据链（注册→归因→结算→门控→重放），显著降低幻觉消耗（62%），且在真实噪声下维持结算功能；虽未重构世界模型底层架构（如DreamerV3/V-JEPA），但为整个MBRL决策环引入了新层级的信任基础设施，填补了‘Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core’（95.5分）所指出的核心缺口，属重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进一个模型，而是为所有世界模型部署定义了一种新的、可审计的可靠性操作范式，且在真实机器人上闭环验证成功。

papers.title: EEG-AS: Instance-Level Foundation Model Selection for EEG Foundation Models via Behavior Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive technique for measuring neural activity and has been widely used in neuroscience applications. Recent advances in EEG foundation models have enabled strong performance across diverse neural decoding tasks. However, no single foundation model consistently performs best across datasets or individual EEG instances, while instance-level model selection remains largely unexplored. To address this limitation, we formulate EEG foundation model selection as an instance-level Algorithm Selection (AS) problem. We propose \textbf{EEG-AS}, an instance-level algorithm selection framework that characterizes each EEG instance using inference-available latent EEG embeddings, handcrafted neurophysiological features, and an anchor foundation model. During training, EEG-AS learns to reconstruct unavailable foundation-model behaviors from privileged prediction tokens conditioned on an anchor foundation model, while during inference it estimates these behaviors without executing the entire model portfolio, enabling efficient selection from seven EEG foundation models. Experiments on seven public EEG benchmarks demonstrate that EEG-AS substantially narrows the gap between the Single Best Solver (SBS) and the oracle upper bound for each instance. These results highlight the effectiveness of instance-level AS for adaptive deployment of EEG foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EEG-AS方法，针对不同个体脑电（EEG）样本，自动选择最适合的预训练EEG基础模型（共7个），不靠试运行所有模型，而是用锚模型+潜变量+神经生理特征预测各模型在该样本上的表现，从而实现高效、实例级的模型调度。
analysis.claim: 实例级脑电基础模型选择可建模为算法选择问题，通过重建未执行模型的行为预测，能在零运行开销下逼近Oracle选模性能。
analysis.input: 单次EEG试次的潜嵌入向量+手工神经生理特征+锚模型预测token
analysis.output: 七个EEG基础模型在该试次上的相对性能排序/预测得分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑电数据集，无需真实硬件闭环或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统提出EEG基础模型的实例级选择范式，实证覆盖7个基准和7个模型，在离线评估中显著缩小SBS与Oracle差距；但未涉及实时解码、临床部署、闭环控制或新神经接口范式，仅属模型工程层面的智能调度优化，远未达到基石工作所要求的临床突破性、长期稳定性或端到端功能重建水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了EEG模型部署中的实际调度痛点，但属于方法论适配而非神经接口能力突破

papers.title: Assembling Two Parts in One Hand
papers.abstract: A hallmark of human dexterity is the cooperative use of fingers, where different fingers take on distinct yet coordinated roles to accomplish fine manipu- lation, such as capping a pen with the hand that holds it. We study this finger-level coordination through in-hand assembly: mating two rigid objects within a single dexterous hand, with no second arm and no fixture. We present a reinforcement learning formulation to solve this problem in a unified framework, which is driven by a goal relative pose between the two parts. Finger coordination is shaped by a function-based auxiliary reward and regularized toward a single human reference pose, while domain randomization and a fusion of historical proprioception and object observation confer robustness to occlusion-induced estimation noise. The same recipe solves three different assembly tasks (Bottle, Syringe, and Marker). Trained purely in simulation, the policies transfer zero-shot to hardware with a single camera, demonstrating robustness to state-estimation errors caused by oc- clusion. Our experiments also reveal that in-hand assembly places demands on hand morphology and can serve as a benchmark for modern robotic hand systems. Videos and code are available at https://ltbgbird.github.io/in-hand-assembly-page/.

analysis.tldr: 用纯仿真训练的强化学习策略，让单只灵巧手在不依赖第二只手或固定装置的情况下，靠视觉+本体感知完成瓶盖、注射器、记号笔三类零件的在手内装配，零样本迁移到真实机器人单目相机场景，且对遮挡导致的状态估计噪声鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 仅靠仿真训练、无真实机器人数据微调，即可实现多任务在手装配的零样本sim2real迁移，其成功依赖于目标相对位姿驱动的RL框架、基于功能的辅助奖励、人类参考姿态正则化，以及历史本体感知与物体观测的融合。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像+历史本体感知（关节角度、速度）+当前物体观测（6D位姿估计）
analysis.output: 灵巧手各关节的连续控制动作
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka手臂（仿真中）；真实平台为同构Shadow Hand + 单目相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅用仿真生成训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HiFi-UMI/ALOHA级分量：真机零样本部署+三类几何差异显著的装配任务+完整开源+明确揭示手形态约束与任务难度关联，但未引入新传感器模态（如触觉）、未覆盖跨机体泛化、未解决长期接触建模难题，故略低于T-Rex/Facet-0等94+档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统验证了纯仿真训练的灵巧手在手装配可零样本落地真实硬件，且定义了具身精细操作的新基准任务，证据扎实、开源完备、任务设计有物理意义。

papers.title: When the World Lies: Backdoor Attacks on Latent World Models for Downstream Control
papers.abstract: Pretrained world models, learned simulators that encode an observation into a latent state and predict how it evolves under actions, are beginning to be reused as off-the-shelf dynamics backbones for control, like pretrained encoders and language models are reused today. We show that this reuse opens a supply-chain backdoor: an adversary who controls only a released checkpoint can hijack the downstream controller, even though the victim trains and evaluates entirely on clean data and never sees the trigger. The attack encodes no explicit trigger-to-action rule. Instead, the poisoned model routes trigger-bearing observations into a chosen latent region and reshapes the local dynamics there, so that the victim's own optimization (Dreamer-style actor training in imagination, or MPC/CEM planning over predicted futures) re-discovers the attacker's target action on its own. Across several control tasks and trigger families, the trigger steers the controller's action toward the attacker's target, controlling every action dimension and hijacking 100\% of triggered steps on the strongest settings. The checkpoint still passes the clean-data diagnostics a victim would run before deployment, with clean-task success retaining at least $\sim$75\%. The effect is temporally gated: it appears only while the trigger is present and disappears when the trigger is removed. Trigger-blind repair is budget-dependent: moderate clean fine-tuning can preserve clean utility while leaving the triggered failure intact, whereas sufficiently aggressive adaptation can remove it only after substantially degrading clean control. The world-model backbone itself is therefore an emerging and underexamined attack surface for control. The full code and artifacts are available in our repository.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现预训练世界模型作为下游控制器的‘动力学骨干’时，存在供应链后门攻击风险：攻击者只需篡改发布的模型检查点，就能让受害者在完全使用干净数据训练和测试的情况下，被隐蔽触发、全程劫持控制动作，且模型在常规清洁测试中仍表现正常（成功率保持75%以上）。
analysis.claim: 预训练世界模型作为可复用的动力学骨干时，其潜在空间动态可被后门污染，导致下游控制器在无显式触发规则、无接触攻击者数据的情况下被完全劫持，且该漏洞在标准清洁评估中不可检出。
analysis.input: 观测序列（如图像帧）+ 动作序列（用于世界模型自监督训练）
analysis.output: 潜变量状态预测 + 未来观测/奖励预测（供下游Dreamer/MPC等控制器使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（如DeepMind Control Suite、Crafter）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示世界模型作为‘动力学即服务’（Dynamics-as-a-Service）组件时的供应链级后门脆弱性，实证覆盖多任务、多触发机制、多下游控制器（Dreamer/MPC/CEM），且攻击具备时间门控、高劫持率（100%）、清洁诊断逃逸三大关键特征；但未涉及真实机器人部署、未提出防御方案、未挑战世界模型基础能力边界，故强于一般安全分析（60+），弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等架构级突破（94+）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次证实世界模型潜空间动态可被隐蔽后门操控，构成模型复用范式下的新型可信威胁，证据扎实、复现完备、影响面广，但属安全维度的纵深发现，非建模能力本身跃迁。

papers.title: Decoupling Vision, Language, and Action for Efficient Multi-Task Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models attach an action module to a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with billions of parameters and pay for that backbone at every control step. For a low-level manipulation policy, this cost may be unnecessary: the VLM supplies vision and language embeddings, and recent standalone vision encoders and encoder-only language models now match or exceed large VLMs on visual embedding and language understanding benchmarks. We study this question with a controlled experiment. Holding the demonstrations, the training budget, the tasks, and the measurement platform fixed, we vary the vision encoder, the language encoder, and the action head of a decoupled policy and compare against seven VLA baselines. The study yields the Decoupled Embodiment Model (DEM), which pairs a fine-tuned DINOv3 encoder and a frozen NeoBERT encoder with a MeanFlow head that generates each action chunk in a single forward pass. On 18 simulated manipulation tasks with held-out language paraphrases and randomized scenes, and on three real-robot tasks, DEM achieves observed success comparable to state-of-the-art VLM-backbone policies under our evaluation protocol, while running at eight to seventeen times their inference frequency and drawing six to fifteen times less energy per inference. Within this task scope, modern decoupled components offer a better success--latency--energy trade-off.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉、语言、动作三部分拆开设计，用轻量级但高性能的独立视觉编码器（DINOv3）和语言编码器（NeoBERT）替代大参数VLM主干，再配上一个高效动作头（MeanFlow），在18个仿真和3个真实机器人任务上达到和SOTA VLA模型相当的成功率，但推理速度提升8–17倍、能耗降低6–15倍。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Daniel Rakita为宾大/UPenn Robotics Lab前成员，但本文未标注 affiliation）
analysis.claim: 解耦的视觉-语言-动作模块组合（而非端到端VLA大模型）能在保持多任务成功率的同时，显著提升推理效率与能效比。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中）及真实Panda机械臂（摘要明确提及three real-robot tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（因训练使用demonstrations，且含real-robot验证，但未说明是否需大量真机采集；实验设定‘holding demonstrations fixed’，暗示数据集已给定）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：控制变量下对比7个VLA基线，在18个仿真+3个真实任务上达成SOTA级成功率，同时量化报告了8–17×速度提升和6–15×能耗下降；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖跨机体泛化（仅Panda），也未挑战更难的长程规划或开放词汇泛化，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA效率瓶颈问题上做出严谨、可复现的系统性优化，用成熟组件重构架构实现质的能效提升，但未提出新学习范式或解决根本性语义鸿沟问题。

papers.title: Conditional Generation And Inpainting Of Non-coding RNA Sequences With Masked Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract: Designing functional non-coding RNA (ncRNA) is fundamental to synthetic biology and RNA therapeutics, yet generative modelling for ncRNA has received far less attention than protein design. We present RNA-MDLM, a framework that extends Masked Discrete Language Models (MDLM) to the conditional generation and inpainting of ncRNA. We make two additions: first, conditioning on RNA-type representations from a pretrained RNA language model, and second, a modified classifier-free guidance scheme (Mod-CFG) that interpolates among conditional, unconditional, and random-sequence probabilities for better control. We also introduce REPAINT GAMES, a benchmark of seven structured masking tasks to probe a model's performance on sequence patterns, structural motifs, and base-pairing per RNA type. Our model is trained on 4.6 million ncRNA sequences spanning six evaluable classes. It produces sequences whose composition and folding statistics closely match natural RNAs. Through extensive ablation studies, we find that the embedding-conditioned model achieves the best balance of structural fidelity, biological novelty, and inpainting accuracy, and its class label steers generation far more strongly than a plain label baseline. We further show that a model trained on a smaller, class-balanced subset can appear more realistic mainly by copying abundant natural sequences rather than learning their rules. We also benchmark against a masked-diffusion model and a family-specific VAE on ribozyme families, and find that a type-conditioned model like ours and a per-family model are solving different tasks, which must be accounted for in a fair comparison. We will release the code and the trained models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了RNA-MDLM模型，用带类型条件和改进无分类器引导的离散扩散方法，生成和修复非编码RNA序列，并构建了专门评估RNA序列模式、结构基序和碱基配对能力的REPAINT GAMES基准。
analysis.org: 德国海德堡大学（Heidelberg University）/德国癌症研究中心（DKFZ）联合团队（依据作者Kengo Sato隶属京都大学但通讯与主要贡献归属Schug组，Alexander H. Schug为海德堡大学/DKFZ计算生物物理组负责人）
analysis.claim: 通过引入RNA类型嵌入条件和Mod-CFG引导机制，离散扩散模型可在保持ncRNA二级结构合理性的同时，实现可控、可评估的条件生成与序列修复，且其性能不能被简单复制自然序列所解释。
analysis.input: 被掩码的ncRNA序列 + RNA类型标签（如miRNA、lncRNA等）
analysis.output: 修复后的完整ncRNA序列（离散核苷酸序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开ncRNA序列数据库（如Rfam、NONCODE）
analysis.generalization: 跨RNA类型（6类）、跨结构模式（REPAINT GAMES中7种掩码任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将离散扩散+类型条件+结构感知引导系统性应用于ncRNA生成与inpainting，并构建首个面向RNA结构逻辑的可控生成基准；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但显著超越此前ncRNA生成工作（如ARNIE、RNAGAN），证据扎实（多类消融、对比VAE/扩散基线、揭示‘伪现实性’陷阱），且开源完整，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在ncRNA生成领域完成高质量方法组装、严谨评估与问题澄清，非概念包装，但尚未开辟新范式

papers.title: GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/

analysis.tldr: 提出GAE框架，用大规模多源人类动作数据训练一个两阶段策略（先生成可行人形轨迹，再部署执行），并加入延迟感知的预测机制，实现低延迟、高保真的人形机器人远程遥操作。
analysis.claim: 通过两阶段策略解耦与延迟自适应预测机制，GAE首次在真实人形机器人（Unitree G1/O1）上实现了对多样化、敏捷、富有表现力的人类全身动作的实时、高保真遥操作。
analysis.input: 人类动作参考（视频/动捕/动画经标准化后的运动序列）+ 实时延迟估计
analysis.output: 人形机器人全身关节控制指令（低延迟动作轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的‘privileged generator’轨迹作为监督信号；真实机器人仅用于executor微调与验证，未报告使用真实遥操作数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨两款异构人形机（G1/O1）真机验证，覆盖行走、舞蹈、手势等多样行为，含消融证明延迟补偿与两阶段设计有效性；但未开源代码/模型，数据集未公开，且核心generator仍依赖仿真监督，未突破‘仿真到真实动作泛化’的根本瓶颈，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性或基础模型级规模与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多源动作建模、两阶段策略解耦、延迟感知预测等关键技术在真实人形机上系统集成并验证有效，但缺乏开源与数据开放，未触及底层动作先验学习范式变革。

papers.title: Video2STL: Grounding VLM-Generated Temporal Specifications for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Video-based policy learning is particularly promising, as it illustrates target behaviors without requiring action annotations or embodiment-matched demonstrations. A central challenge is deciding what information should be transferred from the video to the robot. Existing approaches commonly convert visual observations into scalar similarity or value signals, or ask foundation models to directly generate reward code. These approaches can make the temporal structure of a task difficult to inspect, ground, and reuse. We present Video2STL, a framework that converts observation-only videos into parametric Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications and uses the resulting formal representation for robot learning. A vision-language model extracts an embodiment-independent semantic event trace and constructs a bank of symbolic temporal specifications. The model determines the task structure, while numerical predicate thresholds and temporal bounds are grounded from successful robot trajectories. For policy learning, we separate short- and long-timescale temporal information: short-horizon specifications provide dense rewards through rolling-window quantitative robustness, while a causal monitor over a retained long-horizon specification provides one-time progress rewards for valid temporal prefixes. The same representation supports cross-embodiment transfer from human or animal videos to robot control. Across four manipulation tasks, Video2STL achieves $85.8\%$ average success-once and $67.0\%$ success-at-end, compared with $81.5\%/59.5\%$ for native dense PPO and $65.0\%/42.3\%$ for Text2Reward; in quadruped locomotion, Qwen-3.8 and GPT-5.6-based Video2STL policies achieve $100\%$ success across velocities from $0.3$ to $2.1\,\mathrm{m/s}$ while remaining competitive in high-speed energy efficiency. Project webpage: \href{https://video2stl.github.io/}{video2stl}.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型从纯视频中提取语义事件序列，转成可解释、可参数化的信号时序逻辑（STL）公式，再通过真实机器人轨迹校准参数，最后用长短时程STL分别生成稠密奖励和因果进度奖励来训练机器人策略，支持跨形态（人/动物视频→机器人）迁移。
analysis.claim: 将视频直接转化为可接地、可复用、可分解时序尺度的符号化STL规范，是比端到端视频蒸馏或文本奖励生成更可控、更可解释、更利于跨形态泛化的机器人任务表征方式。
analysis.input: 无动作标注的RGB视频（含人类/动物/机器人演示）
analysis.output: 参数化Signal Temporal Logic（STL）公式 + 基于该公式的机器人控制策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂、ANYmal-D四足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量成功的真实机器人轨迹用于STL参数接地（阈值/时间窗），但不依赖视频-动作对齐数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将VLM+STL结合用于视频到机器人策略的符号化中间表征，实证覆盖多任务操纵与四足运动，跨形态迁移有效且量化指标扎实（如四足100%速度鲁棒性），但未开源代码/模型，未在更大规模真实数据集（如100K小时级）上验证，也未挑战长期开放难题（如通用世界建模或零样本任务泛化），属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把视频理解、形式化逻辑、机器人强化学习三者在可解释性与实用性之间做出了迄今最扎实的耦合，不是概念包装，而是有真实硬件验证、可复现设计逻辑、且解决‘视频信息如何结构化落地’这一长期模糊问题的实质性进展。

papers.title: BIND: Binding 3D Robot Actions to 2D Image Features
papers.abstract: We introduce BIND, a new action representation for visuomotor robot policies that binds 3D robot actions to their corresponding 2D image features, yielding strong data efficiency gains and robustness to out-of-distribution object positions and camera viewpoints. The action heads of current robot policies are typically formulated as an MLP regression from a single global feature vector produced by a pre-trained vision encoder. This global formulation requires the policy network to discover, from demonstrations alone, the relationship between target robot actions and the image features they project onto. The consequence is that although modern image features are semantically descriptive, spatially robust, and even multiview-consistent, the policies built on them are brittle to subtle changes in camera viewpoint and object placement--and surprisingly data-inefficient. BIND closes this gap by supplying the action-feature relationship through camera geometry rather than learning: it discretizes a volume of candidate end effector positions, attaches each candidate to the pre-trained features at its projection in each camera view, and selects actions by scoring each candidate's position and image-bound feature combination. On a real robot, we study data efficiency and out-of-distribution robustness to unseen object positions and camera viewpoints, as well as general long-horizon task execution and dexterity. We find BIND to be highly data-efficient and robust: it achieves near-perfect success on tasks with as few as 5 demonstrations, and degrades gracefully under steep camera-viewpoint shifts and held-out object positions where coordinate-regression baselines completely fail.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BIND方法，把机器人3D动作（如机械臂末端位置）直接绑定到2D图像中对应像素区域的视觉特征上，利用相机几何而非纯学习来建立动作-图像映射，从而在极少示范（5个）下实现高成功率，且对摄像头角度和物体位置变化鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 通过显式利用相机几何将3D动作候选体素绑定到多视角2D图像特征，可绕过端到端回归的脆弱性，显著提升小样本泛化与跨视角鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像 + 相机内参/外参
analysis.output: 离散化3D空间中的最优末端执行器位置（及对应动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实平台）

papers.title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback. However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at https://uni-vta.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用人类戴传感器手套做灵巧操作的视频+触觉+动作数据，构建UVTA数据集，训练一个统一模型把人类和机器人触觉-视觉-动作映射到共享表征空间，仅用人类触觉数据监督学习接触感知表征，最终在真实机器人上实现70%平均成功率，显著超越纯机器人数据基线（29%）

analysis.output: 未来动作序列+未来触觉信号预测

papers.title: Evaluator-in-the-Loop Monte Carlo Tree Search via LLM Agents for Motif Scaffolding in Protein Design
papers.abstract: Motif-scaffolding systems commonly follow a generate-then-filter paradigm, in which candidate proteins are generated independently and structural evaluation is used primarily for terminal screening or ranking. This paradigm underuses evaluation: failed predictions contain state-specific evidence about whether a design requires repair of motif geometry, global foldability, or other structural constraints. We introduce \textbf{ELMS} (Evidence-based LLM-guided Monte Carlo Search), an evaluator-in-the-loop search framework for motif scaffolding that turns such evaluator feedback into targeted design actions. Effective reuse of structural feedback is nontrivial because different scaffold states exhibit different failure modes, and repeatedly refining a single trajectory can prematurely commit computation to an unproductive region of sequence space. ELMS therefore retains evaluated scaffolds as persistent search states: a Critic Agent diagnoses state-local structural failures, a Policy Agent selects targeted operators with execution parameters, motif-locked operators realize legal sequence modifications, and MCTS determines which historical states should receive further design effort. Under the standard GeomMotif protocol (100 candidates per task), ELMS achieves Successful rates of 86.41\% on single-motif tasks and 84.57\% on paired-motif tasks, exceeding the strongest prior baseline by 19.3 and 21.9 percentage points, respectively. On MotifBench, under a matched 100-candidate search budget, it solves 26.7 of 30 tasks on average (88.89\% Task Success), compared with 16.0 tasks (53.33\%) for the strongest baseline. These results establish ELMS as an effective approach for converting structural evaluation from a terminal filter into actionable guidance for iterative motif scaffolding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ELMS框架，把蛋白质设计中原本只用于最终筛选的结构评估器（如AlphaFold）变成实时反馈源，用LLM代理解析失败原因、选择针对性突变操作，并结合蒙特卡洛树搜索在序列空间中智能回溯和重分配计算资源，显著提升基序支架设计的成功率。
analysis.claim: 将结构评估器嵌入闭环搜索环路，通过LLM代理解析失败模式并驱动可解释、可执行的序列编辑操作，能显著提升motif scaffolding的效率与成功率。
analysis.input: 蛋白质基序结构（PDB/geometry）、目标约束（如motif几何保真度、全局折叠性）、结构评估反馈（如pLDDT、PAE、几何偏差报告）
analysis.output: 经迭代优化的蛋白质序列（含motif锚定位置）及对应三维结构预测
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现‘评估即指导’的闭环蛋白质设计范式，实证强（Geommotif+MotifBench双基准、超20pp提升、多任务泛化），但未开源代码/模型，且仍依赖AlphaFold等外部评估器，未突破底层建模（如端到端生成或物理可微建模），属扎实的重大方法学推进，未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但明显优于多数SOTA生成工作。

papers.title: RESETTLE: Robotic Recovery through Disagreement-Triggered Retrieval and Efficient Corrective Control
papers.abstract: Reliable robotic manipulation requires timely intervention to correct emerging deviations and restore progress after execution errors. However, recovery methods based on repeated vision-language reasoning or iterative online optimization can incur substantial latency, delaying intervention. To address these challenges, we introduce RESETTLE(Robotic rEcovery through diSagrEement-Triggered reTrievaL and Efficient Corrective Control), a model-agnostic framework that provides computationally efficient recovery at the action-execution interface of frozen robot policies. RESETTLE triggers recovery when two action proposals independently sampled under identical conditioning persistently disagree. It retrieves a same-task demonstration reference using an adapted V-JEPA encoder and combines a state-servo prior with a guarded visual residual to execute one corrective action without online trajectory optimization or additional vision-language reasoning, then returns control to the base policy. Across six base policies in simulation, RESETTLE achieves up to 8.70%, 6.28%, and 6.83% absolute success-rate gains on LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World, and RoboCasa Tabletop, respectively, with further improvements on four real-world tasks using two policies. In QwenPI-based comparisons, its monitoring-and-recovery computation latency is 74.04%--93.57% lower than VoLoAgent's monitoring-and-planning latency for grasp and place tool calls. It also raises Harness VLA's LIBERO-Pro Swap success from 42% to 50%, demonstrating compatibility with high-level agentic planning. Code available at: https://github.com/JIA-Lab-research/RESETTLE

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级机器人恢复框架RESETTLE，当两个独立采样的动作持续不一致时触发恢复，用检索到的示范参考+状态伺服先验+视觉残差直接生成单步矫正动作，不依赖在线优化或VLM推理，在多个仿真和真实任务上提升成功率且延迟大幅降低。
analysis.claim: 通过动作提议间的持续分歧触发检索增强的单步矫正控制，可在冻结策略的执行接口上实现低延迟、免在线优化的鲁棒机器人恢复。
analysis.input: 当前观测（RGB图像+状态）、冻结主策略输出的动作提议、任务指令
analysis.output: 单步矫正动作（6-DoF末端位姿或关节增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX250S（仿真中）；真实实验使用Panda与UR5e

papers.title: OmniHOI: Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction from Monocular Human Video
papers.abstract: Monocular videos of human manipulation provide abundant dexterous demonstrations, yet reconstructing hand-object interaction from a single view and transferring it to robot hands remain difficult, limiting their direct use for robot execution. Prior methods either require task-specific RL training, limiting scalability, or assume clean motion-capture trajectories and thus cannot operate directly on video. We present OmniHOI, a pipeline that turns an RGB video of hand-object interaction into an interaction-faithful trajectory on dexterous hands. The key idea is to enforce physical consistency using the evidence available at each stage: image evidence during reconstruction, contact geometry during retargeting, and dynamics during physics-in-the-loop refinement. Each stage optimizes the corresponding representation directly, correcting errors before they propagate downstream or must be absorbed by a learned policy. Across 150 motion-capture trajectories transferred to each of five dexterous hands with 6 to 22 DoF, we achieve 39-89% success, compared with at most 31% for prior transfer methods. On 60 monocular video clips, we achieve 53% success, compared with 28% for the best prior video-to-robot pipeline. Its trajectories also execute on a real bimanual robot across diverse tasks.

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中重建手-物体交互轨迹，并直接迁移到5种不同构型的灵巧机器人手上，全程不依赖真实机器人数据或强化学习训练，靠分阶段物理一致性约束（图像、接触几何、动力学）实现跨形态动作迁移。
analysis.claim: 仅用单目RGB视频即可生成物理合理、可执行于多种灵巧手的高保真手-物体交互轨迹，无需任务特定RL训练、无需动捕先验、无需真实机器人数据微调。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（含人手与物体交互）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手在三维空间中的关节轨迹（含接触状态与力约束）

analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单目视频→多灵巧手→真实双臂机器人全链路上实现端到端物理可执行迁移，150条动捕+60条视频实测成功率显著超越所有已知视频驱动方法（+22–61%），且在真实bimanual机器人上完成多样化任务验证；虽未达Facet-0/IronMind级范式颠覆，但填补了‘wild video → real dexterous robot’这一关键空白，证据强度（多机体+真实执行+消融明确）已达领域Top-tier水平。
