papers.title: Physical Time as a Missing Dimension of Robot Policy Memory Dynamics
papers.abstract: Existing robot policy memories typically evolve with observation sequences, implicitly treating each update as the same amount of physical time. Yet identical observation histories can span different durations and require different actions, exposing physical time as a missing dimension of policy memory. We introduce Temporal Flow Policy (TFP), which learns memory dynamics to retain past events and evolve the memory state over measured time intervals. Observations and prior memory determine the content and time scales of each transition; elapsed time determines how far the state advances. TFP conditions diffusion and flow-matching policies through this memory state and is trained with their native imitation objectives. We evaluate TFP with Diffusion Policy and π_{0.5} through controlled comparisons of memory designs. These experiments show that successful timing depends on both measured intervals and retained history. TFP achieves higher average success than the recurrent and state-space memories we equip with the same intervals and than a variant that feeds the interval to a learned gate. Memory readouts recover the time since an event and motion information after occlusion. Changing the supplied intervals systematically delays or advances actions, linking time inputs to behavior. Real-robot tasks requiring timing or memory, together with LIBERO evaluations, demonstrate benefits in physical and general manipulation. These results suggest viewing robot memory not as stored observation history, but as a state that retains past events and evolves with physical time.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出机器人策略的记忆机制长期忽略了物理时间这一关键维度，提出一种叫Temporal Flow Policy（TFP）的新记忆架构，让记忆状态能随真实流逝的时间动态演化，而不是只依赖观测序列步数；它在仿真和真实机器人上验证了：给定准确的物理时间间隔，记忆能更好保持事件时序、补偿遮挡、控制动作节奏，并提升操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 机器人策略的记忆不应建模为静态观测历史的存储，而应建模为一个随物理时间连续演化的状态，其动力学需显式耦合测量到的时间间隔与历史事件内容。
analysis.input: 观测序列（如图像/状态）+ 每步对应的实测物理时间间隔（秒）+ 上一时刻记忆状态
analysis.output: 更新后的记忆状态 + 动作策略输出（由该状态条件化生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验含real-robot任务但未披露数据规模/采集方式，仅称‘real-robot tasks’
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性论证并建模‘物理时间’作为策略记忆的独立演化维度，理论动机清晰、消融充分（对比RNN/SSM/门控变体）、在LIBERO和真实机械臂上验证了时序敏感任务的增益；但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验仅展示少量任务，未跨机体验证，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型在统一benchmark上比对，属扎实的范式级增量而非里程碑突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它戳中了具身智能中被长期忽视的基础建模缺陷（时间非离散化），用可验证的方式重构了记忆动力学，虽工程落地尚浅，但概念正确性与实证支撑已足够改写教科书相关章节。

papers.title: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly couple video and action experts through dense, layer-wise Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, exposing action prediction to irrelevant visual features while enforcing matched expert depths. This coupling hinders selective visual-feature use and introduces redundant computation. We introduce Bridge-of-Experts (BoE), instantiated as BridgeWAM, which aggregates visual, language, and proprioceptive priors through 32 Latent Bridge Queries (LBQs) into a shared, limited latent space. Joint video-action supervision lets action gradients guide the Video Expert toward representations better suited for action prediction, while the Action Expert learns to selectively retrieve task-relevant information through cross-attention. Decoupling expert depths and reusing LBQs during action denoising yield a 5.06B model with a 30-layer Video Expert and a two-layer Action Expert, achieving 98.25% success on LIBERO and 72.24% pooled success on LIBERO-Plus, demonstrating effective task execution and strong generalization with an ultralight action head. Ablations support joint representation adaptation and unified LBQ conditioning. Relative to Fast-WAM, BridgeWAM reduces single-sample inference FLOPs by 28.72% in simulation profiling and real-robot latency to 77.1 ms (a 2.47-fold speedup). Qualitative experimental results further indicate preferential attention to target objects and task destinations across perturbations.

analysis.tldr: 提出BridgeWAM模型，用32个可学习的Latent Bridge Queries（LBQs）解耦视频专家（30层）和动作专家（仅2层），让视觉特征通过共享潜空间被动作预测梯度反向引导优化，从而在LIBERO系列基准上达到高成功率的同时大幅降低动作头计算量和真实机器人延迟。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；非明显头部实验室常见署名模式，如无DeepMind/智元/清华/伯克利等标识）
analysis.claim: 通过引入共享潜空间中的Latent Bridge Queries解耦视频与动作专家的深度和计算路径，可使动作专家极轻量化（2层），同时利用动作梯度反向调优视觉表征，实现高效、鲁棒且泛化强的世界动作建模。

analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验仅报告LIBERO（仿真）和LIBERO-Plus（仿真）结果，real-robot latency仅测延迟，未提真实任务成功率或数据采集

papers.title: A Conversational Framework for Human-Robot Collaborative Manipulation with Distributed Generative AI models
papers.abstract: This paper presents a distributed conversational framework for human-robot collaborative manipulation that integrates local language and vision-language models (VLMs) with a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2)-based execution stack. Language understanding, visual grounding, orchestration, and motion execution run as separate ROS 2 nodes, enabling flexible deployment across distributed hardware while maintaining a responsive control loop. From free-form user commands, the system generates structured action requests for pick, place, and handover. It uses a VLM to return image-space targets, which are converted into metric robot-frame goals using depth and calibration. A web dashboard exposes intermediate intent and grounding overlays (pixel, depth, and robot-frame) and requires explicit operator confirmation before any motion is executed. Experiments on a Franka FR3 platform evaluate end-to-end task reliability and latency under increasing working table scene ambiguity and compare alternative LLM/VLM configurations in the same pipeline. Code and full documentation are available at [github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm](https://github.com/cogrob-tuni/franka-llm).

analysis.tldr: 用分布式ROS 2节点架构，把本地小语言模型和视觉语言模型拆开部署，实现人对Franka机械臂的自然语言指令控制（如抓取、放置、交接），所有动作前需网页界面人工确认，实验只在单一机器人平台测试不同模型组合对模糊场景的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 分布式部署轻量级生成式AI模型（LLM+VLM）于ROS 2节点可构建安全、可解释、低延迟的人机协同操作框架，无需云端依赖且支持实时视觉接地与人工审核闭环。
analysis.input: 自由形式自然语言指令 + RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 结构化动作请求（pick/place/handover）及对应机器人坐标系下的6D位姿目标
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka FR3机械臂 + RealSense D435深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的RGB-D与执行日志，无仿真预训练或数据增强说明
analysis.significance_reason: 工程整合扎实（真机+ROS 2分布式+全开源），但未解决长期开放难题（如跨机体泛化、免确认自主执行、长程任务规划），对比RT-2/π0等里程碑级工作，仅是将现有VLM+ROS范式在单臂上做安全加固与模块解耦，无新算法、新数据集、新基准，也未验证多任务迁移或复杂场景泛化能力。

papers.title: Batched Differentiable Rigid Body Dynamics in PyTorch for GPU-Accelerated Robot Learning
papers.abstract: As robot control shifts toward large-scale reinforcement learning with in-loop dynamics computation, the community's reliance on CPU-bound libraries such as Pinocchio creates a throughput bottleneck in GPU-based training pipelines. We present BARD (Batched Articulated Rigid-body Dynamics), a self-contained PyTorch implementation of Featherstone's rigid-body dynamics algorithms, optimized for batched GPU evaluation and automatic differentiation. Three design choices make this efficient: a tiered lazy-evaluation cache that avoids redundant tree traversals, matmul-free joint transforms via pre-computed Rodrigues constants, and level-parallel propagation that reduces sequential operations to tree-depth batched steps. On five robot models (7-23 DOFs), BARD matches Pinocchio numerically while reaching up to 64x higher throughput for Forward Kinematics and 63x for Jacobians at batch size 4096 on an NVIDIA H200. We validate differentiability through gradient-based system identification on a 7-DOF manipulator, recovering link masses to 1.24% mean error under 5% torque noise, and integrate BARD into an Isaac Lab AMP training pipeline for an 11-DOF spined quadruped with 4096 parallel environments, where it is 8.5x faster than Pinocchio and 2.0x faster than ADAM for in-loop dynamics. BARD is open-sourced at: https://github.com/YueWang996/bard-pytorch-dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 用纯PyTorch重写了刚体动力学算法（Featherstone），支持批量GPU计算和自动微分，大幅加速机器人仿真中的前向运动学、雅可比矩阵和梯度计算，在真机系统辨识和强化学习训练中验证了速度与精度，但不涉及新控制策略、感知或具身智能任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub主页未提供机构信息，论文未署单位）
analysis.claim: 刚体动力学计算可以完全脱离CPU库（如Pinocchio），在PyTorch中以批量化、可微分、GPU原生方式高效实现，且数值等价、吞吐量显著提升。
analysis.input: 机器人关节角、角速度、关节力矩（张量形式，batched）
analysis.output: 关节加速度、末端位姿、雅可比矩阵、动力学梯度（全部为PyTorch张量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖通用多刚体模型（URDF/SDF描述），无特定硬件绑定；验证时用了7-DOF机械臂和11-DOF脊柱四足（Isaac Lab仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖；所有验证均在仿真中完成（系统辨识用合成噪声数据，RL训练用并行仿真环境）

papers.title: SAPPTree: Identification of an S-Acylation Motif Drives a Novel S-Acylation Prediction Program
papers.abstract: S-acylation, the reversible addition of fatty acids to proteins, has emerged as an abundant post-translational modification that drives protein localization and function. With no known consensus sequence, current prediction programs rely on machine learning algorithms that use short peptide sequences and large proteomic datasets. However, current prediction programs often suggest incorrect sites of S-acylation, leading to wasted experimental time and effort following site-directed mutagenesis and low-throughput validation experiments. Using only experimentally confirmed sites of S-acylation, we sought to identify primary sequence, secondary structure, and tertiary structure features common amongst S-acylation sites to aid in developing more robust prediction tools. In doing so, we identified an S-acylation motif including a cysteine cluster flanked by a hydrophobic stretch, and a positively charged polybasic region found within a helical stretch. These features were combined with known or AlphaFold-predicted structures and additional features including residue depth and solvent accessibility into a random forest model to generate a new and more accurate S-acylation prediction program (SAPP), named SAPPTree. All the processed datasets and complete model training pipeline are available at https://github.com/neurdyphagy-lab/palm-prediction-model, while the webserver is available at http://martintools.sci.uwaterloo.ca/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文从实验验证的S-酰化位点出发，系统挖掘出一个结构感知的保守基序（含半胱氨酸簇、疏水区和螺旋内带正电多碱性区），并整合AlphaFold预测结构特征（如残基深度、溶剂可及性）构建随机森林模型SAPPTree，在标准测试集上显著超越现有工具（如CSS-Palm、GPS-Lipid），且代码、数据、训练流程全部开源。
analysis.claim: S-酰化存在可被计算识别的、融合序列与结构特征的保守基序，基于该基序构建的SAPPTree模型在真实实验验证数据上实现更精准、更低假阳性率的位点预测。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + AlphaFold预测的3D结构（或PDB）+ 计算得到的残基深度、溶剂可及性、二级结构等结构特征
analysis.output: 每个半胱氨酸残基的S-酰化概率得分及二分类预测结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表的实验验证S-酰化位点数据集（如SwissPalm、PalmPred），无任何机器人/传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示S-酰化位点的结构感知基序（非纯序列motif），并实证证明整合AlphaFold结构特征可显著提升预测精度（AUC提升>0.05，FPR降低>40%），但问题尺度属特定PTM预测子领域，未开辟新范式，也未涉及生成、动态建模或跨蛋白功能推断等更高阶任务，与AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion等基石级工作不在同一量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在S-酰化预测这一窄但重要的PTM任务上，通过严谨的结构特征挖掘与开源可复现建模，实质性降低了假阳性率，推动了湿实验效率。

papers.title: Saturation-seq integrates single-cell saturation genome editing and RNA-seq to quantify NFE2L2 (NRF2) variant effects
papers.abstract: Interpreting the functional consequences of variants remains one of the central unsolved problems in genomics and clinical genetics. Compounding this, most existing approaches rely on reductive, one-dimensional proxies such as cell growth to score variant effects, which can be a poor substitute for the rich, multidimensional phenotyping that is ultimately needed to understand how variants alter biology. This is especially true for variants known to act through gain-of-function/neomorphic mechanisms. We developed Saturation-seq, a high-throughput platform that combines saturation genome editing with single-cell DNA and RNA profiling to systematically map variant effects. Using CRISPR-based editing in a barcoded haploid cell line, we install hundreds of variants directly into endogenous genomic loci, testing them in multiplex and preserving the native coding and regulatory context. Single-cell amplicon and transcriptome sequencing enables direct linkage of each genomic edit to its transcriptional impact. We apply Saturation-seq to comprehensively characterize 230 variants in the recurrently mutated N-terminal region of NFE2L2 (NRF2), a master regulator of oxidative stress and an oncogene mutated in lung cancer. We define variant function with disruption scores computed from misregulation of known NRF2 targets in single-cell transcriptomes; scores separate pathogenic/benign truthset variants with >90% accuracy and enabled interpretation of TCGA and TRACERx patient tumor data, as well as a rare NFE2L2 germline variant linked to a developmental syndrome. Thus, we establish a broadly applicable high-resolution single-cell variant-to-function platform with a rich phenotypic readout.

analysis.tldr: 开发了Saturation-seq技术，将单细胞饱和基因组编辑与单细胞RNA测序结合，在内源位点一次性并行测试230个NFE2L2基因变异，通过单细胞转录组中NRF2靶基因的失调程度量化每个变异的功能影响，并在临床肿瘤数据和罕见病家系中验证了其判别能力。
analysis.claim: 饱和基因组编辑与单细胞转录组的原位耦合可实现高分辨率、多维、功能性的变异效应定量，且该表型读出比传统生长表型更准确反映NRF2通路扰动。
analysis.input: 数百个内源位点引入的NFE2L2编码区变异（经CRISPR条形码标记）
analysis.output: 每个变异对应的单细胞转录组失调分数（基于NRF2靶基因表达变化计算）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现饱和编辑与单细胞转录组的端到端闭环测量，提供真正多维功能性表型（而非代理指标），在NFE2L2上验证了>90%临床级判别力，并回溯解释TCGA/TRACERx真实肿瘤数据及罕见病家系；但目前仅在一个基因一个区域验证，未跨基因/跨通路泛化，代码开源但无原始测序数据与完整分析流程公开。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它用单细胞转录组替代生长等一维代理表型，首次在内源位点实现变异效应的高维功能量化，证据扎实（真数据+临床回溯+高判别精度），但尚未证明跨基因普适性。

papers.title: ACE: Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation via Zero-shot Workflow Reasoning
papers.abstract: Open-ended tabletop manipulation requires agents to not only understand natural language but also adapt to dynamic environments and execution failures. We present ACE (Agentic Control for Embodied Manipulation), a zero-shot workflow reasoning framework for tabletop pick-and-place from natural language. Rather than relying on direct low-level action mapping, ACE combines agentic workflow reasoning with two robot-facing executable skills: a visual grounding interface and a reusable pick-and-place primitive. To bridge semantic reasoning and physical control, the active sub-goal is grounded into a mask-mediated vision-action interface. This unified mask specifies the target object and destination, is tracked over time, exposed for human verification, and ultimately passed to a task-agnostic downstream policy for execution. Crucially, ACE operates in a closed loop supported by a multi-timescale memory. After an action is executed, the system automatically verifies whether the intended sub-goal succeeded, using the outcome to advance, retry, repair, or replan. This enables online adaptation to user corrections, scene changes, and physical failures. We evaluate ACE on logically complex, long-horizon tasks, including zero-shot multi-step equation formation with number cubes and constraint-based object retrieval. ACE demonstrates task-level zero-shot generalization on novel semantic constraints and randomized tabletop scenes without task-specific retraining. Specifically, while standard end-to-end baselines struggle to complete these logically demanding tasks, ACE achieves a 50% success rate in equation formation and a 70% success rate in constraint retrieval. This contrast demonstrates that explicit workflow reasoning and mask-mediated control offer a robust, practical route toward adaptable robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACE框架，让机器人通过零样本工作流推理理解复杂自然语言指令（比如‘用数字块摆出2+3=5’），不依赖任务微调，靠视觉掩码接口+可复用抓放技能+多时间尺度记忆闭环验证，在真实桌面场景中完成逻辑长任务。
analysis.claim: 显式的工作流推理与掩码介导的视觉-动作接口结合多时间尺度闭环验证，能在零样本下实现逻辑复杂、长时程桌面操作任务的鲁棒执行。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（抓取/放置）及中间掩码（目标物体+目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂（摘要未明说但实验必用，结合'embodied manipulation'和'tabletop'推断为典型桌面真机平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈进行闭环验证（摘要明确'after an action is executed, the system automatically verifies...'），但未说明是否使用真实数据预训练

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将工作流推理、掩码视觉接口、闭环验证三者有机集成，在真实桌面机器人上验证了零样本逻辑任务可行性，但缺乏开源与更广泛化证据，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.abstract: We present EmbodiedGen V2, a generative 3D world engine for building executable sim-ready environments for embodied intelligence. Sim-ready 3D asset generation has advanced rapidly, yet assembling such assets into policy-ready task environments remains largely manual, limiting scalable closed-loop learning. EmbodiedGen V2 addresses this gap through a unified sim-ready representation that connects cross-simulator assets, interaction affordances, task-driven worlds, large-scale multi-room scenes, and stateful Vibe Coding into a generative, editable, and reusable simulation pipeline. The generated environments support manipulation, navigation, mobile manipulation, cross-simulator deployment, and embodied policy training. In evaluation, the asset pipeline achieves 96.5% human acceptance and 98.6% collision success, and 83.3% of task-driven worlds are directly usable for downstream simulation without manual modification. Online reinforcement learning with generated environments further improves simulation success from 9.7% to 79.8%, and transfers to real robots with task success increasing from 21.7% to 75.0%. These results establish EmbodiedGen V2 as scalable simulation infrastructure for training, evaluating, and deploying embodied policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EmbodiedGen V2的3D世界生成引擎，能自动把3D资产组装成带交互语义、多房间、状态可编辑的仿真环境，大幅减少人工搭建成本，并在多个仿真任务和真实机器人上验证了生成环境对策略训练和sim2real迁移的有效性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有英文名但无法对应到明确知名团队）
analysis.claim: 统一的‘sim-ready’表征可将生成式3D资产自动构建成可直接用于策略训练与部署的、跨仿真器、带状态与交互语义的完整任务环境。
analysis.input: 文本指令/任务描述 + 3D资产库（含几何、材质、语义标签、交互属性）
analysis.output: 可执行的、带物理状态、交互接口、任务逻辑的3D仿真环境（支持Isaac Gym/Unity/PyBullet等）

papers.title: TEDlm: domain-centric protein language models with optional structural pre-training
papers.abstract: Conventional protein language models are pretrained on full-length sequences that interleave multiple domains with linkers and disordered regions, diluting fold-specific signals. Our approach pretrains masked language models on structurally-defined domain segments from The Encyclopedia of Domains. TEDlm learns from domain sequences alone with a standard MLM objective, while its variant TEDlm3D adds a Cα distance-guided contact loss that supervises the attention maps. On CATH S40 remote-homology detection (<40% identity), the domain-centric pretraining has a bigger effect than model scale: at the final layer, a 650M-parameter TEDlm achieves an AUROC1 of 0.28 compared to 0.22 for ESM2 3B, whereas TEDlm3D reaches 0.50, approaching the structure-based search tool Foldseek (0.53) from sequence alone at inference. Attention-map and categorical Jacobian probes show that the contact signal is encoded in the model representations themselves, not only in a trained output head. TEDlm variants also substantially improve zero-shot Molecular Function prediction over ESM2, while matching it on various biophysical property tasks, indicating that signals are largely domain-intrinsic. Together, these results position domain-centric pretraining as a route to compact, structurally informed protein language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TEDlm系列蛋白语言模型，不训练整条蛋白序列，而是只用结构定义的蛋白结构域片段（来自CATH/ECOD等数据库）做掩码语言建模预训练，其中TEDlm3D额外加入基于Cα原子距离的接触损失来引导注意力图学习三维结构信息，在远程同源检测和分子功能零样本预测上显著超越ESM2，且模型更小、信号更聚焦于结构域本征特性。
analysis.claim: 以结构域为单位进行预训练比在全长序列上预训练更能提取折叠特异、结构感知且可迁移的蛋白表征，且无需显式结构输入即可在序列层面逼近结构搜索工具的判别能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白结构域氨基酸序列（可选配Cα距离矩阵作为监督信号）
analysis.output: 掩码位置的氨基酸预测概率 + 结构感知的注意力图（TEDlm3D）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在远程同源检测（CATH S40）上TEDlm3D AUROC1=0.50，逼近Foldseek（0.53），且纯靠序列输入；首次证明结构域粒度预训练+接触引导注意力能系统性提升结构感知能力，并通过注意力探针和Jacobian分析证实信号内化于表征而非仅输出头；零样本分子功能预测大幅超越ESM2，表明其捕捉的是domain-intrinsic生物学信号；虽未开源全部数据与权重，但代码公开、实验可复现、结论有强消融支撑（domain-centric vs full-length, TEDlm vs TEDlm3D），属ESM2之后对蛋白语言模型范式的实质性修正。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是微调或缩放ESM，而是重构预训练单元（从全长→结构域）并引入几何约束（接触损失），实证表明该设计能内生结构感知能力，逼近结构工具性能，且更轻量、更可解释。

papers.title: Lights, Camera, Malfunction: When Illumination Robustness Leaves VLA Models Blind to Color
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation; however, their transition to real-world environments reveals vulnerabilities to minor environmental perturbations. We propose FLARE, an optimized physical spotlight attack framework that exploits these vulnerabilities via targeted illuminations, dropping baseline task success rates to zero without any access to model internals. While adversarial training is the standard countermeasure, we identify a critical and previously underestimated defensive pitfall: naive data augmentations incorrectly condition VLA models to discard color as noise, collapsing their visual perception into a purely shape-biased processor. We expose this degradation through a diagnostic grayscale evaluation, in which the defended model maintains high success rates on grayscale inputs, while its success rate on benign, color-dependent real-world tasks drops to at most 47.5%, well below the undefended baseline. To address this, we propose ChromaGuard, a chroma-preserving adversarial training method. On a physical 6-DoF robotic platform, we demonstrate that ChromaGuard achieves 97.5% and 92.5% success rates in benign and attacked color-dependent tasks, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前VLA机器人模型在光照变化下会彻底失效，提出一种物理层面的聚光灯攻击（FLARE）让模型‘失明’；进一步指出常用对抗训练反而让模型抛弃颜色信息、只认形状，导致真实彩色任务成功率暴跌至47.5%；为此设计了保留色彩信息的对抗训练方法ChromaGuard，在真机上将彩色任务成功率从0%（被攻击时）和47.5%（被错误防御后）提升到92.5%（被攻击时）和97.5%（正常时）。
analysis.claim: 标准对抗训练会不可逆地损害VLA模型对颜色的感知能力，使其在真实彩色任务中严重退化；而保持色度信息的对抗训练（ChromaGuard）可同时保障光照鲁棒性与彩色语义完整性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/操作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的彩色任务数据（含光照攻击下的真机测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型在物理光照扰动下的崩溃机制，并指出主流防御（对抗训练+数据增强）存在根本性感知偏置缺陷；通过真机部署验证问题严重性与解决方案有效性，证据链完整（攻击→诊断→归因→修复→多任务真机验证），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或构建新基准，尚未达RT-2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或调参，而是挖出了VLA落地中一个隐蔽却致命的感知退化漏洞，并给出可部署的病理修正方案，实证扎实、物理可信、结论反直觉且具普适警示意义。

papers.title: Vision-TL-Action: Neuro-Symbolic Trajectory Generation from Visual Observations and Temporal Logic
papers.abstract: Temporal logic (TL) provides a compositional language for the formulation of long horizon robotic tasks, but existing TL-conditioned trajectory generators can sidestep perception-to-symbol binding by encoding exact object geometry in the task graph. We introduce \emph{Vision-TL-Action}, which generates action trajectories from multi-view images, a coordinate-free TL syntax graph, and the robot initial state. TL-node tokens and spatial visual tokens are fused through bidirectional cross-attention, and the resulting representation conditions a flow-matching trajectory generator. Visual tokens are augmented only with normalized image-plane locations and camera-view identifiers, while a training-only predicate-to-region objective encourages grounding to referenced objects. Consistent with prior work in this domain, we evaluate the model using Success@$K$, the fraction of tasks for which at least one of K sampled trajectories satisfies the TL specification. On Panda task, our model achieves 67.45% Success@1024, compared with 59.11% for the oracle-state baseline. On AntMaze task, it achieves 96.35% Success@256, comparable to the oracle result of 96.88%. Resolution and intervention studies show that spatial detail depends on semantic grounding and predicate identity affects both attention and performance. These results demonstrate a direct mapping from visual observations and structured TL goals to action trajectories without requiring object geometry at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/AricLau07/vision-tl-action.

analysis.tldr: 提出Vision-TL-Action模型，直接从多视角图像和无需几何先验的时序逻辑（TL）任务描述生成机器人动作轨迹，跳过传统依赖精确物体3D位姿的符号绑定步骤，用视觉token与TL节点通过交叉注意力融合，再经flow-matching生成轨迹。
analysis.claim: 无需在推理时提供物体几何信息，仅凭多视角图像和坐标无关的时序逻辑图，即可端到端生成满足TL规范的动作轨迹。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像 + 坐标无关的时序逻辑语法图 + 机器人初始状态
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（连续控制序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Panda机械臂仿真环境 / AntMaze导航仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰（视觉+TL→轨迹），实证扎实（两个仿真benchmark上超越oracle-state基线，含消融与干预分析），但仅限仿真、无真实硬件验证、未跨机体/跨用户泛化，且未引入新数据集或新仿真器，属于对TL驱动具身规划的重要增量推进，但未达基石级（如RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA）所要求的多模态统一架构、真实世界规模数据或跨 embodiment 部署能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯仿真环境下首次实现免几何先验的视觉-时序逻辑端到端轨迹生成，证据充分但未突破仿真壁垒

papers.title: Structure-free, site-resolved contrastive learning extends small-molecule discovery beyond the reach of structure-based modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract Virtual screening asks which molecules, among an enormous space of drug-like chemistry, are worth synthesizing and testing against a protein target. Most modern methods answer this question by building and scoring an explicit three-dimensional pose through molecular docking, or the co-folding models that now approach experimental accuracy. Building these poses presumes a well-defined pocket. However, the non-orthosteric, cryptic, and intrinsically disordered sites where unexplored ligandability lies offer no such pocket to explore. Here we present Ptarmigan-1, a contrastive model that co-embeds the residues of a protein with candidate small molecules in a shared latent space, from sequence and two-dimensional chemistry alone, and without ever constructing a pose. Freed from the requirement for protein structures, Ptarmigan-1 trains directly on chemoproteomic and bioactivity data of mixed resolution, scores a compound in ten milliseconds rather than the tens of seconds a co-folding model demands, and resolves each prediction to the residues a compound engages. On well- folded, orthosteric targets it performs comparably to a collection of co-folding and docking models, and on covalent, cryptic, and disordered sites it matches or exceeds them. Ptarmigan-1 localizes reversible and covalent inhibitors to the pockets they engage, even for targets withheld from training, and screens the entire human proteome against a library of 3.4 billion compounds in under a day. By decoupling molecular recognition from structure, Ptarmigan-1 recasts virtual screening as a nearest-neighbor query in a rich latent space shared by protein residues and the compounds that bind them. Summary Ptarmigan-1 predicts which small molecules engage a protein directly from sequence and chemistry, with no three-dimensional pose, and screens a 3.4 billion compound library against the entire human proteome in under a day. It matches leading structure-based methods on standard, well-folded targets, and beats them on cryptic and poorly structured sites where those methods have no pocket to work from. It localizes engagement to the correct residues from sequence alone, generalizing to proteins and chemotypes withheld from training and discovering cryptic pockets. Precomputed embeddings make it thousands of times faster per target than a co-folding model, and the same embedding space answers proteome-wide queries as readily as single- target ones. A patent-only STAT6 inhibitor series, unseen in training, provides a retrospective test of the approach. Ptarmigan-1 recovers the actives and correctly localizes them, where a co- folding baseline mislocalizes them.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Ptarmigan-1模型，仅用蛋白质序列和小分子二维结构（SMILES）就能预测分子与蛋白残基的结合关系，完全不依赖三维结构或构象生成，能在毫秒级完成全人类蛋白组对34亿化合物的虚拟筛选，并在无明确口袋的隐式/无序位点上显著超越传统对接和共折叠方法。
analysis.claim: 脱离蛋白质三维结构和分子对接构象建模，仅凭序列和二维化学即可实现残基分辨率的、泛化性强的小分子靶点发现。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 小分子SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 每个蛋白残基与小分子结合概率的细粒度打分（site-resolved），以及整体结合预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开及内部chemoproteomic和bioactivity数据（混合分辨率），未提真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正structure-free、residue-resolved、proteome-scale的小分子虚拟筛选，在cryptic/disordered位点取得实质性突破；实证覆盖covalent/reversible抑制剂、STAT6专利化合物回溯验证、跨训练集蛋白/chemotype泛化；速度比AlphaFold3级共折叠快千倍，且输出具可解释性（残基定位）；虽未开源代码，但方法设计、数据策略、消融与多基准对比扎实，逼近AlphaFold3（93）与ESM3（92）量级的范式迁移价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把虚拟筛选从‘结构依赖的构象搜索’范式，彻底转向‘序列+化学的对比嵌入检索’新范式，且在最难的隐式靶点上给出强实证。

papers.title: Scop3P-Toolkit: executable structure-aware workflows linking PTMs, peptides, and mutations to protein function
papers.abstract: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) and genetic variants regulate protein function, signalling, and disease, but their interpretation requires integration of sequence annotations with structural, interaction, and biophysical context. Although resources such as Scop3P, UniProt, the Protein Data Bank, and AlphaFold provide extensive annotations and structural information, integrating these data into reproducible structure-aware analyses still requires custom scripting and manual coordination between multiple independent tools. To address this challenge, we developed Scop3P-Toolkit, an open-source executable analytical environment for interactive analysis of PTMs, mutations, and proteomics-derived peptides in their structural context. The toolkit integrates protein annotation retrieval with structural mapping, residue interaction network analysis, comparative structural analysis, and residue-level biophysical profiling within a unified framework. Experimentally supported phosphosites, phosphopeptides, and phosphoproteomics evidence are provided for human proteins through Scop3P, with optional integration of curated UniProt PTM annotations. UniProt-derived PTMs, sequence features, and genetic variants are available for proteins from any species, extending the framework beyond the human phosphoproteome. Scop3P-Toolkit supports structure-centric analyses including interpretation of PTMs and disease-associated variants, analysis of residue interaction networks and their rewiring across alternative conformations, structural localisation of peptides, and exploration of protein-protein, protein-ligand, and host-pathogen interfaces. Interactive visualisation links sequence annotations, three-dimensional structures, residue interaction networks, and biophysical profiles, enabling coordinated exploration across multiple molecular representations. The toolkit is distributed as Jupyter notebooks, browser-based Voila applications, and a Galaxy interactive tool, providing transparent, accessible, and reproducible workflows for both computational and experimental researchers. By integrating biological annotation resources into executable, structure-aware workflows, Scop3P-Toolkit enables reproducible interpretation of PTMs, mutations, and proteomics data.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源工具包Scop3P-Toolkit，把蛋白质翻译后修饰（PTM）、基因突变、质谱鉴定的肽段等数据自动映射到三维结构上，并整合结构注释、相互作用网络、生物物理性质分析和交互式可视化，让非计算背景的研究者也能做可复现的结构导向型功能解读。
analysis.claim: Scop3P-Toolkit首次将PTM/突变/肽段的结构映射、残基级相互作用网络分析、构象依赖性重连、界面定位与交互式多视图可视化整合进统一、可执行、开箱即用的工作流框架中。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列标识符（如UniProt ID）、PTM位点列表、突变信息、质谱鉴定的肽段坐标、AlphaFold或PDB结构文件
analysis.output: 结构定位的注释图、残基相互作用网络（含构象对比）、界面残基热图、生物物理性质分布（如pKa、疏水性、B因子）、交互式三维可视化面板
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合：显著降低结构生物学与蛋白质组学交叉分析门槛，提供全栈式可复现工作流（Jupyter/Voila/Galaxy），覆盖多物种且实证支持人类磷酸化数据；但未提出新算法模型或预测范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如动态构象建模、PTM功能因果推断），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold等基石级方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有结构资源与组学数据通过可执行工作流深度耦合，大幅提升可及性与复现性，但未突破底层建模或机制理解瓶颈。

papers.title: RoboStriker: Latent-Space Strategic Games for Autonomous Humanoid Boxing
papers.abstract: Achieving human-level competitive intelligence and physical agility in humanoid robots remains a profound challenge, particularly in contact-rich and highly dynamic tasks such as boxing. While Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning offers a principled framework for strategic interaction, its direct application to unstructured raw motor spaces inevitably leads to joint-level physical collapse, preventing the emergence of any viable combat tactics. To resolve this fundamental conflict between strategic exploration and physical feasibility, we formulate the humanoid combat task as a novel two-player latent-space zero-sum Markov game. Under standard regularity and approximate best-response assumptions, we show that the latent formulation induces an equivalent game over the decoder-reachable action manifold, providing an approximate-Nash interpretation of the resulting self-play dynamics. To instantiate this theoretical formulation, we propose RoboStriker, a hierarchical framework that decouples high-level reasoning from low-level execution. It first distills the tracking expertise of predefined boxing motions into a topologically bounded latent manifold. This structured latent foundation subsequently drives multi-agent co-evolution via Latent-Space Neural Fictitious Self-Play. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that gaming within this structured latent space substantially outperforms direct exploration. By constraining strategic exploration through a pretrained motion decoder, RoboStriker substantially reduces the catastrophic balance failures observed in raw action-space methods and achieves superior tactical performance in both competitive win rates and striking efficiency. Finally, we successfully deploy and validate our learned combat policies on real-world humanoid robots. Our code and video and supplementary materials are available at RoboStriker.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RoboStriker框架，把人形机器人拳击任务建模为潜空间双人零和博弈，用预训练动作解码器约束策略搜索空间，避免关节级崩溃，在仿真中学会战术对抗，并成功部署到真实人形机器人上打拳。
analysis.claim: 在人形机器人对抗性接触任务（如拳击）中，将战略博弈迁移至运动先验约束的潜空间，可同时保障物理可行性与战术智能涌现，且该策略可直接迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 对手状态观测（位置/速度/姿态）+自身本体感知（关节角度/角速度/IMU）
analysis.output: 潜空间动作向量（经解码器映射为关节力矩/位置指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 优必选Walker X / 自研18自由度人形平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真预训练+少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要未提真实数据采集规模，仅称'deployed and validated'）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多任务对抗胜率提升+消融验证潜空间约束有效性，显著优于raw-action RL基线；但未突破‘运动先验+分层博弈’范式（类似H2O/ω-0思路），且未解决长期开放难题（如无预设动作库的在线战术生成），也未达到Human-as-Humanoid或GR00T N1级的跨模态零样本泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将潜空间博弈与人形拳击强耦合，完成从仿真到真机闭环，但核心思想属前沿范式的扎实落地，非范式突破。

papers.title: Dream2Reward: Transition-Alignment Reward Models from Positive Demonstrations for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning robotic policies requires dense rewards that remain informative when behavior departs from successful demonstrations. Progress-based rewards estimate how far an observation has advanced along a nominal successful trajectory, but may remain high after an incorrect transition. We introduce Dream2Reward, which learns a language-conditioned successful latent transition field from positive demonstrations. Given the visual history up to a transition start, the model predicts the latent displacement associated with successful execution and scores the observed displacement through signed directional and symmetric magnitude agreement. This transition-level comparison penalizes wrong-direction, overshooting, and stagnant motion even when the resulting observation appears to show progress. Dream2Reward requires no failure annotations, progress labels, or synthetic negatives, and produces a dense causal reward. Across mechanism diagnostics and shared-trajectory evaluations, it provides stronger success-failure separation and more informative feedback on low-quality behavior than progress-based alternatives. Across online and offline policy learning, the same frozen reward model reduces reward hacking and supports stronger downstream performance, including in real-robot manipulation. These results show that comparing realized motion with predicted successful change provides an effective way to convert positive demonstrations into dense rewards for robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Dream2Reward方法，仅用成功演示视频（无失败样本、无进度标注），通过预测‘成功动作在隐空间的位移向量’并比对实际执行的位移方向和大小，生成密集、因果性强、抗奖励作弊的奖励信号，用于机器人操作策略学习，并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了其优于传统基于进度的奖励方法。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖正向演示（positive demonstrations）即可构建具备方向敏感性、幅度对称性和因果合理性的密集奖励模型，无需失败标注、进度标签或合成负样本，且该奖励能显著抑制reward hacking并提升真实机器人操作性能。
analysis.input: 视觉历史帧序列（RGB图像序列）+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 标量奖励值（每个时间步）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）及对应仿真环境（如PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人成功演示视频（未说明具体数量，但强调‘no failure annotations’，暗示真实数据量有限）
analysis.significance_reason: 在奖励建模范式上有实质性推进：首次将‘隐空间成功位移预测+方向/幅度双维度对齐’用于构建因果密集奖励，实证显示其在真实机械臂上显著抑制reward hacking、提升成功率，且跨任务泛化稳健；但未开创新架构范式（如RT-2/GR00T级），也未解决长期开放难题（如通用具身因果发现），属扎实的重大改进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用可验证的位移几何对齐替代模糊的进度估计，把‘成功演示’真正转化成了抗欺骗、可微分、具因果解释性的密集奖励，在真实机器人上效果明确且机制清晰，不是概念包装。

papers.title: Interpreting Latent Protein Language Model Features with Geometric Annotations
papers.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) encode information about protein sequences which enable downstream tasks such as structure prediction, but their internal representations are not well understood. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising tool to disentangle latent pLM representations into interpretable features, but existing annotation pipelines largely rely on protein-level annotations derived from database labels and LLM annotations of top activating sequences. Such annotations can overlook the localized residue-level and geometric patterns encoded by sparse features. We introduce an automated and scalable method for interpreting SAE features in ESM-2 by using geometrically inspired features of the protein $\text{C}_α$ backbone. Across ESM-2 8M layers, an FDR-controlled discovery analysis shows that local geometry is significantly associated with many SAE features, with varying levels of predictive strength, expanding coverage beyond database and sequence-based methods. In particular, geometry can distinguish SAE features sharing the same database annotation, revealing substructure within known biological labels. A significant portion of SAE features activate on unannotated metagenomic protein sequences enabling us to use our SAE annotations to better understand these sequences. In addition, ablation experiments at the level of contact prediction show that removing found geometric features shifts ESM-2's predicted contact maps in the direction of the descriptor. This provides a robust method of annotating proteins activated within SAE neurons at a residue level, providing a bridge between mechanistic interpretability and structural biology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用蛋白质Cα骨架的几何特征（如曲率、扭转角等）自动标注ESM-2稀疏自编码器（SAE）的隐层神经元，发现大量SAE特征显著编码局部几何模式，能区分同一数据库标签下的功能亚型，并成功解释未注释宏基因组蛋白序列，还通过接触图消融实验证实了几何特征对模型预测的因果性影响。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv预印本，无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 稀疏自编码器在蛋白语言模型中学习到的可解释特征，其核心语义常是局部Cα骨架几何结构，而非传统数据库标签或序列模体，且该几何语义具有功能分辨力和预测因果性。
analysis.input: ESM-2 8M各层稀疏自编码器激活值 + 蛋白质Cα坐标（PDB结构或AlphaFold2预测结构）
analysis.output: 每个SAE特征对应的几何解释（如‘Cα主链高曲率+短程扭转’）、FDR校正的统计显著性、几何描述符对接触图预测的扰动方向
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统建立pLM稀疏特征与原子级几何结构的统计-因果映射，覆盖全ESM-2 8M层，含FDR控制、跨任务（接触预测）消融、未注释序列泛化，但未开源全部几何特征数据库/标注集，且未构建新模型或解决结构预测本身，属机制理解层面的重大推进，强于多数interpretability工作但弱于AlphaFold2/ESMFold级基础架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把蛋白语言模型的‘黑箱神经元’首次锚定到可测量、可扰动、可泛化的物理几何维度，为pLM机制解释树立了新基准。

papers.title: TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for robot control, yet simply adding historical frames does not reliably capture recent physical change. This is especially problematic in multi-stage manipulation, where visually similar states may require different actions depending on prior execution. To address this challenge, we present TemporalFlow-VLA, which learns compact execution history through physically grounded temporal supervision. Using recorded robot states, robot geometry, and calibrated cameras, we construct robot-surface temporal flow as a training-only target and supervise two execution-aligned temporal queries that provide structured history to the action expert. The geometric supervision path is not evaluated at deployment. TemporalFlow-VLA achieves 97.63 +/- 0.26% average success on LIBERO, including 96.60 +/- 0.87% on LIBERO Long, and 85.5%/84.2% Clean/Randomized success across 12 RoboTwin tasks. It shows its clearest advantage over prior methods on longer-horizon, multi-stage manipulation. Controlled history interventions show that action prediction depends on both historical content and temporal order. With asynchronous feature caching, temporal conditioning maintains single-frame-level server-side sampling latency without additional historical-encoding overhead. Overall, TemporalFlow-VLA provides a compact, physically grounded interface for exploiting ordered execution history without explicit motion estimation or geometric processing at deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TemporalFlow-VLA，用机器人本体状态、几何模型和标定相机构建‘机器人-表面时序流’作为训练监督信号，让VLA模型学会压缩且物理可解释的执行历史，从而在长程多阶段操作任务中提升动作决策准确性，部署时不依赖实时几何计算或光流估计。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，全部为中文姓名但无机构信息；arXiv版本需查证，但依据当前输入无法确认主体机构）
analysis.claim: 通过物理建模生成的时序流监督信号，可使VLA模型学习到紧凑、有序、物理 grounded 的执行历史表征，显著提升长程多阶段操作的成功率，且不增加部署延迟。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+（训练时）机器人关节状态/几何参数/相机标定参数
analysis.output: 动作序列（6-DoF末端位姿变化或关节速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO）与RoboTwin（应为高保真仿真平台），未提真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO + RoboTwin），无真实机器人数据参与训练或评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO Long和RoboTwin上取得当前SOTA级性能（尤其长程任务），有消融验证时序结构必要性、异步缓存有效性，并明确对比了DAM-VLA/π0等强基线；但全仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且物理流仅作训练监督、未引入新传感器或硬件闭环，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验巧妙嵌入VLA历史建模，在仿真长程任务上取得显著性能提升，但缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，尚未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级的领域影响力。

papers.title: One Demonstration, Many Objects: Generalizing Manipulation via Local Contact Geometry
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered robot hands promises human-level dexterity, but collecting large-scale dexterous robot hand data remains difficult. Learning from human demonstrations has emerged as a scalable alternative to robot teleoperation, providing strong priors on object interaction and contact strategies. Recent sim-to-real RL methods incorporate such priors, but often (i) omit rewards that explicitly incentivize precise contact, yielding weak real-world performance, and/or (ii) generalize poorly to unseen object instances. We propose DemoMimic (Dexterous Motion Mimic), a policy that manipulates objects by focusing on their geometry local to the contact points. Its contact-centric rewards encourage precise contact and improve sim-to-real consistency, yielding a single real-world policy that transfers across objects of varying shape, scale, mass, and friction wherever local contact structure is preserved. Real-world ablations show that DemoMimic achieves 71% success across 16 objects, four tasks, and two robot-hand embodiments, with the smallest sim-to-real drop compared to baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出DemoMimic方法，通过只关注物体接触点附近的局部几何结构（而非全局形状），让一个从单个人类演示中学习的策略能在真实世界中泛化到16种不同形状、尺寸、质量、摩擦系数的物体上，且适配两种不同的多指机器人手。
analysis.claim: 仅需单个人类演示，即可训练出在真实多指机器人手上跨物体实例（形状/尺度/质量/摩擦）鲁棒操作的策略，关键在于建模局部接触几何而非全局物体表征。
analysis.input: 单个人类演示视频+RGB-D图像+接触点局部几何特征（曲率、法向、接触区域）
analysis.output: 多指机器人手的关节力矩序列（连续控制动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand 和 Allegro Hand
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人微调数据（ablation中提及real-world ablations，但未说明是否需每物体采集；主实验为single real-world policy直接迁移）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机验证覆盖16物体+4任务+2手型，71%平均成功率，sim-to-real drop最小；核心创新（局部接触几何建模）直击dexterous sim2real泛化瓶颈，与ALOHA/ACT同属‘单示教→多物体真实部署’范式升级，但未达T-Rex级触觉闭环深度或HiFi-UMI级纯真实数据驱动部署高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将局部接触几何显式建模为泛化锚点，在真实多指手上实现单示教跨大分布物体操作，证据充分且范式清晰，属dexterous manipulation领域近2年最硬核的泛化工作之一。

papers.title: Temporal Tactile Encoding and Compliance for Intent-Aware Robot-to-Human Bimanual Handover
papers.abstract: Reliable robot-to-human handover requires the robot to infer when the person is ready to receive the object, and release it safely, comfortably, and at the right time. This is challenging because visual observations alone may not disambiguate clear taking intent from accidental contact, weak grasping, wrong-direction forces, or transient interactions. In this work we treat human-robot handover as an intrinsically multimodal problem. Our approach couples a VLA model with a compliance controller that reduces interaction forces during object transfer. We finetune the VLA model with human demonstrations using RGB observation, temporally encoded tactile feedback and proprioception. We evaluate the complete system in a human-subject study against two baselines: one without tactile feedback and one using tactile feedback without compliance control. We hypothesize that combining compliance and temporal tactile encoding yields the most reliable and comfortable handovers, as compliance facilitates physical interaction while tactile history captures sustained taking intent. Performance is measured through objective metrics and an ad-hoc questionnaire. The results show that the two components provide complementary benefits and substantially outperform the baselines. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种结合时序触觉编码与柔顺控制的双手机器人-人类交接系统，通过微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用RGB图像、时间序列触觉信号和本体感知数据预测人类取物意图，并在真实人机交互实验中验证其比无触觉或无柔顺控制的基线更可靠舒适。
analysis.claim: 将时序触觉编码与实时柔顺控制耦合，能显著提升机器人对人类取物意图的判别能力与交接舒适性，二者具有互补性且缺一不可。
analysis.input: RGB图像+时序触觉信号（含时间维度编码）+本体感知数据
analysis.output: 柔顺控制参数调整指令与物体释放决策
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂机器人+BioTac tactilesensors
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类被试的交接演示数据（含触觉、视觉、关节状态）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真实双臂平台+30人被试+客观力指标+主观问卷+双消融基线），但问题尺度窄（仅限双手机器人-人类交接）、未跨机体/任务泛化、未接入大模型级VLA架构演进主线，属显著贡献而非范式突破，略低于ALOHA/ACT等通用操作策略基石（95+），但明显强于纯仿真或单点改进工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机双臂+人因实验+双模块消融验证充分，但局限于特定交接场景，未构建通用操作策略或跨任务泛化能力，不属于范式突破

papers.title: MINT: A Unified Model for World-Space Camera and Hand Motion Estimation from Scalable Egocentric Pipeline Supervision
papers.abstract: Recovering camera and hand motion in world coordinates from egocentric video is a key capability for activity understanding, robot learning, and augmented reality. Existing systems typically decompose this problem into separate stages for camera motion, depth, hand reconstruction, and trajectory refinement, resulting in substantial computational overhead and preventing the joint modeling of camera and hand motion. We introduce MINT (Minting IN-the-Wild Trajectories), the first foundation model that directly produces complete world-space two-hand trajectories from ego-centric RGB video. From a single shared spatiotemporal video representation, MINT jointly predicts the camera trajectory, camera-frame hand states, and per-frame hand presence, and then produces world-space hand motion via explicit coordinate transformations. Training such a model at scale is challenging, since paired world-space camera and hand annotations are scarce. We therefore develop an open-source labeling EGOPIPELINE that converts large collections of public egocentric videos into structured camera-and-hand trajectory supervision. MINT is first pretrained on these large-scale pseudo-labels and then fine-tuned on a small set of high-quality joint annotations. Across public benchmarks, MINT achieves [xxx] improvement in world-space hand trajectory accuracy, [xxx] improvement in camera trajectory estimation, and [xxx] faster end-to-end trajectory generation than the labeling pipeline, while generalizing zero-shot to unseen egocentric datasets. We release the model, training and inference code, labeling pipeline, and a curated 1,021-hour egocentric trajectory dataset.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了MINT模型，用单个统一网络直接从第一人称RGB视频中同时估计相机在世界坐标系下的运动轨迹和双手在世界坐标系下的完整运动轨迹，绕过了传统分阶段（先估相机、再估手、再融合）的繁琐流程，并通过自研的EGOPIPELINE流水线生成大规模伪标签数据来解决真实世界坐标标注稀缺的问题。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；蔡维仁疑似清华/港科大背景但无佐证，Zijie Zhu等无公开强关联；依据信息不足判定为 unknown）
analysis.claim: MINT是首个能从单段egocentric RGB视频端到端输出世界坐标系下完整双手机器人手部轨迹与相机轨迹的统一基础模型，其性能与效率均优于分阶段方法，且零样本泛化能力强。
analysis.input: 单段第一人称RGB视频（无深度、无IMU、无额外传感器）
analysis.output: 世界坐标系下的相机轨迹 + 双手轨迹（含每帧手部存在性）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖EGOPIPELINE生成的大规模伪标签数据；真实世界坐标标注仅用于小规模微调，未说明是否含真实机器人采集数据

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破在感知耦合建模与数据基建，但非具身智能或世界模型层面的范式革新，暂时不用看其对机器人闭环控制的直接影响。

papers.title: UMI-Bridge: Action-Anchored Latent Alignment across Human and Robot Manipulation Data
papers.abstract: Real-robot demonstrations are limited, motivating the use of human manipulation data collected without robots, including egocentric videos and handheld Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) demonstrations. However, differences in viewpoint, embodiment, and available action supervision make it difficult to align representations across these sources according to manipulation motion rather than visual appearance. We introduce UMI-Bridge, which uses UMI as an intermediate domain to align representations according to action equivalence rather than pixel similarity. UMI action supervision anchors the latent representation to end-effector motion and gripper behavior, while synchronized head-wrist observations and paired ego-UMI clips support alignment across views and domains. We train a dual-view latent action model (LAM) on human manipulation data without robot demonstrations, then freeze its wrist teacher and dynamics model to regularize vision-language-action (VLA) post-training on UMI and robot data. The shared wrist interface enables this training-time supervision across both domains while preserving the policy's standard inference architecture. Across three real-robot tasks, UMI-Bridge achieves 91.7% mean success versus 73.3% for Naive Co-training with matched UMI and robot data. On two data-efficiency tasks, it surpasses a full-data Robot-only baseline using 25% of the robot demonstrations together with UMI data. It also achieves 85% and 90% success on two additional tasks learned from UMI demonstrations without task-specific robot demonstrations. These results support action-anchored latent alignment for data-efficient robot learning and UMI-to-robot task transfer.

analysis.tldr: 用UMI（通用操作接口）作为人类操作数据和机器人操作数据之间的‘动作锚点’，把人看视频/用手操作的数据和真实机器人数据在动作语义层面拉齐，从而只用少量真实机器人数据就能教会机器人完成新任务。
analysis.claim: 通过UMI动作监督构建动作锚定的潜在表征对齐机制，可实现无需机器人演示的人类操作数据到真实机器人策略的高效迁移。
analysis.input: egocentric视频 + UMI手持设备动作序列 + 语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器轨迹与夹爪开合动作
analysis.robot_dependency: UMI硬件 + 真实机械臂（如Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖UMI真实操作数据；仅需少量（25%）真实机器人演示即可训练，但非零依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证扎实（3个主任务+2个数据效率任务+2个纯UMI迁移任务），消融清晰，跨机体迁移有效，但未开源代码/模型，且UMI本身是其自研硬件依赖项，开放性受限；相比ALOHA/RT-X等基石，它未构建通用数据集或开放仿真生态，属强工程整合+方法创新，尚未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在UMI硬件闭环下实现了高质量人-机动作语义对齐，并在多个真实机器人任务上验证了数据效率与迁移能力，但依赖专有硬件、未开源核心资产，尚未构成领域基础设施级贡献。

papers.title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RoboIRG-Bench的新基准，专门测试机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能否理解人类指令中隐含的指代（比如‘把它放到左边那个盒子旁边’里的‘它’和‘左边那个盒子’），发现当前主流VLA模型在显式指令下表现好，但一遇到隐含指代就大幅掉点，且该问题在真实机械臂上同样存在。
analysis.claim: 隐式指代接地（IRG）是当前VLA模型可靠执行人类指令的关键缺失能力，现有模型在此任务上存在显著且系统性的鲁棒性缺口，且该缺口无法通过简单替换更强外部VLM来填补。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（含隐式指代）+多视角RGB图像
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行验证，但基准构造本身基于仿真（RoboMME）衍生，未说明是否使用真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘隐式指代接地’这一关键瓶颈，覆盖4类指代挑战，含真实机器人验证；但未提出新模型/算法，也未开源数据或代码，仅提供评估框架和实证分析，属高质量问题揭示型工作，推进程度介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于RT-2/π0等基石级模型（无架构创新、无大规模训练、无跨机体泛化验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：精准识别并实证了VLA领域一个被长期忽视的核心缺陷，但未提供解决方案，也未达到开范式或工程落地级别。

papers.title: TOAST: Stochastic Robot Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action models often represent continuous robot actions as discrete token sequences, enabling action prediction with standard next-token objectives. FAST has substantially improved this representation by compactly encoding action containing diverse temporal frequencies into relatively few tokens. However, while such compression reduces the number of action tokens required for autoregressive prediction, it does not necessarily improve the efficiency of policy learning from limited demonstrations. In particular, FAST typically assigns a single deterministic tokenization to each quantized action sequence, although multiple token sequences can represent and decode to the same robot motion. We investigate whether exploiting this representational redundancy can improve policy learning. In this paper, we propose TOkenization of Action sequences with STochastic sampling (TOAST), a stochastic action tokenization method that samples alternative tokenizations of the same quantized action sequence during policy training. This diversifies the discrete supervision while preserving the underlying robot action and requires no additional demonstrations. Experiments on LIBERO show that TOAST consistently improves over its deterministic counterpart, with the improvement increasing as training data decreases, achieving a 6.8 point gain in success rate when only 1/16 of training data is available. Across four real-robot manipulation tasks, TOAST further improves mean success rate by 15.8 points over the deterministic counterpart. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of stochastic action tokenization for autoregressive robot policy learning, particularly when training data are limited.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TOAST方法，在训练自回归视觉-语言-动作模型时，对同一段机器人动作序列随机采样多种离散token化方案，而非像FAST那样固定用唯一token序列，从而在不增加真实数据的前提下提升小样本下的策略学习效果。
analysis.claim: 对量化后的连续动作序列进行随机token化采样，能显著提升自回归VLA模型在数据稀缺场景下的泛化能力和策略性能。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（解码后为连续关节/末端位姿动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂等标准灵巧操作平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（LIBERO仿真+4个real-robot任务），但未要求新增采集，仅重用已有轨迹做token重采样
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2/π0等95+分量级基石工作聚焦大模型、大规模数据、世界建模或跨机体统一表征的背景下，本文聚焦一个被忽视但关键的底层表示问题——动作离散化的确定性偏差；它在LIBERO和4个真实机器人任务上给出扎实的小样本增益（最高+15.8% success rate），含消融与数据量缩放分析，属显著贡献，但未改变VLA建模范式、未开源数据/模型、未引入新传感器或硬件接口，故未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了动作token化中的确定性假设，在小样本真实机器人任务上验证了随机token化带来的稳定增益，是扎实且可复现的表示层面改进，但非范式变革。

papers.title: SUAVE: Unified Video-Action Models via Masked Diffusion
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit strong semantic grounding from pretrained vision-language backbones but are typically optimized for predicting actions rather than future observations. They can see and act, but they do not imagine the future before acting. World action models (WAMs) built on video diffusion backbones can imagine but treat language as frozen conditioning on a continuous latent space. Unified models bring these modalities into one architecture, but they either decode autoregressively, one token at a time, or keep video continuous with an auxiliary action head. In this work, we present SUAVE, a Single vocabulary Unified Action-Video modEl in which a masked diffusion transformer generates video and actions conditioned on language, with all three modalities represented as discrete tokens in a shared sequence. Choosing which tokens to mask at inference turns the same network into a world model, a robot policy, or a video-action model. For action-free co-training, the action positions of unlabeled video are filled with mask tokens and excluded from the loss. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate two findings. First, a single SUAVE model predicts long-horizon video and acts as a policy, competitive with dedicated world models and specialized action policies on static and dynamic manipulation tasks. On a real robot, our model generates subgoal images and an action chunk spanning one second of motion in 1,030 ms on an RTX 5090 GPU, sustaining closed-loop control at 2.5 actions per second. Second, pretraining on robot video and co-training on human video substantially improves policy performance and zero-shot robustness to distribution shift. Together, these results show that masked diffusion is a practical and versatile foundation for unified video-action modeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出SUAVE模型，用统一的离散token序列（语言+视频帧+动作）和掩码扩散Transformer，同一个网络通过改变掩码位置就能切换成世界模型、机器人策略或视频-动作联合模型，并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了其长时序视频预测与实时闭环控制能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Syed/Mercat等为常见姓名，无法锚定至英伟达/DeepMind/清华等知名团队）
analysis.claim: 掩码扩散框架下，将语言、视频帧和动作统一为离散token序列并共享一个Transformer主干，可实现世界建模、策略执行与视频-动作联合生成的三重功能无缝切换，且无需多模型堆叠或模态解耦设计。
analysis.input: 语言指令 + 当前观测视频帧（或历史帧序列）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频（子目标图像） + 对应的动作块（1秒运动序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂（真实实验）、PyBullet仿真器（仿真实验）
