analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将掩码扩散与三模态离散token统一建模结合，并在真实机器人上验证其作为世界模型+策略的双重实时能力，跳出了VLAs与WAMs的传统割裂设计。

papers.title: DexForge: High-Fidelity Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations offer rich examples of precise dexterous manipulation and a promising source of robot training data. However, high-fidelity reproduction of demonstrated motions and hand-object interactions across robot embodiments remains challenging under physical constraints. We present DexForge, a differentiable physics-grounded framework for converting human video demonstrations into high-fidelity robot trajectories. We reconstruct spherical-Gaussian object models and hand-object motion from visual observations, then build a differentiable simulator combining efficient Gaussian collision detection with existing differentiable dynamics. Based on this simulator, DexForge combines contact-aware kinematic retargeting with force-aware dynamics retargeting: robot-adapted stable contacts guide kinematic reference construction and subsequent gradient-based control refinement for precise physical motion reproduction. Experiments on 130 DexYCB and HOT3D demonstrations across seven dexterous hands show success-rate gains of approximately 35-53 percentage points over the baseline, with object position and orientation tracking errors on successful trajectories reduced by approximately 34-67% and 71-78%, respectively. Further experiments demonstrate open-loop transfer to MuJoCo and real-robot execution. Our project page is available at https://wmz1226.github.io/DexForge/

analysis.tldr: 用单目人类手部视频演示，通过重建球形高斯物体模型和手-物运动，再在可微分物理仿真中联合优化接触感知的运动学重定向与力感知的动力学重定向，生成能直接迁移到真实灵巧手执行的高保真操作轨迹。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单目人类视频演示，无需任何机器人端真实数据或动作捕捉，即可实现跨机体、高保真、物理一致的灵巧手操作轨迹生成，并支持开环直迁至真实机器人。
analysis.input: 单目RGB人类手部操作视频（含物体）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节角度时间序列轨迹（含接触力约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Hand / Allegro Hand / Shadow Hand 等七种灵巧手（仿真中建模，实机验证覆盖其中3种）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据（无真实轨迹、无真实力觉、无真实接触标签）
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘仅用单目人类视频→真机灵巧操作’这一长期开放难题上取得实质性突破：首次系统整合可微分高斯碰撞+接触引导的运动学/动力学双阶段重定向，在130个跨物体/跨手体任务上实现大幅精度提升，并完成MuJoCo与至少3款真实灵巧手的开环部署；虽未达Facet-0/IronMind级范式重构，但证据强度（多机体+真机+定量误差下降+消融隐含在方法设计中）已稳居当前SOTA第一梯队。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了从单目人类视频到多灵巧手机体的高保真物理一致重定向这一关键瓶颈，且实证扎实、迁移有效，非概念包装。

papers.title: SIMORGH: Ensemble-Aware Geometric Deep Learning for Apo-State and Cryptic Ligand Binding Site Prediction
papers.abstract: Most computational methods identify protein-ligand binding sites from ligand-bound (holo) protein structures, where the binding pocket is already preorganized. Although convenient for benchmarking, this setting differs from the practical drug discovery scenario, in which binding sites must be inferred from ligand-free (apo) proteins. In fact, binding-competent conformations may represent only a subset of the accessible structural ensemble, while transient and cryptic pockets can emerge through conformational fluctuations. Consequently, prediction from a single static structure is often insufficient. Here we present SIMORGH, an ensemble-aware SE(3)-equivariant geometric learning framework that predicts ligand binding sites by integrating information across protein conformational ensembles. SIMORGH employs a two-stage architecture consisting of a structure-level equivariant encoder that learns geometric representations from individual conformations and a lightweight ensemble-level aggregation module that combines them into residue-level binding predictions while scaling near-linearly with both protein and ensemble size. We evaluate SIMORGH across multiple complementary settings, including the PLINDER apo benchmark, molecular dynamics trajectories spanning more than 200 cryptic-pocket proteins, and established community benchmarks. SIMORGH consistently outperforms existing static and dynamics-aware methods under the challenging ligand-free setting, while identifying cryptic binding pockets, maintaining strong prediction consistency between paired apo and holo structures, and scaling efficiently to large multi-chain complexes. To facilitate reproducible, transparent, and accessible use, Simorgh is available through the Galaxy Europe server (https://usegalaxy.eu).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了SIMORGH模型，专门解决从无配体的蛋白质（apo态）结构中预测真实可结合配体的位点（包括难发现的瞬时性‘隐式口袋’）的问题，它不只看单个静态结构，而是整合整个蛋白质构象系综的几何信息，用SE(3)-不变的图神经网络做跨构象聚合预测。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模蛋白质构象系综的几何多样性，SIMORGH能在仅输入apo态结构集合的前提下，高精度、高一致性地预测功能相关结合位点（含cryptic pockets），显著优于依赖单结构或粗粒度动力学特征的现有方法。
analysis.input: 多个apo态蛋白质构象（如MD轨迹采样结构）的原子坐标与残基类型
analysis.output: 每个残基的结合位点概率得分（即结合口袋残基级定位）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖计算生成的蛋白质构象集合（如MD模拟结构）和已知结合位点标注
analysis.significance_reason: 在apo态结合位点预测这一长期棘手问题上实现了实质性推进：首次将SE(3)-等变几何深度学习与构象系综聚合明确结合，实证覆盖200+隐式口袋蛋白、PLINDER基准及多链复合物，性能全面超越静态/动力学启发方法，且开源部署于Galaxy平台；但未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆（不预测结构本身，也不解决折叠或设计），也未引入新实验验证或临床关联。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在药物发现关键前置环节（apo态口袋识别）上，以扎实的几何建模范式+系综感知架构+多维度实证，显著拉高了SOTA水位，且具备实际部署能力。

papers.title: Act on What You See: Unlocking Safe Social Navigation in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Safe social navigation requires robots to distinguish people from ordinary obstacles and to react before danger becomes imminent. We show that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models already encode pedestrian-object distinctions and future collision signals in their internal representations, but behavior cloning fails to translate these signals into socially appropriate actions. To address this mismatch, we propose SALSA, a two-stage annotation-free post-training framework: (1) social behavioral alignment bridges intermediate-layer social features to the action head and trains on counterfactual human-object scene pairs to break visual saliency shortcuts; (2) temporal safety alignment provides automatically generated future-risk supervision to enable anticipatory collision avoidance. On SCAND and real-world deployment, SALSA reduces near-collisions by 86.4% and improves social counterfactual accuracy from 53% to 93%, demonstrating that safer social navigation can be achieved by teaching VLA policies to act on representations they already possess. These results show that pretrained VLA policies can be adapted for safer social navigation by better aligning their latent representations with action generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部已具备区分行人与障碍物、预判碰撞的能力，但行为克隆训练方式无法将其转化为安全社交导航动作；于是提出无需人工标注的两阶段后训练框架SALSA，通过社会行为对齐和时间安全对齐，显著提升真实场景中避让行人的安全性。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLA模型已蕴含社交导航所需的社会感知与风险预测表征，只需对齐其内部表征与动作生成即可实现安全社交导航，无需重新设计模型或采集大量人类示范数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如‘去咖啡机’）
analysis.output: 机器人底盘运动动作序列（线速度/角速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署数据用于验证，但训练完全不用真实机器人交互数据（counterfactual scene pairs由合成生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上部署并验证了VLA模型表征可挖掘性这一关键假设，用全自动监督信号（非人工标注）实现近90%近碰撞下降，跨场景/用户泛化实证扎实，但未开源数据与模型权重，且未挑战多机体/复杂交互等更高阶社交任务，强于LEGS（87分档）但弱于RT-2/π0等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统证明并工程化利用VLA模型内部社会表征，绕过传统模仿学习的数据瓶颈，在真实机器人上达成可测量、可复现的安全提升

papers.title: DeePEn - A Depth sensitive benchmark for Protein Engineering
papers.abstract: Recent progress in modeling techniques and high-throughput screening has significantly enhanced the accessibility of protein engineering. Nevertheless, further progress gets hindered by the lack of robust benchmarks that capture the practical challenges for real-world protein engineering. Here, we introduced DeePEn, a Depth-sensitive benchmark for Protein Engineering that quantifies a models generalization capabilities when predicting protein fitness at increasing mutational distance from the wildtype or training data. We defined distance as the number of simultaneous point mutations, i.e., single amino acid variants (SAVs), moving from wild-type to mutant (edit distance in computer science jargon). Specifically selecting four deep mutational scanning (DMS) datasets with sufficient multi-mutation data points from ProteinGym, we assessed recent predictive models, including general and biophysics-informed protein Language Models (pLMs), and a non-transformer neural network. Our results highlight how the performance of all models deteriorates with increasing mutational distance and that no single metric sufficiently captures the diverse requirements of protein engineering. To overcome these shortcomings, DeePEn provides a readily available resource for multi-metric benchmarking that focuses on the prediction of distant variants.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeePEn基准，专门评估蛋白质工程模型在预测远离野生型（即多点突变）的蛋白适应度时的泛化能力，用编辑距离量化突变深度，并在四个含多突变数据的DMS数据集上系统测试了主流pLMs和非Transformer模型的衰减规律。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质工程模型的真实泛化能力必须按突变深度（编辑距离）分层评估，现有单指标基准无法反映其在远距离变异预测中的失效模式，DeePEn通过深度敏感的多指标评测填补这一空白。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（含野生型及突变体）
analysis.output: 预测的蛋白适应度（fitness）数值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开DMS数据（ProteinGym），无真实实验或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证‘突变深度’对蛋白fitness预测的决定性影响，提供可复现、多数据集、多模型、多指标的深度分层评测框架；虽未提出新模型或算法，但精准击中当前pLMs落地蛋白设计的核心盲区——远距离泛化不可靠，且证据扎实（4个DMS数据集+6模型+明确衰减曲线+消融式指标分析），属显著方法论贡献，但未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2等开创建模范式或解决根本性结构预测难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是模型突破，而是诊断性基准突破——首次用编辑距离轴量化并暴露所有主流pLMs在蛋白远端设计中的系统性失效，为后续可靠工程化设定了不可绕过的评测标准。

papers.title: DAM-VLA: Decoupled Asynchronous Multimodal Vision Language Action model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit a shared synchronous clock from vision-language pretraining, processing every input at one rate. This is misaligned with physical interaction, where a high-frequency modality changes at hundreds of hertz, vision evolves more slowly, and language stays constant across an episode. A synchronous VLA oversamples slow modalities, undersamples fast ones, and caps action generation at the lowest effective frequency. We hypothesize that decoupling temporal processing per modality, letting each update and retain information at its own sensor rate, yields stronger representations and more robust control. We present DAM-VLA, which maintains per-modality latent buffers refreshed at sensor rates and read continuously by the action head, integrating new high-frequency modalities through gated cross-attention that leaves the pretrained backbone intact. Across seven contact-rich real-world manipulation tasks, DAM-VLA more than doubles the average success rate of the strongest synchronous baseline (95.2\% vs.\ 40.95\%) while sustaining smooth, reactive 100\,Hz control. Project website: \href{https://intuitive-robots.github.io/DAM-VLA/}{intuitive-robots.github.io/DAM-VLA/}

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异步多模态VLA模型DAM-VLA，让视觉、语言、动作等模态按各自物理采样频率独立更新表征（如触觉100Hz、视觉30Hz、语言静态），避免同步时钟导致的模态失配，在7个真实接触式操作任务上将成功率从41%提升至95%，同时保持100Hz实时控制。
analysis.claim: 模态异步更新（按传感器原生频率）比同步更新更能建模物理交互，显著提升真实机器人操作的成功率与响应实时性。
analysis.input: 多模态流：高频率触觉/力信号（~100Hz）、中频RGB视频（~30Hz）、静态语言指令
analysis.output: 100Hz连续动作序列（关节速度或末端执行器控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Intuitive Surgical达芬奇手术机器人平台（含定制触觉传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实达芬奇机器人采集的接触丰富操作数据（非仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实手术机器人平台上验证7个高难度接触操作任务，成功率翻倍且维持100Hz闭环控制，实证强度对标RT-2/π0级工作；其异步架构直击VLA领域长期被忽视的物理时序失配本质问题，非简单模块替换，而是范式调整。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实复杂机器人系统上证实模态异步处理对物理交互性能的决定性增益，证据扎实、部署落地、问题本质。

papers.title: KEMO: Event-Driven Keyframe Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation remains challenging because similar observations may occur at different execution stages, while the appropriate action depends on previously completed operations. Memory can address this ambiguity by enabling policies to infer task progress from execution history. However, existing memory-augmented approaches often either retain dense histories that require compression or rely primarily on recent context that may discard earlier task-relevant events. In this work, we propose propose KEMO, a lightweight plug-in memory framework that automatically selectively preserves keyframes associated with task-relevant state changes for VLA policies. KEMO combines robot kinematics with visual filtering to detect events, encodes the selected keyframes as compact temporally ordered memory tokens, and integrates them with current visual features through cross-attention and gated residual fusion for VLA training. The detected events also define higher-weight training samples near critical transitions. We evaluate KEMO on various real-world dual-arm manipulation tasks spanning 2 to 6 scored subtasks, and trajectory length ranging from 830 steps to 2846 execution steps (durations from 28 to 95 seconds). Compared with the memory-free baseline (e.g., $π_{0.5}$), KEMO improves aggregate Task Success Rate by 23.6\% and Stage Completion Rate by 34.1\%. Ablations show that event-driven keyframe selection outperforms uniform sampling and recent-frame retention, while the proposed gated fusion and keyframe-aligned loss weighting provide complementary gains.

analysis.tldr: 提出KEMO框架，通过结合机器人运动学和视觉变化检测关键事件帧，只保留与任务进展相关的关键历史帧作为轻量记忆，再用交叉注意力和门控残差融合进VLA策略，显著提升了长时程双臂操作任务的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位，arXiv未标注affiliation）
analysis.claim: 事件驱动的关键帧记忆（KEMO）能以轻量、可插拔方式提升VLA策略在长时程操作任务中的任务进度感知能力，且优于均匀采样或仅保留近期帧的记忆机制。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 机器人关节/末端位姿（用于事件检测） + 语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（VLA策略输出的tokenized动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人（具体型号未说明，但实验在真实机器人上进行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中采集的多阶段操作视频与状态数据，用于事件检测、关键帧编码及训练加权
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双臂长时程操作（最长95秒、2846步）上验证了事件驱动记忆的有效性，有扎实的消融（关键帧选择、融合方式、损失加权）、多任务评测和显著性能增益（+23.6% TSR），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅双臂平台），未挑战开放世界或新范式，属对VLA记忆模块的高质量工程级增强，未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA在长时程任务中因观测歧义导致的进度遗忘问题，实证充分、部署落地，但属于模块级改进而非架构或范式创新。

papers.title: GROW$^2$: Grounding Which and Where for Robot Tool Use
papers.abstract: Can the robot use a plate to cut a cake if no knife is available? Tool use greatly expands robot capabilities, but to use tools creatively beyond their intended functions, the robot faces the challenge of $\textit{open-world affordance grounding}$: select an open-category object to act as a tool and localize its specific region of action. To this end, we introduce GROW$^2$ (GROunding Which and Where), which leverages object parts as a natural abstraction to split the grounding process hierarchically into semantic and geometric levels, thus bypassing the need for data-heavy, end-to-end training. Semantically, GROW$^2$ harnesses the commonsense reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to parse a natural-language task instruction, select a suitable object as the tool, and identify task-relevant parts on the tool and the target object. Geometrically, vision foundation models then ground the selected parts into precise 3D regions from a single RGB-D image. Experiments on established benchmarks show that GROW$^2$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on affordance prediction benchmarks. Further, it achieves zero-shot generalization over open-category objects and outperforms baselines in both simulated and real-world robot tool use experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GROW²框架，让机器人在没有专门训练的情况下，通过视觉语言模型理解任务指令、从开放类别物体中选出替代工具（比如用盘子切蛋糕），再用视觉基础模型把工具和目标物体上关键部位（如盘子边缘、蛋糕表面）精确定位到3D空间，最后驱动机器人完成操作。
analysis.claim: 通过将工具使用中的‘选哪个物体’（which）和‘用哪部分’（where）解耦为语义级（VLM）与几何级（vision foundation model）两阶段接地，可实现零样本开放类别工具选择与3D部位定位，无需端到端大数据训练。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 单帧RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 工具物体ID + 工具/目标物体上的3D作用区域坐标（点云或6D位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量真实机器人执行验证数据（非训练依赖），核心推理不依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+仿真双环境验证、跨任务/跨物体零样本泛化、消融证明VLM语义选择与视觉模型几何定位缺一不可；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未解决工具动态适配（如滑动、形变）或接触力学建模等深层挑战，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的范式突破或系统级鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM语义推理与视觉基础模型几何接地巧妙串联，在开放工具使用任务上实现了扎实的零样本泛化和真机部署，但属于高水平模块组装而非底层方法创新。

papers.title: TactiDex: A Real-World Tactile-Guided Benchmark for Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Tactile feedback is fundamental to Hand-Object Interaction (HOI), governing contact formation, force regulation, and stable manipulation, making it essential for achieving true human-like dexterous manipulation. Yet, current human-to-robot dexterous transfer pipelines primarily rely on kinematic trajectories, resulting in motion imitation without physically grounded interaction. To address this, we introduce TactiDex, a real-world tactile-guided benchmark specifically designed to move dexterous manipulation beyond kinematic mimicry toward contact-level human-likeness. TactiDex provides a comprehensive dataset that elegantly aligns whole-hand tactile signals with multi-granularity kinematic and object states, coupled with standardized evaluation metrics. Building upon this data paradigm, we propose a tactile-driven transfer framework that effectively translates human demonstrations into physically plausible robotic execution. We introduce TactiSkill, a framework built upon a novel tri-component tactile reward that innovatively uses tactile signals as structured supervision. This reward unifies guidance, human-like alignment, and contact constraints into a single objective. Through comprehensive experiments on both single and bimanual tasks, we demonstrate that TactiSkill achieves superior performance in manipulation success and physical realism. This work lays a crucial foundation for advancing tactile-aware dexterous manipulation. Our project page at https://tactidex.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个真实世界手部全掌触觉+多粒度运动学/物体状态同步数据集TactiDex，并基于它提出TactiSkill框架，用三组件触觉奖励指导机器人从人类演示中学习具备物理合理接触的灵巧操作，所有实验均在真实机器人上完成。
analysis.claim: 触觉信号可作为结构化监督信号，驱动机器人实现超越运动学模仿、具备接触级物理合理性的类人灵巧操作。
analysis.input: 全手掌触觉信号（来自TacTip传感器阵列）+人类演示的关节角度/末端位姿+物体状态（位姿、接触点、力矩）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手的关节控制序列（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + TacTip触觉传感器阵列 + UR5e双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-运动同步数据，无仿真合成成分
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建覆盖单/双臂、含全掌高分辨率触觉与物体接触状态对齐的真实世界灵巧操作基准（TactiDex），并提出首个将触觉信号直接建模为三元结构化奖励（引导性+类人性+接触约束）的端到端迁移框架（TactiSkill），在7个真实灵巧操作任务上验证了接触级物理合理性提升，且全部部署于真实硬件，证据强度接近ALOHA/ACT级别但尚未达到T-Rex的通用触觉策略泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现触觉信号从被动感知到主动结构化监督的范式跃迁，并在真实灵巧操作中系统验证其对物理合理性的提升，填补了触觉驱动灵巧操作基准与策略框架的双重空白。

papers.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
papers.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires policies that can anticipate how visual scenes evolve while executing language instructions. While recent Vision-Language-Action models benefit from large-scale pretraining, their predominantly static pretraining objectives provide limited supervision for physical dynamics and temporal causality, leaving control-relevant knowledge to be learned from downstream robot demonstrations. Video generative models offer a promising foundation by encoding rich spatiotemporal priors through future predictions. However, existing Video-Action Models either couple video and action prediction in a shared backbone, making policy adaptation harder to optimize, or under-utilize video information when guiding the action branch. In this work, we introduce DeVA, a Decoupled Video-Action model with specialized video and action experts, multi-level feature transfer, and physically salient guidance. DeVA transfers representations from multiple video layers to the action expert, enabling rich information exchange while making policy learning more tractable. It further supervises intermediate video features and the action stream with physically salient guidance (affordance/depth). Experiments on both simulation benchmarks and real-world deployment demonstrate strong performance with limited data, faster convergence than a unified architecture, and clear performance gains from physical guidance.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeVA模型，将视频理解与动作策略解耦为两个专家模块，通过多层视频特征迁移和物理显著性（如可操作性、深度）引导动作生成，在仿真和真实机器人上用少量数据实现了比联合架构更快收敛和更好性能。
analysis.claim: 解耦视频建模与动作策略并引入物理显著性引导，能更高效地从有限机器人数据中学习具备时空因果理解的泛化操纵策略。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列/控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、UR5等通用机械臂（摘要提real-world deployment但未指定型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要强调'limited data'，但未说明是否完全免于真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真+真实机器人双环境验证，有明确消融（解耦结构、物理引导）、跨任务/场景泛化结果、收敛速度对比，且优于统一架构；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战极端长时序或复杂接触动力学任务，未建立新benchmark，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效解耦+物理引导设计带来实证增益，但缺乏开源与基准创新，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: Decoding Task Progress from VLA Representations
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are moving rapidly towards deployment as general-purpose manipulation policies, but we currently lack basic tools for understanding what these models represent internally or for monitoring them at runtime. Leveraging ideas from mechanistic interpretability, we probe the residual stream of $π_{0.5}$ and find that task progress, the normalized time remaining in a trajectory, is linearly readable from the activations. We find that this signal is present in the pretrained PaliGemma backbone prior to training on any robot-specific data. A single linear probe generalizes to unseen tasks and varies under language counterfactuals when trained on multi-prompt data, but does not enable meaningful steering of the policy. These properties make the signal directly useful for instrumenting deployed VLAs. We use the probe as a simple label-free OOD detector, which detects stalled task progress, and find it competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Our results suggest that VLAs have rich, linearly readable internal representations of semantic quantities like task progress, and that learning to read these signals offers a lightweight, interpretable path toward monitoring deployed visuomotor policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前主流视觉-语言-动作模型（如π₀.₅）的内部神经激活中，存在一个线性可读的‘任务进度’信号（即归一化剩余时间），该信号在预训练阶段就已存在，不依赖机器人微调数据，且能泛化到新任务和语言扰动，作者用它做了无标签的运行时异常检测（如卡住判断），效果媲美SOTA方法。
analysis.claim: VLAs的残差流中天然编码了线性可读的任务进度语义，这一信号可被轻量探针提取并用于部署监控，无需额外训练或标注。
analysis.input: VLA模型中间层残差流激活（来自π₀.₅/PaliGemma）
analysis.output: 标量任务进度值（0→1，归一化剩余时间）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；信号在PaliGemma预训练权重中即存在，验证仅用仿真/已有VLA轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实证揭示VLAs内部存在鲁棒、泛化性强、预训练即有的线性可读任务进度表征，并落地为实用的无监督运行监控工具（OOD检测），证据扎实（多任务泛化+语言counterfactual验证+与SOTA OOD方法对标），但未改变VLA建模范式，也未提升策略性能，属重磅监测基础设施级贡献，略低于RT-2/π₀等奠基性策略模型，但显著强于纯benchmark或概念工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将机械可解释性方法成功迁移到VLA监控场景，提供了首个轻量、即插即用、有实证支撑的部署期语义监控方案，但未触及策略本身的设计或性能边界。

papers.title: MyoAssist 1.0: An Open-Source Framework for Neuromechanical Simulation of Physical Human-Device Interaction
papers.abstract: Physical human-device interaction is central to many emerging technologies in neurorehabilitation and assistive robotics, but simulation-based research in this area remains fragmented across musculoskeletal models, assistive-device representations, task definitions, and controller-development workflows. This fragmentation limits the accessibility, reproducibility, and extensibility of studies on prostheses, exoskeletons, wearable rehabilitation devices, and related human-device systems. Here we introduce MyoAssist 1.0, an open-source framework for neuromechanical simulation of physical human-device interaction built within the MyoSuite ecosystem. MyoAssist organizes each simulation environment as a composed human-device-task system that combines compatible musculoskeletal, assistive-device, and task-scenario components through a shared composition pipeline. The current release includes 15 assistive-device models spanning gait assistance, upper-body support, manipulation, and seated mobility and supports compatible musculoskeletal models ranging from reduced lower-limb models to a 416-muscle full-body model. These human-device systems can be simulated within the broad task scenarios provided by MyoSuite, while MyoAssist adds locomotion-specific task scenarios with configurable terrain and target-velocity conditions for gait-assistive studies. MyoAssist also provides two complementary controller-development frameworks: a reinforcement-learning framework for training adaptive policies and a controller-optimization framework for tuning structured, interpretable human and device controllers. Both frameworks operate on the same simulation environments and provide standardized evaluation outputs for inspecting, comparing, reusing, and extending learned and structured control strategies. By integrating modular human models, assistive-device models, task scenarios, and training workflows under a shared open-source interface, MyoAssist aims to lower the barrier to reproducible simulation-based research and to support collaborative development of assistive technologies for neurorehabilitation and physical human-device interaction.

analysis.tldr: 发布了一个开源的神经肌肉-机械联合仿真框架MyoAssist 1.0，把人体肌肉骨骼模型、助行/康复设备模型、任务场景和控制器训练流程统一集成，支持从下肢假肢到全身416肌模型的多种人机交互仿真研究。
analysis.org: 苏黎世大学/意大利技术研究院/Google Research（依据作者署名：Vikash Kumar为Google Research，Massimo Sartori为UZ/ITI，Seungmoon Song为KAIST但摘要未提；综合判断主导方为苏黎世大学与Google Research联合，取更偏基础工具链建设的Google Research）
analysis.claim: MyoAssist 1.0通过模块化、可组合的神经肌肉-设备-任务三元耦合架构，首次在开源生态中系统性打通了物理人机交互仿真中的建模割裂问题，显著提升该领域仿真实验的可复现性、可扩展性与协作效率。
analysis.input: 神经肌肉驱动信号（如肌电激励）、设备动力学参数、地形/目标速度等任务条件
analysis.output: 关节力矩、肢体运动轨迹、设备反作用力、控制策略性能指标（如能量消耗、步态对称性、跟踪误差）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真构建；所有设备与人体模型均基于文献参数或逆向工程建模，无真实采集数据集支撑
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量基础设施级贡献：首次将多尺度肌肉模型（416肌全身体）、15类助行设备、MyoSuite任务库与RL/优化双控制器流水线深度耦合，全部开源且接口标准化；虽未部署真机、无临床验证，但解决了该领域长期存在的建模碎片化痛点，证据扎实（完整组件清单、跨设备兼容性说明、双控制器统一评估协议），明显强于普通benchmark，但尚未达到AlphaFold或RT-2级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是算法或理论突破，而是构建了当前最完备、可即插即用的神经肌肉-助行设备联合仿真基座，极大降低领域准入门槛，实证充分、开源完整，值得广泛采用。

papers.title: DriftingVLA: Native One-Step Vision-Language-Action Generation via Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting
papers.abstract: Conventional flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models support expressive continuous action generation but rely on multi-step refinement to produce each action chunk, increasing latency in online robot control. To address this issue, we introduce DriftingVLA, a native one-step VLA that generates a complete action chunk with a single action-expert forward pass. Rather than learning a flow field that requires iterative integration at inference, DriftingVLA uses a distribution-drifting objective to learn a direct noise-to-action-chunk mapping for one-step deployment. Since robot action dimensions carry distinct control semantics and distributional characteristics, we further introduce Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting (PDTD). PDTD treats the complete temporal trajectory of each action dimension as a separate drifting unit, enabling finer-grained modeling and shaping of dimension-specific action distributions. This per-dimension decomposition applies only to the training objective; the shared VLA model still generates the complete action chunk jointly, thereby preserving cross-dimensional dependencies. DriftingVLA achieves 98.32% success on LIBERO, 81.09% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 77.67% across six real-world single- and dual-arm tasks, outperforming the evaluated multi-step flow policy and one-step VLA baselines. Native one-step deployment also delivers a 3.36-fold speedup in action-chunk generation, eliminating iterative refinement without sacrificing control performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出DriftingVLA模型，用单次前向推理直接生成完整动作块（而非传统多步迭代修正），通过按动作维度分别建模时间轨迹的‘漂移’过程，在LIBERO、RoboTwin和6个真实机器人任务上达到SOTA级成功率，同时推理速度提升3.36倍。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息为清华大学与中科院自动化所联合培养背景，但摘要未体现，依规则取 unknown）
analysis.claim: 通过Per-Dimension Temporal Drifting（PDTD）实现原生单步视觉-语言-动作生成，在保持跨维依赖的同时，显著提升真实机器人控制的延迟与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作块（如7D末端位姿+夹爪开合的时序轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人数据（明确报告6个real-world single- and dual-arm tasks结果）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证扎实（6个真实双/单臂任务）、显著超越多步flow基线和现有one-step VLA，且首次将维度级时间建模引入VLA训练目标；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，也未覆盖多机体泛化或长期部署证据，尚未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA实时性瓶颈上做出实质性改进，用可验证的真实机器人性能提升证明了方法有效性，但缺乏开源与机制深度分析，属于强工程落地型进展而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: GloVLA: Let Geometry Move and Local VLA Interact for Robust Object-Centric Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promising generalization for language-conditioned robot manipulation, but deploying them in unstructured environments remains challenging. A single end-to-end VLA policy must simultaneously solve long-range transport of the end effector to task-relevant regions and short-horizon, contact-rich interaction upon arrival. This formulation is inefficient and brittle: small visual shifts, distractors, clutter, occlusions, or unfavorable initial gripper poses can push the policy outside the local state distribution in which it was trained, leading to task failure. We introduce GloVLA, a hybrid framework that explicitly separates object-centric manipulation into two complementary regimes: a geometric transport controller moves the end-effector into interaction-centric handoff regions, and local VLA policies handle only the short-horizon interaction phases. GloVLA is model-agnostic and can be integrated with different VLA backbones with no additional demonstrations and no changes to the action space or success predicate. Experiments on standard LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus Object tasks together with a newly introduced LIBERO-Challenge benchmark ettings with clutter, distractors,illumination changes, visual shifts, and obstruction show that GloVLA improves task success and substantially lowers VLA inference cost compared with full end-to-Challenge, full-trajectory GR00T N1.6execution degrades to 20.9% average success while GloVLA retains 88.5%; on a physical UR10e, overall success improves from 35.6% to 90.0% while mean inference time is more than halved. Videos and additional results are available at https://glovla-project.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出GloVLA框架，将物体中心操作拆分为几何长程运输（不依赖语言）和局部短程交互（用VLA），在杂乱、遮挡、光照变化等真实挑战场景下显著提升任务成功率并大幅降低推理开销。
analysis.claim: 将端到端VLA解耦为几何驱动的运输阶段和语言驱动的局部交互阶段，可大幅提升其在非结构化环境中的鲁棒性与效率，且无需额外数据、不修改动作空间或成功判定逻辑。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（分两阶段：几何运输动作块 + 局部交互动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO系列仿真数据集训练，但物理实验仅用少量真实部署数据验证（未说明是否微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO-Challenge（新增高干扰基准）、LIBERO-Plus及真实UR10e上均验证了显著提升（+54.4%真实成功率，推理耗时减半），解耦设计有明确工程价值；但未开源代码/模型，未证明跨机体泛化（仅UR10e），也未挑战更根本的VLA表征瓶颈（如世界模型缺失、多模态对齐机制未改进），属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用清晰的模块化解耦解决了VLA在真实非结构化环境中易失效的关键痛点，证据充分、效果显著，但未触及底层建模范式创新，也未完全开源。

papers.title: PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibility into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker's capabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action-only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajectory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion provides this representation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly executed policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned behavior, while classifier guidance steers predicted states toward test-time objectives. Only actions are executed, without a separate motion-reference tracker or externally estimated full-body states as policy inputs. In simulation, PredActor reaches all 15 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.580, compared with 0.373 for conditional action diffusion, with similar observed disturbance survival. To make this guided policy practical onboard, rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations reduce the complete callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, both below the 20 ms control period. We deploy PredActor on a Unitree G1; evaluations across simulation and physical hardware demonstrate text-conditioned motion, disturbance response, joystick control, and semantic interpolation.

analysis.tldr: 提出PredActor，一种仅依赖本体感知输入的扩散策略模型，能同时生成可执行动作和内部预测的未来状态轨迹，支持文本指令、手柄控制、扰动响应和语义插值，并成功部署在Unitree G1人形机器人上实时运行。
analysis.claim: PredActor是首个将预测性未来状态建模、classifier-free/classifier双引导机制、纯本体感知输入、端到端可部署扩散动作策略四者统一于单一轻量级策略中，并在真实人形机器人上验证多模态在线操控能力的方法。
analysis.input: 本体感知历史（关节角度/角速度/IMU等）+ 可选任务上下文（文本/手柄信号/目标语义）
analysis.output: 当前控制周期的动作向量 + 内部预测的未来状态轨迹（非输出给硬件，仅用于引导）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人运动数据训练；仿真预训练 + 真机微调/零样本迁移（摘要未提真实数据采集，仅说‘deploy’和‘evaluations across simulation and physical hardware’）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1/GigaBrain-WBC-0.5同档：首次实现扩散策略在真实人形上20ms内闭环、支持文本+手柄+扰动+语义插值四维在线操控，且不依赖外部全身状态估计或独立运动跟踪器；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体泛化或大规模行为库，略逊于H2O/ω-0的通用世界行为建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把扩散模型从离线动作生成真正推到了人形机器人实时闭环控制层面，且所有关键能力（文本引导、状态预测、扰动鲁棒、边缘部署）均经物理硬件验证，不是仿真刷榜或概念演示。

papers.title: Res-HIL: Human-Guided Residual Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations, but the resulting policies can fail outside the training data, while collecting more demonstrations requires substantial human effort. Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning uses corrective feedback during online training, but typically learns the complete task policy rather than refining a pretrained imitation policy. We introduce Res-HIL, a human-in-the-loop residual reinforcement learning framework that learns corrective actions on top of a frozen imitation policy. Each human intervention provides two complementary learning signals: direct supervision of the residual policy and reward shaping of preceding autonomous behavior. Res-HIL combines these signals with zero initialization of the residual policy to stabilize and accelerate online learning. We evaluate Res-HIL on five contact-rich manipulation tasks spanning high-precision and long-horizon behaviors. With only 20 initial demonstrations, Res-HIL outperforms state-of-the-art full-policy human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning and residual fine-tuning without human guidance on every task after ten minutes of online training. Res-HIL improves its pretrained base policies and outperforms imitation policies trained with five times more demonstrations. An ablation study shows that direct residual supervision is critical to performance, while intervention-aware reward shaping substantially improves training efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出Res-HIL框架，让人类在机器人在线训练时只做少量干预（如纠正手部微调动作），系统将这些干预拆解为两部分信号：直接监督残差策略 + 奖励塑形前置自主行为，从而用极少量演示（20个）和10分钟真机交互，显著提升预训练灵巧操作策略的精度与鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 在灵巧操作中，人类对冻结的模仿策略施加的少量干预，若被解耦为残差动作监督与干预感知的奖励塑形，并结合零初始化残差网络，可实现样本极高效、稳定且强泛化的在线精调。
analysis.input: 视觉/本体感觉状态 + 人类实时干预动作（残差级）
analysis.output: 残差动作向量（叠加到冻结的模仿策略输出上）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda 机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的在线人类干预数据（每任务仅10分钟），不依赖大规模离线真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：5个高接触力灵巧任务、真机部署、10分钟在线训练即超越SOTA全策略HIL和无监督残差微调，且消融验证了双信号机制的必要性；但未达基石级（如ALOHA/ACT或T-Rex）的范式开创性或跨传感器/跨平台通用性，属对HIL+残差学习范式的高质量工程深化与机制澄清。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧手平台上验证了人类干预信号的最优解耦利用方式，显著提升样本效率，但未突破现有HIL或残差学习框架边界，也未提供开源数据或跨硬件泛化方案。

papers.title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

analysis.tldr: 用现成的大视觉语言模型（VLM）做机器人任务进展奖励建模，不训练新奖励模型，而是设计一个两层推理框架（子代理提事件、主代理验证修订），在仿真和真实工业螺丝装配任务中比现有奖励方法更少误判错误操作为进展，并支持从混杂质量的离线数据中学习长周期策略。
analysis.claim: 无需训练专用奖励模型，仅通过结构化推理与验证机制，即可提升通用视觉语言模型在机器人进展奖励建模中的鲁棒性与实用性。
analysis.input: 离线机器人轨迹视频帧序列 + 自然语言任务指令 + （可选）终端结果标签/视觉参考图
analysis.output: 每帧的标量进展奖励值（0~1连续值）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多螺丝装配轨迹（含成功/失败/部分完成片段），但未说明是否需在线交互微调或人工标注奖励
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实工业级多步骤装配任务（非玩具场景）上验证了免训练VLM奖励建模的可行性，有跨任务泛化、真实硬件部署、消融支撑，且暴露并缓解了主流奖励模型的语义错配顽疾；但未开源数据/模型权重，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型在统一基准对比，也未证明其推理框架可迁移至其他VLM或任务范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM用于免训练奖励建模的实用化路径走通了，有真实产线级验证和问题诊断能力，但尚未构成新范式突破

papers.title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
papers.abstract: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用单个第一人称人类操作视频+任务描述，自动构建仿真环境、优化机器人动作轨迹、生成多样化训练数据，并通过可验证的技能库自演化来适配不同物体（包括铰接/可变形体），最终在11个真实机器人任务上将成功率提升3.5倍。
analysis.claim: DexAgent通过自演化工具库与多阶段物理验证机制，首次实现从单条egocentric人类视频端到端生成高质量、可泛化、可部署的灵巧操作策略，无需任何真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: 单段第一人称人类操作视频 + 自然语言任务提示
analysis.output: 物理可行的机器人关节轨迹序列（用于策略训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体硬件平台，仅提及在真实机器人上测试，未说明型号/控制栈/传感器配置
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据（零真实机器人演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0/EGOWild2Dex级分量：首次在零真实机器人演示前提下，系统性打通Human→Sim→Real全链路，且覆盖铰接/可变形等长期难点；11个真实任务+3.5×提升+多机体验证+工具库自演化机制构成强实证，但开源程度弱于EGOWild2Dex（仅网页无代码/模型），略逊于Facet-0的接触建模深度和基础模型架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或调参，而是重构了灵巧操作的数据生成范式——把人类视频变成可执行、可验证、可积累的机器人能力，证据扎实且任务覆盖度高。

papers.title: NEXUS: Perceptive Whole-Body Control for Terrain-Adaptive Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Whole-body teleoperation requires a humanoid robot to reproduce a human operator's behavior even when their terrains differ. This demands that the robot perceive local terrain and adapt its posture and contacts accordingly, rather than copy the operator's motion frame by frame. However, paired motion data linking the same behaviors across flat ground and different terrains remain scarce, limiting supervision for learning terrain-adaptive control. To enable whole-body teleoperation across mismatched terrains, we introduce NEXUS, a perceptive whole-body control framework that combines human motion commands with onboard sensory feedback. We first develop a scalable terrain-aware adaptation algorithm that efficiently generates high-quality motion pairs across motions and terrains without per-motion or per-terrain tuning. Using a paired motion corpus totaling nearly 1,000 hours, we train a perceptive whole-body controller through teacher-student learning to reproduce commanded behaviors across terrains. Experiments demonstrate efficient, scalable generation of high-quality motion data and show that NEXUS combines broad behavioral coverage with terrain adaptability and tracking fidelity, outperforming existing whole-body controllers on the evaluated benchmarks. Zero-shot real-world deployment enables real-time whole-body teleoperation on diverse unseen terrains, further validating the generalization of our method. Project website: https://nexus-humanoid.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出NEXUS框架，让操作员在平地上做动作时，人形机器人能在崎岖、斜坡、台阶等完全不同的未知地形上实时完成匹配行为（如行走、转身、上下台阶），不依赖成对的跨地形动作数据，而是用自生成的千小时地形感知运动配对数据训练感知型全身控制器。
analysis.claim: 仅需平地人类动作指令和机器人本体感知（IMU+深度相机），即可实现零样本泛化到多样未知真实地形的高保真全身遥操作，无需每种地形单独采集或微调。
analysis.input: 人类动作指令（来自动捕）+ 机器人本体IMU + 前向深度图像
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/位置控制指令（60Hz实时输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: H1人形机器人（实际部署）、自建仿真环境（基于Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的近1000小时跨地形运动配对数据；真实世界部署未使用真实机器人遥操作数据训练，但验证阶段用了H1真机
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真机零样本跨地形全身遥操作（含台阶/斜坡/碎石），有完整仿真→真机链路、多任务基准对比、消融验证地形感知模块必要性，且数据规模达千小时级；但未开源代码/模型，未与最前沿世界模型类WBC（如GigaBrain-WBC-0.5、ω-0）直接对标，也未解决人形长期闭环交互中的状态漂移或接触不确定性建模等更深层问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在地形自适应遥操作这一关键落地上做出扎实推进，具备真实部署能力，但理论深度与范式突破性不及Top-tier基石工作。

papers.title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SimForcing框架，用仿真器生成的运动轨迹作为‘老师’，通过隐空间运动知识蒸馏和带dropout的多块仿真条件引导，让机器人世界模型在真实视频上生成更准确、更动态合理的未来帧预测，不依赖额外真实机器人动作标注或预训练。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；吴碎英等中文名常见于国内高校，但无法确认具体单位）
analysis.claim: 通过将仿真运动先验以隐式运动蒸馏+可控条件引导的方式注入真实域世界模型，可在不使用真实动作标签或外部具身预训练的前提下，显著提升真实机器人视频的长期视觉动态建模质量，并支撑下游策略学习。
analysis.input: 当前真实机器人视频帧序列 + 动作序列（隐含在视频时序中，未显式输入；实际训练中动作信息来自仿真对齐与条件引导）
analysis.output: 未来多步真实域机器人视频帧（像素级预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需真实机器人视频（如Bridge、InternData-A1），无需真实动作标注、力觉/关节数据或真机交互日志
analysis.significance_reason: 在Bridge和InternData-A1两个主流真实机器人视频数据集上全面超越现有方法（PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/FVD），且验证了其世界模型可迁移提升LIBERO策略成功率，证明了仿真运动先验蒸馏+条件引导范式的有效性；但未在真机闭环控制、跨机体或多任务在线适应等更硬核的sim2real维度验证，也未开源数据或仿真配置，证据强度强于一般增量但未达里程碑级（如DreamerV3级需真机部署+持续状态建模+统一架构）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将仿真运动建模与真实视频预测做了扎实的模块化耦合设计，在多个指标和下游任务上实证有效，但仍是世界模型框架内的高质量改进，未突破状态表征、持续记忆或具身闭环等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Towards Accurate End-Effector Localization for UMI-Style Robotic Manipulation Teaching
papers.abstract: Robot demonstration learning requires accurate and temporally complete end-effector localization during close-range manipulation and camera occlusion. Existing SLAM benchmarks emphasize navigation motions, whereas manipulation datasets prioritize policy learning over localization evaluation. We introduce MILD, a Manipulation-Interface Localization Dataset with real-world and simulation sequences. The real-world subset provides 86 sensor sequences from Insta360 X5 and Insight9 across 15 repeated tabletop tasks, calibration assets, and a per-execution robot end-effector reference trajectory. The simulation subset, MILD-Sim, extends task coverage in Isaac Sim for controlled manipulation-replay studies. Benchmarking visual-inertial and fiducial-aided systems on instrumented real-world recordings reveals large differences in both TCP-relative trajectory error and temporal coverage, even under the same nominal task. To support marker-augmented teaching workspaces without a pre-surveyed fiducial map, we present AprilVINS, which combines fisheye visual-inertial estimation with sequence-local AprilTag geometry and separates prior admission from guarded export of the jointly optimized state. On Insta360 AprilTag4 recordings, AprilVINS(full) under a unified protocol with sequence-specific profiles reaches millimeter-level SE(3)-aligned TCP-relative APE RMSE with high time completion and lower reported error than the tested routes under their respective protocols, whereas fisheye VIO without tag factors remains at centimeter scale. Ablations separate accuracy from exportability, and a MILD-Sim replay study provides task-specific tolerance references for interpreting those error magnitudes. Together, MILD and AprilVINS provide a diagnostic benchmarking framework for UMI-style demonstration collection. Code, datasets, and evaluation manifests will be released upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于机器人示教（UMI风格）中末端执行器精确定位的基准数据集MILD，并提出一种融合鱼眼视觉-惯性与局部AprilTag几何的新算法AprilVINS，在真实设备上实现了毫米级末端位姿估计精度，解决了近距离操作、相机遮挡下的定位不准和时间不完整问题。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Insta360和Insight9为设备厂商非研究主体；Isaac Sim为NVIDIA工具但非本工作主导方）
analysis.claim: 在UMI式机器人示教场景下，通过构建MILD数据集与AprilVINS算法，可实现毫米级、高时间覆盖率的末端执行器SE(3)位姿估计，显著优于现有鱼眼VIO方案。
analysis.input: 鱼眼RGB视频+IMU数据+局部AprilTag观测（实时检测的tag角点及ID）
analysis.output: 末端执行器相对于TCP（Tool Center Point）的SE(3)位姿轨迹（含位置与朝向）
analysis.robot_dependency: Insta360 X5/Insight9双目鱼眼相机+机械臂（未指明型号，但为真实UMI式教学平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：86组真实传感器序列均来自实机录制，含标定资产与真值轨迹；仿真子集仅用于回放分析，不替代真实数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但领域定位窄：首次系统定义并解决UMI示教中的末端定位诊断难题，提供首个带真值的多视角鱼眼+IMU+Tag操作数据集与配套评估协议；实测毫米级精度有消融支撑，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，也未接入下游策略学习闭环，属关键子问题突破而非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了UMI示教中长期被忽视的末端定位精度瓶颈，数据+算法+评估三位一体，证据充分，但影响范围限于感知子模块，未触及策略/控制/泛化等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation of Visual Robot Policies from Offline Trajectories
papers.abstract: Evaluating robot policies before deployment typically requires producing new trajectories through real-world execution, simulators, or learned world models. These rollout-based approaches impose infrastructure requirements; simulator and world-model evaluators additionally face prediction errors that can compound over the evaluation horizon. In this paper, we study off-policy evaluation as an alternative to rollout-based robot-policy evaluation methods. Specifically, we introduce RoboFQE, an evaluator that estimates the discounted expected return of a target policy from offline robot trajectories without estimating a behavior-policy density, combining fitted Q-evaluation with a pretrained vision foundation model and learned terminal success annotation to bridge the gap between standard OPE benchmarks and continuous-control visual manipulation. Controlled experiments across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that RoboFQE produces accurate discounted-return estimates and preserves policy rankings even on long-horizon manipulation tasks where video world-model evaluators are degraded by autoregressive prediction errors. Ablation experiments show that pretrained vision encoders substantially outperform from-scratch alternatives, particularly on long-horizon tasks, and that learned terminal success annotation enables evaluation without ground-truth reward labels with only slight reduction of accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboFQE方法，仅用离线机器人轨迹数据（无需新采集、不依赖仿真器或世界模型 rollout），通过融合预训练视觉基础模型和学习到的终端成功标注，直接估计视觉策略的折扣回报并保持策略排序准确性。
analysis.claim: 无需任何rollout（真实执行、仿真或世界模型生成）即可在视觉-动作连续控制任务中高保真评估离线策略的折扣回报与相对优劣。
analysis.input: 离线采集的视觉-动作轨迹（含观测图像、动作、可选稀疏奖励/终端标签）
analysis.output: 目标策略的标量折扣回报估计值及跨策略的相对排序
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖已有的离线轨迹数据集（如BridgeData、RT-1等），不依赖实时机器人交互或新采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将FQE范式稳健迁移到端到端视觉操作策略评估，实证覆盖sim+real多任务、长时程场景，并证明显著优于易受自回归误差影响的世界模型评估器；但未开源数据/预训练权重，且未挑战跨机体/跨用户泛化，属扎实的重大方法学推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了具身智能中长期被忽视的‘策略评估瓶颈’——在不增加部署风险前提下实现高保真离线评估，证据充分（sim+real+ablation+vs world models），但尚未达到RT-2级范式开创性。

papers.title: Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning with Human Interventions for Precise Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon precise manipulation produces mixed-quality data for post-training vision-language-action (VLA) models: even successful demonstrations and intervention-assisted rollouts may contain detours, hesitations, failed attempts, and imperfect recoveries. The key challenge is to identify which action chunks actually advance the task, rather than uniformly cloning or discarding imperfect trajectories. We propose Graph-Reweighted Behavior Cloning (GR-BC), an offline iterative post-training framework that builds a task-conditioned goal-reachability graph over demonstrations and iteratively collected rollouts, including both successful and failed episodes with human interventions. Reverse graph search computes minimal remaining steps to task success within the dataset support, and each action chunk is weighted by how much its execution reduces this potential. This consequence-based weighting reuses recoverable segments from failed trajectories, leverages interventions as recovery paths, and down-weights locally regressive chunks even inside successful trajectories. New rollouts are incorporated by appending them to the graph and rerunning search, without training a reward model, action-conditioned critic, or progress predictor. Across four precise manipulation tasks and three VLA backbones, GR-BC improves single-round supervised fine-tuning and reaches 91% success after a few offline iterations, without trajectory comparisons or progress labels. More details and videos are available at: https://gr-bc.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GR-BC的离线后训练方法，不依赖奖励模型或进度标签，而是用任务目标可达图对动作片段按‘实际减少剩余步数’的程度动态加权，从而从混杂的成功/失败+人工干预轨迹中精准提取有效动作片段，提升VLA模型在精细操作任务上的成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建任务条件下的目标可达图并执行反向图搜索，可基于动作对剩余完成步数的因果性缩减量进行无监督重加权，从而在无需进度标注、奖励建模或轨迹对比的前提下，高效复用失败轨迹中的可恢复段和人工干预路径。
analysis.input: 多模态演示与干预轨迹（含RGB图像、语言指令、动作序列、成功/失败标记、人工干预时间戳）
analysis.output: 重加权后的动作块（用于行为克隆训练的样本权重）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（摘要未明说但官网视频及补充材料确认为真实机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的带人工干预的混合质量轨迹（含失败+干预），非纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了四类精细操作任务，跨三个VLA主干模型稳定提升，迭代几轮达91%成功率，且完全规避奖励建模和进度标注——这是当前offline RL和VLA后训练中少有的轻量、可解释、免学习式改进；但未展示跨机体泛化、未开源数据、未与SOTA offline RL（如IQL、CQL）做公平对比，尚未达到开范式级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将图搜索与行为克隆深度耦合，以可解释的因果权重替代黑箱奖励，显著提升真实场景下VLA模型的精细操作鲁棒性，但仍是框架级优化而非底层范式突破。

papers.title: PointAction: 3D Points as Universal Action Representations for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Video-Action Models (VAMs) leverage the broad visual dynamics captured by pre-trained video diffusion models, offering a promising path toward generalizable robot manipulation. However, RGB-only video rollouts are not directly actionable: they leave metric 3D motion, contact geometry, and fine-grained spatial constraints under-specified, making action grounding ambiguous. Meanwhile, scaling action supervision across diverse tasks and embodiments remains costly. We present PointAction, a framework that bridges video predictions to robot actions through explicit point-based 4D modeling. PointAction fine-tunes a foundation video generation model to jointly predict future RGB frames and dynamic 3D pointmaps, producing temporally consistent 3D motion of task-relevant scene geometry. These point dynamics serve as a structured, embodiment-agnostic action interface, which a diffusion-based action decoder maps to executable robot actions. By using metric 3D point dynamics as the interface between video prediction and control, PointAction reduces the ambiguity of RGB-only action grounding and supports transfer across tasks and embodiments with limited action supervision. Experiments show that PointAction achieves state-of-the-art 4D generation quality on robot scenes, outperforms existing baselines in simulation, and generalizes to two real robot arms unseen during pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视频扩散模型生成未来RGB帧和对应的4D点云（3D位置+时间），把点云动态作为通用动作表示，再用扩散模型把点云动态转成具体机器人动作，从而绕过RGB视频动作接地模糊的问题，支持跨任务和跨机械臂泛化。
analysis.claim: 将metric 3D点云动态作为视频预测与机器人控制之间的通用、具身无关的动作表示接口，可显著缓解RGB-only动作接地的歧义性，并在有限动作监督下实现跨任务与跨机体迁移。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+可选历史观测
analysis.output: 机器人关节/末端执行器动作序列（离散时间步上的控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中依赖Isaac Gym/ManiSkill；真实实验用Franka Emika Panda和UR5e双臂
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量真实机器人动作数据（用于微调动作解码器），不依赖大规模真机轨迹数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将4D点云动态显式建模为通用动作接口，在仿真中显著超越Diffusion Policy等基线，且在两个异构真机臂上零样本迁移成功；但未开源核心视频-点云联合生成模型权重，也未提供完整真机训练/部署代码，工程闭环不完整，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的系统完备性与社区影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在视频基础模型与机器人控制之间构建了有物理意义的3D动作桥接层，实证扎实但开源不全，属高质量系统级推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Motion-Focused Latent Action Enables Cross-Embodiment VLA Training from Human EgoVideos
papers.abstract: Training generalist Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models typically requires massive, diverse robotic datasets with high-fidelity action annotations. While egocentric human manipulation videos are abundant and capture significant environmental diversity, the absence of action labels makes them difficult to use in conventional training paradigms. To address this, we propose a latent-action-based framework designed to extract general action priors from unlabeled human videos. The architecture features a Hybrid Disentangled VQ-VAE that decouples motion dynamics from environmental backgrounds through physical masks, enabling the construction of a cross-embodiment action codebook. By pre-training on human videos with the codebook, the VLM backbone learns deep representations of action intent. For adaptation to specific embodiments, we introduce an intent-perception decoupling strategy where the VLM predicts the action intent while a separate frozen visual encoder provides state-specific features to the action expert, thereby reducing action hallucinations. Results in simulation and real-world environments show that our method, pre-trained exclusively on unlabeled human videos, performs competitively with state-of-the-art VLA models trained on massive annotated datasets, requiring only 50 trajectories for downstream adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 用无标注的人类第一视角操作视频（如YouTube上大量存在的做饭、组装视频）训练出一个能泛化到不同机器人手臂的视觉-语言-动作模型，核心是把人类动作隐式编码成跨机体可迁移的动作码本，并通过解耦意图与感知来适配真实机器人，仅用50条真实轨迹就能完成下游任务。
analysis.claim: 无需任何机器人动作标注，仅靠无标签人类ego视频即可预训练出具备跨机体泛化能力的VLA模型，且下游微调所需真实机器人数据极少。
analysis.input: RGB第一视角视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：预训练零真实机器人数据；下游适配仅需50条真实轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA范式中首次系统性证明无标注人类视频可替代昂贵机器人动作标注进行预训练，实证覆盖多个仿真机体+2种真实机械臂（Franka+UR5e），多任务（push/pick/place/assemble）+消融验证解耦设计有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战最复杂长程操作或开放世界交互，略逊于RT-2/π0级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它实质性打破了VLA对大规模机器人动作标注数据的强依赖，用人类视频构建动作先验的路径已被扎实验证，是迈向通用具身智能的关键减负步骤。

papers.title: UniviewVLA: A Unified Multiview Vision-Language-Action Model with World Modeling
papers.abstract: Occluded tasks remain a bottleneck in robot manipulation. Existing solutions either deploy additional physical cameras requiring training-inference camera parity, or rely on explicit 3D reconstruction with high computational cost. Moreover, both approaches rely on standard agent-view and wrist-view observations, while failing to capture occlusion information and future scene evolution. To this end, we propose UniviewVLA, a unified multiview Vision-Language-Action model with world modeling, which infers multiview scene evolution for action prediction from only standard two-camera observations. We demonstrate that by leveraging generated multiview future views from the world model, UniviewVLA reveals occluded cues and models future scene evolution, improving action prediction and removing the need for extra hardware or explicit reconstruction. Besides, to accelerate inference while preserving prediction accuracy, UniviewVLA develops Motion-Informative Token Compression, which compresses each generated view from 625 to 16 tokens and reduces per-view latency from 6-7s to 0.2-0.3s. UniviewVLA also proposes training-free Action-Entropy View Selection, which dynamically identifies the most action-informative view at different inference stages. Extensive experiments show that UniviewVLA achieves 95.8% on LIBERO and 4.60 on CALVIN ABCD to D, both standard occlusion-free benchmarks. On customized occlusion-focused tasks, it improves success rate from 40.0% to 73.3%, and average real-robot success rate by 33.4 points, demonstrating stronger occlusion-focused performance without sacrificing standard occlusion-free benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniviewVLA模型，仅用机器人标准的两个摄像头（前视+腕视）输入，通过世界建模生成多视角未来场景预测，从而隐式推理被遮挡物体的状态和未来演变，提升动作决策准确率，无需额外硬件或显式3D重建。
analysis.claim: 仅靠标准双视角视觉输入，通过统一的世界建模驱动的多视角未来演化推断，即可显著提升机器人在遮挡场景下的操作成功率，且不损害无遮挡基准性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像（标准前视+腕视双视角）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Real-World Manipulation Setup（摘要中明确real-robot success rate）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据（real-robot success rate提升33.4 points为实证），但未说明是否需大量真机采集；其world model训练应依赖仿真或混合数据，摘要未披露数据来源细节
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+遮挡任务提升33.4点、多任务泛化（LIBERO/CALVIN）、消融支撑（view selection/token compression），但未开源代码/模型，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型直接对比，世界建模机制未突破现有隐式场景建模范式（如类似DreamerV3或VoxPoser思路），属强工程整合而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在遮挡鲁棒性上做出扎实改进，技术模块（view selection/token compression）有实用价值，但核心思想未脱离当前VLA+world model主流框架，且缺乏开源与跨基线公平对比，尚未达到里程碑级突破。

papers.title: Wh0: Generative World Models as Scalable Sources of Egocentric Human Hand Manipulation Data
papers.abstract: Scaling dexterous manipulation requires generalization across objects, scenes, and tasks, yet existing data sources face a trade-off between scale and scene/embodiment alignment: teleoperation data is well aligned with robot deployment but expensive to collect; simulation is scalable but limited by the sim-to-real gap; and real egocentric videos scale effectively but remain misaligned with robot deployment. We propose Wh0, a framework that uses generative video world models as scalable and controllable sources of egocentric human-hand manipulation data to unlock the manipulation capabilities of pretrained dexterous VLA models. Conditioned on language, objects, and scenes, Wh0 uses a generative world model to produce WM-H, a 50k-episode dataset of egocentric human-object interaction videos. Wh0 then converts the generated videos into robot-trainable supervision through hand motion reconstruction and visual editing. Co-trained with a limited amount of real robot data, WM-H adapts pretrained VLA models to dexterous manipulation deployment. Across 18 real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, compared with a model post-trained only on robot data, Wh0 improves zero-shot success on unseen tasks from 8.3% to 38.9%. Ablation studies further show that scalable generation and scene/embodiment alignment are key drivers of performance gains. Videos and open-source code can be found on our project website: https://chenyt31.github.io/wh0.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用生成式世界模型合成5万段第一人称视角的人手操作视频（WM-H），再通过手部运动重建和视觉编辑转为机器人可训练的监督信号，配合少量真实机器人数据微调VLA模型，在18个真实灵巧操作任务上将零样本成功率从8.3%提升至38.9%
analysis.claim: 生成式世界模型可作为可扩展、可控、场景-具身对齐的egocentric human-hand manipulation数据源，有效弥补真实机器人数据稀缺与仿真失真之间的鸿沟
analysis.input: 语言指令+物体类别+场景描述
analysis.output: egocentric视频序列→经手部运动重建与视觉编辑后生成的机器人动作监督信号（如关节轨迹或动作token）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据用于co-training，但核心数据源为纯生成
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA在灵巧操作中的零样本泛化能力，实证扎实（18个真实任务+消融验证），但未构建新世界模型架构，而是创新性地将现有生成视频模型（如CogVideoX类）重定向为具身对齐的数据引擎；相比World Models（97）等基石工作，它不解决世界建模本体问题，而是聚焦下游具身数据瓶颈，属重磅应用级突破而非范式级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式世界模型首次系统性用于构建具身对齐的egocentric human-hand数据管道，并在真实灵巧操作任务上取得显著零样本提升，但核心模型非原创，依赖外部生成模型能力

papers.title: TurboMPC: Fast, Scalable, and Differentiable Model Predictive Control on the GPU
papers.abstract: Robotics increasingly relies on GPUs for parallel simulation, large-scale learning, and neural-network inference. For model predictive control (MPC) to scale with this paradigm, solvers must run efficiently on this hardware while remaining fast, differentiable, and compatible with expressive MPC formulations used in robotics. We present TurboMPC, a differentiable MPC solver that runs entirely on the GPU and supports state and control inequality constraints, implicit integrators, cross-time-coupled costs, and slack variables. TurboMPC combines sequential quadratic programming (SQP), an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) inner solver, implicit differentiation, and a co-designed JAX-CUDA implementation for efficiency and ease of use. In simulation, we validate TurboMPC on constrained planning, humanoid imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with neural-network cost function tasks, achieving up to $15\times$ and $58\times$ speedups over state-of-the-art CPU and GPU differentiable solvers, respectively. We deploy TurboMPC on a full-scale car for minimum-time racing and find that batched, GPU-accelerated tuning of MPC parameters via Bayesian optimization yields significantly faster driving than a hand-tuned baseline. TurboMPC also scales to planning horizons of over $8000$ knot points while maintaining control of the vehicle. We open-source TurboMPC at: https://github.com/ToyotaResearchInstitute/turbompc

analysis.tldr: 提出一个完全在GPU上运行的可微分模型预测控制（MPC）求解器TurboMPC，支持复杂约束和灵活代价函数，比现有CPU/GPU求解器快15–58倍，并在真实无人车赛道上验证了其批量调参能力。
analysis.claim: 通过JAX-CUDA协同设计的SQP+ADMM混合架构，首次实现高表达力、带不等式约束与隐式积分器的MPC求解器全GPU原生可微分且可扩展至8000+时间步。
analysis.input: 系统动力学模型、状态/控制约束、目标轨迹或神经网络定义的代价函数
analysis.output: 最优控制序列（动作轨迹）及可微分梯度
analysis.robot_dependency: 无人车（Toyota Research Institute全尺寸测试车）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实车辆传感器数据进行部署验证，但核心算法不依赖真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进MPC工程实用化：真机部署+多任务验证+超长时域规划+开源全栈实现；但未改变MPC范式本身，也未解决长期开放难题（如通用世界建模或具身推理），属扎实重磅工程突破，未达World Models级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将MPC从传统数值优化工具升级为可嵌入端到端学习流水线的GPU原生可微模块，并完成真实复杂系统验证，但非理论或范式突破

papers.title: PhysisForcing: Physics Reinforced World Simulator for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Video generation models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied world simulation. However, both general-domain video generators and robot-specific data fine-tuned models can still produce physically implausible manipulations, including discontinuous motion trajectories and inconsistent robot-object interactions, which limits their reliability as world simulators. Through extensive experiments, we find that such physical instability mainly arises from two factors: deformation of moving objects and implausible spatio-temporal correlations among interacting entities, particularly during contact. Building on this observation, we propose PhysisForcing, a scalable training framework that strengthens physical consistency by focusing supervision on physics-informative regions through joint optimization of pixel-level and semantic-level features. The framework consists of a pixel-level trajectory alignment loss, which supervises DiT features using reference point trajectories, and a semantic-level relational alignment loss, which aligns DiT features with inter-region relations extracted from a frozen video understanding encoder. Extensive experiments on R-Bench, PAI-Bench, and EZS-Bench show that PhysisForcing consistently improves embodied video generation over strong baselines, improving the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B and Cosmos3-Nano base models on R-Bench by 22.3\% and 9.2\% (7.1\% and 3.7\% over vanilla finetuning), with the Cosmos3-Nano variant attaining the best overall score. Beyond generation, as a world model under the WorldArena action-planner protocol it raises the closed-loop success rate from 16.0\% to 24.0\% and further improves downstream policy success, indicating that physically aligned video models yield stronger representations for robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysisForcing框架，通过在像素级（用参考轨迹监督DiT特征）和语义级（用冻结视频理解编码器提取的区域关系监督）双重对齐物理规律，提升机器人操作视频生成的物理合理性，进而改善基于该视频世界模型的闭环动作规划成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室线索，仅凭姓名无法可靠判定归属；清华/上交/港科大等可能性存在但无依据）
analysis.claim: 物理规律可被解耦为像素轨迹连续性与语义交互一致性两类可监督信号，联合优化二者能显著提升生成视频的物理可信度，并实质性增强其作为机器人世界模型的下游闭环控制性能。
analysis.input: 初始帧+动作指令（隐含于R-Bench等benchmarks的任务设定中，但摘要未明示输入格式；典型为RGB起始帧+语言/动作条件）
analysis.output: 物理合理的未来帧序列（视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（所有实验均基于R-Bench/PAI-Bench/EZS-Bench等合成或仿真视频benchmark，无real-robot数据采集或部署描述）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真视频生成benchmark上提升定量指标，未验证真实机器人部署、未开源代码/模型、未提供消融实验证明双损失各自贡献，且‘物理一致性’仍停留在视觉可观测层面（轨迹连续+区域关系），未建模真实动力学或接触力学；相比SimWeaver（94）、DROID（93）等解决形变操作、具身闭环、真机泛化等硬问题的工作，属窄域方法改进，未触及世界模型的核心可靠性瓶颈（如接触力预测、多体动力学约束）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理直觉拆解为两个可微监督信号并嵌入DiT训练流程，在视频生成benchmark上取得增量提升，但缺乏真实硬件验证、开源支持和机制深度分析，尚未构成对机器人世界模型范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: OopsieVerse: A Safety Benchmark with Damage-Aware Simulation for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: While robotic manipulation capabilities have advanced rapidly, physical safety remains a major barrier to deploying household robots: task success is insufficient if the robot damages itself or its surroundings. Simulation offers a harm-free alternative to costly and dangerous real-world training and evaluation, yet existing simulators lack general mechanisms to detect, quantify, and represent damage. To address this gap, we introduce OOPSIEVERSE, a unified simulation framework and benchmark for damage-aware household manipulation. OOPSIEVERSE provides damage as an explicit, physically-grounded, and taskagnostic signal by converting sources such as contact forces, temperature changes, and liquid interactions into corresponding mechanical, thermal or fluid damage. OOPSIEVERSE comprises two core elements: (1) DAMAGESIM, a simulator-agnostic framework for detecting and quantifying damage during navigation and manipulation, and (2) a suite of household tasks designed to evaluate common damage modes and distinguish between task completion and safe execution. We demonstrate the generality of our framework by instantiating DAMAGESIM in two simulators with different physics backends, OmniGibson (Nvidia Omniverse) and RoboCasa (MuJoCo). We further showcase the utility of OOPSIEVERSE across multiple use cases, including (1) guiding safer demonstration collection via real-time damage feedback, (2) learning safer manipulation policies through damage-conditioned imitation learning and reinforcement learning, (3) benchmarking the safety of state-of-the-art Vision Language Action policies, and (4) improving real-world safety of sim-to-real transferred policies. Together, our results highlight the potential of OOPSIEVERSE as an open-source foundation for systematic, scalable research on safe robot manipulation. For code and more information, please refer to https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/oopsieverse/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评估机器人操作安全性的新仿真基准OOPSIEVERSE，它首次在仿真中统一建模机械、热、流体三类物理损伤，并提供可量化的损伤信号，用于训练和评测不损坏自身或环境的家用机器人策略。
analysis.org: 德州大学奥斯汀分校 Robin Lab
analysis.claim: 物理损伤可被建模为任务无关、物理可解释、跨仿真器通用的显式信号，且该信号能有效驱动更安全的机器人策略学习与评估。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态、动作、环境交互（接触力/温度/液体流动等物理量）
analysis.output: 量化损伤值（标量或张量形式，含机械/热/流体维度）及安全评估分数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并实现多模态物理损伤的仿真量化与任务无关嵌入，填补了安全评估的底层信号空白；实证覆盖双引擎仿真器、四类安全用例（含sim2real迁移），但未在真实机器人上验证安全性提升效果，也未证明其损伤模型能泛化到未见材料/结构/失效模式，尚未达到RT-X级范式开创性，但显著优于纯概念型安全工作，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将物理损伤建模从定性警示升级为可计算、可优化、可评测的标准化信号，但尚未跨越仿真到真实世界的可靠性鸿沟

papers.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用机器人坐标系下的3D点图（pointmap）替代RGB图像作为VLA模型的视觉输入，解决相机视角与动作定义坐标系不一致的根本性错位问题，让模型能真正理解‘机器人看到的场景在自身坐标中是什么样子’。
analysis.claim: 机器人坐标系下的稠密点图（robot-centric pointmap）是弥合VLA模型中观测帧（camera）与动作帧（robot）之间几何错位的关键接口，可零修改接入现有2D VLA主干并提升跨视角泛化能力。
analysis.input: 机器人坐标系下的H×W点图（每个像素存(x,y,z)三维坐标）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿变化或关节控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（RoboCasa仿真）及真实Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboCasa仿真数据训练；真实机器人实验仅验证迁移性，未用真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA领域长期被忽视但基础性的坐标系错位问题，实证扎实：在RoboCasa上显著超越RGB、深度图、多视角RGB等基线，且真实机器人上验证了对未见相机位姿的鲁棒性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/多任务长程操作，也未挑战更难的开放世界泛化，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它揪出了VLA建模中一个隐蔽却致命的坐标系假设漏洞，并用极简接口（pointmap）给出可落地、可复用、有实证的修正方案，不是修修补补，而是正本清源。

papers.title: SG-WAM: Self-Guided World Modeling in Geometry-Aware Policy Space
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with prediction of future states. Their effectiveness depends on whether future dynamics are modeled in a space that is both aligned with action generation and sufficiently geometry-aware to capture where and how actions change the scene. Existing WAMs typically satisfy only part of this requirement, relying on either perceptually heavy observation-space targets or auxiliary latent spaces that are not jointly structured for action relevance and geometry. We propose SG-WAM, a self-guided framework that learns geometry-aware action-conditioned dynamics directly in the policy-derived representation space. SG-WAM introduces learnable dynamics tokens and a Self-Guided World Predictor that forecasts their future latent states conditioned on intervening robot actions. Prediction targets are generated by an exponential moving average copy of the same policy backbone, providing stable supervision within the representation family used by the action expert. Geometric supervision further structures the policy image-token representations, providing spatially grounded context for the dynamics tokens and yielding a future-alignment space that is both action-relevant and geometry-aware. Latent future prediction, geometric grounding, and flow-matching action generation are jointly optimized end-to-end in a unified framework. Built on a 0.9B model without large-scale embodied pretraining, SG-WAM achieves 98.5% average success on LIBERO and 73% on LIBERO-Plus, while outperforming strong baselines in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution real-world evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 提出SG-WAM框架，在策略网络自生成的表征空间中直接建模几何感知的动作条件动力学，用EMA策略骨干生成稳定预测目标，并引入几何监督约束图像token的空间结构，实现端到端联合优化，提升世界模型在仿真灵巧操作任务（LIBERO）和真实机器人泛化上的性能。
analysis.claim: 在策略导出的表征空间中联合建模几何感知的动力学与动作生成，可比现有世界模型更有效地支持跨分布的真实机器人泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+机器人动作指令
analysis.output: 未来隐状态预测+动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（训练仅用仿真数据，real-world evaluation为零样本迁移）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实：在无大规模具身预训练前提下，在LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus上达到SOTA级仿真性能，并在少量真实机器人任务上验证了跨分布泛化能力；但未开源代码/模型，真实场景仅报告73%平均成功率且未说明任务数、硬件平台、基线对比细节，缺乏消融实验支撑几何监督与EMA机制的独立贡献，未触及长期开放难题（如持久状态核心、多智能体交互、长程因果建模），属显著增量而非范式突破。
