analysis.significance_reason: 达到ManiSkill3（87）与Isaac Lab（88）同档：首次在统一框架下系统性覆盖人形全身loco-manipulation全谱系任务（60 task × 50 scene × 1000+ objects），并实证sim2real零样本迁移（非微调），但未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高于Isaac Lab/ManiSkill3；弱于DROID/ALOHA（需真实数据闭环）和Open X-Embodiment（跨平台真实机器人数据集）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法或新范式，而是首个将高保真接触动力学、光栅化渲染、大规模任务/场景/物体、双模数据生成、主流VLA/WAM策略评测全部集成并实证sim2real零样本迁移的人形仿真基座，显著降低人形策略研发门槛。

papers.title: LIBERO-Occ: Evaluating and Improving Vision-Language-Action Models under Scene-Induced Occlusion via Viewpoint Imagination
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, but most evaluations assume that task-relevant objects are fully visible. This assumption often fails in realistic settings, where occlusion makes manipulation partially observable. In this paper, we study \textit{scene-induced occlusion} as a fundamental challenge for VLA models and introduce \textbf{LIBERO-Occ}, an occlusion-oriented extension of LIBERO. Experiments show that state-of-the-art VLAs suffer substantial performance degradation under occlusion. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Viewpoint Imagination (VIM)}, which generates a complementary view from an occluded primary observation and conditions action prediction on both observed and imagined evidence. VIM improves robustness across task suites, occlusion types, and severity levels without requiring additional cameras at deployment time, suggesting that viewpoint imagination is an promising mechanism for perception completion in partially observable manipulation. Our benchmark and corresponding code are available at: \href{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}{https://github.com/litsh/Libero-Occ}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专门测试视觉-语言-动作模型在场景遮挡（如物体被其他物体挡住）下鲁棒性的新基准LIBERO-Occ，并设计‘视角想象’（VIM）方法，通过单视角输入生成互补视角来缓解遮挡导致的动作预测失败，所有实验均在仿真中完成，未用真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 视角想象（VIM）能有效提升VLA模型在场景诱导遮挡下的动作泛化能力，且无需额外硬件部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前视角观测
analysis.output: 动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO仿真环境），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个系统性评估VLA模型遮挡鲁棒性的基准LIBERO-Occ，实证充分（多任务/多遮挡类型/多严重度），VIM方法有消融和跨基准验证，但仍是纯仿真、未触达真实感知-动作闭环瓶颈，未挑战具身交互本质难点（如动态遮挡、触觉补偿、实时重规划），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了VLA模型在部分可观测场景下的评测与方法空白，但限于仿真，尚未进入真实具身挑战层级。

papers.title: Controlling metal-carbonate phase, form, and function through de novo protein design
papers.abstract: Biomineralization enables living systems to construct hybrid materials by controlling the location, orientation, and polymorph of inorganic crystals with proteins and other biomolecules. Despite decades of study, the molecular principles underlying these processes remain difficult to harness in engineered materials, in part because native biomineralization proteins are often intrinsically disordered, heterogeneous, or insoluble. Here we show that de novo designed protein interfaces can be assembled into reconfigurable two-dimensional arrays which template calcite nanocrystals. By fine-tuning RFdiffusion2 on repeat protein scaffolds, we further enable the design of protein architectures which selectively form aragonite, a metastable polymorph of calcium carbonate, in nucleation conditions that otherwise result in a mixture of phases. Extending beyond inorganics found in biological systems, we show that lattice-matched protein designs template cobalt carbonate formation: a flat helical repeat protein interface promotes unconfined growth, whereas soluble D3 cage assemblies yield more homogenous cobalt carbonate nanocrystals confined to the interior of the cage. These protein-cage cobalt carbonate hybrid materials function as electrocatalysts for alkaline water splitting. Our results demonstrate the potential of deep learning-based methods to unlock the structural and functional activity of protein-mineral composites.

analysis.tldr: 用AI设计全新蛋白质结构，精准控制碳酸钙（方解石/文石）和碳酸钴的结晶相、形貌与尺寸，并将设计出的蛋白笼-碳酸钴复合物用作高效碱性水电解催化剂。
analysis.claim: 基于RFdiffusion2的从头蛋白质设计可理性编程金属碳酸盐的晶相、形貌与功能，突破天然无序蛋白在人工矿化中的不可控瓶颈。
analysis.input: 目标晶体晶格参数+对称性约束+功能需求（如催化活性位点暴露）
analysis.output: 可合成的、具有特定重复结构的二维蛋白阵列或D3对称笼状蛋白
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现深度学习驱动的、跨材料（CaCO₃→CoCO₃）的晶相选择性矿化设计，且验证了功能输出（电催化），实验覆盖XRD/TEM/电化学多维度表征，但未开源全部蛋白序列与训练数据，复现门槛高于RFdiffusion原论文；显著强于普通计算材料学工作，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆（无通用模型/未解决折叠-功能映射根本难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是调参刷榜，而是用生成式蛋白设计直接操控无机晶体相变与功能集成，实证扎实、材料体系拓展合理、功能闭环完整。

papers.title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
papers.abstract: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出Kairos世界模型栈，试图统一建模物理世界的感知、预测与生成，通过跨具身数据课程预训练、混合线性时序注意力架构（兼顾局部/中程/长期记忆）和部署感知系统设计，在多个世界建模与长时序任务上刷出SOTA，但未公开代码、模型或数据，也未在真实机器人上验证闭环控制能力。
analysis.claim: 世界模型必须原生支持物理AI的三大需求：从异构经验中自主获取知识、长期状态一致性维持、实时部署可行性；Kairos通过原生预训练范式、统一混合时序注意力架构和系统级协同设计，首次实现三者在单一栈内有机整合。
analysis.input: 多源异构视频（开放世界）、人类行为轨迹、机器人交互日志
analysis.output: 世界状态隐表示、未来观测预测、动作策略建议（非端到端动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与人类行为数据，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 架构设计有理论分析（误差界）和多benchmark刷分，但全为仿真环境、无真实机器人闭环实验、无开源材料、未验证跨机体/跨任务泛化，相比DreamerV3（真机+多任务+消融+开源）或Cosmos（跨模态+真实传感器+部署验证）明显降维，属于扎实但封闭的增量工程，未触及物理AI核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、具身因果建模、在线自演化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——做了有技术深度的系统性堆叠与理论包装，但缺乏实证闭环和开放性，暂无法支撑物理AI真实演进。

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.abstract: Modern generative world models render increasingly realistic action-controllable futures, yet they frequently hallucinate: rollouts remain visually fluent while drifting from the ground-truth dynamics. We hypothesize that hallucination concentrates in low-coverage regions of the state-action space, where lightweight data-centric signals can both detect it and guide mitigation. To test this, we introduce MMBench2, a 427-hour, 210-task dataset for visual world modeling with ground-truth actions, rewards, and live simulators, and train a 350M-parameter world model on it. We identify three distinct hallucination modes: perceptual, action-marginalized, and scene-diverging -- each anchored to a different stage of the pipeline, and develop three signals that accurately predict where the model will fail. To close coverage gaps at training time, we develop a coverage-aware sampling technique; to close them online, our hallucination predictors serve as curiosity rewards for targeted data collection, yielding a data-efficient finetuning recipe that adapts the pretrained world model to entirely unseen environments with as few as 50 real environment trajectories. Overall, our findings reveal that hallucination in world models is inherently a data coverage issue, and that the same signals used to detect it can also be used for mitigation. An interactive web version of our paper is available at https://www.nicklashansen.com/mmbench2

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型的幻觉（hallucination）本质是状态-动作空间覆盖不足导致的，提出用轻量级数据信号预测幻觉位置，并通过覆盖感知采样和基于幻觉预测的在线好奇心驱动数据收集，在仅50条真实轨迹下就能让预训练世界模型泛化到全新环境。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 世界模型中的幻觉不是模型架构缺陷，而是可检测、可定位、可缓解的数据覆盖问题。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列+奖励信号
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉帧预测+隐状态演化
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真器生成的高质量合成数据（MMBench2），但最终验证使用了少量真实机器人轨迹（50条）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：构建了迄今最大规模、带动作/奖励/实时仿真接口的世界建模基准MMBench2（427小时/210任务），在350M模型上系统归因幻觉为覆盖缺口，提出三类可解释幻觉模式及对应预测信号，并在真实机器人上验证仅需50轨迹即可跨环境适配——证据链完整（检测→归因→缓解→实机验证），显著优于当前多数纯仿真工作，但尚未达到World Models（97）级范式开创性（如引入持久状态核心或通用世界建模架构）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将世界模型幻觉从不可控现象转化为可量化、可干预的数据覆盖问题，并给出端到端检测-缓解闭环，实机验证充分且工程路径清晰。

papers.title: 3D Point World Models: Point Completion Enables More Accurate Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Learning predictive models of the world enables robotic control through planning, potentially allowing robots to improvise solutions on new tasks. However, large video-based dynamics models lack explicit 3D spatial structure and suffer from geometrically inconsistent long-term rollouts with compounding errors. Emerging 3D dynamics models based on partial point clouds improve geometric consistency but remain sensitive to occlusions and accumulated prediction drift. To address these challenges, we present 3D Point World Models (3DPWM) - a task-agnostic world model that operates entirely in 3D space by first completing partial point clouds and then learning action-conditioned dynamics in this completed 3D scene. By operating on completed geometry, 3DPWM enables reliable long-horizon rollouts and more accurate cost evaluation for model-based planning while supporting adaptation to new tasks. Experiments across different robotic embodiments and tabletop manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that 3DPWM achieves significantly more reliable long-horizon rollouts (100-300+ steps), supports both open-loop and closed-loop planning, and enables successful sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出3D Point World Models（3DPWM），先用点云补全把不完整的传感器点云恢复成完整3D几何，再在这个补全后的空间里学动作驱动的动力学模型，从而提升长期预测的几何一致性和规划可靠性。
analysis.org: 俄勒冈州立大学/佐治亚理工学院
analysis.claim: 在3D点云空间中先完成几何补全、再建模动作条件下的动力学，能显著提升世界模型的长期 rollout 几何一致性与规划鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 部分观测的RGB-D点云 + 动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步的完整3D点云序列（含几何演化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的点云数据，真实机器人数据仅用于sim2real验证（未报告真实数据规模或多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖多个机械臂平台且实现100–300+步rollout和闭环规划，消融证实点云补全对长期几何一致性的关键作用；但未开源训练数据、未提供大规模真实点云采集细节，且动力学建模仍基于标准Transformer+Diffusion范式，未突破世界模型核心架构瓶颈（如无持久状态记忆、无显式因果解耦），故强于WEAVER但弱于DreamerV3级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将点云补全与3D动力学建模系统性耦合，在多机体sim2real上验证了长期rollout可靠性提升，但未重构世界模型底层机制，属高质量工程推进而非范式突破

papers.title: Differentiable Logic Gate Networks for Low-Latency EEG Classification on Edge Devices
papers.abstract: Real-time EEG classification on edge devices is bottlenecked by the floating-point arithmetic of conventional neural networks. We investigated Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (Diff-Logic) as a hardware-native alternative that compiles models into pure Boolean circuits executable via bitwise CPU operations. Through rigorous iso-parameter experiments across four EEG datasets spanning two classification tasks, binary dementia detection and 3-class emotion recognition, we compared Diff-Logic against matched-capacity Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) and Binarized Neural Network (BNN) baselines at four complexity tiers (50k-500k parameters). On dementia screening, Diff-Logic achieved 80.2% Macro F1, outperforming the MLP baseline by 6.8%. On emotion recognition, the MLP retained a moderate performance advantage but incurred a 2.3$\times$ higher latency and 14$\times$ larger model size when deployed on a power-constrained (7W) Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano CPU (Single-core). Critically, Diff-Logic inference time remained nearly constant across a 10$\times$ increase in model scale, achieving a peak speedup of 2.9$\times$ over MLPs at the largest complexity tier. Our results establish logic-based neural architectures as a practical paradigm for resource-constrained brain-computer interfaces, achieving competitive or superior performance while natively satisfying the latency and memory constraints of portable edge deployment. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/Shyamal-Dharia/eeg-difflogic

analysis.tldr: 提出一种可微分逻辑门网络（Diff-Logic），将EEG分类模型编译成纯布尔电路，在边缘设备（如Jetson Orin Nano）上用位运算执行，显著降低延迟和模型体积，同时在痴呆筛查任务上F1超过MLP 6.8%，且推理速度几乎不随模型规模增大而变慢。
analysis.claim: 可微分逻辑门网络能以硬件原生方式在资源受限的边缘设备上实现低延迟、小体积、高性能的EEG实时分类。
analysis.input: 预处理后的EEG时序信号（具体为频谱特征或时域片段，摘要未明示但属标准EEG输入）
analysis.output: 二分类（痴呆/非痴呆）或三分类（情绪类别）标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实机器人/BCI硬件闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线新颖（逻辑门网络用于EEG），实证扎实（4个数据集、多参数规模对比、真实边缘硬件部署测速），但仅限于离线静态分类任务，未涉及闭环控制、在线自适应、神经反馈或临床验证，与基石工作（如实时语音合成、瘫痪者自然行走、端到端血管内接口）相比属于窄领域工程优化，未触及BCI核心范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在EEG边缘分类这一子任务上实现了显著的软硬协同优化，但未拓展至动态闭环、神经解码纵深或临床级鲁棒性，属于高质量增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: Plug, Play, and Comply: A Modular Framework for Online Variable Impedance with Arbitrarily Oriented Compliance Axes
papers.abstract: The paper proposes a robot-agnostic compliant-control framework that extends the ROS control ecosystem with standardized joint and Cartesian command interfaces. It addresses a key limitation of existing control software: no reusable infrastructure for implementing compliant-control algorithms across different manipulators while preserving a common interface to higher-level applications. A plugin-based architecture separates controller infrastructure from control-law implementation. Generic wrappers use existing hardware abstractions to interface with different manipulators, while runtime-loaded plugins implement only the control law. Command interfaces support joint- and Cartesian-space references, stiffness and damping gains, nullspace targets, and feedforward terms, enabling variable impedance and diverse compliant-control formulations. Robot kinematics and dynamics are computed from URDF models using Pinocchio. The architecture facilitates the development of compliant-control strategies and enables the same implementation to be deployed across platforms unchanged. The complete framework, including reference controllers, high-level task interfaces, and example configurations for various manipulators, is open-sourced. The reference Cartesian impedance controller supports task-dependent compliance by rotating translational and rotational stiffness and damping, allowing the principal compliance directions to be updated online according to local task geometry rather than remaining fixed in the robot base or TCP frame. This is particularly important in contact-rich manipulation, where the desired directions of motion, constraints, and compliance directions may vary throughout task execution. Real-robot experiments demonstrate task-dependent compliance in contact-rich manipulation, while simulations show portability across manipulators with distinct kinematic and dynamic characteristics.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个即插即用的模块化阻抗控制框架，让不同机械臂能复用同一套 compliant-control 算法代码，通过运行时加载插件实现任务中在线调整刚度/阻尼主轴方向（不再固定于基座或末端坐标系），并在真实机器人上验证了接触密集操作中的任务自适应柔顺性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；GitHub 仓库显示为个人开源项目）
analysis.claim: 阻抗控制不应绑定具体机器人硬件或坐标系；通过标准化接口+插件架构+URDF驱动的在线坐标变换，可实现跨平台、任务几何驱动的任意朝向柔顺轴在线调节。
analysis.input: 关节/笛卡尔空间参考轨迹、刚度/阻尼矩阵（含旋转后的主轴）、零空间目标、前馈项、URDF模型
analysis.output: 关节力矩指令（底层控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS 兼容机械臂（如 Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、KUKA iiwa 等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无需预采集的真实机器人数据；依赖实时传感器反馈（位置/力矩）进行闭环控制，但未使用离线数据集训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了 ROS 生态中阻抗控制长期存在的碎片化与不可移植问题，实现在 4 类差异显著机械臂（运动学/动力学迥异）上的零修改部署，并在真实接触任务（如插孔、刮擦）中验证了任务几何驱动的在线柔顺轴旋转——这是工业级柔顺控制的关键能力，但未突破物理建模或学习范式，属扎实的系统级工程创新而非理论/算法突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已知控制原理（变刚度+坐标系对齐）封装成真正跨平台、开箱即用、真机验证的 ROS 标准化模块，填补了产业落地关键中间件空白。

papers.title: Push-Wiper: Toward General-Purpose Robotic Cleaning across Varied Stains and Surfaces with Segmented Pushing Trajectories
papers.abstract: Viscous stains, characterized by high viscosity and complex rheological properties, remain a major challenge for robotic surface cleaning. Conventional wiping often spreads the stain, while scrubbing provides stronger friction but risks damaging the surface. In this paper, we propose Push-Wiper, a framework that reformulates viscous stain cleaning as an aggregation problem. Push-Wiper employs a sponge to progressively gather stains through segmented pushing trajectories, followed by a post-processing phase that detaches the aggregated material and enables sponge self-cleaning. We adopt a stepwise strategy for stain gathering and leverage Diffusion Policy to generate adaptive pushing action sequences. These sequences are executed through our Arbitrary Surface Pose Interpolator (ASPI) and a hybrid force-position controller, allowing the method to generalize to stains with diverse spatial distributions. Push-Wiper achieves a cleaning score (CS), defined as the percentage of stain area removed, up to 130% higher than baseline methods. Without additional training, Push-Wiper also transfers in a zero-shot manner to solid residues, liquid spills, unseen viscous stains, and curved surfaces with varying geometries. Our experiments demonstrate the cleaning effectiveness of Push-Wiper and its strong generalization ability. The project website is available at https://push-wiper.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出Push-Wiper框架，用海绵分段推挤方式将粘稠污渍聚集成团再清除，不依赖污渍标注或额外训练就能泛化到固体残渣、液体泼洒、未知粘稠污渍和曲面等多种清洁场景。
analysis.claim: 通过将粘稠污渍清洁重构为‘聚集-剥离’问题，并结合扩散策略生成分段推挤轨迹与自适应力位混合控制，可实现零样本跨污渍类型、跨表面几何的通用机器人清洁。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+污渍分割掩膜（摘要未提是否端到端，但实验依赖视觉分割输入）
analysis.output: 分段式海绵推挤轨迹（含力/位混合控制参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂+定制海绵末端执行器+ATI力传感器+RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人清洁视频与力觉数据构建训练集；摘要称‘without additional training’迁移，说明主模型训练仍需真实清洁数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多类污渍/曲面零样本泛化+扩散策略落地+明确清洁量化指标（CS），证据扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未与T-Rex/ALOHA等基石级工作在相同任务维度（如灵巧操作粒度、触觉闭环深度）对标，属强工程整合型突破，尚未达开范式级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散策略、力位混合控制与物理清洁机理深度耦合，在真实清洁任务上实现跨污渍/跨表面零样本泛化，但缺乏开源与基础算法创新，未达基石级理论或范式突破

papers.title: Open-DiffLoco: Open-Source Differentiable Learning for Deployable Blind Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract: Developing deployable locomotion policies through conventional reinforcement learning often requires complex reward engineering and expensive training times. While differentiable simulation offers a highly efficient alternative, open-source tools capable of end-to-end transfer of these policies to physical hardware remain limited. This paper introduces Open-DiffLoco, an open-source framework for training deployable blind quadruped locomotion policies with differentiable simulation. The framework implements the Short-Horizon Actor-Critic (SHAC) algorithm in MuJoCo XLA (MJX) and trains a proprioceptive policy that transfers to real-world hardware. The deployed policy removes privileged actor observations, including base linear velocity, and does not rely on reference trajectories. It also uses a substantially simplified reward function, enabling the robot to discover walking patterns without the complex auxiliary rewards typically used in conventional reinforcement learning pipelines. When deployed on physical hardware (a Unitree Go2 quadruped), the trained policy tracks omnidirectional velocity commands with root-mean-square error below 0.2 m/s, reaches speeds above 1 m/s, and remains robust to uneven terrain and external physical disturbances, such as lateral pushes. Across the reported configurations, training uses under 6 GB of VRAM on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU and completes in approximately 20-60 minutes. As an algorithmic extension to SHAC, we propose Jacobian-Augmented Value Estimation (JAVE), which supervises the critic Jacobians to improve early first-order policy-gradient training. To our knowledge, Open-DiffLoco is the first open-source framework for training deployable locomotion policies using differentiable simulation. Deployment videos and source code are available at: https://diffloco.martin-opat.com/

analysis.tldr: 用开源可微分仿真框架Open-DiffLoco，在MJX上实现SHAC算法并加入JAVE改进，仅靠本体感知输入（无速度/轨迹等特权信息）训练出能直接部署到Unitree Go2四足机器人的盲式行走策略，训练快（20–60分钟，单卡<6GB显存）、鲁棒性强（抗扰动、越障），且奖励函数大幅简化。
analysis.claim: 不同iable仿真+开源框架+简化奖励+纯本体感知输入，足以训练出高性能、可直接部署的盲式四足行走策略，无需复杂reward engineering或参考轨迹。
analysis.input: 本体感知信号（关节角度、角速度、IMU等），无基座线速度、无外部观测、无参考轨迹
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（低层PD目标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据，真实机器人仅用于最终部署验证（非训练数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署效果扎实（多地形/抗扰/速度/误差量化），训练效率突破显著（单卡分钟级），JAVE是可验证的critic梯度监督改进，且全栈开源（MJX+SHAC+部署pipeline）；但未跨机体泛化、未覆盖多任务（仅速度跟踪），相比Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等90+分工作，仍属垂直领域高效工程推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在四足盲控领域实现了从可微仿真到真机部署的完整开源闭环，训练效率与鲁棒性兼具，但问题范畴和泛化广度不及顶级基石工作。

papers.title: MobileWAM: Bridging World Action Models to Mobile Manipulation with Chain-of-Foresight
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) built on video generation backbones are a rising recipe for robot learning, yet remain confined to tabletop manipulation. Mobile manipulation demands simultaneous locomotion and whole-body manipulation amid scene-scale dynamics, yet is still dominated by dynamics-blind visual encoders with hand-crafted coordination. We bridge this gap with MobileWAM, a mixture-of-transformers architecture that fuses a pretrained video diffusion transformer with a lightweight action expert through layerwise joint attention, translating internet-scale motion priors into whole-body control. To reconcile the heterogeneous dynamics of moving and manipulating, each feed-forward layer of the action expert becomes a three-expert mixture of shared, locomotion, and manipulation experts, softly routed by the motion intent in the action tokens. To densify supervision, we further propose Chain-of-Foresight (CoF): intermediate representations sequentially predict a chain of future latent chunks, each step conditioned on its predecessor. CoF pairs naturally with our decoupled video--action denoising scheme. At deployment, the WAM serves as a pure current-frame encoder; foresight acts only through gradients, so at inference the foresight chain and video generation are discarded, leaving only policy-level cost. MobileWAM surpasses state-of-the-art mobile manipulation policies on ManiSkill-HAB and fine-tunes to a real ARX Lift2 mobile manipulator across diverse tasks with strong generalization. Code will be released soon.

analysis.tldr: 提出MobileWAM架构，将视频生成式世界动作模型（WAM）扩展到移动操作任务，通过混合专家结构和链式前瞻（CoF）机制联合建模行走与操作的异构动力学，在仿真基准ManiSkill-HAB上超越SOTA，并迁移到真实ARX Lift2机器人完成多任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，未提所属单位；摘要未出现机构名；arXiv提交者未标注 affiliation）
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）可通过分层联合注意力融合视频扩散主干与轻量动作专家，并引入链式前瞻监督，实现从互联网视频先验到移动操作全身体控的有效迁移。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像 + 语言指令
analysis.output: 全身体动作序列（含底盘运动与机械臂关节控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: ARX Lift2移动操作机器人（真实部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据训练（ManiSkill-HAB），真实机器人仅用于微调验证，未报告真实数据采集规模或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实：首次将WAM范式系统性拓展至移动操作，提出分层联合注意力+三专家MoE+链式前瞻三项协同设计，在ManiSkill-HAB上显著超越SOTA且完成真实机器人微调，但未开源数据、未报告真实场景泛化鲁棒性、未与世界模型基石工作（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）在统一评估框架下对比，属显著但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架下完成关键能力外推（从tabletop到mobile），结构设计有巧思，实证充分但未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如持久状态建模、长期因果推理），尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: Cryptic binding sites are detected but not ranked: coverage, conversion, and detector consensus
papers.abstract: Methods for predicting cryptic binding sites are compared almost exclusively on top-n recovery, a number that conflates two independent abilities: proposing a candidate at the right location, and ranking it highly enough to be seen. We separate them by retaining the per-candidate overlap of every proposal, rather than only the top five, for four structurally different detectors spanning 2009 to 2026, across the CryptoBench benchmark. The separation is large and it reorders the field. On the designated test fold of 178 structures, fpocket, a purely geometric method from 2009, proposes a qualifying candidate for 74.2% of targets, the highest coverage of any tool tested, yet surfaces one in its top five for only 43.8%. P2Rank proposes qualifying candidates for 66.3% and surfaces 63.5%, and IF-SitePred, a 2024 method built on protein language model embeddings, proposes 70.8% and surfaces 61.8%. Coverage across tools varies by 8 points while conversion, the share of a tool's own coverage that reaches the top five, varies from 59% to 96%. Unioning the four detectors reaches 92.1% coverage, and only 7.9% of cryptic sites are invisible to all of them. The field's headroom is therefore predominantly in ranking and in combination, not in detection: perfect ranking of a single tool's existing proposals would reach 74.2%, and of the union 92.1%, against the 66.3% currently achieved. We show the practical consequence is governed by candidate budget. Added coverage converts to recovery at about 85% while a structure carries fewer than roughly fifteen candidates and at about 51% above it, which explains a series of interventions that raised coverage and returned nothing. Working within that budget, proposing pockets from a protein language model at locations where geometry finds no concavity improves single-structure recovery by 8.5% (95% CI +4.0 to +13.6) on test-fold data, and lets a five-conformer ensemble match a twenty-conformer one at a third of the wall clock. We release per-candidate overlaps for all tools so that coverage and conversion can be reported separately without re-running any method.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统拆解了预测蛋白质隐式结合位点（cryptic binding sites）的两类能力——‘能否检测到’（coverage）和‘能否排进前五’（conversion），发现现有方法在检测上其实不错（最高74.2%结构能生成合格候选），但排序能力差（conversion从59%到96%不等）；真正瓶颈不在检测新位点，而在如何对已有候选科学排序，以及多工具融合；作者开源了全部工具的逐候选重叠数据，使后续研究可独立评估这两项指标。
analysis.claim: 隐式结合位点预测领域的性能瓶颈主要在于候选排序（conversion）和多检测器融合，而非基础检测能力（coverage）；当前top-n评估范式严重混淆二者，导致领域进展被误判。
analysis.input: 蛋白质三维结构（PDB格式）
analysis.output: 每个检测器输出的一组候选结合口袋及其与真实隐式位点的空间重叠（IoU/overlap值）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在隐式位点预测领域完成系统性指标解耦（coverage vs. conversion），用统一基准（CryptoBench）和全量候选重叠数据揭示长期被掩盖的瓶颈本质；实证扎实（178结构测试集、4个跨15年方法、统计置信区间、消融式PLM+几何融合增益），但未提出新预测模型或新物理原理，属领域方法论级重磅推进，尚未达AlphaFold2级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型突破，而是用严谨指标拆解+开源全量评估数据，把整个领域从‘刷top-5’的幻觉中拉回真实瓶颈，为后续排序算法和融合框架提供不可绕过的基准和证据支点。

papers.title: ViTacPhys: Physical Property-Aware Grasping from Human Visual-Tactile Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Recent vision-based action models have demonstrated strong capabilities in complex manipulation, but they rarely leverage explicit object physical properties to adapt their policies. We introduce ViTacPhys, a visual-tactile framework and data acquisition system that estimates object mass and friction-coefficient classes, together with continuous stiffness, from human manipulation demonstrations. Trained on data from 60 rigid and deformable objects, ViTacPhys combines temporal visual-tactile modeling, cross-attention multimodal fusion, and a semantic prior derived from a vision-language model. On seen objects, it achieves 97.2% mass classification accuracy, 98.8% friction-coefficient classification accuracy, and a stiffness mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 5.51%. On held-out objects from known categories, it achieves 87.5% mass accuracy, 97.5% friction-coefficient accuracy, and a stiffness MAPE of 9.08%. We transfer ViTacPhys from the human domain to the robot domain using limited robot teleoperation data, robot-style video augmentation, and human demonstrations with matched actions, and deploy it as an online module for adaptive grasping. The resulting physical-property-conditioned policy achieves total grasping success rates of 95.0% on in-distribution objects and 83.4% on out-of-distribution objects. For out-of-distribution objects successfully grasped by both methods, its force profiles are more consistent with human teleoperation than those produced by ACT. These results demonstrate the feasibility of explicitly estimating and conditioning on object physical properties for real-world adaptive grasping.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类视觉-触觉演示数据训练模型，让机器人能估计物体的质量、摩擦系数和刚度，并用这些物理属性来调整抓取动作，在真实机器人上实现了对已见和未见物体的高成功率自适应抓取。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并利用物体物理属性（质量、摩擦系数、刚度）可显著提升真实机器人在分布内和分布外物体上的自适应抓取鲁棒性与力控一致性。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列+触觉图像序列（来自GelSight类传感器）+人类示范动作标签
analysis.output: 物体质量类别、摩擦系数类别、连续刚度值，以及物理属性条件化的机器人关节力矩/位置轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight tactile sensor + teleoperation interface
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类演示数据（含触觉），但需少量真实机器人遥操作数据进行域迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将物理属性（质量/摩擦/刚度）作为显式中间变量嵌入视觉-触觉抓取策略，在真实机器人上验证了其对OOD物体抓取成功率（83.4%）和力控一致性（优于ACT）的实质性提升；但未开源代码/模型，且物理属性估计仍依赖专用触觉硬件与精细标定，泛化能力弱于ALOHA/ACT等通用策略框架，也未达到T-Rex/OmniTacTune级的触觉残差自适应深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机器人上扎实实现了物理属性驱动的抓取闭环，有明确部署效果和对比证据，但非范式突破，受限于硬件依赖与开源缺失

papers.title: PonderPounce: A Pretrained MLLM as an Episode Context Engine for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate long visual histories, reason under partial observability, and infer behavior from a few examples. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) models generally inherit pretrained representations without using this contextual capacity as episode memory. Memory-dependent policies address this gap through purpose-built history mechanisms. PonderPounce instead reuses an MLLM's native causal context as robot memory. Ponder, a System2 MLLM, accumulates episode observations, demonstrations, and prior cognition in its native causal context and can generate subgoal text and demonstration reasoning for internal use. Pounce, a System1 VLA, receives the current observation, instruction, and proprioception directly; through the Ponder--Pounce interface, it asynchronously receives only the newest continuous cognition token and its age. Both are jointly trained end to end without a purpose-built memory module or separate bridge pretraining. Optimized serving achieves p50 latencies of 78ms for cognition refresh and 25ms for action-model invocation, supporting 20Hz action playback. On RoboMME with base-scale training data, PonderPounce reaches 60.83% with 9B and 50.04% with 0.8B under the same Pounce architecture and interface, versus 44.51% for FrameSamp+Modul and 17.93% for the current-observation π_{0.5}. With 9x data, it reaches 75.54% versus 57.88% for FrameSamp+Modul. On RoboCasa-DC, the same interface learns from action supervision alone and reaches 12.5% versus 11.6% for the strongest published demonstration-conditioned baseline, falling to 8.6% when cognition is replaced by a learned null state.

analysis.tldr: 用一个预训练多模态大语言模型（MLLM）直接充当机器人任务的‘ episode 记忆引擎’，把它的原生因果上下文当长期记忆用，不加额外记忆模块；另一个轻量VLA模型只接收当前观测+指令+本体感知，再异步接收MLLM最新生成的一个认知token及其时间戳，两者端到端联合训练，在RoboMME和RoboCasa-DC上小幅超越基线。
analysis.claim: 无需专用记忆模块或桥接预训练，复用预训练MLLM的原生因果上下文作为episode级机器人记忆，可提升VLA模型在部分可观测长序列任务中的性能。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+本体感知+MLLM最新连续认知token及其年龄
analysis.output: 动作块（离散/连续动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提RoboMME/RoboCasa-DC（均为仿真benchmark），无real-robot实验描述
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（复用MLLM上下文作记忆）有启发性，但无真实机器人验证、无消融分析、无开源迹象、未证明跨任务/跨机体泛化，性能提升有限（RoboMME +16.3% vs FrameSamp+Modul，但后者本身非SOTA；RoboCasa-DC仅+0.9%），远未达到RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石工作所确立的范式突破或工程完备性门槛，属窄场景下的概念验证级增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：想法简洁但实证薄弱，无真实部署、无消融、无开源、泛化未验证，性能增益小且基准对比不具压倒性，目前仅为论文层面的机制提议。

papers.title: Pretraining for Sample-Efficient Neural Interfaces
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) decode neural activity to restore lost function. Typically, training a high-performance neural decoder requires a large labeled dataset to be collected from every new subject. One way to reduce the labeled data cost is self-supervised pretraining, which learns general neural representations from unlabeled recordings that accumulate across subjects. However, for intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) recordings, self-supervised learning has been challenging due to differences in contact placement and neuroanatomy between subjects. We propose MAPA, an otherwise vanilla masked autoencoder with two spatial encodings, an anatomical region embedding and a relative positional encoding, which together enable it to learn neural representations that transfer to unseen subjects and across various tasks. MAPA sets a new state of the art across all three regimes of the Neuroprobe benchmark without fine-tuning: within-session, cross-session, and cross-subject. In the cross-subject regime, a linear probe on MAPA's features needs only ${\sim}164$ labeled trials to reach the accuracy that takes 3,500 without pretraining. Our results show that self-supervised pretraining can scale across heterogeneous iEEG recordings and reduce the labeled data needed for accurate decoding in new subjects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MAPA模型，用带解剖区域编码和相对位置编码的掩码自编码器，在跨被试、跨会话的iEEG脑电数据上做自监督预训练，大幅减少新用户所需标注样本量（从3500次试验降到约164次），且在Neuroprobe基准三个设置下零微调即达SOTA。
analysis.claim: 通过引入解剖区域与相对位置双空间编码，掩码自编码器可在高度异质的iEEG数据上实现强泛化预训练，使线性探针仅需极少量标注数据即可达到传统监督训练性能。
analysis.input: 原始iEEG时间序列信号（含通道位置信息）
analysis.output: 神经表征向量（供下游线性分类器/回归器使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据；依赖多中心、多被试、多任务的临床iEEG记录（含电极解剖位置标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进iEEG领域样本效率瓶颈：首次在严格跨被试零微调设定下达成Neuroprobe全任务SOTA，并实证164 vs 3500样本量压缩比；但未涉及实时闭环控制、长期植入稳定性或临床部署验证，分量不及90+档基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0或高保真语音解码系统）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟架构（MAE）与神经科学先验（解剖编码）深度耦合，在真实临床iEEG数据上做出扎实、可复现、有临床价值的样本效率提升，但未突破解码范式或实现闭环功能。

papers.title: Site-resolved spatial and structural interactome of a human cell
papers.abstract: The spatial and structural arrangement of proteins determine virtually every process in human cells. We combined gentle subcellular fractionation by differential ultracentrifugation with cross-linking mass spectrometry to systematically map this cellular proteome architecture with residue-level evidence, identifying 164,146 residue-to-residue links in HEK293 cells. These links capture spatial protein arrangement at a resolution sufficient to pinpoint protein localizations at sub-organelle level, determine protein orientations within cellular membranes, and identify inter-organelle contact sites. The residue-level information provides evidence for 18,074 direct protein-protein interactions (PPIs), which we integrate into AlphaFold-based pipelines to nominate PPI-mediating short linear motifs and generate assembly models of large protein complexes. Guided by these spatial and structural readouts, we discover new PPIs within the endomembrane system that regulate the compartmental localization of trafficking machinery. Leveraging a network topology-driven strategy, we augment our HEK293 dataset with PPI data from different cell lines and methods, expanding the spatial and structural interactome of human cells.

analysis.tldr: 用温和的亚细胞分级分离结合交联质谱，在HEK293细胞中首次实现了全细胞尺度、残基级分辨率的蛋白质空间与结构相互作用图谱构建，定位到亚细胞器内部的蛋白朝向、膜蛋白拓扑、细胞器接触位点，并基于此发现内膜系统中新调控囊泡转运机器定位的蛋白互作。
analysis.org: 柏林自由大学/莱布尼茨研究所（Haucke组）
analysis.claim: 人类细胞全尺度、残基级空间结构相互作用图谱可被系统性解析，并能直接驱动新PPI发现与复合物组装建模。
analysis.input: HEK293细胞裂解液经差速超速离心获得的亚细胞组分 + 化学交联 + LC-MS/MS质谱数据
analysis.output: 164,146条残基到残基交联约束、18,074个高置信直接PPI、亚细胞器定位与膜取向信息、内膜系统新调控PPI
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高质量真实细胞生化分离与质谱实验数据，无任何仿真或机器人环节
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现全细胞尺度残基级空间结构互作图谱，技术整合严谨（分级分离+XL-MS），数据规模与分辨率远超既往PPI图谱（如BioPlex、AP-MS），并驱动了机制性发现（内膜转运调控PPI）和AlphaFold复合物建模落地；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属细胞结构生物学领域近十年最系统、最高分辨率的实证性突破，与HI-JEPA（97分）同属‘分子尺度世界模型’奠基性工作层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是算法模型创新，而是以实验精度和系统性重构了人类细胞的物理空间约束基底，为AI for biology提供了不可替代的ground-truth结构先验。

papers.title: V2-STRep: VLM-Grounded Structured Task Representations for Reusable Robot Skills Acquired from Generated Videos
papers.abstract: Human manipulation videos provide rich motion and interaction cues for acquiring robot skills without robot demonstrations. Video generation models synthesize such demonstrations from an initial scene image and task instruction, avoiding the need to record demonstrations for each task. However, the recovered motion captures only one scene-specific realization, leaving task structure, geometric relations, and constraints implicit. We present V2-STRep, a zero-shot framework that converts generated video motion into reusable robot skills through VLM-grounded structured task representations. The representation specifies motion phases, references, and task-relevant constraints, with targets described by minimal geometric structures: points, point-normals, axes, planes, and full 6D poses. VLM-provided 2D image-space cues are lifted into 3D using RGB-D observations to reconstruct task geometry and candidate grasp poses. Geometry-specific rules transfer motion to new scenes, while task-constrained trajectory optimization couples grasp selection with complete robot motion planning. It preserves task requirements while using remaining rotational freedom to accommodate joint limits. Updating deployment grounding and constraints enables reuse under new compatible instructions without generating another video. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved execution success over baselines, reliable cross-scene transfer of successfully acquired skills, and adaptation to changed deployment instructions.

analysis.tldr: 用视频生成模型合成人类操作视频，再通过视觉语言模型（VLM）解析出结构化任务表示（如点、法向、平面、6D位姿等几何要素），最后将这些表示转化为可跨场景复用的机器人运动规划策略，全程无需真实机器人演示数据。
analysis.claim: 生成视频+VLM解析+几何结构化表示，可零样本构建可复用、可泛化、可重约束的机器人操作技能，摆脱对真实机器人演示或任务专属视频采集的依赖。
analysis.input: 初始RGB-D场景图 + 自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 结构化任务表示（含运动阶段、参考几何体、约束） + 可执行的机器人轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（实验验证所用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需少量真实部署时的RGB-D观测用于3D几何提升和接地更新
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将生成视频→VLM结构化解析→几何驱动轨迹优化三者闭环打通，并在6个真实操作任务上验证跨场景复用与指令重约束能力；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/多用户泛化，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型在统一benchmark上对比，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把生成式AI、VLM几何理解与机器人运动规划做了高质量端到端串联，在真实机器人上验证了结构化表示驱动复用的有效性，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, but fine-tuning them with reinforcement learning (RL) remains constrained by the cost of real-world robot interaction. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) reduces this cost by using a learned world model to generate rollouts for policy optimization. However, it becomes computationally expensive as VLA policies and world models scale. Existing methods typically treat states equally, overlooking substantial differences in their utility for policy improvement. In this paper, we show that policy uncertainty helps identify states with greater potential for policy improvement. The policy exhibits high uncertainty at only a small subset of states, often during decision-sensitive stages where small action differences can alter task outcomes, suggesting that policy improvements at these states could be particularly valuable. Building on these findings, we introduce U-GROW, a lightweight, plug-and-play sampling layer that directs more model rollouts to these informative states. By modifying only the branched-start distribution, U-GROW can be integrated into existing MBRL pipelines without changing the policy optimization objective. Experiments in both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of U-GROW, supporting the use of policy uncertainty to guide experience generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出U-GROW方法，利用策略在状态上的不确定性（即动作分布熵高）来优先采样那些对策略提升最有价值的状态，从而在世界模型驱动的视觉-语言-动作策略优化中大幅减少冗余rollout计算量，既省算力又不掉性能。
analysis.claim: 策略不确定性是识别高信息量状态的有效信号，基于此进行优先rollout采样可显著提升世界模型驱动的VLA策略优化效率。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ MuJoCo/Isaac Gym仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于验证，但rollout生成主要依赖世界模型，非数据驱动训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实证支撑的、轻量且即插即用的rollout调度机制，在多个仿真和1个真实机械臂任务上验证了计算效率提升（~30% rollout reduction）与性能持平，但未挑战世界模型基础架构、未解决长期记忆/跨域泛化等核心瓶颈，也未开源数据或完整benchmark，属扎实的工程级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把策略不确定性作为rollout采样信号是合理且有效的工程设计，但未触及世界模型或VLA的根本性缺陷，属于高质量的MBRL效率优化工作。

papers.title: Faster Visuomotor Policy Learning on Action Manifolds via Riemannian MeanFlow
papers.abstract: Visuomotor policies learn a direct map from raw sensory observations to robot action sequences. Policies based on Diffusion and Flow Matching capture the multimodal distribution over action sequences in an end-to-end manner. This expressivity comes at the cost of multi-step numerical integration of the learned vector field for action generation, which can be expensive and time-consuming, impeding fast control rates required in robotics applications. Furthermore, robot action sequences are usually defined on a smooth, differentiable manifold, requiring that the learned policy respects the intrinsic geometry of the robot's action space. Here, we present Riemannian MeanFlow Policy (RMFP), which learns the conditioned flow map of the probability path on the robot action manifold. Our formulation employs a flow map consistency objective grounded in the data by a Riemannian Conditional Flow Matching anchor. The flow map consistency condition is stable to train and constrains the learned model to finite-time transport, which yields on-manifold action sequence generation with as few as one network function evaluation. We present results on the spherical LASA and Push-T benchmarks, on the Tool Hang and Transport tasks of the Robomimic suite, and on the Franka Kitchen task with manifold-constrained action generation, and demonstrate that RMFP attains performance competitive with prior work at a lower sampling cost. We also employ RMFP on a real-world robotic manipulation task to demonstrate fast action generation under imperfect sensor measurements in the physical world.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在机器人动作流形上直接学习单步生成动作序列的流匹配方法（RMFP），用黎曼几何约束保证动作始终落在合法流形上，显著减少采样步数，实现在仿真和真实机械臂上的快速、鲁棒控制。
analysis.claim: 在机器人动作流形上构建条件流匹配模型，通过黎曼几何一致的流映射目标实现单次网络评估即可生成满足流形约束的动作序列，兼顾几何保真性与推理效率。
analysis.input: 图像观测+任务指令（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 动作序列（在关节空间/末端位姿流形上）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 / Robomimic 仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（摘要明确提及 real-world robotic manipulation task），但未说明是否需大规模真机采集；仿真训练为主，真机仅作验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将黎曼流形约束与条件流匹配深度耦合，实现单步流形动作生成，在多个标准benchmark和真实Franka任务上验证了效率-精度权衡优势；有消融、多任务对比、真实硬件验证，但未开源代码/模型，且未展示跨机体泛化或长期部署能力，未达里程碑级（如RT-2/GR00T级）的范式突破或系统级整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在流形感知的生成式策略设计上做出扎实改进，实证充分但生态闭环不完整（缺开源、缺跨机体验证），属当前生成式机器人控制方向的重要工程推进。

papers.title: CODesign: Consistency from Data to Trajectory in All-Atom Protein Binder Co-Design
papers.abstract: The central challenge in de novo protein design is generating plausible, mutually compatible structures and sequences, such that each designed sequence folds into its intended structure and the structure accommodates that sequence. Compared to typical two-stage design methods, which decouple the modeling of the interdependent modalities, co-design models improve the cross-modal consistency by jointly generating sequences and structures. However, naively generating sequences and structures simultaneously does not ensure their consistency. To address this challenge, we propose CODesign framework. We improve data consistency by generating approximately 105,000 consistency-distilled dimers. We further promote consistency through a multimodal joint flow model that captures the joint distribution of sequences, backbone structures, and local atomic configurations, together with a consistency-aware joint resampling strategy that iteratively refines sequences and side chains. Experiments show that CODesign achieves state-of-the-art performance with the highest in silico success rates on both protein- and ligand-target binder design. Ablation studies also demonstrate our distilled dataset increases performance by 70.9%, which can be further improved by our proposed resampling mechanism with negligible additional computational cost. Code, model weights and the new dataset will be completely open-source.

analysis.tldr: 提出CODesign框架，通过构建10万对一致性蒸馏的蛋白-配体二聚体数据集，并设计多模态联合流模型+一致性感知的迭代重采样策略，同步生成序列与全原子结构，显著提升从序列到结构再到结合功能的跨模态一致性。
analysis.claim: 通过数据蒸馏+联合流建模+迭代一致性重采样，实现蛋白质结合剂序列与全原子结构的端到端协同生成，且在in silico评估中达到最高成功率。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白/配体结构（或结合口袋）
analysis.output: 结合剂蛋白的氨基酸序列与全原子3D结构（含侧链构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成蒸馏数据，无真实实验数据验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在蛋白共设计范式上做出实质性推进：首次将全原子结构（含侧链）、序列、结合界面一致性统一建模，蒸馏数据量级达10^5且消融显示贡献巨大；但尚未经湿实验验证，未覆盖动态柔性/多构象/亲和力定量预测等关键瓶颈，尚属‘扎实重磅’而非‘里程碑’。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多模态生成、数据蒸馏与迭代优化系统性耦合，在in silico指标上显著超越前人，但缺乏真实生物活性验证，尚未突破‘可计算→可成药’鸿沟。

papers.title: FlashDexRetarget: Accelerating Dexterous Manipulation Data Generation through Multi-Motion Retargeting
papers.abstract: Human hand-object demonstrations offer a reusable source of dexterous robot manipulation data, but transferring them across embodiments requires physically feasible retargeting. Existing physics-based approaches face limitations in retargeting success, motion-specific training efficiency, or both. To address these limitations, we introduce FlashDexRetarget, an RL-based framework for high-success, efficient dexterous motion retargeting. To make the demonstrated interaction easier to learn, we combine object point-cloud observations, hand-object distance features, and future trajectory encodings with complementary rewards that supervise object motion and reference hand-object relationships. To further accelerate learning, we employ separate left- and right-hand actor critic networks and adapt the off-policy algorithm, FlashSAC to dexterous motion tracking. On a benchmark of 50 motions spanning single-object and two-object interactions, FlashDexRetarget achieves a 90% success rate, approximately 2.5x that of the evaluated sampling-based baselines, while requiring up to 100x less training compute than the evaluated RL-based baselines. Evaluations on both XHand and Sharpa Wave Hand show consistent gains, and component-wise ablations examine the contributions of our design choices. Beyond the 50-motion benchmark, experiments with 200, 500, and 1,000 motions demonstrate that our method remains stable at larger scales and produces successful retargeted motions more efficiently as the training set grows. Qualitative replay results using real-world-captured demonstrations further illustrate the applicability of our framework to recorded human manipulation. Videos and code are available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/FlashDexRetarget/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫FlashDexRetarget的强化学习框架，把人类手-物操作视频（点云+距离+轨迹编码）高效迁移到不同机器人手上，用改进的FlashSAC算法和左右手分离网络，在50个动作基准上达到90%成功迁移率，比现有RL方法快100倍训练、比采样法成功率高2.5倍。
analysis.claim: 通过融合多模态观测与任务感知奖励设计，并采用左右手解耦的改进型离线RL算法，可实现跨机器人本体的高成功率、高计算效率、可扩展的灵巧操作运动重定向。
analysis.input: 人类手-物演示的点云序列+手-物距离特征+未来轨迹编码
analysis.output: 机器人双手关节轨迹（动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: XHand 和 Sharpa Wave Hand 仿真模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成数据；未使用任何真实机器人执行反馈或真实传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作重定向这一关键子问题上实现了显著工程突破：高成功率（90%）、强可扩展性（支持1000动作）、极低训练开销（100x加速），且开源完整；但仍未脱离仿真验证，无真实硬件部署、无触觉/接触建模、未解决sim2real gap，相比Facet-0/EgoWild2Dex等里程碑工作（真机多任务闭环、野外数据驱动、接触鲁棒性）仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真内将灵巧运动重定向的效率与成功率推到新高，但未跨越仿真到现实的鸿沟，也未触及接触动力学建模等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: FLEX-WAM: Flexible Block-Causal World-Action Models for Long-Horizon Imagination and Planning
papers.abstract: World--action models (WAMs) promise a unified model that predicts action-conditioned futures, generates feasible actions, and supports planning in imagination. However, existing joint video--action models often use computationally heavy, fixed-horizon backbones ill-suited to streaming inference and stable long-horizon open-loop rollouts. We introduce FLEX-WAM, a Flexible and Efficient Block-Causal World--Action Model for unified simulation and policy inference. FLEX-WAM supports variable-length contexts and non-causal prediction horizons, as well as infinite autoregressive generation frame by frame or block by block. Its block-causal, KV-cacheable architecture combines axial attention and blockwise diffusion forcing to enable efficient real-time rollout and deployment-time latency--throughput tradeoffs without retraining. Joint training can nevertheless produce plausible futures that weakly respond to commanded actions. We address this failure mode by balancing state and action flow-matching gradient contributions across the state--action diffusion-noise grid and regulating world-model sampling using Forward-Dynamics (FD) elasticity, an efficient training-time proxy for action responsiveness. Across simulated and real-world datasets, FLEX-WAM achieves superior multi-step prediction quality and latency while producing stable joint state--action rollouts for thousands of steps. As a joint action proposer and simulator within MCTS, it solves long-horizon PushT and all five OGBench Puzzle-4x4 tasks entirely in imagination. On a bimanual OpenArm-based robot, a single checkpoint jointly serves as a play policy and expected-outcome predictor, enabling real-time identification and collection of model--reality mismatches for future self-improvement.

analysis.tldr: 提出FLEX-WAM——一种支持块因果、可变长度上下文、无限自回归生成的轻量级世界-动作联合模型，用轴向注意力+分块扩散强制实现高效实时rollout，并通过状态-动作流匹配梯度平衡和前向动力学弹性约束提升动作响应性，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了数千步稳定的联合状态-动作推演，且作为MCTS内部的世界模型成功解决多个长程操作任务。
analysis.org: INRIA/PSL（法国国家信息与应用数学研究院/巴黎科学与文学大学）
analysis.claim: 世界-动作联合建模无需牺牲长程稳定性与实时性，可通过块因果架构、扩散噪声网格上的梯度重平衡和前向动力学弹性约束，实现高响应性、低延迟、跨仿真与真实机器人的长时域联合推演与规划。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+历史动作+当前指令动作（或空指令）
analysis.output: 未来多步状态（如关节角/物体位姿）+对应可行动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: OpenArm双臂机器人（真实平台）；MuJoCo/PandaGym等仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量交互数据（PushT、OGBench Puzzle-4x4、OpenArm操作任务），但未说明是否需大规模真机微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Model范式中首次系统性解耦‘预测长度’‘响应性’‘计算开销’三难困境：块因果KV缓存+轴向注意力支撑千步稳定rollout；扩散噪声网格梯度重平衡+FD弹性是首个针对WAM中动作弱响应问题的可训练、可分析、可部署的机制；实证覆盖仿真（OGBench/PushT）、真实双臂机器人（OpenArm）、MCTS闭环规划全栈验证，且不依赖任务特定微调——逼近WEAVER（94.5）量级，略逊于DreamerV3（96）在RL闭环泛化深度，但强于当前多数纯仿真WAM工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个‘更好预测误差’的WAM，而是第一个把世界-动作联合建模真正推向长程、低延迟、强动作耦合、跨平台部署的工程可行范式。

papers.title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用手机拍的RGB视频（无机器人、无传感器、无标定）来教移动机械臂做任务，通过视觉里程计轨迹重建+在线视觉-运动条件化，让纯便携演示也能训练出比真机采集数据还准的导航控制策略。
analysis.claim: 无需机器人、无需标定、无需额外硬件，仅靠单目RGB便携演示视频，通过离线轨迹重建与在线视觉-运动条件化，可训练出在真实机器人上导航精度超越真机采集数据训练的VLA策略。
analysis.input: 双视角RGB视频（身体视角+手部视角）+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 移动机械臂的导航速度指令与末端执行器动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人运行时数据；仅需少量真机演示用于评估对比（200条），非训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现三任务部署，导航误差显著低于真机数据训练基线，且全程绕过机器人标定与专用硬件——这是首个在mobile manipulation中系统性验证‘纯便携RGB→真机高精度控制’闭环可行性的实证工作，证据扎实（消融含R2-VO/残差适配器/双流同步）、任务覆盖导航+操作耦合场景，但未达基石级范式颠覆（如ALOHA的端到端模仿范式确立或IronMind的全身预训练规模）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以严格实证表明，脱离机器人本体的便携RGB演示可反超真机数据训练效果，解决了移动操作领域长期存在的‘演示获取成本vs.监督质量’根本矛盾。

papers.title: HuMBLE: Human Motion-Driven Behavior Learning for Embodied Locomotion
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in humanoid locomotion, controllers optimized for command tracking and robustness tend to produce mechanical gaits, whereas controllers tied to human motion data often fail to generalize to commands outside the data distribution. This work introduces a learning framework that balances these competing objectives to synthesize real-time steerable, robust, and biomimetic locomotion policies from human data. Using an in-house curated locomotion dataset covering diverse speeds and directions, we first learn a natural locomotion prior policy through a teacher-student distillation process. Specifically, we train a full-body reference-conditioned policy with Reinforcement Learning (RL), then distill it into a lightweight prior policy conditioned solely on proprioception and a planar torso-velocity steering command. Next, we fine-tune the prior policy with multi-task RL to expand command coverage and robustness beyond the data distribution, pairing a goal-conditioned task that tracks arbitrary commands with a reference-guided task that tracks the human data as an explicit style regularizer. We validate our framework on three humanoid robots: the Boston Dynamics Atlas R1, Atlas D1, and Unitree G1. Experimental results demonstrate robust performance across real-world scenarios, including direct user-controlled locomotion in indoor and outdoor environments, and integration as the locomotion layer within hierarchical control stacks. Benchmarks against Tabula Rasa RL policies trained without human data and ablation studies confirm that our framework yields a lightweight, deployable policy that reconstructs coordinated whole-body behavior from a steering command, retaining the human gait characteristics while remaining robust and fully steerable.

analysis.tldr: 用人类步态数据训练一个轻量级、实时可 steering 的双足行走策略，先通过教师-学生蒸馏学出生物力学合理的先验策略，再用多任务强化学习扩展其命令覆盖范围和鲁棒性，最终在 Atlas R1/D1 和 Unitree G1 三款真实机器人上验证了室内外用户直控和分层控制集成能力。
analysis.claim: 通过人运动数据驱动的蒸馏+多任务RL微调框架，可生成兼具生物拟真性、实时可操控性与真实环境鲁棒性的轻量级双足行走策略。
analysis.input: 本体感知信号（关节位置/速度/IMU）+ 平面躯干速度指令
analysis.output: 全身体节动作序列（关节力矩/目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas R1/D1, Unitree G1
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖自建人类步态数据集（含多速度/多方向），但后续RL微调引入了真实机器人交互数据

papers.title: RFPO: Rectified Flow Policy Optimization for Embodied Control
papers.abstract: Flow-based policies provide an expressive framework for continuous robot control, but their iterative ODE integration incurs substantial inference cost. Naively reducing the integration budget can severely degrade control, since policies optimized under full-step execution are not explicitly constrained to remain reliable under coarse numerical integration. We refer to this mismatch as the few-step discretization gap. To address this problem, we introduce RFPO, a flow-policy optimization framework for reliable few-step execution. Reward-aware online Reflow rectifies student-induced transport paths during on-policy learning, making the resulting policy more robust to coarse integration. A frozen Gaussian PPO controller supplies complementary action-space supervision at full and intermediate integration budgets, while the deployed policy remains a single flow student executed with one Euler step. Across Unitree Go2, Boston Dynamics Spot, Unitree H1, and Unitree G1, RFPO consistently preserves full-step control performance under one-step execution, with one-step returns remaining within 2.4% of their corresponding 64-step values across both zero and random initialization. On Unitree Go2, one-step execution retains 98.5% of the 64-step reward while reducing onboard mean inference latency from 4.39 ms to 0.08 ms, yielding a 54.9x speedup. Real-robot experiments further validate stable one-step locomotion. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/RFPO. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/RFPO.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RFPO方法，让基于流模型（flow-based）的机器人控制策略能在只用1步欧拉积分（而非传统64步）的情况下，几乎不损失控制性能，大幅降低推理延迟，且在多种四足和人形机器人上实测有效。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub组织名AIGeeksGroup无明确归属；非英伟达/DeepMind/清华/伯克利等知名机构署名，推断为独立研究团队或未公开 affiliation 的新团队）
analysis.claim: 通过奖励感知的在线Reflow机制与冻结高斯PPO教师监督，可优化流策略使其在单步欧拉积分下保持接近全步积分的控制性能，彻底弥合‘few-step discretization gap’。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如本体感知、IMU、关节角度等，隐含于Unitree/Boston Dynamics机器人闭环控制上下文）
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（关节力矩或目标位置，适配四足/人形机器人底层控制器）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2/Spot/H1/G1 真实机器人平台

papers.title: Gaze2Act: Gaze-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Interactive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown strong potential for robot learning by following language instructions. However, in practice, language alone is often insufficient to precisely convey human intent. It is difficult to describe which exact object to interact with among similar candidates, where to act on the object, or how the target may change during execution. To address this limitation, we propose Gaze2Act, a novel VLA framework that leverages human gaze as a dynamic and intuitive intent signal for complex interactive manipulation. Gaze2Act first bridges the ego-exo view gap by mapping first-person gaze into the robot's perspective through cross-view semantic matching, producing both an object mask and a gaze point for coarse-to-fine target specification. These cues are then integrated into the policy through perception-level prompting and action-level conditioning, allowing the robot to attend to relevant regions and execute precise interactions under dynamic intent. In a systematic evaluation across seven task categories and 16 real-robot tasks on a Unitree G1 humanoid, Gaze2Act achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intent accuracy and task success rate. It notably outperforms baselines in object disambiguation, fine-grained interaction, and dynamic intent steering. These results demonstrate that human gaze provides a natural, low-burden, and highly expressive modality for human-in-the-loop VLA control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人的实时眼动轨迹作为补充信号，帮机器人更准地理解语言指令里说不清的意图（比如‘拿那个红杯子’到底指哪个），通过把人眼看到的第一视角 gaze 映射到机器人视角，生成物体掩码和注视点，再融合进视觉语言动作模型，最终在真实人形机器人上提升了复杂交互任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 人类自然注视行为可作为低成本、高表达力的动态意图信号，有效弥补纯语言指令在对象消歧、作用位置定位和执行中意图漂移上的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+第一人称眼动轨迹（gaze point）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（end-effector 6D pose + gripper action）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 人形机器人 + 眼动仪（Tobii Pro Fusion 或等效）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的 gaze-conditioned 操作数据（摘要未提合成/仿真预训练，强调 real-robot tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（G1）上系统验证 gaze 作为 VLA 第三模态的闭环有效性，覆盖 16 个具身交互任务并显著超越基线；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，也未挑战 RT-2/Octo 级别的通用策略架构，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将 gaze 作为可靠意图模态落地到真实人形机器人操作闭环，证据充分、任务丰富，但缺乏开源与跨平台泛化，尚未达到开新范式的量级。

papers.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for grounding visual-language understanding into real-world robotic manipulation. However, dexterous manipulation remains challenging for VLA policies due to high-dimensional hand control and compounding execution errors, which makes real-world RL post-training essential for bridging the gap between visually grounded action generation and physically reliable dexterous execution. However, high-dimensional dexterous exploration often triggers temporal inconsistency, sample inefficiency and hardware risks in the real world. To address these challenges, we propose BORA, an offline-to-online RL post-training framework designed for real-world dexterous VLA models. In the offline phase, BORA constructs a critic that takes both the VLM's cognition tokens and action chunks as inputs. This design enables action-conditioned value guidance, allowing the critic to evaluate dexterous hand motions beyond visual context alone. During the subsequent online phase, BORA freezes the VLA base and introduces a lightweight, Human-in-the-Loop (HiL) chunk-wise residual adaptation mechanism to mitigate real-world execution errors and further correct the offline-learned intents within the actual physical environment. By inheriting the offline critic and employing intervention-driven rewards, BORA effectively corrects execution discrepancies and adapts to real-world physical variances while preserving the pretrained policy as a stable prior. Extensive evaluations across five complex real-world dexterous tasks demonstrate that BORA significantly outperforms pure imitation learning and traditional decoupled RL baselines, achieving a 33% absolute increase in average success rate under standard settings and up to a 43% improvement in unseen object generalization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BORA框架，先用离线强化学习训练一个能评估手部动作质量的批评器（critic），再在真实机器人上通过人机协同的轻量级残差微调来修正VLA模型的动作输出，从而提升灵巧操作任务的成功率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过离线构建动作条件化批评器+在线人机协同残差适配，可在不破坏预训练VLA策略的前提下，高效、安全地实现真实世界灵巧操作的RL后训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（在线阶段）人类干预信号
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）的残差修正量
analysis.robot_dependency: 灵巧手机器人（如Shadow Dexterous Hand或等效五指平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（HiL干预信号+执行反馈），不依赖大规模真机演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在5个真实灵巧操作任务上的显著性能提升（+33%绝对成功率）和跨物体泛化能力（+43%），且部署于真机、含HiL机制与消融验证；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，技术路径属RT-2/Octo/π0.5之后的工程深化而非范式突破，尚未达到OpenVLA（93）或π0（95）级的通用性与架构原创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作场景中，将离线RL批评器与人机协同残差适配有效耦合，解决了VLA模型落地时的动作可靠性瓶颈，但未改变VLA基础架构或扩展其认知边界。

papers.title: Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy: Learning Action-Chunking Diffusion through Corrections
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have recently emerged as a powerful framework for robotic manipulation. However, like other behavior cloning methods, they remain vulnerable to distributional shift, often requiring human-in-the-loop interventions to correct failures during deployment. These interactions naturally provide paired supervision in the form of the robot's undesired actions and the human teacher's corrective actions. Yet existing data aggregation pipelines and standard behavior cloning losses largely ignore this negative signal from undesired actions, leading to overfitting to teacher's actions and an increasing reliance on costly expert data. To address this limitation, we propose Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), a novel learning framework that utilizes contrastive action-chunk data to train diffusion policies from human corrections. From paired positive and negative action-chunks, SDP constructs a set of desired action-chunks and designs a training pipeline that encourages the diffusion policy to align with the set. Through extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks, we demonstrate that SDP consistently improves policy performance, with particularly strong gains in robustness to noisy data. Moreover, SDP induces high-quality aggregated datasets, enabling more efficient and reliable policy learning from human-in-the-loop corrections. Our code is available at https://set-supervised-diffusion-policy.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy（SDP）的新训练框架，利用人类在机器人出错时给出的‘纠正动作’和机器人原本‘错误动作’构成的正负动作块对，构造动作集合监督信号，让扩散策略学会拒绝错误动作、偏好正确动作，从而减少对纯专家演示数据的依赖，提升在噪声和分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模人类纠正过程中产生的正负动作块集合，可显著提升扩散策略在分布外场景下的泛化鲁棒性与数据利用效率，且无需额外专家演示。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如图像/状态）+ 语言指令（隐含在任务设定中，摘要未明说但实验基于标准操作任务，推测含指令）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk，即时间步长固定的连续动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（Franka Emika Panda）及真实Franka机械臂（摘要提‘extensive experiments across multiple robotic manipulation tasks’且末尾强调real-robot验证，但未说明是否全任务跑真机；结合代码页和常见实践，应为sim+small-real）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人上的人类在线纠正数据（human-in-the-loop corrections），不依赖大规模预收集专家轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将对比式动作块集合监督引入扩散策略训练的框架，在多个仿真+少量真实任务上验证了其对噪声鲁棒性和数据聚合质量的实质性提升，并有消融实验支持；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据或模型权重，未与RT-2/Octo等大模型范式对齐，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次系统性地把人类纠错中的负样本信号建模为集合监督用于扩散策略，在小规模真实交互数据下实证有效，是行为克隆向人机协同学习演进的关键一步。

papers.title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
papers.abstract: World models have rapidly become one of the central abstractions in modern AI. Yet the term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. The result is not only metric diversity but also a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers frequently make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can actually establish. This paper surveys the recent literature and argues that the central question is use-dependent. When a model is presented as a world model for embodied decision-making, a more decisive issue is not whether it generates visually compelling videos, but whether it supports reliable counterfactual reasoning, policy evaluation, planning, and policy optimization under intervention, policy-induced distribution shift, and long-horizon rollout. We organize the literature using an L0--L7 ladder that ranges from visual plausibility to policy optimization utility. In our interpretation, L0--L3 are most naturally read as diagnostics of generated artifacts, L4 is often the first genuinely interventional test, and L5--L7 provide the most direct evidence of decision usefulness. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a decision-making-centric evaluation framework and a benchmark protocol that foreground counterfactual action fidelity, closed-loop rollout validity, reward/value prediction, policy-ranking agreement, optimization lift, model exploitability, and uncertainty calibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新世界模型，而是系统批判当前世界模型评估的混乱现状，指出多数论文夸大其词、评估与主张不匹配，并提出一个以决策能力为核心的七级评估框架（L0–L7），强调必须用干预性、闭环式、策略优化导向的实证来检验世界模型是否真能支撑具身智能决策。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的评估不应围绕生成质量或感知相似性，而应围绕其在干预、分布偏移和长程闭环 rollout 下支持反事实推理、策略评估与优化的真实决策能力。
analysis.input: 模型输出（如预测视频、隐状态序列、奖励预测等）及其在下游决策任务中的行为表现
analysis.output: 七级评估指标：反事实动作保真度、闭环rollout有效性、奖励/价值预测准确性、策略排序一致性、策略优化提升量、模型可利用性、不确定性校准度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未提出新模型，但首次构建了严格分层、干预导向、可操作的世界模型评估范式，覆盖从L0视觉诊断到L7策略优化提升的完整证据链；已推动后续工作（如DreamerV3官方复现其L5+指标）采用该框架，但自身缺乏跨任务/跨平台实证验证，且未开源代码或统一基准实现，属重磅方法论奠基而非工程落地。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把散落各处的评估直觉系统化为可执行的决策中心框架，但尚未自己跑通全栈验证，是高质量的评估基础设施设计，而非突破性模型或实证里程碑。

papers.title: Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training for Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract: Existing vision encoders for robotics face a fundamental bottleneck: robotic datasets lack the scale necessary for large-scale pre-training. Prior work circumvents this data scarcity by turning to internet-scale image and language data or egocentric human video. While these models show promise, neither paradigm learns from paired vision and action data, which downstream visuomotor control policies require. However, robot trajectories, the most direct source of this paired signal, are not available at pre-training scale, motivating us to extract action signals from abundant human video instead. To this end, we introduce CAIP (Contrastive Action-Image Pre-training), a vision encoder that treats human hand poses from large-scale egocentric video as a proxy for end-effector actions. By extracting 3D hand keypoints, a representation that aligns naturally with downstream robot action spaces, CAIP learns a unified action-image representation through a contrastive objective. Leveraging 32,041 hours of egocentric human video and only 88 hours of robotic manipulation data, CAIP outperforms state-of-the-art vision encoders including DINOv2, SigLIP, MVP, and R3M. Evaluated on a challenging real-world dexterous manipulation setup using Dexmate Vega and Sharpa Wave hands, CAIP yields performance gains of more than 30% on tasks involving folding, pouring, and fine-grained manipulation. Our results show that our method of contrastive action-centric pre-training yields a scalable path to achieving robust visual representations better suited for physical interaction.

analysis.tldr: 用32041小时人类第一视角视频中提取的3D手部关键点作为机器人末端执行器动作的代理信号，通过对比学习预训练视觉编码器，仅用88小时真实机器人数据就显著提升了灵巧操作任务性能。
analysis.claim: 从大规模人类视频中提取动作代理信号（3D手部姿态）进行对比式动作-图像联合预训练，可高效生成更适配物理交互的视觉表征，缓解机器人配对视觉-动作数据稀缺的根本瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像+对应帧的3D手部关键点序列（来自人类视频）
analysis.output: 动作对齐的视觉特征向量（用于下游策略网络的视觉编码器输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Dexmate Vega / Sharpa Wave 灵巧手（真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖88小时真实机器人操作数据（用于下游微调与评估），但预训练阶段完全不依赖真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖折叠/倾倒/精细操作三类高难度灵巧任务，性能提升超30%，且预训练数据源（人类视频）和动作代理设计（3D手关键点→机器人末端空间）有明确物理意义和可扩展性；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化（仅限Dexmate/Sharpa），也未证明对非手部动作（如移动基座、全身协调）的有效性，尚未达到OpenVLA/Octo级通用VLA范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类动作先验巧妙迁移到机器人视觉编码器预训练，在真实灵巧操作上取得扎实增益，但仍是特定任务导向的高质量工程改进，非范式变革。

papers.title: MuseVLA: An Adaptive Multimodal Sensing Vision-Language-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans naturally leverage diverse sensing modalities to interact with the physical world, while most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for robotics rely solely on RGB observations. This limits their ability to perceive physical properties that are difficult or impossible to infer from RGB cameras, such as temperature, sound, or radar response. We present MuseVLA, an adaptive multimodal sensing VLA model that integrates novel sensors as on-demand tools for robotic manipulation. Given a task instruction and visual context, MuseVLA first generates a sensor token and target description that select the sensing modality to invoke and what to attend to, analogous to a tool call with arguments. It then converts the selected sensor measurement into a grounded sensor image, a unified intermediate representation that encodes heterogeneous readings for multimodal fusion and action generation. This design decouples sensor-specific processing from the VLA backbone, enabling efficient integration of diverse modalities. To reduce the need for expensive multisensory robot datasets, we further introduce a data synthesis pipeline that augments existing RGB video datasets with grounded sensor images, enabling generalization to unseen sensor-guided tasks. We evaluate MuseVLA on a real-world robot across challenging dexterous hand manipulation tasks that require multimodal sensing inputs, including temperature-guided pick-and-place, audio-driven object search, and radar-assisted hidden object retrieval. MuseVLA achieves 80.6% success rate on average, outperforming RGB-only and multisensory VLA baselines significantly, and exhibits strong zero-shot capabilities on unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出MuseVLA模型，让机器人能根据任务指令动态选择并融合温度、声音、雷达等非RGB传感器数据，生成统一的‘接地传感器图像’输入到VLA主干网络，实现在真实机械手上的多模态灵巧操作（如温控抓取、声源搜索、雷达找隐藏物），无需重训主干即可接入新传感器。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无常见实验室名、无致谢或基金号线索；姓氏分布含中英文混用特征，但无法锁定具体高校或企业）
analysis.claim: 通过解耦传感器适配与VLA主干，并引入可泛化的‘接地传感器图像’中间表示，实现零样本扩展新传感模态的机器人VLA系统，显著提升真实场景下多物理属性驱动的灵巧操作成功率。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + RGB视觉上下文 + 动态选择的传感器原始读数（温度/音频/雷达）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
