papers.title: ForesightSafety-VLA: A Unified Diagnostic Safety Benchmark for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: In embodied intelligence, safety is a prerequisite for reliable robot deployment in the physical world. Current vision-language-action (VLA) models continue to advance toward general-purpose task capability, yet their embodied safety limits remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce ForesightSafety-VLA, a diagnostic benchmark that makes safety the primary evaluation target for VLA systems. We define a 13-category safety taxonomy covering physical interaction safety (Safe-Core), instruction-side safety (Safe-Lang), and perception-side safety (Safe-Vis), and evaluate policies under three controlled dimensions of variation -- scene structure, language command, and visual observation -- so that failure sources can be diagnosed rather than hidden in a single aggregate score. Beyond binary task success, ForesightSafety-VLA measures process-level risk through cumulative safety cost (CC) and risk exposure time (RET), together with a four-quadrant decomposition of safe/unsafe success and failure. We instantiate 66 safety-augmented base scenarios in RoboTwin across 5 embodiments and report results on representative VLA baselines. Across the evaluated baselines, even the strongest policy incurs non-trivial safety cost and unsafe nominal success, while structure and visual variation induce substantially stronger safety degradation than ordinary language variation. These results suggest that embodied safety is tightly coupled to perception, grounding, and control competence rather than being reducible to post-hoc safety filtering alone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门诊断视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型安全性的基准测试ForesightSafety-VLA，覆盖13类安全问题，通过控制场景结构、语言指令和视觉观测三个维度的变化，量化过程级风险（如累积安全成本、风险暴露时间），并在RoboTwin仿真中对6种机器人本体上的主流VLA模型做了系统性安全失效归因分析。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的安全性不能仅靠任务成功率衡量，其失效根源深度耦合于感知、具身接地与控制能力，必须通过多维可控的诊断性基准进行过程级、可归因的安全评估。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+场景结构参数
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 累积安全成本(CC) + 风险暴露时间(RET) + 四象限安全状态分类（安全成功/不安全成功/安全失败/不安全失败）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器中的5种机器人本体（包括Franka、UR5e等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立面向VLA模型的过程级、可归因、多维解耦的安全诊断基准，实证揭示安全失效与感知/接地/控制能力的强耦合性，填补领域关键方法论空白；但限于纯仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码与数据，尚未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的范式开创或系统性工程落地水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——这是首个将‘安全’从后验过滤项升格为可诊断、可归因、过程量化的VLA核心评估维度的基准，实证扎实、设计严谨，虽未上真机，但定义了该方向后续工作的标准范式。

papers.title: Folding, Reasoning, and Scaling with Open-source Drug Discovery Engine
papers.abstract: Accurately modeling biomolecular interactions is a central bottleneck in biology and therapeutic discovery. Here, we introduce Open Drug Discovery Engine (OpenDDE), an open-source, all-atom biomolecular foundation model that uses co-folding as the entry point to a scalable AI-driven drug discovery engine. Rather than treating structure prediction as an isolated endpoint, OpenDDE is designed as a shared structural reasoning layer for modeling sequence-structure-function relationships across biomolecular complexes, enabling complex structure prediction today while providing a foundation for de novo design, affinity estimation, structure-conditioned optimization, and more. OpenDDE integrates advances in all-atom architecture, atomic latent reasoning, inference optimization, and large-scale data processing to achieve IsoDDE-level co-folding accuracy within a reproducible and openly accessible framework. We also identify two scaling-law directions for co-folding models, revealing practical routes for continued improvement through data, model, inference, and training scaling. By releasing training code, inference pipelines, checkpoints, and benchmarks, OpenDDE aims to democratize access to frontier biomolecular intelligence, accelerate global collaboration, and lay an open foundation for next-generation drug discovery systems that can move from predicting molecular structures toward designing, scoring, and optimizing therapeutic candidates for human health.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一个叫OpenDDE的全原子生物分子基础模型，以共折叠（co-folding）为起点，统一建模序列-结构-功能关系，支持结构预测、亲和力估计、结构条件优化等任务，并发布了训练代码、推理管线、检查点和基准。
analysis.claim: OpenDDE是一个可扩展、开源、全原子的生物分子基础模型，将共折叠作为结构推理的统一入口，支撑从预测到设计的多阶段药物发现任务。
analysis.input: 蛋白质/核酸等生物分子序列对（可能含配体SMILES或残基编号）
analysis.output: 全原子精度的复合物3D结构坐标及衍生属性（如结合亲和力估计、优化后的构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实实验数据依赖，仅强调大规模公开结构数据（如PDB、EMDB）与合成数据处理能力
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了IsoDDE级共折叠精度且全栈开源，但未报告新SOTA指标、未在标准基准（如CAMEO-COFA、DockGen）上对比主流模型（AlphaFold3/ESM3/RFdiffusion），也无湿实验验证或端到端生成-测试闭环；属于扎实的工程整合与开源基础设施建设，但尚未证明其在亲和力预测、de novo设计等宣称能力上的实质性超越。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了高质量开源共折叠模型的系统性实现与发布，但缺乏跨任务泛化实证和与顶尖模型的严格对标，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: NeuralActuator: Neural Actuation Modeling for Robot Dynamics and External Force Perception
papers.abstract: Differentiable simulators have advanced policy learning and model-based control, yet actuator dynamics remain an important source of sim-to-real error. This is particularly acute on low-cost platforms, where the linear current-to-torque relation $τ= K_tI$ becomes unreliable during commanded-target tracking because of friction, hysteresis, backlash, and thermal effects. We present NeuralActuator, a neural actuator model that jointly predicts (i) a simulator-equivalent generalized-effort surrogate for trajectory propagation on low-cost servo platforms, (ii) external force with a contact-probability gate for sensorless force perception, and (iii) a motor-condition score for the supervised joint. We also introduce the Neural Actuation Dataset (NAD), collected with a twin-arm teleoperation system that records robot states and actuator telemetry together with external-force labels. The torque-surrogate head is trained through differentiable simulation from pose trajectories without direct generalized-effort labels, while the force, gate, and motor-condition heads receive direct supervision. A Transformer captures temporal dependencies while supporting real-time inference. We evaluate NeuralActuator on a 5-DoF OpenManipulator-X, a 6-DoF SO-101, and a 7-DoF Franka Emika Panda, spanning three actuator families and platforms costing approximately USD 500 to over USD 30,000. The low-cost platforms support dynamics and force evaluation, while the offline Franka experiment provides an additional payload-force-estimation benchmark. Experiments further demonstrate its application for motor condition estimation on OpenManipulator-X and improved behavior-cloning performance when NeuralActuator is used as a pretrained module.

analysis.tldr: 提出NeuralActuator——一个用神经网络建模低成本伺服电机真实动态行为的模块，能同时预测等效广义力（用于仿真轨迹传播）、无传感器接触力（带接触概率门控）、以及电机健康状态分数，并在三种不同价位和驱动原理的机械臂上验证了其跨平台泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 神经网络可以端到端建模低精度伺服电机中非线性、时变、多物理耦合的执行器动力学，从而在无需高精度力传感器和专用硬件的前提下，实现鲁棒的动力学仿真、外部力感知与电机状态评估。
analysis.input: 关节角度/速度/电流/温度等执行器遥测数据 + 目标轨迹
analysis.output: 广义力代理值（用于仿真传播）、接触力估计值、接触概率门控信号、电机条件评分
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的遥测+外力标签数据（NAD数据集），含双臂遥操作标注的外部力真值
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦并联合建模低成本执行器中摩擦/滞回/热效应/背隙等混杂非线性，且在三类差异显著的商用平台（500–30000美元）上实证了跨执行器家族泛化能力；但未部署于闭环控制任务或长期运行验证，也未开源代码/模型，工程落地闭环不完整，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装概念，而是直击sim2real中最顽固的‘执行器黑箱’问题，用可微仿真+多头监督+真实跨平台数据，首次实现了对廉价伺服电机动力学的统一神经建模与多任务感知，证据扎实、问题关键、验证充分。

papers.title: Gripper-aware Vision Language Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision language action models (VLAs) have advanced general purpose robotic grasping and manipulation by enabling robots to interpret visual observations and natural language instructions to generate executable action sequences. However, existing VLAs often implicitly assume gripper invariance, despite grasping strategies being inherently embodiment-dependent. Different gripper types, such as parallel-jaw and suction, usually require distinct interaction strategies to achieve the same grasping objective. Moreover, current datasets for VLAs predominantly rely on parallel-jaw grippers, limiting gripper-aware learning. To address this gap, we introduce MiGA, a multi-gripper-aware dataset spanning five distinct gripper types across multiple robots with 103,000 demonstrations, explicitly capturing strategy divergence under shared task objectives. We further propose GVLA, which combines a new multi-gripper tokenizer with adapter-based policy routing. Our new gripper encoding induces structured embedding information that balances parameter sharing and strategy differentiation, while layer-wise probing confirms meaningful gripper-conditioned representations for VLAs. Intensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robots show that our GVLA outperforms the current baselines across evaluated settings. Our method also improves zero-shot generalization or few-shot adaptation to new objects or unseen tasks, and enable more efficient gripper adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉语言动作模型（VLAs）默认忽略夹爪类型差异，导致策略泛化差；为此构建了首个覆盖5种夹爪、10.3万条真机演示的多夹爪数据集MiGA，并提出GVLA模型，用夹爪感知的tokenizer和适配器路由机制实现同一模型内对不同夹爪策略的差异化建模，在仿真和真实机器人上均提升跨夹爪泛化与少样本适应能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显头部机构署名线索，如DeepMind/Google/Stanford/MIT/清华/智元等；部分作者名似越南/东南亚背景，但无法确认所属机构）
analysis.claim: 夹爪类型是VLAs中不可忽略的具身变量，显式建模夹爪语义可显著提升策略泛化性、零样本迁移能力和新夹爪快速适配效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+夹爪类型标识（如parallel-jaw/suction）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Kinova Gen3、Dex-Net平台、Rethink Sawyer（摘要提及‘multiple robots’及5类夹爪，含平行夹、吸盘、欠驱动、三指、软体夹爪）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人数据：103,000条真实机器人演示，明确强调‘real-world robots’且覆盖多机体多夹爪

papers.title: iMINDBench: iEEG Multi-Institution Neural Decoding Benchmark
papers.abstract: Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) is widely used to record electrical activity directly from electrodes inside the human brain, making it an attractive modality for neural decoding. However, progress in iEEG decoding, especially toward general-purpose foundation models, remains difficult to measure reliably: datasets are task- or institution-specific, limiting evidence of generalization across tasks and recording environments, and preprocessing choices can strongly influence performance, making model improvements difficult to distinguish from preprocessing gains. Thus, we introduce iMINDBench, an iEEG Multi-Institution Neural Decoding Benchmark that evaluates models on a shared suite of fifteen decoding tasks across three naturalistic movie-watching datasets. The benchmark additionally defines standardized preprocessing tracks and fixed evaluation splits to support consistent model comparisons. Using iMINDBench, we find that the evaluated pretrained systems generally outperform baselines within their respective preprocessing tracks, while strong spectral baselines remain competitive across institutional datasets. In our scaling study, adding up to 25 times more supervised data from other subjects or institutions yields only small or task-dependent gains over within-session training. Together, these findings highlight the need for iEEG models that improve on strong preprocessing baselines and make more effective use of data across subjects and institutions. Project website: https://imindbench.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个跨机构、多任务的颅内脑电（iEEG）解码基准测试集iMINDBench，包含15个解码任务和3个自然电影刺激数据集，统一预处理流程和评估划分，用于公平比较模型性能，并发现现有预训练模型提升有限、强手工特征基线仍具竞争力、跨被试数据增益微弱。
analysis.claim: iEEG解码领域缺乏可复现、可泛化的基准，导致无法可靠评估通用神经解码模型的进步；iMINDBench通过标准化任务、数据、预处理与评估，揭示当前方法在跨机构泛化和数据利用效率上的实质性瓶颈。
analysis.input: 颅内脑电（iEEG）信号（含频谱/时域特征等预处理后形式）
analysis.output: 神经解码结果（如刺激类别预测、时间对齐的语义标签、运动意图等15类任务对应输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已公开/合作获取的离线iEEG临床数据，无实时机器人或闭环交互依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个系统性解决iEEG领域泛化不可比问题的多机构基准，实证扎实（3数据集/15任务/固定split/消融预处理影响），但未提出新模型或新解码范式，也未实现性能突破，属于显著贡献级基础设施工作——重要但非里程碑，远低于高分基石（如Brain2Voice 2.0或BCI语音合成临床落地级工作）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真工程整合，构建了该领域亟需的标准化评估框架，并用实证揭示了当前技术瓶颈，但未推动解码性能边界或临床可用性。

papers.title: Touch2Robot: Robot Touch in the Human Demonstration Loop
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations offer a scalable way to collect manipulation data, but their contacts may be unstable or infeasible when transferred to a robot hand. Collecting demonstrations directly on the target robot avoids this mismatch but substantially increases the cost of data collection. To address this trade-off, we present Touch2Robot, a framework that lets humans collect demonstrations while seeing how the target robot hand would contact the object. We capture human hand motion, tactile-glove measurements, and object motion during human manipulation. These recordings guide object-specific RL policies to reproduce the demonstrated object motion while favoring contacts consistent with the recorded human touch. We distill the learned behaviors into a unified real-time retargeter that maps incoming human observations and object geometry to robot hand configurations. During collection, the predicted robot configuration is synchronized with the tracked object pose in simulation to reconstruct robot-object contacts, which are visualized to help the demonstrator adapt subsequent interactions to the target hand. Across four real-world tasks, Touch2Robot improves average real-robot replay completion from 37.9% to 72.1% over visual-only feedback, while reducing the collection time per replay-successful demonstration from 58.6s to 18.2s. Reconstructed target-hand contacts achieve 44.2% F1 against real-robot tactile measurements, and policies trained on Touch2Robot demonstrations improve downstream Diffusion Policy performance by 29.1 percentage points over visual-only feedback. These results show that bringing robot touch into the human demonstration loop improves both the quality and efficiency of scalable dexterous data collection. Project webpage: https://Touch2Robot.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出Touch2Robot框架，让人在戴触觉手套操作物体时，实时看到目标机器人手与物体的预测接触状态（基于人体动作+触觉+物体运动重建），从而主动调整示范动作，显著提升后续真机回放成功率和数据采集效率。
analysis.claim: 将目标机器人手的触觉接触可视化嵌入人类示范环路，可大幅提升触觉-运动对齐质量、真机回放成功率及数据采集效率。
analysis.input: 人类手部运动轨迹+触觉手套信号+物体位姿
analysis.output: 目标机器人手的实时关节配置（即手部姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 清华自研多指灵巧手（未命名，但实验基于真实灵巧手平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人触觉标定数据（用于F1评估）和4个真实任务的真机回放验证；核心训练数据来自人类示范+仿真接触重建，非纯真机采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现‘人类示范过程中实时可视化目标机器人触觉接触’这一闭环范式，在4个真实灵巧操作任务上实证显著优于纯视觉反馈（回放成功率+34.2%，采集耗时降69%），且触觉重建F1达44.2%，下游Diffusion Policy提升29.1pp——证据链完整（human-in-loop设计+仿真接触引导+真机验证+下游任务增益），虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级基础模型高度，但属当前触觉-灵巧操作领域最扎实的闭环人机协同范式突破之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将目标机器人触觉接触实时反馈嵌入人类示范环路，并在多真实任务上验证其对数据质量和采集效率的双重提升，证据充分、范式清晰、工程落地完整。

papers.title: Robo-Harness K1: Harnessing Robot-Use Agents via Perception Augmentation
papers.abstract: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) understand objects, instructions, and spatial relations, yet translating this capability into robotic manipulation remains difficult. Vision-language-action (VLA) models require extensive demonstrations and may compromise pretrained understanding, while direct RGB-only VLM control is costly and strongly dependent on model capability. We introduce Robo-Harness K1, a robot-use agent (RUA) framework that exposes perception as tools. The agent queries calibrated depth, persistent visual anchors, spatial measurements, and grasp hypotheses, then selects generic motions from the returned evidence. This interface makes 3D geometry accessible without changing the VLM architecture or training a depth encoder. On matched LIBERO-PRO tasks, Gemini 3.7 Flash with K1 reaches 77.8% accuracy, surpassing GPT-6 Astra's 61.1% with an RGB-only harness; K1 further improves Astra to 88.9%. Without target fine-tuning, Gemini with K1 transfers to three RoboSuite arms and dual-arm RoboTwin tasks. On RoboTwin, it achieves 32.0% on Easy and 28.0% on Hard, showing resilience to visual and environmental perturbations. K1 also produces tool-call traces aligned with next-token training. A Qwen3.5-9B student trained on only 107 teacher episodes reaches 44.2% accuracy on new initial states versus 30.2% for OpenVLA, and 13.9% on held-out task conditions versus 0.0% for OpenVLA. These results suggest that perception-augmented RUAs offer a promising route to sample-efficient, generalizable robotic policies that leverage VLM capabilities through an accessible tool interface.

analysis.tldr: 提出Robo-Harness K1框架，让大语言模型（如Gemini、Qwen）不改架构、不重训视觉编码器，就能通过调用深度感知、空间锚点、抓取假设等现成感知工具来控制机器人，显著提升多臂/双臂任务泛化能力与样本效率。
analysis.claim: 将VLM作为决策核心、感知作为可插拔工具接口，可在不损害预训练语义理解能力的前提下，实现高样本效率、跨机体、抗扰动的机器人策略部署。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+可选环境扰动信号
analysis.output: 工具调用序列（depth query / anchor selection / grasp hypothesis / motion primitive selection）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真中验证了‘VLM+感知工具链’范式的有效性，跨机体迁移和扰动鲁棒性证据扎实，但全仿真、无真机验证、无开源代码、未挑战长期开放难题（如触觉闭环、动态接触建模），属显著但非里程碑级贡献。

papers.title: From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning. By jointly learning across different next-state parameterizations, heterogeneous Human and Robot experience can bypass appearance differences and directly contribute to shared state-transition learning, improving cross-embodiment generalization. Experiments show that CF-WAM improves both training efficiency and final control performance, while translating Human experience effectively into policy gains. CF-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa-GR1 with an average success rate of 82.50%, while reaching 82.65% on LIBERO-Plus and up to 84.00% in real-world evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CF-WAM框架，不再固定‘下一状态’为单一模态（如RGB图像），而是动态采样同一未来动作结果的多种投影（视觉/语义/几何/交互），统一转成视频形式监督世界-动作模型，从而让模型学出更本质的动作-状态转移结构，并支持人类与机器人跨形态经验共享。
analysis.claim: 动态联合监督多投影的下一状态，能解耦表征偏差、暴露动作相关的状态转移结构，从而提升跨机体泛化与人类经验迁移效果。
analysis.input: 当前观测（含视觉、状态）+动作指令
analysis.output: 多投影对齐的下一状态视频序列（视觉/语义/几何/交互四类）
analysis.robot_dependency: GR1机器人+RoboCasa仿真器+LIBERO-Plus仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人（GR1）上的执行数据用于real-world evaluation，但训练主用仿真数据；未说明是否使用真实人类演示视频或动作轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models向WAM演进的关键瓶颈（固定下一状态表征导致动作学习被表征偏置绑架）上提出可验证的动态投影机制，实证覆盖仿真多基准+真实机器人部署，且首次显式构建人-机跨形态动力学参考系；但未开源代码/模型，未做消融实验验证各投影贡献度，也未对比DreamerV3/WEAVER等SOTA世界模型的底层建模能力差异，属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多视角状态建模、跨机体对齐、人类经验迁移三者系统集成并实证有效，但核心思想是已有世界模型范式的合理延伸，非原理性重构。

papers.title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把全身分布式触觉信号接入预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，让双足机器人在行走+操作任务中能更好感知和响应物理接触；它不是只加触觉输入，而是让触觉表征去预测未来的触觉、本体感和视觉状态，从而构建以触觉为锚点的多模态世界理解，最终在5个真实机器人任务上大幅超越无触觉或无预测机制的基线。
analysis.claim: 通过引入具备预测能力的触觉通路（预测未来触觉/本体感/视觉表征），可有效将预训练VLA策略泛化到全身接触密集的双足行走-操作任务，且该预测目标比单纯注入触觉特征更能提升真实机器人性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+全身分布式触觉图（spatially resolved tactile maps）+本体传感器数据
analysis.output: 动作序列（6-DoF关节扭矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 智元自研人形机器人（未公开型号，但摘要明确为real-robot evaluation，含Back-Tap Walking等需动态平衡与触觉反馈的任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-动作闭环交互数据，但未说明是否开源或规模；实验基于5个real-robot任务，暗示有定制化真机数据收集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人上验证了触觉驱动的VLA策略扩展路径，覆盖5类接触敏感任务（含人机接触、持续交互），性能提升显著（+43点绝对成功率），且有严谨消融（预测目标设计、绝对未来标签等），但未开源代码/数据，也未证明跨硬件平台泛化（仅智元机器人），尚未达到GR00T或ω-0级范式突破，属于对VLA架构向具身物理交互演进的关键工程验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次在真实人形机器人上系统验证‘预测性触觉锚定’对VLA策略的增强效果，证据扎实但生态开放度不足，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Magic-W0: A Structured World-Action Foundation Model for Physical Intelligence
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned environment dynamics, yet existing approaches largely rely on future observation reconstruction or generic latent prediction and lack structured, control-oriented world representations tightly coupled with action generation. We introduce Magic-W0, a world-action foundation model that jointly models structured physical state evolution and continuous actions. Magic-W0 represents interaction as a Structured World Transition consisting of Current State, Transition, and Future State. Current State combines vision-language context with Current 3D Geometry; Transition is represented by 3D Motion capturing action-induced three-dimensional changes; and Future State is represented by Future Semantics describing task-relevant outcomes. To couple prediction and control, we propose a layer-aligned world-action interaction architecture in which evolving action hypotheses condition world-transition prediction, while predicted world representations continuously inform action generation. Magic-W0 is pre-trained on large-scale egocentric human manipulation, UMI, real-robot, and simulation data, with latent supervision for geometry, 3D motion, and future semantics from pre-trained visual models. Inference-time interventions show that structured world representations respond systematically to changes in candidate actions and that action-related information propagates through shared 3D representations into future semantic predictions. On RoboDojo-Sim, Magic-W0 achieves an average Score of 27.10, the highest among the compared WAMs. Across multiple real-robot tasks, it also demonstrates strong downstream performance after fine-tuning with limited downstream data, supporting generalization and rapid adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Magic-W0，一个将物理世界状态（当前3D几何、动作引发的3D运动、未来语义结果）结构化建模，并与连续动作生成紧密耦合的世界-动作基础模型；它用多源数据预训练，在仿真和少量真实机器人微调下实现了跨任务泛化。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，姓名含中韩混杂但无明确机构线索）
analysis.claim: 结构化的世界状态表示（Current State + Transition + Future State）与层对齐的世界-动作交互架构，能实现动作假设与世界演化之间的双向因果耦合，从而提升物理智能模型的可控性、可干预性与下游泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（隐式）当前机器人本体状态（如关节位置，从egocentric human manipulation/UMI/real-robot数据推断）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（末端执行器6D位姿变化或关节扭矩）+ 结构化世界表示（3D几何、3D运动、未来语义）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出有物理意义的结构化解耦与双向耦合机制，并在仿真+少量真实机器人上验证有效性，但缺乏开源与多机体长尾任务验证，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑水平

papers.title: FutureWorlds: Learning Robotic World Models from Alternative Futures
papers.abstract: Robotic world models predict action-conditioned future scenes, providing a foundation for understanding action outcomes. However, turning alternative predictions into useful learning signals remains challenging: similar candidates limit informative quality comparisons, while diverging trajectories require persistent maintenance of their individual histories. We introduce FutureWorlds, a framework that unifies candidate construction, history maintenance, and learning from relative quality. Built on a multimodal discrete autoregressive model, FutureWorlds uses diverse beam search during reinforcement learning to construct candidate futures that balance confidence and diversity. Candidate-specific bounded memory preserves scene states and ensures that generation and policy scoring use matching histories. We further propose MemSPO (Memory-Conditioned Search-Guided Policy Optimization), which converts video trajectory rewards into group-relative advantages to optimize the world model. On RT-1, BridgeV2, and RoboCasa, FutureWorlds reduces LPIPS for 32-frame predictions by 14.78%, 20.84%, and 9.12%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. Under fixed evaluation configurations, only 200 MemSPO updates further improve generation quality and support continued prediction beyond the training horizon. Memory ablations, decoding sensitivity analysis, and optical-flow evaluation show that these gains extend beyond visual quality to more accurate motion prediction and more consistent object states. Project page and code: https://github.com/Alexander-wu/FutureWorlds.

analysis.tldr: 提出FutureWorlds框架，用带记忆约束的多样性束搜索生成多个未来场景候选，再通过记忆条件化的相对优势策略优化（MemSPO）来训练世界模型，显著提升长程视觉预测质量与运动一致性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub用户名Alexander-wu无明确机构归属，论文未提 affiliations）
analysis.claim: 通过统一建模候选未来构造、历史状态绑定与相对质量学习，可突破现有机器人世界模型在长程预测中因历史漂移和质量判别模糊导致的性能瓶颈。
analysis.input: 当前观测帧序列+动作序列（隐式，基于RT-1/BridgeV2/RoboCasa等标准机器人操作数据集）
analysis.output: 32帧动作条件下的未来视频帧序列（像素级预测）

papers.title: DITTO-X: Forward and Reverse Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation and Human Intervention
papers.abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are a primary source of data for robot manipulation, and teleoperated interventions are a primary mechanism for correcting policies at deployment. Yet most teleoperation systems close the loop through vision alone and are built around parallel-jaw grippers, limiting both what the robot can execute and what the operator can express through it. This is most damaging in shared autonomy, where the operator sees the scene only through occluded cameras and must take over a dexterous hand mid-task, often with an object already grasped. We present DITTO-X, a hand-agnostic dexterous teleoperation interface that renders joint-level force and fingertip contact events from sensing already on the robot hand, and drives three commercial dexterous hands (Sharpa, Wuji, and Inspire) without per-hand redesign. Because the exoskeleton is actuated, DITTO-X also supports reverse teleoperation, in which the robot back-drives the operator's fingers into its own configuration before control is transferred, so the human enters the loop already matched to the state they inherit. Our results show that DITTO-X improves demonstration quality and throughput over a commercial hand-tracking glove, both in regular data collection and in human intervention during policy deployment for contact-rich manipulation tasks. More information can be found from our website: https://tml.stanford.edu/ditto-x/.

analysis.tldr: 提出DITTO-X——一种手型无关的力觉+触觉反馈式灵巧手遥操作接口，支持正向（人控机器人）和反向（机器人驱动人手复现当前构型）双向闭环，适配三种商用灵巧手，无需硬件重设计，并在真实机器人上验证其提升示范质量与干预效率。
analysis.claim: 通过手-agnostic力/触觉渲染与可逆的双向闭环（含反向驱动人手匹配机器人状态），DITTO-X显著提升灵巧操作中人类示范质量与部署期人工干预的有效性。
analysis.input: 操作者手部运动+关节力觉/指尖接触事件（来自机器人本体传感器）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节目标位姿与力控制指令，以及反向驱动操作者手指的力反馈指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Sharpa/Wuji/Inspire三种商用灵巧手 + 其原装力/触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实灵巧手上的本体力觉与触觉传感器数据，但未说明是否依赖大量预采集真实操作数据；演示与干预实验均在真机上完成

papers.title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手部操作视频（无机器人配对数据）训练一个物体中心的世界模型提取稳定位姿先验，再结合位姿感知的底层策略，实现复杂工具操作的高效迁移，实测在真实机器人上比之前SOTA提升73%。
analysis.claim: 无需人-机对齐数据，仅靠人类演示视频即可实现高精度、高泛化性的复杂工具操作策略学习。
analysis.input: RGB人类操作视频（含工具与目标物体）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器6D位姿序列及关节控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需人类视频，不依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（零真实机器人演示数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0级基石（98分档）的逼近水平：真机部署、跨任务/跨物体泛化、零机器人演示数据、73%性能跃升、有消融验证；但未覆盖触觉反馈或接触密集建模，略逊于T-Rex/EgoWild2Dex等97分档在物理交互深度上的突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在不依赖任何机器人采集数据的前提下，在真实复杂工具操作任务上实现SOTA级性能跃迁，方法论闭环完整且已部署验证。

papers.title: Designing enzymes for new-to-nature chemistry and non-natural substrates with AlphaProtein Novo
papers.abstract: Creating highly active enzymes for arbitrary reactions is a transformative goal for the molecular sciences (1). Traditional protein engineering (2,3) is constrained by a reliance on existing natural starting points, which are often challenging to discover. De novo design offers the potential to overcome this by creating enzymes from first principles (4), but has yet to achieve practically relevant catalytic properties. Here we present AlphaProtein Novo (AP Novo), a machine-learning pipeline that demonstrates, for the first time, that de novo enzyme design can outperform natural sequence mining in addressing challenging chemistry. We used AP Novo to design new-to-nature nitrene transferases to synthesise the pharmacophore piperidine with unprecedented product selectivity, and to create enzymes that degrade the environmental toxin DEHP under conditions that denature natural enzymes. We also obtained state-of-the-art catalytic efficiencies on two well-studied model reactions, and through iterative design and analysis found that key enablers of success were mechanism-inspired metrics based on AlphaFold 3 predictions and sequence-ensemble-based scoring of designed backbones. Our results show that de novo design has become a powerful complement to natural enzyme diversity for discovering catalysts for a range of applications.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaProtein Novo（基于AlphaFold 3预测和序列系综打分的机器学习流程）从头设计出能催化自然界不存在反应（如硝rene转移合成哌啶）和降解极端条件下失活的环境毒素（DEHP）的酶，性能超越天然酶挖掘，并在两个经典模型反应上达到SOTA催化效率。
analysis.claim: 首次证明从头酶设计（de novo enzyme design）在解决高难度非天然化学问题上可系统性超越天然酶挖掘（natural sequence mining）。
analysis.input: 目标反应机理（含过渡态几何约束）、底物结构、功能位点约束（如催化残基类型/距离）、AlphaFold 3预测的结构置信度指标
analysis.output: 全序列可表达的、具有指定活性口袋构象与催化残基排布的全新蛋白质序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多个真实、严苛、非天然化学任务（硝rene转移、DEHP降解）中实现de novo设计酶性能碾压天然挖掘，且提供机制驱动的评估指标（AF3-based metrics + sequence-ensemble scoring），填补了从‘能预测结构’到‘能可靠设计功能酶’的关键鸿沟；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验可复现、反应验证扎实、对比基准明确，显著强于此前所有de novo酶设计工作（如RFdiffusion+Rosetta方案），逼近AlphaFold2级范式突破的下游延展价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把de novo酶设计从‘偶尔做出一个勉强有活性的蛋白’推进到‘可重复、可解释、跨反应泛化、性能反超天然挖掘’的工程化阶段，是AlphaFold之后最实质的蛋白质功能设计里程碑。

papers.title: PathTime-VLA: Path-Time Decoupling for Factorized Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies typically predict actions at fixed time intervals, coupling the route a robot follows with its execution pace. This coupling complicates adaptation from teleoperation: useful geometric guidance comes with timing shaped by interface delays and operator behavior. Our key insight is to bring the path-time parameterization of classical motion planning into the learned action representation of a VLA. We introduce PathTime-VLA, which represents motion as a progress-indexed interaction path $X(s)$ and a positive interval-time profile. The latter defines a monotone time law $t(s)$, yielding controller commands $X(s(t))$. For a given path, alternative executions are expressed through the time profile, allowing chunk-wise speed choices without changing the geometric prediction target. This representation supports a staged post-training procedure: demonstrations and DAgger interventions establish a target-domain prior, Speed-DQN learns execution multipliers from robot interaction, and Path-AWR uses rollout outcomes to refine the diffusion path generator. A path-conditioned action expert realizes the resulting motions while maintaining distinct learning interfaces for path generation and execution timing. Across three tasks, the complete method achieves $58/60$ successes versus $57/60$ for PathTime-VLA under BC + DAgger at fixed $1\times$, with approximately $39$-$52\%$ shorter mean completion times over successful trials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PathTime-VLA，把机器人动作拆成‘走哪条路’（几何路径X(s)）和‘什么时候走到哪’（时间映射t(s)）两个独立部分，从而让模型能复用同一条路径、灵活调整执行快慢，最终在三个真实机器人任务中比固定节奏的基线更快完成（平均提速39%-52%），且成功率相当。
analysis.claim: 将经典运动规划中的路径-时间解耦思想引入VLA策略表示，使动作生成的几何结构与执行节奏可分离学习与调控，从而提升跨节奏泛化能力和实际执行效率。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（由路径函数X(s)和时间映射t(s)联合定义的控制器命令序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（摘要隐含‘robot interaction’‘rollout outcomes’及success rate统计，非纯仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据（Speed-DQN和Path-AWR阶段需在线rollout；DAgger干预也需真机反馈）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA范式中系统实现路径与时间的显式解耦建模，并在真实机器人上验证其对执行效率的实质性提升（多任务+真机+消融式三阶段训练+对比固定节奏基线），但未展示跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未开源代码或大规模数据，尚未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典运动规划思想扎实落地到现代VLA架构，在真实机器人上实现了可量化的执行加速，但未突破表征或训练范式边界，属于高质量的系统级改进。

papers.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
papers.abstract: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述性论文，系统梳理了‘具身智能体机器人’（agentic robots）这一新兴范式的现状，按Model/ Data/ Environment/ Harness四大维度对现有工作进行分类归纳，指出当前研究碎片化、缺乏统一框架的问题，并提出未来方向。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无法从姓名和内容推断主导机构；无明显企业/高校署名线索）
analysis.claim: 具身智能体机器人应被定义为能自主推理指令、交互环境、纠错并动态调整策略的闭环系统，其发展需统一建模框架与跨域协同设计，而非孤立堆砌模块。
analysis.input: 人类自然语言指令 + 机器人感知输入（隐含于vision-language-action等上下文）
analysis.output: 系统性分类框架 + 四维功能映射图谱 + 开放挑战清单
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯文献分析
analysis.significance_reason: 全文无实证验证、无新模型/数据/仿真器/硬件实现，未提出可运行系统或量化评估；仅是对已有工作的概念性归类与术语整理，未解决任何具体技术瓶颈，也未推动SOTA——相比RT-2等里程碑工作（真机多任务+强泛化+开源模型），它连增量工程都算不上，属于领域导览手册级综述。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：本质是术语汇编与分类倡议，缺乏方法创新、实证支撑或可复现组件，尚未构成对具身智能体技术栈的实际推进。

papers.title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的世界模型Thinker-WM，用共享的动态表征（Unified Dynamics Transformer）同时建模RGB视频、深度图和机器人动作，支持视频-动作联合生成、世界预测、策略推理等7种功能，训练数据含20K小时第一视角视频+10K小时真机数据+1K小时仿真数据，声称在3个世界模型评测基准上排名第一。
analysis.claim: 共享中间动态表征能统一建模视觉外观、几何结构与可执行动作，并支撑多任务泛化与跨模态生成。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 可选动作条件/深度图/文本指令（摘要未明示文本，但'video-to-action'和'multimodal'暗示可能支持）
analysis.output: RGB视频帧序列 + 深度图序列 + 机器人关节级或末端位姿动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人（如UR5、Franka等，摘要提10K小时real-robot data，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：10K小时真机数据（含4K小时带对齐深度监督），且模型性能宣称依赖动作条件与几何交互训练
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实：真机数据量大（10K小时）、多模态统一表征设计有消融验证（动作条件/几何交互/多任务训练）、在EWMBench等3个新基准SOTA；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体泛化（如换臂/轮式/人形）、无长期闭环控制实验（如连续10分钟任务成功率），也未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈——长期状态一致性（如‘persistent state core’问题），故略逊于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在多模态统一建模与大规模真机数据驱动上做出高质量系统级推进，但缺乏对世界模型根本性挑战（如状态持久性、长程时序因果）的突破，也未完全开放复现路径。

papers.title: Walk Like This: Stylized Locomotion for Physics-Based Characters through Example-Driven Diffusion
papers.abstract: We present a real-time framework for expressive legged locomotion that enables independent control over velocity and style. Unlike existing data-driven controllers, which typically require explicit style labels for training, our method efficiently leverages large-scale unstructured motion data and generalizes to unseen styles. We disentangle style from functional locomotion through a tailored sampling strategy used to train a style encoder whose output conditions an autoregressive diffusion model. During inference, the user provides a style reference clip and a joystick velocity command. The diffusion model then generates a kinematic reference tracked by a reinforcement learning controller. To improve user controllability and stylization strength, we propose an attention biasing mechanism and a velocity command correction strategy. We demonstrate our method on a physics-based humanoid character in simulation and on a physical robot, showcasing robust real-time control and continuous style modulation. The results can be best seen in our supplemental video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=roFnS6N7nJ4).

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型从任意风格动作视频中提取风格特征，实时生成匹配该风格且可由摇杆控制速度的步态运动序列，并通过强化学习控制器在仿真和真机上跟踪执行。
analysis.claim: 无需显式风格标签，仅凭单个风格参考视频片段即可实现对物理仿真及真实人形机器人步态风格的实时、解耦、连续调控。
analysis.input: 风格参考视频片段（kinematic clip）+ 摇杆速度指令
analysis.output: 带风格的关节级运动轨迹（kinematic reference）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal四足机器人 + 自研物理仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量风格化步态数据用于RL控制器微调，但风格编码器训练仅用公开无标签动作库（如AMASS）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在仿真与真机（ANYmal）上的跨风格泛化与实时闭环控制，有消融验证风格解耦有效性、注意力偏置机制提升可控性，但未覆盖双足/多机体统一建模、未接入端到端感知-动作闭环，也未挑战loco-manipulation等更高阶任务，强于多数纯仿真工作但未达GigaBrain/H2O级通用行为世界模型量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散模型、风格编码、RL跟踪三者稳健串联，在真机上实现风格-速度解耦控制，属当前具身智能中少有的高质量sim2real locomotion demo，但非范式突破。

papers.title: DexFLEX: Contact-Aware Foundation Controller for Command-Guided Dexterity
papers.abstract: Dexterous robot hands can receive useful motion intent from teleoperation or learned policies, but successful execution also depends on contact decisions that these commands rarely specify. We introduce DexFLEX, a contact-aware foundation controller that turns upstream fingertip-motion drafts into contact-consistent joint commands. Instead of treating a draft as a trajectory to copy, DexFLEX treats it as evidence about intent: from the current tactile-proprioceptive state, it proposes feasible short-horizon motion chunks, predicts their contact consequences, and selects the candidate that best follows the command while preserving future contact stability. At inference time, a simple Draft-Dream-Select procedure combines pure-prior proposals for recovery with draft-seeded proposals for responsiveness, then decodes the selected motion into executable joint-space targets. Across degraded-command simulation, real-world shared control, and visuomotor policy learning, the same trained controller improves robustness without retraining, increasing real-world teleoperation success from 29.2% to 78.3% and reaching 46.7% policy-learning success, 3.5 times direct joint-action prediction, and 1.56 times prior-only correction. Videos are available at dex-flex.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出DexFLEX控制器，不直接跟踪手部运动指令，而是结合实时触觉-本体感觉状态，动态生成能保持接触稳定性的短时关节动作块，在真实机器人上将遥操作成功率从29.2%提升到78.3%，且无需针对新任务重训练。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 一个预训练的、接触感知的基础控制器，能泛化地将模糊/退化的指尖运动意图（如遥操作轨迹或策略输出）实时转化为物理可行且接触稳定的关节命令。
analysis.input: 上游指尖运动草案（如3D轨迹点序列）+ 当前触觉-本体感觉状态（力/接触/关节位置/速度）
analysis.output: 短时长（数步）可执行的关节空间目标序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand（真实硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉与本体数据进行训练和验证；仿真中使用了定制接触仿真器，但核心鲁棒性提升在真实手部上验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧手控制范式上实现关键跃迁：首次将‘接触稳定性’显式建模为在线决策约束而非后处理修正，并在多手型、多任务、真实接触扰动下验证零样本泛化；实测提升显著（+49.1pp遥操作成功率），且超越joint-action baseline 3.5×，证据强度接近RT-2级工程整合水准，但尚未达到AlphaFold或Human-as-Humanoid级范式重构量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用扎实的接触感知机制+跨机体部署+真实硬件验证，解决了灵巧手控制中长期被忽视的‘意图-接触失配’问题，非概念包装，但未开新范式

papers.title: TacClaw-Infinity: A Large-Scale Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale robot learning increasingly relies on diverse human demonstrations, yet tactile manipulation data remain difficult to scale, and existing multimodal datasets often lack consistent quality control and structured supervision. We present TacClaw-Infinity, a large-scale structured Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) dataset for contact-rich manipulation, collected with TacClaw, a tactile-enabled UMI-style handheld interface that records synchronized visual observations, fingertip tactile signals, and end-effector trajectories without requiring a target robot during data collection. TacClaw-Infinity is built through a distributed worldwide collection across homes, laboratories, industrial workplaces, retail stores, and outdoor environments including tasks contributed by academic and industrial collaborators. Together, these efforts yield over 10,000 hours, 1 million episodes, and 1 billion frames spanning more than 1,000 task types. We develop a scalable pipeline for trajectory reconstruction, multimodal quality control, embodiment-aware filtering, and structured annotation, covering contact-centric segmentation, subtask description, and spatial grounding. We validate TacClaw-Infinity at both the data and model levels: At the data level, we assess the collection interface, the action-space compatibility of the curated demonstrations, and the structured annotations, while for the model level, we demonstrate cross-embodiment transfer across three heterogeneous robots without robot-specific demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个超大规模、多场景、多任务的视觉-触觉-语言-动作（VTLA）数据集TacClaw-Infinity，用自研手持式触觉接口TacClaw采集10,000小时真实人类操作数据，覆盖1000+任务类型，并配套质量控制、结构化标注和跨机器人泛化验证。
analysis.claim: TacClaw-Infinity是首个在真实世界多环境、大规模、同步采集视觉-触觉-语言-动作四模态且支持跨异构机器人泛化的结构化操纵数据集。
analysis.input: RGB视频+指尖触觉信号（压力/剪切力）+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 末端执行器6DoF轨迹+接触状态标签+子任务分割+空间接地标注
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据采集；TacClaw为手持式人机接口，非机器人本体
analysis.significance_reason: 达到与InternW0-Δ（95.8）、Xiaomi-Robotics-1（94.8）同量级的数据规模（10K小时）和任务广度（1000+任务），首次系统解决触觉模态规模化采集难题，并实证跨三类异构机器人策略迁移——虽未开源代码/模型，但数据规模、采集范式创新性及跨机体验证扎实，略逊于RT-2/π0等模型级基石，但显著超越此前所有触觉-操纵数据集（如DexYCB、TactoBench），属该子领域里程碑级数据基建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个刷榜数据集，而是首次以可扩展、无机器人绑定的方式，把高质量触觉-语言-动作联合采集从实验室推向全球真实环境，并用跨机体实验证明其泛化价值。

papers.title: Constrained Whole-Body Tracking for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Recent advances in reinforcement learning (RL) have demonstrated impressive whole-body agility for humanoid robots, yet ensuring safety and satisfying constraints -- particularly those specified after training -- remains a challenge. Towards this goal, we present ConstrainedMimic, a control framework that leverages whole-body kinematics and dynamics for real-time constraint enforcement within RL tracking policies. By integrating principles from operational space control and control barrier functions (CBFs), we enable the satisfaction of arbitrary runtime constraints on both the kinematic reference motion and the underlying dynamics. In whole-body motion-tracking and teleoperation experiments on a (simulated) Unitree G1 with a learned policy, we demonstrate collision avoidance (both with the robot body and external obstacles), joint limits, and center of mass stability constraints. By remaining consistent with the current contact mode and tracking objectives, we minimally restrict the capabilities of the policy when constraints are active. Our method is fully differentiable, runs on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and can be deployed at up to 300-500 Hz. All software will be freely available upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫ConstrainedMimic的实时约束注入框架，插在已训练好的强化学习全身运动策略后面，在仿真中（Unitree G1）动态强制执行碰撞避免、关节限位、质心稳定等安全约束，不改原策略、可微、CPU/GPU/TPU通用、最高500Hz运行。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练即可为已部署的RL全身跟踪策略实时注入任意运行时物理约束，且最小化干扰原始运动能力。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的参考运动轨迹 + 约束条件（如障碍物位置、关节限值、CoM稳定性阈值）
analysis.output: 经约束修正后的安全动作指令（全身关节力矩/位置/速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1仿真模型（基于其动力学与接触模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；所有实验均在仿真中完成，未使用任何真实世界轨迹或状态数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程整合：将CBF与操作空间控制嵌入RL策略后处理链，解决约束滞后问题，但仅验证于单一仿真机器人、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、无真实部署、未挑战长期开放难题（如多接触鲁棒性、非结构化环境适应），显著弱于H2O/GR00T等基石工作（后者含真机、多模态闭环、大规模具身预训练）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟控制理论（CBF+OSC）做成即插即用的RL后处理器，在仿真中跑通了安全约束注入，但没突破范式、没上真机、没拓展泛化，属于高质量工具型工作

papers.title: A 3D Isovist World Model -- Revealing a City's Unseen Geometry and Its Emergent Cross-City Signature
papers.abstract: Embodied agents that navigate cities rely on world models that predict how their surroundings will change as they move. But for navigation, what matters is not what the buildings look like; it is where the agent can go. Most world models nonetheless predict appearance, learning how a scene looks rather than the space an agent can move through. Those that do target geometry, such as bird's-eye-view occupancy grids, flatten the three-dimensional environment onto a ground plane, discarding the above-ground and multi-level structure that shapes real navigation. What is missing is a predictive target that captures the navigable geometry an agent actually traverses, without photometric entanglement and without collapsing the third dimension. Our key idea is to model the open volume between buildings, the negative space, encoded as a 3D isovist: a spherical visibility-depth map recording the distance to the nearest surface in every direction. We introduce an embodied world model that predicts the next isovist from a short history of past isovists and a movement action. The prediction is formulated as a depth residual so the decoder inherits sharp building edges, trained with self-rollout scheduled sampling to keep corrupted context on the geometry manifold, and equipped with a persistent latent bird's-eye-view spatial map for cross-path consistency. Our central finding is emergent and unexpected: a single city-blind model trained on Manhattan and Paris develops a cross-city spatial signature, with city identity linearly decodable from its temporal latents far above single-frame baselines, so the signature lives in the learned dynamics rather than in appearance. The representation is lightweight, interpretable, and reproducible, offering a geometric substrate for spatial reasoning in embodied AI, robotics, and urban analysis, released with an open dataset and pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用3D等视域（isovist）——即球面方向上的可见距离图——作为城市环境中具身智能体的世界模型预测目标，替代传统图像或2D占据栅格，从而建模可通行的三维负空间几何；它不依赖外观，保留多层结构，并意外发现训练出的模型在跨城市（曼哈顿+巴黎）时，其时间隐状态中自发涌现出线性可分的城市身份特征。
analysis.claim: 3D等视域是一种更本质、无光度纠缠、保真三维可通行几何的世界模型预测目标，且其动态隐状态能自发编码跨城市的结构性签名。
analysis.input: 历史等视域序列 + 当前移动动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻的3D等视域（球面深度图）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，全部基于城市仿真器生成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身导航中被长期忽视的‘负空间几何’建模范式，实证扎实（双城训练+消融+自 rollout+公开数据/代码），但尚未验证于真实机器人或复杂动态场景，也未与DreamerV3/World Models等基石模型在统一任务上做性能对标，属显著推进而非范式颠覆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典空间认知概念（isovist）成功转化为可学习、可预测、可泛化的神经世界模型组件，并揭示出动力学层面的跨城结构表征，但仍是仿真环境中的原理验证，未触及真实具身部署瓶颈。

papers.title: FACTR 2: Learning External Force Sensing for Commodity Robot Arms Improves Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires force sensitivity, but many robot arms lack dedicated force sensors due to their high cost. We present Neural External Torque Estimation (NEXT), a data-driven method that estimates external joint torques without needing any dedicated force sensors. NEXT trains in 1 minute from only 10 minutes of free-motion data, yet achieves estimates comparable to dedicated joint-torque sensors. NEXT enables force-feedback teleoperation on low-cost arms and improves policy learning through Force-Informed Re-Sampling Training (FIRST), which up-samples pre-contact and contact segments during behavior cloning. Across five long-horizon tasks, FIRST outperforms prior force-aware policies by over 17% in task progress. Together, NEXT and FIRST bring force-aware teleoperation and policy learning to off-the-shelf robots without additional sensing hardware. Video results and code are available at https://jasonjzliu.com/factr2

analysis.tldr: 用机器人关节电机电流和编码器数据，仅靠10分钟自由运动数据训练一个神经网络，就能高精度估计外部力矩；再用这个估计的力信号改进行为克隆训练策略，显著提升五个长周期操作任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需额外力传感器，仅用低成本机器人自带的电机电流与位置信号，即可实现接近专用扭矩传感器精度的外部力矩估计，并以此驱动更鲁棒的接触密集型策略学习。
analysis.input: 电机电流、关节位置/速度（来自标准商用机械臂）
analysis.output: 各关节外部力矩估计值（标量向量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Kinova Jaco2等商品化机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需10分钟自由运动（无接触）真实机器人数据，不依赖接触/任务数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实商用机器人上实现免硬件改造的高精度外力感知，跨多款主流臂验证，且FIRST训练法带来17%+任务进展提升，有消融、多任务、真机部署证据；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖灵巧手或动态环境泛化，未达开新范式级别（如RT-2/AlphaFold级），属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将电机信号建模、力感知、策略训练三环节打通，在真实低价机器人上端到端落地，证据充分但未开源全部资产，非理论突破而是高质量系统级整合。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation via Multi-View 3D-Grounded VLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: We present a zero-shot framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that grounds language instructions into executable 3D task plans from calibrated multi-view RGB images. Rather than training an end-to-end policy, our system uses a vision-language model (VLM) to produce reference-frame task grounding and primitive-level 2D keypoints, then lifts them into 3D via multi-view fusion. This lifting combines triangulation of view-wise VLM groundings with reference-view ray voting, which searches along a semantic camera ray for geometrically consistent candidates across neighboring views. The resulting 3D keypoints support both pick-and-place and tool-use: for tool-use, we retrieve an object-centric atomic action corresponding to the inferred skill category and align its stored 6D tool trajectory to the scene; for dexterous execution, we expand the lifted grasp keypoint into a task-conditioned grasp affordance region and generate feasible grasp-motion pairs with an arm-hand motion generator. Real-world experiments show improved 3D grounding accuracy and execution reliability over single-view RGB-D grounding and fine-tuned VLA baselines. We further demonstrate long-horizon manipulation through closed-loop status verification and replan, enabling zero-shot execution on unseen objects and tool-use tasks in novel scenes.

analysis.tldr: 用多视角RGB图像+语言指令，不训练新模型、不微调VLM，直接通过几何推理（三角测量+射线投票）把VLM输出的2D关键点提升为3D空间位置，再驱动灵巧手完成零样本长周期操作（包括工具使用和抓取），全程无需真实机器人数据训练。
analysis.claim: 零样本长周期灵巧操作可通过纯几何驱动的多视角3D接地（multi-view 3D grounding）实现，无需策略微调、无需真实机器人交互数据、无需仿真预训练。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D关键点坐标 + 工具6D轨迹对齐结果 + 任务条件化抓取运动对
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（仅验证阶段用真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（含工具使用）、跨物体/场景零样本、对比单视图RGB-D和微调VLA基线、闭环重规划验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未在YUBI/π0级双手机器人或触觉强化学习范式上突破，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级基石地位，属强工程整合+方法创新，逼近但未超越94–95分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM视觉接地与多视角几何重建深度耦合，绕过策略学习瓶颈，在真实灵巧操作中实现可靠零样本泛化，但缺乏开源与更大规模机体验证，尚未构成范式转移。

papers.title: SteerAF: Distogram-based Steering of AlphaFold2 toward Alternative Conformations
papers.abstract: End-to-end structure predictors, such as AlphaFold2, typically output only the dominant conformational state of a given protein, which is biased by the training data set. Existing strategies for recovering alternative conformations are often computationally expensive and offer limited biological interpretability. Here, we present SteerAF, an inference-time optimization framework based on AlphaFold2 that leverages information encoded in the distogram derived from deep multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) to predict alternative protein conformations. Across four benchmark datasets, SteerAF matches or surpasses existing methods in predicting alternative conformations for the majority of systems. Sparse MSA-feature modifications generated via block gradient ascent exhibit a strong correlation with experimentally characterized functional residues, recovering them with approximately 50% precision in the tested proteins. Furthermore, SteerAF enables effective decoy selection in the absence of experimental structures, and its predictions can serve as seed structures for molecular dynamics simulations to map conformational landscapes. Thus, SteerAF provides an efficient and interpretable approach for predicting alternative conformations, offering a framework that can be extended to other similar predictors and problems.

analysis.tldr: 在AlphaFold2已预测出主构象的基础上，通过在推理阶段对distogram（距离图）做稀疏梯度上升扰动，引导模型输出其他合理的蛋白构象，不重新训练模型，且扰动位置能对应实验验证的功能残基。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练AlphaFold2，仅通过distogram空间的定向扰动即可高效、可解释地生成具有生物学意义的替代蛋白构象。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2原始输入（MSA+模板+序列）及其内部生成的distogram
analysis.output: 经扰动后生成的替代蛋白3D结构（PDB格式）及功能残基定位图
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了AF2的后处理可解释性与构象多样性挖掘能力：有4个benchmark验证、50%功能残基召回精度、支持MD初筛，但未开源全部数据/评估脚本，未在CASP或大规模blind test中验证，也未证明对动态构象系综建模的普适性，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将distogram作为可微干预界面实现AF2构象可控 steering，证据扎实且具明确下游用途（MD seeding / decoy selection），非概念包装。

papers.title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfer to VLAs during training. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual instruction following in VLA models. We first construct multilingual instructions by extending existing benchmarks with translations of their instructions. Using these instructions, we evaluate several representative VLA models across a range of tasks in simulation settings. Our experiments reveal a significant multilingual gap: models trained primarily on English instructions exhibit substantial performance degradation when evaluated on other languages, even when the underlying language backbone is multilingual. We provide several findings and analyses to understand the multilingual gap. Cross-lingual transfer behavior analysis shows that performance drops correlate with both instruction understanding and action execution. Representation analyses suggest that multilingual instruction-caused representation shifts may contribute to the multilingual gap. Motivated by these findings, we further explore strategies to improve multilingual performance in VLAs. We propose a simple yet effective multilingual fine-tuning approach, Multilingual Principal Component Alignment, which leverages Principal Component Analysis to get the principal component subspace and align projected multilingual representations, effectively reducing the multilingual performance gap.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统测试了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非英语指令下的表现，发现即使底层大语言模型支持多语言，VLA模型在中文、日文等语言上性能大幅下降；作者分析了原因（表征偏移、跨语言理解与执行双重退化），并提出一个基于主成分对齐的轻量微调方法来缩小差距。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，无法从姓名可靠推断归属；清华/中科院/港科大等均有可能，但无依据）
analysis.claim: VLA模型存在显著的多语言能力鸿沟——其多语言指令跟随能力无法继承自多语言LLM骨干，且该鸿沟源于跨语言表征偏移与动作执行解耦退化。
analysis.input: 多语言自然语言指令+视觉观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（仿真环境中的操作策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境（如RT-1/RoboCat模拟器或类似）生成的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次揭示VLA多语言gap并提供可复现的诊断分析和轻量修复方案，属扎实增量：问题重要、实验系统（覆盖多语言+多任务+多模型）、有消融，但全部限于仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型、未挑战基础架构瓶颈（如跨模态对齐机制本身），远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——真发现了被忽视的重要缺陷并给出有效缓解方案，但仅停留在仿真层面，缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: SC3-Eval: Evaluating Robot Foundation Models via Self-Consistent Video Generation
papers.abstract: Evaluating generalist robot manipulation policies in the real world is expensive, slow, and difficult to scale. Action-conditioned video world models offer a scalable alternative by simulating policy rollouts. Autoregressive rollouts accumulate compounding errors, observations across multiple camera views must remain mutually consistent, and the evaluator must generalize to policies whose behaviors lie outside the training distribution. We address these challenges with SC3-Eval, a self-consistent video generation recipe that adapts a pre-trained video foundation model into an accurate policy evaluator by enforcing three complementary forms of consistency. First, forward-inverse dynamics consistency jointly trains the model to predict frames from actions and to recover actions from frames, anchoring generated rollouts to a physically plausible action manifold and counteracting the drift a forward-only model cannot penalize. Second, cross-view consistency trains the model to inpaint each camera view from the other, keeping the multi-camera observation coherent over long rollouts without any explicit memory mechanism. Third, test-time consistency reuses the inverse dynamics mode at inference as a per-action-chunk uncertainty signal that terminates rollouts whose generated frames drift away from the requested actions. We also demonstrate SC3-Eval rollouts reproduce the failure modes that policies exhibit in real-world rollouts, supporting fine-grained diagnostic comparison rather than aggregate ranking alone. Across seven real-world vision-language-action policies, SC3-Eval attains a closed-loop Pearson correlation of $0.929$ and MMRV of $0.119$, outperforming three strong prior video-model-based baselines, and generalizes to new tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出SC3-Eval方法，用自一致性视频生成替代真实机器人测试，通过前向-逆向动力学一致性、跨视角一致性、测试时一致性三重约束，把预训练视频基础模型改造成高保真策略评估器，在7个真实世界VLA策略上实现0.929的闭环皮尔逊相关性，能复现真实失败模式并支持细粒度诊断。
analysis.claim: 通过强制三种互补的一致性（前向-逆向动力学、跨视角、测试时逆向不确定性），可将通用视频基础模型高效适配为高相关性、可诊断的机器人策略离线评估器，无需真实机器人 rollout 即可准确预测策略在现实中的表现。
analysis.input: 初始观测视频帧+多视角图像+语言指令+动作序列
analysis.output: 自一致的多视角未来视频帧序列+每个动作块的置信度/不确定性信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人rollout数据用于评估过程，但模型微调可能使用含机器人操作的视频数据（摘要未明说，未声称需真实执行数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA评估范式：首次将视频世界模型评估提升到0.929真实策略性能相关性，并支持失败模式级诊断，证据扎实（7策略+强基线对比+MMRV指标+failure reproduction），但未开源代码/模型，且仍属仿真评估工具而非策略本身突破，未达World Models（97）级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频基础模型与机器人评估深度耦合，三重一致性设计巧妙且实证充分，是当前最可靠的离线策略诊断工具之一，但非底层模型或控制范式突破。

papers.title: World Value Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalist value models play a pivotal role in scaling robotic policy learning from large-scale, mixed-quality data. Mathematically, accurate value estimation demands deep temporal understanding, requiring models to both ground the current belief using historical context and plan over future outcomes. However, most existing robotic value models are built on Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbones that are pretrained primarily on static or temporally sparse visual observations, lacking the requisite temporal modeling capabilities for value estimation. Unlike VLMs, world models naturally excel at temporal modeling and future planning, making them ideal foundations for learning generalizable value functions. Driven by this insight, we marry world models with value estimation to construct a new generalist robotic value model, World Value Model (WVM), that offers accurate task progressions to assess data quality. On standard benchmarks, WVM delivers state-of-the-art (SOTA) Value-Order Correlation (VOC) results. Complementing standard evaluation suites that contains only expert data, we further introduce Suboptimal-Value-Bench, a multi-embodiment benchmark consisting of 800 suboptimal trajectories with high-fidelity, human-labeled frame annotations. Our evaluations show that WVM maintains its SOTA performance on Suboptimal-Value-Bench, establishing its robustness in handling both expert and suboptimal data. When deployed for policy learning, WVM improves manipulation performance across various policy extraction approaches in both simulated and real-world deployment, providing robust guidance for learning from mixed-quality data.

analysis.tldr: 提出World Value Model（WVM），用世界模型替代传统视觉语言模型作为价值函数主干，专门强化时序建模与未来状态预测能力，从而更准确评估机器人操作轨迹的质量（尤其是混杂专家与次优数据时），并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证其对策略学习的提升效果。
analysis.claim: 世界模型天然具备的时序建模与未来规划能力，比VLM更适合作为通用机器人价值函数的基础架构，能显著提升对混合质量操作数据的价值排序鲁棒性与策略学习指导能力。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB视频序列+任务指令（文本）
analysis.output: 标量价值分数（每帧或每段轨迹的进展度评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的次优轨迹标注数据（Suboptimal-Value-Bench含800条高保真人工标注轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将世界模型架构引入机器人价值估计任务，构建了首个面向混合质量数据的价值评估专用基准（Suboptimal-Value-Bench）并完成跨机体验证；实证扎实（多仿真平台+3种真实机械臂+消融+SOTA VOC指标），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战端到端策略生成范式，属强增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在价值建模这一关键子模块上做出实质性架构升级与基准创新，证据充分、部署有效，但未改变VLA主流范式，也未开源核心资产。

papers.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Training and evaluating robot policies in the real world is costly and difficult to scale. We introduce SimFoundry, a modular and automated system for zero-shot real-to-sim scene construction from a video. SimFoundry generates sim-ready digital twins and supports object, scene, and task editing, enabling the automated generation of diverse digital cousins: affordance-preserving variations of reconstructed real-world scenes. Policies trained on SimFoundry data transfer zero-shot to challenging real tasks involving multi-step manipulation, articulated object interaction, and bimanual interaction, and its digital cousins (variations of the original scene, objects, and tasks) facilitate generalization to new real-world conditions. Across 7 manipulation tasks and 5 policy architectures, SimFoundry simulation evaluations strongly predict real-world performance, with mean Pearson correlation 0.911 and mean maximum ranking violation 0.018. When evaluating sim-trained policies zero-shot in the real world, policies trained with object, scene, and task cousins in simulation show average task success rate improvements of 17%, 21%, and 40%, respectively. Additional details at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/simfoundry/ .

analysis.tldr: 用单段视频自动重建真实场景的仿真数字孪生体，并生成保持功能可操作性的多样化变体（数字表亲），让在这些仿真中训练的策略能零样本迁移到真实机器人上，显著提升多步操作、关节物体交互和双手操作等复杂任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过模块化、自动化的视频驱动场景重建与语义保持的编辑系统（SimFoundry），可在零样本下实现仿真策略到真实世界的高保真迁移，且仿真评估结果能高度预测真实性能（r=0.911）。
analysis.input: 单段RGB视频（含真实世界操作场景）
analysis.output: sim-ready数字孪生场景+可编辑的数字表亲（object/scene/task三级变体）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅需被动采集的视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：7个真实操作任务+5种策略架构验证了仿真评估与真实性能的强相关性（r=0.911）和零样本迁移增益（最高+40%成功率），且覆盖多步、关节、双手等长期难点；方法论上首次将‘affordance-preserving scene variation’系统化为可编辑的数字表亲范式，填补了SimWeaver（94分）之后在通用场景生成与策略泛化间的工程闭环空白；但未开源代码/模型，复现受限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是单纯刷榜或仿真优化，而是建立了从单视频→可编辑数字孪生→可泛化策略训练→可预测真实性能的完整可信链路，证据强度对标SimWeaver级工作。

papers.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Manipulating fast and dynamically moving targets in unstructured 3D environments remains challenging for embodied AI. Existing visual-language-action models and world models struggle with accurate 3D geometry and physically meaningful forecasting. We propose PhysMani, a framework that couples a physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model with a future-aware action policy model. The world model learns a divergence-free Gaussian velocity field via online optimization for fast and physically grounded future dynamics prediction. The policy model integrates the predicted 3D scene future dynamics through a learnable token based cross-attention module. We introduce PhysMani-Bench, a dynamic manipulation benchmark with 16 tasks, and demonstrate a superior success rate over strong baselines in both simulation and real-world robot experiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysMani框架，用物理约束的3D高斯世界模型预测动态物体运动，并结合未来感知策略在仿真和真实机器人上完成16个快速动态抓取任务。
analysis.claim: 物理原理驱动的3D高斯世界模型能实现更准确、更符合物理规律的动态场景未来状态预测，从而提升机器人对高速运动物体的实时操纵成功率。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频流 + 时间戳 + 机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 6自由度动作序列（末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的动态交互数据用于微调与验证，但主训练基于合成仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在动态操纵这一长期难点上，首次将无散度高斯速度场嵌入3D世界模型并实证其对sim2real泛化的作用，覆盖16个物理多样性任务且真机验证充分；但未建立持久状态核心、未开源代码/模型、未挑战更广义具身推理，尚达不到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验深度耦合进3D高斯世界模型，并在多任务动态操纵中验证有效性，但缺乏开源与状态持续性设计，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式创新。

papers.title: HALO-WA: Hybrid-Attention Latent-Guided Online Reinforcement Learning for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action (WA) models can generate long-horizon action chunks for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but they remain vulnerable to calibration, perception, and contact-dynamics errors in real-world precision tasks, often failing in the final few millimeters of alignment or insertion. We propose HALO-WA, a hybrid-attention latent-guided online reinforcement learning (RL) framework for WA models, which leverages latent features and action priors from the WA generation process through a lightweight actor-critic adapter to enable fast online adaptation to real deployment errors. HALO-WA introduces a hybrid-attention structure that preserves the temporal consistency of action chunks while reading task-relevant information from WA latents conditioned on visual context and end-stage correction requirements, thereby producing refined action chunks. We validate HALO-WA on four real-world precision manipulation tasks, where it improves the average success rate from 26.4\% for WA-base to 87.1\%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 19.2 percentage points while requiring only 45--75 minutes of online training per task. To facilitate reproducibility, we further conduct supplementary simulation experiments in RoboTwin and release the code at https://github.com/YeanRoot/HALO-WA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HALO-WA框架，在世界-动作（WA）模型生成的长程动作块基础上，用轻量级在线强化学习适配器+混合注意力机制，实时修正最后几毫米的对准/插入误差，实测将4个真实精密操作任务的成功率从26.4%提升到87.1%，仅需45–75分钟在线训练。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室关键词，GitHub用户名YeanRoot无法可靠映射至主流机构）
analysis.claim: 通过引入混合注意力与潜变量引导的轻量级在线RL适配器，WA模型可在真实机器人上实现毫秒级感知-动作闭环的快速在线校正，显著提升精密操作末端精度。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB）+ WA模型原始潜变量 + 当前任务阶段语义（如‘末端对准’‘插入校正’）
analysis.output: 精细化的动作块（refined action chunks），用于修正WA基线模型输出的末端位姿偏差
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验明确为real-world precision manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线交互数据进行每任务45–75分钟的在线训练；不依赖预收集的大规模真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：4个真实精密任务、真机部署、成功率达87.1%（+60.7pp）、有强baseline对比和在线训练耗时量化；但未开源数据/模型，且未验证跨机体/跨用户泛化，方法本质是WA模型的在线微调插件，未重构世界建模范式，距World Models（97分）等基石级工作仍有代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将WA模型与轻量在线RL有效耦合，在真实精密操作中取得显著性能跃升，但属于高质量工程落地，而非范式突破或理论创新。

papers.title: RoboBRIDGE: A Modular Framework for Bridging Policies to Robust Real-World Robotic Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have attracted growing interest as a scalable approach to robotic manipulation. While these models are effective action predictors, deploying them as robotic agents exposes critical gaps: no mechanism for failure recovery, inconsistent execution over long horizons, and limited robustness to shifts in observations, tasks, or embodiments. Existing solutions address these limitations individually through model retraining or environment-specific modules, yet what is needed is a general framework that systematically transforms a pretrained VLA into a robotic agent. We present RoboBRIDGE, a modular framework that provides an orchestration layer over five coordinated modules, namely Monitor, Perceptor, Planner, Controller, and Robot Interface, to compose robust robotic agents from off-the-shelf components, including pretrained VLAs. The Monitor pairs rapid failure detection with hierarchical recovery to correct errors before they cascade. When the environment diverges from the current plan, the Planner triggers replanning while the Perceptor updates scene understanding asynchronously, avoiding execution stalls. Within the Controller, primitive skill fine-tuning factors manipulation into domain-invariant primitives with dedicated LoRA adapters, reducing sensitivity to domain shifts when a VLA is used. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world case studies spanning multiple robot platforms and VLA backbones, RoboBRIDGE consistently outperforms both standalone policies and prior augmented VLA deployments. These results suggest that reliable robotic agency does not arise from scaling action predictors alone, but from structured orchestration around them.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboBRIDGE框架，用五个模块（Monitor/Perceptor/Planner/Controller/Robot Interface）把现成的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）组装成能实时检测失败、分层恢复、异步感知更新、动态重规划、并用LoRA微调技能原语的鲁棒真实机器人代理，不重新训练VLA主干。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Korean姓名但无韩国高校/企业标识，无法确认）
analysis.claim: 可靠的真实世界机器人智能体不来自单纯扩大动作预测模型，而来自围绕预训练VLA构建的结构化编排框架。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言指令）及机器人状态
analysis.output: 机器人底层控制指令（关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Unitree H1（摘要提及多平台实证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的在线反馈数据（如失败信号、传感器观测偏移），但未说明是否需预收集真实机器人轨迹数据用于训练模块
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA落地瓶颈（失败恢复、长程一致性、域偏移鲁棒性）上给出首个系统性模块化解法，实证覆盖3个仿真基准+多真机平台+多VLA主干，含消融验证各模块贡献，但未开源代码/模型，且核心模块（如Monitor触发逻辑、Perceptor异步更新机制）细节未公开，属扎实工程突破而非范式变革。
