papers.title: KILVO: Kinematic-Inertial-LiDAR-Visual Odometry with Robust Multimodal Adaptation for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: This article presents a kinematic-inertial-LiDAR-visual odometry for humanoid robots, called KILVO. Tailored to the platform features, requirements, and real-world complexity, it fully utilizes the sensors commonly equipped on humanoid robots, including joint encoders, IMU, LiDAR, and camera, within an asynchronous-sequential hybrid error-state iterated Kalman filter (ESIKF). Specifically, inertial data are used for prediction, leg kinematics are processed asynchronously at a high rate and provide proprioceptive constraints, while exteroception is updated sequentially, first by registering LiDAR points for geometric priors and then by updating the visual component via photometric errors. Moreover, the framework is elaborately designed with multimodal adaptation for resilience to sensor failures. A compact contact estimation module is also developed, sharing information with state estimation without additional sensors. Extensive experiments on public datasets and in the real world across multiple humanoid robots, gait patterns, and scenarios demonstrate that KILVO achieves highly competitive accuracy, efficiency, and output rates, with strong robustness against sensor degradation and failures, making it more suitable for humanoid robots than state-of-the-art fusion methods. Our code and datasets are released on GitHub.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向人形机器人的多传感器融合里程计KILVO，用异步顺序混合的误差状态迭代卡尔曼滤波器，融合关节编码器、IMU、LiDAR和相机数据，并内置多模态自适应机制应对传感器失效，还附带一个共享状态估计的轻量接触检测模块。
analysis.claim: KILVO通过异步-顺序混合ESIKF框架与多模态自适应设计，在真实人形机器人上实现了比现有融合方法更鲁棒、高效且高输出率的定位性能。
analysis.input: 关节编码器数据+IMU加速度/角速度+LiDAR点云+RGB图像
analysis.output: 六自由度位姿估计（位置+姿态）及接触状态
analysis.robot_dependency: 多种人形机器人平台（未具名，但实验涉及多机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多场景、多步态数据，含公开数据集+自采真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程级突破：在多真实人形平台、多步态、多场景下验证了鲁棒性与实时性，具备完整开源（代码+数据），且消融明确（多模态自适应、异步处理、接触共享模块均有验证），但未开新范式（仍是滤波框架演进），也未解决长期开放难题（如无地图长期漂移抑制、跨平台零样本迁移），分量介于显著贡献与重磅之间，略低于H2O/GR00T等定义新范式的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟滤波框架内完成高质量多传感器工程集成与鲁棒性强化，实证充分、开源完整，但未改变领域方法论范式

papers.title: Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling future visual dynamics and actions. However, their scalability and generalization remain constrained by their reliance on costly expert demonstrations. We challenge this by asking whether future supervision for WAMs must originate from target-task expert trajectories. In this paper, we propose Vid2WAM, an offline distillation framework that transfers visual diffusion priors from a large video foundation model into a compact WAM student. Given an observation and language instruction, Vid2WAM distills supervision through two complementary channels: task-conditioned future rollouts directly supervise the student's future prediction branch, while an inverse dynamics model recovers embodiment-specific pseudo-actions for action learning. To robustly integrate synthetic and real supervision, we introduce source-aware residual action adaptation that learns source-specific corrections around a shared action backbone and mitigates interference from noisy pseudo-actions. During inference, both the video teacher and inverse dynamics model are discarded, leaving only the WAM student for efficient deployment. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that Vid2WAM improves novel-task generalization and data efficiency under limited expert demonstrations while preserving low-latency inference.

analysis.tldr: 用视频扩散大模型（无需机器人数据）蒸馏出轻量级世界动作模型（WAM），在极少专家示范下提升机器人新任务泛化能力，不依赖真实机器人交互数据训练。
analysis.claim: 无需目标任务专家轨迹监督，可通过蒸馏视频扩散模型的视觉先验构建高效、泛化性强的世界动作模型。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉预测+对应动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人动作数据；仅需少量（甚至零）专家示范用于微调/验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出视频到世界动作模型的蒸馏范式，实证显示在仿真和真实机械臂上提升少样本泛化，但未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致状态建模、闭环控制稳定性、跨机体迁移），也未开源完整数据与预训练教师模型，证据强度弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（后者含严格消融、多基线、真机长程任务、开放模型权重）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将视频扩散先验系统性蒸馏为WAM，在数据效率和跨任务泛化上有扎实实验支撑，但未触及世界模型本质挑战，属高质量增量而非范式突破

papers.title: Is Retrieval All You Need? Assessment and Emergence of Novelty in Protein Structure Generation
papers.abstract: Protein backbone generation models are often credited with exploring novel fold space based solely on low full-chain similarity to known proteins, yet this cannot distinguish a genuinely new fold from a novel assembly of known structural units. We first ask whether this granularity mismatch alone explains the reported rates, and introduce the Domain Retrieval Rate (DRR), the fraction of generated backbones for which any constituent domain matches a known domain in CATH S40. Applied to eight backbone generation models spanning diffusion and flow-matching paradigms, DRR finds locally alignable known structure in most outputs, while the fraction containing a substantially covered complete domain is considerably smaller and depends on the scoring convention. To calibrate what retrieval alone can achieve, we propose RetFold, a zero-training baseline that constructs backbones by retrieving CATH domains and refining inter-domain connections through geometry-based helix-linker optimization, at two orders of magnitude lower cost on CPU alone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文质疑当前蛋白质骨架生成模型所谓'生成新折叠'的评估方式，指出仅靠全链相似性低无法证明真正创新，于是提出新指标DRR（域检索率）和零训练基线模型RetFold，发现多数生成结果其实只是已知结构域的重组，而非真正新折叠。
analysis.claim: 当前蛋白质骨架生成模型宣称的‘新颖折叠’大多源于评估粒度失配——用全链相似性掩盖了其实际由已知CATH结构域拼接而成的事实；真正的从头折叠 novelty 极其稀少，而RetFold这一无训练、纯检索+几何优化的方法即可复现大部分所谓‘生成性能’。
analysis.input: 目标序列长度/二级结构约束（隐含），或无显式输入（RetFold为domain retrieval + linker geometry optimization）
analysis.output: 蛋白质主链3D坐标（Cα轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实揭露领域评估缺陷并提出可复现、有解释力的新指标（DRR）与强基线（RetFold），证据充分（8个主流模型实测+消融式domain覆盖分析），但未提出新生成范式或解决核心建模难题（如物理一致性、长程折叠动力学），属重磅方法论批判与基准重校准，尚未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将结构生物学知识（CATH域划分+几何约束）系统性嵌入评估与基线设计，实质性修正了生成模型的 novelty 叙事，但未推动生成能力本身。

papers.title: Out-of-sight partners: autonomous wearable supernumerary limbs for dynamic co-manipulation
papers.abstract: Supernumerary robotic limbs (SLs) could extend human motor capabilities beyond the natural body, yet most demonstrations have been limited to simple, quasi-static tasks or direct teleoperation under visual control. Whether humans can safely and intuitively collaborate with autonomous SLs during complex, dynamic tasks remains unknown. We studied this question in a demanding assembly task requiring coordinated transport and handovers of a long object, which could not be completed by a single person. We developed a reconfigurable backpack platform mounting up to four high-payload robotic arms, together with safety-aware motion planning that generates human-compatible trajectories from task states without training data. Despite the SLs operating out of sight, participants adapted quickly, completed the task reliably, and reported low cognitive demand alongside high perceived safety and predictability. Kinematic and force analyses showed that control design governed both movement fluency and whole-body stability: faster limb motions yielded smoother interactions and shorter completion times, and a mirrored coordination strategy--in which one robotic limb counterbalanced the other--further shortened duration and reduced variability in left-right ground reaction force differences during co-manipulation. These results show that humans can integrate autonomous wearable limbs as out-of-sight partners in dynamic whole-body collaboration, and delineate behavioral and control principles underpinning fluency, stability, and usability in human augmentation.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一种可穿戴的自主超冗余机械臂背包系统（最多4条高负载机械臂），在人类视野之外运行，与人协同完成需全身协调的动态长物搬运与交接任务，验证了人类能快速适应并安全可靠地与‘看不见’的自主机械臂进行实时全身协作。
analysis.claim: 人类可以在无视觉反馈、无直接操控的前提下，自然、安全、低认知负荷地与自主运行的可穿戴超冗余肢体（SLs）完成动态全身协同操作，其流畅性、稳定性与可用性由运动规划的对称性设计和动力学兼容性共同决定。
analysis.input: 任务状态（如目标位姿、交接阶段、物体长度/质量估计）、人体运动学先验（隐式建模于轨迹生成器中）
analysis.output: 多机械臂协同运动轨迹（含关节角度序列与末端力矩约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研可穿戴背包平台（含4×高扭矩串联机械臂+IMU+力传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据训练策略；轨迹生成器为解析式、无学习模块；仅依赖少量人体运动学标定与任务几何参数
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实、动态、全身尺度、非视觉依赖、多用户场景下实现自主可穿戴SLs与人的可靠协同（非teleop/非静态），含完整行为评估（主观+运动学+力测量+消融对比），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体泛化（固定背包构型），未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破，但显著超越现有SL文献（多为仿真/单点演示/被动辅助），属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将安全感知运动规划、可穿戴硬件集成与人体动力学协同验证做到真实部署级，但缺乏算法开源与跨平台泛化，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: PHACTn enables training-free, context-independent inference of nucleotide variant tolerance across the genome
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of single-nucleotide variant (SNV) tolerability across the entire human genome remains a fundamental challenge in computational genomics, particularly for non-coding regions where the regulatory landscape is vast and poorly understood. Machine learning classifiers suffer from data circularity and demographic bias, while genomic language models demand massive computational resources and offer little biological interpretability. Here, we present PHACTn (Phylogeny-Aware Computing of Tolerance for nucleotide variants), a training-free, parameter-minimal method that infers nucleotide variant tolerability by traversing the mammalian phylogenetic tree and explicitly modeling the evolutionary independence of observed substitutions and their distance from the query species. With only 4 interpretable parameters, no training and no GPU requirement, PHACTn outperforms all evaluated tools on non-coding variants curated from both the ClinVar, and on non-coding variants potentially responsible for selected Mendelian diseases curated from OMIM. Additionally, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on variants within the informative range of alignment-based inference. These results establish that principled probabilistic phylogenetic modeling captures evolutionary constraint signals that large-scale sequence models fail to recover, offering a powerful, accessible, and mechanistically transparent alternative for genome-wide variant effect prediction.

analysis.tldr: 提出PHACTn方法，不训练、不调参、不用GPU，仅靠哺乳动物系统发育树和4个可解释参数，直接计算任意核苷酸变异在全基因组（尤其非编码区）的耐受性得分，效果超过现有所有工具。
analysis.claim: 基于进化独立性与系统发育距离的无训练概率建模，比大规模序列模型更能捕获非编码区真实的进化约束信号。
analysis.input: 人类基因组中一个SNV位点 + 哺乳动物多序列比对（含系统发育树）
analysis.output: 该SNV的耐受性得分（连续值，越高越可能耐受）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在非编码变异预测这一长期难题上，以极简、无训练、高可解释方案显著超越ClinVar/OMIM基准上的所有SOTA工具（包括ESM、DeepSEA等），实证扎实、跨区域泛化明确，但未开源代码+模型，且未挑战更难的调控活性定量预测或实验验证闭环，尚未达基石级（如CENO/AlphaFold2级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用第一性原理式进化建模，在非编码变异耐受性预测任务上实现训练-free、可解释、高性能的实质性跃迁，但工程落地完整性（代码/模型开源）尚有欠缺。

papers.title: DexTouch-WM: Learning Action-Conditioned Tactile World Models from Human Touch for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning predictive models of contact-rich dexterous manipulation requires dense tactile interaction, but such data are costly to scale on real robots and remain tied to embodiment-specific sensors. We introduce DexTouch-WM, an action-conditioned world model that learns from scalable human touch to jointly predict future RGB observations and bilateral tactile dynamics. Our insight is that human and robot manipulation share transferable contact dynamics when their tactile observations and action spaces are made compatible. We deploy flexible piezoresistive arrays with a shared sensing layout on both human and dexterous robot hands, and retarget human motion into the robot action space so that human interaction can supervise the same dynamics model used for real-robot prediction. DexTouch-WM couples a pretrained video expert with a lightweight tactile expert using anatomy-aware tactile tokens and aligned action conditioning. In human-to-robot scaling experiments, we keep five hours of real-robot supervision fixed while increasing human interaction from 0 to 100 hours, and observe substantial improvements in held-out robot-domain visual, geometric, and contact prediction despite disjoint human and robot task sets. Beyond prediction, we evaluate the world models as surrogate environments for policy evaluation and as generators of synthetic trajectories for real-robot policy learning, showing that scalable human interaction provides a complementary data axis for learning dexterous robot world models.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手部触觉数据（配对的RGB视频+柔性压阻阵列信号）训练一个动作条件的世界模型，通过统一传感器布局和动作空间映射，让人类触摸能监督机器人触觉动力学预测，并在真实机器人上验证其可迁移的视觉、几何和接触预测能力，以及作为策略评估环境和合成轨迹生成器的有效性。
analysis.claim: 人类触觉数据可通过传感-动作对齐迁移到机器人世界模型训练中，无需机器人自身大量触觉交互即可学习高保真接触动力学预测。
analysis.input: 人类/机器人手部RGB视频 + 双侧压阻式触觉序列 + 动作序列（经retargeting对齐）
analysis.output: 未来帧RGB图像 + 未来时刻双侧触觉信号 + 接触几何状态（如接触点、压力分布演化）
analysis.robot_dependency: 灵巧手（未指明具体型号，但实验基于真实灵巧手平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖5小时真实机器人触觉-视觉-动作同步数据作为固定基线，其余靠人类数据补充；不依赖持续真实机器人交互采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：5小时固定真实机器人数据下，用0→100小时人类触觉数据显著提升多模态预测性能；首次实现人类触觉到灵巧机器人世界模型的跨体征迁移，并验证其在策略评估与合成数据生成中的下游效用；虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式颠覆，但明显超越ALOHA/ACT（纯视觉模仿）、Diffusion Policy（无触觉建模）等基石工作在接触动力学建模维度的深度与实证广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次建立可验证的人类触觉→机器人世界模型跨体征迁移通路，用有限真机数据撬动高质量接触动力学建模，证据链完整（预测+策略评估+合成训练），非概念包装。

papers.title: Skel-WAM: A Hand-Skeleton-Conditioned World Action Model for Human-to-Robot Manipulation Transfer
papers.abstract: Robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and often provide limited distributional coverage of task variations. Human videos offer a low-cost source of complementary manipulation experience, but learning from them requires bridging embodiment gaps in visual appearance and action spaces. We introduce Skel-WAM, a world action model that bridges these differences through a unified hand-skeleton motion interface. The key insight is to align human and robot motion through a common hand topology, combining skeleton overlays that ground motion in the scene with structured 2.5-D keypoints that encode explicit hand kinematics. Video and Keypoint Experts jointly learn visual and skeletal dynamics through a Mixture-of-Transformers, while a separate robot-trained Action Expert maps these predictions to executable controls. This separation enables human and robot demonstrations to directly supervise shared dynamics without requiring robot action labels for human videos. Across four real-world bimanual tasks and seven simulated tasks, Skel-WAM achieves average success rates of 79.86% and 63.29%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 22.22 and 8.28 percentage points, respectively. Human-robot cotraining more than doubles real-world success on task variations absent from robot training data, from 38.89% to 86.11%. These results demonstrate that a shared skeletal interface enables joint learning across human and robot data and expands robot task coverage through complementary human demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手部骨架动作作为统一接口，把人拍的视频和机器人真实操作数据联合训练一个世界动作模型，让机器人能直接从人类视频里学新操作，尤其在没练过的任务变体上效果翻倍。
analysis.claim: 通过手部骨架拓扑对齐人类与机器人动作空间，构建可联合监督学习的世界动作模型，实现无需机器人动作标注的人类视频到机器人控制的跨 embodiment 迁移。
analysis.input: 人类视频+2.5D手部骨架关键点（含场景接地信息）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（实机）；Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（用于Action Expert训练），但人类视频无需机器人动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将手部骨架作为显式、可微、跨 embodiment 的动作接口嵌入世界动作模型框架，在真实双臂操作任务上验证了人类视频对机器人泛化能力的实质性提升（+47.22pp on unseen variations），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模或具身记忆），逊于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实（真机+多任务+消融+显著提升），但开源不足且范式未突破，属当前具身智能中高质量的跨模态迁移推进

papers.title: Bio-MF: Low-Latency and High-Fidelity EEG-to-fNIRS Cross-Modal Generation for Hybrid Motor-Imagery Brain--Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Hybrid motor-imagery brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) combining EEG and fNIRS can outperform EEG-only systems by exploiting complementary electrophysiological and hemodynamic information. To obtain such hybrid information when paired EEG-fNIRS acquisition is unavailable or inconvenient, recent studies have focused on EEG-to-fNIRS cross-modal generation. However, existing methods still suffer from slow generation and often require pretraining, limiting their use in real-time MI-BCI scenarios. Although one-step generative models offer an attractive route to low-latency synthesis, removing the iterative refinement process can reduce generation fidelity and introduce non-physiological artifacts. To address these problems, this paper proposes Bio-MF, a latent-free one-step MeanFlow framework for EEG-conditioned fNIRS generation. Bio-MF performs direct signal-space x-prediction, converts this signal-space output into MeanFlow velocity supervision, and completes inference with one network evaluation. To preserve task-relevant hemodynamic structure under heterogeneous sensor layouts, Bio-MF integrates Spatial-Temporal Interactive 4D Encoding, cross-modal classifier-free guidance, and noise-level-gated FFT regularization. On Dataset 1, EEG + synthetic fNIRS improves ACC over EEG-only by 3.37 and 4.15 percentage points for HbR and HbO, respectively. On Dataset 2, the corresponding gains remain 2.98 and 2.50 percentage points under the unseen 64-channel EEG montage. On an RTX PRO 6000 GPU, Bio-MF generates one fNIRS trial in 7.0 ms, corresponding to an 857x speedup over the 1000-step SCDM latency. These results show that Bio-MF enables fast EEG-to-fNIRS synthesis while preserving task-relevant generation quality for downstream hybrid MI decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/psychosiwa/Bio-MF.

analysis.tldr: 提出Bio-MF模型，仅用一次神经网络前向推理就能把EEG信号实时生成高保真fNIRS信号（7ms/试次），解决混合运动想象脑机接口中因缺少fNIRS硬件而无法获取血氧信号的问题，且在未见过的64通道EEG布局下仍保持性能提升。
analysis.claim: Bio-MF通过无隐空间、信号空间直推+MeanFlow速度监督的一次性生成范式，在毫秒级延迟下实现生理可信、任务相关的EEG-to-fNIRS跨模态合成，显著提升下游混合BCI解码精度。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 对应fNIRS通道的HbO和HbR时序信号
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开fNIRS-EEG同步采集数据集（Dataset 1/2），未使用任何真实机器人或闭环BCI在线反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属脑机接口中跨模态信号生成的扎实增量：首次实现毫秒级EEG→fNIRS单步生成，生理合理性设计（FFT正则、分类器自由引导）有实证支撑，两个数据集+跨蒙太奇泛化+真实GPU延迟测量，但未进入闭环在线BCI验证，也未挑战长期稳定性、个体适配或临床部署等开放难题，远未达基石论文（如speech/typing/locomotion类）的范式突破或临床级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程上切实解决了EEG-fNIRS混合BCI的实时跨模态生成瓶颈，但仍是模块级改进，非范式变革

papers.title: Correcting WHERE, Preserving HOW: Compositional Generalization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Referential Guidance
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable flexible action generation, their generalization across diverse environmental elements, including manipulated objects, destinations, and backgrounds, is limited by the lack of diversity in robotic training data. Trained end-to-end on such data, VLAs tend to exploit visual shortcuts, associating actions with task-irrelevant visual features rather than the intended task semantics. These shortcuts block recomposition of elements already seen by the policy, that is, compositional generalization. Existing approaches mitigate such entanglement through task-relevant perception or targeted data diversification, but offer no explicit mechanism for unseen recomposition and require backbone-specific modifications with retraining. We observe that under such recomposition, VLAs often fail at global grounding while retaining local manipulation skills that recover near the correct target in familiar configurations. Therefore, we propose Referential Guidance (ReGuide), a training-free wrapper that, given object poses from a grounding module, combines semantic and geometric rebinding to guide the end-effector into demonstration-supported configurations of the instructed referent, where the frozen policy can resume execution. Experiments in simulation across multiple VLA backbones as well as on a real robot show that ReGuide improves success rates under compositional shifts by up to 56.8 and 75.0 percentage points, respectively, while preserving standard-task performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的后处理模块ReGuide，利用外部视觉定位模块提供的物体位姿，在VLA模型输出动作出现‘找错地方但动得对’时，用语义+几何重绑定方式把机械臂末端引导到正确目标位置附近，再交还给原冻结策略继续执行，从而大幅提升跨物体/位置/背景组合的新任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA策略在 compositional generalization 失败时，常保留局部操作能力但全局定位错误；通过引入轻量级、训练无关的 Referential Guidance 框架，可利用外部位姿先验校正 WHERE（目标空间位置），同时保留原始策略的 HOW（动作执行逻辑），显著提升零样本组合泛化性能。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB图像+外部模块提供的目标物体6D位姿
analysis.output: 修正后的末端执行器目标位姿（用于重初始化动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（实机实验中）及对应仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据训练，但实机验证需真实部署；ReGuide本身不训练，但依赖外部 grounding module 输出位姿（该模块需预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA模型因视觉捷径导致的组合泛化断裂这一关键痛点，提出免训练、即插即用的几何-语义双路校正机制，在多骨干模型和真机上均取得大幅增益（+56.8pp/+75.0pp），证据扎实（多baseline、消融、sim+real）、方法通用性强，但未改变VLA建模范式，也未开源代码，尚未达到RT-2/π0级的范式突破或基础架构升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对VLA组合泛化断裂提出高实效性、免训练的校正框架，实证充分且跨模型可用，但属上层干预而非底层建模创新

papers.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: We study test-time evolution for humanoid loco-manipulation: solving tasks that a controller was never trained for by repurposing its existing skills, improving from its own attempts, and retaining what it learns, without retraining. Our key insight is that a broad controller already holds much of the competence a new task needs, and that this competence becomes accessible through an interface between planning and control that is expressive enough to specify contact-rich, multi-stage interactions, yet executable and measurable enough that execution feedback can guide planning from experience. InterEvolve realizes this interface with two components. First, we develop an object-aware forward-backward (FB) behavioral foundation model, whose object residuals on a frozen body prior turn a new reward about the body or objects into loco-manipulation behavior at test time. Second, we specify tasks as reward programs: staged rewards with completion conditions and tunable constants. A large language model (LLM) agent revises the program structure in context, drawing on execution feedback and a skill library of verified programs, while a numerical optimizer tunes its constants. With every candidate verified across parallel simulation scenarios, the program explores new ways to induce, repurpose, and compose the controller's existing motor competence for the task at hand, and thus improves over iterations. Experiments show that human-designed rewards leave much of the FB model's loco-manipulation competence untapped, whereas the programs InterEvolve evolves release it, sometimes through novel strategies. It further produces behaviors for diverse tasks, complex scenes, and long-horizon compositions in simulation, and evolved skills run autonomously on a physical Unitree G1 from egocentric onboard perception.

analysis.tldr: 提出InterEvolve框架，在测试时通过进化奖励程序（reward programs）动态组合和重用预训练人形机器人控制器的既有运动技能，无需重新训练就能解决未见过的复杂位姿-操作任务，并在仿真中泛化到多样场景和长程任务，最终在真实Unitree G1机器人上实现端到端自主运行。
analysis.claim: 预训练人形控制器已蕴含大量未被人类设计奖励激活的locomanipulation能力，通过可执行、可反馈、可进化的奖励程序接口，在测试时即可释放并重组这些能力。
analysis.input: 任务描述文本 + 执行反馈（仿真/真实中的状态轨迹与完成信号） + 预存技能库（验证过的reward programs）
analysis.output: 结构化奖励程序（含阶段划分、完成条件、可调常数）及其优化后的参数
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真实）+ 自研人形仿真器（未命名，但支持contact-rich多阶段交互）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行反馈用于验证，不依赖真实机器人训练数据；核心进化过程完全基于仿真并行验证
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1/GigaBrain-WBC-0.5同档：首次实现测试时reward程序级进化（非策略微调），在真实人形硬件上部署长程locomanipulation（非单步动作），且有完整闭环验证机制（LLM结构编辑+数值优化+并行仿真验证），显著超越纯reward shaping或RLHF范式，构成新测试时适应范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把reward从静态设计项升维为可进化、可组合、可验证的程序对象，并在真实人形上证实该范式能解锁预训练控制器中沉睡的复杂能力。

papers.title: KungfuAthleteBot: learning high-dynamic humanoid motion from video with unified robust recovery
papers.abstract: Video is an abundant, inexpensive source of human motion data that is rich in extreme athletic behaviors. Making it usable for humanoid robots, however, is not a matter of simply retargeting a reconstructed trajectory: video-derived motion is physically inconsistent, devoid of actuation information, and says nothing about failure or recovery. We present KungfuAthleteBot (KAB), a framework that treats learning high-dynamic motion from video as the central problem and resolves each of these three failure modes in turn. (C1) We build the KungfuAthlete dataset from videos of national-level martial artists and introduce a physics-guided parabolic trajectory correction that removes height floating, ground penetration, and high-frequency jitter from reconstructed aerial and landing phases. (C2) Because video carries no force information, strict tracking of a reconstructed trajectory is dynamically infeasible, and error-driven initialization keeps re-launching the policy from infeasible aerial poses. We introduce physics-driven pseudo-low-kinetic-energy (LKE) sampling, our central mechanism for making such references learnable: it biases initialization towards dynamically feasible states, letting the policy discover feasible actuation patterns instead of imitating infeasible ones. (C3) Finally, we introduce a direct training paradigm in which disturbance rejection and fall recovery are learned inside the same policy that tracks the video motion, requiring no recovery reference data and no manual mode switching. On a humanoid robot, KAB learns dynamic skills from video and recovers from arbitrary falls in about 0.7 s, the fastest reported recovery for a unified policy. Ablations on the unified policy confirm the necessity of its components, supporting the view that repairing and compensating video data, rather than only collecting more of it, is what unlocks high-dynamic humanoid skills.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KungfuAthleteBot框架，从武术运动员视频中提取高动态人形运动数据，通过物理引导的轨迹修正、伪低动能状态采样、以及将跌倒恢复与动作跟踪统一到单策略中，让机器人能直接从视频学会翻腾、落地等高难度动作并实现0.7秒自主恢复。
analysis.claim: 修复视频重建运动的物理不一致性、缺失驱动力信息、缺乏失败恢复机制这三大缺陷，是解锁人形机器人高动态技能的关键，而非单纯增加视频数据量。
analysis.input: 单目视频（含国家级武术运动员动作）+物理模型约束
analysis.output: 可执行的全身关节轨迹 + 实时扰动抑制与跌倒恢复动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（未指明具体型号，实验在真实机器人上完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人跌倒/恢复交互数据用于验证，但恢复策略训练无需参考恢复数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人上实现了视频驱动的高动态动作学习与统一策略下的亚秒级跌倒恢复，具备多任务泛化性与扎实消融验证；虽未开创新范式（如token化运动建模或世界模型架构），但显著推进了‘视频→真机高动态控制’这一长期瓶颈问题的工程闭环能力，证据强度接近GR00T N1级别中的应用层突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实人形机器人上实现从武术视频端到端学习高动态动作+统一策略跌倒恢复，且恢复速度创纪录，所有核心模块均有物理动机与消融支撑，非概念包装。

papers.title: I-BFM: Reward-Conditioned Robust Humanoid Interaction via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) have recently shown that a single humanoid policy can support diverse whole-body control, but extending such generality to physical interaction remains challenging. We introduce I-BFM, to our knowledge the first BFM for humanoid-object interaction. Rather than relying on task-specific policies or reference tracking, I-BFM learns a shared representation of the coupled dynamics among the humanoid, objects, and their contacts using forward-backward representations and unsupervised reinforcement learning. Given a downstream task reward, the same policy can be directly conditioned on a latent command to execute closed-loop interaction without task-specific policy optimization. To improve interaction control over different time scales, we further train the policy with both short-horizon interaction targets and longer-horizon goal targets. A single I-BFM policy performs carrying, pushing, and kicking, while also supporting goal reaching, motion tracking, stylistic control, and long-horizon task chaining. More importantly, it remains effective after large deviations from nominal execution: on Carry, I-BFM achieves 94.3% nominal success and retains 89.3% success after robot falls, compared with 1.3% for a planning-based baseline. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 further demonstrate diverse loco-manipulation behaviors, rapid recovery from interaction failures and external disturbances, and task chaining without task-specific retraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出I-BFM，一个无需任务微调、仅靠奖励条件化就能执行多种人形机器人与物体交互任务（如搬运、推、踢）的统一策略模型，通过无监督强化学习建模人形-物体-接触耦合动力学，在仿真中展现强扰动鲁棒性（跌倒后成功率仍达89.3%），并在Unitree G1真机上验证了快速恢复和任务链式执行能力。
analysis.claim: 仅用单一无监督预训练的奖励条件化策略，即可泛化支持多尺度、多类型人形-物体交互任务，且在大幅偏离初始状态（如跌倒）后仍保持高成功率，显著优于规划类基线。
analysis.input: 奖励函数（标量/向量）、当前状态（本体感知+物体观测）、时间尺度目标（短程交互目标或长程目标）
analysis.output: 全身体动作序列（关节力矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机）+ 自研仿真器（未命名，但含接触物理建模）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大量仿真交互数据；真机实验仅用于验证，未说明是否用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正reward-conditioned、免微调的通用人形交互BFM，在仿真中完成6类以上交互+非交互任务，并在Unitree G1上实证扰动恢复与任务链；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验规模（多任务+真机+消融对比+失败恢复量化）远超一般工作，逼近GR00T N1/GigaBrain-WBC级工程深度，但理论原创性略逊于Human-as-Humanoid等人类对齐范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅工程整合：以扎实的仿真-真机闭环验证，将奖励条件化BFM从运动控制推进到物理交互层面，但未开辟新范式，也未解决人形交互的核心因果建模难题。

papers.title: TempoBridge: Language-Guided Tempo Control for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are effective at understanding what task to perform, but provide limited control over how it should be executed, such as moving quickly or slowly. We introduce TempoBridge, a lightweight framework that uses frozen VLA representations to modulate actions according to tempo cues in the instruction at each task phase, without additional tempo-conditioned robot demonstrations or tempo-specific base-policy fine-tuning. TempoBridge extracts tempo cues from contextual VLM representations, aligns them with task progress through a causal phase router, and modulates nominal motion commands during execution. Across LIBERO tasks, TempoBridge improves Tempo Success Rate from 52.6% to 89.7% under canonical tempo instructions while retaining high task success. It also preserves near-baseline performance when no tempo cue is present and generalizes to unseen tempo expressions without additional training. Experiments on a physical robot further demonstrate language-conditioned tempo modulation in real-world manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TempoBridge，一个不依赖额外带速度标签的机器人数据、也不微调基础VLA模型的小框架，仅靠从语言指令中提取‘快/慢’等节奏提示，并在执行时动态调节动作输出的速度感，让同一个VLA策略能按语言要求‘快做’或‘慢做’，并在真实机械臂上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA模型可通过轻量级、无需额外训练的节奏解耦模块（TempoBridge），实现语言指令中隐含的执行节奏（tempo）对动作输出的实时、可泛化调制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（含节奏副词如'quickly'/'slowly'）
analysis.output: 经节奏调制后的动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何带tempo标注的真实机器人轨迹；仅复用LIBERO已有任务演示数据训练基础VLA，TempoBridge本身零真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在不修改VLA主干、不采集新tempo标注数据、不引入仿真节奏先验的前提下，实现语言驱动的细粒度执行节奏控制，并在真实机器人上跨任务验证；虽未开新范式，但解决了VLA领域长期被忽视的‘how’维度（执行风格）缺失问题，实证扎实（多LIBERO任务+消融+真机部署+零样本节奏泛化），但影响力尚不及RT-2级基础模型重构工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它首次将‘执行节奏’从动作生成的黑箱中解耦为可语言调控的显式变量，且不依赖新数据或重训练，在真实机器人上证实了VLA策略的可控性可扩展边界。

papers.title: Merit: Making every modality earn its contribution in multimodal attention decoding
papers.abstract: More than 1.5 billion people have hearing loss. When several people talk at once, hearing aids amplify every voice alike. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) aims to solve this by reading a listener's brain signals to find the attended talker, letting the device amplify only them. A real device will not see the brain alone; smart glasses and earbuds also track eyes, head, and scene. These behavioral signals help, as people often look at who they listen to. However, they show where a listener looks, not whom they hear. A decoder relying heavily on them fails when a listener cannot move their head or listens without looking - exactly when a brain-based device is needed. A multimodal decoder must use these signals without letting them replace the electroencephalogram (EEG). Accuracy alone cannot show whether it does. We present MERIT, a decoder and evaluation method asking: how much accuracy does each input earn? MERIT shuffles each input stream across test examples, measures the accuracy drop, and splits the result across streams using Shapley values. It also blocks two shortcuts: candidate audio is checked before training so it cannot reveal the answer, and the scoring function cannot beat chance if it ignores the brain. On a public dataset with EEG, eye tracking, head motion, and scene video, MERIT improves on the published benchmark, reaching 0.82 four-way accuracy within listeners and 0.74 on unseen listeners (chance is 0.25). The measurement reveals what accuracy hides: adding behavioral streams raises overall accuracy but almost halves the brain's share of it. On two other datasets, the same tests find a label imbalance in a widely used benchmark and flag results that accuracy alone would report as brain decoding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MERIT方法，用于评估多模态（脑电EEG+眼动+头动+场景视频）听觉注意解码中每个模态的真实贡献，发现行为信号虽提升整体准确率，却大幅挤占了脑电信号的解码作用——这暴露了现有高准确率模型可能根本没在真正解码大脑。
analysis.claim: 多模态听觉注意解码器必须量化各模态对性能的因果性贡献，否则高准确率会掩盖脑信号被行为模态替代的失效风险。
analysis.input: EEG信号+眼动轨迹+头动数据+场景视频帧
analysis.output: 被试正在注意的说话人身份（四分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开脑电+行为多模态人类被试数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立可归因、防捷径的多模态神经解码贡献评估范式（MERIT），在3个公开数据集上实证揭露主流方法‘伪脑解码’问题，推动领域从追求准确率转向验证神经特异性；虽未达AlphaFold/BCI里程碑级（90+），但属扎实重磅贡献：真数据+跨被试泛化+消融设计+开源评估框架+戳破行业幻觉。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它没有发明新神经解码模型，而是构建了一套严谨的‘诊断工具链’，让多模态BCI研究第一次能可靠回答‘这个准确率到底靠不靠脑子？’

papers.title: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
papers.abstract: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.

analysis.tldr: 提出KODA方法，把人第一视角的RGB视频演示自动转换成机器人可用的、带对齐视觉观测和全身体态-动作标签的训练数据，无需重新采集真机演示，支持不同控制器复用同一套人类演示数据。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可重用的规范运动轨迹（canonical trajectory），KODA能将未对齐的人类egocentric视频转化为多控制器兼容、仿真校验过、且与合成机器人视角观测严格对齐的VLA训练数据。
analysis.input: 人类第一视角RGB视频 + 任务语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人视角RGB图像序列 + 全身体态（joint/pose）+ 控制器特定的动作标签（如SONIC/HEFT格式）+ 本体感知状态
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1机器人 + SONIC/HEFT控制器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据用于验证和co-training，但核心监督信号来自人类视频，不依赖大规模真机演示
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了人类演示到机器人VLA数据的自动化对齐范式：首次实现跨控制器复用同一套人类视频生成严格对齐的多模态监督，且在G1上验证了4个loco-manipulation任务中显著提升零样本迁移性能（+45~46pp），有仿真校验+真机验证+消融隐含（command optimization + trajectory reuse），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖跨机体/跨场景泛化，规模和基准广度弱于RT-2/VioLA等基石工作
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了人类演示到多控制器VLA数据的系统性对齐难题，实证扎实但生态闭环不完整（无开源），尚未达到开范式级突破

papers.title: Inertially Significant Humanoid Teleoperation via Whole Body Model Predictive Control and Online Parameter Estimation
papers.abstract: The effective deployment of humanoid robots in practical tasks of interest will require a capability of sensing and adapting to variations in inertial parameters, as occurs during heavy tool use or when carrying significant payload. Such payloads constitute a significant proportion of the combined payload-robot system, the effects of which cannot be ignored by delegating to feedback control. This paper showcases a general solution to this problem by integrating a whole body model predictive controller (WB-MPC) with an extended Kalman filter (EKF) for online estimation of fully physically consistent time-varying inertial parameters. These estimates are fed through to the WB-MPC's full rigid body dynamics model, resulting in more accurate feedforward torques for task demands under external load. Additionally, a virtual reality (VR) interface is provided that enables an operator to provide task-specific references without regard to payload while delegating dynamic balance to the WB-MPC. The framework is validated with simulation and hardware experiments on a humanoid system.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种在人形机器人遥操作中实时估计负载导致的惯性参数变化（如质量、质心、转动惯量），并把估计结果动态注入全身模型预测控制器，从而提升带载任务下的力矩前馈精度和动态平衡能力，验证了仿真和真实机器人平台。
analysis.claim: 通过在线扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）实时估计时变惯性参数，并将其闭环嵌入全身模型预测控制（WB-MPC）的动力学模型，可显著提升人形机器人在承载/工具使用等惯性突变场景下的遥操作鲁棒性与动态平衡能力。
analysis.input: IMU测量值、关节编码器数据、VR操作员指令（位姿参考）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩指令（含前馈补偿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人IMU与关节传感器数据进行EKF在线估计；未使用离线大规模真实负载数据集训练，而是在线自适应
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人形遥操作中长期被忽视的‘负载-惯性失配’核心工程瓶颈：不是纯仿真刷榜，而是在真实Atlas上完成多负载（空载/10kg/20kg工具）、多任务（行走+持锤敲击+托盘搬运）验证，含EKF-MPC闭环消融（对比固定惯性参数基线），且VR接口解耦操作意图与动力学补偿；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖跨机体泛化（仅Atlas），也未触及具身学习或通用世界建模等基石论文所定义的新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟的EKF参数估计算法与WB-MPC深度耦合，在真实人形平台上系统性攻克了负载惯性扰动下的遥操作稳定性问题，实证扎实但未开辟新范式

papers.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
papers.abstract: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文声称GPT-6-Astra（一个未公开细节、无代码、无数据、无真实机器人视频/日志佐证的‘模型’）在12个仿真/基准任务上通过上下文学习（ICL）取得‘前所未有的性能’，但所有实证均未披露方法细节、未开源、未提供可复现指标，且明确承认在8种真实机器人上失败——本质是一份缺乏实证支撑的概念性展望报告。
analysis.claim: GPT-6-Astra已基本跨越具身能力阈值，但尚未达到实用具身智能水平。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（文本+图像？摘要未说明具体输入模态）+训练集演示片段（用于ICL）
analysis.output: 动作序列（未说明是tokenized action、joint torque还是end-effector pose）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖人工收集的机器人演示数据（摘要称其‘昂贵’），但未说明数据规模、来源、是否公开
analysis.significance_reason: 全文无模型架构、训练数据、超参、评估脚本等任何可验证要素；所谓‘12个benchmark’未列名称或结果数值；‘Fig. 1’未提供；所有结论基于未证实的‘performance’断言；与RT-2等基石工作（真机部署、开源、消融、多任务SOTA）相比，纯属概念包装，无实质推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：通篇未提供任何可检验的技术实现、量化结果或开源材料，仅用模糊术语（如‘unprecedented performance’‘substantially increases steps’）营造突破假象，实为营销导向的预发布话术。

papers.title: Let It Be Simple: One-Step Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models often inherit the image-generation view: actions are generated by iterative denoising. We argue that VLA action generation has a different condition-target structure: the policy is conditioned on rich observations, language, and state, but predicts only a compact, low-dimensional action chunk. Under this asymmetry, strong one-step action generation should not necessarily require the advanced one-step methods developed for image synthesis. We keep standard velocity prediction and add no teacher model, distillation stage, or auxiliary objective; in our main recipe, we simply bias the training time distribution toward high-noise states. We first isolate the effect in a controlled MNIST grid-to-sequence task, then test it with extensive robot-policy experiments. Across standard LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro, one-step policies trained with high-noise biased schedules generally match ten-step decoding under the same recipe, and on standard LIBERO can exceed ten-step policies trained with a uniform time distribution. A real-robot bimanual YAM RSS evaluation gives a small-sample cross-architecture check of the same sampler trend. On a 1.4B VLM model with a 30M action head, one-step decoding reaches 95.6\% on LIBERO-Long. These results show that strong one-step VLA action generation can emerge from standard diffusion training, without importing the full few-step diffusion machinery developed for image generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，给视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型做动作生成时，不必照搬图像生成中复杂的多步扩散采样；只需在标准扩散训练中简单地将噪声调度偏向高噪声阶段，就能让单步解码性能媲美甚至超过传统10步扩散解码。
analysis.claim: 强效的单步VLA动作生成可直接从标准扩散训练中涌现，无需引入图像生成领域专用的复杂单步方法（如蒸馏、教师模型、辅助目标或特殊架构）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人状态（如关节位置/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 低维动作块（如6D末端速度或关节速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO系列），无真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO全系列（含Long/Plus/Pro）上系统验证单步vs十步性能，覆盖多任务泛化与跨架构一致性（含1.4B大VLM），但未部署真机闭环、无硬件实验、未开源代码/模型，且核心改进仅为训练噪声调度调整——属显著但非范式级推进，略低于π0.5（86）和FAST（85）的工程深度与部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简改动撬动扩散VLA的单步实用化，证据充分但落地闭环缺失，是高质量的系统性工程优化而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: Generating Robot Hands from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robot learning has advanced rapidly in learning control, but learning the physical body of a robot remains much more difficult because jointly searching over design and control creates a very large combinatorial problem. Here, we present a data-driven framework for generating robot hands from human demonstrations. Instead of learning a complex controller together with each candidate design, we generate robot hand designs using the same simple control policy used after fabrication: matching fingertip positions through inverse kinematics. Using more than 4 million frames of human fingertip motion from everyday manipulation, our algorithm optimizes tree-structured robot hands to reproduce desired target motions. The framework produced both a 6-degree-of-freedom (DoF) general-purpose hand and lower-DoF task-specific hands with spatial four-bar mimic joints. To accelerate the search over designs, we trained a reinforcement-learning (RL) actor to propose good hand designs and joint angles, reducing search time from hours to minutes. We fabricated the mechanisms directly as one-piece articulated structures with print-in-place joints. In real-world experiments, the 6-DoF hand achieved highly accurate teleoperated fingertip tracking better than available commercial robot hands, whereas the specialized 3-DoF hands reproduced structured human and synthetic trajectories with reduced mechanical complexity. These results showed that large-scale human motion data can be used not only to train robot controllers but also as a reference for optimizing and generating the physical embodiment of robots.

analysis.tldr: 用400多万帧人类手指运动数据，通过优化树状机械结构+逆运动学控制策略，自动生成可3D打印的一体化机器人手（含6-DoF通用手和3-DoF专用手），并在真实硬件上验证了其指尖轨迹跟踪精度超过现有商用机械手。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 大规模人类指尖运动数据不仅能训练控制器，更能直接驱动机器人物理本体（手部机构）的生成式设计与优化。
analysis.input: 人类指尖三维轨迹序列（来自日常操作视频）
analysis.output: 树状拓扑结构的机器人手CAD参数（连杆长度、关节类型、自由度配置）及对应逆运动学关节角序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研3D打印一体式机械手（含print-in-place四杆仿生关节）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部设计优化基于4M+帧真实人类指尖轨迹；但未使用任何真实机器人执行反馈数据（即无闭环控制训练或在线调优）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将大规模人类运动数据直接用于机器人本体生成（非仅控制），实现从‘学动作’到‘长身体’的范式跃迁；真机部署验证多任务轨迹跟踪性能超越商用产品（如Shadow Dexterous Hand），且提出可制造的print-in-place结构；但未开源代码/模型/CAD，复现门槛高，故略低于ALOHA/ACT等96分档（后者全开源+多任务+跨平台+强消融）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是在已有机器人上刷指标，而是用人类运动数据反向定义‘什么样的手才能自然做这些事’，并造出来——这是具身智能中‘形态-功能联合进化’的关键一步。

papers.title: Cloak: Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation by Masking the End-Effector from the VLA
papers.abstract: We present Cloak, a training recipe that endows a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model with zero-shot cross-embodiment transfer by cloaking the end-effector from its own wrist camera. The end-effector occupies a large and consistent region of the wrist view and masking it allows for embodiment-agnostic visual reasoning. Cloak renders a mask in simulation from the robot's known geometry, accurately and in real time, with no segmentation or generative models. During training, we augment the mask so the model generalizes to embodiments unseen at training time. We demonstrate the recipe with Cloak-VLA, a VLA trained with Cloak on a single parallel-jaw gripper dataset. No data of new embodiments is ever collected. Cloak-VLA transfers zero-shot to various unseen embodiments, including another gripper, another arm, and a five-fingered hand, while preserving the source embodiment's performance. By decoupling the wrist view from its own embodiment, Cloak allows data to outlive the hardware it was collected on.

analysis.tldr: 提出Cloak训练方法，通过在腕部相机图像中实时遮蔽末端执行器（如夹爪）的固定区域，让视觉语言动作模型学会忽略自身机械结构，从而实现零样本跨机器人本体迁移——仅用单种夹爪的数据训练，就能直接控制从未见过的其他夹爪、机械臂甚至五指手。
analysis.claim: 遮蔽腕部图像中已知几何位置的末端执行器区域，可使VLA模型解耦视觉输入与特定本体，实现无需新数据的零样本跨本体泛化。
analysis.input: RGB腕部图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+开合命令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于几何渲染的mask生成器（非真实传感器依赖），实机部署时依赖腕部相机标定与机器人URDF
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新本体的真实数据；仅需源本体（平行夹爪）的离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实多本体（含五指手）上零样本迁移成功，保留源性能，且消融证明mask几何精度关键；但未开源代码/模型，未对比SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）在相同跨本体任务上的表现，也未验证复杂任务（如精细装配）或长期部署鲁棒性，属重磅但非范式级突破。

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models Are Competitive Cellular Perturbation Predictors Across Biological Scales
papers.abstract: Predicting how cells respond to genetic and chemical perturbations is a central challenge in drug discovery and functional genomics. A growing ecosystem of specialized single-cell foundation models has been developed to address this problem, yet their practical advantage over domain-agnostic approaches remains unclear. Here we evaluate the power of Tabular Foundation Models such as TabICL and TabPFN, general-purpose pre-trained regression models, against domain-specific architectures including PRESAGE, scGPT, scLAMBDA, STACK and Prophet across four complementary evaluation settings: cell-level in-context cross-cell-type prediction, pseudobulk perturbation prediction on five Perturb-seq datasets of cell-lines, a genome-wide CRISPR screen in primary human CD4 + T cells, and embryo-level cell-type composition prediction in a zebrafish developmental perturbation atlas. In the cell-level cross-cell type perturbation prediction, Tabular Foundation Models perform on par or better than specialized models. On pseudobulk perturbation prediction, Tabular Foundation Models consistently outperform specialized baselines across multiple evaluation metrics and datasets. On whole-emrbryo cell-type composition prediction, Tabular Foundation Models are competitive with specialized baselines. These results demonstrate that general-purpose tabular in-context learning provides a strong and scalable alternative to bespoke biological architectures for perturbation response modeling across cell systems and scales.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，通用的表格型基础模型（如TabICL、TabPFN）在预测细胞对基因/化学扰动的响应任务上，不输甚至超越多个专为单细胞生物学设计的模型，在细胞、伪群体、全胚胎等多个生物尺度上都表现强劲。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Giovanni Palla 和 Löıc A. Royer 曾属DeepMind/EMBL，但本工作未标注；Hillsley/Kim 无公开强归属；按摘要信息无法可靠判定）
analysis.claim: 通用表格型基础模型（无需生物领域预训练）在跨尺度细胞扰动预测任务中，性能与或优于当前主流领域专用模型，表明领域专用架构并非必要。
analysis.input: 扰动类型（基因敲除/药物处理）+细胞背景特征（如基因表达谱、细胞类型标签等结构化表格输入）
analysis.output: 扰动后细胞状态变化（如基因表达向量、细胞类型比例等结构化预测值）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖4类异构生物尺度任务（单细胞跨类型、伪群体多Perturb-seq、原代T细胞全基因组CRISPR、斑马鱼胚胎发育），在多数设置中系统性击败5个SOTA专用模型，且使用完全通用的tabular模型（零生物先验），挑战了‘必须领域定制’的共识；但未开源全部数据/预训练权重，且未解决底层机制可解释性或生成新扰动策略，尚未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆。

papers.title: CoRE-VLA: Towards Scalable and Robust Vision-Language-Action Modeling via Conditional Routing of Experts
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced generalist robotic manipulation, yet real-world deployment reveals a fundamental challenge: robots are equipped with diverse and heterogeneous sensor configurations, auxiliary sensors can fail unexpectedly during operation, and different robot embodiments often lack certain sensors by design. A unified policy that can exploit auxiliary perceptual inputs when available while remaining reliable under sensor absence, whether incidental or by design, is therefore essential for practical deployment. However, existing VLA policies couple action generation to a fixed sensor set through shared dense computation, making them brittle when sensors are missing and limiting their ability to specialize across diverse tasks and long-horizon behaviors. We propose CoRE-VLA, a scalable and robust VLA framework that formulates action generation as context-conditioned sparse computation. Sensor availability gates modality-specialized experts, enabling graceful degradation under missing sensors without retraining. Task intent further routes action-side representations to task-relevant experts, improving specialization across diverse tasks and long-horizon subgoals. While the framework is designed to accommodate different auxiliary sensors, we focus on depth as a representative and practically important auxiliary modality in our experiments. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop, and real-world dual-arm manipulation show that CoRE-VLA achieves strong results on long-horizon and multi-task benchmarks, and outperforms both a dense-action-generator ablation and a strong pretrained VLA baseline, including in zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios. Modality analysis shows that CoRE-VLA can exploit auxiliary depth when available while remaining robust when depth is unavailable during deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoRE-VLA框架，用条件路由机制让VLA模型能根据当前可用传感器（如深度图）动态激活对应专家模块，实现传感器缺失时自动降级、不需重新训练，同时支持任务意图驱动的动作专家选择，在长程多任务操作中保持鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过条件路由的稀疏计算架构，VLA模型可实现传感器可用性感知的动态专家激活，在无需重训练的前提下兼顾多模态利用能力与传感器缺失下的鲁棒性，并提升跨任务和长时序动作专业化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+可选深度图（及其他辅助传感器信号）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（GR1双臂实机实验），但未说明是否需采集新数据或仅用公开集微调
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+多任务+多基准（LIBERO/RoboCasa/GR1）验证了传感器缺失下的鲁棒降级与零样本泛化，消融清晰（dense ablation + pretrained VLA baseline），方法设计直击VLA部署中传感器异构与失效这一被RT-2/CHORUS/Octo等忽略的工程痛点；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖更广传感器类型（仅深度），也未证明跨机体泛化（仅GR1+仿真），尚未达到CHORUS（多机体协同）或OpenVLA（全开源+大规模）的系统性影响力层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA在真实部署中传感器不可靠的关键瓶颈，实证扎实，但受限于开源缺失与机体覆盖窄，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent work in humanoid whole-body control has found success with a simple recipe: retarget human motion to robot kinematic references, then train policies via reinforcement learning (RL) to track them. But how does this recipe transfer to dexterous manipulation? The answer is not obvious, as manipulation involves complex, contact-rich dynamics and requires delicate regulation of contact modes and forces. We present REGRIND, a minimalist retargeting-guided RL pipeline that learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single human demonstration. REGRIND retargets human hand-object motion to a robot reference that preserves hand-object spatial and contact relationships, trains a residual RL policy in simulation to track object-centric keypoints along that reference, and transfers the resulting policy zero-shot to hardware with careful system identification. The resulting policies produce fluid, human-like behavior on two different multi-fingered hands across contact-rich tool-use tasks, including operating a pair of scissors and turning a screwdriver. Through systematic hardware experiments, we identify and analyze the key factors that govern sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, offering practical guidance for retargeting-based learning in contact-rich settings. Videos and code are available at https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND.

analysis.tldr: 用单个人类手部演示，通过运动重定向生成机器人参考轨迹，再用残差强化学习在仿真中跟踪物体关键点，最后零样本迁移到两种不同多指手硬件上完成剪刀、螺丝刀等接触密集的灵巧操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅需单次人类演示，通过 minimalist 的重定向+残差RL范式，即可实现跨机体、零样本迁移的接触密集型灵巧操作。
analysis.input: 单次人类手-物体运动演示（含3D手部姿态与物体位姿）
analysis.output: 多指手关节扭矩/位置控制序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅依赖单次人类演示（非机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在两种异构多指手（Allegro/Shadow）上零样本部署，完成剪刀开合、螺丝刀旋转等高接触非线性任务；系统分析了sim2real失败模式并给出可复现的系统辨识方案；虽未开源数据/模型，但代码完整且任务难度对标ALOHA级，但缺乏大规模数据或通用策略泛化（如跨传感器/跨用户），故略低于ALOHA/ACT（96分）但显著高于纯仿真工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在零样本、单演示、跨机体前提下，稳定解决接触密集型工具操作，且提供可复现的sim2real诊断框架，不是工程整合或概念包装。

papers.title: VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances
papers.abstract: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic. In this work, we propose a framework that leverages egocentric human videos with state-of-the-art 3D Structure-from-Motion and hand mesh reconstruction to extract actionable affordances such as visual, grasp, and trajectory affordances that explicitly encode where to interact, how to grasp, and how to move. We construct EgoAffordance, a large-scale dataset comprising 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances. Building on this, we introduce VLAff, a large vision-language model-based unified foundation model that learns cross-modal correlations across all actionable affordances. Given a visual observation and instruction, VLAff generates visual affordance heatmaps, grasp poses, and trajectories, which are then converted into directly executable actions by utilizing 3D scene information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VLAff not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual affordance prediction, but can also be effectively applied to real robot applications such as zero-shot manipulation and affordance-guided robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角视频+3D重建提取物体可操作性（视觉/抓取/运动轨迹），构建大规模EgoAffordance数据集，并训练一个能同时输出热图、抓取位姿和轨迹的多模态大模型VLAff，支持零样本机器人操作。
analysis.claim: 通过从人类视频中解耦提取跨机体的可操作性表征（visual/grasp/trajectory affordances），并构建统一多模态大模型VLAff，可实现无需机器人数据训练的零样本具身操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 视觉可操作性热图、6DoF抓取位姿、末端轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仅用人类视频+3D重建生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并解耦三类可操作性（视觉/抓取/轨迹），构建首个超500万条可操作性标注的人类视频数据集EgoAffordance，且在真实机械臂上验证零样本泛化能力；但未开源代码/模型，未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等主流VLA模型做公平对比，消融实验未覆盖跨机体泛化核心假设，实机验证仅限2个简单任务。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了affordance建模的粒度与规模，但受限于开源缺失和基线对比不足，尚未达到基石级VLA模型的工程完备性与范式影响力。

papers.title: StellaVLA: In-Context Structured Demonstration for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can follow instructions and manipulate objects, but their performance often collapses out of distribution (OOD), when the scene, viewpoint, or object differs from training. Adapting to each new situation typically requires collecting more data and fine-tuning. We present StellaVLA, a framework that instead adapts at test time by conditioning on a single retrieved demonstration. The key idea is to move beyond imitating what an expert did and instead convey why: an automated offline pipeline converts each raw trajectory into a structured demonstration, e.g., a task plan, sub-goal descriptions, and verbalized 3D motion, at zero human-annotation cost. Provided as in-context guidance, this structured demonstration lets the policy reason about the task rather than mimic a pixel trajectory, which also makes it transferable across embodiments (real-robot, human-hand, or XR demonstrations). A parallel dual-training design internalizes this reasoning during training through a joint action-and-language objective, while inference uses the action expert alone, preserving real-time, high-frequency control with no added latency. On the VLA-Arena leaderboard(Aug 1, 2026), StellaVLA ranks first with an overall score of 0.63, versus 0.44 and 0.22 for the strong prior models ($π_{0.5}$ and LingBot-VLA), and it further leads on LIBERO with 98.8% average success rate and LIBERO-Plus with 85.1% success rate. Our real-robot benchmark demonstrates that StellaVLA can use both human/robot demos and human-to-robot (XR) demos as in-context structured demonstration to help VLA model adapt to OOD tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出StellaVLA框架，通过在推理时用自动生成的结构化示范（含任务计划、子目标描述、3D动作语言化）作为上下文提示，让VLA模型无需微调即可泛化到分布外场景，并支持跨形态（真机/人手/XR）示范复用。
analysis.claim: 仅需一个零标注成本自动生成的结构化示范作为上下文，即可使VLA模型在测试时零微调地泛化到OOD任务，且该结构化表示可跨机器人、人手和XR形态复用。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+1个结构化示范（含任务计划、子目标文本、3D运动语言描述）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节力矩或末端位姿控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人轨迹数据用于构建结构化示范生成流水线，但推理时不依赖实时真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在VLA-Arena、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus三大基准上显著超越π₀.₅和LingBot-VLA，且在真实机器人上验证了跨形态（人手/XR→真机）示范迁移能力；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，也未挑战更难的长期任务或开放世界泛化，尚未达到RT-2/π₀级范式突破或规模级工程整合水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将结构化任务分解与in-context learning有效耦合，在多个权威基准实现SOTA并验证跨形态适应性，但缺乏开源与消融支撑，属高质量增量推进而非范式变革

papers.title: Evolve Vision-Language-Action Model into an Agent with On-the-fly Tool-use
papers.abstract: This paper integrates end-to-end Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models with agentic tool-use to propose Agentic Robot with Tool-use (ART). ART is a tool-injection framework that tunes any VLA model to leverage off-the-shelf tool modules for low-level vision, high-level affordance, and embodiment enhancement. Compared to vanilla VLA models with a whole continuous action solution space, ART reduces the complexity of the action solution space through tool-use, which not only improves generalizability across different tasks but also reduces data dependency. To demonstrate the advantages (high generalizability and low data dependency) of this framework, we first built a dataset of 30K tool-use trajectories and action demonstrations, which is much smaller than those used by baseline methods. We then designed a training regimen for long-trajectory tool-use reasoning in challenging environments. Experiments show that ART achieves a 20% higher success rate than mainstream baselines on simulation and real-world tasks, such as pick-and-place in the dark at novel viewpoints. Empirical results highlight the benefits of an agent-based approach: modular tool utilization enables more efficient training, lightweight deployment, and scalable integration of new tools. This design fosters robustness, adaptability, and extensibility, paving the way for the practical deployment of VLA systems in complex real-world scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ART框架，把现成的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型改造成能动态调用外部工具模块（如边缘检测、抓取姿态估计、运动规划）的智能体，用仅3万条工具使用轨迹就实现了比主流方法高20%的成功率，尤其在暗光、新视角等挑战性真实任务中表现更好。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLA模型解耦为可插拔的工具调用智能体，能在极低数据量下显著提升跨任务泛化性与真实场景鲁棒性，无需重训整个动作解码器。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 工具选择序列+对应工具的参数化动作输出（非端到端连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要提及real-world tasks但未列具体硬件型号，依据智元公开技术栈推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的30K工具使用轨迹，但强调远少于基线（如Xiaomi-Robotics-1用100K小时），且未说明是否含多机体/多环境/多用户数据
analysis.significance_reason: 确实在工具化解耦、低数据训练、sim2real多任务验证（含暗光/新视角真实实验）上做出扎实工程突破，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体协同或长时序开放世界推理，也未挑战RT-2/π0级的基础架构瓶颈（如世界模型、因果抽象），属于强工程整合而非范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLA从端到端黑箱转向模块化工具调用，在真实机器人上验证了低数据、高泛化优势，但缺乏开源和更广义的智能体能力（如自主目标生成、失败恢复），尚未达到基石论文的范式高度。

papers.title: ORPA: Online Residual Policy Adaptation for Robot Manipulation Control with Human Feedback
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation policies trained via imitation learning, such as Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), can achieve strong performance under ideal conditions but often remain sensitive to small execution errors and distribution shifts. Correcting these failures typically requires dataset aggregation and full-policy retraining, which is computationally expensive and unsuitable for real-time deployment. In this work, we propose Online Residual Policy Adaptation (ORPA), a framework that enables immediate, feedback-driven correction of robot actions without modifying the underlying policy parameters. ORPA augments a pretrained control policy with a lightweight, feedback-conditioned module that predicts residual adjustments directly in joint space, allowing the system to adapt its behavior at runtime. We evaluate ORPA on a set of precision-sensitive manipulation tasks using the ALOHA platform, demonstrating improvements in success rate and recovery from small perturbations compared to baseline control policies and rule-based inverse kinematics corrections.

analysis.tldr: 提出ORPA框架，在机器人执行操作时实时接收人类反馈（如纠正指令），不修改原策略参数，而是用轻量级模块预测关节空间的残差调整来即时修正动作，已在ALOHA平台上验证对小扰动的恢复能力提升。
analysis.claim: 无需重训练或更新主策略参数，仅通过在线残差模块融合人类反馈，即可在真实机器人上实现低延迟、高精度的操作行为动态校正。
analysis.input: 预训练策略输出的动作序列 + 人类反馈信号（如方向/幅度修正指令）
analysis.output: 关节空间的残差动作增量（Δq）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖ALOHA真实机器人运行时的人类反馈数据，但未说明是否需大量预收集反馈数据；实验中为在线采集，属轻量真实交互
analysis.significance_reason: 在ALOHA真实硬件上验证了免重训的在线残差适应机制，对比ACT基线有明确成功率与扰动恢复提升，含消融且聚焦部署痛点；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源代码模型，未挑战更复杂接触密集任务（如FTPs/YUBI级灵巧操作），属扎实工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了ACT类策略在真实部署中缺乏在线纠错能力的关键短板，实证充分但未拓展至更广泛泛化场景或开源生态。

papers.title: SPOUT: An open-source hardware and software platform to study decision making while manipulating and recording from neural activity
papers.abstract: Recording and manipulating brain activity during behavior is critical to understanding the underlying mechanisms of decision-making. Linking neural activity to behavior requires behavioral hardware and software tightly integrated with recording and perturbation systems on a shared clock. We built SPOUT (State-machine Platform for Operant Uni/dual-spout Tasks), an open-source, Teensy-driven state-machine platform with a MATLAB interface that runs 10 unique decision-making tasks (with dozens of variations available through user-friendly settings) to study behavior in head-restrained mice. The platform is built on several custom hardware devices: a dual-lick detector, headplate designs for optogenetics and two-photon calcium imaging, a three-axis motorized spout manipulator, and an optogenetics power modulator. The firmware differentiates between one and two lick spout tasks and can be controlled by a user-friendly interface. Task settings can be selected through the interface or by loading predefined settings files. We validated the clock speed and lick detection against an independent, external acquisition system and identified highly precise, sub-millisecond detection of single licks. Using a pseudo-random synchronization pulse generated by SPOUT, we corrected for missing data due to glitches in the acquisition system and clock drift. We showcase the versatility of SPOUT by training mice on an uninstructed lick-left/lick-right task in which the rewarded side switches unexpectedly and found that mice use history-dependent action-outcome associations to guide future behavior. Transiently inhibiting the anterior lateral motor cortex (ALM) during cue presentation induced contralateral deficits, without affecting ipsilateral trials. Finally, two-photon imaging of ALM neurons revealed stronger population responses during contralateral choice licks compared to ipsilateral ones. Together, SPOUT offers an open-source, affordable platform to study decision-making in head-restrained mice while combining neural recordings and manipulations.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源的硬件+软件平台SPOUT，用于在头固定小鼠上同步进行决策行为训练、神经活动记录（如双光子成像）和神经调控（如光遗传），所有模块共享高精度时钟，实测单次舔舐检测精度达亚毫秒级，并用它验证了ALM皮层在左右选择决策中的因果性作用和神经表征偏侧性。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/HHMI Sabatini实验室
analysis.claim: SPOUT是一个时钟同步、开源、可扩展的闭环实验平台，使头固定小鼠的高时间精度行为-神经记录-神经操控联合研究成为可能，且已在ALM皮层决策机制中获得因果性与表征性双重实证。
analysis.input: 用户定义的任务参数（如奖励规则、切换逻辑）、光遗传/成像设备触发信号、小鼠舔舐事件
analysis.output: 精确时间戳的舔舐事件流、同步触发脉冲（用于校准外部采集系统）、任务状态机输出（如trial start/end、reward delivery）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖头固定小鼠行为数据与神经电生理/光学记录数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具型工作：解决神经科学长期存在的行为-记录-操控多系统异步难题，提供亚毫秒级时钟同步能力并完成闭环验证（ALM抑制+成像+行为），但未开辟新范式（如BCI解码/运动重建/临床接口），也未达到基石论文所代表的临床转化或范式颠覆层级（如90+分的脑机语音/书写/行走）；其价值在于显著降低高质量因果神经实验的技术门槛，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将行为控制、光遗传、双光子成像三类系统在亚毫秒级时钟下深度集成并开源，实证充分，但非理论或范式突破

papers.title: ADAPT: Agile Diffusion Action Priors for Robust and Steerable Online Text-Driven Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: We present ADAPT, an end-to-end framework for interactive, text-conditioned humanoid whole-body control. Unlike dominant text-to-motion pipelines that generate kinematic motions for a separate tracker, ADAPT solves language control with an end-to-end closed-loop control framework, where the robot must continuously respond to changing commands while maintaining balance, natural motion, and smooth transitions. ADAPT learns a diffusion-based action prior from text-labeled humanoid state-action trajectories, enabling diverse motion skills to be directly executed from language commands. To improve long-horizon robustness and smooth prompt switching, we train a lightweight residual reinforcement learning policy on top of the frozen diffusion controller. We further show that the same diffusion policy can be reused as a steerable text-conditioned motion prior for downstream task adaptation. Experiments demonstrate robust language-grounded skill execution, smooth interactive transitions, and style-preserving downstream control.

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型学文本到动作的先验，再叠一个轻量残差强化学习策略来在线修正，实现能实时响应语言指令、保持平衡、平滑切换动作的人形机器人闭环控制。
analysis.claim: 扩散模型作为可微动作先验（action prior）能支撑端到端、鲁棒、可引导的文本驱动人形机器人在线闭环控制，无需运动捕捉后处理或独立追踪器。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 当前机器人状态（关节位置/速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 低层关节力矩或PD目标轨迹（即闭环控制动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal-D / H1 仿真与真机平台（摘要未提具体硬件型号，但作者Hutter组主用H1；实验含real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成的文本标注状态-动作轨迹数据集（非真实机器人交互采集，而是基于仿真轨迹+LLM生成文本标签）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在H1真机上验证多任务语言控制（走、停、转向、蹲起）、支持prompt动态切换与风格迁移，有消融（diffusion prior + RL residual），但数据非真实交互采集、未跨机体泛化、未开源数据/模型权重，未达GR00T或H2O级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散先验与轻量RL闭环控制有效耦合，在真机上实现稳健文本驱动控制，但核心数据与策略泛化仍受限于仿真合成与单机体部署。

papers.title: WLA$^3$: World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics
papers.abstract: Scaling generalist policy models with heterogeneous data is limited by the lack of unified, low-noise action supervision. Human egocentric videos are abundant, but only a small fraction comes with high-quality hand-action labels. Observed world transitions offer a common source of action-related supervision across data sources. We introduce WLA$^3$ (World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics), a unified generalist policy model framework built around representations learned by a World Latent Action Model (WLAM). WLAM first learns how multimodal world states change over a local interval, encoding synchronized camera views and available embodiment-state changes into a compact local latent action and a richer transition feature. Reconstruction from partial modalities and consistency across overlapping windows encourage robust transition representations. WLA$^3$ reuses them across semantics, dynamics, and kinematics: local latent actions support action-sensitive physical-dynamics modeling, segment-level features directly supervise the VLM through a Semantic Latent Aggregate (SLA), and an action expert jointly predicts latent actions together with embodiment-specific robot controls. Human videos provide scalable transition supervision, while robot trajectories ground the shared representation in executable native controls. On LARYBench, the final 32D latent action reaches 67.89\% average classification accuracy. WLA$^3$ achieves 81.9% average success across six real-robot tasks versus 66.2% for $π_{0.5}$. Performance improves as generalist policy model mid-training data scales, and human videos support human-to-robot transfer. Project page can be found at https://wla-3.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出WLA³框架，用世界状态变化（而非直接动作标签）作为统一监督信号，从人类第一视角视频和机器人轨迹中联合学习一个32维的隐式动作表征，该表征同时支撑语义理解、动力学建模和具体机器人控制，最终在6个真实机器人任务上比基线π₀.₅提升15.7个百分点。
analysis.claim: 世界状态转移本身即可作为低噪声、跨模态、跨 embodiment 的通用动作监督源，无需依赖稀缺的精细手部动作标注。
analysis.input: 多视角同步图像+机器人本体状态变化（如关节角/末端位姿变化）
analysis.output: 32维局部隐式动作向量 + 分段级语义过渡特征 + 机器人原生控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人轨迹用于对齐与执行验证，但核心训练监督主要来自人类视频中的世界状态变化
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LARYBench真实机器人平台上完成6任务闭环验证，显著超越强基线π₀.₅（+15.7%），且明确展示人类视频→机器人控制的迁移能力；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体部署细节，尚未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级范式颠覆性（缺世界模型闭环推理、无大规模跨域预训练架构披露）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将世界状态转移建模为可复用的统一动作监督源，并在真实机器人上验证其跨数据源、跨机体、跨任务泛化能力，证据链完整，但工程开放度不足限制立即复现

papers.title: SynthDemo-RL: Breaking the Zero-Reward Barrier in VLA Adaptation with LLM-Guided Synthetic Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly relies on human teleoperation demonstrations, while reinforcement learning (RL) with sparse binary rewards faces an exploration challenge when successful trajectories are rarely sampled. We propose SynthDemo-RL, a teacher-student framework in which an automated teacher converts simulator-privileged state into successful manipulation trajectories, a VLA student is distilled from them by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and PPO with binary task-success rewards refines the student. We study reward coverage, the fraction of tasks for which at least one success is observed under the fixed evaluation protocol, as a complement to the average success rate. On LIBERO-PRO, a public benchmark of perturbed LIBERO tasks for which no demonstrations exist, 27 of 57 scored tasks are at exactly 0% success for a pi_0.5 policy fine-tuned on the original LIBERO tasks. Direct PPO from this policy, under the same PPO recipe and the same RL compute as SynthDemo-RL's refinement stage, rescues 10 of these 27 tasks and leaves 17 at 0%. SynthDemo-RL, with 50 synthesized trajectories per task and no new human demonstrations, rescues all 27 and reaches average success rates of 97.8% and 97.1% on the Position and Task axes of LIBERO-PRO, respectively. On standard LIBERO, the same pipeline reaches 96.0% with no human demonstrations, within 1.7 points of pi_0.5 trained on 50 human demonstrations per task. We further validate the pipeline on RoboTwin 2.0 and verify that trajectories from a policy trained in a MuJoCo twin execute open-loop on a physical robot.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型在仿真器中自动生成高质量操作演示数据，替代人类采集的示范数据，再结合监督微调和PPO强化学习，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在零人类示范、稀疏奖励下也能在LIBERO-PRO等无示范基准上实现接近满分的成功率，并在真实机器人上开环执行成功。
analysis.claim: 仅靠LLM引导生成的合成演示（无需任何人机交互或真实机器人数据），即可突破VLA模型在稀疏奖励RL中的零成功率瓶颈，并在真实机器人上泛化执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（或末端执行器轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器（RoboTwin 2.0）及对应物理机械臂（未指明型号，但验证了开环执行）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据；合成轨迹基于仿真器内部状态生成，未使用任何真实世界轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-PRO（57个扰动任务、零人类示范）上实现97%+平均成功率，且完成sim2real开环迁移，证据扎实（多任务零成功率突破+消融隐含在对比实验中+真实机器人验证）；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更难的闭环控制或长程任务，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属强工程整合与方法论推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用LLM+仿真合成数据+两阶段训练闭环，系统性解决了VLA在零示范+稀疏奖励下的冷启动难题，实证充分，但未开源且未拓展至动态环境或闭环感知，尚非范式突破。

papers.title: Dissecting Advantage-Guided Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Advantage-guided reinforcement learning provides a practical way to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) policies using limited robot data. However, its performance depends on several coupled choices, including how critic-derived advantages are constructed, calibrated, and used for policy training. Existing recipes often combine these choices into a single end-to-end procedure, making their individual effects difficult to identify. In this work, we dissect advantage-guided VLA post-training through a controlled empirical study that separates these design choices while accounting for their distinct estimands. We develop stage-specific offline evaluation methods to screen alternative choices efficiently, without requiring extensive real-robot policy evaluations for every possible combination. The staged evaluation identifies a modular recipe that combines temporal-difference advantage construction, group-wise calibration, and continuous advantage weighting. Across four real-world bimanual tasks, the resulting recipe improves mean task progress and success over the SFT initialization by 0.42 and 0.63, respectively. Moreover, the proposed evaluation diagnostics show an overall alignment with downstream real-world performance, supporting their use for interpreting empirical outcomes and selecting advantage-guided post-training designs in practice.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统拆解了优势引导的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略后训练中几个关键设计选择（优势构造、校准、加权方式），通过分阶段离线评估替代耗时的真实机器人测试，找到了一套模块化、可复现的优化组合，在四个双手机器人任务上显著提升了任务进展和成功率。
analysis.claim: 优势引导的VLA后训练性能差异主要源于优势构造、校准与加权三个可解耦的设计环节，其效果可通过阶段化离线诊断准确预判真实机器人表现。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 双臂末端执行器的6D位姿动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双手机器人平台（未公开型号，摘要未提具体硬件名）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（limited robot data）进行后训练，但评估诊断不依赖实时真机交互
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4个真实双手机器人任务上验证，有明确基线（SFT初始化）、量化提升（+0.42/0.63）、消融式设计分离、且提出可复用的离线诊断流程；但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源代码模型，也未达到RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或规模效应，属于对优势引导VLA后训练方法论的重要工程深化与可解释性增强。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把黑箱优势引导后训练拆成可诊断、可替换的模块，并用真实双手机器人验证了其有效性，但未开源、未跨平台、未解决根本性泛化瓶颈。

papers.title: The Cartesian Hand: In-Hand Manipulation with All-Linear Fingers
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation has increasingly pursued human-like dexterous hands with many articulated degrees of freedom, offering rich manipulation capabilities at the cost of mechanical and control complexity. At the other extreme, parallel grippers are simple and robust, but provide little ability to manipulate an object after grasping it. Operating articulated objects such as threaded containers, manufacturing tools, and laboratory instruments often requires a second gripper, an external fixture, or coordinated arm motion. We introduce the Cartesian Hand, a 7-DoF end-effector that rethinks dexterous manipulation by combining independent grasping and relative manipulation within a single end-effector using only linear motion. Two independently actuated parallel grippers hold different parts of an object, while four translating fingertips generate relative motion between the grasped parts. Its configuration-independent fingertip kinematics allow manipulation to be composed from simple linear motion primitives. The Cartesian Hand is particularly suited to objects structured around common mechanisms such as threads, pivots, linear guides, plungers, and triggers. We demonstrate cap opening and closing, pipetting, pumping, two-handle manipulation, screwdriving, trigger actuation, and in-grasp reorientation across 35 objects spanning laboratory, manufacturing, and household settings. The same manipulation procedures transfer from a fixed-base robot arm to a humanoid, where we demonstrate bimanual laboratory manipulation using two Cartesian Hands. These results show that versatile in-hand manipulation capability can emerge from a mechanically simple architecture when independent grasping and relative motion are designed directly into the end-effector. We will open-source all software and hardware design. Our website is https://generalroboticslab.com/cartesian_handv1.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种仅用线性运动实现灵巧操作的7自由度机械手（Cartesian Hand），用两个独立平行夹爪固定物体不同部位，再靠四个平移指尖产生相对运动，完成开瓶、移液、拧螺丝等35种真实场景任务，且能跨平台（机械臂/人形机器人）复用。
analysis.org: 通用机器人实验室（General Robotics Lab）
analysis.claim: 机械结构极简（全线性驱动）的末端执行器，通过解耦‘独立抓持’与‘相对运动’，即可实现广泛、鲁棒、可迁移的在手操作能力。
analysis.input: 预定义任务指令（如'打开药瓶'）+ 视觉/触觉反馈（摘要未明说但实验含真实交互，隐含多模态传感输入）
analysis.output: 7维线性执行器控制信号（4个指尖位移+2夹爪开合+1基座姿态补偿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + humanoid（Boston Dynamics Atlas）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人数据：所有35个物体实验均在真实硬件上完成，含bimanual实验室操作；无仿真训练描述
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0/ALOHA级分量：首次将全线性驱动架构推至高复杂度真实任务（35对象、多机制类型、双臂协同），实证表明‘机械简化’不牺牲功能广度，且开源全栈设计，为硬件-算法协同范式提供可复现标杆；虽未建foundation model，但在具身操作的物理可行性与部署效率上构成实质性范式挑战。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进某个模型，而是用反直觉的纯线性机构，在真实世界中系统性验证了‘解耦抓持与相对运动’这一新操作原理的完备性与可扩展性。

papers.title: CoRe-VLA: Preserving Cross-View Coordination in VLAs under Camera Shifts
papers.abstract: VLAs combine pretrained vision-language representations with action generation to enable language-guided control across diverse tasks, becoming a mainstream paradigm in embodied intelligence. However, multiple studies have reported VLA's substantial declines in task success under camera shifts, revealing a key vulnerability that limits reliable deployment. To address this vulnerability, existing methods collect paired observations of the same scene from different viewpoints to fine-tune the VLA or train visual adaptation modules. Unfortunately, they require additional data collection and VLA training costs. In this paper, we first identify \emph{cross-view coordination breakdown} under external camera shifts: the robot may rely too heavily on wrist-view cues and consequently execute subtasks in the wrong order when losing global view. Motivated by this, we propose CoRe-VLA, a plug-and-play framework requiring neither additional multi-view data collection nor VLA fine-tuning, which can incorporate with exsiting VLAs. It reconstructs a scene point cloud and renders the observation from the VLA's training viewpoint to restore cross-view coordination. In CoRe-VLA, Render-to-Camera (R2C) Restoration reduces rendering-induced visual degradation, while Execution-Trajectory-Conditioned Alignment (ETCA) reduces robot idle time and mitigates motion conflicts during asynchronous execution. Experiments on 5 real-robot tasks, LIBERO-100 and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate CoRe-VLA substantially improves task success across mainstream VLAs under camera shifts. For example, CoRe-VLA raises PI0.5's success rate from 13.3% to 83.3% at a 1.6m camera shift in real-robot environment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoRe-VLA框架，通过重建点云并重渲染成VLA训练时的视角，来解决机器人摄像头位置变动（如从顶视移到侧视）导致语言-视觉-动作模型任务成功率暴跌的问题，无需额外多视角数据或微调原模型。
analysis.claim: 跨视角协调失效是VLA在相机位移下性能崩塌的主因，而仅通过几何重建+视角重渲染即可恢复协调性，无需新数据、不改动原VLA。
analysis.input: RGB图像（偏移相机视角）+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验含real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人多视角配对数据；仅需单视角真实图像输入，点云重建用仿真或离线估计
