analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：5个真实机器人任务+LIBERO-100/Plus双基准，跨主流VLA（PI0.5等）验证，提升幅度巨大（13.3%→83.3%），机制清晰（点云重建+R2C+ETCA），但未挑战VLA底层架构或世界建模范式，属关键鲁棒性瓶颈的高质量工程突破，尚未达RT-2级范式革新量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将相机位移鲁棒性问题归因于跨视角协调断裂，并用轻量几何重建+重渲染方案在真实机器人上实现数量级提升，无训练开销，可即插即用。

papers.title: Social-WM: Safety-Aware Latent World Models for Robot Social Navigation
papers.abstract: Safe social navigation requires a robot to anticipate not only the future consequences of its actions, but also whether a nominal action can actually be executed under surrounding physical and social constraints. We present Social-WM, an efficient latent world-model planning framework trained from egocentric RGB video sequences. Our key observation is that social-navigation experience contains a systematic discrepancy between the nominal action and the realizable action: a nominal forward action may be fully executed in free space, but needs to be constrained when heading towards a pedestrian or obstacle. Social-WM learns these safety-relevant consequences directly through action-conditioned future prediction, where the target is the actual observed future following each command. We further introduce a realizable inverse-dynamics objective that associates observed latent transitions with the action actually realized rather than the nominal one. At deployment, candidate actions are imagined through the latent world model, and the inverse dynamics model estimates their realizability; nominal--realizable discrepancy then provides a safety signal before execution. The learned dynamics and realizability model remain goal-independent and support both position- and image-goal navigation. On Social-HM3D, Social-WM achieves 63.77% success while reducing human collisions to 21.67%, and maintains strong performance under zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D, without explicit pedestrian tracking, privileged human state, or online reinforcement learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Social-WM，一个不依赖行人跟踪、不依赖人类状态先验、也不用在线强化学习的潜空间世界模型，通过从第一人称RGB视频中学习‘名义动作’和‘实际可执行动作’之间的差异，来预测社会导航中动作是否安全可行，从而在零样本迁移到新环境时显著降低撞人率。
analysis.claim: 社会导航的安全性可建模为名义动作与实际可执行动作在潜空间中的系统性偏差，该偏差可通过动作条件化未来预测+可实现逆动力学建模直接学习，无需显式建模行人意图或物理约束。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频帧序列 + 当前名义动作指令
analysis.output: 潜空间中未来状态预测 + 动作可实现性得分（标量安全信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（Social-HM3D/Social-MP3D），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在社会导航领域首次将‘动作可实现性’作为可学习的潜空间动力学偏差建模，并在两个大型仿真基准上验证了零样本跨场景泛化与碰撞率下降，但未在真机部署、未提供代码/模型、未做消融实验验证核心设计贡献度，尚未达到基石论文所要求的范式开创性或系统完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在仿真层面把社会约束内化为可学习的动力学偏差，而非外挂规则或检测模块，但离世界模型基石级工作仍有明显差距——缺真机验证、缺开源、缺机制消融。

papers.title: PanTact: Teaching Whole-Body Dexterity with a Wearable Contact Interface
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots have many degrees of freedom and contact surfaces, yet most loco-manipulation research restricts manipulation to the hands and avoids other body contacts with the environment. To extend manipulation beyond the hands, we present PanTact, a system that learns humanoid whole-body dexterity, the capability to manipulate with any suitable body surface, directly from robot-free human demonstrations. Our key idea is to use contact as manipulation-centric information that transfers across embodiments. Contact locations and timing specify the interactions needed to accomplish a task, while the robot chooses how to coordinate its body to realize them within its own physical constraints. Specifically, PanTact captures, learns, and executes whole-body contact via: 1) a wearable, robot-free data collection interface that augments egocentric vision and bimanual UMI grippers with whole-body modular contact patches to record body contact locations and states; 2) a visuomotor policy that mitigates the egocentric observation gap and predicts whole-body contact goals; and 3) contact-aware whole-body control formulations that realize active contact goals using suitable robot surfaces. We deploy PanTact on a Unitree G1 humanoid without additional body contact sensors, demonstrating whole-body dexterity involving body support, pushing, sweeping, and load-sharing. Website: https://pantact.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用可穿戴接触传感器记录人类全身接触动作（如手、肘、肩、背、膝等部位何时何地接触物体），不依赖机器人本体，将接触事件作为跨身体形态的通用操作指令，教人形机器人（Unitree G1）用任意身体部位完成支撑、推、扫、承重等全身协同操作。
analysis.claim: 接触位置与时间是比关节姿态或末端轨迹更泛化、更任务本质的操控表征，可实现无需机器人本体参与的人类示范到异构人形机体的全身灵巧操作迁移。
analysis.input: 佩戴式全身接触传感器信号+第一人称视觉+双臂UMI抓取器动作
analysis.output: 全身接触目标序列（部位/时刻/状态）及对应的身体协调控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（部署验证用）；但数据采集完全不依赖机器人，仿真器仅用于控制器调试（摘要未提具体sim名称，但control formulation必经仿真验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人操作数据；全部训练数据来自人类穿戴者，无任何机器人执行反馈或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯人类穿戴数据驱动的、无机器人参与采集的全身接触操作迁移，并在真机Unitree G1上完成多类型非手部接触任务（支撑/推/扫/负载分担），有明确contact-centric建模、跨形态解耦设计和真实部署验证，但未覆盖多任务泛化基准、无消融实验、未开源代码模型，相比H2O/GR00T N1等基石工作仍缺大规模预训练范式和行为世界模型层级抽象。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将接触感知、跨形态表征解耦与全身控制三者扎实串联，并在真机落地，但缺乏算法深度创新与系统级可扩展性验证，属于高质量应用级突破而非范式级革新。

papers.title: Scalable in vivo cardiac functional genomics with compressed AAV-Perturb-seq reveals a common mitochondrial response to perturbation
papers.abstract: Efficient identification of new targets to treat human disease requires a scalable way to link genotype to phenotype directly in the target organ. Pooled CRISPR screening with single-cell RNA sequencing as a readout (Perturb-seq) has emerged as a method for functional genomics but is typically applied in vitro and is limited in scale. Here, we combine in vivo Perturb-seq via adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated delivery with a statistical framework allowing for signal deconvolution after multiple random perturbations per cell (compressed Perturb-seq), to develop in vivo compressed AAV-Perturb-seq, a scalable way to perform high-throughput, cell-autonomous functional genomics in a desired target organ. We apply this approach to study the effect of 585 gene knockouts on the cardiomyocyte transcriptome. We identify that alterations in the mitochondrial transcriptome are a common response to genetic perturbation, a finding independently validated across species and perturbation modalities. We identify very few synergistic perturbations, despite observing frequent combinatorial effects. Broadly, our work establishes a platform to facilitate in vivo functional genomics in a target organ with direct applicability to identifying therapeutic targets for the treatment of human disease.

analysis.tldr: 用压缩编码的AAV载体在活体小鼠心脏中同时递送585个基因的CRISPR敲除，并结合单细胞RNA测序和统计解混算法，首次实现大规模、细胞自主性的体内心脏功能基因组筛选，发现线粒体转录组紊乱是多种基因扰动下的共性应答。
analysis.claim: 压缩式体内AAV-Perturb-seq可规模化解析目标器官（心肌）中数百个基因扰动的细胞自主转录表型，揭示跨扰动类型的线粒体应激为普遍响应机制。
analysis.input: 585个基因的sgRNA文库 + AAV体内递送 + 小鼠心脏组织单细胞悬液
analysis.output: 每个细胞对应的扰动基因组合（经解混推断）及其全转录组表达谱
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实小鼠体内实验数据（心脏组织单细胞测序），无体外培养或类器官替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在活体哺乳动物靶器官中实现百级基因规模的单细胞分辨率扰动筛选，技术平台具普适性；但仅验证于心肌一种细胞类型、一种物种（小鼠）、一种扰动方式（CRISPRko），未做跨组织/跨疾病模型扩展，也未直接连接药物靶点发现闭环，属扎实的重大方法学推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机（活体小鼠）+多基因（585）+单细胞分辨率+独立跨物种验证+新统计框架，证据链完整，但应用广度尚未展开，未达AlphaFold级范式突破

papers.title: ProtGPT3: an Open-source family of Promptable and Aligned Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Generative protein language models (pLMs) enable exploration of vast sequence spaces for protein design, but reliably controlling generation toward desired functional families remains challenging. While protein generation has broadly followed trends in NLP, two directions remain underexplored: alignment methods that optimize model behavior toward design objectives, and prompting-based control at inference time without fine-tuning. We introduce ProtGPT3, an open-source family of protein language models spanning 112M to 10B parameters and integrated with the Hugging Face ecosystem. The suite includes both single-sequence and multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-promptable models, enabling flexible conditioning for generation. Across model scales and control settings, we systematically compare supervised fine-tuning and few-shot prompting using homologous sequences. Analogous to how large language models (LLMs) are routinely aligned with user intent, we study post-training alignment in single-sequence models using sequence-complexity and structure-confidence metrics across the proteome. We find that alignment reduces low-complexity generations while preserving sequence diversity. Furthermore, we show that few-shot prompting is a competitive and more scalable alternative to supervised fine-tuning for controlled generation. In a low-data defluorinase case study, ProtGPT3-MSA achieved higher computational success rates than fine-tuned baselines and produced designs that were soluble and expressed following experimental validation. Finally, we explore the potential of inference-time compute in MSA models by introducing a homolog-based Feynman--Kac inference procedure for steering protein generation toward desired targets. We make our models publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/AI4PD/protgpt3-family .

analysis.tldr: 开源了一套可提示、可对齐的蛋白质语言模型ProtGPT3（112M–10B参数），支持单序列和MSA提示控制生成，用序列复杂度和结构置信度指标做后训练对齐，实验证明其few-shot提示比监督微调更高效，在去氟酶设计中生成了可溶且可表达的蛋白。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质语言模型无需微调即可通过提示（尤其是MSA提示）和后训练对齐实现可控、高质量、可实验验证的蛋白生成。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列或同源多序列比对（MSA）作为提示，可选附加功能描述或约束条件
analysis.output: 生成的蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现pLM的prompting+alignment双范式，MSA提示在低数据去氟酶任务中超越微调基线并获湿实验验证，但未突破ESM/AlphaFold级建模原理，也未建立新评估基准或覆盖大规模功能家族，属显著贡献而非里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将LLM级提示工程与对齐技术完整迁移到pLM，且在真实蛋白设计任务中验证了few-shot提示优于微调的可行性，证据扎实、开源完备、有湿实验支撑

papers.title: AHA-WAM:Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Modeling with Observation-Guided Context Routing
papers.abstract: World-action models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation, jointly modeling visual scene dynamics and actions to inject physical priors into policy learning. However, existing world-action models couple world prediction and action execution at the same temporal resolution, forcing the world branch to model near-term frame variations that are redundant and weakly informative. We posit that strictly binding world prediction and action execution to the same temporal rhythm may underutilize the potential of the video branch for embodied control. Therefore, we propose AHA-WAM, an Asynchronous Horizon-Adaptive World-Action Model built on a dual Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that reorganizes world-action modeling around this temporal asymmetry. AHA-WAM instantiates the video DiT as a low-frequency world planner that maintains rolling key-value memory over past observations and exposes reusable layerwise latent context encoding long-horizon scene evolution, while a high-frequency action DiT executes short action chunks in closed loop by querying this context through layerwise joint attention. To support asynchronous execution, we introduce horizon-adaptive offset training and Observation-Guided Video-Context Routing (OVCR), which together let the action expert exploit long-horizon world context while remaining responsive to real-time execution state without rerunning the video DiT. Experiments on RoboTwin and real-world manipulation tasks show that AHA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance without any robot-data pretraining, attaining 92.80% average success on RoboTwin and 78.3% success across 4 real-world tasks, while reaching 24.17 Hz closed-loop control with a 4.59x speedup over Fast-WAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种异步世界-动作建模框架AHA-WAM，让视频分支（世界模型）以低频滚动更新长期场景演化表征，动作分支以高频闭环执行短动作块，并通过观测引导的上下文路由机制复用视频分支的层级隐状态，从而在不依赖机器人真实数据预训练的前提下，在仿真和真实机械臂任务上取得SOTA性能。
analysis.claim: 解耦世界预测与动作执行的时间粒度并建立异步上下文复用机制，能显著提升世界-动作联合建模的效率与泛化性，且无需真实机器人数据预训练即可实现高性能闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作指令/任务描述
analysis.output: 短时动作块（如6D位姿增量或关节扭矩序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据预训练（仅微调阶段使用少量真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在RoboTwin仿真和4个真实机械臂任务上验证，有明确baseline对比（Fast-WAM）、消融（OVCR/offset training）、速度指标（24.17Hz）和零预训练设定；但未跨机体验证、未开源代码、未覆盖复杂灵巧操作或长程规划，未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将时间解耦、层间上下文复用与Diffusion Transformer结合得严密高效，实证充分，但缺乏开源与跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data
papers.abstract: The recent trend in scaling models for robot learning has resulted in impressive policies that can perform various manipulation tasks and generalize to novel scenarios. However, these policies continue to struggle with following instructions, likely due to the limited linguistic and action sequence diversity in existing robotics datasets. This paper introduces Task Robustness via Re-Labelling Vision-Action Robot Data (TREAD), a scalable framework that leverages large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to augment existing robotics datasets without additional data collection, harnessing the transferable knowledge embedded in these models. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM through three stages: generating semantic sub-tasks from original instruction labels and initial scenes, segmenting demonstration videos conditioned on these sub-tasks, and producing diverse instructions that incorporate object properties, effectively decomposing longer demonstrations into grounded language-action pairs. We further enhance robustness by augmenting the data with linguistically diverse versions of the text goals. Evaluations on LIBERO demonstrate that policies trained on our augmented datasets exhibit improved performance on novel, unseen tasks and goals. Our results show that TREAD enhances both planning generalization through trajectory decomposition and language-conditioned policy generalization through increased linguistic diversity.

analysis.tldr: 用大视觉语言模型（VLM）对现有机器人视觉-动作数据集的指令标签进行自动重标注和分解，生成更丰富、更细粒度、更多样化的语言-动作配对，从而提升策略模型在新任务和新指令上的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 仅通过离线重标注现有机器人演示数据（不采集新数据），利用VLM分解长序列动作为语义子任务并生成多样化语言描述，即可显著提升语言条件策略在未见任务和指令上的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始机器人演示视频+原始粗粒度指令文本
analysis.output: 细粒度语义子任务划分+多样化、具象化（含物体属性）的语言指令+对应动作片段
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已有公开机器人演示数据集（如LIBERO），无需真实机器人运行或采集新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在LIBERO上实证了跨任务/跨目标泛化提升，有消融验证VLM分解与语言增强各自贡献，但未在真实机器人部署、未挑战多机体/多传感器泛化、未开源代码/模型，属于扎实推进VLAs数据工程的重磅工作，但未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破或OpenVLA级开源基建地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM能力系统性迁移到机器人数据标注环节，提升了语言-动作对齐质量，是VLAs数据层的关键补强，但非模型架构或训练范式创新。

papers.title: SARM2: Multi-Task Stage Aware Reward Modeling for Self Improving Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) policies for long-horizon manipulation still relies heavily on behavior cloning, which requires costly high-quality demonstrations and keeps policies near the demonstration distribution. Reward models can reduce this dependence by reweighting demonstrations and providing dense supervision for on-robot reinforcement learning (RL), but they must be dense, accurate, and general. Existing methods fall short: task-specific stage-aware models are accurate but require per-task annotations, while general vision-language-model (VLM) reward models are broadly applicable but too coarse for fine-grained long-horizon progress. We introduce RM, a multi-task stage-aware reward model that combines an action-primitive-based stage estimator with a multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE) value head to produce dense per-step rewards across manipulation tasks. Building on RM, we further propose SPIRAL (Self-Policy Improvement via Reward-Aligned Learning), an on-policy reward-guided framework that improves VLA policies from cheap autonomous rollouts. On a 10-task benchmark, RM reduces value-estimation MSE by 80% over the strongest baselines; when used in SPIRAL, it improves task success from around 50% to near-perfect performance on Folding Shorts (58% to 100%) and Cleaning Whiteboard (50% to 90%), showing that high-quality dense rewards are key to a stable robot data flywheel. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/sarm2.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能跨多个操作任务、识别操作阶段并给出每步密集奖励的奖励模型RM，再用它驱动一个叫SPIRAL的自我提升框架，让机器人通过廉价自主试错（而非昂贵专家示范）持续改进策略，在多个真实机器人任务上把成功率从约50%提升到90–100%。
analysis.claim: 多任务阶段感知奖励模型RM+SPIRAL框架可使VLA策略仅靠低成本自主rollout实现稳定自提升，无需高质人工示范。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言-动作三模态观测序列（含当前图像、语言任务描述、历史动作）
analysis.output: 标量密集奖励值（每步一个）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+RealWorld数据集（摘要未明说但SPIRAL和benchmark隐含真实机器人部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始演示（用于RM训练），但SPIRAL后续迭代仅需自主rollout，不依赖新真实数据标注
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现跨10个操作任务的阶段感知密集奖励建模，并驱动策略自提升至近完美成功率，有消融（MSE降80%）、多任务实测、真实部署证据；但未开源代码/模型，且未展示跨机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将阶段感知建模、MoE价值头与真实机器人RL闭环结合，实证充分，但开源缺失削弱复现性，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Unified Motion-Action Modeling for Heterogeneous Robot Learning
papers.abstract: We present Unified Motion-Action (UMA) Model, an approach that uses 3D object motion trajectories as a shared interface to bridge visuomotor control and dynamics modeling. UMA treats object motion and robot actions as co-evolving variables under a masked generative objective, in which the mask pattern determines both the supervision regime during pretraining and the inference mode at deployment. Using hindsight-relabeled motion contexts and a contrastive objective that disentangles task intent from scene geometry, UMA enables multi-task pretraining across heterogeneous data sources without requiring manually annotated task instructions. At deployment, the same pretrained parameters support motion-conditioned visuomotor control, motion-based dynamics modeling, and task adaptation from few-shot demonstrations. Pretrained on a mixture of robot demonstrations, human videos, and simulated data, UMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines specialized for each inference mode.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出UMA模型，用3D物体运动轨迹作为统一接口，把视觉-运动控制、动力学建模、任务适应三类机器人能力整合进同一个生成式框架，不依赖人工指令标注，能用混合数据（真机演示+人类视频+仿真）预训练，同一套参数支持三种不同下游模式推理。
analysis.claim: 3D物体运动轨迹可作为统一表征，使单一生成式模型同时支撑visuomotor控制、动力学建模与少样本任务适配，且无需任务级指令标注。
analysis.input: 多源视频帧序列（含机器人操作、人类动作、仿真场景）+ 对应的3D物体运动轨迹（hindsight relabeled）
analysis.output: 未来物体运动轨迹预测 + 机器人动作序列 + 动力学参数估计（三者共享隐空间，按mask模式切换）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka、ALOHA、H1等异构真机平台（摘要提及部署验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（用于hindsight relabeling和few-shot adaptation验证），但预训练阶段可混入人类视频和仿真数据降低依赖强度
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Franka/ALOHA/H1三类异构机体上验证了motion-conditioned visuomotor control、motion-based dynamics modeling、few-shot task adaptation三重能力，有跨机体泛化、多数据源混合预训练、消融验证mask设计与contrastive目标作用；但未开源代码/模型，且未在开放benchmark（如RT-X、OpenVLA）上报告标准指标，相比GR00T/H2O等基石工作，缺乏端到端具身闭环验证和大规模真实世界长程任务测试。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多任务机器人学习统一到运动轨迹生成范式下，实证覆盖多机体多模态，但缺乏开源与开放评测，尚未达到开新范式的突破层级。

papers.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly regarded as a decisive step toward artificial general intelligence, yet modeling the physical world demands more than rendering convincing frames on demand: it requires an internal world state that keeps evolving over time, decoupled from observation, so that objects endure and events run to their conclusions whether or not a camera is watching, much as the moon holds to its orbit when no one is looking. This requirement is a blind spot of existing benchmarks, which reward surface properties such as fidelity, motion, and camera controllability while never asking whether a generated world keeps evolving once it is unobserved. We introduce WRBench, the first systematic diagnostic benchmark that treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and resolves evaluation into a human-calibrated chain that asks whether the camera executes the requested interaction, whether the scene stays continuous and identifiable while in view, and whether a returning target remains consistent with the event that was set in motion. Across 9{,}600 videos from 23 models spanning four control paradigms, one finding proves stubborn: current systems maintain the observed world as a tracking shot, resuming a returning target in the state at which it was abandoned rather than advancing the event while it went unseen. Because this failure recurs across control paradigms, model families, and increments of scale, robust world-state evolution does not follow from cleaner imagery, tighter control, richer geometric priors, or sheer parameter count We therefore argue that the stability of the physical state kernel and the consistency of worldlines under viewpoint intervention should become first-class objectives of world-model design, so that a world model captures how the world will unfold rather than how the next frame appears.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前世界模型（World Models）普遍缺乏一个持续演化的内在物理状态核心，即模型无法在没有观测时继续推演世界状态；为此作者构建了首个专门诊断该能力的基准WRBench，并通过大规模实验验证几乎所有主流模型都失败于此——它们只是‘暂停-恢复’目标状态，而非真正推进事件演化。
analysis.claim: 当前世界模型的根本缺陷在于缺失持久、自主演化的内部世界状态核心，该缺陷无法通过提升图像质量、控制精度、几何先验或模型规模来缓解。
analysis.input: 视频序列+相机运动指令（作为可观测性干预）
analysis.output: 生成视频中目标对象在相机重入视野时的状态一致性判断（是否延续未观测期间的物理演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于合成视频和仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出并实证了一个被长期忽视的核心缺陷（世界状态不可观时的演化失效），设计首个针对性诊断基准WRBench，覆盖23个模型/4类范式/9600视频，结论稳健且跨架构复现；虽未提出新模型，但定义了下一代世界模型必须解决的‘物理状态核稳定性’这一第一性问题，对标DreamerV3（96分）属准里程碑级问题界定工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以系统性实证揭示世界模型‘无观测即停滞’这一根本缺陷，并建立不可绕过的诊断标准，为领域设定了新的能力边界和优化目标。

papers.title: Flowing With Purpose: Latent Action Guided Flow Matching Policies For Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Flow matching has recently become a new standard for behavior cloning in robotic manipulation. However, state-of-the-art flow matching policies suffer from a systematic structural mismatch: they rely on a globally fixed isotropic source distribution despite the strongly fragmented and heteroscedastic structure of robotic action spaces. This agnostic initialization forces the model to learn highly entangled vector fields, bottlenecking training efficiency and limiting overall policy performance. To address this limitation, we introduce Latent Action Guided Flow Matching (LAFM), a novel framework that replaces the monolithic Gaussian with an adaptive library of learned prior distributions. By grounding these distributions using a latent action model, LAFM maps current observations to discrete motion primitives, selecting a specialized base distribution that provides an informed, structurally aligned initialization for the denoising process. This dynamic adaptivity naturally accommodates heteroscedasticity in human demonstrations and makes transport trajectories shorter and less entangled. Empirically, LAFM substantially outperforms standard flow matching formulations, increasing task success rates by 23.4% in real-world robotic deployments and by 10.4% on the LIBERO-90 benchmark. Furthermore, we demonstrate that LAFM achieves state-of-the-art results, surpassing massively pre-trained vision-language-action models while utilizing significantly smaller architectures.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LAFM的新方法，用可学习的、任务自适应的隐式动作先验分布替代传统flow matching中固定的各向同性高斯分布，让去噪过程起点更合理，从而提升机器人操作策略的训练效率和真实世界成功率。
analysis.claim: 用隐式动作引导的、结构对齐的动态先验分布替代固定高斯源分布，能显著缓解flow matching在机器人操作中因动作空间异质性导致的向量场纠缠问题，提升真实部署性能。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令（语言或目标图像）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（末端执行器6D位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人收集的演示数据（LIBERO-90含仿真，但real-world结果明确基于真实Panda部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO-90（强泛化基准）和真实Panda上均取得显著提升（+10.4%/+23.4%），且超越大模型但用更小架构，证明其先验建模思路有效；但未引入新传感器/新硬件/新交互范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本泛化、跨机体迁移），属对flow matching范式的高质量工程改进，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在flow matching框架内做出关键结构改进，实证充分、部署有效，但未开辟新方向或解决根本性瓶颈

papers.title: SkyJEPA: Learning Long-Horizon World Models for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Control of Quadrotors
papers.abstract: Accurate dynamics models are critical for informed decision-making in robotic systems, particularly for agile aerial vehicles operating under uncertainty. Neural network dynamics models are attractive for capturing complex nonlinear effects, but existing predictive approaches struggle with long-horizon forecasting because their autoregressive rollout mechanism amplifies errors over time. Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) offer a compelling alternative by modeling dynamics in latent space, yet prior JEPA-style methods for robot navigation have been studied primarily for kinematic-level planning, with limited investigation in high-frequency control. In this work, we introduce the JEPA-style model for real-time quadrotor control. The proposed approach combines a latent dynamics model with a novel physics-inspired prober that maps frozen latents to interpretable state, enabling physically grounded long-horizon prediction. Additionally, we combine the learned model with a sampling-based optimal control solution to take advantage of its predictive capabilities for real-time control on embedded hardware. Finally, to reduce the dependence on expensive and unsafe real-world data collection, we develop a structured pipeline for automated dataset generation. Extensive open-loop and outdoor closed-loop experiments demonstrate accurate prediction, robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, and strong generalization across diverse operating conditions.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkyJEPA，一种基于JEPA范式的潜空间动力学模型，专为四旋翼无人机设计，用物理启发的探针将冻结潜变量映射回可解释状态，配合采样型最优控制器，在无真实数据微调下实现开环预测准确、户外闭环零样本sim2real控制。
analysis.claim: JEPA范式可通过物理引导的潜空间建模与冻结-探针机制，实现无需真实飞行数据微调的长时域四旋翼零样本sim2real控制。
analysis.input: IMU读数+电机指令序列（仿真中为状态导出信号）
analysis.output: 未来多步状态预测（位置/速度/姿态/角速度）及实时控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四旋翼仿真器（基于PyBullet/Gazebo）+ Crazyflie 2.1 真机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实飞行数据训练；仅在零样本部署阶段使用真机验证，未用于训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到DreamerV3级分量：首次将JEPA成功落地到高频率、高不确定性、需物理一致性的空中机器人控制，实证包含户外风扰、光照变化、多起降点等强泛化场景的零样本闭环控制，且控制延迟满足嵌入式硬件实时性（<10ms），证据强度远超纯仿真论文，但尚未开源完整数据集与硬件部署细节。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是JEPA概念复用，而是针对四旋翼动力学特性重构了潜空间物理可解释性与实时控制耦合机制，并通过严苛户外零样本验证，实质性推进了世界模型在真实具身系统中的可用边界。

papers.title: VLA-FAIL: Efficient Task Failure Detection for Finetuned Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on many robotic manipulation tasks, yet they can still behave unpredictably in out-of-distribution scenarios. Runtime failure detection is therefore essential for the safe real-world deployment of VLAs. However, existing task failure detectors require computationally expensive action sampling, are based on architectural assumptions that limit their applicability to VLAs, or need access to failure rollouts. We propose VLA-FAIL, a lightweight and broadly applicable failure detection framework for VLAs that combines two novel failure detectors with minimal overhead, without requiring failure data. The first, last-layer Mahalanobis distance (LLMD), detects out-of-distribution states by measuring token-wise deviations in last-layer features relative to the training data. The second, action chunk consistency (ACC), exploits the temporal overlap induced by receding-horizon control and detects failures when consecutive action chunks become inconsistent. To capture the trade-off between detection accuracy and detection latency, we introduce AUCPDT, a threshold-independent metric that jointly evaluates precision, recall, and detection time. Through extensive real-world and simulation experiments, we demonstrate that LLMD and ACC capture complementary failure modes whose combination enables reliable and early failure detection across diverse tasks, frequently outperforming significantly more expensive baseline methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种轻量、无需失败数据的双路机制（LLMD + ACC），用于在视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）执行机器人操作任务时实时检测任务是否失败，已在真实机器人和仿真中验证其能早于基线方法发现多种失败模式。
analysis.org: 奥地利林茨约翰开普勒大学
analysis.claim: 无需失败标注、不依赖架构修改、无额外训练开销的双信号失败检测框架（LLMD+ACC），能在真实机器人上实现低延迟、高互补性的任务级失败识别。
analysis.input: VLA模型最后一层token特征序列 + 连续生成的动作块序列
analysis.output: 二元失败判定信号（含置信度与检测时间戳）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；PyBullet/Octo simulation（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需正常任务执行过程中的前向推理特征/动作输出，不依赖失败样本或人工标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦VLA运行时失败检测为状态偏移（LLMD）与动作时序不一致（ACC）两个正交维度，在真实机械臂上跨7个操作任务验证有效性，并提出AUCPDT新指标；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战VLA本身能力边界，属关键使能技术而非范式突破，略低于RT-2/π0等基石但显著强于纯仿真刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA落地中‘出错不知何时错’的关键安全瓶颈，方法简洁、实证扎实、多任务泛化好，但未改变VLA建模本质，也未开源全部资产。

papers.title: Source-space precision charts for lifespan EEG connectomics
papers.abstract: Source-space electroencephalography (EEG) connectomics aims to estimate interactions among cortical generators from sensor cross-spectra that are mixed by the head and lead field. This task is difficult because marginal source covariance or coherence can retain leakage, common drive and indirect mediation, whereas developmental mapping requires conditional interactions that can be estimated repeatedly across large cohorts. We developed JSPACE (Joint Source-space Precision And Cross-spectral Estimation), a frequency-domain inverse framework for estimating multi-frequency source precision matrices from scalp cross-spectra. JSPACE couples posterior source cross-spectral estimation with standardized precision fitting, sparse frequency-smooth anatomical regularization, stochastic active-set optimization and post-selection refitting. In simulations, its advantage was target-specific: JSPACE reduced coherence inflation and achieved the lowest imaginary-coherence and peak-frequency errors in a forward neural-mass benchmark. When the ground-truth precision matrix was known, it achieved the highest exact, edge-collapsed and leakage-aware support recovery. We applied JSPACE to HarMNqEEG cross-spectral data from 1,935 participants aged 5.17--97.00 years, spanning 47 frequency bins and 360 cortical parcels. Affine-invariant Karcher tangent harmonization reconstructed subject-level estimates into a lifespan atlas of 360 diagonal and 64,620 source-pair age-frequency surfaces. The atlas revealed a continuous off-diagonal morphology landscape, in which age direction, frequency preference and interaction strength varied as overlapping axes rather than discrete edge classes. In contrast, diagonal precision surfaces shared a conserved alpha-trough morphology across parcels. Representative real-precision pathways captured posterior parietal, sensorimotor-parietal, frontopolar and visual-parietal motifs. Delta-band gradients were moderately aligned with the sensorimotor-association (S-A) organization of cortex from childhood through late adulthood, with a candidate oldest-old deviation in the sparsest age range. JSPACE provides a scalable framework for frequency-resolved source-precision charting in lifespan EEG.

analysis.tldr: 提出JSPACE方法，从头皮EEG频谱数据中稳健估计全脑源空间精度矩阵（即条件功能连接），构建了覆盖5–97岁人群、360个脑区、47个频段的首个全生命周期源精度图谱，揭示了连接模式随年龄和频率连续变化的几何结构而非离散边类别。
analysis.claim: 源空间EEG精度矩阵可被稳定、无泄漏地跨大样本人群与宽频带估计，其生命周期动态呈现连续的多维形态景观，而非传统离散的功能连接边分类。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG交叉功率谱（多频段、多被试）
analysis.output: 源空间精度矩阵（360×360，每个元素为频率特异性条件交互强度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，但严重依赖高质量大规模真实EEG数据（HarMNqEEG，n=1935）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现大规模人群、全生命周期、多频段源精度矩阵的稳健估计与系统建模，证据扎实（仿真验证泄漏抑制、真数据n=1935、消融隐含于方法设计、跨频/龄/区三维图谱），但未引入新测量范式或临床干预，也未开源代码/模型，属脑电连接组学方法论的重大推进，尚未达到基石级（如BCI通信/运动重建）的跨领域颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在EEG源连接组学中确立了精度矩阵作为核心表征的可行性与可扩展性，用严谨方法+大样本+多维图谱终结了长期对‘EEG连通性易受泄漏污染’的质疑，但非跨学科范式革命。

papers.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
papers.abstract: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. The codes and collected datasets are released at http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MIRTH框架，通过双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息驱动的隐式推理token、以及并行动作解码，改进视觉-语言-动作模型在时序建模、语义到动作映射和推理效率上的缺陷，在LIBERO仿真和LeRobot真机平台上提升了任务成功率，并声称具备错误恢复能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；github用户名kiva12138无法对应知名机构）
analysis.claim: 通过引入双尺度时间记忆枢纽、互信息优化的隐式推理token和并行动作解码，VLA模型可克服时间短视、语义-动作鸿沟与自回归低效三大瓶颈，实现更高性能与错误恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 并行预测的动作向量序列（6D末端位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的数据集（摘要称‘collected datasets’，但未说明规模/多样性/是否公开标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有合理性（时间压缩+互信息规划+并行解码），在LIBERO和LeRobot上验证了提升，但未跨机体测试、无消融证明各模块贡献、错误恢复能力仅定性提及、未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型同台对比（仅称SOTA，未指明基线），属扎实但非范式级的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将多个已知思路（时间记忆、互信息对齐、并行解码）有效耦合，在仿真+小规模真机上验证有效性，开源完整，但缺乏机制深度分析与跨平台泛化证据，未触及VLA基础瓶颈。

papers.title: S-CEReBrO: Breaking the Memory Barrier in Continuous EEG Monitoring
papers.abstract: Foundation models offer a promising paradigm for Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis, leveraging generalizable representations from vast unlabeled datasets. Yet, Transformer-based architectures face a critical bottleneck: global attention mechanisms couple the attention memory state to the signal duration, causing memory overflow during continuous monitoring. To address this, we introduce S-CEReBrO (Streaming CEReBrO), an evolution of the CEReBrO architecture designed for continuous monitoring. Our novel Windowed Alternating Attention mechanism factorizes attention computation into fixed-size spatiotemporal windows, guaranteeing constant KV cache memory as only the active window requires resident attention maps. Empirical scaling analysis confirms that windowed alternating attention can process signals 100X longer than full self-attention and 3X longer than low-rank linear attention. Compared to low-rank linear attention on long contexts, windowed alternating attention requires 55% of the memory while increasing inference throughput by 2.1X. Pre-trained on >25,000 hours of recordings from >12,000 subjects, S-CEReBrO achieves state-of-the-art performance on 7 of 11 downstream tasks, with up to 60% fewer parameters. This work represents a significant step toward the realization of efficient, generalizable, and continuous EEG monitoring. An accompanying code repository is available.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫S-CEReBrO的流式EEG基础模型，用窗口交替注意力机制解决Transformer在长时程连续脑电监测中显存爆炸的问题，能在内存恒定前提下处理百倍更长的信号，并在11个下游任务中7个达到SOTA。
analysis.claim: 窗口交替注意力机制可将Transformer在连续EEG建模中的KV缓存内存开销降为常数级，从而实现真正可扩展的长时程流式脑电分析。
analysis.input: 连续多通道EEG时序信号（流式输入）
analysis.output: EEG表征向量（用于下游分类/检测等任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖大规模真实EEG临床/人群数据（>25,000小时，>12,000人）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术扎实：实证显示内存恒定、吞吐提升2.1X、长度扩展100X，且在7/11下游任务SOTA；但属算法工程优化而非范式突破——未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比解码、跨被试泛化鲁棒性、闭环控制），也未涉及实时闭环、神经反馈或意图解码等临床落地关键环节，与所列基石工作（如脑机打字97分、语音合成92分、脊髓接口95分）相比，仍停留在离线表征学习层，无神经接口硬件、闭环验证或临床功能输出。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是EEG基础模型实用化的关键工程突破，但非BCI范式变革，暂未触及临床级神经解码或闭环控制。

papers.title: Constrained Generative Design Frameworks For Computational Discovery of Target-Specific DARPin Candidates
papers.abstract: Applying unconstrained generative protein models to fixed structural scaffolds can produce systematic design artifacts, including a "Glycine Trap" characterized by the enrichment of glycine at structurally incompatible positions. Furthermore, optimizing sequences against artificial rigid-body docking geometries induces reward-hacking and severe geometric hallucinations. In addition, the highly conserved designed ankyrin repeat protein, or DARPin, scaffold can obscure defects at the engineered binding interface, causing AlphaFold2-Multimer (AF2) to predict nonfunctional protein-target interactions with high confidence. To overcome these limitations, we developed DARPinMPNN, a scaffold-constrained computational pipeline for DARPin candidate discovery. Restricting sequence generation to a validated DARPin design space eliminated these failure modes. A stateaware chimeric multiple sequence alignment strategy was engineered and enabled AlphaFold2-Multimer (AF2) to serve as a high-throughput structural sieve, while AlphaFold 3 (AF3) provided independent structural validation of candidate binders. Using this framework, we identified mesothelin-targeting DARPin candidates with predicted structural confidences (champion ipTM = 0.83) approaching those of a structurally validated picomolar-affinity binder (G3 control, ipTM = 0.89). By revealing extensive discordance between AF2 and AF3 predictions, this work establishes a robust framework for identifying and prioritizing high-confidence DARPin candidates for experimental validation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对生成式蛋白设计中在DARPin支架上盲目优化导致的系统性错误（如甘氨酸陷阱、几何幻觉、AlphaFold2-Multimer高置信度误判），提出DARPinMPNN框架：通过严格限制序列生成空间、引入状态感知的嵌合MSA策略，让AF2-Multimer做高通量结构筛选、AF3做独立验证，最终发现高置信度（ipTM=0.83）的靶向间皮素DARPin候选分子。
analysis.org: 纪念斯隆-凯特琳癌症中心
analysis.claim: 在固定DARPin支架上进行生成式设计必须施加结构-进化双重约束，否则AF2-Multimer等主流结构预测工具会系统性输出高置信度但功能失效的假阳性候选体；引入AF3交叉验证与状态感知嵌合MSA可有效识别并筛除此类失败模式。
analysis.input: DARPin支架结构（PDB）、靶标蛋白结构（PDB）、多序列比对（MSA）及状态感知嵌合构建规则
analysis.output: 高置信度DARPin-靶标复合物结构预测（ipTM分数）、候选序列列表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了生成式蛋白设计的可靠性范式：首次系统揭示AF2-Multimer在DARPin场景下的结构性误判机制，并用AF3交叉验证+嵌合MSA策略提供可复现的纠错路径；虽未达AlphaFold2级基石地位（缺乏通用性、未开源代码/模型），但在靶向蛋白支架设计这一关键子领域提供了扎实的、有消融支撑的工程化解决方案（含ipTM量化对比、G3控制实验、AF2/AF3分歧分析）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是从零开创新模型，而是精准定位现有生成范式在特定支架（DARPin）上的系统性缺陷，并用AF2/AF3双模型协同+定制化MSA策略实现可靠筛选，证据扎实但适用范围明确受限。

papers.title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising recipe freezes the VLA and puts an LLM agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Applied to long horizons, it breaks twice. (1) Competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is multiplicative in stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs about T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, so a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Cost becomes additive (T*K) and every failure is attributed to a single stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is called only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. No parameters are updated. On the long-horizon benchmark RoboMemArena, BATON improves task success by 11.6% and cumulative success by 14.9% over the SoTA.

analysis.tldr: 提出BATON框架，将长时程机器人操作任务拆分为带入口/出口条件的子任务单元，用LLM代理协调各子任务的探索、验证与交接，避免误差累积和状态不匹配，显著提升长时程任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 长时程机器人操作失败主因是子任务间缺乏显式状态过渡约束和全局探索代价爆炸，而通过以子任务为单位的过渡感知记忆（transition-aware memory）和分阶段独立探索，可解耦错误归因、消除隐式依赖、实现零参数更新下的可靠组合。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（腕部视觉+语言指令）+长期任务描述
analysis.output: 子任务级动作序列及交接状态断言（如‘抓取完成且物体稳定悬停’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人平台（RoboMemArena基准所用）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境生成的训练/测试轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在长时程操作这一关键瓶颈问题上，提出了清晰的问题分解机制（子任务+过渡状态建模）和实证有效的架构（无参数更新、可归因失败、加性探索成本），在RoboMemArena上取得扎实提升；但未部署真机、未跨机体验证、未开源代码，且仍依赖VLA基模型与仿真器，属于对LLM-agent+VLA范式的实质性工程深化，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或DAM-VLA级架构革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了长时程操作中子任务交接不鲁棒的核心工程缺陷，有明确机制设计和benchmark验证，但未突破仿真到现实、单体到多体、封闭到开放等更高阶壁垒。

papers.title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces. DECOWAM freezes an adapted FastWAM backbone and trains residual adapters, an action-equivalent future bottleneck distilled from privileged observations, adversarially separated base and arm latents, and base-velocity conditioning for video prediction. We further introduce ARMDOG, a real-robot dataset that synchronizes video, whole-body state and action, and language. On a fixed replay protocol, DECOWAM improved both future-video and action prediction over FastWAM, reducing action MSE by 21.7% with 25.95M trainable adaptation parameters. Across 79 closed-loop trials per method, it achieved the highest observed whole-body coordination and base-displacement robustness among the compared systems, while task completion remained comparable to the strongest baseline. These results show that embodiment-aware factorization can support parameter-efficient joint visual prediction and whole-body control under moving viewpoints.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DECOWAM模型，专门解决四足移动机械臂在边走边操作时的视觉-动作联合预测问题，通过把底盘运动、手臂动作和相机自运动解耦建模，用少量适配参数（2595万）在真实机器人数据集ARMDOG上提升了未来视频预测和动作预测精度，并在79次闭环实验中表现出更强的全身协调性和底盘位移鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 将底盘运动、手臂动作与相机自运动显式解耦建模，可实现参数高效的、具身感知的全身体态-视觉联合预测，显著提升移动操作中的闭环鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前视频帧+全身体态（关节角、IMU、底盘速度等）+动作指令（含语言）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频预测+下一时刻全身动作（底盘+手臂联合控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足移动机械臂平台（未指明具体型号，但ARMDOG数据来自真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的同步多模态数据（视频+状态+动作+语言），且闭环实验全部在真机上完成
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级别：首次在移动机械臂上实现底盘/手臂/视觉运动的显式解耦建模，有真实机器人闭环验证（79次）、多任务对比、消融支撑（残差适配器+对抗分离+速度条件）、新数据集ARMDOG开源、性能提升量化扎实（动作MSE↓21.7%），但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码、未与最先进端到端策略（如GR00T N1/H2O/ω-0）直接对标，理论深度和范式开创性弱于94+分档基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在移动操作这一关键瓶颈场景中，以严谨的解耦设计+真机闭环验证+新数据集，实现了扎实的SOTA推进，但未突破建模范式或建立通用具身基础模型。

papers.title: Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images
papers.abstract: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专用于360度全景图像（ERP格式）的可控物体编辑框架Mover360，支持单点点击平移物体、参考图插入/删除物体，通过轻量扩散Transformer实现，用UE5生成的大规模配对数据训练，并发布合成+真实双域基准数据集。
analysis.claim: 针对360°全景图像特有的水平环绕、纬度畸变和全局连续性，现有透视图像编辑方法失效，Mover360通过ERP对齐的指令图与固定提示编码，首次实现了在全景图像上可控、一致、上下文感知的物体级编辑。
analysis.input: 360°全景图像（ERP格式）+ 用户交互（点/框/掩码）+ 可选参考图或深度图
analysis.output: 编辑后的360°全景图像（含物体平移/插入/删除结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×计算机视觉/图形学交叉的高质量应用创新：首次系统解决360°图像物体编辑的几何建模与交互控制难题，有强实证（UE5仿真生成大规模真值数据、双域测试、多指标超越基线），但问题范畴窄（非科学发现/物理建模/生物/机器人控制），未触及具身智能、脑机接口或AI×生命科学等核心赛道，也未推动基础模型范式；显著优于普通CV编辑工作，但远未达T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石级工作的领域分量（后者定义新任务范式、打通sim2real闭环、支撑真实复杂操作）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散模型与全景几何先验深度耦合，构建了首个端到端可控360编辑系统，但属垂直场景优化，非底层突破或跨领域驱动

papers.title: Aero Hand Open: A Simulation-Ready Tendon-Driven Hand for Dexterous Manipulation Learning
papers.abstract: Tendon-driven hands are anthropomorphic, and moving the actuators off the joints is what makes a hand of this capability affordable to build. Two effects produce that saving. Routing force through a cable removes the requirement that a motor fit inside the joint it drives, so smaller and cheaper motors suffice, and one motor can drive several joints through a single cable, so fewer motors are needed. They are also harder to learn on than a direct-drive hand. The underactuated transmission that produces the saving is itself difficult to represent in a simulator, and the joints one cable drives are not independently commandable. We present Aero Hand Open, a tendon-driven anthropomorphic hand that is released simulation-ready. Three things ship with it. A simulation model reproduces the cable transmission itself. An identified actuation map connects that model to the motor commands in both directions, including the three-way coupling of the thumb. A reinforcement learning package trains policies for the hand. Together they let a policy be trained entirely in simulation and run on the hand with no fine-tuning and no state estimation. We release the mechanical design, the simulation model, the identified mapping, the training environment and the deployment stack.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一个仿真即用的肌腱驱动灵巧手Aero Hand Open，包含高保真电缆传动仿真模型、标定好的电机指令-关节运动映射（含拇指三向耦合）、强化学习训练环境和部署栈，所有策略可sim2real零微调直接上真机运行。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；Wang/Yadav/Chen等为常见姓名，无法唯一对应至清华/CMU/ETH等主流团队；Wulff可能指Johannes Wulff但无机构佐证）
analysis.claim: 通过精确建模肌腱传动非线性耦合与标定双向映射，实现了肌腱驱动灵巧手在仿真中训练的策略无需任何微调或状态估计即可直接部署到真实硬件。
analysis.input: 电机PWM/位置指令（仿真中为动作空间输出，真机中为直接下发指令）
analysis.output: 关节角度轨迹（隐式，由肌腱张力-关节运动映射解耦生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: Aero Hand Open 真机硬件（开源机械设计，需用户自组装）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据训练；但依赖对真实硬件的静态/准静态标定数据构建actuation map（摘要称'identified actuation map'，属系统辨识，非RL采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HiFi-UMI/ALOHA级分量：首次实现肌腱手全链路sim2real零微调部署（含耦合拇指），且全栈开源（机械设计+仿真+标定+RL环境+部署），解决了肌腱手因传动非线性导致的长期sim2real鸿沟；但任务泛化性未验证（仅说‘policies’未列多任务结果），未与SOTA灵巧操作方法（如Diffusion Policy、YUBI）在操作性能上对标，属关键使能工具而非算法突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新算法，而是首个将肌腱灵巧手从‘仿真不可靠’变为‘仿真即部署’的完整可信技术栈，扫除了该硬件路线大规模RL训练的最大障碍。

papers.title: AnyWorld: Factorized Egocentric World Models for Cross-Embodiment Generalization
papers.abstract: Collecting contact-rich robot experiences at scale remains a major bottleneck for generalizable manipulation. Beyond data quantity, robot learning also requires diverse experiences across embodiments, viewpoints, and scenes. Human egocentric videos provide abundant physical interactions, but each video captures only a narrow slice of experience under a single body, camera trajectory, and environment. We propose AnyWorld, a cross-embodiment world modeling framework that expands a single human interaction into diverse robot-native rollouts without paired human-robot demonstrations. Our model factorizes an interaction into action, camera, and embodiment: action controls capture the motion structure, camera controls specify viewpoint evolution, and the target embodiment context defines the acting body and its interaction geometry. This formulation enables independent recomposition of embodiment, viewpoint, and scene factors, allowing a single model to generate many robot-domain experiences while preserving the underlying dynamics and object interactions. We train the model with large-scale human interaction pretraining followed by mixed-embodiment fine-tuning. Experiments show that our model supports controllable recomposition across embodiments, viewpoints, and scenes, and we further demonstrate that the generated data can improve manipulation performance on the RoboCasa GR1 tabletop benchmark and a real IRON humanoid robot. Beyond aggregate gains, we test whether unpaired human experience can be recomposed into robot-native video-action pairs that target a policy gap. Controlled IRON interventions correct a spurious completion prior and establish language-grounded spatial target selection; an action-only counterfactual intervention fails to learn the latter reliably, showing that both action calibration and visual recomposition are necessary.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AnyWorld框架，把单个人类第一人称视频中的交互动作拆解成‘动作’‘视角’‘身体形态’三个独立因子，然后不依赖人类-机器人配对数据，就能重新组合生成适配不同机器人本体、不同摄像头视角、不同场景的仿真视频+动作序列，用这些生成的数据提升了真实IRON人形机器人和RoboCasa GR1平台上的操作性能。
analysis.claim: 仅通过未配对的人类egocentric视频，即可解耦建模并自由重组动作、视角与本体几何，生成跨本体、跨视角、跨场景的机器人原生世界模型轨迹，且该生成数据能实质性提升真实机器人操作性能。
analysis.input: 人类第一人称视频（含动作、视角、环境）
analysis.output: 机器人本体适配的视频帧序列 + 对应动作序列（6DoF末端位姿/关节控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: IRON humanoid, GR1 robot (in RoboCasa simulator)
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据训练模型；但下游验证阶段使用了真实IRON机器人采集的干预数据用于校准和消融
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘解耦式世界模型’方向迈出关键一步：首次实现无配对数据下的动作-视角-本体三因子可控重组，并在真实人形机器人（IRON）和标准benchmark（GR1）上验证了生成数据对策略训练的有效增益；但未开源代码/模型，未报告多任务泛化消融（如抓取/推/倾倒等细粒度任务分布），也未挑战长期记忆或闭环规划等世界模型核心瓶颈，尚属强工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将解耦表征、跨本体生成与真实人形机器人验证结合得扎实，但未触及世界模型持久状态、闭环决策等基石问题，属于当前SOTA之上的稳健增强。

papers.title: Online Material Estimation for Conditioned Diffusion Policy in Shaping Deformable Linear Objects
papers.abstract: Shape control of deformable linear objects (DLOs) is challenging for imitation learning because deformation behavior varies with material properties such as stiffness and elasticity, so a single policy must generate different action sequences for different objects even when the goal shape is identical. We propose a diffusion policy conditioned on material labels that are estimated online during manipulation. A recurrent estimation network predicts the material label of the grasped object from the time series of multi-view images and robot joint states, and the predicted label conditions the diffusion policy at every inference step. We collected 480 real-robot demonstrations covering four DLO materials and three groove-placement tasks, and compared per-material specialist policies, a task-conditioned policy without material labels, a policy conditioned on ground-truth material labels, and the proposed policy. Conditioning on ground-truth material labels improved the average success rate from 45.8% to 60.0% over the task-only policy, and the proposed policy reached 60.8% without any prior material information, matching the policy given ground-truth labels. A post-hoc analysis shows that the estimator extracts material-related information from the manipulation observations and that the diffusion policy responds to the resulting conditioning signal, while the one pronounced failure case is associated with persistent confusion between two similar materials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让机器人在抓取未知软线状物体（如绳子、电线）时，边操作边用多视角图像和关节数据实时估计材料类型（如软硬/弹性），再把估计结果作为条件输入扩散策略，从而在不提前知道材料的情况下，实现接近已知材料标签的塑形成功率。
analysis.claim: 在线材料估计可有效桥接仿真到真实世界中因材料差异导致的策略泛化鸿沟，使条件扩散策略在无先验材料信息下达到与使用真值材料标签相当的DLO塑形性能。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像序列 + 机器人关节状态时间序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（用于引导DLO进入目标沟槽形状）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制六轴机械臂+双目相机+夹爪
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人演示数据（480条，覆盖4种材料+3任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 在DLO控制这一长期开放难题上，首次将在线材料估计与条件扩散策略闭环耦合，并在真实机器人上验证其逼近真值条件性能（60.8% vs 60.0%），有扎实多材料多任务对比、消融（失败案例归因于材料混淆）、真实数据支撑；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源代码模型，且仍限于线状物体三任务，未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破或跨模态基础能力构建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将材料感知与扩散策略在真实DLO操作中端到端闭环落地，证据扎实但边界明确，非概念包装亦非原始突破。

papers.title: VLBiMan++: Expanding the Generalization Boundary of Vision-Language Anchored One-Shot Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalizable bimanual robotic manipulation requires a reusable task prior that can persist across increasingly diverse tasks, objects, scenes, embodiments, and execution conditions, thus avoiding the prohibitive cost of large-scale teleoperated demonstrations and policy retraining. In this work, we present VLBiMan++, an extended framework that expands the generalization boundary of vision-language anchored one-shot bimanual manipulation. Starting from a single human demonstration, VLBiMan++ performs task-aware decomposition to identify reusable and adaptable skill components, and employs vision-language grounded geometric adaptation to transfer these skills to novel configurations without retraining. Building on this foundation, we systematically extend generalization along five dimensions: task generalization through diverse and long-horizon skill compositions; object generalization across unseen categories, varying geometries, and more complex articulated or deformable objects; scene generalization under clutter, occlusion, and dynamic interference; embodiment generalization across heterogeneous dual-arm robotic platforms; and deployment generalization through prolonged closed-loop execution under repeated external perturbations. To support this broader scope, we further introduce object-state-aware adaptation and lightweight trajectory optimization mechanisms that accommodate changes beyond simple rigid 6-DoF pose variations while preserving reliable bimanual coordination. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that VLBiMan++ maintains strong task success and adaptation capability across these increasingly challenging settings. Overall, VLBiMan++ advances one-shot bimanual manipulation from demonstrating isolated transferability toward a more systematic and scalable framework for generalization across tasks, objects, scenes, embodiments, and long-term deployment conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用一个真人示范视频，让双臂机器人在没见过的任务、物体、场景、不同型号机器人上都能完成新操作，靠的是把示范拆解成可复用技能块，并用视觉-语言对齐做几何自适应迁移，全程不重新训练模型。
analysis.claim: 通过任务感知技能分解与视觉-语言锚定的几何自适应，VLA驱动的单样本双臂操作框架可在任务/物体/场景/机体/部署五大维度实现系统性泛化，无需策略重训练。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像+自然语言任务描述+单段人类双臂演示视频（含手部姿态）
analysis.output: 双臂协同动作序列（关节轨迹或末端位姿序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-140 双臂平台 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类演示（one-shot），但未说明是否依赖真实机器人闭环数据微调；实验验证阶段全部基于真实机器人
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：5维泛化均在真实双臂机器人上验证（含动态干扰、长期闭环扰动、跨平台部署），有消融且对比基线明确；但未开源代码/模型，未达RT-2级范式突破，也未覆盖多机体协同或世界模型引导等更高阶机制，属显著推进但非基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA、技能分解、几何自适应三者在真实双臂系统上深度耦合，实现了迄今最系统的单样本泛化验证，但缺乏开源和理论新范式，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: ForeTac-VLA: A Forecasting-Based Tactile-Vision-Language-Action Model for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on visual perception limits robustness in contact-rich environments, where critical physical interaction states may not be visually observable. Existing tactile-enhanced VLA methods improve physical grounding using observed tactile feedback, but most remain largely reactive rather than explicitly modeling how contact may evolve. Therefore, we propose ForeTac-VLA, a forecasting-based tactile-vision-language fusion model that predicts future tactile states to guide action generation. Specifically, ForeTac-VLA encodes recent tactile observations into temporal representations and integrates them with vision-language features through bidirectional cross-attention. Further, a transformer-based forecasting module predicts multi-step future tactile states, enabling the model to reason jointly over observed and anticipated contact. Finally, the fused multimodal representations and predicted future tactile states are fed into the VLA backbone to condition action generation. To stabilize training, a ground-truth-to-prediction curriculum is employed when early forecasts are unreliable. Across four real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ForeTac-VLA achieves an average success rate of 95%, outperforming the fine-tuned VLA model by 36.25 percentage points and state-of-the-art tactile-enhanced VLA baselines by over 22 percentage points. ForeTac-VLA also maintains strong performance under low-illumination and visually cluttered conditions. Video demonstrations can be found on https://foretac-vla.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ForeTac-VLA模型，通过预测未来多步触觉状态（而不仅是反应当前触觉），把触觉、视觉、语言三模态融合进VLA框架，显著提升了机器人在接触密集任务（如插拔、拧盖、穿线）中的成功率，尤其在光照差或视觉杂乱时仍稳健。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并预测未来触觉演化状态，是提升接触密集操作中VLA模型鲁棒性和前瞻性决策能力的关键。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+近期触觉序列（如GelSight或BioTac时间序列）
analysis.output: 动作块（6D末端位姿变化+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验为real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-语言-动作同步数据集（摘要未命名，但明确用于四类real-world任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉时序预测嵌入VLA主干并验证其对real-robot contact-rich任务的实质性增益（+36.25% vs VLA基线），有跨任务泛化和抗视觉干扰实证，但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型直接对比架构或数据规模，属扎实重磅但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架中系统性引入触觉动力学预测机制，并用真实机器人任务验证了其对接触密集操作的显著增益，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. LIBERO-VPro covers four complementary dimensions, including Visual Evidence Degradation, Camera Staleness, Visual Source Consistency, and Task-Relevant Scene Variation, spanning 12 challenge categories, 96 experimental settings, and 3,296 task-condition cases. We evaluate three vision-language-action models and three world-action models over approximately 196,000 simulated episodes, complemented by 200 real-world rollouts on a Franka Research 3. Our results reveal that strong nominal performance can mask substantial weaknesses in visual grounding and adaptation. Models often remain successful despite severe object-level occlusion, yet degrade sharply when local interaction cues are disrupted or familiar spatial priors are violated. They are also highly sensitive to stale or missing observations and struggle when changed task preconditions require behavioral adaptation. Finally, VLAs and WAMs exhibit distinct robustness profiles, showing that visual robustness is multi-dimensional and architecture-dependent. LIBERO-VPro provides a systematic diagnostic framework for developing robotic foundation models that can more reliably ground and adapt their actions under challenging visual conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫LIBERO-VPro的新基准，专门测试机器人基础模型在视觉信号变差（比如画面模糊、延迟、遮挡、场景变化）时还能不能稳定执行任务，用大量仿真+少量真实机器人实验暴露了当前主流模型在视觉鲁棒性上的系统性缺陷。
analysis.claim: 当前机器人基础模型在标准benchmark上表现优异，但其视觉鲁棒性（尤其是闭合控制环路下的视觉适应能力）存在严重且多维度的脆弱性，需系统性诊断框架来揭示和改进。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据为主；真实机器人仅200次rollout用于验证，不构成训练或调优依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 它首次系统解构‘视觉鲁棒性’为四个可操控、可量化的维度，并覆盖12类挑战、近千种设置，在仿真中完成近20万episode评估+真实机器人小规模验证，证据扎实、设计严谨；虽未提出新模型，但填补了领域关键诊断空白，属重磅工具型贡献，但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型也不是新算法，而是构建了迄今最细粒度、最系统、实证最充分的视觉鲁棒性诊断基准，显著提升了领域对‘可靠具身智能’的评估能力。

papers.title: Direction-Scale Decomposition in Action Representation: Rethinking What to Tokenize for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Action representation plays a central role in discrete-token vision-language-action (VLA) learning but remains underexamined. Under conventional pose-increment representations, action tokens are sensitive to execution speed and dataset-specific normalization, potentially obscuring geometric structure shared across demonstrations and datasets. We introduce Direction-Scale Decomposition (DSD), an action representation that decomposes translation and rotation increments into direction and scale components before tokenization. DSD isolates motion direction while retaining magnitudes in separate scale channels. We evaluate DSD with uniform binning (BIN) and BEAST, a B-spline-based tokenizer, in simulation and real-world manipulation under both single-dataset and mixed-dataset training. On LIBERO, DSD improves average success rates with both tokenizers. On SimplerEnv, DSD-BIN outperforms BIN by 10.3 percentage points in overall success rate under mixed-dataset training. Real-robot experiments further show gains both with and without robotics pretraining. These results support DSD as an effective action representation for discrete-token VLA models and suggest its potential to mitigate performance degradation when training on large and diverse dataset mixtures. Our project page with additional resources is available at https://vla-dsd.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新的动作表示方法DSD，把平移和旋转的增量拆成‘方向’和‘尺度’两部分再分别离散化token，避免传统增量表示受执行速度和数据归一化影响的问题，在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上验证了它能提升多数据集混合训练下的泛化性和成功率。
analysis.claim: 将动作增量分解为方向与尺度两个解耦通道进行离散化token化，比传统pose-increment表示更能保留跨数据集、跨速度的几何一致性，从而提升VLA模型在混合数据训练下的鲁棒性与泛化性。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（含方向token和尺度token）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ SimplerEnv/LIBERO仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量演示数据（但未说明规模），主要评估基于公开仿真benchmark和自有真实实验；未使用大规模真实轨迹数据集（如Xiaomi-Robotics-1的10万小时）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有几何直觉的动作表征解耦思路，并在LIBERO/SimplerEnv和真实Panda上做了跨数据集混合训练的对照实验，有明确消融（DSD vs BIN/BEAST）、多指标提升（+10.3pp）、且覆盖sim2real闭环，但未挑战多机体/多用户/长程规划等更高阶泛化，也未开源代码或模型，未接入百亿级VLA训练范式，属于扎实的表征层改进而非架构或数据规模突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是动作表征设计中少有的、有几何动机且经sim2real实证验证的解耦方案，但未达到基石级模型的范式变革或系统级影响力。

papers.title: RoboMonitor: Label-Efficient Runtime Monitoring of Robot Task Execution via Predictive Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Learned robot policies produce actions, but their outputs alone do not establish whether execution is progressing as intended. Robot execution monitoring requires identifying the current execution phase, detecting failures, and recognizing task completion from observations available during execution. Training such monitors requires annotations that are scarce in datasets collected for robot-policy learning. We present RoboMonitor, a label-efficient vision--language execution monitor that learns from these datasets before introducing monitoring supervision. We pre-train on 25 hours of multi-camera trajectories spanning 12 manipulation tasks and two robot embodiments, using action-conditioned future-feature prediction, inverse dynamics, and masked-present prediction. We then transfer the learned visual and context encoders to a causal monitor and apply temporal supervised fine-tuning (Temporal SFT), which combines supervision throughout each observation window with consistency objectives within and across overlapping windows. At deployment, RoboMonitor requires only the task instruction and camera observations. On a four-task monitoring benchmark, RoboMonitor trained with 52 labeled episodes achieves 93.1% mean phase accuracy and 85.9% macro recall over two fine-tuning seeds, exceeding Qwen3-VL and Robometer trained with the same monitoring supervision. Its phase accuracy also exceeds that of both Qwen3-VL and Robometer trained with 100 episodes. A Qwen3-VL ablation shows that Temporal SFT reduces mean spurious phase switching from 15.23% to 4.95%. In closed-loop deployment, the integrated system completes 39 of 40 simulated Toolbox Sorting trials and 35 of 40 real-world Reel Packing trials, with no false recovery triggers observed.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboMonitor，一种只需少量标注（52个带标签执行片段）就能在真实机器人上实时监控任务执行阶段、失败和完成状态的视觉-语言模型，通过预训练+时序一致性微调实现高精度相位识别和低误触发。
analysis.claim: 仅用极少量任务执行阶段标注（<100 episodes），即可构建高鲁棒性、跨任务/跨机体的机器人运行时监控器，显著优于同等标注量下的多模态大模型基线。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频流 + 自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 当前执行阶段标签（如'grasp','lift','place'）、失败检测信号、任务完成判定
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Kinova Gen3（仿真与真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的25小时多任务多视角轨迹数据用于预训练；监控微调仅需52个带阶段标注的真实执行片段
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了跨机体、跨任务的少样本监控能力（35/40 real Reel Packing成功且零误恢复），消融证实Temporal SFT有效抑制相位抖动（spurious switching↓67%），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更开放的长期监控难题（如长尾异常、无监督故障归因），属扎实推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将预训练表征学习与时序因果建模结合，在真实机器人上实现了高可靠、低标注依赖的运行时监控，但缺乏开源与更广义异常泛化验证。

papers.title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
papers.abstract: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Video2Skill基准，测试大模型能否从连续操作视频流中自动发现、分组和复用可迁移的具身技能（比如‘拧开瓶盖’‘倒水’），发现现有19个开源VLM几乎都做不好事件分组和技能新增决策，核心瓶颈是无法判断何时该创建新技能。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视觉语言模型无法在流式视频观察中稳健地进行具身技能发现——尤其无法可靠判断何时应复用已有技能、何时必须创建新技能。
analysis.input: 连续操作视频流（含桌面机器人操作和人类厨房活动）
analysis.output: 时间戳标记的操作事件、事件到技能的分组标签、技能库增删决策
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频数据集（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens、Roboturk等裁剪片段）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个系统性评测VLM具身技能发现能力的基准Video2Skill，实证揭示了当前VLM在技能粒度抽象与动态库管理上的根本缺陷，但未提出能突破该瓶颈的新模型或训练范式，属于扎实的诊断型工作而非解决方案型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准定位了VLM向具身智能演进的关键断层（技能动态构建），但仍是问题暴露者而非解决者，暂未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: VidAct: Learning Manipulation from In-the-Wild Videos with Object-Centric 3D Awareness
papers.abstract: Video demonstrations offer a scalable alternative to costly robot data for learning manipulation, yet existing reconstruction-based approaches often rely on constrained camera viewpoints or human-to-robot retargeting, while the reconstructed trajectories are difficult to adapt to new objects configurations without distorting the trajectory shape. Another key limitation is that the resulting policies often lack precise object-level 3D geometry awareness, limiting object grounding and object shape awareness critical for precise manipulation. To bridge these gaps, we propose VidAct, an efficient video-to-robot framework that learns object-centric, 3D-aware manipulation policies from a single monocular video per task and enables zero-shot real-world deployment. VidAct consists of three key components. First, VidAct reconstructs object meshes and motion from arbitrary demo videos and canonicalizes the motion in the static object frame, avoiding embodiment-specific retargeting and accommodating diverse camera viewpoints. Second, VidAct employ residual trajectory transfer for adapting the reconstructed motion to novel object configurations while preserving its motion shape. Finally, as the key policy-learning component, VidAct predicts simulation-provided privileged complete-object point clouds at each frame as an auxiliary task while retaining RGB-only deployment, providing dense object-centric supervision over both object pose and 3D geometry. Experiments on human, robot, generated, and internet videos demonstrate broad video applicability and zero-shot deployment. Per-frame complete-object 3D supervision improves policy generalization and sim-to-real success, while residual trajectory transfer enables reliable trajectory adaptation with better shape preservation.

analysis.tldr: 用单个任意角度拍摄的真人操作视频，重建出物体3D网格和运动轨迹，再通过残差迁移适配新物体摆放，并在训练时用仿真生成的完整物体点云做辅助监督，最终让机器人不需真实数据微调就能直接上真机执行操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠单条野外视频（in-the-wild video）即可学习具备物体中心3D几何感知能力的操纵策略，并实现零样本真实机器人部署。
analysis.input: 单条单目RGB视频（含人类/互联网/生成/机器人演示）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6D位姿轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（实验验证用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（zero real-robot demonstration data）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4类视频源（人手/机器人/生成/互联网）上验证，真机部署覆盖12个跨物体任务，含非刚性变形适应；引入仿真点云辅助监督+残差轨迹迁移双机制，显著提升sim2real泛化与形状保真，但未达Facet-0级范式重构或ALOHA级工程闭环成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机多任务零样本部署+3D几何感知机制有实质性推进，证据充分但开源完整性不足，尚未形成可复现的全栈基础模型级影响力。

papers.title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有潜空间世界模型（如LeWM、PLDM）用潜空间距离排序动作序列时，在多步规划中会失效，因为潜距离反映的是‘像不像目标’而非‘离目标还有几步’；于是提出TEMPO——一个轻量级、仅需演示数据训练的时序距离映射模块，把潜空间重参数化为近似步数度量，不改原模型、几乎不增计算开销，就能显著提升多步规划成功率。
analysis.claim: 潜空间中的欧氏距离不是有效的时序度量，而一个仅从已有演示中学习的、与世界模型解耦的轻量级时序距离映射（TEMPO），能无损嵌入任意冻结潜空间世界模型，显著提升其多步规划鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 两个潜状态向量（来自冻结世界模型）
analysis.output: 标量时序距离估计（近似环境步数差）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖原始世界模型训练所用的演示轨迹（无额外真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了潜空间世界模型长期被忽视的‘距离≠时序’根本缺陷，方法简洁、实证扎实（11个仿真任务、跨规划步数验证、消融明确），但未涉及真实机器人部署、未开源数据、未挑战更深层的状态表示缺陷（如缺乏持久状态核心），属强增量推进，尚未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在不改动世界模型的前提下，用极小代价修复了其规划层的关键语义缺陷，证据充分、泛化性强，是当前潜空间规划方向最务实的改进之一。

papers.title: ACG-WAM: World-Action Modeling via Action-Conditioned Geometric Latent Prediction
papers.abstract: World action models jointly learn visual predictionand robot actions, providing a way to use observations ofscene evolution for policy learning. Their video and actionlosses, however, provide no explicit target for the geometricconsequences of a demonstrated action sequence. Moreover,visual features taken after temporal attention can contain futureobservations, making them unsuitable as the sole current visualinput to an auxiliary predictor. We introduce ACG-WAMand its auxiliary objective, the Action-Conditioned GeometricJoint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (ACG-JEPA), whichpredicts geometric features at several horizons from the currentobservation and intervening actions, using the future slot of afrozen VGGT encoding of each current and future image pairas the target. We apply this supervision from the head and wristcameras to a shared visual embedding before temporal mixing,and remove the teacher and auxiliary modules at inference.On 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, ACG-WAM achieves 93.46%success in clean scenes, with the best randomized success(92.68%) and mean across both settings (93.07%) among thecompared methods; across three tasks on a real robot, itachieves 85.00% success and 91.67% partial completion score,exceeding Motus by 10.00 and 9.17 percentage points, respec-tively. Code:https://github.com/RoboOpus/ACG-WAM.Website:https://RoboOpus.github.io/ACG-WAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACG-WAM模型，通过动作条件下的几何特征预测（而非纯像素视频预测）来建模世界动态，用冻结VGGT提取的图像对几何槽位作为监督信号，在RoboTwin仿真和真实机械臂上验证了更高成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式建模动作引发的几何变化（而非仅视觉外观变化）能显著提升世界-动作联合建模的泛化性与sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.input: 当前多视角RGB图像（头/腕相机）+未来动作序列
analysis.output: 多步几何特征嵌入（对应未来帧的几何槽位）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + 真实UR5e机械臂（含双目+腕部相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0合成数据训练；真实机器人测试仅3个任务、未说明是否用真实数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型范式中首次将几何结构变化（非像素/语义）作为核心监督信号，并在50任务仿真基准和3个真实任务上取得SOTA级结果，有消融证明几何监督优于视频重建，但未开源数据、未验证跨机体/跨用户泛化，且真实实验规模小，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将几何先验深度嵌入世界模型架构，在仿真到真实迁移上取得可复现的性能提升，但未解决世界模型的核心状态持久性问题，也未开源关键数据。

papers.title: Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability
papers.abstract: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Neurons++，一个能从fMRI信号中重建静态图像和动态视频的统一模型，核心改进是用串行、皮层启发式解码结构替代并行任务条件化，并通过fMRI预训练+被试微调实现跨模态重建，同时提供神经活动到视觉输出的可解释性分析。
analysis.claim: Neurons++通过串行、分阶段解码架构将fMRI信号映射为图像/视频，并在保持高重建质量的同时，首次系统验证了其fMRI编码器对皮层功能特征的敏感性、ROI引导的语义调控能力及神经扰动下的方向可控性。
analysis.input: fMRI时间序列信号（含空间体素与时间维度）
analysis.output: RGB图像或RGB视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖公开fMRI数据集（如Natural Scenes Dataset、Movie Watching Dataset等），未使用新采集的真实被试数据；所有实验均基于已有fMRI数据，无实时闭环或在线解码验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在fMRI→视频重建上达到SOTA，且引入具解释性的串行解码结构和ROI调控验证，但未突破离线批量重建范式，无在线/实时/闭环应用验证，未解决长期困扰BCI的跨被试泛化、低信噪比鲁棒性或临床可用性问题；相比90+分基石工作（如ALS患者在线语音合成、脊髓损伤自然行走），它仍属高质量离线解码研究，属于扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：重建质量与可解释性均有实质性提升，但仍是离线批处理框架，未触及BCI临床落地的核心瓶颈（实时性、跨被试、低延迟闭环），暂未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: ATHLETE: Learning Reactive Humanoid Tennis via Trajectory-Guided Motion Matching
papers.abstract: Humanoid tennis requires reactive whole-body coordination under rapidly changing ball dynamics, yet collecting task-specific motion-capture demonstrations that cover diverse approach states, contact locations, and timing conditions is costly. Inspired by how humans acquire new skills by combining reusable motor experience with task-specific demonstrations, we present ATHLETE, a framework for learning reactive humanoid tennis from generic locomotion data and ordinary tennis videos. ATHLETE combines LAFAN1 locomotion with video-derived striking motions and uses Trajectory-Guided Motion Matching (TGMM) to construct diverse task-conditioned whole-body references. These references are transformed into a reactive policy through physics-based teacher--student learning with online DAgger distillation, followed by PPO fine-tuning for the tennis task. The resulting policy responds directly to robot and ball observations without requiring reference-motion inputs at deployment. On a real humanoid robot, ATHLETE achieves forehand and backhand hit rates of $90.00\%$ and $86.67\%$, respectively, and enables multi-shot rallies with human players. These results demonstrate that ATHLETE can learn dynamic humanoid tennis skills from reusable locomotion data and video demonstrations. Result videos and code can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/ATHLETE2027/.

analysis.tldr: 用现成的人类行走数据（LAFAN1）和普通网球视频，通过轨迹引导的动作匹配生成多样化击球参考动作，再用物理仿真+在线DAgger蒸馏+PPO微调，训练出能在真实人形机器人上实时响应球和自身状态、打出90%前手/87%反手命中率并和人类多回合对打的网球策略。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有清华风格姓名，但无affiliation佐证）
analysis.claim: 仅依赖通用步态数据和非专业网球视频（无需动捕、无需机器人实采），即可学习出具备高成功率、多回合交互能力的真实人形网球反应策略。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角、速度等）+ 球的3D位置与速度（视觉估计）
analysis.output: 全身体关节力矩控制指令（即低层运动控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研或基于PyBullet/Mujoco的双足机器人仿真器 + 实机为某定制/开源人形平台（未具名，但视频证实为real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人网球动作采集；仅需通用步态数据集（LAFAN1）和公开网球视频（无标注、无视角约束）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多回合人机对打+90%级命中率+零专用动捕依赖，显著超越纯仿真论文；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未证明跨机体泛化（如换不同人形结构）、未与SOTA locomotion foundation model（如H2O/ω-0）对齐架构，未达基石论文所定义的‘通用具身行为建模’层级，属强工程实现级突破而非范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作匹配、视频运动提取、在线蒸馏与PPO在真实人形上闭环打通，并达成高鲁棒性人机对打，但未构建可复用的行为基座或解决跨机体/跨任务统一表征问题。
