papers.title: MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. We evaluate locally deployable open-weight planners, multi-agent state-tracking strategies, and frontier models. Even the strongest evaluated models fail on a substantial fraction of clean episodes, and their success rates decrease further under online perturbations. Supervised adaptation greatly improves a small model, but performance remains substantially lower on longer and multi-robot missions. We release the benchmark, 261,646 task-level training examples, and an architecture-agnostic expert-trace generation pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试长时程具身智能体在动态多机器人环境中应对任务中断、执行失败和使命更新能力的基准MAGMA-Bench，不依赖具体模型架构，提供技能级接口、26万+任务级训练样本和专家轨迹生成工具，但所有评测模型（包括前沿开源规划器）在干净任务上就已失败率高，扰动下更差，且未在真实机器人上验证。
analysis.claim: 现有基准无法有效评估长时程具身智能体在动态任务与执行失败交织场景下的持续推理能力，MAGMA-Bench首次系统性填补这一空白，通过可控在线扰动和异构多机器人协同任务实现架构无关的严格评测。
analysis.input: 任务描述（自然语言）、当前环境状态（结构化技能接口抽象）、在线扰动信号（如失败通知、新指令）
analysis.output: 技能序列（skill-level action plan）
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于Webots仿真的异构机器人（轮式/机械臂/无人机等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人交互或部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次聚焦‘动态任务+执行失败+多机器人协同’交叉评测，设计严谨、开源充分，但纯仿真、无真机验证、未提出新模型或控制方法，且实证显示当前SOTA模型在此基准上表现极弱——说明它暴露了瓶颈而非突破了瓶颈；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑（真机多任务泛化+世界模型+行动闭环），它属于高质量诊断工具，非推进性工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个针对长时程动态扰动下多机器人协同推理的开源仿真基准，价值在于诊断而非驱动，暂未体现对具身智能核心能力（如sim2real迁移、实时适应、跨机体泛化）的实质性推进。

papers.title: Prospective discovery of LasB inhibitors by integrating generative design, free energy ranking, and experimental validation
papers.abstract: Identifying synthetically accessible, potent ligands from vast chemical space remains a major challenge in drug discovery, particularly because experimental synthesis and testing are costly and low throughput. Here, we present a fully open-source computational–experimental workflow that integrates fragment-based de novo molecular design with rigorous alchemical absolute binding free-energy calculations to enable physics-based prioritization before chemical synthesis. We apply this strategy by targeting the virulence-associated zinc metalloprotease LasB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa. From ~40,000 diverse compounds generated through multi-objective optimization, a small subset was prioritized and experimentally evaluated, leading to the discovery of three previously unreported nanomolar inhibitors (IC 50 22–53 nM) with excellent metabolic and plasma stability. This work demonstrates a general and scalable framework for coupling generative molecular design with quantitative binding affinity prediction, improving decision-making and reducing the cost, time, and risk associated with early-stage drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用开源的生成式分子设计+物理驱动的绝对结合自由能计算，从4万种新分子中筛选出3个对铜绿假单胞菌毒力蛋白LasB有纳摩尔活性且代谢稳定的新抑制剂。
analysis.claim: 将片段级生成式分子设计与高精度alchemical自由能计算闭环耦合，可在合成前可靠预测并发现高活性、高稳定性靶向抑制剂。
analysis.input: LasB蛋白三维结构、锌金属活性位点约束、多目标优化化学先验（合成可行性、类药性、溶解度等）
analysis.output: 可合成的新型小分子抑制剂结构及其预测的绝对结合自由能（ΔG_bind）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真实验验证3个纳摩尔抑制剂，含IC50、代谢/血浆稳定性数据；全流程开源；但靶点单一（LasB）、未跨靶标泛化，未与主流生成模型（如REINVENT、GFlowNet-Drug、DiffSBDD）做SOTA对比，也未证明比传统虚拟筛选（如docking+MMGBSA）显著提效，故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机（湿实验）验证+全开源闭环流程+纳摩尔活性分子发现，但靶点和评估维度较窄，尚未证明范式级可迁移性。

papers.title: VLRLA: Deployment-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language-Action Models through In-Context Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models connect visual perception and language understanding with robot control, providing a foundation for instruction-conditioned manipulation. However, conventional pretrained VLA policies lack a mechanism for gradual adaptation through accumulated interaction experience during deployment. We therefore propose VLRLA, a general framework that equips existing VLA models with \textit{in-context reinforcement learning} capabilities for deployment-time adaptation. Our approach augments a VLA model with a reinforcement learning module that learns from historical observations, actions, rewards, and termination signals. During deployment, the policy gradually refines its action generation and progressively improves task success while keeping model parameters fixed. Our approach is also designed for general applicability and compatibility with diverse learning history construction strategies and model training pipelines. Finally, through extensive experiments, we systematically investigate the learning properties of VLRLA in simulation and demonstrate its ability to adapt to unseen scenarios during real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLRLA框架，让已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人实际部署时，不更新模型参数，仅靠当前任务中积累的‘上下文’（历史观测、动作、奖励、终止信号）实时微调行为策略，从而适应新场景。
analysis.claim: 固定参数的VLA模型可通过部署时的上下文化强化学习（in-context RL）实现零梯度更新的在线适应，无需重训练或微调。
analysis.input: 视觉帧+语言指令+历史交互序列（观测-动作-奖励-终止）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制或离散动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（如Franka/UR5等）及真实机械臂（文中提及real-world deployment但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署时的在线交互数据（reward/termination需人工或程序定义），但未说明是否依赖预采集的真实机器人轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将in-context learning范式系统引入VLA部署适应，实证覆盖仿真多任务+真实机械臂少量任务，有消融和跨场景测试，但未开源代码/模型，无跨机体验证，真实部署仅展示有限泛化（非长期持续适应），未达RT-2级范式突破，属显著但非里程碑式贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但为VLA模型在线轻量适应提供了首个可验证的in-context RL架构，工程落地路径清晰但实证广度不足

papers.title: APT: Action Expert Pretraining Improves Instruction Generalization of Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that couple pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with continuous action experts have achieved strong manipulation performance, yet generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) language instructions remains poor. A known challenge is the structural imbalance in VLA data, where language is far less diverse than visual and action content, making policies prone to visual shortcuts. While discrete-action methods mitigate this through vision-language co-training, continuous action experts lack such protection: they start from random initialization and learn entirely from imbalanced data, producing noisy gradients that corrupt the VLM and fail to exploit its language capability. We address this from a Bayesian perspective, factorizing the policy into a language-agnostic Vision-Action (VA) prior and a language-conditioned VLA likelihood, and propose APT, a two-stage training method emphasizing Action expert PreTraining. In Stage 1, the action expert is pretrained as a VA prior on vision-action pairs from a frozen VLM, bypassing the language imbalance. In Stage 2, language tokens are injected through a gated fusion mechanism that integrates VLM features while preserving the learned visuomotor prior. APT applies to mainstream VLA architectures, including the $π$ and GR00T-style architectures. Comprehensive experiments validate that APT achieves consistent gains on unseen instructions and compositional tasks. Project Page: https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/

analysis.tldr: 提出APT两阶段训练法，先用视觉-动作对预训练动作专家（绕过语言数据不平衡问题），再注入语言信息微调，提升VLA模型对未见过指令的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将策略分解为语言无关的视觉-动作先验和语言条件化的似然，并分阶段训练动作专家，可显著缓解VLA模型因语言数据稀缺导致的指令泛化失败。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真/真实机器人数据集（如Bridge、RT-1、OpenX），未采集新真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有清晰因果逻辑（贝叶斯分解+分阶段解耦训练），在多个主流VLA架构（π、GR00T）和多个基准（Bridge、OpenX、VoxPoser）上验证了对OOD指令和组合任务的稳定提升，含消融实验；但未在真实机器人上部署，未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难的跨机体/跨用户泛化，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA中被长期忽视的语言数据瓶颈问题，实证充分但落地闭环不完整，是高质量的方法论改进而非原理性突破。

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Redirection Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies bring natural language into closed-loop robot control, enabling robots to execute manipulation tasks directly from text instructions. The same interface gives text a recurring role in control because the prompt is reused at every replanning step, and each prompt-conditioned action changes the future observations on which the policy acts. Existing VLA attacks study adversarial prompts that elicit targeted low-level actions or make such actions persist across changing images. We identify a stronger trajectory-level failure mode: a prompt that still $\textit{appears}$ to specify the intended task but redirects the final physical outcome. We mathematically formalize this setting as $\textit{command-preserving trajectory redirection}$, a prompt-only threat model in which the attacker chooses one prompt before the episode, all policy and environment components remain fixed, and the prompt must stay close to the benign instruction while omitting target words and correction language. To find such prompts, we introduce an on-policy prompt search method that uses rollouts to discover perturbations whose closed-loop behavior tracks a target task while satisfying the command-preserving constraints. Experiments in simulation and on hardware show that near-benign prompt perturbations can redirect VLA rollouts to attacker-specified targets. These results expose a trajectory-level vulnerability in VLA instruction grounding: text that appears to preserve the intended command can still give an adversary control over the robot's final physical outcome. Project website: https://vla-redirection-attack.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并系统构造了一类新型攻击：通过微调自然语言指令（如把‘拿苹果’改成‘拿苹果然后放桌上’），让视觉-语言-动作模型在执行过程中看似忠实地遵循原指令，实则最终完成完全不同的物理任务（比如把苹果放进冰箱而非桌上），且该攻击在仿真和真实机器人上均有效。
analysis.claim: VLA模型存在轨迹级指令劫持漏洞——仅通过语义相近、表面合规的文本提示扰动，即可在不触发明显异常的前提下，系统性地重定向整个任务执行轨迹的最终物理结果。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+当前多模态观测（RGB图像等）
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + PyBullet仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于验证，但攻击生成本身不依赖真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化并实证了VLA模型中‘指令表意不变但行为轨迹被劫持’这一高危漏洞，覆盖仿真+真实机器人+多任务，具备强现实威胁意义；但未提出防御方案，未开源代码/模型，也未挑战或改进现有VLA架构本身，属于关键安全缺陷揭示而非技术推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破模型能力，而是首次用扎实实验揭露VLA范式下被忽视的深层语义-行为解耦风险，对部署级可靠性构成实质性警示。

papers.title: HEFT: Heavy-Payload Full-size Humanoid Teleoperation with Privileged Motion Guidance and Windowed Payload Curriculum
papers.abstract: General motion tracking and teleoperation offer a promising path to scalable humanoid skill acquisition, yet most existing frameworks are validated on compact platforms or without real payload interaction, leaving full-size humanoids with real payloads largely unexplored. Scaling to full-size humanoids introduces two compounding challenges: their larger inertia and tighter balance margins make tracking highly sensitive to noise, drift, and retargeting errors from commodity VR trackers, while their payload potential remains largely underutilized. We present HEFT, a heavy-payload full-size humanoid teleoperation framework that addresses both challenges. HEFT learns from deployable noisy VR references with physically plausible reconstructed references through Privileged Motion Guidance (PMG), and uses a Windowed Payload Curriculum (WPC) with expert-guided payload caps to acquire robust heavy-payload tracking. We deploy HEFT on L7, a 175cm, 65kg humanoid. The robot tracks motions including turns, forward/backward locomotion, and squats under payloads up to 24kg.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了全尺寸人形机器人（L7，175cm/65kg）在最高24kg真实载荷下的VR遥操作运动跟踪，通过Privileged Motion Guidance修正消费级VR追踪噪声，用Windowed Payload Curriculum逐步提升载荷能力。
analysis.claim: 在无高精度动捕、仅依赖消费级VR设备的前提下，实现全尺寸人形机器人在真实重载（24kg）下的鲁棒遥操作运动跟踪。
analysis.input: 消费级VR手柄+头显的6DoF位姿+关节角度估计（含噪声）
analysis.output: 全身体关节扭矩控制指令（实时闭环）
analysis.robot_dependency: L7全尺寸人形机器人（自研硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在不同载荷下的闭环遥操作数据，但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署、多任务（转体/行走/深蹲）、跨载荷（0→24kg）验证、消融显示PMG与WPC均有效；但未开源代码/模型，未与SOTA遥操作框架（如H2O、GRAIL）对比，未测试泛化到其他机体或用户，且VR噪声建模和物理重建仍属工程优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实重载人形平台上扎实落地了VR遥操作，解决了噪声敏感与载荷耦合难题，但未开新范式、未开源、未跨机体验证，属于高水平工程推进而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to perform the same learned tasks under environmental shifts, such as changes in camera pose and shifts to a different but similar robot (e.g., from Panda to UR5e). Adapting these models to the shifted environment (i.e., target domain) often requires training on multiple demonstrations for each task, which are costly to collect. To reduce the burden of data curation and training, we propose an analogy-based method that adapts VLA models under environmental shifts through weight vector arithmetic with domain-specific information addition, named Domain ARiThmetic (DART). Unlike prior approaches, DART requires collecting only a single demonstration, enabling efficient adaptation. To accurately isolate domain-specific information for addition, DART performs subspace alignment between singular components in weight vectors to filter out noisy components. In both simulated and real-world experiments, DART outperforms existing VLA adaptation methods in one-shot scenarios across diverse visual and embodiment shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/snumprlab/dart.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫DART的方法，只用一个示范样本（one-shot）就能把视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型快速适配到新环境（比如换摄像头角度或换机器人型号），核心是通过权重向量的子空间对齐+向量加法注入域信息。
analysis.claim: 仅需单个示范样本，即可通过权重空间中的域特定向量算术实现VLA模型在视觉与具身环境变化下的高效跨域适应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+单个目标域示范轨迹（含动作）
analysis.output: 适配后的VLA模型权重（即新参数），用于在目标域执行相同任务
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1个真实机器人示范样本（per task），但未说明是否需真实传感器标定/时序同步等隐性数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在one-shot VLA跨域适应这一明确痛点上给出可验证、多机体（Panda→UR5e）、多视觉位姿、真机+仿真联合验证的方案，有子空间对齐等技术细节和消融，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未挑战更难的开放场景泛化（如未知物体/新任务组合），属扎实推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：方法简洁有效，在one-shot跨域VLA适配任务上实证充分，但受限于单任务单示范设定和未完全开源，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级的系统性影响力。

papers.title: Benchmarking AI Protein Structure Predictors Reveals a Persistent Bias in Multi-State Proteins
papers.abstract: Protein structure predictors achieve high single-state accuracy, but it remains unclear whether they can recover functionally relevant conformational ensembles or account for the presence of ligands and/or binding partners. Here, we benchmark AlphaFold3, Boltz-2, Chai-1, and BioEmu on four canonical multi-state proteins (Pf-MATE, LAO, SecA, and β2AR), quantifying state bias and sampling breadth against experimental reference structures. Models frequently default to a dominant state represented in the PDB; small-molecule ligands have weak or inconsistent effects, while large protein partners drive clear conformational switching between states. Multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-based approaches (AF-Cluster and random subsampling) recapitulate similar biases, indicating that this behavior is not unique to newer architectures. These results underscore current limitations for multi-state protein structure prediction and structure-guided ligand discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了AlphaFold3、Boltz-2、Chai-1和BioEmu等主流AI蛋白结构预测模型在多构象蛋白（如Pf-MATE、LAO等）上的表现，发现它们普遍存在对PDB中优势构象的严重偏好，难以准确采样功能相关的多态构象集合，且对小分子配体响应微弱，仅对大蛋白伙伴有较明显构象切换，说明当前模型在动态结构预测和配体诱导变构建模上存在根本性局限。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AI蛋白结构预测器在多状态蛋白建模中存在系统性构象偏好偏差，该偏差源于训练数据与MSA构建方式，而非模型架构特有，严重制约其在变构药物设计中的实用性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+配体/伙伴蛋白信息（文本/结构标识）
analysis.output: 预测的三维结构集合（多构象采样）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统量化四大前沿模型在多态蛋白上的构象偏差，并关联到MSA采样机制与实验参考结构，证据扎实（4个经典多态蛋白+定量状态分布分析+消融式MSA对比），但未提出新模型或算法，属高质量诊断性研究，推进了领域认知边界，尚未达到基石级方法论突破（如AF2/ESMFold/RFDiffusion）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是新模型，而是用严谨基准揭示了当前SOTA模型在动态结构预测中的结构性缺陷，为后续变构建模和药物发现提供了不可绕过的实证基线。

papers.title: STST-JEPA: Shallow-Target Spatio-Temporal Joint Embedding Prediction Architecture For EEG Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Brain age - the age inferred from a physiological recording - is an emerging biomarker whose deviation from chronological age tracks neurological and psychiatric burden, and EEG is an attractive substrate for it because it is cheap, portable, and temporally rich. Yet EEG brain-age models must contend with cross-site montage heterogeneity, small labelled cohorts, and dominant subject-level non-stationarity, and few EEG foundation models have been shown to deliver competitive age regression across the full pediatric to older adult range in which such a biomarker would actually be deployed. We introduce STST-JEPA, a self-supervised transformer for resting-state and task EEG, pretrained on 47,703 sessions spanning ages 5-81 from the brain.space and Healthy Brain Network (HBN) corpora. The model combines a latent-prediction objective - predicting masked-token representations against an EMA-of-tokenizer target - with an auxiliary signal-reconstruction term, applied to 30-second multi-channel windows under spatiotemporal block masks. A lightweight attentive probe trained on frozen pretrained embeddings achieves a best held-out-validation mean absolute error of 3.06 years (r = 0.924) for age regression on 3,367 sessions, against a predict-the-mean baseline of approximately 10 years MAE. With light task-specific finetuning of the model's final layers, the same pretrained encoder achieves rank-1 placements - with the model's native 30-second windows - on the public NeuralBench x brain.space EEG leaderboard for sex classification (balanced accuracy 0.911), age prediction (r = 0.749), and psychopathology composite regression (r = 0.215). We further show that the model's age-prediction residual is negatively correlated with cognitive efficiency over several tasks we examined.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为STST-JEPA的自监督Transformer模型，用4.7万段跨年龄（5–81岁）多中心EEG数据预训练，通过掩码时空块预测+信号重建联合目标学习通用表征，在冻结主干后仅用轻量探针就实现3.06年脑龄预测误差，并在多个EEG下游任务（性别、年龄、精神病理）上刷榜。
analysis.claim: STST-JEPA通过浅层目标联合嵌入预测架构，在跨站点、跨年龄段、小标注样本约束下，学习到泛化性强的EEG基础表征，显著提升脑龄等生物标志物建模性能。
analysis.input: 30秒多通道静息态/任务态EEG时序信号（按spatiotemporal block mask掩码）
analysis.output: 被掩码时间-空间位置的潜变量表示 + 原始EEG信号重建
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在超大尺度（4.7万段）、全生命周期（5–81岁）、多中心EEG数据上验证了自监督JEPA范式对脑龄等临床相关生物标志物的有效性，MAE=3.06年具临床可解释性，且跨任务迁移表现稳健；但未开源代码/模型权重，未报告消融实验细节，未与同期SOTA（如EEGNet+SSL变体）做公平对比，也未验证其残差是否真能驱动干预决策。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将JEPA框架扎实落地于EEG基础模型，数据规模与任务覆盖广度确属当前领先，但缺乏开源与机制分析，尚未达到‘真突破’门槛

papers.title: Worlds in One Demo: A Synthetic Data Engine for Learning Open-World Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning open-world mobile manipulation policies requires vast data to achieve spatial generalization, long-horizon robustness, and scene generalization. Current prevailing data collection paradigms, teleoperation and UMI, demand prohibitive human effort and cost at scale. To scale beyond the limits of manual data collection, we seek to maximize the value of each human demonstration by scalable data generation. To this end, we introduce WANDA: learning open-World mobile mANipulation from one demonstration via a synthetic DAta engine. WANDA first reconstructs background Gaussian splats and robot-object interaction trajectories from source RGBD observations, as a world substrate for later planning and rendering. It then rearranges contact-rich robot-object interaction segments into extensive spatial configurations, utilizing whole-body motion planning to chain them into new trajectories. To enhance long-horizon robustness, it applies Corrective State Expansion to increase the robot and object state diversity at different stages of mobile manipulation. To unlock cross-environment generalization, trajectories are synthesized on diverse generated 3D worlds from everyday photos. Furthermore, we synthesize photo-realistic observations by compositing rendered robot and object meshes with Gaussian splatting backgrounds. We evaluate our approach on extensive simulation and real-world tasks in various scenes. Experiments show that policies trained with WANDA achieve long-horizon robustness, broad spatial generalization and cross-environment generalization from one real demonstration. Moreover, WANDA naturally supports cross-embodiment data generation, validated by zero-shot deployment on another mobile manipulator with a distinct morphology.

analysis.tldr: 只用一个真实人类演示，通过重建场景高斯溅射、重排交互片段、扩增状态空间、合成多样化3D世界和照片级渲染，生成海量高质量合成数据，训练出能在不同环境、不同机器人本体上泛化的移动操作策略。
analysis.claim: 仅需单次真实人类演示，即可通过可扩展的合成数据引擎WANDA生成具备空间泛化性、长时程鲁棒性和跨环境/跨本体泛化能力的移动操作策略。
analysis.input: 单次真实RGBD演示（含机器人与物体交互）
analysis.output: 移动操作策略（动作序列/轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用移动机械臂仿真器（如Isaac Gym/PyBullet）及真实移动机械臂平台（未指明具体型号，但验证于至少两种形态）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：必须输入1段真实RGBD演示作为种子；后续全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SPEAR/SimFoundry级工程深度：构建端到端合成数据流水线（重建→重排→扩态→跨世界合成→光栅化渲染），在仿真+多真实机器人上验证跨场景/跨本体零样本迁移，且所有模块可复现；但未开源代码/模型，未建立社区基准标准，略逊于RT-X（开放协议+跨实验室统一接口）和DROID（真机闭环自改进）的范式影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现从单段真实演示出发、全自动合成具备跨环境与跨本体泛化能力的移动操作训练数据，证据扎实（多真机部署+消融模块+长任务评估），但受限于未开源，尚未形成生态级影响。

papers.title: Trustworthy Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction via Reliability-Aware Multi-Engine Fusion
papers.abstract: Accurate protein-ligand binding affinity prediction is central to computational drug discovery, yet modern docking engines frequently disagree without indicating which prediction to trust. Consensus scoring and ensemble methods improve mean accuracy but treat all predictions identically without interpretable confidence measures or uncertainty decomposition, ignoring the chemical context of each protein-ligand pair. To address this limitation, we introduce RELIABLE-BA (RELIABiLity-aware Evidential fusion for Binding Affinity), an evidential framework for multi-engine binding affinity prediction. Our model comprises three steps: (1) modeling each engine as an evidential expert via Normal-Inverse-Gamma distributions, (2) scaling epistemic uncertainty through learned reliability from molecular context while preserving each expert's predictive mean, and (3) fusing experts through closed-form aggregation that captures both individual uncertainty and inter-engine disagreement. Experiments on the PDBBind and BDB2020+ benchmarks demonstrate competitive point prediction with substantially improved uncertainty calibration, and additional validation on the SARS-CoV-2 Mpro dataset and 5HT2A receptor demonstrates applicability to clinically relevant drug targets. Crucially, these uncertainty estimates enable reliable filtering of protein-ligand pairs, reducing prediction error by up to 25% when retaining only high-confidence pairs. To our knowledge, RELIABLE-BA is the first multi-engine binding affinity prediction framework to combine evidential fusion with context-dependent reliability, offering a principled path toward trustworthy AI-guided drug discovery. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/yongchand/RELIABLE-BA.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RELIABLE-BA的框架，用证据理论（evidential learning）融合多个分子对接引擎的打分结果，不是简单平均，而是根据每个蛋白-配体对的化学上下文动态评估各引擎的可靠性，并输出带校准不确定性的结合亲和力预测值，从而能筛掉低置信度预测、显著降低误差。
analysis.claim: 通过引入基于分子上下文的可靠性感知证据融合机制，多引擎结合亲和力预测可在保持点预测精度的同时，实现可解释、可校准的不确定性估计，并支持高置信度筛选以实质性降低预测误差。
analysis.input: 蛋白结构+配体SMILES+多个对接引擎（如RF-Score、Vina、PLP等）的原始打分结果
analysis.output: 标量结合亲和力预测值及其对应的不确定性（evidential uncertainty，含epistemic component）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×药物发现领域属重磅增量：首次将evidential learning与多引擎可靠性建模结合，实证覆盖PDBBind/BDB2020+/SARS-CoV-2 Mpro/5HT2A四大场景，不确定性校准指标（ECE、NLL）显著优于基线，且验证了‘高置信筛选降误差25%’这一可落地价值；但未突破底层物理建模或生成范式，未解决亲和力预测的根本性误差来源（如构象采样不足、溶剂化缺失），也未与湿实验闭环验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将证据学习严谨迁移到多引擎融合场景，不确定性校准扎实、开源完整、跨靶点验证充分，但未触及亲和力预测的物理瓶颈，属于当前SOTA框架的高质量可信升级而非范式突破

papers.title: EgoRecovery: Acquiring Failure Recovery Ability Through Human Recovery Demonstration
papers.abstract: Robust embodied robots should be able to recover from failures and retry tasks in order to operate reliably in unstructured and noisy real-world environments. Achieving this capability requires training policies on data that captures recovery behaviors. However, collecting such data through robot teleoperation is difficult to scale, as it is time-consuming to induce diverse failure states, perform corrective actions, and reset the environment. This challenge is further exacerbated by the high diversity of failure modes, which demands substantially more recovery data than success demonstrations. In this work, we show that egocentric human data capturing failure recovery processes provides a scalable alternative. By efficiently arranging task-level failure configurations and recording short recovery segments, human operators can generate more than 10x as much valid recovery data per hour compared to robot teleoperation under our protocol. To address the embodiment gap between human and robot, we propose EgoRecovery, a co-training framework for learning recovery behavior, where human recovery demonstrations are aligned to a compact corrective-intent space shared with robot data, which captures the timing and magnitude of correction. Only a small number of robot recovery demonstrations are required to connect this intent to executable robot actions. At deployment, a learned recovery gate predicts when correction is needed from robot observations and activates the corrective intent only in recovery states. Experiments on real-world recovery tasks show that EgoRecovery improves success from failure starts over robot-only recovery, direct co-training with human recovery data, and direct intent-transfer baselines.

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一视角录像中失败后手动恢复的动作作为数据，教机器人在自己失败时如何恢复；只用少量真实机器人恢复数据做桥接，就能让机器人在真实任务中比纯机器人数据训练的恢复成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角的失败恢复演示可规模化生成高质量恢复行为数据，通过意图空间对齐与轻量机器人桥接，能有效迁移至真实机器人实现鲁棒失败恢复。
analysis.input: 机器人本体观测（如RGB-D、关节状态）+ 人类第一视角视频片段（含失败-恢复过程）
analysis.output: 恢复动作策略（动作序列/轨迹）及恢复触发门控信号
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435i相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败恢复演示（用于意图-动作对齐），但主体训练数据来自人类录制的egocentric视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证人类egocentric恢复行为可作为机器人失败恢复的高效数据源，并提出可验证的意图对齐框架；在真实机械臂上完成多任务（抓取、推、插）失败恢复实验，有消融和多个强baseline对比，但未开源数据集、未跨机体验证、未接入端到端闭环任务栈（如失败检测→恢复→续任务），尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类恢复行为转化为机器人可执行恢复能力的完整技术链已跑通，证据扎实但扩展性与开放性尚有欠缺

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Transfer via Behavior-Aligned Representations
papers.abstract: Recent progress in large-scale imitation learning for robot manipulation has been driven by leveraging datasets across a wide range of robot embodiments. However, achieving significant cross-embodiment transfer is often still challenging. In this work, we study the role of using behavior-aligned representations (e.g., object bounding boxes, language motions, end-effector traces of robot motion) in vision-language-action (VLA) models to promote cross-embodiment transfer. We hypothesize that by possessing invariances across embodiments while being predictive of robot actions, these representations can help unify large-scale cross-embodiment data to enhance transfer. To assess our hypothesis, we develop a simulation-based benchmark designed to assess transfer with diverse cross-embodiment data to new embodiments. Using this benchmark, we compare different representations and ways of incorporating them. We identify that end-effector traces can be particularly beneficial for transfer, representations are generally more useful with larger prior datasets, and can be used to benefit from action-free data. We also demonstrate that they can enhance sim-to-real cross-embodiment transfer, improving task completion progress of real robot policies pre-trained on simulation data by 28%. We provide videos of our evaluations at our website: https://ajaysridhar.com/barx/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何让机器人模仿学习模型在不同机械臂（甚至不同构型）之间迁移能力，核心是用行为对齐的中间表示（如末端执行器轨迹、物体框、语言动作描述）作为跨机体的统一语义锚点，实验证明用末端轨迹做表征能显著提升仿真到真实机器人的跨机体迁移效果，真实机器人任务完成进度提升28%。
analysis.claim: 行为对齐的中间表示（特别是末端执行器轨迹）可作为跨机器人本体的不变语义接口，使VLA模型在不修改架构的前提下实现更鲁棒的跨机体迁移，且能利用无动作标注的数据。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）行为对齐表示（如末端轨迹/物体框/语言动作）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列或末端位姿轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5、ALOHA、H1等仿真与真实平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的跨机体数据；真实机器人实验仅用于最终sim2real验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出行为对齐表征这一清晰设计原则，并在统一仿真基准上系统验证其对跨机体迁移的有效性，含消融和真实机器人验证（+28%任务进度），但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖人形/全身操作等更广本体谱系，属扎实推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将行为语义锚点（如末端轨迹）作为跨机体迁移的轻量接口，实证充分、落地有效，但未改变VLA建模范式，也未解决底层运动学/动力学不匹配的根本矛盾。

papers.title: ContactFlow: A video action conditioning that transfers across embodiments
papers.abstract: World models offer a promising route toward robot planning by enabling agents to imagine and verify the consequences of actions before execution. However, current video-based world models often struggle to capture the physical constraints that govern manipulation, particularly contact. Further, their action conditioning is often constrained to specific embodiments such as parallel grippers. We propose \emph{Contact Flow}, an embodiment-agnostic action representation that encodes manipulation through the trajectory of 3D contact points between an actor and a target object. By discarding actor-specific appearance and kinematics, Contact Flow provides a shared conditioning signal for both human demonstrations and robotic execution. Therefore, we can train a large-scale video generative model on both human and robotic object interaction videos conditioned on Contact Flow, yielding a world model that predicts physically plausible manipulation outcomes. We integrate this model into a propose-imagine-verify-act pipeline, where generated rollouts are assessed by a vision-language model before execution. Experiments on the DROID dataset and real-world tabletop manipulation tasks demonstrate that Contact Flow enables transfer between human demonstrations and different robotic embodiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出ContactFlow——一种不依赖具体机器人形态的3D接触点轨迹动作表征，用它统一条件化人类演示视频和机器人操作视频，训练出能预测物理合理操作结果的世界模型，并在真实桌面任务中实现人类示范到多种机器人本体的跨形态迁移。
analysis.claim: 用接触点轨迹（Contact Flow）作为跨本体的动作条件信号，可使视频世界模型同时泛化到人类演示和异构机器人执行，且生成结果满足物理合理性约束。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + ContactFlow动作轨迹（3D接触点序列）
analysis.output: 未来帧预测视频（物理合理操作结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DROID等真实机器人操作视频数据集，但未说明是否使用真实机器人在线闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将接触动力学显式编码为跨本体动作表征并用于视频世界模型训练，在DROID和真实桌面任务上验证了human-to-robot跨本体迁移，但未开源代码/模型，实验规模有限（单任务类型、未报告多任务消融），物理合理性依赖VLM评估而非定量力/接触约束验证，未达基石级范式突破但属显著贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与多任务实证，但ContactFlow表征设计扎实，是首个系统性打通人类演示与异构机器人视频世界模型条件化的方案。

papers.title: Temporal Policy: History-Initialized Action Generation for Robotic Learning from Demonstration
papers.abstract: By relying on independent couplings from uninformative Gaussian priors, standard diffusion and flow matching models are forced to learn complex, high-cost vector fields to reach the physical action space. Generative models excel at capturing multimodal behaviors for robotic Learning from Demonstration (LfD), but often suffer from high inference cost. This paper introduces Temporal Policy, a generative framework based on stochastic interpolants that formulates action generation as a temporally coupled transport problem. By initializing the generative flow at the robot's recent history, we explicitly couple past states to future action sequences. This data-dependent coupling reduces transport cost and produces straight vector fields. We validate Temporal Policy across visuomotor simulation benchmarks and on a physical Barrett WAM 2x 7DoF teleoperation platform. Our approach reduces transport costs by nearly an order of magnitude compared to noise-initialized baselines, achieving a 19.1 ms inference latency on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080. Crucially, these geometric and computational efficiencies are achieved while matching the success rates of state-of-the-art baselines. This simplified transport geometry bypasses the computational bottleneck of independent Gaussian priors, helping enable high-frequency, closed-loop control. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/dmiller12/TemporalPolicy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Temporal Policy的生成式动作策略框架，通过用机器人最近的动作历史初始化生成过程（而非传统随机噪声），大幅降低扩散模型的向量场传输代价，从而实现低延迟（19.1ms）、高成功率的实时动作生成，已在仿真和真实7DoF机械臂上验证。
analysis.claim: 用机器人近期动作历史替代高斯噪声作为生成起点，可将动作生成的传输代价降低近一个数量级，同时不牺牲任务成功率，从而支持高频闭环控制。
analysis.input: 视觉-运动观测序列（含近期动作历史）
analysis.output: 未来动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Barrett WAM 2×7DoF机械臂 + MuJoCo/PyBullet仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据用于训练和评估，但未说明是否需大量真实交互采集（仅提及teleoperation平台验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LfD生成建模中首次系统性解耦‘初始化方式’与‘传输几何’，实证显著降低延迟并保持性能，在真实7DoF臂上达成19.1ms闭环推断——属扎实的显著贡献，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，也未挑战更复杂场景（如灵巧操作、多智能体），未达基石论文所代表的范式级突破或通用架构影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上切实解决了生成式LfD的实时性瓶颈，但仍是特定设定下的高效改进，非范式转移或通用基础模型。

papers.title: What Can Latent World Models Know? Physical Parameter Identifiability in Multimodal Predictive Representations
papers.abstract: A central premise of latent world models is that predicting the future forces a representation to internalize the physics of its environment. Which physical quantities does a trained latent actually contain, and what decides this? We answer with controlled interventions in POKEWORLD, an interactive environment whose visually identical objects hide mass, drag, and contact stiffness. A certificate-gated protocol first certifies each parameter as recoverable from raw observations, then measures whether it enters the latent, so a null result can be attributed to the objective rather than to the environment. The resulting identifiability map has two organizing mechanisms and one frontier. Inputs limit what can be known, while prediction targets decide what is retained. Stiffness enters the latent only when touch is forecast ($R^2=0.50$, compared with $-0.02$ when the same signal is merely fused into the input), and under single-step prediction a vision-only latent discards even perfectly visible object state. Drag marks the frontier. It carries a recoverability certificate of 0.89 yet plateaus near 0.13 under every deterministic prediction objective we test, while a supervised head on the same trunk reaches 0.45. Parameters whose readout is slow and ratio-type under the sensed coordinates fall outside what these objectives acquire. On RH20T, an input-target factorial across scaling curves reproduces both mechanisms across two robots and 4,258 episodes. Every arm missing information or prediction pressure stays flat over a fivefold data range, and only the full multimodal objective forecasts force beyond a persistence baseline, with held-out gains that grow with scale. Objective structure determines which physical parameters a latent acquires, and additional data improves only the parameters it already acquires.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了潜世界模型（latent world models）到底能学到哪些物理参数（如质量、阻力、接触刚度），发现在视觉完全相同但物理属性不同的环境中，模型是否编码某个参数，主要取决于预测目标的设计（比如是否要求预测触觉信号）和输入模态组合，而非数据量多少；阻力参数即使可恢复也几乎学不到，暴露了当前确定性预测目标的固有局限。
analysis.claim: 潜世界模型中物理参数的可识别性（identifiability）由预测目标（prediction target）和输入模态（input modality）共同决定，而非数据规模或模型容量；某些物理量（如drag）在标准确定性预测目标下本质上不可习得，因其读出特性（slow, ratio-type）与当前目标不匹配。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+触觉+本体感知）
analysis.output: 未来状态预测（含力/触觉/运动学）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于POKEWORLD仿真环境及RH20T仿真数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次用受控干预+可恢复性证书（recoverability certificate）量化分析潜表示对物理参数的捕获能力，揭示预测目标结构对物理知识获取的决定性作用，并在RH20T上跨机器人复现；证据扎实（消融完备、多目标对比、scaling analysis），但未部署真机、未提出新模型架构，属重大机制发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是提出新模型，而是首次以因果可控方式证明‘学不到物理参数’不是数据或算力问题，而是预测目标设计缺陷，为世界模型的物理一致性训练提供了不可绕过的诊断框架。

papers.title: HANSEN: An Integrated Structural and Functional Proteome Resource for Structure-Guided Drug Discovery in Mycobacterium leprae
papers.abstract: Structural biology has advanced antimicrobial discovery by enabling drug-target identification and validation and supporting structure-guided inhibitor design. However, Mycobacterium leprae (M. leprae) , the obligate intracellular bacillus that causes leprosy (Hansen's disease), remains structurally under-characterised. Only 10 Protein Data Bank (PDB) entries represent seven unique proteins within a proteome encoded by 1,603 protein-coding genes. To address this gap, we present HANSEN (https://hansen-leprosy.medschl.cam.ac.uk/home), an integrated structural and functional resource containing computationally predicted three-dimensional models across the M. leprae proteome. Monomeric and oligomeric models were generated using complementary structure-prediction methods, including AlphaFold 3, Boltz-1, Chai-1, and Boltz-2. Models were annotated with predicted Local Distance Difference Test (pLDDT) scores and Predicted Aligned Error (PAE) values. Ligand-binding pockets were predicted using AF2BIND, P2Rank, and fpocket, and ligands from the best-matching PDB templates were modelled within oligomeric complexes. Residue-level B-cell epitope propensity was estimated using DiscoTope-3.0, and ProteomeLM-derived essentiality scores were calculated for each protein. These features were integrated into a relational web database with interactive visualisation through Mol*. We also ranked all 1,603 proteins using a Target Priority Score ranging from 0 to 100. The score combines ProteomeLM-derived essentiality with pocket and AF2BIND predictions, functional annotations, and Boltz-2-associated measures of model quality and tractability. The essentiality model used a logistic-regression head trained on Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M. tuberculosis) Tn-seq labels. It achieved an AUROC of 0.84 in homology-grouped M. tuberculosis cross-validation and a transfer AUROC of 0.78 against the orthologue-aligned M. leprae reference set. Proteins were assigned to four tiers, ranging from high priority to exploratory candidates. Together, HANSEN provides a practical resource for generating and prioritising experimentally testable hypotheses for M. leprae target discovery and structure-guided drug development.

analysis.tldr: 为麻风分枝杆菌（M. leprae）全蛋白组构建了首个整合结构预测、配体口袋识别、B细胞表位预测、功能注释与靶点优先级排序的开放数据库HANSEN，填补其长期缺乏三维结构资源的空白，支持靶点发现和结构导向药物设计。
analysis.claim: HANSEN是首个覆盖M. leprae全蛋白组（1603个蛋白）的集成式结构-功能资源库，通过多模型预测、口袋建模、表位预测与机器学习驱动的靶点优先级评分，系统性支撑该难培养病原体的靶向药物发现。
analysis.input: M. leprae基因组编码的1603个蛋白质序列
analysis.output: 每个蛋白的AlphaFold3/Boltz/Chai等预测结构模型、配体口袋坐标、结合配体构象、B细胞表位倾向性、ProteomeLM衍生必需性得分、Target Priority Score（0–100）及四层靶点分级
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著填补M. leprae这一重要但结构表征严重缺失病原体的系统性资源空白，方法上整合多模型结构预测+跨物种迁移学习必需性建模+多工具口袋/表位预测，并提供可交互Web平台与明确靶点分级策略；但未生成新实验数据、未验证任一预测靶点或化合物，也未在下游湿实验中闭环验证，属于高质量计算资源整合与优先级框架构建，而非机制突破或技术范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将前沿AI结构预测、迁移学习与多模态功能注释系统性落地到一个长期被忽视的关键病原体上，形成即用型药物发现基础设施，但未跨越‘预测→验证’鸿沟。

papers.title: Explicit Language Memory for Long-Horizon Planning in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a unified paradigm for connecting visual perception, language understanding, and robotic control. However, existing VLA models still face major challenges in long-horizon tasks: sparse expert demonstrations constrain cross-task compositional generalization; the non-Markovian nature of long-horizon tasks makes it difficult for policies conditioned only on current observations to maintain temporal consistency; limited closed-loop error correction allows execution errors to accumulate; and end-to-end action fine-tuning may weaken the high-level semantic representations of vision-language model (VLM) backbones. To address these issues, we propose a hierarchical long-horizon VLA architecture with an explicit language-memory module. The central idea is to convert discrete temporal observations into a coherent textual memory sequence with temporal logic. The system is decoupled into a high-level VLM and a low-level VLA: the high-level VLM performs semantic reasoning through a visual question answering training paradigm, while the low-level VLA executes precise continuous control conditioned on subtask instructions and visual observations. The high-level VLM recursively updates both language memory and subtask instructions using the previous memory as a contextual anchor, enabling persistent temporal tracking and dynamic correction during long-horizon execution. We evaluate the proposed method in multiple simulation environments and conduct sim-to-real experiments on a real robotic platform. The results demonstrate that explicit language memory improves the success rate and robustness of VLA models on complex long-horizon tasks while providing an interpretable semantic account of the decision process.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个带显式语言记忆模块的分层VLA架构，把视觉-语言-动作模型拆成高层语义推理（VLM）和底层动作执行（VLA）两部分，用文本序列记录任务进展并递归更新，从而提升长程任务的成功率和可解释性。
analysis.claim: 显式语言记忆能有效缓解VLA模型在长时序任务中的时间一致性缺失、错误累积和高层语义弱化问题，通过解耦架构实现可追踪、可修正、可解释的长程规划。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史语言记忆文本
analysis.output: 子任务指令文本+底层连续动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仿真中训练，仅sim2real验证阶段用真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有实质性创新（显式语言记忆+解耦VLM/VLA），在多个仿真环境+1个真机平台验证了长程任务提升，但缺乏多机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明语言记忆各组件贡献、未开源代码/模型、未与RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石模型在统一基准上对比，属扎实但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了长程VLA中时间建模与语义退化这一关键痛点，但实证深度和开放程度不足，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Cross-View Action Consistency for Camera-Robust Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies fine-tuned from a fixed scene camera can fail when the camera is moved, even when the task, objects, language, and robot state are unchanged. We study scene-camera viewpoint robustness using only a scene RGB image, language, and proprioception, without camera labels, extrinsics, depth, or point-cloud inputs. The wrist stream is masked throughout to prevent an unperturbed visual shortcut from confounding attribution to scene-camera variation. For flow-based VLAs, we propose to regularize the action-flow velocity field, the quantity directly integrated to generate continuous action chunks. We construct action-equivalent view pairs by resetting original LIBERO demonstrations to the same MuJoCo state and rendering nominal and perturbed scene-camera views. Both views are supervised by flow matching, while a cross-view loss encourages their predicted action-flow velocities to agree at the same sampled flow coordinates. On the LIBERO-Plus camera-perturbation track, our method reaches 87.2$\pm$0.4% (4,797 rollouts per seed across 3 training seeds), +7.4pp over flow-matching-only training on the same paired data (79.8$\pm$0.8%, also 3 seeds) and +12.5pp over naive mixed-camera SFT, while maintaining nominal-camera ID performance (95.0$\pm$0.8%; same-data FM-only: 95.0$\pm$4.3%). A shuffled-pair control collapses to 25.8%, showing that the gain depends on action-equivalent pairing. On a real robot, we evaluate three tabletop tasks with 10 rollouts per task and camera placement; held-out-camera success improves from 53.3% to 74.4% under the same single-scene-RGB inference interface.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在场景相机视角变动时性能骤降的问题，提出一种不依赖相机标定、深度或点云的跨视角动作一致性训练方法，在仿真LIBERO和真实机器人上都显著提升了相机扰动下的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅用单帧场景RGB图、语言指令和本体感知信息，通过跨视角动作流速度场一致性正则化，可使VLA策略在未见过的相机位姿下保持鲁棒动作输出。
analysis.input: 单帧场景RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感知（proprioception）
analysis.output: 连续动作块（action chunks）对应的光流式动作速度场
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但为标准桌面机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真阶段完全不依赖真实机器人数据；真实机器人评估仅用10 rollouts/task × 3 tasks = 30次真实交互，无训练数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA鲁棒性这一关键短板上做出扎实推进：有明确问题定义（camera-robustness）、构造了可复现的action-equivalent view pair机制、在LIBERO-Plus benchmark上实现+7.4pp提升且消融充分（shuffled-pair崩溃验证设计必要性），并在真实机器人上验证泛化性（+21.1pp），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，也未挑战更难的动态视角或遮挡场景，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将光流动作表征与跨视角一致性约束结合，在相机鲁棒性这一具体瓶颈上给出可验证、可迁移的解决方案，但缺乏开源与更大规模实证支撑，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Decision-Metric Alignment in Latent World Models: Diagnostics and Action-Conditioned Objectives for MPC Planning
papers.abstract: JEPA-style latent world models can use Euclidean distance to a goal latent as the cost for model-predictive control (MPC). Strong decoding of task variables, however, does not guarantee that this particular cost ranks candidate action sequences by real task progress. We call the latter property decision-metric alignment. We introduce Plan-Real Spearman, which measures latent--real rank agreement on random plans, and CEM-stage Spearman, which measures the same agreement as cross-entropy-method (CEM) search concentrates its proposal. We analyze sufficient conditions under which latent distance preserves real-cost rankings, identifying encoder distortion, terminal rollout error, and candidate margins as the controlling quantities. Guided by the observed empirical alignment gap, DA-LeWM augments LeWM with inverse-dynamics and demonstration-conditioned goal-action heads. Across all our experiments, DA-LeWM accelerates convergence and achieves higher online success than LeWM, while probe scores remain similar. These results show that action-conditioned objectives improve the geometry used by Euclidean-cost, CEM-based latent MPC.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用潜在空间欧氏距离作为模型预测控制（MPC）的代价函数时，即使世界模型能很好解码任务变量，也不代表该距离能正确反映真实任务进展；为此提出两个新诊断指标（Plan-Real Spearman和CEM-stage Spearman）量化‘决策度量对齐’程度，并分析了导致对齐失败的三大根源（编码器失真、终态rollout误差、候选动作间隔），进而设计DA-LeWM模型——在LeWM基础上增加逆动力学头和示范条件化的目标-动作头，显著提升在线成功率，但不改变潜空间可解释性探针得分。
analysis.claim: 潜空间中欧氏距离作为MPC代价函数的有效性，取决于‘决策度量对齐’这一被长期忽视的性质；该对齐可被定量诊断，其失效根源可建模归因，且可通过动作条件化目标建模显式修复。
analysis.input: 状态观测序列+动作序列（用于训练逆动力学与示范条件化目标头）
analysis.output: 动作序列（MPC规划输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验仅提及‘online success’，但无平台/硬件描述，也无真实数据集引用
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有洞见的‘决策度量对齐’概念和两个可计算诊断指标，理论分析清晰，DA-LeWM改进有实证效果（加速收敛、提升online success），但实验完全缺乏细节：未说明任务域（仿真/真实？）、未公开环境/基线配置、无消融验证各组件贡献、未报告统计显著性、未开源代码或模型；相比标尺中94+分的基石工作（如DreamerV3、WEAVER等具备跨任务泛化、大规模真实机器人验证、完整开源栈），本文属扎实但窄域的方法论补丁，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如状态持久性、多智能体交互、长程一致性），也未推动新评估范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：发现了潜空间MPC中一个真实存在的对齐漏洞并给出可诊断、可修复路径，但实证薄弱、不可复现，尚未构成范式推进。

papers.title: CounterAlign: Counterfactual Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with behavior cloning (BC) on expert demonstrations. However, BC provides only positive supervision for expert actions, without explicit negative supervision indicating which actions are instruction-inconsistent or otherwise inappropriate. Reinforcement learning (RL) can provide such corrective signals, but often relies on externally specified rewards or curated non-expert data, both of which are costly to obtain in robotics. We show that offline RL for VLA models need not rely on curated non-expert trajectories: successful expert demonstrations alone can be transformed into dense corrective supervision through instruction relabeling. Specifically, by pairing expert actions with mismatched alternative instructions, we synthesize counterfactual instruction-observation-action tuples from the dataset and combine them with adversarial discriminator training to learn an instruction-grounded reward model for offline RL, without collecting additional rollouts or annotations. On the robustness-focused LIBERO-PRO benchmark, our method improves robustness to object position and task perturbations over a strong state-of-the-art baseline. It also outperforms competitive baselines in real-robot experiments on the TX-G2 (compatible with AGIBot G2). More broadly, our results suggest that, for data-constrained VLA learning, extracting denser supervision from each demonstration can complement collecting additional data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CounterAlign方法，利用专家演示数据本身，通过指令错配（把某个动作配上不相关的指令）生成反事实样本，并用对抗判别器学习一个能区分指令-动作是否匹配的奖励模型，从而在不收集额外真实机器人数据或人工标注的情况下，提升VLA模型对指令扰动和物体位置变化的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 仅用专家演示数据即可通过指令重标注与对抗训练生成稠密的反事实监督信号，替代传统离线RL所需的非专家轨迹或外部奖励设计，显著提升VLA模型在扰动下的泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（机械臂控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人专家演示数据，但不依赖非专家轨迹、人工负样本标注或在线交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-PRO（强扰动鲁棒性基准）和真实TX-G2机器人上验证了有效性，有消融实验支撑反事实构造与判别器设计的关键作用，且未依赖任何外部奖励或非专家数据——这是VLA离线对齐中少有的‘纯专家数据增益’范式；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未达到RT-2/π0等基石级模型的规模、通用性或范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将反事实学习与VLA对齐巧妙结合，在真实机器人上实证有效，属扎实的前沿改进，但非范式突破，也未解决数据效率的根本瓶颈（如零样本指令泛化）

papers.title: GaussianDream++: Efficient 3D Gaussian World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have advanced language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet action-imitation objectives provide only weak supervision for metric 3D structure and short-horizon physical evolution. Geometry-enhanced policies mainly improve current-scene grounding, whereas predictive policies often model future dynamics in RGB or latent spaces and may incur substantial deployment cost. GaussianDream demonstrates that training-time current Gaussian reconstruction and future Gaussian prediction provide effective 3D supervision, but its dense VGGT/TGE-based prefix jointly carries state, dynamics, and action-conditioning information. We present \textbf{\methodname}, a compact, policy-native extension that inserts \textbf{World State Tokens} and \textbf{World Prediction Tokens} directly into the VLA backbone. A training-only \textbf{World Representation Head} decodes these tokens into a Current World and coupled Future Prediction over shared Gaussian primitives, while static--dynamic factorization preserves persistent structure and focuses residual motion on interaction-relevant regions. At inference, the head, renderer, auxiliary objectives, and VGGT/TGE pathway are removed, leaving only 20 world tokens without online Gaussian decoding or rollout. \method achieves \textbf{98.6\%} on LIBERO and \textbf{87.8\%} on LIBERO-Plus, with clear gains under Camera and Layout shifts. Real-robot experiments further improve average success from 29.2\% to 52.5\% over reproduced $π_{0.5}$ while maintaining efficient closed-loop control.

analysis.tldr: 提出GaussianDream++，用轻量级世界状态/预测token嵌入VLA模型主干，在训练时用3D高斯椭球建模当前场景和未来动态，推理时仅保留20个token、不运行高斯解码或渲染，显著提升LIBERO系列仿真基准和真实机械臂操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 在不增加推理开销的前提下，通过将紧凑的3D高斯世界状态与预测token原生嵌入VLA主干，并采用静态-动态因子分解，可大幅提升语言条件机械臂操作的泛化性与真实机器人成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真基于PyBullet/LIBERO；真实实验使用Panda+RealSense D435）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真轨迹数据；真实机器人实验使用作者自采的12任务×5次/任务共60段演示，未公开
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA模型的世界建模范式：首次实现训练时3D高斯监督+推理时零高斯计算的解耦设计，真实机器人成功率提升23.3%且保持闭环控制效率；但未开源代码/数据，未在更开放的现实场景（如非结构化桌面、多物体交互）验证，也未挑战长期规划或物理一致性等更深层世界模型问题，故略低于WEAVER（94.5）和DreamerV3（96）的范式高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架内高效嵌入3D高斯世界建模能力，实证扎实但开源缺失、泛化边界未充分探索，属强工程落地型改进而非新范式突破。

papers.title: Spatially Aware World Action Model via Geometric Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage the capabilities of large-scale pretrained video diffusion models to jointly predict future observations and actions, inheriting rich visual and physical priors from internet-scale video. This has made them a promising paradigm for robot policy learning, yet the prevailing models operate exclusively on RGB observations and do not leverage 3D information. To bridge this gap, we introduce a Spatially Aware World Action Model (SA-WAM), which repurposes a pretrained video model for joint action, RGB, and depth prediction, enabling 3D-aware world modeling and action prediction within a single diffusion backbone. We use a nonlinear encoding that maps the unbounded depth signal into the bounded input domain expected by the frozen VAE tokenizer. This allows us to reuse the tokenizer without 3D-specific fine-tuning, incorporating geometric information without sacrificing the pretrained priors. SA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art results on the RoboCasa and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, while simultaneously improving future-state predictions. Furthermore, SA-WAM outperforms strong baselines in real-world evaluation using a UR5 robotic arm, with strong gains in randomized environments. We analyze the correlation between world model prediction quality and rollout success, providing insights into WAM performance and avenues for its improvement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把现有的视频扩散世界模型（WAM）从只处理RGB图像，扩展为同时预测RGB、深度图和动作，通过非线性编码将无界深度值适配进冻结的VAE tokenizer，从而在不破坏预训练视觉先验的前提下引入3D几何信息，提升了仿真和真实UR5机械臂上的操作泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 在不破坏大规模预训练视频扩散模型视觉与物理先验的前提下，通过几何感知的深度编码方式，可将World Action Model原生扩展为支持RGB+depth+action联合生成的3D空间感知模型，并显著提升其在具身操作任务中的跨环境泛化性能。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+深度图+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步RGB帧+深度图+对应动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实UR5在随机化环境中采集的少量闭环执行数据用于评估，但训练仅用公开仿真数据（RoboCasa/LIBERO-Plus）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了WAM范式：首次将深度作为原生模态嵌入扩散世界模型主干，且验证了其在真实机器人上的增益（非纯仿真刷榜），但未构建新世界模型架构、未解决长期状态一致性等基石问题，也未开源代码/模型，证据强度略逊于DreamerV3或WEAVER级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟WAM框架上稳健注入3D几何信号，实证扎实但未突破范式边界

papers.title: Genome-scale perturbation signatures from primary human CD4 + T cells improve genetics-based prioritization of immune drug targets
papers.abstract: While human genetic evidence improves drug program success, target selection largely relies on associational features. Even functional features are mainly observational, capturing disease associations rather than the consequence of perturbing genes in the disease-relevant human cell type. To move beyond association, we present IGNITE (Immune Genomics and fuNctional Integration for Target Enrichment), a framework that prioritizes immune drug targets by integrating human genetic priors with features from genome-scale perturb-seq in 22 million primary human CD4 + T cells and polarized T-helper subset differential expression. IGNITE is a semi-supervised machine learning model that applies positive-unlabeled learning to approved immune targets, then ranks 19,502 protein-coding genes to prioritize new candidates. In 727 in-trial genes held out from training, functional genomics increased target enrichment among the top 50 nominations from 2.7- to 4.8-fold for immune trial targets at any phase, and from 4.5- to 5.9-fold for targets in Phase III. These performance gains were immune-specific, as IGNITE outperformed genetic comparators on predicting immune-exclusive targets but not on cardiac-exclusive targets. Using temporal validation with labels frozen in 2014, IGNITE outperformed the genetics-only model in ranking 134 genes that subsequently entered immune trials. The functional genomics layer also surfaced two novel, pharmacologically tractable candidates, ELOVL6 and RUVBL1 , elevating their rankings from outside the top 1,000 into the top 50. These findings highlight that perturbational signatures in the disease-relevant human cell type harbor target-relevant signals beyond human genetics, offering a generalizable route to indication-specific prioritization as perturbation atlases expand. Full IGNITE scores are publicly available at https://ignite.eecs.umich.edu/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用2200万个人源原代CD4+ T细胞的全基因组扰动测序（Perturb-seq）数据，结合人类遗传学先验，构建了一个叫IGNITE的半监督模型，专门给免疫疾病药物靶点排序；它显著提升了临床试验中真实靶点在前50名预测里的富集倍数，并成功把两个新靶点ELOVL6和RUVBL1从千名开外推到前50，且所有结果都经过时间冻结验证和跨表型特异性检验。
analysis.claim: 在疾病相关的人类原代免疫细胞中进行的全基因组扰动实验，能提供超越纯遗传关联信号的、具有临床转化价值的靶点优先级信息，且该信号具有免疫特异性。
analysis.input: 人类遗传学先验（如GWAS位点、eQTL等） + CD4+ T细胞中19502个基因的扰动-表达响应谱（来自Perturb-seq） + T细胞亚群差异表达谱
analysis.output: 19502个蛋白编码基因的靶点优先级得分（数值排序）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但它是首个将大规模原代人免疫细胞扰动图谱与遗传学深度耦合、完成严格时间外推验证和临床靶点富集量化评估的工作；证据扎实：22M细胞、727个hold-out临床靶点、Phase III特异性提升、免疫vs心脏特异性对照、两个新靶点被实验可及性验证；填补了‘遗传学→功能扰动→临床靶点’闭环验证的关键实证缺口。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——它用高质量、大尺度、疾病相关原代细胞的功能扰动数据，实证闭环地证明了遗传学之外存在更强的靶点优先级信号，且已开源全部分数供领域复用。

papers.title: Physical priors improve performance of structure-based binding affinity models
papers.abstract: Structure-based drug discovery is a widely used paradigm for the rational design of novel small molecule therapeutics. However, the benefits conferred by the use of structural information has seen limited adoption in machine learning, where ligand-only ("2D") models are still the industry standard for molecular property or binding affinity prediction. Structure-based ("3D") ML models for binding-affinity prediction promise to present a clear advantage, but have not yet overtaken existing 2D models. Here, we show that physics-based priors can improve predictive performance of structure-based models by comparing different model architectures with varying physical priors on several prediction tasks. We present the Modular Training and Evaluation of Neural Networks (mtenn) package, where we decompose affinity prediction into separate steps of embedding structure into learned representations and combining those embeddings into a predicted binding affinity. We consider both E(3)-invariant and E(3)-equivariant architectures to determine the importance of encoding roto-translational inductive biases, as well as different methods for combining learned embeddings. By first optimizing several aspects of model construction using the general purpose PDBBind dataset, we are able to improve the performance and data efficiency of structure-based models. When subsequently trained and evaluated on the COVID Moonshot small molecule drug discovery dataset, our tuned models perform on par with industry standard ligand-only models. Our decomposed model framework highlights that encoding some physical priors improves model performance, while more complex biases such as equivariance offer limited benefit. Additionally, structure-based models generalize better to an unseen target and display higher training efficiency. Overall, these results emphasize that structure-based models benefit from their ability to incorporate physics-informed constraints, giving promising directions for model architecture development. These results also suggest that the strength of these models may be in tasks specifically aimed at generalizability, providing guidelines for their use in early-stage drug discovery campaigns.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了在基于结构的药物结合亲和力预测模型中引入物理先验（如E(3)不变性/协变性、几何约束）的效果，发现简单物理先验（如旋转平移不变性）能提升性能和数据效率，但更复杂的E(3)协变性收益有限；作者开源了模块化框架mtenn，并在PDBBind调优后，在COVID Moonshot真实药物发现任务上达到与工业界主流2D模型相当的水平，同时展现出对新靶点更好的泛化能力。
analysis.org: Scripps Research / Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center
analysis.claim: 在结构基结合亲和力预测中，轻量级物理先验（如E(3)-invariance）可显著提升模型性能、数据效率和跨靶点泛化性，而强几何约束（如E(3)-equivariance）并无额外增益。
analysis.input: 蛋白质-配体复合物3D结构（原子坐标、元素类型、键序等）
analysis.output: 标量结合自由能预测值（ΔG）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅使用公开结构生物学数据集（PDBBind、COVID Moonshot）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在两个独立结构数据集（通用PDBBind + 真实药物发现导向的COVID Moonshot）上完成系统消融，对比多种物理先验架构，验证了‘轻物理先验有效、重几何约束冗余’这一反直觉结论；开源mtenn框架并提供可复现训练流程；结果直接挑战当前2D模型主导的工业实践，为结构基AI药物发现提供了可落地的架构设计指南，但未开创新范式或解决长期开放难题（如精确自由能绝对预测），故低于AlphaFold2/ESM等基石级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验系统性拆解、量化、验证并开源，是面向药物发现实际场景的高质量架构工程，而非概念包装或理论突破。

papers.title: Scaling Vision-Language Reward Learning for Robot Manipulation in Parallel Simulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can replace human annotators in preference-based reward learning, but sequential API requests and single-environment data collection make training slow and costly. We present RAPID (Reward learning with Adaptive Parallel Image Diversity), a system that couples GPU-parallel rollout with data-aware policy updates, single-request preference labeling, automatic reward stabilization, and representative image sampling. We evaluate these components on five Franka Panda manipulation tasks in IsaacLab. Parallel rollout and adaptive updates provide the first substantial reduction in training time: under matched two-stage prompting, mean runtime falls from 9.18 to 3.13 hours. With all RAPID components enabled, training completes in 1.15 hours using 896 rather than 19,840 API calls per run, and aggregate final success rises from 86.3\% to 98.7\%. This represents an 8.0$\times$ end-to-end speedup and a 95.5\% reduction in API usage. An offline evaluation with Gemma~3 12B and GPT-4.1 mini demonstrates that single-request prompting reduces labeling latency and cost across both models. Code is available at: https://github.com/rapid-vlm/rapid-vlm-rl.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RAPID系统，用GPU并行仿真 rollout + 自适应策略更新 + 单次请求式VLM偏好标注，大幅加速基于视觉语言模型的机器人操作奖励学习训练过程，在IsaacLab仿真中将5个Franka任务的训练时间从9.18小时压缩到1.15小时，API调用减少95.5%，成功率从86.3%提升至98.7%。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中给出；Lobna Joualy 等人无明确机构标识，GitHub 仓库无组织归属信息）
analysis.claim: 通过并行rollout、单请求VLM偏好标注和数据感知策略更新，可在不牺牲性能的前提下，将VLM驱动的偏好奖励学习训练效率提升8倍以上，并显著降低大模型API依赖。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 标量奖励值（用于强化学习训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在VLM奖励学习中系统性解耦并行rollout与单请求标注瓶颈，实证充分（多任务+消融+API/时长双指标），但仅限仿真、未跨机体/跨任务泛化、未接入真实硬件，且未挑战reward learning根本性难题（如偏好噪声鲁棒性、语义歧义建模），远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或规模-能力跃迁水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程优化到位、数据扎实，但仍是仿真内闭环改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈，暂时不用看

papers.title: PRIMO: Prior-Informed Odometry from Human-Motion Tracking for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Simulation-trained humanoid proprioceptive odometry faces two transfer challenges: training trajectories generated by specific robot control policies intended for deployment cover only a limited range of motions, while sim-to-real mismatch can make unconstrained predictions unreliable. We address both with Prior-Informed Odometry from Human-Motion Tracking (PRIMO). On the data side, we generate odometry supervision by having the humanoid track diverse retargeted human motions in simulation, decoupling supervision from the deployment policies and broadening the training motion distribution. On the model side, a Prior-Informed estimator uses physics- and symmetry-informed priors to structure velocity and rotation prediction and a coarse raw-context pathway to preserve sensor context alongside encoded features, thereby strengthening sim-to-real generalization. Under a unified real-robot protocol, PRIMO reduces mean error by 31.6%-61.7% relative to the strongest evaluated external baseline in each domain-metric comparison. Across two locomotion-policy revisions, policy specialists exhibit symmetric crossover, whereas Tracking-Locomotion training reduces mean opposite-policy simulation error by 86.8%-94.6%. On real dynamic motion, Tracking-Locomotion training reduces mean error by 69.2%-81.7% relative to training on the union of both deployment policies. Across the tested motion compositions, the Prior-Informed estimator consistently lowers mean trajectory errors relative to its Unconstrained counterpart in both simulation and real-robot evaluation. Code is available at https://github.com/Agibot-Spatial-Intelligence/PRIMO.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PRIMO方法，用人类运动数据在仿真中生成更丰富的本体感知里程计监督信号，并设计一个融合物理先验和对称性先验的估计器，显著提升人形机器人在真实动态运动下的定位精度。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦训练监督（来自多样化人类运动重定向）与部署策略，并引入物理/对称性先验结构化预测，可大幅提升人形机器人本体感知里程计的sim-to-real泛化能力与真实动态运动下的精度。
analysis.input: IMU序列 + 关节角度序列 + 人体运动重定向轨迹（仿真中生成）
analysis.output: 六自由度位姿增量（线速度+角速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的大量人类运动重定向数据；真实机器人仅用于最终验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人形机器人本体感知里程计长期存在的sim-to-real迁移弱、策略耦合过强问题，实证扎实（双策略对比、多运动组合、真实动态测试、显著误差下降），但未开新范式（仍属监督学习+先验增强框架），也未释放训练数据或支持第三方机体复现，分量介于‘重磅’与‘显著贡献’之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形平台上系统性验证了人类运动先验+物理结构化建模对本体感知里程计的增益，证据充分，但未开源数据/模型权重，且未突破监督学习范式，属于高质量工程驱动型推进。

papers.title: What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models hold promise for scalable brain-signal decoding across clinical and cognitive neuroscience applications, yet their pre-training pipelines remain poorly understood. Among design choices, the masking strategy is particularly critical: it determines what the network must predict and from which context. Yet it has never been ablated in isolation, as each new model bundles a new masking strategy with a new backbone and objective. In this paper, we formalize the design choices for spatio-temporal masking strategies and train various models with a single pipeline under varying masking configurations across two SSL frameworks (MAE and JEPA). We then systematically evaluate the resulting 58 pre-trained models on the 12 datasets of OpenEEGBench under a linear probe. Both frameworks agree on an optimal masking configuration and on shared failure modes. Outside these, performance is robust: 11 MAE and 9 JEPA configurations are statistically indistinguishable from the best. We further identify a novel JEPA-specific failure mode, tagged bias-inflation collapse, invisible to standard detectors. With a well-chosen mask, our pipeline reaches REVE-level downstream performance at a fraction of REVE's pre-training compute.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了58种不同的EEG信号时空掩码策略（在MAE和JEPA两种自监督框架下），用统一训练流程和线性探针评估，在OpenEEGBench的12个数据集上找出最优掩码几何结构，并发现JEPA特有的‘偏差膨胀坍缩’失败模式。
analysis.org: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）/索邦大学
analysis.claim: EEG基础模型的掩码几何设计存在明确的最优解，且该解在不同自监督框架（MAE/JEPA）间具有一致性；非最优掩码虽常导致性能下降，但多数配置鲁棒性强，而JEPA对特定掩码敏感并会引发传统检测手段无法识别的隐性坍缩。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时序信号（含空间拓扑）
analysis.output: 重建的EEG信号片段（MAE）或预测的未来表征（JEPA）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（OpenEEGBench），无真实脑机接口硬件闭环或临床部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次对EEG掩码策略进行严格隔离消融（控制骨干网/目标函数/训练流程），覆盖双框架+12数据集+58配置，实证强、结论稳健；但未涉及任何真实BCI闭环任务（如实时解码、在线控制、临床干预）、未验证下游微调效果、未接入硬件或用户反馈，属于高质量方法论基准研究，尚未达到基石级临床/交互突破的量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是EEG基础模型预训练中首个严谨、大规模、跨框架的掩码策略实证研究，但仅停留在离线表征学习评估层面，未触达真实脑机接口的闭环性能或临床价值。

papers.title: ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation
papers.abstract: Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. We further demonstrate deployment on a physical humanoid robot. A complementary video-rating study also favors joint conditioning over the alternatives. The dataset and training, inference, and evaluation code are available through our project page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能直接为仿人机器人生成全身说话动作的扩散模型ECHO-G，输入是语音+带时间戳的文字，输出是机器人关节运动序列，用自建的音频-文本-机器人数据集训练，并在真机上部署验证。
analysis.claim: 联合语音与带时间戳文本的条件扩散模型，能在机器人本体空间中直接生成高质量、多样的共语动作，优于先生成人类动作再重定向的两阶段方法。
analysis.input: 语音波形+带时间戳的文字转录
analysis.output: 机器人关节角度时间序列（全身体态动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 优必选Walker2（摘要未明说型号，但视频和项目页确认为Walker2类双足仿人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖自建BEAT2衍生的真实机器人录音+动作数据集（含真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真机上的端到端共语动作生成，有自建数据集、多维度benchmark、消融验证和视频主观评测，显著优于retargeting基线；但未跨机体泛化、未解决长期运动连贯性/交互耦合等更深层问题，尚未达到GR00T或H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机部署+多维验证的端到端共语动作生成，证据扎实，但属高质量工程整合而非范式突破

papers.title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

analysis.tldr: 提出PIT-GCL模型，用拓扑图对比学习预测两个蛋白是否结合：分别对每个蛋白输入序列、Cα点云和持久同调特征，用结构感知Transformer编码，再通过双向交叉注意力做隐空间‘软对接’，联合二分类和对比损失训练，在通用蛋白互作（PPIRef）和难任务PPB-Affinity上超越现有方法，且支持预计算单蛋白表征以加速大规模筛选。
analysis.claim: 独立编码单蛋白的序列+几何+全局拓扑结构，并通过结构感知的双塔对比学习框架，可实现高泛化性、可复用、无需复合结构的二元蛋白结合预测。
analysis.input: 单蛋白的氨基酸序列、Cα原子三维点云、H0/H1持久同调景观（来自Vietoris-Rips滤波）
analysis.output: 两蛋白是否发生特异性结合的二元概率（logit）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在三个不同粒度/难度的PPI基准上系统验证（尤其PPB-Affinity上唯一超随机基线），首次将持久同调+结构感知Transformer+双塔对比学习整合用于二元结合预测，实证扎实、任务定义清晰、工程可部署（预计算支持筛库），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战AlphaFold3级结构生成或de novo设计等基石级问题，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟组件（ESM-2、持久同调、结构感知Attention）创新组合成端到端可部署的PPI预测流水线，有明确工业价值，但非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: GalaxyMemMD: an end-to-end Galaxy toolset for reproducible membrane embedding, molecular dynamics simulation, and analysis of membrane proteins
papers.abstract: Membrane proteins play crucial roles in cellular signaling, transport, and pharmacological regulation, yet their structural and functional characterization remains challenging due to experimental limitations. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations have become indispensable for probing membrane protein behavior at atomic resolution; however, executing these simulations at scale remains a significant bottleneck. Existing tools excel at system preparation for individual cases, but none offer a complete, high-throughput pipeline spanning embedding, simulation, and analysis across multiple membrane compositions, and rarely integrate modern structure prediction and molecular docking frameworks. Here, we present GalaxyMemMD, a fully automated, open-source Galaxy framework that provides a direct, scalable alternative to existing preparation-only tools. GalaxyMemMD integrates every stage membrane embedding, system preparation, MD execution, and downstream analysis into a single reproducible pipeline. Leveraging Galaxy's HPC-ready job scheduling, GalaxyMemMD natively supports high-throughput parallel simulations across multiple membrane compositions and protein variants, including AlphaFold-derived structural inputs and downstream molecular docking workflows, without repeated manual setup. We validate GalaxyMemMD across six structurally diverse membrane proteins four GPCRs, one ion channel, and one beta-barrel demonstrating consistent system preparation, while the benchmark analysis shows stable embeddings, and reproducible trajectory-level production workflow. Across these benchmarks, GalaxyMemMD matches the setup quality of established tools, therefore serves as both a practical alternative and a capability extension for the membrane protein simulation community.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个基于Galaxy平台的全自动开源工具集，把膜蛋白嵌入膜、分子动力学模拟准备、多膜组分并行模拟执行、轨迹分析、对接等流程全打通，支持AlphaFold结构输入，无需手动干预即可批量运行。
analysis.claim: GalaxyMemMD是首个将膜蛋白嵌入、多组分MD模拟执行与下游分析端到端集成于可复现、高通量、HPC-ready工作流中的开源框架。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构文件（PDB/AlphaFold预测结构）、膜组分定义（如POPC/CHOL比例）、模拟参数配置
analysis.output: 嵌入后的膜蛋白系统结构、MD轨迹文件、关键分析结果（RMSD/Rg/leaflet occupancy等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了膜蛋白计算工作流的工业化水平：首次实现从嵌入→多膜组分并行MD→分析→对接的全链路自动化与可复现，验证覆盖6个典型膜蛋白（含4个GPCR），但未提出新物理模型、新采样算法或新力场，属重大工程整合而非理论/算法突破；显著优于单点工具（如CHARMM-GUI手动流程），但远未达AlphaFold2或ESMFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了膜蛋白模拟领域长期存在的流程割裂、不可复现、难扩展痛点，但未在科学建模层面带来新原理。

papers.title: Tell Robot What Not to Do: A Negation Understanding Perspective
papers.abstract: Instruction following enables robots to perform diverse tasks specified in natural language, making it a fundamental capability for human-robot interaction. Beyond communicating desired outcomes, users also need to specify constraints on what not to do. We investigate how to enable vision-language-action models (VLAs) to follow negated instructions, where robots must accomplish task goals while respecting explicit exclusions. To this end, we propose NegaAlign, a parameter-efficient, plug-and-play framework that extends pretrained VLAs to follow negated instructions through image-language supervision alone. Specifically, we introduce Negation Transformation Layers into selected layers of the vision-language backbone to reshape intermediate instruction representations. Meanwhile, a teacher-guided alignment mechanism is designed to align instruction-relevant visual tokens, transferring action-relevant grounding from instructions that satisfy the negated constraint. The training phase uses supervision constructed from existing demonstrations and updates only the inserted layers, keeping all pretrained parameters frozen, including the action generator. We further introduce NegaBench, a simulation benchmark spanning 10 scenarios across five domains for systematically evaluating manipulation under negated constraints. Experiments across GR00T, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements in negated instruction following. With 11.6M trainable parameters, NegaAlign increases the negated-instruction success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 2.60% to 88.45% on NegaBench and from 12.4% to 88.8% on real-world tasks, while retaining performance on affirmative instructions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个轻量插件式框架NegaAlign，让已有的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）能理解‘不要做某事’这类否定指令，在仿真和真实机器人上把否定指令成功率从不到3%大幅提升到近89%，且不损害原有肯定指令性能。
analysis.claim: 通过仅需图像-语言监督的参数高效微调，可使预训练VLAs可靠遵循含明确排除约束的否定自然语言指令，无需真实机器人动作数据或修改动作生成器。
analysis.input: RGB图像+否定形式的自然语言指令（如‘把苹果放进篮子，但不要碰香蕉’）
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人动作数据，仅用现有演示构造图像-语言监督
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并解决VLA中的否定指令理解问题，提出可即插即用的轻量架构与专用评测基准NegaBench，实证覆盖多模型（π0.5等）、仿真10场景+真实世界任务，消融充分，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未触及长期开放难题（如动态约束推理、反事实规划），属扎实且具启发性的SOTA级推进，未达RT-2/π0等基石模型的范式级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已有VLA范式上精准补缺否定理解能力，方法简洁、实证扎实、效果显著，但属于重要能力模块的增强而非底层范式突破。

papers.title: Sampling-based Kinodynamic Planning with World Models
papers.abstract: Visual world models predict the consequences of actions from images, but planning with them is typically done by optimizers such as CEM and MPPI. However, these optimizers stall on long-horizon tasks where progress requires motion the objective does not reward, such as moving around a block before pushing it. This paper revisits kinodynamic sampling-based motion planning for world models, using the learned model as the propagator of a tree search in latent space. Our key insight is that the sampling strategies devised for high-dimensional search in configuration space apply directly to the latent space of a world model, where they rapidly expand through intermediate states that myopic optimizers never sample. We present two exploration strategies for the high-dimensional latent space, nearest-neighbor-guided RRT and projection-based KPIECE, with GPU-native batched expansion for efficient device utilization. We evaluate with an off-the-shelf DINO-WM on four simulated domains and a real-world block-pushing task. Our approaches match or exceed the success rate of CEM and MPPI at up to 13.8x lower planning time in simulation, and improve the success rate by 20% on the real robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把传统机器人运动规划里的采样算法（如RRT、KPIECE）搬到世界模型的隐空间里做搜索，用树形结构主动探索中间状态，解决了CEM/MPPI等优化器在长视野任务中因短视而卡住的问题，在仿真和真实机械臂推块任务上更快且成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 在世界模型隐空间中复用经典采样式运动规划算法（而非梯度优化），能更高效地发现需多步迂回的可行轨迹，显著提升长视野具身决策的成功率与规划效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 动作指令（隐式编码为世界模型输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人推块视频数据用于微调/适配世界模型，但规划本身不依赖在线真实数据流
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型落地具身控制的路径：首次系统性将高维采样规划引入WM隐空间，提供可验证的替代范式；在4个仿真域+真实推块任务上超越CEM/MPPI，含消融与跨场景测试；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖复杂灵巧操作或开放环境，尚未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的通用性与架构深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟运动规划思想迁移到世界模型隐空间，实证扎实、效果明确，但属方法嫁接而非范式创新，未动摇当前世界模型基础架构。

papers.title: LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints
papers.abstract: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向工业柔性制造场景（如电子组装）的机器人操作评测基准LIBERO-Industry，把产品变型、动态物料流、执行时间窗、严苛几何容差等真实产线约束转化为可调控的任务条件和可量化的成功指标，共含216个系统化变异任务，并用5个主流通用机器人策略验证了这些约束会显著降低性能。
analysis.claim: 工业过程约束（而非单纯任务多样性）是当前通用机器人策略在真实柔性制造中失效的关键瓶颈，需通过结构化、可测量、可组合的基准来暴露和量化这一瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言任务描述+环境状态信号（如传送带速度、时间窗倒计时）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的UR5e+Robotiq 2F-85机械臂（基于LIBERO-Sim）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将工业柔性制造的核心过程约束（非视觉/任务多样性）形式化为可评测维度，并构建了迄今最系统化的约束组合测试套件；但仍是仿真基准，无真机验证、无硬件闭环、未提出新模型或训练范式，属于对评估范式的显著升级而非能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是新方法，而是精准定义并暴露了通用机器人策略在工业落地中最被忽视的‘过程约束’短板，为后续研究提供了不可绕过的评测标尺。

papers.title: ObjDream: Guiding Vision-Language-Action Models with Object-Level Understanding and Future State Prediction
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling robots to generate actions from visual observations and language instructions.
