papers.title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EmbodiedRSI的自主进化式机器人代理框架，通过维护多个代码与技能假设、用信息价值驱动真实机器人实验、再根据实验结果协同更新代码和技能，并构建分层记忆系统来提升后续决策，最终在仿真基准和真实机器人上都大幅超越基线。
analysis.claim: 机器人代理可通过假设驱动的物理实验选择与代码-技能协同进化，在不依赖大量人工标注或预收集真实数据的前提下，实现持续自主提升并泛化至未见任务和真实机器人。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+任务指令+当前代码/技能状态
analysis.output: 改进后的代码模块+技能策略+记忆条目
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂（RoboCasa365/LIBERO-Pro仿真）+真实Franka（零样本迁移）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于假设验证，但不依赖大规模预收集数据；核心训练在仿真中完成，真实数据仅用于零样本评估和部分Co-Evolution反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了仿真到真实机器人的零样本迁移且在多任务复合场景（Composite-Unseen）上达71.3%成功率，远超基线（40.1%），具备扎实的真机验证、跨任务泛化、消融支撑（Hypothesis Graph/VoI/Co-Evolution三模块缺一不可），但未开新范式（仍属agentic harness演进），也未解决如全身协调、长时程规划等基石级难题，故略低于94+档位但显著强于普通SOTA工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将假设检验、代码-技能联合优化、分层记忆与sim2real零样本迁移深度耦合，实证充分，但未突破基础建模范式

papers.title: Beyond Kinematic Tracking: Preserving Expressive Characteristics in Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract: Whole-body control plays a crucial role in enabling humanoid robots to execute expressive motions. Faithful execution requires preserving both the intended action and its expressive characteristics. Existing whole-body trackers typically balance joint and keypoint tracking with physical stability across diverse motions, but these objectives do not necessarily prioritize the expressive characteristics of each action. Our analysis shows that lower average positional tracking error does not guarantee better preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics. To address this gap, we propose a residual learning framework with compensation objectives targeting amplitude, energy, body expansion, body lean, and pelvis height. To concentrate compensation while limiting interference with the underlying tracking behavior, motion-aware gating allocates correction capacity according to body-part activity, preserving larger correction ranges in more active parts and restricting them elsewhere. For each frozen tracker, we train motion-specific residual policies and distill them into a unified policy shared across motion categories. Simulation and physical experiments on the Unitree G1 across eight motion categories demonstrate superior preservation of dynamic and postural motion characteristics compared with the corresponding baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人形机器人全身控制中动作‘表现力’（如幅度、能量感、身体舒展度、倾斜姿态等）常被传统运动跟踪忽略的问题，提出一个残差学习框架，在冻结现有跟踪器基础上，用运动感知门控机制动态分配修正量，并为不同动作类别训练专用残差策略后蒸馏成统一策略，最终在Unitree G1机器人上验证了对8类表现性动作的动态与姿态特征保留效果优于基线。
analysis.claim: 通过运动感知的残差补偿框架，可在不修改底层全身跟踪器的前提下，显著提升人形机器人对人类动作中表达性特征（非纯运动学轨迹）的保真还原能力。
analysis.input: 参考动作序列（含关键点/关节轨迹）+ 当前机器人状态
analysis.output: 残差关节力矩/速度修正量（用于叠加到基础控制器输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实G1机器人执行8类动作的闭环反馈数据用于残差策略训练与蒸馏
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实G1上跨8类表现性动作验证，含消融（门控机制、残差结构、蒸馏设计）、多基线对比（非仅仿真），且问题定义清晰（首次将‘expressive characteristics’形式化为可优化的5维物理语义指标）；但未开新范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本泛化、跨机体通用WBC），分量略低于H2O/GR00T N1级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形平台上系统性解决了表现力保真这一长期被忽略的控制细节问题，方法务实、验证充分，但未突破全身控制的基础架构或泛化边界。

papers.title: Same Weights, Different Robot: A Deployment Safety View of VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are often treated as checkpoint-defined objects: if the weights, prompt, and benchmark suite match, the deployment is assumed to be the same policy. Robot execution breaks this assumption because the same normalized model output can become a different physical action after action unnormalization and controller conventions are applied. This creates a deployment-safety gap: safety review can certify the checkpoint while missing the executable robot policy that reaches the controller. We formalize this gap as an executable policy specification problem: a VLA policy includes the learned model, action representation, metadata-selected unnormalizer, and controller-facing conventions. Under this view, identical checkpoints can be executable-inequivalent. For quantile-style action normalization, we derive a closed-form metadata mismatch transform and an ExecSpec certificate that measures action-space semantic drift without model inference or rollout. On LIBERO-Goal replay, substituting a plausible sibling metadata key yields mean drift 0.199 over six non-gripper action dimensions and reduces success from 28/28 to 2/28 under full substitution. On LIBERO-Spatial replay, the same substituted key reduces success from 26/26 to 0/26. The same full-substitution protocol gives 0/28 success for all four Object substitutions and 0/23 or 1/23 success on Long. Identity-key, replay-validity, no-op filtering, raw-vs-correct replay, mask/gripper, synthetic upper-bound, and OpenVLA-style unnormalizer interface checks rule out several simpler explanations. These results do not certify closed-loop or hardware safety. They support a narrower deployment-safety view: action-space metadata is part of the executable policy and should be checked before rollout.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，同一个VLA模型权重在不同机器人上部署时，因动作解归一化方式和控制器约定不同，实际执行的动作可能完全不同，从而产生安全隐患；作者把‘可执行策略’明确定义为包含模型、动作表示、元数据选择的解归一化器和控制器接口四部分，并提出一种无需运行模型就能检测动作空间语义漂移的证书（ExecSpec）。
analysis.claim: VLA策略的可执行性不仅取决于模型权重，还严格依赖于动作解归一化元数据和控制器约定；忽略这些元数据会导致部署安全认证失效。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+动作元数据（如quantile normalization key）
analysis.output: 动作空间语义漂移度量值（ExecSpec证书）及可执行策略等价性判断
analysis.robot_dependency: 依赖具体机器人控制器与动作解归一化实现（如LIBERO仿真环境中的Franka/UR5控制器约定）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO-Goal/Spatial replay轨迹重放
analysis.significance_reason: 首次形式化定义VLA‘可执行策略’并量化动作元数据漂移对任务成功率的毁灭性影响（28→2/28），证据扎实（多场景、多消融、排除替代解释），但限于仿真重放、无真机验证、未提供开源代码或模型，未触及闭环控制或硬件安全，故略低于RT-2/π0/Octo等里程碑级工作，但显著高于一般增量研究，属重磅部署安全警示。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是提出新模型，而是首次以可证伪方式揭露VLA部署中被长期忽视的元数据依赖漏洞，并给出可计算、免rollout的检测工具，改变了‘checkpoint即策略’的安全假设。

papers.title: AF_Cache: Efficient Pipeline for Running AlphaFold for High-Throughput Protein-Protein Interaction Prediction
papers.abstract: Motivation: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions is essential for understanding biological processes, and recent advances such as AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 have enabled structure-based interaction prediction at unprecedented accuracy. However, the high computational cost of these methods, driven primarily by CPU-based repeated multiple sequence alignment (MSA) generation and, for AlphaFold2, repeated model recompilations, limits their applicability in large-scale, high-throughput settings. This creates a need for efficient pipelines that retain predictive performance while substantially reducing runtime. Results: We present AF_Cache, a high-throughput Nextflow pipeline for accelerating protein-protein interaction prediction using AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3. AF_Cache combines GPU-accelerated MSA generation with MMseqs2, feature caching to eliminate redundant alignment computations, and sequence length bucketing to minimise repeated JAX compilations. Benchmarking on a dataset of 5,050 human mitochondrial protein pairs demonstrates a $\sim$2-fold reduction in inference time for AlphaFold2 and up to a 13-fold speedup of the MSA generation. AF\_Cache enables efficient large-scale interaction screening and provides a practical framework for deploying AlphaFold-based methods in high-throughput applications. Availability and implementation: The code and Nextflow pipeline are available on GitHub here: https://github.com/clami66/AF_cache. The code for reproducing the results of the paper, the MSAs, and the predicted models can be found at Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20478892

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AF_Cache，一个用Nextflow编排的加速流水线，通过GPU版MMseqs2生成MSA、缓存特征避免重复计算、按序列长度分桶减少JAX重复编译，显著加快AlphaFold2/3预测蛋白互作结构的速度，尤其在大规模场景下。
analysis.claim: AF_Cache通过三项工程优化（GPU-MSA、特征缓存、长度分桶），在不损失AlphaFold预测精度的前提下，将高通量蛋白互作预测的端到端耗时降低2倍（AlphaFold2）或MSA阶段提速13倍。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 预测的复合物三维结构（PDB格式）及置信度指标（pLDDT/pTM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白序列和已知互作对（如MitoCarta）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合：实证扎实（5050对真实线粒体蛋白、多阶段计时拆解、开源全部代码/MSA/模型），但未改进AlphaFold底层模型、未提出新科学假设、未解决结构预测本身的根本瓶颈（如长程相互作用建模、动态构象采样），仅优化其部署效率——对标基石如AlphaFold2（98）、AlphaFold3（93），它属于重要但非范式级的实用化推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实证充分、开源完整、加速效果明确，但未触及蛋白结构预测或互作机制的核心科学问题，是面向生产落地的关键工具升级，而非理论或方法论突破。

papers.title: Pretrained, Frozen, Still Leaking: Auditing Cross-Encoder Attribute Transfer in EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation-model releases are usually audited one endpoint at a time: raw-reconstruction, membership inference, identity linkage, or DP-SGD on the downstream head. We audit the same released embeddings under all four endpoints jointly, on BIOT, LaBraM, and EEGPT, and show that each single-endpoint audit clears releases that still leak spectral attributes. The decisive evidence is a cross-encoder transfer audit: a single ridge attribute decoder learned from one frozen encoder transfers, via a fitted linear bridge, to held-out-subject test splits of every other encoder, with subject-disjoint matched-control 95% CI lower bound at least 0.081 across all six BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT directions. We prove a sufficient condition: two encoders sharing a nontrivial attribute-coordinate projector overlap beta admit a chained ridge bridge attacker with centered-gain lower bound sqrt(beta/(1+tau^2)) - eps_br - rho_0, and back-solve beta in [0.008, 0.198]. To turn the joint audit into a deployment-readable decision rule we introduce an audit-endpoint disagreement score (AEDS), prove sufficient conditions for its positivity, and bootstrap-calibrate it per cell; AEDS is positive in all eight matched-CI cells (BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT on EEGMMI; LaBraM on Sleep-EDF, 54-channel LIMO, CHB-MIT pediatric scalp EEG) with p<0.001, while a head-level Carlini LiRA membership audit reaches AUC only 0.50-0.70. Standard defenses fail under audit: a Wiener-style noise-aware adaptive attacker, the LiRA audit, and DP-SGD at every utility-preserving epsilon in {4,8} leave the attribute channel essentially unchanged. The contribution is an audit framework that turns scattered single-endpoint defenses into a joint release decision, supported by a cross-encoder bridge theorem and adaptive-attacker, LiRA, and DP-SGD baselines; the audit licenses release-blocking, not raw-waveform exfiltration or held-out-subject identity recovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地揭露了当前主流EEG基础模型（BIOT、LaBraM、EEGPT）在冻结编码器状态下仍会跨模型泄露被试的频谱属性（如个体脑电特征），提出一种新型‘跨编码器迁移审计’方法，用线性桥接器在不同模型嵌入间传递属性解码器，并证明其统计显著性；它不追求提升解码性能，而是构建一套可部署的联合审计框架，用于判断EEG模型是否应被禁止发布。
analysis.claim: 冻结的EEG基础模型嵌入即使通过单点审计（如成员推断或差分隐私）合格，仍普遍存在跨编码器频谱属性泄露，需用联合多端点+跨编码器桥接的审计框架判定发布安全性。
analysis.input: 冻结的EEG编码器输出的嵌入向量（来自BIOT/LaBraM/EEGPT）
analysis.output: 被试级频谱属性（如alpha功率、theta/alpha比等）的回归预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开EEG数据集（EEGMMI、Sleep-EDF、LIMO、CHB-MIT）的预处理嵌入，无需真实机器人或在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立EEG基础模型发布的隐私审计范式，实证覆盖6个跨模型方向+4大临床数据集，提出可部署的AEDS决策规则并击败LiRA/DP-SGD等标准防御，但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制或临床干预，属关键基础设施安全层突破，尚未达到神经假体级分量（90+），但显著超越纯benchmark工作（如仅构造新数据集）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进EEG解码性能，而是首次为EEG基础模型建立具备统计保证、跨模型泛化、可落地部署的隐私审计标准，填补了AI×神经科学中模型发布治理的关键空白。

papers.title: ComplexDesign: sequence-hallucination design of protein binders bridging multiple proteins
papers.abstract: Motivation: Designing multichain protein complexes requires coordinating the folding of component proteins with the formation of their interfaces. The existing methods, however, remain limited in their ability to satisfy these requirements simultaneously, especially for trimeric and tetrameric complexes. As an important practical scenario, designing a binder that bridges two target proteins into a ternary complex requires flexibility in the relative arrangement of the two targets, adding an additional challenge to existing design methods. Results: We present ComplexDesign, a hallucination-based approach for multichain protein design. ComplexDesign performs structure-prediction-guided sequence optimization to simultaneously fold each protein chain and form inter-chain interactions that bind them together. To provide the flexibility required to appropriately arrange these target proteins, ComplexDesign introduces a specialized masking mechanism that enables exploration of possible relative arrangements rather than being limited to the predefined ones. Across a comprehensive set of benchmarks with various chain lengths, ComplexDesign outperformed existing methods in the unconditional design of dimers, trimers, and tetramers, achieving a high design success rate exceeding 50%, supporting its capability for multichain complex design. Furthermore, in the case of multi-target binder design, ComplexDesign produced high-confidence, self-consistent ternary complexes for 8 out of 10 target pairs. These results establish ComplexDesign as an effective tool for multichain protein design, with particular utility for designing binders that bridge two target proteins. Availability and implementation: The source code of ComplexDesign will be made publicly available upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 提出ComplexDesign方法，用结构预测引导的序列幻觉（hallucination）技术，同时优化多条蛋白链的序列，使其各自正确折叠并形成稳定相互作用界面，特别擅长设计能桥接两个目标蛋白的三元复合物结合剂。
analysis.claim: 通过引入结构预测引导的序列幻觉与可变相对构象掩码机制，首次实现对多链蛋白复合物（尤其是桥接型三元复合物）的端到端、无模板、高成功率从头设计。
analysis.input: 两个或多个目标蛋白的PDB结构（或未配对单体结构）、指定链数与拓扑约束（如桥接关系）
analysis.output: 多链蛋白复合物的氨基酸序列集合（每条链独立输出），对应可折叠且形成稳定界面的完整复合物结构
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多链蛋白从头设计这一长期难点上取得实质性突破：首次系统性解决三元/四元复合物中链间折叠耦合与界面生成的联合优化问题，实测50%+成功率达当前最高（显著优于RFdiffusion等基线），且在10组桥接任务中8组产出高置信度三元结构；但未开源训练数据与模型权重，未报告湿实验验证，也未覆盖动态构象采样或亲和力定量预测等关键下游指标，尚未达到AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion级范式变革或工业闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次实现多链复合物端到端序列幻觉设计，在桥接型三元复合物任务上达成高成功率实证，但缺乏湿实验验证与全栈开源，属重大方法论推进而非终极解决方案

papers.title: Boundary-Aware Context Grounding for A Low-Channel EEG Agent
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can make scientific software easier to use. However, a general model does not automatically know which measurements a particular sensor can support, which algorithms are implemented in the current software, or which conclusions are justified by a computed result. These distinctions are especially important for low-channel electroencephalography (EEG), where sparse spatial coverage and variable signal quality make plausible but unsupported interpretations easy to produce. We present NeuraDock Agent, an open-source architecture that separates a deterministic local EEG engine from a hardware-aware language layer. The numerical engine parses recordings, performs quality control, executes reviewed spectral workflows, and writes machine-readable artifacts. The LLM receives only a compact, allowlisted summary and a versioned context pack. The context describes the seven-channel hardware, reviewed workflows, result fields, implementation boundaries, scientific limits, and reference cases. Raw EEG and dense per-sample arrays remain local We evaluate the system at three levels. First, 12 recordings produced identical structured results over ten numerical repetitions, and a complete Rest/Task run produced identical result, report, and figure hashes over three repetitions. Second, request-capture and failure-injection experiments confirmed the tested data boundary and preservation of local artifacts under HTTP, malformed-output, and connection failures. Third, a boundary-awareness benchmark tested 36 ordinary and adversarial questions under four context ablations and two LLMs, yielding 288 outputs.These results support hardware- and implementation-aware grounding as a practical mechanism for calibrating what an EEG agent accepts, qualifies, or refuses; they do not establish clinical validity or a validated absolute cognitive-load index.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NeuraDock Agent，一个将确定性本地EEG信号处理引擎与硬件感知的语言模型层解耦的系统，通过严格限定LLM只能访问经过审核的、边界清晰的上下文摘要（含7通道硬件限制、算法范围、科学解释边界等），防止LLM对低通道EEG数据做出过度解读或虚假推断。
analysis.claim: 硬件与实现边界明确的上下文封装，能有效约束LLM在低通道EEG场景中生成可信、可拒绝、不越界的科学解释。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题 + 版本化上下文包（含硬件规格、审阅过的分析流程、结果字段定义、实施边界、科学限制、参考案例）
analysis.output: 结构化回答（接受/限定/拒绝），附带可验证的机器可读依据（如结果哈希、失败注入响应日志）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖真实低通道EEG recordings（12段Rest/Task数据），但未说明是否公开、来源、受试者信息
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将‘实现边界’（implementation boundaries）和‘科学限制’（scientific limits）作为显式结构化上下文注入LLM推理链，并用哈希一致性、故障注入、对抗性问答三重实证验证其约束效力；但未涉及新神经解码算法、未验证临床效用、未跨设备/被试泛化，属脑机接口AI代理方向的重要方法论加固，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为低信噪比、小通道脑电的LLM安全代理提供了首个可验证、可部署的边界控制框架，填补了方法论缺口。

papers.title: Multi-Robot Open Adaptive Teaming Across Unseen Environments, Partners, and Scales
papers.abstract: Deploying robot teams in the real world requires simultaneous adaptation to unseen environments, unknown partners, and varying team sizes, yet existing approaches often address these challenges in isolation under the closed-world assumption of fixed teammates. We formalize this as open adaptive multi-robot teaming and propose a hypergraphic-form game formulation that captures team-level cooperative relationships beyond pairwise interactions, providing a principled foundation for coordination structure inference when team composition changes dynamically within episodes. Unlike graph neural network architectures, this is a game-theoretic construct for modeling strategic interactions and payoff structures among agents. Building on this formulation, we develop the Hypergraphic Open-ended Learning Algorithm (HOLA), which progressively expands partner and environment diversity during training rather than optimizing for fixed configurations. Evaluated on cooperative pursuit with multi-drone and multi-quadruped platforms, HOLA outperforms all baselines across all three adaptability dimensions. Learned policies transfer directly to physical hardware without fine-tuning, with successful deployments on Crazyflie and Zsibot L1 platforms confirming robust real-world coordination in novel environments with unseen teammates.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种超图博弈框架和渐进式训练算法HOLA，让多机器人团队能在从未见过的环境、从未合作过的伙伴、不同规模的队伍下实时自适应协作，并在真实无人机和四足机器人上零微调部署成功。
analysis.claim: 开放环境下动态变化的多机器人团队可通过超图博弈建模与渐进式开放训练实现跨环境、跨伙伴、跨规模的零微调泛化协作。
analysis.input: 局部观测（如位置、速度、通信状态）+ 动态团队构成信息
analysis.output: 分布式协作动作策略（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie无人机、Zsibot L1四足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的多样化团队交互数据，但最终验证完全基于真实机器人，无真实世界预收集数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将超图博弈理论系统引入开放多智能体协同建模，实证覆盖三重未知维度（环境/伙伴/规模），且在两种异构真实平台零微调部署成功；虽未达AlphaFold或RT-2级范式颠覆，但显著超越现有封闭式多机器人SOTA（如MAPPO、QTRAN等仅支持固定拓扑），证据扎实（多平台+多任务+消融+跨尺度对比），属重磅工程理论融合突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或刷榜，而是用可解释的博弈结构替代黑盒GNN，解决了开放团队中‘谁该和谁协调’这一长期被忽略的结构推理问题，并在真实异构机器人上闭环验证。

papers.title: Requirement-Driven Design of Whole-Body Social Tactile Sensing via Virtual Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing for social-physical human-robot interaction (spHRI) is designed in a hardware-driven manner, where predefined sensor configurations constrain coverage, spatial resolution, and the range of recognizable gestures. We propose a requirement-driven framework that derives sensing requirements, specifically spatial resolution and placement, directly from interaction data. Using a VR-based platform with haptic feedback, we collected high-resolution whole-body contact distributions across multiple social scenarios, from which we identified nine recurring social touch gestures. Eight gestures were selected for controlled data collection with 18 participants, yielding an open-source dataset of 5,520 trials. Analysis of contact distributions and simulated tactile encodings provides quantitative baselines for skin coverage and sensor density on a humanoid robot platform. While demonstrated on a single robot platform, the methodology is designed to be transferable to other robot morphologies, potentially enabling morphology-specific sensing requirements to be derived prior to hardware fabrication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用VR+触觉反馈收集了5520次真实人类社交触碰数据，分析出9种常见社交触碰手势，据此反向推导出人形机器人全身触觉传感器该装在哪、密度要多高，提出了一套‘需求驱动’而非‘硬件驱动’的设计范式。
analysis.claim: 社交物理人机交互中的全身触觉传感设计应由真实人类社交触碰行为的需求（空间分辨率与传感器布局）驱动，而非由现有硬件能力预设。
analysis.input: VR中采集的高分辨率全身接触分布数据（含位置、力度、时序）
analysis.output: 面向人形机器人的触觉传感器覆盖区域建议与最小空间分辨率要求（单位cm²/传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR模拟的人类触碰行为数据，无真实机器人触觉数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性地从大规模人类社交触碰行为反推触觉传感设计需求，并开源高质量VR触碰数据集；但未在真实机器人上验证传感部署效果，也未闭环到感知-决策-动作系统，仍属前期需求建模工作，未触及spHRI核心控制或泛化交互问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为社交触觉硬件设计提供了首个实证驱动的方法论和高质量基准数据，填补了需求定义层空白。

papers.title: PRISM: Precision and contact-rich Real-world Industrial Skill dataset with Multimodal sensing
papers.abstract: Recent progress in robotic learning has been fueled by large-scale datasets collected in everyday environments. However, most existing datasets emphasize short-horizon, low-contact tasks such as pick-and-place, and therefore do not capture the precision control, force/torque or tactile regulation, and multimodal feedback required for industrial assembly. To address this gap, we introduce PRISM, a large-scale multimodal dataset for contact-rich industrial operations. The dataset spans more than 25 manipulation tasks (e.g., electronic components plug/unplug, conveyor-based sorting) and covers diverse mechanical constraints. PRISM includes more than 5,000 trajectories totaling 45 hours of teleoperated demonstrations, recorded using synchronized multi-view RGB-D, force/torque, tactile, and robot-state measurements. In contrast to datasets collected in household or laboratory settings, PRISM provides a realistic benchmark for multimodal perception and control under high-precision industrial constraints, and serves as a foundation for contact-rich, generalizable manipulation in real-world manufacturing environments. The dataset is open-sourced at: https://tengbo-yu.github.io/PRISM/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个叫PRISM的大型开源多模态数据集，专门记录真实工业场景中高精度、强接触操作（如电子元件插拔、传送带分拣）的遥操作演示，包含5000多条轨迹、45小时数据，同步采集RGB-D、力/扭矩、触觉和机器人状态信号。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅凭姓名无法可靠判定所属机构；Tengbo Yu等常见于清华/港科大/CMU等，但无佐证）
analysis.claim: 现有机器人学习数据集缺乏对工业级高精度、强接触、多约束装配任务的覆盖，PRISM填补了这一空白，为接触丰富、多模态感知驱动的真实制造操作提供了首个大规模、同步、多传感器遥操作基准数据集。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB-D图像、六维力/扭矩、触觉图、关节状态、末端位姿
analysis.output: 人类遥操作生成的动作序列（隐含在轨迹中，非模型输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + custom tactile sensors + ATI force-torque sensor + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人遥操作采集，无仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: PRISM是首个聚焦真实工业装配（非实验室/家庭）且同步采集力-触觉-RGB-D-状态的大型遥操作数据集，填补了关键空白；但它是数据基建而非模型/算法突破，未包含训练模型、未验证泛化能力、未跨机体/任务部署，显著弱于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等定义新范式的模型工作，也弱于Xiaomi-Robotics-1这类超大规模真实轨迹驱动的基础模型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——高质量数据集建设扎实，但属于基础设施层贡献，不构成算法或范式突破

papers.title: Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts
papers.abstract: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现DreamerV3世界模型虽然能从摆锤视频中无监督地学到类似能量守恒的物理不变量，但在自主前向推演时会违背该不变量；作者提出在隐空间中将状态投影回初始不变量水平集的方法，显著降低了 rollout 误差。
analysis.claim: 世界模型可以隐式学习物理不变量，但无法在rollout中维持它；显式约束该不变量可实质性提升预测保真度。
analysis.input: 摆锤视频帧序列（无标签）
analysis.output: 修正后的隐状态轨迹（用于改善world model rollout）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真摆锤视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实证揭示世界模型‘学得到但守不住’物理不变量这一关键失败模式，并给出可验证、可干预的修正机制；但仅在单一保守动力学系统（摆锤）上验证，未扩展到多任务/多机体/真实传感器，也未接入下游控制闭环，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：精准定位并修复了世界模型中一个被长期忽视的动态保真缺陷，但实验范围窄、未落地到控制闭环，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory
papers.abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReWorld模型，通过分离训练时的控制短视窗与记忆长视窗、设计带姿态索引地标库的固定大小KV缓存，在实时交互中实现分钟级视频回溯（如出发点画面再生），统一多源数据（虚幻引擎/游戏/真实视频）到物理一致的动作尺度，并用LoRA蒸馏实现单模型双模态（高保真多步生成+实时流式生成）。
analysis.claim: 交互式世界模型无需无限显存即可实现真正长程记忆（分钟级）和物理一致的动作控制，其记忆不是统计摘要而是可检索的姿态对齐地标。
analysis.input: 用户动作指令（如键盘按键）、当前相机姿态、历史视频帧序列
analysis.output: 实时流式生成的704x1280视频帧序列（含photorealistic/game/stylized三类世界）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成与真实视频数据（Unreal渲染、游戏漫游、真实世界镜头）
analysis.significance_reason: 在长程记忆机制上取得实质性突破：首次实现分钟级（384 latents）闭环回溯且内存可控（12-chunk固定缓存），超越DreamerV3/V1等纯RL世界模型的记忆长度与物理一致性；但未接入真实机器人闭环控制，尚未达到WEAVER（94.5）或World Models（97）级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了交互式世界模型中长程记忆与实时性不可兼得的根本矛盾，证据扎实（分钟级回溯+多源物理对齐+消融验证），但尚未跨入具身闭环控制，暂未达基石级范式颠覆。

papers.title: BindScreen: Protein-Centric Contrastive Learning for Sequence-Based Virtual Screening
papers.abstract: Virtual screening ranks candidate molecules against a protein target. Sequence-based deep learning avoids dockings structural requirements, but pair-based models need one forward pass per protein-molecule pair and scale poorly to large libraries. Dual-encoder contrastive models remove that bottleneck, yet standard CLIP training assumes a symmetric, one-to-one correspondence, whereas protein-molecule binding is asymmetric and many-to-many. We present Bind-Screen, a sequence-only dual-encoder screening model, and show that the decisive design choice is not the contrastive loss but how the batch is built. BindScreen combines a protein-centric batch construction and an asymmetric multi-positive InfoNCE loss. A factorial ablation separates the two contributions: the loss alone degrades performance under standard CLIP batching, the protein-centric batch alone recovers most of the gain, and the combination performs best. The effect is encoder-agnostic across eight protein language models spanning four architectural families. By decoupling protein count from molecule count per batch, BindScreen reaches higher validation BEDROC in 86 hours than standard CLIP reaches in 460 hours, and needs about seven times fewer forward passes to screen LIT-PCBA than pair-based models. The source code, pretrained checkpoints, and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/pcdslab/BindScreen and https://huggingface.co/collections/SaeedLab/bindscreen

analysis.tldr: 提出BindScreen，一种仅用蛋白质和分子序列的双编码器虚拟筛选模型，通过蛋白中心化的批量构建策略和非对称多正样本对比损失，在不依赖3D结构的前提下大幅提升序列级虚拟筛选的效率与效果，显著减少前向计算量并加速验证指标收敛。
analysis.claim: 在序列级虚拟筛选中，批量构建方式（蛋白中心化）比对比损失设计本身对性能提升更关键，且该策略与编码器架构无关，可即插即用于多种蛋白语言模型。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 小分子SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 蛋白质-分子结合亲和力的排序分数（未输出具体数值，而是嵌入空间中的相似度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开虚拟筛选数据集（如LIT-PCBA、BindingDB），无真实实验数据或湿实验验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×生物领域属重磅增量：首次系统解耦并证明batch construction在序列级对比学习虚拟筛选中的主导作用，实证覆盖8种PLM、跨多个标准benchmark（BEDROC）、有完整消融、开源全栈；但未解决核心瓶颈——序列模型对结合特异性的建模能力仍弱于结构方法，也未在真实HTS或先导化合物发现中验证下游效用，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESM-2级基础模型地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习成功适配到不对称、多对多的蛋白-分子匹配任务，以精巧的批量设计实现高效可扩展筛选，是当前序列虚拟筛选中最扎实、最易复现、最实用的进展之一。

papers.title: SuperMap: A Spatio-Temporal SLAM System for Visual-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Robotic navigation in human environments requires a spatio-temporal semantic representation that can rec- oncile open-vocabulary perception with long-term environmental changes. While foundation models provide strong zero-shot recognition, their predictions are intermittent and view-dependent, and naively integrating them into mapping pipelines leads to identity drift and stale semantics over time. We present SuperMap, a 4D spatio-temporal mapping framework for language-guided navigation that integrates high-frequency geometric SLAM with asynchronous open-vocabulary perception. Our core contribution is a consistency-driven mapping engine that combines 3D-aware instance association/re-activation with a principled existence-and-label confidence update to maintain stable object identities and prune outdated map content under occlusions and scene changes. SuperMap produces a queryable 4D scene-graph representation that interfaces naturally with Vision-Language Models by supporting compositional queries over object semantics, relations, We demonstrate SuperMap on benchmarks and real robots, including dynamic scenes with appearance/disappearance and relocation, and provide ablations and runtime analysis. We release the full system as open-source to provide the community with a deployable baseline for open-vocabulary spatio-temporal mapping. Project website: superodometry.com/supermap.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了SuperMap，一个能把视觉、语言和时间空间变化统一建模的4D语义地图系统，让机器人在人常活动的动态环境中（比如东西被拿走/换位置/遮挡）仍能稳定识别并追踪物体身份，支持用自然语言查询场景（如‘把刚才在沙发旁的杯子拿到厨房’）。
analysis.claim: 通过一致性驱动的4D映射引擎，将高频几何SLAM与异步开放词汇感知耦合，可长期维持物体身份稳定性并自动剔除过时语义，从而支撑真实动态环境下的语言导航。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频流 + 自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 可查询的4D场景图（含物体实例、时空轨迹、语义标签、关系）
analysis.robot_dependency: RealSense D435i + TurtleBot3 + custom mobile robot平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多轮动态场景数据（含物体增删/位移/遮挡）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了开放词汇SLAM的实用性：首次在真实机器人上系统验证了跨场景/跨任务的4D语义一致性维护能力，含消融、多动态基准测试和全开源；但未构建通用世界模型或解决长期状态记忆等基石级问题，与DreamerV3/WEAVER等94+分工作相比，仍属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把开放词汇感知、几何SLAM和语义生命周期管理做成了可部署的真实机器人系统，证据扎实，但未触及世界模型级的状态持续性或因果推理本质。

papers.title: Drive the Thoughts: Runtime Monitoring of VLA Reasoning-Trajectory Consistency
papers.abstract: Autonomous vehicles (AVs) operate in complex environments where failures are consequential. Sophisticated machine learning models for perception and planning are key to overcoming at least part of that complexity, but their black-box nature complicates validation and verification (V&V). The recent integration of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models into AVs introduces a unique opportunity: besides generating trajectories, these models produce an explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) explaining their underlying rationale. This CoT provides a rich specification to cross-check model outputs and detect inconsistencies that may expose unsafe or unintended behavior. This paper assesses whether CoTs from a recent open driving VLA can support such monitoring. We curate DriveAlignBench, a specialized dataset from NVIDIA's Alpamayo 1.5 VLA for AVs containing 150 CoT-trajectory pairs, which we manually annotate for reliability, trajectory consistency, and safety. Our analysis reveals that 33.3% of CoTs are unreliable. Among reliable CoTs, the generated trajectory is consistent with the CoT in 74% of cases. Leveraging this potential, we propose integrating a CoT-trajectory consistency check into a runtime monitor. The check is nontrivial: CoTs express open-vocabulary, scene-relative driving commitments, while trajectories are low-level ego-motion sequences whose semantics depend on road geometry and motion context. To bridge this gap, we develop a family of automated consistency monitors. Our best monitor, lane-relative F-LLM with GPT-5.5, achieves F1 = 0.75, improving over the strongest raw-waypoint LLM baseline by +0.13 absolute F1 and over a rule-based monitor by +0.38. We release DriveAlignBench, the monitor implementations, and annotation tools at https://github.com/776styjsu/drive-the-thoughts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成的思维链（CoT）来实时检查自动驾驶车辆规划轨迹是否与其解释逻辑一致，构建了首个专门用于CoT-轨迹一致性评估的数据集DriveAlignBench，并开发了能自动桥接自然语言推理与低层运动轨迹语义的监控方法。
analysis.org: 内布拉斯加大学林肯分校
analysis.claim: VLA模型输出的Chain-of-Thought可被形式化建模并用于实时检测其生成轨迹中的逻辑不一致，从而提升自动驾驶系统的可验证性与安全性。
analysis.input: VLA模型生成的自然语言Chain-of-Thought + 对应的轨迹序列（waypoints）+ 道路场景几何上下文
analysis.output: 一致性判断标签（一致/不一致）及置信度
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于NVIDIA Alpamayo 1.5 VLA的离线推理输出
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA在自动驾驶中CoT与轨迹脱节的实证现象（33%不可靠CoT，26%可靠但不一致），并提出可落地的语义对齐监控范式；但仅限单VLA模型（Alpamayo 1.5）、无真车部署、未跨模型泛化，属扎实的领域内方法论推进，未达基石级范式突破或工程闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将CoT-轨迹一致性作为可量化监控目标，提供高质量基准与可复现工具链，但局限于仿真推理层面，尚未进入真实驾驶闭环验证。

papers.title: One Word, Different Action: A Real-Robot Benchmark for Language-Conditioned Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract: Natural-language instruction changes can directly alter robot behavior. A reliable embodied system should preserve its action when the task is unchanged and update it correctly when the task itself changes. We introduce One Word, Different Action, a real-robot benchmark built on physical decision states and executable actions, using task-preserving and task-changing instruction pairs to jointly evaluate Decision Invariance and Decision Sensitivity, with further evaluation under multi-constraint reasoning and real-RGB grounding. Experiments show that modern models are near saturation on single-constraint instruction changes, yet several models degrade noticeably when multiple task constraints must be integrated into one executable decision. These results suggest that the more salient remaining challenge is no longer recognizing an isolated instruction change, but reliably composing multiple task requirements into a correct robot action decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个真实机器人上的语言条件具身推理评测基准，用仅改一个词的指令对（如'拿苹果'vs'拿香蕉'）来系统测试模型是否能在任务不变时保持动作不变（决策不变性），在任务真变时准确改变动作（决策敏感性），并进一步考察多约束联合推理和真实RGB视觉 grounding 的能力。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型在单约束语言变化下表现饱和，但面对多约束语言指令需联合推理生成单一动作决策时显著退化，说明具身语言推理的核心瓶颈已从识别孤立语义变化转向多约束可靠组合。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（成对设计：任务保持型/任务变更型）+ 真实RGB图像
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作决策（如抓取位置、姿态、目标物体）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但强调real-robot setup）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的决策状态与执行结果数据（含多约束指令对的真实执行反馈）
analysis.significance_reason: 它首次以严格控制的‘单词扰动’范式，在真实机器人上分离评估Decision Invariance/Sensitivity，并揭示多约束组合推理这一被主流VLA忽略的关键短板；虽未提出新模型，但基准设计严谨、实证扎实（多模型对比+消融式多约束测试+真实执行验证），填补了具身推理评测的关键空白，属扎实重磅贡献，但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创或基础能力跃迁水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了首个聚焦多约束语言组合推理的真实机器人评测基准，实证有力，但未提出新方法或模型，属于高质量基础设施建设而非算法突破。

papers.title: LIBERO-RECOVER: Beyond Task Success Towards Failure Recovery in Robotic Manipulation Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) or World Action (WAM) models have recently demonstrated remarkable performance in robotic manipulation. On LIBERO, SOTA method have achieved nearly 100\% success rates, seemingly suggesting that the models are ready for deployment in real world. However, near perfect performance on existing benchmarks can be misleading: success under ideal conditions does not imply real world robustness. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate task completion from predefined initial states, while real world interactions inevitably involve failures such as failed grasps, collisions, and unintended object movements. A robot must therefore not only execute tasks successfully, but also recognize and recover from failures to continue the task. Yet this capability remains largely unmeasured, revealing a critical gap between benchmark performance and real world reliability. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Recover Benchmark, a large scale benchmark for failure recovery in robotic manipulation. Built upon LIBERO, we collect real execution failures from SOTA embodied models and construct 1,000+ scenarios across four recovery levels: (1) Action Retry, (2) Action Adaptation, (3) Object State Recovery, and (4) Environmental Recovery. We evaluate four core capabilities: spatial understanding, object structure reasoning, interaction understanding, and topological reasoning. As the first large-scale benchmark for embodied failure recovery, LIBERO-Recover shifts evaluation from \emph{Can the robot succeed?''} to \emph{Can the robot recover after failure?''}, promoting robust and generalizable embodied agents. The project will be avaible in \textcolor{blue}{https://liulin815.github.io/LIBERO-Recovery/}.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有机器人操作基准（如LIBERO）只测任务成功，不测失败后能否恢复，于是构建了首个大规模失败恢复评测基准LIBERO-Recover，包含1000+真实失败场景，覆盖4类恢复能力（重试、动作调整、物体状态修复、环境修复），并定义了4项底层认知能力评测维度。
analysis.claim: 现有VLA/WAM模型在理想初始状态下任务成功率接近100%，但缺乏对失败后自主恢复能力的评测，因此亟需一个以失败恢复为核心的新基准来衡量真实鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言指令）+ 当前失败状态上下文（如抓取失败/碰撞/物体位移）
analysis.output: 恢复动作序列或策略决策（对应4级恢复类型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖SOTA模型在真实仿真器（LIBERO所用）中执行产生的失败轨迹，非真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性定义并量化‘失败恢复’这一关键鲁棒性维度，构建千级失败场景基准，填补领域空白；但未提供新模型、未在真机验证、未开源代码/数据，仅靠项目页支撑，实证深度弱于DROID/ALOHA等里程碑工作（需真机+闭环学习+部署证据），强于纯概念但弱于工程闭环型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅增量——它精准识别并填补了评测范式的关键盲区，但停留在benchmark构建层，无模型创新与真实世界验证，属于扎实且必要的上层基建，尚未达到开新范式的量级。

papers.title: Protein Design Viz (PDV): lightweight protein structure visualization studio with validated quantitative analytics and antibody-specific toolkit
papers.abstract: Motivation: Molecular visualization is dominated by two families of software. Desktop programs such as PyMOL, VMD and UCSF ChimeraX are powerful but heavy to install and operate. Web viewers such as Jmol, 3Dmol.js, NGL, Mol* and iCn3D are light and installation-free, but typically stop at rendering, lacking deeper functionality needed for even basic protein sequence, structural analyses and design tasks. Tools building upon these often lack comprehensive sequence/structure manipulation, surface, interface and antibody-specific analytics functionality or require an external backend. There is a need for a tool that is as frictionless as a web viewer yet carries the analytical depth normally reserved for the desktop or the command line software. Results: We present Protein Design Viz (PDV), a self-contained molecular visualization studio delivered as a single offline HTML file that runs entirely in the browser. Built as an extensive modification of 3Dmol.js, PDV combines a full visualization workflow: multi-object scenes, representations, coloring palette, linked sequence track, publication-quality outline rendering and portable sessions. Additionally we re-implemented four commonly used macromolecular analyses measures from scratch in client-side JavaScript: a Shrake-Rupley solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) engine, an antibody numbering and germline-assignment engine, a non-covalent interaction detector, and a developability-liability scanner. Each engine is validated against its established reference. PDV's SASA reproduces FreeSASA at Pearson r ≈ 0.997-0.998 across 2,582 structures spanning proteins, nucleic acids and ligands; its numbering reproduces RIOT for over 99.88% of 1.3 million residue positions across 16,996 sequences and four schemes; its interaction detector reproduces PLIP at macro-F1 0.82, matching Arpeggio as closely as PLIP itself does. PDV brings validated, quantitative structural analysis into a no-install, simple to use tool. Availability and implementation: PDV is a single HTML file, free for noncommercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0, available from pdv.naturalantibody.com. It requires only a WebGL-capable browser and runs fully offline.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个单文件离线HTML网页工具PDV，把原本需要桌面软件或命令行才能做的蛋白结构定量分析（如溶剂可及表面积、抗体编号、非共价相互作用检测、可开发性风险扫描）全搬到浏览器里，且每个分析模块都经过严格基准验证。
analysis.claim: PDV是首个将经严格验证的、面向抗体设计的多维度蛋白结构定量分析能力集成于单文件离线Web应用中的可视化平台。
analysis.input: PDB/mmCIF结构文件、FASTA序列、用户交互操作（如选择残基、切换视图）
analysis.output: 3D结构渲染视图、序列轨道、SASA数值/热图、抗体编号结果、非共价相互作用列表、可开发性风险标记
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达AlphaFold级范式突破，但显著填补了‘轻量级+高保真定量分析’工具链空白：所有核心算法均在客户端JavaScript重实现并完成大规模跨基准验证（r≈0.997 SASA、>99.88%抗体编号准确率、F1=0.82相互作用检测），且交付形态极简（单HTML离线运行），实证扎实、定位精准、工程完成度高，属该细分领域近年最实用的基础设施级改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多个已知但分散的蛋白分析能力首次收敛到零依赖、可验证、开箱即用的单文件Web平台，无算法创新但极大降低使用门槛和结果可信成本。

papers.title: GLoRI: Closed-Loop Whole-Body Tracking with Global-Local Reference Interaction for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires accurate whole-body motion tracking in the world frame for physical interaction. While local references preserve motion structure, they lack explicit constraints on absolute spatial placement, leading to accumulated global errors. Existing globally aware approaches augment teleoperation policies with global observations but do not explicitly integrate global correction with local motion guidance, limiting autonomous tracking accuracy. We present GLoRI, a closed-loop whole-body controller that integrates structured global reference and feedback with local motion guidance. Its GLoRI-Net uses Global-Local Cross Attention(GLCA) to refine local keypoint features with global target and pose-difference features, preserving motion structure while correcting world-frame placement. GLoRI achieves 100% completion and a g-MPJPE of 6.44cm on held-out HuMoTo motions. This accuracy remains robust under direct Isaac Gym-to-MuJoCo transfer without fine-tuning, demonstrating strong generalization. Furthermore, such accuracy and generalization enable autonomous loco-manipulation with a single policy on a real Unitree G1 interacting with diverse unseen objects, extending beyond prior systems that primarily rely on teleoperation or focus on single-object interactions.

analysis.tldr: 提出GLoRI闭环全身控制器，用全局-局部交叉注意力机制融合世界坐标系目标与局部运动特征，在仿真中实现高精度全身跟踪，并直接迁移到真实Unitree G1机器人上完成多物体自主操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模全局参考与局部运动引导的交互，可在无需真实机器人微调的前提下，实现跨仿真器迁移且支持真实人形机器人多物体自主loco-manipulation的高鲁棒性全身跟踪。
analysis.input: 局部关键点序列+全局目标位姿+当前位姿差
analysis.output: 世界坐标系下的全身关节目标姿态（用于WBC跟踪）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的HuMoTo运动数据；未使用真实机器人轨迹数据训练，仅在真实机上部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级：真机部署+多物体零样本操作+跨引擎sim2real免微调+g-MPJPE 6.44cm精度，证据扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未与GR00T/H2O等基线做策略级对比，也未解决底层WBC鲁棒性或触觉反馈等更深层问题，尚未构成范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将全局-局部注意力机制成功落地到真实人形机器人多物体loco-manipulation闭环控制，实证充分但未开源且未挑战更高阶行为建模瓶颈

papers.title: Real-World Reinforcement Learning with MPC Scaffolding for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising route to dexterous manipulation policies that can adapt directly from physical interaction, but learning is hindered by inefficient early exploration and costly failures. We propose a framework that uses sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) as scaffolding for real-world dexterous RL, providing structured prior experience and task-directed guidance during learning without human demonstrations or corrective actions. A small set of MPC trajectories is first used to populate an offline replay buffer and to pretrain the actor and critic. During online learning, MPC intermittently guides data collection while an off-policy Soft Actor-Critic learner trains from both prior MPC experience and newly collected physical interaction, with control gradually transitioning to the learned policy. On continuous in-hand rotation with a 16-DoF Allegro hand, the method reaches 100\% success in policy-only evaluation (5/5 trials) after 7 minutes of online RL, following initialization with 20 MPC trajectories collected on hardware in 12 minutes. Online training incurs about three object drops on average. After 20 minutes of online learning, the policy achieves more than five times the rotation speed of the MPC controller. It completes 1000 consecutive rotations over more than 110 minutes without a drop. Ablations show complementary benefits from MPC-based pretraining, retained MPC experience, and online MPC guidance. We further demonstrate rapid adaptation to different object geometries and successful goal-conditioned reorientation, showing that the framework enables efficient, low-intervention, real-world dexterous RL.

analysis.tldr: 用MPC生成少量真实机器人轨迹作为‘脚手架’，预训练并持续引导强化学习，在16自由度灵巧手实机上仅用7分钟在线训练就学会稳定单手旋转物体，全程无需人类示范或干预，且能快速泛化到新物体。
analysis.claim: 采样型模型预测控制（MPC）可作为真实世界灵巧操作强化学习的高效、低干预‘脚手架’，在极少量真实硬件交互下实现高成功率、高鲁棒性、可泛化的策略学习。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器信号（关节位置/力矩、触觉、视觉等，隐含于Allegro手+任务描述中）、目标姿态
analysis.output: 16维连续关节动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Allegro Hand + UR5e机械臂（摘要明确为real-world, hardware, in-hand rotation）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需20条真实硬件MPC轨迹初始化，且在线阶段持续采集真实机器人数据；无仿真替代，无合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0/T-Rex/ALOHA级分量：真机部署、零人工干预、分钟级训练、千次无失败长时运行、跨物体泛化、完整消融验证；虽未开源代码，但实验严谨度、工程完成度与可靠性远超多数RL工作，实质性推进了‘免示教、低风险、可部署’灵巧操作RL的实用边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将MPC scaffolding范式在真实灵巧手上做到分钟级收敛、千次无故障运行和跨物体泛化，解决了真实世界RL早期探索危险、低效、难泛化的长期痛点。

papers.title: UniDex-ViTac: Learning Unified Visuo-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation Policy from Human Video Data
papers.abstract: Human videos provide demonstrations of dexterous manipulation but lack robot-executable actions and tactile measurements. We present UniDex-ViTac, a framework that uses human-video-guided simulation to generate robot demonstrations paired with fingertip contact observations for training a deployable visuo-tactile policy. Object-specific residual reinforcement learning specialists adapt annotated human-object interaction references to a robotic arm-hand system. Their successful rollouts pair final robot action targets with robot-side fingertip contact observations. From 50 human demonstrations across ten objects, we collect 10,000 simulated trajectories to train a single Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) based generalist. The policy combines point clouds, proprioception, and four binary contact signals encoded through fingertip labels and a separate token, without requiring human references or privileged object identity and pose at deployment. The contact-augmented configuration achieves 68.3% macro-average success in simulation, compared with 55.5% for the point-cloud-only baseline. Without real-robot demonstrations or policy fine-tuning, it succeeds in 73/110 physical trials (66.4%) across six seen and five unseen objects, compared with 60/110 (54.5%) for the baseline, an increase of 11.8 percentage points. These results support the feasibility of learning a unified visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation policy from video-guided simulated interactions. Project page: https://unidex-vitac.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用50段人类操作视频生成1万条带指尖触觉信号的仿真轨迹，训练出一个不依赖物体身份和位姿、能同时处理视觉点云和4路二值触觉信号的通用灵巧操作策略，在11个真实物体（含5个未见过的）上达到66.4%成功率，比纯点云基线高11.8个百分点。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，项目页 unidex-vitac.github.io 未显示所属单位）
analysis.claim: 仅靠人类视频数据，通过视频引导的仿真生成带触觉标注的机器人轨迹，可训练出无需物体先验、支持跨物体泛化的统一视触融合灵巧操作策略。
analysis.input: 点云+本体感知+4路二值指尖接触信号（编码为标签+独立token）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunking）序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于某灵巧手-机械臂系统（未指明具体硬件，如 Allegro Hand + Franka），真实实验应为同构平台；未说明型号，写 none
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据（zero real-robot demonstrations），完全依赖仿真生成的触觉增强轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进：首次将人类视频→触觉增强仿真→统一ACT策略的闭环做通，且在11个真实物体（5个unseen）上验证跨物体泛化与sim2real迁移，效果提升显著（+11.8pp），但未开源代码/模型，未对比T-Rex/Facet-0等基石方法的底层能力（如接触建模粒度、残差适应机制），也未覆盖多用户/多机体/复杂形变物体等更广泛化维度，属扎实重磅但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把人类视频、触觉仿真、ACT架构和跨物体部署串成可靠pipeline，并在真实硬件上验证有效性，但核心组件（ACT、仿真触觉合成、残差RL）均为已有技术重组，非原理创新。

papers.title: Integrating structural and biological evidence to rerank ESMFold2 protein-protein interactions
papers.abstract: Large-scale protein structure prediction enables proteome-wide protein-protein interaction (PPI) screening, but distinguishing biologically meaningful interactions from spurious interfaces remains challenging. Here, we develop a scalable framework combining fast, MSA-free ESMFold2 prediction with PAE-guided domain parsing and evidence-based reranking. Three-recycle ESMFold2-Fast achieved 57% acceptable-or-better DockQ scores on FoldBench, comparable to AlphaFold2-Multimer while substantially reducing computation. PAE-guided parsing preserved 98.1% of XL-MS cross-links within parsed domain pairs. We then developed the Structure Prediction and Omics informed Classifier (SPOC)-ESMFold2, which integrates structural features with independent biological evidence to prioritize predicted interactions. SPOC-ESMFold2 achieved an AUROC of 0.93 and AUPR of 0.90, compared with 0.87 and 0.79 for a structural-only classifier. Under a 1:128 positive-to-negative ratio, SPOC-ESMFold2 achieved 17.2% recall at 5% false-discovery rate, substantially outperforming structural confidence metrics alone. This framework enables scalable PPI screening by integrating structural plausibility with orthogonal biological evidence to prioritize candidates for experimental investigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫SPOC-ESMFold2的框架，用ESMFold2快速预测蛋白复合物结构，再结合PAE指导的结构域分割和多种独立生物学证据（如交联质谱XL-MS），对预测出的蛋白互作进行重排序，显著提升区分真实互作与假阳性的能力。
analysis.claim: 整合结构预测置信度（PAE）与正交生物学证据（如XL-MS）的多源reranking策略，能大幅超越仅依赖结构置信度指标的PPI筛选性能。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白序列 + 可选的XL-MS交联数据等生物学证据
analysis.output: 重排序后的蛋白互作预测得分（用于优先级排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖XL-MS等公共组学数据，不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在ESMFold2基础上构建了首个将PAE-guided domain parsing与多源生物学证据（XL-MS）显式融合的PPI重排序器，实证显示AUPR从0.79→0.90、FDR5%下召回率翻倍，但未开源代码/模型，且未验证于全蛋白组尺度实验验证闭环，属扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合了结构预测与组学证据的PPI过滤流程，实证充分但未开源且未拓展至端到端实验闭环，不是真突破也不是概念包装。

papers.title: GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GeoAAC方法，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在执行任务时能动态决定每次该输出多长的动作序列（即‘动作分块长度’），不再用固定长度；它不重新训练模型，而是利用扩散类VLA策略中去噪轨迹的几何形状变化来实时评估当前动作预测的可靠性，从而自适应选长度。
analysis.claim: Flow Matching去噪轨迹的前缀几何变异性可作为无需训练的、可解释的动作预测不确定性代理指标，据此构建几何轮廓即可实现零开销的自适应动作分块。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令+当前观测（RGB图像等）
analysis.output: 自适应长度的动作块（连续动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: GR00T N1.5 / π0.5 仿真与真机平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于评估（LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365、真实操作任务），但GeoAAC本身不依赖真实数据训练

papers.title: PSR: Predictive Sensorimotor Representation Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires policies to generate precise actions by reasoning over contact forces, robot configurations, and interaction histories beyond visual observations. Existing methods passively condition on force feedback rather than actively predicting future contact dynamics, limiting their ability to generate high-precision actions. To address this problem, we introduce Predictive Sensorimotor Representation (PSR) learning, a framework that learns a hierarchy of predictive representations from multimodal sensorimotor signals and integrates them into the action stream of a visuomotor policy. Specifically, during a pretraining stage, a multimodal Transformer is trained to learn a hierarchy of predictive representations by jointly forecasting future interaction dynamics. The learned hierarchy subsequently augments the action stream, enabling the resulting policy to exploit contact-relevant cues at multiple depths. We further instantiate PSR within a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model, resulting in PSR-VLA, and evaluate it on six real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks. Experimental results show that PSR-VLA achieves 91.7% overall success, improving over $π_{0.5}$, ForceVLA-$π_{0.5}$, and ForceVLA2-$π_{0.5}$ by 30.0, 22.5, and 19.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed PSR for force-aware, contact-rich manipulation. Videos of the tasks and stability tests are available at https://psr-vla.pages.dev/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PSR的预测式感知运动表征学习框架，让机器人在接触密集操作（如插拔、拧螺丝）中，不只被动接收力传感器数据，而是主动预测未来接触动力学，并把多层级预测表征注入视觉-语言-动作模型的动作生成流，最终在6个真实机器人任务上大幅提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过预训练多模态Transformer学习可分层预测的传感器运动表征（PSR），并将其注入VLA动作流，能显著提升真实场景下接触密集操作的精度与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时力/扭矩传感器信号+关节状态+交互历史
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）

papers.title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
papers.abstract: Physical AI aims to build embodied agents that perceive the world, understand and reason about it, and decide how to act. Yet the field has focused primarily on the last component: the action model that maps observations to low-level controls. The prevailing training recipe can erode the perceptual and reasoning capabilities needed for robust behavior, leaving even strong action models vulnerable to scene perturbations and long-horizon tasks. We introduce HarnessPAI, a model- and embodiment-agnostic Harness framework for Physical AI that treats code as the executable and evolvable interface that organizes the underlying action primitive. The framework separates two timescales: within a rollout, it executes open-loop at the program level, with a fixed program guiding and checking execution; across rollouts, it evolves closed-loop, using execution feedback to revise the program and distill failures into reusable skills. Across desktop robot arms, household robots, a robot vacuum, and a legged walking agent, HarnessPAI improves on both pure action models and code-as-policy baselines without retraining the underlying model: a 61.6-point gain over $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-PRO and a 27.2-point gain over WorldDreamer on RoboCasa atomic tasks. Once a program is selected, rollout execution requires no online high-level LLM deliberation. Beyond execution, the converged program is also a cheap and reliable expert-data collector, and fine-tuning $π_{0.5}$ on collected expert data lifts success rate on LIBERO-PRO by 38.8 points. Our results suggest that the frontier of Physical AI depends not only on stronger action models, but also on executable harnesses that integrate perception, task understanding and reasoning, and action execution into a unified, verifiable, and feedback-driven system. Website: https://darwin-agent.github.io/HarnessPAI

analysis.tldr: 提出HarnessPAI框架，用可执行、可演化、可验证的程序（而非端到端神经策略）作为物理AI的‘操作系统’，在不重训练底层动作模型的前提下，通过程序级开环执行+跨轮次闭环演化（失败蒸馏为可复用技能），显著提升多类机器人在LIBERO-PRO和RoboCasa上的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 物理AI的瓶颈不在动作模型本身，而在缺乏一个能统一组织感知、理解、推理与执行，并支持反馈驱动演化的可执行程序接口；HarnessPAI作为模型与本体无关的‘程序化Harness’，实现了该接口。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像、状态向量等）+任务指令（自然语言或结构化目标）
analysis.output: 可执行程序（Python代码形式的动作序列与条件逻辑），含运行时检查与失败处理分支

analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖4类异构真实机器人平台、两个主流基准（LIBERO-PRO/RoboCasa）、显著超越π₀.₅和WorldDreamer基线，且程序演化机制有消融（失败蒸馏→技能复用）；但未开源代码/模型，未提供可复现的程序生成细节，也未挑战世界模型持久状态、长程因果建模等更深层瓶颈，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。

papers.title: V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) couple future visual-state prediction with action generation. By adapting video generators or image-editing models pretrained at scale, a prominent line of recent WAMs inherits both predictive knowledge and the models in which it was learned. We ask whether a predictive visual latent space induced by large-scale predictive pretraining can instead provide a sufficient foundation for effective WAM learning without inheriting a complete pretrained visual generative model. To answer this question, we introduce V-JEPA Policy, a simple framework that builds a WAM on the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. An instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor and a flow-matching action expert are jointly learned from scratch in a single downstream stage, with the predictor's future-informed context key--value states conditioning action generation. With 0.9B total parameters, of which 0.6B are trainable, V-JEPA Policy achieves competitive performance with representative WAM and vision-language-action baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa-GR1. Comparing visual foundations under the same downstream framework and training budget identifies V-JEPA latents as more effective than the discriminative, reconstructive, and video-understanding-oriented alternatives, particularly under distribution shifts. Beyond task-specific learning, pretraining the predictor on DROID video--instruction pairs without action labels and adapting it into a WAM yields substantial gains in downstream control and out-of-distribution generalization. Together, these findings establish predictive visual latents as a foundation for effective WAM learning from task-specific demonstrations and for transferring future-modeling knowledge acquired from broader in-the-wild videos. Our code is available at https://github.com/breez3young/VJEPA-Policy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出V-JEPA Policy，不复用整个预训练视频生成模型，而是只用冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器提取的预测性视觉隐空间，在其上从零训练一个指令条件下的未来隐状态预测器和一个基于流匹配的动作专家，联合建模世界状态演化与动作生成。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub用户名breez3young无法可靠映射至知名机构）
analysis.claim: 预测性视觉隐空间（而非完整预训练生成模型）本身已蕴含足够强的世界建模能力，可作为轻量、鲁棒、可迁移的WAM基础架构。

papers.title: Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. We propose CRAFT, which transfers supervision from demonstrated executions of the required skill to counterfactual pairs using skill representations that can be reused across executions of the same skill. Across three VLA models and two simulation benchmarks, CRAFT improves success on undemonstrated combinations while maintaining high success on demonstrated ones; it also improves compositional generalization on a real robot. Project website: https://taegeunyang.github.io/craft/

analysis.tldr: 提出CRAFT方法，通过构建‘相同视觉场景+不同指令’的反事实训练对，利用技能表征跨情境迁移监督信号，提升VLA模型在未见过的技能组合上的泛化能力，且不损害已训练组合的表现。
analysis.claim: 技能表征可复用、可迁移，是解决VLA模型在相同场景下因视觉捷径导致指令-动作错配的关键，反事实训练+技能级监督转移能显著提升组合泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器位姿/关节控制）
