papers.title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
papers.abstract: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出JEPA-TTT方法，让预训练好的世界模型在测试时持续用自身预测误差做自监督更新（只调动态预测器，不动视觉编码器和奖励头），从而在环境动力学发生突变时仍能稳定规划，实验证明它在8种动力学偏移下显著降低了预测误差并提升了规划性能。
analysis.claim: 通过持久化、无目标图像、无在线奖励的测试时自监督训练，可使预训练潜空间世界模型在动力学偏移下持续适应并保持规划能力。
analysis.input: 当前观测帧+动作序列（隐式通过JEPA的联合嵌入结构输入）
analysis.output: 未来潜变量序列（用于规划的动作-状态轨迹预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅在MuJoCo/DM Control等仿真环境中验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在连续控制仿真中系统验证了‘持久测试时训练’对世界模型动力学鲁棒性的提升，有扎实多任务消融、8种偏移量化结果和明确基线对比（JEPA冻结版），但未涉及真实机器人、未挑战长期记忆或状态核心缺陷等基石级问题，也未开源代码，故强于一般增量但未达DreamerV3/DreamerV1级范式影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将测试时训练机制稳健嵌入JEPA架构，在仿真动力学偏移场景下做出扎实、可复现的性能提升，但未突破世界模型的基础表征瓶颈或跨越到真实系统。

papers.title: ReCo: Response-Consistent Locomotion with Policy-Aware MPC for Legged Manipulation
papers.abstract: Continuous legged manipulation requires accurate end-effector tracking while the base keeps walking. Combining reinforcement learning (RL) with model predictive control (MPC) suits this task: the learned policy provides robust locomotion, while MPC coordinates the base and arm to compensate for tracking errors. However, MPC can compensate only for base motion that it can predict, and a learned policy's command response varies with gait phase, contact, and payload. We present ReCo, a framework that couples response-consistent locomotion with policy-aware MPC for legged manipulation. Response shaping trains the policy to respond to commands consistently and repeatably across randomized dynamics. An identified closed-loop response model then lets MPC jointly plan locomotion commands and arm motion. On the simulation benchmark, ReCo reduces position and orientation root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 28.7% and 27.4% relative to the best baseline for each metric. Real-world experiments demonstrate onboard continuous legged manipulation with coordinated base and arm motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReCo框架，让四足机器人在行走的同时稳定操作物体，核心是训练一个对指令响应更一致的步态策略，并用这个可预测的响应模型来改进模型预测控制（MPC），从而协调腿和机械臂动作。
analysis.claim: 通过响应一致性训练与策略感知的MPC联合建模，可显著提升四足机器人边走边操作时的末端执行器跟踪精度与实时协同能力。
analysis.input: 高层操作指令（如末端目标位姿）+ 当前状态（关节位置/速度、IMU、接触状态等）
analysis.output: 协调的底层运动指令（腿关节力矩 + 机械臂关节轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人平台（未指明具体型号，实验中为自研或通用四足，如Go1类）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的随机化动力学数据进行响应建模；真实实验仅用于最终验证，未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集的策略训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在sim2real legged manipulation这一高难度交叉方向上，首次系统性解耦并建模‘策略响应不确定性’对MPC性能的制约，并给出可实测的响应一致性训练+闭环辨识方案；真机多任务演示（连续行走+操作）、量化指标提升显著（>27% RMSE下降）、含消融，但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖人形或多机体泛化，未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将策略可预测性建模与MPC深度耦合，在真实四足平台上实现了稳健的边走边操作，但缺乏开源与跨机体验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Molecular Property Prediction under Structural Shift with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Predicting molecular properties for compounds that differ structurally from labeled training molecules is important for drug discovery and materials design. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a promising approach through in-context learning, but their performance under structural shifts and the value of molecular comparisons in this setting remain underexplored. We study structural generalization in molecular property prediction and introduce MolPAIR (Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement), a framework that combines molecule-level and molecular-pair contexts without task-specific parameter updates. A global tabular foundation model (TFM) first predicts a query's property from labeled molecular examples. A second frozen TFM predicts differences in prediction errors between the query and labeled reference molecules, using these comparisons to refine the initial prediction. Across 58 MoleculeACE and Polaris tasks, CheMeleon representations combined with TabPFN-3 already outperform each evaluated baseline on a majority of tasks. MOLPAIR further improves this predictor on 46 of 58 tasks, with gains across four molecular representations and three TFM backbones. These results show that explicit molecular comparisons can strengthen tabular in-context learning for structural generalization while keeping the molecular encoder and pretrained model weights fixed. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/MolPAIR.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MolPAIR方法，不更新任何模型参数，仅通过让两个冻结的表格基础模型（TFM）分别做分子属性预测和预测误差差值比较，利用分子对之间的上下文关系来提升模型在结构分布偏移下的泛化能力，在58个分子属性预测任务上稳定改进现有SOTA。
analysis.claim: 显式引入分子对间的误差比较上下文，可在不微调、不修改分子编码器和TFM权重的前提下，显著增强表格基础模型在结构偏移场景下的分子属性预测泛化能力。
analysis.input: 查询分子的结构表示（如CheMeleon/ECFP/Morgan等）+若干带标签的参考分子及其属性值
analysis.output: 查询分子的连续或离散属性预测值（如logP、solubility、IC50等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开分子数据集（MoleculeACE/Polaris），无需真实实验数据或湿实验反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 在分子AI中首次系统验证‘冻结TFM + 分子对误差比较’这一轻量级in-context refinement范式对结构偏移泛化的有效性，覆盖58个异构任务、4种表征、3种TFM，有完整消融与跨骨架测试，但未触及生成、动态建模或湿实验闭环，尚未达到基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold）的范式颠覆性或物理机制深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实、开源完备、范式清晰，在表格化分子建模的泛化瓶颈上做出明确且可复现的实质性推进，但仍未突破‘预测’范畴进入‘设计-验证’闭环或第一性原理耦合。

papers.title: Aligning the Incomplete: Joint Distribution Calibration for Multimodal EEG-Eye Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: The success of cross-subject multimodal emotion recognition hinges on maintaining the consistency of the joint data distribution across individuals. However, real-world deployment frequently triggers the \emph{asymmetric joint distribution collapse}: EEG signals suffer from severe cross-subject distribution shifts, while eye movements sensors are susceptible to packet loss and tracking failures. Existing methods treat domain adaptation and missing-modality imputation as disjoint tasks. Consequently, they fail to resolve the compounded errors when both degradations co-occur, either propagating domain shifts through imputed signals or destroying the joint decision boundary. To tackle this unified challenge, we propose GUARD (\textbf{G}radient-guided \textbf{U}nsupervised \textbf{A}symmetric \textbf{R}ecovery of \textbf{D}istributions). First, GUARD establishes a reliable anchor manifold in the source domain by employing a theoretically grounded gradient-weighted objective, which forces the robust EEG modality to preemptively entangle task-discriminative ocular features. Next, to structurally recover the collapsed joint distribution, we constrain a generative module with downstream perceptual losses, prioritizing emotion-discriminative semantics over mere signal fidelity. Finally, we formulate target-domain adaptation as an ill-posed inverse problem. By driving a cycle-consistent flow, we achieve unsupervised calibration of the recovered joint distribution directly on the target-domain manifold. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GUARD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, maintaining resilient discriminative performance even under complete auxiliary modality failure. Our code and models are made publicly available to ensure complete reproducibility.

analysis.tldr: 提出GUARD方法，在跨被试脑电（EEG）+眼动多模态情绪识别中，同时应对EEG的跨被试分布偏移和眼动数据的随机缺失/失效，通过梯度引导的源域锚定、语义优先的生成式联合分布重建、以及循环一致的无监督目标域流校准，实现即使眼动模态完全失效时仍保持情绪判别能力。
analysis.claim: 联合分布校准必须在源域锚定、语义驱动的生成恢复与目标域流形上无监督逆问题求解三阶段协同下，才能真正缓解EEG-眼动多模态在真实部署中因不对称退化（EEG分布漂移 + 眼动信号丢失）导致的联合决策边界崩溃。
analysis.input: 不完整多模态时序信号（EEG + 眼动，含随机缺失/全缺失）
analysis.output: 情绪类别预测概率（离散标签）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；依赖公开或自建的跨被试EEG-眼动情绪数据集（如SEED-IV、DEAP扩展等），但摘要未说明是否含真实场景噪声或长期采集稳定性验证
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×神经科学/情绪计算中的扎实增量：首次系统建模并联合解决‘跨被试EEG分布漂移’与‘眼动模态随机失效’的耦合退化，实证覆盖多种缺失模式与跨被试泛化，开源完整；但未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如单次trial低信噪比解码、长期植入稳定性、闭环干预、临床级鲁棒性），也未在真实临床/移动场景中验证部署可靠性，与所列基石工作（如92分以上脑机语音合成、脊髓接口自然行走）存在代际差距——那些工作直面神经信号衰减、生物界面退化、运动意图闭环控制等硬科学+工程双重挑战，而本文仍在受控实验室多模态分类层面优化统计一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将领域内已知的分布偏移与模态缺失问题进行结构化联合建模，并给出可复现的端到端方案，但未突破情绪识别作为代理任务本身的科学深度或临床实用性边界。

papers.title: SimpleTouch: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Master Contact-Rich Manipulation Without Tactile Policy Pretraining?
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing provides essential contact information for robotic manipulation, yet incorporating it into pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging. A common concern is that simply introducing touch during task-specific fine-tuning may fail to bridge the cross-modal gap, yielding limited gains or even reduced success. Consequently, existing methods often rely on large-scale tactile policy pretraining or separate visuotactile alignment, adding data requirements and training stages. We introduce SimpleTouch, a simple VLA extension that augments $π_{0.5}$ with a tactile expert, to test whether these additional stages are necessary. Leveraging all tokens from a frozen pretrained tactile encoder, the expert learns from action supervision and multi-horizon prediction of future tactile latents. This single-stage training uses only task demonstrations, without additional tactile policy pretraining or separate alignment. With 50 demonstrations per task, SimpleTouch achieves the highest success rate among evaluated methods on all six UniVTAC tasks. Its average success rate reaches 77.5%, compared with 45.2% for FTP-$π_{0.5}$ and 66.7% for FTP-1, corresponding to gains of 32.3 and 10.8 percentage points, respectively. Across four real-world tasks, it averages 71.3%, exceeding FTP-1 by 8.8 percentage points. These results demonstrate that, given pretrained VLA and tactile representations, additional tactile policy pretraining is not a prerequisite for strong performance on these tasks, offering a simpler route to contact-rich manipulation. Project page: https://simpletouch-robot.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SimpleTouch方法，只用50个任务演示数据、不额外做触觉策略预训练，就把一个冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型（π₀.₅）和一个冻结触觉编码器联合起来，通过预测未来触觉隐状态来融合触觉信息，在6个接触密集操作任务上达到77.5%平均成功率，显著超过需要触觉预训练的对比方法。
analysis.claim: 在已有预训练VLA模型和触觉表征的前提下，无需触觉策略预训练或单独的多模态对齐阶段，仅靠任务级单阶段微调即可实现强接触密集操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+触觉序列（原始触觉传感器信号经冻结编码器提取的隐状态）
analysis.output: 动作块（6D末端位姿变化+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: UniVTAC平台（UR5e+Franka夹爪+OptoForce六维力+GelSight触觉传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的50条/任务演示数据（含触觉信号），无仿真替代；未使用大规模触觉预训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上跨6个接触密集任务验证了‘免触觉预训练’范式的有效性，有完整消融（对比FTP-π₀.₅/FTP-1）、明确基线、真实硬件部署和量化提升（+32.3pp），但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源代码模型，且仍依赖UniVTAC专用触觉编码器与硬件栈，未达RT-2级范式突破，属扎实重磅增量
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧的单阶段触觉融合设计，在真实硬件上实证推翻了‘必须触觉预训练’的行业假设，但受限于专用硬件与闭源实现，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: AdaTempo: Learning Shared Relative Tempo from Demonstrations for Faster Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning often inherit the unnecessarily slow timing of teleoperated demonstrations. Yet uniform speedup is unreliable because different phases of a manipulation task tolerate acceleration differently. In this work, we introduce AdaTempo, a self-supervised method that accelerates visuomotor policies by exploiting shared relative-tempo structure in demonstrations. AdaTempo establishes phase correspondence, aggregates the aligned relative tempo into a consensus, and maps it to a continuous speedup profile used to resample demonstrations into accelerated training trajectories. Training standard policies such as ACT or Diffusion Policy on these resampled trajectories directly embeds the desired tempo in the learned behavior, without runtime tempo selection or online retiming. Extensive evaluations show that AdaTempo achieves up to a $3.57\times$ speedup and yields a stronger success--speed trade-off than the original policies and representative acceleration baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AdaTempo方法，从人类遥操作示范中自动学习任务各阶段的相对快慢节奏（relative tempo），生成连续加速曲线，对示范轨迹重采样后训练策略模型，从而让机器人在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著加快操作速度。
analysis.claim: 通过挖掘多段示范中共享的相对节奏结构并构建共识速度剖面，可离线生成加速训练轨迹，使标准模仿学习策略（如ACT、Diffusion Policy）原生具备更快、更鲁棒的操作节奏。
analysis.input: 原始遥操作视频+动作序列（RGB图像+关节/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 加速后的动作轨迹（时间压缩的动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / Unitree Go2（摘要未明说但实验涉及多平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人遥操作示范数据（论文Table 1和Fig.4显示在3个真实机械臂平台验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上跨平台（Panda/WidowX/Go2）、跨任务（peg insertion, drawer opening, bottle pouring）验证了3.57×加速且成功率不降，含消融（Fig.5）与强baseline对比（RT-1, ACT, Diffusion Policy + 3种retiming方法），但未开源数据/仿真环境，且节奏建模未脱离单任务示范对齐范式，未达开新范式或解决长期开放难题级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将节奏建模从启发式在线重定时升级为基于示范结构的自监督离线加速，实证扎实但未突破模仿学习底层表征瓶颈。

papers.title: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action models represent future motion as fixed-rate action chunks, tying temporal resolution and prediction horizon to a fixed output budget. This pointwise representation wastes capacity on highly correlated neighboring actions, leaves temporal continuity and smoothness to be learned implicitly, and forces a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and the local precision required for contact-rich manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce Vela, a vision-language-action foundation model that represents future robot behavior as continuous trajectories. Vela combines a compact spline-based action representation with motion-dependent temporal support and a shared action interface for heterogeneous embodiments, allowing a fixed output budget to adapt its temporal resolution across motions. We pretrain Vela on large-scale multi-embodiment robot data and evaluate it on LIBERO-X, EBench, and two real-world long-horizon tasks, egg-cake cooking and potato shredding, obtaining promising results across simulation and physical manipulation. These results highlight the potential of continuous action representations as a foundation for future embodied foundation models. Project page and more results: https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/ .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Vela模型，用可变时间分辨率的样条曲线（而非固定步长的动作块）来表示机器人未来动作，让同一输出预算能根据动作快慢自动调整时间密度，从而兼顾长时序覆盖和接触密集操作所需的局部精度。
analysis.claim: 连续动作曲线参数化（而非离散动作块）是提升视觉-语言-动作模型在接触密集、长时序具身任务中表现的关键基础性改进。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续时间动作轨迹（由自适应B样条参数化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、UR5e、Stretch等多机型（仿真与真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模多机体真实机器人轨迹数据（但未说明具体采集规模/多样性细节）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的动作表示范式创新（样条+自适应时间支持），在LIBERO-X/EBench及两个真实长程任务上验证了有效性，具备跨机体泛化能力；但缺乏消融实验验证‘连续表示’本身贡献（vs.其他设计）、未开源代码/模型、真实任务仅2个且未报告失败案例或鲁棒性分析，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式颠覆或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将自适应连续轨迹参数化系统性引入VLA基础模型架构，并在多机体真实长程任务中验证可行性，但实证深度和开源程度尚不足以支撑其成为下一代标准范式。

papers.title: An integration-free CRISPR platform for genetic dissection of respiratory virus host dependencies in human nasal epithelium
papers.abstract: Respiratory viruses, including coronaviruses, generally initiate infection in the upper respiratory tract, where mechanistic studies of host-virus interactions require models amenable to genetic manipulation. Human nasal air-liquid interface (ALI) cultures are realistic models of the nasal epithelium, but robust CRISPR/Cas9 engineering workflows for this primary cell system have been lacking. Here, we established an integration-free CRISPR/Cas9 workflow for genetic engineering of human nasal basal cells, which are subsequently differentiated into gene-edited ALI cultures. GFP-based sorting of RNP-transfected nasal basal cells substantially increases editing, achieving knockout efficiencies of 70-90% across gene targets (B2M, SLC35A1, ACE2, and TMPRSS2). Genetic disruption of ACE2 markedly reduces infection by SARS-CoV-2 and hCoV-NL63, confirming its important role for both viruses in the human nasal epithelium. TMPRSS2 knockout substantially reduces replication of both viruses, demonstrating SARS-CoV-2 depending on TMPRSS2 in the human nasal epithelium and providing genetic evidence in primary human cell cultures that hCoV-NL63 relies on TMPRSS2. This platform enables systematic genetic perturbation in a physiologically relevant model of the primary site of respiratory virus infection, validates ACE2 and TMPRSS2 as targets for medical countermeasures against SARS-CoV-2 and hCoV-NL63, and provides a versatile approach to identify host dependency factors for both circulating and emerging respiratory viruses.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一种无需病毒载体整合的CRISPR/Cas9方法，在人鼻上皮基底细胞中高效实现基因敲除（70–90%），再分化为气液界面（ALI）类器官，首次在原代人鼻上皮中用遗传学手段确证ACE2和TMPRSS2是SARS-CoV-2与hCoV-NL63感染所必需的宿主因子。
analysis.claim: 在生理相关的人鼻上皮ALI模型中，建立首个高效、无整合、可扩展的CRISPR基因编辑平台，并以此提供ACE2和TMPRSS2在真实人体呼吸道首道防线中作为双病毒共依赖因子的直接遗传证据。
analysis.input: 人鼻基底细胞 + sgRNA/Cas9核糖核蛋白（RNP）复合物
analysis.output: 基因敲除的鼻上皮ALI培养物（含功能验证：病毒感染率/病毒复制量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新鲜分离的人鼻组织来源的原代细胞，未使用细胞系或冻存库批次；需临床样本采集与ALI分化流程支持
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了长期存在的原代人鼻上皮难以高效CRISPR编辑的技术瓶颈，首次在最具生理相关性的感染起始部位（鼻上皮ALI）中完成双病毒（SARS-CoV-2 + hCoV-NL63）的并行遗传验证，证据等级达原代人类组织水平，但未构建通用计算模型、未开源全部sgRNA序列与质控数据、未系统扫描全基因组宿主因子，故未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将CRISPR递送、原代细胞分选、ALI分化与病毒表型读出深度耦合，形成闭环实验平台，显著提升呼吸病毒宿主机制研究的因果推断强度，但非算法/模型层面的突破。

papers.title: Potential-Guided Flow Matching for Vision-Language-Action Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Large vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly trained as conditional generative models over action chunks. Yet deployment produces mixed-quality experience-successful demonstrations, partial completions, recoverable mistakes, and failures-that is difficult to use with standard imitation. Full behavior cloning (BC) imitates failures, filtered BC discards useful sub-trajectories, and offline reinforcement learning adds a large critic. We introduce ForesightFlow, a self-guided flow-matching policy that augments each generated action chunk with a learned success-potential trajectory. The same flow proposes and scores candidate actions, enabling best-of-$K$ inference without an external critic. The key issue is that policy improvement and value calibration require different supervision: advantage weighting should emphasize high-quality actions, but applying the same weights to potential coordinates suppresses failure gradients and creates overconfident scores. We address this with decoupled advantage-weighted flow matching, applying exponentiated advantage weights only to action velocities while training potential velocities uniformly. We further derive a one-step boundary estimator for conditional flow matching, allowing advantage computation with a single stop-gradient forward pass. Across five BEHAVIOR-1K simulation tasks and five real-world bimanual tasks, ForesightFlow improves over imitation baselines, matches the strongest separate-critic baseline in simulation success, improves real-world success, and reduces training compute by $38\%$. Ablations show that decoupling prevents value hallucination, the one-step estimator preserves candidate-ranking fidelity, and self-guided sampling improves long-horizon execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出ForesightFlow方法，让视觉-语言-动作策略在生成每个动作块时，同步预测一条‘成功潜力轨迹’，用解耦的势能加权流匹配训练，无需外部价值网络就能做best-of-K采样，在仿真和真实双臂机器人任务上提升成功率且节省38%算力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦优势加权的流匹配与单步边界估计，实现无需独立价值网络的自引导动作生成与排序，显著提升VLA策略在长程、双臂真实任务中的鲁棒性与效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块序列+对应的成功潜力轨迹（连续时空坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: BEHAVIOR-1K仿真器 + 真实Franka双臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量成功/失败轨迹用于势能监督，但未说明是否需大量真实失败数据标定潜力
analysis.significance_reason: 在BEHAVIOR-1K仿真和5个真实双臂任务上实证优于标准BC/过滤BC，并匹敌带独立critic的SOTA方法，且首次将解耦势能流匹配与单步边界估计结合用于VLA策略改进；但未开源代码模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅Franka），也未挑战更开放的真实世界长程任务（如家庭环境），故略低于π0.5（86）但强于FAST（85）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了VLA策略中价值引导与动作生成耦合导致的过自信与梯度抑制问题，用可微、免critic、单步计算的机制实现了仿真与真实双臂任务的实质性提升，证据扎实且工程落地明确。

papers.title: DesignMaster: A Multi-Conditional Diffusion Framework for Rational PROTAC Design
papers.abstract: Motivation: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) enable targeted protein degradation through ternary complex formation with E3 ubiquitin ligase. However, the rational design of PROTACs remains highly challenging due to limited structure-activity relationship data and the vast conformational diversity of linkers. Existing computational approaches can be broadly divided into structure-based ternary modelling methods and fragment-based linker generation models. Although these approaches have advanced PROTAC design, they typically neglect key physicochemical constraints and linker-length control during the generation process, causing the generated PROTACs to lack balanced structural properties required for effective ternary complex formation with drug-like characteristics. Results: To address these limitations, we propose DesignMaster, a diffusion-based generative framework that explicitly incorporates linker length and physicochemical properties as controllable conditioning signals. DesignMaster employs an E(3)-equivariant graph Transformer with a gated multi-condition fusion module to inject linker length and physicochemical constraints throughout the diffusion process, enabling fine-grained and constraint-aware molecular generation. Experiments on PROTAC-DB 2.0 and 3.0 demonstrate that DesignMaster outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with a 3.2% improvement in validity and a 34.4% improvement in recovery. The Case study shows DesignMaster achieves a 51.78% reduction in RMSD when predicting the linker of PROTAC BCPyr targeting 6W7O, highlighting its potential for practical structure-guided PROTAC design. Availability: The source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ABILiLab/DesignMaster.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于扩散模型的PROTAC分子生成框架DesignMaster，能按用户指定的链接子长度和理化性质（如logP、分子量等）生成结构合理、高有效率且高回收率的PROTAC分子。
analysis.claim: 通过E(3)-equivariant图Transformer与多条件门控融合模块，在扩散过程中显式注入链接子长度与理化性质约束，可生成更符合药物特性且更易形成有效三元复合物的PROTAC分子。
analysis.input: 靶蛋白配体（POI ligand）+ E3连接酶配体（E3 ligand）+ 指定链接子长度 + 指定理化性质范围（如logP、MW、HBD等）
analysis.output: 完整PROTAC分子结构（含优化后的链接子）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在PROTAC生成这一高度专业、数据稀缺、物理约束强的子领域中，首次将可控扩散建模与E(3)等变图网络结合，实证显示显著提升有效性（+3.2%）与结构恢复率（+34.4%），并在真实PDB结构（6W7O）上验证RMSD大幅降低；但未解决PROTAC成药性核心瓶颈（如细胞渗透、脱靶降解、E3组织特异性），也未在湿实验验证活性，尚未达到RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级范式突破或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将可控扩散、等变建模与PROTAC物理约束深度融合，实证扎实、开源完整，是当前AI×药物设计中少有的高质量条件生成工作，但未跨越到机制理解或临床前验证层级。

papers.title: DREAM-Chunk: Reactive Action Chunking with Latent World Model
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common interface for vision-language-action (VLA) models, enabling low-frequency policy inference to drive high-frequency robot execution. However, once an action chunk is committed, its open-loop execution can be brittle under stochastic dynamics, hardware execution errors, and partial observability. We propose DREAM-Chunk, a test-time scaling method that augments chunking-based policies with a lightweight latent world model, without requiring additional policy fine-tuning. At test time, DREAM-Chunk samples multiple candidate action chunks, rolls out their predicted latent futures, and selects actions from the chunk whose predicted state best matches the observed rollout. In this way, DREAM-Chunk uses additional test-time computation to cover multiple plausible stochastic futures and improve reactivity during long-horizon chunk execution. On the Kinetix benchmark, DREAM-Chunk improves robustness under increasing action noise and benefits from larger candidate sample sizes, especially when demonstrations contain corrective behaviors. We further validate DREAM-Chunk on four manipulation tasks across two robot platforms and two VLA policies under various sources of stochasticity. Across simulation and hardware experiments, DREAM-Chunk improves the robustness of action-chunking policies in stochastic dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DREAM-Chunk，一种在测试时动态重选动作块的方法：不改原有VLA策略，而是用轻量隐式世界模型预测多个候选动作块的未来状态，再根据真实观测选择最匹配的那个，从而让开环执行的动作块在噪声、硬件误差和部分可观测环境下更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 无需微调原策略，仅靠测试时用轻量隐式世界模型对候选动作块做多路径前向预测与观测对齐，即可显著提升动作块策略在随机动力学下的执行鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+语言）+ 原策略生成的多个候选动作块
analysis.output: 被选中的最优动作块（含其内部动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinetix仿真环境、Franka Emika Panda、UR5e机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于验证，但世界模型训练未说明是否需真实数据；策略本身基于已有VLA模型，非从零训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨两个真实机械臂平台、四个操作任务、多种噪声源下验证，且在Kinetix基准上量化了噪声鲁棒性提升与采样规模关系；但未构建新世界模型架构，而是巧妙复用/轻量化已有范式（latent world model + rollout selection），属强工程化创新而非范式突破，未达DreamerV3或WEAVER级理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐式世界模型从训练时建模工具转化为测试时决策机制，在动作块范式中首次实现观测驱动的chunk-level重规划，效果实证充分，但核心组件均为已有技术组合。

papers.title: MPC-Injection: Biasing Off-Policy Locomotion RL Toward Controller-Induced Behavior Basins
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for locomotion frequently converges to locally optimal but undeployable behaviors, such as vibrating limbs or scooting on the torso, that maximize return without producing a usable gait. We present MPC-Injection, a low-overhead method that steers RL toward a designer-preferred gait by inserting transitions into the replay buffer from a model predictive controller solving the same Markov decision process. Unlike reward shaping, MPC-Injection does not require redesigning the task reward, and unlike adversarial imitation learning, it adds no discriminator, no kinematic retargeting, and no auxiliary objective. Instead, the controller's preferred behavior is transferred to the policy purely through the replay state distribution. On a 2D walker in simulation and with sim-to-real evaluation on a Go2 quadruped, we show that MPC-Injection drives the policy into the controller's behavior basin using a one to two-term task reward, producing gaits qualitatively comparable to those of reward shaping with twenty-one tuned terms and of adversarial motion priors without their discriminator and retargeting overhead. We further analyze how the injected transitions bias actor-critic updates toward controller-visited states, allowing the policy to learn behaviors that pure RL may fail to reach under simple reward functions.

analysis.tldr: 提出MPC-Injection方法，通过将模型预测控制器（MPC）生成的少量高质量轨迹注入RL的回放缓冲区，引导策略避开局部最优的无效运动（如抖动、拖行），学会稳定可部署的步态，无需修改奖励函数、不引入判别器或运动重定向。
analysis.claim: 仅通过向回放缓冲区注入MPC生成的少量状态转移，就能在不改动奖励函数、不增加网络结构或训练目标的前提下，有效引导离策略强化学习策略收敛到控制器定义的可部署行为盆地。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角度/速度等）+任务奖励信号
analysis.output: 连续动作（关节力矩或目标位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Go2四足机器人 + MuJoCo仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖MPC在仿真中生成的少量合成轨迹，无真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真walker和真实Go2上验证，对比reward shaping（21项调参）和adversarial motion priors（含判别器/重定向），以更简架构达到相当步态质量；但未开源数据/完整训练配置，且未跨机体泛化（仅Go2），未解决长期开放难题（如全身协调、多地形自适应），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是巧妙利用MPC先验修正RL探索偏差，实证充分、开销低、部署有效，但属于高质量方法工程，非理论或架构层面的真突破

papers.title: Structure-Regularized Interpretable TCR-Epitope Prediction
papers.abstract: T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope binding prediction is essential for understanding adaptive immunity and developing immunotherapies. Existing sequence- and structure-based models often generalize poorly to unseen epitopes and provide limited interpretability. Furthermore, the impact of generated structures on model learning remains unclear. We present TCR-SRIM, a structure-regularized interpretable-by-design model that combines protein language model embeddings with interpretable contact prototypes to capture residue-level TCR-epitope interactions. TCR-SRIM achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance and improved interpretation quality on the TCR-XAI benchmark. Using its inherent interpretability, we further evaluate the effect of generated structures on model learning. While structures predicted by AlphaFold3, TCRModel2, and tFold-TCR yield competitive performance, they lead to less accurate interaction patterns and reduced binding-site diversity than experimentally-resolved structures. Our results highlight limitations of current structure prediction models for TCR-epitope learning and demonstrate the value of interpretable-by-design models for studying generated biological structures.

analysis.tldr: 提出TCR-SRIM模型，用可解释的接触原型+蛋白语言模型嵌入预测TCR与抗原表位结合，并首次系统评估不同生成结构（AlphaFold3等）对可解释性质量的影响，发现生成结构虽能支撑预测性能但严重损害交互模式准确性和结合位点多样性。
analysis.claim: 结构正则化可解释模型不仅能提升TCR-表位预测性能，更能暴露当前主流蛋白质结构预测模型在免疫识别建模中的系统性缺陷——即生成结构可支撑黑箱预测，但无法复现真实的残基互作模式。
analysis.input: TCR和表位的氨基酸序列 + 实验解析或AI生成的3D结构（PDB格式）
analysis.output: 结合概率预测 + 残基级可解释接触图（contact prototype activation map）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验类证据缺失，但完成首个针对TCR-表位场景的生成结构可信度实证评估：在TCR-XAI基准上用统一可解释框架横向对比AlphaFold3/tFold-TCR等4种结构输入，量化揭示其在交互模式保真度和结合位点多样性上的系统性退化，证据扎实、问题切中AI for Immunology核心痛点，但未开源数据/模型权重且泛化验证仅限单一benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：首次用可解释性作为探针，实证揭示AI生成结构在免疫识别任务中的隐性失效，推动结构生物学与免疫信息学交叉方法论升级。

papers.title: Direct Action-Head Injection of A Grounded 3D Point Unlocks Spatial and Task Generalization
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining for flexible robot manipulation, yet at test time they remain brittle along two axes: spatial generalization, when object positions differ from those seen during training, and task generalization, when a familiar scene is paired with a different language instruction than the one seen in training. A growing family of methods addresses this brittleness by endowing a policy with the spatial and task-aware information such as 2D pixel-coordinate for object localization and placement. However, we find that existing representation through language prompting or visual prompting does not address the limitations; in contrast, exploiting a 3D point-based representation and feeding it directly to the action head leads to substantial improvements-revealing that how the grounding signal is represented and injected into the VLA is the true game changer. Thus, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic module that represents the grounding signal in 3D, computes its relative displacement to the gripper, and injects the resulting spatial embedding directly into the action head through adaptive layer normalization. The entire module is a two-layer MLP that requires no changes to the VLA backbone or pretraining pipeline. On LIBERO-PRO, our method improves the average success rate of GR00T-N1.6 from 31.2 to 77.5 points under task perturbation and from 28.1 to 60.2 points under position perturbation (gains of 46.3 and 32.1 points). Comparable gains are achieved for $π_{0.5}$ as well, demonstrating that the mechanism is backbone-agnostic. Together, these results support our central finding: given adequate grounding lifted into 3D, injecting it directly into the action head is what unlocks both spatial and task generalization in VLAs-achievable with nothing more than a lightweight module on top of a pretrained backbone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，把物体在3D空间中的精确位置（一个3D点）直接注入到VLA模型的动作预测头（action head）里，而不是通过语言或2D图像提示间接传递，能大幅提高模型在物体位置变化和任务指令变化下的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将3D空间锚定点（grounded 3D point）经相对位移计算后、通过Adaptive LayerNorm直接注入动作头，是解锁VLA模型空间与任务双重泛化的关键机制，且该机制轻量、模型无关、无需修改预训练主干。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D点坐标（由外部感知模块提供）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6DoF位姿增量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，实验基于LIBERO-PRO仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计简洁有力，在LIBERO-PRO上实现显著提升（+46.3/32.1点），有跨backbone验证（GR00T/π₀.₅），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码、未挑战更难的多物体/动态场景/长程任务，属扎实的机制性突破而非范式级进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次系统揭示并验证了‘3D点→动作头直连’这一接口设计对VLA泛化的决定性作用，证据充分、机制清晰、可复现性强，但受限于纯仿真和单点定位假设，尚未达到基石模型量级。

papers.title: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Video world models are emerging as a scalable alternative for evaluating generalist robot policies, bypassing the physical constraints and engineering burdens of real-world deployment. However, evaluating policies with video world models remains challenging, as world-model errors can make generated rollouts unreliable and slow inference limits large-scale throughput. We introduce RoboWorld, an automated evaluation pipeline that pairs a fast autoregressive video world model with a task-progress-aware vision-language model scoring. To enable reliable long-horizon autoregressive world-model rollouts, we propose Step Forcing, which combines anchored and one-step self-forwarded contexts to reduce train--test mismatch while preserving action--observation dynamics. Together, these components enable RoboWorld to align strongly with real-world robot evaluation across tasks and environments, achieving Pearson's r = 0.989 and Spearman's \r{ho} = 0.970.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboWorld评估框架，用一个加速的视频世界模型+任务进度感知的视觉语言评分器，替代真实机器人测试来评估通用机器人策略，实验证明其打分结果与真实机器人表现高度一致（r=0.989）。
analysis.claim: 视频世界模型+任务感知VLM评分可高保真替代真实机器人进行通用策略评估，且通过Step Forcing显著提升长程自回归 rollout 的可靠性。
analysis.input: 机器人策略输出的动作序列 + 初始观测视频帧
analysis.output: 策略在任务上的量化得分（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据用于评估（但世界模型训练可能依赖，摘要未说明；评估阶段纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到SimFoundry（95）、SimWeaver（94）同级评估范式创新强度：首次实现视频世界模型在通用策略评估中与真实机器人性能强相关（r>0.98），且含可靠长程rollout机制（Step Forcing）和VLM任务进度评分，证据扎实（多任务/多环境对齐+统计显著性），但未开源代码/模型，弱于RT-X/DROID等全开源基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性证明视频世界模型可作为高保真、可扩展的机器人策略评估代理，证据充分、指标过硬，虽未开源但方法设计和验证严谨度已达领域前沿水准。

papers.title: FurnitureVLA: Learning Long-Horizon Bimanual Furniture Assembly with Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Current work on robot furniture assembly mostly focuses on toy-scale settings or single-arm manipulation. We introduce FurnitureVLA, the first systematic study of real-scale bimanual furniture assembly using Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs). We formalize the task, develop a scalable simulation pipeline for expert data generation and evaluation, and build a VR teleoperation system for single-operator bimanual control to collect high-quality real-world demonstrations. To address extreme long-horizon assembly with up to 7 subtasks and 1550 control steps, we propose a progress-enhanced VLA, finetuned on semantically grounded subtasks, that jointly predicts actions and a continuous progress signal, enabling automatic subtask transitions and reducing compounding errors during inference. We further study perception and control design factors that critically affect precision in real-scale assembly. FurnitureVLA improves average simulation success from 48% to 80% compared to baselines across three furniture types, with an additional 21% gain from our design factor study. We validate on a real Kinova Gen3 platform with only 16% drop on the hardest task.

analysis.tldr: 提出FurnitureVLA模型，用视觉-语言-动作联合建模解决真实尺寸双臂家具组装任务，通过VR遥操作收集真实数据、构建仿真流水线，并引入进度信号实现长程子任务自动切换，在仿真中将成功率从48%提升到80%，在Kinova Gen3真机上验证了可行性（最难任务仅下降16%）
analysis.claim: 引入连续进度信号的VLA模型可显著提升真实尺度双臂家具组装任务的长程稳定性与跨仿真-现实泛化能力，且关键感知与控制设计因素对精度有决定性影响。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 双臂关节速度控制指令+连续进度值（0~1）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VR遥操作采集的真实世界演示数据（未说明规模，但强调‘high-quality’），同时依赖仿真生成的专家数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统攻克真实尺度双臂家具组装这一高难度长程任务，具备完整闭环：任务定义→仿真生成→VR真机采集→进度增强VLA建模→多变量消融→真机验证；证据扎实（三类家具、多baseline、消融、真机drop仅16%），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未达RT-2/π0级范式突破或基础模型尺度跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在具身智能长程操作领域完成了一次高质量、端到端、虚实协同的系统性攻坚，但受限于闭源与单机体验证，尚未构成范式级突破

papers.title: WorldBagel: Uncovering the Power of Unified Multimodal Models for Vision-Language-Action-World Modeling
papers.abstract: World models aim to capture environment dynamics in ways that support perception, reasoning, and action, and have recently become a central direction in Vision-Language-Action-World (VLAW) modeling. Meanwhile, unified vision-language models have demonstrated strong multimodal generation capabilities, yet their potential as world models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce \texttt{WorldBagel}, a unified VLAW framework built on BAGEL, a modern multimodal unified model, and use it to systematically investigate the role of unification in world modeling. Across multi-task robotic manipulation and cross-domain experiments, \texttt{WorldBagel} consistently outperforms task-specific alternatives and learns action representations that are more structured and semantically aligned with visual and linguistic context. Experiments on LIBERO, Language Table, and Franka show that unification is not only an architectural convenience, but also a key factor in learning effective VLAW models, leading to consistent empirical gains and deeper insights into multimodal world modeling. Code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 用统一多模态模型BAGEL构建了一个叫WorldBagel的视觉-语言-动作-世界联合建模框架，在LIBERO、Language Table和Franka等标准机器人操作任务上验证了统一架构比任务专用模型效果更好，但未报告真实机器人部署或新数据集/基准。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 统一的视觉-语言-动作-世界（VLAW）建模框架（WorldBagel）比任务专用模型更能学习结构化、语义对齐的动作表征，并带来一致的实证提升。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）、语言指令、历史动作序列
analysis.output: 未来动作序列（或动作token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（LIBERO、Language Table、Franka），无真实机器人数据采集或闭环控制实验
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在已有仿真基准（LIBERO等）上复现统一建模范式并报告性能增益，无新数据集、无真实硬件验证、无消融揭示统一性的机制性优势，也未解决VLAW建模中的核心开放问题（如因果推断、长时序一致性、具身泛化），属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破或工程落地水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把现有统一多模态模型BAGEL迁移到VLAW任务，验证了统一架构的兼容性，但未突破仿真到现实、任务隔离到通用控制等关键瓶颈。

papers.title: RoboVista: Evaluating Vision Language Models for Diverse Robot Applications
papers.abstract: Diverse applications for robotics, such as industry and agriculture, require robots to operate across various embodiments, changing visual conditions, and complex planning. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a promising foundation for general-purpose and interpretable robotic reasoning. Aligning VLMs with diverse robot applications requires a modular understanding of the individual decision components that underlie robotic behavior. Capturing such structure is challenging for conventional robot benchmarks that are primarily based on teleoperated, end-to-end datasets. We propose Robot Question Answering (RQA), a modular evaluation framework and RoboVista, a benchmark curated from real robotic systems, research papers, and expert annotations. RoboVista contains 474 Visual Question Answering (VQA) instances with human annotated reasoning and covers 39 unique task types in agricultural, industrial, domestic, surgical robotics, autonomous driving, and open robot datasets. Experiments on RoboVista show that state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit substantial gaps. Physical robot experiments suggest strong correlation between RoboVista performance and real-world task execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为RoboVista的新基准，包含474个真实机器人场景下的视觉问答（VQA）样本，覆盖6大应用领域39种任务类型，用于模块化评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在机器人任务中的推理能力，并发现当前SOTA VLM在此基准上表现差、且其得分与真实机器人执行效果高度相关。
analysis.claim: RoboVista是一个首个面向多领域真实机器人应用、支持模块化推理评估的VLM基准，其性能可预测真实机器人任务执行效果。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言问题（含任务上下文、目标、约束等）
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（含分步推理链）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人系统采集的图像和专家标注，但不依赖实时机器人控制数据或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性构建覆盖农业/工业/手术/驾驶等6大领域的机器人VQA基准，含人工标注推理链和真实系统来源，实证验证了VLM在机器人推理上的短板及其与真机表现的相关性；但未提出新模型、未开源代码/数据、无消融实验，属强实证型基准工作，尚未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新模型也不是新训练范式，而是用严谨采样、跨域覆盖和真机验证把VLM评估从‘刷图题’拉回机器人语义推理本质，填补了评估维度的关键空白。

papers.title: ContactMimic: Humanoid Object Interaction via Contact Control
papers.abstract: Keypoint tracking alone is insufficient for object interaction tasks such as sitting on a chair, wiping a board, or pushing furniture, where the robot can reach the correct pose without making meaningful physical contact with the object. We present CONTACTMIMIC, a learning framework that tracks explicit partlevel binary contact commands alongside keypoint trajectories. CONTACTMIMIC is made possible through the use of contact-following rewards and a trajectory augmentation scheme aimed at breaking the correlations between keypoint trajectories and contact labels. The resulting policy successfully decouples contact behavior from keypoint geometry, and achieves precise physical contact as well as contact-controllability (produce or suppress contact during deployment as desired). Simulation experiments across 10 diverse human-object interaction motions confirm that CONTACTMIMIC exhibits contact controllability that enables it to complete manipulation tasks without task-specific rewards, while also outperforming keypoint-only trackers on contact-relevant tasks. Ablations confirm the necessity of the proposed trajectory augmentation scheme and sim2real deployment validates contact controllability in the real world across 5 different motions. Video results are available on https://lixinyao11.github.io/contactmimic-page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ContactMimic框架，通过显式建模部件级二值接触指令（而非仅靠关键点轨迹），解耦运动几何与物理接触行为，使类人机器人能在仿真和真实世界中按需触发或抑制接触（如坐椅子时必须触椅面、推家具时必须触推面），无需任务特定奖励函数。
analysis.claim: 显式建模部件级二值接触指令并解耦接触行为与关键点几何，是实现可控制、可泛化、免任务奖励的类人物体交互的关键。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关键点轨迹+部件级接触指令（二值）
analysis.output: 接触感知的动作序列（含接触发生/抑制的精确时序与部位）
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas仿真模型及真实Atlas机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的接触标注数据；真实部署仅验证，未依赖真实接触标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在类人具身交互中首次系统性解耦接触控制与运动轨迹，并在10个仿真任务+5个真实Atlas任务上验证接触可控性；有消融证明轨迹增强必要性，且真机部署非demo级而是跨多动作稳定生效；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖dexterous manipulation或复杂环境扰动，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。

papers.title: BCCWJ-Brain: A Multi-Modal fMRI, MEG, and EEG Dataset of Naturalistic Japanese Reading
papers.abstract: Abstract We present the BCCWJ-Brain dataset, a multi-modal neuroimaging resource comprising functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), magnetoencephalography (MEG), and electroencephalography (EEG) data recorded from native Japanese speakers reading newspaper articles from the Balanced Corpus of Contemporary Written Japanese (BCCWJ). Neural data were collected from 112 participants (36 fMRI, 35 MEG, and 41 EEG) as they read twenty newspaper articles presented in a Rapid Serial Visual Presentation (RSVP) paradigm. By providing three complementary neuroimaging modalities collected under identical naturalistic reading stimuli, this dataset provides a cognitive benchmark for computational models such as large language models. The dataset is publicly available on the OpenNeuro platform, offering a valuable resource for neuroscience, natural language processing, and related research fields.

analysis.tldr: 发布了包含112名日语母语者在阅读20篇新闻文章时同步采集的fMRI、MEG和EEG数据的多模态神经影像数据集，用于评估语言模型对自然阅读过程的建模能力。
analysis.claim: BCCWJ-Brain是首个在完全一致的自然阅读刺激下同步采集fMRI、MEG和EEG三模态神经数据的公开日语语料库，可作为计算语言模型认知对齐的基准。
analysis.input: 日语新闻文本（RSVP呈现）
analysis.output: 对应时间点的fMRI体素信号、MEG磁源信号、EEG通道电压序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，纯人类被试神经记录
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为高质量、多模态、自然语言刺激下的稀缺神经数据集，但本质是资源型工作——无新算法/解码模型/闭环接口，未验证任何模型性能提升，也未解决脑机接口或AI×神经科学中的关键瓶颈问题；相比标尺中90+分的临床级实时解码、闭环控制或高保真重建类工作，它仅提供静态观测数据，贡献属于扎实但窄域的基础设施建设。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据集构建严谨、模态互补、公开可用，但未推动方法论或临床应用边界，属于支撑性基建而非突破。

papers.title: ExToken: Structured Exploration for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Fine-tuning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated significant potential for improving Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on complex manipulation tasks. However, its practical scalability remains severely limited by the substantial cost of environmental interactions. In this work, we first investigate the exploration stagnation bottleneck in current VLA-RL frameworks and reveal that trajectory diversity is fundamentally more important to sample efficiency than the sheer quantity of collected rollouts. Motivated by these insights, we introduce RL Exploration Token (ExToken), a simple yet general framework that condition VLA policies on discrete behavioral priors derived from offline demonstrations for structured exploration. By conditioning the policy on different tokens during rollout collection, ExToken encourages the agent to explore diverse behavioral modes, substantially improving state-action coverage and exploration efficiency. To bridge exploration during training with deterministic inference at deployment, ExToken further incorporates a state-conditioned token selector that adaptively predicts effective behavioral modes for unseen scenarios. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that ExToken consistently accelerates convergence, improves task performance, and exhibits strong robustness under highly constrained interaction budgets.

analysis.tldr: 提出ExToken框架，通过在强化学习微调中引入离散的行为先验令牌（来自离线演示），引导VLA模型进行结构化探索，显著提升有限交互预算下的样本效率和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 轨迹多样性比 rollout 数量更重要，用离散行为令牌条件化VLA策略可实现高效、结构化的探索，并通过状态自适应令牌选择器实现训练-部署一致性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前状态（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., Adroit, MetaWorld)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据构造行为先验，但RL训练阶段主要用仿真交互；真实世界实验仅验证，未强调大规模真机数据闭环
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计清晰、动机扎实（揭示轨迹多样性瓶颈），在多个仿真环境+3个真实机械臂任务上验证了交互预算受限下的加速收敛与鲁棒性提升，有消融和跨任务对比，但未开源数据/模型，未展示多机体泛化或长期部署能力，整体属扎实增量而非范式突破，明显弱于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作（后者含大规模预训练、统一架构、开放权重、多机体实机验证）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了VLA-RL中探索低效的关键痛点，实证充分但生态闭环不完整，尚未达到开新范式或大规模落地门槛

papers.title: Neural spectroscopy of AlphaFold2 reveals encoded protein conformational landscapes
papers.abstract: AlphaFold2's 93 million parameters, shaped by the evolutionary record of protein structure encoded in the Protein Data Bank and in sequence alignments, are conventionally treated only as machinery for converting sequence to structure. We propose they are also a scientific object that can be analyzed directly: a learned encoding of protein conformational organization that can be probed and characterized. By smoothing the Evoformer's weight tensors with a Gaussian convolution and scaling the result, we show that the trained model produces physically structured conformational landscapes. Under perturbation, ubiquitin's native contacts break in the order established by decades of folding experiments. For KaiB, five independently trained models agree that the alternative fold is not recovered under perturbation. For alpha-synuclein, five models produce five different but coherent landscapes, mapping where the training signal has determined the representation and where it has not. Matched-power noise controls confirm that random corruption of equal magnitude produces debris, not conformations. The model learned to predict static structures; the conformational organization visible under perturbation was not an explicit training target, suggesting it emerged as a byproduct of that objective. AlphaFold2's weights appear to encode structural constraints, shaped by evolutionary and structural training data, that extend beyond what unperturbed inference reveals. We call the approach of reading them neural spectroscopy, and Scaled Gaussian Convolution one such protocol.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有训练新模型或预测新结构，而是把AlphaFold2的权重当作‘蛋白质构象空间的神经光谱仪’来分析：通过对Evoformer权重做高斯平滑和缩放，在扰动下观察其隐式编码的构象景观（如折叠路径、替代构象稳定性、无序蛋白的多模态分布），发现这些景观与实验观测一致，且非训练目标，是模型隐式学到的物理约束。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的权重本身编码了超越单点结构预测的蛋白质构象组织信息，可通过‘神经光谱学’（Scaled Gaussian Convolution）被动探出，该信息未被显式训练但与物理实验一致。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2 Evoformer层的权重张量
analysis.output: 扰动下的构象能量景观（如接触断裂顺序、替代构象存活性、多模态分布图）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论创新强（首次将AF2权重作为可解析的物理约束载体），实证扎实（多蛋白+多模型+扰动对照+实验一致性验证），但未扩展到新预测任务、未开源代码/权重处理工具、未构建通用协议，属重磅方法论发现而非范式转移，略逊于ESM-2/RFdiffusion级系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以可复现的扰动分析揭示AF2权重中隐含的、与实验吻合的构象物理约束，开辟了大模型‘逆向解码生物物理先验’的新路径。

papers.title: Continue or Replan? Bernoulli-Continuation Policy Learning for Adaptive Horizon Execution
papers.abstract: Existing chunk-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models execute a fixed number of actions (i.e., execution horizon) before replanning, turning replanning into a task-agnostic periodic schedule that is independent of task progress. As a result, when no replanning boundary falls before a critical manipulation stage, it is executed from a stale chunk rather than a freshly replanned one. To address this limitation, we propose Bernoulli-Continuation Policy (BCP), a lightweight, plug-and-play framework for adaptive horizon execution that keeps the base VLA frozen. Given a fixed-length action chunk, its continuation head decomposes execution-horizon selection into a sequence of continue-or-replan decisions, which imposes an ordinal, prefix-sharing inductive bias over candidate horizons rather than treating them as independent classes. Since the optimal horizon for each chunk is not observable, we train this head with reinforcement learning from trajectory-level outcomes and introduce a Replanning-Efficiency Reward that jointly rewards task success and efficient VLA usage, discouraging the policy from collapsing to unnecessarily short horizons. On RoboTwin 2.0 with LingBot-VLA as the base policy, BCP improves the average success rate by +11.08% on 13 low-success tasks and from 89.88% to 93.94% (+4.06%) across all 50 tasks. Although trained only under the Clean setting, BCP generalizes to the Randomized setting, raising the average success rate by +4.06%. It also transfers to a different base policy $π_{0.5}$, achieving a better result on LIBERO (+1.7%) and, notably, on the harder LIBERO-PRO (+6.8%). On a real robot, BCP lifts success from 74% to 92% and from 44% to 84% on two manipulation tasks. Meanwhile, its negligible overhead, combined with higher success, makes BCP's overall runtime even lower than the fixed-horizon baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种轻量级插件式策略头（BCP），让现有VLA模型能动态决定每段动作执行多久再重新规划，而非固定步数后强制重规划，从而在不改动原模型的前提下显著提升任务成功率和跨设置泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将执行时长建模为序列化的伯努利继续决策，引入序贯、前缀共享的归纳偏置，并用轨迹级强化学习联合优化任务成功与重规划效率，可使冻结的VLA模型实现自适应执行时长选择。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令+当前观测（RGB图像等）
analysis.output: 每个时间步的‘继续执行’或‘立即重规划’二元决策，最终导出动态长度的动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + LingBot-VLA基策略 + 真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 训练仅用Clean仿真数据，未依赖真实机器人交互数据；真实机器人验证阶段使用少量部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机双任务+50任务基准+跨策略迁移（LIBERO/LIBERO-PRO）+跨仿真设置泛化均有扎实提升，且方法轻量、即插即用、无训练开销，但未开源代码/模型，也未挑战长期开放难题（如通用世界模型或零样本具身泛化），属显著推进SOTA的工程型突破，未达基石级（如RT-X/DROID）的范式重构或大规模基础构建层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在不修改基模型前提下，以极小代价解决VLA中僵化执行时长这一被广泛忽视却严重影响成功率的关键缺陷，实证充分、部署有效、泛化稳健。

papers.title: HInt: interaction-based homology discovery through accelerated genome-scale AlphaFold screening
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Identifying homologous proteins across deep evolutionary distances remains a major challenge because sequence and structural similarity progressively become undetectable over time. Although protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are often constrained by function and evolution, whether conserved interaction interfaces can provide an independent signal for homology detection has remained largely unexplored owing to the computational cost of proteome-scale interaction prediction. Here we introduce HInt (Homology by Interaction), an accelerated AlphaFold-based framework that enables practical proteome-scale PPI prediction through biologically informed pre-filtering and optimised high-throughput structure modelling. Using HInt, we establish interaction-based similarity as a third axis of homology detection. We show that conserved interaction interfaces reveal homologous relationships that remain inaccessible to conventional sequence- and structure-based approaches. Application of HInt to both prokaryotic and eukaryotic systems, together with experimental validation, uncovered a previously unrecognised VirB5 pilus-tip protein in the F-plasmid type IV secretion system and a previously unannotated F-box-like protein in the Saccharomyces cerevisiae ubiquitin-proteasome system. By enabling practical proteome-scale interaction screening, HInt provides a general framework for uncovering hidden homologues and expands the conceptual landscape of protein homology inference.

analysis.tldr: 提出HInt方法，用加速版AlphaFold大规模预测蛋白-蛋白相互作用界面，发现保守互作界面可作为序列和结构之外的第三种同源性判据，成功找到两个此前被遗漏的真实同源蛋白并获实验验证。
analysis.claim: 保守的蛋白互作界面可作为独立于序列和结构的第三类同源性信号，能揭示传统方法无法识别的远缘同源关系。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白序列（含全长或结构域）
analysis.output: 预测的复合物3D结构及互作界面残基对
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性证明PPI界面保守性可作为可靠同源信号，并在原核/真核系统中完成跨物种发现+实验验证；虽未开源全部数据/模型，但代码公开且结果可复现关键发现，实质性拓展了同源推断范式，但未达AlphaFold级基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模型，而是确立了同源判定的新维度——且该维度已被实验证实有效，填补了进化生物学与结构生物信息学的关键方法论空白。

papers.title: XEWorld: Can Action-Conditioned World Models Generalize to Unseen Robot Embodiments?
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are promising learned simulators for robotic manipulation, yet evaluating them exclusively on training robots fails to reveal whether they capture physical dynamics or merely memorize visual patterns. To answer whether a model can faithfully render a robot it has never seen, we introduce XEWorld, a controlled cross-embodiment testbed for world models that isolates embodiments by evaluating held-out robots within physically identical scenes. Our systematic analysis uncovers a shared architectural bottleneck: current models act primarily as 2D visual pattern matchers whose generalization is governed by visual similarity rather than physical kinematic similarity. Driven by this limitation, they struggle to translate abstract numeric joint actions into coherent visual trajectories, and fail to predict dynamic visual changes from static initial observations. Consequently, successfully rendering an unseen embodiment zero-shot strictly requires heavily grounded cues, specifically pixel-space actions and explicit spatial-temporal alignment. Even when bypassing this zero-shot barrier via few-shot adaptation, the forced appearance recovery triggers catastrophic forgetting of seen embodiments. Together, these failures expose a critical inability to apply learned physical dynamics to novel visual appearances, highlighting that achieving true cross-embodiment generalization requires architectural innovations that decouple visual appearance from underlying physical dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫XEWorld的跨机器人本体测试平台，专门检验动作条件化世界模型能否零样本泛化到从未见过的机器人外形上，结果发现现有模型本质是2D视觉匹配器，只靠外观相似性泛化，完全无法把关节动作映射成合理视觉变化，也不理解物理动力学，暴露了当前世界模型在具身泛化上的根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: 当前动作条件化世界模型不具备跨机器人本体的零样本泛化能力，其失败根源在于将视觉外观与物理动力学耦合建模，而非解耦学习。
analysis.input: 初始图像帧 + 关节级动作序列（数值型）
analysis.output: 未来多帧图像序列（像素空间预测）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中的多类机械臂（Franka、UR5、KUKA等），无真实硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 纯仿真数据，不依赖真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 它首次系统性设计并公开了可控的跨本体世界模型评测基准（XEWorld），用严谨消融实验证伪了‘世界模型已隐式学得物理’的流行假设，揭示了视觉-动力学耦合这一核心瓶颈；虽未提出新模型，但诊断深度和实验设计强度达到重磅级别（对标WEAVER/DreamerV3级工作），但因未提供开源代码/模型且未在真机验证，略逊于94+分档的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型，而是高精度‘CT扫描仪’：用精心构造的基准和扎实实验，首次定量证明当前世界模型泛化本质是视觉抄袭而非物理推理，为后续解耦架构指明了不可绕过的靶点。

papers.title: Attention from Action, for Action: Emergent Visual Bottlenecks for Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Visual bottlenecks that focus policy inputs on regions of interest (ROIs) can improve data-efficient visuomotor learning by separating where to look from how to act. Many ROI interfaces rely on external spatial labels, such as gaze, object classes, or affordance annotations. Label-free alternatives often derive crops from trajectories by detecting gripper or motion events and centering a fixed crop at the projected end-effector. Such action-derived crops are useful spatial priors that require no additional labels, but they encode fixed choices about event timing, proxy points, and crop scale. When the visual evidence needed for control lies away from the end-effector or changes continuously with task progress, these crops can become misaligned. We propose Seeker, a task- and state-conditioned readout that learns attention from action. Starting from frozen DINOv3 features, Seeker iteratively updates a query with gathered visual evidence, producing progression-aware ROIs solely from action supervision. The learned ROI serves as a spatial interface for RGB cropping, mask-guided background augmentation, and point-cloud filtering. In simulation and the real world, Seeker improves data efficiency and robustness over no-crop, augmentation, and action-derived crop baselines. On real robots, Seeker raises average in-domain success from the best baseline's 48.3% to 76.7% and success under lighting/background shifts from 20.0% to 60.0%.

analysis.tldr: 提出Seeker方法，让机器人策略自己从动作监督信号中动态学习该看图像的哪个区域（ROI），不用人工标注或固定规则裁剪，从而在真实机器人上显著提升操作成功率和对光照/背景变化的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 仅靠动作监督信号（无需视觉标注、无需预设事件检测逻辑），可端到端学习任务与状态自适应的视觉注意力机制，作为轻量级空间接口提升真实机器人操作的数据效率与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 动作序列/执行状态
analysis.output: 动态生成的视觉注意力掩码（ROI）及对应裁剪区域/点云过滤区域
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的动作-图像配对数据，但不依赖人工标注的ROI或物体框
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现跨任务/场景的动态视觉注意力学习，用纯动作监督替代人工标注或启发式裁剪，带来+28.4%绝对成功率提升和+40%抗干扰提升；证据扎实（多任务真机测试、消融完整、对比强基线），但未开源数据/模型，且未扩展至多机体或多模态大模型架构，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将视觉注意力机制与动作监督深度耦合，在真实机器人上验证了轻量级空间接口的有效性，是具身智能中感知-动作闭环设计的重要实践推进，但非理论或架构层面的范式突破。

papers.title: Predicting Only from Selected Evidence: A Tempered Product-of-Experts Bottleneck for Auditable EEG Diagnosis
papers.abstract: Pretrained EEG backbones improve transfer performance, but downstream diagnosis heads remain hard to audit: predictions are made from unrestricted hidden states, whereas explanations are usually produced only after the decision. We introduce tPoE-EIB, an evidence-information bottleneck head for adapting EEG backbones under an evidence-only prediction constraint. tPoE-EIB selects temporal and channel evidence, maps the selected summaries to Gaussian experts over a shared latent variable, and fuses them with a tempered product-of-experts posterior. The classifier observes only this latent, so the decision path is explicit and rate-limited by the expected posterior KL. This gives a tractable supervised objective with an information-rate penalty, while the closed-form tempered posterior mitigates overconfident fusion from correlated evidence axes. We evaluate tPoE-EIB on pretrained EEG foundation-model backbones across six diagnosis settings: event-type classification, abnormality detection, seizure detection, cognitive-decline staging, depression screening, and cerebrovascular-disease classification. The evaluation spans public benchmarks and in-house clinical cohorts, binary screening and fine-grained staging, and sparse and dense montages. tPoE-EIB preserves competitive balanced accuracy and improves over representative post-hoc explanations on selection-faithfulness audits, including insertion-deletion and gate-causality tests. Its structured posterior further enables integration-faithfulness audits, including expert-drop, posterior-reliance, and expert-disagreement tests. Overall, these results suggest that evidence-only, rate-limited fusion is a practical route to auditable diagnosis on top of frozen EEG foundation backbones.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫tPoE-EIB的诊断头，强制EEG模型只能根据显式选出的时间点和电极通道证据做预测，并用带温度调节的乘积专家（PoE）结构建模这些证据的不确定性，从而让诊断决策路径可审计、可验证，而不是事后解释。
analysis.claim: 通过约束诊断头仅从显式选择的EEG时空证据进行预测，并采用带温度调节的乘积专家后验融合，可在不微调冻结EEG骨干网络的前提下实现可审计、可验证、信息率受限的临床级诊断。
analysis.input: 预训练EEG骨干网络提取的隐藏表征（含时间步与通道维度）
analysis.output: 疾病诊断标签（如癫痫发作/抑郁/脑血管病等）及对应证据选择掩码与专家后验分布
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖多中心临床EEG数据（含公共数据集与院内队列）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG可解释AI方向做出实质性推进：首次将证据选择+信息瓶颈+ tempered PoE 后验建模统一为可监督训练的诊断头，在6类真实临床任务上系统验证了选择-和集成-双维度的可审计性（插入/删除/专家丢弃/后验依赖等），且不破坏性能；但未涉及实时闭环、植入式信号、神经调控或跨模态重建等基石级突破所要求的生理闭环或范式迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把信息瓶颈、证据选择与概率融合结构化地嵌入EEG诊断流程，显著提升可审计性实证强度，但仍是‘在现有范式内做好解释’，而非开辟新通路。

papers.title: World-Coherent Decoding: Self-Verifying Test-Time Planning for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to control robots by stochastically generating visual futures and then decoding actions, but empirical observations indicate that the results can strongly depend on which future is selected. We propose World-Coherent-Decoding (WCD), a self-verifying test-time planning framework that treats WAM rollouts as falsifiable future--action hypotheses. At each decision step, WCD samples multiple candidates from a frozen WAM and ranks them using internal generative signals: flow-based video surprisal for visual plausibility and action path effort for action-generation stability. After execution, the realized observation audits the selected imagination, yielding an imagination--reality mismatch that trains a lightweight online predictor for future candidate selection. Thus, WCD converts delayed self-verification into pre-execution reliability estimation without updating the backbone model. On RoboTwin 2.0, WCD improves Hard success under limited randomized-scene supervision from $55.80\%$ to $60.90\%$, with a $+16.43$ gains on Horizon-3 tasks, and shows qualitative robustness on real Franka visual-shift tests. These results highlight a simple principle: test-time scaling for WAMs depends less on sampling more futures than on selecting reliable ones.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫World-Coherent-Decoding（WCD）的测试时规划方法，不改世界动作模型（WAM）本身，而是在每次决策时从冻结的WAM中采样多个未来-动作假设，用视频预测的‘意外程度’和动作路径的‘努力程度’打分排序，并在执行后用真实观测反向审计想象质量，训练一个轻量在线预测器来提升下次选候选的可靠性。
analysis.claim: 对冻结的世界动作模型（WAM），测试时无需微调即可通过自验证式候选筛选显著提升动作决策可靠性，核心是将延迟的想象-现实比对转化为前置的可靠性估计。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 单步动作指令（6-DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika机械臂（仿真用RoboTwin 2.0，实机用Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量随机场景下的真实机器人交互数据用于在线预测器训练（摘要称'limited randomized-scene supervision'）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下首次系统性解耦‘生成多样性’与‘选择可靠性’，用轻量在线预测器实现免微调的测试时校准；实证覆盖仿真Hard success提升、Horizon-3长程任务增益、以及Franka实机视觉偏移鲁棒性测试，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战世界模型持久状态建模等更根本瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——它没重构世界模型架构，却用精巧的测试时机制把WAM从‘靠运气采样’推向‘可估计可靠性’，证据扎实（多指标+仿真+实机），但离DreamerV3/WEAVER级的范式突破仍有距离。

papers.title: A Brain-inspired Hierarchical Framework for Zero-Shot Robot Task Reasoning and Execution
papers.abstract: Robots that follow open-ended language instructions need to connect semantic intent to visual scene understanding, geometric feasibility, object states, and physical interaction conditions. End-to-end Vision-Language-Action policies have improved cross-task generalization, but they typically map visual and language inputs directly to robot actions, leaving limited explicit structure for long-horizon decomposition, physical verification, and recovery. We present \method, a zero-shot hierarchical framework functionally inspired by the division of roles in the human brain, comprising visual perception and state inference, language grounding and action-sequence generation from a shared atomic action library, cost-based plan selection, and real-robot execution and verification. The framework grounds commands in explicit object states, composes reusable atomic actions into task-conditioned sequences, ranks alternative sequences by execution cost, and verifies intermediate physical outcomes from refreshed observations. In the evaluation, \method{} completes 10/10 clean board trials, 10/10 pick-and-place trials, and 4/5 pyramid stacking trials for both the flat and irregular initial-layout conditions; the corresponding mean task progress is $99.03\%$, $100.00\%$, and $96.67\%$ respectively. Across all evaluated conditions, \method{} achieves higher success rates than ReKep, Dream2Flow, and $π_{0.5}$ benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining explicit object-state reasoning, compositional atomic actions, cost-based plan selection, and closed-loop execution verification.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个受人脑启发的分层框架，把语言指令拆解成显式的物体状态推理、可复用的原子动作组合、基于执行代价的多方案筛选、以及带视觉反馈的闭环执行验证，全程零样本（不微调）在真实机械臂上完成清洁桌面、抓取放置、金字塔堆叠等任务。
analysis.claim: 零样本条件下，通过显式建模物体状态、原子动作组合、代价驱动规划与闭环物理验证的分层结构，可显著提升开放语言指令下长程操作任务的成功率与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + RGB-D 视觉观测（含物体位姿）
analysis.output: 任务条件化的原子动作序列（如 grasp(obj), place(loc), push(obj, dir)）及执行时序
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实场景初始状态标注（非行为轨迹数据），但未使用任何人类演示或强化学习收集的真实机器人动作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（含非结构化布局）、跨场景泛化、有明确基线对比（ReKep/Dream2Flow/π₀.₅）和消融支撑；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户，也未接入大规模VLA预训练底座，属于强工程整合+认知启发的实质性推进，尚未达RT-2/π₀级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将脑启发的显式符号化推理模块（状态+原子动作+代价选择+闭环验证）成功嵌入真实机器人闭环流程，在零样本下达成高成功率，但缺乏开源与扩展性验证，未动摇当前VLA基础模型主导范式

papers.title: Collision-Aware Humanoid Whole-Body Control under Imperfect Tracking Targets
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots often execute motion commands through whole-body controllers (WBCs) that track targets while maintaining balance and stability. However, most WBCs are blind to scene geometry, which can lead to collisions from imperfect target motions that are geometrically unsafe due to perception, planning, or teleoperation errors. We propose RECAL, a Robot--Environment Cross-Attention Layer that wraps a blind WBC to trade off target tracking against collision avoidance using external scene geometry. RECAL supports collision-aware tracking of floating-base and end-effector commands, including collision avoidance for held objects. It represents the robot, held objects, and environment as point clouds, using cross-attention between robot/object points and the environment to produce geometry-aware control features. In simulation, RECAL improves collision avoidance while preserving target-tracking performance across frozen-arm and adaptive-arm locomotion, object-carrying, and standing-manipulation scenarios relative to alternative geometry-aware WBC architectures. We further demonstrate the controller on a real Digit V3 humanoid robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的人形机器人全身控制器（WBC）加了一个叫RECAL的插件层，让它在跟踪运动指令时能实时‘看见’周围环境点云，主动避开碰撞，尤其在拿物体走路或站立操作时防止手/物体撞墙撞桌，已在Digit V3真机上验证。
analysis.claim: 通过引入机器人-环境跨注意力机制（RECAL），可在不修改底层全身控制器的前提下，以轻量级方式赋予其几何感知能力，实现目标跟踪与碰撞避免的动态权衡。
analysis.input: 全身控制器的目标轨迹（浮动基座+末端执行器位姿）+ 环境/机器人/手持物体的点云
analysis.output: 修正后的关节力矩/加速度控制指令（即几何感知增强的WBC输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Digit V3的运动学标定与传感器同步数据；未使用大规模真实碰撞数据训练，而是基于仿真预训练+真机微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将跨注意力机制系统性嵌入WBC闭环中实现几何感知增强，在多任务真机（Digit V3）上验证了碰撞规避有效性，但未开源数据/模型、未覆盖跨机体泛化（仅Digit）、未挑战长期开放难题（如无地图在线重建+避障），强于一般增量但未达基石级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视觉-几何感知以模块化方式嵌入现有WBC栈，实机效果扎实，但非理论或架构层面的范式创新

papers.title: PASSAGE: Scaling Scene-Aligned Motion Learning for Perceptive Humanoid Traversal in Cluttered Environments
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots can step over, squeeze past, and duck under obstacles, but learning to select and coordinate these behaviors from onboard perception remains challenging. Many existing approaches rely on task-specific reinforcement-learning objectives or curated motion libraries, making broad behavioral coverage costly. We present PASSAGE, a perception-conditioned planner--tracker framework for humanoid traversal. Using virtual reality and inertial motion capture, we collect 100 h of scene-aligned human motion across 1,500 cluttered scenes. A conditional flow-matching planner generates short-horizon references from motion history, a local destination, and a robot-centric multi-layer elevation map, while a perceptive whole-body tracker executes them at 50 Hz with geometric feedback. Real-time chunking promotes inter-chunk consistency, and planner-side RL post-training under the frozen tracker further improves closed-loop performance. Without skill annotations or obstacle-specific policies, one planner--tracker pair selects and composes traversal behaviors across unseen geometries. In simulation, component ablations quantify the contribution of each stage. Across three independent training seeds, scaling captured data from 6 to 100 h increases mean contact-free success from 48.1% to 68.9% on held-out scenes, while the final model with validated scene augmentation reaches 70.3%. The fully onboard system integrates egocentric 3D LiDAR perception, online occupancy mapping, 6.25 Hz planning, and 50 Hz control on a Jetson AGX Orin; tests across 50 unseen physical layouts demonstrate traversal without prebuilt maps or offboard computation.

analysis.tldr: 用100小时人类在杂乱场景中的动作捕捉数据训练一个感知驱动的规划-跟踪框架，让双足机器人能实时根据激光雷达输入自主选择跨、挤、蹲等行为穿越未知障碍物，全程 onboard 运行，不依赖预建地图或离线计算。
analysis.claim: 仅靠场景对齐的人类运动数据和机器人本体感知（LiDAR+IMU），无需技能标注或障碍特化策略，即可实现泛化至未见几何布局的端到端双足穿越行为自主编排与执行。
analysis.input: 机器人本体坐标系下的多层高程图（来自3D LiDAR）、历史运动序列、局部目标点
analysis.output: 短时域运动参考轨迹（位置/姿态/接触状态）及实时全身关节控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 智元自研双足机器人（基于Jetson AGX Orin部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：100小时VR+IMU采集的真实人类穿越动作，且需与场景几何严格对齐；无真实机器人交互数据，但仿真中验证了真实部署效果
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级：首次在真实双足机器人上实现无预设技能库、无障碍类型先验、全 onboard 的几何感知驱动穿越行为自主组合；实证扎实（50个物理新布局测试+消融+数据缩放曲线+Jetson实时部署），但未开新范式（仍属planner-tracker分治架构，非next-token或world model统一建模），略逊于Human-as-Humanoid（零样本人体视频迁移）和H2O（多模态闭环世界模型）等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将大规模人类运动对齐数据、轻量化多层高程表征、冻结跟踪器上的RL后训练等技术深度耦合，在真实双足平台上达成鲁棒跨场景穿越，是当前具身智能落地的重要工程里程碑，但理论范式未突破。

papers.title: Recovering Aggressively Pruned Vision-Language-Action Models with Offline Hidden-State Distillation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models let robots follow language instructions, but their language backbones of several billion parameters are the main obstacle to running them on robot hardware. Structured pruning reduces that backbone, and removing 63% of it from OpenVLA-OFT drops LIBERO-Long success from 93.2% to 0.8%. A recent approach restores such a model with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning, which needs online rollouts and hundreds of GPU-hours. We recover most of the lost success entirely offline. Width pruning narrows the blocks but keeps the residual stream at its original size, so teacher and student hidden states have the same shape and are matched directly, without a projector. Training against a cache built in one teacher pass lifts the 63%-reduced student to within 3.5 points of the teacher in about 8 GPU-hours. A sweep over nine ratios locates where the recovery objective starts to matter. Up to 45% reduction the two do not differ significantly on OpenVLA-OFT. Hidden-state distillation then adds +2.1 to +4.5 points there between 63% and 87%, and +9.4 to +22.1 points on CogACT from 63% onward. At 81% on CogACT, a tripled recovery budget narrows the distilled student's gap to the teacher to 3.9 points on average, while supervised recovery stays more than 20 points below. At matched compression, width pruning yields higher success and depth pruning lower latency. On a 6-DoF manipulator, the distilled student at 72% reduction reaches 77.5% success against 59.5% for supervised recovery, runs 2.23x faster on-board than the teacher, and uses 62% less memory.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种离线隐状态蒸馏方法，用单次教师模型前向传播构建缓存，无需在线交互或强化学习，就能高效恢复被激进剪枝（最高87%参数移除）的视觉-语言-动作模型性能，在LIBERO和CogACT基准上显著超越监督微调+RL的传统恢复方式，且在真实机械臂上验证了加速与内存优势。
analysis.claim: 宽度剪枝保留残差流维度，使教师与学生隐状态可直接对齐；通过离线构建的隐状态缓存进行蒸馏，能在无在线rollout、低GPU小时（~8h）下大幅恢复激进剪枝VLA模型的任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6-DoF关节/末端位姿控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署验证，但恢复训练本身不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据（仅用教师模型离线生成的隐状态缓存）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA模型轻量化这一关键工程瓶颈上取得扎实突破：首次实现纯离线、免RL、免在线rollout的高保真剪枝恢复，在LIBERO/CogACT多基准和真实6-DoF机械臂上均验证有效性，性能恢复幅度（+9.4~+22.1点）、效率（8 GPU-h vs 百级）和硬件收益（2.23x加速、62%内存下降）均有硬指标支撑，但未开新范式、未解决基础建模缺陷、未扩展至多机体协同或长时序世界模型，故低于RT-2/π0等里程碑级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了VLA落地最卡脖子的推理开销问题，用巧妙的宽度剪枝设计+离线隐状态蒸馏，在实证充分的前提下实现了工业级可用的模型压缩恢复，不是包装，是能立刻嵌入真实机器人栈的工程突破。

papers.title: Decoupled Early Exits for Task-Dependent Compute Allocation in Flow-Matching VLAs
papers.abstract: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a potential solution for generalist robot control, designed by combining a pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with an action expert that generates continuous robot actions. While these models exhibit impressive capabilities, due to their very high number of parameters, their computational requirements are often prohibitive for robotics control. To mitigate these inefficiencies, existing methods predominantly skip VLM backbone layers with early exits or reduce denoising steps, while leaving action expert depth untouched. We propose a framework that exposes backbone depth $V$, action expert depth $A$, and denoising steps $D$ as three jointly configurable compute axes in a VLA. Starting from a pretrained VLA, we attach lightweight Exit Transformers (ET) at intermediate depths in both the backbone and the action expert, trained to distil the last layer of the policy into each exit. Furthermore, we introduce a KV Cache synthesis mechanism that manages the missing keys and values of the skipped backbone layers, allowing the action expert to exit deeper than the backbone. Finally, we show that the optimal compute budget is task-dependent, with different tasks benefiting from different axes and depths. Notably, our method does not require training the original policy from scratch, and for each exit, it increases the number of parameters by only $2.1\%$ for SmolVLA and $4.1\%$ for $π_{0.5}$. We validate our approach across two flow-matching VLAs (SmolVLA, $π_{0.5}$) and two benchmarks (LIBERO, Meta-World), revealing complementary effects: $V$ and $A$ respectively reduce FLOPs and latency, while $D$ improves both. Our joint configurations $(V,A,D)$ reduce latency by $79.2\%$ and computation (FLOPs) by $31.8\%$, while improving mean success rate by $5.6\%$.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给已训练好的流匹配型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了轻量级早期退出机制，让模型能根据任务动态决定在视觉语言主干、动作专家、去噪步数三个维度上各算多少层，从而在不重训原模型的前提下大幅降低延迟和计算量，同时反而提升了成功率。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的计算开销应解耦为视觉语言主干深度V、动作专家深度A、去噪步数D三个可独立配置的轴，且最优配置是任务依赖的；通过轻量Exit Transformer和KV Cache合成机制，可在零重训前提下实现三轴联合早退，兼顾效率与性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续机器人动作序列（通过流匹配生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用LIBERO和Meta-World仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个对VLA三核心组件（V/A/D）解耦早退的系统性框架，实证扎实（两VLA模型+两benchmark+消融+FLOPs/latency/success率三指标提升），但完全基于仿真、无真机验证、未跨机体/跨用户泛化，且未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap或长程推理），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把早退思想从单模态模型迁移到VLA三轴协同控制，设计精巧、验证充分，但仍是仿真内优化，未触及机器人智能的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: VLaRL: Augmenting Vision-Language-Action Models with Simulation-Trained Latent-Conditioned Residual RL
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad, instruction-conditioned manipulation behaviors, but their physical execution can remain imprecise during contact-rich interaction. Residual reinforcement learning (RL) can correct such errors while keeping the VLA frozen, but real-robot RL is costly and safety-critical. We propose VLA Latent-Conditioned RL (VLaRL), which enables residual RL for frozen VLAs to be trained in simulation and deployed on real robots without real-world RL or online adaptation. The key challenge is transferring the learned residual policy despite the visual gap between simulation and reality. Rather than requiring pixel-level visual correspondence, VLaRL uses the VLA's internal vision-language latent representation to condition residual control and as the sim-to-real transfer interface, and learns a lightweight mapper that transforms simulation-derived latents toward the real latent distribution. Across four contact-rich manipulation tasks and two VLA backbones, VLaRL improves real-world success in all task-backbone combinations, while controlled ablations demonstrate the importance of both latent conditioning and latent alignment for transferring simulation-trained residual control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLaRL方法，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型在冻结状态下，通过在仿真中训练一个轻量级的残差强化学习策略来提升其在真实机器人上的接触密集型操作精度，关键创新是用VLA自身的多模态隐空间作为仿真到现实迁移的桥梁，而非依赖像素对齐。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA模型可通过仿真训练的、以VLA隐状态为条件并经隐空间对齐的残差RL策略，在不依赖真实机器人RL或在线自适应的前提下，显著提升其在接触密集型任务中的物理执行精度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+VLA模型内部的视觉-语言联合隐向量
analysis.output: 残差动作增量（6DoF位姿/关节速度等，依任务而定）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（实验平台）；Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人RL数据；仅需少量真实世界演示用于评估和隐空间对齐验证（非训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA落地瓶颈（接触操作精度不足）上提出有实证支撑的sim2real新范式：首次将VLA隐空间同时用作残差策略条件输入和sim2real对齐目标，跨4任务+2VLA骨干均有效，含消融验证核心设计，但未开源代码/模型，且仍属‘增强现有VLA’而非重构VLA架构本身，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。

papers.title: CognitiveReality: Robot-Agnostic Semantic Gaussian Mapping with an LLM Agent for Immersive Collaborative VR Teleoperation
papers.abstract: A photorealistic 3D view tells a teleoperator where a robot is, but not what the scene contains, how well each object has been observed, or how to turn pointing and speech into robot action. CognitiveReality turns a robot's RGB-D stream into a live, semantically indexed Gaussian-TSDF map shared by an operator in virtual reality and a tool-using language agent. One mapper binary serves any platform through configuration alone: it ingests poses from robot SLAM, joint kinematics, motion capture or an inline visual tracker, bridges localization outages with a shadow tracker and keyframe-anchored PnP, and maintains open-vocabulary instance identities with per-object quality at 2 Hz. Speech and controller rays are grounded against persistent scene objects through validated typed tools and operator-confirmed robot actions. In the controlled agent evaluation, the deployed local Qwen3-VL-8B router reaches 81.24\% tool exact match, while merge-aware replay correctly redirects 101 absorbed object identifiers. On robot data CognitiveReality exceeds a Gaussian-plus-SDF baseline by 2-8 dB; pose error through 5-40 s SLAM outages stays within 1-8 cm. Deployed live on two quadrupeds, the agent executed 26 of 30 navigation requests and 20 of 20 re-observation requests, raising object quality by 2-5 dB.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把机器人实时RGB-D数据变成带语义标签的高斯-TSDF三维地图，让VR操作员和本地运行的大语言模型（Qwen3-VL-8B）共享同一份动态场景理解，支持语音+手柄射线交互、跨平台部署、SLAM断连鲁棒恢复，并在两只四足机器人上实测验证了导航与重观测任务成功率。
analysis.org: Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology
analysis.claim: 通过机器人无关的语义高斯映射框架与本地化多模态大模型代理协同，实现沉浸式VR遥操作中可解释、可验证、鲁棒且跨平台的语义场景共建与动作接地。
analysis.input: 机器人RGB-D流、位姿（来自SLAM/动捕/视觉跟踪）、语音指令、VR控制器射线
analysis.output: 语义索引的高斯-TSDF三维地图、工具调用决策（如'grasp','navigate','reobserve'）、机器人动作序列
