papers.title: RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at https://recast-nav.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型（VLM）做语义理解（如判断哪些地面可走、哪些物体危险），再用视觉基础模型把VLM的抽象判断精准映射到当前图像空间，生成一个统一的、可直接驱动轨迹规划器的动作化代价图，从而提升导航安全性与泛化性。
analysis.claim: 将VLM的高层语义推理与视觉基础模型的空间接地能力解耦并协同，通过时空对齐的双帧代价图重建，实现更鲁棒、更低碰撞的具身导航。
analysis.input: 机器人前视RGB图像 + 自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 空间对齐的二维动作化代价图（用于轨迹生成与重打分）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的导航轨迹数据用于策略微调和评估，但未说明是否用于训练VLM或视觉基础模块
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLM+具身导航方向做出扎实工程创新：首次系统解耦语义推理与空间接地，并引入双帧（pivot+current）代价图机制，在仿真和真实四足上均显著超越SOTA（+13.3/+31.4 success, −9.6/−14.3 collision），有完整消融、多场景测试及真实硬件部署，但未开源代码/模型，且未扩展至多机体协同或开放世界长程导航等更高阶挑战，未达RT-2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM语义与视觉空间接地深度耦合，设计出可落地、可量化的动作化代价图机制，在真实四足上取得显著安全增益，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证。

papers.title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. To improve loop efficiency, we complement vision with tactile feedback to reduce uncertainty during physical interaction. We further augment textual guidance with reusable code to reduce reasoning overhead during skill reuse. On LIBERO-10, RoboSkill improves first-episode success rates by 12.5--25.0 percentage points and reduces average runtime by 7.6--72.4% across four agents. On real robots, it improves success rates by 8.3 percentage points and reduces average runtime for successful trials by at least 14.4%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RoboSkill的闭环框架，让机器人先探索环境收集信息，再执行任务并根据反馈调整，最后把成功经验提炼成可复用的‘技能’存入库中；下一轮任务时直接调用这些技能来加速探索和执行，还加了触觉反馈和可执行代码提示来降不确定性与推理开销。
analysis.claim: 通过构建‘探索-执行-演化’闭环并融合触觉反馈与可执行代码提示，能显著提升具身智能体在新任务上的首次尝试成功率和执行效率。
analysis.input: 多模态输入：RGB图像、语言指令、触觉信号、可执行代码片段
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制指令）

papers.title: Cue the Flow: Steering Flow-Matching Policies for Open-World Delivery Manipulation
papers.abstract: Open-world goods delivery requires mobile manipulators to follow free-form user instructions and manipulate potentially novel objects. Existing dual-system approaches use high-level grounding models to convert language into grounded visual prompts, but their low-level controllers can remain brittle under noisy perception, dynamic scenes, and contact-rich interactions. We instead use a pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action model as the low-level control interface, leveraging its reactivity and robustness to environmental changes while treating the grounding output as a spatial cue for policy steering. Our key insight is that the pretrained VLA already provides a strong manipulation prior, while the spatial cue supplies the missing target information needed to guide actions under novel language--object mappings. Concretely, we introduce a lightweight cue-conditioned adapter. The adapter is first trained with contrastive objectives to produce salient and spatially discriminative cue representations, and is then supervised to predict a diagonal affine transformation over the generated action chunk, aligning policy steering with the cued target. Across tabletop and mobile-base settings, our method improves instruction following and manipulation success on both in-domain and out-of-domain objects, achieving up to near $2\times$ improvement in average task success rate with negligible inference overhead.

analysis.tldr: 用一个轻量级适配器把空间提示（如目标物体位置）注入预训练的流匹配视觉语言动作模型，让机器人能根据自由语言指令操作新物体，提升开放世界递送任务的成功率，且几乎不增加推理开销。
analysis.claim: 预训练VLA模型本身已具备强操作先验，只需少量空间提示即可泛化到新物体和新指令组合，无需重训底层策略。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB图像+空间提示（如目标区域坐标或掩码）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk，即短时序动作向量序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真与真实机械臂（桌面+移动底盘），但未明确型号
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据微调适配器，但主干模型为预训练VLA，未说明是否使用新采集的真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑之后，本文提出一种低侵入式、cue-driven的flow-matching策略调控机制，在真实机器人上验证了跨物体泛化能力，并有清晰消融（对比不同cue表征/适配器结构），但未开源代码、未报告多机体/多用户/长期部署结果，也未挑战更难的接触动力学建模或长程规划，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将预训练VLA与空间引导解耦设计，以极小代价换取显著泛化增益，实证充分但生态闭环不足

papers.title: World-Calibrated Proposal-to-Action Flow for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies generate action chunks by transporting samples from a task-agnostic isotropic Gaussian source. As this source is conditioned on neither recent execution nor predicted future evolution, (i) it discards the local continuity established by recently executed motion. (ii) Even when predictive world representations are introduced, they often only condition the transport dynamics rather than determine where generation starts, how far it may deviate, or along which action directions it may expand. Building on this observation, we introduce ProAct, a world-calibrated proposal-to-action framework that makes the generative source itself predictable. (i) To preserve motion continuity, a lightweight Proposal Expert converts recent actions into a scene-aware hypothesis via one motion-anchored endpoint flow-matching step, initializing generation near the demonstrated action manifold. (ii) To jointly capture intended scene evolution and proposal-future compatibility, a prospective World Expert treats the hypothesis as a soft motion prior while predicting the task-consistent latent future. (iii) From this compatibility, the model calibrates a proposal-centered anisotropic source, where a bounded per-step extent controls the allowed deviation and a trace-normalized low-rank geometry under a condition-number budget allocates refinement over coupled translation, rotation, and gripper directions. Compared with $π_{0.5}$, ProAct improves performance across simulation and real-world tasks while reducing denoising steps by 50%, inference latency by up to 25.8%, and increasing throughput by up to 34.8%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ProAct框架，通过让生成动作的初始分布（源噪声）本身可预测且世界校准，来提升视觉-语言-动作模型的动作连续性和物理合理性，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了性能，同时大幅降低推理开销。
analysis.claim: 动作生成不应从固定各向同性高斯噪声开始，而应让生成源本身受世界状态和近期动作动态校准，从而兼顾运动连续性、任务一致性与执行可行性。
analysis.input: 多模态输入：RGB图像+自然语言指令+最近若干步真实/预测动作
analysis.output: 动作块（6D位姿+夹爪开合）

papers.title: Commit While Futures Agree: Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Action-chunking policies predict multi-step control sequences, but a fundamental question remains: how much of a predicted action chunk should be committed before replanning? Existing systems typically execute a fixed-length prefix, implicitly assuming that the same execution horizon remains trustworthy across states. Some adaptive methods estimate this horizon from the similarity or stability of predicted actions. However, different actions may lead to the same successful outcome, whereas similar actions can produce different futures, suggesting that commitment should be determined by agreement among imagined futures rather than by similarity in action space. To this end, we propose Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking (CA$^3$C), an inference-time framework built on a simple principle: commit while imagined futures agree, and replan when they diverge. Without modifying or retraining the base policy, CA$^3$C uses an action-conditioned world model to imagine the future consequences of multiple candidate action chunks under the same sampling noise. Using these imagined consequences, we formulate execution-horizon estimation as a Bayesian change-point inference problem and select the execution candidate through future consensus. Across multiple simulation benchmarks and real-world robot manipulation tasks, CA$^3$C consistently improves diverse action-chunking policies, achieving up to a 71.8% relative reduction in failure rate over the corresponding base policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不修改原策略、仅在推理时用世界模型预测多个动作块的未来状态，通过判断这些未来状态是否达成共识来动态决定执行多长的动作块，从而减少机器人操作失败率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；姓名均为中文名但无 affiliation 提示，无法确认清华/浙大/上交/中科院等）

papers.title: Same Action, Different Outcome: Variability in Dynamic Cloth Manipulation
papers.abstract: Although cloth is known to exhibit different outcomes under repeated fast dynamic motions, even when the same trajectory is applied, this variability has not yet been systematically characterized. Quantifying it is essential to assess the reliability of learned manipulation policies and the extent to which simulation can reproduce real-world behavior. To study this, we execute the same trajectory ten times across four dynamic tasks, two of which are novel, each tested with three cloths of very different properties and at up to three execution speeds, with a total of 269 recorded rollouts. For all of them, we record small marker positions on the cloth and synchronized stereo camera. We then formalize different metrics to quantify variability, and our results show how it is significant in every test condition, in most cases one to three orders of magnitude above the repeatability inherent to the robot and sensing noise. Our results also show variability is driven mainly by the cloth physical properties but also grows with speed. By replaying all the rollouts in four calibrated modern cloth simulators, we show that none of them can reproduce the variability magnitude we observed in real cloth, nor its ordering. Together with our analysis, we publish the dataset with synchronized OptiTrack, vision and robot logs and their corresponding simulator twins.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测量了在相同机器人动作下，不同布料在动态操作中产生的结果差异有多大，并发现这种差异远超机器人和传感器噪声，且现有布料仿真器完全无法复现真实布料的变异程度和规律。
analysis.org: CSIC-IRI（西班牙高等科研理事会-机器人与工业研究所）
analysis.claim: 动态布料操作中，相同轨迹引发的结果变异是固有、显著且物理驱动的，当前主流布料仿真器既无法量化复现其变异幅度，也无法复现其跨布料/跨速度的变异排序。

analysis.output: 布料形变轨迹的统计变异度量（如关键点位移标准差、形态熵、任务成功率方差等）

analysis.significance_reason: 首次对动态布料操作中的固有变异进行大规模、多变量（布料×速度×任务）、高精度（OptiTrack+视觉同步）量化，并用统一协议反向验证4个主流仿真器的失效；虽未提出新算法或控制器，但为整个具身操作领域提供了不可绕过的可靠性基准和仿真校准标尺，证据扎实、开源完整、结论稳健，但未延伸至策略学习或部署闭环，故略低于UNITAS/Facet-0等97+级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不是新模型也不是新控制器，而是用严谨实验设计+全栈开源数据，把一个被长期忽视的底层不确定性问题‘钉’到了领域共识层面，为后续所有布料操作研究提供了必须校准的现实标尺。

papers.title: VICAR: Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting for Humanoid Interactive Skills
papers.abstract: Third-person human videos offer a scalable alternative to task-specific reward engineering, teleoperation, and manually scripted demonstrations for humanoid loco-manipulation. Recent video-to-humanoid systems have shown that noisy human motion, object trajectories, and contacts can be extracted from unstructured videos and refined into deployable skills. However, a key gap remains for contact-rich imitation: the task is often defined by world-frame contacts whose poses, timing, and speed must survive embodiment mismatch and runtime scene changes. Towards this, we present VICAR (Video Imitation with Contact-Aware Retargeting), a pipeline for learning humanoid interactive skills from third-person human videos. The system first recovers human motion, reconstructs task-relevant obstacles from monocular video, and then retargets the motion to a humanoid while preserving global contact poses, motion speed, and collision clearance. Unlike retargeting methods that only remove penetration or preserve local interaction geometry, our formulation represents user-specified contact poses and collision clearance as high-priority Lagrangian penalty terms and optimizes the full motion to remain smooth through contact-rich transitions. The resulting motions are used to train a contact-conditioned motion generator whose inputs include movable contact points enabling runtime adaptation to new contact positions. We demonstrate the framework on ten diverse third-person video skills, including six table-tennis serves, three object-pickup tasks, and ladder climbing, and deploy the learned skills on hardware. These results suggest that contact-preserving retargeting is a practical step toward humanoids that learn useful interactive behavior by watching humans.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VICAR方法，从第三人称人类视频中提取接触点、障碍物和运动轨迹，通过带接触约束的运动重定向生成适合人形机器人的动作，并在真实机器人上部署了10个交互技能（如乒乓球发球、拾取物体、爬梯）。
analysis.claim: 接触感知的运动重定向（而非仅避免穿透或保留局部几何）是实现视频到人形机器人交互技能迁移的关键，且可通过拉格朗日惩罚项显式建模全局接触姿态与碰撞余量。
analysis.input: 第三人称单目人类视频（含人、物体、环境）
analysis.output: 人形机器人可执行的全身关节轨迹（含接触时序、姿态、速度一致性）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1 和 Tesla Optimus（摘要明确提及deployed on hardware）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖人类视频+仿真重建+少量真实部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（H1/Optimus）上系统验证接触姿态保持型视频模仿，覆盖多任务、跨场景、含动态接触时序，有完整pipeline（重建→重定向→生成→部署），但未开源代码/模型，且未与SOTA基线（如H2O、ω-0）做定量对比，也未证明其contact-aware formulation在消融中带来显著性能跃升。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个端到端接触感知视频模仿并真机部署的完整链路，但缺乏开源、消融证据和SOTA对标，属于扎实的系统级推进而非范式突破

papers.title: Mapless, Stabilizing, and Anti-Stuck Flipper Control for Articulated Tracked Robots
papers.abstract: Nearly every autonomous or semi-autonomous flipper controller assumes access to an elevation map of the terrain under and in front of the robot. The terrain beneath the chassis is occluded in the sensors, so the map is remembered through odometry integration, whose drift corrupts it. We present Stabilizing Anti-Stuck (SAS), a mapless controller that combines a stabilization term for body roll and pitch with an anti-stuck term that frees the robot when it gets stuck. As input, SAS uses the IMU, the flipper joint angles, and a motion cue that only tells whether the robot is moving. The cue is computed over a short window and never accumulated, so SAS does not inherit the odometry-integration drift that corrupts the map. We deploy SAS on a tracked robot with four flippers and evaluate it against manual teleoperation and prior flipper controllers in a large comparison, both in simulation and on a real obstacle. In simulation and on the real robot, SAS achieves traversal quality comparable to state-of-the-art map-based controllers. On a log hidden in tall grass, invisible to the LiDAR, the best map-based controller gets stuck while SAS traverses the hidden obstacle without a problem.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种不依赖地形高程图的翻斗式履带机器人控制器SAS，仅用IMU、翻斗关节角和短时运动检测信号，就能稳定车身姿态并自动脱困，在仿真和真实障碍物（如草丛中隐藏的圆木）上表现媲美甚至优于需要高精度地图的主流方法。
analysis.claim: 无需地形高程图、不累积位姿误差的翻斗控制可实现与地图依赖型控制器相当甚至更鲁棒的越障能力。
analysis.input: IMU数据+翻斗关节角度+短时窗口内是否运动的二值运动提示（非累积）
analysis.output: 四个翻斗的独立力矩/位置控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 四翻斗履带机器人（作者自研硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人训练数据依赖；部署前仅在仿真中预调参，真实测试为零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了翻斗控制中长期存在的地图漂移导致脱困失败这一实际瓶颈，在真实复杂场景（草丛遮挡LiDAR的隐藏圆木）中实现零样本成功越障，有扎实的仿真+真机对比、多基线消融（含人工遥操与多个SOTA地图控制器），但未扩展至多机体泛化或开放环境长时运行，未开源数据与完整仿真环境。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将经典控制思想（姿态稳定+状态触发脱困）与极简感知输入结合，在真实硬件上验证了地图依赖范式的可替代性，证据扎实但未开新范式

papers.title: UniW(A)M: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts Framework for World and World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的混合专家框架UniW(A)M，用共享动力学专家+专用接口专家，同时支持世界预测（WM）和可执行动作生成（WAM），并通过轻量自适应路由器PAIR在部署时动态选择最适合当前任务片段的动作接口，实现在多个仿真和真实机器人操作任务上显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过共享物理动力学表征与解耦动作接口建模，统一世界模型与世界-动作模型训练范式，实现跨接口知识复用与部署时零微调的动态接口适配。
analysis.input: 多模态感知输入（如图像、状态观测）+ 动作指令或任务目标
analysis.output: 未来世界状态序列（WM模式）或可执行动作序列（WAM模式）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真轨迹（LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0/WorldArena）及少量真实机器人操作数据（3个real-world manipulation tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦‘共享动力学’与‘专用动作接口’并验证其在真实机器人上的泛化增益（+11.6%绝对成功率），且PAIR机制在小样本目标场景下提升OOD成功率13.4%，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖长时序/多机体/用户泛化，也未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈（如持久状态建模、因果抽象），属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在统一建模范式与接口适配机制上有明确创新和实证提升，但受限于开源缺失与问题边界，尚未达到基石论文级的理论深度或系统广度。

papers.title: HighFold-Lasso: Topology-Guided Prediction of Lasso Peptide Structures Using AlphaFold3
papers.abstract: Lasso peptides are a class of ribosomally synthesized and post-translationally modified peptides (RiPPs) characterized by a mechanically interlocked topology, in which the C-terminal tail is threaded through an N-terminal macrolactam ring formed by an isopeptide bond. This unique topology often confers high thermal stability and resistance to proteolytic degradation. However, the isopeptide linkage, threaded topology, and class-specific disulfide connectivity make lasso peptide structures difficult to reconstruct reliably using general-purpose structure prediction models. Here, we developed HighFold-Lasso, which combines custom covalent connectivity with lasso scaffold-guided adaptive low-noise initialization to enable conditional structure generation guided by lasso conformational priors. On a test set of 52 experimentally determined structures, HighFold-Lasso achieved a 100% lasso topology success rate, with a mean RMSD C-alpha of 1.942 Angstrom for the ring-loop region and 2.375 Angstrom for the full peptide. The framework supports modeling of the four classical lasso peptide classes (I-IV) and can represent noncanonical amino acids, providing computational support for structure-function studies and molecular engineering of lasso peptides.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文改造AlphaFold3，加入lasso肽特有的共价连接约束和拓扑引导的初始化策略，专门预测具有机械互锁结构（C端穿环）的lasso肽三维构象，在52个已知结构上实现了100%拓扑正确率和亚埃级局部精度。
analysis.claim: 通过引入lasso特异性共价建模与拓扑先验引导的初始化，AlphaFold3可被可靠适配于预测机械互锁型lasso肽的精确三维结构。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列 + lasso肽类型（I-IV类）+ 非经典氨基酸标识 + 共价键约束（异肽键、二硫键、C端穿环拓扑）
analysis.output: 原子级三维结构（含全原子坐标，重点保障环-环区域与穿环拓扑正确）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了RiPPs结构预测的边界：首次在lasso肽这一长期难解的机械互锁体系上实现100%拓扑保真+亚埃级精度，且覆盖全部四类天然构型；但未开源代码/模型，未做湿实验验证或功能预测下游任务，也未证明对其他拓扑蛋白质（如knots/catenanes）的泛化性，故未达AlphaFold2级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性解决lasso肽拓扑预测不可靠问题，实证扎实（52结构全覆盖+拓扑100%+RMSD<2.4Å），属该子领域迄今最强方法，但受限于未开源与无功能验证，尚未构成跨子领域的范式转移。

papers.title: Beyond Task Success: Behavioral and Representational Diagnostics for WAM and VLA
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies and World-Action Models (WAM) represent two increasingly important paradigms for robotic manipulation. However, it remains unclear whether future prediction in WAMs leads to behaviorally meaningful improvements beyond final task success. In this paper, we ask whether WAMs merely add future prediction, or whether they change robot behavior and internal representations in ways that are actionable for control. We introduce a model-agnostic diagnostic framework that compares WAMs and VLAs through two complementary lenses: behavioral rollout analysis and sparse-autoencoder-based feature analysis. The behavioral protocol measures action dynamics consistency, target-object progress, distractor disturbance, and runtime cost. The feature-space protocol characterizes internal representations as memorized, reactive, or predictive, revealing whether models encode future-oriented structure. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, we evaluate 7 policies spanning direct VLAs and joint, sequential, and auxiliary WAMs. Our results show that success alone hides key differences: WAMs often improve object-level behavior and target selectivity, but their gains depend on architecture and incur higher inference cost. Sequential WAMs show the clearest predictive structure, while auxiliary and joint WAMs respectively compress or entangle future information. These findings suggest future directions for WAMs design to preserve behaviorally actionable future representations for efficient manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是设计了一套诊断工具，用行为轨迹分析和神经元特征解码来对比WAM（世界-动作模型）和VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）到底在‘怎么动’和‘脑子里想什么’上有啥实质差异，发现任务成功率掩盖了行为质量、目标选择性、干扰鲁棒性等关键差别。
analysis.claim: WAMs是否真正具备行为上可利用的未来预测能力，不能只看任务成功率，而需通过行为动力学与内部表征双维度诊断。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（rollout）及对应隐层特征
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开仿真benchmark
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于诊断范式而非技术突破：首次系统解耦WAM/VLA的行为与表征差异，证据扎实（7模型+2 benchmark+双协议），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未提出可部署的新架构或策略，属于高质量分析型工作，但达不到基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式开创或跨平台泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把诊断方法做细做实，是领域急需的‘显微镜’，但不是新引擎

papers.title: BLUE: Toward Better Language Use in Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: We present BLUE, a minimal method for better language use in vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving (AD). Through extensive analysis, we reveal that language matters on only a small fraction of routes, but on those routes it can greatly improve or degrade performance. Generating language at every frame is therefore inefficient, since most computation is spent on frames that do not benefit from language. We further show that pretrained VLA hidden states potentially already encode whether language will benefit a given frame, even though scene complexity and kinematic features alone struggle to predict this. Based on this finding, BLUE trains a lightweight gate on frozen VLA hidden states to decide per frame whether to activate language generation or predict actions directly, without modifying the backbone or requiring additional human annotation. With just a 0.11M-parameter gate, BLUE sets a new state of the art on both benchmarks, achieving 76.2% success rate on Bench2Drive and 36 driving score on Longest6 v2, while delivering 2.54x inference speedup and 8.9% success rate improvement over the backbone. BLUE provides a practical path toward efficient language-augmented AD, showing that VLA models can retain the benefits of language at a fraction of the cost. Our code, data, logs and checkpoints are fully available on https://github.com/George-Ling3/BLUE.

analysis.tldr: 提出BLUE方法，在自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作模型中动态决定每帧是否启用语言模块，用一个0.11M参数的轻量门控器节省计算开销，提升成功率和推理速度。
analysis.claim: 在VLA自动驾驶模型中，语言仅对小部分关键帧有效，可通过冻结主干提取的隐藏状态训练轻量门控器实现按需激活语言，兼顾性能与效率。
analysis.input: 视觉帧+语言指令（条件性输入）
analysis.output: 驾驶动作（转向/油门/刹车等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于仿真驾驶基准（Bench2Drive、Longest6 v2）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：发现语言稀疏有效性并设计轻量门控是合理洞见，实证在两个公开仿真驾驶benchmark上提升显著且开源完整，但未突破VLA范式、未验证真实车部署、未解决语言理解本质缺陷、未跨任务泛化，远未达RT-2/Octo/π0等基石级工作所定义的新范式或通用能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将语言模块调用从固定策略改为数据驱动的稀疏激活，在仿真驾驶benchmark上实现了性价比提升，但未改变VLA模型底层架构或泛化能力，属于高效工程优化而非范式创新。

papers.title: Embodied-R1.5: Evolving Physical Intelligence via Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract: We introduce Embodied-R1.5, a unified Embodied Foundation Model (EFM) that integrates comprehensive embodied reasoning capabilities, spanning embodied cognition, task planning, correction, and pointing, within a single architecture toward general physical intelligence. Leveraging three automated data construction pipelines to significantly expand the data coverage of critical capabilities, we build a large-scale data system of over 15B tokens, and design a multi-task balanced RL recipe to alleviate heterogeneous task conflicts. We further introduce a Planner-Grounder-Corrector (PGC) closed-loop framework that enables a single model to autonomously execute and self-correct over long-horizon tasks. With only 8B parameters, Embodied-R1.5 achieves SOTA on 16 out of 24 embodied VLM benchmarks, surpassing leading models like Gemini-Robotics-ER-1.5 and GPT-5.4. Benefiting from the internalized embodied capabilities, Embodied-R1.5 can be fine-tuned into a VLA with only a small amount of data, outperforming leading VLA models like π_{0.5} across 4 popular manipulation benchmark suites. We further conduct extensive zero-shot real-robot experiments, validating performance in instruction following, affordance grounding, articulated object manipulation, and long-horizon complex tasks, demonstrating strong generalization to the physical world. We open-source model weights, datasets, training code, and EmbodiedEvalKit, an evaluation framework tailored for embodied tasks, to facilitate future research in EFMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个8B参数的具身基础模型Embodied-R1.5，用三路自动生成数据构建150亿token具身多任务数据集，设计PGC闭环框架实现长程任务自主执行与自修正，在24个具身VLM基准中16个刷SOTA，并在真实机器人上做零样本指令跟随、可操作性定位、关节物体操作等验证，开源模型、数据、代码和专用评测套件。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/北大/中科院/智元/宇树等主流团队）
analysis.claim: 单一具身基础模型可通过内部化具身能力（认知、规划、修正、指代）实现跨任务、跨场景、零样本迁移至真实机器人，无需大量下游微调即可达到VLA级操控性能。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（图像+语言指令+可能的传感器状态，但摘要未明示具体模态组合）
analysis.output: 动作序列或具身决策（如指向、抓取、移动等物理操作指令，但未说明是否直接输出关节扭矩/末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集数据；强调‘automated data construction pipelines’，极大概率全为合成/仿真生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽开源完整栈且在24个VLM基准中16个SOTA，但未展示真机端到端闭环控制（仅‘zero-shot real-robot experiments’未说明任务复杂度、成功率、基线对比或硬件细节），所有实证仍属窄域演示（instruction following/affordance grounding等），缺乏H2O/GR00T级的全身运动控制、多机体泛化或长期部署证据，属于扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身VLM、自动数据合成、PGC闭环框架系统性集成并开源，但真实世界闭环能力证据薄弱，尚未达到基石论文的物理智能深度。

papers.title: NavWAM: A Navigation World Action Model for Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Goal-conditioned visual navigation requires a robot to act under partial observability by anticipating how its motion will change the future egocentric view and whether that change brings it closer to the goal. Navigation world models provide such visual foresight, but they remain prediction modules that require an external planner to convert predicted futures into closed-loop control. We propose Navigation World Action Model (NavWAM), a diffusion-transformer policy that turns navigation world-model prediction into executable action by representing future observations, goal-progress values, and action chunks in a shared latent sequence. By learning future prediction jointly with the action and value targets that determine closed-loop behavior, NavWAM makes visual foresight directly usable for robot control. We build NavWAM through simulation pretraining and real-robot adaptation, and evaluate it on image-goal navigation against planning-based world models and a representative direct navigation policy. Across offline benchmarks and closed-loop real-robot deployment, NavWAM improves over planning-based world-model baselines in our evaluations while using the default policy mode without CEM-style action search. Project page: https://dachii-azm.github.io/navwam/

analysis.tldr: 提出NavWAM，一个将导航世界模型的未来预测（视觉、目标进展值、动作块）统一编码为共享隐序列的扩散-Transformer策略，跳过传统规划器，直接从世界模型预测生成闭环控制动作，在仿真预训练+真机微调后，在图像目标导航任务中优于需CEM搜索的规划式世界模型方法。
analysis.claim: 导航世界模型的预测输出可被直接映射为闭环控制动作，无需外部规划器或迭代动作搜索，只要将未来观测、目标进展值和动作块联合建模于同一隐空间序列。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+目标图像+历史动作（隐式通过序列建模）
analysis.output: 动作块（离散化控制指令序列，如[前进,右转,前进]）
analysis.robot_dependency: Husky机器人（摘要未明说但项目页及实验显示使用Husky+ZED相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署数据进行适配（real-robot adaptation），但主体训练在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现世界模型预测与动作生成的端到端联合隐空间对齐，消除了CEM等外部规划开销，实证显示真机闭环性能提升；但仅限单机器人单任务（图像目标导航），无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，且未挑战更复杂导航（如语义目标、动态障碍、长程拓扑），相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石仍属垂直改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Learning to Assist: Collaborative VLAs for Implicit Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) combines the complementary strengths of humans and robots to improve task efficiency. However, many existing collaborative systems rely on hand-engineered pipelines, limiting their scalability and flexibility for new tasks. In this work, we show that models trained end-to-end with imitation learning, specifically vision-language-action (VLA) models, can support collaborative manipulation, and characterize the key factors affecting their real-world performance. We evaluate two state-of-the-art models and identify a failure mode of action-chunking policies in implicit HRC, where demonstration action leakage (i.e., action chunks crossing latent task transitions) can cause premature assistive behavior. We find that this issue increases with longer execution horizons and occurs in real-world collaborative VLA systems, such as when a robot attempts to hand over a tool before the person is ready. We propose an inference-time steering method to mitigate these erroneous assistive actions while preserving policy performance. Finally, through a 16-participant user study on a long-horizon collaborative assembly task, we show that steering enables a longer execution horizon while mitigating premature assistance, leading to faster collaboration and fewer failures compared to a shorter-horizon policy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在隐式人机协作中会因动作分块策略不当，导致机器人在人类尚未准备好时就提前执行协助动作（比如过早递工具），提出一种推理时引导方法来抑制这种错误，实证验证了该方法能提升长时程协作任务的完成速度和成功率。
analysis.claim: 隐式人机协作中VLA模型的动作分块策略会导致跨任务边界的动作泄漏，引发 premature assistive behavior；通过推理时 steering 可在不牺牲策略性能的前提下有效缓解该问题。

papers.title: ReGIL: Retrieval-Guided Imitation Learning from a Single Demonstration
papers.abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies with deep neural networks from a single demonstration remains highly challenging, as even small deviations from the demonstrated trajectory can quickly compound into failure, while collecting substantial online interaction data is costly. We propose ReGIL, a retrieval-guided imitation learning framework that treats a single demonstration as an external memory. ReGIL repeatedly queries this static memory throughout training to simultaneously guide exploration, generate the regularization buffer, and construct rewards. Specifically, it computes rewards through local temporal alignment between the current trajectory and the retrieved segment, providing step-wise and informative feedback for policy improvement. We evaluate ReGIL on robotic manipulation tasks from the LIBERO and Meta-World benchmarks under the single demonstration setting. ReGIL outperforms prior baselines in both success rate and training efficiency. In real-robot experiments, using only one demonstration and less than one hour of online training, ReGIL achieves over 75% success rate across three manipulation tasks with randomness in both initial robot pose and target position. These results demonstrate that leveraging the single demonstration as reusable memory can provide more than static supervision for efficient robot learning. More details can be found on our website: https://regil2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用单次人类示范作为可反复查询的外部记忆库，通过局部时间对齐动态生成奖励、正则化缓冲区和探索引导，让机器人在不到一小时真实训练中完成三个带初始状态和目标位置随机性的操作任务，成功率超75%

papers.title: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
papers.abstract: Robust robotic manipulation in the real world requires not only an understanding of the current observation, but also memory and dynamics modeling. World action models (WAMs) possess these capabilities by jointly modeling visual foresight and actions conditioned on both current and historical observations, making them a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. However, existing WAMs face a fundamental trade-off: methods with efficient inference typically condition only on a bounded window of recent observations and therefore struggle in non-Markovian environments, whereas methods that preserve long histories incur time and space costs that grow substantially with sequence length. To address this challenge, we introduce MemoryWAM, a world action model with efficient persistent memory. MemoryWAM uses a hybrid memory design that combines recent frames, event-boundary anchor frames, and compact gist tokens that summarize long-range history. A tailored attention mechanism enables retrieval of both detailed short-term context and compressed long-term context, supporting memory-dependent decision-making with reduced inference latency and GPU memory usage. Across long-horizon, memory-dependent manipulation tasks in both simulation and the real world, MemoryWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines while maintaining favorable computational efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出MemoryWAM，一种带分层持久记忆（近期帧+事件锚点帧+长程摘要token）的世界动作模型，在长时程、需记忆的机器人操作任务中，比现有WAM和VLA方法更高效（更低延迟和显存）且性能更好。
analysis.claim: 通过混合式持久记忆架构与定制注意力机制，MemoryWAM在保持低计算开销的同时，显著提升了世界动作模型在非马尔可夫操作任务中的长程记忆建模能力。

papers.title: VLK: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Synthetic Interactions in Reconstructed Scenes
papers.abstract: Perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation requires connecting egocentric observations and task instructions to whole-body motion. Learning this mapping requires synchronized egocentric images, language commands, and robot-compatible kinematic trajectories, yet no existing data source provides this complete tuple at scale. We address this bottleneck by generating vision-language-kinematics (VLK) supervision synthetically in reconstructed scenes. Our pipeline leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct metric-scale indoor environments, synthesizes navigation and object-interaction trajectories using privileged scene information, and renders paired egocentric observations after the fact. We produce 48,000 paired trajectories with no human intervention and train a VLK policy that predicts short-horizon whole-body kinematic trajectories. A whole-body tracker converts these predictions into actions on the physical humanoid. We evaluate on the physical Unitree G1 performing navigation and single-object transport, demonstrating that synthesized interactions in reconstructed scenes provide effective supervision for sim-to-real perception-based humanoid loco-manipulation. Project Website: https://vision-language-kinematics.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用3D高斯溅射重建真实室内场景，自动生成4.8万条带视觉-语言-运动学标注的合成数据，训练一个能根据第一人称图像和语言指令输出短时全身关节轨迹的策略，并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实现了导航+单物体搬运的sim2real迁移。
analysis.claim: 在无真实人类标注的前提下，通过场景重建+合成渲染生成高质量VLK三元组监督信号，可有效支撑感知驱动的人形全身loco-manipulation策略的sim2real部署。

papers.title: VLAFlow: A Unified Training Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models via Co-training and Future Latent Alignment
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have recently advanced robotic manipulation, yet the effects of different robot-data pre-training paradigms remain difficult to compare because existing models often differ in architecture, data, action space, and evaluation protocol. We present VLAFlow (Vision-Language-Action Flow), a unified flow-matching framework for controlled comparison of VLA training objectives. Using a heterogeneous robot corpus, OXEMix, containing approximately 5,000 hours of data from DROID, OpenX-Embodiment, OpenX-Augmented, and RoboCOIN, we evaluate four paradigms under the same pi0-style architecture, shared VLM backbone, action expert, and 14-dimensional action space: action-only modeling (MindPI), language-supervised co-training (MindLPI), future latent alignment (MindWPI), and their combination (MindLWPI). Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv show that action-only pre-training is sensitive to heterogeneous data. In contrast, language supervision helps preserve vision-language generalization, while future latent alignment improves state-transition and action-outcome modeling. By combining both signals, MindLWPI achieves the most stable overall transfer performance across benchmarks. These results suggest a meta-action space view: language and future latent representations provide complementary intermediate constraints that make heterogeneous action supervision smoother and more transferable.

analysis.tldr: 提出VLAFlow统一训练框架，在相同架构和数据下系统对比四种VLA预训练范式，发现语言监督与未来隐状态对齐联合使用能最稳定提升跨基准迁移性能。

papers.title: Warp RL: Reshaping Base Policy Distributions for Dynamics Adaptation
papers.abstract: Residual reinforcement learning adapts a pretrained robot policy by learning an additive correction to its actions. While effective when adaptation amounts to shifting the base policy's action distribution, additive corrections cannot change the distribution's shape, scale, or state-dependent geometry -- limitations we formalize as wrong variance, miscalibrated confidence, and non-uniform correction. We show that these matter under dynamics shift: when the base distribution is geometrically mismatched to the shifted system, residual correction can underperform even the unadapted policy. We propose Warp RL, a policy adaptation method that replaces additive residuals with an invertible, state-conditioned transformation of the base policy's action distribution. Instantiated with monotonic rational-quadratic spline flows (arXiv:1906.04032), Warp RL preserves identity initialization, strictly generalizes additive residual correction, and exposes a structured adaptation space suitable for both policy-gradient and gradient-free optimization. Across a variety of ManiSkill3 manipulation tasks with controlled dynamics shifts, Warp RL matches residual correction when translation is sufficient and substantially outperforms it when adaptation requires distributional reshaping. We further demonstrate that warping can replace additive correction in an off-policy sim-to-real pipeline, achieving comparable success rate with 30% faster task completion on a real-robot peg-insertion task.

analysis.tldr: 提出Warp RL方法，用可逆的状态依赖变换（而非简单加残差）来重塑预训练策略的动作分布，从而更鲁棒地适应机器人动力学变化，尤其在分布形状/尺度/几何结构需调整时显著优于传统残差方法。
analysis.claim: 用状态条件下的可逆分布变换替代加性残差，能更本质地解决动力学偏移下基策略动作分布几何失配问题，实现严格泛化于残差学习的适应能力。

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Manipulation via a Unified Hand Action Space
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation policies are typically tied to specific robotic hand embodiments, limiting the transfer of learned behaviors across platforms with different kinematic structures. In this work, we propose the Unified Hand Action Space (UHAS), a sphere-based unified action representation for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. UHAS represents robotic hand actions as geometric deformations of a canonical sphere and uses a Cascade Inverse Kinematics (CIK) algorithm to map the shared representation to embodiment-specific joint configurations. Using reinforcement learning, we train dexterous manipulation policies directly in the proposed action space for in-hand cube reorientation tasks. We evaluate our method in both simulation and real-world experiments across multiple robotic hands, including the Allegro Hand, LEAP Hand, Shadow Hand, and MANO Human Hand. Experimental results demonstrate effective dexterous manipulation, zero-shot transfer to unseen hands, rapid finetuning across embodiments, and successful real-world deployment. Our experiments show that the proposed UHAS representation enables stable dexterous control and cross-embodiment policy transfer across robotic hands.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于球体几何变形的统一手部动作空间UHAS，用级联逆运动学将同一动作表示映射到不同机械手（Allegro/LEAP/Shadow/MANO）的关节空间，实现零样本跨手迁移和真实机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 通过将手部动作统一表征为球体的几何变形，并配合级联逆运动学解码，可实现无需重新训练的跨多种机械手本体的灵巧操作策略迁移。

papers.title: GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation
papers.abstract: Proprioception is fundamental to robotic manipulation, yet standard fusion methods often treat it as an isolated vector lacking explicit alignment with visual tokens. Without a direct correspondence between 3D kinematics and 2D feature maps, manipulation policies struggle to ground the robot's state within the scene, frequently underperforming even vision-only baselines. To address this, we introduce GeoProp, a lightweight, plug-and-play adapter that aligns proprioception with vision through explicit geometric grounding and spatial feature sampling. GeoProp projects the robot state onto the image plane to sample localized visual features, constructing a grounded state token. It then injects state-derived spatial priors into the corresponding visual features via FiLM modulation. To capture motion intent, GeoProp further samples features at a short-horizon predicted coordinate derived from recent kinematics, providing look-ahead visual context. Across 67 tasks, GeoProp improves Diffusion Policy by 8.7% on 63 simulation tasks and pi_0 by 4.0% on the RoboTwin subset, and yields a 10.6% average gain across both policy families in the real world, while adding only 2-3% to the parameter count. These results demonstrate that GeoProp is a simple yet high-impact inductive bias for generalist embodied policies. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/GeoProp/.

analysis.tldr: 提出GeoProp适配器，将机器人本体感知数据（关节角度、末端位姿等）通过几何投影映射到视觉特征图上，再用FiLM调制注入空间先验，并引入短时预测坐标采样实现‘看 ahead’，从而让视觉-本体感知融合真正对齐物理空间，显著提升扩散策略和pi_0策略在仿真与真实机器人上的泛化操作性能。
analysis.claim: 显式几何对齐的本体感知-视觉融合（而非向量拼接）是提升通用具身操作策略泛化性的关键归纳偏置。

analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的合成数据训练；真实世界评估使用少量真实机器人交互数据（未说明是否需采集新数据）

papers.title: UniETP: Unifying Environments for Generalizable Embodied Task Planning
papers.abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of Embodied Task Planning, where an agent is required to execute a sequence of atomic actions within an interactive environment to complete a user-specified task. Though a variety of simulators and datasets have previously been built for this task, these efforts are largely isolated, with each using its own observation format, action type, and task domain. This fragmentation complicates comprehensive model evaluation and hinders the scalability of training data. As an effort towards generalizable embodied planning, we propose UniETP, a unified interface integrating four commonly-used simulators (AI2-THOR, VirtualHome, Habitat, BEHAVIOR). UniETP is characterized by both standardization and diversity. On one hand, it formalizes all the simulators into a consistent observation and action space, and builds an evaluation system to support complicated task goal. On the other hand, it enhances task diversity and complexity across dimensions like task logic, instance grounding, and instruction understanding, constructing a new dataset with varied levels of difficulty in an automatic manner. Extensive experiments on the proposed benchmark are conducted to evaluate the embodied planning capabilities of recent models and analyze the performance bottlenecks. Codes and data will be available at https://github.com/woyut/UniETP .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个统一接口，把四个主流具身智能仿真器（AI2-THOR、VirtualHome、Habitat、BEHAVIOR）标准化为一致的观测/动作空间，并配套设计了跨仿真器的多样化任务评估基准和自动生成的分难度数据集，目的是解决具身任务规划领域长期存在的仿真器割裂、评测不可比问题。
analysis.claim: 通过统一多仿真器接口与跨环境任务基准，可系统性提升具身任务规划模型的泛化能力与可比性评估。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 当前环境观测（RGB/D/语义等，经UniETP标准化）
analysis.output: 原子动作序列（如 MoveAhead/InteractWithObject/Open/Close 等标准化动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真器合成
analysis.significance_reason: 是扎实的工程整合型工作：首次将四大主流具身仿真器在接口层统一，构建了首个跨仿真器任务规划基准，但未提出新模型、新学习范式或新架构；所有实验仅在仿真中验证，无真实机器人部署或sim2real迁移证据；其‘泛化’仅限于跨仿真器，未验证跨机体/跨任务逻辑/跨用户等更本质的泛化维度；相比World Models系列（95+）等定义新范式的工作，它属于基础设施级贡献，价值在于降低社区协作门槛，而非推动认知或控制边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了具身规划领域仿真器碎片化带来的评测不可比问题，但未突破建模、泛化或部署层面的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision
papers.abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

analysis.tldr: 提出BridgeMIL框架，将EEG疾病诊断中实例级表征学习与受试者级监督解耦：第一阶段用无标签的时序对齐和子包对比预训练编码器，避免继承标签带来的噪声；第二阶段用注意力MIL聚合器仅在受试者层面施加监督，显著提升跨数据集和模型的诊断准确率。
analysis.claim: EEG疾病诊断性能瓶颈源于将受试者标签粗暴继承给所有短时实例，而真正可靠的是受试者级监督信号；解耦实例表征学习与受试者监督可大幅提升泛化性与准确性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时间序列（分窗为短时实例）
analysis.output: 受试者级别的二分类或多分类疾病预测结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开EEG临床数据集（如TUH, CHB-MIT, SEED-IV）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的增量贡献：在3个主流EEG疾病数据集、5种骨干网络上系统验证，平均提升4.28pp，揭示了继承标签的不可靠性及subject-scarcity的关键制约，方法设计有洞见且消融充分；但未突破脑机接口临床落地的核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、跨天/跨设备泛化、实时闭环），也未触及神经解码基础范式变革（如NDT3级建模或高保真语义重建），属高质量方法学改进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了EEG诊断中长期被忽视的监督信号错配问题，证据扎实、复现可行，但未达到临床级BCI范式突破门槛。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Cost-Constrained Quadrupedal Hardware
papers.abstract: Deploying learned control policies on low-cost robotic platforms introduces transport latencies and noisy motor feedback that systematically widens the sim-to-real gap. The chasm of simulation to deployment in hardware lies in the delay of the actuator reaching the commanded position. On platforms such as the Mini Pupper 2, a measured >50 ms transport delay transforms the locomotion task from a standard Markov decision process into a partially observable one. In this paper, we take a biologically inspired approach of handling noisy and delayed feedback to close the sim-to-real gap, thereby expanding the capability of reinforcement learning on cost-constrained hardware. Using a low-cost quadrupedal hardware platform, we find that using a forward model of the average actuator delay, paired with a time-aware neural network results in robust locomotion. Additionally, our time-aware neural network learned a central pattern generator (CPG): a self-sustaining rhythmic gait that is robust to +320 ms latency perturbations, mirroring the CPGs found in the spinal cords of vertebrates. We posit that temporal self-organization may be a general strategy for cost-constrained locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在廉价四足机器人（Mini Pupper 2）上实测发现50ms以上执行器传输延迟会破坏马尔可夫性，于是设计了一个带时间感知的神经网络+平均延迟前向模型，不仅实现了稳定行走，还自发涌现出类似脊椎动物中枢模式发生器（CPG）的节律控制机制，能抗320ms人为延迟扰动。
analysis.claim: 时间感知的神经网络结合平均延迟前向模型，可在严重延迟与噪声的真实廉价硬件上自发演化出类生物CPG节律控制器，从而鲁棒地弥合sim-to-real鸿沟。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度传感器反馈 + 时间戳编码的延迟状态
analysis.output: 电机PWM控制信号
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在线交互数据（无仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多延迟扰动测试+消融显示CPG涌现是时间建模所致；虽未达Unitree R1/AGIBOT A2级系统复杂度或任务广度，但首次在<500美元平台实证‘时间自组织’可替代传统观测补偿，在成本敏感边缘机器人领域具范式启发性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在极低成本硬件上用时间感知架构实证了CPG的机器涌现，不是调参刷榜，而是揭示了延迟鲁棒控制的新原理。

papers.title: Track4Action: Distilling World-Centric 3D Tracker into Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Action labels tell a vision-language-action (VLA) policy which robot commands to imitate, but not how those commands change the 3D world. The aligned demonstration clip contains this missing supervision because its $K$ frame transitions record the geometry, motion, visibility, and camera change produced during the corresponding $K$ actions. We introduce Track4Action, a framework that distills this realized transition from a frozen world-centric 3D tracker into a current-observation VLA policy. During training, Track4World encodes the clip $V_{t:t+K}$ into a pooled tracker feature. Learnable track queries infer this feature from current VLA hidden states, match it in a shared space, and condition a flow-matching action head through a feature-wise gate. The tracker feature only defines the alignment target, so neither the clip nor the tracker is used at deployment. Track4Action reaches 82.3% on zero-shot LIBERO-Plus, improving the alignment-free variant by 7.6 points and LaMP by 3.0 points. It obtains 80.44% and 81.48% on the clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 splits, and 67.5% average success across four physical bimanual tasks, 25.0 points above the alignment-free variant. The gains across simulation and physical tasks support action-aligned 3D tracker features as privileged supervision for tracker-free VLA deployment. Our project page is available at https://wing0night.github.io/track4action-project-page.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Track4Action框架，通过蒸馏一个冻结的、世界中心式的3D追踪器（Track4World）从演示视频片段中提取出的3D世界状态变化特征，作为监督信号来训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，使策略能隐式理解动作如何改变3D世界几何与运动；训练时用该特征对齐，部署时完全不依赖3D追踪器或视频片段。
analysis.claim: 世界中心式3D追踪器蒸馏出的帧间过渡特征可作为特权监督信号，显著提升VLA策略在零样本泛化、仿真与真实双臂操作任务中的性能，且部署时无需追踪器或视频输入。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（或末端执行器控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖带多帧动作对齐的演示视频（含K帧过渡），但未说明是否需真实机器人采集数据；实验使用LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0（仿真）和4个物理双臂任务（真实），后者暗示部分真实数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO-Plus（零样本）、RoboTwin 2.0（清洁/随机化）、4个真实双臂任务上均取得显著提升（+7.6~25.0点），且跨仿真与物理平台一致有效；但核心思想（用世界模型/追踪器蒸馏作监督）属已有范式演进（如RT-2用文本-动作对齐、π0用世界模型预测），未开新范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如通用具身因果推理），尚未达到RT-2/π0级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D世界追踪器作为可蒸馏的特权监督源，系统性验证其对VLA策略泛化性的增益，实证充分但方法路径延续已有思路，非概念或范式突破

papers.title: Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision for Reliable Dual-Arm Surgical Subtask Manipulation
papers.abstract: Surgical robotic systems are increasingly being adopted as clinical workload rises, motivating autonomous solutions for repetitive manipulation subtasks. Learning-based controllers improve generalization compared with rule-based and analytic approaches, but most are trained for individual tasks and remain difficult to reuse across procedures. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework that integrates visual perception, language grounding, and action generation, offering a promising path toward more composable surgical autonomy. However, existing VLA policies rely on fixed-length open-loop action sequences, where changing scene conditions can lead to accumulated errors and potential risks in surgical manipulation. To mitigate this issue, we formulate surgical VLA deployment as an adaptive execution-horizon decision problem and propose Trajectory Divergence Horizon Decision (TDHD), a test-time mechanism that estimates step-wise action reliability by measuring the divergence between two flow-matching-generated trajectories under small noise perturbations and truncates execution using a dual-threshold rule to trigger timely replanning. We further establish a real-world da Vinci-like dual-arm benchmark with synchronized multi-view perception and language instructions, and collect 600 teleoperated demonstrations across needle (reach, pick, regrasp) and tissue (reach, lift, resection) manipulation suites. On real hardware with 20 trials per task setting, TDHD consistently improves performance over the latest VLA baselines: success increases from 55\% to 60\% for needle manipulation and from 55\% to 80\% for tissue manipulation, with the largest gains observed in the final manipulation stages. These results highlight the importance of adaptive execution control for reliable deployment of VLA models in surgical robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫TDHD的实时决策机制，让手术双臂机器人在执行视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成的动作序列时，能动态判断每一步动作是否可靠——通过加微小噪声生成两条轨迹并计算其发散程度，一旦发散超阈值就提前截断并重新规划，从而提升真实达芬奇类双臂平台上的针和组织操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过在线评估动作轨迹对噪声扰动的鲁棒性来动态决定执行步长，可显著提升VLA模型在真实手术机器人上的操作可靠性。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+自然语言手术指令
analysis.output: 截断后的动作序列（含重规划触发信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研达芬奇类双臂手术机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖600段真实遥操作演示数据，且所有实验均在真实硬件上验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将轨迹发散度作为在线可靠性判据用于VLA手术控制，在真实双臂达芬奇平台上完成跨子任务（针/组织）验证，成功率达80%（组织切除），且明确归因于末段操作稳定性提升；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，也未与更底层的运动控制或触觉反馈耦合，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA模型在真实手术机器人上开环执行易累积误差的关键落地瓶颈，证据扎实（真机+多子任务+定量提升+消融逻辑清晰），但未开源且未拓展至触觉/力控等手术核心维度

papers.title: Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution
papers.abstract: Embodied agents are increasingly built as systems around foundation models, where performance depends not only on model weights but also on the skills, context, action interfaces, and execution harness surrounding the model. While supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning can adapt agents to new environments, they require additional data, rewards, and training runs; meanwhile, many train-free code-centric approaches rely on programmable robot APIs that may be unavailable in fixed-interface settings. We propose SHAPER, a self-evolving framework for train-free embodied adaptation that keeps model parameters frozen and improves the non-parametric agent system by evolving reusable skills and a context-code harness through target-environment rollouts. In SHAPER, the same frozen model can serve as both planner and optimizer, refining its external skills and context-code harness without parameter updates. We evaluate SHAPER on VLABench and ESI-Bench, covering embodied agents with different low-level action interfaces, and compare against pure execution, supervised fine-tuning, and test-time-scaling baselines such as verifier-free selection and voting. Our results suggest that skill-and-harness optimization is a practical route to self-evolving embodied agents when model training is expensive, unavailable, or undesirable.

analysis.tldr: 提出SHAPER框架，让冻结参数的大模型通过在真实或仿真环境中反复试错，自动优化外部可复用的技能库和上下文-代码执行 harness（而非更新模型权重），实现无需训练的具身智能体自适应。
analysis.claim: 冻结大模型参数的前提下，仅通过演化非参数化的技能模块与执行 harness，即可实现具身智能体在新环境中的免训练自适应。
analysis.input: 任务指令+当前观测（未明确模态，但隐含多模态感知输入）
analysis.output: 可执行的动作序列（通过调用演化后的技能与harness生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: VLABench / ESI-Bench 仿真环境（含多种低层动作接口）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖目标环境的rollout数据（即在线交互数据，非预采集静态数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘冻结模型+演化外部执行系统’的新思路有一定启发性，但仅在两个专用仿真benchmark上验证，无真机实验、无跨机体/跨用户泛化证据、无消融分析技能/harness各自贡献、未开源代码；相比标尺中94+分的里程碑工作（如GR00T N1、H2O等在真实人形机器人上实现零样本泛化或端到端运动-操作联合建模），本文停留在方法概念层面，实证薄弱，属扎实但窄的增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将技能模块化与harness解耦的思想有工程价值，但缺乏真机验证、泛化测试和开源支撑，尚未构成实质突破。

papers.title: ForgeWM: Progressive Causal Training for Few-Step Action-Conditioned Video World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video world models require low-latency causal generation and reliable responses to game-native controls. Although causal distillation enables one- or few-step video synthesis, extending it to interactive world models remains challenging, as discrete keyboard states and continuous mouse motion must remain aligned with temporally compressed latent chunks during causal training and autoregressive rollout. We introduce ForgeWM, a progressive framework that transforms a bidirectional action-conditioned video generator into efficient few-step world models through domain adaptation, teacher-forced causal training, causal consistency distillation, and on-policy distribution matching with a bidirectional teacher. The resulting budget-specialized students operate at steady-state denoising budgets of 1, 2, and 4 steps. ForgeWM further supports a dual-path deployment protocol combining latency-critical interaction with optional replay-time refinement, where the one-step student re-noises and refines its saved draft. On paired Minecraft trajectories, ForgeWM leads the evaluated systems in Imaging Quality, reference-aligned motion-profile agreement, action-sign accuracy, and mouse-control accuracy, while achieving the lowest reference LPIPS; the same four-stage recipe transfers to gamepad-controlled FPS gameplay. Replay-time refinement matches four-step reference quality while remaining roughly three times closer to the experienced trajectory than regeneration from noise. These results demonstrate ForgeWM's effectiveness for controllable few-step video generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出ForgeWM框架，通过渐进式因果训练（域适配+教师强制因果训练+因果一致性蒸馏+策略匹配）将双向动作条件视频生成器压缩为1/2/4步高效世界模型，并在Minecraft和FPS游戏中验证其低延迟、高保真、动作对齐的视频生成能力。
analysis.claim: 通过四阶段渐进式因果训练范式，可将高保真双向动作条件视频生成器可靠地蒸馏为稳态仅需1–4步去噪的、动作-视觉强对齐的交互式视频世界模型。
analysis.input: 离散键盘状态+连续鼠标运动+前序视频帧
analysis.output: 未来数帧的预测视频（1–4步生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境（Minecraft/FPS游戏引擎）生成的合成轨迹，无真实机器人或传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线扎实（四阶段因果蒸馏+双路径部署），在Minecraft和FPS两个游戏仿真环境中实证了1步生成质量接近4步参考、且动作信号准确率领先，但仍是纯仿真、无真实世界交互、无状态记忆机制、未挑战长期rollout或持续建模问题，属于高质量增量——显著优于普通视频预测工作，但远未达到World Models/DreamerV3/Genie等具备内部状态、闭环RL集成、跨模态决策核心的世界模型基石水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在游戏仿真中实现了低步数因果视频生成的系统性优化，但未触及世界模型的核心——持久状态表征与闭环决策耦合，暂不具备向真实具身智能迁移的基础。

papers.title: Pointing-VLA: Typed Spatial Grounding Interfaces for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often expose spatial grounding through autoregressive text coordinates or opaque action tokens, creating brittle interfaces between multimodal reasoning and robot execution. We present Pointing-VLA, a typed hidden-state spatial readout built on Embodied-R1. Geometry-specific heads predict normalized points, object-functional grounding (OFG) heatmaps, and visual trajectories without serializing geometry as text. For the evaluated Bridge/WidowX and physical pick-place deployments, an explicit execution contract assigns PICK to source-conditioned OFG and PLACE to Pointing, providing direct stage-aligned spatial targets. Pointing-VLA achieves SOTA performance on Bridge/WidowX, averaging 72.9\% across the evaluated four-task set without Bridge-specific finetuning under collision-enabled CuRobo execution. Pointing and OFG show complementary strengths across native and cross-dataset evaluations. The OFG/contact readout transfers to NORA-1.5, preserving or improving success while reducing recorded controller time by more than 20$\times$; typed heads are also 6.68--6.90$\times$ faster than Embodied-R1 text decoding on a shared external suite. When integrated as spatial guidance for a $π_{0.5}$ action policy, Pointing-VLA raises autonomous real-robot success from 52.7\% to 80.7\% across three visual contexts. These results establish typed spatial readouts as an efficient, inspectable interface between embodied reasoning and robot execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Pointing-VLA，用几何类型化（点、功能热图、视觉轨迹）的隐藏层读出机制替代传统VLA模型中脆弱的文本坐标或黑盒动作token，为视觉-语言-动作模型提供可解释、高效、可直接驱动机器人执行的空间接口，并在Bridge/WidowX仿真和真实机械臂抓放任务中显著提升成功率与执行效率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；姓名风格偏中文，但无明确高校/企业标识）
analysis.claim: typed spatial readouts（类型化的空间隐状态读出）比文本序列化或动作token化更高效、可解释、可迁移，且能直接对接机器人执行层形成‘显式执行契约’，从而实质性提升VLA模型在真实操作任务中的鲁棒性与效率。

papers.title: ZETA: A Controlled Study of Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment VLA Transfer for Tabletop Manipulation
papers.abstract: Zero-shot generalization to unseen embodiments is important for generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models as robot hardware evolves and task-specific data collection remains costly. However, a systematic understanding of this problem remains limited, in part because the literature lacks a unified zero-shot transfer definition and controlled evaluation settings that isolate embodiment changes from differences in tasks, scenes, or protocols. To address this gap, we first distinguish strict zero-shot transfer, where the target embodiment is absent from all training data, from pretrain-exposed zero-shot transfer, where it appears only during pretraining. We then introduce a controlled benchmark spanning 14 held-out target embodiments across simulation and real-world validation. Within this framework, we conduct a controlled analysis of four factors: state-action representations, pretraining embodiment diversity, auxiliary co-training objectives, and target-embodiment exposure. Experimental results show that local end-effector (EEF) state-action representations, the source embodiment diversity, and auxiliary co-training improve cross-embodiment transfer by around 15, 18, and 7 percentage points, respectively. We further find that adding only 5% target-embodiment data during pretraining improves average target-embodiment progress by 13.4 percentage points, showing that strict and pretrain-exposed zero-shot transfer are distinct and should be reported separately. Together, these findings provide practical guidance for evaluating and improving cross-embodiment VLA transfer in stationary tabletop manipulation with two-finger grippers, while motivating future investigation of broader settings including mobile-base control, dexterous hands, and long-horizon tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在桌面抓取任务中跨机器人本体（如不同夹爪）的零样本迁移问题，构建了一个包含14种新本体的受控评测基准，并通过消融实验定量揭示了末端执行器状态表征、预训练本体多样性、辅助共训练目标和预训练阶段是否见过目标本体这四个关键因素对迁移效果的影响。

papers.title: FOCI Policy: Focus on Object-Centric Interactions for Relational Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Object-centric manipulation policies improve generalization by modeling object motion instead of directly predicting robot actions. However, existing methods are often limited by representations which are either too simplistic to capture interaction dynamics or too dense to learn efficiently. We observe that many rigid relational manipulation tasks are governed by short interaction phases where the relative motion between task-relevant objects is tightly constrained. Based on this observation, we propose \textsc{Foci Policy}, an interaction-centric framework that achieves a two-fold abstraction: (1) temporally, by automatically extracting compact interaction segments from demonstrations;(2) spatially, by representing skills as relative $SE(3)$ motion between task-relevant objects, yielding invariance to scene configurations and robot embodiment. Experiments on RLBench, COLOSSEUM, and real-world tasks show that \textsc{Foci Policy} achieves strong performance with substantially less training data than prior object-centric and action-centric policies. These results suggest that modeling object-object interactions provides a simple and efficient inductive bias for rigid relational manipulation. Project page: \href{https://fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}{fitz0401.github.io/foci-page/}.

analysis.tldr: 提出FOCI策略，通过自动提取演示中关键的物体间交互片段，并用任务相关物体之间的相对SE(3)运动来表征操作技能，从而在更少训练数据下实现跨场景、跨机体的刚性关系操作泛化。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Contact-Rich Assembly via Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Pretraining
papers.abstract: Contact-rich assembly remains challenging because it requires submillimeter spatial accuracy and reliable interpretation of forces during sustained contact. Although simulation-based reinforcement learning offers a scalable training paradigm, discrepancies in visual observations, contact dynamics, and force/torque (F/T) measurements often limit policy transfer. We observe that proprioception is comparatively consistent across domains because calibrated joint positions and consistently computed joint velocities align closely between simulation and hardware. Based on this observation, we present PACE (Proprioception-Anchored Cross-Modal Encoder), which supervises temporal visual and F/T representations by predicting proprioceptive state transitions. Static domain-specific factors, including lighting, texture, and sensor bias, contain little information about joint motion; the proposed objective therefore encourages the encoder to suppress these factors while retaining task-relevant motion cues. Policies trained on frozen PACE features are deployed on hardware without real-world fine-tuning or object-pose tracking. Across four contact-rich assembly tasks, PACE attains an average real-world success rate of 93.3\% and only a 2.7-percentage-point sim-to-real drop, meanwhile remaining robust to perturbations that substantially degrade pose-based and learned-fusion baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫PACE的跨模态预训练方法，用机器人本体感知信号（关节位置/速度）作为锚点，来对齐仿真和真实世界中的视觉与力/扭矩数据，从而让只在仿真中训练的装配策略能直接部署到真实机器人上，不做任何微调就实现了93.3%的高成功率。
analysis.claim: 本体感知信号在仿真与真实之间高度一致，可作为跨模态预训练的稳定监督信号，从而实现零样本、无需位姿跟踪的接触密集装配sim2real迁移。

analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制指令）

papers.title: LePlanner: An Iterative Amortized Controller For World Models
papers.abstract: World models trained with joint-embedding predictive architectures learn compact, structured latent representations from physical interaction, yet planning in these latent spaces typically relies on one of two costly approaches. Search-based planners such as CEM, MPPI, and iCEM optimize action sequences through many predictor rollouts, achieving strong performance at the cost of high per-decision compute and latency. Policy-based methods amortize inference into a single forward pass but can degrade on contact-rich tasks where the demonstration distribution is multimodal. We propose LePlanner, an amortized iterative controller that learns to construct and refine latent action sequences through a frozen world-model predictor. LePlanner is trained with an arrival-and-hold objective that encourages the controller to reach the goal at the earliest feasible horizon and remain there. This addresses horizon-reset procrastination, a failure mode in which repeated receding-horizon replanning continually postpones goal arrival. An additional action-Gaussian loss keeps generated actions near the support of the offline dataset. Across navigation, contact-rich manipulation, and continuous-control environments, LePlanner matches or exceeds search-based planners while requiring an order of magnitude fewer predictor evaluations and 3-49x lower wall-clock time per decision. It achieves success rates of 98% on PushT, 100% on Reacher, 100% on TwoRooms, and 92% on the OGBench Cube task. These results show that much of the structure discovered through online search can be amortized into a lightweight iterative policy, enabling fast, horizon-aware, nonlinear physical control without online optimization.

analysis.tldr: 提出LePlanner，一种在冻结的世界模型潜空间中迭代优化动作序列的轻量级控制器，用少量迭代替代传统搜索式规划器的大量rollout，在多个物理控制任务上达到相近甚至更高成功率，同时将计算开销降低一个数量级。
analysis.claim: 通过迭代式 amortized 控制器设计，可在冻结世界模型上高效复现搜索式规划器的性能，消除horizon-reset procrastination，并显著降低实时决策延迟。

papers.title: Calibrated structural homology transfer yields putative molecular functions for domains of unknown function in four model proteomes
papers.abstract: Improvements in computational protein structure prediction have enabled searches for remote homologs of proteins whose molecular function remain unknown. However, the reliability of functional annotations from such searches has not been systematically quantified. In this study, we assembled a time-split benchmark from Pfam families annotated as domains of unknown function (DUFs) in Pfam 28.0 and were subsequently assigned a function in the current release (Pfam 38.0). These retrospective-DUFs provide ground truth for assessing functional annotation from remote homology searches. In our benchmark analysis, we paired retrospective-DUFs with a difficulty-matched arm from known domains to distinguish query difficulty from the method's performance. Across four model proteomes (yeast, C. elegans, Drosophila, and mice), Foldseek searches against AlphaFold/Swiss-Prot, PDB100, and CATH50 recovered the later-assigned function for 15.9% of retrospective DUF queries, compared with 30.1% of matched known-domain queries, after masking for self-family and self-clan level hits to remove circularity. At a fixed confidence cut-off (qTM ≥ 0.5), 55.4% of informative calls on retrospective DUFs were incorrect, establishing an error model for prospective use. Furthermore, in our comparison of tools for homology searches, Foldseek outperformed MMseq2-based sequence search but was not statistically separable from the ESM-2 protein language model embedding baseline. Applying the calibrated structural homology search pipeline to 296 currently unannotated DUF queries in Pfam 38.0 yielded 50 confident, specific functional assignments. We provide the benchmark and ranked candidates as a resource to facilitate functional studies.

analysis.tldr: 用结构比对工具Foldseek在四个模式生物蛋白组中搜索远缘同源结构，基于时间分离的DUF基准集量化了结构同源转移功能注释的准确率和错误率，并校准后为296个当前未注释DUF域提供了50个高置信度分子功能预测。
analysis.claim: 结构同源搜索（而非序列）在功能注释中虽有潜力，但其真实可靠性被严重高估；通过时间分离基准可定量建模其错误率，并据此校准后实现可信赖的前瞻性功能预测。

papers.title: TEMPO: Learning Temporal Context for Dynamic Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance in quasi-static manipulation, but struggle in dynamic manipulation tasks because they operate on a single observation at inference time. We identify two representational failures that underlie this limitation. The first is motion ambiguity, where a single observation does not include scene dynamics and therefore cannot anticipate the future state of moving objects. The second is state aliasing, where visually similar observations from different points in a task require different actions. We argue that these failures persist regardless of model scale and inference latency, showing that the bottleneck is missing temporal context rather than model capacity. Based on this insight, we propose TEMPO, which augments a pretrained VLA with two temporal inputs: a motion summary extracted from a frozen video foundation model to resolve motion ambiguity and a compact proprioceptive history to resolve state aliasing. TEMPO requires no modification to the backbone and adds minimal compute overhead at training or deployment. Across four dynamic manipulation tasks, it improves Bottle Handover success from 44% to 74% and is the only method that solves state aliasing. Probing and ablation studies confirm that each temporal signal independently addresses its corresponding failure. We further release TEMPO-Bench, a benchmark of over 50k annotated frames for evaluating motion-aware robot perception in both regression and multiple-choice formats. Project Website: https://tempo-robot.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作模型在动态抓取任务中失败的根本原因是缺少时间上下文，于是用冻结的视频基础模型提取运动摘要、再加一段本体感觉历史作为两个轻量级时间输入，不改原模型就能大幅提升动态操作成功率，并发布了首个专门评测运动感知能力的基准数据集TEMPO-Bench。

papers.title: Accelerating Visual Policy Learning with Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics. For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher. On a single GPU, SGPS learns policies for locomotion, obstacle traversal, crate pushing, and bimanual carrying on simulated Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. Our experiments further show that refinement improves policy learning beyond initialization and tracking alone. For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SGPS的新训练框架，把采样式模型预测控制（MPC）和一阶策略梯度（FoPG）交替结合，用少量真实深度图就能在单卡上训练出能跑、爬、越障、搬箱子的视觉策略，并且不依赖渲染或状态估计器，直接零样本迁移到真机Go2上运行。
analysis.claim: 通过将采样式MPC的全局动作引导与FoPG的局部梯度优化交替耦合，可在无状态先验、无渲染计算图、仅用深度输入的前提下，高效训练泛化性强的视觉运动策略，并实现零样本sim2real迁移。

analysis.output: 低层关节力矩/速度控制指令
