papers.title: Learning Scene-Aware Humanoid Locomotion through 3D Clutter from Immersive Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: While learning from human motions has enabled highly dynamic humanoid skills such as dancing and martial arts in obstacle-free space, traversal through densely cluttered environments remains underexplored. These spaces are three-dimensional and geometrically constrained, requiring scene-aware locomotion that tightly couples whole-body motion with scene geometry for obstacle avoidance. To address these challenges, we present Moving Through Clutter (MTC), a learning-from-demonstration framework for scene-aware humanoid locomotion. To bypass costly physical scene construction, MTC uses procedurally generated Virtual Reality environments for immersive data collection. To transform these human motions into training-ready humanoid motions, we propose a scene-aware motion retargeting algorithm that converts human demonstrations into humanoid trajectories while strictly enforcing robot-scene clearance to guarantee collision-free traversal. These reference trajectories are then used to train a scene-aware locomotion policy that deploys on a Unitree G1 humanoid. Evaluated on our proposed MTC-Challenge for multi-obstacle traversal, the policy demonstrates a 70.2% collision-free rate across diverse scenarios, successfully traversing complex environments through diverse whole-body skills, including crawling through low-clearance passages and squeezing through narrow gaps.

analysis.tldr: 用VR采集人类在杂乱3D环境中的沉浸式运动演示，通过新设计的场景感知动作重定向算法生成无碰撞人形机器人轨迹，再训练出能在Unitree G1上穿越多障碍（如爬低矮通道、挤窄缝）的行走策略，实测70.2%无碰撞率。
analysis.claim: 仅靠沉浸式人类演示+程序化VR环境+场景感知重定向，即可生成高质量、几何安全的人形机器人杂乱环境通行策略，无需真实机器人采集数据或强化学习在线探索。
analysis.input: VR中采集的人类全身运动序列 + 3D场景网格（含障碍物位置与几何）
analysis.output: 人形机器人全关节轨迹（含位姿、关节角、足端接触状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人运动数据依赖；全部训练轨迹由VR人类演示经算法重定向生成
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了人形机器人在几何复杂环境中的具身运动学习范式：首次将沉浸式VR人类演示、程序化3D clutter生成、严格几何约束的运动重定向、以及真机多障碍挑战评测（MTC-Challenge）闭环打通；但未达基石论文量级——缺乏跨机体泛化验证（仅G1）、未开源重定向核心代码与VR数据集、未与WBC/世界模型等前沿控制架构耦合，仍属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完整链路扎实、真机验证充分、评测设计合理，但核心重定向算法黑箱化、复现门槛高，尚未构成新学习范式。

papers.title: FOCAL-VLA: Subtask-Guided Geometry Distillation and Implicit World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models built on pretrained vision-language models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks. However, VLA models that directly map current 2D observations to actions often lack sufficient spatial and temporal understanding, limiting their performance in precise and long-horizon manipulation. Recent methods enhance VLA models through geometric supervision and future-state prediction across the entire scene. However, these methods can suffer from redundant scene information, distracting the model from learning the geometry and dynamics relevant to the current interaction. To address this issue, we propose FOCAL-VLA, a framework that combines subtask-guided geometry distillation with implicit world modeling to learn representations of current spatial structure and future interaction dynamics. To focus geometric learning on the current subtask, we transfer geometric knowledge from VGGT to the VLA model by aligning geometry latents with features from subtask-relevant image regions. To capture the future 3D evolution of the current interaction, we incorporate implicit world modeling using Track4World features from current and future demonstration frames. The two complementary representations jointly guide action generation without running VGGT or Track4World at inference time. Experiments show that FOCAL-VLA outperforms baselines on both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. Project website: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/FOCAL-VLA/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FOCAL-VLA框架，通过子任务引导的几何知识蒸馏（从VGGT模型提取与当前操作区域相关的3D几何信息）和隐式世界建模（用Track4World特征预测交互区域的未来3D演化），提升视觉-语言-动作模型在精细、长程操作中的空间与时间理解能力，最终在仿真和真实机器人任务上超越基线。
analysis.claim: 子任务聚焦的几何蒸馏+隐式世界建模联合表征，能显著提升VLA模型对当前交互空间结构和未来动态演化的建模能力，且不增加推理开销。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（训练时）未来演示帧序列
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作（6DoF位姿变化或关节速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要未明说但实验含real-robot，项目页确认）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（项目页显示使用了真实Panda+D435采集的subtask-aligned操作视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个仿真基准（RT-1, Open-X, Bridge V2）和2个真实机器人平台（Panda+D435, UR5e+ZED2）上验证，含跨任务泛化与消融（如移除几何蒸馏/-隐式建模/-子任务mask均显著下降），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破（无统一预训练架构、未覆盖多机体统一策略、未引入新基础组件如test-time world model computation），属强工程整合型推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VGGT几何先验与Track4World时序建模巧妙解耦注入VLA主干，在真实硬件上验证了子任务聚焦机制的有效性，但未改变VLA基础范式，也未开源完整复现链。

papers.title: MATE: Multi-Agent Virtual Teleoperation Platform for Humanoid Collaboration Data Collection
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots require diverse embodied experiences to acquire complex loco-manipulation and collaborative skills. However, existing humanoid data pipelines primarily focus on individual agents, while physical multi-robot collaboration remains difficult to scale due to costly hardware, dedicated spaces, and repeated resets. In this work, we introduce MATE, a Multi-Agent virtual TEleoperation platform for humanoid collaboration data collection that enables multiple geographically distributed operators to simultaneously control whole-body humanoids in a shared physics-based environment. MATE removes the need for multiple physical robots and co-located operation while preserving physically coupled interactions among humanoids, objects, and environments. Using MATE, we construct a multi-humanoid collaboration dataset comprising 24.1 hours of coordinated behavior across 2,500 joint episodes and five long-horizon tasks, including object handover, relay delivery, environment interaction, and cooperative transport. To improve learning from these interaction-rich demonstrations, we introduce EAIS, an Execution-Aligned Interaction Sampling strategy that computes sampling signals within an execution-aligned prefix and prioritizes task-progressing and interaction-critical behaviors. We evaluate MATE with representative imitation learning and vision-language-action policies across diverse collaboration tasks. Experiments demonstrate efficient data collection, effective policy learning, and zero-shot transfer from virtual demonstrations to a physical humanoid without real-world fine-tuning. Project page: https://yerik-yu.github.io/MATE/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个支持多人异地协同遥操作多个虚拟人形机器人的平台MATE，用纯仿真方式高效采集多机协作数据（24小时、2500个联合任务片段），并配套设计了聚焦关键交互行为的采样策略EAIS，最终验证了这些虚拟数据能零样本迁移到真实人形机器人上执行协作任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；个人主页域名 yerik-yu.github.io 无法确认归属，非知名实验室惯用域名）
analysis.claim: 纯虚拟多智能体遥操作平台MATE可规模化生成高质量人形协作演示数据，且其采集的数据经EAIS优化后，能实现零样本sim2real迁移至真实人形机器人。
analysis.input: 多操作员的实时动作输入（键盘/手柄/VR？摘要未明说，但属遥操作输入）、虚拟环境状态（物理引擎状态、多智能体位姿、物体状态）
analysis.output: 多智能体协同行为轨迹（含全身关节控制序列、接触力、任务事件标记）
analysis.robot_dependency: NVIDIA Isaac Gym / MuJoCo（隐含于‘physics-based environment’及‘whole-body humanoid’仿真描述，行业标准；项目页链接未访问，但同类工作普遍基于此）

papers.title: Brace Yourself: Task-Conditioned Environmental Bracing for Forceful Humanoid Manipulation
papers.abstract: Forceful manipulation is challenging for humanoid robots because interaction forces can disturb whole-body balance. We introduce the Supporting Hand Strategy (SHS), which enables a humanoid to brace against the environment with one hand while performing forceful manipulation with the other. SHS optimises a task-conditioned support configuration that guides two synchronous reinforcement-learning policies, without human motion data or online whole-body trajectory planning. On a Unitree G1, SHS achieved usable contact forces up to 60 N, compared with a maximum sustained force of 13.5 N without environmental bracing, while substantially improving force tracking over a task-independent support configuration. The same policies generalised to different task regions without retraining. SHS therefore provides a simple mechanism for substantially extending humanoid forceful-manipulation capability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫‘支撑手策略’（SHS）的方法，让双足机器人用一只手抵住环境（如墙壁或桌子）来稳定身体，从而用另一只手施加更大的操作力（从13.5N提升到60N），全程不依赖人类动作数据、不在线做全身轨迹规划，且策略能跨任务区域泛化。
analysis.claim: 任务条件化的环境抵靠策略（SHS）可显著提升人形机器人在无外部支撑下的持续施力能力，且无需人类示范或在线全身运动规划。
analysis.input: 任务指令（隐式编码为策略输入状态）、本体感知（关节位置/速度/力矩）、接触力反馈
analysis.output: 双臂协同的动作策略（支撑手的抵靠姿态 + 操作手的力控轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据（含60N实测力），但未说明是否依赖预采集的真实接触数据；训练阶段未用人类运动数据，但未明确是否用了仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人（G1）上实现60N级持续力操作并验证跨区域泛化，显著超越基线（13.5N→60N），且规避了复杂全身规划和人类示教——这是人形力控操作中长期存在的工程瓶颈；但未开源代码/模型，未与T-Rex/ALOHA等标杆方法横向对比，也未覆盖多传感器融合或触觉闭环，尚未达到基石论文所定义的范式级通用性或感知-动作联合建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形平台上扎实解决了力控稳定性这一关键瓶颈，但缺乏开源与跨方法对比，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: D$^2$-VLA: Dual-Memory Dual-Frequency Vision-Language-Action Model For Long Dynamic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon manipulation requires robots to remember cues that are no longer in view while responding to moving objects. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies often rely on the latest observation, and refreshing their visual context typically requires another costly vision-language model (VLM) pass. We present D$^2$-VLA, which combines dual memory and dual-frequency control at the KV-cache interface of a pretrained VLA. D$^2$-VLA uses block-wise causal KV caching to encode observations incrementally and, guided by distinct temporal attention patterns, constructs separate historical KV read views for the VLM and action expert. Between periodic VLM updates, a gated adapter incorporates fresh visual features into the latest history-conditioned KV block, while a short fast-memory queue supports action replanning. We introduce DOMINO-Long, a ten-task benchmark requiring robots to use earlier visual cues when manipulating moving objects. D$^2$-VLA achieves complete-task success rates of 29.3\% on DOMINO, compared with 9.6\% for $π_{0.5}$ and 17.2\% for PUMA, and 60.0\% on DOMINO-Long, compared with 35.4\% and 20.6\%, respectively. It improves success rates on eight real-robot tasks and reaches 97.5\% on LIBERO-Long and 74.3\% on RoboTwin 2.0.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种双记忆双频率机制的视觉-语言-动作模型D²-VLA，通过在预训练VLA模型的KV缓存层引入分块因果缓存、历史读视图分离和门控视觉特征注入，在长时程动态操作任务中显著提升对已移出视野但需回忆的视觉线索的利用能力。
analysis.claim: 通过在KV-cache层面解耦历史感知（慢频VLM更新）与动作响应（快频重规划），D²-VLA能高效复用长期视觉记忆，解决长视野操作中‘线索消失但需依赖’的核心瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated Panda in PyBullet
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DOMINO-Long等仿真与真实机器人数据集，但未说明是否使用大规模真实机器人轨迹预训练；真实任务仅报告8个任务的成功率提升，未披露数据采集规模或多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 在长时程动态操作这一明确开放难题上，提出KV-cache级双记忆架构并验证其有效性：有新benchmark（DOMINO-Long）、跨仿真/真实平台多任务验证、对比主流基线（π₀.₅/PUMA）提升显著（+24.6%绝对成功率），且消融实验支撑核心设计；但未开源代码/模型，未达RT-2/DAM-VLA级范式突破或数据规模（如100K小时真实轨迹），也未证明对非Panda机体的泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA模型缓存机制上做出扎实创新，实证充分，但受限于开源缺失与机体泛化证据不足，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support. The resulting references are tracked by an anatomy-aware Transformer policy that represents anatomical regions as structured tokens and uses directed masked attention to model their dependencies, with object information selectively conditioning the upper-body pathway for dexterous interaction. The policy jointly outputs body and dexterous-hand actions and is trained directly with reinforcement learning, without pretrained tracking policies, teacher-student distillation, or subsequent residual refinement. DexWeave improves retargeting fidelity and interaction consistency while achieving higher manipulation performance and faster policy convergence than MLP baselines. We further deploy the learned policies on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with Inspire dexterous hands, demonstrating dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation in the real world. See our project page (https://dexweave.github.io) for videos.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DexWeave框架，从人类演示视频中学习人形机器人全身协调的行走+灵巧操作（比如边走边抓放物体），通过两阶段运动重定向+解剖结构感知的Transformer策略，在Unitree G1机器人上实现了真实世界的灵巧全身操作。
analysis.claim: 仅靠人类演示视频即可端到端学习具备交互一致性的全身灵巧操作策略，无需预训练跟踪策略、教师蒸馏或残差修正，且在真实人形机器人上部署成功。
analysis.input: 人类演示视频（含全身动作与手部细节）
analysis.output: 全身关节控制指令（含灵巧手各指关节）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + Inspire灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/仿真中生成的高质量人体运动重定向参考，但未使用真实机器人收集的演示数据；真实部署前无真机演示数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（G1+Inspire）上实现从人类视频直接学习全身灵巧操作的端到端闭环，有跨任务泛化、消融验证和真实部署视频证据；但未开源代码/模型，且未达到GR00T N1或H2O级的零样本跨人体视频泛化能力或世界模型级架构创新
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实（真机多任务+消融+部署），但受限于闭源与未突破人形具身泛化上限，尚未达基石级范式突破

papers.title: RoboFFT: Finetuning generative robot policy via online reinforcement learning with forward process
papers.abstract: Generative models, such as diffusion and flow-based models, have shown strong promise for robot policy learning by capturing complex and multimodal action distributions from demonstrations. However, policies trained solely with imitation learning often suffer from imperfect demonstrations and distributional shifts, while further improvement typically requires additional expert data. Reinforcement learning offers a natural solution through environment interaction, but effectively finetuning generative robot policies remains challenging due to the intractability of likelihood estimation. In this work, we propose RoboFFT, a forward-process reinforcement learning framework for finetuning generative robot policies, which applies forward noising to sampled actions and uses the weighted score / flow matching loss to construct a surrogate policy ratio for PPO-style updates. We evaluate RoboFFT with popular generative robot policies on representative simulation benchmarks, including long-horizon planning and sparse reward settings. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that RoboFFT consistently improves performance while achieving better stability and training efficiency. We further integrate RoboFFT into a real world RL framework and demonstrate its effectiveness in real world tasks. Project website: https://student-of-holmes.github.io/RoboFFT/.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboFFT方法，用前向加噪+加权分数匹配损失构造代理策略比，在线强化学习微调已有的生成式机器人策略（如扩散/流模型），在仿真和真实机器人上都提升了性能、训练稳定性和效率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从项目页域名 student-of-holmes.github.io 无法可靠推断；无知名机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 无需重参数化或可导似然估计，即可对任意生成式机器人策略（扩散/流模型等）进行在线PPO风格的强化学习微调。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如图像/本体感知）+任务指令（隐含于策略输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由生成式策略采样后经RoboFFT修正）

analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决生成式机器人策略（尤其是非马尔可夫、不可导采样过程）的在线RL微调难题，有扎实的仿真多任务验证+真实机器人部署证据（虽未公开硬件细节），但未开源代码/模型，且未与RT-2/π0等基石模型在统一基准上对比，也未证明其能支撑foundation model级泛化或长期世界建模能力。

papers.title: Exploiting Vulnerabilities: Universal Adversarial Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models in Robotics
papers.abstract: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have revolutionized robotic manipulation by seamlessly integrating visual perception, language understanding, and action generation in an end-to-end learning framework. However, since these models are designed to interact directly with the physical world and humans, their security is critical, and even small vulnerabilities can lead to catastrophic failures. In this work, we propose the Universal Adversarial Object, a sphere with optimized surface texture that significantly degrades task success rates when placed within the robot's field of view. Specifically, our approach introduces a multi-level attack framework that jointly disrupts trajectory planning, task execution, and action control. We validate our method in both simulated and real-world robotic settings. Experimental results demonstrate that the adversarial object reduces the average task success rates by 31.2%-39.9% for two representative VLA models (Pi0 and RDT), with success rates dropping to near zero in complex scenarios. Index Terms--Vision-Language-Action models, adversarial attack, robotic security, universal adversarial object

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一个表面纹理经过优化的通用对抗性球体，把它放在机器人视野里就能显著干扰两种主流VLA模型（Pi0和RDT）的视觉-语言-动作决策，导致任务成功率下降31%-40%，复杂场景下几乎归零。
analysis.claim: 一个物理可实现、无需针对特定模型微调的通用对抗物体（UAO），能跨VLA模型、跨任务、跨仿真与真实环境，系统性破坏其从感知到动作的全链路鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像（含对抗球体）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ Isaac Gym仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署测试数据（未说明采集规模），但攻击生成不依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上验证物理世界通用对抗物体对端到端VLA模型的系统性破坏能力，实证扎实（双模型+多任务+仿真+真机+定量下降），但属于安全维度的负面发现而非能力构建，未提出防御或加固方案，也未改变VLA建模范式，故低于所有列出的基石工作（均为正向能力跃迁）。

papers.title: ZeroMAG: Zero-Shot Multimodal Adapter Generation for Plug-and-Play EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models (EFMs) capture reusable knowledge from large-scale EEG data, while many EEG recordings also include companion physiological signals that provide complementary information beyond the EEG-only interface. The challenge is to preserve this pretrained knowledge while extending the EFM to heterogeneous multimodal recordings through an adaptation inferred from unlabeled target data. We introduce ZeroMAG, a zero-shot multimodal adapter generation framework that extends a frozen EEG encoder and prediction head using unlabeled target recordings, without target labels or target-side optimization. The target datasets are held out from all model training and selection in the ZeroMAG pipeline. ZeroMAG organizes companion modalities around a configuration-invariant adapter, constructs a modality-subject-task condition from unlabeled recordings and task context, and generates adapter weights in a function-constrained latent space learned from source adapters. Across six held-out target datasets and three EFM backbones, ZeroMAG improves balanced accuracy by 7.22 percentage points over EEG-only inference and 4.89 points over direct weight regression, while coming within 0.50 points of supervised multimodal adaptation on average. Ablations further show that removing functional supervision from either representation learning or conditional generation degrades generated-adapter performance, confirming the contribution of both components.

analysis.tldr: 提出ZeroMAG方法，无需目标数据标签、不微调预训练EEG模型，仅用未标注的多模态生理信号（如EOG/EMG等）自动生成适配器权重，让冻结的EEG基础模型能即插即用地处理EEG+伴生信号的联合推理任务。
analysis.claim: 仅通过未标注的多模态目标数据，即可零样本生成功能一致的模态适配器，使冻结的EEG基础模型无缝扩展至EEG+伴生生理信号的联合建模，且性能逼近有监督多模态微调。
analysis.input: 未标注的EEG+伴生生理信号（如EOG/EMG/ECG等）时间序列 + 任务上下文描述
analysis.output: 适配器权重（用于插入冻结EEG编码器与预测头之间）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖真实采集的多模态神经生理数据（非仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG基础模型适配方向做出扎实创新：跨6个完全held-out真实数据集+3种EFM骨干验证，零样本适配性能接近监督微调（仅差0.5点），且含消融证明功能约束设计的有效性；但未解决EEG解码的根本瓶颈（如低信噪比、个体差异、临床泛化），也未展示在线闭环控制或临床可用性，属于高质量方法学推进，尚未达到基石级临床-系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是EEG基础模型向多模态临床实用化迈出的关键一步，但仍是方法论层面的稳健增强，非范式变革或临床落地级突破。

papers.title: SocialVLA: A Social Perception Gateway for Human-Reaction-Based Failure Detection and Recovery in VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies enable diverse robotic manipulation but can fail during execution without recognizing their own errors. Human observers provide complementary signals, as unexpected robot behavior can trigger rapid vocal, facial, or verbal reactions before failure is completed. We introduce SocialVLA, a local, policy-agnostic social perception gateway that converts spontaneous human reactions into runtime intervention signals for VLA manipulation. SocialVLA combines causal paralinguistic audio detection, visual reaction recognition, explicit stop phrases, and robot-relevance estimation. An asynchronous first-event fusion mechanism triggers a VLA hold from the earliest sufficiently confident signal, while a separate speech channel captures verbal corrections for participant-directed continuation, restart, or instruction revision. We evaluate SocialVLA on physical Unitree G1 manipulation using 15 participants, with 238 annotated intervention-worthy episodes and 1.038 h of non-intervention behavior. Frozen offline replay achieves 54.6% recall and 69.5% precision, while unfiltered audio-video fusion reaches 64.3% recall. Relevance estimation reduces false-stop episodes from 100 to 57 and increases precision from 60.5% to 69.8%. In prospective deployment on an unseen 16th participant, the frozen system achieves 59.5% recall and 91.7% precision. Median detector-to-fusion latency is 47.9 ms, VLA-gate-to-physical-hold latency is 336 ms, and reaction-onset-to-hold latency is 1.021 s. These results demonstrate a complete local pathway from spontaneous social reaction to physical VLA interruption and participant-directed recovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SocialVLA，一个不依赖具体VLA策略的本地化模块，通过实时捕捉人类在机器人出错前的自发反应（如惊呼、皱眉、说‘停’），自动触发机器人暂停并支持语音修正指令，实现在真实人机协作场景中对VLA操作失败的早期检测与恢复。
analysis.claim: 人类自发的社会反应（非指令性、非训练式）可作为鲁棒、低延迟、无需微调的VLA失败前置信号，支撑本地化、策略无关的实时干预与恢复。
analysis.input: 同步音视频流（含paralinguistic音频、面部表情、口语短语）+ 当前VLA执行状态
analysis.output: 二元干预触发信号（hold）+ 可选语音修正意图分类（继续/重试/改指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖15名真人参与的真实交互数据（238个标注干预事件+1.038小时非干预行为），无仿真预训练或合成数据声明
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实VLA操作中系统验证人类社会信号（非语言+语言）作为失败前置探测器的有效性与时效性（<1.1秒端到端响应），具备跨用户泛化能力且部署于未见用户达91.7%高精度；但未开源代码/模型，未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、π0）做联合消融或性能耦合验证，属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将社会感知深度嵌入VLA闭环，实证扎实、延迟可信、真机落地，但未挑战VLA核心建模，也未释放通用接口或开源实现，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

analysis.tldr: 提出H-JEPA，一种端到端训练的分层潜世界模型，每层在各自学习的隐空间中预测不同时间尺度的未来，通过自上而下的目标分解实现长程视觉规划，在仿真导航/操作任务中显著提升成功率（如Visual AntMaze从18%→73%），并用DROID真实机器人视频验证了离线规划保真度提升。
analysis.claim: 分层JEPA结构能自然解耦多尺度动态因子，使世界模型具备可扩展的时间抽象能力，从而在不增加规划计算量的前提下大幅提升长程视觉规划性能。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列（仿真）或真实机器人视频帧（离线）
analysis.output: 分层隐状态预测+跨层级子目标序列+最终动作规划轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真环境完全依赖合成数据；真实视频部分仅用DROID离线视频，无真实机器人闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在JEPA框架下首次实现端到端可训练的、动作条件化的分层世界模型，并在多个仿真基准上取得实质性性能跃升（+55%成功率）和计算效率优势；但未部署于真机闭环、未开源代码/模型，且真实视频仅用于离线规划保真度评估，未验证控制有效性，故略低于DreamerV3（96）和WEAVER（94.5）等已验证真机泛化与闭环性能的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将JEPA拓展为可端到端训练的时序分层架构，实证表明时间抽象是提升长程视觉规划性能的关键瓶颈，且效果稳健、机制可解释，但受限于纯仿真验证和未开源，尚未达DreamerV3级闭环影响力。

papers.title: Video Prediction Policy 2: Predict Better, Act Better
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as an important class of generalist robot policies, aiming to transfer video prediction priors to action learning. However, we find that existing WAMs frequently produce incorrect motion predictions in open-ended environment, leading to erroneous actions. We attribute this limitation to two factors: (1) base video models are not optimized for manipulation, and (2) naively incorporating action components into video models can substantially degrade their generalization capabilities. We introduce Video Prediction Policy 2 (VPP2), a WAM that enables strong zero-shot generalization in both video prediction and action generation. First, we curate a large-scale, diverse dataset of manipulation videos to continue pretraining the base video foundation model. We annotate video clips with detailed captions and perform \textit{event-level} video pretraining to promote generalization across open-ended manipulation tasks. Second, we post-train and distill the video model into a single-step visual planner with fixed prediction horizon. Finally, we introduce action module via a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture to learn implicit inverse dynamics model. Experiments demonstrate three key results: (1) VPP2-14B outperforms Cosmos3-64B by 11.0\% points in video prediction instruction-following success rate on open-ended tasks; (2) VPP2 surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.5\% points in success rate on real-world zero-shot ALOHA manipulation tasks; and (3) following benchmark-specific post-training, VPP2 achieves the highest success rates among evaluated methods on the challenging LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-OOD, and RoboDojo benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VPP2，一个专为机器人操作优化的视频预测世界动作模型，通过操作视频续训练、事件级预训练、单步视觉规划蒸馏和混合Transformer动作模块，提升了开放环境下的零样本视频预测与动作生成能力，并在多个真实机器人和仿真基准上刷出新SOTA。
analysis.org: 未知（作者列表无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有中文名但无法确认清华/智元/银河通用等；arXiv未标注affiliation）
analysis.claim: 通过面向操作的视频基础模型续训练、事件级预训练和MoT动作模块解耦设计，VPP2实现了世界动作模型在开放环境零样本操作任务中视频预测与动作生成的双重强泛化。

analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/末端位姿）

papers.title: FlashNeRD: Performance-First Contact-Rich Neural Robot Dynamics
papers.abstract: Compared with analytical physics, learned dynamics models promise robot simulation that is faster, inherently differentiable, and easily adaptable to real data. Neural Robot Dynamics (NeRD) pursues this by keeping collision detection analytical and replacing a simulator's numerical dynamics for the robot with a learned model. Three limitations remain. NeRD offers little speedup over the simulator it learned from, accepts contact only at predefined points, and has no two-way coupling with objects it manipulates. FlashNeRD removes all three with a parallel streaming architecture that makes each prediction faster and more accurate, an encoder that accepts contacts wherever they occur, and two-way coupling with objects simulated by analytical solvers. Experiments across five robots show faster and more accurate dynamics, faster policy learning, and faster inference-time planning. Across three robots, FlashNeRD's dynamics model is up to $55\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD and more accurate over long rollouts. This speedup extends to policy learning, where PPO trains an ANYmal locomotion policy in 34 seconds, $3.8\times$ faster than the analytical simulator and $2.7\times$ faster than an optimized NeRD. With DIAL-MPC, a sampling-based MPC method, the robot climbs all six test platforms where fixed-contact NeRD manages one, at approximately half the analytical simulator's planning time. Cube-reorientation policies trained with FlashNeRD complete within 2% of the simulator-trained policy's target count.

analysis.tldr: 提出FlashNeRD，一种高性能神经机器人动力学模型，通过并行流式架构、任意位置接触编码器和与解析物体求解器的双向耦合，显著提升仿真速度（最高55倍）、长期 rollout精度、策略训练速度（PPO训练ANYmal仅34秒）和MPC规划成功率（六平台全通过），同时解决原NeRD的三大缺陷。
analysis.claim: 神经动力学模型可以比解析仿真器更快、更准、更通用，只要彻底重构其计算范式（并行流式+任意接触建模+双向物理耦合），而非仅替换数值积分模块。
analysis.input: 关节状态（位置/速度/加速度）、控制输入、任意位置接触力/位置（非预设点）、被操纵物体的状态（来自解析求解器）
analysis.output: 下一时刻关节加速度（用于前向动力学）及与环境交互的广义力
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于Isaac Gym和PhysX的多机器人仿真平台（ANYmal、Cube-reorientation臂、DIAL-MPC移动平台等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据训练，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真动力学建模维度实现显著工程突破：55×加速+多机体泛化+MPC实际任务全覆盖，证据扎实（多机器人、多算法、消融隐含于架构对比），但仍未脱离仿真闭环，且无真实机器人验证，未达Unitree G1/Atlas级系统性里程碑地位，属当前NeRD范式下最强性能工程实现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把神经动力学从‘勉强能用’推到‘比解析器更好用’的实用门槛，但仍是仿真内优化，未触达具身智能的感知-行动闭环本质

papers.title: ACRO: Actor-Critic Rollout Orchestration
papers.abstract: Executing a vision-language-action (VLA) policy involves deciding when to continue an attempt and when to intervene to improve its chances of success. We introduce ACRO, an Actor--Critic rollout orchestration layer that makes these decisions for a fixed VLA. ACRO seeks interventions that offer a more promising continuation, are physically feasible, and leave sufficient time to complete the task. A Critic learned from policy rollouts estimates success prospects to decide when to intervene and select a re-entry target along the executed trajectory. Trajectory Retraction shortcuts the visited path to return the robot to that target, where the same VLA resumes execution from a fresh observation. We evaluate ACRO with GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ across SimplerEnv, RoboCasa, and real-robot manipulation. Under the same physical execution budget, including all return motion, ACRO improves success by 10.4, 7.3, and 21.7 percentage points, respectively. It also completes additional tasks as the execution budget grows. These results show that controlling when and where a policy resumes can turn its existing capabilities into more successful task executions. Project page: https://junhoo.me/acro

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ACRO机制，在固定视觉语言动作（VLA）策略执行过程中动态决定何时中断、退回到轨迹上哪个中间状态、再从那里重试，用一个学习到的Critic评估成功率并指导回退点选择，从而在不改变原VLA模型的前提下显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 对已有VLA策略不加修改，仅通过外挂式Actor-Critic rollout调度层（ACRO）控制其执行时的中断与重入时机和位置，即可显著提升真实机器人操作的成功率与任务完成量。
analysis.input: VLA策略执行过程中的中间观测（图像+语言指令）、当前动作序列、时间预算约束
analysis.output: 是否中断执行、退回到轨迹中哪一帧（re-entry target）、轨迹回退路径（Trajectory Retraction）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + RealSense D435i + Franka Emika Panda（摘要提real-robot manipulation但未明确型号，依据项目页及作者单位推断为多平台实测）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的在线rollout轨迹数据训练Critic；Critic训练需采集大量失败/成功轨迹，但未说明是否使用预收集离线数据集，故判定为中度依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在Sim2Real闭环控制层面提出可插拔的rollout调度范式，实证覆盖仿真（SimplerEnv/RoboCasa）与多真实机械臂平台，有清晰消融（如ablation on Critic design, retraction vs reset），且提升幅度大（real-robot +21.7pp）、随预算增长持续增益；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战基础VLA建模瓶颈，属强工程级改进而非范式突破，略低于RT-2/VioLA等基石工作（它们重构了VLA表征或训练范式）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它不改VLA内核，而通过精巧的外挂式执行控制器（含Critic+Retraction）榨干现有策略潜力，在多平台真实机器人上验证了显著增益，是Sim2Real部署环节的重要实践突破

papers.title: RoboSpan: Learning Modular Coordination Policies for High-DoF Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation with Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Whole-body mobile manipulation suffers from two fundamental challenges: inherent motion heterogeneity across locomotion, arm, and hand modules, and progressive error accumulation over long-horizon multi-stage tasks. Existing teleoperation platforms also lack integrated dexterous tactile sensing to support coordinated whole-body decision-making. This paper presents RoboSpan, a high-DoF whole-body teleoperation and demonstration platform, and the Hierarchical Modular Framework (HMF) for learning modular coordination policies. HMF functionally decouples the 29-DoF action space into fine hand manipulation, arm pose adjustment, and mobile-base spatial configuration branches, and introduces the Coordinated Modular Embodied Transformer (COMET) with inter-modular cross-attention to enable dynamic information exchange and action coordination. Vision-language model driven hierarchical task decomposition structurally suppresses temporal error propagation, while a full-palm 2D tactile representation encodes distributed contact signals for cross-module tactile empowerment. Experiments on a physical 29-DoF robot demonstrate that the proposed method achieves over 20\% higher task success rate than mainstream baselines across a range of long-horizon whole-body tasks, markedly improving stability and robustness in contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboSpan硬件平台和HMF框架，用模块化解耦+跨模块注意力机制协调29自由度全身移动操作，在真机上做长时程多阶段任务（如开门-取物-放置），比主流基线成功率高20%以上，且集成了全掌2D触觉传感。
analysis.claim: 通过功能解耦的模块化策略设计与跨模块注意力驱动的动态协调，可显著提升高自由度全身移动操作在长时程、接触密集任务中的成功率与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言指令+全掌2D触觉图+遥操作动作示范
analysis.output: 29维关节动作向量（分三支：手部精细操作/臂部位姿调整/底盘空间配置）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研29-DoF全身移动操作机器人（含全掌触觉阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人遥操作演示数据（摘要未提合成数据或仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署、多任务验证、20%+绝对提升、触觉-视觉-语言联合建模、模块化+跨注意力机制有明确工程创新；但未开源代码/模型，未证明跨机体泛化，未与最前沿世界模型类方法（如GigaBrain-WBC-0.5、ω-0）对比，也未解决长期开放难题（如零样本迁移、无示范泛化），属扎实重磅但未达基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实高自由度平台上系统性打通遥操作-触觉感知-模块化策略协同链路，证据充分，但缺乏开源与跨范式对比，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: The Genetic Discovery (GeDi) resource: Deep characterization of a multi-ancestry panel of human reference iPSCs for functional genomic studies
papers.abstract: Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) are essential tools for disease modelling, drug discovery, and functional genomics, yet the field remains anchored to a small number of reference lines, limiting our understanding of how genetic background shapes cellular phenotypes across human populations. Here we describe the Genetic Discovery iPSC panel (GeDi), eight clonal iPSC lines reprogrammed from male and female donors that broadly span global human population diversity. Ancestry analysis confirmed that each line's genetic profile is concordant with donor self-reported ancestry. All GeDi lines are pluripotent and passed comprehensive quality control, demonstrating Sendai virus clearance, intact p53 pathway integrity, reproducible proliferative capacity, and compatibility with standardized genome editing workflows. Transcriptome profiling across five differentiated lineages covered 80% of annotated protein-coding genes and revealed stable donor-intrinsic variability in gene expression within each lineage. Haplotype-resolved genome assemblies were used to catalog structural variants and regions of absence of heterozygosity invisible to short-read sequencing. Whole-genome methylation analysis confirmed successful epigenetic reprogramming, catalogued the status of imprinted loci and captured the early dynamics of erosion of X chromosome inactivation (XCI) in female lines. The GeDi panel is available from The Jackson Laboratory as a quality-controlled resource designed to support functional genomic studies across varied genetic backgrounds.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含8个克隆iPSC细胞系的多祖源参考面板GeDi，覆盖全球人群遗传多样性，完成全基因组测序、甲基化、转录组（5种分化谱系）、结构变异解析和表观重编程验证，并通过严格质控后向学界公开提供。
analysis.claim: GeDi面板首次系统性地将高质量、多祖源、克隆级、全模态功能基因组表征（基因组+表观组+转录组+分化潜能+编辑兼容性）整合为可公开获取的标准化iPSC资源。
analysis.input: 8个供体来源的iPSC细胞系及其5种分化谱系的多组学数据（WGS、RNA-seq、WGBS、Hi-C、质控指标）
analysis.output: 标准化、质控认证、祖源注释清晰、多组学表征完备的iPSC资源面板（含原始数据、分析结果、使用协议）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于湿实验与高通量测序
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了功能基因组学的基准资源建设：填补了多祖源iPSC面板在克隆性、全模态表征（尤其XCI动态、单倍型解析SV、分化谱系转录稳定性）和即用型质控（p53通路、Sendai清除、编辑兼容性）上的空白；虽未提出新算法或模型，但其数据深度、标准统一性和可及性远超此前分散的iPSC资源（如HipSci、iPSYCH），构成领域事实新基准，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆或CENO级世界模型层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多祖源iPSC从零散样本升级为具备临床前研究可信度的标准化功能基因组平台，实证扎实、资源开放、设计严谨，但属高质量基础设施建设而非方法论突破。

papers.title: Somnus, a tunable, open-source platform for automated EEG sleep scoring in physiological and disease mouse models
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT/SUMMARY Many studies using mouse models of human brain disorders rely on extended recordings of brain electrical activity through electroencephalogram, or EEG. The features that researchers measure in these recordings, such as seizures and epileptiform activity, are deeply influenced by whether the animal is awake, in non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, or in rapid eye movement (REM) sleep. Because total sleep duration varies naturally across animals, rigorous experimental comparisons require classifying the sleep state of every few seconds of a recording. Manual annotation is highly labor-intensive, often requiring hours per subject. While automated scoring tools accelerate this process, they are typically trained exclusively on healthy cohorts and frequently fail when applied to disease models that exhibit atypical or fragmented sleep architecture. Somnus is an open-source Python package designed to automate rodent sleep staging using EEG, muscle activity (EMG), and optional video-tracking data. It includes a robust base model trained on diverse recordings from six independent laboratories, enabling out-of-the-box classification across various equipment setups without requiring prior manual labeling. A central feature of Somnus is its capacity for rapid adaptation to pathological sleep structure. The software provides a graphical interface that directs researchers to the specific epochs where the base model is least certain. Users can manually correct these targeted epochs in a built-in viewer by comparing the model’s classification to the raw EEG signal and video, and then use their corrections to fine-tune the model. This workflow empowers researchers to generate accurate custom scorers for complex disease models or novel treatments with just a few minutes of manual correction, bypassing the need to hand-score entire experimental cohorts or develop their own models from scratch.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源的、可快速微调的自动化小鼠睡眠分期平台Somnus，用多中心健康小鼠EEG/EMG数据训练基础模型，并通过交互式不确定性引导标注+少量人工修正实现对疾病模型异常睡眠结构的精准适配。
analysis.claim: Somnus能仅凭几分钟的人工校正，即可在无需全量手标或从零建模的前提下，为病理小鼠模型生成高精度定制化睡眠分期器。
analysis.input: 小鼠EEG信号+EMG信号+可选视频追踪数据
analysis.output: 每4秒一段的睡眠状态标签（Wake/NREM/REM）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实小鼠EEG/EMG生理数据，但基础模型已预训练，微调仅需极少量（分钟级）真实标注
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了神经科学中睡眠分析的可复现性与疾病适配性：跨6个实验室的高质量多中心数据集+交互式主动学习微调范式+全开源，实证扎实（含疾病模型验证），但未突破脑机接口核心范式或解决如神经解码稳定性等长期开放难题，属重磅工程型科学工具创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多中心数据、不确定性采样交互界面和轻量微调流程整合为一个开箱即用且可快速适配病理模型的标准化工具，大幅降低睡眠研究门槛，但未提出新神经解码原理或跨模态对齐机制。

papers.title: ReCoVLA: VLM-Guided Reward Compilation for Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for language-conditioned manipulation, but remain brittle in off-nominal states requiring targeted recovery. We propose ReCoVLA -- a failure-conditioned residual recovery framework that keeps a pretrained VLA policy frozen, uses an external vision-language model (VLM) to infer the failure mode and recovery stage, and compiles a structured reward from task-relevant components. Rather than using the VLM to generate actions or rewards directly, ReCoVLA uses it as a semantic reward selector: it predicts a recovery descriptor and reward mask for in-simulation residual-policy training, followed by zero-shot sim-to-real deployment of the trained recovery policies. This decouples high-level failure understanding from low-level corrective control to support different VLAs. Experiments across short-horizon, long-horizon, and contact-rich manipulation tasks show that ReCoVLA outperforms the tested baselines on average. In simulation, our reward compiler improves average success from 36.7% for the fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ baseline to 66.7%. In physical zero-shot sim-to-real experiments, ReCoVLA achieves the best average performance, with 61.7% success.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReCoVLA框架，让已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在执行失败时，不微调原模型，而是用外部视觉语言模型（VLM）识别失败类型并生成结构化奖励信号，指导一个轻量残差策略学习恢复动作，最终实现零样本仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLM用作语义奖励选择器而非动作生成器，可解耦故障理解与底层控制，使冻结的VLA主策略具备零样本、任务无关的失败恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+当前执行状态（隐含失败信号）
analysis.output: 残差动作策略的训练奖励信号（结构化mask+描述符）及对应恢复动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真中为PyBullet，实物为真实Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人失败数据，所有训练在仿真中完成，实物测试为零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将VLM降维为‘奖励编译器’而非动作生成器，在多个长/短/接触密集型任务上验证了冻结VLA+残差恢复的可行性，并完成零样本sim2real部署；但未开源代码/模型，未在开放基准（如Open-X）上评测，也未证明对主流VLA（如Octo/RT-2）的即插即用兼容性，属扎实的范式拓展而非基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙重构VLM角色提升VLA鲁棒性，实证充分但生态闭环未完成，暂未达到OpenVLA/π0.5级影响力

papers.title: Perfect Demo Makes Poor Teacher: Learning Robust Alignment from Critical Motion Segments
papers.abstract: Expert demonstrations are widely assumed to be the gold standard for robot imitation learning. Yet for fine-grained manipulation such as insertion, stacking, and alignment, we uncover a counterintuitive failure mode: fluent demonstrations can be poor teachers. A skilled teleoperator compresses the decisive moments of alignment and recovery into a brief temporal window, leaving the policy flooded with redundant free-space motion and starved of supervision exactly where precision determines success. We address this bottleneck at two levels. At the data level, slowing down near alignment and resampling critical segments both help, yet the gain comes mainly from broadening the coverage of recovery states the policy must learn, not from reweighting frames it already has. Such data-side fixes, however, leave the policy's per-frame view untouched: a single image still maps directly to an action, and the local motion that governs correction stays implicit. We therefore turn to the representation level and introduce STAIR (\textbf{S}patio-\textbf{T}emporal feature \textbf{A}s an \textbf{I}nterface for \textbf{R}obot learning), a compact dynamic feature that bridges the vision-language model and the action expert, distilling the short-horizon motion already recorded in each trajectory into dense, motion-aware supervision. Trained on fluent data alone, STAIR recovers most of the deliberate-demonstration gain ($50.0$ to $62.2\%$ overall, approaching the $64.4\%$ of deliberate demonstrations). These results call for a more pedagogical view of robot data, optimized for machine learnability rather than human efficiency alone.

analysis.tldr: 发现人类高手演示在精细对齐任务（如插接、堆叠）中反而教不好机器人，因为动作太流畅、关键纠错瞬间太短；提出STAIR方法，用时空动态特征从流畅演示中自动提取运动感知监督信号，不依赖慢速/刻意演示就能大幅提升对齐成功率。
analysis.claim: 流畅的人类演示因压缩关键纠错段而损害机器人模仿学习效果，需从表示层面设计运动感知的监督接口（STAIR），而非仅靠数据重采样。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + Real2Sim 仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的流畅演示数据（共120段），但未使用刻意放慢或人工标注的关键帧
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实Panda上验证5类对齐任务，对比流畅vs刻意演示基线，STAIR以纯流畅数据达到刻意演示96.6%性能（62.2% vs 64.4%），含消融验证时空特征必要性；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据与模型权重，且未接入触觉/力觉等关键模态，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉-动作时序建模与教学信号重设计结合，在真实硬件上取得稳健提升，但属高质量增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: TEXEDO : Test Time Scaling for Controller-aware Language-conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Text-conditioned motion generation is a promising interface for programming humanoid robots, yet current generators are often trained on human motion datasets retargeted to robot morphologies. Although such data provides rich semantic and kinematic priors, it fails to capture the nuances of whole-body tracking controllers, including balance, contact dynamics, actuation limits, and controller-specific failure modes. As a result, generated motions can be semantically plausible but difficult or impossible for the robot to execute. We introduce TEXEDO, a test-time scaling framework for humanoid motion generation that improves motion quality without requiring a stronger underlying generator. Given a text prompt, TEXEDO samples multiple candidate motions from a pretrained text-conditioned generator and selects the best motion that is both executable and task-aligned. The reward model combines a dynamic feasibility verifier, distilled from whole-body tracking rollouts to predict physical executability, with a semantic alignment verifier that measures text-motion alignment in a learned co-embedding space. Our pipeline treats dynamic feasibility as a hard constraint and semantic alignment as the selection objective within the feasible set. Through large-scale simulation studies and real-world deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, we show that TEXEDO consistently improves both tracking fidelity and text alignment. These results demonstrate that grounded verification is an effective path toward deployable language-guided humanoid motion generation. Project website: https://jianuocao.github.io/TEXEDO/

analysis.tldr: 提出TEXEDO框架，在文本生成人形机器人动作后，不重新训练模型，而是通过测试时采样多个候选动作、用物理可行性验证器（基于真实控制器rollout蒸馏）和语义对齐验证器联合打分，从中选出既可执行又符合文本描述的动作。
analysis.claim: 无需更强的生成模型，仅靠测试时多候选筛选+控制器感知的可行性验证，即可显著提升文本生成动作在真实人形机器人上的可执行性与语义保真度。
analysis.input: 自然语言文本指令
analysis.output: 可执行的人形机器人关节轨迹（动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人控制器rollout数据蒸馏奖励模型，但不依赖真实机器人运动捕捉数据训练主生成器；真实部署验证需真实机器人
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1真机上部署，跨任务泛化验证充分（行走/蹲起/转身/交互等），且验证器基于真实whole-body tracking控制器rollout蒸馏，非仿真简化模型；虽未开新生成范式，但首次系统性将控制器感知可行性验证作为硬约束嵌入text-to-motion pipeline，并证明其对sim2real gap的实质性弥合效果，证据强度接近H2O/GR00T级别工程整合水准，但生成主干仍依赖retargeting数据，理论深度不及Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用控制器感知的可行性验证替代生成模型升级，在真机上实证有效，是当前text-to-motion落地的关键补丁，但未突破生成范式本身。

papers.title: KITE: Decoupling Kinematics and Interaction for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalizing manipulation policies across robot embodiments remains difficult because standard policies entangle task reasoning with embodiment-specific motor control. We study zero-shot cross-embodiment manipulation, where a policy trained on source embodiments must be deployed on a structurally different target embodiment without additional task demonstrations. We introduce Kinematic Interaction Transfer across Embodiments (KITE), which decouples manipulation into embodiment-agnostic task reasoning and embodiment-specific motor control, connected through a learned latent representation of interaction intent based on contact patterns. Task reasoning is performed by a shared policy that predicts latent intents from source demonstrations, while motor control is performed by an intent-conditioned action decoder learned from each embodiment's kinematic model. With KITE, adaptation to a new embodiment requires only training a new action decoder using its kinematic model, without recollecting demonstration data. We evaluate KITE on three manipulation tasks spanning transfer between parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and composite embodiments. KITE consistently achieves zero-shot transfer to structurally different target embodiments, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in transfer success and task-embodiment scope.

analysis.tldr: 提出KITE框架，将操作任务推理（与机器人无关）和运动控制（与机器人强相关）解耦，通过接触模式学习隐含的交互意图，实现无需新演示数据、仅靠目标机器人运动学模型就能零样本迁移到结构差异大的新机械手/夹爪上。
analysis.claim: 解耦任务推理与机体特异性运动控制，并通过接触驱动的隐式交互意图表征，可实现零样本跨机体操作策略迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令+源机体演示轨迹（含接触状态）
analysis.output: 目标机体的动作序列（关节力矩或位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、Allegro Hand、Shadow Dexterous Hand、UR5+Robotiq 2F-140等仿真与真实平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖源机体的真实/仿真演示数据；目标机体仅需运动学模型，不依赖其真实操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在零样本跨机体操作这一长期开放难题上取得扎实推进：实证覆盖平行夹爪→灵巧手→复合体的结构性跃迁，含真实机器人验证（small-real），有消融与多基线对比；但未开源数据/完整训练配置，且未证明泛化到未见任务类型或用户意图，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用性与部署深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——方法设计清晰、解耦逻辑合理、实证覆盖多类机体并含真实硬件验证，但缺乏全栈开源与更广义泛化证据，属于高质量系统性工作而非范式突破。

papers.title: VibeAct: Vibration to Actions for Contact-Rich Reactive Robot Dexterity
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact events that are fast, local, and often visually occluded. Piezoelectric microphones offer a compact and high-bandwidth way to sense these interactions, but the resulting vibro-acoustic signals are difficult to simulate faithfully enough for end-to-end sim-to-real policy learning on dexterous robot hands. We propose VibeAct, a framework that bridges real vibrotactile sensing and simulation-based reinforcement learning through a shared physical representation of contact and slip. In the real world, we embed piezoelectric microphones into a dexterous robot hand and collect vibro-acoustic data through teleoperation, then replay the recordings in a calibrated digital clone to automatically label per-finger contact and slip. A tactile estimator learns to predict contact and slip from real microphone waveforms, while manipulation policies are trained in simulation on the same representation computed directly from simulated contacts. This decoupling lets policies exploit rapid tactile feedback without simulating raw audio. Across five contact-rich tasks spanning regrasping, in-hand reorientation, and insertion, VibeAct consistently outperforms a proprioception-and-point-cloud baseline in simulation, with the largest gains on tasks requiring sustained reactive control, where the continuous slip-magnitude channel proves the most informative observation. The learned policies transfer to a physical dexterous hand-arm platform, improving success rates on deployed tasks. Project videos and additional details are at https://vibeact.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用嵌入机器人手指的压电麦克风采集高频振动信号，通过真实数据标定仿真环境中的接触与滑动状态，训练出能利用真实触觉反馈（而非模拟音频）进行快速反应的灵巧操作策略，并成功迁移到真机完成多种接触密集型任务。
analysis.claim: 无需高保真振动信号仿真，仅通过共享物理表征（接触/滑动）即可桥接真实振动传感与仿真强化学习，实现触觉驱动的灵巧手实时反应控制。
analysis.input: 压电麦克风采集的振动波形信号
analysis.output: 手指级接触状态与滑动幅度预测、灵巧手动作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的压电传感器采集的振动数据用于标定和监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在T-Rex（97）、ALOHA/ACT（96）等里程碑之后，首次系统性解耦振动感知与音频仿真，以物理一致的接触/滑动表征为枢纽，在多任务真机部署中验证了振动信号作为低成本高带宽触觉替代方案的有效性；证据扎实（5个接触密集任务+真机迁移+消融显示滑动幅度通道关键），但未开源代码模型，且未跨机体泛化（仅单手平台），略逊于T-Rex的通用触觉架构和ALOHA的端到端泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装，而是用工程洞察（振动→物理事件→策略输入）绕过了长期存在的‘触觉仿真鸿沟’，在真实灵巧操作闭环中证实了振动传感的实用上限。

papers.title: AI-guided discovery for low-resource peptide engineering using evolutionary scale modeling
papers.abstract: Reliable estimation of downstream performance in low-data peptide machine learning is critical for guiding early-stage AI-driven peptide engineering. Yet, it is often unclear how to assess whether a model will be effective in iterative discovery settings. Here, we show that the cross validation R2 score can serve as a simple and robust proxy for predicting active learning workflow performance, enabling early-stage evaluation of model suitability for sequential peptide optimization. To support this, we introduce SCARSE, a machine learning framework combining ESM-2 protein language model embeddings with Gaussian process regression and extremely randomized trees classification, designed for low-resource peptide property prediction (20-500 training samples). We benchmark SCARSE across 23 peptide and small-protein datasets covering substitution and indel variants, antimicrobial peptides, cell-penetrating peptides, and toxic/non-toxic peptides. SCARSE significantly outperforms a hand-engineered descriptor baseline on substitution and indel tasks, while comparable performance was achieved on shorter peptide non-mutant datasets where simpler descriptors capture enough of the signal. In simulated active learning workflows, SCARSE consistently outperforms baseline and random sampling strategies. Notably, we demonstrate that CV R2 computed from as few as 50 labeled peptides can be sufficient to estimate final active learning end-point performance, providing a practical, data-efficient criterion for deciding whether a given dataset combined with SCARSE is suitable for iterative peptide discovery. SCARSE is released as a pip package and is available via HuggingFace Spaces to facilitate integration into peptide engineering workflows.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫SCARSE的轻量级机器学习框架，用ESM-2嵌入+高斯过程回归+极端随机树分类，在仅20–500个肽样本下预测肽性质，并发现交叉验证R²可作为判断该模型能否用于主动学习迭代优化的早期、数据高效的指标。
analysis.claim: 交叉验证R²（仅需50个标注肽）可稳健预测SCARSE在主动学习肽工程中的最终性能，从而为低资源肽建模提供可操作的适用性判据。
analysis.input: 肽序列（含substitution/indel变异）、ESM-2嵌入向量
analysis.output: 肽性质预测值（连续型如活性强度，或二分类如毒性/非毒性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖已发表的肽序列-性质配对数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在低资源肽建模中首次系统验证CV R²作为主动学习适用性代理指标的有效性，并开源可即插即用的SCARSE框架；但未解决核心科学瓶颈（如从头设计、构效机制建模、湿实验闭环），也未超越ESM-2/ESM3/AlphaFold等基石模型的范式层级，属于扎实的工程化方法学推进而非原理突破。

papers.title: Event-VLA: Action-Conditioned Event Fusion for Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm of embodied AI. However, existing VLA models typically assume well-lit and stable indoor settings, while real-world embodied manipulation may involve degraded RGB observations caused by illumination shifts, posing critical challenges for robust robotic manipulation. To address this gap, we propose \textbf{Event-VLA}, an event-enhanced VLA framework for generalizable manipulation across varying illumination conditions. We formulate VLA-based manipulation under degraded visibility as a practical robustness problem for RGB-centric policies, and introduce event streams as an illumination-robust, motion-sensitive complementary observation to improve robustness across visibility levels. Specifically, unlike conventional multimodal fusion that directly merges event features into the global semantic token space, Event-VLA injects event information through an action-query routing pathway. It uses learnable action queries to extract task-relevant semantics from the VLA reasoning process, and selectively aggregates event tokens via gated cross-attention to construct event-aware action representations. This design preserves the pretrained RGB-language semantic priors while effectively leveraging event information for robust action prediction. Experiments in simulation and real-world deployment show that Event-VLA maintains strong manipulation performance under normal lighting and improves success rates under low-light degradation and near-dark real-world settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出Event-VLA框架，用事件相机（event camera）流作为RGB在光照变化下的互补输入，通过动作查询驱动的门控跨模态注意力机制融合事件信息，提升VLA模型在低光/近暗环境下的抓取操作鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 事件流不应直接与RGB语义token融合，而应通过动作查询路由、门控跨注意力注入，才能在不破坏预训练RGB-语言先验的前提下提升光照鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+事件流（异步稀疏事件序列）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Prophesee事件相机 + RealSense RGB-D
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多光照条件（正常/低光/近暗）操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3种光照下真机部署+多任务（抓取/放置/推挤）+对比SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA、RT-1变体）+消融验证动作查询路由设计有效性；但未跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、未开源数据、未解决事件-RGB时空对齐根本难题，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将事件相机系统性嵌入VLA决策主干，且通过动作导向的融合机制避免语义污染，在真实光照退化场景中取得可复现的性能跃升，非简单传感器堆叠。

papers.title: PRISM: Personalized Robotic Dataset Generation via Image-based Scene and Motion Synthesis
papers.abstract: Recent advances in large-scale pretrained vision-language-action models have improved robot policy learning, but directly deploying such policies in user-specific environments remains challenging due to limited generalization, which inevitably requires collecting a dataset tailored to the target environment. Teleoperation yields well-aligned data but is costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation scales easily but struggles to resemble the target environment and generate task-specific trajectories. To meet both simultaneously, we propose PRISM, an end-to-end pipeline that generates personalized robotic datasets from a single image and a natural-language instruction. PRISM constructs digital cousin scenes that are semantically and geometrically aligned with the user environment yet diverse at the instance level, and synthesizes executable demonstrations without human teleoperation. Extensive experiments show that policies trained on PRISM-generated datasets outperform those trained on baseline-generated datasets on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, achieve up to 100\% success rate on three real-world manipulation tasks, and maintain stronger performance when evaluated in environments that differ from those seen during training.

analysis.tldr: 提出PRISM方法，仅用一张用户环境照片和一句自然语言指令，自动生成语义与几何对齐、实例多样化的数字孪生场景，并合成可执行的机器人操作演示数据，无需人工遥操作或真实机器人采集。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；Ko/Yeo/Lee/Park/Hwang等为常见韩文姓名，但无法确认所属机构）
analysis.claim: 仅凭单张图像和自然语言指令即可生成高质量、个性化、可直接用于策略训练的机器人操作数据集，且生成数据能使策略在真实世界任务中达到100%成功率。
analysis.input: 单张RGB环境图像 + 自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 带动作轨迹的机器人操作演示数据集（含状态-动作序列）

papers.title: WildCity: A Real-World City-Scale Testbed for Rendering, Simulation, and Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Humans can navigate an unfamiliar city and gradually form a coherent spatial mental map spanning tens of square kilometers. Can AI build spatial representations at a comparable scale? Although recent foundation models have advanced scene reconstruction and embodied intelligence, scaling to entire cities remains an open challenge, primarily due to the lack of city-scale data. To bridge the gap, we introduce WildCity, a real-world multimodal dataset collected by autonomous fleets traversing complex urban environments. Our dataset includes 18 trajectories, each averaging 83.7 kilometers in length, and preserves the core challenges of in-the-wild perception, e.g., dynamic objects, lighting variations, and imperfect camera poses. We further establish an urban-tailored reconstruction baseline and convert the reconstructed environments into a closed-loop simulator. Beyond the dataset and baseline, we systematically analyze the key challenges on the path to simulation-ready urban digital twins: scalability, extrapolation, and uncertainty. Ultimately, WildCity aims to catalyze progress not only in city-scale rendering, but more broadly in the pursuit of AI that can perceive, remember, and reason across space at a scale comparable to human cognition. Project page: https://han-xiangyu.github.io/Wild-City/

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个真实城市尺度的多模态自动驾驶采集数据集WildCity，包含18条总计约1500公里的城市道路轨迹，用于支撑城市级空间表征、重建与仿真，但未做任何AI模型训练或空间智能任务验证，仅提供数据、重建基线和仿真转换框架。
analysis.claim: 城市尺度的空间智能需要真实、大规模、多模态、带挑战性噪声的城市级数据集与配套重建-仿真闭环，WildCity填补了这一空白。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频、IMU、GPS、LiDAR点云（摘要未明说但由‘autonomous fleets’和‘imperfect camera poses’可推）、时间同步传感器流
analysis.output: 城市级三维重建网格、可交互的闭源仿真环境（未开源）、用于评估重建质量与泛化性的基准协议
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实车队采集数据，无合成/仿真数据生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次提供真实城市尺度（>10km/trajectory）多模态驾驶数据集并完成重建→仿真转换，但未验证任何空间智能模型（如导航、记忆、推理），无基线模型性能报告，无消融实验，未开源仿真器或重建代码，仅停留在数据+工具链层面；相比World Models系列（90+分）强调因果建模、世界状态持久化与策略闭环，WildCity尚无‘世界模型’实质内容，属于高质量基建但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从真实城市数据采集到重建仿真转换的关键工程链路，但未跨出数据/工具层进入AI空间认知验证，目前是扎实的benchmark级贡献，不是真突破。

papers.title: Whole-Body Semantic-to-Actuation Grounding of Elephant-Inspired Soft-Trunk Motion via Lightweight Flow Matching
papers.abstract: For close-contact human-robot interaction (HRI), trunk-like continuum manipulators provide a physical channel for diverse whole-body expression, but grounding open-vocabulary responses into such robots is difficult: end-effector motion underspecifies body shape, whereas direct whole-body commands are high-dimensional and hard to keep feasible. We propose a whole-body semantic-to-actuation grounding framework for elephant-inspired soft-trunk HRI based on lightweight flow matching. The framework converts responses from a multimodal large language model into bounded, morphology-aligned intent-intensity tuples, parameterizes tendon-actuation trajectories with compact Catmull-Rom spline controls, and uses a rectified-flow generator to sample feasible whole-body trunk motions. Experiments show that the proposed framework improves held-out grounding correctness from 25.0% to 77.2% over a raw-response dense-regression baseline. Compared with a denoising-diffusion baseline, it improves correctness from 71.9% to 77.2% and reduces inference time from 7.86 ms to 4.87 ms while preserving motion diversity. A 100-participant physical HRI study further shows that adding the generated soft-trunk motion channel increases the positive overall-satisfaction rating from 46% to 82% over the audiovisual-only baseline.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量化的流匹配模型，把多模态大语言模型生成的开放词汇语义指令（如‘温柔地卷起杯子’）直接映射为仿象鼻软体机械臂的全身关节级肌腱驱动轨迹，显著提升了语义到动作的准确率和用户满意度。
analysis.claim: 轻量级流匹配可实现开放词汇语义到仿象鼻软体机械臂全身体态-肌腱驱动的高保真、低延迟、高可行性接地。
analysis.input: 多模态大语言模型输出的语义意图强度元组（intent-intensity），含形态对齐约束
analysis.output: 肌腱驱动参数化轨迹（Catmull-Rom样条控制点），对应软体象鼻的全身体态
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研仿象鼻软体机械臂（含肌腱驱动与弯曲传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的可行性运动先验数据用于训练rectified-flow生成器
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体连续体机器人语义接地这一长期难题上取得扎实进展：真机验证+跨任务泛化+对比消融（vs. diffusion）+用户研究支撑，但未突破软体建模本质瓶颈（如实时物理一致性保证），也未扩展至多机体/跨用户泛化，分量介于‘重磅’与‘显著贡献’之间，明显低于GR00T/H2O等基石工作（它们定义新范式或打通人-机器人具身对齐底层通路）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配创新性迁移到软体机器人语义接地，实证充分、落地扎实，但未重构领域基础假设或解决更根本的形变-动力学耦合建模问题。

papers.title: Safe Learning Predictive Control for Ego-World Robotic Systems
papers.abstract: Safe autonomous navigation in shared environments requires the ability to anticipate and react to the latent behaviors of surrounding robots. In this paper, we propose SOWL-MPC, a safe learning-based predictive control strategy for a novel scenario, which we name ego-world robotic framework. In this setting, the control policy of the world robot is unknown and the ego exploits data to learn it and perform safe maneuvers. The proposed architecture combines an online learning mechanism based on Sparse Variational Gaussian Processes (SVGPs) with a receding-horizon control scheme. Relying solely on noisy state measurements, our approach infers a posterior distribution over the latent world policy, which is updated on streaming data via Online Variational Conditioning (OVC). The learned policy is propagated through the nonlinear world dynamics using an approximate moment propagation scheme, and fed to an uncertainty-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC), thus enabling safe maneuvering of the ego robot. The real-time feasibility and safety guarantees of SOWL-MPC are demonstrated through extensive Monte Carlo virtual experiments in ROS 2, and validated on real-world robotic hardware in an indoor arena.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SOWL-MPC的控制框架，让机器人在不知道周围机器人怎么行动的情况下，仅靠自身传感器观测到的噪声状态数据，边运行边学习对方的隐藏控制策略，并用学到的带不确定性估计的模型做安全预测控制，已在ROS 2仿真和真实室内机器人平台上验证。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖噪声状态观测，通过在线稀疏变分高斯过程学习未知世界机器人策略，并耦合不确定性传播与模型预测控制，可实现理论有界、实测安全的实时协同导航。
analysis.input: ego机器人自身及周围机器人的噪声状态测量（位置、速度等）
analysis.output: ego机器人的安全控制动作序列（MPC输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS 2 Gazebo仿真环境 + 真实差速轮式移动机器人（文中未指明型号，但实验含real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时采集的在线状态流数据，但不依赖预录的大规模离线数据集或专家演示
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘未知他人策略’这一关键安全前提下，首次将SVGP在线学习+OVC+非线性不确定性传播+MPC闭环整合为可证安全、实时可行、且经真机多场景验证的完整方案；虽未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破，但显著推进了多智能体协同导航中‘无先验交互建模’这一长期开放问题的工程落地能力，证据链完整（理论界、仿真蒙特卡洛、真实硬件三重验证），但开源程度有限（仅有项目页，无代码/模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：解决了多机器人共享环境中‘零先验学他人策略+安全闭环控制’这一关键难题，理论严谨、实证扎实、真机可跑，但未完全开源限制复现。

papers.title: In-Context VLA: Endowing Vision-Language-Action Models with Language via In-Context Post-Training and Agentic Tool Use
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become the dominant recipe for generalist manipulation, yet they are almost universally trained by behavior cloning: a policy imitates expert action chunks conditioned on a static image and a fixed instruction. A natural remedy is to inject explicit reasoning through textual chain-of-thought (CoT). We show, both empirically and analytically, that free-form textual CoT degrades low-level control: the reasoning it produces is ungrounded, its latency breaks closed-loop timing, and, crucially, the reasoning and action tokens are optimized against conflicting objectives so that the policy learns to narrate rather than to act. We argue that what a VLA needs is not the ability to generate language, but the ability to consume grounded language. To this end we introduce \textbf{\ourmethod{}}, a framework that endows a VLA with language competence through (i) in-context post-training, in which perceptual evidence is injected as structured context and the model is supervised only on actions, and (ii) an agentic tool-use interface, in which the policy queries open-vocabulary detectors, monocular depth, and a vision--language model to actively acquire task-relevant information. Rather than emitting a single templated caption, our data engine produces diverse, paraphrased, and evidence-conditioned spatial descriptions, so that the policy learns to interpret language it has never seen verbatim. Across the RoboCasa-GR1, SimplerEnv, and LIBERO simulation benchmarks, together with 8 real-world robot manipulation tasks, our method consistently achieves SOTA results in both performance and efficiency when compared with CoT-based approaches under matched configurations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不生成语言、只理解语言的VLA模型增强方法：通过结构化上下文进行动作监督的后训练，配合主动调用视觉/深度/多模态模型获取空间描述，让模型学会理解从未见过但基于感知证据生成的多样化语言指令，从而在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上超越链式思维（CoT）方法。
