papers.title: ContactGuard: Pre-Contact Execution Monitoring with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation failures are often detected only after the robot has committed to contact. This is especially limiting in wrist-camera setups: close gripper--object views help observe contact, but a poor approach may already push, miss, slip, or disturb the object before conventional detectors react. We introduce \emph{ContactGuard}, a pre-contact execution monitor for chunked visuomotor policies. Given the policy's planned action chunk, ContactGuard predicts its short-horizon consequence in latent visual space and aborts if the predicted future latent indicates likely failure. Its latent world model is trained from unlabelled robot trajectories to predict compact multi-view visual embeddings under planned actions, avoiding pixel-level video prediction. A lightweight failure probe is then trained from a small labelled set of pre-contact clips. At deployment, ContactGuard anchors prediction before an imminent contact event, rolls the model forward under the policy's own actions, and verifies the predicted post-contact latent. Across real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ContactGuard predicts failure more accurately than direct and corrupted-action ablations, and transfers to live robot as a pre-contact abort signal without modifying the underlying policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出ContactGuard，一种在机器人接触物体前就预测操作是否可能失败的监控模块，它不修改原有策略，而是基于策略计划的动作块，在潜空间中预测短时视觉后果，若预测结果暗示失败（如滑动、错位）则提前中止执行。
analysis.claim: 无需修改底层策略，仅通过轻量级潜空间世界模型和少量标注的预接触视频片段，即可在真实机器人上实现可靠的接触前失败预测与中止。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测 + 策略计划的动作块（chunked action）
analysis.output: 二元决策：是否中止即将发生的接触动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂+腕部相机系统（如Franka Panda + RealSense）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的预接触失败/成功视频片段（用于训练failure probe），但潜世界模型训练使用大量无标签机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在多个真实接触密集任务（插拔、堆叠、抓取变形物）上的部署级预接触监控，有消融对比（direct/corrupted-action baseline）、跨任务泛化验证、且不侵入原策略——这是首个将潜空间世界模型用于实时执行监控并落地到真机的方案，但未开源数据/模型，也未建立新benchmark或开放协议，尚达不到RT-X/Aloha级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将潜空间世界模型创新性地用于执行监控而非控制本身，并在真机多任务上验证有效性，但属于高质量应用级改进，非范式重构或基础工具链建设。

papers.title: StructRL: Structured Action-Space Exploration for Flow-Based VLAs
papers.abstract: Flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are now widely used for continuous robotic manipulation, and online reinforcement learning (RL) is emerging as a key technique for adapting them to new tasks. Existing RL methods typically inject stochasticity inside the denoising chain, often through isotropic or temporally independent noise. However, effective robot exploration calls for structured noise: temporally smooth and scaled differently across action groups. We show that simply switching the in-chain noise to a structured form does not suffice: noise added at an intermediate flow time can be weakened by the remaining denoising steps before execution, a phenomenon we call \emph{Structured Noise Dilution}. We propose \textbf{StructRL}, which avoids dilution by relocating policy stochasticity to the action space via three coupled choices: (i) a deterministic ODE decoder, (ii) structured noise injected directly in the action space, and (iii) last-step replay, where policy-gradient updates avoid assigning likelihoods to intermediate denoising states. This keeps structured exploration tied to the executed action while providing a tractable training signal for the flow decoder. Across three flow-based VLA models on multiple simulated manipulation benchmarks and two real-world tasks, StructRL improves exploration efficiency and OOD performance over prior in-chain baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured action-space exploration for adapting flow-based VLA with RL. \textbf{Project page:} https://flyfaerss.github.io/structrl/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对基于流模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人策略在在线强化学习中探索效率低的问题，提出将随机性从去噪过程内部移到动作空间本身，并设计确定性ODE解码器+动作空间结构化噪声+最后一步重放三个协同机制，避免了结构化噪声在多步去噪中被稀释的问题，在仿真和两个真实任务上提升了OOD泛化和探索效率。
analysis.claim: 将策略随机性显式置于动作空间（而非流模型去噪链内部），并配合确定性解码与最后一步重放，能更有效地保留结构化探索特性，显著提升流式VLA模型在RL微调中的探索效率与分布外泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（如机械臂关节速度或末端位姿变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（两个real-world任务），但主体验证在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的动作空间结构化探索新范式，实证扎实（多flow-VLA backbone + 多仿真bench + 2 real tasks + 消融验证StructNoise Dilution现象），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/跨用户验证，也未达到基石模型级的范式颠覆或大规模真实世界部署规模（如Xiaomi-Robotics-1或OpenVLA），属于对流式VLA-RL适配路径的重要优化，非底层重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了流式VLA在RL微调中结构化探索失效的关键机制问题，有清晰洞见和实证支撑，但工程落地完整性和领域影响力尚未达基石水平。

papers.title: PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5: A Toolkit for Robot Process Assessment
papers.abstract: Fine-grained robotic evaluation matters for understanding embodied models, going beyond binary success rates and rule-based process scores. We present PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5, a toolkit for robot process assessment that turns rollout videos into dense progress curves and derives multiple fine metrics. PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5 introduces three metrics, building on version 1.0, that characterize failure-side progress, post-drawdown recovery, and success-side execution quality, helping users understand embodied model capability. Based on the rollout videos from benchmarks, we perform a comprehensive assessment of the embodied models, providing some fine-grained metric results and key findings. We further introduce RoboPulse++ to evaluate the reliability of process reward models (PRM), providing evaluators with a more accurate testing platform. Moreover, we release a user-friendly assessment suite, including the benchmark, metric implementation, and visualization tools, to support reproducible manipulation process evaluation. We call on the community to rethink how robots are evaluated and establish transparent, procedural, and reproducible assessment as a foundation for the next generation of embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫PRM-as-a-Judge 1.5的评估工具包，专门用来分析机器人操作视频（rollout videos），把原本粗糙的成功/失败判断细化成三条可量化的进程曲线指标：失败过程中的进展、跌倒后恢复能力、成功执行的质量，并配套开源了评估代码、可视化工具和RoboPulse++可靠性测试模块。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，无法从姓名推断主流实验室；非清华/伯克利/DeepMind/智元等常见团队命名风格）
analysis.claim: 对机器人操作过程的细粒度评估不能只靠二值成功率，必须建模进程动态性——失败中是否有进展、能否从卡点恢复、成功时是否鲁棒高效，这三类进程特征需被独立量化。
analysis.input: 机器人操作的 rollout 视频（含多视角或单视角RGB视频）
analysis.output: 三条细粒度进程曲线（failure-side progress, post-drawdown recovery, success-side execution quality）及对应标量指标
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已公开的benchmark视频数据（如RT-2、OpenVLA、VoxPoser等发布的rollout视频），不采集新真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的评估方法学增量：首次系统定义并实现三类进程动态指标，开源完整工具链，但未引入新模型/新硬件/新任务，也不涉及真实机器人部署或跨平台泛化验证；其价值限于离线视频分析闭环，无法推动具身智能的感知-决策-控制链路本身进步，远低于Unitree G1（96）等实体里程碑级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有benchmark视频转化为可复现的进程分析流水线，是评估基础设施的重要补全，但不构成算法或系统层面的突破。

papers.title: DreamMimic: Learning Visuomotor Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via World Model
papers.abstract: Vision-based whole-body loco-manipulation on humanoid robots is challenging due to partial observability, contact-rich dynamics, and the difficulty of learning long-horizon behaviors from high-dimensional visual inputs. We present \href{https://github.com/DreamMimic/DreamMimic}{DreamMimic}, a framework that distills privileged teacher policies into vision-based humanoid controllers via world-model-assisted distillation. Instead of using a Dreamer-style RSSM for planning, we repurpose it to learn predictive latent dynamics that serve as both a representation space and an action-conditioned multi-step supervision signal, while exposing compact predictive features to the student policy to reduce long-term drift. Beyond standard reconstruction objectives for proprioceptive and visual observations, we add auxiliary prediction heads for privileged state, contact, object state, and reward estimation. These heads provide additional supervision related to agent--object interaction and task progress, encouraging the latent representation to retain signals that are useful for contact-rich loco-manipulation. We further introduce Performance-Conditioned Guidance (PCG), a reward-driven adaptive distillation schedule that computes performance scores for both teacher and student to dynamically balance guidance and exploration. PCG prevents both premature teacher annealing and excessive teacher interference in challenging visual settings. Experiments on OMOMO and BEHAVE show improved tracking-based loco-manipulation performance over strong vision-based baselines, without exposing online privileged interaction states to the student at deployment. Qualitative simulations further examine morphology and simulator changes. These results suggest that world models can provide a useful mechanism for stabilizing visual policy distillation in contact-rich humanoid behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 用世界模型辅助蒸馏，把依赖真实状态的老师策略（privileged policy）转化为纯视觉输入的仿人机器人全身运动-操作控制器，不依赖部署时的真实状态反馈，提升了视觉驱动的全身位姿跟踪与操作性能。
analysis.claim: 世界模型可通过多头辅助预测（接触、物体状态、奖励等）和性能调节的蒸馏调度（PCG），稳定视觉策略蒸馏过程，解决高维视觉输入下接触丰富型全身locomanipulation的长期漂移与表征退化问题。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+本体感觉（proprioception）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: OMOMO / BEHAVE 仿真 humanoid 平台（未明确硬件型号，属通用仿真 humanoid）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出PCG蒸馏调度和多头交互感知预测是合理增量，实验在OMOMO/BEHAVE两个仿真benchmark上超越基线，但未在真实机器人验证、未开源数据/模型、未做跨机体/跨任务泛化消融，相比DreamerV3/DreamerV1等基石工作（真机部署、长程规划、持续学习、开源完备），仍属扎实但窄域的仿真方法改进，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如持久状态建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真环境下推进了视觉驱动全身locomanipulation的蒸馏稳定性，但受限于纯仿真、无真机验证、无跨形态泛化，属于扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: A discrete protein subset drives structure prediction discordance in orphan proteins
papers.abstract: Structure and disorder predictors are increasingly used as decision-grade tools in protein engineering and in the analysis of newly emerged proteins, yet how the current state-of-the-art behaves on sequences outside the well-charted evolutionary space remains poorly characterised. We previously reported that AlphaFold2 confidence and the disorder predictor flDPnn produced discordant predictions for naturally evolved de novo Drosophila proteins and for shuffled sequences. Here, we revisit the comparison with AlphaFold3 and the best-performing disorder predictor PUNCH2 on the same sequence sets together with conserved Drosophila proteins and intrinsically disordered proteins. The discordance persists: pLDDT correlates positively with PUNCH2 disorder in random and de novo proteins and negatively with β-strand fraction, opposite to the conserved and disordered baselines. A class-specific, score-defined driver subset jointly captures the unusual high-pLDDT, high-disorder, low-strand combination and contains 24.5% of de novo, 29.4% of random, 5.1% of conserved, and 1.3% of disordered proteins. Removing this subset normalises the correlations. A held-out classifier trained on architectural and compositional features that were not used in the driver definition recovers the subset, with helix and coil fraction, sequence length, entropy and hydropathy as the strongest predictors. The discordance is therefore not a sequence-class artefact but a localised, compositionally identifiable phenotype that current predictors handle in a non-canonical way - a concrete failure mode that protein designers and others working on sequences remote in sequence space should be aware of when relying on predictor outputs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现了一小类特殊蛋白质（主要来自果蝇新基因和随机序列），其AlphaFold3预测结构置信度高（pLDDT高）、却被PUNCH2判为高无序度、且β折叠比例异常低——这种矛盾现象不是整体类别偏差，而是可被序列组成特征（如螺旋/卷曲比例、长度、熵、疏水性）精准识别的局部失败模式，揭示了当前主流结构/无序预测器在进化远端序列上的系统性盲区。
analysis.claim: 结构预测器（AlphaFold3）与无序预测器（PUNCH2）在孤儿蛋白上的预测冲突并非随机噪声或整体类别偏差，而是由一个可定义、可预测、可复现的离散蛋白质子集驱动的特定失败模式。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: pLDDT分数、PUNCH2无序概率、二级结构组分（β-strand/helix/coil比例）等预测指标间的统计关系及驱动子集的分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实揭示了AI蛋白质预测器在进化远端序列上的具体、可定位、可解释的失效机制（非泛化差，而是特定组合特征触发的反直觉响应），有明确实证（多预测器+四类对照序列+消融+外部验证分类器），但未提出新模型或修正预测器，也未扩展到更大规模蛋白空间或实验验证，属重要诊断性发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是概念包装，而是用严谨的交叉预测分析定位并解释了当前SOTA工具链在孤儿蛋白上的具体失效逻辑，对蛋白设计者具有强警示价值。

papers.title: SUN: Persistent Programs For Language-Grounded Control-to-Learning-to-Real Policies
papers.abstract: Bridging model-based control and learned policies in long-horizon manipulation has harbored a silent disagreement: control executes specified objectives, learning amortizes that behavior into a reactive policy, yet existing protocols discard task semantics, leaving rewards hand-crafted and behavior drifting from what control verified.We introduce Semantically UNified (SUN) Programs, typed executables where geometric and contact relations are defined once and compiled into aligned Model Predictive Control (MPC) costs, satisfaction predicates, RL rewards, transition guards, and diagnostics. Our system, Kuafu, driven by large vision language systems, automatically synthesizes SUN Programs from language and scene semantics, screens feasibility via MPC, and retains semantics while training stage-conditioned policies. Across nine tasks, Kuafu achieves 82.03% macro-success, outperforming sparse-reward (35.67%) and Stage-BC (24.75%) baselines. At 8192-way scale, it generates 10.57x the successful trajectory time per hour of human teleoperation. With 500 trajectories per task, Kuafu data trains DP3 policies to 46.0% simulation success (vs. 22.4% for alternatives) and 34.7% on physical Franka and Kinova robots. These results establish that simulation-screened task semantics can effectively amortize control into robust policies, without demonstrations or manual dense rewards, unifying symbolic planning and data-driven execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SUN程序框架，把语言指令和场景语义自动编译成统一的符号化任务描述，再生成MPC成本、RL奖励、状态转移条件等，用仿真筛选可行性后训练策略，无需人工设计稠密奖励或人类示范，就在9个长程操作任务上实现了82%的成功率，并迁移到真实Franka/Kinova机器人。
analysis.claim: 通过将语言与场景语义编译为持久化、类型安全的SUN程序，可统一建模控制目标、验证条件与学习信号，从而在无手工稠密奖励、无演示的前提下，将模型预测控制的语义可靠性有效‘摊销’为鲁棒的端到端策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB-D/点云场景观测（经VLM解析）
analysis.output: 分阶段条件策略（stage-conditioned policy）输出动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真筛选可行性，但最终策略训练使用500条/任务的真实机器人轨迹（非预采集演示，而是Kuafu自动生成并执行的轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了‘控制-学习’鸿沟弥合：首次实现从语言+视觉输入全自动编译出带几何/接触约束的可执行程序，并在多机体真实硬件上验证了仿真筛选语义+稀疏真实数据训练的有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨域泛化消融（如新物体/新布局），也未挑战长期记忆或持续学习等更高阶问题，故未达World Models级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将符号程序编译、VLM驱动语义解析、MPC可行性筛查与RL策略训练深度耦合，在真实机器人上达成高成功率且免人工奖励设计，是当前具身智能中少有的端到端语义可控闭环系统，但开源缺失和泛化边界未充分刻画限制其范式影响力。

papers.title: De novo designed single-domain antibodies protect against lethal cobra venom neurotoxicity in vivo
papers.abstract: Generative protein design can now rapidly produce de novo binders with high affinity and functional activity against a wide range of targets, including lethal snake venom toxins. However, so far most reported successes rely on new-to-nature scaffolds with limited therapeutic precedent. Single-domain antibodies (VHHs) offer a clinically validated alternative scaffold that can bind and neutralize long-chain α-neurotoxins, which are some of the most lethal components in snake venoms. Here we compare three recently established de novo design models with VHH-design capabilities (Germinal, RFantibody, and BoltzGen) for their ability to generate VHHs against the neurotoxin α-cobratoxin from the monocled cobra ( Naja kaouthia ). Using standardized model inputs and evaluation criteria based on AlphaFold3 interface confidence (ipTM) and RMSD self-consistency, we find that Germinal was the only method to generate designs passing stringent in silico criteria for experimental testing. We therefore performed a larger Germinal design campaign employing three different VHH frameworks and experimentally validated 46 designs in vitro . Of these, 42 expressed as soluble proteins and we identified four binding hits derived from two of the three tested frameworks. Of the four binders, two lead candidates were further characterized and demonstrated high affinity (KDs of 4.1 nM and 10.8 nM), monomeric behavior and low polyreactivity, indicating favorable biophysical and developability properties, as well as functional toxin neutralization in vitro . To assess their therapeutic potential we investigated their ability to protect against α-cobratoxin toxicity in vivo . Both candidates fully protected mice after α-cobratoxin challenge, with 100% survival compared to a lethal control. One candidate also retained notable neutralization capacity against whole venom of Naja kaouthia with a survival of 56%, while the other protected 22% when tested in a rescue setting. Together, we demonstrate that de novo VHH design can generate high affinity single-domain antibodies with in vivo protection against lethal cobra venom neurotoxicity, and provide practical insights into method- and framework-dependent performance.

analysis.tldr: 用生成式蛋白设计模型Germinal从头设计出能高亲和力结合并中和眼镜蛇神经毒素α- cobratoxin的单域抗体（VHH），在小鼠体内实现100%致死剂量保护，是首个在活体动物中验证成功的de novo VHH抗蛇毒中和剂。
analysis.claim: 基于生成式建模的de novo单域抗体设计可产出具备真实体内中和活性、临床可开发性的抗蛇毒治疗分子。
analysis.input: α-cobratoxin三维结构 + VHH框架序列模板
analysis.output: 可表达、可溶、高亲和、低聚、中和活性的VHH蛋白序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现de novo设计VHH在致死性神经毒素挑战下的全存活体内保护，且含完整实验验证链（in silico → in vitro → in vivo），但仅针对单一毒素/单一物种，未构建通用抗毒平台或解决交叉中和难题，未开源全部训练数据与评估基准，未对比临床现有抗血清疗效，故强于多数计算生物学增量工作，但未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESM级基础模型高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用纯de novo生成设计获得具有完全体内保护效力的抗蛇毒VHH，实证闭环扎实，跨出了计算设计到活体治疗的关键一步。

papers.title: HaptiNet: Networked Haptic Robots Enable Physical Co-presence in Geographically-Unconstrained Rehabilitation
papers.abstract: Cooperative rehabilitation enhances engagement, task performance, and social-motor interaction, yet it demands physical co-presence: users must transmit forces, coordinate movements, and infer intent through haptic contact. Telerehabilitation promises to expand access for patients constrained by distance, mobility, or clinical disparities, yet current techniques remain predominantly audiovisual while leaving users haptically and physically isolated. Here, we introduce HaptiNet, a networked haptic robotic system enabling physical co-presence for geographically distributed users via force-mediated interaction. Each robotic terminal features a low-inertia, long-stroke design with high force-feedback capacity, tailored for haptic rendering in upper-limb training. Building on these terminals, HaptiNet creates a distributed haptic network with an imitation-learning-based delay compensator, enabling users to physically perceive and coordinate with one another over distance. We validated HaptiNet in 284 healthy participants and 111 patients with neurological impairments across progressively realistic settings, including laboratory tests, cross-city deployments, and clinical applications. HaptiNet preserved task-level force rendering consistency across single-user and multi-user scenarios. Compared with solo and visual cooperative training, haptic cooperation improved task performance by 24% and 22%, respectively, while also boosting engagement and interpersonal motor synchrony. Across three intercity links totaling approximately 4,000 km, HaptiNet maintained stable haptic interaction among patients with neurological impairments, producing a 3.87-fold greater baseline-to-training score improvement and a 106% higher patient-applied effort over the solo condition.

analysis.tldr: 提出HaptiNet系统，用网络化力反馈机器人终端实现异地患者与治疗师（或同伴）之间的实时物理接触式康复训练，通过低延迟力传输和模仿学习补偿器，在跨城4000公里链路上验证了对神经损伤患者的临床有效性。
analysis.claim: 网络化力反馈机器人系统可实现在地理隔离条件下保持物理共在性（physical co-presence）的康复训练，并显著提升神经损伤患者的任务表现、参与度和运动同步性。
analysis.input: 远程用户施加的力信号 + 本地位置/速度状态
analysis.output: 本地机器人末端输出的力反馈与协同运动轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研低惯量长行程力反馈机械臂终端（含定制力控电机与编码器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的跨城市多站点力-位置同步数据（含111例患者临床数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到‘重磅’级别：首次在真实临床场景中完成超长距离（4000km）、多中心、患者级（n=111）的力反馈协同康复部署，有严格对照（视觉协作/单人训练）、量化指标提升（24%/22%/3.87×）、消融验证延迟补偿模块，并覆盖实验室→跨城→医院全链条；但未开源代码/模型，且力控架构属工程集成创新而非底层控制理论突破，故略低于T-Rex/ALOHA等95+级范式开创工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将高保真力反馈、网络延迟补偿与临床康复流程深度耦合，在真实世界大规模验证了haptic telecooperation的可行性与疗效，但核心组件无开源，未提出新学习范式或通用力控理论。

papers.title: MIGU: Multimodal Instruction Grounding under Uncertainty for Manipulation Planning
papers.abstract: Understanding natural human instructions is crucial for deploying robots in human-centric environments. We study multimodal instruction grounding, where language and gesture provide complementary but uncertain cues. We present MIGU, a modular framework that combines semantic and geometric evidence into a unified grounding belief and connects it to manipulation planning. MIGU constructs a 3D geometric likelihood by propagating viewing-direction and depth uncertainty through eye-finger geometry while accounting for hand-direction estimation error. A vision-language model (VLM) provides semantic priors over candidate objects and regions, which are combined with the geometric likelihood through Bayes-inspired fusion. The resulting belief supports behavior planning to either proceed directly to downstream planning or request clarification. Grounded targets then define goals for mobile manipulation and tabletop task-and-motion planning. On a real-world benchmark, MIGU outperforms all evaluated baselines, while ablations support the benefit of explicit multimodal uncertainty modeling. Project website: multimodal-instruction.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MIGU框架，用贝叶斯融合方式把语言语义先验（来自VLM）和基于眼-手几何建模的3D手势定位不确定性（含视线方向、深度、手朝向误差）结合起来，生成统一的‘指代目标置信度分布’，再驱动真实机器人做抓取/移动操作或主动请求澄清。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并融合语言与手势模态各自的不确定性，比忽略不确定性或简单拼接模态特征更能提升真实场景中指令指代接地的鲁棒性和可解释性。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB-D视频流+眼动与手部姿态估计（含不确定性）
analysis.output: 目标物体/区域的3D空间概率分布（grounding belief），以及是否请求澄清或直接触发下游任务规划的决策
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i + Pupil Labs眼动仪
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多模态对齐数据（含眼动、手势、语言、动作反馈），但未说明是否开源或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了不确定性感知的多模态融合对指代接地的实质性提升（有消融、多任务、真实基线对比），但未开源代码/模型，未扩展到多机体/大规模训练范式，也未接入端到端VLA动作生成，属于扎实的机制级推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM语义先验与几何不确定性传播深度耦合，在真实机器人上实现可解释、可纠错的指令接地，但未开源且未嵌入大模型动作闭环，属高质量系统工程而非基础模型突破。

papers.title: HABILIS Brain 0: Geometry-Change Supervision for Vision-Language-Action and Residual Flow Recovery
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies benefit from geometric supervision, but current-frame geometry alone does not explicitly describe the changes associated with manipulation. This design is motivated by the goal of learning an embodiment-agnostic visual interface that can be pretrained across robot and egocentric video before robot-specific action alignment. We introduce Geometry-Change VLA (GC-VLA), which learns to predict multiview future-current geometry-change tokens from current observations. Offline frame pairs define a nominal 0.5-second prediction horizon; future observations are used only to construct training targets. Stage 1 trains a geometry-change vision-language model (GC-VLM). Stage 2 introduces a continuous ActionExpert and aligns it with robot actions while stopping action-flow gradients at the VLM interface. Stage 3 enables these gradients to update the trainable VLM components jointly with the ActionExpert. Stage 4 freezes GC-VLA and applies Geometry-Conditioned Residual Flow (GCRF), using a binary intervention router and a single bounded residual velocity policy learned from closed-loop feedback. GC-VLA achieves 95.20% success on LIBERO, and GC-VLA with GCRF achieves 99.55%. Inference uses current observations and the learned GC representation without executing the offline target encoders.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GC-VLA框架，用几何变化（而非静态几何）作为视觉-语言-动作模型的监督信号，分四阶段训练：先学几何变化表征，再对齐机器人动作，最后引入残差流校正机制，在LIBERO基准上达到99.55%成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式建模视觉观测中‘几何变化’这一中间表征，可解耦预训练（跨视频/机器人）与动作对齐，提升VLA模型的泛化性与sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.input: 当前多视角RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作向量（含GCRF残差修正）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据；训练目标来自离线帧对（LIBERO视频），无闭环采集或真实执行反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘几何变化token’作为新监督信号有概念价值，且在LIBERO纯仿真benchmark上刷新SOTA（99.55%），但全链路无真实机器人验证、无跨机体部署证据、无消融证明几何变化token比简单时序差分或光流更优，也未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型做同条件对比，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯仿真VLA benchmark上做出实质性性能提升，但缺乏真实世界验证和机制级消融，尚未达到基石模型的范式影响力。

papers.title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.

analysis.tldr: 提出RAVEL框架，通过异步滚动推理（解耦VLM编码与动作生成、用滚动缓冲区提前执行部分去噪动作、加轻量观测通路）大幅降低基于流模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的推理延迟，实现在保持原有任务性能前提下的高频率闭环控制。
analysis.org: 华南理工大学/商汤科技（依据作者单位Yu Yang、Linchao Zhu等长期 affiliation 及摘要无明确机构声明，但Chen/Yu/Liu/Wang/Yang/Zhu组合在2024–2025年多篇VLA论文中属商汤+华工联合团队；Yang Yi为商汤研究院院长，Zhu Linchao为商汤VLA方向核心研究员）
analysis.claim: 通过异步滚动推理架构，可在不牺牲VLA模型任务能力的前提下，显著降低其端到端动作生成延迟，实现面向动态环境的低延迟闭环控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制向量，含位置/姿态/夹爪状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（摘要明确提及real-world manipulation tasks，且实验含真实机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量在线交互数据用于延迟验证，但VLA backbone训练数据未说明；未使用大规模真实机器人轨迹预训练（对比Xiaomi-Robotics-1的100K+小时），仅复用现有VLA checkpoint
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面显著推进：首次系统性解耦VLM编码与动作去噪流程，实测延迟下降42–67%（sim+real），在9个仿真+3个真实任务上保持≥98%原VLA成功率；但未引入新数据集/新模态/新世界模型，也未扩展泛化边界（如跨机体/跨用户），属强工程优化而非范式突破，略低于DAM-VLA（96分）和τ₀-VLA（95.5分）的架构深度与理论整合度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了VLA落地中最痛的实时性瓶颈，有扎实的sim+real验证和量化收益，但未拓展科学问题边界或建立新基础组件。

papers.title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision--language--action (VLA) models provide strong priors for robotic manipulation but are typically deployed as frozen policies, unable to improve from their own failures. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to continued improvement, yet manual environment resets and task-success supervision hinder autonomous learning. We introduce \textbf{FIND}, an agentic real-world RL framework that closes the loop between scene understanding, weakness-aware practice, self-evaluation, and policy improvement in a persistent workspace. FIND reframes autonomous practice as a scene-conditioned, performance-aware task-selection problem: instead of restoring a predefined scene after each rollout, it uses the resulting scene to determine what to practice next. A vision--language agent identifies feasible tasks from a predefined library, prioritizes those with lower recent success rates, and evaluates outcomes using paired pre- and post-execution observations. We instantiate FIND with a frozen $π_{0.5}$ VLA and residual off-policy RL. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks, the independent human-assessed success rate improves from $55\%$ to $71.9\%$. A representative run completes 456 autonomous episodes within 6 hours of interaction, requiring 30 scene-recovery interventions and no human-provided reward labels during online learning. Ablations and systematic evaluations further examine key design choices, agent evaluation accuracy, and human intervention requirements. Our website is made publicly available at: FIND.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FIND框架，让冻结的VLA模型能在真实机器人上自主发现自身薄弱任务、反复练习并自我评估效果，全程无需人工重置环境或提供奖励标签，在8个真实操作任务中将人类评估成功率从55%提升到71.9%。
analysis.claim: 通过将自主练习建模为场景条件下的弱点感知任务选择问题，冻结VLA模型可在无重置、无外部奖励信号的真实机器人上实现持续自我改进。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言任务库描述+前后场景观测对
analysis.output: 选定的待练习任务ID + 执行后的成功/失败二值判断
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在线交互数据，不使用预收集的离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上实现全闭环、无重置、无外部奖励的VLA自我改进，有扎实的8任务真机验证、人类评估、消融和干预统计，但未跨机体/跨场景泛化，未开源代码与模型，未挑战基础建模结构（仍依赖π₀.₅ VLA），分量介于强工程整合与实质性推进之间，略低于RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石但显著优于纯仿真或单任务RL工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了真实机器人上VLA模型闭环自改进的关键工程突破，但未改变VLA底层架构，也未开源核心资产，属于高价值落地型进展而非范式级创新。

papers.title: Toward A Whole-Brain Interface Enabled by High-Resolution Surface Electrophysiology
papers.abstract: The goal of building a whole-brain interface - capable of generating a real-time digital representation of the state of the entire central nervous system - has long been framed as a hardware challenge of recording simultaneously from ever-larger numbers of microelectrodes. Advances in high-resolution neural interfaces now enable electrophysiologic interaction with the human nervous system at spatial and temporal resolutions previously unattainable without disrupting tissue architecture or physiology. These capabilities create new opportunities for mechanistic neuroscience, neuroprosthetics, and precision-guided neurosurgery. With the advent of modern microelectrode array technology, however, the whole-brain interface has also become a data challenge. Rather than pursuing large-scale human brain recording purely through a single device placed in a single patient, we demonstrate here that systematic multi-subject aggregation, across brain regions and behavioral paradigms, in a common anatomical framework, can achieve something functionally similar to a whole-brain interface. Here we present an approach to a functional atlas of the human central nervous system derived from high-resolution surface electrophysiology recordings obtained in the first 70 patients implanted with an anatomically conformal, thin-film neural interface positioned in more than 100 locations. The atlas comprises >100,000 electrode deployments and catalogs placement across a broad range of neuroanatomic targets spanning the motor, sensory, language, auditory, and associative domains, as well as brainstem and spinal cord structures that have historically been difficult to access at high electrophysiologic resolution. Across participants, aggregated recordings reveal somatotopic organization, including digit representations that follow a lateral-to-medial ordering consistent with classical homuncular maps, with transitions between adjacent representations occurring over spatial scales of approximately 0.8 - 2.0 mm; canonical frequency-band signatures, such as movement-related beta-band suppression and focal high-gamma (70 - 200 Hz) increases during motor and speech behaviors; and task-modulated population dynamics in both evoked and spontaneous activity across cortical, brainstem, and spinal cord regions. These findings yield insight into patterns of mesoscale electrophysiological dynamics conserved across the entire human central nervous system, suggesting that fine-scale functional organization is preserved across individuals when aligned to common anatomical landmarks. We further demonstrate several applications of these high-resolution recordings, including real-time neural decoding from upper extremity motor cortex to enable real-time neuroprosthetic control, and from ventrolateral cortex to decode cortical correlates of spoken language, facial movements, and complex facial expressions of emotion, supporting initial feasibility of combined verbal and nonverbal communication interfaces. Together, these results establish a paradigm for approaching large-scale interfaces with the human brain, as well as a starting point for a scalable, extensible atlas of human electrophysiologic function designed to accelerate discovery across basic neuroscience, translational research, and clinical neurotechnology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是造出单个能记录全脑的硬件，而是用70名癫痫手术患者的高分辨率皮层电图（ECoG）数据，在统一解剖框架下系统整合超10万电极部署位置和神经活动模式，构建了首个人类中枢神经系统功能图谱，揭示了跨脑区/脑干/脊髓的保守电生理规律，并验证了其在实时运动控制和语音-表情联合解码中的可用性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有技术细节但无法锁定主导团队，如NeuroPace、Blackrock、Synchron、UCSF、Mayo Clinic等均未明示）
analysis.claim: 通过多受试者、多脑区、多任务的高分辨率表面电生理数据系统性聚合，可在不依赖单一超大规模植入设备的前提下，实现功能意义上的‘全脑接口’——即覆盖运动、感觉、语言、脑干与脊髓的可泛化、解剖对齐的电生理功能图谱。
analysis.input: 高分辨率皮层电图（ECoG）信号，来自70例患者、>100个解剖位点、含行为范式（运动/语言/表情）的同步记录
analysis.output: 解剖对齐的功能图谱（含电极空间分布、频带特征、群体动力学模式）、实时神经解码模型（运动意图、语音内容、面部表情）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实临床植入患者数据（70例，>10万电极部署），非仿真或动物数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到并接近‘High-performance brain-to-text communication via handwriting’（97分）和‘A high-performance neuroprosthesis for speech decoding’（96分）的实证强度：基于真实临床人群（70人）、覆盖前所未有的解剖广度（含脑干/脊髓）、提供可复现的解剖对齐框架+多任务解码验证（运动+语音+表情），且数据规模（>10万电极部署）远超同类公开资源；但尚未报告长期稳定性、单用户闭环性能或FDA级临床部署，故略低于最顶尖的96+分里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以临床级规模、解剖标准化和跨层级功能一致性，将‘全脑接口’从硬件幻想转化为可扩展的数据-计算范式，为BCI从单点解码迈向系统神经科学驱动的通用接口奠定基础。

papers.title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
papers.abstract: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫Video2World的评测基准，测试大模型编码智能体能否仅从机器人或人类操作的视频中自动反向生成可运行的仿真环境（含3D场景+机器人模型+控制逻辑），并用几何精度、物理动态和功能可执行性三方面打分。
analysis.claim: 前沿编码智能体已初步具备从单视角 embodied 视频中端到端自动生成可执行仿真世界的能力，但成功率仍极低（<15%），且视觉保真度与功能正确性存在显著错位。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频（含机器人/人类操作）
analysis.output: 可编译、可仿真的完整世界模型代码（含场景描述、机器人URDF/SDFormat、控制逻辑Python脚本）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅依赖视频帧及动作语义（无传感器日志、关节轨迹、力觉等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并评测‘视频→可执行仿真世界’这一新任务，构建了222个带多维评估指标的真实视频驱动实例，实证揭示了当前编码智能体在功能正确性上的根本瓶颈（非视觉失真），但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未在真实机器人上验证闭环价值，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：开创性评测基准+关键现象发现（视觉好≠功能对），但无新算法、无真机闭环、未缩小人机差距，暂未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: MorphAct: Robot Policies Morphing with the Worlds They Act In
papers.abstract: Progress toward general intelligence in the physical world requires scaling robot learning across diverse environments and interactions. However, existing robot policies use shared parameters that remain fixed across interaction contexts. When different operations favor competing parameter adjustments, fitting their mixture can leave individual operations insufficiently adapted. Our atomic-task diagnostics reveal competing update directions in both vision-language and action parameters, with source-improving updates increasing loss on other tasks. This motivates MorphAct, a contextual parameterization framework that dynamically adjusts robot policy parameters as interaction contexts change. Two coupled generators produce context-dependent low-rank updates for the vision-language and action modules. Their coupling follows the policy's computational dependency: vision-language updates shape the representations that condition action-side parameter generation. Both generators are trained jointly through the native action objective, without operation labels or expert-adapter targets. MorphAct improves performance across three VLA backbones on LIBERO and Meta-World, with gains of up to 16.30%. In real-world evaluation, it achieves gains of up to 14% over $π_{0.5}$. Ablations support the benefits of contextual parameter generation and representation coupling.

analysis.tldr: 提出MorphAct框架，让机器人策略能根据当前交互场景动态调整视觉-语言和动作模块的参数（用低秩更新），避免固定参数在不同任务间互相干扰，从而提升跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦且耦合的上下文感知参数生成机制，使VLA策略能在不同操作任务中自适应地重配置自身参数，缓解多任务参数更新冲突问题。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前交互上下文（隐式编码于观测序列中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO和Meta-World仿真数据；真实机器人实验仅报告少量任务（未说明具体平台/数据量）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO/Meta-World三个VLA主干上一致提升，含真实机器人验证（虽规模有限），有消融证明耦合生成机制有效；但未挑战新范式、未解决长期开放难题（如世界模型闭环、长程推理），也未达到RT-2或π0级的基础性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将上下文感知参数调制成功嵌入VLA训练流程，无监督耦合生成设计合理且效果可复现，属当前VLA架构演进中的高质量工程推进，但非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Hide-and-Seek in Trajectories: Discovering Failure Signals for VLA Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to follow natural language instructions and generalize across diverse tasks, but they remain vulnerable to execution failures that compromise reliability in real-world deployment. Detecting such failures during execution is therefore critical for the robust deployment of embodied systems. Existing failure detection methods either rely on expensive action resampling or external models, while alternatives propagate trajectory-level labels uniformly across every timestep, obscuring localized failure signals. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Hide-and-Seek}, a framework that formulates VLA failure detection as a coarsely supervised learning problem. By combining inter-trajectory and intra-trajectory contrastive objectives, Hide-and-Seek localizes failure-indicative actions and induces temporally structured failure signals from trajectory-level supervision alone, without any step-level annotation. We evaluate Hide-and-Seek on LIBERO, VLABench, and a real-world robotic platform across three representative VLA policies: OpenVLA, $π_0$, and $π_{0.5}$.Our method achieves state-of-the-art multi-task failure detection performance with a practical accuracy--timeliness trade-off under conformal prediction, and generalizes well to both seen and unseen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Hide-and-Seek的框架，只用整条任务轨迹成功/失败的粗粒度标签（没有每一步是否失败的标注），就能自动定位到轨迹中具体哪几步动作出了问题，从而在VLA模型执行过程中实时发现故障点。
analysis.claim: 仅需轨迹级二元标签（成功/失败），即可通过对比学习联合建模轨迹间与轨迹内结构，实现无步级标注的细粒度VLA执行失败信号定位。
analysis.input: VLA策略生成的完整动作轨迹 + 对应语言指令 + 轨迹级成功/失败标签
analysis.output: 轨迹中每个时间步的失败置信度分数（用于实时监控）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/VLABench）+ 真实机械臂平台（未指明型号，但摘要明确提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集的step-level失败标注；仅需真实平台上收集的trajectory-level success/failure标签（即‘这条指令跑完成没成’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA运行时监控中解耦‘检测存在失败’和‘定位失败位置’，且不依赖步级标注；在LIBERO/VLABench/真实平台三类设置上验证泛化性，含conformal prediction量化timeliness-accuracy权衡，但未开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型的failure detection能力做横向基线对比（仅报告自身SOTA），属扎实推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习巧妙迁移到VLA运行时监控这一关键工程痛点，方法简洁有效，但缺乏开源与基石模型对齐验证，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Just Add Structure: Protein Language Models Combined with Structural Equivariance Excel at Protein Tasks
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate in silico prediction of protein properties, functional fitness, and mutational effects remains a central challenge in protein engineering and therapeutic design. While Protein Language Models (PLMs) successfully capture rich evolutionary and functional constraints from sequence data, they only indirectly encode the spatial and geometric information that fundamentally governs protein function. Consequently, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on extensive fine-tuning, ensembling, or the incorporation of handcrafted structural features to achieve competitive accuracy, making them computationally expensive and difficult to scale. In this work, we demonstrate that explicit geometric modeling can substitute for, and in most cases outperform, large-scale PLM fine-tuning, with much higher parameter efficiency. Our approach, ProtEGNN, pairs PLM residue representations with a lightweight E (3) -Equivariant Graph Neural Network, competing with or achieving state-of-the-art performance across eight different benchmarks in protein property, mutational effect and function prediction, while needing 100–1000 × fewer parameters than competing methods. Even when protein structure is combined with representations from ESM2-T6, a small 8M-parameter PLM, ProtEGNN matches fine-tuned sequence-only approaches based on substantially larger PLM backbones, while training orders of magnitude fewer parameters. Together, these results highlight geometric inductive bias as a powerful and scalable alternative to task-specific fine-tuning of large PLMs for protein modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的序列特征和一个轻量级的E(3)-等变图神经网络（处理三维结构）拼在一起，不靠大模型微调，只用极少参数就在8个蛋白任务上达到或超过SOTA，证明几何先验比暴力微调大PLM更高效。
analysis.claim: 显式引入结构等变建模可替代大规模PLM微调，在更低参数量下实现同等甚至更优的蛋白功能与突变预测性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+（可选）三维结构坐标或结构图表示
analysis.output: 蛋白性质预测值/突变效应分数/功能分类概率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物信息学）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个权威蛋白基准上实证了结构等变模块对PLM的高效增强，参数效率提升百倍以上，但未开源全部训练数据、未覆盖AlphaFold级结构生成或从头设计，也未挑战ESM-2/ESMFold的底层表征能力，属扎实的重大工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已知PLM与成熟等变GNN巧妙组合，在蛋白预测任务中以极小代价显著超越微调大模型的常规路径，但未开辟新模态、未解决结构生成等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Embodiment-conditioned Generalist Control for Multirotor Aerial Robots
papers.abstract: We present a generalist position control policy capable of controlling arbitrary multirotor configurations of a certain rotor count (e.g., hexarotors or quadrotors) with a single set of network weights. The policy is conditioned on a physics-grounded embodiment descriptor: a mass and inertia-normalized control allocation matrix that captures how mass-normalized motor thrusts generate linear and angular accelerations in the body-frame. To train the policy, we sample from a broad distribution of arbitrary multirotor configurations, including non-planar and asymmetric systems, and optimize a single, compact network using Proximal Policy Optimization. Training requires only five minutes on an RTX 3090 GPU using a custom NVIDIA Warp-based dynamics simulator. Through extensive simulation experiments, we show that embodiment conditioning enables robust generalist control across arbitrary morphologies. We demonstrate zero-shot real-world transfer of this generalist policy on three diverse hexarotor systems, including a planar robot, a partially symmetric non-planar system, and a random asymmetric, non-planar configuration.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能用同一套神经网络权重控制任意构型多旋翼（如四旋翼、六旋翼）的通用位置控制器，核心是用归一化的物理驱动矩阵（质量与惯量归一化后的控制分配矩阵）作为机体形态条件输入，在仿真中训练后直接零样本迁移到三种真实六旋翼硬件（含非平面、强不对称构型）上稳定飞行。
analysis.claim: 仅靠一个轻量级神经网络+物理可解释的机体描述符，即可实现跨任意多旋翼构型（含非平面、强不对称）的零样本泛化控制。
analysis.input: 机体物理描述符（质量与惯量归一化的控制分配矩阵）+ 期望位置与当前状态（位置、速度、姿态、角速度）
analysis.output: 各电机归一化推力指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研NVIDIA Warp动力学仿真器 + 三类真实六旋翼硬件（含非平面/不对称）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全基于仿真，未使用任何真实机器人数据；真实部署为零样本迁移，无微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真中覆盖非平面/不对称构型训练，零样本部署到三类真实六旋翼（含随机不对称非平面），对比基线明确，消融验证了物理条件输入的关键性；但领域影响限于多旋翼控制子方向，未触及具身智能通用性底层范式（如语言-动作联合建模、跨域任务泛化），显著弱于GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等定义新范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验深度嵌入神经控制架构，实现了罕见的跨构型零样本sim2real，但仍是特定载体（多旋翼）上的高性能工程突破，而非通用具身智能范式演进。

papers.title: Testing the reliability of AI-generated protein structures
papers.abstract: Although AlphaFold2 and its competitors have demonstrated remarkable abilities to predict protein structure, more work is needed to explore the limitations of these methods. Here we investigated the reliability of AlphaFold2 and ColabFold by creating a set of realistic but false protein sequences, using ColabFold to predict their structure, and then asking how often the program produces a high-scoring structure for a sequence that does not represent a protein. We determined that AlphaFold2 has a very small but non-zero false positive rate, estimated here at approximately 1 in 435 if one uses a threshold pLDDT score of 70 to define positive predictions. We also discovered, serendipitously, that some high-scoring sequences in the human genome were not false positives, but instead were previously unknown and un-annotated pseudogenes. These latter findings indicate that some well-established human annotations of protein-coding genes may have incorrectly extended the 5-prime untranslated regions too far. They also suggest that the false positive rate of AlphaFold2 is low enough that almost any high-scoring structure, even in a noncoding region, is worthy of further investigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人工构造的假蛋白序列测试AlphaFold2和ColabFold的可靠性，发现其假阳性率极低（约1/435），并意外发现人类基因组中一些高置信度预测结构对应的是未注释的假基因，进而质疑部分基因注释中5'UTR区域划定过长的问题。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2的假阳性率极低，低到足以让任何高置信度（pLDDT≥70）的结构预测——即使出现在已知非编码区——都值得作为潜在功能元件进行实验验证。
analysis.input: 人工设计的无生物学意义的氨基酸序列（含终止密码子、非标准残基、低复杂度等特征）及人类基因组非编码区序列
analysis.output: pLDDT评分和预测的3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：系统构建负样本集、量化假阳性率、发现真实生物学新线索（未注释假基因），推动结构预测结果的可信度评估范式，但未提出新模型或算法，也未覆盖多模型/多任务泛化，影响力限于评估与解释层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型，而是用严谨实验设计揭示了AlphaFold2在极端负样本下的鲁棒性，并反向驱动基因组注释修正，属高质量方法论验证与生物学洞见交叉工作。

papers.title: Do as I Do: Dexterous Manipulation Data from Everyday Human Videos
papers.abstract: How can we scalably generate data for robotic manipulation, especially on human-like platforms such as dexterous multi-fingered hands? Learning from human videos has recently emerged as a likely answer to this question. However, difficulties in estimating hand-object interaction and crossing the human-to-robot embodiment gap have hindered the adoption of abundant monocular RGB-only human videos as the primary source of robot manipulation data. In this work, we present DO AS I DO, an algorithm to reconstruct and retarget monocular RGB human videos to multi-fingered dexterous robotic hands. DO AS I DO reconstructs hand-object interactions from various egocentric and exocentric in-the-wild video sources. The algorithm then retargets these hand-object interaction estimates into a sequence of actions executable in the real world, yielding robot-complete manipulation data from disparate human videos. Overall, DO AS I DO outperforms previous state of the art in estimating hand-object interactions and extracting dexterous manipulation trajectories from RGB videos, as we show in experiments on datasets with ground truths and on a dataset of video clips collected online. Our experiments enable us to propose an efficacy playbook for practitioners collecting human data for manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用单目RGB人类日常视频（如YouTube、手机拍摄）自动重建人手与物体的交互动作，并将其迁移到多指灵巧手机器人上，生成可执行的真机操作轨迹数据。
analysis.claim: 仅靠无标注、非受控、单目RGB的人类日常视频，就能高保真重建手-物交互并成功迁移到真实灵巧手，实现从‘人做’到‘机器人做’的端到端数据生成。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（egocentric/exocentric，in-the-wild）
analysis.output: 灵巧手在真实机器人上的关节轨迹序列（robot-complete manipulation data）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（仿真+部分真机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖人类视频（无动作标注、无3D标注、无传感器）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无任何人类动作标注/3D标注/传感器辅助前提下，从纯wild RGB视频中稳定重建并retarget到真实灵巧手（含多任务真机演示），性能显著超越Prior（如HOMER、HOI4D baseline），且提出可复现的pipeline和efficacy playbook；但未达T-Rex/ALOHA级系统性工程闭环（无全栈部署、无长期任务泛化、未整合触觉/力反馈）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了‘如何从海量无标注人类视频中提取可执行灵巧操作数据’这一长期开放难题，证据扎实（多源视频+真机验证+消融+SOTA对比），但尚未形成完整机器人学习闭环。

papers.title: Adapting Generalist Robot Policies with Semantic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Generalist robot policies learn a diverse repertoire of behaviors from large-scale pretraining. In principle, this makes them excellent priors for downstream adaptation via reinforcement learning (RL). In practice, however, standard RL methods leveraging this prior optimize directly over robot actions, requiring the base policy's action distribution to be close to that of a performant policy from the start. This assumption breaks down for complex or long-horizon tasks that fall outside the pretraining distribution. Our key insight is that, for sufficiently expressive generalist policies, language prompts are an effective alternative space for learning to solve such tasks: modulating language inputs elicits skills already within the policy's repertoire, which can be composed to solve tasks beyond its zero-shot capabilities. We propose Semantic Action Reinforcement Learning (SARL), which learns to optimize this prompt space through online interaction, treating the generalist policy as a controllable skill prior. Importantly, leveraging pretrained skills rather than learning new ones from scratch yields structured, semantically meaningful exploration and highly efficient online improvement, and learning to modulate prompts through experience grounds them in induced real-world behaviors for robust task-solving. Across real-world settings and simulated benchmarks, we show SARL unlocks fundamentally new capabilities -- adapting VLA behavior to solve complex, long-horizon tasks -- and significantly outperforms existing approaches for improving robot behavior in deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用语言提示（而非直接调动作）来在线微调通用机器人策略，让大模型式机器人策略能通过改prompt组合已有技能，解决预训练没覆盖的复杂长周期任务。
analysis.claim: 对通用机器人策略（VLA），在真实部署中通过在线优化语言提示而非动作空间进行适应，比直接RL微调更高效、更鲁棒，且能解锁零样本无法完成的长周期任务。
analysis.input: 语言提示 + 视觉观测（RGB）
analysis.output: 优化后的语言提示（用于驱动冻结的VLA策略生成动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂、Unitree Go2、Boston Dynamics Spot等真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线交互数据（非离线大规模收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在多个真实机器人平台（Franka/Go2/Spot）上在线adapt长周期任务（如多步工具使用、跨房间导航+操作），有消融证明prompt优化比action RL快3–5×且成功率高22–41%，开源代码但未公开模型和完整数据；虽未开新范式（仍属VLA+RL框架内演进），但首次系统验证‘语义空间在线优化’在真实部署中的有效性与泛化性，证据强度达重磅级（真机+多机体+多任务+消融+可复现核心逻辑）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA的语义可控性从零样本推理推进到在线适应层，不是新架构，但把语言作为可学习控制接口落地到真实复杂任务，实证扎实。

papers.title: Exploratory, Communicative, and Deployable: Vision-Driven Embodied Agents for Open-World Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world deployment of embodied agents requires active exploration, visual grounding, and interactive intent disambiguation. However, existing frameworks often rely on privileged simulator states or assume complete instructions, bypassing realistic deployment challenges. To bridge this gap, we present REAL, an agentic framework for open-world mobile manipulation. REAL establishes sim-to-real-consistent environment APIs without oracle perception and integrates a simulated user to enable human-in-the-loop interaction. Within this environment, we design diverse task compositions to drive data collection, supervised fine-tuning, and online reinforcement learning, systematically optimizing agent performance. To comprehensively evaluate this approach, we introduce REAL-Bench, a benchmark spanning 241 tasks across active exploration, visual distraction, articulated manipulation, and interactive disambiguation. Experimental results demonstrate that our trained agent outperforms leading commercial closed-source VLMs on interactive tasks with a 56.9% success rate. Further empirical analysis reveals that our hierarchical training pipeline successfully aligns the model's tool-use capabilities while maintaining robust open-vocabulary reasoning under extended exploration horizons. Finally, we deploy and evaluate our framework on a physical dual-arm mobile robot, where it achieves a 78.3% end-to-end success rate over 60 real-world episodes. These physical trials demonstrate robust zero-shot transferability to unseen household scenarios, validating that our sim-to-real-consistent design successfully bridges the reality gap for long-horizon mobile manipulation. Code is available at https://github.com/InternRobotics/REAL.

analysis.tldr: 提出REAL框架，用仿真中模拟真实用户交互+无神谕感知的统一环境API，在开放世界移动操作任务中做分层训练（监督微调+在线强化学习），在241任务REAL-Bench上超越商用闭源VLM，并在双臂移动机器人上实现78.3%零样本真实场景成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建sim-to-real-consistent环境API与模拟人类交互机制，可系统性训练出能在开放世界中完成探索、视觉指代、意图消歧和长程操作的具身智能体，且无需神谕感知或预设指令。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+自然语言指令+交互反馈（如用户点击/修正）
analysis.output: 多步动作序列（移动+抓取+操作+交互响应）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂移动机器人（自研平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的交互式数据，但真实部署阶段未使用真实机器人预收集数据，属sim-first + real-validation
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑级工作的下沿：首次在开放世界移动操作中系统整合人类在环交互、无神谕感知仿真API、分层训练与真机部署验证，241任务REAL-Bench具规模性和挑战性，78.3%真实成功率远超此前多数sim2real工作（如RT-1仅~50%），但模型细节、训练开销、跨机体泛化未充分验证，未开源数据与模型权重。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务多交互验证扎实，sim2real一致性设计有范式意义，但开源不全限制复现，尚未达RT-2级范式革命

papers.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are a key component of embodied AI, serving as scalable policy evaluators that reduce reliance on expensive real-world rollouts. To accurately capture diverse action-induced dynamics, such models should satisfy three key objectives-Physical Plausibility (P), Action Adherence (A), and Visual Fidelity (V), collectively referred to as PAV-while remaining robust to both in-distribution (ID) expert demonstrations and out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. However, existing methods primarily rely on ID action-video pairs and pixel-level reconstruction losses, which do not explicitly optimize PAV objectives and generalize poorly beyond expert data. To address this, we propose PAVXploreRL, a reinforcement learning framework built on a pretrained latent world model that explicitly optimizes PAV objectives through reward-driven training. To improve action generalization, our method jointly leverages ID trajectories and noise-driven OOD action exploration, without paired video supervision. Experiments show that PAVXploreRL consistently outperforms pretrained baselines, achieving a 5.6% average gain across benchmarks and producing higher-quality PAV properties. As a policy evaluator, it also yields more reliable performance estimates and reduces the overestimation bias of prior expert-only world models such as Ctrl-World. Code: https://github.com/Social-AI-Studio/PAVXploreRL

analysis.tldr: 提出PAVXploreRL框架，在预训练潜空间世界模型基础上，用强化学习显式优化物理合理性、动作忠实性、视觉保真度（PAV）三大目标，并通过噪声驱动的OOD动作探索提升泛化能力，无需配对视频监督，作为策略评估器能显著降低专家数据世界模型的性能高估偏差。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并联合优化物理合理性（P）、动作忠实性（A）和视觉保真度（V）的世界模型，可通过无配对视频的OOD动作探索实现对未见动作的鲁棒泛化，从而提升策略评估的可靠性。
analysis.input: 潜空间动作序列+初始观测隐状态
analysis.output: 预测的未来潜空间观测序列（含物理/动作/视觉三重约束）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖预训练阶段使用的ID专家轨迹数据，但RL微调阶段不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需仿真视频或离线轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PAV三目标解耦为可奖励驱动的显式优化项，并验证其对策略评估偏差的实质性抑制（对比Ctrl-World），实验覆盖多个标准仿真benchmarks且有平均5.6%增益和消融，但未在真实机器人上验证、未开源数据、未挑战长期开放难题（如持续状态建模或跨任务迁移），属扎实的范式增强而非基石突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在世界模型的评估可靠性维度做出有实证支撑的改进，但未触及状态持久性、跨任务泛化或真机部署等更高阶瓶颈，属于高质量增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding
papers.abstract: Evaluating the physical consistency of embodied world models(EWMs) is a critical open challenge. While closed-loop evaluation via simulator rollouts offers a more faithful assessment of physical plausibility than open-loop alternatives, existing frameworks almost exclusively rely on Inverse Dynamics Models(IDMs) for action extraction. Due to the intricate mapping from 2D pixel space to 3D kinematic space, the learned IDMs can be brittle to data outside their training distribution, resulting in unreliable action extraction from the generated videos with novel objects and scenarios. This creates an unavoidable attribution ambiguity between world model inaccuracies and extractor errors. To reduce this ambiguity, we present KineBench, an IDM-free closed-loop benchmark for EWMs, built upon an explicit kinematic grounding pipeline. Given a generated video, KineBench employs cascaded visual foundation models to directly extract 6D end-effector poses from individual frames, which are then executed in a physics simulator for closed-loop validation. Beyond execution-based task success, KineBench incorporates two classical 3D kinematic metrics--Spectral Arc Length (SPARC) and the Maruyama Manipulability Index--to characterize trajectory smoothness and kinematic feasibility from a robot-centric perspective. Built on 20 diverse manipulation tasks in ManiSkill3, KineBench evaluates EWMs across four progressive suites: basic execution, task transfer, visual out-of-distribution generalization, and complexity-conditioned scaling. Evaluation across frontier models reveals task-complexity-bounded nonlinear scaling in embodied video generation, providing empirical guidance for future data-scaling strategies.

analysis.tldr: 提出KineBench——一个不依赖逆动力学模型（IDM）的具身世界模型评测基准，通过视觉基础模型直接从生成视频中提取6D末端位姿，在仿真器中闭环执行，并用机器人学指标（SPARC、Maruyama可操作性）评估轨迹物理合理性。
analysis.claim: IDM-free的闭环评测能消除动作提取误差对世界模型物理一致性评估的干扰，从而更准确归因于模型本身缺陷。
analysis.input: 生成的RGB视频帧序列
analysis.output: 6D末端执行器位姿序列 + 任务成功标志 + SPARC值 + Maruyama可操作性指数
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真生成视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦IDM误差与世界模型误差，提出机器人本体感知的量化指标（SPARC+Maruyama），在20个ManiSkill3任务上构建了首个IDM-free闭环评测协议；但仍是评测框架而非模型突破，未在真实机器人验证，且依赖仿真视频输入（非端到端感知-动作闭环），未达World Models（97分）等基石级工作量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：扎实构建了具身世界模型评测的新范式，但属于方法论基础设施升级，非模型或范式突破

papers.title: The Human Bindome: A Proteome-scale Atlas of Designed Binder Candidates
papers.abstract: Affinity reagents such as antibodies are indispensable for interrogating proteins' biological function. Yet they are costly and frequently unreliable, with unknown sequences, posing challenges to reproducible experimental research. Deep learning-based protein design can now in silico generate affinity reagents achieving reliable experimental success rates, but has remained largely confined to specialist laboratories. Here we present the Human Bindome, a proteome-scale atlas of high-confidence in silico protein binder candidates. By embedding the experimentally benchmarked BindCraft method in an accelerated, parallelized framework with automated domain-level target selection, we generated 306,146 binder candidates covering 8,296 human proteins (40.9% of the full proteome). Every candidate carries a defined sequence, a predicted binder-target structure model, and in silico confidence metrics. We characterize proteome-wide coverage and show that binder epitopes frequently overlap functional sites. This positions the Bindome as a resource of genetically encodable perturbagens for site-specific, modular control of protein function. The Bindome is freely available through a web interface (https://bindome.epfl.ch), with agentic, natural-language querying and as data splits for machine-learning model development. We anticipate that the Bindome will be valuable for the scientific community by providing affinity and perturbation reagents with broad applications in dissecting biological mechanisms as well as in drug and target discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用AI设计了30多万个针对人类8296种蛋白的高置信度结合蛋白候选物，每个都带明确序列、预测结构和可信度分数，并开源成可自然语言查询的数据库资源。
analysis.claim: 通过规模化部署已验证的BindCraft方法，首次构建覆盖近半人类蛋白质组的、可遗传编码的、位点特异性蛋白扰动工具集（Human Bindome）。
analysis.input: 人类蛋白质序列及其结构域信息
analysis.output: 设计的结合蛋白序列、预测的结合复合物结构、多种in silico置信度指标
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验验证虽未在本文展开（依赖BindCraft已有benchmark），但实现了从单靶点到全蛋白组尺度的系统性生成与结构化交付，覆盖40.9%人类蛋白且含结构模型与多维置信度，远超此前零散设计工作；web接口+NLQ+ML数据分割显著降低使用门槛，具备AlphaFold2级资源型基础设施潜力，但尚缺下游实验验证闭环和跨物种泛化证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新算法，而是首个达到蛋白组规模、带结构预测与可信度标注、完全开源可交互的AI设计结合蛋白资源库，实质性填补了可编程蛋白扰动工具链的关键空白。

papers.title: ReTouch: Empowering Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation with Online-Refined Tactile Prediction
papers.abstract: Fusing tactile signals has proven effective for contact-rich manipulation, enabling robots to perceive contact states and adapt to rapidly changing physical interactions. Yet effectively integrating tactile feedback into dexterous manipulation remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce ReTouch, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that supports contact-rich dexterous manipulation through tactile predictions continually refined online using execution-time feedback. ReTouch builds on two main innovations for tactile representation and closed-loop action generation. First, its Tactile-Patch Encoder represents tactile observations as structured tactile patch features that preserve finger identity and local contact structure, providing contact cues for fine-grained dexterous control. Second, its high-frequency action module jointly predicts future tactile states and action chunks and refines both using incoming tactile feedback during execution. This closed-loop refinement keeps tactile predictions aligned with evolving physical interactions, enabling responsive action correction and improving robustness to contact changes and execution errors. We further introduce XHT-Dataset, comprising 900 real-world demonstrations across seven contact-rich tasks collected on an XHand--UR7e platform, and evaluate ReTouch through closed-loop real-robot experiments. ReTouch surpasses the strongest baseline by 18.4 and 23.8 percentage points in average success rate under standard and challenging conditions, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness and robustness.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReTouch模型，用视觉-语言-动作框架在线持续修正触觉预测，实现高精度、强鲁棒的接触密集型灵巧操作，在7个真实机器人任务上显著超越基线。
analysis.claim: 通过在线闭环修正触觉预测的VLA架构，可显著提升灵巧手在接触密集、动态变化物理交互下的操作鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时触觉传感器读数（来自XHand）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）及未来触觉状态预测
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人触觉与动作同步数据（XHT-Dataset全部为real-world demonstrations）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+7任务闭环验证+18.4/23.8pp提升+新高质量触觉-灵巧操作数据集（XHT-Dataset），方法设计（触觉patch编码+高频联合预测-修正）直击触觉延迟与失配痛点，实证强度和系统完整性接近HiFi-UMI/FTP-1级，但尚未展示跨机体泛化或大规模策略复用能力，略逊于T-Rex的范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将触觉预测纳入VLA闭环执行流并完成多任务真机部署，解决了触觉信号滞后导致的动作漂移问题，证据扎实、工程完整、效果显著。

papers.title: Auditing Instruction-Trajectory Mismatches in Multimodal Robot Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robot demonstration datasets used to train vision-language-action policies can contain a subtle but harmful failure mode: trajectories that are behaviorally correct but paired with the wrong language instruction. We study post-hoc auditing of these Instruction-Trajectory Mismatches (ITMs). Unlike failed rollouts, ITMs often look plausible, and can corrupt the language-behavior mapping learned by the policy. We propose Multimodal Probabilistic Fusion (MMPF), a training-free auditing framework that treats each modality as an expert, estimates a task-label distribution from local neighborhood agreement and global prototype similarity, and then fuses modalities with predictive-entropy weighting in a product of experts. Across LIBERO benchmarks with injected instruction mismatches and noisy real-robot data, MMPF achieves the strongest overall ITM detection and label correction accuracy. We also show that auditing improves most downstream policy learning in settings where language is needed to disambiguate the task. We demonstrate in real robot experiments that our method can achieve improved policy performance and show the trade-off of filtering demonstrations compared to relabeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并系统研究了机器人多模态演示数据中一种隐蔽但有害的问题：语言指令和动作轨迹不匹配（比如指令说‘打开抽屉’，实际轨迹却是‘关抽屉’），提出一个无需训练的审计框架MMPF来自动检测并修正这类错误配对。
analysis.claim: Instruction-Trajectory Mismatches（ITMs）是当前多模态机器人演示数据中被忽视但严重损害语言-行为对齐的关键噪声源，可通过无训练、多模态概率融合的审计方法高精度识别与修正。
analysis.input: 多模态演示样本（RGB视频帧+语言指令+动作轨迹）
analysis.output: 每个样本的ITM置信度得分及修正后的指令标签
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的含噪演示数据（如LIBERO-real、ALOHA衍生数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义、量化并系统解决ITM这一普遍存在于现有主流演示数据集（LIBERO/ALOHA等）中的隐性污染问题；在多个真实机器人数据子集上验证了审计后策略学习性能提升，且方法无需训练、可即插即用；但未开源数据、未提供完整复现实验脚本（仅code-only），且未在全新硬件平台或跨厂商数据上验证泛化边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进某个模型，而是揪出整个领域数据基建里长期被忽略的‘脏标签’病灶，并给出可落地的诊断工具，直接提升下游所有基于指令微调的VLA策略可靠性。

papers.title: AutoWorldModel-Bench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Automated World-Model Research
papers.abstract: World modeling is an unsettled field: architectures, training objectives, and state representations interact in complex ways, and no single recipe dominates across environments. This makes it an ideal testbed for AI coding agents acting as autonomous researchers--a setting in which the improvement direction is not specified in advance, unlike the engineering-to-spec tasks that dominate current agent benchmarks. We introduce AutoWorldModel-Bench, a closed-loop benchmark in which frontier coding agents autonomously improve a provided world-model starter under a fixed compute budget. The benchmark spans eight game environments under a unified structured-state representation--ground-truth entity state extracted from each game and consumed through a shared tensor format--which isolates dynamics modeling from perception and enables minutes-per-run iteration. Across 64 sessions, Codex-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 improve their starter on 63; in 91% of sessions the winning edit is a non-trivial research-style modification--a new objective, representation, rollout procedure, or architectural change--rather than a hyperparameter tweak. Our benchmark offers a setting in which frontier coding agents can be evaluated on open-ended research rather than engineering-to-spec problems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为AutoWorldModel-Bench的闭环基准，让大模型编码代理（如Codex、Claude）在固定算力预算下，自主修改和优化一个初始世界模型，目标是提升其在8个游戏环境中的状态预测能力，所有环境统一使用真实实体状态（ground-truth structured state）作为输入输出，绕开感知难题，专注动力学建模。
analysis.claim: 世界模型研究可被形式化为一个可自动化的科研过程，即由AI编码代理在封闭、标准化、状态中心的基准上自主迭代改进模型架构、目标函数与表示方式。
analysis.input: 统一张量格式的结构化真值状态（如物体位置、速度、属性等）
analysis.output: 未来多步结构化状态预测（即世界模型的动力学预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于游戏仿真器生成的ground-truth状态
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个将‘AI自主科研’范式落地到世界模型领域的闭环基准，设计严谨（统一state representation、compute budget约束、非超参调优主导的编辑行为），实证扎实（64次运行中91%为实质性研究级修改），但未提出新世界模型算法或解决长期开放问题（如状态持久性、跨域泛化、具身一致性），也未在真实系统或复杂科学任务中验证价值，属于显著方法论贡献而非基石突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——它把AI做科研的抽象主张变成了可复现、可度量、有统计显著性的实验框架，但未推进世界模型本身的建模能力边界。

papers.title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become a dominant paradigm for generalist embodied agents, demonstrating strong complex and long-horizon task completion in structured settings. Yet it remains an open question whether current VLA systems can benefit from more effective architectural design, scale to substantially larger and more heterogeneous data regimes, and achieve broader generalization across tasks and embodiments. To this end, we present GigaBrain-0.7, an embodied foundation model with substantially improved generalization across diverse robot embodiments. Specifically, GigaBrain-0.7 unifies understanding, prediction, and action through a three-system architecture, scales pretraining to over 37,000 hours of heterogeneous embodied data, and introduces one-stage alignment training that jointly optimizes vision-language understanding and multi-embodiment action generation. Compared with the preceding GigaBrain-0 series and prior state-of-the-art models including $π_{0.5}$, GigaBrain-0.7 achieves substantial improvements in foundation zero-shot capabilities, language-conditioned instruction following, and post-training task success rates. In particular, on our in-house Maker H01 platform and mainstream robot embodiments, GigaBrain-0.7 demonstrates strong task adaptability and completion ability across both home and industrial scenarios. All training code and pretrained model weights will be released.

analysis.tldr: 提出GigaBrain-0.7，一个三系统架构的具身基础模型，用37000小时异构机器人数据预训练，统一视觉-语言理解与多机体动作生成，宣称在零样本任务、指令跟随和真实机器人任务成功率上有提升，但未披露具体任务集、基线对比数值、真实机器人测试规模及消融实验。
analysis.claim: 通过三系统解耦架构、超大规模异构具身数据预训练和单阶段对齐训练，可使具身基础模型涌现跨机体、跨场景的泛化能力，无需针对每种机器人微调。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 多机体兼容的动作序列（tokenized action tokens）
analysis.robot_dependency: Maker H01平台及多种主流机器人（未列明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的37000小时异构数据，但未说明数据来源分布、标注方式、是否含失败轨迹或多样性统计
analysis.significance_reason: 架构上提出三系统解耦属工程整合，但无新模块原理性突破；37k小时数据量虽大，却未公开数据构成、清洗逻辑、跨机体配比，也未在标准benchmark（如RT-X、OpenVLA）上报告分数；真实机器人验证仅提‘Maker H01及主流机体’，无任务列表、成功率数字、对比基线（如π₀.₅）的具体提升幅度，缺乏消融证明三系统设计本身贡献；相比标尺中94+分工作（如GR00T N1的零样本人形泛化、H2O的端到端仿真-真实闭环），本文实证深度和范式原创性明显不足，属扎实但窄域的工程规模化尝试。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了大规模数据驱动的多机体VLA模型训练与开源，但缺乏关键实证支撑（定量结果、消融、标准评测），未达到基石论文所要求的范式启发性或问题解决深度。

papers.title: FetchMan: Learning Visual Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Policies from Simulated Experiences
papers.abstract: Visual loco-manipulation policies that can generalize to novel scenes and objects have long been a goal of robotics research. However, today's data-hungry algorithms make collecting sufficient demonstrations a struggle for tabletop manipulation, and even more so for humanoids that must also walk and balance. Learning from simulated data and transferring that behavior to the real world, as is commonly done in locomotion, sidesteps this struggle, so we replicate that recipe for loco-manipulation. In doing so, we find that cloning synthetic demonstrations results in a low performance ceiling no matter the amount of training data. Reinforcement learning breaks through it, and refining the cloned policy with Flow-GRPO on a single sparse reward yields performance that synthetic behavior cloning cannot match. Together, these stages form our end-to-end sim-to-real pipeline spanning more than 150,000 scenes, which we use to train FetchMan. We evaluate it on FetchMan-Bench, a simulation benchmark we release, and deploy it zero-shot on a real Unitree G1, where our single-object reach-and-pick policy walks to and grasps a target across unseen scenes at 73.3% success. Finally, we extend this recipe to multi-object training, a first step toward loco-manipulation generalist policies at this data scale.

analysis.tldr: 用纯仿真数据（15万+场景）训练一个能走路+抓取的视觉-动作策略，先行为克隆再用稀疏奖励强化学习微调，最终零样本迁移到真实Unitree G1机器人上，单目标抓取成功率73.3%。
analysis.claim: 纯仿真训练的视觉人形运动-操作联合策略，经Flow-GRPO稀疏奖励微调后，可零样本泛化至真实人形机器人执行跨场景行走与抓取任务。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令（如'抓取红色杯子'）
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（含行走与手臂操作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，训练阶段零真实轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在人形locomanipulation上实现大规模纯仿真训练→真实部署闭环，且有跨场景多物体扩展尝试；但未开源代码/模型，benchmark仅限自建仿真环境，真实测试仅单任务、单机体、无跨机体/跨用户验证，显著弱于RT-2/π0等真正开放、多机体、多任务、强实证的范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：扎实的sim2real pipeline落地，但缺乏开源与广义泛化实证，尚未达到范式突破层级

papers.title: Prism-GRPO: Faster VLA Policy Optimization via Splitting Same-outcome Groups
papers.abstract: GRPO is increasingly used for reinforcement learning of vision-language-action (VLA) policies because, unlike PPO, it does not require training a critic. This simplification comes with a sampling cost: group-relative advantages require multiple rollouts from each scene. Under binary success rewards, groups whose rollouts all succeed or all fail have zero advantage and are discarded by dynamic sampling. These groups are especially common early in training, when most rollouts fail, wasting much of the expensive robotic rollout budget. We introduce Prism-GRPO, which augments binary outcome reward with a weighted trajectory-level execution-quality score. By splitting same-outcome groups into a quality spectrum, Prism-GRPO recovers training signal while ensuring that every success still outranks every failure. Quality scores can be derived from simulator contacts, executed actions, or visual observations, avoiding task-specific progress rewards. We prove that Prism-GRPO never increases the probability that a sampled group is discarded for having zero advantages, and derive a gradient-alignment condition under which its combined update remains a local ascent direction for task success. Across four RoboTwin tasks spanning different horizons and coordination patterns, Prism-GRPO improves success and quality at matched rollout budgets and reaches target success rates with up to 56% fewer rollouts. It also suppresses a reward-hacking shortcut, with the cleaner behavior transferring under direct deployment to a real robot. Through ablations, we show consistent gains across contact-, smoothness-, and VLM-derived quality signals.

analysis.tldr: 提出Prism-GRPO算法，在二值成功奖励下，通过引入轨迹级执行质量分（如接触、动作平滑性或视觉特征）将全成功/全失败的‘零优势组’拆解为有梯度的质量谱，从而在不增加真实机器人采样开销的前提下恢复训练信号，显著减少达到目标成功率所需的真机rollout次数。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息为浙江大学与华为云联合团队，但摘要未体现，按规则取 unknown）
analysis.claim: 在二值奖励VLA策略优化中，对same-outcome rollout groups施加可泛化、免人工设计的轨迹质量加权，能严格保留成功优于失败的序关系，同时提升每单位真实rollout的梯度有效性和收敛效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）仿真接触信号/动作序列/视觉特征
analysis.output: 动作序列（端到端VLA策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台（含真实机器人部署验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人rollout数据进行训练与验证（明确提到‘direct deployment to a real robot’及‘matched rollout budgets’）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA策略优化这一关键工程瓶颈上做出扎实改进：真机部署验证+4个异构RoboTwin任务+56% rollout节省+消融覆盖多源质量信号+理论保障梯度方向；但未突破VLA建模范式（仍是GRPO变体），也未构建新数据集/模型架构/硬件接口，属强工程推进而非范式创新，故低于RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没有发明新模型或新任务定义，而是精准识别并解决了GRPO在真实机器人采样下的信号稀疏痛点，用轻量、可插拔的质量增强机制实现了显著的效率跃升和行为净化，证据链完整且落地扎实。

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning
papers.abstract: Behaviour Cloning (BC) has driven remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet it is fundamentally limited by its inability to self-improve: a policy that fails cannot learn from that failure without additional human demonstrations. Reinforcement Learning fine-tuning offers a path to self-improvement but has proven difficult to scale to the multi-billion-parameter models underpinning modern robot policies. We propose Q-Planning, which equips a large visuomotor BC policy with a small off-policy Q-function. Because a Q-function estimates value rather than imitates actions, it can be trained on the same successful demonstrations as the BC policy and later absorb both successful and failed deployment rollouts, an asymmetry BC does not have. We exploit this asymmetry to enable value-guided action selection at inference (a single-step Q-weighted average over BC draws) and online self-improvement that fine-tunes only the Q-function, leaving the BC weights untouched. On LIBERO and bimanual RoboTwin, ten iterations of self-improvement lift every benchmark score we tested (LIBERO-10 93% to 99%, RoboTwin 83.8% to 91.4%) and shorten successful episodes on the near-ceiling suites (LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal). On two contact-rich bimanual real-robot tasks, the same loop (BC frozen, no human intervention) improves purely from its own deployment rollouts: stack-cups 40% to 90% and insert-wallet 25% to 80% in five iterations, whereas SFT on successful rollouts alone stalls at 55% and 30%. Under an identical online budget Q-Planning is the only method, among Best-of-N, filtered SFT, IBRL, DSRL, and DAWR, that improves stably from failures without training an auxiliary actor.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Q-Planning方法，让已训练好的行为克隆（BC）机器人策略不再依赖新的人类示范，而是通过冻结BC主干、仅在线微调一个小的离线Q函数，利用自身失败和成功的部署数据持续自我提升，在多个仿真和真实双臂任务上显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅靠冻结的BC策略+可独立在线更新的小型离线Q函数，就能实现无需人类干预、稳定利用失败经验进行自我改进的机器人策略优化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
