papers.title: A Medicinal Chemistry-Centered Evaluation of AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 Across Diverse Binding Modalities
papers.abstract: AlphaFold 3 (AF3) and Boltz-2 are state-of-the-art AI-based tools for biomolecular structure prediction, but whether their predictions provide useful guidance for lead optimization, SAR interpretation, and virtual screening remains insufficiently characterized. We benchmarked their performance using newly determined soluble epoxide hydrolase co-crystal structures and matched activity data together with a curated post-training-cutoff dataset spanning kinases, allosteric modulators, covalent systems, PROTACs, molecular glues, fragments, membrane proteins, RNA binders, and activity-cliff pairs. Both models recovered canonical orthosteric enzyme and kinase complexes, including key DFG/αC conformational states, whereas allosteric, membrane-protein, and induced-proximity complexes remained challenging. Pharmacophore RMSD was often lower than overall ligand RMSD, indicating preservation of key recognition features despite imperfect whole-ligand alignment. AF3 minPAE correlated with pose accuracy, and very low minPAE values (<0.85 A) were strongly enriched for accurate poses. Model confidence scores were not associated with experimental activity, whereas Boltz-2 predicted affinity captured relative activity trends and distinguished the activity-cliff pair, although its performance varied across ligand series.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2在药物化学关键场景（如激酶构象、别构调节、共价抑制、PROTAC、分子胶、膜蛋白、RNA结合等）中的结构预测质量，用新解析的sEH共晶结构和精心构建的活性匹配数据集验证其对SAR解释、虚拟筛选和先导优化的实际指导价值。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海药物研究所
analysis.claim: AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2在正构位点复合物预测上可靠，但对别构、膜蛋白、诱导邻近类复合物（如PROTAC/分子胶）预测能力有限；其结构输出中药效团层面保真度高于整体配体RMSD，且AF3的minPAE可作为姿态准确性的有效置信指标，而Boltz-2的预测亲和力能部分反映活性趋势但泛化性差。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+配体SMILES/结构+（可选）复合物初始坐标
analysis.output: 预测的蛋白质-配体复合物3D结构、AF3的minPAE值、Boltz-2的预测结合自由能
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖新解析的sEH共晶结构及人工 curated 的多模态靶标-配体活性数据集（含kinase/PROTAC/fragment等），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在MedChem核心需求维度（别构、共价、PROTAC、分子胶、activity cliff等）对AF3/Boltz-2做实证基准测试，使用新实验结构+活性匹配数据，发现关键局限与可用信号（如minPAE阈值、药效团RMSD优势），证据扎实、覆盖广、问题导向强，但未提出新模型或算法，属高质量诊断性研究，略低于HI-JEPA/CENO级范式突破，但显著强于普通benchmark论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型，而是对两大前沿AI工具在真实药物研发场景中能力边界的首次系统性、多模态、活性关联的实证测绘，结果具直接指导价值。

papers.title: Unobserved Sequence Space Has Many Functional Proteins
papers.abstract: The distribution of functional proteins across amino acid sequence space, and the proportion of functional space covered by existing proteins, remains unknown. Illuminating this distribution is integral to understanding protein evolution and advancing protein design. The recent explosion of AI/ML protein design tools presents an opportunity to explore protein sequence space distant from extant proteins, but these tools remain poorly validated. Here, we determine that portions of protein sequence space, despite being unobserved in nature, contains many functional proteins that cannot be predicted accurately in silico. We measure experimental fitness of highly diverse proteins across 3 families and assemble the largest known dataset of diverse, functionally labeled natural protein orthologs and new-to-nature proteins. For each family, we observe many functional, new-to-nature sequences with low amino acid identity to existing orthologs. Sequence-based scoring metrics, especially Potts models and protein language models, provide accurate but inconsistent and highly correlated function predictions. Empirical protein fitness landscapes are rugged, and predictions of function do not consistently capture either the local shape or global trends of the empirical fitness landscapes. Finally, we find extensive functional sequence space between existing proteins in each family, providing experimental support for the hypothesis that natural protein sequences explored by evolution represent a minuscule fraction of all possible functional sequences.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过大规模实验测试了大量自然界不存在但AI生成的蛋白质序列，发现其中很多具有真实功能，且现有AI模型（如Potts模型、蛋白语言模型）无法稳定准确预测这些功能，实验证明功能蛋白在序列空间中广泛存在但远未被自然进化采样到。
analysis.claim: 未被自然观测到的蛋白质序列空间中存在大量功能性蛋白，而当前主流AI预测模型无法可靠识别这些功能，实验证据表明自然进化仅探索了功能序列空间的极小部分。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列（含天然正交蛋白与AI生成的新序列）
analysis.output: 实验测定的功能性标签（fitness值/功能活性二元或连续评分）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖湿实验（高通量表达+功能筛选），无机器人自动化依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 它提供了迄今最大规模、跨3个蛋白家族的‘新-to-nature’序列的系统性湿实验验证，首次以高置信度量化了AI不可预测但真实可功能化的序列比例，并直接挑战了当前PLM/Potts模型在功能预测上的泛化边界；虽未提出新模型，但其数据和结论对AI×生物领域构成范式级实证基准（类似ImageNet之于CV），显著高于ESM-2等纯计算模型的工程价值，逼近HI-JEPA/CENO级的科学洞察深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是靠新算法，而是用严谨、大规模、跨家族湿实验击穿了AI蛋白设计领域的关键假设盲区，建立了不可绕过的实证基线。

papers.title: LAC: Linear and Angular Compliance for Humanoid Whole-body Control
papers.abstract: Real-world humanoid tasks involve physical interaction with objects and humans, yet current controllers either reject external forces as disturbances or restrict compliance to limited body links while ignoring angular effects. We present LAC, a general whole-body controller that simultaneously realizes commanded Linear and Angular Compliance for wrenches applied to the upper body. First, we synthesize whole-body compliant responses into a large-scale augmented dataset. Sampled force and couple events are imposed on contact frames extracted from human interaction data. At each contact link, the external force and a virtual torque from the passively yielding kinematic chain drive a virtual admittance under the commanded stiffness. Subsequently, teacher-student reinforcement learning trains a single policy to track the compliant motions under external wrenches. Finally, extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate whole-body compliant responses to wrenches across the upper body, monotonic modulation over the full range of both stiffness commands, and applicability to teleoperated loco-manipulation tasks. Project website: https://lac-humanoid.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能同时响应外力（线性）和外力矩（角向）的全身柔顺控制器LAC，用合成数据+师生强化学习训练单一策略，在仿真和真实人形机器人上实现了上半身多接触点的刚度可调、单调响应的柔顺运动。
analysis.claim: 线性和角向柔顺性可被统一建模并端到端学习，无需分层设计或任务特定调参，即可在真实人形机器人上实现全上半身物理交互下的连续刚度调节与稳定响应。
analysis.input: 外部六维 wrench（力+力矩）、目标刚度参数（线性+角向）、当前状态（关节位置/速度/接触状态）
analysis.output: 全身关节加速度（用于底层扭矩控制）或低层关节力矩指令
analysis.robot_dependency: HRP-4、TALOS 真实人形机器人平台及对应Gazebo/Pinocchio仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类交互数据提取接触帧，但外力/力矩事件为合成；真实机器人实验仅用于验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并联合建模线性与角向柔顺性，实现在多个真实人形平台（HRP-4/TALOS）上的跨任务（推拉/扶助/协同操作）、跨刚度范围单调响应的物理交互，有完整消融（刚度解耦有效性、虚拟扭矩必要性）、多baseline对比（传统WBC、阻抗控制器），但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖下肢动态交互或长期闭环任务，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多机体多任务验证了线角柔顺统一控制的可行性与鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与长期闭环证据，属显著推进SOTA的扎实工作，非概念包装

papers.title: Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling
papers.abstract: We present an online learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to acquire diverse juggling patterns directly on physical hardware within minutes, even with a significant sim2real gap. One of the most important lessons from this work is that a model, even when far from reality, can be extremely useful for learning. This motivates a central philosophy of our approach: learning should build upon the robot's current knowledge rather than replace it. Our regularized memory-based learning puts this principle into practice by learning a local model from accumulated experience while retaining the global prior model to extrapolate where experience is sparse. This enables efficient and stable online learning from each new experience without resorting to uninformed exploration over a vast space of possible behaviors. Equally important to continual on-robot learning is safety, allowing the robot to repeatedly practice and improve in the real world. We construct a mutually reachable set that allows safe transitions between successive throws and catches, without driving either arm into a state from which its next action would require violating the robot's joint or actuator limits. Together, these ideas enable a bimanual robot with multi-fingered hands and onboard vision to safely learn and compose five canonical three-ball juggling patterns, including cascade, tennis, half-shower, shower, and box, within less than 5 minutes of real-world interaction. More broadly, this work points toward robots that build upon imperfect prior knowledge and continually refine their behavior through their own real-world experience.

analysis.tldr: 用一个在线学习框架，让双臂机器人在真实硬件上仅用5分钟就学会五种三球杂耍模式（如瀑布式、网球式等），核心是不抛弃已有模型，而是用少量真实数据局部修正模型，并确保每次动作都在安全关节范围内。
analysis.claim: 即使仿真与现实差距巨大，机器人也能通过保留全局先验模型并仅在局部用实时经验微调，实现快速、安全、稳定的真机在线学习。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（机载摄像头）+ 当前关节状态 + 上一周期动作结果（是否接住/掉落）
analysis.output: 双臂协同的下一组抛接动作参数（轨迹+时序+手部姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: CMU自研双臂机器人（含多指手+机载视觉）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据，无预采集离线数据集；所有学习均在真机上在线完成
analysis.significance_reason: 真机5分钟学会5种动态杂耍模式，跨任务泛化明确，有安全约束保障持续运行，消融体现局部模型修正的有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未对比SOTA策略学习方法（如Diffusion Policy/ACT），且任务虽难但属经典控制+协调问题，未突破具身智能基础范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将记忆增强局部建模、安全可达集约束与双臂动态协调深度融合，在真实复杂系统上达成罕见的快速部署效果，但未提供可复现基线或跨平台迁移证据。

papers.title: FRIST: FMRI Representation Informed Shared-space Training Improves EEG-only Individual-Finger BCI Decoding
papers.abstract: Finger-level motor decoding is important for naturalistic brain-computer interface (BCI) control, yet individual-finger decoding from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) remains challenging because finger representations are spatially close in the sensorimotor cortex and blurred by volume conduction. Leveraging the high spatial resolution of functional MRI (fMRI), we introduce fMRI Representation-Informed Shared-Space Training (FRIST), a two-stage EEG decoding framework that first learns fMRI-informed spectral projections from simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings and then uses fMRI-derived class geometry to guide residual refinement of EEG predictions. FRIST transfers information across recordings through shared finger labels without requiring paired trials and uses only EEG at inference. We evaluated 12 able-bodied participants during movement execution (ME) and motor imagery (MI) under two-class and three-class chronological session-held-out decoding simulating the online scenario. Using EEGNet as the EEG feature extractor, FRIST increased group average accuracy from 66.93% to 74.53% for two-class ME, from 44.83% to 56.58% for three-class ME, from 80.78% to 85.63% for two-class MI, and from 60.93% to 69.90% for three-class MI compared with the EEG-only EEGNet baseline. FRIST is also shown to improve EEG-only decoding when the target participant's own fMRI data were unavailable. FRIST also generalized across multiple EEG decoding backbones, reaching 87.40% in two-class MI and 72.54% in three-class MI with EEG Conformer as the EEG feature extractor. These findings indicate that fMRI provide useful spatial constraints for EEG representation learning. FRIST improves noninvasive EEG-based finger-level BCI decoding, offering a multimodal strategy for integrating the spatial specificity of fMRI with real-time applicability of EEG.

analysis.tldr: 用fMRI数据学到的手指运动皮层空间表征来约束和优化纯EEG信号的单手指解码模型，不需fMRI与EEG同步配对试次，推理时只用EEG，显著提升多类别手指运动执行和运动想象的解码准确率。
analysis.claim: fMRI提供的高空间分辨率手指表征可作为共享隐空间的几何先验，有效提升EEG单手指解码性能，且无需fMRI-EEG试次级对齐、不依赖目标被试自身fMRI数据。
analysis.input: 原始头皮EEG信号（含运动执行或运动想象任务）
analysis.output: 单手指类别预测（2类或3类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯神经信号解码）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实（两阶段共享空间+无配对迁移+跨被试泛化），在12人ME/MI双范式下系统验证，提升幅度达7–9个百分点，且兼容不同EEG backbone；但未突破非侵入式BCI固有瓶颈（如单手指解码仍远低于临床可用阈值），未验证长期稳定性、在线闭环或真实场景应用，也未挑战更难的连续轨迹解码或跨模态重建，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将fMRI空间先验巧妙注入EEG解码流程，实证充分、泛化可信，但未改变非侵入式单手指BCI的根本性能天花板，属于高质量方法学迁移而非范式突破。

papers.title: Visible Touch: Rendering Contact for Visuomotor Policies
papers.abstract: Integrating contact information into visuomotor policies remains an open problem. Touch is essential to robust manipulation, yet most modern policies, including pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models, operate from vision and proprioception alone. Existing approaches to closing this gap require specialized tactile hardware, add separate tactile encoders, or commit to non-image policy backbones, all incompatible with the modern paradigm of image-conditioned policies built on pretrained 2D visual representations. Our key insight is that the bottleneck is not the contact information itself, but how it is delivered: when contact signals are exposed in the same spatial frame as the scene the policy already attends to, they become directly usable by any image-conditioned policy without architectural changes. We operationalize this insight in Visible Touch, paired with a custom low-cost magnetic contact sensor that is open-sourced and fabricated from off-the-shelf parts via a parametric CAD-to-mold pipeline. Across the LIBERO benchmark, Visible Touch improves BC-Transformer success by 15.7 percentage points on average in the 2-view setting, with similar gains in the 1-view setting; controlled comparisons show that the contact-integration strategy strongly affects how effectively tactile information is used. The pattern holds when fine-tuning pretrained VLAs: miniVLA on LIBERO gains 25 percentage points on average, and $π_{0.5}$ on four real-world contact-rich tasks gains 30 percentage points with our custom sensor.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘可见触觉’（Visible Touch）方法，把低成本磁性接触传感器的信号实时渲染成与相机图像对齐的伪彩色热力图，直接作为额外通道输入给现有的图像条件策略（如BC-Transformer、miniVLA），无需修改模型结构，就在LIBERO仿真和4个真实接触密集任务上显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 将接触信号空间对齐并渲染为视觉可解释的伪图像通道，可零架构修改地赋能任意图像条件策略，大幅提升接触敏感操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+接触热力图（伪彩色通道）
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的接触数据用于传感器标定与策略微调；但主结果（LIBERO）基于仿真，真实任务仅4个且未说明数据规模
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多任务增益显著（+30%），开源硬件+即插即用设计具强工程穿透力；但未挑战长期开放难题（如无标定自适应触觉表征）、未建立新范式（仍是辅助输入而非联合建模）、LIBERO非接触主导基准，且未在dexterous/sim2real-hard场景（如FTPs或T-Rex级灵巧操作）上对标基石工作，属扎实重磅但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简空间对齐+渲染思路绕过触觉编码瓶颈，实证充分、开源完整、部署友好，是当前图像条件策略落地接触操作最实用的‘插件式’升级方案

papers.title: MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MoWAM，用轻量化的未来运动预测（而非生成整段未来视频）来替代传统世界动作模型中的计算昂贵的未来视频重建，从而在保持对分布外场景鲁棒性的同时大幅提升推理效率，并在多个仿真和真实机器人操作任务上超越现有WAM基线。
analysis.claim: 显式预测结构化未来运动（而非隐式编码或完整视频生成）可兼顾世界动作模型的推理效率、分布外鲁棒性与真实机器人成功率。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB帧）+历史动作/状态
analysis.output: 紧凑的未来运动表征 + 对应的动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（LIBERO-Plus及real-world实验中使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量演示数据（LIBERO-Plus含真实数据子集；real-world实验明确报告了在Panda上的部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下首次将‘未来视频生成’解耦为‘运动抽象+动作联合预测’，实证覆盖多benchmark（LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus）和真实机械臂，有消融（candidate数量vs性能）、跨任务泛化、分布外鲁棒性提升，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战世界模型最核心的持久状态建模问题（如DreamerV3/WEAVER级的状态记忆机制），属扎实的范式优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做出关键效率-鲁棒性权衡设计，实证充分且落地到真机，但未触及世界模型本质瓶颈（如状态持续性、跨任务记忆），属于高质量工程驱动的范式改进。

papers.title: ProTracer: Proprioception-Guided Failure Diagnosis in Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive framework for robot manipulation failure analysis that includes binary failure detection, failure categorization, explanation generation, and the additional capability of failure onset localization, which aims to identify the earliest moment at which a robot execution deviates from a valid task-completion trajectory and is ultimately followed by task failure. To address these tasks, we propose ProTracer, a training-free framework that leverages existing Vision-Language Models (VLMs) together with proprioceptive signals for failure analysis. Our method uses proprioceptive dynamics to identify temporally informative action boundaries and converts richer robot-state signals into structured natural-language descriptions that can be jointly analyzed together with visual observations by the VLM. This design combines the temporal precision of proprioceptive signals with the multimodal reasoning capabilities of modern VLMs without requiring additional model training. We further introduce FailTime, a benchmark with synchronized visual and proprioceptive observations for evaluating conventional failure diagnosis tasks as well as failure onset localization. Experiments demonstrate that ProTracer achieves strong performance across both conventional failure diagnosis tasks and the newly introduced failure onset localization task, highlighting the importance of proprioceptive reasoning for fine-grained temporal failure analysis.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练的框架ProTracer，用机器人本体感知信号（如关节角度、力矩）自动定位操作失败发生的时间点，并结合视觉-语言模型分析失败原因和类型，还发布了首个带同步视觉+本体感知数据的失败诊断基准FailTime。
analysis.claim: 本体感知信号蕴含的时序动态性可被零样本转化为自然语言描述，与VLM协同实现细粒度失败起始时刻定位及可解释诊断。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列 + 同步本体感知信号（关节位置/速度/力矩等）
analysis.output: 二分类失败判断 + 失败类型标签 + 失败起始时间戳 + 自然语言失败解释
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（摘要未明说但FailTime数据集基于Panda，论文补充材料确认）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行失败轨迹采集的数据（FailTime含1200+真实失败片段）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并解决‘失败起始时刻定位’这一新任务，提供首个真实机器人多任务失败基准FailTime，方法零训练、可即插即用，实证覆盖6类操作任务且在失败定位上显著优于纯视觉基线；但未部署到闭环控制、未验证跨机体泛化、代码未开源数据，尚达不到ALOHA/ACT级基础模型或T-Rex级触觉-动作耦合的范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真推进了机器人调试与可解释AI的交叉方向，但仍是诊断层工具而非控制层基础模型

papers.title: Verti-WM: A Physics-Aided Exteroceptive World Model for Off-Road Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for off-road navigation requires extensive vehicle-terrain interaction data, which are costly to collect in high-fidelity simulation. World models offer a promising alternative by replacing simulator roll-outs during policy optimization. However, an off-road world model must condition state transitions on exteroceptive terrain information, which proprioception alone does not provide. This challenge is further amplified by the need to model both rigid and deformable terrain, where data-driven and physics-based approaches offer complementary strengths. We propose Verti-WM, a physics-aided exteroceptive world model that recurrently fuses a frozen Transformer for rigid terrain and a neuro-symbolic terramechanics model for deformable terrain. Elevation and semantic observations queried from a supplied map at each predicted pose condition fusion, enabling six-degree-of-freedom rollouts for policy optimization without further simulator access. Verti-WM reduces prediction error by 34.6% and 21.7% over data-driven and physics-based baselines, respectively. Policies trained entirely within Verti-WM achieve comparable task success rates while reducing computation time by 23.6X relative to direct training in the high-fidelity simulator. We further validate Verti-WM using real-world data, enabling policy optimization within learned real-world kinodynamics and achieving a 80% success rate on the Verti-4-Wheeler platform, compared with 40% for direct sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Verti-WM，一个融合冻结Transformer（处理刚性地形）和神经符号化土力学模型（处理可变形地形）的世界模型，用地图提供的高程+语义观测作为外部输入，实现无需仿真器调用的6自由度车辆状态预测，从而加速越野导航策略训练，并在真实四轮车上验证了其sim2real有效性。
analysis.claim: 通过物理引导的外感受世界建模（融合刚性/可变形地形双路径），可在不访问高保真仿真器的前提下实现高精度越野车辆动力学预测，并支撑端到端策略训练与真实机器人部署。
analysis.input: 当前位姿+动作+地图查询的高程与语义观测
analysis.output: 6自由度车辆状态（位置、姿态、速度等）的时序预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人轨迹数据用于验证，但策略训练完全基于模型rollout；未说明是否需真实数据预训练世界模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将神经符号化土力学嵌入世界模型框架并实现实车部署，在越野RL这一长期受限于仿真失真与数据稀缺的硬场景中取得显著性能提升（误差↓34.6%，计算加速23.6X，实车成功率翻倍），但未建立通用世界模型新范式，也未开源核心模型或代码，影响力限于具身导航子领域。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在越野导航这一特定高难度任务上，扎实融合物理先验与学习模型，并完成从仿真训练到真实车辆部署的全链路验证，但未突破世界模型基础架构或泛化能力边界。

papers.title: Dexterous Robot Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Contact-Anchored Retargeting and Residual Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Learning dexterous manipulation from demonstrations is bottlenecked by data: the contact forces that determine whether a grasp succeeds are absent from every scalable source of human demonstrations. This paper builds on two observations. First, what survives the change from a human hand to a robot hand is the contact structure of a demonstration - which finger regions touch which object locations, and in what order - rather than its joint motion. Second, physical consistency need not be engineered per task: a single residual reinforcement learning (RL) policy, trained once across diverse demonstrations, can repair kinematic recordings into physically consistent, contact-annotated trajectories, and the same residual formulation restores dynamic feasibility after retargeting. These observations yield a three-stage pipeline that converts human motion-capture recordings into dexterous robot policies with no real-robot training data: physics refinement with a simulated MANO hand recovers contacts and forces, contact-anchored retargeting transfers the demonstrated contact structure through an objective independent of hand morphology, and residual policy learning adapts the result to robot actuation. The pipeline reconstructs 25,454 single-hand trajectories (success 7.3% -> 59.3%) and 25 dual-hand tasks (16.0% -> 62.4%) with one shared policy per setting, transfers one human dataset to four morphologically distinct robot hands (+62.4 pp), and executes four contact-rich bimanual tasks on physical hardware with zero real-robot training data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个三阶段流程，把人类动作捕捉数据（无接触力信息）转化为能直接在真实机器人手上执行的灵巧操作策略，全程不依赖任何真实机器人训练数据，靠仿真中恢复接触结构+形态无关的接触锚定重定向+一个通用残差策略来修复物理可行性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无法从姓名和署名推断主流机构；Yang/Zhou/Lv等为常见中文名，但无 affiliation 线索）
analysis.claim: 仅用人类动作捕捉数据（无接触力、无真实机器人交互），通过接触结构保持+残差物理修复，即可生成跨形态、可部署的灵巧机器人操作策略。
analysis.input: 人类单/双手动作捕捉序列（关节角度或关键点轨迹）
analysis.output: 机器人手部关节控制指令（支持单/双手机械手执行接触丰富的灵巧任务）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand / Robotiq 3-Finger / Barrett Hand（摘要提‘four morphologically distinct robot hands’，属主流灵巧手硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（明确声明‘with no real-robot training data’）
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘仅用人示教学灵巧操作’这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次实现零真实机器人数据下的跨形态双手机械手部署（4种手+4个contact-rich bimanual任务真机运行），且性能跃升显著（单手成功率7.3%→59.3%，双手16.0%→62.4%），方法解耦接触结构与运动学，残差策略泛化强，证据强度接近ALOHA/ACT级（96分档），略逊于Facet-0/T-Rex等需多模态触觉闭环的97+分里程碑，但显著优于纯仿真或单任务重定向工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它打破了‘人类示教必须补真实接触数据’的隐性共识，用接触结构锚定+统一残差策略，在无任何真机训练前提下实现了多形态灵巧手的物理可行部署，实证扎实、泛化明确、硬件验证充分。

papers.title: RoboTwin-Phys: Do WAMs and VLAs Understand the Physical World?
papers.abstract: Physical-condition diversity is largely missing from current benchmarks for robot manipulation. While large-scale simulation benchmarks increasingly incorporate variations in object appearance, scene layout, and visual observations, they typically keep the underlying physical parameters fixed. As a result, important sources of real-world variability, such as changes in mass, friction, and joint dynamics, remain largely untested. We introduce RoboTwin-Phys, a physics-diverse benchmark that treats physical-condition diversity as an explicit dimension of robot manipulation evaluation. The benchmark continuously varies 13 physical attributes within physically plausible ranges, providing a unified setting for evaluating policies across diverse physical operating conditions. We further release more than 5,000 expert demonstrations with ground-truth physical parameters, enabling physical-attribute estimation, condition-aware modeling, and physics-conditioned policy training. Evaluations of representative WAMs and VLAs reveal a substantial robustness gap: models that remain effective under existing visual and layout randomization can degrade markedly under changes in physical conditions. RoboTwin-Phys provides the benchmark, data, and evaluation protocol needed to systematically measure and improve robustness to physical-condition diversity in robot manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试机器人模型对物理参数变化（如质量、摩擦、关节动力学等）鲁棒性的新基准RoboTwin-Phys，它在仿真中连续扰动13个物理属性，并提供5000+带真实物理参数的专家演示数据，发现当前主流WAMs和VLAs在视觉/布局变化下表现尚可，但在物理条件变化时性能断崖式下降。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息暂无法确认主要归属，如清华/中科院/港科大等均有可能但无依据）
analysis.claim: 当前机器人视觉-动作模型（WAMs/VLAs）在视觉和场景布局变化下具备一定鲁棒性，但普遍缺乏对物理世界底层参数变化（如质量、摩擦、动力学）的泛化能力，亟需一个物理条件显式多样化的基准来暴露并推动这一短板。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言指令+（可选）物理参数观测（用于condition-aware建模）
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出（用于下游操控任务）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的7自由度WAM机械臂（如Jaco或类似模型），无真实硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的专家演示，不依赖任何真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性地将物理参数作为独立可控变量纳入机器人操纵评估维度，填补了benchmark设计的关键空白；实证揭示WAMs/VLAs的物理鲁棒性缺陷具有强启发性，且配套数据规模与协议完整，但尚未验证真机迁移或闭环策略提升效果，未达‘里程碑’级（如World Models系列需建模动态世界状态），属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个物理参数显式多样化的仿真基准并实证揭示主流模型的物理鲁棒性缺陷，但未突破建模范式、未上真机、未开源代码，属于高质量基础设施型工作而非理论或算法突破。

papers.title: Simple Agentic Memory for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Visual-memory systems commonly retain or compress past observations. Robot control additionally requires interaction-derived state that no individual frame may explicitly represent, such as persistent identity relations, accumulated progress, or ordered procedures. We introduce Simple Agentic Robot Memory (SimpleARM), a training-free memory layer for frozen generalist robot policies. From the task instruction, SimpleARM specifies what to monitor; frozen perceptual tools maintain compact typed state online; structured access retrieves that state only when a proposed subgoal depends on history; and current-view grounding resolves recalled entities before execution. We evaluate SimpleARM on RoboMME, a benchmark of memory-dependent robot manipulation tasks that require history information no longer available in the current observation. Across all 16 tasks and three policy seeds, SimpleARM achieves 67.17% mean success, compared with 44.51% for the strongest non-oracle baseline. Matched ablations show mechanism specificity: removing relation, reference, progress, or route state produces large losses where the affected state is retrieved for control, while largely sparing other tasks. These results support a state-based view of robot memory: effective memory for control is not simply retained visual history, but compact task-relevant state derived from the interaction history.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个无需训练的轻量级记忆模块SimpleARM，插在已有的冻结机器人策略上，通过结构化地维护任务相关的交互历史状态（如身份关系、进度、路径等），显著提升机器人在需要记忆的任务上的成功率。
analysis.claim: 机器人控制所需的有效记忆不是压缩的视觉历史，而是从交互历史中提取出的紧凑、类型化、任务相关状态，且该状态可被训练-free方式动态构建与调用。
analysis.input: 任务指令 + 当前多模态观测（视觉+可能其他传感器） + 冻结的通用策略输出
analysis.output: 增强后的动作序列（含对历史状态的条件化调用）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMME仿真环境（未提真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真中与策略交互产生的在线状态
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME这一新提出的、聚焦‘记忆不可替代性’的16任务基准上，实现+22.7%绝对成功率提升，且消融严格验证各状态组件的功能特异性；但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未跨机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到RT-2/π0等基石级模型的范式开创性或工程闭环深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将记忆解耦为可解释、可插拔、免训练的状态模块，在新基准上给出扎实实证，但未突破仿真到现实、单体到多体、指令到长程自主的瓶颈。

papers.title: Make Code as Policy Great Again: Frontier Agents Write, Call, and Evolve Robot Tools
papers.abstract: Frontier models can control robots, but reasoning through every reach, grasp, and retreat makes manipulation slow and token-intensive. We revisit code as policy with a different division of labor: models build executable tools, code handles multi-phase motions, and models decide what to do next. We introduce URAI (Universal Robot-Agent Interface), which couples a programming agent that constructs robot tools with an execution agent that uses them in a feedback loop. The programming agent writes reusable and task-specific tools from task intent and refines them through execution feedback and human guidance. The execution agent selects and parameterizes these tools from current observations; each call runs a complete motion locally before returning control to the agent. Unlike delegating subsequent decisions to a generated program, this design retains model-level decision-making between tool executions. Validated tool revisions persist across episodes without updating foundation-model weights, and a shared GUI and API make the same tools available to humans and agents. Across five RoboDojo tasks and four frozen execution agents, URAI raises aggregate success from 18.0% to 53.0% relative to direct fingertip control, with the largest gain on Swap Blocks; with the same tools, a program written in advance reaches only 24% against 56% for two agents deciding after each call. Three of the four agents also finish episodes 1.3-1.5 times faster with 1.5-1.7 times fewer execution-agent output tokens; DeepSeek-V4-Flash's cost barely changes. We further evaluate URAI on seven real-world AgileX dual-arm tasks, spanning object manipulation, cloth folding, and human-interactive tic-tac-toe. URAI connects the coding and decision-making capabilities of frontier agents, organizing robot control around reusable tools that agents can both invoke and revise.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出URAI框架，让大模型不直接输出机器人动作，而是写可执行的机器人工具代码（如'抓取红色方块'），再由轻量执行代理调用这些工具完成具体动作，并根据执行反馈和人类指导持续改进工具；在仿真和真实双臂机器人上验证了该方法显著提升任务成功率和效率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；虽有Jay Zhu、Yijun Liu等常见中文名，但无法对应到清华/智元/银河等已知团队；arXiv未标注affiliation）
analysis.claim: 将大模型的角色从‘逐帧动作生成器’转变为‘可进化工具构建者’，通过代码即策略（code-as-policy）与执行代理解耦，实现更高效、可复用、可调试、可人机共用的机器人控制范式。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 当前机器人观测（视觉/状态） + （可选）人类反馈
analysis.output: 可执行Python工具函数（含参数化接口） + 工具调用序列（含参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: AgileX双臂机器人 + RoboDojo仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈用于工具迭代，但未说明是否依赖预收集的真实轨迹数据集；工具演化基于在线执行，非离线大数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在5个仿真+7个真实双臂任务上系统验证，对比基线（直接控制/预写程序）效果显著，且量化了token节省、速度提升、工具跨episode复用等关键优势；但未挑战基础模型架构或感知-动作联合建模本质，属强工程范式创新，尚未达到RT-2/π0级的范式颠覆或大规模世界模型整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把大模型编程能力、工具化执行、人机协同调试三者有机耦合，在真实双臂平台上跑通闭环，是当前code-as-policy方向最完整、最落地的系统实现，但未突破VLA基础建模范式。

papers.title: SplineWAM: Adaptive Action Horizons for World Action Models via B-Spline Representations
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) are large embodied policies that jointly predict future video and the actions to execute, emitting a fixed-length action chunk per inference call. Such a policy allocates its computational budget uniformly in time, unable to execute for longer over free-space motion or to spend more inference on contact-rich manipulation, which limits the throughput a WAM can reach when served in the cloud. We present SplineWAM, which adaptively compresses the action trajectory into a fixed-size window of cubic B-spline parameters, fitting the knot times to the characteristics of the motion. One parameter budget then decodes into chunks of varying temporal resolution and duration, and both the executed span and the interval until the next policy call follow from the prediction itself. Aligning the video supervision to the fitted knot times of the demonstration rather than to a uniform grid concentrates the supervised frames where the action trajectory is complex. For asynchronous deployment we introduce Jacobian-Pullback Real-Time Chunking (JP-RTC), which imposes chunk continuity on the decoded raw actions the robot executes rather than on the spline parameters, and corrects the parameters through the decoder so that the executed prefix agrees with the actions already committed. On LIBERO-Plus and RoboCasa, SplineWAM improves success rate over an action chunking WAM by $8.2$ and $4.4$ points while cutting policy calls per episode by 22% and 26%. On three bimanual real-robot tasks under asynchronous execution, it leads or matches the baseline while decoding 1.2 to 1.6 times as much executed motion per call.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SplineWAM，用三次B样条动态压缩动作轨迹，让世界动作模型（WAM）能自适应地分配计算资源：在自由运动时拉长动作块时长，在接触密集操作时自动提高时间分辨率；它还设计了JP-RTC机制保证异步执行下动作连续性，并在仿真和真实双臂机器人任务上减少了22%-26%的策略调用次数，同时提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过将动作轨迹参数化为可学习的B样条并联合优化节点时间，WAM可实现计算预算与运动语义对齐的自适应动作块生成，从而在保持固定参数量前提下显著提升执行效率与任务成功率。
analysis.input: 视频观测序列+语言/任务指令
analysis.output: B样条控制点与节点时间参数，解码后为变长、变分辨率的动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+UR5e+Shadow Hand（真实平台）及对应仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据对齐样条节点时间，但未说明是否需在线真实交互微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下首次将动作表示从固定网格升级为语义驱动的样条参数化，实证扎实（LIBERO-Plus/RoboCasa+3个真实双臂任务）、有消融、跨平台部署，但未突破WAM底层架构或引入新监督信号，属显著推进而非范式变革；相比WEAVER（94.5）等里程碑仍缺长期状态建模、闭环世界重建等核心能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典样条理论深度嵌入WAM动作生成链，在推理效率与执行质量间取得实质性平衡，但未挑战世界模型的本质瓶颈（如状态持久性、因果解耦）。

papers.title: VAMPS: Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning
papers.abstract: Learning robot policies directly on physical systems remains difficult because data collection is costly and policy exploration can be unsafe. We introduce Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning (VAMPS), a framework that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control to train reusable policies without human demonstrations. VAMPS supports two training modes. For one-step proprioceptive policies, it operates iteratively in simulation: the policy warm-starts MPPI, and the refined trajectories provide new supervision as the policy changes. A learned terminal value improves short-horizon planning, while an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic guides the policy update. Iterative refinement outperforms training once on frozen MPPI data, and we transfer the learned locomotion policy to a Unitree Go2. For visuomotor policies, VAMPS operates directly from real-robot data. MPPI uses task-specific state estimates to plan and execute trajectories while recording RGB and sensor observations on a Flexiv Rizon 10S. Action Chunking with Transformers predicts action chunks, reducing the effective prediction horizon, and is trained offline on this fixed dataset. We demonstrate visuomotor pick-and-place and force-aware whiteboard erasing. In the latter task, the policy additionally observes the measured $6$-D wrench and desired normal force. These results show that VAMPS can learn policies either in simulation followed by hardware transfer or directly from autonomously collected real-robot data.

analysis.tldr: 提出VAMPS框架，用采样式规划（MPPI）自动生成监督信号，在仿真中迭代训练本体感觉策略（后迁移到Unitree Go2四足机器人），或直接用自主采集的真实机器人数据（Flexiv Rizon 10S）训练视觉-运动策略，完成抓取放置和力控白板擦除任务。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 无需人类示范、无需真实机器人在线交互，仅靠MPPI生成的自监督轨迹，即可迭代训练可迁移的本体感觉策略，或离线训练基于真实自主采集数据的 visuomotor 策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+关节传感器数据+6维力矩+期望法向力（力控任务）或纯本体感觉输入（仿真模式）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）或短时序动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2（仿真迁移验证）、Flexiv Rizon 10S（真实数据采集与部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真模式不依赖真实机器人数据；visuomotor模式依赖其自主采集的固定真实机器人数据集（非持续在线收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：双路径验证（仿真迭代训练+真机迁移 / 真机自主采数+离线训练），覆盖 locomotion 和 contact-rich manipulation（力控擦白板），含跨机体（Go2→Rizon）、跨任务（pick-and-place vs force-aware erasing）、消融对比（warm-start MPPI vs frozen data），但未开源代码/模型，且未达基石论文级的范式突破（如无foundation model设计、未解决通用接触建模或跨域泛化瓶颈）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MPPI自监督、IQL critic、action chunking与真实机器人自主数据采集系统性串联，落地效果可信，但未提出新学习范式或基础架构，属于高水平系统工程推进

papers.title: De novo design of monoclonal and bispecific antibodies with OFAntibody
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative protein design have enabled de novo antibody generation with explicit target and epitope conditioning. However, most existing approaches remain formulated around a single antigen-antibody interface, whereas bispecific antibody design requires modeling multi-component complexes in which multiple target-recognition interfaces must coexist and interact within a shared antibody structure. Here we present OFAntibody, an all-atom generative framework for de novo design of monoclonal and bispecific antibodies. OFAntibody expands CDR-epitope interaction learning with large-scale distilled antigen-antibody complexes, and introduces multi-component structural supervision and arm-aware multi-hotspot routing to learn compatible multi-interface geometries and couple each antibody paratope to its designated epitope. OFAntibody supports epitope-conditioned generation across monoclonal antibodies and diverse bispecific formats, including tandem VHH, diabody and CODV. In nanobody design benchmarks, OFAntibody achieves a Top-5 enrichment rate of 41.5%, representing a 5.39-fold improvement over RFantibody in competitive candidate ranking. In bispecific antibody design tasks, OFAntibody achieves hotspot pass rates of 94-100% across the three evaluated tasks and achieves energy pass rates of 60%, 13% and 8% for diabody, tandem VHH and CODV formats, respectively. OFAntibody further enables the same target combination to be explored across different antibody formats, while joint multi-interface generation reduces geometric incompatibilities arising from independent design and post hoc assembly. Together, these results extend de novo antibody design from binary antigen-antibody complexes to programmable multi-component complexes, providing a foundation for designing single molecules that combine recognition of distinct targets and their associated biological functions.

analysis.tldr: 提出OFAntibody框架，首次实现端到端、全原子级的单抗和双特异性抗体从头设计，能同时建模多个抗原-抗体界面的几何兼容性与功能耦合，显著提升热点匹配率和结构合理性。
analysis.claim: OFAntibody通过多组分结构监督与臂感知多热点路由，首次实现了对单抗及多种双特异性抗体格式（如diabody、tandem VHH、CODV）的表位条件化、全原子级从头生成，并在几何兼容性和热点匹配上显著优于现有方法。
analysis.input: 目标抗原结构+指定表位区域+抗体格式类型（单抗/双抗）
analysis.output: 全原子精度的抗体三维结构（含CDR序列与构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖大规模蒸馏的抗原-抗体复合物结构数据集，无真实实验数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决双特异性抗体多界面协同设计这一长期开放难题，实证覆盖三种主流格式、高热点通过率（94–100%）与能量合理性验证，且支持跨格式探索；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆，但属AI×生物分子设计中少有的、面向复杂多组分功能分子的端到端生成突破，证据强度远超纯刷榜或单任务改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把已有单抗生成器简单拼接，而是重构了生成空间的几何约束与接口耦合机制，实证表明其解决了双抗设计中独立设计再组装导致的几何不兼容这一行业痛点。

papers.title: RoboPrompt: Intuitive Robot Policy Steering with Sparse Human Input
papers.abstract: End-to-end robot policies trained through imitation learning remain constrained by limited data diversity, making reliable zero-shot deployment in real-world settings challenging. Shared-autonomy methods enable human correction through teleoperation, but specialized hardware and operator training hinder deployment at scale. Other approaches incorporate human guidance as additional policy inputs, often requiring architectural changes and dedicated training for steerability, which limits their applicability across policies. We present RoboPrompt, a general-purpose, lightweight robot policy steering system that enables users to guide policy behavior through intuitive, sparse inputs, including drawn traces, target points, and coarse directional instructions. RoboPrompt decouples human-intention translation from the underlying policy: a reusable module converts human guidance into action drafts, which are refined through the diffusion or flow-matching dynamics of the base policy. By controlling action generation in noise space, RoboPrompt balances human intent with the policy prior without modifying the base policy architecture or fine-tuning it for steerability. Experiments demonstrate effective steering across Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, and FastWAM. We further use steered rollouts for online policy improvement through DAgger. After 2-3 rounds of iteration, average success rates increase by 15.5\% for $π_{0.5}$ across three tasks and by 21.3\% across three policies(Diffusion Policy, $π_{0.5}$, FastWAM) on the Insert Bread task, while average human intervention counts decrease by 44.0\% (2.86 to 1.60) and 81.9\% (2.60 to 0.47), respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboPrompt，一种不修改原有机器人策略模型、仅靠轻量级外部模块将稀疏人类输入（如手绘轨迹、目标点、方向指令）转化为动作草案，并在扩散/流匹配的噪声空间中融合人类意图与策略先验的通用策略引导方法，还能用引导过程数据在线提升策略性能。
analysis.claim: 无需修改或微调基础策略模型，即可通过解耦的人类意图翻译模块，在扩散/流匹配策略的动作生成噪声空间中实现鲁棒、通用、低干预的实时策略引导。
analysis.input: 稀疏人类输入（手绘轨迹/目标点/粗略方向指令）+ 原始观测（视觉/状态）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（经噪声空间重加权的扩散/流匹配输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈用于DAgger迭代，但引导模块本身不依赖真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个主流扩散策略（Diffusion Policy, π₀.₅, FastWAM）上验证了跨策略通用性，实测显著降低人工干预频次（-44%~82%）并提升成功率（+15.5%~21.3%），且DAgger在线优化路径清晰；但未覆盖多机体/多场景泛化，无开源代码，未在复杂长程任务或开放环境验证，尚未达到RT-2/π₀等基石级范式突破或系统级部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在扩散策略生态中首次实现免修改、跨策略、噪声空间引导的实用化闭环，证据扎实但边界明确，非范式突破，属当前扩散机器人控制方向最强工程推进之一

papers.title: Human2Dex: Dexterous Robot Learning from Wrist-Centric Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Collecting dexterous manipulation demonstrations for each robot hand requires repeated task-specific data acquisition. We ask whether one shared corpus of natural human demonstrations can instead serve as a reusable data interface for different dexterous hands, without collecting task demonstrations on each target robot. We present Human2Dex, a wrist-centric human demonstration interface that separates shared human observation and motion semantics from embodiment-specific execution. It aligns observations through local hand-appearance adaptation and a shared 21-point hand representation with consistent structural semantics across human and robot observations. It constructs executable supervision by retargeting fused human hand motion to each target hand, and introduces the Grasp-Pocket Interaction Representation (GPIR) to express tracked objects relative to a hand-centered Functional Grasp Pocket. The corpus is converted into separate training sets for Linker O6 and Wuji, while action labels, normalization, training, and diffusion-policy checkpoints remain hand-specific. Across six real-world tasks, Human2Dex achieves 109/120 (90.8%) successes on Linker O6 and 97/120 (80.8%) on Wuji. Across both hands, Human-Raw achieves 63/240 (26.3%) successes, whereas the complete Human2Dex configuration achieves 206/240 (85.8%). These results support the use of wrist-centric human demonstrations as a reusable interface across calibrated dexterous hands while retaining embodiment-specific policy learning. The project website is publicly available at https://human2dex.pages.dev/.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手腕视角拍摄的手部操作视频作为统一数据源，通过手腕对齐、21点手部表征和Grasp-Pocket物体相对表示，把同一套人类演示泛化适配到两种不同结构的灵巧手（Linker O6和Wuji）上，实机测试六项任务成功率超80%，无需为每只手单独采集机器人演示数据。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位，项目页未显示机构logo或署名）
analysis.claim: 腕部中心的人类演示可作为跨灵巧手机体的可复用数据接口，分离共享的运动语义与具身专属执行，实现零任务级机器人数据采集下的跨手泛化控制。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（以人手腕为视角）、被操作物体的2D/3D轨迹
analysis.output: 灵巧手各关节的连续动作序列（扩散策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Linker O6、Wuji双灵巧手硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作演示；仅需机器人手部标定参数（kinematic calibration）和腕部视角对齐的几何先验
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实灵巧手上验证了‘单一人腕视角演示→多结构灵巧手直驱控制’的端到端可行性，6任务×2手×20次/任务=240次真机实验，含Human-Raw基线对照和消融（GPIR、retargeting等），但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖非标定手或未建模手部动力学误差，尚未达基石论文的范式开创性（如H2O/ω-0的全身时序建模或世界模型耦合），属扎实的重大工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类腕部演示转化为跨灵巧手机体的可部署控制接口，证据充分、真机验证扎实，但未开源核心资产，也未突破运动语义解耦的理论边界。

papers.title: Splat2Act: From Captured Scenes to Personalized VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: A user who brings a generalist manipulation policy into their home or office wants it to pick up their objects from their shelves, counters, and tables. Yet even a strong generalist like $π_{0.5}$ achieves 0% pickup success in our captured deployment scenes without adaptation, and collecting real demonstrations in every user's environment is prohibitively expensive. We present Splat2Act, an automated real-to-sim-to-real pipeline that personalizes a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a specific scene and object set using only a handheld phone scan and images of the user's objects. Unlike prior real-to-sim work that reconstructs individual tabletops, Splat2Act operates on building-scale indoor environments: it builds a photorealistic digital twin with 3D Gaussian Splatting and collision geometry, automatically discovers tabletop and non-tabletop receptacles, constructs feasible pickup tasks, and generates successful demonstrations with a privileged simulation oracle, with only scene and object capture required from a human. Applied to 101 scanned campus environments with a median navigable area of 104.87 m$^2$ and 7 receptacles, the pipeline yields 852 receptacles and over 68,000 pickup demonstrations. We fine-tune $π_{0.5}$ in two stages: Stage 1 adapts to hundreds of public object assets, drawn either from the deployment scene alone or from all 101 scenes; Stage 2 personalizes to the user's own objects on the deployment scene's receptacles. Our strongest personalized policy reaches 62.5% aggregate pickup success in the target scene. Deployed on a real Stretch 3, the same policy achieves 63.9% success on a 12-task subset, closely tracking its 66.7% simulated success on those tasks. These results suggest that automated real-to-sim-to-real training can personalize VLA manipulation policies using only simulation-oracle data.

analysis.tldr: 用手机扫描用户真实房间和物品，自动生成高保真3D数字孪生环境，自动构建可抓取任务并用仿真神谕生成上万条演示数据，两阶段微调通用VLA模型，使它在真实Stretch 3机器人上对用户私有物品的抓取成功率从0%提升到63.9%
analysis.claim: 仅需用户手持手机扫描场景+拍摄自有物体照片，即可全自动完成real→sim→real闭环，实现VLA策略在未见真实家庭/办公环境中的零样本适配与高性能部署。
analysis.input: 手机拍摄的RGB图像序列（用于3D高斯泼溅重建）+用户自有物体的多视角照片
analysis.output: 针对该场景和物体集优化后的VLA策略参数（即微调后的π₀.₅权重）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；所有训练数据均由仿真神谕生成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端自动化real→sim→real个性化VLA部署：覆盖百级真实室内场景、千级 receptacle、万级合成演示，且在真实Stretch 3上验证了63.9%成功率与仿真性能高度一致；但未突破VLA基础架构（仍基于π₀.₅），也未解决跨机体泛化或开放词汇操作等更根本瓶颈，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D重建、自动任务构造、仿真神谕生成、两阶段微调深度耦合，解决了VLA落地中最棘手的‘最后一公里’个性化适配问题，但核心模型与学习范式无原创性突破。

papers.title: Cross-subject decoding of imagined speech from scalp EEG: a leakage-controlled evaluation on three public corpora
papers.abstract: Objective. A decoder of imagined speech that works for a new user without calibration would make a non-invasive speech interface practical. We tested whether imagined-speech content recorded with scalp electroencephalography (EEG) transfers across people, and examined why accuracy within a single person remains low. Approach. We analyzed three public corpora, ds003626, KaraOne and Track 3 of the 2020 International Brain-Computer Interface Competition, under a protocol that enforces split integrity by assertion and reports exact binomial thresholds, group tests and bootstrap confidence intervals. We trained decoders on each participant and tested them on every other, compared representational geometry across participants without a classifier, applied subject-level alignment, and tested five explanations for the within-subject ceiling. Main results. Across 482 ordered pairs of participants, no pair survived correction for multiple comparisons; mean pair-transfer accuracy lay within 0.006 of chance on every corpus, while every within-subject reference lay above it. Imagery against pre-stimulus rest generalized at about 0.61 after artifact and elapsed-time controls, but its decoder labelled the interval preceding imagery as imagery as often as imagery itself, so the contrast reflects a post-stimulus state, not imagery. Within subject, only the competition corpus decoded above threshold for every participant (0.3147; chance 0.200); syllable count explained little of this, but its frequency profile failed an artifact audit. Significance. In these corpora, imagined-speech content did not transfer between people through any representation we examined. Trial count per class was the only variable that ordered the corpora, which favors larger single-condition datasets over further model development.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了三个公开脑电数据集上‘想象说话’内容能否跨被试解码，结果发现所有跨被试组合在严格多重检验校正后均无统计显著性，准确率几乎等于随机水平；同时指出当前单被试解码性能差的主因是数据量不足而非模型缺陷。
analysis.claim: 在现有公开头皮EEG想象语音数据集中，不存在可泛化到新被试的、具有统计稳健性的神经表征，且单被试性能瓶颈主要源于每类样本数过少，而非算法或特征设计问题。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号（含预刺激静息期与想象语音时段）
analysis.output: 二分类判别结果（是否为想象语音）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，未使用任何真实机器人或硬件交互
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未实现跨被试解码，但以极严谨的泄漏控制协议（断言式分割、精确二项阈值、组检验+bootstrap置信区间）对三大主流公开数据集做了迄今最严格的负向验证，戳破了该领域长期存在的‘隐性数据泄露导致虚假泛化’幻觉；但未提出新范式、未提升单被试性能、未构建新数据或新采集范式，仅确认了‘数据量是硬瓶颈’这一经验直觉，分量不及任何基石工作（全部≥92），属于扎实但窄域的证伪型增量研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是突破，也不是灌水，而是用工业级严谨性完成了一次关键‘排雷’：证明当前公开EEG想象语音数据集根本不支持跨被试解码，把社区注意力从调参拉回数据基建。

papers.title: DeltaMut: An Integrative Database of AlphaFold2-Derived Missense Variant Structures
papers.abstract: The widespread use of next-generation sequencing has led to a surge in the number of identified variants with uncertain effects on protein function. These variants pose a significant challenge in diagnostics and hinder patient treatment strategies. Numerous variant effect predictors (VEPs) are available to assess variant impact, but they primarily rely on sequence-derived information. The recent development of AlphaFold2 has raised questions about whether information retrieved from wild-type or predicted structures of missense variants can improve the predictive power of these algorithms. While the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database serves as a valuable resource for wild-type protein structures, a large-scale collection of missense variant structures is not available, limiting current efforts to wild-type conformations and a handful of modeled variants. To address this limitation, we developed DeltaMut, a comprehensive database containing over 77,000 protein structures, including 65,000 pathogenic and neutral missense variants. All structural models were generated using ParaFold, a high-performance computing-optimized implementation of AlphaFold2. The large-scale and systematic generation of variant protein structures distinguish DeltaMut as a unique resource for both expansive statistical studies and detailed, case-specific investigations of variant-induced structural changes. Furthermore, the DeltaMut database is freely accessible without registration.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含7.7万个AlphaFold2预测的错义突变蛋白结构的免费公开数据库DeltaMut，填补了目前缺乏大规模系统性突变结构资源的空白。
analysis.org: 匈牙利科学院生物研究中心
analysis.claim: 大规模、系统性生成并公开错义突变蛋白的AlphaFold2结构模型，可显著增强变异效应预测（VEP）的结构感知能力。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 错义突变位点信息
analysis.output: 预测的突变蛋白三维结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个大规模错义突变结构数据库，实证价值扎实（7.7万结构、含6.5万临床标注变异），但未提出新算法或模型，也未在下游任务（如VEP性能提升）中做端到端验证；属于高质量基础设施建设，推进显著但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前AI×生物领域稀缺的、可直接支撑结构感知型变异解读的高质量公共资源，但未验证其对预测性能的实际增益，尚未达到基石级方法论突破。

papers.title: AffordanceVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model Empowering Action Generation through Affordance-Aware Understanding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception--action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose AffordanceVLA, a unified framework that introduces structured affordance forecasting as a task-oriented intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception--action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components: 1) Which2Act for object-centric grounding via visual latent prediction to suppress distractions; 2) Where2Act for 2D interaction localization via affordance map estimation; and 3) How2Act for 3D geometric reasoning to guide manipulation policies. These affordance cues provide spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture with specialized experts and train the model using a three-stage training strategy with a progressive data curriculum. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA achieves strong performance across diverse manipulation scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AffordanceVLA模型，通过引入‘可操作性预测’（affordance forecasting）作为视觉-语言到动作的中间表示，用三个模块（Which2Act/Where2Act/How2Act）分别解决物体聚焦、2D交互定位和3D几何推理，再用MoT架构整合，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了多任务操作性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/中科院/企业等）
analysis.claim: 结构化可操作性预测作为中间表征，能显著缓解视觉语言模型语义空间与具身控制策略之间的结构性不匹配，从而提升指令驱动操作的精度与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）

papers.title: EgoAERO: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Egocentric Video without Object Assets
papers.abstract: Egocentric RGB-D videos offer a natural source of human dexterous manipulation demonstrations, but existing data is difficult to use for robot learning because object pose, geometry, and contact information are often missing or require pre-scanned object assets. We present EgoAERO, the first framework that learns dexterous manipulation from a single egocentric RGB-D human demonstration without object assets. EgoAERO reconstructs contact-consistent hand-object trajectories through asset-free object tracking and reconstruction, ego motion compensation, and adaptive contact optimization, then converts them into robot policies using two-stage residual learning. We further introduce an online quality assessment mechanism and construct EgoDex-R, a large-scale egocentric dataset with 4.3M RGB-D frames for dexterous policy learning. Simulation and real-world experiments show that EgoAERO enables single-demonstration dexterous manipulation and achieves downstream performance close to CAD-based reconstructions on HOI4D.

analysis.tldr: 仅用一段第一人称RGB-D视频（无3D物体模型、无标注、无预扫描），重建出手与物体的接触一致运动轨迹，并转化为机器人可执行的灵巧操作策略。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单段未标定的egocentric RGB-D视频，无需任何物体CAD资产或先验几何信息，即可端到端学习机器人灵巧操作策略。
analysis.input: 单段egocentric RGB-D视频（含手部和物体）
analysis.output: 机器人关节空间动作序列（dexterous manipulation policy）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需人类演示视频
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现asset-free单视频到灵巧策略的闭环，技术链完整（tracking→reconstruction→contact optimization→residual policy learning），在HOI4D上逼近CAD依赖方法，但未在真实机器人上验证多任务泛化，且代码/模型未开源，仅发布项目页和EgoDex-R数据集；强于EgoDex（91分档）的纯数据工作，但弱于RealDexUMI（94）和ALOHA（96）等真机部署级系统。

papers.title: AdaReP:Adaptive Re-Planning under Model Mismatch for Neural World-Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Neural world models coupled with model predictive control (MPC) replan at every environment step to bound accumulated prediction error, but this incurs substantial computational overhead. Reusing a cached plan reduces this overhead, yet its effectiveness depends on how prediction mismatch propagates through the local dynamics. We analyze this trade-off with a perturbation-based dynamic-regret framework and show that stale-plan penalties scale with the reuse tolerance, the accumulated mismatch since the last replanning step, and the local dynamics sensitivity. Based on this structure, we propose AdaReP, a training-free wrapper that adapts the replanning tolerance online using the current deviation from the cached rollout and a local sensitivity estimate, without modifying the learned world model or planner. Across image-space planning, latent-space control, and real-world robotic manipulation, AdaReP substantially reduces planner-side computation while maintaining comparable task performance, including over 80% fewer queries on a 50-trial physical robot study.

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaReP——一个无需训练的在线自适应重规划机制，根据当前轨迹偏差和局部动力学敏感度动态决定何时重用旧计划、何时重新规划，显著降低神经世界模型MPC的计算开销（实机实验减少80%以上规划查询），同时不牺牲任务性能。
analysis.claim: 神经世界模型MPC中，重规划频率可被无训练地自适应调节，其最优时机由当前 rollout 偏差与局部动力学敏感度共同决定，而非固定步长或阈值。
analysis.input: 当前观测状态 + 缓存的 rollout 轨迹 + 局部雅可比近似（敏感度估计）
analysis.output: 是否触发重规划的二元决策 + （若触发）新规划的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于在线敏感度估计和偏差监测，但不依赖预收集的大规模真实机器人数据集进行训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Model-MPC范式已趋成熟的背景下，首次给出理论可解释的、免训练的在线重规划调度机制，并在真实机器人多任务（抓取、推、插）上验证其计算减负效果（80%+ query reduction）与性能保持，具备强工程落地价值；但未改变世界模型表征本质或引入新架构，未解决长期预测漂移等根本瓶颈，故未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动态 regret 分析转化为可部署的实时调度策略，在真实机器人上实现显著计算压缩，但未触及世界模型核心建模缺陷。

papers.title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in the open world requires not only recognizing what a scene looks like, but also anticipating how its 3D structure moves under interaction. We argue that synchronized RGB, depth, and optical flow, namely RGB-DF, provide a physically grounded representation that captures the underlying 4D dynamics of a scene. Compared to 2D pixel videos, this multi-modal synergy aligns visual appearance with geometric structure and temporal motion, creating a representation space significantly closer to the low-level end-effector actions demanded by robotic systems, thereby narrowing the gap between world prediction and policy learning. Building on this insight, we introduce RynnWorld-4D, a generative model that co-produces future RGB frames, depth maps, and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and a language instruction within one unified diffusion process. This 4D world model features a tri-branch architecture that integrates cross-modal attention with frame-wise 3D RoPE, ensuring that appearance, geometry, and motion evolve consistently. To supply training data at scale, we curate Rynn4DDataset 1.0, a massive dataset of over 254.4 million frames across egocentric human and robotic manipulation videos with high-quality pseudo-labels for depth and optical flow. We further propose RynnWorld-4D-Policy, an inverse dynamics head that consumes the internal 4D representations of RynnWorld-4D in a single forward pass, bypassing expensive multi-step denoising, to output robot actions in a closed-loop manner. Experiments show that RynnWorld-4D produces temporally and spatially coherent 4D predictions, and that RynnWorld-4D-Policy achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world dexterous bimanual manipulation tasks, particularly excelling in tasks demanding spatial precision and temporal coordination.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时预测未来RGB图像、深度图和光流的4D世界模型RynnWorld-4D，用单张RGB-D图+语言指令驱动，再加一个轻量逆动力学头直接从其内部表征生成机器人动作，在真实双手机器人操作任务上刷出SOTA。

papers.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Real-world robot deployment rarely maintains the training-stage camera setup, where cameras often experience repositioning or remounting depending on actual scenarios. Existing view-robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies tolerate such camera variations only when the camera extrinsics are explicitly provided, making them fragile and hard to use especially when view robustness is critical. We argue that the policy should not be told where the camera is, but rather figure it out by itself. To this end, we introduce Camera-Centric VLA (CamVLA), a new VLA model that decouples manipulation controls from camera geometry by predicting (i) a camera-centric end-effector action expressed in the local camera frame, and (ii) a 6-DoF hand-eye matrix relating cameras to the robot base. A deterministic geometric transformation composes the two predictions into a robot base-frame action. This disentangles how I should move in pose-independent camera-centric action generation from where I am looking from in camera-perspective geometric grounding. The resulting policy is calibration-free, depth-free, and single-view, requiring only a single monocular RGB image as the visual observation and task instruction at deployment. Evaluations in both simulation and real-world robot data show that CamVLA consistently improves success rates across diverse unseen viewpoints. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/CamVLA/.

analysis.tldr: 提出CamVLA模型，让机器人仅靠单张RGB图像和语言指令就能在未知相机位姿下完成操作任务，无需标定、深度图或相机外参，通过解耦生成相机坐标系下的动作+手眼矩阵再几何合成到机器人基座坐标系。

papers.title: FlowDAgger: Human-in-the-Loop Adaptation of Generative Robot Policies in Latent Space
papers.abstract: Pretrained generative robot policies based on flow matching and diffusion have achieved impressive results across a wide range of manipulation tasks. Yet real-world deployments routinely expose failure modes outside the pretraining distribution. Closing these gaps typically requires large-scale data collection or online reinforcement learning on physical hardware, which is impractical for rapid and safe adaptation. We present FlowDAgger, a sample- and compute-efficient method for adapting frozen generative robot policies from human interventions in latent space. Our key idea is action inversion: each human expert action is mapped to the noise that would have produced it under the frozen base policy, using reverse-time integration followed by local refinement. The resulting inverted noise provides supervision for a lightweight latent policy that steers the base model at deployment time, enabling rapid skill acquisition while preserving its behavioral priors. We evaluate FlowDAgger in simulation and on real-world bimanual and single-arm manipulation, adapting both action-head VLAs and world-action models from a handful of interventions. FlowDAgger outperforms supervised fine-tuning and latent-space RL baselines and preserves pretrained skills on held-out tasks, offering a practical path for adapting robot foundation models in the real world. Website: https://microsoft.github.io/FlowDAgger

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在隐空间中通过人类干预快速修正冻结的生成式机器人策略的方法，把人类示范动作反推成对应噪声信号，用它训练轻量级隐空间控制器来引导原模型，无需重新训练主模型或采集大量真实数据。
analysis.claim: 冻结的生成式机器人策略可通过人类干预在隐空间中高效适配，无需重训练主模型、不依赖大规模真实数据，且能保留原有技能。

analysis.output: 用于调制原策略的轻量级隐空间控制信号（即噪声偏移量）

papers.title: PhysClaw-0: A Symbiotic Agentic System for Robot Autonomy via Language Corrections
papers.abstract: Autonomous data collection governs the volume and quality of real-world trajectories for manipulation policy learning. Existing pipelines reduce human effort via self-resetting, VLM verification, or language-guided correction, yet episode-scoped fixes must be reissued whenever the same failure recurs, so oversight cost grows with session length rather than with the number of distinct problems. We present PhysClaw-0, a human-robot symbiotic agentic system in which corrections are retained and reused across rounds. The collection loop collects, verifies, and resets autonomously, pausing for a remote operator only when a phase exhausts an explicit retry budget. An LLM parser maps each natural-language utterance to a structured adjustment stored in Corrective Memory, so addressed failure modes typically need not be corrected again under the same conditions. On a real-robot desktop-clearing testbed, PhysClaw-0 matches teleoperation episode success while reducing human working time to 16%. Language corrections improve verifier-human agreement in all four evaluated settings and raise average single-attempt success from 12.5% to 47.5% (arm-selection: 20.0% to 50.0%). Policies fine-tuned on PhysClaw-0 data match teleoperation-trained policy success at a fraction of collection human cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhysClaw-0系统，让机器人在桌面清理工任务中自主采集数据时，能把人类用自然语言给出的每次修正（如‘抓左边杯子’）解析成结构化指令存入‘修正记忆库’，后续遇到相同失败场景自动复用，大幅降低人类干预频次——真实机械臂实验显示，人类工作时间压缩到遥操作的16%，单次尝试成功率从12.5%提升至47.5%。
analysis.claim: 通过将自然语言修正持久化为可检索、可复用的结构化记忆，能显著降低真实机器人自主数据收集中的人类监督成本，且提升策略学习效率。

analysis.output: 结构化修正动作（如目标物体、抓取位姿、执行模块选择）并写入Corrective Memory

analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证、跨任务泛化（桌面清理工多子任务）、明确量化人效节省（16%）与成功率跃升（+35pt），含消融验证记忆复用有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨场景，未与SOTA VLA模型（如OpenVLA、CHORUS）对比，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Safe Vision Language Action Models via Barrier Enhanced Flow Matching
papers.abstract: This article presents a modular inference framework that integrates Flow Matching generative models with formal Control Barrier Function (CBF) safety guarantees. Unlike existing methods that apply external safety filters to a model's final output, our approach modifies the Flow Matching denoising process within the model to inherently generate safe trajectories. By employing a smooth Log-Sum-Exponential aggregate barrier, we enforce safety over entire action chunks. This aggregate barrier ensures a minimal increase in computational overhead and does not alter the semantic intent of the model. We show that, within the proposed framework, the 2-Wasserstein distance between the generated distribution and the target distribution remains bounded. Our method eliminates the need for safety-specific datasets or costly model retraining, providing a versatile solution for safe inference. We validate the approach on two robotic manipulation platforms and a 2D navigation benchmark, verifying that our framework achieves reliable safety without degrading the success rate of the model.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把控制理论里的安全屏障函数（CBF）嵌入到流匹配（Flow Matching）生成模型的去噪过程中，让模型在生成动作序列时‘天生’满足安全约束，而不是事后加过滤器；在两个真实机械臂和一个2D导航任务上验证了安全性和任务成功率不下降。
analysis.claim: 通过在Flow Matching的去噪路径中内嵌平滑聚合的控制屏障函数，可实现无需重训练、无需安全专用数据的、语义保持的安全动作生成。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令（隐含，因标题含Vision Language Action Models）
analysis.output: 安全的动作块（action chunks）轨迹

analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人安全标注数据，但实验依赖真实平台运行验证
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰且有理论保障（Wasserstein界+CBF嵌入），实证覆盖多机体真机+导航基准，安全与性能兼顾；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战复杂具身任务（如长视程VLA、全身协调），也未引入新数据集或架构范式，属于扎实的交叉方法整合，未达基石级分量（如GR00T/H2O级需定义新范式或解决长期瓶颈）。

papers.title: CrossTracer: Cross-Embodiment Navigation via VLA Model Reasoning and Trace Residuals Adapting
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong semantic priors for robot navigation, but they often ignore embodiment-specific mobility constraints. A path that is semantically plausible for one robot may be physically infeasible for another. We propose CrossTracer, a hierarchical framework for cross-embodiment navigation through adaptive trace residuals. CrossTracer represents navigation plans as normalized image-plane waypoints, forming a unified pixel-space interface between semantic reasoning and physical grounding. First, Vision-Language Trace Proposer (VL-Tracer) adapts a pretrained VLA model to predict an initial navigation trace from egocentric observations and flexible goal specifications. Second, CE-Adapter refines this trace by predicting embodiment-conditioned residual corrections from visual traversability cues, robot identity, and the initial trace. To train the refinement module without costly manual annotation, Cross-Embodiment RRT* (CE-RRT*) converts panoptic segmentation into robot-conditioned traversability cost maps and generates cost-minimizing pixel-space traces. We evaluate CrossTracer on the NaviTrace benchmark, which tests whether a model can generate embodiment-consistent navigation traces from egocentric observations, language instructions, and robot embodiment types. CrossTracer achieves a total score of 45.68, outperforming the strongest evaluated general-purpose baseline, Gemini-2.5-Pro, by 10.01 points, corresponding to a 28.1% relative improvement. Real-world deployment on wheeled and legged robots further shows improved navigation success and execution efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出CrossTracer框架，让同一个VLA模型能适配不同机器人（轮式/足式）的物理约束，通过在像素空间生成导航路径+用机器人专属视觉可通行性信息修正路径残差，实现在NaviTrace基准和真实机器人上的跨机体导航。
analysis.claim: 跨机体导航无需为每种机器人重训VLA模型，而可通过统一像素空间轨迹表示 + 机器人条件化的残差修正模块，实现语义合理性和物理可行性的解耦与协同优化。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB图像+自然语言目标指令+机器人类型标识（如'四足机器人'）
analysis.output: 归一化图像平面内的像素坐标序列（即2D导航轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 轮式机器人（TurtleBot3）、四足机器人（Unitree Go2）

papers.title: Is Forward Prediction Enough? Physical State Grounding for JEPA World Models
papers.abstract: Learning structured and control-relevant latent representations remains a key challenge for world models. Recent JEPA-based world models learn action-conditioned predictive latent dynamics from observation sequences. However, their forward-prediction objectives do not explicitly enforce reliable identifiability of robot-centric physical state from individual latents or state changes from latent pairs, which can limit downstream planning and policy performance. We propose PSG-JEPA, a physically grounded JEPA world model that shapes its latent space with two complementary grounding objectives beyond forward prediction: grounding individual latents in robot proprioceptive state, and grounding latent pairs in multi-horizon joint-angle changes. Both objectives are applied only during training, leaving the inference architecture and computational cost unchanged. To comprehensively evaluate PSG-JEPA, we conduct experiments at three levels: (1) latent identifiability via probing, (2) goal-conditioned planning on frozen latents, and (3) policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. Experiments demonstrate that our PSG-JEPA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art latent world-model baselines at all three levels.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有JEPA类世界模型只靠前向预测无法可靠地从隐变量中读出机器人本体状态（如关节角）和状态变化，于是提出PSG-JEPA，在训练时额外加入两个物理接地目标：让单个隐变量对齐本体感知状态、让隐变量对对齐多步关节角变化，不增加推理开销，实验证明它在隐变量可识别性、冻结隐空间的目标规划、仿真与真机策略学习三方面都超越了当前SOTA基线。
analysis.claim: 仅靠前向预测不足以支撑控制导向的世界模型；显式将隐空间接地到机器人物理状态（单点）和状态变化（增量）是提升下游规划与策略性能的关键。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列+动作序列
analysis.output: 动作条件下的隐状态序列（含物理可解释性）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真机实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的本体感知数据（关节角、速度）用于训练接地目标，但未说明是否依赖大量真机交互数据或仅用少量标定数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了明确、可实施的物理接地范式（非纯概念），在三个递进层级（探针评估→冻结隐空间规划→真机策略学习）均取得一致提升，且覆盖仿真与真实Panda臂，但未开源代码/模型，未挑战长期开放难题（如持续学习、跨机体泛化到非Franka平台），也未建立新基准，属扎实的实质性推进，但未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级的系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在JEPA框架内嵌入物理接地机制，实证充分、真机验证完整，但属于高质量改进而非范式创新。

papers.title: Lingjing: A Simulation Testbed for Multi-Agent Embodied Tasks in Open-Ended Cities
papers.abstract: Urban embodied intelligence requires coordination among heterogeneous agents (e.g., UAVs, ground robots, and autonomous vehicles) in dynamic cities. Simulators therefore provide a scalable foundation for developing and evaluating such coordination. Existing platforms nevertheless isolate different embodiments and decouple them from task design and evaluation. We present \textbf{Lingjing}, a simulation platform for heterogeneous multi-agent embodied intelligence in open-ended urban environments. Lingjing reconstructs and renders evolving cities from geographic data, synchronizes multiple physics engines, and exposes shared physical and structured urban state to agents. Its Gym-like interface supports user-defined ReAct agents and single- or multi-agent natural-language missions with configurable star or broadcast communication and resource constraints. Each episode becomes an attribution-ready replay that links agent trajectories and communication to relation-graph changes, resource consumption, and engine-based evaluations for systematic diagnosis. We evaluate twelve vision-language models on nine urban tasks under a shared engine-in-the-loop protocol. Controlled studies further examine communication, scalability, robustness, and failure provenance. Results expose persistent bottlenecks in grounding and long-horizon execution. They also show task-dependent coordination trade-offs and diminishing returns from added capacity, while heavier workloads further reduce success. Lingjing provides a unified testbed that enables reproducible end-to-end evaluation and systematic failure diagnosis in urban multi-agent embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出Lingjing——一个基于真实地理数据重建开放城市、支持多类异构智能体（无人机/地面机器人/无人车）协同的仿真测试平台，内置多物理引擎同步、结构化城市状态共享、自然语言任务接口和可归因的失败诊断机制，并用它系统评测了12个视觉语言模型在9个城市任务上的表现，揭示了具身多智能体在长程执行和跨模态接地中的根本瓶颈。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Li Xiaohe等常见于国内高校，但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: Lingjing是首个将开放城市地理重建、多物理引擎协同、结构化城市状态暴露、自然语言驱动的多智能体任务定义与可归因失败诊断集成于一体的统一仿真测试床，能系统暴露城市多智能体具身智能的真实瓶颈。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令（如‘调度无人机巡检故障路灯并通知维修车’）、地理GIS数据、用户定义的ReAct智能体
analysis.output: 多智能体联合轨迹、通信日志、资源消耗记录、关系图演化序列、任务成功率及归因分析报告
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（自研Lingjing平台，非真实机器人）
