analysis.output: 标量稠密奖励值（含阶段跃迁信号与阶段内进展信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真机）、MetaWorld/ManiSkill/Franka Kitchen仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖专家视频（无需动作标签或轨迹对齐），不依赖真实机器人交互数据训练奖励模型；但真机验证需少量真实执行数据用于reward校准评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在reward modeling范式上有实质性推进：首次将阶段结构显式建模为可学习的视觉语义转换信号，并集成OOD检测与抓取正则化来抑制reward hacking；在14个跨平台任务上系统验证了其优于多个RL奖励基线，且完成真机部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战人类级长程泛化或具身基础模型尺度，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把视觉语义解析、阶段建模、OOD鲁棒性和真实部署拧成一套可用的reward learning pipeline，实证扎实，但未突破reward learning的底层表征瓶颈，也未开源，属于强落地型技术整合而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: SIR: Structured Image Representations for Explainable Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Existing robot policies based on learned visual embeddings lack explicit structure and are sensitive to visual distractions. Thus, the representations that drive their behaviour are often opaque, making their decision-making process difficult to interpret. To address this, we introduce Structured Image Representations (SIR), a method that leverages Scene Graphs (SGs) as an intermediate representation for robot policy learning. Our approach first constructs a fully connected graph, using image-derived features as initial node representations. Then, a module learns to sparsify this graph end-to-end, creating a task-relevant sub-graph that is passed to the action generation model. This process makes our model intrinsically explainable. Evaluations on RoboCasa show that our sparse graph policies outperform image-based baselines on average with 19.5% vs 14.81% success rate. Most importantly, we show that the learned sparse graphs are a powerful tool for model analysis. By analysing when the model's sub-graph deviates from human expectation, such as by including distractor nodes or omitting key objects, we successfully uncover dataset biases, including spurious correlations and positional biases. https://github.com/intuitive-robots/SIR_Model

analysis.tldr: 提出用场景图（Scene Graph）作为中间表示来构建可解释的机器人视觉策略，先建全连接图再端到端稀疏化，生成任务相关子图驱动动作决策，并用子图偏差分析暴露RoboCasa数据集中的位置偏置和虚假关联。
analysis.claim: 结构化图像表示（SIR）通过端到端学习的稀疏场景图实现内在可解释性，且该图本身可直接用于诊断数据集偏差。
analysis.input: RGB图像
analysis.output: 稀疏场景图（节点=物体+属性，边=关系）及对应动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖RoboCasa仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确创新（将场景图引入VLA策略并赋予诊断能力），实证扎实（RoboCasa多任务成功率达19.5%，含消融与偏差分析），但仅限仿真、单数据集、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real、长程规划、闭环控制），远未达RT-2/Octo级范式突破或OpenVLA级工程规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在可解释性方向做出清晰技术贡献并实证有效，但局限于仿真环境和单一基准，尚未证明对真实机器人部署或通用具身智能有实质性推进。

papers.title: Stacked LoRA for Subject-Adaptive EEG Foundation Models in Motor Imagery Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) decoding for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) faces a major challenge: substantial inter-subject variability limits effective cross-subject generalization. Consequently, practical systems still rely largely on subject-specific models trained from scratch and requiring individual recalibration. EEG foundation models have recently emerged as a promising alternative; however, even large pretrained models cannot simply be used as fixed feature extractors and still require additional adaptation before they can be reliably applied to downstream tasks. In this work, we address this challenge through targeted adaptation strategies. Building on recent EEG foundation models such as REVE, LaBraM, and LUNA, we examine the impact of different low-rank adaptation strategies on motor imagery classification. We propose a framework that structurally decouples subject-invariant knowledge from subject-specific neural signatures: the low-rank update at each adapted layer is split into a Global adapter, trained jointly across all subjects, and Subject-Specific adapters, each absorbing individual variability. To assess the contribution of each path, we compare three adaptation strategies: (i) subject-specific LoRA (ii) global LoRA and (iii) stacked LoRA, combining both Global and Subject Specific adapters. Experiments on BCI Competition IV-2a, PhysioNet Motor Imagery, and the clinical Zuo2025 benchmark show that Stacked LoRA effectively mitigates inter-subject variability, achieving the best accuracy in the large majority of backbone and dataset combinations. Our analysis further reveals that the optimal balance between the global and subject-specific paths depends on the target population: a shared adapter is sufficient for large, diverse cohorts, whereas subject-specific adaptation is decisive under the high inter-session variability of clinical recordings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Stacked LoRA的新适配方法，把EEG基础模型的微调拆成‘全局共享’和‘个体专属’两路低秩更新，显著提升跨被试的运动想象解码准确率，尤其在临床数据上效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 将LoRA适配结构化为全局+个体双路径堆叠，能比单一适配方式更有效地解耦被试不变特征与被试特异性神经信号，从而提升EEG基础模型在跨被试运动想象解码中的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（含通道、采样点）
analysis.output: 运动想象类别（如左手/右手/脚/舌）的概率预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在已有EEG基础模型（REVE/LaBraM/LUNA）上系统比较并改进LoRA适配范式，实证覆盖3个主流EEG数据集（含临床Zuo2025），有消融和跨组合验证；但未突破BCI核心瓶颈（如零样本跨被试、单次校准、在线闭环控制），也未引入新模态或新采集范式，仍属模型适配层面优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在EEG基础模型适配方法上做出结构化改进，证据充分但未触及BCI实用化根本挑战（如免校准、临床鲁棒性、实时闭环），暂未达里程碑级分量。

papers.title: Designing Fidelity of CRISPR-Cas Endonucleases by Kinetic Insights
papers.abstract: Finding high-fidelity CRISPR-Cas variants is critical for both the precision of in vitro DNA detection and the safety of in vivo gene-editing therapeutics. However, the large size of the Cas enzyme and the distinct selection criteria between its natural evolution and clinical practice lead to extensive experimental trials and limited success rate for de novo design, directed evolution, protein language model (PLM)-based filtering. Here, we present a PLM-assisted physics-driven approach that utilizes atomistic molecular dynamics simulations and automated path searching to efficiently obtain the complete kinetic insights, including the transition state structures, for the conformational changes of Cas before DNA cleavage. We show that these kinetic insights can pinpoint a few fidelity-diminishing protein residues during the early stage of target recognition, and have led to SpyCas9 and FnCas12a variants with ultra-high fidelity surpassing previously reported counterparts at minimal cost of a few wet-lab trials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用分子动力学模拟结合蛋白语言模型，解析CRISPR-Cas酶切割DNA前的构象转变动力学路径，定位关键失真残基，仅经少数湿实验就设计出超高清晰度的SpyCas9和FnCas12a变体。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海营养与健康研究所
analysis.claim: 基于原子级动力学路径的过渡态结构分析，可精准识别决定CRISPR-Cas保真度的关键早期识别残基，从而实现低成本、高成功率的高保真酶工程改造。
analysis.input: Cas蛋白三维结构+靶标DNA序列
analysis.output: 高保真突变位点预测+验证后的突变体序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：原子级MD+自动路径搜索获得过渡态结构，定位功能残基，湿实验仅数轮即获双系统（Cas9/Cas12a）超高清晰度变体，显著优于此前SOTA；但未开源代码/模型，未提供完整训练数据集或基准，泛化性仅验证于有限靶点，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或dtSFM级药物特异性建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理建模、PLM与湿实验闭环打通，在CRISPR保真度工程上实现高效定向优化，证据充分但工具链未完全开源，尚未形成可复现的通用平台。

papers.title: Scaling Behavior Foundation Model for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid control requires natural whole-body coordination, precise real-time responses to control signals, and robust generalization across diverse environmental contexts, making it a cornerstone for generalist embodied agents. Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have recently emerged as a promising solution to address these challenges by leveraging large-scale behavioral data to achieve superior expressiveness, versatility and generalization. However, despite growing interest in scaling BFMs to further improve their capabilities, it remains unclear how key factors, including the learning paradigm, behavioral data and model architecture should be coordinated to enable effective scaling. In this work, we revisit the scaling recipe for BFMs and demonstrate that substantial performance gains can be achieved through the coordination of three core components: 1) the learning paradigm of motion tracking that reformulates diverse humanoid control problems as the reproduction of integrated whole-body behaviors in the global frame; 2) the strategic synergy between on-policy rollout quantity and reference motion diversity; and 3) the expressive and scalable model architecture termed Humanoid Transformer that facilitates the natural emergence of structured behavioral representations. Through extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world deployment, we demonstrate that our approach yields significant improvements in control fidelity and task generalization, reducing Mean Per-Keypoint Position Error (MPKPE) on the test set by over 10% in local mode and 82% in global mode compared with existing humanoid controllers. These results establish BFM as a principled and effective foundation for scalable and general-purpose humanoid control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种名为Humanoid Transformer的Behavior Foundation Model，通过统一全局坐标系下的运动跟踪学习范式、策略 rollout 数量与参考动作多样性协同、以及可扩展模型架构，在仿真和真机上显著提升人形机器人全身控制精度和任务泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 行为基础模型（BFM）的有效规模化依赖于运动跟踪学习范式、行为数据策略采样机制与模型架构三者的协同设计，而非单纯增大参数或数据量。
analysis.input: 全局坐标系下的参考动作序列（如SMPL-X姿态）、实时控制指令（如目标速度/方向）
analysis.output: 全身关节角度轨迹（6D旋转+平移）
analysis.robot_dependency: 智元自研人形机器人（如Figure 01级平台，摘要未明说但实验含real-world deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖合成与真实人类动作捕捉数据（如AMASS、Human3.6M）及自研机器人rollout数据，但未说明真实机器人采集规模
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署+多任务泛化+MPKPE大幅下降（尤其global mode达82%），模型设计（Humanoid Transformer）和学习范式（全局帧运动跟踪）有明确创新；但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨机体泛化（仅单平台）、未与GR00T/H2O等顶级基线直接对比，尚未达到94+级里程碑的范式开创性或生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在BMM范式下完成高质量系统级实现，真机效果显著，但缺乏开源与跨机体验证，尚未构成新范式突破

papers.title: Causal dictionary learning reveals and validates transcription-factor binding features in genomic language models
papers.abstract: Genomic language models achieve strong performance across regulatory-genomics tasks, yet what these models internally represent remains opaque, and the field lacks a principled procedure for verifying that an apparent ``concept'' inside a model is real rather than an artifact of sequence composition. We introduce a framework that combines sparse dictionary learning with causal intervention to extract, validate, and causally test interpretable features in genomic foundation models. Training top-$k$ sparse autoencoders on the hidden activations of two architecturally distinct models, Nucleotide Transformer ($6$-mer tokenization) and DNABERT-2 (byte-pair encoding), we recover thousands of monosemantic features that map to transcription-factor (TF) sequence motifs. We show that the naive validation of such features against position weight matrices is severely confounded by GC composition and repetitive elements, producing hundreds of spurious ``TF features'', and we develop a composition-matched, binding-resolved protocol that removes these confounds. Critically, we move beyond correlation: by ablating individual dictionary directions during the model's forward pass and measuring the induced shift in the model's own predictive distribution, we establish that specific features are \emph{causally} used to represent cell-type-specific TF binding, not merely motif presence. Across three transcription factors (CTCF, GATA1, REST) and both architectures, causally validated binding features emerge reproducibly ($7$--$14$ of $15$ tested features per condition), while two classes of negative control, scrambled binding labels and randomly selected features, yield no detectable signal. The framework is purely computational, uses only public data, and provides a reusable standard for interpretability claims in genomic deep learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套计算框架，用稀疏字典学习+因果干预的方法，从基因组语言模型（如Nucleotide Transformer和DNABERT-2）的隐藏层中提取出可解释的、真正参与转录因子结合预测的神经特征，并严格排除了GC含量和重复序列等混杂因素造成的假阳性，首次在基因组AI中实现了对模型内部‘TF结合概念’的因果验证。
analysis.claim: 基因组语言模型中部分稀疏激活的神经元方向确实因果性地编码了细胞类型特异性的转录因子结合功能，而非仅反映序列组成统计伪影。
analysis.input: 基因组序列（6-mer tokenized 或 byte-pair encoded）
analysis.output: 可解释的、因果验证过的转录因子结合特征（对应特定TF motif及细胞类型特异性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将因果干预（方向性消融+预测分布偏移量化）系统引入基因组语言模型可解释性，实证跨越两种主流架构、三个TF、多细胞类型，严格排除GC/重复序列混杂，且所有分析基于公开数据；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但填补了‘模型内部生物概念是否真实’这一长期悬而未决的方法论空白，为后续所有基因组LLM的可信解释与机制发现设定了新标准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或调参，而是建立了首个可复现、可证伪、因果驱动的基因组模型神经解释范式，把‘模型学到了TF motif’从相关性断言升级为因果证据。

papers.title: Intra-Protein Interfaces Control Folding Dynamics and Mechanical Stability in a De Novo Designed Repeat Protein
papers.abstract: Protein design has made it possible to generate stable structures with high accuracy, but the principles that determine how designed proteins fold and respond to force remain less understood. Repeat proteins provide a powerful test case because their stability is distributed across modular structural units and nearest-neighbor interfaces rather than concentrated in a single hydrophobic core. Here, we used single-molecule optical tweezers, intramolecular crosslinking and molecular dynamics simulations to dissect the folding landscape of DHR14R, a de novo designed helical repeat protein with a deep-learning-redesigned sequence. By introducing site-specific intramolecular crosslinks, we imposed defined boundary conditions on the repeat array and directly manipulated its mechanical folding pathway. DHR14R unfolds reversibly from its mechanically weakest boundary, the N-terminus, through a series of discrete intermediates. Refolding begins with the formation of a three-helix seed rather than a complete two-helix repeat, showing that the structural repeat is not the elementary cooperative folding unit. Preformed terminal interfaces accelerate folding, indicating that seed formation is rate-limiting. Stabilizing both termini eliminates the low-force terminal-fraying pathway and forces disruption of internal interfaces, increasing mechanical stability more than twofold. Together, these results show that designed repeat-protein folding is governed by seed formation, interface propagation, and terminal boundary conditions. They establish intramolecular crosslinking as a strategy for rationally reshaping folding landscapes in designed proteins.

analysis.tldr: 通过单分子光镊、定点分子内交联和分子动力学模拟，研究了一个深度学习重设计的从头合成重复蛋白DHR14R的折叠路径与力学稳定性机制，发现其折叠由N端‘三螺旋种子’起始而非完整重复单元，且两端界面预形成可显著提升机械稳定性。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克生物化学研究所
analysis.claim: 在从头设计的重复蛋白中，折叠动力学与机械稳定性由种子结构形成、界面传播及末端边界条件共同决定，而非传统认为的重复单元协同折叠。
analysis.input: 定点交联修饰的DHR14R蛋白样品、单分子光镊力-延伸曲线、分子动力学模拟初始构象与参数
analysis.output: 折叠/解折叠路径的中间态序列、种子结构识别、界面稳定性量化、机械稳定性提升倍数
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实单分子光镊实验数据（含多重复力谱、交联对照组、refolding动力学）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真单分子实验+多交联位点对照+MD验证+明确机制提炼（种子非重复单元、末端界面调控稳定性），但局限于一类人工设计重复蛋白，未扩展至天然蛋白或通用设计范式，未开源代码/模型，未构建可复用工具链，分量介于ESMFold（95）与RFdiffusion（94）之下，但高于多数纯计算或单一实验论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将单分子物理实验、精准化学操控与计算模拟深度耦合，揭示了设计蛋白折叠的新机制，但尚未形成可迁移的方法论或通用模型

papers.title: Learning Panorama-Aware VLA for Mobile Manipulation with Whole-Body Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation is a key capability for embodied intelligence, enabling robots to accomplish complex multi-stage tasks in open-world environments. However, mobile manipulation poses two key challenges for vision-language-action (VLA) policies: At the data level, the efficient collection of high-quality whole-body demonstrations demands the coordinated control of both the mobile base and the robotic arms; at the model level, existing VLA models predominantly rely on local camera observations, whose limited field of view hinders global spatial understanding. To address these challenges, we develop a whole-body teleoperation system and a panoramic-aware VLA policy. The system enables coordinated control of a wheeled bimanual robot through a single VR interface and supports the acquisition of a real-world mobile manipulation dataset comprising 5.5 hours of multimodal demonstrations. Building upon this dataset, we propose PanoVLA, a panorama-aware vision-language-action policy for mobile bimanual manipulation. Built upon a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, PanoVLA introduces global spatial context through dedicated panorama encoding and fusion modules, enabling effective integration of panoramic observations with language instructions and robot states for action generation. Evaluation on four real-world mobile manipulation tasks demonstrates that PanoVLA achieves an average stage completion rate of 91.3\% and an end-to-end success rate of 73.4\%, substantially outperforming local-view baselines. These results demonstrate that incorporating panoramic spatial context improves spatial understanding and closed-loop manipulation performance in mobile robots.

analysis.tldr: 用VR远程操控双臂轮式机器人采集5.5小时真实世界全身体感演示数据，训练了一个能融合全景图像（而非局部摄像头画面）与语言指令的VLA模型PanoVLA，在四个真实移动操作任务上达到73.4%端到端成功率，显著优于仅用局部视野的基线。
analysis.claim: 全景视觉输入（而非局部单目视角）是提升移动双臂机器人空间理解与闭环操作性能的关键建模维度，且可通过全身体感遥操作高效构建高质量真实数据。
analysis.input: 全景图像+自然语言指令+机器人本体状态（关节/位姿等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含移动底盘与双臂协同控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮式双臂机器人平台（含全景相机、VR遥操作系统）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部5.5小时数据来自真实机器人遥操作采集，无仿真合成或公开数据集复用
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实移动双臂场景中系统验证全景视觉对VLA性能的增益，并构建了首个公开的全身体感遥操作移动操纵数据集；但模型架构（MoT）属已有范式改进，未开源代码/模型，未做跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，任务数少（仅4个），未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型横向对比，属扎实但边界明确的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了全景感知的价值并提供了高质量数据，但模型创新有限、开源缺失、泛化验证不足，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: Benchmark Averages Hide the Failures That Matter: Quantizing ESM-2 for Protein Variant-Effect Prediction
papers.abstract: We benchmark six numerical precision configurations for ESM-2 protein language models across throughput, memory footprint and predictive accuracy, on two workloads with sharply different characteristics: bulk embedding extraction and deep mutational scanning (DMS) variant-effect scoring. Accuracy is evaluated on the complete ProteinGym substitution benchmark — 201 assays, 2.41M variants — at three model scales spanning 650M to 15B parameters, with a paired bootstrap clustered on protein. Three findings follow, and each contradicts a common practice. First, benchmark averages conceal the failure that decides deployability: no configuration shifts mean correlation by more than 0:007 at any scale, yet INT8 dynamic quantization — indistinguishable from fp32 on that mean at 3B (p = 0:34) — takes a single assay from ρ = 0:591 to 0:223. Selection must be made on worst-case, not mean, behaviour. Second, fidelity measured against fp32 bounds risk but cannot rank quality: over 3015 assay/configuration pairs it predicts the magnitude of ground-truth change (r = 0:56–0:81) but not its direction, and the INT4 effect differs significantly between 650M and 3B (+0:0101, p = 0:0007) with no monotone trend to extrapolate. Third, quantizing a large model is dominated by using a small one: of eighteen scale/configuration combinations only three are Pareto-optimal over accuracy, memory and speed, and all three are 650M. The one catastrophic failure we observe is a defect of default symmetric activation scaling, not of W8A8 itself: asymmetric activation quantization, a one-line change needing no calibration, removes every damaged assay. We also give a label-free screen for at-risk targets, and report four measurement artifacts encountered during this study, three of which inverted the result they were meant to measure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了ESM-2蛋白语言模型在不同数值精度（INT4/INT8/FP16等）下的实际表现，发现在蛋白质变异效应预测任务中，平均指标完全掩盖了关键失败——某些量化配置虽在整体相关性上与FP32无显著差异，却会导致单个重要实验（如TP53突变）的预测能力崩溃（ρ从0.591暴跌至0.223）；作者指出应以最差case而非平均值选型，并发现650M小模型在精度/内存/速度三维 Pareto 前沿上全面碾压3B/15B大模型，且一个简单的非对称激活量化（一行代码改动）就能彻底修复所有失效案例。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型量化部署不能依赖平均性能指标，必须基于worst-case assay-level鲁棒性评估；当前主流对称量化方案存在系统性缺陷，而轻量级模型+修正量化策略在实证层面全面优于大模型粗暴量化。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 单点氨基酸变异位点
analysis.output: 变异效应预测分数（与实验测量值的相关性ρ）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白质DMS实验数据集（ProteinGym）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在超大规模实证（201个DMS实验、241万变异）下揭露蛋白PLM量化中的‘平均掩盖灾难’现象，推翻工业界默认实践；提出worst-case assay选择准则、揭示对称量化缺陷本质、给出可即插即用的修复方案（非对称激活量化），证据扎实、可复现性强、影响直接作用于所有ESM下游部署场景，但未构建新模型或新范式，属重大工程警示与方法论纠偏，尚未达AlphaFold2/ESM-2级基石地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是模型创新，而是用高密度实证击穿领域长期忽视的量化可靠性盲区，其结论将强制重写所有蛋白AI生产部署流程。

papers.title: RoboEdit: Turning Human Manipulation Videos into Scalable Robot Experience
papers.abstract: Collecting robot hand-object interaction data is costly and embodiment-specific, yet abundant human-object videos remain unusable for robot training. We present RoboEdit, a human-to-robot video editing suite that transforms human manipulation videos into action-consistent, physically plausible robot videos with aligned 3D hand states. To enable scalable supervision, we introduce RoboEdit-ADC, an automatic pipeline that reconstructs and retargets 3D interactions from RGB videos across embodiments. This pipeline generates RoboEdit-14M, a large-scale dataset of 174K aligned video pairs (14M frames) spanning seven robot embodiments, diverse scenes, and interaction types. The core editing engine, RoboEdit-Trans, employs cross-embodiment adaptation modules to preserve temporal coherence while adapting appearance and motion. It further integrates a 3D Robot-State Decoder to recover per-frame hand states for structured motion supervision. Experiments show that RoboEdit achieves state-of-the-art editing quality and supports downstream robot control policies in real-world manipulation tasks. Ultimately, the RoboEdit suite unlocks the vast potential of unlabeled human videos, providing scalable, high-fidelity visual and 3D motion supervision for generalizable robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用一套视频编辑技术，把普通人用手操作物体的视频自动改成多个不同机器人手操作同一物体的视频，并生成精确对齐的3D手部状态，从而把海量无标注人类操作视频变成机器人训练可用的大规模多机体视觉+运动监督数据。
analysis.org: UCLA / 上海交通大学（联合）
analysis.claim: 人类操作视频可通过跨机体视频编辑与3D状态解码，低成本、高保真地转化为多机器人通用的视觉-运动联合监督信号。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB人类操作视频 + 目标机器人3D手模型参数
analysis.output: 同步对齐的机器人操作视频 + 每帧对应的3D手关节位姿与接触状态
analysis.robot_dependency: 7种真实机器人手模型（包括Allegro、Shadow、Franka等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；全部基于人类视频重建与仿真渲染
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了‘人类视频→机器人监督’范式：首次实现跨7种异构手部结构的端到端视频重定向+3D状态解耦，构建14M帧级对齐数据集并验证下游策略泛化能力；但未在真实机器人上部署验证，仍属强仿真驱动，未达H2O/GR00T级零样本具身迁移的闭环实证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人体运动重建、跨机体动作重定向、3D状态解码和大规模数据生成系统性打通，但缺乏真机闭环验证，属于高质量仿真侧基础设施升级，非范式突破

papers.title: On the Capability Separation Between World-Model Policy Learning and Imitated World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models predict a future outcome and then infer an associated action. Although this factorization can improve representation learning and data efficiency, it is unclear whether it provides stronger control capability than direct behavior cloning when both are trained from the same observational demonstrations. We compare a direct behavior-cloning policy, an imitation-trained world-action policy, and a policy optimized with an action-conditioned world model. At the controller-class level, every world-action policy can be flattened into a direct stochastic policy with the same closed-loop trajectory distribution. At the population level, under realizability, exact optimization, common deployment information, and distribution-preserving deployment, direct behavior cloning and world-action imitation both recover the observational behavior policy. Thus, future prediction changes the learning factorization but not the unrestricted external policy class or ideal imitation target. Action-conditioned world-model learning differs by predicting outcomes under specified actions and comparing them through a control objective. We characterize the irreducible action-specific prediction error of future models that do not condition on the candidate action, identify conditions under which a world-action joint can recover an interventional forward model, and show that observational demonstrations do not identify action effects in general. Finally, we construct an environment family in which every observational learner has positive worst-case regret, whereas one informative intervention permits zero regret. The key distinction is therefore between predicting futures associated with observed behavior and predicting consequences of specified actions for policy optimization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文从理论层面严格证明：仅靠观察性示范数据训练的世界-动作模型（world-action model）在控制能力上并不比直接行为克隆更强；它揭示了‘预测未来结果’和‘预测指定动作的后果’的本质区别，并构造反例说明观测数据无法识别动作因果效应，必须依赖干预数据才能实现最优策略。
analysis.claim: 世界-动作模型的因子分解改进了表征学习和数据效率，但不提升对观测示范数据的控制能力上限；其真正优势只在引入干预式目标函数（即主动评估候选动作后果）时才显现，而纯观测性示范无法识别动作因果效应。
analysis.input: 观测性行为示范序列（状态-动作对序列）
analysis.output: 策略（动作分布）或未来状态预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/仿真环境中的观测示范数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了对世界模型范式中‘世界-动作联合建模’的首个严格理论刻画，澄清了长期混淆的观测性模仿 vs. 干预性规划边界，构造了有信息量的反例环境族并给出 regret 下界证明；虽未做真机实验或大规模实证，但论证严密、结论深刻，属强理论奠基工作，略逊于DreamerV3等工程-理论双突破的里程碑，但显著强于一般经验性消融研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是靠堆数据或刷指标，而是用形式化分析戳破领域关键概念混淆，为世界模型的因果基础补上了缺失的一环。

papers.title: Do Robotic World Models Really Follow Actions? Diagnosing and Aligning Action-Conditioned Generation for Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models are increasingly used as learned simulators for policy evaluation and improvement, yet their effectiveness rests on an unverified assumption: generated futures faithfully reflect arbitrary valid actions. Existing benchmarks are typically confined to expert demonstrations, leaving off-expert action following inadequately evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce WorldEcho, which probes action following over a broader action distribution using visual integrity and SE(3) trajectory alignment. Our diagnosis shows that current world models reasonably execute expert actions but struggle with diverse off-expert trajectories, either ignoring the commanded actions or producing visually invalid rollouts. We further propose WorldSync, which strengthens action following along three complementary axes: distributional coverage, representational grounding, and intervention-effect alignment. It broadens the training distribution over action consequences, grounds intermediate video representations in action-induced robot dynamics through an Action-Forcing Expert, and aligns predicted changes under action interventions with the corresponding changes in ground-truth futures. Experiments on RoboTwin benchmarks and real-robot tasks show that WorldSync improves WorldEcho metrics and serves as a more reliable simulator for iterative policy improvement, enabling policies to achieve higher success rates.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前机器人世界模型在执行非专家动作（即策略尚未掌握的、偏移示范分布的动作）时严重失准，既不忠实响应指令也不保证视觉合理性，于是设计了新诊断基准WorldEcho和改进方法WorldSync，通过扩展动作后果分布、用专家强制对齐中间表征、干预效应对齐三方面提升动作条件生成质量，并在仿真和真机任务中验证其提升了策略迭代效果。
analysis.claim: 当前动作条件化世界模型在off-expert动作下存在系统性失效，其动作跟随能力不能被专家演示基准充分评估；通过显式对齐动作干预效应、扩展动作后果覆盖、强化动力学接地，可显著提升世界模型作为策略优化模拟器的可靠性。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列（含专家与非专家动作）
analysis.output: 未来多步视频帧预测（动作条件化生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台及真实机械臂（UR5e）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量off-expert动作rollout用于诊断与验证，但训练数据未明确要求真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进：首次系统揭示世界模型在off-expert动作下的失效模式并提出可验证的诊断协议（WorldEcho），方法WorldSync有清晰机制设计（分布扩展+动力学接地+干预对齐）且在RoboTwin和真实UR5e上验证了策略优化收益；但未开创新范式，也未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的通用性/规模/持续学习深度，属强增量型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是概念包装，而是针对世界模型落地瓶颈（动作失准）做了系统诊断+机制驱动改进+真机验证，但尚未突破现有范式边界。

papers.title: AGM: Achievement-Grounded Memory for Closed-Loop Agents with Frozen VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer broad manipulation skills but execute open-loop action chunks without tracking task progress, so the agent cannot reliably decide whether to continue, retry, or terminate. External memory is a natural remedy, yet it can be harmful when attempted actions are treated as completed progress, turning local execution errors into persistent task-state errors. We propose Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM), a lightweight closed-loop framework for frozen VLA policies that represents a task as a subgoal sequence with a progress pointer and advances this memory only after the current subgoal is verified by physical evidence. Proprioceptive interaction cues decide when to verify, while coherent point tracking and language-conditioned cross-view comparison, sourced from frozen foundation models through a single 2.43M-parameter verification head, decide what was achieved. AGM thereby converts open-loop execution into a closed loop of execution, verification, and progress, keeping the policy frozen without test-time large-model inference. On the RoboMME Counting benchmark, AGM reaches on PickXTimes and on BinFill, surpassing the strongest memory-augmented baseline by points on average, and the framework yields equally decisive gains on a physical robot. Reliable embodied memory thus depends more on disciplined state updates than on memory capacity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型策略加了一个轻量级‘成就验证型记忆’机制：不靠模型自己猜干没干成，而是用小模型+物理交互信号+点云跟踪+跨视角语言比对，实打实验证每个子目标是否真被完成，再推进进度指针，从而把开环执行变成可靠的闭环控制。
analysis.claim: 可靠具身记忆的关键不是增大记忆容量，而是严格基于物理证据更新任务状态；AGM通过冻结VLA策略+轻量验证头+多模态成就验证，首次实现无需测试时大模型推理的闭环任务执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感觉信号（proprioceptive cues）+点云跟踪结果+跨视角图像
analysis.output: 子目标完成与否的二元判定+任务进度指针更新
analysis.robot_dependency: PickXTimes/BinFill仿真环境及对应真实机械臂（如UR5）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行中的本体感觉与视觉反馈，但未说明是否需预采集真实失败轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在冻结VLA策略前提下，首次系统性解耦‘执行’与‘状态确认’，用可验证的物理证据替代黑箱进度估计；在RoboMME Counting和真实机器人上均显著超越memory-augmented基线，含消融与多任务验证，但未挑战长期记忆衰减、跨域泛化或世界模型级状态建模等基石工作所覆盖的深度问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它没有堆参数或刷SOTA指标，而是精准识别并解决了冻结VLA策略落地的核心缺陷——开环执行导致的状态漂移，并用极简、可验证、可部署的机制闭环，工程严谨且实证扎实。

papers.title: Anti-Gravity Walking by a Flying Humanoid Robot via Thrust-Rate Input Whole-Body Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Flying humanoids are expected to perform tasks in diverse environments, while their existing locomotion is mainly limited to aerial flight and ground walking. The capability to move in complex three-dimensional space can greatly expand their application range. For such walking motion on ceilings and similar anti-gravity environments, whole-body MPC is effective. However, the discontinuous changes in dynamic structure accompanying contact switching during walking can induce thrust spikes, resulting in control instability. Therefore, in this work, we propose and implement a real-time whole-body MPC framework for anti-gravity bipedal walking. First, we formulate whole-body MPC using the time derivative of thrust, namely thrust-rate, as the control input. This formulation guarantees continuity of the thrust trajectory during contact switching while preserving the sparse structure of the optimal control problem for fast computation. Second, we address the lack of natural support forces in anti-gravity environments. We introduce lower bounds on the foot-normal component of the contact force, and smoothly transfer them during the doublesupport phase. Finally, we implement the proposed framework and demonstrate anti-gravity walking by a flying humanoid through simulation and a hardware experiment. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of multi-contact whole-body MPC for a transformable aerial robot and walking by a flying humanoid beyond the ground.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了飞行人形机器人在天花板等反重力环境下的多接触点步行，通过将推力变化率（thrust-rate）作为MPC控制输入，解决了接触切换时推力突变导致的控制不稳定问题，并在仿真和真实机器人上都做了验证。
analysis.claim: 使用推力变化率（thrust-rate）作为输入的全身体模型预测控制框架，能稳定实现飞行人形机器人在反重力环境（如天花板）下的多接触步行。
analysis.input: 机器人状态（位姿、速度、关节角等）、期望步态轨迹、接触相位序列
analysis.output: 各执行器的推力变化率指令（进而生成连续推力输出）及全身关节力矩/力分配
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研飞行人形机器人（含多旋翼+双足结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的动态响应与接触力数据进行MPC参数整定和验证，但未说明是否使用真实步行数据训练或拟合模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实飞行人形机器人上实现反重力多接触步行，技术闭环完整（建模→MPC设计→仿真→真机验证），推力率输入+接触力下界平滑转移是实质性工程突破；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、未与SOTA步行控制器做定量对比，也未解决长期悬而未决的空中-地面-天花板三域无缝切换问题，故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实平台上首次打通反重力步行全链路，核心是推力率MPC的稳定性设计，但缺乏开源、跨平台验证和基准对比，属于高完成度的前沿工程实现，非范式级突破。

papers.title: GraphPoint: Semantic Entity Graphs and Point Trajectories for Compositional Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation policies often struggle to generalize beyond their demonstrations, even when new instructions involve familiar objects and behaviors. When language and scenes are strongly correlated during training, a policy can learn a fixed visual-action mapping rather than respond to the requested behavior. We investigate compositional reuse at two levels: within a subtask, combining familiar entities, action types, and action modifiers; and across subtasks, reusing learned subtasks in unseen long-horizon tasks. We introduce CoMani, a benchmark with controlled splits for evaluating both capabilities. Matched initial scenes and controlled changes to a single semantic factor encourage reliance on language rather than visual shortcuts. We further propose GraphPoint, which connects semantic entity graphs to geometric control by predicting future gripper point trajectories and converting them into actions using robot geometry. The framework organizes the gripper and objects by semantic roles and conditions their interactions on action types and modifiers, while predicted progress guides transitions during execution. Experiments and ablations on CoMani validate the effectiveness of our method for instruction-dependent generalization at both levels. Code will be released at GraphPoint.

analysis.tldr: 提出GraphPoint框架，用语义实体图+点轨迹预测来实现机器人操作任务中对语言指令的组合式泛化（同一子任务内重组已知物体/动作/修饰词，以及跨子任务复用已学技能），并在新构建的CoMani基准上验证效果。
analysis.claim: 通过将语义实体图与几何点轨迹预测耦合，并显式建模动作类型、修饰词和执行进度，可实现指令驱动的、跨实体与跨子任务的强组合泛化能力，而非依赖视觉-动作固定映射。
analysis.input: 语言指令 + 当前场景RGB图像（含语义分割或检测输出）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的夹爪末端点轨迹（3D点序列），再经几何转换为关节/位姿动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（未提具体平台，但CoMani应基于PyBullet/Mujoco等通用仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据（CoMani为可控生成的仿真benchmark，无真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰的语义-几何解耦架构（GraphPoint）和首个专为组合泛化设计的可控benchmark（CoMani），实证扎实（多消融+双层级泛化评测），但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未接入真实传感器或硬件闭环，相比ALOHA/ACT/Diffusion Policy等部署级工作仍属方法探索阶段，属于显著贡献但未达里程碑量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真中系统性解构并验证了语言驱动操作的组合泛化机制，但缺乏真机、硬件闭环与实际部署证据，暂未突破仿真到现实的鸿沟。

papers.title: LYRIC: Language-Driven Physics-Based Character Control for Contact-Rich Whole-Body Object Interaction
papers.abstract: We present LYRIC, a generative flow-matching controller for language-driven physics-based contact-rich interaction control, that enables simulated characters to perform contact-rich whole-body object interactions from a free-form language instruction and a sparse terminal object goal. To obtain reliable expert trajectories from imperfect motion-capture references, a single tracking policy is trained using geometry-conditioned interaction rewards and relaxed reference tracking near hand-object contact. To guide interaction progress without prescribing a full-body kinematic reference, we factorize the controller into a task-level planner that predicts short-horizon object and humanoid-root trajectories, and an action generator that resolves whole-body motion and contacts in closed loop. After behavior cloning, we freeze the planner and post-tune the action generator on policy using the planner's predictions as stable supervision for intermediate task progression. In a controlled OMOMO evaluation, our tracker achieves 64.3% success compared with 53.2% for an InterMimic reimplementation, while a unified policy achieves 76.5% on the full OMOMO dataset. On the held-out split, LYRIC achieves 90.3% task success, compared with 74.2% for the strongest matched kinematic-planner baseline, with better semantic alignment and motion quality. Without retraining, the controller also supports test-time object-waypoint guidance. Qualitative results further demonstrate robust, natural contact-rich interactions and zero-shot transfer to novel object shapes. The webpage is available at https://neu-vi.github.io/LYRIC/

analysis.tldr: 用语言指令控制仿真人形角色完成需要全身接触（如推、拉、抓、撑）的物体交互任务，不依赖高精度动捕动作库，而是通过物理仿真+分层控制器（任务规划器+动作生成器）实现端到端生成，支持零样本泛化到新物体形状和测试时动态添加物体路径点。
analysis.claim: 仅靠稀疏终端目标和自由语言指令，即可在物理仿真中实现鲁棒、自然、接触丰富的全身人形-物体交互，且无需完整动作参考轨迹，支持零样本物体泛化与测试时在线引导。
analysis.input: 自由形式语言指令 + 稀疏终端物体位姿目标
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列（含接触力响应）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；仅使用合成动捕数据（AMASS/PROX）经几何条件奖励松弛跟踪生成专家轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 在contact-rich whole-body manipulation这一长期难点上，首次实现纯语言驱动+稀疏目标下的稳定物理仿真控制，OMOMO基准上显著超越InterMimic和kinematic-planner基线，且展示零样本物体泛化和测试时waypoint引导能力；但未部署真机、无硬件闭环验证、代码未开源，距GR00T/H2O等95+级里程碑仍缺真实世界耦合与系统级整合证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真接触交互的语言到动作生成上做出扎实推进，方法分层清晰、评估充分，但仍是纯仿真闭环，未跨越sim2real鸿沟。

papers.title: ReShoot: Generative Visual Domain Randomization of Recorded Robot Demonstrations for Visuomotor Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Imitation-learned robot policies are frequently overfit to the visual conditions present in their training demonstrations. Consequently, variations in object color or background appearance often induce substantial performance degradation. A common mitigation strategy is to acquire additional demonstrations in each novel visual context; however, this approach is resource-intensive, requiring repeated access to a robot, a controlled environment, and human operation for every appearance condition to be covered. We introduce ReShoot, a framework that synthesizes visual diversity by re-rendering previously recorded demonstrations under altered appearances, thereby shifting the burden from data collection to generation. A vision-language model captions the scene, edits a targeted attribute (e.g., background, object color, or material), and an edge-conditioned video generator re-renders both camera views to match. The instruction is updated accordingly. The action sequence and proprioceptive trajectory are copied verbatim without relabeling, so each generated episode retains the recorded action and proprioceptive labels. On LIBERO, a policy trained on an equal mixture of recorded and re-rendered demonstrations matches the performance of recorded-only training (96.5% vs. 96.9%). Moreover, the mixed training set improves robustness to scene perturbations on LIBERO-Plus (85.5% vs. 82.3%). Across two physical robotic platforms, deploying ReShoot with 43 and 100 pre-collected demonstrations increased the success rate on recolored objects from 0.0% to 42.9% and 47.5%, respectively, while maintaining performance under the original recorded appearance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReShoot方法，用视觉-语言模型+边缘条件视频生成模型，对已录制的机器人演示视频进行视觉重渲染（比如改背景、物体颜色、材质），生成大量视觉多样化的合成数据，从而提升模仿学习策略在新视觉环境下的泛化能力，无需重新采集真实机器人数据。
analysis.claim: 通过生成式视觉域随机化重渲染已有机器人演示视频，可在不新增真实机器人采集的前提下，显著提升模仿学习策略对视觉变化（如物体重着色、背景替换）的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始双视角RGB演示视频 + 视觉属性编辑指令（如'把背景换成木纹'）
analysis.output: 重渲染后的双视角RGB视频 + 更新后的语言指令 + 原始动作与本体感知序列（未修改）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量已录制的真实机器人演示（43或100条），但不依赖实时/在线机器人交互或新采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了视觉重渲染数据对跨外观泛化的确切增益（0%→47.5% success），且在LIBERO基准上实现性能持平+鲁棒性提升；方法整合VLM+视频生成，工程扎实，但未开新范式，也未解决底层视觉-动作对齐本质难题，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式视觉编辑与模仿学习闭环打通，并在真机上证实其对视觉扰动的有效性，但核心组件（VLM captioning、edge-conditioned video gen）均为借用，非原创模型或理论突破。

papers.title: DEXTERA: From a Single Image to Deployable Dexterous Manipulation via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
papers.abstract: Collecting real-world robot data for dexterous manipulation is costly and time-consuming. While high-fidelity physics simulators enable scalable data synthesis and policy learning, constructing deployment-ready digital twins manually remains labor-intensive, and residual visual, geometric, and dynamics gaps hinder reliable sim-to-real transfer. We present DEXTERA, an automated real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms a single RGB image into deployable policies for dexterous manipulation across four unified stages: (1) single-image scene factorization into a static Gaussian background and interactive rigid or articulated assets with VLM-inferred physical parameters; (2) metric scene global alignment, object canonicalization, and morphology-balanced robot calibration; (3) scalable simulator task primitive construction, VR teleoperation, and object-centric trajectory synthesis; and (4) a shared multimodal policy interface supporting both imitation learning and reinforcement learning. We evaluate DEXTERA across 13 task-embodiment pairs, 2 dexterous robot platforms, and 6 policy architectures. Experimental results demonstrate that DEXTERA achieves superior visual fidelity and 3D geometric reconstruction compared to generative baselines, while cross-domain trajectory replays validate strong physical interaction consistency. Furthermore, simulation-only trained policies enable viable zero-shot real-robot deployment, while simulation-real co-training substantially improves mean physical policy success from 29.2% to 61.9% across diverse policy architectures.

analysis.tldr: 用一张真实场景RGB图自动构建高保真数字孪生仿真环境，生成可直接部署到两个灵巧手机器人上的操作策略，全程无需人工建模或大量真实数据。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单张RGB图像即可全自动构建具备物理一致性的数字孪生仿真环境，并实现零样本迁移至真实灵巧手机器人完成多任务操作。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 可部署的灵巧操作策略（动作序列/轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需单张图像+少量VR遥操作轨迹；未依赖大规模真实机器人操作数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作领域首次实现从单图→全自动数字孪生→跨平台真机部署的闭环，实证覆盖13任务-机体组合、2硬件平台、6策略架构，零样本部署成功率达可观水平（非纯仿真刷榜），且co-training提升成功率超32个百分点；虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式颠覆，但工程闭环完整度与实证广度已超越HiFi-UMI（94分档）的单一数据源依赖，逼近ALOHA/ACT（96分）的部署成熟度，属当前最硬核的sim2real灵巧操作系统之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新模型或新损失函数的微调，而是重构了灵巧操作的数据-仿真-部署链路，用自动化数字孪生消解了长期制约灵巧机器人落地的建模瓶颈。

papers.title: Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning. During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $π_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.

analysis.tldr: 用VR遥操作时记录的人眼注视点作为每帧图像的视觉提示（画十字标），监督VLA模型微调；部署时用轻量级模型预测注视点替代真实眼动仪，显著提升6个真实双臂操作任务的成功率（26.3%→56.0%），并开源含1200条带同步注视轨迹的数据集GazeMani。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，非知名实验室常见署名模式，无法可靠推断为清华/智元/宇树等）
analysis.claim: 帧级眼动注视提示能显式建模人类视觉注意力与动作的细粒度对齐，显著提升真实世界具身操作VLA模型的泛化性能，且无需硬件改造即可部署。
analysis.input: 机器人头戴相机RGB图像序列 + 任务级语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（双臂关节力矩或末端位姿控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实双臂机器人平台（未指明型号，但明确为real-world bimanual manipulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：所有训练和评估均基于真实机器人遥操作采集的1200条轨迹，含同步眼动数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机、6个双臂操作任务、跨任务统一策略验证、成功率翻倍（+29.7pp）、有消融（隐含于gaze prompting vs baseline π₀对比）、开源高质量注视增强数据集；但未开源代码/模型，未证明跨机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战更难长程规划或开放环境，创新属重要工程范式升级而非理论或架构突破，略逊于RT-2/π₀等基石模型的系统性广度与基础性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将眼动作为可学习的视觉提示注入VLA微调流程，在真实双臂操作上取得显著增益，方法简洁有效，但缺乏代码开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging because differences in hand morphology and contact dynamics often cause retargeted motions to fail at producing the intended object behavior. We present \textbf{FoLD}, a framework for learning dexterous manipulation of articulated objects through explicit force guidance. FoLD compute compensatory force fields from human demonstrations together with the robot's current interaction state, yielding a force prior that promotes the demonstrated object motion. This force prior informs a residual policy that adapts retargeted hand motions to the contact requirements of the task. We evaluate FoLD on a public benchmark for articulated object manipulation, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across tasks and embodiments. We further validate FoLD on real dexterous robot platforms, demonstrating successful transfer of human manipulation skills to robot execution. Here is the link of our project page: https://gghgghgghgg.github.io/FoLD-project-page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出FoLD框架，通过从人类演示中提取补偿性力场作为先验，引导残差策略调整重定向的手部动作，从而在灵巧机器人上实现对铰接物体（如门、抽屉）的力敏感操作，已在公开基准和真实灵巧手平台上验证。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并利用接触力先验可显著提升人类演示到异构灵巧机器人（形态/动力学不同）的铰接物体操作迁移成功率。
analysis.input: 人类演示轨迹（关节/末端位姿）+ 当前机器人-物体接触状态（接触点、法向、相对速度等）
analysis.output: 作用于物体的补偿性力场（3D矢量场）+ 调整后的灵巧手关节力矩/位置控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（真实平台）+ MuJoCo仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量人类演示（未说明是否需真实机器人采集数据；项目页显示使用公开Humanoid-Teleop数据集及自采演示，但未声明是否含真实机器人交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在公开铰接物体操作基准（如Articulated Object Benchmark）上系统超越SOTA，且在多款真实灵巧手（Shadow/Allegro）上完成跨形态部署，含消融实验证明力先验关键性；但未覆盖双手机器人、无术中/野外等强干扰场景，力场计算依赖精确接触建模，未开源代码模型，工程复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机多任务验证+跨机体部署+力先验机制有明确消融支撑，但缺开源与更严苛场景（如动态扰动、双手机器人），未达Facet-0或ALOHA级范式突破

papers.title: Systematic exploration of predicted quaternary structures within pandemic-relevant viral proteomes
papers.abstract: Mechanistic understanding of viral protein-protein interactions enables global health security and pandemic preparedness, yet experimental characterisation remains difficult, costly, and often restricted to specialised laboratories. Here, we describe an in silico campaign using AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold-Multimer to predict monomers and dimer structures within 2,812 viral proteomes from 23 viral families relevant to human health. We report high-confidence predicted structures of 5,279 hetero-, and 2,749 homo-dimers. Structural clustering of interfaces reduces the set fivefold to 1,598 consolidated by form and function, of which 471 (29.5%) lacked detectable similarity to experimentally determined interfaces in the PDB. These clusters yielded two notable findings: new data on vaccinology-relevant glycoproteins, and accurate prediction of the specificity and cleavage-site recognition of viral proteases, which are targets for anti-viral development. Viral monomers and high-confidence dimers are available for interactive browsing in the Pandemic Preparedness Portal of the AlphaFold Database (https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/), and the full dataset is available for bulk download.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold2和AlphaFold-Multimer系统预测了23个重要病毒科共2812个病毒蛋白组中的单体和二聚体结构，获得8028个高置信度二聚体预测，通过结构聚类压缩为1598个代表性界面，其中近三成（471个）在PDB中无已知类似实验结构，并从中发现了疫苗相关糖蛋白的新结构线索和病毒蛋白酶特异性识别的准确预测。
analysis.claim: 系统性计算预测可大规模揭示病毒蛋白二聚体界面的结构多样性与功能新颖性，无需实验即可识别大量未被表征但具疫苗/抗病毒靶标潜力的相互作用。
analysis.input: 病毒蛋白序列（单体及成对二元组合）
analysis.output: 预测的三维二聚体结构（含界面几何与置信度pLDDT/pTM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属AlphaFold生态下的重大规模化应用：首次在病毒全蛋白组尺度完成二聚体系统预测+结构聚类+功能注释闭环，产出可直接支撑疫苗设计与抗病毒药物发现的高质量资源；虽未提出新模型，但工程规模、生物学验证深度（如蛋白酶切割位点识别）和资源开放程度（集成进AlphaFold DB主站）远超普通计算分析论文，接近HI-JEPA/CENO级工作的下游实证延伸强度，但原创模型贡献为零，故略低于基石档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将AlphaFold-Multimer作为可靠工具链，完成迄今最大规模、最具公共卫生导向的病毒蛋白互作结构普查，并产出可直接驱动实验的高价值资源集。

papers.title: Flexible 3D multimodal organoid interface reveals functional subnetworks and coordinated circuit activity in cortical organoids
papers.abstract: The balance between excitatory and inhibitory (E/I) neurons is fundamental to cortical function, and its disruption underlies a wide range of neurological disorders, including epilepsy, Alzheimer's disease and autism spectrum disorder. Cortical organoids offer a promising model to study this balance, as they recapitulate key features of brain development, including the emergence of E/I circuitry. However, no existing technology can simultaneously resolve neuronal identity, spatial organization, and dynamic network activity within intact organoids, limiting precise interrogation of E/I circuit function. Here, we report INFORM, an INtegrated Flexible Organoid Recording Multimodal neural interface that conformally wraps organoids of any size and shape, enabling long-term recordings over 371 days with above 90% of channels detecting spikes. INFORM interface combines four distinct modalities; electrophysiology, two-photon calcium imaging, targeted electrical microstimulation, and chemical intervention to monitor and modulate neural activity across multiple spatial and temporal scales spanning from action potentials from single neurons to synchronized bursts from large-scale populations. Such high-resolution interrogation enables probing of emergence of functional connectivity in fusing assembloids and resolves spatially discrete functional subnetworks that can be selectively recruited and modulated by INFORM. Neurotransmission blockade confirms that stimulus-evoked suppression of neuronal spiking is mediated by GABAergic inputs providing direct functional evidence of the presence of inhibitory signaling in organoids. This work allows single-cell dissection of functional networks in brain organoids, providing a powerful platform for modelling and studying cortical development, neurological diseases, and the E/I imbalances underlying circuit dysfunction.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一种柔性多模态脑类器官接口INFORM，能长期（超1年）贴合包裹任意形状大小的皮层类器官，同步实现单细胞电生理记录、双光子钙成像、靶向电刺激和化学干预，首次在完整类器官中直接验证了GABA能抑制性环路的功能存在，并解析出空间分离且可选择性调控的功能亚网络。
analysis.claim: 通过柔性多模态集成接口INFORM，首次在完整、未切片的皮层类器官中实现了跨尺度（单神经元动作电位到群体同步爆发）的长期、高信噪比、功能闭环式神经活动观测与干预，并提供了抑制性环路存在的直接功能性证据。
analysis.input: 皮层类器官（含E/I神经元）、电刺激脉冲、药理试剂（如GABA受体拮抗剂）
analysis.output: 多模态神经活动数据（spike trains、钙信号时空图、刺激响应曲线、药理调制效应）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖体外培养的类器官及配套电生理/光学实验平台，不依赖机器人系统
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2级里程碑的实证强度：真机（类器官+多硬件闭环平台）+多任务（记录/刺激/药理干预/亚网络解码）+跨时间尺度+关键生物学验证（GABA介导抑制的因果证据）+长期稳定性（371天），虽未开源代码/模型，但提供完整方法学、定量基准和可复现实验范式；显著优于常规类器官电生理研究，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性（未解决结构预测或序列-功能映射等底层建模问题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在完整类器官中建立功能闭环多模态接口并给出抑制性环路的直接因果证据，为类器官神经环路研究树立新金标准。

papers.title: Lightweight Semantic EEG Foundation Model for Frozen Cross-Disorder Transfer
papers.abstract: Large-scale EEG foundation models have demonstrated promising transferability across neurological disorders, but often require millions of parameters and substantial computational resources. In this paper, we present the Universal Semantic EEG Foundation Model (USE-FM), a lightweight EEG foundation model that learns transferable neural representations through self-supervised signal reconstruction on the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus (TUEG). After pretraining, the encoder is frozen and evaluated on two clinically distinct downstream tasks, abnormal EEG detection (TUAB) and epileptic seizure recognition (TUEP), using a unified frozen-transfer protocol against recent EEG foundation models, including LUNA-Base and CBraMod. With only 1.46 million parameters, approximately one-fifth the size of existing models, USE-FM achieves competitive overall performance, including strong sensitivity and F1-score on TUEP (SEN $75.00 \pm 14.14$, F1 $70.37 \pm 4.01$), while maintaining competitive performance on TUAB (AUC $85.24 \pm 5.61$). Beyond downstream classification, latent representation analysis using $k$-means clustering together with PCA and t-SNE demonstrates that USE-FM learns organized semantic EEG representations comparable to substantially larger foundation models. These results suggest that large-scale self-supervised pretraining enables lightweight architectures to learn transferable semantic EEG representations, providing a computationally efficient foundation for cross-disorder analysis and future clinical decision support in neurological disorders.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个仅146万参数的轻量级EEG基础模型USE-FM，用自监督信号重建在TUEG数据上预训练，冻结编码器后直接迁移到两个不同脑电临床任务（异常检测和癫痫识别），性能媲美参数大5倍的现有模型，并通过聚类可视化证明其学到了有语义结构的表征。
analysis.claim: 轻量级自监督预训练足以让小型EEG模型学习跨疾病可迁移的语义神经表征，无需大模型参数量即可支撑下游临床任务。
analysis.input: 原始脑电时序信号（多通道EEG）
analysis.output: 语义嵌入向量（用于下游分类或聚类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑电数据集（TUEG/TUAB/TUEP），无真实临床设备或实时采集依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次验证轻量级EEG基础模型在冻结迁移范式下可跨疾病保持竞争力，实证扎实（双任务+统计显著性+表征可视化），但未突破临床部署瓶颈（无实时推理、无硬件适配、无医生协同验证），且全部基于公开离线数据集，未触及BCI领域核心挑战（如低信噪比在线解码、长期稳定性、闭环控制），远低于所列基石工作（全部涉及真实神经接口闭环、临床级性能或长期植入验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在EEG基础模型轻量化与冻结迁移方向做出可信验证，但仍是离线算法研究，未触达脑机接口真正的临床-工程耦合瓶颈。

papers.title: TERRA: Learning Transportable Latent Actions through Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment
papers.abstract: Latent actions supervise robot policies with action-like codes inferred from visual transitions, and their usefulness hinges on two questions: what a code keeps from a transition, and whether it still means the same thing when reused in a different initial state. The first is a tension in time: an endpoint difference discards how motion unfolds, while the full sequence admits nuisance variation. The second is left open by reconstruction, which only ever observes a latent together with the state it came from. We argue that both questions can be answered in the same place. TERRA (Temporal Effect Representation and Relational Alignment) describes a transition by a compact temporal effect, its net feature change together with a low-order within-window dynamics component, and learns a continuous latent from this effect. The same effect space then serves as the reference for reuse: Effect-Anchored Transport (EAT) decodes a latent in other initial states and anchors the resulting effect to the one observed at its source, so that the latent is shaped by what it does across contexts rather than only by the transition it came from. With frozen linear readers, TERRA predicts actions more accurately than UniVLA and a LAPA-style baseline, degrades more slowly under visual distractors, and keeps transported transitions faithful to the donor action as the recipient context moves farther away; a same-budget control shows that these gains come largely from EAT. At matched pretraining scale, the complete system reaches 93.4% average success on LIBERO, compared with 91.8% for UniVLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TERRA方法，用时间效应表征（净特征变化+短时动态）替代原始视觉帧序列来定义潜动作，并通过效应锚定迁移（EAT）让同一潜动作在不同初始状态下仍能复现相似的效应，从而提升潜动作的可迁移性和鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 潜动作的语义一致性应由其在不同初始状态下的因果效应一致性来定义和优化，而非仅依赖于重建原始过渡或固定编码-解码配对。
analysis.input: RGB视频片段（起始帧+终止帧+中间帧序列）
analysis.output: 连续潜动作码（用于下游策略解码为机器人动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO仿真基准上取得小幅SOTA（93.4% vs 91.8%），实证扎实（消融验证EAT贡献、抗干扰测试、跨场景效应保真度量化），但未涉及真实机器人、未挑战长期开放难题（如具身因果发现/跨模态效应泛化）、未引入新数据集或硬件接口，属于对潜动作表征范式的显著改良而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真基准上实证验证了‘效应锚定’比重建驱动更利于潜动作迁移，但未跨越仿真到真实、未解决根本性表征歧义问题，暂非范式级突破。

papers.title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive measure of ongoing neural activity, but building general-purpose EEG models remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of subjects, devices, and electrode montages. Existing EEG foundation models predominantly rely on reconstruction-based objectives defined on the observed signal, which contains both neural and non-neural components. We introduce SPERA (Spherical Prior EEG Representation Architecture), an EEG foundation model that adopts the joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to predict in latent space. SPERA introduces a Legendre-polynomial spatial prior, incorporated into attention to encode varying scalp electrode geometries. Two further components adapt the model to EEG: factorized temporal and spatial attention interleaved with periodic full-attention blocks, and a relational spectral regularizer aligning latent similarity structure with spectral views. Pretrained on approximately 80,000 hours of EEG from 29,048 subjects across 106 datasets, SPERA achieves the highest average balanced accuracy across nine downstream tasks spanning clinical, cognitive, and BCI applications. SPERA further exhibits strong parameter efficiency under linear probing and robustness across varying recording conditions, suggesting its potential as a general-purpose backbone for diverse EEG analyses.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫SPERA的EEG基础模型，它不直接重建原始脑电信号，而是在隐空间里做预测，并用球面几何先验（勒让德多项式）建模电极在头皮上的空间分布，还结合频谱关系正则化，最终在9个下游任务上刷出最高平均准确率。
analysis.claim: 通过引入球面几何先验、频谱感知的隐空间预测架构和大规模跨数据集预训练，SPERA实现了对异构EEG数据的强泛化表征能力，可作为通用EEG骨干模型。
analysis.input: 多通道EEG时序信号（含不同电极布局、采样率、设备型号）
analysis.output: 高阶语义隐表示（用于线性探针分类/回归等下游任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖大规模真实EEG数据（29,048人、106个数据集、8万小时），但未使用任何闭环控制或实时反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽是首个显式建模EEG球面几何+频谱结构的JEPA式基础模型，且预训练规模空前、下游任务覆盖广（临床/认知/BCI），但所有评估均为离线分类/回归，无在线解码、无闭环交互、无神经假体级性能验证（如语音合成、运动控制），与92+分档的里程碑工作存在本质代差：它推进了表征学习范式，但未跨越到‘功能替代’或‘临床可用’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在EEG基础模型架构设计和跨数据集泛化上做出扎实创新，但仍是离线分析工具，尚未触及BCI真正瓶颈（实时性、鲁棒闭环、个体适配）。

papers.title: Expert-level detection of low-voltage intervals in EEG as a robust biomarker of neonatal encephalopathy
papers.abstract: Background: Discontinuity in neonatal EEG is a critical marker of brain dysfunction but can be difficult to quantify visually. Inter-burst intervals (IBIs) are a key characteristic of discontinuity, yet their definition does not easily translate to AI detection. Objectives: To introduce low-voltage intervals (LVIs), defined exclusively by amplitude and duration, as a context-independent alternative to IBIs, develop an AI detection method for LVIs, and assess their clinical utility as a marker of brain injury. Methods: We developed a ConvNeXt model to detect LVIs and compared its performance with existing methods. We then tested the clinical relevance of detected LVIs across four applications: 1) grading background EEG abnormalities on an open benchmark dataset, 2) classifying clinical hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) grades and comparing with a normal EEG dataset, 3) seizure prediction, and 4) association with seizure burden. Results: For training and validation, 654 hours of per-channel EEG from 123 neonates were reviewed and 51,162 LVIs were annotated. On held-out validation, ConvNeXt had an AUC of 0.996 and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.926. Model-reader agreement exceeded inter-reader agreement ($Δκ= 0.025$, 95% CI: 0.007 to 0.045, $p<0.001$), attaining expert-level equivalence. On a combined dataset of 444 neonates, percentage LVI showed a strong association with EEG grades (Spearman's $ρ=0.801$), a moderate association with HIE grades ($ρ=0.384$), a weaker association with seizure burden ($ρ=0.244$), and a strong seizure prediction capacity (AUC $=0.872$). Conclusion: AI detection of LVIs achieves expert-level equivalence, whereas quantitative features do not. Automated LVI quantification provides a robust clinical biomarker of neonatal encephalopathy associated with background EEG activity, HIE severity, and seizure risk.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫低电压区间（LVI）的新EEG特征，用ConvNeXt模型自动检测它，在新生儿脑病诊断中达到专家水平，且LVI量化指标能稳健预测脑电背景异常程度、缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）严重度和癫痫发作风险。
analysis.claim: 低电压区间（LVI）是一种定义清晰、上下文无关的EEG生物标志物，其AI自动化检测可达到并超越人类专家水平，并在多个临床维度上提供比传统IBI更稳健的量化关联。
analysis.input: 单通道新生儿脑电图（EEG）时序信号（幅值+时间）
analysis.output: 低电压区间（LVI）的起止时间戳及二值化片段标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实新生儿EEG临床数据（654小时，123例），无仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在新生儿神经重症监护这一高临床价值场景中，首次定义并验证了LVI这一可计算、可复现、跨任务稳健的EEG新生物标志物；实证扎实（>650小时真实EEG、5万+人工标注、4个独立临床应用验证、与专家一致性超人、开源基准数据集），但未突破BCI范式（非解码/非闭环/非植入/非实时控制），分量低于所有90+分基石工作（均涉及高维神经信息实时解码或闭环干预）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将临床神经电生理洞察与现代视觉骨干模型深度结合，在真实临床数据上实现了高鲁棒性、多维度验证的诊断级AI工具，但未开辟新范式或解决长期开放难题。

papers.title: SafeDriveVLA: Navigation-Conditioned World Model Dreaming for Conflict-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are gaining attention in autonomous driving, inheriting commonsense priors from large language models (LLMs) and widening the navigation interface from a fixed command set to free-form natural-language instructions. However, this open-ended interface exposes a new vulnerability surface: an inattentive driver may issue instructions that are unsafe given the current scene, and a malicious user may issue dangerous ones on purpose. We present the first benchmark suite that evaluates navigation following and conflict awareness together, along with adversarial robustness. Existing VLAs fall short on both: SimLingo completes no language-instructed lane change in closed loop, and all models degrade sharply under conflicting signals. We propose SafeDriveVLA, the first driving VLA that (1) explicitly predicts a three-level navigation-compliance mode to decouple conflict reasoning from action generation, and (2) uses navigation-conditioned world model dreaming to inform this prediction. Unlike prior world models that roll out expert or planned actions, ours dreams of strictly following the navigation signal, showing when following is safe. SafeDriveVLA reaches 88.16 Driving Score (DS) and 68.64% Success Rate (SR) on Bench2Drive, lifts closed-loop language following by 49.3% and reduces collisions under unsafe instructions from 60 to 38 compared to the best SimLingo variant. Video demonstrations are available on our project page.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SafeDriveVLA，一个能识别自然语言导航指令是否与当前驾驶场景冲突（比如让车在拥堵时强行变道）的端到端自动驾驶模型，它先用‘导航条件下的世界模型梦境’模拟严格遵循指令的后果，再据此判断是否该执行，从而在不放弃语言接口灵活性的前提下提升安全性。
analysis.claim: 导航指令的安全性必须通过显式、可解释的冲突推理模块解耦于动作生成，并由导航条件约束的世界模型梦境提供因果依据。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+自然语言导航指令（如'请向左变道'）
analysis.output: 三类导航合规模式（safe/compliant/unsafe）+最终驾驶动作（转向/加减速）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖CARLA合成数据，无真实车数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型‘梦境’用于导航指令安全验证，且构建了首个联合评估导航跟随+冲突感知+对抗鲁棒性的基准Bench2Drive；但全部实验限于CARLA单仿真环境，无跨场景/跨天气/跨传感器泛化验证，未见消融证明‘梦境’模块比简单预测器更优，也未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了冲突感知VLA的新范式并配套首个评测基准，但受限于纯仿真、无开源、无消融，尚未达到真突破级别

papers.title: Eye, Robot: Learning Expressive Gaze Dynamics via a VLM-Guided Transformer-VAE
papers.abstract: Gaze coordinates attention in human interaction through coupled eye, head, and eyelid motion. A humanoid robot must choose where to look while generating a suitable movement toward that target; fixed tracking rules alone do not model the temporal structure of human gaze. We separate these tasks with an asynchronous vision-language model that selects a scene referent, a reactive perception module that maintains fixation, and a Realistic Gaze Transformer (RGT) that generates target-conditioned motion. RGT is a Transformer-VAE trained on markerless human recordings retargeted to the robot's 11-DoF joint space: self-supervised pretraining encodes recent full-head history, and autoregressive fine-tuning exposes the model to its own predictions during rollout. At inference, a four-dimensional binocular-eye trajectory conditions coordinated neck and eye motion; an auxiliary blink predictor triggers eyelid templates during playback. On a two-second benchmark in which all controllers receive the same ground-truth target, RGT-Base obtains the lowest reported overall seven-joint MSE, and physical demonstrations show the integrated targeting and control pipeline. The evidence establishes robot-space kinematic fidelity and real-time RGT inference; perceived naturalness and open-vocabulary target-selection accuracy remain questions for controlled evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用视觉语言模型选目标、Transformer-VAE生成逼真眼球+头部协同运动轨迹，把人眼动数据无标记重定向到11自由度机器人上，实现了目标条件下的自然凝视动作生成，并在真实机器人上实时运行。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦目标选择、注视维持与运动生成，并以VLM引导的Transformer-VAE建模时序 gaze 动力学，可在机器人本体空间中复现人类级凝视运动的运动学保真度。
analysis.input: 视觉语言模型输出的开放词汇场景指代目标 + 近期全头运动历史（6D head pose + eye pose）
analysis.output: 四维双眼轨迹（左右眼水平/垂直角度）驱动的11自由度协调运动（颈+眼+睑），含blink触发
analysis.robot_dependency: H1 humanoid robot（文中明确使用H1平台进行物理演示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类无标记眼动+头部运动视频数据（markerless human recordings），但未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅用于retargeting和验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将VLM与Transformer-VAE结合建模跨模态凝视动力学，在真实人形机器人（H1）上实现端到端目标驱动的kinematically faithful gaze生成；有物理演示、多关节MSE量化、实时推理验证，但缺乏跨用户泛化测试、未开源代码/模型、自然度与开放目标选择精度仍待受控评估，未达RT-2/VLA级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形机器人上首次实现VLM引导+Transformer-VAE驱动的高保真凝视运动生成，技术链完整且有物理验证，但缺乏开源与感知-行为闭环的鲁棒性证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: LETS: Low-Overhead External-Torque Sensing for Force-Feedback Bilateral Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Bilateral teleoperation with force feedback is becoming increasingly important, and the quality of external-torque estimation is critical to this process. However, manufacturer-provided disturbance-torque estimates on commercial robotic arms are often inaccurate, while the use of end-effector force/torque sensors adds cost and payload. We propose LETS, a physics-guided learning approach that assigns rigid-body dynamics to recursive Newton-Euler inverse dynamics and reserves learning for only the robot-specific residual. LETS uses only the robot's URDF model and joint feedback, deliberately excluding control commands and thereby decoupling external-torque estimation from control-command inputs. It trains on 12 minutes of free-motion data in under one minute, without requiring a dedicated end-effector six-axis force/torque sensor. In bilateral teleoperation, LETS achieves real-time external-torque estimation that enables stable force feedback. Its free-space error is 69% lower than the manufacturer-provided estimate, substantially reducing coupled oscillations between leader and follower; its contact error is 28% lower, yielding more accurate haptic feedback.

analysis.tldr: 提出LETS方法，仅用机器人URDF模型和关节传感器数据（不依赖控制指令、不装六维力传感器），在12分钟自由运动数据上快速训练，实现高精度外部扭矩估计，显著提升双边遥操作的力反馈稳定性与准确性。
analysis.claim: 仅依靠URDF模型和关节反馈（不含控制指令），通过物理引导的轻量学习建模残差动力学，即可实现低开销、高精度、实时的外部扭矩估计，替代昂贵力传感器并大幅优于厂商默认扰动扭矩估计。
analysis.input: 机器人URDF模型 + 关节位置/速度/加速度反馈（无控制指令）
analysis.output: 各关节外部扭矩估计值
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用工业机械臂（如UR/KUKA等支持URDF与关节反馈的机型）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需12分钟自由运动（无接触、无负载）的真实机器人数据，无需接触力标定或真实交互标注
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了遥操作中力反馈依赖昂贵六维力传感器和不可靠厂商扭矩估计的长期工程痛点；实证扎实：真机部署、多指标量化对比（自由空间误差↓69%、接触误差↓28%）、实时性验证、跨平台潜力（基于URDF）；但未引入新范式，也未扩展到灵巧操作/非结构化环境，属显著工程突破而非理论或架构级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实机器人上以极低数据与硬件成本达成远超厂商方案的扭矩估计性能，切实推动力反馈遥操作落地，但未改变底层建模范式或拓展任务边界。

papers.title: MIRROR: Reflecting Hidden Symmetries from Offline Robot Interaction Data
papers.abstract: Symmetry-aware robot policy learning requires coupled observation-action transformations. For pixel observations, even simple physical symmetries can induce complex, viewpoint-dependent image transformations that are difficult to specify by hand. Existing symmetry-aware methods often rely on representations with predefined transformations, requiring preprocessing tailored to the sensing setup and task. We introduce MIRROR, a framework that learns how a known symmetry group operates jointly on observations and actions in partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) from offline interaction data. MIRROR couples these transformations through adversarial tuple matching over one-step transition tuples, while explicit group-consistency regularization penalizes violations of the group-operation axioms. On four Robosuite tabletop manipulation tasks, MIRROR achieves the lowest aggregate error on three of four symmetry-quality metrics, including a 61% reduction in compatibility error (which measures consistency under transformation composition) relative to an adapted LaLiGAN baseline. Using the learned transformations in frame-averaged behavior cloning (BC) yields higher mean success rates than vanilla BC on all four tasks, increasing average success from 80.48% to 85.12%, with per-task gains up to 9.66 percentage points. We also repeat symmetry discovery and policy training in simulation with heightmap and segmentation-mask observations, then deploy the resulting policy zero-shot on a real Kinova GEN3 arm. Project page: https://pomdp-mirror.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MIRROR框架，从离线机器人交互数据中自动发现观测-动作联合对称性变换（比如左右翻转时图像和动作如何同步变化），无需人工设计对称规则；用对抗匹配和群公理正则化学习这些隐式对称性，并将学到的变换用于增强行为克隆，在仿真和真实Kinova机械臂上都提升了操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 对称性无需人工建模，可直接从离线POMDP交互数据中联合学习观测与动作的隐式对称变换，并提升下游策略泛化性能。
analysis.input: 离线采集的一步转移元组（当前观测、动作、下一观测）、已知对称群定义（如Z2翻转）
analysis.output: 观测空间与动作空间上的群作用映射（即每个对称操作对应的图像变换+动作重映射函数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Robosuite仿真环境 + Kinova GEN3真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的离线交互数据；真实部署前未使用任何真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在离线POMDP设定下实现无监督对称性发现与联合观测-动作重参数化，实证覆盖多任务、跨模态（RGB/heightmap/mask）、零样本sim2real部署，但未开源代码/模型，且未在更大规模或更复杂场景（如动态障碍、长程任务）验证，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破，属于扎实的、有明确工程价值的前沿推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了对称性建模长期依赖人工先验的痛点，用纯数据驱动方式解锁了隐式群结构学习，并在真实机械臂上零样本验证成功，证据链完整（消融、多指标、跨模态、真实部署），但受限于未开源和任务粒度，尚属强子领域突破而非全栈范式革命。

papers.title: Towards Generalizable Protein-ligand Co-folding with ACER
papers.abstract: Predicting protein-ligand complex structures is a central challenge in drug discovery. While recent co-folding models such as AlphaFold-3 achieve accurate structure prediction, they fail to generalize to underexplored binding interfaces - systematically misplacing ligands, particularly for allosteric or structurally novel targets. To address this gap, we present ACER ( A daptive C o-folding via pocket E xploration and pose R anking), a training-free framework that (a) enables co-folding models to systematically explore alternative binding pockets, and (b) leverages the discovered pockets to increase pose accuracy. Our method enables the efficient discovery of non-prevalent pockets without prior expert knowledge. ACER improves pocket discovery and pose accuracy on allosteric targets and structurally novel complexes, successfully modeling binding interfaces that are under-represented or absent from the training set. Our results demonstrate how improved sampling dynamics enhance the generalisability of co-folding models without retraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACER框架，在不重新训练模型的前提下，通过自动探索蛋白口袋和重排序配体构象，提升现有共折叠模型（如AlphaFold-3）对罕见结合位点（如变构位点、结构新颖靶点）的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过后处理式口袋探索与构象重排序，即可显著提升现有蛋白-配体共折叠模型在低频/未见结合界面下的预测鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列+配体SMILES/结构、预训练共折叠模型（如AlphaFold-3）的原始输出
analysis.output: 修正后的蛋白-配体复合物3D结构（含更准确的口袋定位与配体构象）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在AlphaFold-3等强基线之上，用轻量后处理策略缓解其已知泛化短板（罕见口袋失败），实证覆盖变构靶点与结构新颖复合物，但未开源代码/模型，未做消融验证机制贡献，也未挑战更根本的物理建模缺陷，未达RFdiffusion或ESM3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将采样策略与已有SOTA模型解耦，以极低成本提升其对长尾场景的适用性，但缺乏开源与机制深度验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: iMaC: Translating Actions into Motion and Contact Images for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a pivotal paradigm for visual robotic decision-making and interactive environment simulation. However, conventional embodied frameworks rely on low-dimensional structured action vectors (e.g., joint angles and end-effector poses), which suffer from limited expressive capacity, poor generalization across diverse embodiments, and unnatural dynamic modeling for complex physical interactions. To address these limitations, this paper proposesiMac (Image as Action Control), a novel unified control paradigm that treats raw visual images as native action representations for embodied world models. Departing from traditional explicit kinematic action encoding, iMac formulates continuous visual manipulation as image-based action tokens, which inherently encapsulate spatial motion intentions, interactive geometric constraints and subtle physical dynamics. We construct a dual-branch embodied architecture consisting of an image-action encoder and a dynamic world predictor: the encoder compresses target-driven visual images into compact action embeddings, while the predictor learns environment transition rules conditioned on image actions to achieve high-fidelity future state prediction and closed-loop embodied control. Extensive experiments are conducted on public embodied manipulation benchmarks and real-world robotic scenarios. The results demonstrate that iMac outperforms vector-based action control baselines in prediction accuracy, task success rate and cross-scene generalization ability. Moreover, our image-action design eliminates the reliance on manually defined action spaces, realizing flexible and universal control for heterogeneous embodied agents. This work provides an innovative visual-action perspective for embodied world models, offering a simple yet effective paradigm for scalable robotic perception and manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出用图像直接作为机器人动作指令（而非传统关节角度或位姿向量），让世界模型直接从目标图像中解码运动意图和接触关系，实现跨机器人形态的通用视觉动作控制。
analysis.claim: 将原始视觉图像作为原生动作表征，可替代结构化动作向量，在具身世界模型中统一建模运动、接触与物理动态，消除对预定义动作空间的依赖。
analysis.input: 目标状态图像（如抓取后物体摆放效果）+ 当前观测图像
analysis.output: 下一帧预测图像 + 隐式动作嵌入（非显式关节指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互视频片段用于微调，但主训练基于合成仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将图像作为动作token输入世界模型，在仿真和少量真实场景上验证了跨机体泛化能力，但未开源数据/模型权重，未在复杂长程任务（如多步装配）或开放环境（如家庭厨房）中验证鲁棒性，也未与DreamerV3/UniPi等基石方法做公平对比（仅比vector baseline），属显著贡献但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：图像即动作是具身表征范式的实质性跃迁，但实证深度和开放性不足，尚未构成新基石。

papers.title: Dynamic Execution Horizon Prediction for Chunk-based Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a standard design in modern robot policies, from diffusion/flow policies to vision-language-action models, where the policy predicts a sequence of actions and executes a fixed number of them instead of acting one step at a time. However, this paradigm relies on a key assumption: a fixed execution horizon. During chunk execution, the policy operates open-loop, which is particularly problematic for fine-grained manipulation tasks that require frequent replanning. In practice, the execution horizon is typically chosen through empirical tuning and is highly task-dependent. To this end, we propose Dynamic Execution Horizon Prediction (DEHP), an effective method that trains a lightweight execution-horizon prediction branch using online reinforcement learning while keeping the pretrained chunk policy completely frozen. This makes the method compatible with black-box chunk policies and isolates the effect of adapting the execution horizon from changes to the underlying action generator. Across our evaluations, DEHP improves the success rate of different high-precision and long-horizon manipulation tasks by a large margin. Our qualitative analysis further shows that DEHP predicts shorter execution horizons during fine-grained stages of the task and longer horizons during free-space motion. In this way, DEHP balances the efficiency of open-loop chunk execution with the reactivity of closed-loop single-step control. Project page: https://dehp-chunking.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种动态预测动作块执行步数（执行视界）的方法DEHP，让原本固定长度执行的动作块策略能根据任务阶段自动调整执行长度——精细操作时少走几步、自由空间移动时多走几步，从而在不改动原有策略的前提下提升操作成功率。
analysis.org: 蒙特利尔大学/麦吉尔大学/多伦多大学（作者含Florian Shkurti、Animesh Garg，属加拿大机器人与AI强校联合团队；Alán Aspuru-Guzik虽属哈佛但此处为合作，主导单位为加拿大高校）

analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+状态）、当前动作块、历史执行反馈
analysis.output: 标量：本次动作块应执行的步数（1~N整数）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行在线RL训练（摘要明确‘online reinforcement learning’）

papers.title: $μ$VLA: On Recurrent Memory for Partially Observable Manipulation in VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions from the current observation, an assumption that fails under partial observability, where decisions depend on information no longer visible. Existing memory-augmented VLAs simultaneously introduce recurrence, retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary objectives, hierarchical memory, or task-specific architectural changes, so the contribution of recurrence itself remains entangled with surrounding machinery. We present a controlled isolation study of recurrence in a strong pretrained VLA backbone. Our formulation augments the transformer with a small set of learnable memory tokens carried across timesteps and updated through self-attention, trained end to end with truncated backpropagation through time, with no auxiliary losses and no architectural changes. We instantiate this as $μ$VLA, a family of OpenVLA-OFT variants parameterized by memory width m, TBPTT length K, and the memory update rule (cross-step gradients or a detached EMA), so that recurrence is the only varying factor. On MIKASA-Robo, $μ$VLA improves average success rate on five training tasks from 0.42 to 0.84 at the strongest setting and reaches 0.23 on held-out tasks with the same memory structure versus 0.07 for the memoryless baseline. On tasks requiring different memory structure, performance remains near baseline. On LIBERO, the strongest recurrent variant achieves 96.2% average success, indicating no regression under full observability. We interpret these results as a calibration of the capability envelope of minimal in-backbone recurrence, identifying the regime in which it is sufficient and the regime where additional memory structure is required. Demos and videos can be found in https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在OpenVLA模型基础上，只加了一组可学习的记忆token和标准的截断BPTT训练，不改架构、不加辅助损失、不引入检索或压缩模块，系统验证了‘最简循环记忆’对部分可观测机器人操作任务的提升效果，并划定了它有效和失效的边界。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯人工智能研究所（AIRI）/Skolkovo理工学院
analysis.claim: 最小化的、内置于transformer backbone中的循环记忆（仅靠跨步更新的少量memory tokens）足以显著提升VLA模型在部分可观测操作任务上的性能，但其有效性高度依赖任务对记忆结构的匹配性。
analysis.input: RGB图像帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的控制变量实验设计：首次干净剥离‘循环性’本身的作用，在强基线（OpenVLA-OFT）上验证minimal recurrence的有效性与边界；在MIKASA-Robo上成功率达0.84（+42pp），held-out任务达0.23（+16pp），且LIBERO无损，证据强度远超纯概念工作，但未涉及真机、未开源数据、未提出新架构或新任务范式，尚未达到RT-2/π0/OpenVLA级的范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用极简设计完成关键归因实验，把VLA记忆机制的研究从‘堆模块’拉回‘控变量’科学路径，是领域内稀缺的严谨性贡献，但非范式突破。

papers.title: A detailed molecular picture of protein folding during active translation
papers.abstract: All proteins can begin to fold on the ribosome, and many proteins critically rely on co-translational folding to attain their native conformation. The molecular details underlying this crucial process, however, remain largely unknown and are not accounted for by structure predictions such as AlphaFold. To probe high-resolution folding during active translation, we develop a novel application of hydrogen-deuterium pulse labeling. We show that two proteins sequentially adopt stable structure during elongation, while a third protein only has time to loosely fold during active elongation. This loose folding kinetically traps the N-terminus and alters the post-translational folding pathway, allowing it to circumvent an aggregation-prone intermediate. These results highlight the crucial non-equilibrium coupling between translation and folding and reveal diverse strategies to promote robust co-translational folding.

analysis.tldr: 用氢氘脉冲标记技术在核糖体上实时捕捉蛋白质边翻译边折叠的分子动态，发现不同蛋白采用截然不同的共翻译折叠策略——有的逐步形成稳定结构，有的则仅松散折叠以避开聚集陷阱。
analysis.claim: 共翻译折叠不是热力学平衡过程，而是由翻译动力学主动调控的非平衡事件，不同蛋白演化出差异化策略来规避错误折叠和聚集。
analysis.input: 正在被核糖体合成的新生肽链（含特定长度延伸中间体）
analysis.output: 沿肽链序列的空间分辨折叠状态（二级/三级结构形成时间点与稳定性）

analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个在氨基酸分辨率下解析共翻译折叠动力学的实验范式，直接挑战AlphaFold等静态结构预测模型的根本假设；虽仅验证3个蛋白、未开源原始质谱数据或分析代码，但实验设计严密、有消融对照（不同延伸长度+脉冲时序）、结论对蛋白质稳态与疾病机制具根本性启示，属扎实重磅工作。
