analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（抓取/定位/装配类）、量化轨迹偏差降低29–79%、引入状态空间压缩新指标关联到策略训练潜力；但未跨机体/跨用户验证，硬件定制性强（32-DoF指尖显示器非通用方案），未开源代码或数据，未与SOTA自主策略（如ACT/Diffusion Policy）联合验证训练增益，故略低于ALOHA/ACT（96）和T-Rex（97）等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实遥操作系统中首次系统验证分布式触觉反馈对运动灵巧性与策略可训性的双重提升，硬件闭环严谨，但缺乏开源与泛化验证，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models
papers.abstract: A common strategy for scaling world models is to train on more crawled video with more compute. We argue that this strategy is inefficient: scaling world models also requires a recursive data engine that offers grounded reward signals. The success of code agents illustrates why this matters. As code is executable, compilers and runtimes can provide high-quality rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training of LLMs. By contrast, spatial generation still relies largely on fuzzy proxies such as CLIP scores. These signals are fuzzy and biased, making them hard to support RL post-training. Compared with these, game development provides a missing reward environment for spatial world models. A scene encoded by a game engine is an executable world specification: the engine can efficiently check collision, physics, navigability and bounded playability, while the developer provides the global verification signal by judging whether the scene should be accepted. Game development also provides real-world long-horizon trajectory data for RL post-training. We therefore propose Reinforcement Learning with Human-Engine Verification (RLHEV), a post-training paradigm that combines dense engine signals with implicit human acceptance feedback from the development process.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用游戏开发过程作为可验证的轨迹数据引擎来训练世界模型，核心是把游戏引擎（如Unity/Unreal）当作物理和逻辑可执行的‘世界编译器’，用引擎自动检测碰撞、导航性等信号 + 开发者人工验收反馈，构建带密集奖励的长时序空间轨迹数据，用于大模型的世界模型后训练。
analysis.claim: 游戏开发天然构成一个可执行、可验证、带人类隐式反馈的长时序空间世界建模数据引擎，比纯视频爬取或CLIP打分等模糊代理信号更适配世界模型的强化学习后训练。
analysis.input: 自然语言场景描述 + 游戏开发交互行为序列（如编辑器操作、参数调整、测试运行）
analysis.output: 可执行的游戏场景（含物理、碰撞、导航约束）及对应的人类验收标签与引擎自检信号（如collision-free率、playable-step数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于游戏引擎仿真与人类开发行为日志
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的类比（游戏引擎≈世界编译器），但全文无实证：未发布任何数据集、未报告具体世界模型性能提升、无对比基线（如vs. DreamerV3/Genie）、无消融验证引擎信号有效性；仅停留在范式提案和流程描述层面，未突破‘可验证空间奖励’这一长期难题（如未解决人类反馈稀疏性、引擎信号与真实世界语义鸿沟等实质瓶颈）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——用游戏开发类比世界模型训练很有洞察力，但零实证支撑，未提供可复现数据、模型或性能增益，属于高潜力方向上的空转提案

papers.title: GlanceWAM: Sparse Test-Time Imagination for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: Video generative models provide rich physical priors for robot learning, yet existing world-action models (WAMs) face a fundamental trade-off: synchronous video generation at control rate is latency-prohibitive, while abandoning test-time visual imagination sacrifices task success. We show that visual imagination achieves both real-time inference and superior success rates when generated asynchronously off the critical path and consumed directly in latent space. We introduce GlanceWAM, which decouples imagination from control within a single video DiT: an asynchronous proposer glances ahead on a slow clock to imagine a single lookahead frame seconds into the future in the background, while an action head decodes action chunks at control rate (48 ms) purely in latent space without blocking. Enabled by a non-interfering attention mask that isolates video representations and staleness-robust horizon training that accommodates asynchronous lookahead aging, GlanceWAM breaks the speed-success dilemma. Trained purely on demonstrations, it attains 72.2% on the 24-task RoboCasa kitchen benchmark (surpassing synchronous Cosmos Policy at 67.1% and imagination-free co-training at 64.4%) and 99.0% on LIBERO, executing at 48 ms per chunk on an NVIDIA A100 GPU (24x faster than synchronous baselines). Code is available at https://github.com/linhanwang/GlanceWAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出GlanceWAM，让机器人世界-动作模型在测试时异步、稀疏地生成未来帧（只生成1帧、慢节奏、不阻塞控制），用latent空间直接消费该帧信息来决策，从而在保持48ms实时控制的同时大幅提升任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，通讯或主页信息不可得；虽有清华拼音名但无署名机构佐证）
analysis.claim: 视觉想象无需同步于控制周期也能有效提升机器人策略性能，关键在于将其移出关键路径、以稀疏异步方式在latent空间中低开销消费。
analysis.input: 当前观测视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真演示数据（no real-robot data used）
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboCasa和LIBERO两个主流具身智能仿真基准上显著超越同期SOTA（+5.1%和+0.3%），且实证了‘异步稀疏想象’这一新设计范式对latency-success权衡的实质性突破；但未涉及真实机器人、未验证跨机体/跨用户泛化、未开源数据与模型权重，尚未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的系统性奠基地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真基准上扎实优化了世界模型的推理架构，解决了实际部署中的关键延迟瓶颈，但仍是仿真内闭环，未触达真实具身系统的复杂性。

papers.title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
papers.abstract: Explorable image-to-scene generation is essential for applications in gaming, robotics, and virtual reality. Existing methods based on video diffusion model (VDM) commonly rely on incomplete conditioning signals such as sparse point clouds or 2D panoramas, leading to stochastic hallucinations, long-term drifts and suboptimal 3D consistency. We present SpatialCrafter, a novel two-stage framework that addresses these issues by introducing a global 3D proxy for high-fidelity image-to-scene generation. Specifically, we decompose the generation process into global proxy generation and appearance refinement. For proxy generation, we propose a Point-anchored Sparse Structure~(PaSS) Flow module that predicts a spatially aligned and geometrically consistent 3D proxy. For appearance refinement, we re-frame the VDM as a Generative Deferred Refiner which synthesizes high-frequency photorealistic details upon proxy-defined scene geometry. To better integrate the proxy with the pre-trained VDM, we introduce Parallel Geometry Injection and Proxy-Aware Corruption training strategies, which improve robustness to proxy artifacts without disrupting the pretrained generative manifold. Furthermore, as no suitable dataset exists for this explorable scene generation task, we construct a new large-scale dataset of 115K scenes. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first hybrid dataset for image-to-scene generation. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that SpatialCrafter outperforms state-of-the-art methods, mitigates long-term drift, and remains robust and consistent under rapid camera motion and extreme viewpoint changes. Code, models, and the newly constructed dataset will be publicly released. See more at https://fangchuan.github.io/SpatialCrafter/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SpatialCrafter，用单张图像生成可自由探索的3D场景：先生成一个几何一致的稀疏3D代理（PaSS Flow），再用改进的视频扩散模型在其上叠加真实感纹理细节，解决了现有方法因条件信号不全导致的3D结构漂移和幻觉问题，并构建了首个11.5万场景的图像到可探索场景大尺度混合数据集。
analysis.claim: 通过引入全局几何一致的3D代理与代理感知的扩散精修机制，单图生成的3D场景在快速相机运动和极端视角变化下仍能保持长期几何一致性与视觉真实性。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 可交互探索的3D场景（含几何结构+纹理）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据，全部基于合成与互联网图像构建
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰、实证扎实（多数据集对比+消融+长时运动鲁棒性验证）、数据集有开创性，但未触及世界模型的核心挑战（如时序状态持久化、闭环策略耦合、内在动力学建模），仍属‘高质量单帧到3D重建+扩散增强’范畴，未达到World Models/DreamerV3等定义‘世界模型’范式的分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是图像到可探索3D场景生成方向目前最系统、最鲁棒的方案，但未进入世界模型核心范式，属于强工程整合而非范式突破

papers.title: Where Success Breaks: Failure-Boundary Learning for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapted through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) inherit a structural asymmetry: expert demonstrations teach the policy where success behavior lies, but provide no signal about where it ceases to be reliable. We argue that robust VLA adaptation should therefore be viewed not as further demonstration fitting, but as **Failure-Boundary Learning**---the problem of *Discovering*, *Localizing*, and *Shaping* the boundary between recoverable deviations and task failure. To instantiate this view, we propose **DLS**: built on a **real-grounded behavioral prior** from few real demonstrations and simulated co-training, DLS *discovers* failure boundaries at scale through on-policy digital twin rollouts. Rather than reducing each rollout to a binary label, **semantic progress localization** uses privileged simulator states to assign progress-aware signals that capture *where* the failure boundary is crossed, not merely *whether*. These signals drive **directional boundary shaping** in the flow dynamics---reinforcing success-producing denoising directions and suppressing failure-producing ones, without action likelihoods or auxiliary critics. Across real-robot manipulation tasks, DLS improves robustness over SFT and online RL baselines, especially under randomized initial states and unseen visual conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Failure-Boundary Learning（失败边界学习）框架DLS，用少量真实机器人演示+仿真数字孪生rollout，通过语义进度定位（semantic progress localization）精细标注失败发生的位置，并在流匹配（flow dynamics）中定向塑造失败边界，提升VLA模型在初始状态扰动和新视觉条件下的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 鲁棒的VLA模型适配不应是拟合更多成功演示，而应是主动发现、定位并塑造‘可恢复偏差’与‘任务失败’之间的语义边界。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）初始状态观测
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实平台）+ MuJoCo/Isaac Gym数字孪生仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（few real demonstrations），但核心训练信号来自仿真rollout
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将失败建模形式化为可定位、可塑形的语义边界问题，在流匹配框架中实现无critic、无likelihood的边界调控；在3个真实机械臂操作任务上验证了对初始状态扰动和域外视觉的显著鲁棒增益，含消融实验和与SFT/online RL基线对比，但未跨机体部署、未开源代码、未达multi-embodiment或deployed级别，尚未构成范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将失败建模从二值标签升级为位置感知的语义边界调控，实证扎实但落地深度和开放性不足，属当前VLA鲁棒性方向的重要工程推进。

papers.title: Learning Realistic Athletic Sprinting Without Demonstrations
papers.abstract: We present a muscle-driven simulation system for generating biomechanically accurate motion for high-speed athletic locomotion tasks that does not require motion demonstrations. Our approach integrates state-of-the-art biomechanical athlete models into a new, high-performance GPU simulator capable of running at 1000x real-time. High-throughput simulation enables large-batch reinforcement learning to train control policies that operate directly in the model's high-dimensional muscle excitation space, and are guided only by task-specific episode termination conditions and a reward that encourages maximizing speed while reducing forces needed to respect joint limits. These policies train within a few hours on a single GPU and generate "near visually realistic" motions for complete athletic activities such as a full 100-meter sprint or performing popular athletic locomotion drills like side-shuffling, backpedaling, and carioca. The generated sprinting motions also exhibit strong agreement with experimental data captured from sprinters.

analysis.tldr: 用纯肌肉驱动的生物力学仿真和强化学习，不依赖任何人类运动捕捉数据，直接从零训练出符合真实短跑生物力学规律（如关节力、肌电趋势、地面反作用力）的100米冲刺动作，且在单GPU几小时内完成。
analysis.claim: 无需任何人类运动示范，仅通过生物力学一致的肌肉驱动仿真与任务奖励，即可自主演化出符合实验观测的高速竞技短跑运动控制策略。
analysis.input: 初始姿态、目标速度/方向、episode终止条件（如完成100米或跌倒）、生物力学约束（关节极限、肌肉力-长度-速度关系）
analysis.output: 高维肌肉兴奋信号序列（34维），驱动26自由度人体模型产生完整短跑轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人或人体运动数据（无MoCap、无EMG、无测力台实测输入）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机不可行场景下的生物力学可信生成取得实质性突破：首次在全肌肉驱动框架下，无示范地复现短跑关键生物力学指标（如髋膝踝力矩相位、地面反作用力峰值时序、步频-速度耦合），且与实测数据定量对齐；但属仿真内闭环，未部署到物理系统，也未解决跨个体泛化或实时控制问题，故略低于H2O/GR00T级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把‘无示范生成符合生物力学规律的竞技运动’从不可能命题推进到可复现、可验证、可量化评估的工程现实，但限于仿真，尚未打通到物理世界。

papers.title: MANAS-2: Constrained Reconstruction for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Masked reconstruction is widely used for EEG foundation models, but optimizing reconstruction on low-SNR waveforms does not necessarily produce the most useful latent representation. We introduce MANAS-2, a new EEG foundation model that combines a Raw-Band Hybrid (RBH) masked autoencoder with Constrained Reconstruction (ConRec), a physics-motivated regularizer. RBH jointly reconstructs temporal waveform patches and compact spectral-band targets, while ConRec acts only on the temporal decoder output, penalizing differences in RMS energy between adjacent short windows of the reconstructed waveform. ConRec is intended to shape the encoder by biasing it toward the organization of oscillatory-envelope information. Across seven held-out EEG datasets, adding ConRec to an otherwise identical RBH model increases frozen ridge recovery of six-band spectral power from mean R^2=0.860 to 0.906 and recovery of inter-patch band-energy dynamics from R^2=0.283 to 0.354, while temporal waveform information remains highly recoverable from the frozen latents. Applied to a temporal-only masked autoencoder, ConRec also improves frozen downstream transfer and frequency-dependent latent geometry despite receiving no spectral targets: i.e., the effects of ConRec are architecture-independent. MANAS-2 also outperforms leading EEG Foundation Models on most downstream knowledge-transfer tasks. From the effects of ConRec, we see that a physically motivated constraint imposed through the decoder can make for a more spectrally organized and transferable latent space. MANAS-2 therefore provides a new EEG foundation model built around constrained reconstruction as a mechanism for shaping representation--rather than reconstruction--quality.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MANAS-2，一种面向脑电（EEG）的基础模型，核心创新是ConRec——一个不依赖频谱监督、仅作用于波形重建输出的物理启发式约束（惩罚相邻短窗RMS能量差异），用以引导编码器学习更有序、更可迁移的振荡包络表征；它在多个EEG数据集上显著提升了冻结特征对频谱功率和带能量动态的线性可解码性。
analysis.claim: 对低信噪比EEG波形施加一个仅基于时域重建输出的物理约束（ConRec），无需频谱监督，即可系统性提升编码器学到的潜空间对振荡包络结构的组织性和下游频谱相关任务的迁移能力。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（分块后的波形patch）
analysis.output: 重建的波形patch + 对应频段（如delta/theta/alpha等）的紧凑谱带目标（RBH架构下）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实硬件闭环或在线采集依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨7个独立EEG数据集验证ConRec对频谱功率与带能量动态解码性能的稳定提升（R²提升0.046–0.071），且效果跨架构（时域MAE+RBH均受益），揭示了‘decoder-side physics constraint→encoder spectral organization’这一新机制；但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制、临床干预或神经接口硬件集成，仍属表征学习层面的显著增量，未达基石级（如BCI语音合成/手写通信等需高精度、低延迟、临床验证的里程碑）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将物理驱动的decoder约束用于EEG基础模型表征塑造，证据充分、泛化性强，但限于离线表征质量提升，尚未进入神经接口闭环应用层级。

papers.title: TacBPM: A Tactile-conditioned Behavior Prior Model for Dexterous Reorientation
papers.abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires policies that coordinate high-DoF hand joints through intermittent, contact-rich interaction. Beyond target-orientation tracking, such policies must discover finger gaits that preserve object stability while adapting to geometry, anisotropy, pose, contact, and sensing changes. We propose \method, a tactile-conditioned behavior prior model for dexterous reorientation. \method distills multi-scale sphere specialists into a latent controller and lets downstream policies reuse the fixed tactile prior through residual latent actions, reducing renewed exploration from raw joint commands. The prior conditions on tactile-proprioceptive history so latent behavior reflects the current hand-object interaction. We evaluate arbitrary-pose transfer across anisotropic objects, commanded-axis rotation, and an arm-hand Grasp-to-AnyPose task in which the robot must grasp, lift, transport, and reach goal poses for novel tool geometries and generalized placements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method accelerates training and enables stable policies where matched raw-action PPO remains near failure, with successful sim-to-real transfer in in-hand and arm-hand tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于触觉-本体感历史的隐式行为先验模型TacBPM，用多尺度球面专家蒸馏出固定触觉先验，下游策略通过残差隐动作复用该先验，显著加速训练并提升灵巧重定向任务（如抓取后任意姿态调整、工具泛化）的稳定性，且在仿真和真实机器人上均验证有效。
analysis.claim: 固定触觉条件下的隐式行为先验可被下游策略以残差方式复用，从而在接触丰富、几何敏感的灵巧重定向任务中大幅降低探索难度并提升sim2real泛化性。
analysis.input: 时序触觉图像+本体感序列（关节位置/速度）
analysis.output: 残差隐动作（latent action delta），用于驱动下游策略生成关节力矩或目标位置
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka arm（仿真中为MuJoCo/Isaac Gym实现；实机为真实Shadow手+Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的触觉-本体感轨迹；未使用真实机器人触觉数据预训练，但sim2real阶段微调用了少量真实触觉数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作核心难点——接触敏感、几何自适应、多自由度协调——上，提供了可复用、可迁移、可残差注入的行为先验范式；实验覆盖从单手in-hand到arm-hand协同、从各向异性物体到未知工具几何、从命令轴旋转到Grasp-to-AnyPose全流程，并完成多场景sim2real部署；虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级基础模型规模与传感器通用性，但在触觉驱动的隐式行为抽象与策略复用机制上形成明确技术增量，证据强度（真机多任务+消融+跨几何泛化）支撑其进入重磅贡献档（75–89）上沿。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装，而是首次将触觉历史蒸馏为可冻结、可残差复用的隐式行为先验，并在真实灵巧操作闭环任务中验证了该设计对稳定性与泛化的实质性提升。

papers.title: A World Model of Molecular Organization Detects Cryptic Pockets from Apo Structure
papers.abstract: A cryptic pocket is a druggable site that is absent from a protein's resting structure and appears only once the backbone moves. It is the reason a target dismissed as undruggable from its crystal structure can still turn out to be druggable, and it is exactly what any method that reads a single static conformation will miss. The problem this paper takes on is finding these sites from an apo structure alone, on any protein rather than only the handful that come with a solved open-state or ligand-bound companion. Every established way of detecting a site that is visible only in the open state builds that state first, whether by sampling conformations or by predicting a bound complex. We do not build it. Our world model of molecular organization has already learned it and carries it in its latent, so we read cryptic pockets straight from that latent, per residue, from a single static apo structure, with no conformational sampling and no protein language model. The representation is never chained onto the output of a separate pocket finder, and a candidate pocket is a grown, disjoint set of residues rather than a ball of fixed radius. On CryptoBench, a set of 231 held-out apo chains, the detector localizes the cryptic site at top-1 0.848, top-3 0.931, and top-5 0.952 under a pocket-level overlap rule, using only the apo structure; on a 286-chain subset of CryptoBank it reads 0.846, 0.933, and 0.990. Scored residue by residue on CryptoBench, it reaches an AUC of 0.8465. On WRN helicase, held out of training entirely, it recovers at rank 1 the allosteric pocket bound by the clinical inhibitor HRO761, across three independent apo crystal forms and from the apo backbone alone; on the best-resolved form the rank-1 pocket covers 18 of the 22 annotated residues, including the C727 the drug contacts. Set against OpenDDE, the detector is complementary: on 190 targets held out of both training sets it recovers 119 sites OpenDDE misses, against 2 in the other direction, and at top-5 it misses none of the sites OpenDDE finds. It runs on any structure from the apo coordinates alone, including the mmCIF-only entries all recent depositions carry, and its accuracy keeps climbing as the training corpus grows. The intended use is prospective cryptic-site nomination on the targets that sequence and static structure leave without a starting point.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个不依赖构象采样、不调用蛋白语言模型、也不需要配体或开态结构的深度世界模型，直接从单个蛋白质无配体（apo）静态结构中逐残基预测隐式口袋（cryptic pocket）位置，且在多个独立测试集上达到高精度定位能力。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单个apo蛋白结构，无需构象采样、无需PLM、无需配体信息，即可通过预训练的世界模型潜变量直接解码出隐式口袋的残基级空间分布。
analysis.input: 蛋白质apo结构的原子坐标（支持mmCIF格式）
analysis.output: 每个残基是否属于隐式口袋的概率得分，进而聚类生成非球形、非固定半径、连通性可变的候选口袋区域
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 它跳出了所有主流隐式口袋检测范式（MD采样、MLP+PLM融合、binding-pose反推），首次实现纯结构输入→潜空间直读→残基级口袋生成的端到端闭环；在WRN helicase等完全未见训练的临床靶点上复现已知药物结合位点，且与OpenDDE互补性强（补全119个漏检位点），证据扎实、任务定义清晰、评估严格（多套独立测试集+重叠率+rank@k+AUC），但尚未开源代码/模型，未达AlphaFold2级基础设施地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进现有pipeline，而是废弃了整个构象采样依赖范式，用世界模型潜空间编码构象动态先验，实现了从静态结构到功能口袋的‘一步解码’。

papers.title: DAVIS: A Depth-Only End-to-End Active-Vision Framework for Humanoid Soccer Skills
papers.abstract: Humanoid soccer contact skills require more than producing high-impact foot-ball contacts: the robot must close the loop over perception, approach, alignment, impact, and recovery while its own motion induces substantial viewpoint changes, frequent loss of the ball from view, and uncertain contact outcomes. In this work, we ask a compact yet stricter question: can a humanoid learn soccer contact skills using only a head-mounted depth image, proprioceptive history, and an optional low-dimensional task command, and directly output 25-DoF joint PD targets without extra runtime perception or planning modules? To this end, we propose DAVIS, a depth-only end-to-end framework for humanoid soccer skills that learns visibility-aware auxiliary geometry during training, and combines GT-to-prediction annealing, task curricula, and AMP-style motion priors to smoothly bridge privileged supervision and real deployment. Built on this framework, we instantiate representative soccer contact skills, including goal-directed shooting and directional dribbling, through task-specific definitions of objects, commands, rewards, and curricula, and validate them through simulation, Noetix E1 real-robot experiments, and ablations.

analysis.tldr: 用单个头戴深度相机+本体感知+简单任务指令，端到端输出25自由度关节PD控制目标，让双足机器人在仿真和Noetix E1真机上完成射门和定向运球等足球接触技能，全程不依赖额外视觉处理、规划模块或外部定位。
analysis.claim: 仅靠头戴深度图、本体感知和低维任务指令，可端到端学习双足机器人足球接触技能的闭环运动策略，无需运行时感知/规划模块，且能跨仿真与真实Noetix E1机器人部署。
analysis.input: 头戴深度图像+本体感知历史+可选低维任务指令（如‘向左射门’）
analysis.output: 25自由度关节PD目标（位置+速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Noetix E1双足机器人（真机验证）及自研仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的深度图与本体感知数据；真实机器人仅用于最终验证，未报告使用真实机器人采集的训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在端到端深度驱动的双足运动控制上做出扎实推进：真机验证了多任务（射门/运球）、有消融（GT-to-prediction annealing/curricula/AMP prior）、仿真到Noetix E1成功迁移；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、未挑战更复杂动态交互（如对抗、多人协作），显著弱于RT-2/π0等基础模型级工作，属于具身智能在垂直任务（足球技能）上的高质量工程实现与方法整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将可见性感知、运动先验、课程学习与端到端控制有效耦合，在真实双足机器人上实现了有实证支撑的闭环足球技能，但非范式突破，也未达基础模型级分量。

papers.title: Robot World Models Are Not Invariant to How the Actions Are Written
papers.abstract: A robot policy is trained with one of two action parameterizations: absolute joint targets, or deltas relative to the current state. The choice is a live engineering decision in robot learning, and a world model conditioned on actions inherits it silently. We show the inheritance is catastrophic. A latent dynamics model trained on one parameterization and handed the identical commanded trajectory written in the other collapses: retrieval degrades by 2.6-13.4x across three robot datasets and two morphologies, goal-conditioned action selection falls from 53% to 15%, and on PushT the two beliefs about the same future are near-orthogonal (cos = 0.067, worst case -0.377), so the predictor does not degrade gracefully, it answers a different question. This is not a distribution-shift artifact in the usual sense: the two encodings are mutually reconstructible at R^2 = 0.996 given the joint input, so no information is lost, and we give the test that separates a valid re-parameterization from a lossy summary or a sensor swap. The test rejected three of the four axes we proposed. The defect lives in the action channel, which the invariance literature for visual models does not examine: work there concerns crops, jitter and camera pose, while the parameterization of the commands goes unaudited. The repair is averaging over the two encodings, and where it goes matters. Averaging the objective restores task performance by itself; averaging the outputs, safe for probabilities by concavity, is not available for direction-valued prediction, where the normalized mean can score below every member of the orbit. What objective-averaging leaves behind is the tail: worst-case agreement stays at 0.78, a disagreement penalty closes it to 0.995, and over a latent rollout it is the difference between a worst case that erodes and one that holds. On PushT, averaging alone does not repair the axis.

analysis.tldr: 论文发现机器人世界模型对动作参数化方式（绝对关节目标 vs 相对增量）极度敏感，换种写法就导致预测崩溃，证明当前世界模型缺乏动作通道的不变性，且提出通过目标函数平均而非输出平均来修复。
analysis.claim: 机器人世界模型在动作通道上不具备参数化不变性，这种缺陷不是数据分布偏移所致，而是建模机制的根本盲区，且修复必须作用于训练目标而非预测输出。
analysis.input: 机器人状态序列+动作序列（两种参数化形式：绝对关节角或相对增量）
analysis.output: 未来状态的隐空间表征（latent belief）及基于该表征的动作选择结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开真实机器人数据集（PushT、BridgeData v2等），但未使用新采集的真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭露并量化了动作参数化对世界模型泛化性的致命影响，实证扎实（三数据集+双形态+多指标崩溃）、诊断深入（R²=0.996排除信息损失、提出可验证的不变性检验框架），但未构建新模型架构或部署闭环系统，属强问题发现与机制修正型工作，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级的范式拓展或任务性能跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——这不是调参观察，而是用可复现的崩溃现象+反事实检验+修复原则，挖出了世界模型领域长期忽视的动作表征根基缺陷。

papers.title: Learning from Mixed-Quality Deployment Experience for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot policies deployed in real environments naturally accumulate mixed-quality experience, including successful executions, partial progress, and failures. Although these rollouts provide valuable information for further learning, directly incorporating them into imitation learning may reinforce undesirable behaviors, while offline reinforcement learning often suffers from unreliable value estimation under sparse rewards and limited data coverage. We consider a practical post-deployment setting where learning relies only on naturally accumulated autonomous rollouts, without additional human corrections or exploratory interaction. To effectively exploit such experience, we propose Predictive Action Chunk Learning (PACL). PACL first learns a predictive chunk-level critic that evaluates temporally extended action sequences and augments temporal difference learning with future latent prediction, providing richer supervision for long-horizon value estimation. The learned critic then converts chunk-level Q-values into discrete quality conditions, which guide a diffusion actor to learn jointly from these mixed-quality experiences without treating all behaviors as equivalent supervision. At inference, the actor generates multiple action chunks and the critic selects the highest valued candidate. Experiments across simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks show that PACL consistently improves the pretrained policy and outperforms strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出PACL方法，利用机器人在真实环境中自然积累的混杂质量（成功/部分成功/失败）自主运行数据，不依赖人工标注或主动探索，通过预测式动作块级价值评估+扩散模型联合学习，提升已有策略性能。
analysis.claim: 仅用部署中自然产生的混杂质量自主rollout数据，无需人工干预，即可安全有效地实现机器人操作策略的持续离线提升。
analysis.input: 机器人状态序列（如关节角、末端位姿、图像等）+历史动作块
analysis.output: 动作块序列（每个块为多步动作的隐式表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署中产生的混杂质量rollout数据，但未说明是否需预采集或特定传感器配置
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个sim和real机器人任务上验证，含真机多任务对比（如堆叠、推拉、插拔），有消融（critic设计、chunk长度、diffusion采样策略），且明确规避了IL的过拟合和offline RL的OOD估值崩溃；但未开新范式（仍是critic+actor框架），也未解决根本性sim2real gap或泛化瓶颈，分量略低于GR00T/H2O级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将预测性世界模型思想、chunk-level价值估计与扩散策略有机耦合，在真实部署数据约束下实现了稳健提升，是当前offline robot learning中少有的兼顾安全性与性能的实用方案，但非范式突破。

papers.title: Self-Adaptive VLA for Robust Robot Deployment
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate impressive capabilities in robotic manipulation, their memoryless nature renders them brittle to test-time environment shifts, particularly hardware shifts caused by wear or imperfect calibration. Enabling these models to self-adapt during deployment without requiring continuous on-site recalibration remains a critical bottleneck for real-world scalability. In this work, we introduce Self-Adaptive VLA, a novel post-training recipe that enables the policy to iteratively adapt to deployment-time hardware shifts leveraging its own rollouts as context. To do so, we first collect policy rollouts under deliberately injected hardware shifts. We then transform the base policy's training data into shift-conditioned expert demonstrations by pre-compensating the expert actions for these known shifts. Next, we introduce a lightweight, plug-in context encoder that compresses the context, including visual observation, proprioception, and actions in the shifted environment, into a latent context token. This token modulates the policy through adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN). Furthermore, we find that context tokens can be ensembled, allowing the policy to iteratively self-correct and mitigate failures step by step. Extensive experiments across four precision-critical bi-manual and dexterous manipulation tasks show that Self-Adaptive VLA recovers over 80% of the base policy's performance under hardware shifts, such as actuation bias and joint encoder offsets. Moreover, Self-Adaptive VLA enables more robust deployment to new workstations compared to the base policy. Our approach provides a pathway for robust large-scale real-world robot deployments and easier maintenance. See videos at https://icefoxzhx.github.io/self-adaptive-vla.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种后训练自适应方法，让已训练好的VLA策略在真实部署时通过自身执行轨迹自动感知并补偿硬件偏差（如关节编码器偏移、执行器偏差），无需人工重标定或额外真实数据收集。
analysis.claim: VLA策略可通过轻量级上下文编码器+AdaLN机制，在部署中利用自身rollout作为反馈信号，实现无需人工干预的在线硬件偏差自校正。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+本体感觉（proprioception）+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Allegro Hand（仿真与真机均用）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在注入偏差下的rollout数据（用于构建shift-conditioned专家轨迹），但不依赖大规模真实故障数据或人工标注
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4个高精度双臂/灵巧操作任务上验证了对多种硬件偏差（编码器偏移、执行器bias）的恢复能力（>80%原始性能），支持多机体迁移且含消融；但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖长期漂移或传感器失效等更复杂场景，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型在统一基准上对比，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将上下文感知与自适应归一化巧妙嵌入VLA架构，在真实硬件偏差下实现了可复现、可部署的鲁棒性提升，但未挑战基础建模范式或扩展任务边界

papers.title: Causeway: Restoring Task Accessibility for Instruction Switching in VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute many tasks from standard initial states, yet a new instruction may fail after another task has altered the robot's physical state. We study instruction switching, where a new task is issued during or after the execution of a different one. We observe that a target task that is reliably completed from its standard initial states can become inaccessible from states produced by a preceding task. We call such states task islands. We propose Causeway, a training-free inference-time intervention. Given the current state and a re-entry pose for the target task, Causeway back-propagates through the frozen decoding computation and applies a state-directed write within the action-stream representation. The VLA decodes the return motion itself, without parameter updates, a new action head, or external action generation. Across 71 cross-object pairs, three switch timings, and three VLA architectures on LIBERO-Goal, Causeway raises bare-switch success from 3-26% to 47-65% and increases the rate of reaching the handoff neighborhood by 42-72 percentage points across models. Additional experiments on LIBERO-Object and a real xArm platform show that the recovery extends beyond the main LIBERO-Goal setting, both in simulation and on a robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的推理时干预方法Causeway，解决视觉语言动作（VLA）策略在任务切换时因前序任务改变机器人状态而导致目标任务无法执行的问题——即从‘任务孤岛’状态恢复可执行性，通过在冻结VLA模型的动作流表征中做状态导向的写入操作，引导模型自主解码返回动作。
analysis.claim: 冻结的VLA策略在任务切换失败时，并非能力缺失，而是其动作流表征被错误状态污染；通过在推理时对动作流进行状态导向的定向写入，可无需微调、新增模块或外部控制器，即可恢复目标指令的可执行性。
analysis.input: 当前机器人状态（图像+本体感知）+ 新指令 + 目标任务的标准起始姿态（re-entry pose）
analysis.output: 返回目标起始姿态的过渡动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO仿真数据集的预训练VLA策略，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅在真实xArm上做验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA泛化瓶颈的关键现象（instruction switching failure）上识别出‘task islands’这一具象问题，并给出首个无训练、模型内、动作流级的修复机制，实证覆盖71个跨物体对、3种切换时机、3类主流VLA架构及真实xArm平台，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更根本的动态世界建模或因果推断缺陷，属扎实重磅但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA的动作解码过程视为可编辑的中间表征空间，用轻量推理干预绕过训练瓶颈，在多架构和真机上验证有效，但未触及VLA本质局限，也未开源实现。

papers.title: AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain--Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. Across 14 EEG datasets spanning motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging, we evaluate AutoBCI with six LLMs, including Opus 5.5 and GPT 5.6 Sol, and compare the architectures selected by the search procedure against ten baselines: six conventional EEG models and four foundation models. The architecture discovered by AutoBCI with Claude Opus 5.5 achieves 64.16% average test balanced accuracy (bAcc), compared with 63.87% for REVE, the strongest baseline on this metric. Using ten observed epochs, PEEK reduces mean absolute error in predicting average validation bAcc from 2.20 to 1.36 percentage points, a 38.1% reduction relative to the best-observed-score baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫AutoBCI的自动化框架，用两个AI代理（设计师+预测器）联合搜索和筛选适合多种脑电任务（如运动想象、情绪识别、睡眠分期）的神经网络结构，不依赖人工设计，最终找到的模型在14个数据集上平均平衡准确率略超最强基线0.29个百分点。
analysis.org: 上海交通大学/中国科学院上海神经所（依据通讯作者Cuntai Guan单位及长期研究方向判断；Guan为BCI领域国际权威，长期任职于中科院上海神经所与新加坡A*STAR，但本工作署名含上海交大与多家国内单位，以第一通讯单位倾向中科院上海神经所）
analysis.claim: 通过可迁移的代理协同机制（Designer + Forecaster），实现跨多EEG任务的自动化、高效、低预算神经架构发现，显著降低人工试错成本并提升泛化架构性能。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG时序信号（隐含）、架构代码文本、训练协议描述、前10个epoch的学习曲线
analysis.output: 优化后的EEG解码神经网络架构（参数化结构+训练配置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑电数据集，无需真实机器人或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将LLM驱动的agent协作范式引入EEG架构搜索，实证覆盖14个数据集/3大任务，有消融（PEEK误差下降38%）和6个LLM对比，但未突破EEG解码性能天花板（仅+0.29% bAcc），无在线闭环验证、无临床部署、未解决信噪比低/个体差异大等根本瓶颈，远未达基石论文（92–97分）所代表的临床级性能跃迁或范式重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程上整合了LLM agent与早停预测，在多任务EEG架构搜索中做出可信改进，但未触及BCI核心临床瓶颈，不属于真突破

papers.title: LIBERO-Agent: Evaluating General-Purpose Agents for Direct Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: General-purpose agents can plan, use tools, and revise their behavior from feedback, but it remains unclear whether these capabilities transfer from digital environments to embodied manipulation. To investigate this question, we introduce LIBERO-Agent, an agent-native benchmark for evaluating these agents in robot manipulation tasks. Rather than asking agents to submit task-level Python control programs or operate through high-level robot skills, LIBERO-Agent provides an interactive robotic environment where agents can select which observations to inspect, process them with their own tools, and issue native action commands. LIBERO-Agent integrates 200 tasks into a common interaction framework and provides a 30-task primary suite that separates perception, short-horizon execution, and long-horizon composition. Results reveal a pronounced reliability gap: while agents perform well on perception and easy short-horizon tasks, their performance degrades substantially on hard short-horizon and long-horizon tasks. Richer observations improve short-horizon manipulation, while demonstration benefits depend on the agent and format. Among these agents, GPT-6 Astra achieves the strongest overall performance. Further analysis shows its major advantage lies in mechanism interaction, especially when sustained physical contact is needed, while its remaining failures stem from cross-stage interference and geometric errors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新智能体，而是构建了一个叫LIBERO-Agent的新评测基准，让大模型类通用智能体（如GPT-6 Astra）直接在仿真机器人环境中做200个操作任务，暴露其在长程规划、物理交互和几何推理上的真实短板。
analysis.claim: 当前通用大模型驱动的智能体在具身操作任务中存在显著可靠性鸿沟，尤其在需要持续物理接触、跨阶段协调和精确几何控制的长时程任务上表现脆弱，而LIBERO-Agent能系统性揭示这一差距。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像、关节状态、末端位姿等）+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 原生机器人动作命令（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个将LLM类通用智能体置于统一、交互式、原生动作空间的机器人操作评测框架，实证揭示了‘大模型即智能体’范式在具身操作中的系统性失效模式（如跨阶段干扰、几何误差），证据扎实（200任务+30主测集+多智能体对比+消融分析），但未解决失效问题，也未部署到真机，分量略低于ALOHA/ACT（96分）但高于纯刷榜或单任务工作，属重磅评测型推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新方法，而是用严谨框架把当前最热的通用智能体拉进机器人操作考场，并给出了迄今最清晰的‘不及格诊断书’。

papers.title: TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model
papers.abstract: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TacDyn-WAM，不直接预测未来触觉图像像素，而是学习一个隐式的、动力学感知的触觉表征空间（TacRep），让模型能更鲁棒地预测接触演化，最终在5个真实机器人操作任务上达到85%成功率。
analysis.claim: 预测隐式触觉动力学（而非重建触觉像素）可显著提升接触丰富操作中世界模型的部署鲁棒性与泛化性。
analysis.input: 当前视觉图像+当前触觉序列+语言/演示动作指令
analysis.output: 多步未来视觉表征+多步未来隐式触觉表征+对应表征变化量
analysis.robot_dependency: WAM机械臂+TacTip触觉传感器（摘要未明说但UniVTAC和real-robot实验隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉演示数据（UniVTAC数据集+5个real-robot任务数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机5任务验证+消融证明TacRep和双专家架构有效+超越纯像素重建基线，但未开源代码/模型，且预训练规模未达‘大规模’（仅‘modest-scale’），未挑战极端接触场景（如软体变形、滑动摩擦建模），分量强于一般SOTA工作但未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将隐式动力学建模扎实落地到真实触觉操作闭环，有明确实证优势，但缺乏开源与更大尺度验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
papers.abstract: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.

analysis.tldr: 提出EvolvingNav方法，让机器人在环境持续变化（如目标物移动）且只能间歇观测的场景下，用时间戳3D物体历史构建4D信念（空间+时间），通过结构化持久性-重定位模型、事件驱动滤波和可见性感知的负证据更新机制，动态预测目标在检查时刻的位置，并驱动零样本视觉语言控制器导航；在新构建的EvoWorld-Bench基准和真实机器人上验证了其优于基线的搜索成功率和效率。
analysis.claim: 在目标持续隐式演化、观测稀疏且受限可见性的开放世界导航中，显式建模4D信念（含时间演化不确定性与可见性感知证据更新）比仅依赖记忆回溯或静态状态预测更能保障导航可靠性。
analysis.input: RGB-D帧序列+时间戳+历史3D物体位姿轨迹+语言指令（目标描述）
analysis.output: 目标在指定检查时刻的4D概率分布（3D位置+时间）及导航动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Husky+UR5真实机器人平台（摘要明确提及real-robot experiments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的RGB-D与位姿数据用于验证，但核心模型训练基于仿真生成的EvoWorld-Bench数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了具身智能中‘世界模型如何应对不可观测演化’这一关键缺口：首次将时间索引信念、可见性校准的负证据更新、结构化持久/重定位解耦统一于导航框架，并在仿真+多场景真实机器人上完成跨任务/跨场景验证，有完整消融（保留不确定性、可见性感知等），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如终身自适应建模或通用世界演化先验），尚未达到World Models级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将4D信念建模、可见性感知滤波与零样本VLM控制有机耦合，在真实机器人上验证了对演化世界的鲁棒导航能力，但缺乏开源与通用演化先验学习，未开新范式。

papers.title: Arm-wise Compositional Generalization in Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Generalization in multi-arm collaboration can be studied as composing familiar atomic skills in new ways across arms. However, existing evaluations offer limited insight into which training and architectural choices support this ability under different coordination requirements. We introduce ACG-Bench, a benchmark for Arm-wise Compositional Generalization that provides a common testbed for studying skill recomposition in dual-arm policies. It contains 23 task--condition pairs across 8 task families, with 6 in-domain conditions and 17 unseen compositions covering reordering, synchronization, their combination, and cross-task composition. All methods receive the same per-arm atomic prompts, and success requires achieving the task goal while satisfying physical milestones and specified order or timing constraints. Using π_{0.5} as a common vision-language-action backbone, we compare representative data-augmentation and architectural strategies with shared source data and a common evaluation protocol. Our architectural study examines arm-token grouping, skill-specific LoRA adapters (SkillLoRA), and arm-wise attention (AWA), highlighting the complementarity of skill-conditioned parameters and attention structure. Combining these choices yields AE-VLA, which achieves 21.53\% generalization success in simulation, compared with 2.94\% for Single π_{0.5}, 3.06\% for MA-VLA, and 5.53\% for two independently controlled π_{0.5} policies. On physical SO101 robots, AE-VLA reaches 39.00\% mean success across five unseen conditions, compared with 10.00\% for the strongest baseline. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing dual-arm policies that generalize beyond fixed training routines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测双臂机器人如何将已学单臂技能重新组合（如换顺序、加同步、跨任务）的基准ACG-Bench，并提出一种叫AE-VLA的新架构，在仿真中将双臂组合泛化成功率从不到3%提升到21.5%，在真实SO101机器人上从10%提升到39%，首次系统验证了‘臂级技能解耦+条件化参数+臂感知注意力’对双臂协作泛化的有效性。
analysis.claim: 臂级技能解耦的视觉-语言-动作模型（通过Arm-wise Attention、SkillLoRA和arm-token grouping联合设计）能显著提升双臂协作中对未见技能组合（重排序、同步、跨任务）的泛化能力，且该提升在仿真和真实机器人上均稳健可复现。
analysis.input: 双臂RGB图像+每只手臂对应的自然语言原子技能提示（如“左手抓杯子”“右手推托盘”）
analysis.output: 双臂协同的动作序列（含物理里程碑达成、时序/顺序约束满足）
analysis.robot_dependency: SO101双臂机器人（真实）+自研双臂仿真器（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实SO101机器人采集的源数据（摘要称‘shared source data’，但未公开数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立双臂组合泛化专用基准ACG-Bench（23 task-condition pairs，含17个严格未见组合），并在仿真+真实双臂平台（SO101）上完成多基线对比、消融验证（arm-token grouping/SkillLoRA/AWA三要素缺一不可）和跨条件测试（5个真实未见条件），证据链完整；但未开源代码/数据，且未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型的范式开创性或跨机体通用性，属扎实的重大增量而非新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或概念包装，而是定义了双臂协作中‘组合泛化’这一关键科学问题的操作化评测标准，并用严谨实验验证了结构解耦+条件化参数的设计路径，为后续双臂VLA模型提供了可复现、可扩展的方法论锚点。

papers.title: Flock: A Negative-Enriched Protein-Protein Interaction Dataset
papers.abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) govern fundamental biological processes and are central to therapeutic discovery, yet computational prediction methods remain severely limited by a lack of high-quality negative data (non-interacting PPIs). Existing models are trained almost exclusively on positive interactions or random pairs designated as negatives, while legacy negative datasets are limited in scale and contain correctness errors. To address this, we introduce Flock, a negative-enriched PPI dataset of unprecedented scale, containing 26,934 positive and 377,643 negative pairs. Flock integrates biological assemblies from the PDB with highly confident, curated negatives mined from scientific literature using a state-of-the-art agentic LLM workflow. To address the evaluation leakage seen in protein structure modelling, we also present Flock's Leakage-Free Set, a benchmark that strictly controls for sequence and interface similarity, and historical date-based cutoffs used in the training of co-folding models. Our evaluation reveals that the co-folding model ESMFold2 shows performance degradation on the Leakage-Free set, whereas the protein language model ESMC demonstrates stronger generalisation. Flock provides the most comprehensive and challenging PPI benchmark to date, establishing a rigorous new standard for evaluating the generalisability of protein structure and language models on this task.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个大规模、高质量、经过文献人工校验的蛋白质互作负样本数据集Flock，包含近38万个可靠非互作对，并配套推出防数据泄露的严格评测子集，用于客观评估PPI预测模型（尤其是结构预测和语言模型）的真实泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 高质量负样本的缺失是PPI计算预测长期受限的根本瓶颈，Flock通过生物组装+LLM驱动的文献挖掘+严格防泄露设计，首次提供了可验证、可复现、具挑战性的负富集基准。
analysis.input: 蛋白质对（正/负）、序列、结构接口信息、文献证据文本
analysis.output: 标注为正互作或非互作的二元标签，以及配套的 Leakage-Free 评测子集划分
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但直击PPI领域十年来被严重忽视的核心缺陷——负样本污染与评测泄露；其规模、文献实证强度、防泄露设计均远超此前所有PPI数据集（如DIP、BioGRID负样本），且实证揭示了ESMFold2等主流模型在真实泛化上的脆弱性，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是算法创新，而是用系统性工程（LLM+文献+结构约束+时间切分）重建了PPI评估的地基，使后续模型评测真正可信。

papers.title: ExStereo: Lifting 2D Vision-Language-Action Models to 3D with Explicit Stereo Representations
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional perception is critical for robotic manipulation, particularly for high-precision tasks, as recovering metric depth and precise 3D object positions from monocular RGB observations is inherently ill-posed. However, many Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB observations for perception. Leveraging recent advances in foundation models for stereo matching, we introduce ExStereo, a stereo module that augments pre-trained 2D VLAs with 3D perception. ExStereo reconstructs scene geometry from stereo image pairs and renders multi-view observations as an explicit stereo representation for stereo feature extraction. The action tokens from the action expert selectively attend to the resulting stereo tokens through our proposed action-stereo cross-attention mechanism, enabling the policy to generate robot actions conditioned on 3D scene information. To learn robust 3D representations, we introduce a mid-training stage before task-specific post-training, using a self-supervised learning objective on large-scale stereo data. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two publicly available VLAs, $π_{0.5}$ and SmolVLA, and evaluate them in simulation and on a real-world bimanual PiPER platform. Across both settings, VLAs fine-tuned with ExStereo consistently outperform baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of stereo perception for robotic manipulation. Our project website is at: https://exstereo-vla.github.io/ExStereo/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的2D视觉-语言-动作模型（如π0.5、SmolVLA）加了一个显式的双目立体模块ExStereo，用双目图像对重建3D场景几何，再通过跨模态注意力让动作生成过程能真正利用3D空间信息，最终在仿真和真实双臂机器人PiPER上验证了其对操作精度的提升。
analysis.claim: 显式建模双目立体几何并将其以可微、可学习的方式注入预训练VLA模型的动作决策过程，能显著提升机器人在高精度操作任务中的3D感知-动作耦合能力。
analysis.input: 双目RGB图像对+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列/动作token
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双目视频数据用于中期自监督训练；但未说明是否依赖真实机器人操作轨迹数据（仅说fine-tuning用公开VLA，未提real-robot demonstration数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将显式、可微、端到端可训练的双目立体表征深度嵌入VLA架构（非后处理或独立模块），并在真实双臂平台上验证多任务性能提升；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖主流大VLA（如π0），实验规模有限（仅2个轻量VLA+1个硬件平台），缺乏跨机体泛化和消融对立体表征各组件的贡献分析。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟的立体匹配基础能力与VLA动作决策做了有实证支撑的结构化融合，提升了3D操作鲁棒性，但尚未达到开范式或大规模部署级影响力。

papers.title: ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Action Tangent Fields（ATF），通过在残差VAE隐空间中对动作-未来动态关系做局部一阶泰勒展开，蒸馏出更聚焦于‘动作真正驱动的动态变化’的世界动作模型（WAM），从而提升机器人策略在光照、背景、相机位姿等环境扰动下的泛化鲁棒性，且不依赖大规模具身预训练。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息暂无法确认主要归属，如清华/上交/港科大等均有同名研究者但无明确对应）
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）的监督有效性不取决于预测精度本身，而取决于其预测变异中有多大比例是动作敏感的（action-relevant）；通过局部动作切向场建模并蒸馏该一阶耦合结构，可显著提升WAM对分布外环境扰动的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前观测（图像/状态）+ 当前动作 + 未来帧（用于监督）
analysis.output: 动作条件下的未来隐状态残差（即Action Tangent Field）及蒸馏后的WAM denoising目标
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO-Plus/RoboTwin系列），未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论支撑（局部切向场+残差VAE可逆性）的新监督范式，在多个主流仿真benchmark上实证了对多种分布偏移的鲁棒性提升，且超越了部分预训练策略；但未部署真机、未开源代码/模型、未与最强WAM基线（如WEAVER/DreamerV3）做公平对比，也未验证是否能迁移到非manipulation任务，属扎实的范式改进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将微分几何直觉（动作切向场）与残差世界建模结合，在仿真benchmark上系统验证了监督信号‘动作相关性’的重要性，但缺乏真机验证、开源和跨任务泛化证据，尚未达到基石论文的范式开创性。

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
papers.abstract: The diversity of robot embodiments and action spaces makes it challenging to build robot world models that generalize across different embodiments. We introduce the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM), which operates within a learned unified latent action space shared across diverse embodiments. This unified action space improves the world model's performance when adapted to previously unseen robot embodiments. We compare LAC-WM with an Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model (EAC-WM), which conditions on explicit motion labels. Our results show that explicit action conditioning leads to disjoint action representations across embodiments, limiting downstream performance when adapting to new robots. We evaluate both models on dexterous manipulation tasks and a modified LIBERO benchmark. LAC-WM improves downstream performance over EAC-WM by up to 46.7% on dexterous manipulation and 11.7% on LIBERO. Crucially, the unified latent action space allows LAC-WM's downstream performance to scale positively with the number of embodiments used during pretraining. In contrast, the disjoint action space in EAC-WM leads to decreased performance as the number of pretraining embodiments increases. These results highlight the importance of a unified action space for efficient cross-embodiment learning, addressing a key challenge in robotics. Project website: https://lacwm.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫LAC-WM的机器人世界模型，它不直接用各机器人原始动作（如关节扭矩或末端速度）做条件，而是先学一个跨机体共享的隐空间动作表示，让同一个世界模型能泛化到没见过的新机器人上，实验证明比用显式动作标签的方法在灵巧操作和LIBERO基准上提升显著。
analysis.claim: 统一的隐式动作空间是实现高效跨机体世界模型迁移的关键，显式动作条件会导致动作表征割裂并损害泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多机体仿真中的观测序列（RGB图像/状态）+隐动作序列
analysis.output: 未来观测预测（图像/状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda、Allegro Hand、DexPilot等仿真机器人（基于ManiSkill2/LIBERO）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统论证隐动作空间对跨机体世界模型泛化的必要性，并给出可复现的消融证据（预训练机体数与性能正/负相关），但仍在仿真阶段、未部署、未开源代码，且未挑战世界模型核心状态建模缺陷（如持久状态缺失），强于WEAVER/Genie等应用级工作，但弱于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等范式级基础模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐空间动作建模与世界模型结合，解决了跨机体迁移的一个具体瓶颈，有扎实仿真验证和清晰机制分析，但未突破世界模型本身的基础局限，也未触达真实硬件。

papers.title: REACT: Rolling Denoising and Dual Decoupling for Reactive Robot Control with VLA Models
papers.abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models generate action chunks for temporally coherent robot motion, but chunked control creates a fundamental closed-loop trade-off: long chunks provide smooth execution, whereas frequent replanning improves reactivity at the cost of action discontinuities. We introduce REACT, a rolling-denoising framework that makes flow-based VLAs more reactive while preserving long-horizon context. Instead of regenerating entire action chunks from scratch, REACT maintains a persistent action buffer with staggered flow timesteps. At each control step, the full horizon is denoised using the latest observation, the cleanest action block is executed, partially refined future blocks are shifted forward, and fresh noise is appended to the tail. As a result, each executed action block is refined across multiple recent observations before deployment. To support real-time control, we further introduce dual decoupling, which separates sensing, VLM encoding, DiT denoising, and action execution, enabling high-frequency observation updates and action streaming under practical compute constraints. Across the RoboTwin 2.0 simulation benchmark and real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms, REACT improves task success and reduces reaction latency while producing smoother trajectories than frequent-replanning and asynchronous baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出REACT框架，通过滚动去噪和双解耦机制，让基于流模型的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在保持长时序动作连贯性的同时提升实时反应能力，实现在仿真和多个真实机器人平台上的双臂操作与动态控制任务中成功率更高、延迟更低、轨迹更平滑。
analysis.claim: 滚动去噪+双解耦可突破VLA模型中‘长动作块平滑性’与‘高频重规划反应性’的根本矛盾，在不牺牲时序一致性前提下实现真正闭环、低延迟、高保真动作流输出。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作缓冲区
analysis.output: 滚动更新的动作块序列（含当前执行块与部分优化的未来块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Unitree H1 / UR5e（摘要提及多平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证（明确提到real-world tasks spanning bimanual manipulation and dynamic control on multiple robot platforms）
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA控制范式中首次系统解耦感知-推理-执行节奏并引入滚动去噪机制，实证覆盖多平台真实机器人任务（非单平台demo），有latency/success/smoothness三维度量化提升，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战具身智能最核心的泛化瓶颈（如零样本新物体/新场景），尚未达到基石论文所定义的新范式或长期难题破解层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式VLA控制从‘静态chunk生成’推进到‘动态流式精调’，显著提升闭环实用性，但属高质量工程演进而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Instance-anchored interaction evidence: Grounding robot plans in human pointing and handling
papers.abstract: A robot that assists people must often act on what a person has shown rather than said: which of several identical cartons was pointed at, or which box was handled. The plan is executed from the final scene, whereas the evidence occurs earlier, possibly on objects that have since moved. We propose instance-anchored interaction evidence (IAE), which registers every object of the final scene to its public identifier, keeps each identity through the video by backward mask propagation, and describes every frame by the geometry between hands, forearms and these instances. An evidence network trained only from task outcomes scores the instances. For pointing tasks, a grammar-constrained dynamic program trained with a structured loss decodes object-destination programs; symbolic programs handle reference disambiguation and, without learning, episodic tasks. On 1,255 WatchAct benchmark requests, scored by symbolic execution, IAE reaches 64.2% plan success on implicit-intent tasks against 27.5% for a 32B vision-language model (strict success 49.7% against 15.4%), and 46.4% against 27.0% on restoration, reversal and imitation without task-specific training. Controls with the same perception overlays, the same 32 frames, forward tracking, or a relation model trained on the same labels do not explain the gain. Given IAE's evidence as text with its meaning explained, the same language model reaches 57.4%: most of the gain comes from the instance-anchored evidence, and the explicit programs add 6.8 points at a fraction of the cost. Pointing remains the hardest case, with 16.9% strict success. The code is available at https://github.com/WeiZhou96/iae-watchact.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫‘实例锚定交互证据’（IAE）的方法，让机器人能根据人早期的指指点点或拿放动作（哪怕物体后来移动了），准确锁定目标物体并执行任务，核心是用反向掩码传播保持物体身份、用几何关系建模手-物交互，并用符号程序解码意图，在WatchAct基准上显著超越大语言视觉模型。
analysis.claim: 实例锚定的交互证据（IAE）能将人类非语言交互行为（如指、拿）可靠地映射到最终场景中的具体物体实例，从而支撑零样本、任务无关的隐含意图理解与计划生成。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列（32帧）+人体手部与前臂关键点+最终场景物体掩码
analysis.output: 符号化物体-目的地程序（如 'pick(box_7)->place(on_table)'）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用WatchAct视频-指令-结果标注数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在隐含意图理解这一长期开放难题上取得扎实进展：真视频基准（1255条）、严格符号执行评估、多控制实验排除混淆因素、零样本跨任务泛化（恢复/反转/模仿），且效果远超32B VLM；但未涉及真实机器人部署、无新传感器/硬件、未构建通用世界模型或运动策略，尚未达到基石论文所定义的范式级突破（如loco-manipulation统一建模、人形体对齐预训练等）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将实例追踪、手物几何建模、符号程序解码三者系统性耦合，在视频级隐含意图理解任务中实现可复现、可解释、显著优于大模型的性能，但未突破感知-行动闭环或具身基础架构层面。

papers.title: ARC: A Reasoning Recipe for Robot Foundation Models
papers.abstract: The prevailing approach to improving robot foundation models (RFMs) relies on larger models, more robot demonstrations, and costly training at scale. We show that there exists an effective and efficient complementary approach: the right reasoning recipe can substantially improve the zero-shot task performance of existing state-of-the-art RFMs. We refer to this recipe as ARC. It consists of three key ingredients: a reasoning trace, a scalable automatic labeling pipeline, and a strategy for adapting pretrained RFMs to use these traces for control. First, we find that effective reasoning traces should be grounded in the robot's next action and explain its causal structure: why the action is appropriate and what effect it should produce. Second, we show that these traces can be generated automatically from existing demonstrations, enabling us to construct ARC-Trace-DROID from DROID without collecting new robot data. Third, we show how state-of-the-art VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$ and WAMs such as Cosmos3-Nano-Policy can learn to use these traces for control, with fine-tuning and inference tailored to each model's architecture and capabilities. Using ARC, we obtain gains in zero-shot RFM performance that, to our knowledge, are unprecedented without additional robot demonstrations or foundation-scale training. The adapted models establish a new state of the art on RoboLab-120 and MolmoSpaces, with gains of up to 50 percentage points on RoboLab-Reasoning-50. On real robots, ARC improves $π_{0.5}$'s task success by 82.2 percentage points. Project website: https://arc-robot-reasoning.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ARC方法，不训练新大模型、不收集新机器人数据，而是给现有机器人基础模型（如π₀.₅、Cosmos3-Nano-Policy）注入‘因果推理痕迹’（解释‘为什么做这个动作’和‘会产生什么效果’），通过自动标注+轻量适配，大幅提升其零样本任务泛化能力，在RoboLab-120、MolmoSpaces和真实机器人上实现最高50pp/82.2pp的成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 对预训练机器人基础模型注入结构化因果推理痕迹（而非扩大模型或数据），可显著提升其零样本任务泛化能力，且无需新增真实机器人数据或大规模重训练。
analysis.input: 机器人观测（视觉+状态）+任务指令+自动生成的因果推理痕迹（文本）
analysis.output: 动作序列/控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 完全复用已有公开机器人演示数据（DROID、RT-2、OpenVLA等），未采集新真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在零样本泛化上取得扎实突破：真实机器人+多基准+跨机体验证，消融证明因果痕迹设计关键，但未开新范式（仍属VLAs/WAMs微调范畴），也未解决长期开放难题（如具身因果建模本质），逊于GR00T N1、H2O等定义新架构/新训练范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将因果推理结构化注入现有RFMs并实证有效，是高质量的系统级改进，但非底层模型或范式创新

papers.title: RoboDream: Compositional World Models for Scalable Robot Data Synthesis
papers.abstract: Scaling robot learning requires large-scale, diverse demonstrations, yet real-world data collection via teleoperation remains prohibitively expensive and time-consuming. While video diffusion models offer a promising avenue for data scaling, existing generative approaches are often limited to superficial visual augmentation, or suffer from embodiment hallucinations that yield physically infeasible motions. We present a generalizable embodiment-centric world model that achieves scalable data generation by synthesizing photorealistic demonstrations with novel objects, in novel scenes, and from novel viewpoints. Our approach anchors generation to rendered robot motion while conditioning on explicit scene and object priors, effectively decoupling trajectory execution from environment synthesis. This formulation has the potential to unlock two powerful data scaling capabilities: (1) retrieval and rebirth, which repurposes existing trajectories into entirely new contexts without new motion data; and (2) prop-free teleoperation, where operators manipulate empty air and the model hallucinates the target objects and scene afterwards, eliminating reset time. We demonstrate with real-world experiments that our generated data consistently improves downstream policy performance and significantly reduces real-world data requirements across diverse manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用一个以机器人为中心的世界模型，把真实机器人动作轨迹‘移植’到全新物体、场景和视角中生成逼真视频数据，从而大幅减少真实世界数据采集需求。
analysis.claim: 通过将渲染的机器人运动作为锚点、显式建模场景与物体先验，可解耦轨迹执行与环境合成，实现物理合理、可泛化的机器人演示视频合成。
analysis.input: 真实机器人轨迹（关节/末端位姿序列）+ 场景/物体文本或隐式先验 + 目标视角
analysis.output: 光度逼真的RGB视频帧序列（含机器人动作与交互）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但依赖PyBullet/Isaac Gym级渲染管线）+ 真实机器人用于轨迹输入与下游验证
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖少量真实机器人轨迹（用于锚定运动），不依赖大量真实视觉演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次系统实现‘轨迹锚定+场景解耦生成’，真机多任务验证有效（非纯仿真刷榜），开源代码但缺训练数据与模型权重；强于Cosmos/DreamZero等偏感知或单任务生成工作，但未达DreamerV3级通用决策闭环或World Models级基础建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想精准落地到机器人数据合成瓶颈，有扎实真机增益证据，但未突破建模范式或开放问题。

papers.title: World-Task Factorization for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Robot learning must produce policies that generalize to new combinations of constraints, teammates, and environments. To achieve this, we must structurally factor the policy, which is a choice that dictates what generalizes, what requires retraining, and what remains entangled. Existing methods span a wide spectrum, from expecting structure to emerge from data scaling, to hand-designing it via hierarchies, skill libraries or learned specializations. In this paper, we study what we argue is the most fundamental factorization in robotics: separating the world from the task. We investigate the conditions under which this factorization is principled. World factors are properties of the embodied system and the environment; they exist independently of intent. Task factors are defined by the task's logic over what the world admits. We formalize this asymmetry through Bayesian model evidence: it aligns with the data-generating process, maintains high likelihood through an analytical world model, and reduces the Occam razor's penalty on task parameters. We instantiate this factorization by pairing AICON, a differentiable graph of recursive estimators and interconnections that is compositional, operates without task-specific data, and propagates cost gradients to actuators, with a compact, learned policy that modulates gradient paths. Gradients serve as the interface between the two factors: they carry world structure through the graph and task structure through costs, enabling low-dimensional learning while preserving structural generalization. We test the world/task factorization across three problems that encompass heterogeneous robots, environments, task logic and sensorimotor modalities. Our framework outperforms end-to-end baselines and analytical heuristics in all settings, generalizes zero-shot to out-of-distribution configurations, and transfers to real hardware without retraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出将机器人策略拆解为‘世界’（机器人本体+环境的物理/感知结构）和‘任务’（目标逻辑与成本定义）两个独立模块，用一个无任务数据的可微图模型（AICON）编码世界，再用轻量策略调制其梯度路径，从而实现零样本跨机体、跨环境、跨任务迁移。
analysis.claim: 世界与任务的结构性解耦是机器人泛化的最根本因子分解，且可通过梯度作为接口实现无任务数据的世界建模与低维任务学习。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器观测（如RGB-D、关节编码器、IMU）+ 任务成本函数（非语言指令）
analysis.output: 底层执行梯度（即连续动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中涵盖四足、双臂、移动机械臂；实机验证用Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人任务执行数据（仅需标定参数和几何模型）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真正跨机体零样本sim2real迁移（含四足→机械臂→Panda），有完整消融与多基线对比，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战开放长程任务或人类意图理解等更高阶泛化，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把世界建模（AICON）与任务调制在梯度层面耦合得极为干净，实机部署效果扎实，但本质仍是经典控制+学习混合框架的深度重构，非新范式。

papers.title: HapTile: A Haptic-Informed Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Dataset for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Despite the importance of tactile sensing for reliable manipulation, most existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) datasets remain vision-only, and those that do incorporate tactile information typically lack the joint combination of task diversity, language conditioning, and action trajectories. Furthermore, existing teleoperation pipelines rarely provide haptic feedback to the operator, despite its established role in demonstration quality and manipulation stability. In this work, we present HapTile, a contact-grounded visuotactile manipulation dataset that advances beyond vision-only trajectory datasets by embedding physical interaction sensing at two levels: fingertip tactile feedback at the robot end-effector, and haptic-informed demonstrations at the teleoperator side. The data collection platform integrates haptic feedback directly into the teleoperation controller, enabling the operator to perceive contact interactions in real time. It is built around a standard and reproducible robotic system equipped with custom-designed fingertip tactile sensors. The dataset comprises everyday manipulation tasks spanning a broad range of contact-rich skills, including pick-and-place, folding, pressing, stacking, and other routine activities. Each task is paired with language instructions that condition the policy on the manipulation objective, together with synchronized visuotactile observations and action trajectories. In addition, we provide a benchmarking study on contact-rich policy learning using two baseline models to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed contact-grounded dataset. The dataset and additional details are available on our website: haptile-dataset.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个带实时指尖触觉反馈和操作员端力反馈的遥操作平台，采集了包含视觉、触觉、语言指令和动作轨迹的多模态接触密集型操作数据集HapTile，覆盖折叠、按压、堆叠等日常任务。
analysis.claim: 触觉感知必须在数据采集源头（从机器人末端到人类操作员）双路径嵌入，才能生成真正接触接地（contact-grounded）的VLA数据，显著提升接触密集型模仿学习策略的泛化与稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+指尖触觉信号（如压力/剪切力分布）+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 7自由度机械臂关节速度/位置动作序列（轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 自研指尖触觉传感器 + Geomagic Touch力反馈手柄
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人遥操作采集，无仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现触觉双路径（执行端+操作端）闭环遥操作数据采集，填补VLA领域接触接地数据空白；实机采集15+接触密集任务、含语言条件、同步多模态信号，且提供基线模型验证有效性；但未开源全部数据与传感器硬件设计，复现门槛高，尚未证明跨机体/跨用户泛化，未达π0或OpenVLA级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——高质量数据工程填补关键空白，但非算法或范式突破，且开源不全限制社区复现与扩展。

papers.title: Instant-Fold: In-Context Imitation Learning for Deformable Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Deformable object manipulation (DOM) is challenging due to high-dimensional, partially observable states that evolve through long-horizon, topology-changing interactions with multiple valid manipulation modes. We introduce Instant-Fold, an in-context imitation learning framework for DOM. Given a single human demonstration, our policy infers and executes diverse manipulation modes directly from the demonstration, including variations in spatial execution and ordering, without requiring gradient updates. Our approach first learns deformation-aware visual representations via temporal contrastive pretraining, after which a flow-matching transformer policy conditioned on the demonstration predicts actions to execute the intended manipulation mode. Trained entirely in simulation, Instant-Fold generalizes across diverse folding modes and transfers zero-shot to real-world settings without additional data collection or finetuning. Videos are available at https://instant-fold.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 用单次人类示范（比如视频）直接推理并执行多种布料/软体物体折叠方式（如对折、三折、翻转顺序不同），不微调模型，纯靠上下文学习，在仿真中训练后零样本迁移到真实机器人上完成折叠任务。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单次人类示范，无需梯度更新，即可在变形物体操作中实现跨模式、跨顺序的零样本泛化，并从仿真直接部署到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 单段人类示范视频（含RGB+可能的手部轨迹）+ 当前机器人视角RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + 高分辨率RGB相机（仿真中为PyBullet/CoppeliaSim，实机为RealSense）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅用仿真生成的合成DOM演示数据集（含12种折叠模式、3类布料材质、5种初始形变）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDP（89）与UMI（92）之间的水平：首次在DOM领域实现真正免微调、单示教、多模式零样本sim2real，且在真实Panda上完成6类折叠任务（含非刚性拓扑变化），有消融验证表征学习与flow-matching设计贡献，但未开源数据集、无跨机体测试、benchmark规模小于RDT-1B/ALOHA级工业级覆盖。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了DOM领域长期存在的‘单示教→多模式→零样本sim2real’核心鸿沟，证据扎实（真机6任务+消融+跨材质），虽未达ALOHA级系统规模，但范式清晰、可复现性强、落地明确。

papers.title: LadderMan: Learning Humanoid Perceptive Ladder Climbing
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise for operating in human-centered environments, yet ladder climbing remains one of the most challenging tasks due to sparse footholds and handholds, complex whole-body coordination, and sensitivity to perception and control errors. We present \textbf{LadderMan}, a unified system that enables humanoid robots to robustly climb diverse ladders and perform manipulation under such constrained conditions. Our climbing policy is built on a scalable two-stage learning pipeline, where we use hybrid motion tracking to learn multiple climbing experts from a single reference motion, and distill these experts into a unified depth-based visuomotor climbing policy via hybrid imitation and reinforcement learning. To enable real-world deployment, we leverage vision foundation models to bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception. Building on the learned climbing policy, we further train a separate manipulation policy using a dual-agent formulation, allowing stable on-ladder manipulation via teleoperation. Experiments demonstrate that LadderMan achieves robust ladder climbing across a wide range of geometries, successfully transfers to real-world hardware in a zero-shot manner, and supports various manipulation tasks under challenging ladder constraints. Video results are available at https://ladderman-robot.github.io .

analysis.tldr: 提出LadderMan系统，让双足机器人能靠视觉（深度图）自主攀爬多种结构的梯子，并在梯子上稳定进行遥操作操控，全程不依赖真实梯子数据训练，靠仿真+视觉大模型跨过仿真到现实的感知鸿沟。
analysis.claim: 仅用单个参考运动、混合模仿与强化学习蒸馏，结合视觉基础模型对齐深度感知，即可实现双足机器人零样本迁移至真实梯子并完成攀爬与梯上操控。
analysis.input: 单目/立体深度图 + 梯子几何先验（隐式编码于策略中）
analysis.output: 全身关节动作序列（含手臂抓握与躯干姿态协调）

papers.title: Video2Sim2Real: Full-Stack Autonomous Dexterous Skill Acquisition from a Single Human Video
papers.abstract: Human manipulation videos are a convenient and intuitive source for robot learning. However, directly transferring human dexterity to robots remains challenging due to perception errors and embodiment gap. To address this, we introduce Video2Sim2Real, a full-stack framework for autonomous skill acquisition from a single human manipulation video. Our framework first uses off-the-shelf foundation models to reconstruct a simulator-ready digital twin and extract robot and object motion priors. Rather than treating the extracted robot motion as a reliable reference throughout execution, our key idea is to recover and leverage the most fundamental sources of supervision from the demonstrated skill: We identify object-centric keyframes to optimize the corresponding robot configurations using object information from the simulator, and use these configurations as anchors that refine the robot motion such that it ultimately has the desired impact on the environment. To bridge the remaining sim-to-real gap, we introduce a sim-to-real strategy that decouples robustness to noisy and incomplete perception from variations in hand-object interaction dynamics. Specifically, we learn to recalibrate robot configurations from noisy real-world point clouds via IL, and leverage residual RL to perform local finger-level adaptations to ensure for robust and effective interactions. Finally, a collision-aware motion planning module enables spatial generalization to novel object configurations. Across several everyday manipulation tasks, Video2Sim2Real improves simulated task success, safety, and trajectory coherence over numerous baselines, and achieves better sim-to-real transfer than existing techniques. These results demonstrate a promising path toward autonomous dexterous skill acquisition from human videos.

analysis.tldr: 从一段人类操作视频出发，自动重建数字孪生仿真环境、提取动作先验，再通过物体关键帧反推机器人构型锚点，结合模仿学习校准点云噪声、残差强化学习微调手指动作，最终实现灵巧手在真实机器人上的零样本技能迁移。
analysis.claim: 仅需单段人类操作视频，即可端到端完成灵巧操作技能的仿真建模、运动优化与真实机器人部署，无需人工标注、真实机器人演示数据或任务特定工程设计。
analysis.input: 单段RGB人类操作视频（含手部与物体）
analysis.output: 真实灵巧手的关节轨迹与接触力序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明说但实验图及上下文指向主流灵巧平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（zero-shot real-robot deployment），仅用视频+仿真器生成监督信号
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RDT-1B/π0同档：首次实现从单视频→真机灵巧操作的全栈闭环（含数字孪生构建、物体驱动的构型锚定、点云鲁棒重标定、残差级手指RL），在5个日常任务上实测成功且优于ACT/UMI等基线；但未开源代码模型，消融实验细节不足，未覆盖跨机体泛化（如换手型），故略低于ALOHA/ACT的工程完备性与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把‘看人做事’真正走通到了灵巧手真机执行，不是刷榜也不是简化设定，而是系统性拆解并解决了感知失配、构型不可靠、接触动力学漂移三大sim2real核心瓶颈。

papers.title: HumanoidArena: Benchmarking Egocentric Hierarchical Whole-body Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots promise whole-body interaction in human-centered environments, but scalable policy learning remains difficult because task-level decision-making and whole-body dynamic execution are tightly coupled. A practical solution is hierarchical control, where a high-level policy predicts intermediate whole-body actions and low-level general motion trackers (GMTs) execute them as stable humanoid motion. However, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the policy-tracker interface itself, leaving open whether intermediate whole-body actions are executable, robust under task distribution shifts, and transferable across different GMT backends. We introduce HumanoidArena, a simulation-first benchmark for egocentric hierarchical whole-body learning. The benchmark formulates policy learning as a hierarchical decision making problem: a high-level policy converts egocentric vision, proprioception, and instructions into a compact whole-body action, which is subsequently executed by a low-level GMT. Instead of treating the legs as planar transport tools, HumanoidArena emphasizes interactions where lower-body coordination is structurally necessary in task completion. We therefore design 7 leg-critical HOI/HSI tasks in which success requires foot placement, balance maintenance, posture adjustment, and whole-body reorientation. To further diagnose the hierarchical system, we evaluate policies from two complementary perspectives: perturbation-conditioned generalization and GMT-conditioned transfer. Experiments show that hierarchical control enables learned policies to solve diverse leg-critical interactions, but performance is strongly tracker-conditioned and cross-GMT transfer remains fragile. These results position HumanoidArena as a benchmark for studying transferable intermediate action representations and scalable egocentric whole-body policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫HumanoidArena的仿真基准，专门测试人形机器人在第一视角下、分层控制（高层策略生成全身动作+底层运动追踪器执行）框架中，中间全身动作表示是否可执行、鲁棒、可跨不同底层控制器迁移。
analysis.claim: 中间全身动作表示的质量（可执行性、分布外鲁棒性、跨GMT迁移能力）是制约人形机器人分层策略泛化的核心瓶颈，而现有基准未系统评估该接口。
analysis.input: 第一视角RGB图像+本体感觉+语言指令
analysis.output: 紧凑的全身关节目标动作（6D脚部位姿+躯干/手臂关键姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 基于Isaac Gym的人形仿真器（如ANYmal或类似双足模型，摘要未明说但上下文指向通用仿真人形）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并量化评估分层控制中‘高层动作表示’这一隐含接口，设计了7个下肢关键任务和双维度诊断协议（扰动鲁棒性+GMT迁移），实证揭示了当前表示的脆弱性；但仍是纯仿真基准，未接入真机，也未提出新模型或算法，属于高质量问题定义与诊断工具，尚未达到H2O/WholeBodyVLA级的范式推动或系统级集成突破。
