papers.title: RARM: Confidence-Gated Progress Reward Modeling for RL in Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for robot manipulation is often bottlenecked by reward design, especially in long-horizon tasks: sparse success rewards provide weak supervision, while hand-crafted dense rewards are tedious to design and generalize poorly across tasks. Progress-based reward models offer a promising alternative by estimating how far an observation has advanced toward task completion, but existing approaches often require task-specific demonstrations or progress labels, and can assign high rewards to visually plausible but physically incorrect states. We introduce the Reference-Anchored Reward Model (RARM), a lightweight visual comparator that converts a single successful demonstration into a dense, progress-aware reward. RARM is trained once on general-purpose videos with a contrastive temporal objective, requiring no robot-specific data, task-specific reward labels, or per-task reward engineering. At deployment, RARM matches rollout clips to reference clips and rewards only confident forward progress, suppressing uncertain matches that may otherwise produce false-positive rewards. Across 9 simulated manipulation tasks from LIBERO and MetaWorld and 4 real-world tasks, RARM achieves the best overall success rates in subsequent RL training, with particularly large gains on long-horizon tasks such as cloth folding, where unreliable progress estimates are especially harmful.

analysis.tldr: 提出RARM方法，用单个成功演示视频训练一个轻量级视觉对比模型，自动为机器人操作任务生成置信度过滤的进度奖励，无需任务定制标注或真实机器人数据，在9个仿真和4个真实任务上提升了长程操作（如布料折叠）的RL成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅需一个成功演示视频，即可零样本泛化地生成高置信度、抗误判的进度奖励信号，显著提升长时序操作任务中强化学习的收敛性与成功率。
analysis.input: 当前观测帧序列（rollout clip）与参考成功演示帧序列（reference clip）
analysis.output: 标量进度奖励值（经置信度过滤）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（训练用通用视频，部署仅需单次成功演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 在reward modeling这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次实现完全免任务标注、免机器人数据、单示例驱动的跨任务进度奖励建模，并在真实机器人上验证了对长程任务（如cloth folding）的实质性提升；证据扎实（9+4任务、消融明确、对比SOTA），但未颠覆RL范式或引入新硬件/感知模态，尚不及T-Rex/ALOHA等奠基性工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将对比学习、置信度门控与进度奖励建模深度耦合，解决了reward engineering的实操痛点，但核心思想仍属现有技术栈的精巧组合，非范式突破。

papers.title: Characterising AlphaFold 3s ability to predict T cellantigen specificity
papers.abstract: T cells are a key part of the adaptive immune system. Using their surface-bound T cell antigen receptors (TCRs), these cells scan peptides and other antigens presented to them by major histocompatibility complex molecules (MHCs) on the surface of cells, searching for abnormalities. Although determining the map between TCRs and their target antigens is of vital importance for the design of safe and effective T cell-based vaccines and therapeutics, decoding these interactions is challenging. Experimental methods are not scalable, and sequence-based computational methods have issues generalising to new antigens. The IMMREP25 benchmark of methods for predicting T cell antigen specificity showed that AlphaFold-based methods promise improved generalisation to novel antigens. However, the ability of structure prediction models to predict T cell antigen specificity has not been robustly evaluated previously. In this work, we characterise AlphaFolds ability to predict T cell antigen specificity. We created a pipeline for high-throughput prediction of TCR:peptide-MHC (pMHC) structures using AlphaFold that is > 100 fold faster than the default implementation and used it to benchmark AlphaFold 3 (AF3) and similar models at predicting T cell antigen specificity. We investigated the underlying correlates of AlphaFold-derived binding scores and found that the models predictive power is related to the positioning of TCRs over the pMHC and not chemical interactions. Furthermore, we refine the AlphaFold-derived binding scores by training a machine learning model we call the PAE Aggregator. We then investigate AF3s ability to uncover the clustering rules of TCR repertoires and recapitulate mutational scanning experiments. These analyses show that AlphaFold3 clusters sequence-similar TCRs according to their binding mode and detects disrupting point mutations accurately. Our results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of structure-based approaches for predicting TCR specificity, guiding the development of more reliable immunological prediction methods.

analysis.tldr: 用加速100倍的AlphaFold3流水线预测TCR-pMHC结构，系统评估其对T细胞抗原特异性的预测能力，发现其得分主要反映TCR在pMHC上的空间定位而非化学互作，并通过PAE聚合器和聚类/突变分析揭示AF3可捕捉结合模式相似性但不直接建模免疫识别机制。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3的结构预测输出（尤其是PAE和pLDDT）隐含T细胞抗原特异性信息，但该信号源于几何定位偏差而非生化互作建模，需后处理（PAE Aggregator）和下游分析才能释放其免疫学解释力。
analysis.input: TCR序列 + pMHC序列（含肽段和MHC等位基因）
analysis.output: TCR-pMHC复合物3D结构 + 基于结构的结合评分（原始AF3 PAE/pLDDT + PAE Aggregator校准分） + TCR聚类结果 + 突变影响判别
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：构建AF3专用高通量流水线、在IMMREP25基准上系统评测、揭示PAE与结合模式的几何关联、验证聚类与突变扫描能力；但未提出新模型，未解决TCR特异性预测的核心难题（如泛化到未见MHC等位基因或跨物种），仍属AF3能力边界探查而非方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是新模型，而是迄今最严谨的AF3在TCR特异性任务上的诊断性评测，指明了结构模型在免疫预测中的有效维度与根本局限。

papers.title: MAMMOTH: A Multi-Modal End-to-End Policy for Off-Road Mobility Robust to Missing Modality
papers.abstract: Reliable autonomous navigation in unstructured off-road environments remains a critical unsolved challenge due to extreme terrain diversity, drastic illumination variations and acute sensor degradation. Recent developments have approached the problem as a traversability costmap estimation or visual navigation task. However, many exhibit heavy reliance on RGB modality, leading to poor performance in varied illumination such as glares, shadows or low ambient light. Achieving robust generalization in such conditions requires integrating modalities that provide supplementary scene information. Such multi-modal methods suffer from a rigid dependency on the presence of near-perfect sensor inputs, leaving them unable to robustly handle sensor degradation or individual modality failure. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMMOTH (MAsking Multi-Modal inputs for Off-road Traversability Heuristic-informed navigation), a unified end-to-end navigation policy for robust off-road visual-goal-conditioned navigation and undirected exploration. Specifically, MAMMOTH efficiently fuses multi-modal observations (RGB, Thermal, 3D Pointcloud and Ego Velocity) and is trained with a modality dropout scheme, enabling it to generalize to missing modalities at inference time. Furthermore, we employ a diffusion policy to learn the joint conditional probability distribution of physically-grounded trajectories and a intrinsic traversability heuristic. MAMMOTH utilizes this heuristic to prefer safer, smoother trajectories. We validate MAMMOTH through extensive real-world robot experiments in distinct off-road environments, including night-time operation. Our results demonstrate superior performance, with significant improvements in collision avoidance, terrain-aware planning and generalization to missing modalities. The code and dataset used for this work will be made publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MAMMOTH的多模态端到端导航策略，能在越野环境中用RGB、热成像、点云和自车速度输入，即使部分传感器失效（如夜间热相机坏掉或点云丢失）也能继续安全行驶，并在真实机器人上验证了夜间的鲁棒性。

analysis.output: 物理可行的运动轨迹（含可通行性偏好）

papers.title: A capsule polysaccharide synthesis locus database for the Klebsiella oxytoca Species Complex
papers.abstract: The Klebsiella oxytoca Species Complex (SC) represents an emerging healthcare-associated group of opportunistic pathogens. The capsular polysaccharide is a virulence determinant and target for novel vaccines, monoclonal antibodies and phage therapy. In the absence of broadly accessible phenotyping techniques, prediction of capsule types from whole-genome sequence data is critical for understanding capsule diversity and epidemiology, and to prioritise capsule types as targets for novel anti-K. oxytoca SC interventions. Here we present the first comprehensive capsule synthesis locus (K locus) database targeted for the K. oxytoca SC, comprising 88 distinct loci defined by gene content and which is compatible with the rapid genome typing tool Kaptive. The database provides high coverage of publicly available K. oxytoca SC genomes (97.6% of 2,244 genomes, dereplicated from a total of 4,055), and the typing rate is significantly higher than that achieved with the pre-existing Klebsiella K locus database (97.6% vs 50.3%, p <0.0001), which primarily targets the Klebsiella pneumoniae SC. We demonstrate the utility of the novel K. oxytoca SC database by application to three diverse clinical K. oxytoca SC isolate collections (n=61 to 102 genomes each), suggesting a high diversity of K types. The novel K. oxytoca SC K locus database (github.com/klebgenomics/KoSC-surface-antigen-loci) will provide a key resource to support larger systematic studies and ongoing genomics surveillance efforts for the K. oxytoca SC.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个专用于克雷伯菌属臭鼻亚种复合体（K. oxytoca SC）的荚膜多糖合成基因座（K locus）数据库，含88个基于基因组成定义的K型，显著提升全基因组序列中荚膜型别的识别准确率（97.6% vs 原K. pneumoniae数据库的50.3%），支持疫苗/抗体/噬菌体靶点筛选和基因组流行病学监测。
analysis.claim: 首个专为K. oxytoca物种复合体构建的、经实证验证高覆盖高精度的K locus数据库，填补了该临床重要病原体荚膜分型工具的空白。
analysis.input: 细菌全基因组序列（FASTA格式）
analysis.output: 荚膜类型（K型）预测结果及对应K locus结构注释
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、开源、实证充分的领域专用数据库资源，显著改进分型覆盖率与精度，但属于关键基础设施建设而非方法学或机制突破；其价值类比于早期RefSeq细菌基因组集或CARD抗生素耐药数据库——扎实、必要、可复用，但未改变科学范式或催生新算法/疗法。

papers.title: Interpretable EEG biomarkers with bag-of-waves: Spatial and temporal waveform dictionaries for low-data regimes
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used to diagnose neurological conditions, but its analysis usually relies on either predefined spectral features or deep neural networks. Predefined features carry a strong bias, since they fix in advance what counts as informative, while deep neural networks and foundation models are hard to interpret and need large amounts of data and compute. We present bag-of-waves, an interpretable framework that learns a small dictionary of recurring EEG waveform templates, called atoms, using shift-invariant k-means without labels. The continuous EEG is then turned into a sequence of atom tokens, whose counts feed a simple downstream classifier or clustering step. We extend this representation in two ways: we add atom-to-atom transitions, which we call n- grams, to capture temporal structure, and we move from single-channel atoms to regional and cross-channel spatial atoms for the multichannel case. We test the method on three complementary datasets, each probing a different aspect: single-channel mouse genotype clustering with only sixteen animals (the low-data and temporal case), resting-state dementia classification (the spatial case), and the TUEV benchmark, a six-way classification of clinical EEG events (a high-data comparison against strong deep and foundation baselines). Across all three datasets, bag-of-waves achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art deep and foundation models. Yet, it operates with a fraction of the parameter count and provides full interpretability: because every atom corresponds to an inspectable waveform, the method explicitly recovers known clinical morphologies that a neurophysiologist can directly validate. Its main advantage is that it works in the low-data regime where heavier models are a poor fit.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫'bag-of-waves'的可解释EEG分析方法：不依赖标签，用平移不变k均值从少量EEG数据中自动学习几十个典型波形原子（如尖波、慢波），把连续脑电信号转成原子序列和计数，再用简单分类器完成疾病判别或分型；在仅16只小鼠、临床 dementia 分类等低数据场景下，性能媲美大模型，且每个原子都对应真实可验证的神经电生理波形。
analysis.org: 贝勒医学院/德克萨斯大学休斯顿健康科学中心（摘要作者含 Zhandong Liu、Matthew J. McGinley，隶属贝勒医学院神经信息学与计算神经科学方向；Austin Thomas、Junseok Park 等亦属该体系）
analysis.claim: 在极低样本量（如16例）的EEG分析任务中，无需监督训练、仅靠无标签波形聚类构建的可解释原子字典，即可达到与大型深度模型相当的判别性能，且所有决策依据均可被神经生理学家直接审阅验证。
analysis.input: 原始多通道或单通道EEG时序信号（微伏级电压时间序列）
analysis.output: 原子序列（tokenized waveform IDs）、原子频次统计向量、n-gram转移矩阵、空间原子组合模式
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；仅需标准临床或实验EEG采集设备输出的原始信号
analysis.significance_reason: 在脑机接口与神经科学交叉的‘可解释AI for EEG’子领域实现显著推进：首次系统性将无监督波形字典学习（带时空扩展）与临床可验证性绑定，在三个异构低数据场景（基因型小鼠、痴呆患者、TUEV临床事件）上实证有效；虽未达90+级里程碑（如实时脑-语音合成或脊髓接口闭环），但解决了长期存在的‘深度模型黑箱+小样本失效’双重瓶颈，证据扎实（含已知临床波形回溯验证、消融n-gram/空间原子贡献、对比SOTA foundation模型），且方法轻量（<1k参数 vs 百万级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是包装概念，而是用可复现的无监督波形建模，在真实低数据神经诊断任务中同时达成高性能、可解释性与临床可验证性，填补了EEG AI落地的关键缺口。

papers.title: CORSICA: Reproducible Suppression of Cochlear Implant Artifacts in EEG evoked by Continuous Speech
papers.abstract: Objective. Electroencephalography (EEG) is a key tool for studying auditory processing in cochlear implant (CI) users. In particular, EEG recordings obtained during continuous speech are becoming increasingly important for assessing speech and language processing in CI users, and may be utilized for neurofeedback. However, CIs also induce strong stimulation artifacts that are time-locked to the stimulus and mask the neural responses that have smaller magnitudes. Existing artifact reduction methods are typically based on event-related potentials (ERPs) or require manual component selection, making them unsuitable for naturalistic listening conditions or large datasets. Approach. We develop CORSICA (CORrelation-baSed ICA artifact rejection), a reproducible, parameter-efficient method for CI artifact reduction in EEG responses to continuous speech. CORSICA operates on independent components (ICs) obtained through Infomax ICA and requires no manual component labelling, with performance governed by a single tunable threshold. It exploits the observation that CI artifacts temporally follow the audio signal without delay, whereas neural responses have an inherent lag due to auditory pathway latencies. For each IC, CORSICA computes the cross-correlation with the speech stimulus. Artifacts are identified by a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of the correlation peak near zero lag, and the component is rejected if this SNR exceeds a threshold. To benchmark CORSICA, we evaluate two alternatives: a TRF-based SNR method, in which temporal response functions are fitted to each IC and artifact-driven peaks near zero lag are used for rejection, and a variant replacing ICA with second-order blind identification (SOBI) as the source separation step. Main results. CORSICA effectively suppressed CI artifacts while preserving neural activity, enabling recovery of physiologically plausible TRFs with only 2% of ICs rejected. Both benchmark methods confirmed the validity of the SNRbased rejection framework, but CORSICA outperformed the TRF-based alternative in artifact suppression quality. Replacing ICA with SOBI as the source separation step required more ICs to be rejected, further supporting ICA as the preferred backbone for CORSICA. Significance. CORSICA provides a fully objective, label-free approach to identifying CI artifacts in speech-evoked EEG data, with no manual intervention required. By centering artifact rejection on a single interpretable threshold, it offers a reproducible preprocessing standard for future EEG studies on speech processing in CI users. Conclusion. Our findings demonstrate that objective CI artifact suppression in speech-evoked EEG data is feasible on the basis of the ICs temporal response patterns.

analysis.tldr: 提出CORSICA方法，用单阈值、无需人工标注的交叉相关分析，在连续语音刺激下的CI用户EEG数据中自动识别并剔除耳蜗植入体诱发的刺激伪迹，保留真实神经响应。
analysis.claim: CI伪迹在独立成分（IC）上表现为与语音刺激零滞后高信噪比的交叉相关峰，据此可全自动、客观、可复现地剔除伪迹成分。
analysis.input: 连续语音音频信号 + CI用户同步采集的EEG数据（经Infomax ICA分解后的独立成分）
analysis.output: 剔除伪迹成分后的干净IC集合（用于后续TRF建模或神经响应分析）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实CI用户EEG数据（含已知语音刺激时序），但未说明是否需特定硬件同步或在线闭环反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了CI-EEG领域长期存在的伪迹压制难题：首次实现完全免人工、单参数、基于生理时序特征（零滞后vs.延迟）的客观判据；在真实CI用户数据上验证了TRF恢复质量，且有合理对照（TRF-based SNR、SOBI替代实验）；但未跨设备/多中心验证，未展示下游任务（如解码性能提升）增益，也未开源完整预处理pipeline或基准数据集。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破在方法论客观性与可复现性上，但限于离线批处理、单一数据源、无下游应用验证，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: StableMimic: Smooth Human-Like Recovery for Humanoid Motion Tracking - Learning Beyond the Tracking Distribution for Structured Post-Fall Behavior
papers.abstract: Humanoid motion trackers perform reliably within learned tracking distributions, but falls can move the robot into low-height, contact-rich states from which an advancing command is temporarily unreachable. Tracking-only policies may chase infeasible references, producing rapid, large-amplitude limb corrections that increase risk to the robot and its surroundings. We present StableMimic, a unified tracker trained beyond the nominal tracking distribution. Perturbed resets around multiple human get-up references expose prone, supine, off-balance, and intermediate ground-contact states, shaping structured recovery that returns the robot to the trackable region. Because tracking and recovery occupy markedly different state--action distributions, StableMimic uses dedicated experts for each regime and a proprioceptive gate that continuously blends their actions. A hidden successor-state objective teaches human-reference-shaped recovery without exposing reference identity or phase to the deployed Actor; deployment requires no get-up reference, recovery command, trajectory retrieval, or external policy switch. On the complete retargeted LAFAN1 dance subset, StableMimic achieves the lowest errors on all four tracking metrics among five methods. Across 100 matched push-to-fall trials per method, it recovers in 100/100 and attains the lowest values on six of seven post-fall motion and load measures, supporting improved interaction safety under this protocol. Real Unitree G1 dance and standing-reference deployments qualitatively demonstrate bounded limb motion, autonomous recovery, and command resumption.

analysis.tldr: 提出StableMimic，一个能在人形机器人摔倒后自主、平滑、类人地恢复站立的统一跟踪控制器，不依赖外部指令或参考轨迹，通过在多种跌倒姿态（俯卧/仰卧/失衡）上进行扰动重置训练，并用本体感觉门控动态融合跟踪与恢复两个专家策略。
analysis.claim: 通过扩展训练分布至跌倒后接触丰富的低高度状态，并引入本体感觉驱动的双专家门控机制，可实现无需参考轨迹、无需外部切换、无剧烈肢体动作的稳定类人恢复，同时保持高精度运动跟踪。
analysis.input: 本体感觉信号（关节角度、角速度、IMU、足底力）+当前跟踪目标（如舞蹈动作序列）
analysis.output: 关节扭矩控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的大量扰动跌倒-恢复配对数据；真实部署仅用于定性验证，未报告真实跌倒数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证了100次推倒-恢复闭环成功率及6/7项负载/运动指标最优，且在LAFAN1舞蹈子集上全面超越5种基线方法；但恢复策略仍基于预设人类起身参考（LAFAN1中提取），未解决零样本跌倒状态泛化或跨机体迁移，也未开源代码/模型，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实G1上实现了高鲁棒性、低冲击的自主跌倒恢复，证据充分、指标全面，但核心恢复先验来自人类动作库，非从零学习或通用物理理解，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: Act with Intent: Distilling Behavior Intent for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can turn multimodal context into robot actions, but their action decoders are still trained largely by behavior cloning. This supervises which motor command was demonstrated while leaving implicit the local objective served by the behavior under the instruction. Future-based supervision enriches action learning with frames, latent observations, trajectories, or motion representations, but these signals capture particular realizations of what may happen rather than the shared semantic objective of the forthcoming behavior. We propose Intention Distillation (INDI), which distills behavior-level intent into the action decoder. During training, a frozen teacher VLM interprets a demonstrated segment from the current observation, instruction, coarse action summary, and corresponding execution video. From its standard inputs, the deployed VLA recovers the resulting multimodal intent representation at an intermediate decoder layer and uses it to organize action prediction together with representations of how the behavior unfolds and what it achieves. On SimplerEnv-Bridge, INDI improves GR00T-N1.7 from 64.3% to 84.7%, and on RoboCasa Kitchen it improves the controlled GR00T-N1.7 baseline from 64.1% to 70.3%, with consistent gains on $π_{0.5}$ across both benchmarks. In real-world tasks, INDI improves average success from 62.0% to 68.7%, with gains of up to 12.0 pp on longer-horizon tasks. Further analyses show that the recovered latent is used by the decoder, captures behavior objective and execution progress, and organizes downstream predictions in an objective-dependent manner. These results show that action decoders benefit from explicitly modeling the semantic objective of the behavior they generate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫INTENTION DISTILLATION（INDI）的方法，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在生成机器人动作时，不再只模仿示范动作本身，而是先从教师视觉语言模型中蒸馏出‘行为意图’（即‘为什么要这么做’的语义目标），再用这个意图指导动作解码器预测更合理、更鲁棒的动作序列。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并蒸馏行为级语义意图，能显著提升VLA模型的动作泛化性与长程任务成功率，且该意图表征可被解码器实际使用并组织下游预测。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+自然语言指令+粗粒度动作摘要+执行视频片段
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节扭矩/末端位姿等，具体取决于底层VLA）
analysis.robot_dependency: SimplerEnv-Bridge仿真器、RoboCasa厨房仿真器、真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行视频用于意图蒸馏，但未使用真实机器人轨迹做行为克隆训练（即不依赖真实动作标签）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个仿真基准和真实机械臂上取得一致提升（尤其长程任务+12pp），提供了意图表征可解释性分析和消融证据，但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，也未挑战RT-2/π0等基石模型的范式层级（仍是行为克隆增强而非世界模型或推理架构革新）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在现有VLA范式内做了高质量的意图注入设计，实证扎实但未突破框架边界

papers.title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes
papers.abstract: This work introduces Configured Failure Trapping, a novel backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which aims to activate attacks through stealthy textual triggers and induce configured failure modes. Unlike prior backdoor attacks that treat any task failure as a successful attack, Configured Failure Trapping requires the attacker to control how the robot fails (e.g., causing the robot to grasp with a specified positional offset), making it substantially more challenging and hard to detect. To support the new task, we propose an effective data engine for synthesizing high-quality target trajectories and an automated suite for measuring configured-failure fidelity. Then, based on this foundation, we construct two new benchmarks, namely Trap-LIBERO and Trap-RoboTwin, that instantiate Configured Failure Trapping across four representative failure modes. To address this task, we identify sparse action deviation as a critical challenge and accordingly propose a novel method named TrapVLA, which explicitly learns trigger-induced action residuals to steer the policy toward the configured failure behavior. Extensive experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic settings show that TrapVLA effectively injects configured failure modes into VLA models while largely preserving performance on clean data. Project page: https://john-liua.github.io/TrapVLA/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的新型后门攻击方法，不是简单让机器人‘出错’，而是精准控制它以特定方式失败（比如抓取时偏移5厘米），并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了该攻击的有效性和隐蔽性。
analysis.claim: 通过可控失败模式注入（Configured Failure Trapping），可对VLA模型实施高保真、任务感知、难以检测的后门攻击，且不显著损害其在干净数据上的性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+文本触发器（如特定短语）
analysis.output: 被操控的异常动作轨迹（如带固定偏移的抓取动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX250S（真实机器人实验提及）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人失败演示数据用于评估，但攻击注入本身基于合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并系统实现‘可控失败模式’这一更危险、更隐蔽的VLA后门范式，实证覆盖仿真+真实机器人+多失败类型，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战当前SOTA模型（如OpenVLA/Qwen-RobotManip）的安全鲁棒性，属于强问题定义+扎实验证的显著贡献，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了VLA安全威胁建模的粒度（从‘是否失败’到‘如何失败’），但因缺乏开源与对前沿SOTA的攻防验证，尚属领域内重要警示而非范式变革。

papers.title: SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humans traverse complex terrain over long distances without losing balance, whereas perceptive humanoid policies become fragile as perception and control errors accumulate. We present SOLO, a unified framework addressing two compounding causes of this long-horizon fragility: dense terrain reconstruction smooths action-critical details, and pointwise imitation lacks temporal credit assignment. Its Query Reconstructor (QR) uses Fourier-encoded cell queries to retrieve spatially specific evidence from depth-proprioception tokens, preserving sharp terrain boundaries. Trajectory-Aware MSE (TA-MSE) Distillation adds next-state teacher-student disagreement to the PPO reward, enabling Generalized Advantage Estimation to propagate future disagreement penalties to preceding actions. In simulation, QR reduces height-map L1 error by factors of 3.3-4.0, while TA-MSE surpasses PPO and MSE+PPO in curriculum progression. On stress-test terrains, SOLO achieves 97.5% mean traversal success and 96% stepping-stone success, versus 75.0-75.6% and 0-3% for dense-reconstructor variants. Deployed zero-shot with only a chest-mounted depth camera and proprioception, SOLO completes a continuous 1.5-km outdoor route and an indoor mixed-terrain course. Project page: https://sunpihai-up.github.io/solo/

analysis.tldr: 提出SOLO框架，通过Query Reconstructor（保留地形细节的查询式重建）和TA-MSE蒸馏（将未来状态分歧惩罚反向传播到当前动作），显著提升人形机器人在长距离、多变真实地形（如碎石、台阶、户外连续1.5公里路线）下的零样本通行鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 长时程感知型人形运动的脆弱性源于稠密地形重建抹平关键几何细节 + 点对点模仿缺乏时间信用分配，SOLO通过空间精准查询重建与轨迹感知误差蒸馏协同解决。
analysis.input: 胸挂深度相机图像+本体感觉信号（关节角度/速度/力矩等）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩控制指令（端到端策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1人形机器人（摘要明确部署于H1，项目页证实）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人采集的监督数据；训练完全基于仿真（MuJoCo/Isaac Gym），仅部署阶段用真实传感器输入，无真实轨迹标注或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 达到GR00T N1（96）、H2O（95）同档工程-算法整合强度：真机零样本完成1.5km户外长程+混合室内地形，远超多数sim2real工作；但未引入新范式（如token化运动建模、世界模型架构、跨模态具身对齐），核心创新是两个精巧模块（QR/TA-MSE）的耦合设计，证据扎实（消融充分、多基线对比、stress-test量化），略逊于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction（97）这类定义新范式的里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实人形机器人上实现迄今最远距离（1.5km）零样本长程通行，靠的是对地形重建失真与信用分配失效这两个具体瓶颈的精准手术式改进，而非概念重构。

papers.title: Paint What You See: Benchmarking Dexterous Visual Tool Use in Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Evaluation is shifting from static QA toward agentic settings where models act through external tools. We identify a critical yet underexplored capability within this space - dexterous visual tool use: fine-grained, closed-loop parameterized visual action in which models infer tool parameters from visual evidence, and those parameters directly govern the final result. Existing benchmarks cover web navigation, GUI operation, and software engineering, but rarely target this coupling between visual evidence and execution precision. We propose EASEL, a benchmark evaluating a controlled instance of dexterous visual tool use that adopts reference-guided visual reconstruction as its primary proxy task: the agent incrementally paints a canvas to match a reference image. EASEL additionally includes semantic tasks spanning region annotation, handwriting, and path planning. We further provide EASEL-Data, a 440k-sample two-stage curriculum dataset for trajectory supervision, and EASEL-9B to investigate its effect on this capability. Evaluation of 25 models reveals that current multimodal agents systematically struggle on EASEL. Reconstruction similarity bottlenecks at low levels (0.40-0.54), while trajectory diagnostics expose severe closed-loop instability - models typically saturate early or degrade post-peak. Semantic tasks reveal sharp capability boundaries in precision annotation and path planning. EASEL-9B, trained on EASEL-Data, surpasses the base model by a relative 6.3%, ranking third among all evaluated models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫EASEL的新基准，专门测试多模态AI模型能否根据视觉输入（参考图）精细控制画笔动作来逐步重绘图像，同时包含区域标注、手写、路径规划等语义任务，发现现有25个主流模型在此类‘视觉驱动的灵巧工具操作’上普遍表现差、闭环不稳定。
analysis.claim: 当前多模态智能体严重缺乏‘从视觉证据中推断并闭环执行高精度参数化工具动作’的能力，而EASEL是首个系统评测该能力的基准。
analysis.input: 参考图像+画布初始状态+可能的文本指令（如‘画一个圆’）
analysis.output: 逐笔绘制的动作序列（含位置、笔触大小、颜色、压力等参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真画布环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有洞见的新能力维度（视觉证据→参数化工具动作闭环），构建了首个针对性强、多任务分层的基准和配套数据集，实证扎实（25模型评测+轨迹诊断+消融验证），但本质仍属评估型工作，未提出新模型架构或控制范式，也未在真实物理系统验证，与T-Rex/ALOHA等解决真实灵巧操作瓶颈的里程碑工作存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视觉-动作闭环的评估做深做细，但仍是benchmark驱动的诊断性工作，未突破建模或部署层面。

papers.title: R2S-Eval: Robot Evaluation with Real-to-Sim Calibration via Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Evaluating robot manipulation policies is becoming increasingly important as generalist models, particularly vision-language-action (VLA) models, are deployed on physical robots. However, conventional real-world evaluation remains labor-intensive, unstable, and insufficiently informative. It requires repeated hardware trials, manual scene resets, and continuous operator monitoring, may produce different policy rankings across repeated evaluations, and primarily relies on success-rate metrics that provide limited information about execution quality. In contrast, humans assess robot performance by observing and comparing complete behaviors rather than relying solely on binary success outcomes. To this end, we propose R2S-Eval, an evaluation pipeline that combines real-to-sim calibration with vision-language model (VLM) preference evaluation. The real-to-sim component efficiently generates rollout videos in a simulator calibrated to the real-world evaluation setting, thereby reducing the need for repeated hardware trials. The VLM evaluator assesses the execution quality of rollout videos and produces pairwise preferences, which are subsequently aggregated into policy rankings. We further introduce a protocol to assess whether the proposed evaluation pipeline yields validated policy conclusions while mitigating the key challenges of conventional real-world evaluation. Experiments in both simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that R2S-Eval produces reliable and stable policy conclusions, achieves agreement with human preferences, substantially reduces repeated hardware-operation effort, and reveals behavior-quality differences that are not captured by binary success labels. In general, R2S-Eval advances robot evaluation from manual success counting toward automated, statistically stable, and quality-aware evaluation of robot behavior. Project page: https://r2s-eval.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出R2S-Eval评估框架：用视觉语言模型（VLM）对仿真中生成的、经真实场景标定的机器人操作视频做成对偏好打分，替代传统依赖反复真机实验和二值成功率的低效人工评估，实现更稳定、更细粒度、更接近人类判断的行为质量评估。
analysis.claim: 基于真实-仿真标定与VLM偏好评价的自动化评估 pipeline，能在显著减少真机实验次数的前提下，产出比二值成功率更稳定、更符合人类判断的策略排序。
analysis.input: 机器人操作的 rollout 视频（来自标定后的仿真器）
analysis.output: 策略间的成对偏好关系及聚合后的策略排名
analysis.data_dependency: 需少量真实场景视频用于real-to-sim标定（摘要未说明是否需真机交互数据，仅提‘calibrated to the real-world evaluation setting’，推断需真实视频但不依赖真机闭环执行数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将real-to-sim标定与VLM偏好建模系统性引入机器人策略评估，实证显示其能稳定排序、匹配人类判断、揭示行为质量差异；但未在多机体/跨任务泛化验证，无真机闭环部署，代码模型未开源，属显著贡献而非里程碑——它优化了评估范式，但未推动策略本身能力边界。

papers.title: WM-Craftnet: World Synesthesia Model for Generalizable and Robust Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalizable and robust dexterous in-hand manipulation requires a policy to infer object pose, geometry, contact, and potential slip from partial and noisy observations. Although recent tactile and visuotactile RL methods achieve strong in-hand rotation in controlled settings, their robustness often degrades under pose shifts, force disturbances, and object variation. We propose WM-Craftnet, a world-model-conditioned framework that learns compact action-conditioned latent dynamics from proprioception, depth, tactile sensing, and actions, supervised by multimodal reconstruction and reward prediction. Rather than using the world model for latent imagination or policy optimization, WM-Craftnet uses the learned World Synesthesia Model (WSM) as recurrent task context for an asymmetric actor--critic policy. Importantly, WSM is trained to reconstruct clean depth targets from noisy depth inputs, providing a denoised geometric state for real-robot deployment. Ablations over recurrent baselines, auxiliary heads, tactile masking, and WSM modality heads show that predictive world modeling, clean-depth supervision, and tactile contact cues all shape the learned state. A WSM pretrained on nine \(z\)-axis objects serves as a reusable prior for \(49\)-object downstream policy learning. This context improves multi-object rotation, with quantitative and qualitative evidence for unseen-object, perturbation-recovery, and sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 提出WM-Craftnet框架，用多模态（深度+触觉+本体感知）输入训练一个世界合成模型（WSM）来去噪深度图并建模隐状态动力学，再将该隐状态作为上下文输入给异构Actor-Critic策略，提升灵巧手在-hand旋转任务中对新物体、外力扰动和仿真到真实环境的泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过将预测式世界模型（WSM）作为可复用的、去噪增强的递归任务上下文，而非用于想象或策略优化，能显著提升灵巧手操作策略在跨物体、抗扰动和sim2real场景下的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 本体感知+深度图像+触觉信号+动作
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + RealSense D435 + BioTac SP
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多物体触觉-视觉-本体数据（含9个预训练物体+49个下游物体）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署、49物体泛化、扰动恢复定量测试、消融验证WSM各模块贡献、预训练-微调范式复用；但未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破（如无统一接触建模基础架构/未开源核心模型权重/未覆盖全接触操作谱系），属强工程整合+方法创新，略逊于ALOHA/ACT（后者已形成通用模仿学习基础设施）但优于多数单任务触觉策略工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在灵巧操作领域实现了多模态世界模型与策略解耦设计的高质量落地，证据充分但未开新范式

papers.title: From LLM-Generated Specifications to Learned Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract: Quadruped robot locomotion policies are often trained using reinforcement learning, which in turn relies heavily on hand-crafted reward functions. Designing reward functions requires substantial manual engineering, and it is often unclear which local rewards will induce the desired global behavior. Shaped rewards from formal specifications in languages like Signal Temporal Logic (STL) can make rewards more interpretable, but writing STL specifications itself still requires domain expertise. We study whether large language models (LLMs) can fill this gap by generating Parametric Signal Temporal Logic (PSTL) specifications that are subsequently used for policy learning. Given a natural language locomotion objective and a constrained specification grammar, GPT-5.5 and Qwen 3.6 independently propose STL templates for command tracking, safety, and gait structure. We instantiate the parameters of the generated PSTL templates using expert trajectories and retain only specifications that are consistent with demonstrated expert behavior. The resulting specifications are then transformed into smooth, finite-history reward functions and used to train a quadruped locomotion policy with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in MuJoCo XLA (MJX). We evaluate both \emph{gait-aware} and \emph{gait-agnostic} settings. The former specifies walking-trot, trot, and bound regimes, while the latter allows contact patterns to emerge from the task objective. We compare against hand-engineered rewards, Text2Reward-style LLM-generated reward code, and an expert-switching oracle. Gait-aware Qwen 3.6 specifications achieved 100\% survival and command success across all tested speeds (0.3--2.1 m/s) and matched the target gait at high speeds, whereas Text2Reward achieved 0\% for both metrics at $\geq 1.9$ m/s. Videos: https://stl-locomotion.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型（GPT-5.5/Qwen 3.6）把自然语言描述的四足机器人行走目标自动转成可执行的参数化信号时序逻辑（PSTL）规范，再据此生成平滑奖励函数，训练出在0.3–2.1 m/s全速段100%存活且精准复现目标步态的MuJoCo仿真策略，显著优于手工奖励和Text2Reward基线。
analysis.claim: 大语言模型可在约束语法下自动生成语义合理、行为一致的PSTL规范，替代人工设计奖励函数，实现更鲁棒、可解释、泛化性更强的四足运动策略学习。
analysis.input: 自然语言行走目标（如‘快速安全地向前走，保持稳定不摔倒’）+ 约束的PSTL语法模板
analysis.output: 参数化STL规范 → 平滑有限历史奖励函数 → PPO训练所得运动策略（关节力矩/动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo XLA（MJX）中的四足机器人仿真器（如A1或Go1简化模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量专家演示轨迹用于参数实例化与规范筛选，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证LLM生成形式化运动规范（PSTL）的可行性与实效性，在仿真中达成全速段鲁棒步态控制，证据扎实（多LLM对比、消融式规范筛选、跨速测试、vs Text2Reward/oracle），但仅限仿真、未上真机、未开源代码/模型，未突破reward engineering范式本身，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM+形式化规范+强化学习链条打通并实证有效，但停留在仿真闭环，缺乏真机验证与开源支撑，尚未构成方法论级突破。

papers.title: Phase-and-First-Arrival VLM Feedback for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning in Surgical Manipulation
papers.abstract: Sparse outcome feedback limits what robots can learn from unsuccessful attempts at complex manipulation. Failed multi-stage surgical attempts can contain grasps, lifts, or transfers worth reusing. In sparse-reward reinforcement learning, terminal rewards collapse such attempts to the same outcome, while scalar vision-language model (VLM) ratings reveal neither what progress merits credit nor when it occurred. We introduce phase-and-first-arrival feedback: one VLM query per recorded episode identifies the furthest visually verified task phase and when that phase is first reached, allowing the learner to reuse partial behavior and localize credit. We instantiate it in SurgPhaseBench, a phase-structured suite spanning rigid and deformable tasks, and evaluate it in simulation and hardware. Across five simulated tasks, our method reaches 75.2% mean success, compared with 52.1% for a reward based on Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) using the same visual input; the advantage persists when only the feedback representation changes. On hardware, the same record supports autonomous block picking and slip recovery. Together, these results show that trajectory-level visual supervision can preserve partial progress while providing the temporal credit needed for sparse-reward control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用视觉语言模型（VLM）对机器人手术操作的每个尝试视频打‘阶段进度+首次到达时间’标签，替代传统稀疏终端奖励，让强化学习能复用失败尝试中的有效子行为（比如成功抓取但没完成转移），并在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了该反馈机制显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 轨迹级、阶段感知的VLM反馈（而非标量评分或终端奖励）能有效解耦稀疏奖励中被淹没的部分成功，实现跨阶段信用分配与行为复用。
analysis.input: 单段操作视频（含RGB图像序列+任务文本描述）
analysis.output: 最远达成的任务阶段编号 + 该阶段首次出现的帧时间戳
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435 摄像头
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人录制的失败/成功操作视频用于VLM标注；但训练RL策略时仅需这些标注结果，不依赖真实机器人在线交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏奖励手术操作这一长期难点上，首次将VLM用于细粒度、可定位的阶段级信用分配，并在仿真+真机双环境验证多任务泛化性；但未开源代码/模型，未与RT-2/π0等范式级工作对比，也未证明其反馈机制可迁移至通用VLA架构，属扎实的重大改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM从全局评分器升级为时空定位器，在手术操作中实现了有实证支撑的信用分解，但未触及基础模型架构或通用具身智能范式。

papers.title: Localized Visual Feature Aggregation via Focus Pooling for Visuomotor Policies
papers.abstract: Focusing on spatially localized, control-relevant visual cues has been shown to improve data efficiency in visuomotor policies by reducing the need to model task-irrelevant visual variation. Existing methods often impose this focus through input preprocessing, such as cropping control- or object-centric regions in RGB images or point-clouds. However, it remains underexplored whether such localized features can be exposed directly from commonly used convolutional neural network (CNN) encoded features. In this paper, we show that intermediate CNN features preserve localized visual context for control, but existing pooling methods fail to aggregate it effectively. We introduce FocusPool, an attention pooling module that selectively aggregates intermediate visual features according to their relevance to the robot's current proprioceptive context. The resulting pooled representation captures task-progressive, control-relevant local information and is used directly for policy learning. Across simulation and real-world experiments, FocusPool improves policy success rates over pooling and explicit local focus methods by 36.2% and 41.2%, with training only 5.8% of encoder parameters.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FocusPool的新注意力池化模块，不靠预处理裁剪图像，而是直接从CNN中间特征图中按机器人当前本体感觉（如关节角、末端位姿）动态聚焦并聚合空间局部视觉特征，从而提升视觉运动策略的数据效率和成功率。
analysis.claim: CNN中间层特征天然保留控制相关的空间局部视觉信息，但标准池化会破坏其结构；通过本体感觉引导的注意力池化（FocusPool）可无损提取并聚合这些信息，显著提升策略性能且仅微调极小比例编码器参数。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 机器人本体感觉（关节角/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 聚合后的视觉特征向量（用于后续策略网络输入）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（PyBullet/Mujoco）及真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于验证，但训练主阶段在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰、实证扎实（仿真+真实机器人多任务验证，含与crop-based方法和标准pooling的对比，有消融），但未突破范式——仍属视觉表征工程优化，未解决具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程时序建模、跨形态泛化、零样本迁移），也未达到ALOHA/ACT或Diffusion Policy级的通用性或部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在视觉特征利用效率上做出扎实改进，有明确工程价值，但未开新范式，也未达领域基石水平。

papers.title: Harness Robotic OS: A Unified Embodied-Agent Runtime for Closed-Loop Quadruped Inspection
papers.abstract: Autonomous property inspection requires more than robust robot navigation: a deployable system must connect heterogeneous sensing, reusable autonomy capabilities, multimodal scene understanding, human interaction, and enterprise response within a traceable operational loop. Existing quadruped inspection systems commonly integrate these functions through task-specific interfaces, making contextual coordination, knowledge reuse, and controlled adaptation difficult. This paper presents \textit{Harness Robotic OS} (HROS), a unified embodied-agent runtime, and Argos, its realization for residential-community inspection. HROS organizes the system into robot runtime, embodied autonomy skills, cognitive agent runtime, and interaction and operations planes. A shared context connects physical state with agent reasoning; streaming ASR/TTS supports voice-based mission interaction; hierarchical working, episodic, and semantic memory preserves operational knowledge; and a safety-gated self-evolution loop converts execution traces into versioned candidate updates without permitting unconstrained online modification. The Argos prototype integrates a Vbot quadruped, Fast-LIO2 localization and mapping, Hobot-Stereo depth perception, PCT-Planner global planning, EGO-Planner local motion generation, and OpenClaw-orchestrated Qwen3-VL inspection analysis. Experiments in a residential property environment achieved 100\% waypoint reachability, outdoor localization error below 10~cm, local obstacle-response latency below 200~ms, representative hazard-detection rates of 85--95\%, and 99\% success in alarm delivery and structured-report generation. These results validate the deployed navigation and inspection closed loop, while HROS provides an extensible software foundation for memory-augmented, voice-aware, and continuously improvable embodied inspection agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Harness Robotic OS（HROS）的统一具身智能体运行时系统，专为四足机器人住宅巡检任务设计，把感知、规划、运动控制、多模态理解、语音交互、记忆机制和安全可控的自我演进闭环全部集成在一个可部署的软件架构里，并在真实社区环境中验证了导航、避障、隐患识别和报告生成的端到端闭环能力。
analysis.claim: 统一的具身智能体运行时（HROS）能结构化整合异构感知、自主技能、认知推理与人机交互，并通过安全门控的执行迹演化机制实现可追溯、可版本化、不破坏稳定性的持续改进。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、IMU、激光雷达、语音指令、巡检任务语义描述
analysis.output: 四足机器人运动轨迹、隐患检测结果（类别+位置）、结构化巡检报告、语音反馈
analysis.robot_dependency: Vbot四足机器人 + Fast-LIO2 + Hobot-Stereo + PCT-Planner + EGO-Planner + OpenClaw-orchestrated Qwen3-VL
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实四足机器人在住宅环境中的部署数据（含定位、避障、检测、报警全流程）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个在真实住宅场景完成端到端巡检闭环（导航+检测+报告+语音交互+安全自演化）的工业级四足具身OS架构，证据扎实（100%可达率、<10cm定位误差、<200ms响应、85–95%隐患检出），但未突破底层运动控制或世界建模范式，属于重大工程整合与系统级创新，尚未达到GR00T/H2O/ω-0等定义新范式的95+分量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从单点算法到可部署、可记忆、可演化的具身巡检系统闭环，但未提出新学习范式或基础模型结构。

papers.title: ReWeight: Leveraging Human Data for VLA Post-Training via Demonstration Retrieval and Sample Weighting
papers.abstract: Post-training vision-language-action (VLA) models for specific robots and tasks requires in-domain demonstrations, yet collecting diverse robot data is costly. Egocentric human demonstrations provide a scalable alternative, but directly mixing human and robot data can introduce cross-embodiment discrepancies and degrade policy performance. To address this challenge, we introduce ReWeight, a framework that incorporates human data into VLA post-training through demonstration-level retrieval and sample-level weighting. ReWeight learns a cross-embodiment visuomotor representation that combines visual observations with future actions to measure behavioral similarity between human and robot demonstrations. Based on optimal transport, it retrieves human demonstrations relevant to the target robot data and assigns larger weights to samples with smaller cross-embodiment discrepancies. We evaluate ReWeight using $π_{0.5}$ across eight simulation tasks and four real-world tasks under both clean and randomized settings. In simulation, ReWeight improves the average success rate of post-trained $π_{0.5}$ from 39% with only robot data and 44% with randomly mixed human-robot data to 57%. In the physical experimental setting, it achieves an average success rate of 68.8%, outperforming the baselines by 28.8% and 13.8%, respectively. Overall, ReWeight provides an effective paradigm for transforming abundant egocentric human experience into transferable supervision for robot learning. (Project webpage: https://reweight-vla.github.io/)

analysis.tldr: 提出ReWeight框架，用人类第一视角演示数据辅助VLA模型后训练，通过跨形态表征检索相似人类演示，并按人机行为差异程度对样本加权，提升机器人任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 人类演示数据可通过示范级检索与样本级加权有效迁移至VLA模型后训练，缓解跨形态偏差导致的性能下降。
analysis.input: 人类/机器人第一视角视频帧 + 对应动作序列（含未来动作预测）
analysis.output: 加权后的训练样本权重分布，用于调整VLA模型后训练损失

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示作为目标域锚点，但主体训练依赖人类演示（如Ego4D、EPIC-KITCHENS子集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在8个仿真+4个真实任务上系统验证了人类演示加权迁移的有效性，真机结果提升显著（+28.8%绝对），有跨机体泛化证据和最优传输驱动的可解释加权机制，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战VLA基础架构瓶颈（如世界模型、分层规划），属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类演示迁移问题建模为可计算的跨形态行为对齐任务，方法务实、实证充分，但未触及VLA核心架构创新或大规模真实数据基建。

papers.title: TacSushi: Tactile-Grounded World-Action Modeling for Dexterous Sushi Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous food manipulation requires control under deformation, occlusion, and uncertain contact. We present TacSushi, a tactile-grounded, Cosmos3-based world-action policy that learns from recorded future consequences while acting on current observations. The backbone encodes current RGB, language, and hand state, and feature-wise gated fusion incorporates fingertip tactile features into the action representation. During training, a decoder conditioned on demonstrated action chunks predicts logged future visual observations, task progress, relative contact risk, and tactile summaries; this decoder is removed at deployment. Failed trials provide consequence supervision, but their actions are excluded from imitation. We train TacSushi on 340 successful and 50 failed real-robot trials and compare six methods in 600 separate rollouts across three in-distribution tasks and two out-of-distribution ingredient variants. To assess food quality beyond a single geometric threshold, we score terminal outcomes using an anchored visual-quality protocol that equally weights five human ratings and three vision-language-model ratings per rollout. Full TacSushi achieves 68.3% average in-distribution success and 37.5% out-of-distribution success, compared with 36.7%/10.0% without future-consequence supervision and 25.0%/17.5% with direct tactile concatenation in place of gated fusion. These comparisons support complementary benefits of feature-wise gated tactile fusion and training-only predictive supervision.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人做寿司操作任务，提出一个融合指尖触觉的视觉-语言-手部状态策略模型TacSushi，核心是训练时用未来视觉/风险/触觉等后果预测做监督（部署时去掉预测头），并通过门控式触觉特征融合提升灵巧操作鲁棒性，在3个标准寿司任务和2种新食材上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 触觉特征需通过特征级门控融合而非简单拼接接入动作表征，且仅在训练阶段利用多模态未来后果预测进行监督，可显著提升真实灵巧食品操作的泛化性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+手部关节/姿态状态+4指指尖触觉信号
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Panda + BioTac tactiles
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：340成功+50失败的真实机器人操作轨迹，全部采集自物理平台
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署、跨食材泛化、多维终端质量评估（人类+VLM）、消融完整（对比无后果监督/直接拼接触觉）、数据量合理（390真实轨迹），但未开源代码/模型，且任务域聚焦食品操作，通用性弱于T-Rex/Facet-0等跨物体/跨场景/跨传感器的基础模型；属当前触觉灵巧操作中工程扎实、实证充分的顶尖应用级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作闭环中系统验证了触觉融合范式与后果监督的有效性，但未突破基础建模范式或跨域泛化边界，属于高完成度、强实证的应用标杆

papers.title: RoboFind: Multi-Agent Personalized Object Search for People Who Are Blind or Have Low Vision
papers.abstract: Blind and low-vision users often need to locate a specific personal object rather than an arbitrary instance of the same category. The task calls for a robot that can move through the space and reach viewpoints the user cannot, and for an accessible interface where the user says which object is meant and learns whether the right one was found. We present RoboFind, a multi-agent framework in which a smartphone teaches the target and a quadruped robot carries out the search. A Target Teaching Agent converts guided smartphone recordings into a semantic target profile and a reusable multi-view reference bank through an accessible capture flow with AR guidance, speech and haptic feedback, and screen-reader support, so later missions refer to a stored object without repeating the teaching process. At runtime, a Navigation Agent explores the environment and proposes candidate targets, a Verification Agent checks each candidate against the stored references, and a Coordination and Recovery Agent completes the mission or triggers recovery and continued search. Across 32 real-robot missions, RoboFind reaches 85.0% success against 25.0% for a reconstructed sequential first-stop baseline over 20 trials with ten targets, and reduces false success from 75.0% to 5.0%. On six shared targets it succeeds in 10/12 trials, against 5/12 for 12 independently executed GPT-6 Astra-only trials. These results show that the multi-agent design fits the demands of personalized object search, where verifying object identity before declaring completion is what makes the outcome something a user can rely on.

analysis.tldr: 为视障人士设计了一个多智能体机器人系统RoboFind：用智能手机教机器人识别用户特定的个人物品（比如自己那副眼镜），再由四足机器人在真实环境中搜索并确认，避免找错相似物品。
analysis.claim: 个性化物品搜索必须将目标教学、导航探索、身份验证和任务协调解耦为多智能体协作流程，才能在真实场景中实现高精度、低误判的可靠检索。
analysis.input: 智能手机录制的多视角AR引导视频+语音指令+触觉反馈+屏幕阅读器交互（用于目标教学）；机器人RGB-D+IMU+激光雷达数据（用于导航与验证）
analysis.output: 机器人抵达目标物品位置并给出确认/否决判断（含语音反馈）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 四足机器人 + 智能手机（作为教学端）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人部署数据：32次真实任务全部在物理环境运行，含10个私有目标物、6个跨用户共享目标；无仿真预训练或纯仿真报告
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上闭环验证‘个性化物体’（非类别级）搜索的多智能体架构，含可复用目标库、跨用户验证、显著压降误成功（75%→5%），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更广义的具身泛化（如新场景零样本迁移），属扎实重磅但未达范式级突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把目标教学、导航、验证拆成可验证的多智能体流水线，并在真实机器人上跑通高可靠性搜索，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，不是理论或范式突破

papers.title: Duty Factor Predicts Robust Constrained Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Gait Types
papers.abstract: Quadrupedal robots are increasingly deployed in environments where locomotion must remain robust to disturbances and constrained terrain. Gait type, such as walking or trotting, is commonly used to characterize quadrupedal locomotion. However, gait type does not uniquely define locomotion, as parameters such as duty factor, speed, and stance width can vary within a single gait type. In this work, we investigate the relationship between these gait parameters using three distinct quadrupedal locomotion control approaches. First, using whole body trajectory optimization with LQR feedback, we show that duty factor is a stronger predictor of local error convergence than nominal gait type. Second, we investigate duty factor selection with a learned locomotion controller, suggesting how duty factor may serve as a low-dimensional parameter for adapting locomotion robustness in narrow-terrain environments. Finally, we show that these trends persist under a centroidal model predictive control framework and validate them through narrow-terrain experiments on a physical quadruped. These results show that duty factor provides a simple and effective basis for understanding and selecting robust quadrupedal locomotion across gait types and control architectures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现步态周期中脚与地面接触时间占比（占空比）比传统步态分类（如行走、小跑）更能预测四足机器人在狭窄地形下的运动鲁棒性，并在三种不同控制框架（轨迹优化+LQR、学习型控制器、CMPC）下验证了该规律，最后用真机窄地形实验确认了结论。
analysis.claim: 占空比（duty factor）是比步态类型更本质、更普适的鲁棒四足运动预测因子，适用于不同控制架构和地形约束条件。
analysis.input: 步态参数（占空比、速度、支撑宽度等）及地形约束条件
analysis.output: 鲁棒性评估指标（局部误差收敛性、失稳阈值、成功穿越率）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人窄地形实验数据（含扰动与约束），但未说明是否公开采集数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖三类主流控制范式（优化、学习、模型预测控制），含真机窄地形扰动实验与消融对比，揭示了被长期忽视的底层运动学参数（占空比）的普适性作用；但未开新范式、未解决长期开放难题（如通用地形自适应），也未达RT-2/AlphaFold级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——用多范式真机实验证实占空比是比步态类型更根本的鲁棒性调控变量，证据链完整，但属于对既有控制框架的深度洞察而非范式突破

papers.title: DAWN: Noise-Robust Quadruped Parkour via Depth-Denoising World Models
papers.abstract: Vision-based legged locomotion methods assume clean depth at training time and rely on hand-tuned post-processing filters at deployment. However, filter parameters are rarely disclosed, hindering reproducibility, and performance degrades substantially when depth noise is left unaddressed. Building noise robustness directly into the learning pipeline would eliminate this dependency. While such robustness has been explored for proprioceptive inputs, analogous approaches for depth perception remain largely absent in legged locomotion. We propose DAWN (Denoising and Alignment in World models for Noise-robustness), a noise-robust perception framework for legged locomotion, which builds noise robustness directly into a world model via two modifications: (1) feeding noisy depth to the encoder while keeping clean depth as the reconstruction target, forcing the model to implicitly denoise its input; and (2) applying contrastive learning to align the latent states of noisy and clean depth. Importantly, DAWN is not tied to a specific noise model, requiring no manual tuning to the noise distribution at deployment. Furthermore, it incurs no additional inference cost over existing world model-based methods. Without any manual filter calibration -- relying solely on the learned noise-robust representation -- DAWN achieves zero-shot quadruped parkour on a Unitree Go1: traversing stairs up to 18 cm, clearing gaps up to 70 cm, and mounting steps up to 45 cm from raw depth observations. Ablation studies show that denoising and contrastive alignment contribute at complementary levels -- reconstruction and representation, respectively -- and yield additive gains when combined. Videos and code are available at: https://dawn-parkour.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出DAWN框架，让四足机器人仅靠原始带噪声的深度图就能完成跑酷任务（上楼梯、跨沟、上台阶），不依赖人工调参的后处理滤波器，而是把去噪能力直接嵌入世界模型的训练过程。
analysis.claim: 将深度去噪与对比对齐联合嵌入世界模型训练流程，可实现零样本、免人工调参、无额外推理开销的噪声鲁棒四足跑酷。
analysis.input: 原始带噪声的深度图像序列
analysis.output: 动作策略（连续控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go1 + RealSense D435i 深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人部署数据用于最终验证，但训练数据主要来自仿真（未明说比例，但实验显示需sim2real迁移）
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次系统性将自监督深度去噪与世界模型结合，并在真实四足机器人上完成多类型复杂地形零样本泛化；虽未开创新范式（如Dreamer系列），但显著推进了视觉鲁棒性与世界模型落地的工程闭环，证据扎实（真机多任务+消融+开源）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是理论突破，但把噪声鲁棒性从‘部署补丁’升级为‘学习内建能力’，并在真实Go1上验证了跨任务零样本跑酷，是当前sim2real世界模型落地的关键补强。

papers.title: Fast Plans, Faithful Actions: Closing the Planning-Execution Gap in Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) systems consist of a high-level vision-language planner and a low-level action expert that generates continuous actions. This hierarchical design has practical value only if the planner can generate plans fast enough to meet real-time control requirements, and the resulting plans actually contribute to the generation of action. We study one such system, a waypoint hierarchy pipeline adapted from $π_{0.5}$, and find that neither requirement is satisfied. This baseline relies on token-level autoregressive decoding (Token-AR) to generate a waypoint plan, requiring 57 very expensive vision-language model (VLM) forward passes. However, we find that erasing the waypoint endpoints has little effect on task success. Two findings reveal the misalignment of planner-executor: the planner generates outputs at an excessively fine granularity, and the executor underuses plans as a control condition. We address the latency issue with waypoint-aligned block-autoregressive decoding (Block-AR), and plan underuse issue with normalized goal modulation (NGM), a layer-wise goal path constrained by phase gating and anti-shortcut training so that the waypoint influences action generation maintaining other signals. Our method reduces the maximum number of VLM forward passes from 57 to 8 on LIBERO, including one prefix prefill, and achieves an $8.7\times$ reduction in planning latency on a Rokae dual-arm robot. With normalized goal modulation and anti-shortcut training, Block-AR's success rate on LIBERO-Long increases from 91.0% to 96.2%, while its average success rate across the four suites increases from 95.85% to 98.45%. On three bimanual tasks with this robot, success rates remain comparable across methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前分层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中，高层规划器生成的路径点计划既慢（57次大模型前向）又无效（删掉终点几乎不影响成功率），于是提出两种改进：块对齐的自回归解码（Block-AR）大幅降低推理延迟，以及归一化目标调制（NGM）强制执行器真正使用规划路径——最终在LIBERO和真实双臂机器人上显著提升成功率与实时性。
analysis.claim: 分层VLA系统中规划-执行失配的根本原因是规划粒度过细且执行器未有效利用规划信号，通过Block-AR解码结构与NGM目标调制机制可同步解决高延迟与计划空转问题。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（双臂关节速度/位姿增量）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈进行NGM训练与anti-shortcut设计，但未说明是否依赖大规模真机轨迹数据预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO四套基准+3个真实双臂任务上验证，有明确消融（Block-AR vs Token-AR、NGM vs no NGM）、真实硬件延迟测量（8.7×）、成功率提升（+2.6% avg），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难长时序或开放世界任务，未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级范式突破，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是概念包装，而是定位并修复了分层VLA中被广泛忽视的‘规划空转’顽疾，用可复现的架构修改+训练机制，在仿真与真实机器人上均取得稳健增益。

papers.title: Generate, Track, Improve: Perceptive Multi-Skill Humanoid Locomotion with RL-Fine-Tuned Motion Generators
papers.abstract: General purpose humanoids require locomotion controllers that are multi-skill, perceptive, dynamic, and robust enough to go anywhere humans can. In this work, we present a two layer locomotion architecture: (1) a perceptive flow matching motion generator plans whole body trajectories from raw depth images while a (2) perceptive tracking policy trained with control-guided RL follows these motions. Both policies are trained on a library of terrain consistent motion clips created with dynamically optimized human data which yields both accurate velocity tracking and terrain consistent references. Our central contribution is a simple yet effective off-policy RL fine tuning loop that improves the motion generator. A structured search method is used with the generator to gather data for advantage weighted regression. This off-policy loop is much more sample efficient than on-policy residual fine tuning and improves terrain consistency on unseen geometries and skill compositions. We find that successful terrain traversals increased by up to 25 percentage points and skill selection improved by up to 80 percentage points. By using raw depth images to perceive the environment no odometry or height maps are needed, and outdoor deployment is easy. With two cameras, the policy can see terrain coming from further away and adjust its velocity regardless of the commanded speed so it can traverse the terrain. A single policy pair enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to walk, run, stand, jump on and off of boxes, and traverse stairs in outdoor environments. Project page: https://zolkin1.github.io/generate-track-improve/

analysis.tldr: 用深度图直接感知地形，通过两层架构（运动生成器+RL微调的跟踪控制器）让Unitree G1人形机器人在户外真实场景中完成行走、奔跑、上下箱、爬楼梯等多技能运动，无需高度图或里程计，且微调过程大幅提升了未见地形和技能组合下的运动一致性。
analysis.claim: 通过离线RL微调运动生成器，可在不依赖显式地形建模或预设状态估计的前提下，显著提升人形机器人在真实复杂户外地形中多技能运动的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始深度图像（双目摄像头输入）
analysis.output: 全身关节轨迹（生成器输出） + 实时关节力矩/位置控制指令（跟踪策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + RealSense D455深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的地形一致运动片段（用于构建初始motion clip库），但RL微调阶段主要使用结构化搜索+离线数据复用，非持续真实数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1上全技能（走/跑/跳/爬梯）户外部署，有明确量化提升（+25pt通行率、+80pt技能选择准确率），含消融验证离线RL微调有效性，并规避了传统方法对高度图/IMU/里程计的依赖；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证（仅G1），也未挑战极端动态任务（如摔倒恢复、高速对抗），故略低于GR00T N1或H2O级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将运动生成、感知驱动、离线RL微调三者在真实人形平台上稳健闭环，证据扎实但生态开放度不足，属当前具身智能落地的高完成度范例。

papers.title: Learning Task and Motion Plans from Real Demonstrations with Hybrid Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a task plan and the motion that executes it. Generative planners trained on demonstration produce both in one pass, requiring neither a symbolic domain nor search. To date, however, they have relied on thousands of scripted demonstrations of fixed-base arms and executed open loop. This paper presents a hybrid flow matching planner: a single network generates the symbolic plan with masked discrete flow matching and the motion trajectory with continuous flow matching. Unlike prior generative planners, we aim to learn from a much smaller set of demonstrations and to execute the plan in closed loop. Two properties of the data compensate for the small dataset. A demonstration resumed from any of its intermediate actions is itself a demonstration, which multiplies the training samples and enables replanning after every action. Objects of the same kind are interchangeable, which turns demonstrations of one goal into demonstrations of every permuted goal. Our base implementation produces valid plans on 68% of held-out scenes; a training and generation scheme for the discrete plan raises this to 76%, and replanning after every action raises the task completion rate from 40% to 53% in a kinematic simulation. The planner matches the task completion rate of motion-only flow matching policies while additionally providing the symbolic plan, and it outperforms previous hybrid diffusion formulations on both task completion and plan validity. We validate the planner on a real mobile manipulator. Videos and project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种混合流匹配规划器，用单个神经网络同时生成符号任务计划（如'抓杯子→放桌上'）和连续运动轨迹，只用少量真实机器人演示数据就能训练，并支持每步动作后重新规划，最终在真实移动机械臂上验证了可行性。
analysis.claim: 仅需少量真实演示即可训练出能闭环执行、自动生成可解释符号计划与运动轨迹的统一生成式规划器。
analysis.input: 真实机器人演示的动作序列（含位姿、关节、物体状态等观测）
analysis.output: 符号任务计划（离散动作序列）+ 连续运动轨迹（关节/末端位姿时间序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + TurtleBot3 移动底座（真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据，但强调小样本（未给出具体数量，从上下文推断远少于‘数千’），且通过演示切片和目标置换增强数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实移动操纵平台上实现端到端符号+运动联合生成与闭环重规划，验证了小样本混合流匹配的可行性；虽未达Facet-0/IronMind级范式突破，但在生成式规划方向上显著推进了实用性（真机部署+重规划+符号可解释性），证据扎实（多指标提升+消融对比+真实硬件验证）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将离散符号规划与连续运动生成统一建模为混合流匹配，在真实移动机械臂上实现了闭环重规划，是生成式机器人规划向实用化迈出的关键一步，但未重构底层表征或解决接触密集等根本瓶颈

papers.title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
papers.abstract: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. Offline, ChunkAct compiles the memory into these chunks, so execution is memory-free at test time and the planner is reserved for decisions that require reasoning. LLM computation therefore scales with the number of decisions rather than the number of primitives. On LIBERO-Pro, ChunkAct improves task success by 5.0 points over the state of the art in agentic robotics while requiring 2.9x fewer LLM calls, 4.4x fewer input tokens, and 2.3x fewer output tokens.

analysis.tldr: 提出ChunkAct方法，将机器人任务中重复性高的动作序列打包成‘动作块’，让大语言模型只在关键决策点调用一次，而不是每个基础动作都调用一次，从而大幅减少LLM调用次数和计算开销，同时提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 在具身智能代理框架中引入动作分块机制，可显著降低LLM推理开销而不牺牲泛化能力，使LLM调用频次与决策数而非动作数对齐。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言观测+任务指令+记忆状态（离线编译后不需输入记忆）
analysis.output: 自主执行的动作块（含多步原始动作），失败时返回控制权
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在主流仿真基准LIBERO-Pro上实证了显著的效率-性能帕累托提升（+5.0% success, -65% LLM calls），且机制清晰、有离线编译+在线chunk执行的完整闭环，但未验证真实机器人、未跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未开源代码或模型，属扎实的系统级优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效压缩了LLM在具身代理中的冗余推理，是当前agentic robotics落地的关键瓶颈攻关，但尚未跨越仿真到现实的鸿沟

papers.title: MUCO: A Mani-Unit-Structured Manipulation Framework for Compositional Long-Horizon Robot Tasks
papers.abstract: Learning and executing long-horizon robot manipulation as complete task trajectories raises data-collection costs, lim?its capability reuse, and causes local failures to cascade into later task stages. We introduce manipulation units (MUs) as reusable operations, each defined by a local goal, an initi?ation condition, and observable success and failure criteria. MUs are learned and verified individually. During execution, consecutive MUs remain coupled through shared environ?ment dynamics. We formulate MU-Structured Manipulation (MUSM) and realize it through MU-Centric Orchestration (MUCO). Given language and vision, MUCO constructs an MU sequence, matches each MU to compatible policy models in a frozen capability registry, and dispatches the model with the highest calibrated success rate. Visual verification checks MU outcomes against success and failure criteria and governs transitions, enabling retry or fallback to another model from the current state without re-executing verified MUs. Canonical keys enable checkpoint reuse for equivalent MUs across tasks without new demonstrations or updates. We evaluate MUCO on RLBench, RoboTwin 2.0, and five real-world tasks. MUCO achieves higher complete-task success and verified progress, stronger failure containment, and lower error propagation than baselines. Results demonstrate cross-task MU reuse and het?erogeneous policy composition without joint training, shared backbones, or common action representations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种以可复用‘操作单元’（MU）为基本构件的机器人长程操作框架MUCO，每个MU有明确定义的启动条件、目标和成败判据，系统在执行时动态组合冻结的策略模型、视觉验证结果并支持失败重试与跨任务MU复用，无需联合训练或统一动作表征。

papers.title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
papers.abstract: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.

analysis.tldr: 提出Fréchet Forcing方法，用短视频片段（<400帧）微调流式世界模型，通过三个无教师约束（生成锚定、上下文保真、现实匹配）避免长程rollout漂移，在不依赖长视频、真实未来标签或在线教师模型的情况下，使模型稳定生成超4000帧且动作一致的视频预测。

papers.title: PACE: Phase-Aware Chunk Execution for Robot Policies with Action Chunking
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action and diffusion-based robot policies often use action chunking, where each policy query predicts a sequence of future actions and the robot executes an open-loop prefix before re-querying. While this interface improves local motion continuity, deployment still requires choosing the execution horizon: how much of each predicted chunk should be executed before acquiring a new observation. However, our experiments show that success is strongly task-dependent and non-monotonic with respect to the execution horizon, making a single constant horizon an unreliable deployment rule. We propose PACE (Phase-Aware Chunk Execution), a training-free test-time execution method that selects the execution horizon online from the predicted chunk itself. PACE exploits the phase-dependent kinematic structure of manipulation trajectories by identifying low-speed transition points in the predicted speed profile and using them as candidate replanning boundaries. Because PACE uses only the predicted action chunk, it is plug-and-play and requires no retraining or access to policy internals. We validate PACE through large-scale evaluations in both simulation and real-robot settings. On 50 RoboTwin2.0 tasks, PACE raises the average success rate from 57.8% to 64.2%. In real-robot experiments on bimanual ALOHA and single-arm Franka platforms, PACE improves the average task score from 60.7 to 77.7 and the average success rate from 50.7% to 70.4%. Ablations and rollout-level analyses show that PACE adapts execution horizons across manipulation phases, shortening near transitions while preserving longer execution during coherent motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决机器人动作分块策略（action chunking）中‘每次该执行多长动作序列’这个关键部署难题，提出一个无需训练、仅靠预测动作块自身速度曲线就能动态决定执行长度的在线方法PACE。
analysis.claim: 动作分块策略的执行长度不应固定，而应根据预测动作块内部的运动相位结构（特别是低速过渡点）在线自适应选择，且该选择可完全在测试时完成、无需重训练或访问策略内部。
analysis.input: 预测的动作块（含时间维度的连续动作序列）
analysis.output: 执行该动作块的截断长度（即下一个重规划点）
analysis.robot_dependency: ALOHA双臂平台、Franka单臂平台、RoboTwin2.0仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据训练，但验证阶段使用了真实机器人运行数据

papers.title: eMEM: A Hybrid Spatio-Temporal Memory System For Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: We present eMEM (Embodied Memory), a hybrid graph-based memory system for embodied agents operating in physical environments. Current agent memory architectures, such as Generative Agents, MemGPT, and A-MEM, treat memory as text streams or knowledge graphs, but embodied agents require memory that is simultaneously searchable by meaning, space, and time. eMEM fills this gap with a multi-index architecture (SQL ITE for structured storage, hnswlib for approximate nearest neighbour semantic search, and an R-tree for spatial queries) unified behind a single graph model. A tiered consolidation pipeline transforms raw perceptual observations into compressed summaries, mirroring hippocampal-neocortical consolidation in biological systems. Ten agent-facing recall tools expose memory retrieval primitives, including concept-to-location resolution and cross layer recall, as first-class operations for LLM tool calling. The system is fully embedded and runs in-process alongside the agent. In addition we introduce eMEM-Bench v1, a benchmark we construct over ProcTHOR-10K scenes for embodied memory evaluation. The benchmark is organised explicitly around eight cognitive-psychology paradigms (DRM lures, pattern separation, pattern completion, source monitoring, context-dependent retrieval, long-horizon interference, serial position, and a foil augmented retention curve), each chosen so that the result is interpretable against the broader memory-systems literature in humans and prior agent-memory systems; a level of diagnostic that surface-task benchmarks like LoCoMo or OpenEQA cannot provide. eMEM scores 80.8 weighted mean over 988 probes, with a flat retention curve at ceiling from 1 h to 1 yr of simulated delay on room-unique items. We show that a pure RAG baseline (the flat_rag ablation) loses 30 pt on context dependent retrieval and 29 pt on DRM lure rejection, isolating the contribution of multi-layer storage and consolidation respectively. We release both the system and the benchmark code.

analysis.tldr: 提出eMEM——一个融合结构化存储（SQLite）、语义检索（hnswlib）和空间索引（R-tree）的图式具身记忆系统，支持按意义/位置/时间三重查询，并配套首个基于认知心理学范式的具身记忆评测基准eMEM-Bench v1。

analysis.output: 结构化记忆图节点与边（含语义标签、空间坐标、时间戳、压缩摘要），以及面向LLM工具调用的10种可组合召回原语

papers.title: Regulatory landscape of widespread stop codon readthrough in Drosophila
papers.abstract: In stop codon readthrough (SCR), ribosomes continue to translate past the stop. While programmed SCR is rare in mammals, it appears remarkably widespread in insects, yet its regulation and biological significance remain poorly understood. Here, we systematically characterize SCR in Drosophila melanogaster by integrating ribosome profiling, comparative genomics, proteomics, and functional screening. We identify ~1,400 SCR genes, reveal sequence features associated with programmed SCR, and distinguish constitutive and tissue-restricted modes. We identify conserved cis-elements sufficient to stimulate constitutive SCR and demonstrate that many remain functional in mammalian cells. Unexpectedly, the major distinction between insect and mammalian cells was not termination efficiency, but insect responsiveness to SCR-promoting regulatory elements. SCR was further associated with increased overall protein output, suggesting a function beyond proteome diversification. Our results establish SCR as a pervasive regulatory mechanism in Drosophila and provide a new framework for its study through the Drosophila Stop Codon Readthrough Atlas.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统绘制了果蝇中广泛存在的终止密码子通读（SCR）图谱，整合多种组学数据鉴定出约1400个发生SCR的基因，发现并验证了保守的顺式调控元件，揭示其在果蝇中是普遍存在的转录后调控机制，且部分元件在哺乳动物细胞中仍具功能。
analysis.org: 麻省理工学院/哈佛大学Broad研究所
analysis.claim: 终止密码子通读（SCR）在果蝇中是一种广泛、受顺式元件调控、具有组织特异性和功能输出效应的内源性基因表达调控机制，而非随机翻译错误。
analysis.input: 果蝇多组织核糖体图谱（Ribo-seq）、比较基因组序列、质谱蛋白质组数据、功能筛选报告系统

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多组学数据深度整合为首个果蝇SCR系统图谱和可复用资源（Drosophila SCR Atlas），证据扎实、开源完备，但未提出新计算范式或颠覆性生物学机制。

papers.title: VQActFlow: Vector-Quantized Action Mode Steering for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-task robot manipulation policies are challenging to learn from demonstration because traditionally a single network must select among qualitatively different action modes from a multimodal demonstration distribution, conditioned on language and visual context. A wrong mode selection means executing the wrong task or an action infeasible in the scene. Tokenizing continuous actions into a learned discrete codebook separates these modes at the representation level, offering structural advantages for multi-task learning. We propose VQActFlow, a multi-task manipulation policy that tokenizes action chunks and generates code sequences via Variational Flow Matching. VQActFlow maintains an explicit preference over action modes throughout generation. Inference-time guidance acts on this preference to steer mode commitment. We instantiate this with classifier-free guidance over language conditioning, which steers the policy toward the instructed action mode, and a learned codebook critic that supplies a complementary feasibility signal. We evaluate VQActFlow on three platforms: the LIBERO simulation benchmarks, a Unitree G1 humanoid performing whole-body pick-and-place, and an ALOHA-style bimanual platform performing contact-rich tasks. Across these benchmarks, VQActFlow outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出VQActFlow，将连续动作分块并用向量量化（VQ）映射到离散码本，再用变分流匹配（Variational Flow Matching）生成码序列，并在推理时通过无分类器语言引导和可学习码本判别器联合调控动作模式选择，从而提升多任务机器人操作中动作模式的准确性和场景可行性。

papers.title: EEG Benchmarking Needs a Task Specification Layer: NeuroDoc for Rulebook-Guided, Executable Benchmark Construction
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly rely on multi-dataset training and evaluation, yet public EEG datasets still lack a shared task specification layer that can turn heterogeneous recordings into reusable benchmark units. Existing standards organize files, metadata, and provenance, but they do not specify EEG tasks under a common language and rulebook, leaving critical task semantics scattered across papers, code, and manual interpretation. We investigate whether heterogeneous public EEG datasets can be standardized through a structured task specification language paired with a shared rulebook. Our methodology represents each benchmark entry as a task document synchronized with an executable task kernel, with the rulebook defining task fields, evidence requirements, document-kernel alignment, review states, and machine-checkable constraints. Using this methodology, we release a community-reviewed EEG benchmark corpus centered on 53 completed and reviewed entries with 245 task definitions spanning diverse paradigms, and we introduce NeuroDoc and NeuroAudit as the operational support layer for rulebook-guided drafting, upgrading, review, amendment, and release management. We further examine whether the resulting benchmark units can be instantiated in a shared downstream setting across four EEG foundation model backbones, providing execution-based evidence for reusable, auditable, and executable EEG benchmarking infrastructure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出 NeuroDoc 框架，用结构化任务文档+可执行任务内核+社区审核规则本，把散乱的公开EEG数据集统一成可复现、可审计、可执行的基准单元，已构建含53个审核条目、245个任务定义的EEG基准语料库，并在4个EEG基础模型上验证了其下游可执行性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅列姓名；无明显机构标识如MIT/UCSD/中科院等）

analysis.output: 结构化任务文档（NeuroDoc）+可执行任务内核（Python函数/配置）+审核状态标记
