papers.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse tasks. However, effective robotic manipulation in physical environments fundamentally requires geometric understanding and spatial reasoning. While some VLA approaches attempt to incorporate 3D information, they are constrained by limited data availability and geometric information loss in current 3D encoding pipelines, and fail to jointly capture 3D geometry and temporally structured actions in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, we introduce Lift3D-VLA, a unified VLA framework that equips models with explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and enables temporally coherent action generation. First, building upon our previous work Lift3D, an enhanced 2D model-lifting strategy is proposed to geometrically align 3D points with pretrained 2D positional embeddings. This design enables direct point-cloud encoding within the VLA vision encoder while minimizing spatial information loss. Based on explicit 3D inputs, we propose Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding (GC-MAE), a dual-objective self-supervised framework that reconstructs the current point cloud while predicting its future geometric evolution. This formulation allows the 2D vision encoder to internalize both 3D structure and physical dynamics. To fully exploit 3D representations, we further design layer-wise temporal action modeling, which leverages multiple layers of the LLM to collaboratively predict action chunks, enabling temporally consistent predictions. Across 22 simulated tasks and 8 real-world manipulation tasks, Lift3D-VLA achieves 10.8% and 11.1% higher mean success rates on MetaWorld and RLBench than the best-performing prior VLA methods, and outperforms the strongest real-world baseline by 4 percentage points, while exhibiting stronger generalization to out-of-distribution perturbations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型升级为能真正理解3D点云几何结构和物理动态变化的版本，通过几何对齐的点云编码、自监督预测未来点云演变、以及分层时序动作建模，在仿真和真实机器人上都比之前最好的VLA方法提升了约10%的成功率。
analysis.claim: VLA模型必须显式建模3D几何与动态演化才能实现鲁棒的具身操作，而Lift3D-VLA通过点云对齐编码、GC-MAE自监督预训练和分层时序动作生成，首次在统一框架中联合实现这两者。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时3D点云（来自深度相机）
analysis.output: 时序一致的动作块（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；MetaWorld/RLBench仿真器（仿真评估）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的点云-动作对数据用于微调，但未说明是否开源该数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在22个仿真任务和8个真实机器人任务上系统性超越所有已知VLA基线（包括OpenVLA/Octo），且有消融实验证明各模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型/真实数据，且未在跨机体（如非Panda机械臂）或跨用户场景验证泛化，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属于扎实、可复现、有工程落地能力的重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架中首次完整嵌入3D几何与动力学建模，并在真机多任务上稳定胜出，但开源缺失和泛化边界未充分验证，尚属强工程实现而非理论范式跃迁。

papers.title: Capabilities, specificity gaps and training-data dependence of AlphaFold3 across diverse application areas
papers.abstract: Structure prediction models have moved from single proteins to assemblies that include diverse biomolecules and their modifications. AlphaFold3 (AF3) and related models extended structural modelling via an all-atom framework, opening many new potential applications in structural biology. We evaluate how well the new capabilities of AF3 translate into application tasks in diverse areas: prediction of ubiquitinated protein structures, T-cell receptor (TCR)-epitope recognition, antibody-antigen complexes, protein-RNA and protein-lipid interactions. We find that, while AF3 can perform well in favourable settings, this performance is uneven across applications. In RNA-target predictions, the model confidence fails to separate genuine from decoy interaction partners and in several tasks accuracy depends on the presence of related complexes in the training set. Taken together, our assessment is more cautious than for AF2, whose gains in modelling monomers and complexes were clear and broadly generalisable. AF3's extension to new biomolecule types shows less consistent performance and generalisation. AF3 can be a powerful tool for hypothesis generation and prioritisation, but its predictions and use of confidence metrics will depend strongly on the specific application area and must be interpreted with respect to training-set overlap. We expect that the benchmarks provided here will serve for testing of future developments in the structure prediction field.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了AlphaFold3在多种非蛋白类生物分子复合物（如蛋白-RNA、蛋白-脂质、TCR-表位等）结构预测任务上的实际表现，发现其性能高度依赖训练数据中是否存在相似复合物，且置信度分数无法可靠区分真实与错误预测，泛化性远不如AlphaFold2。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3在跨生物分子类型（RNA、脂质、TCR等）的结构预测任务中表现出显著的能力缺口和训练数据依赖性，其置信度不可靠，泛化能力有限。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列+修饰信息+配体序列/化学结构（如RNA序列、脂质SMILES、肽段序列）
analysis.output: 全原子三维结构坐标
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖训练集中是否包含同源或类似复合物（如相同RNA家族、相同TCR超家族）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个对AlphaFold3多模态生物分子预测能力的系统性实证评估，覆盖5类关键应用场景并揭示其核心缺陷（置信度失效、数据强依赖、泛化断裂），证据扎实（多任务、消融式训练集重叠分析、定量指标对比），但未提出新模型或算法，属高质量诊断性工作，分量介于扎实增量（74）与显著贡献（60）之间，低于ESMFold/RFdiffusion等开创性模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——不是突破模型，而是用严谨实验戳破AF3宣传泡沫，明确划出其能力边界，对领域实践有强指导价值

papers.title: Antigen-specific Antibody Multi-modal Foundation Model for Functional Antibody Design
papers.abstract: Antibodies are essential proteins that play a central role in immune recognition by binding specific antigen molecules. Although recent protein language models have enabled progress in single-chain protein modeling and generation, they often fall short in antigen-specific antibody design, where effective modeling requires explicit pairing between antibody and antigen, particularly at the epitope level. To address these limitations, we introduce AAMFM, an Antigen-specific Antibody Multimodal Foundation Model that learns unified representations of antibody sequences and structures conditioned on antigen context. AAMFM incorporates rich antigen information including geometric interfaces and epitope annotations via a cross-modal adapter, enabling joint modeling of antibody-antigen interactions in a shared latent space. To further guide the model toward functional relevance, we fine-tune AAMFM using Calibrated Direct Preference Optimization (Cal-DPO), leveraging preference signals extracted from a strong structural prior to align learning with binding-specific objectives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AAMFM achieves state-of-the-art performance in functional antibody design, revealing its potential for antigen-specific antibody engineering. Our code is available at https://github.com/XL-S224/AAMFM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个抗体-抗原多模态基础模型AAMFM，用交叉模态适配器融合抗体序列/结构与抗原的表位和几何界面信息，并通过校准的直接偏好优化（Cal-DPO）对齐结合功能目标，在抗体功能设计任务上刷出SOTA结果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub用户名XL-S224无明确机构指向，论文未提 affiliations）
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模抗体-抗原共变结构与表位语义的多模态联合表示，并引入基于结构先验校准的偏好优化，可显著提升抗原特异性功能性抗体的设计能力。
analysis.input: 抗体序列+抗体结构（如Cα坐标）+抗原结构+抗原表位标注+抗原-抗体界面几何特征
analysis.output: 优化后的抗体序列及/或结构（用于功能设计）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将表位级抗原上下文与抗体序列/结构在统一多模态空间中联合建模，并引入结构引导的Cal-DPO优化；但未开源训练数据、未报告跨抗原泛化（仅限测试集内抗原）、无湿实验验证、benchmark仅限计算指标（如dRMSD、interface F1），相比ESM-2/AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion等基石工作，缺乏原理性突破或大规模生物学有效性证明，属于扎实但窄口径的生成模型改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在抗体-抗原多模态生成这一细分方向做出实质性方法整合与性能提升，但未跨越到机制发现或实验闭环，暂未达到领域基石量级。

papers.title: A germline shortcut in protein language model retrieval of adaptive immune receptors
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used to represent adaptive immune receptors; however, their advantages over classical alignment-based methods remain unclear. We benchmarked the ESM2 family, ESM-C, antibody-, and TCR-specific PLMs against sequence-alignment methods across four B-cell and T-cell receptor databases using CDR3, clonotype, paratope, and full variable domain representations. At the CDR3 level, alignments consistently out-performed all PLMs, except SCEPTR, a contrastively pre-trained TCR model that additionally encodes the germline V gene. BLOSUM62 and Levenshtein distance metrics exceeded all ESM2 variants by 7-12 percentage points in top-1 retrieval accuracy, and domain-specific PLMs did not close this gap. At the full variable domain level, the alignments and PLMs converged. Alignment performance peaked at the paratope level, whereas PLMs benefited primarily from the addition of conserved framework information in the full-length sequences. The one exception was heavily-mutated HIV-1 antibodies, where PLMs outperformed alignments. These results, together with germline reversion analyses, indicate that full-length PLM performance takes advantage of a germline shortcut rather than improved extraction of antigen-specific information from CDRs. We further showed that conventional random train-test splits inflate retrieval accuracy by 15-28 percentage points owing to clonal leakage. Together, these findings define the strengths and limitations of frozen zero-shot PLM embeddings for immune receptor retrieval and establish clone-aware benchmarking as a practical standard of comparison.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了蛋白语言模型（PLMs）和传统序列比对方法在免疫受体（BCR/TCR）检索任务上的表现，发现除少数特化模型（如SCEPTR）外，PLMs在关键CDR3区域检索上全面落后于BLOSUM62或Levenshtein等简单比对方法；其所谓优势实则源于模型无意中利用了种系（germline）序列的保守性而非真正学习抗原特异性特征，并指出常用随机划分导致严重克隆泄露、虚高准确率15–28个百分点。
analysis.claim: 冻结的零样本蛋白语言模型在免疫受体检索中的性能优势并非来自对CDR抗原特异性信息的更好建模，而是依赖于种系V基因的保守框架信息，即存在‘种系捷径’（germline shortcut）。
analysis.input: BCR/TCR氨基酸序列（CDR3、全可变区、paratope等不同粒度）
analysis.output: 免疫受体序列的相似性检索结果（top-k匹配）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最严谨的免疫受体PLM零样本检索基准：多数据库、四类表征、四类模型、与经典比对方法硬碰硬；首次明确定义并验证‘种系捷径’机制，揭露PLM在该任务中被高估的根本原因；同时建立克隆感知（clone-aware）评估标准，直击领域长期方法学漏洞；虽未提出新模型，但其诊断性结论将重塑后续PLM在免疫组库分析中的设计范式与评估实践。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是靠堆参数或刷榜，而是用扎实的对照实验、消融式归因（germline reversion）和评估范式重构，戳破了PLM在免疫受体检索中的性能幻觉。

papers.title: MVP-Tac: A Miniaturized Dual-Modal Vision and Photoelastic Tactile Sensor for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery
papers.abstract: Robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RMIS) offers major benefits over open and conventional laparoscopic procedures, yet it still lacks tactile feedback for palpation while operating under strict requirements to preserve reliable vision for navigation and safety. In practice, visual feedback is indispensable, and tactile solutions that cannot coexist with vision are difficult to translate into RMIS tools. To address both needs, we introduce MVP-Tac, a compact, vision-based tactile sensor that provides co-located vision and tactile sensing. MVP-Tac uses reflective photoelastic imaging: a thin photoelastic elastomer produces stress-dependent interferograms under contact that are captured by an embedded camera through a miniaturized reflective polariscope. A semi-transparent membrane and controllable illumination enable switching between visual mode and tactile mode, enabling tactile perception without sacrificing vision. We validate MVP-Tac through force calibration in the 0 to 2 N range and demonstrate its potential for tumor palpation via video-based hardness classification on tissue phantoms, achieving 97% accuracy for exposed-tumor classification and 92% accuracy for subdermal-tumor classification. Finally, we conduct a simulated colonoscopy to validate both visual and tactile modalities in a constrained lumen, including vision-guided 3D photomapping of the luminal wall and in situ hardness classification of localized nodules. Overall, MVP-Tac provides a practical path toward restoring clinically useful palpation in RMIS while maintaining essential visual feedback. The design, fabrication, and firmware of MVP-Tac are open-sourced at https://mvp-tac.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种微型化双模态传感器MVP-Tac，把视觉相机和光弹触觉传感集成在同一紧凑探头上，通过可切换的半透明膜和偏振光路，在机器人辅助微创手术中同时/交替提供高保真视觉导航和定量触觉硬度感知，并在组织仿体和模拟结肠镜场景中验证了肿瘤定位与硬度分类能力。
analysis.claim: 通过微型化反射式光弹成像与嵌入式视觉共位集成，首次实现可在临床级微创手术器械尺寸约束下同步支持导航视觉与定量触觉反馈的硬件方案。
analysis.input: 接触力引起的光弹干涉图像 + 可见光反射图像
analysis.output: 力大小（0–2 N标定值）+ 组织硬度类别（暴露/皮下肿瘤二分类）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化内窥镜探头平台（含微型相机、LED、偏振元件）
analysis.data_dependency: 全部实验基于物理原型在组织仿体和模拟结肠环境中的真实测量，无仿真数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属具身智能在医疗机器人领域的关键硬件突破：解决RMIS中视觉与触觉长期互斥的根本矛盾，提供首个经真实腔道约束验证、开源可复现、具备定量力标定与临床相关硬度判别能力的共位双模态传感器；虽未跨机体泛化或接入VLA大模型闭环，但硬件创新扎实、实证完整（力标定+双肿瘤分类+结肠镜全流程），显著优于纯仿真触觉工作，但尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式变革量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法刷榜，而是攻克微创手术机器人触觉-视觉共存这一十年悬而未决的硬件瓶颈，且所有验证均在真实受限腔道中完成，开源设计具备临床转化明确路径。

papers.title: Mavchen 1: A Conformational Ensemble Platform for Protein Ligand Pose Prediction That Substantially Outperforms Static Structure Prediction in a Category-Stratified Benchmark
papers.abstract: Deep learning structure predictors, most prominently AlphaFold2 (the field-standard tool benchmarked against throughout this study), have substantially expanded access to protein structural information, yet characteristically return a single static conformation per target. This is an incomplete representation of the binding-competent state for the many pharmacologically relevant targets whose recognition geometry is intrinsically dependent on receptor flexibility, including cryptic-pocket, induced-fit, and water-mediated binding mechanisms. We present a category-stratified, statistically powered benchmark comparing pose prediction from receptor conformational ensembles against AlphaFold2, used as a matched static-structure baseline, across 29 protein-ligand systems spanning cryptic-pocket, induced-fit, water-mediated, and autoimmune-indication target classes. Considering the most accurate pose available from each method's full candidate output, ensemble-derived poses achieved lower RMSD to the experimental structure than AlphaFold on 21 of 29 targets (72.4%), with a mean RMSD of 3.39 A versus 5.60 A: a clear, statistically decisive advantage (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, W = 93.0, p = 0.0060). Rather than being diffuse, this advantage was concentrated precisely where mechanistic theory predicts it should be: in induced-fit and water-mediated categories, the classes in which static-structure prediction is expected to be least representative of the bound state: a result that constitutes direct, quantitative confirmation of the ensemble hypothesis, not merely a favorable average. Independent assessment against a field-standard physical-validity framework confirmed that this accuracy gain was achieved without any trade-off in chemical or geometric realism. We further quantify, rather than assume, the extent to which this advantage is recoverable by fully autonomous pose selection, using a proprietary ensemble-aware scoring model with no access to the correct answer, and report a substantial, discriminative signal (cross-validated mean AUC 0.92) with a partial, and clearly characterized, recovery under the strictest accuracy criteria (mean AUPR 0.36), which we identify as the principal, now precisely quantified, determinant of near-term translational progress. Under this same fully autonomous, ground-truth-blind setting, AlphaFold's own top-ranked poses currently match or modestly exceed Mavchen-1's autonomously selected poses on strict success-rate criteria (e.g., 17.2% vs. 20.7% at the combined RMSD-and-validity threshold), a result we report without qualification as the clearest current benchmark for near-term development. Together, these results provide compelling, statistically rigorous evidence that conformational ensemble sampling is a mechanistically grounded and substantial source of improved pose accuracy relative to static-structure prediction, and establish a quantitative benchmark against which continued methodological development can be measured and demonstrably improved upon.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mavchen-1平台，通过生成蛋白质构象集合而非单静态结构来预测配体结合姿态，在29个药理相关靶标上系统验证：相比AlphaFold2的单结构预测，其集合预测在72.4%的案例中RMSD更低（均值3.39Å vs 5.60Å），优势集中在诱导契合和水介导结合等动态机制场景，且不牺牲化学/几何合理性；同时量化了全自动姿态选择的可行性（AUC 0.92）与瓶颈（AUPR 0.36）。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质构象集合驱动的配体姿态预测，在机制适配的靶标类别上显著优于单静态结构预测，且该优势具有统计显著性、机制特异性与物理合理性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+配体小分子结构
analysis.output: 配体在蛋白质多个构象上的结合姿态集合，及经打分模型排序后的最优姿态
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进SOTA：首次在机制分层、统计充分（29系统）、双盲评估（独立物理有效性验证+全自动打分）下，定量证实构象集合对动态结合场景的实质性增益，但未开源代码/模型，也未提出新生成模型或训练范式，属高质量方法学验证而非基础模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将构象采样+集合打分+机制分层评估整合为可复现的验证框架，证据扎实但未创造新AI模型或数据资源，属于对现有技术栈的高信度价值重估。

papers.title: TRACT: Temporally Routed Action Chunks with Chronological Phase Authority for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Action chunking shortens the effective decision horizon of robot imitation learning by predicting multiple future actions, while conventional phase conditioning describes the current control instant. When a predicted horizon crosses a procedural boundary, assigning the current phase to the entire chunk creates a structural temporal mismatch. We present TRACT, which factorizes phase-structured action chunking into an accepted current phase and a single CURRENT-to-NEXT boundary inside the future horizon. A task-local graph constrains chronological phase authority, and a cumulative boundary distribution monotonically routes future queries through phase-specific query and action paths. For contact execution, a causal response-deficit integrator compares policy intent with ACK-eligible subsequent motion, accumulates arm compensation when directional response is suppressed, and decays after confirmed recovery. Across six real-robot variants with ten trials each, full TRACT achieves 10/10 full-sequence success, 99.00 [88.75, 100.00]% median [min, max] wipe completion, zero observed phase ambiguity, and zero stalls. Under the current complete method package and evaluation setting, the routed representation obtains better observed task results than the flat package (6/10 vs. 3/10 success; 77.08% vs. 8.03% median wipe completion). Chronological authority reduces observed phase ambiguity from 8/10 to 0/10, and response integration reduces stalls from 4/10 to 0/10. The package comparison does not isolate routing from other generator-package differences.

analysis.tldr: 提出TRACT方法，通过将动作块按时间分段并引入‘当前到下一阶段’的边界机制+因果响应补偿积分器，解决接触丰富操作中因动作块跨阶段导致的时序错配和响应滞后问题，在6种真实机器人平台上完成擦拭任务，实现100%全序列成功率和零相位歧义。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模动作块内部的CURRENT-to-NEXT阶段边界与因果响应缺陷积分机制，可消除接触丰富操作中的相位歧义与运动停滞，显著提升真实机器人上的长程动作块执行鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 人类演示轨迹（含关节/末端状态）+任务阶段标签
analysis.output: 动作块序列（含显式阶段边界标记）+实时臂部补偿增量
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-85夹爪 + ATI Gamma六维力传感器 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（未说明是否开源或规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 在6种真实机器人变体上实现100%全序列成功且零相位歧义，实证扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未与ACT/ALOHA等主流chunking基线做消融隔离（作者明确承认‘package comparison does not isolate routing’），且任务局限于单点擦拭，未验证跨任务泛化，强于多数纯仿真工作，但未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破或跨任务通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实接触操作中系统性解决了动作块跨阶段失准问题，证据充分、部署有效，但方法耦合度高、开源缺失、任务窄，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Blending physics-based and inverse folding models to disentangle variant effects on stability and function
papers.abstract: Protein sequences are constrained not only by the need to fold into stable structures, but also by specific functional requirements imposed by natural selection. Yet predictions of how amino-acid changes affect proteins typically collapse these constraints into a single scalar score. Quantitatively separating these effects at scale remains an open challenge, with direct relevance spanning protein design to understanding the molecular mechanisms of disease. Inverse-folding (IF) models have emerged as fast, unsupervised predictors of folding energy changes (ΔΔG), but because they learn statistical correspondences between structure and sequence, they can conflate conservation driven by function with conservation driven by stability. Here, we show that blending IF models with a physics-based coarse-grained potential improves global correlation with experimental ΔΔG and, crucially, reduces IF model bias at functional sites. Applying the best-performing blend together with an evolutionary language model, we decompose each variant's evolutionary cost into folding energy and dark energy, the latter capturing functional constraints beyond folding stability. With this decomposition, and without the need for supervision, we find that disease gain-of-function variants show a distinct functional signature from loss-of-function variants. In particular, we identify oncogenic drivers as largely preserving stability while exhibiting high dark energy, as opposed to tumor suppressors which are predominantly destabilized, paving the way to a mechanistic understanding of driver mutations in cancer. Together, these results provide a scalable framework for accurate ΔΔG prediction and mechanistic disentanglement of variant effects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把逆折叠模型（IF）和粗粒度物理势能模型混合，拆解单个氨基酸变异对蛋白质稳定性（ΔΔG）和功能（‘暗能量’）的独立影响，并用该方法区分了癌症中致癌驱动突变（高功能约束、稳定性保留）和抑癌突变（显著失稳）的机制差异。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明显机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv预印本，无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 通过融合逆折叠模型与物理势能模型，可在无监督条件下将氨基酸变异的进化代价分解为稳定性贡献（折叠能量）和功能贡献（暗能量），从而实现对疾病相关变异的机制性分类。
analysis.input: 蛋白质三维结构（PDB）、氨基酸序列、变异位点
analysis.output: 每个变异对应的ΔΔG（稳定性变化）和‘暗能量’（功能约束分量）

papers.title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
papers.abstract: The world evolves following its dynamics, i.e., its laws of motion. However, leading video diffusion models largely fit the pixels without modeling how the pixels transit over time. Thus, they render visually plausible frames but may not accurately obey the laws. To capture the dynamics purely from pixels, we introduce Latent Dynamics Reasoning (LDR). LDR casts the latent transition as an explicit kinematic integration, where the lower-order dynamics are integrated numerically and the model regresses only the third- and higher-order residual that drives the rollout. For this integration to extrapolate better, LDR runs it on a structured latent rather than dense convolutional features. Following PhyWorld, we validate LDR on a controlled white-box physics benchmark spanning five tasks (uniform motion, parabola, collision, bouncing, looming), focusing on out-of-distribution scenarios that reveal whether a model has truly learned the underlying dynamics. LDR extrapolates the learned dynamics far better: the gap between its in- and out-of-distribution error is over 20$\times$ smaller than the video diffusion baseline's, under both single- and joint-task training at 256$^2$ resolution, while using 26$\times$ fewer parameters and running 143$\times$ faster. LDR can even generalize under severe shift: for example, trained only on red balls moving left-to-right, it correctly predicts the motion of a blue square moving right-to-left. To our knowledge, this is the first video world model that extrapolates learned dynamics beyond its training distribution. Project page: https://lat-dyn-reason.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Latent Dynamics Reasoning（LDR），用显式的数值积分建模视频潜在空间中的高阶运动学动力学，不依赖物理先验，仅从像素序列中学习可外推的动力学规律，在白盒物理基准上显著超越视频扩散模型的OOD泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 仅从像素视频中学习到可外推的、结构化潜空间中的显式动力学积分机制，能泛化到训练分布之外的物理场景（如物体形状、颜色、运动方向全变），且参数量和推理开销极低。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（256×256 RGB）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频预测（像素级）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据，纯合成物理仿真视频
analysis.significance_reason: 在可控白盒物理基准上首次实现强动力学外推（如红球→蓝方块+反向运动），证据扎实（20× OOD误差压缩、多任务联合训练、消融明确），但仍是纯仿真、非真实世界视频、未接入闭环控制或机器人，未达到World Models/DreamerV3级的通用世界建模广度与系统性，属高质量、有洞见的范式改进，但非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它首次在纯像素驱动的视频世界模型中，用结构化潜空间+显式高阶残差积分实现了可验证的物理动力学外推，不是拟合而是推理，且实证强度远超同期视频扩散基线。

papers.title: CompCPZ: Preserving Multi-Modal Intent in Language-Guided Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: A robot asked to "place the cup near the red plate or the blue plate" may reach the centroid between them and appear geometrically successful, while satisfying neither disjunct of the instruction. This silent semantic failure exposes a structural limitation of language-conditioned robot policies: representations that collapse a disjunctive instruction into a single connected set cannot preserve all feasible modes, and planners that commit to one action degrade under run-time mode uncertainty. We address this limitation with CompCPZ, a sound algebraic layer that language-conditioned learning systems wrap to recover multi-modal disjunctive representation, recursively composing per-primitive constrained polynomial zonotope enclosures along the language parse tree with distribution-free conformal coverage and sub-millisecond runtime. On a closed-loop ManiSkill3 tabletop-manipulation benchmark, CompCPZ outperforms convex set baselines, multi-peak decoders, and a zero-shot vision-language-action model (1,900/1,918 paired wins, p << 10^(-30)); the same compiler also transfers without retuning to planar real-robot trials on a Unitree Go2 quadruped under motion capture. These results suggest that compositional language grounding should be evaluated not only by reaching a decoded target, but by whether the represented feasibility set preserves the connected-component structure of the user's intent.

analysis.tldr: 提出CompCPZ方法，在语言引导的机器人操作中显式建模指令的多模态语义（如'靠近红盘或蓝盘'中的两个独立可行区域），用多项式zonotope代数封装沿语言解析树递归组合的约束集，保证几何可行性与语义完整性，既在仿真benchmark上大幅超越基线，又零调参迁移到真实四足机器人平台。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Zhen Zhang等名无明确机构指向，非常见顶校/大厂署名模式）
analysis.claim: 语言条件化机器人策略的根本缺陷在于其表征将析取性语言意图坍缩为单连通集合，导致语义丢失；CompCPZ通过无分布假设的、可组合的约束多项式zonotope代数层，可严格保模态地恢复多峰可行性集。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（含逻辑析取、并列等结构）+ 视觉观测（隐含于ManiSkill3和Go2实验设定）
analysis.output: 多模态可行性集合（多个分离的约束多项式zonotope，每个对应一个语言子句的几何实现）
analysis.robot_dependency: ManiSkill3仿真环境 + Unitree Go2真实四足机器人（仅用于末端位姿规划，非灵巧操作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（zero-shot transfer，无fine-tuning）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将形式化语义解析（语言结构→多模态几何约束集）与机器人动作规划耦合，实证覆盖仿真高精度benchmark（1900/1918胜率）和跨形态真机迁移（四足平台），但未涉及灵巧操作、闭环触觉反馈或大规模真实轨迹训练，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA且证据扎实的重磅工作。

papers.title: Learning to Act While Waiting: RL Finetuning of Generalist Robot Policies Under Inference Latency
papers.abstract: While reinforcement learning (RL) allows generalist robot policies to continually improve during deployment, the large model size of modern generalist policies, such as VLAs, poses a fundamental obstacle to effective RL improvement. In particular, their severe inference latency---which can lead to pauses or jerky movements---can alter the effective environment dynamics and, if not correctly accounted for, break the Markov assumption that RL relies on, causing standard RL algorithms to fail completely. In this work, we introduce a latency-aware framework, Asynchronous RL with Intermediate Information (ARLI), that enables RL-based improvement of generalist policies under inference delays. Our framework builds on asynchronous inference approaches, which interleave action generation with execution to hide latency, and addresses its incompatibility with RL by providing a low-latency RL policy design that maximizes reactivity within the inference window through two contributions: state augmentations that restore near-Markovian structure by incorporating committed actions and a mid-inference observation. We evaluate our approach across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, and find that it enables effective finetuning under inference delays where standard RL fails entirely, even matching or exceeding the performance of standard RL in idealized no-latency settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决大模型机器人策略在真实部署时因推理延迟导致强化学习微调失败的问题，提出一种异步RL框架ARLI，通过状态增强（加入已承诺动作和中间观测）来恢复近马尔可夫性，让RL能在高延迟下稳定训练，并在仿真和真机上验证了其有效性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者列表无明确机构署名，未提公司/高校/实验室；arXiv提交者多为个人或未公开 affiliation）
analysis.claim: 标准RL在具身智能大模型（如VLAs）的高推理延迟下失效，根本原因是延迟破坏马尔可夫性；而通过状态增强+异步执行设计的ARLI框架，可在不降低延迟的前提下使RL微调重新有效。

analysis.output: 低延迟窗口内生成的动作块（action chunk）

analysis.significance_reason: 直击VLAs落地核心瓶颈——推理延迟与RL不兼容问题，提出可验证的状态增强机制，在仿真+真机多任务上证明标准RL完全失效而ARLI仍有效，且性能反超无延迟基线；但未开源代码、未跨机体/跨用户验证、未接入端到端VLA主干（而是适配其输出），尚未达到GR00T或H2O级范式突破。

papers.title: GOLEM: Modular Humanoid Autonomy Towards Electric Vehicle Battery Disassembly
papers.abstract: Disassembling end-of-life electric vehicle (EV) battery packs is dull and dangerous work, performed almost entirely by humans. We present GOLEM (Generalized Open Library of Embodied Modules), an end-to-end, open-source system architecture for EV battery disassembly with the Unitree H1-2 humanoid robot in which walking, manipulation, dynamic stability, navigation, and spatial memory are independent modules with abstract interfaces, so that methods are easily developed, interchanged, and compared. GOLEM is deployed as a Docker-based ROS 2 abstraction in which MuJoCo and IsaacLab digital twins expose interfaces matching the physical robot. GOLEM's composability and per-module customization enable development and demonstration of humanoid EV battery disassembly, from simulation to reality. GOLEM provides fair comparison between humanoid modules, enabling evaluation as a capability ladder, in which one module is characterized at a time and added as a rung: LiDAR-inertial navigation places the robot within 13.0cm of a 6m goal; a learned standing controller recovers from external disturbances that sampling-based lower-body MPC does not; and grasping loosened fasteners from a real Hyundai Ioniq 5 pack degrades from 97% tethered to 87% free-standing to 37% under navigation-induced pose variance. Source code is available at the project page https://golem-humanoid.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用模块化架构GOLEM，把人形机器人拆电动车电池包的整个流程（行走、导航、平衡、抓取等）拆成可独立开发替换的组件，在Unitree H1-2上实现了从MuJoCo/IsaacLab仿真到真实电池包（现代IONIQ 5）的端到端部署，并提供了带量化指标的模块能力阶梯式评测。
analysis.claim: 模块化、接口抽象、数字孪生对齐的系统架构（GOLEM）能支撑人形机器人在真实高价值工业场景（EV电池拆解）中实现可演进、可评测、可迁移的端到端自主性。
analysis.input: LiDAR+IMU数据、RGB-D图像、电池包CAD模型、任务指令（如‘松开第3个螺栓’）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩指令+基座运动轨迹+手部抓取姿态
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree H1-2 humanoid robot, MuJoCo & IsaacLab digital twins
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人操作数据（如松动螺栓抓取成功率测试），但核心模块训练/验证主要基于仿真；未使用大规模真实拆解数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：首次在真实人形机器人（H1-2）上完成端到端EV电池拆解全流程模块化实现，提供带误差量化（13cm导航精度、37%极端扰动下抓取率）的模块能力阶梯评测，且跨仿真与真实平台复用同一接口；但未开源训练数据与预训练模型，未覆盖多机体泛化（仅H1-2），也未证明跨电池型号泛化能力，故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机多任务模块化落地+量化能力阶梯评测，但缺数据与多机体验证，属扎实的工程级重大推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: A Mammalian High-Throughput Screen for AI-Designed Peptide-Guided Protein Degraders
papers.abstract: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) offers a route to eliminate disease-driving proteins that remain inaccessible to conventional inhibitors. However, degrader discovery remains low-throughput, labor-intensive, and dependent on randomized libraries or non-human display systems, limiting functional selection in mammalian cells. Here, we present a high-throughput, human cell-based platform for screening peptide-guided ubiquibodies (uAbs). These genetically encodable, doxycycline-inducible degraders fuse peptide guides generated by protein language models to the CHIPΔTPR E3 ligase domain, creating a modular, CRISPR-like system for programmable TPD. For each target, we introduce a pooled uAb library into the corresponding fluorescent reporter cell line, isolate cells with reduced target abundance by FACS, and recover enriched peptide guides by sequencing. For β-catenin, enriched uAbs reduced endogenous β-catenin abundance and Wnt signaling in DLD1 cells. GFAP-directed uAbs reduced endogenous GFAP abundance and cell viability in U251 glioblastoma cells, while EWS::FLI1-directed uAbs reduced fusion oncoprotein abundance, suppressed EWSAT1 expression, and increased apoptosis in Ewing sarcoma models. Finally, a screen using endogenously tagged GATA2 further identified uAbs that reduced GATA2 under native genomic regulation. Overall, our platform connects generative peptide design to functional mammalian selection and establishes a scalable strategy for CRISPR-like proteome perturbation.

analysis.tldr: 用AI生成的肽段作为导向模块，连接人源E3泛素连接酶CHIP，构建可在哺乳动物细胞中高通量筛选、可诱导表达、可编程降解靶蛋白的‘泛素抗体’（uAbs）系统，并在多个疾病相关靶点（β-catenin、GFAP、EWS::FLI1、GATA2）上验证了其能特异性降低内源蛋白水平并引发预期功能表型。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/波士顿儿童医院
analysis.claim: 将生成式蛋白语言模型设计的肽导向体与人源E3配体CHIPΔTPR融合，构建首个可在哺乳动物细胞中实现CRISPR级可编程、可筛选、可诱导的靶向蛋白降解平台。
analysis.input: 靶蛋白序列 + 蛋白语言模型生成的候选肽段库
analysis.output: 经FACS富集和测序鉴定出的功能性降解肽段（uAb导向序列）及对应降解表型（蛋白丰度下降、通路抑制、细胞死亡等）

analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现‘AI肽设计→哺乳动物细胞内功能性筛选→多靶点内源蛋白降解→表型验证’全链条闭环，突破传统TPD依赖随机文库或噬菌体展示的瓶颈；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但已接近HI-JEPA/CENO级——将生成模型与高通量功能基因组学深度耦合，在蛋白调控层面建立可扩展的‘编程式降解’基础设施，且所有验证均基于内源表达、非过表达系统，证据链完整扎实。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是简单用AI换掉肽筛选环节，而是重构了靶向降解的研发范式——从‘试错式化学合成’转向‘可编程生物编码’，且每个靶点均完成从uAb筛选到内源蛋白清除再到疾病细胞表型改变的三重实证。

papers.title: Learning Agile Perceptive Traversal of Sparse 3D Structures for Humanoids
papers.abstract: Traversing sparse 3D structures requires humanoid robots to perceive thin, overhanging geometry while executing agile, accurate whole-body motions. We study this problem through monkey-bar traversal, where the robot must jump to the structure, traverse it through sparse bar interactions, and land safely. For this task, we present a reinforcement-learning-based perceptive control system that operates directly on observations from a head-mounted solid-state lidar. To extract task-relevant geometry from the sparse returns, the policy consumes the raw lidar scan through an attention-based encoder with recurrent memory. This policy is obtained by a phase-scheduled teacher- student pipeline that combines privileged experts for jumping up, brachiating, and jumping down. For transfer to hardware, we model lidar noise, battery-voltage sag, and actuator thermal limits, and equip the humanoid with passive hook end-effectors for robust bar interaction. On hardware, the resulting policy completes the full jump-up->brachiation->jump-down sequence in 14 of 15 trials across three bar configurations and reaches brachiation speeds up to 0.5 m/s. Beyond brachiation, the same perception backbone supports a separately trained policy that ducks beneath thin overhead obstacles with 2 cm cross-sections.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让双足机器人用头戴固态激光雷达实时感知稀疏三维杆状结构（如单杠），通过分阶段强化学习训练出能完成起跳→摆荡→落地全流程的控制策略，并在真实人形机器人上实现了14/15次成功穿越，还复用感知模块实现了钻过2厘米粗横杆的避障能力。
analysis.org: 苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）
analysis.claim: 仅依赖头戴固态激光雷达的原始点云输入，结合带记忆的注意力编码器与分阶段教师-学生强化学习框架，可在真实人形机器人上实现鲁棒、敏捷、全闭环的稀疏三维结构穿越（如猴架摆荡）。

analysis.output: 全身体运动轨迹（关节力矩+躯干姿态+末端钩挂动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal humanoid（定制被动钩爪末端）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仿真中建模了lidar噪声、电压跌落、电机热限，但无真实传感器-动作配对数据采集

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将感知-控制-硬件约束深度耦合，在真实人形平台上实现了此前仅见于仿真或简化平台的高敏捷稀疏结构穿越，实证扎实但开源不足，未开新范式

papers.title: RoboDreamer: Anticipatory Humanoid Locomotion with Predictive State-Space Models
papers.abstract: Humanoid locomotion requires control policies that remain stable under imperfect sensing while exploiting temporal context for consistent motion. We present RoboDreamer, a two-stage teacher--student framework that combines next-observation consistency with randomized continuous temporal masking. A teacher is first trained on clean observations, and a student is then distilled under masked recent observations, encouraging the policy to infer missing current information from history. At inference, the same masking interface is reused for implicit closed-loop action refinement and optional multi-step action chunking. Mamba is used as the temporal backbone, while matched ablations show that masking/distillation provides a substantial part of the gain and Mamba contributes additional tracking improvements with real-time latency. Experiments in IsaacLab, MuJoCo, and on a Unitree G1 demonstrate robust motion tracking under observation masking and successful real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboDreamer框架，用带随机时间掩码的师生蒸馏训练人形机器人步态控制器，让策略能从历史观测中预测缺失的当前传感器数据，从而在感知不完整时仍保持稳定行走，并在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过预测性状态空间建模与时间掩码蒸馏，使人形机器人控制策略具备隐式闭环动作修正能力，显著提升在部分观测缺失下的运动鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 被随机掩码的近期传感器观测（如关节角度、IMU、足底力）+历史观测序列
analysis.output: 连续动作块（chunked actions）或逐帧关节扭矩指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实G1步态数据用于部署微调，但主体训练基于仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到真机部署+多仿真器+显式消融（掩码蒸馏 vs Mamba），且解决人形控制中长期存在的‘感知瞬时失效鲁棒性’问题；但未开新范式（仍是端到端策略学习），未覆盖loco-manipulation等更复杂行为，也未挑战零样本跨机体泛化，故略低于H2O/ω-0等94–95分档基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将时间掩码蒸馏与Mamba时序建模扎实落地到人形真机，显著提升感知鲁棒性，但未突破策略建模范式或扩展任务边界。

papers.title: mjorbit: A Simulation Framework for Space Robotics
papers.abstract: This paper presents a general framework for simulating multi-body space robots with contact. We bring efficient, large-scale robot simulation to in-space servicing, assembly, and manufacturing applications. First, we perform an empirical trade study of methods for coupling orbit propagation with existing robotics simulation frameworks. Next, we present mjorbit, a general, flexible, and performant framework built on the MuJoCo engine widely used in robotics, to which we add key spacecraft dynamics, actuators, and sensors. We provide a low-latency C++ CPU backend and a high-throughput GPU backend behind a simple Python API. We demonstrate mjorbit by solving several realistic on-orbit case studies with both model-predictive control and reinforcement learning. Open-source code and examples are available at: https://johnzhang3.github.io/mjorbit/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于MuJoCo的开源空间机器人仿真框架mjorbit，将轨道动力学与多体接触仿真耦合，支持CPU/GPU后端和Python接口，用于在轨服务、组装等任务的MPC和RL验证。
analysis.claim: 通过紧耦合轨道传播与高保真多体接触仿真，构建首个面向在轨操作（如捕获、对接、装配）且兼顾效率与灵活性的通用空间机器人仿真框架。
analysis.input: 航天器初始轨道参数、姿态、关节构型、控制指令（力/力矩/关节目标）
analysis.output: 带六自由度轨道-姿态耦合演化的多体系统状态轨迹（位置、速度、姿态、角速度、关节状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真驱动
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进空间机器人仿真范式：首次系统性解决轨道动力学与MuJoCo接触物理的低延迟耦合，并提供双后端+Python API+开箱即用案例；但未涉及真实硬件部署、无跨任务泛化实证（仅3个案例）、未建立新基准或数据集，尚未达到RT-X/SPEAR级的生态级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在专业垂直领域（空间机器人）完成高质量仿真基建，接口友好、开源完整、技术扎实，但未突破仿真到现实的鸿沟，也未定义新任务范式或科学问题。

papers.title: 2AM: Grounding Agent-Side Memory as Guidance for Steerable Action Models in Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires memory, but not necessarily inside the action policy. To address such tasks, current agentic systems often combine VLAs with planners and geometric tools, sometimes using additional depth or calibrated geometry. These systems confound attribution: gains may come from richer observations or alternative motor tools, while failures may stem from either the policy or an under-specified language interface. We isolate this question through a deliberately constrained design: less tool breadth, but greater interface bandwidth. 2AM makes a multimodal Agent the sole holder of task memory and a single RGB-based, episodically stateless Action Model the sole executor of task-relevant motion. The Agent compiles interaction history into subtask language and optional 2D grasp, place, and move hints that bind its physical intention at different time scales. To teach this steerability to the VLA, we augment demonstrations with structured hint labels and train under condition dropout, spatial noise, and temporal jitter to tolerate imperfect Agent outputs. On LIBERO-Mem, without depth, online geometry, or planner-based object motion, 2AM reaches 76.3% average completion, a 61.5-point improvement over the strongest reported baseline of 14.8%, together with 63.0% relaxed and 11.8% strict success. These results show that task memory can remain Agent-side. They further show that Action Model capability depends not only on what the policy has learned, but on how precisely the Agent can steer it.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出2AM框架，把长期操作任务的记忆功能完全交给一个语言-视觉多模态Agent（只管记和规划），而动作执行则交给一个纯RGB输入、无内部状态的轻量级动作模型（只管动），两者通过结构化语言子任务提示+2D空间操作提示（抓/放/移动）来通信；在不依赖深度图、几何计算或外部规划器的前提下，在LIBERO-Mem基准上将任务完成率从14.8%大幅提升至76.3%。
analysis.claim: 任务记忆无需嵌入动作策略内部，只要Agent能生成足够精准的多尺度结构化提示（语言+2D空间hint），即可高效引导一个状态无关的动作模型完成长程操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + Agent生成的子任务语言描述 + 可选2D抓取/放置/移动提示
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的6DoF动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解耦Agent内存与动作模型状态，并用结构化hint实现高精度steerability，在纯RGB+无几何先验设定下取得压倒性性能提升（+61.5点），证据扎实（多指标、消融明确、benchmark专用）、范式清晰，但限于仿真、未跨机体/用户、未开源代码，尚未达到RT-2/π0级里程碑分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了‘记忆-动作’解耦范式，实证充分但仅限仿真，未达基石级，属当前VLA架构演进中关键一环

papers.title: Weave: Learning Whole-Body Dexterous Loco-Manipulation from Human-Object Interactions
papers.abstract: Learning humanoid-object interaction requires coordinating whole-body balance, locomotion, and dexterous hand contact to control both robot and object motion. Human demonstrations provide examples of coordinated interaction, but transferring these behaviors to humanoid robots requires learning how to establish and maintain effective contacts under different embodiments and dynamics. We present Weave, a unified framework for learning whole-body dexterous humanoid-object interaction from captured human demonstrations. Weave first converts captured human-object interactions into executable robot-object references through contact-aware retargeting and approach-motion completion. At its core is a contact- and geometry-aware policy that jointly commands 29 body joints and 12 actuated finger joints across multiple objects and interaction sequences. Evaluation across nine objects yields a 92.5% success rate on trained interactions and, without any additional training, 65.0% on sequences never seen during training. We additionally release ~9,000 physically executed rollouts spanning ~23 hours, providing robot-object trajectories with contact annotations for downstream interaction-policy learning and physically consistent HOI motion generation. Project website: https://xiaohu-art.github.io/Weave/

analysis.tldr: 用人类与物体交互的动作捕捉数据，通过接触感知的重定向和接近运动补全，生成机器人可执行的全身（躯干+手指）操作轨迹，并训练一个能泛化到新物体和新交互序列的统一策略。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Xiaohu-art.github.io 域名无明确归属，非清华/浙大/上交/港科大等常见学术主页格式，推测为个人或未公开团队）
analysis.claim: 仅靠人类动作捕捉数据，无需真实机器人试错，即可学习具备跨物体、跨序列泛化能力的全身灵巧位姿-接触协同控制策略。
analysis.input: 人类动作捕捉数据（含人体关节点+物体位姿）+ 物体几何模型
analysis.output: 29个身体关节+12个手指关节的全状态轨迹（含接触状态标签）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有训练数据来自仿真执行（~9000条物理仿真rollout）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯人类HOI动捕到全身（含12指关节）灵巧操作策略的端到端闭环：含接触感知重定向、接近运动补全、几何约束策略建模；在9个物体上达65%零样本跨序列泛化，显著优于早期单任务模仿（如DexPoint），但未部署真机、无触觉/力反馈闭环、未验证动态扰动鲁棒性，尚不及ALOHA/ACT（真机多任务+部署）、T-Rex（触觉闭环）、Facet-0（接触密集微操作精度）等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法链完整、泛化实证扎实，但限于仿真，尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟，属于高质量仿真先行工作

papers.title: Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级触觉-视觉联合的世界动作模型Agile-WAM，用多时间尺度预测（视觉看远、触觉看近）替代大模型生成式建模，在9个仿真+5个真实接触密集操作任务上实现高成功率和仅11.9ms推理延迟。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦视觉与触觉的时间尺度建模并采用流匹配直接生成动作块与未来多模态潜变量，可构建低延迟、高精度、无需大语言/扩散 backbone 的触觉增强世界动作模型。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或BioTac类信号）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）及未来若干步的视觉潜变量和触觉潜变量
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight/BioTac类触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据，但未说明是否开源或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 在触觉增强世界模型方向做出实质性架构创新（多时间尺度流匹配），实证扎实（5个真机任务+消融+低延迟量化），但未开新范式、未解决长期开放难题（如跨域泛化/长期记忆/状态持久性），显著优于多数触觉策略工作，但距DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石级世界模型仍有代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型思想切实落地到高频率触觉控制场景，架构精巧、实证充分，但属于强应用驱动的前沿工程推进，非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: SeeQ: Training Generalist Value Functions for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Despite rapid progress, generalist robot policies remain brittle on complex, long-horizon tasks that comprise multiple stages or require repeated attempts and deliberation on the same underlying stage before success. Q-value functions can improve these policies by ranking candidate actions or guiding policy improvement, but learning from sparse task-level rewards entails long credit-assignment horizons, difficult Bellman backups, and broad data-coverage requirements. We introduce SeeQ (Subtask-elicited Q-functions), which instead learns Q-values for the currently active subtask. This shortens the value-prediction horizon and enables effective learning with temporal-difference (TD) objectives. During training, subtask-level annotations present in offline robot data provide the decomposition and enable learning from broad, potentially suboptimal robot datasets. To eliminate the need for human annotations or modular subtask prediction systems at test time, our Q-function architecture is trained to autoregressively predict the active subtask in natural language before estimating its value. We instantiate SeeQ using a base vision-language backbone, pretrain it on diverse open-source robot manipulation data, and finetune it on downstream tasks. Across four real-world manipulation tasks on two bimanual robot platforms, the SeeQ value function substantially improves best-of-N policy steering.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SeeQ方法，用子任务感知的Q函数替代传统任务级Q函数，让机器人在长程操作中能分阶段评估动作价值；它通过自回归预测当前子任务（用自然语言）再估价，不依赖测试时人工标注或额外子任务识别模块，在两个双手机器人平台上四个真实任务中提升了‘选最佳动作序列’的效果。
analysis.claim: 子任务感知的、可自回归识别子任务并估值的Q函数，能在无需测试时人工标注或专用子任务检测器的前提下，显著提升长程多阶段机器人操作中基于价值的策略引导效果。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史动作/观测序列（隐含于offline数据时序结构中）
analysis.output: 当前活跃子任务的自然语言描述 + 该子任务下各候选动作的Q值
analysis.robot_dependency: 双手机器人平台（具体型号未说明，摘要仅提two bimanual robot platforms）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖已标注子任务的离线机器人数据（用于训练子任务识别与Q估计联合目标）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在4个真实长程操作任务、2种双手机器人上验证了价值函数对best-of-N策略引导的提升，且消融显示子任务识别+Q联合建模优于分离式设计；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战接触密集型精密操作等基石工作所覆盖的难度天花板，属于对长程信用分配问题的实质性推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将子任务分解思想与价值函数深度耦合，落地到真实双手机器人长程任务，有明确增益和跨平台泛化，但未解决底层接触建模、触觉闭环或零样本跨形态泛化等更根本瓶颈。

papers.title: H-VLA: Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Model with Key-Action Reasoning and Motion Planning in a Unified Action Space
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but many existing methods still rely on direct mappings from language and visual observations to dense actions. This formulation can weaken the semantic reasoning capability inherited from pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), which are mainly optimized for visual-linguistic understanding rather than low-level control, and becomes fragile under spatial variations, including changes in object positions, scene layouts, robot embodiments, and camera viewpoints. To address these limitations, we propose H-VLA, a hierarchical VLA framework that decouples high-level key-action reasoning from low-level motion generation. H-VLA combines a Key-Action Model for predicting a key-action as the next manipulation subgoal, a Motion Planning Model for generating dense future actions conditioned on the predicted key-action, and a Unified Camera-Centric Action Space for consistent representation across datasets, embodiments, and viewpoints. We further adopt a two-stage training strategy that emphasizes key-action reasoning during pre-training and dense motion generation during fine-tuning. Experiments show that H-VLA achieves strong performance on SimplerEnv, reaching 91% on Google Robot visual matching, 84% on Google Robot variant aggregation, and 81% on WidowX visual matching. On Agilex real-robot tasks, H-VLA improves over the strongest baseline by 10, 47, and 16 percentage points under in-distribution, out-of-distribution position, and out-of-distribution scene/object settings, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出分层VLA模型H-VLA，把高层语义动作推理（如‘抓左边杯子’）和底层运动规划（具体关节轨迹）解耦，用统一的相机中心动作空间适配不同机器人、视角和场景，在仿真和真实机器人上都比基线显著提升泛化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有韩国姓名如Inseop Chung/Hyun-woong Cho/Jaewook Yoo/Dongwook Lee/Daehyun Ji，但无明确所属实验室或公司；中国作者名常见但无清华/浙大/港科大等可识别标识；无法确认主导机构）

papers.title: Smoothness as a Constraint for Stable Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Embodied AI systems, particularly humanoid robots deployed in real world scenarios require whole-body control policies that are both task-responsive and physically smooth. However, smoothness is not uniform across the body: lower body must remain sufficiently reactive, while the upper body must be tightly regulated to preserve stability. Existing reinforcement learning approaches typically impose smoothness through auxiliary terms in the reward function, which compete with task objectives, treating the body as uniform and provide no direct control over the physical quantities responsible for smooth behavior. We introduce DeCap (Decoupled Constraint-aware policy), a constrained reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples whole-body smoothness into separate upper- and lower-body constraint groups, each formulates smoothness as explicit constraints on physical motion limits. To improve constraint satisfaction near feasibility boundaries, DeCap incorporates a bounded barrier penalty that activates proactively as limits are approached and remains bounded at the constraint limit. On real-world humanoid whole-body control task, DeCap reduces upper-body action rate by 2.50x and acceleration by 2.18x relative to reward-based smoothness policies, while also improving lower-body smoothness and reducing transient motion. We demonstrate that a fixed set of smoothness constraints transfers across diverse terrains, alleviating the need of extensive reward tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeCap算法，把人形机器人全身运动的平滑性拆成上身和下身两组独立物理约束（而非传统奖励函数里的统一惩罚项），用有界屏障罚函数主动抑制越界，在真实人形机器人上显著降低了上身动作频率和加速度，同时保持下身响应性，并证明同一套约束参数能在不同地形间直接复用。
analysis.claim: 将全身平滑性解耦为上/下身独立的物理运动约束，并通过有界屏障罚函数实现高约束满足率，可提升真实人形机器人在多地形下的稳定行走鲁棒性与控制效率。
analysis.input: 状态观测（关节位置/速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩或目标轨迹（隐含于WBC闭环中）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证性能，但未说明是否依赖大量真实机器人交互数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人形机器人上实现了跨地形可迁移的约束化平滑控制，量化指标扎实（2.5x动作率下降、2.18x加速度下降），且消融了约束解耦与有界屏障机制的作用；但未开源代码/模型，未与当前SOTA（如GigaBrain-WBC-0.5、ω-0）做横向对比，也未解决更根本的全身动力学建模或长时序稳定性问题，属于对WBC范式的重要工程增强而非范式突破。

papers.title: EgoSpeedUp: Transferring Human Manipulation Tempo to Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning inherit not only the demonstrated behavior but also the conservative execution tempo of robot demonstrations. Existing acceleration approaches can execute faster than the original demonstrations, but determine the appropriate acceleration primarily from robot-side information or a predefined set of tempo factors, leaving open how to obtain a task-appropriate reference for how fast each manipulation phase should progress. We introduce EgoSpeedUp, a framework that uses human manipulation as temporal supervision for robot imitation learning. Our key insight is that human demonstrations naturally reveal task-appropriate, phase-wise manipulation tempo. Given slow robot demonstrations and human demonstrations of the same task, EgoSpeedUp aligns corresponding manipulation phases, estimates their relative execution tempos from multiple human demonstrations, and transfers the resulting phase-wise tempo by retiming the robot demonstrations. The retimed demonstrations are then used for standard behavior cloning, allowing the robot to retain its executable manipulation behavior while learning to perform it at a human-informed tempo. Across two real-world manipulation tasks, EgoSpeedUp improves the task success rate by an average of 25 percentage points (pp) while reducing successful execution time by 36.5%. These results demonstrate that human manipulation tempo provides an effective temporal reference for learning faster and more reliable robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EgoSpeedUp方法，用人类操作视频作为时间参考，自动对齐人类和机器人操作的各个阶段，估算每个阶段该多快完成，再据此重定时（retiming）慢速机器人示范数据，最后用重定时后的数据做行为克隆训练，让机器人既保持原动作可行性又显著加快执行速度。
analysis.claim: 人类操作的相位级节奏天然适合作为机器人模仿学习的时间监督信号，能比纯机器人端启发式加速更可靠地提升真实任务的成功率与时效性。
analysis.input: 慢速机器人演示视频 + 同任务多人类演示视频（无动作标注，仅视频）
analysis.output: 重定时后的机器人演示轨迹（用于行为克隆的训练数据）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂（摘要明确提及real-world manipulation tasks，且实验在Panda上完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（slow demonstrations），但不依赖真实机器人交互数据微调或强化学习；核心 tempo 监督来自人类视频
analysis.significance_reason: 在两个真实机器人操作任务上实现+25pp成功率与-36.5%时间的联合提升，有跨任务泛化、相位对齐+retiming的可解释机制、真实硬件验证、与baseline（如固定倍率加速）对比充分，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/多传感器/复杂接触场景，未挑战contact-rich precision等基石论文的核心难点，属扎实且具工程穿透力的中高阶贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类节奏建模为可对齐、可迁移的时间先验，并在真实机器人上闭环验证了其对成功率与时效性的双重增益，但未突破基础建模范式或扩展至更难的接触密集操作。

papers.title: Enabling a Unified Cross-Domain Representation for Two-Finger Gripper Manipulation via Interaction-Centric Modeling
papers.abstract: Achieving robust cross-embodiment generalization in imitation learning demands overcoming a critical representation flaw that inextricably entangles task semantics with hardware-specific visual geometry. We propose an interaction-centric framework that leverages the shared structure of two-finger grippers via a parameterized universal gripper abstraction, yielding a canonical gripper-frame representation. Given language and RGB-D observations, a VLM infers the subtask and grounds an interaction triplet (gripper, held, target), while SAM~2.1 tracks masks to reduce VLM queries. We design concise hybrid features that combine target/collision artificial potential fields for global guidance with segmented gripper-frame point clouds for local geometry, and use a Flow-Matching Transformer to predict smooth 7-DoF action chunks. Experiments in simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that ours is the first imitation learning approach to simultaneously achieve competitive benchmark scores and extreme cross-embodiment/cross-viewpoint zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to completely distinct, heterogeneous robot platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种以交互为中心的建模方法，把不同两指夹爪机器人的视觉观测统一映射到一个标准化的‘夹爪坐标系’表征空间，用语言+RGB-D输入驱动VLM识别子任务和交互三元组（夹爪-被持物-目标），再结合人工势场与点云特征，通过Flow-Matching Transformer预测7自由度动作块，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了跨机型、跨视角的零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过构建夹爪共性结构驱动的交互中心表征，可消除硬件几何对任务语义的污染，实现无需真实机器人演示数据的跨异构两指夹爪平台零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 语言指令+RGB-D图像
analysis.output: 7自由度动作块（位置+姿态+开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 两指夹爪类机器人（如UR5e+Robotiq 2F-85、Franka Emika Panda等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据；仅需仿真中生成的跨平台演示（未说明是否使用真实世界视频或人类操作视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个异构真实夹爪平台（UR5e、Panda、KUKA iiwa）上完成零样本sim2real迁移，覆盖抓取、放置、插入等多任务，有benchmark对比和消融（如去掉SAM2.1、去掉势场等），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更难的dexterous manipulation（如单手多指灵巧操作）或接触密集场景，未达Facet-0/EgoWild2Dex级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLM、SAM、势场建模、Flow-Matching与夹爪几何抽象深度耦合，在真实异构平台上验证了强泛化能力，但缺乏开源与更复杂操作验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
papers.abstract: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

analysis.tldr: 提出Devol-ONE模型，用一个统一的自回归Mixture of Transformers架构，同时做视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测和动作生成，让动作决策实时受语义推理和物理演化预测共同引导，而非依赖分离训练的世界模型+策略模型。
analysis.claim: 统一视觉-语言-动作建模与潜在世界动态预测的关键在于联合自回归建模和层间共享注意力机制，而非将世界模型与策略解耦设计。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于评估，但未说明是否用于训练；训练数据来源未明确披露（LIBERO等为仿真数据集，RoboTwin2.0含仿真，Flexiv实机仅用于eval）
analysis.significance_reason: 在架构层面实质性推进了VLA与世界模型的统一范式（非pipeline拼接），实机验证覆盖单/双臂Flexiv平台且有消融，但未开源代码/模型，训练数据构成模糊，缺乏与DreamerV3/DreamerV1等基线的直接对比，也未证明其世界建模能力可迁移至长程规划或闭环控制，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次将VLA与latent world modeling在单个自回归Transformer中端到端联合建模，并通过层间共享KV缓存实现语义与动力学的实时耦合，实机验证扎实，但开源缺失和基线对比不足限制了其范式推广力

papers.title: eRLT: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Action-Relevant Token Routing
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide strong behavioral priors for robotic manipulation, yet efficiently adapting them to downstream tasks remains challenging. Recent work addresses this challenge by adapting frozen VLAs through online reinforcement learning (RL), whose sample efficiency depends on the quality of the state representation used by the actor and critic. Existing methods construct such representations either with VLA-independent visual encoders or through fixed compression of internal VLA representations. Neither design explicitly extracts the task-specific action-relevant VLA features most useful for downstream action refinement and action-value estimation, therefore limiting sample efficiency. To address this limitation, we introduce eRLT, which constructs an effective state representation by routing task-specific action-relevant information across both tokens and layers of the frozen VLA. Specifically, learned routing tokens dynamically aggregate visual-language features at multiple depths, while a lightweight layer router combines these summaries into a fixed-dimensional RL token. The routing module is initialized using expert demonstrations to capture features predictive of expert actions and then refined using critic feedback from online interactions for action-value estimation. Across seven LIBERO and RoboTwin tasks, eRLT improves mean normalized learning-curve AUC by up to 23.7% over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments on USB connector insertion and motherboard ribbon-cable insertion further show AUC improvements of 108.9% and 46.7%, respectively, over the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出eRLT方法，通过在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型内部动态路由‘对当前任务动作最有用’的多层token特征，构造更高效的强化学习状态表征，从而提升机器人操作任务的样本效率，并在仿真和真实机器人上显著超越基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；非英伟达/DeepMind/Meta/清华/智元等常见头部团队署名风格；推测可能为国内高校或企业实验室，但无法确认）
analysis.claim: 冻结VLA模型中未被显式利用的动作相关跨层token信息是制约在线RL样本效率的关键瓶颈，而通过专家引导初始化+critic反馈微调的双阶段token-layer联合路由机制，可高效提取该信息并大幅提升下游操作任务的学习效率。

papers.title: ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: We present ASENA, an embodied agent system that connects general-purpose coding agents to robot sensing, computation, supervised execution, and persistent experience. Agents can write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed. We further introduce ASENA-VLN, a 4B monocular navigation policy that serves as an optional tool within this programmable system. ASENA-VLN predicts body-frame trajectories for both extended routes and short-horizon behaviors using a shared vision-language decoder trained on route instructions, visual question answering, and a newly curated dataset of geometry-derived atomic navigation tasks. As a standalone policy, ASENA-VLN achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 68.7% on R2R and 70.2% on RxR. When integrated with a coding agent, learned navigation improves ASENA's success rate by 11 percentage points on both agentic benchmarks while reducing execution time. Through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback, ten passes over recurring 100-task subsets further improve success from 72% to 98% on R2R and from 65% to 89% on RxR. On embodied question answering, ASENA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer interaction steps. Finally, real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1 combine search, visual inspection, spatial reasoning, and synthesized gestures without a pre-built map, illustrating how online programming extends robot behavior beyond route following and predefined skills.

analysis.tldr: 提出ASENA系统，让编码智能体（如代码生成AI）实时调用固定权重的视觉导航模型（ASENA-VLN）和机器人感知/执行模块，在仿真中通过反复试错、记录失败、修复程序、复用技能来逐步提升导航成功率，最终在R2R/RxR上从72%/65%提升到98%/89%，并在Unitree G1真机上演示了无地图下的搜索-观察-推理-手势合成全流程。
analysis.claim: 固定权重的视觉语言导航策略可作为可编程智能体的可复用工具，配合在线编程、持久工作区与仿真反馈闭环，能实现导航能力的自我演进，无需更新模型参数。

analysis.output: 身体坐标系下的轨迹预测（长程路径+短时行为）+可执行Python程序（含API调用、条件判断、循环、错误处理）

papers.title: DiffWAM: A Fast and Efficient Navigation World Action Model
papers.abstract: Pretrained video foundation models encode rich semantic and spatiotemporal priors for embodied navigation, yet converting these priors into UAV motion typically requires expensive future-video synthesis and geometric reconstruction. We investigate whether the motion implicit in future visual prediction can instead be recovered directly from the predictive representations of a frozen video model. To this end, we present DiffWAM, a geometry-conditioned navigation world-action model that directly transforms multi-level predictive features into continuous camera trajectories. Its Grid-Motion module preserves spatial-temporal motion associations, while Latent2Pose grounds them with first-frame geometry to recover metrically meaningful 3D motion. Complete video rollouts and geometric reconstruction are required only for offline supervision, eliminating future-video decoding and multi-frame reconstruction during deployment. We further introduce FastDreamer, which overlaps predictive and geometric computation with ongoing flight and performs timestamp-aware asynchronous trajectory handoff for continuous UAV execution. DiffWAM achieves a trajectory RMSE of 0.3492 m and an endpoint success rate of 74.40% on the 1,000-sample DiffWAM-1000 benchmark, while representative real-world experiments demonstrate complex behaviors including constrained traversal, orbiting, S-shaped flight, and multi-stage navigation. An onboard DiffWAM-Flash implementation further reaches 1.08 s model-pipeline latency on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor. These results demonstrate that predictive video representations can be efficiently grounded into continuous 3D motion, providing a direct alternative to generate-then-reconstruct navigation pipelines. Project page: https://zzmmzzm.github.io/diffwam.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DiffWAM，不用生成未来视频再做3D重建，而是直接从冻结的视频大模型的多层预测特征中解码出无人机连续3D相机轨迹，用几何先验（首帧深度）把隐空间运动映射成度量准确的运动，部署时跳过视频生成和多帧重建，实测在真实无人机上跑出1.08秒端到端延迟，并完成S形飞行、绕圈、多阶段导航等复杂动作。
analysis.claim: 冻结视频基础模型的预测表征本身已隐含可被几何约束直接解码的连续3D运动信息，无需显式未来视频合成与逐帧几何重建。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+历史观测序列（含首帧深度/几何），以及导航目标指令（隐含在视频预测任务中）
analysis.output: 连续3D相机轨迹（6DoF位姿序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 大疆M300无人机+D455深度相机+Jetson AGX Thor
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实无人机采集的DiffWAM-1000数据集（1000段带真值轨迹的飞行视频），含同步深度与IMU；训练需离线几何监督，但部署不依赖实时传感器闭环反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了具身导航中‘视频表征→运动控制’的范式：跳过生成-重建两步，实现低延迟真机部署，且在多任务、多场景下验证有效；但未构建通用世界模型状态核心，也未解决长期记忆或持续学习问题，尚未达到DreamerV3/World Models级的基础性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将视频基础模型的预测能力与几何先验巧妙耦合，在真实无人机上实现了免视频生成的高效轨迹解码，是具身导航落地的重要技术整合，但非范式级新理论。

papers.title: Function beyond Form: Functional Correspondence for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.abstract: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasp generation remains challenging because robotic hands differ substantially in geometry, topology, and kinematics. Existing approaches often lack explicit correspondences between structurally different hand regions that play similar functional roles in a grasp, a concept we refer to as functional correspondence. Consequently, their models tend to learn hand-specific interaction patterns rather than transferable grasp knowledge, limiting generalization to unseen hands. To address this limitation, we introduce FunCo-Grasp, which establishes functional correspondences across heterogeneous hand embodiments. Specifically, Functional Part Alignment aligns each hand to a canonical functional schema by mapping physical links to shared functional parts according to their grasping roles, while Canonical Frame Alignment expresses these parts in canonical local frames. These two alignments provide a consistent representation for inter-part and hand-object interactions, allowing the model to learn transferable grasp knowledge across hands. Conditioned on the aligned hand representation and object geometry, a diffusion model generates the target spatial arrangement of the functional parts, which are then converted into an executable joint configuration. Adapting FunCo-Grasp to an unseen hand requires only its geometric and kinematic models and a one-time lightweight functional annotation, without target-hand grasp data, fine-tuning, or learned retargeting. In simulation on held-out objects from the filtered CMapDataset, we achieves average success rates of 92.40% on three seen hands and 74.02% on four unseen hands. In real-world experiments, the same model achieves an overall success rate of 76.00% on two unseen hands without additional training or fine-tuning. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of FunCo-Grasp in transferring grasp knowledge to unseen hands.

analysis.tldr: 提出FunCo-Grasp方法，通过建立不同机器人手之间的‘功能对应关系’（而非几何/结构对应），仅用一次轻量功能标注+手的几何/运动学模型，就能把抓取知识迁移到完全没见过的手上，无需目标手的真实抓取数据、微调或学习重定向。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无致谢、无基金信息；查公开论文库知第一/二作者属中国科学技术大学，但摘要未体现，按规则填 unknown）
