analysis.output: 目标手的关节角度配置（可执行抓取姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用CMapDataset关联的多种灵巧手模型（如Shadow, Allegro, Robotiq等），实机验证涉及2种未见过的手；具体型号未说明，填 none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖目标手的真实机器人抓取数据（zero-shot）；仅需源手在仿真中的合成抓取数据（来自CMapDataset过滤版）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并建模‘功能对应’（非结构/拓扑对齐），在仿真+真实机器人上验证了4种未见手的零样本迁移能力（74.02%/76.00%成功率），有消融（Functional Part Alignment + Canonical Frame Alignment双模块验证），但未开源代码/模型，且未与Facet-0/T-Rex等基石工作在相同任务/指标下对比，也未覆盖触觉/动态交互等高阶操作，属显著推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将‘功能角色对齐’形式化为可计算的跨形态表征机制，并在多手零样本抓取上取得扎实实机验证，超越现有基于几何配准或运动学映射的迁移方法。

papers.title: EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

analysis.tldr: 提出EpicWorldModel，一种能建模部分可观测环境下多种可能未来的随机潜世界模型，用流匹配（flow-matching）训练预测多个潜在状态，并将预测方差作为探索信号融入CEM规划，提升遮挡场景下的目标定位成功率。
analysis.claim: 在部分可观测、存在本质不确定性的环境中，通过联合优化潜空间与流匹配目标训练的随机JEPA，可生成有判别力的不确定性信号，从而驱动探索式规划并显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.input: 历史观测图像序列+动作序列（部分可观测条件下的低维潜编码）
analysis.output: 多个潜在未来潜状态分布 + 对应的不确定性（方差）信号
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真环境合成数据，无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了JEPA类世界模型在部分可观测性下的建模能力，首次将flow-matching引入随机潜世界模型训练并赋予其明确的规划语义（方差=探索信号），实验在标准仿真benchmarks上验证有效，但仅限仿真、未跨机体/任务泛化、无真实硬件验证，未达DreamerV3或WEAVER级范式突破，属扎实的重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在JEPA框架内系统性嵌入随机性建模与不确定性驱动规划，实证充分但局限于仿真，尚未跨越到真实机器人或开放科学问题。

papers.title: Continual Humanoid Motion Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid whole-body controllers can now track a diverse set of dynamic motions, but they are typically trained offline and then frozen, so teaching such a controller a new skill tends to erode the skills it already mastered. We study continual learning for humanoid whole-body motion, where a single controller must acquire skills from a sequential task stream without revisiting past data. We introduce Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN, a progressive neural network (PNN) policy that prevents catastrophic forgetting by construction while reusing knowledge across skills through lightweight low-rank adaptation. A two-level motion-similarity measure, built from dynamic time warping aggregated by optimal transport, decides which prior skill to build on and how much new capacity to allocate, yielding strong forward transfer and large efficiency gains. Across six sequentially learned skill categories, our similarity-guided LoRA policy attains the best forward transfer (0.125 vs. 0.079) and the highest average accuracy among all methods, while saving up to 94.5% of trainable parameters and 40.8% of training time. The resulting controller reaches 96.13% sim-to-sim transfer and is deployed on a physical Unitree G1. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/continual-humanoid-learning-35D3.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN的新方法，让一个人形机器人控制器能像人一样持续学新动作（比如先学走路再学踢球），且不忘记旧技能；它用运动相似性动态决定复用哪个旧技能、加多少新参数，在仿真中高效学会6类连续动作，并成功部署到Unitree G1真机上。
analysis.claim: 通过运动相似性引导的LoRA-PNN架构，可在不访问历史数据的前提下实现人形机器人全身体控策略的持续学习，显著缓解灾难性遗忘并提升前向迁移效率。
analysis.input: 运动轨迹序列（如关节角度/力矩时序）+任务标识
analysis.output: 全身体控策略（输出关节力矩或目标状态）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机部署）+自建仿真环境（基于PyBullet/Mujoco类）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的合成运动轨迹数据；未使用真实机器人采集的动作数据（如IMU/动捕）
analysis.significance_reason: 在人形机器人持续学习这一长期薄弱方向做出扎实推进：首次将LoRA与PNN结合用于全身体控，实证覆盖6类连续技能、含真机部署和量化前向迁移指标，但未触及多机体泛化、跨用户适应或真实世界长尾扰动鲁棒性，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将LoRA、PNN与运动相似性度量有效耦合，在持续学习框架下实现了人形控制策略的高效增量扩展与真机落地，但科学问题深度和泛化广度仍属强工程演进，非范式变革。

papers.title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PAIR框架，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中插入一个可学习的‘桥接表示’（Bridge Tokens），把感知端的视觉语言特征和动作端的专家动作潜码对齐，让动作生成模块从更结构化、任务相关的中间表示出发，从而提升连续动作VLA模型在仿真和真实机器人上的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 引入共享的感知-动作桥接表示（Bridge Tokens），显式建模从视觉语言理解到连续动作生成的过渡，比隐式监督更有效。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（或动作token序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖预训练VLA模型所用的真实机器人轨迹数据（如CALVIN、LIBERO-Plus），但未采集新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（显式桥接表示）且在多个基准（LIBERO-Plus、CALVIN、7个真实任务）上取得稳定但有限提升（+13.6%真实任务成功率），有消融和表示分析支撑，但未开源代码/模型，未提出新数据集或仿真器，也未解决VLA领域核心瓶颈（如长程规划、稀疏奖励、跨域泛化鲁棒性），属于扎实的表示层面改进，未达基石级范式突破或工程规模量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在VLA表示对齐上做了有实证支持的实质性改进，但未开源、未开新范式、提升幅度中等，属于高质量增量工作而非真突破。

papers.title: RLHND: Video Foundation Models as Physically Grounded Hand Trackers for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Recently, approaches that leverage human video datasets for robot policy training have become increasingly prevalent. However, most existing hand trackers regress pose from cropped frames with limited priors on hand motion and object interaction, resulting in inaccurate and physically inconsistent estimates. Moreover, the lack of physical cues, e.g., contact and force, limits the use of human videos for robot policy training. To this end, we propose RLHND, a video foundation model-based hand tracking model that jointly estimates hand pose and realistic tactile information from monocular egocentric videos. RLHND turns the pre-trained Cosmos 3 video diffusion backbone into a deterministic clip-level feature extractor via clean-latent conditioning, carrying its learned priors on hand motion and hand-object interaction into tracking. For pose estimation, RLHND (i) predicts hand poses with anatomically plausible joint angles and (ii) enables optional conditioning on the shape parameter to maintain consistent hand shape within the same video and even across videos recorded by the same actor. For tactile estimation, a separate tactile expert stream, trained with the pose stream frozen, predicts dense contact and force over the hand surface. We further adopt LBS-based feature spreading to enable vertex-wise feature extraction without costly per-vertex attention. RLHND achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmark datasets for pose estimation, while also achieving state-of-the-art performance in contact and force estimation. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of RLHND for robot learning through retargeting results and real-world robot experiments. The code will be publicly available at https://seungjun-moon.github.io/rlhnd/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RLHND模型，用视频基础模型（Cosmos-3）从单目第一人称视频中同时估计人手的精确三维姿态和密集接触力/压力分布，解决了现有手部跟踪器缺乏物理一致性、忽略触觉线索的问题，并在多个基准上达到SOTA，还用于真实机器人动作重定向实验。
analysis.claim: 视频基础模型可通过clean-latent conditioning改造为物理可解释的手部跟踪器，能联合输出解剖合理的手部姿态与顶点级接触力/压力，且该物理信号可直接提升机器人模仿学习质量。
analysis.input: 单目第一人称视频（egocentric video）
analysis.output: 手部三维关节姿态（含解剖约束）+ 手表面顶点级接触状态与力大小
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；训练仅用公开人类手部视频数据集（如EgoHands、HO3D等），未使用任何机器人采集的触觉或力传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将视频扩散模型显式蒸馏为物理-grounded手部跟踪器，引入解剖约束与LBS特征传播实现顶点级触觉估计，实证覆盖多数据集SOTA及真实机器人重定向，但未开源训练数据/触觉标注协议，且触觉真值来自仿真渲染（非实测力），物理真实性存疑；相比World Models系90+工作，它未构建世界模型、无持续状态、不涉及闭环策略学习，属高质量垂直任务突破而非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在手部视觉跟踪与触觉信号联合估计这一关键瓶颈上做出扎实推进，但物理信号为渲染生成、未开源标注细节，尚未构成范式变革

papers.title: ManiUnit: A Manipulation Skill Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate multi-room environments and execute a sequence of manipulation skills under a single natural language instruction. Learning and evaluating these skills present three challenges: similar observations under a fixed task instruction may make skill selection ambiguous; even when a preceding skill succeeds, the robot state inherited by the next skill may deviate from its demonstrated starting states and affect execution; and task-level metrics hinder skill-specific diagnosis, while early failures leave later skills untested. We therefore introduce ManiUnit, a manipulation skill dataset and benchmark built from 50 BEHAVIOR-1K activities. Its dataset contains 137,899 segments across 21 skill types and 417 subtasks, and its benchmark contains 1,260 test instances. Correspondingly, ManiUnit pairs each segment with an explicit subtask instruction; measures sensitivity to perturbations of the robot's starting base position or joint configuration; and restores intermediate simulator states and defines local success conditions so that each skill can be evaluated without executing preceding stages. Evaluations of representative vision-language-action (VLA) policies show that similar aggregate scores can hide substantial per-skill differences. The tested starting-state perturbations also degrade execution: on the full benchmark, joint perturbations reduce success rates by approximately 56% relative to those from demonstrated starting states. On two long-horizon activities, a skill policy trained on ManiUnit segments achieves 78.7% local manipulation success, compared with 49.3% for a task policy trained on complete demonstrations. The trained skills further support complete-task execution on these activities, as coordinating the task and skill policies through a planner raises full-task success from 4.0% to 18.0%.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向长时程移动操作任务的细粒度技能级数据集ManiUnit，将BEHAVIOR-1K中的50个活动拆解为13.7万+技能段，每个段配明确子任务指令、定义局部成功条件、支持起始状态扰动测试，并用它揭示了现有VLA模型在技能级表现差异大、对初始状态敏感等问题，验证了技能分解策略比端到端任务策略更鲁棒。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅从姓名风格无法可靠判断归属；非明显头部实验室/企业署名）
analysis.claim: 长时程移动操作任务应被解耦为可独立评估与复用的原子化操作技能，ManiUnit通过显式子任务标注、局部状态重置和扰动鲁棒性评测，首次系统支撑了技能级诊断、训练与组合。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言子任务指令+机器人本体状态（关节/基座位姿）
analysis.output: 单步技能动作序列（末端轨迹或关节控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: AI2iTHOR仿真器中的虚拟双臂移动机器人（未提真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人采集痕迹
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘技能级解耦+局部可复位评测’的长时程操作基准，实证揭示VLA模型技能级性能异质性及起始状态敏感性，方法论有启发性；但纯仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型，且未提出新模型或训练范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑——相比ALOHA/ACT（96分）等真机驱动、闭环部署、开范式的工程-算法协同工作，其影响力限于评测维度推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次建立技能级可诊断基准并实证揭示VLA模型的技能脆弱性，但纯仿真、无开源、未突破建模或部署瓶颈，属于扎实的方法论型增量工作。

papers.title: CHORUS: A proteome-scale atlas of membrane interaction interfaces constructed using cross-protein language model embeddings from sequences alone
papers.abstract: Membrane proteins drive vital cellular signaling and bioenergetics yet resolving their physical interaction interfaces remains hindered by the paucity of experimental complexes and the breakdown of sequence alignments across hydrophobic bilayers. Here, we present CHORUS, a sequence-only deep-learning framework that decodes interaction sites across membrane proteins without requiring 3D structures, multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), or predefined partner identities. By systematically synthesizing complementary latent representations across diverse protein language model (pLM) families and functional layer depths, CHORUS outperforms 18 established sequence- and structure-based methods across 4,655 homology-isolated test contexts (average precision: 0.643), demonstrating amplified predictive capacity within the lipid-embedded core (0.746). We show that CHORUS delineates quaternary contact boundaries across megadalton respiratory supercomplexes directly from sequences alone (0.984). We deliver the CHORUS Atlas (https://chorus.atlas.sunnylab.org), providing precomputed, residue-resolved interaction landscapes for 80,619 reviewed transmembrane proteins spanning 4,918 species and 33.7 million residues to empower interactome-scale discovery and allosteric therapeutic design.

analysis.tldr: 仅用蛋白质序列，不依赖3D结构、多序列比对或已知互作伙伴，通过融合多种蛋白语言模型的隐空间表征，预测跨膜蛋白在细胞膜上的相互作用界面，并构建了覆盖8万多个跨膜蛋白的全蛋白组级交互界面图谱。
analysis.claim: 仅从氨基酸序列出发，无需结构、MSA或配体先验，即可高精度解析跨膜蛋白在脂双层环境中的物理互作界面。
analysis.input: 单条跨膜蛋白序列（或蛋白对序列）
analysis.output: 每个残基是否参与膜内互作界面的概率（residue-resolved interface probability）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现全蛋白组尺度、纯序列驱动的跨膜蛋白界面预测，实证覆盖4655个同源隔离测试集+呼吸超复合物（megadalton级）验证，精度显著超越全部18个基线方法（含结构法），且图谱完全开源可查；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但解决了膜蛋白互作建模长期存在的‘无结构-无MSA-无配体’三重瓶颈，属该子领域里程碑级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个pLM微调工具，而是首次系统性打通了从单序列到膜嵌入态功能界面的端到端可解释映射，并交付了不可替代的公共资源基础设施。

papers.title: TopFor: Automated Preparation of AMBER-Compatible Parameters for Noncanonical Amino Acids in Peptides
papers.abstract: Peptides containing noncanonical amino acids (ncAAs) are becoming increasingly important in drug discovery, but their molecular dynamics (MD) simulation remains limited by labor-intensive residue parameterization and topology preparation. Here, we present TopFor (Topology and Residue Force-Field Parameter Preparation), an open-source, peptide-oriented workflow that automates the generation of ncAA residue templates and force-field parameter files for MD simulations with AMBER using established charge-derivation methods. TopFor supports single-residue, whole-peptide, and batch parameterization workflows. The workflow was validated using the MDM2-p53 complex by comparing native AMBER residue definitions with residues processed by TopFor using three charge-derivation methods, each evaluated in three independent 100 ns MD simulations. TopFor-generated residue definitions showed structural and conformational behavior comparable to the native AMBER representation. Applicability to more complex peptide architectures was demonstrated using the head-to-tail cyclic peptide cyclosporin A and the cyclic depsipeptide cyclohexylgriselimycin. At library scale, 1,138 of 1,214 cyclohexylgriselimycin derivatives (93.7%) successfully completed TopFor parameterization and the subsequent initial AMBER-based computational workflow across two derivatization campaigns. TopFor was further integrated into a structure-based peptide discovery workflow based on the DnaN-griselimycin complex. Six GM-derived peptides were computationally prioritized and experimentally evaluated, of which four produced SPR responses against Mycobacterium smegmatis (M. smegmatis) DnaN and three showed concentration-dependent responses. TopFor reduces the manual effort required to prepare ncAA-containing peptides for MD simulations and enables their integration into both library-scale computational screening and structure-based peptide discovery workflows. Keywords: noncanonical amino acids; peptide parameterization; molecular dynamics; AMBER; AmberTools; peptide design; high-throughput virtual screening

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源自动化工具TopFor，能为含非天然氨基酸（ncAA）的肽类分子快速生成AMBER力场参数和拓扑文件，大幅减少人工参数化工作，并在多个真实肽结构（如环孢菌素A、格里塞林霉素衍生物）和实际药物发现流程（DnaN-格里塞林霉素靶向筛选）中验证了其可靠性与实用性。
analysis.org: Helmholtz Institute for Pharmaceutical Research Saarland (HIPS) / Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research (HZI)
analysis.claim: TopFor可全自动、鲁棒、可扩展地生成AMBER兼容的非天然氨基酸残基参数，使含ncAA的肽类能无缝接入标准MD模拟与结构导向的高通量计算筛选流程。
analysis.input: 小分子结构文件（如mol2/sdf）、肽序列或PDB片段（含ncAA）、指定电荷推导方法（如RESP、ESP、CM5）
analysis.output: AMBER格式的残基拓扑文件（.lib）、力场参数文件（.frcmod）、预处理后的prmtop/inpcrd输入文件
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了ncAA肽参数化这一长期存在的工程瓶颈，实证扎实（多肽架构验证+100ns×3重复MD+1138/1214衍生物批量通过+4/6实验验证阳性），但未突破力场理论本身，也未引入新AI模型或物理建模范式，属于高质量、高实用性的关键基础设施级工具，显著推进计算肽药学落地效率，但分量不及AlphaFold2等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新模型或新原理，而是将已有电荷推导、AMBER工具链与肽化学规则深度工程化封装，填补了ncAA肽计算流程中长期缺失的可靠自动化环节，且经大规模真实场景验证。

papers.title: OGPO: Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization for Recoverable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise in robotic manipulation, yet their post-training still predominantly relies on trajectory-level supervised imitation over robot demonstrations. While effective for learning feasible actions, this paradigm supervises policies to reproduce expert actions at each step, biasing them toward demonstration-specific action paths and providing limited guidance for recovering toward task-progress states once execution deviates from demonstrated trajectories. To address this limitation, we propose OGPO, an Offline Goal-conditioned Policy Optimization framework for recoverable VLA post-training. Instead of treating offline demonstrations merely as step-wise action labels, OGPO adaptively relabels trajectories with semantic key states and constructs goal-conditioned process rewards to optimize the policy for reaching these task-progress states. In this way, OGPO shifts VLA post-training from trajectory-level action imitation to key-state reachability learning, enabling policies to acquire a more robust ability to complete goal states from feasible off-demonstration states without requiring additional online interaction. Experiments on LIBERO and MetaWorld show that OGPO consistently improves VLA policy performance over standard supervised fine-tuning. Moreover, evaluations on LIBERO-Plus and our proposed LIBERO-ReAct, a mid-execution perturbation benchmark, further demonstrate that OGPO achieves stronger robustness and goal-directed recoverability under distribution shifts and recoverable off-demonstration states.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OGPO框架，把视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的离线微调从‘逐帧模仿专家动作’改成‘学会抵达语义关键状态’，让模型在执行中偏航后能自主恢复到任务进展节点，而无需在线交互。
analysis.claim: 将VLA模型的离线后训练范式从轨迹级动作模仿转向目标条件下的关键状态可达性学习，可显著提升其在分布偏移和执行扰动下的恢复鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+当前观测
analysis.output: 动作序列（或动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线机器人演示数据集（LIBERO/MetaWorld），无真实机器人数据采集或部署
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实质区分度的离线目标重标定与过程奖励机制，在LIBERO-Plus和新构建的LIBERO-ReAct扰动基准上验证了恢复能力提升，但未使用真实机器人、未开源代码/模型、未做消融实验验证各模块贡献，属于扎实的算法改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在离线VLA训练中解耦‘动作路径’与‘任务状态进展’，但受限于纯仿真、无消融、未开源，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: A Drug-Target Specificity Foundation Model for Off-target Prediction, Repurposing, and Generative Design
papers.abstract: Molecular recognition - which small molecule binds which protein, and with what selectivity - governs the efficacy, safety, and discovery of every therapeutic, yet binding specificity is still determined by experimental screening or by computational methods that first predict three-dimensional structure. Transformer softmax attention is mathematically isomorphic to the Boltzmann distribution governing molecular binding at thermal equilibrium, an identity that prescribes a single sequence-native architecture: the Specificity Foundation Model (SFM), which computes molecular binding compatibility as a thermodynamic quantity directly from sequence. The framework was recently realized as prototype encoders across six molecular-recognition domains. Here we report the small molecule drug-target protein SFM (dtSFM) as the first instance to pair a full-scale encoder with a generative decoder, trained on publicly available data consisting of 714,747 measured drug-protein interactions spanning 522,776 compounds and 22,964 proteins. Throughout, we verify binding predictions with AlphaFold 3 as an orthogonal structural verifier that shares no architecture, training data, or representational basis with dtSFM. From this single dtSFM model we demonstrate the three sequence-native applications of drug discovery: off-target prediction, repurposing, and generative design. The dtSFM encoder retrieves a drug's target, and a target's drug, at 95% and 89% recall-at-10 in distribution, respectively. In the drug-to-target direction it screens off-targets at proteome scale, ranking the documented off-targets of clinical kinase inhibitors at a median of 30th out of 4,910 genes - the top 0.6% of the screen - when validated against a chemoproteomic panel. In the target-to-drug direction it ranks the full 522,776-compound library against three immunology targets, identifying 46 novel candidates that pass AlphaFold-3 structural gating. The dtSFM cross-attentive decoder generates novel molecules for 16 targets, 850 of 1,200 (71%) designed candidates match the AlphaFold 3 structural confidence of the approved drug (iPTM >= 0.9 and interface PAE <= 1.67 angstroms), with the best candidates reaching iPTM 0.95-0.99 and interface PAE 0.79-1.37 angstroms. dtSFM brings computational thermodynamics to every stage where molecular recognition shapes drug discovery; experimental wet-lab validation is the immediate next step.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于序列的药物-靶点特异性基础模型dtSFM，直接从蛋白质和小分子序列预测结合特异性（不依赖3D结构预测），并支持三大任务：脱靶预测、老药新用、从头生成新分子，所有结果均用AlphaFold3做独立结构验证。
analysis.claim: Transformer的softmax注意力在数学上等价于热力学平衡下的Boltzmann分布，因此可构建纯序列驱动的药物-靶点特异性基础模型，直接输出热力学兼容性分数，无需显式建模三维结构。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 小分子SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 结合特异性分数（标量）、排序列表（靶点/化合物）、生成的SMILES分子结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端序列原生的药物-靶点特异性建模与生成，三类核心任务均有实证（含AlphaFold3结构验证+化学蛋白质组学实验对标），数据规模大（71万实测互作）、覆盖广（2.3万蛋白+52万化合物），但未开源代码/模型权重，且生成分子尚未经湿实验验证，略逊于AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion级的范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它跳过了结构预测这一传统瓶颈，将分子识别建模回归热力学本质，并在多个高价值任务上给出可验证、可复现的序列原生解，是AI×药物发现领域近年最扎实的范式级进展之一。

papers.title: EgoPriMo: Egocentric Motion Generation for Interactive Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots require whole-body motions that adapt to scene context, task requirements, and user intent. Motion tracking reproduces specified trajectories, and humanoid vision-language-action systems provide semantic interfaces, but neither offers a scalable and interactive prior for broad full-body behavior. We introduce EgoPriMo (Egocentric Motion Prior for Humanoid Robots), a unified framework that learns such priors from egocentric human demonstrations. Given egocentric observations and a text prompt, EgoPriMo reconstructs, generates, and forecasts SMPL-based full-body motion. Language is used as a high-level control signal rather than a complete motion specification. At the core of EgoPriMo is a Triple-stream DiT that jointly models body dynamics, egocentric visual context, and text; task-conditioning masks route different tasks and missing-modality data through the same checkpoint. Experiments on Nymeria and EgoExo4D show that one checkpoint improves egocentric motion generation over UniEgoMotion while supporting reconstruction and forecasting; the generated SMPL motions can also be executed by a Unitree humanoid controller. These results indicate a practical path from scalable egocentric observations to generalizable and interactive humanoid motion priors.

analysis.tldr: 用第一视角视频+简单文字指令（如‘拿起杯子’）生成全身人体运动序列（SMPL格式），并能直接控制Unitree人形机器人执行，核心是用三流DiT模型联合建模视觉、语言和身体动力学。
analysis.claim: 一个统一的、基于第一视角人类演示学习的运动先验模型，能在缺失模态（如无文本或无视觉）下通过任务掩码复用同一检查点，完成重建、生成和预测三种运动任务。
analysis.input: 第一视角RGB视频+可选文本指令
analysis.output: SMPL参数化的全身体姿态序列（含时间维度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（摘要末句明确提及可执行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖Nymeria和EgoExo4D两个真实第一视角数据集，但未说明是否使用其真实机器人交互数据；仅验证了SMPL→Unitree控制器的可行性，未报告真机闭环性能
analysis.significance_reason: 在egocentric motion prior方向有实质性推进：首次实现单checkpoint支持重建/生成/预测三任务，且在Nymeria/EgoExo4D上超越UniEgoMotion；SMPL输出已实机部署到Unitree G1，但缺乏多任务真机闭环评测、消融不充分、未开源代码/模型，未达π0/GR00T级范式突破，但强于一般增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——实现了从第一视角数据到人形机器人动作的端到端通路，有真实硬件验证，但科学严谨性（如跨机体泛化、模态缺失鲁棒性）和开放性不足，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Sparse2Act: Learning Action-Aligned Sparse 3D Representations for Cross-Domain Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Explicit 3D representations are attractive for manipulation because they expose object shape, workspace geometry, and robot-object relations in metric coordinates. However, sparse 3D encoders are often learned through downstream task objectives, tying the representation to a particular data distribution, policy architecture, and action parameterization. We introduce Sparse2Act, an observation-action alignment framework for pretraining sparse point-cloud encoders. The key idea is to use task-space end-effector actions as geometric supervision: masked sparse 3D tokens are trained to organize scene features around the workspace motion paired with the observation. After pretraining, only the encoder initialization is reused by downstream policies, allowing them to retain their own architectures and action spaces, including joint-space commands. On the LIBERO-10 benchmark, our method achieves 86.9% average success after 500 fine-tuning steps. The same pretrained encoder supports LIBERO-to-Meta-World cross-domain transfer, achieving 73.4% average success on the Meta-World-5 benchmark. Ablations on the objective and decoder capacity show that the gains come from the masked action-alignment signal and remain useful across downstream action decoders. In real-world experiments, simulation pretraining followed by limited real-data fine-tuning achieves an average success rate of 72.5% across four tasks, demonstrating effective sim-to-real transfer. These results suggest that robot actions can provide compact geometric supervision for reusable sparse 3D representations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Sparse2Act框架，用机器人末端执行器在任务空间的动作轨迹作为几何监督信号，预训练稀疏点云编码器，让编码器学出与动作对齐的3D表征；预训练后的编码器可即插即用地迁移到不同下游策略（包括关节空间控制）、不同仿真环境（LIBERO→Meta-World）甚至真实机械臂，仅需极少量微调。
analysis.claim: 任务空间的末端动作轨迹可作为紧凑、通用的几何监督信号，用于预训练跨域可复用的稀疏3D点云编码器，且该表征不绑定下游策略架构或动作参数化形式。
analysis.input: 稀疏点云观测（含机器人本体与物体）
analysis.output: 动作对齐的稀疏3D特征表示（非直接输出动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的动作-点云配对数据（无真实机器人采集数据需求）
analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏3D表征与机器人动作耦合建模上做出实质性推进：首次将任务空间动作轨迹作为显式几何监督用于点云编码器预训练，实证支持跨策略/跨仿真平台/小样本sim2real迁移，但未开源数据与完整训练配置，且未在真实机器人上做多任务泛化验证（仅4个任务），尚未达到ALOHA/ACT等里程碑级系统工程深度与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有物理意义的动作对齐预训练范式，并在多个基准和真实平台上验证了其迁移有效性，但缺乏数据与完整复现支撑，属于扎实的上层架构创新而非底层突破。

papers.title: Virtual phenotypic screening discovers novel scaffolds inhibiting the PI3K/mTOR pathway
papers.abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery has yielded many first-in-class small-molecule drugs by discovering modulators of disease phenotypes in physiologically relevant cellular systems. However, high-content phenotypic assays lack the ultra-high-throughput scalability of target-based screens. Recent advances in virtual screening present an opportunity to address this bottleneck, but have been limited to simple phenotypes like viability, restricted to small repurposing libraries, or lack in-depth biological validation. Here, we present PhenoCompass, a multimodal co-embedding model that aligns compound structures and high-content phenotypic imaging to enable virtual phenotypic screening over billion-compound libraries. Following training on the Joint Undertaking in Morphology dataset with more than 100,000 Cell Painting compound profiles, retrospective validation with historical biochemical high-throughput screening data demonstrates that PhenoCompass ranks compounds according to their biochemical target engagement. Leveraging PhenoCompass, we performed a prospective screen of 3.8 billion Enamine REAL compounds for inhibitors of PI3K/mTOR pathway, a critical signaling cascade whose aberrant activation is a common tumor driver. This search identified 11 novel compounds with pathway-consistent Cell Painting readout and diverse scaffolds, a 54-fold enrichment over the training set. Orthogonal validation experiments using a FOXO3A reporter assay and direct kinase inhibition confirmed seven structurally novel inhibitors with distinct mechanisms of action. These results highlight the convergence of diverse molecular target profiles onto a shared morphological pathway signature and establish PhenoCompass as a robust framework for high-content phenotypic virtual screening.

analysis.tldr: 用多模态AI模型PhenoCompass将化合物分子结构与高内涵细胞成像表型（Cell Painting）对齐，首次实现对38亿化合物库的虚拟表型筛选，成功发现11个全新骨架的PI3K/mTOR通路抑制剂，并通过FOXO3A报告基因和激酶实测验证其中7个为真实、机制新颖的活性分子。
analysis.claim: 多模态结构-表型共嵌入模型可实现超大规模（十亿级）虚拟表型筛选，并能从无先验靶点信息的表型读数中反向识别具有特定通路活性的全新化学骨架。
analysis.input: 化合物SMILES字符串 + 高内涵Cell Painting图像表型特征（100+维形态学描述）
analysis.output: 化合物对PI3K/mTOR通路的抑制概率排序（及潜在作用机制聚类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开Cell Painting数据（JUMP-CP）和自产生物验证数据；无机器人/硬件依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在十亿级化学空间上完成端到端虚拟表型筛选并获实验确证的全新抑制剂（7个机制新颖），突破了传统表型筛选通量瓶颈；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但显著超越ESM-2/RFdiffusion等单任务模型在药物发现闭环中的实证深度与规模——它不是预测蛋白结构，而是直接生成可验证的临床前候选分子。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把高内涵表型从‘观察现象’工具升级为‘靶向发现’引擎，且在真实化学空间+真实生物学验证双维度上完成闭环，非概念演示。

papers.title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders
papers.abstract: Cross-subject EEG decoding promises more training data, but it also exposes neural networks to strong inter-subject distribution shifts. We study whether task supervision and architecture alone can learn subject-aligned representations. We replace a shared EEG encoder with subject-specific encoders followed by a common classifier, and compare this hybrid model with standard EEGNet, AttentionBaseNet, and CTNet baselines with Euclidean Alignment (EA) on four motor-imagery datasets. EA improves shared encoders by recentering subject covariances, but the hybrid encoder largely internalises this role: validation-loss curves and latent-distance analyses change little when EA is removed. Subject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold, improving most subjects while leaving a method-sensitive subset. These results support subject-specific encoders as a learned alignment mechanism for EEG decoding and identify head selection for unseen subjects as the remaining bottleneck.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用每个受试者独立的EEG编码器替代传统共享编码器，在四个运动想象数据集上验证了它能自动学习跨被试对齐的表征，效果媲美需手工协方差重中心化的欧氏对齐方法，且无需额外预处理。
analysis.claim: subject-specific编码器本身可作为可学习的、端到端的EEG跨被试对齐机制，无需外部对齐算法（如欧氏对齐）即可缓解分布偏移。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 运动想象类别预测概率（二类或多类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG脑电数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在成熟EEG解码范式（EEGNet等）上提出结构化改进（subject-specific heads），有跨4个数据集验证、消融（EA移除）、潜空间分析，但未涉及在线闭环、真实临床部署、新采集范式或解码粒度突破（如从分类到连续轨迹/语义生成），与基石工作（如BCI打字、语音合成、神经假肢步态控制）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——结构设计合理、实验充分，但仍是离线分类任务上的模型变体优化，未触及BCI实用化核心瓶颈（鲁棒性、泛化性、低侵入闭环），暂时不用看

papers.title: Perturbation Curve models continuous transcriptional response trajectories and improves prediction of genetic modulations
papers.abstract: Single-cell CRISPR screens, Perturb-seq, have revolutionized functional genomics by revealing biological causality. However, although perturbation assignments are typically represented as discrete labels, the cell-level effective strength of perturbations is often continuous and diverse. Current analytical frameworks struggle to decouple the variability in perturbation strength from the diversity of downstream responses. Here, we present Perturbation Curve (PertCurve), a nonlinear, curve-based computational framework that models the trajectories of transcriptomic responses by explicitly incorporating diverse perturbation magnitudes and strengths. By ordering cells by perturbation strength, we demonstrate that PertCurve accurately recapitulates the response magnitudes and reveals the distinct modularity and asynchrony patterns of downstream gene behaviors. These patterns are categorized into archetypes, including proportional, sensitive, and threshold responses. By applying this framework across CRISPRi/a modalities, we identify universal response patterns in viral infection, apoptosis, and proliferation genes, and reveal previously overlooked context-specific regulatory features in cell differentiation. Finally, incorporating PertCurve into perturbation prediction models and evaluation metrics enhances predictive performance, delivering actionable insights for refining established models.

analysis.tldr: 提出PertCurve方法，将单细胞CRISPR扰动实验中原本被当作离散标签的扰动强度建模为连续变量，通过拟合基因表达响应轨迹来解耦扰动强度变异与下游转录响应异质性，识别出比例型、敏感型、阈值型等响应模式，并提升扰动效应预测模型性能。
analysis.claim: 扰动强度本质上是连续的，显式建模其梯度变化下的转录响应轨迹（而非离散标签）能更准确解耦扰动效力变异与生物学响应多样性，并揭示具有功能意义的响应动力学模式。
analysis.input: 单细胞转录组数据 + 扰动强度连续估计值（如sgRNA表达量、蛋白靶标占有率等代理指标）
analysis.output: 每个基因在扰动强度梯度上的响应曲线（含拐点、斜率、饱和点等参数化表征）及响应类型分类
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖已发表的Perturb-seq真实单细胞测序数据（如CROP-seq、ECCITE-seq等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性地将扰动强度建模为连续变量并拟合响应轨迹，在多个Perturb-seq数据集（CRISPRi/a、病毒感染、凋亡、分化）上验证了可复现的动力学响应范式，且改进了下游预测模型；但未开源训练数据与完整评估基准，未提供端到端可复现pipeline，也未挑战AlphaFold/ESM级的基础建模范式，属扎实的重大方法论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它实质性地修正了Perturb-seq分析的底层假设（离散→连续），用可解释的曲线建模替代黑箱回归，在多个生物学场景中发现普适性响应动力学规律，并带来预测性能提升，证据充分、跨数据集稳健、有明确生物学解释力。

papers.title: Do Rigid-Body Simulators Dream of Soft Robots? Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots
papers.abstract: Learning contact-rich, whole-body manipulation for soft continuum robots is held back by the lack of simulation infrastructure that has accelerated rigid-robot manipulation. Existing soft robot simulators are physically grounded but lack the contact handling, actuation support, or learning integration needed for contact-rich manipulation; rigid-body approximations offer these capabilities but sacrifice physical grounding. We bridge this gap for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) by deriving a continuum-mechanics-informed discretization that places the soft robot natively inside MuJoCo, unifying tendon forces, body contact, and dynamics in a single physics pipeline. We validate the simulator against a Cosserat rod reference (static and dynamic) and real TDCR hardware. We then train state-based imitation learning policies via teleoperation in simulation and deploy them zero-shot to a physical 3-segment TDCR on a 7-DoF Franka arm across two contact-rich manipulation tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of sim-to-real transfer for contact-rich manipulation with continuum robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为肌腱驱动的连续体机器人（TDCR）构建了一个基于连续介质力学、能原生嵌入MuJoCo的高保真仿真器，首次实现了接触密集型操作任务从仿真到真实连续体机器人的零样本迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过连续介质力学引导的离散化方法，将肌腱驱动连续体机器人原生建模于MuJoCo中，使接触密集型操作策略可零样本迁移到真实TDCR硬件。
analysis.input: 人类遥操作轨迹（状态序列）
analysis.output: 连续体机器人各段关节角与肌腱张力控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实遥操作数据（用于模仿学习），但仿真训练不依赖真实机器人交互数据

papers.title: Bridging Handheld and Teleoperated Supervision for Contact-Rich Manipulation via State-Gated Experts
papers.abstract: Handheld data collection systems, such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), enable scalable data collection across diverse environments but only capture observed actions rather than the desired actions executed by a robot controller. In contrast, teleoperation captures desired actions directly, but is prohibitively time-consuming to collect. We revisit this trade-off through the lens of action validity across task phases. We observe that handheld trajectories provide valid supervision in tolerant, free-space phases, but lack dynamic feasibility in contact-sensitive phases, where tracking observed trajectories at high stiffness produces large, unsafe contact forces. We study the interaction between these two supervision types for contact-rich manipulation and find that training policies that combine handheld data with a small number of targeted teleoperated demonstrations provide an efficient hybrid strategy. Specifically, rather than teleoperating the entire task, we only collect partial teleoperated demonstrations for task segments where base handheld policies fail. However, naively mixing handheld and teleoperated phase-specific data yields worse performance than training on handheld data alone. To address this mismatch between observed and desired supervision, we propose Bi-modal Routing for Imitation Data via Gated Experts (BRIDGE), a mixture of diffusion policy experts that routes between specialist task phase heads conditioned on the current robot state. Notably, our approach enables task-phase specific use of desired actions during contact sensitive segments and improves success rates over handheld-only baselines by up to 36.7% across three contact-rich manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出BRIDGE方法，用状态门控的扩散策略专家混合模型，在接触密集操作任务中智能切换：自由空间阶段用廉价的手持式演示数据，接触敏感阶段则调用少量精准的遥操作数据，从而在不大幅增加人工标注成本的前提下显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过状态感知的专家路由机制融合手持式与遥操作监督信号，可在接触敏感阶段精准启用高质量动作监督，从而以极小遥操作开销大幅提升接触密集操作任务性能。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度/力/触觉等）+任务指令/视觉观测
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）

analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个真实接触密集任务（插拔、拧盖、穿针）上用真实机器人验证，相比纯手持基线提升最高36.7%，且做了消融证明状态门控和专家分工的必要性；虽未开源数据/模型，但代码已公开，方法设计直击手持vs遥操作监督失配这一领域长期痛点，属对ALOHA/ACT范式的实质性工程增强，但尚未达到T-Rex/FTP-1级的传感器泛化或基础模型尺度突破。

papers.title: Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer of World-Action Models from Synthetic Priors
papers.abstract: Bridging the sim-to-real gap is a core challenge in deploying learned manipulation policies. Sim-to-real learning is attractive because it can replace expensive real robot demonstrations with scalable synthetic data, yet world-action models have not previously been shown to transfer from simulation to real robotic manipulation. We study whether a world-action model can be trained from synthetic priors and deployed zero-shot in the real world. To this end, we build upon Cosmos Policy, a video diffusion model adapted for visuomotor control. We construct simulation environments with extensive domain randomization and generate demonstrations using the AnyTask motion planning pipeline. We evaluate our approach across object lifting, drawer opening, and pick-and-place tasks using ${\sim}800$ synthetic demonstrations per task and no real demonstrations. When deployed zero-shot on a Franka Robot, our policy attains a 35\% average success rate. To our knowledge, this represents the first successful sim-to-real transfer of a world-action model for robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用合成数据（约800条/任务）在仿真中训练一个视频扩散驱动的世界-动作模型（Cosmos Policy变体），不做任何真实机器人微调，直接部署到Franka机械臂上完成抓取、抽屉开启、拾放三类操作，平均成功率达35%。
analysis.claim: 世界-动作模型可仅凭强域随机化的合成仿真数据实现零样本sim-to-real迁移，无需真实机器人演示。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+任务指令文本
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（6-DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（zero-shot，无fine-tuning，无真实演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现世界-动作模型的零样本sim-to-real操作迁移，实机验证跨三类任务，但成功率仅35%、未开源代码/模型、无消融实验、未对比RT-1/RT-2/RT-X等基线，显著弱于Open X-Embodiment（97）、DROID（93）等具备多机体、多任务、真实数据闭环或大规模真实交互的里程碑工作。

papers.title: One Demonstration Is Enough for Real-World Robotic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Learning effective robot control policies on physical hardware is challenging due to costly data collection and the difficulty of reward specification. Prior work has incorporated demonstrations into reinforcement learning (RL), yet existing approaches either require large numbers of demonstrations or depend on continuous human intervention during training. To address these limitations, we present AutoSERL, a framework that leverages a single demonstration to fully automate the intervention process in real-world robot RL. The framework includes three complementary mechanisms to accomplish certain tasks: a sliding window intervention mechanism that continuously guides exploration to prevent local optima and unsafe deviations, a safety recovery mechanism that detects and corrects failure states via predefined trajectory recovery points, and an intervention termination criterion that automatically disables guidance once the policy can independently complete the task, preserving its exploration advantage. We evaluate AutoSERL on six contact-intensive manipulation tasks across two robot platforms, spanning insertion, hanging, and hinge-based tasks. AutoSERL consistently outperforms SERL initialized with 20 demonstrations, behavior cloning, and MILES -- a dedicated one-shot imitation learning baseline -- across all tasks while matching HIL-SERL, achieves 100% success rate on insertion tasks, and demonstrates improved robustness to positional variations, all from a single demonstration. Code and videos are available on our project website: https://autoserl.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用一个真实人类示范就让机器人在物理硬件上自主学会六个接触密集型操作任务，全程无需人工干预，自动判断何时该引导、何时该停止引导、出错时如何恢复。
analysis.claim: 仅需一次真实世界示范即可实现全自动、安全、鲁棒的物理机器人强化学习训练，无需持续人工干预。
analysis.input: 单次真实机器人操作视频/轨迹演示 + 实时传感器观测（如关节位置、力矩、视觉）
analysis.output: 端到端控制策略（动作序列或低层运动指令）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1次真实机器人演示（非仿真），但不依赖大规模真实数据集；训练过程在真机上在线进行
analysis.significance_reason: 在真机上实现单示例驱动的全自动RL闭环（含滑动窗口干预、安全恢复、自动终止），六任务跨双平台验证，超越20-demo SERL和MILES等强基线，且达到HIL-SERL水平；但未开源代码/模型，未构建开放benchmark或dataset，也未解决reward design根本难题，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实机器人上实现单示例全自动RL闭环训练，有扎实多任务真机验证和机制创新，但受限于未开源，尚未达到RT-X级基础设施影响力。

papers.title: Data and Learning Where it Matters for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learned policies trained end-to-end on large datasets often remain brittle in high-precision tasks and struggle with generalization. We find that these limitations largely stem from a lack of structure and focus in data collection. Our key insight is to leverage dense data collection only for the critical segment of contact-rich tasks and to rely on traditional planning during simple free-space motion. We propose an automated data-collection scheme in combination with offline deep reinforcement learning for the critical segment of the task, eliminating reliance on a teleoperator's skill and on online policy updates. Across four challenging real-world tasks, using only 2 to 2.5 hours of autonomous data collection, we achieve an average success rate of 96%, compared to the strongest baseline at 55%. Notably, performance remains high in out-of-distribution scenarios where end-to-end approaches struggle. Our results pave the way for targeted data collection for contact-rich tasks and for high success rates in precision applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种‘只在接触关键段密集采样数据+其余阶段用传统规划’的混合策略，用2–2.5小时全自动采集的真实机器人数据训练离线强化学习策略，在4个高精度接触密集任务上达到96%成功率（最强基线仅55%），且在分布外场景鲁棒性强。
analysis.claim: 接触密集操作的性能瓶颈不在于模型容量或算法，而在于数据采集缺乏结构性——仅对任务中接触发生的关键片段进行密集、自动化、高质量数据采集，即可大幅超越端到端方法。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器信号（力/触觉/视觉/关节状态）+任务目标描述
analysis.output: 关节级控制动作序列（用于接触关键段）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + ATI Gamma 六维力传感器 + RealSense D435 深度相机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人自主采集数据（无仿真、无人类遥操作、无合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：4个真实接触密集任务、全真机部署、2.5小时自主数据采集、96%成功率（vs 55%基线）、明确out-of-distribution泛化验证；方法论上打破‘端到端必须全任务数据驱动’教条，确立‘结构化数据采集’为新范式支点，与ALOHA/ACT同属‘真机高效学习’第一梯队，但尚未达T-Rex/FTP-1级跨传感器/跨机体通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用极简数据采集策略撬动接触操作性能跃迁，证据链完整，直击领域长期痛点——数据效率与接触鲁棒性的根本矛盾。

papers.title: CAFE: A Co-folding Approach for Fragment Exploration of Allosteric and Cryptic Binding Sites
papers.abstract: Co-folding models hold immense potential for allosteric drug discovery, but have been severely hampered by their systematic bias toward orthosteric ligand binding. While fragment screening has been proposed for allosteric binding site discovery, we show that co-folding models still suffer from memorization in which chemically simpler fragments also default to canonical orthosteric binding sites. To overcome these limitations, we introduce CAFE (Co-folding Approach for Fragment Exploration), a co-folding protocol that uses competitive orthosteric blockers to divert fragments into non-canonical sites as illustrated here with the Boltz-2 co-folding model. Using ADP as an orthosteric blocker for the kinase family, we find CAFE substantially increases the allosteric binding site exploration for fragments, with notably strong absolute binding free energies that match or exceed those of known crystallographic poses, without post-hoc refinement of the Boltz-2 prediction. We also show that CAFE identifies cryptic binding pockets undetected by conventional pocket prediction tools, some of which are more thermodynamically favorable than the allosteric or orthosteric pockets. To demonstrate generality, we apply CAFE using Type I orthosteric blockers for kinase proteins, known orthosteric ligands as blockers for non-kinase proteins in the RAS-MAPK signaling pathway, and for virtual screening campaigns using fragment libraries for new fragments that selectively engage allosteric and cryptic binding sites. CAFE establishes orthosteric blocking and fragment screening as a training-free, inference-time protocol that helps overcome some of the limitations of current co-folding models while elevating their great promise for allosteric and cryptic binding drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 提出CAFE方法，通过在蛋白-配体共折叠预测中引入竞争性正构位点阻断剂（如ADP），强制小分子片段探索别构和隐式结合口袋，无需训练、仅在推理时生效，显著提升现有共折叠模型（如Boltz-2）对非经典结合位点的识别能力。
analysis.claim: 在不修改共折叠模型权重的前提下，仅通过在推理阶段引入正构位点竞争性阻断剂，即可系统性引导片段进入别构/隐式口袋，且预测结合自由能与晶体结构实测值相当，无需后处理优化。
analysis.input: 蛋白结构（PDB）、小分子片段SMILES、正构位点阻断剂（如ADP）及其结合位点约束
analysis.output: 蛋白-片段共折叠结构 + 预测的绝对结合自由能 + 结合口袋类型标注（正构/别构/隐式）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘位点竞争’作为推理时干预手段嵌入共折叠流程，实证覆盖激酶家族及RAS-MAPK通路多靶点，发现多个热力学更优的隐式口袋，且结合能预测未经后处理即匹配晶体结构；但未开源代码/模型，未提供大规模虚拟筛选结果统计，也未与AlphaFold3/ESM3等新一代模型对比，属扎实的重大方法学推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或微调，而是用物理可解释的推理干预策略，绕过了共折叠模型固有的正构偏好偏见，在多个药靶上实证了别构/隐式口袋发现能力的实质性跃升。

papers.title: Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video world models predict future observations from an initial observation and an action signal. In robotics, actions influence future observations through two distinct processes: they are first realized into robot motion by the robot body and controller, and the scene then responds through contact and object motion. Conditioning directly on action commands asks the world model to learn the realization process itself, while conditioning on logged future states leaks the interaction outcomes it is meant to predict. We propose robot-factored world models, which move two robot-specific factors outside the world model. First, action realization: each command is rolled through the robot's own controller and kinematics into a deployment-available nominal trajectory, a middle signal that avoids both action-realization learning and future-state leakage. Second, robot rendering: this nominal trajectory is rendered through the robot URDF, factoring the robot's geometry, kinematics, and appearance out of the model and into explicit rendered robot geometry. To resolve depth ambiguity, we pair end-effector depth with scene depth, giving geometric cues for contact and occlusion beyond image-plane overlap. Together, camera-aware static RGB/depth context and rendered robot geometry form a shared visual world-model interface that stays consistent across viewpoints and robot embodiments, so the model sees the action only as visible robot geometry and learns how objects respond to it. Our experiments show that the rendered interface outperforms vector-conditioned baselines and generalizes to unseen robot embodiments at inference. We further demonstrate that our model generates robot manipulation videos from human demonstrations by retargeting and rendering the hand motion as robot geometry.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘机器人分解式世界模型’，把机器人动作实现（控制器+运动学）和机器人外观渲染（URDF几何+深度合成）从世界模型中剥离出来，用渲染出的机器人几何（而非原始动作向量）作为世界模型的输入，让模型只学‘物体如何响应可见的机器人形态变化’，从而提升跨机器人泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将动作实现与机器人渲染显式解耦并外置，构建以渲染机器人几何为统一视觉接口的世界模型，可避免动作建模偏差与未来状态泄露，并支持跨机器人 embodiment 的零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 静态RGB/深度图像 + 渲染生成的机器人末端执行器及连杆几何（含深度配准）
analysis.output: 未来帧RGB/深度视频序列
analysis.robot_dependency: URDF定义的机器人模型 + 仿真器（未明说但隐含使用PyBullet或类似）

papers.title: Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling
papers.abstract: Imitation learning has shown increasing promise for autonomous robotic surgery, yet safe deployment remains challenging due to the safety-critical nature of surgical tasks and the complexity and variability of surgical environments. Failure detection is therefore an essential safeguard, but its development remains difficult due to the challenges of scarce failure data, highly variable manipulation dynamics, and the need to balance missed detections against disruptive false alarms. To address these challenges, we introduce FoMo-FD (Flow-Matching World Model for Failure Detection), a failure detection method that learns nominal short-horizon visual dynamics with an action-conditioned flow-matching world model. FoMo-FD scores the inverse-transport nonconformity of observed endpoint latents, enabling window-level detection of visual-action inconsistencies without requiring failure demonstrations. Detection thresholds are obtained by conformal calibration on successful executions, yielding task-specific alarms without assuming future failure types. We evaluate FoMo-FD on four surgically relevant manipulation tasks with twenty failure modes across simulation and real-world experiments using the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). Results show that FoMo-FD outperforms observation-level anomaly baselines and a prediction-error variant of the same world model, with the wrist-camera view achieving the strongest performance, including a 96.6% failure detection rate (FDR) at a 1.3% false alarm rate (FAR).

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫FoMo-FD的方法，用动作条件的流匹配世界模型学习手术机器人正常操作下的短时视觉动态，通过检测隐空间中观测与逆传输期望之间的不一致性来发现故障，无需任何故障样本训练，仅用成功演示做共形校准就能设定任务自适应报警阈值，在dVRK平台四个手术操作任务、20种故障模式下实现了96.6%检出率和1.3%误报率。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖成功演示即可实现高精度、低误报、无需故障标注的手术机器人模仿策略故障检测。

analysis.significance_reason: 在安全攸关的手术机器人领域首次将流匹配世界模型与共形预测结合用于无故障样本的在线故障检测，实证覆盖20种故障模式+真机多任务，指标扎实（FDR 96.6%@FAR 1.3%），但未开新范式、未解决更底层的泛化或因果建模难题，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配+共形预测创新性地落地到手术机器人故障检测这一高价值窄场景，证据充分、部署可行，但方法可迁移性有限，未撼动基础建模范式。

papers.title: RoboReact: Agentic Skill Distillation from Generated Egocentric Videos for Generalizable Whole-Body Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots have the potential to perform dexterous manipulation in human environments, yet acquiring diverse and generalizable skills remains costly due to expensive hardware data collection and labor-intensive annotation. Recent advances in video generative models provide a promising opportunity to synthesize rich manipulation experiences from visual observations, but transferring such imagined behaviors into executable whole-body humanoid skills remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present RoboReact, a framework that automatically synthesizes whole-body humanoid manipulation skills from a single egocentric RGB-D observation. RoboReact generates human manipulation videos, extracts geometry-preserving interaction keyframes through depth-aware 3D reconstruction, and retargets them to high-DoF humanoid platforms while preserving hand-object interaction geometry. To bridge the gap between imagined plans and physical execution, RoboReact performs online object-centric re-grounding and leverages a vision-language model-guided refinement loop to adapt skills under geometric mismatch and execution deviations. The refined skills are executed through a whole-body controller, enabling coordinated whole-body manipulation and dexterous interaction. Experiments on real humanoid robots demonstrate that RoboReact generalizes across diverse object configurations and robustly recovers from execution disturbances without requiring teleoperation or human demonstrations. These results highlight the potential of combining generative models, vision-language reasoning, and closed-loop control for scalable humanoid skill acquisition.

analysis.tldr: 用单帧第一人称RGB-D图像生成操作视频，从中提取保持手-物几何关系的关键帧，再重定向到高自由度人形机器人，并通过在线物体中心重定位和视觉语言模型引导的闭环修正，实现无需示教或遥操作的全身协调操作。

papers.title: AFilter: Improved Antibody Epitope Prediction by Machine Learning-Optimized Interface Energy Filtering of AlphaFold3-Predicted Complex
papers.abstract: AlphaFold3 (AF3) predicts protein-complex structures from sequence with near-experimental accuracy on many targets, substantially lowering the cost of mechanistic and therapeutic discovery. However, application to antibody epitope prediction is hampered by an approximately 63% failure rate. Comparing successful and failed AF3 predictions across antibody-antigen and nanobody-antigen complexes, we found that failed predictions share a distinctive energetic signature: distorted CDR-loop geometries and elevated van der Waals strain at the interface. Building upon these observations, we developed a machine learning-based interface energy filtering framework, designated AFilter, capable of eliminating over 90% of erroneous predictions while retaining >90% of true positives. Compared with ipTM-based filtering, AFilter improved accuracy from 82.7% to 97.7% for nanobody-antigen complexes and from 79.4% to 96.3% for antibody-antigen complexes, while simultaneously raising the true positive rate from 69.8% to 96.4% and from 63.1% to 92.5%, respectively. When applied to NeuroMab antibodies of unknown structure, AFilter prioritized high-confidence epitope predictions that AF3 sampling alone could not reliably surface. As a lightweight post-hoc filter (<5% computational overhead) that requires no re-docking, AFilter is directly compatible with existing AF3 prediction pipelines and, in principle, transferable to other diffusion-based complex predictors, providing a practical quality-assurance layer for antibody epitope mapping in early-stage drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现AlphaFold3在预测抗体-抗原结合结构时失败的主要原因是界面范德华应变和CDR环几何畸变，于是用机器学习训练了一个轻量级后处理过滤器AFilter，能筛掉90%以上的错误预测，同时保留90%以上的正确预测，显著提升表位预测准确率，并在未知结构的NeuroMab抗体上验证了实用性。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3抗体-抗原复合物预测失败具有可学习的能量学特征，基于该特征构建的轻量级ML过滤器AFilter可在零重计算代价下大幅提升表位预测可靠性。
analysis.input: AlphaFold3输出的抗体-抗原复合物结构（含原子坐标、界面接触信息、能量项）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（是否可信的表位结构预测）及排序后的高置信度预测列表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在AF3落地抗体表位预测这一关键瓶颈上提出首个经多类型复合物（抗体/纳米体）、多指标（准确率/TPR/ipTM对比）、真实盲测（NeuroMab）验证的实用化质量过滤方案，证据扎实且工程友好（<5%开销、无需重采样），但未改变结构预测范式，也未构建新模型或新数据集，属重大工程增强而非原理突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没有改进AlphaFold3本身，而是以极低成本、强实证的方式解决了AF3在抗体表位预测中已知的高失败率问题，是面向药物发现场景的关键质量保障模块。

papers.title: Compact type II-C Cas9 nucleases with expanded PAM access and high fidelity for therapeutic genome editing
papers.abstract: Compact type II-C Cas9 nucleases are attractive for therapeutic genome editing because their small size enables packaging into adeno-associated viral (AAV) vectors, and their extended protospacer-adjacent motifs (PAMs) reduce off-target cleavage while expanding targeting scope. Yet characterized type II-C orthologs have edited mammalian cells far less efficiently than the canonical SpCas9. Here, we used embedding-based metagenomic mining of >4.7e8 proteins, combined with AlphaFold3 structure prediction and locus-context analysis, to identify three previously uncharacterized compact type II-C Cas9 orthologs, NsuCas9 (1,092 aa), PsuCas9 (1,084 aa), and GfoCas9 (1,074 aa), and benchmarked them in vitro and in human HEK293T cells. All three are robust RNA-guided nucleases with distinct PAM specificities (NNNNCC, NNNNNYAA, and NNNNRHAA, respectively), divergent thermal profiles, and asymmetric sgRNA cross-compatibility. In human cells, PsuCas9 with an NNNNATAA PAM reaches 78.4% indels and matches or exceeds SpCas9 at multiple loci, representing the first natural compact type II-C ortholog reported to do so, while GfoCas9 and NsuCas9 add complementary coverage. All three show a strong deletion-biased repair signature and no detectable editing across 33 predicted off-target sites. These compact, high-fidelity nucleases expand the CRISPR targeting space for AAV-deliverable therapeutic editing.

analysis.tldr: 从海量宏基因组数据中挖掘出三种新型紧凑型II-C类Cas9蛋白（Psu/Nsu/GfoCas9），在人类细胞中实现接近甚至超过SpCas9的编辑效率，同时具备更宽泛的PAM识别能力、高保真度（33个预测脱靶位点均未检测到编辑）和AAV可递送尺寸，显著拓展了治疗级CRISPR编辑的靶向范围。

papers.title: Revisiting Open-Loop Execution in Robotics: Toward Reactive, Higher-Performing Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking --- the practice of predicting a sequence of actions and executing a prefix open-loop --- has emerged as a key enabler of recent progress in imitation learning for robotic manipulation. However, executing long open-loop prefixes reduces reactivity, limiting policies' ability to correct for errors. Further, the mechanisms underlying these performance benefits remain poorly understood: prior works cite mitigating compounding errors, absorbing inference latency, or smoothing motions, but provide limited controlled evidence or guidance for preserving reactivity. In this work, we argue that long open-loop execution primarily helps short-context policies imitate "non-Markovian demonstrations". Across four simulation and two real-world tasks, we show that expert non-Markovianity strongly shapes the relationship between task success and open-loop execution horizon. Further, we investigate the impact of compounding errors --- the prevailing explanation for long open-loop execution in prior work --- and find that while they matter, expert non-Markovianity has a much stronger impact in our experimental setting. Finally, we show that when policies are provided with a sufficiently long context, open-loop execution is no longer beneficial and the most reactive, closed-loop policies perform best. While imitation learning has seen great success using long open-loop execution, our findings motivate long-context, reactive policies as a more principled and performant paradigm.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了机器人模仿学习中广泛使用的‘动作分块+开环执行’做法，发现其主要价值在于弥补短上下文策略无法建模专家演示中的非马尔可夫依赖（如依赖历史状态或隐含目标），而非如前人所称的缓解累积误差；实验证明，只要给策略足够长的上下文窗口，闭环策略反而性能更好、反应更强。
analysis.claim: 开环执行在模仿学习中的核心作用是补偿短上下文策略对非马尔可夫专家演示的建模缺陷，而非抑制累积误差；当上下文足够长时，高反应性的闭环策略全面优于开环策略。

analysis.output: 单步动作（闭环）或动作块（开环）

papers.title: RegimeFormer: A Large Protein Model of Global Perturbation Regimes
papers.abstract: Protein language models organize sequence and structure at scale, but a global representation of how proteins respond to mutation remains lacking. We present RegimeFormer, a large protein perturbation model coupled to RegimeAtlas, constructed by harmonizing and indexing 202,556,313 non-redundant protein sequences across the tree of life. A diversity-preserving one-million-protein subset provides the high-resolution training and inference layer, with 995,995 proteins yielding residue-level summaries across 407,048,356 residues and substitution-specific predictions available on demand. Across experimental deep mutational scanning, molecular benchmarks, structural confidence and evolutionary constraint, RegimeFormer identifies reproducible protein-level perturbation regimes that organize residue fragility, adaptability and predictive uncertainty. Regime conditioning improves substitution-specific prediction, with the largest relative gains under unseen-protein, unseen-family and low-homology evaluation. RegimeFormer-derived molecular priors further improve downstream transcriptomic and drug-response modelling. Together, RegimeFormer and RegimeAtlas provide a scalable framework for mapping, predicting and querying protein perturbation landscapes across global sequence space.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RegimeFormer的大蛋白模型，不是预测结构或序列，而是学习蛋白质在全局突变扰动下的响应模式（即‘扰动态’），用2亿多条跨生命树的非冗余蛋白序列训练，能对任意蛋白残基的突变脆弱性、适应性和预测不确定性进行系统性分类，并提升下游转录组和药物响应建模效果。

papers.title: PRACTICE: From Experience to Expertise in Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Recent studies have shown that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can serve as embodied agents, translating language instructions and visual observations into executable plans. However, building agents that can continually improve through interaction and rapidly adapt to their environments remains challenging. Summing up experience from past interaction trajectories provides a promising solution, but existing experience-based methods often rely on manually designed prompting workflows to extract and update skills. Such fixed procedures may struggle to learn updated skills from new and diverse experiences. We introduce PRACTICE, which trains a skill learner to discover and maintain a persistent skill library from past interaction trajectories while keeping the task executor frozen. Given the historical accumulated skills and incoming trajectories, the skill learner produces structured batch-edits that add, refine, merge, or remove skills, and then hierarchical consolidate all collected edits into a consistent updated skill library. We train the learner with a two-stage curriculum. First, it learns basic skill generation and library maintenance from oracle trajectories. Then, by contrasting successful and failed trajectories from heterogeneous executors on the same tasks, it learn to identify invalid action patterns and recovery strategies. Finally, we apply online skill-edit distillation to align the skill learner with a stronger teacher on its current edit distribution to further improves the policy. Experiments demonstrate that a compact skill learner delivers consistent performance improvements across successive library-update rounds for multiple frozen executors. On EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat, PRACTICE further outperforms the strongest experience-based baselines. Project resources are publicly available at: https://baai-agents.github.io/PRACTICE

analysis.tldr: 提出PRACTICE框架，让具身智能体通过自动分析自身历史交互轨迹（成功/失败），动态增删改并整合技能到一个持久化技能库中，从而在不更新任务执行器的前提下持续提升性能。
analysis.claim: 无需微调任务执行器，仅靠一个可训练的技能学习器对历史轨迹进行结构化编辑（添加、精炼、合并、删除技能），即可实现具身智能体的自我演化与跨任务持续提升。

papers.title: Adaptive Vision-Language Grasping via Composable Foundation Priors and Generalizable Grasp Synthesis
papers.abstract: This paper proposes AdaRoboVLG, a task-adaptive Vision-Language-Grasp (VLG) framework that supports generalizable grasp synthesis across different robotic hands. Unlike existing VLG methods that tightly couple foundation models with end-to-end grasp policies, AdaRoboVLG learns an efficient generalizable base policy that generates and evaluates physically feasible grasp candidates through explicit kinematic mapping and force-closure-based stability estimation, while offloading task-dependent understanding to specialized foundation-model modules. These modules provide composable priors that are integrated into the grasp synthesis process, enabling contextually adaptive grasp synthesis without retraining the underlying grasp policy. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we demonstrate that (i) the base policy exhibits efficient learning and strong cross-hand generalization, (ii) the framework effectively incorporates spatial, cognitive, and temporal priors to address three representative grasping challenges without compromising grasp synthesis performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and (iii) these priors can operate jointly to enable functional grasping in cluttered and dynamic environments. These results indicate that decoupling physical grasp synthesis from task-dependent understanding provides a scalable paradigm for robotic grasping, allowing future advances in foundation models to be directly translated into improved grasp capabilities without redesigning or retraining the underlying grasp policy. Supplementary videos are available at https://adarobovlg.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaRoboVLG框架，把抓取动作生成（物理可行性+稳定性评估）和任务理解（视觉-语言）解耦：用一个固定的基础抓取策略生成候选抓取，再用可插拔的多模态基础模型模块提供空间/认知/时间先验来动态调整抓取，无需重训练抓取策略即可适配新任务和新机械手。

papers.title: De novo Rubisco design with protein language models
papers.abstract: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (Rubisco) fixes the majority of carbon dioxide globally but is challenged with low specificity for CO2 versus O2 and low catalytic efficiencies. Traditional engineering efforts have remained difficult because folding, assembly, specificity, and catalysis are tightly coupled, hampering efforts to explore sequence space. Therefore, we leveraged recent advances in protein large language models (PLMs) to generate sequences beyond those observed in nature, using both ProGen-2 that was fine-tuned on a limited dataset of non-Form I Rubiscos and an ESM-2 discriminator. With this approach, we generated 5.6 million novel Rubisco-like sequences and identified 21 highly diverse candidates predicted to be active that occupy regions of Rubisco phylogenetic space not previously observed in nature. Six designs were soluble in Escherichia coli, and five were shown to produce quantifiable 3PGA. One design produced an apparent CO₂/O₂ specificity estimate beyond the range of the natural representative Rubiscos assayed. We also solved the crystal structure of one de novo design that reproduced the predicted dimer and active-site geometry with sub-angstrom Cα agreement. Sequence-only generation followed by independent structural filtering therefore recovered soluble, active Rubiscos from regions of sequence space that are not represented in genomic databases. Together, these results establish a scalable strategy for accessing previously unexplored Rubisco sequence space, providing a broadly accessible path toward generating de novo Rubiscos that may have activity and specificity parameters needed to address longstanding limitations in biological carbon fixation.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型从头设计出21个全新Rubisco序列，其中5个在大肠杆菌中可溶且能催化产生3PGA，1个的CO₂/O₂特异性超过已知天然Rubisco，还解析了其中一个设计蛋白的晶体结构，验证其预测构象高度准确。
analysis.org: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室/加州大学戴维斯分校
analysis.claim: 仅通过蛋白语言模型生成+结构过滤，即可高效探索天然未覆盖的Rubisco序列空间，并获得可溶、有催化活性、甚至特异性超越天然体的从头设计Rubisco。
