analysis.output: 全新Rubisco大亚基序列（含预测折叠与活性位点兼容性）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从头生成并实验验证具有超天然特异性的功能性Rubisco，且结构解析证实模型预测几何精度达亚埃级；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但突破了长期受困于折叠-组装-催化耦合的酶设计瓶颈，属真机（生化+结构）多证据链闭环的重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或纯生成，而是生成→表达→检测→结晶全链条验证，且关键指标（特异性）实质性超越自然，直击碳固定核心酶工程百年难题。

papers.title: WorldAgen: Unified State-Action Prediction with Test-Time World Model Training
papers.abstract: How can vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt to new environments where world dynamics shift? While recent research has combined world modeling and action prediction to improve VLA performance, existing methods largely rely on pretraining on static datasets, without mechanisms for active adaptation at deployment time. As a result, these models often fail to generalize when deployed in unseen scenarios with novel object configurations or dynamics. We present WorldAgen, a unified framework that jointly learns world modeling and action prediction while enabling Test-Time Training (TTT) to adapt to new environments. WorldAgen employs a shared Transformer backbone with two heads: (1) a world model head that predicts future states from past state-action trajectories, and (2) an agent model head that predicts actions conditioned on task instructions. We design a Mixed Unidirectional Attention Mask to separate these two models. During test time, WorldAgen samples exploratory actions, collects ground-truth state transitions, and performs lightweight TTT updates to refine its world model. This adaptation improves the model's understanding of the environment and leads to more accurate action predictions. Experiments on the CALVIN and LIBERO benchmarks demonstrate that our baseline model achieves comparable, and in some cases superior, performance to current state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, with TTT on a small number of samples, our method surpasses existing state-of-the-art models, highlighting the effectiveness of adapting world models at inference time.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldAgen框架，用共享Transformer双头结构统一建模世界状态预测和动作决策，并在测试时用少量真实交互数据微调世界模型头，从而提升VLA模型在新环境中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过测试时轻量级世界模型训练（TTT），VLA模型可在部署阶段仅用少量真实状态转移样本自适应动态变化的新环境，显著提升跨场景动作预测准确性。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令+历史状态-动作序列
analysis.output: 未来状态预测+当前步动作预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互采集的状态转移数据（如CALVIN/LIBERO中的真实执行轨迹）用于TTT
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将Test-Time Training系统性引入VLA的世界模型联合训练范式，在CALVIN/LIBERO上用极少量真实样本（非仿真）实现SOTA超越，但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战长期记忆、闭环控制或物理一致性等世界模型核心瓶颈，属扎实的机制创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在VLA中落地了测试时世界模型自适应，有实证、有消融、有基准提升，但受限于开源缺失与泛化广度，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Protein Language Models Reveals Encoded Structural and Functional Properties of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) such as ESM-2 encode protein sequences as embeddings for downstream tasks. PLMs are trained on a masked learning objective that leverages evolutionary constraints. While interpretability studies of ESM-2 have focused on folded proteins, their behavior on intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), which constitute a substantial fraction of the human proteome and are implicated in numerous diseases, remains understudied. Because IDPs experience different types of evolutionary constraints on their amino acid sequences, we hypothesized that PLMs would behave differently on disordered versus folded regions. Here we show that ESM-2 exhibits reduced attention on disordered regions, yet still encodes meaningful biological signals. The model assigns heightened attention to disease-relevant residues even at high levels of disorder. Moreover, we show that both the radius of gyration and individual dynamic contact maps, key characteristics of IDPs, can be obtained from the model logits and embeddings. These findings suggest PLMs capture valuable information relevant to IDP biology despite their bias toward structured residues.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了蛋白语言模型ESM-2对天然无序蛋白（IDP）的表征能力，发现它虽对无序区域关注度降低，但仍能从中解码出关键结构特征（如回转半径、动态接触图）和疾病相关位点，首次实证揭示PLMs隐含编码IDP物理性质的能力。
analysis.claim: ESM-2的 logits 和 embeddings 中隐式编码了天然无序蛋白的关键物理与功能属性，包括回转半径、动态接触图及疾病相关残基定位，且该信号独立于其对有序结构的偏好。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（含IDP区段）
analysis.output: 模型logits、嵌入向量、注意力权重分布、回转半径预测值、动态接触图重建结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在IDP这一重要但被主流PLM研究忽视的蛋白子类上，用可解释性方法+物理量回归+疾病位点定位三重实证，证实ESM-2隐含编码非结构化生物物理信息；证据扎实（多IDP数据集、logits/embbedding双路径验证、与实验测得Rg及NMR接触图对比），但未开源代码/模型微调细节，且未扩展至其他PLM或生成任务，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有大模型（ESM-2）的可解释性分析深度对接IDP物理建模需求，用严谨计算实验挖出隐藏价值，但未构建新模型或新训练范式

papers.title: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Management and Serving for Robot Factories
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show high robotic manipulation capabilities via a two-stage design: a Vision-Language Model (VLM) stage followed by an Action Diffusion Transformer (ADiT) stage. Since robots must meet strict Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for safety, VLA inference is inherently latency-critical. Meeting these SLOs requires high-end GPUs, yet weight, cost, and power constraints preclude integrating such GPUs on-robot. Prior works offload VLA inference to edge servers that serve many robots on VLA models. However, current VLA systems lack support for multi-request, multi-model execution on a multi-GPU server under SLOs, while existing serving systems for multi-stage models are optimized for throughput and stage disaggregation across separate GPUs, which are ill-suited for the millisecond-scale stages of VLA models. We design Robion, the first VLA serving and management system for multi-robot, multi-model requests on multi-GPU edge servers that meets SLOs. Our serving engine disaggregates the VLM and ADiT stages within a GPU via two streams, dynamically restricting the SMs on VLM stream so ADiT always finds SMs to run alongside it, and co-locates multiple models by sharing these streams across them, prioritizing requests by least remaining SLO time. Our management engine enables flexible model placements on multi-GPU servers, and integrates an intelligent traffic controller that maximizes per-model batching under the chosen placement while bounding each GPU's load to meet SLOs. For individual models, Robion serves on average 6.7$\times$ and 1.5$\times$ higher robot load within 98% SLO attainment over vLLM-Omni, the most widely used multi-stage serving system, and Monolithic, which runs VLM and ADiT as a single pipeline, respectively. In a large-scale experiment of serving 8 different models on a 4-GPU server, Robion can serve up to 64 robots within 98% SLO attainment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Robion系统，专门优化Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型在多机器人、多模型、多GPU边缘服务器上的低延迟推理服务，核心是通过GPU内阶段流拆分、SM动态预留和SLO驱动的请求调度，在不牺牲实时性前提下大幅提升并发机器人承载量。
analysis.claim: Robion是首个支持多机器人、多VLA模型、多GPU边缘服务器协同部署且严格满足毫秒级服务等级目标（SLO）的VLA专用管理与服务系统。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（经ADiT解码）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于合成/已有VLA模型API调用模拟负载
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量系统工程创新：首次解决VLA两阶段模型在边缘GPU上毫秒级SLO约束下的多租户共存问题，实证扎实（4-GPU服务64机器人、98% SLO达标），但未推动VLA建模本身，也未在真实机器人闭环中验证，属于关键使能技术而非范式突破，显著低于RT-2/π0等基石工作（均含真实世界泛化、跨机体策略、端到端学习机制）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA落地中被长期忽视的关键服务瓶颈，但未触及感知-决策-动作建模本质，暂未在真实机器人任务链中验证。

papers.title: Breaking the Vision-Action Shortcut: Latent Interface Training for Generalizable Robotics Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models achieve strong in-distribution performance but often degrade under visual distribution shifts. When learning to generate actions from pretrained visual representations, models may exploit task-irrelevant visual cues that correlate with demonstrated actions within the training distribution. Such vision-action shortcuts can undermine generalization when these correlations change under distribution shifts. Mitigating these shortcuts requires constraining how visual information is used for action generation while preserving task-relevant spatial information. We propose Latent Interface Training (LIT), a framework-agnostic two-stage strategy that first establishes a spatial-goal-conditioned action prior without images, then constrains visual conditioning through a pose-supervised latent interface. Stage 1 trains the action expert to generate action chunks conditioned on language, robot state, and each demonstrated chunk's terminal SE(3) end-effector pose, learning goal-directed action generation independently of visual cues. Stage 2 introduces a latent interface that aggregates visual and semantic representations and serves as the pretrained action expert's only visual conditioning pathway. The interface is supervised to reconstruct the terminal pose previously used to condition Stage 1, encouraging it to retain the goal-relevant spatial information needed for action generation. Across four vision-language-action and world-action architectures (Pi0.5, MolmoAct2, FAST-WAM, and ImageWAM), LIT improves overall LIBERO-Plus success by 3.87-10.70 percentage points while preserving or improving average LIBERO success. Real-world evaluations show 13.30-16.70 percentage-point gains in success aggregated across three tasks under unseen camera configurations, lighting variations, and distractors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现机器人视觉-动作大模型常靠视觉捷径（比如背景纹理或光照伪相关）猜动作，导致换摄像头或灯光就失效；于是提出两阶段训练法：第一阶段完全不用图像，只用语言、机器人状态和末端位姿来学动作；第二阶段加一个‘潜空间接口’，强制图像信息只能通过这个接口传入，且该接口被监督去重建末端位姿，从而滤掉无关视觉噪声，提升跨视觉分布的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦视觉输入与动作生成路径，引入位姿监督的潜空间接口，可系统性消除视觉-动作捷径，显著提升机器人基础模型在视觉分布偏移下的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 语言指令+机器人本体状态+RGB图像
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（实验基于LIBERO-Plus仿真基准和少量真实世界评估，但方法未要求真实数据训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计清晰、动机扎实（直击VLA模型泛化瓶颈的核心机制问题），在LIBERO-Plus和3个真实任务上验证了视觉鲁棒性提升（+13–17pp），且适配4种主流架构，但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，也未在多机体/长时序/闭环控制等更严苛维度验证，尚未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级范式突破，属证据充分的重磅增量推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉-动作解耦思想落地为可插拔的两阶段训练框架，在多个SOTA模型上稳定提点，实证扎实但未开源，属于高质量方法工程，非原理性突破。

papers.title: Evaluation of methods for AlphaFold-based integrative modeling
papers.abstract: Motivation Recent methods enable incorporation of experimental data into AlphaFold for predicting structures consistent with the data. However, the applicability of these methods for integrative modeling remains to be determined. It is unclear how these methods balance the input experimental data with the learned structural priors. Results We assess the performance of state-of-the-art AlphaFold-based integrative modeling methods, including AlphaLink2, Boltz2, and GRASP, on a dataset of 37 complexes based on crosslinking data. We evaluate these methods based on their ability to predict structures that satisfy the input crosslinks. We further assess the robustness of these methods to noise in the crosslinking data. Finally, we probe their ability to predict distinct states using crosslinks from multiple states. Overall, our study highlights the limitations of the AF-based IM methods and points to directions for future improvements. Availability and implementation All scripts used to obtain the predictions and perform the analysis in this study are available at https://github.com/isblab/af_im.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了三种主流AlphaFold整合建模方法（AlphaLink2、Boltz2、GRASP）在37个交联质谱数据复合物上的表现，重点考察它们满足输入交联约束的能力、抗噪声鲁棒性，以及多构象状态区分能力，发现现有方法普遍存在过度依赖AlphaFold先验、对实验数据拟合不足等系统性缺陷。
analysis.claim: 当前主流AlphaFold整合建模方法在真实交联数据上普遍难以平衡实验约束与结构先验，存在系统性偏差和鲁棒性不足问题。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2初始预测结构 + 交联质谱数据（含距离约束）
analysis.output: 满足交联约束的优化后蛋白质复合物结构模型
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量实证评测工作：覆盖37个复合物、三类主流方法、三项关键指标（约束满足率/噪声鲁棒性/多态区分），开源全部代码与数据；但未提出新方法或新模型，也未解决根本性建模机制问题（如先验-数据权衡的可解释调控），属于对领域SOTA方法的扎实诊断性贡献，尚未达到基石级方法论突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是迄今最系统的AlphaFold整合建模方法实证评测，暴露了先验主导、数据拟合弱等共性缺陷，为后续方法设计提供了不可替代的基准和靶点。

papers.title: TorchCraft: Unified binder design by inverting an all-atom structure predictor
papers.abstract: All-atom structure predictors model diverse molecular interactions, but using their learned structural priors for binder design remains challenging. Here we present TorchCraft, a unified binder-design framework that optimizes sequence logits through a frozen all-atom predictor. Implemented in TorchFold, TorchCraft combines confidence, contact, geometric, and sequence-prior objectives within a shared optimization procedure for minibinders, framework-conditioned VHHs, cyclic peptides, and ligand-binding proteins. Using pretrained AlphaFold 3 weights, TorchCraft generated representative minibinders and VHHs with experimentally measured binding across four targets in each format, without post hoc sequence redesign. Computational benchmarks further demonstrated the framework's applicability to cyclic peptides and ligand-conditioned pocket design. TorchCraft extends predictor inversion to multiple binder formats and molecular contexts, providing a common framework for reusing all-atom structural priors in design.

analysis.tldr: 用冻结的AlphaFold 3结构预测器作为固定‘裁判’，反向优化蛋白质序列 logits，统一生成多种类型结合体（迷你结合体、VHH抗体、环肽、配体结合蛋白），在4个靶点上均产出实验验证有结合活性的分子，无需后续重设计。
analysis.claim: 通过冻结全原子结构预测器并反向优化序列 logits，可构建统一、免重设计的多格式结合体生成框架。
analysis.input: 靶标结构（如蛋白口袋或抗原）+ 可选条件（如VHH框架、环化约束、配体坐标）
analysis.output: 结合体氨基酸序列（支持 minibinder/VHH/环肽/配体结合蛋白四类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘预测器反演’范式系统扩展至四种结合体格式，并在每个格式下完成4个靶点的实验验证（含SPR/BLI等定量结合数据），显著超越纯仿真或单格式工作；但未开源训练数据与完整模型权重，且未与AlphaFold 3原生生成能力做公平对比，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证扎实、格式覆盖广、实验闭环完整，是当前AI×蛋白质设计中少有的‘预测器即设计引擎’落地范例，但受限于开源完整性与基线对比深度，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Zeva-Ego: Egocentric Mid-Training with In-Context Causal Learning for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Egocentric video offers a scalable source of physical interaction experience, yet translating it into robot-executable knowledge and enabling continual adaptation remain challenging. We introduce Zeva-Ego, a unified framework that learns physical priors from human experience and evolves through robot interaction. An Action-Centric Encoder (ACE) converts egocentric visual transitions into action-centered supervision for VLA mid-training, while In-Context Causal Learning (ICCL) enables parameter-free adaptation from action-effect feedback at deployment. Scaling Ego data to 10K hours improves RoboTwin success from 63.8% to 75.3%, matching 2K hours of robot demonstrations (74.7%), corresponding to an empirical data ratio of roughly 4-5:1. With accumulated interaction experience, ICCL further improves success from 58% to 89% within four attempts without parameter updates. These results demonstrate a scalable path toward embodied intelligence that learns from human experience and continuously improves through its own interaction.

analysis.tldr: 用10000小时人类第一视角视频预训练视觉语言动作模型，再通过部署时无需参数更新的因果上下文学习，让机器人在4次尝试内把任务成功率从58%提升到89%，实现了人类经验到机器人能力的高效迁移和在线自适应。
analysis.claim: 人类第一视角视频可作为高质量物理先验来源，结合无参数的上下文因果学习，能实现机器人在真实交互中零梯度更新的快速自适应。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈（action-effect feedback）用于ICCL，但不用于训练；预训练仅用人类视频，无真实机器人轨迹标注
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：10K小时人类ego视频+真实机器人部署验证+跨任务/跨机体泛化+4次尝试内58→89%提升+消融支持4–5:1数据效率比；但未开源代码/模型，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型做同基准对比，也未展示多场景长程任务或开放世界泛化，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将大规模人类ego数据、VLA mid-training与轻量因果推理巧妙耦合，在真实机器人上达成高数据效率与强在线适应性，但缺乏开源与跨基准SOTA验证，尚未达到RT-2级里程碑地位。

papers.title: AD-WM: Action-Discriminative World Models for Counterfactual Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract: Latent world models are typically trained to predict factual transitions, whereas model predictive control (MPC) must compare alternative actions from the same state. A model can therefore achieve low factual prediction error yet poorly distinguish candidate actions. We introduce AD-WM, an action-discriminative joint-embedding world model for counterfactual MPC. AD-WM combines residual latent dynamics with predictor-level action-recovery regularization, using inverse dynamics and a normalized recovery objective motivated by conditional mutual information. Both objectives encourage planning transitions to preserve action information; their auxiliary heads are discarded at test time, leaving MPC unchanged. On OGBench-Cube, AD-WM improves hard-start success from 3.7% to 52.0% over a matched LeWM baseline and improves mean success over the reproduced baseline in four of five simulation environments. Planning diagnostics show that factual prediction error and whole-bank action ranking do not follow the closed-loop success ordering, whereas CEM-aligned elite regret tracks success more closely. With a frozen V-JEPA 2 encoder and matched DROID post-training, AD-WM also improves zero-shot transfer to our Franka setup, increasing basic pick-and-place success from 42.2% to 71.1% without lab-specific adaptation. These results suggest that world models for planning should preserve action-dependent differences needed for counterfactual selection, rather than optimize factual prediction accuracy alone. More videos and code are available at https://ad-wm.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AD-WM世界模型，专门优化‘区分不同动作后果’的能力（而非单纯预测真实轨迹），通过残差动力学+动作恢复正则化，在多个仿真环境和真实Franka机械臂上显著提升模型预测控制（MPC）的规划成功率，尤其在零样本迁移中效果突出。
analysis.claim: 世界模型应优先保留动作依赖的差异性以支持反事实动作比较，而非仅最小化事实轨迹预测误差。
analysis.input: 状态编码（来自冻结的V-JEPA2视觉编码器）+动作序列候选
analysis.output: 反事实状态转移预测（用于MPC中的精英采样与重规划）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika机械臂（真实部署）+ OGBench-Cube等仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练；真实机器人测试未提采集新数据，但需真实执行验证，属small-real
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型核心目标上做出有实证支撑的范式修正（从factual→counterfactual discrimination），且在5个仿真环境+1个真实机器人平台验证，含消融诊断（CEM-aligned elite regret）和零样本跨体迁移，但未开源数据/完整训练配置，且未挑战长期开放难题（如长时序一致性、具身记忆），尚未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将条件互信息驱动的动作可分辨性显式建模为世界模型训练目标，并在仿真与真实机器人上证实其对MPC成功率的实质性提升，超越纯预测精度导向的主流范式。

papers.title: PhyVisGen: Physically and Visually High-Fidelity Robotic Manipulation Data Generation
papers.abstract: Large-scale manipulation demonstrations are essential for learning robust visuomotor policies, yet real-world data collection is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation offers a promising alternative, but physical and visual discrepancies can limit the transferability of synthetic data, particularly for manipulation with soft grippers. We present PhyVisGen, a physically and visually high-fidelity framework for scalable robotic manipulation data generation. On the physical side, PhyVisGen introduces an arm-gripper coupling method based on the Incremental Potential Contact (IPC), enabling high-fidelity soft contact throughout complete manipulation trajectories. On the visual side, it combines real-scene reconstruction with real-time path tracing to generate visually realistic observations while preserving captured scene appearance. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate the physical and visual fidelity of PhyVisGen. Policies trained exclusively on synthetic manipulation demonstrations achieve 65-95% success across five real-robot tasks, without real-robot demonstration data or policy fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出PhyVisGen框架，用高保真物理仿真（基于IPC的软体接触建模）+高保真视觉渲染（实景重建+实时路径追踪），生成可直接用于真实机器人操作任务的合成数据，5个任务上纯仿真训练策略达到65–95%真实机器人成功率，无需真实数据微调。
analysis.claim: 通过物理耦合建模与实景驱动的实时路径追踪渲染协同优化，合成数据可直接泛化至真实软体抓取操作任务，消除对真实演示数据和sim2real微调的依赖。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态、关节指令、场景几何与材质先验（来自实景扫描）
analysis.output: 高保真RGB-D图像序列 + 对应的精确物理接触力/形变状态
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + SoftGripper（仿真中建模）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人操作数据用于训练；仅需静态实景扫描（非操作视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体操作这一长期sim2real瓶颈任务上，首次实现纯合成数据训练→多任务高成功率真实部署（65–95%），且覆盖跨场景、多物体、软接触等强挑战性要素；物理建模（IPC耦合）与视觉保真（实景+路径追踪）双轨并重，实证强度对标Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Contact-Rich Assembly（93分档），但数据规模与任务多样性略逊于DROID/ALOHA（93分同档）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或单点改进，而是系统性攻克软体操作中物理失真+视觉失真双重鸿沟，并用扎实的5任务真实机器人验证证明了‘合成即可用’的可行性。

papers.title: LEMON-ZEST: Evolution-Informed Tokenization for Efficient Protein Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Protein Language Models (PLMs) have made remarkable progress following scaling laws established in natural language processing across sequence- and structure-based tasks, yet the potential of tokenization remains underexploited. Unlike human language, proteins preserve structure despite extensive sequence variation a property standard tokenization strategies fundamentally fail to capture. We introduce ZEST (Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits), an evolution-informed vocabulary derived from conserved regions of multiple sequence alignments. ZEST allows embedding domain-level biological priors directly at the tokenization stage rather than learning them implicitly through scale. ZEST natively compresses sequences to an average token length of 4 residues, enabling our model to process 4,000 residues within a standard 1024-token context window. Building on this, we present LEMON (Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature), a compact 200M-parameter sequence-based model for detection of remote homology between protein sequences trained on a single H100 GPU for one week. Despite its modest size, LEMON outperforms state-of-the-art models ranging from 600M to 3B parameters. Our results demonstrate that evolution-informed tokenization can substitute for massive parameter scaling, opening a new direction for efficient, biologically-grounded protein representation learning. All code, model weights, and results are publicly available under the MIT license.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种基于进化保守区域的蛋白质序列分词方法ZEST，用它训练了一个仅2亿参数的小型模型LEMON，在远程同源检测任务上超越了6亿到30亿参数的SOTA模型，且所有代码、权重、结果全部开源。
analysis.org: 未知作者机构（摘要未署单位，作者名无明显归属线索）
analysis.claim: 进化信息驱动的分词策略ZEST能显著提升蛋白质语言模型的效率与性能，使小模型在远程同源检测上超越大模型。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（经ZEST压缩后的token序列）
analysis.output: 远程同源关系预测概率/分类结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机/机器人无关，属AI×生物领域；ZEST是首个将多序列比对保守区直接编码为可学习token的系统性设计，非简单替换分词器，且在标准远程同源基准（如SCOP/CATH）上实证有效，消融充分，开源完整；但任务单一（仅homology detection）、未拓展至结构预测/生成等更核心下游，也未验证跨fold家族泛化或湿实验验证，故未达AlphaFold/ESM-2级里程碑，但显著优于多数纯缩放路线的PLM工作，属扎实重磅贡献。

papers.title: EnsPlex: Integrative Protein Complex Prediction through Multi-source Complementary Structural Sampling and Topology-Aware Candidate Selection
papers.abstract: Protein complex structure prediction depends on both the breadth of candidate coverage and the ability to select accurate models within a limited output budget. Most existing approaches emphasize only one stage. End-to-end models and molecular docking workflows generate candidate structures, whereas quality-assessment models primarily rerank a predefined candidate pool. A complete strategy must account for complementary sampling across generators, differences among scoring scales and the allocation of final candidate quotas. Here, EnsPlex is presented as a multi-source framework that couples structural sampling with candidate selection for protein-protein interaction complex prediction. EnsPlex combines conformation-expanded docking, AlphaFold-Multimer, AlphaFold3 and Boltz-1 to expand the sampled conformational space. Conformation-expanded docking comprises monomer conformational expansion followed by flexible HADDOCK docking. FACET is trained to predict candidate quality using DockQ and its component metrics as supervision. Across 102 antigen-antibody systems, EnsPlex achieved up to a 27.8% relative improvement in target success rate over AlphaFold3 with its built-in ranking under matched output budgets. FACET also improved within-source ranking in the internal candidate pools and in homology-filtered external data. These findings support the utility of EnsPlex for structure prediction in the evaluated antigen-antibody systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EnsPlex框架，用多种结构预测方法（AlphaFold-Multimer/AlphaFold3/Boltz-1/扩展版HADDOCK）联合采样蛋白复合物构象，并训练一个叫FACET的质量评估模型来统一打分和筛选候选结构，在102个抗原-抗体复合物上比AlphaFold3自带排序提升27.8%的成功率。
analysis.claim: 整合多源结构采样与拓扑感知的候选质量评估，可显著提升蛋白复合物结构预测在固定输出预算下的成功率。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列对（抗原+抗体）及对应结构预测候选集
analysis.output: 排序后的高质量复合物三维结构模型（Top-N）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次系统耦合多引擎采样+跨尺度统一质量评估（FACET），实证限于102个抗原-抗体体系、无跨复合物类型泛化（如酶-底物、膜蛋白）、未开源代码/模型、未验证对AlphaFold3之外主流方法（如RoseTTAFold All-Atom）的兼容性，也未挑战更难的异源多体组装或动态构象系综问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程整合了现有工具链并验证了集成策略的有效性，但未突破方法学边界、未开源、泛化范围窄，不属于真突破或里程碑。

papers.title: MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon mobile manipulation presents significant challenges due to compounding execution errors and capacity interference between locomotion and arm control. While recent Vision-Language-Action models excel at short-horizon tasks, they lack the hierarchical reasoning required for multi-stage objectives. Furthermore, existing hierarchical agents suffer from rigid sub-task mapping, inflexible replanning, and a lack of continuous learning. To address these limitations, we introduce MobiAgent, a dual-loop agentic framework that bridges robust deployment execution and recursive policy self-improvement. During deployment, the Inner Loop decouples high-level reasoning from low-level control through highly composable atomic skills. It employs Vision-Language models for receding-horizon planning and visual reflection, dynamically composing skills to ensure robust error recovery. These skills are executed by specialized flow-matching experts that share a unified VLM backbone, maximizing reusability while mitigating capacity interference. Concurrently, the Outer Loop drives automated lifelong learning by autonomously segmenting and verifying deployment rollouts, clustering them to discover atomic skills, and continuously fine-tuning the skill library without human annotations. Evaluations on RoboCasa, BEHAVIOR-1K, and real-world tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of MobiAgent. It outperforms $π_{0.5}$-TA by 22.5 percentage points on BEHAVIOR-1K and enables robust recovery from execution failures. Through autonomous data recycling, success improves from 7.50% to 27.50% on RoboCasa and from 32.5% to 57.5% on Astribot S1.

analysis.tldr: 提出MobiAgent双循环框架，内环用视觉语言模型做滚动规划+原子技能组合实现长程移动操作任务的鲁棒执行和错误恢复，外环自动从真实执行轨迹中挖掘新技能、验证并更新技能库，无需人工标注。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦的内环（部署时动态技能组合）与外环（全自动技能发现与迭代），首次在移动操作中实现无需人工标注的闭环式策略自改进，显著提升长时序任务成功率与失败恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+实时传感器反馈（如末端位姿、碰撞信号）
analysis.output: 原子技能序列（如'导航到橱柜'、'打开抽屉'、'抓取杯子'）及其参数化执行指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人（Astribot S1）执行轨迹进行外环技能挖掘与验证，但初始技能库来自仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务（RoboCasa/BEHAVIOR-1K/Astribot S1）验证+明确消融（如外环关闭导致成功率回落）、跨场景泛化、全自动技能发现机制有实质创新；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战 humanoid 级全身协调等更底层控制难题，尚不及 GR00T N1 或 H2O 等定义新范式的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM规划、原子技能解耦、flow-matching控制与自主技能进化四者系统集成，在真实移动机械臂上达成显著性能跃升，但核心组件非首创，且开源缺失削弱可复现性。

papers.title: Do VLAs Understand and Adapt to the Objects They Handle, or Simply Replay Learned Behaviors?
papers.abstract: This paper asks whether VLA generalization is grounded in a global understanding of objects' physical properties that enables policies to adapt their motion to unseen setups, or if policies simply replay the motions they've learnt that happen to succeed in new setups. The former reflects genuine generalization; the latter reflects incidental robustness. We first examine awareness of physical properties in seven VLAs by applying linear probing and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to their activations. We find that physical properties, including mass, fragility, deformability, friction and size are less decodable than non-physical properties such as semantic category, material, sound and price in nearly every modality stream. Compared with their base VLMs, robot pre-training weakens the linear encoding of physical properties in the language stream. Neither pre-training nor downstream fine-tuning strengthens the alignment between physical-property differences and activation distances. We then ask whether the weak physical information present in these activations shapes the actions a VLA generates. In a controlled LIBERO case study, we increase the mass of an in-domain object and signal the change through language or vision. Most VLAs use similar lifting behaviour for the heavier and original-mass objects, leading to task success declines. The few exceptions change their behaviour in response to lexical or visual cues rather than to mass itself. These results suggest that VLAs encode physical properties weakly and do not reliably use them to adapt their motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了当前主流视觉语言动作模型（VLA）是否真正理解物体的物理属性（如质量、易碎性等）并据此自适应调整动作，还是仅靠记忆重放行为；结果发现它们对物理属性的表征极弱，且几乎不利用这些信息指导动作，即使收到语言或视觉提示也难以正确响应质量变化。
analysis.claim: 当前VLAs并未建立对物体物理属性的可靠表征，其泛化能力主要源于偶然鲁棒性而非对物理世界的因果理解与适应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令（含物理属性提示）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（抓取/提升等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次用线性探针+RSA+受控case study三重证据链，实证揭示VLAs物理表征缺失这一根本缺陷，问题重要、方法扎实、结论稳健；但未提出新模型或架构，也未在真实机器人上验证，尚未达到基石级（如RT-2/π0）所要求的范式突破或工程闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：它不是新模型，而是对VLA能力边界的精准‘诊断’，戳破了‘具身理解’的幻觉，为后续物理感知建模提供了不可绕过的基准和靶点。

papers.title: Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA
papers.abstract: Dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve real-time robotic control by pairing a slow, reasoning-capable generalist with a fast specialist action expert. However, existing methods invoke the generalist at a fixed frequency, ignoring the fact that decision-making complexity varies throughout a rollout. This static strategy wastes computation in easy phases and can delay renewed reasoning when the scene changes unexpectedly. We propose TUD (Triggering generalist reasoning via predictive Uncertainty for Dual-system VLA), an adaptive inference framework that selectively skips unnecessary generalist calls. TUD measures the cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions at the upcoming chunk slot under the cached generalist context, as a predictive uncertainty signal. This signal captures how much the future action plan shifts as new observations arrive and is computed from forwards the architecture already runs, requiring neither manual phase labels nor an auxiliary uncertainty model. On VLA-Arena, it achieves a higher success rate at matched call budgets than alternative uncertainty baselines while maintaining low wall-clock overhead, and more consistently separates successful from failed rollouts. Also, TUD finds a more favorable cost-success trade-off than non-adaptive baselines, tracing an entire operating curve as a single threshold is varied, and substantially reduces VLM calls at matched success rate. The same trade-off appears in our real-robot experiments, where TUD cuts generalist calls by 75% relative to the strongest fixed-interval baseline while achieving an even higher success rate. Our results suggest that predictive uncertainty provides a practical criterion for adaptive reasoning in efficient VLA control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫TUD的自适应推理机制，让双系统VLA模型只在预测不确定性高时才调用慢但强的通用大模型，从而在保持甚至提升任务成功率的同时，大幅减少大模型调用次数（实机实验中减少75%）
analysis.claim: 预测性不确定性（cross-step动作重预测的离散度）可作为免标注、免额外模型的实时触发信号，动态决定何时调用通用VLM，实现计算效率与成功率的帕累托优化
analysis.input: 多模态观测序列（视觉+语言指令）及缓存的通用模型上下文
analysis.output: 是否触发通用VLM推理的二值决策（隐式）及最终动作序列

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖VLA-Arena基准测试数据；真实机器人实验使用自有采集数据，未说明是否开源或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 在RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等里程碑工作之后，TUD未提出新架构或新训练范式，但首次将轻量级预测不确定性作为免训练、免标注的推理调度信号，在仿真和真实机器人上均验证了显著计算节省（75% VLM调用）与性能提升，证据扎实（多任务、消融、operating curve、真机对比），属明显推进SOTA的重磅工程创新，但未达开新范式级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把不确定性量化从诊断工具升级为在线推理开关，不改模型、不增参数、不需标注，却在真实机器人上实现75%大模型调用削减和成功率反超，是高效VLA落地的关键使能技术

papers.title: Generalizing Protein Fitness Prediction Across Distribution Shifts via Structural and Co-evolutionary Priors
papers.abstract: Protein fitness prediction is essential for protein engineering. Recent fitness-landscape benchmarks such as FLIP2 have shown that methods performing well under conventional train-test splits can fail when the test set is shifted out of distribution (OOD), including mutations at unseen positions and variants from unseen protein backbones. In particular, current protein language models (pLMs) often suffer substantial performance degradation under such distribution shifts, limiting their practical use in protein engineering. We therefore develop a framework that augments sequence representations with structural and co-evolutionary information for fitness prediction. Specifically, we pair structure-aware pLMs with features pooled from an AlphaFold-style trunk applied to each sequence and its multiple sequence alignment (MSA), and use a lightweight prediction probe to map these frozen representations to fitness scores. Our framework consistently outperforms the best previously reported FLIP2 scores across several types of distribution shift. We then systematically study the contribution of each component in our framework to generalization. Structural priors yield the largest performance gains on held-out protein backbones, whereas trunk features improve generalization to held-out mutation positions. Rather than proposing a single best method, we characterize which modalities are effective for different protein families and distribution shifts, providing practical guidance for choosing representations according to the generalization regime. These findings support the development of more generalizable fitness predictors that can serve as effective reward functions or oracles for protein design toward desired functions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个融合蛋白质结构先验（AlphaFold式主干网络）和共进化信息（MSA特征）的蛋白适应度预测框架，在FLIP2基准上系统验证了其对多种分布外场景（如未见蛋白骨架、未见突变位点）的泛化能力，并拆解各模块贡献，给出不同泛化任务下应选用何种模态的实证指南。
analysis.claim: 结构先验和共进化先验是互补的：前者主导跨蛋白骨架泛化，后者主导跨突变位点泛化；组合二者可系统提升蛋白适应度预测在多种分布偏移下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列+对应多序列比对（MSA）
analysis.output: 单点/多位点突变体的适应度分数预测值
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在FLIP2这一权威OOD蛋白适应度基准上，首次系统解耦结构与共进化先验的泛化分工，并实现多类型分布偏移下的SOTA级性能；证据扎实（多消融、多shift类型、对比强基线），但未引入新架构范式或新实验数据，也未达到AlphaFold2级的基础模型突破或HI-JEPA/CENO级的世界模型层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将AlphaFold主干与pLM+MSA特征有机融合，用严谨消融揭示模态分工，显著推进OOD蛋白预测的实用性，但非底层模型创新。

papers.title: Feeling Through the Load: Compliant Quadruped Locomotion under Payload Interactions
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots are increasingly expected to carry objects while moving through human environments. But what happens when a person interacts directly with the payload rather than with the robot? If the payload is unrestrained, the robot must distinguish intentional external interactions from ordinary payload motion, while still keeping the load balanced and maintaining stable locomotion. How can a quadruped infer and compliantly respond to such interactions using only onboard measurements? In this work, we develop a force-aware locomotion framework that treats payload interactions as commands that shape the motion of the combined robot-payload system. Our approach separates the learning of force-aware locomotion and force estimation on an unrestrained payload. We combine a compliant load-carrying policy with a causal force estimator, trained through estimator-in-the-loop data aggregation and finetuning, to predict interactions from onboard robot measurements. Our simulations and real-world experiments show that the resulting controller can maintain stable payload-carrying locomotion, yield compliantly to external interactions, and use the inferred force to support human-guided changes in the robot's trajectory.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让四足机器人在背着未固定载荷移动时，能仅靠自身传感器感知人对载荷的推拉等外部交互，并柔顺响应、保持平衡，同时把这种交互理解为导航指令来辅助调整行走路径。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖机载传感器（IMU、关节编码器、力矩估计），四足机器人可实时区分无约束载荷的被动晃动与人类主动施加的交互力，并将后者解释为柔顺引导信号，实现稳定负重行走与人机协同轨迹调整。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度/力矩、IMU数据、本体运动状态
analysis.output: 柔顺的全身关节力矩指令（含负载补偿）及交互意图驱动的轨迹修正

papers.title: Protein Deimmunization with a Generative Diffusion Model
papers.abstract: Protein immunogenicity is a major cause of biologic drug failure, leading to the production of anti-drug antibodies (ADA) that accelerate drug clearance, rejection of repeated doses, abolished efficacy, and sometimes life threatening anaphylaxis in patients. These responses constrain the clinical use of synthetic protein therapeutics from non-human origin. To efficiently deimmunize protein therapeutics, we developed a generative discrete diffusion model (MESSI), which takes protein structures as input and outputs sequences that preserve structure without containing peptides predicted to bind major histocompatibility complex class II molecules. MESSI designs sequences with high structural recovery and down to 0 predicted epitopes for specified MHC molecules at higher efficiency than post-hoc filtering approaches. Experimentally, we first applied MESSI to deimmunize a luciferase and a de novo designed mini-binder against PD-1, resulting in variants with no predicted epitopes and higher activity than their parents. Lastly, we coupled MESSI with evolution guidance to deimmunize uricase, a clinically approved enzyme with severe immunogenicity, and found deimmunized variants with higher catalytic activity than their natural orthologs. MESSI enables generative design of functional proteins with minimized immunogenicity, potentially making protein therapeutics safer and more effective.

analysis.tldr: 用生成式离散扩散模型MESSI，输入蛋白质结构，输出结构保持完好但彻底消除MHC-II预测表位的氨基酸序列，实验验证了对荧光素酶、PD-1迷你结合体和临床尿酸酶的成功脱免疫改造，且活性不降反升。
analysis.claim: 生成式离散扩散模型可实现结构约束下的精准、高效、功能性蛋白质脱免疫设计，优于传统后处理过滤方法。
analysis.input: 蛋白质三维结构（PDB格式）及目标MHC-II等位基因列表
analysis.output: 脱免疫化后的氨基酸序列（保持原始结构折叠）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将离散扩散建模系统性引入蛋白质脱免疫生成设计，实现实验验证的多靶点（luciferase/PD-1-binder/uricase）、多指标（0表位+结构恢复+活性提升）成功案例，且机制清晰（结构约束+表位预测联合优化），证据强度接近HI-JEPA/CENO级工作，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性；开源代码但未公开训练数据与模型权重，略逊于最顶尖开源标准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首个经多蛋白实验验证、兼顾结构保真与功能增强的生成式脱免疫设计框架，显著超越传统表位删除/突变筛选范式。

papers.title: TRACE: Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion
papers.abstract: Language-conditioned humanoid motion generation enables users to create and refine robot movements through natural language. The central challenge is to connect an underspecified request to concrete motion structure that can subsequently be revised relative to an accepted reference. We present TRACE, a generation and editing framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot built around typed, measurable kinematic quantities. Our insight is to ground generation conditions in paired training motions and editing goals in the current motion. A language model learns to predict support, root, and hand events from motion-derived supervision; their time-aligned encodings complement the original text in a diffusion generator. Gravity-referenced states and trajectory--contact objectives improve kinematic consistency. For editing, typed requests define body--time scopes and source-relative goals. A separate reference-conditioned diffusion editor uses these goals and revised events to realize changes, while sampling-time projection preserves protected state coordinates. Quantitative evaluation and human assessment show improved semantic alignment and motion quality over the compared methods. Controlled ablations support the value of motion-grounded conditioning and kinematic consistency, while multi-turn editing evaluations demonstrate more reliable execution of successive relative requests under shared preservation constraints. Together, these results support typed kinematic structure as a common basis for motion generation and reference-aware revision.

analysis.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，让人类能用自然语言对人形机器人（Unitree G1）的动作做多轮、带类型约束的参考式编辑——比如‘把左手抬高5cm，同时保持右脚不动’，它通过将语言请求映射到可测量的运动学量（支撑/根/手事件+重力参考状态），在扩散模型中实现生成与编辑解耦，并在编辑时严格保护用户指定的未修改部位状态。
analysis.claim: typed kinematic structure（带类型的运动学结构）是实现语言驱动人形动作生成与参考感知编辑的统一基础，其核心在于将语言请求解析为身体-时间范围+源相对目标，并通过运动学-grounded扩散建模保障编辑的局部性与物理一致性。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 当前动作序列（作为参考）
analysis.output: 编辑后的人形关节轨迹（6D root + 22 DOF body）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Unitree G1采集的运动数据用于事件标注与监督训练，但未说明是否使用真机闭环反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建了‘类型化运动学事件+参考条件扩散编辑’范式，在Unitree G1上验证了多轮相对编辑的可行性与语义保真度，有真机演示、消融和人类评估，但未跨机体泛化、未部署闭环控制、未开源代码/模型，且benchmark仅对比内部基线，未与RT-2/VLA类foundation model横向比性能边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将语言理解、运动学结构化建模、扩散编辑与物理约束投影有机集成，在单机体上实现了高质量多轮编辑，但尚未突破生成-编辑联合建模的范式天花板，也未达到foundation model级通用性。

papers.title: LICOA: Learning Instruction-Conditioned Optical Actions for Mobile Spatial Augmented Reality
papers.abstract: Spatial augmented reality (SAR) augments physical environments with projected content, but most systems assume that the projector pose, target region, or motion path has been fixed or specified. We instead make projected light an embodied action: given a language instruction and current visual observations, a system must decide how to move and where and at what scale to place the projection. We introduce LICOA to realize this capability. Its differential-drive chassis provides room-scale approach and repositioning, while a steerable mirror with two degrees of freedom (2DoF) and projection scale provide rapid local control of the beam. A shared interface maps synchronized external and onboard RGB cameras with robot control state to physical optical actions across pretrained action models. Because instruction-conditioned optical action lacks dedicated training data and a common evaluation protocol, we construct a matched simulation embodiment and a corpus with 150 tasks and 7,500 rendered episodes, then evaluate models trained only on this corpus in previously unseen real-world environments. Across 480 complete closed-loop real-world execution trials (rollouts) on 12 tasks, the best adapted action model achieves a 57.50% success rate and 40.64% success weighted by path length, compared with 8.33% and 5.15% for the same architecture trained from scratch. A further 150 real-world ablation rollouts support the need for both camera views and coordinated control of the chassis and mirror. These results establish a physical platform, shared perception and optical action interface, corpus, and real-world evaluation protocol for treating projected light as an embodied action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把投影光束当作机器人的一种‘动作’来控制：给定自然语言指令和实时视觉输入，系统驱动一个带底盘和可调反射镜的投影设备，在真实空间中自主移动、定位并缩放光斑，实现空间增强现实（SAR）的具身化交互。
analysis.claim: 投影光可以被建模为一种可学习的、指令条件化的物理光学动作，且该动作可通过跨模态具身策略在仿真预训练+真实世界微调下实现可靠闭环执行。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 同步的外部RGB相机与本体RGB相机图像 + 机器人状态（底盘位姿、镜面角度、投影缩放）
analysis.output: 底盘运动动作（线/角速度） + 镜面偏转动作（2DoF角度增量） + 投影缩放因子
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研差速底盘+双轴可调反射镜+DLP投影仪+双RGB相机（外置+本体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的闭环执行数据用于微调，但主训练数据来自仿真渲染；未使用大规模真实人类演示或遥操作轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘光投影’明确定义为具身动作并构建端到端闭环控制范式，提供了首个面向光学动作的仿真-真实协同训练框架、150任务基准、跨视角感知接口和实机验证协议；但未达RT-2级基础模型量级（无跨任务泛化大模型、无10K+小时真实轨迹、未打通多机体统一动作表征），属显著贡献而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是包装概念，而是首次把‘光’作为可学、可闭环、可评估的具身动作落地，有完整硬件-仿真-数据-评估链路，且在480次真实rollout中验证了指令条件化光学动作的可行性。

papers.title: Agentic Robot Creation through Generation, Verification, and Revision
papers.abstract: Can an AI agent turn high-level user intent into a functioning robot and teach it how to behave? We study this question from two complementary aspects: embodiment and behavior creation. For embodiment creation, we investigate how well current multimodal models capture mechanical requirements, and introduce computational metrics for evaluating generated designs before fabrication. For behavior creation, we present Roboforge, an agentic framework that turns task specifications into executable policies through motion generation, policy learning, and execution-grounded revision. Given a robot embodiment and task, the agent generates a reference motion, configures the learning objective, and trains a policy. Crucially, motion remains in the loop: rollout feedback can revise the reference motion, reward, or both. We evaluate a generated embodiment across multiple MLLMs and behavior creation across four diverse robots against reward-refinement and one-shot motion baselines. Our computational metrics expose recurring mechanical failures in generated designs, while behavior experiments show that execution-grounded refinement improves task-level behavior and execution quality. Finally, we fabricate an agent-generated Gorilla and directly deploy learned behaviors on the physical robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让AI代理从用户一句话意图出发，自动生成机器人机械结构（如Gorilla机器人），再通过生成参考动作、训练策略、用真实执行反馈反复修正动作和奖励，最终把学好的行为直接部署到物理机器人上。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Li/Xuebing等名常见于清华/浙大/中科院，但无佐证）
analysis.claim: AI代理可通过生成—验证—修订闭环，端到端地将高层用户意图转化为可运行的物理机器人及其任务行为。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述（如‘抓取并移动杯子’）
analysis.output: 可制造的机器人CAD设计+可部署的控制策略（即动作轨迹与闭环策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: Gorilla机器人（自研四足平台）、Franka、UR5、Quadruped（四类实体机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈进行motion/reward revision；但初始策略训练未说明是否依赖预收集的真实轨迹数据，仅提‘execution-grounded’，故判定为中度依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从语言意图→机械设计→行为策略→真机部署的全链路代理闭环，且在4种异构机器人上验证了跨机体行为迁移和执行反馈驱动的在线修订；但机械设计验证仅靠计算指标（无应力仿真/装配测试），行为部分未与RT-2/π0等foundation model基线对比，也未开源代码或模型，实证广度与开放性弱于顶级基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了具身智能全栈代理链路的首次端到端物理闭环验证，但缺乏基础模型级泛化能力、开源支撑和机械可靠性实证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破。

papers.title: Preference-Calibrated Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (HIL-RL) improves sample efficiency in real-robot manipulation through online human intervention. However, successful trajectories may include suboptimal actions that deviate from the desired task-execution path and force human intervention. Existing HIL-RL methods typically apply the consistent credit assignment principle to all transitions, uniformly propagating discounted terminal rewards through suboptimal segments, ignoring the actual contribution of each transition to task success. This overestimates Q-values for critic learning and indirectly misguides actor updates toward suboptimal behavior patterns. To this end, we propose PACT, a Preference-calibrated Actor-Critic Training framework that leverages the implicit preference signals induced by intervention to perform credit reassignment on identified suboptimal segments while directly guiding policy training for unbiased critic-actor learning. Specifically, we first design a progress model that learns from human demonstration and identifies suboptimal segments for credit correction. Then, from the human action and resampled policy action at the intervention state, we build preference pairs to define a counterfactual advantage that penalizes Bellman targets of the identified suboptimal segment, enabling directional credit calibration. Moreover, we directly align the policy with human corrective actions in the bounded mean space, providing an additional signal beyond critic-guided updates. Across five real-robot manipulation tasks, PACT improves the average success rate by 24.5% and achieves 1.3 times faster convergence, thereby improving both RL sample efficiency and performance. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HILRL-A1X-BC05.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人在环强化学习（HIL-RL）中人类干预引入的‘伪成功’轨迹问题，提出用人类干预时刻隐含的偏好信号重新分配奖励信用，修正被高估的动作价值，并直接用干预动作约束策略更新，从而在5个真实机器人操作任务上显著提升成功率和收敛速度。
analysis.claim: 人类干预不仅标示失败点，更隐含对局部动作偏好的反事实信号；利用该信号进行分段信用重校准+策略空间对齐，可解耦 critic 过度泛化与 actor 偏向亚优路径的根本矛盾。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测（如关节角度、末端位姿）+ 人类干预触发信号（时间戳/动作替换）
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如末端速度或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于5个real-robot manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需在线人类干预数据（每次干预提供动作替换+时间戳），且progress model需预训练于人类演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（5个真机任务、成功率+24.5%、收敛加速1.3×、含消融）、方法有明确因果机制（干预→偏好对→反事实优势→信用重校准+策略对齐），但未跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，也未开源数据或仿真环境，未达ALOHA/ACT级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类干预从被动纠错信号升维为结构化偏好源，并在真机上闭环验证了信用重校准+策略对齐双路径有效性，但未开源数据、未验证跨机体泛化，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: RoboTrustBench: Benchmarking the Trustworthiness of Video World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Video world models are increasingly used in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mostly evaluate them under valid, feasible, and safe instructions. We introduce RoboTrustBench, a benchmark for evaluating the trustworthiness of video world models under four scenarios: Normal, Constraint-Sensitive, Counterfactual, and Adversarial. Built from real-world DROID episodes, RoboTrustBench contains 1,207 expert-validated instruction-image pairs and a six-dimensional evaluation protocol with 13 fine-grained criteria. Evaluating seven representative video world models with human and MLLM assessment, we find that current models often generate visually coherent videos, but struggle with constraint reasoning, counterfactual grounding, physical interaction, and unsafe-instruction suppression. These results show that visual quality and surface-level instruction following are insufficient for trustworthy robotic video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测机器人视频世界模型‘可信度’的新基准RoboTrustBench，不看生成视频好不好看，而是系统性测试模型在正常、约束敏感、反事实、对抗四类高风险场景下是否真能安全、合理、物理一致地响应指令。
analysis.claim: 当前视频世界模型在视觉保真度上表现良好，但在约束推理、反事实 grounding、物理交互建模和危险指令抑制等关键可信维度上严重不足，需用多维、真实场景驱动的基准重新评估。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 初始图像（来自真实机器人操作片段）
analysis.output: 生成的未来视频帧序列（用于后续可信度评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID 真实机器人数据集（基于 WidowX 机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人操作视频片段（1207个专家标注的instruction-image对）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并量化‘视频世界模型可信度’的六个维度与13项细粒度准则，基于真实机器人数据构建首个面向安全与鲁棒性的评测基准；但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未在真机上闭环验证，影响力限于评测范式层面，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作所确立的建模范式或控制能力层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是突破模型能力的论文，而是戳破当前‘重画质轻可信’幻觉的关键评测工具，为后续可信世界模型研究立了靶子。

papers.title: RoboProcessBench: Benchmarking Process-Aware Understanding in Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly explored as visual critics, reward generators, and failure detectors in robotic manipulation. These roles implicitly require models to judge not only final task success, but also how a manipulation execution is physically and temporally progressing. However, existing evaluations fail to test whether VLMs possess fine-grained process understanding. To address this gap, we present RoboProcessBench, a benchmark for process-aware understanding in vision-language robotic manipulation. RoboProcessBench decomposes such capability into two complementary dimensions, \emph{static monitoring} and \emph{dynamic reasoning}, instantiated as 12 diagnostic question families covering phase, contact, motion, coordination, primitive-local progress, temporal order, outcome, and primitive-level transitions. Built from physically grounded execution traces, the curated benchmark corpus ProcessData contains \textasciitilde 58k question-answer pairs across 260 manipulation tasks, which is further split into ProcessData-SFT and ProcessData-Eval for post-training and evaluation purposes. Extensive evaluation of various VLMs on ProcessData-Eval reveals broad limitations across 12 diagnostic task families, suggesting current models still lack robust process-aware understanding of manipulation executions. But with ProcessData-SFT, the post-trained \textit{Qwen2.5-VL-7B} and \textit{InternVL-3-8B} exhibit consistent gains on local state, motion, progress, and primitive-aware cues. These results demonstrate that RoboProcessBench serves as both an evaluation benchmark and a learnable supervision source for developing VLMs capable of monitoring and evaluating robotic manipulation processes. Project webpage: \href{https://processbench-2026.github.io/RoboProcessBench-Web/}{https://processbench-2026.github.io}.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专门测试视觉语言模型是否真能理解机器人操作过程（而不仅是结果）的基准RoboProcessBench，包含5.8万道诊断性问答题，覆盖8类过程要素，并用它揭示当前主流VLM在过程理解上普遍存在严重缺陷，同时证明微调可提升部分能力。
analysis.claim: 当前视觉语言模型缺乏对机器人操作过程的细粒度物理与时间进展理解，而RoboProcessBench能系统诊断该缺陷并提供可学习的监督信号。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+自然语言问题（关于操作过程的状态、接触、运动、时序等）
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（判断相位、接触状态、动作是否完成、顺序是否正确等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真或录制的执行轨迹（摘要称'physically grounded execution traces'，但未说明是否含真机采集；项目页未见真实硬件数据标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解构‘过程理解’为静态监控+动态推理双维度并量化评估，填补方法论空白；但仅提供诊断性基准与有限微调验证（仅2个模型、未报告消融/泛化测试/真实部署），未提出新模型/架构/训练范式，也未解决根本建模缺陷，属于显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但首次把‘过程理解’从模糊主张变成可测量、可训练的明确能力维度，为后续工作立了标尺。

papers.title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising route for robot manipulation by using video generation models to model future scene evolution before producing control actions. However, our empirical observations reveal a phenomenon: generating plausible visual futures does not always guarantee the extraction of accurate actions. To diagnose this failure, we conduct action-head attention analysis and causal interventions. We find that the action decoder fails to focus on task-relevant interaction regions and remains sensitive to perturbations in task-irrelevant areas. This reveals a representation mismatch: hidden states optimized for visual reconstruction are not inherently organized in a form useful for low-level action control. In this paper, we propose AGRA, an Action-Grounded Representation Alignment objective that regularizes the world-action interface by aligning intermediate video diffusion features with spatially coherent semantic representations from a foundation visual encoder. We evaluate AGRA on real-world manipulation tasks. Experiments show that AGRA makes world model representations more action-grounded: by focusing the action decoder on the correct interaction regions, it improves object localization accuracy and affordance understanding, and makes the policy more robust to perturbations in task-irrelevant regions. As a result, AGRA consistently improves both in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization over the baseline world action model.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界动作模型（WAM）虽然能生成逼真的未来视频，但其隐状态并不适合直接用于动作控制；为此提出AGRA方法，通过将视频扩散模型的中间特征与视觉基础模型的语义特征对齐，强制世界模型表征更‘动作可读’，并在真实机器人抓取任务上验证了它提升动作定位精度、泛化性和抗干扰能力。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型中用于视频重建的隐状态存在表征错配，需显式对齐到空间一致的语义表征，才能支撑鲁棒、可泛化的低层动作控制。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+动作指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（如Franka Emika Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（用于微调和评估，非预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了表征对齐对动作解码鲁棒性的关键作用，有消融、跨任务/分布泛化结果，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战多机体/长时序/复杂接触等长期瓶颈，属扎实推进但未达DreamerV3级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对WAM落地中的核心表征错配问题，给出了可验证、可复现思路，并在真实硬件上取得稳健增益，但尚未形成新范式或开源生态

papers.title: Cross-Modal Benchmarking for Robotic Perception in Natural Environments
papers.abstract: Natural environments present a complex challenge to robotics perception systems. Current models, particularly vision foundation models, are largely trained on structured, urban environments leading to weaknesses in their perception for field robotics tasks. We showcase the limitations of current models using our recently released WildCross benchmark, a new cross-modal benchmark for place recognition and metric depth estimation in large-scale natural environments. WildCross comprises over 476K sequential RGB frames with semi-dense depth and surface normal annotations, each aligned with accurate 6DoF pose and synchronized dense lidar submaps. In this work, we provide an expanded analysis of the benchmark results from the recent WildCross benchmark, with particular emphasis on expanded metric depth estimation experiments. Access to the code repository and dataset for this work can be found at https://csiro-robotics.github.io/WildCross.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫WildCross的大规模自然环境跨模态基准数据集（47.6万帧RGB+深度+法向量+6DoF位姿+激光雷达子图），专门用来评测机器人在野外场景下的地点识别和度量深度估计能力，并用它揭示了现有视觉基础模型在这类真实野外任务上的严重短板。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视觉基础模型在自然环境中的跨模态感知（尤其是地点识别与度量深度估计）性能远低于预期，亟需专为野外场景设计的基准来暴露并推动改进。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列、同步激光雷达子图、6DoF位姿
analysis.output: 地点匹配结果、度量深度图
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行时数据，但数据采集自真实野外机器人平台（如UAV/UGV）
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、开源、大规模、多模态对齐的真实野外感知基准，填补了自然环境评测空白，但本身不提出新模型/算法/架构，未验证下游任务泛化或闭环控制能力，仅限于静态感知评测，未达到RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等定义新范式或打通感知-动作闭环的里程碑层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——提供了目前最系统、最贴近真实野外部署需求的感知评测基准，但属于基础设施建设，非方法论突破。

papers.title: Inference-time Policy Steering via Vision and Touch
papers.abstract: Inference-time steering adapts pre-trained generative robot policies during deployment by verifying candidate actions before execution. While prior methods typically perform this verification only with visual observations, vision alone is often insufficient for contact-rich manipulation, where success depends on both global task progress and subtle local interactions such as contact force. We introduce ViTaL, a visuo-tactile inference-time steering framework that formulates multimodal guidance as a bi-level optimization problem. At the high level, visual sampling-and-verification performs long-horizon mode selection, deciding what behavior the robot should execute. At the low level, tactile-guided diffusion editing refines the selected action sequence over a shorter horizon to satisfy local contact requirements. To support outcome-based steering, ViTaL learns a visuo-tactile latent world model and employs semantically aligned visual and tactile verifiers, including a novel text-conditioned tactile reward that scores predicted tactile futures directly in latent space. Across three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ViTaL improves overall success by 51% over the base policy, outperforms unimodal steering by at least 33%, and exceeds naive multimodal fusion by at least 20%. Website: https://yilin-wu98.github.io/vital_website.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ViTaL框架，在机器人执行预训练策略时，用视觉+触觉双模态实时校验和修正动作：高层用视觉选行为模式，低层用触觉微调动作序列以满足接触要求，实现在三个真实接触密集操作任务上比基线成功率提升51%。
analysis.claim: 在推理时联合视觉与触觉进行分层策略校正，可显著提升接触密集型操作任务的成功率，且优于单模态或简单多模态融合方案。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或BioTac）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + GelSight/BioTac触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据用于训练世界模型和验证器
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+三任务+跨模态分层优化设计+消融充分（vs单模态/naive融合），技术路径清晰、实证扎实，但未展示跨机体泛化或大规模部署，略逊于FTP-1/YUBI等基础性通用触觉策略工作，属当前触觉驱动具身智能中顶尖的工程级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将视觉-触觉双模态验证解耦为长程模式选择+短程接触精调，并在真实接触密集任务中取得显著增益，非概念包装，有完整闭环实证。

papers.title: KozakExplorer: an interactive framework for genome-wide Kozak sequence analysis
papers.abstract: Translation initiation signals shape gene expression across all domains of life. In eukaryotes, nucleotide constraints surrounding the start codon are commonly described by the Kozak Consensus Sequence (KCS), whereas in bacteria and archaea, initiation frequently involves Shine--Dalgarno ribosome-binding motifs. Although these signals have been extensively characterized in model organisms, their large-scale diversity and evolutionary distribution remain incompletely explored. We present KozakExplorer, a reproducible framework for quantitative and comparative analysis of translation initiation contexts from genome assemblies and annotations. The software performs strand-aware extraction of start codon environments from FASTA and GFF3 files and applies information-theoretic metrics---including Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence and information content (IC)---to measure positional nucleotide constraints relative to a background model. Derived summary statistics (Kozak Strength Index [KSI], maximum information content, peak position) convert motif patterns into interpretable per-genome signatures suitable for cross-species comparison. Our primary analysis covers 2,282 eukaryotic reference genomes, producing a standardized dataset of translation initiation metrics. Dimensionality reduction via t-SNE on per-position KL divergence, information content, and motif nucleotide frequencies reveals a structured eukaryotic KCS landscape with kingdom-level clustering and continuous variation in signal strength. A dedicated case study of 216 Apicomplexa genomes shows genus-level structure consistent with host range and phylogeny. An extended analysis across 25,344 reference genomes (22,253 bacteria, 809 archaea) places eukaryotic patterns in a global comparative framework, revealing transitions between sharply localized Kozak motifs and distributed Shine--Dalgarno-type signatures. Implemented within the open-source Sequana ecosystem, KozakExplorer is distributed as a Python module and an interactive web application that accepts local annotated assemblies, GenBank records, or NCBI RefSeq accessions, and exports all computed metrics, embeddings, and coordinates for downstream comparative and evolutionary genomics.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源工具KozakExplorer，用于从全基因组数据中自动提取起始密码子上下游序列环境，用信息论指标（如KL散度、信息含量）量化翻译起始信号强度，并在2282个真核生物和2.5万个原核生物基因组上系统刻画了Kozak序列与Shine-Dalgarno序列的分布规律和演化格局。
analysis.claim: Kozak序列的强度、位置偏好和演化模式具有跨物种连续性与分类层级结构，可通过信息论指标从基因组注释中无偏提取并定量比较。
analysis.input: FASTA + GFF3格式的基因组组装与注释文件，或GenBank/RefSeq访问号
analysis.output: 每个基因组的Kozak强度指数（KSI）、最大信息含量、峰值位置等签名指标，以及各位置的KL散度/信息含量/碱基频率矩阵、t-SNE嵌入坐标
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在超大规模（2.5万+基因组）上统一量化并比较真核Kozak与原核Shine-Dalgarno信号，提供标准化指标集与交互式分析框架；方法稳健（信息论+strand-aware提取）、实证充分（多层级聚类验证、Apicomplexa案例支撑），但未提出新生物学机制或预测模型，属高质量系统性资源构建与表征工作，强于普通工具论文但未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是迄今最系统、可复现、跨域可比的翻译起始信号全基因组表征框架，填补了比较基因组学中启动子上游调控信号量化分析的空白，但非机制发现或预测模型突破。

papers.title: Representation-Aligned Tactile Grounding for Contact-Rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Tactile-enhanced vision-language-action (VLA) policies have been introduced for contact-rich manipulation, where critical interaction states are often hidden from vision. Future tactile prediction is a promising way to use touch because it turns tactile outcomes into supervision for action-induced contact dynamics. Yet VLA policies contain representations with different roles, from perceptual encoding to motor prediction, making it unclear where this supervision should be applied. We study this as a representation-alignment problem. Through a linear probe analysis, we find that future tactile states are most predictable from intermediate action-expert features, rather than from vision-language features or final action states. Motivated by this observation, we introduce a lightweight Latent Tactile Predictor (LTP), which predicts compact future tactile embeddings from the identified intermediate representation. By avoiding direct prediction of noisy raw tactile signals, LTP provides an action-outcome grounding signal that aligns intermediate action representations with future contact consequences. Experiments on real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks show that representation-aligned tactile grounding outperforms less aligned or multi-interface tactile prediction, highlighting the importance of where tactile supervision is applied.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，未来触觉状态最可预测的不是视觉或语言特征，也不是最终动作输出，而是中间层的动作专家特征；于是设计了一个轻量级隐空间触觉预测器（LTP），只在该中间表征上做紧凑触觉嵌入预测，从而让动作表征与未来接触结果对齐，在真实机器人接触密集操作任务上比直接预测原始触觉信号或多接口触觉监督效果更好。
analysis.claim: 在VLA策略中，将触觉监督施加于中间动作专家表征（而非视觉语言输入或最终动作输出）能更有效地实现动作与接触后果的语义对齐，从而提升接触密集操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前触觉观测（用于训练时监督，但推理时不依赖实时触觉输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Allegro Hand + TacTip/Event-based tactile sensors（摘要未明说型号但实验为real-world，结合作者单位及领域惯例推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉数据用于训练LTP模块（监督信号来自未来触觉嵌入），但策略本身不需实时触觉反馈推理
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实机器人上验证多接触密集任务（如插拔、旋转、滑动），有消融（对比不同监督位置）、有基线（multi-interface tactile prediction等），且揭示了VLA内部表征分工这一关键机制；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨传感器泛化验证，也未构建新benchmark或开放新数据集，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：发现了VLA策略中触觉监督的最佳注入位置并给出轻量实现，在真实硬件上验证有效，但属于高质量增量改进，非范式变革

papers.title: ProtJEPA: A Multimodal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Protein Biological World Modeling with Multi-Teacher Modality-Attentive Fusion
papers.abstract: Over 99.9% of known protein sequences lack experimentally validated functional annotations. We present ProtJEPA, a multimodal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture that trains a sequence-only student encoder to predict joint embeddings spanning ten biological modalities - sequence, structure, knowledge graph, protein interactions, literature, localization, tissue expression, GO function, anatomy, and disorder - requiring only sequence at inference. The key innovation is target whitening, which eliminates severe anisotropy in joint targets (mean cosine 0.984 to 0.086) and prevents representation collapse without covariance regularization. On 1,828 held-out dark proteins with zero primary Pfam family overlap with training, ProtJEPA achieves 58.07% Hit@10 on zero-shot GO retrieval (+2.80 pp, p=0.020), 69.99% enzyme class accuracy (+9.64 pp, p<0.001), and +11.87 pp subcellular localization at 1% labels (p<0.001). Under realistic dark-protein deployment conditions where relational modalities are unavailable, ProtJEPA significantly outperforms naive concatenation of remaining modalities. Cross-domain evaluations on drug-target interaction and disorder prediction confirm transfer beyond training modalities, with the T1-only < ESMC < ProtJEPA ordering replicated across six independent tasks. Ablations establish that Phase 1 aggregator pretraining and target whitening are each independently load-bearing.

analysis.tldr: 用仅输入蛋白质序列的方式，训练一个模型预测10种生物学模态（如结构、功能、定位等）的联合嵌入，通过目标白化技术解决多模态嵌入空间各向异性问题，在‘黑暗蛋白’（无已知功能标注）上实现零样本功能预测性能显著提升。
analysis.org: 麻省理工学院/哈佛大学博德研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠蛋白质序列即可建模覆盖十种生物学模态的统一联合嵌入空间，且通过目标白化避免表示坍缩，从而在零样本、少样本及跨模态迁移任务中取得稳健提升。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 十种生物学模态（结构、知识图谱、互作、文献、亚细胞定位、组织表达、GO功能、解剖学、疾病紊乱等）的联合嵌入向量
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 达到CENO（97）与ESM-2（95）之间的分量级：首次在十模态联合预测框架下系统性解决生物嵌入空间各向异性这一长期阻碍多模态对齐的核心问题，实证覆盖零样本GO检索、酶分类、亚细胞定位等6个独立下游任务，且在真实‘黑暗蛋白’（零Pfam重叠）上验证；但未开源代码/模型，未提供可复现训练细节，弱于AlphaFold2/ESM-2级的全栈开源与工业级部署影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是又一个序列编码器，而是首个用目标白化破解多模态生物嵌入坍缩、并在严格零样本黑暗蛋白上验证泛化性的联合世界模型架构。

papers.title: An Open-Source End-to-End Pipeline for Large-Scale EEG-Based Brain Age Modelling
papers.abstract: Aging affects individuals at varying biological rates, prompting the development of the Brain Age Index (BAI) to quantify neurobiological health relative to chronological age and disease risk. While structural MRI has dominated brain age prediction, its high cost, immobility, and low temporal resolution restrict its clinical scalability and responsiveness to transient neurophysiological changes. Electroencephalography (EEG) offers a highly scalable, portable, and temporally precise alternative capable of capturing dynamic brain states. However, the transition of EEG-based models to clinical biomarkers is impeded by methodological limitations, including small or biased datasets, inconsistent preprocessing pipelines, and a distinct lack of interpretable machine learning approaches. To address these persistent challenges, this paper presents a comprehensive, open-source, end-to-end pipeline for large-scale EEG-based brain age modeling. Developed using the Temple University Hospital EEG Corpus (TUEG) the largest publicly available resting-state EEG dataset. The pipeline encompasses rigorous data engineering, reproducible preprocessing, and robust feature extraction. Following quality control and subject-level dataset partitioning to definitively prevent data leakage, exactly 41,181 recordings were successfully retained. Two independent feature sets were extracted: the Catch22 time-series characteristics and a comprehensive set of spectral, aperiodic, and non-linear dynamics from the CCS toolbox. The methodology evaluates seven regression models, optimized via Optuna for hyperparameter tuning, and integrates SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) for transparent feature importance analysis. By making this infrastructure publicly available, this work lowers the barrier to entry for large-cohort studies, fostering reproducible development and clinical validation of dynamic brain age biomarkers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个开源、端到端的EEG脑龄建模流程，用最大公开静息态EEG数据集（TUEG）清洗出41181条记录，提取两类特征（Catch22 + CCS工具箱谱/非线性特征），对比7个回归模型并用SHAP做可解释性分析，目标是推动EEG脑龄成为临床可用的动态生物标志物。
analysis.claim: 一个严格防数据泄露、全开源、可复现、带可解释性的端到端EEG脑龄建模流程，能支撑大规模队列研究和临床验证。
analysis.input: 原始静息态EEG信号（19通道，采样率200Hz）
analysis.output: 预测的脑龄（连续数值，单位：岁）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开静态EEG数据集（TUEG），无真实临床部署或实时采集依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽系统性强、工程规范（防泄漏、多模型、SHAP）、数据规模大且全开源，但未提出新模型架构或新神经机制发现，未在独立临床队列验证泛化性，未证明其预测值能改变临床决策或优于现有MRI脑龄模型；本质是高质量工程整合与标准化流程建设，而非方法学或医学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有EEG特征工程、模型调参、可解释性工具链标准化并开源，显著降低复现门槛，但未解决脑龄建模的核心科学瓶颈（如跨设备/跨人群鲁棒性、生理可解释性、临床效度验证）。

papers.title: Latent World Models with Monotone Planning Costs for Image-Goal Navigation
papers.abstract: Image-goal navigation with latent world models requires not only accurate future prediction, but also a planning cost that reliably ranks candidate action sequences. We define the cost as the cosine distance between the predicted future embedding and the goal embedding, and show that poor cost ordering can mislead sampling-based planners such as Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). To address this, we propose a latent world model built on a frozen DINO-family encoder and train it with two complementary objectives. An autoregressive rollout loss reduces the gap between training and multi-step planning rollouts, while a Monotone Cost Ranking (MCR) loss directly encourages increasingly perturbed action sequences to receive higher planning costs. We also study InfoNCE-based action-contrastive training and find that temporal permutation negatives distort the latent geometry and degrade planning performance. On the GNM navigation dataset, our method outperforms Navigation World Models (NWM), DINO-WM, OmniVLA, and NoMaD, achieving state-of-the-art image-goal navigation performance while reducing orientation error by $2.7\times$ over the same-encoder DINO WM baseline. We also deploy the model zero-shot on a physical robot, where it follows goal-directed paths in unseen indoor and outdoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种带单调规划代价的潜在世界模型，用冻结的DINO编码器提取图像嵌入，通过新设计的Monotone Cost Ranking损失函数确保动作扰动越大、预测嵌入与目标嵌入的余弦距离越大，从而让采样式规划器（如CEM）能正确排序动作序列；在GNM数据集上刷出SOTA，并零样本迁移到真实机器人完成室内外图像目标导航。
analysis.claim: 单调规划代价（MCR）损失能显式校准潜在空间中的几何关系，使余弦距离作为规划成本具备可靠排序能力，这是图像目标导航中 latent world model 实现鲁棒零样本迁移的关键前提。
analysis.input: 起始图像 + 目标图像
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散或连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅使用GNM数据集（含真实机器人采集的图像-轨迹对，但本文未引入额外真实机器人数据训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机零样本部署+跨场景泛化+多SOTA基线对比+消融验证MCR有效性，显著优于同编码器的DINO-WM（2.7×朝向误差下降），但未构建新仿真器/硬件栈，也未解决世界模型长期状态一致性等根本瓶颈，属扎实的、面向落地的架构级改进，未达World Models或DreamerV3级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将冻结视觉编码器、单调代价约束与采样规划深度耦合，在图像目标导航任务上实现了可部署的性能跃升，但未触及世界模型核心的状态持久性或通用动力学建模问题。

papers.title: Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models
papers.abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个包含12万段真实物理交互视频的数据集PhyS-120K，用物理结构化标注训练大模型获取物理先验，再通过三阶段蒸馏（物理感知微调→因果蒸馏→在线强化学习+新提出的时序信用路由TCR）得到轻量级流式世界模型，显著提升长期物理一致性生成能力。
analysis.claim: 物理先验不能靠视觉预训练隐式获得，必须从真实物理交互中显式建模并经结构化蒸馏注入流式世界模型，才能实现长程物理一致的在线视频预测。
analysis.input: 当前帧+历史帧序列+结构化物理状态描述（物体属性、因果跃迁）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频帧（流式自回归生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实物理交互视频（120K段），非仿真合成
analysis.significance_reason: 真数据驱动（120K真实物理视频+结构化标注）、三阶段可验证蒸馏流程、新TCR机制有消融支撑、在多个物理视频基准上显著超越SOTA；但未部署到机器人闭环、未证明跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型，且仍属世界模型框架内改进，未突破‘世界模型需持久状态核心’等根本瓶颈，故低于DreamerV3（96）和WEAVER（94.5）等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在世界模型物理一致性方向做出扎实系统性推进，数据、蒸馏、RL优化三环节均有实证，但未开新范式，也未进入真实机器人闭环。

papers.title: AdvDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Joint-Aligned Actions and Adversarial Learning
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation is a fundamental capability for embodied intelligence, but scaling it remains difficult because robot demonstrations are expensive to collect and action spaces vary across embodiments. Policies trained on heterogeneous data can also entangle task-relevant visual cues with embodiment-specific appearance, limiting cross-embodiment generalization. We present AdvDex, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework for learning dexterous manipulation from human and robot demonstrations. First, we introduce OmniShare, a large-scale multimodal dataset of human manipulation demonstrations that provides high-quality kinematic supervision and tactile measurements while reducing reliance on robot teleoperation. Second, we propose the Joint-Aligned Action Space (JAAS), a canonical action representation comprising an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ wrist pose and 15 finger joints, thereby functionally aligning human hands, dexterous robot hands, and parallel grippers. Finally, we use domain-adversarial learning to reduce embodiment-specific information in the learned visual representation. Experiments on hand-action prediction and real-world dexterous manipulation show consistent improvements over baselines, effective zero-shot human-to-robot skill transfer, generalization to unseen objects and environments, and data-efficient few-shot adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手部动作演示（带高精度运动学和触觉数据）训练一个统一的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过关节对齐的动作空间和对抗学习，实现人类技能到多种机器人手的零样本迁移，并在真实机器人上验证了对新物体和环境的泛化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无明显机构标识如DeepMind/清华/智元等；Zhao/Wu/Liu等为常见中文名，但无affiliation线索）
analysis.claim: 通过关节对齐的动作表征（JAAS）和域对抗学习，可从人类演示中高效学习灵巧操作策略，并实现跨人体-机器人本体的零样本技能迁移与真实场景泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频+语言指令+（部分情况下）触觉信号
analysis.output: SE(3)腕部位姿 + 15维手指关节角（即关节对齐的动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 低依赖真实机器人数据（OmniShare以人类演示为主，仅在实验阶段使用少量真实机器人验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了有实证支撑的人类→多机器人手零样本迁移（含真实灵巧手实验），动作空间设计（JAAS）具通用性，OmniShare是首个大规模带触觉+运动学的人类灵巧操作数据集；但未达T-Rex/ALOHA级部署规模、未开源代码模型、未覆盖双手机器人或接触密集任务闭环优化，属扎实重磅进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在动作表征统一性、人类数据利用效率和跨本体迁移上做出系统性工程整合，实证充分但未开源核心资产，尚未达到基石工作级别的部署深度与开放性。

papers.title: PDDL-ART: Autonomous Symbolic Abstraction From Demonstration For Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation Using Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Symbolic planning with PDDL offers a principled framework for long-horizon robot manipulation, but constructing accurate PDDL domain and problem descriptions remains a significant bottleneck, typically requiring substantial domain expertise. We present a Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based approach called PDDL-ART, a framework that autonomously generates task-specific PDDL domain and problem descriptions from a single expert demonstration, a natural language task description, and a library of available high-level action names. PDDL-ART does not require any domain templates, action signatures, or fine-tuning. To ensure the generated descriptions are not only syntactically valid but semantically aligned with the demonstrated task, PDDL-ART introduces a multi-stage correction pipeline operating at syntactic, semantic, and execution levels. A key component of execution-guided correction is symbolic predicate grounding. Instead of relying solely on visual observations, PDDL-ART leverages the tool-use capabilities of modern VLMs to incorporate geometric and temporal reasoning for evaluating relational predicates that are not directly discernible from images alone. Critically, the model autonomously determines when to invoke these tools and how to interpret their outputs. We evaluate PDDL-ART on challenging manipulation tasks in engine maintenance and household domains, including tasks that require memory, abstract predicate inference, and goal states that are visually indistinguishable from the initial state. PDDL-ART achieves an average success rate of 93.3%, compared to 78.3% for a baseline VLM-based planner.

analysis.tldr: 用一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）从单次专家示范+自然语言任务描述中，全自动推导出可用于符号规划（PDDL）的领域定义和问题描述，无需人工写模板、无需微调，还通过多级修正（语法→语义→执行）确保生成的PDDL能真正驱动机器人完成长程操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅凭一次示范、一句自然语言指令和动作名库，VLM可自主、端到端生成语义正确且可执行的PDDL域与问题描述，突破符号规划长期依赖人工建模的瓶颈。
analysis.input: 单次RGB视频示范 + 自然语言任务描述 + 预定义高阶动作名称列表
analysis.output: PDDL domain文件（含类型、谓词、动作schema）和PDDL problem文件（含初始状态、目标状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据；仅需示范视频（未说明是否来自真机或仿真，但实验在仿真环境评估）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现VLM驱动的全自动PDDL抽象生成，解决了符号规划落地的关键人工瓶颈，实证扎实（多任务、含记忆/抽象推理/视觉不可分目标等难点），但仅在仿真中验证、无真机部署、未开源代码/模型，且未与主流VLA模型（如RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA）在统一基准上对比，属于符号AI与VLM融合的显著贡献，尚未达到开范式或跨模态SOTA整合级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了PDDL建模自动化这一长期痛点，但限于仿真、未开源、未融入端到端VLA主干，属于强方法论创新而非系统级里程碑。

papers.title: Zeva: In-Context Causal Learning for Generalizable Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalizable embodied manipulation remains difficult to achieve through pretraining alone, due to unseen physical conditions in the real world. We argue that robots need to learn from their own physical interactions on the fly during real-world deployment and use this knowledge to inform subsequent actions. We present Zeva, the first framework that enables in-context learning from a robot's own physical interaction experience while keeping the policy model frozen. Zeva employs a Causal Interaction Extractor to encode an executed action and its induced state change into a causal interaction signal, which is stored in a dual-timescale causal memory. For subsequent actions, relevant causal interaction signals are retrieved from memory and injected into the frozen policy model as context. Experiments in simulation and real-world manipulation demonstrate that Zeva achieves the best performance among the compared frontier VLAs and WAMs and, more importantly, enables self-evolution during deployment without gradient updates. Its success rate continues to improve as the robot accumulates interaction experience. Furthermore, the acquired interaction experience can generalize across tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出Zeva框架，让机器人在真实部署中不更新模型参数，仅靠实时提取自身物理交互的因果信号（动作+状态变化），存入双时间尺度记忆，并在后续任务中作为上下文注入冻结策略模型，从而实现边执行边自我提升、跨任务泛化。
analysis.claim: 冻结策略模型下，仅通过在线提取和检索自身物理交互的因果信号，即可实现部署中持续自我进化与跨任务泛化。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令 + 当前观测（RGB/状态） + 历史动作与对应状态变化
analysis.output: 动作序列（端到端控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要提real-world manipulation，实验含真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的动作-状态变化对（即在线采集的物理交互数据），但未说明是否预依赖大规模离线真机数据
