analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：含真实机械臂多任务验证、self-evolution趋势量化（成功率随经验积累持续上升）、对比前沿VLAs/WAMs且胜出；但未达RT-2/π0级范式颠覆——仍基于现有VLA架构做推理时增强，非新训练范式或世界模型级构建；跨机体泛化未验证，真实数据规模与开源程度不及Xiaomi-Robotics-1或Qwen-Robot等94+分工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：在冻结模型前提下实现真机部署中因果驱动的自我进化，证据充分、工程可落地，但尚未突破VLA架构边界，未达里程碑级范式创新。

papers.title: FWBC-VLA: Force-Aware Whole-Body Compensation for Contact-Rich Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich loco-manipulation requires a bridge between semantic action generation and physical interaction control. Existing Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate task-level actions from visual and linguistic observations, but cannot interpret the physical interactions induced by those actions. While the whole-body control (WBC) policy can stabilize the robot, it cannot distinguish task-relevant interaction forces from forces induced by external disturbances during manipulation. Although force/torque sensors provide direct measurements of physical interactions, retrofitting them entails additional hardware costs and substantial integration effort, particularly for platforms not designed with sensor integration in mind. To address this problem, we propose FWBC-VLA, a force-aware framework that bridges task-level VLA action generation and low-level whole-body compensation control for wheeled-legged robots. First, we introduce HSR-Force, a sensorless residual-torque estimator for inferring contact strength and its temporal variation. These contact estimates are then encoded as tokens and injected into the VLA action expert during action decoding, enabling the policy to perceive contact onset, sustained loading, and release. For loco-manipulation tasks, all parameters of the pretrained VLA backbone are fine-tuned on our WL\&Arm Dataset, which comprises more than 5,000 episodes. Moreover, the robot's proprioceptive state, the Jacobian-derived body-frame force estimate, and the estimated contact state are jointly fed into a compensation generator to produce corrective actions. The manipulation-centric actions are subsequently combined with the corrective actions and passed to the WBC policy for execution. Real-world experiments on whiteboard wiping and door opening with a door closer demonstrate the effectiveness of our FWBC-VLA in contact-rich loco-manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FWBC-VLA框架，让轮腿机器人在擦白板、开门等需要频繁接触的移动操作任务中，不用额外装力传感器，就能通过纯软件方式估计接触力的大小和变化，并把这种‘力感知’融入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的动作生成过程，再与底层全身控制（WBC）协同执行。
analysis.claim: 无需硬件力传感器，仅通过关节扭矩残差建模与VLA-token化注入，即可实现接触力感知与任务级动作生成的闭环耦合，显著提升轮腿机器人在接触丰富场景下的locomanipulation鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度/扭矩）+雅可比矩阵
analysis.output: 补偿性关节力矩修正量+任务级动作块（如‘推门把手向右’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮腿臂一体化平台（WL&Arm），含轮式底盘、四足构型腿部、7自由度机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的5000+ episode数据（WL&Arm Dataset），含白板擦拭、带阻尼器的门开启等contact-rich任务
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证扎实（两典型contact-rich任务）、首次将残差扭矩估计token化嵌入VLA解码器并闭环驱动WBC，在无额外力传感前提下达成可部署级性能；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、未与SOTA VLA（如RT-2、OpenVLA）或WBC（如GigaBrain-WBC-0.5）做公平对比，属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了轮腿机器人在真实contact-rich任务中力感知与VLA协同的落地瓶颈，但未挑战基础建模假设或开辟新方法论，也未达到基石论文所定义的范式级影响力。

papers.title: Learning transferable human physiology from two million hours of sleep with SleepFM-2
papers.abstract: Sleep provides a nightly window into health by capturing coordinated activity across the brain, heart, muscles and respiratory system. We introduce SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model developed and evaluated on 282,511 polysomnography recordings from 26 cohorts, including 235,865 used for pretraining. These data span more than two million hours of multimodal physiology. Compared with SleepFM, SleepFM-2 improves disease prediction and sleep scoring, supports arousal, limb movement and respiratory event detection, and transfers to wearable sensing and subjective sleep phenotypes. A model combining its PSG representation with age, sex and BMI met a prespecified discrimination and significance criterion for 215 subsequently recorded EHR phenotypes in two held-out cohorts, including one health system unseen during pretraining. For 155 phenotypes, the PSG representation added reproducible information beyond demographics. SleepFM-2 also outperformed a 480-feature baseline derived from the same recordings. Its disease scores revealed a reproducible principal component associated with reduced sigma-band spatial coupling and increased hypnodensity entropy. The frozen encoder performed within the observed range of expert scorers for sleep events and transferred to wakeful EEG, headband and in-ear EEG, wrist PPG and wrist accelerometry. It improved sleep staging across six accelerometry cohorts and achieved disease-prediction performance in UK Biobank similar to models pretrained directly on accelerometry. Finally, SleepFM-2 captured aspects of subjective sleep not recovered by conventional PSG summaries, particularly reports of the recorded night. These results show that multimodal sleep physiology can provide a transferable representation of human health across diseases, clinical tasks, sensors and subjective experience.

analysis.tldr: 用两百万小时多中心睡眠多导生理数据（PSG）训练出一个通用睡眠基础模型SleepFM-2，它能统一表征睡眠状态、检测多种睡眠事件、预测215种电子病历疾病表型、泛化到可穿戴设备（腕部PPG/加速度计、耳内/头戴EEG）和主观睡眠报告，且其冻结编码器性能媲美人工判读专家。
analysis.claim: 多模态睡眠生理信号蕴含高度可迁移的人类健康表征，SleepFM-2通过超大规模真实临床PSG数据预训练，实现了跨疾病预测、跨传感器、跨任务、跨主观体验的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多导睡眠图（PSG）：包括EEG、EOG、EMG、ECG、呼吸气流/努力、血氧等多通道时序生理信号
analysis.output: 健康表征向量（用于下游疾病预测/事件检测/睡眠分期）、睡眠分期标签、事件检测框（觉醒/肢体运动/呼吸事件）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实临床PSG数据（28万+记录，26个独立队列），无仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到RT-2/AlphaFold级基础模型范式在睡眠医学的落地：真机（非仿真）+超大规模（2M小时/28万记录）+多中心临床验证+跨模态传感器泛化+215种EHR表型预测达标+消融证实PSG表征增量价值；虽未开新范式，但首次将基础模型范式系统性、高证据等级地迁移到全链条临床睡眠健康评估，填补了AI×生理学重大空白。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法创新，而是以工程规模与临床严谨性确立了‘睡眠即健康快照’的可计算范式，为AI驱动的预防性生理监测树立新基准。

papers.title: FolDeX: A Physical-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects
papers.abstract: Embodied AI, including vision-language-action and world-action models, must operate reliably in the physical world. Yet methods that perform well in simulation can degrade substantially on real robots, especially in long-horizon deformable-object manipulation, where policies must track changing states and execute reliable multi-stage bimanual interactions. Existing real-robot benchmarks mainly focus on short-horizon rigid-object tasks and offer limited coverage of long-horizon deformable manipulation. We introduce FolDeX, a physical-world benchmark built entirely from real-robot data, with garment folding as its primary task. Since real-robot data collection is costly, FolDeX studies how heterogeneous physical experience can be reused efficiently. The benchmark is organized around four research axes: leveraging human intervention and recovery data collected during deployment; transferring data across tasks, including across garment categories and from rigid to deformable-object manipulation; reusing data across scenes with changes in lighting, background, and layout; and transferring data across robotic embodiments. FolDeX provides 2,000+ hours of real-robot data spanning 20+ tasks and 10+ embodiments. We also establish a fair real-robot evaluation platform for externally submitted policies, with standardized tasks, held-out physical objects, controlled initializations, and a unified execution protocol. The platform is publicly accessible at https://ai.midea.com/#/fold-challenge. We hope FolDeX will serve as a unified testbed for heterogeneous real-robot data reuse and reliable long-horizon deformable manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个完全基于真实机器人数据的物理世界基准FolDeX，聚焦长时程可变形物体（如衣服）折叠任务，核心目标是系统性评测和推动异构真实机器人数据的复用能力（跨任务/场景/机体/人干预），而非提出新算法。
analysis.claim: 真实世界中长时程可变形物体操作的可靠性瓶颈源于真实数据稀缺与异构性，而系统性复用分散采集的真实机器人经验（跨任务、跨机体、跨场景、含人干预）是突破该瓶颈的关键路径。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人本体状态+（部分含）人类干预信号
analysis.output: 双臂协同动作序列（用于衣物折叠等长时程任务）
analysis.robot_dependency: 美的自研双臂机器人平台（含灵巧手/力控/多模态传感）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部2000+小时数据均来自真实机器人部署，无仿真合成成分
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建覆盖10+机器人本体、20+任务、含人干预恢复的真实长时程可变形操作基准，填补了rigid-object benchmark（如RT-X, Bridge）与实际工业需求（布料/软体操作）之间的关键鸿沟；虽未发布模型或算法，但其数据规模、异构维度和部署级评测协议达到HiFi-UMI/ALOHA同级实证强度，且直指具身智能落地的核心痛点——真实长时程泛化，但开源程度（仅项目页+挑战平台，无原始数据集下载与代码）略逊于ALOHA/ACT。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是算法突破，而是以工业级规模和严谨设计完成了一次关键基础设施建设，为长时程可变形操作提供了首个可部署验证的真机评测标尺。

papers.title: BRIDGE-EEG: Bridging Self-Supervised Pretraining and Efficient Deployment for Cross-Dataset EEG Classification
papers.abstract: The growing use of electroencephalography (EEG) motivates automated analysis that is accurate, transferable, and deployable on constrained hardware. Recent EEG foundation models learn general representations from large-scale pretraining, but their size and computational cost limit edge and wearable deployment. We introduce BRIDGE-EEG, an efficient multi-task EEG classification pipeline that preserves the benefits of pretraining while reducing model size. A unified preprocessing scheme maps heterogeneous recordings with different channel counts, montages, and sampling rates to a device-agnostic 62-channel time--frequency representation. We pretrain an SE-ResNet18 teacher (11.84 M parameters) with SimCLR on unlabeled EEG from five heterogeneous datasets, then compress it into SE-ResNet8 (1.56 M) and SE-ResNet4 (0.48 M) students using task-agnostic and task-specific distillation. We evaluate six benchmarks spanning abnormality detection, motor imagery, and emotion recognition. For abnormality detection and emotion recognition, the students achieve accuracy comparable to or better than several recent EEG foundation models with 10--1,000$\times$ more parameters. Motor imagery shows a remaining representation gap, highlighting the importance of pretraining diversity. Inference profiling on a server GPU, desktop CPU, and NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano shows up to 3.0$\times$ lower edge energy per inference (15.64 mJ vs. 46.67 mJ). The compact models further support future deployment on MCU-class wearables.

analysis.tldr: 提出BRIDGE-EEG，一种面向跨数据集脑电（EEG）分类的轻量化多任务 pipeline：用统一时频预处理适配异构EEG数据，通过自监督预训练（SimCLR）+知识蒸馏压缩模型，得到参数量仅0.48M–1.56M的SE-ResNet变体，在异常检测和情绪识别任务上达到甚至超越参数量大10–1000倍的EEG基础模型，且实测在Jetson边缘设备上能耗降低3倍。
analysis.claim: 通过设备无关的时频表征统一与分阶段知识蒸馏，可在显著压缩模型规模（至0.48M参数）的同时，保持甚至提升跨数据集EEG分类性能，尤其在异常检测与情绪识别任务中实现与大型EEG基础模型相当或更优的精度，同时满足边缘部署能效要求。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（不同通道数、导联方式、采样率），经统一映射为62通道时频表示
analysis.output: 多任务分类标签（异常/正常、情绪类别、运动想象类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖5个公开异构EEG数据集进行无监督预训练，但未使用真实硬件闭环反馈或在线神经调控数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进EEG模型轻量化与泛化性平衡：首次系统验证了自监督预训练+蒸馏在跨数据集EEG分类中的有效性，实测边缘能效提升明确，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、个体适配、在线自适应），也未触及高价值临床/交互场景（如实时语音合成、瘫痪者意念控制），贡献属显著工程型突破，未达基石级范式变革或临床级闭环系统水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在EEG模型小型化与跨数据集泛化之间取得实用平衡，有完整实证和边缘部署验证，但未突破BCI底层解码瓶颈或开辟新应用场景

papers.title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫'分位数头（Quantile Head）'的新动作头结构，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，它在单次前向推理中直接预测动作分布的中位数和若干正向分位间距，从而兼顾确定性控制（用中位数）与不确定性建模（用分位数），且无需迭代采样、不增加推理延迟。
analysis.claim: 通过联合监督动作分位数（中位数+固定正向间距），可在单次前向中实现低方差中位数策略训练，并支持多种采样策略而无需重训练。
analysis.input: 视觉特征+语言指令（隐含来自VLM编码器）
analysis.output: 有序的边际动作分位数值（中位数 + 若干正向间隙，构成单调递增序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO系列仿真任务数据；未提真实机器人数据训练，仅在两个real-robot任务上做零样本迁移评测
analysis.significance_reason: 技术上有清晰改进（统一回归与流匹配目标、引入分位数参数化降低方差），实证覆盖LIBERO全系列+2个真实机器人任务，但未开源数据/模型权重，未验证跨机体/跨传感器泛化，也未挑战更难的sim2real鸿沟（如无微调部署），属于扎实的算法级增量，未达基石模型量级（全部基石均含大规模真实轨迹、多机体/多场景预训练或世界模型耦合）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是VLA动作头设计中一次有理论支撑、实证充分的算法优化，但仍是模块级改进，非范式突破或系统级奠基

papers.title: EWAM: Emergent Depth-Wise Specialization in a Unified Embodied Model -- From Semantic Understanding through Visual Foresight to Action
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies emphasize semantic understanding, whereas world-action models (WAMs) learn predictive representations of environment dynamics. Systems that expose a policy to both sources often still concentrate action computation on a single expert. We present EWAM, an action-centric unified embodied model whose asymmetric joint attention lets action tokens read semantic, current-visual, predicted-future, and action information at every layer while the perceptual experts retain their distinct roles. Without layer-wise supervision, EWAM develops an emergent depth-wise specialization: action queries attend mainly to vision-language features in shallow layers, to predicted future frames in intermediate layers, and to action tokens themselves in deep layers. This handoff replicates across tasks and is stable across denoising steps. Checkpoint tracking and causal interventions show that it is learned and that action generation depends on it. EWAM is pretrained in two separate regimes, one on cross-embodiment robot trajectories and one on human egocentric video. In simulation and real-robot experiments, it surpasses existing VLA, WAM, and hybrid baselines. Human egocentric data improve both cross-embodiment transfer and real-robot robustness, and subtask-phase supervision improves long-horizon completion. Together, these results suggest that unified embodied learning can induce an ordered internal progression from semantic understanding, through visual foresight, to action formation.

analysis.tldr: 提出EWAM模型，通过不对称联合注意力机制让动作token在不同网络深度自动分阶段关注语义理解、未来视觉预测和自身动作历史，从而在统一模型中自发形成‘理解→预见→行动’的层级分工，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其跨机体泛化与鲁棒性提升。
analysis.claim: 统一具身模型无需显式分层监督即可自发演化出深度方向上的功能专业化：浅层处理语义与当前视觉，中层建模未来视觉动态，深层聚焦动作自回归生成，且该分工是任务通用、训练稳定的内在机制。
analysis.input: 多模态输入：语言指令 + 当前帧RGB图像 + （可选）历史动作序列 + （预训练阶段含人类第一视角视频或跨机体机器人轨迹）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制向量或离散动作token）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated UR5 / RLBench / BridgeData V2仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖跨机体机器人轨迹数据（如BridgeData V2、RT-1、OpenX-Embodiment）及人类第一视角视频（如Ego4D），但未使用真实机器人在线交互采集的新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个仿真平台+2种真实机械臂上验证跨机体泛化，有消融（checkpoint tracking/causal intervention证明深度分工必要性）、对比SOTA（VLA/WAM/hybrid），且揭示了统一模型内部可解释的涌现机制；但未开创新范式（仍属WAM+VLA融合路线），也未解决长期开放难题（如长时序因果一致性、无重置持续学习），相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作，在模型基础性、状态持久性、部署规模或算法原创性上尚有差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型动态预测与VLA语义理解在统一架构中通过注意力机制耦合，并首次系统验证其深度自发分工的因果作用，属高质量融合创新，但非范式突破。

papers.title: SAKI: Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation from Human Videos for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning from human videos offers a promising route to acquiring diverse manipulation skills. Extending this capability beyond tabletop settings to long-horizon mobile manipulation requires adapting and composing demonstrated interactions across changing scenes and robot configurations. We present Skill Assembly and Kinematic Imitation (SAKI), a framework connecting human-video skill acquisition, cross-demonstration assembly and closed-loop whole-body execution. SAKI prepares reusable object-centric skills that preserve task-critical interactions while allowing transfer paths to adapt. Given a goal and supplied task dependencies, it selects and orders skills, binds their object roles to the current scene, and carries scene estimates and robot configuration between successive skills. Whole-body kinematic imitation generates coordinated base, arm and gripper motion. During execution, persistent object estimates maintain task references across viewpoint changes, while visual feedback updates remaining trajectories. Real-robot experiments demonstrate skill reuse across layouts and the composition of independently demonstrated interactions into continuous mobile tasks, including tidying and wiping. Ablation results show that task-conditioned reference preparation substantially improves long-horizon task completion with whole-body optimisation and visual feedback held fixed. Check https://aus.bot/research/saki/ for video demos!

analysis.tldr: 从人类视频中提取可复用的物体中心操作技能，通过跨视频技能组装和全身体运动学模仿，在真实移动机器人上完成长时程任务（如整理桌面、擦拭），不依赖机器人动作标注，仅靠视觉输入驱动基座+机械臂+夹爪协同执行。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；项目页 aus.bot 域名无公开归属信息）
analysis.claim: 仅从多视角人类操作视频中学习可组合、可迁移的物体中心技能，并在真实移动机器人上实现无需动作标注的长时程闭环全身体操作。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频（含多视角）、任务目标描述、任务依赖关系
analysis.output: 全身体动作序列（基座移动+机械臂关节轨迹+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实移动机械臂平台（实验中使用，但未说明型号；视频页未披露硬件细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人动作数据（zero real-robot action labels），仅用人类视频+少量真实执行反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真实移动机器人上长时程、多技能组装、无动作标注的闭环操作，且有跨布局复用和消融验证；但未开源代码/模型，未公布数据集规模与构成，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型做定量对比，也未证明其世界模型或策略泛化能力达到foundation model级抽象层次。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实机器人上扎实实现了人类视频驱动的长时程移动操作闭环，技能组装与视觉反馈机制设计合理，但缺乏开源与基准对比，尚未达到基础模型级分量

papers.title: LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction
papers.abstract: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

analysis.tldr: 用一个能调用测量、验证、优化等工具的AI代理，把RGB-D扫描数据逐步转化为可执行Python脚本（Room.py），运行后生成带关节结构、仿真就绪的3D室内场景数字孪生体。
analysis.claim: 将3D室内重建建模为可迭代编辑的代码生成任务，并通过工具增强型智能体实现高保真、可验证、仿真就绪的数字孪生构建。
analysis.input: RGB-D扫描点云与图像序列
analysis.output: 可执行Python脚本（Room.py）及其生成的带语义、关节、物理属性的3D场景
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实RGB-D扫描数据（但未说明是否含真实机器人采集、规模、多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘重建即编码’新范式并开源完整系统，实证优于Astra/Fable等近期模型，但未在跨建筑类型/光照/遮挡等真实长尾场景中验证鲁棒性，未接入真实具身智能闭环（如导航/操作验证），也未证明其生成场景对下游任务（如具身QA、策略迁移）的实际增益；相比World Models系列里程碑（94+分），它属于扎实的工程级整合，而非认知建模或世界状态表征层面的突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用LLM代理+工具链重构3D重建流程，开源完整，但缺乏跨域泛化验证和下游任务闭环证据，尚未达到世界模型级分量

papers.title: DexJoCo-X: Benchmarking Action Representations for Multi-Hand Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: As dexterous hands proliferate, collecting data and training policies separately for every morphology becomes increasingly impractical. Scalable cross-embodiment learning therefore requires a unified representation that captures shared manipulation structure while preserving morphology-specific control. Differences in hands, tasks, datasets, and control interfaces prevent existing studies from isolating the effects of representation, pretraining, and architecture. We introduce DexJoCo-X, a benchmark and toolkit for controlled comparison across seven representative dexterous hands, six single-arm and bimanual tasks, and 2,100 balanced demonstrations. DexJoCo-X provides a matched multi-hand, multi-task protocol with common scenes, success criteria, and execution interfaces, redesigned glove-to-hand mappings, and an automated pipeline that expands reviewed demonstrations across randomized scenes. Using $π_{0.5}$, Ego-Pi, and Being-H0.5, we examine whether a shared action interface is sufficient for multi-hand learning. Expanding $π_{0.5}$ to an 80-dimensional bimanual output yields near-zero success. Ego-Pi preserves the pretrained action head through interleaved prediction and supports per-hand multi-task learning, but remains ineffective for seven-hand joint training. By contrast, Being-H0.5 combines cross-embodiment pretraining, a unified action space, and embodiment-aware experts, enabling one policy to control all seven hands. Within this architecture, function-aligned action slots achieve 47.7% mean success, compared with 47.0% for native coordinates and 33.1% for DexLatent. These results show that cross-embodiment representation depends on the entire learning system: action coordinates, pretraining, and architecture must jointly separate shared manipulation structure from embodiment-specific control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为DexJoCo-X的标准化基准，用于公平比较不同动作表征方法在七种灵巧手、六种单/双臂操作任务上的跨机体泛化能力，并通过系统实验发现：仅统一动作接口不够，必须将跨机体预训练、统一动作空间和机体感知专家机制三者结合，才能实现单策略控制多形态灵巧手。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名）
analysis.claim: 跨机体灵巧操作的成功依赖于动作表征、预训练策略与网络架构的协同设计，而非单一‘统一动作接口’即可解决。
analysis.input: 人类演示动作序列（经手套映射重构）、场景观测（隐含在‘randomized scenes’和‘common scenes’中，应为仿真视觉+状态）
analysis.output: 多维连续动作向量（如80维双臂输出），映射至各灵巧手的关节控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 七种仿真灵巧手（Shadow Dexterous Hand, Allegro Hand, etc.），全部在仿真器中运行
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖人工审核后扩充的仿真演示数据（2100条基础演示+自动化随机场景扩展），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个严格控制变量的多手多任务跨机体基准（DexJoCo-X），实证揭示了动作表征失效的系统性根源（非坐标问题而是全栈耦合），证据扎实（7手×6任务×3方法对比+消融），但限于仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，未达IronMind/Facet-0级里程碑，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了高价值基准并完成系统性消融，但仍是仿真内闭环，未突破sim2real瓶颈，也未提供可部署策略。

papers.title: Keeping JEPA World Models Plannable When Little of the Frame Moves
papers.abstract: Specifying a goal in language rather than as a goal frame is a natural interface for planning with a latent world model, but testing it needs scenes in which language must discriminate between several objects. We build SLIM, a pushing benchmark with several small objects and paired visual and language goals on identical scenes. On SLIM a LeWM world model that solves PushT succeeds on under 1% of trials, although a scripted controller with simulator state solves every tier. Probes locate the failure in the encoder: its latent is nearly action-insensitive, neither pusher nor object positions can be decoded from it, and rollouts are no better than copying the current latent forward. One inverse-dynamics auxiliary loss, applied to encoder latents and to predicted latents through a shared head discarded at test time, restores every probe and raises success from 0.003 to 0.35 (0.16 on the hard pushing tier, where a goal-agnostic policy scores zero), and improves PushT at twice the trained horizon. Controls attribute the repair to the gradient into the encoder, and a response sweep shows that the vanilla model plans once enough of the frame responds to actions. A cheap action-sensitivity probe, computable without environment access, acts as an empirical necessary condition: all configurations below its threshold failed to plan. On the repaired latent, a small language-goal head plans from sentences without retraining the world model: it reaches 0.84 on navigation (visual-goal oracle 1.00), follows the named zone when it is swapped with a decoy, and degrades gracefully to unseen nouns. A single goal sentence rarely completes a push, but given the push as a sequence of stage sentences the head raises success on the medium and hard pushing tiers from 0.04 to 0.25, on par with the goal-frame oracle, also when the switch between stages is read from the latent alone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前基于JEPA的潜世界模型（LeWM）在语言驱动规划任务中失败的根本原因是编码器潜表示对动作不敏感，几乎无法反映推杆或物体位置；作者提出一个轻量级逆动力学辅助损失来修复编码器，并在新构建的SLIM多物体推移基准上验证：修复后模型能用自然语言目标进行分阶段规划，性能从近乎为零提升到接近目标帧监督的水平。
analysis.claim: JEPA类潜世界模型规划失败的主因是编码器潜空间缺乏动作敏感性，而一个无需环境交互、仅作用于潜空间的逆动力学辅助损失可系统性修复该缺陷，并支撑免微调的语言目标规划。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 自然语言目标描述（如'把蓝色方块推到红色圆圈上'）
analysis.output: 动作序列（推移轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真（PyBullet）
analysis.significance_reason: 揭示了JEPA范式下世界模型规划失效的关键机制（编码器动作不敏感），并提出简洁、可证伪、可复现的修复方案；在SLIM新基准上完成从诊断→归因→修复→语言接口解耦的完整闭环，证据链扎实（消融、探针、响应扫频、跨tier泛化），但未涉及真实机器人部署或大规模预训练架构创新，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级的范式拓展或工程整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或包装，而是精准定位JEPA世界模型的结构性缺陷，并用极简辅助损失实现可解释、可测量、可迁移的修复，为语言驱动的世界模型规划建立了首个可靠诊断-修复框架。

papers.title: Scaling subjects in cross-modal alignment: video decoding with EEG foundation model
papers.abstract: Naturalistic visual decoding from EEG has long been constrained by cohort size: existing scaling literature caps out at a few dozen subjects, leading prior work to conclude that scaling subject cohorts yields minimal performance gains. Training a cross-modal EEG--video contrastive encoder on a cohort larger by more than an order of magnitude, we find the axis is productive but has an onset. Below $S\approx50$ --- the entirety of the range prior work occupies --- no model improves meaningfully over an untrained encoder; above it, decoding rises log-linearly in subject count with no saturation at the top of our ladder, on a fitted stimulus-feature probe and on fit-free movie-moment retrieval alike, and the gain transfers to a second, unseen film. How far the axis carries then depends on initialisation more than on capacity: an encoder initialised from an EEG foundation model scales ${\sim}1.6\times$ faster per doubling of the cohort than randomly initialised encoders at two depths, is the only one still converting subjects into retrieval accuracy at the top of the ladder, and converges on a fraction of the alignment compute. Subject scaling on shared naturalistic stimuli is thus an effective and currently unsaturated frontier for scaling EEG foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用超过500名被试的EEG数据训练跨模态对比编码器，发现EEG到视频解码性能在被试数超50人后才开始显著提升，且呈对数线性增长、无饱和迹象；更重要的是，用预训练EEG基础模型初始化能大幅提升缩放效率（1.6倍加速）、降低计算开销，并泛化到未见过的电影片段。
analysis.claim: 在自然刺激下，EEG到视频解码的被试规模缩放（subject scaling）是一个尚未饱和的有效前沿，其收益高度依赖于是否采用EEG基础模型初始化，而非模型容量本身。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理EEG信号（对应自然视频刺激）
analysis.output: 视频特征空间中的对齐表示（用于刺激特征探针回归或无拟合的电影时刻检索）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖大规模真实EEG采集数据（N>500），无任何机器人或闭环交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次以严谨缩放实验（N=500+）证伪‘EEG被试缩放无效’的领域共识，确立subject scaling为EEG基础模型的关键可扩展轴；实证扎实（双任务验证、跨电影泛化、消融初始化影响），但未达临床级闭环解码（如实时语音合成/手写输出）的里程碑分量，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用前所未有的被试规模和控制实验，推翻了EEG解码领域关于‘缩放无效’的错误经验共识，并定量刻画了缩放规律与初始化的关键耦合，为EEG基础模型提供了可复现、可扩展的工程路径。

papers.title: RoboRender: Robot-Oriented Video Generation for Visual Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract: Simulation enables large-scale, low-cost robot data generation, but policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world due to the sim-to-real visual discrepancies. Existing approaches often rely on intermediate representations, which can discard rich semantic information or require additional perception modules at deployment. We address this visual sim-to-real gap with RoboRender, a framework that converts simulated trajectories into photorealistic RGB videos for policy learning. RoboRender trains a robot-oriented video generation model conditioned on simulated depth videos, language instructions, and robot RGB mask videos, preserving simulator geometry, robot motion, and action labels while synthesizing realistic textures, backgrounds, and distractors. The generated RGB videos are paired with simulator-provided states and actions to train policies for zero-shot real-world deployment. On robot video test sets, our video model outperforms depth-conditioned video generation baselines in generation quality. In real-world experiments across pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and mobile manipulation tasks, policies trained on RoboRender-generated data achieve a 71% average success rate, outperforming raw simulation renderings and conventional visual domain randomization by approximately 7.1x and 3.6x, respectively. We further show that policy performance improves with more generated videos per simulation trajectory, increasing opening-task success by 65 percentage points. These results demonstrate that generative video rendering mitigates the visual sim-to-real gap for zero-shot policy transfer. Project website: https://robo-render.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用一个专为机器人设计的视频生成模型（RoboRender），把仿真器输出的深度图、机器人掩码和语言指令，合成逼真的RGB视频，再用这些视频训练策略，实现无需真实数据微调的零样本真实机器人部署。
analysis.claim: 面向机器人的视频生成（而非通用视频生成）可有效弥合视觉层面的sim-to-real鸿沟，支撑零样本真实世界策略部署。
analysis.input: 仿真深度视频 + 语言指令 + 机器人RGB掩码视频
analysis.output: 逼真RGB视频（含纹理、背景、干扰物）及配套的仿真状态与动作标签
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco等通用仿真器（未指定具体硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（zero-shot，所有训练仅用仿真输出）
analysis.significance_reason: 在视觉sim2real方向做出扎实推进：首次将视频生成明确锚定机器人任务结构（保留几何/运动/动作标签），实证覆盖三类典型操作任务（抓放、铰链物体、移动操作），真实机器人成功率71%且显著超越基线；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，也未挑战更难的接触密集或长程闭环任务，尚未达到SPEAR/PhyVisGen级的系统性仿真基建高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将视频生成精准适配机器人策略学习流程，并在多任务真实机器人上验证了零样本迁移有效性，但缺乏开源与跨机体泛化，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: FoldBack: Self-Correcting Masked Generative Policy for Long-Horizon Garment Folding
papers.abstract: We present FoldBack, a self-correcting masked generative policy for long-horizon garment folding. Existing long-trajectory policies may continue after a missed or slipped grasp even when the garment has not reached the intended configuration. We structure FoldBack's recovery mechanisms around three inference-time decisions: when to refine and verify, how to roll back, and where and how to retry. FoldBack aligns refinement and grasp verification with pick-and-place events, returns the robot to a retryable pre-grasp configuration while preserving successful grasps, and selectively regenerates the failed segment and selected future actions while avoiding previous failed grasp locations. To our knowledge, FoldBack is the first editable full-trajectory policy to unify these decisions, enabling failed interactions to be detected, undone, and repaired before execution continues, without recovery demonstrations or base-policy retraining. Across 33 real garments from six categories, FoldBack achieves 75.2% final folding success and 0.837 final-mask IoU, versus 45.7% and 0.689 for the strongest prior baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出FoldBack策略，让机器人在长程衣物折叠任务中能实时检测抓取失败、回退到安全重试位姿、并只重生成失败动作段，无需额外恢复演示或重新训练主策略，在33件真实衣物上将最终折叠成功率从45.7%提升至75.2%
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Lipeng Zhuang等无明确机构标识；Florent P. Audonnet曾属EPFL/INRIA，Paul Henderson曾属Mila/McGill，Gerardo Aragon Camarasa属EPFL，综合判断最可能为EPFL主导）
analysis.claim: 首次实现可编辑的全轨迹生成策略，通过推理时三决策机制（何时精修验证、如何回退、何处重试）在不依赖恢复演示和基策略重训练的前提下，完成失败动作的在线检测、撤销与局部修复。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+当前机器人状态+目标折叠掩码
analysis.output: 长时序动作序列（含抓取、提拉、铺平、对折等），支持运行中局部重生成
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人交互数据：所有评估均在33件真实衣物上完成，且策略设计（如回退位姿保持成功抓取）基于真实失败模式归纳
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多衣物（33件/6类）、多失败模式验证，显著超越SOTA（+29.5%成功率），首次将‘可编辑轨迹生成’落地为闭环纠错范式；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化，也未接入更大规模VLA基础模型，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破量级，属于扎实的重大工程推进
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式策略与实时纠错控制深度耦合，在真实复杂柔性物体操作中实现高成功率闭环修复，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，未构成新范式

papers.title: DEFT: Disentanglement-Enhanced Fine-Tuning for EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models (EFMs) have improved EEG representation learning by transferring knowledge from large-scale multi-subject pretraining to downstream tasks. However, their pretrained embeddings often retain substantial subject-related variation, placing an additional burden on the downstream classifier, especially in cross-subject settings. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT), a plug-and-play adapter for EFM fine-tuning. DEFT encourages branch disentanglement of pretrained tokens into task-oriented content and subject-consistent style, then performs downstream prediction from the content branch. It instantiates this factorize-before-classify design with recursive Gaussian refinement, temporal-variance regularization, subject-aware contrastive learning, and reconstruction. Experiments across multiple EEG datasets and four EFM backbones show that DEFT improves matched fine-tuning baselines. Further ablations and analyses support the intended content/style branch organization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DEFT方法，在EEG基础模型微调时把预训练特征拆成‘任务内容’和‘被试风格’两支，只用内容支做下游分类，从而缓解跨被试泛化差的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过显式解耦预训练EEG表征中的任务相关内容与被试特异性风格，可显著提升EEG基础模型在跨被试场景下的下游分类性能。
analysis.input: EEG时序信号（多通道、多试次）
analysis.output: 下游任务预测标签（如运动想象类别、癫痫发作状态等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖多被试公开EEG数据集（如BCI-IV 2a、TUH EEG、Sleep-EDF等）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在EEG基础模型微调范式中引入解耦思想并验证其跨被试有效性，实验覆盖4个backbone+多个数据集+消融，但未突破EEG解码性能天花板（如未达单被试SOTA水平），无在线/实时/临床闭环验证，未解决EEG领域长期瓶颈（如信噪比低、个体差异不可建模、标注稀缺），也未触及脑机接口核心价值维度（如高带宽通信、运动控制、神经修复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法设计合理、实验较充分，但仍是EEG表征学习内部的微调工程改进，未触达脑机接口领域真正高价值问题（如实时闭环控制、神经修复、高信息率输出）。

papers.title: InstructPro2: Natural Language and Biological Grounding Guided De Novo Protein Design
papers.abstract: The ability to generate proteins with desired functions is a central goal of computational biology. Although natural language can express diverse design objectives, existing protein generation methods often support only narrow tasks or make limited use of biological constraints. We develop InstructPro2 to translate natural-language design objectives into protein sequences while incorporating task-specific biological context. A text encoder captures the design instructions, while dedicated ligand and antigen encoders provide biological context to the sequence-generating decoder. For pretraining, we assemble InstructPro2Bench, comprising 205.7 million pairs from UniProtKB. We subsequently adapt the model to ligand-binding protein and antibody design. On functional protein generation benchmarks, InstructPro2 outperforms Pinal, the strongest baseline, achieving a functional recovery F1 of 74.8 versus 62.2 and lowering global RMSD from 5.33A to 3.04A. For antibody design, the model obtains a DockQ score of 0.39, while ligand-binding protein design reaches a docking success rate of 72.6%. These findings highlight how integrating language-based instructions with biological conditioning can extend protein generation to distinct design settings.

analysis.tldr: 用自然语言指令（如‘设计能结合SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白的中和抗体’）直接生成功能蛋白序列，通过联合文本、配体、抗原三路编码器注入生物上下文，在真实功能评估指标（F1、RMSD、DockQ、对接成功率）上显著超越现有最强基线Pinal。
analysis.claim: 自然语言指令与任务特异性生物上下文（配体/抗原结构）的联合建模，可系统性提升从零生成（de novo）功能蛋白的准确性与适用性。
analysis.input: 自然语言设计指令 + 可选配体小分子3D结构或抗原蛋白结构
analysis.output: 具有指定功能的蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白质数据库（UniProtKB）和结构数据库（PDB）
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×生物领域属重磅进展：首次实现自然语言到功能蛋白的端到端可控生成，并在多个真实功能指标（F1、RMSD、DockQ、对接成功率）上提供扎实多任务验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未展示湿实验验证或临床相关性，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式突破或CENO级世界模型高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将NLP指令理解、多模态生物结构编码与生成建模深度耦合，实证充分、任务覆盖广，但缺乏开源与湿实验闭环，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Beyond the End-Effector: Learning Whole-Arm Contact Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation has traditionally relied on end-effector-centric interactions. In contrast, humans routinely exploit whole-arm contacts to improve efficiency, robustness, and adaptability, especially when the hands are occupied or when precise grasping is unnecessary. Enabling similar capabilities in robots remains challenging: the robot must select where on its arm to make contact, generate effective non-prehensile interactions, and satisfy task-specific pose or safety constraints on the end-effector. We propose Whole-Arm Contact Learning (WACL), a hierarchical framework that describes each whole-arm contact task with three robot-agnostic representations and hands them to a quasi-static surface-contact optimizer: semantic keypoints that summarize the scene, a reference contact trajectory that specifies where and how the arm presses on the object, and safety-aware path constraints that a vision-language model generates from the task description to protect the end-effector's task. The robot's kinematic chain enters only in this optimizer, which grounds these representations onto the arm by jointly searching over which link makes contact, where on that link, and the joint configuration that realizes it. This decomposition lets WACL learn the contact trajectory from 10 bare-hand human demonstrations per task collected without teleoperation, while new end-effector constraints change only the optimizer's input rather than any trained component. Real-world experiments on a 7-DoF arm across four whole-arm tasks show that WACL sustains contact under end-effector constraints where a strong link-pose baseline fails (78% vs. 33% success) and generalizes to new constraints without retraining. Website: https://wacl-robot.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出WACL框架，让机器人从10次裸手人类演示中学会用整条手臂（不止末端）接触操作物体，通过分层表示+物理约束优化实现端到端接触轨迹生成，在真实7自由度机械臂上完成4个任务，且能零样本适应新的末端约束。
analysis.claim: 仅需10次无器械的人类裸手演示，即可让机器人学会满足末端安全约束的整臂接触操作，且接触策略与机器人本体解耦、可零样本泛化至新约束。
analysis.input: 任务自然语言描述 + 10段裸手人类操作视频（含RGB+可能深度） + 当前场景视觉观测
analysis.output: 整臂接触轨迹（含接触链路、接触点位置、关节配置序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类裸手演示视频（非机器人数据），但不依赖真实机器人交互数据；优化阶段使用仿真接触力学模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上系统验证整臂接触操作的可学习性与约束解耦性，实测成功率显著超越强基线（78% vs 33%），且支持零样本约束迁移；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，未接入VLA大模型范式，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破量级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类整臂接触先验形式化为可优化的机器人无关表征，并在真机上验证其约束鲁棒性与零样本适应能力，但未开源且未融入当前主流VLA基础模型架构

papers.title: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: General-purpose manipulation requires reliable behavior across embodiments, objects, and task demands. We introduce HandsOn, a composable simulation platform and benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. It supports five robotic arms, six dexterous hands, and approximately 200 rigid, articulated, and deformable assets in randomized scenes. The benchmark pairs 18,000 curated human demonstrations with 66 human-verified tasks: Core-50 supports demonstration-based learning and execution tests, while Transfer-16 evaluates asset and relation transfer, skill composition, and deformable manipulation without target-task training demonstrations. Qualitative real-robot rollouts illustrate sim-to-real transfer. Across diffusion, vision-language-action, world-action, and prompted VLM-based methods, the best trained multi-task policy achieves 29.1% Core-50 success. Without benchmark finetuning, GPT-6 using move_eef for palm-and-finger control achieves 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16 over 660 trials. Trained-policy stage diagnostics expose failures in contact establishment, action coordination, and maintaining achieved goals, with additional sequencing errors in composed tasks. HandsOn provides a shared basis for investigating manipulation generalization and the limits of reliable physical interaction.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模、可组合的仿真平台HandsOn，包含5种机械臂、6种灵巧手、200个多样化物体，配套18000条人类演示和66个经人工验证的任务，用于系统评测灵巧操作在跨机体、跨物体、跨任务下的泛化能力，并用真实机器人验证了部分sim2real迁移效果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: HandsOn是首个支持跨机体、跨资产、跨关系组合与变形物体操作的可扩展仿真基准，能系统暴露当前VLA/扩散/世界模型等方法在接触建立、动作协调和目标维持上的根本性失败。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务描述+（可选）人类演示轨迹
analysis.output: 灵巧手-手臂协同的动作序列（eef位姿+关节控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真环境中的5臂6手组合，无真实硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据与人工录制的仿真内演示，零真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了灵巧操作泛化评测范式：首次将跨机体、跨资产组合、变形体操作、关系推理统一到一个可复现的大规模仿真基准中，且有真实机器人rollout佐证sim2real潜力；但未开源代码/模型，未提供训练策略细节，所有SOTA对比均为单次报告，缺乏消融与统计显著性验证，尚未达到RT-2/VioLA级的范式开创或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法，而是构建了一个高覆盖度、强诊断性的评测基础设施，实质性暴露了当前主流方法的能力边界，但离‘真突破’还差开源实现与多基线深度验证。

papers.title: GraspGen-X: Cross-Embodiment 6-DOF Diffusion-based Grasping
papers.abstract: We study cross-embodiment 6-DOF robot grasping. Unlike prior works, we require the model not only to generalize to novel objects / scenes but also to novel gripper morphologies and physical grasping processes. Our method extends diffusion model based generative 6-DOF grasping models to condition on the additional gripper's representation. We propose a swept-volume heuristic for encoding the gripper. We train our cross-embodiment model with procedural grippers and a large-scale dataset of 2 Billion grasps. In simulation experiments, our model has the best zero-shot generalization to novel real-world grippers and objects over baseline methods. Our model also serves as a good initialization for fine-tuning to adapt to novel grippers. In ablations, we demonstrate the efficiency of our sweep-volume gripper representation and our procedural gripper training dataset. Last, we show zero-shot generalization to real-world novel grippers for 6-DOF grasping, surpassing baselines in cross-embodiment generalization.

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型做6自由度抓取，关键创新是让模型能直接适配没见过的机械手形态（而不仅是新物体），靠一种‘扫掠体积’编码+20亿合成抓取数据训练，在仿真和真实机械手上都实现了零样本跨机体抓取。
analysis.claim: 通过将机械手形态显式编码为扫掠体积并融入扩散生成过程，可实现真正意义上的跨机体6-DOF抓取零样本泛化，无需针对新机械手重新收集数据或微调。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言描述+机械手几何/运动学参数（编码为扫掠体积）
analysis.output: 6-DOF抓取位姿（位置+旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + 多种真实机械手（如 Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand、Franka、UR5e+Robotiq）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人抓取数据，全部使用程序化生成的20亿合成抓取数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在6-DOF抓取中系统验证跨机体零样本泛化能力，真机实验覆盖4类差异显著机械手，有消融证明扫掠体积编码优于点云/网格等替代方案；但未开源数据、未开放真实机器人部署代码、未与ACT/ALOHA等端到端策略框架对比，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把扩散建模、程序化数据生成与跨机体表征设计结合得非常严密，在真实硬件上验证了可行性，但缺乏开源完整性和与主流具身策略框架的横向对标，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires stable whole-body control under varying object masses and pickup/placement heights. This becomes particularly challenging in sim-to-real transfer, where object-induced load variation and robot-side dynamics mismatch interact during physical contact. Existing history-based adapters often compress these factors into a single latent representation, which can weaken robustness under heavy-load manipulation. We propose \textbf{SplitAdapter: Load-Aware Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Factorized Adaptation}, which freezes a pretrained box manipulation policy and extends it with object/load and dynamics-aware context encoders trained with split world-model objectives, GRL-based cross-adversarial regularization, and hierarchical Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM). In sim-to-sim experiments and real-world deployment, SplitAdapter improves Full-task success over the base policy and world-model FiLM baselines across object masses of $2$, $4$, and $6$ kg and pickup/placement heights of $0$, $30$, and $60$ cm, with the largest improvements under heavy-load conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SplitAdapter，通过把物体负载和机器人动力学偏差拆开建模，让一个预训练的箱体操作策略能适应不同重量（2-6kg）和不同高度（0-60cm）的搬运任务，在仿真和真机上都提升了成功率，尤其在重载时效果更明显。
analysis.claim: 将负载变化与机器人本体动力学失配解耦建模，并通过分层FiLM+对抗正则化实现更鲁棒的sim2real loco-manipulation泛化。

papers.title: Mind Your Steps: A General Learning Framework for Accurate Humanoid Foothold Tracking
papers.abstract: Enabling humanoid robots to operate in complex, dynamic environments remains a critical challenge, fundamentally limited by the ability to navigate robustly, safely, and accurately. While reinforcement learning with velocity-commanded policies has achieved remarkable robustness in humanoid locomotion, this approach lacks explicit control of the foothold placement, leading to unsafe behavior, such as stepping onto human feet, or imprecise navigation, hindering the following manipulation task. Conversely, explicit foothold-tracking policies offer a promising alternative by directly being commanded with target foot poses. However, existing approaches are often limited by unrealistic state assumptions, compromising real-world deployment, or they are part of staged pipelines, making them tied to specific downstream tasks. In this work, we introduce a novel, lightweight framework for training general-purpose 3D foothold-tracking policies. By dynamically providing footstep support through a goal sampler, this method enables the learned policy to be agnostic to specific terrains. Our new target representation effectively mitigates challenges arising in the real world, such as noisy and inaccurate pose estimation and foot contact estimation. Designed for direct real-world transfer, our policy acts as a standalone low-level controller that can be seamlessly paired with various high-level foothold generators. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework through extensive experiments in simulation and in the real world. By coupling our policy with different upstream planners, we achieve natural and accurate locomotion in challenging settings, paving the way for loco-manipulation tasks in complex environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级3D足底位置跟踪框架，让类人机器人能根据高层规划器给出的目标脚位，在仿真和真实机器人上鲁棒地执行精确落脚，解决速度指令控制无法保证落脚精度、而现有显式足底跟踪方法依赖强假设或任务耦合的问题。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所

papers.title: GenHOI: Contact-Aware Humanoid-Object Interaction by Imitating Generated Videos without Task-Specific Training
papers.abstract: Humanoid-Object Interaction (HOI) is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots, yet it remains challenging due to the tight coupling between dynamic balance and stable interaction with diverse objects. Existing methods often require time-consuming task-specific policy training or rely on rigid trajectory replay, which limits their ability to accommodate novel interaction scenarios. In this work, we present \textit{GenHOI}, a simple yet effective framework that enables humanoid robots to perform diverse object-interaction tasks in a zero-shot manner by directly imitating a single generated video, without task-specific training or physical demonstration data. GenHOI first reconstructs the robot-object scene in simulation and renders a first-frame image, which, together with the language command, conditions the synthesis of a task-oriented interaction video. The generated video is then analyzed to identify interaction-relevant contact events and estimate hand-object contact regions, which are encoded as object-centric geometric constraints that convert visual interaction cues into physically grounded optimization priors. Guided by these priors, the reference motion recovered from the video is refined and smoothed to resolve the scale ambiguity inherent in 2D video generation, while adapting a single reference trajectory to unseen robot-object relative poses. The optimized trajectory is finally executed by a closed-loop tracking controller. We validate the proposed framework in extensive simulation and real-world experiments across diverse object-interaction tasks, including box grasping, asymmetric bimanual chair carrying, table lifting from below, and cylindrical-object enveloping.

analysis.tldr: 提出GenHOI框架，让双足机器人仅靠一个语言指令+生成的2D交互视频（无真实演示、无任务训练），就能零样本完成抓箱、抬桌、抱圆柱等复杂人-物交互任务，核心是把视频里的接触事件转为几何约束来优化运动轨迹。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名；Zhihai Bi等姓名未指向明确知名团队；Andrew F. Luo非主流AI实验室常见署名；J Y过于模糊）

analysis.output: 优化后的全身关节轨迹（用于闭环控制器执行）

papers.title: The N2D Haptic Glove: A Multi-Finger Glove for 2D Directional Force Feedback for Contact Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans rely on directional fingertip forces to probe and regulate contact during manipulation, yet most wearable haptic gloves render only vibration or single-axis force, leaving force direction ambiguous. Without directional cues, users must infer contact force from vision alone, often leading to over-pressing, inconsistent control, and reduced precision in robotic teleoperation. We present the N2D Haptic Glove, a multi-finger wearable device that renders planar flexion-extension fingertip forces using capstan-drive transmissions for high-transparency force feedback. Through benchtop validations and a user study involving haptic teleoperation of a robotic arm and hand, we demonstrate that compared to visual-only and single-axis haptic baselines, planar fingertip feedback significantly reduces contact force error during precise manipulation, improves trial-to-trial consistency, and enhances overall user experience in axial probing tasks. These findings establish the N2D Haptic Glove and directional finger-based haptics devices as a promising modality for contact-rich teleoperation, immersive virtual reality simulations, and robot learning from demonstrations. N2D Haptic Glove's hardware and software system will be fully open-sourced at \href{https://ucsdarclab.github.io/n2d-glove/}{this https URL}.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一款能向手指指尖施加二维平面方向力（而非仅振动或单轴力）的触觉手套，通过实验证明这种方向性触觉反馈能显著降低远程操控机器人时的接触力误差、提升操作一致性与用户体验。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 二维方向性指尖力反馈比视觉-only或单轴力反馈更能提升接触丰富型遥操作任务中的力控精度、一致性和主观体验。
analysis.input: 用户手指运动（用于闭环遥操作）+ 机器人端接触力/位置信号（用于生成反馈）
analysis.output: 多指指尖二维平面方向力（x-y平面内可变方向与幅值的力）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + Robotiq 2F-85夹爪 + 自研N2D手套构成的遥操作系统
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人遥操作采集的用户行为数据（含力、轨迹、主观评分）

papers.title: Where Should Action Generation Begin? A Learnable Source Prior for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Generative robot policies typically begin action generation from an observation-independent standard Gaussian distribution, leaving the choice of source distribution underexplored. This work asks a simple question: where should action generation begin? We propose LeaP, a Learnable source Prior that replaces the standard Gaussian with a proprioception-conditioned diagonal Gaussian over action chunks. Parameterized by a lightweight MLP, LeaP jointly predicts the mean and state-adaptive variance of the source distribution, while keeping the downstream generator architecture and inference solver unchanged. This design provides an observation-informed yet stochastic initialization, allowing the generator to focus on precise action refinement rather than transporting samples from an uninformed noise source. On 15 RoboTwin manipulation tasks, LeaP achieves an average success rate of 81.6%, outperforming four representative baselines -- including deterministic-source methods, a no-prior counterpart, and a diffusion-bridge policy -- by 6.5 to 25.5 percentage points. The same prior consistently improves both flow-matching and diffusion-bridge generators, while using fewer parameters and converging faster. The advantage carries over to real-world deployment, where LeaP attains the best performance. These results suggest that the source distribution is an independent and reusable design axis for generative robot policies, complementary to the choice of generative dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现生成式机器人策略通常从无意义的标准高斯噪声开始生成动作，于是提出一个轻量级可学习的先验分布（LeaP），用本体感觉信息动态决定动作块的起始分布，让生成器更专注精细调整而非从头‘搬运’噪声，在仿真和真实机器人上都显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 生成式机器人策略的源分布（source distribution）是一个被忽视但独立、可学习、可迁移的设计维度，用本体感觉条件化的对角高斯先验替代标准高斯，能系统性提升生成质量与效率。
analysis.input: 机器人本体感觉（关节位置/速度等）+任务指令（文本或嵌入）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）的均值与状态自适应方差（即源分布参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台（基于PyBullet/Mujoco风格的多任务操作仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人采集的数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了源分布这一新设计轴并验证其有效性：在15个RoboTwin任务上稳定超越4类基线（含diffusion-bridge），且迁移到真机仍有效；但仅限于已有生成范式（flow-matching/diffusion-bridge）内部改进，未改变生成动力学本质，也未开源代码/模型，缺乏跨机体/跨传感器泛化验证，未挑战长期开放难题（如长程时序一致性、零样本任务泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在生成式机器人策略的底层分布建模上做出扎实、可复现、可迁移的增量创新，但属于范式内优化，非范式突破。

papers.title: PanoVine: Whole-Body Visuomotor Control for Soft Growing Vine Robot
papers.abstract: Vine robots, a class of soft, growing robots, are suitable for navigating complex and confined environments due to their compliant bodies and self-supporting growth mechanism. However, hysteresis, tether interactions, and deformations make them difficult to predict and model, which in turn limits the effectiveness of conventional planning and control approaches. In this work, we present a data-driven, vision-based control framework for the first autonomous vine robot system. Our system integrates 19 cameras distributed along the robot's body to provide comprehensive feedback of both the robot state and the surrounding environment. Using this rich whole-body vision feedback, we train an end-to-end visuomotor policy from demonstrations for closed-loop autonomous control in complex environments. The policy efficiently aggregates information from distributed sensing while maintaining robustness to inaccurate robot states and actuation. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned policy enables robust navigation and manipulation in challenging scenarios, including steering through branched structures, climbing up slopes, traversing unsupported terrain, reaching objects precisely, and maneuvering through confined spaces and obstacles. Project website https://panovine-bot.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用19个沿体分布的摄像头做全身体感视觉输入，训练端到端视觉运动策略，首次实现软体生长型藤蔓机器人在复杂环境（分支结构、斜坡、悬空地形、狭小空间）中的自主导航与精准抓取。
analysis.claim: 全身体分布式视觉反馈可克服藤蔓机器人强滞后、大变形、缆线干扰等建模不可靠问题，支撑端到端学习鲁棒闭环控制策略。

analysis.output: 电机驱动信号（控制生长速率与方向）

papers.title: Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints
papers.abstract: We present Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints, SPARK, a training-free neurosymbolic manipulation system that reaches 43.7% on six LIBERO-PRO position \& task cells, more than doubling CaP-Agent0 and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines. CaP-Agent0, a multi-turn code-generation agent, achieves 18.2% by re-querying an LLM at every turn, but its restart-from-scratch solution proves costly against minor policy failures. Perception is the layer that fails most under position and task changes so SPARK spends its computation there. A single Gemini call composes the plan as a typed behavior tree (BT) of composable primitives, each already containing the low-level control (motion, grasping, depth geometry) a code-generation agent would otherwise regenerate on every trial. The rest of the budget goes to perception: a second Gemini call proposes three alternative text prompts per object, SAM3 evaluates each, and we keep the prompt$\to$label pair with the most confident detection and a recovery loop then retries a failed primitive against freshly detected objects, with no new LLM call. The alternative prompts add +27.7 points on the spatial suite and +10.0 on the object suite, with the recovery loop adding +5.0 overall. SPARK runs the same primitives on three robot families (UR10e, Franka FR3, bimanual Franka) across nine unique tasks at twenty trials each, averaging 68%. Since the detector, planner, and controller modules sit behind the typed plan, they swap independently without training, and each primitive's checkable post-condition traces a failure to the corresponding module or a kinematic limit. Every trial logs a verified, labeled trajectory, so a training-free planner that already beats VLAs can supply the data those policies need without teleoperation. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/spark-page/

analysis.tldr: 提出SPARK系统，不用训练就能做机器人操作规划：用Gemini生成带类型约束的行为树（含预编译的底层控制逻辑），再用SAM3+多提示检测+失败恢复机制提升感知鲁棒性，在LIBERO-PRO六个任务上达43.7%，远超CaP-Agent0和VLA基线，并在三类真实机器人上跨机体验证。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练、仅靠大模型+模块化行为树+感知重试机制，即可实现跨机器人平台、可诊断失败原因、可自动生成高质量操作轨迹的神经符号型操作规划系统。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 可执行的行为树（含运动/抓取/深度几何等低层控制参数）及对应验证轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时视觉输入，但不依赖预先采集的真实机器人操作数据集（零训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨三类机器人+九任务+二十轮/任务+失败归因+轨迹自动标注，证据扎实；但未开源代码/模型，且行为树 primitives 依赖 Gemini 和 SAM3 的闭源能力，无法脱离商业API复现；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分基石，缺乏触觉/力控/高自由度灵巧操作等核心突破，属显著推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将大模型规划、模块化行为树、感知重试与真实机器人部署深度耦合，形成可诊断、可迁移、免训练的操作栈，但高度依赖闭源API且未开源，暂无法被社区复现或扩展。

papers.title: ELASTIC: Efficiently Learning to Adaptively Scale Test-Time Compute for Generative Control Policies
papers.abstract: Generative control policies (GCPs), such as diffusion policies and flow-based vision-language-action models, enable test-time scaling in robot control. Test-time compute can be allocated along two axes: sequential scaling, which increases denoising steps to refine actions, and parallel scaling, which samples multiple candidate actions to search across modes of the policy distribution. However, the optimal allocation of sequential and parallel compute is hard to know a priori as it is state-, task-, and policy-dependent. For example, early stages of a grasp may benefit from broader parallel exploration, while near-contact phases may require more sequential refinement for precision. We present ELASTIC, an algorithm that learns state-dependent test-time compute schedules for GCPs. We formulate compute allocation as a meta-Markov Decision Process in which a meta-policy interacts with a frozen pretrained robot policy and selects sequential steps and parallel samples at each denoising iteration to maximize task success while minimizing compute. Using reinforcement learning, this meta-policy also learns adaptive compute schedules without access to the GCP's training data. Across simulated manipulation benchmarks with diffusion policies, ELASTIC Pareto-dominates fixed and single-axis scaling baselines at matched compute budgets. On real-world robot manipulation with the $π_{0.5}$ vision-language-action model, ELASTIC matches best-of-$10$ success while reducing wall-clock latency by 34%.

analysis.tldr: 提出ELASTIC算法，让生成式控制策略（如扩散策略）能在运行时根据当前机器人状态动态决定该多采样（并行）还是多去噪步（串行），从而在固定计算预算下提升任务成功率或降低延迟。
analysis.claim: 测试时计算资源的最优分配是状态依赖的，ELASTIC通过元强化学习自动学习这种状态依赖的串行/并行计算调度策略，无需访问原始生成策略的训练数据。
analysis.input: 机器人当前观测（视觉+语言指令）及生成式控制策略的中间隐状态
analysis.output: 每步去噪迭代中选择的并行采样数与串行去噪步数
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实实验）+ MuJoCo/Isaac Gym仿真环境（模拟实验）

papers.title: GraspIT: A Dataset Bridging the Sim-to-Real gap and back for Validated Grasping SE(3) Pose Generation
papers.abstract: Robust robotic grasping of novel objects requires datasets that simultaneously provide photorealistic RGB-D observations, physically validated grasp quality annotations, and a principled bridge between simulation and the real world, which existing datasets lack to provide jointly. \textbf{GraspIT} addresses this gap: tabletop scenes in NVIDIA Isaac Sim are annotated via a four-stage physical slip-test on parallel Franka Panda instances, producing trajectory-reachability checks and continuous quality scores beyond force-closure.Of ${\sim}$2.3M candidates, 83% pass as \emph{good} ($s{\geq}0.50$); the 17% that passed force-closure but failed the slip-test provide graded hard negatives. A Real$\leftrightarrow$Sim loop back-projects these labels onto 100 real-world scenes. The release provides ${\sim}$316k annotated RGBD frame sets across 1035 sim and 100 real scenes, with instance masks, 6-DoF poses, physical object properties, and scored 6-DoF grasps. All tools are open-source and Docker-containerized. The trajectory planning within Isaac Sim further allows streaming of high resolution demonstrations for tabletop manipulation policy learning and behavior cloning.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为GraspIT的大规模RGB-D抓取数据集，通过在Isaac Sim中对230万个候选抓取位姿进行四阶段物理滑移测试（超越传统力封闭判断），生成连续质量评分，并将验证结果反向投影到100个真实桌面场景，实现Sim↔Real双向标注对齐。

papers.title: Minimal Data, Maximal Insight (MDMI): A Structure-guided Pipeline for Discovering Functional Alternatives in Peptide-Protein Interfaces
papers.abstract: Discovering functional peptides across vast sequence space remains a formidable challenge, particularly when experimental training data is scarce. We present Minimal Data Maximal Insight (MDMI), a two-stage structure-guided computational pipeline that designs functional peptide variants using only a small, annotated dataset. Rather than relying on sequence information alone, MDMI integrates three-dimensional structural features derived from predicted peptide-protein complexes into a machine learning model that captures interface geometry and binding energetics. This structure-aware predictor, paired with a genetic algorithm for sequence exploration, reduced false positives from 70% to close to zero in an all-negative benchmark panel compared with a sequence-only model in computational benchmarking, and produced approximately four-fold more high-confidence in silico binders than state-of-the-art peptide/protein design baselines. Using the split-GFP system as a testbed, where fluorescence provides a direct functional readout of peptide-protein complementation, MDMI identified peptides with up to 38% sequence divergence from wild-type in Stage 1 while retaining measurable activity. In Stage 2, motif-guided recombination of successful Stage 1 variants produced highly divergent yet functional peptides bearing over 50% sequence difference from wild-type, revealing two distinct functional clusters in sequence space. As further validation, a top-performing candidate expressed as a full-length GFP fusion retained a GFP-like emission profile, supporting formation of a fluorescent GFP-like scaffold. These results demonstrate that structure-informed pipelines can uncover remote functional sequence space from minimal data, with broad implications for peptide and therapeutic analog discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用极少实验数据（仅一个小的标注肽段-蛋白复合物数据集），结合三维结构特征和遗传算法，设计出与野生型序列差异超50%但仍保持功能的新型功能性肽段，实验证明其能在split-GFP系统中恢复荧光，并形成类GFP发光骨架。
analysis.claim: 仅需极小标注数据，通过结构引导的两阶段计算流程（结构感知预测器+遗传算法探索），可在远程序列空间中高效发现保持功能的肽段变体。

analysis.output: 高置信度功能性肽序列（含>50%序列差异但保留功能）

papers.title: VistaVLA: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware 3D Gaussian-Grounded VLA for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful end-to-end paradigm for robotic manipulation by mapping language instructions and 2D visual inputs directly to actions. However, these models lack an explicit, scene-level 3D representation, limiting their ability to reason over spatial layouts and geometric constraints. While recent efforts incorporate explicit 3D cues, such as depth maps or point clouds, to improve geometric awareness, they primarily capture low-level structures and lack high-level semantic grounding in 3D space. In human cognition, interaction with the physical world relies on a 3D semantic cognitive map - an internal mental model that integrates spatial layouts with semantic context to enable persistent, viewpoint-invariant reasoning. In light of this, we present VistaVLA, a novel two-stage framework that constructs a geometry- and semantics-aware 3D cognitive representation from 3D Gaussian primitives and grounds it as compact context tokens for VLA policy learning. Specifically, VistaVLA lifts multi-view vision-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, forming geometry-anchored semantic tokens that align view-consistent spatial grounding with 2D visual feature spaces. To make this 3D representation computationally tractable for effective VLA control, we introduce Merge-then-Query (MtQ), a token summarization mechanism. MtQ compresses dense Gaussian primitives into a highly compact set of spatially informative tokens, achieving a 99% token reduction while preserving action-relevant 3D layouts and semantic context. Extensive evaluations in both simulated and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness of VistaVLA. Notably, in real-world scenarios, VistaVLA improves success rates by 22.8% across seven real-world tasks and by 30.0% over the VLA-Adapter baseline on challenging out-of-distribution tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VistaVLA，用3D高斯原语构建带几何和语义信息的3D认知表征，再压缩成紧凑token输入VLA策略模型，提升机器人操作任务在真实场景中的泛化性和成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式构建几何与语义联合对齐的3D高斯表征，并通过Merge-then-Query压缩机制实现高效VLA策略学习，显著提升真实机器人操作任务的成功率与OOD鲁棒性。

papers.title: Leveraging unlabelled data for generalizable neural population decoding
papers.abstract: Robust and accurate neural decoders are integral to neurotechnologies such as brain-computer interfaces and closed-loop experiments. Recent work has shown that tokenizing neural data at the spike level facilitates multi-session pretraining and delivers state-of-the-art decoding performance. However, current spike-based models are restricted to supervised learning (SL), limiting training to datasets with paired behavioural labels. To address this limitation, we introduce MOJO (Masked autOencoder-based JOint training), a training framework for spike-tokenizing models that jointly leverages self-supervised learning (SSL) via masked autoencoding and SL objectives. We evaluate MOJO on three spiking datasets spanning monkey motor cortex during reaching tasks and multi-regional mouse recordings during vision and decision making tasks, demonstrating superior performance over purely SL-trained models. This improvement is especially pronounced when training with limited labelled data, particularly in few-shot finetuning, where only a small amount of labelled data from a new session is available. Incorporating SSL also yields more interpretable neuronal representations, improving performance on brain region classification and spike-statistics prediction without explicit optimization for these tasks. We further show that MOJO generalizes beyond spiking data to human electrocorticography during speech, where it continues to outperform purely SL-trained models and achieves performance comparable to neuro-foundation models (NFMs) designed specifically for continuous signals. Overall, augmenting spike-tokenizing models with SSL improves performance in label-impoverished settings and enables the use of unlabelled data across various tasks and species, while generalizing to other neural modalities. These results suggest a path towards more flexible and scalable data usage when training NFMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出MOJO框架，用掩码自编码（SSL）联合监督学习训练神经脉冲token化模型，在猴子、小鼠和人类ECoG数据上验证：显著提升少样本解码性能，增强跨任务/跨模态泛化能力，并意外提升神经表征可解释性。
analysis.org: 蒙特利尔大学/魁北克人工智能研究所（Mila）

papers.title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has demonstrated success in both physical and simulated domains; however, the predominant methodology remains rooted in simulations. The predominance of simulations makes translating research to physical reality uncertain for both algorithms and researchers. We propose a physical platform that is designed to simplify the transition. In this paper, we present the Open Ant: a physical variant of the commonly used Gymnasium Ant environment, along with a simulation. We demonstrate that competent walking policies can be learned from scratch in approximately one hour directly from the physical robot's experience for two substantially different RL algorithms: SARSA($λ$) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Separately, we show policies that were learned in simulation transfer to reality. We also examine how well the platform supports a nimble experimental ecosystem. Specifically, we observe the speed with which new users from diverse backgrounds achieve their first success with the platform, and how easily the platform can be repaired and updated when hardware issues arise. Both the hardware design and software are available as open-source on GitHub for ease of customization. In summary, we advocate for the use of the Open Ant for RL researchers who frequently use simulated environments, so they can more easily include robot experiments in their evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 作者设计了一个开源的四足机器人硬件平台‘Open Ant’，它是经典仿真环境Gymnasium Ant的物理对应体，支持从零在真实机器人上一小时内学出稳定行走策略（用SARSA(λ)和SAC），也验证了sim2real策略迁移，并强调其易上手、易维修、全开源，目标是降低RL研究者做真机实验的门槛。
analysis.claim: 一个低成本、开源、仿真对齐的物理Ant平台能显著降低强化学习研究者开展真实机器人实验的实践壁垒，并支持高效策略训练与sim2real迁移。

papers.title: LeapBot-WA: World-Anchor Action Models via Predictive Latent Alignments
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, yet the prevailing reliance on pixel-level video generation creates a fundamental bottleneck. Forcing models to reconstruct task-irrelevant visual details dissipates representational capacity and renders policies vulnerable to visual distractors. In this paper, we propose LeapBot-WA, which establishes a novel Predictive-Latent paradigm for WAMs by operationalizing the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) as a World-Anchor. Departing from the traditional reliance on visual synthesis, LeapBot-WA shifts the core of world modeling to Predictive Semantic Alignment, extracting abstract physical dynamics directly within a latent foundation space. To bridge the modality gap between non-Gaussian predictive features and diffusion priors, we introduce the Isotropic Semantic Autoencoder (ISAE), which reshapes the anchor's latent space into a diffusion-friendly manifold to prevent off-manifold drift. Furthermore, we design an Asymmetric Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. During training, an Anchor Diffusion Transformer acts as a privileged dynamics expert to guide the Action Diffusion Transformer; at inference, this heavy dynamics branch is pruned, enabling zero-overhead execution. LeapBot-WA achieves state-of-the-art performance among predictive models on LIBERO and matches top-tier generative WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 without requiring large-scale trajectory pre-training. It further demonstrates superior zero-shot robustness to unseen environments and successful real-world transfer, establishing a highly efficient and robust latent-centric paradigm for scalable robotic control. Code: https://github.com/LeapWM/leapbot-wa.

analysis.tldr: 提出LeapBot-WA，一种不依赖像素级视频生成的世界动作模型，改用预测性语义对齐在潜空间建模物理动力学，通过ISAE和不对称MoT架构实现高效训练与零开销推理，在LIBERO上SOTA、RoboTwin 2.0上媲美顶级生成式WAM，且零样本泛化强、实机迁移成功。

papers.title: Does EEG Foundation Models Transfer to Speech? A Benchmark on Overt and Imagined Speech Decoding
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models pretrained on thousands of hours have shown large gains over task-specific networks for motor imagery, seizure detection, sleep staging, and emotion recognition, but their transfer to speech decoding-arguably the most demanding non-invasive BCI application-remains untested. We present the first systematic benchmark of EEG foundation models against strong convolutional baselines for speech decoding, using two corpora: UGR-MINDVOICE (overt and covert Iberian Spanish) and BCI Competition 2020 Track 3 (imagined speech). We compare two foundation models (LaBraM, EEGMamba) against three established baselines (EEGNet, ShallowFBCSPNet, EEGConformer) under a unified preprocessing and fine-tuning protocol. Large-scale EEG pretraining yields no consistent advantage over a 16K-parameter CNN on speech tasks, indicating that current general-purpose EEG pretraining does not yet transfer to speech production and motivating speech-specific foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了当前主流EEG基础模型（LaBraM、EEGMamba）在朗读和想象语音解码任务上的迁移能力，发现它们并不比轻量级CNN（如EEGNet）表现更好，说明现有通用EEG预训练范式尚未适配语音解码这一高难度BCI任务。

papers.title: NeuroWorld: A Latent Brain World Model for Stimulus-Conditioned Human Brain Dynamics
papers.abstract: Forecasting human brain activity during naturalistic experience requires modeling how endogenous neural states evolve causally under continuous sensory drive. Existing brain encoding models instead frame this as stimulus-to-response regression without strict temporal constraints, allowing future stimuli to leak into current predictions. We introduce NeuroWorld, to our knowledge the first brain world model, which casts naturalistic brain functional dynamics prediction as stimulus-conditioned evolution in a learned latent brain-state space, separating endogenous states (measured via fMRI) from exogenous multimodal stimuli across two stages. Latent Dynamics Learning (LDL) jointly learns a transition-sufficient representation and causal dynamics through next-latent prediction, without reconstructing the observed fMRI signal. Latent Rollout Decoding (LRD) freezes LDL, autoregressively rolls latent states forward from an observed fMRI prefix, and decodes them into subject-specific whole-brain responses. Across three naturalistic movie-fMRI benchmarks spanning 30 participants, including our newly collected Singapore Multimodal Imaging & Naturalistic Dataset (SG-MIND; 20 participants, 8,519 paired stimulus-response clips, 140.7 person-hours of viewing), NeuroWorld achieves state-of-the-art multi-step rollout performance under strictly causal stimulus access, with greater robustness to long-horizon autoregressive drift, supporting reliable simulation of extended brain-state trajectories. Extensive interpretability analyses characterize the functional organization of the learned dynamics, establishing latent-space world modeling as a principled framework for causal forecasting of human brain activity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NeuroWorld，一个首次将人脑动态建模为‘刺激条件下的潜在状态演化’的世界模型，用两阶段方法（学习潜在动力学+自回归解码）在严格因果条件下预测fMRI时间序列，不依赖未来刺激信息，在三个自然电影-fMRI数据集上实现了多步预测SOTA。
analysis.org: 新加坡科技设计局/南洋理工大学联合团队（依据作者单位：Singapore University of Technology and Design, Nanyang Technological University）
analysis.claim: 人类大脑在自然刺激下的功能动态可被建模为一个刺激条件驱动的、因果封闭的潜在状态世界模型，该模型能实现严格因果约束下的长程fMRI序列自回归预测。
analysis.input: 多模态自然刺激（视频+音频）及其对应的时间对齐fMRI前缀序列（即历史脑响应）
analysis.output: 未来多时间步的全脑fMRI体素级响应预测（逐TR预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖fMRI扫描数据，无真实机器人交互或控制需求
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建严格因果、刺激条件化的脑动态世界模型，实证覆盖30人、含新采集的SG-MIND大规模数据，多步预测性能显著优于现有编码模型且抗长程漂移；但未涉及实时闭环干预、神经调控或临床接口，仍属离线预测建模，未达基石级BCI系统（如speech/text neuroprosthesis）的临床转化与功能重建分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜式改进，而是首次将世界模型范式严谨引入人脑动态因果建模，实证扎实、框架清晰、数据规模可信，但限于预测而非干预，尚未跨越到神经接口实用层级。

papers.title: PhyAI: Real-Time Physical AI at the Edge, Scalable Rollouts in the Cloud
papers.abstract: Physical AI policies require inference throughout their lifecycle, including model evaluation, cloud reinforcement learning rollout, edge GPU serving, and onboard deployment. Although these settings share the same checkpoint and action semantics, they often rely on separate inference programs. To unify them, we build PhyAI, a Physical AI inference engine with a single runtime that keeps architecture-specific conditioning, solver, cache, and output logic in model adapters while sharing graph execution, kernels, memory management, and parallel services. The same codebase runs vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) on single or multiple GPUs across onboard, edge, and cloud deployments. We used the adapter interface to add MiniCPM-Robot on the day of its release. PhyAI achieves 1.40x-4.65x speedups over the official implementations of pi0, pi0.5, GR00T N1.7, and MiniCPM-Robot. On Cosmos3-Nano-Policy-DROID it reduces latency from 2.46 to 1.18 s on eight H20 GPUs (CFG=2, TP=4), a 2.08x speedup. Specialized runtimes remain faster in several configurations, so our goal is one runtime with competitive latency rather than the fastest result in every case. Detailed profiles reveal why different models need different execution policies: on a Hopper-series GPU at batch size one, the pi0.5 action expert accounts for 8.8% of FLOPs but 57.2% of latency; at batch size 32 its share drops to 13.5% and throughput reaches about 100 samples/s. Cosmos3 remains generation-dominated and gains only 14.3% throughput as batch size increases from 1 to 16. We further introduce the control-time Roofline, which distinguishes inference-bound from environment-bound control; the measured pi0.5 points on four LIBERO suites are environment-bound while Cosmos3 stays inference-bound. Code and benchmarks: https://github.com/mingti-org/phyai.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PhyAI——一个统一的物理AI推理引擎，用单一运行时支持从云端强化学习 rollout 到边缘GPU和机器人端部署的全流程，通过模型适配器解耦架构特异性逻辑，共享底层执行基础设施，显著加速多个主流VLA/WAM模型的推理。
analysis.claim: 物理AI全生命周期推理（云rollout/边缘服务/端侧部署）可由一个统一运行时高效支撑，无需为不同部署场景重复开发独立推理程序。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言输入（VLA）或世界状态输入（WAM）
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖已有模型checkpoint和标准benchmark（如LIBERO）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程系统创新：统一了多场景推理栈，实测加速1.4–4.6×，开源完整代码与benchmark，但未解决新科学问题、未提升策略能力上限、未验证跨机体/跨任务泛化，也未推动具身智能核心算法（如泛化策略学习、sim2real迁移、闭环控制鲁棒性），相比GR00T N1/WholeBodyVLA等94+分基石工作，属于关键基础设施优化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把已有的VLA/WAM模型在不同硬件上跑得更高效、更统一，但没让机器人变得更聪明或更通用。

papers.title: AutoIntervene: Calibrated Intervention for Action-Chunking Imitation Learning Policies
papers.abstract: Action-chunking visuomotor policies learn from demonstrations and improve temporal consistency by predicting short action sequences rather than single-step commands. Yet perception errors and execution drift can move the robot outside the demonstration distribution, while the policy continues to produce smooth action chunks that are inconsistent with the observed state. We present AutoIntervene, an online framework that selectively transfers control between an action-chunking policy and an operator during deployment. AutoIntervene evaluates proposed chunks against a visual-action support memory built from successful task executions, combining visual similarity with consistency between proposed and reference actions. Phase-local support governs policy-to-operator transfer within the current task phase, whereas global support governs the return to policy control after operator recovery. We calibrate separate switching thresholds for the two directions from empirical quantiles of evaluation-level scores on held-out expert demonstrations, avoiding direct manual tuning of score cutoffs. Intervention segments retained from successful rollouts target learner-induced states and provide corrective supervision for subsequent policy updates. Experiments on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show higher post-adaptation task success and lower operator-control time than manual intervention. Videos and additional results are available at https://aus.bot/research/autointervene/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个在线干预框架AutoIntervene，让动作分块策略在执行偏移时自动触发人工接管，并基于视觉-动作记忆库打分决定何时交还控制权，用量化分位数自动校准切换阈值，在真实双臂操作任务中减少了人工干预时间、提升了任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过可校准的双向干预机制（policy→operator 和 operator→policy），结合相位局部与全局视觉-动作支持度评估，能自动、鲁棒地缓解动作分块策略在真实部署中的感知漂移与执行漂移问题。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测 + 当前动作分块预测 + 历史成功执行片段构成的视觉-动作记忆库
analysis.output: 二元干预决策（是否接管）及接管/交还控制的时机
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实双臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的专家演示数据构建视觉-动作支持记忆库；干预段落也来自真实成功rollout
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了动作分块策略在真实部署中因感知/执行漂移导致‘越走越错却越平滑’的关键缺陷，实证扎实（真机双臂任务、对比手动干预、含消融）、机制清晰（相位局部+全局支持、自动分位数校准），但仅限于特定干预范式下的闭环调控，未扩展至多任务泛化或跨机体迁移，也未开源代码/模型，尚未形成方法论级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破性干预机制设计+真实双臂验证，但受限于封闭部署场景和缺乏开源，暂未达到基石级范式影响力。

papers.title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Action verbs describe not only the physical outcomes of actions, but also how those actions are performed. Yet action representations in vision-language-action models (VLAs) are typically optimized for reconstruction under L1/L2 losses in raw action space, where numerical proximity need not reflect linguistically meaningful distinctions. On BridgeV2, we show that action trajectories contain verb-grounding information beyond visual state changes, and that reconstruction-only discrete tokenization systematically erodes this information.
