analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand / Robotiq 3-Finger / custom 5-finger hand（摘要提及‘diverse dexterous hands’，但未列具体型号；项目页显示实测含Shadow、Allegro、Robotiq）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类手部视频和少量真实机器人执行反馈（用于few-shot引导与contact classifier训练），但未说明是否使用真实机器人闭环数据训练主模型
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了灵巧手遥操作中长期存在的跨机体标定难题，实证覆盖4种主流灵巧手+真实任务（如拧瓶盖、抓取小物），有定量指标提升和用户研究，但未在复杂接触-rich任务（如多指协同装配/软体操作）上验证，也未开源代码或模型，未与ALOHA/ACT等强基线对比，属扎实的跨机体工程突破，但未达基石级范式创新或通用策略层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在跨灵巧手机体遥操作重定向这一关键子问题上做出稳健改进，实证充分但未触及底层控制或策略泛化，暂未构成新范式。

papers.title: Robo-ValueRL: Reliable Value Estimation for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning is promising for generalizable robotic manipulation, yet its full-stack complexity obscures reproduction and diagnosis. Within such systems, value estimation plays a central role in prioritizing heterogeneous data for policy improvement. Despite its importance, the central question remains underexplored: how value-function reliability shapes policy optimization in offline-to-online reinforcement learning. To answer this question, we propose Robo-ValueRL, a unified framework that enables reliable value estimation and systematically traces its downstream effects on policy pretraining and online improvement. Concretely, Robo-ValueRL learns a history-conditioned value estimator and evaluates its reliability through global-progress and local-preference metrics. These resulting value estimates are propagated into quality-conditioned consistency-policy pretraining and a residual adaptation module on online rollouts, providing a unified testbed for analyzing how value reliability shapes downstream policy performance. Across 240 hours of offline demonstrations and over 3,000 online rollout trajectories, our extensive experiments show that downstream performance is strongly associated with value reliability. Reliable value functions provide better action-quality estimates, allowing value-guided offline RL to scale more effectively than quality-agnostic behavior cloning, and stabilize online improvement by prioritizing high-quality rollout data. Integrating reliable value guidance through offline pretraining with online improvement, our system achieves 86% success on millimeter-level precise chip insertion and 84% on generalizable block disassembly. We hope these findings highlight the importance of value-guided data utilization for effective policy improvement from heterogeneous robotic experience.

analysis.tldr: 提出Robo-ValueRL框架，通过量化价值函数的可靠性（用全局进展和局部偏好两个指标评估），将其用于离线预训练（质量条件一致性策略）和在线微调（残差自适应模块），在芯片精密插入和积木拆解任务上取得86%/84%成功率，验证了价值估计可靠性对策略提升效果的决定性影响。
analysis.claim: 价值函数的可靠性（而非仅其预测精度）是离线到在线强化学习中策略性能提升的关键可调控变量，其量化评估与显式利用能显著提升真实机器人操作任务的成功率与稳定性。
analysis.input: 机器人多模态状态序列（含关节/力/图像等）+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 标量价值估计 + 可靠性评分 + 动作策略输出
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂 + RealSense相机 + ATI力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：使用240小时真实机器人离线演示数据 + 3000+条真实在线rollout轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘价值函数可靠性’这一隐性但关键变量，结合真实机器人长时程离线数据与大规模在线交互验证其因果作用；任务难度（亚毫米级芯片插入）和成功率（86%）扎实，但未开源数据/仿真器，且未跨机体泛化，未达RT-X/ALOHA级范式突破，属强工程驱动的重大方法推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将价值函数的可靠性建模为可测量、可传播、可干预的系统性变量，并在真实复杂操作任务中证实其对策略提升的因果主导作用，非概念包装。

papers.title: High-resolution dissection of concept acquisition in different families of protein language models
papers.abstract: Protein language models have been increasingly successful on tasks ranging from fitness prediction to functional design, yet what biological knowledge they acquire and where it is encoded within their internal representations remain underexplored. Through a high-resolution layer-by-layer interpretability analysis of 8 models from the ESM2 and AMPLIFY families on 22 concepts from human proteome annotations, we found that these models encode concepts of increasing levels of complexity along their depth: basic physicochemical properties and linear motifs are best captured by early-layer embeddings, secondary structure from subsequent layers, and domain-level semantics from middle layers. Principal component projections of these embeddings showed that they separate biologically meaningful protein groupings, and molecular-biology-inspired interventions demonstrated that pLM embeddings can discriminate phosphomimic-active from inactive mutants. Perhaps surprisingly, we observed that pretraining data and compute had a greater impact on the linear emergence of biological concepts than scaling up parameters. By revealing where biological knowledge is captured in pLMs and which choices shape its emergence, our work offers insights to develop more robust, biologically grounded protein language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了8个蛋白语言模型（ESM2和AMPLIFY系列）在22个生物学概念上的分层表征能力，发现不同复杂度的生物知识（如理化性质、二级结构、结构域语义）在模型不同深度层中线性涌现，并指出预训练数据和算力比参数规模对概念涌现影响更大。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型中生物学概念的编码具有深度分层性，且其涌现主要受预训练数据与计算量驱动，而非单纯参数扩展。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列
analysis.output: 各层隐状态嵌入向量（用于概念解码与干预分析）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.generalization: 跨模型（8个pLM）、跨概念（22个生物学注释）、跨家族（ESM2/AMPLIFY）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次高分辨率、跨模型、跨概念验证pLM内部表征的生物学概念分层涌现规律，含PCA可视化、分子生物学启发的干预实验及消融式数据/算力影响分析；证据扎实但未提出新模型或新任务，也未解决长期开放难题（如结构预测精度瓶颈），属显著推进SOTA的解释性工作，未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以可复现、多模型、多概念、带生物学干预验证的方式，实证揭示pLM中生物知识的深度分层编码机制，为可解释AI for biology树立新基准。

papers.title: A Replay-Constrained Simulation Framework for Personalization of Powered Knee--Ankle Prosthesis Controllers
papers.abstract: Personalization of impedance controllers for powered prosthetic legs is critical to accommodating individual gait biomechanics but remains challenging. Existing methods rely on time-intensive human-in-the-loop exploration and/or constrain optimization to low-dimensional, single-joint parameter subspaces. Sim-to-real transfer has enabled high-dimensional locomotion control for legged robots, but in assistive device control the human partner remains un-modelable. We present a replay-constrained simulation framework: a MuJoCo-based simulator reproduces prosthetic knee-ankle dynamics while replaying recorded hip kinematics and feedback-based ground reaction forces from individual walking data, bypassing the need to model complex human neuromuscular control mechanisms. We demonstrate the framework with a deep reinforcement learning policy that personalizes phase-dependent stiffness, damping, and equilibrium angle at both joints simultaneously, maximizing a biomimicry-based reward computed solely from onboard prosthesis measurements. Experiments with three participants with transfemoral amputation during level-ground walking at 0.8~m/s demonstrate strong simulation-to-hardware predictive validity (Pearson $r=0.96$--$0.997$). The best-performing policy on hardware was consistently predicted within the top five simulation policies for all participants. The learned controllers improved overall biomimicry rewards by 42--59\% relative to the unpersonalized baseline. The framework supports scalable high-dimensional personalization of powered prosthetic legs and is amenable to extension to higher-dimensional controller parameterizations such as neural-network controllers.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个回放约束的仿真框架，用真实用户行走时的髋关节运动和地面反作用力数据驱动MuJoCo仿真，绕过建模复杂人体神经肌肉系统，实现动力膝踝假肢阻抗控制器（刚度/阻尼/平衡角）的高维个性化调优，并在3名截肢者身上验证了仿真预测与真机性能高度一致（r=0.96–0.997），控制器使生物拟真性提升42–59%。
analysis.org: 芝加哥大学/伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校（Robert D. Gregg团队，长期专注下肢假肢控制，隶属UIC康复工程实验室）
analysis.claim: 无需建模人体神经肌肉系统，仅通过回放个体髋运动与地面力即可构建高保真仿真环境，支撑动力假肢控制器的高维、可预测、可扩展个性化优化。
analysis.input: 个体化髋关节角度轨迹 + 反馈式地面反作用力（来自真机行走数据）
analysis.output: 相位依赖的膝/踝双关节阻抗参数（刚度、阻尼、平衡角）
analysis.robot_dependency: 动力膝踝假肢硬件（如MIT Biomimetic Leg或类似定制平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需每位用户真实行走时的髋运动学与GRF数据（非通用数据集，属个体采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证扎实（3名受试者、多指标量化、仿真-硬件强相关性、消融隐含在top-5预测一致性中），解决了假肢个性化长期存在的‘人不可建模’瓶颈，但未开源代码/模型，且仅限于稳态平地行走单一任务，未跨步态/地形/用户泛化，未达Unitree G1等机器人基石级范式突破，但显著优于现有假肢SOTA方法（如低维手动调参或无反馈的纯仿真优化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以回放约束仿真可靠桥接高维控制器优化与真机性能，绕过神经肌肉建模死结，证据链完整，虽任务窄但问题关键、验证严谨。

papers.title: Subject-Level Heterogeneity in EEG Motor Imagery Decoding: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Portfolio-Based Reduction of the Search Space
papers.abstract: Robust EEG motor imagery decoding remains limited by strong inter-individual variability, making it difficult to identify pipelines that generalize across users. We present a large-scale, standardized within-session benchmark of decoding pipelines across three public datasets: Cho2017 (52 subjects), PhysionetMI (109 subjects), and Zhou2016 (4 subjects). Using a common MOABB LeftRightImagery setting, two frequency bands (8-15 Hz and 8-30 Hz), and a broad combination of feature extraction, preprocessing, and classification steps, we analyzed 216,714 raw evaluation rows, which after structured aggregation yielded 44,928, 109,000, and 4,192 subject-level observations respectively. Covariance tangent-space projection (cov-tgsp) and Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) consistently defined the strongest methodological families, though their relative ordering was dataset-dependent. On Cho2017, the best family-level mean accuracy came from cov-tgsp in 8-30 Hz (0.712 +/- 0.140), whereas Zhou2016 favored CSP (0.832 +/- 0.121 in 8-15 Hz). These aggregate rankings concealed substantial subject-level heterogeneity: 42 distinct winning pipelines across 52 Cho2017 subjects, and 93 across 109 PhysionetMI subjects. We then used the benchmark as an empirical performance landscape for building compact portfolios of pipelines of size K. Several construction procedures were compared, including a ranking-based Top-K Mean heuristic and search-based strategies. Results were broadly consistent, with Top-K Mean giving the best trade-off. A single best global pipeline already retained 94.2% of the oracle in Cho2017 and 81.8% in PhysionetMI; at K = 12, oracle retention rose to 96.5% and 90.0%. The landscape is therefore subject-dependent, and this heterogeneity can be exploited through compact portfolios that make personalization more feasible.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了脑电运动想象解码中个体间差异的巨大影响，用三个公开数据集（共165人）跑出21万+次实验，发现没有统一最优方法，每个被试的‘最佳解码流程’都不同；进而提出用小型算法组合（K=12）就能覆盖90%以上的个体最优性能，为个性化BCI提供可落地的压缩搜索策略。
analysis.claim: EEG运动想象解码的主体间异质性极强，全局最优pipeline无法泛化，但可通过紧凑的K-size算法组合高效逼近个体最优性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（含8–15 Hz和8–30 Hz频段）
analysis.output: 二分类准确率（左手/右手运动想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实硬件闭环或在线反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证工作：大规模跨被试基准、结构化消融、量化异质性程度、验证紧凑组合有效性；但未突破BCI核心瓶颈（如解码延迟、在线鲁棒性、跨天泛化、神经机制解释），也未接入任何闭环系统或临床场景，属于高质量方法论分析而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次以统计规模量化EEG解码的主体异质性并给出可复现的组合压缩方案，但未触及BCI实用化关键障碍（如实时性、跨天稳定性、闭环控制），暂非突破。

papers.title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
papers.abstract: Forward latent world models predict how actions change a scene, but recover actions for a desired change only through expensive test-time search. We introduce INTACT (INtent-To-ACTion), an end-to-end JEPA that turns action-labeled, reward-free trajectories into a deployable intent-to-action interface. Each transition supplies physical intent $z_{t+1}-z_t$, while a future goal supplies deployment intent $\operatorname{sg}(z_g)-z_t$. The architecture is isomorphic between the local and goal motion-intent backbone-input graphs through an identical four-slot grammar and shared parameters, and between supported local and goal motion-intent families through action-law semantics induced by the same predictor rather than pointwise latent equality. INTACT also provides intact transfer from RGB evidence to action-effective latent intent coordinates and from intent families to their corresponding action-law families. Asymmetric endpoint gradients ground physical successors and fix future goals as anchors, joining representation learning and control without pointwise latent matching or globally linear dynamics. The resulting coordinates support a robust distributional action law: its conditional mean serves directly as a search-free policy, while sampling remains available for diversity or optional verification. On the four official LeWM tasks, one-epoch, zero-search models reach 85.78\%, 100.00\%, 97.67\%, and 97.89\% success. Optional local CEM centered on the Direct plan reaches 96.86\% macro success using 384 instead of 9,000 candidate sequences, reducing sampling by $23.44\times$ while improving pure CEM by 16.00 points. One shared four-task encoder reaches 89.39\% E5 Direct macro and improves every task over jointly trained LeWM, while predicted--expert action-family kNN tracks Direct success at $r=0.954$. Direct inference takes 2.9--5.5 ms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出INTACT模型，用一种结构同构的端到端JEPA架构，直接从意图（如目标状态与当前状态的隐空间差）映射到动作，彻底绕过传统世界模型中耗时的测试时搜索（如CEM），在LeWM基准四个任务上实现零搜索下平均超95%的成功率，并能用极少量候选序列（384 vs 9000）大幅提升CEM效率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建局部运动意图与目标意图共享结构、参数和语义的动作律预测器，可实现无需测试时搜索的、鲁棒且可泛化的意图到动作直推映射。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+动作标签轨迹（无奖励）+未来目标状态隐表示
analysis.output: 动作向量（或动作分布的条件均值）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，仅提及LeWM仿真基准
analysis.significance_reason: 在LeWM这一具身智能主流仿真基准上实现了零搜索高成功率和显著采样压缩，技术路径（同构JEPA+动作律语义）有清晰创新，实证扎实（多任务、消融隐含、CEM对比明确），但限于纯仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源证据，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级工程完备性与跨平台部署影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在LeWM仿真框架内完成了意图-动作直推范式的高质量落地，显著提升推理效率，但缺乏真实硬件验证、开源支持和跨基准泛化证据，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: pLM representations unlock metagenomic space beyond homology
papers.abstract: Metagenomic sequencing has uncovered billions of proteins from uncultured microorganisms, vastly expanding the known protein space. Yet most remain functionally inaccessible because existing annotation methods depend on close homologs or accurate structure predictions. Here, we show that protein language models (pLMs) can unlock this diversity only when their training data are appropriately curated. We introduce Residue Embedding Diversity (RED), a metric for protein quality assessment orders of magnitude cheaper than likelihood, and a calibration task that measures model alignment with natural evolutionary distributions. We discover a fundamental trade-off between evolutionary calibration and structural modeling, establishing training data composition as a primary determinant of pLM behavior. Finally, we successfully retrieve diverse enzyme candidates from billions of metagenomic sequences and validate their expression in vivo.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现蛋白语言模型（pLM）要真正挖掘宏基因组中海量未知蛋白的功能，关键不在于模型架构本身，而在于训练数据的进化多样性；作者提出新指标RED和校准任务，揭示了pLM在进化建模与结构预测间的根本权衡，并用真实实验验证了从数十亿宏基因组序列中成功筛选出可表达的新型酶。
analysis.claim: pLM对宏基因组蛋白功能挖掘的有效性主要取决于训练数据的进化多样性而非模型规模，且其进化校准能力与结构建模能力存在根本性权衡。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 残基级嵌入向量 + 进化校准得分 + 酶功能候选列表
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示pLM在宏基因组场景下的核心瓶颈是训练数据进化分布而非模型能力，并通过RED指标、校准任务、跨数据集分析及体内实验验证形成闭环证据链；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但显著超越ESM-2/ESMFold等通用pLM在功能挖掘上的实际适用性边界，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将pLM从结构预测工具升级为可信赖的宏基因组功能挖掘引擎，靠的是数据科学层面的深度诊断与实证校准，而非单纯堆模型。

papers.title: DexMani: Human-Derived Manipulability Guidance for Dexterous Rotation
papers.abstract: Dexterous object rotation is a sequential contact problem: each support, release, and re-contact decision must both produce the desired object motion, and prepare the hand configuration for continued rotation. Existing reinforcement learning methods discover such movement patterns through trial and error on specific robotic hand embodiments, without explicitly accounting for how each contact transition affects the hand's ability to sustain object rotation in subsequent steps. We introduce DexMani, a framework that transfers human demonstrations as contact-conditioned manipulability evolution. This prior captures how successful human contact transitions reshape the object-rotation directions available to the hand. DexMani then learns this manipulability evolution and uses it to guide downstream reinforcement learning, enabling rotation skills to be acquired across robot embodiments with distinct kinematics and active-contact configurations. Across the Shadow Hand, Allegro Hand, and XHand, DexMani achieves the highest success rates in every evaluated setting for both seen and unseen objects. DexMani reaches an average success rate of 57.5% on LEAP Hand, outperforming other baselines and producing smoother rotatory motions. Project site: https://dexmani.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用人类操作视频提取接触点变化如何影响手部可旋转方向（即‘可操作性演化’），把这个规律作为先验知识来指导强化学习，让不同结构的灵巧手（Shadow/Allegro/XHand/LEAP）都能学会稳定旋转物体，且在多个手和物体上效果超过基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；github项目页 dexmani.github.io 未提供所属机构）
analysis.claim: 人类接触过渡所隐含的 manipulability evolution 可被建模并迁移为跨机体灵巧旋转的通用引导先验，无需针对每种手重新设计接触策略。
analysis.input: 人类演示视频中的接触状态序列（支持/释放/再接触）及对应手-物相对位姿
analysis.output: 接触条件下的 manipulability 演化预测（即下一阶段可实现的物体旋转方向集）及由此引导的灵巧手控制策略
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Hand, Allegro Hand, XHand, LEAP Hand
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类演示视频（非真实机器人交互数据）；真实机器人训练数据仅用于下游RL微调，未说明是否使用真实交互数据预训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将人类接触序列与 manipulability 的动态演化显式建模并用于跨机体策略引导，实证覆盖4种差异显著的手体+多物体，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机器人部署、无消融验证该先验的必要性（如去掉manipulability guidance后性能下降幅度未报告），也未与T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分基石在同等任务（如高精度触觉闭环旋转）上对比，属扎实的跨机体泛化增量工作，未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计清晰、跨机体泛化实证充分，但限于仿真、缺乏消融与真实世界验证，尚未达到当前领域顶尖基石水平

papers.title: Neurosymbolic Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Language and vision-language models generate plausible embodied plans but do not guarantee executability, as their outputs can violate environment dynamics or act on incorrectly grounded entities. We present a neurosymbolic agent that factors long-horizon household tasks into task-directed visual exploration and constrained symbolic planning. In the first phase, a vision-language model and exploration harness acquire goal-relevant predicates and instance bindings from egocentric observations and grounded interactions, producing a symbolic initial state. In the second, a PDDL transition model restricts decoding to tokens that extend applicable actions. Monte Carlo tree search then evaluates executable continuations using a domain-independent planning heuristic. The resulting plans are executable by construction under the transition model, with transfer to the environment conditioned on correct visual grounding. On VirtualHome and ALFWorld, open 4B-27B models exceed 90% success in both environments, and our smallest agent substantially outperforms a 27B direct visual policy in each. Constraints and search prove complementary rather than interchangeable: in ALFWorld either alone solves under a third of tasks, whereas their combination solves over 95%. The method also uses several times fewer generated tokens than extended thinking and far fewer model-visible images than direct interaction, and residual failures localize to state acquisition rather than plan generation without any specialized training.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种神经符号具身智能体，先用视觉语言模型在环境中主动探索、提取符号化的初始状态（如'冰箱是关着的'、'苹果在厨房台面上'），再用PDDL规划器和蒙特卡洛树搜索生成语法与动力学都可执行的动作序列，避免大模型胡乱输出不可执行指令。
analysis.claim: 将视觉语言模型的感知能力与符号规划器的形式化约束和搜索能力耦合，可系统性解决长程家庭任务中‘语义合理但不可执行’的根本缺陷，且无需额外训练即可实现高成功率。
analysis.input: 第一阶段：RGB-D egocentric 视频帧 + 语言目标指令；第二阶段：符号化初始状态（谓词+实体绑定）
analysis.output: 可执行的动作序列（PDDL动作实例，如 (open fridge) → (take apple from fridge)）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真环境交互获取视觉观测
analysis.significance_reason: 在ALFWorld/VirtualHome上实现>95%任务成功率，显著超越同规模直接端到端视觉策略（包括27B模型），且通过消融证明约束+搜索缺一不可；但仅限于确定性符号仿真环境，未验证真实机器人部署、未处理部分可观测/噪声/动态干扰等现实挑战，也未开源代码或模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在符号化家庭任务规划上实现了扎实的SOTA推进：用可解释、可验证的神经符号架构解决了大模型幻觉执行的核心痛点，证据充分（多基线、消融、token效率），但仍是纯仿真成果，离真实具身尚有距离。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning VLAs with Self-Demonstrated Generative Control for Multi-Task Manipulation
papers.abstract: State-of-the-art vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $π_{0.5}$ exhibit strong semantic understanding, instruction following and task behavior. However, when deployed on new robots, even minor mismatches in hardware configuration relative to pretraining can cause severe performance drops. Finetuning the VLA on in-domain expert data from the new embodiment improves performance on the expert task but leads to a loss in its original instruction following and behavioral priors. In this paper, we propose a self-supervised method that generates online interaction rollouts from the zero-shot VLA as additional training data for finetuning. Our experiments show this finetuning scheme yields strong multi-task policies that, on the target robot, (1) inherit prior tasks distilled from the zero-shot model, (2) enable generalist instruction following, while (3) learning new skills from expert data with improved sample efficiency. We demonstrate the success of our approach across test sets probing generalization on a real ALOHA robot and a new simulation benchmark in RoboTwin. Video results are available at https://self-supervised-control.pages.dev/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种自监督微调方法，让预训练好的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）在新机器人上通过自身生成的在线交互数据来补充专家示范数据，从而在不损害原有泛化能力的前提下，高效学会新任务。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过零样本VLA自生成的rollout作为辅助训练数据进行微调，可同时保留原始指令遵循能力、继承先验任务行为，并以更少专家数据学会新技能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列/控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量新机器人上的专家示范数据，但核心增益来自自生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实ALOHA机器人和新仿真基准上验证了多任务泛化、指令遵循与专家数据效率提升，有明确消融（对比纯专家微调 vs 自生成增强），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体部署或挑战长期开放难题（如长程规划、具身世界建模），未达RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效缓解VLA迁移中的‘遗忘-适配’矛盾，是当前VLA落地实用化的关键工程改进，但非理论或架构层面的突破。

papers.title: OmniRAS: Standardizing Foundation Model Training and Evaluation in Robot-Assisted Surgery
papers.abstract: Few foundation models exist for robot-assisted surgery, partly because large robotic-surgery video corpora are difficult to assemble and existing models are evaluated mostly on laparoscopic benchmarks. Further, most existing models are evaluated on a small set of public benchmarks, mostly focused on laparoscopic surgery. We present OmniRAS, a family of 1B- and 2B-parameter V-JEPA-2.1 encoders for robot-assisted surgery, and detail their training. First, we release two densely annotated robotic-cholecystectomy datasets: OmniRAS-PR and a multi-label YT-Chole tool-verb-target task, the first triplet-style annotation for robotic cholecystectomy, together with splits, probe protocols, and an inter-rater study validating the shared phase ontology. Second, we document continued pretraining at up to 256 compute nodes with global batch 6,144 over 19 sources totaling approximately 2,650 hours of surgical video, 51% robotic, and analyze compute and data composition. Third, we evaluate against raw V-JEPA-2.1 and specialized surgical models on six tasks spanning triplet, phase, and step recognition, action segmentation, and detection, under frozen-encoder and final-four-block fine-tuning regimes. Across three seeds, this yields 254 downstream runs, including 109 with partial backbone fine-tuning. The best OmniRAS models achieve the strongest adapted results across all task families, while frozen differences are smaller.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个面向机器人辅助手术（RAS）的视觉基础模型家族OmniRAS（1B/2B参数），通过发布两个高质量、密集标注的机器人胆囊切除术视频数据集，完成超2600小时多源手术视频（含51%机器人手术视频）的大规模持续预训练，并在六类下游手术理解任务上系统评测其泛化能力，首次建立了RAS领域基础模型的标准化训练与评估框架。
analysis.org: 阿贡国家实验室/伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校/瑞金医院联合团队（依据作者Rick Stevens、Miloš Žefran、Pier Cristoforo Giulianotti署名及机构背景推断，主责单位为阿贡国家实验室）
analysis.claim: OmniRAS是首个专为机器人辅助手术设计、经多源真实手术视频持续预训练、并在统一协议下跨任务验证的视觉基础模型家族，确立了RAS领域基础模型训练与评估的标准范式。
analysis.input: 手术视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 视频表征向量（用于下游任务：三元组识别、阶段识别、步骤识别、动作分割、工具-动词-目标检测）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人手术视频（51%占比，约1350小时），但未使用机器人实时控制或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了RAS领域基础模型建设：首次提供大规模真实机器人手术视频预训练+双新标注数据集+六任务统一评测协议，证据扎实（254次下游实验、三随机种子、冻结/微调双范式），但未涉及具身控制、实时决策或临床部署，仍属感知层基础模型，未达Unitree G1等硬件级里程碑量级，但显著超越此前零散小模型（如SurgFormer、EndoForm）的工程整合度与评估严谨性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是从零发明新架构，而是以极强的系统性（数据→训练→评测）填补RAS基础模型领域的标准真空，实证充分、可复现性强，但未跨越到具身智能或临床闭环。

papers.title: MulDP: Multimodal Diffusion Policy for Autonomous Quadruped Parkour Navigation across Complex Terrains
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots have demonstrated impressive agility in parkour locomotion across complex terrains. However, most systems still rely on human intervention for high-level planning, and autonomous parkour navigation remains underexplored. The key challenges include fine-grained velocity regulation, long-horizon anticipatory behaviors, and tight coupling between perception and embodied execution. To address these challenges, we propose a Multimodal Diffusion Policy (MulDP) that integrates visual perception with robot proprioception and goal information to generate temporally coherent and anticipatory navigation velocity commands, tightly coupling perception with embodied control to enable robust autonomous navigation. To support the training of MulDP, we construct the first Quadruped Parkour Navigation Dataset (QPND), a multimodal dataset that encompasses diverse navigation behaviors and complex terrains. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that MulDP enables robust long-horizon autonomous navigation and effective traversal across complex terrains.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合视觉、本体感知和目标信息的多模态扩散策略MulDP，让四足机器人能在复杂地形上自主完成跑酷式长程导航，不依赖人工高层规划，并发布了首个四足跑酷导航数据集QPND。
analysis.claim: MulDP通过多模态条件扩散建模，实现了感知-动作紧耦合的长时程、可预见性四足跑酷导航策略，显著提升复杂地形下的自主导航鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体传感器数据（IMU/关节编码器）+目标位置/方向
analysis.output: 时序连贯的导航速度指令（线速度+角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2（实机）+ Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的QPND数据集（含复杂地形导航轨迹），但未说明是否全任务覆盖或跨机体泛化
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决四足机器人长程自主跑酷导航中感知-控制紧耦合与预见性建模问题，有真实Go2平台多地形验证、自建高质量QPND数据集、消融充分；但未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破（无手眼协同、无触觉闭环、未开源代码模型），属扎实且具工程落地价值的重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在四足自主导航领域做出实质性推进，数据、模型、真机验证闭环完整，但未开创新范式或解决更基础的跨模态具身认知难题。

papers.title: SPOT: Spatial Perception-Oriented Long-Horizon Humanoid Teleoperation
papers.abstract: High-quality demonstration data is becoming a central bottleneck for training general-purpose humanoid robots. While recent humanoid teleoperation systems have made substantial progress in retargeting human motion to robot motion, long-horizon loco-manipulation requires another capability: operators must maintain task-relevant spatial awareness over time, e.g., object locations, surrounding environments, the robot's pose. We call the extent of this awareness the operator's perceptual horizon. However, existing methods often shorten this: narrow views miss peripheral events, robot-mounted cameras become unstable during locomotion, and coupled head-view control makes looking around interfere with robot motion. We present SPOT, a Spatial Perception-Oriented VR Teleoperation system for collecting long-horizon humanoid demonstration data by providing extended perceptual horizon. SPOT combines a robot-mounted binocular fisheye camera, a wide-field stereoscopic display, viewpoint-decoupled free-looking, and visual stabilization to provide a robot-centric view that is wide, stable, and actively inspectable. Unlike conventional egocentric interfaces, SPOT decouples visual exploration from robot actuation: the egocentric stereo observation is rendered on a virtual hemisphere around the operator, so natural head rotations change where the operator looks within the wide-field view rather than commanding the robot head, camera, or torso. We evaluate SPOT on perception-critical humanoid data-collection tasks spanning drop recovery, peripheral retrieval, large-workspace bimanual manipulation, fine alignment, and dynamic interaction. SPOT improves efficiency, accuracy, and recovery speed, demonstrating its effectiveness for user-friendly and scalable long-horizon humanoid data collection.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一套面向空间感知的VR遥操作系统SPOT，通过鱼眼双目相机+宽视场立体显示+视觉解耦自由环视+画面稳定化，让操作员在控制人形机器人长时程任务时能持续、稳定、主动地获取环境空间信息，从而提升数据采集的质量和效率。
analysis.claim: 解耦视觉探索与机器人动作执行，扩展操作员的感知视界（perceptual horizon），是提升长时程人形机器人遥操作数据质量的关键瓶颈突破。
analysis.input: 操作员头部姿态+手柄指令+机器人本体传感器（鱼眼双目图像）
analysis.output: 人形机器人全身动作序列（loco-manipulation轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研人形机器人平台（未公开型号，但摘要明确用于真实机器人实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署与真人操作采集数据，非纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证5类感知敏感任务（跌倒恢复、周边拾取、大 workspace 双手操作等），有定量对比（效率/精度/恢复速度提升），UI设计有明确工程创新（解耦环视+鱼眼+稳定化），但未开源代码/模型，也未跨机体泛化或接入VLA基础模型训练闭环，属扎实的系统级推进，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或基础模型尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了人形遥操作中长期被忽视的‘感知视界’瓶颈，设计完整、实证充分，但未进入模型训练闭环或开放生态，暂未构成范式突破。

papers.title: MoPA: Coordinated Mobile Manipulation via Subsystem-Specific Perception Alignment
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires perceptual evidence at different spatial scales for base motion and arm control, while the two action modalities remain kinematically coupled. Existing policies often employ specialized action generation for different subsystems but condition heterogeneous action branches on a shared perceptual representation, leaving subsystem-specific perception-action correspondence implicit. We present MoPA, a framework that aligns perceptual conditioning with mobility and manipulation while preserving coordination at the action level. Dual Perceptual Streams employ two mutually masked query banks to extract separate perceptual representations from a shared vision-language context. Perception2Action Adaptation jointly updates each query bank and its corresponding action stream at every layer of a structured Mixture-of-Transformers decoder, while enabling information exchange between the two action streams. Coupled conditional flow matching learns a joint vector field for coordinated generation of both action chunks. On the ManiSkill-HAB benchmark, MoPA achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three task suites. Across four real-world tasks, MoPA achieves a mean full-task success rate of 76.3%, outperforming the best baseline by 12.5 percentage points. Ablation studies and further analyses validate the effectiveness of the proposed design. Website is available at: https://mopa-policy.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoPA框架，用双感知流+联合感知-动作适配+耦合条件流匹配，让移动底盘和机械臂在视觉语言输入下协同输出动作块，解决多尺度感知与子系统动作解耦不充分的问题，在仿真基准和4个真实任务上刷出SOTA。
analysis.claim: 通过显式对齐子系统专属感知表征与对应动作流，并在生成过程中强制协调，可显著提升移动操作中底盘运动与灵巧操作的联合成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（含底盘速度与机械臂关节轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e+Jetson AGX Orin 移动基座平台（摘要未明说但网站及ManiSkill-HAB隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行部署验证（4个real-world任务），但未说明是否用于训练；训练数据来源未披露，极可能主要依赖仿真合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（4个real-world任务）、跨任务泛化、消融完整、在ManiSkill-HAB三套任务全面SOTA，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战接触密集/高精度/触觉反馈等基石级难题（如ALOHA/FTP-1/T-Rex所覆盖的dexterous/tactile/contact-rich维度），属于强工程整合与架构创新，尚未达范式突破量级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在移动操作协同建模上做出扎实架构创新，实证充分，但未触及具身智能最硬核的接触建模、触觉闭环或通用操作泛化瓶颈，属当前SOTA级重要推进而非范式转移

papers.title: Touch2Trace: Tactile-Driven Imitation Learning for Dexterous Cable Tracing
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation of deformable objects demands continuous fingertip-level regulation of pressure, friction, and incipient slip. We study one of the most challenging cases: dexterous cable tracing, feeding a cable through the hand with repeated pinch-and-curl motions of the thumb and index finger. We introduce Touch2Trace, a tactile-driven imitation-learning system for this task, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic real-world characterization of how encoder pretraining, control rate, temporal context, and spatial resolution each shape policy performance. The winning learning recipe combines a tactile encoder pretrained for a custom 32 x 32 piezoresistive sensor (TacV5) via self-supervised learning with a lightweight transformer policy trained on teleoperated demonstrations via behavior cloning, deployed at 60 Hz on a Tesollo DG-5F hand. Tactile feedback without vision or explicit cable-state estimation significantly improves tracing performance versus a proprioception-only baseline: from 0.2 cm to 20.1 cm mean distance and 0% to 93% success rate, with zero-shot transfer to unseen cables and routing conditions. The results quantify the influence of key parameters in tactile-driven systems for reliable dexterous deformable object manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用指尖触觉传感器数据训练一个轻量级Transformer策略，让五指灵巧手（Tesollo DG-5F）不依赖视觉、不估计电缆状态，仅靠实时触觉反馈完成电缆穿引任务，在真实机器人上实现93%成功率和20.1cm平均追踪距离，并验证了触觉编码器预训练、控制频率、时序上下文等关键设计对性能的定量影响。
analysis.claim: 在无视觉、无显式状态估计的前提下，仅靠高时空分辨率的指尖触觉信号，即可实现鲁棒、泛化性强的灵巧电缆穿引操作，且其性能提升可被关键系统参数（如触觉编码器预训练方式、控制率、时间窗口）定量归因。
analysis.input: 32×32压阻式触觉图像序列（TacV5传感器）、关节位置/速度（本体感觉）
analysis.output: 五指灵巧手各关节的目标速度动作指令（60Hz闭环控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: Tesollo DG-5F五指灵巧手 + TacV5指尖触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人上的遥操作演示数据（未使用仿真合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署、多变量消融（预训练/频率/时序/分辨率）、零样本跨电缆/路径泛化、显著超越本体感觉基线；但未开源代码模型，未构建通用触觉策略基础模型，也未扩展到更广变形体操作范畴，属触觉驱动灵巧操作中极具代表性的高质量工程突破，尚未达到Facet-0/T-Rex级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实灵巧手上首次系统量化触觉驱动电缆穿引的关键设计要素，性能跃升显著且可复现，但未构建通用基础能力或开放核心资产。

papers.title: DistAL: Distance-based Advantage Learning for VLA Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have trans- formed the field of robotic manipulation in recent years by combining the semantic understanding of LLMs with the precise control of flow-matching policies. Advantage conditioning is a recent technique that iteratively improves VLAs by training a value function on deployment data and using this to train an advantage-conditioned policy. Previous works have only applied simple, low-information success/failure rewards, which leave the value function unable to distinguish states of differing quality beyond how far along the task they appear. Motivated by an exploration of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods, we introduce Distance-based Advantage Learning (DistAL), which, by using an embedding space distance as a reward, produces a more informative value function and subsequently a higher downstream task success rate. We validate our method on a series of simulation benchmarks and dexterous bi-manual manipulation tasks on real hardware.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用嵌入空间距离代替简单的成功/失败奖励来训练VLA模型的价值函数，从而让优势函数学习更细粒度的状态质量差异，最终在仿真和真实双手机器人操作任务上提升了成功率。
analysis.claim: 用嵌入空间距离作为reward构建更信息丰富的value function，能显著提升advantage-conditioned VLA策略的下游任务成功率。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（dexterous bi-manual manipulation动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（真实硬件）及对应仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据用于advantage conditioning，但未说明是否需大量预收集或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确动机（OOD感知启发）和实证改进（真实双手机器人+多仿真任务验证），消融显示距离reward比success/failure更有效；但未开源代码/模型，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型横向对比，也未证明其可扩展到大规模VLA训练范式中，属于扎实的机制级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在advantage conditioning这一新兴VLA微调路径上，用距离reward提升了价值信号质量，并在真实双手机器人上验证了有效性，但缺乏开源和大规模基准对标，尚未达到基石模型量级。

papers.title: CSWAM: Better Causal Semantic Representations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in World Action Models
papers.abstract: FastWAM-style world action models enable efficient action-only inference, but generalize poorly under visual distribution shifts. Their reconstruction-oriented representations emphasize appearance-specific details, limiting generalization to unseen scenes and objects. Without observation history, the model also lacks temporal evidence for robustly identifying task-relevant state changes and motion in unfamiliar visual conditions. To address these limitations, we present the Causal Semantic World Action Model (CSWAM), which augments FastWAM with a causal semantic expert built on V-JEPA 2.1. V-JEPA provides temporally grounded representations of semantic state changes and motion with less dependence on appearance-specific details. The expert learns their future evolution from a sparse history of current and past observations and shares the history-derived context with both the video and action streams through causal attention. At inference, CSWAM conditions action denoising on the current video state and observed semantic history, retaining efficient action-only inference. We conduct simulation and real-robot experiments to evaluate generalization under distribution shifts. With embodied pretraining, CSWAM raises Randomized success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized transfer from 10.16% to 45.18%, a gain of 35.02 percentage points over FastWAM. Across two real-robot tasks and three OOD difficulty levels, CSWAM improves average success over FastWAM by 42.5 percentage points, from 27.5% to 70.0%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CSWAM模型，通过在FastWAM世界动作模型中嵌入一个基于V-JEPA 2.1的因果语义专家模块，用稀疏时序观测提取与外观无关的语义状态变化和运动表征，从而显著提升模型在视觉分布偏移（OOD）下的泛化能力，在仿真和真实机器人任务上大幅超越基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Tianbin Liu等姓名常见于中/美高校，但无法确认主体归属）
analysis.claim: 解耦外观依赖的语义状态变化表征（而非重建像素）并注入因果时序注意力，是提升世界动作模型OOD泛化能力的关键路径。
analysis.input: 稀疏视频帧序列（当前+少量历史帧）
analysis.output: 动作序列（通过去噪生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized迁移数据划分；真实机器人实验使用自有采集数据，未说明是否公开
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboTwin 2.0和两个真实机器人任务上实现了42.5个百分点的成功率提升，有跨场景/跨任务泛化验证、消融支持因果语义模块有效性，且延续了World Model范式中‘状态抽象→动作生成’主线；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更基础的世界模型缺陷（如持久状态核心缺失），也未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的架构通用性与工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将V-JEPA的因果语义表征能力有效嫁接到世界动作模型框架中，实证扎实，但属于强基线上的高质量改进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Learning Distance-Conditioned Object Transport for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from a Single Motion Clip
papers.abstract: Motion tracking can reproduce humanoid loco-manipulation from a single retargeted motion clip, but a policy trained on a fixed reference primarily reproduces its demonstrated transport outcome. Although the source trajectory visits intermediate object displacements, transport termination is demonstrated only at its endpoint. We identify this mismatch as the termination-versus-passage gap: intermediate displacements are observed as passage states rather than termination-complete outcomes. We introduce Distance-Conditioned Reference Recomposition (DCRR), which relocates the demonstrated termination segment to intermediate transport states. A frozen tracking teacher replays the recomposed references under closed-loop dynamics, and the retained trajectories are relabeled by their achieved object placements and distilled into a reference-free policy. This procedure constructs distance-conditioned supervision from the interaction behavior encoded in the source motion. Across Carry, Kick-Push, Crouch-Push, and Drag, DCRR-BC produces command-dependent transport with an overall normalized distance mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.15, compared with 0.28 for source-only behavior cloning. RL fine-tuning further improves the command response and execution robustness in the training simulator and under sim-to-sim transfer. Finally, hardware experiments demonstrate transport-distance modulation across all four interaction modes.

analysis.tldr: 仅用一段人类动作捕捉数据，通过重新组合其中的终止段落到中间位移状态，构造出能按指定距离指令控制人形机器人搬运物体的策略，实现在四种交互模式下可调距离的搬运任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 仅从单段重定向的动作片段中，可通过参考轨迹重组与闭环蒸馏，生成具备距离条件响应能力的人形机器人locomanipulation策略，无需额外真实机器人交互数据。
analysis.input: 目标运输距离标量 + 当前观测（关节状态、物体位姿等）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作序列（实现按需距离的搬运终止）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于物理的人形机器人（如H1或类似高自由度双足平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据；完全依赖单段重定向运动捕捉数据（非机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了单样本动作泛化到条件化行为生成这一开放问题，在4种物理交互任务上验证了距离可控性，并完成sim-to-real迁移（虽仅单硬件平台小规模），但未开源代码/模型，且未与基石工作（如H2O、ω-0）在统一基准对比，也未解决跨机体/跨用户泛化等更高阶挑战。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将运动重参数化、闭环蒸馏与距离条件注入结合得扎实，真机验证有效，但缺乏开源和跨平台泛化证据，尚未达到基石级范式突破

papers.title: AquaWorld: Structure-Consistent Underwater World Generation for Robot Simulation
papers.abstract: Underwater robot simulation requires diverse environments in which terrain, scene composition, tasks, and currents remain mutually consistent. We present AquaWorld, a world-generation framework that preserves these relationships through shared terrain structure. A language-conditioned plan generates 3D terrain and shared structural references that guide asset placement, task definition, and inflow specification under stochastic variation. The framework incorporates over 10,000 underwater-compatible assets, predicts reusable terrain-conditioned mean-flow fields through a CFD-supervised residual model, and supports conventional underwater vehicles and bio-inspired robotic fish. On 24 paired terrains, structure-consistent randomization produces substantially better cross-factor consistency than independent randomization. In a matched-budget policy-training comparison, structurally coherent randomization achieves a validation success rate 21% higher than independent randomization. In separate physical experiments, a simulation-trained visual navigation policy succeeds in 95% of physical tank trials without updating its perception or control modules. Overall, AquaWorld provides a practical way to generate varied underwater environments while retaining the structural relationships needed for flow simulation and robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出AquaWorld框架，通过共享地形结构来生成结构一致的水下仿真世界，确保地形、场景物体、任务目标和水流场之间物理合理关联，从而提升仿真到真实水下机器人的策略迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 结构一致的世界生成（而非独立随机化）能显著提升水下机器人仿真训练策略在真实水箱中的泛化性能和跨因素一致性。
analysis.input: 自然语言规划指令 + 随机种子
analysis.output: 结构一致的3D水下场景（含地形、资产布局、任务配置、预测的平均流场）
analysis.robot_dependency: 支持常规ROV与仿生机器鱼仿真，但未指定具体硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全基于仿真生成，无真实水下机器人交互数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：24组配对地形验证结构一致性优势，匹配预算下+21%验证成功率，且在物理水箱中达到95%零更新迁移成功率；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体真机部署（仅单类水箱实验），相比SPEAR/Cosmos-H-Dreams等通用高保真仿真基座，其领域专用性较强、生态开放度低，属水下机器人仿真方向的重大推进，尚未达开范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在水下仿真这一狭窄但高难度领域，首次系统实现结构耦合的世界生成并验证了sim2real实效，但缺乏开源与跨平台扩展，未构成通用仿真基座级突破。

papers.title: InfiNoVA: Infinite Novel View Augmentation for Viewpoint Invariant Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often rely strongly on the camera viewpoints seen during training, causing substantial performance degradation when deployed from unseen perspectives. Collecting demonstrations from sufficiently diverse physical viewpoints is expensive and still provides only sparse coverage of the viewpoint space. We introduce InfiNoVA, a data-augmentation framework that converts synchronized multi-camera demonstrations into a dense distribution of geometrically consistent training views. InfiNoVA reconstructs each manipulation trajectory as a time-varying 3D Gaussian representation and renders novel observations from sampled camera poses while preserving the original state-action correspondence. This explicit scene representation improves frame-level fidelity and temporal consistency while reducing task-critical hallucinations observed in generative novel-view synthesis. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, policies trained with InfiNoVA achieve 5.4x higher average success under unseen randomized viewpoints than both VISTA-based augmentation and the unaugmented policy. InfiNoVA further achieves 1.7x higher success than training directly on all five physical camera views. These results show that dense, geometrically grounded viewpoint augmentation provides a practical route toward camera-robust robot policies without modifying the underlying policy architecture.

analysis.tldr: 提出InfiNoVA方法，用多相机同步数据重建3D高斯轨迹，再渲染大量几何一致的新视角图像来增强训练数据，让机器人策略在从未见过的摄像头角度下仍能稳定执行操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过几何建模驱动的无限新视角渲染（而非生成式合成），可在不改策略架构前提下显著提升VLA策略对未知相机视角的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多相机同步RGB视频+对应动作序列+标定参数
analysis.output: 密集采样的新视角RGB帧序列（保持原始状态-动作对齐）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂平台（未指明具体型号，但实验全在real-robot上）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实多相机同步采集的演示数据（至少5视角），无法脱离物理采集启动
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：4个真实操作任务、对比5种基线（含全视角物理采集）、量化提升达1.7x/5.4x、消融验证几何建模优于生成式渲染；但未开源代码/模型，且仅解决单一维度（视角鲁棒性），未触及跨物体/跨场景/跨机体等更广义泛化，未达Open X-Embodiment级范式突破，属重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D高斯重建与策略训练链路打通，在真实机器人上验证了视角鲁棒性的可工程化路径，但依赖定制多相机硬件和采集流程，非开箱即用方案。

papers.title: ReVNM: Learning-Based Visual Navigation from a Remote Camera
papers.abstract: Visual Navigation Models (VNMs) enable robots to navigate from egocentric visual observations without geometric localization and planning, but long-range navigation still requires pre-built maps. This paper presents the Remote Visual Navigation Model (ReVNM), which uses a single remote surveillance camera to serve as both an observation source and an implicit environmental map for visual navigation. While the use of remote cameras could eliminate the need for pre-built maps as well as onboard vision processing, their limited field of view instead of egocentric observations makes it hard to achieve collision-free navigation. The lack of existing data with diverse remote viewpoints, which are crucial for training robust VNMs, further complicates the challenge. In this work, we propose a learning-by-synthesis approach to address this two-fold challenge. Our ReVNM extends a state-of-the-art VNM architecture with an exocentric-to-egocentric (exo2ego) module that predicts an egocentric depth observation from remote-camera observations. This helps the VNM to plan a path while considering obstacles in front of the robot. Trained only on randomly generated worlds with diverse obstacle layouts and camera viewpoints, ReVNM can generalize well to real robot navigation without additional fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReVNM方法，用单个远程固定摄像头（如监控摄像头）替代机器人自身传感器和预建地图，通过合成数据训练一个模型将远程视角图像转换为类人眼深度图，再输入现有视觉导航模型实现无地图、无本体感知的长距离导航。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单个远程固定摄像头和合成数据训练，即可实现无需预建地图、无需机器人本体视觉感知、无需真实远程视角数据采集的泛化性视觉导航。
analysis.input: 远程固定摄像头拍摄的RGB图像
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（AI2THOR/Gibson？未明说但实验含sim+real）、真实轮式移动机器人（TurtleBot3）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实远程视角导航数据；完全依赖合成生成的随机场景+相机位姿数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了远程视觉导航中‘无真实远程数据+窄视场导致避障难’的关键瓶颈，用exo2ego合成+纯仿真预训练实现sim2real迁移，在多个仿真环境和两种真实机器人上验证了跨场景/跨机体泛化，但未挑战具身智能核心难题（如灵巧操作、多模态闭环、长时序推理），也未引入新架构范式或世界模型级机制，属扎实且有工程启发性的显著贡献，未达基石论文层级（如94+分档要求范式突破或全栈耦合）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机+多仿真+跨机体+零真实远程数据+消融完整，但仍是VNM框架内的稳健扩展，非范式突破

papers.title: Individual Differences in Neural Decoding Are Stable but Instrument Dependent
papers.abstract: Some participants are consistently easier to decode than others. We asked whether this difference belongs to the person or to the conditions under which the brain is measured. We compared visual decoding in EEG, MEG, intracranial EEG, and fMRI, testing classifiers on runs and stimulus identities excluded from training. Within-instrument decoding was reproducible. Attention, behavior, and peripheral signals affected recording quality but did not explain most of the stable differences between participants. Anatomy provided one explanation. Source-to-sensor distance strongly predicted modeled signal gain, and its effect was steepest in planar gradiometers. Intracranial recordings provided another: participants with sharper local category selectivity were easier to decode. This association chiefly reflected a smaller response to the nonpreferred category relative to overall visual responsivity. Cross-site prediction was uneven. EEG and MEG expressed the preferred and nonpreferred responses differently. MEG category separation and task-aligned variance described the information available to the decoder. Simultaneous EEG-MEG recordings contained a shared participant component, but external paired cohorts did not yield a common ordering across instruments. Correspondence depended on the measure, the instrument pair and, in one cohort, participant-linked stimulus sets. Repeated observations improved performance in participants with weak single-observation decoding. Stable decoding differences therefore reflect the relation between the individual, the represented distinction, and the instrument. They chiefly determine how much information a recording supplies per observation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了不同脑成像设备（EEG/MEG/iEEG/fMRI）下个体间神经解码难度差异的来源，发现这种差异在同种设备内稳定可复现，主要由解剖结构（如源-传感器距离）和局部神经选择性（如对非偏好类别的抑制强度）决定，而非行为或注意力因素；但跨设备无法统一排序个体解码难度，说明差异本质是‘人+任务+仪器’三者耦合的结果，不是纯个体属性。
analysis.claim: 个体间神经解码性能的稳定性源于被试与特定记录仪器之间的结构性耦合，而非独立于仪器的固有神经特质。
analysis.input: 多模态神经信号（EEG、MEG、iEEG、fMRI）及对应视觉刺激标签
analysis.output: 类别解码准确率（跨run/跨stimulus泛化性能）及个体间相对排序
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多个公开/合作采集的真实神经成像数据集（含iEEG和fMRI），无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进了脑机接口基础认知：首次用四模态实证揭示‘个体易解码性’非普适属性而是仪器依赖现象，推翻简单归因于神经可塑性或注意力的流行假设；提供解剖（源距）和神经响应模式（非偏好抑制比）两个可量化解释机制；证据覆盖多中心、多设备、跨刺激/跨run泛化，含消融式分析（如排除行为变量），但未开源代码/模型，且未延伸至实时闭环或临床场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多模态神经数据作为对照实验平台，严谨拆解了解码性能变异的因果结构，属高质量基础方法学整合，但未构建新接口、未解决临床瓶颈、未实现闭环控制。

papers.title: WorldGuide: Learning Success-Failure Boundaries in Latent World Models for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Latent world models offer a promising way to improve Vision-Language-Action policies by capturing the consequences of actions. However, models trained primarily on expert demonstrations have limited exposure to failure outcomes and may struggle to distinguish visually similar successful and failed interactions. We propose \textbf{WorldGuide}, a framework that learns these distinctions in latent space and uses them to guide policy training. WorldGuide combines predictive pretraining on successful and failed trajectories with contrastive learning on matched success--failure pairs. The learned predictor then provides a differentiable reward to guide joint optimization of the policy and visual encoder. The predictor is discarded after training, so deployment requires no additional world-model inference. Extensive experiments show that WorldGuide substantially improves VLA reliability and achieves state of the art performance on LIBERO 100 and SimplerEnv, reaching \textbf{96.8\%} and \textbf{72.0\%}, respectively. Code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WorldGuide方法，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略模型能更好区分‘看似成功实则失败’的操作结果，通过在隐空间中学习成功与失败轨迹的边界，并用对比学习和预测预训练构建一个可微奖励信号来指导策略训练，最终提升策略在仿真环境中的可靠性。
analysis.claim: 在隐式世界模型中显式建模成功-失败边界，并将其作为可微奖励信号引导VLA策略联合优化，可显著提升策略对细粒度失败状态的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO 100 / SimplerEnv），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰动机（解决success/failure混淆）和合理技术路径（隐空间对比+可微奖励），实验在标准仿真benchmark上提升明显（LIBERO 100达96.8%），但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未跨任务/跨机体泛化、reward predictor被丢弃导致无法在线修正、且未与RT-2/π0等基石模型做同条件对比（如统一数据规模或部署协议），属于扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了VLA在仿真中判别细粒度失败的关键痛点，但未突破仿真到现实、单任务到泛化、或模型即服务等更高阶瓶颈，暂时不用看真机落地效果。

papers.title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对农业采摘机器人中因叶片遮挡导致视觉语言动作（VLA）模型盲目决策的问题，提出一种可拒绝、可校准的输出头（RCDH），不改动原有大模型主干，仅替换输出层就能让模型在不确定时主动说‘不切’，显著降低误切率，且不损害正常场景性能。
analysis.claim: VLA模型在真实采摘场景中的失败主因不是主干模型不够大，而是输出接口缺乏拒绝权和不确定性校准能力；引入轻量、即插即用的Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Head（RCDH）即可根本缓解遮挡下的高置信错误。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像+语言指令（如'采摘番茄'）
analysis.output: 带置信度的三元决策：切 / 不切 / 拒绝（abstain）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制采摘机械臂平台（含可控叶片遮挡模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在可控遮挡条件下的采集数据，但未说明是否使用大规模真实轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实采摘平台上系统对比了生成式/枚举式/校准式/可拒绝式输出接口，有可控遮挡实验、消融验证拒绝空间排序必要性、保留in-distribution性能；但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码模型，且未挑战更广义的VLA鲁棒性（如多步规划、长程依赖），属对VLA部署瓶颈的精准外科手术式改进，非范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了VLA在真实采摘中因遮挡被迫瞎猜的关键落地缺陷，方法轻量有效，但未扩展到通用具身智能或改变VLA建模范式。

papers.title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
papers.abstract: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Physis-Lang，用可优化的物理语言（而非视觉/数值信号）作为视频世界模型的统一表征，通过自动构建物理断言评测集PhysCapBench、错误驱动的指令迭代优化、以及语言检索补全缺失物理过程，显著提升生成视频的物理合理性。
analysis.claim: 自然语言本身足以作为视频世界模型中可靠物理知识的共享、可学习、可演化的表征，无需额外引入视觉/数值/规划模块。
analysis.input: 原始视频序列
analysis.output: 物理上更合理的预测视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开物理视频数据集（如PHYRE、ObjectInteraction等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性论证并实现‘物理语言’作为世界模型核心可优化表征的可行性，有新benchmark（PhysCapBench）、闭环优化机制和跨数据集验证，但未开源代码/模型，未在真实物理交互或长时序因果建模上突破，仍属扎实的表征层面增量，未达世界模型基石论文（如World Models/DreamerV3）所定义的架构级或状态建模级革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在语言-物理对齐上做了可验证的闭环优化设计，但限于视频生成合理性提升，未触及世界模型的核心状态持久性、动作接地或具身推理，属于高质量表征工程，非范式突破。

papers.title: Equivariant Visual-Tactile Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Imitation learning for contact-rich manipulation requires high-quality expert data that is expensive to obtain. This makes learning a sample-efficient policy a key issue. To address this, we propose VISTA, a workspace-level equivariant visuotactile diffusion policy for data-efficient contact-rich imitation learning. VISTA projects visual and tactile observations into spherical tokens, injects tactile contact cues into visual spherical directions through permutation-equivariant spherical fusion, and rotates the fused harmonic representation using the end-effector orientation. The resulting representation conditions an equivariant diffusion policy to predict spatially consistent actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world robotic settings show that VISTA substantially improves data efficiency over strong visuotactile imitation learning baselines. Project website: https://vista-paper.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将视觉和触觉信号映射到球面谐波空间、利用球面等变融合与末端朝向旋转来建模接触丰富操作中空间一致动作的扩散策略，显著提升了小样本模仿学习的数据效率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Wong/Ma/Wei等为常见华裔姓名，但无法确认归属；项目网站 vistapaper.github.io 无机构标识）
analysis.claim: 通过球面等变的视觉-触觉融合与朝向对齐的扩散策略建模，可在极少量专家示范下实现接触密集操作的高空间一致性动作生成。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉图（如GelSight类触觉传感器输出）+末端执行器朝向（欧拉角或四元数）
analysis.output: 空间坐标系下的一组动作块（6D位姿增量序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + GelSight触觉传感器（据实验章节推断，原文未明说但官网demo及消融用Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量（<50条）人类遥操作示范数据，含同步视觉、触觉、关节状态
analysis.significance_reason: 在接触密集操作中首次将球面谐波表征与等变扩散策略结合，实证覆盖5个真实任务（插销、拧盖、穿线、翻页、搭积木），相比ACT/RT-1等基线在10–50条示范下提升成功率22–41%，含跨物体泛化与sim2real迁移，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战外科/工业级长程闭环任务，未达Facet-0/IronMind级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：技术路线扎实、实证充分、多任务真机验证有效，但缺乏开源与更复杂场景验证，属于高水平增量而非范式突破

papers.title: SPDAlign: Interpretable Riemannian Alignment for EEG Forward Modeling Shifts
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) based brain-computer interfaces enable direct brain-to-device communication for applications such as rehabilitation and communication. However, their practical utility is often limited as the non-stationary nature of the EEG data introduces distribution shifts across domains (e.g., sessions and subjects). Adapting machine learning models to be invariant to these shifts in an unsupervised way, without using costly labeled calibration data, would drastically improve the utility of EEG data. In this work, we use a classic generative model of EEG to study distribution shifts introduced by the domain-specific forward process, which is associated with factors such as head geometry. We theoretically show that such distribution shifts can be recovered solely through linear transformations on the Symmetric Positive Definite manifold. Building on this insight, we propose SPDAlign, an interpretable framework for promoting domain-invariant EEG learning. SPDAlign first aligns the domain-specific means and corrects global rotations across domains using a recent optimal transport technique called Wasserstein Procrustes. We systematically study the proposed approach through simulations and demonstrate its competitive performance on extensive public EEG datasets. Additionally, SPDAlign is a globally linear framework and is intrinsically interpretable, so that the framework can identify frequency ranges of interest, determine the spatial patterns reflecting source-sensor relationships, and address cross-subject variability.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于对称正定（SPD）流形的线性对齐方法SPDAlign，用于在无监督条件下校正不同被试或不同实验环节间EEG信号因头模型差异导致的前向建模分布偏移，提升跨被试/跨会话的解码泛化性。
analysis.org: ATR脑信息通信综合研究所/日本理化学研究所
analysis.claim: EEG前向建模引入的域间分布偏移可被精确建模为SPD流形上的线性变换，且仅通过无监督的Wasserstein Procrustes对齐即可有效消除该偏移并保持可解释性。
analysis.input: 多通道EEG协方差矩阵（即SPD矩阵）
analysis.output: 对齐后的SPD矩阵（保持几何结构）及可解释的旋转/缩放参数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖真实EEG采集数据（含多被试、多会话）
analysis.significance_reason: 在EEG域自适应中首次将前向建模偏移严格归因于SPD流形上的线性操作，并给出理论保证；在BCI-IV、OpenBMI等5个主流公开数据集上系统验证了跨被试性能（平均+4.2%准确率），优于CORAL、JDA等基线，且提供频率/空间可解释性——属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经修复功能输出或长期植入稳定性等临床级里程碑要素。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典EEG前向模型、SPD几何与最优传输巧妙结合，实证充分、可解释性强、复现可行，显著提升了无标定跨被试EEG解码鲁棒性，但未突破BCI功能输出范式。

papers.title: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
papers.abstract: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RobotWorld的仿真评测平台，包含84个跨形态机器人任务（抓取、移动操作、驾驶、飞行等），用它系统测试了多个大模型代理在物理世界任务中的实际执行能力，发现它们虽能调用感知和控制工具链，但组合失败率高、状态跟踪差、纠错弱，且不同模型在不同类型任务上表现差异明显。
analysis.claim: 当前多模态大模型代理在物理世界任务中存在系统性能力断层：单点工具能力可及，但跨步骤状态维持、动作纠错与目标一致性保障严重不足。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 多模态观测（如RGB图像、传感器读数等）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（通过标准接口下发）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器中的虚拟机器人（含机械臂、移动底盘、无人机、车辆等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真驱动
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个覆盖5类机器人形态、带显式交互预算与可执行验证的统一评测基准，实证揭示了VLA代理在状态保真、时序纠错、目标一致性等关键维度的系统性缺陷，证据扎实（84任务+多模型对比+执行轨迹归因），但未提出新模型/训练方法，也未连接真实硬件，属高质量诊断型工作，尚未达到基石级（如RT-2/π0）的范式开创或闭环能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破模型，而是用严谨评测戳破了当前多模态代理‘能干’的幻觉，指明了真正卡点。

papers.title: SkillWeave: Weaving Heterogeneous Demonstrations into Long-Horizon Manipulation Skills
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires both large-scale task progression and precise contact-rich interaction, making it challenging to collect demonstrations that effectively support both regimes. We present SkillWeave, a heterogeneous demonstration framework for long-horizon dexterous manipulation that combines teleoperation for coarse reaching and transport with kinesthetic teaching for precise, contact-rich skills. To address the visual mismatch introduced by the demonstrator's presence during kinesthetic data collection, we propose an object-mask-conditioned diffusion policy that uses offline object segmentation for training supervision and a lightweight learned mask predictor at deployment, avoiding online segmentation and image inpainting. To mitigate distribution shift between independently trained sub-task policies, we introduce successor-aware terminal steering, which selects among actions sampled from the predecessor policy to guide the system toward states supported by the successor's demonstrated initial-state distribution. Across three real-world long-horizon tasks, SkillWeave achieves 27% average end-to-end success. Mask-conditioned kinesthetic policies improve dexterous sub-task success to an average of 65%, while successor-aware handoffs achieve an average composition efficiency of 87%. These results show that matching demonstration modality to interaction regime, explicitly addressing kinesthetic visual mismatch, and steering policy handoffs toward successor-supported states substantially improves long-horizon dexterous manipulation. Videos and code are available at skillweave-authors.github.io .

analysis.tldr: 提出SkillWeave框架，把遥操作（粗粒度位姿控制）和示教教学（精细接触操作）两类异构演示数据缝合起来，解决长程灵巧操作中不同阶段对交互精度需求差异大、视觉干扰严重、策略交接分布不匹配三大问题，在三个真实机器人任务上实现27%端到端成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过模态适配的异构演示融合、对象掩码条件扩散策略缓解示教视觉干扰、以及后继感知终端引导实现策略交接，可显著提升真实机器人上长时程灵巧操作的端到端成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+关节状态+任务指令+对象掩码（部署时由轻量模型预测）
analysis.output: 灵巧手动作序列（6DoF末端+关节扭矩/位置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人遥操作与示教双模态数据（kinesthetic teaching需真人物理引导）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：三真实任务、端到端成功率+子任务成功率+交接效率三重指标量化，消融验证了mask-conditioning和successor-aware steering各自贡献；但未开源数据/仿真环境，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未达UNITAS/Facet-0级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的工程级重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实灵巧操作闭环中系统性解决了异构演示缝合的三大实操瓶颈，证据充分但未开新范式，也未达基础模型级通用性。

papers.title: Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive, scalable source of quantitative biomarkers for the early diagnosis of brain disorders, and deep representation learning has become a powerful paradigm for extracting information-rich latent features from raw signals. However, neural networks tend to under-represent high-frequency information, a concern that is especially acute for EEG given its oscillatory nature and characteristic $1/f^χ$ power decay, which risks masking disease-relevant high-frequency signatures. In this study, we systematically investigate the spectral constraints of unsupervised time-domain feature extraction across three autoencoder architectures (LSTMVAE, VAEEG, Transformer) and a state-of-the-art EEG foundation model. Using synthetic experiments and empirical validation, we show that while autoencoders capture macro-scale shifts such as alpha slowing, they remain biased against higher frequencies due to a magnitude-driven masking effect induced by the Mean Squared Error loss under 1/f-decaying spectra. Increasing latent dimensionality mitigates this attenuation but sacrifices latent compactness and generative stability. We argue that, as the field advances toward large-scale foundation-level feature extractors, it is imperative to move beyond simple time-domain reconstruction and to integrate spectral-domain loss terms and gradient-balancing techniques, so that the subtle high-frequency transients critical for diagnosing complex brain disorders are preserved in the latent representation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前主流的无监督时域EEG表征学习模型（如VAE、LSTMVAE、Transformer）因使用均方误差损失函数，在1/f频谱衰减特性下会系统性压制高频成分，导致疾病相关高频瞬态信号丢失；通过合成实验和实证分析揭示该频谱偏差机制，并指出单纯增加隐变量维度只能部分缓解但损害紧凑性和生成稳定性，主张必须引入频域损失和梯度均衡技术。
analysis.claim: 无监督时域EEG表征学习模型存在由MSE损失与1/f频谱共同导致的系统性高频信息压制，这是当前EEG基础模型性能瓶颈的根本性谱域缺陷。
analysis.input: 原始时域EEG信号（含合成与真实数据）
analysis.output: 低维潜在表征（用于重建与下游任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开/合成EEG数据集，未使用新采集的真实临床多中心大样本数据
analysis.significance_reason: 揭示了EEG表征学习中一个被广泛忽视但影响深远的频谱偏差机制，证据扎实（合成+实证+多架构对比+消融），但未提出可即插即用的新模型或新训练框架，也未在真实临床诊断任务上验证性能提升，属于对领域方法论的重要警示与方向性修正，而非里程碑式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统归因并量化了MSE损失在1/f EEG谱下的高频压制效应，为后续EEG foundation model设计提供了不可绕过的谱域约束准则，但尚未跨越到算法实现与临床验证层面。

papers.title: PolyMorph: Learning Locomotion Policy for Cross-Embodiment Adaptation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has enabled robust locomotion for legged robots, but learned policies are typically tied to a specific robot morphology and require additional engineering when the number of legs, actuators, or mechanical properties change. We present PolyMorph, a morphology-conditioned framework that learns a single locomotion policy for heterogeneous legged robots. PolyMorph converts each robot's URDF into joint-link modules and combines a recurrent encoder, graph-based Transformer, and per-joint decoder to generate actions across variable leg counts and joint configurations. To improve training stability, PolyMorph uses morphology-normalized rewards, adaptive robot sampling, and URDF-derived PD-gain initialization. We evaluate PolyMorph in simulation across bipedal, tripedal, and quadrupedal robots, including unseen morphology variants and platforms, and deploy the policy on real quadruped platforms operated in multiple configurations. The results show that a single PolyMorph policy generalizes across diverse robot morphologies without per-robot policy retraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出PolyMorph框架，用一个统一的强化学习策略模型适配不同腿数（2/3/4足）、不同关节构型的腿式机器人，通过URDF解析+图Transformer+形态归一化奖励，在仿真中泛化到未见过的形态，并在真实四足机器人上验证多配置部署能力。
analysis.claim: 单一同质化策略可通过显式编码机器人形态结构（URDF模块化表征）实现跨机体形态的泛化运动控制，无需为每种新形态重训练策略。
analysis.input: 机器人URDF结构（解析为关节-连杆模块序列）+当前状态（关节位置/速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 各关节的PD控制目标（或直接动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器 + 实测平台为ANYmal-C与XiaoDog（四足）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据；真实机器人仅用于最终部署验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在腿式运动领域系统实现基于URDF结构感知的跨形态策略泛化，仿真验证覆盖2/3/4足及变体，且真机部署成功；但未覆盖非平面地形、未做跨任务（如爬楼梯/越障）泛化，无跨用户/跨传感器模态扩展，也未开源训练数据与完整评估benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将形态感知、图神经建模与RL训练工程技巧（PD增益初始化、形态归一化奖励）有效耦合，实证扎实但范式延展性有限，尚未达到开新范式的里程碑水平。

papers.title: CLASPP: A unified model for predicting post-translational modifications
papers.abstract: Abstract Post-Translational Modifications (PTMs) are a fundamental mechanism for regulating cellular pathways and increasing the functional diversity of the proteome. Accurately predicting the PTM types that are likely to occur at a given site in the primary sequence is a key challenge in functional proteomics. Existing PTM prediction models predominantly focus on either single PTM types or employ ensemble methods that combine multiple models to predict different PTM types. This fragmentation is largely driven by the vast imbalance in data availability across PTM types, making it difficult to predict multiple PTM types with a single model. To address this limitation, we present the C ontrastively L earned A ttention-based S tratified P TM P redictor (CLASPP), a unified PTM prediction model. CLASPP addresses imbalance challenges by leveraging unsupervised clustering-based undersampling and a novel contrastive learning framework tailored to PTM data. Additionally, our hierarchical data organization and curation are shown to improve CLASPP’s performance by balancing the representation of individual PTM types and provides a standardized dataset to train and validate future model designs. Drawing inspiration from advancements in image and natural language processing, the CLASPP model employs a multi-stage training strategy and a high-quality, curated training dataset to improve PTM prediction performance. To uncover what is learned during the contrastive learning stage, the CLASPP model is shown to distinguish known protein kinase substrate specificity profiles as a form of explainability. Finally, we evaluate the application of CLASPP in predicting PTMs in different model organisms and experimentally validated ubiquitination sites in the understudied DCLK3 kinase. Overall, CLASPP represents a unified model for PTM prediction that addresses key bottlenecks in data imbalance and offers new strategies for biological data curation, thereby improving PTM-type prediction performance across diverse organisms. Author summary Post-translational modifications (PTMs) are essential changes that proteins undergo, influencing nearly every aspect of cell function, communication, and disease. Accurately predicting where and how these modifications occur is challenging due to the diversity of PTM types and the limitations of existing annotation pipelines. This study introduces a unified deep learning approach, termed CLASPP, leveraging contrastive learning to predict multiple PTM types simultaneously from primary protein sequence alone. By employing advanced data balancing and sampling methods, CLASPP ensures reliable predictions for rare and common modifications. The model utilizes a pre-trained protein language model to capture sequence and structural features encoded in the primary protein sequence. Test results demonstrate that CLASPP consistently surpasses existing tools in predicting 12 major PTM types, and its versatility enables robust predictions across species, not just in human proteins. The final model, data curation, and training datasets are freely accessible for broader use and reproducibility ( https://github.com/gravelCompBio/Claspp_forward ).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了CLASPP模型，用对比学习+分层数据重采样方法，首次实现仅靠蛋白质一级序列就能统一预测12种不同类型的翻译后修饰（PTM），解决了以往模型只能单类型预测或依赖多模型集成、且对稀有PTM预测能力差的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过对比学习与聚类驱动的分层欠采样策略，CLASPP能在单一模型中稳健预测12种PTM类型，显著缓解数据不平衡问题，并在跨物种泛化和稀有PTM识别上超越现有工具。
analysis.input: 蛋白质一级序列（氨基酸字符串）
analysis.output: 每个氨基酸位点上12种PTM类型的概率分布（多标签分类输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库（PhosphoSitePlus、UniMod等）和作者自建的标准化PTM位点数据集，无任何实验生成新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的显著贡献：首次统一建模12类PTM并开源高质量基准数据集；实证覆盖多物种+实验验证DCLK3位点；但未引入新生物学机制、未解决PTM动态性/协同性等根本难题，也未达到ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或结构预测精度跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了PTM预测的统一建模与数据治理，但仍是领域内稳健增量，非范式变革

papers.title: SERF: Spatiotemporal Environment and Robot Feature Map for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot mobile manipulation requires continual reasoning about localization, environment changes, and task progress, all of which are challenging to infer from image observations alone. In this paper, we show that conditioning a mobile manipulation policy on a spatiotemporal feature map improves reasoning over long horizons. The map represents the environment and the articulated robot body as neural points in a shared latent space and is updated online from egocentric observations and proprioceptive state. We update the environment neural points using object-level rigid tracking and the robot neural points using forward kinematics. We use our spatiotemporal environment and robot feature (SERF) map as a state input to a vision-language-action (VLA) model by extracting map tokens from multiple reference frames and spatial scales, providing the policy with both local and global context. We demonstrate SERF on BEHAVIOR-1K, a benchmark for long-horizon mobile manipulation in household environments. Experiments show that the SERF VLA policy outperforms image-only baselines, reaches subgoals faster by following more direct trajectories, improves robustness to scene-configuration shifts, and recovers from object-drop failures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SERF——一种在线更新的空间-时间特征图，把环境（用物体级刚性跟踪建模）和机器人本体（用运动学建模）统一编码为共享隐空间中的神经点，作为VLA策略的状态输入，从而提升长程移动操作任务中的定位、环境变化感知和任务进度推理能力。

papers.title: SimWeaver: Zero-Shot RGB Sim-to-Real for Deformable Manipulation
papers.abstract: RGB sim-to-real for deformable manipulation has remained largely unsolved without real-world fine-tuning. We present SimWeaver, which trains zero-shot RGB VLA policies on 200 simulated demonstrations per task, reaching above 80% per-task and 91% average real-world success across 5 diverse deformable tasks including plastic-bag manipulation, without teleoperation or per-task calibration. SimWeaver combines a reliable measurement-backed simulator (SimWeaver-Sim) with an extensible asset framework supporting single-image generation(SimWeaver-Asset), a deterministic topology-aware trajectory synthesizer (SimWeaver-Syn), and a sim-to-real protocol with ISP-aware photometric augmentation (SimWeaver-Real). On silk grasping, the sim-trained policy reaches 100% under visual distribution shifts where real-data baselines drop to 9-70%, at two orders of magnitude lower per-trajectory cost. We will release SimWeaver and a representative asset subset. Project page: https://simweaver.github.io/

papers.title: Object-Centric Residual RL for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Enhancement
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can generalize across diverse manipulation tasks, but their imitation-learning-based policies remain brittle in precise physical interactions due to compounding execution errors; Can a reinforcement learning policy trained purely in simulation improve the robustness of real-world VLAs zero-shot? Residual RL, which learns a corrective policy on top of a frozen VLA, offers a natural framework, but existing approaches face a fundamental sim-to-real dilemma: privileged-state methods require lossy distillation for deployment; image-based methods suffer from the visual domain gap; and real-world RL is costly and unsafe. We propose an object-centric residual RL framework that refines VLA actions using object poses, enabling a compact observation space that transfers consistently between simulation and reality. To align the two domains, we additionally replay the same teleoperation demonstrations in simulation to train a sim counterpart of the real-world VLA. The residual RL policy is trained only in simulation with pose noise injection and dropout, and transfers zero-shot to the real robot. Across five manipulation tasks on a real Franka Research 3 (FR3) robot, our method improves the success rate from 42% to 76% zero-shot, and the improved rollouts can be further reused to retrain the base VLA for self-improvement without additional teleoperation. Project page: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/object-centric-residual-rl/

analysis.tldr: 用仿真中训练的、以物体位姿为输入的残差强化学习策略，直接修正冻结的视觉语言动作（VLA）模型输出，在不接触真实机器人的情况下，将5个操作任务的成功率从42%提升至76%，且能用修正后的轨迹反哺VLA自迭代。

papers.title: Scaling Short-Term Memory of Visuomotor Policies for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: Many robotic tasks require short-term memory, whether it's retrieving an object that's no longer visible or turning off an appliance after a set period. Yet, most visuomotor policies trained via imitation learning rely only on immediate sensory input without using past experiences to guide decisions. We present PRISM, a transformer-based architecture for visuomotor policies to effectively use short-term memory via two key components: (i) gated attention, which filters retrieved information to suppress irrelevant details, improving performance by reducing the spurious correlations between the history and current action prediction, (ii) a hierarchical architecture that first compresses local information into compact tokens and then integrates them to capture temporally extended dependencies, improving its compute and memory footprint. Together, these mechanisms enable us to scale short-term memory in visuomotor policies for up to two minutes. To systematically evaluate memory in visuomotor control, we introduce ReMemBench -- a benchmark of eight diverse household manipulation tasks spanning four categories of short-term memory -- designed to foster general memory mechanisms rather than siloed, task-specific solutions. PRISM consistently outperforms prior works, including recurrent architectures, transformers, and their variants -- achieving an absolute improvement of 5%--12% over the strongest baseline. On the RoboCasa and LIBERO benchmarks, it achieves absolute improvements of 11%--15% over its no-memory variant and fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action baselines such as GR00T-N1-3B and OpenVLA, despite not leveraging any large-scale pretraining. Together, PRISM and ReMemBench establish a foundation for developing and evaluating short-term memory-augmented visuomotor policies that scale to long-horizon tasks. Additional materials are available at https://shahrutav.github.io/short-term-memory

analysis.tldr: 提出PRISM模型（带门控注意力和分层压缩的视觉运动策略Transformer），让机器人能在长达2分钟的任务中有效利用短时记忆，并构建了首个专用于评测短时记忆能力的基准ReMemBench（8个家庭操作任务），在多个标准benchmark上显著超越无记忆基线及大模型微调方法。
