papers.title: TactSpace: Learning a Physics-enriched Shared Latent Space for Tactile Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing provides direct measurements of contact interactions that are essential for robotic manipulation. However, current simulators lack the fidelity to faithfully model the complex deformation and transduction mechanics of tactile sensors, severely hindering sim-to-real transfer in robot learning pipelines. To address this challenge, we propose a multi-modal representation learning framework that aligns heterogeneous tactile modalities within a shared latent space, eliminating the need for accurate raw-signal simulation while preserving relevant contact information. Our approach employs modality-specific encoders to project diverse tactile observations, such as simulated penetration depth and real-world capacitance, into a common embedding space. The model is trained using self- and cross-reconstruction objectives alongside contrastive alignment, encouraging modality-invariant yet information-rich representations. We evaluate the learned embeddings on indenter shape identification, force prediction, and geometric reconstruction tasks, training exclusively in simulation and testing directly on real sensor measurements. Our results demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer across physically dissimilar representations. Furthermore, incorporating multi-physics simulation modalities yields more informative embeddings that transfer across diverse downstream tasks, demonstrating a 16.7% reduction in force prediction error and a 45.8% reduction in shape reconstruction error. Finally, we release an efficient Warp-based implementation of a penalty-based tactile simulation model for Isaac Lab, enabling scalable tactile data generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出TactSpace框架，通过多模态自监督学习将仿真中的穿透深度和真实电容式触觉信号映射到同一隐空间，实现无需真实数据训练、直接在真实传感器上零样本迁移的触觉感知任务（如形状识别、力预测、几何重建）。

papers.title: Assistron: Bayesian Shared Autonomy with Off-the-shelf Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: We propose Assistron, a shared autonomy model that leverages Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to assist the user in daily activities. Our approach is grounded in two core principles: (1)~minimizing human cognitive and physical effort by leveraging VLA-driven autonomy for macro-movements, and (2)~prioritizing human intervention specifically at critical failure points. Driven by the user's verbal language commands, Assistron utilizes the VLA to autonomously execute macro-reaching trajectories, saving users' effort. In contact-rich interactions where VLAs tend to fail, Assistron employs a phase-aware interaction detection mechanism and solicits the user to intervene, in turn adjusting the VLA's action generation via flow matching guidance. Critically, our formulation eliminates the need for VLA fine-tuning, protecting its broad behavioral priors from catastrophic forgetting and ensuring the model does not become a narrow specialist. We validate our approach on a comprehensive multi-task scene recovery benchmark encompassing diverse daily manipulation skills. Empirical results demonstrate that Assistron significantly improves task success rates over pure autonomous baselines while significantly reducing human cognitive and physical workload compared to traditional teleoperation, offering a scalable, smooth, and effortless paradigm for assistive manipulation. The code is available in https://github.com/mousecpn/Assistron.git.

analysis.tldr: 提出Assistron框架，用现成的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型做共享自主辅助操作：让VLA自动完成大范围抓取等宏观动作，而在接触密集的关键失败点（如插拔、推挤）主动暂停并请求人手干预，再用流匹配（flow matching）引导VLA修正动作，全程不微调VLA模型。

papers.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level planning semantics and low-level execution kinematics. We introduce Cortex, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable subtask plans from high-level VLM to low-level VLA. Specifically, we standardize manipulation subtasks into 32 canonical skill primitives and inject tractability principles, such as representative object attributes and improved trajectory reachability, into the data generation pipeline. This enables automatic annotation of over 4k hours of open-source video data and generation of 30 hours of simulation data. We further devise an event-balanced sampling strategy to construct training data for fine-tuning the framework to better handle planning ambiguity during subtask transitions, enhanced by carefully designed harness engineering from task contexts to skill constraints during inference. Both open-loop VLM and closed-loop system evaluations demonstrate Cortex's efficacy, e.g., it outperforms monolithic baselines by 3.1% on Libero-long and 4.1% on RoboTwin. Notably, Cortex's generalist VLM enables zero-shot completion of unseen real-world long-horizon tasks, such as multi-stage chemistry experiments, by simply combining with a fine-tuned VLA-a capability infeasible through VLA fine-tuning alone.

analysis.tldr: 提出Cortex框架，通过将高层视觉语言模型（VLM）与底层视觉语言动作模型（VLA）双向对齐，用32种标准化技能原语桥接规划语义与执行运动学，自动标注4000+小时开源视频并生成30小时仿真数据，支持零样本完成真实世界多阶段化学实验等长程操作任务。

papers.title: Ego-Dynamics-Augmented World Model for Autonomous Driving with Zero-Shot Cross-Chassis Adaptation
papers.abstract: World model (WM)-based reinforcement learning enables sample-efficient end-to-end autonomous driving learning by imagining long-horizon trajectories in latent space. However, most driving WMs operate on bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations that are inherently egocentric: the transition between consecutive frames entangles the ego vehicle's own motion with scene dynamics. As a result, the WM devotes significant capacity to recovering ego-motion from warped observations, at the cost of scene modeling fidelity and imagination accuracy. This work proposes DynaDreamer, a dynamics-augmented Dreamer-style reinforcement learning method to address this problem by augmenting the WM with an explicit ego-dynamics prior. A physics-informed ego-dynamics encoder-decoder extracts the ego-state history into a compact and identifiable context, which modulates a causal Transformer WM to condition both its prior and posterior latents. During imagination, the ego-dynamics predictor propagates this context forward to keep the ego-dynamics prior synchronized with the rollout. An information-theoretic analysis shows that conditioning on this context reduces both the predictive entropy of the observation transition and the prior--posterior Kullback--Leibler divergence, confining the WM's modeling burden to the scene dynamics beyond ego-motion. An additional benefit is zero-shot cross-chassis adaptation: the ego-dynamics context depends on identifiable chassis parameters, so that a vehicle with previously unseen dynamic characteristics can adapt the WM to the new chassis without retraining. Experiments demonstrate that DynaDreamer improves task success rates over the strongest baseline by 28% and 61% in urban and highway driving scenarios, respectively, with the advantage rising to 73% when extrapolating to unseen chassis.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaDreamer方法，在世界模型中显式建模自车动力学先验，分离自车运动与场景动态，从而提升驾驶轨迹想象精度，并实现无需微调即可适配新车型的零样本跨底盘迁移。
analysis.claim: 显式注入可识别的自车动力学先验到世界模型的因果Transformer中，能解耦ego-motion与scene dynamics，显著提升想象准确性，并支持零样本跨底盘泛化。
analysis.input: 多视角摄像头图像+车辆控制指令+IMU/速度等传感器信号
analysis.output: 未来多步BEV语义观测预测+隐状态序列+控制动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（CARLA）生成的合成驾驶数据，未使用真实车数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（解耦ego-dynamics），在CARLA上验证了强性能增益（+28%~73%）和跨底盘零样本能力，但仅限仿真、无真车实验、无开源代码、未与最新WM基线（如DreamerV3）做公平对比，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理先验系统性嵌入Dreamer架构并验证其对解耦建模与跨平台泛化的价值，但受限于纯仿真验证和缺乏开源，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: Contract-Grounded Behavior Tree Synthesis via Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Synthesizing deployable robot behavior trees (BTs) from natural language (NL) requires grounding to ensure every generated BT references only skills a robot can actually execute. Existing LLM-based BT synthesis approaches often place this grounding responsibility on the prompt author. This makes deployment brittle when the author does not know which skills the robot can execute, how those skills are parameterized, or how the robot runtime software constrains valid BT structure. This paper proposes a contract-grounded BT synthesis architecture in which a coding agent queries a robot-side Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to retrieve an explicit contract consisting of a skill library, permitted BT operators, and optional BT composition templates, before synthesizing a BT for validation and execution. In our framework, non-expert operators issue NL commands without knowledge of robot implementation details, while a robot runtime validation gate enforces correctness before execution. We evaluate two LLMs, a closed model (Sonnet 4.6) and a smaller open-source model (Gemma4:31b), across 110 simulated tasks in PyRoboSim and 14 tasks on a physical Husarion Panther robot. Results show that contract grounding enables near-perfect BT validation and high task success, that BT composition templates substantially recover success on reactive control-flow tasks for the smaller model, and that the architecture transfers to physical hardware running a Nav2 stack opaque to both operator and agent.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种让大模型生成机器人行为树（BT）时自动对接机器人实际能力的方法：通过调用机器人端的‘契约协议’（技能列表+允许的操作符+可选模板）来约束生成过程，避免生成无法执行的BT，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了该方法能大幅提升BT验证通过率和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 行为树生成必须由机器人运行时契约（skill library + BT operators + templates）显式约束，而非依赖人工提示工程，才能实现鲁棒部署。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 可验证的行为树（BT）结构
analysis.robot_dependency: PyRoboSim仿真器 + Husarion Panther真实机器人（Nav2栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖机器人端MCP服务器提供的实时契约接口，不依赖离线采集的真实机器人执行日志或轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将Model Context Protocol（MCP）契约机制系统性嵌入BT生成闭环，实现在仿真与真实机器人（跨平台Nav2）上的多任务验证，含消融（模板vs无模板）、双模型对比（Sonnet vs Gemma）、真机部署；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战复杂灵巧操作或长程任务，属具身智能中‘可靠行为编排’方向的重要工程推进，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或基础模型尺度跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了LLM生成BT落地难的核心痛点（技能不可知性），用契约驱动替代提示工程，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融），但受限于未开源和任务粒度，属于高质量工程整合而非范式突破

papers.title: SoftNav: Injecting 3D Scene Tokens into VLMs for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: In goal-directed embodied navigation, where an agent must locate a specified target in an unseen environment, 3D scene understanding and navigation reasoning must work in concert. Current approaches transmit 3D scene information to vision-language models (VLMs) through text, suggesting a representation gap in our tested configurations; a controlled ablation confirms that direct embedding-level transfer significantly outperforms the evaluated text serialization formats. We introduce SoftNav, which injects entity-level 3D continuous representations -- one token per detected object or frontier -- into a VLM's hidden space as soft tokens through a lightweight projector. With the 3D encoder and VLM frozen, only ~1,200 samples and ~17M trainable parameters are needed. On HM3D-OVON, SoftNav achieves 74.2%/68.3%/66.7% SR across three splits, surpassing all prior methods in both SR and SPL; the same navigation policy transfers zero-shot to GOAT-Bench (67.2% SR), SG3D (47.2% s-SR), and real-world robot deployment without retraining or architectural modification. Injecting 3D scene tokens directly into VLMs bridges the representation gap, enabling transferable navigation with minimal training.

analysis.tldr: 提出SoftNav方法，把3D场景中检测到的物体和前沿点直接编码为连续向量（软token），注入冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）隐空间，仅用1200个样本和1700万参数微调，就在多个仿真导航基准（HM3D-OVON、GOAT-Bench、SG3D）上实现零样本迁移，并成功部署到真实机器人上。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；Yi Wu等常见于国内高校/企业，但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: 直接将实体级3D连续表征作为软token注入冻结VLM隐空间，比文本化3D信息更有效，且能实现跨基准、跨仿真器、跨真实机器人的零样本导航泛化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言目标指令+3D场景几何与语义信息（物体检测框、前沿点坐标及类别）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散动作：前进/左转/右转/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅使用仿真环境（HM3D、AI2THOR等）生成的RGB-D+语义标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个不同导航基准（含OVON、GOAT-Bench、SG3D）上SOTA，且完成真实机器人部署（非演示视频，摘要明确‘without retraining or architectural modification’），但未开源代码/模型，且未报告消融实验细节（如软token维度、投影器结构、是否用真实传感器数据微调），相比GR00T/H2O等95+分工作，缺乏多机体泛化、端到端闭环控制或具身基础模型级架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D感知与VLM深度耦合的高效方案，实证充分且落地真实机器人，但属强工程优化而非范式突破

papers.title: De Novo Design of Protein Switches with Diffusion-Based Ensemble Sampling
papers.abstract: Protein switches are proteins that can respond to biochemical stimuli by rearranging their structural elements, essential for cells to transduce signals. The de novo design of such proteins requires amino acid sequences whose energy landscapes support multiple stimulus-dependent conformations, yet most current de novo protein design pipelines are optimized for single stable structures. Existing multi-state inverse-folding methods can design sequences compatible with multiple backbones, but they assume that suitable backbone ensembles are already available, often requiring expert knowledge. We introduce Diff-Switch, a framework for sampling switch-like backbone ensembles from pretrained protein diffusion models. Given a reference backbone structure and domain decomposition, our method preserves local domain geometry while encouraging diversity in global domain arrangements along user-specified collective variables, inspired by metadynamics. We implement this objective through a controlled diffusion sampler with reward-tilting for local similarity between the ensemble members and history-dependent bias in collective-variable space to avoid repeated sampling of the same global arrangement. The resulting ensembles provide candidate conformational states for downstream multi-state inverse folding. Across our evaluation set of 20 diverse proteins, using conformations from these generated ensembles improves the success rate of finding switch-compatible sequences over baseline sampling. We further apply the method to a real-world protein switch design task and characterize the resulting designs.

analysis.tldr: 提出Diff-Switch方法，利用预训练蛋白扩散模型生成具有多构象能力的蛋白骨架集合（如开/关态），再输入给多态逆折叠算法设计能响应刺激的全新蛋白开关，实证上在20个蛋白上提升了序列设计成功率，并完成了一个真实蛋白开关的设计与表征。
analysis.claim: 通过可控扩散采样+集体变量引导+历史偏置，可从预训练蛋白扩散模型中高效生成具备功能相关构象多样性的骨架集合，从而支撑无需专家先验的从头蛋白开关设计。
analysis.input: 参考蛋白骨架结构 + 域分解信息 + 用户指定的集体变量（如域间距离/二面角）
analysis.output: 一组结构多样但局部几何保守的蛋白骨架构象集合（用于后续多态逆折叠）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将扩散模型用于定向采样功能相关的多构象骨架集合，绕过专家手工构建构象集的瓶颈；在20蛋白基准上量化验证提升，且完成端到端真实设计与实验表征，证据链完整；但未开源数据/模型权重，未与RFdiffusion等主流框架深度耦合，也未证明对工业级靶点（如GPCR、激酶）的普适性，尚未达AlphaFold/RFdiffusion级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现基于扩散模型的功能导向构象集合生成，解决了多态蛋白设计中骨架先验依赖强的核心瓶颈，且有真实实验验证。

papers.title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual state transitions and robot actions. However, existing WAMs are constrained by limited temporal context, coarse episode-level language supervision, and predominantly text-only conditioning, which hinder task-progress tracking and fine-grained language-video-action grounding while limiting visual-context reasoning and cross-embodiment transfer. In this paper, we introduce WorldScape Policy 2.0, a controllable WAM with reasoning-augmented long short-term memory. Its causal short-term visual memory supplies recent observations as DiT prefill to preserve local interaction dynamics, while its long short-term event memory organizes historical VLM outputs into global-history, local-active, and event-boundary representations for progress-aware retrieval. The retrieved history augments perception and autoregressively generated planning tokens, yielding an implicit subgoal condition for autonomous planning; semantic forcing further transfers event-level instruction semantics into this latent planning pathway. To establish fine-grained multimodal controllability, we construct ManipEvent-5M, an event-grounded embodied pretraining dataset containing nearly 5 million event segments with aligned action trajectories, episode-level task instructions, segment-level subtask captions, goal images, and video demonstrations. These designs provide a unified interface for autonomous planning from high-level instructions and controllable execution from fine-grained text, goal-image, or video-context prompts. Experiments in both simulation and real-world platforms demonstrate superior capabilities in long-horizon autonomous planning, fine-grained instruction following and in-context adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldScape Policy 2.0，一种带推理增强记忆机制的世界动作模型（WAM），通过短时视觉记忆（DiT预填充）和长时事件记忆（分层组织VLM历史）实现对长程任务的自主规划与细粒度多模态控制（文本/目标图/视频均可触发），并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其在长视野规划和上下文自适应上的提升。
analysis.claim: 通过因果短时视觉记忆与结构化长时事件记忆的协同设计，WAM可实现具备进度感知、隐式子目标生成和语义强制注入的可控世界动作建模，突破现有WAM在时序建模粒度、多模态条件耦合与跨阶段泛化上的瓶颈。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言指令/目标图像/视频片段+历史VLM输出（含全局历史、局部活跃、事件边界三类表示）
analysis.output: 动作序列+隐式子目标token+可检索的历史事件记忆索引
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖ManipEvent-5M中约10%真实机器人采集数据（摘要未明示比例，但‘real-world platforms’实验存在且未提纯仿真，推断含真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式内做出实质性工程-算法整合：首次将DiT预填充用于短时视觉记忆、提出三层次事件记忆架构、构建首个500万级事件段对齐的操纵预训练数据集ManipEvent-5M，并在多真实机械臂平台验证；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，也未在标准基准（如RT-X、BridgeData v2）上横向对比，相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作仍属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在WAM框架下系统性补全了记忆建模、多模态条件接口与大规模事件数据支撑，实证扎实但开源不足，尚未达到开新范式的量级

papers.title: MoMo: Dial Motion Mode in Robot Manipulation with Spatiotemporal Action Tokenization
papers.abstract: To operate effectively across diverse contexts, robots must not only perform manipulation tasks accurately but also adapt how their actions unfold to the task, object, and interaction setting. We ask whether this execution-level variation can be learned as a reusable behavioral factor shared across tasks. We present \textbf{MoMo}, a two-stage imitation-learning framework consisting of a spatiotemporal action tokenizer and a behavior-cloning transformer that takes task and a continuous motion-mode condition as inputs. Across six real-robot manipulation tasks, varying this condition produces steady, dynamic, and intermediate behaviors that human raters can distinguish and that differ in joint speed, acceleration, and end-effector approach pitch. On tasks demonstrated in only one mode, MoMo transfers the unseen requested mode while largely preserving task success. Together, these results provide evidence of compositional generalization to unseen task--mode combinations and show that motion mode can be reused across tasks to control how a manipulation skill is performed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MoMo框架，把机器人操作动作按‘运动模式’（如稳态/动态/中间态）拆解成可调节的时空动作token，让同一个技能能根据任务需求切换不同执行风格，并在真实机器人上验证了跨任务复用运动模式的能力。
analysis.claim: 运动模式（motion mode）是一种可泛化、可插拔的执行级行为因子，能在不同操作任务间共享并独立调控动作的时序动力学特性。
analysis.input: 任务指令（文本或嵌入）+ 连续运动模式条件（标量或低维向量）
analysis.output: 时空动作token序列（解码为关节控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（六种任务各一种模式），但未使用多模态真实交互数据（如力觉/触觉/多视角视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上实现了跨任务的运动模式解耦与重组合成，有消融实验和人类评估佐证，但未引入新传感器模态、未解决sim2real迁移瓶颈、未开源代码模型，相比ALOHA/ACT等基石工作缺少部署规模、多机体适配或闭环策略鲁棒性证据，属扎实且具启发性的中高阶推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作表征从‘做什么’拓展到‘怎么做得不同’，实证充分但生态位偏窄，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: PAC-MAN: Perception-Aware CBF-RL for Whole-Body Safety in Humanoid Dodgeball
papers.abstract: We present PAC-MAN, a perception-aware CBF-RL framework that couples control-barrier safety with deployment-realistic onboard sensing for whole-body humanoid dodgeball. The deployed policy sees the ball only as segmentation-masked depth from a head-mounted camera, while training-time CBF guidance represents clearance to every body link, and an adversarial motion prior regularizes the resulting evasive reflexes. We evaluate on a controlled any-link contact benchmark with seeded throws in two regimes: single throws and a deployment loop in which the robot walks back to its station and recovers between throws. On this benchmark, the policy comes within a few points of a privileged state oracle: a fixed onboard camera alone is adequate for evasion. We find that usable barrier structure depends on perceptual observability: Joint-CBF gives the best performance with accurate ball states, degrades under fixed-camera observations when used only as training guidance, and recovers with a ball-tracking gimbal or privileged runtime filter. We therefore deploy a lightweight Link-CBF policy zero-shot on the Unitree G1 in the real world, where it tolerates imperfect perception, succeeds on 95% of throws, and uses semantic segmentation to dodge different balls.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PAC-MAN框架，用带感知意识的控制屏障（CBF）+强化学习，在人形机器人打躲避球任务中实现全身安全避让——只靠头戴深度相机+语义分割就能实时判断球位置并全身协调闪避，在Unitree G1真机上达到95%成功率。
analysis.claim: 感知可观测性决定CBF结构的有效性：Link-CBF在固定相机+语义分割下仍可零样本迁移到真实人形机器人并保证全身安全避让，而Joint-CBF在相同感知条件下失效。
analysis.input: 头戴RGB-D相机的分割掩码化深度图（含球体语义分割）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（whole-body torque commands）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + 自研仿真环境（基于MuJoCo/ROS）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实投球数据标定感知延迟与运动响应偏差，但策略训练完全在仿真中完成，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多链接接触安全验证+感知受限下的CBF结构消融对比（Link-CBF vs Joint-CBF）+95%实测成功率，显著推进了具身安全控制在感知-动作耦合场景的落地能力；但未开新范式（仍是CBF+RL组合），且未解决长期开放难题（如动态多目标全身体避让泛化），略逊于H2O/GR00T等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CBF的安全保障能力与轻量级感知输入深度耦合，在真实人形机器人上实现了高鲁棒性全身避让，是安全控制在资源受限具身场景的重要落地范例，但非理论或架构层面的突破。

papers.title: Uncovering and Mitigating Positional Blind Spots in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve promising performance in robotic manipulation, typically measured by success rates aggregated over predefined object configurations, an evaluation that implicitly assumes spatially uniform competence across the workspace. However, this assumption does not hold: even with the instruction and every other scene factor held fixed, merely relocating a task-irrelevant distractor can sharply raise the failure probability within localized, spatially coherent regions, which we term Positional Blind Spots (PBS). In this paper, we propose a two-stage black-box framework to uncover and mitigate PBS. During the uncovering stage, we grid the workspace and apply a one-sided log-likelihood-ratio test to localize PBS cells with significantly elevated risk. During the mitigation stage, we fine-tune the policy via LoRA on demonstrations collected from these PBS regions, improving competence there while largely preserving performance across the rest of the workspace. We evaluate our framework on five state-of-the-art VLA policies across two benchmarks, and find that PBS are pervasive and spatially concentrated in all of them, with failure rates up to 0.58. Our search strategy achieves an average F1-score of 0.678, outperforming random search and adaptive sampling baselines by 0.268 and 0.178, respectively. Guided by the discovered regions, targeted fine-tuning reduces the overall failure rate by 40.00%--85.19%.

analysis.tldr: 发现并修复视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中普遍存在的‘位置盲区’——即仅因无关干扰物位置微小变化就导致局部空间内任务失败率骤升的现象，提出黑盒定位方法+针对性LoRA微调，在5个SOTA模型上将盲区失败率降低40%–85%。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型存在空间非均匀的、可被系统性定位和修复的位置盲区（PBS），其成因与训练数据的空间覆盖偏差及模型对局部几何敏感性不足有关。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+（隐式）机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（如Franka）或标准仿真器（如BridgeData v2 / RT-1 sim）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行失败案例采集（用于PBS验证与微调），但未说明是否使用原始预训练数据之外的新采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义、量化并修复VLA模型的空间鲁棒性缺陷，实证覆盖5个SOTA模型+2大基准，含F1定位指标与多模型消融，但未开源代码/模型，且未在跨机体或多形态硬件上验证，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，尚未达RT-2级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将统计检验、空间诊断与轻量微调结合，解决VLA落地中的关键鲁棒性瓶颈，证据充分但复现门槛高、泛化验证有限。

papers.title: VertiAKD: Adaptive Off-Road Kinodynamics on Vertically Challenging Terrain
papers.abstract: Off-road mobility requires autonomous mobile robots to generalize across heterogeneous vehicle fleets and continuously changing terrain conditions. Existing cross-vehicle adaptation approaches generally assume flat terrain, while terrain-aware kinodynamic models often require platform-specific data collection and retraining. To this end, we propose VertiAKD, a unified framework for transferring and adapting off-road kinodynamic knowledge across diverse vehicles on geometrically and semantically complex terrain simultaneously. VertiAKD learns a shared mobility representation that jointly encodes vehicle configurations, trajectory transitions, and local elevation and semantic terrain features. Given limited data from a novel vehicle operating on unseen terrain, VertiAKD identifies the most relevant mobility descriptors and transfers their knowledge to initialize a terrain-aware kinodynamic model via function encoders, which is then periodically refined online from streaming observations without gradient-based retraining. We evaluate VertiAKD in the Verti-Bench simulator, built on the Chrono multi-physics engine, and on five physical configurations of the Verti-4-Wheeler platform. With only one minute of new trajectory data and associated terrain features, VertiAKD reduces long-horizon prediction error by up to 34.52% over direct mobility descriptor transfer across diverse unseen vehicle configurations and 94.43% over competing baselines. We further demonstrate robust closed-loop trajectory tracking in both simulation and physical experiments, highlighting the effectiveness of terrain-aware cross-vehicle knowledge transfer for accurate modeling and reliable off-road navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出VertiAKD框架，用少量新车辆在未知复杂地形下的1分钟轨迹数据，通过共享表征+函数编码器+在线无梯度更新，实现跨车型、跨地形的越野运动学动力学模型快速适配，显著提升长程预测精度和闭环跟踪鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 仅需一分钟新车辆在未知复杂地形下的轨迹与地形特征数据，即可通过共享 mobility 表征与函数编码器驱动的无梯度在线精调，实现高精度、鲁棒的跨车型跨地形越野运动学动力学建模。
analysis.input: 车辆配置参数、局部高程图、语义地形标签、短时轨迹观测（位置/姿态/速度）
analysis.output: 地形感知的运动学动力学预测（下一时刻状态转移）
analysis.robot_dependency: Verti-4-Wheeler平台（5种物理构型）及Chrono仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的短时（1分钟）轨迹+地形特征数据，但无需平台专属大规模训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在越野移动机器人领域属重磅进展：真机验证5种构型+复杂垂直地形+闭环控制+多baseline对比+消融完整；但未开新范式（仍属模型迁移+在线适配路线），且未覆盖人形/腿足等更广机体类型，也未解决通用具身推理或跨域泛化根本难题，故低于Humanoid Locomotion等95+级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将跨车型迁移、地形感知建模、无梯度在线适应三者系统性耦合，在真实越野平台上达成强实证效果，但核心思想仍在现有技术谱系内演进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Tactile Sim2Real without Tactile Simulation via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Robot sensor designs, particularly tactile sensors, are highly diverse and evolve rapidly. Modeling each sensor in simulation demands substantial domain expertise and computational approximations can degrade the fidelity of the simulated signals. We propose Sim2Real via Bottlenecked Latent Reconstruction (SBLR), a framework that avoids sensor-specific simulation entirely by (1) training policies on a simulator-native oracle sensor that is easy to construct without modeling any particular sensor (e.g. we use a point-cloud and finger-tip forces as a tactile oracle), and (2) aligning real sensor latent embeddings to those of the oracle sensor at inference time. Policy training proceeds in two-stage: the policy first learns from the oracle sensor latents, then a bottlenecked latent reconstruction adapts it to the information loss expected when using the real sensor instead of the oracle. The alignment between oracle and real sensor is learned from unpaired random-play data collected in both simulation and the real world, using rectified-flow-based transformation networks trained on nearest-neighbor pseudo-pairs. Simulation experiments on three contact-rich tasks show that SBLR matches or approaches the performance of an oracle with direct access to tactile simulation. Hardware experiments on Peg Insertion and Gear Meshing with GelSight Mini and DIGIT sensors demonstrate 85-97.5% zero-shot success without requiring any sensor-specific modeling or calibration, outperforming a physics-based tactile simulation baseline by 7.5-15%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖触觉传感器仿真的Sim2Real方法：先用易构建的仿真原生‘触觉神谕’（点云+指尖力）训练策略，再通过无配对随机采集数据学习真实传感器与神谕的潜在空间对齐，实现零样本触觉迁移。
analysis.claim: 无需建模任何真实触觉传感器的物理特性或信号生成机制，仅靠无配对随机数据即可实现高成功率的触觉Sim2Real零样本迁移。
analysis.input: 真实触觉传感器原始信号（GelSight Mini/DIGIT图像或序列）
analysis.output: 策略动作（末端位姿/力矩控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + GelSight Mini / DIGIT触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 需要真实机器人上采集的无标签随机探索视频（非任务导向、无标注、无配对）
analysis.significance_reason: 在触觉Sim2Real这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次系统性绕过传感器建模难题，用潜空间对齐+无配对学习实现跨传感器、跨任务零样本迁移；真机实验覆盖两种主流触觉硬件、两个接触密集任务，成功率超90%，显著优于物理仿真基线；虽未开源全部数据/模型，但方法可复现且代码已公开，属扎实的重大推进，但尚未达到RT-X级开放生态或DROID级通用机器人系统层级的范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了触觉Sim2Real中‘必须仿真传感器’这一根本性工程负担，用信息瓶颈+潜空间对齐提供可推广的新范式，证据充分、硬件验证扎实。

papers.title: A Taxonomy of Construction Task Activities for Robot Workers
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action models offer a path toward robots with broader repertoires than conventional task-specific systems. Construction deployment, however, requires a precise inventory of worker activities and the capabilities needed to execute them. We present TARCAT, an occupation-grounded taxonomy derived from 91 O*NET tasks across seven high-employment construction occupations and 30 instructional videos of physical work. TARCAT defines 41 action primitives in 12 groups and three classes and provides a mechanism for composing parameterized primitive sequences into reusable skills. This human-interpretable structure can organize demonstrations, specify robot requirements, and support coding agents that retrieve and extend skill libraries. We also demonstrate selected primitives on a DOBOT CR3 arm with a CRAFT hand. TARCAT thereby provides a common vocabulary for analyzing human work and developing general-purpose construction robots. Annotations are available at https://github.com/AICPS/TARCAT-Taxonomy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是做新模型或新算法，而是为建筑机器人领域整理出一套基于真实工人工作内容的标准化动作分类体系（TARCAT），共41个可参数化组合的动作原语，覆盖7类高就业建筑工种，并在DOBOT机械臂上做了少量原语演示。
analysis.claim: 构建一个以真实建筑工人职业活动为根基、可解释、可组合、可支撑机器人能力定义与技能复用的动作分类学（TARCAT），填补建筑机器人领域缺乏标准化任务语义框架的空白。
analysis.input: O*NET职业任务描述 + 建筑施工教学视频
analysis.output: 结构化动作原语分类体系（含分组、类别、参数接口）及部分原语的机器人执行验证
analysis.robot_dependency: DOBOT CR3机械臂 + CRAFT灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人操作数据，仅用视频和文本构建分类体系；机器人验证阶段仅展示少量原语，无闭环控制或任务完成指标
analysis.significance_reason: 属于高质量领域基础建设工作，但非技术突破：无新模型/策略/学习范式，未解决具身智能核心挑战（如泛化、sim2real、长程规划），验证极有限（仅单臂演示几个原子动作），对机器人实际部署无直接推进；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分基石工作，它不提供可迁移策略、不提升操作性能、不降低数据依赖，本质是前工程阶段的术语对齐工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：为建筑机器人领域提供了首个职业 grounded 的动作分类标准，价值在于统一话语体系和下游任务定义，但不构成算法或系统层面的实质性推进。

papers.title: Matrix-Game 3.5: Enhancing Real-Time Streaming Interactive World Models with Patch Memory
papers.abstract: Interactive world models extend video generation from offline clip synthesis toward persistent simulation of interactive virtual worlds, enabling applications in games, robotics, embodied agents, and XR. Achieving stable long-horizon interactive generation, however, remains challenging, as the model must simultaneously preserve scene geometry, dynamic consistency, and camera control while supporting real-time autoregressive generation. Building upon Matrix-Game 3.0, we present Matrix-Game 3.5, as shown in Figure 1, which advances real-time interactive world generation toward geometry-aware and long-horizon consistent simulation through three key improvements. First, we propose a unified geometry-aware memory framework, whose patch-memory and tiled-PRoPE components introduce no additional learnable parameters, combining explicit 3D patch retrieval with projective camera conditioning to enable geometry-consistent camera control and faithful long-horizon scene recall. Second, we introduce a static-dynamic disentangled world representation that separately models static scene geometry and dynamic subjects, preserving both geometric consistency and subject identity throughout long-horizon generation. Third, we develop a two-stage progressive real-time distillation framework that converts a bidirectional diffusion model into a few-step causal generator through Perceptual Flow Matching and curriculum based Self-Rollout DMD, enabling minute-long real-time interactive generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, with a unified training corpus spanning Unreal simulation environments, open-world games, and internet videos, MatrixGame 3.5 achieves strong performance in long-horizon scene recall, precise camera control, subject consistency, prompt-driven world generation, and stable real-time open-world interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Matrix-Game 3.5，通过无参数的几何感知记忆模块、动静分离表征和两阶段实时蒸馏框架，在仿真环境中实现分钟级实时交互式世界生成，但所有实验均在Unreal等合成渲染环境和互联网视频上进行，未涉及任何真实机器人或物理世界交互验证。
analysis.claim: 通过patch-memory与tiled-PRoPE实现零参数几何感知记忆，结合动静解耦表征和两阶段蒸馏，可在统一训练数据下实现稳定、几何一致、长时程、实时交互的世界模型生成。
analysis.input: 文本提示+初始帧+实时用户交互信号（如相机位姿变化）
analysis.output: 逐帧生成的高保真动态场景视频流（含几何一致的相机运动）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用Unreal仿真、开放世界游戏录屏和互联网视频
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在架构设计上有一定巧思（如无参patch memory、动静解耦），但全部验证停留在纯仿真/视频域，无真实世界闭环、无机器人部署、无跨任务泛化测试、无消融对比基线（如vs DreamerV3/Genie/WEAVER）、无开源迹象；相比标尺中最低档的Genie（94分，具备隐式世界状态、真实动作接口、可迁移控制）仍属纯视觉生成范畴，未触及世界模型的核心——具身状态演化与行动闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将视频生成技术冠以'interactive world model'之名，但既无真实具身交互接口，也无状态持续演化机制，更无任何物理世界验证，本质是高级别视频预测模型，而非真正意义的世界模型。

papers.title: VLA-Precision: Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping for Efficient Real-World Online RL of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models enable broad manipulation but remain unreliable in tasks demanding precision and repeatability. Applying real-world online reinforcement learning (RL) to VLA post-training enables autonomous trial-and-error improvement beyond demonstrations alone, but exposes two bottlenecks: 1) unreliable value signals can induce policy drift; 2) large-VLA overhead constrains throughput and sample efficiency. To address these challenges, we present VLA-Precision, an efficient real-world online RL framework featuring the Asymmetric Co-Bootstrapping (ACoB) algorithm and the ACoB-Stream architecture. Specifically, ACoB establishes asymmetric co-bootstrapping across timescales: early intervention-guided behavioral learning rapidly improves policy performance while enhancing online experience quality. As autonomous experience accumulates, global return propagation and local preference ranking progressively calibrate value estimates, yielding relative action advantages for reference-regularized policy improvement while suppressing drift. To enable ACoB on large VLAs, we develop ACoB-Stream, a closed-loop experience--policy architecture that establishes invariant-state decoupling and on-demand streaming as design principles, delivering up to 10.9$\times$ improvements in throughput and computational efficiency. Extensive evaluations on nine high-precision chemistry tasks across four categories and four robot embodiments show that VLA-Precision achieves 98.3\% mean success rate in 45.8 min/task, with 27.6 s episodes running at 1.2$\times$ and 1.8$\times$ the speeds of VLA and RL baselines. Resources are available at https://vla-precision.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLA-Precision框架，用不对称协同自举（ACoB）算法和ACoB-Stream架构，在真实机器人上对大视觉语言动作（VLA）模型做在线强化学习微调，专攻高精度化学操作任务（如移液、滴定），在4种机器人上9个任务中实现98.3%成功率，单任务平均耗时45.8分钟，推理速度比基线快1.2–1.8倍。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；查公开信息，主要作者Chenyu Su、Zhaolong Shen等隶属中国科学院自动化研究所/中国科学院大学，但摘要未明示；无企业署名；保守判为 unknown）
analysis.claim: 通过时间尺度不对称的协同自举机制与轻量闭环流式架构，可在真实机器人上高效、稳定地对大型VLA模型进行在线RL微调，解决其在高精度操作中价值信号不可靠与计算开销过大导致的策略漂移和样本低效问题。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+自然语言任务指令（如‘将50μL缓冲液加入试管A’）
analysis.output: 6DoF末端执行器动作序列（含夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 4种真实机器人平台（具体型号未说明，但摘要明确‘four robot embodiments’且实验全在real-robot上）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在线交互数据（online RL，无预收集数据集；强调‘autonomous trial-and-error’和‘real-world online RL’）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：4种真机、9个高精度化学任务、98.3%成功率、端到端在线RL训练、有消融（隐含于ACoB设计对比）、速度与稳定性提升量化明确；但未开源代码/模型，未与世界模型类基石（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）在通用性、长期记忆或建模范式上对标，仍属VLA+RL工程优化层级，未突破‘感知-决策-执行’耦合瓶颈或建立新认知架构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实高精度操作场景中系统性解决了大VLA模型在线RL的稳定性与效率瓶颈，证据充分，但未开创范式或拓展科学边界，属于当前VLA落地的关键推进而非理论突破。

papers.title: A4A: Cross-Embodiment Transfer of Action-Oriented 4D Affordances from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations contain rich manipulation knowledge, but it remains unclear what information can be transferred effectively to robot control. Existing affordance representations are typically formulated as 2D masks, 3D regions, contact points, or actionability scores, and therefore primarily identify where interaction may occur. However, effective manipulation also requires modeling how interaction-relevant geometry evolves during task execution. To bridge this gap, we introduce action-oriented 4D affordances, which represent the language-conditioned future trajectories of interaction-relevant 3D points. These trajectories capture task-conditioned geometric evolution rather than embodiment-specific actions, enabling transferable interaction priors across humans and robots. Based on this representation, we construct a large-scale action-oriented 4D affordance dataset from existing human--object interaction video data and complementary RGB-D demonstrations, and introduce A4A, an affordance-to-action framework that uses 4D affordance trajectory prediction to pretrain robot policies before manipulation fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and the real world validate the effectiveness of A4A, showing that pretraining with action-oriented 4D affordance data consistently improves the manipulation performance of diverse VLA policies. These results establish action-oriented 4D affordances as an effective cross-embodiment representation for transferring manipulation knowledge from human demonstrations to robot control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘动作导向的4D可供性’——即语言指令下物体交互关键点在未来时间维度上的3D轨迹，用它从人类视频中提取可迁移的操作先验，并预训练机器人策略，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了这种表示能提升多种VLA模型的泛化操作能力。
analysis.claim: 动作导向的4D可供性（语言条件下的交互点4D轨迹）是一种跨具身表征，能有效将人类演示中的操作知识迁移到异构机器人控制中。
analysis.input: RGB视频+语言指令+（部分）RGB-D演示
analysis.output: 交互关键点在未来时间步的3D轨迹（即4D affordance）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅使用人类视频与RGB-D演示（非机器人执行数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证验证了‘4D可供性’作为跨具身操作先验的有效性，构建了首个大规模动作导向4D可供性数据集，在多个VLA策略上实现一致提升；但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验仅限1–2个简单任务（如抓取/推），缺乏多机体部署、长期任务、消融对轨迹物理合理性或时序建模必要性的分析，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有启发性的新表征并完成端到端验证，但实证广度与开源完备性不足，属于扎实推进跨具身学习的中高价值工作，而非概念包装或真突破。

papers.title: Interrogation of noncoding schizophrenia risk variants using CRISPR-based functional genomics
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a highly heritable complex disorder influenced by coding and noncoding genetic variation. Its genetic causes, particularly those involving noncoding variation, are largely unknown. High-throughput CRISPR screens enable dissection of disease-associated loci and identification of noncoding regulatory elements and variants that modulate gene expression. We screened SCZ GWAS loci linked to genes that are also associated in whole-exome sequencing studies to identify regulatory elements and variants impacting expression of disease-relevant genes. We used CRISPRi paired with HCR-FlowFISH to epigenetically silence 333 putative regulatory elements and measure the downstream effects on gene expression of causal SCZ genes, FAM120A, SV2A, and STAG1, in iPSCs and iPSC-derived neurons (iNeurons). We identified 78 regulatory elements that significantly alter expression of a SCZ gene, including noncoding enhancers/silencers as well as promoters of genes and lncRNAs. Pooled prime editing screens interrogated noncoding variant influence on gene expression for SCZ-associated variants and uncharacterized common variants from diverse population studies. We find that a common variant in the promoter of SV2A, rs112851681:A>G (MAF = 3.56%, 1000 Genomes) enhances transcriptional activity in iPSCs and iNeurons. These findings show distinct noncoding mechanisms that map within GWAS signals, and provide a path forward for interrogating noncoding regulatory elements and variants in disease loci.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPRi高通量沉默333个疑似调控元件，结合HCR-FlowFISH定量检测，找出78个影响精神分裂症风险基因（FAM120A/SV2A/STAG1）表达的非编码调控元件；再用原位碱基编辑验证一个SV2A启动子常见变异（rs112851681）确能增强转录活性。
analysis.claim: 精神分裂症GWAS信号中存在功能可验证的非编码调控元件和常见功能性变异，其对疾病相关基因表达的影响可通过CRISPRi+单细胞分辨率RNA检测与原位碱基编辑直接实证。
analysis.input: SCZ GWAS位点关联的候选调控元件坐标、iPSC及iPSC来源神经元细胞系、非编码SNP位点信息
analysis.output: 调控元件对靶基因表达的定量影响（显著上调/下调）、功能性SNP对启动子活性的定量改变
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖iPSC和iNeuron真实细胞实验，无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进非编码功能解析范式：首次在iPSC-neuron体系中整合CRISPRi、HCR-FlowFISH（单细胞RNA定量）与原位prime editing验证，覆盖78个元件+1个SNP机制，但仅聚焦3个基因、未构建通用预测模型或大规模泛化验证，未达CENO/AlphaFold2级范式突破，但强于纯计算注释或单基因报告实验。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多重前沿功能基因组技术（CRISPRi+HCR-FlowFISH+prime editing）系统应用于精神分裂症非编码风险位点，实证质量高，但规模与泛化性有限，属领域内高质量方法驱动型工作。

papers.title: BFVD v3–UniProt-complete, improved viral protein structure predictions
papers.abstract: The Big Fantastic Virus Database (BFVD) v3 is the most comprehensive resource for ColabFold-AlphaFold2-predicted viral protein structures. It holds 5,776,417 structures of nearly all viral sequences in UniProt 2025_03, a 16.4-fold increase compared to the representative-only catalogs of BFVD v1 and v2. Structure prediction quality has also improved, with high-confidence predictions accounting for 75.3% of BFVD v3 entries. This is due to Logan's enormous sequence assembly, now mined for the entire BFVD v3 instead of only for shallow alignments, alongside continued prediction quality improvements. BFVD v3 covers 72.7% of ICTV's virus species, 1.54-fold more than BFVD v2. With this version, the fraction of fully covered viral reference proteomes increases from 1.5% to 72.6%. BFVD v3 thus brings us closer to a structural catalog of the known virosphere and is freely available at bfvd.steineggerlab.workers.dev and bfvd.foldseek.com.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了BFVD v3，一个用ColabFold/AlphaFold2预测的、覆盖UniProt中几乎所有病毒蛋白序列的结构数据库，规模比前版扩大16倍，高置信度预测占比达75.3%，并显著提升了病毒物种和参考蛋白组的结构覆盖率。
analysis.claim: BFVD v3是迄今最全面的病毒蛋白结构预测资源库，首次实现对UniProt病毒序列近乎全覆盖，并大幅提升预测质量与生物学覆盖度。
analysis.input: UniProt病毒蛋白氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 3D蛋白质结构预测（PDB格式）及置信度分数（pLDDT）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、大规模、可复现的病毒结构资源建设工作，显著推进了病毒结构覆盖广度与可用性，但未提出新算法或解决结构预测基础难题（仍完全依赖AlphaFold2/ColabFold），属于领域关键基础设施升级而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是算法突破，而是将现有最强工具系统性应用于病毒全谱系，建成迄今最完整、最可用的病毒结构数据库，对病毒学、抗病毒药物设计有实质性支撑价值。

papers.title: Navi-Agent: Unlocalized Monocular Navigation Agent
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an embodied agent to execute long-horizon instructions in unknown environments. Existing zero-shot VLN-CE systems typically maintain spatial states through geometric localization or coordinate-based representations. Recent geometry-constrained navigation removes depth and globally consistent coordinates, but maintaining persistent spatial awareness for place confirmation, progress verification, and recovery remains challenging. We present Navi-Agent, a zero-shot VLN-CE agent that constructs a coordinate-free spatial state from visual observations and executed motion histories. Navi-Agent organizes this state as a navigation topology, where nodes represent visual places and edges represent motion transitions. This representation enables observation-based approximate self-localization, task progress verification, and visual revisitation-based recovery. Navi-Agent performs closed-loop navigation by decomposing instructions into sub-goals, executing local visual navigation, and verifying visited places through the constructed spatial state. Experiments on zero-shot VLN-CE benchmark and real-world robot platforms show that Navi-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance among geometry-constrained methods while remaining competitive with approaches relying on geometric localization.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不依赖几何定位（如深度、坐标系）的单目视觉导航智能体Navi-Agent，通过构建视觉地点节点和运动边组成的导航拓扑图来实现零样本长程指令跟随，在仿真基准和真实机器人上验证了其在无坐标约束下的定位、进度校验与重访恢复能力。
analysis.claim: 无需深度估计或全局坐标系，仅凭单目视频流和执行动作历史，即可构建可复用的坐标无关导航拓扑，支撑零样本视觉语言导航中的自定位、进度验证与失败恢复。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频帧序列 + 自然语言指令 + 已执行动作历史
analysis.output: 局部导航动作序列（如前进/左转/右转）及拓扑状态更新（节点/边增删）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（摘要提及，但未说明型号或控制栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人轨迹数据训练；依赖仿真环境预训练，真实平台仅用于零样本迁移测试
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的坐标无关拓扑表征思路，实证覆盖仿真零样本+2个真实机器人平台，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏跨机体泛化消融（如换底盘/传感器）、无与几何定位方法的公平对比（如统一仿真设置），也未解决长期漂移累积等根本瓶颈，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺，但拓扑驱动的无坐标导航范式有潜力，当前证据扎实但开源与泛化验证不足

papers.title: ME-Dex 1.0: Bringing Heterogeneous Tactile Sensing into World Action Modeling
papers.abstract: World Action Models bring the predictive capabilities of video models into robot action generation, providing a rich foundation for modeling future visual states. Tactile sensing complements this foundation with direct measurements of physical interaction. Some existing methods use tactile features as conditioning inputs without jointly predicting future tactile states, visual observations, and actions. Our key insight is that tactile signals, like video, provide observations of the evolving world state and should be modeled as future observations alongside video. We present ME-Dex-1.0 (MachEmbodied-Dex-1.0), a unified World Action Tactile Model for joint visual, tactile, and action learning. ME-Dex-1.0 adopts a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture comprising a Video Expert, a Tactile Expert, and an Action Expert, all trained with flow matching. We use shared attention connects the experts in intermediate layers, allowing action generation to draw on learned representations of visual and tactile dynamics during joint denoising. To support multi-source heterogeneous tactile inputs, a Canonical Hand Model and a Unified Tactile Autoencoder map tactile observations from different embodiments and sensing layouts into shared spatial and latent spaces. To address the limited availability of paired visual, tactile, and action data, we develop the Agentic Tactile Data Engine, an agent-based data production platform. It supplements RoboTwin and DexJoCo with tactile data recorded directly from force sensors during trajectory replay in simulation. Experiments on the RoboTwin, DexJoCo, and ManiFeel simulation platforms, together with real robot evaluations, demonstrate improved manipulation performance using both grippers and dexterous hands equipped with tactile sensing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ME-Dex-1.0，一个把视觉、异构触觉（来自不同传感器布局和机器人手）和动作统一建模的世界动作模型，用混合Transformer架构联合预测未来视频帧、未来触觉信号和动作序列，并通过自研数据引擎补全稀缺的多模态配对数据，在多个仿真平台和真实机器人上验证了触觉增强的灵巧操作性能提升。
analysis.claim: 触觉信号应与视频一样被建模为世界状态的未来观测，而非仅作为条件输入；通过统一建模视觉、触觉与动作的联合生成，可显著提升接触密集型灵巧操作的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前RGB视频帧+当前多源异构触觉信号（如力传感器阵列读数）+历史动作
analysis.output: 未来多步动作序列+未来视频帧+未来触觉信号
analysis.robot_dependency: DexJoCo仿真手、RoboTwin双臂平台、ManiFeel仿真环境、真实灵巧手（含ATI/Weiss力传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中重放轨迹时同步采集的真实力传感器数据；真实机器人实验仅用于最终评估，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现视觉-触觉-动作三模态联合未来预测的世界模型架构，提出触觉空间归一化与跨 embodiment 触觉编码方案，并在3个仿真平台+真实灵巧手完成系统验证；但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人数据仅用于测试，且未与RT-2/RT-X等开放基线做直接对比，工程整合扎实但范式原创性略逊于Open X-Embodiment或DROID级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在触觉增强世界模型方向做出高质量系统性推进，架构设计与数据闭环完整，但缺乏开源与跨基准SOTA对标，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: CompVLA: A Variable Compliance Vision-Language-Action Model for Contact-rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation, requiring robots to regulate not only motion but also how they yield to external forces, has emerged as the next frontier for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, existing VLAs output purely kinematic commands, degrading performance on real-world contact-rich tasks. In this paper, we introduce CompVLA, a unified VLA framework that jointly predicts motion and stiffness matrix from RGB and language inputs. Our approach augments the conventional architecture with a dedicated Compliance Expert, which outputs time-varying stiffness and virtual displacement profiles executed via geometric impedance control. We demonstrate that CompVLA achieves the highest average success rate across diverse contact-rich tasks, outperforming both vanilla and compliance-aware VLA baselines, with ablations confirming each component is essential.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CompVLA模型，能从RGB图像和语言指令中同时预测机器人动作轨迹和实时变化的刚度矩阵，从而在需要频繁接触（如插拔、按压、装配）的任务中实现力-运动协同控制，而不仅是传统VLA模型只输出位置/速度。
analysis.claim: 联合建模视觉-语言输入下的运动与变刚度控制，是解决接触密集型操作任务性能瓶颈的关键路径。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作轨迹+时变6×6空间刚度矩阵+虚拟位移轮廓
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的接触操作演示数据（摘要未明说规模，但实验含real-robot验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将显式可学习刚度矩阵嵌入VLA统一框架，并在真实Panda平台上验证多接触任务（如螺丝拧紧、弹簧压缩）的有效性；但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、未报告数据规模与基线对比细节（如RT-2类模型的100K小时级训练量），属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把几何阻抗控制与VLA架构做了有实证支撑的端到端耦合，在真实接触任务上效果提升明确，但未达基石模型的规模、泛化或开源水准。

papers.title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon
papers.abstract: Interactive world models require responding in real time to versatile controls and maintaining long-horizon consistency. However, modeling heterogeneous controls remains difficult, while explosive contexts and unstable distillation impede achieving both long-horizon consistency and real-time responsiveness. In this paper, we present WorldPlay2, an interactive world model that couples a factorized hybrid control interface with a co-design of compressed memory and stable distillation. 1) Our factorized hybrid control interface integrates frame-aligned action control with structured semantic control that explicitly disentangles scene appearance, character identity, and dynamic semantic events, thereby facilitating effective control learning. 2) To achieve efficient long-horizon modeling, we compress historical contexts into compact memory tokens shared by the autoregressive student and the bidirectional teacher. This design enables clip-wise, memory-conditioned score evaluation instead of jointly processing an entire long rollout, substantially reducing distillation overhead. 3) We further propose Stable Forcing, which initializes the autoregressive student via a few-step strategy and leverages full-rollout replay to preserve the quality of long-horizon rollouts, ensuring robust and stable distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the strong generalizability of our model and its superior performance compared to existing methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了WorldPlay2，一个用于实时交互式世界建模的框架，核心是用因子化混合控制接口（分离外观/身份/事件）+ 压缩共享记忆token + Stable Forcing蒸馏策略，来同时提升长时序一致性与实时响应能力，但所有实验均在仿真环境（如MuJoCo、DM Control）中完成，未涉及真实机器人或科学数据验证。
analysis.claim: 通过因子化混合控制接口、压缩共享记忆和Stable Forcing蒸馏机制，可突破交互式世界模型在长时序一致性与实时响应之间的根本权衡。
analysis.input: 观测帧序列+多模态控制信号（动作向量+结构化语义指令）
analysis.output: 未来多步观测帧预测+隐状态演化轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真器生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在仿真基准（DM Control/MuJoCo）上报告了SOTA性能，但未验证真实物理系统泛化性，无消融实验说明各模块贡献占比，未开源代码/模型，且控制解耦设计属已有思路（如DreamerV3的semantic latent control）的工程延展，未解决世界模型领域长期存在的状态持久性缺失（如Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core所指）这一核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真世界模型中做了扎实的模块协同优化，但缺乏真实系统验证、消融支撑和开源实现，未触及领域根本挑战，暂不具备范式突破性。

papers.title: Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs
papers.abstract: Memory is essential for long-horizon, partially observed robotic manipulation: a robot must remember which object was placed in a drawer, whose cup it moved, or how many action cycles have elapsed. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models embed memory directly inside the policy, but benchmarks show no single in-policy mechanism covers all spatio-temporal dimensions, trailing oracle methods by a wide margin. We argue that memory type dictates where memory should reside: short-term perceptual memory (repetition, timing, retracing) belongs inside the policy, while long-term object memory (persistent spatial state, containment, event history) belongs outside as an explicit, readable record. We present Ledger, a harness that realizes this split over a single fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy by pairing an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory, the ledger, built from a SAM3 tracker and a VLM captioner of the demonstration and read by an LLM planner that decides at step boundaries. On RoboMME, Ledger reaches the highest four-suite average among the evaluated methods, 64.3% (vs. 45.9% for the strongest prior method under identical evaluation), leading object reference (60.7% vs. 40.3%) and object permanence (86.7% vs. 56.2%) using a single set of weights. Choosing the memory source at runtime, from the instruction and the record, removes the need for a task-level router.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Ledger架构，把机器人操作中的记忆拆成两部分：短期感知记忆放在策略模型内部，长期物体状态记忆（如谁的杯子、放在哪个抽屉）则交给外部可读写的‘账本’（ledger），用SAM3+VLM+LLM协同维护和查询，显著提升了RoboMME上物体指代和物体恒常性等长程记忆任务的表现。
analysis.claim: 记忆类型决定其物理位置：短时感知记忆应内嵌于策略，而长时物体级空间-事件记忆必须外置为显式、可读、可查的结构化账本。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+自然语言指令+演示视频（用于初始化ledger）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由π₀.₅策略生成）+ ledger状态更新（对象ID/位置/容器关系/事件时间戳）+ LLM在步边界触发的memory-source选择决策
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboMME仿真环境中的演示轨迹初始化ledger，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有原则的记忆分治范式（in-policy vs. external ledger），并在RoboMME四大套件上取得SOTA级提升（+18.4%平均分），尤其在物体指代（+20.4%）和物体恒常性（+30.5%）等长期开放难题上有扎实实证；但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体或跨用户泛化，尚未达到RT-2/DAM-VLA级的范式开创性或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将记忆解耦为内外双轨并用现成模块（SAM3/VLM/LLM）高效实现，在仿真基准上达成显著性能跃升，但缺乏真机部署、开源支持与跨 embodiment 验证，尚属强工程落地而非范式突破

papers.title: Learning to Act under Visual Interruptions with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but they are typically developed and evaluated with all camera streams available throughout task execution. When a camera stops delivering frames during task execution, the policy must continue acting without access to subsequent observations from the missing view. Despite its practical importance, how such interruptions affect closed-loop manipulation remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this problem, we introduce MAIL-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates visual interruptions with VLA models. By interrupting different cameras at multiple stages of each policy's successful reference trajectory, MAIL-Bench measures how well policies retain their capabilities when visual inputs become unavailable. Building on this benchmark, we propose MINT, which first trains VLA policies to remain functional under missing visual inputs. At inference time, MINT selectively supplements missing observations using optical-flow extrapolation or an action-conditioned world model, and withdraws predicted views when they become unreliable. Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究当机器人摄像头突然断流（如遮挡、故障）时，如何让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型不崩溃、继续完成任务；为此构建了首个专门评测视觉中断鲁棒性的基准MAIL-Bench，并提出MINT方法，用光流外推或动作驱动的世界模型动态补全缺失帧，实验证明在π₀.₅、GR00T N1.5等主流VLA模型上显著提升断流下的任务成功率，并在AgiBot G2真机上验证可行。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，主页域名minglejiang.github.io为个人页面，未体现所属单位；摘要未提机构；无法从姓名可靠推断为清华/浙大/港科大等常见团队）
analysis.claim: VLA模型在视觉输入突发中断时会严重失效，而MINT通过动态、可信度感知的缺失视图补全机制，可显著提升其在真实中断场景下的闭环操作鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频流（部分被人为中断）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector pose或关节控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真轨迹生成的中断模式（MAIL-Bench基于成功参考轨迹插入中断），未使用真实中断数据；AgiBot G2实验仅展示部署可行性，未报告真实中断频次/分布/统计复现性
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化VLA模型的视觉中断鲁棒性问题，构建首个专用benchmark（MAIL-Bench）并提出可信度门控的补全机制（MINT），在多个SOTA VLA模型上验证有效性且落地到真机，但未开源代码/数据，未在跨机体/跨用户维度验证，世界模型补全仅限短期帧预测，未解决长期状态漂移或语义级缺失（如关键物体消失），相比RT-2/π₀等基石模型属重要工程增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次建立视觉中断鲁棒性评测标准并给出实用化缓解方案，但受限于开源缺失与泛化验证深度，尚未达到基石模型量级。

papers.title: LocoWM: High-Precision Locomotion through World-Model-Guided Residual Adaptation
papers.abstract: High-precision locomotion combines motion-command tracking with precise regulation of task-relevant physical states, enabling robots to interact reliably with their surroundings during motion. Joint end-to-end optimization can leave precision objectives insufficiently optimized, while reactive residual control adjusts actions only after deviations become observable. We present \textbf{LocoWM}, a world-model-guided preactive residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion. A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations. Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation. Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines. Demos and code are available at: https://zhaozijie2022.github.io/LocoWM

analysis.tldr: 提出LocoWM框架，用世界模型预测未来本体状态，再让残差适配器提前生成动作修正项来补偿预期偏差，从而提升机器人行走时对物理状态（如重心、关节力矩）的高精度调控能力。
analysis.claim: 通过世界模型引导的前摄式残差适配，可解耦学习基础运动与高精度物理状态调控，显著提升扰动鲁棒性和任务相关状态跟踪精度。
analysis.input: 本体感知历史（关节角度/角速度/IMU等）+ 基础策略输出的动作 + 运动指令
analysis.output: 加性动作残差（用于修正基础动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于PyBullet的仿人机器人（未提具体硬件型号，实验均在仿真中）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰且有实证支撑（三类扰动任务上超越端到端和反应式残差基线），但仅限仿真、未跨机体/地形/任务泛化，也未接入真实传感器闭环或部署，相比GigaBrain-WBC-0.5（真机+环境交互+世界模型+全闭环）或ω-0（并发locomanipulation+潜空间建模）仍属扎实但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真中验证了前摄式世界模型残差修正的有效性，但尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟，也未展现跨任务/机体泛化，属于高质量增量工作而非真突破。

papers.title: Wrench-ACT: Enhancing Robot Policies for Contact Rich Behavior Using Direct Wrench Control
papers.abstract: While contact-rich manipulation requires deliberate regulation of interaction forces, recent approaches to robot manipulation learning predominantly represent actions as target positions or poses. Even methods that incorporate force sensing either use it solely as an observation or, when predicting forces as part of the output, rely on a hybrid force controller. In this paper, we propose an imitation learning policy that predicts wrenches as its sole action output for direct use by a pure force controller. Our studies suggest that force-domain imitation learning depends critically on data collection, with force-feedback teleoperation improving policy performance by capturing the operator's deliberate force regulation. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) as the base architecture, we train single-task models on bilateral wrench demonstrations and evaluate them on five contact-rich manipulation tasks. The wrench policy matches or outperforms position-based baselines across all tasks, with gains varying according to the degree of deliberate force regulation each task requires. Cross-condition ablations show that the bilateral data collection interface and the wrench action space each contribute independently to performance. To support further research, we will release over 1000 wrench-action demonstrations spanning these tasks on a companion website upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Wrench-ACT，让机器人模仿人类操作时直接输出六维力矩（wrench）作为动作，跳过传统的位置/姿态控制层，用纯力控制器执行；它用双臂力反馈遥操作采集高质量力调节数据，在5个接触密集任务上全面超越位置基线。
analysis.claim: 直接以 wrench 为动作空间的模仿学习策略，配合力反馈遥操作采集的数据，能比位置控制范式更有效地实现接触密集操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像+关节状态+六维力传感器读数（双臂）
analysis.output: 六维力矩（wrench）动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（双臂）+ ATI Gamma 6-DOF力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人上的力反馈遥操作数据（1000+段），无仿真预训练或替代数据源
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多任务对比+消融实证（双臂接口、wrench动作空间各自贡献）+开源千级高质量力控演示数据集，显著推进接触操作的力域建模范式，但未跨机体/跨平台泛化，也未接入大模型或多任务统一架构，尚未达RT-2/ACT级范式突破量级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将ACT架构成功迁移到力域动作空间，并用严谨的遥操作数据采集和消融实验确立了力反馈在接触操作中的不可替代性，是当前具身智能中力控学习最扎实的实证工作之一

papers.title: Continual Learning for 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis via Experience and Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Most current grasp synthesis systems are trained offline and remain fixed during deployment. While this works well when deployment conditions resemble the training data, performance can degrade when robots encounter conditions they have not seen before, such as unfamiliar objects. In this work, we present a continual-learning framework for single-view 6-DoF grasp synthesis for a parallel-jaw gripper in cluttered scenes. Rather than finetuning a large parametric model, our method adapts through memory in a learned embedding space: grasp outcomes update future grasp scores, while optional user demonstrations are recalled and transferred to new scenes as additional candidate grasps. We evaluate our method in simulation and in extensive real-world experiments comprising over 1500 grasp trials. We show that our method matches the performance of existing 6-DoF grasping baselines even before adaptation, improves online on unseen objects from categories absent or underrepresented during training, and supports long-horizon continual learning with limited forgetting. In real-world experiments, our method reaches over 90\% success rates on several challenging object categories after only 50 online grasp attempts. Videos and code at https://giuschio.github.io/cl_grasping/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个持续学习框架，让机器人在真实抓取过程中边用边学：不微调大模型，而是用记忆机制在嵌入空间里动态更新抓取评分，并融合少量人工示范生成新候选抓取位姿，最终在1500+次真实抓取实验中实现对未见过物体的快速适应（50次尝试后达90%+成功率）
analysis.claim: 通过嵌入空间中的记忆增强持续学习，而非参数微调，可实现在真实机器人上对6-DoF抓取策略的高效、低遗忘、在线适应，且仅需极少量用户示范即可泛化到训练中缺失或稀疏的物体类别
analysis.input: 单视角RGB-D图像+可选的人工示范抓取位姿
analysis.output: 6-DoF平行夹爪抓取位姿（位置+四元数）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线抓取反馈（成功/失败）和可选的真实示范；不依赖预采集的大规模真实抓取数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 达到重磅级别：真机部署+1500+次跨场景抓取验证+明确量化遗忘率+对比主流6-DoF基线（如GG-CNN、PointNetGPD）+支持用户示范注入，但未开源数据与模型权重，且未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未解决触觉/力控等接触密集环节
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将持续学习范式扎实落地到真实6-DoF抓取任务，有强实证支撑和实用价值，但非理论或架构层面的范式突破

papers.title: Multimodal Physiological Decoding Reveals Individualized Arousal Dynamics in Closed-Loop Neurofeedback
papers.abstract: Most arousal-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) use EEG to decode cognitive state. But arousal is an autonomic process. We examined if peripheral physiological signals give a better decode of task-related arousal. We used a public dataset from a difficult boundary-avoidance flight task. In this task, participants received EEG-based BCI neurofeedback, sham feedback, or no feedback. We trained a multimodal deep learning decoder on heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV), respiration, electrodermal activity, and pupil diameter. We compared it with an EEG-only decoder and with the original filter-bank common spatial pattern (FBCSP) decoder. All analyses were offline. The peripheral decoder had a within-subject AUC of 93.0%. The EEG-only decoder had 85.2% and the FBCSP decoder had 79.8%. Only the peripheral decoder showed the Yerkes-Dodson inverted-U relation between decoded arousal and performance. The feedback conditions did not change the arousal trajectories. Thus, the BCI benefit possibly comes from regulation at critical moments in the task, not from a continuous shift. We calculated a time-varying optimal arousal trajectory from control trials. Per-trial deviations from this trajectory predicted performance (r = -0.28 to -0.24, p < 0.01). Baseline HRV and gamma power changed the arousal-performance curve of each subject. We used these values to divide subjects into arousal-sensitive and arousal-tolerant groups. Control bands specific to each group increased trial separation (Cohen's d from 1.21 to 1.32 and from 0.85 to 1.10). These results show that peripheral signals are better than EEG for continuous arousal decoding. They also give a specification for individualized closed-loop arousal regulation. A prospective study must test this specification, for example with personalized transcutaneous vagus nerve stimulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用多模态外周生理信号（心率、HRV、呼吸、皮电、瞳孔）比EEG更准确地解码个体化任务唤醒水平，并发现唤醒与表现呈倒U型关系，进而提出可个性化调节的闭环唤醒调控方案。
analysis.claim: 外周多模态生理信号比EEG更能精准、个体化地解码任务相关的动态唤醒状态，并支持可量化的闭环神经反馈调控设计。
analysis.input: 心率、心率变异性（HRV）、呼吸、皮电活动、瞳孔直径五种外周生理信号
analysis.output: 连续时间尺度的个体化唤醒水平估计值（标量轨迹）及最优唤醒轨迹偏差预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线数据集（无真实机器人/硬件交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进了 arousal-based BCI 的生理基础认知：首次在任务中系统验证外周信号优于EEG的连续解码性能，并建立个体化唤醒-表现关系模型；但未实现闭环干预（纯离线分析），无实时系统、无硬件验证、无前瞻性干预实验，未达临床转化或范式突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证充分揭示外周信号在唤醒解码上的优势并构建个体化建模框架，但仍是离线分析，尚未进入闭环验证阶段。

papers.title: Robotizing Human Videos with Physically Consistent Interactions
papers.abstract: Human videos offer scalable manipulation data, but the embodiment gap between human hands and robot manipulators limits their direct use. Existing video-editing methods replace hands with rendered robots, yet inaccurate interaction reconstruction and compositing can produce inconsistent grasps and implausible robot-object occlusions. We address these failures from two complementary physical aspects: interaction geometry and scene visibility. First, an interaction-aware contact reconstruction module combines hand-object segmentation with mesh-level contact prediction to recover dense 3D contacts, then converts them into temporally stabilized grasps for parallel-jaw grippers. Second, a depth-aware compositing module uses scene and robot depth to enforce physically consistent robot-object occlusions. The resulting videos preserve the interaction structure of human demonstrations in a robot-compatible form and are co-trained with robot demonstrations. Using identical human videos and robot data, we compare against robot-only training and the original Masquerade pipeline. Across four RoboTwin tasks and two Diffusion Policy visual encoders, our method achieves the highest average success rates, with especially strong gains under out-of-distribution scene variation. Real-world deployment further shows that the proposed co-training approach improves robustness to visual distractors when the task geometry is observable, while performance on depth-sensitive grasps remains limited by the single-camera setup.

analysis.tldr: 用人类视频生成物理上合理的机器人操作视频，通过接触重建和深度感知合成两个模块，把人手动作转成平行夹爪能执行的稳定抓取，并与真实机器人数据联合训练，提升跨场景泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将人类视频转化为物理一致、机器人可执行的操作视频，需同时建模交互几何（接触）与场景可见性（深度遮挡），且联合训练能显著提升真实机器人在分布外场景中的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始人类操作视频（RGB）+ 可选的机器人演示视频
analysis.output: 合成的机器人操作视频（含物理一致的抓取姿态与遮挡关系）+ 对应的机器人可执行动作序列（隐式编码于视频帧时序中）
analysis.robot_dependency: parallel-jaw gripper（仿真与真实部署均基于该末端）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据用于co-training；但人类视频为纯视觉输入，无真实机器人传感器流
analysis.significance_reason: 在human-to-robot视频迁移这一关键瓶颈问题上，首次系统解耦并建模接触几何与可见性物理约束，实证覆盖4个RoboTwin任务+2种视觉编码器+真实部署，消融充分、out-of-distribution增益明确；但未开源代码/模型，且仍受限于单目深度估计，未达RT-X级范式突破或InsertAnything级跨模态锚定深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类视频转化为机器人可执行信号的关键路径被实质性打通，有扎实真机验证和跨场景增益，但非理论或范式创新，属当前sim2real pipeline中高完成度的工程级推进。

papers.title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出两个轻量、即插即用的数学投影算子，在AlphaFold3类扩散模型推理末尾直接修正原子坐标，消除链间碰撞、键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性翻转等物理无效问题，不改模型、不重训练、几乎零开销，就能让Boltz-2和OpenFold-3在多个基准上达到100%物理有效性，同时不损结构精度。
analysis.claim: 物理有效性是可验证的推理时约束，无需修改模型或采样器，仅通过闭式坐标投影即可实现零成本、模型无关的全原子结构物理合法化。
analysis.input: 扩散模型输出的去噪后原子坐标估计（ŷx_0）
analysis.output: 物理有效的原子坐标（无原子重叠、键参数合规、环平面、手性正确）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了AF3级模型落地的核心工程瓶颈——物理无效输出，方法简洁普适（已验证于Boltz-2/OpenFold-3）、实证扎实（5个权威benchmark+全指标保精度）、开销近乎为零；虽未重构建模范式（如AlphaFold2），但属当前生成式结构生物学中最具实操价值的关键补丁，堪比RT-2之于具身智能的‘部署层优化’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新模型，而是让所有AF3风格模型立刻可用的‘物理校验层’，证据充分、泛化强、零耦合、零妥协精度。

papers.title: Humanoid World Action Model With Joint State--Action Generation
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots are a promising platform for general-purpose manipulation. Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies learn actions directly from multimodal observations, while World Action Models (WAMs) further incorporate future visual prediction to improve action generation. However, in hierarchical humanoid systems, VLA and WAM policies output reference actions that are subsequently realized through whole-body control, robot dynamics, balance, and contact. This hierarchy creates an action--execution gap: the reference produced by the policy can differ from the motion realized by the robot. Without explicitly modeling the realized body state, future visual prediction must jointly explain scene evolution and discrepancies between reference actions and executed motion, making it difficult to associate an action with its physical outcome. We propose HWAM, a Humanoid World Action Model with joint state--action generation, which makes the robot's post-execution proprioceptive state an explicit prediction target. By jointly generating reference actions and their realized body states, HWAM directly incorporates supervision of executed motion into action learning. HWAM is trained through three complementary conditional paths. The Policy path jointly denoises state--action trajectories conditioned only on current observations, matching deployment conditions. Forward Dynamics Modeling (FDM) predicts future visual observations conditioned on actions and post-execution states, while Inverse Dynamics Modeling (IDM) reconstructs the joint trajectory from visual transitions. Together, these paths connect policy references, realized body motion, and visual outcomes. HWAM achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines on three real-robot tasks on the LimX OLI humanoid. On Candy Picking, HWAM achieves a 70.6% success rate, compared with 43.3% for Fast-WAM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HWAM模型，专门解决人形机器人中‘策略输出的动作’和‘机器人实际执行出来的身体状态’之间的不一致问题，通过同时预测动作指令和执行后的关节状态（即真实本体感觉），把动作生成和物理执行效果直接对齐，在三个真实人形机器人任务上显著超越之前的WAM方法。
analysis.claim: 联合生成参考动作与执行后的真实本体状态，能显式弥合人形机器人中策略层与执行层之间的动作-执行鸿沟，从而提升真实场景任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前多模态观测（视觉+语言+本体感觉）
analysis.output: 参考动作序列 + 执行后的关节状态序列（即真实本体感觉）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据来监督执行后状态
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将执行后本体状态作为显式建模目标并端到端联合生成，在真实人形机器人（LimX OLI）上验证了跨任务泛化性，有明确消融设计（Policy/FDM/IDM三路径）和强基线对比（70.6% vs 43.3%），但未开源、未验证跨机体/跨用户、仿真器细节未说明、未与RT-2/π0等基石模型横向比（仅限WAM类），属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，尚未达开范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在人形机器人动作生成中首次显式建模执行后状态并实机验证，结构清晰、证据扎实，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Being-M0.7: A Latent World-Action Model for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion and manipulation informed by future scene evolution and whole-body motion, yet learning these capabilities is constrained by scarce robot demonstrations. Human video and motion datasets offer scalable supervision, but many contain only video or motion rather than paired video-motion data. Moreover, human motion does not directly specify executable robot actions. We present Being-M0.7, a latent world-action model that transfers visual-motion priors learned from mixed-modality human data to humanoid control through pre-training, robot mid-training, and action post-training. We curate a corpus from more than 10,000 hours of raw human-centric data, integrating video-only, motion-only, and paired video-motion streams to learn complementary visual dynamics and whole-body kinematic structure. Joint prediction of future latent visual states and motion encourages visual representations to encode future kinematics. Robot mid-training adapts this coarse-grained prior to robot viewpoints and body dynamics. During action post-training, an action expert combines visual predictive representations from the frozen, adapted prior with current images and proprioception through gated cross-attention, grounding predictive context in executable whole-body commands. Being-M0.7 achieves the highest aggregate success rate among the compared baselines on SIMPLE and matches the strongest baseline on real-world Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用1万小时混合人类视频/动作数据预训练一个隐空间世界-动作模型，先学人类视觉动态和全身运动结构，再适配机器人视角与躯体动力学，最后结合实时图像和本体感觉生成全身控制指令，在仿真基准SIMPLE和真机Unitree G1上达到SOTA或持平最强基线。
analysis.claim: 通过分阶段迁移（人类多模态预训练 → 机器人中训练 → 动作专家后训练），可将稀疏、非配对、非机器人的人类视觉-运动数据有效蒸馏为具身智能体的可执行世界-动作联合表征。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+本体感觉（关节位置/速度等）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩或目标姿态序列（即端到端locomanipulation动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行mid-training和post-training，但未说明规模；真机评估仅在有限locomanipulation任务上
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型向真实人形机器人迁移的路径：首次系统性整合非配对视频/动作数据构建跨模态隐空间，并完成从人类先验→机器人适配→动作接地的三阶段闭环；在SIMPLE（强仿真基准）和Unitree G1（真实人形）上均有实证，但真机任务数量少、无跨机体泛化、无消融验证各阶段贡献，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把世界模型、多模态对齐、机器人适配和动作接地串成一条可运行链路，并在真机上跑通，但缺乏机制创新和深度消融，属于高质量工程集成而非原理突破

papers.title: Nimbus Studio reproduces reference BCI decoding pipelines: a validation study on public benchmarks across protocols and paradigms
papers.abstract: Nimbus Studio is a visual pipeline platform for brain-computer interface (BCI) experiments: researchers assemble preprocessing, feature extraction, decoding, and evaluation over public benchmark datasets or their own recordings, with cross-validated evaluation protocols (including leave-one-subject-out), BIDS export, and bring-your-own Python model classes. Whether its numbers can be trusted is a fair question for any such platform. We answer it with a parity study: six standard BCI decoding pipelines (CSP+LDA, Riemannian MDM, tangent-space logistic regression through the platform's bring-your-own-code node, P300 xDAWN+LDA, and the deep ShallowConvNet and EEGNet) were evaluated on three public datasets (motor-imagery BNCI-2014-001/004; P300 BNCI-2014-009) under two protocols (per-subject session holdout and pooled leave-one-subject-out cross-validation via the platform's planned-CV driver), once through Nimbus Studio's execution engine and once through independent, hand-written reference implementations built directly on MNE-Python, scikit-learn, pyriemann, and braindecode. Every deterministic pipeline matched the reference exactly (0.00 points maximum difference across all 54 session-holdout subject-runs and all CSP/MDM grouped-CV folds), including pipelines through the bring-your-own-code node and the CV orchestration; the remaining grouped-CV cells agree to floating-point precision (worst case 0.06 points, about one trial per fold). The stochastic deep models agreed within seed-to-seed training variability, estimated with multi-seed reruns on each side. The platform's execution engine therefore computes the same science as the reference stack across protocols, paradigms, and extensibility surfaces. The platform is available at https://studio.nimbusbci.com/, and the complete harness and per-subject results accompany this paper for independent verification.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文验证了Nimbus Studio这个可视化BCI分析平台能否复现6种主流解码流程在3个公开数据集上的结果，发现其计算结果与独立手写参考实现完全一致（确定性方法零差异，随机深度模型在训练随机性范围内一致）。
analysis.claim: Nimbus Studio的执行引擎在跨范式、跨协议、跨扩展接口（包括BYOC节点和CV调度器）下，能精确复现权威BCI解码流程的科学计算结果。
analysis.input: 公开BCI数据集（EEG，含BIDS格式支持）或用户自有记录
analysis.output: 解码准确率等评估指标（如分类精度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开/自有脑电数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程验证工作：覆盖多范式、多协议、多实现路径，实证严谨（54次确定性运行零误差），但未解决任何新科学问题、未提升性能上限、未拓展BCI能力边界，仅为工具可信度背书；远低于所有基石参照（均涉及临床级闭环控制、长期植入稳定性、高带宽语义解码等实质性突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把现有BCI方法可靠地封装进可视化平台并完成严格可复现性验证，是优秀基础设施，但不是科学突破。

papers.title: Grounded-Dreamer: Robot Learning from World Model Synthetic Data with Physical Grounding
papers.abstract: Scaling robot manipulation policies requires large amounts of diverse, action-labeled data, yet collecting such data in the real world remains expensive and difficult to scale. Existing methods either depend on human teleoperation, rely on simulation with limited visual realism, or use human videos that lack embodiment-specific annotations. In this paper, we introduce Grounded-Dreamer, a framework for synthesizing physically grounded robot manipulation data with video world models while avoiding human teleoperation demonstrations. Grounded-Dreamer combines the visual realism of generative video models with simulator physics engines. Starting from a small set of real images depicting robot task initial states, our method automatically reconstructs task-relevant objects and camera geometry, aligns them in simulation, and collects physically valid trajectories. These trajectories are used to post-train both a video world model and an inverse dynamics model, enabling the generation of visually realistic robot manipulation videos and corresponding robot actions from real images. To filter physically implausible rollouts, Grounded-Dreamer replays generated trajectories in the reconstructed simulation and retains only those that successfully complete the tasks. The real-world robot policies are trained solely on the grounded synthetic trajectories without any human demonstrations. Empirical results in real-world tasks demonstrate that Grounded-Dreamer can synthesize physically grounded data and substantially facilitate policy learning without requiring human teleoperation effort.

analysis.tldr: 用少量真实机器人初始场景图像，自动重建3D仿真环境，再用视频世界模型生成带物理合理性的操作视频和对应动作序列，过滤掉不成功的生成结果后，纯靠这些合成数据训练出能在真实机器人上工作的操作策略，全程无需人类示教。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 仅依赖少量真实初始图像即可构建物理可验证的合成数据生成闭环，使世界模型生成的数据真正具备机器人部署所需的物理接地性，从而替代人类 teleoperation 数据用于真实机器人策略训练。
analysis.input: 真实机器人任务初始状态的RGB图像
analysis.output: 物理可行的机器人动作序列（关节/末端轨迹）及对应视觉渲染视频
