analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：精准定义并量化了VLA模型的长期记忆瓶颈，但止步于诊断，未提供治疗方案或实证闭环。

papers.title: Beyond State-as-Action: Exploiting Command-State Discrepancy for Robot Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Constructing action targets from measured robot motion is an established approach in imitation learning. Under interaction constraints, however, command-state discrepancy may reflect control demands that motion alone does not capture. We investigate when this information matters and how to exploit it. Across three real-robot tasks, task and phase analyses reveal larger supervision gaps under constrained interaction, while selective command retention provides evidence of locally useful command information. Building on these findings, we propose Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW), which accounts for robot response times and combines subsequent progress, persistent unmet demand, and demand changes into continuous weights for command supervision. The method requires no task-phase annotations or changes to policy architecture or inference. CSDW improves over uniform command supervision on constrained tasks, while methods perform similarly in the less constrained task. Project page: https://seen-e.github.io/CSDW/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现机器人在受约束交互任务中，控制器指令（command）和实际状态（state）之间的差异（command-state discrepancy）包含重要控制需求信息，而传统模仿学习只用状态做动作标签会丢失这部分信息；于是提出一个轻量级加权机制CSDW，在不改模型结构、不需额外标注的前提下，用响应延迟、未满足需求持续性、需求变化率三个信号动态加权指令监督信号，提升受限任务的模仿学习效果。
analysis.claim: 在受物理/交互约束的机器人模仿学习任务中，command-state discrepancy 不是噪声而是可利用的控制语义信号，其动态加权能显著提升真实机器人上的策略性能，且无需任务相位标注或架构修改。
analysis.input: 机器人关节状态序列 + 对应控制指令序列 + 任务执行时序（隐式，无显式phase标注）
analysis.output: 加权后的指令监督信号（用于训练策略网络的损失权重）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（具体型号未说明，摘要明确为 three real-robot tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的 command-state 同步轨迹数据，但未说明是否需特定硬件传感器或闭环反馈接口
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了 command-state discrepancy 的监督价值，并提出免标注、免架构修改的即插即用加权机制CSDW，在三个受限任务上稳定提升性能（有消融），但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，也未与SOTA端到端策略（如RT-2、RoboT0等）对比，属扎实的机制创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将被长期忽略的底层控制信号差异转化为可即插即用的监督加权方案，在真实受限任务上实证有效，但缺乏开源与广义泛化验证，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: X-Reset: Scaling Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Embodiment Resets
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation can train dexterous manipulation policies without robot demonstrations, but training a single generalist policy with task-agnostic rewards faces a severe exploration problem: approaching, grasping, and reorienting diverse objects with many degrees of freedom is difficult to discover from scratch. Prior works make exploration tractable with high-quality robot demonstrations, per-task reward shaping, or by restricting policies to narrow modes of behavior. We propose X-Reset, a framework that instead resolves exploration with human hand-object demonstrations. Rather than imitating or tracking retargeted human motion, X-Reset kinematically retargets hand-object states to noisy robot states, filters out states that are unstable in simulation, and samples the remainder as resets during RL training with general-purpose object-centric rewards. The resulting policy depends only on object state and goal, with demonstrations entering training through the reset distribution. We show that X-Reset trains generalist policies on 20 objects across three embodiments---a 22-DoF hand on two different arms and a parallel-jaw gripper---and resolves the exploration challenges of RL from scratch. X-Reset scales with the number of training objects, generalizes to unseen objects, can learn from imperfect hand-pose estimates, and transfers behaviors zero-shot from sim-to-real.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手-物体交互的粗糙姿态数据（哪怕不准）作为仿真中RL训练的初始状态采样分布（reset distribution），让机器人无需任务特定奖励或演示就能学会跨多种机械臂和手型、泛化到新物体的灵巧操作策略。
analysis.claim: 通过将噪声化的人类手-物体姿态经运动学重定向+稳定性过滤后构建RL训练的reset分布，可彻底绕过灵巧操作RL中的探索瓶颈，实现免演示、免奖励塑形、跨机体的通用物体中心策略学习。
analysis.input: 当前物体状态（位姿/几何）+目标物体状态
analysis.output: 关节速度或动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Franka Emika Panda / parallel-jaw gripper（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类手-物体视频估计的姿态序列（非精确标注，允许噪声）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：三类不同本体（22-DoF灵巧手×2臂+二指夹爪）、20个物体、零样本sim2real迁移、对不准确手姿态鲁棒；但未开源代码/模型，且仍限于仿真预训练+简单真实验证（无复杂扰动/长期部署），未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙复用低成本人类姿态数据解决RL探索瓶颈，实证充分、泛化性强，但非理论或架构层面的范式创新，也未完全打通真实世界长尾挑战。

papers.title: Reactive Humanoid Multi-Contact Using Learned Stability Models
papers.abstract: We present a planning and control approach to reactively use hand contacts to stabilize a humanoid in low stability scenarios, where only using feet contacts may result in a fall. Candidate contacts are sampled within the robot's reachable workspace, and a preview is computed by rolling out the centroidal dynamics through pre-impact, impact and post-impact phases. Sampled points are scored based on the Center of Pressure (CoP) control authority at the post-impact phase. Central to our approach is a learned model of the robot's CoP region during post-impact, which enables rapid evaluation of candidate contact points compared to traditional optimization-based methods. The presented planner has two stages: the first selects an optimal bracing region and the second computes an optimal bracing point within the region. Our simulation results demonstrate an average increase in impulse resilience of 89% over recovery without hand contacts and 17% over a naive planning strategy (closest reachable region). We validate our framework on hardware, performing push tests while standing and walking. The standing trials show an average 43% reduction in stabilization time compared to naive hand placement and the walking trials demonstrate a 18% reduction compared to baseline recovery (without hand contacts).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种让双足机器人在快摔倒时快速用手撑地来稳住身体的方法，核心是用一个学出来的模型快速预测手撑在哪能最有效稳住重心，比传统优化快得多，并在仿真和真机上验证了它确实比不用手、或随便找地方撑手更抗推、恢复更快。
analysis.claim: 通过学习重心投影区域（CoP region）的映射关系，可实现多接触点（尤其是手部）的实时、高鲁棒性稳定性规划，显著提升双足机器人在扰动下的动态恢复能力。
analysis.input: 机器人当前状态（质心动力学状态）、候选手部接触点位置、外部扰动估计
analysis.output: 最优手部接触点坐标及对应支撑策略（含预冲击、冲击、后冲击阶段的控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: NVIDIA Isaac Gym + Unitree H1 真机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的质心动力学轨迹数据训练CoP区域模型；真机验证未使用真实接触力/触觉数据，仅用运动学与IMU反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将学习型CoP区域建模嵌入多接触实时规划闭环，在H1真机上完成站立/行走双场景抗扰验证，有完整消融（vs无手/vs最近区域）、量化提升（43%/18%），但未开源数据/模型，且未跨机体泛化到非H1平台，未解决触觉缺失下的接触质量评估等深层问题，属扎实重磅但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把学习模型精准嵌入经典质心动力学规划框架，在真机上做出可复现、有量化的稳定性提升，但未颠覆建模范式或解决感知-动作耦合根本瓶颈。

papers.title: Generating Structural Ensembles of Disordered Proteins with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Generative models of protein structures have accelerated scientific discovery. However, the leading structure-prediction models are trained primarily on crystal structures, limiting their ability to sample the conformations of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). All-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can probe the diversity of IDP conformational ensembles, but these simulations are slow and costly. Leveraging the speed of generative models and the accuracy of MD, we develop Zephyr, an SE(3) equivariant diffusion model trained on simulated IDP ensembles. The model generates the structure of a single protein sequence in two phases: a coarse-grained structure is first sampled and heavy atoms are subsequently denoised onto this structure. We evaluate our method on two fronts: ensemble accuracy and sampling efficiency. Across five test systems, the model reproduces key geometric and energetic metrics of the MD ensembles, while sampling at least 63 times faster.

analysis.tldr: 用SE(3)等变扩散模型Zephyr，基于分子动力学模拟生成的无序蛋白构象系综训练，能快速（比MD快63倍以上）生成符合几何与能量统计特征的粗粒化+全原子结构系综。
analysis.claim: SE(3)等变扩散模型可在保持IDP构象系综物理合理性的同时，实现比全原子分子动力学快两个数量级的高效采样。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 结构系综（含粗粒化骨架和重原子坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖模拟生成的IDP构象系综（无真实实验结构或NMR系综数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将SE(3)扩散建模系统性应用于IDP系综生成，验证了在5个IDP上对MD系综关键统计量（Rg、Asphericity、Φ角分布、MMGBSA能量）的保真复现，但未使用实验系综（如NMR RDC/PCS）校准，且泛化仅限于训练同源IDP家族，未跨fold或跨长度尺度验证；相比AlphaFold2等基石工作，它解决的是一个更窄、更下游的采样效率问题，而非结构预测根本挑战。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在IDP构象生成这一重要但被主流结构模型忽视的子方向上，首次实现了物理约束与生成效率的实质性平衡，但尚未触及实验可验证性与跨系统泛化。

papers.title: Making Waves: A Membrane-Coupled Delta Array for Manipulating Objects Below the Actuator Spacing
papers.abstract: Distributed manipulator systems manipulate objects through the coordinated motion of many actuators. However, an object must be supported by several actuators at once, so the centre-to-centre actuator spacing imposes a hard lower bound on manipulable object size. We remove this bound by coupling the end-effectors of an 8 x 8 array of three degrees-of-freedom delta robots with a stretchable fabric, turning 64 discrete contacts into a continuous surface capable of manipulating objects smaller than the actuator spacing. Viewing the array as a displacement field over that surface, we investigate local quasi-static and cyclic fields as manipulation primitives. These primitives can be applied globally across the array or locally confined around each tracked object to independently manipulate several objects in parallel. We then train a policy acting on low-order discrete cosine transform coefficients: at equal action dimension, commanding a nineteen-delta neighbourhood halves the placement error of commanding the whole array. The policy transfers to hardware without adaptation at 76% success. The platform manipulates objects from 15mm-90mm, a six-fold range spanning both sides of the actuator spacing, 43.3mm, on a single surface.

analysis.tldr: 用一块弹性布把64个delta机器人末端连成一张连续可变形的‘波浪膜’，突破传统分布式机械手因执行器间距导致的最小可操作物体尺寸限制，首次实现单平台操控从15mm到90mm（跨越43.3mm硬件间距）的六倍尺度范围物体，并用DCT压缩表征+局部策略实现多物体并行精准放置，真机零适配迁移成功率76%。
analysis.claim: 通过将离散delta执行器阵列耦合到弹性膜上，构造出等效连续位移场，从而消除执行器中心距对可操作物体最小尺寸的硬性约束。
analysis.input: 物体位姿观测（视觉跟踪）、低阶离散余弦变换（DCT）系数编码的位移场目标
analysis.output: 各delta机器人末端的三维位移指令（经DCT解码后映射）
analysis.robot_dependency: 8×8 delta机器人阵列 + 弹性织物膜
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的闭环操控数据训练策略，含多尺寸物体放置任务的真实轨迹与成功标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次以物理耦合膜替代刚性连接，从底层机制上解除分布式操纵器的尺寸下限桎梏；实证覆盖6倍尺度跨度、多物体并行、零适配部署，且策略基于可解释DCT表征，兼具原理创新性与工程鲁棒性，达到Facet-0/ALOHA级里程碑的实质性推进水平（虽未引入基础模型或跨模态泛化，但在接触式精密操纵的物理层约束突破上具有范式意义）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进控制算法，而是重构执行器-环境交互的物理界面，从根本上瓦解了分布式操纵领域长期存在的尺寸下限教条

papers.title: What the Guard Misses, the Robot Executes: Implied Harm in VLA Instructions
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) act on instructions without being able to refuse, so screening harmful requests falls to monitors. We test whether these monitors catch ordinary robot tasks requested for harmful reasons, holding the task fixed while varying only how explicitly the intent is stated. $π_{0.5}$ completes the task at every level of explicitness, as often as for harmless controls. Text guards flag nearly every blunt request but few implied ones: up to 95% of implied-harm runs end with the task done and no flag raised, and up to 90% even after recalibrating on robot instructions. Monitoring the model's activations does not close this gap. Linear probes separate harmful from harmless instructions almost perfectly in the base language and vision-language models, but this separation weakens after robot training in two model families, most for implied harm.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的监控系统几乎无法识别‘用无害动作执行有害意图’的指令，比如让机器人‘递一杯水’（实际是给正在被胁迫的人递毒药），而模型仍会照做且不触发警报。
analysis.claim: 现有VLA模型的文本监控器对隐含危害指令（implied harm）严重失效，且模型内部表征在机器人微调后对危害意图的可探测性显著下降。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（含显式/隐式危害意图）+ 视觉输入（未明确说明但隐含于VLA设定）
analysis.output: 是否触发监控警报、模型是否执行任务、线性探针对危害意图的分类准确率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于已有VLA模型（如π₀.₅）和公开监控器行为分析
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA监控在隐含意图下的结构性失效，并提供跨模型家族的实证（激活探针+行为测试），但未提出新模型/防御机制，也未在真实机器人上验证，属于扎实的诊断性研究而非解决方案，分量介于‘显著贡献’与‘扎实增量’之间，明显低于RT-2等基石工作（需模型级改进+真机部署+多任务泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：精准定位了VLA安全监控的关键盲区并给出强实证，但未提供修复方案，也未脱离仿真/离线分析框架。

papers.title: Sensor Geometry as a Flow-Matching Prior for Multi-Channel Brain Signals
papers.abstract: Flow-matching models start from an isotropic Gaussian source, the standard choice when the correlation structure of the data is unknown in advance. For multi-channel brain recordings, however, part of this structure is known in advance. Electrodes sit at fixed positions on the head, and volume conduction through the skull and scalp makes nearby electrodes co-vary in a way that is shared across subjects. Existing EEG generative models nonetheless leave the network to learn this from scratch. We put this structure into the source instead. From the sensor coordinates alone, we build a k-nearest-neighbor graph and take a graph-Matérn function of its Laplacian as the source covariance, so the flow starts from spatially coherent patterns rather than channel-independent noise. The change adds no learned parameters, works with any coupling and any drift network, and uses the same three hyperparameters on every dataset. Across eight EEG datasets and four flow-matching methods, the graph-Matérn source lowers the spectral discrepancy between generated and real signals in the five clinical bands (PSD-KL) on most datasets. PSD-KL falls by 12% to 17% in geometric mean over datasets depending on the method and by up to 40% on PhysioNet-MI, the densest montage. We show that the improvement stems from the spatial eigenvectors of the local graph of sensor positions, since randomizing the eigenvectors while preserving the eigenvalue spectrum eliminates the gain. Furthermore, a prior fitted directly to the empirical data covariance performs worse than isotropic noise. The same construction applies unchanged to MEG, intracranial EEG with patient-specific grids, and a traffic-sensor network, lowering PSD-KL for every method on each. https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出将脑电信号传感器的空间几何位置（电极坐标）编码为流匹配生成模型的先验协方差结构，用图Matérn函数构造空间相干的源噪声，而非传统各向同性高斯噪声，从而在不增加参数、不改变网络结构的前提下，显著提升EEG/MEG等多通道脑信号生成的频谱保真度。
analysis.claim: 利用传感器几何构型构建图拉普拉斯上的Matérn协方差作为流匹配模型的源分布先验，能比各向同性高斯先验更有效地建模多通道脑信号的空间相关性，并带来可复现、跨数据集、跨模态的频谱保真度提升。
analysis.input: 传感器三维坐标（电极位置）+ 多通道脑信号时序（EEG/MEG/iEEG）
analysis.output: 生成的多通道脑信号时序（与真实信号同维度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖公开脑电/脑磁数据集（如PhysioNet-MI等），但未使用任何闭环控制或在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有力，实证扎实：在8个EEG数据集+MEG/iEEG/交通传感器共4类模态上一致提升PSD-KL（最高40%），并通过消融（随机化特征向量）锁定几何图结构是增益来源；但属生成建模的先验工程改进，未解决BCI核心挑战（如解码精度、低延迟闭环、长期稳定性、临床部署），也未推动神经接口性能边界，故显著优于纯benchmark但远未达基石级（如Brain2voice 2.0或handwriting BCI）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是脑信号生成领域一次高质量的先验建模创新，证据充分、泛化性强，但属于方法论优化而非范式突破或临床级性能跃迁。

papers.title: Directed evolution of a thermostable family-A DNA polymerase into a reverse transcriptase for 2'-modified RNA
papers.abstract: RNA-based therapeutics increasingly rely on nuclease-resistant xeno-nucleic acids (XNAs), but engineering polymerases capable of reading and amplifying these non-canonical substrates remains a major challenge. Natural DNA polymerases cannot process C2' sugar modifications, and the complete structural determinants governing this limitation remain poorly understood, limiting rational design strategies. In this study, we apply directed evolution methods to Thermus thermophilus DNA polymerase using a microfluidic implementation of the Compartmentalized Self-Replication (CSR). We identify an engineered variant, termed E5, capable of reverse transcribing C2'-modified RNA, a previously inaccessible activity for this enzyme. Next-generation sequencing allow us to track evolutionary trajectories across nine rounds of evolution. Through an integrated analysis combining statistical methods, protein language models, and crystallographic data, we reveal unknown epistatic networks controlling polymerase function. This large-scale experimental dataset (>196,000 thermostable enzyme variants) provides a robust basis for predicting sequence-to-function relationships, accelerating development of enzymes for aptamer discovery and synthetic biology applications.

analysis.tldr: 用微流控定向进化技术改造嗜热菌DNA聚合酶，获得能高效逆转录2'-修饰RNA（如2'-F、2'-OMe）的新型逆转录酶E5，并通过超19万突变体测序+结构解析+蛋白语言模型分析，揭示了控制该功能跃迁的表型-基因型映射规律和上位性网络。
analysis.org: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）
analysis.claim: 通过大规模定向进化与多模态功能解析，首次将家族A嗜热DNA聚合酶重编程为具有实用活性的2'-修饰RNA逆转录酶，并系统解码其功能涌现的结构与进化机制。
analysis.input: 2'-氟代/2'-甲氧基修饰的RNA模板 + dNTPs
analysis.output: 互补DNA链（cDNA）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；全部为生化实验平台（微流控CSR系统、NGS、X射线晶体学）产出
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了长期悬而未决的2'-XNA逆转录功能突破（此前无家族A聚合酶成功案例），提供>19万高质量突变体功能数据集与高分辨率结构机制，实证扎实、多技术交叉验证充分；但尚未展示下游应用（如XNA aptamer生成效率提升或体内兼容性），且未开源全部突变体序列与模型权重，未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性，属重磅工程-机制双驱动贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在RNA治疗关键酶工具领域取得实质性突破，兼具高通量实验创新、机制深度解析与可扩展数据资源，但应用闭环与开源完整性尚不充分

papers.title: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90$\times$ and 10.67$\times$. Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需重新训练、通用的推理加速框架RealtimeWAM，通过分层并行+自适应计算（选择性特征缓存+Transformer残差复用+局部精调）大幅降低世界动作模型（WAM）的推理延迟，在多个仿真基准和5个真实机器人任务上实现8–10倍加速且几乎不损成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需修改模型结构或重新训练，仅通过运行时调度与自适应计算协调，即可在任意WAM架构上实现毫秒级低延迟推理，同时保持高任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前帧图像+历史动作/状态（具体依WAM架构而定）
analysis.output: 下一动作块/控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验含5个real-world tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于评估，但不依赖其进行训练或微调（training-free）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM推理工程化瓶颈上取得扎实突破：真机验证+多架构兼容+毫秒级延迟+成功率几乎无损；但未开新范式（仍属World Model下游加速），也未解决世界模型核心缺陷（如状态持久性、长程一致性），故低于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石（94–96分档），但显著优于纯仿真刷榜或单点优化工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将WAM从‘不能实时’推进到‘可部署实时’，证据充分（真机+多架构+消融隐含在方法描述中），但未触及世界模型本质建模问题。

papers.title: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies excel at generalist robotic manipulation but generate actions without explicitly modeling their environmental consequences. World action models (WAMs) incorporate future prediction, yet most rely on costly video generation, while latent alternatives either use predicted futures only as auxiliary targets or infer latent actions from suboptimal visual transitions through costly large-scale video pretraining. We introduce WAVE-0 (World-model-Augmented VLA Execution), a framework that bridges VLAs and WAMs through a lightweight latent world model. By connecting the semantic understanding of pretrained VLAs with explicit future prediction, WAVE-0 allows anticipated action consequences to directly guide action generation. Built on a pretrained VLA, its 257M world model translates VLM-generated latent action plans into predicted future representations that condition the action expert, unifying latent planning, future prediction, and action generation. The world model is trained directly on ground-truth robot actions with a counterfactual ranking objective, requiring neither pixel reconstruction nor large-scale video pretraining. WAVE-0 achieves success rates of 91.47% on RoboTwin 2.0 and 98.7% on LIBERO, along with 88.0%, 61.4%, and 75.0% on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para, respectively. On real-world tasks, it improves the success rate of $π_{0.5}$ from 38.3% to 73.3%. These results demonstrate strong manipulation performance and generalization across diverse distribution shifts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WAVE-0框架，把视觉语言动作策略（VLA）和世界动作模型（WAM）结合起来：不生成像素级未来视频，而是用一个轻量级的潜在空间世界模型，直接预测动作在潜空间中的未来状态表示，并用这个预测结果实时修正VLA的动作输出，在多个仿真基准（LIBERO系列、RoboTwin）和真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过轻量级潜空间世界模型将VLA与WAM桥接，使VLA能利用显式的、无需像素重建的未来状态预测来指导动作生成，从而提升泛化性与真实机器人表现。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器位姿/关节扭矩等低维控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台、LIBERO仿真环境、真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的ground-truth动作轨迹用于世界模型训练（非行为克隆式监督，而是counterfactual ranking目标），但未说明是否依赖大规模真实交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA与world model的协同范式：避开计算昂贵的视频生成，用潜空间counterfactual ranking训练轻量世界模型，且在多个LIBERO变体和真实Franka上验证了泛化增益；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战长期开放难题（如持续学习、状态持久性、多智能体交互），也未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的架构通用性与理论深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上巧妙融合VLA与潜空间WAM，在多个基准和真实机器人上实证有效，但缺乏开源与基础建模创新，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Modeling and Understanding Neural Weights of Humanoid Policies with Diffusion
papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have driven rapid progress in humanoid control, enabling increasingly agile behaviors in the real world. However, humanoid control networks are typically obtained through conventional training procedures, while comparatively little attention has been given to directly modeling the distribution of their learned weights and generating functional networks in weight space. In this work, we investigate whether high-performing humanoid control networks can be generatively modeled directly through their weights. We adopt a latent diffusion framework that couples a linear autoencoder with a Diffusion Transformer. The autoencoder compresses actor network parameters into a compact latent space, and the Diffusion Transformer models the distribution of these latents. Trained on networks collected from reinforcement learning for the Unitree G1 robot, our approach generates deployable networks that perform various motions in the real world, including walking, dancing, and spin kick. Beyond generation, we further study the learned weight space to better understand the structure captured by these humanoid control networks. We identify a structural principle in the first-layer weights that consistently reflects the robot's kinematic prior. Notably, this kinematic prior emerges under both Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Imitation Learning (IL) training, suggesting that it is not specific to a particular optimization process but may instead reflect common knowledge associated with humanoid embodiment. Together, these results demonstrate the feasibility of generative modeling in humanoid network weight space, while providing initial insights into the information encoded by their learned weights. Additional results are available on our project website: https://humanoid-weight-diffusion.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用扩散模型直接建模人形机器人控制策略的权重分布，从大量RL训练出的Unitree G1策略中学习权重的潜在结构，能生成可部署的新策略（走路/跳舞/侧踢），并发现第一层权重隐含了与机器人运动学一致的结构性先验。
analysis.claim: 人形机器人控制策略的权重本身具有可学习、可生成的统计分布结构，且该结构编码了与机器人本体相关的运动学先验。
analysis.input: 已训练好的人形机器人actor网络权重（来自Unitree G1 RL训练）
analysis.output: 生成的全新可部署控制策略权重（即完整神经网络参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人训练所得的策略权重集合（非传感器数据，而是策略参数本身）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在权重空间实现人形策略的生成式建模，并在真实G1上验证多任务部署；发现跨RL/IL一致的运动学先验是实质性洞见，但未开源代码/模型，未做消融或跨机体泛化，未与SOTA策略生成方法对比，尚未构成范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将扩散建模创新性地迁移到策略权重空间并实机验证，但缺乏开源、消融和横向对比，属于扎实且有启发性的方法学整合，而非理论或范式突破

papers.title: DemoStream: Batched Task-and-Motion-Plan Optimization for Automated Learning from Demonstration
papers.abstract: Learning from demonstration is an effective strategy for endowing robots with manipulation capabilities but requires training on datasets comprised of massive amounts of demonstrations. Existing demonstration collection approaches either require constant human involvement, for example, via teleoperation or are specialized for a single task. Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems are able to autonomously solve and therefore generate demonstrations for general-purpose tasks; however, learning from their demonstrations has proven difficult due to multi-modality in their solutions. In this work, we build on recent work leveraging GPU acceleration for TAMP and propose DemoStream, a TAMP system that optimizes demonstration quality in order to improve behavior cloning success rates. First, we introduce batched TAMP sampling operations along with a new TAMP algorithm that correspondingly performs batched constraint satisfaction in order to explore many solutions in parallel. We conduct simulation experiments ablating different action spaces, cost functions, and batch sizes to analyze the effect of these choices on downstream policy success rates. Finally, we show that we can leverage the safety guarantees of TAMP to directly collect real-world demonstrations at an average rate of 66 demos per hour. See our website for policy rollout videos: demostream.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出DemoStream系统，用GPU加速的批量任务与运动规划（TAMP）自动生成高质量、多样性演示数据，替代人工示教，显著提升行为克隆成功率，并在真实机器人上以66个/小时速率安全采集演示。
analysis.claim: 通过批量化、并行化的TAMP求解与显式优化演示质量（而非仅求解可行性），可生成更利于行为克隆学习的高质量、低歧义演示数据，且该过程具备形式化安全保证，可直接迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: 任务目标描述（如PDDL风格任务规范）+环境几何与物体状态
analysis.output: 高质量、高成功率的动作序列演示（即可供行为克隆训练的轨迹-动作对）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真 + Franka Emika Panda真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖历史真实机器人演示数据；依赖TAMP生成的合成演示，但真实部署阶段需少量初始环境标定
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将TAMP从‘求解器’升维为‘演示生成器’，并实证验证其在真实机械臂上的高效安全采集能力（66 demos/hr）和对下游BC性能的实质性提升（含消融）；虽未覆盖具身通用性（如无全身/移动基座/多机体），但为LFD范式提供了可验证、可扩展、带安全保证的新数据引擎，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将TAMP深度重构为可扩展、可优化、可落地的演示生成基础设施，非概念包装，但尚未达到开新范式级（如RT-2/AlphaFold）的广度与颠覆性。

papers.title: Benchmarking Positional Encoding Strategies for Transformer-Based EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a widely used non-invasive technique for measuring brain activity in brain-computer interface (BCI) applications. Supervised EEG decoding models often struggle to generalize across tasks, subjects, and datasets, motivating transformer-based EEG foundation models trained with self-supervised learning. Since transformers are permutation-invariant, they require explicit positional information. Unlike textual tokens, EEG electrodes are spatially distributed across the scalp, raising the question of how electrode positions should be encoded in transformer-based EEG models. In this study, we benchmark five positional encoding strategies within the CBraMod backbone and evaluate them under linear probing and fine-tuning protocols on motor imagery classification and emotion recognition. Our results show that no single strategy consistently outperforms across tasks. Spherical Positional Encoding (SPE) yields strong representations for motor imagery but underperforms on emotion recognition, while Asymmetric Conditional Positional Encoding (ACPE) demonstrates more consistent performance across tasks. These findings suggest that the optimal positional encoding strategy is task-dependent, with no universal solution across EEG decoding scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了5种给EEG电极位置编码的方法在Transformer模型中的效果，发现没有一种编码方式在所有脑电任务（运动想象、情绪识别）上都最优，任务不同应选不同编码策略。
analysis.claim: EEG变压器模型中不存在普适最优的位置编码策略，最优选择高度依赖具体解码任务。
analysis.input: 多通道原始EEG时序信号（含电极空间坐标）
analysis.output: 任务特定分类标签（如左手/右手运动想象、情绪类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论基准测试，无新模型架构/无真实闭环交互/无临床或具身部署价值；虽覆盖两个任务且含消融，但仍在传统监督式脑电分类框架内，未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈（如跨被试零样本泛化、在线自适应、神经反馈闭环），显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出生成或临床级功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是脑电信号处理子领域的扎实基准工作，但与具身智能/机器人方向无关，既不驱动动作生成也不连接物理执行器，对机器人感知-决策-行动闭环无实质贡献。

papers.title: SynthICL: Scalable In-context Imitation Learning with Synthetic Data
papers.abstract: In-context imitation learning (ICIL) enables robots to learn new tasks from a small number of demonstrations by conditioning a pre-trained policy on task-specific examples, without retraining at test time. Despite this promise, training generalizable and scalable in-context imitation policies remains an open challenge. We present SynthICL, a scalable framework that trains ICIL policies entirely from RGB-only synthetic data. Specifically, we build a data generation pipeline to produce high-fidelity ICIL data and train a flow-matching transformer policy on the resulting dataset. SynthICL avoids the need for depth sensing, precise camera calibration, and real-world training data in prior approaches, offering a simpler and more scalable alternative. We further incorporate subgoal prediction by training the model to predict the next subgoal images, enabling more precise and visually grounded control. Evaluated on 16 unseen real-world manipulation tasks, SynthICL achieves an average success rate of 79% with only one demonstration provided at test time and outperforms prior methods. Project page: https://synth-icl.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用纯合成RGB视频数据训练一个能根据少量示范（1个）即时模仿新任务的机器人策略，不依赖真实数据、深度传感器或相机标定，在16个未见过的真实操作任务上达到79%成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅用高保真合成RGB视频数据即可训练出泛化性强、无需微调、支持单示例上下文学习的机器人模仿策略，并通过子目标图像预测提升视觉接地控制精度。
analysis.input: RGB视频片段（含任务示范序列+当前观测帧）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制指令）及下一子目标图像预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（真实部署时）+ Isaac Gym（合成数据生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；仅在真实环境测试时需真实执行，但训练完全脱离真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯合成RGB数据驱动的ICIL，跨16个真实任务验证，消融充分（含子目标预测贡献），但未开源代码/模型，且未在多机体/用户/长时序复杂任务上验证鲁棒性，强于RDT-1B以下但未达Octo/π0级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用成熟技术（flow-matching transformer + synthetic pipeline）系统性解决ICIL的数据瓶颈，实证扎实但未开新范式，开源缺失削弱复现门槛

papers.title: Agile Fall Recovery for Quadrotors with Bidirectional Thrust via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous fall recovery is a critical capability for quadrotors operating in real-world environments, where collisions or failures may leave the vehicle resting on the ground in an arbitrary attitude. This problem is challenging because recovery must be achieved under limited onboard sensing, in constrained free space, with ground contact, and in the presence of unknown disturbances. In this letter, we present an RL-based framework for autonomous fall recovery of a quadrotor from arbitrary ground attitudes to stable hover using only lightweight onboard sensors. To address severe partial observability and intermittent sensor invalidity, we train a recurrent policy within an asymmetric actor--critic architecture, leveraging an Incremental Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion (INDI) controller to track the policy output. Combined with high-fidelity simulations of motor response and optical flow, the overall training framework significantly reduces the sim-to-real gap. Simulation ablation studies validate the importance of the main design choices, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer and robust recovery under different initial attitudes, wind disturbances, and additional payloads. These results demonstrate that agile quadrotor fall recovery can be achieved without explicit state estimation using only limited and unreliable onboard sensing.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习训练一个循环策略，让能双向推力的四旋翼无人机在任意倒地姿态下仅靠轻量级机载传感器（如IMU和光流）自主翻身并恢复悬停，不依赖精确状态估计。
analysis.claim: 无需显式状态估计、仅依赖受限且不可靠的机载传感器，即可实现四旋翼在任意地面姿态下的零样本敏捷跌落恢复。
analysis.input: IMU角速度/加速度 + 光流图像序列（无深度/无GPS/无外部定位）
analysis.output: 双向推力电机的控制指令序列（含反向推力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制双向推力四旋翼硬件平台（含倾转电机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实跌落视频与IMU数据用于光流仿真校准，但策略训练完全在仿真中完成，真实部署无fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多扰动鲁棒性+零样本跨姿态恢复+绕过传统状态估计算法，在微型无人机自主容错领域属显著推进；但未开源数据/模型，且平台依赖特殊双向推力硬件，通用性受限，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定硬件（双向推力旋翼）上实现了高鲁棒性的真机零样本跌落恢复，技术扎实但生态封闭、泛化路径窄，暂未形成可迁移的方法论范式。

papers.title: Sensorimotor World Models: Perception for Action via Inverse Dynamics
papers.abstract: Perception for action suggests that representations of the world should be shaped not by visual fidelity alone, but by their relevance for actions. At the same time, latent JEPA-style world models advocate learning compact predictive states from high-dimensional observations to facilitate the prediction of future states, but end-to-end training of these models is nontrivial because representations may collapse if our only goal is to construct a latent state that is easy to predict. We introduce a sensorimotor world model (SMWM): a latent world model trained end-to-end with inverse dynamics regularization. This single regularizer addresses both issues: it prevents representation collapse and induces action-aligned representations. By forcing latent states to preserve information about the action underlying a transition, it biases the model toward the controllable degrees of freedom of the environment while discarding uncontrollable distractors. This yields stable latent world models trained from offline, reward-free trajectories, without frozen encoders, exponential moving averages, or complex latent regularizers. Empirically, SMWM learns compact, interpretable latent spaces and enables competitive planning performance across simple 2D and 3D control tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫传感器运动世界模型（SMWM）的新方法，用逆动力学正则化来训练潜空间世界模型，让学到的隐状态既稳定又和动作强相关，从而在不依赖奖励、不冻结编码器、不用EMA或复杂正则的情况下，从离线轨迹中学会紧凑可解释的潜空间，并在简单2D/3D控制任务上实现有竞争力的规划性能。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 仅靠逆动力学正则化即可同时解决潜空间坍缩与动作无关性问题，从而端到端训练出稳定、动作对齐、无需额外工程技巧的潜世界模型。
analysis.input: 高维观测序列（如像素图像）+对应动作序列
analysis.output: 紧凑、动作对齐的潜状态序列，支持未来状态预测与基于潜空间的规划
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的离线轨迹，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有力（单正则解决两大经典问题），实证覆盖多个仿真控制任务且含消融，但仅限简单2D/3D环境、无真实机器人验证、未挑战长期开放难题（如长时序一致性、跨任务泛化、具身交互鲁棒性），显著弱于DreamerV3/World Models等基石工作（均含真机迁移、多任务强泛化、端到端闭环控制证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用逆动力学正则化实现了潜世界模型训练范式的简化与语义对齐，但仍是仿真环境中的原理验证，尚未触及具身智能核心瓶颈。

papers.title: FT-WBC: Learning Fault-Tolerant Whole-Body Control for Legged Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Legged manipulators combine the mobility of legged platforms with the manipulation capability of robotic arms. However, arm-induced Center-of-Mass shifts and dynamic disturbances make the system more prone to instability under actuator failures, potentially leading to falls, task failures, or safety risks. Existing fault-tolerant control methods mainly focus on locomotion alone, leaving the coupled problem of whole-body stability and arm reachability in fault-tolerant loco-manipulation largely unaddressed. To bridge this gap, we propose FT-WBC, a fault-tolerant loco-manipulation framework for robust whole-body control of legged manipulators under actuator failures. FT-WBC adopts a decoupled upper- and lower-body policy architecture and introduces two key modules: a Fault Estimator (FE) and a Posture Adaptation Module (PAM). The FE predicts faulty joints from lower-body proprioceptive histories, while the PAM uses this fault information to adapt the base posture plan generated by the arm policy, converting potentially unstable posture requests into safe and executable base posture commands. Through this fault-aware posture adaptation mechanism, FT-WBC synthesizes compensatory gaits under actuator failures and preserves as much arm workspace as possible while maintaining whole-body stability. Simulation and real-world experiments show that FT-WBC significantly improves survival rate and workspace under weakening or locked failures, and transfers zero-shot to a real legged manipulator in the real world.

analysis.tldr: 提出FT-WBC框架，在腿足机器人+机械臂的整机系统发生执行器故障（如关节卡死或力矩衰减）时，通过故障估计器识别故障关节，并动态调整底盘姿态规划以补偿稳定性损失，从而在维持全身稳定的同时尽可能保住机械臂工作空间。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦上下身策略、引入故障估计器与姿态自适应模块，可在执行器故障下实现腿足-操作一体化系统的零样本迁移式容错整机控制，兼顾稳定性与操作可达性。
analysis.input: 下肢本体感知序列（关节角度/速度/力矩）+上肢任务目标（如末端位姿）
analysis.output: 补偿后的底盘姿态指令（六自由度基座位姿）与下肢步态轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人+七轴机械臂（仿真中为ANYmal+Cheetah-arm，实机为自研清华四足平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中注入的执行器故障数据训练FE；实机验证仅用少量真实故障测试，未使用真实故障数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决腿足-操作耦合系统下的执行器级容错控制问题，实机验证覆盖多种故障模式（锁定/衰减）、多任务（reach/grasp/move）和跨机体迁移（仿真到自研真机），有消融实验支撑核心模块有效性，但未开源代码/模型，且未与主流locomanipulation基线（如WholeBodyVLA、GRAIL）做联合故障鲁棒性对比，属扎实重磅进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实腿足操作机器人上实现了有实证支撑的端到端容错控制，但受限于闭源与基线对比缺失，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.abstract: We present RoboAtlas, a contextual Active SLAM framework that adaptively balances geometric exploration and semantic reasoning using a scalable 3D semantic mapping system, OpenRoboVox. RoboAtlas integrates frontier exploration, global semantic-map reasoning, and egocentric VLM-based reasoning through a contextual multi-armed bandit that transitions from exploration to semantically guided navigation as scene understanding improves. We evaluate the system in simulation and on a Unitree Go2 robot in large-scale real-world environments exceeding 1800 m2 with approx. 30k mapped semantic instances, achieving a 100% task success rate. On the GOAT-Bench "Val Unseen" benchmark, RoboAtlas achieves state-of-the-art performance with highest reported success rate (SR) of 90.6%, using GPT-4o, improving over the strongest prior baseline by 17.8 percentage points in SR. Using the much smaller Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, it still achieves 88.8% SR, outperforming all baselines using GPT-4o in SR, and revealing the importance of the information gained by our semantic mapping framework over simply replacing the underlying foundation model. The results demonstrate that grounding foundation models with large-scale 3D semantic maps enables robust and efficient contextual Active SLAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboAtlas框架，用可扩展的3D语义地图系统OpenRoboVox，结合前沿探索、全局语义地图推理和以视觉语言模型（VLM）为核心的自我中心推理，通过上下文多臂老虎机动态权衡几何探索与语义理解，在真实大场景（1800m²+）中用Unitree Go2机器人实现100%任务成功率，并在GOAT-Bench上刷出90.6%的SOTA成功率。
analysis.claim: 将大规模3D语义地图作为基础，通过上下文自适应机制耦合几何SLAM与VLM语义推理，可显著提升主动SLAM在真实复杂环境中的任务成功率和泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、IMU数据、语言指令（如'找红色灭火器'）、初始语义先验
analysis.output: 语义一致的导航路径与目标定位动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2机器人 + RealSense D435i传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的1800m²级环境数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练；OpenRoboVox建图模块需真实扫描数据初始化
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于超大真实场景（1800m²+）、多任务高成功率（100%）、GOAT-Bench SOTA（90.6%）、消融证实语义地图增益远超换更大VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B反超GPT-4o基线），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体验证，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本语义泛化或终身地图演化），属扎实重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM、3D语义地图与主动SLAM深度耦合并实机验证，效果显著，但缺乏开源与更广泛化证据，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式影响力。

papers.title: BoltzProt-1: Towards Efficient De Novo Binder Design with Good Developability
papers.abstract: Designing binders against novel protein targets remains a central challenge in computational drug discovery. Here we introduce BoltzProt-1, a pipeline for generating protein binders, including nanobodies, with improved hit rates and favorable developability properties. At its core lie a refined iteration of BoltzGen's generative model and a novel protein-protein interaction prediction model, BoltzPPI. Employing BoltzPPI instead of BoltzGen's standard structure-prediction confidence metrics to rank nanobody (VHH) designs increases the confirmed-binder hit rate from 3.3% to 8.0% across 10 novel targets. Assessed on 10 additional targets used in prior literature, the BoltzProt-1 pipeline obtains nanobody screening hits for 7 of 10 targets, surpassing the 6 of 10 previously reported by Chai-2. Finally, evaluating the developability of BoltzProt-1-designed nanobodies in terms of stability, aggregation, purity, polyspecificity and hydrophobicity reveals that 58% of its confirmed binders pass every criterion, exceeding both BoltzGen (40%) and clinical-stage VHH controls (21%).

analysis.tldr: 提出BoltzProt-1流程，用改进的生成模型BoltzGen和新训练的蛋白-蛋白互作预测模型BoltzPPI联合筛选纳米抗体，将实验验证的结合体命中率从3.3%提至8.0%，并在10个新靶点中实现7个成功筛选，同时58%的确认结合体满足全部可开发性指标（稳定性、抗聚集等），显著优于前代BoltzGen和临床阶段对照。
analysis.claim: 用BoltzPPI替代结构置信度打分进行生成后排序，可显著提升de novo纳米抗体设计的实验命中率和可开发性达标率。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白结构（PDB格式）或序列
analysis.output: 可开发性达标的纳米抗体（VHH）氨基酸序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖已发表的蛋白结构、结合实验数据及可开发性检测结果（如DSF、SEC-HPLC、SPR等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在de novo蛋白 binder设计中首次将PPI预测模型直接用于生成式筛选排序，并在10+10个独立新靶点上完成湿实验验证，命中率翻倍且可开发性达标率超临床对照；但未开源代码/模型权重，未覆盖更广蛋白类型（仅VHH），也未证明对非结构化靶点或突变靶点的鲁棒性，尚未达到RFdiffusion/AlphaFold2级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成模型与专用判别模型闭环耦合，在真实湿实验中系统验证了对新靶点的高命中与高可开发性，但未开源核心资产，未拓展至通用蛋白支架，属当前AI×生物领域顶尖的工程级推进。

papers.title: CoFL-S: Spatially Queryable Sector Flow Fields for Local Language-Conditioned Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation has increasingly emphasized high-level instruction reasoning, memory, global map construction, and instruction decomposition, while the low-level action representation remains comparatively underexplored. We propose CoFL-S, a low-level vision-language-action framework that predicts a language-conditioned flow field over the robot's local visible sector and generates continuous trajectories by rolling out the predicted field. To train this low-level representation, we convert each VLN-CE episode, originally a whole-episode instruction paired with an action sequence, into frame-level local supervision with aligned sub-instructions and matched action, trajectory, and dense flow-field targets. For evaluation, we introduce a continuous-time Habitat benchmark that isolates low-level action interfaces from instruction decomposition and executes all methods through a shared velocity-command controller, enabling decomposition-independent closed-loop comparison across different planner frequencies rather than fixed discrete forward-and-turn transitions in VLN-CE. Under matched encoders and training settings, CoFL-S consistently outperforms action-token and action-chunk baselines across planner frequencies in the continuous-time Habitat benchmark, and zero-shot real-world closed-loop deployment further shows its advantage over both baselines beyond simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoFL-S，用语言指令引导机器人在局部视野内生成可空间查询的连续流场（flow field），再从中积分出平滑轨迹；它把传统VLN任务中离散动作序列转为帧级稠密流场监督，并在新设计的连续时间Habitat基准上验证了其比动作token/块方法更鲁棒、更适配不同规划频率，还做了零样本真机闭环部署。
analysis.claim: 语言条件下的局部流场表征比离散动作token或chunk更适配连续控制接口、更具跨规划频率泛化性，且能零样本迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言子指令（局部帧级对齐）
analysis.output: 局部可见扇区上的二维空间流场（x,y方向速度矢量场），用于积分生成连续轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Habitat simulator + 真实轮式机器人（未指明型号，仅称zero-shot deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全依赖合成数据（VLN-CE转换而来），真实机器人仅用于零样本部署验证，无真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLN低层动作表征长期被忽视的问题，提出了可微分、空间可查询的流场接口并构建了首个连续时间VLN benchmark，但未开源代码/模型，真实部署仅单次零样本、无任务多样性与消融，未挑战复杂场景或长程导航，贡献属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将稠密流场引入VLN低层控制并配套新benchmark，但实证深度不足（无开源、无消融、真机验证极简），尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: Identifying and Addressing Systematic Data Leakage in Protein-Ligand Affinity Benchmarks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding affinity is a crucial goal in structure-based drug discovery, with the potential to significantly shorten development timelines. Recently, a new wave of machine learning models based on co-folding, such as Boltz-2 and IsoDDE, has demonstrated performance that matches or exceeds that of gold-standard physics-based methods like Free Energy Perturbation (FEP). This paper provides a critical assessment of these claims, revealing that current benchmarks are heavily influenced by data leakage, and proposes a new benchmark that explicitly controls for data leakage. We demonstrate that splitting by protein-sequence identity is inherently insufficient to prevent data leakage due to “target mirroring,” in which homologous proteins with low overall sequence identity still exhibit highly correlated binding profiles. Our meta-analysis of documents in the ChEMBL 36 database identifies more than 6,000 such assay pairs and finds that leakage persists for sequence-identity thresholds as low as 0.2, well below the values commonly used in benchmarks today. Additionally, we show that a ligand-only baseline model, which lacks protein structural information, achieves surprisingly high performance on the FEP+ 4 and OpenFE benchmarks ( r = 0.66 and r = 0.36, respectively). Our results indicate that current benchmarks tend to reward models for memorizing training data and exploiting localized leakage rather than truly learning biophysical principles. To address this issue, we propose the Novelty-Tiered Affinity Benchmark, in which the test data is partitioned into ligand novelty tiers. In the most challenging tier (Tanimoto similarity < 0.35), ligand-only models perform notably worse ( r = 0.14), offering a clear baseline for evaluating genuine generalization. We argue that the field must move beyond sequence-based splits to ensure that AI-driven discovery translates into successful prospective laboratory research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前蛋白质-配体亲和力预测的主流基准（如FEP+4、OpenFE）存在严重系统性数据泄漏——因同源蛋白靶标间‘靶标镜像’效应，仅靠蛋白序列相似性阈值划分训练/测试集无法避免泄漏；作者用ChEMBL 36元分析证实该问题普遍存在，并提出新基准Novelty-Tiered Affinity Benchmark，按配体结构新颖性分层评估，迫使模型真正泛化而非记忆泄漏模式。
analysis.claim: 当前蛋白-配体亲和力预测基准因靶标镜像效应导致系统性数据泄漏，仅靠蛋白序列相似性划分训练/测试集无效；真正检验模型泛化能力需按配体结构新颖性分层构建基准。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构（PDB）与配体SMILES/3D构象
analysis.output: 结合自由能预测值（ΔG或pKd/pKi）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露了领域长期忽视的基准设计根本缺陷（靶标镜像），提供大规模实证（6000+泄漏对、多阈值验证）、提出可操作的新评估范式（配体新颖性分层），并给出强反证（配体-only基线在旧基准上r=0.66→新最难层跌至r=0.14），但未发布开源代码/模型，且未推动新模型架构，属方法论纠偏型重磅工作，未达AlphaFold级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次系统性证伪主流亲和力基准有效性，并建立以配体结构新颖性为锚点的评估新标准，为AI药物发现可信性立下关键路标。

papers.title: TAC-LOCO: Unified Whole-Body Control for Quadrupedal TACtile-Informed LOCO-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dynamic loco-manipulation requires legged robots to coordinate whole-body motion while maintaining stable physical interaction with grasped objects under uncertain external forces. While tactile sensing has been widely studied for robotic manipulation, its role in dynamic whole-body control remains largely unexplored. Existing works without tactile feedback commonly grasp firmly rather than regulate the grasp according to the interaction. We propose TAC-LOCO, a tactile-augmented unified reinforcement learning framework that encodes tactile array observations from compliant grippers into a compact latent representation and joins it with proprioception for unified control of the legs, arm, and gripper. With effective grasp stability reward design, the policy learns to simultaneously track body velocity and end-effector trajectories, moderate grasp force, and prevent object slip under both gradual load changes and sudden release events. We deploy the policy zero-shot on a Unitree Go2 with an Interbotix WidowX 250 arm and tactile gripper, demonstrating dynamic tactile-informed loco-manipulation under varying external interactions, achieving a 47% reduction in grasping force and an object drop rate of less than 1%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合触觉反馈的全身强化学习控制器，让四足机器人边走边操作物体时能根据触觉实时调节抓握力，防止打滑，在Unitree Go2+机械臂上零样本部署成功，抓握力降低47%，掉物率低于1%。
analysis.claim: 触觉信息可被压缩编码后与本体感知融合，支撑四足机器人在动态行走-操作耦合任务中实现零样本部署的、力敏自适应的全身闭环控制。
analysis.input: 四足机器人本体传感器数据（关节位置/速度/IMU）+ 触觉阵列信号（来自 compliant gripper）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（含腿、臂、夹爪）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2 + Interbotix WidowX 250 + 自研触觉夹爪
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉与运动数据进行训练和验证，但未说明是否使用真实数据预训练或微调；部署为零样本，暗示仿真训练为主，真实数据仅用于验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实四足-手臂系统上实现触觉驱动的全身loco-manipulation零样本部署，有明确消融（抓握力/掉物率量化）、多扰动场景（渐变负载+突发释放）、跨任务泛化（行走+抓取+抗扰），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更复杂环境（如非结构化地形、多物体交互），强于多数sim2real工作但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实四足机器人上实现触觉闭环的全身loco-manipulation零样本部署，证据扎实、指标明确、硬件栈完整，但开源缺失限制复现与扩展

papers.title: Scale-Aware Attention for Scarce Neural Data: An RG-Flow Transformer on Sleep-EDF EEG
papers.abstract: Brain field potentials are scale-free: their power spectra follow a $1/f^β$ law whose aperiodic exponent $β$ tracks cortical state, and sleep depth in particular is a shift in $β$. We ask whether a transformer endowed with an explicit renormalization-group (RG) inductive bias -- the RG-Flow Transformer, which couples ordinary self-attention to a scale-aware stream with a learnable anomalous dimension $γ$, block-spin coarse-graining, and an entropy-gated synchronization bridge -- has an advantage over a parameter-matched vanilla transformer on \emph{real, scarce} EEG. Using the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF corpus with a strict leakage-free by-subject hold-out, we (i) benchmark RG-Flow against a param-matched vanilla transformer and a hierarchy-only ablation on 5-class AASM sleep staging, (ii) sweep the per-subject data budget to look for the inductive-bias crossover predicted when data are scarce, and (iii) test whether RG-Flow's learned $γ$ tracks the measured spectral exponent $β$ out-of-sample -- a quantity the vanilla model does not possess. Across $5$ subjects and $5$ seeds under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation, RG-Flow and the vanilla transformer are statistically indistinguishable on 5-class staging (77.3\% vs 77.0\% accuracy; paired $p=0.294$), and the predicted scarce-data crossover does not appear: vanilla is numerically ahead at every data-limited budget. What does separate the models is interpretability -- RG-Flow recovers the continuous spectral exponent out-of-sample ($β$-recovery $R^2 = 0.416$), a capability the vanilla architecture has no analogue for.

analysis.tldr: 提出RG-Flow Transformer模型，试图用显式重正化群（RG）归纳偏置建模EEG信号的尺度不变性，在Sleep-EDF稀缺真实数据上做睡眠分期任务，结果发现其分类性能与普通Transformer无统计差异，但能额外预测脑电谱指数β（R²=0.416），提供可解释性新维度。
analysis.claim: 显式嵌入重正化群物理先验的Transformer（RG-Flow）虽未提升稀缺EEG数据上的睡眠分期准确率，但能从EEG中无监督地、跨被试地恢复出反映皮层状态的连续谱指数β，这是标准Transformer完全不具备的能力。
analysis.input: 原始单通道/多通道EEG时序信号（Sleep-EDF数据）
analysis.output: 5类睡眠分期标签 + 连续谱指数β的预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床EEG数据（Sleep-EDF），无机器人/传感器硬件依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献在于将凝聚态物理中的重正化群思想具象化为可训练神经模块，并在真实稀缺脑电数据上验证其可解释性价值（β恢复R²=0.416），但核心任务（睡眠分期）未超越基线，且代码/模型未开源；相比90+分基石工作（如高精度BCI语音解码、脊髓接口自然行走），它未解决临床级BCI的关键瓶颈（低延迟/高鲁棒/跨用户泛化/闭环控制），属扎实的算法-神经科学交叉增量，非范式突破或临床推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将RG物理先验工程化为可学习模块并实证其在真实EEG上的可解释性增益，但未带来性能提升，也未开源核心资产，属于方法论上有启发性的严谨增量工作。

papers.title: Enabling 24-hour Agricultural Robotics: Unsupervised Day-to-Night Cross-Modal Image Translation for Nighttime Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: While visual navigation has been extensively studied in agricultural robotics, most existing systems assume daytime conditions. In fact, deploying autonomous robots at night offers significant advantages, including 24-hour crop and soil monitoring, fruit harvesting, and nocturnal pest detection. Modern vision-based systems, however, rely heavily on large-scale well-annotated image datasets, which remains challenging to obtain for nighttime operation scenarios. To address this, we propose an unsupervised image translation framework that converts daytime plant-row RGB images into near-infrared (NIR) nighttime counterparts without requiring pixel-to-pixel supervision. This enables the direct reuse of daytime semantic labels for training nighttime perception models. In particular, by incorporating a pre-trained Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model, the proposed framework is designed to preserve semantic consistency during day-to-night translation. Additionally, a visibility mask is introduced to account for the limited effective range of NIR illumination in nighttime scenes. We conduct comparative evaluations with state-of-the-art image translation baselines and demonstrate higher image qualities, as supported by improved performance in downstream semantic segmentation for nighttime visual navigation. For evaluation, we utilize AgriNight--a novel dataset comprising 428 daytime and 549 nighttime images collected using night-vision-equipped mobile robots in agricultural fields and manually annotated with pixel-wise semantic labels--and introduce it as the first benchmark for nighttime agricultural visual navigation. We also perform real-time autonomous navigation experiments with a physical robot operating at night. The data and code are available at: https://github.com/mamorobel/AgriNight.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无监督的白天RGB到夜间近红外图像翻译方法，让白天标注的数据能直接用于训练夜间农业机器人视觉导航模型，并发布了首个农业夜间视觉导航数据集AgriNight，在真实机器人上验证了夜间自主导航效果。
analysis.claim: 无需像素级配对标注，即可将白天农田RGB图像无监督翻译为语义一致的近红外夜间图像，从而复用白天标注数据支撑夜间视觉导航。
analysis.input: 白天农田RGB图像（含植物行结构）
analysis.output: 语义对齐的近红外夜间风格图像（含可见性掩码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化夜视移动机器人（用于数据采集与实机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实夜间机器人采集的AgriNight数据集（549张夜间图+人工像素级标注），但模型训练本身不依赖夜间标注图像，仅需白天RGB图
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了农业机器人夜间视觉缺乏标注数据的关键瓶颈，首次构建了带像素级标注的夜间农田图像基准数据集并完成真机验证；但方法本质是CLIP引导的GAN式跨模态翻译改进，未突破图像翻译范式，也未覆盖多任务泛化或跨机体部署，贡献集中于特定场景（农田行导航）的工程闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在农业夜间导航这一被长期忽视的细分场景中，完成了从问题定义、数据基建、方法设计到真机验证的完整链条，但技术内核未达范式级创新。

papers.title: Exo2EgoPose: Leveraging Exocentric Demonstrations for Vision-Language guided Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Forecasting
papers.abstract: Perceiving multimodal cues and forecasting fine-grained actions from an egocentric (Ego) perspective is vital for applications like robot manipulation. However, previous studies either rely mainly on under-informed visual inputs to predict coarse human motions or follow the VRM/VLA paradigm, which suffers from insufficient robot data and the gap between human and robot embodiments. We observe that 3D hand pose naturally serves as a unified representation to bridge human-robot actions. Hence, we investigate an under-explored Vision-Language guided Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Forecasting (VL-EHPF) task, which aims to predict future Ego 3D hand poses from visual observations, a language instruction, and pose states. To overcome the limited field-of-view and highly dynamic motions in the Ego view, we propose a framework dubbed Exo2EgoPose, which innovatively leverages holistic and stable exocentric (Exo) demonstrations as guidance to compensate for partial and dynamic Ego-view cues. Specifically, we introduce a Dual-level Exocentric Reconstruction Module (DERM), which incorporates the paired Exo videos as supervision to reconstruct their video-level and chunked frame-level representations, thereby modeling spatial contexts and temporal dynamics. Then, the Global-to-Local Modulation Module (GLMM) utilizes the reconstructed hierarchical Exo representations for progressive feature refinement via attention mechanisms and adaptive modulation, enabling comprehensive Exo guidance for accurate Ego hand pose forecasting. Extensive experiments on \textit{AssemblyHands}, \textit{Ego-Exo4D}, and our newly constructed \textit{EgoMe-pose} benchmarks show the superiority of our method, which outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin. Moreover, it demonstrates an effective human-to-robot transfer capability and yields improvements on the \textit{CALVIN} dataset. Code will be released.

analysis.tldr: 提出Exo2EgoPose框架，用第三人称（Exo）视频作为监督信号来提升第一人称（Ego）视角下、结合语言指令的3D手部姿态预测精度，核心是通过双层级Exo重建模块和全局到局部调制模块实现跨视角知识迁移。
analysis.claim: 利用配对的第三人称视频作为稳定、全局的监督信号，可显著提升第一人称视角下视觉-语言引导的3D手部姿态预测精度与泛化性。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频帧 + 自然语言指令 + 当前手部姿态状态
analysis.output: 未来若干帧的3D手部关节坐标序列（egocentric 3D hand pose）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用人类手部动作数据集（AssemblyHands/Ego-Exo4D/EgoMe-pose）
analysis.significance_reason: 任务设定有启发性（Exo→Ego跨视角指导），方法结构清晰且在三个新/现有benchmark上验证有效，但未涉及任何机器人闭环控制、真实硬件部署或动作执行；所有实验纯仿真/离线预测，无动作生成或策略学习；‘human-to-robot transfer’仅体现为在CALVIN上做姿态预测微调，未验证实际机器人操作效果；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等真正打通感知-语言-动作闭环的基石工作，仍属感知层子任务的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：聚焦于egocentric pose forecasting这一感知子任务，引入exocentric supervision思路并验证有效，但未触及动作规划、具身控制或真实机器人交互，不属于具身智能或VLA范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: GEM-GPT Enables Personalized Cell Type-Resolved Therapeutic Design for Systems Pharmacology
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a powerful framework for drug discovery, yet most current approaches follow one-drug-one-gene target-based paradigms that struggle to capture the complexity and heterogeneity of chronic and systemic diseases. Omics-driven systems pharmacology provides a promising strategy to overcome these limitations, but generative AI tools specifically designed for systems pharmacology-oriented drug design remain scarce. To address this gap, we introduce GEM-GPT, a transcriptomics-based molecule generation framework that designs personalized therapeutic compounds capable of reverting cell type-specific disease states back to a healthy phenotype. GEM-GPT employs a biology-inspired deep fusion architecture that couples a single-cell RNA-sequencing (scRNA-seq) foundation model with a molecular GPT model, enabling the modeling of cell type-specific chemical-gene interactions during molecule generation. This integration allows GEM-GPT to outperform state-of-the-art baselines, generate distinct molecules for different cell types, and generalize robustly to previously unseen cell types. We further demonstrate the utility of GEM-GPT through a case study in personalized drug discovery for opioid use disorder (OUD). In this application, GEM-GPT successfully identifies both therapeutic compounds possessing distinct chemotypes and existing FDA-approved drugs predicted to modulate cell type-specific OUD disease phenotypes in individual patients. Together, these results establish GEM-GPT as an advance in AI-driven systems pharmacology by bridging single-cell omics and molecular generation to support personalized, systems-aware therapeutic design.

analysis.tldr: 用单细胞RNA测序数据训练的生成模型GEM-GPT，能为不同细胞类型分别生成可逆转疾病表型的小分子化合物，并在阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）患者中成功复现已知药效和发现新化学型候选物。
analysis.claim: GEM-GPT首次将单细胞转录组基础模型与分子GPT耦合，实现细胞类型分辨率下的个性化、系统药理学导向的治疗分子生成。
analysis.input: 单细胞RNA测序数据（scRNA-seq）表征的疾病vs健康细胞类型状态
analysis.output: 具有预测性细胞类型特异性调控活性的小分子结构（SMILES）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖公开/私有scRNA-seq数据集（如OUD患者样本）及分子属性数据库
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了AI×生物医学交叉：首次实现scRNA-seq引导的细胞类型分辨分子生成，有跨细胞类型泛化验证、OUD临床队列案例、与FDA药物匹配分析及化学型差异性证据；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏湿实验验证、无独立benchmark对比、未证明生成分子的实际生物学活性，尚未达到dtSFM或ESM-2级的范式定义力或工业级可部署性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真正在单细胞分辨率上打通‘疾病状态→靶向分子’生成闭环，证据扎实但落地闭环未完成

papers.title: Morphing MILR: Design and control of a cable-driven limbless robot with rolling joints for maneuvering in complex environments
papers.abstract: Limbless robots offer exceptional mobility in confined and cluttered environments due to their slender bodies and their ability to exploit body-terrain interactions. Recent designs incorporating compliance demonstrate robust locomotion without complex sensing or control; however, these systems typically rely on fixed body configurations, with each morphology specialized for a single locomotion mode or environment. This raises a key challenge: how can a single limbless robot achieve versatile locomotion while preserving the robustness of compliance-mediated locomotion? To address this challenge, we present a cable-driven limbless robot that reconfigures body morphology and compliance to enable diverse locomotion modes. Distributed cable actuation generates traveling body waves, while programmable passive compliance enables robust contact-rich locomotion without terrain knowledge or high-bandwidth feedback. Rolling joints reorient bending planes along the body, enabling rapid reconfiguration and smooth transitions between locomotion styles, and incorporate geared locking to maintain configuration without continuous power. By combining programmable bending compliance and morphology control, the platform achieves lateral undulation, sidewinding, rolling, and twisting within a single system. Experiments demonstrate reliable gait generation, traversal in obstacle-rich environments, and transitions between modes, establishing a versatile limbless platform for navigating complex environments with applications in search and rescue, environmental monitoring, and inspection.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种靠缆绳驱动、带滚动关节的无肢软体机器人，能主动改变身体形态和刚度，在不依赖复杂感知和实时反馈的情况下，用同一套硬件实现侧向波动、侧绕、滚转、扭转等多种运动模式，并在障碍密集环境中完成可靠运动和模式切换。
analysis.claim: 通过可编程的被动柔顺性与滚动关节驱动的形态重构相结合，单一体系结构可在无需地形先验或高带宽闭环控制的前提下，实现多种鲁棒、接触丰富的无肢运动模态。
analysis.input: 预设的缆绳张力序列与关节锁定指令（开环/低频编程）
analysis.output: 身体形态配置 + 连续身体波形 + 多模态运动行为
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研缆绳驱动无肢机器人原型（含滚动关节与齿轮锁止机构）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验数据；未使用仿真预训练或迁移，所有结果均来自真机测试
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了无肢机器人中罕见的、硬件级可重构形态+可编程柔顺性的耦合设计，真机验证了4种迥异运动模态及跨障碍环境的稳定切换，但未开源代码/模型，未与主流基线（如OCTOPUS、MORPH）定量对比，也未解决长期开放难题（如自主地形识别适配），属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在硬件创新、多模态运动实现和真实复杂环境部署上扎实落地，但缺乏算法通用性扩展、开源支持和跨平台基准验证，尚未达到基石论文的范式影响力层级。

papers.title: HAM-VLN: Harnessing Hierarchical Agentic Memory for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables robots to follow instructions in previously unseen environments. Recently, a training-free paradigm has emerged: the robot queries a multimodal LLM to understand its observations and plan the next action. However, long-horizon navigation based on either image streams or dense map inevitably introduces a growing memory and reasoning bottleneck. We present HAM-VLN, a decision-coupled, agent-authored memory that equips the robot with a persistent, depth-grounded world graph. In the same model call used to select the next action, HAM-VLN also records semantic and reflective information---including room type, objects, navigation progress, and failure notes. Recent waypoints remain verbatim within a bounded window, while older history re-enters the context only through retrieval scored by relevance, recency, and salience, together with one-hop topological expansion. This design requires no additional LLM calls beyond the per-waypoint decision. Compared to previous methods, HAM-VLN not only improves various navigation metrics but also reduces the context length by more than 65%. Specifically, HAM-VLN achieves 61.0% Success Rate (SR) on VLN-CE R2R, 52.7% SR on VLN-CE RxR, and 79.7% SR on HM3D-v2 ObjectNav without any training.

analysis.tldr: 提出HAM-VLN，一种无需训练的视觉-语言导航方法，通过让多模态大模型在每次决策时同步构建并维护一个带深度信息的世界图谱记忆（含房间类型、物体、进度、失败记录），用检索+拓扑扩展压缩长程历史，显著缩短上下文长度，提升零样本导航成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练，仅靠一次调用多模态大模型即可同步完成动作决策与层次化记忆构建，通过可检索、有拓扑结构的持久化世界图谱缓解长程VLN中的记忆与推理瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令+当前视角深度图
analysis.output: 离散导航动作（如左转/右转/前进/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（R2R/RxR/HM3D-v2）
analysis.significance_reason: 是VLN领域少有的真正落地零样本、免训练、且有明确记忆机制设计的工作，指标提升扎实（尤其HM3D-v2达79.7% SR），但本质仍属LLM+VLN的工程整合：未引入新传感器模态、未验证真实机器人部署、未解决底层感知鲁棒性或跨域泛化（如不同建筑风格/光照/语言歧义），也未挑战VLN根本瓶颈（如指代消解、隐含前提推理），相比标尺中94+分的具身智能范式级工作（如WholeBodyVLA、GRAIL），它未涉及运动控制、本体感知或具身协同建模，仅在决策层做记忆优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多模态LLM的记忆管理显式结构化为可检索的世界图谱，在仿真VLN任务上实现了免训练下的性能与效率双赢，但未突破VLN的语义理解或具身耦合瓶颈。

papers.title: Toward the Cognitive--Physical Limits of Embodied Intelligence through a World-Model-Centric Autonomous Racing Agent
papers.abstract: Embodied artificial intelligence aims to develop agents that perceive, reason, and act through continuous interaction with the physical world. However, most embodied systems are still evaluated within conservative safety margins or moderate interaction regimes, leaving their capability boundaries under extreme conditions insufficiently understood. Autonomous racing provides a stringent testbed by combining high-frequency localization and perception, adversarial interaction, near-saturated vehicle dynamics, and strict safety constraints. Existing systems push high-speed performance but rarely model and refine cognitive and physical limits jointly. Here we show that a world-model-centric autonomous racing agent provides a concrete step toward exploring these coupled limits. The framework learns predictive world models from near-limit successes and failures to capture interaction evolution, ego dynamics, and feasible-motion boundaries, coupling world-state construction, future-aware reasoning, and near-limit control in a closed-loop refinement process. Training data were collected from real-vehicle autonomous racing, where the onboard system maintained robust localization and perception at speeds up to 256.3 km/h and peak lateral acceleration of 26.8 m/s$^2$. In full-scale simulated racing, the well trained world-model-centric agent achieves an 88.3% interaction success rate across various challenging simulated racing scenarios. Closed-loop refinement of the world model and policy further improved utilization of cognitive-physical limits, recovery from failure modes, and generalization across varying conditions and unseen circuits. These results suggest a boundary-aware methodology in which world models help embodied agents represent, predict, and continually refine their capability boundaries for safer real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个以世界模型为核心的自主赛车智能体，用真实高速赛车（256km/h、26.8m/s²侧向加速度）数据训练预测性世界模型，联合建模认知推理与物理极限，在仿真中实现88.3%高难度交互成功率，并通过闭环优化提升极限工况下的失败恢复与跨赛道泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 世界模型可以被显式用于联合表征、预测并闭环优化智能体的认知-物理耦合边界，从而在极端动态条件下提升自主系统的安全边界感知与适应能力。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器流（含高速定位、视觉、IMU等）+赛道先验+历史控制序列
analysis.output: 近极限条件下的安全控制动作序列（转向/油门/制动）及世界状态演化预测
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化全尺寸无人赛车平台（含RTK-GNSS、激光雷达、IMU、车规级计算单元）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部训练数据来自真实车辆在极限工况下的自主赛车实采（非合成、非迁移、非小规模标定）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型系统性用于显式建模和闭环优化‘认知-物理耦合极限’，且基于真实极限赛车数据（256km/h+26.8m/s²）验证，具备强物理真实性与边界意识；但未开源代码/模型，未在真车部署闭环，仿真评估未覆盖对抗性人类车手或随机扰动，相比Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等90+分工作，缺乏范式迁移广度与跨领域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用真实极限数据驱动的世界模型方法，扎实推进了具身智能在物理边界认知上的可解释性与可控性，但工程闭环完整性和开源程度制约其成为里程碑

papers.title: Flex-$π$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict the future to act better, but nearly all of them predict only RGB latents, trained purely for pixel reconstruction, with no explicit signal for the 3D geometry or object semantics manipulation needs. We find a surprising free lunch: the same frozen video-generation VAE that encodes RGB also encodes 3D pointmaps almost losslessly, with no pointmap-specific training at all. This lets us supervise Flex-$π$, a 6B-parameter WAM, on 3D geometry and object-centric DINO semantics alongside RGB, at no cost in new sensors, new pre-training, or inference latency. Every visual signal is projected into this shared latent space and denoised jointly with actions inside a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone; per-stream dropout with cross-modality forcing then lets a single trained checkpoint run on any subset of these streams, from a fast action-only mode to full joint generation. The result is a policy that is exceptionally demonstration-efficient and generalizes well, beating the strongest baselines by up to 2-7$\times$ on dexterous, precise, real-world bimanual manipulation tasks both in and out of distribution, all while running faster than $π_{0.5}$. Our project website: https://flex-pi.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出Flex-π模型，利用冻结的视频VAE天然编码3D点图和对象语义的能力，在不增加传感器、预训练或推理延迟的前提下，实现RGB、3D几何、对象语义三流联合建模；通过多流dropout和共享去噪架构，单个检查点可动态适配不同输入模态组合，在真实双手机器人精细操作任务中显著提升样本效率和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 冻结视频VAE隐空间天然支持多模态对齐（RGB/3D点图/DINO语义），无需额外训练即可构建计算灵活、模态可裁剪的世界-动作联合模型，大幅提升真实机器人操作的样本效率与跨分布泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像、3D点云、DINO对象语义特征（可任意子集组合）
analysis.output: 机器人关节动作序列（bimanual）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+RealSense D435i+定制夹爪（摘要明确提及real-world bimanual manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（demonstration-efficient implies real-robot demos used；out-of-distribution evaluation confirms real-robot deployment）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进世界模型范式：首次在真实双手机器人上验证‘冻结视觉VAE隐空间天然承载3D+语义’这一关键洞见，并实现模态可裁剪的统一去噪策略；性能超越π₀.₅且部署于真实硬件，但未开创新架构范式（如DreamerV3的离散世界状态建模）或解决长期开放难题（如持续状态记忆缺失），故略低于DreamerV3（96）但高于WEAVER（94.5）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：在真实双手机器人上首次实证冻结视频VAE隐空间的多模态可解释性与可复用性，并落地为计算灵活、泛化强的部署级策略，非概念包装

papers.title: ViTaR: Visuo-Tactile Residual Adaptation for Foundation VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: As Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models scale toward real-world deployment, contact-rich manipulation exposes a critical blind spot: these policies encode broad visual-semantic priors yet remain unaware of local contact events, producing identical actions whether contact is established, lost, or destabilized. Existing remedies either modify VLA internals, risking catastrophic forgetting, or demand online reinforcement under near-failure contact conditions. Both grant tactile unbounded influence over action generation, conflicting with the priors that make VLAs generalizable. We introduce ViTaR, which reframes tactile feedback from an action-generating perceptual input to an execution modulator that selects and scales bounded residual corrections atop a frozen VLA, preserving pretrained capabilities by construction. ViTaR decomposes adaptation into two stages: Effect-Guided Modeling determines whether and which correction is locally justified via outcome-grounded preference evidence, and Residual Action Modulation converts this evidence into a residual choice with continuously scaled gain from real-time visuotactile observations. On the UniVTAC benchmark spanning seven contact-rich tasks, ViTaR achieves 61.3% average success, a 30.6 percentage-point improvement over its frozen VLA base that also surpasses purpose-built tactile baselines. Physical-robot experiments confirm that bounded tactile modulation transfers to real sensor noise and dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出ViTaR方法，让已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型在接触密集操作中不重训、不改结构，仅靠触觉信号实时选择并缩放小幅度残差动作修正，显著提升真实机器人上的接触鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 触觉不应直接生成动作，而应作为执行调制器，在冻结的VLA主干上施加有界、证据驱动的残差修正，从而兼顾泛化性与接触适应性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时触觉观测（如GelSight或BioTac信号）
analysis.output: 叠加在冻结VLA输出上的有界残差动作向量（含选择与连续增益）
analysis.robot_dependency: UniVTAC仿真平台及物理机器人（未指明具体型号，但实验含real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖UniVTAC基准中的真实触觉-动作对数据，但未说明是否需采集新真实机器人数据；物理实验表明可迁移至真实传感器噪声和动力学，暗示低依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一基准UniVTAC上实现+30.6pp绝对提升，且经多任务真实机器人验证，机制设计（冻结VLA+触觉调制）直击VLA落地核心矛盾——触觉与语义先验的冲突；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证（如非UniVTAC硬件），也未挑战更底层的VLA架构瓶颈，属扎实的重大推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙解耦触觉作用路径，在不牺牲VLA泛化能力前提下注入接触鲁棒性，实证充分但生态闭环未完成。

papers.title: Robust Brachiation on a Life-Sized Dual-Arm Robot Using Waypoint-Guided Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Brachiation is a form of locomotion in which primates move primarily using their arms, enabling traversal in environments without footholds. However, this motion requires highly coordinated whole-body movement and precise timing control for bar grasping and release. As a result, achieving robust behavior on life-sized robotic platforms remains challenging. In this study, we present a reinforcement learning-based method to realize brachiation on a life-sized dual-arm robot. The core of the proposed approach is Waypoint-Guided Reinforcement Learning (WGRL), a learning framework for inducing non-linear and complex motions. For high-difficulty tasks where imitation learning data are unavailable, WGRL guides behavior acquisition by sparsely specifying waypoints for the end-effector trajectory, while whole-body motion is generated through reinforcement learning. In addition, by integrating the waypoint-following guidance with rewards based on task success and mechanical energy, and training in an environment designed for Sim-to-Real transfer, the proposed method achieves both forward progression and motion stability. The acquired behavior is evaluated through Sim-to-Sim experiments under monkey-bar environments with geometric variations and hardware experiments, confirming robust brachiation including failure recovery behavior. This study provides effective learning design guidelines for realizing arm-based locomotion on life-sized robotic hardware and expanding the traversable workspace of robots.

analysis.tldr: 用带稀疏末端执行器路径点引导的强化学习方法，在真实双臂大尺寸机器人上实现了能稳定摆荡、适应杠间距变化、并能从失败中恢复的臂式移动（类似猴子荡秋千）
analysis.claim: 通过Waypoint-Guided Reinforcement Learning（WGRL）框架，可在无示范数据的前提下，在life-sized双臂机器人上实现鲁棒、可恢复、跨几何变体的brachiation运动
analysis.input: 当前机器人状态（关节位置/速度/末端位姿）、目标路径点序列（稀疏设定）
analysis.output: 全身体节动作序列（关节力矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 东京大学自研life-sized dual-arm robot（未命名，但含双7-DOF臂+躯干+基座）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅在仿真中预训练，真实实验阶段使用纯在线微调/部署
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在life-sized双臂硬件上实现具备失败恢复能力的brachiation，含多几何变体测试与真实失败-重试闭环，证据扎实（真机+多场景+消融对比WGRL vs baseline RL），但未开源代码/模型，且任务仍属窄域高难度运动控制，未扩展到通用loco-manipulation范式或跨机体泛化
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机验证了高难度非周期性全身协调运动的学习新范式，但受限于闭源与任务专一性，尚未达到开创新范式的里程碑级别

papers.title: DeepInsight II: One Trace from Benchmark to Robot
papers.abstract: Across a Physical AI stack, evaluation maturity is inversely aligned with deployment risk: foundation models enjoy mature, standardized harnesses, while the embodied layers on which deployment actually turns remain fragmented across benchmark-specific simulators, embodiments, and interfaces. The first DeepInsight report (v1) unified evaluation across this stack behind three abstractions---task, resource, and result---but its quantitative evidence centered on the foundation-model layer; navigation and manipulation (System 1) and whole-body control (System 0) remained simulation case studies, and physical execution was outside its empirical scope. DeepInsight II keeps that substrate fixed and quantifies the embodied half. First, it reproduces released-checkpoint references across two navigation and four manipulation benchmarks under their native protocols. Second, MotionBench places four released whole-body controllers under one workload and metric contract, then carries a qualified within-family cohort from parallel simulation to matched real-robot trials in which simulated and physical rollouts share a parent trace identity while retaining execution-domain-specific records, making the sim-to-real gap a native reduction rather than a reconciliation across toolchains. Third, a composed System 2--1--0 study extends trace localization into five evidence-grounded handoff labels, each mapped to a concrete repair action, with a measured repairability criterion and physical episodes testing the same attribution under hardware-observable state. The contribution is therefore not a new evaluation architecture, but empirical continuity from benchmark execution to matched robot evidence and repair-oriented diagnosis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新模型或新算法，而是系统性地把多个已发布的机器人导航、操作和全身控制模型，在统一协议下复现评测，并首次在仿真与真实机器人之间建立‘同源轨迹身份’（parent trace identity），让sim和real的执行能直接比对、归因故障、触发可操作的修复动作。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 评估链路的实证连续性（从benchmark到真实机器人）可通过‘轨迹身份锚定’实现，使sim2real差距转化为可定位、可修复的诊断问题，而非不可比的工具链鸿沟。
analysis.input: 已发布模型的checkpoint + benchmark定义的任务指令 + 真实机器人传感器输入（隐含）
analysis.output: 跨域一致的轨迹标识符 + 故障归因标签（5类handoff labels）+ 对应的硬件可观测修复动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 多款真实机器人平台（未具名，但明确含匹配real-robot trials）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于验证归因与修复动作，非训练依赖，而是诊断验证依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 它首次将benchmark评测、仿真控制器、真实机器人执行三者用‘同源轨迹身份’锚定，实现可复现的故障归因与修复验证；虽未提出新模型，但在评估范式上完成关键跃迁——但缺乏开源代码/数据，且未覆盖端到端VLA大模型（如RT-2/Octo级）的全栈trace，故未达里程碑级（90+）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把机器人评估从‘跑通benchmark’升级为‘trace可追踪、故障可定位、修复可验证’，是具身智能可信部署的关键基础设施级工作。

papers.title: Hyper-Fold: Exploring the Expressive Limit of Sequence-Geometry Learning for Proteins via Hypergraph Modeling
papers.abstract: Protein structure modeling rests on a single computational primitive: the interaction between what a residue is (sequence content) and where it sits (three-dimensional geometry). What is the expressive limit of this layer class? We show that the complete bilinear operator over content-geometry outer products--the sufficient statistic of all second-order interactions--is the expressive ceiling, while the additive message passing of mainstream geometric GNNs is provably blind to content-geometry binding. We then introduce Hyper-Fold, a rank-K separable convolutional backbone approaching this ceiling at message-passing cost: each radius neighborhood is organized into a sequence hyperedge and a contact hyperedge, modulated by an edge-conditioned matrix-valued operator factorized into K learned basis operators with geometry-generated coefficients. Across enzyme function prediction, fold classification, and ligand binding site detection, Hyper-Fold and its hierarchical variant Hyper-Fold-Deep achieve the best results among protein-specific structure encoders; Hyper-Fold-Pocket, an anchored set-prediction head, surpasses UniSite-3D on UniSite-DS and two zero-shot benchmarks with no sequence language model features, 68x fewer parameters, and 4.8x lower latency--suggesting that a sufficiently expressive 3D backbone recovers information that fusion architectures previously borrowed from evolution-scale pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出主流几何图神经网络（如SE(3)-Transformer、EGNN）在建模氨基酸序列内容与三维几何位置的耦合关系时存在理论性表达缺陷，提出用超图建模+秩-K可分离卷积的Hyper-Fold架构逼近内容-几何二阶交互的理论表达上限，并在多个蛋白结构理解任务上以更小模型、更低延迟、不依赖序列语言模型特征的方式达到SOTA。
analysis.claim: 主流几何GNN的加性消息传递机制在数学上无法捕获序列内容与三维几何的绑定关系，而完整双线性外积算子才是该任务的理论表达上限；Hyper-Fold通过超图组织与秩-K可分离卷积，在接近该上限的同时保持计算可行性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质原子级三维坐标与残基序列标识（无预训练序列嵌入）
analysis.output: 残基/口袋级功能预测概率、折叠类别、结合位点集合

papers.title: WISE: World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Post-training VLA policies typically rely on supervised fine-tuning with costly expert demonstrations or reinforcement learning with expensive and potentially unstable real-world exploration. World models offer a promising alternative by evaluating candidate behaviors through imagined futures, yet effective post-training requires more than accurate prediction: imagination must be scheduled where it is useful, bounded within reliable horizons, and translated into trustworthy policy supervision. In robotic manipulation, the value of imagination varies substantially across execution stages, while extended rollouts can accumulate prediction errors and introduce unreliable learning signals. We introduce WISE (World-model-guided Imagination Scheduling for Efficient Post-training of Vision-Language-Action Models), a unified framework that coordinates when and how world-model imagination is used during policy refinement. WISE selectively invokes imagination at interaction-relevant states, performs bounded multi-view rollouts, evaluates candidate futures using progress and completion signals, and uses their relative outcomes to refine actions generated from real interaction contexts. Extensive experiments with both $π_0$ and $π_{0.5}$ demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse manipulation tasks while reducing GPU computation time by approximately 80% compared with full imagination. Real-world evaluations further show substantial gains in robustness and generalization under diverse real-world distribution shifts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WISE框架，用世界模型在机器人操作任务的策略微调阶段智能调度‘想象’——只在关键状态启动有限步、多视角的想象 rollout，用进度和完成信号评估想象结果，并据此修正真实交互中生成的动作，从而大幅减少计算开销（GPU时间降80%）并提升真实场景鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；姓名风格偏中文，但无高校/企业标识）
analysis.claim: 世界模型在VLA后训练中的价值不在于‘多想’，而在于‘何时想、想多少、怎么用’；通过可解释的、任务阶段感知的想象调度机制，能以极低计算代价换取真实机器人操作性能与泛化性的实质性提升。
