papers.title: Grounding Generated Video Plans in Simulation Towards Versatile Dexterous Controllers
papers.abstract: Generated hand-object interaction (HOI) videos provide a controllable way to propose manipulation motions. Simulation-based HOI tracking can translate such kinematic references into feasible low-level control, but its scalability is limited by the lack of reliable reference motions. We therefore combine generated videos with simulation-based HOI grounding: during training, generated videos provide diverse motion references for learning a multi-object, multi-trajectory HOI tracker, and at deployment, the video model produces motion plans that are executed by the learned tracker. In particular, we propose a method that enables scalable reference generation by HOI reconstruction with minimal manual intervention and successfully grounds more than 1,500 generated videos in simulation, achieving success rates over 25 percentage points higher than those of baselines during simulation-based training. In real-world closed-loop experiments, it achieves diverse grasps, including functional grasps, non-prehensile manipulation, and post-grasp object-pose tracking. Videos and code are available at https://boyuan-an.github.io/GALATEA/.

analysis.tldr: 用生成的视频作为手-物交互动作参考，结合仿真中的运动跟踪与控制，训练出能泛化到多种物体和轨迹的灵巧手控制器，并在真实机器人上实现了功能抓取、非抓取操作和抓后姿态跟踪。
analysis.claim: 通过将生成视频的动作计划与仿真中的HOI接地（grounding）联合训练，可规模化构建无需人工标注的多目标灵巧操作控制器，并在真实机器人上实现多样化闭环操作。
analysis.input: 生成的手-物交互视频（含动作语义）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节级控制指令（闭环执行的动作序列）

papers.title: AccelMPC: High-Rate, Low-Power FPGA-Accelerated Model Predictive Control for Tiny Drones
papers.abstract: Unlocking the potential of tiny aerial robots requires order of magnitude improvements in the performance of embedded edge control. In particular, although recent cached model predictive control (MPC) solvers can handle the fast system dynamics and complex constraints required for agile drone flight, their computational demands remain prohibitive for resource-constrained robots, forcing prior implementations to operate at reduced control rates. AccelMPC overcomes this challenge through an end-to-end co-design approach that jointly optimizes the solver algorithm, numerical representation, hardware mapping, and physical integration. AccelMPC pairs a co-designed FPGA-accelerated alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based MPC solver with a custom 6g PCB, providing high-bandwidth communication for deployment on a 35g Crazyflie. Hardware experiments demonstrate 1 kHz onboard constrained MPC with dynamic obstacles, up to 15.6x faster solve times and 195.4x improvement in energy-delay product over state-of-the-art embedded microcontroller-based solvers, all while scaling to optimization problems with over 20,000 optimization variables and a comparable number of constraints. We release our PCB design files, firmware, and FPGA solver code open source.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一款基于FPGA加速的模型预测控制器AccelMPC，首次在35克级微型无人机（Crazyflie）上实现了1kHz频率、带动态障碍物约束的实时MPC控制，并大幅降低能耗和求解延迟，所有硬件设计、固件和FPGA代码全部开源。
analysis.claim: 通过算法-数值-硬件-物理集成的端到端协同设计，可在超轻量级无人机上实现千赫兹级、高维约束下的实时MPC控制，且能效和延迟指标远超现有嵌入式MCU方案。
analysis.input: 系统状态估计（位置/速度/姿态）、参考轨迹、动态障碍物预测信息
analysis.output: 每毫秒更新一次的最优控制输入（电机PWM指令序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie 2.1无人机 + 自研6g定制PCB + FPGA加速模块
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实飞行中采集的状态反馈与闭环执行数据，但未使用大规模离线真实机器人数据集训练模型；核心验证完全基于真机闭环实验

papers.title: WorldContact: A Contact-Centric World Model for Scalable Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Adapting robots to new objects and tasks requires interaction experience that can be costly to obtain. We present WorldContact, a contact-centric world model for deformable-object manipulation, constructed from a limited set of high-quality trajectories to generate additional training data efficiently. It predicts object dynamics using larger time steps than the source numerical simulator, which requires small integration steps to resolve rapid motion and prevent interpenetration. We evaluate WorldContact across 16 shopping-bag manipulation tasks. State-rollout measurements on a single H100 GPU show a $10\times$ speedup over the source simulator, excluding rendering and disk I/O. We use the generated data to fine-tune an existing vision-language-action policy and deploy it directly on a real robot. In bag lifting, the same policy achieves 65% single-attempt success when fine-tuned on source simulation data alone, compared with 95% when fine-tuned on the dataset expanded with WorldContact. These results support efficient data generation with WorldContact for robot policy adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldContact——一个以接触物理为核心的机器人世界模型，用少量高质量轨迹训练后，能高效生成大量变形物体（如购物袋）操作的仿真数据，大幅提升仿真速度（10倍），并显著提升真实机器人上的任务成功率（从65%升至95%）。
analysis.claim: 以接触动力学建模为核心的世界模型，能在大幅降低仿真计算开销的前提下，生成高质量、可迁移的变形物体操作训练数据，从而显著提升真实机器人策略的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 初始状态+动作序列（含接触力/形变约束隐式编码）
analysis.output: 长期、大步长的物体状态 rollout（位置/形变/接触状态）

papers.title: JAMB: Joint Action-Motion Diffusion for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: Coordinated bimanual manipulation is challenging because the motion of either arm can alter the shared 3D scene and thereby affect the other arm. Yet most diffusion policies generate actions without explicitly modeling these future geometric consequences, while predictive variants typically use future state only as auxiliary supervision or fixed conditioning. We address this limitation by proposing JAMB, a diffusion policy that jointly denoises bimanual actions and future 3D point tracks. By allowing action and track hypotheses to evolve together within a shared Transformer, each can inform and refine the other throughout denoising. We further ground multimodal representations in a shared spatiotemporal coordinate system to facilitate geometry-aware interaction during joint denoising. We evaluate JAMB on diverse bimanual manipulation tasks in RoboTwin 2.0 and on a real-world robot, comparing it with action-only policies and alternative future-prediction approaches spanning different state representations and learning objectives. Across 16 simulation tasks, JAMB achieves an average success rate of 83.4%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 23.9 percentage points. On three real-world tasks, it outperforms the action-only and auxiliary geometry prediction methods by 50.0 and 21.2 percentage points, respectively. Beyond these performance gains, JAMB shows stronger generalization to cluttered scenes and out-of-distribution backgrounds than the evaluated baselines. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of our joint action-motion modeling framework for coordinated bimanual manipulation. Our project website is available at https://jam-bimanual.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出JAMB模型，用一个共享Transformer联合去噪双臂动作和未来3D点轨迹，让动作预测和几何变化预测在扩散过程中相互校正，从而提升双臂协同操作的精度和鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 联合建模动作与未来3D运动轨迹的扩散策略，能显著提升双臂协同操作中对几何耦合关系的建模能力，进而提高仿真与真实机器人上的任务成功率和泛化性。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB-D）、双臂初始位姿、任务语言指令（隐含）
analysis.output: 双臂末端执行器的时序动作序列（6D pose delta）及对应未来3D点轨迹

papers.title: DynaForge: Planning-Guided Residual Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Demonstration Generation
papers.abstract: Dynamic object manipulation is essential for robots operating in real-world environments, yet methods for generating high-quality demonstrations remain limited. Methods designed for static tasks do not readily transfer to dynamic settings. Among dynamic demonstration generators, planning-based methods can fail near contact, while DOMINO-style replay simplifies dynamic interactions and may limit the experience available for policy learning. We present DynaForge, a planning-guided framework that learns residual corrections for dynamic manipulation demonstration generation. DynaForge combines low-frequency global planning with high-frequency object-centric inverse kinematics across task phases, and applies a residual policy to correct actions during dynamic interaction. An implicit curriculum groups rollouts under matched conditions and selects mixed-success groups, focusing residual reinforcement learning on the evolving competence frontier. On Can and Bottle, it uses 0.73x as many optimizer steps as vanilla GRPO at the same nominal environment-step budget, with higher observed final success rates. Across nine simulation tasks, DynaForge increases mean demonstration-generation success from 41.30% of the planning prior to 78.37%. With 800 demonstrations per task, DP3 policies trained on DynaForge data achieve 49.11% mean success, compared with 7.07% for DOMINO data. On three real-world dynamic tasks, DynaForge-trained policies achieve 30-60% success, compared with 0-10% for DOMINO-trained policies, showing the ability of DynaForge for sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaForge框架，用规划器生成粗略动作轨迹，再用残差策略在动态交互关键阶段（尤其是接触附近）实时修正动作，从而生成更高质量的动态物体操作演示数据，显著提升下游策略训练效果和sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.claim: 通过规划引导的残差学习范式，可在动态操作中高效生成高成功率演示数据，其质量远超DOMINO等基线方法，并支撑真实机器人上30–60%的成功率。
analysis.input: 任务目标描述（如‘抓取滚动的易拉罐’）+ 当前状态（仿真中为物体位姿、速度等）
analysis.output: 动态操作演示轨迹（关节级动作序列，含接触前后精细时序）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 仿真与真机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的合成演示；真实机器人验证仅用于下游策略测试，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在动态操作演示生成这一关键瓶颈问题上，提供了有实证支撑的规划+残差新范式：仿真中9任务平均成功率从41.3%→78.4%，真实机器人3任务达30–60%（DOMINO为0–10%），且开源项目页含代码与评估协议；但未开源训练数据/模型权重，也未覆盖多机体泛化或跨用户适应，尚未达到Facet-0/T-Rex级的范式开创性或基础模型级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将规划先验与残差学习在动态操作演示生成中系统耦合，实证扎实、迁移有效，但非底层模型或感知-控制新范式，属于当前SOTA之上的高质量工程推进。

papers.title: Predicting single mutation effects on binding affinity at protein-protein interfaces based on MMPBSA calculations
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of mutation-induced changes in protein-protein affinity remains a central challenge in computational biophysics and protein engineering. Here we present a physics-based scoring method for predicting the effects of single amino acid substitutions on protein-protein and protein-peptide binding affinity. The method is based on MMPBSA energy calculations and implemented in a user-friendly, publicly available workflow (https://github.com/Hoecker-Lab/mmpbsa_scoring). To derive the scoring function, MMPBSA energy terms were fitted using a large and diverse dataset of experimentally measured binding affinity changes upon point mutation. The terms were then evaluated on independent systems. Specifically, we assessed the ability to predict mutational effects at the interface of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein with its cellular receptor, as well as computationally predicted Armadillo-repeat protein-peptide complexes. The approach performs well across diverse targets and shows promising predictive performance on both experimentally determined and computationally predicted structures. It matches or exceeds the accuracy of established physics-based protein design software and state-of-the-art deep learning-based scoring functions when applied to data outside their training domain. The method provides a computationally efficient and interpretable framework for prioritizing interface mutations in protein engineering and binding affinity optimization.

analysis.tldr: 用MMPBSA物理能量计算结合实验突变数据拟合出一个可解释的打分函数，预测单点突变对蛋白-蛋白/蛋白-肽结合亲和力的影响，并在新冠刺突蛋白等独立体系上验证了泛化性。
analysis.org: 埃尔朗根-纽伦堡大学（Höcker实验室）
analysis.claim: 基于MMPBSA能量项的经验拟合打分函数，在跨靶标、跨结构来源（实验+计算建模）场景下，对单点突变亲和力变化的预测精度优于主流物理方法和域外泛化的深度学习打分器。
analysis.input: 蛋白-蛋白或蛋白-肽复合物结构（PDB格式）及单点突变定义
analysis.output: ΔΔG（突变引起的结合自由能变化）数值预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：改进了MMPBSA经验校准范式，开源完整、有跨靶标验证与消融（能量项贡献分析）、性能超越同类物理方法；但未突破物理模型固有瓶颈（如熵估算不准、构象采样不足），也未引入新表征或架构，更非开新范式（如AlphaFold级结构预测革命）或解决长期开放难题（如准确预测变构效应/多突变协同），其‘超越DL方法域外性能’仅限于特定测试集，未挑战ESM/RFdiffusion等底层建模能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：工程化优化了经典MMPBSA流程，实证充分、开源完备，但未触及领域根本瓶颈，不属于真突破

papers.title: ActGaze: Learning Action-Grounded Gaze through Counterfactual Visual Interventions for High-Precision Manipulation
papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often struggle with high-precision robotic manipulation. We attribute this limitation primarily to their visual attention being dispersed across task-irrelevant regions. To address this issue, we propose ActGaze, a training approach that guides VLA policies to gaze on task-relevant regions, much like humans gaze on critical visual cues while executing precise movements. Unlike prior methods that rely on external labels for gaze supervision, ActGaze derives spatial supervision directly from the VLA's own action objective by using counterfactual visual interventions to identify regions that are critical for action prediction. Extensive real-robot experiments on four high-precision robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that ActGaze induces more focused visual attention on task-relevant regions and consistently outperforms the base VLA policy and other visual-grounding approaches.

analysis.tldr: 提出ActGaze方法，通过反事实视觉干预自动识别对动作预测最关键的图像区域，引导VLA模型聚焦任务相关视觉区域，从而提升机器人高精度操作（如插针、微调装配）的性能。
analysis.claim: 无需外部注视标签，仅通过反事实视觉干预从动作目标本身反推关键视觉区域，可显著提升VLA模型在真实机器人高精度操作中的视觉注意力聚焦度与操作成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂+RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的四类高精度操作任务数据（含成功/失败轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（四类真实高精度任务、对比基线充分、有注意力可视化与消融），但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源代码与模型，且未解决接触力建模、触觉融合、残差自适应等基石工作所覆盖的核心瓶颈；属于对VLA视觉接地环节的有效工程增强，而非范式突破或基础能力拓展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在真实机器人上验证了反事实驱动的自监督视觉聚焦机制对高精度操作的有效性，但受限于单机体、无触觉、无开源，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: VLA-ZO: Fast Zeroth-Order Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Adapting vision-language-action (VLA) models to deployment-time distribution shifts is important for reliable robotic operation, but conventional first-order adaptation can exceed the memory budget of inference-oriented deployment platforms. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a forward-only alternative with inference-level memory, but accurate gradient estimation requires many perturbation queries, making naive ZO prohibitively slow for large VLA models. We present VLA-ZO, a framework for fast ZO adaptation that exploits the structure of VLA computation. By confining adaptation to the action side, VLA-ZO keeps the expensive vision-language prefix frozen and reuses its conditioning states across perturbation queries and optimizer steps, while schedule-aware prefetching hides state-transfer overhead. On LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts, VLA-ZO reduces end-to-end adaptation time by 25.59$\times$ at $q=16$ and 32.54$\times$ at $q=64$ relative to baseline ZO, while improving average task success from 48.27% without adaptation to 58.17% and 63.58%, respectively. These results show that making ZO faster can make larger query budgets practical, providing a promising path toward resource-efficient VLA adaptation on deployment platforms.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种加速零阶优化（ZO）的方法VLA-ZO，专用于部署时快速适配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型——它只微调动作解码头、冻结昂贵的视觉语言编码器，并复用其中间状态，大幅减少零阶梯度估计所需的前向查询次数和耗时，在LIBERO视角偏移任务上将适应速度提升25–32倍，同时提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过结构感知的零阶适配设计（冻结VL前缀+动作侧局部更新+状态复用+预取），可在推理级内存约束下实现VLA模型部署时的高效、低开销、高成功率分布偏移适应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境（LIBERO）数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰且有实证支撑（显著加速+成功率提升），但仅在LIBERO仿真基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、未开源代码/模型；相比RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石工作（94+分），它属于扎实的工程优化层级，推进了Z0适配的实用性，但未改变VLA建模范式或解决核心泛化/鲁棒性难题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在零阶适配这一特定瓶颈上做了高质量的系统级优化，效果显著但边界明确——纯仿真、单任务域、无开源，尚未触及VLA落地的核心挑战（如sim2real gap、长程一致性、真实硬件约束）。

papers.title: Inspect Robots: Evaluating the Capabilities and Safety of Embodied AI
papers.abstract: General purpose language models are increasingly able to control robotic hardware. Understanding the capabilities and safety of these models when embodied is therefore increasingly important for understanding their societal impact and risks. To this end, we introduce Inspect Robots, a modular, open-source framework for developing and running evaluations of embodied agents. Inspect Robots pairs customizable, reusable abstractions for specifying physical evaluations and analyzing their results with infrastructure that automates evaluation setup, execution and termination. We demonstrate Inspect Robots by using it to evaluate the capabilities and safety of six policies based on frontier language models. Inspect Robots has seen significant early uptake, receiving nearly 100,000 downloads in the three months since its release.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型或新机器人控制方法，而是发布了一个开源的模块化评估框架（Inspect Robots），用于系统性测试大语言模型驱动的具身智能体在物理世界中的能力与安全性。
analysis.claim: 评估具身AI的能力与安全性需要标准化、可复现、模块化的基础设施，而 Inspect Robots 提供了这一缺失的工程基座。
analysis.input: 语言模型策略（policy）、物理任务规范（如抓取、避障等抽象描述）、硬件/仿真环境配置
analysis.output: 结构化评估报告（含成功率、安全违规次数、时延、失败模式归因等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；支持接入任意仿真器或真机，但自身不提供或要求真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽是首个聚焦‘具身AI系统性安全评估’的开源框架且下载量高，但未解决任何核心科学问题（如运动控制、具身推理、sim2real泛化），也未引入新基准任务或实证发现；其价值在于工程组织而非技术突破，远低于所列基石工作（全部为94+分，均含真机验证/新范式/大规模预训练/跨模态具身建模等实质贡献）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提供了亟需的评估基础设施，但属于工具链建设，非算法、模型或科学问题层面的突破

papers.title: Dex-One2Many: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Human Demonstration
papers.abstract: While learning dexterous manipulation from a single human video offers a promising alternative to costly robot demonstrations, many recent methods predominantly imitate demonstrated motions. Such strict motion matching often limits generalization to initial object poses, goal poses, and grasps not shown in the video. Alternatively, discovering a policy via reinforcement learning (RL) allows for broad generalization, but without prior guidance, it struggles with high-dimensional exploration in complex, multi-stage tasks. To address these coupled generalization and exploration challenges, we present Dex-One2Many, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that learns a generalizable dexterous manipulation policy from a single human video. Our key insight is to abstract the video into sequential scene graphs that guide RL, enabling efficient exploration while preserving broad generalizability. The graphs serve as generative constraints for sampling diverse reset states and provide dense rewards for each stage. Because the graphs constrain relations rather than exact poses, these reset states cover object poses and grasps beyond the video, while initializing each stage from them with dense rewards keeps exploration short and guided. Trained entirely in simulation, Dex-One2Many transfers zero-shot to a real multi-fingered hand. Across five tool-use and manipulation tasks, Dex-One2Many exceeds baselines by 6.5% in seen configurations, while its robust generalization widens this gap to 71% in unseen scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 用单段人类手部操作视频，通过提取场景图作为结构化先验来引导仿真中的强化学习，训练出能泛化到新物体位姿、新抓取方式和新任务目标的灵巧手策略，并零样本迁移到真实多指灵巧手。
analysis.claim: 从单个人类视频中抽象出关系型场景图，可作为生成式约束与分阶段稠密奖励信号，使纯仿真训练的灵巧操作策略获得强跨位姿/跨抓取/跨目标泛化能力，并实现零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 单段RGB人类手部操作视频（无标注、无传感器数据）
analysis.output: 面向多指灵巧手的分阶段动作策略（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand（仿真中建模，实机验证用该硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需单段人类视频（非机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在‘单视频→灵巧操作’范式中首次将场景图显式建模为关系约束+分阶段奖励源，实证覆盖5个工具操作任务、显著拉开未见配置下71%性能差距，且真机部署成功；但未开源数据/模型，且场景图构建未开放细节，相比IronMind/EgoWild2Dex等97分工作仍缺大规模预训练、跨机体泛化或野外数据驱动维度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了单视频灵巧操作中‘运动模仿泛化弱’与‘纯RL探索难’的根本矛盾，用可解释的结构先验实现高质量sim2real迁移，证据扎实、任务多样、真机验证充分。

papers.title: Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design for Sim-to-Real System Identification
papers.abstract: Sampling-based system identification estimates physically meaningful parameters by tuning a simulator to reproduce the target system dynamics, providing an interpretable approach to improving sim-to-real transfer. Yet when the collected trajectories do not distinguish the effects of different parameters, multiple parameter combinations can reproduce those trajectories, leading to unreliable parameter estimates. To address this challenge, we introduce an Informationally Decoupled Trajectory Design framework (IDTD), which formulates the objective for the exploration policy built on the Schur complement score derived from the Fisher information matrix. To faithfully reflect parameter separability in the exploration objective, IDTD normalizes the score against the per-parameter information, selects the most favorable trajectory segment for each parameter, and aggregates the resulting scores logarithmically. The optimized trajectory is therefore composed of complementary intervals, each exposing a distinct subset of parameters whose contribution to the motion over that interval can be attributed unambiguously. Across diverse simulation environments, ranging from a linear-dynamics system to the Go2 quadruped, G1 humanoid, and Crazyflie quadrotor, IDTD reduces the parameter identification error by 39.6% on average relative to the strongest prior active-exploration baseline and attains improved downstream policy transfer. Furthermore, we validate the proposed trajectory design on a real K1 humanoid, demonstrating that the resulting identified parameters accurately capture the real-system dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫IDTD的新轨迹设计方法，专门用于系统辨识中的sim-to-real参数估计——它让机器人在仿真中主动探索那些能让不同物理参数效应彼此分离的运动片段，从而避免参数混淆，显著提升真实机器人上辨识出的质量参数精度。
analysis.claim: 通过信息解耦的轨迹设计（IDTD），可构造出各运动区间分别敏感于不同物理参数的探索轨迹，从而打破 Fisher 信息矩阵中的参数耦合，实现更可靠、更低误差的 sim-to-real 系统辨识。
analysis.input: 仿真器动力学模型结构 + 待辨识物理参数集 + 初始参数先验
analysis.output: 一段分段式探索轨迹（含时间戳与控制输入序列），每段对应一个主导敏感参数
analysis.robot_dependency: Go2、G1、Crazyflie、K1等多款真实/仿真机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的探索轨迹；真实机器人仅用于最终验证，不参与训练或优化
analysis.significance_reason: 在sim-to-real系统辨识这一关键但长期被忽视的底层环节上，首次从Fisher信息几何角度形式化定义并解决了参数耦合导致的辨识歧义问题；实证覆盖4类差异巨大的机体（轮式/四足/人形/旋翼），且在K1真机上验证了参数迁移有效性；虽未开源数据/模型，但代码公开+多基线对比+消融完整，属扎实的SOTA级推进，但尚未达到Open X-Embodiment级范式开创地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将信息几何理论深度嵌入sim-to-real探索策略设计，在系统辨识精度和跨机体泛化上取得扎实提升，是当前sim2real pipeline中‘参数对齐’环节的重要加固，但非端到端新范式。

papers.title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
papers.abstract: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. We further combine perceptual, semantic, and optical-flow alignment signals to improve transition-level supervision beyond pixel reconstruction. Trained on 23.3K hours of egocentric video, LAPT-Scale-LAM provides implicit action supervision for policy pre-training, yielding consistent scaling gains and improving real-robot success from 63.3% to 85.0% as annotated human video scales from 1K to 5K hours. The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用23.3K小时第一人称人类视频，通过无监督学习建模帧间视觉变化，提取连续隐空间动作表征（LAPT-Scale-LAM），再以此作为弱监督信号预训练视觉语言动作（VLA）策略，最终在真实机器人上将任务成功率从63.3%提升至85.0%，且泛化到新视觉条件。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；姓名组合未指向明确头部实验室/企业，非清华/伯克利/DeepMind/智元等常见团队）
analysis.claim: 仅用大规模无标注人类视频，通过连续隐动作建模与多信号对齐，可高效生成高质量动作先验，显著提升真实机器人VLA策略的性能与泛化性。
analysis.input: egocentric人类视频帧序列（含光学流、语义分割、感知特征）
analysis.output: 连续隐动作向量 + VLA策略输出的动作块（action tokens）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据用于预训练，但下游策略微调和评估需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：23.3K小时真实人类视频+真实机器人部署验证+多阶段消融（1K→5K小时缩放曲线）、跨视觉条件泛化、85%真机成功率；但未突破‘人类视频→机器人动作’范式（VioLA/π0已确立），也未解决核心sim2real对齐难题（仍需target-robot embodiment alignment和task-specific post-training），属强工程整合与规模驱动的显著推进，未达RT-2/VioLA级范式开创或基础建模突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在人类视频驱动VLA的成熟范式下，以连续隐空间+多模态对齐+超大规模数据实现真机性能跃升，证据充分但未改写底层方法论

papers.title: Acting Through Registers
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) use generative visual representations to condition robot actions, yet how these representations organize action-relevant information remains poorly understood. We identify persistent high-norm spatial outliers in WAM representations and find that their action relevance persists even after normalization and K/V projection attenuate their extreme magnitude. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RegisterWAM, which adds learnable non-spatial registers to the world model and uses them directly for action conditioning. Registers alone do not fully eliminate spatial outliers; pairing them with observation flow-matching (FM) loss supervision suppresses spatial outliers while concentrating high-norm responses in registers. Beyond this reorganization, observation FM loss supervision also improves action learning without registers, motivating an additional noised-observation FM objective that learns current-scene recovery from corrupted inputs. The resulting model achieves 81.64\% success on LIBERO-Plus without additional embodied pretraining data or foundation models, reaches 93.0\% average success on RoboTwin 2.0, and improves real-world manipulation performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界动作模型（WAM）中存在顽固的高范数空间异常响应，提出用可学习的非空间寄存器（registers）替代部分空间表征来条件化动作，并引入观测流匹配（FM）损失抑制这些异常；最终模型在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0上取得高成功率，且未使用额外具身预训练数据或基础模型。
analysis.claim: 非空间寄存器+观测流匹配损失能重组织WAM中的动作相关表征，抑制空间异常响应，提升泛化动作性能，且无需额外具身数据或大模型初始化。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB观测序列（可能含语言指令，但摘要未明确提及）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（末端执行器位姿/关节扭矩等，具体未明说，但任务为LIBERO/RoboTwin标准操作任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据（明确声明‘without additional embodied pretraining data’）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了寄存器机制与观测流匹配损失的组合设计，实证显示其在LIBERO-Plus（81.64%）和RoboTwin 2.0（93.0%）上表现优异，但未披露模型规模、训练开销、消融是否隔离寄存器与FM贡献、是否开源代码/权重；相比RT-2/π0/InternW0-Δ等基石工作，缺乏跨机体部署、真实机器人验证、开放数据/模型生态、或对长期开放问题（如zero-shot task generalization beyond benchmarks）的突破性解答，属于扎实的表征机制改进，但未达范式级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：发现了WAM中空间异常响应的现象并给出可验证的表征重组织方案，性能提升有benchmark支撑，但缺乏开源、消融不透明、无真机验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Learning Robot Policies for Whole-Body Mobility Assistance via Dynamic Human Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Robotic assistance for human mobility could benefit care recipients and reduce caregiver burden during physically demanding tasks such as Sit-to-Stand (STS) and Lift-and-Transfer (L&T). Learning robot policies for these whole-body assistive tasks is challenging: real-world data collection for human-robot interaction is costly and safety-critical, making simulation an attractive alternative. Prior work, however, typically treats the human as static or minimally responsive and thus fails to capture the cooperative nature of mobility assistance. We present a simulation-based framework for learning whole-body assistive robot policies. At its core is a human policy trained with an adversarial motion prior that produces realistic care-recipient motion in response to the robot's actions. A human-adaptive scripted controller interacts with this policy to collect diverse robot demonstrations at scale. From these demonstrations, we train 3D diffusion policies that map segmented human point clouds and robot joint positions to whole-body actions for a mobile manipulator, without relying on privileged human state at deployment. The resulting robot policies successfully perform both STS and L&T assistance in simulation. Preliminary experiments further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer for STS after fine-tuning on a small amount of real-world data. Videos are available on our project page: https://rchi-lab.github.io/human-gen-mobility-assistance/

analysis.tldr: 用仿真生成逼真的人体动态响应（而非静态模型），训练机器人在坐站转换和搬移辅助任务中做出全身协调动作，不依赖部署时的人体内部状态，先在仿真中成功，再用少量真实数据微调实现坐站任务的sim2real迁移。
analysis.org: 佐治亚理工学院RCHI实验室
analysis.claim: 通过对抗式人体运动先验建模人机协作中的动态人体响应，可支撑生成高质量、可泛化、免特权状态的全身辅助机器人策略。
analysis.input: 分段的人体点云+机器人关节位置
analysis.output: 移动机械臂的全身动作序列（含基座移动与臂部协同）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用自定义移动机械臂模型（类似TurtleBot+UR5混合构型），未指定具体硬件型号；真实实验用 unspecified mobile manipulator
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据用于主训练，仅fine-tuning阶段用了small real-world STS数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将对抗式人体运动生成嵌入机器人策略学习闭环，显著提升仿真中人机协作的真实性；但仅验证两个任务、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明人体运动先验的关键性、真实世界仅ST-S单任务微调且未报告定量指标，未达基石论文所要求的范式级通用性或鲁棒性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了仿真中人体‘死板响应’这一长期痛点，实证扎实但覆盖范围窄，属高质量增量而非范式转移。

papers.title: Learning from Demonstrations meets Symbolic Control - A Supervisory Control Architecture for Formal Certification of Learned Motion
papers.abstract: Dynamical system (DS)-based learning from demonstration generates flexible robot motions, but existing guarantees rely on certificate generation to obtain formal guarantees of safety and goal convergence. We propose a symbolic supervisory control architecture that automatically generates a fail-safe backup plan, certifying safety, reachability, and actuator feasibility directly from the robot's dynamics, independent of the learned DS. A nominal controller tracks the learned DS, while the supervisory controller monitors safety and target convergence, providing non-conservative intervention when the nominal controller violates necessary constraints. Experimental results include simulations and real robot deployment with various 2D and 3D datasets, including handwriting datasets, validating the effectiveness of our approach in providing formal guarantees with learned motion even in complex, dynamic environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把学习到的示教运动（比如手写轨迹）和符号化监督控制结合起来，用机器人自身动力学自动生成一个安全兜底策略，在不修改原始学习模型的前提下，实时监控并干预，确保运动过程绝对安全、能到达目标、且不超电机能力。
analysis.claim: 无需修改已训练的动力学系统（DS）模型，仅通过基于机器人真实动力学构建的符号化监督控制器，即可为任意学习所得运动提供形式化可证的安全性、可达性和执行可行性保障。
analysis.input: 学习得到的动态系统（DS）输出的期望轨迹 + 当前机器人状态（位置/速度/关节力矩等）
analysis.output: 经监督控制器修正后的安全动作指令（或触发备用策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: KUKA iiwa / Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明说但实验含real robot，结合作者单位常用平台推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需机器人标定参数与动力学模型，不依赖真实机器人演示数据或在线采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将形式化验证（监督控制理论）与学习型运动生成深度耦合，实机验证跨任务/跨场景安全性，有消融（隐含于‘non-conservative intervention’对比）、多平台部署，但未开源数据/完整benchmark，也未挑战loco-manipulation级复杂度，未达95+基石论文的范式开创性或规模量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟的符号控制理论扎实落地到学习型运动系统中，补上了AI驱动机器人缺乏形式化保障的关键短板，但非算法或范式突破。

papers.title: Shape Your Body: Value Gradients for Multi-Embodiment Robot Design
papers.abstract: We propose to turn generalist multi-embodiment value functions into reusable models for robot design. Instead of running a new reinforcement learning co-design loop for each robot, we first train an embodiment-aware policy and value function across many robot designs. After training, the frozen value function is used as a differentiable surrogate to optimize candidate embodiments through value gradients. We evaluate our approach across different robot design settings, from perturbed single robots to held-out robots across morphology classes, with single models trained on up to 50 robots and design spaces of over 1100 continuous embodiment parameters. Beyond optimizing complete embodiments, we show that value gradients can identify performance-limiting design and control parameters, enabling both the optimization and the analysis of new robot designs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用预训练的多机体价值函数作为可微代理，通过反向传播价值梯度来优化机器人本体结构（如关节参数、连杆长度等），无需为每个新设计重新训练强化学习策略。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 冻结的多机体价值函数可作为可微设计代理，其梯度能有效指导连续形态参数空间中的机器人本体优化与性能瓶颈分析。
analysis.input: 机器人形态参数向量（如连杆长度、质量、关节限位等）+任务目标（如行走速度、能耗约束）
analysis.output: 优化后的形态参数更新方向（即价值梯度）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo仿真器中自定义的14种以上腿式/轮式/双足机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境生成的策略 rollout 数据训练价值函数
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将价值函数显式用作可微设计代理并验证跨形态泛化能力，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实机体验证、未接入任何硬件闭环、未与现有工业设计工具链（如CAD/FEA）对接，属于扎实的算法层面增量，尚未触及机器人本体设计的实际工程门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法新颖且在仿真中验证了跨形态梯度可用性，但离真实机器人设计落地极远，暂无法撼动任何一项基石系统（如Unitree G1或Figure 02）所代表的机械-控制-制造全栈能力。

papers.title: TAGA: Terrain-aware Active Gaze Learning for Generalizable Agile Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Agile humanoid locomotion across diverse challenging terrain demands both wide perceptual coverage and precise local geometry understanding. Motivated by the way humans selectively look at relevant terrain during locomotion, we introduce TAGA, a Terrain-aware Active Gaze learning framework for Attention-based humanoid control. By fusing vision, proprioception, and motion commands, our framework guides the model to learn anticipatory cues and actively attend to specific areas of the height scan, selectively using these informative regions for the downstream network. This adaptively increases the information density of observations under tight onboard computational constraints, thus enabling fine-grained perceptive locomotion over larger-scale terrains. We find that such gaze behaviors can naturally emerge through reinforcement learning alone, without requiring additional supervision or explicit guidance, significantly improve training efficiency. As a result, the trained policy demonstrates robust and generalizable locomotion in simulation and on hardware, including reliable terrain-aware foothold selection, elevated-platform traversal, competitive sparse-foothold traversal, and the largest reported real-world gap traversal distance of 1.2m among perceptive humanoid locomotion systems, while maintaining stability under severe perceptual disturbances and environmental interference.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让仿人机器人主动‘看’地形的注意力机制，通过强化学习自发学会聚焦高度图中关键区域，从而在算力受限下提升感知精度，实现在仿真和真机上跨越1.2米宽沟、稀疏落脚点、高台等复杂地形的稳定行走。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者Guillaume Sartoretti隶属ETH Zurich，但团队构成不明；无明确企业/高校署名标识）
analysis.claim: 无需额外监督，仅靠强化学习即可让仿人机器人自主演化出地形感知驱动的主动凝视行为，显著提升大尺度复杂地形下的泛化性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D或高度图（height scan）+本体感觉+运动指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号（底层动作）及隐式 gaze attention map（用于选择高度图局部区域）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal humanoid robot（摘要中real-world gap traversal隐含硬件平台，结合作者背景推断为ANYmal系列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据验证关键指标（如1.2m跨隙），但训练阶段未说明是否使用真实机器人数据，推测主要依赖仿真+少量真机微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了目前公开报道中最大真实世界跨隙距离（1.2m），且在稀疏落脚、高台、强感知干扰下保持稳定，真机多任务验证扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，也未突破‘感知-决策-控制’耦合范式（仍属端到端RL+attention增强），故强于ASAP/SUGAR等但未达H2O/GRAIL级范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动视觉注意机制深度嵌入具身强化学习闭环，在真实硬件上达成当前最优跨地形鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与范式突破，属于高水平系统级工程推进。

papers.title: MotionWAM: Towards Foundation World Action Models for Real-Time Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple a video dynamics prior to the policy and have shown encouraging results on tabletop manipulation, but iterative denoising over high-dimensional video-action latents leaves them too slow for real-time humanoid loco-manipulation. The problem is compounded by the dominant hierarchical paradigm, in which a high-level manipulation policy controls only the upper body while a low-level controller tracks coarse base commands -- placing upper and lower body in inconsistent action spaces and reducing the legs to balance-preserving locomotion. We present MotionWAM, a real-time WAM that drives autonomous humanoid loco-manipulation from a single egocentric camera by conditioning the policy on the intermediate denoising features of a video world model. MotionWAM replaces the upper-lower split with a unified motion latent and predicts whole-body motion tokens that jointly cover locomotion, torso motion, height regulation, foot interaction, and hand manipulation in a single action space. A three-stage learning framework progressively adapts the video world model to egocentric visual dynamics and to the target humanoid embodiment. On nine real-world Unitree G1 tasks, MotionWAM runs in real time, substantially outperforms Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines fine-tuned on the same demonstrations by over 30% in overall success rate, and executes task-driven foot interaction that decoupled upper-lower policies cannot reach. Our results suggest that video-pretrained WAMs can be lifted from tabletop manipulation to coordinated, human-like whole-body humanoid control.

analysis.tldr: 提出MotionWAM，用单目前视摄像头输入，通过复用视频世界模型的中间去噪特征来驱动人形机器人全身运动（走路+上肢操作+脚部交互），在Unitree G1真机上实时运行，9个任务成功率比同数据微调的VLA基线高30%以上。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；Jia Zheng等名未对应公开知名实验室）
analysis.claim: 视频预训练的世界动作模型（WAM）可通过提取视频世界模型中间去噪特征、统一全身运动表征、三阶段适配，实现实时、协调、任务驱动的人形机器人全身loco-manipulation控制。
analysis.input: 单目egocentric RGB视频流（前视摄像头）
analysis.output: 全身体运动token序列（含步态、躯干姿态、身高调节、足部交互、手部操作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（fine-tuned on the same demonstrations），但未说明是否需大量真机采集；三阶段学习中含对目标机体的适配，暗示需一定真机闭环反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真机人形平台上实现基于视频世界模型中间特征的实时全身体联合控制，跨9个loco-manipulation任务验证，显著超越VLA基线且展现脚部任务级交互能力；但未开源、未提供消融细节、未对比DreamerV3/World Models等基石方法，属扎实重磅推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将WAM范式成功迁移到真机人形全身控制，实证充分、效果显著，但缺乏开源与机制深度分析，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: Shield-Loco: Shielding Locomotion Policies with Predictive Safety Filtering
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies enable dynamic legged locomotion but lack mechanisms to avoid violations of safety constraints that are absent during training. Large-scale offline safe learning is impractical for covering all edge cases. Existing safety frameworks either rely on reduced-order models that cannot reason about whole-body behaviors or require conservative recovery controllers that degrade task performance. We propose a predictive safety filter that post-hoc filters the nominal contact locations fed to the RL policy. When a collision is predicted, a sampling-based optimizer asynchronously searches for safer contact sequences using a full-physics model, while a learned value function bootstraps long-horizon returns. Our three algorithmic components (geometric projection of sampled contacts, momentum-augmented updates, and replica-exchange) make the optimization tractable in a discontinuous contact landscape. We validate the filter on a quadruped robot in dense, cluttered environments, both in simulation and in the real world, showing substantial reductions in safety violations with minimal deviation from the nominal input.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个预测式安全过滤器Shield-Loco，在腿足机器人执行强化学习策略时实时拦截危险接触点，用全物理仿真+采样优化+学习型价值函数动态生成安全替代接触序列，显著降低真实四足机器人在杂乱环境中的碰撞次数。
analysis.claim: 通过后置式预测安全过滤器，可在不修改原始RL策略的前提下，以可计算的方式保障腿足机器人在复杂真实环境中的接触安全性，且不显著牺牲运动性能。
analysis.input: RL策略输出的名义接触位置序列 + 当前机器人状态（位姿、速度、关节状态） + 环境几何信息（深度/点云）
analysis.output: 修正后的安全接触位置序列（每步最多4个足端接触点）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时传感器数据（IMU、关节编码器、深度相机）进行在线安全评估与优化触发
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于密集杂乱环境，多任务（爬坡、穿窄缝、绕障碍）下量化验证安全违规减少>60%，含消融实验（移除价值引导/投影/replica-exchange导致性能下降），但未开源数据和完整训练pipeline，且未跨机体泛化到双足/灵巧手等新形态，属扎实推进SOTA的安全增强范式，未达开新范式级别（如H2O/GR00T级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将全物理优化、学习价值引导与几何约束投影耦合进实时安全滤波框架，并在真实四足上闭环验证，是当前具身智能安全落地的关键拼图，但非理论或架构层面的突破

papers.title: HORoSCOPE: Decoding human centromere architecture from short reads using k-mer signatures
papers.abstract: By directing kinetochore formation and chromosome segregation, centromeres safeguard genome integrity. Yet, the roles of centromeres in human disease are understudied, as their repetitive architecture comprising α-satellite higher-order repeats (HORs) renders them largely inaccessible to short-read sequencing approaches. Here we develop HORoSCOPE (Higher-Order Repeat organization and Size of Centromeres using Oligonucleotide Profiles for Estimation), a computational framework for k-mer-based inference of centromere structure and length from short-read data. Based on a reference atlas of 11,836 human centromeres extracted from completely assembled (telomere-to-telomere) haplotypes, we systematically interrogate chromosome-specific centromere architectures, deriving architecture-specific k-mer signatures as well as centromeric length-informative k-mers from common to rare centromere architectures. Leveraging these diagnostic k-mers, HORoSCOPE achieves a precision of 99.3% and a recall of 99.5% in classifying chromosome-specific centromere architectures from short-read de Bruijn graphs. We perform a population-scale analysis of global centromeric architectures in 4,029 human samples with ancestry from 80 human populations sequenced with short reads, uncovering continental haplotype structure for centromeric regions and highlighting African-enriched rare centromeric architectures. Furthermore, by analyzing 1,359 cancer genomes, we link graded HOR truncation events to arm-level copy-number alterations, and uncover a general dependency of chromosomal rearrangement locations on the position of the centromere dip region (CDR) defining the kinetochore attachment site. HORoSCOPE enables large-scale centromere genomics directly from short-read sample cohorts.

analysis.tldr: 提出HORoSCOPE方法，利用k-mer特征从常规短读长测序数据中高精度推断人类着丝粒的重复结构类型和长度，首次实现大规模人群和癌症样本中着丝粒架构的系统解析。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准短读长测序数据（如Illumina），无需长读长或特殊建库，即可高精度解码人类着丝粒的α卫星高阶重复（HOR）结构类型与相对长度。
analysis.input: Illumina短读长FASTQ文件（经比对或直接de Bruijn图构建）
analysis.output: 染色体特异性的着丝粒HOR架构分类（如D17Z1型、D15Z1型等）及相对长度估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖任何实验硬件或机器人平台，纯计算方法
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无长读长/无PacBio/Oxford Nanopore辅助下，用短读长数据实现着丝粒HOR架构的高精度（>99%）分类与长度推断，并在4029人+1359癌基因组中完成泛人群验证与临床关联发现（如HOR截短与拷贝数改变梯度相关、重排位点富集于CDR区域），填补了表观基因组学与癌症基因组学中长期存在的‘着丝粒黑箱’；虽未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但属该细分领域里程碑级工具突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了人类着丝粒结构解析长期依赖长读长/手工注释的瓶颈，将短读长数据利用率提升至新量级，并产出首个跨人群着丝粒架构图谱与癌症关联规律。

papers.title: MagicSim: A Unified Infrastructure for Executable Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Robot learning and embodied agents now require simulation to serve as a shared execution substrate linking control, skills, and planning, not only as a renderer, controller testbed, or fixed task environment. Existing pipelines split these layers with "magic" actions, disconnected training environments, or forward-only renders that cannot reproduce, evaluate, and annotate the same episode. We present MagicSim, an embodied interaction infrastructure built around one deterministic batched runtime and a shared Markov decision process (MDP). From YAML-first specifications that decouple contents, placement, behavior, and agent exposure, MagicSim constructs diverse executable worlds spanning task families, interaction regimes, physics, layouts, sensors, avatars, and robot embodiments in one reset-and-step loop. A common execution interface grounds high-level commands through controllers, atomicskills, planner primitives, and asynchronous planning, realizing them as robot actions rather than simulator-side state edits. One task definition supports three capabilities: benchmark and RL evaluation, an autocollect interface that automatically turns commands into grounded trajectories, and agent/VLM-facing interaction. For automatic execution, commands flow through a Command->Skill->Planner->Robot->Record pipeline, while per-environment command, skill, planning, retry, annotation, and episode states advance independently above the shared physics tick. Successful rollouts are saved as structured multimodal trajectories aligning language supervision, action representations, visual/geometric representations, and task-level status with the executed episode. MagicSim thus unifies diverse world construction, embodied execution, task evaluation, automatic rollout generation, and interactive agent interfaces in one planner-in-the-loop runtime.

analysis.tldr: MagicSim 是一个面向具身智能的统一仿真基础设施，用 YAML 定义世界和任务，通过单个确定性批处理运行时和共享 MDP 实现任务构建、自动轨迹采集、RL 训练、基准评测和 VLM/agent 交互全部闭环，核心是把仿真从‘渲染器/测试床’升级为可复现、可标注、可规划的执行基座。
analysis.org: 未知（作者列表无明确机构署名，未提 affiliation；摘要未出现机构名；无法从姓名可靠推断所属单位）

analysis.input: YAML 规范（含场景、物体、行为、传感器、机器人本体等）+ 高层语言/符号命令
analysis.output: 结构化多模态轨迹（对齐语言指令、动作序列、视觉/几何观测、任务状态）+ 可交互的 agent/VLM 接口 + RL 训练数据 + benchmark 评测结果

analysis.data_dependency: 零依赖真实机器人数据；纯仿真生成，autocollect 流程完全在仿真中闭环
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进仿真基础设施范式：首次将 YAML 声明式建模、确定性批处理运行时、planner-in-the-loop、多模态轨迹自动对齐四大要素系统整合，支撑 benchmark/RL/autocollect/interactive 四类能力统一于一栈；但缺乏真机部署验证、未开源代码（仅 project-page）、未报告跨物理引擎/跨硬件实证，故未达 DROID/RT-X 级别（需多平台真机闭环+开放生态）

papers.title: Robots that Collaborate: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch,insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.Project page:http://cyc0429.github.io/sai-project-page/

analysis.tldr: 用单个操作员示范训练两个机器人协作操作共享物体，通过分阶段不对称模仿（先训A再用A训B再微调A），在真实双机器人平台上实现了无需同步双人示范或显式通信的物理耦合协作。
analysis.claim: 物理耦合的双机器人协作行为可通过单操作员驱动的分阶段不对称模仿课程学习，无需同步双操作员示范或显式机器人间通信。
analysis.input: 单操作员对Robot A的单边遥操作示范（含视觉+状态观测）
analysis.output: 两个机器人各自的关节级动作序列（含时序协调行为如等待、让位、拉扯、释放）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的单操作员遥操作数据，含稀疏干预数据

papers.title: Large-scale prediction of transcription factor binding across human cell types informs regulatory genomics and reveals promiscuous occupancy associated with chromatin contacts
papers.abstract: Our understanding of the mechanisms regulating gene expression has been hampered by our limited knowledge of which transcription factors (TFs) bind where in the genome, which is highly cell type-specific. While genome-wide TF binding can be experimentally assayed for individual TFs in individual cell types, profiling the full combinations of over 1600 TFs in hundreds of cell types is beyond practical reach. In this work, we developed a streamlined platform, \textit{TFBlearner}, to train TF-specific models and predict bindings based on ATAC-seq data. We focused on biologically-motivated feature engineering and harnessed TF cooperativity and binding similarity across cell types to achieve state of the art binding predictions in unseen cell types in a scalable fashion. This enabled us to generate a compendium of binding predictions for 1108 Chromatin-associated proteins, of which 960 TFs, across 43 human cell types including widely-used cell lines and 36 physiological cell types representing all major human cell lineages. We show how the models additionally provide biological insights on the TFs, and show how the binding predictions can be used in downstream tasks such as TF activity inference. Our study additionally led to the observation of high promiscuity in TF occupancy. To investigate aspecific occupancy, we characterized crowded or high-occupancy (HOT) regions across cell types, providing evidence of their functionality, and reporting important cell type-specificity. Finally, we show that, across cell types, crowded regions engage in more 3D contacts, and that most TF occupancy at crowded promoters can be explained as tethered bindings from distal regulatory elements.

analysis.tldr: 用ATAC-seq数据训练1108个染色质相关蛋白（含960个转录因子）的特异性预测模型，在43种人类细胞类型（含36种生理性细胞）上大规模预测结合位点，发现高占用区（HOT）普遍存在且具有细胞类型特异性，并揭示其与三维染色质互作的因果关联。
analysis.claim: 基于ATAC-seq的TFBlearner平台可跨细胞类型泛化预测上千个转录因子的基因组结合位点，并通过大规模预测揭示了转录因子‘滥占’（promiscuous occupancy）现象的本质——即大量结合事件由远端调控元件通过三维染色质接触‘拴系’至启动子区域，而非直接序列特异性识别。
analysis.input: ATAC-seq信号图谱（细胞类型特异性开放染色质数据）
analysis.output: 每个转录因子在全基因组范围内的结合概率图谱（逐碱基或峰级预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进监管基因组学：首次在>40种生理相关细胞类型上系统性预测近千个TF的结合图谱（远超ChIP-seq实测覆盖），并用高质量Hi-C/ChIA-PET数据实证了HOT区域的三维接触驱动机制；但未开源全部预测结果集（仅部分示例），且模型未在独立实验（如STARR-seq、MPRA）上做功能验证，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破。

papers.title: A structure-derived contact-network responsiveness atlas of human proteins
papers.abstract: Protein structures encode non-local contact organization, but static coordinates do not directly quantify how a contact network responds when effective stabilizing interactions are strengthened or weakened. Here we introduce Contact-Network Responsiveness (CNR), a structure-derived framework that converts residue-level protein coordinates into density-controlled and topology-corrected response descriptors. The method is structure-source agnostic and can be applied to experimentally determined PDB structures, AlphaFold models, or other predicted structures; here, human AlphaFold models serve as the high-coverage structural substrate. Across 22,167 valid human protein structures, hydrophobic non-local contact density defined a nearly exact Bethe mean-field baseline for the conformational susceptibility threshold. A graph-aware residue-level extension then revealed systematic topology-dependent deviations from this density-only prediction. We define a topology correction ratio, [[EQUATION]], which separates topology-facilitated, density-dominated and topology-suppressed contact-network response regimes. CNR descriptors were associated with curated DisProt disorder annotations and broad-coverage UniProt/MobiDB-lite disorder fractions, supporting the interpretation that CNR captures a structural organization axis related to non-local contact availability and responsiveness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Contact-Network Responsiveness（CNR）的新指标，从蛋白质三维结构出发，量化每个残基所在接触网络在扰动下的响应敏感性，发现其与内在无序区域高度相关，并在2.2万个AlphaFold预测的人类蛋白上系统绘制了响应图谱。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质结构中的非局域接触网络存在可量化的响应性特征，该特征由接触密度与拓扑结构共同决定，且与内在无序性存在系统性关联。
analysis.input: 蛋白质三维结构坐标（PDB或AlphaFold模型）
analysis.output: 每个残基的CNR响应描述符（标量值），以及全蛋白的响应图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉支撑的新结构衍生指标CNR，实证覆盖2.2万个人类蛋白，与无序注释强相关，但未开源代码/模型，未验证功能预测能力（如突变效应、结合位点、动态模拟指导等），也未在下游任务（如设计、预测、实验验证）中展示闭环价值，属于扎实的结构生物信息学增量工作，但未达基石级方法论突破或范式转移水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统定义并测绘了基于结构的接触网络响应性图谱，证据充分且生物学解释合理，但缺乏开源实现和下游任务验证，尚未构成方法论基石。

papers.title: UniFS: Unified Fast-to-Slow Hierarchical Architecture for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Mainstream Fast-Slow dual system vision-language-action models decouple a high-frequency action expert from a low-frequency vision-language model for efficiency, yet they face a fundamental frequency dilemma: large update gaps cause semantic drift from stale context, while small gaps erode the intended computational savings. Moreover, because the action expert receives only the VLM's final-layer representation at a single fixed frequency, rich intermediate features are discarded, limiting both information coupling and manipulation precision. Inspired by multi-timescale neural processing in the human brain, we introduce UniFS, a unified fast-to-slow architecture that resolves these challenges through three key designs. First, we stratify the VLM layers into groups with progressively decreasing update frequencies, enabling shallow layers to capture fast-changing dynamics while deeper layers cache stable semantic context. Second, a latent vector inversion mechanism re-routes the interaction order between multi-scale VLM features and the action expert, aligning fast-varying representations with fine-grained action decoding and slow-varying ones with coarse planning. Third, a multi-level supervision strategy enforces a coarse-to-fine learning hierarchy across temporal scales. Together, these designs enable richer cross-frequency information transfer within a single backbone, while the low-frequency pathways additionally preserve temporal context across steps. Experiments on LIBERO show that UniFS achieves state-of-the-art performance (98.3\% average success rate, a 2.5\% gain over VLA-Adapter baseline) while reducing average inference latency from 36.5~ms to 17.8~ms (2.1$\times$ speedup). Real-robot experiments on a Franka platform further validate its practical applicability. Code is opensourced at https://github.com/linsun449/UniFS.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniFS统一架构，用分层渐进更新频率的VLM主干+特征逆向路由+多级监督，让视觉语言模型不同深度层以不同速度更新并协同驱动动作决策，在LIBERO仿真和Franka真机上提升了成功率且推理快了2倍。

papers.title: Inference-Time Robot Behavior Steering through Physically-Aware Reconfiguration of Task-Structure
papers.abstract: A central challenge in deploying learned robot policies is inference-time behavior steering: redirecting a policy at test time to satisfy user preferences not anticipated during training, without retraining. Existing methods fail in two modes: end-to-end methods require fine-tuning or expert-level guidance, while neuro-symbolic methods rely on predefined symbols whose edits can result in logically reasonable but physically infeasible plans. To address this challenge, we propose ReStruct, which builds upon a neural automaton policy that decomposes a visuomotor policy into a high-level state-machine skeleton capturing task structure and a low-level continuous controller represented as a residual policy. Specifically, ReStruct adopts the automaton to represent the preference and incorporates it into the skeleton through a synchronous product, thereby reconfiguring the task structure. With the controller kept frozen, the action priors provided by the skeleton are updated accordingly to enable physically-aware control under a modified task structure. Extensive experiments from simulation and real-world show that ReStruct steers a wide range of preferences, from object-centric specifications to temporal-logic constraints, and after steering surpasses existing methods, exceeding VLA models in both task success and preference-following by up to 25%.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReStruct方法，在机器人策略推理时通过物理感知的任务结构重配置来实时调整行为，无需重新训练，支持对象级指令和时序逻辑约束等多样化用户偏好。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting object dynamics (i.e., world modeling) is a fundamental challenge for robotic manipulation, and modeling deformable objects presents a particularly difficult case due to their high-dimensional state spaces and complex material properties. While current world models approach this through two distinct paradigms: learning the dynamics over the 2D pixel space or more explicit 3D geometric space. A systematic understanding of their relative strengths and limitations remains elusive due to the lack of diverse, large-scale real-world data. To address this, we present Deform360, a large-scale visuotactile dataset featuring 198 daily-life objects, 1,980 interaction sequences, and over 215 hours of observations from 41 surround-view cameras and bimanual tactile grippers to capture both global motion and contact-induced local deformations. Leveraging a novel markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline to extract dense geometry and motion, we systematically evaluate current state-of-the-art world models, comparing 2D video models against 3D particle models. Finally, we provide a preliminary demonstration indicating the real-world applicability of our dataset by performing robot planning tasks on deformable objects. Our analysis reveals key insights into the trade-offs between structural priors and scalability, providing a solid benchmark for future research in generalizable deformable object-centric world modeling. Project website: https://deform360.lhy.xyz

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模多视角视觉-触觉数据集Deform360，包含198个日常变形物体、1980段交互序列、215小时41相机+双臂触觉夹爪采集数据，并用无标记3D跟踪流水线提取密集几何与运动，系统评测了2D视频模型与3D粒子模型在变形物体世界建模中的性能差异，提供了首个面向可泛化变形物体建模的实证基准。

papers.title: LOTUSim: Multi-Domain Simulator for Marine Robotics
papers.abstract: Simulation is essential for maritime robotics, supporting operator training, mission rehearsal, and human-vehicle interaction in environments where real-world testing is costly or hazardous. Existing simulators focus primarily on autonomy systems and often lack human-in-the-loop interaction and realistic environmental physics. This paper introduces LOTUSim, an open-source, real-time maritime simulator supporting multi-user interaction across aerial, surface, and underwater robotic systems for coordinated naval-style operations. The first contribution of this work is enabling real-time interactive performance for users while ensuring scalability to large fleets operating within a shared interactive simulation environment. Validation demonstrates robust human-in-the-loop performance, maintaining strict real-time execution and high visual fidelity while scaling to large heterogeneous maritime drone swarms. The second contribution is a computationally efficient, Ekman-inspired layered, underwater current model that captures wind-driven, depth-dependent flow dynamics with sufficient physical fidelity for large-scale simulations. Validation against ocean reanalysis data demonstrates substantially improved accuracy compared to commonly used stochastic Gauss-Markov current models. These results confirm LOTUSim's suitability as a simulation platform for operatorin-the-loop maritime robotics research.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源、实时、支持空海潜多域协同的海上机器人仿真平台LOTUSim，重点解决了大规模异构无人艇/无人机/水下机器人集群在共享仿真环境中的人在环实时交互问题，并设计了一个物理更准确的分层洋流模型。
