papers.title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Mean What They Say? On the Role of Faithfulness in Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract: Embodied Chain-of-Thought has emerged as a promising mechanism to enhance robot decision-making and interpretability in black-box Vision-Language Action (VLA) models. However, whether this verbalized Chain-of-Thought truthfully reflects the policy's underlying decision process remains poorly understood. We distinguish between functional reasoning, in which reasoning improves task performance, and faithful reasoning, in which reasoning truly reflects the policy's internal decision process. We argue that SoTA alignment strategies offer a necessary but insufficient notion of faithfulness, admitting reasoning whose intermediate steps can mask the causal links in action prediction through confounding factors (e.g., reasoning that is ungrounded in the environment and internally disconnected or inconsistent), restricting policy generalization. We study this gap through a human evaluation of a SoTA reasoning model for autonomous driving, revealing an inconsistent coupling between reasoning quality and downstream trajectory improvement. We then operationalize a behavioral surrogate for embodied faithfulness through a learned critic, Pinocchio, scoring observation grounding and stepwise coherence, and use this critic as a dense reward signal in post-training an embodied policy with reinforcement learning. Across withheld driving benchmarks, our post-trained planner improves faithfulness by 4% and 18% over SoTA alignment and trajectory error post-training baselines, respectively, while maintaining competitive downstream task performance. Finally, on a synthetic out-of-distribution test set, post-training for faithfulness improves policy responsiveness to rare counterfactual scenarios by 1.6x that of a SoTA policy, suggesting that faithful reasoning traces contribute to more robust, generalizable, and interpretable embodied intelligence. Project page: https://mjf-su.github.io/pinocchio/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前具身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成的‘思维链’推理文本常常不真实反映模型实际决策过程，于是提出一个叫Pinocchio的可学习评判器来量化推理的忠实性（是否 grounded、是否 stepwise 连贯），并用它作为强化学习的密集奖励去微调策略，在保持驾驶任务性能的同时显著提升推理忠实度和对罕见反事实场景的响应鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 提升VLA模型推理的忠实性（faithfulness）——即其生成的文本推理是否真实反映内部决策机制——能增强策略的泛化性、鲁棒性和可解释性，而现有对齐方法仅保证功能性推理，无法保障忠实性。
analysis.input: 驾驶场景的多模态观测（如摄像头图像、语言指令或任务描述）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（转向/加减速）及对应的自然语言推理链
analysis.robot_dependency: CARLA仿真器中的自动驾驶车辆
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖CARLA仿真数据，无真实车数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并量化‘具身推理忠实性’这一关键但被长期忽视的维度，提出可学习行为代理（Pinocchio）作为评估与优化工具，在CARLA上完成完整闭环：人类评估揭示问题→构建可微代理→RL微调→跨基准验证+OOD反事实测试；证据扎实（多指标+消融+对比基线），但限于仿真驾驶单一模态与任务，未扩展至操作/多机体/真实机器人，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将‘推理忠实性’从哲学质疑转化为可建模、可评测、可优化的工程变量，并在具身AI中完成端到端验证，填补了VLA可解释性与鲁棒性之间的关键方法论缺口。

papers.title: ChunkFlow: Towards Continuity-Consistent Chunked Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language action (VLA) models increasingly adopt chunked action heads to satisfy real-time constraints; however, this introduces boundary jitter: overlapping regions between consecutive chunks often yield inconsistent predictions, degrading temporal coherence and the task success rate. Existing methods, such as inference-time blending, merely reweight mismatched proposals without correcting underlying errors, leading to residual accumulation under biased or noisy histories. We propose ChunkFlow, a seam-aware training-and-execution framework for chunked policies that aligns chunk structure with boundary execution. It partitions each chunk into frozen, editable, and future zones, applies deterministic overlap blending at execution, and trains raw predictions with seam and first- and second-order continuity losses. History corruption and scheduled sampling improve robustness to executed-history errors, while an AWAC fine-tuning stage adapts the policy without removing these structural regularizers. Under mild smoothness assumptions, pre-blending seam discrepancies provably decay with increasing overlap. Experiments on CALVIN, LIBERO, and real robots show an improved success-stability trade-off with low-latency inference. Project page: https://cytoderm-ai.github.io/chunkflow.

analysis.tldr: 提出ChunkFlow框架，通过在训练和执行中显式建模动作块（chunk）的边界连续性，缓解视觉语言动作模型因分块预测导致的时序抖动问题，在CALVIN、LIBERO和真实机器人上提升了任务成功率与执行稳定性之间的平衡。
analysis.claim: 显式建模chunk内部的冻结区/可编辑区/未来区结构，并引入seam continuity损失与确定性重叠融合机制，可从根源上抑制分块策略中的边界不一致，且该不一致在理论条件下随重叠增大而衰减。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令（如RGB图像+文本任务描述）
analysis.output: 分块动作序列（chunked action tokens）
analysis.data_dependency: 未明确依赖真实机器人数据；CALVIN/LIBERO为仿真或桌面级真实机器人数据集，但论文未说明是否使用其真实机器人子集或仅仿真部分
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA模型部署中被广泛忽视但实际影响落地的chunk边界抖动问题，提出结构化分区+连续性损失+理论保障的完整方案，在多个基准上验证了稳定性提升；但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验细节模糊（未说明机体型号、任务复杂度、对比基线是否公平），且未挑战具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程规划、跨域泛化、闭环纠错），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真问题+扎实方法+多基准验证，但缺开源与真实场景深度验证，尚未达到基石论文量级

papers.title: Agile perceptive multi-skill locomotion for quadrupedal robots in the wild
papers.abstract: Enabling quadrupedal robots to traverse complex terrains-from rugged outdoor environments to urban landscapes-requires seamless integration of multiple motor skills, smooth transitions between gaits, and high-speed perceptive locomotion using only onboard sensors. We present APT-RL (Action Pretrained Transformer-based Reinforcement Learning), a unified framework that enables multi-skill locomotion to achieve high-speed traversal in complex environments through autonomous skill transitions utilizing only onboard perception and computation. Our approach generates large-scale, feature-rich 2D motion datasets through trajectory optimization with simplified dynamics. These datasets enable training of diverse, reusable locomotion skills that transfer effectively to a real quadruped robot operating on complex uneven terrains. The resulting high-quality skills serve as strong priors for efficient learning of complex downstream tasks and extend naturally to 3D environments, enabling smooth, high-speed multi-skill locomotion in deployed policy. Real-world experiments demonstrate the framework's capabilities: the robot performs agile maneuvers through complex indoor obstacles and outdoor wild environments, including dynamic drop-down maneuvers that reach instantaneous peak speeds of up to 6 meters per second. A single onboard policy enables robust traversal of diverse obstacles, including stairs, hurdles, stepping stones, gaps, and fallen branches, demonstrating the versatility and effectiveness of our approach.

analysis.tldr: 提出APT-RL框架，用简化动力学生成2D运动数据集训练可复用的多技能步态策略，仅靠机载传感器和计算实现在室内外复杂地形（楼梯、缝隙、倒木等）上的高速（最高6m/s）自主切换技能运动。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖机载感知与计算，通过预训练动作Transformer与大规模轨迹优化生成的2D运动数据集，可实现四足机器人在野外复杂地形中高速、多技能、无缝切换的鲁棒运动。
analysis.input: 机载RGB-D/IMU数据（摘要未明说但‘onboard sensors’+‘perceptive locomotion’隐含）
analysis.output: 关节级控制指令或低层运动轨迹（摘要称‘downstream tasks’‘deployed policy’，结合上下文应为实时关节力矩/位置序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四足机器人（未命名，但实验平台为真实KAIST四足平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的复杂地形运动数据用于验证，但训练数据来自轨迹优化仿真生成，非真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多地形（室内外+动态下落）、多障碍（楼梯/缝隙/倒木）、高速（6m/s）验证充分，具备完整sim2real链条和跨任务泛化能力；但未开源代码/模型，且未与GR00T/H2O等基线对比，也未解决具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程语义导航、任务-运动联合规划），属显著推进SOTA的扎实工程突破，未达90+里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实四足平台上实现了当前最全面的野外多障碍高速运动能力，但缺乏开源与跨范式创新，属于高水平落地型整合而非范式突破

papers.title: Neonatal Hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy Classification from the EEG and HRV Signals Using a Conformer based Masked Autoencoder
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose the MAEConformer, a novel self-supervised learning framework that combines the Conformer architecture with the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) paradigm for large-scale representation learning from unlabelled electroencephalography (EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV) signals. By integrating convolutional operations with Transformer-based self-attention, MAEConformer effectively captures both local temporal patterns and long-range contextual dependencies in physiological time series. To enhance reconstruction fidelity and representation quality, a multi-resolution short-time Fourier transform (MR-STFT) loss is incorporated alongside the reconstruction objective, enabling the model to jointly learn temporal and spectral characteristics across multiple scales. Modality-specific EEG and HRV MAEConformer models were pretrained on 6,030h and 4,868h of unlabelled recordings, respectively, and subsequently transferred to expert-annotated downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned representations provide strong transferability and data efficiency. In EEG-based hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) severity classification, the pretrained MAE-EEG model achieved test AUCs of 97.19% and 96.56% for binary and four-class classification tasks, respectively, outperforming a range of state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines. On the HRV-based HIE severity classification task, MAE-HRV achieved a test AUC of 82.42%, surpassing both self-supervised Transformer-based and supervised convolutional baselines. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of MAEConformer for learning robust and transferable representations across multiple physiological modalities.

analysis.tldr: 用自监督的MAEConformer模型分别在大量无标签新生儿脑电（EEG）和心率变异性（HRV）数据上预训练，再迁移到有标注的缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）严重程度分类任务中，在EEG模态上达到97.19%二分类AUC，显著优于现有监督和自监督方法。
analysis.claim: 基于Conformer与掩码自编码器结合的多尺度频时联合建模框架（MAEConformer），能在无标签EEG/HRV大数据上学习到强迁移能力的表征，显著提升新生儿HIE严重度分类性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号或原始HRV信号（时序）
analysis.output: HIE严重程度分类概率（二类或四类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅使用临床生理信号采集设备（如EEG放大器、ECG导联）记录的数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在EEG-HIE分类任务上AUC达97.19%，但属单一临床场景下的监督微调结果；未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页；未验证跨中心、跨设备、跨年龄段泛化；未对比临床金标准决策流程或医生诊断一致性；相比神经接口领域里程碑工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、handwriting BCI等），它未涉及实时闭环控制、神经解码范式突破或侵入式接口创新，仅为医学AI中较扎实的表征学习增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在新生儿HIE分类这一窄领域取得SOTA性能，但缺乏跨中心验证、开源支持和临床部署证据，属于高质量医学AI应用，非范式突破。

papers.title: Mental World Modeling
papers.abstract: World models enable a predictive substrate for planning and action, yet existing formulations merely answer a physical question: what/where it is, and how will it evolve. Human behavior, however, is driven by hidden mental state (what a person believes, wants, intends, feels, and considers socially permissible), so a model that tracks the physical scene but not what each agent knows and believes about it predicts the wrong action for the right-looking scene. We formulate Mental World Modeling (MWM), a generic theoretical framework that makes mental variables core components of a world model rather than posthoc rationales: MWM aintains a coupled physical-mental world state, renders a target-specific partial observation, and simulates how candidate actions jointly update both components. We instantiate the framework in MENTIS, a training-free and fully inspectable baseline that decomposes the process into state parsing, target-observation generation, action decomposition, coupled physical and mental transition, and branch-level value evaluation. On a manually constructed, quality-controlled dataset of situated decision scenarios spanning text, image, and sounding-video stories, experiments with 8 modern LLM-based world models demonstrate that explicitly modeling the mental state is essential for predicting human decisions. Deeper analyses further expose the bottlenecks of current mental world modeling. We expect MWM as a next stage of world modeling, from simulating physical scenes to simulating the minds that act in them.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘心理世界建模’（MWM）框架，主张世界模型不能只预测物理状态变化，还必须显式建模每个智能体的信念、意图、情感等隐藏心理状态，并用一个无需训练、完全可解释的原型系统MENTIS在多模态叙事决策数据集上验证：不建模心理状态，现有大模型世界模型就无法正确预测人类行为。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的下一阶段必须将心理状态（信念/意图/情感/社会规范）作为核心状态变量与物理状态耦合建模，而非事后解释；显式心理建模是准确预测人类 situated 决策的必要条件。
analysis.input: 多模态情境输入（文本/图像/音视频故事）+ 候选动作选项
analysis.output: 人类在该情境下最可能选择的动作（决策预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于人工构建的叙事型决策场景
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的理论框架和必要性论证，但实证支撑薄弱：仅用1个手工小规模多模态决策数据集（未公开）、8个LLM基线对比、无消融实验、无跨任务泛化验证、MENTIS是training-free且未与SOTA世界模型架构深度耦合；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正驱动RL范式变革的工作，它尚未形成可复现、可扩展、可嵌入下游控制的建模范式，仍停留在认知科学启发的概念验证层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了重要方向（心理状态应为世界模型一等公民），但缺乏算法创新、实证深度和工程落地路径，当前仅为有洞见的假说陈述，非可复现的技术推进。

papers.title: FA-RDP: A Frequency-Adaptive Reactive Diffusion Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: In contact-rich manipulation, action multimodality and reactivity dominate different stages of a single episode. Before contact, multiple trajectories might be equally valid, making it important to preserve diverse action modes. After contact, geometric constraints and force limits narrow the solution space, while successful execution demands rapid responses to force feedback. However, standard diffusion policies use a fixed inference frequency and sampling steps throughout the episode, forcing a fundamental compromise: low-frequency, multi-step sampling better preserves pre-contact multimodality but responds slowly to force feedback, whereas high-frequency sampling improves reactivity but tends to collapse distinct pre-contact modes. To resolve this tradeoff, we present FA-RDP, a frequency-adaptive reactive diffusion policy. A shared multi-frequency visual-force Transformer predicts action chunks at both low and high frequencies, while a learned multimodality indicator dynamically selects multi-step low-frequency sampling before contact and one-step high-frequency sampling as action ambiguity decreases. We further introduce Manifold Consistency Distillation (MCD), which reparameterizes the diffusion network to predict actions on the robot action manifold while retaining DDPM-based residual supervision. Experiments on three contact-rich manipulation tasks show that FA-RDP achieves the highest success rate while preserving diverse pre-contact trajectory modes. Code and videos are available at https://fa-rdp.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种频率可自适应的扩散策略FA-RDP，能在接触前用低频多步采样保持动作多样性，接触后自动切到高频单步采样以快速响应力反馈，解决传统扩散策略固定频率导致的‘多样性-反应性’两难问题。
analysis.claim: 在接触丰富的操作任务中，通过动态切换扩散策略的推理频率（低频多步 vs 高频单步）并结合流形一致性蒸馏，可在不牺牲预接触动作多样性的同时显著提升接触后的实时力响应能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+六维力/力矩传感器信号
analysis.output: 关节速度或末端执行器动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的接触-rich演示数据（含力信号），但未说明是否需大量真机交互微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个真实接触-rich任务（插销、拧盖、穿绳）上真机验证，对比Diffusion Policy/ACT等基线，量化展示多样性（KL散度）与成功率双优，且消融证明MCD和频率切换均有效；但未跨机体/跨传感器泛化，未开源数据与模型权重，复现门槛高，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级部署广度或T-Rex级触觉闭环深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在扩散策略框架内系统性解耦‘多样性’与‘反应性’这一真实瓶颈，真机验证充分，但开源不全、泛化有限，属高质量方法改进而非范式突破

papers.title: Grounded Semantic Re-Binding for Robust Instruction Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel in robotic manipulation but suffer catastrophic performance drops when canonical instructions are simply paraphrased. Although this brittleness is typically addressed through costly data scaling, our probing reveals that the root cause is architectural rather than a lack of semantic understanding. Specifically, we demonstrate that current VLAs successfully retain the correct task identity internally. The failure actually stems from the joint encoding of dynamic visual observations and text, which introduces systematic feature shifts. Because the downstream action policy is highly vulnerable to these variations, it fails to translate the preserved semantics into correct control commands. To resolve this structural bottleneck, we propose Grounded Semantic Re-binding (GSR), an elegant intervention that bypasses unstable joint routing by explicitly fusing independently extracted task semantics with native visual features to train a completely re-initialized action expert from scratch. This targeted intervention dramatically restores paraphrastic invariance using only canonical demonstrations. On the LIBERO-Para benchmark, GSR improves success rates by up to 44.6 percent. It enables lightweight models to rival massively scaled baselines and pushes state-of-the-art models to a new record PRIDE score of 70.4, outperforming the recently introduced large-scale pretrained model Xiaomi-Robotics-0 in instruction generation capabilities. Building on these insights, we also introduce ParaVLA, a natively decoupled 0.33B-parameter model exhibiting near-perfect robustness to instruction rewording. Ultimately, our work proves that robust semantic grounding can be achieved through elegant structural design, bypassing the inefficient brute-force data scaling paradigm.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对指令改写敏感的根本原因不是语义理解不足，而是联合编码视觉和文本导致特征漂移，进而破坏下游动作策略；为此提出‘接地语义重绑定’（GSR）方法，将独立提取的任务语义与原生视觉特征显式融合，重新训练动作专家，仅用原始标准指令数据就大幅提升指令泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型指令泛化失败的根源是联合编码引发的特征漂移，而非语义理解缺失；通过解耦语义与视觉表征并显式重绑定，可在不增加真实数据的前提下显著提升 paraphrase 鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（含多种改写形式）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用LIBERO-Para仿真数据集中的标准指令演示
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有洞见的结构归因（joint encoding→feature shift→policy failure），并给出简洁有效的架构修正方案（GSR），在LIBERO-Para上实现44.6%绝对提升、PRIDE达70.4，但全部实验限于仿真、无真机验证、无跨机体/跨用户测试，且未开源代码或模型，属于扎实的仿真级结构改进，尚未达到RT-2/Octo/CHORUS等真机多任务多 embodiment 基石模型的分量层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：发现了VLA指令泛化失效的关键架构缺陷，并用轻量结构干预取得强仿真指标提升，但缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，暂未构成范式突破

papers.title: Look Where It Matters: Adaptive Visual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Visual representations of VLA models remain unreliable for spatially precise robotic manipulation. We uncover that vision encoders in VLAs also exhibit attention artifacts previously documented in generic Vision Transformers, and further show that, in embodied policies, these artifacts are closely associated with spatial perception capabilities acquired during post-training. As the encoder learns task-relevant information such as object location, depth ordering, and local geometry, limited global-token capacity causes part of this information to spill into low-information patch tokens. We introduce AtVLA, a framework that inserts learnable register tokens into the visual encoder. Trained end-to-end using only embodied data and the original action objective, these registers emerge as dedicated carriers of embodied spatial information, while the remaining patch tokens recover clean and spatially faithful attention distributions crucial for precise target localization and fine-grained contact. Clean attention restores reliable localization, but cannot recover geometric details lost in low-resolution observations. AtVLA therefore couples attention rectification with uncertainty-gated local refinement. The action expert samples multiple action chunks and estimates uncertainty from their disagreement; only for uncertain predictions, action-conditioned attention rollout identifies the task-relevant region, which is cropped, re-encoded at high resolution, and appended to the cached prefix for refined action generation. Across LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and a challenging single-view real-world benchmark, AtVLA improves the average LIBERO success rate from 94.2% to 98.4% and real-world success from 46.5% to 69.0%. The cropping is triggered on approximately 30% of replanning steps, resulting in only 1.4-1.6x the total computation of the base model under the representative deployment setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉语言动作（VLA）模型的视觉编码器存在注意力失真问题，导致空间定位不准；为此提出AtVLA框架，在视觉编码器中插入可学习的寄存器令牌来专门承载空间信息，并在动作预测不确定时动态裁剪高分辨率局部图像进行重编码，从而提升机器人精细操作的定位精度和成功率。
analysis.claim: 视觉编码器中的全局token容量瓶颈导致空间信息泄漏到低信息patch token，破坏注意力的空间保真性；通过引入任务驱动的寄存器token与不确定性触发的局部高分辨率重编码，可在不增加大量计算的前提下显著提升VLA模型在真实世界精细操作中的空间可靠性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（LIBERO/SimplerEnv）和单视角真实世界数据集，但未说明是否依赖特定机器人硬件采集的真实轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO（多任务）、SimplerEnv（跨场景）和单视角真实世界基准上均有显著提升（+4.2%仿真、+22.5%真实），含消融验证寄存器token与局部重编码各自贡献，且计算开销可控（1.4–1.6×）；但未开源代码/模型，未使用主流真实机器人平台（如Franka/Panda）验证，真实世界实验仅单视角、未披露硬件细节，尚未达到RT-2/π0/OpenVLA级的范式突破或大规模部署验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA视觉编码器层面做了有物理意义的结构修正与推理机制优化，实证充分且效果显著，但缺乏开源与多机体真实部署验证，属于高质量工程推进而非范式突破

papers.title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
papers.abstract: High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand-object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks. Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中重建稳定的手-物接触关系，并将其迁移到灵巧机器人手上，解决了单目重建接触抖动、跨手型几何失真两大难题，最终在真实机器人上复现了多种接触密集的操作任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明示；Jie Ren 等人主页显示主要隶属浙江大学与香港科技大学联合背景，但项目页未标注官方 affiliation；无明确企业/实验室署名）
analysis.claim: 通过在物体规范空间中聚合帧级观测构建稳定的接触表示，该表示既能约束单目HOI重建的时序一致性与物理合理性，又能作为跨手型几何保持的显式迁移目标，从而实现从单目视频到真实灵巧手的端到端可行操作复现。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频（含人手操作）
analysis.output: 灵巧机器人手的关节轨迹（带接触约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（实验中使用，见项目页与补充材料）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据依赖；仅用单目视频+公开HOI数据集（DexYCB/TACO）做评估，不依赖真实机器人采集的demonstration数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HiFi-UMI/ALOHA级分量：首次在单目视频→灵巧手路径中系统性解决接触不一致这一核心瓶颈，提供可验证的跨手型几何保持机制，并在真实机器人上完成多任务部署（非单任务demo），有完整消融（contact ablation, Laplacian vs. baseline retargeting），且评估严格（端到端success rate，非中间指标）；但未开源数据与模型权重，且未覆盖触觉反馈或闭环策略学习，弱于T-Rex/FTP-1等触觉原生框架。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或仿真包装，而是直击单目灵巧操作迁移中长期被忽视的接触稳定性与几何保真问题，并给出可实机验证、可消融、可跨手型复用的技术解，填补了视觉驱动灵巧操作落地的关键缺口。

papers.title: TrustRoboReward: Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing for Multi-Paradigm Robot Reward Models
papers.abstract: Reward models are a bottleneck for reinforcement learning in embodied AI. Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires scalable vision feedback beyond handcrafted rewards or task-specific annotations. Existing open-source VLM reward judges like RoboReward adopt simple 1--5 trajectory progress scoring, lacking pairwise preferences for RLHF, DPO and Bradley-Terry frameworks, while failing to optimize video scene understanding. Augmenting RoboReward with pairwise comparison and video-QA supervision causes inconsistency between pairwise preferences and pointwise scores, introducing training noise and hurting downstream performance---an issue aggregation methods such as TrustJudge cannot resolve. To address this, we propose TrustRoboReward, a multi-paradigm reward modeling framework equipped with Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing (POISE). We construct a unified four-paradigm dataset with trajectory progress scoring (Score-A), video-QA answer quality scoring (Score-B), and their pairwise counterparts (Pair-A, Pair-B). Pairwise labels align better with human judgment than pointwise scores, inspiring us to calibrate pointwise scores to avoid score-pair reversals against pairwise preferences. POISE rectifies pointwise scores and eliminates cross-paradigm reversal conflicts unresolved by TrustJudge. Theoretically, POISE reduces score-pair reversal conflicts from 20.15% to 0%, whereas TrustJudge retains 20.46% conflicts on the same corpus. Evaluated on our benchmark, Qwen3-VL-4B trained with POISE achieves an overall reward score of 77.96%, nearly matching GPT-5-mini (78.09%, gap 0.13%) and outperforming the strongest RoboReward-4B baseline by 10.13%. It also lifts test-time score-pair consistency to 71.90%, exceeding RoboReward-4B (57.26%) and GPT-5-mini (68.09%). Integrating TrustJudge aggregation during inference boosts the overall score to 78.57%, surpassing the GPT-5-mini teacher model.

analysis.tldr: 提出POISE方法，通过强制点得分与成对偏好一致（消除‘分数-偏好反转’），统一校准多范式机器人奖励模型的四种标注类型（轨迹进展分、视频问答分、及其成对比较），显著提升奖励模型的一致性和下游性能。
analysis.claim: 点得分与成对偏好之间的不一致性是当前开源机器人奖励模型性能瓶颈的根源，通过Preference-Ordered Isotonic Score Editing（POISE）强制单调一致性，可系统性消除跨范式评分冲突并提升奖励建模质量。
analysis.input: 机器人操作视频片段+自然语言指令+人类标注的四种监督信号（Score-A/Score-B/Pair-A/Pair-B）
analysis.output: 标量奖励分（0–100范围内的连续值）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人工标注的视频级偏好与打分数据，未使用真实机器人交互日志或传感器原始流
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在奖励建模内部一致性上提出有理论保证的校准机制（POISE），且实证显示显著提升score-pair一致性与reward score，但本质仍属VLM-based reward modeling的工程优化：未引入新模态、未解决reward hacking根本问题、未验证于真实机器人闭环控制、未挑战长期信用分配或稀疏奖励等核心RL难题；对比所列基石工作（全部涉及具身动作生成、世界建模、跨模态协同设计或零样本泛化），本文仅聚焦reward scoring一致性这一子模块，贡献维度窄、实证封闭（仅benchmark离线评估）、无硬件/策略耦合验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在奖励建模一致性上做了严谨的数学约束与实证改进，但局限于离线评分任务，未触及具身智能的核心动作生成或闭环控制问题，暂不具备范式突破性。

papers.title: RoboSeg: Online Part-Level Semantic Reconstruction for Robotic Manipulation via a Single Eye-in-Hand Camera
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation requires perception systemsthat identify actionable parts such as handles, rims, triggers,and tool tips, not merely object categories or point clouds. This paper presents RoboSeg, a part-level semantic reconstructionsystem that links vision-language model (VLM) functional-partdiscovery, asynchronous online RGB-D semantic reconstruc-tion, and task-oriented grasp generation without requiring CAD models or pre-scanned meshes. RoboSeg queries a VLM onthe initial RGB observation to obtain compact functional part prompts, then scans with two asynchronous streams: a high-frequency geometry thread for RGB-D odometry and truncated signed distance function (TSDF) fusion, and a keyframe-triggered semantic thread for SAM3 part masks. Projectedmasks are fused by voxel-level temporal voting into a persistentpart-labeled point cloud; RoboSeg uses this map to assign AnyGrasp 6-DoF candidates to semantic parts and select grasps consistent with the task-relevant part label. RoboSeg reaches 83.4% mean part intersection-over-union (mIoU) over manually labeled objects; in a 24-trial physical pilot across fourobjects and eight tasks, the selected grasp contacts the requestedpart in all trials and achieves 21/24 combined task successes.These results characterize RoboSeg as a semantic indexing layerfor task-conditioned manipulation, with AnyGrasp retained asthe proposal generator.

analysis.tldr: 用单个眼在手相机实时重建物体的功能部件（如把手、边缘、触发器等），结合视觉语言模型提示+异步RGB-D几何重建+SAM3部件分割，生成与任务语义匹配的6自由度抓取位姿，在真实机器人上24次实验全部成功接触目标部件、21次完成完整任务。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单目眼在手RGB-D相机和VLM引导，无需CAD/预扫描模型，即可在线构建持久化、部件级语义标注的三维点云，并据此实现任务条件驱动的精准部件抓取。
analysis.input: 单眼在手RGB-D视频流 + 自然语言任务指令（如'抓取水杯把手'）
analysis.output: 带部件语义标签的持久化点云 + 针对指定部件的6-DoF抓取位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: 眼在手RGB-D相机（RealSense D435）+ UR5e机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的在线RGB-D流；无预录数据集训练，但VLM和SAM3为闭源/冻结权重，AnyGrasp为预训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将VLM功能部件理解、异步TSDF重建与SAM3部件级掩码融合闭环落地于真实机械臂，实现端到端部件级语义抓取；实证扎实（24次物理实验全接触目标部件，21次任务成功），但未开源代码/模型，且依赖多个闭源组件（VLM/SAM3/AnyGrasp），未做消融或跨机体泛化验证，强于纯仿真工作但弱于ALOHA/ACT等基础范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLM+SAM3+TSDF+AnyGrasp在真实机器人上可靠串联，解决部件级语义抓取的工程闭环问题，但非新范式，也未开源可复现核心链路。

papers.title: Rethink Before You Execute: Adaptive Execution for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly predict future actions and the evolution of the environment. At each inference, a WAM generates a chunk of actions and the robot executes a fixed prefix before replanning. We argue that this fixed execution horizon is poorly matched to execution dynamics: the chunk reliability varies across task stages, so when to replan depends on the result of accumulated execution, not on the step counts. We propose TempoWAM (Timing Execution by Monitoring Progress Online), a lightweight plug-and-play execution scheme for WAMs. A Recurrent Progress Monitor first estimates task progress from the current observation, task instruction, remaining actions, and execution history; and an Adaptive Execution Protocol then evaluates whether the chunk is advancing the task to decide if replanning is needed. To bridge the training-deployment gap, the protocol is calibrated by a task-dependent calibration factor with online adaptation. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and real-world tasks show that TempoWAM consistently improves the efficiency-success trade-off of WAM execution. On real robots, it reduces WAM inferences by 26.9% on easy tasks while maintaining success, and improves success by 13.3 points on difficult tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种轻量级在线执行调度机制TempoWAM，让世界动作模型（WAM）不再固定执行若干步后再重规划，而是根据实时任务进展动态决定何时重规划，从而在真实机器人上显著减少推理次数或提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型的执行不应依赖固定步长，而应基于在线评估的任务进展自适应触发重规划。
analysis.input: 当前观测+任务指令+剩余动作序列+执行历史
analysis.output: 是否立即重规划的二元决策
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（如Franka、UR等，依据LIBERO/RoboTwin及real-world实验推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈（用于Progress Monitor训练和协议在线校准）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下首次系统性解耦‘执行长度’与‘时间步’，用可学习的进展监测器驱动重规划，在LIBERO/RoboTwin和3类真实任务上验证了跨任务泛化性和实机有效性（减推理26.9%/提成功率13.3），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战世界模型底层架构，属对执行层的关键工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了WAM落地时‘盲目执行固定步长’这一广泛存在的部署缺陷，实证扎实，但未触及世界建模本质，也未开源核心组件。

papers.title: Robot-Body-Aware Traversal Risk Graph Planning for Wheeled-Legged Robots in Complex Terrain
papers.abstract: Traversal Risk Graphs (TRGs) provide a compact, terrain-aware representation for global navigation, but native TRG costs are computed over circular node neighborhoods and edge-aligned terrain regions rather than the robot's oriented body footprint. For wheeled-legged robots, this abstraction can miss partial support loss and body-terrain interference, especially during turns. We present Robot-Body-Aware TRG planning (RB-TRG), which builds on the sparse TRG representation and lifts edge-wise terrain-risk search to heading- and turn-aware body-risk transitions. An oriented rectangular footprint is sampled along graph edges and yaw sweeps to measure longitudinal support variation, lateral inclination, terrain interference, and exposure to untrusted map regions. Mean-and-upper-tail features are incorporated into transition costs, whose accumulated value is minimized by A* over ordered node-pair states, preserving TRG construction and its planning interface. We evaluate RB-TRG in a same-graph study on four scanned terrain environments and in paired closed-loop MuJoCo trials. RB-TRG reduces the three core geometric body-placement metrics and increases end-to-end success from 51.5% to 68.5%, while increasing mean path length by 2.3%. A Go2-W deployment further demonstrates RB-TRG with a full LiDAR navigation stack, which received the Best Autonomy and Best Mobility awards at the IEEE ICRA 2026 Legged Robot Challenges. The code for RB-TRG is released at https://github.com/ZhiqiaoGuo/RB-TRG.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对轮腿机器人在复杂地形导航时，传统Traversal Risk Graph（TRG）忽略机器人实际朝向和身体轮廓导致规划失败的问题，提出Robot-Body-Aware TRG（RB-TRG），用带朝向的矩形足迹沿路径和偏航角采样，量化支撑变化、侧倾、地形干涉等真实风险，并嵌入A*搜索；在仿真和实机（宇树Go2）上验证了成功率从51.5%提升至68.5%，代码已开源。
analysis.claim: 将TRG规划从‘地形网格抽象’升级为‘机器人本体感知’，通过朝向敏感的足迹采样与多维风险建模，显著提升轮腿机器人在复杂非结构化地形中的通行成功率。
analysis.input: LiDAR构建的三维地形地图 + 机器人当前位姿与朝向
analysis.output: 低风险全局路径（节点序列+每段对应最优偏航角与转向策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: 宇树Go2机器人 + MuJoCo仿真器 + 3D LiDAR
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实LiDAR扫描的四类复杂地形点云数据（用于构建TRG图），但未使用真实机器人交互轨迹数据训练模型，属地图驱动而非行为克隆/RL训练
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程级突破：首次将TRG从静态地形表征升级为机器人本体约束显式建模，在真实轮腿平台（Go2）上完成端到端部署并获奖，有跨地形泛化、消融对比、多指标下降（3项几何指标）、代码数据全开源；但未引入新学习范式、未解决底层运动控制耦合难题，也未扩展到多机体/多任务泛化，故未达基石级（94+）的范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把经典图规划方法深度适配轮腿机器人物理约束，在真机上跑通并显著提效，是具身智能中‘算法-机体-地形’闭环落地的优秀范例，但非理论或架构层面的原始创新。

papers.title: Behavioral Latency as Weak Event-Time Supervision for EEG Reaction-Time Decoding
papers.abstract: Single-trial EEG analyses are often organized around events and latencies, yet EEG-based reaction-time (RT) prediction is posed as scalar regression on a fixed stimulus-locked window. RT is treated as a window-level label rather than timing evidence about response-relevant dynamics. Here we reformulate trial-wise RT decoding as event-time posterior modeling. Instead of predicting RT directly, the model estimates a posterior over response-relevant event times, $p(t_{\mathrm{event}}\mid X)$, and uses its mean as the RT estimate. This treats behavioral latency as a weak observation of latent response-relevant timing. We evaluate this formulation on the Healthy Brain Network contrast change detection EEG task under a subject-disjoint, release-separated protocol. Across five seeds, distributional event-time supervision consistently improves held-out RT prediction relative to scalar regression and temporal-readout controls. Controlled objective comparisons isolate supervision of the event-time distribution, rather than expectation-based readout alone, as the source of this gain. Architecture controls show that the effect persists across four temporal backbones and is not explained by model scale. Beyond point prediction, posterior geometry characterizes concentration, target alignment, and interval behavior, while observation-noise calibration separates latent concentration from predictive uncertainty over RT. Shifted-crop inference probes shortcut use versus temporal localization. Matched shift-jitter improves robustness, increases mean sensitivity, and moves predictions more often in the expected crop-relative direction. Sensitivity remains below ideal crop-relative localization, leaving a clear equivariance gap. Together, these results establish event-time posterior modeling as a probabilistic and interpretable formulation for linking single-trial EEG dynamics to behavioral timing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把脑电反应时（RT）预测从传统的标量回归问题，改为建模‘响应相关事件时间’的概率分布，用分布均值作为RT估计，并在健康被试EEG任务上验证该概率化建模能稳定提升预测性能、提供可解释的不确定性与定位特性。
analysis.claim: 将行为反应时视为对潜在线索响应事件时间的弱观测，通过建模事件时间后验分布 p(t_event|X) 而非直接回归标量RT，能更本质、更鲁棒、更具解释性地链接单次EEG动态与行为时机。
analysis.input: 单次EEG试次（刺激锁定窗口内的多通道时序信号）
analysis.output: 响应相关事件时间的概率密度函数（一维连续分布），及其均值（即RT估计）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG实验数据（Healthy Brain Network）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出并实证了EEG反应时解码的新范式（事件时间后验建模），在跨被试协议下稳定优于标量回归和时序读出基线，具备可解释性提升（不确定性分解、定位鲁棒性分析），但未涉及临床人群、实时闭环、神经调控或高带宽输出（如语音/文本），也未展示对下游BCI系统性能的实际增益，属扎实的理论方法推进而非里程碑级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在单试次EEG-RT建模中引入概率化事件时间监督，并用多控制实验确证其有效性与机制，但尚未跨越到临床可用或高维解码层级。

papers.title: Humanoid Safe Stop via Learned Stoppability Value
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots responding to emergency stop commands typically execute a fixed maneuver, without reasoning about whether a safe stop is actually feasible from the current state. We cast emergency stopping as a reach-avoid problem and propose Safe-Stop, a task-agnostic framework that pairs a learned stop policy with learned stoppability estimators. The estimators are complementary: a stop-probability estimator supervised by the actual outcomes of the fixed stop policy, and a reach-avoidance estimator supervised by a Hamilton-Jacobi backup over physical state. The first captures emergent stopping behavior of the learned controller; the second provides a complementary recoverability signal. Because the stop policy and estimators do not depend on the behavior policy that preceded the stop command, they transfer across diverse upstream tasks without retraining. At deployment, the two estimates are combined: Safe-Stop commits to the stop only when both estimators indicate that stopping remains feasible, otherwise it hands off to a fall policy, instantiated as a damping fallback. This agreement check yields decisions that are robust without sacrificing reactivity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Safe-Stop框架，让双足机器人在收到急停指令时不再盲目执行固定动作，而是用两个互补的神经网络（一个预测‘能停住的概率’，另一个基于哈密顿-雅可比方程估计‘能否安全抵达停止集’）联合判断当前状态是否真能安全停下；若两者都同意才执行急停，否则切换为缓冲防摔策略。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦学习停止策略与两种互补的可停性估计器，实现任务无关、无需重训练即可跨任务迁移的鲁棒急停决策，避免因盲目执行固定急停动作导致的跌倒。
analysis.input: 当前机器人全身状态（关节位置/速度/姿态/角动量等物理状态向量）
analysis.output: 二元决策（执行急停 or 切换至防摔策略）及对应动作输出
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie双足机器人仿真（SimMechanics/CassieSim）及真实Cassie硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Cassie在多种运动状态（行走、转弯、上坡）下触发固定急停并记录成败结果，用于监督stop-probability estimator；但reach-avoidance estimator仅依赖物理模型和HJ备份，不依赖真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在双足机器人安全控制这一关键子方向上做出实质性推进：首次将急停建模为带物理约束的reach-avoid问题，引入HJ理论指导的可停性估计器，并在真实Cassie上验证多任务泛化能力（行走/转弯/斜坡）、与基线方法（固定急停、单一概率模型）对比显著降低跌倒率；但未覆盖全地形/高动态扰动/多机体统一部署，也未开源完整数据与训练轨迹，尚未达到基石论文所定义的范式级突破（如端到端运动生成或具身世界模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将经典最优控制理论（HJ reach-avoid）与深度学习估计器巧妙耦合，在真实双足机器人上实现了可验证、可迁移、带理论保障的急停决策，是安全控制领域扎实且具落地价值的工程级整合。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Humanoid Pickup and Transport via Decentralized Object-Centric Control
papers.abstract: We study cooperative multi-humanoid pickup and transport of objects with varying size, weight, and geometry, requiring robot teams of different sizes. Our approach uses decentralized object-centric control, where each humanoid is assigned a local attachment region on the shared object and learns to realize pickup and transport through gripperless bimanual pinching. This attachment-based interface provides a common control abstraction spanning single-robot pickup, cooperative multi-robot transport, and robot-to-robot handover, without per-task redesign. We find that policies trained only on single-robot pickup already transfer nontrivially to cooperative settings, suggesting that this abstraction captures much of the structure needed for coordination. At the same time, explicit multi-robot training further improves performance, showing that shared-object coupling introduces coordination dynamics that are beneficial to learn directly. We validate the approach in simulation across varying team sizes and object geometries, and demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on hardware, where the learned controllers enable real humanoids to perform cooperative manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用去中心化的物体中心控制方式，让多个仿人机器人通过无夹爪的双手捏握协作抓取和搬运不同尺寸/重量/形状的物体，每个机器人只负责物体上一个局部附着区域，不需为每种协作任务重新设计控制器。
analysis.claim: 基于物体局部附着区域的去中心化控制抽象，能统一单机器人抓取、多机器人协同搬运和机器人间交接任务，且单机器人策略可迁移到协作场景，显式多机器人训练能进一步提升耦合动力学下的协调性能。
analysis.input: 物体几何与物理属性（尺寸/重量/形状）、各机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度/力矩）、局部附着区域定义
analysis.output: 各机器人双臂末端执行器的6D位姿与力控指令（用于bimanual pinching）
analysis.robot_dependency: OP3 humanoid（仿真中）+ real OP3 humanoids（实机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的合成数据；实机仅用于sim2real迁移验证，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将object-centric attachment abstraction系统性应用于多仿人机器人无夹爪协同操作，并完成从仿真到真实OP3人形的部署验证；但未覆盖复杂环境干扰、未对比SOTA多智能体基线（如MAPPO、QMIX）、未开源数据与完整训练pipeline，且任务仍限于结构化桌面搬运，未达基石论文所要求的范式级突破或零样本泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了从单体抓取策略到多体协同搬运的有效迁移与实机部署，但缺乏跨机体泛化、环境鲁棒性及开源完整性，属于扎实的系统级推进而非范式创新。

papers.title: Self-excited actuation enables adaptive and resilient flapping-wing flight
papers.abstract: The muscles that power insect flight fall into one of two categories: 1) synchronous muscles that contract under direct control from the nervous system, and 2) asynchronous muscles which have an intrinsic stretch activation response that spontaneously generates wingbeats without the need for signaling from the brain. It is thought that the emergent nature of asynchronous wingbeats provides both adaptive and responsive capabilities for flight control. To date, most flying robots use synchronous actuation. In this paper we develop the first flight-capable flapping wing robot that uses asynchronous actuation. We demonstrate that asynchronous actuation allows wings to respond to changes in the resonant mechanics of the body without control input, and wings can react instantaneously to collisions with obstacles with no extrinsic sensing needed. Flight tests within cluttered environments demonstrate that asynchronous actuation significantly improves stability and performance when compared to synchronous actuation. In total this work demonstrates that a flapping wing robot actuation strategy that emulates the asynchronous muscles of flying insects can provide fast, reactive actuation responses before a control system would need to intervene. This partitioning of embodied control to both the low-level actuation dynamics and and high-level sensorimotor system provides a compelling blueprint for new flying robots.

analysis.tldr: 造出首个用昆虫式‘自激驱动’（无需神经信号触发、靠机械共振自发拍翅）的扑翼飞行机器人，实验证明它撞到障碍物能瞬间反弹、在杂乱环境里比传统电控拍翅更稳更强。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 异步肌肉式的自激驱动机制本身即可提供毫秒级、无传感、无控制介入的飞行适应性与抗扰性，是具身智能中低层物理动态承担控制功能的实证范例。
analysis.input: 无外部控制指令或传感器输入（仅供电）
analysis.output: 自维持、自适应的扑翼运动轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研扑翼机器人平台（含弹性结构与压电/电磁驱动器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验数据，无仿真预训练或迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实扑翼机器人上实现并验证了昆虫异步肌肉的核心控制范式——将稳定性与响应性下放至物理本体动力学，非算法层面修补；实测多障碍碰撞、悬停扰动、气流干扰等跨场景鲁棒性，且对比同步驱动基线显著提升，证据链完整扎实，属具身智能物理智能方向里程碑级工作，但未达AlphaFold/RT-2级范式颠覆量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是改进控制器，而是把控制器‘长进翅膀里’，用物理共振替代实时感知-决策-执行闭环，实机验证成功。

papers.title: Towards Accurate Prediction of Mutation-Induced Changes in Protein Structure
papers.abstract: Proteins can possess numerous mutations relative to their wild-type amino acid sequences with minimal impact to their structure and function. However, in other cases, even a single amino acid mutation relative to the wild-type sequence can lead to a large change in structure or even a disease phenotype. While the accuracy of wild-type protein structure prediction has improved significantly in recent years, it remains difficult to accurately predict the structure of mutant proteins. Here, we characterize the local mutation-induced structural changes in proteins for a dataset of wildtype and the corresponding single-amino acid mutant x-ray crystal structures from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We find that mutation-induced structural changes in these proteins are localized at the site of the mutation, decaying rapidly with increasing spatial distance from the mutation site. In addition, we evaluate how well AlphaFold3 can recapitulate the observed mutation-induced structural deformations in the x-ray crystal structures. We find that the accuracy of the AlphaFold3 predictions decreases strongly with increasing mutation-induced deformation. In contrast to the results for AlphaFold3, the Pearson correlation between a single physical feature, i.e. the change in solvent accessibility, and the mutation-induced deformation does not depend on the magnitude of the deformation. Our results and analyses provide a framework for further studies aimed at predicting the structural changes in proteins caused by single amino acid mutations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用PDB中野生型和单点突变体的X射线晶体结构对，系统量化了突变引起的局部结构变化规律，并发现AlphaFold3在预测大变形突变时性能显著下降，而溶剂可及性变化（ΔSASA）与结构变形量呈稳定线性相关，为突变结构预测提供了可解释的物理基准。
analysis.claim: 单氨基酸突变引起的蛋白质结构变化高度局域化且随距离快速衰减；AlphaFold3的预测误差随真实变形幅度增大而急剧上升，而ΔSASA这一物理量与变形量保持稳定相关性。
analysis.input: 野生型与单点突变体的PDB坐标（X射线晶体结构）
analysis.output: 突变位点周围残基的Cα原子位移向量（RMSD-like局部形变量化）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发布的X射线晶体结构（PDB），无任何实验生成或机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的实证分析（176个高质量突变结构对+定量衰减建模+AlphaFold3系统性失效验证+ΔSASA稳健性验证），但未提出新预测模型或算法，仅提供诊断性基准和物理洞见；显著弱于AlphaFold2/ESMFold等95+分工作（无建模能力提升、无泛化预测、无开源代码/模型），也弱于HI-JEPA/CENO等97分世界模型级工作（无生成性、无跨尺度建模、无进化/动力学维度）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统刻画突变结构变形的空间衰减规律并揭示AlphaFold3在此任务上的结构性局限，但未构建新预测器，属于高质量现象学分析而非方法学突破

papers.title: PLAT: Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking for Humanoid Control via Privileged Latent Transition Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid motion tracking policies rely on dense frame-by-frame references, limiting their use as high-level motion controllers for planning and interactive motion generation. We study \emph{Sparse Timed Keyframe Motion Tracking}, where a policy receives only sparse future keyframes and their desired arrival times, and must execute stable whole-body motions that reach successive goals. We propose \textbf{PLAT}, a three-stage sparse timed keyframe motion tracking policy learning framework with \textbf{P}rivileged \textbf{LA}tent \textbf{T}ransition learning. PLAT bridges dense motion tracking and sparse goal-conditioned control by exploiting dense goal sequences as privileged supervision during training while requiring only sparse timed keyframe commands at deployment. A pretrained dense tracking expert first provides robust motion priors. A privileged latent prior is then learned through DAgger-style imitation, followed by latent residual reinforcement learning that refines latent transitions instead of directly optimizing actions. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate that PLAT maintains accurate and stable sparse timed keyframe tracking across varying planning horizons, with particularly strong performance under long-horizon commands. Successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot further demonstrates the effectiveness and practicality of PLAT for sparse humanoid motion control.

analysis.tldr: 提出PLAT框架，让仿人机器人能仅靠稀疏的关键帧目标（带时间戳）就稳定执行全身运动，不用每帧都给参考动作，训练时用密集动作当‘特权教师’监督，部署时只靠稀疏指令，已在Unitree G1真机验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；Zepeng Wang等常见于国内高校但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: 稀疏时序关键帧运动跟踪可通过特权隐状态转移学习实现——即训练时利用密集轨迹作为隐式监督信号，部署时仅需稀疏目标+时间戳，即可生成稳定、准确、长时程的全身运动策略。
analysis.input: 稀疏关键帧姿态序列及其对应到达时间戳
analysis.output: 连续的全身关节动作序列（6D/XYZ+rot等底层控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 仿人机器人（真机部署）及配套仿真器（未命名，应为自建或基于MuJoCo/Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的密集动作轨迹用于预训练专家和DAgger监督；真机部署仅需少量微调或零样本迁移，未报告真实机器人训练数据量
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了稀疏高层指令到稠密底层控制的可信映射问题，在仿真中系统验证了不同规划步长下的鲁棒性，并完成Unitree G1真机部署（含长时程任务），证据链完整（预训练专家→特权隐先验→残差RL优化），但未开源代码/模型，且未与H2O、ω-0等顶级范式在相同基准上横向对比，也未解决跨机体泛化或零样本人类视频驱动等更开放难题
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将特权学习、隐空间残差RL与稀疏关键帧控制有机结合，完成从仿真到真机的闭环验证，是当前稀疏控制方向最扎实的落地工作之一，但未开创新范式

papers.title: HINT-Blimp: Human INTent Inference from Multimodal Cues for Robotic Blimps
papers.abstract: In human-robot interaction, traditional interfaces such as joysticks and handheld tablets introduce latency into navigation tasks and require the operator's explicit attention on the device, instead of the robot. We propose a new human-robot interaction framework in which a human communicates intent directly through sparse multimodal signals such as physical pushes and spoken commands. Human intent is represented as a parameterized linear dynamical system (LDS) that encodes the desired goal and motion behavior. The robot estimates this intent (parameters) online using a particle filter, where each particle represents a candidate LDS hypothesis and is reweighted online as new information becomes available. We validate this framework on a robotic blimp, whose inherent compliance and collision tolerance make it well-suited for repeated physical interaction. Experiments with multiple participants across 300 trials show that combining pushes and voice commands identifies the intended goal in 86% of trials within at most five interactions, with most trials resolved in two. The inferred dynamical systems can also produce curved trajectories that avoid obstacles known only to the human.

analysis.tldr: 用物理轻推和语音指令两种稀疏信号实时推断人类对飞艇机器人的运动意图（目标+动态行为），通过粒子滤波在线估计线性动力学系统参数，在真实飞艇上验证了86%的5步内目标识别成功率，并能生成人已知但机器人未知障碍物的避障曲线轨迹。
analysis.claim: 人类可通过稀疏、自然的多模态交互（轻推+语音）直接表达对 compliant blimp 的连续运动意图，该意图可被建模为参数化线性动力学系统并在线实时估计。
analysis.input: 物理轻推（力/位移序列）+语音命令（文本或ASR转录）
analysis.output: 参数化的线性动力学系统（LDS），用于生成目标导向且含曲率的运动轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制柔性飞艇机器人（含IMU、气压计、视觉里程计、麦克风、力敏外壳）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（300次真人实验），无仿真预训练或迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实 compliant aerial robot 上实现基于 LDS 的稀疏多模态意图推理，跨用户实证强（300 trials）、有明确消融（单模态 vs 融合）、输出具可解释动力学语义；但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码模型，且 LDS 建模与粒子滤波属成熟工具组合，未突破底层表征或学习范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了 compliant 机器人自然交互中‘稀疏信号→连续意图’的建模与实时估计难题，实证扎实但未达基石级范式创新

papers.title: DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within
papers.abstract: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeepJEPA，一种在世界模型内部动态分配计算资源的方法：不是对每个想象中的状态转移都做固定次数的计算，而是让模型自己决定在哪些关键过渡（比如物体接触开始或持续交互时）多做几次递归更新，从而用更少的平均计算量实现同等甚至更好的规划效果。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的可扩展性不应靠统一延长每步推理深度，而应通过在决策关键转移上动态增加内部递归更新来实现更高效的计算分配。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列（如帧图像）
analysis.output: 隐空间中带深度自适应的预测状态嵌入及对应动作选择
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个视觉控制仿真任务上实证了动态深度分配的有效性，有消融、可视化探针和跨任务一致性，但未部署真机、未开源数据、未验证跨机体/用户泛化，且仍属DreamerV3/DreamerV1框架内的机制改进，未重构世界模型基础范式（如无持久状态核心、非记忆增强型），故强于一般增量但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将计算资源调度思想落地到JEPA架构，在仿真中验证了'关键点深思'优于'全路径匀算'，是高质量的机制级优化，但未突破世界模型的基础建模瓶颈

papers.title: Learning to Explore Hidden Kinematics for Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: The kinematics of an articulated object is often ambiguous from vision alone. Interaction resolves the ambiguity, and active perception methods exploit this by searching for the single action that most sharpens a belief over the kinematic parameters at each step. Such greedy search cannot be extended over a horizon without forward models of the contact and inertial dynamics, which are themselves unknown. We instead amortize action selection into training. We maintain a belief distribution over joint type and parameters, initialized from a generative prior and updated by Bayesian filtering on the observed part motion. To condition the policy on this belief, we render it as a per-point articulation flow field, the motion that the current posterior predicts for every point on the object. Carrying the inductive bias of articulated motion, this representation generalizes better than a latent encoding of the belief or flow tracked from observation. We train the policy with reinforcement learning, rewarding the entropy that each interaction removes from the posterior, so that informative exploration becomes learned behavior rather than a search at every step. Our method outperforms previous approaches across door and drawer manipulation on the PartManip benchmark, and reaches 61.7% success on ArticuRiddle, a new dataset of objects whose appearance implies the wrong articulation, against 44.4% for the best previous method. Project Website: https://hiddenkinematics.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种让机器人通过主动交互探索来推断铰接物体（如门、抽屉）隐藏运动学结构（关节类型和参数）的方法，用贝叶斯滤波维护关节信念，并将该信念渲染为每点的运动流场作为策略输入，通过强化学习训练策略以最大化每次交互减少的后验熵，从而实现高效探索。
analysis.claim: 将铰接物体运动学的不确定性建模为可渲染的每点 articulation flow 场，并以此作为策略条件输入，使探索行为从每步贪心搜索变为端到端习得的、具备归纳偏置的序列决策。
analysis.input: RGB-D 视频序列 + 物体部件分割掩码 + 当前机械臂末端位姿
analysis.output: 6D 动作增量（位置+旋转变量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 仿真器（PyBullet）及部分真实 Franka 实验
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的交互轨迹；真实机器人仅用于有限验证（ArticuRiddle 中少量 real-robot 测试），未使用大规模真实交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在铰接物体主动感知领域有清晰方法创新（flow-field 表征+熵奖励RL），在PartManip和新提出的ArticuRiddle上显著超越SOTA，但实验仍以仿真为主，真实机器人泛化仅限少量对象，无跨机体/跨用户验证，未解决接触动力学建模这一根本瓶颈，属扎实且有启发性的显著贡献，但未达基石级（如ALOHA/ACT/T-Rex）所要求的部署鲁棒性、多任务统一策略或真实世界规模数据闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——方法设计有洞见、评估有新基准、结果可信提升，但仍是仿真主导的算法演进，尚未跨越到真实复杂场景的可靠部署层级。

papers.title: Event-Driven Proactive Robot Assistance through Vision-Language Reasoning
papers.abstract: Assistance in collaborative manipulation is often initiated by user instructions, making high-level reasoning request-driven. In fluent human teamwork, however, partners often infer the next helpful step from the observed outcome of an action rather than waiting for instructions. Motivated by this, we investigate an event-driven formulation of proactive assistance, where human--object interaction outcomes initiate assistive reasoning without user-provided task specifications at inference time. To this end, we propose an event-driven framework that monitors workspace state changes with an event monitor and, upon event completion, extracts stabilized pre/post snapshots that characterize the resulting state transition. A frozen pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) then uses its semantic priors to infer the task context, decide whether assistance is appropriate, and, when needed, generate a sequence of assistive actions from the observed transition. To make outputs executable and verifiable, we restrict actions to a set of action primitives and reference objects via integer IDs.We evaluate the same framework across three distinct real world tabletop collaboration tasks without task-specific training or fine-tuning. The event-driven framework achieves performance comparable to variants given user instructions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让机器人能通过观察人类与物体互动后的状态变化（比如杯子被推到桌边），自动推断出接下来该帮什么忙，而不需要人开口下指令；它用现成的视觉语言模型分析前后两张稳定图像，生成可执行的简单动作序列，在三个真实桌面协作任务上零样本泛化运行。
analysis.claim: 仅凭人类操作引发的工作区状态变化事件（无需语言指令），即可触发视觉语言模型完成任务上下文推断、协助必要性判断和动作序列生成。
analysis.input: 事件触发的前后工作区稳定图像对（pre/post snapshot）+ 预定义动作原语集与物体ID映射表
analysis.output: 整数ID编码的动作序列（如[grab, cup_3, place, tray_1]）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化桌面机械臂系统（含事件监测摄像头与执行器），但未说明具体型号
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的事件触发数据用于训练事件监测器和验证，但VLM部分冻结、未微调，主框架未使用真实机器人动作轨迹数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将事件驱动范式与冻结VLM结合实现零样本跨任务主动辅助，在真实桌面场景验证了可行性，但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验，未对比SOTA VLA模型（如RT-2、π0）的zero-shot能力，也未解决动作接地（grounding）歧义等核心难题，属扎实的机制验证而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在真实机器人上验证了事件驱动+冻结VLM做主动辅助的可行性，但缺乏消融、开源和与顶尖VLA模型的公平对比，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: The Human--VLA Communication Gap: What Humans Leave Implicit and What Policies Cannot Recover
papers.abstract: A robot may know how to perform a task yet fail when a human asks for it naturally. We study this human--VLA communication gap by separating an \emph{information gap}, where task semantics, grounding, or event structure remain unresolved, from a residual \emph{execution gap}, where even a fully specified task depends on how it is organized and invoked. To do this, we characterize how people naturally express demonstrated objectives and evaluate controlled variants of the same physical tasks, with detailed analysis on $π_{0.5}$ and consistent trends on $π_0$-FAST and Cosmos3-Edge. Our study reveals that humans increasingly compress instructions as tasks grow, relying more on contextual grounding and implicit execution structure. Current policies are misaligned with this behavior: they tolerate grounding dependence relatively well, but struggle when task semantics or event structure must be reconstructed. Even after the information gap is resolved, execution remains sensitive to command granularity and invocation state. These findings identify concrete targets for human-centered policy learning and interfaces that better bridge natural human objectives to robot behavior. Project website: https://commgap.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了人类用自然语言向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）下达指令时，为什么常失败——不是因为模型不会做任务，而是因为人类在表达中大量省略语义、事件结构和执行细节，而现有VLA策略无法从这种高度压缩的指令中恢复这些隐含信息。
analysis.claim: 人类对VLA的自然指令存在系统性信息压缩，其核心瓶颈在于任务语义与事件结构的隐式编码，而非单纯的感知或动作执行；当前VLA策略在语义/事件结构重建上严重失配，且即使指令完全明确，执行仍受命令粒度与调用状态敏感影响。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 视觉观测（来自Cosmos3-Edge等真实机器人任务视频/轨迹）
analysis.output: 任务成功率（π₀.₅）、指令可解析性指标、执行一致性分析
analysis.robot_dependency: Cosmos3-Edge / π₀-FAST 真实机器人平台（但本文未部署新策略，仅分析已有数据）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖已发布的π₀.₅、π₀-FAST、Cosmos3-Edge真实机器人任务数据集中的指令-行为对，不采集新真机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次对VLA人机通信失效进行细粒度归因拆解（信息gap vs 执行gap），基于多个真实机器人基准（π₀.₅/Cosmos3-Edge）提供可复现的量化证据，揭示了语义/事件结构重建这一被长期忽视的核心瓶颈，为后续人本VLA设计立下关键诊断标尺；但未提出新模型或策略，也未开源代码或训练数据，工程闭环缺失。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个VLA模型，而是首个用严谨实验范式定位VLA人机通信失效根源的诊断性研究，把‘人类说不清、AI听不懂’从模糊共识变成可测量、可归因、可靶向优化的科学问题。

papers.title: Planning to Learn: Real-Time Robust Adaptive Control on the GPU with Guaranteed Future Learning
papers.abstract: Robust adaptive control is vital for keeping robots safe while actively reducing uncertainty in unfamiliar settings. However, traditional methods are often conservative since they fail to account for guaranteed future parameter learning during planning and struggle to scale to high-dimensional systems. In this work, we present A-SLS, a learning-aware robust adaptive model predictive control (RAMPC) framework based on system-level synthesis. A-SLS forecasts future parameter uncertainty and preserves correlations between process disturbances, parameter error, and estimate updates to construct tight, guaranteed reachable sets that account for future information gain. We also develop a GPU-accelerated A-SLS solver to enable real-time performance. Across nonlinear robotic systems, A-SLS reduces reachable-tube conservativeness, maintains real-time performance, and scales to whole-body control for a quadruped with 61 states, 8 uncertain parameters, and 12 control inputs. We further demonstrate the approach on hardware, where a physical Crazyflie drone learns an uncertain dynamics parameter online to stabilize on the fly.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫A-SLS的GPU加速鲁棒自适应模型预测控制框架，能在实时控制中显式建模‘未来参数会越学越准’这一事实，从而大幅收紧可达集、减少保守性，并在四足机器人（61维状态）和Crazyflie无人机硬件上验证了在线学习不确定动力学参数并稳定飞行的能力
analysis.claim: 通过在规划阶段显式嵌入可证明的未来参数学习过程，能构造更紧致、有理论保证的可达集，从而在保持实时性和鲁棒性的同时显著降低传统RAMPC的保守性
analysis.input: 当前状态估计、在线参数估计及其协方差、过程扰动统计、控制约束
analysis.output: 实时生成的鲁棒最优控制序列（含理论保证的可行性与稳定性）
analysis.robot_dependency: Crazyflie无人机、四足机器人仿真（未指明具体平台，但实验含真实Crazyflie）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Crazyflie飞行数据进行在线参数学习验证；四足实验为仿真，未提真实机体数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将系统级合成（SLS）与可证明的在线参数学习闭环耦合，实现规划中对‘学习即降不确定性’的显式利用；真机验证+61维全身体控制+GPU实时求解，证据扎实；但未开源数据/完整benchmark，且未与World Models类长期记忆建模范式形成对比或整合，尚未达到开新范式级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将学习感知能力深度嵌入鲁棒MPC理论框架并实现实时硬件部署，是控制理论与具身学习交叉的重要推进，但非范式革命

papers.title: How Visible Are Silent Manipulation Failures? An Observability Study of False-Success Detection in Simulated Robot Episodes
papers.abstract: Imitation-learning policies for robot manipulation inherit the quality of the success labels attached to their training episodes, and those labels are usually produced by the robot's own success check. A particularly damaging error is the false success: an episode the robot logs as a success when the task outcome was actually wrong. We ask a narrow but practical question about these episodes. Once an episode has already been flagged as a success, how much of the information needed to overturn that label is present in proprioception, and how much requires vision? We build a simulated testbed on two bimanual ALOHA tasks, induce failures through environment perturbations rather than label edits, label every episode by privileged simulator state that the detector never sees, and keep only episodes the robot flagged as successful. We then compare detectors restricted to proprioception against a vision-based detector. We find that recoverability spans a wide range: in cube transfer the false successes are almost fully recoverable from joint data alone, while in peg insertion proprioception recovers only part of them and a vision detector closes most of the gap. We also show that the proprioceptive separability we measure rests on velocity differences far below any realistic sensor noise floor, so it is best read as an optimistic upper bound that a noiseless simulator inflates. We release the generation and evaluation pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究机器人模仿学习中‘假成功’（即机器人误判为成功但实际失败）的可观测性问题，用仿真环境生成真实失败却被机器人标记为成功的操作片段，然后测试仅靠关节传感器数据（本体感觉）能否识别这些错误，发现不同任务差异很大，且理论上的可分辨性在真实噪声下几乎不可行。
analysis.claim: 在机器人操纵任务中，假成功的可观测性高度依赖任务类型和模态：部分任务中本体感觉理论上可区分假成功，但该能力被现实传感器噪声完全淹没。
analysis.input: 仿真器中的本体感觉数据（关节位置/速度）或RGB图像
analysis.output: 二分类标签（真成功 / 假成功）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是重要的诊断性工作，揭示了模仿学习中success labeling的根本脆弱性，但仅限于仿真、单平台、双任务，无真实硬件验证，未提出修复方案，也未构建可复用的大规模数据集或新训练范式；相比DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等基石工作，它属于深度问题剖析而非系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把可观测性分析做细了，但仍是仿真内诊断工具，未跨出闭环改进或真实部署一步，暂时不用看

papers.title: KDM: embedding DNA/RNA motifs and sequences in a shared k-mer space for unified discovery, analysis and binding prediction
papers.abstract: Motif discovery and binding-site prediction in DNA and RNA sequences are central tasks in regulatory genomics, yet the methodological landscape is split between interpretable but rigid position weight matrices (PWMs) and high-performing but opaque machine-learning models. We present KDM, a unifying framework in which both motifs and sequences are represented as probability distributions over a shared k-mer dictionary, embedded via the Hellinger transformation. This common geometry enables motif-sequence scoring, motif-motif comparison, de novo discovery, and binding prediction with a single primitive, the Bhattacharyya coefficient. We instantiate four tools on this representation: KDMMap for positional enrichment analysis, KDMMatch for information-content-aware motif matching, KDMFind for unsupervised motif discovery via projective non-negative matrix factorization, and KDM-LRLM for binding prediction with Lasso-regularized logistic regression. Across 1,324 transcription-factor ChIP-seq and 161 RBP eCLIP experiments, KDMMap matches CentriMo's motif rankings in 84% of TF and 79% of RBP experiments, and KDMMatch agrees with Tomtom on motif annotation in 74.5% of TFs. On binding prediction across four datasets covering 2,475 experiments, KDM-LRLM matches or exceeds eight deep-learning and three k-mer-based competitors. Notably, AI methods overtake k-mer methods only in the top quartile of training-set size, indicating that data scale, not architecture, drives the recent dominance of deep models. KDM provides a single interpretable representation across the full motif-analysis workflow.

analysis.tldr: 提出KDM框架，将DNA/RNA序列和调控基序（motif）统一映射到共享的k-mer概率分布空间，用Hellinger变换嵌入、Bhattacharyya系数度量相似性，实现可解释的端到端基序分析：包括富集检测、匹配注释、无监督发现和结合预测。
analysis.claim: DNA/RNA基序与序列可在共享k-mer概率空间中统一表征，使所有核心基序分析任务（发现、比对、富集、预测）退化为同一几何空间中的简单相似性计算，兼顾可解释性与竞争力。
analysis.input: DNA或RNA序列（FASTA格式）、已知基序（如JASPAR/PWM格式）
analysis.output: 基序富集分数、基序匹配得分、新基序矩阵、结合概率预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开ChIP-seq/eCLIP等高通量测序数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在基序分析这一经典但长期割裂的领域，首次实现全栈任务（发现→匹配→富集→预测）的统一可解释表征；实证覆盖超1400个真实实验，性能匹敌主流工具（CentriMo/Tomtom）且超越多数k-mer方法，在中等数据规模下甚至媲美深度模型；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属监管基因组学中罕见的‘原理简洁+实证扎实+全流程覆盖’的重磅工程科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅工程整合——用几何统一性替代方法碎片化，所有任务共享同一可解释表示，证据充分、跨任务泛化强、已在真实大规模实验中验证

papers.title: PTDL:Multi-Terrain Fall Recovery via Phase-Terrain Decoupled Learning
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots can fall on slopes, gravel, and uneven ground in unstructured environments. We target integrated fall recovery and locomotion: rebuilding balance from a fallen state using proprioception alone and resuming velocity-commanded walking at the fall site. Prior methods often stop at quasi-static rise, neglect the post-fall ground-contact phase, or, when trained on mixed terrains without separating recovery and locomotion phases or per-surface constraints, collapse to a single compromise get-up across surfaces. We propose Phase--Terrain Decoupled Learning (PTDL), which decouples training supervision along phase and terrain axes while deploying one proprioceptive policy. On the phase axis, projected-gravity-gated dual motion-prior discriminators and a probe-to-walk transition link post-fall recovery to commanded walking. On the terrain axis, terrain-stratified recovery shaping assigns surface-specific training supervision on flat ground, gravel, and slopes; terrain labels are training-only and withheld from policy observations, enabling implicit post-fall strategy selection at deployment. We validate PTDL on a 29-DoF Unitree G1 across flat ground, gravel, and slopes up to 20 degrees in simulation and on hardware, achieving stable cross-terrain recovery, smooth recovery-to-locomotion transitions, and differentiated post-fall rise behaviors under one deployed policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出PTDL方法，让双足机器人仅靠本体感知就能在斜坡、碎石、不平地面等多地形摔倒后自主恢复平衡并无缝切换到速度指令驱动的行走，核心是把恢复阶段和地形类型两个维度解耦训练，但共用一个策略网络。
analysis.claim: 仅用本体感知输入、单个部署策略，即可实现跨地形（平地/碎石/斜坡）的摔倒恢复与指令行走的端到端闭环，且不同地形触发差异化的起身行为。
analysis.input: 本体感知信号（关节角度、角速度、IMU等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的多地形摔倒数据，硬件验证阶段使用真实G1机器人少量实测摔倒样本（未说明采集规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+三类典型非结构化地形+多任务闭环（摔倒→恢复→行走）+消融验证相位/地形解耦有效性，显著优于纯仿真或单地形方案，但未开源代码/模型，未对比SOTA基线（如H2O/ASAP的fall recovery模块），也未证明泛化到未见地形或新机体，属扎实的工程级突破而非范式级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实G1上实现了多地形摔倒恢复与行走的端到端闭环，解耦设计有实证支撑，但缺乏开源与广义泛化验证，尚未达到H2O/ASAP级分量

papers.title: Differences between protein fitness models can be used to design variants of altered specificity
papers.abstract: The vastness of sequence space makes it challenging for directed evolution to efficiently traverse the fitness landscape. In recent years, unsupervised probabilistic models trained on natural sequences have shown promise for predicting the functional effects of mutations and designing new proteins, leading many to suggest that these models may be useful for guiding directed evolution campaigns toward functional regions of sequence space. However, many directed evolution campaigns are interested in evolving new substrate or ligand specificity, and the behavior of unsupervised sequence models on predicting and designing activity against altered substrates or ligands has not been tested. We have built a curated database of multiplexed functional assay results profiling substrate or ligand specificity and systematically how assessed various popular unsupervised protein fitness models score and design variants that alter selectivity in these datasets. We find that sequence models that learn from the surrounding sequence context, especially protein language models, systematically bias against variants that alter specificity. This bias leads them to design altered-specificity variants at similar or lower rates than random chance. However, we propose a simple strategy to exploit this bias by taking weighted differences of model scores to enrich libraries for altered-specificity variants. These findings and our database should help guide how biologists best use protein fitness models and provide a framework to help machine learning researchers develop a new generation of machine learning models that can better design novelty.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现主流蛋白语言模型（如ESM）在预测/设计改变底物特异性的突变时存在系统性偏差（反而抑制特异性改变），并提出用多个模型打分的加权差值来反向富集这类突变，同时构建了首个专门用于评估特异性改变的多路功能实验数据库。
analysis.claim: 蛋白序列模型对特异性改变的预测存在可被利用的系统性负向偏差，其模型分差可转化为设计改变特异性的有效策略。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 底物/配体类型（多类别功能标签）
analysis.output: 预测的特异性改变概率 / 富集后的突变文库设计建议
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖高通量湿实验数据（multiplexed functional assays），无机器人交互
analysis.generalization: 跨底物、跨蛋白家族（在数据库覆盖范围内）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示主流PLM在特异性设计任务中的根本性失效机制，并给出可复现、经多蛋白-多底物实验证实的修正策略；数据库填补关键空白，但未发布新模型架构或端到端生成能力，未达AlphaFold/ESM级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是从零建模，而是精准诊断现有AI工具的盲区并给出可落地的实验级修正方案，证据充分、问题重要、策略已验证。

papers.title: Self-Improving VLA Policies: Selected Diffusion Noise for Spurious-Robust Action Smoothing
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies enable strong generalization in robotic manipulation, but remain sensitive to spurious visual correlations and noisy action generation, leading to brittle behavior under perturbations. We introduce Selected Diffusion Noise (SDN), a simple, training-free test-time method that improves both robustness and success rate by leveraging the diffusion noise space as a controllable degree of freedom. SDN dynamically samples noise vectors that are maximally separated from a reference set to mitigate reliance on spurious cues, while selecting candidates that yield more coherent action trajectories. This dual objective encourages stable behavior even under object-masked observations and reduces action jitter without modifying model parameters. We evaluate SDN on two simulation benchmarks (Google Robot, Widow-X) and two real-world robotic datasets across multiple VLA policies, including pi_0, Groot-N1.5, and Groot-N1.6. SDN consistently improves success rates by +8% in simulation and +10% in real-world settings, while producing smoother and more stable actions. Our results highlight that diffusion noise selection can serve as an effective and general mechanism for enhancing VLA policies at test time.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需训练的测试时技巧——从扩散模型的噪声空间中动态挑选与参考噪声最远、且能生成更连贯动作的噪声向量，来提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在遮挡和干扰下的鲁棒性与动作平滑性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv提交者多为越南/德国混合资深研究者，但无高校/企业标识）
analysis.claim: 扩散模型的噪声空间本身可作为测试时可控自由度，通过有选择地采样噪声而非固定或随机采样，即可显著提升VLA策略对虚假视觉线索的鲁棒性和动作轨迹稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节控制或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Widow-X / Google Robot仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖已发布的真机数据集（如RT-1、Bridge等衍生数据），但未采集新真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效（+8%~+10%成功率提升、动作更平滑），在多个VLA基线和仿真/真实设置上验证，但未开源代码、未提供消融实验细节、未挑战跨机体泛化或长期部署问题，属于扎实的测试时优化增量，未触及VLA建模本质瓶颈（如多模态对齐、时序因果建模），远未达RT-2/Octo/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是扩散VLA领域一次聪明的测试时调优实践，提升了鲁棒性与平滑性，但未改变模型结构、训练范式或数据需求，也未解决根本性的spurious correlation成因。

papers.title: Acting While Understanding: Asynchronous Semantic-Action Decoupling for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong task understanding and generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the high computational cost of full-model inference limits their deployment in low-latency, high-frequency closed-loop control. We propose an asynchronous semantic-action decoupling framework that separates semantic understanding from action generation along the internal semantic-action interface of existing VLAs, without redesigning the vision-language backbone or introducing an external planner. A low-frequency understanding module asynchronously updates reusable semantic conditions, while a high-frequency action module continuously outputs control actions without repeatedly invoking the full model. To mitigate the temporal mismatch between stale semantics and the current execution state, we further introduce historical action conditioning and time-misalignment training, which provide short-horizon execution context and improve feedback control robustness under stale semantic conditions. Experiments on LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$ and UniVLA, together with real-robot deployment using UniVLA, show that the proposed framework achieves up to 35.6 Hz server-side action-module inference throughput and offers a low-intrusion path to high-frequency closed-loop control without running full VLA inference at control rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种异步解耦机制，把视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的语义理解（慢速更新）和动作生成（高速执行）分开，避免每次控制周期都跑完整大模型，从而在不改模型结构的前提下将动作输出频率从几Hz提升到35.6Hz，并在真实机器人上验证了可行性。
analysis.claim: 无需修改现有VLA骨干网络或引入外部规划器，仅通过内部语义-动作接口的异步解耦与时间错位训练，即可实现高频率闭环控制下的低延迟动作输出。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 实时控制动作（关节速度/末端位姿增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: UniVLA仿真环境 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号，仅称‘real-robot deployment’）

papers.title: Pose-Agnostic Robotic Functional Grasping via Observation-Action Canonicalization
papers.abstract: Functional robotic grasping requires a policy that generalizes across diverse object geometries and poses while maintaining task-specific contact precision. We study this challenge through mug-handle grasping, where thin handles, instance variation, and upright or inverted placements make both perception and control sensitive to object configuration. Grasp pose detection methods operate open-loop and are sensitive to estimation errors on thin handle structures. Learned visuomotor policies must implicitly learn to handle the coupled variation in visual appearance and action direction induced by different object placements, limiting generalization. We propose AnyMug, a canonicalized visuomotor reinforcement learning framework for functional grasping that trains a single closed-loop policy entirely in simulation and deploys it zero-shot on a real robot. AnyMug introduces observation-action canonicalization, which transforms both the depth observation and the predicted end-effector action into a shared object-centric frame. The policy therefore sees a consistent mug-centered view and emits actions in a canonical direction regardless of mug placement, allowing the same grasping behavior to be reused across configurations. A handle-aware reward further encourages precise approach, gripper alignment, and opposing-finger placement, while a pose curriculum and domain randomization improve training stability and sim-to-real transfer. In simulation, AnyMug achieves over 93% success rate on both unseen upright and inverted mugs and transfers zero-shot to a real Franka Panda, reaching 80% success rate on 5 held-out physical mugs across both pose categories.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnyMug框架，通过将深度观测和机械臂动作统一映射到以物体为中心的规范坐标系，实现单个仿真训练的闭环策略在真实Franka Panda上对不同朝向（正立/倒置）和形状的杯子把手进行零样本功能抓取，成功率80%。
analysis.claim: 通过观察-动作规范化的思想解耦物体位姿变化对视觉感知与动作输出的联合扰动，使单一仿真训练的闭环策略可零样本泛化至真实机器人上的多朝向、多实例功能抓取任务。
analysis.input: 单帧深度图像
analysis.output: 6自由度末端执行器动作（含抓取姿态）

papers.title: X-Morph: Human Motion Priors for Scalable Robot Learning Across Morphologies
papers.abstract: Recent progress in humanoid behavior models has been driven in large part by abundant human motion data, but comparable motion data is scarce for non-humanoid legged robots such as quadrupeds, hexapods, and quadruped manipulators. A promising alternative is to repurpose human motion across embodiments; however, direct retargeting often produces motions that are visually plausible yet physically inconsistent or difficult to track under robot dynamics. We present X-Morph, a human-motion-to-robot-behavior pipeline that converts human motion into deployable locomotion and loco-manipulation policies for diverse non-humanoid legged morphologies. A cross-morphology retargeting stage converts human motions into kinematically plausible, intent-preserving robot references, which are then tracked by a privileged RL policy and distilled into a causal student policy. We evaluate X-Morph on three morphologically distinct platforms: a quadruped, a hexapod, and a quadruped equipped with a manipulator. The resulting policies track diverse retargeted motions, generalize to unseen human motions, and support downstream use cases including video-based teleoperation, behavior-prior control, and text-conditioned motion generation. These results suggest that large-scale human motion can serve as a substrate for learning broad, reusable behavior priors beyond humanoid robots. Project page: https://maker-rat.github.io/morph/

analysis.tldr: 用人类动作数据（如AMASS）作为先验，通过跨形态重定向+特权强化学习+因果蒸馏，生成适配四足、六足、带机械臂四足机器人的可部署运动与运动操作策略，无需各平台的真实机器人运动数据。
analysis.claim: 人类运动数据可作为通用行为先验，支撑跨形态（非人形腿式机器人）的可部署策略学习，且无需目标机体的真实运动数据。
analysis.input: 人类动作序列（如AMASS中的SMPL参数）、机器人形态参数（关节数、连杆结构）
analysis.output: 机器人关节轨迹（locomotion）或关节+末端位姿轨迹（loco-manipulation）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + 自研morph-aware simulator（含动力学模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人运动数据依赖；仅需仿真中合成的少量奖励信号（无真实轨迹监督）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性验证人类动作先验对非人形腿式机器人策略泛化的可行性，三类差异显著机体+多下游任务（视频遥操/文本生成）实证扎实，但全部实验限于仿真、无真机部署、无消融验证蒸馏模块必要性，未达DROID/ALOHA级工程闭环或Open X-Embodiment级跨平台数据基建深度。

papers.title: Embodied.cpp: A Portable Inference Runtime of Embodied AI Models on Heterogeneous Robots
papers.abstract: Embodied AI models now span vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs), but practical deployment remains fragmented across model-specific Python stacks, backend assumptions, and robot-side glue code, especially on heterogeneous edge devices. Existing inference runtimes are designed mainly for request-response serving and therefore do not satisfy the runtime contract of embodied deployment: multi-rate execution inside closed-loop control, latency-first batch-1 inference on heterogeneous hardware, and extensible embodied interfaces beyond fixed token I/O. We present Embodied.cpp, a portable C++ inference runtime for embodied models. Based on an architectural analysis of representative VLA models and WAMs, Embodied.cpp captures a shared execution path and organizes it into five layers: input adapters, sequence builders, backbone execution, head plugins, and deployment adapters. The runtime provides modular multi-rate execution, latency-first fused inference, and extensible operator and I/O support, enabling deployment across heterogeneous devices, robots, and simulators through one backend abstraction. We evaluate Embodied.cpp on two VLA models, HY-VLA and pi0.5, and on a preliminary WAM benchmark using a LingBot-VA Transformer block. The VLA deployments achieve successful closed-loop execution with 100.0% and 91.0% task success rates, respectively. The WAM benchmark reduces block memory from 312.2 MiB to 88.1 MiB. These results show that Embodied.cpp improves deployment efficiency while preserving high accuracy across diverse embodied model architectures.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Embodied.cpp的C++推理运行时，把不同具身AI模型（VLA/WAM）的共性执行流程抽象成五层架构，让它们能统一、低延迟、多速率地部署到各种机器人和边缘设备上，不依赖Python栈，实测在两个VLA模型和一个WAM模块上提升了部署效率（如内存减至1/3.5）且保持高任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；姓名风格含中文名但无 affiliation 提示）
