papers.title: Isoform-level resolution in single-cell CRISPR screens reveals hidden functional consequences of gene perturbation
papers.abstract: Single-cell CRISPR screens have enabled systematic investigation of gene function, but studies have largely focused on gene-level effects, overlooking transcriptional complexity and isoform usage. Methods capable of capturing splicing and isoform usage have emerged, including long-read sequencing and alternative library preparation strategies, but their suitability for large-scale perturbation screens remains unevaluated. We compare two library preparation methods (10x Genomics and Parse Biosciences) across Illumina short-read, Oxford Nanopore, and PacBio long-read sequencing, applying CRISPRi to silence three genes with distinct regulatory roles (DDX6, GEMIN5, GFI1B) in K562 cells. While short-read methods detected some splicing events, only long-read sequencing consistently captured isoform-level changes. Although Parse provided even transcript coverage, we observed strong intronic read enrichment, limiting its utility for splicing analysis. The primary constraint of long-read approaches was sequencing depth: ~21 million reads are needed for 80% saturation of splicing events in a single perturbation. Notably, GEMIN5 knockdown produced only modest differential expression but the most extensive splicing changes, an effect invisible to gene-level analysis, underscoring the value of isoform-level screens. We provide a practical framework for isoform-level analysis in single-cell CRISPR screens, identifying current capabilities and limitations. As perturbation studies scale, long-read sequencing will be essential for comprehensive functional interpretation, capturing biology missed by gene-level analysis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了短读长和长读长测序技术在单细胞CRISPR筛选中解析基因剪接异构体（isoform）变化的能力，发现只有长读长测序（Nanopore/PacBio）能稳定检测到扰动引起的异构体层面变化，而传统基因水平分析会漏掉关键功能效应（如GEMIN5敲降几乎不改变基因表达量，却引发最广泛的剪接异常），并量化了实现80%剪接事件饱和检测所需的最低测序深度（约2100万reads）。
analysis.claim: 在单细胞CRISPR筛选中，仅靠基因水平表达分析会系统性遗漏由剪接调控介导的功能性扰动后果，必须结合长读长测序才能可靠捕获isoform-level表型。
analysis.input: CRISPRi扰动的K562单细胞样本（含DDX6/GEMIN5/GFI1B三个靶基因）、两种建库方法（10x/Parse）与三种测序平台（Illumina/Nanopore/PacBio）的组合数据
analysis.output: isoform-level剪接变化谱（含具体可变剪接事件、isoform比例偏移）、测序饱和度曲线、方法适用性评估结论
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单细胞CRISPR筛选中完成多平台、多建库策略的isoform解析能力实证比对，用真实扰动数据证明基因水平分析存在重大盲区（GEMIN5案例），并给出可复现的测序深度量化阈值；但仅限K562细胞系和3个基因，未扩展至原代细胞、体内模型或高通量规模，也未提出新算法或模型，属于扎实的方法学验证与范式提醒，而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨实验设计证实了单细胞CRISPR筛选中isoform层面分析的必要性与可行性，填补了方法学评估空白，但受限于细胞系和规模，尚未构成范式革命。

papers.title: Reverse to Advance: Teleoperation-Cost Effective Hard Policy Learning from Reversed Easy Tasks
papers.abstract: High-quality teleoperation datasets are costly to collect, particularly for hard tasks. We observe that many tasks exhibit directional asymmetry: completing the forward hard task is difficult, whereas reversing it by relaxing or disrupting the environment is comparatively easy. This suggests that reversed easy-task trajectories can serve as a scalable supervision signal for the hard task, reducing the cost of manual demonstration collection. However, reversed data can be noisy, and directly training on it may yield suboptimal policies. To enable largely automated acquisition and effective use of reversed data, we propose a teleoperation-cost effective framework for hard policy learning via temporal reversal of easy tasks, consisting of three key components: a closed-loop data collection pipeline that alternates between hard-task and easy-task policies to autonomously reset the environment and generate diverse trajectories; a hierarchical data refinement pipeline that temporally inverts easy-task rollouts and filters low-quality motion using kinematic priors and a critic-guided advantage filter; and an iterative policy learning method that trains the hard-task policy using both initial reversed easy-task demonstrations and the filtered reversed data in a continuous online learning loop. By combining automated collection, hierarchical refinement, and iterative learning, our method enables scalable, reliable training of complex, high-precision manipulation tasks. Across two simulated benchmarks and real-robot experiments, we demonstrate that our method improves hard-task success rates with higher data efficiency and more stable training compared to reversal-based and reinforcement-learning baselines, without requiring extensive hard-task teleoperation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用‘反向简单任务’（比如把拼好的积木打乱）的自动采集数据来替代昂贵的人工遥操作示范，通过时间反转、运动学过滤和 critic 指导筛选，再迭代训练出能完成正向困难任务（如精准拼装）的策略，显著降低对真实遥操作数据的依赖。
analysis.claim: 方向不对称性（forward hard / backward easy）可被系统性利用：通过自动化采集+时间反转+分层过滤的闭环流程，用零/极少硬任务遥操作数据即可训练出高成功率的复杂操作策略。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节/末端位姿）、环境观测（模拟中为状态向量或RGB-D，实机应含视觉/触觉等）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（关节速度或末端力矩控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（实机部分）；Isaac Gym / PyBullet（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需极少量（甚至零）硬任务遥操作数据；依赖大量自动采集的易任务（含环境扰动）轨迹及其反转数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机械臂上验证了跨任务泛化（如从插销到穿环），有完整闭环数据生成+critic引导过滤+在线迭代学习三阶段设计，对比基线显示更高数据效率与稳定性；但未开源数据集、未覆盖多机体/多用户、未解决触觉/残差自适应等基石工作已突破的方向，属扎实推进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将方向不对称性观察转化为可落地的全自动数据蒸馏流水线，在真机上实现高精度操作的低成本训练，但未触及具身智能的核心泛化瓶颈（如跨硬件/跨模态鲁棒性）

papers.title: Asynchronous Multimodal Diffusion Policy Composition via Latency-Aware Guidance Fusion
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong potential for robotic imitation learning, and recent extensions incorporate additional modalities to improve manipulation performance. However, these modalities often differ not only in information content but also in sensing rates and inference latencies. Existing multimodal diffusion policies typically rely on synchronous fusion or manually designed multi-frequency architectures, which either slow down high-frequency feedback or limit extensibility to new modality combinations. We propose LAG-Fusion, a latency-aware guidance fusion framework for asynchronous multimodal diffusion policy composition. LAG-Fusion allows modality-specific policies to operate at their native inference rates and contribute denoising guidance whenever available. To make asynchronous composition consistent, we derive a reference-frame rebasing rule for diffusion variables under relative action representations, enabling delayed guidance to be aligned before fusion. We instantiate LAG-Fusion in contact-rich manipulation by composing a low-frequency vision policy with a high-frequency force policy. Experiments under heterogeneous modality latencies show that LAG-Fusion improves policy responsiveness and task performance over synchronous fusion and specially designed force-aware baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LAG-Fusion的框架，让机器人不同传感器（比如视觉和力觉）以各自天然速度异步运行，并把它们在扩散策略中的去噪指导动态对齐融合，解决了多模态感知延迟不一致导致的响应滞后问题。
analysis.claim: 异步多模态扩散策略可通过延迟感知的指导融合与参考帧重基化实现一致、高效、可扩展的实时控制。
analysis.input: 多模态观测流（如RGB图像、六维力/扭矩），各模态按其原生采样率异步输入
analysis.output: 扩散生成的动作序列（相对动作表示下的去噪轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（实验提及contact-rich manipulation，但未指明具体平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的异步多模态数据（摘要称“experiments under heterogeneous modality latencies”，隐含真实部署验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决扩散策略中多模态异步融合的时序对齐问题，理论推导（参考帧重基化）扎实，且在接触式操作任务上实证优于同步融合和定制力觉基线；但仅验证单一组合（视觉+力）、未跨机体/任务泛化、无开源数据集、未开放模型权重，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法论层面（异步扩散指导融合），但实证范围窄、复现门槛高，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: GuidedAttention: Interpretable and Correctable Visual Attention for OOD-Robust Robot Manipulation via Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: End-to-end visuomotor policies provide little opportunity for humans to understand or correct the policy's visual attention. We propose GuidedAttention, a visuomotor imitation learning framework that introduces interpretable and correctable visual attention as an explicit intermediate representation. Task-relevant attention keypoints are predicted from camera images and condition a diffusion-based action policy. Users can inspect and optionally correct selected keypoints once at rollout initialization, after which the corrected attention is automatically propagated throughout execution by a tracking module. Experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that GuidedAttention consistently improves robot manipulation performance, particularly under positional and appearance out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GuidedAttention的模仿学习框架，让机器人在视觉操作中能显式生成可被人类查看和手动修正的关键点注意力区域，再用这些关键点驱动扩散策略做动作，修正后还能自动跟踪传播到后续动作帧，从而提升面对位置或外观分布外（OOD）场景的鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 显式建模、可解释且可人工修正的视觉注意力中间表征，能显著提升端到端视觉运动策略在分布外场景下的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节/末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要未提具体规模，但强调real-world实验），仿真中使用合成数据训练，真实部署需微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将可编辑注意力作为显式中间表示嵌入扩散策略流程，并验证其对OOD鲁棒性的实际增益；但仅在单一机械臂+简单抓取/推移任务上验证，无跨机体/跨用户/多任务消融，真实世界实验规模小（未说明任务数/样本量/失败率），开源程度仅限项目页（无代码/模型/数据），未挑战接触密集、灵巧操作或长时序闭环控制等核心难点，属扎实但窄域的机制创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把可编辑注意力与扩散策略做了有实证支撑的耦合设计，在OOD鲁棒性上有明确改进，但任务范围窄、实证深度有限、开源不足，尚未达到基石级方法的通用性与分量。

papers.title: Synthetic Combinatorial Minimisation of Cell Cycle Control in Yeast
papers.abstract: The eukaryotic cell cycle, with its inherent regulatory redundancy, provides an ideal target for exploring genome modularisation and minimisation through synthetic genomics. Building upon principles established by the Synthetic Yeast Genome (Sc2.0) project, we used CRISPR- mediated genome engineering to relocate nine key cell cycle genes into a synthetic gene cluster in the S. cerevisiae genome, to allow combinatorial study of these genes in yeast. We employed Cre/loxP recombination to rapidly generate hundreds of strains with different gene deletion combinations in the module, with the objective of identifying minimal gene sets that permit robust cell cycle function. Using FACS-sorting and POLAR (Pool of Long Amplified Reads) sequencing, we conducted high-throughput analysis of gene deletion combinations in large cell pools, detecting approximately 80% of theoretically possible gene combinations, including those predicted from prior mathematical modelling studies. Our findings demonstrate that the cell cycle gene set can be minimised while maintaining viability, though only select combinations of gene deletions ensure robust fitness across different conditions. This work establishes a framework for genome minimisation, opening the door to the design of simplified, modular synthetic genomes for diverse applications.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPR和Cre/loxP在酵母中构建可组合删减的细胞周期基因簇，高通量筛选出能在多种条件下维持稳健增殖的最小基因集合，建立了一套可扩展的基因组模块化简化方法论。
analysis.claim: 真核细胞周期调控网络存在功能冗余，可通过合成基因组学手段系统性删减并识别维持稳健细胞周期所需的最小基因组合。
analysis.input: 酵母基因组中九个细胞周期基因的合成簇结构、Cre/loxP介导的重组逻辑、FACS分选信号、POLAR测序读长
analysis.output: 支持稳健细胞周期的最小基因组合列表（含条件依赖性）、各组合在不同培养条件下的适应度量化值
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实验设计扎实（CRISPR+Cre/loxP+POLAR+FACS多技术闭环），覆盖80%理论组合并验证条件鲁棒性，但仅限单种模式生物（S. cerevisiae）和单一生物学过程（细胞周期），未拓展至其他通路或跨物种，也未提供通用建模框架或开源完整数据集，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次在真核细胞周期中实现高通量、可编程的合成基因组删减筛选，并实证最小功能集的条件依赖性，但未突破酵母体系边界，也未形成可迁移的通用平台。

papers.title: Rich structure alphabets enable highest accuracy protein search
papers.abstract: Protein structure databases have grown from thousands of experimentally determined structures to hundreds of millions of AI-predicted models, creating an urgent need for search methods that combine high accuracy with practical scalability. Here, I present the third generation of Reseek, a protein structure search algorithm achieving the highest overall accuracy (median rank 1) according to diverse metrics among tested methods including DALI, Foldseek and TM-align. Improved accuracy is obtained by parallel sequence alignment of many discrete alphabets capturing primary, secondary and tertiary features, giving a combined space of ~10^22 possible states. Separate statistical models are optimized for family, superfamily and fold discrimination, respectively, revealing distinct combinations of features that characterize each level. Hundreds of query structures can be searched a against a multimillion-structure database on a server computer in minutes, making large-scale structure search at state-of-the-art accuracy practical on commodity hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出Reseek v3，一种基于多层级结构字母表并行比对的蛋白质结构搜索算法，在多个基准上达到中位排名1的最高精度，能在普通服务器上几分钟内完成百万级数据库的高精度搜索。
analysis.claim: 通过构建涵盖一级、二级、三级结构特征的离散‘丰富结构字母表’并行比对，配合针对家族/超家族/折叠层级分别优化的统计模型，Reseek v3在保持可扩展性的同时实现了当前最高的蛋白质结构搜索精度。
analysis.input: 查询蛋白的三维结构（PDB格式或等效表示）
analysis.output: 数据库中结构相似度排序列表（含rank、Z-score、分类层级判别）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在结构搜索精度上超越DALI/Foldseek/TM-align等经典工具，但未引入新范式（如端到端深度学习建模、生成式结构理解或物理驱动建模），本质是传统比对+统计模型的工程化升级；缺乏开源代码与模型权重，仅提供项目页和预编译二进制，复现受限；性能提升未在AlphaFold2/ESMFold/RFDiffusion等基石工作定义的新任务（如从头生成、动态构象预测、功能位点推断）上体现价值，仍局限于经典静态结构检索场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：显著优化了传统结构比对的精度与效率，但未突破方法论边界，也未解决AI×生物领域当前的核心瓶颈（如生成、泛化、可解释性），属于扎实的增量型工具升级。

papers.title: HI-JEPA: A World Model of Molecular Organization Learned from Measured Proximity
papers.abstract: Proteins act through the company they keep. Which molecules occupy the same nanoscale neighborhood in intact tissue determines what can physically interact, and disease rearranges those neighborhoods before it changes anything a sequence records. That quantity (measured proximity between molecular species in unperturbed tissue) has never been acquired broadly enough to train on. Published colocalization arrives study by study and never accumulates into a graph. The measurement has to be made rather than collected. We built ASCEND, a spatial computing platform that measures pairwise molecular proximity from expansion microscopy at molecular resolution in intact tissue, and applied it to 164 proteins across 37 imaged regions in five studies, spanning cultured neurons, isolated synapses and mouse cortex in disease and control. HI-JEPA is a representation trained on those measurements. Each protein is one embedding, trained to predict the embeddings of its measured neighbors in latent space; it never reconstructs its input and generates no negatives. A set of proteins measured in one neighborhood forms a configuration, which is the object the model perturbs and plans over. The representation performs operations a sequence model cannot. It names a protein from the bare geometry of a microscopy point cloud, matched against 234,048 deposited structures, at top-1 accuracy 0.748 against a chance rate of 1.0 x 10^-5. It predicts physical interaction between sequence-dissimilar proteins that were both withheld from training at AUC 0.908, where ESM-C 6B reaches 0.514 against partner-count-matched negatives. It recovers a held-out complex member in the top 100 of 13,447 candidates at recall 0.954, against 0.514 for a ranking built from complex frequency alone. Asked which partners a knockout disrupts, it recovers the experimentally observed ones at recall@100 0.640; asked the same question about a different protein, with the ranking rule and denominators unchanged, it recovers 0.028, so the answer follows the action. Given 5xFAD mouse cortex with no disease label, no reward and no indication that amyloid is relevant, ranking 1,574 measured assemblies by their departure from wild type returns amyloid-beta bound to AMPA receptor subunits in nine of the top ten. Planning over the same configurations independently selects the same subunits (GluA2, GluA3, GluA4) and predicts that disrupting the PSD-95 scaffold worsens the configuration, both agreeing in sign with experiments the model never saw. Ablating the measured-proximity channel at training time degrades cross-scale partner recovery from median rank 14 to 68 while leaving navigation and within-scale dynamics intact; ablating the perturbation channel does the reverse. The cross-scale capability therefore comes from the measurement and not from having seen more data. The intended application is target nomination in diseases where sequence and structure supply no starting point. Note: This is a capability report. The architecture, the training procedure and the acquisition protocol are proprietary and are not described. Section 4.2 gives the evaluation protocol behind every number reported.

analysis.tldr: 用新型空间成像技术ASCEND测量了164种蛋白在完整组织中的真实纳米级邻近关系，训练出HI-JEPA世界模型，能仅凭显微镜点云几何结构识别蛋白、预测物理互作、恢复复合物成员、定位疾病扰动靶点，且所有能力均基于实测邻近性而非序列或结构先验。
analysis.claim: 分子在未扰动组织中的实测空间邻近性构成一种可学习的‘分子组织世界模型’，其蕴含的生物学信息远超序列与结构，能直接支撑跨尺度（从点云→复合物→通路→疾病表型）的因果推理与靶点发现。
analysis.input: 显微镜点云（蛋白质空间坐标+标识）、邻近性图（实测的分子对共定位）
analysis.output: 蛋白嵌入向量、邻近性预测、复合物成员排序、扰动响应排名、亚细胞配置变化方向
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖ASCEND平台生成的原始空间邻近数据；无公开替代数据源；数据不可复现采集（需专用扩展显微镜+定制标记流程）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建并验证了以原位实测空间邻近性为唯一监督信号的分子世界模型，在跨尺度推理（点云→复合物→疾病扰动）上实现系统性突破，证据强度对标CENO（97分）：多层级严格消融（邻近通道/扰动通道）、全盲预测（无疾病标签/无amyloid提示下召回Aβ-AMPA）、实验一致性验证（PSD-95扰动预测符号与实测一致），且解决的是长期空白——序列/结构无法覆盖的‘组织原位功能语境’问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是用AI拟合已知生物学，而是用新测量范式定义了新的生物学表征空间，并证明该空间可被建模为世界模型，直接驱动靶点发现。

papers.title: Learning protein function through autonomous experimental interaction
papers.abstract: Biological AI learns primarily from existing observations, but many questions cannot be answered from available data alone. Here we show that AI can instead acquire knowledge by acting directly on biological systems and learning from the consequences. We developed a closed-loop framework in which autonomous agents design protein variants, construct and characterize them in a robotic laboratory, learn from the resulting experimental feedback, and decide what experiments to perform next. We then allowed the system to operate continuously and without human intervention for approximately one month, during which multiple agents independently explored protein sequence space while learning from shared experimental experience. Applied to glycoside hydrolases, the agents discovered enzymes with substantially altered substrate specificity toward non-native sugars and progressively learned the structure of the underlying sequence-function landscape. The resulting experimental experience also revealed determinants of substrate specificity and protein expression that were not specified as learning objectives. These results demonstrate that AI can autonomously interact with biology over extended periods to acquire knowledge through experience, establishing a framework for biological discovery driven by continuous experimental interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个全自动闭环系统：AI代理自主设计蛋白质突变序列，调用机器人实验室合成并测试这些蛋白，根据实验结果（如酶活性、表达量）更新模型，再决定下一步测什么，连续无人干预运行一个月，成功发现了能识别非天然糖类的新酶，并反向揭示了影响底物特异性和蛋白表达的关键序列规律。
analysis.org: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
analysis.claim: AI可以通过持续、自主、闭环的实验交互（而不仅是分析已有数据）在生物学中获得新知识，并发现未预设目标的隐性功能规律。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列、实验目标（如底物特异性优化）、历史实验结果（活性/表达量等定量读数）
analysis.output: 待实验的蛋白质突变设计方案（即下一组要合成测试的序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化机器人湿实验室（含DNA合成、克隆、表达、纯化、酶活检测模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验产生的新数据；无预训练数据集，所有学习均来自该系统自身产出的约1个月实验数据（数百个蛋白变体）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现长达一个月、多代理共享经验、全自主决策→执行→学习闭环的生物实验AI系统，真机部署、多轮迭代、发现未设目标的生物学机制（如表达与特异性的耦合），其范式意义堪比早期AlphaFold对结构预测的启蒙价值，虽技术深度不及AlphaFold2，但在‘AI驱动实验科学’这一新兴范式中属奠基级工作，显著超越同期纯仿真或单轮优化研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模型，而是确立了‘AI作为自主实验科学家’的新范式，且已在真实生物实验室中持续验证。

papers.title: Pre-training Visual Dexterity in Simulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale pre-training has made robot policy fine-tuning increasingly data-efficient, but this progress has largely been driven by datasets and embodiments built around simple parallel-jaw grippers. Dexterous, multi-fingered hands remain comparatively data-starved because real teleoperation is costly to scale, while human hand video is off-embodiment and requires lossy pose estimation and retargeting. We introduce Simulation Pre-training for Dexterity (SPD), a pre-training framework for dexterous manipulation that uses data entirely collected in simulation. In SPD, humans manipulate virtual objects inside a VR headset, enabling on-embodiment trajectories and robot-free collection. With the help of five operators, we collect 75 hours of multi-task dexterous manipulation over one week, and use it to pre-train a causal transformer on a sequence modeling objective. We study the benefits of simulation pre-training on real-world tasks by fine-tuning on 1-2 hours of physical demonstrations on a 56-DoF bimanual dexterous setup. We find that our approach outperforms training behavior cloning policies from scratch, showing that simulation teleoperation is a viable pre-training source for real-world dexterous manipulation. We perform ablation studies, measuring the benefits of history conditioning and short action chunks for reactive control.

analysis.tldr: 用VR头显让真人操作虚拟多指手完成75小时多任务仿真操作，以此预训练因果Transformer模型，再用1-2小时真实机器人演示微调，显著提升真实双手机器手灵巧操作性能。
analysis.claim: 纯仿真中采集的、人类在VR内操控虚拟灵巧手的数据，可作为高质量预训练信号，有效迁移至真实灵巧机器人操作任务。
analysis.input: VR中采集的多模态动作序列（手部关节+物体位姿+视觉帧）
analysis.output: 动作块（short action chunks）序列，用于反应式控制
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据用于预训练，仅微调阶段需少量真实演示
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证VR仿真灵巧操作数据可作为强预训练源，真机微调仅用1-2小时即超越从零训练，含消融（历史条件/动作分块），但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源代码与数据，未接入主流灵巧平台（如Shadow/DexLab/Allegro），规模与开放性弱于DROID/ALOHA级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：方法设计扎实、实验闭环可信，是sim2real在灵巧操作上的重要工程推进，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: An open multimodal spatial resource integrating same-tissue transcriptomics, proteomics, and histology
papers.abstract: Spatial transcriptomic and proteomic technologies provide complementary insights into tissue organisation, cellular phenotype and function, yet integrating these modalities on the same tissue section remains technically challenging. Sequential workflows must preserve RNA integrity, antigenicity and tissue morphology while maintaining accurate spatial registration. At present, publicly available multimodal datasets suitable for computational method development remain limited. Here, we present a workflow for sequential 10x Genomics Xenium spatial transcriptomics, COMET cyclic immunofluorescence, and haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histological staining on the same formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue section. We demonstrate this approach across multiple biologically distinct human tissues, including tonsil, hepatocellular adenoma, and matched tumour and non-tumour hepatocellular carcinoma, illustrating the widespread applicability of the workflow beyond a single tissue type. Following image registration, Xenium-derived cell segmentations were applied to protein images to generate integrated single-cell transcriptomic and proteomic measurements for downstream analyses. To facilitate community reuse, we publicly release four representative aligned tissue cores together with transcript coordinates, multiplex protein images, H&E images, cell segmentations, and integrated single-cell datasets. We additionally introduce UnumLocalia, an open-source visualisation and data extraction tool that enables interactive exploration of aligned multimodal images, supports user-defined cell segmentation, and allows export of integrated single-cell data for downstream analyses. Together, this technical protocol, workflow, software, and openly available dataset provide a reusable resource for multimodal spatial biology, supporting advances in biological discovery, computational method development, multimodal data integration, and validation of emerging analytical approaches across complementary spatial technologies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一套能在同一张石蜡包埋组织切片上依次完成空间转录组（Xenium）、多重蛋白成像（COMET）和H&E染色的技术流程，并公开了4个配准好的多模态组织数据集及配套开源可视化工具UnumLocalia，供社区用于方法开发和跨模态整合验证。
analysis.claim: 在同一FFPE组织切片上实现RNA、蛋白与组织形态学三模态空间数据的保真、可注册、可复现的顺序采集，并提供首个公开的、经严格图像配准的同切片多模态单细胞级整合资源。
analysis.input: 同一张FFPE组织切片（含RNA、抗原表位、组织结构）
analysis.output: 配准后的多模态图像（Xenium转录坐标+COMET蛋白荧光+H&E）、细胞级联合特征矩阵（每个细胞含空间转录+蛋白表达+形态学注释）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于病理切片扫描与成像平台（如Xenium仪器、显微镜），无自动化操作或闭环控制
analysis.significance_reason: 虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但首次系统解决同切片三模态（转录+蛋白+形态）保真采集与配准这一长期技术瓶颈，提供首个高质量、多组织、开源、带cell-level对齐的基准数据集与工具链，实证扎实（3种组织+匹配癌/非癌样本+完整配准+消融式流程验证），显著推动空间多组学方法学开发与交叉验证，属75–89分档的重磅资源型贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是算法突破，而是构建了当前空间生物学最稀缺的‘黄金标准’多模态对齐基础设施，其价值在于让后续所有模型都有可靠ground truth可依

papers.title: Towards Professional Tennis Styles for Humanoid Robots with Adaptive Motion Planning and Tracking
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in real-world ball sports. However, achieving professional motion styles while maintaining strong task performance remains challenging. In this work, we propose AdaPT, an Adaptive Motion Planning and Tracking framework that learns professional tennis serving and rally styles directly from broadcast videos. This hierarchical design is motivated by the key insight that the planner generates stylistic kinematic motions, while the tracker executes them with minimal interference with planning. Despite its effectiveness in simulation, a substantial sim-to-real gap emerges: tracking performance inevitably degrades on real robots, and this degradation is partially overlooked by autoregressive planning and further compounded by noisy perception. To address these issues, our adaptation mechanism improves tracking robustness by learning to track randomized execution speeds, while conditioning the planner on a learned motion-speed adapter to mitigate compounding errors. Real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate the effectiveness of our adaptation mechanism in bridging the sim-to-real gap. We further deploy AdaPT policies on the full-size Dobot Atom humanoid robot (1.7m) and demonstrate in-the-wild serving without motion capture. Beyond these results, our real-world experiments reveal both algorithmic and engineering insights for future humanoid ball-sports systems. Videos and code are available on our \href{https://humanoidtennis.github.io/AdaPT/}{project website}.

analysis.tldr: 用广播网球视频直接学习专业级发球和对打动作风格，提出分层框架AdaPT（规划器生成风格化运动学轨迹，跟踪器鲁棒执行），通过速度随机化训练和运动速度适配器缓解仿真到真实机器人的跟踪退化，在Unitree G1和1.7米Dobot Atom上实测无动捕完成野外发球。
analysis.claim: 仅靠广播视频即可让双足机器人复现职业网球手的运动风格，且在真实大尺寸人形机器人上实现无动捕、开环式发球。
analysis.input: 广播网球视频帧序列（含人体姿态与球轨迹）
analysis.output: 关节级运动轨迹（含节奏、发力时序、身体旋转等风格特征）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运动数据；依赖广播视频中提取的人体2D/3D姿态，但未使用任何真实机器人采集的动作捕捉或力控数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在全尺寸人形机器人（Dobot Atom）上实现无动捕、基于视频学习的职业网球发球，跨机体部署成功且有真实场景视频证据；但未做多任务泛化（仅发球+简单对打）、无严格baseline对比、未开源数据与仿真环境，相比Human-as-Humanoid（95分）等真正打通人类视频→人形策略→多任务迁移的范式工作，仍属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实大尺寸人形上实现了高难度视频驱动风格化运动部署，但缺乏跨任务泛化、消融不充分、数据与仿真不可复现，尚未达到开新范式的量级。

papers.title: Inferring Action from Future Latent State for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) build robot control on video-generation backbones, which jointly predict dense future visual trajectories and robot actions. We argue that video generation is an unnecessary intermediate objective for world-action modeling. For robotic manipulation, the goal of a world model is not to reproduce how the world looks at every intermediate moment, but to predict the state that the world will reach after an action is executed. The intermediate frames only describe the visual transition between physical states, which consumes substantial model capacity and computation, but do not directly specify the physical outcome that the robot action is intended to produce. In this paper, we propose DELE-w0.5, which infers robot actions from predicted future states without relying on video generation. Concretely, DELE-w0.5 infers the action sequence from its corresponding compact future latent state. The future latent state captures the action-relevant physical outcome of robot interaction and serves as an explicit bridge between world modeling and action generation. The core design principle of DELE-w0.5 is to model how the physical world changes under robot actions, rather than how its visual appearance evolves frame by frame. This formulation removes the high-dimensional visual redundancy introduced by dense video representations, and it therefore enables cheaper training and low-latency inference. Across 480 real-robot trials on four long-horizon manipulation tasks, our DELE-w0.5 achieves the best performance among all compared policies, attaining 62.5 overall full-task success and 81.3 macro ordered-stage progress, outperforming the strongest baseline by 47.5 and 30.7 percentage points, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DELE-w0.5模型，不生成未来视频帧，而是直接预测动作所导致的紧凑未来物理状态（latent state），再据此反推动作序列，在480次真实机器人长程操作任务中显著超越所有基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅从姓名风格无法可靠判断归属）
analysis.claim: 对机器人操作而言，世界-动作建模不应以视频生成为中间目标，而应直接建模动作到未来物理状态的映射，并以此隐式定义动作生成。
analysis.input: 当前观测（含视觉等多模态输入，具体未明说但隐含于world model上下文）
analysis.output: 动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验基于real-robot）

papers.title: FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models~(VLAs) have demonstrated significant promise in generalizing to complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. However, their performance remains brittle, as they are typically trained on trajectory-monotonic, failure-free demonstrations. This reliance on ``perfect" data leaves them unable to recover from common execution errors, such as a missed grasp, a dropped object, or an unexpected collision. In this paper, we propose FLARE, a novel framework that endows VLAs with robust error recovery capabilities through a ``Retry" and ``Reset" paradigm. First, we introduce a ``Retry" mechanism by injecting perturbation and bridging segments that decouple robot pose from environment state into demonstrations, enabling the policy to autonomously handle execution deviations. Second, to address critical, state-breaking (OOD) failures, we introduce a ``Reset" pipeline. We leverage an MLLM for offline failure analysis to automatically identify OOD states from execution videos. This analysis enables the efficient, targeted collection of a small library of object-centric ``Reset" skills, which are trained to restore the environment to a task-valid state. Our full framework integrates these learned policies. At inference, an online MLLM monitor arbitrates between task execution and ``Reset" skills. Experiments on challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks show our approach significantly improves task success and robustness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FLARE框架，让视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在机器人抓取操作出错时能自动判断错误类型并选择重试（Retry）或重置环境（Reset），其中Reset依赖多模态大模型分析视频识别异常状态，并调用少量预训练的物体中心重置技能来恢复任务条件。
analysis.claim: 通过引入Failure-Aware的Retry+Reset双机制，VLAs可在接触密集型操作中自主检测、分类并恢复常见执行失败，显著提升端到端策略的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB视频流 + 语言任务指令 + 实时机器人状态（关节/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含Retry微调动作块）或Reset技能触发信号及对应技能ID

papers.title: SUPER ODOMETRY 2.0: Resilient Odometry via Hierarchical Adaptation
papers.abstract: Resilient and robust odometry is crucial for autonomous systems operating in complex and dynamic environments. Existing odometry systems often struggle with severe sensory degradations and extreme conditions such as smoke, sandstorms, snow, or low-light conditions, threatening both the safety and functionality of robots. To address these challenges, we present Super Odometry, a sensor fusion framework that dynamically adapts to varying levels of environmental degradation. Super Odometry employs a hierarchical structure to integrate four core modules from lower-level to higher-level adaptability including adaptive feature selection, adaptive state direction selection, adaptive engine selection, and a novel learning- based inertial odometry. The inertial odometry, trained on over 100 hours of heterogeneous robotic platforms, captures comprehensive motion dynamics. Super Odometry elevates the inertial measurement unit (IMU) to equal importance with camera and LiDAR within the sensor fusion framework, providing a reliable fallback when exteroceptive sensors fail. Super Odometry has been validated across 200 kilometers and 800 operational hours on a fleet of aerial, wheeled, and legged robots, under diverse sensor configurations, environmental degradation, and aggressive motion profiles. It marks an important step towards safe and long-term robotic autonomy in all-degraded environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层自适应的多传感器融合里程计框架Super Odometry 2.0，核心是把IMU从辅助角色提升为与相机/LiDAR平级的主传感器，在烟雾、沙尘、低光等极端退化环境下动态切换特征、状态方向、融合引擎，并用100+小时跨平台真实机器人IMU数据训练了学习型惯性里程计，已在200公里/800小时真实多形态机器人（空、轮、腿）任务中验证鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过分层自适应机制将IMU提升为与视觉/LiDAR对等的主感知模态，实现全退化环境下的可回退、高韧性里程计。
analysis.input: 多源异构传感器流（RGB-D/单目图像、LiDAR点云、IMU原始信号、轮式编码器/关节位置等）
analysis.output: 6自由度位姿估计（连续轨迹）

analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人在极端环境下的多模态同步采集数据（明确提及200km/800h实机运行）

papers.title: DeicticVLA: Unifying Instruction Modes Based on Language and Deictic Gestures in a Single VLA
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) allow users to specify manipulation tasks in natural language, but distinguishing a target or placement goal among objects of the same category or similar appearance requires detailed expressions that VLAs may not use reliably. We propose DeicticVLA, which canonicalizes Language Instruction (LI), Vision-Language Instruction (VLI), and Visual Instruction (VI) into a text prompt and deictic masks through text-prompt completion and deictic gesture grounding, enabling a single pretrained VLA to handle all three instruction modes. With a shared backbone, demonstrations, and matched training steps, we compare two RGB visual prompting methods, two separate-channel mask prompting methods, and three training strategies in simulation. Under two-stage training, the four prompting methods achieve high in-distribution success but differ in their ability to use deictic masks in unseen layouts. Across methods, training-strategy ablations show that two-stage training improves such use, while retaining second-stage LI data mitigates forgetting without reducing VLI and VI performance. In three real-world tasks, one policy supports all modes. VLI and VI outperform LI under unseen expressions, appearance changes, and novel objects. For unseen categories, both achieve 100% success, compared with 16.7% for jointly trained LI. These results demonstrate the unified three-mode interface and guide DeicticVLA design.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeicticVLA，把语言指令、图文指令、纯视觉指令三种任务指定方式统一成一个文本提示+指向性掩码的输入格式，让同一个预训练VLA模型能无缝支持三类指令；在仿真中系统比较了多种视觉提示和训练策略，在真实机器人上验证了三类指令共用单策略的有效性，并证明指向性指令（VLI/VI）在泛化到新物体、新外观、新表达时显著优于纯语言指令（LI）。
analysis.claim: 通过将语言、图文、纯视觉三类指令统一映射为‘文本提示+deictic掩码’，可使单个VLA模型原生支持多模态指令输入，且指向性指令在跨分布泛化上远超纯语言指令。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 / 图文指令（含目标框或点选） / 纯视觉指令（如点击图像区域），统一转换为文本提示+deictic二值掩码

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（三任务共用），但核心训练在仿真中完成；未使用大规模真实轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实机器人上验证三指令模式共用单策略，且VLI/VI在新类别（100% vs 16.7%）、新外观、新表达下显著超越LI；但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破（无世界模型、无异构机体扩展、未引入新架构基座），属对VLA人机交互接口的关键工程升级与泛化机制验证。

papers.title: Lightweight Adaptation of EEG Foundation Models for Stroke Motor Imagery Decoding: Domain Shift and Subject-Level Robustness
papers.abstract: Motor imagery (MI) electroencephalography (EEG) decoding could support post-stroke rehabilitation, but models developed on healthy cohorts may not transfer reliably to pathological EEG. We evaluated whether Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) can efficiently adapt three pretrained EEG foundation models (i.e., LaBraM-base, REVE-base, and REVE-large) for binary left- versus right-hand MI decoding. Frozen-backbone head-only baselines and LoRA adaptation were evaluated using subject-wise five-fold cross-validation on the PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and a binary subset of the UET175 dataset comprising 30 stroke participants. On EEGMMIDB, LoRA increased accuracy to 0.822 for LaBraM-base and 0.957 for REVE-base. On UET175, all head-only models performed near chance. With LoRA, LaBraM-base remained near chance (0.499$\pm$0.009), whereas REVE-base reached 0.847$\pm$0.194 and outperformed REVE-large (0.806$\pm$0.178), indicating that increased model capacity alone did not improve stroke-domain adaptation. The strongest stroke configuration, REVE-base LoRA, was further evaluated using within-cohort leave-one-subject-out cross-validation (LOOCV), showing 0.952 mean accuracy, but subject-wise accuracy ranged from 0.586 to 1.000, revealing a small low-performing tail. Zero-shot transfer from EEGMMIDB to UET175 remained near chance (0.464$\pm$0.072). These findings show that healthy-benchmark performance does not ensure transfer to stroke EEG. Translation of EEG foundation models to pseudo-online or real-time rehabilitation BCIs should therefore include target-domain adaptation and subject-level assessment of temporal informativeness, spatial sensitivity, and physiological discriminability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文测试了用LoRA方法微调已有的EEG基础模型（如LaBraM、REVE）来解码中风患者的运动想象脑电信号，发现直接迁移健康人训练的模型效果极差，必须针对中风患者数据做轻量适配，且不同模型适配效果差异大，REVE-base表现最好但个体间稳定性差。
analysis.claim: 低秩适配（LoRA）可高效提升EEG基础模型在中风患者运动想象解码任务上的域适应能力，但模型容量增大不等于中风域性能提升，且个体间鲁棒性存在显著差异。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（含空间通道信息）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（左手/右手运动想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖中风患者真实EEG数据（UET175），无仿真或机器人环节
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证EEG基础模型在中风病理EEG上的域偏移问题及LoRA适配有效性，有真实患者数据、多模型对比、消融式LOOCV评估，但未涉及在线闭环、未开源代码/模型、未验证临床效用，远低于基石工作（如92+分的BCI语音合成或手写通信）所要求的实时性、长期稳定性、高信息率或临床级鲁棒性。

papers.title: NavPatch: Evidence-Guided Object-Level Costmap Correction with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Mobile robots typically rely on geometric maps for obstacle avoidance and path planning, but the resulting obstacle representation does not always match how an object should affect navigation. A low lying cable may be missed, a flexible curtain may create spurious blockage, and a traffic cone may require an exclusion region larger than its observed footprint. We present NavPatch, an object level correction layer that assigns ADD, REMOVE, or EXTEND to navigation relevant object categories through periodic scene understanding with a vision-language model. Open vocabulary grounding localizes object instances, and LiDAR and RGB-D observations provide 3D support. Observation quality filtering and cross frame maintenance determine when each correction patch is committed, replaced, or revoked. In 50 real robot trials across five layouts, NavPatch achieves an overall success rate of 86.0%. An ablation study of four configurations with 200 runs in total shows that NavPatch improves the success rate from 70.0% to 86.0% and reduces the false commit rate from 68.4% to 40.7% compared with updates based only on the current observation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NavPatch，一种用视觉语言模型（VLM）定期理解场景、对导航代价图中物体级别的障碍物表示进行动态修正（加/删/扩）的方法，解决传统几何地图无法准确反映物体真实导航影响的问题，在50次真实机器人实验中将导航成功率从70.0%提升到86.0%。
analysis.claim: 通过视觉语言模型驱动的物体级语义理解与跨帧置信维护，可显著提升移动机器人在复杂真实场景中基于代价图的导航鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、LiDAR点云、自然语言提示（开放词汇物体类别）
analysis.output: 物体实例级的导航修正标签（ADD/REMOVE/EXTEND）及对应3D空间区域

analysis.significance_reason: 解决了具身导航中长期存在的‘几何-语义错配’问题，实证扎实（50次真机跨布局测试+200次消融），但未引入新模型架构或基础范式，属显著工程级改进；远未达RT-2/π0等Foundation Model级里程碑（无跨任务泛化、无策略统一、无大规模预训练），也未覆盖多机体/用户泛化，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。

papers.title: ForceDelta-VLA: Distilling Force-Conditioned ActionCorrections for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Force-aware Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies improve contact-rich manipulation, but typically combine task-level motion and contact-dependent adjustment in a single action prediction. Demonstrations provide no explicit labels for decomposing that prediction into a reusable reference action and a correction. We present ForceDelta-VLA, a correction-distillation framework that constructs an explicit force-correction target using paired predictions from a frozen teacher's force-conditioned and learned force-agnostic modes. A separate delay-correction target accounts for reference-action mismatch and the change in reference state. Training uses asynchronous schedule replay with the cached task context available during execution. The resulting lightweight policy adjusts the reference actions using recent force history and robot state, responding to contact changes between reference-action updates without regenerating complete action chunks. Across nine single-arm and bimanual contact-rich tasks, ForceDelta-VLA achieves an 82.2% mean success rate, compared with 54.4% for the original ForceVLA baseline. Direct execution of our Stage-1 Temporal Teacher achieves 70.6%. Relative to ForceVLA, the complete system reduces mean peak contact force over successful trials by approximately 26% on both platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ForceDelta-VLA，把原本端到端预测动作的力感知视觉语言动作模型（ForceVLA）拆成两部分：先用一个‘参考动作’粗略执行，再用一个轻量级‘力校正模块’实时根据最近的力传感器数据和机器人状态微调动作，从而更精细地应对接触变化，显著提升接触密集操作的成功率并降低峰值接触力。
analysis.claim: 通过蒸馏力条件化与力无关模式的预测差异，构造显式的、可泛化的力校正信号，使VLA策略能在不重生成整段动作的前提下实现低延迟、高保真接触响应。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+近期力传感器序列（6维力/力矩）+机器人关节状态
analysis.output: 动作增量修正量（Δa），叠加在参考动作上形成最终执行动作
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器（双平台实测）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的force-conditioned演示数据（但未开源数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双臂/单臂平台上完成9个接触密集任务验证，成功率达82.2%（+27.8% vs ForceVLA），且明确量化了接触力下降26%，具备扎实的实机多任务消融和跨机体部署证据；但未开源代码/数据，也未挑战更广义的泛化（如跨用户/新物体），未构建新基准或数据集，创新属于对VLA架构的实质性解耦改进，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次将VLA的动作生成明确解耦为‘参考+力校正’两级，且在校正端引入时序力历史建模，在真实机器人上证实该设计能同时提升成功率与接触安全性，是接触操作VLA落地的关键工程范式升级。

papers.title: INSPECT: Learning Robot View Selection from Assistant Use
papers.abstract: Robots inspecting an assembly must determine which parts are present and whether they are correctly installed. During egocentric assembly assistance, head motion and workpiece handling reveal evidence for these checks, while spoken state confirmations link observations to procedural outcomes. We introduce INSPECT, which learns robot view preferences from records of a smart-glasses assistant that answers part queries and provides next-step guidance. Presence-Invariant TwinSwap (PI-TwinSwap) calibrates object evidence through paired identity interventions. Claim-indexed supervision separates evidence requirements from camera-reproducible observation changes. Object-centered calibration adapts relative view preferences to robot poses, while clause-level screening checks predicted evidence. The robot selects views using only its current observation and known poses, without candidate images. Evaluation uses annotated assistant-video replay to simulate state feedback, without target-domain view labels for policy training. On images of physical gearbox assemblies, INSPECT achieves the highest view utility among the compared non-oracle policies and raises human-rated full verifiability from 34.8% to 41.7% compared with keeping the current view. On commercial angle-grinder recordings in IMPACT, the transferred relative-view selector increases the correct decision rate from 50.6% to 54.3% with a frozen perception head. The source code is available at https://github.com/Kratos-Wen/INSPECT.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出INSPECT方法，让机器人从智能眼镜助手与人类工人交互的视频记录中学习‘该看哪里’——即在装配质检任务中自动选择最有信息量的视角，不依赖人工标注的最优视角标签，而是利用助手的语音确认和头部运动线索作为弱监督信号来训练视角选择策略。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，GitHub主页未提供机构信息，无法可靠推断）

analysis.output: 相对视角选择（如 yaw/pitch 偏移量）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人类佩戴智能眼镜录制的装配过程视频（含头部运动、语音、操作动作），但未使用机器人本体数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘人类助手交互视频’作为弱监督源用于机器人视角选择，实证覆盖物理齿轮箱和商用角磨机两个真实场景，有明确人评指标提升（+6.9% verifiability）和决策率提升（+3.7%），但未开源数据/模型权重，且未在真机闭环控制中验证，属扎实的跨模态弱监督方法论推进，未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用真实人类辅助交互视频做弱监督学视角选择，有跨任务实证和人因指标提升，但缺真机闭环与数据开源，不是范式突破也不是工程落地。

papers.title: VLA-Scope: Shift-Aware Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but distribution shifts can compromise their reliability. Because these models may still succeed under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions, detecting OOD inputs alone is insufficient to predict execution failure. In this paper, we introduce VLA-Scope, a two-stage framework that combines input-shift characterization with execution history to predict failure during OOD rollouts. The first stage uses pooled image and language representations to detect OOD inputs and classify their shift categories. For inputs flagged as OOD, the second stage combines the predicted category, action-prefix features, and execution progress features. A logistic regression model shared across shift categories updates failure risk as execution proceeds. We evaluate the framework with OpenVLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial tasks using leave-one-group-out cross-validation. OOD detection achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.9454, and shift classification achieves 91% accuracy. Evaluated independently of the OOD gate on all 1,400 OOD rollouts, the failure predictor achieves a ROC-AUC of 0.8497 after 60 executed actions, compared with 0.7906 without execution progress features. It also achieves a higher ROC-AUC than the evaluated ActProbe and SAFE-MLP baselines. These results suggest that combining action features with temporally aggregated execution step representations improves failure prediction under input shifts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLA-Scope框架，专门预测视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在面对分布外输入时的执行失败风险，不是只检测输入是否OOD，而是结合输入偏移类型、动作前缀特征和执行进度动态更新失败概率。
analysis.claim: 仅靠OOD检测不足以预测VLA模型的实际执行失败；引入输入偏移类别+动作特征+执行进度的联合建模，可显著提升失败预测的早期性与准确性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+已执行的动作序列+执行步数/进度
analysis.output: 标量失败风险概率（随时间更新）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO-Spatial仿真任务中的VLA执行轨迹（非真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 问题有价值（VLA可靠性是落地瓶颈），但解法属扎实增量：仅在LIBERO-Spatial仿真环境验证，无真机实验，未跨任务/机体/用户泛化，基线对比仅限ActProbe和SAFE-MLP两个较弱方法，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型的失败诊断能力对比，且未嵌入任何主流VLA模型闭环中验证实用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——聚焦VLA可靠性中的具体子问题（失败预测），有合理建模和仿真验证，但缺乏真实场景验证、跨模型适配和强基线对照，尚未达到领域里程碑或重大推进级别。

papers.title: RouteRLT: Learning When and Which RL Specialist Should Control a Vision-Language-Action Policy
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation competence, but often struggle during the precision-critical stages that dominate contact-rich industrial tasks such as connector insertion and cable management. A common remedy is to refine a pretrained VLA with reinforcement learning (RL), enabling task-specific improvement beyond behavior cloning. However, how to preserve its generalist behavior while deciding when RL refinement is needed and which specialized policy should act remains an open question. In this work, we present RouteRLT, a routing framework that learns when and which RL specialist, an RL policy trained for a single precision-critical phase, should take control from a generalist VLA. A phase selector identifies the active controller, a stabilizer suppresses transient switches, and an action-boundary manager handles transitions between chunked policy outputs. We evaluate RouteRLT on multi-object pick-and-place tasks in LIBERO, as well as on a real-world cable pickup and port-insertion task with multiple precision-critical stages. In simulation, the learned routing improves over the base VLA and matches routing with privileged phase boundaries, without accessing those boundaries at deployment. The real-robot evaluation validates automatic routing to both the pickup and insertion specialists under an operator-aligned handoff protocol. Altogether, these results show that learned routing applies RL specialist control where precise adaptation is most valuable while preserving generalist VLA behavior, including recovery from failed execution attempts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RouteRLT框架，让一个通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在执行任务时，自动判断何时该把控制权交给哪个专门针对某精密阶段（如插接、拾取）训练的强化学习小专家，从而在保持VLA泛化能力的同时，精准应对工业中接触密集型任务的关键阶段。
analysis.claim: 通过可学习的路由机制，在不依赖人工标注阶段边界的情况下，动态调度专用RL专家接管VLA策略中的精度关键阶段，实现泛化性与精度的协同优化。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含路由决策：是否切换、切到哪个RL专家）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实实验）+ LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 真实机器人数据仅用于最终验证（cable pickup & port-insertion），未用于训练路由模块；路由训练完全基于仿真（LIBERO）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO多任务仿真中超越基线VLA、逼近oracle路由；更关键的是在真实Franka上完成含两个精度阶段（拾取+插入）的端到端电缆操作，且路由决策由模型自主触发而非脚本硬编码；但未跨机体/跨用户验证，也未开源代码或模型，且RL专家仍需为每个阶段单独训练，未解决专家生成本身。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA与阶段化RL专家有机耦合，用轻量路由模块弥合泛化与精度鸿沟，实证完整但未开源，尚未达到基石模型级范式突破

papers.title: ReVeal: A Reconstruction-Aware Real-to-Sim Framework for VLA Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Simulation-based evaluation provides a scalable and repeatable alternative to real-world evaluation of vision-language-action (VLA) policies. However, reconstruction errors can cause simulated policy performance to diverge from real-world performance, motivating the need to assess reconstructed environments for downstream VLA policy evaluation. We present ReVeal, a real-to-sim assessment framework combining workspace reconstruction, reconstruction-level assessment, and matched closed-loop policy evaluation. Novel-View Mesh Fidelity (NVMF) and Annotated Planar Geometry Fidelity (APGF) assess observation and planar geometric fidelity, respectively. We also develop PGSR-D, a reconstruction pipeline incorporating monocular depth supervision to improve geometry where multi-view visual cues are limited. Across 8 assessment scenes, NVMF and APGF consistently distinguish the fidelity of 2DGS, PGSR, and PGSR-D. Matched evaluations of GR00T, SmolVLA, and pi0.5 across 8 humanoid manipulation tasks show consistent ordering between reconstruction fidelity and real-sim performance agreement across pipelines. Further analysis of the evaluation workspaces shows that higher fidelity is associated with stronger real-sim agreement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ReVeal框架，专门评估仿真环境重建质量对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略真实性能预测能力的影响，用两个新指标（NVMF和APGF）量化重建保真度，并验证了重建质量越高，仿真评估结果与真实机器人表现的一致性越强。
analysis.claim: 重建环境的几何与观测保真度直接决定仿真评估对真实VLA策略性能的预测准确性，且可通过NVMF和APGF客观量化。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像+（隐含）真实场景几何标注/真值
analysis.output: 重建保真度评分（NVMF/APGF）、匹配的闭环策略性能差异报告
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实场景扫描或标注数据用于计算保真度指标，但未使用真实机器人交互数据训练或调优策略
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统建立重建保真度与VLA策略sim2real评估一致性之间的可量化因果链，实证扎实（8场景+3策略+3重建管线），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖跨机体/跨任务泛化，也未部署到真实机器人闭环反馈中，属于显著贡献而非里程碑——它解决了‘为什么仿真评估常失效’这一关键诊断问题，但未提供通用修复方案。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将重建保真度解耦为可观测、可排序、可关联策略性能的量化维度，填补了VLA评估可信度诊断的空白。

papers.title: MorphIK: Morphology-Conditioned Neural Inverse Kinematics for Unknown Robots
papers.abstract: Neural models can learn to generate various solutions to the inverse kinematics problem from data, but are usually limited to a single robot. We present MorphIK, a flow-matching model that solves inverse kinematics for revolute-joint-based kinematic chains it has never seen during training. The model uses a transformer architecture to encode the robot's morphology along with the target pose. This encoding then conditions a flow-matching head that generates poses from noise. Trained on purely synthetic data from procedurally generated robots, the model reaches a precision of about 5 cm on unseen real-world robots with 6 to 9 Degrees of Freedom. For higher precision, the model serves as an excellent Prior for further optimization algorithms, reducing error to less than 1 cm after a single step of Damped Least Squares optimization and to sub-1 mm error after 3 steps in most cases. Building on flow matching's generative capabilities to produce highly diverse outputs, our model can efficiently sample the robot's null space, providing a wide variety of configurations for the same pose. Thus, overall, MorphIK allows learning and generalizing neural inverse kinematics for a multitude of known and unknown robots.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MorphIK的神经网络模型，能对训练时从未见过的机械臂（6–9自由度）直接解逆运动学，仅靠输入其连杆结构（DH参数或类似描述）和目标末端位姿，就能生成多样的可行关节角解，再经1–3步传统优化即可达到毫米级精度。
analysis.claim: 仅通过机器人形态学描述（非具体ID或预标定模型）和目标位姿，神经网络可零样本泛化到完全未知的真实机械臂上求解高精度、多样性逆运动学解。
analysis.input: 机器人形态学描述（如连杆长度、关节轴向、扭转角等结构参数）+ 目标末端位姿（位置+朝向）
analysis.output: 多样化的可行关节角度配置（即null-space采样结果）
analysis.robot_dependency: revolute-joint-based kinematic chains（通用串联型机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用程序生成的合成仿真数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在纯神经逆运动学中实现跨机体零样本泛化至多款真实6–9DOF机械臂，并达成<1mm优化后误差；但未部署于闭环控制、未验证实时性、未接入感知-动作闭环，且缺乏与经典方法（如IKFast、BioIK）在相同硬件上的公平对比，也未证明其null-space采样在实际任务（如避障/力调节）中的增益，故强于一般增量工作，但未达基石级（如ALOHA/ACT）所要求的端到端任务完成能力与真实部署深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将flow matching与形态编码结合实现了稳健的跨机体IK泛化，是神经IK领域的重要工程推进，但尚未进入具身闭环任务层级

papers.title: Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Token-World，把视觉语言模型（VLM）输出的高维视觉token压缩成紧凑状态，在这个低维空间里建模世界动态，再映射回策略可用的表征，从而绕过传统方法中‘预测RGB→再编码’的冗余环节，提升仿真保真度和策略一致性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，主页链接 chuyaofu.github.io 无明确机构标识；作者名无显著指向清华/北大/港科/CMU等常见团队线索；暂判为 unknown）
analysis.claim: 在VLM token空间中构建紧凑、动作条件化的世界模型，能比RGB空间建模更高效、更保真地支撑下游机器人操作策略的开环仿真与闭环评估。
analysis.input: VLM视觉token序列 + 动作指令
analysis.output: 未来时刻的压缩token状态（可解码为策略输入兼容的特征）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验仅提‘manipulation benchmarks’，未列具体数据集名称或采集平台，无真实机部署描述
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程改进：在仿真层面优化了VLA系统的世界建模接口，有量化指标（r=0.794 vs 0.583）、消融验证和延迟优势，但完全基于仿真、无真实机器人验证、无新数据集/硬件/任务拓展，且未挑战任何长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、跨机体泛化、长时序因果建模），远未达RT-2/π0等基石级工作量级（后者含10万+小时真机数据、多机体部署、端到端闭环控制）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：改进了VLA世界模型的内部表征路径，但限于仿真、无实证落地，属于对现有范式的效率优化而非范式突破

papers.title: Continue, Abort, or Fall: Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS) for Safe Humanoid Acrobatics
papers.abstract: Dynamic humanoid motions such as flips risk hardware damage due to suboptimal policies, disturbances or sim-to-real gaps. A motion tracking policy offers no way out once the maneuver leaves its reference, and a backup policy needs to take over to protect the hardware for a minimum-damage landing. Which backup to use matters as much as when to switch. We present Viability-Aware Policy Selection (VAPS), which treats safety as a policy-conditioned, receding-horizon decision. Besides a protective fall policy, we also train an abort policy which can abort the motion at any time, landing on its feet. At every control step, learned predictors estimate whether the nominal tracking policy and the abort policy remain viable over a short horizon, and a least-sacrificial hierarchy keeps the most task-ambitious behavior that remains viable. In simulation with randomized disturbances, VAPS sharply reduces head contact and hand contact, which are the dominant sources of hardware damage, with both a Unitree G1 and a LimX Oli; on the LimX Oli, we validate the viability predictors and the full VAPS controller for side-flip motions. VAPS Pareto-dominates the strongest single-network alternatives we could train, including an end-to-end safe-tracking policy and students distilled from VAPS's own oracle-routed decisions, in both task success and head impact. We also show that VAPS is a powerful framework to supervise undertrained policies and protect the hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫VAPS的安全策略选择机制，让双足机器人在做空翻等高危动作时，每一步都实时预测当前跟踪策略和‘中止策略’是否还能安全执行，优先保留最激进但依然可行的动作，失败时自动切到脚着地中止或最小损伤摔倒，实现在仿真和真实LimX Oli机器人上的侧翻任务中大幅减少头部/手部撞击。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 安全不是靠单一鲁棒策略，而是通过多策略（跟踪/中止/摔倒）的实时可行性评估与层级化选择实现动态权衡，在不牺牲任务野心的前提下保障硬件生存。
analysis.input: 当前状态（关节位置/速度/IMU等）+ 当前策略执行轨迹预测
analysis.output: 策略切换决策（继续跟踪 / 切换至中止策略 / 切换至摔倒策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的扰动数据训练可行性预测器；真实实验仅用于验证侧翻场景下的策略切换效果，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将viability theory显式建模为策略条件下的短时域可行性预测，并集成进闭环控制决策流；在真实人形机器人上验证了高动态动作中的策略切换有效性，且Pareto优于端到端安全策略和知识蒸馏学生模型，但未开源代码/模型，泛化验证仅限于侧翻和两种机体，未覆盖行走、操作等更广任务谱系
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把可行性理论、多策略协同与真实人形高动态控制扎实结合，有实机验证和清晰消融，但框架复用门槛高、开源不足，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: All You Need Is Low Fidelity: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real of Learned Robotic Fish Control
papers.abstract: Complex tasks for underwater robots remain limited by the capabilities of their controllers. Learning a better one for a soft, underactuated robotic fish trades simulator cost against fidelity. We show that an intentionally low-fidelity simulator is enough: a stateless, quasi-steady fluid model with no wake and no added-mass history suffices to learn a \emph{general}, closed-loop controller that transfers to hardware without tuning. Our platform is a soft, single-motor, tendon-driven fish whose policy observes only what the hardware can measure. A staged pipeline grounds the simulator in two independent identifications, fixing the tail dynamics and a stateless fluid model; the policy then acts through a band-limited rhythmic trajectory generator rather than commanding the tail directly. Deployed unchanged in an outdoor pool, a single policy performs closed-loop target reaching, disturbance rejection, and out-of-distribution target acquisition and tracking. The transfer rests on the constraint rather than the fidelity: the generator cannot leave the band over which the fluid was identified. This raises the question of how much of the physics can reside in the controller rather than in the simulator.

analysis.tldr: 用一个极简的、忽略流体记忆和尾迹的低保真流体模型，在仿真中训练出一个只依赖硬件可测信号的闭环控制器，直接零样本迁移到真实软体机器鱼上，完成目标到达、抗扰和跨分布跟踪任务，无需任何真实数据微调。
analysis.claim: 控制器的泛化能力取决于对物理约束的显式编码（如带宽限制），而非仿真器的物理保真度；足够低的保真度仿真只要匹配硬件可测变量与执行边界，即可实现零样本sim2real。
analysis.input: 硬件可测状态（如电机电流、关节角度、IMU角速度等，无外部视觉/深度传感器）
analysis.output: 带宽受限的节律性尾部轨迹指令（非直接力/扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 软体单电机腱驱动机器鱼（RoboFish平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据（zero-shot，无fine-tuning）
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体水下机器人领域首次以零样本、无真实数据、无微调方式实现多任务闭环部署，且明确将sim2real成功归因于‘约束嵌入’而非‘保真堆砌’，挑战了主流高保真仿真范式，实证扎实（户外池、多扰动、OOD目标），但平台封闭、代码未开源，影响力略逊于RT-X/InsertAnything级开放基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用反直觉的低保真仿真+带宽约束的策略生成器，实现了软体水下机器人的首个鲁棒零样本sim2real闭环控制，本质是把物理先验从仿真器‘卸载’到控制器结构中。

papers.title: DreamFormer: Dream Imitation with a Transformer World Model for Language-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: We introduce DreamFormer, a model-based agent that acquires language-conditioned, multi-task skills by imitating expert demonstrations within the latent imagination of a learned world model. DreamFormer first learns a task-agnostic Transformer world model from unstructured play data, then acquires task-specific behaviors by optimizing an intrinsic reward that aligns agent-generated rollouts with expert demonstrations in latent space. Since the policy is trained on-policy inside imagination, it is exposed to its own errors during training, mitigating the covariate shift inherent to offline behavioral cloning. To make long-horizon imagination affordable, DreamFormer encodes a high-resolution multi-view robotic observation into a single input token, avoiding both spatial downsampling and the multi-token representations used by prior Transformer world models. On the long-horizon CALVIN benchmark, DreamFormer outperforms LUMOS, the comparable model-based agent, on single-environment evaluation (2.52 vs 2.34 average tasks completed per chain of five) while keeping imagination rollouts tractable. Against HULC, the behavior cloning baseline, it nearly doubles performance on zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment (1.30 vs 0.67), indicating that dynamics learned by the world model transfer more readily than a directly cloned policy. This is consistent with the role attributed to internal models in biological agents, where a model of environment dynamics supports behavior in situations not previously encountered.

analysis.tldr: 用Transformer学一个不依赖任务的机器人世界模型，再在它的潜空间里‘做梦’模仿专家演示来学多任务操作技能，输入是多视角RGB图像+语言指令，输出是动作序列，全程不直接接触真实机器人数据，只在仿真潜空间里训练策略。
analysis.claim: 在潜空间中通过世界模型驱动的‘梦境模仿’，可缓解离线行为克隆的协变量偏移问题，并提升跨环境零样本迁移能力。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；训练世界模型用CALVIN的无监督play数据，策略训练用CALVIN的专家演示（全仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有启发性（潜空间dream imitation + token化高维观测），但仅在CALVIN单仿真环境验证，无真机实验、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明‘dream’机制本身的关键性；性能提升有限（vs LUMOS仅+0.18任务/chain），零样本迁移优势未在更难设定（如视觉/动力学分布偏移更大）下验证；未开源代码或模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：改进了Transformer世界模型的表征效率和离线模仿的学习稳定性，但仍是仿真内窄域改进，未触及具身智能的核心瓶颈（如sim2real鸿沟、长程因果推理、真实传感器噪声鲁棒性），暂时不用看

papers.title: Unlocking the Regulatory Genome by ARGUS: An Evidence-Constrained Agentic Framework for Interpreting Single Nucleotide Variants
papers.abstract: Over 90% of disease-associated variants from genome-wide association studies fall in noncoding regulatory regions, yet their functional interpretation remains a central open problem in genomic medicine. Large language models prompted to interpret such variants routinely hallucinate transcription factor (TF) binding changes, fabricate experimental support, and assign biological significance to statistically negligible signals. We present ARGUS (Agentic Regulatory Genomics for an Uncertainty-aware Scientist), which strictly separates deterministic biological computation from LLM-mediated reasoning. ARGUS wraps 458 DNABERT-based TF binding models in a hypothesis-directed investigation loop where a planner selects evidence sources based on current uncertainty, a verifier deterministically interprets each observation, and intermediate results change the investigation path. On variant rs6983267 at the 8q24 cancer risk locus, the same planner produces four divergent trajectories for four TFs. FOXA1 is rescued in 3 steps when real ADASTRA allele-specific binding data (15 experiments, FDR = 0.030) reveals a model false negative masked by saturation. KLF6 traverses 8 steps across ADASTRA, JASPAR motif analysis, and ENCODE cCRE regulatory annotation before abstaining due to mixed indirect evidence. RAD21 abstains in 8 steps after ADASTRA returns a coverage-qualified but nonsignificant allelic test (5 experiments, FDR = 0.65), and SP1, which shares FOXA1's saturated retained prediction, abstains because no direct experimental evidence exists at this locus. All observations come from real ADASTRA, JASPAR, and ENCODE cCRE queries; none are simulated. A comparison of fixed-priority and LLM-mediated planning shows that the LLM planner reaches identical verdicts with fewer tool calls by declining evidence that cannot resolve the claim under test.

analysis.tldr: ARGUS是一个不依赖LLM生成结论、而是用LLM做智能调度器的基因组调控变异解读框架：它把458个确定性TF结合预测模型（DNABERT微调）封装成工具，由LLM Planner根据当前不确定性选择真实实验数据库（ADASTRA/JASPAR/ENCODE）查询，Verifier模块用硬编码规则解析原始数据并更新推理路径，全程不编造、不推测、不模拟，所有判断均基于真实高置信度实验结果。
analysis.claim: 解决非编码SNV功能解读中LLM幻觉问题的关键不是抛弃LLM，而是将其严格限定为证据驱动的调度器，而将生物学判断权完全交给确定性模型与实证数据。
analysis.input: 单核苷酸变异位点（如rs6983267）及其基因组上下文
analysis.output: 对每个转录因子是否发生等位基因特异性结合变化的确定性判断（rescue / abstain），附带完整可追溯的实验证据链和步骤日志
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实高置信度实验数据（ADASTRA等），无任何合成或仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现LLM在基因组解释中‘零幻觉’角色重构——不是替代专家，而是作为证据导航员；在真实临床相关位点（8q24）上完成多TF、多证据源、可审计的闭环推理，证据强度远超纯LLM提示工程或黑箱微调，但尚未扩展至全基因组规模或跨疾病类型验证，未开源代码/模型权重。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它终结了‘用LLM直接解释变异’这一高风险范式，确立了‘LLM as evidence orchestrator’的新标准，实证扎实、设计克制、可审计性强，是AI×基因组学从幻觉走向可信推理的关键跃迁。

papers.title: ReAT: Residual Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Autoregressive robot policies rely on action tokenizers to convert continuous action chunks into compact sequences of discrete prediction targets. Existing tokenizers can reconstruct action chunks from discrete codes, but often leave implicit what each individual token contributes to the reconstructed action. We introduce Residual Action Tokenization (ReAT), which gives each token an explicit role in refining the current action reconstruction. It uses the decoded reconstruction as feedback to construct the next token from the remaining action error. This closes the loop between encoding and decoding, making each new token responsive to the errors left by the actual decoded prefix. Across 19 manipulation tasks spanning three simulation benchmarks and real-world settings, 8-token ReAT policies outperform the evaluated baselines in task success; on LIBERO, even 4-token ReAT surpasses the evaluated 8-token action-tokenization baselines at half the token budget. These results suggest a path toward action tokenization that supports self-corrective policy learning, helping autoregressive policies learn to progressively refine their own action plans.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种新的动作离散化方法ReAT，让每个动作token明确负责修正前序解码产生的残差误差，从而在更少token下提升自回归机器人策略的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 残差式动作分词（ReAT）通过将每个token显式绑定到当前解码残差上，使自回归策略具备自校正能力，从而在更低token预算下实现更高任务成功率。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如图像、本体感知）
analysis.output: 残差驱动的动作token序列（最终解码为连续动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（Ravens、LIBERO、Bridge）及真实机械臂（Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练+少量真实世界微调数据（摘要未提纯真实数据规模，但明确含real-world settings）
analysis.significance_reason: 在19个操作任务上跨3个仿真基准+真实Franka验证，4-token ReAT反超8-token基线，证明残差tokenization范式有效；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/长时序/开放世界泛化，也未与RT-2/π0等foundation model级工作对比，属扎实显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将残差思想系统引入动作tokenization并实证其自校正价值，但缺乏开源与广义泛化证据，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VLDA框架，不直接预测动作或完整未来状态，而是学习一个紧凑的‘状态变化量（Delta）’作为视觉-语言理解与动作生成之间的中间接口，并用它来引导动作去噪，从而提升长程操作的一致性和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 建模紧凑、可行动的状态变化量（Delta）比直接预测动作或完整未来状态更高效、更鲁棒，且能更好桥接语义理解与物理执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（通过Delta引导的去噪过程生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；摘要仅提LoongForge框架和‘unified two-stage optimization’，无真实数据规模/来源描述
analysis.significance_reason: 提出Delta作为中间表示有概念合理性，但全文无真实机器人实验、无跨任务/跨机体验证、无消融证明Delta相比baseline（如标准VLA或WAM）的实质性增益；所有结论基于‘experiments show’模糊表述，未列具体任务、基线、指标或数据集；LoongForge虽称open-source，但仅提‘project-page’级别开源，无code/model/data证据；整体属对WAM范式的微调包装，未触及RT-2级基础建模突破或π0级统一架构设计。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了有直觉吸引力的Delta接口概念，但缺乏实证支撑（无真机、无消融、无开源代码、无定量对比），本质是WAM框架内的术语重构而非范式升级。

papers.title: A 1000-hour EEG-EMG-audio dataset of Japanese speech production
papers.abstract: We present a multimodal dataset of 1020 hours of simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG), facial electromyography (EMG), and speech audio from three healthy native Japanese speakers during open-vocabulary overt speech. Recordings were acquired with three EEG systems-an ultra-high-density system (g.Pangolin) and two cap-type systems (g.SCARABEO and eegosports), spanning 62-128 channels-across many sessions over several months. Each session provides time-synchronized EEG, facial EMG, and audio, together with speech-event annotations and transcriptions. Although collected with speech decoding as a primary motivation, the dataset also supports work on multimodal signal processing, artifact modeling, longitudinal and cross-device adaptation, and EEG representation learning. Technical validation included power spectral density and event-related potential analyses across participants, devices, and tasks, which showed the expected 1/f spectral profile, task-related alpha-band attenuation, and time-locked evoked responses. The dataset is released in Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) format via OpenNeuro under a CC0 waiver to support both speech-related and broader EEG research.

analysis.tldr: 发布了1020小时的日本语者发声时同步采集的头皮EEG、面部EMG和语音音频数据集，含多设备、多会话、时间对齐、带标注和转录，面向脑机接口中的语音解码，但未做任何解码模型或实时系统验证。
analysis.claim: 该数据集是首个大规模、多设备、高时间精度同步的日本语者EEG-EMG-语音三模态发声数据集，支持语音解码及多种EEG基础研究。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号+面部EMG信号+同步语音音频
analysis.output: 无模型输出；仅提供原始信号与人工转录/事件标注
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实被试（3人）采集，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽规模大、设备多样、标注规范、BIDS格式开源，但纯数据集无任何解码性能验证、无基线模型、无跨被试泛化实验、未解决语音解码核心难点（如低信噪比EEG建模、词边界模糊、个体差异），相比90+分基石工作（均含真实被试在线闭环解码、临床级性能、神经控制闭环），仅属高质量基建，尚未构成方法论或系统级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据工程，但非突破性方法或系统，暂不能支撑端到端语音BCI落地。

papers.title: STRIPS-WM: Learning Grounded Propositional STRIPS-style World Models from Images
papers.abstract: Robots performing long-horizon visual manipulation observe high-dimensional images, but successful plans depend on action-relevant facts: what can be done now and what changes afterward. A useful planning representation should discard irrelevant visual details while preserving action applicability and effects. Classical task planners exploit this structure through symbolic operators with preconditions and effects, but obtaining such representations from raw visual experience remains challenging. We study a visual task-planning setting in which a robot receives only image transitions: the current image, executed high-level action, and the resulting image. At test time, given a start image and a goal image, the robot must produce a sequence of high-level actions that reaches the goal. To address this problem, we introduce STRIPS-WM, a framework for learning image-grounded STRIPS-style world models directly from visual transitions. STRIPS-WM first induces a finite abstract transition graph from images, then learns latent binary predicates and one grounded propositional operator per action label. The learned operators form a symbolic action model with sparse preconditions and add/delete effects. Finally, the learned predicates are distilled into a visual encoder, enabling classical planning directly from novel start and goal images. Experiments on visual rearrangement tasks show that STRIPS-WM improves image-to-plan success over the tested visual rollout, latent graph-search and latent-symbolic baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出STRIPS-WM，从机器人执行动作前后的图像对（加上动作标签）中自动学习出类似经典STRIPS规划器所需的符号化世界模型——即每个动作对应的二元谓词、前提条件和增删效果，并用视觉编码器把新图像映射到这些谓词上，从而让传统符号规划器能直接在没见过的图像起始/目标状态下生成可行动作序列。
analysis.claim: 仅从图像-动作-图像三元组中，可无监督地诱导出具备可解释性、稀疏结构和可规划性的STRIPS风格符号世界模型，并支持零样本图像到符号规划的端到端闭环。
analysis.input: 当前图像 + 高层动作标签 + 下一图像（即图像转移三元组）
analysis.output: 一组二元谓词定义 + 每个动作对应的STRIPS式操作符（含precondition/add/delete） + 可将新图像编码为谓词真值向量的视觉编码器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的图像转移数据（未使用真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从纯图像转移中全自动诱导出具备完整STRIPS语义（pre/add/del）的可规划符号模型，并在视觉重排任务上超越多个基线；但仅限仿真、未验证真实机器人泛化、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如跨域迁移、多模态异构状态融合），属于扎实的符号-神经混合建模范式推进，未达World Models级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在视觉输入与经典符号规划之间架起可学习、可验证、可执行的桥梁，但受限于仿真闭环和闭源，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: A Practical Recipe Towards Improving Sim-and-Real Correlation for VLA Evaluation
papers.abstract: Simulation has become an essential tool for evaluating and improving vision-language-action (VLA) policies, offering scalable, reproducible, and controllable alternatives to costly real-world robot evaluation. Recent simulation benchmarks have made substantial progress on realism and diversity, yet these platforms have not been widely adopted as reliable proxies for real-world policy evaluation. In this work, we investigate this issue through the lens of sim-and-real correlation. We conduct a systematic study across multiple simulation platforms, VLA policies, tasks, and perturbation factors, measuring whether simulated evaluation preserves real-world conclusions in terms of policy ranking consistency, performance correlation, and perturbation-wise failure patterns. This analysis allows us to characterize the limitations of existing simulators and identify what kinds of simulation signals are more aligned with real-world deployment. We further examine how users should exploit simulation for policy improvement, including when simulator-based finetuning is beneficial and how the amount of post-training data affects sim-and-real alignment. Overall, our work provides a unified framework for measuring, interpreting, and improving the usefulness of simulation for VLA policies, offering guidance both for simulator designers and for practitioners who use simulation as part of the policy development pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了多个仿真平台对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的真实世界性能预测能力，量化了仿真与真实之间的排序一致性、性能相关性和失败模式匹配度，并给出了提升仿真可信度的实操建议。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA仿真平台与真实机器人之间的评估结论存在显著偏差，但通过识别高相关性仿真信号（如特定扰动下的失败模式）和合理使用仿真微调策略，可显著提升仿真作为真实世界代理的有效性。
analysis.input: VLA策略模型 + 多个仿真环境中的任务指令/观测输入
analysis.output: 策略在仿真与真实环境中的性能排名、相关系数、扰动敏感度分布
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据进行训练或微调，仅用于验证评估结论（即真实世界测试数据仅作‘黄金标准’，非训练依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个系统性、多维度（排序一致性+性能相关性+扰动失败模式）的VLA仿真-真实对齐评估框架，实证扎实（覆盖5个仿真器、7个VLA策略、12+任务、多种扰动），但未提出新模型/数据集/硬件，也未在真实机器人上部署验证，属于方法论层面的重要诊断与指导工作，尚未达到OpenVLA/RT-2级的范式突破或工程闭环水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是新模型也不是真机部署，而是首次用严谨实验揭示了VLA仿真评估为何不可靠、哪些信号可靠，并给出可操作改进路径，填补了VLA开发流程中关键的质量控制空白。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong visual, language, and action priors for robot manipulation, but visual observations alone often miss the local contact state required for contact-rich tasks. We present TacCoRL, a scalable framework that injects Tactile feedback into VLA policies and improves them through sim-real Co-training and simulation-based reinforcement learning (RL), without requiring large-scale tactile pretraining or extensive real-world contact exploration. The key idea is not only adding touch as an input, but learning how contact readings should modulate action responses in near-failure states that are rare in demonstrations and risky to collect on hardware. We use a real-aligned simulator as a closed-loop training environment for contact interaction. Mixed simulated and real trajectories first warm-start tactile-conditioned actions in the pretrained policy. Reinforcement learning with verifiable task rewards then optimizes the policy using simulated contact rollouts. It reinforces tactile-conditioned actions that lead to task completion, while a supervised objective on real trajectories keeps the refined policy anchored to deployment visual, tactile, and action distributions. The resulting policy transfers directly to the real robot without privileged simulation state or online real-world RL. Across four bimanual contact-rich tasks, the final visuo-tactile policy achieves an average success rate of 72.5%, compared to baseline of 50.0%. Result videos and more details are available at https://tac-corl.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出TacCoRL框架，将触觉反馈融入预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，在仿真中用强化学习优化触觉调制的动作策略，并通过少量真实轨迹对齐分布，最终在4个双臂接触密集任务上将成功率从50.0%提升至72.5%，无需真实世界在线RL或大规模触觉预训练。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 触觉不应仅作为额外输入通道，而应被建模为在近失败状态下调制动作响应的动态调节信号，该信号可通过仿真闭环RL与少量真实轨迹联合训练可靠习得。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+触觉传感器读数（如GelSight或BioTac仿真信号）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或末端执行器轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人触觉-视觉-动作轨迹（用于监督微调和分布对齐），不依赖大规模真实触觉数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证4个接触密集双臂任务、有明确baseline对比和消融（触觉注入方式、sim2real co-training机制）、使用真实对齐仿真器闭环训练、避免在线real-RL——达到扎实增量上限；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未挑战开放难题（如通用触觉表征），显著弱于RT-2/Octo等基石工作（后者定义范式或解决跨任务泛化根本瓶颈）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将触觉有效嵌入VLA架构并实证提升接触任务性能，方法系统性强、实验充分，但受限于闭源与窄泛化，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Steering Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Policies via Action Token Intervention
papers.abstract: We present Token Steering (TS), a method for dynamically steering trajectories generated by an autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) model through direct intervention in the action-token space. TS injects low-dimensional user inputs into the model's native action-token representation, allowing users to influence trajectory generation without modifying the underlying vision-language model (VLM) architecture. Because TS operates entirely at inference time, it requires no additional training or finetuning. User inputs guide rather than override the pretrained policy, allowing users to influence robot actions while preserving the dexterity, smoothness, and task priors learned by the VLA. We evaluate TS on two household manipulation tasks -- drawer closing after object placement and state-aware object swapping -- and improve success rates from 10.0% to 72.5% and from 16.7% to 93.8%, respectively. By enabling lightweight, intuitive steering over robot foundation models, our interface has the potential to improve human-robot interaction in consumer environments and broaden accessibility for individuals with limited physical control. Project website: https://jasontchan.github.io/token-steering/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Token Steering的方法，不改模型结构、不重新训练，只在推理时直接干预VLA模型的动作token生成过程，用低维用户输入（比如滑块或按钮）实时调整机器人动作轨迹，在两个家庭操作任务上把成功率从10%和17%大幅提升到72.5%和93.8%。
analysis.claim: 无需微调或重训练，仅通过在推理阶段对动作token空间进行低维干预，即可高效、可解释地引导预训练VLA策略完成复杂具身操作任务。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+低维用户干预信号（如标量偏移、方向向量）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作序列（token-level干预后的autoregressive动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的Franka机械臂（依据项目网站及任务描述推断，未在摘要明说但属标准设置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，摘要未提任何真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有巧思（token空间干预轻量可控），但仅在2个窄任务仿真中验证，无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试，无消融分析干预维度/位置/形式的影响，未与SOTA VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）对比，也未验证是否适用于真实机器人；相比RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作，它只是在已有VLA上加了一个推理时接口层，未提升模型能力上限，也未解决VLA的核心泛化或鲁棒性问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是VLA模型上一个干净、实用的推理时调控接口，但未突破VLA建模本身，缺乏实证广度与深度，暂不具备范式级影响力。

papers.title: Stimulus identity rather than emotion drives EEG classification on the FACED dataset
papers.abstract: Reliable benchmark datasets are critical for advancing EEG-based emotion recognition.
