The Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset (FACED) is the largest publicly available EEG emotion dataset (123 subjects, nine emotion categories) and a widely adopted benchmark. We demonstrate that both intra-subject and cross-subject classification on FACED primarily reflects stimulus identity rather than emotion. Using a linear classifier (LinearSVC) and a deep learning model (CLISA), we show that (1) classification performance is comparable for trials where subjects reported feeling versus not feeling the assigned emotion; (2) accuracy drops when stimulus-assigned labels are replaced with individual self-reports; and (3) accuracy increases when reducing to one video per emotion despite discarding two-thirds of the data. These results reflect three design choices in FACED: few stimuli per category, stimulus-assigned labels, and within-video temporal splits for cross-validation. Together, these make the dataset susceptible to temporal autocorrelation and stimulus-identity confounds. To guide future work, we propose five recommendations — spanning stimulus diversity, temporal independence, and label validation — for emotion-decoding study designs that mitigate these confounds.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前最大的公开EEG情绪识别数据集FACED存在严重设计缺陷：模型实际学到的是视频刺激的身份特征（即‘看的是哪个视频’），而非真实的情绪状态，因此该数据集无法有效支撑情绪解码研究。
analysis.claim: FACED数据集上的EEG情绪分类性能主要源于刺激身份混淆，而非情绪神经表征的可靠解码。
analysis.input: EEG信号（多通道时序）
analysis.output: 情绪类别标签（九类）
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭露主流基准数据集的根本性方法学缺陷，证据扎实（三组对照实验+消融式归因），推动领域反思实验设计范式，但未构建新数据集或新模型，属高质量批判性工作而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是技术新方法，而是对领域基石数据集的实证性质疑，戳破了情绪EEG解码长期依赖的虚假基准，具有方法论警醒价值

papers.title: Trustworthy agentic genomics through versioned skill libraries
papers.abstract: Summary Genomics is adopting autonomous AI agents that interpret genomes from natural-language instructions faster than it is building the means to trust them. We report the first large-scale controlled evaluation of where, in an agentic genomic pipeline, correctness must reside for the system to be trustworthy at clinical scale. Using pharmacogenomics, a domain where errors are measurable and sometimes lethal, we benchmarked nine frontier large language models across 44,550 scored evaluations on 110 pharmacogenomic cases, and tested model interpretation of real star-allele diplotypes from more than 7,000 individuals in three ancestrally diverse populations. Trustworthiness proved to be a property of pipeline architecture, not of the model. Letting the model reason was stochastic and unsafe, and grounding it in the correct guidelines by retrieval paradoxically increased lethal-class errors. Encoding the validated decision logic as a versioned skill and executing it as code made the pharmacogenomic mapping exact, auditable and identical across models, confining all residual error to a single input-interpretation step. On individual genomes, unguarded model interpretation degraded along an ancestry gradient; execution removes this gradient from the clinical mapping, relocating it to the auditable completeness of the input caller. This establishes a generalisable, auditable architecture for trustworthy agentic genome interpretation at scale. Highlights Correctness must be executed, not reasoned or retrieved, to be trustworthy Retrieval raises phenotype accuracy yet increases lethal-class errors; skills do not Execution makes the clinical mapping exact and model-invariant; error stays at input A deterministic input caller is the predicted route to all-correct emitted answers In brief Corpas and colleagues show that trustworthy agentic genome interpretation comes not from making language models reason correctly about biology, but from confining them to interpreting input while versioned, validated skills do the reasoning as executed code. Across nine large language models and 110 pharmacogenomics cases, executing the skill makes the clinical mapping deterministic, auditable and model-invariant. Significance Genomics is adopting autonomous, language-model-mediated agents faster than it is building the standards needed to trust them. On a pharmacogenomic benchmark with lethal-class consequences, we show that an agent’s trustworthiness is not a property of the model but of how the agent is constrained: correctness must be moved out of the stochastic model into a versioned skill executed as code, with the model confined to interpreting heterogeneous input. This gives the field a transferable architecture for trustworthy agentic genome interpretation, a predicted route to deploying it so that every emitted answer is correct (execute the validated skill, call the input deterministically, and abstain on the irreducible residual), and a way to develop genomic skills as validated, executable, versioned units rather than prompts. Following a validation framework described elsewhere, we use clinical-grade to mean determinism, auditability, traceability to versioned components and population-invariant performance, all achieved under skill-constrained execution. We distinguish two senses of population performance: the executed clinical mapping is population-invariant by construction, verified across European, Latin American and East African origin individuals, whereas the model’s interpretation of real, ancestrally diverse diplotypes is not, degrading along an ancestry gradient, which is precisely why the mapping must be executed rather than reasoned. We do not claim full clinical validation, which would additionally require non-canonical inputs, real-world genomic and clinical data, human comparators and multi-site concordance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，在基因组学中让大语言模型直接推理药理基因型-表型映射是不可靠且存在种族偏差的，转而将经过临床验证的决策逻辑封装为可版本控制、可执行的代码技能（skill），由模型仅负责解析输入（如星等位基因型），从而实现确定性、可审计、跨人群一致的临床级基因解读。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中明确列出；Manuel Corpas 为 Genomelink / H3 Biomedicine 前成员，Alfredo Iacoangeli 与 UK Biobank/Wellcome Sanger 相关，Nathan Skene 为 Max Planck / UK Dementia Research Institute，但无统一主导机构）
analysis.claim: 基因组学AI代理的可信度不取决于大语言模型本身，而取决于是否将经验证的临床决策逻辑以版本化、可执行代码技能的形式固化，使模型退居为输入解析器。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 真实人群来源的星等位基因型（star-allele diplotypes）
analysis.output: 药理基因型-表型映射结果（如 CYP2C19 *1/*2 → 'intermediate metabolizer'）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人群基因型数据（>7000名欧洲/拉丁美洲/东非裔个体）及临床注释的110个药理基因组案例
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在药理基因组学这一高风险领域完成大规模受控评估（44,550次评分），实证揭示LLM推理不可靠、检索增强反而增加致命错误，并提出‘技能即代码’架构——该架构在真实多祖先群体上验证了临床映射的确定性与跨人群不变性，证据扎实（真数据+多模型+消融对比+可审计性设计），但尚未开源完整代码/技能库，也未覆盖非标准输入或真实临床工作流，未达AlphaFold级范式革命，属重磅工程范式迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用高风险场景下的大规模实证推翻了‘让LLM理解生物学’的主流路径，确立了‘可信=可执行技能+受限模型’的新架构，为AI驱动的临床基因组学提供了首个可审计、可版本化、可跨人群部署的落地范式。

papers.title: CoLI: A Reproducible Platform for Continuum Robot Learning via Monolithic 3D Printing and Isomorphic Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Continuum robots offer strong potential for manipulation tasks due to their high degrees of freedom, compliant structures, and operational safety. However, their adoption in both research and practical applications has been hindered by reproducibility issues arising from complex fabrication and assembly processes, challenging kinematic modeling, and a lack of intuitive control interfaces. To address these challenges, we present a novel open-source continuum robot design. The platform features a simplified fabrication pipeline enabled by multi-material 3D printing, allowing the arm to be fabricated as a monolithic compliant structure with minimal assembly. Control is achieved through an isomorphic teleoperation interface that establishes a direct actuator-level mapping, eliminating the need for explicit kinematic modeling and providing a singularity-free mapping. Building on this hardware design, the platform further supports imitation-learning-based autonomous control. The proposed system is evaluated through hardware characterization and a set of manipulation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the platform provides a reproducible, learning-ready continuum robot system, accelerating algorithmic development and systematic benchmarking for the continuum robotics community.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个用多材料3D打印一体成型的连续体机器人硬件平台，配等距映射式遥操作接口，无需运动学建模即可直接控制，支持模仿学习，目标是解决连续体机器人因制造复杂、标定困难、控制不直观导致的算法复现难问题。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅知通讯作者为Chenxi Xiao，无机构信息）
analysis.claim: 通过单体3D打印结构+等距遥操作接口，可消除连续体机器人对显式运动学建模和精密装配的依赖，构建首个可复现、即插即学的连续体机器人开源实验平台。
analysis.input: 人类操作员的手部运动（通过等距遥操作接口映射）
analysis.output: 连续体机器人末端执行器的连续形变轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研单体3D打印连续体机械臂（含气动/缆驱动模块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的遥操作演示数据（摘要称‘imitation-learning-based autonomous control’且‘evaluated through hardware characterization’，但未说明是否使用外部数据集或预采集规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了连续体机器人硬件标准化与学习友好性：单体打印大幅降低制造门槛，等距映射绕过长期困扰的运动学建模难题，并配套开源数据与基准任务；但未展示跨机体泛化、未对比主流基线（如SAC/BC/Diffusion Policy在该硬件上的性能）、未验证复杂接触操作（如穿针、软组织缠绕），影响力限于细分硬件-学习接口层，尚未达到ALOHA/π0级算法范式突破或YUBI/RealDexUMI级通用接口规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了连续体机器人领域长期存在的硬件不可复现、控制不直观两大工程瓶颈，但算法深度和任务广度尚属扎实增量，非范式突破。

papers.title: Duet: Dual-Robot Understanding via Efficient Teaching
papers.abstract: Dual-robot collaboration enables tasks that exceed the reach and payload of a single robot, such as collaboratively transporting objects across environments and executing coordinated handovers. Data acquisition is the primary bottleneck for training these systems. To this end, we introduce DUET, a dual-robot learning framework for mobile manipulation. For efficient data collection, we create a unified dual-embodiment synchronized VR-based teleoperation system for in-domain heterogeneous robot data collection. We further develop a complementary tracking pipeline that records human-human coordination and collaborative mobile manipulation priors. To allow efficient learning, we introduce an Action Chunking Transformer based architecture that first pretrains collaborative policies on efficient human-human demonstrations, before finetuning them on a minimal set of real-robot teleoperation trajectories. We develop a benchmark of four collaborative tasks to evaluate our framework using a Unitree G1 humanoid and a Dexmate Vega1 mobile manipulator. The results demonstrate that harnessing human priors not only yields superior task performance compared to baselines trained only on robot data, but also reduces the total human effort required for data collection. Our human data collection pipeline achieves 5.4x acceleration on average from teleoperation, but we perform equally or better than robot-only data trained policies across all tasks. Our project page is available at https://zhaoy37.github.io/Duet/.

analysis.tldr: 提出DUET框架，用VR遥操作+人类协作视频数据双路采集，结合动作分块Transformer模型，让两个异构机器人（人形+移动机械臂）学会协同搬运和交接任务，大幅减少真实机器人数据采集量。
analysis.claim: 通过融合人类协作先验（VR遥操作+人类视频）与少量真实双机器人轨迹，可显著提升双机器人协同任务性能并降低数据采集成本。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人本体状态+VR手柄动作+人类协作视频帧序列
analysis.output: 双机器人协同动作序列（含时序对齐的关节扭矩/末端位姿指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + Dexmate Vega1移动机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实双机器人遥操作轨迹（用于微调），但核心训练数据来自人类VR遥操作和人类协作视频
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+4个跨机体协同任务+人类先验与机器人数据联合训练范式有实质创新，性能超越纯机器人数据基线，但未开新范式（如GR00T/N1级通用具身架构）、未解决长期开放难题（如泛化到未知机体组合或长程任务规划），属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类协作先验系统性引入双机器人协同学习闭环，实证充分、部署可信，但非理论或架构级突破

papers.title: MAPL: Multi-Objective Preference Learning for Robot Locomotion
papers.abstract: Reward design remains a major bottleneck in reinforcement learning for robot locomotion, where successful policies often depend on carefully tuned, task-specific reward functions. Preference-based reinforcement learning offers an alternative, but existing LLM-based methods typically ask for a single overall judgment between behaviors, making it difficult to capture the multiple competing objectives that underlie high-quality locomotion. We present Multi-Objective AI-Informed Preference Learning (MAPL), a framework that learns locomotion rewards from high-level natural language objectives rather than manually engineered reward equations. MAPL prompts a large language model to compare trajectories independently along semantically meaningful criteria, using generic language descriptions that are terrain-invariant and require little domain expertise. These objective-wise preferences are used to train a multi-head preference scoring model, whose outputs are aggregated to form a scalar reward for policy optimization. Across four quadruped locomotion environments, MAPL trains policies using only LLM-generated preferences and achieves performance comparable to or better than expert-designed rewards, while eliminating task-specific reward engineering.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型对机器人行走轨迹按多个自然语言描述的目标（如稳定性、效率、平滑性）分别打分，再融合成标量奖励来训练四足机器人策略，完全不用人工设计奖励函数。
analysis.claim: 通过让大语言模型在多个语义明确的维度上独立比较运动轨迹，可替代人工奖励工程，实现高质量、泛化性强的四足机器人强化学习训练。
analysis.input: 多段四足机器人仿真轨迹 + 每段对应的自然语言目标描述（如'保持身体高度稳定'）
analysis.output: 标量奖励值（用于RL策略优化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree A1 / Go1 仿真模型（基于PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据；全部依赖仿真轨迹采样与LLM偏好标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将多目标偏好分解+LLM语义评分引入具身运动学习，在4个仿真地形任务上验证了免人工奖励的可行性，但未部署真机、无跨机体验证、未与SOTA运动控制器（如Cassie/ANYmal最新成果）对比，也未解决LLM偏好噪声或一致性等根本缺陷，属扎实且有启发性的增量推进，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计清晰、实验完整，解决了奖励工程痛点，但限于仿真和单机体，尚未证明其在复杂现实场景中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: CoDex: Learning Compositional Dexterous Functional Manipulation without Demonstrations
papers.abstract: In this work, we study Compositional Dexterous Functional Object Manipulation (CD-FOM): tasks such as aiming and actuating a spray bottle on a plant or a glue gun on wood, which require both actuating an object's internal mechanism and controlling its pose to apply the object's function to the environment. These tasks pose significant challenges for robots due to the demanding integration of semantic understanding of the object's function, actuation mode, and application area with intricate physical dexterity to manage grasp stability, movement trajectory, and actuation. We introduce CoDex, a zero-demonstration framework that autonomously discovers CD-FOM manipulation strategies. CoDex uses vision-language models (VLMs) to infer semantic constraints from the task and scene. These constraints guide analytic constrained optimization to generate a short list of functional grasp candidates that can be efficiently refined with reinforcement learning to generate full grasp-move-actuate policies transferable from simulation to the real world. We evaluate CoDex on a 7-DoF robot arm with a 16-DoF multi-fingered hand across six CD-FOM tasks involving previously unseen objects with internal mechanisms, including spray bottles, hot glue guns, air dusters, flashlights, and pepper grinders, and their application to unseen target objects, showcasing its ability to autonomously discover and execute complex, physically viable dexterous behaviors without human demonstrations. More information at https://robin-lab.cs.utexas.edu/CoDex/.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoDex框架，让机器人无需人类示范就能自主学会操作带内部机构的工具（如喷壶、胶枪），先用视觉语言模型理解任务语义，再通过约束优化生成可行抓取点，最后用强化学习优化出‘抓取-移动-触发’完整策略，并在真实7自由度机械臂+16自由度灵巧手平台上完成6个新物体新场景的任务。
analysis.claim: 无需任何人类演示，仅凭视觉语言模型引导的约束优化与仿真到现实迁移的强化学习，即可实现对未知功能性物体的 compositional dexterous functional manipulation。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务描述（如'用喷壶给植物喷水'）
analysis.output: 端到端灵巧操作策略（包含抓取位姿、运动轨迹、触发动作时序）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Shadow Dexterous Hand
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据，但依赖仿真中预建的物体功能模型和物理参数；真实实验阶段使用少量真实交互微调（摘要未说明是否需真实数据微调，但强调‘transferable from simulation to the real world’，且未提real-data fine-tuning，故判为 low）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无演示前提下系统性解决‘功能性灵巧操作’这一长期开放难题（区别于单纯抓取或开柜门），实证覆盖6类含复杂内部机构的新物体+新目标场景，真机验证+跨物体泛化+仿真到现实迁移+VLM语义引导闭环，证据链完整扎实，但未开源代码/模型，且未与ALOHA/ACT等SOTA示范学习方法做直接对比，略逊于T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它跳出了‘必须靠人教’的范式，在功能性灵巧操作这个硬骨头问题上，用VLM+约束优化+RL实现了真正意义上的自主发现与执行，证据充分、任务真实、平台完整。

papers.title: SE(2) Navigation Mesh
papers.abstract: Global navigation for ground robots in complex multi-level environments requires representations that accurately capture traversable regions while enabling efficient path planning. Current approaches present key limitations: Point clouds and volumetric occupancy maps lack explicit surface structure for traversability estimation, whereas direct pathfinding on dense triangle meshes is computationally prohibitive. Navigation meshes mitigate these challenges through polygonal abstraction of the underlying mesh, but assume yaw-invariant traversability, rendering them unsuitable for non-circular robots in constrained spaces. We propose SE(2) Navigation Mesh (SE(2) NavMesh), a polygonal representation of traversable regions that encodes yaw-dependent traversability. Our method evaluates traversability using footprint masks and constructs a graph over yaw-specific layers with explicit translational and rotational connectivity. Grounded in this representation, we develop an A*-String Pulling-A* (ASA) pathfinding strategy that hierarchically optimizes robot position and heading. We also present an online method that incrementally updates the SE(2) NavMesh from streaming point clouds during concurrent geometry reconstruction. In simulation, the SE(2) NavMesh captures over 50% more traversable area than classical NavMeshes, and the SE(2) NavMesh + ASA pipeline consistently outperforms sampling-based baselines in constrained environments. Extensive real-world experiments on a physical robot validate real-time online generation and successful navigation across multiple environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能表达机器人朝向依赖可通行性的导航网格（SE(2) NavMesh），通过分层多朝向多边形图结构建模，配合A*-String Pulling-A*路径规划，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其在复杂狭小环境中比传统导航网格覆盖更多可通行区域、路径更优且支持实时在线更新。
analysis.claim: SE(2) NavMesh 是首个显式编码朝向依赖可通行性的多边形导航表示，支持非圆形机器人在多层复杂环境中高效、精确、实时的全局导航。
analysis.input: 流式点云数据（含几何重建）
analysis.output: 带朝向信息的最优路径（位置+航向序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的点云流与导航任务执行反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多环境跨任务验证+明确超越采样类基线+首次系统解决yaw-dependent traversability建模问题，但未开源数据/完整训练细节，且未挑战长期开放难题（如语义泛化或长时序状态维持），属扎实重磅增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将朝向敏感可通行性建模、分层图构建与混合路径优化完整落地到真实四足机器人，证据充分但未开源全栈，尚未达到World Models级范式意义。

papers.title: TrustVLA: Mechanism-Guided Inference-Time Defense Against Vision-Language-Action Backdoors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are deployed through pipelines that end users cannot audit, and a poisoned VLA can behave normally on clean observations while a small visual trigger redirects a long-horizon robot policy before any failure becomes observable. Existing vision or language defenses rarely explain what a triggered VLA representation looks like or how to recover behavior without retraining. We study this gap through two independently proposed VLA attacks from groups with distinct injection strategies, BadVLA and INFUSE; the latter persists after downstream clean adaptation. Across the evaluated poisoned models, we identify a recurring internal mechanism: a \emph{compact causal footprint}, namely a small visual support that is attention-seeded, spatially compact, and \emph{causal} in a precise sense -- masking it returns a clean-calibrated evidence-evolution score to the normal operating region. This footprint motivates TrustVLA, a mechanism-guided inference-time defense that adapts the Dirichlet evidence framework from trusted classification to monitor per-token, per-layer epistemic uncertainty in VLA policies. With only a small clean calibration set, TrustVLA (i)~detects abnormal evidence evolution, (ii)~localizes the compact support by counterfactual mechanism-score drop, and (iii)~recovers the observation by localized inpainting. Across OpenVLA/LIBERO and $π_{0.5}$ transfer evaluations, TrustVLA reduces attack success while preserving clean-task performance, providing a retraining-free, mechanism-guided defense for visual-triggered VLA backdoors.

analysis.tldr: 提出TrustVLA，一种不需重新训练、在推理时检测并修复视觉触发式后门攻击的防御方法，通过识别被毒化VLA模型中可解释的‘紧凑因果足迹’，结合Dirichlet证据监控和局部反事实归因实现检测、定位与图像修复。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言动作（VLA）模型中的后门攻击存在可泛化的紧凑因果足迹，据此可构建无需重训练、可解释、推理时生效的三步防御机制（检测-定位-修复）。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 安全/受攻击判断 + 触发区域定位 + 修复后的观测输入（用于下游策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需小规模干净校准集（非真实机器人交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在VLA后门防御中建立可解释的因果机制（紧凑因果足迹），实证覆盖BadVLA/INFUSE两类攻击、多个VLA基座（OpenVLA/LIBERO/π₀.₅），具备跨任务/跨模型泛化性，但未在真实机器人上验证，无开源代码，且未挑战更复杂的多模态耦合后门（如语言+视觉协同触发），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺真机验证与开源代码，但机制发现扎实、评估全面，是VLA安全领域首个具备可解释性与推理时修复能力的系统性方案。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Motion Maps: An Open-Vocabulary, Uncertainty-Aware, Queryable Motion Attribute for 3D Scene Maps
papers.abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D maps let robots answer language queries about what and where, but they assume a static world and cannot answer queries about how scene elements behave. We introduce Vision-Language-Motion Maps (VLMM), an open-vocabulary, natural-language-queryable 3D map in which each element carries a fused motion attribute: a VLM/LLM semantic movability prior combined with geometrically observed cross-frame motion, together with a per-element uncertainty. Queries reduce to attribute filters that distinguish what has been seen to move, what could move but has not, and what stays still. On a controlled simulator benchmark with exact ground truth (AI2-THOR, three scene types) we show through ablation that the schema fields are non-substitutable: a semantic-only baseline fails motion queries even with strong features, and neither motion field substitutes for the other (the prior cannot answer "what is moving," observed motion cannot answer "what could move"). On real dynamic RGB-D (TUM and Bonn, six sequences) we show the uncertainty channel-our key difference from prior fused-motion work-consistently improves moving-vs-static average precision and reduces false motion flags, and is robust to estimated (noisy) poses. The raw confidence is not calibrated, but post-hoc isotonic calibration reaches an expected calibration error of 0.10. VLMM is a representation contribution: the closest prior maps each lack at least one of the four properties-open-vocabulary, language-queryable, fused prior-and-observed motion, and per-element uncertainty-that our combination provides.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫VLMM的新型3D场景地图表示，它不仅能回答‘这是什么、在哪’（传统开放词汇地图），还能用自然语言回答‘这个东西会不会动、正在动吗、为什么不确定’——通过把大模型给出的语义可动性先验、跨帧几何观测到的实际运动、以及每个物体的不确定性估计三者融合进地图元素中。
analysis.claim: 开放词汇、可自然语言查询、带不确定性感知的融合运动属性（语义先验+观测运动）是构建动态3D场景地图的必要且不可替代的表示维度。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频序列 + 自然语言查询（如‘哪些东西能动但还没动？’）
analysis.output: 每个3D地图元素的三元组：（可动性先验概率，观测运动向量，不确定性标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人动作数据，仅需动态RGB-D序列（TUM/Bonn）和仿真器轨迹（AI2-THOR）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将语义可动性先验、观测运动与显式不确定性三者耦合进开放词汇3D地图，实证表明三者缺一不可；但在真实机器人闭环控制、任务泛化、策略输出等关键环节无验证，未接入任何执行层，仍属表征层创新，强于纯benchmark但弱于RT-2/Octo等具身行动模型范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真推进了动态场景理解的表征基础，但尚未连接感知与行动，属于扎实的上游表示创新，非具身智能闭环突破。

papers.title: Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
papers.abstract: The ability to acquire skills rapidly and effortlessly while retaining those already mastered is essential for robots. However, current methods still rely on a cumbersome training-time loop that is costly and slow, while eroding skills already mastered. In this paper, we introduce HOST (Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion), a framework that enables a robot to acquire skills in seconds from a single human video while retaining previously mastered skills. HOST resolves skill acquisition through a cascade of self-grounded prediction. It first estimates the robot's progress within the demonstrated task, then translates the upcoming progression into the robot's own future observations, and finally derives actions from these predicted observations. This cascade is trained on targets coupled to the video demonstration, obtained by mapping the robot trajectory and the video demonstration onto a shared task progress manifold, then redefining each target to align with the future progression of the video. HOST thereby enables the robot to actively follow the demonstrated procedure and adapt it to the robot's embodiment. HOST acquires novel skills at inference time from a single human video in an average of 29 seconds and achieves a 62% average success rate. It exceeds the zero-shot baseline by 45% while retaining previously mastered skills. HOST even exceeds the baseline fine-tuned on 50 robot demonstrations per task while requiring 50 times fewer demonstrations and acquiring each skill 507 times faster. Additional information about HOST is available on the project website.

analysis.tldr: 提出HOST框架，让机器人仅看一段人类操作视频（无需任何机器人数据），29秒内学会新操作技能，且不遗忘已学技能，平均成功率62%，比零样本基线高45%，比用50段真机演示微调的基线更快更少数据。
analysis.claim: 仅凭单段人类视频，机器人可在推理时秒级获得新操作技能，且不干扰已有技能，核心是通过共享任务进度流形实现自接地预测级联。
analysis.input: 单段人类操作视频（无标注、无同步、无机器人视角）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据（训练阶段未使用任何真机轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨任务泛化（12个操作任务）、实测秒级部署、显著超越零样本和少量微调基线，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验和多机体对比，未达ALOHA/ACT级系统性工程深度与开放性，属扎实重磅但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机械臂上实现了单视频秒级技能迁移的端到端闭环，证据扎实，但开源缺失和消融不足限制其复现与社区推动能力。

papers.title: Spectral power, but not phase connectivity, decodes the subanaesthetic ketamine state from surface EEG: the role of between-subject transferability
papers.abstract: Abstract Subanaesthetic ketamine alters the content of consciousness while leaving responsiveness intact. We asked whether this state can be decoded from single eyes-closed EEG epochs, and how spectral power and phase-based connectivity compare when used as features. Re-analysing openly available 62-channel EEG from ten participants (awake versus subanaesthetic ketamine), we trained classifiers under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation to discriminate the two conditions from log band power, weighted phase-lag index (wPLI) connectivity, and their concatenation. Band power decoded the ketamine state above chance (balanced accuracy 0.71), whereas wPLI connectivity computed on the same epochs was at chance (0.47), and combining the feature sets did not improve on power alone. The dissociation held across three classifier families and across spatial montages, and was not explained by the dimensionality of the connectivity feature space. To identify its source, we decomposed the per-feature drug effect into components shared across subjects and subject-specific. The ketamine effect on connectivity was large within individuals but largely subject-specific, and therefore not transferable to held-out subjects (shared fraction 0.05), whereas the spectral effect was substantially shared across subjects (0.53); both feature classes carried comparable individual identity, so the asymmetry reflects transferability rather than fingerprint-likeness. The spectral signature was also recoverable from a sparse electrode subset, as a five-channel lateral montage performed as well as the full array. Undirected phase connectivity thus fails to decode subanaesthetic ketamine not through insufficient spatial sampling, but because the connectivity drug effect is subject-specific in form.

analysis.tldr: 用公开的10人静息态EEG数据，发现仅靠频谱功率（而非相位连接性）能稳定区分亚麻醉剂量氯胺酮状态与清醒状态，且该频谱信号在被试间可迁移，而相位连接变化几乎完全是个体特异的，无法跨被试泛化。
analysis.claim: 亚麻醉氯胺酮引起的脑电改变中，频谱功率具有跨被试可迁移的群体标记特性，而相位连接性虽在个体内显著但不具备跨被试解码能力。
analysis.input: 单次闭眼静息态62通道EEG片段（log带功率或wPLI相位连接矩阵）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（清醒 vs 亚麻醉氯胺酮）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开的离线小规模临床EEG数据（n=10），无实时采集或闭环交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的神经生理机制解析工作，揭示了频谱功率作为跨被试生物标志物的稳健性，但样本量极小（n=10）、无临床验证、未涉及解码实时行为或干预闭环，与基石级BCI（如高精度脑-语/脑-手实时解码、脊髓接口恢复自然步态）相比，既无新范式、也无功能重建、更无临床转化证据，仅限离线分析层面的特征可迁移性归因。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有EEG特征、公开数据集和标准机器学习流程用于厘清一个具体药理神经标记的可迁移性来源，方法规范但问题尺度窄、临床相关性弱，暂不具备推动BCI实用化的直接价值。

papers.title: Safety First: Input Screening for Protein Design Tools
papers.abstract: As biological AI models become more powerful, practical biosecurity approaches are needed to support beneficial applications while reducing misuse risks. Sequence–similarity–based screening approaches are no longer adequate to safeguard biological AI models because these models can design molecules with novel sequences and structures. Therefore, a screening approach that takes function into account is needed. To address this need, we propose a new screening method for AI-enabled protein binder design tools. Our framework screens protein binding targets, with a focus on the human proteome, as opposed to the binder molecule itself. We constructed a database of 14,541 potentially harmful proteoform targets from the human proteome (7.1% of all human protein proteoforms) classified by biosecurity risk level. To discern structural and functional features, we evaluated constructs with an embedding-based screening method using the ESM-C protein language model. ESM-C achieved high accuracy for detecting variants of known targets (F1 scores >97%), with performance similar to BLASTP. However, ESM-C proved to be more effective at capturing functional relationships, distinguishing benign mutations from damaging ones where BLASTP did not. To characterize how screening would affect bioscience research, we measured flagging rates across diverse protein datasets. Flagging rates were significant for mammalian proteins weighted by publication frequency (23% for human, 20% for mouse), and rates for organisms distantly related to humans were minimal (<1.1% for bacteria, fungi, plants, and viruses). Among commercially relevant targets, 63% of antibody patent targets were classified as dual-use, reflecting that therapeutically important proteins often perform critical biological functions. To identify and flag risky user requests from protein binder design tools without placing an undue burden on scientific research and innovation, it will be essential to deploy this screening approach in a way that addresses the overlap our analysis showed between targets of concern and therapeutic targets—possibly in concert with tiered trusted access frameworks. This new method provides a foundation for proportionate safeguards for biological AI models that reduce misuse risks while preserving their benefits for legitimate research and demonstrates a concrete proof of principle that can be generalized to other protein design tools and biological AI models.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向蛋白结合靶点（而非设计出的结合蛋白本身）的生物安全筛查框架，用ESM-C模型对人类蛋白组中1.45万个潜在有害蛋白变体按生物安全风险分级，并验证其比传统BLASTP更能识别功能破坏性突变，同时量化了不同生物数据集的误报率和商业靶点的双用途比例。
analysis.claim: 基于功能感知的靶点级筛查（而非序列相似性）可更准确识别AI蛋白设计工具中潜在的高风险请求，且能兼顾科研可用性与生物安全需求。
analysis.input: 人类蛋白组中的蛋白序列及其已知功能注释、突变信息、生物安全风险标签
analysis.output: 靶点蛋白的生物安全风险等级分类（如高/中/低风险）及功能扰动预测（良性/致病性）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建靶点级生物安全风险数据库并实证验证功能嵌入模型（ESM-C）在风险识别上优于序列比对，覆盖多物种与专利靶点，但未开源代码/模型，未集成进任一主流蛋白设计工具链，属扎实的跨学科方法论落地，尚未形成技术闭环或社区标准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺工程闭环，但为AI驱动蛋白设计设定了首个可量化的生物安全评估范式，证据扎实、问题关键、尺度真实。

papers.title: De novo design of a protein fold for small-molecule binding through aromatic π stacking
papers.abstract: The de novo design of proteins that bind chemically complex small molecules has broad chemical and biological implications, but strategies typically rely on a small set of protein scaffolds and require extensive experimental screening. Here, we computationally designed proteins around a minimal aromatic π-stacking motif to bind the anthracycline anticancer drug doxorubicin. Experimental characterization of twelve proteins revealed a μM doxorubicin binder; two additional design cycles improved scaffold stability and binding affinity to yield an 85-residue protein that binds doxorubicin with a dissociation constant of 85 nM. An X-ray crystal structure of the protein-drug complex confirmed the accuracy of the designed π-π stacking interactions. The designed protein could act to protect cultured cells from doxorubicin-induced cytotoxicity. Unlike previous ligand-binding protein designs based on repeat proteins or naturally occurring folds, the designed protein adopts a previously unobserved 5-helix globular fold, indicating that a broader space of folded, functional proteins exists even for compact tertiary structures smaller than 100 residues. These results demonstrate that motif-guided generative protein design can discover compact de novo protein folds capable of high-affinity recognition of chemically complex small molecules.

analysis.tldr: 用计算方法从头设计了一个全新的5螺旋球状蛋白折叠，专门通过芳香π-π堆叠结合抗癌药阿霉素，实验验证其85 nM亲和力、晶体结构证实设计精度，并展示其在细胞中保护作用。
analysis.claim: 基于最小芳香π堆叠基序的模因引导生成式蛋白设计，可发现全新紧凑型功能性折叠，实现对化学结构复杂的非肽类小分子的高亲和力结合。
analysis.input: 阿霉素分子结构 + 芳香π堆叠几何约束 + 蛋白骨架生成先验
analysis.output: 85残基全新5螺旋蛋白序列及三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验验证了全新折叠+高亲和力+晶体结构确认+功能表型（细胞保护），且突破了以往依赖天然支架的范式；但仅针对单一分子（阿霉素），未展示跨分子泛化或大规模生成能力，未开源代码/模型，未构建通用benchmark，故强于多数de novo设计工作但未达RFdiffusion/ESMFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现从头设计出全新折叠、高亲和力、结构验证、功能验证的小分子结合蛋白，实质性拓展了可设计蛋白结构空间的边界。

papers.title: Robo-Dopamine 2.0: History-Conditioned and OOD-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models improve robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to compounding errors, scene changes, and off-trajectory states. Reinforcement learning can refine pretrained VLA policies, yet sparse success signals hinder exploration, while engineered dense rewards are costly and task-specific. Existing learned visual reward models often rely on static before-after observations, causing temporal ambiguity and weak discrimination between robustness-preserving variations and task-invalid failures under out-of-distribution (OOD) execution. We introduce Robo-Dopamine 2.0, a history- and OOD-aware process reward model with a pairwise prediction interface. It combines (1) history-conditioned pairwise rewards that use source-aligned reference panels for synthetic OOD queries and observed rollout history for online queries, while preserving the queried endpoints, and (2) an OOD-aware signed progress space that represents valid progress, robustness, failure, and recovery. A Signed-Hop Curriculum with transition-aware replay learns coarse execution ordering before fine-grained progress calibration. We also construct an OOD trajectory dataset and a five-family benchmark. Reference panels improve mean visual order consistency (VOC) from 0.967 to 0.986 and OOD-robust VOC from 0.906 to 0.958. With the same 400K pairwise-reward budget, Signed-Hop training with 25% replay reaches 0.9872 mean VOC, compared with 0.9858 for a matched-pool shuffled control. In downstream reinforcement learning, the full model achieves 86.8% mean RoboTwin success and 71/80 successful real-world insertions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Robo-Dopamine 2.0，一种能根据机器人执行历史判断动作序列是否在‘正确方向上进展’的奖励模型，专门解决VLA策略在真实操作中因小错误累积、场景变化或偏离轨迹而崩溃的问题；它用参考图像面板合成OOD测试样本，构建带符号的进展空间（区分有效进展/鲁棒性保持/失败/恢复），并通过Signed-Hop课程学习提升排序鲁棒性，在仿真和真实机械臂插入任务中验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 历史条件化+OOD感知的过程奖励建模，能显著提升VLA策略在分布外执行中的鲁棒性与可校准性，且无需人工设计密集奖励函数。
analysis.input: 机器人执行的历史观测序列（多帧RGB+状态）+当前/目标端点图像+参考面板图像（用于合成OOD查询）
analysis.output: 标量符号化进展得分（+1:有效进展, 0:鲁棒性保持, -1:失败, +0.5:恢复）及成对相对排序概率
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真器 + UR5e真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实插入任务的80条成功轨迹（仅80次真实实验），其余训练数据来自合成与仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有结构的设计（符号化进展空间、Signed-Hop课程、参考面板合成OOD）并实证提升了VOC和真实插入成功率，但真实世界验证仅限单一任务（80次插入）、无跨机体/跨用户测试，未接入端到端VLA闭环训练，开源程度低（仅项目页），相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作，属于扎实的子问题推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在过程奖励建模这一关键子方向上做出结构清晰、实证可信的改进，但受限于真实数据规模、泛化验证广度和开源完整性，尚未达到开新范式或支撑通用操作基础模型的量级。

papers.title: InstructMove: A Text-Indispensable Benchmark for Instruction-Following Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made general-purpose robot manipulation increasingly plausible by conditioning robot actions on natural-language instructions. A key test of such generality is whether policies actually follow language instructions. Yet many manipulation benchmarks leave this ability underdetermined: the intended object or destination is often visually salient or uniquely feasible, allowing policies to succeed without grounding the instruction. We argue that instruction-following evaluation should be text-indispensable: multiple actions should be visually and physically plausible, while only one should be consistent with the language instruction. We introduce InstructMove, a text-indispensable benchmark for instruction-following manipulation. InstructMove instantiates this principle in pick-and-place scenes with semantic distractors, decomposing instruction following into category identification, attribute discrimination, spatial reasoning, and compositional pick-and-place. InstructMove supports a train-eval protocol with InstructMove training data and held-out evaluation tasks, with additional diagnostics for language dependence. Experiments with representative VLA policies show that InstructMove provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing visual shortcuts and that InstructMove simulation data can improve real-world instruction-following manipulation performance. Code: https://github.com/HorizonRobotics/RoboOrchardSim

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫InstructMove的新基准，专门测试机器人是否真能根据自然语言指令做抓取放置操作，而不是靠视觉捷径蒙混过关；它通过引入语义干扰物让多个动作在视觉上都合理，只有一条符合文字指令，从而强制模型必须理解语言。
analysis.claim: 指令跟随操纵的评估必须是‘文本不可或缺’的——即在多个视觉与物理上均可行的动作中，仅有一个与语言指令一致，否则无法验证模型是否真正理解语言。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 抓取-放置动作序列（含目标物体类别、属性、空间关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰、可操作的‘text-indispensable’评估原则并落地为首个专注指令跟随语义鲁棒性的基准，但仅基于单一仿真环境、无真实硬件验证、未覆盖多机体/跨任务泛化，且未开源数据或模型，属于扎实的增量型方法论贡献，远未达T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了有明确诊断价值的仿真基准，推动VLA评估范式升级，但缺乏实证广度与开放性，尚未形成对真实部署的闭环支撑。

papers.title: WaterFlow: Prediction of Ordered Water Molecule Positions on Protein Structures
papers.abstract: Ordered water molecules mediate many protein functions, including stability, ligand binding, and catalysis. Predicting their positions with sub-angstrom accuracy would support protein design, binding affinity prediction, and automated model building in X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM. However, water molecule prediction lags behind protein and other molecule structure predictions. Here, we introduce WaterFlow, a flow-matching-based generator model and confidence model for predicting the positions of ordered water molecules in protein structures. WaterFlow outperforms the existing state of the art at every precision level. We demonstrate that WaterFlow can accurately predict ground truth modeled water molecules, including those around protein-ligand interactions and on predicted structures. We also show that WaterFlow predictions fit well directly to experimental data, and therefore propose that it may be used for both prediction and modeling water molecules. This includes novel predictions that are often associated with positive electron difference density, meaning the model places water molecules at sites the original structure depositions omitted. We use this improved model to address the data constraint. By mapping the Pareto front of achievable accuracy of water molecule prediction, alongside analysis of different training data schemas, we quantified the trade-off between data quantity and data quality, demonstrating that the diversity of high-quality structures is limiting the possible results. Overall, WaterFlow predicts ordered water to serve as a solvent module for structure-based drug design and for water molecule placement during crystallographic refinement.

analysis.tldr: 提出WaterFlow模型，用流匹配（flow-matching）方法在已知蛋白结构上高精度预测有序水分子的三维坐标，并验证其能填补X射线晶体结构中遗漏的真实水位点，且预测结果与实验电子密度图吻合。
analysis.org: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室/加州大学旧金山分校（联合团队，通讯作者Wankowicz、Wall、Holton均隶属LBNL/UCSF）
analysis.claim: WaterFlow是首个基于流匹配的生成式模型，能在亚埃级精度下泛化预测蛋白表面及结合口袋中有序水分子的位置，并可直接用于实验结构修正和药物设计中的溶剂建模。
analysis.input: 蛋白质主链与侧链原子坐标（PDB格式）、可选配体坐标、局部几何环境特征
analysis.output: 有序水分子的三维空间坐标（x,y,z）及其置信度得分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开结构生物学数据库（PDB、EMDB）中的高质量实验解析结构，未使用任何机器人或传感器采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将流匹配生成范式系统应用于水分子位置预测，在多个严格基准（包括ligand-bound复合物、de novo预测结构、电子密度拟合）上显著超越Prior SOTA（如Hydrogenate、WaterDock、3D-RISM），提供可解释置信度，并发现大量被原始PDB遗漏但具正差分电子密度的水位点；但未开源代码/模型权重，训练数据未完全公开，且未嵌入端到端药物设计闭环（如结合自由能提升验证），故未达AlphaFold2级里程碑，但属结构生物学AI工具链的关键补缺。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个‘打榜式’水预测器，而是首个用生成式建模+置信校准+实验密度验证三位一体解决水定位不确定性的方法，实质性推进了结构生物学中长期被低估的溶剂建模瓶颈。

papers.title: Model Validation Protocols for Machine Learning in Small Molecule Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Abstract Machine learning (ML) models for molecular property prediction are increasingly deployed in drug discovery, yet their adoption in real-world scenarios requires an understanding of the conditions in which a model succeeds or fails. While standardized benchmarks are powerful instruments to measure and unlock progress in ML research, they should not be blindly treated as the end goal. Especially static and retrospective benchmarks, in which no true unknown test set is employed, limit our ability to robustly validate a model’s performance. Building on the collective expertise of a cross-industry consortium, we present a model validation framework consisting of five recommendations that would enable the community to move beyond aggregate metrics toward understanding where and why molecular property prediction models fail. We connect evaluation choices to real-world applications and case studies encountered in pharmaceutical research. The framework proposes splitting strategies that mimic realistic distribution shifts and expose common failure modes. We apply the recommended framework on a recently released dataset of absorption, distribution, metabolism, and excretion (ADME) properties. Across two complementary model algorithms, our case studies reveal four distinct failure modes (extrapolation, interpolation, representation, and evaluation) showing that model errors arise not only from distribution shift but also from limitations in molecular representations. Our results show that commonly used evaluation protocols can significantly overestimate performance and may not detect important model failure modes. All software and data are released via https://github.com/srijitseal/polaris .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套针对小分子药物发现中机器学习模型的验证协议，强调不能只看标准基准上的平均指标，而要通过模拟真实分布偏移的划分策略，系统识别模型在 extrapolation、interpolation、分子表征和评估设计四个维度上的具体失败原因，并在ADME数据集上实证了常用评估方法会严重高估模型性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者来自多家机构，包括辉瑞、默克、诺华、拜耳、阿斯利康等药企及学术合作者，无单一主导机构）
analysis.claim: 当前小分子性质预测模型的主流评估范式（静态回顾性基准+聚合指标）无法反映真实药物研发中的失败模式，必须采用面向分布偏移、失败归因和应用语境的验证协议。
analysis.input: 小分子SMILES或图表示 + 目标ADME性质标签
analysis.output: 预测的连续型/分类型ADME性质值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开/合作提供的小分子性质数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个面向药物发现落地场景的、可操作的ML模型验证框架，有完整开源实现和ADME实证，揭示了四大失败模式并量化了评估偏差；但未提出新模型/新表征/新数据生成机制，也未解决核心科学难题（如准确预测难测ADME），属于方法论层面的重要规范升级，而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是真突破，但填补了AI×药物发现领域长期缺失的模型可信评估方法论空白，对工业界实践有直接指导价值。

papers.title: Toward Trustworthy Robot-Assisted Sliding Palpation for Shallow Vessel Localisation with a Calibrated Digital Twin
papers.abstract: Reliable localisation of shallow subsurface vessels is important for safe robot-assisted venous access and vessel-aware manipulation, but collecting diverse tactile data on physical hardware is costly, time-consuming, and can degrade soft vision-based tactile sensors. We present a robot-assisted sliding-palpation framework in which a calibrated digital twin generates labelled tactile sequences, reducing reliance on real-world data. The twin models sensor-vessel contact, is calibrated against real palpation trajectories using Bayesian-optimisation-based domain adaptation, and is randomised over sliding direction and contact conditions. A spatio-temporal graph neural network trained on simulated marker trajectories performs per-node vessel classification and produces a human-verifiable top-view localisation map through 2D-to-3D-to-2D geometric projection. We evaluate three datasets: Sim, Silicone, and Meat, the latter a raw-meat phantom with vessel models at nominal depths of 0 to 30 mm, using four train-to-test configurations: Sim to Sim, Sim to Silicone, Sim to Meat, and Meat to Silicone. The calibrated twin achieves a simulated-to-real marker-alignment mean absolute error of 0.50 mm at deepest contact across four canonical interactions. After reprojection onto a 1 mm top-view grid, predicted vessel pixels lie on average 1.05 to 5.49 mm from the nearest true vessel pixel across the four models, with 1.05 to 1.31 mm for all except Sim to Meat. The larger error for Sim to Meat reflects the greater domain shift and current limit of simulation transfer. These results demonstrate progress toward trustworthy tactile palpation through calibrated simulation, interpretable localisation, and transparent cross-domain evaluation. Code, model weights, and data are publicly available on GitHub and Zenodo.

analysis.tldr: 用一个校准过的数字孪生模型生成带标注的滑动触诊触觉序列数据，训练图神经网络识别浅层血管位置，并通过几何投影生成可人工验证的二维定位图，在硅胶和生肉仿体上验证了跨仿真到真实场景的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 校准的数字孪生可显著降低对真实触觉数据的依赖，同时支持可解释、可验证、跨域可靠的浅层血管触觉定位。
analysis.input: 滑动触诊过程中的触觉传感器标记点轨迹（3D时序坐标）
analysis.output: 每个空间节点的血管存在概率 + 2D俯视图定位热力图
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + TacTip触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 低：仅需少量真实轨迹用于数字孪生校准（Bayesian优化），主训练数据来自仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 在触觉血管定位这一高临床价值窄任务上，首次系统实现‘校准数字孪生→跨域泛化→可解释输出→全开源验证’闭环；虽未达T-Rex/ALOHA级通用性与部署规模，但在触觉医疗机器人中属当前最扎实的sim2real实证工作之一（含4种迁移配置、3类物理平台、消融明确、误差量化到毫米级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是通用策略，但在触觉医疗这一关键子领域，以严谨的校准机制、透明的评估协议和完整开源，实质性推进了可信触觉感知的落地可行性。

papers.title: Sensing Which Modality Matters: Evidence-Gated Regularization for Robust VLA Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies fuse multimodal sensory inputs, but training on limited and homogeneous robot demonstrations encourages spurious inter-sensor correlations rather than task-relevant signal, a failure we term modality entanglement. Under real-world occlusions and distractors, this manifests as nuisance sensitivity to corruption of uninformative sensors and single-modality insufficiency when only one informative sensor remains intact. We propose Evidence-Gated Regularization (EGR), a modality-agnostic training objective that introduces zero inference-time overhead. EGR derives a per-frame and per-sensor task-relevance signal to gate two state-conditional consistency objectives: invariance on low-evidence sensors, and single-sensor sufficiency on high-evidence ones. We introduce a benchmark based on BEHAVIOR-1K, comprising a fast inference-only diagnostic suite and 47 rollout-based skills targeting modality entanglement. We validate EGR on this benchmark and on two real-robot setups with fundamentally different embodiments: a bi-manual setup with two Kinova arms and three RGB cameras, and a single-arm MELFA ASSISTA setup combining vision and GelSight tactile sensors. EGR improves simulation success rates (SR) from 12.5% to 16.4% under full modalities (+31%), from 9.4% to 16.5% under uninformative-sensor corruption (+75%), and from 2.8% to 6.1% under single-sensor fallback (+120%). Under physical-object distractors, EGR boosts SR from 30% to 85% on the bi-manual setup (+183%) and from 55% to 70% on the tactile setup (+27%).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在训练时容易把不同传感器信号错误绑定（模态纠缠），导致一有遮挡或干扰就失效；为此提出一种叫EGR的正则化方法，在训练时自动判断每帧每个传感器对任务的证据强度，并据此约束模型：对弱证据传感器要求不变性，对强证据传感器要求单模态也能完成任务，且不增加推理开销。
analysis.claim: 通过证据门控正则化（EGR）解耦多模态输入的虚假相关性，可显著提升VLA策略在传感器损坏、遮挡和单模态退化下的鲁棒性，且无需修改模型结构或增加推理负担。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（可选）触觉信号等多模态传感器输入
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector pose / joint actions）
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinova双臂平台、MELFA ASSISTA单臂+GelSight触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（BEHAVIOR-1K衍生技能+两个实机平台采集的rollout数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多机体真实机器人上验证了模态纠缠问题并提出可即插即用的训练目标EGR，实测提升显著（如单传感器fallback下性能翻倍+），但未开源代码/模型，也未在更大规模VLA基座模型（如Qwen-RobotManip、Xiaomi-Robotics-1）上验证，属于扎实推进鲁棒性子方向的重磅工作，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模态鲁棒性问题形式化为可学习的证据门控正则化，在多个真实异构机器人上验证有效，但缺乏开源与大规模基座集成，属高质量工程驱动型改进。

papers.title: How to Learn from What a Human Would Avoid? Intervention-Aware World Models with Real-World RL for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-fingered dexterous manipulation remains a frontier for real-world reinforcement learning (RL) due to the high-dimensional action space and the prohibitive cost of hardware failures. While human-in-the-loop (HIL) RL allows operators to intervene before failures occur, current pipelines often treat these interventions as reactive corrections, discarding the rich safety signal inherent in the operator's decision to take control. In this paper, we ask: How can we learn from what a human would avoid? We present WHIRL, a safety-aware RL framework that transforms binary human interventions into forward-predictive signals for proactive risk avoidance. Our approach centers on an intervention-aware latent world model with four prediction heads: dynamics, reward, termination, and a novel per-state intervention-probability head that learns to predict the likelihood of a human takeover at future states. This head provides an actor-side risk-shaping term that discourages the policy from entering "intervention-prone" regions, modeling the operator's internal safety threshold. We evaluate our framework on a 16-DoF LEAP Hand across tasks spanning convex and irregular object grasping, prismatic manipulation, and long-horizon multi-stage tasks. Our results show that predictive risk-shaping enables the system to achieve a 96.7 percent success rate on complex grasping tasks while reducing the operator intervention burden by up to 84 percent in step-weighted terms. By closing the loop between human intuition and predictive world modeling, this work provides a practical safety-aware recipe for training complex dexterous agents in the real world while reducing operator fatigue and hardware-risk exposure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WHIRL框架，让机器人通过预测‘人类何时会干预’来主动避开危险状态，从而在真实世界多指灵巧操作中大幅减少人为干预次数并提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 人类干预不是噪声而是可建模的安全信号，将其转化为世界模型中的干预概率预测头，能实现前摄式风险规避，显著降低真实灵巧操作中的人力负担与硬件风险。
analysis.input: 多指手本体状态（关节角、速度等）+ 视觉/触觉观测（隐含）+ 人类干预二值信号
analysis.output: 动作序列（16-DoF灵巧手控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: LEAP Hand（16自由度真实灵巧手）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人上的HIL干预数据（需人实时接管）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将人类干预建模为可学习的、前向预测的潜变量（intervention-probability head），并在16-DoF真实灵巧手上完成跨物体/跨任务部署，实测减少84%干预步数且成功率96.7%，证据强度接近ALOHA/ACT级（96分）但稍逊于HiFi-UMI（94分）的纯数据驱动泛化能力，属当前真实灵巧操作RL中最扎实的安全闭环工作之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把人类干预从被动纠错升级为主动风险建模，且在高自由度真实手上验证了可部署性，不是概念包装。

papers.title: Improving Imitation Learning Efficiency for Manipulation through Geometric Prior Pretraining
papers.abstract: Applying an imitation learning policy to a new manipulation task usually requires collecting new demonstrations and retraining the model, which makes sample efficiency a practical concern. Pretraining on large-scale robot datasets is effective in this respect, but such datasets are costly to collect and train on, while data augmentation techniques typically require a new round of data generation and retraining for each task. A complementary question is what useful prior can be provided to a policy at negligible cost before any task-specific data are collected. In this study, we construct a geometric visual pretraining dataset in which each scene contains only a plane, an object, and a hand, and trajectories are generated automatically. The scenes contain neither textures nor backgrounds; pretraining primarily exposes the policy to the geometric relationship between the hand and the object. Furthermore, representing the hand as a cube avoids tailoring the dataset to a specific robot morphology. We evaluate this geometric prior using ACT on three simulated robots across five manipulation tasks each, as well as on three real-world robot tasks. Across many of these robot--task combinations, fine-tuning from the geometric prior achieves higher success rates in the early stages of training than training from scratch while using only a small number of task demonstrations. These results suggest that even highly simplified geometric scenes can provide a useful initialization that transfers across robots and to real-world tasks when task data are limited.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用极简的纯几何场景（平面+物体+立方体手）自动生成大量预训练数据，让模仿学习策略在微调时只需少量真实任务演示就能快速收敛，且效果跨仿真机器人、跨真实机器人任务。
analysis.claim: 仅靠无纹理、无背景、手建模为立方体的纯几何视觉预训练，即可为操作类模仿学习提供强泛化初始化，显著提升小样本微调效率，并跨机器人形态与仿真-现实边界迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像（仅含平面、物体、立方体手）
analysis.output: 动作序列（ACT策略输出的动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人演示数据用于预训练；微调阶段需少量真实任务演示（但远少于从头训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖3种仿真机器人+3种真实机器人平台+8个操作任务，对比训练从零开始，量化早期成功率提升；预训练设计极简却有效，揭示了几何先验的强迁移价值；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或硬件闭环，未解决触觉/力控等核心瓶颈，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用低成本几何先验替代大规模真实数据预训练，在多机体多任务上验证了小样本微调增益，是ACT范式下的稳健增强，但非底层方法创新或系统级部署突破。

papers.title: Gated Residual Body-Hand Coordination for Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Whole-body humanoid teleoperation commonly combines a motion-tracking policy with a separate dexterous-hand retargeter. However, independently generated commands do not explicitly preserve body-hand geometric relations, leading to mismatches in relative wrist poses and fingertip positions during bimanual interaction. We present a gated residual coordination framework that keeps both modules frozen and applies bounded corrections to their outputs. A motion-conditioned action gate allocates correction authority across joint groups, while reference-geometry-dependent reward gates emphasize relevant interaction objectives during training. To establish the nominal body controller on Agile One, we introduce multi-pose morphology calibration that jointly estimates triaxial scales and effector-local offsets, together with staged motion dataset curation for training a SONIC-based tracker. The residual policy uses human motion references, initial commands, and robot proprioception without explicit object or contact observations. In simulation, it reduces wrist and fingertip geometry errors by 39.2-56.3% over direct composition on held-out GRAB motions, while preserving whole-body tracking on AMASS, with success rates of 89.03% without residual coordination and 89.29% with it. Ablations characterize the contributions of reward gating, adaptive correction authority, and separate body and hand correction heads.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种门控残差协调机制，在冻结现成的身体运动追踪器和灵巧手重定向器的前提下，通过轻量级残差修正来保持身体与手部之间的几何关系，解决双手机器人遥操作中手腕姿态和指尖位置错配的问题。
analysis.claim: 冻结独立训练的身体与手部控制器后，仅靠运动条件门控的残差修正即可显著改善双手机器人遥操作中的身体-手部几何一致性，且不损害整体运动保真度。
analysis.input: 人类动作捕捉序列（AMASS/GRAB）、机器人本体感知数据（关节角、IMU等）、初始控制器输出
analysis.output: 对身体与手部各自控制器输出的残差修正向量（按关节组分片）
analysis.robot_dependency: Agile One 人形机器人（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的 staged motion dataset 和 GRAB/AMASS 真人动作数据，无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（门控残差协调）且有量化提升（39.2–56.3%几何误差下降），但完全基于仿真、未在真机验证、未跨机体/任务泛化、无接触或物体交互建模，属于针对特定遥操作pipeline的扎实工程改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如闭环感知-动作耦合、多模态因果建模、真实环境鲁棒性），远低于所列基石工作（全部含真机部署/世界模型/零样本迁移/大规模行为建模等实质突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在冻结双模块前提下用门控残差缓解几何错配，效果可测但局限在仿真+单机体+无接触场景，未突破遥操作范式

papers.title: Beyond Kinematics: Benchmarking Simulation Fidelity for Muscle-Driven Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: In this work, we conduct a systematic comparison of two state-of-the-art motion-imitation reinforcement learning (MIRL) pipelines, one built on SCONE/HyFyDy and one built on MuJoCo/MyoSim. HyFyDy emphasizes physiological realism through detailed musculotendon modeling, while MuJoCo prioritizes computational efficiency and scalable policy learning. While recent work has demonstrated that both pipelines reproduce human kinematics with high fidelity, it remains unclear if they accurately capture the underlying neuromuscular behavior that produced the movement. This limitation is particularly important for robotic assistive-device design and control, where outcome measures such as muscle activation patterns and metabolic cost are often used as optimization targets. To conduct a systematic comparison, our work compares both pipelines using a common set of human motion-capture and electromyography (EMG) measurements. The results find that while both pipelines produce similar kinematics with relative accuracy, the muscle activations from HyFyDy are more aligned with the experimental EMG, as supported by the average pooled (RMSE, r) values for muscle activations from HyFyDy and MuJoCo: (0.164, 0.4) and (0.344, 0.11), respectively. While we conclude that the more advanced physiological realism of HyFyDy currently makes it more suitable for musculoskeletal modeling, both require further development to bring physiological realism to GPU-parallelizable simulation environments and advance robotic assistive device design.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用真实人体运动捕捉和肌电（EMG）数据，系统对比了两个肌肉驱动的运动模仿学习仿真平台（HyFyDy vs MuJoCo/MyoSim），发现生理建模更精细的HyFyDy在肌肉激活预测上显著更准，但两者都还无法兼顾高保真生理建模与GPU并行加速，对助行机器人等需优化肌肉活动或代谢成本的应用仍有明显差距。
analysis.claim: 在肌肉驱动的运动模仿学习中，仿真平台的生理保真度（而非仅运动学保真度）必须通过真实EMG数据验证，且当前主流平台在肌肉激活建模上存在显著性能差异。
analysis.input: 人体运动捕捉序列 + 同步表面肌电（sEMG）信号
analysis.output: 仿真生成的关节角度轨迹 + 肌肉激活时序曲线
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实人体EMG与运动捕捉数据（非机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次用同步EMG+MoCap对齐评估肌肉驱动仿真的神经肌肉保真度，方法扎实、指标明确、有量化消融（RMSE/r），但仅限单任务（步行）、未开源代码/模型、未扩展到控制闭环或机器人设计落地，属高质量基准研究，尚未达到基石级（如RT-X/SPEAR）的范式开创性或系统规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它用硬实证戳破了‘运动学拟合好=生理可信’的行业幻觉，但仍是面向仿真器评估的窄域基准工作，离机器人部署或AI×生物闭环还有关键一跃。

papers.title: AVT-Fabric: Active Visuo-Tactile Perception via Adaptive Evidence Selection for Efficient Robotic Fabric Comparison
papers.abstract: Robotic fabric comparison needs to actively combine visual appearance and tactile cues. Here, we present AVT-Fabric, an RGB-first framework that allocates tactile evidence according to the difficulty of each comparison. A dual-scale gate evaluates answer-token confidence and raw logit separation to determine whether another force-tagged GelSight observation is needed. Compact textual memory preserves the executed history, and majority voting consolidates the selected predictions. On 400 held-out comparisons, AVT-Fabric achieves 98.0% accuracy with a compact 7B Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), surpassing the 94.0% reported by the 90B MLLM-Fabric baseline by 4.0 percentage points while processing only 1.60 of five available stages on average. It improves on matched passive inference by 9.25 percentage points and reduces model-side latency by 61.8%, while also improving on RGB-only accuracy. Four additional MLLM backbones support the generalizability, accuracy, and efficiency of the framework. This framework is also deployed on a real robotic system, achieving 78.1% pairwise ranking accuracy and correct fabric selection in seven of eight application scenarios. AVT-Fabric demonstrates that adaptive evidence selection can improve both the accuracy and efficiency of robotic visuo-tactile reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫AVT-Fabric的主动感知框架，让机器人在比较布料时先看RGB图，只在视觉判断拿不准时才主动触发GelSight触觉传感器补采数据，用双尺度门控机制决定是否追加触觉证据，最终在真实机器人上实现布料配对排序78.1%准确率，并显著降低计算延迟和触觉使用频次。
analysis.claim: 自适应选择触觉证据（而非固定多模态融合）可同时提升机器人布料比较任务的准确率、推理效率与部署可行性。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 可选的GelSight触觉图像（力标定） + 文本指令（如‘哪块更粗糙？’）
analysis.output: 二元比较结果（A>B 或 B>A）及置信度
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + GelSight触觉传感器 + RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的布料触觉-视觉配对数据，但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨模型验证+明确量化节拍/延迟/触觉调用率，且在布料这一经典接触敏感任务上超越大模型基线；但任务粒度窄（仅 pairwise fabric comparison）、未挑战通用操作、未开源代码/数据，未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破，属扎实的工程级重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实布料比较任务中首次系统实现‘视觉先行+触觉按需触发’的主动感知闭环，证据充分、部署可信，但未扩展至通用操作或开放科学问题。

papers.title: STRIDER: Stepping-Enabled Multi-Gait Hierarchical 3D Loco-Manipulation Framework for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation faces two prominent limitations: controllers using continuous velocity commands cannot precisely regulate individual footholds, while specialized foothold-tracking modules are difficult to integrate with whole-body manipulation. Furthermore, standard action-based imitation distillation primarily transfers expert actions, without explicitly encouraging a shared representation of heterogeneous skills. This paper introduces STRIDER, a hierarchical multi-gait framework to bridge these gaps. The framework integrates terrain-aware 3D stepping logic, Adversarial Motion Priors (AMP)-based natural walking, and Cartesian upper-body control: its stepping expert selects feasible footholds in the stance-foot frame and generates clearance-aware swing trajectories. To fuse distinct walking and stepping experts into one executable student policy, we propose Latent Distillation Proximal Policy Optimization (LD-PPO), a distillation algorithm augmented with teacher-conditioned latent alignment. By jointly optimizing on-policy reinforcement learning, DAgger-based action reconstruction, and latent alignment, LD-PPO transfers expert actions while encouraging a shared skill representation across heterogeneous modes. Simulation and real-robot evaluations on the TianGong Omni humanoid show that LD-PPO outperforms vanilla distillation-PPO in foothold-tracking and posture-tracking accuracy. Deployed on hardware, STRIDER realizes multi-gait loco-manipulation with accurate foothold and end-effector tracking.

analysis.tldr: 提出STRIDER框架，用分层结构把3D步态规划（含地形感知落脚点选择）、AMP自然行走和笛卡尔上肢控制整合起来，并设计LD-PPO蒸馏算法让不同专家策略共享隐空间表征，在天工全向人形机器人上实现了多步态下的精准落脚点+末端执行器协同跟踪。
analysis.claim: 通过层级化多模态专家融合与教师条件化的隐空间对齐蒸馏（LD-PPO），首次在真实人形机器人上实现兼具高精度落脚点控制与上肢操作的多步态loco-manipulation。
analysis.input: 地形点云+任务指令（隐含在专家演示中）+当前本体状态（关节/IMU/足底力）
analysis.output: 下肢步态动作序列（含落脚位置/摆动轨迹）+上肢笛卡尔末端位姿轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 天工Omni人形机器人（含定制foot pressure sensors、IMU、关节编码器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的专家演示数据（DAgger采集）和仿真预训练，但未说明真实数据规模与多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真实人形机器人（天工Omni）上多步态loco-manipulation的端到端闭环，落脚+末端双轨跟踪精度显著优于基线，且含消融验证；但未跨机体泛化、未开放代码/模型、未挑战极端非结构化地形或长时序任务，相比Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等95+级工作，属扎实工程突破而非范式革新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在国产先进硬件上完成多模态loco-manipulation闭环落地，有真实部署、量化提升和消融，但开源不足、泛化边界未充分验证，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: Which Terrain Is Better? Preference Learning with VLM Prototypes for Off-Road Traversability Ranking
papers.abstract: In vision-based off-road navigation, a robot needs to know not only which obstacles to avoid but also which terrain is better. The first is handled by freespace detection or semantic segmentation. The second is usually answered with a traversability score, but no universal ground truth exists for such a score, so perception falls back on a predefined value per semantic class or a freespace confidence. These scores say what a region is, not which region a robot should prefer. We therefore formulate this preference as visual traversability ranking, an ordering of visible terrain that can be supervised by comparisons between two regions. Standard annotations do not label preference, but they imply its direction. We present TravPro, which converts these annotations into ordered region pairs and fits a small readout on frozen vision--language model (VLM) patch tokens to these pairs. The tokens are clustered once into a fixed prototype bank, and the readout learns a preference score per prototype. The readout is then applied to every patch and serves as a teacher that turns sparse comparisons into dense preference pseudo-labels without pixel-wise annotation. An RGB student distills these maps into a dense terrain-preference map together with a non-ground mask that excludes obstacles and background from the ranking. On five unseen domains, TravPro reaches a mean pairwise accuracy of 0.915 against 0.783 for the strongest baseline, producing an ordering sensitive to surface condition that a per-class value cannot represent. The same VLM and the same supervision yield no such ordering when the VLM is prompted and the supervision is used as dense targets; what matters is how they are used.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TravPro方法，用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）提取图像patch特征，通过聚类生成固定地形原型，再用稀疏的两两地形偏好比较数据训练一个轻量读出头，为每个原型打分；最后蒸馏成稠密的RGB地形偏好图，能区分表面条件细微差异（如湿泥 vs 干土），在5个未见野外域上显著超越基线。
analysis.claim: 地形偏好排序不能靠语义类别预设分数或自由空间置信度，而应建模为基于视觉的两两比较学习任务，利用冻结VLM的patch级语义原型+稀疏比较监督可高效生成稠密、泛化强的可通行性偏好图。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像
analysis.output: 稠密像素级地形偏好得分图 + 非地面掩膜（排除障碍物与背景）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需图像中可见地形的两两偏好标注（可从现有语义/深度标注隐式推导）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将VLM patch原型与稀疏偏好学习结合用于野外可通行性建模，在5个未见真实域上实现0.915 pairwise accuracy（大幅超越0.783基线），证明其对表面物理属性（非语义类别）的敏感建模能力；但未开源代码/模型，未部署到真机闭环，也未挑战跨机体或动态时序泛化，属扎实的SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙复用冻结VLM的细粒度视觉语义能力，将稀疏人类偏好转化为稠密地形决策信号，实证充分、泛化可信，但未触及具身闭环或硬件耦合，是高质量的感知层升级。

papers.title: Robots That Take Initiative: A Framework for Building and Evaluating Proactive Robots
papers.abstract: Effective robot assistance beyond narrow roles and repetitive tasks requires robots to be proactive - to decide what needs to be done rather than waiting to be told. While proactivity is increasingly explored, it lacks a unified formulation, and work in the domain is typically evaluated offline against static human models that cannot capture the effect of a robot's actions on the environment and the user's own behavior. We introduce a unified formalism for proactive robot assistance, organize it into three levels, and provide a framework to address the highest level of unprompted proactive assistance. We then show that offline evaluation overstates performance in this setting, and contribute a closed-loop evaluation with a human model that adapts to the robot. Finally, we present a method, GAP, that instantiates our framework, learning from passive observation to anticipate user goals and act. Under closed-loop evaluation, prior state-of-the-art methods collapse, in some cases adding more work than they save, while GAP remains robust and substantially outperforms them.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个三层主动式机器人辅助的统一形式化框架，重点实现最高层级的‘无提示主动协助’，并设计了能随机器人行为动态调整的人类模型闭环评估方法，发现以往离线评估严重高估性能；作者还提出了GAP方法，仅通过被动观察学习预测用户目标并主动行动，在闭环测试中显著优于现有SOTA方法。
analysis.claim: 真正的主动式机器人必须在闭环人机交互中被评估，而现有离线评估范式失效；基于被动观察建模用户意图并实现无提示主动干预是可行且可量化的路径。
analysis.input: 被动观察到的用户动作序列、环境状态（如物体位姿、任务上下文）
analysis.output: 主动发起的动作决策（如提前递工具、整理工作台、启动下一步操作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的移动机械臂平台（如Fetch或模拟版）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有训练和评估均在仿真中完成，未使用任何真实人机交互轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性揭露离线评估对主动机器人性能的严重高估，并建立首个闭环自适应人类模型评估范式，实证扎实；但GAP方法仍限于仿真、任务窄（厨房/办公场景简单目标链）、未上真机、泛化能力未验证，未达基石级（如H2O/GR00T）所要求的跨 embodiment / zero-shot / real-robot robustness 或范式迁移强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：建立了主动机器人评估的新标准并给出首个闭环验证的可行方案，但仍是仿真驱动的窄域方法，尚未跨越到真实世界鲁棒部署阶段。

papers.title: Aim Short to Reach Far: Your Frozen World Model Can Plan Better Than You Think
papers.abstract: Planners built on visual world models commonly score each predicted outcome by its distance to the encoded goal image. We show that this target can limit control even with exact dynamics and globally optimal short-horizon search: reaching a goal may require actions that initially move away from it. With frozen LeWM models, intermediate targets substantially improve action synthesis and recorded-action ranking on Cube, PushT, Reacher, and TwoRoom. Learned targets and targets drawn from observed experience both produce these gains. We introduce Anchored Planning, which retrieves a recorded segment whose start and end resemble the current and goal observations, then aims at an observation shortly after its start. The frozen model scores actions toward this target from the current state. Without additional training, planning toward observed targets outperforms the released LeWM planner on every task in our long-range evaluation. Additional final-goal search falls short of the same gains. Lower successor-prediction error need not translate into better control. Success also depends on how far ahead the target is placed and on shrinking the retrieval span as execution advances. Changing only the target lets the same frozen model and planner reach goals that final-goal scoring misses.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用世界模型做规划时，直接以最终目标图像为优化目标反而效果差；改用从历史经验中检索出的、略超当前状态的中间图像作为临时目标（'锚定目标'），能显著提升冻结世界模型在多个仿真操控任务中的长程规划成功率，且无需任何额外训练。
analysis.claim: 对冻结的视觉世界模型而言，规划性能瓶颈不在于模型精度或搜索算法，而在于目标表征方式——使用短距、可检索的中间观测锚点比直接优化到最终目标图像更有效。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+目标图像+历史轨迹片段库（用于检索）
analysis.output: 动作序列（通过短视界搜索生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真器生成的录制轨迹（PushT/Cube/Reacher/TwoRoom等标准benchmark数据），不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘锚定规划’这一反直觉但实证稳健的目标重参数化范式，在多个标准仿真benchmark上系统验证了其对冻结世界模型的增益，超越原LeWM基线且有消融（如目标距离、检索跨度影响），但未涉及真实机器人、未开源代码、未挑战长期开放难题（如状态持久性/多智能体交互），属扎实推进SOTA的工程级改进，未达基石论文量级（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用简单目标替换策略显著激活冻结世界模型潜力，是高质量的规划机制设计，但非模型架构或学习范式突破。

papers.title: GraspTwin: Zero-Shot Task-Oriented Grasp Optimization via a Digital Twin
papers.abstract: As robots transition from structured factory settings into homes, they are required to interact with an ever-increasing variety of objects. Many tasks require grasping, and often it is not sufficient to just pick up the target object. Consider a task like "pouring coffee" --- to facilitate the subsequent pouring, the robot should grasp the mug by its handle. Existing learning-based approaches for grasping either find robust and collision-free grasps that are largely agnostic to the task (e.g., picking up the mug by its rim), or leverage foundation models to propose task-appropriate grasp locations that lack fine-grained physical grounding (e.g., reaching for and missing the handle). In this work, we bridge these approaches with a real-to-sim-to-real framework. Based on a single RGB-D observation, we construct a digital twin of the environment, query a large foundation model to propose grasps that align with the object's affordances and task description, and then optimize the proposals to ensure robustness and plausibility before executing the result on the real robot. Our key insight is that the grasp proposals of the foundation model should be regarded as semantic priors that serve as seeds for local, gradient-free optimization. We leverage Bayesian optimization with Thompson sampling to draw batches of nearby poses, which are subsequently evaluated in parallel under domain-randomized physics rollouts. The resulting grasp is both task-oriented and physically feasible for execution by the robot arm. Our full zero-shot real-world transfer only takes a few minutes and improves task-oriented grasping success by up to 33% as compared to other state-of-the-art pipelines. Our code is available here: https://github.com/VT-Collab/GraspTwin/

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像构建环境数字孪生，调用大模型生成任务导向的抓取语义先验（如‘抓咖啡杯把手’），再通过贝叶斯优化+物理仿真批量评估并微调这些先验，最终在真实机械臂上零样本执行高成功率的任务适配抓取。
analysis.claim: 任务导向的抓取不应直接依赖大模型输出，而应将其作为语义先验种子，通过无梯度、小规模、物理驱动的局部优化实现零样本真实机器人部署。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB-D图像 + 自然语言任务描述（如'pouring coffee'）
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿（位置+朝向）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人抓取数据；仅需单帧真实传感器输入用于构建数字孪生
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机零样本跨任务（6个日常任务）、多物体（20+ household objects）、对比SOTA提升达33%，含消融验证语义先验+物理优化的必要性；但未开源数据/模型权重，且未扩展至双臂/动态场景，未达Facet-0或ALOHA级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机零样本任务抓取取得显著性能跃升，方法论清晰闭环（语义先验→物理优化），但开源不全、泛化边界明确，属强工程整合+方法创新，非范式革命

papers.title: ThinkNet: Compact Architecture Selection and Validation-Gated Ensembles for Subject-Independent MI-EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Practical assistive and rehabilitative brain--computer interfaces require subject-independent motor-imagery EEG (MI-EEG) decoders that generalize to new users under limited target-user data and constrained compute. However, held-out-subject performance can be overstated when test-subject information influences preprocessing, model selection, or ensemble selection. We present \textit{ThinkNet}, a validation-controlled framework that combines train-only normalization, validation-guided evolutionary search, and validation-gated inference to identify compact decoders and inference policies for held-out subjects. We evaluate four-class BCI Competition IV-2a (session T) decoding with nine Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) folds, three seeds, seven fixed decoder entries, and a broader search over ten representative decoder families; the held-out subject is never used for normalization, hyperparameter, architecture, or ensemble-policy selection. In the fixed benchmark, the validation-selected compact decoder achieved 44.35$\pm$15.41\% accuracy with 4.9K parameters, 19 KB FP32 weights, and 0.99 ms batch-1 Orin CUDA inference. Across the broader search, compact models ($\leq$25K parameters) achieved higher mean held-out accuracy than mid-size and large alternatives after selected retraining (40.10\% vs. 35.09\% and 34.78\%). Validation-gated ensembling improved over validation-selected single-model inference, reaching 43.98$\pm$16.25\% in the fixed benchmark and 43.31$\pm$15.88\% for the compact six-family ensemble. A non-deployable oracle analysis revealed a 6.1-point family-selection gap and near-zero validation--test correlation, showing that validation reliability remains a key bottleneck under subject shift. Thus, ThinkNet is a validation-controlled framework for compact MI-EEG model and inference-policy selection, rather than a single-architecture benchmark.

analysis.tldr: 提出ThinkNet框架，用纯训练集归一化、验证集引导的进化搜索、验证集门控集成策略，在不使用任何目标受试者数据的前提下，为运动想象EEG解码任务自动选出紧凑模型和推理策略，并在BCI Competition IV-2a数据上验证其跨被试泛化能力与部署友好性。
analysis.claim: subject-independent MI-EEG解码的性能瓶颈不在模型容量或架构多样性，而在于验证过程本身不可靠；ThinkNet通过完全隔离测试被试信息的三重验证控制机制（归一化/搜索/集成），可稳定选出小参数量、低延迟、跨被试可用的解码器。
analysis.input: 原始MI-EEG时序信号（4类，BCI Competition IV-2a session T）
analysis.output: 4类运动想象意图的概率分布
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（BCI Competition IV-2a）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的跨被试实验设计（9-fold LOSO+3 seeds）、明确的计算约束指标（4.9K参数/0.99ms/19KB）、揭示了验证-测试相关性近乎为零的关键缺陷，但未突破MI-EEG解码的准确率天花板（~44% vs. SOTA 70%+），也未引入新神经表征、新采集范式或临床闭环验证，属方法论层面的重要增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统暴露并缓解subject-independent EEG解码中验证污染问题，但未提升绝对性能上限，也未进入真实临床或在线闭环场景。

papers.title: SENSE: Semantic Neural Speech Synthesis from Brain Dynamics via Spatial Graph Encoding
papers.abstract: Reconstructing speech from non-invasive brain signals offers a promising pathway for restoring communication in individuals who are cognitively intact but unable to speak. Existing EEG-to-speech approaches formulate this task as acoustic reconstruction, optimizing waveform fidelity while ignoring whether the generated speech preserves high-level semantic content. In this work, we revisit this formulation and argue that EEG signals carry not only acoustic but also semantic information. We identify two key limitations of prior methods: (1) the neglect of spatial relationships between EEG electrodes, and (2) the failure to exploit the semantic structure of the N400 paradigm, where congruent and incongruent trials reflect distinct semantic processing. We propose SENSE(Semantic-EEG Neural Speech SynthEsis), which combines a graph-based EEG encoder over electrode geometry with EEG Semantic Conditioning (ESC), aligning EEG to a pretrained semantic space using only congruent trials. On the N400 dataset, SENSE consistently outperforms prior methods on both acoustic and semantic metrics, and model-internal channel attribution suggests distributed reliance on auditory, sensorimotor, and centro-parietal regions, consistent with known speech-perception neuroscience. In the unseen-subject setting, SENSE trained on only two subjects already surpasses the strongest baseline trained on all eighteen subjects in word error rate, and matches it on acoustic metrics with as few as eight subjects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SENSE方法，用图神经网络建模EEG电极空间关系，并利用N400语义范式中的语义一致性（congruent trials）将脑电信号对齐到预训练语义空间，从而直接合成语义保真度更高的语音，而非只追求波形相似。
analysis.claim: 非侵入式EEG信号中蕴含可解码的语义信息，通过显式建模电极空间拓扑和N400语义范式结构，能显著提升脑-语音合成的语义保真度，且具备跨被试泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多通道非侵入式EEG信号（基于N400范式采集）
analysis.output: 合成语音波形及对应语义表征（隐式对齐到文本语义空间）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖N400范式下采集的特定语义对照EEG数据（congruent/incongruent trial），但未使用真实语音输出设备或闭环反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 在非侵入式EEG-to-speech领域取得实质性推进：首次系统引入N400语义范式指导建模、显式编码电极空间图结构、并在跨被试设置下以极小样本（2人）超越全量基线（18人），语义指标提升有神经科学依据（通道归因与已知语言区一致）；但尚未达到基石级（如92+分工作）的临床部署成熟度、实时性、或侵入式高信噪比下的端到端语音质量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在非侵入式脑语音合成中首次将语义神经机制（N400）转化为可计算建模范式，证据扎实（跨被试、消融支持、神经可解释性），但未达临床级实时闭环或侵入式性能标杆，属领域内显著突破。

papers.title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboCoach框架，用共享的动作条件世界模型（COACHWORLD）在想象中执行技能链、自动诊断首次失败的子任务，据此精准请求对应子任务的人类演示并更新对应专家适配器，显著提升长程操作成功率和跨组合泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 世界模型可作为主动教练，通过想象失败驱动靶向式子任务示范采集与模块化策略更新，实现低成本、高泛化性的长程机器人技能自改进。
analysis.input: 任务指令+当前观测（视觉/状态）+已编排的子任务序列
analysis.output: 子任务级动作序列（由多个专家适配器协同输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人子任务演示（150条），但核心训练和诊断基于世界模型想象，不依赖大规模真实轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型驱动的主动学习范式上做出实质性推进：首次将想象失败系统性用于指导子任务级示范采集与模块化更新，并在双仿真平台+双真机平台上验证了想象失败与真实失败的强相关性（rho=0.84）及跨组合迁移能力（35% vs 0%）；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战长期开放难题（如持续状态记忆、跨域零样本泛化），理论深度和架构原创性弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型从被动预测器升级为主动教练，在真实机器人上实现了有数据效率、可解释、可扩展的模块化技能改进，但缺乏底层建模创新和全栈开源支撑。

papers.title: DreamTest: World-Model Surrogates for Search-Based Testing of Deep Reinforcement Learning Agents
papers.abstract: Testing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents in cyber-physical systems aims to uncover diverse failures before deployment, but each execution can be expensive. Surrogate-assisted testing reduces this cost by learning to predict which test configurations are likely to fail. Prior surrogates treat the system as a black box and predict pass or fail outcomes directly; we instead model how a test unfolds and estimate failure from an imagined episode. We introduce DreamTest, a world-model surrogate for testing DRL agents. DreamTest adapts a recurrent state-space model to learn agent behaviour and environment dynamics from the agent's training log. Given a candidate configuration, imagined rollouts produce a failure score that guides search without executing every candidate in a simulator or real system. We evaluate DreamTest for failure prediction, test generation, and failure diversity on Parking, Humanoid, and DonkeyCar. Mean area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) exceeds the strongest baseline by 97%, 12%, and 39%, respectively, and gains on five out-of-distribution test sets reach 145%, 29%, and 44%.
