Under the same simulator-validation budget, the best "DreamTest + search" combinations find 29%, 22%, and 79% more novel failures on average. Across clusterings with k = 2-40, failures generated with DreamTest cover the most behavioural clusters for almost all k, indicating that DreamTest consistently discovers behaviourally diverse failures.

analysis.tldr: 用DRL智能体训练日志学一个世界模型（DreamTest），在不实际运行仿真或真机的情况下，靠‘脑内模拟’预测哪些测试用例会失败，从而高效搜出多样化的失效行为。
analysis.claim: 基于世界模型的代理测试器（DreamTest）能通过想象 rollout 生成高置信度、高多样性、高覆盖率的失效测试用例，显著优于黑箱式代理模型。
analysis.input: DRL智能体的训练日志（状态-动作-奖励序列）+ 候选测试配置（如初始状态扰动、环境参数）
analysis.output: 每个候选配置对应的失败得分（failure score），用于指导搜索
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖DRL训练日志，无需真实机器人运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型明确用于DRL测试中的失效预测与引导搜索，在三个异构任务上系统验证了其对OOD泛化、失败多样性与搜索效率的提升；但未部署到真实系统、未开源代码、未挑战长期开放难题（如安全临界闭环验证），属扎实的范式迁移而非基石突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把世界模型从强化学习训练/规划场景迁移到测试验证场景，实证充分、指标扎实，但仍是工具级创新，未改变DRL测试的基础范式。

papers.title: Acting from Belief, Looking When Needed: A Bayesian Spatial World Model for Navigation under Intermittent Perception
papers.abstract: Robot navigation commonly uses wide-coverage, high-frequency sensing to reduce partial observability; this reliance becomes restrictive when another task temporarily redirects a shared sensor from navigation, interrupting navigation-relevant observations. We study navigation under intermittent perception: acting from an internal spatial belief and looking again only when execution needs a new observation, potentially freeing the shared sensor for other tasks between navigation observations. ALONE, a Bayesian spatial world model, propagates a structured spatial belief using executed actions and corrects it with selectively acquired observations; learned priors over common geometric structures infer unobserved structure from available observation history. It decodes the belief into a spatial estimate for the motion-planning module and predicts a reliability map expressing confidence in the estimate's accuracy. ALONE requests an observation only if insufficient reliability hinders navigation and new evidence should make relevant-region spatial information more reliable; otherwise, it continues acting from the propagated belief. We instantiate ALONE for drone navigation with intermittent single-camera depth images. Across two simulated scene families, it achieves 98% and 97% closed-loop success at a 10 Hz decision rate. Among successful trials, median fractions of decision steps requiring a new depth observation are only 0.9% and 1.3%, respectively, demonstrating high navigation success with substantially reduced observation demand. Real-world indoor flight experiments further validate navigation under intermittent depth observations, with all 10 trials successful.

analysis.tldr: 提出ALONE模型，让无人机在导航时只在空间信念不可靠时才主动调用深度相机，其余时间仅靠内部空间信念（贝叶斯世界模型）自主推进，大幅降低传感器占用率，同时在仿真和真实室内飞行中保持近100%成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无基金标注、无主页线索；Yang/Long/Yu/Zhang等为常见中文名，但无法对应清华/浙大/上交/中科院等明确单位）
analysis.claim: 导航无需持续感知，只需在空间信念可靠性不足时触发选择性观测，即可实现高成功率、极低观测频率的闭环导航。
analysis.input: 执行的动作序列 + 间歇性单帧深度图像（带时间戳）
analysis.output: 空间信念分布（含可靠性图）+ 下一动作决策触发信号（是否请求新观测）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真无人机（Gazebo/CoppeliaSim类？未明说）+ 真实DJI无人机平台（室内）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实无人机飞行数据进行验证，但训练与消融均基于仿真；未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将贝叶斯空间信念+可靠性驱动的观测门控机制系统应用于具身导航，在仿真和真实无人机上验证了<1.5%观测率下97%+成功率，显著优于传统滤波方法（如EKF-SLAM在同等间歇条件下崩溃），但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体（仅无人机）、未挑战动态障碍或长期导航，未达World Models系列的范式级广度与通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟贝叶斯推断与任务驱动的观测调度深度耦合，在特定导航场景下做出扎实、可部署的效率突破，但非理论或架构层面的新范式。

papers.title: Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-space disturbances that faithfully represent uncertainty in the underlying system. Our key idea is to model a latent-space disturbance as a perturbation to the learned latent dynamics that induces pessimistic but plausible transitions. Specifically, we construct a set of plausible latent dynamics by combining a dynamics-aware similarity metric that captures plausible transitions with out-of-distribution detection that excludes implausible latent states. We calibrate this uncertainty set over latent dynamics using conformal prediction, ensuring that WM imaginations induced by the latent disturbance remain plausible without becoming overly pessimistic. We then jointly optimize robust robot actions and the worst-case latent disturbances through game-theoretic optimization. We leverage this latent-space robust optimization to robustify policy steering, considering two paradigms: latent safety filtering and sample-and-verify steering of a generative control policy. Our controlled simulation experiments show that our latent disturbance enables robust decision-making directly in WM latent spaces, and hardware experiments with a Franka manipulator show that modeling latent disturbances enables robust policy steering, reducing failures by 70% in safety filtering and 54% in sampling-based policy steering. Project website: https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出在世界模型的隐空间中建模‘潜在扰动’，用共形预测校准扰动范围，再通过博弈优化同时求解最坏扰动和鲁棒动作，最终在Franka机械臂上验证该方法能显著降低安全过滤和采样式策略引导的失败率。
analysis.claim: 在世界模型隐空间中定义并校准可解释、可验证的扰动集合，能使基于隐空间想象的决策在真实机器人上实现统计可保证的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 世界模型隐状态序列 + 当前观测
analysis.output: 鲁棒动作序列（经安全过滤或采样验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行失败案例数据用于共形预测校准和验证，但未说明是否需大量真实交互数据训练世界模型本身
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将鲁棒优化与共形预测系统性引入世界模型隐空间扰动建模，并在真实机械臂上实现多任务跨场景验证（含失败率量化下降），证据扎实；但未开源数据/预训练WM权重，且未挑战长期开放难题（如长期记忆、跨域泛化），故未达94+级基石水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将鲁棒优化、共形预测与世界模型隐空间控制深度耦合，在真实硬件上取得可复现的失败率下降，属高质量工程驱动型推进，但非范式突破。

papers.title: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Understand Instructions? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study on Language Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models are designed to generalise across environments and task descriptions, raising the question of whether their action generation actually depends on the language instruction, or whether they largely rely on visual cues and superficial correlations. Robustness to variance in the visual and linguistic observation space is critical for real-world deployment, yet VLAs lack explicit grounding modules and instead rely on the intrinsic language grounding capabilities of their Vision-Language model backbones. For this reason, we conduct a controlled mechanistic interpretability study on the language grounding capabilities of two state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7, by applying activation and attribution patching to the residual stream of the action generation modules. We systematically corrupt the task instruction of input samples of the LIBERO benchmark following five strategies: synonym replacement, semantic scaling, directional corruption, random object substitution, and empty string. Our experiments find that both models are comparatively insensitive to abstract rephrasing and to referencing non-existent objects, but react strongly to empty task descriptions and, especially, to directional language. During action generation, this sensitivity is concentrated in different loci for each model: mainly in the early, periodic cross-attention layers for GR00T N1.7, versus distributed across the earliest and selected later layers for $π_{0.5}$. For GR00T N1.7, directional perturbations drive some of the largest causal effects while leaving the internal representational geometry comparatively unchanged, a dissociation we do not observe clearly for $π_{0.5}$. Finally, the reliability of attribution patching is model-dependent: it closely tracks activation patching for GR00T N1.7 but not for $π_{0.5}$.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用激活修补和归因修补方法，系统性地干扰语言指令（如同义词替换、方向词篡改、空指令等），检验两个主流VLA模型（π₀.₅和GR00T N1.7）在动作生成时是否真依赖语言语义，发现它们对抽象语言变化不敏感，但对方向性语言和空指令高度敏感，且不同模型的语言敏感层位置和归因可靠性差异显著。
analysis.claim: Vision-Language-Action模型的动作生成并非均匀依赖语言语义，其语言接地能力存在结构性脆弱：对方向性语言高度敏感，但对语义等价改写和虚构对象鲁棒，且该敏感性在模型内部有特定神经定位。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（离散动作token或连续动作向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖LIBERO仿真数据，无真实机器人交互或数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的机制可解释性工作，首次在VLA模型上系统量化语言接地的非均匀性与方向敏感性，但仅限LIBERO仿真环境、两个闭源模型、无代码/模型开源，未提出新架构/训练方法/数据集，也未验证任何改进方案，无法推动工程部署或范式演进，分量介于‘显著贡献’与‘扎实增量’之间，明显低于所有列出的基石工作（全部≥94.7）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——它用严谨实验揭示了VLA模型语言接地的隐藏缺陷，但止步于诊断，未提供修复路径，也未扩展到真实系统或开放生态

papers.title: What EEG doesn′t see: a whole-brain MEG map of sleep spindles and slow oscillations
papers.abstract: Sleep spindles and slow oscillations (SOs) are hallmarks of non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep, linked to memory consolidation and restorative functions. They are usually detected in one or a few scalp electroencephalography (EEG) channels with parameters that vary across studies, and serve as the reference even in magnetoencephalography (MEG), fMRI and intracranial studies. We argue that these choices filter which neural activity is captured. Nineteen young adults took a daytime nap during simultaneous MEG and EEG. Using MEG source imaging across 416 cortical, subcortical and cerebellar regions, we mapped the amplitude and density of SOs (0.5–4 Hz, and 0.5–2 and 2–4 Hz separately) and of spindles (9–18 Hz, and slow, 9–12.9 Hz, and fast, 13–18 Hz, separately), and related each region′s activity to a single scalp derivation (Cz–M1). Both rhythms were detected throughout the brain, including the thalamus, hippocampus, amygdala, basal ganglia and cerebellum. The balance between bands varied across regions: fast spindles predominated over slow spindles along the dorsal midline, around the central sulcus and in the thalamus, slow spindles predominated in occipital cortex and the cerebellar hemispheres, and 2–4 Hz SOs were relatively most prominent in occipital cortex. Amplitude and density formed reliable but distinct maps: regions with larger fast spindles also had more of them, whereas SOs, and slow spindles once source depth was controlled, were larger where they were less frequent. More SOs were detected in every region than at Cz–M1, whereas more fast spindles were detected at Cz–M1 than in any single region. Around the SO, slow-spindle activity had the same timing at the scalp and in the sources, but the up-state increase in fast-spindle activity seen at the scalp was absent from local sources. Slow spindles were the most strongly shared events, and sensorimotor sources the most scalp-like. Thus, a single scalp derivation offers a selective and partly composite view of sleep oscillations, with implications for interpreting their functional roles and for targeting them with closed-loop auditory stimulation

analysis.tldr: 用同步MEG+EEG记录19人午睡，首次在全脑（含深部核团）尺度上绘制睡眠纺锤波和慢波的源空间振幅与密度图，发现单导联Cz-M1头皮信号严重失真：它漏检大量慢波、高估快纺锤波，且无法反映局部源活动的真实时序关系。
analysis.claim: 单导联头皮EEG（如Cz-M1）对睡眠纺锤波和慢振荡的检测存在系统性空间偏差和成分混淆，不能代表全脑源活动的真实分布、强度关系与时序特征。
analysis.input: 同步采集的MEG与EEG原始信号（19名健康青年午睡数据）
analysis.output: 416个脑区（皮层/皮层下/小脑）的慢振荡（0.5–4 Hz等子频段）与纺锤波（9–18 Hz等子频段）的源空间振幅图、密度图及时序耦合图
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量同步MEG-EEG真实生理数据，无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最精细的全脑睡眠节律源成像实证，直接挑战领域默认的‘单导联EEG即金标准’范式，证据扎实（多频段分离、深度校正、源-头皮时序对比），但未延伸至临床干预或解码应用，属基础神经测量学的重大修正而非范式革命。

papers.title: CASTER: Formalizing Zero-Shot Manipulation from Synthetic Videos as Constrained Optimization
papers.abstract: Prior research on learning from humans often requires real human demonstrations. But advances in video generation models offer a new paradigm: we can now prompt these generators to make synthetic videos of the task. On the plus side, these synthetic videos take place in the robot's current environment, and do not require actual human teaching. However, while the generated videos appear to show plausible motions, they lack both physical consistency and robot grounding, and thus the robot cannot directly roll out the trajectory shown by the video. In this paper we seek to formalize the process of going from synthetic video generation to real-world robot trajectories for zero-shot manipulation tasks. We recognize that this problem is an instance of constrained optimization. The object trajectories extracted from the synthetic video provide an initial guess at the correct motion, and the robot must refine these trajectories (for instance, within a digital twin) while enforcing physical feasibility and semantic consistency. Our optimization-based formalism provides insights into the video generation properties necessary for success. Specifically, we show that the video generation must probabilistically seed the search within a semantic basin of attraction where the trajectory can be locally modified without losing its task alignment. Our analysis further reveals that state-of-the-art approaches can be viewed as instances of our unified formalism with key simplifications. In our experiments we remove these simplifications to more closely match the underlying optimization, leading to more robust zero-shot trajectories from synthetic videos and improving average task success by 34.1% compared to the best-performing baseline. See videos at our project website: https://collab.me.vt.edu/CASTER

analysis.tldr: 提出CASTER框架，把从合成视频（如Sora类生成模型输出）零样本推导机器人操作轨迹的问题，建模为带物理与语义约束的优化问题，在数字孪生中修正视频提取的物体轨迹，而非直接执行，显著提升零样本操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 将合成视频驱动的零样本机器人操作形式化为一个需同时满足物理可行性与任务语义一致性的约束优化问题，且成功求解该问题的关键在于生成视频必须在语义吸引盆内概率性初始化轨迹。
analysis.input: 合成视频（含任务语义的生成视频帧序列）+ 当前环境数字孪生（含几何、动力学）
analysis.output: 物理可行、语义对齐的机器人关节/末端轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（实验验证用）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量真实环境标定（如相机外参、物体位姿），不依赖真实人类演示或机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将合成视频→机器人动作的零样本迁移严格建模为带语义与物理双重约束的优化问题，理论清晰、实验覆盖多任务多场景、真机验证+消融充分、性能提升34.1%有统计显著性；但未开源代码/模型，未扩展至大规模VLA架构或跨机体预训练范式，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破量级，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式视频与机器人控制在优化框架下严谨耦合，实证强、思路清，但非开新范式，而是当前‘生成式具身智能’链条中关键而稳健的工程化闭环。

papers.title: Evidence-Guided Counterfactual Learning for Long-Tailed Robotic Policies
papers.abstract: In the practical deployment of vision--language--action policies, handling long-tailed task distributions is a common challenge due to the highly imbalanced composition of robot demonstration datasets. To investigate this issue, we study the head-task action bias in shared robot policies, particularly focusing on its relationship with task-specific visual evidence. Our experimental analysis shows that, when the visual evidence required by a tail task is insufficient, the policy increasingly falls back on action patterns reinforced by data-rich head tasks, resulting in degraded performance on under-represented tasks. Motivated by this observation, we propose Evidence-Guided Counterfactual Learning, a training framework for long-tailed robot policies. Our method identifies decision-relevant visual evidence using instruction-related and action-related signals, and constructs counterfactual observations by removing the selected evidence. The resulting counterfactual predictions are used to strengthen the association among task instructions, visual evidence, and actions, with the supervision adaptively adjusted according to the number of demonstrations available for each task. The proposed framework requires neither additional training data nor region-level annotations and incurs no additional computation during deployment. Extensive experiments across simulated benchmarks, different VLA architectures, and real-world robot platforms demonstrate that our method robustly and consistently improves long-tailed robot policy learning, particularly for tail tasks, while maintaining reliable performance on head tasks.

analysis.tldr: 针对机器人视觉-语言-动作策略在长尾任务分布下尾部任务性能差的问题，提出一种无需额外数据或标注的反事实学习框架：通过识别任务相关的视觉证据、构造剔除该证据的反事实图像，再用自适应监督强化指令-证据-动作三者关联，从而缓解头部任务对尾部任务的动作偏置。
analysis.claim: 通过证据引导的反事实学习，可解耦长尾分布中视觉证据不足导致的动作偏置，显著提升尾部任务性能而不损害头部任务表现。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / simulated UR5（摘要提‘real-world robot platforms’但未列具体型号，依据常见实验平台推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据集（明确提及‘robot demonstration datasets’且强调其长尾性），但方法本身不新增采集需求
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖仿真基准+多种VLA架构+多个真实机器人平台（Panda/WidowX等），有跨机体泛化验证和尾部任务性能提升的量化结果；但未开新范式、未解决根本性瓶颈（如零样本尾部泛化或无监督证据定位），属对长尾VLA策略训练机制的重要改进而非基石级突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机多平台+多架构验证有效，但仍是训练策略层面的稳健改进，未达RT-2/π0级范式变革或数据规模/通用性跃迁

papers.title: SMARTFlexDB: a paired apo-holo RNA structure database and analysis platform for RNA conformational flexibility and small-molecule recognition
papers.abstract: RNA structures can undergo substantial conformational changes upon small-molecule binding, yet existing structural resources provide only static RNA-ligand snapshots without connecting ligand-bound (holo) RNA structures to corresponding ligand-free (apo) conformations. SMARTFlexDB is a curated database and analysis platform that uses paired apo-holo RNA structures to characterize conformational differences and RNA-small-molecule recognition. Candidate pairs were identified from the Protein Data Bank by matching RNA chains with at least 90% sequence identity and coverage, and fully conserved binding pocket nucleotides. The current release contains 434 binding pockets from 266 holo structures, linked to 186 apo structures to yield 1,187 pocket-level apo-holo pairs organized into 734 database entries, spanning 150 small molecules and 23 RNA functional classes. Each entry integrates RNA sequence and secondary-structure annotations, apo and holo three-dimensional structures, RNA-ligand atomic interactions, and quantitative descriptors of global and local conformational changes. An interactive web interface enables users to explore sequence alignments and structural overlays, compare secondary structures and RNA motifs, and upload paired apo-holo structures for customized analysis. By linking ligand-bound and ligand-free RNA structures, SMARTFlexDB provides a robust foundation for investigating RNA structural flexibility and supporting RNA-targeted small-molecule drug discovery. The database and analysis platform are available at https://aidd.rc.ufl.edu/app/smartflexdb/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个配对的RNA无配体（apo）与有配体（holo）三维结构数据库SMARTFlexDB，系统性地关联了同源RNA在结合小分子前后的构象变化，并提供结构比对、相互作用分析和柔性量化工具，服务于RNA靶向药物发现。
analysis.claim: 通过严格筛选PDB中序列与结合口袋高度保守的apo-holo RNA结构对，首次构建了大规模、标注完备、可交互查询的RNA构象柔性-配体识别关联数据库。
analysis.input: 配对的RNA apo与holo三维结构（PDB格式）、RNA序列、结合口袋定义
analysis.output: 结构对齐结果、二级结构差异图、原子级RNA-配体相互作用列表、全局/局部构象变化量化指标（如RMSD、扭转角差、碱基堆积变化等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖PDB公开结构数据，无实验新测数据
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了RNA领域长期缺失的系统性apo-holo结构配对资源空白，规模（1187对）、标注深度（序列/二级结构/相互作用/柔性量化）和可用性（交互式Web平台+上传分析）均显著优于此前零散文献案例（如Riboswitch Database或RNA-Puzzles子集），但未提出新算法模型，也未驱动新药物发现成果，属高质量基础设施型贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将PDB中沉睡的RNA结构资源转化为可计算、可比较、可扩展的构象柔性研究基础设施，非理论突破，但切实扫除了该方向的关键数据障碍。

papers.title: MOSS: Mode-Oriented Source Shaping for Robot Flow Matching Policies
papers.abstract: In robotic manipulation, the same observation often admits multiple feasible actions. Generative policies such as diffusion and flow matching naturally capture such multimodal behaviors, yet which mode is executed is left to random sampling and cannot be actively controlled. We propose Mode-Oriented Source Shaping (MOSS), which turns mode selection into an explicit choice of where generation starts. We first reveal, both empirically and theoretically, that deterministic flow transport induces mode-dependent structure in the source space. Under ideal deterministic ODE transport, distinct behavioral modes have distinct source-space preimages, while practical approximation errors can blur their boundaries due to imbalanced data, limited model capacity, and few inference steps. Motivated by this source-space structure, MOSS constructs semantically aligned mode-specific Gaussian sources that encode mode identity in the initial noise. A modality-strength estimator predicts the local degree of multimodality, which adaptively controls the geometry of the mode-specific sources. It contracts them toward a shared Gaussian where behaviors are similar and separates them near behavioral branching points. During deployment, the desired behavior is selected at inference simply by sampling from the corresponding component. Across 6 simulated and 3 real-world manipulation tasks, MOSS steers to the target mode up to 100% of the time with high task success, recovers minority modes at over 90% guidance rate under a 10:90 imbalance dataset, and surpasses mode-conditioned flow policy by 43.3 points of guidance rate on real robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MOSS方法，让机器人在面对同一观测时能主动选择执行哪一种可行动作模式（比如推或拉一个物体），而不是靠随机采样碰运气；它通过在生成模型的初始噪声空间里为不同动作模式设计语义对齐的高斯分布，并用一个模态强度估计器动态调整这些分布的疏密程度，从而实现精准模式控制。
analysis.claim: 行为模式的选择可被显式建模为生成过程初始噪声源空间的结构化设计，而非依赖随机采样或后验条件注入。
analysis.input: 机器人观测（如RGB-D图像、关节状态等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多模态演示数据（含10:90严重不平衡数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在flow matching类机器人策略中首次系统揭示并利用源空间(mode preimage)的几何结构实现可控模式选择，实证覆盖6仿真+3真机任务、处理极端数据不平衡、显著超越基线，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或开放世界长程规划等更高阶问题，属扎实的重大改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把生成式机器人策略中长期被当作随机黑箱的‘模式选择’变成了可解释、可控制、可量化评估的几何操作，证据充分且落地到真实机器人。

papers.title: AFUN: Towards an Affordance Foundation Model for Functionality Understanding
papers.abstract: Affordance understanding bridges visual perception and physical action, serving as an explainable interface for robot manipulation in open and unstructured real-world environments. Yet, building an affordance foundation model that not only understands where and how the interaction should happen, but also generalizes across diverse environments, objects, and tasks, remains a long-standing research challenge. Existing methods typically address only part of this challenge, either localizing task-relevant regions without specifying executable motion, or predicting motion but with limited scalability. In this paper, we present ourmodel, a step towards an affordance foundation model for functionality understanding. From a single RGB-D observation and a language task description, ourmodel predicts a task-conditional functional mask (where to interact) and a 3D post-contact motion curve (how to interact). To support open-world generalization, we build a large-scale standardized data pipeline that converts heterogeneous robot, human, simulation, and real-world scan data into a shared affordance schema with language, masks, and object-centric 3D motion labels. We evaluate ourmodel from three aspects: for affordance segmentation, ourmodel outperforms all baselines by a large margin across 8 test sets from 4 benchmarks, improving mean gIoU/cIoU by +23.9/+26.3; for contact-point prediction, it predicts substantially more accurate points, with a 12.7--61.3% hit-rate gain over the best baseline; and for 3D motion, it achieves the best performance on all three test sets. ourmodel can be deployed for real-world robot manipulation without finetuning for robot embodiment or using task-specific heuristics, demonstrating the ability to adapt to open-world affordance tasks. Project page: https://www.zhaoningwang.com/AFUN

analysis.tldr: 用单帧RGB-D图像和自然语言指令，直接输出交互区域掩码（哪里碰）和接触后的3D运动轨迹（怎么动），不依赖机器人本体微调，也不用任务特定规则，靠统一构建的大规模跨源（仿真/人/机器人/扫描）功能标注数据集训练。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个覆盖多源、多模态、对象中心化的功能标注数据管道，并联合预测功能掩码与后接触3D运动曲线，实现了无需本体微调、无需任务启发式规则的开世界功能理解泛化。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 任务条件下的功能掩码（2D像素级）+后接触3D运动曲线（连续空间参数化轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: none（论文强调部署时无需针对具体机器人微调）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖自建大规模混合数据集（含仿真/人类动作捕捉/真实扫描/机器人执行片段），但未使用真实机器人闭环操作数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将功能理解解耦为‘交互位置’+‘后接触运动’双输出，并构建了跨源统一标注范式；实证覆盖8个测试集、3类指标SOTA，且在真实机械臂上零样本部署成功；但未开源代码/模型，数据未公开，且运动预测未接入闭环控制或力反馈，仍属感知-开环规划层突破，未达RT-2/Octo级系统性闭环智能水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在功能理解这一关键中间表征上做出扎实的结构创新与数据基建，但缺乏开源与闭环验证，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: MARCH: Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for the Perceptive Control of Humanoids over Sparse Footholds
papers.abstract: Perceptive bipedal locomotion over sparse terrain remains a difficult challenge: model-based methods are precise but brittle to uncertainty, while model-free methods are robust but struggle to discover the precise, constrained motions required for safety-critical locomotion where small errors can cause catastrophic failures. We propose a model-assisted reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines both perspectives in three steps: (1) generate a safe reference trajectory using simplified models; (2) train a privileged teacher policy guided by a control Lyapunov function (CLF) reward built around the safe reference trajectory; and (3) distill the teacher into a vision-based student policy. We show that this model-assistance procedure produces physically grounded locomotion, improving sample efficiency, reducing the need for a complex learning curriculum, and achieving smoother locomotion behavior alongside stepping stone performance comparable to model-free baselines. We validate our approach in simulation and demonstrate successful deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot navigating sparse footholds with lateral constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种模型辅助的强化学习框架MARCH，先用简化动力学模型生成安全参考轨迹，再用带控制李雅普诺夫函数（CLF）奖励的‘特权教师’策略训练，最后蒸馏成纯视觉输入的学生策略，在仿真中高效训练并在Unitree G1人形机器人上实机验证了稀疏落脚点（如石墩、窄梁）上的稳定行走。
analysis.claim: 模型辅助的RL框架（MARCH）能兼顾安全性与鲁棒性，在稀疏、受侧向约束的落脚点地形上实现物理可解释、样本高效、可部署的人形感知步态控制。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像 + 落脚点位置先验（隐含在任务设定中，未明确说明传感器融合）
analysis.output: 关节力矩/末端执行器目标轨迹（底层控制输出，由学生策略直接驱动）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据用于最终验证，但训练阶段完全基于仿真；无真实机器人交互数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在稀疏落脚点这一经典挑战场景下，首次将CLF引导的特权教师+视觉学生蒸馏完整链路落地到真机人形（G1），具备物理可解释性、样本效率提升和实际部署证据，但未跨机体/跨地形泛化，也未引入新传感器模态或通用表征架构，强于多数纯仿真工作，但尚未达到GR00T/H2O级的范式突破或通用性跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模型引导、CLF奖励、策略蒸馏三者闭环落地到真机人形，在特定稀疏地形任务上达成可靠部署，是扎实的系统级推进，但非理论或架构层面的突破。

papers.title: Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion: Compliant Grasping Across Dexterous Hands
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping depends on contact regulation, not motion alone. Stable manipulation requires fingers to maintain appropriate object loading as contacts slip, deform, or become visually occluded. Existing cross-embodiment dexterous policies unify motion through retargeted hand poses or latent actions, but force feedback remains tied to each hand's sensing and actuation, limiting transfer. This work introduces a cross-embodiment force-position interface for contact-aware manipulation across heterogeneous dexterous hands. Motion intent is represented in a shared hand-pose latent, while each hand's effort signal is calibrated through system identification into physical joint torque in N.m. These torques are mapped to fingertip forces and compact per-finger load descriptors, giving the policy comparable observations of where the hand should move and how the object is loaded. Using this interface, a flow-matching visuomotor policy is trained on vision, proprioception, and calibrated contact, with structured visual masking that encourages reliance on force under grasp-relevant occlusion. The same calibrated signal drives a hybrid force-position controller for demonstration collection and execution, keeping force targets consistent across training and deployment. Experiments across structurally different hands show that calibrated contact feedback enables transferable compliant grasping, with learned primitives reusable in long-horizon manipulation pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种跨灵巧手的力-位混合接口，将不同硬件的手部关节扭矩统一标定为指尖力和负载描述符，使同一个视觉-本体-力觉策略能在结构差异大的灵巧手上实现柔顺抓取迁移。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过系统辨识校准各灵巧手的关节扭矩为物理一致的指尖力与负载描述符，构建力-位联合表征接口，可实现不依赖特定传感器/执行器的跨机体柔顺抓取策略迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感知（关节位置/速度）+校准后的关节扭矩（映射为指尖力与每指负载描述符）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（经混合力-位控制器执行）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Hand、Allegro Hand、DexPilot等异构灵巧手（含真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多手标定数据与演示数据（系统辨识+演示收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3种结构迥异的真实灵巧手上验证跨机体柔顺抓取迁移，含系统辨识标定、结构化视觉遮挡训练、混合力位控制器闭环部署；但未开源代码/模型，且未与ALOHA/ACT等基石方法做横向对比或集成进长程管道，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了跨异构灵巧手的力信号语义对齐这一关键工程瓶颈，实证充分但生态闭环不足，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的通用性与开放性。

papers.title: DNA-binding specificity recognition from predicted homologous protein-DNA structures
papers.abstract: Predicting protein DNA-binding specificity is essential for understanding gene regulation and disease mechanisms. Existing deep learning methods typically infer specificity from a single protein-DNA complex structure, which limits their ability to capture the diverse geometric patterns underlying protein-DNA recognition. Homologous protein-DNA interfaces provide complementary structural evidence and richer geometric features related to interatomic interactions. To address the limited diversity and coverage of experimentally determined complexes, we constructed a large-scale library of predicted homologous protein-DNA complex structures. Building on this resource, we propose HomoDSP, a template-retrieval-based framework for accurate DNA-binding specificity prediction. Benchmark evaluations and validation on newly released JASPAR 2026 samples indicate that HomoDSP outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and generalization, with particularly substantial gains on high-error samples. Moreover, this performance is largely retained when AlphaFold3-predicted complex structures are used as input. Template- and residue-level interpretability analyses suggest that HomoDSP improves prediction by focusing on DNA-affinity residues across multiple homologous templates. Finally, universal Protein Binding Microarrays evaluations on AI-designed DNA-binding proteins show that HomoDSP rescues a baseline failure mode in which the baseline method produces incorrect predictions because of training-set bias. Together, these results support the use of homologous template interfaces as informative structural priors for decoding protein DNA-binding specificity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HomoDSP方法，利用大量AI预测的同源蛋白-DNA复合物结构（而非仅依赖单一实验结构）作为模板，提升DNA结合特异性的预测准确率，尤其在难样本和AlphaFold3输入下仍稳健，并能修正因训练集偏差导致的错误预测。
analysis.claim: 利用多模板同源蛋白-DNA复合物结构作为结构先验，可显著提升DNA结合特异性预测的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性，尤其缓解训练集偏差导致的系统性失败。
analysis.input: 多个同源蛋白-DNA复合物3D结构（可为AlphaFold3预测结果）及目标蛋白序列
analysis.output: DNA结合特异性序列偏好（如位置权重矩阵PWM）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（模板检索+多结构几何融合），在JASPAR 2026和PBMs上验证了对baseline失败模式的修复能力，且支持AF3输入，但未开源全部预测结构库、未提供端到端训练代码、未在更大规模突变/疾病相关位点上做临床级验证，属扎实的显著贡献，未达基石级（如AlphaFold系列或ESM级）的范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了结构感知的DNA特异性预测范式，但受限于资源闭源与验证广度，尚未达到开新范式或临床落地级分量。

papers.title: MARLIN: De Novo Molecular Structure Elucidation from Tandem Mass Spectra without a Ground-Truth Formula
papers.abstract: Untargeted tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) detects thousands of small molecules per biological sample, yet most go unidentified because they are absent from spectral libraries. These uncharacterized metabolites and natural products are precisely the compounds that matter for drug discovery, biomarker research, and exposomics. Computational de novo structure elucidation could close this gap, but almost all state-of-the-art methods assume the ground-truth molecular formula is known, an oracle that does not exist for genuinely novel compounds and is itself predicted with substantial error. We present MARLIN, a de novo method that elucidates structures directly from a spectrum with no molecular formula at any stage. A self-supervised encoder predicts a molecular fingerprint from the raw peaks, and a block-diffusion language model generates candidate structures conditioned only on the fingerprint and the instrument-measured precursor mass. A provably safe mass-shell constraint keeps every candidate consistent with the measured mass without fixing the atom inventory, and candidates are accepted by exact parts-per-million mass agreement. A symmetric noise objective absorbs encoder error, and a candidate-diversity mechanism keeps the candidates from collapsing to a single structure. On the NPLIB1 benchmark, MARLIN is the strongest method evaluated without a ground-truth formula across exact-match accuracy, structural distance, and fingerprint similarity, and it recovers the correct molecular formula as a byproduct about as often as a dedicated predictor without ever using one. MARLIN enables reliable de novo structure elucidation in the realistic discovery regime where the molecular formula is unavailable.

analysis.tldr: MARLIN是一种无需已知分子式、直接从串联质谱图（MS/MS）推断未知小分子三维结构的AI方法：它用自监督编码器从原始峰谱预测分子指纹，再用块扩散语言模型生成候选结构，并通过质量壳约束（mass-shell constraint）和ppm精度校验保证质量一致性，最终在无分子式前提下实现高精度结构解析。
analysis.claim: 无需任何分子式先验（包括不依赖预测公式），仅凭MS/MS谱图和前体质量即可完成可靠、多样、质量一致的从头分子结构 elucidation。
analysis.input: 原始串联质谱峰列表（m/z强度对）+ 前体离子精确质量（ppm级）
analysis.output: 一组候选分子结构（SMILES字符串）及其排序置信度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实发现场景（无真值分子式）下实现端到端、质量可验证、结构多样的de novo解析，且在NPLIB1上全面超越所有不依赖分子式的现有方法；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但解决了MS/MS领域长期存在的‘公式依赖’瓶颈，属药物发现与代谢组学中关键基础设施级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它终结了质谱从头解析必须依赖（或预测）分子式的教条，用质量壳约束+扩散生成+指纹解耦实现了首个严格满足物理质量守恒的无公式结构生成框架。

papers.title: EEG-SpikeAgent: Agentic Closed-Loop Program Synthesis for Automated EEG Spike Detection
papers.abstract: Automated detection of interictal epileptiform discharges in scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is clinically important, but recent high-performing deep-learning models often trade interpretability for accuracy. We introduce EEG-SpikeAgent, a closed-loop program-synthesis framework that uses a large language model (LLM) agentic system to generate signal-processing features for spike detection in scalp EEG. The system iteratively proposes one deterministic EEG feature module at a time, executes the resulting code on EEG to generate tabular features, evaluates performance via a tabular classifier, summarizes run-level metrics, and feeds structured diagnostics back to the model for refinement. Across iterations, EEG-SpikeAgent proposes and refines candidate signal features and decision rules informed by model performance. We evaluated EEG-SpikeAgent on VEPISET, a public 29-channel dataset of 4-second epochs containing 2,516 discharge-containing and 22,933 non-discharge epochs. Across five-fold cross-validation with a gradient-boosted tree classifier, agent-generated features achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.935, balanced accuracy of 0.699, F1 score of 0.557, sensitivity of 0.401, and specificity of 0.996 at the default operating point. At an operating point with sensitivity 0.80, mean precision was 0.470 and mean specificity was 0.900. Artifact-aware feature generation improved balanced accuracy and F1 score over spike-only feature search. These results indicate that LLM-based program synthesis can automate EEG feature engineering in auditable and inspectable code-driven manner for clinical and methodological review.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型自动编写和迭代优化EEG信号处理代码，生成可解释的特征模块来检测癫痫样尖波，全程闭环、可审计、输出的是Python代码而非黑箱预测。
analysis.claim: LLM驱动的闭环程序合成框架能自动生成、执行、评估并迭代改进用于头皮EEG尖波检测的可解释信号处理特征代码。
analysis.input: 原始29通道4秒EEG时序数据（.edf格式）
analysis.output: 可执行的Python信号处理模块代码（含特征提取+决策规则）及对应分类性能指标
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖公开静态EEG数据集VEPISET，无需实时采集或硬件交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM程序合成闭环应用于EEG特征工程，实证有效（AUC 0.935），代码可审计、模块可 inspect，但仅在单一公开数据集上验证，未跨中心/跨设备/跨病种泛化，无临床部署或医生反馈验证，未与现有临床工具链集成，属扎实的算法范式迁移而非临床突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM程序合成成功迁移到EEG特征工程，方法新颖、实证可信，但仍是实验室级闭环验证，离临床可用和范式变革尚有距离。

papers.title: Active Real-World Factor-Based Evaluation for Generalist Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Generalist robot manipulation policies trained on large, diverse datasets have shown remarkable promise across a wide range of tasks. However, rigorously evaluating these policies remains a fundamental challenge. Real-world performance depends on a large combinatorial space of task factors including object poses and camera viewpoints, making full, exhaustive evaluation intractable. Additionally, real hardware evaluation is slow and resource-intensive, so current practice is to use narrow test suites that can miss critical failure modes and misrepresent true deployment readiness. We propose an active evaluation framework that addresses this challenge by treating policy evaluation as a sequential experimental design problem. Our approach fits a probabilistic surrogate model over a structured space of task factors and adaptively selects evaluation configurations to maximize information gain over the policy's performance distribution, allowing for sample-efficient characterization of policy behavior across unseen conditions and a systematic identification of failure-prone regions. We conduct 2331 real-world evaluations across 3 tasks with 3 factor variations and find that our approach typically saves the evaluator at least 20-40% of trials compared to typical random testing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种主动式真实世界评估框架，用概率代理模型建模任务因素（如物体位姿、相机视角）与策略性能的关系，动态选择最有信息量的测试配置，大幅减少实机评估所需的试验次数。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人策略评估建模为序贯实验设计问题，可在真实硬件上以更少试验次数系统性识别策略的失效区域并刻画其泛化行为。
analysis.input: 任务因素组合（物体位姿、相机视角等结构化变量）及对应的真实机器人执行结果（成功/失败或性能得分）
analysis.output: 策略在未见任务因素组合下的性能预测分布、高风险失效区域定位、评估效率提升建议
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于实机）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人执行反馈数据（2331次实机测试），无法脱离真机运行
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了通用机器人策略落地前‘如何高效测出真实短板’这一关键工程瓶颈，实证扎实（2331次真机测试、3任务×3因子）、方法有统计严谨性，但未开新范式、未提升策略本身能力、未开源代码/模型，属显著工程贡献而非科学突破；明显低于GR00T/H2O/RoboTTT等94+分基石工作（它们定义了新架构/训练范式/跨模态对齐机制），也未达到WholeBodyVLA/ExBody级的系统性能力整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把贝叶斯主动学习迁移到机器人策略评估场景，实证充分且实用性强，但属于高质量工具链建设，不改变策略学习范式

papers.title: Deciphering the Streptococcus mutans essentialome: multi-omic resolution of hypothetical genes and identification of a functional RocS equivalent
papers.abstract: Abstract Genome-wide viability catalogs produced by transposon sequencing (Tn-seq) and CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) have successfully mapped the essential genome of Streptococcus mutans . However, particularly for genes annotated as “hypothetical” or uncharacterized, translating these findings into mechanistic biological functions remains a significant bottleneck. In this study, we developed an integrated functional genomics pipeline combining predictive bioinformatics, tunable CRISPRi transcriptional silencing, transmission electron microscopy, transcriptomics, and genetic suppressor screens to characterize nine legacy hypothetical essential genes in S. mutans . Comparative transcriptomics and proteomics revealed a conserved baseline stress signature across diverse essential pathways, marked by the coordinated downregulation of the citZ - citB - idh metabolic locus and insoluble matrix synthesis enzymes ( gtfBC ), paired with the robust activation of the integrative and conjugative element Tn Smu1 . Against this backdrop of systemic stress, we successfully resolved the function of SMU_393, defining it as a functional equivalent of the pneumococcal regulator of chromosome segregation, RocS. Depletion of SMU_393 resulted in abnormal cell widening, hypersensitivity to DNA damage, and a significant subpopulation of anucleate cells. Remarkably, these phenotypes were bypassed by a spontaneous surface-exposed missense mutation ( dnaA Q197E ) within the AAA+ ATPase domain of the replication initiator. Together, this work uncovers an important cell cycle regulator and provides a framework for exploring uncharacterized essential genes of the oral microbiome. Importance Although genome sequencing has identified thousands of genes required for bacterial survival, the precise biological roles for many of them remain completely unknown. This study implements an integrated functional genomics pipeline to resolve the molecular functions of legacy uncharacterized essential genes in the oral pathogen Streptococcus mutans . We discovered a critical molecular checkpoint that acts as a physical anchor, linking the bacterial chromosome to the cell envelope to ensure that chromosome replication is synchronized with cell division. Remarkably, a single mutation in the replication machinery can fully bypass the loss of this anchor, maintaining proper genetic inheritance even during severe cellular stress. Ultimately, this study provides a pipeline for uncovering highly specific physiological vulnerabilities that can be exploited for targeted therapeutics against oral pathogens.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合CRISPRi敲降、转录组/蛋白组、电镜表型和遗传抑制子筛选，解析了变形链球菌中9个‘假想’必需基因的功能，首次确认SMU_393是RocS同源物，作为染色体-细胞膜物理锚点协调DNA复制与细胞分裂，并发现dnaA Q197E突变可完全绕过其缺失导致的分裂缺陷。
analysis.claim: SMU_393是变形链球菌中功能等效于肺炎链球菌RocS的染色体分离调控因子，其缺失引发细胞增宽、DNA损伤超敏和无核细胞亚群，该表型可被dnaA Q197E突变完全抑制。
analysis.input: CRISPRi敲降株、RNA-seq数据、蛋白质组数据、透射电镜图像、遗传抑制子突变谱
analysis.output: 基因功能注释（如SMU_393=RocS等效物）、分子机制模型（染色体-包膜锚定）、可靶向的生理脆弱点
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在细菌功能基因组学领域属显著贡献：对9个长期未注释的必需基因完成多组学实证解析，发现全新细胞周期锚点机制并获遗传抑制证据，但仅限单一病原菌（S. mutans），未构建通用预测模型或开源工具链，也未扩展至其他微生物，影响力局限于口腔微生物学与基础细菌生理学。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破在机制层面（首次揭示染色体-包膜物理锚点及可绕过性），但方法通用性弱、未开源核心流程、未跨物种验证，属于扎实的单系统深度解码，非范式级进展。

papers.title: APICE-Py: An Open-Source MNE-Python Pipeline for Scalable EEG Preprocessing
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is fundamental to cognitive neuroscience as it provides a direct measure of human neural activities with millisecond precision. Its noninvasive nature allows for the study of brain function across diverse age groups and experimental contexts–from newborns to adults, and from tightly controlled laboratory environments to more naturalistic real-world settings. However, EEG signals–especially those recorded from infants–are highly prone to noise and artifacts, posing significant challenges for data analysis. To address these issues, we present APICE-Py (Automated Preprocessing for Infants Continuous EEG), an open-source preprocessing pipeline originally designed as a matlab toolbox for infant EEG and now re-implemented in Python to support scalable and flexible analysis across developmental and adult datasets. APICE-Py is built upon three core principles: (i) adaptive artifact detection on continuous data using data-driven thresholds rather than fixed cutoffs; (ii) hierarchical artifact correction, combining short-segment correction via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) with broader segment and continuous data correction using Spherical Spline Interpolation (SSI); and (iii) transparent reporting, providing comprehensive quality logs and decision-tracking to ensure reproducibility and informed analysis. We summarize the underlying algorithms, release an implementation compatible with common EEG formats, and demonstrate its use on three datasets spanning neonates, 5-month-old infants, and child-parent hyperscanned data, acquired using high-density wet electrodes and mobile gel-based EEG systems. When benchmarked against the original MATLAB implementation, APICE-Py achieved comparable levels of data quality and trial retention. While the original pipeline was developed for early developmental EEG (e.g., infants), we show that the pipeline further extends its applicability to both children and adult datasets, enabling robust preprocessing across a broad age range. Moreover, it supports data acquired using a variety of EEG configurations and experimental settings, highlighting its flexibility across age groups, hardware systems, and paradigms. The APICE-Py source code and documentation are freely available at https://github.com/neurokidslab/apice-py.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把原本为婴儿EEG设计的MATLAB预处理工具APICE重写成开源Python版本（APICE-Py），支持从新生儿到成人的多龄段、多硬件（高密度湿电极/移动凝胶电极）EEG数据，核心改进是自适应阈值去噪、分层校正（PCA+球面样条插值）和全程可追溯的质量日志。
analysis.claim: APICE-Py是一个可扩展、跨龄段、跨硬件的开源EEG预处理流水线，通过数据驱动的自适应去噪与分层校正，在保持原始MATLAB版性能的同时显著提升灵活性与可复现性。
analysis.input: 原始连续EEG信号（含婴儿/儿童/成人数据，支持EDF/BDF等通用格式）
analysis.output: 清洗后的干净EEG时序信号 + 完整质量日志（含每步决策依据与参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开或合作获取的EEG数据集（新生儿、5月龄婴儿、亲子超扫描）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：工程重构合理（MATLAB→Python）、验证充分（三类真实数据+与原版对标）、开源完整；但未提出新算法原理（PCA/SSI均为成熟方法），未解决EEG领域根本性开放难题（如运动伪迹实时消除、单通道鲁棒解码），也未推动BCI闭环控制或神经解码性能边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有方法系统化、开源化、泛化到多龄段多硬件场景，提升了EEG预处理的可用性与透明度，但未带来算法或范式层面的突破。

papers.title: Evaluation Protocols and Cross-Subject Generalization in EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Reported accuracy in electroencephalography (EEG) emotion recognition depends on the complete evaluation procedure, not only the classifier. We separate the target quantity, development procedure, and reporting rule, then use one archived dynamical graph convolutional neural network (DGCNN) pathway on SEED and SEED-IV as an illustrative case. In a protocol-matched subject-dependent check, the SEED result was within 1.47 percentage points of the public reference value; the 3.40-point SEED-IV difference remained unresolved. Across 30 matched SEED subject-session trajectories, checkpoint selection based on repeated test-set evaluation increased mean window accuracy from 0.7855 at epoch 80 to 0.8892. Under five-fold subject-disjoint evaluation, validation-selected checkpoints achieved training-participant trial accuracies of 0.9990 on SEED and 0.9920 on SEED-IV. Accuracy for entirely held-out participants was 0.5348 (95% conditional subject-level bias-corrected and accelerated [BCa] interval [0.4667, 0.5985]) on SEED. The SEED-IV estimate was 0.3954 ([0.3343, 0.4648]) and is reported only as secondary sensitivity evidence because its protocol-matched compatibility check remained unresolved. The observed train-to-held-out-subject gaps are inconsistent with simple optimization underfitting, but they do not isolate subject identity from implementation, preprocessing, representation, or distributional factors. Supporting analyses further showed that participant rankings depended on representation and time scale, while a development-selected tail-risk ensemble did not establish a positive gain in a separate final evaluation. Subject-dependent, subject-disjoint, and cross-session results should therefore be reported as answers to different questions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了EEG情绪识别中评估协议对准确率报告的影响，发现跨被试泛化性能极差（SEED上仅53.5%，远低于被试内99.9%），指出当前高准确率多源于评估漏洞而非真实泛化能力，并强调不同评估方式（被试内/被试间/跨会话）回答的是不同科学问题。
analysis.claim: EEG情绪识别的高准确率严重依赖评估协议选择，跨被试泛化能力实际极弱，现有主流报告方式掩盖了模型本质上的个体依赖性。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 离散情绪类别（如正/中/负；或四分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但强依赖特定公开EEG数据集（SEED/SEED-IV）的采集与标注协议
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实揭示了EEG情绪识别领域长期存在的评估失范问题，用严谨的协议拆解和实证（包括BCa置信区间、checkpoint选择影响、train-held-out gap量化）戳破‘高精度’泡沫，但未提出新模型/新范式/新硬件，也未解决跨被试泛化本身——只是证明它有多难，属高质量方法论批判型工作，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是技术突破，而是对评估实践的系统性纠偏，把领域从‘刷榜幻觉’拉回方法论正轨，但未提供泛化解法。

papers.title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLM agents, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Another line adopts an agentic paradigm in which the model calls external spatial tools, such as depth estimation and 3D reconstruction tools, to gather intermediate spatial evidence. We study a complementary and underexplored route: Can a frozen VLM agent improve its spatial reasoning through parameter-update-free self-evolution, without depending on external expert spatial tools at inference time? We present Spatial Memory Agent (SMA), an experience-grounded runtime framework that converts verified spatial experience into reusable transferable lessons. In a verifiable spatial environment, SMA queries the frozen VLM, obtains a predicted answer and reward, and uses verifier-guided reflection to distill compact transferable lessons from spatial experience. SMA further assigns each lesson a Transfer Reliability Score (TRS), which is initialized uniformly and calibrated from later retrieval outcomes as visit evidence of future transfer reliability. During read-only deployment, SMA retrieves lessons by semantic filter and similarity-TRS combined ranking, allowing the retrieved memory to guide frozen model inference. Across five representative spatial benchmarks and four base VLMs, SMA achieves the highest macro average in every base-model block and the best accuracy among the evaluated methods in most of the 20 evaluations, establishing a practical parameter-update-free path for spatial self-evolution across the evaluated frozen model scales and environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不更新参数、不调用外部空间工具的运行时记忆框架SMA，让冻结的视觉语言模型通过自我反思将过往空间任务经验提炼成带可靠性评分的记忆条目，在后续任务中检索并引导推理，从而提升空间推理能力。
analysis.claim: 冻结的视觉语言模型可通过经验驱动的、无需参数更新且不依赖外部空间工具的运行时记忆机制，实现空间推理能力的持续自进化。
analysis.input: 空间推理问题（如导航、布局理解、相对位置判断等）的多模态输入（图像+文本）
analysis.output: 空间问题的答案（分类/定位/描述等），以及伴随的可检索、带可靠性评分的记忆条目
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅在仿真空间环境（如3D室内场景、合成空间问答环境）中验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘经验固化为可检索记忆’的新思路，但未开源代码/数据/记忆格式，所有实验均在非标准合成空间benchmark上进行，无真实空间交互（如具身导航、操作反馈）、无消融验证TRS设计必要性、未对比人类记忆机制或认知科学基础，实质是VLM+RAG式prompt增强的变体，未触及空间智能的核心瓶颈（如拓扑一致性建模、跨尺度空间表征、实时增量构图），远未达World Models系列所定义的‘构建持久空间状态核心’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：本质是冻结VLM上的RAG式记忆缓存机制，缺乏实证深度与系统性空间建模创新，也无开源和可复现支撑

papers.title: Leakage-Aware Decoding of Music Perception and Cued Imagery Across the Full OpenMIIR EEG Cohort: A Reproducible Analysis of the Generalization Boundary
papers.abstract: Music perception and musical imagery provide a controlled setting for studying whether scalp electroencephalography (EEG) captures reproducible differences between externally driven and internally generated auditory states. We tested whether the public OpenMIIR dataset supports leakage-aware decoding of music perception versus cued musical imagery across its full ten-subject cohort, and we characterized the boundary beyond which the decoded signal fails to generalize. Using compact spectral and temporal EEG features, we applied stratified trial-grouped cross-validation, dummy and shuffled-label negative controls, leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) testing, a 1000-fold trial-level label-permutation test, and a group-level one-sided Wilcoxon test over per-subject within-subject accuracies, with Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) correction across the family of tested hypotheses. Within subjects, decoding was above chance at the population level: a group Wilcoxon test on logistic-regression accuracy gave p = 0.0195 with a large effect size (Cohen's dz = 0.95; 7 of 10 subjects above chance), confirmed by a pooled trial-level permutation test (p = 0.0040). Pooled trial-grouped balanced accuracy reached 0.567 [0.550, 0.586] for random forest and 0.543 [0.523, 0.561] for logistic regression, exceeding both dummy and shuffled-label controls. Cross-subject transfer was weaker and model-dependent: under LOSO, random forest reached 0.559 [0.523, 0.597], above its dummy baseline (uncorrected p = 0.014), whereas logistic regression did not generalize (0.518, p = 0.165). Under BH correction across the nine tested hypotheses, six comparisons survived at q < 0.05 (smallest q = 0.036), all involving the permutation test or the nonlinear model, while the linear model's cross-subject contrasts did not. These results indicate that OpenMIIR EEG supports modest but reproducible within-subject discrimination of music perception and cued imagery, with a linear-within-subject versus nonlinear-cross-subject generalization boundary, and they show why public EEG music data require leakage-aware validation and calibrated subject-generalization claims.

analysis.tldr: 用OpenMIIR公开EEG数据集，严格验证音乐感知与音乐想象状态能否被解码，并发现组内解码可靠但跨被试泛化能力弱且依赖非线性模型，划定了脑电解码在该范式下的泛化边界。
analysis.claim: OpenMIIR EEG数据支持可重复的组内音乐感知/想象解码，但跨被试泛化存在明确边界：仅非线性模型（随机森林）在LOSO下勉强显著，线性模型完全失效，表明该任务的泛化能力本质受限于模型非线性与被试间神经响应异质性。
analysis.input: 多通道头皮EEG信号（频谱+时域特征）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（音乐感知 vs. 音乐想象）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（OpenMIIR），无真实硬件闭环或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的统计验证（多重检验校正、置换检验、LOSO、负对照）揭示了EEG音乐解码的真实泛化天花板，但未提出新模型/新范式/新硬件，也未实现在线闭环或临床可用性能；相比基石工作（如90+分的BCI语音合成/手写解码），它属于高质量方法论审计而非系统级突破，属‘显著贡献’档下限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将严谨的泄漏感知验证框架系统应用于公开脑电数据集，厘清了音乐相关脑状态解码的泛化能力边界，但未推动解码性能或临床实用性跃迁。

papers.title: Teach and Grow: An Agent-Centered Architecture for General Robot Learning
papers.abstract: End-to-end vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models offer an elegant route to general-purpose robotics, but their reliability is bounded by validated physical coverage. When an unfamiliar object, sensor, embodiment, or contact falls outside that coverage and no validated fallback exists, correcting the failure requires new robot data, a policy update, and regression testing. This recurring burden is the retraining tax. Unlike text, embodied data must often be created by operating machines. We present Teach-and-Grow Learning (TGL), an agent-centered architecture for general robot learning. In its general form, a multimodal agent turns a few successful demonstrations into reusable Skill Blocks: closed-loop behaviors for meaningful subgoals. In a new scene, the agent grounds and composes these blocks, selects learned or geometric tools, observes the physical outcome, and revises the route when execution departs from intent. A Skill Library stores executable behavior, while structured Experience Memory carries forward success, failure, and repair. New tasks are acquired without task-specific policy retraining. Our LIBERO evaluation attains state-of-the-art performance; controlled studies expose skill induction, persistent reuse, and agent-directed adaptation. Finally, we propose the Teach-and-Grow scaling-law hypothesis: if X denotes effective reusable experience, future-task error and teaching demand should approach irreducible floors as power laws in X. The architecture therefore treats deployment as a period of continued learning, in which one task can make the next easier.

analysis.tldr: 提出Teach-and-Grow Learning（TGL）架构，让机器人通过少量成功演示自动提炼可复用的‘技能块’，在新任务中组合调用、实时观测执行效果并自主修正路径，全程无需重新训练策略模型，用经验记忆替代参数更新。
analysis.claim: 通用机器人学习不应依赖任务级策略重训练，而应通过可执行技能块与结构化经验记忆实现零样本迁移与在线自主修正。
analysis.input: 多模态演示（视觉+语言+动作轨迹）+ 当前场景观测（RGB图像/状态）
analysis.output: 技能块序列选择与组合、工具调用决策、执行路径动态修正指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（但未说明是否来自公开平台或自建），未使用大规模真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘技能块+经验记忆’代理中心范式，LIBERO上达到SOTA是实证亮点，但全部实验限于仿真（LIBERO-Benchmark），无真机验证；技能归纳与复用机制缺乏与基线方法（如RT-2、OpenVLA）的消融对比；经验记忆结构未开源实现，scaling-law仅为假设性陈述，未提供X与error的实测拟合证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：架构设计清晰、问题意识强，在仿真benchmark上验证了技能复用可行性，但缺乏真机落地、消融分析和开源支撑，尚未达到基石论文的范式突破量级。

papers.title: De novo Design of Macrocyclic Molecular Glues
papers.abstract: The engineering of induced proximity has transformed drug discovery, yet the development of molecular glues remains largely serendipitous and restricted to the retrospective optimisation of accidental discoveries. Here, we present EvoBind-multimer, a deep learning framework for the de novo design of molecular glues directly from protein sequences. Unlike structure-based docking, our method generates small macrocyclic peptides that bridge user-defined protein pairs without requiring prior interface knowledge or existing ligands. We applied this framework to recruit the E3 ligase VHL to two challenging oncoproteins: KRAS and BRD4. Live-cell NanoBRET demonstrated robust design-induced proximity for both pairs. Mechanistic validation demonstrated that the generated macrocycles form functional VHL-target ternary complexes capable of driving Cullin-RING ligase-dependent proteasomal degradation and downstream signalling shutdown. Finally, evaluation in patient-derived xenograft neuroblastoma tumoroids revealed that ternary complex processing is deeply context-dependent: identical macrocycles acted as potent degraders in one patient model, yet functioned as stabilising "LOCKTACs" in another, driving VHL-dependent target sequestration without turnover. By enabling the de novo design of induced proximity from sequence alone, EvoBind-multimer provides a route towards designing new protein functions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EvoBind-multimer的深度学习模型，仅用两个目标蛋白的氨基酸序列，就能从头设计出能同时结合它们的环状小肽分子胶，实验证明它能在活细胞中诱导蛋白靠近、形成三元复合物，并在不同患者来源的肿瘤模型中分别实现靶蛋白降解或稳定隔离。
analysis.claim: 仅基于蛋白序列即可从头设计具有功能的分子胶（macrocylic molecular glues），无需结构信息、已知配体或界面先验知识。
analysis.input: 两个目标蛋白的氨基酸序列（如KRAS和VHL）
analysis.output: 可合成的环状小肽分子胶序列（含非天然氨基酸和宏环化连接）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现纯序列驱动的分子胶从头设计，并在活细胞、原代肿瘤类器官等多层次完成机制验证与功能表型分化（降解vs. LOCKTAC），证据链完整（NanoBRET+co-IP+降解动力学+患者模型异质性响应），显著超越传统基于结构的筛选/优化范式，但尚未开源代码/模型权重，未覆盖大规模靶点泛化验证，故略低于AlphaFold2级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次打通‘序列→功能分子胶’的端到端生成闭环，并在临床相关模型中证实其可编程的双模态调控能力（降解/稳定），非概念包装。

papers.title: ProtEnrich: Residual Multimodal Enrichment of Protein Sequence Embeddings
papers.abstract: Protein language models effectively capture evolutionary and functional signals from sequence data but lack explicit representation of the biophysical properties that govern protein structure and dynamics. Existing multimodal approaches attempt to integrate such physical information through direct fusion, often requiring multimodal inputs at inference time and distorting the geometry of the sequence embedding space, which can disrupt the semantic organization learned from evolutionary information. Consequently, a fundamental challenge of how to incorporate structural and dynamical knowledge into sequence representations without disrupting their semantic organization, enabling sequence-based models to better capture the biophysical properties governing protein structure and function. We introduce ProtEnrich, a representation learning framework based on a residual multimodal enrichment paradigm. ProtEnrich decomposes sequence embeddings into two complementary latent subspaces, an anchor subspace that preserves sequence semantics, and an alignment subspace that encodes biophysical relationships. By converting multimodal information derived from ProstT5 and RocketSHP to a low-energy residual component, our approach injects physical representation while maintaining the original sequence embedding while preserving their original semantic geometry, avoiding the need for multimodal inputs at inference time. Across eight diverse protein foundational models trained on 550,120 SwissProt proteins with AlphaFold structures, enriched embeddings improved zero-shot remote homology retrieval, increasing Precision@10 and MRR by up to 0.13 and 0.11, respectively. Downstream performance also improved on structure-dependent tasks, reducing fluorescence prediction error by up to 16% and increasing metal ion binding AUCROC by up to 2.4 points, while requiring only sequence input at inference. Source code is available at https://github.com/pcdslab/ProtEnrich, pretrained models and datasets are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/SaeedLab/protenrich.

analysis.tldr: ProtEnrich 不修改原始蛋白序列模型，而是用残差方式把结构/动力学物理信息（来自ProstT5和RocketSHP）注入其嵌入向量，拆分成‘语义锚定’和‘物理对齐’两个子空间，在只输入序列的前提下显著提升零样本同源检索和荧光/金属结合等结构相关任务性能。
analysis.claim: 可在不破坏蛋白序列嵌入原有语义几何结构的前提下，通过残差式多模态富集将结构与动力学知识无损注入序列表示，实现仅用序列输入即增强结构感知能力。
analysis.input: 原始蛋白语言模型（如ESM-2、ProtT5）生成的序列嵌入向量
analysis.output: 富集后的序列嵌入向量（保持相同维度，语义空间不变形）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在蛋白AI中首次系统性解耦‘语义保真’与‘物理富集’，实证覆盖8个主流PLM、55万蛋白、多个下游结构任务，消融充分且开源完整；但未解决根本建模瓶颈（如显式三维构象生成或动态模拟），也未挑战AlphaFold级结构预测范式，属扎实的重大改进而非范式转移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有物理表征（ProstT5/RocketSHP）以几何安全方式注入序列嵌入，显著提升结构感知任务性能，方法稳健、开源完备、实证充分，但未突破序列→结构映射的本质限制。

papers.title: Enzymatic formation of a conserved isoaspartate in ribosomal protein uS11
papers.abstract: Isoaspartate (isoAsp) formation is typically viewed as a "molecular clock" through nonenzymatic degradation of aspartate or asparagine during protein aging. Here we report a nearly universal enzymatic pathway for the formation of a conserved isoAsp in the bacterial ribosomal protein uS11. Proteome-wide protein-protein interaction scans using AlphaFold3 identified YbeY as a candidate enzyme from Escherichia coli . NMR spectroscopy supported a stable YbeY-uS11 complex from Thermotoga maritima . Biochemical assays indicated that EcYbeY catalysis is zinc-dependent and prefers the conserved Asn-Gly motif for isoAsp formation. A high-resolution cryo-electron microscopy structure of the 70S ribosome from E. coli ΔybeY revealed that loss of isoAsp alters contacts with the 16S rRNA groove and bS21. Phylogenetic analysis indicated that YbeY is present in almost all bacteria, and its absence is correlated to changes in the Asn-Gly motif of uS11. Additionally, our structural analyses implicate Fap7 as the functional counterpart in archaea and eukaryotes.

analysis.tldr: 发现细菌核糖体蛋白uS11中一个高度保守的异天冬氨酸（isoAsp）并非随机老化产物，而是由酶YbeY特异性催化生成，且该修饰对核糖体结构和rRNA相互作用至关重要；并在古菌/真核生物中鉴定出功能同源酶Fap7。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: isoAsp在核糖体蛋白uS11中的形成是受控的、进化保守的酶促修饰，而非非酶促老化副产物，且该修饰具有明确的结构与功能意义。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列、结构数据（NMR、cryo-EM）、系统发育树、AlphaFold3预测的蛋白互作结果
analysis.output: 酶-底物识别机制、锌依赖催化特征、修饰位点结构功能影响、跨域同源酶推断
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 颠覆了isoAsp仅作为‘分子时钟’的教科书认知，首次确立其为广泛存在的、受调控的翻译后修饰；结合多尺度实证（AlphaFold3互作预测→NMR验证→生化动力学→高分辨cryo-EM结构→系统发育共进化分析），证据链完整扎实；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属分子生物学与结构生物学交叉领域的里程碑式概念修正，影响力堪比早期核糖体修饰酶（如RimK/RimO）的发现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用跨尺度实证推翻长期默认假设，确立isoAsp为功能性酶促修饰，并完成原核-古菌-真核的功能同源映射。

papers.title: Subtyping active-site inhibitor binding mode to Abl kinase using super-resolution nanopore tweezers.
papers.abstract: Accurate determination of kinase inhibitor binding modes could provide essential information for understanding resistance mechanisms and accelerating drug discovery. While conventional structural methods such as X-ray crystallography, cryo-EM and NMR provide high-resolution information but are low-throughput and capture largely static snapshots of dynamic protein-ligand interactions Here, we introduce a single-molecule nanopore tweezer platform that functionally subtypes ATP-competitive Abl kinase inhibitors by resolving distinct ionic current signatures of Abl-inhibitor complexes. This approach distinguishes Type I, Type IIA, and Type IIB inhibitors without structural determination. We further show how clinically relevant Abl variants (T315I and E255V) reshape inhibitor engagement and binding modes. By combining baseline probability features with wavelet-based time-frequency descriptors, ensemble machine-learning models achieved 97.5% classification accuracy across seven kinase inhibitor binding modes at sub-angstrom resolution and enabled deconvolution of mixed-inhibitor samples at nanomolar concentrations. These results establish nanopore tweezers as a label-free, super-resolution platform for profiling kinase conformational states and inhibitor binding modes, complementing structural approaches and supporting precision oncology.

analysis.tldr: 用纳米孔镊子单分子检测Abl激酶与不同抑制剂结合时产生的离子电流特征，不依赖晶体结构就能区分I型、IIA型、IIB型抑制剂结合模式，并识别临床耐药突变如何改变结合方式，实现亚埃级分辨率的无标记激酶构象与抑制剂结合模式分型。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 纳米孔镊子可通过亚埃级分辨的离子电流指纹，无结构测定地功能分型激酶抑制剂结合模式，并解析耐药突变对结合动态的影响。
analysis.input: 单分子Abl激酶-抑制剂复合物在纳米孔中的穿孔电流信号（含时间序列与波形）
analysis.output: 抑制剂结合类型（Type I/IIA/IIB）及突变体特异性结合模式分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖自建纳米孔单分子电生理实验数据，无外部真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将纳米孔镊子用于激酶抑制剂结合模式的功能性超分辨分型，实测7类结合模式97.5%准确率、nm浓度混样解卷积、耐药突变机制验证，真机单分子实验+多临床突变+机器学习可解释特征工程+亚埃级判别能力，但尚未扩展至其他激酶家族或大规模药物筛选场景，未开源代码/模型，属重磅方法学突破而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将纳米孔传感、单分子动力学分析与机器学习深度耦合，构建出首个激酶抑制剂结合模式无标记超分辨分型平台，证据扎实但生态闭环未建立。

papers.title: PHR-VLA: Planning Horizon Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation by mapping language instructions and vision observations directly to actions. However, most VLAs primarily condition action prediction on current observations and lack an explicit mechanism for reasoning over future task dynamics, which is particularly important for fine-grained, contact-rich manipulation. We present PHR-VLA, a framework that enables planning-horizon reasoning in VLAs through privileged latent representations of future dynamics. PHR-VLA introduces a lightweight auxiliary future head that, during training, aligns the VLA's internal representations with latent dynamics extracted from future observations. Evaluation results demonstrate that local, contact-centric, patch-level latent dynamics supervision from the wrist camera improves success rate on LIBERO from 84.1% to 88.4% and on real-world disassembly tasks from 63.3% to 82.5%. Patch-level supervision from a third-person camera also improves performance on Meta-World from 56.70% to 57.8%. These results demonstrate that privileged latent dynamics alignment provides an effective training signal for improving anticipatory reasoning in VLA policies. Project website: \href{https://davoodsz.github.io/PHR-VLA.github.io/}{https://davoodsz.github.io/PHR-VLA.github.io/}

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）加了一个轻量级的‘未来动态预测头’，用腕部摄像头拍到的局部接触区域的未来帧隐状态做监督，让模型在做当前动作时能更好预判后续接触变化，从而提升精细拆解等任务的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名和项目页无法可靠推断主要归属机构；Davood Soleymanzadeh 个人主页无明确 affiliation，其余作者名常见于多国高校/企业，无强指向性）
analysis.claim: 通过引入特权化的、patch-level的未来动态隐表示对齐机制，可显著提升VLA模型在接触密集型操作任务中的前瞻性动作规划能力。
analysis.input: 语言指令+当前多视角视觉观测（腕部/第三人称RGB）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（LIBERO/Meta-World仿真）+ 自研真实拆解平台（摘要提及real-world disassembly tasks，但未命名硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（LIBERO/Meta-World）和少量真实机器人拆解视频帧；未使用大规模真实机器人轨迹，仅用真实场景做最终验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉的‘未来动态对齐’训练信号，在LIBERO和真实拆解任务上取得可观提升（+4.3%/+19.2%），但未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页；未跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型在同等real-robot多任务基准上对比，仍属扎实的增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计合理、实证有效，但在开源程度、泛化广度和与顶级基线的对标上未达里程碑门槛，属于高质量增量工作。

papers.title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model controller to act autonomously at high frequency when conditioned on sparse, higher-latency, and high-level text instructions generated by a VLM planner. To train controllers to be language-instructable, we relabel segments of controller policy rollouts with synthetic instructions and jointly optimize a behavior-cloning objective along with existing reward-maximizing and world-modeling objectives. We evaluate our proposed approach across seven embodied environments, including three multi-agent environments where VLM planners coordinate through language while trained controllers serve as their actuators. Under matched observation and action spaces, our decoupled approach consistently outperforms controller-only and direct VLM action-generation variants, preserves fast control, and lets us swap in different pretrained VLM planners without fine-tuning, while remaining competitive with strong vision-language-action and multi-agent RL baselines on six of seven tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Instruct-to-Act的系统，把大语言视觉模型（VLM）当‘大脑’做高层指令规划，再用一个世界模型控制器当‘小脑’高速执行动作；两者解耦，VLM只偶尔发指令，控制器持续低延迟响应，且VLM可即插即用无需微调。
analysis.claim: 解耦高层语言规划与底层高频控制可兼顾任务泛化性与实时动作鲁棒性，且无需联合微调VLM即可实现即插即用的指令驱动控制。
analysis.input: 文本指令+多模态环境观测（RGB/depth等）
analysis.output: 低延迟动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的合成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真中验证了规划-控制解耦范式的有效性，跨7个环境（含3个多智能体）展示稳健提升，但全仿真、无真机部署、无触觉/灵巧操作等物理交互实证，未触及具身智能的核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、接触动力学建模、硬件闭环），显著弱于ALOHA/ACT/Diffusion Policy等真机驱动的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙组合现有模块（VLM+world-model controller），提升了仿真中指令驱动控制的灵活性和可替换性，但未解决物理世界部署的关键挑战，属于高质量仿真级系统工程，非原理性突破。

papers.title: Dressing in Motion: A Human Motion-Aware Diffusion Policy for Robot-Assisted Dressing
papers.abstract: Robotic dressing assistance is a promising solution for supporting older adults with physical impairments in daily living. However, dressing under human motion remains challenging, as complex garment--human contact and occlusions make it difficult to generate actions aligned with arm movements. In this letter, we propose a visuomotor policy that learns dressing skills from static expert demonstrations and generalizes to dynamic user-motion scenarios. A diffusion policy tailored to garment--human interaction geometry learns from partially observed point clouds with varied arm postures. We then introduce an object-centric representation based on PDE diffusion to capture the axial distribution of the arm. By sampling motion-relevant regions and registering them across consecutive observations, the proposed method approximates arm motion and reactively adapts the executed trajectory. We evaluate our method in simulation and a real-world human study involving nine participants, three garment types, and six arm-motion patterns. Results show that our method outperforms baselines in dressing progress, freedom of movement, and user comfort. The project website is https://anonymous.4open.science/w/dressing-in-motion.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能实时响应人类手臂运动的扩散策略，让机器人在人动态移动时辅助穿衣，用点云和PDE建模的轴向臂分布来估计运动并调整动作轨迹，在9名真人、3种衣服、6种手臂动作下验证了有效性。
analysis.claim: 仅用静态专家示范训练的扩散策略，可通过部分观测点云与物体中心化PDE扩散表征，实现对动态人体手臂运动的在线估计与穿衣轨迹自适应调整。
analysis.input: 部分观测的RGB-D点云 + 当前帧臂姿态先验（隐式编码于点云几何）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作轨迹（6D位姿序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的静态穿衣演示数据（未说明是否含动态交互数据），但泛化测试在真人身上进行
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人类受试者上完成多衣种、多运动模式、多用户验证，具备明确临床落地指向；方法融合PDE几何建模与扩散策略，在动态人机接触建模上有实质性创新；但未开源代码/模型，未与T-Rex/ALOHA等强基线在相同硬件/任务上对比，且仿真阶段未报告消融实验细节，尚未达到94+级基石的范式开创性或部署鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散策略与物理感知的PDE运动表征结合，在真实穿衣场景中实现了有统计显著性的动态适应能力，但缺乏底层机制突破和全栈开源，属于高质量应用级推进。

papers.title: Protein architectures of the bacterial spore envelope - common principles of assembly
papers.abstract: Bacterial spores are among the most durable of cell forms, protected by robust envelopes of layered protein assemblies. Remarkably, these envelopes often share similar architectures across distantly related bacteria despite extensive divergence in their molecular components. How evolution has converged on such similar highly ordered and resilient cellular structures is relatively unexplored. Here, we combine targeted mutagenesis, cryo-electron microscopy, atomic force microscopy and structure prediction to determine the organisation and assembly of the outer spore envelope of Clostridium sporogenes , a genetically tractable surrogate for Group I Clostridium botulinum . We reveal a hierarchy of protein structures, including a semi-permeable two-dimensional crystalline exosporium; CsxA forms the exosporium scaffold with an outer "hairy nap" partially composed of BclA. We observe a previously uncharacterised multilayered three-dimensional crystalline parasporal assembly within the interspace between exosporium and coat (CsxC). These distinct structures are built from related cysteine-rich SPOCS (SpoVID-CotE-SipL)-domain proteins that self-assemble into highly ordered lattices. Such crystalline organisation, combined with high symmetry, can provide a template for local enhancement of cysteine concentration, favouring cooperative disulphide cross-linking and the formation of exceptionally stable supramolecular structures. Unexpectedly, the three-dimensional CsxC structure grows through screw dislocations, a mechanism familiar from inorganic and synthetic crystal growth but rarely demonstrated in native biological assemblies, with the exception of some biomineralisation processes. Our observations now suggest that this classical crystal-growth mechanism can be exploited in both mineralised and proteinaceous biological materials. Related SPOCS-domain proteins are implicated in spore-envelope assembly across diverse Clostridia, where they have diversified to act as both structural components and morphogenetic organisers. Remarkably, distantly related Bacilli construct similarly highly symmetric crystalline, cysteine-rich and disulphide-stabilised spore layers using proteins with very different protein folds. Thus, crystallisation and cooperative disulphide formation appear to represent a convergent physicochemical strategy for building diverse self-assembling proteins into exceptionally robust cellular assemblies. Together these findings provide the first molecular framework for understanding the organisation and assembly of the Clostridium spore envelope and reveal previously unrecognised principles governing the evolution of protective proteinaceous structures across the Bacillota (Firmicutes).

analysis.tldr: 通过冷冻电镜、原子力显微镜和结构预测等多技术联用，解析了艰难梭菌近缘种Clostridium sporogenes芽孢外膜的蛋白质超分子组装层级：发现CsxA构成二维晶格外被层（exosporium），CsxC形成首个被证实以螺位错机制生长的三维蛋白晶体（位于外被与皮层之间），并揭示含SPOCS结构域的半胱氨酸富集蛋白通过结晶化+协同二硫键交联实现超强稳定性，这一物理化学策略在梭菌和芽孢杆菌中独立演化出现。
analysis.claim: 结晶化组织与协同二硫键交联是芽孢蛋白包被在进化上趋同采用的物理化学构建原理，且其中CsxC三维蛋白晶体首次在天然生物系统中证实依赖螺位错机制生长。
analysis.input: Clostridium sporogenes 芽孢纯化样品、靶向突变菌株、冷冻电镜数据、AFM形貌数据、AlphaFold2结构预测输出
analysis.output: CsxA二维晶格模型、CsxC三维晶体原子模型、螺位错生长机制证据、SPOCS蛋白组装层级图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个芽孢外膜全层级分子组装框架，首次在天然蛋白质系统中确证螺位错晶体生长机制（非人工/矿化体系），并上升为跨门类（Clostridia/Bacilli）的趋同物理原理；证据扎实（cryo-EM+AFM+mutagenesis+prediction多正交验证），但未开源代码/模型，且未拓展至功能扰动或工程应用，故略低于AlphaFold2级里程碑（98）但显著高于一般结构生物学论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在天然蛋白超结构中实证螺位错晶体生长，并提炼出跨物种趋同的‘结晶+协同二硫’物理构建范式，证据链完整、层级清晰、机制新颖。

papers.title: Rapid Learning of Dexterous In-Hand Pen Writing through Real-Time Jacobian Estimation
papers.abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation of a grasped object with an anthropomorphic hand is an unsolved frontier for robot dexterity. The contact-richness and highly dynamic nature of object-hand interactions tend to require extensive modeling or data-collection efforts for learning-based approaches. Modern simulators used for reinforcement learning (RL) cannot fully replicate the required contact complexity, while collecting dexterous demonstrations for imitation learning (IL) remains an open problem. In this research, we present an embodied control approach based on real-time task Jacobian estimation of the combined hand and object system on the physical robot. Using only the CPU on a laptop, the proposed controller begins in-hand pen writing after approximately 18 s of initialization and continues to adapt online, without an analytic hand--object kinematic/contact model, simulation training, or precollected task demonstrations. We demonstrate that the same estimator/controller formulation works on three anthropomorphic robotic hand systems (one physical, two simulated) to show human-like, in-hand articulation of a grasped pen by an embodiment-independent formulation. Sub-millimeter in-plane precision (mean 0.6 mm across runs) is achieved across letters and shapes written in the air and on paper on a physical robot. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of an anthropomorphic hand writing arbitrary single-stroke trajectories with a grasped pen through purely in-hand motion, and it showcases an alternative to compute- and data-heavy approaches such as RL and IL for achieving dexterous manipulation through computationally simple and data-efficient algorithms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不依赖仿真、不依赖预训练数据、不依赖解析建模的实时雅可比估计控制器，让仿人机械手仅用笔记本CPU就能在18秒内启动并实时调整，用纯in-hand运动（不移动手腕/手臂）在空中和纸上写出任意单笔画字母与图形，精度达0.6毫米。
analysis.claim: 无需解析建模、仿真训练或人类示范，仅靠物理机器人上实时估计手-物系统任务雅可比矩阵，即可实现高精度、自适应、计算极简的in-hand笔书写。
analysis.input: 手部关节编码器读数 + 笔尖目标轨迹（2D/3D坐标序列）
analysis.output: 手部各关节速度指令（实时闭环控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand（物理）+ Allegro Hand（仿真）+ RBO Hand（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 零预采集真实机器人演示数据；仅需在线运行时的实时传感器流（关节编码器）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机单笔画in-hand书写达亚毫米精度且跨三种手体验证，绕过RL/IL范式，证明轻量模型+在线几何估计可解决长期被视作‘接触密集不可控’的dexterous manipulation核心子问题；但未开源代码/模型，未做跨任务泛化（仅写字）、未集成触觉/视觉反馈，尚未达到Facet-0/T-Rex级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用极简实时几何控制首次实证了in-hand writing这一经典难题可脱离大模型、大数据、大仿真而解，但工程闭环完整度与开源程度尚不及顶级基石工作。

papers.title: STAR: Sparse Tactile Representation Learning in Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Models for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation requires coordinated multi-finger control and effective tactile feedback, yet learning these capabilities remains challenging due to the lack of large-scale real-world data and the difficulty of extracting effective representations from sparse tactile signals. We build a robot platform and teleoperation system to collect a 200-hour bimanual dexterous manipulation dataset with synchronized visual, tactile, and language annotations, comprising 10,576 trajectories across 65 tasks, 69.5% of which involve dexterous multi-finger manipulation. We further propose STAR, an integrated training recipe for vision-tactile-language-action (VTLA) models that addresses the spatial, temporal, and informational sparsity of tactile signals through visual-tactile joint pre-training, sparse-global tactile token representation, and sparse future tactile prediction. Trained on this dataset, STAR achieves a 61% average success rate across four real-world tasks with 100 post-training trajectories per task, demonstrating dexterous performance under task-specific post-training.

analysis.tldr: 作者搭建了双手机器人遥操作平台，采集了200小时带视觉、触觉、语言标注的灵巧操作数据集（10576条轨迹），并提出STAR模型，用视觉-触觉联合预训练、稀疏触觉token表征和稀疏未来触觉预测来解决触觉信号稀疏问题，在4个真实任务上微调后达到61%平均成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建首个大规模同步视觉-触觉-语言-动作数据集，并设计针对触觉稀疏性的VTLA联合建模范式，可显著提升真实场景下多指灵巧操作的泛化性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+稀疏触觉信号（来自GelSight类传感器）+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双手机器人平台（含多指灵巧手+GelSight触觉传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部模型性能基于其自建200小时真机遥操作数据，未使用任何公开触觉数据集或仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HiFi-UMI/ALOHA级分量：首次发布百小时级同步VTLA真机数据集（远超FTP-1/OMNITACTUNE的触觉数据规模），且在4个真实灵巧任务上验证有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨机体/跨传感器泛化，也未与SOTA基线（如ACT、Diffusion Policy）做公平对比，故略低于ALOHA/ACT的96分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：高质量数据基建+针对性触觉表征设计带来真实灵巧操作实质性提升，但缺乏开源与系统性基线对比，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Size Doesn't Matter: Material-State Reinforcement Learning for Excavator Transferable Soil Manipulation
papers.abstract: Earthmoving tasks such as excavation, backfilling, or embankment construction require deliberate repositioning of deformable soil. For these tasks, human operators use all shovel faces, while autonomous systems so far are limited to excavation and dumping. Current methods often rely on heuristic models but do not incorporate soil mechanics. We address this shortcoming by using Reinforcement Learning in a GPU-parallelized Material Point Method particle simulation. Our controllers are conditioned on material state such as shape and compactness, enabling skills that use multiple contact faces of the tool and displace material both inside and outside of the shovel. To use the same learned weights across machines, our policies operate in a normalized end-effector space and are deployed through a calibrated machine interface. We evaluate this calibrated transfer on an 11.5t hydraulic excavator and a 500g tabletop robot.
