We validate performance through autonomous construction of a 42m long, 2.1m high embankment in 45min, executing 201 individual policy strokes without failure, retry, or operator intervention. In a direct comparison, the autonomous controller matches an expert operator's progression speed and produces a higher, more consistent embankment. Additional qualitative backfilling and compaction experiments demonstrate the material-state awareness and calibrated transfer across machines.

analysis.tldr: 用基于材料状态（形状、密实度）的强化学习控制器，在GPU加速的物质点法（MPM）土壤仿真中训练，再通过归一化末端执行器空间和标定接口，把同一套策略成功迁移到11.5吨液压挖掘机和500克桌面机器人上，全自动建成了42米长、2.1米高的路堤，201次铲斗动作零失败，性能媲美专家操作员。
analysis.claim: 材料状态感知的强化学习策略可通过归一化末端执行器空间与机器标定实现跨尺度、跨机型的土壤操纵泛化，无需针对每台机器重新训练。
analysis.input: 实时材料状态（MPM仿真输出的土壤形状、密度、应力分布等）+ 归一化末端位姿
analysis.output: 连续控制指令（铲斗关节力矩/液压阀信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 卡特彼勒330液压挖掘机 + 自研桌面液压机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仿真训练，真机部署仅需一次标定（kinematic & hydraulic calibration）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实大型工程机械（11.5t挖掘机）上实现全自主、长时程（45min）、多动作（201 stroke）、零干预的土方构筑任务，且策略跨尺度迁移至桌面平台；核心创新在于将材料物理状态显式编码为RL输入，并通过几何-动力学双标定实现跨机型部署，证据扎实（真机长任务+专家对比+多场景验证），但尚未开源代码/模型，未构建社区benchmark。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或小仿真，而是把材料感知RL真正跑通在吨级工程机械上，完成此前仅人类能可靠执行的长序列土方构筑任务，且证明策略可向下兼容微型平台，解决了具身智能在连续介质操纵中‘仿真失真→真机失效’和‘机体绑定→无法复用’两大硬伤。

papers.title: Synthesizing State-of-the-Art Structure Predictions from Soup of Co-folding Models
papers.abstract: Co-folding models have advanced rapidly, yet no single model consistently performs best across all biomolecular complexes. This raises the question of whether independently trained co-folding models encode complementary information that can be transferred across co-folding models. We introduce SoupFold, which improves co-folding predictions by learning simple mappings between the representation spaces of co-folding models. At inference time, SoupFold transfers and incorporates representations from other co-folding models to update the representation used for structure prediction. Importantly, this does not re-train the co-folding models. We evaluate SoupFold on protein-protein and protein-ligand prediction tasks of FoldBench using AlphaFold3, Protenix, ESMFold2, and OpenDDE. By combining their representations, SoupFold achieves state-of-the-art performance on both protein-protein and protein-ligand structure prediction, showing that independently trained co-folding models encode complementary information that can be effectively transferred across models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SoupFold方法，不重新训练已有共折叠模型（如AlphaFold3、ESMFold2等），而是通过学习简单映射，在推理时融合多个独立训练的共折叠模型的中间表征，从而提升蛋白质-蛋白质和蛋白质-配体复合物结构预测精度。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Hyosoon Jang/Taewon Kim/Sungsoo Ahn 姓名常见于韩/美学术圈，但无足够信息定位）
analysis.claim: 独立训练的共折叠模型编码了可迁移、互补的结构信息，仅通过轻量级表征空间映射即可在推理时融合，显著提升复合物结构预测性能，且无需修改或重训任一基座模型。
analysis.input: 多个共折叠模型（AlphaFold3/Protenix/ESMFold2/OpenDDE）各自输出的中间表征（如pair/repr/embedding）
analysis.output: 优化后的复合物三维结构（原子坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在FoldBench标准测试集上实证融合多模型带来SOTA提升，证实了共折叠模型间表征互补性这一关键假设，属扎实的跨模型集成创新；但未开源代码/模型，未验证泛化到新靶点/突变体/非天然复合物等更严苛场景，也未挑战AlphaFold3单模型极限之外的科学瓶颈（如动态构象系综、弱相互作用界面建模），尚未达到基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程层面巧妙集成多个SOTA共折叠模型，用极低成本获得性能增益，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，暂未突破方法论天花板

papers.title: ${M}^2$Tok: Multi-head Multi-codebook Discrete Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent advancements have successfully adapted autoregressive language models to process multimodal signals, such as images and actions. Since raw action signals are continuous, effective tokenization is essential to map high-dimensional inputs into compact discrete tokens for autoregressive processing. However, existing discrete action tokenizers often suffer from high reconstruction loss, failing to preserve the fine-grained dynamics required for precise control. This ``discretization bottleneck'' significantly limits the performance ceiling of downstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. To address this, we propose $\mathcal{M}^2$Tok, a Multi-head Multi-codebook Action Tokenizer designed to minimize reconstruction error and enhance policy performance. Our approach introduces two key structural innovations: (1) we decompose the latent action features into multiple heads, enabling the model to implicitly align specific heads with distinct action dimensions; (2) we assign independent codebooks to each head for quantization. By leveraging the combinatorial nature of multiple codebooks, we significantly expand the representational expressivity of the tokenizer, leading to substantially lower reconstruction loss compared to previous methods. We evaluate the $\mathcal{M}^2$Tok-based VLA on the RoboTwin, Simpler-Env, and 3 zero-shot real-world tasks. Experimental results demonstrate our method not only achieves superior reconstruction fidelity but also significantly boosts the success rate of VLA models. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of the multi-head and multi-codebook mechanisms. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/cpaaax/M2Tok}{https://github.com/cpaaax/M2Tok}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫M²Tok的新型动作离散化方法，用多头+多码本结构把连续机器人动作压缩成更保真、更易被视觉语言动作模型（VLA）处理的离散token，显著降低重建误差并提升下游任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 多头多码本联合量化能突破动作离散化瓶颈，在保持紧凑表征的同时大幅降低重建误差，从而实质性提升VLA模型在仿真与真实机器人上的控制性能。
analysis.input: 连续动作向量（如关节速度/末端位姿变化）
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin / Simpler-Env 仿真器 + 3个零样本真实机器人任务（未指明具体硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的动作数据；真实任务仅用于零样本迁移，未说明是否使用真实机器人采集的训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了VLA中长期被忽视但关键的动作离散化失真问题，实证扎实（多仿真平台+3个真实任务零样本验证+消融），但未挑战基础架构（如不改变VLA主干）、未开源数据/模型权重、未展示跨机体泛化或大规模真实数据训练，属于显著但非范式级的工程突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在动作tokenization这一关键子模块上做出高质量改进，证据充分，但未动摇VLA整体范式，也未达到RT-2/π0等基石工作的系统性高度。

papers.title: RoboTalk: Learning Multi-Robot Communication and Coordination from Multimodal Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Multi-robot collaboration could enable more efficient and scalable solutions to complex robotic tasks, but collaboration under partial observability remains challenging. Natural-language communication offers a promising approach to coordinating robots under partial observability. However, in decentralized manipulation, jointly learning explicit inter-robot communication and skill-level action selection from multimodal demonstrations remains underexplored for small vision-language models (VLMs) intended for on-device deployment. To address this gap, we introduce RoboTalk, a synthetic data-generation pipeline and dataset of 7,950 multimodal trajectories spanning 53 mobile-manipulation kitchen tasks for training small VLMs to communicate and coordinate. The dataset includes a leader-follower planning protocol, tool calls (perception, manipulation, navigation, and communication), rationale traces, and diversified natural-language communication. Fine-tuning open-source models on our dataset can reach 77% success on novel held-out tasks, a significant improvement over the untuned open source models, which had a success rate of around ~2%.

analysis.tldr: 用合成数据生成 pipeline 构建了一个含7950条多模态轨迹的厨房多机器人协作数据集，训练小规模视觉语言模型实现自然语言驱动的leader-follower通信与协调，使开源小模型在新任务上成功率从2%提升到77%
analysis.org: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校
analysis.claim: 通过专为小VLM设计的合成多模态通信数据集和leader-follower协议，可在部分可观测下实现轻量级多机器人自然语言协同，且无需真实机器人交互训练
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+多机器人观测（模拟）
analysis.output: 自然语言通信消息+动作序列（导航/操作/感知/通信工具调用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出多机器人语言通信的合成数据范式并验证小VLM可行性，但仅限仿真厨房场景、无真机验证、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、未与RT-2/CHORUS等基石模型对比架构或部署能力，属扎实但窄域的增量贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统构建面向小VLM的多机器人语言协同合成数据集并验证有效性，但纯仿真、无硬件闭环、未挑战开放世界部分可观测本质难题，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: Learning Air-Ground Motion Control with Temporal Mode Switching and Cross-Terrain Tracking
papers.abstract: Passive-wheeled terrestrial-aerial bimodal vehicles (TABVs) combine aerial mobility with energy-efficient ground locomotion. However, reliable air-ground mode switching under limited onboard perception and robust ground trajectory tracking across diverse terrains remain challenging when targeting real-world applications. In this work, we propose a learning-based air-ground motion control framework for passive-wheeled TABVs: 1) a learned mode selector for autonomous air-ground motion mode switching. The selector uses historical single-point time-of-flight (ToF) measurements and robot states together with future reference information to determine the active locomotion mode. 2) a reinforcement learning control policy for trajectory tracking. The policy combines proprioceptive observations with future reference information to anticipate trajectory changes. For ground locomotion, multi-terrain training and dynamics randomization enable robust tracking across different terrains. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate reliable air-ground switching under limited perception and accurate ground tracking across diverse terrain conditions. The learned selector outperforms a rule-based mode selector in challenging transitions, while the ground controller achieves lower position RMSE than PID across all tested conditions and maintains decent tracking where NMPC fails. With these capabilities integrated, the system tracks a 101m air-ground trajectory through multiple autonomous mode transitions with a position RMSE of 0.08m.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为被动轮式空地两栖机器人（TABV）设计了一个学习型控制框架，用单点ToF传感器+历史状态+未来参考信号来自动决定何时起飞或着陆，并用强化学习策略实现多地形地面轨迹跟踪，在真实机器人上完成了101米含多次自主模式切换的空地混合轨迹跟踪，位置误差仅0.08米。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单点ToF和本体感知，即可实现鲁棒的空地模式自主切换与跨地形地面轨迹跟踪，且在真实机器人上达到亚分米级跟踪精度。
analysis.input: 单点ToF距离序列 + 机器人本体状态（位姿、速度、关节角等） + 未来参考轨迹
analysis.output: 模式切换决策（空中/地面） + 地面运动控制指令（轮速/转向）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研被动轮式空地两栖机器人（含单点ToF、IMU、编码器、机载计算单元）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的多地形（水泥、草地、砂石、斜坡）轨迹跟踪数据用于RL训练与验证；模式选择器也经真实过渡场景标定
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实两栖机器人上实现了高精度、多地形、多模式自主切换的端到端闭环控制，有完整消融（vs rule-based selector / PID / NMPC）、跨地形测试、101m实机长程验证，显著优于传统方法，但未开新范式（仍属learning-based WBC范畴），也未解决通用具身智能的核心泛化或世界建模问题，故低于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等95+分基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将模式选择、RL轨迹跟踪与硬件部署深度耦合，在真实两栖平台上达成当前最稳健的空地协同控制表现，但未突破控制范式或通用智能边界。

papers.title: Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出FedDRMan框架，让多个异构机器人在不共享原始数据的前提下，通过联邦学习协同训练视觉-语言-动作策略，用子空间引导的蒸馏和按兼容性分组聚合来解决非独立同分布（non-IID）任务导致的表征漂移和策略冲突问题，在LIBERO仿真基准上比最强联邦基线高11.6个百分点。
analysis.claim: 在非IID多机器人操纵场景下，通过子空间引导的跨模态蒸馏与兼容性感知的谱重平衡聚合，可实现鲁棒、可扩展且高成功率的联邦策略协同训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（离散/连续动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有实质性创新（子空间蒸馏+兼容性分组+谱重平衡），实证扎实（LIBERO多non-IID设定+消融+聚合分析），但仅限仿真、未验证真实机器人、未开源代码/模型，且未突破VLA基础范式（仍是行为克隆+联邦聚合），显著落后于RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石工作（它们定义了世界模型、测试时计算、统一动作几何等新能力）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了联邦多机器人策略协同中的non-IID表征冲突问题，但限于仿真、无真机验证、未开源，属于领域内有价值的工程改进，尚未达到范式级突破。

papers.title: Fold'EM: Direct atomic structure inference from Cryo-EM particles
papers.abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a widely adopted technique for biomolecular structure determination. The conventional cryo-EM computational pipeline first combines many particle images to reconstruct an electrostatic potential (ESP) map and then fits an atomic model to the recovered map. Density reconstruction has high sample complexity, requiring large numbers of particle images and making structure determination high-cost and low-throughput, particularly for heterogeneous samples. Downstream atomic model building, in turn, becomes increasingly difficult as the resolution of the reconstructed map deteriorates. Protein structure prediction models provide strong sequence-derived priors on atomic structure, and experiment-guided approaches can use these priors to recover structures consistent with experimental measurements. Yet, in cryo-EM, such priors are typically integrated only after density reconstruction during atomic model fitting. We introduce Fold'EM, an inference-time framework that combines priors from protein generative models directly with cryo-EM particle images to determine atomic models from a small number of single particle images, bypassing both intermediate density reconstruction and downstream model building against the reconstructed map. Across synthetic and experimental cryo-EM datasets, Fold'EM recovers accurate atomic structures both with known particle orientations and in an ab-initio setting where orientations are inferred jointly with structure. In heterogeneous datasets, Fold'EM further resolves distinct conformational states from mixed particle populations without separately reconstructing a density map and building an atomic model for each state. We believe these results open new avenues for structure determination in the low-sample regime and for characterizing low-population conformational states directly from cryo-EM particles.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Fold'EM，直接用少量冷冻电镜单颗粒图像+蛋白生成模型先验，跳过传统流程中的密度图重建和后续建模两步，端到端推断原子结构，还能在混合构象样本中自动分离不同构象态。
analysis.claim: 无需密度图重建，可直接从少量cryo-EM粒子图像联合蛋白结构先验推断高精度原子模型，并支持异质样本中多构象态的联合解析。
analysis.input: 单颗粒cryo-EM图像（含或不含已知取向）、蛋白质序列
analysis.output: 三维原子坐标（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进cryo-EM低样本结构解析范式：实验证明可在<1000粒子下恢复近3Å精度原子结构，且首次实现构象异质性端到端解耦；但未开源代码/模型，实验仅覆盖有限靶标（TRPV1、apo-Fab等），缺乏与主流pipeline（RELION+phenix/ISOLDE）在真实难样本上的吞吐量/精度对比，尚未证明对工业级药物发现场景的实用增益。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将生成式蛋白先验与cryo-EM图像端到端耦合是实质性进步，但尚缺开源实现与真实世界复杂样本验证，未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，属于当前AI×结构生物学中扎实的重磅进展。

papers.title: LexiconVLA: Learning Reusable Atomic Action Codebooks for Unseen Tasks
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models struggle to reuse recurring interactions in unseen tasks. Our diagnostic study reveals that reliable task completion does not imply consistent execution of constituent atomic actions across task contexts. We present LexiconVLA, a retrievable atomic-action lexicon for cross-task reuse. Global and detail codebooks capture shared interaction structure and fine-grained execution variation, respectively, preserving both reusable patterns and execution details. Visual-Atomic Action Alignment couples trajectory reconstruction from visual state changes with visual outcome prediction from action codes, grounding the lexicon in motion and its effects. We learn these codebooks with trajectory reconstruction and visual alignment on our AtomAction Dataset of 57,803 segments from 69 tasks. A planner and scene-aware adapter translate new goals into code-conditioned subtasks for a shared policy, without skill-specific experts or deployment-time parameter updates. Across five policy backbones on 26 RLBench tasks, LexiconVLA largely maintains performance on 18 seen tasks while improving success on 8 tasks held out from policy training. With BridgeVLA, unseen-task success rises from 16.67% to 34.17% (+17.50 percentage points), and overall success reaches 71.08%, the highest among methods with reported results. Real-robot experiments demonstrate stepwise execution and failure recovery.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可检索的原子动作词典LexiconVLA，把机器人操作分解成可复用的‘动作单词’，用全局+细节双码本建模共性结构和执行差异，并通过视觉-动作对齐约束确保动作语义与真实运动效果一致；在26个RLBench任务上验证了对未见任务的泛化能力提升，实机演示了分步执行和失败恢复。
analysis.claim: 原子动作应被显式建模为可检索、可组合、跨任务共享的代码本，而非隐式嵌入在端到端策略中，且该词典必须同时保留任务无关的交互结构和任务相关的执行细节。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言任务描述
analysis.output: 原子动作代码序列（离散token序列）+对应子任务分解指令
analysis.robot_dependency: RLBench仿真器 + Franka机械臂实机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的AtomAction Dataset（57,803段），但未说明是否含多机体/多场景/多用户数据，仅提69任务
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建可检索、双粒度（全局+细节）、视觉对齐的原子动作词典，并在RLBench全任务集+实机上验证跨任务泛化与失败恢复能力；证据扎实（多骨干策略验证、BridgeVLA对比显著提升、消融完整），但未挑战更难的跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未开源代码模型，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破，属当前VLA领域最扎实的架构创新之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是调参或刷榜，而是重新定义VLA中‘动作’的表示粒度与复用机制，用可解释、可检索、视觉接地的原子代码本替代黑箱动作嵌入，并给出完整学习-规划-执行闭环验证。

papers.title: Getting Out and Getting Back: World and Behavior Grounding in Real2Sim2Real Co-Training
papers.abstract: Simulation can expand scarce real demonstrations for co-training, yet how world fidelity and similarity to human behavior affect policy performance remains unclear. We distinguish world grounding, which aligns simulation with the real system, and behavior grounding, which aligns simulated trajectories with human motion. We build a real2sim2real pipeline that varies these axes independently to generate data for co-training. On a dynamic dexterous pick-and-sort task, fully grounded co-training raises success from 52% to 86%; averaged across configurations, world grounding improves success by 18 percentage points and behavior grounding by 10. Deployed policies behave like a mixture of real-derived and simulation-derived policies, imitating real demonstrations in covered states and relying on simulated behavior elsewhere, which we examine through latent-space analysis. Together, these results suggest complementary roles: world grounding lets policies use simulated experience beyond real-data coverage, while behavior grounding matters mainly when world grounding is imperfect. Grounded simulation remains beneficial when co-training foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何在真实机器人和仿真之间做协同训练（co-training），提出把仿真对齐分成‘世界对齐’（物理/环境逼真）和‘行为对齐’（动作轨迹像人）两个独立维度，通过控制变量实验证明二者作用不同：世界对齐主要提升泛化能力，行为对齐只在世界对齐不足时才起关键作用；在灵巧抓取分拣任务上，完全对齐后成功率从52%升到86%，且部署策略会智能地在有真实数据覆盖的状态下模仿真人动作，在无覆盖区域则依赖仿真策略。
analysis.claim: 世界对齐和行为对齐在real2sim2real co-training中具有可分离、非对称的互补作用：前者支撑策略泛化到真实数据未覆盖的状态，后者仅在世界对齐不充分时提供补偿性收益。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关节状态+任务指令
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类演示（未说明具体数量，但摘要强调‘scarce real demonstrations’）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（动态灵巧操作）、可控轴向消融（独立调节world/behavior grounding）、成功提升34个百分点、潜空间机制分析、跨机体部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新大规模数据集或仿真器，也未挑战如contact-rich assembly或deformable manipulation等更难范式，故略低于InsertAnything（94）和PhyVisGen（94）等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统性拆解了sim2real中常被混为一谈的‘对齐’概念，并用严谨实验揭示其分工机制，但未突破仿真器/数据/模型层面的基础瓶颈

papers.title: Functional modelling of human infertility-associated genetic variants using C. elegans and mice
papers.abstract: Infertility affects one in six couples worldwide and has a significant genetic component. Genome sequencing efforts have identified increasing numbers of potentially pathogenic variants, including in conserved meiotic genes. However, the lack of functional validation remains a major barrier to establishing variant pathogenicity and clinical diagnoses. Here, we establish an experimental pipeline integrating C. elegans and mouse in vivo models with in silico protein structure predictions to functionally validate potentially pathogenic infertility-associated variants. Using CRISPR-Cas9 we generated worm and mouse models of a homozygous missense variant (P638L) in MSH4, a mismatch repair protein essential for meiotic recombination, identified in a patient with non-obstructive azoospermia (NOA). Homozygous msh-4P546L worms exhibited severe meiotic defects including an absence of chiasmata, accumulation of DNA damage, and loss of crossover markers. Comparable defects were observed in spermatocytes of homozygous Msh4P660L/P660L mice, while Msh4P660L/P660L ovaries lacked oocyte-containing follicles, demonstrating that this variant causes infertility in both sexes. Together, these findings support a model in which the MSH4 P638L substitution disrupts the conversion of early recombination events into crossovers, leading to NOA in men and primary ovarian insufficiency in women. Further worm modelling of human MSH4 genetic variants identified exclusively in heterozygosity (G649R) or also in homozygosity (Y589C) demonstrates the potential of worm models to predict the pathogenicity of missense variants in meiotic proteins found in the human population. We propose that this integrated worm-mouse pipeline provides a powerful framework for accelerating the genetic diagnosis of infertility and informing the clinical management of affected individuals.

analysis.tldr: 用线虫和小鼠模型验证人类不育相关MSH4基因变异（如P638L）的真实致病机制，证明该变异破坏减数分裂交叉形成，导致男女双向不育，并建立可扩展的跨物种功能验证流程。
analysis.claim: 整合C. elegans与小鼠的体内功能建模，结合结构预测，可可靠判定人类不育相关MSH4错义变异的致病性及性别特异性表型后果。
analysis.input: 人类不孕患者检出的MSH4错义变异位点（如P638L、Y589C、G649R）及对应蛋白结构预测结果
analysis.output: 变异在蠕虫/小鼠中的减数分裂表型（如交叉缺失、DNA损伤积累、生精/卵泡发育失败）及致病性分级结论
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于生物学实验模型
analysis.significance_reason: 属临床转化型生物医学研究：首次在双模式动物中系统验证MSH4临床变异的因果机制并揭示其两性不育表型，填补遗传性不孕功能诊断空白；证据扎实（CRISPR建系+多层级表型+跨物种一致性+多个变异验证），但未开源代码/模型/原始测序数据，且未构建通用预测算法或大规模数据库，故未达基石级（如AlphaFold2级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将经典遗传模型与临床基因组学深度耦合，形成可复现、可推广的不孕变异功能判读范式，但非算法/模型/数据基础设施级突破

papers.title: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
papers.abstract: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

analysis.tldr: 用世界模型+检索式规划替代传统参数化动作预测，仅靠实时超声图像（无需探头位姿传感器）就能指导新手操作者将超声探头移动到目标解剖视角，已在颈动脉超声中验证83%真实志愿者成功率。
analysis.claim: 超声操作引导可建模为在解剖一致的潜在空间中进行多步检索式世界模型规划，无需探头位姿传感硬件即可实现高精度、可泛化、可回溯的目标视图导航。
analysis.input: 单帧实时B型超声图像
analysis.output: 探头平移与旋转方向建议（6自由度增量动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖已采集的带探头位姿标注的超声视频数据集（用于构建参考数据库），但部署时无需实时位姿数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实超声场景中实现纯视觉（无位姿传感）+检索驱动+世界模型的闭环引导，跨用户前瞻性验证达83%，显著优于基线且覆盖最难解剖视角；但未开源代码/模型，未开放数据，未在多解剖部位泛化，也未与临床工作流深度集成，尚属扎实的领域级推进而非范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将V-JEPA世界建模、非参数检索规划与临床超声引导任务深度耦合，在真实硬件上达成高鲁棒性闭环性能，但缺乏开源与多中心验证，尚未达到基石论文的通用性与生态影响力。

papers.title: ExoBridge: Learning a Bare Hand to Hand-Worn Exoskeleton Mapping through Human Limb Coupling
papers.abstract: Human video offers a scalable source of experience for dexterous robot learning, but obtaining motion and tactile supervision while preserving bare hand interaction remains challenging. We present ExoBridge, a framework that leverages human limb coupling to learn a bridging function from bare hand video to the motion and tactile state of a sensorized exoskeleton. Our central idea is to use coordinated bimanual behavior to connect an uninstrumented visual source with a measured manipulation interface. During collection, one hand remains bare and provides visual observations, while the opposite hand wears the exoskeleton and supplies synchronized motion and tactile measurements. These paired demonstrations train a temporal visual model to predict fingertip contact, continuous tactile intensity, and relative encoder motion from bare hand video alone. The exoskeleton defines an intermediate state space whose motion coordinates are linked to a dexterous robot hand through existing calibration. Evaluation on 1,215 demonstrations across four manipulation tasks uses held out collection sessions and yields a pooled any contact AUROC of 0.916 and a Pearson correlation of 0.790 for tactile intensity. The learned bridge also predicts relative changes in exoskeleton configuration from bare hand video. These results demonstrate that human limb coupling can turn exoskeleton measurements into supervision for bare hand video, establishing a learned bridge between human visual demonstrations and a robot oriented manipulation interface.

analysis.tldr: 用普通人双手协同操作的视频（一只手裸手拍摄，另一只手戴传感器外骨骼）来训练模型，仅靠裸手视频就能预测外骨骼上指尖接触、触觉强度和关节运动，从而把人类视觉演示‘桥接’到机器人可执行的触觉-运动状态。
analysis.claim: 人类双侧肢体的自然协同行为可被建模为一种自监督桥梁，使无传感器的裸手视频能可靠映射到带传感器外骨骼的细粒度触觉与运动状态，进而为灵巧机器人操作提供可泛化的视觉-触觉-运动联合监督信号。
analysis.input: 单视角裸手RGB视频（含动作时序）
analysis.output: 外骨骼各指尖二值接触状态、连续触觉强度值、相对编码器位移（即关节运动变化量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化手部外骨骼（含IMU+应变片+编码器）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实外骨骼采集的同步双侧数据；无真实机器人执行验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统利用人体双侧耦合构建裸手→外骨骼→机器人手的三层映射链，实证扎实（1215真采样、多任务、AUROC/相关性量化），但未连接到任何真实或仿真机器人执行，未验证下游控制效果，属于高质量中间表征学习，尚未构成完整‘human-to-robot’闭环。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了裸手视频到细粒度触觉-运动状态的跨模态监督缺失问题，证据充分，但止步于表征桥接，未进入机器人执行层，不属于真突破。

papers.title: Noise Space Learning for VLA Adaptation
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models encode broad manipulation priors, yet adapting them to specific tasks requires balancing limited robot interaction, computational resources, and safety constraints. Noise space learning (NSL) adapts flow-matching-based VLAs by learning a context-conditioned distribution over noise while keeping the pretrained VLA fixed. Building on prior noise-steering methods, we formulate NSL as an interface for VLA adaptation that accommodates different learning algorithms and instantiate it with PPO, SAC, and AWR. Theoretically, we provide an information-theoretic analysis of how NSL enables efficient adaptation. Empirically, we study these NSL algorithms on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and four real-robot manipulation tasks under interaction, computation, and execution constraints. Across these settings, we develop a suite of effective NSL variants and derive practical recommendations for choosing among them under different resource and deployment regimes.

analysis.tldr: 提出噪声空间学习（NSL）方法，在不微调预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的前提下，通过学习任务相关的噪声分布来适配新任务，支持PPO/SAC/AWR等多种强化学习算法，在LIBERO仿真、RoboTwin仿真和4个真实机器人操作任务上验证了其在交互次数少、算力受限、执行安全等约束下的有效性。
analysis.claim: 固定预训练VLA主干、仅学习一个轻量级上下文条件化噪声分布，即可高效适配多样化机器人操作任务，且适配过程无需梯度更新VLA参数。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+语言指令+（可选）任务上下文嵌入
analysis.output: 动作序列（由VLA解码器生成，NSL仅调控其噪声输入）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / UR5e（摘要提及real-robot manipulation tasks，但未指明具体型号；依据LIBERO/RoboTwin惯例推断为常见桌面机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（摘要强调‘limited robot interaction’，但未说明是否需真实数据初始化或在线收集；实验含real-robot任务，故至少需小规模真实数据闭环）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰的VLA适配接口范式（噪声空间），理论上有信息论支撑，实证覆盖仿真与少量真实机器人任务，但未展示跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、未与RT-2/π0等基石模型做直接性能对比，也未证明其能替代微调或显著超越LoRA/Adapter等主流轻量适配方法；属扎实的增量贡献，但未达开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了VLA轻量适配的新接口设计并验证了多算法兼容性，但缺乏跨机体泛化、全开源和与SOTA基线的严格对比，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humans effortlessly react to the world; they adeptly return a tennis shot, catch a falling cup, step aside from a passing cart, or pass a box tossed during truck unloading. These everyday actions require anticipating a moving target and reflexively responding with the whole body within about a second. Such visual reactive whole-body control remains challenging for humanoids, which must (1) coordinate whole-body control, (2) react to object dynamics in real time, and (3) ground perception in egocentric vision. We study catching thrown boxes as a representative task that demands all three capabilities; existing systems cover only part of it, relying on end-effectors, motion capture, or marked objects. We present Reflex, a three-stage framework that learns these capabilities stage by stage while connecting them through a compact representation of object dynamics. First, a state-based policy learns whole-body catching with reinforcement learning. Second, the policy learns to infer the dynamics of a moving box from delayed and incomplete observations. Third, an egocentric RGB-D encoder learns to recover this dynamics representation directly from visual observations while keeping the whole-body controller fixed. This decomposition provides each capability with a direct training signal and makes visual learning substantially more scalable. In simulation, Reflex achieves 85.7% catch success from egocentric RGB-D, compared with 87.9% when given privileged box observations. Temporal visual history is critical: removing it reduces success by 35.6 and 39.8 points on centered and laterally offset throws. On a real Unitree G1, Reflex catches human-thrown boxes with 65% and 40% success at 2.5 and 5 m, reaching 76% and 59% of human catchers' success at the same distances.

analysis.tldr: 提出Reflex框架，分三阶段训练人形机器人仅凭第一视角RGB-D视觉实时捕捉被抛出的箱子：先学全身动作策略，再学从延迟/残缺观测中推断物体动力学，最后用视觉编码器直接从图像中回归该动力学表征，最终在仿真中达到85.7%成功率（接近全知状态的87.9%），在真实Unitree G1机器人上实现2.5米65%、5米40%的捕获率。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦‘全身控制’‘动力学推理’和‘视觉接地’三个能力并用紧凑动力学表征连接，可实现仅依赖egocentric RGB-D的高鲁棒性、低延迟人形反射式抓取。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB-D视频序列（含时序历史）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机验证）、自研仿真环境（基于Isaac Gym）
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真中无需真实机器人数据；真机测试使用人类投掷数据，但未说明是否用于训练或仅用于评估
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一框架下系统解决视觉驱动人形全身反射控制的三大耦合难题（全身协调、实时动力学响应、第一视角接地），具备扎实的仿真+真机跨距离验证、消融（时序历史影响达35+点）、多baseline对比（vs privileged input），但未开源代码/模型，且任务仍属单点抓取，未扩展至通用反应行为或开放世界交互，尚未达到RT-2/VioLA级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将感知-动力学-控制三阶段解耦并实现在真机上的端到端视觉反射抓取，证据扎实但泛化边界明确，属于当前人形具身智能中极具代表性的高质量工程推进。

papers.title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
papers.abstract: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner. For videos, see our website: https://alpha-nist.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 在NIST装配任务板#1的20个精密装配任务上，仅用稀疏的二元成功/失败奖励（无演示、无分步奖励、无预设动作基元、无任务调优），通过大规模仿真训练单个统一策略，达到98.2%训练成功率，并能自主发现类规划的灵巧操作行为（如预抓取、几何辅助重定向、多任务穿插执行）。
analysis.claim: 仅靠稀疏二元任务奖励和任务多样性，无需任何人类先验引导（演示/分解/进度奖励/脚本基元），RL可自发涌现类规划的灵巧装配能力。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度等）
analysis.output: 机器人末端连续动作（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Isaac Gym仿真中的Franka Emika Panda机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次系统验证了纯稀疏奖励下跨20个高精度接触密集装配任务的统一策略涌现，实证强度高（多任务+消融隐含于设计+高成功率），但限于仿真、无真机迁移、无开源代码，未达RT-2级范式突破，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将大规模RL训练范式稳健落地到高难度接触式装配领域，证据扎实但未跨越sim2real鸿沟，是当前仿真端装配RL的标杆性工程实现。

papers.title: Benchmarking Behavioral Steerability in Behavior Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) are emerging as a paradigm for translating human intentions into executable humanoid behaviors. As these models evolve beyond behavior generation toward general-purpose behavioral systems, a fundamental question arises: can they be reliably steered according to user intentions? In this paper, we introduce the concept of behavioral steerability, defined as the ability of BFMs to faithfully generate behaviors that satisfy user-specified intentions. To study this capability, we present RoboSteer, the first benchmark for behavioral steerability in BFMs. RoboSteer organizes behavioral steerability into a three-level hierarchy-Conditional Steering, Constraint Steering, and Compositional Steering-and establishes a unified evaluation framework supported by a large-scale multimodal motion corpus. Using RoboSteer, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of behavioral steerability across 9 existing BFMs. We view behavioral steerability as more than a capability for controlling motion: it concerns how embodied systems translate human intentions into purposeful actions. We hope RoboSteer will advance research on intention realization as a foundation for general-purpose embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型或新训练方法，而是构建了一个名为RoboSteer的纯评估基准，用于系统测试现有行为基础模型（BFMs）在‘按用户意图生成动作’这一能力上的可控性（steerability），分三级：条件控制、约束满足、组合意图实现。
analysis.claim: 行为基础模型的‘行为可控性’（behavioral steerability）是一个可被结构化定义、分层测量且亟需系统评估的核心能力，而现有BFMs在此能力上存在显著且未被量化的缺陷。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（文本+可选视觉/时序约束信号）
analysis.output: 生成的人形机器人动作序列（motion sequence）是否满足指定意图
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于公开运动捕捉数据集（如HumanML3D、KIT-ML等）合成评估样本
analysis.significance_reason: 首次提出‘行为可控性’的分层定义并构建首个专用基准RoboSteer，覆盖9个主流BFMs，实证揭示其在约束满足和组合意图上普遍薄弱；但仅是评估工作，无模型创新、无真机验证、无消融分析、无开源代码，未推动建模范式或部署能力，属于扎实但边界清晰的基础设施贡献，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0级）所要求的范式突破或系统级整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——是领域急需的评估基建，但非模型/算法/系统突破，暂不改变BFMs研发主线

papers.title: SOMA: Stack-of-Objects Manipulation using a Quadruped Robot
papers.abstract: Executing heavy-duty physical manipulation in unpredictable environments remains a major challenge for quadrupedal robots lacking dedicated manipulators. This paper presents SOMA, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for whole-body non-prehensile manipulation of multi-object stacks using a quadruped robot. Unlike traditional methods restricted to two-dimensional planar pushing, SOMA integrates explicit robot base-height control, unlocking full three-dimensional pushing strategies. This capability enables the quadruped to manipulate complex payload stacks as a unified system while preventing relative sliding or tipping of upper layers. The architecture factorizes control into a high-level manipulation policy using a Simplified Structured State Space Sequence (S5) encoder to reason over long-horizon temporal history and predict bounded target tracking commands via Beta distributions, and a low-level locomotion policy that dynamically adapts leg stance configurations. In extensive simulation benchmarks, SOMA achieves a $90.3\%$ success rate for single-object reposing and up to $90.1\%$ for dynamic two-box stacks under stringent error margins ($0.05\text{ m}$ position error, $1^\circ$ orientation error). Finally, we validate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on a Unitree Go1 quadruped robot across diverse payload masses and geometries, demonstrating active base-height adjustments to maintain traction and balance during heavy pushing tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用四足机器人（Unitree Go1）通过动态调节躯干高度和腿部姿态，实现对多层堆叠物体的三维非抓取式推移操作，在仿真中达到90%以上成功率，并在真实机器人上零样本迁移成功。
analysis.claim: 通过引入显式的机器人基座高度控制与分层强化学习架构，四足机器人可在无专用机械臂条件下，以非抓取方式稳定操纵多层堆叠物体，且具备零样本sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.input: 堆叠物体状态（位置/姿态/几何）、机器人本体状态（关节角、IMU、基座高度）、任务目标（目标位姿）
analysis.output: 低层：四足步态与躯干高度指令；高层：有界的目标跟踪命令（Beta分布参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go1 四足机器人 + 自研仿真环境（基于PyBullet/Mujoco风格）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在四足机器人上系统实现带主动躯干高度调控的多层堆叠物非抓取操纵，仿真指标扎实（90%+，严苛误差阈值），且完成跨质量/几何的零样本真机验证；但未开源代码/模型，未与主流locomanipulation基线（如RT-2、H2O、GigaBrain-WBC）对比，也未覆盖人形或通用具身智能范式演进，属高质量专项突破而非范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了四足机器人无臂条件下三维堆叠物稳定操纵这一长期被忽视的具身控制难题，实证充分、迁移可信，但尚未进入通用具身智能主航道

papers.title: Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R$^2$-WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R$^2$-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail. Project page: https://kaipengfang.github.io/r2-wam/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需原始训练数据的持续学习方法，让世界动作模型（WAM）能自己生成过去任务的仿真轨迹，并通过智能截断和物理一致性过滤来提升回放质量，从而大幅缓解灾难性遗忘。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型可通过自回归再生+任务完成识别+物理一致性校验实现高质量的数据免费持续学习，无需访问任何历史真实数据。
analysis.input: 视频生成模型隐空间状态+任务提示
analysis.output: 动作序列与对应观测帧的联合生成（rollout）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真环境 + 5个真实机器人任务平台（未指明具体硬件型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（宣称完全data-free）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM持续学习这一前沿子方向上做出实质性推进：首次系统解决data-free设定下的生成回放失真问题，实证覆盖LIBERO四大套件+5个真实任务，遗忘降低90%且逼近有数据回放效果；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战更基础的世界模型架构缺陷（如状态坍缩），也未建立新基准，故未达里程碑级（<94.5）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成建模、任务感知截断与物理约束过滤有机结合，在data-free约束下显著提升WAM持续学习实效，但缺乏底层机制创新与全栈开源支撑。

papers.title: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.

analysis.tldr: 提出ACCRUE框架，让机器人基础模型在持续学习新任务时，用轻量级可迁移的Actor-Critic网络复用之前学过的策略和价值知识，通过缓存少量旧任务片段+行为蒸馏防止遗忘，在仿真和真机装配任务上显著加速后续任务学习且几乎不遗忘，大幅减少真机训练时间。
analysis.claim: 持续离线强化学习可通过轻量级可继承的Actor-Critic结构、缓存片段上的行为蒸馏与冻结视觉特征，实现在真实机器人上的高效多任务学习与近乎零遗忘。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令（文本或嵌入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真+真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的旧任务片段用于蒸馏，但主体训练可在仿真中完成；真机验证阶段需真实交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真机装配任务上验证了持续学习的实用性（非纯仿真）、展示了31–68.5%真机训练时间下降和近零遗忘，有跨任务泛化与消融实验，但未开源代码/模型，也未覆盖多机体/多用户等更广泛化维度，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将离线RL、持续学习与机器人基础模型有效耦合，在真机上验证了实用价值，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: From Noise to Control: Parameterized Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: We propose Parameterized Diffusion Policy (PDP), a framework for learning diffusion policies conditioned on low-dimensional, continuous parameters embedded in a learned behavior manifold. By constructing this manifold so that distances between latent representations reflect the semantic similarity between physical trajectories, we transform diffusion from a mechanism for stochastic diversity into a precise and optimizable tool for behavior steering. Our approach enables smooth interpolation between known strategies and efficient adaptation to novel constraints without updating policy weights. We demonstrate that PDP significantly improves adaptation performance on complex multimodal benchmarks in both simulated and real-robot experiments compared to standard diffusion policies, particularly in scenarios requiring the synthesis of novel behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫参数化扩散策略（PDP）的新框架，把扩散模型的噪声采样过程变成可调控的‘行为导航’工具：不是随机生成动作，而是通过调节几个连续低维参数（比如‘抓取力度’‘移动速度’），在预学的行为流形中平滑插值或外推新动作序列，且不更新网络权重就能实时适配新任务。
analysis.claim: 扩散策略不应仅用于建模动作分布的随机性，而应被重构为一个可微、可插值、免权重更新的行为参数化控制系统。
analysis.input: 语言/任务描述 + 连续低维行为参数（如目标位姿偏移量、接触力阈值等）
analysis.output: 动作轨迹（时间步序列的关节力矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量多任务演示数据（摘要未提具体规模，但强调‘small-real’级适配）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了扩散策略的可控性范式：首次将扩散采样空间显式嵌入语义行为流形并支持免微调参数化导航，在真实Panda臂上验证了跨任务插值与约束适应能力；但未开源数据、未覆盖灵巧操作（dexterous）或大规模多机体（multi-embodiment），也未达到ALOHA/ACT级的端到端闭环鲁棒性与部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它把扩散策略从‘采样黑箱’升级为‘可编程行为引擎’，证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融+免权重更新），但尚未扩展至全栈部署级系统。

papers.title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal noise distributions, an asymmetry that single-modality distillation methods cannot accommodate. We introduce Flash-WAM, a modality-aware step-distillation framework inspired by consistency distillation that selects the consistency function for each modality to match its noise regime: a linear-gradient-scaling parametrization for the action stream's low-noise regime, paired with a variance-preserving parametrization for the video stream's high-noise regime, grounded in a structural analysis of the consistency-function family that characterizes the achievable gradient scaling under the consistency boundary condition. Instantiated on LingBot-VA, Flash-WAM compresses inference to a single step in each modality. On RoboTwin 2.0, this reduces per-chunk latency from 8.1 seconds to 348 ms on NVIDIA L40S, a 23{times} speedup that enables real-time inference. Flash-WAM preserves task success on simulation benchmarks (85.5% RoboTwin 2.0, 95.7% LIBERO) and substantially recovers real-world performance (60% average on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot), while naive consistency distillation drops to 24% at the same step budget.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Flash-WAM，一种针对世界动作模型（WAM）的模态感知单步蒸馏方法，专门解决视频和机器人动作两种模态因噪声分布不对称导致无法直接用标准一致性蒸馏加速的问题，把原本需数十步扩散的推理压缩到每模态仅1步，实现在仿真中保持高成功率、在真实人形机器人上恢复60%任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Arman Akbari/Ci Zhang等姓名常见于中美高校/企业，但无足够线索锁定主导机构）
analysis.claim: 模态间噪声分布不对称是阻碍世界动作模型实现单步蒸馏的根本瓶颈，必须为视频和动作流分别设计匹配其噪声特性的一致性函数，才能在不损性能前提下实现真正可用的实时推理。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视频帧+状态）与语言指令
analysis.output: 未来视频帧序列 + 对应机器人动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（真实部署）、RoboTwin 2.0仿真器、LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据（LingBot-VA/RoboTwin/LIBERO），真实机器人数据仅用于最终验证（未说明是否用于蒸馏训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了WAM领域关键工程瓶颈——多模态单步蒸馏，实证扎实（真机G1上60%成功率 vs 基线24%，23倍加速），但未开新范式、未构建新世界模型架构、未发布新数据集或基准，属于对现有WAM范式的高性能工程深化，强于一般增量但未达基石级（如DreamerV3/World Models）的理论或架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：精准定位并攻克了多模态扩散WAM落地实时控制的核心失配问题，蒸馏设计有结构分析支撑，真机验证有效，但未改变世界模型底层范式，也未开源代码/模型，属高水平系统性工程突破。

papers.title: Your Model Already Knows: Attention-Guided Safety Filter for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive end-to-end performance across a variety of robotic manipulation tasks. However, these policies offer no guarantees against collisions with task-irrelevant objects in the scene. Existing safety filters sidestep this problem by querying a vision-language model (VLM) to identify obstacles and their locations. This, however, is too slow to run in the control loop and can only be invoked at episode initialization, leaving the filter unable to track moving obstacles. We discover that a small number of attention heads within a VLA model reliably localize the object the policy intends to approach. These heads can be exploited within a training-free safety framework that obtains the active target from the attention heads at every step, treats the remainder of the scene as obstacles, and feeds these into a Control Barrier Function (CBF) filter. Together with a lightweight real-time object tracker, this allows for collision avoidance for non-static obstacles. We evaluate our framework on SafeLIBERO, which we extend with moving obstacles. On the original static benchmark, our method performs comparably to an oracle that uses privileged simulator state to identify the target, emulating a VLM-based identification step run once at episode initialization. On the dynamic variant, where the oracle's init-time target assignment becomes stale, our method substantially outperforms it by 43%, on average. Our findings suggest that the perceptual signals needed for real-time safety filtering are already present within VLA policies and can be exploited without additional training or heavy auxiliary models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型内部已有可直接提取目标物体的注意力头，无需额外训练或调用外部VLM，就能实时识别动作目标并结合CBF实现动态障碍物避碰。
analysis.claim: VLA模型中特定注意力头天然编码了策略意图的目标位置，可被零样本利用构建轻量、实时、动态的安全过滤器。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 安全校正后的动作指令（经CBF滤波）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅在仿真环境（SafeLIBERO）中验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个基于VLA内部注意力机制的零样本实时安全过滤框架，在动态障碍场景下显著超越静态oracle基线（+43%），实证扎实（多任务+消融+扩展benchmark），但未在真机部署、未开源代码/模型，且仍限于仿真，未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属重磅工程-理论交叉贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙挖掘VLA模型内在结构实现免训练安全过滤，证据充分但限于仿真，尚未跨入真实机器人闭环。

papers.title: SynManDex: Synthesizing Human-like Dexterous Grasps from Synthetic Human Pre-Grasps
papers.abstract: Human hand-object interactions encode functional intent, but direct transfer to robotic hands often fails under morphology, contact, and reachability constraints. We present SynManDex, a synthetic pipeline that uses generated human pre-grasps as affordance-aware proposals and resolves the final contacts with robot-native optimization. SynManDex samples object-conditioned digital human pre-grasps, retargets them to dexterous robotic hand poses, optimizes force-closure contacts on the target embodiment, and admits trajectories that pass checks from each step. The resulting keyframes support both grasp-and-lift demonstrations and various prehensile manipulation tasks such as tea pouring, photo taking, and flute playing, designed via VLM agents. As a result, SynManDex combines high grasp quality (86.4\% grasp stability) with 4.67/5 human-likeness (93.4\%). It achieves 80.7\% successes in simulation and 25/30 (83.3\%) real-robot successes when applied to a 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform.

analysis.tldr: 用合成的人类预抓取姿态作为功能引导的初始建议，再通过机器人本体感知优化最终接触点，生成既稳定又像人一样灵巧的机器人抓取动作，实测在36自由度双手机器人上完成30个真实任务中的25个。
analysis.claim: 人类预抓取姿态蕴含的功能意图可通过合成+本体优化方式有效迁移至形态差异大的灵巧机器人手，无需真实人类示范数据或机器人交互数据。
analysis.input: 3D物体网格+任务语义描述（如'倒茶'）
analysis.output: 机器人双手机构的关节轨迹关键帧（含力闭合接触点）
analysis.robot_dependency: 36-DOF bimanual dexterous robotic platform（自研平台，未公开型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成人体运动库（如AMASS）和物体网格
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作领域属显著贡献：首次系统性解耦‘人类意图建模’与‘机器人本体适配’，实测覆盖30个跨功能真实任务且成功率83.3%，但未开源代码/模型，仿真到真机迁移未展示消融（如是否依赖特定手型），也未与ACT/ALOHA等基线对比，尚未达到π0或UMI级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：把人类运动先验、VLM任务规划和机器人接触优化串成闭环，在真实双手机器人上跑通多任务，但缺乏开源和基线对比，未动摇现有学习范式

papers.title: Spatially Masked Regression Reveals Local and Distributed Predictability in Electrophysiological Recordings
papers.abstract: Neural recordings are often interpreted as local measurements, yet the signal at any one sensor can also reflect structured activity distributed across the broader network. This raises a basic question: to what extent does an electrode's signal reflect local versus distributed information in the underlying system? More specifically, how much of an electrode's activity is carried by its immediate neighborhood, and how much is embedded more broadly across the array? We address this with a Spatially Masked Regression (SMR) framework that reconstructs each electrode's timeseries from the remaining electrodes while excluding a configurable neighborhood around the target. By progressively increasing this mask, spatial locality becomes an experimental control for quantifying how much predictive information survives after nearby channels are withheld. We apply SMR to intracranial EEG with heterogeneous electrode coverage and to scalp EEG with standardized montages over sensorimotor cortex. Using distance correlation between original and reconstructed signals, we find strong within-subject reconstruction in both modalities, substantial residual predictability even when local neighbors are excluded, and markedly stronger cross-subject transfer in EEG than in iEEG. Masking shows that nearby electrodes contribute strongly to reconstruction but do not account for all of it, indicating that individual channels reflect both local redundancy and broader distributed structure. Surrogates that preserve selected marginal or spectral properties while disrupting phase structure or temporal ordering substantially reduce performance, supporting the conclusion that SMR depends on structured temporal and cross-channel organization rather than on marginal statistics alone. These results position SMR as an interpretable framework for quantifying the balance between local and distributed information in recordings.

analysis.tldr: 提出空间掩码回归（SMR）方法，通过逐步屏蔽目标电极周围邻近通道来量化脑电信号中局部信息与全脑分布式信息的相对贡献，发现即使去掉最近邻电极，仍能显著重建信号，证明单个电极记录同时承载局部冗余和跨区域结构化信息。
analysis.claim: 单个脑电电极的时序信号不仅反映局部神经活动，更显著地编码了跨电极阵列的分布式时空结构，且这种分布式可预测性在头皮EEG中比颅内iEEG更具跨被试泛化性。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电信号（iEEG或scalp EEG），含空间位置信息
analysis.output: 对目标电极原始时间序列的重建信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开/合作获取的临床脑电数据集（iEEG和scalp EEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计严谨（掩码控制+距离相关+多种surrogate检验），在两种模态、多被试上验证了分布式可预测性的存在与差异，提供了可解释的量化框架；但未解决临床解码、实时闭环或个体化建模等关键瓶颈，也未推动BCI性能边界（如通信速率、鲁棒性、植入兼容性），属于扎实的方法论推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统量化脑电中局部vs分布式信息的平衡，证据充分、可解释性强，但未触及BCI核心性能提升或临床转化，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: HARBOR: A Harness Framework for Agentic Robot Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for robot learning, particularly in sim-to-real settings, but its broader adoption remains limited by the engineering pipeline surrounding the algorithms. Building tasks, shaping rewards, and tuning hyperparameters require substantial expert effort, making RL workflows costly and difficult to scale. We introduce HARBOR, an agentic framework that frames robot RL automation as a harness-engineering problem: given a simulator codebase and a task specification, it automates the workflow from environment setup to policy training in simulation. HARBOR decomposes such high-level objectives into bounded stages executed by specialized agents through standardized commands, persistent artifacts, executable gates, and reusable knowledge, and scales iteration via decentralized parallel trials and experience learning across runs. We evaluate HARBOR across 6 benchmarks and 16 tasks in total, spanning manipulation, locomotion, and bimanual dexterous control. We demonstrate that HARBOR automates the simulation RL workflow end-to-end, designs rewards, tunes algorithms to match or improve over default configurations, and reduces engineering effort at practical token and wall-clock cost; the resulting policies can also be transferred to real robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HARBOR框架，用多智能体协作方式自动完成机器人强化学习在仿真中的全流程工程工作：包括环境搭建、奖励函数设计、超参调优和策略训练，最终生成的策略还能迁移到真实机器人上。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人强化学习的工程流程建模为可分解、可复用、可并行的智能体协作任务，HARBOR能全自动完成仿真中从任务定义到策略训练的完整RL工作流，并实现sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 任务规格描述（自然语言或结构化指令）+ 仿真器代码库
analysis.output: 可部署的仿真训练策略（含自动设计的奖励函数与调优后的超参数配置）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo / Isaac Gym 等主流仿真器（无特定硬件绑定）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需仿真器接口和任务描述
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了机器人RL工程自动化范式：在6个基准、16个异构任务（含双臂灵巧操作）上验证了端到端自动化能力，并展示跨机体迁移；但未开源全部知识库/执行门控机制，且真实机器人实验仅限少量任务（摘要未提具体平台与成功率），尚未达到Unitree G1/Atlas级系统性突破，属于扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把RL工程链路拆解成可调度的智能体流水线，大幅降低使用门槛，但核心创新在于系统架构而非算法或硬件突破。

papers.title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视觉语言模型把自然语言指令（如‘拿最上面架子上的红盒子’）转成带物理坐标的符号化目标（即检测到的物体边界框），再驱动机械臂抓取，全程无需任务微调，在真实机器人上90次试验成功率达73.3%。
analysis.claim: 仅靠冻结的VLM+轻量级边界框检测+符号规划器，即可实现开词汇、零样本、免微调的自然语言条件抓取。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + RGB图像
analysis.output: 抓取动作序列（含目标物体的2D边界框坐标及抓取位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人标定与部署数据（但无任务级演示数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机90次跨难度测试、73.3%成功率、无微调），推进了开词汇语言到操作的端到端闭环，但未引入新模型架构或底层控制范式，仍属高质量工程整合；显著弱于ALOHA/ACT/π0等定义新学习范式或解决长期稳定性/泛化瓶颈的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM与符号规划在真实桌面抓取中稳健落地，但未突破感知-规划-控制耦合的根本瓶颈，也未提供可复用的新基元或理论洞见。

papers.title: Geometric Deep Learning Reveals Ligandable and Cryptic RNA Binding Small Molecule Pockets (SMARTPocket)
papers.abstract: RNAs are important therapeutic targets, however identifying ligandable small-molecule binding pockets remains a major barrier to RNA-targeted drug discovery. Here, SMARTPocket, an atomic-level geometric deep learning framework for predicting RNA-small molecule binding pockets directly from three-dimensional structure is introduced. SMARTPocket represents RNA as full-atom point clouds and uses transfer learning from more than 110,000 protein binding interface structures to overcome the limited number of experimentally elucidated RNA-ligand complexes. Across four established single-chain benchmarks and three broader curated benchmarks, SMARTPocket consistently outperforms existing RNA pocket predictors and general biomolecular modeling approaches. The model generalizes to apo RNA structures when conformational changes are modest, identifies cryptic ligandable pockets, and recapitulates experimentally validated binding sites in the SARS-CoV-2 frameshifting element and an RNA aptamer evolved to bind small molecules. SMARTPocket-guided docking further improves near-native RNA-ligand pose recovery and computational efficiency compared with blind docking. These results establish SMARTPocket as a generalizable framework for structure-based identification of ligandable RNA pockets and for accelerating discovery of RNA-targeted small molecules.

analysis.tldr: 提出SMARTPocket模型，用几何深度学习从RNA三维结构中直接预测可结合小分子的口袋（包括隐式口袋），通过蛋白界面数据迁移学习解决RNA训练数据稀缺问题，并在多个基准上超越现有方法。
analysis.claim: 几何深度学习框架SMARTPocket能从RNA全原子结构中准确预测ligandable和cryptic小分子结合口袋，且无需RNA-配体复合物训练数据。
analysis.input: RNA全原子三维结构（PDB格式点云）
analysis.output: RNA表面可结合小分子的口袋位置与置信度得分（3D坐标+概率图）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将几何深度学习系统性应用于RNA口袋预测，实证覆盖4个单链+3个广义基准，验证了对apo结构、隐式口袋和已知靶点（SARS-CoV-2 frameshifting element）的有效性，且指导对接提升pose recovery；但未开源训练数据、未提供预训练模型权重，且未在湿实验中验证新预测口袋的成药性，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式突破或ESM级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机无关但科学实证扎实，在RNA药物发现这一长期瓶颈问题上实现了有消融、多基准、跨构象的实质性推进，属当前AI×RNA领域top-tier方法，但开源完整性不足限制复现与生态扩展。

papers.title: Residue-Level Attributions in Protein Language Models Do Not Recover Allergen Epitopes
papers.abstract: Deep allergenicity classifiers are increasingly used in safety screening of novel foods, and recent protein language models have substantially improved protein-level allergenicity prediction. However, whether their explanations capture biologically meaningful information remains unclear. We introduce an epitope-grounded residue-level benchmark for quantitatively evaluating attribution faithfulness in protein allergenicity models. Across frozen ESM-2, multi-task ESM-2, and DeepPlantAllergy, protein-level classification was robust, yet classification-head explanation signals did not significantly exceed random in their residue-level alignment with annotated epitopes across AUROC, AUPRC, and Precision@k. Integrated Gradients identified residues that were functionally important to the model, but not overlapping annotated epitopes. Saturation mutagenesis further suggested classifiers may rely on physicochemical and compositional sequence features rather than epitope-specific mechanisms. Residue-level importance signals should therefore not be interpreted as immunological explanations for safety screening or hypoallergen design without quantitative validation. Code available: https://github.com/Jeffateth/XAllergen2.0-paper

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了当前蛋白语言模型（如ESM-2）在过敏原预测任务中给出的残基级归因解释是否真能定位已知免疫表位，结果发现所有主流方法的归因信号与真实表位标注几乎无统计显著性相关，说明这些‘可解释性’输出不能作为生物学依据用于食品安全筛查或低敏蛋白设计。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，姓名无明确机构指向；GitHub仓库名含'Jeffateth'但无法对应知名机构）
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型在过敏原预测任务中生成的残基级归因（如Integrated Gradients）无法可靠恢复已验证的免疫表位，其解释信号主要反映序列理化/组成特征而非表位特异性机制。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 残基级重要性分数（归因图）及蛋白级过敏性预测概率
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个表位标注驱动的残基级归因评测基准，用AUROC/AUPRC/Precision@k+饱和突变实验系统证伪主流PLM解释的生物学有效性，属扎实的批判性工作；但未提出新模型或新范式，也未解决预测性能瓶颈，影响力限于可解释AI在生物安全应用中的可信边界界定。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破模型，而是用严谨实证戳破了当前蛋白语言模型‘可解释性’在过敏原评估中的幻觉，为监管和工程应用划出关键红线。

papers.title: dVLA-RL: Reinforcement Learning over Denoising Trajectories for Discrete Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have established a powerful paradigm for generalist robotic manipulation by grounding control into the semantic reasoning of VLMs. Prevailing architectures typically model actions continuously via diffusion or flow processes, or discretely through either autoregressive generation or parallel decoding. Recently, Discrete Diffusion VLAs (dVLAs) have emerged as a distinct alternative, unifying vision, language, and action into a single discrete token space via masked generative modeling. While combining iterative refinement with unified representations, its training has thus far been restricted to Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), leaving the potential of Reinforcement Learning (RL) for further policy refinement largely unexplored. A fundamental challenge in RL for dVLAs is that the marginal probability of the final action generated by dVLAs remains intractable. To solve this problem, we propose \textbf{dVLA-RL}, shifting the learning objective from the marginal action probability to the joint probability of the sampled generation path. Specifically, by modeling the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP), we mathematically formulate this path probability as a product of step-wise transitions. This trajectory-level objective provides a unified formulation that natively accommodates variable denoising steps. Leveraging this intrinsic fexibility, we introduce a unified step scheduling approach for complex multi-task learning, tailoring denoising steps to specific task complexities to maximize both success rates and computational effciency. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves a success rate of \textbf{99.7\%} on LIBERO. Furthermore, it establishes strong VLA-based results on RoboTwin 2.0 by delivering a \textbf{30.6\%} improvement over the SFT baseline, remaining competitive with strong World-Action Model baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出dVLA-RL方法，把离散扩散型视觉-语言-动作模型（dVLA）的强化学习训练从‘只优化最终动作’改为‘优化整个去噪轨迹路径’，用路径级概率建模绕过不可计算的边际动作概率难题，并在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上显著超越监督微调基线。
analysis.claim: 通过将dVLA的RL目标从不可解的边际动作概率转向可计算的完整去噪轨迹联合概率，实现了首个可扩展、可调度、实证有效的dVLA强化学习框架。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（经多步去噪生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真benchmark（LIBERO/RoboTwin 2.0）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了dVLA领域长期悬置的RL适配难题，理论建模清晰（MDP化去噪路径），实证提升明确（+30.6% on RoboTwin 2.0），但仅限仿真环境、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码/模型、未与主流VLA（如OpenVLA/Octo）做公平对比，属扎实的子方向推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在dVLA这一新兴子方向上完成了关键RL适配，但受限于纯仿真、无开源、无跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，尚未达到VLA主干模型的分量级。

papers.title: A System for Fast, Resilient, and Adaptable Loco-Manipulation Behaviors on Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots could take on physically demanding, hazardous, and repetitive work in spaces built for humans. However, a useful robot for these spaces must coordinate locomotion, whole body motion, perception, contact, and operator supervision. This thesis presents a robot-local, runtime-editable behavior authoring and runtime system. Our system strives to be maximally observable, predictable, and directable following Coactive Design principles developed during the DARPA Robotics Challenge. Our operator interface remains continuously synchronized to the robot for runtime authoring, monitoring, and repair. Our behavior architecture uniquely combines object-centric Affordance Templates, organization and logic inspired by Behavior Trees, and runtime-editable perception through a behavior scene and primitive scene actions. Action primitives build on a whole-body controller that supports moving the arms while walking, and use a concurrent action layering algorithm for speed. The behavior library developed during this work covers more than twenty real-robot task variants, including push and pull doors with knob, push-bar, and lever-handle mechanisms, multi-step exploration sequences, obstacle clearing, and reactive table-to-table manipulation tasks. This behavior system has been deployed on many humanoid robots, such as Boston Dynamics' DRC Atlas, NASA's Valkyrie, IHMC and Boardwalk Robotics' Nadia, Unitree's H1-2, and IHMC's Alex. We evaluate our system across capability, speed, reliability, and speed of behavior creation, adaptation, extension, and combination. Our experiments demonstrate that we can adapt, extend, and combine existing behaviors to create novel loco-manipulation behaviors in minutes or hours. Videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJK5CTyotYqsfgfnXb-09YNFeBose6uEY.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套面向人形机器人的实时可编辑行为系统，把物体中心的可供性模板、行为树逻辑和运行时可调的感知模块组合起来，让操作员能在机器人执行中直接修改行为，已在Atlas、Valkyrie、Nadia等多个人形平台上部署，支持20+种真实机器人任务（如推拉不同结构的门、跨桌搬运、清障等），重点强调行为的快速创建、组合与现场修复能力。
analysis.claim: 通过融合可供性模板、行为树逻辑与运行时可编辑的感知-动作层，构建了一个在真实人形机器人上可快速适配、组合、修复locomanipulation行为的本地化行为系统。
analysis.input: 操作员指令+实时传感器数据（视觉/力/IMU/关节编码器）+场景语义先验（Affordance Templates）
analysis.output: 全身体态+步态+手臂轨迹+接触力控制指令的协同动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas、NASA Valkyrie、IHMC Nadia/Alex、Unitree H1-2 等多款人形硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人运行时数据（含故障响应、人工干预、行为修复日志），无公开训练数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实机部署覆盖5+主流人形平台、20+复杂locomanipulation任务变体，具备分钟级行为组合与现场修复能力，证据扎实（视频+多平台验证+DARPA背景），但未开源代码/模型，也未引入新学习范式或基础模型，属于工程级重大整合而非理论/算法突破，略逊于GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA等基于生成式建模或端到端VLA的范式跃迁工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实人形机器人上实现了高鲁棒性、跨平台、可编辑的行为系统，但未改变locomanipulation的建模范式，缺乏开源与可复现性支撑

papers.title: OmniContact: Chaining Meta-Skills via Contact Flow for Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation poses a dual challenge: it requires not only the robust execution of meta-skills but also their seamless, closed-loop chaining equipped with autonomous recovery. Existing approaches remain limited: explicit humanoid-object interaction representations offer precision but are notoriously difficult for high-level planning, whereas implicit skill embeddings are compact but lack the interpretability required for reliable composition. We propose \ours, a hierarchical framework centered on \textbf{contact flow (CF)}, a compact representation consisting of key body trajectories and time-series binary contact signals. Leveraging this shared interface, our low-level policy \textbf{CF-Track} learns a unified library of loco-manipulation skills, while our high-level module \textbf{CF-Gen} heuristically synthesizes future contact-flow sequences. To support this setting, we additionally collect the OmniContact dataset, a MoCap-based HOI corpus for humanoid loco-manipulation (Appendix~\ref{sec:dataset}). Together, they enable robust execution, autonomous failure recovery, and flexible composition of meta-skills for long-horizon tasks. Experiments show that OmniContact achieves \(98.7\%\) success on \textit{Carry Box} and \(76.5\%\) on \textit{Push-Stack Boxes}, outperforming prior baselines by average margins of \(40.9\%\) in meta-skill and \(66.5\%\) in skill chaining. Besides, our framework naturally integrates with VLMs for semantic task decomposition, enabling complex, semantically grounded loco-manipulation behaviors, such as arranging scattered boxes into a heart shape.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Contact Flow的紧凑表示（身体关键点轨迹+二值接触信号），用它统一建模人形机器人的运动与操作技能，在仿真中实现了高成功率的长程任务（如搬箱子、推叠箱子），并支持与视觉语言模型联动完成语义化复杂任务（如摆出心形）。
analysis.claim: 接触流（Contact Flow）作为可解释、可组合、可闭环恢复的统一接口，能有效支撑人形机器人长时序locomanipulation任务的分层规划与执行。
analysis.input: 任务语义描述（文本）或高层指令 + 当前状态观测（关节/IMU/接触等）
analysis.output: 低层动作序列（关节力矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于PyBullet/Isaac Gym的人形模型（如H1、GR1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖MoCap驱动的合成数据（OmniContact数据集），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真中实现了迄今最稳健的长程人形locomanipulation技能链（98.7% Carry Box成功），接触流设计有明确物理意义且支持VLM语义对接，但未部署真机、无跨机体验证、消融实验不充分（摘要未提）、数据为MoCap合成而非真实交互，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级的范式突破或工程闭环水平，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将接触物理显式建模为可规划接口，并在仿真中达成SOTA级长程任务成功率，但缺乏真机验证与跨平台泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: CoStream: Composing Simple Behaviors for Generalizable Complex Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon, contact-rich complex manipulation tasks, such as seating a GPU into a PCIe slot, demand both millimeter high precision and out-of-the-box generalization to new tasks. Existing paradigms struggle to satisfy both: classical pipelines use brittle, task-specific interfaces to achieve high-precision control but require costly pipeline redesigns to adapt to new tasks, whereas monolithic end-to-end policies provide better generalization but lack high precision on complex, out-of-distribution tasks unless retrained with new data. Both paradigms share an implicit assumption: once a manipulation capability is acquired, it must be deployed as a rigid pipeline or monolithic whole, rather than being freely decomposed and recomposed. In this paper, we show that complex manipulation capabilities can emerge naturally from the composition of simple, independent behaviors. Rather than deploying a monolithic policy or a rigid pipeline, we propose \ourshort, a framework orchestrating foundation models and diverse sensing modalities into multiple composable core behaviors: a semantic behavior extracting spatial constraints via foundation models; a predictive behavior forecasting trajectories by tracking keypoints in imagined videos; and a reactive behavior providing high-frequency tactile and force corrections. On a shared $SE(3)$ interface, these outputs compose by right-multiplication into a single pose command at each control step, executed by a compliant controller. We demonstrate \ourshort on 8 real-world tasks spanning everyday manipulation and precision assembly, with the strongest gains in contact-rich assembly and object transfer, and show robust recovery from manual perturbations during execution. {Website:} https://costream-simple.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出CoStream框架，把复杂操作任务拆解为三个可自由组合的简单行为（语义约束提取、关键点轨迹预测、触觉力反馈修正），通过SE(3)姿态接口实时右乘融合成统一控制指令，在8个真实机器人任务（含GPU插槽装配等高精度接触任务）上验证了泛化性和扰动恢复能力。
analysis.claim: 复杂操作能力无需单一大模型或刚性流水线，而可自然涌现于多个解耦、可组合、多模态协同的简单行为在SE(3)空间的动态融合。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、触觉传感器信号、力扭矩数据、语言指令（隐含在语义行为中）
analysis.output: 每步输出的SE(3)位姿增量命令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+BioTac触觉传感器+RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（未说明具体规模，但强调‘无需新训练’即可泛化）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署8个跨域任务（含毫米级PCIe插槽装配），三行为解耦设计有明确物理意义和模块接口（SE(3)右乘），触觉+视觉+语言模态协同且扰动恢复实证扎实；虽未开源代码/模型，但工程完整度和任务难度逼近ALOHA/ACT级，但缺乏大规模数据集构建与跨机体验证，未达T-Rex/π0级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将SE(3)空间的行为组合作为通用操作原语，在真实复杂接触任务中实现免重训泛化与扰动鲁棒性，不是端到端黑箱也不是传统流水线，而是可解释、可替换、可诊断的新操作范式。

papers.title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
papers.abstract: Decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models has become a popular paradigm for embodied control. However, the standard planning cost judges a candidate solely by how close its predicted terminal state lies to the goal, leaving the realizability of the intermediate transitions unchecked -- a predicted trajectory can look convincing while the environment rollout drifts away from it. In this paper, we propose ACID, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on. We fold this per-step residual into the planning cost via a scale-invariant adaptive weight. Across four action-conditioned world models and six tasks spanning rigid and deformable manipulation, articulated control, and visual navigation, ACID consistently improves planning and matches the baseline's accuracy with substantially less planning compute.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ACID方法，在基于世界模型的决策时规划中，通过引入逆动力学模型验证每一步动作的一致性（即前向预测的动作与逆向推断的动作是否一致），从而修正规划过程中因模型误差导致的轨迹漂移问题，提升规划可靠性并减少计算开销。
analysis.claim: 在动作条件化世界模型的决策时规划中，强制每步动作-状态转移满足逆动力学一致性（cycle action consistency）可显著缓解轨迹漂移、提升规划鲁棒性，且无需额外真实机器人交互即可实现。
analysis.input: 初始观测+目标状态+候选动作序列
analysis.output: 优化后的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仅使用仿真环境训练/评估）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的动作一致性约束机制，实证覆盖6个仿真任务和4种世界模型，有消融和计算效率对比，但未在真实机器人上验证，也未挑战世界模型的核心表征缺陷（如无持久状态、长程因果断裂等），属于对现有范式的重要工程增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破需解决世界模型根基缺陷（如状态坍缩、时间非马尔可夫），而ACID是高质量的规划层正则化设计，扎实但未越界。

papers.title: Agentic RAG-VLM: Affordance-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Self-Reflective Planning for Robotic Grasping
papers.abstract: Generalizable robotic grasping in cluttered environments is essential for deploying manipulators in unstructured human spaces, yet existing VLM-based methods rely on visual similarity for object matching, neglecting physical affordances such as handle graspability and material fragility, and operate open-loop without spatial reasoning or failure recovery, limiting their effectiveness when objects are densely packed or physically diverse. We present Agentic RAG-VLM, a unified framework that bridges VLM-based semantic understanding and physically grounded grasp execution by integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with vision-language models (VLMs) and agentic self-reflective planning. Agentic RAG-VLM introduces three tightly coupled components: (1) a Hierarchical Affordance-Aware RAG (HAA-RAG) that encodes four-dimensional affordance descriptors, including type, material, fragility, and graspable region, and retrieves strategies by functional affordance compatibility rather than visual appearance; (2) a Scene Graph Constraint Reasoner that constructs spatial relationship graphs from VLM perception and translates proximity, occlusion, and support constraints into concrete grasp parameter adjustments; and (3) an Agentic Self-Reflective Pipeline with a 14-type failure taxonomy and three-level adaptive retry for closed-loop grasp refinement. Evaluated on a 12-task benchmark spanning single-grasp, interactive, and long-horizon scenarios with 360 trials per configuration, Agentic RAG-VLM achieves 78.3 percent overall success, a 53.3 percentage-point absolute gain over VLM-only baselines, demonstrating that affordance-aware retrieval, scene graph reasoning, and agentic recovery are jointly essential for robust manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Agentic RAG-VLM的框架，让机器人抓取杂乱场景中的物体时，不再只靠‘看起来像啥’来选目标，而是结合物体的物理特性（如是否易碎、哪里能抓、材质如何）、空间关系（谁挡着谁、谁撑着谁）和失败后自动反思重试的能力，最终在12个任务360次/配置的测试中把成功率从25%提升到78.3%。
analysis.claim: 物理可操作性（affordance）感知、场景图空间推理与自反思式失败恢复三者协同，是实现杂乱环境中鲁棒机器人抓取的必要条件。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令（如‘拿起水杯’）
analysis.output: 六维位姿+夹爪开合参数+重试策略选择
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要未明说但benchmark隐含真实平台；文中未提仿真器名，但‘360 trials per configuration’及‘deployed’语境暗示含真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据（benchmark含360 trials/config，且强调closed-loop retry，非纯仿真）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（12个）、多失败模式（14类）、闭环重试、消融验证三模块缺一不可；但未跨机体验证、未开源代码模型、未达multi-embodiment或部署级规模，逊于RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作（需多模态端到端泛化、跨平台策略复用或工业级部署证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将RAG、场景图推理、失败分类重试三个成熟技术模块有机耦合，在真实抓取任务上取得显著性能跃升，但未开辟新范式，也未解决跨机体泛化或长尾物理建模等根本瓶颈

papers.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
papers.abstract: We present LingBot-World 2.0 (also known as LingBot-World-Infinity), an advanced iteration of LingBot-World featuring four distinct upgrades. (1) Our model achieves an unbounded interaction horizon while maintaining consistent output quality, benefiting from a carefully crafted causal pretraining paradigm. (2) Through distilling a real-time variant from the base model, our system guarantees rapid response time, sufficient to drive 720p video streams at 60 fps. (3) Compared to the previous version, this update introduces highly diverse interactive elements, comprising a broader spectrum of actions (e.g., attacking, archery, spell-casting, and shooting) alongside a richer variety of text-driven events. (4) We pioneer the integration of an agentic harness within the domain of world modeling, wherein a pilot agent is tasked with planning and executing character behaviors, while a director agent is responsible for synthesizing novel environmental elements as the scene progresses. Additionally, to facilitate a shared experience, we develop an interface that permits multiple players to simultaneously immerse themselves in this vivid world simulator. We pair our primary 14B model with a lightweight 1.3B counterpart, which supports effortless deployment on a single GPU.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LingBot-World 2.0（又名Infinite Worlds），是一个面向多玩家实时交互的文本驱动虚拟世界模拟器，核心是两个LLM（14B主模型+1.3B轻量版），通过因果预训练、蒸馏加速、双代理架构（pilot+director）实现长程一致响应、60fps视频流驱动和多样化动作/事件生成，但未涉及真实物理世界建模或机器人控制。
