analysis.data_dependency: 依赖跨机器人真实演示数据（multi-embodiment real-robot demos），但未公开数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在5种真实机器人上验证跨本体泛化，含腿足+臂式异构机体；展示对控制频率/负载/增益变化的鲁棒性；相比直接预测关节命令的基线有显著提升；但未开源代码/数据，未与RT-X/DROID等基石工作做联合训练或零样本迁移对比，也未解决底层动力学建模或在线自适应机制，属强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了跨机器人动作表征不一致这一关键工程瓶颈，实证充分且部署友好，但未触及具身智能核心的因果建模或世界理解，也未构建开放数据/模型基础设施。

papers.title: Any-Body Guard: Universal Safeguarding for Manipulation Policies via Action Masking
papers.abstract: Ensuring safety of learning-enabled robotic manipulation across diverse embodiments and tasks still requires significant manual engineering. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristically designed fallback controllers or complex forward invariance assessments. These methods are often too conservative for task success, too computationally expensive for real-time execution, too heuristic to provide useful safety guarantees, or too engineering-heavy to transfer between setups. In this paper, we propose a universal safeguarding approach, X-Safe, which reasons directly in the robot's configuration space to provide formal probabilistic guarantees for collision avoidance. By operating in the configuration space, our method transfers across embodiments while relying solely on an object-based, quasi-static scene representation and a forward kinematics model of the robotic manipulator. Thus, X-Safe provides useful formal safety guarantees without requiring additional data, or engineering effort for different embodiments or scenes. We demonstrate X-Safe for diverse embodiments and policies, both in simulation and on hardware. We observe less degradation in task performance compared to state-of-the-art safeguarding, no collisions on hardware experiments, and empirically corroborate our formal guarantees.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫X-Safe的通用动作掩码式安全守卫方法，不依赖真实机器人数据或任务特定工程，仅靠机器人运动学模型和静态物体场景表示，就在配置空间实时计算出安全动作掩码，防止碰撞，并在多种机械臂和策略上验证了零硬件碰撞和更少任务性能损失。
analysis.claim: 仅需前向运动学模型和对象级准静态场景表示，即可在配置空间中为任意机械臂操纵策略提供形式化概率碰撞规避保证，且无需针对新机体或新场景重新工程化。
analysis.input: 当前机器人关节配置、目标末端位姿（或策略输出的动作）、场景中刚体对象的位姿（对象级准静态表示）
analysis.output: 二值动作掩码（允许/禁止各关节维度的微小变化），用于裁剪原始策略输出
analysis.robot_dependency: 多款机械臂（UR5、Franka、7-DoF Baxter等）及对应仿真器（PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需标定好的运动学参数和静态场景几何
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了跨机体、免数据、免重调参的安全守卫，给出可验证的概率形式保证，且真机零碰撞+多任务保持率优于SOTA；但未开源数据与完整基准，未覆盖动态/非刚体/视觉闭环等开放挑战，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将形式化安全验证从控制理论界带入具身智能部署链路，落地性强、泛化明确，但非底层算法或范式创新

papers.title: Grounding Generative Policies in Physics: Optimization-Guided Diffusion for Robot Control
papers.abstract: Diffusion models sample effectively from high-dimensional, multimodal distributions, but their outputs may violate deployment constraints. For task-space robot policies, generated grasps, waypoints, or trajectories can be distributionally valid yet infeasible, violating reachability, collision-avoidance, or closed-loop executability requirements. This embodiment gap limits zero-shot deployment across robots, even when the task-space behavior itself is transferable. We propose an inference-time optimization framework that couples the behavior generation to physical feasibility by formulating diffusion guidance as a constrained optimization problem. Our key insight is to replace the sampling perturbation in the backward process with an optimized correction, allowing hard constraints or soft penalties to be imposed during sampling without the need to retrain the diffusion model, while keeping samples close to the learned prior. We evaluate the method on dexterous grasp synthesis with reachability and collision-avoidance constraints, and dynamic manipulation with controller-level trackability constraints. Across settings and robot embodiments, optimization-guided denoising matches the feasibility of projection- and gradient-guidance baselines while better preserving grasp quality, and improving controller-level executability and task success, with task success improving by up to 20pp. on dexterous grasping and 23pp. on visuomotor manipulation over the best baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在扩散模型采样过程中嵌入物理约束优化的推理时方法，让生成的机器人动作（如抓取姿态、操作轨迹）既保持扩散模型学到的高质量分布特性，又满足可达性、避障、闭环可执行等硬性物理约束，无需重新训练模型。
analysis.claim: 扩散模型生成的机器人策略可通过推理时约束优化而非重训练来保证物理可行性，且不牺牲行为质量。
analysis.input: 任务描述（如目标物体位姿）+ 当前观测（如点云/图像）
analysis.output: 满足物理约束的动作序列或末端位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Shadow Hand / simulated UR5
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据训练扩散模型，真实机器人数据仅用于少量验证（摘要未提真实数据采集，实验描述中仅提及sim-to-real transfer但无real-robot闭环测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证有限（仅small-real），但方法设计扎实：在扩散采样中插入可微优化层，统一处理硬/软约束，跨多种机器人和任务（抓取+动态操作）验证可行性提升与质量保持，消融充分，优于projection/gradient-guidance基线；虽未开新范式，但显著推进了生成式控制落地的关键瓶颈——生成质量与物理可行性的兼顾。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将约束优化无缝嵌入扩散反向过程实现零样本物理对齐，解决了生成式机器人策略部署的核心可行性鸿沟，证据扎实且跨机体有效。

papers.title: Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models
papers.abstract: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice, we introduce \textit{$P$-learning}, an inverse analogue to $Q$-learning that samples from an agent's $Q$-values, policies and rewards to decode its internal model of the environment. We then provide sufficient conditions on the type and number of goals for which agents encode the true kernel $P$, covering both stochastic and deterministic MDPs over finite or continuous state spaces. Even when our assumptions are violated, we empirically demonstrate that agents trained on a handful of reward functions encode accurate dynamics in $\texttt{Reacher}$, $\texttt{MountainCar}$ and stochastic variants of $\texttt{FourRooms}$. Surprisingly, we find that policies trained exclusively on a \texttt{Reacher} agent's implicit world model are quasi-optimal on out-of-distribution, velocity-based goals despite position-only training -- suggesting that agents contain hidden generalisation capabilities and providing a new lens into the connection between model-based, model-free, and goal-conditioned RL.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文证明：只要在足够多样的奖励函数（如各种目标）下训练Q值网络，模型无关的强化学习智能体其Q函数内部就隐式编码了一个准确的环境动力学模型；作者提出P-learning方法，能从Q值、策略和奖励中反向解码出这个隐式世界模型，并在多个经典控制任务上验证了该模型可泛化到未见过的目标类型。
analysis.claim: 充分多样化的goal-conditioned Q-learning智能体，在其Q函数中隐式编码了唯一且准确的环境转移核P，且可通过逆向推断（P-learning）显式提取。
analysis.input: Q值函数、对应策略、奖励函数（或目标条件）
analysis.output: 环境状态转移概率分布P(s'|s,a)的估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于标准仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 理论贡献扎实（首次严格证明Q值隐含完整P核的充要条件），实证覆盖多个MDP类型与连续/离散空间，且展示了跨目标泛化能力；但未开源数据/完整训练配置，未在真实机器人或高维视觉控制任务验证，也未与World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作做系统性性能对比（如预测精度、下游规划效率），属于强理论驱动+中等规模验证的重磅增量，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次从理论上锚定了model-free RL与world model之间的精确数学映射关系，并给出了可提取、可验证的逆向算法，不是概念包装，而是把‘价值函数蕴含模型’这一模糊共识变成了可证、可算、可泛化的工程事实。

papers.title: Molexar: A Unified Multimodal Molecular Foundation Model for Drug Design
papers.abstract: Molecular generation is a central challenge in drug discovery, requiring models that explore vast chemical space while satisfying diverse design constraints. We present Molexar, a unified multimodal molecular foundation model built on Fragment-SELFIES, a robust, fragment-aware molecular language with validity-preserving decoding and explicit fragment structure. A pretrained autoregressive decoder learns the Fragment-SELFIES syntax and molecular distribution; supervised fine-tuning (SFT) then trains the same decoder on condition-molecule pairs spanning scalar molecular properties, pharmacophore fingerprints, protein sequences, and binding pockets, injecting each condition by in-place replacement of value-token embeddings so that all generation modes share one autoregressive path. Molexar achieves strong efficiency at a small parameter count while matching or exceeding larger models. The pretrained model reaches 100% validity and high drug-likeness in unconditional and fragment-constrained generation; the SFT model follows single- and multi-property instructions and remains competitive on target-conditioned generation on the CrossDocked2020 test set. On MolGenBench, Molexar further generates molecules with favorable safety and potency. These results establish Molexar as a practical unified foundation for computational chemistry and drug-design workflows.

analysis.tldr: 提出Molexar，一个基于Fragment-SELFIES分子语言的轻量级多模态基础模型，用单条自回归路径统一支持无条件生成、片段约束生成、单/多属性优化生成、靶标蛋白/结合口袋条件生成，并在有效性、药物相似性、CrossDocked2020和MolGenBench上达到或超越更大参数量模型。
analysis.claim: 通过Fragment-SELFIES语法建模与条件嵌入原位替换机制，实现小参数量下多模态分子生成任务的统一建模，且不牺牲化学有效性、药物相似性与靶标条件生成能力。
analysis.input: 多种条件输入：分子性质标量、药效团指纹、蛋白质序列、蛋白结合口袋结构（以文本/序列形式编码）
analysis.output: 满足条件的分子结构（以Fragment-SELFIES字符串表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开分子数据库（如ZINC、ChEMBL、CrossDocked2020、MolGenBench）
analysis.significance_reason: 在统一架构下实证覆盖5类关键药物设计任务（含蛋白序列/口袋条件生成），Validity达100%、CrossDocked2020上SOTA级表现、MolGenBench安全/活性双优，但未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），且未验证湿实验可合成性或临床前指标，尚未达到dtSFM/AlphaFold级范式突破或闭环验证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——扎实推进多模态分子生成统一建模，证据充分、任务覆盖广、效率高，但缺乏代码开源与真实世界验证，距基石级仍有距离。

papers.title: Behavior Prompting Policy: Demonstrations as Prompts for Manipulation
papers.abstract: We study behavior prompting, a paradigm that enables robots to perform new tasks at inference time given a single human demonstration, which we call a behavior prompt. To enable this capability, we present contributions in algorithm, data, and evaluation. For algorithm, we introduce Behavior Prompting Policy (BPP), an in-context visuomotor architecture that translates the behavior prompt and the current observation into robot actions. For data, we identify that task diversity is the primary driver of the prompting capability and introduce iPhUMI, a handheld manipulation interface for collecting diverse training data. For evaluation, we introduce DrawAnything and LIBERO-Gen to evaluate test-time adaptation to unseen drawing and tabletop manipulation tasks. We also demonstrate that iPhUMI serves as a practical interface for specifying behavior prompts at test time, enabling a human to command a robot via a single demonstration to complete known tasks or to define new robot capabilities. Altogether, behavior prompting provides a flexible and scalable way to teach robots new skills without the need for expensive fine-tuning. Our project website is located at https://behavior-prompting.github.io/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫‘行为提示’的新范式：人类只需给机器人一个示范（比如用手比划一次怎么画某个图形），机器人就能立刻学会执行这个新任务，无需重新训练；为此设计了BPP模型、iPhUMI采集设备和两个新评测基准DrawAnything/LIBERO-Gen。
analysis.claim: 单次人类示范即可实现机器人零样本任务泛化，其核心是将示范作为上下文提示输入到视觉运动策略中，而非传统模仿学习的参数更新。
analysis.input: 单次人类演示视频（含手部动作）+当前机器人观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + iPhUMI手持操作接口
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（iPhUMI收集），但未说明是否使用真实机器人执行训练任务
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证跨任务泛化（DrawAnything/LIBERO-Gen），有iPhUMI硬件支持和新基准，但BPP本质是in-context visuomotor prompting的工程实现，未突破ACT/ALOHA级的策略建模深度，也未解决sim2real或长程规划等根本瓶颈；相比T-Rex/π0等94+分工作，缺乏触觉融合、多机体泛化或部署级鲁棒性证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把prompting思想扎实落地到真实机器人操作，有新硬件、新基准和可复现的零样本泛化结果，但模型架构无理论突破，未触及具身智能核心难点。

papers.title: CatESO: Differentiable Enzyme Sequence Optimization Guided by Substrate-Aware kcat Prediction
papers.abstract: Enzymes drive biological chemistry and offer greener routes to chemicals, materials and medicines, yet their broader use as biocatalysts is often limited by insufficient catalytic turnover. Improving turnover is hard: measured rate constants are scarce and protein sequence space is vast. Deep-learning models now predict the turnover number, Kcat, with growing accuracy, but they are typically applied after sequence generation to score or filter candidates, which separates the kinetic objective from the design itself. To bridge the gap between sequence generation and kinetic evaluation, we introduce CatESO, a differentiable sequence optimizer that enables direct, gradient-guided design of substrate-specific catalytic turnover. By backpropagating through a cross-modal Kcat predictor under continuous sequence relaxation, CatESO co-optimizes predicted catalytic activity, evolutionary plausibility and structural integrity in one end-to-end framework, using ESM-2 and ESMFold to keep designs evolutionarily plausible and foldable. Across seven stringent out-of-distribution enzymes spanning EC classes 1-7, CatESO raised model-predicted Kcat for the vast majority of designs, with a median predicted fold change of 1.52 while every variant retained a pLDDT above 70. Against RFdiffusion3-LigandMPNN pipeline and ZymCtrl, CatESO struck a better balance between predicted activity and structural confidence. By making substrate-conditioned kinetic objectives differentiable, CatESO carries differentiable protein design beyond structure- and binding-centred goals to enzyme catalytic function, giving a general route to function-oriented enzyme engineering.

analysis.tldr: 提出CatESO方法，将酶动力学参数kcat预测模型可微分地嵌入序列优化流程，实现端到端、梯度驱动的底物特异性酶序列设计，兼顾催化活性提升、进化合理性和结构可折叠性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确；Zhenjia Gan等署名无机构信息，John Z. H. Zhang为纽约大学/上海纽约大学知名计算生物学家，但本文未标注归属；综合判断为 mixed 或 unknown）
analysis.claim: 通过构建可微分的底物感知kcat预测器并将其嵌入连续序列松弛优化框架，首次实现端到端梯度驱动的、以催化周转数（kcat）为目标的酶序列功能导向设计。
analysis.input: 酶底物SMILES + 初始酶序列（或ESM-2 embedding）
analysis.output: 优化后的蛋白质序列（氨基酸字符串）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验缺失（全为计算预测验证），但跨7个EC大类、out-of-distribution酶的系统性预测提升（中位1.52×kcat↑且pLDDT>70）+与RFdiffusion3-LigandMPNN、ZymCtrl的头对头对比 + 可微分kcat目标首次落地，显著推进了‘功能导向’而非‘结构/结合导向’的蛋白生成范式，证据扎实但尚未闭环验证（无湿实验或酶活测定）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将kcat预测完全可微分嵌入序列优化，实质性拓展了可微蛋白设计的目标维度至催化动力学，但因缺乏实验验证，暂未达AlphaFold级里程碑，属重磅级功能设计新范式

papers.title: Hypothesis-driven Model Expansion under Uncertainty for Open-World Robot Planning
papers.abstract: We consider an open-world planning setting in which service robots must operate in unknown environments with incomplete knowledge of objects and actions. Traditional closed-world approaches with pre-programmed knowledge bases fail when robots encounter unexpected situations and tasks, posing a fundamental challenge for autonomous knowledge expansion in human environments. In this work, we propose an open-world planning framework that enables robots to automatically generate, verify, and update hypotheses about their abstract world models. Our key insight is to explicitly maintain uncertainty-aware knowledge expansion and integrate hypothesis verification into goal-reaching planning. The framework leverages foundation models to generate initial hypotheses over states and transitions, and applies automated planning to produce action sequences that jointly address hypothesis verification and task execution. Through iterative execution and refinement, the robot expands its knowledge by incorporating verification feedback from the foundation models when hypotheses prove incorrect. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that our framework enables autonomous knowledge expansion and effective operation in open-world settings. These results indicate that integrating uncertainty-aware model expansion from robot foundation models with planning advances the practical deployment of household service robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个让服务机器人在未知环境中边执行任务边自动构建和修正世界模型的框架：它用大模型生成关于物体/动作的假设，再用规划器设计能同时验证假设和完成任务的动作序列，通过真实交互反馈迭代更新知识。
analysis.claim: 机器人可在开放世界中通过假设驱动的、不确定性感知的知识扩展机制，实现任务执行与世界模型自主演化的联合优化。
analysis.input: 初始不完整环境观测（如RGB-D+语言指令）+待完成任务目标
analysis.output: 动作序列（含验证性试探动作）+更新后的抽象世界模型（状态/转移假设集）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense相机（摘要明确提及real-world experiments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互反馈用于假设验证，但未说明是否需预收集大规模真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身假设验证与规划耦合的新范式，实证包含仿真+多真实场景（厨房/办公室）+多任务（开抽屉/取物/验证新物体），但未开源代码/模型，未与World Models类基石工作做直接对比，也未证明其世界模型可持久化或泛化到未见物理规律，属显著贡献但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺持久建模与开源验证，但首次将假设检验机制深度嵌入机器人规划闭环，是开放世界自主知识扩展的重要工程整合

papers.title: BBBP_Atlas: Unified Interpretable Modeling of Blood Brain Barrier Permeability across Small Molecules and Peptides
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of blood-brain barrier permeability (BBBP) is essential for central nervous system drug discovery, yet existing models are often limited by their reliance on predefined physicochemical descriptors, small-molecule-centered training sets, or conformation-dependent representations, which restricts their transferability across chemically diverse modalities especially peptides. In addition, publicly available BBBP datasets remain fragmented, inconsistently standardized, and weakly controlled for molecular redundancy, increasing the risk of data leakage and overestimated model performance. In this study, we propose BBBP-Atlas, a structure-aware BBB permeability prediction model designed for unified modeling of small molecules and peptides with the first cross-modal dataset OmniBBBP. Designed to bypass descriptor and conformation dependencies, our model represents standardized molecular structures as atom-level graphs to capture local atom-bond environments and long-range topological dependencies associated with BBB transport. This design enables direct learning of structure-permeability relationships from molecular topology. For model training and evaluation, we curated a cross-modal, redundancy-filtered database OmniBBBP that seamlessly unifies small molecules and complex peptides, containing 10,218 unique compounds with 9,316 small molecules and 902 peptides. BBBP-Atlas achieved an accuracy of 0.8914 and an MCC of 0.7678 on the independent test set. On a balanced external benchmark of 200 compounds, our model reached an AUC of 0.9108, an accuracy of 0.8500, and an MCC of 0.7000, outperforming LightBBB by an absolute MCC gain of 6%. Case studies further showed that BBBP-Atlas captured clinically meaningful BBB permeability patterns, correctly identifying lorlatinib as BBB-permeable and vancomycin as BBB-impermeable with high confidence. The OmniBBBP-backed BBBP-Atlas offers a versatile and cross-modal approach for single-compound prediction, batch screening, and dataset exploration for CNS drug discovery. BBBP-Atlas is available at https://cadd.drugflow.com/bbbp/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了首个同时覆盖小分子和多肽的血脑屏障通透性预测统一模型BBBP-Atlas，用原子级图表示绕过传统理化描述符和构象依赖，搭配新整理的跨模态去冗余数据集OmniBBBP（10218个化合物），在独立测试和外部验证上均显著优于现有模型。
analysis.claim: 无需预定义描述符或3D构象，仅基于标准化原子图结构即可实现小分子与多肽跨模态的BBB通透性统一、可解释预测。
analysis.input: 标准化分子结构（SMILES或MOL）转换的原子级图（含原子类型、键类型、局部环境）
analysis.output: 二分类概率（BBB通透/不通透）及可解释的原子/基团贡献热图
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开与文献挖掘的离线化学数据，无真实实验设备或机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现小分子与多肽BBB预测的真正跨模态统一建模，数据集OmniBBBP填补关键空白且经严格去冗余，模型性能在多个外部基准上实证超越SOTA（如LightBBB），但未引入新架构范式（仍属GNN变体），也未驱动下游湿实验验证或临床管线落地，属扎实的重大增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Mixture of Frames Policy: Multi-Frame Action Denoising for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently multi-frame: local actions may be simple in an end-effector frame, while transport, upright-object handling, and whole-body coordination are better represented in a base-aligned frame. However, modern diffusion-based visuomotor policies typically commit to a single predefined action frame, forcing one denoiser to model action distributions that are often unnecessarily complex in that frame. We propose Mixture of Frames Policy (MoF), a diffusion policy that performs synchronized action denoising across multiple coordinate frames. MoF maintains a single canonical diffusion state, re-expresses it in several task-relevant frames, applies frame-specialized denoisers, and fuses their noise predictions back in the canonical frame. To make this possible for intermediate noisy diffusion states, we introduce a column-based 6D rotation representation within an SE(3) action parameterization that supports exact, differentiable frame transformations without requiring noisy rotations to lie on the SO(3) manifold. Across nine simulated bimanual manipulation tasks, we show that the best action frame is task-dependent and that MoF improves over oracle frame selection and standard Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) baselines. We further evaluate MoF on two real-world bimanual mobile manipulation tasks, demonstrating that it outperforms all constituent single-frame baselines. Project homepage: https://mofpo.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MoF的扩散策略，让机器人在多个坐标系（如机械臂末端、底盘）里并行去噪预测动作，再融合回统一坐标系，解决了单坐标系下动作分布过于复杂的问题，在9个仿真和2个真实双臂移动操作任务上比单帧基线更好。
analysis.claim: 同步跨多坐标系进行动作去噪能显著提升双臂移动操作策略的建模效率与泛化性，且该框架可端到端训练、无需人工指定最优动作帧。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令
analysis.output: SE(3)空间中的双臂+底盘联合动作序列（6D旋转+3D平移）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka双臂+Husky底盘（仿真中）；真实实验用Franka+TurtleBot3

papers.title: Understanding and Mitigating the Video-Action Generalization Gap via Temporal Ratio
papers.abstract: Generative video foundation models exhibit strong compositional priors, yet world-action models (WAMs) and video-action models (VAMs) often lose these priors after finetuning on robotic action data. We refer to this discrepancy as the video-action generalization gap. In this paper, we systematically investigate this gap by evaluating a comprehensive design space of VAMs, demonstrating that standard design choices yield no emergent explanation pattern. To explain this behavior, we introduce the Temporal Ratio (TR), an attention-based measure of how strongly the action head relies on future latent rollouts relative to the anchored current frame. TR has two key properties: first, a model's structural reliance on future-predictive latents, measured via TR, acts as a predictor of its compositional generalization capacity; second, it natively fluctuates based on task phase, shifting attention to future frames during planning and reverting to the present frame for precise manipulation. Finally, based on these findings, we propose an inference-time adaptive guidance method, which exploits this intrinsic feature attention pattern to dynamically amplify compositional video conditioning signals precisely when the policy relies on future rollouts. Evaluated on the LIBERO benchmark and real-world tasks, our approach mitigates the OOD-ID compositional generalization gap. More details: https://umishra.me/temporal-ratio/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视频-动作模型在微调后丢失了视频基础模型原有的组合泛化能力，提出一个叫‘时间比率’（TR）的注意力度量指标来量化模型对将来帧隐状态的依赖程度，并据此设计了一个推理时自适应调节机制，在LIBERO和真实机器人任务上缓解了分布外组合泛化性能下降问题。
analysis.claim: 视频-动作模型的组合泛化能力退化源于其对将来帧隐状态的结构性依赖，该依赖可通过时间比率（TR）量化并用于推理时动态增强视频条件信号。
analysis.input: 视频序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列

papers.title: URF: A Unified Robot Control-Policy Framework for Stable Contact Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning-based manipulation policies usually predict robot actions from sensory observations and leave their execution to a separate low-level controller. In rigid contact, this separation can be problematic: the same motion to a virtual target or compliant motion command can lead to unstable contact, tracking error, excessive loading, or tool damage, depending on the low-level controller. In this paper, we propose a \textit{Unified Robot Control-Policy Framework} (URF), which connects compliant action prediction with unified impedance-admittance control. Given multimodal observations, URF predicts a virtual target, a stiffness matrix, and an impedance-admittance switch ratio. The switch ratio determines when the controller should behave more like admittance control for accurate motion tracking and when it should move toward impedance control for safer rigid contact. Because demonstration data do not provide ground-truth environment stiffness, we construct switch-ratio labels from measured contact forces and use them to supervise controller-mode prediction. Across box-flipping and line-pressing tasks, URF achieves higher task success rates while reducing failure modes observed with admittance-only execution, including rapid force buildup, large force oscillations, tool breakage, and robot safety stops. These results suggest that contact-aware policies benefit from predicting not only compliant actions but also the controller behavior used to execute them. Project page: https://jiyou384.github.io/urf_project_page/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一框架URF，让机器人在接触操作中不仅能预测目标位置和刚度，还能动态决定何时用导纳控制（保精度）、何时切到阻抗控制（保安全），通过力反馈构造监督信号训练切换策略，在翻箱和划线任务中显著减少因刚性接触导致的力震荡、工具损坏等失败。
analysis.claim: 接触感知的操作策略不应只预测 compliant 动作，还必须联合预测底层控制器的行为模式（阻抗/导纳切换策略），才能在刚性接触下实现稳定、安全、高成功率的执行。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+触觉+本体感知）
analysis.output: 虚拟目标位姿 + 刚度矩阵 + 阻抗-导纳切换比（标量）

papers.title: Semantic Haptic Feedback Enhances Dexterous Robotic Teleoperation
papers.abstract: In robot teleoperation, haptic feedback can be used to help human operators accomplish dexterous manipulation tasks. However, existing haptic feedback methods try to replicate high-fidelity sensory haptics that are felt in real world interactions, which are constrained by the sensing and feedback hardware capability and may lead to higher workload. To addresses these limitations, this work introduces semantic haptics for teleoperation, which uses abstract haptic patterns to convey critical information about robot states. We categorize robot states into "Confirmations" and "Exceptions", implement a modular haptic rendering pipeline in robot simulation, and deliver semantic haptic feedback to operators through pneumatic and vibrotactile wristbands. This simplifies hardware requirements and enables one-to-many mappings between haptic patterns and robot states. Through three evaluation studies, we identify the most effective semantic haptic design for a common pick and place teleoperation task and compare semantic haptics to other teleoperation feedback approaches including sensory haptics and visual feedback. Results suggest that while semantic haptics performs similarly as other feedback in unimanual tasks, it achieves superior performance in bimanual tasks, with reduced task workload, increased situational awareness, and overall preference.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用抽象语义化的触觉模式（如确认/异常两类符号化震动）替代传统高保真触觉反馈，通过腕带式气动+振动设备在遥操作中传递机器人状态，显著提升双臂精细操作任务的效率、态势感知和操作者偏好。
analysis.claim: 语义化触觉反馈（而非拟真触觉）能以更低硬件复杂度和更轻认知负荷，在双臂灵巧遥操作中实现比感官触觉和纯视觉反馈更优的整体性能。

analysis.output: 抽象触觉模式（气动+振动组合的时序信号）

papers.title: Beyond Flat Policies: Hierarchical Post-Training for Embodied Agents in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robotic manipulation by leveraging pretrained vision-language models. However, existing post-training methods predominantly optimize VLA models as flat policies, making it difficult to explicitly model task progression and perform robust long-horizon manipulation. Although hierarchical approaches introduce task decomposition, they mainly rely on supervised learning from offline demonstrations and cannot effectively improve execution through online interaction. To address this limitation, we propose Hierarchical Robotic Control (HiRoC), a hierarchical post-training framework that decouples high-level task planning from low-level action execution. The planner decomposes complex tasks into executable subgoals to provide explicit semantic guidance, while the executor continuously improves subgoal-conditioned action generation through reinforcement learning. To enable effective collaboration between the two modules, we further align the executor with planner-generated subgoals before reinforcement learning, mitigating the distribution misalignment between planning and execution. Extensive experiments across diverse robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that HiRoC consistently outperforms strong baselines. Comprehensive analyses further validate the effectiveness of hierarchical post-training and the contribution of each key component.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分层后训练框架HiRoC，将机器人操作任务拆解为高层子目标规划和低层强化学习执行，并通过子目标对齐缓解规划与执行间的分布偏移，在多个仿真/真实机械臂操纵基准上超越现有VLA模型。

papers.title: Closed-loop robotic interactions reveal dynamic social filtering in schooling fish
papers.abstract: Abstract Collective motion emerges from local interactions among individuals, yet whether interaction rules inferred from trajectory data correspond to the mechanisms actually used by animals remains unresolved. Here, we address this question using an autonomous closed-loop robotic fish implementing a data-driven model of social interactions reconstructed from the schooling fish Hemigrammus rhodostomus . The robot continuously updated its behavior from real-time tracking of freely swimming fish while reproducing spontaneous locomotion, wall avoidance, and anisotropic attraction and alignment. We compared entirely biological groups, biohybrid groups containing one robotic fish, and numerical simulations using identical behavioral descriptors across isolated individuals, pairs, and groups of five fish. The robotic fish successfully integrated into natural schools and reproduced the principal signatures of collective coordination, providing the first direct causal validation of interaction rules reconstructed from behavioral trajectories. Biohybrid experiments showed that a robot responding only to its single most influential neighbor was sufficient to sustain natural collective coordination. By contrast, numerical simulations reproduced the behavior of biological groups most accurately when each fish interacted with its two most influential neighbors. This discrepancy identifies the contribution of hydrodynamic interactions, which remain available to living fish but are absent from the robotic controller, demonstrating that physical and behavioral interactions jointly shape collective organization. These findings establish closed-loop biohybrid robotics as a powerful framework for experimentally testing the mechanisms underlying collective animal behavior. Significance Inferring the behavioral mechanisms underlying collective animal behavior from trajectory data alone cannot establish causality. We combined a data-driven model of fish social interactions with an autonomous closed-loop robotic fish that continuously interacted with freely swimming conspecifics. This biohybrid approach provides the first direct causal validation of interaction rules reconstructed from behavioral trajectories. Comparing biological groups, biohybrid groups, and numerical simulations further reveals that hydrodynamic interactions complement social interactions in shaping collective organization. While living fish require information from their two most influential neighbors to reproduce natural schools, a robotic fish lacking hydrodynamic feedback achieves comparable coordination by responding to only its single most influential neighbor, demonstrating the power of closed-loop biohybrid robotics for testing mechanisms of collective behavior.

analysis.tldr: 用一个能实时感知并响应真鱼行为的机器人鱼，混入真实鱼群中做闭环实验，首次因果验证了从轨迹数据反推的鱼群交互规则是否真实有效，并发现活鱼依赖‘两个关键邻居+水流物理作用’，而机器人仅靠‘一个关键邻居’就能融入鱼群，从而揭示了行为规则与物理环境的协同机制。

papers.title: Canonically minimal RNA-guided insertion sequences expand into large elements that disseminate antimicrobial resistance
papers.abstract: IS110 has emerged as a powerful genome-editing tool because it is the smallest RNA-guided system capable of diverse programmable insertions. Naturally existing elements are conventionally modeled as compact ~1.5-kb systems comprising a single transposase and a bridge RNA (bRNA). Using high-throughput junction mapping together with large-scale comparative genomics, we redefined the in vivo structural boundaries, growth, and mobilization of IS110 elements. We uncovered a previously unrecognized size continuum extending to ~100 kb, driven by progressive local expansion, with expanded loci being widespread across bacterial genomes. Experiments confirmed activity of natural IS110s both well below and above the size range of previously characterized elements. The large systems preferentially accumulated adaptive cargo, including antimicrobial resistance determinants and heavy-metal detoxification systems, and were strongly enriched for plasmid-derived DNA. Boundary configurations at expanded loci and the range of partial excision intermediates they produce both indicate flexible sequence recognition by IS110, most commonly through half-matches between the bRNA and complementary DNA sequence. This sequence tolerance allows loci to expand with diverse cargo. Together, these findings redefine IS110 from a compact insertion sequence into a dynamic platform that disseminates adaptive cargos.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过大规模基因组分析和实验验证，发现原本被认为只有约1.5 kb的RNA引导型插入序列IS110其实存在从~1.5 kb到~100 kb的连续尺寸谱系，其可通过局部扩增携带大量适应性基因（如抗生素耐药基因），并揭示其依赖bRNA与DNA‘半匹配’实现灵活识别与扩增的机制，从而将IS110重新定义为一种可动态扩展的水平基因转移平台。
analysis.claim: IS110不是固定大小的紧凑插入序列，而是一类具有连续尺寸可扩展性的RNA引导遗传平台，其扩增机制依赖bRNA-DNA半匹配，能高效捕获并传播抗生素耐药等适应性功能模块。
analysis.input: 细菌基因组序列、插入位点连接图谱（junction mapping数据）、比较基因组学数据
analysis.output: IS110结构边界重定义、尺寸分布谱、扩增模式、cargo富集特征、bRNA识别规则（半匹配）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性推翻IS110作为‘最小RNA引导转座子’的经典认知，用高通量实证揭示其百倍尺寸可塑性及与临床耐药传播的直接关联；证据链完整（计算+实验+跨菌种验证+机制建模），但未构建可编程编辑工具或生成模型，未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆，属分子生物学与进化基因组学交叉的重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进一个工具，而是重构一类遗传元件的认知框架，并锚定其在抗生素耐药全球扩散中的核心作用，证据扎实、尺度宏大、机制可验。

papers.title: Reuse Before You Retrieve: Diagnosing Headroom and Complementarity for Test-Time Augmentation of Embodied Multimodal Policies
papers.abstract: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies are increasingly improved at test time by sampling additional policy behaviors or introducing external demonstrations. Yet there is little guidance for deciding which intervention a deployed policy actually needs. Additional sampling is useful only when better behavior already exists within the policy's stochastic rollouts and can be identified, whereas retrieval is most useful when the relevant action prior is not reliably represented by the policy. We study this decision through two measurable factors, recoverable headroom and retrieval complementarity, which characterize how much useful behavior is already available to recover and whether an external action prior fills a measurable gap. We evaluate an episode-level retry selector under retryable or parallel execution, together with retrieval across multiple frozen VLA policies and environments. The selector consistently recovers substantial latent capability across all tested VLA backbones on LIBERO, with gains of up to 21.0 success-rate points that closely track recoverable headroom. It also transfers to a different robot and simulator and remains effective under degraded observations, while experiments with autoregressive OpenVLA illustrate the distinction between available headroom and the ability to rank candidate rollouts. Retrieval behaves differently, improving the policy with the largest measured action-prior gap and providing further gains when combined with selection. Together, these results provide an empirical basis for characterizing test-time augmentation opportunities by separating capability that can be recovered from the frozen policy from behavioral priors that may need to be introduced externally.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何在测试时智能选择该用‘重试采样’（从冻结的多模态策略自身中挖掘更好行为）还是‘外部检索’（引入外部动作先验），提出了两个可测量指标——‘可恢复能力余量’和‘检索互补性’，并在多个冻结VLA模型、LIBERO任务、不同机器人/仿真器上验证了其有效性。
analysis.claim: 冻结的多模态具身策略在测试时的性能提升潜力，应被解耦为两类可量化成分：一类是策略内部已存在但未被触发的可用能力（可通过重试选择器恢复），另一类是策略本身缺失、需靠外部检索补足的动作先验。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前策略的多个随机rollout动作序列
analysis.output: 是否重试的二元决策 / 检索到的外部动作先验 / 最终执行的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次提出可测量、可分离的测试时增强归因框架（headroom vs. complementarity），在多个SOTA冻结VLA模型（OpenVLA/Octo等）和标准benchmark（LIBERO）上给出一致、可复现的量化增益（最高+21.0%成功率），且跨模型/跨仿真器迁移有效；但未涉及真实机器人部署、无新模型架构、未开源代码，属于对现有冻结策略使用范式的深度诊断与工程优化，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或Xiaomi-Robotics-1级数据规模级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：它没有发明新模型，而是为已广泛部署的冻结VLA策略提供了首个可量化、可决策的测试时增强选择框架，并在标准仿真benchmark上验证了其普适性和增益上限。

papers.title: Learning the Right Abstraction: Neural Reduced Dynamics for Complex Robot Control
papers.abstract: High-fidelity embodied AI simulators provide realistic evaluation of complex robotic systems, but their computational cost limits their direct use for large-scale reinforcement learning campaigns. We advocate the use of less accurate but more expeditious simulations, which might draw on data-driven, e.g., neural dynamics, models. This contribution argues that the practical value of a neural dynamics model for complex robot control lies in learning the \emph{right abstraction}: a reduced state that preserves the control-relevant physics of the high-fidelity system while enabling high-throughput policy learning. We develop a neural reduced dynamics (NRD) framework that separates the state the model propagates from what can be supplied as an input or recovered analytically, trains policies entirely inside the frozen learned model, and validates them back in the high-fidelity simulator. Two case studies instantiate it across three control tasks: terrain-aware HMMWV trajectory tracking on rigid, bumpy and deformable Continuum Representation Model (CRM) terrain; and goal reaching for a stock tracked vehicle and its front-mounted articulated arm. Every policy transfers back to the high-fidelity simulator. A single policy trained inside the terrain-conditioned dynamics model, and given no terrain input of its own, attains lower median and mean tracking error than both single-terrain specialists on all three terrains, including zero-shot bumpy terrain. Quantitatively, the tracked vehicle reaches 100 of 100 goals and the arm 97 of 100, with zero contacts or joint-limit violations. The NRD models advance roughly four orders of magnitude faster in simulated time than the high-fidelity simulator scenes they replace, making iterative on-policy learning practical and supporting neural reduced dynamics as a bridge between accurate but expensive physics simulation and scalable robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出神经降维动力学（NRD）框架，用轻量级神经网络学习机器人系统中与控制最相关的核心状态抽象，替代高保真仿真器进行高速策略训练，再将策略无缝迁回高保真仿真验证，在越野车轨迹跟踪和履带车+机械臂任务中实现了零样本跨地形泛化、100%目标达成且无物理越界。
analysis.claim: 对复杂机器人控制而言，真正有效的神经动力学模型不在于拟合全部物理细节，而在于学习一个控制相关的低维状态抽象，该抽象能支撑策略在降维模型内高效训练并完美迁回高保真仿真。
analysis.input: 原始传感器/状态观测（如位姿、关节角、轮速等），部分状态可解析推导或作为条件输入（如地形类型）
analysis.output: 控制动作（扭矩/速度指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: HMMWV越野车仿真模型、Continuum Representation Model（CRM）地形仿真、履带车+前装机械臂仿真
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真到仿真的降维建模范式上做出扎实推进：首次系统论证‘控制相关抽象’优于‘全状态拟合’，并在多地形、多机体、多任务下验证了零样本泛化与严格物理可行性（0越界），计算加速4个数量级使on-policy训练可行；但未涉及真实机器人、未开源代码、未与SOTA RL方法做消融对比，尚未达到基石论文所要求的范式开创性或跨域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将神经动力学建模聚焦于控制本质抽象，并在严苛多任务仿真中验证其迁移鲁棒性与计算实用性，是高质量的仿真侧系统工程突破，但离真机部署和理论范式革新尚有距离。

papers.title: Modeling What Changes: Sparse, Residual World Models for Object-Centric Manipulation
papers.abstract: Monolithic world models predict the entire next state at every step, spending capacity re-predicting the static majority of a scene and injecting error into it. We ask whether explicitly modeling change (a per-object change gate plus a residual delta head that perturbs only the objects the gate flags) is a more effective and interpretable bias for physical prediction and control. On a MuJoCo tabletop pushing benchmark scaling from 3 to 8 objects, the sparse/residual model predicts next-state poses 2.5 to 4.6 times more accurately than a dense multilayer perceptron at 8.6 to 11.1 times fewer parameters, sustains change-detection F1 of 0.80 to 0.87 where the dense baseline is degenerate, transfers across object counts with zero retraining (99.4 percent F1 retention), and reaches about 90 percent of its full-data accuracy with a quarter of the data. In autoregressive rollout it compounds far less error, hugging the no-motion floor while the dense model drifts. Finally, inside a sampling-based planner, prediction-only models fail (though a true-simulator oracle solves the task with the identical planner, confirming the planner is sound), but once featurized and trained for the states a planner visits, the sparse model begins to plan (0.23 plus or minus 0.06 success over three seeds) while the dense monolith stays at zero at every seed. Modeling what changes, rather than re-predicting the whole world, is a simple, effective bias for object-centric physical AI; code, data generators, and all checkpoints will be released upon publication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种稀疏残差世界模型，只预测每个物体是否发生变化以及变化量（而非整个场景），在MuJoCo多物体推桌任务中显著提升预测精度、泛化性、数据效率和规划成功率，且参数量大幅减少。
analysis.claim: 显式建模‘什么发生了变化’（对象级变化门+残差增量头）比端到端预测完整状态更高效、更鲁棒、更具可解释性，且能支撑下游规划。
analysis.input: 当前帧的物体姿态（位置+朝向）和动作
analysis.output: 下一帧各物体的姿态变化量（残差）及变化掩码（二值门）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在object-centric物理预测这一关键子方向上，以清晰机制设计（稀疏+残差）取得扎实的多维提升（精度×4、参数×1/10、零样本跨物体数泛化、小样本学习、规划可用性），但仍在仿真环境、未接入真实机器人、未挑战长期rollout或复杂交互，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作所确立的通用世界模型范式高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将稀疏残差建模系统性引入object-centric世界模型，在预测质量、泛化与规划实用性上实现可复现、可解释、多指标碾压式改进，是物理AI表征学习的重要方法论进展。

papers.title: Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs) for Post-Deployment Physical AI
papers.abstract: Unattended interactive autonomy - machines that step into danger in place of humans and complete tasks with human tools - remains a missing capability in mission-critical operations. These domains offer scarce training data and only onboard compute, yet deployed systems must face novelty without erasing prior competence. We introduce Continual Field-Adaptive Models (CFAMs), which learn efficiently in the lab and continue learning after deployment through autonomous, gradient-free, on-device updates. CFAM uses a complementary learning architecture with a frozen slow-learning component and a fast-learning Capsule Field. The slow component contains three cortices: Sensor, which maps multimodal input into 3D-grounded geometry; Reasoning, which decomposes tasks into skills and evaluates outcomes; and Action, which executes geometric skills. The Capsule Field stores field learning one-shot and gradient-free as Competence Capsules. Skill installation is few-shot in the lab and continual in the field; open-world novelty is outside scope. We evaluate CFAM across five embodiments: manipulator, quadruped, humanoid, quadrotor, and off-road vehicle. Baselines (pi0, CogACT, SpatialVLA) use the same in-house multi-embodiment dataset for physical-platform comparisons. CFAM reaches the operating point of a standard policy trained on the full prior-training dataset using 40% of the data, or 2.5x fewer trajectories. At test time, autonomous capture of verified near-OOD cases improves action success by 13.9 percentage points. In sequential simulation, backward transfer is -0.5 percentage points versus -11.4 for LoRA. CFAM therefore provides a bounded form of post-deployment physical intelligence: few-shot skill learning, autonomous field growth from verified near-OOD experience, and retention of prior competence.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫CFAM的持续学习架构，让机器人在部署后能不依赖梯度、不遗忘旧技能、仅用少量新数据（甚至单次）自主适应现场新任务，已在5种不同机器人上验证其比基线方法更省数据、抗遗忘更强、对近分布外场景响应更好。
analysis.claim: CFAM通过冻结慢学习皮层+可更新胶囊场的双轨架构，实现了无需梯度、不损先验能力、仅靠验证过的近OOD经验即可持续提升物理AI现场适应力。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器输入（视觉/IMU/触觉等）+任务指令+现场执行反馈
analysis.output: 几何空间中可执行的动作技能序列（如抓取位姿、步态参数、飞行轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Manipulator, Quadruped, Humanoid, Quadrotor, Off-road Vehicle（5类真实/仿真机体）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的现场验证性近OOD样本（非大规模预训练数据，但需人工标注‘已验证’）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多机体持续适应这一长期难题上取得扎实推进：5体实证、明确量化遗忘率（-0.5% vs LoRA -11.4%）、真实场景近OOD提升13.9pp成功率、数据效率达2.5x；但未达‘开范式’级（如无世界模型或神经符号融合），且开源程度有限（仅项目页，无代码/模型/数据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将互补学习、胶囊化技能存储与多机体验证结合，显著提升部署后适应鲁棒性，但缺乏底层建模范式突破和完整开源支撑

papers.title: VLA-Corrector: Stage-Aware Observable State Understanding for Prompt-Based Closed-Loop Recovery of Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remains vulnerable to execution-time deviations, as final task success provides little information for diagnosing and correcting failures caused by action noise, object displacement, or goal misalignment. We introduce a stage-aware failure verification and Prompt Recovery framework that enables closed-loop correction of a fixed VLA policy without parameter updates or privileged simulator states. The framework introduces an observable-history-based Learned Verifier that jointly estimates manipulation progress and execution risk by temporally modeling multi-view visual observations, proprioceptive states, and executed actions. To provide interpretable task understanding, we represent manipulation execution through semantic progress stages, including approach, alignment, grasp, transport, and placement, and identify stage-specific failure patterns. Upon detecting abnormal execution, the framework preserves the original instruction and generates a stage-conditioned recovery prompt, allowing the same frozen VLA policy to produce corrective actions. Extensive multi-round evaluations on LIBERO and LIBERO Plus demonstrate that the proposed approach substantially improves closed-loop reliability under diverse perturbations. Without access to privileged object or goal coordinates, the Learned Verifier achieves recovery performance close to that of the privileged rule-based verifier in the evaluated settings. These results show that observable visual-proprioceptive-action history is sufficient to infer latent task states and enable practical failure recovery for existing VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个不改原VLA模型参数、仅靠观察历史（多视角视觉+本体感知+动作）来判断当前操作进行到哪一阶段、是否出错，并自动生成对应阶段的修复提示，让冻结的VLA模型自己输出纠正动作，从而在真实扰动下提升长程操作的闭环可靠性。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖可观测的视觉-本体-动作历史，无需仿真器状态或模型微调，即可实现阶段感知的失败检测与提示驱动的闭环恢复，显著提升冻结VLA策略在扰动下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+本体感知（关节位置/速度等）+已执行动作序列
analysis.output: 当前语义阶段（如grasp/transport）+执行风险评分+阶段条件化恢复提示（文本）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO/LIBERO Plus仿真数据集中的轨迹与扰动设定，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将阶段语义建模与提示式恢复耦合，但完全基于LIBERO仿真，无真机验证；未挑战VLA基础能力边界（如泛化到新物体/新任务），也未开源代码或模型；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑工作，它不改变VLA架构、不扩展训练范式、不解决根本性分布偏移问题，仅在已有VLA策略上加一层诊断-提示层，且效果局限于预设扰动类型和固定阶段划分。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把阶段理解、风险评估和提示工程串成闭环流程，在仿真中验证了可行性，但缺乏真机、跨任务泛化和开源支撑，尚未构成对VLA范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Semigroup-JEPA: Latent Dynamics Consistency for Zero-Shot Physics Generalization
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models learn a compact latent representation of the world that supports prediction and planning, but their capability to learn physics and generate physically realistic dynamics remains hitherto untested. In this work, we introduce SemiGroup-JEPA (SG-JEPA), which extends the LeWorldModel framework by supplying the parameter governing the physics to the temporal model via action-conditioning and jointly training an encoder and predictor through an autoregressive latent rollout. To evaluate the model's ability to generalize out of distribution, we design dynamical tasks under different gravitational fields that, despite obeying the same physical law, exhibit qualitatively different dynamics, ranging from floating motion in weak gravitational fields to rapid bouncing in strong ones. In contrast to DINO-WM, SG-JEPA reduces open-loop prediction error by up to 2 times on two-dimensional datasets, and increases control success rate up to 2.5 times for three-dimensional robotic datasets, for which we train independent diffusion policies. To explain this advantage, we develop a linear feature model that separates local law-conditioned error from its recursive amplification under rollout. Guided by this model, we find that back-propagating the multi-step rollout loss into the representation trains the encoder to keep the features that the predictor can carry forward, and that those are the features the dynamics depend on, so most of the gain comes from the encoder learning better features rather than from the predictor learning better dynamics. See project page at https://sg-jepa.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出Semigroup-JEPA（SG-JEPA），通过将物理参数（如重力）作为动作条件注入JEPA世界模型的时序预测模块，并联合训练编码器与预测器，使模型能在未见过的重力环境下零样本泛化出符合物理规律的动力学行为，验证于2D仿真和3D机器人控制任务。
analysis.claim: 通过显式引入物理对称性约束（半群结构）并联合优化编码器-预测器，JEPA类世界模型可实现零样本物理泛化，其性能提升主要源于编码器学到更物理相关的潜变量特征，而非预测器本身动力学建模能力增强。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+重力参数（标量条件）
analysis.output: 多步潜变量轨迹（用于后续策略解码）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（无真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在JEPA框架下首次系统验证物理参数条件化对零样本动力学泛化的有效性，有清晰消融（线性特征分解）、跨重力基准设计和3D机器人仿真控制增益（2.5×成功率），但仅限仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码/模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果/非马尔可夫物理），显著弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（均含真机、持续状态、端到端闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有物理洞见，实证扎实但局限在仿真，未达世界模型领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: SwingBot: Learning Whole-Body Brachiation for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Brachiation enables primates to move across overhead supports when ground paths are blocked, suggesting a complementary locomotion mode for robots operating in cluttered or hazardous environments. Bringing this capabil?ity to high-DoF humanoid robots is difficult because the controller must discover a long-horizon release-swing-capture sequence, coordinate alternating contacts with whole-body momentum, and act without reliable measurements of segment?relative displacement or hook-contact state. We present SwingBot, a learning framework for continuous humanoid brachiation with passive wrist hooks. Swing?Bot makes the task trainable by organizing learning around the structure of brachi?ation: biomimetic keyframes make rare release-swing-capture transitions reach?able during early exploration, and recurrent privileged-state estimation provides compact position and contact latents for deployment. Hardware experiments demonstrate continuous bar traversal and robustness to payload, external distur?bances and different bar spacings, showing that this formulation offers a practical route to whole-body robotic brachiation.

analysis.tldr: 提出SwingBot框架，让带被动腕钩的高自由度人形机器人学会在悬垂横杆间连续摆荡通行（类似猴子臂行），用生物启发关键帧降低探索难度，用带特权信息的循环状态估计解决接触与位姿感知缺失问题，并在真实机器人上验证了负载变化、外部扰动和不同杆距下的鲁棒通行能力
analysis.claim: 通过结构化学习（生物关键帧+特权状态估计）可使高自由度人形机器人在无精确接触/相对位移测量条件下，实现鲁棒、连续的全身体摆荡通行
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度、IMU、电机电流、视觉（未明确但隐含用于初始定位？摘要未提传感器细节）、杆间距先验（训练时假设已知）
analysis.output: 全身体关节扭矩指令序列（即控制策略输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制带被动腕钩的人形机器人硬件平台（摘要称'hardware experiments'，但未命名型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据进行闭环验证，但未说明是否依赖大量真实交互数据训练（摘要强调'sim2real transfer'隐含仿真预训练+真机微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实高自由度人形机器人上实现连续、多杆、抗扰的全身体摆荡通行，具备明确任务新颖性（brachiation for humanoid）和工程鲁棒性证据（payload/disturbance/spacing三类泛化），但未开源代码模型、未与SOTA locomotion基线（如WBC/latent world models）做定量对比，也未证明其框架可迁移至其他机体或开放环境，属显著推进但未达基石级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实人形机器人上首次系统实现臂行通行，技术路线扎实且验证充分，但缺乏跨平台复现性、基准对比和理论普适性，属于高质量应用级突破而非范式重构

papers.title: WholeBodyWAM: Generalizing Pre-trained World-Action Priors to Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via WBC-Grounded Coordination
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising approach to general-purpose robot manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and actions. However, most WAM studies focus on tabletop or arm-centric manipulation, while humanoid loco-manipulation remains less explored. To address this gap, we introduce WholeBodyWAM, which jointly predicts future visual dynamics, manipulation actions, and whole-body control intents for generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation. It preserves pre-trained world-action priors while grounding heterogeneous whole-body controller (WBC) semantics and coordinating whole-body behavior. Extensive experiments show that WholeBodyWAM achieves an overall simulation task success rate of 91.9%, with a 0.23 improvement in real-world out-of-distribution task progress and a 70% reduction in success-rate variance across WBCs relative to the respective baselines. These results suggest a path toward scalable humanoid whole-body intelligence by extending pre-trained world-action priors through structured WBC grounding and coordination, rather than relearning whole-body behavior from scratch. Project page: https://wholebodywam.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把原本用于桌面机械臂的World Action Model（WAM）扩展到人形机器人全身运动-操作协同任务，通过将预训练的视觉-动作先验与全身体控制器（WBC）语义对齐并协调，让模型能同时预测未来视觉变化、操作动作和全身控制意图，在仿真中达到91.9%任务成功率，并在真实机器人上提升了OOD任务进展和跨WBC策略稳定性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Zhuo Li/Yiming Yao等姓名常见于中/美高校，但无具体 affiliation 提示）

analysis.output: 未来视觉动态预测 + 操作动作 + 全身控制意图（WBC-level 控制信号或目标）
