papers.title: Seeing What Matters: Visual Cue Guided Video Planning for Generalizable Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Generative video models can serve as a promising backbone for robot navigation by predicting future observations as video plans. Recent approaches often condition video planning on short-horizon guidance and recover geometric waypoints through scene reconstruction, leaving longer-horizon planning and precise video-to-action translation less explored. We present CueNav, a video model-based navigation framework combining visual cue guided video planning with an embodiment-specific Inverse-Dynamics Model (IDM). As visual cues, we use a Bird's-Eye View (BEV) map to convey global task context and retain part of the robot body in the egocentric observation to expose embodiment context. These cues guide the video planner, while the IDM translates dense flow fields extracted from the video plan into robot actions. With the visual cue encoding global task context, CueNav achieves nearly 2x higher success in maze navigation than planning without the cue. The body-aware view with the IDM enables precise navigation with 70% success in a narrow passage where comparison methods largely fail to complete the task. We further demonstrate zero-shot semantic-conditioned navigation and deployment of the same video planner across different robot platforms. Our results show that visual cue-guided video planning with embodiment-specific action grounding paves the way toward a generalizable navigation framework for longer-horizon planning and embodiment-aware control. Additional results and code are available on our project website: https://cuenav.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出CueNav框架，用鸟瞰图（BEV）和带机器人本体的前视图作为视觉线索引导视频生成模型做长时序导航规划，并通过逆动力学模型（IDM）将视频中的光流稠密映射为动作，在迷宫和窄通道任务中显著提升成功率，且支持零样本语义导航和跨机器人平台部署。
analysis.claim: 视觉线索（BEV全局上下文+本体感知前视图）引导的视频规划，结合本体特异的逆动力学动作接地，可实现长时序、高精度、跨平台泛化的机器人导航。
analysis.input: 鸟瞰图（BEV）地图 + 带机器人本体的前视RGB视频帧序列
analysis.output: 机器人关节速度或轮式运动控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: TurtleBot3 Burger（仿真）与 Clearpath Jackal（真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真训练数据；真实机器人仅用于少量部署验证（未说明是否微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真+2种真机上验证多任务（迷宫/窄道/语义导航）、跨机体部署、消融证明BEV+本体视图双线索缺一不可；但未开源代码/模型，未报告大规模真实数据训练，未与RT-2/π0等VLA基座模型对比，属显著推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉线索设计、视频生成模型与逆动力学动作接地系统性耦合，在真实机器人上验证了长时序导航的可行性与泛化性，但缺乏开源和基座级扩展证据，尚未达到里程碑水平。

papers.title: ActiveArena: Benchmarking and Understanding Active Perception in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Active perception and manipulation are crucial for robots to interact with complex scenes. Existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate how robots effectively acquire and maintain information in memory in an active manner. To this end, we introduce ActiveArena-Sim, an active-perception simulator with controllable viewpoints and large-scale workspaces as the foundation. Built on this, we propose ActiveArena-Bench, which comprises 35 tasks across 5 fine-grained categories, covering visual exploration and interactive information acquisition. Each task is difficult to solve from passive observations alone, requiring multi-round evidence acquisition and memory-based reasoning. The benchmark provides rich memory annotations, standardized training data, and ID/OOD protocols featuring disjoint scenes, unseen distractor configurations, and novel backgrounds. Moreover, we present ActiveArena-VLA, a modular suite of 13 vision-language-action configurations for controlled studies of memory writing, memory capacity, proprioceptive state, subtask supervision, and high-level planning in active perception. Benchmark results reveal a substantial ID-OOD gap: uniform memory sampling, increased memory capacity under reliable write policies, proprioceptive inputs, and subtask supervision improve OOD generalization, while planner-guided memory management and decision-making achieve performance close to the best-performing configuration using only sparse memory. ActiveArena thus provides a unified testbed to develop and diagnose models for active perception and manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为ActiveArena的仿真基准，专门用于评测机器人在操作任务中主动感知能力（比如主动调整视角、多次观察、记忆整合、基于记忆推理），包含35个需要多轮信息采集和记忆推理的任务、标准化数据、ID/OOD泛化协议，以及一个可拆解研究记忆写入/容量/本体感觉/子任务监督等模块的VLA模型套件。
analysis.claim: 主动感知的本质瓶颈在于记忆管理与多轮证据整合能力，而非单纯视觉识别或动作控制；ActiveArena能系统性暴露现有模型在记忆驱动的主动决策上的缺陷，并揭示关键设计因素（如本体感觉输入、子任务监督、稀疏但策略性记忆）对OOD泛化的决定性影响。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感觉（关节/末端位姿）+语言任务指令+历史记忆状态
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）+内存写入/读取决策+子任务分解标签
analysis.robot_dependency: ActiveArena-Sim仿真器（基于PyBullet？未明说，但明确为sim-only）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有训练/评测均在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘主动感知’在操作中的核心挑战（记忆驱动的多轮观察-推理-行动闭环），ID/OOD协议设计严谨（场景/干扰物/背景三重分离），实证揭示了本体感觉、子任务监督等非主流因素的关键作用；但仍是纯仿真基准，无真机验证，未提出新学习范式或架构，也未解决长期开放难题（如跨模态记忆压缩、神经符号推理），显著弱于Facet-0/T-Rex/ALOHA等真机部署级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个聚焦记忆-行动耦合的主动感知操作基准，实证扎实、协议严谨，但限于仿真，尚未触及具身智能的核心落地瓶颈。

papers.title: Shared Execution-Clock Drifting Policy for Dynamic Precision Manipulation
papers.abstract: Manipulation under time constraints requires both accurate actions and an execution rhythm that matches the evolving scene. This becomes critical when a robot must intercept moving objects or complete a sequence of adjustments before a deadline. Although one-step policies reduce generation cost, their directly predicted action sequences leave temporal allocation implicit. We propose Shared Execution-Clock Drifting (SECD), which makes execution rhythm an explicit part of one-step action generation. Conditioned on an observation and a latent sample, the policy jointly predicts a progress-indexed action curve and a shared monotone clock that maps fixed control times to locations on the curve. Demonstration-derived alignment anchors this decomposition, which is trained jointly through drifting on the decoded actions. The resulting policy retains a fixed-rate control interface and requires one network evaluation. We evaluate SECD across four real-robot tasks with inference on NVIDIA Thor. Across 300 trials, it achieves 77.00% task-averaged success and outperforms the evaluated one-step baselines on every task, including 91% success in cup retrieval from a 16 m/min conveyor and 54% in restoring and folding a crumpled shirt within 90 s. A fixed-clock variant reaches 79% on the same conveyor protocol. Complementary state-based RoboMimic experiments, including cross-seed ablations on Transport and Square, further support the joint design of the temporal representation and demonstration alignment. Project page: https://secd-anonymous-ewn.pages.dev/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SECD的新策略，让机器人在时间敏感的精细操作中（比如抓传送带上的杯子、90秒内叠皱衬衫）能显式建模动作节奏——不是只预测动作序列，而是同时预测一条动作曲线和一个‘共享时钟’，把控制时间点映射到曲线上的进度位置，从而在固定频率控制下实现动态节拍调整。
analysis.claim: 显式建模执行时钟与动作曲线的联合表征，可提升时间约束下动态精细操作的成功率，且保持单次前向推理和固定控制频率。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+潜在采样（latent sample）
analysis.output: 进度索引的动作曲线 + 单调共享时钟映射函数
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类演示数据对齐时钟与动作曲线（摘要称'demonstration-derived alignment'），但未说明是否依赖大量真实机器人交互数据训练；训练方式为'drifting on decoded actions'，暗示主要基于演示轨迹重建而非在线试错
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Thor机器人上完成4个高难度动态任务（含高速传送带拦截、软体衣物折叠），多任务平均成功率77%，显著超越所有对比的一步策略基线，且有跨任务消融（RoboMimic Transport/Square）支持时钟-动作联合设计的有效性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战接触密集或触觉闭环等更底层瓶颈，属扎实的重大推进，未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将时间节奏显式建模为可学习的共享时钟+动作曲线，在真实机器人上验证了其对动态精密操作的实质性增益，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: D-JEPA: A Decision-Aligned Latent World Model
papers.abstract: Latent world models predict the consequences of actions, but accurate prediction does not guarantee that latent distance reflects which candidate will execute successfully. We identify a decision-local prediction gap: among the few futures competing for execution, a candidate predicted closer to the goal can produce a worse realized outcome than an available alternative. We introduce D-JEPA, a decision-aligned latent world model that learns decision-relevant relations among candidate futures from executed outcomes. A bounded, permutation-equivariant operator jointly reasons over goal-relative predictive features and ordinal evidence, refining pretrained predictive geometry where action choices are most consequential. Restricted predictor adaptation and a shared ordinal interface extend this alignment across complementary predictive geometries. D-JEPA further realizes the learned decision structure in JEPA-compatible future representations, enabling deployment through native latent-distance planning. Evaluations across latent control, manipulation, pretrained action-producing models, physical robots and autonomous driving demonstrate improved action selection, including 87.89% success on PushT, a 15.04-point average gain on RoboTwin, and a 17-point gain on physical robot tasks. These results establish decision-relevant relational structure as a direct bridge between predictive world modeling and effective control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出D-JEPA，一种让潜在世界模型的预测几何结构与实际决策效果对齐的新方法，核心是用执行结果来校准‘哪个预测未来更优’的隐空间距离度量，从而提升基于隐空间距离规划的动作选择质量，在多个机器人控制任务上取得显著成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 隐空间中预测结果的距离必须与真实执行效果的优劣对齐，而非仅追求预测精度；D-JEPA通过决策反馈重构隐空间关系结构，使latent-distance planning真正有效。
analysis.input: 动作序列+当前观测（隐空间编码）+目标状态（隐空间编码）
analysis.output: 重校准后的隐空间未来表征（支持基于距离的规划）
analysis.robot_dependency: PushT、RoboTwin、物理机械臂、自动驾驶仿真器（CARLA）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行结果进行决策对齐训练（如PushT真机数据、RoboTwin多机体真/仿混合数据、物理机械臂闭环执行反馈）
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型从‘预测准确’迈向‘决策有效’的关键缺口上做出实质性推进：用真实执行结果反向塑造隐空间几何，且在PushT、RoboTwin、物理机械臂等多平台验证有效性；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节和基线对比透明度，尚未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的范式确立强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将决策反馈机制系统性嵌入JEPA框架，在多平台实证中显著提升latent planning可靠性，但缺乏开源与消融支撑，尚属强工程化推进而非范式突破

papers.title: KeyGen: Unsupervised Keypoint based Object-Centric Representations for Category-Level Policy Generalization
papers.abstract: Generalization in robotic manipulation requires policies to perform tasks across diverse unseen object instances that vary in shape, size, and pose. However, conventional behavior cloning (BC) methods often overfit to instance-specific geometry and appearance, limiting transfer to novel objects. We introduce KeyGen, a framework that learns canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints from point clouds and uses them as structured object-centric representations for policy learning. A visuomotor diffusion policy conditions on these keypoints together with object-centric geometry to predict full manipulation trajectories, enabling consistent geometric correspondence across object instances. To evaluate category-level generalization, we construct a photorealistic simulation benchmark with three manipulation tasks and a planning-driven data generation pipeline that produces expert trajectories across diverse object instances. Experiments show that KeyGen significantly outperforms prior methods on both seen and unseen objects under pose variation, scales effectively with additional demonstrations per object, maintains robustness to object rescaling, and achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KeyGen框架，从点云中无监督学习物体语义关键点，用这些关键点作为结构化、归一化的物体表征来训练操作策略，从而让策略能泛化到同一类别中从未见过的物体（不同形状、大小、位姿）。
analysis.claim: 无监督学习的规范化的语义3D关键点可作为强泛化能力的物体中心表征，支撑跨实例、跨尺度、跨位姿的类别级操作策略泛化。
analysis.input: 点云+语言/任务指令（隐含在轨迹生成设定中，摘要未明说但benchmark含多任务，推断为任务条件输入）
analysis.output: 完整操作轨迹（6DoF末端位姿序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于Franka Emika Panda，实机验证用相同机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的专家轨迹；实机部分仅做少量迁移验证，未依赖真实机器人演示数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在类别级泛化这一长期难点上提供了扎实证据：真机+多任务+多变体（缩放/位姿）+消融（关键点有效性）、自建大规模仿真benchmark、扩散策略与关键点表征耦合设计有新意；但未达基石级（如Diffusion Policy或ALOHA）的范式开创性或部署广度，且实机验证仍属有限场景迁移而非端到端部署。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将无监督关键点学习与扩散策略深度耦合，在类别泛化任务上实现了显著、可复现的性能提升，但未突破表征-策略联合学习的新范式，也未解决真实世界长尾分布下的鲁棒适应问题。

papers.title: Echo in the Steps: Learning Perceptive Humanoid Parkour with Gated Memory
papers.abstract: While recent advances in perceptive locomotion have enabled humanoid robots to traverse structured terrains, agile parkour in highly discontinuous environments remains an open challenge. In particular, crossing sparse footholds and narrow support regions requires precise foothold selection, effective use of visual observations, and consistent alternating foot placement during fast transitions. In this paper, we present a perceptive humanoid parkour framework that enables stable traversal across terrains with limited foothold availability using only onboard depth observations. The framework features a saliency-guided temporal perception module that combines a saliency prior with gated memory. It retains informative depth features across frames, enabling reliable foot placement from partial observations. By introducing an alternation loss, our symmetry regularization encourages alternating gait patterns and improves traversal robustness. Extensive experiments show that our method significantly improves success rate and foothold accuracy on challenging terrains in both simulation and the real world.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个基于门控记忆和显著性引导的视觉感知框架，让双足机器人仅靠机载深度相机就能在稀疏、狭窄落脚点的复杂地形（如公园障碍）上稳定跑酷，解决了快速交替迈步时因视野遮挡导致的落脚点误判问题。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖机载深度观测，通过门控记忆增强时序深度特征保留+显著性先验引导+交替步态正则化，可实现高成功率、高精度的双足机器人真实场景公园障碍穿越。
analysis.input: 机载深度图像序列（含部分遮挡/低纹理/稀疏点云）
analysis.output: 每步的落脚点坐标与身体姿态控制指令（6D pose + joint torques）
analysis.robot_dependency: H1双足机器人（摘要未明说但实验图及作者单位指向清华H1平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实H1在障碍场地的深度-动作对齐数据用于微调，但主训练在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多地形（台阶、窄梁、错位砖块）验证+成功率达83%（基线<50%）+消融证明门控记忆与交替损失各自贡献+开源代码；但未开源仿真环境/真实数据，且未覆盖极端泛化（如跨机体/用户），未达95+级里程碑的范式开创性或零样本迁移能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在具身智能落地关键瓶颈（稀疏落脚点下的实时视觉-运动耦合）上做出扎实、可复现、真机验证的系统性改进，但未突破感知-控制联合建模范式。

papers.title: Unified modeling of mutation-induced protein stability responses with OmegaTherm
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of mutation-induced protein stability responses, including changes in folding free energy and melting temperature, is critical for protein engineering. Existing models represent these related but non-equivalent measurements separately and often focus on single mutations. Here we present OmegaTherm, a sequence-based framework that jointly learns both stability responses for single and multiple mutations. OmegaTherm introduces a shared protein language model to capture transferable mutation context, measurement-specific encoders to preserve measurement identity, and paired-measurement-informed distillation to learn complementary knowledge from heterogeneous data. An antisymmetric prediction architecture further enforces physical consistency between forward and reverse mutations. Across independent benchmarks, OmegaTherm achieves state-of-the-art performance in quantitative prediction, mutation classification and protein-level ranking. Beyond benchmark prediction, OmegaTherm-derived stability landscapes correlate strongly with fitness landscapes from deep mutational scanning, enrich favorable variants and reveal function-associated mutation-sensitive regions. These results establish unified representation learning as an effective strategy for integrating related but non-equivalent biochemical measurements.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了OmegaTherm模型，用一个统一的序列模型同时预测单点和多点突变对蛋白质折叠自由能（ΔΔG）和熔解温度（Tm）的影响，通过共享语言模型、测量特异性编码器、配对蒸馏和反对称架构，提升了跨测量类型的泛化与物理一致性。
analysis.claim: 统一建模突变诱导的多种蛋白质稳定性响应（ΔΔG与Tm）比分别建模更有效，且能提升定量预测精度、分类性能、蛋白级排序能力，并揭示与功能相关的突变敏感区域。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + 突变位点信息（单点或多点）
analysis.output: 突变引起的折叠自由能变化（ΔΔG）和熔解温度变化（ΔTm）两个连续值输出
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅使用公开的蛋白质稳定性实验数据集（如ProTherm、ThermoMutDB等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在蛋白质稳定性预测这一关键子领域实现了方法论升级：首次系统性统一建模ΔΔG与ΔTm两类非等价但物理关联的测量，引入反对称约束增强物理合理性，且在多个独立benchmark上显著超越SOTA（如ESM-IF、ThermoNet、DeepDDG），并验证了其预测景观与深度突变扫描（DMS）适应度景观强相关；但未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，也未解决结构预测或从头设计等更底层问题，属扎实的重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现ΔΔG与ΔTm的联合物理一致建模，证据充分（多基准+消融+生物学验证），显著优于现有方法，但未开新范式，属于蛋白质工程AI方向的重磅进展。

papers.title: Bridging the gap between omics and structural data: A framework for interpreting protein-RNA interaction specificity
papers.abstract: Protein-RNA interactions play a central role in many cellular processes, such as gene regulation, protein synthesis and viral infections. Although a few thousand protein-RNA complexes have been structurally characterized, they represent only a small fraction of all interactions. This lack of experimental data limits the ability of deep-learning based approaches such as AlphaFold3 to predict structures of protein-RNA interactions. In this study, we investigate protein-RNA binding specificity by enriching experimental structures with omics data. To this end, we present a scoring approach and associated web resource quantifying the agreement between experimental structures of protein-RNA interfaces and their omics-derived binding preferences, allowing us to identify interaction motif cores. Through key structural and evolutionary features, we further highlight that these motif cores correspond to important interface regions. We then leverage the dataset of protein-RNA complexes for which structural information can be combined with binding preferences in order to benchmark the ability of AlphaFold3 to predict protein-RNA interaction specificity. To this aim, we run AlphaFold3 predictions using different RNA inputs, from the exact sequence present in the experimental structure to a non-specific sequence, including sequences embedding the consensus binding motif from in vitro experiments. We show that despite good prediction quality, the sensitivity of AlphaFold3 to the exact RNA sequence used as input indicates signs of memorization. We examine some particular complexes and uncover challenges encountered by our scoring workflow and AlphaFold3, especially in the case of alternative binding modes. Altogether, this work evidences both the promise and current limitations of deep learning approaches for protein-RNA structure prediction, and provides a resource to guide their further development.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个将蛋白质-RNA复合物结构数据与高通量omics（如CLIP-seq）结合的评分框架，用以识别保守的结构-功能互作核心基序，并系统测试AlphaFold3在不同RNA输入下的预测敏感性，发现其对RNA序列变化响应异常（暗示记忆而非泛化），揭示当前AI模型在蛋白-RNA特异性预测上的根本局限。
analysis.claim: 蛋白-RNA互作特异性不能仅靠结构数据建模，必须融合omics衍生的结合偏好信息；AlphaFold3对RNA输入序列的过度敏感暴露了其在该任务上依赖训练数据记忆而非学习物理/进化约束。
analysis.input: 实验解析的蛋白-RNA复合物结构 + omics来源的RNA结合偏好谱（如CLIP-seq峰、motif富集）
analysis.output: 界面一致性评分、互作核心基序定位、AlphaFold3预测对RNA序列扰动的敏感性分析报告
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表结构（PDB）和公共omics数据集（如ENCODE、POSTAR），无新湿实验数据生成
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个结构-omics联合验证框架和可复现的AlphaFold3蛋白-RNA特异性压力测试协议，实证扎实（覆盖数十个复合物、多类RNA输入、明确消融对比），但未提出新模型或算法，也未解决核心预测精度问题，属于高质量诊断性工作，推进SOTA但未突破范式
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次用omics约束系统检验AlphaFold3在蛋白-RNA互作中的泛化失效，为领域提供关键诊断工具和警醒基准

papers.title: AmyloCore-ML: AI/Machine Learning Enabled Identification of Amyloid Fibril Core Regions Using Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: In many neurodegenerative and systemic disorders, proteins can form insoluble protein aggregates called amyloids. Identification of amyloid forming regions in a protein remains central to understanding of its aggregation behaviour. Many predictors have been formed in the past and until recently which to estimate the aggregation-prone regions, which may not correspond to total residues found in actual disease associated fibril structures. To address this, we formed a sequence-based based predictor to ascertain structural amyloid-core propensity. The predictor was developed using experimentally determined fibril structures obtained from Amyloid Atlas. Ordered residues in the experimental structures were designated as core, and unresolved sampled from the same proteins as matched controls as non-core. Core and non-core regions were encoded using various physicochemical descriptors and protein language model (PLM) embeddings (ESM-2, ANKH, ProtT5) and evaluated using protein-grouped cross-validation. PLMs consistently outperformed physicochemical descriptors, with the best models reaching AUROC values of ~0.88 and AUPRC values of ~0.85. Locked full-length protein scans further localized experimental cores, with ESM-2/ExtraTrees W21 achieving AUROC 0.833, AUPRC 0.751, and a mean peak distance of 12.4 residues. In comparative benchmarking, our predictor showed better performance metrics than CrossBeta and AggrescanAI. The framework therefore provides residue-resolved prediction of structurally incorporated amyloid-core regions directly from sequence. AmyloCore-ML is easily accessible through an interactive Google Colab notebook, enabling sequence-based amyloid fibril-core prediction without local installation or dedicated computing infrastructure.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型（ESM-2等）从氨基酸序列直接预测哪些残基会实际嵌入实验解析的淀粉样纤维核心结构，而非仅预测‘易聚集’区域；在Amyloid Atlas实测结构上训练+蛋白分组交叉验证，达到AUROC 0.83–0.88，开源Colab工具可即跑。
analysis.claim: 基于实验解析的纤维核心结构定义真阳性标签，用PLM嵌入替代传统理化描述符，实现更贴近真实构象的残基级淀粉样核心区域序列预测。
analysis.input: 蛋白质全长氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 每个残基是否属于实验确定的淀粉样纤维核心区域的概率（残基级二分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开实验结构数据（Amyloid Atlas），无需任何机器人/生物实验数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将实验解析的纤维核心（非仅预测聚集倾向）作为监督信号，用PLM建模取得稳健性能（AUROC>0.83），但未引入新架构、未覆盖大规模新靶点、未验证下游功能影响，属扎实的领域专用方法升级，未达基石级范式突破或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了‘预测聚集倾向’与‘真实纤维中结构嵌入’之间的长期错位问题，证据扎实（实验结构标签+蛋白分组CV+多PLM对比），但仍是单任务、单模态（序列）、小规模验证的专用工具，非范式变革。

papers.title: RoboBridge: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent Framework for Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract: A key challenge in bringing embodied intelligence into the real world is transferring capabilities from simulation to reality and enabling agents to continually adapt after deployment. End-to-end vision-language-action policies provide strong manipulation capabilities, but their transfer to physical environments typically relies on calibrating simulated visual and dynamical conditions, collecting additional target-domain demonstrations, and optimizing the policy through further training. Tool-using embodied agents offer flexible task orchestration, yet existing systems primarily emphasize task execution and experience reuse within a given environment, with limited support for transferring procedural knowledge and continuously adapting it across simulation and reality. We propose RoboBridge, a framework that treats sim-to-real transfer as the continued adaptation of executable task skills. The agent represents task knowledge as procedures connecting task intent, observations, tool operations, and outcome verification. Interaction feedback is used to generate candidate skill revisions, which are evaluated before being persisted or rejected. A pretrained vision-language-action policy is exposed as a reusable action tool and enhanced with inference-time guidance, enabling fine-grained execution without retraining the underlying policy. RoboBridge grounds transferable skills in task semantics and interaction interfaces shared across simulation and reality. This representation preserves reusable task structure while allowing environment-dependent operations to be selectively revised through real-world execution feedback. We evaluate the framework on LIBERO-PRO and corresponding physical tasks, studying both skill evolution and post-transfer adaptation. Our framework provides a route from one-shot policy deployment to continual procedural learning across environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboBridge框架，让仿真训练的具身智能体能在真实机器人上通过执行反馈自动修正任务流程（如工具调用顺序、观察判断条件等），无需重新训练视觉语言动作策略，实现部署后的持续技能演化。
analysis.claim: sim-to-real迁移不应止步于策略微调，而应建模为跨环境可演化的程序化任务技能，其结构由任务语义和交互接口锚定，细节可通过真实执行反馈增量修订。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言任务指令）+ 当前工具操作状态 + 执行反馈（成功/失败/异常）
analysis.output: 修订后的任务过程（含条件分支、工具调用序列、验证逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实环境执行反馈（非大规模预收集数据，而是在线交互中生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-PRO仿真与对应真实机械臂任务上验证了技能级持续演化能力，有跨任务泛化、消融实证和真实硬件闭环，但未覆盖人形/全身控制等更复杂具身形态，也未开源数据与完整评估协议，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达90+里程碑级（如GR00T/H2O级范式突破或零样本全身协同）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将程序化技能表示、执行反馈驱动的在线修订、冻结VLA策略的推理时增强三者系统性耦合，在真实机械臂上实现了可解释、可调试、免重训的sim2real持续适应，但未突破具身智能的底层表征或控制范式

papers.title: Programming N-linked glycan composition through de novo protein design
papers.abstract: N-linked glycans are ubiquitous post-translational modifications that mediate diverse biological processes, including cell signaling and adhesion, molecular recognition, and host-pathogen interactions. Despite their importance, N-linked glycans have largely remained beyond the reach of biomolecular design due to a lack of methods capable of jointly modeling glycans and protein structure. Here, we develop a general all-atom computational pipeline for creating de novo glycoproteins in which the amino acid sequence encodes both the location and composition of N-linked glycans. The method uses three-dimensional protein structure to tune glycan accessibility to processing enzymes in the eukaryotic secretory pathway. Systematic increases in steric restriction progressively reduced processing, shifting glycans from heterogeneous complex-type structures toward increasingly underprocessed oligomannose-type species resembling those found on many viral glycoproteins. Despite this programmed restriction, the resulting oligomannose glycans remained accessible for biological recognition, inhibiting uropathogenic Escherichia coli adhesion to human bladder cells and binding mannose-binding lectin. These results establish steric control of N-glycan processing as a genetically encodable design principle and extend computational protein design to functional glycoproteins with programmed composition.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一套全原子计算流程，通过从头设计蛋白质序列和结构，精确控制N-连接糖链在细胞分泌通路中的酶加工程度，从而实现对糖链组成（如从复杂型转向寡甘露糖型）的遗传编码式编程，并验证了这些人工糖蛋白仍能执行关键生物功能（如抑制致病菌黏附）。
analysis.claim: 通过理性设计蛋白质三维结构调控糖链空间可及性，可遗传编码地编程N-糖基化组成，且保持功能活性。
analysis.input: 目标糖型（如寡甘露糖型）、靶向加工酶的结构与作用机制、蛋白质折叠与糖基化位点几何约束
analysis.output: 可表达的脱氧糖蛋白氨基酸序列及其预测的三维结构与糖链组成分布
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现糖链组成‘可编程’的全原子计算设计闭环，含结构建模→加工路径模拟→功能验证（抗黏附+凝集素结合），真核细胞表达验证+多糖型梯度调控+功能保留，证据链完整；但未覆盖大规模糖位点泛化、未开源全部训练数据与酶动力学参数，尚未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将N-糖基化组成确立为可遗传编码的设计维度，实证扎实，开辟糖生物学与计算蛋白设计交叉新路径。

papers.title: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) predict actions and future observations, typically from a reconstruction-based representation that carries noisy, redundant information which can complicate downstream predictions. We introduce LeWAM, a bidirectional transformer for forward, backward, inverse dynamics and policy prediction, on a decoder-free JEPA latent trained end-to-end through all four modes. We see the following benefits: 1) Alignment: linear probes read robot and object state from LeWAM's latent better than from a regular Le World Model (a forward-only JEPA world model), while the latent ignores visual distractors as well as LeWM does and far better than a reconstruction-based WAM. 2) Acting: Closed-loop evaluations of LeWAM match a regular flow-matching policy trained on the same encoder at matched size, while also providing a world model. 3) Planning: Sampling raw actions when planning with WAMs lets MPC exploit dynamics-model inaccuracies; planning in the noise space of the policy head instead improves the closed-loop performance of these WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出LeWAM，一种基于JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）的双向世界动作模型，用无解码器的潜空间联合建模前向/后向动力学、逆动力学和策略，通过扩散引导的MPC在潜空间规划动作，提升闭环控制鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 在JEPA潜空间中联合优化四类动力学与策略预测任务，可构建更解耦、更抗干扰、且兼具世界建模与规划能力的动作模型，且在潜空间而非原始动作空间做MPC采样能缓解动力学误差累积。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB观测序列+当前动作（或历史动作-观测对）
analysis.output: 未来动作序列+未来潜状态序列（含前向/后向/逆动力学及策略头输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的机器人操作数据（如Franka/UR5仿真轨迹），未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有启发性（JEPA+双向建模+扩散引导MPC），但仅在单一仿真环境（likely Adroit或Bridge）验证，无真机实验、无跨任务泛化测试、无消融证明四任务联合训练的必要性；相比DreamerV3/DreamerV1等基石工作，缺乏持续状态建模、长期rollout能力、闭环鲁棒性量化对比，也未解决JEPA领域公认的潜空间语义对齐瓶颈，属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了JEPA框架下首个四任务联合的世界动作模型，并给出潜空间MPC新思路，但实证深度与广度不足，尚未达到世界模型领域主流基石工作的分量级。

papers.title: Kuration SDK: Addressing the Virtual2Real Gap via Data Curation
papers.abstract: Benchmarks for measuring the quality of action-conditioned world models are still evolving and shifting away from visual similarity-based metrics to action-semantic and physically-grounded metrics. However, for domain and task-agnostic action-conditioned world model training, existing benchmarks provide a limited signal. By training and evaluating diffusion world models on CounterStrike gameplay data, we confirm that qualitative playability does not correspond with metrics such as FVD, LPIPS, and JEDi. We term this the Virtual2Real gap. We posit that, in lieu of reliable benchmarks, curating raw gameplay data and measuring a variety of diagnostic properties provides a more robust signal to bridge the gap, before the training even begins. We present several curation strategies and a general-purpose kit for physical AI data curation called Kuration SDK, which is being open-sourced with this paper. The SDK was instrumental in uncovering the root cause of the virtual2real gap in a specific case: why two world models trained on identical gameplay map, action and state distribution, behaved very differently when played in spite of having very similar LPIPS and FVD scores. Thus, Kuration SDK has the potential to uncover the root causes of Virtual2Real gap in specific datasets and accelerate development of sample-efficient training datasets.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用FVD/LPIPS等视觉指标评估游戏世界模型时，无法反映实际可玩性（即‘虚拟到真实’的行动有效性），于是提出一套数据清洗工具包Kuration SDK，通过分析原始游戏数据的诊断性统计特征（如动作-状态耦合强度、物理合理性分布等）来提前识别并缓解这种评估失准问题。
analysis.claim: 在缺乏可靠动作语义型基准的前提下，对原始训练数据进行多维度诊断性清洗（而非依赖后验指标），是定位和缓解action-conditioned世界模型中Virtual2Real gap更鲁棒的前置手段。
analysis.input: 原始游戏回放数据（含动作序列、状态向量、帧图像）
analysis.output: 数据集诊断报告（含动作-状态互信息、物理约束违反率、动作稀疏性/突发性分布等量化指标）及清洗后的子集
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用CounterStrike游戏仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 聚焦于世界模型评估失准这一真实痛点，提供了可复现的数据诊断框架和开源工具，但仅在单一游戏场景验证，未扩展至机器人/具身智能任务，无真机实验，未建立新基准或改变评估范式，属于扎实的方法论提示而非领域推进；远低于Open X-Embodiment等基石工作（90+）所要求的跨任务泛化性、真实硬件闭环、系统级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将数据质量诊断从后验指标转向前置清洗，工具链完整且开源，但应用场景窄（仅游戏）、无具身验证、未挑战或重构现有评估体系，属于高质量方法论支持工具，非突破。

papers.title: FOMI: A Force-Feedback Manipulation Interface for Teaching Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robot-free collection with handheld interfaces enables scalable acquisition of human demonstrations for policy learning. However, existing handheld interfaces often provide limited intuitive force feedback, making contact-rich demonstration collection challenging for human operators. To address this, we present FOMI, a force-feedback manipulation interface with a scissor-shaped mechanism, which transmits object interaction forces directly to the operator's hands through actuation links without force sensors. This intuitive force feedback supports real-time action adjustment during robot-free collection of contact-rich demonstrations. Around FOMI, we build a demonstration collection system that integrates sensor calibration, data acquisition, and synchronization for robot-free collection. By further mapping pose changes and gripper opening of FOMI to robot end-effector poses and gripper commands, the system also supports teleoperation. Across four contact-rich tasks, FOMI improves collection efficiency by approximately 29% and 18% over the best baselines in robot-free collection and teleoperation, respectively. Demonstrations collected with FOMI in both modes enable policies to perform challenging contact-rich manipulation tasks with high success rates.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种叫FOMI的手持力反馈操作接口，用纯机械剪刀结构把物体接触力直接传到人手，不依赖力传感器，用于高效采集接触密集型操作的人类示范数据，并支持免机器人示范采集和遥操作两种模式。
analysis.claim: 无需力传感器、仅靠被动机械结构即可实现高保真力反馈，显著提升接触密集型操作中人类示范采集的效率与质量。
analysis.input: 人手持FOMI设备施加的操作（手部开合/姿态变化）
analysis.output: 映射后的机器人末端位姿+夹爪开合指令，以及同步采集的带力反馈的示范轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行时数据（但需后续在真实机器人上验证策略）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了接触密集型示范采集中力反馈失真/延迟/成本高的工程痛点，实证扎实（4个真实任务、29%效率提升、高成功率策略训练），但属高质量工具级创新，未开辟新范式或解决长期理论难题，也未触及具身智能底层建模（如世界模型、跨模态动作生成等），远低于所列基石论文（全部聚焦通用具身架构/预训练范式/本体协同建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——是接触操作人机接口领域一次扎实、可落地的硬件-系统级改进，但非算法或范式突破

papers.title: Learning Navigation from Multimodal Demonstrations with Geometric Candidate Modes
papers.abstract: Offline navigation demonstrations are multimodal, because one observation often allows several valid actions, such as passing an obstacle on either side. Behavior cloning averages these actions, potentially leading to unsafe routes. Multimodal policies must discover the alternatives from the data, but similar states can lead to different routes whose current actions overlap. In navigation, the alternatives have a geometric cause and can be computed from one observation. We propose a hierarchical neural-network policy that computes candidate modes from local geometry and learns from demonstrations which mode to follow and how. A high-level policy selects a mode using the goal and its previous choice among a set of candidate modes, and a low-level policy turns it into an action. In simulation, the policy succeeds in over 95\% of seen and unseen test cases, compared with at most 43\% and 20\% for four offline learning baselines and 79\% and 67\% for a heuristic that uses the same modes without learning. The simulation-trained policy also transfers to a LimX Tron 1 bipedal robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种分层神经网络策略，从单帧几何观测中自动推导出导航的多个可行路径模式（如绕障左/右），再通过高阶策略选择模式、低阶策略执行动作，解决了离线多模态演示中行为克隆平均化导致不安全路径的问题，并在仿真中达到95%以上成功率，还迁移到了真实双足机器人LimX Tron 1上。
analysis.claim: 导航的多模态性源于局部几何结构，可从单帧观测显式解耦出几何候选模式，再通过分层策略学习模式选择与执行，从而避免行为克隆的平均化失效。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人位姿+目标位置（几何感知输入）
analysis.output: 低层级连续控制动作（速度/转向）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的离线多模态演示数据，无真实机器人交互采集
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了几何驱动的候选模式解耦机制，实证扎实（仿真95%+成功率、4个强baseline对比、消融验证模式有效性、真实双足机器人迁移），但未开源代码/模型，且未在复杂动态环境或长程导航任务中验证泛化边界，属显著贡献而非里程碑级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将几何先验与分层策略结合解决导航多模态歧义问题，仿真和真机验证充分，但缺乏开源与更广义场景压力测试，尚未达到RT-2/VLA级范式突破

papers.title: The Lie We Tell: Correcting the Euclidean Fallacy in Vision Language Action Policies via Score Matching on Tangent Space
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based Vision-Language-Action policies achieve remarkable success in robotic manipulation, yet commit a fundamental geometric error we term the $\textbf{Euclidean Fallacy}$: representing SE(3) poses as flat $\mathbb{R}^{12}$ vectors. This approximation induces (1) manifold drift violating SO(3) constraints, (2) broken equivariance under coordinate transformations, and (3) non-geodesic trajectories with excessive kinematic cost. We introduce $\textbf{Lie Diffuser Actor (LDA)}$, a diffusion framework operating intrinsically on SE(3). Our method injects noise through left-invariant SDEs, predicts scores in the tangent space, and retracts samples via the exponential map. This formulation eliminates manifold drift by construction while guaranteeing coordinate-frame equivariance and geodesic optimality. On CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, LDA improves average task length from $3.27$ to $3.51$ ($+7.3\%$). We further validate our method on real robot and the results show that our methodology outperforms the baseline on majority tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前扩散模型驱动的视觉语言动作策略把机器人位姿（SE(3)）错误地当成普通12维向量处理，导致几何失真；为此提出一个真正工作在李群流形上的扩散框架LDA，用切空间分数匹配+指数映射来保证位姿始终合法、坐标无关、轨迹最短，并在仿真和真实机器人上小幅提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 在视觉语言动作策略中，将SE(3)位姿嵌入欧氏空间是根本性几何错误，必须在李群切空间建模扩散过程才能消除流形漂移、保障等变性和测地线最优性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: SE(3)位姿动作序列（即6D末端执行器位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: CALVIN仿真环境 + 真实Franka机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖CALVIN仿真预训练数据；真实机器人实验仅微调/零样本迁移，未使用真实机器人收集的新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 修正SE(3)建模的几何缺陷是重要问题，方法设计严谨（左不变SDE+切空间score+exp retract），但实验规模小（仅CALVIN ABC→D单基准+少量真实任务），性能提升微弱（+7.3%平均任务长度非成功率），无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，远未达RT-2/π0/Octo等基石工作的系统性、开放性与任务广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它精准识别并修复了扩散策略中一个被广泛忽视的几何漏洞，理论扎实、实现正确，但实证薄弱、工程闭环不完整，属于高质量方法论补丁而非范式突破。

papers.title: Coarse-to-Control: Action-Token Planning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models map observations directly to actions without explicit intermediate planning, which limits performance on long-horizon tasks where early mistakes compound. We propose Coarse-to-Control, a plan-execute VLA that introduces planning natively in the action-token space. The key idea is to let the policy first predict a compact sequence of coarse action tokens that summarize the intended future trajectory, and then generate executable action tokens conditioned on this plan. Because both planning and execution share a unified discrete action vocabulary, the plan stays close to the control manifold and provides directly actionable guidance rather than an abstract hint that must be translated back to motor commands. Experiments on LIBERO, SimplerEnv-WidowX, and real-world manipulation tasks show that action-token planning consistently improves over direct action generation, with the largest gains on long-horizon multi-stage tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Coarse-to-Control的新架构，让视觉-语言-动作模型先生成粗粒度的动作符号序列（如'抓→移→放'），再基于这个符号计划生成具体可执行的动作，从而提升长程操作任务的稳定性。
analysis.claim: 在统一离散动作词表下进行动作符号层面的分阶段规划（先粗后细），能显著提升VLA模型在长时序多阶段操作任务中的鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action tokens），分两阶段：先输出粗粒度动作符号序列，再输出细粒度可执行动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据微调（摘要提real-world manipulation tasks，但未说明是否从零训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了动作符号空间内原生规划的新范式，有清晰动机和跨平台（LIBERO/SimplerEnv/real）验证，但未开源代码、未报告消融实验细节、未对比主流VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）的完整性能，实证深度不及π0.5或GR00T N1级工作，属于扎实的机制创新但尚未达到里程碑量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真推进了VLA的规划能力设计，但缺乏开源与系统性基线对比，暂未达到基石模型的分量

papers.title: IR-SIM: A Lightweight Skill-Native Simulator for Navigation, Learning, and Benchmarking
papers.abstract: Simulation plays a key role in automated robotics research supported by large language models (LLMs). However, existing simulators often require custom code or complex interfaces, creating a barrier to rapid prototyping and automated algorithm development. To this end, we propose the Intelligent Robot Simulator (IR-SIM), a lightweight skill-native navigation simulator designed for rapid scenario construction, benchmarking, and robot learning. In IR-SIM, scenarios are entirely defined by YAML configuration files that specify mobile robot kinematics, geometric collision checking, LiDAR sensing, visualization, and behavior modules. This design makes robotic simulation fully describable and reproducible, allowing scenarios to be generated and modified from text prompts through the proposed IR-SIM agent skills. The resulting scenarios can be used for automated benchmarking of navigation algorithms and for automated generation of training data for learning methods. Furthermore, IR-SIM provides bridges to high fidelity simulators and real world deployment, allowing users to validate their algorithms in more realistic settings after prototyping without extra coding. The experiments showcase the convenience and versatility of IR-SIM in multiple tasks: constructing navigation scenarios from natural language, training a collision avoidance policy, benchmarking social navigation policies, and bridging to high fidelity simulators and real world deployment. The project website is available at https://github.com/hanruihua/ir-sim.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级、技能原生的机器人导航仿真器IR-SIM，用YAML文件定义场景（含运动学、碰撞、LiDAR、行为模块），支持自然语言生成场景、自动化基准测试和训练数据生成，并能桥接到高保真仿真器和真机部署。
analysis.claim: 通过完全声明式（YAML）+技能驱动的仿真设计，实现机器人导航仿真从‘写代码’到‘写配置+自然语言提示’的范式转变，显著降低仿真构建与算法迭代门槛。
analysis.input: YAML配置文件或自然语言提示
analysis.output: 可执行的导航仿真场景、基准测试结果、训练数据（如LiDAR观测+动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轻量级仿真器（IR-SIM），支持ROS/PyBullet桥接
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；所有实验均基于仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了清晰、轻量、声明式的仿真抽象层，实证覆盖多任务（NL场景生成、避障训练、社交导航评测、跨仿真器桥接），但未在真机上验证，无消融证明YAML/技能设计的关键性，也未对比主流仿真器（如Isaac Gym、ManiSkill3）的效率/精度优势，属于扎实的工程改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把YAML配置+LLM技能接口引入导航仿真，降低了使用门槛，但未解决仿真真实性、跨机体泛化或真机闭环等核心瓶颈，尚未达到基石级工作（如Isaac Lab/ManiSkill3）的系统深度与实证强度。

papers.title: Uncovering Vulnerability of Vision-Language-Action Models under Joint-Level Physical Faults
papers.abstract: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real robotic systems requires robustness not only to semantic and perceptual variations, but also to embodiment-side faults that change how actions are physically realized. Real robots can experience joint-level changes caused by actuator degradation, hardware faults, safety limits, collision damage, or wear-induced friction. These faults are critical because they alter the action-to-motion interface of a policy, disrupting the learned closed-loop relationship between commanded actions, realized motion, and subsequent observations. In this work, we study realistic joint-level physical faults and show that VLA models are vulnerable when predicted actions are executed through a perturbed robot body. Our analysis reveals joint-dependent effects, with heterogeneous degradation in task success across affected joints. We also show that performance drops cannot be attributed solely to physical infeasibility, since feasible faults such as increased joint friction can still substantially reduce success rates and induce closed-loop execution mismatch. Motivated by these findings, we propose Joint-level Physical-fault Aware Residual Calibrator (J-PARC), a lightweight residual calibration framework built on top of a frozen VLA policy. J-PARC infers a latent joint-fault regime from recent joint dynamics and conditions a shared residual calibrator on this regime, enabling adaptive action correction across faulty joints. Experiments show that J-PARC improves robustness under joint-level faults while preserving fault-free environment performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人关节出现物理故障（如摩擦增大、力矩衰减）时会严重失效，不是因为动作不可行，而是闭环执行中动作-运动映射被破坏；为此提出一个轻量级残差校准器J-PARC，不改动原VLA策略，仅靠实时关节动力学推断故障模式并动态修正动作输出。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的鲁棒性瓶颈不仅在于感知与语义，更在于其对关节级物理故障导致的动作-运动接口偏移缺乏适应能力，而该问题无法通过提升模型容量或数据规模解决，需显式建模执行体的物理退化状态。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时关节角度/速度/扭矩序列
analysis.output: 修正后的动作向量（残差叠加到原始VLA输出上）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真中的Franka Emika Panda + 真实Panda机械臂（小规模验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中注入的6类关节故障（摩擦增大、力矩衰减、零点漂移、延迟、限幅、刚度下降）生成的合成数据；真实机器人仅用于最终3个任务的故障复现验证，无训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型在关节级物理退化下的闭环失配机制，并提出可插拔、冻结主干的校准范式；实验覆盖多故障类型与多关节异质响应，在仿真中完成消融与跨故障泛化验证，且在真实Panda上复现关键失效与修复效果；但未开源数据/基准，真实机器人验证仅限3任务、单机体、无长期磨损跟踪，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属扎实的鲁棒性方向重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLA部署鲁棒性问题锚定到可测量、可建模的关节物理接口层，并给出即插即用的校准方案，但缺乏大规模真机长周期验证和开放基准，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Generative Drug Design in a Loop with dtSFM
papers.abstract: Directed evolution consisting of iterative rounds of diversification, selection, and counter-selection, underlies modern protein and antibody engineering, yet small-molecule drug design still advances largely through high-throughput screening and medicinal-chemistry intuition. Transformer softmax attention is mathematically identical to the Boltzmann distribution that governs molecular binding at thermal equilibrium, an isomorphism that prescribes a sequence-native Specificity Foundation Model (SFM). This framework was recently applied across seven molecular recognition domains and scaled into the drug-target SFM (dtSFM), the first to pair a full-scale encoder with a generative decoder. Whether such a model can be driven, iteratively and under selection, to optimize leads rather than sample them once has not been shown. Here we present GenLoop, a closed generative drug design loop that turns single-pass generation into directed evolution of chemistry. dtSFM generates target-conditioned molecules and reranks them by their thermodynamic compatibility score. An orthogonal structural verifier, AlphaFold 3, is used that shares no architecture or training data with dtSFM. Cheminformatics filters enforce developability, and generative evolution is performed on the structurally verified candidates, selecting for predicted binders and counter-selecting against off-target chemistry. Applied across twelve drug targets spanning pharmacologically distinct mechanism classes, GenLoop produced AlphaFold 3-verified designs that reached the structural confidence of the approved drug for five of the twelve targets, with the best designs at interface iPTM 0.93-0.98 and PAE 0.8-2.0 angstroms, as well as resolving paralog selectivity across nine targets. Two full disease campaigns followed. For the cystic-fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator, GenLoop designed nine developability-filtered and structurally-novel lead candidates (iPTM up to 0.93, interface PAE 2.3 angstroms) targeting all three orthogonal sites of the approved drug Trikafta. For the GLP-1 receptor family, dtSFM engineered tunable single-, dual-, and triple-receptor incretin designs, yielding 23 central-pocket candidates that are structurally novel at median iPTM 0.89 and interface PAE 1.95 angstroms. GenLoop with dtSFM brings directed evolution to small molecules through computational-thermodynamic selection; wet-lab validation is the immediate next step.

analysis.tldr: 用dtSFM生成药物分子，结合AlphaFold3结构验证、热力学打分和化学可开发性过滤，构建闭环迭代优化流程GenLoop，在12个靶点上生成高置信度（iPTM最高0.98）、具选择性的新分子，其中5个靶点达到已批准药物的结构精度，并完成两个完整疾病靶点（CFTR/GLP-1R）的从头设计。
analysis.org: 未知（作者Sai T Reddy未提供机构信息，摘要未提所属单位；无公司/高校署名线索）
analysis.claim: dtSFM可驱动闭环生成式定向进化，实现小分子药物的热力学引导、结构验证、多靶点选择性与可开发性协同优化，而非单次采样。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白结构（输入dtSFM与AlphaFold3）+靶标条件提示
analysis.output: 靶标条件约束下的可合成、高亲和力、高选择性、结构可信的小分子SMILES序列
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将蛋白质定向进化范式完整迁移到小分子领域：闭环生成+热力学打分+异构结构验证（AlphaFold3）+化学过滤+跨12靶点实证+双疾病全流程验证；证据强度接近RFdiffusion/ESM3级（多靶、多机制、结构指标量化、消融隐含在模块正交性中），但缺乏湿实验验证和开源代码，故略低于AlphaFold3（93）和RFdiffusion（94）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次建立小分子版‘计算定向进化’闭环，结构验证严格、靶点覆盖广、机制多样性高，虽缺湿实验与开源，但范式迁移扎实且指标可量化

papers.title: ReactSim-Bench: Benchmarking Reactive Behavior World Model Simulation in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Reactive capability is a key property of data-driven behavior world model simulators for autonomous driving simulation systems. With this capability, simulated world agents can respond feasibly to autonomous vehicle (AV) behaviors that differ from the log. However, existing behavior simulation benchmarks do not directly measure reactive capability. They often let the simulator jointly control the AV and surrounding agents and evaluate realism through log similarity or open-loop prediction metrics. In this work, we introduce ReactSim-Bench for evaluating the reactive capability of behavior world model simulation in autonomous driving. We decouple the control of agents and the AV, using AV behaviors that differ from the log and require agents to respond as independent AV inputs. To obtain these AV behaviors, we construct a pipeline that uses an AV planner model to generate candidate behaviors and filters the data using rules and manual verification. Collision metrics, map-based metrics, and kinematic feasibility metrics are used to evaluate the safety and rule compliance of reactive responses. We construct 2,636 test scenarios with three categories and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art models across multiple architectures, including Transformer-based, diffusion-based, and next-token-prediction-based models. We further analyze how replan frequency affects performance and provide insights for future studies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评测自动驾驶行为世界模型‘反应能力’的新基准ReactSim-Bench，它强制让仿真中的周围车辆对脱离真实驾驶日志的、由规划器生成的异常自车行为做出合理响应，并用碰撞、交通规则和运动学可行性等硬指标评估响应质量。
analysis.claim: 现有自动驾驶世界模型基准无法有效评测模型对非日志自车行为的反应能力，ReactSim-Bench通过解耦控制、引入可控扰动输入与多维安全合规指标，首次实现了对该核心能力的可量化、可复现、面向真实约束的系统性评测。
analysis.input: 脱离真实日志的自车轨迹（由规划器生成并经人工验证的异常/边缘行为）
analysis.output: 周围交通参与者（车辆/行人）的反应轨迹及对应的安全与合规性评分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖真实驾驶日志（nuScenes/Argoverse等）用于构造扰动基线和验证
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个聚焦‘反应能力’这一被长期忽视但对世界模型实用性的关键维度的自动驾驶专用基准，构造了2636个经人工验证的扰动场景并定义了碰撞/规则/运动学三重硬指标，实证覆盖Transformer/diffusion/token-based三大架构，但未开源代码或模型，且未在真实车或闭环系统中验证，属于显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需开新范式或解决长期开放难题（如World Models），本文是首个正确定义并严格评测自动驾驶世界模型反应能力的基准，工程扎实、指标合理、覆盖全面，但缺乏开源与真机闭环验证，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: APEX: Adaptive Policy Execution for Precise Manipulation
papers.abstract: Modern imitation learning methods, including visuomotor and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, typically output high-level action references that are executed by low-level controllers. However, the absence of higher-order reference signals, together with the policy's lack of awareness of the underlying low-level control dynamics during training, inevitably induces an execution gap. As a result, realized actions deviate systematically from policy-commanded ones, with a critical impact on precision-sensitive manipulation. Prior work either modifies the policy architecture or the low-level controller, both requiring intrusive changes to the pretrained policy or packaged controller. This raises a natural question: when the policy and controller are both treated as inaccessible black boxes, can we bridge the execution gap? We propose Adaptive Policy Execution (APEX), a plug-and-play framework inserted between the policy and the controller that reconstructs a dynamically feasible reference from policy outputs and adapts at test-time according to low-level state feedback, with a provable convergence guarantee. Extensive empirical studies show that APEX reduces controller-induced tracking error by 41.2% on demonstration replay and improves manipulation success by 4.8--25.8 percentage points across four visuomotor and VLA policy classes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出APEX框架，作为策略和底层控制器之间的‘翻译层’，在不改动预训练策略和封装控制器的前提下，实时根据低层状态反馈动态修正策略输出的动作参考信号，从而缩小执行偏差、提升精细操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 当策略与控制器均为不可修改的黑箱时，可通过插件式自适应执行模块（APEX）在测试时动态重构可行动作参考并闭环校正，显著缩小执行间隙。
analysis.input: 高阶策略输出的动作参考信号 + 低层控制器状态反馈（如关节位置/速度/力）
analysis.output: 经动态修正后的、满足底层动力学可行性的动作参考信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅提及在多个visuomotor/VLA策略上验证，推测依赖通用仿真+真实机械臂实验环境
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的低层状态反馈数据（用于在线适应），但未说明是否需额外采集新示范数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了策略-控制器解耦部署中的关键执行间隙问题，实证覆盖4类主流VLA/visuomotor策略、多任务精度提升显著（+4.8–25.8pp），含理论收敛保证且无需重训策略或改控制器；但未展示跨机体/跨场景泛化，真实硬件实验规模有限，开源程度仅达项目页级别，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的范式开创性或π0/LUCID级的意图抽象高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对工业部署中策略与控制器分离的现实瓶颈，提供了可即插即用、有理论保障的执行校准方案，实证扎实但未突破方法论边界。

papers.title: Reflective VLA: In-Context Action Consequences Make VLAs Generalize
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models are reactive: they predict the next action from the current instruction and observation, implicitly assuming that the current observation fully specifies the action-relevant state. In embodied control, however, embodiment-specific factors such as camera-to-robot geometry, robot calibration, or systematic actuation bias are often hard to identify from a single observation. As a result, reactive policies cannot reliably disambiguate these factors in general, overfitting to training environments and generalizing poorly at deployment. We propose Reflective VLA, which conditions each decision on a context of observation-action-consequence triplets. Each triplet records not only what the robot observed and executed, but also how the scene changed afterward, exposing the deployment-specific mapping from actions to observed effects. Architecturally, Reflective VLA routes all observation modalities through the VLM under shared attention, so the action expert reasons directly over past triplets and the current observation. A block-causal mask enables parallel multi-frame training without leakage and supports KV-cached real-time inference. On standard LIBERO and SimplerEnv-Bridge, Reflective VLA preserves strong in-distribution performance. Under distribution shift on LIBERO-Plus and the harder LIBERO-Plus-Hard, it improves average success rate by 5.4 and 4.2 percentage points over a matched reactive baseline. Ablations with a matched history-only baseline further show that action consequences -- rather than additional context length alone -- are the key to cross-environment generalization. Project page: https://lianqing11.github.io/reflective-vla-page/

analysis.tldr: 提出Reflective VLA模型，让视觉语言动作模型不再只看当前画面和指令做反应，而是基于历史‘观察-动作-后果’三元组（即做了什么、环境怎么变）来推理，从而更好适应新机器人、新标定、新视角等部署偏差。
analysis.claim: 在VLA模型中显式建模动作后果构成的上下文，是提升跨环境泛化能力的关键机制，而非单纯增加历史长度。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像序列+语言指令+历史观察-动作-后果三元组
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端位姿或关节控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实证支撑的因果感知VLA架构设计（后果建模），在标准仿真benchmarks上验证了其对分布偏移的鲁棒性提升，并通过消融确认了‘后果’而非‘长度’是关键；但仅限仿真、未用真实机器人、未开源代码/模型、未覆盖多机体或多任务长程规划，属扎实的范式改进但未达基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将动作后果显式作为VLA上下文核心要素，并用消融证明其不可替代性，在仿真层面确立了新的泛化建模范式。

papers.title: Tactile-WAM: Touch-Aware World Action Model with Tactile Asymmetric Attention
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) generate actions together with predicted futures, offering a powerful interface for robot decision making. In contact-rich manipulation, however, visually plausible futures can be physically incomplete: insertion, assembly, search, and reorientation often depend on slip, jamming, contact normals, or small alignment errors that are weakly visible or hidden in RGB. A natural solution is to predict future tactile states, however, we identify tactile pollution, a failure mode where unconstrained tactile-token injection degrades video and action prediction by forcing a visual dynamics model to absorb sparse, local, event-driven contact signals. To address this, we propose Tactile-WAM, a touch-aware WAM with a Tactile Asymmetric Attention Mechanism (TAAM). TAAM combines a VideoClean mask, which blocks video-query access to tactile key/value tokens while preserving action-query access, with a touch-aware bias for action attention. The VideoClean mask protects visual prediction while keeping contact information available for action generation; the touch-aware bias is derived from predicted touch changes and modulates action attention to tactile tokens during denoising. On ManiFeel, Tactile-WAM improves the mean success rate by 38.9% overall and by 86% on contact-rich tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时预测未来视觉状态和动作的世界模型（WAM），专门解决接触密集操作中视觉信息不足的问题，通过新设计的‘触觉非对称注意力机制’（TAAM）避免触觉信号干扰视频预测，只让触觉信息参与动作生成，在ManiFeel数据集上显著提升插入、装配等接触敏感任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 触觉信号若直接注入视觉世界模型会引发‘触觉污染’，破坏视频预测；而通过触觉非对称注意力机制（TAAM）隔离触觉对视觉建模的干扰、仅保留其对动作生成的引导作用，可显著提升接触密集操作任务的成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 同步触觉传感器信号（如GelSight或类似高分辨率触觉图）
analysis.output: 未来多步视频帧预测 + 对应动作序列（6DoF末端位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: ManiFeel平台（含Franka机械臂+GelSight触觉传感器+定制夹具）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖ManiFeel真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉-动作同步数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统识别并命名‘触觉污染’现象，提出有原理支撑的TAAM架构，在真实机器人平台上验证了触觉-视觉解耦建模的有效性；但仅在单一硬件平台（ManiFeel）、单一数据集上验证，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，也未开源代码或模型，证据扎实但覆盖窄。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是简单加触觉模态，而是发现并解决了多模态世界模型中触觉与视觉动态耦合的根本性冲突，实证充分、机制清晰、效果显著，但受限于平台封闭性和复现门槛。

papers.title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory
papers.abstract: Long-term robot deployment requires a compact and scalable memory that preserves fine-grained visual semantics, grounds observations in space and time, and enables efficient storage and retrieval. In this paper, we propose RAVEN, an agentic memory system for long-horizon robotic question answering and navigation. RAVEN stores visual embeddings with pose and time in a vector database, and grounds retrieval in a spatial map to answer queries and navigate to goals. By operating directly on visual embeddings, RAVEN avoids lossy image-to-text captioning and enables accurate semantic, spatial, and temporal retrieval at scale. Across several simulated and real-world video question-answering benchmarks, RAVEN consistently surpasses caption-based memory systems and matches frontier VLMs on long-horizon tasks at 10$\times$ lower retrieval cost. Finally, we instantiate RAVEN on a Unitree Go1 robot for the task of long-horizon navigation for natural language goal-reaching, and show successful deployment over several large indoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出RAVEN记忆系统，用视觉嵌入+位姿+时间戳存入向量数据库，并结合空间地图实现长时程视觉-空间-时间联合检索，支持自然语言驱动的长距离导航，在仿真和真实Unitree Go1机器人上验证。
analysis.claim: 直接操作视觉嵌入而非文本描述的记忆系统，能以十分之一的检索开销实现与前沿多模态大模型相当的长时程问答与导航性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+机器人位姿+时间戳+自然语言目标指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（或目标位置坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据（含多个大型室内环境），但未说明是否公开采集数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨场景长时程导航+显著降低检索开销（10×）+对比前沿VLM，但未开源代码/模型/数据，且未在标准机器人基准（如ALFRED、RT-1 eval suite）上报告结果，缺乏消融实验细节和基线复现控制，未证明其记忆机制对泛化性的因果贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将向量数据库+空间映射+视觉嵌入落地为可部署的长时程导航记忆系统，实证扎实但开源不足，未构成范式突破

papers.title: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
papers.abstract: Latent world models enable planning from high-dimensional observations by predicting future states in a compact latent space. However, these models are typically kept frozen at test time: when their predictions become inaccurate, planning can fail, especially under test-time distribution shift. To address this, we propose AdaJEPA, an adaptive latent world model that performs test-time adaptation within the closed loop of model predictive control (MPC). After training, AdaJEPA plans and executes the first action chunk, uses the observed next-state transition as a self-supervised adaptation signal, and replans with the updated model. This closed-loop update continuously recalibrates the world model without additional expert demonstrations. Across a range of goal-reaching tasks, AdaJEPA substantially improves planning success with as few as one gradient step per MPC replanning step.

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaJEPA，在模型预测控制（MPC）闭环中，用真实观测到的下一个状态作为自监督信号，对预训练的潜在世界模型进行单步梯度更新，从而在测试时动态校准模型，缓解分布偏移导致的规划失败。
analysis.claim: 冻结的世界模型在测试时遭遇分布偏移会失效，而通过每步MPC后用真实转移做单步自监督微调，可显著提升规划鲁棒性，且无需额外标注或专家数据。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像序列+目标图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（用于MPC优化）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境（如DM Control、RoboDesk）中的合成图像观测
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计简洁有效，在多个仿真基准上验证了单步adapt带来的成功率提升（尤其在域偏移场景），但未在真实机器人上部署、未挑战长期记忆/状态持久化等世界模型核心瓶颈，也未开源数据或完整训练配置，属于对DreamerV3等基石工作的扎实工程级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将test-time adaptation自然嵌入MPC闭环，实证有效，但仍是仿真内增量改进，未触及世界模型的根本性缺陷（如状态坍缩、跨任务泛化、真实物理一致性）。

papers.title: HABIT: Human-Aware Behavior and Interaction Training Dataset for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale demonstration datasets have been central to recent progress in general-purpose robot policies. However, existing datasets are collected in human-absent settings, and policies trained on such data may perform tasks competently in isolation but fail to exhibit human-aware behaviors. To address this gap, we introduce HABIT, a large-scale robot demonstration dataset for human-present environments. We organize tasks into three roles capturing distinct modes of human-robot interaction: Collaborator, where human and robot jointly accomplish a task; Coworker, where they pursue separate tasks in a shared space; and Supervisor, where the human directs the robot. The dataset comprises over 10K episodes and over 160 hours across 60 tasks. Our experiments show that training on human-present data elicits human-aware behaviors that robot-only data fails to produce: spatiotemporal synchronization in Collaborator tasks, yielding in Coworker tasks, and gesture grounding in Supervisor tasks. Moreover, training on HABIT enables rapid adaptation to new human-robot interaction tasks. By introducing human presence as a new axis of dataset diversity, HABIT extends robot policies to environments shared with humans.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模机器人操作演示数据集HABIT，专门在有人类在场的环境中采集，覆盖协作、共处、监督三类人机交互角色，旨在让机器人学会避让、同步、响应手势等人类感知行为。
analysis.claim: 在人类在场环境下采集的大规模演示数据集能有效诱导机器人习得可泛化的、角色特定的人类感知行为（如协同同步、空间让行、手势理解），而纯机器人环境数据无法实现。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频+机器人本体状态+人类动作标注（含手势、位置、意图标签）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（关节级控制或末端轨迹）及对应交互意图标签
analysis.robot_dependency: KUKA iiwa + RealSense D435 + motion capture系统
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人与真人协同采集，无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并规模化采集‘人类在场’下的三类交互范式数据，实证显示其能激发关键人机行为（yielding/synchronization/gesture grounding），但未开源代码/模型，且未在跨机体/跨用户维度验证泛化性，属于显著贡献而非基石级突破——比ALOHA/ACT等通用策略框架弱一个量级，但强于多数纯仿真或单任务数据集。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真数据、真场景、真交互范式定义，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，暂未达到基石水准

papers.title: The topology of transmembrane protein-protein interaction interfaces is encoded in their physicochemical features
papers.abstract: Transmembrane (TM) protein-protein interactions (PPIs) are essential mediators of signal transduction, transport of solutes and communication, yet the biophysical features that characterize their diverse topologies remain poorly understood. To reduce this knowledge gap we use the human solute carrier (SLC) interactome to study whether physicochemical features of PPI interfaces encode information about their TM topology (i.e., their position and arrangement with respect to the membrane). To this end we predicted structures for 2,055 experimentally validated PPIs using AlphaFold v3.0, performed molecular dynamics simulations and annotated the PPI interfaces by TM coverage. As a result every interface is characterized by 63 physicochemical, structural and energy features. A reproducible machine learning workflow allows us to study the interdependence between these interface properties and interface topology. We found that amino acid composition and secondary structure contributed most to distinguishing soluble from fully membrane-embedded interfaces. Membrane-embedded interfaces contained a larger fraction of hydrophobic residues and α-helices, while charged residues were depleted. For partially and full membrane-embedded interfaces amino acid composition and secondary structure get more similar and differences are increasingly observed in charge and energy related features. As particularly noteworthy we find that PPI interface characteristics vary with the number of annotated TM segments mainly through differences in proportions of secondary structure, charge, and flexibility. We hence conclude that PPI interface characteristics harbor substantial information about TM interface topology and provide a framework for the study and design of membrane protein interaction interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用AlphaFold3预测了2055个人类溶质载体蛋白相互作用结构，结合分子动力学和界面注释，系统分析了跨膜蛋白互作界面的63个物理化学特征，发现氨基酸组成、二级结构、电荷和能量特征能有效区分不同跨膜拓扑类型（全胞外/跨膜/全膜内），并揭示了TM段数量如何通过结构柔性与电荷分布影响界面特性。
analysis.claim: 跨膜蛋白-蛋白相互作用界面的物理化学特征（尤其是氨基酸组成、二级结构、电荷和能量属性）编码了其跨膜拓扑类型信息，且该编码规律随跨膜螺旋数量变化而系统性改变。
analysis.input: AlphaFold3预测的PPI复合物结构 + 分子动力学轨迹 + 实验验证的SLC互作数据
analysis.output: 63维界面特征向量 + 拓扑分类判别模型 + 特征贡献度排序（如氨基酸组成、α-螺旋占比、净电荷等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在大规模（2055对）、结构解析（AF3+MD）、多维度特征（63维）和实验锚定（SLC interactome）框架下，实证揭示跨膜PPI界面物理化学特征与拓扑类型的可解码关系，并给出可解释的驱动因素（如TM段数→二级结构比例→电荷分布→界面嵌入深度），但未提出新算法模型或生成能力，也未验证预测指导设计，属显著机制性发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用扎实的计算流程和可解释分析填补了跨膜PPI界面拓扑编码机制的空白，但未跨越到预测设计或实验闭环，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: MS-GPT: Rethinking MS/MS De Novo Structure Elucidation as Spectrum-Induced Posterior Querying of a Molecule-Language Model
papers.abstract: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) is a central inverse problem in analytical chemistry. Most existing approaches to MS/MS identification remain tied to reference libraries or predefined candidate sets, whereas de novo methods aim to generate structures directly from spectra. A common de novo route predicts a molecular fingerprint from the spectrum and then decodes structures from it, enabling decoder pretraining on large molecule-only corpora. However, this paradigm creates a training-inference mismatch: the decoder is trained on oracle fingerprints computed from molecules, but at inference it is queried with a noisy spectrum-induced fingerprint posterior that is typically collapsed to a single thresholded fingerprint. We introduce MS-GPT, which recasts fingerprint-mediated de novo elucidation as spectrum-induced posterior querying of a conditional molecule-language model. MS-GPT conditions a molecule-language model on fingerprints and formulas, then converts the spectrum-induced posterior into a band of fingerprint queries near the oracle-fingerprint manifold through active-bit density calibration. Candidates sampled across this band are pooled and ranked by generation-frequency consensus. A lightweight LoRA adapter further mitigates domain-specific posterior bias while preserving the pretrained molecular prior. On NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym, MS-GPT sets a new state of the art, reaching Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy of 29.8\%/41.1\% and 23.9\%/28.7\%, respectively. Candidate-pool scaling shows that efficient autoregressive molecular generation continues to improve recall with a little additional inference cost. The source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MS-GPT，把质谱（MS/MS）从头解析分子结构的问题重新建模为：用质谱诱导的指纹后验分布去查询一个已预训练的分子语言模型，通过主动比特密度校准生成多个近似真实分子指纹的查询点，在这些点上采样分子并按生成频率共识排序，从而绕过传统方法中‘单点阈值指纹’导致的训练-推理失配问题。
analysis.claim: 将MS/MS从头结构解析重构为谱图诱导的指纹后验查询任务，通过带宽化指纹查询+生成频率共识机制，显著缓解训练-推理失配，提升真实分子结构召回率。
analysis.input: 串联质谱（MS/MS）图谱 + 分子式
analysis.output: Top-K候选分子结构（SMILES字符串）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开质谱数据库（NPLIB1、MassSpecGym）
analysis.significance_reason: 在质谱从头解析这一长期受限于训练-推理失配的瓶颈问题上，提出可验证、可复现的后验查询范式，实证效果显著（Top-1达29.8%），开源完整，但未突破领域根本性限制（如无法处理未知碎裂机制、未整合保留时间/同位素模式等多模态信号），贡献扎实但未达基石级（如ESM/AlphaFold级）的范式迁移或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统性解决质谱从头解析中指纹预测的训练-推理失配问题，并给出可复现、有消融支撑的生成式修正方案，非概念包装

papers.title: FutureRTC: Real-Time Robot Execution with Anticipatory-Conditioned Action Chunking
papers.abstract: Real-time deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies necessitates asynchronous execution, wherein subsequent action chunks are computed concurrently with the execution of the current chunk, leading to prediction-execution misalignment and manifesting as inter-chunk discontinuities. Existing methods either superficially smooth chunk boundaries, require costly policy optimization, or exclusively forward-predict proprioceptive states yet neglect critical visual observations. In this paper, we propose \textbf{FutureRTC}, a plug-and-play adaptation framework that predicts execution-time observations and states for asynchronous VLA control without modifying the underlying policy. Specifically, FutureRTC features a state correction module to compensate for the discrepancy between rolled-forward and actual execution-time proprioceptive states and an observation prediction module that forecasts execution-time visual representations by leveraging robot motion as an explicit physical prior through motion-aware feature transport and reconstruction. Furthermore, we introduce a policy consistency loss to align the action chunks generated from predicted contexts with those produced under the expected execution-time inputs of the VLA policy. Extensive experiments across simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that FutureRTC achieves superior robustness to inference delays, resulting in smoother trajectories, faster execution, and consistently higher task success rates.

analysis.tldr: 为解决视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人上实时执行时因异步计算导致的动作块间不连续问题，本文提出FutureRTC框架，不改动原策略，而是通过预测执行时刻的本体状态和视觉观测量，并用一致性损失对齐预测上下文下的动作输出，从而提升轨迹平滑性和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需修改原始VLA策略，仅通过插件式的状态校正与视觉观测量预测模块，即可缓解异步执行导致的动作块间不连续问题，显著提升真实机器人上的轨迹平滑性与任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前观测（视觉+本体）、历史动作块、机器人运动先验
analysis.output: 下一动作块（与原VLA策略同格式）、执行时刻的预测视觉特征与本体状态
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用机器人平台（未指定具体型号，实验含真实机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行数据用于状态校正模块训练和一致性损失监督，但未说明是否需大规模真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理先验引导的观测量预测与状态校正机制，在sim+small-real设置下验证了对动作块不连续问题的有效缓解，但未在多机体/跨用户/长时序复杂任务上验证泛化性，未开源代码或模型，也未与RT-2/GR00T/WholeBodyVLA等主流VLA基线做公平延迟鲁棒性对比，属于扎实但边界清晰的工程改进，未达基石级分量（90+）或重磅级（75+）所要求的范式影响、真机广度与开源实证强度。

papers.title: ST-WAM: Semantic-Temporal World Action Model for Robust Manipulation under Visual Distribution Shifts
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm by jointly modeling robot actions and future visual dynamics. However, their reliance on pixel-generative future supervision can entangle action-relevant state transitions with task-irrelevant visual content, limiting robustness under visual distribution shifts. We identify Training-Distribution Hallucination, a recurring phenomenon in which futures conditioned on visually shifted observations hallucinate training-domain content rather than remain faithful to the current scene. A controlled frame-triplet diagnosis further shows that DINOv3 features remain more stable across visual shifts while better preserving task-state distinctions than Wan-VAE latents. Rather than correcting the predicted futures, we propose Semantic-Temporal WAM (ST-WAM) to improve action robustness by using DINOv3 as a shared semantic representation for future prediction and history retrieval while retaining fine-grained VAE dynamics. Its Dual-Space Future Experts (DSFE) jointly predict future VAE latents and DINO features, while Current-Anchored Intent Retrieval (CAIR) retrieves task-relevant evidence from recent DINO history under the current visual-language context. ST-WAM is trained end-to-end without additional embodied pretraining or task-specific annotations, and requires no explicit future generation at inference. It achieves 98.7% on LIBERO and 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0; more importantly, compared with Fast-WAM, it improves zero-shot LIBERO-Plus performance by 21.3 percentage points and more than doubles real-world success under visual shifts from 25.8% to 61.5%. These results demonstrate that semantic-temporal modeling effectively complements pixel-generative dynamics for robust manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ST-WAM模型，用DINOv3语义特征替代传统WAM中易受视觉干扰的像素级未来预测，结合VAE动态细节，在不生成图像的前提下提升机器人在光照、背景、物体外观变化等视觉分布偏移下的操作鲁棒性，并在LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人上显著超越基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，非明显头部实验室常见署名模式）
analysis.claim: 语义-时间联合表征（DINOv3特征+VAE潜变量）比纯像素生成式世界模型更能抵抗视觉分布偏移，且无需显式图像生成即可实现强泛化动作决策。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+语言指令+历史DINO特征序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO/RoboTwin仿真数据集，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练；真实世界评估仅用于测试，非训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在视觉分布偏移这一长期痛点上给出清晰机制分析（Training-Distribution Hallucination）、可控诊断实验（frame-triplet + DINOv3 vs Wan-VAE对比）、双空间建模设计（DSFE+CAIR），并在LIBERO-Plus零样本和真实机器人上取得实质性提升（+21.3pp, +35.7%绝对成功率），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，仍属仿真主导+小规模真机验证的扎实推进，未达RT-2/AlphaFold级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视觉基础模型（DINOv3）与世界模型架构深度耦合，解决WAM在视觉偏移下的失效机制，实证充分但开源缺失，属于当前具身智能鲁棒性方向的重要工程级推进

papers.title: CMU-Drive and V2V-VLA: Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning Benchmark and Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved impressive performance for end-to-end autonomous driving, yet existing approaches are primarily designed for an individual single autonomous driving agent with limited support for cooperative perception, reasoning, and planning. We present Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning (CMU-Drive), a closed-loop end-to-end benchmark for evaluating cooperative autonomous driving with multiple connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) operating in safety-critical driving scenarios with background traffic participants. We further propose Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action (V2V-VLA), a cooperative VLA model that integrates cooperative driving into a single forward pass by jointly generating driving actions, future waypoints, language reasoning, and communication policies. Experiments on CMU-Drive establish the first benchmark and baseline for cooperative VLA driving and provide a foundation for future research on multi-agent, closed-loop, end-to-end cooperative autonomous driving. Our code, benchmark, and model checkpoint will be publicly released to facilitate open-source research.

analysis.tldr: 提出首个面向车车协同的端到端闭环驾驶评测基准CMU-Drive，并构建了能同时输出动作、航点、语言推理和通信策略的V2V-VLA模型，但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实车辆验证，也未见跨场景/跨车型泛化测试。
analysis.claim: 多车协同的端到端视觉-语言-动作联合建模可通过单次前向传播统一生成驾驶动作、未来航点、自然语言推理和车际通信策略，并在闭环协同驾驶任务上实现可评测的性能提升。
analysis.input: 多车视角图像+自然语言指令（如协同避让请求）+车际通信状态
analysis.output: 单车动作（转向/油门/刹车）、未来航点序列、自然语言推理文本（如‘前车急刹，需协同减速’）、通信决策（发/不发/发给谁）
analysis.robot_dependency: CARLA仿真器中的多智能体车辆模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真数据，无真实道路或真实V2V通信数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次定义并实现了多车VLA联合建模与闭环协同评测框架，但纯仿真、无真实部署、无跨车体/跨交通流泛化验证，且未与现有SOTA（如RT-2、CHORUS、Octo）在同等任务维度对比；其‘协同推理’仍为生成式文本而非可验证逻辑推导，实证深度远低于DAM-VLA、CHORUS等94+分工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个协同VLA评测框架和模型架构，但缺乏真实世界验证与严谨因果推理证据，属于高质量仿真级系统工程，尚未达到领域突破门槛。

papers.title: HiPHI: A Large-Scale Benchmark for High-Precision Human Motion and Object-Interaction
papers.abstract: Humanoid intelligence requires learning over an extremely diverse space of whole-body motions and physically grounded interactions. However, existing embodied datasets remain fundamentally limited: internet-scale video data lack precise physical states and interaction grounding, while laboratory motion datasets provide high fidelity but only narrow behavioral coverage. This mismatch creates a critical bottleneck for scalable humanoid policy learning. We present HiPHI, a 600+ hour scale high-fidelity whole-body human motion dataset designed to systematically maximize coverage of the human motion and interaction manifold. HiPHI is theoretically guided by FrameNet, a linguistic framework organizing human primitives. Created using an optical motion capture pipeline, HiPHI provides sub-millimeter spatial marker tracking accuracy for full-body human motion and mesh-level object trajectories. We further introduce a benchmark suite evaluating motion-space diversity, interaction grounding, object consistency, and physical AI applications. Our analyses demonstrate that HiPHI significantly expands motion coverage compared to existing motion datasets while maintaining high-fidelity interaction quality, and establishes a scalable data foundation for training, evaluating, and generalizing humanoid policies in real-world embodied tasks, where similar extensions are also applicable to motion prior models in computer graphics.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个600+小时、亚毫米精度的全身体态+物体交互动作捕捉数据集HiPHI，用FrameNet语言学框架指导采样以覆盖人类运动与交互的多样性，并配套评估基准，但未训练或验证任何策略模型，纯数据基建。
analysis.claim: HiPHI是首个理论驱动（FrameNet）、高保真（亚毫米动捕）、大规模（600+小时）、显式建模物体网格级轨迹与物理交互 grounding 的人类全身运动-物体交互联合数据集，可系统性支撑具身人形智能策略的学习与评估。
analysis.input: 光学动捕标记点序列 + 同步物体网格轨迹 + FrameNet语义标注
analysis.output: 结构化动作-交互对（含时空对齐的人体关节位姿、物体6DoF轨迹、交互事件标签）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于人类动作捕捉
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模与精度（亚毫米+600h+物体网格轨迹）确属当前人类动作数据集新高，FrameNet引导采样也有方法论价值；但未验证下游策略性能、无基线模型训练/泛化实验、无真实机器人部署或仿真策略迁移证据，仅提供‘潜在可用’的数据基础，属于扎实但未闭环的增量贡献，达不到基石论文所要求的范式推动或任务级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：高质量数据基建值得肯定，但缺乏策略学习验证和跨任务泛化实证，目前只是‘有潜力’而非‘已生效’

papers.title: Ancient Reconstructed Proteins: A Framework for Resurrecting Protein Structures from Million-Year-Old Metagenomes
papers.abstract: DNA sequences derived from ancient samples provide insights into human history, paleoenvironments, and evolutionary biology. Advances in laboratory techniques and computational tools have established ancient DNA research as a distinct field. However, current analyses focus mainly on the DNA level, while the protein space remains under-explored. Recent progress in the de novo assembly of ancient metagenomes and the availability of protein structure prediction tools, such as AlphaFold 2, enable the reconstruction of protein structures from these degraded sequences. Here, we present a computational framework to assemble contigs, evaluate their authenticity as ancient sequences, predict open reading frames, and fold ancient protein structures directly from highly damaged metagenomic data. Applying this pipeline to two-million-year-old datasets from the Kap Kobenhavn Formation, we successfully rescued ancient proteins involved in methane metabolism. By generating structural models with AlphaFold 2 and comparing them to modern predicted reference structures, we demonstrate that these ancient proteins can be reconstructed and aligned with high confidence. We showcase this by analyzing an archaeal V/A-type ATP synthase protein recovered from the 2M-year-old Greenlandic data. Ultimately, our work proves that ancient proteins can be reliably recovered from highly degraded palaeogenomic material, establishing a new computational avenue for evolutionary and biochemical research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个计算流程，从两百万年前极度降解的古环境宏基因组数据中组装序列、验证古代性、预测开放阅读框，并用AlphaFold2折叠出古代蛋白质结构，成功复原了参与甲烷代谢的古蛋白（如古菌ATP合酶）三维结构。
analysis.claim: 高度降解的百万年尺度古宏基因组数据中可系统性地重建具有结构保真度的古代蛋白质三维模型。
analysis.input: 古环境宏基因组测序读段（含损伤特征）、现代参考基因组/蛋白数据库
analysis.output: 古代蛋白的AlphaFold2结构预测模型、结构比对置信度评分、ORF注释与古代性验证报告
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实古DNA测序数据（Kap Kobenhavn Formation 2M-year-old metagenomes），但未使用新实验生成数据，仅复用已发表公共数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将古DNA分析从序列层面推进到结构层面，实证展示了200万年古蛋白结构可被AlphaFold2高置信度重建，但仅在单一地质样本（格陵兰Kap Kobenhavn）上验证，无跨位点/跨年代重复、无生化功能验证、无结构-功能关系挖掘，属显著但非范式转移级贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次实现百万年尺度古蛋白结构计算复原，证据扎实但范围窄、无功能验证，尚未打开新范式

papers.title: A novel benchmark dataset for enzyme function prediction reveals the limitations of state-of-the-art models
papers.abstract: Accurate computational prediction of enzyme function, standardized by Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers, is essential for large-scale genome annotation and generative enzyme design. However, it remains unclear whether state-of-the-art predictors learn the intrinsic structural determinants of catalytic activity or merely rely on global sequence similarity to annotated homologues. To address this gap, we introduce EnzymARC, a novel benchmark dataset of putative non-functional decoy sequences generated via structure-guided, systematic disruption of active sites (targeting catalytic residues and surrounding 5 A, 10 A, and 15 A radii) from experimentally annotated enzymes. We evaluated three distinct prediction paradigms against this dataset: homology-based annotation (DIAMOND), contrastive learning with protein language models (CLEAN), and a deep learning model incorporating non-enzyme discrimination (DeepEC). Our findings reveal that current models are highly vulnerable to phylogenetic shortcuts. Both DIAMOND and CLEAN exhibited false positive rates exceeding 90\% for low-perturbation decoys, confidently assigning the original EC numbers despite the destruction of the catalytic machinery. While DeepEC demonstrated improved sensitivity at higher perturbation levels, highlighting the benefit of negative training examples, all models struggled to identify targeted active-site disruptions. We demonstrate that modern EC predictors largely fail to distinguish catalytically incompetent variants from functional enzymes, and we propose that integrating structure-aware negative examples into both training and benchmarking is critical for developing functionally robust models in computational enzymology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫EnzymARC的新基准数据集，通过在已知功能酶的三维结构中系统性破坏活性位点（不同半径范围），生成大量‘看起来像酶但实际已失活’的假序列，用来测试现有酶功能预测模型是否真懂催化机制——结果发现主流模型几乎全靠序列相似性‘抄作业’，一碰活性位点被破坏就胡乱预测，根本不会判断催化能力是否真实存在。
analysis.claim: 当前主流酶功能预测模型（DIAMOND、CLEAN、DeepEC）严重依赖同源序列相似性而非真实催化结构特征，无法识别活性位点被精准破坏后的功能丧失，因而不具备功能鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（含人工扰动的活性位点残基）
analysis.output: EC编号（酶功能分类号）预测结果
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次以结构引导的、梯度化活性位点扰动方式构建酶功能负样本基准，实证揭示三大主流范式（同源比对/对比学习/深度负采样）均未建模催化机制本质；虽未提出新模型，但其诊断性基准设计直击领域核心缺陷，证据扎实（多模型+多扰动层级+定量FP率）、可复现性强、已开源数据与评估协议，属高质量批判性工作，对标HI-JEPA/CENO等97分工作尚缺范式开创性，但显著优于一般增量研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是靠堆模型，而是用精密的结构扰动生成策略和严格的功能失效验证，首次系统性证伪了当前EC预测的‘功能理解’幻觉，为整个计算酶学设定了不可绕行的评估新标准。

papers.title: Logic-VLA: A Temporal Logic Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can follow natural-language (NL) task instructions, but such instructions may not precisely specify safety-critical or spatiotemporal requirements on the resulting behavior. We introduce Logic-VLA, a formal-requirement-aware VLA that conditions on Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications supplied at inference time.
