Logic-VLA uses a syntax-graph-based STL encoder pre-trained to capture temporal logic semantics. Policy adaptation proceeds in two stages: STL-conditioned supervised fine-tuning on satisfying demonstrations is followed by trajectory-level preference optimization over matched satisfying-violating rollout pairs using a flow-matching surrogate for Identity Preference Optimization. This formulation improves formal requirement satisfaction while preserving the nominal NL task. We evaluate Logic-VLA in closed-loop quadcopter navigation simulation across randomized photorealistic environments and test generalization to STL formulas unseen during training. Across the evaluation benchmarks, Logic-VLA improves STL satisfaction rate over an STL-blind base policy by 24.8 to 40.7 percentage points (pp) while reducing nominal NL task success by at most 1.8 pp, showing that a single VLA can adapt its behavior to varying formal requirements without requiring a separate policy for each specification.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Logic-VLA，一个能在执行自然语言指令的同时、实时响应用户输入的信号时序逻辑（STL）形式化约束（比如‘先避开红色区域，再在5秒内到达目标’）的视觉-语言-动作模型，在仿真四旋翼导航任务中验证了它能大幅提升对形式化要求的满足率，且几乎不损害原始语言任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 单个VLA模型可通过推理时注入Signal Temporal Logic（STL）规范实现对安全关键和时空行为约束的动态适应，无需为每条约束训练专用策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+Signal Temporal Logic（STL）公式
analysis.output: 动作序列（四旋翼控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的满足/违反STL的成对轨迹数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将STL形式化约束显式注入VLA模型推理流程，并在闭环仿真中验证了跨公式泛化能力与任务-约束解耦性；但仅限单一体型（四旋翼）、单一仿真环境、无真实硬件验证，未触及VLA基础架构升级（如世界模型、分层规划），也未挑战多机体/长程任务/开放词汇约束等更难维度，属于扎实的前沿方法拓展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在VLA框架中打通了形式化验证需求与端到端策略执行的接口，但仍是仿真限定下的方法增强，非基石级突破

papers.title: PredVLA: A Sub-Million-Parameter Predictive-Coding Policy for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large pretrained vision-language-action models dominate modern robot-manipulation benchmarks, but it remains unclear how much model scale is necessary for strong language-conditioned control, or whether fundamentally different control architectures can remain competitive at much smaller parameter budgets. We present PredVLA, a language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with only 0.68 million trainable network parameters and no robot-data pretraining, whose hierarchical generative recurrent dynamics predict visual features and proprioception while observations influence latent state only through online inference from the resulting sensory prediction errors. On LIBERO, PredVLA achieves an 86.9% mean success rate across the three short-horizon suites and 75.4% when the long-horizon suite is included. Under a controlled comparison using the same frozen front end, demonstrations, action decoder, and evaluation protocol, PredVLA achieves 3.7x and 7.4x mean success rates of parameter-matched Transformer and LSTM policies, respectively. The predictive-coding formulation also makes the contribution of observation-driven correction directly measurable: because observations influence the recurrent state only through prediction-error-based latent inference, disabling this inference yields an exact open-loop control condition. Together, these results show that a sub-million-parameter recurrent generative policy can achieve strong performance on modern language-conditioned manipulation benchmarks while providing an explicit mechanism for prediction-error-driven online state correction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个仅68万参数的轻量级预测编码策略PredVLA，不依赖机器人数据预训练，用递归生成式动态建模视觉特征和本体感觉，仅靠在线预测误差更新隐状态，在LIBERO基准上达到86.9%短程任务成功率，且在相同冻结视觉编码器和动作解码器条件下，性能是同参数量Transformer和LSTM的3.7倍和7.4倍。
analysis.claim: 子百万参数的预测编码式递归生成策略，无需机器人数据预训练，即可在语言条件操控基准上实现强性能，并提供可测量的预测误差驱动在线状态修正机制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（经共享动作解码器映射）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（摘要明确‘no robot-data pretraining’）
analysis.significance_reason: 性能扎实（LIBERO短程86.9%），机制清晰（预测误差即修正信号），但仅限仿真基准、无开源、无真实机器人验证、未跨任务/机体/用户泛化，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或工程闭环水平，属高质量增量——比刷榜小模型强，但离开新架构范式或实际部署尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在严格控制变量下验证了预测编码架构对小参数量语言操控策略的有效性，但缺乏开源、真实硬件验证与跨场景泛化，尚未构成范式突破或实用化进展。

papers.title: AM-Bench: A Modular Simulation Suite and Benchmark for Aerial Manipulation Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Standardized benchmarks have played a central role in advancing robot manipulation learning, yet most focus on ground-supported manipulation systems, which limits their applicability to dynamics-critical domains such as aerial manipulation (AM). AM presents distinct system-level challenges, including environmental disturbances, coupled dynamics between the manipulator and floating base, and constrained degrees of freedom. Consequently, task performance depends jointly on robot embodiment, low-level control, and high-level policy design. We introduce AM-Bench, a modular simulation suite and benchmark for multirotor-based AM policy learning. AM-Bench includes representative embodiments spanning underactuated, fully actuated, and overactuated systems, 12 tasks across contact, transport, and constrained interaction, configurable aerodynamic disturbances and actuator saturation, standard low-level controllers, and baseline policy-learning algorithms. Unlike prior manipulation benchmarks that primarily emphasize end-to-end policy performance, AM-Bench enables system-level evaluation of how embodiment, control, disturbances, and policy choices interact. We demonstrate its diagnostic value through three simulation studies spanning high-level policies, policy--control interfaces, and embodiments, together with real-world validation of modeled effects and a hardware test of the learning pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于空中机械臂（多旋翼无人机+机械臂）策略学习的模块化仿真套件和基准测试AM-Bench，覆盖多种机体构型、12类典型任务、可配置扰动与执行器限制，并支持从高阶策略、控制接口到本体设计的系统级归因分析，且做了仿真验证和真实硬件管道测试。
analysis.claim: 空中机械臂策略学习不能沿用地面操纵基准，必须建立能解耦评估本体、控制、扰动与策略交互影响的模块化仿真基准。
analysis.input: 任务指令（隐式，通过任务重置参数定义）+ 状态观测（含IMU、关节编码器、视觉等仿真传感器数据）
analysis.output: 低层控制指令（如电机PWM或力矩）或高层动作序列（取决于策略层级）
analysis.robot_dependency: Gazebo/PX4仿真栈 + 自研多旋翼-机械臂耦合动力学模型；真实验证使用Custom quadrotor-arm platform（未公开型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，所有训练/评估在仿真中完成；真实硬件仅用于端到端学习管道的可行性验证（非训练数据源）
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了空中机械臂领域缺乏系统级可解耦基准的空白，仿真设计严谨（覆盖欠/全/过驱动构型、12任务、扰动建模）、有真实硬件管道验证，但未开源数据集/预训练模型，且未在多平台部署或跨实验室复现，相比RT-X/DROID等基石级工作仍属领域专项推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向空中机械臂系统级归因分析的模块化仿真基准，实证扎实但生态开放度不足，尚未达到开新范式或大规模复现门槛。

papers.title: ChainSplat: A Physics-Inspired Screw-Theoretic Model for Learning Deformable Linear Object Dynamics from Multi-View RGB Videos
papers.abstract: Identifying the underlying dynamics and 3D geometry of deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as cables, ropes, and hoses, is essential for accurate robotic manipulation, but remains challenging due to their high-dimensional configuration spaces and diverse behaviors arising from varying material properties. Existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines and auxiliary depth inputs, which are prone to errors under dynamic interactions, while their high-dimensional state representations make model-based control computationally expensive. In this paper, we introduce ChainSplat, a physics-inspired framework that jointly learns the 3D geometry, appearance, kinematics, and dynamics of DLOs solely from multi-view RGB videos. ChainSplat represents a DLO as an open-chain structure of rigid links connected by revolute joints, yielding an analytic, screw-theoretic model with a compact state representation parameterized by joint configurations. By integrating this formulation with Gaussian splatting, ChainSplat jointly recovers DLO dynamics, kinematics-aware 3D geometry, and appearance, while enabling high-fidelity RGB rendering from arbitrary states. Through real-world experiments, we demonstrate that ChainSplat achieves state-of-the-art performance in dynamics predictions, 3D geometry reconstruction, and RGB rendering across dynamic interactions. ChainSplat further enables real-time state and force estimation, as well as accurate model-based trajectory optimization, highlighting its practical utility for real-world robotic manipulation of DLOs. Accompanying source code and video are available at: https://chainsplat.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 仅用多视角RGB视频，把软绳/电缆建模成带转动关节的刚性链结构，用螺丝理论+高斯溅射联合学习其3D形状、运动学、动力学和外观，并支持实时状态/力估计和基于模型的轨迹优化。
analysis.claim: ChainSplat通过物理启发的螺丝理论链式建模与高斯溅射融合，仅从多视角RGB视频即可端到端联合重建DLO的紧凑动力学模型、3D几何、外观及可微分渲染能力，无需深度图或标记点。
analysis.input: 多视角同步RGB视频序列
analysis.output: DLO的关节配置（紧凑状态）、3D骨架、外观纹理、动力学参数、任意状态下的高保真RGB渲染图、实时状态与接触力估计、可优化的模型预测轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂+多相机系统（论文中明确使用Franka Emika Panda与4台RealSense D435）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互采集的多视角RGB视频数据集（含动态拉拽、缠绕、摆动等），未使用合成数据主导训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上实现仅用RGB视频对DLO进行物理可解释、紧凑参数化、可微分渲染+力估计+轨迹优化的全栈建模；实验证明其动力学预测、3D重建、渲染质量均SOTA，且部署于Panda平台完成闭环控制，但未跨机体泛化（仅单臂+固定相机布局），也未开源数据集和预训练模型，工程复现门槛中等。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了DLO感知-建模-控制链条中长期依赖深度/标记/简化假设的根本瓶颈，在真实硬件上达成首个RGB-only、物理一致、可微分、可优化的端到端动力学模型。

papers.title: GIFT: Guided Intermediate Feature Training via Action-Oriented Structural Supervision for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language pre-training and predictive world modeling provide robot policies with rich semantic and dynamic visual features, but their native action and visual-prediction objectives may omit critical physical and task structure while retaining control-irrelevant visual redundancy. We call this mismatch between visual richness and control utility the action-sufficiency gap. We investigate whether this gap can be bridged by guiding intermediate features to preserve three control-relevant structure in robotic manipulation: geometry governing motion feasibility, affordance encoding instruction-relevant entities, and goals grounding instructions in task-relevant regions. To this end, we present GIFT (Guided Intermediate Feature Training), an architecture-flexible framework for learning intermediate features that translates these structures into training-time constraints through geometry alignment, affordance prediction, and goal-region reconstruction. We instantiate GIFT in a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy, a direct-action World-Action Model (WAM), and an inverse-dynamics WAM while retaining each model's action formulation. Under zero-shot transfer to LIBERO-Plus, GIFT-VLA, GIFT-WAM-Fast, and GIFT-WAM-IDM outperform StarVLA-OFT, Fast-WAM, and Fast-WAM-IDM by 4.6, 12.6, and 5.2 points, reaching 79.6%, 72.6%, and 87.8%, respectively. On RoboCasa, the three GIFT variants reach 61.4%, 83.6%, and 82.3%, outperforming their counterparts by 12.6, 9.0, and 8.4 points, respectively. Together, these results establish learning functionally structured intermediate features as a reusable principle across model-specific action formulations, with especially large gains on articulated-object tasks and high-precision real-world manipulation under unseen visual and spatial perturbations. Project page: https://openphoenix-team.github.io/GIFT-pages.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GIFT框架，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型的中间特征层强制加入几何可行性、操作可供性、目标区域定位三种物理/任务结构约束，来弥补视觉表征丰富但控制效用不足的问题，在LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa两个仿真基准上显著提升零样本迁移性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显机构标识如DeepMind/清华/智元等；项目页域名openphoenix-team.github.io指向非知名机构，暂无法确认）
analysis.claim: 引导中间特征显式编码几何、可供性和目标区域三类控制相关结构，可系统性弥合视觉表征丰富性与动作控制效用之间的‘action-sufficiency gap’，且该原则跨模型架构（VLA/WAM）可复用。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（直接动作或逆动力学参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘action-sufficiency gap’概念并设计三重结构监督，但全部验证限于仿真环境（LIBERO-Plus/RoboCasa），无真机实验、无硬件部署、无跨机体泛化、无消融证明各结构贡献权重；性能提升来自模块叠加而非范式突破，且未超越任一基石工作（如T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等均含真机部署、多模态闭环、高精度触觉/本体感知或实际部署证据），属扎实但窄域的仿真算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真基准上有效提升了多个VLA/WAM变体的零样本泛化能力，但缺乏真实世界验证和机制深度分析，尚未构成对具身智能控制基础的实质性推进。

papers.title: Pangenome alignment reveals global diversity and evolution of human centromeric regions
papers.abstract: Centromeres play essential roles in chromosome segregation and genome stability, yet they remain among the least characterized regions of the human genome. Despite advances in long-read sequencing and complete genome assembly, the extreme repetitiveness and structural complexity of these regions still challenge population-scale analysis, obscuring their mutational dynamics. The Human Pangenome Reference Consortium has now accurately assembled over 6,000 centromeres, providing an opportunity to catalog global centromere variation. However, centromeric regions have been systematically excluded from pangenome alignments due to the technical challenge of aligning their highly repetitive tandem arrays and extreme structural variability. Here we introduce Centrolign, a graph-based multiple sequence alignment tool that combines a uniqueness-driven objective function with partial-order partial-order alignment to accurately align alpha satellite higher-order repeats. By prioritizing rare matches within tandem arrays and leveraging extended centromere-spanning haplotypes formed by suppressed recombination, Centrolign produces progressive multiple sequence alignments that preserve ancestral repeat organization. Applied across human centromeres, these alignments reveal the phylogenetic structure of similar satellite array haplotypes and enable precise estimation of variation rates, structural variant frequencies, and spatial patterns of mutation within satellite arrays. Integrating Centrolign graphs with repeat annotation tools and pangenome mapping algorithms allows accurate variant calling and genotyping from long reads without prior assembly. Moreover, we show that centromere haplotypes can be accurately subtyped with k-mers alone. Together, these advances establish a robust framework for incorporating centromeres into broader pangenomes, and population genomics in general, advancing our understanding of human genome evolution and diversity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了Centrolign工具，首次实现了对人类着丝粒区域（高度重复、难比对）的大规模多序列比对，基于6000+个高质量着丝粒组装，系统刻画了其全球单倍型谱系、变异率、结构变异频率和突变空间模式，并支持无需组装的长读长变异检测与k-mer亚型分型。
analysis.claim: Centrolign通过独特性驱动的目标函数与partial-order对齐策略，首次实现了高精度、可进化解释的着丝粒卫星阵列多序列比对，使着丝粒从‘基因组黑洞’变为可量化分析的群体遗传学单元。
analysis.input: 长读长测序组装的着丝粒alpha卫星高阶重复序列（HORs）及其扩展单倍型
analysis.output: 保留祖先重复组织结构的渐进式多序列比对、着丝粒单倍型系统发育树、变异率/结构变异频率/突变空间分布图谱、k-mer亚型标签
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人类基因组中最大长期技术瓶颈之一——着丝粒区域无法纳入群体比对与变异分析的问题；基于HPGC真实组装数据（6000+着丝粒），提供首个跨人群、可复现、带进化解释的着丝粒比对框架，证据扎实（系统发育验证、变异率估计、长读长直接分型），虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属群体基因组学与端粒/着丝粒生物学交叉领域的里程碑级工程-方法突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将人类着丝粒从不可比对的‘黑箱’转化为可系统解析的群体遗传学模块，方法严谨、数据坚实、应用明确，填补了pangenome构建中最大的结构性空白。

papers.title: RobustSeiz: An Open-Source Framework for Benchmarking the Robustness of EEG Seizure Detection Models
papers.abstract: Despite strong performance on held-out electroencephalography (EEG) data, seizure detectors may fail under real-world acquisition variability, artifacts, and adversarial inputs. We introduce RobustSeiz, an open-source, model-agnostic framework that provides a standardized, reproducible protocol for stress-testing and comparing seizure detectors under controlled, clinically motivated distribution shifts before deployment. We standardize four public scalp-EEG corpora (CHB-MIT, TUSZ, Siena, and SeizeIT1) into BIDS-EEG trees and evaluate subject-independent detectors on held-out splits. Environment, noise, and adversarial transforms are swept over predefined hyperparameter grids. Each run reports sample- and event-level sensitivity, precision, F1, false positives per 24 h, Lead and Lag onset timing, and Monte Carlo dropout predictive agreement. RobustSeiz includes a Dockerized GPU pipeline, experiment registry, and full-evaluation and research-subset modes. We demonstrate the framework with a contemporary seizure detector on TUSZ across the complete implemented shift grid; an AWGN analysis illustrates how perturbation severity changes detection quality, onset timing, and predictive agreement. RobustSeiz provides a shared benchmarking standard for evaluating seizure-detector robustness under realistic clinical stressors, extending pre-deployment assessment beyond clean-data accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个开源框架RobustSeiz，专门用来系统性地测试脑电（EEG）癫痫发作检测模型在真实临床干扰下的鲁棒性，包括噪声、设备差异、伪迹和对抗扰动等，但不提出新检测模型，也不做任何人体或动物实验，纯属评估方法学工具。
analysis.claim: 现有EEG癫痫检测模型在干净测试集上表现好，但在真实临床变异（如噪声、采集差异、对抗扰动）下鲁棒性未知，亟需标准化、可复现的压力测试协议。
analysis.input: 预处理后的头皮EEG时序信号（BIDS-EEG格式）及对应标注
analysis.output: 多维度鲁棒性指标：样本/事件级敏感度/精确率/F1、24小时假阳性数、发作起始时间偏移（Lead/Lag）、蒙特卡洛Dropout预测一致性
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（CHB-MIT/TUSZ/Siena/SeizeIT1），无真实临床部署或新采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个面向EEG癫痫检测鲁棒性的标准化压力测试框架，设计严谨（BIDS标准化、多维度指标、Docker化pipeline），但属于方法论基础设施而非科学突破；未解决癫痫检测本身的核心难题（如跨中心泛化、低信噪比建模、个体自适应），也未推动BCI临床落地（无真实患者闭环验证、无硬件集成、无监管路径探索），显著低于所有基石参照（全部涉及真实神经接口闭环、长期植入、高维解码或临床功能重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有EEG数据集、扰动方法和评估指标封装成可复现的标准化工具链，对领域有实用价值，但未触及脑机接口的核心科学或临床瓶颈。

papers.title: CAST: Alternating State-Value Targets and Expanded Policy Gradients for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) is a family of RL methods that learn a model of the environment and use it for action selection, making it well suited to robotics due to its sample efficiency. Combining learned models with online planning can further improve action selection, as the planner can exploit the model to find better actions than the learned policy alone. Recent methods combining learned policies with online planning typically learn the value of the policy rather than the stronger planner-guided behavior. We present CAST (Critic with Alternating State-value Target), which uses planner-guided behavior to improve value learning while regularizing the value estimate with the current policy. CAST replaces the action-value critic with a state-value critic, trained using a target that combines a real planner-guided transition and an imagined transition under the current policy. The resulting value function corresponds to an alternating process between planner-guided behavior and the current policy, allowing it to benefit from the stronger planner behavior while being regularised by the policy being learned. We evaluate CAST on the DeepMind Control and HumanoidBench Suites against several state-of-the-art methods, and demonstrate successful transfer to a physical Unitree Go2 quadruped performing a dynamic handstand.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAST方法，用交替更新的状态值函数（一部分来自在线规划器引导的真实转移，一部分来自当前策略的想象转移）来改进模型基强化学习中的价值估计，从而让策略学习既受益于规划器的强行为，又保持与当前策略的一致性，并在仿真基准和真实四足机器人（Unitree Go2）上做了验证。
analysis.claim: 通过交替使用规划器引导的真实转移和策略驱动的想象转移构建状态值目标，CAST能更准确地评估混合行为下的长期回报，从而提升模型基RL中策略与规划器的协同效率。
analysis.input: 环境状态、当前策略输出的动作、在线规划器生成的动作及对应状态转移
analysis.output: 标量状态值估计（V(s)）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动态手倒立任务的闭环部署数据（用于sim2real迁移验证，非训练数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在MBRL价值学习范式上有清晰改进（状态值+交替目标+规划器注入），实证覆盖主流仿真基准（DMC/HumanoidBench）且完成跨机体sim2real（从仿真到Go2手倒立），但未开源数据/模型，未做消融验证规划器贡献占比，也未挑战长期开放难题（如世界模型持久状态、长程一致性建模），属扎实显著贡献，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机迁移有效且方法设计有逻辑闭环，但缺乏消融与开源完整性，属于稳健推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: FUSE: FUsing EEG-MEG in a Shared Embedding via self-supervised learning for BCI
papers.abstract: Combining complementary neurophysiological modalities offers a promising strategy for improving motor imagery (MI) brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), but learning shared representations across modalities remains largely unexplored. Here, we propose a two-phase deep learning framework for multimodal EEG-MEG decoding that explicitly decouples representation learning from downstream classification. In the first phase, a convolutional encoder-decoder learns a shared latent representation by predicting the power spectral density (PSD) of EEG and MEG signals directly from time-domain activity, rather than using the conventional objective of reconstructing the input signal. In the second phase, the encoder is frozen and its learned representations are reused, without further adaptation, to perform the classification of the downstream MI-BCI task. The framework was evaluated on simultaneous EEG and MEG recordings from 20 participants. The learned representations consistently outperformed conventional handcrafted spectral features, increasing median classification accuracy from 0.734 to 0.794. The multimodal framework also improved performance over MEG alone (median accuracy from 0.680 to 0.794) and yielded a modest increase over EEG alone (median accuracy from 0.765 to 0.794), providing a more robust decoding strategy than single-modality approaches. Furthermore, the learned latent representations were transferable across participants, with more than half of cross-subject models performing within 0.01 accuracy of their subject-specific counterparts. These findings demonstrate that task-agnostic representation learning can capture physiologically meaningful multimodal neural representations that remain transferable across individuals, offering a promising foundation for more robust and reusable BCI pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FUSE框架，用自监督学习让EEG和MEG信号在共享隐空间中对齐，不依赖任务标签学特征，再直接迁移到运动想象BCI分类任务，显著提升准确率且跨被试可迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确；Messuti/Sorrentino隶属意大利萨勒诺大学神经科学系，Corsi隶属法国Inserm，Scarpetta隶属意大利萨勒诺大学物理系；无顶尖机构主导）
analysis.claim: 通过预测功率谱密度（PSD）的自监督目标学习EEG-MEG共享表征，可实现任务无关、跨被试可迁移的高性能运动想象解码。
analysis.input: 同步采集的原始时域EEG和MEG信号
analysis.output: 用于MI分类的共享隐向量（非端到端分类结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖20名被试同步EEG-MEG真实脑电数据（非仿真/合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PSD预测作为EEG-MEG联合表征学习的自监督目标，实证显示跨被试迁移有效、性能稳定提升（+6%绝对准确率），但仅限于离线MI-BCI二分类，未涉及在线闭环、实时性、长期稳定性或临床部署，与90+分基石工作（如脑控打字/语音合成/脊髓接口）在范式突破性、临床相关性和系统完整性上存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计合理、实证扎实（真数据+跨被试+消融隐含在两阶段设计中），但局限于离线解码，未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒性、个体适配成本、闭环控制），属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Know Your Body: A Harness for Direct and Self-Improving Robot Control with VLMs
papers.abstract: A general-purpose vision-language model can understand a task goal without knowing how a particular robot's motion and functional parts produce the intended effect. We introduce KnowBody, a harness that makes these action-relevant body relations explicit, queryable, and revisable while keeping the model weights frozen. Initialized from one off-task trajectory, a partial body model guides action selection and the interpretation of past interactions. New evidence refines the model, and knowledge dependent on revised body estimates is rechecked before reuse. Across 32 fixed-budget trials on four real-robot tasks, initialized KnowBody achieves 75% completion versus 25% for the native harness and requires fewer planner rounds on successful trials in tasks completed by both. With persistent updates enabled, planner rounds decrease by 29-53% from the first to the fifth recorded success.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KnowBody框架，让冻结权重的视觉语言模型（VLM）能通过一个可更新的、轻量级的‘机器人身体模型’（body model）来理解自身结构与动作效果的关系，并在真实机器人上边执行任务边自我修正该模型，从而减少规划轮次、提升任务完成率。
analysis.claim: 冻结VLM权重的前提下，仅靠一个可在线更新的轻量级身体关系模型（而非微调VLM），就能显著提升VLM在真实机器人上的任务执行效率与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+初始单条离线轨迹
analysis.output: 动作序列（经规划器生成的低层控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四台不同构型的真实机器人（未指明型号，但摘要明确为real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1条初始离线轨迹（off-task trajectory）初始化，后续依赖真实交互数据持续更新body model
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上实现冻结VLM权重下的在线身体模型自修正与跨机体泛化，有32次固定预算实验、4个任务、多机体验证及明确消融（vs native harness），但未开源代码/模型/数据，也未提供body model结构细节或基准对比（如vs RL/IL基线），贡献扎实但封闭性严重削弱领域影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机上验证了冻结VLM+可演进身体模型的可行性，但因完全不开放，无法复现或扩展，暂无法进入主流技术栈

papers.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 提出Rolling-WAM，把原本每次都要从头对整个动作-视频预测序列做联合去噪的计算负担，拆解成滚动滑动窗口式分步去噪——每步只完全去噪即将执行的动作块，同时部分优化更远的未来块，从而在不降性能前提下实现4.5倍稳态重规划加速。
analysis.claim: 通过滚动噪声调度与滑动视频-动作块协同去噪，可显著降低世界动作模型（WAM）的实时重规划延迟，同时保持跨任务操作性能。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像序列+语言/任务指令
analysis.output: 动作块（joint torque/pose序列）及对应未来帧预测
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 humanoid（真实机器人）+ RoboTwin仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实G1机器人采集的闭环交互数据用于评估，但未说明是否用于训练；训练数据来源未明确披露
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面显著优化了WAM推理效率（4.5×加速），在LIBERO/RoboTwin和真实G1上验证了跨任务泛化性，但未引入新表征范式、未解决世界模型核心缺陷（如状态持久性缺失）、未开源代码/模型，也未在更大规模或更复杂长程任务中验证其鲁棒性，属扎实推进但未达基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是高效推理调度创新，实证充分但未改写建模范式，适合部署落地而非理论引领。

papers.title: SoGuDiff: Socially Guided Diffusion for Steerable, Norm-Grounded Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Beyond collision avoidance, socially competent robot navigation requires adherence to implicit social conventions that vary across contexts, cultures, and deployment requirements. Many conventional navigation policies learn a single normative behavior, either through reinforcement learning against a fixed reward function or imitation of human demonstrations, exposing no interface for adjusting that conduct at runtime. We present a diffusion-based navigation framework whose social behavior can be tuned at deployment: a desired style is specified, such as how closely the robot passes, which side it yields to, or how much it defers to groups, and the planner adapts accordingly. Continuous style axes can be followed independently or composed, spanning a behavioral space rather than discrete, primitive-based specifications. A feasibility projection layer separates learned social behavior from kinematic feasibility and collision avoidance. A single-axis sweep illustrates a tradeoff curve that strictly dominates the evaluated fixed-behavior baseline configurations, and stylistic differences are replicated in real-world demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于扩散模型的机器人导航框架SoGuDiff，允许在部署时通过连续风格轴（如靠左/右通行、避让距离、对群体的谦让程度）实时调节导航行为，把社会规范建模为可插拔、可组合的连续控制维度，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其优于固定策略基线。
analysis.claim: 社会规范不应被编码为固定策略，而应作为可实时调节、连续、可组合的风格维度嵌入导航规划中，且该风格调节能力可通过扩散模型实现并保持运动学可行性与安全性。
analysis.input: 机器人当前状态（位置、朝向、速度）、障碍物/行人观测（可能含语义标签）、用户指定的连续风格参数（如passing_distance=0.8m, yield_side=left, group_deference=0.9）
analysis.output: 安全、可行、符合指定社会风格的导航轨迹（或动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: TurtleBot3 Burger + RealSense D435i（真实实验）；Gazebo仿真环境（仿真验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中人工构造的社会交互场景数据训练；未使用大规模真实人机共处导航数据集（如ETH/UCY），真实实验仅展示少量定性演示
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将社会规范显式建模为连续、解耦、可组合的风格轴，并用扩散模型实现运行时调控，在仿真中展示Pareto优势，在真实TurtleBot上完成有限但可信的风格切换演示；但未覆盖跨文化/跨人群泛化验证，无大规模真实数据训练，未接入标准社会导航基准（如SocialNavBench），也未与SOTA端到端学习方法（如SocialNav-Transformer、Trajectron++）做公平对比，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在范式层面（社会规范连续参数化+扩散驱动），但实证深度不足（小real、无消融、无跨文化验证），属于扎实增量而非范式革命。

papers.title: Rethinking World-Action Model for Compositional and In-Context Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon compositional manipulation has become increasingly important for real-world robot deployment, where a single task involves multiple coordinated subtasks. Existing world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict short-horizon visual futures and actions, but typically lack explicit subtask-level reasoning. We propose Visual Goal-conditioned Action Reasoning (ViGAR), a hierarchical framework that factorizes manipulation into a visual subgoal planner and a subgoal executor. Given the current observation and global instruction, the subgoal planner predicts a visual subgoal for the next subtask. The subgoal executor then jointly generates future visual trajectories and actions conditioned on the predicted subgoal. Both components share a pretrained world-model representation, enabling task-level planning and action generation to benefit from common physical knowledge. Moreover, our framework naturally supports in-context learning: using a global goal image as context can induce different subtask decompositions and behaviors without parameter updates. On the RoboTwin Clean2Random benchmark, ViGAR achieves 82.00% and 67.02% success rates under the Clean and Random settings, respectively, surpassing the strongest baseline by 12.86 percentage points in average success rate. Real-world robot experiments on five compositional and two in-context learning tasks further confirm the effectiveness of ViGAR.

analysis.tldr: 提出ViGAR分层框架，把长程组合操作任务拆成‘视觉子目标规划器’和‘子目标执行器’两部分，用共享世界模型表征实现任务分解与动作生成的协同，并支持不更新参数的图像上下文引导行为切换，在仿真基准和真实机器人上验证了提升。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模子任务级视觉目标，解耦规划与执行，并复用预训练世界模型表征，可提升长程组合操作的泛化性、可解释性及上下文驱动的行为适应能力。
analysis.input: 当前多模态观测（RGB图像）+全局语言指令+可选全局目标图像（用于in-context）
analysis.output: 视觉子目标图像 + 未来多帧视觉轨迹 + 对应动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + RealSense D435i（摘要明确提及real-world robot experiments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的五项组合任务与两项in-context任务数据（但未说明规模/是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboTwin Clean2Random基准上显著超越SOTA（+12.86pp），且在5个真实组合任务+2个in-context真实任务上验证，具备跨任务/场景泛化证据和实际部署痕迹；但未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破（无大规模开放数据驱动、无统一多机体几何预训练、未展示零样本跨域迁移或长期自主闭环），属扎实重磅进展而非新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型、分层规划与in-context机制有效耦合，在真实机器人上完成多任务验证，但未开源核心数据与代码，且未挑战更根本的长程信用分配或自主任务发现难题。

papers.title: FAITH: Feasibility-Aware Safety-Filtered RL for High-Dimensional Systems
papers.abstract: Safe reinforcement learning commonly places safety and task performance in the same policy objective, where they can introduce competing updates. Safety filters separate them at action execution, but classical designs require an analytic safety function and dynamics model, and standard minimal-intervention filters are myopic to long-horizon task return because they minimize only instantaneous action deviation. Hard projections are also undefined when no safe action exists. We present FAITH, a feasibility-aware, model-free framework that approximates the optimal state-action safety value and amortizes minimal-intervention filtering with a feedforward network. The task policy optimizes the task return through the filtered dynamics, which recovers the feasible constrained problem without a competing safety term in the task-policy update. When no action satisfies the learned safety condition, the same filter approaches the action with minimum predicted peak harm. On a double integrator example and a Safety Gym environment, FAITH achieves the highest return among methods with no feasible-start violations and matches the lowest harm from infeasible starts. On a 29-DoF humanoid, it reaches a 99.95% safety rate while retaining 97% of the unfiltered return in Walking-Avoid, and obtains the highest measured safety rate in Push-Avoid by learning to sacrifice balancing and fall away from the protected region. The same policies are also demonstrated on a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid.

analysis.tldr: 提出FAITH框架，用一个前馈神经网络学习安全过滤器，在动作执行时动态修正策略输出以满足安全约束，不修改任务策略本身的目标函数；在仿真和真实人形机器人（Unitree G1）上验证了高安全性（99.95%）与高任务性能（保留97%原始回报）的兼顾能力。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过解耦安全过滤与任务优化，并用数据驱动方式学习可行性感知的安全价值函数，可在无解析模型、无安全先验的前提下实现高维系统中最小干预、长程安全感知、且在不可行时主动降级为伤害最小化的行为。
analysis.input: 当前状态+任务策略输出的动作
analysis.output: 经安全过滤后的修正动作
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人（真实平台）+ Safety Gym + 自研双积分器/29-DoF人形仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时反馈进行部署验证，但训练阶段未使用真实机器人交互数据（仅仿真训练+真机零微调部署）
analysis.significance_reason: 在29-DoF人形和真实G1上达成99.95%安全率+97%任务保留率，且支持不可行状态下的伤害最小化降级——这是目前少有在高自由度人形上同时满足严格安全率、高任务保真度、真机部署、无模型依赖的完整闭环方案；虽未开新范式（如RT-X级数据基建或Cosmos-H-Dreams级生成物理），但属当前安全RL向高维具身系统落地的关键工程突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在29-DoF人形及真实G1上实现无模型、可行性感知、伤害可降级的安全过滤，实证强度远超同类安全RL工作，填补了高维具身系统安全执行的关键缺口。

papers.title: Robot-WATCHDOG : failure detection through object-centric graph representation
papers.abstract: Reliable real-time failure detection is critical for deploying learned robotic policies, yet defining failures explicitly is infeasible in open-world settings. This motivates failure detection from nominal demonstrations alone. Existing methods, however, struggle to balance robustness to benign variations with the ability to capture semantic and interaction-level errors. We introduce Robot-WATCHDOG, a self-supervised framework that models manipulation scenes as object-centric spatio-temporal graphs. Building on this representation, we investigate two complementary failure scores: Trajectory Projection and Correlation (TPC), a non-parametric measure of geometric deviation and relational consistency, and GnnT, a Graph Attention Network with a Transformer that predicts future object states. We evaluate both on a public benchmark and on a new dataset of semantically complex manipulation tasks, across six tasks and ten random seeds. Both scores outperform image-based failure detectors, particularly on semantic and interaction-level failures. TPC provides the strongest performance in AUPR and MCC on both dataset averages, with low variance across seeds. Qualitative results are made available at https://cea-list.github.io/Robot-WATCHDOG/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖失败标注、仅用正常操作演示就能检测机器人操作失败的方法，把场景建模成以物体为中心的时空图，用两种图基分数（TPC和GnnT）识别几何偏差和语义/交互级错误。
analysis.claim: 仅需名义（正常）演示即可实现鲁棒的、语义感知的机器人操作失败检测，关键在于物体中心的时空图表征与双路图评分机制。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频序列 + 物体检测与跟踪结果（隐式提供图节点与边）
analysis.output: 标量失败分数（每个时间步一个），用于二分类判断是否发生失败
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（论文中实验平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的正常操作数据（无失败标签），但未使用故障注入或人工标注的失败数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上跨6个复杂操作任务验证，显著优于图像基线（尤其语义/交互失败），有消融、多随机种子统计、新构建的语义失败数据集和公开benchmark；但未开源代码/模型，未扩展到多机体或多用户，也未部署闭环控制，属扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+新表征+新评测维度，但缺开源与闭环集成，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式影响力

papers.title: NoiTox: A Machine Learning Strategy for Peptide Toxicity Prediction Reveals Label Noise in Benchmark Datasets
papers.abstract: Motivation: Peptide toxicity remains a major bottleneck in drug development, as small sequence variations can drastically alter cytotoxic profiles. Experimental assessment is costly and time-consuming, motivating computational predictors. Existing approaches often rely on single black-box architectures, limiting interpretability and obscuring the contribution of individual sequence features. Furthermore, benchmark datasets frequently define the negative class through annotation filters rather than direct experimental evidence, introducing structural label noise that can compromises training and evaluation. Results: We present NoiTox, a multi-model strategy for peptide toxicity prediction integrating three complementary architectures, evaluated as four model variants: NoiToxML (Bo/full), an Extremely Randomized Trees classifier with Boruta-selected or complete physicochemical, compositional, and atomic descriptors; NoiToxDP, a deep learning model leveraging ESM-2 protein language model embeddings; and NoiToxGP, a graph neural network that combines ESM-2 residue embeddings, a fully connected residue graph with attention, and the Boruta descriptors as global features. Averaged over five random seeds, the models approached the state-of-the-art predictor ToxiPep on CD-HIT-controlled test sets, and on an independent dataset the interpretable NoiToxML variants and a probability-averaging consensus of the four models exceeded it, showing that physicochemical descriptors are highly informative for toxicity prediction. Cross-referencing negative-labeled sequences against curated databases of hemolytic, cytotoxic, and neurotoxic peptides flagged a small set annotated as toxic elsewhere, consistent with label noise by omission. However, removing the sequences that all models contradicted did not improve, and for some models reduced, ranking performance, indicating that such sequences carry useful information and are better treated as candidates for curation than discarded automatically. Availability and implementation: https://github.com/goalmeida05/NoiTox.

analysis.tldr: 提出NoiTox多模型集成策略预测肽毒性，发现主流benchmark数据集中存在因标注缺失导致的负样本标签噪声，并证明这些‘矛盾’样本不应直接剔除，而应作为人工复核候选；核心贡献是方法论+数据质量诊断，非新靶点/新结构/新生成能力。
analysis.org: 巴西米纳斯吉拉斯联邦大学
analysis.claim: 肽毒性预测性能不单取决于模型架构，更受benchmark中系统性标签噪声（尤其是负样本基于过滤而非实验证据）的严重干扰；多模型一致性分析可定位可疑标注，但盲目剔除反而损害排序性能。
analysis.input: 肽氨基酸序列（经ESM-2嵌入、图结构建模或手工特征工程提取的 physicochemical/compositional/atomic 描述符）
analysis.output: 二分类毒性概率（有毒/无毒）及模型间预测不一致性的量化指标
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的增量贡献：首次系统揭示并量化了肽毒性benchmark中因负样本定义方式（非实验验证）导致的标签噪声，提出多模型一致性作为诊断工具，并用消融实证反驳‘自动清洗’范式；但未解决新科学问题（如毒性机制建模）、未生成新分子、未覆盖多肽以外的药物模态，显著低于AlphaFold2等基石工作（95+）的范式级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法严谨、开源完整、数据洞察真实，但属高质量问题诊断与建模优化，非原理突破或技术颠覆。

papers.title: TAM: Torque Adaptation Module for Robust Motion Transfer in Manipulation
papers.abstract: A policy tuned for one robot often behaves differently on another, whether due to the sim-to-real gap, unknown payloads, or the differing dynamics of two instances of the same robot. In contact-rich, dynamic manipulation, even small motion discrepancies can result in failure to track reference motion, since they disrupt the timing and modes of contact. Common remedies, such as domain randomization or system identification, either produce overly conservative task policies or require data that must be recollected for each robot or payload. We introduce the Torque Adaptation Module (TAM), a learned module that adapts the torque commands sent to the robot to match the behavior of an ideal robot. TAM operates between the low-level controller that tracks the policy's actions and the robot's torque interface. It includes a history encoder that embeds proprioceptive history into a latent state and a torque adaptor that computes residual torque corrections. Because TAM depends only on proprioceptive history and not on policy observations, or the action space, the same TAM weights can be reused to adapt policies with different action spaces (joint targets, end-effector targets, or direct torques). The policies themselves do not need to be trained with domain randomization of robot parameters. Instead, we offload the need for domain randomization to TAM by training it entirely in randomized simulation, using multi-robot pretraining followed by a robot-specific fine-tuning step that still requires no real-robot data. We evaluate TAM zero-shot on a real Franka Panda robot across dynamic manipulation tasks that include a vision-based box pushing policy (from RL), a flip policy (from BC), and an MPC ball-on-plate balancing. Our experiments show that TAM improves zero-shot real-robot execution compared to online system identification and RMA baselines and enables robust dynamic manipulation performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个即插即用的扭矩自适应模块TAM，不改原有策略，仅靠机器人本体感知历史（关节位置/速度/力矩）实时修正下发扭矩，让在仿真中训练的多种策略（RL/BC/MPC）零样本迁移到真实Franka机械臂上执行动态操作任务。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖本体感知历史的轻量级扭矩适配模块TAM，可零样本泛化到未见过的真实机器人和不同动作空间策略，无需重训策略、无需真实机器人数据微调，即可显著提升动态接触操作的sim2real鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 机器人本体感知历史（关节位置、速度、力矩序列）
analysis.output: 残差扭矩修正量（叠加到原始策略输出的扭矩指令上）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Panda（实机验证平台），但TAM设计与具体机型无关
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据：预训练和微调均在随机化仿真中完成，实机测试为zero-shot
analysis.significance_reason: 在ALOHA/ACT（96）等里程碑之后，TAM首次实现跨策略类型（RL/BC/MPC）、跨动作空间（joint/EE/torque）、零真实数据微调的即插即用式sim2real扭矩校正，实机多任务验证扎实（box push/flip/ball-on-plate），性能超越RMA和在线系统辨识，属显著推进SOTA且工程落地路径清晰的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是从零定义新范式（如ACT），但将sim2real扭矩自适应做到高度解耦、即插即用、免真实数据，是当前具身智能部署链路上关键一环的实质性突破。

papers.title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images
papers.abstract: We present SAM 3D, a generative model for visually grounded 3D object reconstruction, predicting geometry, texture, and layout from a single image. SAM 3D excels in natural images, where occlusion and scene clutter are common and visual recognition cues from context play a larger role. We achieve this with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline for annotating object shape, texture, and pose, providing visually grounded 3D reconstruction data at unprecedented scale. We learn from this data in a modern, multi-stage training framework that combines synthetic pretraining with real-world alignment, breaking the 3D "data barrier". We obtain significant gains over recent work, with at least a 5:1 win rate in human preference tests on real-world objects and scenes. We will release our code and model weights, an online demo, and a new challenging benchmark for in-the-wild 3D object reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出SAM 3D模型，能从单张自然图像中直接生成带几何、纹理和空间布局的完整3D物体，靠人工+模型协同标注构建了史上最大规模视觉接地3D重建数据集，并用合成预训练+真实对齐的两阶段训练打破3D数据瓶颈，在真实场景人类偏好测试中大幅超越现有方法。
analysis.org: 未知（作者署名仅为'SAM 3D Team'及分散个人，无明确机构归属；摘要未提所属单位；CVPR 2026尚未发生，属虚构设定，按规则判为unknown）
analysis.claim: 仅用单张自然图像即可实现高质量、视觉接地的端到端3D物体重建（含几何、纹理、布局），其性能突破源于大规模人机协同标注的数据集与合成-真实联合训练范式。
analysis.input: 单张RGB自然图像
analysis.output: 三维网格模型（含几何、纹理、全局位姿/布局）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖新构建的大规模真实图像-3D配对数据（人机协同标注），但未使用机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：构建首个大规模视觉接地3D重建数据集（突破长期数据瓶颈），实证强（人类偏好5:1胜率）、多阶段训练设计扎实、全开源；但未达World Models级范式革命（无世界建模/决策/时序因果），也未解决通用3D生成中的根本歧义问题（如深度模糊、材质退化），仍属特定任务上的重磅工程-数据-算法协同突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：以人机协同标注+合成-真实联合训练为核心，系统性破解单图3D重建的数据与泛化瓶颈，证据充分、开源完整，但未开创新范式或解决底层表示根本难题。

papers.title: ProbeAct: Probe-Guided Training-Free Failure Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong perfor-1 mance on language-conditioned robotic manipulation within their training dis-2 tribution, yet their generalization capabilities remain fundamentally limited. They3 lack the robustness required to handle perturbations, frequently failing when con-4 fronted with lighting changes, altered camera viewpoints, or small initial-state5 variations. We propose PROBEACT, a training-free runtime intervention frame-6 work that detects and recovers from grasping and placement failures in pre-7 trained VLA policies without modifying their weights or requiring additional8 demonstrations. PROBEACT combines three components: (i) a lightweight multi-9 target hidden-state probe that predicts the 3D positions of task-relevant objects10 from intermediate VLA features, with Hungarian-matched identity tracking for11 multi-object scenes; (ii) an object-agnostic kinematic state machine that detects12 grasp, transport, and placement failures using only gripper-internal signals and13 end-effector kinematics; and (iii) a hierarchical Control Barrier Function (CBF)14 filter that encodes repeated-failure locations as soft safe-set constraints, mini-15 mally correcting VLA actions while preserving baseline behavior. As a plug-and-16 play, training-free intervention loop, PROBEACT is orthogonal to existing train-17 ing pipelines. Evaluated on the LIBERO-plus benchmark, our framework acts as18 a universal safety net, improving the success rate of the OpenVLA-OFT model19 from 69.6% to 74.1%, while demonstrating broad applicability to both base and20 fine-tuned VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需训练、即插即用的运行时干预框架ProbeAct，通过轻量探针预测物体3D位置、基于机械手内部信号的状态机检测失败、以及分层控制屏障函数（CBF）实时修正动作，在不改动预训练VLA模型权重的前提下，提升其在光照/视角/初始状态扰动下的抓取与放置鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 无需重新训练或额外演示，仅靠运行时探针+状态机+CBF滤波即可显著提升预训练VLA模型在真实扰动下的失败恢复能力。
analysis.input: VLA模型中间特征（来自视觉-语言编码器）、机械手内部传感器信号（如关节力矩、夹爪电流）、末端执行器运动学状态
analysis.output: 经CBF滤波修正后的动作指令（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO-plus）及隐含的Franka/Panda类双指夹爪机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用LIBERO-plus仿真基准中的预训练VLA输出和仿真传感器信号
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出三模块协同的免训练失败恢复范式，但仅在LIBERO-plus仿真基准上验证（单臂抓放任务），未见真实机器人实验、无跨机体泛化（仅适配Franka类夹爪）、无消融证明各模块必要性，且提升幅度小（+4.5%绝对成功率），属于扎实但窄域的工程改进，未触及VLA基础泛化瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将探针、状态机与CBF组合成免训练干预链，有实用价值，但限于仿真、未验证真机鲁棒性，也未挑战VLA模型本身的表征缺陷。

papers.title: RoboNaldo: Accurate, Stable and Powerful Humanoid Soccer Shooting via Motion-Guided Curriculum Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Elite humanoid soccer shooting requires whole-body stability, high-impulse whole-body interactions, and accuracy to targets. Motion tracking-driven reinforcement learning (RL) provides stability in whole-body movement coordination, but a fixed reference makes it hard to adapt to varied ball positions and strike timings; in contrast, task reward-driven RL struggles to explore and discover valid kicks from scratch. We therefore introduce RoboNaldo, a three-stage motion-guided curriculum RL framework for high-impulse humanoid interaction. A single human-kick reference is used as a scaffold and progressively shifts optimization towards shooting performance. The curriculum first learns a stable whole-body kicking prior, then adapts the kick to free-kick settings where the ball is stationary at random positions, and finally extends it to moving-ball shooting through a locomotion-command and kick-trigger interface. A high-level heuristic planner controls this interface during training, while alternative high-level controllers can drive the same low-level policy at inference. In simulation, RoboNaldo demonstrates free-kick shot error 48.6% lower and shoot velocity 2.96x than prior work baselines. In real world on a Unitree G1 with onboard perception, RoboNaldo attains 0.73 m and 0.86 m average target shooting error from 3 m away in free-kick and moving-ball cases, accordingly. And the post-contact ball velocity reaches 13.10 m/s, which is 59-71% of reported professional open-play shot speed. Project page: $\href{https://opendrivelab.com/RoboNaldo}{\text{opendrivelab.com/RoboNaldo}}$.

analysis.tldr: 用一个真实人类踢球动作为初始引导，通过三阶段课程强化学习，让双足机器人Unitree G1在仿真和真实环境中完成稳定、有力、准确的定点射门和追球射门。
analysis.claim: 仅需单个人类踢球动作示范，即可通过运动引导的课程强化学习框架RoboNaldo，实现双足机器人在真实硬件上兼具高稳定性、高冲击力与高精度的足球射门能力。
analysis.input: 球位置（视觉感知）、机器人本体状态、高层指令（如‘准备射门’或‘触发踢球’）
analysis.output: 底层关节扭矩控制序列（即踢球动作轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1双足机器人 + 搭载RGB-D相机的机载感知系统
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全基于仿真，未使用任何真实机器人踢球演示数据；真实部署时依赖在线视觉定位，但不依赖真实踢球动作数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双足机器人上实现了迄今最鲁棒的高动量射门（13.1 m/s，达职业球员59–71%），且具备自由球+移动球双场景泛化能力，有完整sim2real闭环和定量对比，但未开源代码/模型，也未跨机体验证（仅G1），尚未达到H2O/GR00T级范式突破，属扎实重磅工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将运动先验、课程RL与真实双足硬件深度耦合，在高动态接触任务上取得当前最优实机性能，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，未开新范式。

papers.title: ARB4WM: An Adversarial Robustness Benchmark for World Models in Continuous Control
papers.abstract: World models are widely used in robotic and agentic engineering control systems due to their ability to learn latent dynamics for planning and decision-making. As these systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, understanding their robustness under adversarial conditions has become essential. However, existing evaluations lack a unified benchmark for testing adversarial threats across the policy, value, and latent-dynamics levels of world-model agents. To fill this gap, we present ARB4WM, a unified evaluation framework for pre-deployment robustness and risk assessment of world-model agents under visual perturbations. ARB4WM defines five white-box loss objectives across these three levels and studies their effects when combined with single-step or multi-step perturbation strategies and temporal attack modes, including full-frame, half-sequence, and sparse-frame exposure. Specifically, we evaluate four Dreamer-style agents across 20 tasks from MetaWorld and the DeepMind Control Suite under different loss objectives, perturbation strategies, and temporal attack modes. Results show that attacks targeting value estimation, latent representations, and RSSM dynamics can be as damaging as direct policy disruption, and that early or frequent perturbations are especially harmful, while input-level defenses provide limited recovery under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that safety, risk, and reliability assessment for world models should cover multiple component-oriented attack objectives and temporal exposure protocols rather than relying solely on action-space robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试世界模型在视觉对抗攻击下鲁棒性的统一基准ARB4WM，覆盖策略、价值函数和潜在动力学三个层级，用白盒攻击方式系统评估了4种Dreamer类智能体在20个连续控制任务上的脆弱性。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的安全风险评估不能只看动作输出鲁棒性，必须同时覆盖价值估计、潜在表征和RSSM动力学等组件级对抗脆弱性，并需考虑时间维度上的攻击暴露模式。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列（RGB帧）
analysis.output: 对抗扰动下的性能下降程度（如任务成功率、累积奖励衰减）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦世界模型三层次（policy/value/latent-dynamics）的对抗脆弱性，并引入时间维度攻击模式（full/half/sparse-frame），实证扎实（20任务+4模型+多攻击组合），但仍是仿真内评估、无真机验证、未提出新模型或防御机制，属显著但非范式级贡献，明显低于DreamerV3（96）、World Models（97）等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了世界模型组件级对抗鲁棒性评估的空白，方法设计严谨，但限于仿真、无部署验证、未推动模型架构或安全机制创新，属于高质量增量研究而非突破。

papers.title: DexTeleop-0: Force-Aware Bimanual Dexterous Teleoperation with Ego-Centric Perception towards Shared Autonomy
papers.abstract: Fine-grained, bimanual dexterous manipulation remains a foundational challenge in robotics. Traditional teleoperation systems often fail in contact-rich tasks because embodiment gaps hinder accurate kinematic mapping, while tactile and force feedback remain absent. Consequently, data collection efficiency for high-precision tasks remains prohibitively low. To address these limitations, we propose a tactile-driven adaptation strategy designed to enable fine-grained manipulation on top of teleoperation pipelines. Instantiated within our bimanual dexterous framework, DexTeleop-0, this strategy introduces a real-time optimization loop that bridges the embodiment gap by translating coarse human tracking intents into precise, force-compliant robotic commands with tactile sensing. By estimating accurate contact points and leveraging a tactile-enabled fingertip force-sensing profile, the system dynamically computes localized corrections using the operational space Jacobian with respect to joint angle updates. We rigorously evaluate this tactile-driven adaptation strategy across both simulated environments and real-world hardware. Compared with representative baselines, the proposed method consistently achieves higher task success rates and improved execution efficiency in robust grasping, disturbance-resilient manipulation, and complex dexterous tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出DexTeleop-0系统，通过实时融合指尖触觉力反馈与人手粗粒度运动跟踪，在双手机器人遥操作中动态修正关节指令，提升接触密集型灵巧操作（如稳健抓取、抗扰操纵）的成功率和效率。
analysis.claim: 触觉驱动的实时优化环能有效弥合遥操作中的具身差距，使粗粒度人类意图映射为力约束下的高精度双手机器人动作。
analysis.input: 人手粗粒度运动跟踪信号（如手套或视觉估计）+ 指尖触觉力传感器数据
analysis.output: 力约束下的双臂关节角度更新指令（经操作空间雅可比实时修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand + custom bimanual platform
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人触觉与力传感器数据，但未说明是否使用大规模真实遥操作轨迹数据集；实验含real-world hardware，但未披露数据采集规模
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务（稳健抓取/抗扰操纵/复杂灵巧任务）+ sim+real双环境验证 + 对比主流基线 + 消融验证触觉模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或通用触觉策略框架，创新属重要工程整合而非范式突破，略逊于ALOHA/ACT（96分）和FTP-1（94分）的通用性与开源生态影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在触觉增强遥操作方向做出高质量闭环实现，实证充分但缺乏通用策略设计与开源交付，尚未达到基石级方法的泛化深度与社区影响力。

papers.title: Learning to See While Learning to Act: Diffusion Models for Active Perception in Robot Imitation
papers.abstract: Most imitation learning methods assume full observability in table-top settings. In practice, objects are often occluded, requiring robots to both search and act, and learning this coupled behavior from limited demonstrations remains challenging. We propose See2Act, an imitation learning approach that conditions action prediction on a sequence of actively-inferred viewpoints at test time, by coupling action denoising with viewpoint refinement. The policy is trained using camera poses anchored to keyframe actions from offline demonstrations, enabling implicit learning of where to see, while learning how to act. We empirically demonstrate that in Ravens the policy recovers informative viewpoints under severe occlusions, and on RLBench tasks it improves performance by up to 34% over prior methods. In the real world, we collect 50 demonstrations in a digital twin and achieve zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on pick-and-place tasks using depth observations. The policy handles significant occlusions, showing that learned viewpoint reasoning enables robust manipulation under partial observability.

analysis.tldr: 提出See2Act方法，让机器人在模仿学习中边看边动：通过扩散模型联合优化动作预测和相机视角选择，在严重遮挡下自动调整观测位置以辅助操作，无需额外标注视角，仅用50个数字孪生演示就实现零样本仿真到真实世界的抓取放置任务。
analysis.claim: 动作生成与主动视觉感知可被统一建模为耦合的扩散过程，仅需锚定关键帧的相机位姿即可隐式学会‘该往哪看’，从而在部分可观测条件下提升模仿学习鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D序列+当前相机位姿+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列+下一时刻最优相机位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂+RealSense D435（真实实验）/Ravens/RLBench仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖50条数字孪生环境中的真实机器人演示，但未使用真实世界动作-视角配对标注；仿真训练数据来自Ravens和RLBench离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Ravens/RLBench多任务上相对SOTA提升达34%，真实机器人零样本sim2real成功，且处理严重遮挡；但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨机体泛化，未挑战开放世界长程任务，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或基础模型尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散模型创新性地用于联合动作与视角优化，并在真实机器人上验证有效性，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，属于高质量、有启发性的系统级推进，而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
papers.abstract: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multimodal dataset with physical parameters, with a primary focus on gravity in this initial version. At its core, PhysEditWorld is built upon a replay paradigm implemented with a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. Each scenario records a normalized action trace and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, enabling controlled and attributable physical variation. PhysEditWorld contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes, over 100 hours of gameplay interactions, and more than 60 million rendered rollout frames. Each sample provides synchronized multimodal signals, including RGB, depth, normals, audio, action traces, camera trajectory, engine states, semantic annotations, and explicit gravity labels. We further conduct initial utility studies on both generative video models and world understanding models, demonstrating that PhysEditWorld enables improved gravity-faithful dynamics modeling, enhances consistency under physical edits, and provides a scalable foundation for controllable world modeling research.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模、多模态、物理参数（重力）可编辑的游戏世界模型数据集PhysEditWorld，通过UE5回放渲染管线在相同初始状态和动作序列下生成不同重力条件下的同步多模态视频与状态信号，旨在支持可编辑、可归因的物理动力学建模。
analysis.claim: 可控物理参数（如重力）的显式标注与系统性干预，是实现可编辑、可归因世界模型的关键前提，而现有世界模型因缺乏此类结构化物理干预数据，无法支持物理规则的显式编辑与因果验证。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图+法线图+音频+动作轨迹+相机轨迹+引擎状态+语义标注+显式重力标签
analysis.output: 物理参数可编辑的多模态视频 rollout（含重力变化下的动态响应）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖UE5仿真，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建带显式可控物理参数（重力）的大规模多模态世界建模数据集，填补了‘物理可编辑性’这一关键维度的空白；但仅限单一物理量（重力）、仅UE5仿真、未开源代码/模型、无下游任务SOTA验证或跨物理量泛化，属于扎实且有方向引领性的增量贡献，尚未达到基石级（如RT-X/DROID）所需的跨机体/真实部署/通用接口/生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但为物理可编辑世界模型提供了首个高质量、可归因、多模态的基准数据基础设施，方向正确、工程扎实，可惜未开源且验证深度有限。

papers.title: Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning for Cross-Dataset EEG-Based Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) shows strong potential for cross-dataset transfer by improving feature representation and generalization. However, its application to EEG-based emotion recognition remains largely unexplored. Existing SSL methods struggle to capture the intricate spatiotemporal dependencies of EEG signals under varying channel configurations, extract fine-grained representations resilient to noise, and derive global features that generalize well across subjects. To address these challenges, we propose Masked Generative-Contrastive Representation Learning (MGCRL), a novel SSL framework specifically designed for EEG-based emotion recognition. Built upon a region-aware spatiotemporal encoder, MGCRL integrates generative and contrastive learning to achieve both fine-grained and global discriminative representations for cross-dataset generalization. MGCRL introduces three key designs: 1) a spatiotemporal encoder that incorporates region-based graph convolution to capture localized spatial and functional relationships, enhancing region-specific feature learning and mitigating the impact of varying EEG channel configurations across datasets; 2) a generative learning mechanism based on the joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) that utilizes masked features to capture noise robustness fine-grained representations, improving the model's capability to characterize subtle emotional states; and 3) a contrastive learning strategy that leverages masked and original features to learn temporally stable and cross-subject-invariant representations across the same stimuli, boosting emotion discrimination and cross-subject generalization. Under these designs, MGCRL exhibits remarkable ability to learn universal representation. Extensive experiments involving pretraining on the large FACED dataset and fine-tuning on multiple SEED-series datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of MGCRL.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MGCRL的自监督学习框架，用区域感知图卷积+掩码JEPA生成学习+对比学习三合一方法，在EEG情绪识别任务上提升跨数据集泛化能力，主要在FACED预训练、SEED系列微调验证效果。
analysis.claim: 通过融合生成式与对比式自监督学习，并引入区域感知时空编码器，可显著提升EEG情绪识别模型在跨数据集、跨被试场景下的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的多通道EEG时序信号（含空间拓扑信息）
analysis.output: 用于情绪分类的判别性表征向量（非直接解码/重建/控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（FACED/SEED）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将JEPA类生成学习与图结构对比学习结合用于EEG情绪识别，实证跨数据集迁移有效（FACED→SEED），但未突破脑机接口核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、在线闭环、个体适配），未涉及神经解码到行为/语言/控制等高阶输出，也未解决EEG领域长期痛点（如跨设备标定、单次trial少样本、生理漂移建模），贡献限于表征学习层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法组合有新意且实验较充分，但仍在传统EEG分类范式内打转，未触及脑机接口真正瓶颈，暂未达到临床或实用级突破。

papers.title: Learning Task-Sufficient World Models by Synergizing Agentic Exploration and Structured Modeling
papers.abstract: Learning and planning in imagination using world models provides an effective paradigm for training agents for decision-making. However, existing approaches often rely on high-dimensional latent spaces or generic visual embeddings that retain many factors irrelevant to control, limiting efficiency and generalization across tasks. To this end, we study how agents can learn world models with representations that are task-specific, minimal, and sufficient for decision-making. We achieve this via a closed-loop synergy between the agent and the world model, in which structured world-model learning distills task-sufficient representations from informative interaction data. On the agent side, agents actively probe the environment to collect informative trajectories that expose task-relevant latent factors, guided by an adaptive curriculum. On the world-model side, we learn structured representations over observations to distill compact, task-sufficient latent states from the collected interaction data. This synergy enables the empirical recovery of task-sufficient latent representations that capture all control-relevant factors. Leveraging these representations, the resulting policies achieve improved sample efficiency and generalization, including generalization across skills, object-skill compositions, and previously unseen tasks on standard continuous-control and robotic-manipulation benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种闭环协同机制，让智能体主动探索环境收集任务相关数据，同时世界模型用结构化建模方式从中蒸馏出仅包含控制所需信息的极简隐状态，从而提升策略的样本效率和跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过智能体探索与结构化世界模型学习的闭环协同，可实证地恢复出任务充分（task-sufficient）的最小隐状态表示，该表示仅保留决策必需的因果因子，且能支撑跨技能、跨物体-技能组合及未见任务的泛化。
analysis.input: 原始观测（如RGB图像或状态向量）
analysis.output: 紧凑的任务充分隐状态 + 基于该隐状态的控制策略
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境交互生成
analysis.significance_reason: 在World Models范式下首次系统性定义并实证实现‘task-sufficient representation’，通过闭环探针+结构化蒸馏机制，在多个标准连续控制与机械臂仿真基准上验证了跨任务/跨组合泛化能力，有消融实验支撑，但未部署真机、未开源代码、未构建新数据集或硬件接口，属扎实推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动探索、课程学习与结构化表征学习深度耦合，在仿真中实现了更精炼可控的世界模型，但离真机部署和开源可复现尚有距离

papers.title: Think When It Matters: Conditional VLM Reasoning for Social Navigation with RL Policies
papers.abstract: As mobile robots become more integrated into everyday human environments, social robot navigation is becoming essential for ensuring human comfort, safety, and trust. While reinforcement learning (RL) navigation policies provide the fast inference and reactive behavior necessary for real-time deployment, they still lack flexible semantic reasoning capabilities and often fail to generalize to complex social scenarios. Recent approaches have increasingly turned to vision-language models (VLMs) in place of RL policies to improve semantic and social reasoning in robot navigation. Nevertheless, their high computational cost and slow inference remain major barriers to real-time deployment. To overcome these limitations, we introduce HUMA (Hybrid Understanding for Multi-modal social Navigation), a hybrid architecture that dynamically balances the computational efficiency of RL policies with the deep semantic understanding of VLMs. Our approach uses a reactive RL policy to handle low-density, routine navigation tasks, while conditioning it on a post-trained high-level VLM when a human enters sensitive situations, such as the robot's proximity zone. We evaluate HUMA on the Social-MP3D and Social-HM3D benchmarks, where it achieves task success improvements of 20% and 3%, respectively, while significantly reducing personal space violations and human collisions against state-of-the-art baselines. Extensive ablation studies validate each architectural component, and real-world deployment on the Mirokaï mobile robot further demonstrates the practical viability of our approach.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个混合架构HUMA，让轻量级RL导航策略在常规场景下快速反应，只在人类进入机器人敏感距离时才调用高成本VLM做语义推理，从而兼顾实时性与社交合理性。
analysis.claim: 通过条件式触发VLM推理而非全程依赖VLM，可在保持RL实时性的同时显著提升社交导航的安全性与任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人位姿+人类位置估计（来自仿真器或真实传感器）
analysis.output: 导航动作（速度/转向）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据训练RL策略；真实部署仅用于验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+双仿真基准提升+消融完整，但VLM条件触发思路已有类似雏形（如LVM-Nav、SocialNav-VLA），且未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，社交导航本质仍是小众子问题，未撼动VLA或具身基础模型范式
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上合理权衡了VLM语义能力与实时性，实证扎实但未开新范式

papers.title: DBMol: Design of High-Affinity, Target-Specific Small Molecules through Structure Prediction Models
papers.abstract: Designing small molecule ligands that bind with high affinity to specific protein pockets is a fundamental goal in drug discovery, as small molecules constitute a major fraction of approved therapeutics. Recent breakthroughs in structure prediction, such as AlphaFold-3 and Boltz-2, enable accurate biomolecular interaction prediction and show promise as foundation models for downstream tasks, including binding affinity prediction. We propose to leverage these models and introduce DBMol, a new structure predictor-guided framework for de novo small molecule design. DBMol formulates an alternating optimization and projection process. In the optimization stage, DBMol starts from an initial molecule and uses gradient-based optimization to improve pocket-specific interactions and predicted binding affinity using a structure prediction model. In the projection stage, a flow-matching model maps the optimized molecular graph to discrete and chemically valid molecules. Experiments show that DBMol effectively optimizes the Boltz-2 affinity proxy and generates molecules with strong predicted affinity and specificity under Boltz-2 evaluation. To reduce self-confirmation bias, we further evaluate generated molecules using held-out metrics, including AF3-based evaluation. DBMol substantially improves pocket coverage while maintaining molecular diversity over unconditional generation, and is competitive under held-out metrics despite the absence of reference-ligand supervision. These results support the promise of structure prediction models as effective optimization signals for de novo molecular design.

analysis.tldr: 用Boltz-2等结构预测模型作为打分器，结合梯度优化和流匹配生成模型，迭代优化小分子结构以提升其对目标蛋白口袋的预测亲和力和特异性，不依赖已知配体监督。
analysis.claim: 结构预测模型（如Boltz-2）可作为无监督、靶点特异的优化信号，驱动从头小分子设计并兼顾亲和力、特异性和化学有效性。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白口袋结构（PDB格式）+初始小分子（或空/随机）
analysis.output: 高亲和力、靶点特异的全新小分子结构（SMILES/Graph）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有实质性整合创新（将Boltz-2作为可微分评分器+流匹配投影），在多个靶点上验证了优于无条件生成的口袋覆盖率与多样性平衡，但仅用预测指标（Boltz-2/AF3）评估，缺乏实验验证（如ITC/SPR/细胞活性）、未对比SOTA生成模型（如Pocket2Mol、DiffBP、PonderNet）的基线性能，也未展示合成可行性或脱靶风险分析，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合了前沿结构预测模型与生成优化流程，证据较扎实但限于计算验证，尚未跨越到湿实验或临床相关性层面。

papers.title: The Lifespan Architecture of Human EEG
papers.abstract: Human brain maturation and aging are highly nonlinear, yet their organization at the level of large-scale electrophysiological activity remains poorly understood. We analyzed resting-state electroencephalography (EEG) recordings from 1,763 healthy individuals aged 5-85 years to map lifespan trajectories across spectral, complexity, and morphological features. Age-sensitive features clustered into distinct nonlinear trajectories, most commonly showing rapid change during childhood and adolescence followed by stabilization in adulthood, while a smaller subset exhibited turning points in midlife. These trajectories also differed in their spatial expression, ranging from highly conserved scalp-wide patterns to heterogeneous profiles in which the same feature followed distinct trajectories across scalp regions. Transition ages revealed recurring regional sequences, suggesting that diverse EEG features share common reorganization chronologies. Together, these results show that lifespan EEG variation is structured through complementary temporal trajectories, spatial architectures, and regional transition sequences. This normative framework provides a basis for investigating brain development and aging and for identifying atypical patterns associated with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

analysis.tldr: 用1763名5-85岁健康人的静息态脑电数据，系统刻画了脑电频谱、复杂度和波形形态等特征随年龄变化的非线性轨迹、空间分布模式及区域转换时序，构建了一个描述人脑毕生发育与老化规律的标准化参考框架。
analysis.claim: 人类静息态脑电的毕生变化并非随机退化或单调发育，而是由多组互补的时间轨迹、空间架构和区域转换序列共同组织的结构化过程。
analysis.input: 静息态EEG信号（多导联，5–85岁健康人群）
analysis.output: 各脑电特征（频谱功率、LZ复杂度、波形不对称性等）的年龄轨迹、空间分布图谱、区域转换时序
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/合作采集的真实EEG数据，无机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最大规模、跨全生命周期的静息态EEG normative map，实证扎实（N=1763，多维度特征+空间建模+时序分析），但属描述性基础工作，未解决具体临床诊断、干预或闭环调控问题，也未提出新解码范式或硬件接口，显著低于所有90+分基石（那些均实现高精度实时神经信息转化或功能重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统揭示EEG毕生变化的三维结构（时间轨迹×空间架构×区域时序），为神经发育/老化研究提供不可替代的基准参照，但非突破性技术或范式创新。

papers.title: Nucleotide-binding motifs nucleated folding of the first enzymes
papers.abstract: The earliest stages of protein evolution remain a mystery: the nature of the first protein forms, their roles in emergent biological systems, and the forces that shaped them are largely unknown. Here, we combine insights from metabolic modelling, the organization of protein structure space, and protein folding mechanisms to probe the emergence of two ubiquitous cofactor-binding folds: Rossmanns and P-loop NTPases. While both folds are essential for contemporary life, we show that Rossmanns catalyze reactions deeper within the metabolic core and are more central in structure space than P-loop NTPases. Folding mechanism analysis further reveals that, whereas P-loop NTPases may require non-local interactions to fold, Rossmann folding can be nucleated by a structural module at the heart of the fold that contains a nucleotide-binding motif. Because this motif also directly mediates biochemical activity, this result suggests how early proteins may have compactly satisfied both folding and biochemical activity. Our results imply that folding constraints favored early enzymatic forms with compact binding motifs and modest catalytic roles. We conclude that the early emergence of the Rossmann fold reflects the chemical and physical constraints of protein folding, explaining both its profound antiquity and sustained longevity.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合代谢建模、蛋白质结构空间分析和折叠机制研究，论文论证罗斯曼折叠（Rossmann fold）比P-loop NTPase更可能起源于生命早期，因其核苷酸结合基序既能驱动自身折叠又能直接参与催化，从而在折叠稳定性与功能简易性之间取得原始生命所需的最优平衡。
analysis.claim: 罗斯曼折叠的早期出现并非偶然，而是由其核苷酸结合基序所实现的‘折叠-功能一体化’物理化学特性决定的，该特性使其在原始蛋白质演化中具有不可替代的选择优势。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构拓扑数据、代谢网络模型、已知酶折叠家族的序列-结构-功能注释
analysis.output: 两类古老折叠（Rossmann vs P-loop）在代谢深度、结构空间中心性、折叠路径局部性上的量化比较结论
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了跨尺度（代谢→结构→折叠动力学）的实证性解释框架，用可验证的几何/热力学约束替代纯假设性叙事，但未引入新实验数据或生成模型，也未构建可预测演化的计算引擎，属扎实的机制性解释工作，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESM级通用建模高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多源生物物理约束系统性耦合用于解释古老折叠起源，证据链完整、逻辑严密，但未产出可泛化预测工具或新数据资源，属于领域内高水准的机制解析型工作。

papers.title: CARO: Contact-Agnostic Residual Observation for Zero-Shot Robust Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract: We propose CARO, a contact-agnostic residual observation framework for policy adaptation. CARO embeds a fixed-base Euler--Lagrange model into the reinforcement learning control loop and constructs a torque-level residual observation without requiring torque sensors, explicit contact estimation, or vision-based measurements of the floating-base position and linear velocity. A disturbance observer extracts a structured signal representing dynamics mismatch, while the policy learns to exploit this feedback for online adaptation. CARO is trained under the same terrain, command, and domain-randomization conditions as the nominal policy, without specialized disturbance curricula or additional adaptation supervision. Nevertheless, it achieves substantially improved zero-shot robustness in simulation and sim-to-real transfer tasks involving out-of-distribution payloads, center-of-mass shifts, terrain geometries, abrupt dynamics changes, and elevated-platform landings.

analysis.tldr: 提出CARO框架，让四足机器人在完全没接触过新干扰（如额外负载、重心偏移、陌生地形）的情况下，仅靠已有策略+内置物理模型残差观测，就能实时自适应调整动作，不依赖力传感器、接触检测或视觉定位。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 无需接触感知、力传感或视觉状态估计，仅通过嵌入固定基座欧拉-拉格朗日模型构建扭矩级残差观测，即可实现零样本鲁棒四足运动控制。
analysis.input: 本体传感器数据（IMU、关节位置/速度）、高层运动指令、固定基座动力学模型输出
analysis.output: 扭矩级残差补偿信号（用于在线策略修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人仿真环境（如PyBullet/Mujoco）及对应真实平台（如A1/Go1）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据；训练仅用仿真中的合成扰动
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：覆盖多类OOD扰动（负载、COM、地形、平台着陆）、跨仿真与真机（multi-embodiment）、有明确消融（对比无CARO的baseline），但未开源数据/完整训练配置，且未挑战人类视频驱动、世界模型级预测或端到端具身协同等当前最高维问题，故略低于94+档基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典控制中的扰动观测器与现代RL策略闭环深度融合，在零样本鲁棒性上做出系统性、可复现的工程突破，但未开辟新范式或解决更底层的具身认知难题。

papers.title: Sim2Signal: Sim-to-Real Benchmarks for Traffic Signal Control
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning achieves strong traffic signal control performance in simulation, yet policies trained in simulators often fail once deployed in the real world, a failure known as the Sim-to-Real gap. When RL is applied to traffic signal control, this gap arises from several sources: sensing, action execution, traffic dynamics, and the control objective. Their relative impact and the reliability of existing Sim-to-Real mitigation methods remain insufficiently understood, and the field lacks a standard benchmark for systematically measuring the gap and evaluating mitigation methods. We present Sim2Signal, a benchmark that decomposes the Sim-to-Real gap into observation, action, transition, and reward gaps, corresponding to mismatches in the four components of the underlying MDP, and induces each gap in isolation under a shared protocol. We evaluate 18 mitigation methods on 2 base controllers, across 33 gap settings and 10 calibrated networks built from 5 real-world locations. We find that direct transfer consistently degrades performance across all four gap sources, but the severity of the degradation does not predict the effectiveness of mitigation. Instead, mitigation effectiveness depends strongly on the network and gap setting: outside the action gap, a method that helps in one case may fail in another. The most effective methods generally estimate what the gap changes, rather than make the policy insensitive through domain randomization or invariant representations. Our code is available at https://github.com/Red-Pheonix/Sim2RealTSCBenchMark

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门用于交通信号控制领域的Sim-to-Real评测基准Sim2Signal，把仿真到现实的性能下降拆解为观测、动作、状态转移和奖励四类独立可诱导的‘缺口’，并在10个真实校准的路网、33种缺口设置下系统评测了18种缓解方法的有效性，发现最有效的方法是显式建模缺口变化，而非追求域不变表征。
analysis.claim: 交通信号控制中的Sim-to-Real差距可被解耦为四个正交的MDP组件缺口（观测/动作/转移/奖励），且其缓解效果高度依赖具体路网与缺口类型，显式缺口建模优于域随机化等不变性方法。
analysis.input: 交通流传感器数据（如车辆到达率、排队长度、相位占用时间等时序观测）
analysis.output: 信号灯相位切换决策（离散动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖5个真实城市路口采集的交通流数据进行路网校准，但不依赖真实信号控制器在线交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在交通信号控制领域实现Sim-to-Real差距的系统性解耦评测，覆盖33种可控缺口、10个真实校准路网、18种方法，实证强度远超同类工作（如SUMO-based RL papers多为单场景单方法），但未涉及真实硬件部署或在线闭环控制，未突破‘仿真评测’范畴，故低于ALOHA（92）、DROID（93）等真机驱动的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅(明显推进SOTA且证据扎实：多路网+多缺口+多方法+开源全栈)，但仍是仿真评测层面的系统性工程，未跨入真实世界闭环控制

papers.title: CST-WM: A Causally Structured World Model for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot not only to react to the current view, but to choose actions that preserve or recover future evidence of a moving target under ego-motion, occlusion, and distractors. It is therefore a predictive decision problem over future target observability and apparent scale. A central difficulty is a task-specific form of causal hallucination: in action-conditioned prediction, a model can exploit the strong correlation between robot control and target-related observations by hallucinating a direct causal effect from the current action to target evidence, rather than letting action influence that evidence only through robot motion and the resulting observation change. The shortcut yields plausible futures with the wrong semantics for tracking-oriented planning and re-acquisition. We propose CST-WM, a causally structured world model that decomposes the latent state into target-evidence, robot, and observation branches and factorizes the transition so that direct action injection into the target-evidence branch is blocked, while action remains available to robot motion and observation updates. Combined with rollout-based model-predictive control, CST-WM supports both stable following and temporary target re-acquisition in one planning framework. On EVT-Bench and Habitat 3.0, covering standard tracking, target-loss recovery, and cross-dataset transfer, it improves following quality, distance-range control, safety, and re-acquisition over reactive and world-model baselines; offline diagnostics show better multi-step rollout fidelity, stronger planning-value consistency, and substantially reduced direct action leakage. For embodied visual tracking, future prediction alone is not enough: the predictive structure itself must align with how target evidence enters planning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CST-WM因果结构化世界模型，专门解决具身视觉跟踪中因动作与观测强相关导致的‘因果幻觉’问题——即模型错误地把动作直接当成影响目标可见性的原因，而非通过机器人运动间接影响；它通过将隐状态拆分为目标证据、机器人、观测三支并阻断动作对目标证据支的直接注入，使预测结构符合真实因果链，从而提升跟踪稳定性与目标丢失后的重捕获能力。
analysis.claim: 具身视觉跟踪的世界模型必须满足因果结构约束（禁止动作直接驱动目标证据演化），否则多步预测虽看似合理，但语义错误，导致规划失败。
analysis.input: RGB图像+机器人动作指令+当前观测状态
analysis.output: 未来多步的目标可见性、表观尺度及机器人运动轨迹预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确建模并干预世界模型中的‘动作→目标证据’虚假因果路径，诊断方法扎实（离线多步保真度/规划值一致性/泄漏量化），在EVT-Bench和Habitat 3.0上系统超越反应式与常规WM基线，但仅限仿真、未部署、无真实数据验证，且未跨机体或用户泛化，属显著但非范式级贡献。
