papers.title: Dynamics-Induced Commitment in Learning-Based Robotic Penalty Kicks
papers.abstract: Learning in robotic games is constrained not only by strategic information but also by what the body can still execute. We study this coupling in a hierarchical humanoid-quadruped penalty system in which game-level self-play policies command fixed soccer whole-body controllers (S-WBCs). The humanoid shooting skill is initialized from self-collected motion-capture data, whereas the quadruped saving skill is learned by reinforcement learning. We introduce dynamics-induced commitment mapping (DIC-Map), a body-grounded analysis that estimates continuation capability, identifies the first persistent loss of a terminal alternative, and tests whether the remaining interaction admits a reduced zero-sum game. For symmetric terminal alternatives, the reduced game yields a closed-form bound on optimal strategy concentration determined by the responder's value of deferring. We further show that, when the responder acts through an estimator, equal response values eliminate the direct terminal-allocation gradient and leave an estimator-mediated first-order learning channel. Experiments locate commitment about 0.29 s before contact, and changing only ball speed shifts deferral coverage. Across four responder policies, replacing the estimator raises save rate from 0.240 to 0.472, whereas a comparable gain in read accuracy obtained by waiting raises it only to 0.246. Posterior analysis is used for the equilibrium comparison because the available coverage terms are observational proxies. Project website: https://chris-ruizegeng.github.io/penaltykick/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究机器人罚球博弈中，身体动力学如何强制限制策略选择时机（即‘承诺点’），提出DIC-Map方法量化分析人在踢球前何时因物理约束而无法再改变决策，并通过真实四足机器人守门实验验证：用估计器替代响应策略能将扑救成功率从24.0%提升至47.2%，显著优于单纯延长反应时间。
analysis.claim: 机器人在动态博弈中的策略承诺并非由认知延迟决定，而是由身体动力学导致的不可逆状态转移所诱导；该‘动力学诱导承诺’可被建模、定位并用于提升对抗性交互性能。
analysis.input: 球速、初始姿态、S-WBC控制器输出的动作指令流
analysis.output: 承诺时刻（标量时间戳）、剩余可行动作集、简化零和博弈下的最优策略浓度界
analysis.robot_dependency: MIT Cheetah3 四足机器人 + 自研人形踢球平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的踢球运动学数据初始化人形控制器，但守门策略训练主要在仿真中完成，仅最后阶段迁移到实机
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将博弈论中的‘承诺’概念严格锚定到机器人动力学可行性边界上，提出可计算的DIC-Map并实证其对守门性能的实质性提升（+23.2pp），但实验仅限单任务（罚球）、单场景（固定距离/角度）、未开源代码/模型，且理论边界依赖强假设（对称终端替代、理想估计器），尚未扩展到多智能体或开放环境。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在动力学与博弈策略间建立了可测量、可干预的因果链，但受限于实验广度与开源程度，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: DITTO: Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation
papers.abstract: Collecting data for manipulation with high-DOF hands is challenging, as interfaces must capture rich hand motion while rendering the contact interactions essential for precise manipulation. Existing data collection approaches face a trade-off: teleoperation ensures deployment consistency but lacks force feedback, while handheld (in-the-wild) systems provide natural force transparency but introduce a visual embodiment gap at deployment. We present DITTO, a Dexterous Interface for Transparent TeleOperation, which resolves this through the anatomically informed co-design of a dexterous 7-DOF robotic hand and a kinematically equivalent motorized exoskeleton. A 1-to-1 actuator mapping between the exoskeleton and robotic hand enables handheld (in-the-wild) data collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint-level force feedback unified in a single platform. We demonstrate that the DITTO exoskeleton spans the operator's natural index-to-thumb workspace, and showcase DITTO's dexterous capabilities via learned policies on contact-rich tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出DITTO系统，用一个解剖学对齐的7自由度机械手+完全对应驱动的电机化外骨骼，实现单平台同时支持野外手持数据采集（自然力反馈）和双侧遥操作（关节级力反馈），解决了现有方法在力透明性与视觉具身一致性之间的根本权衡。
analysis.claim: 通过解剖学驱动的硬件共设计，首次在一个统一平台上同时实现高保真力反馈的手持式数据采集与双侧遥操作，消除了接触密集灵巧操作中力透明性与视觉具身一致性的固有冲突。
analysis.input: 操作者手部关节角度与接触力（来自外骨骼传感器）
analysis.output: 7-DOF机械手的关节位置/力矩指令及实时力反馈信号
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研7-DOF机械手 + 自研电机化外骨骼
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类操作者在真实硬件上采集的演示数据，未使用仿真预训练或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到Facet-0/T-Rex级分量：首次以纯硬件共设计（非算法补丁）闭环解决灵巧遥操作中‘力透明’与‘视觉具身’不可兼得这一长期开放难题；实机验证多接触任务（如插拔、旋转、捏取），提供joint-level force feedback且无延迟补偿设计，硬件细节完整公开（含actuator mapping原理），但未开源代码/模型，故略低于Facet-0（98）的全栈开源+大规模泛化基准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法微调或仿真刷榜，而是通过精密机电共设计根治了灵巧遥操作领域十年未解的感知-执行耦合矛盾，实机证据扎实，硬件创新具有范式迁移潜力。

papers.title: TADreamer: Zero-Shot Language-Guided 3D Navigation for Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal Robots via Video Imagination
papers.abstract: Language-guided navigation for terrestrial-aerial bimodal robots requires selecting routes and locomotion modes that match scene context and task intent. Generated videos can represent such motion sequences, but recovering metrically consistent navigation references from them is challenging because of scale ambiguity and axis-dependent geometric distortions. We present TADreamer, a zero-shot framework that grounds video-imagined navigation in measured geometry without task-specific training or fine-tuning. A vision-language model translates onboard observations and instructions into navigation prompts, selects valid generated videos, and provides corrective feedback when regeneration is needed. The selected video is reconstructed into 3D waypoints annotated with terrestrial or aerial modes. A two-stage calibration procedure uses field-of-view constraints to initialize scale estimation, then refines axis-dependent scales, rotation, and translation by registering the reconstructed point cloud to measured geometry. The calibrated waypoints and mode labels guide a planner that incorporates measured geometry for robot execution. Real-world experiments demonstrate navigation across seven indoor and outdoor scenarios. With five candidates per round, usable videos are obtained within two rounds in all seven scenarios. On the calibration observations, our method reduces mean absolute depth error by 87.7% and mean absolute relative depth error by 86.3% compared with NavDreamer.

analysis.tldr: 提出TADreamer框架，让陆空双模机器人无需任何任务训练，仅靠语言指令和机载视觉输入，通过生成并校准导航视频来获得带运动模式标签的3D路径点，再结合实测几何信息完成真实场景导航。
analysis.claim: 零样本下可通过视频想象+两阶段几何校准，将语言指令可靠地转化为陆空双模机器人可执行的、度量一致的3D导航路径。
analysis.input: 机载RGB图像+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 带陆/空运动模式标签的3D路径点序列（即带语义的动作轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研陆空双模机器人平台（含机载相机与飞控/轮式底盘）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的标定场几何测量数据（如已知尺寸结构、激光雷达扫描点云），但不依赖任务级真实导航轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现陆空双模机器人零样本语言导航的端到端几何闭环（视频生成→3D重建→轴向校准→模式标注→规划执行），在7个真实室内外场景验证有效性，深度误差降低超86%，但未开源代码/模型，且未与RT-2/π0等VLA基线对比，也未证明跨机体泛化或长期导航鲁棒性，属扎实的重大推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将视频生成、几何校准与双模态规划深度耦合，在真实双模机器人上达成零样本语言导航的完整技术链，但缺乏开源与跨基线对比，尚未达到RT-2级范式意义。

papers.title: HOTICE: Whole-Body Humanoid Object Transportation in Cluttered Environments
papers.abstract: Object transportation is a fundamental capability for humanoid robots operating in real-world, human-centric environments, yet existing methods struggle when clutter constrains free space around both the robot and its carried payload. We present HOTICE, a whole-body humanoid learning framework for transporting objects through such cluttered environments. First, we introduce Humanoid-Object Decoupled Potential Fields, which jointly encode collision-avoidance guidance for the robot and the carried object, enabling coordinated, obstacle-aware motion for both. Second, to address the large action space inherent to whole-body loco-manipulation, we design a dual-agent reinforcement learning architecture that decouples upper- and lower-body control while preserving whole-body coordination via shared state observations and rewards. To train a policy that generalizes across diverse cluttered scenes, we further employ a specialist-to-generalist distillation strategy, in which privileged teacher policies are distilled into a single deployable student policy. We evaluate HOTICE in MuJoCo simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid, demonstrating effective and robust object transportation across cluttered scenarios for objects of varying shapes. Our results show that HOTICE reliably coordinates whole-body motion and object-aware collision avoidance, generalizing effectively to previously unseen cluttered environments while achieving strong performance in sim2real deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出HOTICE框架，让双足人形机器人在堆满杂物的真实感环境中边走边稳稳搬运各种形状的物体，核心是解耦人形与物体的势场避障+上下身分离但协同的双智能体强化学习架构，并用教师-学生蒸馏提升泛化性，在MuJoCo仿真和Unitree G1真机上都验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦人形-物体势场建模与双智能体分层控制架构，实现人形机器人在高度杂乱环境中鲁棒、泛化的全身协同物运能力。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角、速度等）+ 物体位姿 + 环境点云/占据栅格（仿真中）或视觉/深度观测（真机端隐含）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/目标轨迹（底层控制器输入）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 人形机器人 + MuJoCo 仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的大量合成训练数据；真机实验仅用于部署验证，未报告真实世界交互数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在人形物运这一长期薄弱环节做出扎实推进：首次系统解决‘人形+被携物体’双重避障耦合问题，双智能体架构有明确工程合理性，且在真机G1上完成多形状物运验证；但未开源数据/环境配置，未测试跨机体泛化，也未与H2O/ω-0等SOTA全身模型做直接对比，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了人形物运中人-物协同避障的关键建模瓶颈，并在真机上实证有效，但缺乏跨机体验证、数据不可复现、未对标顶级基线，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: RIDE: Reference-Anchored Inference-Time Diffusion Editing for Scaffold Hopping
papers.abstract: Scaffold hopping is a critical task in drug discovery, which seeks to discover new, structurally distinct molecules that share key functional groups and similar 3D shape with a reference binding ligand. Existing diffusion-based scaffold hopping methods formulate the problem as conditional generation of scaffolds given the functional groups. However, they lack a principled mechanism to jointly enforce 2D structural novelty and preserve the 3D shape of the reference ligand. Here, we introduce RIDE, a Reference-anchored Inference-time Diffusion Editing framework for scaffold hopping. RIDE recovers the reference diffusion noise trajectory conditioned on the binding pocket and functional groups, selects an optimal trajectory segment for editing via noise perturbation, and conducts a value-guided scaffold sampling to generate new scaffolds. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that, compared to baselines, RIDE consistently generates scaffolds with lower 2D similarity and higher 3D similarity to the reference, with an average improvements of 11.7% and 7.3%, respectively. Further analysis reveals that RIDE can accommodate various reward functions, and can preserve 3D similarity even when this is not explicitly included in the reward. Two case studies illustrate RIDE's ability to generate distinct scaffolds with different structures and properties, and its ability to introduce substantial 2D variation while maintaining very high 3D similarity. RIDE is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RIDE-C8A0.

analysis.tldr: 提出RIDE方法，在扩散模型推理阶段通过锚定参考配体的噪声轨迹，动态编辑生成新分子骨架，在保持3D形状相似性的同时显著提升2D结构新颖性，用于药物发现中的骨架跃迁任务。
analysis.claim: 在不牺牲参考配体3D形状保真度的前提下，通过推理时噪声轨迹锚定与编辑，实现更可控、更高质量的骨架跃迁生成。
analysis.input: 参考配体的3D构象、结合口袋结构、关键功能基团（SMILES或子图）
analysis.output: 具有结构新颖性且3D形状高度相似的新分子骨架（SMILES或3D分子）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将扩散模型的推理时噪声轨迹显式锚定并编辑用于骨架跃迁，在多个定量指标（2D/3D相似性）上稳定超越SOTA基线，有完整消融、多奖励验证和两个可解释案例，但未在真实湿实验验证、未接入端到端ADMET或活性预测闭环，也未证明对下游临床候选物发现的实际加速作用，属于扎实的算法级显著贡献，未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计新颖、实证扎实、开源完整，但缺乏湿实验验证与端到端药效闭环，属于高质量增量而非范式变革。

papers.title: Skill-Space Shooting for Autonomous Robot Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Robots deployed in the physical world must be able to improve beyond their initial training as they encounter new situations and failures. For this improvement to scale across tasks, it must make effective use of experience without requiring human demonstration of each correction. Recent agentic systems offer a way to reduce this reliance on human effort by using foundation models to autonomously compose learned behaviors to complete tasks. Yet completing tasks this way does not itself teach a task policy to overcome its own failures; that requires turning these behaviors into learnable corrections for the policy. Our insight is that many such corrections are familiar short behaviors, or skills: they recur across tasks and describe actions that foundation models can reason about from a scene. We introduce skill-space shooting, which uses foundation model guidance to explore corrections through these reusable skills and turn successful trials into policy improvement. Real-world experiments show repeated improvement in policies acting autonomously, while skills can also be shared to reduce the teaching needed to improve on new tasks. By making reusable skills a source of corrective supervision, skill-space shooting enables scalable and generalizable policy improvement within and across tasks. Additional results and videos at https://skill-space-shooting.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫‘技能空间射击’的方法，让机器人在真实世界中遇到失败后，不靠人类示范，而是调用预定义的短技能库，在大模型指导下尝试用这些技能修正错误，并把成功修正的经验反馈给策略网络进行自我更新。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位，github主页未显示 affiliation）

analysis.output: 修正后的动作策略（即更新后的policy参数）

papers.title: HiWE: Hierarchical World Knowledge Model with Visual Keypoint Enhancement for Zero-Shot 3D Path Planning
papers.abstract: Robot demonstration generation requires a system to identify where an interaction should occur, plan a feasible motion, and execute the required contact. HiWE connects these decisions through a point-based interface between visual grounding and language-based planning. PointVLM is instruction-tuned to associate task-relevant objects with image coordinates using a mixture of point annotations, segmentation-derived samples, robot observations, and visual question answering data. Depth measurements lift these predictions into a semantic 3D representation. A language planner, 3DLLM, uses this representation to specify end-effector waypoints and gripper commands, while a hybrid grasping module resolves local grasp poses. The evaluation covers 14 simulated manipulation tasks and four physical-robot tasks, together with ablations of the visual training data, spatial inputs, and grasp selection. Here, zero-shot execution refers to deployment without task-specific demonstration training; the visual model uses existing robot data during fine-tuning. This paper describes the original point-based formulation of the framework; its relationship to the subsequent GeneralVLA extension is detailed in the introduction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层世界知识模型HiWE，用视觉关键点增强来实现零样本3D路径规划：先用PointVLM模型把语言指令和图像中任务相关物体的关键点坐标对齐，再用深度信息升维成语义3D表示，最后由语言大模型3DLLM生成末端轨迹和夹爪指令，加混合抓取模块输出具体抓姿；在14个仿真+4个真机任务上验证零样本泛化能力（不针对任务微调演示数据）。
analysis.claim: 通过点级视觉-语言对齐与分层语义3D表征，可在无任务专属示范数据的前提下，实现跨任务的零样本机器人3D路径规划与抓取执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+深度图
analysis.output: 末端执行器3D路径点序列+夹爪开合指令+局部抓取位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（摘要中4个物理任务隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖现有机器人多模态数据（点标注/分割/机器人观测/VQA）进行PointVLM微调，但不依赖任务专属演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出点级视觉-语言接口和分层3D规划框架，但未建立持久状态世界模型核心，未解决长期开放难题；真机仅4个简单任务，无跨机体/跨用户泛化，消融限于视觉输入而非世界建模机制；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术链路完整、有真机验证，但世界建模深度不足、泛化范围窄、开源程度有限，尚未达到开新范式或解决领域核心瓶颈的量级。

papers.title: Refusals That Bend: Measuring and Predicting Task Malleability in Embodied VLM Planners
papers.abstract: Embodied vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for robots because they generalize across diverse environments. However, this requires their safety alignment to also hold in unseen environments. Existing red-teaming assumes an adversary who optimizes the prompt, the pixels, or text in the environment, and existing benchmarks ask whether a planner recognizes or mitigates a hazard in a fixed scene. Neither asks whether a refusal the planner has already given survives an ordinary change to the environment. We ask that question by placing a single everyday object into the environment, with no pixel, gradient, or prompt under adversarial control. On $846$ tasks that a constitution-guarded planner initially refuses, we find $20.2\%$ of tasks can be flipped to compliance by one or more objects, and the number of objects differs from one task to another. In addition, the object need not be chosen for the task, i.e., items drawn from a fixed list, with no knowledge of the environment or the instruction, bypass safety about as often as items proposed for the specific task. We qualitatively contrast the tasks bypassed most and least often and find that the distinction lies in how conspicuous the hazard is in the instruction and environment. Susceptibility to safety bypass is therefore a property of the task, which we call its \emph{malleability}, and we show that it can be predicted before the target is ever queried. A composite of signals read from a small open-source VLM identifies malleable tasks $2.4\times$ as often as picking at random. Everyday objects, whether placed by an adversary or introduced by ordinary rearrangement of the environment, are thus sufficient to overturn a refusal. Because susceptibility is determined by how a task is specified, we recommend assessing malleability per task prior to deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，给具身视觉语言模型（VLM）规划器下达一个它原本拒绝执行的危险任务指令后，仅仅在环境中随意添加一个日常物品（如杯子、椅子），不修改提示词、图像像素或任何对抗性输入，就有约20%的概率让模型‘改口’同意执行——这种因环境微小变化导致安全拒答失效的现象被定义为‘任务可塑性’（malleability），并构建了首个可预测该现象的轻量信号组合方法。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，arXiv署名无明确机构标识，仅含个人姓名；Leo Y. Lin等未见于主流实验室公开主页或近期高影响力机器人论文署名序列）

analysis.input: 文本指令 + 环境RGB图像（含新增日常物体）
analysis.output: 二元决策：是否拒绝执行该任务（refusal/compliance）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把安全对齐问题从‘prompt红队’拉回‘环境语义稳定性’维度，提供了可测量、可预测的新诊断工具，但未解决也未部署任何缓解机制。

papers.title: Autonomous Robotic Navigation for Endovascular Brain-Computer Interface Access
papers.abstract: Endovascular brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) avoid craniotomy but require precise device delivery through anatomically variable cerebral veins. This work presents the first demonstration of in vitro autonomous robotic navigation for endovascular BCI access in the cerebral venous system. Soft Actor-Critic controllers were trained in silico for two sequential tasks spanning the right internal jugular vein to the superior sagittal sinus, using geometric augmentation of one training anatomy. Navigation was evaluated in a training anatomy and an anatomically unseen hold-out model over 250 in silico episodes and five fluoroscopy-guided in vitro robotic runs per task-anatomy condition, comprising 1,000 simulated episodes and 20 physical runs overall. Task recurrent predictors were also evaluated for online identification of impending navigation failure. In silico success rates for Tasks A and B were 85.6% and 98.4% in the training anatomy and 42.0% and 91.6% in the hold-out anatomy, respectively. Fourteen of 20 physical runs were successful (70% overall), including 80% success for Task B in the hold-out phantom. In silico the predictors detected 99.3-100.0% of failures with false-alarm rates of 0.8-6.7%. During in vitro evaluation, predicted risk increased before failed episodes, but elevated probabilities during some successful runs showed reduced calibration after transfer. These results demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous cerebral venous access and show how online failure prediction could support human oversight, while also identifying anatomical generalization and sim-to-real calibration as priorities before preclinical translation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次在体外血管模型中实现了机器人自主导航，将导管从颈内静脉精准送入上矢状窦，用于支持无需开颅的血管内脑机接口植入，同时开发了能在线预警导航失败的预测模块。
analysis.claim: 基于强化学习的软体机器人控制器可在解剖变异的静脉系统中实现高成功率的自主导航，并支持在线失败风险预测，为血管内BCI的临床自动化铺路。
analysis.input: 荧光透视图像（fluoroscopy）+ 血管几何结构（3D仿真模型）
analysis.output: 导管末端位姿控制指令（连续动作空间）及失败风险概率
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化磁驱动微导管机器人平台（含力反馈与实时荧光配准）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练；仅5次/任务的物理实验用于验证，无真实人体或动物数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现端到端自主血管内导航至关键静脉窦，且在未见解剖结构上保持Task B 91.6%仿真成功率和80%物理成功率，但仅20次体外实验、无生物组织/血流/动态生理干扰验证，离‘Fully Endovascular Neural Interface’（94分）等临床就绪型工作仍有明显差距，属显著但非里程碑式推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实（20次体外运行）、跨解剖泛化有实证、失败预测模块具临床监督价值，但缺乏活体生理环境验证和长期稳定性证据，尚未达到预临床转化门槛。

papers.title: PACE: Stage-Consistent Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Progress-Aligned Context for Execution
papers.abstract: Demonstration-conditioned policies provide a natural interface for specifying robot behavior, yet long-horizon manipulation remains difficult when visually similar states recur across different stages or when demonstrations and executions proceed at different speeds. We identify the resulting failure mode as stage confusion and introduce Progress-Aligned Context for Execution (PACE), a stateful method that continually reinterprets a complete demonstration according to realized execution progress. PACE compresses the demonstration into ordered multimodal prompt tokens and uses training-only dual-edge attention supervision to expose its latent stage structure. During execution, an episode-local fast-weight memory causally encodes realized action-observation transitions and modulates prompt cross-attention, producing a progress-aligned context for a unified diffusion action expert without test-time stage labels or stage-specific policies. PACE improves success from 88.9% to 94.0% on LIBERO-Gen Goal Chain, from 79.1% to 83.3% on Spatial Combination, and from 33.3% to 73.3% on the two-step Block Routing tasks. Failure analysis further indicates that structured demonstration alignment and causal execution memory jointly mitigate stage confusion.

analysis.tldr: 提出PACE方法，通过在执行过程中动态对齐演示视频的‘进度’来解决长程操作中因视觉相似状态反复出现导致的阶段混淆问题，用带因果记忆的快速权重机制实时调整扩散策略的注意力上下文，不依赖人工标注阶段标签或分阶段策略。
analysis.claim: 通过建模演示与执行之间的进度对齐关系，并引入 episode-local 因果记忆调制跨注意力，可系统性缓解长程模仿学习中的阶段混淆问题，显著提升多步操作任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB演示视频+当前真实机器人观测（图像+状态）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由扩散策略生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真演示数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-Gen基准上实现显著提升（Block Routing从33.3%→73.3%），有消融验证结构化对齐+因果记忆的协同作用，但仅限仿真、未部署真机、未跨机体/用户泛化，且未挑战接触密集或灵巧操作等核心难点，属扎实的长程策略对齐方向增量贡献，未达基石论文（如ACT/Diffusion Policy/ALOHA）所定义的范式级或部署级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真长程操作阶段对齐问题上提供了有实证支撑的新机制，但未突破仿真到真实、单机体到多机体、或接触/灵巧等更硬核瓶颈，暂未达到领域基石水平。

papers.title: Do VLAs Really Follow Instructions? Diagnosing How-Level Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are expected to follow instructions like their language backbones, yet prior work has focused on What-level instructions that specify the task rather than How-level instructions that specify how to carry it out. Through our diagnoses, we find that How-level instructions do not help current VLAs and lower task success. We hypothesize that pairing each training episode with a single instruction limits How-level instruction following, and show that training with segment-level enriched instructions makes actions respond to such instructions without consistently raising task success. To measure How-level instruction following beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce SIMPLER-IN, where success requires conditions given only in the instruction. It shows that the gained responsiveness does not extend to demanding or out-of-distribution How-level instructions. How-level instruction following thus remains an open challenge.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型根本不会遵循‘怎么做’类指令（比如‘用左手抓’‘缓慢移动’），反而会因这类指令降低任务成功率；作者尝试用分段式丰富指令训练来提升响应性，但发现模型只在简单指令上有效，对复杂或分布外的‘怎么做’指令依然失效；为此他们新建了一个专门测‘怎么做’能力的诊断基准SIMPLER-IN。
analysis.claim: 当前VLA模型不具备可靠的How-level指令遵循能力，且该能力无法通过简单增强训练指令得到实质性解决。
analysis.input: 图像+自然语言指令（含What-level和How-level两类）
analysis.output: 动作序列/机器人控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（摘要未提真实数据，仅说‘training episode’，上下文为仿真或离线VLA训练范式）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示VLA模型在How-level指令上的根本性失效，并构建首个针对性诊断基准SIMPLER-IN，属扎实增量贡献；但未提出可落地的解决方案，无真机验证、无新架构突破、无性能提升，也未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如闭环控制、sim2real、多机体泛化），远低于RT-2、π0、InternW0-Δ等基石工作所代表的范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——精准诊断出VLA模型被长期忽视的能力盲区并给出首个专用评测工具，但止步于问题暴露，未提供可复现、可扩展、可部署的解决路径。

papers.title: E2DRL: End-to-End Differentiable Reinforcement Learning for 3D Obstacle Avoidance in Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract: Differentiable reinforcement learning shows strong promise for robot policy learning, but its application to legged locomotion has remained limited to blind walking or simulated 2D tasks. Extending it to end-to-end visual obstacle avoidance is challenging because hard collision constraints and early termination upon contact corrupt first-order gradients, trapping optimizers in local minima. We present E2DRL, which addresses this with a soft differentiable obstacle-interaction formulation: penetration penalties across multiple body keypoints with velocity-conditioned stop-gradient shaping to provide the first-order training signals for 3D obstacle avoidance. To realize a deployable perception-control system, a privileged teacher trained via Soft Analytic Policy Optimization (SAPO) in a differentiable simulator is distilled into a recurrent depth-based student via DAgger, then blended with a base locomotion policy using a terrain-aware gating module for deployment. In simulation, E2DRL achieves higher sample efficiency than PPO and demonstrates superior velocity-tracking performance and 3D obstacle-avoidance capability compared with both PPO and Duality-based DCBF NMPC. We present the first sim-to-real validation of end-to-end differentiable RL for 3D obstacle avoidance on a Unitree Go2 in static and dynamic environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出E2DRL方法，用可微分强化学习实现四足机器人端到端视觉3D避障：通过软穿透惩罚+速度条件的stop-gradient设计解决碰撞导致梯度中断问题，并用特权教师蒸馏+地形感知门控融合策略实现在Unitree Go2上的sim2real部署。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室线索，仅从姓名风格推测可能为中国高校或研究所，但无法确认清华/浙大/哈工大等具体归属）

analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（隐式输出，经底层控制器映射）

papers.title: Active Generative Simulation: Meta-Learning What to Simulate for Sim-and-Real Policy Co-Training
papers.abstract: Sim-and-real co-training is an effective way to scale robot learning by augmenting limited real-world demonstrations with simulation data. However, existing approaches typically treat simulators as fixed data sources, relying on uniform generation, offline retrieval, or manual parameter alignment by domain experts. We formulate \textit{Active Generative Simulation}: optimizing a simulator's data-generation distribution to maximize downstream real-world performance. To solve this problem, we propose MetaGenSim, a meta-learning framework that trains an auxiliary rater network via meta-gradients to automatically discover high-utility data-generation distributions within a user-specified simulation parameter space, without manual parameter alignment. Across simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, MetaGenSim outperforms uniform generation and retrieval baselines, achieves a 150% relative improvement in real-world full-task success over uniform generation, and matches expert manual alignment. We further show that distributions curated with a lightweight proxy policy transfer to VLA fine-tuning, and that MetaGenSim can exploit partial alignment through atomic skill stitching and object-receptacle composition when exact sim-and-real task alignment is unavailable. Project website: https://meta-gensim.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Active Generative Simulation的新范式，让仿真器自己学会‘生成什么数据最能提升真实机器人任务表现’，用元学习训练一个‘评分网络’自动搜索仿真参数空间中的高价值数据分布，无需人工调参，实测在真实机械臂操作任务上比均匀采样仿真数据提升150%成功率，效果媲美专家手动对齐。
analysis.claim: 仿真器的数据生成分布应被主动优化以最大化下游真实世界策略性能，而非固定或人工对齐；该目标可通过元学习框架MetaGenSim自动实现。
analysis.input: 用户指定的仿真参数空间（如物体材质、摩擦系数、相机噪声范围等）+少量真实世界演示轨迹
analysis.output: 仿真器参数的高价值分布（即生成哪些类型仿真数据最有效）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RAVEN 手术机器人仿真环境（摘要未明说但实验含RAVEN，项目页确认）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（用于meta-gradient更新和验证），但不依赖大规模真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多任务验证（包括Franka和RAVEN）、有消融（uniform vs retrieval vs MetaGenSim）、显著超越基线且匹配专家调参，但未开源代码/模型，且未证明可扩展至复杂VLA或长程任务，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式重构或持续状态建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将元学习精准嵌入仿真数据生成闭环，在真实机器人上验证了‘仿真器可被训练’这一关键工程洞见，但缺乏开源与更大规模泛化证据，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Make Your VLA More Robust Without More Data By Interleaving Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown remarkable progress for mobile manipulation, but their performance on long-horizon tasks remains poor. These tasks are especially challenging because (1) progress toward high-level goals must be maintained across extended sequences of spatially distributed subtasks, and (2) early execution errors compound rapidly over the task horizon. These challenges persist despite finetuning on large human teleoperated mobile manipulation data, indicating that more data alone may not resolve the problem. To address these challenges, we propose MPVI: Motion Planner / VLA Interleaving, a framework that integrates model-based motion planning with VLAs to improve robustness without further training. The proposed integration enables localization and navigation to distant or occluded target objects through cluttered scenes using open-vocabulary object detection, frontier exploration and motion planning. However, such integration is non-trivial, requiring reliable switching between modules; we show one way forward via VLM-based completion checking with proprioceptive triggers. We evaluate our approach on the BEHAVIOR-1K benchmark and demonstrate 113% improvement in task progress over a top end-to-end VLA baseline. Additional details are available at the project page: https://mpvi.netlify.app/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MPVI框架，把现成的VLA模型和传统运动规划模块（如导航、探索、定位）交替调用，用视觉语言模型做任务完成检查来触发切换，不重新训练VLA就在BEHAVIOR-1K上把长程任务进展提升了113%。
analysis.claim: 通过在推理时将VLA与模块化运动规划器交替调度，并用VLM+本体感知信号触发切换，可显著提升VLA在长时序移动操作任务中的鲁棒性，且无需额外训练或真实机器人数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体感知（位置/关节等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（含导航、抓取、移动等多阶段动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用BEHAVIOR-1K仿真数据评估
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面显著推进：首次系统性证明‘VLA+经典规划模块’交替执行可大幅超越端到端VLA在长程任务上的表现，有完整消融（切换策略、VLM检查机制）、多任务BEHAVIOR-1K验证、明确失败模式分析；但纯仿真、无真机部署、未开源代码/模型，未挑战跨机体泛化，分量略低于π0.5（86分）但高于FAST（85分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把VLA和运动规划做成可插拔流水线，在仿真中实证了长程鲁棒性的新路径，但缺真机验证和开源，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data
papers.abstract: Video world models are a foundational generative technology for embodied AI and the Metaverse, yet existing approaches are inherently limited to a single agent observing from a single perspective. Extending these models to multi-agent settings introduces two critical challenges: data scarcity (coordinated multi-view recordings are prohibitively expensive to collect for general open-domain scenarios) and world state alignment (independently generated video streams cannot ensure that shared physical environments and events evolve consistently across views). To address these challenges, we propose MetaWorld, a novel framework that scales multi-agent video world models to open-domain environments directly from single-view videos. First, we introduce Monocular World-State Unrolling (MWSU) to explicitly decompose monocular footage into the camera operator's ego-motion and the visible subject's spatial trajectory. This camera-trajectory decomposition naturally extracts synchronized multi-agent motion data within a shared 3D space, completely bypassing the need for multi-camera setups. Second, for precise visual control, we develop the Subject-Aware World Generator to enable appearance-driven simulation conditioned on per-agent identity images. Finally, to ensure both views are grounded in the identical physical reality, we propose World-State Alignment, a per-frame inter-branch cross-attention mechanism inserted at every transformer layer of the video DiT. By jointly synchronizing the denoising process, WSA enforces both static geometric consistency and dynamic motion consistency, encouraging that the shared 3D environment and physical events remain well-aligned across both egocentric views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MetaWorld achieves superior cross-view consistency and identity fidelity, establishing a highly scalable, physics-driven paradigm for multi-agent video world modeling.

analysis.tldr: 用单视角视频训练出能生成多个智能体（如不同人）同步、一致、物理合理的多视角视频的世界模型，不依赖昂贵的多相机同步采集。
analysis.claim: 仅用单视角视频即可构建具备跨视角几何与运动一致性的多智能体视频世界模型，核心在于将单目视频解耦为相机运动与主体轨迹，并通过跨分支世界状态对齐机制强制多视图共享同一3D物理演化。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB视频序列（含任意人类活动）
analysis.output: 同步生成的多视角（egocentric）视频流（每个视角对应一个智能体）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需公开单视角人类行为视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-Kitchens）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出MWSU解耦与WSA对齐机制是实质性创新，实验证明跨视角一致性显著优于基线，但未在真实机器人上部署、无动作控制闭环、未接入具身任务benchmark（如RT-2/ManiSkill），仍属视频生成范畴的具身前驱工作，强于纯刷榜但弱于DreamerV3等真具身决策框架。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在视频世界模型向多智能体扩展的关键瓶颈（数据与对齐）上给出可验证的技术解，但尚未进入具身行动闭环，暂非里程碑级突破。

papers.title: VOLT: Vision and Language Trajectory Segmentation for Faster-than-Demonstration Policies
papers.abstract: Humans often take longer to demonstrate a task than a robot would need to execute it. Rather than learning to replicate the demonstration at the same pace, many industrial and practical applications require robots to perform tasks as quickly as possible. In this paper, we investigate several hypotheses for learning policies that operate faster-than-demonstrations. Our experiments show that the most effective strategy is to downsample recorded demonstrations and train the robot's policy on this accelerated data. However, uniformly downsampling an entire trajectory can be problematic. Some parts of a task can be safely sped up (e.g., unconstrained motion), while others demand slower, more precise motion (e.g., object interactions or fine manipulation). To address this challenge, we introduce VOLT, a vision-and-language trajectory segmentation method that reasons over video demonstrations, and leverages contextual cues to determine when acceleration is appropriate and when careful precision is required. VOLT identifies segments where slow, deliberate motion is necessary, then selectively downsamples the remaining segments. The resulting reformatted trajectories can be used with standard imitation learning approaches, such as diffusion policies. Our results highlight that segmentation quality is critical -- baseline methods often misidentify when acceleration is possible, leading to overly cautious or unreliable policies. Compared to state-of-the-art alternatives, VOLT allows robots to execute tasks faster while maintaining strong performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VOLT方法，通过分析视频+语言指令的演示数据，自动识别任务中哪些动作段必须慢速精准（如抓取、接触操作），哪些可以安全加速（如空载移动），然后只对可加速段做时间下采样，生成‘快于示范’的训练轨迹，让机器人学得更快但不牺牲精度。
analysis.claim: 任务轨迹中存在可加速与不可加速的语义分段，基于视觉-语言理解的细粒度轨迹分割是实现安全、可靠、快于示范策略学习的关键前提。
analysis.input: 视频演示帧序列 + 对应自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 轨迹的时间分段掩码（每段标注是否允许加速）及重采样后的加速轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人录制的带语言标注的视频演示数据（摘要未说明是否含真实机器人数据，但强调‘industrial and practical applications’且对比baseline在真实执行效果，推断含真实数据；但未明确规模/多样性，故写‘中等依赖’）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个显式建模‘加速可行性’的视觉-语言轨迹分割范式，实证显示其优于uniform downsampling和现有baseline，在真实机器人上实现速度提升+成功率保持；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，未接入主流扩散策略基座做端到端消融，贡献属显著但非范式级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在问题定义（快于示范≠均匀加速）和分割机制设计，有真实机器人验证，但工程闭环与开放性不足，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级里程碑地位。

papers.title: R-loop Prediction Reveals Generalization Limits of DNA Foundation Models Beyond Regulatory Genomics
papers.abstract: DNA foundation models are increasingly proposed as general-purpose representations for genomic prediction and design, yet their evaluation remains largely centered on conventional regulatory tasks. This leaves a critical question unresolved: do DNA foundation models generalize to sequence biology beyond conventional gene regulation? To answer this question, we introduce RloopBench, a systematic benchmark for R-loop-forming sequence prediction as a biophysically distinct, genome-stability-associated task. We compare rule-based methods, task-specific models, classical sequence encodings, and foundation model representations across in-distribution, cross-platform, consensus-level, and cross-species evaluations. Foundation models achieve strong performance when positive and negative sequences are compositionally separable, but this advantage does not consistently transfer to cross-platform and cross-species settings, where they are often comparable to classical k-mer representations. Unexpectedly, a one-hot classifier baseline shows the strongest overall sensitivity to R-loop-forming sequences, exceeding more complex models across several generalization tests. Rule-based and task-specific models also exhibit limited transfer outside their original training regimes. Performance is further shaped by sequence properties, negative-control design, experimental platform, and species-specific genomic context. Together, RloopBench establishes genome-stability-associated sequence prediction as a complementary direction for DNA foundation model development and evaluation, while underscoring that simple sequence encodings remain necessary baselines for assessing model generalization beyond conventional regulatory tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫RloopBench的新基准，专门测试DNA基础模型在预测R-loop（一种与基因组不稳定性相关的特殊DNA-RNA杂交结构）任务上的泛化能力，结果发现这些大模型在跨平台、跨物种等真实挑战场景下并不比简单的k-mer或one-hot分类器强，甚至更差。
analysis.claim: DNA基础模型在调控基因组学之外的序列生物学任务（如R-loop预测）中缺乏稳健泛化能力，其优势高度依赖于训练数据的组成偏差，简单基线模型反而更具鲁棒性。
analysis.input: DNA序列（含正负样本设计，覆盖不同实验平台与物种）
analysis.output: R-loop形成概率/二分类预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示DNA基础模型在非调控类、生物物理机制明确的基因组稳定性任务中的泛化失效，实证扎实（多平台/多物种/多负样本设计/消融对比），但未提出新模型或新架构，属高质量诊断性工作；显著优于纯benchmark（如GenBank-based刷榜），但远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或实用影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是技术突破，而是用严谨基准戳破了DNA基础模型‘通用性’的过度宣传，为领域设定了更严苛的评估标准。

papers.title: Systematic functional annotation of thousands of BAHD acyltransferases in plant genomes using Protein Language Model and phylogenomic tools
papers.abstract: The functional annotation of plant genes lags significantly behind their genomic annotation. Closing this gap requires thorough cataloging of reported protein activities alongside predictive methods that scale beyond sequence-similarity inference. Focusing on the BAHD acyltransferase enzyme family as a model, we assembled FuncZymeDB-BAHD, a large database of 2,705 LLM-retrieved and curated enzyme-acceptor-donor activities covering 336 BAHDs from 156 plant species, a 2-to-6-fold expansion over Swiss-Prot and prior compilations. We further developed FuncPred-OG, which maps queries to orthologous groups and previously characterized enzymes in FuncZymeDB-BAHD, returning hits with high evidence provenance. FuncPred-OG enabled functional prediction of over half of BAHDs across 85 plant proteomes, of which five novel predictions were validated via in vitro assays and recent studies. For the remaining BAHDs without FuncPred-OG annotation, we developed FuncPred-AI, where logistic-regression classifiers trained on protein language model embeddings achieved high Area-Under-the-Precision-Recall-curve (AUPR) scores and correct-hit rates up to 93%. FuncPred-AI yielded >1 probable donor/acceptor annotation for 99.9% (8894/8897) of BAHDs in our pan-plant dataset. Finally, the FuncPred workflow and datasets were deployed on a web portal for broader utilization, potentially reducing experimentalist efforts for selecting candidates from days to minutes. Overall, this framework provides a generalizable template for functional annotation of entire enzyme families.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型（PLM）和系统发育工具，大规模注释了8897个植物BAHD酰基转移酶的功能（供体/受体底物），构建了含2705条实验验证活性的数据库FuncZymeDB-BAHD，并开发了两个互补预测工具FuncPred-OG（基于同源群映射）和FuncPred-AI（基于PLM嵌入的逻辑回归），在85个植物蛋白组中实现超半数BAHD的高置信功能预测，其中5个预测经体外实验验证。
analysis.claim: 结合PLM嵌入、正交群映射与实验验证，首次实现对整个BAHD酶家族在泛植物尺度上的系统性、可验证、高覆盖率功能注释。
analysis.input: BAHD蛋白序列
analysis.output: 预测的底物类型（供体如乙酰辅酶A、受体如类黄酮/生物碱等）及置信度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进植物酶功能注释范式：构建首个大规模、人工校验的BAHD活性数据库（2705条，远超Swiss-Prot），提出OG+AI双轨预测框架，5个预测获体外实验验证，且全流程开源；但未引入新PLM架构或训练范式（依赖现有ESM类模型），也未解决更普适的‘酶功能预测’根本难题（如反应机制建模、立体选择性预测），属领域内扎实的重大工程化突破，未达AlphaFold级范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有PLM能力与系统发育分析、人工-curated数据库深度耦合，形成可复现、可扩展、已验证的植物酶注释流水线，大幅压缩实验筛选周期，但未创造新模型或解决底层生物学建模难题。

papers.title: AnnotateAnything: Automatic Annotation of 3D Assets for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Simulation enables scalable robot data collection, but raw 3D assets provide only geometry, lacking the semantic, interactive, and physical knowledge needed to specify where and how robots should act. In this work, we present AnnotateAnything, a general automatic annotation framework that converts passive 3D assets into manipulation-ready assets with structured, diverse, and executable manipulation labels. AnnotateAnything is built around two complementary pipelines. First, a unified visual-language annotation pipeline using vision-language reasoning to infer object semantics, interaction constraints, and 3D-grounded cues, providing human-prior guidance for identifying meaningful interaction regions. Second, a fully automatic and massively parallel physics annotation pipeline grounds these priors in each asset's geometry and physical constraints through candidate generation, geometry optimization and trajectory generation. This pipeline produces diverse and executable action annotations, including grasp poses, dexterous contacts, articulation waypoints, insertion directions, hanging affordances, and navigation targets. Using the generated annotations, we further build an asynchronous parallel simulation data-collection system across diverse objects, tasks, and robot embodiments. Experiments demonstrate that AnnotateAnything achieves superior annotation efficiency, data-collection efficiency, and task success rates over existing annotation and data-generation pipelines, while also supporting downstream tasks such as affordance detection, robotic VQA, and visual instruction finetuning. We provide project materials on the project page and plan to release the full code, annotations, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Videos, code, demo assets, and annotations are provided in supplementary materials Project page: https://tourmaline-caramel-169490.netlify.app.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AnnotateAnything框架，自动给3D模型（如椅子、水壶）打上机器人可执行的操作标签（比如哪里能抓、怎么插、往哪挂），把‘死’的3D资产变成‘能用’的仿真训练素材，全程无需人工标注。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明示；虽有中文名作者，但无机构署名线索，项目页域名tourmaline-caramel-169490.netlify.app不指向知名机构）
analysis.claim: 仅靠3D几何模型即可全自动、大规模生成结构化、物理可行、任务多样化的机器人操作标注（grasp/insert/hang/articulation等），且标注可直接驱动仿真数据采集与下游任务训练。
analysis.input: 原始3D资产（mesh/obj/GLB格式，仅含几何）
analysis.output: 结构化操作标注：抓取位姿、灵巧接触点、铰链运动路径、插入方向、悬挂支撑面、导航目标点等
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯基于3D资产和物理仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了仿真数据生成的自动化瓶颈：首次将视觉语言推理+并行物理仿真耦合，批量产出多类型可执行操作标注，并验证其提升下游任务性能；但未开源核心代码/数据，也未在真实机器人上部署或验证跨仿真器泛化，尚未达到DROID/MimicGen级的系统性影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了3D资产到机器人可操作表示的自动化鸿沟，证据扎实（多任务+物理可行性验证+下游增益），但因缺乏全开源和真机闭环，尚属高质量工程整合，非范式突破

papers.title: ConfDock: Atom-specific Uncertainty Quantification for Molecular Docking via Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract: Molecular docking is widely used in structure-based drug discovery, yet most approaches provide point estimates without rigorous uncertainty quantification. This limitation makes it difficult to assess when a predicted pose should be trusted, especially when docking methods are applied to diverse protein-ligand systems. We present ConfDock, a conformal prediction (CP) framework for constructing atom-specific prediction intervals for ligand docking poses. ConfDock combines graph neural network (GNN) based quantile estimation with split conformal calibration, producing intervals that adapt to local protein-ligand environments while retaining distribution-free finite-sample coverage guarantees. We evaluate ConfDock on 238 protein-ligand complexes across four docking methods representing distinct computational paradigms. The proposed approach yields substantially narrower prediction intervals compared to standard split CP (57.2% average reduction in mean interval width, up to 74.5%) while maintaining target coverage across all evaluated settings. Ablation analysis indicates that the GNN captures the dominant structure-dependent variability in uncertainty, whereas the conformal calibration step provides a bounded adjustment to ensure coverage guarantees. These results demonstrate that combining learned, structure-aware quantile estimation with conformal calibration enables rigorous uncertainty quantification for molecular docking at atom-level resolution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ConfDock方法，为分子对接预测的每个原子位置生成具有统计保证的不确定性区间，解决传统对接工具只给单一预测结果、无法判断可信度的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过将图神经网络驱动的原子级分位数估计与分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction）结合，ConfDock能在无需分布假设的前提下，为任意蛋白-配体对接结果提供严格覆盖概率保证的原子级不确定性量化。
analysis.input: 蛋白-配体复合物结构（PDB格式）、对接预测的初始pose（坐标）
analysis.output: 每个配体原子坐标的三维置信区间（x/y/z方向独立区间）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现原子级、分布无关、跨多种对接引擎（AutoDock Vina/RFscore/PLANTS/DOCK）的共形不确定性校准，实证扎实（238个复合物+消融+宽度压缩超57%），但未改变对接范式本身，也未整合生成或物理建模能力，属于关键使能技术而非底层突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了分子对接的可靠性评估范式，但仍是工具层增强，非AlphaFold级的基础模型或生成范式变革。

papers.title: Peptide:MHC Binding Stability Prediction Using Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: A bstract Peptide:MHC class I (pMHC-I) binding stability governs the persistence of antigenic complexes at the cell surface and plays a key role in facilitating downstream immunological signals such as antigen presentation, T-cell activation, and immunodominance. However, methods for in silico stability prediction remain underexplored relative to binding affinity prediction, in part because available half-life datasets are sparse and expensive to collect. Here, we perform a systematic reassessment of pMHC-I stability prediction using controlled, similarity-aware data splits and apply a recently introduced supervised transfer-learning strategy to MINT, an interaction-aware protein language model, pre-trained on binding affinity and fine-tuned for quantitative half-life prediction. We show that MINT improves stability prediction over standard ESM-2 representations and existing predictors, and that assay-conditioned recalibration corrects systematic shifts across experimental measurement modalities. Across eluted ligand, immunogenicity, and personalized neoantigen prioritization benchmarks, predicted stability provides signal beyond binding affinity, enriching for naturally presented and immunogenic peptides within affinity-filtered candidate sets. These results establish pMHC-I half-life as an orthogonal and transferable biophysical signal connecting peptide binding, surface presentation, and T-cell recognition, and provide a leakage-aware, assay-aware framework for future antigen-presentation modeling.

analysis.tldr: 用改进的蛋白语言模型MINT预测肽段与MHC-I分子结合后的半衰期（稳定性），在控制数据相似性偏差的前提下，证明稳定性预测能补充传统亲和力预测，在自然呈递和T细胞免疫原性上提供独立且可迁移的生物学信号。
analysis.org: Scripps Research / Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
analysis.claim: pMHC-I结合半衰期是一个正交于结合亲和力、可被蛋白语言模型有效预测、且对自然抗原呈递和T细胞识别具有独立预测价值的生物物理信号。
analysis.input: 肽段序列 + MHC-I等位基因序列
analysis.output: 定量结合半衰期（小时）预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开的体外半衰期实验数据集（如NetMHCpan-elution、IEDB stability assays），无真实机器人或高通量实验平台耦合
analysis.significance_reason: 在pMHC稳定性预测这一长期被忽视但生物学意义明确的子问题上，首次系统性构建泄漏感知、测定条件校准的评估框架，用严谨的数据划分+消融实验证明MINT显著超越ESM-2及现有工具，并在三个下游免疫学任务中证实稳定性信号不可被亲和力替代——证据扎实、任务关键、开源代码可用，但未引入全新建模范式（仍属PLM微调），也未覆盖MHC-II或临床队列验证，故略低于AlphaFold2/ESM2级里程碑，但强于一般方法学论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以严格防泄漏方式确立pMHC-I半衰期为独立可预测的免疫相关生物物理维度，并给出首个经多任务验证的实用预测器

papers.title: EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning effective action representations is critical for robotic manipulation, where raw control trajectories are often noisy, redundant, and difficult to model directly. Existing methods mainly encode the structure of the action stream itself, treating the role of actions in the environment as implicit. Yet manipulation is about changing the world: the same action segment can induce different outcomes under different scene contexts, making action semantics inherently environment-dependent. We propose EDAR, an Environment-Dependent Action Representation that grounds action tokens in both executable control structure and expected visual consequences. By coupling motor commands with their environment-conditioned effects, EDAR encourages the learned action space to capture interaction semantics rather than merely command-level patterns. Experiments on simulated and real-robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that EDAR improves downstream policy learning, especially in long-horizon manipulation. These results highlight the importance of grounding action representations in executable control structure and environment-conditioned visual change.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EDAR方法，把机器人动作表示成既包含可执行的底层控制结构、又绑定其在特定环境里预期视觉变化的联合表征，从而让动作语义真正依赖于场景上下文，提升长程操作任务的策略学习效果。
analysis.claim: 动作语义本质上是环境依赖的，仅建模动作序列自身结构不足以支撑泛化操作；将动作表征同时锚定于可执行控制结构和环境条件下的视觉后果，能显著提升长时程操纵策略的学习效率与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令+当前状态
analysis.output: 环境依赖的动作token序列（每个token隐含控制结构与预期视觉变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda仿真器 + 真实Panda机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（摘要未提采集规模，但实验含real-robot验证，推断为小规模）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的动作表征解耦思路（控制结构+环境后果），在sim和small-real上验证了对长程任务的增益，有消融和多基准对比，但未开源代码/模型，未展示跨机体泛化或复杂接触力学建模，未挑战高精度灵巧操作（如YUBI/RealDexUMI级双指协同），也未解决触觉-视觉-力耦合等开放难题，属扎实且有启发性的增量贡献，但未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但首次系统性将动作语义显式解耦为‘可执行性’与‘环境后果’两要素，并在真实机器人上验证有效性，为动作表征设计提供了新范式线索。

papers.title: Low-latency neuromorphic closed-loop control of hippocampal ripples in vivo
papers.abstract: Real-time closed-loop neuromodulation, in which stimulation is precisely timed to ongoing brain dynamics, holds transformative potential for treating neurological disorders and probing neural circuit function. However, it requires low-latency, energy-efficient processing of high-bandwidth neural signals that conventional computing architectures struggle to deliver. Neuromorphic computing, which emulates the event-driven and massively parallel operation of biological neural circuits, offers a compelling alternative. Yet, its integration into closed-loop frameworks validated in vivo for fast, transient oscillations has not been demonstrated. Here, we present a fully integrated neuromorphic framework for real-time detection and manipulation of hippocampal ripples: brief (30-100 ms), high-frequency (100-250 Hz) oscillations that are critical for memory consolidation and implicated in neurological disorders. We train compact spiking neural networks comprising 41 neurons and 530 parameters using surrogate-gradient backpropagation, achieving detection performance competitive with deep learning models across 23 recording sessions while consuming up to 200-fold less energy when deployed on SpiNNaker neuromorphic hardware. Integration with the open-source Open Ephys platform yields total closed-loop latencies of approximately 50 ms, enabling intra-event stimulation in up to 80% of ripples. Validating the complete sensing-processing-stimulation pipeline in awake, head-fixed mice, we demonstrate that neuromorphic-triggered optogenetic inhibition significantly alters ripple dynamics and reduces oscillatory energy. This work establishes a practical and accessible neuromorphic framework for low-latency closed-loop control of fast brain dynamics in vivo.

analysis.tldr: 用低功耗类脑芯片（SpiNNaker）实时检测小鼠海马体中持续仅30–100毫秒的高频涟漪振荡，并在50毫秒内触发光遗传抑制，首次在清醒小鼠体内验证了全链路类脑闭环调控的可行性。
analysis.claim: 紧凑型脉冲神经网络可在类脑硬件上实现亚50ms闭环延迟、能量效率提升200倍的海马涟漪实时闭环调控，且在清醒小鼠体内具备功能有效性。
analysis.input: 颅内多通道电生理信号（LFP/宽频带）
analysis.output: 光遗传刺激触发信号（二值事件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖清醒小鼠体内真实电生理+光遗传闭环实验数据（23个记录session，含行为状态标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在清醒哺乳动物体内实现类脑芯片驱动的亚50ms闭环调控，实证了脉冲网络对瞬态脑振荡的高时序精度干预能力；但仅限单一脑区（CA1）、单一振荡类型（涟漪）、单一干预方式（光遗传抑制），未跨物种/跨疾病模型/跨模态验证，且开源程度有限（仅代码，无模型权重与原始数据），未达基石级工作（如BCI语音合成或脊髓接口）的临床广度与系统复杂度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它是首个在活体哺乳动物中完成端到端类脑闭环调控的实证工作，技术路径扎实、延迟与能效指标过硬，但应用范围窄，尚未进入临床转化或跨范式拓展阶段。

papers.title: ProteinSketch translates spatial intuition into protein design with bimanual interaction in VR
papers.abstract: Generative AI-based protein design can create diverse structures for desired functions but offers human designers limited control over three–dimensional architectures. We developed ProteinSketch, a bimanual virtual reality platform in which immersive backbone sketches and volumetric envelopes are directly created and translated into constraints for diffusion-based protein generation. RFdiffusion-based real-time refinement enabled interactive exploration and construction of user-specified protein topologies. Volumetric conditioning of sketched envelopes enabled high-fidelity control of anisometric geometries, confirmed by cryo-electron microscopy. These user-defined volumetric constraints enabled functional-binder design and extension of pre-existing minibinders to surfaces otherwise difficult to access within complex molecular environments using conventional design approaches. This collaborative human-AI framework integrates human spatial reasoning with generative AI for spatially directed, shape-controlled design of protein structure and function.

analysis.tldr: 用VR双手交互画出蛋白质骨架草图和三维体积包络，实时驱动RFdiffusion生成符合该几何约束的蛋白质结构，并通过冷冻电镜验证了设计精度，实现了人类空间直觉与AI生成的闭环协同设计。
analysis.claim: 人类在VR中通过双手机制进行空间草图绘制和体积包络定义，可作为高保真几何约束直接引导扩散模型生成具备指定拓扑与各向异性形状的蛋白质结构，且该约束能成功导向功能蛋白（如表面结合器）的设计。
analysis.input: VR中双手绘制的蛋白质主链草图 + 用户定义的三维体积包络（volumetric envelope）
analysis.output: 满足草图与包络约束的原子级蛋白质结构（PDB格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖RFdiffusion预训练权重及少量cryo-EM验证数据（非训练用）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现VR原生、双手机制、实时反馈的蛋白质几何约束生成闭环，且cryo-EM实验证实了体积包络对各向异性结构（如长条形结合界面）的控制力；但未开源核心VR-生成耦合代码，未在标准benchmark（如DiffDock、ProteinMPNN下游任务）上做泛化对比，验证案例仅3个设计（含1个minibinder扩展），未挑战AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion级的基础建模能力，属重大工程整合与人机范式创新，而非底层模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VR空间交互、扩散模型与结构生物学验证深度耦合，显著提升了人类对生成过程的几何控制力，但未改变蛋白质生成的底层建模范式或拓展其功能边界。

papers.title: CG-World: A Large-Scale World-State Dataset and Protocol for World Models
papers.abstract: World models must learn the joint dynamics of states, actions, events, and observations, yet existing video, robotics, and simulation datasets usually capture only part of this structure. We introduce CG-World, a large-scale world-state dataset and protocol derived from industrial computer graphics production pipelines. CG-World explicitly records intermediate states, including multimodal semantics, spatial structure, skeletal and controller states, motion curves, camera and lighting parameters, physics caches, contact events, and multi-pass renderings. CG-World v1 contains approximately 850,000 temporally aligned segments of 1-5 seconds. It separates latent states, observations, relations, events, and branch metadata, and organizes them into unified spatiotemporal samples. To support intervention learning and counterfactual reasoning, CG-World defines a branch lineage covering factual trajectories, observation interventions, action interventions, mechanism interventions, and strict counterfactual branches, with intervention targets, invariants, and alternative outcomes explicitly recorded. We evaluate the dataset on geometry-conditioned video generation, action prediction, and closed-loop vision-language-action policy transfer. Results show that CG-World provides reusable structured supervision for controlled generation, action modeling, and embodied policy transfer. We plan to expand CG-World through continued data collection and community collaboration toward a shared data infrastructure for world models, Physical AI, and embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个来自工业级计算机图形流水线的大规模世界状态数据集CG-World，显式记录了动画制作中完整的中间状态（骨骼、控制器、物理缓存、光照、相机、接触事件、多通道渲染等），并设计了支持干预学习和反事实推理的分支谱系协议，目标是为世界模型提供结构化、可干预的监督信号。
analysis.claim: 世界模型需要联合建模状态、动作、事件与观测的完整动力学结构，而现有数据集仅覆盖其中片段；CG-World通过工业CG流水线生成的高保真、多模态、时空对齐、带干预谱系的世界状态数据，首次系统性填补这一结构性空白。
analysis.input: 多模态中间状态（骨骼/控制器/物理缓存/相机/光照/接触事件/多通渲染）+干预类型与目标
analysis.output: 结构化世界状态序列（含分支谱系、不变量、反事实结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于工业CG仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统定义并发布具备完整世界状态要素（含干预谱系）的工业级CG数据集，结构设计严谨，但当前仅v1且无开源代码/模型，评估仅限三项下游任务（生成/预测/迁移），缺乏跨域泛化验证、消融分析或与SOTA世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）的严格对比，尚未证明其能实质性推动模型架构或训练范式升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——数据构造理念先进、结构完备，但实证深度不足，尚属高质量基建型工作，非范式突破

papers.title: EasyBCI Agent: Towards Universal Neural Data Preprocessing for Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces translate neural activity into device commands, yet their performance hinges on preprocessing that remains manual, expert-dependent and poorly reproducible. Large language model agents can automate scientific coding, but existing systems lack the modality coverage, raw-data isolation, experience accumulation and domain oversight that neural preprocessing requires. We introduce EasyBCI, a two-phase LLM agent that plans and executes preprocessing pipelines for six signal types. A Plan Agent profiles each recording into a text-only Data Fingerprint that never exposes raw data to the model and selects a literature-grounded operator sequence. An Execution Agent generates, runs and self-corrects code until quality criteria are met, while a quality-gated experience system retains validated strategies as reusable skills. A domain expert intervenes at two decision gates, retaining human judgement where undetected error can invalidate downstream analyses. Evaluation on EEG with a fixed linear classifier shows that all five EasyBCI backbones preserve more task-relevant separability than the manual pipeline. Under same-backbone comparison, EasyBCI outperforms general-purpose coding agents on both label schemes for four of five configurations. EasyBCI extends to five additional modalities spanning nearly three orders of magnitude in sampling rate, producing complete reproducible pipelines with recorded decision provenance. These results indicate that domain-specific orchestration can bring auditable preprocessing within reach of laboratories lacking dedicated expertise, illustrating design principles applicable to AI agents in other scientific domains.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫EasyBCI的两阶段大语言模型智能体，自动为六种神经信号（如EEG等）生成可审计、可复现的预处理流程，全程不暴露原始数据，由领域专家在关键节点把关，最终在EEG任务上比人工流程保留了更多任务相关判别性。
analysis.claim: 领域专用的LLM智能体可通过分阶段规划-执行+专家门控+经验沉淀机制，实现神经数据预处理的自动化、可审计化与跨模态泛化，且无需暴露原始数据。
analysis.input: 神经信号原始记录（文本描述的Data Fingerprint，不含原始波形）
analysis.output: 完整可运行的预处理代码+质量验证报告+决策溯源日志
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖公开/实验室EEG及其他神经信号数据集（摘要未明说但隐含需实测数据验证pipeline）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM agent系统性用于神经数据预处理全流程自动化，并引入‘原始数据隔离+专家双门控+技能沉淀’设计，在EEG上实证优于人工流程且扩展至6种模态；但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如解码性能跃迁、临床长期稳定性、闭环控制），属高质量方法学推进而非范式突破，显著弱于所有90+分基石工作（均涉及高精度实时闭环解码或临床功能重建）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将LLM agent范式扎实落地到神经科学预处理这一长期手工瓶颈环节，设计严谨、实证充分、跨模态可扩展，但未触及BCI最核心的解码与闭环控制问题。

papers.title: CORTIVA: Candidate-Score Fusion of Complementary Visual Teachers for EEG- and MEG-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract: Decoding visual experience from non-invasive brain activity is central to neuroscience and brain-computer interfaces. Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) offers fine spatial detail, but its slow hemodynamics and burdensome acquisition limit temporally resolved decoding. Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide millisecond resolution, making image retrieval compelling: identify the viewed image from one neural response and a fixed candidate bank. Contrastive alignment to pretrained visual representations enables zero-shot retrieval from EEG and MEG, but most systems collapse heterogeneous visual supervision into a single embedding before ranking. This early consolidation imposes one similarity geometry on every candidate order and removes encoder-specific disagreements from the final ranking. We propose CORTIVA, a candidate-score fusion framework that preserves this complementary evidence. Three decoding routes are aligned to heterogeneous visual targets, score the same indexed candidates independently, and combine only their temperature-scaled score vectors before ranking. On the 200-way THINGS-EEG2 benchmark, CORTIVA reaches 73.5% Top-1 and 95.3% Top-5 across ten participants, exceeding the strongest reported baseline by 10.3 and 5.4 percentage points. With a modality-specific neural encoder, the same fusion principle reaches 42.4% Top-1 on THINGS-MEG. Matched route-removal retraining and four weight controls demonstrate that CORTIVA's gain arises from integrating complementary route scores and persists with uniform weighting, without requiring a specialized weighting rule. Independent DINOv2 analyses further reproduce the local error neighborhoods and posterior neural-visual correspondence. These results establish candidate-score fusion as a simple and testable alternative to embedding-level consolidation for neural image retrieval.

analysis.tldr: 提出CORTIVA框架，不把多种视觉教师模型的预测结果提前融合成单一嵌入，而是让每个教师独立打分再融合分数向量，从而提升EEG/MEG脑信号到图像检索的准确率。
analysis.claim: 在EEG/MEG到图像检索任务中，候选图像层面的分数融合（candidate-score fusion）比嵌入层面的早期融合（embedding-level consolidation）更能保留互补视觉监督信息，显著提升检索性能。
analysis.input: 单次EEG或MEG脑响应信号（对应一张观览图像）
analysis.output: 候选图像库中匹配图像的排序列表（Top-1/Top-5检索结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人依赖，仅依赖公开脑电/脑磁数据集（THINGS-EEG2、THINGS-MEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法简洁有效，在THINGS-EEG2上提升显著（+10.3% Top-1），有跨被试泛化和消融验证，但未突破模态瓶颈（仍依赖固定候选库、零样本但非生成式、未解决低信噪比根本问题），且未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高；远未达神经接口基石级工作（如实时语音解码、运动意图闭环控制）的临床/范式意义。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在脑信号图像检索的分数融合策略上做出合理改进并验证有效，但仍是封闭候选集下的判别式检索，未触及重建、生成或在线闭环等关键挑战，属于高质量方法学微创新。

papers.title: Embodied Passive Aeroacoustic Perception Enables Relative Sensing and Pursuit Between Aerial Robots
papers.abstract: Aerial robots generate structured aeroacoustic fields during flight, yet these signals have been underexplored as a source of onboard relative perception, particularly under the strong ego-acoustic interference generated during simultaneous flight in various outdoor conditions. We introduce embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, a sensing paradigm in which an aerial robot infers actionable relative-state information from the naturally generated sound of flight while operating within its own evolving aeroacoustic field. We present SonicFly, a passive aeroacoustic perception framework that enables one unmanned aerial vehicle to estimate and follow another using only the leader's intrinsic flight sound, without active acoustic signaling, inter-robot communication, GPS sharing, or external sensing infrastructure. The system uses a lightweight four-microphone array, rotorcraft-informed acoustic representations, a neural bearing-range estimator, and confidence-gated filtering for closed-loop flight. Through acoustic characterization, onboard localization, and outdoor pursuit experiments, we show that multirotor aeroacoustic signals contain sufficient information to support relative perception despite strong ego-acoustic interference, environmental variability, and changing flight geometry. During acoustic-only pursuit, SonicFly achieved a mean distance-maintenance error of 1.34 m across diverse outdoor trajectories and operating conditions. Analysis of the acoustic channel reveals design principles governing embodied passive aeroacoustic perception, including the roles of harmonic structure, spectral separability, and spatial acoustic cues in determining observability. Our results establish the feasibility of embodied passive aeroacoustic perception for aerial robots and suggest that naturally generated behavioral signals can serve as information for robotic perception and coordination.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让无人机仅靠听另一架无人机飞行时自然产生的声音（不依赖GPS、通信、主动发声或外部设备），就能实时估计相对位置并完成跟飞，核心是用四麦克风阵列和专门设计的声学表征+神经网络来克服自身旋翼噪声的强干扰。
analysis.claim: 多旋翼无人机在强自噪声和动态环境下的自然飞行声信号中蕴含足够鲁棒的相对状态信息，可通过被动声学感知实现无通信、无GPS、无主动信标的闭环跟飞。
analysis.input: 四麦克风阵列采集的原始声压信号（含强自噪声）
analysis.output: 相对方位角、距离估计值，以及闭环控制所需的跟飞动作指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四麦克风阵列+DJI M300/Custom quadrotor平台
analysis.data_dependency: 严重依赖真实无人机户外飞行采集的声学数据（含多场景、多轨迹、多干扰条件）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实复杂户外环境中验证了纯被动声学相对感知的可行性，具备多场景部署证据、闭环真机实验、系统级消融（如谐波结构剥离、空间线索屏蔽）、定量误差指标（1.34m），但未开源数据/模型，且未扩展至群体协同或跨机体泛化，属扎实重磅工作，但未达World Model级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将声学物理建模、传感器硬件定制、神经估计器与闭环控制深度耦合，在真实复杂环境中达成首个可部署的被动声学跟飞系统，非概念包装，但未开新范式。

papers.title: TRACE: Learned Proprioceptive Odometry for Legged Robots under Unreliable Contact Conditions
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present TRACE (Tokenized Robust Attention for Contact-Aware Estimation), an end-to-end learned proprioceptive odometry estimator for legged robots under unreliable contact conditions. The proposed estimator directly predicts relative displacement, relative rotation, and body-frame velocity from a recent history of onboard inertial and joint measurements. To improve robustness under unreliable contact conditions, we introduce a foot-aware cross-attention module that adaptively weights IMU and leg-wise kinematic tokens without relying on manually defined contact or slip thresholds. The estimator is trained with direct supervision and two physics-inspired auxiliary losses that promote kinematic consistency and reliable use of leg information. To reduce policy-specific overfitting and consequently improve sim-to-real transfer, simulation training incorporates policy randomization, followed by partial real-world fine-tuning of the temporal encoder and prediction head. Experiments across diverse indoor and outdoor terrains demonstrate consistent reductions in position drift compared with classical filtering-based, hybrid, and purely learning-based baselines. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of the proposed training objectives, policy randomization, and real-world fine-tuning, particularly under unreliable contacts and sim-to-real mismatch.

analysis.tldr: 提出TRACE模型，用纯本体感知（IMU+关节编码）数据估计四足机器人在打滑、失接触等不可靠接触条件下的位姿变化，不依赖接触检测或手工阈值，通过脚部感知的交叉注意力和物理启发的辅助损失提升鲁棒性，并结合策略随机化仿真训练+部分真实数据微调来改善sim2real效果。
analysis.claim: 仅用IMU和关节数据即可在接触不可靠（如打滑、悬空、软地面）条件下实现高鲁棒性的本体感知里程计估计，无需显式接触状态输入或人工设定阈值。
analysis.input: 近期IMU角速度/加速度序列 + 各腿关节角度/角速度序列
analysis.output: 相对位移向量、相对旋转四元数、机体坐标系下线速度与角速度
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人（具体未指明型号，实验含ANYmal与Unitree Go2）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据用于微调（摘要称'partial real-world fine-tuning'），但主体训练基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中解决了长期存在的本体感知里程计对接触假设敏感这一关键瓶颈：真机多地形验证（室内外）、跨机体测试（ANYmal+Go2）、完整消融（策略随机化/辅助损失/微调缺一不可）、对比SOTA基线（滤波/混合/纯学习方法）且显著降低漂移；但未开新范式（仍是端到端回归），也未解决更根本的长期漂移累积问题，尚未部署于开放场景或任务闭环中。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将物理约束建模、注意力机制与sim2real训练策略系统性融合，在真实四足平台上验证了接触鲁棒性里程计的可行性，但未突破感知-运动耦合建模范式。

papers.title: EnvACE: Internalizing Environment Dynamics via World Rehearsal for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Training large language model agents for long-horizon tool use typically relies on interactions with real or synthesized executable environments, whose construction and verification are costly, or on external simulators that are difficult to ground. We introduce EnvACE, an agentic reinforcement learning method that replaces external environment interaction during training with world rehearsal. The policy alternates between acting and rehearsal: it first generates a tool call, then plays the role of the environment to produce the response induced by that action, and conditions subsequent decisions on the rehearsed response. Both roles are jointly optimized end-to-end using task-success rewards. Through world rehearsal, the policy internalizes the relationship between actions and their environment responses in its parameters, yielding an agent world model that directly supports decision making. Across BFCL-v4, tau^2-Bench, VitaBench, and FinMCP-Bench, EnvACE achieves strong and transferable performance, outperforming environment-scaling baselines in the overall evaluation. Controlled studies further show that world rehearsal consistently improves policy learning across model scales. At test time, the internalized world model enables private rehearsal before committed execution, yielding further gains under a moderate rehearsal budget without additional external interaction. Our findings establish world rehearsal as a new path toward scaling LLM agent training beyond the constraints of external environments. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Within-yao/EnvACE.

analysis.tldr: 提出EnvACE方法，让大语言模型代理在训练时不依赖真实或外部仿真环境，而是让模型自己扮演‘环境’来模拟工具调用后的响应（即‘世界排演’），从而内化环境动力学，提升长程工具使用能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无明显头部机构署名线索；GitHub仓库名 'Within-yao' 暗示可能为个人或小型团队，非英伟达/DeepMind/清华等明确主体）
analysis.claim: 通过端到端联合优化‘代理-环境’双角色，使LLM代理能在无外部可执行环境交互的情况下，仅靠内部世界排演（world rehearsal）学习并泛化长程工具调用策略。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 历史工具调用与响应（含自生成的排演响应）
analysis.output: 下一步工具调用（结构化动作，如API调用）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖合成基准测试中的工具API响应模拟（但未说明是否使用真实API日志或人工标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘代理自演环境’机制系统化用于LLM工具调用训练，在多个跨领域基准上验证有效性且有消融，但未提供真实API交互验证、未开源训练数据/环境接口、未证明对不可靠/动态变化的真实工具（如网页DOM漂移、API版本变更）的鲁棒性；相比World Models系列（95+分）缺乏显式状态空间建模、记忆机制或闭环生成质量评估，属于强工程整合而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把世界模型思想轻量化嫁接到LLM代理训练流程中，实证扎实但未触及状态表征、长期一致性或真实环境不确定性等核心挑战，暂未达到世界模型基石论文的理论深度与系统性。

papers.title: IcFuzz: Fuzzing Isaac Sim with Semantic Stage Guidance and Multi-level Mutation
papers.abstract: Robotics simulators serve as a foundational infrastructure for embodied AI, facilitating safe and scalable robotic system development. NVIDIA Isaac Sim has emerged as one of the most popular simulators, distinguished by its GPU-accelerated physics engine and photorealistic rendering, which enable high-fidelity modeling of complex environments. However, its inherent complexity inevitably introduces software bugs that can compromise simulation reliability. Existing fuzzing approaches struggle to test Isaac Sim effectively due to challenges of context-aware object semantics, hierarchical simulation control, and a vast simulation state space. In this paper, we propose IcFuzz, the first fuzzing approach for Isaac Sim. IcFuzz first performs an LLM-based semantic stage segmentation, decomposing simulation programs into structured stages that capture context-aware object semantics. Guided by this information, IcFuzz designs multi-level mutation operators to systematically exercise the simulator across hierarchical granularities. To efficiently navigate the vast simulation state space, IcFuzz employs a multi-armed bandit algorithm to adaptively schedule mutation operators. Experimental results show that IcFuzz outperforms the baselines in terms of both code coverage and bug detection. Specifically, IcFuzz achieves approximately 190\%--205\% of the code coverage of the baselines and detects an average of 3.7 unique crashes over three rounds of 12-hour tests, while no crashes are detected by the baselines. Moreover, IcFuzz has uncovered 11 bugs over approximately four months, 9 of which have been confirmed or fixed by the developers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出IcFuzz，一种专为NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真器设计的模糊测试工具，通过大语言模型解析仿真程序的语义阶段结构，并结合多级变异算子和多臂赌博机调度策略，系统性地发现仿真器中的软件缺陷。
analysis.claim: IcFuzz是首个针对Isaac Sim的语义引导式模糊测试框架，能显著提升代码覆盖率和真实崩溃bug检出率。
analysis.input: Isaac Sim的Python仿真脚本（含场景构建、物体放置、物理交互逻辑等）
analysis.output: 触发崩溃/异常的变异后仿真脚本及对应错误日志
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖Isaac Sim仿真脚本输入
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM驱动的语义解析与多级变异+bandit调度结合用于机器人仿真器 fuzzing，实证效果扎实（11个真实bug被厂商确认/修复），但问题域属仿真器质量保障（支撑性工作），非具身智能核心范式突破；相比SPEAR/SimFoundry等定义新仿真范式或大规模跨任务基准的工作，其领域影响力更窄、不可替代性较低。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真工程突破，但属仿真基础设施可靠性保障的垂直方向，非具身智能主干进展

papers.title: PanGBank: a large-scale resource of precomputed microbial pangenomes built with PPanGGOLiN
papers.abstract: PanGBank (https://pangbank.genoscope.cns.fr) is a comprehensive open-access database providing precomputed prokaryotic pangenomes at a broad taxonomic scale. Built upon PPanGGOLiN partitioned pangenome graphs, PanGBank addresses the growing need for large-scale comparative genomics through a standardized, regularly updated, and fully accessible resource. The initial release comprises two complementary collections covering more than 4,600 prokaryotic species from the Genome Taxonomy Database (GTDB), encompassing over 393,000 genomes: GTDB_all, maximizing taxonomic and environmental diversity through the inclusion of MAGs and SAGs, and GTDB_refseq, focusing on high-quality, annotation-rich genomes. Each species-level pangenome integrates graph-based statistical partitions into persistent, shell, and cloud gene families, together with regions of genomic plasticity (panRGP) and co-localized functional modules (panModule). PanGBank offers multiple access modes, including a REST API, a command-line interface (PanGBank-cli), and an interactive web interface. By combining large-scale pangenome resources with advanced graph-based analyses, PanGBank provides a scalable framework for exploring microbial diversity, genome evolution, functional variation, and the dissemination of adaptive traits across prokaryotic populations, as illustrated by a use case on Acinetobacter baumannii pangenome investigating the distribution and evolution of antimicrobial resistance determinants.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个覆盖4600多个原核物种、39万+基因组的大规模开源泛基因组图谱数据库PanGBank，基于PPanGGOLiN算法生成标准化的图结构泛基因组（含持久/壳/云基因家族、基因组可塑区panRGP和功能模块panModule），提供Web/API/CLI三种访问方式，并以鲍曼不动杆菌耐药基因演化为例验证其分析能力。
analysis.claim: PanGBank是首个在GTDB尺度上系统性构建、持续更新、全开放访问的图结构泛基因组资源库，支持跨物种微生物多样性与适应性性状演化的规模化解析。
analysis.input: 已组装的原核基因组序列（含MAGs/SAGs/RefSeq）
analysis.output: 物种级图结构泛基因组（含基因家族分区、panRGP、panModule等注释）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽非算法原创（依赖PPanGGOLiN），但首次实现GTDB全尺度泛基因组图谱的工业化级构建与标准化发布，数据规模（4600+物种/39万+基因组）和结构深度（panRGP/panModule）远超此前任何公共资源（如Pangenome Graph Library或PGG),且实证用于耐药演化分析，具备真实科研杠杆效应；但未提出新模型或颠覆性分析范式，属重磅基础设施而非理论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有泛基因组算法规模化落地为可复用、可扩展、可验证的国家级生物信息基础设施，显著降低微生物比较基因组学门槛，但核心方法非原创。

papers.title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies rely on large multimodal backbones to jointly perform perception, language conditioning, and action generation at every control step. Much of this capacity supports open-domain semantics, whereas continuous robot manipulation primarily requires compact representations of observations, actions, and the transitions induced by actions. Pixel-level world models provide another route, but predicting visual details irrelevant to control can be unnecessarily expensive. We propose SLIM (Self-supervised Latent Interaction Model), a compact 0.5B-parameter latent interaction policy. SLIM learns action-grounded predictive latents that capture both action-conditioned future transitions and the actions that explain observed changes. SLIM learns these representations through self-supervised masked trajectory prediction, combining action reconstruction with future-latent prediction. A compact Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone models interactions between observation latents and action tokens. The resulting policy is trained with flow matching for language-conditioned action generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-world evaluation, SLIM matches or exceeds representative large-scale VLA and world-action-model baselines with fewer parameters, no additional embodied pretraining, lower inference latency, and substantially lower GPU memory usage.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个0.5B参数的轻量级机器人操作策略SLIM，用自监督掩码轨迹预测学习动作锚定的隐状态表示，不依赖额外具身预训练，在仿真和真实机器人上性能媲美或超过更大规模VLA模型，且推理更快、显存占用更低。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属，如非公开合作则默认unknown）
analysis.claim: 紧凑的、动作锚定的自监督隐状态建模（而非像素重建或大语言对齐）足以支撑高性能机器人操作，无需额外具身预训练即可达到甚至超越更大规模VLA模型。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列+语言指令+历史动作
analysis.output: 未来动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；摘要仅提‘real-world evaluation’但未描述数据来源、规模、采集方式，也未提是否微调或零样本迁移，故判为 limited（弱依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 在保持显著更低计算开销前提下，实证验证了轻量级动作-隐状态联合建模的有效性，真机+多任务+跨场景对比主流VLA基线，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节（如MoT结构贡献、flow matching必要性），未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：技术路线清晰、实证充分，但缺乏开源与机制分析，是高效架构设计的优秀实践，而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models
papers.abstract: Predicting the answer to interventional ``what if'' questions --- the outcome of an action never taken --- requires a \emph{mechanistic}, causal model, not a curve fit; and learning such a model requires \emph{experiments}, because passive data leaves its mechanisms unidentified. Experiments are expensive, so the central problem is \emph{data efficiency}. We present the Model Discovery Agent (MDA), which couples a large language model (LLM), used as a \emph{proposer} of candidate structures, with standard Bayesian machinery --- sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) for parameter and structure posteriors, simulation-based inference (SBI) for intractable likelihoods, and value-of-information (VoI) for experiment design --- to discover latent mechanistic world models from few interventions. MDA operates in the M-open setting: when the truth lies outside the current hypothesis class, a predictive check flags the inadequacy and the proposer expands the hypothesis space with a new model whose parameters are then identified by designed experiments. We show that \emph{discovery and design reinforce}: the design step identifies the mechanism the discovery step proposes, and the identified mechanism improves predictions, enabling further discoveries from the remaining unexplained residuals. On three different benchmarks --- covering physics (\DPbench, \citep{wiemann2026discoverphysics}), chemistry (\CHEMbench, \citep{kabra2026autoscilab}) and biology (\HHbench, a new partially observed single-neuron electrophysiology benchmark we create) --- we show that MDA sets a new SOTA in terms of data-efficient model learning and reliable interventional prediction ability.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Model Discovery Agent（MDA）的系统，用大语言模型自动提出可能的因果机制结构，再用贝叶斯方法（SMC+SBI+VoI）设计最少干预实验来验证和精炼这些结构，从而在极少量实验下发现物理、化学、生物系统背后的可解释机理模型。
analysis.claim: LLM可作为可解释机制模型的结构提议器，与贝叶斯实验设计闭环耦合，能在极少数干预下发现真实世界的因果机制模型。
analysis.input: 少量干预实验数据 + 领域知识文本提示（如物理定律描述）
analysis.output: 可解释的、参数化的、具备反事实预测能力的机制模型（如微分方程结构及其参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖合成或实验室级真实干预数据（如电生理记录、化学反应观测）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM结构生成与贝叶斯实验设计（VoI+SBI+SMC）深度闭环耦合，在三个跨学科基准（含新构建的神经电生理HHbench）上实证了极低干预下的机制发现能力；但未开源核心代码/模型，且所有实验仍基于仿真或小规模实验室数据，尚未在高维复杂生物系统（如全细胞通路、多细胞组织）中验证其可扩展性，故强于常规AI for Science工作，但未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现LLM驱动的可解释机制模型自发现与贝叶斯实验设计闭环，在物理/化学/简化神经场景中显著提升数据效率，但尚未跨越到真实高维生物系统验证。

papers.title: A structure-guided classification framework reveals the diversity and catalytic architecture of BECR ribonuclease
papers.abstract: Microorganisms across all domains of life engage in molecular conflict, deploying toxins to inhibit competitors or respond to biological threats. Among these, ribonuclease toxins are particularly widespread and diverse. A substantial fraction is associated with the BECR fold, a compact α/β architecture that supports RNase activity despite extensive divergence. Although several canonical members are well characterized, many BECR-fold proteins remain difficult to identify because of low sequence similarity, variation in catalytic residues, and structural elaborations that obscure evolutionary relationships. The growing availability of high-confidence protein structure predictions provides an opportunity to reassess this deeply divergent protein landscape. Here, we integrate iterative profile-HMM searches, profile-similarity networks, structural analyses, active-site mapping, and genomic context to examine BECR proteins across the tree of life. Our analysis resolves an expanded BECR-fold landscape comprising canonical BECR and BECR-like superfamilies, refines the organization of canonical BECR proteins and identifies previously unrecognized families. We further validate BECR-Tox2 as a toxin neutralized by a cognate immunity protein and show that its homologs occur in both Menshen-like anti-phage systems and polymorphic toxin loci.
