Together, these findings expand and clarify the BECR-fold landscape and provide a framework for identifying and interpreting highly divergent proteins of this fold.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用结构引导的分类框架，系统梳理了高度多样且序列保守性极低的BECR折叠核糖核酸酶家族，重新划定了其超家族边界、发现了新亚家族，并通过实验验证了一个新毒素BECR-Tox2及其免疫配对蛋白，还揭示了它在抗噬菌体系统和多态性毒素位点中的分布。
analysis.claim: BECR折叠蛋白的多样性远超此前认知，仅靠序列无法可靠识别，必须依赖结构引导的整合分析框架才能系统解析其进化关系、催化架构与生物学功能。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2预测的高置信度蛋白质三维结构 + 多序列比对 + 基因组上下文信息
analysis.output: BECR折叠蛋白的分层分类体系（含新定义的BECR-like超家族）、催化残基定位图谱、功能关联推断（如毒素-免疫对、系统归属）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×生物（结构/功能注释）领域扎实的范式升级：首次将结构预测（AF2）作为核心驱动力，系统重构一个长期混乱的经典折叠家族，完成从‘无法归类’到‘可解释分类+功能验证+系统定位’的闭环；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但显著超越纯计算注释类工作，证据链完整（结构聚类→活性位点映射→基因组语境→实验验证毒素中和），且结果直接支撑抗噬菌体机制研究和新型毒素挖掘。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是刷榜或概念包装，而是用新工具（AF2结构）解决了一个经典、顽固、影响广泛的生物学分类难题，并给出可验证的功能解释。

papers.title: 4DStreamCtrl: Interactive Video Generation with Online 4D Control
papers.abstract: Generative video models now synthesize footage nearly indistinguishable from reality. Their promise as interactive tools hinges on fine-grained control of how objects and the camera move over time, yet each existing approach captures only part of this: camera-parameter methods steer the viewpoint but cannot move objects, 2D-trajectory methods act in the image plane and ignore depth and occlusion, and recent 3D methods add geometry but run only offline at a fixed length. In particular, none combines 3D-consistent control of both camera and objects with real-time, streaming generation. Here we show that camera motion, object trajectories, and depth can be unified into a single 3D point-track representation, from which one model performs joint camera and object control, depth editing, and motion transfer in a single forward pass. To learn this interface at scale, we mine in-the-wild video for 3D motion supervision, yielding OpenVidHD-Motion3D, and encode it with a lightweight Geometric Motion Head that plugs into a pretrained video diffusion model. Because this encoder is temporally separable, we distill the model into a causal streaming student that generates arbitrarily long video in four denoising steps at memory independent of length. This unified design surpasses prior camera-only, 2D, and offline-3D methods in motion-control precision while covering modalities they address only in isolation. 4DStreamCtrl runs at 20 FPS on a single high-end GPU for 480p video and stays temporally coherent over hundreds of frames, enabling, to our knowledge, interactive 4D-controllable streaming generation for the first time. More broadly, grounding generation in explicit 3D geometry with efficient causal inference points toward interactive world models with closed-loop spatiotemporal control, from controllable simulators to real-time visual imagination for embodied agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出4DStreamCtrl，用一个轻量几何运动头将相机运动、物体轨迹和深度统一为3D点轨迹表示，嵌入预训练视频扩散模型，实现在线流式生成（单次前向、4步去噪）、实时20FPS、480p、数百帧连贯的4D（3D空间+时间）可控视频生成。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Shiqian Li等常见于国内高校但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: 将相机与物体的3D运动、深度和时间演化统一为可学习的在线4D点轨迹表示，使视频生成首次支持实时、流式、长程连贯、多模态（相机+物体+深度+运动迁移）的4D交互控制。
analysis.input: 文本提示 + 用户指定的3D点轨迹（含相机/物体运动与深度变化）
analysis.output: 逐帧生成的480p RGB视频帧序列（流式输出）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正因果、流式、4D一致（相机+物体+深度）的视频生成，在控制粒度、实时性（20FPS）、长度无关内存和跨模态整合上显著超越现有相机参数法/2D轨迹法/离线3D法；但未开源代码与模型，未在标准benchmark上与SOTA全面对比，也未验证跨场景/跨对象泛化能力，且未接入任何具身系统或真实世界闭环，尚属高质量方法创新而非世界模型级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在视频生成控制维度上完成关键架构统一与实时化落地，但缺乏开源、泛化验证与闭环应用，尚未达到世界模型基石论文的分量

papers.title: Compliance for Free: Learning Identifiable Impedance via Bilateral Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models tell a robot where to move, but not how hard to push. Contact-rich tasks depend on that second quantity, compliance, yet no widely used demonstration interface records it. The obstacle is identifiability as realized pose and measured force cannot separate the operator's intended equilibrium from their stiffness, so VR controllers, SpaceMouse and handheld grippers cannot supply compliance supervision even in principle. Prior compliance-output policies work around this with hand-specified task structure, privileged simulation contact state, or dedicated force and tactile hardware. Four-channel bilateral teleoperation removes the ambiguity directly by using the leader arm as a separate measurement of the intended equilibrium, making per-axis stiffness identifiable by regression using only the joint-torque sensing already on the manipulator. This yields per-timestep, direction-dependent compliance labels at zero annotation cost, which we use to fine-tune a VLA to emit stiffness alongside pose. On a Franka Research 3 wiping task, ours is the only policy of five whose contact force changes when the instruction asks for a firm wipe rather than a normal one (6.4N (normal) to 9.1N (firm) RMS, Cohen's d = 0.89, p = 0.023

analysis.tldr: 论文提出用四通道双边遥操作（leader-follower双臂）自然解耦操作者意图的平衡位置和刚度，无需额外标注就能为每个时间步、每个轴向生成合规性（阻抗）标签，进而微调视觉-语言-动作模型，使其能根据指令（如‘用力擦’vs‘正常擦’）输出对应接触力大小。
analysis.org: CSIC-UPC（西班牙高等科学研究理事会-加泰罗尼亚理工大学）
analysis.claim: 四通道双边遥操作可从纯关节扭矩信号中无监督地、逐轴识别出操作者意图的刚度参数，从而为VLA模型提供零成本、方向敏感的合规性监督信号。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+leader臂关节位置/速度+follower臂关节扭矩
analysis.output: follower臂各关节的目标轨迹+各轴向刚度参数（即阻抗矩阵对角元）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（Franka Research 3）+ leader arm（KUKA LWR4+）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实双边遥操作采集的数据，需leader-follower同步硬件与力矩传感，无法脱离真实机器人系统运行
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实机器人上实现无标注、逐轴、方向敏感的刚度识别，并验证其能驱动VLA模型产生语义可控的接触力变化（统计显著），填补了接触丰富任务中合规性监督缺失的关键空白；但仅在一个擦拭任务、单一平台、未跨机体/用户/场景泛化，且未开源代码或数据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了接触任务中合规性无法从常规遥操作获取的根本性标识难题，并在真实机器人上给出可复现、有统计效力的因果验证，非概念包装。

papers.title: PIVOT: Physically Informed Vision-Language Off-Road Traversability for Field Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Terrain assessment is a critical capability for off-road mobile robots, enabling safe and reliable navigation through unstructured and geometrically complex environments. Conventional geometry-based terrain assessment is fast to compute but often overly conservative in unstructured environments. We present PIVOT: a Physically Informed Vision-Language Off-Road Traversability navigation system that augments conventional geometry-based planning with vision-language-model (VLM)-based semantic reasoning for field robots. To physically ground this assessment, we quantify how strongly the VLM's predicted traversal energy cost, robot vibration, and wheel slip correlate with real-world measurements and introduce a unified traversability score that weights each modality by its prediction-measurement correlation. For efficiency, we design a two-level navigation architecture that retains geometry-based planning as the nominal mode and invokes semantic replanning only when that mode fails to find a path. Across five repeated closed-loop trials on a mixed-terrain route totalling around $6.4$ km, the proposed system increases overall autonomy from $59.6\%$ to $97.0\%$, reduces human interventions from $11$ to $3$, and increases the mean distance between interventions (MDBI) from $69.2$ m to $412.9$ m compared with geometry-only navigation. These results demonstrate that physically grounded VLM-based terrain assessment can substantially extend autonomous navigation beyond the limitations of geometry alone, while preserving efficient geometric planning as the nominal mode.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PIVOT系统，把视觉语言模型（VLM）对越野地形可通行性的语义判断，用真实物理测量（振动、打滑、能耗）校准后，嵌入到传统几何导航流程中——只在几何规划失败时才触发VLM重规划，从而大幅提升野外机器人自主行驶里程和稳定性。
analysis.claim: 物理可验证的视觉语言模型语义地形评估，能显著扩展几何导航的适用边界，且无需牺牲计算效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言地形描述（如'loose gravel'）+机器人本体状态（IMU、轮速等）
analysis.output: 统一可通行性分数（加权融合VLM预测的能耗/振动/打滑）+是否触发语义重规划的二值决策
analysis.robot_dependency: Clearpath Husky机器人平台（含IMU、wheel encoders、RGB相机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实野外机器人采集的6.4km闭环测试数据（含振动、滑移、能耗同步测量）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+多地形长距闭环验证+物理量级相关性量化校准+明确的fallback机制设计，显著优于纯仿真或单点benchmark工作；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化，也未构建通用VLA基础模型，因此未达RT-2/π0级范式突破，属扎实重磅工程级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM语义能力与物理可解释性、实时导航架构深度耦合，并在真实复杂野外环境中验证了可靠性提升，但非基础模型或通用框架创新。

papers.title: Beyond Reconstruction Error: Analytical and Data-Driven Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Discrete action tokenization is central to autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, yet action representations are often evaluated primarily through reconstruction fidelity. We ask which representation properties actually matter for closed-loop control by comparing fixed analytical, data-driven linear, and nonlinear neural representations under a unified tokenization interface. Across rate-distortion analysis, sequence-modeling diagnostics, and 3,500 LIBERO rollouts, representation rankings change with the evaluation criterion. PCA achieves lower nominal reconstruction error than Temporal-DCT, but produces less predictable token sequences and 3.0 percentage points lower mean seen-task success across three policy-training seeds, with the policy ordering reversing in one seed. In a matched seed-42 ablation, an autoencoder further reduces reconstruction error yet does not yield the strongest policy and exhibits greater sensitivity to discrete token perturbations. These findings show that reconstruction fidelity alone cannot reliably select action representations for autoregressive control, motivating joint evaluation of geometric fidelity, sequence predictability, decoder stability, and closed-loop performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了在自回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中，不同动作离散化方法（如PCA、DCT、自编码器）的实际控制效果，发现重建误差越小不代表策略性能越好，必须联合评估几何保真度、序列可预测性、解码器鲁棒性和闭环任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 重建误差最小的动作tokenization方案，在闭环控制任务中未必产生最优策略性能；动作表征的优劣需通过多维联合评估（而非单一重建指标）判定。
analysis.input: 连续动作序列（来自LIBERO仿真环境）
analysis.output: 离散动作token序列（用于训练自回归VLA策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖LIBERO仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一接口下对多种动作tokenization方法进行跨维度实证比较（重建误差/序列建模诊断/3500次LIBERO rollout），揭示重建保真度与闭环性能的非单调关系，属扎实的范式反思型工作；但未提出新tokenization方法，未扩展到真实机器人或多机体，也未集成进更大VLA基座模型，故未达基石级分量（如RT-2/π0等94+档）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨的消融实验戳破了VLA领域对重建误差的盲目迷信，但仍是方法论层面的诊断性工作，非架构或规模突破。

papers.title: Imperfection for Precision: Upcycling Imperfect Data for High-Precision Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Training vision-language-action (VLA) models for high-precision manipulation typically requires task-specific, high-quality data (e.g., teleoperation), which is slow and expensive to collect. To reduce this burden without compromising manipulation precision, we propose $\varepsilon$4P (Imperfection for Precision), a simple yet effective method that "upcycles" two otherwise discarded data sources: (1) low-precision data from the target task and (2) high-precision data from mismatched tasks. Rather than naively mixing these imperfect data sources throughout co-training, $\varepsilon$4P controls where each source contributes along the flow-matching trajectory. Specifically, low-precision, target-task data is used at high noise to preserve high-level task context and high-precision, task-mismatched data is used at low noise to transfer low-level action precision. Through real-robot experiments on both sub-millimeter, high-precision tasks and coarse-grained tasks, we demonstrate that the proposed method (1) effectively leverages additional imperfect data to improve policy performance by up to 31.7 percentage points, and (2) can replace an equal amount of task-specific, high-quality data with an average performance drop of only 4.2 percentage points. Overall, $\varepsilon$4P points toward a scalable paradigm for high-precision manipulation, in which heterogeneous, imperfect data can be systematically repurposed to reduce reliance on costly task-specific, high-quality data. More details are available at https://varepsilon4p.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ε4P方法，通过在扩散策略的噪声调度中分层复用两类‘废料数据’：用低精度但任务匹配的数据在高噪声阶段保留任务语义，用高精度但任务不匹配的数据在低噪声阶段注入动作细节，从而大幅减少对昂贵高精度遥操作数据的依赖。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无网址域名指向明确实体，github页varepsilon4p.github.io为项目页，非机构主页）
analysis.claim: 在扩散策略框架下，对不同质量与任务匹配度的数据进行噪声层级定向复用，可显著降低高精度机器人操作对任务专属高质量数据的依赖，且不牺牲精度。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（视觉+语言）
analysis.output: 高精度末端执行器动作序列（亚毫米级轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（实验验证含sub-millimeter任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人高精度数据用于低噪声阶段监督，但大幅减少用量；仍需真实机器人部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机验证亚毫米级操作、跨任务泛化、31.7pp提升和仅4.2pp替换代价，方法设计有原理支撑（噪声层级解耦），但未开源代码/模型，未构建新benchmark或dataset，创新属重要工程范式升级而非底层模型或硬件突破，略逊于Facet-0/T-Rex等94+分基石（后者定义新感知模态/接触建模范式或实现全栈部署闭环），但强于多数纯仿真或单任务刷榜工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散策略的噪声调度特性与数据质量维度显式对齐，是面向真实部署的高价值数据效率方案，但缺乏开源与基础组件贡献，尚未达到开新范式级别

papers.title: Boltz2-Notebook: An Interactive Google Colab Platform for Diffusion-Based Biomolecular Structure and Binding Affinity Prediction using the Boltz2 model.
papers.abstract: Recent advances in deep learning-based structure prediction, including AlphaFold3 and the open-source Boltz model family, have extended biomolecular modeling to joint prediction of protein-ligand, protein-nucleic acid, and multi-chain complexes with binding-affinity estimation. Boltz-2 is among the most feature-complete of these open models, but its practical use requires a local CUDA-capable GPU, command-line execution, and manually authored YAML configuration files, limiting accessibility for researchers without dedicated computational infrastructure. We developed Boltz2-Notebook, a Colab-native interface comprising four integrated stages - automated environment setup, interactive parameter-to-YAML generation, execution management, and automated confidence and affinity visualization - together with a manifest-driven batch mode for multi-target screening. All modelling capabilities are inherited unmodified from Boltz-2; Boltz2-Notebook's contributions are limited to accessibility, input construction, and workflow automation. Independent of the software, we curated a benchmark of 317 protein-ligand pairs (122 proteins, 277 ligands) from BindingDB and predicted binding affinity in triplicate using the Boltz-2 command-line engine on high-performance computing infrastructure. Predicted and experimental pIC50 values showed moderate correlation (Pearson r = 0.609 [95% CI 0.540-0.675]; Spearman ρ = 0.625; R 2 = 0.371; MAE = 0.968 pIC50 units), with high triplicate reproducibility (pairwise r = 0.97) but a systematic compression of the predicted affinity range and no measurable relationship between Boltz-2's self-reported confidence metrics and prediction accuracy. Boltz2-Notebook is freely available as open-source software and provides external, reproducible evidence - including a specific confidence-calibration limitation - relevant to interpreting Boltz-2 affinity predictions responsibly.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型或算法，而是把已有的开源Boltz-2蛋白-配体结构与亲和力预测模型封装成一个交互式Google Colab笔记本，降低了使用门槛，并用317个真实蛋白-配体对做了独立验证，发现其亲和力预测有中等相关性但存在系统性压缩偏差、且自评置信度与实际精度无关。
analysis.claim: Boltz2-Notebook显著提升了Boltz-2模型的可用性，并通过独立基准测试揭示了其结合亲和力预测中未被报告的关键局限性：预测范围压缩、置信度不可靠。
analysis.input: 蛋白质PDB/FASTA + 配体SMILES（或SDF）
analysis.output: 三维复合物结构预测 + pIC50亲和力数值预测 + 置信度分数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工具工程+实证审计工作：提供了首个独立、可复现的大规模Boltz-2亲和力验证（n=317），量化了其系统性偏差和置信度失效，但未改进模型本身；远低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold等基石（95+），也弱于近期生成式药物设计基础模型（96），更接近高质量benchmark或方法诊断报告（典型分值45–55）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——本质是Boltz-2的易用性封装与独立诊断报告，价值在于透明化暴露模型缺陷，而非技术推进。

papers.title: Watch, Recall, Act: Always-On Robots in Concurrent Embodied Streams
papers.abstract: An always-on robot faces an endless stream that never resets: instructions arrive and lapse, the scene changes, and its own past actions reshape what it must reason about. Today's action models are built for the opposite: a fixed instruction, no mid-task intervention, single-step reasoning. In an open-ended world a robot must watch a live stream for far-future cues, recall its own far-past actions, and act on them under dual-arm concurrency. We present ARMS (Always-on Robot in Multi-modal Streams), a deliberately simple streaming policy: a single pretrained $π$0.5 backbone augmented by three lightweight modules that turn live perception, embodied states, and the robot's own past actions into context the backbone reads before it acts. The modules update this context asynchronously, so watching and recalling never block acting and the two arms act at once. Rather than inventing new mechanisms, ARMS integrates these learned context providers with an agent-causal self-history that logs which arm did what, and when. To supervise them without extra annotation, we build ARMS Dataset, whose staged construction script itself labels every module from real dual-arm teleoperation. Trained on it, ARMS reaches 45% on the combined task against 28% for the strongest of our four main baselines, and ablations confirm the memory module, the embodied-state head, and asynchronous concurrency are each necessary.

analysis.tldr: 提出ARMS框架，让双臂机器人在持续运行的多模态流（视觉、指令、自身动作历史）中实时观看、回忆过去动作、并发执行操作，用轻量模块增强预训练π0.5骨干网络，不引入新模型结构，而是通过异步更新的上下文机制实现‘永远在线’行为。
analysis.claim: 一个永远在线的机器人必须能异步地观看未来线索、回忆远期自身动作，并在双臂并发下实时行动；ARMS通过三个轻量模块+预训练骨干+自因果动作日志，在无需新架构的前提下实现了该能力。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+语言指令+双臂关节状态+自身历史动作时间戳序列
analysis.output: 双臂并发的动作块（6D位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机械臂（未指明具体型号，但数据来自真实双臂遥操作）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实双臂遥操作数据，所有模块监督信号均来自该数据的自动标注脚本
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了‘永远在线’具身智能范式：首次将异步上下文更新、自因果动作日志、双臂并发策略统一于轻量增强预训练骨干框架，并在真实双臂平台上验证多任务性能（45% vs 28%），但未跨机体部署、未开源代码/模型、未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型直接对比，且仍属单场景小规模真机实验。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在π0.5基础上扎实构建了面向持续流的双臂实时决策闭环，实证充分但生态开放度不足，尚未达到基石级范式突破

papers.title: Latent evolving World Action Model
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model action generation and environment dynamics and are mostly built on pretrained Video Diffusion Models (VDMs). In VDM-based WAMs, observations are first encoded by a VAE, and the resulting compressed latents are then processed by large video diffusion backbones to extract effective features for action generation. However, this paradigm ties WAM performance and training cost to large-scale video generation pretraining, limiting WAM efficiency and scalability. In this paper, we theoretically and empirically investigate how visual representations affect action generation in WAMs. Our results show that predictive embeddings from Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) encoders better support action generation than compressed VAE latents, with I-JEPA performing best in our encoder comparison. Based on these findings, we propose LeWAM, which conditions action generation on JEPA embeddings and models environment evolution by predicting future embeddings in the same space, without relying on a video diffusion backbone. We further find that imitation learning matches demonstrated actions but does not distinguish better actions from worse ones, even though small action deviations can greatly affect task success. To address this limitation without additional environment interaction or the human oversight required for resets and safety, we introduce Demonstration-Guided DPO (DemoDPO), an offline preference refinement stage that derives preference supervision directly from demonstrations.With only 0.4B trainable parameters, LeWAM achieves an average success rate of 92.28\% on RoboTwin 2.0, comparable to that of state-of-the-art VLAs and WAMs, and maintains practical effectiveness on real-world manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出LeWAM模型，用JEPA编码器替代视频扩散模型提取视觉表征，直接在隐空间预测环境演化并生成动作，配合仅基于演示数据的离线偏好优化（DemoDPO），在参数量仅0.4B的情况下，在RoboTwin 2.0仿真基准上达到92.28%成功率，且迁移到真实机械臂任务仍有效。
analysis.claim: JEPA类预测性隐空间表征比VAE压缩+视频扩散的范式更高效、更适配世界动作建模，且可通过纯演示数据的离线偏好学习（DemoDPO）缓解模仿学习无法区分优劣动作的根本缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列（含动作历史）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器（基于Isaac Gym）及配套真实UR5e+Robotiq 2F-85机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0官方演示数据集；真实机器人实验使用作者自采演示，未公开
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式中首次系统验证JEPA表征优于VAE+VDM，并提出DemoDPO这一轻量级离线偏好机制，在仿真基准上逼近SOTA（如WEAVER/Genie），且有真实机器人验证；但未开源代码/模型，未在多机体/跨用户等强泛化维度验证，也未挑战长期记忆、状态一致性等世界模型核心瓶颈（如Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core所指问题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将JEPA表征、隐空间演化建模、演示驱动偏好学习三者有效耦合，在效率与性能间取得新平衡，但未突破世界模型的基础理论瓶颈，也缺乏全栈可复现性支撑。

papers.title: PoLoCo: A reproducible pooled low-coverage workflow for draft genome assembly and allele frequency analysis from ethanol-preserved small non-model invertebrates
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Many ecologically important small invertebrates are preserved in ethanol, which compromises DNA integrity and severely limits their potential to be utilized in further genomic research. The lack of soil arthropod representation ultimately results in limited availability of reference genomes and population genomic inference from pooled sequencing (Pool-seq). Results We introduce PoLoCo (Pooled Low-Coverage), a reproducible workflow integrating pooled specimen draft genome assembly from ethanol-preserved specimens with population-level allele-frequency analysis. We assembled a 411 Mb draft genome of Entomobrya nivalis from pooled short reads, achieving 97.7% BUSCO completeness despite notable fragmentation. Comparison with the published reference genome showed partial genomic correspondence while also revealing reference-dependent differences in the retained SNP datasets. The application of PoLoCo to 82 retained pooled populations produced a final distance-thinned allele-frequency dataset suitable for population-scale genomic inference. Case-study execution documented the computational requirements of the major workflow components on standard HPC infrastructure, with the workflow, documentation, and software environments openly available in Zenodo. Conclusions PoLoCo demonstrates that draft genome assemblies and reproducible Pool-seq allele-frequency analyses can be performed with long-preserved sample material from the field. PoLoCo integrates reference construction, sync-based allele-frequency analysis, and benchmarking into a free and open workflow. It establishes a reproducibility benchmark for biodiversity genomics and yields a transferable workflow for ecological and evolutionary initiatives where high-quality DNA or long-read sequencing is not feasible.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个开源可复现的工作流PoLoCo，用乙醇保存多年的小型无脊椎动物混合样本的低覆盖短读长数据，组装出BUSCO完整性97.7%的草图基因组，并同步产出可用于群体遗传推断的等位频率数据集。
analysis.claim: 乙醇长期保存的小型非模式无脊椎动物混合样本，仅用低覆盖Illumina短读长即可支撑高质量草图基因组组装与群体尺度等位频率分析。
analysis.input: 乙醇保存的混合小型无脊椎动物DNA提取物的Illumina短读长（低覆盖）
analysis.output: 草图基因组（FASTA）+ 群体水平SNP等位频率矩阵（sync格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了生态基因组学中‘乙醇保存样本DNA降解导致无法用于Pool-seq’这一长期实操瓶颈，提供了首个端到端、全开源、经HPC实测验证的标准化流程；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold级），但在非模式生物资源受限场景下显著拓展了群体基因组学的应用边界，证据扎实（真实样本+多群体+BUSCO量化+参考比对+计算文档公开）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是理论突破，但为全球生态与进化生物学实验室提供了可立即部署、免长读/免高质DNA的可靠工具链。

papers.title: VisTacAlign: Co-Training Dexterous Policies on Tactile Human and Robot Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are a cheap source of data for dexterous manipulation, but co-training a robot policy on them requires closing the human--robot gap in every modality the policy consumes. We present VisTacAlign, a framework for co-training 3D-visual-tactile dexterous policies on human and robot demonstrations. Glove-tracked human hand motion is retargeted to a 17-DoF tactile robot hand with a one-time fingertip correction. The human hand is then erased from both stereo views and replaced by a posed robot-hand mesh painted with pixels from robot recordings, and a real-time stereo foundation model is re-run on the composite, so the human point clouds carry the same stereo errors and visibility as the robot ones. Finally, a capacitive tactile glove is aligned to the robot's fingertip sensors in its signal space, giving one interpretable per-finger force representation. A diffusion transformer consumes point-cloud, proprioceptive, and per-finger tactile tokens. On three real-world tasks requiring precise force -- Lego assembly, plucking strawberries of varying size, and activating and lifting a power drill -- adding aligned human demonstrations to existing robot data improves over robot-only policies, and ablations show that both tactile input and visual alignment are necessary. Project page: https://vis-tac-align.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出VisTacAlign框架，把人类戴手套演示的手部运动和触觉信号对齐到机器人手的视觉、本体感知和触觉模态上，用合成的‘人-机混合’多模态数据联合训练扩散Transformer策略，在乐高拼装、草莓采摘、电钻启动三个真实任务上验证了加入对齐后的人类数据能提升机器人策略性能。
analysis.claim: 通过跨模态对齐（视觉重渲染+触觉信号空间映射）可使人类戴手套演示有效迁移至高自由度触觉机器人手的策略训练，且视觉对齐与触觉对齐二者缺一不可。
analysis.input: 对齐后的3D点云（含视觉重渲染误差）、本体感知信号、每指独立的电容式触觉力表征
analysis.output: 动作序列（dexterous policy输出的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 17-DoF tactile robot hand（具体型号未明，但含电容指尖传感器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的视觉（双目）、本体感知、触觉数据用于重渲染和信号对齐；人类数据仅需手套追踪+电容手套，不依赖机器人采集的人类演示
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上完成三任务验证，有消融证明视觉重渲染与触觉对齐均必要，且首次实现人类电容手套触觉信号到机器人指尖传感器的跨设备信号空间对齐；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖跨机体泛化（仅单手），未挑战更复杂手术或微操作等长期开放难题，略逊于Facet-0/T-Rex级里程碑，但强于EgoWild2Dex（后者无真实触觉闭环），达到‘重磅’档位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类演示迁移至触觉灵巧操作的关键模态对齐环节做全链路实证，非概念包装，但受限于开源缺失与机体单一，尚未达范式突破级别

papers.title: EpiZoo: a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics
papers.abstract: Large-scale single-cell epigenomic atlases characterize chromatin regulatory landscapes across diverse biological contexts, spanning cell types, tissues, individuals and species. Foundation models provide an opportunity to capture the full spectrum of cellular diversity in these atlases, yet current models remain largely confined to individual species by genomic coordinate dependence and overlook regulatory information encoded in DNA sequences. Here we introduce EpiZoo, a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics. EpiZoo converts million-dimensional single-cell epigenomic profiles from diverse species into compact cell sentences that integrate DNA-encoded regulatory information, sequence-independent epigenomic context and accessibility-based importance. Built around a mixture-of-experts transformer and containing 2.6 billion parameters in total, EpiZoo is pretrained on our manually curated multi-species Omni-scATAC corpus of approximately 20.9 million cells to learn regulatory programs across species. On external datasets excluded from pretraining, EpiZoo achieves state-of-the-art performance in fundamental single-cell analysis tasks, including feature extraction, cell type annotation and data imputation. Its sequence-aware architecture enables extension to evolutionarily diverse species, and supports comparative analysis of regulatory conservation and divergence during primate evolution. Benefiting from this modeling design, EpiZoo enables context-aware prioritization of somatic mutations in cancer and prediction of cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility from DNA sequences across genomic regions and species.

analysis.tldr: EpiZoo是一个26亿参数的DNA序列感知基础模型，用多物种单细胞ATAC数据（2090万细胞）预训练，把高维染色质可及性图谱压缩成‘细胞句子’，支持跨物种细胞类型注释、数据补全、癌症体细胞突变优先级排序和跨物种序列到可及性的预测。
analysis.claim: DNA序列信息与跨物种表观基因组上下文可被统一建模为紧凑、可迁移的‘细胞句子’，从而支撑无需物种对齐的泛化性单细胞分析与进化比较。
analysis.input: 单细胞ATAC-seq峰矩阵（百万维二值/计数向量）+对应基因组DNA序列（窗口化k-mer嵌入）
analysis.output: 低维细胞嵌入（‘cell sentence’），支持下游任务：细胞类型标签、缺失峰补全、突变功能评分、染色质可及性预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开和自建的批量测序数据（无实时仪器/机器人交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现DNA序列与跨物种单细胞表观图谱的端到端联合建模，实证覆盖灵长类多物种、癌症突变优先级等关键场景，性能SOTA且有消融验证；但未开源代码/模型权重，且未挑战更难的‘零样本物种泛化’（仍需微调），尚未达到CENO/AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在跨物种表观基因组基础模型方向取得扎实突破，证据充分、任务覆盖广、生物学解释性强，但受限于开源不足和泛化边界，尚属领域内重大推进而非新范式开创。

papers.title: MEG-Mamba: A Scalable State-Space Foundation Model for Magnetoencephalography
papers.abstract: Magnetoencephalography (MEG) is an imaging technique that offers a non-invasive, millisecond-resolution view of human brain activity. The increasing availability of MEG data presents an opportunity to take advantage of a recent advance in artificial intelligence, namely self-supervised foundation models. Existing foundation models for MEG (and electroencephalography) have been built on a transformer architecture. Here, we introduce MEG-Mamba: a generative foundation model for neural activity (source reconstructed, parcellated MEG) built on a Mamba architecture. MEG-Mamba is trained to predict the next token of a discretised MEG signal, conditioned on a brain region and recording session. MEG-Mamba surpasses the generative fidelity of a transformer-based alternative (MEG-GPT) while pre-training in less time (22 vs 400 GPU-hours) and modelling a longer context (4 vs 0.32 s). We evaluate MEG-Mamba by examining the spatio-spectral characteristics of the data it generates and by interpreting its learned embeddings. Furthermore, we demonstrate that lightweight stimulus conditioning (LoRA) can be used to generate realistic task-evoked responses that are not included in pre-training. Our results suggest that Mamba is a promising backbone for scaling neural foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用Mamba架构替代Transformer，构建了一个可扩展的MEG脑信号基础模型MEG-Mamba，能在更短训练时间、更长上下文下生成更保真（spatio-spectral一致）的源空间MEG信号，并支持轻量微调生成未见过的任务态响应。
analysis.claim: Mamba架构比Transformer更适合构建高保真、长上下文、高效训练的MEG源信号生成式基础模型。
analysis.input: 离散化的源空间MEG信号序列+脑区标签+记录会话标识
analysis.output: 下一个时间步的离散化MEG token（即生成式建模输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开/合作获取的源重建MEG数据集（如Cam-CAN、HCP-MEG等），但未说明是否使用真实采集新数据或仅复用已有预处理数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将Mamba成功迁移到MEG建模并验证其优于Transformer基线（生成保真度+效率+上下文长度），但仍是纯模拟信号生成任务，无下游闭环解码（如脑机通信/控制）、无临床验证、无实时部署、无跨被试泛化实证；相比分量标尺中90+的里程碑工作（如实时语音合成BCI、自然行走脊髓接口），它处于扎实方法迁移阶段，尚未触及神经接口的核心价值环（意图→行为）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在神经信号建模架构选型上做出有实证支持的改进，但未进入解码-交互-应用闭环，属于高质量方法学探索，非突破或工程整合。

papers.title: AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies may predict a transferable manipulation strategy yet fail to realize it reliably on the encountered object: objects compatible with the same grasp differ in geometry and compliance, and visual feedback degrades under closure occlusion. AgenticTactileVLA is presented as an execution-time supervisor that shifts part of object-specific adaptation from prediction to physical interaction. A fixed VLA provides the approach and hand targets; the supervisor decides whether to remain transparent, refine finger flexion, retain or release the corrected configuration, return control to the VLA for retry, or select a compliant hand-control regime. It uses finger-position and motor-effort feedback as proprioceptive contact evidence and requires neither tactile sensors nor VLA retraining. On a Unitree G1 with a BrainCo Revo2 hand, a randomized matched-block evaluation on five objects held out from VLA training yields 61.3% completion for the base VLA, 72.0% for unconditional close-to-stall control, and 84.0% for the supervisor under a shared budget; the gain is positive on every object and persists under moderate pose perturbations. Ablations show the gain is not explained by extended closure alone, and that selective triggering reduces correction episodes by 65.7% with no detected change in completion. A retention audit shows acceptance predicts retention in 88.9% of held-out cases, while compliant objects expose conservative false rejection. A thin-walled-cup study demonstrates contextual routing to compliant control, matching an always-compliant reference. These results suggest that contact-guided execution-time adaptation can improve the object-level generalization of a fixed VLA to held-out objects by adapting physical realization without object-specific retraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AgenticTactileVLA，一个不修改原始视觉语言动作（VLA）模型、仅在执行时用手指位置和电机力矩等本体感觉信号做实时决策的监督器，动态决定是否微调抓握、保持/释放姿态、切换柔顺控制或交还控制权，从而显著提升固定VLA对未见过物体的灵巧操作成功率，且无需触觉传感器或重训练。
analysis.claim: 仅靠本体感觉（关节位置+电机力矩）作为接触证据，在执行时动态干预固定VLA策略，即可显著提升其对未见物体的灵巧操作泛化能力，且无需触觉传感器、无需VLA重训练。
analysis.input: VLA输出的手部目标位姿 + 实时手指关节角度 + 电机电流/力矩反馈
analysis.output: 执行时干预决策（透明通过/微调屈曲/保持/释放/交还控制/切换柔顺模式）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人 + BrainCo Revo2灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时本体感觉数据，但不依赖预先采集的触觉或操作演示数据；所有干预逻辑基于在线信号，无离线训练数据需求
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实G1+Revo2平台上对5个held-out物体完成随机配对评估，相较基线提升22.7个百分点，且每物体均正向增益；消融验证非单纯延长闭合时间所致，触发选择机制降低65.7%冗余修正；保留决策准确率88.9%，并展示柔顺模式上下文路由能力；虽未达Facet-0/IronMind级范式突破（如端到端接触建模、大规模预训练基础模型），但为‘固定VLA+轻量执行时接触监督’这一工程可行路径提供了迄今最系统、最可信的真实硬件验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将本体感觉驱动的执行时监督机制落地到真实人形灵巧手系统，以极低侵入性显著提升固定VLA的跨物体泛化，是具身智能中‘预测-执行解耦’范式的高完成度实践，但未改变VLA底层表征或学习范式。

papers.title: A multi-scenario EEG dataset for auditory attention decoding in naturalistic multi-talker environments
papers.abstract: Understanding how the brain selectively follows relevant speech amid competing voices is a central challenge in auditory neuroscience and a key step toward neuro-steered hearing technologies. However, most open-source Electroencephalography (EEG) datasets for Auditory Attention Decoding (AAD) use idealized single-competing-talker paradigms that oversimplify the acoustic, spatial, and semantic structure of everyday communication. To capture this ecological complexity, we introduce the SoundBubble-EEG dataset: a high-density 128-channel EEG resource comprising more than 25 hours of recordings from 30 participants. The paradigm requires listeners to selectively attend to a dynamic target speaker group, a designated "sound bubble", amid competing multi-speaker distractor bubbles across three realistic scenarios: a restaurant, a home TV viewing, and a meeting discussion. By bridging the gap between constrained laboratory protocols and real-world auditory scenes, this dataset enables investigations of multi-talker speech comprehension, neural speech tracking, and cross-scenario generalization. It also provides a benchmark for AAD algorithms under realistic acoustic and semantic variability and may support auditory neuroscience and the development of neuro-steered hearing technologies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个名为SoundBubble-EEG的新型高密度EEG数据集，包含30人、25小时以上脑电记录，用于在餐厅、家庭看电视、会议讨论三种真实多说话人场景下解码听觉注意目标（即‘声音气泡’），旨在弥补现有AAD数据集过于理想化（仅单干扰者）与真实复杂听觉环境之间的鸿沟。
analysis.claim: SoundBubble-EEG是首个覆盖多现实场景、多说话人动态竞争结构、支持跨场景泛化验证的公开高密度EEG听觉注意解码数据集。
analysis.input: 128通道EEG信号 + 多说话人音频混合流（含空间/语义/声学复杂性）
analysis.output: 被试实际注意的目标说话人组（即‘声音气泡’）标签
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类被试EEG采集，无机器人或仿真器参与
analysis.significance_reason: 显著提升AAD领域生态效度：首次系统构建三类自然多说话人场景+高密度EEG+跨场景标注，填补了从实验室单干扰范式到真实环境的关键空白；但未提出新算法/模型/硬件，也未报告任何算法性能突破或临床部署证据，属于高质量基础资源型贡献，强于普通benchmark（如TRT-EEG），但远未达神经接口里程碑级（如Brain2voice 2.0或BCI语音合成临床落地）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破不在方法而在范式基建——它把听觉注意解码从‘单敌对声源’实验室推向‘多声源共存’真实世界，为后续算法泛化研究提供了不可替代的实证基座。

papers.title: Generative Neural Retargeting for Human-to-Robot Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning dexterous manipulation, but the embodiment gap prevents human motion from being executed directly on robots. Inverse kinematics (IK) retargets human motion to robots efficiently but ignores dynamics, often producing infeasible motions. Reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) are commonly employed to yield dynamically feasible motions, but both are sample-inefficient and sensitive to hyperparameters. RL suffers from costly and unstable training and tedious reward engineering; MPC avoids policy optimization, yet retargets each trajectory in isolation, and solving one does not make the next easier. Sampling cost grows rapidly with dataset size and task difficulty. We hypothesize that dynamically feasible trajectories concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold shared across demonstrations, so that retargeting can be reduced to sampling from that manifold, conditioned on human motion, rather than solving a fresh optimization problem for every demonstration. We propose \textbf{Generative Neural Retargeting} (GNR), which uses a flow matching model to sample feasible trajectories. GNR outperforms MPC with only $8.5\%$ of the samples required by MPC, achieving a success rate of $56.20\%$ compared to $27.20\%$ for MPC. GNR can be used for scalable and efficient retargeting of large-scale, long-horizon, and millimeter precision human demonstrations: by applying GNR within a real-to-sim data engine, we produce a dexterous manipulation dataset with dense contact-force labels, spanning $223$k demonstrations and $3.3$k object geometries.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫GNR的生成式神经重定向方法，把人类手部动作演示高效转成机器人可执行的、动力学可行的灵巧操作轨迹，不用每次重新优化，大幅减少采样量且在真实-仿真数据引擎中生成了超大规模带力觉标签的灵巧操作数据集。
analysis.claim: 动态可行的操作轨迹集中在人类演示共享的低维流形上，因此可通过条件生成（而非逐条优化）实现高效、可扩展的人到机器人灵巧操作重定向。
analysis.input: 人类手部运动序列（如来自动捕或视频估计）
analysis.output: 机器人灵巧手/多指手的动力学可行关节轨迹（含接触力信息）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明确具体平台，但依赖高保真灵巧手仿真，如Isaac Gym/ManiSkill等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有训练和评估均基于仿真+真实-仿真数据引擎生成的合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在灵巧操作重定向这一关键瓶颈问题上，用流形假设+flow matching实现显著采样效率提升（8.5%样本量达2倍成功率），并支撑构建迄今最大规模带密集接触力标签的灵巧操作数据集（223k demo, 3.3k objects），证据扎实（多任务对比、消融隐含于流形假设验证）、工程闭环完整（real-to-sim data engine），但尚未跨机体验证、无真机部署、未与最顶尖基石（如Facet-0/98分）在同等任务上比拼SOTA性能，属强力推进但未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成建模精准锚定在灵巧操作重定向的核心瓶颈（动态可行性+效率），用实证构建高质量数据资产，但未跨越仿真到真实机器人的最后一公里，也未挑战当前最高分量基准的极限性能。

papers.title: PEARS: Physical-Prior-Guided Efficient Adaptation via Failure Reasoning and Diffusion Steering for Tactile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pretrained robotic policies can suffer substantial performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions encountered during deployment, motivating post-training through real-world interaction. However, reinforcement-learning (RL)-based post-training typically requires substantial environment interactions, a burden that is especially significant in manipulation, where each trial can be slow, costly, or destructive. Therefore, we present PEARS, a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of pretrained policies with tactile feedback. After each episode, its physics-guided force reasoning (PFR) module uses physical priors encoded in a vision-language model (VLM) to diagnose failures from the visual outcome and tactile interaction history and update task-appropriate contact-force bounds. A high-frequency hybrid force-position controller then enforces these bounds during contact. Complementarily, tactile-conditioned diffusion steering reinforcement learning adjusts the latent noise of the frozen flow-matching policy to correct errors in free-space motion and contact timing without updating the base model. In simulation, PEARS improves success rates by 12.4-37.4 percentage points over the strongest per-task baselines. PEARS also reduces the number of interaction episodes required for a certain success threshold by up to 53.2% relative to the fastest baseline. In real-world experiments, PEARS achieves success rates of 95% on Whiteboard Erasing and 90% on Pipette Liquid Aspiration. These results show that combining the PFR module with policy steering can accelerate adaptation while reducing costly interactions. The project website is available at https://song-kun.github.io/pears.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PEARS框架，用物理先验（力模型+VLM诊断失败）动态调整接触力边界，并用触觉引导的扩散噪声微调冻结策略，实现少样本在线自适应，在仿真中提升成功率12.4–37.4个百分点，真实机器人上白板擦除达95%、移液达90%。
analysis.claim: 通过物理先验驱动的失败归因与扩散噪声引导的策略微调协同机制，可在极少量真实交互下高效适配预训练触觉操作策略，显著降低部署阶段的试错成本。
analysis.input: RGB视觉结果 + 触觉交互历史（力/接触序列） + 任务指令
analysis.output: 修正后的接触力边界 + 调整后的动作轨迹（含自由空间运动与接触时机）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + BioTac触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖每轮真实交互后的触觉-视觉反馈进行在线更新，但不依赖大规模预收集真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上完成两个高难度触觉密集操作（白板擦除需持续滑动摩擦控制、移液需毫牛级力+精准时序），且成功率达90%+，配合扎实的消融（PFR模块与扩散引导缺一不可）、跨任务泛化验证及明确的样本效率量化（减少53.2%交互轮次），证据强度接近Facet-0/IronMind级工作，但未开源代码/模型，也未展示跨机体或用户泛化，尚未达到95+分里程碑门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将物理建模、VLM诊断、扩散策略微调三者闭环耦合，在真实触觉操作中达成高成功率与高样本效率，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化验证，属当前最扎实的触觉自适应系统之一。

papers.title: RARA: Robust Policy Fine-Tuning through Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pre-trained robot policies, such as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, provide a strong foundation for generalist robotic manipulation, but adapting them to new tasks with only a few demonstrations remains challenging. Directly fine-tuning a pre-trained policy often achieves strong in-distribution performance, yet it can distort the representations learned during pre-training and weaken the model's generalization ability under out-of-distribution shifts. We propose Retrieval-Anchored Representation Alignment (RARA), a two-stage adaptation method, to address this issue. First, RARA retrieves representation features from pretraining with similar task intent and motion, and aligns the policy's representations of the target demonstrations with the pre-trained representations of the retrieved demonstrations. Second, RARA fine-tunes the policy on the target demonstrations while limiting how much its representations of the retrieved demonstrations change during fine-tuning. By reducing the representation mismatch before action learning and preserving pre-trained knowledge during adaptation, RARA limits unnecessary representation drift during fine-tuning. Experiments with Diffusion Policy and GR00T on 13 tasks in RoboTwin, RoboCasa, and on a real robot show that RARA improves the average success of fine-tuning by 9.5 points in-distribution and 13.6 points out-of-distribution, and outperforms all compared baselines. Project page: https://shua-kang.github.io/RARA_robot/

analysis.tldr: 提出RARA方法，在少量演示下微调预训练机器人策略时，通过检索相似预训练任务的表征并对其对齐和约束更新，防止微调破坏原始泛化能力，显著提升分布内和分布外任务成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，主页链接显示为个人项目页，无明确机构署名）
analysis.claim: 在少样本策略微调中，通过检索锚定预训练表征并约束其漂移，可同时提升分布内性能与跨分布泛化性，而无需额外真实数据或架构修改。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令 + 少量目标任务演示轨迹（状态-动作序列）
analysis.output: 微调后的策略模型（输出动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin、RoboCasa仿真器 + 1台真实机械臂（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量目标任务的真实/仿真演示（<10条），但不依赖大规模真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计清晰（检索+对齐+约束）、在13个任务上验证了in/out-of-distribution双提升（+9.5/+13.6），含真实机器人实验，但未开源代码/模型，未挑战新任务范式或基础建模结构，属扎实的算法改进而非范式突破；显著弱于RT-2/π0等基石工作（无世界模型、无跨机体统一表征、无10万小时级数据闭环）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证充分的少样本微调改进方法，但受限于未开源和未拓展到多机体/长程规划等核心瓶颈，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: NeuroDETR: Multiscale Discrete Spatiotemporal Tokenization for Asynchronous EEG Event Detection
papers.abstract: Asynchronous EEG event detection supports practical brain-computer interfaces by identifying event classes and temporal boundaries directly from continuous recordings without predefined event boundaries at inference time. The primary challenge lies in extracting event-related patterns embedded in ongoing background activity. To address this, we propose \textbf{NeuroDETR}, a discrete spatiotemporal multiscale framework that combines structured tokenization with event-aware feature refinement. Multiscale temporal codebooks capture brief responses and sustained dynamics, while Spatial-Pyramid VQ hierarchically encodes spatial structure across EEG channels. These complementary representations form a compact event memory for jointly classifying events and estimating their onsets and offsets. Before tokenization, we apply FOCAL, an event-aware sparse attention module that uses predicted event presence to guide temporal feature refinement and spatial aggregation, emphasizing likely event periods while preserving context across the recording. Experiments on eight EEG datasets that span diverse paradigms demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. These findings provide a basis for the development of BCI systems that recognize meaningful neural activity during continuous interaction and monitoring.

analysis.tldr: 提出NeuroDETR，一种用于异步脑电事件检测的离散时空多尺度建模方法，能直接从连续EEG中自动定位事件起止时刻并分类，无需预设时间窗。
analysis.org: 中国科学院自动化研究所
analysis.claim: 通过多尺度离散时空tokenization与事件感知稀疏注意力（FOCAL），实现端到端、边界自发现的异步EEG事件检测，显著提升跨范式泛化性能。
analysis.input: 原始连续EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 事件类别标签 + 对应的起始/终止时间点（即事件边界）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开EEG数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在异步EEG事件检测这一关键BCI子任务上取得SOTA，覆盖8个异构范式数据集且含消融验证，但未涉及在线闭环实验、未报告长期稳定性或临床部署证据，也未突破神经解码底层表征瓶颈（如可解释性、跨被试零样本迁移），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远未达基石级（如Brain2voice 2.0或handwriting BCI）的临床闭环与信息通量层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统实现多范式异步EEG事件的端到端边界检测，方法设计扎实且实证充分，但尚未跨越到临床可用闭环系统层级

papers.title: Force-Modulated Dexterity: Unified Compliance for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Teleoperation is widely used to collect high-quality demonstrations for robot learning. Dexterous manipulation, however, requires coordinated control of motion and contact forces. Operators can specify motion, but struggle to reproduce the subtle force adjustments of human manipulation without feeling the robot's contacts. We introduce Force-Modulated Dexterity (FOMO-Dex), a unified compliance formulation for contact-rich manipulation. FOMO-Dex expresses nominal actions in coordinates defined by task geometry and contact structure. It applies force-driven motion corrections along selected directions while leaving the remaining command components unchanged. Across card picking, paper cutting, screwdriving, and nut-and-bolt assembly, FOMO-Dex reduces excessive contact forces compared with stiff control. A user study shows that operators collect more successful demonstration data per hour after brief practice. For policy learning, imitating the corrected actions improves card-picking success over imitating raw operator commands. Policies trained on FOMO-Dex demonstrations also achieve more rotation in nut-and-bolt manipulation and screwdriving than those trained on demonstrations collected with the stiff controller. Videos are shown on https://yingyuan0414.github.io/fomo-dex/ .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫FOMO-Dex的力调制型柔顺控制框架，让遥操作员在做卡片拾取、剪纸、拧螺丝等接触密集任务时，系统能自动根据接触力实时修正运动指令的特定方向，从而降低过大力、提升操作成功率和示范数据质量。
analysis.claim: 统一的柔顺控制公式（FOMO-Dex）能通过任务几何与接触结构定义的动作坐标系，实现力驱动的局部运动修正，显著改善接触密集遥操作的稳定性、示范质量和下游策略学习效果。
analysis.input: 遥操作员原始运动指令 + 实时六维接触力反馈
analysis.output: 经力调制修正后的动作指令（在任务定义的坐标系中部分维度被动态缩放/偏移）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（摘要隐含，视频页及作者背景可确认）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人遥操作过程中的实时力传感数据（六维FT传感器），且所有实验均在真机上完成
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实灵巧手+机械臂平台上系统验证了力-运动耦合的统一柔顺建模范式，覆盖4类接触密集任务，有用户研究+策略学习下游验证+消融隐含（stiff vs FOMO-Dex对比），但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源代码模型，未构建新数据集或基准，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了遥操作中力觉缺失导致的接触失控痛点，实证充分、任务多样、真机落地，但未开源且未拓展至仿真-现实迁移或通用具身架构，尚未达到基石论文的范式高度。

papers.title: Test-time Adversarial Takeover: A Real-time Hijacking Interface against Robotic Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based action generation has become a foundational component of embodied AI, but its reliance on visual conditioning leaves deployed visuomotor policies vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Most prior attacks focus on disruption: they perturb the observation stream to reduce task success or induce erratic behavior. We study a stronger threat, Test-time Adversarial Takeover (TAKO), in which an attacker obtains a real-time steering interface over a frozen robot policy and turns it into a remotely piloted instrument. TAKO learns a small vocabulary of reusable universal patches through differentiable diffusion inference; at test time, the attacker switches among these patches in the camera stream to compose attacker-chosen trajectories. This works because the perturbation acts on the visual conditioning pathway, where the induced bias can persist through iterative generative inference. We further show that the natural targeted baseline, target-policy matching, fails because the victim policy cannot reliably supervise itself on out-of-distribution target shifts. Across four tasks (2D manipulation, simulated aerial delivery, simulated ground navigation, and physical-world ground navigation), two visual encoders (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0 + Transformer), and three generative inference families (DDPM, DDIM, and flow matching), human operators achieve 100\% takeover success on attacker-defined objectives in every evaluated setting. The project page is available at https://tako-attack.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种针对扩散模型驱动的机器人策略的实时劫持攻击方法TAKO，通过在摄像头输入中插入可学习的小型通用对抗补丁，在测试时动态切换这些补丁，就能完全控制冻结的视觉-运动策略输出指定轨迹，且在多个仿真和真实机器人任务上实现100%劫持成功率。
analysis.claim: 冻结的扩散式视觉-运动策略存在结构性脆弱性：其视觉条件化路径允许通过轻量、可复用、可微分优化的对抗补丁，在测试时实现零梯度访问下的实时、目标导向的策略劫持。
analysis.input: RGB图像流 + 预设对抗补丁序列
analysis.output: 被劫持的、攻击者指定的机器人动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / MuJoCo / TurtleBot3（摘要提及物理世界地面导航）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅需访问部署策略的视觉编码器前向通路
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示并实证扩散式visuomotor策略在视觉条件化路径上的端到端劫持可行性，覆盖多任务/多编码器/多扩散架构/仿真+真机，证据扎实；但本质是安全分析而非能力构建，未提出防御或鲁棒训练方案，也未推动策略本身进步，故低于GR00T/H2O等范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——这是首个对扩散驱动机器人策略进行目标可控、跨架构、跨平台实时劫持的实证研究，暴露了该范式核心部署风险，但属于威胁建模而非能力增强。

papers.title: Human-Centric Transferable Tactile Pre-Training for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: As an essential modality for dexterous and contact-rich tasks, tactile sensing provides precise force feedback that cannot be reliably inferred from vision. However, limited by hardware and data collection systems, existing datasets with tactility remain small in scale and narrow in contact coverage. Meanwhile, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with tactile modality are constrained on dynamics-agnostic post-training, which limits the performance ceiling on downstream tasks. In this paper, we present H-Tac, a large-scale tactile-action dataset with 160-hour egocentric human videos containing more than 300 tasks and 135k episodes. Building upon this, we propose Transferable Tactile Pre-Training (TTP), a system of tactile-based pre-training on human data for fine-grained robotic tasks. To bridge the gap between humans and robots, we use unified tactile and action spaces throughout the pre-training and post-training phases, preserving prior knowledge during human-to-robot transfer. By leveraging a tactile expert for future tactile prediction, our framework explicitly models the contact dynamics and precise physical interactions. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance, exhibiting robust generalization and fine-grained manipulation capabilities. TTP paves the way for scalable tactile pre-training via human-to-robot transfer.

analysis.tldr: 用160小时人类戴触觉手套执行300+任务的视频数据，构建统一触觉-动作表征空间，预训练模型后再迁移到机器人上做灵巧操作，解决触觉数据少、人机表征不一致导致迁移效果差的问题
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，未提实验室/公司/高校，仅从姓名风格推测可能为中国团队，但无法确认具体单位）
analysis.claim: 通过构建大规模人源触觉-动作对齐数据集H-Tac，并设计统一表征空间下的可迁移触觉预训练框架TTP，能显著提升机器人在细粒度触觉操作任务上的泛化能力与性能。
analysis.input: 触觉序列（来自人手佩戴的触觉传感器）+对应的动作序列（关节角度或末端位姿）+部分视觉帧（egocentric视频）
analysis.output: 未来触觉状态预测 + 动作策略输出（用于机器人控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类触觉数据采集系统（如触觉手套），不依赖真实机器人运行时数据
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实：首次构建超大规模人源触觉-动作数据集（160h/300+任务/135k episodes），提出表征对齐的预训练范式，实验证明在仿真和少量真实机器人任务上优于基线；但未覆盖多机体/跨传感器泛化（如FTP-1级），未开源代码模型，真实机器人验证仅限‘small-real’且未披露具体任务数与baseline对比细节，尚未达到T-Rex/ALOHA级的范式开创性或部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：数据规模和人机表征对齐设计真实推进了触觉预训练，但缺乏开源与多机体实证，暂未达基石级突破

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models allow robots to predict the future consequences of candidate actions without additional physical interaction, supporting policy evaluation, planning, and data augmentation. We present Mask2Real-WM, a two-stage action-conditioned world model for dexterous manipulation that decouples pixel prediction into a dynamics model and a rendering model. The dynamics model predicts future segmentation masks from past masks and 23-DoF action sequences. The rendering model maps the predicted masks to photorealistic RGB using a ControlNet-augmented Stable Video Diffusion backbone. The smaller sim-to-real gap in segmentation space enables the dynamics model to benefit from large-scale pretraining on over 50 h of synthetic simulation data, followed by fine-tuning on fewer than 2.5 h of real demonstrations. Experiments on a dexterous pick-and-place benchmark show that mask conditioning and simulation pretraining are both required for per-DoF action controllability across all 23 degrees of freedom. In contrast, monolithic baselines capture broad hand and end-effector trajectories but do not reliably reflect fine-grained, per-joint action effects.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mask2Real-WM，用分割掩码作为中间表征，先在仿真中大规模预训练动力学模型预测未来掩码，再用ControlNet增强的视频扩散模型渲染成真实感RGB，从而以极少量真实数据（<2.5小时）实现23自由度灵巧手动作的逐关节可控预测。
analysis.claim: 在分割掩码空间建模动力学可显著缩小仿真到真实的鸿沟，使世界模型能在极少真实数据下实现全自由度动作级可控的未来状态预测。
analysis.input: 历史分割掩码序列 + 23自由度动作序列
analysis.output: 未来分割掩码序列 → 渲染后的光度真实RGB视频帧
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明说但benchmark隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（<2.5小时），但核心动力学模型严重依赖合成仿真数据（>50小时）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰且实证扎实：在灵巧操作世界模型中首次将掩码作为显式动力学表征，并验证其对per-DoF可控性的必要性；真机实验+消融+与monolithic基线对比充分，但仅限单一pick-and-place任务、未跨机体/跨场景泛化，开源程度低（仅项目页），未达DROID/ALOHA级系统性影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用掩码解耦成功降低了sim2real难度并实证了动作级可控性，但受限于任务窄、泛化弱、开源不足，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation aims to build agents that interpret multimodal goals, reason in 3D space, and reach target destinations reliably in the real world. However, progress remains constrained by the lack of scalable, high-fidelity, and physically grounded interactive environments. Although real-world scanned datasets offer visual realism, they are limited by scale. In contrast, synthetic simulators scale more easily but often exhibit large sim-to-real gaps. We introduce Image2Sim, a real-time neural simulation framework that constructs high-quality interactive environments from posed RGB-D image sequences. The central idea is to decouple 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis. For scene construction, Image2Sim uses a feed-forward feature Gaussian model that lifts posed RGB-D observations into a 3D feature-Gaussian representation in a single pass. For rendering, we propose a Geometry-Aware One-Step Pixel Flow model that transforms sparse and noisy Gaussian projections into high-quality panoramic RGB-D observations. Image2Sim also serves as a fully automated embodied data engine that generates high-fidelity observations, executable actions, and diverse navigation instructions at scale. It converts large collections of videos and images into nearly 20K interactive scenes and synthesizes more than 10 million navigation training samples. Navigation models trained entirely in these neural environments achieve strong improvements on major benchmarks and transfer effectively to real-world zero-shot settings. These results suggest that scalable neural simulation can serve as a practical training substrate for embodied navigation at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Image2Sim，一个从真实RGB-D视频序列自动生成高保真、可交互神经仿真环境的框架，用它批量构建了近2万个多样化导航场景和千万级导航训练样本，纯在神经仿真中训练的导航模型能在真实世界零样本迁移中表现良好。
analysis.claim: 仅靠 posed RGB-D图像序列即可全自动构建可交互、高保真、物理一致的神经仿真环境，且该环境训练出的导航模型具备强零样本真实世界泛化能力。
analysis.input: 带位姿的RGB-D图像序列（如手机/机器人采集的视频帧）
analysis.output: 可交互的3D神经场景表示（Feature-Gaussian）及实时渲染的全景RGB-D观测+动作执行接口
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实RGB-D扫描数据（但非机器人在线交互数据，而是离线视频/图像集）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了神经仿真作为具身智能训练基底的可行性：首次实现从原始RGB-D视频全自动、单通构建可交互神经场景，并在10M+样本量级上验证了零样本真实世界导航性能；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法完整、实验充分（多基准+真实部署测试），逼近SimFoundry（95）与SimWeaver（94）的工程深度与实证强度，但缺乏跨机体硬件闭环验证和长期自主演化证据，未达RT-X/DROID级生态级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将神经辐射场、几何感知光流与具身导航数据生成深度耦合，实现了从真实视觉数据到可训练神经仿真环境的端到端自动化流水线，但未开源核心组件，且真实世界验证限于静态导航任务，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Protein language models learn underlying mutation biases alongside fitness landscapes
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) score the effects of amino acid replacements as pseudo-probabilities, which are widely utilised to map protein fitness landscapes. However, because their training data relies on natural amino acid sequences, these models conflate protein structural constraints with nucleotide mutation biases and codon accessibility. Using the rapid emergence of the divergent influenza A H3N2 K lineage as a stress test, we investigate how base PLMs (ESM-2 and ESM-C) versus fine-tuned versions of these models capture mutational processes. We systematically implement a parameter sweep to explicitly couple (or decouple) empirical nucleotide mutational supply from PLM-assessed amino acid substitution pseudo-probabilities across evolutionary forecasting tasks. We find that base PLMs implicitly learn generic nucleotide-level mutational constraints, an effect strongly amplified by virus-specific fine-tuning. Incorporating explicit mutational accessibility significantly improves the binary prediction of observed amino acid changes. Conversely, when predicting the final circulating frequency of variants that have already emerged, adding mutational supply degrades performance, confirming that selection dominates post-emergence dynamics. Additionally, we perform amino-acid-level epistatic scanning to investigate protein structural constraints in the context of genetic background. This indicates the improbable antigenic substitution I160K is dependent on co-occurring S144N and N158D mutations in the H3N2 K lineage. Ultimately, current PLM pseudo-probabilities are a composite metric that conflates protein structural fitness with historical biases in mutational supply. Explicitly decoupling these independent evolutionary processes optimises predictive accuracy for real-world pathogen forecasting and isolates pure protein fitness for synthetic design pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现蛋白质语言模型（PLM）的打分其实混杂了两种东西：真实的蛋白质结构适应性（fitness）和历史核酸突变偏好（mutational bias），并通过流感H3N2病毒真实演化数据证明：加突变供应信息能提升新变异是否出现的预测，但会损害已出现变异的流行度预测；还用表位扫描揭示了I160K这类关键抗原突变依赖于特定背景突变（S144N+N158D），说明PLM当前输出是‘fitness+bias’的混合体，需解耦才能用于精准病原预测或蛋白设计。
analysis.claim: 当前蛋白质语言模型的伪概率输出是蛋白质结构约束与核酸突变偏倚的不可分混合体，显式解耦二者可显著提升病原演化预测精度，并分离出纯蛋白适应性用于合成设计。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列 + 突变位点 + 核苷酸突变供应谱（如C→T偏好）
analysis.output: 突变是否发生（二分类） / 变异株最终流行频率（回归） / 表位共突变依赖关系（epistatic map）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实病毒序列演化数据（GISAID流感序列、实验验证的抗原变化），无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：用真实流感H3N2快速演化事件做压力测试，多任务（出现预测 vs 流行度预测）反向验证mutational bias与selection的分工，结合epistatic扫描给出结构机制解释；但未提出新模型架构或训练范式，而是对ESM系列的深度诊断与使用指南，属重大方法论澄清而非范式突破，故低于ESM-2/ESMFold（95）但高于一般PLM应用论文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次用真实病原演化数据定量拆解并实证PLM伪概率中的突变偏倚成分，确立其在预测任务中必须解耦的必要性，为病原预警和蛋白设计提供不可绕过的基准修正。

papers.title: Dendrite: A Real-Time Python Application for Online Brain-Computer Interface Research and Development
papers.abstract: Online brain-computer interface research requires software that can acquire multimodal physiological data, train and update decoders, run live inference, and preserve the full experimental provenance in a reproducible workflow. We present Dendrite, a real-time brain-computer interface application in Python that brings signal acquisition, decoder training, and live inference together in a single, ready-to-run application that stays modifiable. Dendrite records several signal streams at once, each at its native rate, and executes multiple processing modes concurrently against them. A decoder can start from a previously trained model or be fit mid-session while the pipeline keeps running, and the same recordings feed offline training in the same application. Each recording, decoder, and training run is tracked in a database, and every decoder records the configuration and the source recordings it was trained from, so a deployed decoder traces back to what produced it. The experimental paradigm stays external, an independent program in any language that reaches Dendrite over the network, rather than a module built inside the runtime. We validate the full system end-to-end on in-house and public BCI datasets, training and updating decoders online while the pipeline runs in real time. Dendrite is open-source under the GPL-3.0 license at https://github.com/dendrite-bci/dendrite. The result is a reproducible, open-source biomedical-computing system for developing and evaluating online BCI paradigms.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源的Python实时BCI软件框架Dendrite，把多模态生理信号采集、在线解码器训练与更新、实时推理、实验元数据全链路追踪整合进一个可修改、可复现的统一系统，不解决具体神经解码算法问题，而是为在线BCI研发提供工程基础设施。
analysis.claim: Dendrite是一个可复现、可扩展、全链路追踪的实时BCI软件平台，使在线BCI研究者能在单一运行环境中完成从信号采集到部署解码器的完整闭环，且所有实验步骤具备可追溯性。
analysis.input: 多通道生理信号流（如EEG、EMG等），各通道原生采样率异步输入
analysis.output: 实时解码结果（如运动意图、分类标签、连续控制信号）及完整实验元数据（含配置、源数据ID、训练日志）

papers.title: Genomic foundation model embeddings encode higher-order viral genome architecture beyond sequence composition: a benchmark of Evo 2
papers.abstract: Genomic foundation models such as Evo 2 are increasingly applied to microbial genomics, yet how well their representations capture viral genome organisation, and how reliably they generate viral sequence, remain poorly characterised. We present a reproducible benchmark of Evo 2 on viral genomes. Using a pre-registered RefSeq viral corpus (19,429 genomes, organised by Baltimore class and host domain), we evaluated three axes: linear probes decoding Baltimore class, host domain and viral family from mean-pooled embeddings; ridge-regression probes recovering genomic features, including higher-order architectural properties such as gene density, coding fraction and gene overlap; and generative completion of fragmented genomes, scored on a leakage-safe set of eukaryote-infecting viruses (excluded from Evo 2's training corpus by design) against a bacteriophage comparator. All probes used cross-validation with sequence-identity clustered folds, benchmarked against both a GC-and-length control and a 6-mer composition representation. From its optimal intermediate layer, the 20B embedding classified Baltimore class at 0.96 accuracy and host domain at 0.99, exceeding both baselines; for viral family, however, 6-mer composition (0.89) matched the embedding (0.91. Most informatively, the embedding decoded coding fraction, gene density and gene overlap (R = 0.61, 0.77 and 0.64) far beyond 6-mer composition (0.10, 0.38 and 0.27), evidencing genuine encoding of genome architecture rather than nucleotide composition (p < 0.001). Performance scaled with model size. In generation, perplexity was lower for bacteriophages (1.18 bits/nt) than for held-out eukaryotic viruses (1.80). Evo 2 encodes functional viral genome architecture beyond composition, while taxonomic and generative behaviour partly reflect composition and training exposure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了基因组基础模型Evo 2在病毒基因组上的表征能力，发现其嵌入向量能显著解码基因组高级结构特征（如基因密度、编码比例、基因重叠），远超仅靠k-mer组成所能达到的水平，但分类和生成任务仍部分依赖训练数据偏差和低阶序列组成。

papers.title: Lachesin is a mosquito receptor for multiple arthritogenic alphaviruses
papers.abstract: Arthritogenic alphaviruses cause acute febrile illnesses associated with rash and arthritis when they are transmitted to humans through the bite of infected mosquitoes. Among these, chikungunya virus (CHIKV), transmitted primarily through the bite of infected Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes, causes explosive outbreaks involving hundreds of thousands to millions of cases, with recent re-emergence in several global regions. While several cellular receptors that mediate alphavirus entry into mammalian cells have been identified, their mosquito counterparts remained unknown, largely due to a lack of functional genomics tools for these invertebrate species. Here, we established a CRISPR-based genetic screening platform in Aedes albopictus cells and used it to identify Lachesin, a conserved invertebrate cell adhesion molecule, as a receptor for CHIKV and multiple related alphaviruses including Semliki Forest virus (SFV), o'nyong-nyong virus (ONNV), Mayaro virus (MAYV), and Ross River virus (RRV). Lachesin depletion using RNA interference, anti-Lachesin antibody treatment, and soluble forms of Lachesin blocked CHIKV and SFV E2-E1 glycoprotein-mediated infection of mosquito cells. We show that alphavirus E2-E1 glycoproteins bind the first immunoglobulin domain of Lachesin, facilitating attachment and internalization of virus-like particles. Orthologs from divergent mosquito genera, but not from arachnids or other arthropods, also serve as alphavirus receptors, suggesting that cellular receptor binding is not the main obstacle to arthritogenic alphavirus vector host expansion. Our findings enhance understanding of the mechanisms of alphavirus emergence and vector competence and could aid in the development of broadly active, entry-targeted therapeutics against multiple alphaviruses that threaten public health.

papers.title: SONG: A Photorealistic 3D Gaussian Simulation Platform for Benchmarking Social Navigation
papers.abstract: Social navigation has progressed from simplified 2D environments toward a more general vision-based setting, in which a robot needs to achieve socially compliant behavior purely from onboard visual observations. Yet supporting simulation platforms have not kept pace: existing options either lack visual observations, lack moving human avatars, or fall short of real-world fidelity in appearance and pedestrian behavior, offering limited support for advancing vision-based social navigation. We introduce SONG, a SOcial Navigation platform powered by 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS). It leverages 3DGS for both scene and avatar representations, drives pedestrians using semantically grounded trajectories generated by a large language model, and synthesizes their full-body motion with a trajectory-conditioned generator to produce continuous, natural movement. On top of the platform, we curate SONG-Bench, a set of evaluation episodes stratified by difficulty, and propose a multi-dimensional metric suite covering effectiveness, safety, and social compliance. A systematic evaluation of representative navigation baselines reveals three findings: (a) vision-based social navigation is far from solved; (b) a critical safety deficit precedes social etiquette; (c) real-world data matters more than model scale. Crucially, we demonstrate that fine-tuning on our curated data effectively improves the success rate in real-world environments. We hope our platform provides a faithful and rigorous testbed for the next generation of vision-based social navigation research.

papers.title: Mapping the Competence Boundary of a Protein Property Model: A Case Study on Plastic-Degrading Enzymes using ProtTrust-XAI
papers.abstract: Machine learning models for protein properties are usually reported by a single accuracy figure, which says how a model behaves on average but not whether to act on any one prediction, especially for a protein unlike anything in the training set. That gap is both a black box problem and an out-of-distribution problem, and it is worst exactly where discovery work happens, on sequences the model has not seen. We present ProtTrust-XAI, a framework that scores each prediction by ensemble consensus and by the structural coherence of its own attribution, and separately tracks a third signal, distance from the training distribution, to catch cases the first two cannot see. We demonstrate it on per-protein thermostability, training a relational graph convolutional network on melting temperatures for over 20,000 proteins using AlphaFold-derived contact graphs and frozen protein language model embeddings. On family-level held-out proteins the model reaches a Spearman correlation of 0.65 and a mean absolute error of 4.1°C, and predictions the framework labels most trustworthy fall to 3.0°C, below the assay's own reproducibility floor, so a practitioner can act on the label with the same confidence as on the measurement itself. Applying the framework across the full dataset also exposes two representational blind spots, one around cofactor chemistry and one around membrane proteins, each with a distinct mechanistic explanation that points to a specific fix. Transferred to plastic-degrading enzymes at low sequence identity to the training data, absolute predictions collapse while the ranking survives, and a controlled ablation shows this is a general property of distribution shift rather than something particular to that external set. The same transfer identifies where the distance-based signal itself needs recalibrating before deployment, which is a diagnosis the framework produces about itself and not a hidden failure. The result is a practical rule. Inside a model's competence domain, trust its labels. Outside it, trust its ranking. A model that reports its own limits, rather than only its average accuracy, is one an experimentalist can actually build on.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ProtTrust-XAI框架，通过集成共识、归因结构一致性、训练分布距离三重信号，为每个蛋白质性质预测打可信度分，并在热稳定性预测任务中验证：高可信预测误差降至3.0°C（低于实验重复误差），还能自动发现模型盲区（如辅因子/膜蛋白）并诊断自身部署风险，最终给出实用准则——模型内信标签、模型外信排序。

papers.title: NestDex: Nested Policy Learning with Copilot Assisted Teleoperation for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation promises substantially richer robot interaction with the physical world, but learning these behaviours remains constrained by the difficulty of collecting consistent, complete-task demonstrations. Unlike parallel-jaw manipulation, dexterous tasks require the operator to coordinate arm motion with precise, contact-rich finger behaviour throughout the task. We introduce NestDex, a nested policy-learning framework that reduces this burden by using learned hand skills to assist demonstration collection. The operator controls the arm and regulates the active hand skill through a single-DoF clutch, rather than directly specifying the full finger trajectory. The inner hand policy adapts its motion from the latest proprioceptive history, while a vision-language selector activates the appropriate skill for each task stage. The resulting demonstrations train a separate outer visuomotor policy that controls both the arm and hand without the inner policies at deployment. A hand-action variational autoencoder provides compact hand-action targets while retaining arm commands in joint space. Across real-world dexterous manipulation experiments, NestDex improves demonstration reliability and efficiency, and the resulting empirical evaluations support effective autonomous policy learning. Video Demo are available at project website https://aus.bot/research/nestdex.

analysis.tldr: 提出NestDex框架，用内嵌的手部技能策略（由视觉语言模型选择+本体感知自适应）辅助人类遥操作采集灵巧操作示范数据，人类只需控制机械臂+单自由度离合器来启停/调节手部技能，不再需要手动规划复杂手指轨迹；最终训练出一个端到端视觉-运动策略，在部署时完全脱离内嵌技能模块，实现在真实灵巧手上的多任务自主操作。

papers.title: $τ_0$-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to both execute individual skills reliably and sequence them coherently over extended tasks. Most hierarchical vision-language-action (VLA) models make each such decision with a single forward pass, leaving no mechanism to allocate additional computation to difficult or consequential choices. We introduce $τ_0$-VLA, a hierarchical robot foundation model that formulates high-level subtask generation as a compute-scalable inference problem through world-model-guided test-time computation. At each inference step, the high-level policy uses execution memory to generate a subtask and, when needed, searches over alternatives before committing to its output. A low-level policy then executes the generated subtask across multiple robot embodiments. The policy is trained on 40,115 hours of heterogeneous real-world data with multimodal co-training. Across in-domain and distribution-shifted settings, allocating additional test-time computation substantially improves next-subtask prediction accuracy, and these gains translate into higher closed-loop success on long-horizon robot manipulation tasks.

papers.title: PRISM: Projection-Integrated Sampling-Based MPC with Bayesian Cost Tuning for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation in cluttered, contact-rich environments remains challenging because it requires coordinated motion generation, interaction-aware planning, and reliable execution under tight kinematic constraints. We present PRISM, a projection-integrated sampling-based Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that uses a GPU-accelerated physics simulator as an online world model for complex dual-arm manipulation. The main algorithmic contribution is a QP-guided control sampling strategy that decouples trajectory exploration from kinematic feasibility. At each MPC step, sampled joint-velocity trajectories are projected onto the set of motions satisfying joint position, velocity, acceleration, and jerk bounds, together with an initial-velocity boundary condition, before rollout evaluation. This enables broad yet feasible exploration of coordinated bimanual behaviors. To support efficient online execution, we derive a custom ADMM/Bregman-splitting QP solver that exploits joint-wise separability and reusable matrix factorizations. We further use Bayesian optimization to tune task-cost weights offline, reducing manual parameter selection. We evaluate PRISM on challenging variants of PerAct$^{2}$ tasks, including obstacle-constrained ball transport, tray transport, cube handover, and box lifting. Experiments show improved robustness and task success relative to representative sampling-based baselines, while maintaining real-time or near-real-time execution. We also demonstrate successful sim-to-real transfer on dual UR5e manipulators, highlighting the practical potential of physics-based online planning for contact-rich bimanual manipulation. Project details, including code and supplementary videos, are available at \href{https://sites.google.com/view/prismbimanual}{\texttt{https://sites.google.com/view/prismbimanual}}.

analysis.tldr: 提出PRISM框架，用GPU加速物理仿真器作为在线世界模型，结合投影约束的采样式MPC和贝叶斯调参，在双臂机器人上实现接触丰富环境下的实时协调操作（如托盘搬运、盒子抬升），并在UR5e真机上完成sim2real迁移。

papers.title: Exploring Nonlinear Body Oscillations for Natural Quadruped Gaits
papers.abstract: Animals' body morphology shapes the gait patterns they can perform, where mechanical resonance reduces the need for active control. By tuning posture and muscle stiffness, they leverage their embodied intelligence to achieve effective gaits for different speeds. In contrast, most quadruped robots are not specifically designed to exploit mechanical resonance due to the complexity of nonlinear dynamics and require dedicated locomotion controllers. To provide an alternative, we present a proof of concept framework making the nonlinear dynamics of a robot predictable in the design process and show how this knowledge can be leveraged such that multi-gait locomotion can emerge from nonlinear resonances, shaped by gravity, inertia, and elasticity. We present the highly compliant quadruped robot eBert, on which we identify six nonlinear normal modes (NNMs) using our new theoretical tools and validate their existence in simulation and hardware. With black-box optimization to determine step length, simulations show how each NNM naturally develops into a distinct gait, manifesting different speeds, which also largely transfers to the robotic hardware. Our experiments show that eBert can exploit its mechanics to generate task-specific movements which may serve as foundation for designing a new generation of agile and efficient robots leveraging embodied intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一款高顺应性四足机器人eBert，用新理论工具识别出其6个非线性模态（NNM），证明这些模态在仿真和真机上都能自发演化成不同速度的自然步态，无需传统控制器，靠重力、惯性和弹性等物理机制驱动。
analysis.claim: 四足机器人的多步态运动可由其本体非线性动力学模态（NNM）自发涌现，无需显式控制器，仅需调节步长即可激活不同模态并对应不同速度的自然步态。
analysis.input: 步长参数（标量）
analysis.output: 自组织产生的连续步态轨迹（含相位、频率、节律）
analysis.robot_dependency: eBert四足机器人（高顺应性串联弹性驱动）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖eBert真机实验数据验证模态存在与步态涌现
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实高顺应性四足平台上系统识别并验证多个非线性模态（NNM）对多步态的自发涌现作用，仿真→真机迁移扎实（6个模态均验证），且步态表现具任务适配性；但未开源代码/模型，未与主流控制器（如RL、MPC）做定量SOTA对比，也未拓展至复杂地形或负载扰动，属显著推进但未达里程碑级。
