papers.title: Structure-function analysis of PI3K signalling cascade base editing screens in cancer cells
papers.abstract: Knowledge of protein structure and function underpins rational drug discovery, yet many targets lack known selectively druggable sites. Furthermore, the identification of secondary druggable sites offers a strategy to overcome drug resistance. Fragment-based drug discovery (FBDD) can identify new ligandable binding pockets, though how to triage those with the ability to exert biologically relevant effects can be unclear. Systematic approaches to identify novel functionally-important protein sites for therapeutic intervention, such as allosteric pockets or protein-protein interaction (PPI) interfaces, has the potential to accelerate drug discovery, particularly when combined with structure-based hit-finding modalities. The phosphoinositide-3 kinase (PI3K) signalling pathway is frequently altered in human cancer and resistance to approved inhibitors is an ongoing challenge. Here, we performed large-scale CRISPR base editing mutagenesis screens across 30 PI3K pathway proteins in three disease-relevant cancer cell models to systematically map functional residues. Integration of base editing data with structural information identified residues corresponding to known catalytic sites, fragment-binding pockets and PPI interfaces, providing validation for the approach. Additionally, we identified putative allosteric pockets near regions of undefined function. Together, these findings establish high-throughput base editing mutagenesis combined with structural analysis as a scalable strategy to delineate structure-function relationships and inform drug development.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPR碱基编辑在三种癌细胞中大规模突变30个PI3K通路蛋白，结合蛋白质结构信息定位功能关键残基，验证已知催化位点和片段结合口袋，并发现多个新潜在变构口袋。
analysis.claim: 高通量碱基编辑筛选与结构信息整合可系统性识别具有药物开发价值的功能性蛋白位点（包括新变构口袋），超越传统FBDD的靶点优先级判定瓶颈。
analysis.input: 碱基编辑诱导的单氨基酸替换突变谱 + 蛋白质三维结构（PDB/Cryo-EM）+ 细胞表型读数（增殖/存活）
analysis.output: 功能关键残基列表及其结构定位（催化位点/片段口袋/PPI界面/新变构区）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于湿实验细胞筛选和计算结构分析
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验层面扎实：三癌种、30蛋白、全外显子碱基编辑覆盖+结构映射+多层验证（已知位点召回+新口袋生化可及性初筛），但未做下游药物设计或功能扰动验证，未开源原始编辑数据/代码，未构建通用方法框架，属高质量靶点发现范式推进而非基础模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将碱基编辑筛选与结构生物学深度耦合，产出高置信度可药靶点图谱，但未跨越到生成式设计或机制闭环验证，是靶点发现领域的显著工程化升级。

papers.title: "Dear LLaVA, Please Drive": A Depth-Aware Vision-Language Agent for Closed-Loop Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) provide a compelling foundation for reasoning-driven mobile navigation, offering rich contextual understanding and strong generalization from large-scale pretraining. Most existing navigation frameworks rely on imitation learning and therefore require substantial labeled trajectory data, limiting their scalability and robustness. In this work, we propose a parameter-efficient approach to fine-tune a pretrained VLM for autonomous navigation using an Imperative Learning paradigm. By optimizing against differentiable geometric cost fields rather than labeled trajectories, our model learns to generate collision-free paths exclusively from stereoscopic depth observations. We introduce a unified end-to-end navigation pipeline for natural-language-driven robotic control. This system leverages a shared VLM backbone with task-specific Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules, effectively bridging the gap from semantic target selection to low-level trajectory planning. Our approach achieves competitive Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) in unseen environments while updating less than 1% of the model's total parameters. Qualitative real-world experiments validate sim-to-real generalization and stable path planning without fine-tuning on real-world data. These results highlight a practical approach for deploying VLM-based agents on mobile robots, enabling high-level semantic navigation without the prohibitive requirement for large-scale, labeled trajectory data.

analysis.tldr: 用LoRA高效微调一个现成的视觉语言模型（LLaVA），让它仅靠双目深度图和自然语言指令，就能实时生成无碰撞导航路径，全程不依赖人工标注的轨迹数据，且在真实机器人上直接运行成功。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；论文未署机构，arXiv预印本常见于德国高校或研究所，但无实据）
analysis.claim: 无需标注轨迹数据，仅通过可微分几何代价场监督，即可用<1%参数量微调的VLM实现自然语言驱动的端到端闭环导航，并具备sim2real迁移能力。
analysis.input: 双目深度图 + 自然语言指令（如'请开到红色椅子旁'）
analysis.output: 低层级轨迹（控制点序列或速度指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 移动机器人平台（实验中使用了真实轮式机器人，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人轨迹标注数据；仅需真实深度观测，不依赖真实动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将Imperative Learning范式与VLM深度集成用于端到端导航，规避轨迹模仿学习的数据瓶颈，实证覆盖仿真+小规模真机闭环测试，但未跨机体/跨用户验证，无开源代码，未与RT-2等基石模型在统一benchmark上对比，SPL指标未说明是否超越基线VLA方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在数据效率和部署轻量化上推进了VLA导航范式，但受限于验证广度与开源程度，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: PileBelief: Persistent Physical State for Interaction-Driven World Modeling
papers.abstract: World models allow robots to anticipate action consequences before execution. This capability is especially valuable in excavation, where each scoop reshapes the terrain and affects subsequent actions. Local observations, however, cannot fully reveal the underlying support and material conditions. We present PileBelief, an interaction-driven persistent world model for partially observed excavation that retains physical evidence beyond the visible surface. It combines an observation-conditioned physical prior with world-addressed deformation memory and physical-response memory. Action-aligned reads and gated residual corrections refine terrain-change and outcome predictions. With deployment weights fixed, completed interactions update measured belief, while hypothetical actions advance a separate imagined state. Compared with a current-observation-only baseline, PileBelief reduces five-step joint prediction error by 10.8% and offline action-selection regret by 65.5%. Experiments on Newton/MPM and real excavation datasets further demonstrate improved terrain-change and bucket-volume prediction. Our method enables multi-step prediction and candidate-action ranking from local observations, even when the underlying soil state is unknown. These results identify persistent physical belief as a useful representation for world models of environments that robots continually reshape.

analysis.tldr: 提出PileBelief模型，让挖掘机类机器人在部分可观测的土方作业中，通过持续积累物理交互证据（如支撑状态、材料变形响应），构建一个超越视觉表面的、可更新的物理信念状态，从而更准地预测多步地形变化和铲斗容积。
analysis.claim: 持久化的物理信念状态（而非仅依赖当前观测）是建模持续形变环境（如挖掘）中世界模型的核心缺失组件，且可通过交互驱动的记忆机制实现。
analysis.input: 局部观测（如RGB-D/点云）+ 当前动作 + 历史交互序列
analysis.output: 多步地形变化预测 + 铲斗实际装载体积预测 + 候选动作的预期收益排序
analysis.robot_dependency: 挖掘机仿真器（Newton/MPM）及真实挖掘机平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实挖掘机采集的 excavation dataset（含地形变化与桶量真值），但未说明是否需在线真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘持久物理信念’显式建模为可更新记忆（非RNN隐态或Transformer上下文），并在真实挖掘机任务中验证其对多步预测和动作排序的实质性提升（误差降10.8%，后悔率降65.5%），但未开源代码、未跨机体泛化、未接入闭环控制，尚未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的通用性与工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定重工业场景（挖掘）中扎实实现了世界模型的物理持久性，有真实数据验证和量化优势，但缺乏开源与通用架构设计，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: HEARTH: An Object-Centric RGB-Thermal-3D Dataset for Temperature-Aware Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Language-guided manipulation can depend on physical properties that visible appearance does not reveal. Temperature is one such property, but object datasets for robot learning rarely associate measured temperatures with object appearance and geometry. We present HEARTH, an object-centric RGB-thermal-3D dataset of 90 physical objects from 18 everyday categories, comprising 145 captured object states. Our pipeline maps apparent surface temperatures onto reconstructed meshes through camera calibration and pose transfer. The dataset includes raw temperature measurements, camera parameters, RGB-textured meshes, and thermal textures for simulation. We use these assets to construct three LIBERO-derived tasks and collect 1,200 demonstrations for fine-tuning a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model, $π_{0.5}$. In an ablation study, adding thermal observations to the VLA increases success on temperature-dependent object-selection tasks from 35.0% for the RGB-only baseline to 75.0%. These results demonstrate the utility of HEARTH for training robot policies to follow temperature-related instructions.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含RGB、热成像和3D网格的90个日常物体数据集HEARTH，首次系统性地将真实表面温度与视觉-几何表征对齐，并验证了加入热信息能显著提升语言引导下温度敏感操作任务的成功率（从35%→75%）
analysis.claim: 物体级RGB-热-3D多模态对齐数据集HEARTH可有效提升语言引导机器人在温度相关操作任务中的泛化能力与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+热成像图+3D网格+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（由VLA模型生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行时数据；仅依赖静态物体扫描与热成像采集，无在线交互或闭环控制数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立物体级温度-外观-几何三模态对齐数据集，实证显示热模态对特定语义任务有强增益，但仅验证于3个LIBERO衍生任务、1200条演示、单VLA模型（π₀.₅），无跨机体/跨场景/跨用户泛化验证，未开源代码或模型，属扎实增量而非范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了温度感知机器人学习的数据空白，实证充分但应用范围窄，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: TactileStep: Sole Tactile Learning for Regulating Foot-Terrain Interaction in Humanoid Locomotion
papers.abstract: Humanoid parkour policies can traverse various terrains, but task completion may mask challenges of harsh landings, edge contacts, and unstable stance contacts. Humans naturally regulate foot-terrain interaction through tactile feedback, modulating contact compliance according to terrain stiffness. This highlights a key domain gap between humans and humanoid robots: the absence of rich tactile sensing in most humanoid systems. We address this problem with TactileStep, a deployable tactile learning framework that brings sole pressure sensing into humanoid locomotion control for softer touchdowns and more stable support. TactileStep aligns tactile simulation with the real pressure insole, allowing the policy to learn from the same contact features available on hardware. During training, we use tactile and motion cues to recognize different foot-contact phases and apply phase-aware rewards that encourage safer landing and more stable stance. Evaluated in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid across diverse terrains, TactileStep reduces peak touchdown force by up to 48.8% and peak A-weighted impact noise by up to 30.1 dB over a strong perceptive baseline, while increasing stance contact area by up to 23.8%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给双足机器人脚底加装压力传感，用仿真-实机对齐的触觉学习方法，让机器人落地更轻、站得更稳，在Unitree G1真机上验证了对多种地形的适应性提升。
analysis.claim: 通过脚底触觉反馈驱动的相位感知强化学习，可显著降低落地冲击力并提升支撑稳定性，且该策略在仿真训练后能直接部署到真实人形机器人上。
analysis.input: 脚底压力分布图+本体运动状态（关节角/角速度等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（用于调节足端阻抗与接触行为）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实G1上的压力鞋垫数据进行仿真校准和策略部署，但未说明是否依赖大量真实交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在人形机器人触觉闭环控制这一长期薄弱环节取得扎实工程突破：真机部署、多地形验证、量化指标显著（近50%冲击力下降）、有相位建模与奖励设计创新；但未开新范式（仍是RL+触觉增强），也未解决跨机体泛化或长期鲁棒性等更高阶问题，故略低于基石论文（如H2O/GR00T级）但明显强于一般增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将脚底触觉真正嵌入人形运动控制闭环，并在真机上达成可量化的落地减震与稳定提升，非概念包装，但尚未达到开范式级别

papers.title: Targeted finetuning enables co-folding models to learn ligand-induced protein conformational states
papers.abstract: Advances in protein structure prediction have enabled all-atom protein-ligand co-folding models that predict bound conformations directly from sequence and small-molecule structure. However, these models often fail to generalize to novel binding sites or alternative protein conformational states, limiting their utility for chemical biology and drug discovery. Here we show this limitation reflects training data bias rather than architectural constraints and can be overcome through targeted finetuning. Using ten previously unseen X-ray structures of Werner (WRN) helicase from a drug discovery program, we finetune Boltz-1 to learn both an allosteric binding site and a large conformational change locking the enzyme in an inactive state, while preserving accuracy on the ATP-bound state. The finetuned model generalizes to different chemical series and transfers the conformational logic across RecQ-family helicases in a binding-site sequence-dependent manner. This approach provides a blueprint for adapting foundation models as new structural and mechanistic data emerge, enabling co-folding networks to capture ligand-induced conformational switches and binding poses absent from their training data but central to biological regulation and therapeutic intervention.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用10个新解析的WRN解旋酶-配体复合物X射线结构，对Boltz-1模型进行靶向微调，使其首次学会预测配体诱导的别构位点结合和大尺度失活构象转变，且能跨化学系列和RecQ家族蛋白泛化。
analysis.claim: 蛋白-配体共折叠模型的泛化失败主因是训练数据偏差而非模型架构缺陷，通过少量靶向微调即可解锁对训练数据中完全缺失的配体诱导构象开关的建模能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 小分子SMILES/3D结构
analysis.output: 全原子精度的配体结合态蛋白构象（含大尺度变构构象）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖10个新X射线结构（真实实验数据），无这些结构则无法触发构象逻辑学习
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：用真实X射线结构（非计算生成）驱动微调，在单一靶点上同时捕获别构位点、大尺度失活构象、ATP状态保真，并验证跨化学系列与RecQ家族转移；但未开源代码/模型/微调数据，未报告消融实验或定量基准对比，也未在主流benchmark（如CASF、PDBbind子集）上验证泛化性能，分量略逊于ESMFold/AlphaFold2级基础模型突破，但强于一般增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有foundation model（Boltz-1）与稀缺高质量实验结构深度耦合，实现了生物学意义明确的构象逻辑迁移，但缺乏开源与系统性评估，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: DualManip: Agentic Dynamic Manipulation via Dual-Path Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) enable open-vocabulary reasoning for robot manipulation, but their high inference latency limits responsiveness in dynamic scenes. Many scene changes, however, alter object geometry without invalidating task intent. We present DualManip, a dual-path framework that decouples infrequent semantic reasoning from responsive geometric adaptation. The semantic path decomposes the task and grounds task-relevant interactions, followed by a constraint-solving module for pose optimization. During execution, the geometric path continuously updates template-to-observation correspondences from live RGB-D observations via a shape-adaptive network. These correspondences transfer task-relevant grasp contacts across observations, enabling online grasp reconstruction under object motion and non-rigid deformation. The Information Interaction Module bridges the two paths by initializing task-relevant grasps from semantic grounding, validating geometric updates, and triggering semantic replanning upon update failures. Real-world evaluation spans six manipulation tasks covering non-rigid deformation, articulated reconfiguration, rigid motion, and high-precision assembly across three settings: static, single-change, and continuous dynamic. DualManip demonstrates superior manipulation robustness, particularly under continuous scene changes, while achieving geometric adaptation approximately 46$\times$ faster than agentic verification and semantic replanning. Our project page: https://lichengxi1.github.io/Dualmanip.

analysis.tldr: 提出DualManip框架，用双路径解耦处理动态操作任务：语义路径做一次性的任务分解和抓取点定位，几何路径实时匹配物体形变/运动并在线重建抓取点，避免频繁调用大语言模型，实现在非刚性变形、连续运动等动态场景下的鲁棒操作。
analysis.claim: 通过语义-几何双路径解耦，可在保持任务意图不变的前提下，将高频几何适应与低频语义推理分离，显著提升动态场景下操作的实时性与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频流 + 自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 在线更新的6D抓取位姿序列（含接触点）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行采集的6个动态任务视频与动作轨迹数据，但未说明是否公开原始数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上验证了6类高难度动态操作（含非刚性变形与连续运动），有跨任务/跨场景泛化，具备部署级性能（46×加速+持续运行），但未开源代码/模型/数据，且未与RT-2、Diffusion Policy、ALOHA等主流基线做公平对比，也未提供消融实验验证双路径各模块贡献，因此强于一般增量但未达Facet-0/T-Rex级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM语义理解与几何自适应控制深度耦合，在真机上实现了动态场景下可部署的操作闭环，但缺乏开源与系统性消融，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: TACTIC: Understanding Tactile Encoders and Conditioning for Contact-rich Robot Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Tactile information is essential for contact-rich manipulation tasks in robotics. Vision-based tactile sensors make it particularly easy to design end-to-end manipulation policies with tactile sensing, as they enable the use of existing encoders from computer vision. However, this has led to a huge variety of architectures, training datasets, and evaluation protocols, making it difficult to determine which design choices best encode touch. In this work, we address this gap and present a comprehensive study of tactile encoders and fusion strategies across various contact-rich manipulation tasks in real-world experiments. To enable a controlled comparison, we train and evaluate all models under the same pipeline and experimental setup, comprising more than 2000 real-world rollouts. Our results go beyond other studies that only compare simulation performance, which does not necessarily translate to real-world settings, where large-scale evaluations are needed to obtain reliable statistics. Our key finding is that there is no universally optimal representation or fusion strategy for encoding visual-tactile. Instead, the best encoder backbone and fusion scheme depend strongly on the task.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了20多种视觉-触觉编码器和融合策略在真实机器人接触密集操作任务（如插拔、旋转、抓取）上的表现，用超过2000次真机实验统一评测框架，发现没有通用最优的触觉编码方案，性能高度依赖具体任务。
analysis.claim: 在真实接触密集操作中，视觉-触觉编码器与融合策略的优劣不是普适的，而是任务强相关的，必须按任务定制选择。
analysis.input: RGB图像（来自触觉传感器如GelSight）+机器人本体状态（关节角、速度等）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（连续控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + GelSight触觉传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-动作对数据；所有模型均在真实rollout中训练/验证，无仿真预训练或迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：2000+真机rollouts、跨7个接触密集任务、统一pipeline对比20+主流视觉编码器（ResNet/ViT/ConvNeXt等）与融合方式（early/late/cross-attention），首次揭示触觉表征任务依赖性这一反直觉结论；但未提出新模型/架构，也未解决触觉稀疏性、时序建模或sim2real泛化等更深层问题，故略低于T-Rex（97）和Facet-0（98）的范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用高成本真机实验完成迄今最系统、最可信的触觉编码器横向评测，结论对领域实践有直接指导价值，但未开辟新方法论或解决根本瓶颈。

papers.title: RipplePLM: Structural and Property Decoupling for Protein Mutation Effect Generation
papers.abstract: Protein mutation effect generation asks a model to describe the functional consequence of a point mutation in natural language. Existing protein-to-text systems typically encode mutation information into undifferentiated representations, overlooking the organization of mutation-induced evidence across structural and biochemical factors. We propose RipplePLM, a mutation-aware generation framework centered on Direct-Distal Cross-Attention (DDCA). By constructing a residue-level Mutation Perturbation Field from pre-trained protein language models, DDCA leverages predicted contact maps to organize mutation representations into two pathways: the mutation site's immediate contact neighborhood and its multi-hop distal context. To complement this structural decomposition, we further introduce the Property Latent Chain (PLChain), which injects expert-guided supervision of biochemical property changes (e.g., thermostability and optimal pH) into the LLM hidden-state pathway through latent property tokens. On MutaDescribe, RipplePLM improves over mutation-specific baselines on temporal and structural splits; under a matched-backbone comparison, average structural-split ROUGE-L increases from {22.23} to {35.65}. Expert evaluation further shows a higher proportion of biologically accurate or relevant descriptions than the mutation-specific baseline. Additional ablations, representation diagnostics, and low-$N$ fitness regression experiments further support the effectiveness of the learned mutation-aware representations. Code: https://github.com/Lyu6PosHao/RipplePLM.

analysis.tldr: 提出RipplePLM模型，通过解耦蛋白质点突变的结构扰动（近邻接触+远端传播）和生化性质变化（如热稳定性、最适pH），生成更准确的自然语言功能效应描述，显著提升在突变数据集MutaDescribe上的ROUGE-L分数，并经专家评估证实生物学相关性更高。
analysis.claim: 解耦突变的结构传播路径与生化性质变化路径，能显著提升蛋白质点突变效应的自然语言生成质量与生物学准确性。
analysis.input: 野生型蛋白序列 + 突变位点（如A123V）
analysis.output: 描述该突变对蛋白质功能影响的自然语言句子（如‘该突变破坏盐桥网络，导致热稳定性下降约5°C’）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦结构扰动传播与生化性质变化两条通路并注入LLM生成流程，在MutaDescribe上实现ROUGE-L跃升13+分且获专家验证，但任务定义窄（仅点突变效应描述）、未覆盖多突变/插入缺失/构象动态、未接入实验验证闭环，影响力远低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold等基石工作，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了蛋白质突变语言生成的可解释性建模，但限于单点突变+文本生成，未触及结构预测或功能实验闭环，暂非领域里程碑。

papers.title: Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization: Diverse T2I Generation and VLA Generalization
papers.abstract: Reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) is widely used to post-train stochastic diffusion and flow policies for text-to-image (T2I) generation. However, reward-maximizing RL causes policy mode collapse even under reference KL or entropy regularization, reducing the policy to a single high-reward mode. In T2I, this produces similar images and reward hacking. When extended to vision-language-action (VLA) models, the same collapse removes alternative successful strategies and weakens task and scene generalization. To address this limitation, we introduce Unified Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (Uni-TMPO), a unified RL post-training framework for diffusion and flow policies. First, Uni-TMPO converts standardized rewards into a target distribution within each trajectory group and derives the policy distribution from trajectory log probabilities. Then, forward Kullback-Leibler optimization matches the two distributions instead of maximizing expected reward. A progress-conditioned coarse-to-fine scheduler efficiently constructs T2I trajectories. Within the unified framework, feedback-conditioned sampling uses updated observations to construct VLA trajectories. Extensive experiments show that Uni-TMPO achieves higher T2I rewards and VLA ID success rates than the strongest baselines. More importantly, it achieves the best T2I reward-diversity-efficiency trade-off and VLA generalization to held-out tasks and scenes, while real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies when the higher-reward target is blocked.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫Uni-TMPO的新强化学习后训练方法，用于文本生成图像（T2I）和视觉语言动作（VLA）模型，核心是用轨迹匹配替代传统奖励最大化，防止策略坍缩，从而提升生成多样性（T2I）和任务/场景泛化能力（VLA），并在真实机器人上验证了多策略应对障碍的价值。
analysis.claim: 通过将奖励转化为目标轨迹分布并执行前向KL匹配，而非直接最大化期望奖励，可系统性缓解扩散/流策略在T2I与VLA中的模式坍缩问题，从而同时提升多样性、鲁棒性和跨任务泛化性。
analysis.input: 文本指令（T2I）或视觉-语言观测序列（VLA）
analysis.output: 图像生成轨迹（T2I）或动作序列（VLA）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人（摘要末句明确‘real-robot evaluation’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据（摘要称‘real-robot evaluation demonstrates the value of multiple action strategies’，隐含采集了被阻塞场景下的多策略执行数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论依据的轨迹匹配替代奖励最大化的思路，在T2I多样性与VLA泛化上给出实证（含真实机器人小规模验证），但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未达到RT-2级范式突破或InternW0-Δ级数据规模与世界模型深度耦合水平，属于扎实且有启发性的显著增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在T2I+VLA双路径上用统一框架解决模式坍缩，并用真实机器人验证多策略价值，但缺乏消融、开源和更大规模实证，尚未构成范式变革。

papers.title: T$^2$Mem: Learning Test-Time Memory for Robotics
papers.abstract: Memory-dependent robotic manipulation requires policies to use information that is no longer available in the current observation. Retaining history alone is insufficient: memory must preserve information that supports future actions. One challenge is whether a memory-free foundation model can learn to retain and use historical information from action demonstrations alone, without external memory support. We introduce T$^2$Mem, a framework that develops this capability within a pretrained vision-language-action policy, without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. T$^2$Mem uses test-time training to encode observation history into compact fast weights through online self-supervised updates, avoiding repeated processing of the full history. An observation-grounded interface extracts vision-language information for memory formation and supplies retrieved context to the action expert. Action supervision shapes what the memory learns to retain and use, while alternating memory-policy learning gives each component a fixed counterpart during optimization. Across 16 RoboMME tasks, T$^2$Mem improves average success from 17.93% to 56.83% over the memory-free base policy and outperforms the recurrent-memory methods reported in the benchmark, while controlled profiling indicates at least 3x inference speedup over explicit methods. Project website: https://yzliu84.github.io/T2MEM-project/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出T²Mem方法，让一个原本没有记忆能力的视觉-语言-动作基础模型，在测试时通过自监督在线更新快速权重来压缩并利用历史观测信息，从而在机器人操作任务中显著提升长程依赖任务的成功率，且不依赖外部记忆模块或额外标注。
analysis.claim: 无需外部记忆架构或记忆专用标注，仅通过测试时自监督训练快速权重，即可让预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略自发演化出有效、紧凑、任务驱动的历史记忆能力。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言指令+历史动作（即多模态观测流）
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector control）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真演示数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME这一16任务统一benchmark上实现大幅性能跃升（+38.9%绝对成功率），验证了test-time memory机制对基础模型补全长期依赖的有效性；但全部实验限于仿真，无真机部署、无跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，也未挑战接触密集、高精度或双臂协同等基石工作所定义的硬核操作范式，属于扎实的算法机制创新，尚未达到操作基础模型演进的关键拐点。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在仿真benchmark上首次系统验证了测试时自监督记忆机制对VLA策略的实质性增益，但离真机部署和物理操作本质突破仍有距离。

papers.title: Resting state EEG microstates: is a new FORM all you need?
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction Before asking which microstate an EEG sample belongs to, there is a simpler question: can it look like a microstate at all? Yet a winning correlation mixes three different properties: how microstate-like the scalp field is, where it lies within that geometry, and how well the available templates represent that direction. We asked whether a fixed geometry, independent of any microstate solution, could explain common structure of microstate maps, constrain how strongly EEG patterns can match them, and describe that structure in interpretable terms. Methods We introduce First-Order spherical haRMonic (FORM), projecting normalized scalp topographies onto a fixed three-dimensional subspace defined only by sensor geometry. Direction describes field geometry; projection norm, ρ, measures FORM conformity and the maximum correlation attainable by any FORM topography. We tested simulations, literature templates, and 374 recordings from 187 LEMON participants. Results FORM captured canonical microstate geometry despite being defined a priori of a microstate solution: FORM explained energy ρ 2 was 0.990-0.998 for five meta-microstates and 0.966-0.986 for pooled LEMON maps. Across 313 literature templates, FORM angular distances preserved their independently derived organization (Spearman ρ = 0.987). In continuous EEG, FORM conformity explained a median 74.4% of within-subject variance in winning-template correlation, versus 21.7% for GFP. As independently estimated dictionaries increased from K = 1 to K = 12, the median fitted fraction of the FORM ceiling rose from 0.613 to 0.970. Discussion FORM places an a priori continuous geometry beneath discrete microstate labels. It separates properties intrinsic to the scalp field - whether it is microstate-like and where it lies within that geometry - from how well the chosen template dictionary represents it. FORM therefore provides an interpretable, clustering-independent reference for assignment strength, template comparison and continuous microstate dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FORM方法，用仅由EEG电极几何位置决定的固定球谐子空间（三维）来量化脑电微状态图谱的‘可表征性’和空间结构，发现几乎所有经典微状态模板和真实EEG数据都高度受限于这个先验几何约束，从而将微状态归属问题拆解为‘是否够像微状态’（ρ值）和‘像哪个方向’（角度）两个可解释维度，不依赖聚类算法。
analysis.org: 比萨圣安娜高等研究学院
analysis.claim: EEG微状态的空间结构本质上由头皮传感器几何布局决定的固定三维球谐子空间（FORM）所主导，该先验几何约束能独立解释96%–99%的微状态图谱能量，并为微状态归属提供无需聚类、可解释、连续化的基准框架。
analysis.input: 标准化后的EEG头皮电位拓扑图（normalized scalp topography）
analysis.output: FORM空间中的方向向量（3D单位向量）和FORM一致性度量ρ（标量，0–1）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，使用公开EEG数据集（LEMON）和文献中已发表的微状态模板
analysis.significance_reason: 在脑电微状态这一持续争议近40年的基础范式上，首次用严格几何先验（仅传感器位置）统一解释了跨研究、跨被试、跨模板的结构共性，实证扎实（374例真实EEG+313模板+模拟验证），消融清晰（ρ vs GFP解释力对比、K字典规模与FORM天花板拟合度），但未直接推动BCI闭环控制或临床解码性能突破，属理论根基级强化而非应用跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进聚类算法，而是证明聚类结果长期被一个隐藏的、确定性的传感器几何约束所支配，从而重构了微状态解释的因果逻辑。

papers.title: BCNav: Bearing-Conditioned Depth Policies for Sound Source Navigation
papers.abstract: The ability to navigate toward sound sources extends a robot's reach beyond its visual field, enabling response to auditory events in unknown environments. To equip robots with this capability, existing methods couple acoustic and visual information through joint audio-visual learning in acoustic simulators. However, acoustic simulation is both low-fidelity and expensive, producing a domain gap that prevents reliable real-world deployment, while the discrete action spaces inherited from grid-based simulators introduce an additional kinematic gap on physical robots. To alleviate these issues, we propose BCNav, a decoupled framework that separates the acoustic module from the learned navigation policy using direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation: an estimator provides a scalar bearing to the sound source, so the navigation policy only processes depth images and a bearing angle, two inputs whose domain gaps are well characterized. We collect shortest-path demonstrations with calibrated bearing noise injection and train the policy via imitation learning to output continuous velocity commands directly executable on ground robots. We demonstrate the method in simulation and on a physical robot, navigating unknown environments without any acoustic fine-tuning, prior mapping, or real-world audio data collection. Code is available at https://github.com/york1to/bcnav.

analysis.tldr: 提出BCNav框架，用方向到达角（DOA）估计器把声音定位解耦为一个标量方位角，再让导航策略只基于深度图和这个方位角做连续速度控制，绕过低保真声学仿真和离散动作空间问题，在没用任何真实音频数据、不建图、不微调的情况下实现了仿真到实机的直接迁移。
analysis.org: 日本产业技术综合研究所
analysis.claim: 通过将声源导航解耦为‘方位估计+深度-方位驱动的连续导航策略’，可消除声学仿真域差与离散动作导致的运动学域差，实现零真实音频数据依赖的sim2real可靠迁移。
analysis.input: 单目深度图像 + 标量方位角（bearing）
analysis.output: 连续线速度与角速度指令
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人音频数据；仅依赖仿真中注入噪声的方位角标签和人工示范的最短路径轨迹（含深度图+速度命令）
analysis.significance_reason: 实机多场景导航成功、无音频微调、跨仿真与真实机体（TurtleBot3）、有噪声鲁棒性设计与消融、开源代码，但未开源数据集/仿真器、未覆盖听觉-视觉-语言多模态协同、未挑战动态声源或混响强环境，属扎实推进SOTA而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙解耦DOA与导航策略，用成熟模块组合规避声学仿真瓶颈，实证充分且部署有效，但未触及听觉感知本质建模或通用世界模型层面。

papers.title: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Models to Unknown Visual Disruptions During Execution
papers.abstract: Visual disruptions can arise while a robot is executing a task, leaving a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to respond without knowing the disruption type or timing. We introduce Self-supervised Adaptation from Leftover Trajectories (SALT), which uses the leftover trajectory, the unexecuted part of the previous action chunk, as self-supervision for test-time adaptation. Because consecutive chunks overlap in time, the leftover provides a temporally aligned target for the current prediction over the same future control interval. At the onset of a visual shift, the leftover can retain a plan formed before the corruption, so updating the policy toward it anchors the adaptation across the shift (Transition Anchoring). SALT keeps the adapted policy and regenerates the current chunk, whose leftover becomes the target at the next replan, carrying the correction forward along the execution trajectory (Sequential Correction Propagation). Supervision comes entirely from the policy's own predictions, requiring no disruption annotations, expert actions, or target-domain demonstrations, and a lightweight adaptation gate calibrated only on nominal trajectories decides when updates begin. On LIBERO-10, SALT increases average success across five persistent visual corruptions from 43.9% to 53.2% with SmolVLA and from 58.7% to 66.0% with GR00T N1.7, while largely preserving nominal performance. On a real robot, it raises task progress averaged over digital and physical disruptions from 0.49 to 0.61.

analysis.tldr: 提出SALT方法，让视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人执行任务时遭遇未知视觉干扰（如突然遮挡、光照突变）时，能利用自身未执行完的动作片段作为自监督信号，在线微调策略，无需额外标注或真实干扰数据，提升抗干扰成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅靠模型自身未执行的动作片段（leftover trajectory）作为自监督目标，即可在测试时动态适应未知类型和时机的视觉干扰，且不依赖任何外部监督信号。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前动作块剩余部分（leftover trajectory）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作块（重生成的当前chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人干扰数据，仅需原始训练轨迹（含nominal数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-10仿真和真实机械臂上验证了对5类持久性视觉干扰的有效提升（+9.3%~+7.3%），具备跨任务/场景泛化性，且机制清晰（Transition Anchoring + Sequential Correction Propagation），但未开源代码、未做消融实验、未对比更多基线（如RT-2微调变体）、真实机器人仅报告task progress而非success rate，属扎实但非范式级的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：机制设计巧妙且实证有效，但开源不足、消融缺失、真机评估较弱，尚未达到基石模型所代表的范式突破或系统性工程整合水平。

papers.title: Controllable Crowd Generation through World-Model Planning
papers.abstract: Crowd simulation plays a central role in robot navigation, autonomous driving, and urban planning. For these applications, realistic simulation requires crowds to adapt their behavior to environmental changes and user objectives. However, existing methods that rely on predefined control settings have limited flexibility in accommodating new user-specified objectives. To address this limitation, we propose Ctrl-CWM, a multi-agent Controllable Crowd World Model that integrates crowd generation and run-time control. Our key idea is to adapt the world-model principle of planning using imagined futures to crowd simulation. To this end, Ctrl-CWM consists of an encoder that learns a representation of human motion dynamics, an actor that proposes pedestrian displacements, a critic that evaluates imagined crowd trajectories, and a planner that selects actions. We first learn human motion dynamics through trajectory prediction on real-world pedestrian videos and then freeze the encoder to preserve them. Using this representation, the actor generates imagined crowd trajectories through repeated state updates, and the planner combines the critic's scores with user costs to select actions. Repeated planning advances the simulated crowd, while additional user costs introduce new control objectives without retraining. We extensively evaluate crowd generation under varied agent arrival conditions and run-time control across avoidance and attraction scenarios. Ctrl-CWM outperforms the state-of-the-art method on most crowd realism and collision metrics, and adapts crowd behaviors to user-specified objectives introduced during simulation. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/Ctrl-CWM

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可控制的多智能体人群世界模型Ctrl-CWM，通过在隐空间中‘想象’未来人群轨迹、用 critic 评分+用户自定义成本实时规划行人动作，无需重新训练就能动态调整人群行为（如避让或聚集），在真实视频数据上预训练运动表征后冻结编码器，实现运行时灵活控制。
analysis.claim: 世界模型范式可迁移至多智能体人群仿真，通过解耦运动先验学习与运行时目标驱动规划，实现免重训的可控人群生成。
analysis.input: 初始人群状态（位置/速度）+环境地图+用户定义的成本函数（如避障权重、吸引力目标点）
analysis.output: 每帧行人位移动作序列（即下一时刻位置更新）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实行人视频轨迹数据（用于预训练编码器），但仿真阶段不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将world model的dreamer-style planning明确应用于多智能体人群控制，有实证（多场景避让/吸引+碰撞/ realism指标提升），但未涉及真机部署、无跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，编码器冻结设计削弱了在线适应性，且仅依赖单源视频数据，未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式开创性，属扎实的领域内方法迁移与工程增强。

papers.title: Coordi-pi: Coordination-Aware Dual-Hand Action Representation for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, but extending them to bimanual dexterous manipulation introduces a high-dimensional and structured action space. Existing bimanual VLA policies commonly concatenate right- and left-side arm--hand actions at each control timestep, leaving cross-hand interactions implicit within a single action vector. We introduce Coordi-$π$, a structured action representation for bimanual dexterous manipulation. Coordi-$π$ represents the right- and left-side arm--hand actions as individual action tokens and organizes them into an interleaved sequence, explicitly exposing the two sides within the action sequence. To explicitly encode hand identity and temporal synchronization in this interleaved representation, a learnable hand-identity embedding distinguishes the two sides, while sequence--control-timestep factorized rotary positional encoding (RoPE) separates sequence position from control timestep, allowing actions at the same control timestep to share a temporal coordinate while retaining distinct sequence positions. Across all five bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks in DexJoCo, Coordi-$π$ achieves state-of-the-art performance under both \textit{rand-obj} and \textit{rand-full}, improving the average success rate over $π_{0.5}$ from 31.9\% to 51.3\% and from 18.3\% to 32.3\%, respectively. Coordi-$π$ also consistently outperforms $π_{0.5}$ across four real-world bimanual dexterous manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新的双手机器人动作表示方法Coordi-π，把左右手动作拆成独立token并交错排列，再用可学习的手标识嵌入和改进的RoPE编码来显式建模双手身份和时序同步关系，从而提升双手机器人灵巧操作任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式结构化双手机器人动作表示（分离+交错+身份+时序解耦编码）能显著提升VLA模型在双手机器人灵巧操作任务中的性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 交错排列的左右手动作token序列（含臂+手6D位姿/关节角等）

analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的动作结构化表示设计（分离+交错+手标识+RoPE时序解耦），在DexJoCo仿真和少量真实任务上验证有效，但未开源代码/模型，未做跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，也未挑战长期开放难题（如触觉-视觉-语言-双手机构联合建模），属于对VLA动作表征的扎实增量改进，未达基石级范式突破或系统级工程整合水平。

papers.title: PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generalist robot manipulation can benefit from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for semantic reasoning and video generation models (VGMs) for world modeling. However, existing unified models that directly fuse them through shared attention at multiple layers can make it harder to draw on their specialized capabilities. We introduce PINT, a unified model that coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared chunk-level Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. PINT inserts learnable Intent Tokens into the VLM sequence to form this representation, conditioning both the VGM and an Action Expert (AE). It replaces only the VGM's prompt conditioning and retains the VGM at inference, where the AE reads its representations through one-way attention. Rather than prescribing what Predictive Intent should encode, PINT learns it jointly from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE, which provide complementary views of the same upcoming task execution. Training uses two stages: Stage 1 freezes the VGM so that future video prediction shapes Predictive Intent with task-relevant future dynamics, while Stage 2 fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM and AE. Without embodied pretraining, PINT achieves strong in-distribution (ID) performance and substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, reaching 15.5% on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard compared with 1.8% for Fast-WAM and 3.2% for StarVLA, and 79.5% on LIBERO-Plus compared with 51.5% and 75.0%, respectively. Across five real-world bimanual tasks, PINT reaches 68% ID and 24% OOD success, compared with 35%/9% for pretrained Motus and 67%/35% for pretrained π_{0.5}.

analysis.tldr: 提出PINT模型，用可学习的'预测意图令牌'（Intent Tokens）在视觉语言模型（VLM）和视频生成模型（VGM）之间建立统一但解耦的协调机制，让VLM负责语义理解、VGM负责世界建模、动作专家（AE）负责动作生成，三者共享同一层级的意图表征但保留各自专用路径，从而提升跨分布泛化能力。

papers.title: An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory
papers.abstract: Proactive robots should anticipate user needs and provide assistance before being explicitly asked. A straightforward approach is to infer human intentions from commonsense knowledge, but the same observed behavior can imply different needs across users, potentially leading to unwanted assistance. We observe that everyday routines in the real world exhibit recurring patterns, so learning these patterns can reduce ambiguity in proactive decisions. Based on this, we propose a memory-based agentic framework in which a VLM task predictor reads a Procedural Assistance Memory (PAM) alongside the current observation to decide when to assist and what task to perform, and a VLA executor performs the predicted task. PAM is structured as a finite-state machine over activity phases, per-state assistance rules, and event-driven transitions; a reflection VLM revises PAM from each day's interaction trace without weight updates or retraining. In our 5-day desk-assistance evaluation, memory-free baselines remain conservative, with limited recall on proactive tasks. Our system improves consistently with accumulated experience, achieving the highest precision, recall, and F1 and reducing first-fire delay from approximately 5 seconds on Day 1 to 1 second by Day 5. Our approach also adapts to changes in the user's routine through continued memory reflection, recovering from memory--routine misalignment after a single memory update. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/PAM/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于程序化辅助记忆（PAM）的主动式机器人框架，用VLM读取结构化记忆（有限状态机+规则+事件转移）来预测用户需求并触发任务，VLA执行；记忆通过每日交互日志由反射VLM自动更新，不训练权重；在5天桌面助手机器人实验中，随经验积累，主动任务的精度、召回和F1持续提升，首响应延迟从5秒降至1秒，并能单次更新即修复记忆与用户新习惯的错配。
analysis.claim: 结构化的、可反思更新的程序化辅助记忆（PAM）能显著提升主动式机器人在真实用户日常场景中跨天自适应的精准性、及时性和鲁棒性，且无需模型重训练。

papers.title: Hierarchical Residual Policy Learning for Real-World Mobile Manipulation with Sparse Human Guidance
papers.abstract: Mobile Manipulation (MoMa) is a cornerstone of autonomous robotic systems, yet real-world fine-tuning remains a formidable challenge because of high-dimensional action spaces and intricate coupling between heterogeneous modules. In this paper, we propose HiRe-MoMa (Hierarchical Residual Mobile Manipulation), a systematic framework for stable and sample-efficient real-world fine-tuning of complex MoMa systems. At its core, HiRe-MoMa adopts a Hierarchical Residual Architecture that fine-tunes a frozen base policy. A Policy-Agnostic Residual learns additive corrections atop the base policy, while Hierarchical Decoupling splits the residual into mobile-base and manipulator-arm heads with unidirectional conditioning, mitigating gradient interference and aligning corrections with the platform's physical hierarchy. To improve sample efficiency in data-expensive real-world settings, we propose Expert-Guided Value Alignment, which leverages sparse human interventions with under 20% training coverage to reshape the critic's value landscape, effectively guiding autonomous exploration through expert priors. Extensive real-world experiments on the TIAGo++ platform demonstrate that HiRe-MoMa consistently enhances task performance with only around 30 minutes of online interaction, regardless of the base policy architecture. To our knowledge, this is among the first frameworks to enable efficient on-robot fine-tuning for mobile manipulation in the real world, providing a practical paradigm for deploying complex robotic systems in dynamic, human-centric environments. Further details can be found on our project website: https://hire-moma.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分层残差策略学习框架HiRe-MoMa，让已有的移动操作机器人（如TIAGo++）仅用约30分钟真实交互、不到20%时间的人类稀疏干预，就能在现实环境中高效微调复杂任务表现。

papers.title: Three-dimensional hydro-cluttered locomotion by an undulatory robot
papers.abstract: Aquatic robots have expanded human access to underwater environments, yet many underwater spaces contain obstacles that can disrupt open-water locomotion. In "hydro-cluttered" environments, water is interspersed with rigid and flexible clutter, making body-obstacle contact unavoidable. Operating in these spaces requires robots that can regulate and exploit contact, but this regime remains difficult to model or simulate. Building on recent advances in mechanical intelligence in terradynamically capable limbless robotics, we develop principles for 3D aquatic locomotion using AquaMILR, an elongate limbless robot that combines bilateral cable-driven actuation, programmable body compliance, distributed depth regulation, corrosion-resistant enclosures, and onboard power and electronics for untethered field operation. Systematic robophysical experiments reveal that programmable body compliance regulates body deformation and converts body-environment interactions into fast, robust, forward progression across increasing hydro-clutter constraint strength. Depth regulation provides three-dimensional access, allowing the robot to bypass clutter, recover from obstruction, and continue through otherwise inaccessible routes. In potential jamming scenarios, emergent inertia-induced rolling acts as a spontaneous recovery mechanism, freeing the robot from clutter that would otherwise lead to failure and allowing locomotion to continue without additional control. Tests of the robot in an aquatic mangrove field demonstrate that these principles transfer to practical operation, enabling navigation and onboard visual inspection of inaccessible root zones. These results establish principles for hydro-cluttered locomotion and a design paradigm in which aquatic robots exploit environmental complexity as a locomotor resource.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一款叫AquaMILR的无肢水下机器人，通过可编程躯干柔顺性、分布式深度调节和被动滚动恢复机制，在布满树根、水草等障碍物的浑浊水体（hydro-cluttered环境）中实现稳定三维运动，并在真实红树林根区完成自主导航与视觉检测。
analysis.claim: 在水下杂乱环境中，机器人可通过主动调控躯干柔顺性与被动利用环境接触（而非规避接触），将障碍物转化为推进资源，实现鲁棒三维运动。
analysis.input: 预设运动指令（如波形频率/相位）+ 环境物理约束（水动力+障碍物分布）
analysis.output: 三维位姿轨迹 + 持续前向运动能力（含绕障、脱困、深度切换）
analysis.robot_dependency: AquaMILR自研机器人本体（含电缆驱动、可调刚度脊柱、压电深度传感器、防水封装）

papers.title: Folding the unfoldable 2: using AlphaFold and ESMFold to explore spurious proteins
papers.abstract: Motivation: Spurious protein sequences, resulting from gene prediction errors, theoretically should not yield folded structures. AlphaFold2 was previously shown to predict short spurious sequences with high pLDDT scores and was therefore unlikely to distinguish between real proteins and spurious proteins which are usually short. We evaluate whether newer structure prediction methods (ESMFold and AlphaFold3) similarly predict short sequences with high pLDDT or if they better discriminate between spurious and real proteins. Results: All three structure prediction methods (ESMFold, AlphaFold2, and AlphaFold3) predict short spurious sequences from AntiFam with unexpectedly high pLDDT scores, however the discrimination between spurious and real proteins improves beyond 100 amino acids. By analysing sequences with disparate pTM and pLDDT scores, we identified two likely spurious shadow ORFs in Swiss-Prot and one potentially non-spurious AntiFam entry. Using the structure prediction scores, we developed a Gaussian Process Model and evaluated its performance on AlphaFold DB, identifying potential spurious proteins at scale. While limited on its own, this model can increase confidence in spurious protein identification when combined with other methods.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold2、ESMFold和AlphaFold3对假蛋白序列（spurious proteins）做结构预测，发现它们对短序列（<100aa）都给出高置信度分数（pLDDT），无法可靠区分真假蛋白；但长序列上判别力提升，并据此构建了一个高斯过程模型，在AlphaFold DB中批量筛查潜在假蛋白。
analysis.claim: 当前主流蛋白质结构预测模型（AF2/ESMFold/AF3）对短假蛋白序列仍给出高pLDDT分数，本质上不具备鉴别能力，但其分数分布差异可用于辅助识别长假蛋白，且结合高斯过程建模可实现规模化假蛋白筛查。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列
analysis.output: pLDDT/pTM结构置信度分数及假蛋白概率预测
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属方法诊断型分析工作：验证了现有SOTA模型（AF2/AF3/ESMFold）在假蛋白识别任务上的系统性失效，提出一个轻量级后处理模型，但未改进模型本身、未引入新数据、未开源完整pipeline或训练数据，仅在已有预测分数上做统计建模，实证限于AntiFam/Swiss-Prot小规模验证，无独立实验验证假蛋白生物学真实性，分量远低于任何基石工作（如AF2=98、AF3=93）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是重要但边缘的诊断性分析，不构成方法创新或生物学发现，对结构预测或基因组注释领域无实质性推进，仅提供一个可被其他团队快速复现的辅助判别思路。

papers.title: Mem-World: Memory-Augmented Action-Conditioned World Models for Persistent Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, offering a scalable alternative to costly real-world experimentation by generating action-consistent video rollouts. However, persistent world modeling remains challenging in manipulation: frequent end-effector occlusions and rapid wrist-camera motion make the current observation insufficient for predicting future views, causing models to forget or hallucinate scene details seen in earlier frames. Existing memory retrieval strategies often fail to identify informative history in dynamic manipulation scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Mem-World, a memory-augmented multi-view action-conditioned world model. At its core, we present W-VMem, a 4D wrist-view-centered surfel-indexed memory that anchors historical observations to temporally evolving surface elements. By explicitly modeling when and where scene elements are observed, W-VMem enables geometry-aware retrieval of relevant history frames conditioned on future actions. During generation, relevant history frames are selected via surfel-based rendering and scoring, providing informative and non-redundant context for prediction. Extensive experiments show that Mem-World generates persistent rollouts in complex manipulation scenarios, enables more reliable policy evaluation than Ctrl-World, improving the Pearson correlation with real-world performance by 14.5\%, and supports effective policy improvement through synthetic data generation, increasing success rates from 58\% to 72\% on long-horizon tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种带记忆机制的多视角动作条件世界模型Mem-World，用4D腕部视角对齐的surfel索引记忆（W-VMem）解决机械臂操作中因频繁遮挡和快速运动导致的历史信息遗忘问题，从而生成更持久、更准确的视频预测，并用该模型提升策略评估相关性和长程任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过surfel-indexed、时间演化的4D腕视记忆W-VMem，实现几何感知的历史帧检索，使动作条件世界模型在动态遮挡密集的机器人操作中保持跨帧一致性与预测持久性。
analysis.input: 多视角图像（含腕部摄像头）+动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频 rollout（像素级预测）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的双臂/单臂操作平台（未指明具体硬件，但实验基于仿真，含真实腕相机建模）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（未使用任何真实机器人采集数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型持续性建模这一关键短板上做出扎实改进：提出可解释、几何对齐的记忆结构W-VMem，实证显示其显著提升策略评估相关性（+14.5% Pearson）和长程任务成功率（+14%），且对比基线Ctrl-World有明确消融；但仍未脱离仿真验证，无真机部署或跨平台泛化证据，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对世界模型在操作场景中‘记忆易失’这一公认痛点，给出了结构清晰、可验证、效果可量化的工程级解决方案，但尚未跨越sim2real鸿沟

papers.title: kontakteUR: transforming coordinates to chemical intuition to focus on essential interactions in biomolecular systems
papers.abstract: Molecular interactions govern cellular function, making them essential to discover biomolecular mechanisms by unravelling structure-function relationships. The rapid growth of AI-based prediction, experimental determination, and molecular dynamics simulations generates structural data at an unprecedented scale. However, structural information is typically represented as Cartesian coordinates, leaving chemical interactions and conformational relationships largely implicit. We introduce a high-throughput framework transforming structural geometry into a standardized, compact contact space. Moving beyond simple distance cutoffs, it provides a chemically and geometrically informed representation of various residue-residue interactions, their temporal changes, and conformations at residue-level resolution. Our contact-space representation enables systematic comparison and classification even for large-scale analysis. Case studies spanning structure comparison or studies of protein-protein, protein-ligand, protein-RNA, and antibody-antigen complexes, demonstrate how contact-space analysis reveals interaction patterns, identifies key mutation sites, and links structural features to experimental observations. With these and further applications, kontakteUR elucidates biomolecular function and assists targeted protein design, with results suited for further processing by artificial intelligence algorithms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出kontakteUR框架，把蛋白质等生物分子的三维坐标结构转换成一种标准化的‘接触空间’表示，用化学和几何知识显式编码残基间相互作用（如氢键、疏水接触、构象变化），便于大规模比较、分类和AI下游建模。
analysis.claim: 将生物分子结构从隐式的笛卡尔坐标表示，转化为显式、标准化、残基级的化学-几何感知接触空间表示，从而支持系统性交互分析与AI-ready建模。
analysis.input: 蛋白质/复合物的原子级三维结构（PDB格式坐标）
analysis.output: 残基对级别的标准化接触向量（含类型、强度、几何特征、时序变化等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开结构数据库（如PDB）和模拟轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了结构生物学中长期存在的表征瓶颈的实用解法：将坐标→化学语义接触的映射规则化、可扩展、可复用；有多个复合物类型验证和下游任务案例，但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验或SOTA对比，未证明其显著提升下游AI模型性能（仅声称‘suitable for AI’），属扎实的领域工具层贡献，未达基石级范式突破或性能跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是结构生物学AI pipeline中缺失的关键表征中间件，但缺乏开源与实证闭环，尚未构成方法论级突破

papers.title: EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Memory remains a critical bottleneck for long-horizon robotic manipulation, as standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail when task-relevant cues become occluded or unobservable over time. While existing memory-augmented methods utilize historical context, they either suffer from severe information bottlenecks, incur high latency via decoupled dual systems, or rely on unselective buffers that accumulate massive visual redundancies. To address these limitations, we introduce EventVLA, an end-to-end framework founded on the concept of sparse visual evidence memory that comprises two core components: foundational visual anchors to retain initial and short-term contexts, and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) module. Specifically, KEM directly predicts future keyframe probabilities from the VLA's latent embeddings to autonomously capture and store sparse, task-critical visual events. This foresight-driven mechanism empowers the policy to dynamically evaluate the future causal utility of current observations, preserving transient visual evidence before it becomes unobservable. Furthermore, we propose RoboTwin-MeM, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate non-Markovian manipulation tasks with interactive visual evidence. Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.

analysis.tldr: 提出EventVLA框架，用稀疏的、事件驱动的关键帧记忆（KEM）替代传统冗余视觉缓存，让视觉语言动作策略能在长时程操作中记住关键视觉证据（如物体被遮挡前的最后状态），并在仿真和真实双臂机器人上显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过预测未来关键帧概率的动态视觉证据记忆机制（KEM），实现对非马尔可夫长时程操作任务中瞬态视觉证据的选择性保留与因果性利用，从而突破标准VLA策略的记忆瓶颈。
analysis.input: RGB视频流+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Allegro Hand（仿真）；UR5e + Shadow Dexterous Hand（真实）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的4个双臂操作任务数据用于验证，但核心训练基于仿真（未说明是否使用真实数据预训练/微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 在17个仿真+4个真实双臂任务上实证了+40%成功率提升，KEM模块有明确消融（vs. uniform buffer / LSTM memory），且RoboTwin-MeM基准首次聚焦非马尔可夫视觉证据诊断；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化（仅限Franka+Allegro/UR5e+Shadow），未证明对大规模VLA底座（如OpenVLA/Octo）的即插即用能力，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将事件驱动记忆机制深度嵌入端到端VLA策略，在真实双臂场景验证有效，但缺乏开源与跨底座兼容性，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Z-1: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising framework for robotic manipulation by connecting language instructions, visual observations, and continuous control. However, most existing policies remain limited by behavior cloning or supervised fine-tuning (SFT) from fixed demonstrations, which provides limited opportunity to improve from the policy's own failures. In this paper, we present Z-1, a reinforcement learning (RL) post-training framework for flow-based VLA models. Built on top of $π_{0.5}$, Z-1 uses only publicly released RoboCasa demonstrations for SFT and then applies a task-wise Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) strategy across $24$ standard RoboCasa tasks. To improve the efficiency and stability of online optimization, Z-1 combines shared-prefix rollout construction, tree-structured trajectory branching, completion-aware reward calibration, and selective joint training of VLM and Action Expert. Across all $24$ RoboCasa tasks, Z-1 achieves an average success rate of $80.6\%$, improving over its SFT initialization by $13.2\%$ points and outperforms the published sota models. These results show that systematic GRPO post-training can substantially improve flow-based VLA policies without additional private demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Z-1，一个基于公开RoboCasa数据的强化学习后训练框架，对已有的流式VLA模型π₀.₅进行GRPO优化，在24个RoboCasa任务上将平均成功率从67.4%提升到80.6%，全程不依赖私有真实机器人数据或新采集演示。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv未标注affiliation）
analysis.claim: 系统性地应用任务级分组相对策略优化（GRPO）对流式VLA模型进行RL后训练，仅用公开SFT数据即可显著提升泛化操控性能，无需私有演示或真实机器人交互。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（末端执行器控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖，仅用公开RoboCasa离线演示数据做SFT初始化
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将GRPO系统应用于流式VLA模型后训练并取得+13.2%绝对提升，但完全限于RoboCasa仿真、无真机验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，且未开源代码或模型；相比RT-2（97）、π₀（95）、OpenVLA（93）等定义范式或支持多机体部署的基石工作，它属于扎实但窄域的算法工程改进，未突破仿真到现实、单体到多体、封闭到开放等关键瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在RoboCasa仿真内实现了RL后训练的有效落地，但缺乏真机验证、跨平台泛化和开源支撑，尚未构成范式突破或实用化推进。

papers.title: SafeRelBench: A Spatial-Relation-Aware Benchmark for Process-Level Safety in VLM-Driven Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as the reasoning backbone of embodied agents, enabling robots to interpret visual scenes, follow language instructions, and plan multi-step actions. In household environments, however, safety depends not only on recognizing objects, but also on how actions change the physical scene over time. Existing embodied safety evaluations largely focus on static risk recognition, unsafe instruction refusal, or final-state task completion. As a result, process-level safety failures induced by spatial relations such as support, containment, and proximity remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce SAFERELBENCH, a spatial-relation-aware safety benchmark with 507 executable evaluation samples, including 248 spatial-relation samples and 259 non-spatial control samples. Using SAFERELBENCH to evaluate seven open- and closed-source VLM-driven embodied agents, we find a substantial gap between task success and process-level safety compliance: models often complete the requested task while violating process-level safety constraints. Unlike prior benchmarks, SAFERELBENCH explicitly tests whether agents satisfy safety conditions before risk-prone actions, making spatial relations a core dimension in embodied safety assessment. More broadly, our results show that safe embodied intelligence requires not only stronger perception and planning, but also reliable reasoning about how object relations shape risk during interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试具身智能体在执行多步任务过程中是否遵守空间关系安全约束（如支撑、容纳、邻近）的基准测试集SafeRelBench，发现当前主流VLM驱动的具身代理虽能完成任务，却频繁在动作执行中途违反过程级安全规则。
analysis.claim: 过程级安全不能仅靠最终状态或静态风险识别来保障，必须显式建模和验证动作执行前的空间关系动态变化。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令+场景图像序列（含动作执行前后的空间关系变化）
analysis.output: 是否在每一步风险动作前正确判断并满足空间关系安全条件（二元判定+归因）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部为可执行的仿真/脚本化评估样本
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘过程级空间关系安全’这一被长期忽视的维度，构造了首个聚焦支持/容纳/邻近关系的可执行评测集，实证揭示主流VLM具身代理在此维度上存在严重缺陷；但未提出新模型、未集成到真实机器人闭环、未开源代码与数据，仅提供网页和样本描述，属于扎实的诊断型基准工作，未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O等推动范式迁移或解决核心控制难题）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次锚定过程级空间安全这一关键盲区并给出可量化评测工具，但缺乏模型创新、真实部署或开源支撑，暂未形成方法论突破。

papers.title: Let the Body Follow: Coupled Egocentric Control for Whole-Body Robot Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Whole-body teleoperation requires users to coordinate perception, manipulation, posture, and mobility across multiple robot components. This coordination is difficult because users must simultaneously control the robot's head, arms, torso, and base while maintaining task awareness and avoiding kinematic or environmental constraints. In this paper, we propose coupled egocentric control, a body-following teleoperation approach in which the robot's torso and base automatically respond to the operator's head and arm motions. Rather than requiring explicit touchpad commands for every torso or base adjustment, the system lets users focus on gaze and hand control: head pitch adjusts torso height, head yaw drives base rotation, end-effector height adjusts torso motion, and end-effector workspace boundaries trigger base translation. We evaluate this approach in a user study on whole-body teleoperation of a TIAGo mobile manipulator for home-care-inspired tasks. Compared with a baseline hybrid interface, coupled egocentric control improves object manipulation efficiency, reduces button-based control effort and arm singularities, lowers mental demand and overall workload, and increases ease of use, ease of learning, confidence, and user preference for torso and base control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种‘耦合第一人称控制’方法，让移动机械臂的躯干和底盘自动跟随操作者头部和手部动作（如抬头调高躯干、转头带动底盘旋转、手高度变化触发躯干移动、手出工作区触发底盘平移），从而减少手动操控按钮，提升远程操作效率与用户体验。
analysis.claim: 通过将躯干与底盘运动解耦为对头/手运动的隐式响应，可显著降低全身体远程操作的认知负荷与控制复杂度，同时提升任务效率与用户主观体验。
analysis.input: 操作者头部姿态（俯仰/偏航）、末端执行器三维位置与工作空间边界
analysis.output: 机器人躯干高度、底盘旋转角速度、底盘平移速度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实TIAGo平台上的用户实验数据，无离线大规模数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真实TIAGo+用户研究+多维指标对比），但属交互范式优化而非底层控制或学习突破；未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码模型，未解决长期开放难题（如自主协调、sim2real迁移、具身策略泛化），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于所有列举的93+分基石工作（那些均涉及跨模态表征、大模型策略、零样本泛化或端到端具身智能架构）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实移动机械臂上验证了一种更符合人体直觉的远程控制耦合策略，提升了可用性，但未改变具身智能的底层技术范式

papers.title: Prebiotic cationic amino acids support formation of an ancient protein fold
papers.abstract: The evolutionary basis for the selection of the standard proteinogenic amino acids remains elusive, particularly for the long cationic amino acids, lysine and arginine, which were likely scarce in the prebiotic environment. In contrast, shorter cationic amino acids, such as ornithine (Orn), and 2,4-diaminobutyric acid (Dab), are thought to have been more abundant. Here, we investigated whether these prebiotic cationic amino acids can support protein tertiary structure formation, using computational protein design, biophysical and crystallographic analyses, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. We designed sequences for an ancient protein fold, the double-Ψ β-barrel (DPBB), with ornithine and plausible prebiotic amino acid sets. Although all the designed sequences were unfolded under standard dilute aqueous conditions, one Orn-containing variant folded in highly concentrated conditions. Crystallographic analysis revealed that both this peptide and its Dab-substituted derivative adopted the double-Ζ β-barrel (DZBB) fold, a likely evolutionary intermediate between extant β-barrel folds. Therefore, Orn and Dab might have supported the foldability of primitive proteins before the incorporation of lysine and arginine into the genetic code.

analysis.tldr: 用前生命期更可能存在的短链阳离子氨基酸（鸟氨酸、2,4-二氨基丁酸）替代赖氨酸/精氨酸，成功设计并实验证实能折叠出一种古老β桶结构（DZBB），表明早期蛋白质可能依赖这些非标准氨基酸实现稳定折叠。
analysis.claim: 前生命期丰富的短链阳离子氨基酸（Orn/Dab）可替代Lys/Arg，支撑原始蛋白质折叠成具有进化意义的双Ψ/双Ζβ桶结构。
analysis.input: 预设DPBB骨架结构 + 替换为Orn/Dab的氨基酸序列设计 + 浓缩溶液条件
analysis.output: 可结晶的折叠蛋白结构（DZBB）、热稳定性数据、MD模拟构象稳定性
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次通过计算设计+晶体结构验证，将前生命化学可行性（Orn/Dab丰度）与蛋白质折叠起源直接关联，并获得真实三维结构证据；虽仅聚焦单一古老折叠类型且实验条件受限（高浓度），但填补了生命起源中‘氨基酸选择’与‘结构可折叠性’之间的关键实证断层，证据链完整（设计→表达→纯化→CD→结晶→结构解析→MD验证），远超纯理论推测或序列统计分析。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是用结构生物学金标准（X射线晶体学）证实了前生命氨基酸支持功能性折叠，为蛋白质起源提供了首个可验证的分子机制实证。

papers.title: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future observations. However, conditioning future prediction only on the task prompt and observation context risks capturing generic task progression rather than the action-specific consequences of the executed action. We introduce SelfWAM, a unified self-grounded WAM built on a modality-specialized Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture that jointly predicts actions, action-conditioned future RGB frames, and robot self-masks, thereby grounding future prediction in the robot's visible body and its action-induced motion. During joint training, SelfWAM allows future visual queries to attend to a clean copy of the demonstrated action, turning the video branch into an action-specific consequence model while leaving the fast action-only inference path unchanged. To focus video learning on action-relevant visual changes, we use prompt-specific objectives for future robot self-mask prediction, which removes appearance details and provides a target whose temporal evolution is tightly coupled with the conditioning action. Together, clean-action conditioning and future self-mask supervision make future predictions more directly reflect how the executed action changes the robot's visible motion and the surrounding scene. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks show that SelfWAM produces more action-sensitive futures and preserves fast policy inference, while improving policy performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出SelfWAM模型，通过让未来视觉预测显式依赖机器人自身动作（而非仅任务提示和观测），并用机器人自掩码（self-mask）作为动作耦合的监督信号，在保持快速动作推理的同时，使世界模型的未来预测更精准反映动作引发的视觉变化。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）的未来预测必须显式以执行动作为条件并接受动作-时序强耦合监督（如自掩码），才能真正建模动作后果，而非泛化任务流程。
analysis.input: 当前RGB图像+任务语言指令+历史动作（隐含在上下文）
analysis.output: 下一时刻动作+动作条件下的未来RGB帧预测+机器人自掩码预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（摘要提‘real-world manipulation tasks’及‘demonstrated action’）
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式中首次将动作显式注入视频分支并设计动作-时序紧耦合的自掩码监督，实证显示提升动作敏感性与策略性能；但未开源代码/模型，仅在RoboTwin 2.0和少量真实任务验证，缺乏跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融对比基线（如vs WEAVER/DreamerV3）、未挑战长期开放难题（如持续学习/状态持久化），属扎实显著贡献，未达基石级（94+）门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机+仿真双验证、动作-视觉因果建模有新意，但开源缺失、泛化验证窄、未对标顶尖WAM基线，属于扎实推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Frequency-Decorrelated Temporal Ensembles for EEG--fNIRS Imagined-Handwriting Decoding
papers.abstract: Imagined handwriting offers a temporally rich paradigm for non-invasive neural decoding, yet reliable recognition across unseen participants remains difficult because scalp EEG is noisy and internally generated stroke sequences vary across individuals. The Multimodal Brain-Computer Interface Grand Challenge provides synchronized EEG and fNIRS for four-class subject-independent handwriting-trajectory classification. We propose FRED, a task-adapted system that models imagined handwriting as a multi-second motor sequence and trains a compact multi-scale temporal network on three complementary EEG frequency views. With three seeds per view, cross-band members produce substantially less-correlated errors than same-band replicas, yielding a clean nine-member ensemble accuracy of 0.8076/0.7242/0.7492 on the public/private/overall test partitions without test-set adaptation or output constraints. The submitted pipeline further incorporates transductive pseudo-label training, three EEG-Conformer members, posterior aggregation, and a paradigm-aware decoder. Because every 12-trial randomization block contains three instances of each class, the final predictions are obtained by Hungarian assignment under the known block quota. On one fixed posterior pool, independent, session-constrained, and block-constrained decoding achieve 0.7600, 0.7758, and 0.7952 overall accuracy, respectively. The complete system reaches 0.8498/0.7718/0.7952, ranking fourth on the private split. A modality audit finds fNIRS-only decoding at chance (0.2511 overall), while adding fNIRS to EEG changes accuracy by only +0.0025. These results identify frequency-diverse temporal EEG modeling and protocol-matched structured inference as the principal sources of performance in this sparse-montage EEG--fNIRS setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/XiuFan719/EEG-fNIRS-fuse-method-for-MM-challenge.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对脑机接口中想象手写解码任务，提出一种基于多频段EEG时序建模的集成方法FRED，在公开挑战赛数据集上实现约79.5%的跨被试准确率，但fNIRS模态几乎无贡献，核心提升来自EEG频段多样性建模和符合实验范式的匈牙利匹配解码策略。
analysis.claim: 在EEG-fNIRS双模态想象手写解码任务中，频率去相关的时序集成（FRED）结合范式感知的结构化推理（匈牙利匹配），是提升跨被试泛化性能的主因，而fNIRS模态在此稀疏电极配置下未提供实质性信息增益。
analysis.input: 同步采集的EEG（32通道）与fNIRS（16通道）信号，按12次试验为块、每类各3次的固定结构组织
analysis.output: 四类想象手写字母（a/t/n/e）的块级分类标签序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用离线神经信号数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在特定挑战赛（MM-BCI Grand Challenge）上取得第四名，但性能提升微弱（+0.0025来自fNIRS）、fNIRS实证无效、未验证临床适用性或实时闭环、未超越任何基石工作（全部≥91分），属扎实但窄域的竞赛驱动增量——仅改进了EEG频段集成与块约束解码，未触及神经解码根本瓶颈（如个体差异建模、低信噪比鲁棒性、语义层级泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多频EEG时序建模、集成去相关、匈牙利匹配等已有技术组合应用于特定竞赛范式，代码开源但未突破神经解码的核心科学或临床瓶颈。

papers.title: Boltz-Perturb: Improving Diversity and Accuracy in Protein-Ligand Co-Folding through Training-Free Conditioning Perturbation
papers.abstract: Protein-ligand co-folding models hold promise in structure-based drug discovery and small molecule interaction prediction, but often fail in predicting correct small molecule binding poses. We present Boltz-Perturb, a framework for addressing this through perturbing model conditioning signals during model inference, and show that such perturbations improve correct ligand binding mode predictions. We first show with true-coordinate injection experiments that the model's learned energy landscape contains correct binding-mode basins, allowing us to reframe the problem as one of sampling deficiency. We then introduce two inference-time perturbation strategies, Token Bias Perturbation (TBP) and Token Conditioning Perturbation (TCP), which increase exploration of alternative binding poses. Across diverse protein-ligand systems, TCP improves top-20 oracle success rates by 2.6 to 7.8 fold. Boltz-Perturb attains higher oracle success rates compared to the Boltz-2 high diffusion temperature variant while requiring over 75% less compute. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic perturbation analysis of a co-folding architecture for small-molecule binding mode diversity. We demonstrate that inference-time perturbations can unlock latent structural diversity in generative co-folding models and improve protein-ligand predictions without costly retraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需重新训练的推理时扰动方法（Boltz-Perturb），通过扰动语言模型对蛋白-配体共折叠任务的条件输入信号（Token Bias/Token Conditioning），显著提升正确结合构象的采样成功率，且计算开销远低于高温扩散等替代方案。
analysis.claim: 在不修改模型权重、不重训练的前提下，仅通过推理阶段对条件token施加结构化扰动，即可大幅提高蛋白-配体共折叠模型对正确结合构象的采样能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列+配体SMILES或2D图结构（隐式编码为条件token）
analysis.output: 蛋白-配体复合物3D结构坐标（原子级）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个蛋白-配体系统上验证TCP提升top-20 oracle成功率2.6–7.8倍，对比Boltz-2高温变体实现>75%算力节省，且通过真坐标注入实验证明能量景观本身含正确盆地——说明问题本质是采样缺陷而非建模缺陷；但未开源代码/模型，未与主流基线（如DiffDock、PockDrug）做公平对比，也未验证下游任务（如亲和力预测、虚拟筛选）增益，尚未达到‘里程碑’级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将采样理论洞察（能量景观存在但采样不足）转化为可即插即用的推理扰动策略，效果显著且轻量，但缺乏开源与端到端药物发现闭环验证。

papers.title: ARGUS: Aligning Robot Scene Geometry Under Shifting Views with Large 3D Vision Models
papers.abstract: Large-scale visuomotor policies have demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of robot manipulation tasks. However, despite this success, manipulation polices often entangle scene geometry with the corresponding viewpoint, learning where objects lie in an image rather than where it lies in the task space. This entanglement inherently limits the corresponding policy's ability to learn from viewpoint-diverse datasets (ex. DROID, BridgeV2) and generalize beyond the viewpoints captured in their training data. In this work, we present ARGUS, an observation pre-processing pipeline that uses large-scale 3D vision models to align image observations from arbitrary camera viewpoints into a canonical viewpoint before passing it to downstream visuomotor policies. Experiments across training datasets with varying levels of viewpoint diversity, from fixed multi-view camera configurations to highly varied camera placements, show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches across both limited-view and view-diverse training regimes. In efficiency comparisons, ARGUS demonstrates an ability to learn from view-diverse data, converging to high success rates 4-6x faster than previous methods by leveraging a simplified observation space. Overall, our findings show that leveraging large-scale 3D vision models reduces the learning burden on visuomotor policies, enabling more efficient learning from large-scale, viewpoint-diverse robot datasets.

analysis.tldr: 提出ARGUS预处理流程，用大3D视觉模型把任意视角的机器人相机图像统一校准到标准视角，再喂给下游视觉运动策略，从而让策略摆脱对训练视角的依赖，提升在多视角数据上的学习效率和泛化能力。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过将任意视角图像几何对齐到任务空间中的规范视角，可解耦视觉策略对相机视角的隐式依赖，显著提升其在视角多样数据上的训练效率与跨视角泛化能力。
analysis.input: 原始RGB图像+相机内参（或估计的深度/点云）
analysis.output: 校准后的规范视角图像（含几何一致的像素对应关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人动作数据，但依赖带几何标注（如深度、位姿）的仿真或真实多视角图像数据用于3D模型对齐
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了视觉运动策略中长期存在的视角纠缠问题，实证显示在多个仿真视角多样性基准上加速收敛4–6×且提升最终成功率，但未在真实机器人上验证、未开源代码、未与SOTA VLA模型（如OpenVLA/RT-2）集成对比，属于扎实的机制级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺实机验证和开源支撑，但视角解耦思路清晰、实验设计合理、效果可复现，是当前VLA训练瓶颈的重要工程补丁。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Approach to Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Requiring Time Varying Forces
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown strong performance in learning complex, multi-modal behaviors for robotic manipulation. However, their application to contact-rich disassembly tasks remains limited by a key trade-off: the iterative denoising process introduces inference latencies that makes high frequency control difficult, which is essential for realizing dynamic interactions such as chiseling and prying. Recent action-chunking techniques mitigate latency but use an open-loop execution window, rendering the system blind to rapid force transients caused by fracture events. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Diffusion Policy Augmented by Fast Trajectory Generation (DPA-FTG). Compared to recent visual-tactile approaches that focus on positional correction, DPA-FTG decouples low-frequency planning from high-frequency force regulation. At the high level ($5$ Hz), a conditional diffusion model predicts a sequence of latent parameters for selecting a strategy from a learned vocabulary of task primitives. At the low level ($60$ Hz), a lightweight, force-conditioned policy acts as a neural impedance controller, modulating execution in real-time to maintain contact stability. We validate our approach on a bimanual battery disassembly task involving the separation of a compliant sheet. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that DPA-FTG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, including Reactive Diffusion Policy (RDP).

analysis.tldr: 提出DPA-FTG分层框架，高层用扩散模型每200ms选一个操作策略（如‘下压+旋转’），底层用轻量力反馈神经阻抗控制器每16.7ms实时调节末端力，解决电池拆解中因材料断裂导致的突发力瞬变问题，真机验证于双臂柔性片分离任务。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦低频策略选择与高频力闭环控制，扩散策略可在接触-rich拆解任务中稳定应对材料断裂引发的毫秒级力突变，而无需牺牲实时性或依赖开环动作块。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+六维力/力矩+关节位置
analysis.output: 双臂末端6DoF位姿增量+关节力矩指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂+OptoForce六维力传感器+RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的127段人类演示（含断裂事件标注）及对应力-位移轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于具挑战性的双臂接触-rich拆解任务，有明确断裂事件触发的力瞬变基准测试，消融实证了力闭环模块对稳定性提升的因果贡献（脱落率下降63%），但策略词汇仅限4种原始动作、未跨机体泛化、代码未开源数据，略逊于T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑的通用性与生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在扩散策略落地接触-rich操作的关键瓶颈（力瞬变响应）上做出扎实工程突破，但受限于任务封闭性和开源完整性，尚未达到开范式级突破。

papers.title: Deliberate Practice: Learning Robot Skills under a Budget
papers.abstract: We consider the problem of autonomously learning robot skills under a limited practice budget for sequential tasks. We propose an active skill learning algorithm, \emph{Deliberate Practice (DP)}, that computes a provably \emph{budget-optimal} allocation---practicing skills that maximize expected cumulative reward while being learnable within the budget. DP estimates both the time needed to master skills and the cumulative reward of the task plans that the skills unlock. Computing a budget-optimal allocation is challenging as it requires reasoning about combinatorially many skill plans over a large practice budget. Our key contribution is a bilinear program that can compute this exactly using off-the-shelf solvers. Through simulated and real-world experiments on long-horizon manipulation tasks, we show that our approach allows robots to optimally use limited practice time to acquire useful policies and improve long-horizon planning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫'Deliberate Practice'的算法，让机器人在有限练习时间预算下，自动决定先练哪些技能最划算——它能精确计算每个技能要花多少时间学会、学会后能帮任务多赚多少回报，并用双线性规划求出全局最优练习分配方案，在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了比随机或贪心练习更高效。
analysis.claim: 在有限练习预算约束下，通过联合建模技能习得时间与任务长期回报，可精确求解预算最优的技能练习序列分配问题。
analysis.input: 任务图结构（技能依赖关系）、技能学习曲线估计、任务奖励模型
analysis.output: 技能练习顺序与时长分配方案（即练习计划）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + 仿真环境（PyBullet）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据校准学习曲线，但未使用大规模真实技能演示或部署级真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个可精确求解预算约束下技能练习分配的优化框架，理论严谨且在真实短Horizon操作任务中验证有效；但未解决具身智能核心瓶颈（如泛化到新物体/新场景/新机体），未接入视觉/触觉等感知闭环，也未在长程、接触密集、双臂协同等高难度任务上验证，相比T-Rex/ALOHA/FTP-1等基石工作，属于扎实的规划层增量贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在‘如何科学练技能’这个被长期忽视的元问题上给出了可证明最优的计算解法，但未触及感知-动作闭环的本质挑战，暂未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Efficient exploration of sequence space enables rapid generation of functional genome editors
papers.abstract: The problem of how protein sequences translate into defined functions remains largely unsolved despite decades of progress. New methods to efficiently explore protein sequence space will help to shed light on these sequence-function relationships, particularly for complex protein function. Here, we describe an approach to create novel, functional proteins through the integration of deep mutational scanning, structural analysis, and evolutionary mining within prompts for a generative protein language model (PLM). We demonstrate the utility of this approach with the generation of novel compact RNA-guided nucleases. This approach is highly efficient, resulting in active nucleases with ~40% sequence divergence relative to natural proteins and activity equivalent to or exceeding by up to ~3X that of other compact nucleases at multiple endogenous loci in human cells. The approach described here is rapidly deployable and produces new sequences that will serve as scaffolds for further exploration of complex protein functionality, as well as substrates for novel genome engineering applications.

analysis.tldr: 用深度突变扫描、结构分析和进化信息增强蛋白语言模型的提示词，快速生成出与天然蛋白序列差异达40%但活性相当甚至高3倍的新型紧凑型RNA引导核酸酶。
analysis.org: 哈佛大学/布罗德研究所
analysis.claim: 通过在生成式蛋白语言模型（PLM）的prompt中融合实验性（DMS）、结构性和进化性先验知识，可高效定向探索序列空间，直接产出高活性、高功能性的全新人工核酸酶。
analysis.input: 蛋白语言模型输入：融合了DMS功能打分、AlphaFold2结构置信度、多序列比对保守性等信息的增强型prompt
analysis.output: 全新设计的蛋白序列（紧凑型RNA引导核酸酶）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量DMS实验数据集（来自同组前期工作）和结构预测结果，但未使用真实机器人或自动化湿实验闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个内源位点验证活性，对比基准明确（其他紧凑核酸酶），序列差异度高（40%），且整合了三类异构生物先验；但未开源代码/模型权重，未展示跨蛋白家族泛化，也未构建可复用的通用框架，属于对PLM提示工程的高质量应用级突破，尚未达到CENO/ESM-2级范式革新水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多种生物先验系统性注入PLM prompt并验证功能产出，是当前AI×基因组编辑领域最扎实的端到端生成工作之一，但非范式变革。

papers.title: VLCP: Vision Language Control Policy Closed-Loop Code Replanning for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Turning a frontier vision-language model into a robot policy usually means fine-tuning it to emit an action representation it never saw in pretraining, which throws away much of the reasoning that made the model worth reaching for. We go the other way and keep the VLM frozen. It writes the policy as a short Python control function, with no demonstrations and no fine-tuning. Writing that code once is open-loop, though. Existing closed-loop methods react at the wrong level: they retry a fixed policy or pick a different subtask, but never rewrite the code that failed. VLCP closes the loop where the failure actually lives, on the control code, within a single episode. Every $K$ steps the VLM re-observes the scene from multi-view RGB, proprioceptive state, and a state delta, then rewrites the control function from what it just saw, so a failure is caught before it compounds. We evaluate on a 57-task MuJoCo/RoboVerse sweep. This training-free policy reaches $35.1\%$ pooled success, against $3.5\%$ for the identical system queried once per episode. That tenfold gap holds with non-overlapping confidence intervals in every scene family. The gain traces to a $27.3\%$ within-episode recovery rate on failed grasps: a miss an open-loop controller would carry to the end of the episode gets re-observed and fixed at the next replan. And the loop stays cheap. A median $84\%$ of input tokens hit cache, an episode needs only about $10$ compact queries, and control blocks written during any replan persist to a cross-episode skill library reused in later prompts.

analysis.tldr: 用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）实时重写短Python控制函数来实现机器人操作的闭环策略，不微调、不依赖演示数据，每K步根据多视角RGB+本体感知状态重生成控制代码，在57个MuJoCo/RoboVerse任务上将成功率从3.5%提升至35.1%，关键在于单次episode内对失败动作（如抓取失误）的代码级重规划与恢复。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv未显示affiliation，推断为独立研究者或未公开团队）
analysis.claim: 冻结VLM无需微调即可作为闭环代码生成器，直接在单次机器人操作episode中动态重写控制逻辑，比一次性开环调用提升10倍成功率，且恢复发生在代码层而非动作层。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+本体感知状态+状态变化量（state delta）
analysis.output: 可执行的短Python控制函数（含条件分支与循环的控制块）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（纯仿真训练与评估）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘代码级闭环’新范式，实证扎实（57任务、非重叠置信区间、27.3%单episode恢复率），显著优于开环基线，但限于仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码/模型，尚未达到RT-2/π0等基石级（需真机多机体+跨域泛化+开源生态）的分量，属强推进但非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将VLM闭环能力锚定在可执行控制代码生成层面，并在大规模仿真任务中验证其恢复有效性，但因无真实机器人验证和不可复现，暂未达里程碑级别。

papers.title: Multi-Peptide Prompting Enables In-Context Learning in Protein Language
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are trained primarily on individual protein sequences, yet many peptide-discovery problems require inference from only a small number of labeled examples.
