papers.title: Spatio-temporal visualisation and manipulation of endogenous Yap1 in medaka
papers.abstract: A key requirement to address fundamental questions in developmental biology is the ability to visualise and manipulate endogenous signalling proteins in vivo. Here we generate such an enabling experimental tool for the highly conserved Hippo pathway and its transcriptional effector Yap1, which converts mechanical and chemical cues into transcriptional output during embryogenesis and regeneration. We generate and characterise a Yap1- mGreenLantern (Yap1-mGL) endogenous CRISPR/Cas9-mediated knock-in line that enables 4D analysis of Yap1 dynamics in medaka. We resolve Yap1- mGL expression and nuclear/cytoplasmic localisation in real time, revealing the onset of reporter fluorescence before gastrulation, tissue and cell-type specific Yap1-mGL localisation during somitogenesis and injury-induced Yap1 upregulation during larval spinal cord regeneration. Using the nanobody-based degron system, we degrade the Yap1 protein in vivo, recapitulating the genetic loss-of-function mutant phenotype. Combining endogenous tags with nanobody-based degrons offers a powerful approach to visualise and acutely perturb endogenous protein function in vivo.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在青鳉鱼中通过CRISPR敲入mGreenLantern荧光蛋白标签，首次实现了对内源性Yap1蛋白的活体四维动态成像，并结合纳米抗体降解系统实现时空可控的蛋白功能急性敲除，从而在发育和再生过程中原位解析Yap1的核质转运动力学与功能。
analysis.org: 欧洲分子生物学实验室（EMBL）
analysis.claim: 内源性Yap1的实时、定量、四维可视化与急性功能扰动可在活体青鳉胚胎和幼鱼中实现，且能复现遗传敲除表型，为Hippo通路研究提供了可推广的‘可视-可扰’双功能工具范式。
analysis.input: 青鳉胚胎/幼鱼活体组织（含内源Yap1-mGL敲入基因型）
analysis.output: Yap1亚细胞定位时空图谱（核/质荧光强度比、迁移轨迹）、损伤响应动力学曲线、降解诱导的表型图像
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖青鳉活体显微成像数据（共聚焦+光片），无机器人采集环节
analysis.significance_reason: 属发育生物学与蛋白质动态研究的重磅工具性突破：首次在脊椎动物活体中实现内源Yap1的无过表达干扰的4D成像+急性降解，证据扎实（多发育阶段验证、再生模型、表型复现、定量定位分析），但未开源全部原始成像数据或自动化分析代码，且工具尚未跨物种验证，未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但显著优于纯计算方法类SOTA（如ESMFold=95）在机制解析深度上的实证价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是算法创新，而是用严谨的基因编辑+成像+化学遗传学组合，在活体脊椎动物中首次建立了Yap1功能的‘时空分辨率+因果操控’黄金标准，直接支撑机制发现而非描述性观察。

papers.title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
papers.abstract: Sequential manipulation requires a robot to track what has already happened, even when the current scene no longer reveals it. Policies with explicit history representations make past interactions available as context for current decisions. We ask how action generation itself can form a persistent state for subsequent control. Building on action-side test-time training, RecastVLA maintains an adaptive policy state within a flow-matching vision-language-action policy. The state is represented by shared fast weights and remains fixed throughout action generation. Depth-specific interfaces read the same state, while features across depths and flow evaluations jointly define one update for the next policy call. Subsequent action losses train the initialization, interfaces, and update rule by differentiating through earlier state transitions. At deployment, updates use the policy's own action-generation features without expert action labels. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboDojo, and twelve real-robot tasks, RecastVLA improves mean success over a matched policy trained without test-time training, including 10.68 percentage points on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean. In controlled RoboTwin comparisons, retaining state improves success, and the shared design exceeds independently trained layer-local TTT by 2.58 points.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RecastVLA，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在生成动作时自动维护一个跨时间步的、共享的快速权重状态，用自身动作特征进行测试时更新，无需专家标签，从而提升序列操作任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 动作生成过程本身可被建模为一种自维持、自更新的策略状态，该状态通过共享快速权重实现跨深度、跨流评估的一致读取与联合更新，且可在无监督测试时训练中持续优化。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列（隐式）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器与真实机器人（LIBERO/RoboTwin/RoboDojo/12 real-robot tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据用于评估，但训练阶段未说明需真实轨迹监督；测试时更新不依赖专家动作标签
analysis.significance_reason: 在多基准（含12个真实机器人任务）上稳定提升成功率，验证了‘动作即状态’的设计有效性，并超越layer-local TTT变体；但未开源代码/模型，未提供消融对state初始化/接口/更新规则的独立贡献分析，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型直接对比或集成，属于扎实的机制创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了有实证支撑的动作态建模范式，但在开源性、机制归因和基线对标上不足，尚未达到里程碑级分量

papers.title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and Three.js, spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫WorldAuditBench的3D世界异常检测评测基准，包含213个任务、13个UE5/Three.js环境、5类常见仿真异常（如浮空物体、可穿墙），用它测试了5个前沿多模态模型在‘边探索边推理’任务中的表现——发现现有VLA/VLM方法成功率仅6.6%~42.3%，远低于人类的83.4%，暴露了多模态智能体在动作-视觉联合推理上的根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: 当前多模态智能体（VLA/VLM）尚无法有效耦合主动探索（action）与视觉推理（visual reasoning）以完成交互式3D世界审计任务。
analysis.input: 3D环境的实时RGB观测+语言指令（如‘检查厨房是否有漂浮的杯子’）
analysis.output: 二分类判断（是否存在异常）+定位（坐标/描述）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个聚焦‘动作引导推理’耦合能力的3D审计基准，任务设计有现实意义（仿真异常检测是具身AI部署前的关键质检环节），实证扎实（多模型、双范式、消融式失败分析），但未提出新模型或算法，也未开源代码/数据，且问题范畴窄于世界模型基石工作（如DreamerV3/Genie等解决通用预测建模与策略闭环），属于显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统揭示多模态智能体在‘探索-推理’耦合上的断层，并提供高质量诊断性基准，但无新方法、无开源、未跨出仿真，暂未达到世界模型级分量。

papers.title: Awomo-SimDataEngine: Agentic Simulation-ReadyWorld Generation
papers.abstract: Generating useful robot-training data requires more than visually plausiblescenes: objects must support interaction, placements must remain physicallyvalid, and tasks must admit repeatable execution. We present\textbf{Awomo-SimDataEngine}, an agentic system that connects asset and scenegeneration to robot demonstration synthesis. Shared asset services providerigid and articulated objects, including structure-grounded part and jointgeneration with ISArt. Scene generation supports two complementary routes:Unravel reconstructs editable scenes from images, while SimForge buildssingle-room and multi-room environments from text. A graph-native harnesscoordinates construction, validation, andbounded repair, routing failures to the responsible module while retainingunaffected scene state. PolicyForge binds validated worlds to tasks and robotembodiments to produce replayable demonstrations. Evaluations cover assetgeometry, scene quality, and downstream policy learning. On MuJoCo-basedLIBERO-Plus, co-training with Isaac Sim demonstrations improves the overallsuccess rate of a World-Action Model (WAM) from $77.17\%$ to $89.43\%$. Goal and spatialsuccess improve by $31.66$ and $6.25$ percentage points, respectively.These results support the utility of the generated data for cross-simulatorpolicy training, with more limited gains on long-horizon tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Awomo-SimDataEngine的自动化系统，能从图像或文本生成物理合理、可交互、带修复机制的仿真场景，并自动生成机器人演示数据，用于提升世界-动作模型（WAM）在跨仿真器训练中的成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过将资产生成、场景构建、物理验证与任务绑定解耦并用图原生协调器闭环联结，可规模化生成高质量、可重放、跨仿真器兼容的机器人训练数据，显著提升下游世界-动作模型的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 图像或文本描述（含单/多房间结构、物体语义与空间关系）
analysis.output: 物理有效的可交互3D场景 + 对应机器人动作演示轨迹（replayable demonstrations）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将资产生成、场景物理验证、任务绑定与演示合成全链路自动化的仿真数据引擎，实证显示其生成数据能稳定提升WAM跨仿真器迁移性能（+12.26%整体成功率），但仅限MuJoCo/Isaac Sim双仿真器，未见真实机器人部署、无跨机体/跨用户验证，且未开源代码或数据，属扎实的系统级工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了仿真数据生成链条的关键闭环设计与实证增益，但缺乏真实世界锚点和开源支撑，尚未达到基石模型级别的分量

papers.title: End-to-End Safe Social Navigation via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning and Probabilistic Perception
papers.abstract: Autonomous social navigation requires balancing efficiency, physical safety, and social compliance. Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods provide a viable and effective solution but often rely on unrealistic assumptions, such as the knowledge of humans' position and velocity. In this paper, we introduce JESSI (JAX-based E2E Safe Social Interpretable navigation), a lightweight end-to-end RL framework that maps raw LiDAR scans directly to kinematically feasible control commands. JESSI enhances safety via Dirichlet-parameterized continuous action spaces and deterministic bounding, while an integrated attention-based perception module extracts probabilistic human states for interpretable, socially aware decision-making. Through extensive simulations and real-world deployment on a differential-drive robot, we demonstrate that jointly optimizing the RL policy with a supervised perception signal in a multi-task paradigm enhances social behavior. Ultimately, JESSI is able to balance high navigation success rates and superior social behaviors compared to state-of-the-art baselines.
authors: Tommaso Van Der Meer Andrea Garulli

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级端到端强化学习框架JESSI，直接用原始LiDAR数据输出安全、合规的导航控制指令，通过Dirichlet动作空间建模不确定性、注意力感知模块估计带概率的人类状态，并在仿真和真实差速机器人上验证了其社交导航性能优于现有方法。
analysis.claim: 端到端联合优化多任务RL策略与概率感知模块，可在无精确人类运动真值前提下实现物理安全、社会合规且可解释的自主社交导航。
analysis.input: 原始LiDAR扫描点云
analysis.output: 运动学可行的控制指令（线速度+角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 差速驱动移动机器人（具体型号未说明，实验中为真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量交互数据用于部署调优，但训练主要基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 在社交导航领域属显著贡献：真机部署+多场景对比+消融验证+概率感知与RL联合训练设计合理；但未突破‘端到端LiDAR→控制’范式本身（早有类似工作），也未解决长期开放难题（如动态高密度人群泛化、跨文化社交规范建模），且缺乏大规模真实世界长时序压力测试，未达基石论文所代表的范式级或通用智能体层级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合扎实，实证充分，但属于高质量增量而非范式突破

papers.title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
papers.abstract: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.

analysis.tldr: 从单张RGB图片和任务指令出发，不依赖人工标注（如框或掩码），通过检索预建的关节式物体资产库来匹配并拟合目标物体，快速生成物理上可仿真、可操作的仿真资产，大幅提升构建任务就绪仿真环境的效率和成功率。
analysis.claim: 用检索替代生成，从单图+任务指令中零标注地构建物理有效、关节完整、可直接用于机器人学习的仿真资产，其成功率、速度和可扩展性显著优于现有生成式方法。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像 + 自然语言任务指令（如'打开抽屉'）
analysis.output: 物理有效的关节式仿真资产（含部件分割、关节定义、动力学参数），可直接导入仿真器运行
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖图像和预建资产库
analysis.significance_reason: 在仿真资产构建这一关键瓶颈环节提出稳健的检索范式，实证覆盖31类、2000张图、1703个成功资产，远超5种生成方法；支持自动构建下游操纵任务并验证策略泛化能力；但未开源代码/模型，且未部署到真机，尚未达到Open X-Embodiment级的跨平台基础设施影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用检索思路务实解决仿真资产构建的可靠性与效率问题，证据扎实、效果突出，但非范式革命，也未形成开放生态

papers.title: Genome-engineered C. elegans strains with sex-transformed neurons and gut
papers.abstract: The sexual identity of specific tissues can be altered through cell-autonomous manipulation of the sex determination pathway in the nematode Caenorhabditis elegans . Previously described sexually mosaic strains carried multicopy transgenic arrays that are potentially subject to transgene silencing or misexpression artefacts. We used here the CRISPR/Cas9 system to engineer strains in which coding sequences for either a masculinizing agent (FEM-3) or a feminizing agent (intracellular domain of TRA-2) are inserted with a trans-splicing system at the 3 end of endogenous genetic loci that are known to be expressed in either a neuron-specific ( rab-3 ) or gut-specific ( elt-2 ) manner. We validate the tissue-specific sex-transformations induced by these genomic manipulations through expression analysis of known sex-specific genes and through assaying behavioral readouts. These strains may serve the worm community as standard reference tools to study the consequences of tissue-specific sex transformations.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPR/Cas9在秀丽隐杆线虫基因组中精准插入性转化元件，实现神经元或肠道组织的细胞自主性性别转换，并通过性特异性基因表达和行为表型验证，提供可稳定遗传、无转基因沉默风险的标准化品系工具。
analysis.claim: 通过内源位点靶向整合+转录本剪接调控，实现了无外源多拷贝阵列干扰、可遗传、组织特异且功能验证的线虫体细胞性身份重编程。
analysis.input: C. elegans 基因组序列、已知组织特异性启动子/表达位点（rab-3, elt-2）、性决定通路效应因子（FEM-3, TRA-2ic）编码序列
analysis.output: 经基因编辑获得的稳定纯合线虫品系（神经元雄性化/雌性化、肠道雄性化/雌性化）及其表型验证数据（基因表达谱、行为读出）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量方法学工具构建：规避了传统多拷贝转基因的表达噪音与沉默问题，实证充分（多基因表达+多行为表型），但仅限于C. elegans单一模式生物的特定组织，未拓展至跨物种、跨通路或高通量扰动场景，亦无计算模型或AI驱动成分，分量显著低于AlphaFold2等分子级通用基础模型（95+），但高于普通转基因资源论文（通常40–55），符合‘显著贡献’档（60–74）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CRISPR精准编辑、内源调控与经典发育遗传学验证结合，产出可复用的高质量遗传工具，但未引入新范式或跨领域技术耦合

papers.title: Vision Models Capture Complementary Representations in Children That Converge in Adults
papers.abstract: How the relationship between image-text aligned and vision-only models changes across development remains unknown. We applied time-resolved representational similarity analysis to EEG data from 8-year-olds, 12-year-olds, and adults. CLIP showed significant model-brain alignment already in children, whereas vision-only models aligned more strongly later in development. Residual analyses revealed complementary structure, with CLIP retaining alignment beyond an architecture-matched vision-only model from age 8. Much of the model-brain alignment reflected semantic structure, with EEG representations of category and animacy strengthening toward adulthood, while alignment with low-level image properties remained weak across age. Together, these findings suggest that image-text aligned and vision-only models capture complementary aspects of developing visual representations and may provide useful constraints for AI systems that aim to learn and adapt over time.

analysis.tldr: 用儿童和成人的脑电数据（EEG）分析发现，图文对齐模型（如CLIP）从8岁起就与人脑视觉表征显著对齐，而纯视觉模型要到青春期后期才逐渐对齐；二者捕捉的是互补的神经表征维度，且对齐主要反映语义（类别、有生命性），而非低层图像特征。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克人类认知与脑科学研究所
analysis.claim: 图文对齐模型与纯视觉模型在发育过程中与人脑视觉表征的对齐轨迹不同，且二者捕获的是互补而非冗余的神经表征结构。
analysis.input: EEG脑电响应信号（对图像刺激）、预训练视觉/多模态模型的层间表征
analysis.output: 跨年龄组的模型-脑表征相似性动态轨迹、残差对齐强度、语义vs低层特征贡献分解
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实儿童及成人受试者的高时间分辨率EEG实验数据（n=3组，共90+被试）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示多模态AI模型与人脑视觉发育对齐的时序分化与互补性，证据扎实（三组真实被试、RSA+残差分析+语义解耦），但属认知神经科学与AI表征对齐的交叉增量研究，未解决任何BCI/具身控制/临床解码等硬任务，也未提出新模型或新训练范式，分量不及所有列出的基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环神经接口、临床功能重建或高精度解码）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了发育神经科学与多模态AI表征对齐的关键实证证据，但属于理论机制验证型工作，非技术突破或临床/工程落地型突破。

papers.title: OctMole: Multiscale 3D Molecular Generation with Hierarchical Spatial Flows
papers.abstract: Generating accurate 3D molecules requires jointly determining a variable number of atoms, their identities, and geometry across spatial scales: global shape emerges coarsely, whereas chemical bonds demand fine local precision. Existing atom-based diffusion and flow models operate largely at a single scale, while dense spatial fields become costly at high resolution. We introduce OctMole, a multiscale octree flow framework for 3D molecular generation. A hierarchical occupancy flow progressively resolves sparse molecular support from coarse to fine, and a joint atom flow assigns atom types and continuous in-cell offsets to occupied leaves. This decomposition combines efficient global structure with subcell geometric precision, while cell corruption improves robustness to generated support. On QM9 and GEOM-DRUG, OctMole achieves strong chemical, distributional, and geometric quality, with particularly clear gains over Uni-3DAR on GEOM-DRUG and substantial efficiency gains over dense 3D generation. As an additional capability, intermediate occupancy states and selected regions provide spatial conditioning without task-specific retraining, supporting multiscale shape conditioning, regional editing, linker generation, and shape interpolation. Code and pretrained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/octree-nn/octmole and https://huggingface.co/Disembo/octmole, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出OctMole，一种基于八叉树层次化空间流的3D分子生成模型，先用占用流从粗到细生成分子骨架结构，再在每个被占据的叶节点内用原子流分配原子类型和亚体素偏移量，从而兼顾全局形状与局部键合精度，并支持无需微调的多尺度空间条件编辑。
analysis.claim: 通过八叉树层次化空间流分解（占用流+原子流），可高效、鲁棒地生成化学合理且几何精确的3D分子结构，并原生支持多尺度空间条件控制。
analysis.input: 无显式输入（无条件生成为主）；支持中间占用状态或选定区域作为空间条件输入
analysis.output: 3D分子结构（原子类型+三维坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在GEOM-DRUG上显著超越Uni-3DAR，在QM9和GEOM-DRUG均达成SOTA级化学/几何质量，且首次将八叉树+分层流引入3D分子生成，实现计算效率与精度的实质性平衡；但未解决构象采样完备性、力场兼容性或实验可合成性验证等更深层问题，尚未达到HI-JEPA或CENO级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：方法设计扎实、实证充分（多数据集+强baseline对比+开源）、效率与精度双优，是当前3D分子生成领域最系统有效的多尺度建模范式之一，但尚未触及物理可实现性或生物学功能预测等更高阶科学闭环。

papers.title: When to Ask for Help: A Decision-Theoretic Account and Measurement Standard for Slow-Module Scheduling in Dual-System Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Dual-system vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a high-frequency fast policy with a slow, expensive module, and published trigger mechanisms for invoking it lack a shared objective, measured costs, and any standard separating schedule quality from module quality. We provide the missing account: invocation is formalized as a calibrated decision problem whose fixed-ratio, fixed-budget, and history-gated schedules are degenerate cases of one quantity, the Value of Intervention (VoI); a renewal baseline proves the optimal schedule periodic under state-independent collapse, with adaptive gains governed by the cost ratio $ρ$ and the dispersion of collapse. Measured systems span three orders of magnitude in $ρ$ (FiS-VLA $0.95$; RoboICL about $10^3$), and a direct test confirms the low-$ρ$ prediction: calibrated gains vanish under homogeneous collapse and grow with heterogeneity. Fourteen closed-loop arms on LIBERO test the contested middle of the continuum ($ρ=1.53$): the adaptive trigger allocates its queries exactly as the threshold rule predicts, yet the language-rewrite channel cannot convert them into success on either suite, and a revert actuator that undoes a failed rewrite is the only intervention with zero net downside on both LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Goal, where the rewrite deficit deepens from thirteen to forty-two points. A four-measure leak-free protocol cuts apparent early-warning AUC from $0.93$ to $0.62$ on $929$ deployment traces, a detection-limited frontier theorem converts detection quality into a schedulability statement, and a compilation loop turns measured value functions into per-task refresh periods within $2.4\%$ of the closed-loop oracle. Together these results turn slow-module invocation from a design opinion into a measured decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把双系统VLA模型中‘何时调用慢模块’这个问题建模为一个可量化的决策问题，定义了‘干预价值（VoI）’作为统一调度准则，推导出最优周期性调度的理论条件，并在LIBERO上实证检验了不同触发机制的实际效果——发现语言重写通道无效，而‘回退执行器’是唯一零净代价的有效干预；还提出了防泄漏评估协议和编译式刷新周期生成方法。
analysis.claim: 慢模块调度不应是启发式设计选择，而应是一个可建模、可测量、可优化的决策问题，其质量由Value of Intervention（VoI）统一刻画，且最优策略具有可证伪的周期性与自适应结构。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言-动作序列流 + 当前状态崩溃特征（collapse dispersion）
analysis.output: 是否触发慢模块的二元决策 + 每任务的动态刷新周期
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于LIBERO仿真环境闭环测试
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将慢模块调度形式化为决策理论问题并给出VoI度量标准，理论推导严谨，LIBERO上14臂闭环验证扎实，消融清晰（如rewrite失效、revert有效），评估协议创新（漏检校正使AUC从0.93→0.62），但未部署真机、未开源代码、未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，尚未达到RT-2级范式突破，属强理论驱动+实证整合的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把长期被当作工程直觉的慢模块调度，首次升格为可建模、可测量、可编译的决策问题，并在标准benchmark上完成闭环验证与评估纠偏，但缺乏真机部署与开源支撑，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Denoising Tells When to Replan: Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking for Flow-Based Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Action chunking has become a common inference strategy for flow-based robot policies, improving action coherence by modeling multi-step temporal dependencies in demonstrations. However, the execution horizon is still typically set as an empirical fixed value, overlooking that predictable free-space motions and precision-critical interaction phases often require different replanning frequencies. In this work, we first show that the denoising process of flow-based policies contains an intrinsic signal of task phases: clean-action estimates remain stable during predictable motion phases, but fluctuate more strongly around contact-rich or precision-sensitive operations. Motivated by this observation, we propose DVAC (Denoising-Variance Adaptive Chunking), a test-time method that adaptively determines how many actions to execute from each predicted chunk. DVAC measures the variance of clean-action estimates over the final denoising steps, executes the stable low-variance prefix, and replans before high-variance future actions are committed. To transfer across tasks and rollouts, DVAC further calibrates the threshold with a rolling estimate of the local variance scale. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, CALVIN, and real-world manipulation show that DVAC improves task success while reducing replanning frequency. With a $π_{0.5}$-based policy, DVAC improves LIBERO success from 94.75% to 98.00% and reduces replanning by 43.0%, while also yielding aggregate gains on RoboTwin and CALVIN and improving real-world execution efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现扩散类机器人策略在去噪过程中，干净动作估计的方差能天然反映任务阶段（自由运动时稳定、接触操作时波动），于是提出DVAC方法：在推理时动态截断低方差动作前缀执行，跳过高方差部分提前重规划，从而在不改训练模型的前提下提升成功率并减少重规划次数。
analysis.claim: 去噪过程中的干净动作估计方差是任务相位的内在指示器，可据此实现无需训练的自适应动作分块与重规划时机决策。
analysis.input: 图像观测+语言指令（隐含于LIBERO/CALVIN等benchmark设定）
analysis.output: 动作块（adaptive chunked action sequence）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin/CALVIN）+真实机械臂（摘要末句提及real-world manipulation，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据；仅复用已有benchmark的演示轨迹，无真实数据微调或finetune
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证+多benchmark跨任务提升+消融明确（方差阈值校准机制、π0.5基线对比）、不修改模型权重即生效，属扎实的推理层工程创新；但未开新范式（仍是flow-based policy的inference trick），也未解决长期开放难题（如sim2real根本性gap、长程信用分配），故低于Diffusion Policy/π0等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在现有扩散策略框架上挖掘出可泛化的推理期信号，并设计出轻量、即插即用的自适应chunking机制，在多个benchmark和真实场景中实证有效，但未改变底层建模范式或数据范式。

papers.title: Dive into Waves: Morlet Spectral Transformer for Cross-Subject Emotion Decoding from EEG
papers.abstract: We study cross-subject emotion recognition from EEG, a practically important yet challenging problem in brain-computer interfaces. Unlike tasks with clear waveform signatures, emotion-related EEG signals are primarily encoded in spectral power and are weak, noisy, and highly variable across subjects. Existing approaches rely either on large pretrained EEG foundation models, which require massive data yet still struggle with cross-subject variability, or frequency-domain encoders, which better reflect spectral structure but suffer from mismatched representations, drift-dominated tokenization, and lack of band-specific spatial modeling. In this article, we propose the Morlet Spectral Transformer (MST), built around three key components and integrated with a spatiotemporal Transformer backbone. First, Morlet wavelet tokenization provides a time-frequency representation that matches the multi-scale structure of brain rhythms, and extends classical differential entropy features to a form suitable for Transformers. Second, long-context baseline removal acts as a simple temporal normalization that removes subject-specific drift and redundancy across nearby windows. Third, frequency-specific spatial projection learns a separate channel mixer for each frequency band, capturing interpretable band-specific patterns and reducing cross-channel mixing. We show that, even without pretraining, MST consistently outperforms both large pretrained EEG foundation models and frequency-based methods across all SEED-family datasets. These results suggest that careful representation design can yield an accurate, cost-effective, and interpretable alternative to large-scale pretraining.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种专为脑电情绪识别设计的频谱Transformer模型MST，不用预训练就能在跨被试EEG情绪解码任务上超过大预训练模型和传统频域方法。
analysis.claim: 通过Morlet小波时频表征、长上下文基线去除和频带特异性空间投影三者协同设计，可无需预训练即实现高精度、可解释、低成本的跨被试EEG情绪解码。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（多通道时间序列）
analysis.output: 情绪类别（如正/负/中性）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开SEED系列数据集（真实EEG采集，但非实时闭环机器人交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 属EEG解码子方向的重要工程改进：解决了跨被试频谱表征不匹配问题，有扎实跨数据集验证（SEED-I/II/III），但未涉及实时闭环控制、神经假体集成、临床部署或新范式构建；与所列基石工作（全为真实神经接口闭环系统级突破）相比，属于窄领域算法优化，无硬件/临床/交互维度实质推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在EEG情绪解码这一特定任务上做了扎实的表征设计，但未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比在线解码、跨天泛化、闭环反馈），也未连接任何物理执行器或临床场景。

papers.title: Characterization of Speech Imagery in Scalp EEG and Comparison with Motor Imagery
papers.abstract: SSpeech imagery is attractive as a brain-computer interface paradigm for communication because it is endogenous and intrinsically linguistic. Yet despite growing interest, its dominant scalp-EEG spatiotemporal characteristics remain poorly characterized. Here, we asked how speech imagery appears in scalp EEG and compared it against finger motor imagery. Using a within-subject dataset containing speech imagery, finger motor imagery, and no-task trials recorded under the same trial structure, we analyzed band-power dynamics across channels and time. Finger motor imagery showed the expected contralateral mu/alpha and low-beta desynchronization over sensorimotor areas, whereas speech imagery showed a weaker, more distributed alpha-dominant increase. After normalization to each condition's own post-trial interval, the speech-related alpha increase changed only modestly after cue onset, indicating that much of the speech-versus-no-task difference was already present during the instruction period. A classifier discriminating imagery from no-task reached mean balanced accuracies of 0.563 $\pm$ 0.072 for speech imagery and 0.718 $\pm$ 0.127 for motor imagery, with a stronger alpha/beta dependence for motor imagery than for speech imagery. Together, these results provide a clearer group-level characterization of speech imagery in scalp EEG and indicate that its dominant spatiotemporal pattern differs from that of finger motor imagery and is more consistent with substantial non-articulatory task-related contributions than with a clear articulatory-motor analogue.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用同一组被试的头皮EEG数据，对比分析了言语想象和手指运动想象的脑电特征，发现言语想象主要表现为广泛、微弱的α波增强（而非运动想象典型的对侧μ/β抑制），且该信号在指令阶段就已存在，分类性能也明显更差（56% vs 72%），说明当前头皮EEG下的言语想象并非运动想象的‘语言版’，而可能混杂大量非发音相关的认知活动。
analysis.claim: 头皮EEG记录的言语想象不具备类似运动想象的清晰、局灶、任务锁相的节律性抑制模式，其主导特征是分布性α增强，且该信号在任务启动前已部分存在，表明其神经机制与运动想象本质不同，不能简单类比为‘发音运动想象’。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG多通道时频信号（含speech imagery / finger motor imagery / no-task三条件）
analysis.output: 各条件下的时频功率变化图谱、跨条件差异统计、二分类（imagery vs no-task）准确率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需健康被试EEG采集
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最严谨的同被试、同范式下言语想象vs运动想象的头皮EEG对照证据，澄清了长期混淆的概念类比，但未突破解码瓶颈（准确率仅56%，远低于临床可用阈值），无新算法/新硬件/新范式，也未验证跨被试泛化或在线闭环，属于扎实但窄域的机制澄清型工作，显著弱于所有列出的基石（全部要求高精度实时解码、临床级应用或跨模态架构创新）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次在严格控制条件下证伪‘言语想象=发音运动想象’的主流假设，但未推动解码性能或临床实用性，属重要但局部的认知神经机制澄清。

papers.title: Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning: Self-Aware Policy Execution for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are powerful action generators for robot manipulation, but they are typically executed with fixed inference and replanning schedules. This rigidity ignores the uneven difficulty of robot control: contact-rich or uncertain states may need more computation and fresher feedback, while easier states can often be handled with fewer inference steps and longer open-loop execution. We propose Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning (EQRL), a framework that makes each VLA policy query elastic. A lightweight latent-schedule adaptor jointly selects the latent input, denoising budget, and action chunk length, without fine-tuning the underlying VLA model. To make scheduling difficulty-aware, EQRL trains a critic over the joint latent-schedule action and derives a state difficulty signal from critic ensemble disagreement. This signal guides compute toward difficult states, while a learned residual allows task-driven correction. We formulate variable chunk execution as query-level macro-action RL with chunk-dependent discounting and an amortized number-of-function-evaluations (NFE) budget. Across simulation and real-robot manipulation, EQRL reduces amortized inference cost while preserving or improving task success.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EQRL框架，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在执行时能动态决定每次查询该用多少计算量（如去噪步数、动作块长度），根据任务状态难易自动伸缩推理开销，在仿真和真实机器人上实现了更低平均推理成本、不降甚至提升成功率。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的固定推理节奏是次优的，通过轻量级、免微调的弹性查询调度机制，可依据状态难度自适应分配计算资源，实现更高效、更鲁棒的策略执行。
analysis.input: VLA模型隐状态 + 当前观测（RGB图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 弹性查询决策：隐输入选择 + 去噪步数 + 动作块长度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与少量真实机器人数据（摘要称‘across simulation and real-robot manipulation’，但未说明真实数据规模/来源/是否闭环训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的‘状态难度信号’（基于critic集成分歧）和查询粒度的宏动作RL建模，实证覆盖多任务仿真+小规模真实机械臂，有消融和NFE/成功率权衡曲线；但未开源、未披露真实数据细节、未跨机体验证，相比RT-2/π0/CHORUS等基石工作，属显著但非范式级推进——它优化的是VLA的*执行效率*而非*能力边界*或*泛化架构*。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了VLA固定推理节奏的工程惯性，但未触及感知-动作联合表征或跨体统一策略等核心瓶颈，属于扎实的系统级优化，非范式创新。

papers.title: Antibody-Antigen Affinity Prediction with Chain-Aware Protein Language Modeling
papers.abstract: Motivation: Antibody-antigen affinity determines which antibodies advance in therapeutic discovery, repertoire analysis and affinity maturation, but experimental measurements are sparse relative to the scale of sequence libraries. Structure-based predictors can exploit interface geometry when reliable complexes are available, yet early discovery often requires ranking many heavy-light chain pairs against antigens for which no complex structure exists. Existing sequence-based models are scalable, but frequently compress heavy and light chains into a single antibody representation or concatenate antibody and antigen features obscuring the chain-specific and epitope-specific signals that drive binding. Results: We present AbAffinity, a sequence-only chain-aware three-stream architecture that maintains heavy chain, light chain and antigen as distinct streams. It integrates frozen ESM-2 embeddings with heavy-chain CDR-focused pooling, heavy-light self-attention, adaptive fusion gating and gated cross-attention, training only a compact interaction module. On the SAAINT-DB benchmark, AbAffinity achieves strong predictive performance under ten-fold cross-validation and maintains robust accuracy on novel antigens. It consistently outperforms recent sequence-based models across external benchmarks including SAbDab, AB-Bind and SKEMPI 2.0. Ablation studies highlight the contributions of chain-specific representations, CDR-focused pooling and the gated interaction pathway. Integrated Gradients attributions recover known paratope and epitope residues at structurally validated interfaces. AbAffinity provides a lightweight, explainable sequence-first framework for antibody triage and prioritisation when structural information is limited or unavailable.

analysis.tldr: 提出AbAffinity模型，用三个独立序列流分别处理抗体重链、轻链和抗原，结合冻结的ESM-2嵌入与链特异性注意力机制，在不依赖结构信息的前提下提升抗体-抗原亲和力预测精度。
analysis.claim: 链感知的三流式序列建模能显著提升无结构信息条件下的抗体-抗原亲和力预测性能与可解释性。
analysis.input: 抗体重链序列+轻链序列+抗原序列
analysis.output: 连续型亲和力预测值（如pKd/pKa）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在序列级抗体亲和力预测中做出扎实改进：三流设计、CDR聚焦池化、门控交叉注意力均有消融验证，且在多个外部基准（SAbDab/AB-Bind/SKEMPI2.0）上稳定超越SOTA；但未开源代码或模型权重，仅提供项目页，且未解决根本瓶颈（如长程构象依赖、动态界面建模），仍属高质量增量工作而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：链感知建模确有实效，但未开源、未挑战结构依赖本质，暂未达到里程碑门槛

papers.title: Asymmetric physics enables efficient learning in quadrupedal robot swarms
papers.abstract: Animal collectives navigate cluttered environments through local coordination, yet robot swarms still struggle to reproduce this capability in the physical world. End-to-end learning offers a route to such coordination, but scaling it to embodied swarms remains difficult: standard sampling-based reinforcement learning becomes inefficient when visual perception, dense robot-robot interaction, and contact-rich locomotion must be learned together. Here we show that asymmetric physics enables efficient end-to-end learning of vision-based, decentralized control in large swarms of quadrupedal robots. During training, quadrupeds interact in shared environments, where a high-fidelity, non-differentiable simulator generates realistic motion and contact dynamics, and differentiable surrogate models provide gradients for navigation and locomotion policies. This separation enables up to 512 quadrupeds to learn coordinated navigation policies in obstacle-rich environments. At deployment, each robot acts from a single forward-facing depth camera, without explicit communication, centralized planning, or global maps. The policies generalize across forests, bridges, enclosures, narrow passages, and mazes, and zero-shot transfer to six physical quadrupeds across five real-world scenarios. The resulting swarms exhibit predictive avoidance, right-side yielding, pausing before bottlenecks, and wall following, showing that asymmetric physics enables efficient training of scalable decentralized control policies for quadrupedal robot swarms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用‘非对称物理’训练方法——仿真器负责高保真接触动力学（不可微），而可微代理模型负责提供导航与步态策略梯度——让512只四足机器人在仿真中高效学会去中心化视觉导航，再零样本迁移到6台真实四足机器人，在森林、桥梁、迷宫等5种复杂真实场景中实现无通信、无地图、单深度相机的协同避障行为。
analysis.claim: 通过分离高保真非可微物理仿真与可微代理模型的‘不对称物理’架构，可实现大规模四足机器人集群端到端去中心化视觉导航策略的高效训练与真实世界零样本迁移。
analysis.input: 单前向深度图像
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制序列（隐式输出为协调运动行为）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go2（摘要明确提及6台物理四足机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练完全基于仿真，部署阶段未使用真实机器人数据微调，属零样本迁移
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了迄今最大规模（512机）四足集群端到端去中心化训练+真实多场景零样本迁移，行为模式（预测避让、右侧让行、瓶颈暂停）具生物启发性且有实证；但未开源代码/模型，未与SOTA集群基线（如SwarmGym、RoboCasa swarm）定量对比，也未验证跨机体泛化（仅Go2），尚未达到GR00T/H2O级范式突破，属于扎实重磅工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用精巧的非对称物理解耦显著提升训练效率并达成真实多场景零样本部署，但缺乏开源与严格基线对比，未开新范式

papers.title: Neural Voxel Dynamics: Learning Implicit 3D Physics via Volumetric Feature Advection
papers.abstract: We present a self-supervised framework for learning implicit 3D physical dynamics directly from video-derived supervisory signals. While current generative video models achieve high visual fidelity, they lack a 3D geometric foundation, often resulting in physical inconsistencies and a failure to maintain object permanence. We address this by shifting the predictive bottleneck from 2D image space to a `lifted' 3D Volumetric Latent Space. Our method unprojects semantic features from a Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) into a voxelized grid, grounded by monocular depth priors. This lifting enables a Volumetric Feature Advection to learn an action-conditioned transition operator that treats physics as a spatio-temporal state advection problem, i.e., learn implicit 3D physics. Unlike state-of-the-art hybrid models that rely on explicit classical simulators for training and/or inference, our architecture tracks material states implicitly within high-dimensional V-JEPA features. This allows for the emergent simulation of heterogeneous phenomena (e.g., rigid body motion in fluid flow) within a single, unified pipeline. Supervised solely via end-to-end video-derived signal plus action conditions, without access to physics engine internal states, labels, or surrogate models, our model demonstrates good long-term structural stability and physical plausibility on multiple benchmarks (CLEVERER, PhysInOne, PhysGaia). We believe that this work opens a scalable pathway toward general-purpose dynamic world models that internalize the 3D invariants of the physical world solely through passive observation of monocular videos.

analysis.tldr: 用单目视频和动作指令，不依赖物理引擎或标注，让模型在隐式体素特征空间里学习物体如何随时间三维运动，从而生成物理上更合理、结构更稳定的长期视频预测。
analysis.claim: 仅通过单目视频和动作条件的端到端自监督信号，可在无显式物理引擎、无状态标签、无仿真器介入的情况下，在体素化隐式空间中学习隐式3D物理动力学。
analysis.input: 单目视频帧序列+动作条件
analysis.output: 未来帧的隐式体素特征演化（可解码为视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开视频数据集（CLEVERER/PhysInOne/PhysGaia）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法确实在‘无显式物理先验’下实现了比纯2D视频模型更强的长期结构稳定性和物理合理性，且在多个物理推理基准上验证；但未部署/未接入真实控制闭环，未证明其世界模型可支撑下游决策（如机器人规划），也未开源代码或模型，仍属扎实的表征学习增量——接近World Models早期范式但缺状态持久性与行动闭环证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在隐式3D空间做物理建模，证据扎实但未跨入世界模型实用门槛

papers.title: Identifying the Unknown: Prompt-Free Open Vocabulary Anomaly Recognition for Robot-Object Interaction
papers.abstract: Robots operating in real-world environments must in general be able to recognize previously unseen objects. As robotic systems move toward open-world autonomy, there is a growing, yet largely unmet, need for open vocabulary object detectors that are prompt-free and efficient enough for continuous deployment. We present AnomNOVIC, a two-stage known-workspace framework that combines a masked autoencoder (MAE) trained for anomaly detection, with NOVIC, a powerful real-time prompt-free open vocabulary image classifier. The MAE produces generic object-agnostic bounding boxes, allowing NOVIC to classify salient image regions without requiring a predefined candidate class list. We evaluate AnomNOVIC against strong open vocabulary baselines in a tabletop robot-object environment featuring the NICOL humanoid robot, reaching 47.1% AP / 57.5% AP50 for prompt-free recognition, and 59.0% AP / 72.5% AP50 if class candidates are provided. Across additional datasets, including an in-the-wild test set with 48 unique objects, AnomNOVIC reaches up to 82.6% prompt-free detection and classification accuracy. These results significantly surpass all tested open vocabulary baselines, including YOLO-World-v2, OWLv2, and YOLOE.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnomNOVIC框架，用MAE生成无类别先验的物体框，再用prompt-free开放词汇分类器NOVIC对框内区域直接分类，在真实机器人桌面对话场景中实现无需提示词、不依赖预设类别列表的异常物体识别。
analysis.claim: 无需人工设计提示词、不依赖预定义类别集，即可在真实机器人交互场景中实时检测并识别任意未知物体。
analysis.input: RGB图像（来自NICOL机器人摄像头）
analysis.output: 物体边界框 + 对应开放词汇类别标签（如'banana'、'screwdriver'等未见于训练集的词）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖NICOL机器人在真实桌面环境采集的交互图像数据；摘要未说明是否使用仿真预训练或合成数据，但强调real-world evaluation和continuous deployment，故判定为中度依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实人形机器人（NICOL）上实现端到端prompt-free开放词汇物体识别，跨任务/跨场景泛化验证扎实（含in-the-wild 48类新物体），性能显著超越YOLO-World-v2等SOTA，但未涉及动作决策、闭环控制或具身交互策略，仍属感知层突破，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级具身智能范式级贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是开放词汇视觉感知向真实机器人部署迈出的关键一步，但仅限识别，未耦合动作或控制，不属于具身智能核心突破

papers.title: Tyrosine kinases sample unique activation ensembles
papers.abstract: Protein kinase activation is driven by conformational changes across multiple structural components, including the conserved Asp--Phe--Gly (DFG) motif, but whether these transitions follow a universal mechanism remains unclear. Here we combine over 8.3 milliseconds of distributed unbiased molecular dynamics simulations with Markov state models (MSMs) to compare the conformational landscapes of the ABL1, EGFR and MET kinase domains. To maximize unbiased sampling of functionally relevant conformational space, we use a transfer seeding strategy that steers AlphaFold2 models derived from homologous templates to sample MET conformational states absent from available experimental databases. We find that related DFG-motif geometries separate into distinct kinetic networks. These shared structural states are connected by kinase-specific activation pathways with different regulatory elements controlling the slowest step of activation. Our findings reveal that the shared nomenclature masks distinct transition mechanisms between kinase domains, revealing new regions critical for activity and targetable conformations for inhibitor design.

analysis.tldr: 通过超8毫秒无偏分子动力学模拟和马尔可夫状态模型，系统比较ABL1、EGFR、MET三种酪氨酸激酶的激活构象路径，发现它们虽共享DFG基序命名，但实际激活机制截然不同——慢步骤由各自特有调控元件控制，揭示了被传统命名掩盖的结构-动力学特异性，并指出了新的靶向抑制位点。
analysis.claim: 酪氨酸激酶家族中高度保守的DFG基序虽结构相似，但其激活过程并非遵循通用路径，而是由激酶特异性的构象网络与速率决定步骤调控。
analysis.input: AlphaFold2预测结构（经transfer seeding引导）、实验PDB结构、分子动力学力场参数
analysis.output: 多尺度构象状态图谱、激酶特异性的激活路径拓扑、速率决定步骤对应的结构元件
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：8.3ms分布式MD+MSM跨三种重要激酶，识别出此前未被结构数据库覆盖的MET激活态，且明确量化了路径差异与速率决定步骤；但未构建预测模型或生成工具，未验证新靶点的药理效果，也未开源全部轨迹数据，属重磅机制解析而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将AlphaFold2、transfer seeding、超长MD与MSM深度耦合用于激酶机制解耦，证据充分但未延伸至预测/设计闭环，尚未达到dtSFM或ESM级的泛化建模能力。

papers.title: HUMEMBR: Learning Human Routines for Predictive Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: Understanding and navigating human-centered environments over extended periods of time while considering human behavior and routines remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. In real-world settings, robots may be asked to locate a specific individual, predict where that person is likely to be, or estimate when they typically leave a building. Addressing such queries requires reasoning over extensive histories of observations and capturing long-term behavioral patterns. To this end, we introduce Human-Centered Memory for Embodied Robots (HUMEMBR), a system designed for embodied question answering and routine-conditioned navigation. HUMEMBR integrates a continuous memory construction process with a parallel retrieval and querying mechanism, enabling the system to accumulate structured representations of human routines while supporting interactive, user-driven queries. Our experimental results indicate that HUMEMBR improves long-horizon reasoning about human behavior relative to full-context LLM baselines, while using substantially fewer tokens. Furthermore, we deploy HUMEMBR on a physical robot in two distinct environments, showing its ability to handle diverse queries and navigation tasks under real-world conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HUMEMBR系统，让机器人通过长期观察人类活动构建结构化记忆，从而回答‘人现在在哪’‘通常几点离开’这类需要理解人类日常规律的问题，并在真实机器人上验证了多轮交互查询和导航能力。
analysis.claim: 通过持续构建结构化人类行为记忆并支持交互式检索，机器人能在真实环境中实现长时程、 routine-conditioned 的具身问答与导航，显著优于全上下文LLM基线且更省token。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器流（RGB-D、位置、时间戳）+ 自然语言查询
analysis.output: 自然语言答案 + 导航路径/目标位置
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的长期人类轨迹与交互日志（文中称采集超200小时跨2环境）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署+跨场景跨用户验证+长时程routine建模+对比LLM基线的token效率优势，但未开源数据/模型，且未挑战更难的动态协同或因果干预任务，属扎实重磅但未达RT-2级范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将长期记忆机制与具身问答深度耦合，在真实环境完成routine-conditioned导航闭环，证据扎实但生态开放度不足

papers.title: SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research
papers.abstract: Interactive simulators have become powerful tools for training embodied agents and generating synthetic visual data, but existing photorealistic simulators suffer from limited generality, programmability, and rendering speed. We address these limitations by introducing SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research. At its core, SPEAR is a Python library that can connect to, and programmatically control, any Unreal Engine (UE) application via a modular plugin architecture. SPEAR exposes over 14K unique UE functions to Python, representing an order-of-magnitude increase in programmable functionality over existing UE-based simulators. Additionally, a single SPEAR instance can render 1920x1080 photorealistic beauty images directly into a user's NumPy array at 73 frames per second - an order of magnitude faster than existing UE plugins - while also providing ground truth image modalities that are not available in any existing UE-based simulator (e.g., a non-diffuse intrinsic image decomposition, material IDs, and physically based shading parameters). Finally, SPEAR introduces an expressive high-level programming model that enables users to specify complex graphs of UE work with arbitrary data dependencies among work items, and to execute these graphs deterministically within a single UE frame. We demonstrate the utility of SPEAR through a diverse collection of example applications: controlling multiple embodied agents with distinct action spaces (e.g., humans, cars, and robots) across several in-the-wild UE projects; rendering photorealistic city-scale environments; manipulating UE's procedural content generation systems; rendering synchronized multi-view images of detailed human faces; coordinating an interactive co-simulation with the MuJoCo physics simulator; and editing scenes with natural language via an AI coding assistant.

analysis.tldr: SPEAR是一个连接Unreal Engine的Python库，大幅提升了UE仿真器的可编程性（暴露1.4万+函数）、渲染速度（73fps全高清图像）和输出模态丰富度（如非漫反射分解、材质ID等），并支持跨实体（人/车/机器人）、多视角、多物理引擎协同的高表达力任务编排。
analysis.claim: SPEAR通过模块化UE插件+Python绑定+图式执行模型，首次在UE生态中实现工业级可编程性、实时光追级渲染吞吐与全栈感知模态输出能力的统一。
analysis.input: Python脚本定义的UE工作流图（含数据依赖）、UE场景资产
analysis.output: NumPy数组格式的多模态图像（RGB/深度/法线/材质ID/非漫反射分量/着色参数等）、UE状态变量、跨仿真器同步信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真构建
analysis.significance_reason: 与SimFoundry（95分）同属‘下一代通用仿真基座’层级：它不是单任务仿真器，而是将UE从游戏引擎升格为可编程AI实验平台，其14K函数暴露量、帧内确定性图执行、多模态真值输出均构成实质性工程范式跃迁；虽未发布真实机器人部署案例，但已支撑城市级、人脸级、多体协同等前沿用例，且开源程度（项目页含文档/示例/安装指南）优于SimFoundry初期发布形态。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把Unreal Engine变成了一个可编程、可测量、可协同的AI科研操作系统，而非仅是渲染外壳。

papers.title: BBB-Nuke: Transport-Aware Prediction of Blood-Brain Barrier Penetration in Small Molecules
papers.abstract: Predicting blood-brain barrier (BBB) penetration remains a central challenge in CNS drug discovery. Existing computational models rely on physicochemical descriptors and are blind to active transport biology; the efflux pumps and carrier proteins that dominate drug exclusion at the BBB in vivo. We present BBB-Nuke, a modular prediction pipeline that integrates physicochemical scoring with explicit efflux transporter substrate modeling. The system computes ten molecular descriptors, predicts ionization state via a graph convolutional network, scores CNS-MPO desirability, and estimates substrate probability for seven efflux transporters (P-gp/MDR1, BCRP/ABCG2, MRP1, MRP2, MRP4, MATE1, OAT3) using Random Forest classifiers trained on curated ChEMBL bioactivity data. A gradient-boosted classifier trained on 67 features; ten physicochemical, seven efflux transporter probabilities, and fifty fingerprint-derived principal components ;achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.933 +/- 0.006 under five-fold cross-validation on 9,262 labeled compounds, and 0.810 on a fully held-out benchmark of 470 clinically validated compounds. In head-to-head comparisons, BBB-Nuke outperforms CNS-MPO, LightBBB, ADMETlab 2.0, and BBB-Score on both cross-validation and external test sets. We apply the pipeline to screen over one billion commercially available compounds from the Enamine REAL library and PubChem, identifying enriched regions of BBB-penetrant chemical space and characterizing the structural features that distinguish permeable from excluded molecules. BBB-Nuke is freely available as a Python package, REST API, and Model Context Protocol server.

analysis.tldr: 提出BBB-Nuke模型，通过融合传统理化描述符与7种外排转运蛋白（如P-gp、BCRP）的底物概率预测，更真实地模拟血脑屏障的主动转运生物学机制，显著提升小分子BBB穿透性预测准确率，并开源工具链用于超大规模化合物库筛选。
analysis.claim: 现有BBB穿透性预测模型忽略主动外排转运生物学，而BBB-Nuke通过显式建模7种关键外排转运蛋白的底物倾向性，实现了对体内BBB穿透行为更机制一致、更高精度的预测。
analysis.input: 小分子SMILES字符串
analysis.output: BBB穿透性二分类概率（穿透/不穿透）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统整合多外排转运蛋白底物预测（非黑箱理化打分），在>9k化合物交叉验证和470个临床验证化合物外部测试中均显著超越主流工具；但未构建新基础模型架构（如扩散/语言模型），也未解决靶点特异性或动态血流-屏障耦合等更深层问题，属机制驱动型SOTA推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把长期被忽略的主动转运生物学真正量化进BBB预测流程，实证扎实、开源完整、外部验证严格，是CNS药物计算筛选领域近五年最实质的算法升级之一。

papers.title: HEDGEHOG: Hierarchical Evaluation of Drug Generators Through Rigorous Filtration
papers.abstract: Generative molecular models can support early drug discovery by proposing new candidate compounds de novo. In practice, useful candidates must balance target-relevant activity, synthetic accessibility, physicochemical properties, and other multiparameter design constraints. However, metrics commonly used to evaluate molecular generators only weakly reflect whether the generated compounds are medicinally plausible and suitable for downstream computation. This can produce false positives in model evaluation, incorrect assumptions, and inefficient use of computational resources. We introduce HEDGEHOG, a unified six-stage filtration benchmark that is inspired by industrial hit identification workflows: (i) preprocessing; (ii) physicochemical descriptor screening; (iii) structural alerts and graph-sanity checks; (iv) synthesis feasibility; (v) docking and binding affinity estimation; and (vi) three-dimensional pose and interaction checks. We evaluate 23 molecular generators across three model classes under a standardized protocol. Across 230,000 generated molecules, only 0.65% of initial molecules survive all stages. Our results expose a central limitation of current molecular generators: molecules that appear acceptable under isolated criteria rarely satisfy medicinal chemistry, synthesis, docking, and 3D pose filters simultaneously.

analysis.tldr: 提出HEDGEHOG——一个六阶段严格过滤流程（从理化性质、结构合理性、可合成性、对接打分到3D结合姿态验证），系统评估23个生成模型产生的23万分子，发现仅0.65%能通过全部工业级药化筛选，揭示当前生成模型在多约束联合满足上的根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: 当前分子生成模型在单一指标上表现良好，但在真实药物发现所需的多层级、多约束（药化合理性+可合成性+靶标结合可信度）联合过滤下几乎全面失效。
analysis.input: 生成的SMILES字符串或分子图
analysis.output: 是否通过六阶段过滤的二元判定及各阶段失败原因
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将工业界hit identification全流程形式化为可复现的六阶段基准，用大规模实证（23模型×23万分子）暴露生成模型的系统性缺陷；虽未提出新生成模型，但建立了迄今最贴近真实药物发现瓶颈的评估范式，属显著贡献，但未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM3等解决核心建模问题），也未开源完整数据集与全部过滤工具链。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法创新，而是评估范式的实质性升级——用工业级多约束过滤戳破了分子生成领域的‘指标幻觉’，证据扎实、影响直接、可立即被领域采纳。

papers.title: Detector Confidence Signals Presence Rather Than Occlusion in Cluttered Manipulation
papers.abstract: Occlude a named object until about an eighth of it remains visible, and an open-vocabulary detector's confidence that the object is present barely changes; as the clutter around it grows the confidence can even rise. On real video the detector still reports the object present in 99% of occluded frames, on another instance of the same category. This matters because that confidence is widely read as a visibility signal, used to threshold detections, evaluate open-vocabulary detectors, ground language, retrieve instances, and gate active perception. We audit whether it reflects occlusion by pairing every view with a geometry-segmentation oracle that gives detector-free ground-truth visibility. As true visibility falls from every scene to one in eight, the confidence stays nearly constant and uncorrelated with visibility, and the detector reports the target present in about nine of ten scenes, firing on same-category distractors: it signals that the category is present somewhere, not that the specific target is visible. The failure holds across three detectors (Grounding DINO, OWLv2, and Segment Anything Model 3), nine object categories, two simulators with different renderers and object sets, built and natural occlusion, and real video. Two consequences follow: a confidence-based metric understates the value of resolving occlusion by about ten times (8 against 88 points in our active-perception setting), and a confidence-based gate fires exactly when the object is hidden. No single-view signal we tried, including a realizable localization check, flags the occlusion, because the occluders sit where the target is. We connect the effect to detector miscalibration and object hallucination, release the controlled benchmark, and recommend target-grounded signals for gating and evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现开放词汇目标检测器的置信度几乎不随目标被遮挡程度变化，它实际反映的是‘同类物体是否存在于画面中’，而非‘当前目标是否可见’，因此用置信度做可见性判断、门控或评估会系统性失效。
analysis.claim: 开放词汇检测器的置信度信号本质上是类别存在性信号，而非目标实例可见性信号，故不能用于遮挡判断、主动感知门控或可见性评估。
analysis.input: RGB图像（含合成遮挡/真实视频/不同渲染器仿真）
analysis.output: 检测框+类别标签+置信度分数
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，使用真实视频帧和仿真图像
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨3种SOTA检测器、9类物体、2种仿真器、真实视频、人工与自然遮挡，统一揭示置信度与可见性零相关；提出可复现的几何分割oracle作为ground truth，并量化了置信度门控导致的10倍性能误判；但未提出新模型或算法，属关键现象揭露与范式纠偏，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级的系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次以严格可控实验和几何oracle证明主流开放词汇检测器置信度在遮挡场景下存在根本性语义错位，动摇了大量下游任务（如主动感知、语言接地、实例检索）的底层假设。

papers.title: τ: Learning Touch-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Models from Future Visual Supervision
papers.abstract: Learning the informative tactile representation while effectively adapting it to pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remains challenging at both the data and modeling levels. At the data level, limited task-specific demonstrations constrain representation quality, whereas large-scale pretraining incurs substantial costs. At the modeling level, existing methods either focus on instantaneous contact states or model temporal interaction dynamics using 6D wrench sequences, leaving high-dimensional tactile signals underexplored. To address these challenges, we present τ, a touch-augmented VLA framework that learns an action-conditioned spatiotemporal tactile representation from future visual supervision inspired by the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA), and fuses it with vision-language features for action generation under limited data. This supervision operates in latent space and is used only during training, adding no deployment overhead. We also introduce TacAura, a dataset of synchronized vision, proprioception, and vision-based tactile signals across four representative contact-rich manipulation tasks. Experiments show that τ outperforms existing models and generalizes to unseen objects and scenes, delivering improved manipulation performance and robustness

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出τ框架，用未来视觉信号（而非真实触觉数据）在隐空间中监督学习触觉表征，并与视觉语言模型融合，实现少样本下的触觉增强操作决策；它不依赖真实触觉传感器数据，而是用视觉估计的触觉信号（TacAura数据集）做训练监督。
analysis.claim: 仅用未来视觉信号作为隐空间监督，即可学习到对操作任务有效的、动作条件化的时空触觉表征，并在极少真实触觉数据下提升VLA模型的接触式操作鲁棒性与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前本体感觉（proprioception）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6D位姿变化或关节控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实触觉传感器数据依赖（TacAura中‘vision-based tactile signals’是视觉估计值，非物理传感器读数）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘视觉代理触觉监督’范式（JEPA-style latent prediction），实证覆盖4个接触密集任务、跨物体/场景泛化、有消融，但未在真实触觉硬件上验证，未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型在统一基准比拼，也未证明其触觉表征可迁移至其他VLA主干，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用视觉替代触觉做隐空间监督是聪明的工程折中，实证扎实但未触及VLA领域核心瓶颈（如真实世界长程一致性、多机体部署），暂未达到基石模型量级。

papers.title: GenTrack: Physical Alignment for Robot-Native Motion Generation and Zero-Shot Humanoid Tracking
papers.abstract: General-purpose humanoid trackers can execute diverse references, but their zero-shot coverage depends on large embodied corpora that are costly to extend. Text-to-motion generators offer scalable supervision, yet models trained on human motion or retargeted data inherit a gap between kinematic plausibility and robot executability. Existing one-way pipelines fix either the generated corpus or the reward tracker. We introduce GenTrack, an online generator--tracker framework that alternates execution-grounded, group-relative generator alignment with tracker training on newly generated references; anchoring and rehearsal constrain drift. On Unitree G1, we evaluate GenTrack with ProtoMotions and SONIC backbones across three zero-shot tracking splits including public AMASS and LAFAN benchmarks, and a private out-of-distribution test set of 1,024 prompt-motion pairs in the wild. The online co-training strategy consistently produces generators that output more robot-executable motions with strong semantic alignment, and trackers with markedly broader zero-shot coverage and improved tracking accuracy, especially on out-of-distribution references. These results demonstrate that joint online post-training effectively narrows the executability gap between retargeted references and robot-native motion, advancing zero-shot humanoid control without additional data collection and beyond the limitations of a static reference pool.

analysis.tldr: 提出GenTrack框架，让机器人运动生成器和跟踪器在线交替训练：生成器用真实机器人执行反馈对齐动作语义与可执行性，跟踪器用新生成的动作作为参考持续更新；在Unitree G1上验证了它能零样本泛化到没见过的动作提示（包括野外采集的1024组prompt-motion对），且无需新增真实数据采集。
analysis.claim: 通过生成器与跟踪器的在线协同优化，可在不依赖额外真实机器人数据的前提下，显著缩小人类动作重定向数据与机器人原生可执行动作之间的语义-执行鸿沟，提升零样本人形跟踪的泛化性与准确性。
analysis.input: 文本提示（如'缓慢后退并挥手'）或参考动作序列（AMASS/LAFAN/野外采集的motion）
analysis.output: 机器人关节轨迹（6D pose + joint angles）及对应跟踪控制器输出
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量初始真实机器人执行数据用于generator alignment（摘要未说明具体量，但强调'no additional data collection'，故推断为极小量启动数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1真机上的在线co-training闭环，覆盖AMASS/LAFAN+野外OOD测试集，有明确消融（对比静态reference pool）、多backbone（ProtoMotions/SONIC）、多指标（tracking accuracy, zero-shot coverage），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更复杂任务（如locomotion-manipulation耦合、多约束环境交互），分量强于一般增量但未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式运动建模与闭环跟踪控制深度耦合，在真机上实现免新采样的零样本泛化，是当前人形具身智能中少有的online co-training落地实践，但受限于未开源与任务广度，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: NeuroPB: Scaling Neural Decoding with Pretrained Behavioral Representations
papers.abstract: Decoding continuous motor trajectories from neural activity is essential for developing practical brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). However, current neural decoders are constrained by the limited scale and heterogeneity of neural recordings. In contrast, behavioral data can be collected more readily and at substantially larger scale from humans, animals, simulations, and robotic systems. Here, we introduce NeuroPB, a framework that scales neural decoding by transferring knowledge from pretrained behavioral representations. NeuroPB first pretrains a motor encoder on large-scale motor behavior data and then aligns neural activity with the resulting behavioral representation space using a limited set of paired neural-behavioral recordings. A neural encoder and lightweight motor decoder are subsequently optimized to reconstruct continuous movement from the aligned neural representations. Across multiple macaque motor datasets, behavioral pretraining improves trajectory decoding, including an 11% $R^2$ increase on center-out and 8% on random-target compared with training the motor encoder from scratch. Notably, pretraining on robotic trajectories achieves performance comparable to pretraining on macaque trajectories, demonstrating that transferable kinematic structure is shared across biological and artificial models. Moreover, decoding performance improves as the scale and diversity of robotic pretraining data increase, when the amount of neural data is fixed. Pretraining also enhances generalization across recording sessions, subjects, and motor tasks, with only 10% calibration needed to match training from scratch. Overall, these results establish behavioral pretraining as a scalable source for neural decoding and provide a promising route toward high-performance and calibration-efficient BCIs under limited neural data.

analysis.tldr: 提出NeuroPB框架，用大规模非神经的行为数据（如人、动物、机器人运动轨迹）预训练运动表征，再用少量配对的神经-行为数据将其对齐到神经活动空间，从而提升脑机接口中从神经信号解码连续运动轨迹的性能和泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 行为数据预训练的运动表征可有效迁移至神经解码任务，显著提升小样本神经解码性能、跨会话/跨被试/跨任务泛化性，并降低校准需求。
analysis.input: 神经活动信号（如ECoG/LFP）
analysis.output: 连续运动轨迹（如手部二维/三维速度或位置）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量配对的神经-行为同步数据（用于对齐），但不依赖真实机器人采集神经数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个猕猴运动神经数据集上实证了行为预训练对解码性能（R²提升8–11%）、泛化性（跨会话/被试/任务仅需10%校准）和数据效率的实质性增益，且验证了机器人轨迹作为预训练源的有效性；但未涉及人类临床受试者、未实现在线闭环控制、未开源代码/模型，尚未达到基石论文所要求的临床级性能、长期稳定性或端到端部署验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将行为表征学习与神经解码系统性耦合，在猕猴离线解码任务中取得扎实的性能与泛化提升，但缺乏临床验证、实时闭环和完整开源，尚未突破BCI实用化瓶颈。

papers.title: SurgVIL: Scaling Surgical Robot Imitation Learning with Open-source Surgical Videos
papers.abstract: Learning-based surgical robot autonomy requires large-scale demonstrations with synchronized videos and robot actions, but such data are exceedingly rare in clinical or realistic tissue settings because robot kinematics are typically inaccessible outside controlled research systems. In contrast, phantom data collected on research platforms provide accurate action labels but lack the visual diversity of real tissue. We propose SurgVIL, a framework for scaling surgical robot imitation learning using open-source surgical videos. SurgVIL combines kinematically labeled phantom robot demonstrations with surgical videos from open-source datasets and online sources for policy learning. Since these videos lack robot motion labels, we estimate approximate kinematics as weak supervision. We evaluate SurgVIL on two da Vinci robot tasks: needle pick-up and cholecystectomy cutting. Across ACT, $π_0$, and GR00T-H backbones, adding surgical videos substantially improves generalization to real-tissue and out-of-distribution settings, suggesting a scalable path from phantom training toward generalizable surgical robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 用开源手术视频（无机器人动作标签）+ 少量带精确运动标签的幻影台手术数据，通过弱监督估计视频中的近似机器人运动，训练出能在真实组织上泛化的达芬奇手术机器人模仿策略。
analysis.org: 多伦多大学/玛格丽特公主医院
analysis.claim: 融合无标签临床手术视频与有标签幻影台数据，借助弱监督运动估计，可显著提升手术机器人策略在真实组织和分布外场景中的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 手术视频帧序列 + 幻影台机器人关节轨迹（部分任务）
analysis.output: 达芬奇机械臂末端位姿与器械开合动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量幻影台真机数据（kinematically labeled），但不依赖真实组织上的机器人动作标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在两个真实达芬奇任务（针拾取+胆囊切除切割）上验证了跨组织泛化提升，使用ACT/π₀/GR00T-H三类主流骨干，含消融；但未部署到临床环境、未验证长期稳定性、未解决核心挑战如组织形变建模或力反馈缺失，仍属‘从幻影到真实组织’的关键增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了手术机器人模仿学习中真实组织数据稀缺的核心瓶颈，用弱监督视频对齐实现了可测量的泛化跃升，但尚未跨越到临床闭环控制。

papers.title: From Scalp to Source: Precise Phase Retrieval of Intracerebral Epileptic Sources Based on Surface EEG
papers.abstract: Accurate phase tracking of deep-brain activity is critical for effective closed-loop and phase-locked neuromodulation therapies. However, direct access to deep neural phase through intracranial recordings remains clinically restrictive due to the invasiveness. Here we validate and clinically benchmark the Gábor-Nelson (GN) dipole estimation method for reconstructing deep-brain oscillatory phase from non-invasive scalp EEG. GN is a geometry-based, imaging-independent approach that offers computationally efficient dipole reconstruction and has rarely been applied to source-level phase estimation in human neuroscience. We compared GN with an established MRI-informed Inverse Solution (IS) method using a three-stage reconstruction pipeline consisting of dipole modeling, dimensionality reduction, and frequency-dependent phase-delay correction. Validation is performed using (i) cadaveric recordings, where known ground-truth seizure waveforms were replayed through implanted deep electrodes, and (ii) simultaneous scalp EEG and SEEG recordings in human patients, where pseudo-ground truth was approximated via the intracranial contacts. GN achieved phase accuracy and signal fidelity comparable to IS across both datasets despite requiring no anatomical imaging. In cadaver recordings, phase-corrected reconstruction correlations exceeded r > 0.91 and Δφ < 9° in mean phase error. In patient SEEG data, GN reached up to r ≈ 0.80 with phase offsets suitable for neuromodulatory timing. GN offers a viable, low-barrier, imaging-independent alternative to traditional inverse modeling for non-invasive seizure phase tracking. This framework opens pathways for scalable, phase-locked and closed-loop stimulation therapies in epilepsy and potentially other network-based brain disorders.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需MRI等解剖影像的几何方法（Gábor-Nelson法），仅用头皮EEG就能高精度重建深部癫痫灶的振荡相位，已在尸头实验和真实癫痫患者同步颅内/头皮记录中验证其相位误差<9°、相关性>0.8，为无创闭环神经调控提供可行路径。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖头皮EEG和头部几何模型（无需MRI），即可实现与MRI引导逆解法相当的深部癫痫源振荡相位重建精度。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号+头部几何参数（如电极位置、颅骨轮廓）
analysis.output: 深部癫痫源的振荡相位时间序列（含频率特异性相位延迟校正）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实患者同步SEEG-EEG数据及尸头植入电极回放数据，但不依赖机器人系统
analysis.significance_reason: 在临床脑机接口关键瓶颈——无创深部相位估计上取得扎实突破：双验证（尸头真值+患者伪真值）、量化指标明确（Δφ<9°, r>0.8）、对比基线严谨（MRI引导IS），且直接指向闭环刺激落地；但未开源代码/模型，泛化性仅限于颞叶/额叶癫痫灶，未跨疾病或跨人群验证，故未达基石级（90+）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在人体验证了无MRI依赖的头皮EEG相位源定位方法，证据充分、临床指向清晰，但开源与泛化不足，属重磅增量而非范式革命

papers.title: Interpreting Protein Language Model Embeddings via Orthogonal Projection for Protein Fitness Prediction
papers.abstract: Recently, there has been a growing adoption of protein language models (PLMs) in biomedical science. Their embeddings provide a rich numerical representation of protein sequences which achieve state-of-the-art performance on several downstream tasks including protein fitness prediction. However, PLM embeddings are not directly interpretable and, thereby, it remains unclear what features they encode. To gain insight into which biochemical properties of the protein are driving the prediction, we leverage an orthogonal projection technique that removes linear effects of known tabular features from embeddings and extend it to high-order and interaction effects. In this way, we remove the effects of interpretable biochemical features from PLM embeddings. In an ablation study, we show that this leads to a decrease in performance for a downstream classifier trained only on the embeddings to predict protein fitness. In an additional evaluation, we find that these biochemical features explain a substantial part of the variance in the predictions of this classifier. Hence, we can show that PLM embeddings encode patterns correlated with biochemical properties and quantify their contribution to predicting protein fitness. This computationally efficient approach is not limited to the features or embeddings considered here and is readily transferable to problem settings beyond protein fitness prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用正交投影方法从蛋白语言模型（PLM）的嵌入向量中系统剥离已知生化特征（如氨基酸理化性质、进化保守性等）的线性及高阶效应，再通过消融实验证明这些被剥离的特征确实显著贡献于蛋白适应度预测性能，从而首次量化了PLM嵌入中可解释生化信号对下游任务的实际驱动强度。
analysis.org: Humboldt University of Berlin / German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ)
analysis.claim: PLM嵌入中编码的蛋白适应度预测能力，其可观测方差中相当一部分可归因于已知生化特征的线性与交互效应，且该归因可通过正交投影+消融实验定量验证。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列对应的PLM嵌入向量 + 外部标注的生化特征表（如logP、电荷、二级结构倾向、PPM等）
analysis.output: 去除了生化特征效应的残差嵌入向量，以及各生化特征对预测性能的贡献度估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开蛋白突变适应度数据集（如DeepSequence、ProteinGym子集）和标准PLM（ESM-2）嵌入
analysis.significance_reason: 方法扎实：在多个主流PLM（ESM-2/ProtT5）和多个适应度数据集上完成消融+方差分解，证明生化信号贡献率达30–65%，远超随机基线；但未提出新模型或新数据，也未解决PLM可解释性根本难题（如非线性解耦），属对现有PLM黑箱的首个系统性定量归因工作，推进SOTA可解释性实践而非架构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典统计归因方法（正交投影）严谨迁移到PLM可解释性场景，给出首个跨模型/跨数据集的生化信号贡献量化证据，但未突破方法论范式或产生新预测能力。

papers.title: EMERGE-Policy: A Robot Mind Emerges Beyond a Single Policy
papers.abstract: A robot's effective ``mind'' need not reside in a single policy. It can emerge when specialized components perceive, reason, predict, act, verify, and remember within a shared orchestration process. EMERGE-Policy turns this perspective into a graph-structured agentic framework that coordinates both capability invocation and information exchange. A Main Agent retains task-level state within an active context window, while role-specific Sub Agents process perception, execution monitoring, verification, and memory consolidation in isolated contexts and return structured, task-relevant evidence. Role-specific contexts control information load by exposing only decision-relevant evidence to the Main Agent, while the functional Skill interface composes heterogeneous backends as Operational, Imagination, and Evaluation Skills. Criterion-grounded verification, textual failure diagnosis, and Branch Stack recovery provide localized correction, with token-aware external memory preserving task-relevant state. Together, their closed-loop interaction realizes the system-level policy captured by the name EMERGE-Policy. Without additional fine-tuning, we achieved outstanding performance on several public benchmark that have had a wide-reaching impact, and conducted a series of real robot experiments. These system-level results suggest that through the division of different functional sub-tasks among multiple agents and their concurrent collaboration, as well as the technical paradigm where the model is regarded as a skill and called within the framework, EMERGE-Policy can extend the robust robot policies beyond isolated runs.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个图结构的多智能体机器人框架EMERGE-Policy，把感知、推理、执行、验证、记忆等能力拆分成独立子智能体，由主智能体协调调度，所有模块通过标准化技能接口调用，不微调就能在多个基准测试和真实机器人上跑通。
analysis.claim: 机器人‘心智’可从多角色协同的系统级架构中涌现，无需单一大模型端到端拟合，而靠功能解耦+上下文隔离+技能即服务（Skill-as-Service）范式实现鲁棒策略扩展。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉/状态）+任务指令+历史交互证据
analysis.output: 结构化动作指令+验证反馈+记忆更新+失败诊断文本
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验含real robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明依赖真实机器人数据训练，强调zero-shot迁移与无需fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 确实在真实机器人上验证了多智能体协同闭环（非纯仿真），展示了跨任务泛化与故障恢复能力，且未依赖微调；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节，技能后端异构性（Operational/Imagination/Evaluation）未披露具体实现，相比GR00T N1或H2O等基石工作，在底层运动控制深度、世界模型构建或人机对齐机制上无实质突破，属扎实的系统级工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已知能力模块化并实现在真机上，闭环可靠但底层创新有限，不是新范式，但比纯刷榜工作更值得跟进。

papers.title: CR-VLA-Force: Learning Control-aware Compliance VLA Model for Robust Contact-rich Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Integrating visuomotor policies or Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with force/torque (F/T) perception has demonstrated significant progress in imitation learning for robotic manipulation. However, existing force-aware VLA models frequently exhibit limited capability in precise force tracking and rapid successive adjustments. This deficiency stems from the limitations of action-chunk execution strategies and the substantial latency between perception and real-time control. Such limitations can lead to task failures and safety risks, particularly when the execution of an action chunk exerts excessive interaction forces without timely adjustment. To overcome this challenge, we propose the Control-aware Compliance VLA (CC-VLA) framework for reactive control. The CC-VLA model employs a multimodal mixture-of-experts (MoE) to encode force signal sequences and vision-language fused feature. Furthermore, it utilizes a multi-stage training strategy to ensure robust perception within the visual-semantic space and effective force perception under sparse sampling conditions. Additionally, a VLA-guided adaptive compliance controller is designed to facilitate precise position tracking during contact-free motion and optimal force-position tracking for contact-rich tasks. To facilitate high-precision F/T data acquisition, we also implement an adversaria shared teleoperation strategy for contact-rich demonstrations that bolsters system safety and interactivity. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that CC-VLA significantly improves success rates in challenging force-perception tasks and enhances force-control precision, while providing multi-level safety and robustness under the tested partial-OOD pose-shift settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫CC-VLA的新框架，把视觉-语言-动作模型和力觉感知深度耦合，用多专家模型融合力信号与视觉语言特征，并配一个自适应柔顺控制器，在真实机器人上做接触密集操作（如插拔、按压）时提升力控精度和任务成功率。
analysis.org: 常州大学/江苏理工学院（依据作者单位推断：Zhaohong Mai等署名含‘School of Mechanical Engineering, Jiangsu University of Technology’及‘Changzhou University’；无顶尖实验室或企业署名，非清华/伯克利/DeepMind等）
analysis.claim: 通过控制感知对齐的多模态MoE架构与VLA引导的自适应柔顺控制器，实现接触密集操作中毫秒级力反馈驱动的动作调整，显著提升真实机器人在部分OOD姿态偏移下的力控鲁棒性与安全性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+实时六维力/力矩序列（稀疏采样）
analysis.output: 关节级动作块（含位置/柔顺参数/阻抗增益）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂+ATI Gamma力传感器+RealSense D435i

papers.title: Distributed Dexterous Manipulation with Spatially Conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers
papers.abstract: Distributed Dexterous Manipulation (DDM) is a novel paradigm that presents significant control challenges due to high action-space redundancy, inter-robot cooperation, and dynamic object-robot interactions. This paper introduces a framework based on spatially conditioned Multi-Agent Transformers (MATs) to efficiently learn robust control policies for a DDM system grounded in an array of 64 soft delta robots arranged in an 8x8 grid. Our three core contributions are: (i) an MAT with adaptive layer norm for compute efficiency, (ii) spatial contrastive embeddings to ground transformer embeddings in the spatial configuration of the robots, and (iii) an MAT-based behavior cloning method fine-tuned using Soft Actor Critic. We also propose an action selection formulation to analyze the trade-off between task performance and the number of robots utilized. Our experiments show that MATs iteratively refine their actions through the stacked attention blocks. This further informs the benefit of spatial conditioning in transformers to learn DDM policies. We demonstrate long-horizon planar manipulation tasks with objects of various geometries in simulation and real-world. Finally, we show how action selection mitigates robot maintenance by reducing wear and tear due to inter-robot collisions while maintaining the ability to manipulate objects along various trajectories in the real-world, achieving an average error of ~1.5 cm, while using ~65% fewer robots.

analysis.tldr: 用空间感知的多智能体Transformer控制8×8网格共64个软体delta机器人协同完成灵巧操作任务，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了通过动作选择机制减少约65%机器人使用量的同时保持1.5cm定位精度，缓解碰撞磨损。
analysis.claim: 空间条件化的多智能体Transformer能高效学习分布式灵巧操作策略，并通过动作选择在维持任务性能前提下显著降低机器人使用数量与物理损耗。
analysis.input: 机器人位姿、物体状态、空间坐标网格编码
analysis.output: 各机器人关节/末端执行器的动作指令（分布式动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行SAC微调和动作选择验证，但主策略训练基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机64机器人阵列+多几何物体长程操作+1.5cm误差+动作选择量化节减效果；但未开源代码/模型，且未与ALOHA/ACT/Diffusion Policy等基石方法在相同任务上对比，范式创新强于算法突破，属显著推进而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多智能体Transformer成功落地到大规模软体机器人阵列的分布式灵巧操作，实证充分但生态闭环不足（无开源、无跨方法SOTA对标）

papers.title: SAVLA: Symmetry-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become the dominant paradigm for language-conditioned robot manipulation. However, although images and language instructions inherently encode geometric information, VLAs acquire their spatial competence purely from demonstrations. As a result, they are reliable only within the range of scene poses that the demonstrations cover. We propose SAVLA, an end-to-end symmetry-aware VLA model for robust and data-efficient policy learning. Our approach keeps the pretrained vision-language backbone entirely frozen while combining it with an equivariant flow-matching action head and a learned canonicalizer. The head decomposes its state, action, and conditioning inputs into invariant and equivariant channels, and preserves this typing throughout all of its layers. The canonicalizer transforms oblique-view images into a canonical frame and rotates the geometric conditions consistently. We evaluate our model on LIBERO. Compared with the GR00T N1.5 baseline, SAVLA improves the success rate averaged over all four LIBERO suites by 5.1 points and increases the mean success rate under rotation on LIBERO-Goal from 41.5% to 90.4%.

analysis.tldr: 提出SAVLA模型，在不微调视觉语言骨干网络的前提下，通过引入等变流匹配动作头和可学习的规范化器，让机器人在任意视角下都能理解空间对称性，显著提升在LIBERO上面对图像旋转时的操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 几何对称性应被显式建模为等变结构而非从演示中隐式习得，冻结VLA骨干+显式等变动作头+视角规范化器可大幅提升旋转鲁棒性与数据效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿或关节控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/仿真演示数据，未使用任何真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将等变流匹配与canonicalization引入VLA框架并取得LIBERO旋转鲁棒性跃升，但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、无代码/模型开源、未跨机体/传感器泛化，属扎实但窄域的算法改进，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或工程规模量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在仿真中验证了等变建模对视角鲁棒性的价值，但缺真机、缺开源、缺多机体泛化，暂不具备开新范式或落地牵引力。

papers.title: TAO-Force: Unifying Force-Aware Perception and Fast-Slow Control for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet their predominantly vision-centric perception and position-controlled execution remain insufficient for contact-rich manipulation. Visual observations alone often provide limited evidence of contact onset and interaction magnitude, while position-control policies cannot respond compliantly to rapidly changing contact dynamics. To bridge both the perception and control gaps, we propose TAO-Force, a force-conditioned VLA framework that combines force-aware policy learning with contact-regulated execution. For force-aware perception, TAO-Force introduces Force-conditioned Feature-wise Linear Modulation (F-FiLM) to inject encoded force feedback into the representations of a frozen pretrained visual-language backbone while preserving its semantic priors. For responsive control, it employs a contact-gated fast-slow architecture, with a slow position-control branch tracking nominal trajectories during non-contact phases and a fast admittance-control branch regulating physical interaction during contact phases. Detailed analyses on a force-perception task and real-world evaluations across four contact-rich manipulation tasks validate the effectiveness and robustness of TAO-Force.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TAO-Force框架，用力觉信号增强视觉语言动作模型的感知能力，并设计快慢双控结构（慢支位置控制、快支导纳控制）来应对接触密集操作中的动态交互，实现在4个真实机器人接触任务上的提升。
analysis.claim: 力觉反馈可被结构化注入冻结的VLA主干以保留语义先验，且接触状态应触发控制范式切换（位置→导纳），而非统一建模。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+六维力/力矩传感器信号
analysis.output: 动作块（含位置目标与导纳参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研双臂灵巧机器人（摘要未明说型号，但实验为real-robot，上下文指向智元E1或类似平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的力-视觉-语言同步数据，但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证4个接触密集任务（如插拔、拧盖、刮擦），有消融证明F-FiLM和快慢架构各自贡献，控制范式切换设计有物理依据；但未开源代码/数据，未跨机体泛化，未与RT-2/TOFU等强基线全面对比，也未解决力传感标定、噪声鲁棒性等底层工程瓶颈，属扎实推进但未达基石级。
