papers.title: Design and Assembly of Combinatorial DNA Barcodes for Probe-based Genomics Applications
papers.abstract: Probe-based genomics technologies are extending molecular analysis into intact tissues and fixed cells, yet strategies to decode complex experimental conditions encoded in cellular RNA remain limited. Here we present a modular framework that integrates custom software tools with purpose-built cloning reagents to design, assemble, validate, and deploy combinatorial DNA barcodes. Combinatorial barcodes comprise spatially adjacent collections of known sequences, enabling millions of unique molecules to be efficiently distinguished using a limited set of probes. Our software tools integrate with optimized assembly plasmids and whole plasmid long-read sequencing for high-fidelity construction and structural validation of diverse combinatorial barcode architectures. Assembled barcode libraries are flexibly transferred into user-modified expression vectors to support diverse downstream experimental applications. We showcase the versatility of this framework by assembling two structurally distinct combinatorial barcode libraries, each containing millions of unique sequences. Following rabies virus-based delivery to the mouse brain, we validate in vivo decoding of a combinatorial barcode architecture capable of distinguishing ~16.3 million expressed RNAs through probe-based in situ sequencing. Our framework for flexible and accurate combinatorial barcode construction fills a technically demanding niche delivering cost-effective molecular reagents for multiplexed experimentation on current and evolving probe-based genomics platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一套软硬件协同的模块化流程，用于设计、组装和验证能编码上千万种实验条件的组合式DNA条形码，并在小鼠脑内用狂犬病毒递送+原位测序成功解码了约1630万个RNA分子，解决了探针式基因组技术中高通量分子标签构建难、验证难、部署难的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过整合定制软件、专用克隆载体和全长质粒长读长测序，实现了可扩展、高保真、可灵活部署的组合式DNA条形码库构建与体内功能验证。
analysis.input: 实验设计参数（如条形码长度、模块数、序列约束）、用户指定的载体骨架
analysis.output: 经结构验证的完整质粒DNA条形码文库（含百万级唯一序列）及配套解码探针集
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖湿实验产出的长读长测序数据（PacBio/ONT）和原位测序图像数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属探针式空间组学关键使能技术：首次实现百万级组合条形码的全流程闭环（设计→组装→全长验证→体内解码），且在真实神经环路场景中完成1600万RNA分子的原位分辨，证据扎实（含长读长结构验证、体内功能测试、双架构对比），但未开源核心代码/质粒，复现门槛高，尚未形成广泛工具链生态。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：解决了空间多组学中高复杂度分子条形码工程化的长期瓶颈，实证充分、场景真实、规模领先，但开源不足限制扩散。

papers.title: VIP: Variation-based Iterative-learning Planning for Robotic Navigation
papers.abstract: Over the past decade, autonomous robotic systems have been increasingly deployed in applications such as surveying, search and rescue, and last-mile delivery. These applications require robots to generate safe and efficient motion plans in large, complex, and obstacle-dense environments, often under limited onboard computing resources. However, conventional planning methods commonly rely on finite-dimensional trajectory parameterization or increasingly long prediction horizons, leading to rapidly growing computational costs, particularly in multi-robot scenarios. This paper presents a novel variation-based iterative-learning planning (VIP) framework for efficient motion planning of both single robots and robotic swarms. Instead of optimizing a large number of discrete trajectory variables, VIP directly updates the planning command as a continuous function in an infinite-dimensional function space. The same variation-based update can be implemented in a model-in-the-loop manner for offline planning or in a robot-in-the-loop manner between online physical executions. By avoiding the computational burden associated with horizon expansion and high-dimensional trajectory discretization, VIP maintains a per-iteration computational complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n)$, where $n$ denotes the number of spatial discretization points. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework can efficiently generate and iteratively improve motion plans for different planning objectives, robotic platforms, and swarm configurations, highlighting its effectiveness, computational efficiency, and scalability as a general planning methodology.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫VIP的迭代式运动规划框架，把轨迹优化从离散变量优化改成在函数空间里用变分法连续更新控制指令，从而避免随预测步长和空间离散点数爆炸的计算开销，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了对单机和多机编队规划的高效性与可扩展性。
analysis.claim: 通过在无限维函数空间中进行变分迭代更新规划指令，VIP能以O(n)每轮复杂度实现高效率、可扩展、跨平台的机器人导航规划，无需依赖长时域离散化或模型精确参数化。
analysis.input: 环境观测（如激光/深度图）、当前状态、规划目标（如终点、避障约束、多目标权衡）
analysis.output: 连续时间下的控制指令流（如速度场、转向率函数等，非离散动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: UGV小车（实测用Clearpath Jackal）、无人机（Gazebo+PX4仿真）、多机集群仿真平台
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需少量初始可行轨迹或随机扰动生成的原始计划，不依赖大规模真实机器人运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在规划范式层面有实质性推进：用变分迭代替代传统参数化优化，实测支持单机/多机/异构平台，真机验证含动态避障与编队重规划，但未开源代码、缺乏与主流规划器（如 CHOMP、TrajOpt、MPNet、RRT*+NN）的公平多指标对比（如成功率/平滑度/实时性/能耗），也未证明其在极端稀疏奖励或长程拓扑规划上的优势。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将变分法系统性引入机器人在线规划闭环，显著改善计算可扩展性，并完成从仿真到中小规模真实机器人的可信迁移，但尚未达到开创新范式的程度，也未形成社区级工具链或基准影响。

papers.title: PathFold: Predicting the Entire Protein Folding Pathway from Protein Sequence Alone
papers.abstract: Recent advances in protein structure prediction, exemplified by AlphaFold, have largely addressed the determination of static structures, one aspect of the protein folding problem. However, predicting folding pathways, by which proteins reach their native states, remains a significant challenge. Here, we present PathFold, a deep learning framework that predicts protein folding pathways directly from sequence information. PathFold leverages an AlphaFold-based module to extract structural information from the sequence and generates a progressive folding trajectory from an extended conformation using a diffusion model. By modeling the full trajectory, it enables prediction of folding intermediates and transition pathways, analogous to those observed in steered molecular dynamics (SMD) simulations. The predicted pathways reveal well-defined intermediates and sequential folding events, and show agreement with experimental folding data, including measured Φ-values.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PathFold模型，仅用蛋白质氨基酸序列作为输入，直接预测整个折叠过程的动态轨迹（从完全伸展到天然态），生成包含中间态和过渡路径的连续构象序列，并声称与实验Φ值和SMD模拟结果一致。
analysis.claim: 仅从蛋白质序列出发，无需任何结构先验或动力学模拟初始化，即可端到端预测具有物理合理性的完整折叠路径（含可验证中间态）。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 时间步对齐的连续3D构象轨迹（即折叠路径）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实折叠动力学实验数据训练；依赖AlphaFold2预训练权重和公开PDB结构数据，但无实测折叠路径数据（如单分子FRET、Φ-value实验的时间分辨数据）用于监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将扩散模型引入端到端折叠路径生成，技术组合有新意；但未在真实动力学数据上做监督训练或定量验证（Φ-value仅作定性对比），未提供路径物理合理性（如能垒、速率、折叠核）的量化评估，也未与主流路径模拟方法（如Markov State Models、AWSEM、OpenMM+REMD）做计算效率/精度对比，属于扎实但窄向的增量工作，远未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或HI-JEPA级世界模型尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线合理且首次实现序列→路径端到端生成，但缺乏动力学实证支撑和物理机制可解释性，目前仍属概念验证阶段，非真突破

papers.title: FoldKit: A Python library for efficient storage and retrieval of co-folding predictions
papers.abstract: AlphaFold 3 (AF3) enables structure prediction of biomolecular complexes through co-folding multiple interacting molecules, making it increasingly useful for de novo protein design and for large-scale studies of protein-protein, protein-peptide, and other biomolecular interactions. However, systematic co-folding experiments can produce large volumes of output data, particularly when multiple random seeds and samples are generated for each input complex. We introduce FoldKit, a Python package for efficient storage and analysis of large-scale AF3 co-folding results. FoldKit converts raw AF3 outputs into a compact, structured representation while preserving the metadata needed for downstream analysis. The FoldKit Python library provides convenient programmatic access to global, single chain, and interface confidence metrics such as pLDDT, pTM, ipTM, ipAE, and ipSAE, as well as an ensemble-level interface for accessing and aggregating these metrics for a single input across multiple seeds and samples. We benchmark FoldKit on three types of AF3 co-folding datasets: (i) a protein design campaign with 2 chains per input, (ii) a TCR-pMHC dataset with 4 chains per input, and (iii) a pooled-AF3 protein-protein interaction dataset with up to 22 chains per input. We find that FoldKit reduces storage requirements by approximately 5-15-fold compared to native AF3 outputs, depending on dataset composition, while maintaining direct programmatic access to individual predictions, ensembles, and confidence metrics. By reducing storage requirements and facilitating programmatic access to relevant outputs, FoldKit facilitates large-scale computational studies of biomolecular interactions. FoldKit is available from PyPI and can be installed using pip.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫FoldKit的Python工具库，专门用来压缩和高效读取AlphaFold 3生成的大量共折叠（co-folding）预测结果，把原始输出体积缩小5–15倍，同时保留所有关键置信度指标（如pLDDT、ipTM等）的编程化访问能力。
analysis.org: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai
analysis.claim: FoldKit通过结构化序列化与元数据封装，在不损失分析能力的前提下，显著降低AlphaFold 3共折叠预测结果的存储开销并提升下游计算可访问性。
analysis.input: AlphaFold 3原始输出文件（含多链结构、多个随机种子/样本的预测结果）
analysis.output: 紧凑的结构化二进制/JSON格式数据包，支持按链、接口、ensemble粒度查询pLDDT/pTM/ipTM/ipAE/ipSAE等指标
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程工具——解决AF3大规模共折叠场景下的实际IO瓶颈，但未提出新模型、新算法或新科学发现；其价值限于提升已有方法（AF3）的可用性，且仅适配AF3输出格式，泛化性弱，无生物学新洞见或实验验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是AlphaFold 3生态中一个实用、轻量、开源的配套工具，但非科学突破，也不构成独立方法论贡献。

papers.title: BinauralVAE: Spatial Audio Reconstruction For World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied artificial intelligence has historically very much relied on visual perception, leading to a proliferation of multiple vision-centric world models. However, this reliance fails to capture spatial understanding in its entirety and can even present vulnerabilities in environments with visual occlusions, low-light conditions, or blackouts-scenarios, where acoustic information becomes a critical alternative for spatial awareness and navigation. Despite its potential, research into realistic spatial audio and particularly the development of audio-centric world models remains sparse. In this technical report, we introduce BinauralVAE: a flexible, open-source pipeline (https://github.com/Luizerko/BinauralVAE) that explores multiple models for spatialized audio reconstruction, progressing from fundamental baselines to advanced, mathematically grounded architectures. Our approach evaluates various Variational Autoencoder architectures -- including complex-valued variants -- to learn robust latent representations of binaural signals. Developed alongside AudioWorldSim, our methodology leverages realistic acoustic data captured as a simulated robot navigates an environment. This pipeline establishes a foundation for state representation in a future audio-based world model, designed to map the direct causal connection between navigational actions and their resulting acoustic consequences, and helping to enable sound as an essential complementary modality for spatial knowledge acquisition.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫BinauralVAE的开源变分自编码器框架，用仿真机器人采集的双耳音频数据训练模型，目标是重建空间音频信号，为未来‘以声音为中心的世界模型’打基础，但全文无真实机器人实验、无下游任务验证、无世界模型闭环（无动作预测/规划/梦回放），仅停留在音频表征学习阶段。
analysis.claim: 双耳音频可以被建模为世界模型中与视觉互补的空间感知模态，BinauralVAE通过复数域VAE等架构能学习鲁棒的声学潜在表征。
analysis.input: 双耳音频信号（时频谱或复数短时傅里叶变换表示）
analysis.output: 重建的双耳音频信号（时频谱或复数STFT）
analysis.robot_dependency: AudioWorldSim（仿真器，非标准机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的双耳音频数据，无真实机器人录音或交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出音频世界模型概念并开源了仿真数据与VAE pipeline，但未构建任何世界模型核心组件（如状态转移预测、动作条件建模、梦回放、闭环控制），也未在真实或具身任务中验证其对导航/避障/定位的增益；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等定义范式的基石工作，它连最小可行世界模型都未实现，仅是模态扩展的初步表征探索。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：有开源诚意和合理技术选型，但缺乏世界模型的关键因果建模、行动闭环与实证验证，本质是‘音频表征学习’而非‘世界模型’。

papers.title: MEMOBench: A Process Level Memory Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires acting on information that is no longer visible, yet Vision-Language-Action policies are usually evaluated when the current observation largely determines the next action. Existing robotic memory benchmarks expose this gap, but they still rely mainly on final task success and therefore conflate forgetting with manipulation failure. We present \textbf{MEMOBench}, a benchmark for process level memory evaluation in robotic manipulation. MEMOBench includes 30 history dependent tasks, 1{,}500 expert demonstrations, and 4{,}200 executable checkpoint instances from 84 templates. Each checkpoint pairs coarse to fine language with a simulator predicate and labels one memory operation: Storage, Update, or Compression. These annotations define Memory Storage Rate, Memory Update Rate, and Memory Compression Rate, which measure memory fidelity alongside task success. Across standard and memory augmented VLA policies, the strongest memory module baseline reaches only 31.9\% average success rate, and high storage often coexists with weak update and compression. Checkpoint language also supervises semantic, contrastive, and framewise memory alignment objectives, yielding modest gains across different memory operations. MEMOBench provides a diagnostic evaluation suite and training supervision for memory grounded robotic policies. The project page is available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/MEMOBench.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评估机器人操作中‘过程级记忆’能力的基准MEMOBench，包含30个依赖历史信息的任务、1500段专家演示和4200个带精细记忆操作标注（存储/更新/压缩）的检查点，首次将记忆 fidelity 与任务成功率解耦量化。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名和项目页github.com/Collab-Gen推断为国内高校或联合团队，但无法确认具体机构）
analysis.claim: 机器人操作中的记忆能力必须在过程层面（而非仅最终成功）被独立、可分解地评测，现有基准因混淆遗忘与操作失败而失效。
analysis.input: 多模态时序输入（视觉+语言指令+历史动作/状态），以及每个检查点对应的粗粒度到细粒度语言描述
analysis.output: 三类记忆操作标签（Storage/Update/Compression）及对应率（Memory Storage/Update/Compression Rate）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器（隐含于‘executable checkpoint instances’和‘simulator predicate’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的专家演示与检查点，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次提出过程级记忆解耦评测范式并构建首个带操作语义标注的记忆基准，证据扎实（4200检查点+三类操作定义+跨策略诊断结果），但纯仿真、无真机验证、未部署、未证明对下游泛化有提升，属显著贡献而非里程碑——远低于ALOHA/ACT/T-Rex等真机驱动、部署就绪、解决接触密集操作本质难题的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破性评测范式，但限于仿真，尚未证明对真实操作性能提升，属于关键基础设施建设，非算法或系统突破。

papers.title: SaltyMeta: a curated benchmark and protein language model-informed web tool for salty peptide prediction
papers.abstract: Excess sodium intake remains a major public health challenge, while salty and saltiness-enhancing peptides offer a potential route to preserve sensory saltiness in reduced-sodium foods. Machine-learning studies of salty peptides, however, are constrained by small datasets, heterogeneous evidence standards, uncertain negative labels, and sequence similarity leakage. Here we present SaltyMeta, a curated benchmark and web-accessible screening framework for salty or saltiness-enhancing short peptides. The benchmark contains 580 peptides, including 280 positive peptides and 300 negative peptides, all standardized to 2-15 residue one-letter amino-acid sequences. Quality control found no non-standard residues, exact duplicates, or positive-negative overlaps. A similarity-grouped split retained 456 peptides for training and 124 for held-out testing. We evaluated 548 interpretable peptide descriptors, frozen ESM2 embeddings at 8M, 35M, and 150M parameter scales, and descriptor-embedding fusion models under grouped cross-validation. The traditional ExtraTrees baseline selected by training-set grouped cross-validation achieved ROC-AUC=0.693 in cross-validation and ROC-AUC=0.704, PR-AUC=0.702, F1=0.626, and MCC=0.304 on the held-out test set. The best initial protein-language-model fusion was traditional descriptors plus ESM2-8M embeddings, with grouped CV ROC-AUC=0.696 and test ROC-AUC=0.700. Advanced optimization using PCA95 dimensionality reduction and ExtraTrees feature-importance filtering yielded a practical ESM2-8M PCA95 top-300 model with test ROC-AUC=0.715 and PR-AUC=0.703, although repeated-CV gains remained modest. SaltyMeta is a transparent prioritization tool, not a sensory validation substitute. We provide benchmark, models, scripts, GitHub, and Streamlit for reproducible screening of food-derived peptides.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个高质量、无泄漏的咸味肽预测基准数据集SaltyMeta（580条肽，严格去重和分组划分），并系统评估了传统描述符、ESM2多尺度嵌入及融合模型的预测性能，开源全部代码、模型和Web工具，用于食品来源肽的可复现咸味优先级排序。
analysis.claim: SaltyMeta是首个经严格质量控制、抗序列相似性泄漏、支持分组交叉验证的咸味肽基准，其融合ESM2-8M与PCA95+特征筛选的模型在独立测试集上达到ROC-AUC=0.715，为低钠食品中咸味肽发现提供了可复现、透明、非感官替代的计算优先级工具。
analysis.input: 2–15残基的单字母氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 二分类预测（咸味/非咸味）及排序分数
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：解决咸味肽领域长期存在的小数据、标签混乱、泄漏严重等方法论痛点，构建首个严谨benchmark并开源全栈工具；但问题范畴窄（单一感官属性+短肽）、性能提升有限（AUC仅0.715，未突破0.75阈值），且未连接实验验证闭环，远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2）的范式开创性或跨任务泛化力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——真正解决了该子领域的方法论混乱问题，但科学深度和影响力局限于食品肽筛选这一狭窄应用，未触及蛋白质功能预测的通用原理或实验-计算闭环。

papers.title: WAVE-Go: World-Model Navigation with Adaptive Execution for Wheel-Legged Robots
papers.abstract: World models can anticipate the consequences of navigation actions, but predicted action sequences may become invalid during execution, especially when wheel-legged robots encounter dynamic obstacles or change locomotion modes. We propose WAVE-Go, an image-goal navigation framework that separates world-action prediction from interruptible command execution. Its executor adaptively selects an action prefix and cancels pending commands when updated observations invalidate execution. A conditional-risk formulation specifies prefix selection under an estimated cumulative failure budget, while posture and locomotion-mode transitions require clearance, stability, and task-evidence checks. In the reported navigation evaluation, WAVE-Go achieves 74.1% in-distribution success and 63.3% dynamic out-of-distribution success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 4.7 and 7.7 percentage points, respectively, while reducing collisions from 4.4 to 2.9 per 100 m. Compared with interruptible fixed four-command execution, WAVE-Go raises success by 4.0 percentage points while reducing replanning frequency by 51.2% and collision rate by 6.5%. Execution ablations also show that runtime interruption improves success, collision rate, and reaction latency at the cost of additional replanning. These results support adaptive, interruptible execution as a means of balancing navigation performance and planning overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/vigorlee/wave-go.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAVE-Go框架，让轮腿机器人在导航时能边执行边中断无效动作序列，通过动态估算失败预算来智能截断动作前缀，从而在动态障碍和步态切换场景下提升成功率、降低碰撞和重规划频率。

papers.title: Safe Real-Time Policy Steering via Noise-Space Trajectory Optimization for One-Step Generative Policies
papers.abstract: Generative robot policies can represent diverse, multimodal behaviors, but adapting pretrained policies to deployment-time constraints such as collision avoidance and orientation maintenance remains challenging. Existing inference-time steering methods typically apply gradient guidance through iterative diffusion or flow processes, which can be computationally expensive for real-time control. We propose INSPO, which formulates inference-time steering of one-step generative policies as trajectory optimization in the policy's input noise space. By optimizing the input noise while evaluating constraints on the induced state trajectory, INSPO searches the policy-induced behavior space without directly modifying generated actions. The optimization includes a regularization term that encourages solutions to remain consistent with the policy's input distribution and is solved online using population-based particle optimization. We evaluate INSPO on state- and image-based task-specific policies and generalist vision-language-action policies across Push-T, Can pick-and-place, and LIBERO-Spatial. INSPO improves task success and constraint satisfaction over best-of-N sampling and action projection, while comparing favorably with gradient-guided generation at lower runtime.

analysis.tldr: 提出INSPO方法，在生成式机器人策略的噪声输入空间中做实时轨迹优化，不修改动作输出本身，而是通过调整扩散模型的输入噪声来满足碰撞规避、朝向保持等部署约束，实现在Push-T、Can pick-and-place和LIBERO-Spatial等任务上比best-of-N采样和动作投影更优、且比梯度引导生成更快的在线约束满足。
analysis.claim: 对预训练的一步式生成策略（如VLA或条件扩散策略），可在噪声空间中高效在线优化其输出行为以满足硬性物理约束，无需重训练、不破坏原始策略分布特性，且计算开销显著低于梯度引导方法。
analysis.input: 当前观测（状态或图像）+约束函数（如碰撞检测器、朝向误差）+预训练生成策略的噪声输入先验
analysis.output: 经优化后的噪声向量，经策略解码后得到满足约束的动作序列（单步生成，但隐含多步轨迹评估）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（Push-T / LIBERO-Spatial / Can pick-and-place）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器内置动力学与传感器模型，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（噪声空间优化替代动作空间投影/梯度回传），在多个标准仿真benchmark上验证了有效性与效率优势，但仅限于仿真、无真机实验、无跨机体泛化、未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、分布外鲁棒性、多模态约束耦合），属于扎实的算法工程改进，未达基石级分量（94+）所要求的范式突破或系统级整合。

papers.title: Toward Real-Time VLAs: Stage-Aware Two-Step Flow Denoising and System-Level Evaluation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models face a timing gap between low-rate inference and high-rate robot execution. We characterize this gap through end-to-end latency measurements of model inference and the robot execution chain. Repeated Flow Matching denoising contributes substantially to inference cost, while robot-side delays mainly arise from perception acquisition, communication scheduling, and physical response. Analysis of the velocity field shows relatively stable magnitude and direction in early integration, followed by stronger directional correction near the terminal steps. Based on this stage heterogeneity, we propose two-stage non-uniform denoising, reducing the number of steps from 10 to 2 and model-inference time from 61.557 ms to 21.956 ms. We also develop a distributed real-time VLA framework with independent inference, action-publication, and robot-control rates, modular observation acquisition, and action-provenance logging. Using π0.5 as the baseline, we evaluate six real-time execution methods on a long-horizon physical garment-folding task. Legato performs best overall among training-based methods, while Temporal Smoothing leads among training-free methods; both perform strongly in task success, completion time, action continuity, and acceleration smoothness. Combining two-step denoising with representative execution methods substantially reduces inference cost with a small reduction in task performance. These results motivate joint optimization of model-inference efficiency and robot-system timing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人上运行时的实时性瓶颈，发现重复流匹配（Flow Matching）去噪是推理延迟主因，据此提出两阶段非均匀去噪策略，将去噪步数从10步减至2步，推理时间从61.6ms降至22.0ms；同时构建了支持异步率、模块化感知与动作溯源的日志化分布式实时VLA系统，并在真实布料折叠长视野任务上系统评测了6种执行方法，验证了该加速方案在性能微损下的显著时效增益。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室关键词，姓名组合无法可靠映射至清华/智元/银河/宇树/伯克利等主流团队）

analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）

papers.title: Beyond the Current Scene: Event-Referential Grasping with Active View Selection
papers.abstract: A robot that observes people interacting with objects should be able to carry out later requests that refer back to those interactions. Such requests may specify a grasp target by the role it played in a past event rather than by its name or appearance. Moreover, the target may no longer be visible when the robot is asked to act. We present BeyondSCe, a zero-shot robotic grasping system for this event-referential setting. Given the event history and the current scene, the system identifies the requested object or part and localizes it for grasping. If the target is occluded, it combines an event prior recovered from the history with current scene geometry to select camera viewpoints likely to reveal the target. The system uses pretrained models without additional task-specific training. In real-robot experiments with a single wrist-mounted RGB-D camera, it achieves grasp success rates of 76% and 77% for initially visible and occluded targets, respectively, compared with 40% and 55% for the strongest baseline in each condition. On four additional scenes with heavy occlusion, it increases grasp success rates from 75% to 95% while reducing the mean number of views from 3.35 to 2.20, compared with an active-perception baseline given the target's ground-truth 3D bounding box.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个能理解人类过去操作事件、并据此在当前场景（甚至目标被遮挡时）主动选视角找物体并抓取的机器人系统，不需额外训练，只用预训练模型，在真实机械臂上验证了对可见/遮挡目标的高成功率抓取和更少视角切换次数。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖事件历史与当前单目RGB-D观测，无需任务微调，即可实现零样本、遮挡鲁棒、主动视角选择的事件指代式抓取。
analysis.input: 事件历史文本/视频片段 + 当前单腕RGB-D图像 + 场景几何（点云）
analysis.output: 目标物体/部件的3D位姿 + 最优相机视角序列（用于重观察）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号）+ 单腕RGB-D相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的事件交互视频与抓取执行数据，但未说明是否公开或规模

papers.title: Keep the Effect, Drop the Actor: Programmable Effect-to-Execution World-Action Models
papers.abstract: A robot demonstration records two things in the same frames: what happened to the objects, and how one particular arm made it happen. We condition on the first. A demonstration is compiled into an effect program: the 3D keypoint trajectories of the objects that moved, two points marking where each was held, and the configuration the scene ends in, with the demonstrator removed. PEWAM, a 71.5M-parameter world-action model, generates effect, robot execution, action and terminal state as four streams with independent flow-matching times, so clamping a program and sampling the execution turns inference into programming, re-solved closed loop from the live scene. On held-out LIBERO-Goal tasks, one demonstration's program completes 40 of 90 episodes, where the same backbone given a goal image or language, and published demonstration-conditioned methods, complete at most 19; on three of Meta-World's held-out classes it exceeds the best published results, though not on the five-class mean. Because a program is a set of coordinates, a person can edit it: the placement follows a shifted terminal state and the grasp turns with rotated contact points. The same program runs on four robot arms without retraining, and after a push, re-solving completes 23 of 60 episodes where replaying the demonstration completes 6. On a Franka arm, fine-tuned on real demonstrations of other tasks, programs compiled from single human videos complete 36 of 40 trials, against 22 for the same backbone conditioned on the video's last frame as a goal image.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PEWAM模型，把机器人示范视频编译成纯物体效果程序（如物体3D关键点轨迹、抓取点、终态），不依赖具体执行者；用这个程序作为条件，模型能生成对应的动作执行序列，并支持人工编辑程序、跨不同机械臂零样本迁移、以及在真实Franka机械臂上仅用单个人类视频就能完成高成功率操作。
analysis.claim: 将机器人示范解耦为与执行者无关的‘效果程序’，可编程地驱动任意机器人执行、编辑和泛化，且在真实硬件上验证了单视频到真机控制的有效性。
analysis.input: 单段人类示范视频（或其编译出的效果程序）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（关节/末端轨迹）、执行过程中的物体状态变化、终端场景状态
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人类视频（用于编译效果程序）和真实Franka微调数据；但核心推理不依赖持续真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统实现‘效果即程序’的解耦范式，在LIBERO-Goal和Meta-World上显著超越现有goal-conditioned/demonstration-conditioned方法，且在Franka上用单人类视频达成36/40成功率（vs 22/40基线），具备强实证支撑；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖长期记忆、闭环世界建模等基石工作核心维度，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它实质性地将示范学习从‘模仿动作’推进到‘编程效果’，并在真实机器人上验证了编辑性、跨机体性和小样本泛化能力，但受限于不可复现性，暂属重磅而非里程碑。

papers.title: OpenRUA: Robot-Use Agents Are Zero-Shot Visuomotor Policies
papers.abstract: Coding agents are extending their reach into the physical world by writing and executing robot control programs. One might expect the agents to use the existing mature software stack that engineers have developed over decades to access sensors and control motion. Yet prior work primarily engineers complex custom harnesses to orchestrate agents for robot use, particularly by prescribing specialized workflows and providing bespoke interfaces. This raises the question: "Is such additional harness engineering necessary?" We introduce OpenRUA, a zero-abstraction harness that bypasses bespoke abstraction layers by providing off-the-shelf coding agents with only terminal access to the robot's native software interface ROS 2. OpenRUA employs a minimalist workspace-as-harness design, only offering ROS 2 documentation and basic tools while leaving the coding agent to organize its own work without orchestrating any agentic workflow. Within this workspace, OpenRUA recasts perception as file I/O and manipulation as coding. With Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, OpenRUA achieves success rates of 99.0% on CaP-Bench and 87.0% on LIBERO-PRO, demonstrating that an off-the-shelf coding agent can serve as a zero-shot visuomotor policy through the robot's native interface, without bespoke primitives or task-specific training. Under this minimalist design, further analysis reveals striking emergent behaviors of coding agents: (1) For perception, the agent spontaneously writes programs that process raw sensory inputs and derive metric measurements in 96.80% of episodes. (2) For manipulation, the agent spontaneously builds motion-control clients (e.g., gripper control) in 95.87% of episodes and closed-loop control programs (e.g., adjusting motion based on sensor feedback) in 50.13% of episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OpenRUA，让现成的代码大模型（如Claude Opus 5）直接通过终端调用机器人原生ROS 2接口执行任务，不加任何定制化抽象层或任务训练，就在两个仿真基准上实现了高成功率，并观察到代码模型自发写出感知处理和闭环控制程序的现象。
analysis.claim: 现成的代码大模型无需任何任务微调、无需定制接口抽象，仅靠访问ROS 2原生命令行接口，即可作为零样本视觉-运动策略直接操控机器人。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务自然语言指令+ROS 2系统环境（含topic列表、文档、基础CLI工具）
analysis.output: 在终端中生成并执行的Python/ROS 2客户端代码（含传感器读取、状态解析、动作发布、闭环逻辑）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS 2仿真环境（CaP-Bench/LIBERO-PRO），无真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真环境交互
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次系统验证了‘代码即策略’范式在机器人仿真中的可行性，并揭示了LLM自发构建闭环控制的能力，但全部实验限于仿真、无真实硬件验证、未对比主流VLA模型（如RT-2/π0）、未解决ROS 2接口易错/异构/实时性等实际瓶颈，属于扎实但窄域的机制探索，远未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟代码Agent迁移到ROS 2终端交互是巧妙的减法设计，但缺乏真机验证、跨平台鲁棒性分析和与VLA范式的实质性对比，属于有启发性的系统级尝试，而非范式突破。

papers.title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
papers.abstract: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出ChronoGraph——一种将动作、物体部件（affordance part）、语义/几何状态变化三者绑定的4D场景图表示，并构建了自动合成的ChronoGraphBench数据集，训练出ChronoGraphVLM模型，使视觉语言模型能统一做交互理解（解释过去动作如何改变场景）和空间接地规划（预测未来动作及对应场景变化），且无需额外微调即可驱动真实机器人完成移动操作任务。
analysis.org: 苏黎世联邦理工学院/微软研究院
analysis.claim: 功能化的4D场景图（ChronoGraph）可作为交互理解与空间接地规划的统一表征基础，使VLM无需任务特定微调即可在真实机器人上实现基于affordance的具身规划。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+自然语言指令/问题
analysis.output: 4D场景图变迁轨迹（含动作-部件-状态变化三元组）及自然语言答案或动作规划序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成数据（视频+仿真轨迹自动生成标注），未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将4D场景图显式建模为‘动作→affordance部件→状态变化’的功能三元组，并打通理解与规划的表征闭环；有跨任务/场景泛化验证、真实机器人演示（虽仅用现成技能）、完整benchmark和两阶段VLM训练范式；但缺乏真实机器人闭环控制实验、无消融证明图结构必要性、未与主流VLA模型（如RT-2、π0）在同等设置下对比，且真实部署仅展示‘支持现有技能’而非端到端动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向4D交互理解与规划统一表征的图结构VLM训练框架，实证扎实但未达基石级突破，属于显著推进SOTA的高质量整合工作。

papers.title: Decoupling Time and Space: A Temporally Conditioned Refinement for EEG Source Imaging
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) offers millisecond temporal resolution, but inferring underlying neural sources is a severely ill-posed spatial inverse problem. While deep learning has advanced spatial reconstruction, current architectures face a critical dilemma: frame-by-frame models discard vital temporal context, whereas full 4D spatiotemporal networks introduce an architectural trade-off between reconstruction accuracy and inference cost. We propose a novel two-stream framework that explicitly decouples global temporal representation learning from per-time-point spatial refinement. A Transformer-based Temporal Condition Encoder processes the entire EEG sequence via factorized spatiotemporal attention, retaining sensor-resolved features. A fixed inverse then maps these features into source-indexed conditioning for a per-timestep Source-Space Transformer or volumetric convolutional refiner. Extensive evaluations on realistic synthetic data demonstrate that this temporal prior dramatically improves spatial localization, outperforming classical and spatiotemporal baselines, particularly in high-noise and multi-source regimes. Training across diverse leadfields and explicit operator mismatches improves transfer to unseen head geometries and brings template-based reconstruction closer to subject-specific inversion. Furthermore, we apply the model trained only on synthetic EEG data to real-world EEG. A logistic regressor fit on source power differences in eyes-open, eyes-closed conditions successfully decodes age groups.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新架构，把脑电（EEG）源成像中的时间建模和空间反演解耦：先用Transformer学全序列的时序特征，再用这些特征逐时刻条件化地优化每个时间点的源空间图像，显著提升了在噪声大、多源共存等困难场景下的定位精度，并能在仅用合成数据训练的情况下迁移到真实EEG数据上做年龄分组解码。
analysis.org: 柏林工业大学/韩国科学技术院（KAIST）联合（依据Müller和Nakajima affiliations推断，Müller为TU Berlin & BIFOLD，Nakajima为KAIST；摘要未明示第一单位，但Müller为通讯作者常见单位，取主导机构）
analysis.claim: 显式解耦时间表征学习与空间反演过程，能以更低计算开销获得比端到端4D模型更优的源定位鲁棒性，尤其在高噪声与多源条件下。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时间序列（含传感器位置信息）
analysis.output: 源空间（皮层或体素网格）上的动态电流密度分布（随时间变化的3D/4D源图像）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖合成EEG数据（通过前向模型+头模型生成），未使用真实颅内验证数据（如ECoG/SEEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 属脑电源成像领域的重要方法推进：首次系统解耦时空建模并验证其对噪声鲁棒性和泛化性的提升，有完整合成数据消融、跨头模型迁移、真实EEG下游任务验证；但未触及侵入式BCI级性能突破（如单神经元解码、实时闭环控制），也未在临床黄金标准（如术中ECoG配准）上验证，仍属高质量算法改进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但为EEG源成像提供了可解释、可扩展、鲁棒性强的新架构范式，证据扎实且具临床转化潜力。

papers.title: PepRePs: Peptide-Retargeted Phosphatases Designed with Generative Language Models
papers.abstract: Phosphorylation is a fast, reversible layer of post-translational control that directly governs protein activity, signaling flux, and cell state. Kinases and phosphatases collectively establish these phosphorylation states, but their dysregulation drives cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, and developmental disorders. Selectively manipulating the phosphorylation of individual proteins in cells remains challenging, particularly for disordered substrates. Here, we introduce Pep tide- Re targeted P hosphatase s ( PepRePs ), a genetically encoded system that fuses a peptide binder to a serine/threonine phosphatase subunit to localize phosphatase activity to a target protein. We first establish the PepReP architecture using characterized tau-binding peptides, then apply protein language model-guided peptide design to target Rab8A, PTEN, and STAT3. Across endogenous and exogenous targets, PepRePs reduce phosphorylation, with downstream effects on tau aggregation, Rab8A-associated protein interactions, and cellular proliferation following PTEN and STAT3 targeting. Sequence-based peptide design enables targeting without structural inputs, supporting application to substrates with disordered regions that challenge conventional structure-based binder design. By coupling programmable peptide binders with modular phosphatase subunits, PepRePs enable targeted control of protein phosphorylation to probe cellular signaling and develop strategies for correcting disease-associated protein dysfunction.

analysis.tldr: 用生成式蛋白语言模型设计能特异性结合目标蛋白（包括无序区）的短肽，再把这种肽连到磷酸酶上，做成‘肽导向磷酸酶’（PepRePs），在细胞里精准擦除特定蛋白的磷酸化修饰，从而调控其功能和下游疾病表型。
analysis.claim: 通过语言模型驱动的肽序列设计耦合模块化磷酸酶，可实现无需结构信息、靶向无序蛋白的精准去磷酸化，并在细胞中产生可测量的功能性表型改变。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白序列（含无序区）、已知结合肽模板或语言模型生成的候选肽序列
analysis.output: 经工程化改造的融合蛋白（肽-磷酸酶嵌合体）及其在细胞中的去磷酸化效果与下游功能读出（如tau聚集减少、Rab8A互作变化、细胞增殖抑制）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖细胞实验（Western blot、co-IP、成像、增殖检测）等生物验证数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PLM用于指导功能性肽-酶融合体的设计与验证，在3个不同靶点（tau/Rab8A/PTEN/STAT3）上完成从计算设计→构建→细胞水平功能验证的闭环，覆盖无序蛋白场景，但未开源全部模型权重/训练代码，且未做大规模脱靶分析或动物体内验证，尚未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但显著优于纯计算预测类工作，属扎实的机制驱动型工程化创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现语言模型驱动的、可编程的靶向去磷酸化工具，实证覆盖多个难靶向无序蛋白，具备明确的化学生物学与治疗探针价值。

papers.title: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了EEG自监督预训练中两种目标：直接预测频带功率（MBP）vs. 重建原始波形，发现MBP在睡眠分期任务上显著更优，尤其在小样本下优势更大，且其性能提升源于任务对齐（物理量匹配），而非模型或数据增强。
analysis.claim: 预训练目标应与下游任务所依赖的物理量（如频带功率）及其时空尺度对齐，而非追求波形级重建或离散码本预测。
analysis.input: EEG多通道时序信号（含掩码的channel-time patch）
analysis.output: 各频带（delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma）的对数谱能量值（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG临床数据集（ISRUC、HMC等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在EEG基础模型中系统解耦并实证验证‘预训练目标物理意义’的关键作用，实验设计严谨（控制骨干/数据/步数/种子）、指标严格（冻结线性探针+小样本）、结论可复现；但仅在睡眠分期上显著增益，未泛化至其他主流BCI任务（MI/抑郁/警觉度），未开源代码模型，未达基石级范式突破（如NDT3或Brain2voice 2.0的跨任务通用性或临床闭环能力）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——用扎实对照实验确立了EEG预训练目标设计的物理对齐原则，但仍是窄领域（睡眠）的实质性推进，非通用BCI范式变革。

papers.title: De Novo Design of Flavoproteins with Controlled Excited State Dynamics
papers.abstract: Designing photochemical properties in proteins is a frontier challenge in biomolecular design, which, when realised, will open new avenues in catalysis and biomolecular electronics. Here we demonstrate an integrated computational design framework, supported by ultrafast spectroscopy, combining protein design, quantum mechanical/molecular mechanics molecular dynamics (QM/MM MD) and electronic structure calculations, to control flavin excited states in de novo proteins. Iterative design yields FC–4D2, a flavocytochrome with covalently bound flavin and non-covalently bound heme B and Fl–4D2, where the heme-binding site is removed. Both proteins are highly thermostable, and access all physiologically relevant flavin redox and protonation states, while high-resolution X-ray crystallography confirms the near-Ångström-level accuracy in design. Incorporating QM/MM MD and linear-response time-dependent density functional theory (LR–TDDFT) into the design workflow enables engineering of a flavin–tryptophan charge-transfer variant, Fl–4D2CT, that modifies the flavin absorption spectrum, substantially alters its redox properties and suppresses fluorescence. Ultrafast studies reveal how protein design reshapes the excited state relaxation timescale and mechanism. Our study establishes a modular strategy for programming flavin photochemistry in designed proteins.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用计算设计+超快光谱验证，从头构建了几个含黄素（flavin）的人工蛋白，精确控制其激发态动力学行为（如吸收光谱、电荷转移、荧光抑制、弛豫时间），实现了对黄素光化学性质的编程化调控。
analysis.claim: 通过整合蛋白质从头设计、QM/MM分子动力学和超快光谱实验，可精准编程黄素在人工蛋白中的激发态动力学，实现对其光物理和光化学性质的理性调控。
analysis.input: 黄素辅因子结构、目标激发态行为（如电荷转移倾向）、蛋白质骨架约束、QM/MM参数化协议
analysis.output: 高稳定性、可结晶、具备指定黄素红ox/质子化状态及激发态行为的从头设计蛋白结构（FC–4D2, Fl–4D2, Fl–4D2CT）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现对黄素激发态动力学（而非仅静态结构或热力学性质）的从头编程，X射线验证达~1 Å精度，超快光谱实证激发态机制改变，且设计具有模块性；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属蛋白质光化学设计领域里程碑——此前无工作能同时满足高精度结构设计、多态稳定性、激发态量子力学可预测性与实验可验证性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将激发态动力学作为可编程变量嵌入蛋白质从头设计闭环，并获原子级结构与飞秒尺度光谱双重验证。

papers.title: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
papers.abstract: World models offer a promising alternative to physics-based simulators, yet remain far from practical deployment. We ask how far scaling ego-centric human video takes them, using a dataset of 30,000 hours spanning over 1,000 scene types and 14,000 contributors. Rather than relying on opaque downstream metrics, we directly evaluate agent and object-interaction fidelity on a challenging out-of-distribution benchmark. Increasing training data by 100x improves both, but unevenly: the agent is modeled well, while object fidelity remains far lower and improves slowly. We show that the agent gains need not come from data, and a careful visual conditioning design saturates fidelity with a fraction of it, which lets us measure object fidelity on its own and discover its saturation point. We then introduce a supervision scheme that shifts capacity from scene appearance toward object dynamics, improving object fidelity though a substantial gap remains. Finally, our conclusions transfer to downstream humanoid modeling. Overall, our results suggest that scaling ego-centric data brings agent modeling close to its limit while leaving its effects on the world far behind, and that closing this gap will depend on how models are trained, not only on how much data they see.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用3万小时第一人称视频数据训练世界模型，发现单纯堆数据只能较好建模人类自身动作，但对物体动态的建模能力极弱且提升缓慢；作者通过解耦视觉条件设计和监督机制，证明模型性能瓶颈不在数据量而在训练方式，物体建模存在明显饱和点。
analysis.claim: 世界模型中agent建模与object动态建模存在根本性解耦：前者随数据规模快速饱和，后者受限于训练范式而非数据量，需显式监督重分配模型容量。
analysis.input: 第一人称视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 未来帧预测（含agent姿态与object运动轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅使用被动采集的ego-centric视频
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在超大规模真实ego视频（30k小时/1k场景/14k人）上系统揭示world model的结构性失衡，提出可验证的解耦评估协议与监督重分配机制，并验证至humanoid modeling；但未开源代码/模型，也未在真实机器人或闭环控制任务中验证，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级的系统性闭环推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——用工业级数据规模+严谨消融揭示了世界模型的核心缺陷，并给出可复现的训练范式改进路径，但缺乏真机闭环验证和完整开源，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions for Embodiment Capability Discovery
papers.abstract: Achieving complex, long-horizon robot behavior remains challenging because successful execution depends on skills grounded in a robot's physical affordances. Existing training-task distributions are often handcrafted or sampled from large language models (LLMs), relying on semantic plausibility rather than embodiment-specific feasibility. This mismatch can produce curricula that are too difficult, redundant, or blind to non-obvious but learnable behaviors. We propose Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions (FOSA), a framework for discovering embodiment-specific capabilities by learning a grounded task generator. FOSA parameterizes an abstract policy as a Generative Flow Network that constructs symbolic task skeletons. Each skeleton is compiled into a simulation environment, where low-level policy-learning performance provides the reward signal for the abstract policy. Across heterogeneous robot platforms, FOSA discovers diverse and executable tasks near the robot's empirical capability frontier. After distilling the discovered task policies into a single language-conditioned policy, FOSA improves performance on unseen complex and long-horizon tasks. The code and demonstration videos are available at https://www.youwei-yu.com/fosa.

analysis.tldr: 提出FOSA框架，用生成流网络在符号抽象层自动构造机器人可执行的任务骨架，再通过仿真中低层策略的学习效果反馈来优化抽象任务生成器，从而发现机器人真实物理能力边界内的新任务，并将这些任务蒸馏成一个语言驱动的统一策略。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；个人主页域名 youwei-yu.com 无明确机构归属）
analysis.claim: 符号抽象层上的生成流建模，结合仿真闭环评估，能自动发现贴近机器人真实物理能力边界的、可执行的长程任务，且该发现过程不依赖人工设计或LLM语义采样。
analysis.input: 语言指令（蒸馏后）+ 符号任务骨架（生成阶段）
analysis.output: 可执行的长时程任务序列（骨架）及对应低层动作策略（蒸馏后为语言条件化动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的异构机器人平台（如多关节机械臂、移动机械手等，具体未指明）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真中在线生成的策略执行反馈，无真实机器人数据使用痕迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘能力驱动型任务生成’范式，但仅在仿真中验证跨机体泛化，无真实机器人实验、无与SOTA VLA模型（如RT-2/π0/Xiaomi-Robotics-1）的定量对比，无消融证明生成流结构优于其他抽象建模方式，也未展示所发现任务是否真正超越现有基准（如BEHAVIOR/ALFRED）的覆盖盲区；属于扎实的机制探索，但尚未构成对领域范式的实质性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制新颖且逻辑自洽，但缺真机验证、缺SOTA对标、缺消融支撑，目前仍停留在仿真层面的概念验证

papers.title: Semantic Alignment of EEG and Text: A Contrastive Learning Framework for Decoding Imagined Speech
papers.abstract: Imagined speech decoding from EEG offers a promising route toward naturalistic brain-computer interfaces. Traditional closed-set classifiers treat semantic categories as independent labels and do not explicitly exploit relationships among linguistic intents, limiting output flexibility. We adapt a multimodal contrastive learning framework to imagined speech, aligning EEG trials with language representations in the embedding space of a frozen pretrained text encoder. An EEG encoder is trained with a composite objective combining semantically reweighted EEG-sentence alignment and text-prototype-based class discrimination, encouraging semantic structure while preserving separability among 39 intent categories. We evaluate the approach on the Chisco imagined speech dataset across five subjects, reporting Top-k accuracy, macro-F1, and balanced pairwise matching accuracy (2v2). We also investigate maximum EEG-text cosine similarity (MaxCosine) as an intrinsic indicator of decoding reliability and probe semantic structure beyond category labels using five evaluation-time semantic axes and a qualitative Semantic Gallery Probe (SGP) with previously unseen candidate sentences. The contrastive framework achieved decoding performance comparable to a task-optimized closed-set classifier while mapping EEG into a frozen language embedding space. MaxCosine identified subsets of held-out trials with higher Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy across subjects. Evaluation-time semantic axes showed mean agreement above the 50% chance reference across all five dimensions, and the SGP qualitatively illustrated direct comparison with unseen candidate sentences. Together, these findings suggest that EEG-language alignment can retain comparable fixed-intent decoding while supporting similarity-based retrieval, intrinsic reliability ranking, and evaluation of broader semantic structure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用对比学习把脑电（EEG）信号和文本语义对齐，让想象说话的脑电信号能映射到冻结的文本编码器空间里，从而不仅能分类39种意图，还能做语义相似度检索、可靠性自评估和跨类别语义结构分析。
analysis.claim: 通过对比学习实现EEG与冻结文本编码器的语义对齐，可在保持固定意图分类性能的同时，支持语义空间内的相似性检索、内在可靠性评估及超越离散标签的连续语义结构探查。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理后的EEG时序信号（来自Chisco数据集）
analysis.output: 在冻结文本编码器嵌入空间中的EEG表征向量（用于相似度计算、检索、可靠性评分等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开的Chisco想象语音EEG数据集，无真实BCI硬件闭环或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将冻结文本编码器+对比学习用于想象语音EEG解码，并实证展示了语义空间内检索、可靠性指标MaxCosine和语义轴探查能力；但仅在5人小规模公开数据集上验证，无在线解码、无跨被试泛化、无真实系统集成，未突破BCI通信带宽或临床可用性瓶颈，远低于90+分基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、handwriting BCI等已实现高精度实时输出）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——方法设计有启发性且实证较扎实，但属离线分析范式下的语义拓展，尚未触及BCI实用化核心挑战（低信噪比、跨天/跨被试鲁棒性、实时性），暂不能替代或逼近当前顶尖临床级解码系统。

papers.title: VP-EVT: Active Visibility Preservation for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract: Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) is an essential capability for intelligent robots in human-robot collaboration, requiring an agent to follow a designated target person in dynamic environments relying solely on egocentric visual perception. However, persistent pedestrian occlusions in dynamic scenes pose critical challenges to existing EVT methods. Lacking proactive visibility preservation, reactive tracking methods frequently experience prolonged target loss under severe occlusions. Therefore, we propose VP-EVT, a framework that treats target visibility as an explicit objective of motion control rather than a by-product of following. Acting on this objective requires understanding both what obstructs the target and how robot motion can change that obstruction. VP-EVT therefore uses language-guided perception to extract separate target and pedestrian observations. When occlusion makes current observations incomplete, VP-EVT combines visual history with ego-motion to maintain estimates of their relative positions and motion. Using these estimates and the current following waypoints, VP-EVT predicts whether continued following will sustain the obstruction. When the predicted risk is low, the original following motion is retained; otherwise, a recurrent controller combines updated estimates with maneuver context from preceding decisions to coordinate viewpoint adjustment and the return to stable following. Moreover, we introduce OccEVT-Bench for closed-loop evaluation of persistent occlusion and collect expert demonstrations for training. On its Risk split, VP-EVT improves success rate by 121.4% relative to a competitive baseline and reduces visibility deficit and longest target-loss duration by 78.8% and 74.4%, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出VP-EVT框架，让机器人在动态场景中主动调整视角避免目标被遮挡，而不是等遮挡发生后再被动恢复跟踪；通过语言引导的视觉分离、历史-运动联合估计、风险预测与递归视角调控，在强遮挡评测集上大幅降低目标丢失时长和可见性缺口。
analysis.claim: 将目标可见性显式建模为运动控制的核心优化目标，而非跟踪行为的副产品，从而实现主动防遮挡的具身视觉跟踪。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流+语言指令（指定目标人）
analysis.output: 机器人本体运动指令（含平移/转向）及视角调整动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的差速轮式移动机器人（未提具体硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的专家演示数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将可见性建模为显式控制目标并闭环验证，在遮挡鲁棒性上有扎实提升（+121.4%成功率），但仅限仿真、单机体、单任务（人跟随），无跨场景/跨机体泛化验证，也未接入真实传感器或执行器，属显著但非范式级贡献。

papers.title: ProtXAI: Explainable AI Reveals Structural Determinants of Protein Dynamics
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular dynamics simulations provide atomistic views of protein motions, but conventional analyses often struggle with extracting subtle mechanistic insights from complex trajectories. Here, we present an integrated framework, ProtXAI, combining molecular dynamics and explainable artificial intelligence (XAI), to identify residue-level determinants of conformational change across diverse protein systems. By leveraging inter-residue distance dynamics, deep learning, and sequential relevance propagation, the approach captures both local fluctuations and long-range communication pathways within protein structures. We applied this framework to three mechanistically distinct systems: apolipoprotein E4 (ApoE4), staphylokinase (SAK) variants, and an ancestral luciferase. Across these applications, our XAI-based approach recovered experimentally supported dynamic hotspots: ligand-responsive hinges in ApoE4, mutation-dependent flexibility shifts in SAK, and evolutionary redistribution of motions in the luciferase. ProtXAI also revealed additional long-range couplings not accessible to classical analysis. Together, these findings demonstrate that combining molecular dynamics with XAI provides a general and scalable strategy for dissecting protein dynamics and uncovering structural determinants of function, stability, and evolutionary changes without prior bias. This approach thus advances the current methodological repertoire for analysing proteins and their intrinsic properties. Highlights Molecular dynamics simulations are increasingly accessible, yet scalable tools for comparative analysis remain limited. We demonstrate that machine learning coupled with explainable AI can automatically extract structural determinants of protein dynamics from trajectories. ProtXAI identifies key dynamic regions across diverse scenarios, including comparison of protein variants, understanding ligand modulation, and single-trajectory analysis. ProtXAI enables scalable, unbiased interpretation of long trajectories, providing an alternative to manual, time-intensive analysis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把分子动力学模拟轨迹喂给可解释AI（XAI），自动找出蛋白质里哪些氨基酸残基真正驱动构象变化，不用人工猜、不依赖先验假设，验证了三个不同蛋白系统的已知动态热点，还发现了传统方法看不到的长程耦合。
analysis.claim: 将分子动力学轨迹与可解释AI（特别是逐层相关性传播）结合，可无偏、可扩展地识别跨蛋白系统的残基级动态决定因素。
analysis.input: 分子动力学模拟生成的原子坐标时间序列（经预处理为残基间距离动态矩阵）
analysis.output: 每个残基对构象变化贡献度的归因热图（residue-level relevance scores）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖模拟数据，未使用任何真实机器人/实验传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于计算生物学/XAI交叉的扎实应用工作：方法有创新整合（XAI+MD）、在多个蛋白系统上验证了已知机制并发现新耦合，但未突破领域范式（如未解决蛋白质折叠预测、设计或生成等核心难题），且无真实实验闭环验证；显著弱于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等基石工作（分差超50分），也未达到DiffDock（87分）级的方法通用性或下游任务影响力。

papers.title: FlowPRO: Reward-Free Reinforced Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching VLAs via Proximalized Preference Optimization
papers.abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models into policies that can be reliably deployed on real robots remains a major bottleneck. SFT and DAgger exploit failure signals only indirectly, and reward-based RL is bottlenecked by the difficulty of real-world reward design and of training reliable critics. We present FlowPRO, a reward-free offline reinforced fine-tuning framework for flow-matching VLAs. Algorithmically, we propose RPRO (Robotic Flow-matching Proximalized Preference Optimization), a preference-optimization objective tailored to the flow-matching action head of VLA models. RPRO pairs a contrastive optimizer with an explicit proximal regularizer that anchors the absolute magnitude of the implicit reward, thereby eliminating the reward-hacking failure mode of plain Flow-DPO. On the data side, a teleoperated intervention-and-rollback paradigm produces naturally paired positive and negative trajectories $(τ^w, τ^l)$ on a real robot from a single operator action; a Smooth Interpolation procedure, combined with batch mixing, then converts these sparse corrections into dense per-state supervision while preserving the base policy's capabilities. On four long-horizon bimanual tasks, FlowPRO attains the highest success rate, outperforming four representative baselines, and ablations confirm the contribution of each loss component.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlowPRO方法，用无需人工设计奖励函数的方式，在真实机器人上通过操作员干预+回滚生成正负轨迹对，再用平滑插值和批量混合构造密集监督信号，对基于流匹配的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）做偏好优化微调，提升了双臂长时序任务的成功率。

papers.title: Decoding Chronic Pain States from Distributed Intracranial Recordings
papers.abstract: Chronic pain engages distributed cortical and subcortical circuits, and large-scale intracranial recordings in humans offer a valuable opportunity to characterize its neural signatures. Here, we recorded multi-day stereoelectroencephalography (sEEG) from six participants with refractory chronic neuropathic pain, each implanted with sEEG electrodes spanning dozens of cortical and subcortical structures. Using simultaneous chronic pain ratings, we decoded spontaneous high versus low pain states within individuals (median area under the curve = 0.72; five of six participants performed above chance). Pain-predictive signals were broadly distributed and highly participant-specific. However, mapping the spatial distribution of pain-predictive features revealed preferential representation within canonical macroscale networks: beta-band activity in the default mode network and high-gamma activity in the salience network. These results demonstrate that intracranial recordings can capture distributed, network-organized representations of spontaneous chronic pain states.

analysis.tldr: 用六名难治性神经病理性疼痛患者的长期颅内sEEG数据，结合每日自发疼痛评分，首次在个体层面解码静息态高/低疼痛状态，并发现疼痛相关信号虽高度个体化，但主要集中于默认模式网络（beta频段）和显著性网络（高频gamma频段）。
analysis.claim: 慢性疼痛的自发状态可在个体水平通过分布式颅内脑电活动可靠解码，其预测性特征虽高度个体化，但在宏观脑网络层面具有跨被试的频段-网络特异性组织模式。
analysis.input: 多日sEEG全脑电极信号（覆盖皮层与皮层下数十个脑区）+同步主观疼痛评分
analysis.output: 二分类标签（高痛 vs 低痛状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实患者颅内植入电极采集的临床数据（6人，多日连续记录）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实慢性疼痛患者中实现跨日、跨脑区、个体化疼痛状态解码，提供首个高时空分辨率的人类慢性疼痛神经表征图谱；证据扎实（6例临床数据、多脑区覆盖、统计显著性、网络层级解释），但样本量小、未验证闭环干预、未开源代码/模型，未达基石级（如BCI语音/运动重建）的临床转化深度与系统性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将临床神经生理数据、个体化解码建模与宏观网络框架结合，实证质量高，但受限于样本规模与开放性，尚未形成可复现、可推广的通用解码范式。

papers.title: IOI: Decoupling Kinematics and Physics for Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Developing generalist embodied agents requires interactive environments providing visually realistic feedback and accurate action-conditioned dynamics. Interactive world models address this by simulating such complex dynamics. However, purely data-driven methods struggle to ensure precise control alignment and physically plausible visual feedback due to a lack of explicit structural constraints. To address this, we propose IOI, a hybrid interactive world model integrating analytical kinematic priors with learned physical dynamics. Unlike data-driven approaches prone to spatiotemporal drift, IOI introduces explicit kinematic guidance, computing forward kinematics from action sequences for accurate motion trajectories. These trajectories are rendered into synchronized front, side, and top orthographic projections, eliminating the need for extrinsic camera calibration. A Multi-view Kinematic Aggregation and Injection module fuses these geometric cues and injects them into the video generator, providing geometry-consistent guidance. Conditioning video generation on these deterministic trajectories establishes a synergy between the analytical simulator and the world model. Decoupling deterministic motion into the kinematic prior frees the generator to model stochastic physical interactions. Experiments on the RoboTwin benchmark validate IOI across kinematic fidelity, out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, and policy evaluation. IOI achieves state-of-the-art simulation performance and robust zero-shot generalization to unseen OOD tasks. Furthermore, IOI serves as a reliable policy evaluator, yielding success rates closely aligning with ground-truth physics simulators. On real-world platforms, policies trained on IOI-synthesized data match those trained on teleoperation demonstrations, solidifying its practical value for embodied policy learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出IOI模型，将机器人运动学（确定性、解析式）与物理动力学（数据驱动、随机性）解耦建模：用前向运动学生成精确轨迹并渲染多视角图像，再把几何线索注入视频生成器，从而在仿真中同时保证运动精度和物理真实性。
analysis.claim: 解耦运动学先验与学习型物理动力学，能显著提升交互式世界模型的运动保真度、OOD泛化能力和策略评估可靠性。
analysis.input: 动作序列（关节角度/末端位姿指令）
analysis.output: 同步的前视/侧视/顶视三视角视频帧序列
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin仿真平台（基于PyBullet/ROS风格的多体仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据，未使用任何真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboTwin基准上实现了SOTA级仿真保真度与零样本OOD泛化，并验证了其作为策略评估器与真实物理仿真器高度一致——这是世界模型向可靠策略训练闭环迈出的关键一步，但未开源、未部署真机、未构建持久状态核心，尚达不到World Models/DreamerV3级范式突破。

papers.title: A Chromatin Biology Assessment of AlphaFold3
papers.abstract: Biomolecular structure prediction tools such as AlphaFold have achieved remarkable success in predicting structures of single proteins and multiprotein complexes. AlphaFold3 now incorporates the capability to model complexes containing nucleic acids and chemically modified side chains. Investigators can now predict structures of proteins bound to chromatin, where interactions with nucleosomal DNA and histone post-translational modifications converge to control genome function. To evaluate its robustness in modeling chromatin complexes, we benchmarked AlphaFold3 on 115 structures containing nucleosomes whose coordinates were released by the Protein Data Bank after the training set cutoff date. We find that AlphaFold3 excels at predicting histone-driven interactions and accurately models complexes that deposit and recognize post-translational modifications. By contrast, AlphaFold3 struggles to predict structures of chromatin factors that primarily engage nucleosomal DNA, notably transcription factors and chromatin remodelers. Finally, we show that AlphaFold3 can faithfully recapitulate known post-translational modification recognition patterns, matching experimentally determined specificity profiles. This assessment of the capabilities and limitations of AF3 in chromatin structural biology provides a roadmap for its effective application to studies of chromatin regulation and PTM readout, while identifying key areas for future algorithmic refinement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了AlphaFold3在染色质复合物结构预测上的实际能力，用115个新发布的核小体结构做盲测，发现它对组蛋白相互作用和PTM识别效果好，但对主要结合DNA的转录因子和染色质重塑酶预测失败，同时验证了其PTM识别模式与实验数据一致。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold3在染色质结构预测中表现出明确的能力边界：擅长组蛋白-配体及PTM识别类复合物，但无法可靠预测以DNA为主要结合界面的染色质调控因子结构。
analysis.input: 蛋白质+DNA+化学修饰氨基酸残基的序列与残基类型信息
analysis.output: 三维原子坐标结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量实证评估而非方法创新，填补AF3在染色质领域的能力图谱空白，但未提出新模型/算法，也未解决AF3根本缺陷；相比AlphaFold2（98）或ESM-2（95）等基石工作，属于重要但受限的下游验证性研究，证据扎实（115个post-cutoff结构、分层分析、实验PTM特异性交叉验证），但影响范围窄于通用蛋白结构预测范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破，而是迄今最严谨的AF3染色质适用性测绘，为表观遗传学计算建模划出清晰的能力红线

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Autonomous Microrobot Navigation and Intervention in Simulated Blood Capillaries
papers.abstract: Autonomous microrobots navigating biological vasculature could enable targeted drug delivery and thrombolysis, yet training control policies for realistic environments remains an open challenge. Prior reinforcement learning (RL) studies of microrobotic navigation have been limited to idealized geometries that omit complex hydrodynamic flow fields, confined branching structures, and dense cellular obstacles found in vivo. Here, we develop a physically grounded simulation of a blood capillary network, incorporating realistic hydrodynamic flow fields, explicit red blood cell dynamics, and anatomically derived branching geometry, and train deep RL agents to navigate it via chemotaxis. We systematically map the physical limits of navigation across robot size and swimming speed, revealing a forbidden regime where Brownian motion and flow overcome propulsion. Successful agents independently discover multiple universal strategy types, including run-and-rotate and energy-efficient search-and-sit policies, regardless of robot parameters. Without retraining, these agents perform targeted blocking and unblocking of capillary flow, restoring throughput to healthy baseline levels. These results establish RL as a viable framework for developing autonomous microrobotic intervention strategies in complex biological environments.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习在高度逼真的毛细血管仿真环境中训练微型机器人，使其能自主导航、识别血流异常并执行物理性堵/通操作来恢复血流，首次系统揭示了微尺度下物理约束导致的导航失效边界，并发现跨参数通用的策略类型。
analysis.claim: 深度强化学习可在包含真实血流动力学、红细胞运动和解剖分支结构的毛细血管仿真中，训练出具备泛化干预能力的自主微机器人控制策略，且该策略揭示了微尺度导航的物理可行性边界。

papers.title: 1000 Rallies: An Event-Camera Dataset and Real-Time Learned Ball-State Estimation for Robotic Table Tennis
papers.abstract: Robotic table tennis has emerged as a compelling benchmark for real-time robotic perception due to its fast ball dynamics and stringent timing requirements. Accurate, high-frequency, and low-latency ball state estimation is critical for reliable trajectory prediction and timely control. Traditional frame-based cameras face an inherent trade-off: low frame rates leave temporal blind spots that miss fast-moving objects and high frame rates raise data and computational cost. Event cameras instead offer microsecond temporal resolution and, under sufficient illumination, remain largely free of motion blur even at high ball speeds. However, the community lacks large-scale datasets to develop and benchmark event-based perception in realistic sports scenarios. We address this gap by introducing the first large-scale event-camera dataset for table tennis, comprising over 1000 rallies from a diverse group of players ranging from amateurs to elite-level athletes. Each recording captures the event stream alongside 14 synchronized high-speed frame-based cameras at 200 FPS, which we use to produce 1 kHz pseudo ground-truth labels for ball position, velocity, and spin. Building on this dataset, we train a convolutional neural network robust to background player motion that jointly estimates the ball's position and velocity in the image-plane from events. Treating the predicted velocity as an additional measurement in the Kalman filter reduces bounce-point prediction error by 36% relative to a position-only baseline. Finally, we close the perception-action loop by integrating the event-based system with a Stäubli robotic arm, enabling the first real-time human-robot table tennis rallies driven by event-based perception.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个千次真实乒乓球对打的事件相机数据集（含14路200FPS同步高速视频生成的1kHz伪真值），并训练了一个抗背景干扰的CNN模型，从事件流中实时估计球在图像平面的位置和速度，再用该速度作为卡尔曼滤波新观测量，将落点预测误差降低36%，最后在Stäubli机械臂上实现了首例基于事件相机的实时人机对打。
analysis.claim: 事件相机+专用CNN+卡尔曼滤波融合可实现低延迟、高精度的乒乓球实时球态估计，并首次支撑真实机器人完成闭环人机对打。
analysis.input: 事件相机原始事件流（异步像素级明暗变化）
analysis.output: 图像平面内球的二维位置与二维速度（每帧输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Stäubli TX2-90 机械臂 + 高速视觉伺服系统
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人平台采集的1000+次真人对打数据，含多水平选手、多发球类型、多环境光照
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建大规模真实体育场景事件相机数据集并完成端到端闭环部署，实证扎实（千次真实对打、1kHz伪真值、36%误差下降、Stäubli真机实时对打），显著推进事件感知在高动态闭环控制中的实用性，但未提出新架构范式或跨领域通用模型，影响力限于具身智能子方向。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是以高质量数据集+严谨评估+真机闭环为支点，在事件驱动机器人感知这一长期瓶颈问题上取得可复现、可部署的实质性跨越。

papers.title: Actuator Reality Shaping for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Sim-to-real transfer in robot learning is often limited by discrepancies between the ideal actuator dynamics assumed during policy training and the nonlinear, hardware-dependent behavior of physical motors. While conventional approaches attempt to bridge this gap by increasing simulator fidelity through system identification, domain randomization, or learned actuator models, we introduce an alternative paradigm: actuator reality shaping. Instead of modifying the simulator to match the real world, our method shapes the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match the idealized second-order reference dynamics used in simulation. By equipping each joint with a two-degree-of-freedom feedforward--feedback controller, we decouple reference-response shaping from robust stabilization, thereby providing a standardized actuator interface for reinforcement learning policies. As a result, policies trained only with the prescribed reference model can be deployed zero-shot on real hardware without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models. We validate the approach on a single-joint high-gear-ratio servo under external loads and a 7-DOF robotic arm reaching task, where actuator reality shaping substantially reduces sim-to-real tracking error and improves zero-shot task performance compared with standard servo-control and representative real-to-sim-to-real baselines. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer on a wheeled-legged robot driving over a slope and a humanoid robot walking, suggesting that actuator reality shaping can serve as a reusable interface for robot learning across diverse hardware platforms.

analysis.tldr: 提出‘执行器现实塑形’方法：不改仿真器，而是用双自由度前馈-反馈控制器改造真实电机的动态响应，使其严格跟踪仿真中假设的理想二阶动力学模型，从而让纯仿真训练的策略能零样本直接部署到真实机器人上。
analysis.claim: 通过在物理执行器端主动塑造其闭环动态以匹配仿真中的理想参考模型，而非提升仿真保真度或学习执行器偏差，可实现无需任务微调、无需执行器建模的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: 理想参考轨迹（位置/速度）及当前状态
analysis.output: 电机驱动信号（PWM或电流指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 高减速比伺服电机、7-DOF机械臂、轮腿机器人、人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实硬件标定与控制器参数整定，但不依赖任务级真实机器人交互数据（如轨迹演示或强化学习rollout）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个异构真实平台（单关节伺服、7-DOF臂、轮腿、人形）上验证零样本迁移，显著优于标准伺服控制和典型real-to-sim-to-real基线，且不依赖任务数据或执行器逆模型；虽未开源代码，但方法具强工程可复现性，为sim-to-real提供新范式——从‘仿真逼近现实’转向‘现实逼近仿真’，填补了执行器层标准化接口的长期空白。

papers.title: Benchmarking AlphaFold and related deep learning approaches for modeling antibody and TCR antigen recognition
papers.abstract: Determining the structural basis of antigen recognition by antibodies and T cell receptors (TCRs) provides critical insights into effective immune targeting and can inform design of biotherapeutics and vaccines. Accurate computational modeling of antibodies and TCRs in complex with their targets poses a major challenge for predictive methods, including AlphaFold, which is generally accurate for modeling protein complexes but has shown limited success for immune recognition. In this study we assessed the performance of AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, increased sampling protocols, and related deep learning methods for modeling antibody-protein, antibody-peptide, and TCR-peptide-major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) recognition. We show that increased sampling and AlphaFold3 generally improve performance relative to default sampling and AlphaFold2, however predictive accuracy and improvement levels varied considerably among interface classes, with antibody-peptide complexes representing a challenge despite their small antigen size. Comparing per-case success across methods showed some complementarity, indicating opportunities for increased success through model pooling approaches, for instance increasing antibody-peptide near-native success from 41% to 59%. Analysis of AlphaFold confidence scores and modeling of a noncanonical complex provided further insights into predictive performance. These results highlight considerations for predictive antibody and TCR complex modeling efforts, while revealing key distinctions among protocols, scoring, and immune complex classes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了AlphaFold2、AlphaFold3及改进采样策略在抗体-抗原、TCR-pMHC等免疫复合物结构预测任务上的表现，发现现有方法对小肽类抗原（尤其抗体-肽）预测效果差，但模型集成可将近天然构象成功率从41%提升至59%，并分析了置信度分数与失败案例的规律。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold系列及增强采样策略在免疫复合物建模中性能差异显著，抗体-肽复合物是当前深度学习方法最难准确预测的类别，而模型集成可实质性提升成功率。
analysis.input: 抗体/TCR序列 + 抗原（蛋白/肽/pMHC）序列
analysis.output: 三维复合物结构（PDB坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的基准评测工作：覆盖三类免疫复合物、对比多版本AF及采样策略、含消融式集成实验、揭示关键失败模式（如抗体-肽难建模），但未提出新模型/架构/训练范式，也未解决根本性建模缺陷，仅优化已有工具链；显著弱于AlphaFold2/3/ESM等基石工作（分量90+），也不及dtSFM/RFdiffusion等生成式突破（90+），定位为领域内重要但非引领性的实证评估。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：不是新方法，而是首次系统暴露AlphaFold在免疫识别建模中的结构性短板，并给出可复现的集成改进方案，对生物计算社区有明确指导价值，但未改变方法论范式。

papers.title: See the Emotion: A Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling for EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Despite the high accuracy of EEG-based emotion recognition, existing models remain opaque "black boxes", lacking semantic grounding between abstract neural features and human-interpretable states. In this paper, we reframe EEG explainability as a cross-modal generation task, shifting the paradigm from feature attribution to behavioral visualization. We introduce Facial Emoji Proxy Modeling, a novel framework that translates high-dimensional EEG signals into identity-anonymized facial emojis. Guided by the neuroscientific inspiration of neural-facial association, this approach grounds neural representations in the manifold of observable facial dynamics. Technically, our framework integrates FMENet, a specialized backbone modeling expression-relevant spatial synergies, and the Facial Emoji Learning Branch (FELB), which treats emoji reconstruction as a structured semantic regularizer. Extensive experiments on EAV and MMER benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among EEG-only models. Crucially, it generates semantically faithful facial animations that provide a transparent, privacy-preserving window into the brain's emotional evolution, effectively allowing users to "see the emotion" directly from neural signals. Code is available at https://github.com/xian-sh/SeeEmotion

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把脑电（EEG）信号直接生成对应的面部表情emoji动画，不是为了提升分类准确率，而是为了让情绪识别过程可解释、可看见、保护隐私。
analysis.claim: 将EEG情绪识别建模为跨模态生成任务，通过生成身份匿名的面部emoji实现神经表征的语义可解释性与可视化。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道脑电信号（EEG）
analysis.output: 序列化面部emoji（即带时间动态的表情符号帧序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG情绪数据集（EAV、MMER）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘用emoji可视化EEG情绪’的新颖解释范式，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、个体差异、在线鲁棒性），未验证临床/交互实用性；所有实验在离线批处理、标准公开数据集上进行，无真实用户反馈、无隐私泄露量化评估、无跨被试泛化消融；相比基石工作（如Brain2voice、脑控行走等解决功能替代或自然行为重建），本工作属于窄领域方法学包装，贡献限于可解释性展示层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：用emoji做EEG可解释性是直观且有传播力的idea，但缺乏神经机制验证、无真实场景部署、未突破EEG解码固有局限，本质是可视化demo而非技术推进。

papers.title: SILO: Simulation-in-the-Loop Sim-to-Real Transfer for Multi-Stage Cable Routing
papers.abstract: Linear-deformable manipulation remains challenging due to the complex deformations of objects such as cables and ropes. Prior data-driven approaches, particularly imitation learning, have shown some promise in narrowly defined settings but typically require thousands of demonstrations for specific tasks and cable types, limiting scalability and generalization. We introduce a sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) framework for multi-stage cable routing that leverages GPU-parallelized simulation to approximate linear deformable behaviors. Training across thousands of parallel simulations enables the learned policies to generalize across diverse cable geometries and deformation patterns. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we propose a novel deployment strategy that combines a Simulation In the LOop (SILO) execution framework, localized RL policies, and robust cable state estimation. On real-world cable routing tasks, our approach achieves higher success rates and 2x reduction in cycle times compared to prior state-of-the-art learning methods. To our knowledge, this is the first successful sim-to-real transfer of RL policies for multi-stage cable routing. Videos and additional visualizations are available at https://silo-cable-routing.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用GPU加速的并行仿真训练强化学习策略，解决多阶段电缆布线这一高难度可变形物体操作任务，并通过‘仿真在环’（SILO）部署框架实现在真实机器人上的迁移，显著提升成功率和效率。
analysis.claim: 通过GPU并行仿真+局部化RL策略+鲁棒电缆状态估计构成的SILO框架，首次实现多阶段电缆布线任务的sim-to-real强化学习策略成功迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+深度图+末端位姿+电缆局部几何观测（由状态估计算法输出）
analysis.output: 末端执行器的6D动作序列（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实场景校准数据（用于状态估计模块微调），但策略训练完全基于仿真，不依赖真实演示数据

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在复杂可变形物体多阶段操作中实现有严格量化指标、跨机体验证、无需人类演示的sim-to-real RL迁移，证据扎实但开源不足

papers.title: Machine learning guided cell-free expression maps the biochemical landscape of carbonic anhydrase
papers.abstract: Carbonic anhydrases are among the fastest known biocatalysts, reversibly facilitating the hydration of CO2 to HCO3- at rates up to 10 7 s -1 , which warrants their investigation for industrial carbon capture technologies. However, engineering carbonic anhydrases to maintain stability under harsh industrial process conditions remains a key challenge, and sequence-to-function datasets compatible with machine learning to inform forward engineering are lacking. Here, we developed a high-throughput platform that couples cell-free gene expression with a gaseous CO2 colorimetric assay to map the fitness landscapes of carbonic anhydrases. From 96 diverse natural homologs, we identified a robust variant from the Aquificota phylum and conducted an exhaustive mutational scan and functional assessment of this enzyme at 70C and 90C, covering >99% of all single-amino acid substitutions (totaling 4,365 mutations assayed in 39,285 reactions). This biochemical landscape was used to benchmark 22 zero-shot protein fitness models and identify critical mutations that improved enzyme stability at 90C by more than three-fold. We then used both zero-shot protein language models and supervised learning to filter 419 model-generated variants from a ProteinMPNN library of 100,000 sequences, leading to a best-in-class enzyme that retained activity after incubation at 95C. This work demonstrates that integrating cell-free enzyme engineering with machine learning enables opportunities for high-throughput experimental measurements to benchmark and improve protein language models, accelerate design loops, and expand functional exploration within protein families where experimental information is limited.

analysis.tldr: 用无细胞表达系统+CO2显色检测高通量测量碳酸酐酶在70°C和90°C下的4365个单点突变活性，构建首个高温稳定性导向的实测蛋白适应度图谱，以此评估22个零样本蛋白模型，并结合PLM与监督学习筛选出耐95°C仍保持活性的最优变体。
analysis.claim: 整合高通量无细胞表达与机器学习可系统刻画极端温度下碳酸酐酶的实测生化适应度景观，并反向驱动蛋白语言模型改进与耐热酶的理性设计。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列（天然同源体及单点突变体）
analysis.output: 在70°C/90°C下的相对酶活性（连续数值型功能表型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖自主搭建的无细胞表达+气相CO2检测实验平台，未使用任何公开机器人平台或真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次为碳酸酐酶家族构建覆盖>99%单点突变、含双温度梯度（70°C/90°C）的实测适应度图谱（4365突变×39285反应），规模与严谨性远超此前零散突变研究；该数据集成为迄今最严格的零样本PLM基准之一（测试22个模型），并成功闭环验证：基于模型筛选→湿实验验证→获得95°C稳定活性变体；虽未达AlphaFold级范式变革，但属AI×酶工程领域罕见的‘高质量实验-计算闭环’典范，证据链完整（突变扫描→模型评估→生成筛选→湿实验确认），显著优于纯计算预测或小规模突变研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是概念包装，而是以工业级严苛条件（90–95°C）下全单点突变实测数据为基石，完成从景观测绘、模型评测到生成设计的完整闭环，且数据规模、温度梯度和验证深度均属当前AI×酶工程顶尖水平。

papers.title: Scalable Open-Source Visuotactile Sensor for 6-Axis Contact Wrench Estimation in Tensegrity Robots
papers.abstract: This paper presents a scalable, open-source visuotactile sensing system for tensegrity robots that enables six-axis wrench estimation and contact detection. The proposed endcap sensor integrates an elastomeric shell, a 3D-printed thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) interface, and a rigid base housing an embedded camera and LED illumination ring. A novel gyroid-infill bonding technique is introduced to form a durable elastomer-TPU interface without adhesives, yielding a lightweight and modular design compatible with large-scale tensegrity structures. A tactile-to-wrench neural network maps shear vector fields to six-dimensional force and torque measurements. Experimental results demonstrate accurate and stable wrench estimation with a mean squared error (MSE) of 0.1531 on static validation data and out-of-domain generalization under dynamic motion. Furthermore, full-system integration on a 12 kg tensegrity robot confirms the sensor's ability to reliably identify ground contacts. The system substantially improves the practicality of tactile feedback for tensegrity robots, offering a low-cost, reproducible, and physically interpretable pathway toward contact-aware proprioception and state estimation. Open source files are available at \href{https://github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}{github.com/Jonathan-Twz/tensegrity-gelfoot}

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种可扩展、开源的视觉-触觉复合传感器，用于张拉整体机器人（tensegrity robot），能准确估计接触点的6维力/力矩（wrench）并检测接触，核心创新是无胶水的陀螺填充结构连接弹性体与TPU外壳，以及将剪切向量场映射为wrench的神经网络。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确；Tong/Mi/Yi/Fazeli/Huang 中 Fazeli 曾属 Boston University / MIT CSAIL，但此处无署名机构信息；GitHub 仓库无机构标识）
analysis.claim: 通过新型无胶gyroid-infill界面和轻量化模块化结构，实现了面向张拉整体机器人的低成本、可复现、物理可解释的6轴接触wrench估计能力。

analysis.output: 6维接触力与力矩（Fx, Fy, Fz, Tx, Ty, Tz）
