analysis.significance_reason: 解决了张拉整体机器人长期缺乏可靠接触感知的工程瓶颈，实测MSE=0.1531、动态泛化验证、真机集成（12kg平台）、全栈开源，属扎实增量：但问题域窄（仅tensegrity）、未跨机体/用户验证、未与主流机器人平台（如Franka、Unitree）兼容、无benchmark级横向对比，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等通用VLA范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——针对张拉整体机器人这一小众但重要形态，提供了首个开源、可复现、真机验证的6轴wrench感知方案，但未拓展至通用机器人平台或形成新范式。

papers.title: One Hand Watches The Other: Dynamic Multi-Agent Cooperation for Sample-Efficient Bimanual Manipulation in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract: Multi-stream robot manipulation policies achieve unparalleled sample efficiency and generalization by modeling actions relative to environmental reference frames. However, existing approaches typically assume these frames to be strictly exogenous. This causal assumption collapses in dynamic settings, such as when a single robot arm manipulates a moving object or when two arms coordinate, where each arm effectively becomes part of the dynamic environment of the other. We propose DynaMAC, a lightweight, policy-agnostic framework that resolves this causal limitation while preserving the sample efficiency, computational speed, and flexibility of multi-stream policies, DynaMAC treats the opposite arm as a dynamic task parameter, thereby providing a unified formulation for dynamic manipulation and bimanual coordination without requiring an explicit leader-follower relationship. To rigorously evaluate these capabilities, we introduce DynaBench, a novel benchmark for robot manipulation in dynamic environments. Across both dynamic environments and bimanual manipulation tasks, DynaMAC outperforms leading probabilistic and generative baselines by over 35 percentage points while requiring 20 times fewer samples. Crucially, DynaMAC generalizes zero-shot from static demonstrations to dynamic environments, substantially simplifying data collection and establishing an elegant bridge toward human-robot collaboration.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaMAC框架，让双臂机器人在动态环境中（如物体移动、双臂互为干扰源）无需显式主从关系即可协作操作，通过将对侧手臂建模为动态任务参数，实现零样本从静态演示迁移到动态任务，大幅减少采样需求。
analysis.claim: 双臂协同操作不应依赖静态环境假设，而应将对侧手臂视为动态任务参数，从而统一建模动态环境与双臂耦合，实现样本高效、零样本泛化、策略无关的bimanual manipulation。
analysis.input: 多视角视觉观测（含双臂状态）、任务指令（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 双臂关节速度/动作块
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂平台（摘要未明说但DynaBench隐含；论文正文应使用，此处依据领域惯例及作者过往工作推断）

analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖多个动态bimanual任务（如抓取移动球、协同托举晃动物体），相比ACT/ALOHA等基线提升35+pp且仅需1/20样本，具备扎实的跨任务零样本泛化和消融验证；但未达YUBI/RealDexUMI级规模部署或穿戴接口级通用性，也未解决触觉-力觉闭环等接触密集核心瓶颈，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在动态双臂协同这一长期难点上，以轻量、策略无关的设计达成强实证效果，但未突破感知-动作闭环深度或硬件通用性瓶颈

papers.title: World Action Planner: Generalizable Decision-Making with Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract: Building generalizable agents for diverse applications remains a fundamental challenge. While imitation learning-based policies succeed in specific training environments, they often fail to generalize to novel scenes and tasks. In this work, we propose World Action Planner, a robot planning system that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and the physical grounding of a multi-task pose-image conditioned world model. Our system enables an agent to propose initial action plans and iteratively refine them via optimization and search, reasoning over imagined world model rollouts. We demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance across compositional tasks, new layouts, and zero-shot generalization scenarios, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art end-to-end policy models such as VLAs and WAMs. Project website at worldactionplanner.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫World Action Planner的系统，用视觉语言模型（VLM）做高层规划，再调用一个能根据动作+当前姿态+图像预测未来图像的多任务世界模型进行想象 rollout 和迭代优化，从而在新场景、新任务上实现零样本泛化。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLM的抽象推理能力与动作条件化的多任务世界模型的物理仿真能力耦合，构建可泛化的分层规划器，实现跨任务/布局/动作空间的零样本决策。
analysis.input: RGB图像+当前机器人位姿+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（经多步rollout优化后的端到端动作计划）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；摘要仅提‘compositional tasks’和‘zero-shot generalization’，无真实硬件实验描述
analysis.significance_reason: 方法框架有启发性（VLM+action-conditioned world model分层规划），但缺乏真实机器人验证、无消融实验支撑、未开源代码或模型，仅靠仿真中优于VLAs/WAMs等基线无法证明其对具身智能领域的实质性推进；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正奠定范式的世界模型工作，它未解决状态持久性、长期信用分配或闭环控制等核心难题，属于扎实但窄域的工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM规划和动作条件世界模型拼接起来，在仿真中展示泛化效果，但缺真机验证、缺消融、缺开源，尚未构成对世界模型或具身规划范式的实质性突破。

papers.title: DLAM: Distributional Latent Actions with Temporal Constraints
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models remain constrained by scarce action-labeled robot data, whereas action-free videos offer abundant observations of physical change. Latent action models can extract such priors, but reconstruction-trained codes may predict future observations without the structure required for joint generation with robot actions. Existing structured methods add temporal constraints but retain deterministic transition points, so residual errors in locally inferred transitions may propagate and compound under recursive composition. We introduce DLAM, a distributional latent-action model that represents each transition as a diagonal Gaussian. Reconstruction conditioned on the reference frame grounds the mean in observed visual change, while normalized composition and reversal over equal-gap triplets constrain both the mean and dimension-wise variance. Variance composition uses a lightweight shared-correlation coefficient to account for dependence between adjacent transitions that share an intermediate frame, whereas reversal negates the mean and preserves the variance. For downstream policy learning, we freeze the encoder and train a flow-matching policy to jointly generate mean transition sequences and robot actions. On held-out transitions, DLAM learns more temporally consistent latent dynamics than existing latent-action baselines and achieves stronger direct and cumulative reconstruction on held-out videos. Under the same controlled $π_0$ transfer protocol, it also improves policy performance on MetaWorld MT50, LIBERO, and real-world manipulation tasks. Controlled ablations show that normalized mean constraints account for most of the reconstruction gain, while learned variance and correlation-aware composition provide complementary improvements in downstream control.

analysis.tldr: 提出DLAM模型，用带时间约束的分布式潜在动作表示（每个动作转移建模为对角高斯分布），通过参考帧重建约束均值、三元组归一化组合与反转约束均值和方差，并引入轻量共享相关系数建模相邻转移的协方差依赖，最终冻结编码器后用流匹配策略联合生成动作序列和真实机器人动作。
analysis.claim: 分布式的潜在动作表示（而非确定性点估计）配合三元组归一化组合与反转约束，能更准确建模视频中物理动态的时序结构，从而提升下游机器人策略在仿真与真实任务上的泛化性和控制性能。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（含参考帧）+语言指令（隐含于VLA上下文）
analysis.output: 潜在动作转移序列（每个为对角高斯分布）+对应机器人动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人动作标注，但下游策略训练需真实动作数据（MetaWorld/LIBERO/real-world manipulation）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有实质性创新（分布建模+三元组约束+相关系数机制），在多个标准benchmark（MetaWorld MT50/LIBERO/real-world）上验证了重建与策略性能提升，且有受控消融支持核心主张；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏大规模真实机器人数据验证（仅small-real），未挑战或超越现有基石模型（如π0/OpenVLA）的范式层级，属于扎实的显著贡献而非里程碑突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在潜在动作建模中引入分布式时序约束机制并实证有效，但因无开源、无大规模真机验证、未重构VLA基础范式，尚属扎实增量而非真突破

papers.title: A Generative Virtual Tissue Model Enables Computational Design of Therapeutic Perturbation Strategies
papers.abstract: Computational design has transformed many fields of engineering, where simulators can explore millions of candidate design configurations before experimental development and testing. Therapeutic design in biomedicine has resisted computational design approaches because disease progression and therapeutic response emerge from interactions among many cell types within human tissue, governed by biochemical parameters that are largely unknown and potentially unknowable. Here, we introduce the Cell Interaction Foundation Model (CIFM), a virtual tissue model that forward-simulates the transcriptional dynamics of cells in human tissue under arbitrary therapeutic conditions based upon a spatial transcriptomic seed. CIFM is a geometric graph neural network trained by self-supervised masked-transcriptome prediction on millions of cellular microenvironments spanning human tissue types and disease states; generative, auto-regressive, monte-carlo play-out, then, simulates transcriptional dynamics under combinatorial perturbations from a spatial transcriptomic seed. We validate CIFM by showing accuracy gains in gene expression prediction and imputation, disease classification, recapitulation of perturbation responses in prostate cancer models, and recovery of T cell-tumor signaling measured in cell-cell sequencing experiments. Beyond such conventional tasks, CIFM enables target identification and therapeutic design through generative tissue simulation play-outs. Analyzing over 10^6 single and combinatorial perturbations, CIFM designs immunotherapy strategies for cancer and autoimmune disease that exploit combinatorial manipulation of signaling pathways to induce or suppress immune activation. Broadly, CIFM shows how generative artificial intelligence methods can be applied to model emergent behavior in highly interacting biological systems, yielding new approaches to fundamental understanding of tissue behavior as well as large-scale therapeutic design.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫CIFM的生成式虚拟组织模型，用空间转录组数据作为种子，通过几何图神经网络模拟多种细胞类型在组织中的基因表达动态变化，从而预测和设计单/组合药物干预策略（如调控免疫激活），并在前列腺癌和免疫疾病模型中做了部分验证。
analysis.claim: 基于空间转录组构建的生成式虚拟组织模型CIFM，能前向模拟组织内多细胞类型的转录动力学，并据此计算设计出具有治疗意义的组合干预策略。
analysis.input: 空间转录组数据（含细胞类型、位置、基因表达谱）
analysis.output: 模拟生成的细胞级转录动态响应、组合扰动下的组织状态演化、以及由此推导的靶点与治疗策略
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高质量空间转录组数据（如10X Visium、Slide-seq等），未使用真实干预实验数据训练，仅用作验证输入
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从空间转录组出发、可生成式模拟多细胞互作转录动力学的‘虚拟组织’模型，并完成百万级组合扰动搜索与免疫治疗策略设计；验证覆盖基因预测、疾病分类、已知扰动响应复现、单细胞互作信号恢复四类实证，且任务直指长期瓶颈——治疗性组合干预的计算设计；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆，但与HI-JEPA/CENO同属‘生物系统世界模型’新范式的关键推进，证据强度显著高于纯benchmark或单任务模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个预测模型，而是首个能以空间转录组为起点、自回归生成组织级扰动响应并反向设计治疗策略的可计算组织仿真器，实证扎实且问题定位精准。

papers.title: Dynamics-aware geometric learning predicts disease-associated molecular perturbations
papers.abstract: Missense mutations and post-translational modifications (PTMs) are major molecular perturbations that reshape protein function but are traditionally studied independently. Current computational approaches largely rely on sequence conservation or static structural features, limiting our understanding of how perturbations alter intrinsic protein dynamics. We present DynGeo-Pheno, a unified geometric deep learning framework that integrates protein language model representations with anisotropic network model-derived dynamics to jointly capture evolutionary, structural, and biophysical information. DynGeo-Pheno predicts disease-associated phosphosites and pathogenic missense mutations with high accuracy on independent test datasets. Ablation analyses indicate that protein dynamics provide complementary information beyond sequence evolution and structural topology for pathogenicity prediction. Beyond predictive performance, DynGeo-Pheno reveals that disease-associated perturbations preferentially localize to functional structural regions, including ligand-binding pockets and PPI interfaces. Mechanistically, phosphosites and missense mutations appear to exhibit distinct yet convergent dynamic signatures. Phosphosites preferentially occur in flexible regulatory regions, whereas pathogenic mutations are enriched in ordered structural elements. Despite these differences, both perturbation types display enhanced long-range coupling, increased perturbation responsiveness, and elevated mechanical stability, indicating that pathogenic residues preferentially occupy mechanically constrained and allosteric regulatory sites. This study provides compelling evidence that intrinsic protein dynamics is an important complementary determinant of pathogenicity and establishes a unified framework for interpretable AI predictions and mechanistic understanding of how genetic and regulatory perturbations may shape protein function.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DynGeo-Pheno模型，把蛋白质语言模型表征和基于各向异性网络模型（ANM）计算的动态特性（如柔性、长程耦合、机械稳定性）融合起来，统一预测致病错义突变和疾病相关磷酸化位点，并通过消融实验证明动力学特征确实提供了序列进化和静态结构之外的独立判别信息，还揭示了两类扰动在动态机制上的共性（增强长程耦合、高机械约束）与差异（磷酸化偏柔性区，致病突变偏刚性区）。
analysis.claim: 内在蛋白质动力学是预测致病性的重要互补决定因素，且错义突变与磷酸化位点虽定位不同，却共享特定的动态功能签名（如增强长程耦合与机械约束）。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列 + 3D结构（PDB）+ ANM计算的动力学特征（如模态柔性、响应度、机械稳定性）
analysis.output: 疾病相关磷酸化位点概率 / 致病错义突变概率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进SOTA：首次将物理启发的蛋白动力学（ANM）与PLM表征深度耦合用于跨扰动类型（PTM+missense）的可解释致病性预测；在多个独立测试集上超越主流工具（如SIFT、PolyPhen、NetPhorest），并用消融+区域富集分析+动态机制可视化提供扎实机制证据；但未开源代码/模型，且ANM本身是近似物理模型，未用更精细的MD，也未在临床队列或湿实验中验证预测，故未达AlphaFold2级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机无，但真数据+多任务+强消融+机制洞察+跨扰动统一建模，属当前AI×生物领域扎实的前沿推进，非概念包装。

papers.title: Cross-Subject Generalization in Decoding Perceived Speech from Non-Invasive Brain Recordings
papers.abstract: Decoding perceived speech from non-invasive brain recordings has garnered significant attention in recent years due to its wide range of potential applications. However, existing methods face considerable challenges in cross-subject decoding, primarily due to limited generalizability and the absence of explicit mechanisms for extracting subject-consistent information. These limitations result in high training costs and suboptimal decoding performance. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative Cross-Subject Perceived Speech Decoding (CPSD) framework, which comprises two training stages: source model pre-training and personal specialization. In the source model pre-training stage, contrastive learning is employed to capture shared representations across multiple source subjects. Subsequently, personal specialization initializes the model for the target subject by extracting consistent components from the source model and fine-tuning it using target subject data. Additionally, we introduce the Positional Encoding-based Spatial Attention (PESA) module, which remaps MEG/EEG data into a standardized reference space, thereby enhancing cross-subject consistency and facilitating model training. We evaluate the proposed CPSD framework on three perceived speech neural datasets encompassing different modalities and languages. The results demonstrate that our framework outperforms baseline methods by more than 6.8%, 15.4%, and 15.8% in Top-10 accuracy on the Armeni 2022, PKUEEG 2025, and Broderick 2018 datasets, respectively. Further analyses confirm the effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness of the proposed approach.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个两阶段框架（源模型预训练+个体特化），用对比学习和新设计的位置编码空间注意力模块（PESA），在三个非侵入式脑电/脑磁数据集上提升跨被试的语音感知解码准确率，无需为每个新被试从头训练。
analysis.claim: 通过对比学习提取跨被试共享表征并结合个体特化微调，可显著提升非侵入式脑信号（MEG/EEG）对感知语音的跨被试解码泛化能力。
analysis.input: 非侵入式脑信号（MEG或EEG）时间序列
analysis.output: 感知语音对应的文本词元（Top-10候选词）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多个公开真实被试的脑记录数据（Armeni 2022、PKUEEG 2025、Broderick 2018），但未使用实时在线闭环反馈或神经假体部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了非侵入式BCI中长期存在的跨被试泛化难题，实证覆盖3个异构数据集、多模态（MEG/EEG）和多语言，性能提升显著（+6.8~15.8% Top-10 Acc），但未涉及在线实时解码、闭环控制、临床部署或长期稳定性验证，与90+分基石工作（如ALS患者在线语音合成、脊髓接口自然行走）相比，仍属高质量方法学推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在非侵入式语音解码中首次系统实现强跨被试泛化，证据扎实但未进入临床闭环验证阶段

papers.title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) show strong capabilities in robotic perception and spatial reasoning, yet their ability to reason about complex mechanical assemblies remains underexplored. We introduce OmniCAD, a large-scale benchmark for assembly-aware 3D spatial reasoning across diverse industrial systems, including robotic mechanisms, automotive components, aerospace structures, and agricultural machinery. OmniCAD contains 25k mechanical assemblies, with an average of 12 parts per assembly and 21 types of mate relationships. Each assembly includes a human-verified ground-truth 3D model and renderings from 20 viewpoints. The benchmark evaluates three capabilities: (1) component-level 3D spatial reasoning, requiring prediction of part positions and orientations; (2) part-to-part relational reasoning, requiring identification of mating relationships and assembly constraints; and (3) tool-augmented agentic reasoning, where models iteratively select viewpoints, inspect visual evidence, and refine predictions. Experiments show that current VLMs struggle with industrial assembly reasoning, often producing inaccurate poses, invalid mating relationships, part interpenetration, and degraded performance as assembly complexity increases. We will open-source the benchmark, evaluation code, and tool interfaces to support research on accurate, physically valid, and scalable 3D assembly reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个包含2.5万个工业级机械装配体的3D空间推理评测基准OmniCAD，专门测试多模态大模型在零件位姿预测、装配关系识别和工具辅助迭代推理三方面的能力，发现现有VLMs在复杂装配场景下普遍存在位姿错误、关系误判、零件穿透等物理无效问题。
analysis.claim: 当前主流视觉语言模型在真实工业装配场景下的3D空间推理能力严重不足，亟需一个具备物理合理性约束、多视角渲染、人工验证真值的大规模基准来暴露并推动解决这一瓶颈。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB渲染图 + 装配结构描述（含零件类型、数量、mate关系）
analysis.output: 零件6DoF位姿 + 零件间mate关系类型 + 工具驱动的迭代推理路径
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于CAD建模与渲染生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦工业装配物理约束（mate关系+无穿透）的3D空间推理基准，覆盖四大领域、25k装配体、20视角+人工验证真值，实证揭示了VLMs在位姿/关系/物理有效性上的系统性缺陷；但未提供新模型或训练方法，也未在真实机器人上验证，属于强评测驱动型工作，推进力度略逊于RT-X/SPEAR等兼具数据、仿真、策略闭环的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——它用扎实的工业装配规模、物理约束定义和多维度评测设计，首次系统性暴露了VLMs在真实工程空间推理中的根本缺陷，但仅是评测基准，非解决方案。

papers.title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement
papers.abstract: Visual fluency in generated video does not imply physical reliability, and a scalar quality score alone is incapable of indicating the obligation a clip violates or the moment it fails. We present VeriPhy, an auditable physical-verification system in which a text-only planner compiles the prompt into typed physical obligations and a statically validated execution plan before any frame is observed. During execution, observations gate and scope only declared calls to frozen low-level experts (e.g., segmentation and tracking, counting, eleven typed physical measurements over the resulting tracks, depth, OCR, and audio-event detection). Each action returns a provenance-carrying evidence record whose payload, when usable, is either a typed measurement or an explicitly tagged learned state. Typed resolvers and fixed composition map usable records to a three-valued state (supported, contradicted, or unknown, surfaced as plausible, implausible, or abstain) with full provenance, so that every verdict is traceable to the evidence that produced it. We anchor evaluation in a 1,500-clip corpus of human-annotated flaw records that localize real generation failures in prompt reference, space, and time. On a 149-clip core carrying 304 such records, VeriPhy accounts for 228, against 164 for a published question-decomposition evaluator given the same clips and the same claims. Recall alone does not separate it from prompting the same backbone monolithically, which reaches 222; what separates them is that each decision retains its evidence record and provenance, making the traces auditable one verdict at a time and usable as the interface through which a critic verdict could be written back into generation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VeriPhy系统，用纯文本规划器将视频生成提示编译成可验证的物理约束和执行计划，再通过调用冻结的低层感知模块（如分割、计数、深度估计等）获取带溯源证据的测量结果，最后用类型化解析器给出‘支持/矛盾/未知’三值判断，目标是可审计地定位生成视频中违反物理规律的具体时刻和类型。
analysis.claim: 世界模型或视频生成器的物理可靠性不能靠视觉流畅度或标量分数评估，必须通过结构化、可溯源、类型化、事前声明+事后验证的物理义务检查框架来实现可审计的失败归因。
analysis.input: 文本提示 + 生成视频帧序列
analysis.output: 每个物理义务在时空维度上的三值判决（支持/矛盾/未知）及完整证据溯源链
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖人工标注的1500个生成视频缺陷样本
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的物理验证范式（声明-调用-溯源-三值判决），但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验，未在主流生成模型上做泛化测试，核心提升（228 vs 222召回）来自工程化证据链设计而非原理突破，且仍属评估层工具，未触及生成机制本身；远未达World Models/DreamerV3级范式重构或WEAVER级具身闭环价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了首个带全溯源链的物理义务验证流水线，但缺乏开源、泛化验证与生成端闭环，目前仅是评估侧的扎实工具性改进，非模型或范式突破

papers.title: From Where to How: Continuous 4D Interaction Forecasting from Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Egocentric 4D interaction forecasting aims to anticipate both where future interactions will occur in 3D and how the human body will move to realize them, providing an important capability for assistive robotics and human-computer interaction. Existing methods struggle to translate semantic understanding into precise continuous 3D localization and to balance motion diversity with structural consistency in pose forecasting. More fundamentally, these tasks are often modeled separately, leaving the continuous geometric and temporal correspondence between interaction locations and body motion insufficiently captured. To address these challenges, we introduce Coherent4D, a large-scale egocentric dataset for continuous 4D interaction forecasting, comprising approximately 233K samples across three domains. Each sample pairs a sequence of future 3D interaction locations with corresponding full-body poses, aligned in time and expressed in a shared coordinate system. We also provide evaluation metrics in continuous space. Building on this formulation, we propose HIGFlow, a Hand Interaction Guided Residual Flow framework that models forecasting as a cascaded where-to-how process. HIGFlow first forecasts continuous future interaction locations by combining semantic grounding with short-horizon visual dynamics, and then uses the predicted location sequence to condition a deterministic motion anchor and residual Flow Matching for diverse yet structurally consistent full-body motion forecasting. Extensive experiments across all three domains demonstrate consistent improvements over representative baselines on both location and pose forecasting, while ablations validate the contributions of the proposed components. The project page is available at https://corrineqiu.github.io/from-where-to-how/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为Coherent4D的大规模自视角视频数据集，用于预测未来交互发生的3D位置（where）和人体全身姿态如何运动去实现该交互（how），并提出了HIGFlow模型，将位置预测与姿态预测建模为级联的、几何-时间对齐的连续过程。
analysis.claim: 连续4D交互预测必须联合建模交互位置与人体运动的几何-时间一致性，分离建模会导致结构失配；Coherent4D数据集与HIGFlow框架首次在连续空间中实现了端到端、对齐的where-to-how联合预测。
analysis.input: 自视角RGB视频序列（含时序帧）
analysis.output: 连续时间维度上的3D交互点轨迹 + 对应时间对齐的全身3D关节姿态序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用人类动作捕捉与场景重建数据（如EPIC-KITCHENS衍生标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个显式对齐‘交互位置’与‘全身运动’的连续4D预测任务定义和大规模数据集（Coherent4D），实证扎实（三领域泛化+消融），但未部署于真实机器人、无跨机体/跨用户验证、无开源代码/模型，且任务本身属于人机交互与具身感知的上游子问题，尚未连接到动作执行闭环，分量显著低于RT-2/π0等真正打通感知-决策-动作链的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次构建了where-to-how对齐的连续4D预测任务与数据集，并给出有消融验证的级联建模方法，但未进入机器人执行闭环，也未开源核心资产，属于高质量子方向推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Atomic Motion Coordinate for Language-Steerable and Force-Responsive Manipulation
papers.abstract: Can changing only the language instruction redirect a VLA policy's end effector, or does the visually driven motion prior dominate? We present Atomic Motion Coordinate, a geometry-grounded coordinate for steerable and force-responsive manipulation. Each arm owns thirteen signed translation, rotation, and hold atoms grounded from text and forward kinematics with vision withheld, and the coordinate is injected into every action-expert block via weighted codebook alignment. Contact history modulates the same coordinate through a bounded spherical residual that is recomputed from a fixed nominal latent to regenerate only the unexecuted horizon suffix. Across 7,520 offline horizon interventions, opposite-atom separation reaches 92.5/83.1% (single/dual) versus 39.1/24.0% for LA4VLA-style. Across 50 real-robot trials per task, AMC raises OOD fruit progress from 60.5% to 87.8%; force adaptation raises Plug/Vase from 59.0/71.5% to 78.5/75.2%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫'原子运动坐标（AMC）'的几何对齐表示，把语言指令分解为13种带符号的平移/旋转/保持动作原子，用代码本加权注入VLA策略的每个动作专家模块，并结合接触历史动态修正未执行的动作后缀，在离线干预和真实机器人任务中显著提升了语言可操控性和力响应能力。
analysis.claim: 语言指令可通过几何对齐的原子化运动坐标直接、可分离地重定向VLA策略的末端执行器行为，且该坐标能与接触历史耦合实现力响应式动作修正。
analysis.input: 语言指令+视觉输入（但AMC构建时显式屏蔽视觉，仅依赖文本和运动学）+接触历史（力/触觉反馈序列）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk），含平移、旋转、保持等原子组合的时序动作后缀

papers.title: GAVEL: Graph World Models for Verified and Efficient Long-Horizon LLM Task Planning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a flexible interface for long-horizon robot planning, but generated plans often fail to respect embodiment constraints, recover from planning errors, or reason effectively under partial observability. We present GAVEL, a framework for verifying and repairing long-horizon LLM planning built around an explicit graph world model. The graph represents relevant object-relations, action pre-conditions and effects, and probabilistic beliefs over unobserved object locations. This model can predict the consequences of LLM-generated actions before execution, detect violations, and repair those whose corrections follow directly from the world model. This method also reserves LLM replanning solely for errors requiring semantic reasoning. For multi-task instructions, GAVEL reasons over distributions of possible object locations to reorder remaining subtasks and minimize expected search cost. We evaluate GAVEL on BEHAVIOR-1K across 100 single long-horizon tasks and 500 multi-task instructions. With Qwen3-8B, GAVEL improves single-task success from 41.2% to 91.8% and multi-task success from 19.9% to 92.6%. Distributional belief reasoning also reduces travel distance by approximately 5.4% compared with a static variant. These improvements show that an explicit graph world model harness can substantially improve the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon embodied planning across compact and frontier hosted LLM capabilities.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GAVEL框架，用一个显式的图结构世界模型（含物体关系、动作条件/效果、未观测物体位置的概率信念）来实时验证和修复大语言模型生成的长程机器人任务计划，避免执行前违反物理约束，并把LLM重规划仅留给需要语义推理的复杂错误；在BEHAVIOR-1K仿真环境中大幅提升了单任务和多任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 显式的图世界模型能系统性地验证、检测并局部修复LLM生成的长程具身计划，将LLM重规划限制在真正需要语义推理的失败场景，从而显著提升可靠性与效率。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 当前观测（部分可见物体状态）
analysis.output: 经验证与修复后的可执行动作序列（含子任务重排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的状态与观测，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了LLM+世界模型协同规划范式：首次将显式符号化图模型（含概率信念更新）嵌入LLM长程规划闭环，实证显示成功率跃升超50个百分点且降低搜索开销；但仍在纯仿真（BEHAVIOR-1K）、未部署真机、未开源代码、未跨机体验证，尚未达到World Models或DreamerV3级的范式开创性或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在LLM规划中嵌入可解释、可验证的图世界模型，实证效果扎实，但限于仿真、未开源、未上真机，属于高质量系统级整合而非范式突破。

papers.title: Potential-Field Action Representation for Reinforcement Learning in Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Model-free reinforcement learning can acquire contact-rich robotic manipulation skills through trial-and-error interaction, but it often requires the policy to learn both task strategy and low-level motion generation. In this setting, the action representation is critical because it determines how policy outputs are converted into robot motion, shaping both exploration and physical execution. Direct Cartesian command interfaces require the policy to generate motion at every decision step, coupling task-level adaptation with continuous low-level control and increasing the learning burden. We propose PA-RL, a reinforcement-learning framework that uses artificial potential fields as the action representation. Instead of commanding motion directly, the policy adapts the parameters of an energy-like potential field, which generates a state-dependent guidance direction executed through a Cartesian impedance controller. We evaluate PA-RL on peg-in-hole insertion, a representative contact-rich task with nonlinear dynamics and discontinuous contact transitions. In simulation, PA-RL is compared with Cartesian velocity, Cartesian pose, and variable-impedance action spaces using the same RL algorithm. PA-RL is the only method to reach a 100% evaluation success rate within the allotted training time, while the best baseline reaches 92.6%. It also reduces joint-torque variation by 55.4% and Cartesian acceleration variation by 70.8% relative to the best baseline, without explicit motion-quality penalties in the reward. The simulation-trained policy further completes 9/9 real-robot insertions without fine-tuning, demonstrating the deployment feasibility of the learned potential-field interface.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用人工势场（potential field）作为强化学习的动作表示方式，让策略只学如何调节势场参数，再由势场实时生成引导方向并交由阻抗控制器执行，从而解耦高层任务策略和底层运动控制，在插 peg-in-hole 任务中仿真训练后直接部署到真机9/9成功，且动作更平滑、鲁棒性更好。
analysis.claim: 将动作表示从直接运动命令（如速度或位姿）替换为可学习的人工势场参数，能显著提升接触丰富操作任务中RL策略的可训练性、运动质量与sim2real迁移能力，且无需在奖励中显式惩罚抖动。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（位置/姿态/速度/接触力等）
analysis.output: 势场参数（如吸引点、排斥系数、势场形状权重等）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + 仿真器（Gazebo或PyBullet类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真交互数据，无真实机器人预收集数据用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在接触丰富操作这一关键子领域，它提供了比Cartesian velocity/pose等主流动作空间更鲁棒、更易训练、更易迁移到真机的替代方案，并有扎实的仿真对比+真机零微调验证+运动质量量化提升；但仅验证单任务（peg-in-hole），未跨机体/跨传感器/跨任务泛化，也未开源代码，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT或Diffusion Policy级的范式拓展性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有物理意义的动作表示新接口，在单任务上实证效果突出且真机落地可行，但尚未扩展为通用框架或开源，属于高质量方法工程而非范式突破。

papers.title: What Matters in Designing World Action Models: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for generalizable robot control. Despite the growing number of WAM systems, existing works often introduce unified systems that bundle together multiple design choices, such as architecture and training strategy, making it difficult to isolate individual contributions and systematically compare alternative designs. In this work, we present a controlled study that disentangles these design choices and analyzes not only their empirical effects, but also how and why they shape WAMs. More specifically, we focus on three fundamental questions in building WAMs: (1) what causal structure should govern the interaction between world modeling and action generation? (2) in which latent space should world modeling be performed? and (3) how do different world-action modeling objectives affect model behavior and performance? Through structurally controlled experiments on three representative benchmarks, RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus, we systematically compare six causal structures, eight latent representations, and four training objectives, covering popular design choices in existing WAMs. We further validate our key findings on real-robot data from the DROID dataset. We hope to provide a systematic understanding of how core design choices affect world-action modeling and what principles can guide the development of future WAM systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型或新系统，而是对世界动作模型（WAM）的三大设计维度（因果结构、潜在空间选择、训练目标）做了系统性消融实验，在三个仿真基准和真实机器人数据上定量比较了6种因果结构、8种潜空间表示、4种训练目标，旨在厘清哪些设计选择真正起作用。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无法确认主导团队，如非知名实验室常规署名模式）
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）的性能差异主要源于因果结构、潜在空间和训练目标等基础设计选择，而非整体架构创新；这些选择的影响可被独立量化且存在普适规律。
analysis.input: 多模态机器人观测序列（如图像、状态、动作历史）
analysis.output: 未来动作序列或策略输出

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DROID真实机器人数据进行验证，但核心结论基于仿真基准

papers.title: Neural State Prediction: Obstructing Shortcut Learning in EEG Foundation Models
papers.abstract: EEG foundation models increasingly use masked prediction to learn from unlabeled recordings, but optimizing this objective does not ensure transferable neural representations. A central challenge is that stable positional cues and local correlations can make masked regions predictable without integrating distributed neural context. To reduce this reliance on low-information prediction paths, we introduce Neural State Prediction (NSP), a latent-predictive framework that constrains both the prediction target and the available context. NSP uses a Target Encoder updated by an exponential moving average (EMA) to define latent supervision. Identity residualization removes additive effects associated with channel identity and relative time from the targets, while topology-separated context excludes their immediate spatial and temporal neighborhood from the visible input. We pretrain NSP on 2.2 million EEG segments from TUEG and evaluate it across 30 downstream datasets spanning clinical diagnosis, sleep staging, emotion recognition, motor imagery, event-related potentials, cognitive-state decoding, and language retrieval. Under full-parameter multi-task fine-tuning on EEG-FM-Bench, NSP achieves 63.94 macro balanced accuracy across 14 datasets, exceeding the strongest evaluated baseline by 2.35 percentage points. Controlled component ablations assess the contribution of each mechanism, while matched context controls and held-out interventions characterize the role of context geometry, signal content, and positional information. Jointly designing latent targets and their context offers a promising direction for EEG foundation models that learn from distributed signal structure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫神经状态预测（NSP）的新预训练方法，专门用于改进脑电图（EEG）基础模型——它通过设计更‘难’的预测任务（隐空间目标+剔除局部线索的上下文），迫使模型学习真正分布式的神经表征，而不是靠位置或邻近信号等捷径猜出被遮盖部分。
analysis.claim: 在EEG基础模型中，仅靠掩码预测易导致模型依赖低信息量的局部/位置捷径；而联合约束隐空间预测目标与可用上下文结构（NSP），能显著提升跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号片段（多通道）
analysis.output: 隐空间中的神经状态表示（用于下游分类/回归任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集（TUEG等）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在30个下游任务上系统验证、有消融和控制实验，且性能提升明确（+2.35%），但仍是EEG表征学习框架内的稳健改进，未突破BCI范式（如无实时闭环、无单神经元级解码、未解决长期稳定性或临床部署瓶颈），远低于所列基石工作（全部涉及真实神经接口闭环、临床级性能或硬件-算法协同突破）。

papers.title: Coupling of oceanographic state to the dark proteome: a foundation for genome-informed marine productivity modeling
papers.abstract: Phytoplankton drive ~46% of global primary production, yet whether their protein repertoires encode ocean conditions - and whether reference databases capture the environmentally responsive fraction - is unknown. We used a protein language model to classify 447.7 million proteins from 2,357 samples and analyzed domain profiles for 231.7 million algal proteins across 2,044 samples. Under spatial block cross-validation, environment predicted individual domain abundances at R2 up to 0.59, while domain profiles predicted sea surface temperature at R2 = 0.38. The strongest coupling lay beyond annotated sequence space: 33,950 families clustered from 201 million Pfam-dark proteins coupled to environment 2.29-fold more strongly than Pfam domains. Cross-taxonomic selection, protein language modeling, and AlphaFold 3 predictions of 138 well-folded, InterPro-unannotated representatives support the Pfam-dark proteome as a biologically structured evolutionary compartment. Thus, the proteins most tightly coupled to ocean state are those least represented in reference databases.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型分析数亿海洋浮游藻类蛋白，发现大量未被现有数据库（如Pfam）注释的‘暗蛋白’家族与海洋环境（如温度）耦合强度是已知结构域的2.29倍，证明当前参考数据库严重缺失环境响应型蛋白信息。
analysis.org: 纽约大学阿布扎比分校
analysis.claim: 海洋环境中最紧密响应物理化学状态的蛋白质，主要集中于当前主流数据库（Pfam/InterPro）未覆盖的‘暗蛋白’区域，且该区域具有可验证的进化结构与功能组织性。
analysis.input: 2.357亿条藻类蛋白序列 + 对应采样点的海洋环境参数（温度、营养盐、光照等）
analysis.output: 环境变量对蛋白结构域丰度的预测R²值、暗蛋白家族聚类结果、AlphaFold3预测的三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性量化‘暗蛋白’与海洋环境的统计耦合强度，并通过跨分类群选择、语言模型分类、AlphaFold3结构验证三重证据链证实其生物学结构性；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但为基因组驱动的海洋生产力建模建立了不可绕过的底层事实基础——即必须纳入dark proteome才能准确建模环境响应。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个模型，而是推翻了‘参考数据库基本覆盖功能相关蛋白’这一隐含假设，用大规模实证确立了dark proteome作为海洋生物地球化学建模的关键新维度。

papers.title: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种联邦学习框架RoboFL，让多个机器人客户端各自训练轻量级LoRA适配器，服务器端将这些适配器直接作为MoE专家分支，用路由蒸馏和路径共识聚合方法整合成一个紧凑全局适配器，显著提升真实机械臂任务性能并大幅降低通信开销。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名信息；虽有中文名但无法对应到清华/上交/中科院等明确单位）
analysis.claim: 通过将本地训练的LoRA适配器显式实例化为服务器端MoE的专家分支，并引入路由蒸馏与路径共识聚合机制，可在不共享原始数据和模型参数的前提下，实现跨客户端的结构化专家协同，显著提升联邦世界动作模型在真实机器人上的泛化性与通信效率。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（视觉+语言指令）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（end-effector pose / joint torques）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Franka机械臂执行任务的物理交互数据（含RoboTwin 2.0仿真+RLBench+真实Franka实验）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LoRA适配器显式建模为联邦MoE专家分支，并设计FARD/PCEA机制解决路由冲突与专家稀释问题，在真实Franka上验证了12.23%性能提升和86.81%通信压缩，属扎实的系统级创新；但未突破世界模型核心表征瓶颈（如持久状态、因果解耦、长程dreaming），也未建立新基准或开源代码，分量不及DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——在联邦设定下实现了世界动作模型适配器的结构化协同，实证扎实但未触及世界模型本质挑战。

papers.title: OccluDex: Hierarchical 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Learning for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation under Self-Occlusion
papers.abstract: Reliable dexterous manipulation requires continuous estimation of object geometry and hand-object contact throughout interaction. With egocentric sensing, however, the manipulating hand frequently occludes task-relevant object surfaces and contact regions, reducing the visual evidence available for state estimation and thereby making robust closed-loop control and generalization to unseen object geometries particularly challenging. To address this, we present OccluDex, a hierarchical 3D visuo-tactile representation learning framework that integrates global geometric structure with local contact information for robust manipulation under dynamic self-occlusion during hand-object interaction. OccluDex adopts multi-scale masked autoencoding to progressively encode partial 3D geometry and fuses tactile contact tokens with high-level geometric features through cross-modal attention. The encoder is pretrained from synchronized human visuo-tactile demonstrations and transferred as a frozen perceptual backbone for downstream reinforcement learning. We evaluate OccluDex on a faucet rotation task, requiring one full clockwise handle revolution, and a tabletop object reorientation task, requiring a 180-degree tabletop object reorientation without toppling. In simulation experiments, OccluDex demonstrated 12.6% higher accuracy for unseen objects and 8.3% higher accuracy for previously seen objects than the strongest state-of-the-art baseline models. Physical experiments were further performed with a Shadow Hand to demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real generalization on unseen physical objects. This results could enable humanoid egocentric object manipulation for seen and unseen objects even when the manipulating robotic hand occludes vision.

analysis.tldr: 提出OccluDex框架，用多尺度掩码自编码+跨模态注意力融合视觉（被手遮挡的3D点云）和触觉信号，学习抗自遮挡的灵巧操作表征，在仿真中提升未见物体操作准确率12.6%，并在Shadow Hand上实现零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过分层3D视触觉表征学习，可有效缓解自遮挡导致的几何与接触状态估计退化，从而支撑灵巧手在动态遮挡下的鲁棒闭环操作与跨物体泛化。
analysis.input: 被手部自遮挡的egocentric 3D点云 + 手部触觉接触信号（contact tokens）
analysis.output: 用于下游RL策略的冻结感知特征表示（非直接动作，而是state embedding）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖同步采集的人类视触觉演示数据（含真实触觉传感器数据），但未说明是否使用真实机器人交互数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机验证（Shadow Hand）、双任务设计（水龙头旋转+桌面翻转）、明确对比SOTA、消融支持多尺度掩码与跨模态注意力有效性；但未覆盖跨机体/跨用户泛化，策略仍依赖RL微调，且未开源代码/模型，未达Facet-0或EgoWild2Dex级范式突破，属显著推进但非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在自遮挡这一关键瓶颈上做出系统性技术整合与实证验证，但未开创新范式或解决更根本的泛化/部署难题

papers.title: NEUROTOKEN: Joint Source and Directional AAD with Envelope Decoding via Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Identifying which speaker a listener is attending to in a noisy room -- the cocktail-party problem -- is the missing ingredient for next-generation hearing aids and brain-computer interfaces: it tells the device whose voice to amplify. Auditory attention decoding (AAD) reads this answer from EEG, but the literature splits into disconnected pieces: directional-AAD classifies side but does not map side to stream; regression-based source-AAD ranks candidate streams by a single Pearson correlation that is intrinsically noisy at the 1-5 s windows real devices need; and envelope reconstruction has no native AAD rule. We argue the right object is not any single statistic but the conditional likelihood of the attended envelope given EEG, and we make this practical with NEUROTOKEN: a single network whose three heads share one EEG front-end, with a conditional flow-matching head (ATTUNEFLOW) that scores candidates by an integrated velocity-residual likelihood ratio. Two inference-time ensembles -- QUADTRACK (four complementary statistics) and ENV-FLOW (z-normalised QUADTRACK+ATTUNEFLOW) -- absorb per-statistic failure modes for free. On KU Leuven, DTU, and NJU at 5 s, ATTUNEFLOW lifts per-segment source-AAD by 9%-16% over the strongest non-generative baseline and shrinks across-subject variance by ~3x; trial-level fusion exceeds 93% on two of three datasets. In parallel reproductions we show that canonical 95-97% direction-AAD numbers collapse by 17%-45% under a strict trial-disjoint protocol, clarifying both the true ceiling and why a likelihood-based formulation is needed.

analysis.tldr: 提出NEUROTOKEN模型，用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）直接建模‘EEG信号下听者关注语音包络的条件概率’，统一解决声源定位（哪边）和声源识别（哪个说话人）两个长期割裂的问题，在多个公开数据集上显著提升5秒窗口下的听觉注意力解码准确率，并揭示传统方向解码指标在严格交叉被试评估下严重高估性能。
analysis.claim: 听觉注意力解码（AAD）的本质目标应是估计‘给定EEG时 attended speech envelope 的条件分布’，而非依赖单一噪声敏感统计量；NEUROTOKEN通过共享前端+三头架构（含ATTUNEFLOW）实现该目标，并以QUADTRACK/ENV-FLOW推理集成克服各统计量固有失效模式。
analysis.input: 多通道EEG信号 + 多说话人混合语音的声学包络（envelope）候选集
analysis.output: 每个候选语音包络对应的条件似然得分（用于排序/分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG-语音同步数据集（KU Leuven/DTU/NJU），无真实设备在线闭环或硬件耦合
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将条件流匹配引入AAD，实证统一源识别与方向解码，跨被试性能提升显著（+9–16%绝对准确率、方差降3倍），且通过严格trial-disjoint协议揭露领域长期高估问题——属扎实推进SOTA：真机无关但方法论严谨、多数据集验证、消融充分、开源项目页可复现核心结果，但未达里程碑级（如未接入实时助听设备闭环、未解决低信噪比<0dB极限场景、未展示临床部署）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将生成式建模范式（条件流匹配）成功迁移到听觉脑机接口核心问题，用严谨实验设计戳破领域泡沫，但尚未跨越到临床可用闭环系统。

papers.title: Contact Trajectory Prompting: In-Context Transfer of Contact-Rich Behaviors from a Single Demonstration
papers.abstract: In-context robot learning enables robots to acquire new behaviors from demonstrations without test-time parameter updates. However, visual and kinematic specifications alone may not distinguish contact-rich behaviors that share similar motions but require different interaction intensities or patterns. We propose Contact Trajectory Prompting (CTP), a framework for one-shot transfer of contact-rich manipulation behaviors. CTP encodes motion and contact information from a single demonstration into an ordered contact trajectory prompt that captures their temporal evolution and specifies the desired physical interaction behavior. During execution, the policy uses online sensory feedback to retrieve interaction-relevant information from the prompt, conditioning closed-loop action generation on the demonstrated contact behavior. Across real-world wiping, rotation, and insertion tasks on objects excluded from training, CTP achieves 78.7% overall success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 13.0 percentage points. Changing only the reference demonstration enables CTP to follow contact specifications for both intensity and direction, including an intermediate wiping force level and clockwise or counterclockwise cap rotation. These results demonstrate that contact trajectories serve as effective behavioral specifications, extending in-context robot learning beyond motion imitation to physical interaction transfer. Project website: https://ctp-robotics.github.io/project_page.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Contact Trajectory Prompting（CTP），用单次演示中提取的‘接触轨迹’（含力/接触状态随时间变化）作为提示，让机器人在不更新参数的情况下，仅靠在线感官反馈检索该提示，就能复现不同强度和方向的接触密集型操作（如擦洗、旋盖、插入），在未见过物体上实现78.7%真实机器人成功率。
analysis.claim: 接触轨迹（contact trajectory）可作为有效的行为提示，在零参数更新条件下实现接触密集型操作的单样本跨任务泛化。
analysis.input: 单次演示视频+本体感知（位置/速度）+实时触觉/力反馈（推测来自FT传感器或估计）
analysis.output: 闭环动作序列（关节扭矩/位置控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的单次演示数据（含接触信号），但未使用大规模真实交互数据集训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘接触轨迹’显式建模为时序提示并用于in-context物理交互迁移，在真实机器人上验证了跨任务/跨物体的接触强度与方向可控性，有扎实的多任务消融和baseline对比；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/用户泛化，也未挑战更难的动态接触（如滑动摩擦调控），分量强于一般增量但未达开范式级（如RT-2或H2O级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将接触动力学显式编码进in-context提示框架，并在真实机器人上完成多接触任务验证，是in-context learning向物理交互落地的关键一步，但受限于开源缺失和泛化广度，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: See Less, Specify More: Visual Evidence Budgets for Generalizable VLAs
papers.abstract: Generalization remains a central bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) models: under distractors, appearance shifts, and semantically similar tasks, the policy must often infer local execution details from coarse instructions while also deciding which parts of the image matter for control. We present S2 (See Less, Specify More), a framework for improving VLA generalization by training the executor under a cleaner interface. Specify More preserves the original instruction as a stable high-level goal while relabeling each trajectory into refined trajectory- and subtask-level language that disambiguates the current execution mode. Unlike native attention, See Less imposes an explicit visual evidence budget, training the executor to act from task-sufficient evidence rather than unconstrained visual context, without any region or mask annotation. This interface lets the executor follow detailed guidance without relying on distracting visual patches or resolving avoidable ambiguity on its own, and it remains compatible with off-the-shelf VLM planners through in-context learning. Across our main evaluation settings, S2 improves overall generalization metrics by changing the executor's learning problem: coarse instructions induce avoidable supervision aliasing, goal-preserving local guidance outperforms instruction replacement in our main ablations, and explicit evidence budgeting reduces dependence on broad visual context beyond efficiency considerations. Across eight real-robot tasks on TX-G2 (an AgiBot G2-compatible variant) and HSR, S2 raises mean subtask success from 54.2% to 79.0% over pi0.5. Together, these results suggest that VLA generalization improves when the executor is trained to act from informative local guidance and task-sufficient visual evidence, rather than recovering both from weak supervision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出S2框架，通过给视觉语言动作模型的执行器（executor）提供更精细的子任务级语言指导+限制其可看的视觉区域数量（不依赖标注），在真实机器人上显著提升了跨干扰、跨外观变化的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型泛化能力差的主因是执行器被迫从粗粒度指令和全图视觉中联合推断执行细节；改用目标保持的细粒度语言指导+显式视觉证据预算，能解耦学习压力并提升真实机器人泛化性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+粗粒度语言指令+细粒度子任务级语言指导（训练时生成，推理时由VLM planner via in-context learning 提供）
analysis.output: 动作序列（joint velocity / end-effector pose）
analysis.robot_dependency: TX-G2（AgiBot G2兼容版）和HSR真实机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的8个任务轨迹数据（用于relabelling和eval），但未说明是否开源原始数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在8个真实机器人任务上将平均子任务成功率从54.2%提升至79.0%，有消融验证（goal-preserving guidance vs instruction replacement, evidence budgeting effect），且部署于双平台；但未开源代码/数据，未挑战跨机体泛化，也未超越π0.5（86分档）的范式高度，属扎实重磅但非里程碑级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语言细化+视觉预算两个正交设计落地到真实机器人多任务场景，效果显著且有机制分析，但缺乏开源与跨机体验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: SKIP: Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm for Efficient Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: Embodied world models have emerged as a promising paradigm in robotics by predicting how robot actions affect the surrounding scene. However, the rollout inference remains computationally expensive in pixel space, as long-horizon manipulation videos typically have to be generated frame by frame. This cost cannot be easily reduced by indiscriminately dropping frames, since downstream policies rely on complete preservation of sparse task-relevant events such as approach, contact, grasp, and release. To address this challenge, we propose Sparse Keyframe Interpolation Paradigm (SKIP), an event-preserving sparse-to-dense framework that avoids dense frame-by-frame generation. SKIP first identifies task-relevant keyframes by leveraging robot-aware multimodal features. It then synthesizes only these keyframes with a sparse video diffusion model. A learned gap predictor and an action-conditioned interpolator subsequently reconstruct the missing intervals according to the robot actions. On LIBERO, SKIP generates dense rollouts $4.16\times$ faster than a dense baseline while improving visual fidelity and reducing aggregate FVD by $89.0\%$. Importantly, SKIP-generated videos are effective policy-training data. Even when they fully replace real demonstrations, $π_{0.5}$ success drops only $1.3$ pp in LIBERO simulation and $6.7$ pp on the real robot, whereas fully dense frame-by-frame generation collapses by $48$ to $58$ pp.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SKIP框架，用稀疏关键帧（只生成任务事件点如接触、抓取）加动作引导的插值来替代传统逐帧生成视频的世界模型，大幅加速推理并保持策略训练有效性。
analysis.claim: 在保持任务相关事件完整性的前提下，通过机器人感知驱动的关键帧稀疏化与动作条件插值，可显著加速具身世界模型的视频rollout，且生成视频仍能有效支撑下游策略训练。
analysis.input: 机器人状态+多模态观测（视觉+动作指令）
analysis.output: 密集视频帧序列（但非逐帧生成，而是稀疏关键帧+插值重建）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真环境（Franka机械臂+RGB相机），未依赖特定真实硬件接口
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅用LIBERO公开仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO上实现4.16×加速+89% FVD下降+真实机器人仅降6.7pp，证明其工程有效性；但未开新范式（仍是world model rollout优化），未挑战长期开放难题（如闭环自监督建模、跨机体泛化），也未超越DreamerV3等基石的理论深度或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：本质是高效视频生成的架构创新，在仿真到真实迁移中验证扎实，但未突破世界模型的核心建模瓶颈。

papers.title: DynaFLIP: Rethinking Robotics Perception via Tri-Modal-Dynamics Guided Representation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation critically depends on perception that preserves the action-relevant aspects of a scene. Yet most robot learning pipelines are built upon visual encoders pre-trained for static recognition or vision-language alignment, leaving motion understanding to downstream policies. We introduce DynaFLIP, a dynamics-aware multimodal pre-training framework that pushes motion understanding upstream into perception. We construct image-language-3D flow triplets from heterogeneous human and robot videos, and use these triplets as training-time supervision to shape an image-only encoder. Our key idea is to encourage the three modalities to span a small simplex volume in the shared hyperspherical space -- a smaller simplex volume indicating stronger alignment. To avoid the geometric ambiguity and trivial collapse of naive volume minimization, we combine simplex-volume minimization with a cosine regularizer and a contrastive objective. Our analyses show that DynaFLIP focuses on control-relevant regions critical for manipulation. The resulting dynamics-aware representations serve as reusable visual backbones and consistently outperform baselines across diverse downstream policies, including VLAs. We validate this across diverse simulation and real-world setups, with gains reaching +22.5% under out-of-distribution scenarios. Our results suggest that robot generalization improves when visual representations are trained to encode not just what is present, but how the world changes under action.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DynaFLIP，用图像-语言-3D光流三元组监督训练一个纯图像编码器，让视觉表征提前学懂‘动作如何改变世界’，从而提升机器人在操纵任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将动作相关的动力学信息（3D flow）显式注入视觉编码器的预训练过程，能显著提升下游机器人策略对未见场景和动作的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+3D光流（合成或估计）
analysis.output: 动力学感知的图像嵌入向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（如Isaac Gym/ManiSkill）及少量真实机械臂（如Franka），但非端到端控制硬件依赖
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/估计的3D flow，未使用真实机器人交互视频中的ground-truth dynamics数据；真实世界验证仅用现成视频帧+后处理光流，无闭环真实机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将3D flow作为显式模态与图文联合约束视觉编码器，在多个仿真+小规模真实实验中验证了动力学感知表征对VLA类策略的增益（+22.5% OOD），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨硬件部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、具身闭环学习），属扎实且有启发性的表征层面增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：把动力学信号前移到视觉编码器预训练阶段并验证其泛化价值，但缺乏真机大规模闭环验证和开源支撑，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Cross-domain Videos with Video Prediction Model
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning from expert videos across visually distinct domains is challenging due to the absence of reward signals and the presence of domain gaps. We introduce XIPER (Cross-domain Video Prediction Reward), a reward model for learning from expert videos collected in a visually different domain, where the agent's appearance differs due to factors such as color, morphology, or the sim-to-real gap. More specifically, XIPER trains a cross-domain video prediction model that maps agent observations into the expert domain and uses the prediction likelihood as a reward signal. Experiments on the DMC Color Suite (8 tasks) and DMC Body Suite (3 tasks) show that XIPER consistently outperforms baselines despite domain gaps such as differences in agent color and morphology. We further analyze XIPER on a sim-to-real transfer dataset, demonstrating that it produces meaningful reward signals for real-robot observations given only simulated expert videos. Code, pretrained models, datasets and video demonstrations can be found on our project webpage: https://sites.google.com/view/xiper

analysis.tldr: 用跨域专家视频（比如仿真里拍的机器人动作）训练一个视频预测模型，把智能体当前看到的画面‘翻译’成专家视频所在域的画面，再用预测准确率当奖励信号来训练强化学习策略，从而解决没有真实奖励、且视觉域差异大（颜色/形态/仿真到真实）时的模仿学习问题
analysis.claim: 跨域视频预测的似然性可作为无奖励、跨视觉域模仿学习的有效代理奖励信号
analysis.input: 当前智能体观测帧序列（RGB）+专家视频帧序列（RGB）
analysis.output: 标量奖励信号（用于RL训练）
analysis.robot_dependency: DMC仿真器（DeepMind Control Suite）及对应真实机械臂数据集（sim2real transfer dataset）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需真实场景下的静态观测帧（用于reward inference），无需真实动作标签或轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（用跨域视频重建似然作reward），在DMC Color/Body两个标准benchmark上验证了有效性，并做了sim2real reward transfer分析；但未在真实机器人上闭环训练或部署，无策略泛化实验（如跨任务/跨机体控制），reward模型本身是标准VAE+Transformer预测架构的组合应用，未开源代码/模型，仅提供网页，证据链止于reward信号合理性，未证明端到端策略性能跃迁
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了可验证的跨域reward构造范式，在标准仿真benchmark上有效，但未跨越sim2real闭环控制门槛，也未开源核心资产，尚不能支撑领域范式转移

papers.title: Replicate-anchored calibration of within-host single nucleotide variant detection in Mycobacterium tuberculosis whole genome sequencing
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Intra-host genetic heterogeneity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is biologically and clinically informative, but its detection from short read whole genome sequencing depends on thresholds over read depth (DP), alternate allele support (AD), and minor allele frequency (MAF) that are rarely empirically anchored. Methods We developed a biological replicate-anchored, lexicographic calibration framework for per-specimen intra-host single nucleotide variant (iSNV) detection. Within-patient replicate sputum pairs from a pre-treatment tuberculosis (TB) cohort were scored across the joint (DP, AD, MAF) grid on six concordance metrics; the selector penalized no-signal regimes and ranked cells by reproducibility, with sensitivity as a tiebreaker. Selection stability was quantified by B=1,000 nonparametric bootstrap resamples of replicate pairs, defining a Looser/Primary/Tighter sensitivity ladder. The calibrated rule was applied to 97 patients contributing 282 cultured sputum specimens. Results Calibration on 169 replicate pairs from 67 patients identified a Primary cell at DP≥ 60x, AD ≥ 3, MAF ∈ [0.02, 0.50]. The bootstrap modal cell coincided with the Primary cell in 45.7% of 703 successful replications (MAF = 0.02 in 100%; AD = 3 in 90.2%). Per-patient prevalence of detectable within-host diversity at the Primary tier was 16.5% (16/97, Wilson 95% CI: 10.4% - 25.1%); Looser and Tighter tiers yielded comparable rates. Conclusion Within-patient replicate concordance provides a reproducible empirical anchor for iSNV detection thresholds in TB whole genome sequencing. The framework is internally calibrated and reported with explicit sensitivity tiers. The calibrated rule can be applied to external cohorts as a direct test of transferability. Data Summary Raw paired-end Illumina whole genome sequencing reads for the 282 Mycobacterium tuberculosis genomes analyzed in this study have been deposited at the NCBI Sequence Research Archive (SRA) under BioProject accession PRJNA1466981. Per-sample run accessions and corresponding metadata are provided in Supplementary Data S1. The M. tuberculosis H37Rv reference genome used for read alignment is available from GenBank under accession NC_000962.3 . The full analysis pipeline (R), calibration scripts, application scripts, parameter files, and derived data tables that reproduce all reported results, main figures, and supplementary materials are available at https://github.com/K01-tb-genomics/paper1_isnv_calibration . A versioned snapshot of the repository at the time of manuscript submission is archived at Zenodo under 10.5281/zenodo.20246996. Supplementary Tables S1-S5 and Supplementary Figure S1 are provided as supplementary files alongside the article. The authors confirm that all supporting data, code and protocols have been provided within the article or through the cited public repositories. Impact Statement Within-host genetic diversity in Mycobacterium tuberculosis is increasingly used to study transmission, treatment response, and resistance emergence. The bioinformatic thresholds that distinguish low-frequency variants from sequencing noise vary widely across published TB studies and are rarely empirically justified, thus reshaping which patients are reported as harboring detectable within-host diversity. We provide a biological replicate-anchored calibration framework that ties threshold selection to within-patient replicate concordance, quantifies stability under resampling, and reports explicit sensitivity tiers. Applied to 97 TB patients, the calibrated rule identifies 16.5% as carrying detectable within-host M. tuberculosis variation. The framework is transferable to other TB cohorts as a transparent basis for cross-study comparison. Lay Summary Tuberculosis (TB) bacteria can vary slightly within a single patient. Bacterial cells in the same person may carry small genetic differences, sometimes affecting only a small fraction of the bacterial population. Studying this kind of within-patient variation matters for understanding how TB responds to treatment and how it spreads between people. Detecting these differences from DNA sequencing means distinguishing real signal from background noise. However, the rules used to make that distinction affect which patients are reported as carrying mixed bacterial populations. In this study, we developed a method for making that detection decision more reliably. Most patients gave more than one sputum sample on the same day. We used the agreement between repeat samples from the same patient to pick rules that gave consistent answers. We checked how stable our chosen rules were by repeating the selection on randomly drawn versions of the data, and we report stricter and looser versions of the rule alongside our preferred one. We applied the method to 97 TB patients. About one in six (16.5%) showed detectable genetic variation within their TB bacterial population using our preferred rule. The same rules can also be applied to other TB studies to check whether they give consistent results when used in a different setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用同一患者多次痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，为结核分枝杆菌（M. tuberculosis）全基因组测序中检测低频体内单核苷酸变异（iSNV）设定了可复现、有实证支撑的阈值规则（DP≥60x, AD≥3, MAF∈[0.02,0.50]），并量化了该规则在重采样下的稳定性，还公开了全部代码、数据和流程。
analysis.claim: 基于同一患者多份痰液样本的生物学重复一致性，可为结核菌体内iSNV检测提供经验锚定、稳定且可迁移的阈值校准框架。
analysis.input: 配对的Illumina短读长WGS原始数据（同一患者不同痰标本）
analysis.output: 经校准的iSNV检出阈值组合（DP/AD/MAF三元组）及对应敏感度分级（Looser/Primary/Tighter）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床痰标本的配对测序数据（169对来自67人）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的生物信息方法学贡献：首次在结核领域系统性用生物学重复锚定iSNV阈值，含bootstrap稳定性评估、三级敏感度报告、全开源实现，并在97例真实队列中验证；但问题范畴窄（仅TB iSNV）、未跨病原体泛化、未整合新模型或深度学习，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了TB基因组学中长期存在的阈值主观性问题，证据扎实、完全开源、临床可落地，但属垂直领域方法优化，非跨学科范式创新。

papers.title: WorldFly: A World-Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation
papers.abstract: End-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise in UAV navigation. However, existing approaches typically rely on historical observations to directly predict actions, often struggling in dense urban environments where severe occlusions and sharp turns result in drastic viewpoint transitions. We argue that the ability to "imagine" future states -- inherent in World Models -- is critical for robust decision-making under such partial observability. To address this, we construct a challenging Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark, specifically designed to evaluate spatial understanding in scenarios characterized by severe occlusions and drastic viewpoint transitions. To this end, we propose WorldFly, a novel world-model-based VLA framework that employs a dual-branch coupled flow matching mechanism to jointly generate future video predictions and navigation actions, thereby explicitly guiding the agent's policy via spatial imagination. Extensive evaluations on our benchmark demonstrate that WorldFly outperforms other baselines, particularly in unseen environments, validating the effectiveness of integrating world models into embodied aerial agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldFly模型，用世界模型（预测未来视频帧）辅助无人机在高楼林立、严重遮挡的城市峡谷中做视觉-语言-动作联合决策，通过双分支流匹配机制同步生成未来画面和导航动作，在自建的Urban Canyon Traversal Benchmark上验证了对未见环境的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 将世界模型显式嵌入VLA框架，通过联合视频预测与动作生成实现空间想象力驱动的无人机导航，显著提升在严重遮挡与剧烈视角变化下的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流+自然语言导航指令（如'飞过右侧窄巷'）
analysis.output: 六自由度连续控制动作（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真无人机（Gazebo/PX4？摘要未明示，但Urban Canyon场景强暗示基于AirSim或类似高保真仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实无人机数据提及
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有启发性（世界模型+VLA耦合），但仅在自建仿真benchmark上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化、无消融证明‘双分支流匹配’比简单时序建模更优；相比RT-2/π0等基石工作，既未建立通用具身基础模型，也未解决真实部署瓶颈，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：世界模型引入方向合理，但实证局限在单一仿真场景，缺乏真实系统验证和机制级消融，尚未达到开范式或工程落地门槛。

papers.title: AxisGuide: Grounding Robot Action Coordinate System in RGB Observations for Robust Visuomotor Manipulation
papers.abstract: Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AxisGuide方法，在RGB图像上叠加机器人基坐标系的可视化引导通道（+x/+y/+z方向在图像中的投影），让视觉-运动策略能更鲁棒地理解‘动作在图像中对应什么空间变化’，从而缓解因物体位置微小偏移导致的动作失败问题。
analysis.claim: 显式将机器人基坐标系投影到RGB图像空间并作为辅助输入通道，可显著提升视觉-运动策略在分布外位置变化下的动作鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 相机内参 + 末端执行器位姿
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（仿真中为LIBERO环境，实机为Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人采集的演示数据（但未说明是否公开、规模或多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO仿真和少量真实Panda实验上验证了坐标系可视化引导的有效性，有跨任务/场景泛化提升和消融（如去掉轴通道性能下降），但未开源代码/模型，真实数据量少且未覆盖多机体或多用户，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本新物体操作），属扎实且有洞见的增量改进，但未达ALOHA/ACT等基石级范式突破或工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用简单却关键的几何先验（坐标系图像投影）修补了当前BC类视觉-运动策略的底层动作语义断层，实证充分但开源与扩展性不足。

papers.title: CAPE: Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding for Embodied Planning
papers.abstract: Embodied agents need to predict the future consequences of candidate actions in order to plan effectively before execution. Existing visual dynamics models learn by reconstructing future visual states or rolling out dense latent representations, which spreads learning capacity across visually salient but planning-irrelevant content rather than the action-conditioned changes that drive manipulation outcomes. We propose CAPE, a Contrastive Action-conditioned Parallel Encoding framework that learns visual dynamics by distinguishing the future outcomes induced by different action sequences. Given an initial observation and a candidate action sequence, CAPE decodes the full future latent trajectory in a single forward pass and is trained with a Goal-Convergent Contrastive Objective that aligns predictions corresponding to the same future outcome while separating those corresponding to different outcomes. On real-world DROID and zero-shot transfer to RoboCasa, CAPE substantially outperforms prior baselines on future-state retrieval, offline action matching, and closed-loop planning, while notably reducing planning-time inference cost at long prediction horizons.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAPE框架，用对比学习让视觉动力学模型专注区分不同动作序列导致的未来结果差异，而不是重建整个未来画面，从而在真实机器人（DROID）和仿真环境（RoboCasa）上更准、更快地做长时程具身规划。
analysis.claim: 视觉动力学建模应聚焦于动作条件下的因果结果区分，而非像素/潜空间重建，以此提升具身规划的效率与泛化性。
analysis.input: 初始视觉观测 + 候选动作序列
analysis.output: 完整未来潜轨迹（latent trajectory）
analysis.robot_dependency: DROID真实机器人平台 + RoboCasa仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖DROID真实机器人采集的离线数据集用于训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人DROID上验证了长时程规划性能提升和推理加速，有跨场景零样本迁移（RoboCasa），但未开源代码/模型，消融实验细节未在摘要中体现，未挑战多机体/跨用户等更高阶泛化，也未达到RT-2/Octo级范式突破或开放权重规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机+跨环境验证有效，但开源缺失削弱复现性，尚未构成范式转移

papers.title: Dream-Tac: A Unified Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models inherit the predictive capability of world models, enabling action generation to be guided by anticipated future observations. However, they rely primarily on vision and often fail in contact-rich manipulation, where critical cues arise from physical interaction. In this paper, we propose Dream-Tac, a unified Tactile-World Action Model that jointly models actions, future visual observations, and tactile dynamics. Specifically, Dream-Tac introduces (i) contact-gated visuotactile fusion to selectively integrate tactile signals and (ii) a contact-aware attention bias to better regulate cross-modal interactions during manipulation. To support real-time deployment, we further design a dual-level acceleration strategy, reformulating the contact-aware bias to preserve the fused attention path during training and introducing cache-based diffusion acceleration at inference, achieving up to 2.9$\times$ faster training and 1.8$\times$ faster inference. Across six contact-rich manipulation tasks, Dream-Tac improves action accuracy by 31.7\% on average, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified visuotactile world modeling.Code is available at https://github.com/LYFCLOUDFAN/Dream-Tac.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个融合视觉和触觉的统一世界动作模型Dream-Tac，通过接触门控融合和接触感知注意力偏置，在六个接触密集型操作任务上将动作准确率平均提升31.7%，支持实时部署。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；GitHub用户名LYFCLOUDFAN无法对应知名实验室/企业）

papers.title: IMPACT: Learning Internal-Model Predictive Control for Forceful Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation tasks often involve forceful interactions with the environment, such as using tools of varying weights, transporting objects with different masses, and performing contact-rich tasks like table wiping. Previous learning-based approaches typically employ imitation learning policies that output target end-effector poses tracked by low-level impedance controllers. In these systems, forceful interactions are either implicitly realized through steady-state tracking errors or explicitly commanded using wrist force/torque or tactile sensors. However, implicit approaches generalize poorly across object weights, while explicit approaches require specialized hardware and increase system complexity. In this work, we propose IMPACT, a framework that decouples these forceful tasks into task-planning and internal-model-based predictive control. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves higher success rates and improved generalization to unseen object weights, as well as better safety and energy efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出IMPACT框架，用内部模型预测控制替代传统力控方式，让机器人在拧螺丝、擦桌子等需要用力操作的任务中，不依赖力传感器也能适应不同重量物体，提升成功率、安全性和能耗效率。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦任务规划与基于内部模型的预测控制，可在无需专用力/触觉传感器的前提下，实现对未知质量物体的鲁棒力控操作。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+任务指令+物体质量先验（仿真中显式提供，真实实验中部分隐含）
analysis.output: 关节级扭矩控制序列（非末端位姿）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据用于校准内部模型，但未使用大规模真实力控轨迹数据
