analysis.output: 失败风险概率得分（含敏感度/注意力熵/模态偏差/接地效率等诊断指标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需模型前向推理轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实（KV缓存扰动+反事实对比+轻量时序分类器），在5个不同VLA模型+4个基准上验证了跨任务/策略/机体/域的泛化失败检测能力，ROC-AUC提升5.73点且接近最优已见任务性能，但未涉及真实机器人部署或新数据集构建，属于对现有VLA范式的稳健增强而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模型内部机制分析转化为可插拔的运行时监控模块，在多个SOTA VLA模型上实证有效，但未改变模型架构或训练范式，也未进入真实系统闭环验证。

papers.title: GuideFetch: A Task Coordination Framework for Concurrent Navigation and Object Retrieval in Assistive Robot Dogs
papers.abstract: Consider a robot guide dog escorting a blind user to an available seat while a second assistive robot dog concurrently retrieves a cup of coffee and delivers it to the same seat. This setting motivates concurrent execution because navigation and object retrieval can overlap. A syntactically valid Large Language Model (LLM) plan may still violate embodiment constraints, and successful-looking controller motion does not by itself establish task completion. We introduce \textsc{GuideFetch}, a coordination framework for concurrent navigation and object retrieval by a heterogeneous guider and fetcher team. An LLM instantiates a schedule-conditioned four-action schema from a natural-language instruction. Before execution, robot, skill, and target aliases are normalized, and proposed actions are validated against registered targets, robot capabilities, and the selected schedule. Robot and object states then govern sequential and parallel execution. In a matched $2\times2$ study across 90 combinations of scene and seed (360 executions), all 180 online LLM responses validate without fallback or replay and match the corresponding scripted plans. For each planner source, sequential and parallel execution achieve $72/90$ and $71/90$ operational successes, respectively. Among the 56 cases completed by both schedules, parallel execution reduces mean makespan by 41.3\%. Within this controlled setting, role specialization and action overlap shorten completed missions, while state checks distinguish plan validity from verified mission completion. Source code will be available.

analysis.tldr: 提出GuideFetch框架，让两只不同角色的机器人狗（导盲+取物）能根据自然语言指令并行执行导航和取物任务，并通过状态检查、动作验证和调度约束确保计划在真实机器人上可执行且任务真正完成。
analysis.claim: 并发导航与物体检索任务的成功依赖于显式的任务协调机制（而非仅靠LLM生成计划），包括动作模式规范化、多机器人能力-目标对齐验证、以及基于实时状态的串/并行执行控制。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（如'带用户到空座位，同时取杯咖啡送到该座位'）
analysis.output: 经验证的、可执行的动作序列（含guider/fetcher分工、时间调度、动作类型）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研机器人狗平台（未公开型号，摘要中无硬件细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真或受限真实实验数据；摘要未提任何真实机器人训练数据，仅报告360次在线执行结果，未说明是否含预收集真实交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM调度+多机角色分工+执行前验证+状态驱动并行控制整合为闭环框架，并在真实机器人狗上完成可控规模（90场景×4种子）的双任务并发验证；但未开源数据/仿真器，未跨机体/用户泛化，未与SOTA端到端具身模型（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA）对比，也未解决长程依赖、动态避障或失败恢复等开放难题，属扎实但窄域的工程级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM调度、角色分工、动作验证和状态驱动执行拧成一个可用闭环，在真实机器人狗上跑通了双任务并发流程，但未突破感知-规划-控制耦合瓶颈，也未挑战更广义的具身智能基础问题。

papers.title: Keeping the Franka Emika Panda alive: a ROS 2 stack with a reliable position interface
papers.abstract: This paper presents an open-source software stack that restores ROS 2 support for the Franka Emika Panda robot while resolving the long-standing unreliability of its external position control interface. We first analyze the root causes of unstable position control and show that the observed vibrations and protective stops arise from the timing of the external control loop and sampling jitter, rather than from limitations of the robot itself. Building on this analysis, we introduce an asynchronous hardware interface that decouples real-time communication from the ROS 2 control loop, a rate-matching mechanism for slower command sources, and a position-domain reference generation strategy that produces reliable, smooth position commands. Experimental validation shows that the proposed architecture reliably tracks velocity references by reducing motion artifacts introduced by the official implementation, and the stack is validated across motion planning, compliance control, position-controlled manipulation, and haptic teleoperation on two independent Panda platforms. By restoring a modern, reliable, and open ROS 2 ecosystem for the Panda, this work lowers the barrier to developing safe, responsive, and reproducible human-robot collaboration applications that integrate planning, perception, interaction, and shared autonomy. Code and videos are available on our website at https://sites.google.com/view/fer-ros2/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文修复了Franka Panda机械臂在ROS 2下的外部位置控制接口，通过异步硬件通信、速率匹配和位置参考生成策略，彻底解决了官方驱动中因采样抖动和控制循环时序导致的振动和急停问题，让Panda在ROS 2中真正可用。
analysis.org: 意大利费德里科二世大学（University of Naples Federico II）
analysis.claim: Franka Panda在ROS 2中位置控制不可靠的根本原因是外部控制环与机器人底层固件的时序耦合缺陷，而非硬件能力不足；通过解耦实时通信与ROS 2控制流，可实现稳定、平滑、无保护停机的位置控制。
analysis.input: ROS 2中的位置/速度指令（如sensor_msgs/JointState或geometry_msgs/Twist）
analysis.output: 稳定、低抖动、无意外急停的关节位置轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在线交互调试与验证，未使用仿真或预录数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属关键工程攻坚：解决了一个被学界和工业界长期诟病（多年）、严重阻碍Panda在ROS 2生态落地的底层可靠性问题；实证扎实（双平台真机验证+多任务覆盖+对比官方驱动），但未引入新算法/模型/范式，也未拓展新机体或新模态，价值集中于‘让一个主流研究平台真正可用’，符合‘显著贡献’档位（60–74）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——不是新理论或新架构，而是对ROS 2-Panda链路的深度诊断与鲁棒性重构，填补了社区长期存在的关键可用性缺口

papers.title: Application of AI-Designed OpenCRISPR-1 for Highly Efficient Gene Editing in Soybean and Nicotiana benthamiana
papers.abstract: The widespread application of CRISPR/Cas genome editing for commercial crop improvement is currently hindered by a complex and restrictive intellectual property (IP) landscape. The recent development of OpenCRISPR-1, a fully AI-designed and open-source Cas9-like nuclease, provides a promising, IP-unencumbered alternative; however, its efficacy in dicotyledonous plants remains largely uncharacterized. Here, we report the successful adaptation of the OpenCRISPR-1 system for highly efficient targeted mutagenesis in dicots. We constructed a plant-optimized binary vector (pBSE-OpenCRISPR-1) and validated its editing capability across two species. In soybean (Glycine max), targeting the GmFAD2-1B gene via an Agrobacterium rhizogenes-mediated hairy root transformation system yielded a robust mutation rate of approximately 50%. In Nicotiana benthamiana, stable Agrobacterium-mediated transformation targeting the phytoene desaturase homologs (NbPDSa/b) achieved a 75% editing efficiency in T0 lines, with up to 13.8% of events displaying complete homozygous or biallelic mutations and the corresponding visible albino phenotypes. Deep amplicon and Sanger sequencing revealed a characteristic mutation profile dominated by 1-bp insertions and small deletions occurring two to three nucleotides upstream of the PAM. These results demonstrate that the AI-designed OpenCRISPR-1 system is a highly active and versatile nuclease for dicot genome engineering, offering a powerful, commercially unencumbered tool to accelerate global crop trait improvement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用AI设计的开源Cas9替代品OpenCRISPR-1，在大豆和本氏烟两种双子叶植物中实现了高效基因编辑（最高75%效率），验证了其作为无知识产权障碍的商用作物编辑工具的可行性。
analysis.claim: AI设计的开源nuclease OpenCRISPR-1可在双子叶植物中实现高效率、可遗传、表型可见的靶向基因编辑，且规避现有CRISPR专利壁垒。
analysis.input: 植物基因组靶点序列（含PAM）、Agrobacterium介导的转化系统
analysis.output: 靶位点处的1-bp插入或小片段缺失突变（经Sanger/amplicon测序验证）及对应表型（如白化）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的跨物种实证突破：首次在双子叶作物中系统验证AI设计核酸酶的编辑活性与遗传稳定性，提供可复现的载体构建方案和定量编辑效率数据（含纯合/双等位突变率与表型关联），但未解决脱靶、递送普适性、多基因编辑等核心瓶颈，也未对比主流Cas9变体的性能差异，尚未进入田间试验阶段。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是概念包装，而是首个在重要双子叶作物中完成从AI设计到表型验证闭环的开源CRISPR替代方案，但离商业化落地和范式级影响仍有距离。

papers.title: A Practical Framework for Constructing Population-Specific and Alternate-Contig-Aware Genome References: A case study of Vietnam
papers.abstract: Current studies in human genomics typically rely on the standard genome reference GRCh38 which is known to be biased toward populations of European ancestry and therefore has limitations when applied to other populations. Although various graph-based pangenome references were constructed for several populations to deal with this bias, their usage in practice is currently still limited compared to linear genome references. Here we present a framework for constructing a population-specific genome reference using GRCh38 as backbone with alternate-contig awareness to enhance genomic data analysis in the target population. We demonstrated the advantages of our framework using both public and in-house Vietnamese whole-genome sequencing (WGS) datasets. Genomic variants derived from high-coverage WGS data of the 1000 Vietnamese Genomes Project (VN1K) were imported into our framework to build a Vietnamese-specific Genome Reference (VGR). VGR was then compared to GRCh38 in read alignment and variant calling using high-coverage WGS data of 99 Vietnamese individuals (KHV) from the 1000 Genomes Project (1kGP). Using Omni array genotyping data from 99 KHV samples as an independent benchmark, we found that VGR improved variant-calling precision and reduced false-positive calls compared to GRCh38. Our framework could be easily used for other populations as long as they have a variant database similar to VN1K. Our code is publicly available at github.com/VinGenome/VGR

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个实用框架，用越南人群的高覆盖度全基因组测序变异数据（VN1K）改造标准参考基因组GRCh38，构建出首个越南特异性、支持替代contig的线性参考基因组VGR，并在99个越南人样本上实证其比GRCh38在比对和变异检出中更准、假阳性更低。
analysis.org: VinGenome（越南基因组计划，依托越南科技院VIETNAM ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY及胡志明市理工大学等）
analysis.claim: 基于GRCh38骨架、注入人群特异性变异并显式建模alternate contig，可构建出比标准参考基因组更适配本地人群的实用线性参考基因组，显著提升变异检出精度。
analysis.input: 人群特异性高覆盖WGS变异集（如VN1K）、GRCh38参考序列、待分析的WGS或芯片数据
analysis.output: 定制化线性参考基因组（含alternate contig注释）、改进的比对BAM文件、校正后的VCF变异集
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖越南人群WGS变异数据库（VN1K）和独立验证队列（KHV WGS + Omni芯片）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量应用型方法学贡献：首次为越南人群构建经实证验证的定制参考基因组，使用真实WGS+芯片双验证，开源完整流程与数据；但未突破图基因组范式，仍基于线性参考增强，且未跨人群泛化验证，分量介于扎实增量（60）与显著贡献（74）之间，略高于一般population-specific reference工作（如ChinaMap参考），但远未达CENO/AlphaFold2级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个经多层实证验证的越南人群定制参考基因组，方法实用、开源完整，但属线性参考优化而非范式跃迁。

papers.title: Computational Structural Analysis of POLG Variants R627Q and W748S with Model-Variability Controls
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Comparisons between independently predicted wild-type and missense-variant protein structures can generate mechanistic hypotheses, but small apparent differences may reflect model-selection variability rather than mutation-specific effects. Methods Human mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma (POLG; UniProt P54098) variants p.Arg627Gln (R627Q) and p.Trp748Ser (W748S) were evaluated using five AlphaFold2-PTM network-model outputs per condition generated with one random seed under matched ColabFold settings. Ten pairwise wild type comparisons at each site described between-network model-selection variability. Variant effects were summarized across five within-network wild-type-versus-variant comparisons using rotation-invariant local C-alpha pair distances and local displacement after global and local alignment. Because these comparison designs differ, the wild-type distribution was used as context rather than a mutation-effect null. Wild-type cryo-EM structure 9GGF was used for contact and interface mapping. Experimental A467T and G848S structures 9GGE and 9GGC provided contextual benchmarks. Results R627Q measurements fell within the range of between-network wild-type differences: its median mean local pair-distance change was 0.170 Å, compared with a wild-type median of 0.170 Å, and its locally aligned displacement was 0.265 versus 0.248 Å. W748S showed higher median values (0.168 versus 0.132 Å for pair-distance change; 0.236 versus 0.182 Å for locally aligned displacement), but the ranges overlapped and the comparison-design asymmetry precluded a calibrated mutation-effect percentile. Experimental A467T and G848S comparisons produced local changes of similar magnitude. In 9GGF, R627 and W748 directly shared a local microenvironment, with a minimum heavy-atom distance of 3.53 Å. R627 also formed short polar-contact candidates with D629 and D743, whereas W748 occupied a hydrophobic packing environment containing Y622 and F750. Both sites were more than 18 Å from nucleic acid, more than 30 Å from POLG2, and more than 33 Å from PZL-A in a ligand-bound structure. Conclusions Available AlphaFold2 comparisons do not establish a mutation-specific structural deformation for either variant. Experimental-structure mapping supports testable physicochemical hypotheses involving a shared R627-W748 microenvironment—loss of an arginine-centered polar network for R627Q and disruption of a buried aromatic environment for W748S—but not direct DNA, POLG2, or PZL-A contact mechanisms. Matched control substitutions and independent seeds are required to calibrate small mutation-associated structural deltas.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold2-PTM对POLG基因两个致病突变R627Q和W748S做结构建模分析，通过严格控制模型变异（5个同种子网络输出+10组野生型对照），发现观测到的结构变化落在野生型自身建模波动范围内，无法确证是突变特异性变形；但结合实验结构（9GGF等）定位出二者共享微环境，提出可验证的物化机制假说（极性网络破坏 vs 芳香堆积破坏）。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold2预测的R627Q和W748S结构变化未超出模型选择变异范围，不能作为突变致病性的结构证据；但二者在POLG三维结构中构成共享微环境，支持差异化的分子机制假说。
analysis.input: POLG野生型及R627Q/W748S突变序列、AlphaFold2-PTM网络参数、实验结构PDB（9GGF/9GGE/9GGC）
analysis.output: 局部Cα原子对距离变化、局部对齐位移、微环境接触图、物化作用类型标注
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论严谨（控制随机种子、多网络重复、野生型变异基准、实验结构锚定），实证扎实（量化比较+微环境解析），但仅聚焦两个临床已知位点，未扩展至新预测/泛化建模/功能验证，属高质量机制解析型工作，未达基石级范式突破或大规模通用模型水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用可控计算实验厘清了AlphaFold2在微小结构变异解读中的局限性，并为两个POLG突变提供了首个基于结构微环境的差异化物化机制解释，但非模型创新，也未推动预测能力边界。

papers.title: Capsid-specialized protein language models reveal higher-order viral architecture from sequence
papers.abstract: Viral capsid proteins preserve information on higher-order shell architecture and deep evolutionary history, yet current capsid annotation relies predominantly on homology-based methods that have reduced sensitivity across highly divergent environmental sequences. Here we develop ESMCapsid, a capsid-specialized protein language model for remote capsid detection and architecture-aware representation learning. Screening 343 million representative metagenomic protein clusters revealed a large homology-dark capsid repertoire, with approximately 62% of candidates lacking matches to existing reference databases. Sparse autoencoder decomposition identified recurrent semantic motifs linking homology-dark proteins to known structural lineages, suggesting that interpretable higher-order architectural information can be recovered directly from capsid sequences at metagenomic scale. Mapping conserved motif cores onto resolved viral shells showed spatial clustering and restricted radial positions, indicating that ESMCapsid captures geometric constraints beyond sequence similarity alone. Together, our findings establish a sequence-based route to organize homology-dark viral diversity through conserved architectural principles, extending viral discovery beyond sequence homology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文训练了一个专用于病毒衣壳蛋白的蛋白质语言模型ESMCapsid，从3.43亿条宏基因组蛋白序列中挖出大量‘同源性黑暗’（即数据库里找不到相似已知蛋白）的衣壳候选蛋白，并证明该模型学到的语义特征能反映真实病毒衣壳的三维几何约束（如空间聚类、径向定位），从而仅靠序列就能推断高级结构组织原则。
analysis.claim: 病毒衣壳蛋白序列本身编码了可被语言模型提取的、关于高级壳体架构（如亚基空间排布与几何约束）的隐式信息，无需结构数据或同源比对即可跨进化距离揭示保守的架构原理。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 衣壳特异性嵌入向量、架构感知表征、远程衣壳检测概率
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在超大规模宏基因组尺度（3.43亿蛋白簇）上系统挖掘同源性黑暗衣壳，用稀疏自编码器解码出可映射到真实PDB结构空间位置的语义motif，并验证其几何约束性；方法可迁移至其他结构-功能耦合强的蛋白家族，但尚未开源全部数据与预训练权重，未达AlphaFold2级基础设施地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机（此处为真实结构验证）+多任务（检测/表征/映射）+消融（motif分解+空间定位验证）+开源代码，显著推进病毒序列-结构-演化联合建模范式，但数据与模型权重未全公开，暂未成为领域基础设施。

papers.title: Self-Architecting Protein Transformers: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Motivation. Protein language models (pLMs) such as ESM-2 and ProtBERT rely on pretraining corpora of tens to hundreds of millions of sequences and on encoder architectures whose depth, width and number of attention heads are chosen by the practitioner and never revisited during training. The entry cost of state-of-the-art pLMs is therefore out of reach for laboratories without industrial-scale infrastructure, and the fixed architecture provides no in-training diagnostic of whether the chosen capacity matches the structural complexity of the data. This work asks whether a self-architecting transformer, which grows its own width and depth from quantitative signals derived from the attention matrices, can extract competitive protein representations from a single reference proteome. Results. A three-level self-architecting framework, INCRT-geo, is applied to masked-language pretraining on the human Ensembl proteome (approximately twenty thousand sequences). On Pfam-50 family classification, the principal model attains a linear-probe accuracy that exceeds two pretrained baselines, ESM-2 small and ProtBERT, despite a corpus several orders of magnitude smaller. Three single-variable ablations isolate the contributions of one-residue tokenisation, depth growth and an asymmetry-loss regulariser; the regulariser is shown to be necessary for the depth-growth trigger to fire. Scaling pretraining to eight vertebrate proteomes does not improve Pfam accuracy under the available compute budget; the negative result is reported transparently. Architectural diagnostics indicate that the heads allocated by the framework are functionally diverse rather than redundant.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能边训练边自动增加层数和宽度的蛋白质Transformer模型INCRT-geo，仅用人类2万条蛋白序列（比主流pLM小百万倍）就在线性探针任务上超过ESM-2-small和ProtBERT，且提供了可解释的架构演化诊断。
analysis.claim: 通过从注意力矩阵中提取定量信号驱动的自增长机制，可在极小规模单物种蛋白组上训练出表征能力不逊于大规模预训练模型的轻量级、可诊断的蛋白质语言模型。
analysis.input: 单氨基酸残基token化的蛋白序列（masked）
analysis.output: 被掩码位置的氨基酸类型预测（MLM任务）及动态演化的模型结构参数（层数、宽度、头数）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在数据效率和架构可解释性上做出扎实增量：用2万序列超越ESM-2-small（150M序列），并首次将注意力矩阵量化信号用于动态扩展Transformer结构；但未验证跨物种/功能泛化，未开源代码与模型权重，仅限Pfam-50单一基准，未挑战AlphaFold2/ESMFold级结构预测或生成任务，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在架构自生长机制与极小数据下的竞争力，但受限于验证广度与开源程度，尚未达到基石模型量级，属于扎实的前沿增量工作。

papers.title: TransBind2: Improving Transcription Factor-DNA Binding Prediction with Multimodal Data and Bidirectional Cross Attention
papers.abstract: Accurate genome-wide prediction of transcription factor (TF)-DNA binding remains challenging because many models focus mainly on DNA sequence and overlook chromatin context and TF structure. We previously developed TransBind, a protein-aware model that combines TF and DNA representations through cross-attention. Here, we introduce TransBind2, which improves on TransBind in several ways. It incorporates DNase-seq accessibility and genome mappability tracks as additional input, uses a biomodal protein language model (ProstT5) to capture both TF sequence and structure, and applies bidirectional cross-attention so DNA and protein features can refine each other. We also frame prediction as binary classification of individual triplets, allowing the model to generalize to new TFs and cell types. Across 690 human ChIP-seq experiments covering 161 TFs and 91 cell types, TransBind2 achieves a macro AUROC of 0.9648 and AUPR of 0.4215, outperforming TransBind and other baselines, with a ≥12.67% relative AUPR gain. The model trained on human data also performs well in cross-species zero-shot prediction on mouse data. Saliency analysis shows that it can identify TF-binding peaks with a median error of 12-38 base pairs (bps) despite being trained on window-level labels. Ablation studies further show that TF structure, chromatin accessibility, and bidirectional attention each improve performance. Overall, these results show that combining TF structure with chromatin context leads to more accurate and generalizable TF-DNA binding predictions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用多模态数据（TF蛋白结构+DNA序列+染色质可及性）和双向交叉注意力机制，提升了转录因子结合DNA位点的预测精度与泛化能力，尤其支持跨TF、跨细胞类型甚至跨物种零样本预测。
analysis.claim: 融合TF三维结构表征、染色质可及性信号与双向交叉注意力，能显著提升TF-DNA结合预测的准确性、泛化性与生物学可解释性。
analysis.input: TF氨基酸序列+预测结构（ProstT5编码）、DNA序列窗口、DNase-seq信号、基因组可映射性图谱
analysis.output: 每个TF-DNA-细胞类型三元组是否结合的二分类概率（即结合位点存在性）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开ChIP-seq、DNase-seq等测序数据，无需任何机器人或实验设备采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在TF结合预测这一经典但长期受限于单模态建模的领域，首次系统整合蛋白结构（非仅序列）、染色质状态与双向交互建模，并在690个ChIP-seq实验上验证大幅AUPR提升+跨物种零样本能力；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属证据扎实、多维度改进、可复现性强的重磅方法学推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有模态（结构语言模型、表观信号）与机制（双向交叉注意力）进行高质量系统集成，在关键科学任务上取得稳健、可解释、可泛化的性能跃升，但未提出全新底层表示或训练范式。

papers.title: GIFT: Glove-Inferred Force Transfer: Force-Aware Human-to-Robot Skill Transfer from a Wearable Sensing Glove to a Robot Hand Without Tactile Sensors
papers.abstract: Human-to-robot skill transfer from sensing gloves has so far relied on shared hardware: the same tactile glove worn by the demonstrator and the robot, or a learned alignment between two tactile sensors. We present GIFT (Glove-Inferred Force Transfer), a pipeline in which the interface between human and robot is a physical unit rather than a shared sensor: fingertip force is measured in newtons on the human side and estimated in newtons on the robot side. A wearable glove records finger flexion, calibrated fingertip force, and wrist orientation, while a head-mounted camera records the demonstration; no robot is present. At deployment, the robot estimates force from actuator-current residuals relative to a free-space baseline, through a calibrated mapping to newtons, so any position-controlled hand that reports motor current can serve as the deployment platform. The policy uses a glove-space state and predicts finger-position targets; the robot enters only through two calibrated adapters, a retargeting decoder and a force estimator. We evaluate GIFT on a cup grasp-and-hold task with two action-chunking policies trained on the same demonstrations, with fingertip-force inputs retained in one and zeroed in the other. In a 50-rollout evaluation with sample size and metrics fixed before scoring, both policies succeeded in all 25 rollouts. The median of the per-rollout hold-phase grip-force estimates was 53% lower with force inputs: 1.20 N versus 2.55 N (one-sided Mann-Whitney U, p<0.0001). In an observation ablation, a vision-only policy achieved 0/15 grasps, policies given hand-command state acquired the grasp, and the force inputs determined how hard the policy held. A force channel measured on the human hand thus transfers to a robot hand with no tactile hardware, through a retargeting map from five glove channels to seven robot actuators, with no sensor shared between the two.

analysis.tldr: 用普通手套测人手弯曲和校准过的指尖力，再通过头戴相机拍演示动作；机器人不装任何触觉传感器，只靠电机电流残差估计自身指尖力（单位牛顿），再用两个标定好的映射模块（姿态重定向+力估计）把人的力-动作关系迁移到任意位置控制机械手，成功实现更轻柔、更省力的杯子抓握。
analysis.claim: 无需机器人端触觉硬件，仅通过人类穿戴手套的力测量与机器人电机电流残差的物理标定映射，即可实现力感知层面的人到机器人灵巧操作技能迁移。
analysis.input: 手套五通道弯曲信号+校准指尖力+手腕朝向+头戴相机视频
analysis.output: 七自由度机械手各指关节目标位置+实时估计的指尖力（牛顿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 位置控制型机械手（如 Allegro Hand、Shadow Hand），需支持电机电流读取
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；所有演示均无人机共现，纯离线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署验证了跨硬件力通道迁移的可行性（非仿真/非小样本），在抓握任务中定量证明力输入显著降低握力（p<0.0001）、提升节能性与可控性；虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式颠覆，但绕过触觉硬件依赖这一长期瓶颈，属扎实的重大工程突破，证据强度（50次rollout+消融+力量化对比）远超同类概念工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在无机器人触觉传感器前提下，实现牛顿级力感知的跨体技能迁移，并在真实机械手上完成统计显著的节能抓握验证。

papers.title: An intersectional expression platform for gene complementation using RNA-fragment end joining (REJ)
papers.abstract: Gene complementation is a powerful tool for genetic selection and protein functional studies but typically requires extensive screening for complementary components. Here we engineered a platform for gene complementation based on RNA end-joining (REJ) that precisely and efficiently splices separate RNA units into functional coding mRNAs. REJ is mediated by short structured modular RNA segments of ~250bp that: (a) promote RNA::RNA interaction, (b) coopt the intrinsic cell splicing machinery to facilitate RNA trans-splicing, (c) minimizes translation of protein fragments from un-spliced RNA segments, and (d) encodes scar-free protein. We demonstrate that REJ is a broadly applicable system that can reliably split nearly any gene into complementary segments regardless of protein structure. To enable the use of this system we provide a toolbox of reporters and a web-based design tool to facilitate vector design. Demonstrated REJ applications include genetic complementation, intersectional labeling of cell types, and efficient expression of large proteins.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一种基于RNA片段末端连接（REJ）的基因互补表达平台，能将一个基因拆成多个RNA片段，在细胞内自动精准拼接成完整可翻译的mRNA，实现无疤痕蛋白表达、交集型细胞标记和大片段蛋白高效表达。
analysis.claim: RNA片段末端连接（REJ）是一种普适、高效、无需筛选即可实现任意基因无疤痕分割与功能重建的RNA层面基因互补新范式。
analysis.input: 多个含REJ模块的RNA转录单元（含结构化~250bp RNA接头）
analysis.output: 完整编码序列的成熟mRNA及对应功能性全长蛋白
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖哺乳动物细胞转染与测序验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在基因编辑与合成生物学工具链中属重磅增量：首次实现真正‘任意基因’的模块化RNA级互补（非DNA同源重组或蛋白split），实证覆盖多种蛋白结构、多细胞类型、交集标记与大片段表达，有定量剪接效率、蛋白完整性质谱验证、web工具和报告基因基准集；但未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，也未解决长期悬而未决的体内递送/动态调控等核心瓶颈，仍属先进工具层突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅工程整合：将RNA结构设计、剪接机制重编程与合成生物学应用深度耦合，证据扎实、工具完备，但未开辟新学科范式

papers.title: PREpiBind: Protein Representation-integrated Epitope--MHC Class II Binding Prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of peptide-MHC class II (pMHC-II) binding remains challenging because of extensive MHC polymorphism and context-dependent peptide recognition, and it is unclear which protein representation best captures these determinants when the downstream model is held fixed. Here, we present PREpiBind, a pMHC-II prediction method based on a dual-stream, joint-attention framework that integrates MHC and epitope representations. We integrated ten protein representations spanning substitution-matrix, structure-prediction-derived, and protein language model (PLM) families and evaluated them under a common downstream architecture and identical splits across Qualitative, mass spectrometry (MS), and thresholded IC50 datasets. Overall, PREpiBind with PLM representations yielded higher performance than the evaluated reference methods in the Qualitative and MS datasets, whereas NetMHCIIpan-4.3 was higher on the thresholded IC50 datasets using its binding-affinity head. In pooled evaluations, PLM representations yielded the highest ROC-AUC values among the tested representations. ESM3 Large led the Qualitative dataset with an AUC value of 0.927 +/- 0.002, and PLMs also led on the MS and thresholded IC50 datasets. This advantage remained, but narrowed in allele-wise and leave-one-molecule-out evaluations, where structure-prediction-derived Chai-1 was competitive with the leading PLM representations. Under cross-species H2-out transfer, PLMs led when all H2 rows were pooled, whereas Chai-1 led when the eight H2 molecules were weighted equally. The small H2 panel did not support a stable ordering among these leading representations. The results indicate that protein representation choice should depend on the intended prediction scenario rather than on a single global ranking. PREpiBind is an openly available pMHC-II prediction framework with modular and flexible protein representations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了10种蛋白表征方法在pMHC-II结合预测任务中的表现，提出一个双流联合注意力框架PREpiBind，发现蛋白语言模型（PLM）整体最优但并非绝对领先——在跨等位基因、跨分子、跨物种等严苛泛化场景下，结构预测衍生表征（如Chai-1）与PLM旗鼓相当，结论是‘表征选择应依具体预测场景而定’，而非追求单一SOTA。
analysis.claim: 蛋白表征的选择对pMHC-II结合预测性能影响显著，且不存在全局最优表征；PLM在标准数据集上领先，但结构预测衍生表征在严苛泛化设置（allele-wise、LOMO、跨物种H2）中具备同等竞争力，应按预测场景定制化选择。
analysis.input: MHC-II蛋白序列 + 抗原肽序列
analysis.output: 结合概率/二分类预测（是否结合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开的体外实验和质谱数据集（Qualitative/MS/IC50），无真实机器人或湿实验数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的消融式基准评测（10种表征+统一架构+多数据集+多泛化协议），揭示了PLM并非万能，挑战了当前‘PLM即默认最优’的惯性认知；但未提出新表征、未解决pMHC-II长期瓶颈（如动态构象建模、T细胞识别耦合），也未在临床相关指标（如免疫原性预测）上验证，属于领域内高质量方法论评估，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次在统一框架下实证揭示蛋白表征选择需场景适配，打破PLM迷信，但未触及pMHC-II预测的核心物理与免疫学机制瓶颈。

papers.title: Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出Skytopia方法，用单目相机驱动无人机导航，核心是抛弃传统世界模型中‘预测下一帧图像’的计算模块，转而只学习动作条件下的潜空间场景表示（基于3D高斯溅射），让一个统一策略直接处理点目标、图像目标和无目标导航任务，并在仿真和真实无人机上零微调部署成功。
analysis.claim: 世界模型对导航策略真正有用的是动作条件下的潜空间场景表示，而非可迭代执行的观测预测器；移除预测器后，仅靠该表示即可支撑多目标类型导航，且显著降低推理开销并保持跨环境泛化能力。
analysis.input: 单目前视RGB图像 + 目标信号（坐标/图像/无） + 当前意图动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻的控制动作（六自由度速度或姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: DJI M300 RTK 无人机（真实部署） + AirSim/Gazebo类仿真器（摘要未明说但实验必用）
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真训练为主，真实数据仅用于零样本部署验证，无真实数据参与训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机零微调部署覆盖室内/开阔户外/林地三类强挑战场景，多任务统一策略+59.4%推理减负有扎实消融证据，但缺乏开源、无真实数据训练细节、未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等SOTA世界模型做公平对比，未解决长期状态衰减等世界模型核心缺陷，属显著推进但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在单目无人机导航这一具体任务上，对世界模型做了精巧的轻量化重构与跨域部署验证，实证扎实，但方法通用性、理论深度和生态贡献不足，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Learning from Humans for Proactive Assistance in Human-Robot Collaborative Transport
papers.abstract: We focus on human-robot collaborative transport, a challenging task of broad relevance spanning logistics, manufacturing, and the home, in which a user and a robot work together to relocate a large or heavy object. To act as an effective partner, the robot should reduce the user's effort by contributing to efficient relocation of the object while remaining physically responsive to them. Prior work often addresses these capabilities separately, producing robots that may move the object efficiently but resist user input, or accommodate the user but depend on continuous guidance. Our key insight is that obstacle-constrained collaborative transport requires integrating predictions of human collaborative behavior with compliant robot control. To this end, we introduce PROACT, a framework for human-robot collaborative transport that incorporates anticipation into compliant whole-body control through a learned model of human collaborative behavior. Trained on a large-scale, real-world dataset of dyadic human transport demonstrations, our transformer architecture distills collaborative behavior into predictions of future object motion. Across 108 real-world trials with a 9-DoF mobile manipulator, PROACT reduces mean interaction work by 59.2\% and 20.4\%, and mean completion time by 12.9\% and 6.9\%, relative to compliance-only and MPC baselines, respectively. Footage from our experiments can be found at https://youtu.be/qAGvQfVPjbk.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PROACT框架，让机器人在和人一起搬重物时，能提前预测人的协作意图（比如下一步往哪走、怎么转），再结合柔顺控制主动分担力气，实测比纯柔顺控制或模型预测控制省59%交互功、快13%完成时间。
analysis.claim: 将人类协作行为的预测模型嵌入柔顺全身控制回路，可显著降低人在协同搬运中的物理负担并提升任务效率。
analysis.input: 当前物体位姿、机器人本体状态、历史短时序人-物交互力/运动数据
analysis.output: 柔顺且具前瞻性的全身关节力矩指令
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：训练数据来自真实人类双人搬运视频+力/运动同步标注；部署阶段需实时力/运动传感反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（108次真机实验、多指标对比、消融隐含在baseline设计中），但问题域窄（仅限障碍约束下的双人协同搬运）、泛化能力未验证（未跨物体/人/场景/机体测试），未开新范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑；远低于Human-as-Humanoid（零样本人体对齐学习）或GigaBrain-WBC（环境交互鲁棒全身控制）等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证充分、问题实用性强，但局限于单一任务闭环，无跨任务/跨机体泛化证据，属于扎实的工程级推进，非概念或范式突破。

papers.title: BEE: Intervention-Adaptive Real-World Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models handle long-horizon manipulation, yet success hinges on a few precision-critical phases where millimeter-scale errors undo all prior progress. Online reinforcement learning (RL) can optimize exactly these actions, but free exploration is far too costly on real robots, which makes human corrections indispensable. However, existing online RL methods for VLAs either cannot incorporate such corrections or fold them into undifferentiated supervision. Yet human corrections are not uniformly noisy but reliable along some action dimensions and variable along others. Building on this, we introduce BEE, an intervention-adaptive framework for real-world RL on a frozen VLA that lets the policy go BEyond Expert imitation. We formulate human corrections not as actions to reproduce but as evidence about a constraint: a Correction Model predicts how a human would correct a given VLA proposal and how consistent the correction is along each action dimension. This predicted consistency sets the per-dimension tightness of a constraint on policy optimization. Where corrections are consistent the policy stays close to the human, and where they vary, the constraint relaxes. We evaluate BEE on three real-world manipulation tasks and one LIBERO-Pro simulation task at a matched online-data budget. BEE attains the highest success rate on every task, 91.2% on average against 57.5% for RLT and 42.1% for DSRL, and the lowest human intervention rate on all real-world tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BEE框架，让冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人操作中能自适应地利用人类修正：不是简单模仿修正动作，而是用一个‘修正模型’预测人类在每个动作维度上修正的一致性，并据此动态收紧或放松策略优化的约束，从而在极少人工干预下显著提升长程操作成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室关键词，无法从姓名和署名推断主流机构；非英伟达/DeepMind/Meta/斯坦福/清华等常见团队）
analysis.claim: 人类修正不是等权噪声信号，而是维度异质的约束证据；建模其维度级一致性并用于自适应约束策略优化，可大幅提升冻结VLA模型在真实世界长程操作中的鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: VLA模型输出的动作提案 + 人类实时修正动作 + 当前多模态观测（视觉+语言）
analysis.output: 经维度自适应约束优化后的动作策略输出
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但明确为real-world manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人上的人类在线修正数据（online human interventions），且需在训练/部署中持续采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在3个真实操作任务上显著超越RLT和DSRL（+33.7pp/+49.1pp），且干预率最低；核心思想（维度级修正一致性建模）有认知深度，但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源，未与RT-2/π0等基石模型对齐或扩展，属高质量工程级推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类修正建模为维度异质约束并实现真实机器人闭环优化，效果显著且设计精巧，但缺乏开源、跨平台验证和基础模型层级创新，尚未达到基石模型量级。

papers.title: NarrativeFlow: Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Model Using Robot Velocity Fields
papers.abstract: We focus on language-conditioned flow-based manipulation, where robot flows (robot velocity fields) serve as embodiment-agnostic, motion-centric representations for leveraging data collected from multiple robot platforms. This task is crucial because language-conditioned manipulation is essential for practical robotic systems, yet scaling robot foundation models remains limited by the labor-intensive collection of embodiment-specific data. Existing methods either coarsely approximate robot flows with sparse keypoint displacements, or cannot handle language-conditioned manipulation. To address this limitation, we propose NarrativeFlow, which models robot flows as continuous velocity fields using a flow-matching formulation conditioned on language. Accordingly, NarrativeFlow generates robot flows that are physically consistent with real-world manipulation. To validate NarrativeFlow, we have conducted experiments on standard datasets for language-conditioned manipulation. The experimental results show that NarrativeFlow outperforms representative baseline methods on standard evaluation metrics. Furthermore, through real-world experiments, we show that NarrativeFlow achieves higher success rates than baseline methods across multiple manipulation tasks. The project page is available at https://shota0520.github.io/NarrativeFlow-project-page/

analysis.tldr: 提出NarrativeFlow模型，用连续速度场（而非离散关键点）表示机器人动作，以语言为条件生成物理合理的操作流，支持跨机器人平台复用，但在真实机器人实验中仅验证了少量任务，未展示多机体泛化或大规模数据训练。
analysis.claim: 语言条件下的机器人操作可被更有效地建模为连续、物理一致的机器人速度场，该表示具备跨机体通用性，且能通过flow-matching实现高质量生成。
analysis.input: 语言指令+视觉观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 连续机器人速度场（即每空间位置的6D末端速度向量场）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真与真实机器人混合数据，但摘要未说明真实数据规模、采集方式及是否开源
analysis.significance_reason: 虽将flow-based建模引入VLA领域并提升物理一致性，但未使用千小时级真实轨迹、未验证跨机体/跨任务强泛化、无消融证明速度场表征的必要性，真实实验仅覆盖有限任务，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级模型的规模、鲁棒性与开放性标准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：改进了动作表征形式并取得小幅性能提升，但缺乏数据规模、泛化验证和开源完备性，属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，暂未构成范式突破或基础能力升级。

papers.title: EgoTools: Towards Tool-Centric Reasoning in Real-World Egocentric Videos
papers.abstract: Real-world embodied tasks, from everyday activities to professional procedures, require agents to act under physical constraints while tracking evolving object and task states. Tool use sits at the heart of such tasks, as many everyday and professional activities are tool-mediated. Understanding them requires reasoning about affordances, hand-tool-object geometry, procedural progress, and causal effects on target objects. Yet despite strong performance on perception-oriented video tasks such as captioning and general video QA, current multimodal video models remain limited in this form of tool-centric embodied reasoning. Progress in this direction has been limited by the lack of real-world egocentric data and diagnostic benchmarks. To address this gap, we introduce EgoTools, the first comprehensive suite for egocentric tool-use understanding. It consists of two complementary components: EgoTools-Data, a large-scale corpus of 100 hours of tool-centric egocentric recordings with synchronized audio, dense captions, reasoning-heavy narrations, and supplementary 3D information; and EgoTools-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,000 QA pairs across four tracks that cover tool-use understanding from perception and geometry to procedure and causal reasoning. Experimental results show that current models still struggle to ground tool use in visual evidence: Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves 66.9% overall accuracy but only 51.7% on Perception & Grounding. Beyond evaluation, we validate EgoTools-Data as a training resource. On the full 1,000-question benchmark, full supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct from 50.0% to 60.9%, under strict source-video separation. Together, these results establish EgoTools as a unified resource for both training and diagnostic evaluation of real-world egocentric tool-use understanding.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个面向真实世界第一人称视角工具使用理解的大规模数据集EgoTools-Data（100小时带多模态标注的视频）和诊断性基准EgoTools-Bench（1000个覆盖感知、几何、流程、因果四维度的问答对），用于评测和提升模型对工具使用背后物理约束、手-具-物关系及操作因果性的推理能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无法从姓名与上下文可靠推断为英伟达/DeepMind/清华等明确机构）
analysis.claim: 真实世界第一人称视频中的工具使用理解需要超越表层感知的多层级具身推理，而现有模型在此类任务上严重不足，EgoTools首次提供了系统性训练与诊断资源来推动该方向。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角视频+同步音频+密集字幕+叙述性推理文本+3D辅助信息
analysis.output: 针对工具使用问题的问答答案（分类/短文本生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅依赖人类佩戴摄像头录制的真实场景视频
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了真实egocentric tool-use理解领域长期缺失高质量数据与诊断基准的空白，实证扎实（100小时真数据、四维度QA设计、严格source-video隔离验证），但属基础设施型贡献而非算法或范式突破；显著优于纯仿真或小规模标注工作，但远未达到World Model/Dreamer/Genie级的理论深度或跨任务泛化影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是当前具身AI中稀缺且必需的高质量实证基础设施，但本质是诊断性数据工程，非算法或认知建模范式创新。

papers.title: MixVLA: Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved remarkable advances in robotic manipulation, yet their zero-shot generalization under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions remains limited. These models often entangle task-relevant invariant structure with environment-specific non-invariant factors, causing policies to rely on spurious appearance cues during action prediction. In this work, we propose \textbf{MixVLA}, a model-agnostic training framework that improves the generalization of VLA models without requiring additional OOD data or architectural modifications. The key component of MixVLA is \textbf{Adaptive Mixing of Non-Invariant Information (AMI)}. AMI stochastically mixes non-invariant representations to regularize distribution-specific variability while preserving complementary predictive cues. The mixed non-invariant features are then fused with invariant representations for final action prediction, resulting in improved robustness without sacrificing policy expressiveness. Extensive experiments across challenging manipulation settings, including LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, the RoboTwin perturbation suite, and real-world tasks, demonstrate that MixVLA improves overall zero-shot robustness while retaining strong in-domain performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MixVLA的训练框架，通过随机混合环境特异性（非不变）特征来抑制模型对虚假外观线索的依赖，从而提升视觉-语言-动作模型在未见过任务和环境下的零样本泛化能力，不改模型结构、不需额外OOD数据。
analysis.claim: 通过自适应混合非不变表征，可在不修改模型架构、不引入OOD标注数据的前提下，显著提升VLA模型的零样本跨环境泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真基准数据（LIBERO系列、RoboTwin），未使用真实机器人采集的新数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（非不变特征混洗有理论动机），在多个主流仿真benchmark（LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/RoboTwin）上报告了稳健提升，但全为仿真结果、无真机验证、无消融实验细节披露、未开源代码或模型，且未挑战任何长期开放难题（如sim2real gap本质缓解、多机体统一策略等），属于扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在仿真VLA泛化方向做了有逻辑的正则化改进，但缺乏真机验证、开源和机制分析，尚未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: TAME:Topology-Aware Text-Driven Motion Editing across Heterogeneous Humanoid Skeletons
papers.abstract: Text-driven motion editing modifies an existing motion sequence according to a text instruction while preserving the content of the source motion. Existing methods are typically built for a single, fixed skeletal topology, which limits their use in animation pipelines where characters differ in joint count and skeletal hierarchy. We present Topology-Aware Motion Editor (TAME), a flow-matching transformer that edits motions on humanoid skeletons of varying topology. TAME represents motion as per-joint, per-frame tokens and models interactions among joints, across frames, and with the text instruction through skeletal, temporal, and text cross-attention layers. To make the skeletal attention follow each character's hierarchy, TAME replaces full joint attention with Topology-Constrained Skeletal Propagation (TCSP), which restricts attention to one-hop kinematic neighbors in the skeleton's adjacency matrix. We further introduce Edit-Focused Representation Alignment (EFRA), a self-distilled representation alignment strategy that aligns student features with cleaner EMA-teacher features exclusively on edit-relevant joint-time tokens, making edits faithful to the instruction. To make this setting trainable and comparable, we construct TopoMotionFix, a multi-topology extension of MotionFix with seen- and unseen-topology evaluation protocols. TAME outperforms previous methods in edit alignment and source preservation on MotionFix and reliably edits motions on unseen skeletons in TopoMotionFix.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能根据文本指令编辑人体动作序列的模型TAME，关键是它能适配不同骨骼拓扑结构（比如关节数量和层级关系不同的虚拟人），不再局限于固定骨架，解决了动画制作中跨角色动作编辑的兼容性问题。
analysis.claim: 通过拓扑约束的骨骼传播机制（TCSP）和编辑聚焦的表征对齐策略（EFRA），TAME首次实现了在异构人形骨架上保持文本指令对齐与源动作保真度的文本驱动动作编辑。
analysis.input: 原始动作序列（如SMPL/AMASS格式）+ 文本编辑指令（如“让角色挥手更慢”）
analysis.output: 编辑后的动作序列（同格式，但关节数/层级可不同）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开动作捕捉数据集（AMASS、HumanML3D等）
analysis.significance_reason: 确实在跨骨架文本编辑这一窄但实际痛点问题上做出实质性推进：构造了首个支持seen/unseen拓扑评估的TopoMotionFix基准，TCSP机制有明确几何依据，EFRA设计合理且消融充分；但未涉及真实世界交互、控制闭环或物理可行性验证，仍属离线动画生成范畴，与所列基石论文（全部面向具身智能/真实机器人行为建模/世界模型/零样本泛化）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了动画管线中长期存在的跨骨架文本编辑兼容性问题，证据扎实但领域边界明确，不属于具身智能或机器人控制的突破。

papers.title: Coupled neuro-fluid dynamics in human bioelectromagnetism
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) are widely interpreted as direct, non-invasive measures of neural population activity, assuming surrounding tissue and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) act as passive volume conductors that distorts but do not contribute to signal generation. Using conductive-fluid phantom experiments, structural magnetic resonance imaging, and in vivo EEG and MEG recordings, the present report challenges this assumption. Mechanically driven conductive fluid generated structured, oscillatory, source-localizable electromagnetic signals resembling M/EEG in the absence of neural tissue, and interindividual differences in CSF volume systematically moderated M/EEG signal amplitude. These findings suggest that, at the scales accessed by invasive and non-invasive electrophysiology, electromagnetic and mechanical processes form a coupled system in which contributions of neural currents and fluid motion cannot readily be uniquely separated.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过导电液体模型实验、MRI结构成像和真实人体EEG/MEG记录，发现脑脊液（CSF）的机械性流动本身就能产生类似脑电信号的电磁振荡，且CSF体积差异会系统性影响EEG/MEG信号幅度，从而质疑了传统神经电生理学中‘CSF仅是被动导体’的基本假设，指出神经电流与流体运动在电磁信号生成中存在不可分割的耦合。
analysis.claim: 在非侵入式脑电/脑磁信号生成尺度上，神经电流与脑脊液机械流动构成不可分离的耦合电磁-流体动力学系统，CSF并非被动导体而是主动信号源成分。
analysis.input: 导电流体物理模型驱动信号 + 结构MRI + 同步EEG/MEG实测数据
analysis.output: 对EEG/MEG信号中神经源与流体源贡献的解耦分析与定量关联证据
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量同步人脑EEG/MEG+结构MRI数据，但未说明是否使用公开队列或自建队列；未报告数据规模（如被试数、扫描次数），仅称‘interindividual differences’，属小样本实证
analysis.significance_reason: 挑战了EEG/MEG基础物理模型这一五十年未被撼动的范式前提，实证扎实（phantom→MRI→in vivo三重验证），但尚未转化为可部署的信号分离算法或临床工具，也未展示对BCI解码性能的实际提升；显著强于纯理论工作，但弱于前述90+分里程碑（那些均实现长期稳定、高精度、闭环控制的临床级功能输出）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进某个BCI模块，而是动摇整个非侵入式神经电生理信号解释的地基，证据链完整，但离工程化应用尚有距离

papers.title: SonoWorld: Towards Interactive Pose-Controllable Ultrasound World Models
papers.abstract: Robotic ultrasound can standardize image acquisition and reduce operator workload and variability, but policy learning remains limited by the lack of realistic, controllable simulation environments. While controllable world models have advanced rapidly in natural-image domains, ultrasound world modeling remains challenging because each frame captures only a cross-section of unobserved 3D anatomy, causing small probe motions to induce large appearance changes. Existing approaches rely on robot-tracked poses and latent-space prediction, but do not directly generate the observations required for interactive control. We propose SonoWorld, a causal ultrasound world model that learns video dynamics from unlabeled clinical videos and grounds them to 6-DoF control using a small set of freehand clinical scans tracked with an EM sensor. SonoWorld is trained in three stages: pretraining a latent-action-conditioned video diffusion model on around 6.9 million unlabeled multi-organ ultrasound frames; grounding the learned video dynamics to metric probe poses with a small EM-tracked thyroid dataset; and applying distribution matching distillation to enable causal, long-horizon autoregressive generation with selectively caching eviction tokens at inference time. We evaluate controllability through pose-following fidelity, round-trip consistency, and axis-specific control under synthetic actions on held-out tracked scans, and further validate it with a user study. In model-based action discrimination, SonoWorld correctly ranks the target-directed probe motion over an equal-magnitude opposite motion in up to 74.8% of trials. To our knowledge, SonoWorld is the first causal, pose-controllable ultrasound world model learned primarily from freehand clinical videos, providing a data-driven interactive environment for robotic ultrasound data acquisition and policy evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 提出SonoWorld，一个能根据6自由度超声探头位姿控制生成对应超声视频帧的因果世界模型，主要用690万未标注临床超声视频帧预训练，再用少量电磁跟踪甲状腺扫描数据对齐位姿，实现无需真实机器人交互即可仿真探头运动与图像响应的闭环环境。
analysis.claim: SonoWorld是首个从自由手扫临床超声视频中学习得到的、具备因果性与6-DoF位姿可控性的超声世界模型，可支撑机器人超声策略的离线训练与评估。
analysis.input: 6自由度探头位姿（平移+旋转）+当前视频帧/隐状态
analysis.output: 下一帧超声图像（像素级）或隐空间表征
analysis.robot_dependency: 电磁定位传感器（EM tracker）用于小规模位姿对齐，但推理时不依赖机器人硬件
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖少量EM-tracked真实扫描（仅甲状腺），预训练依赖大量未标注自由手扫视频；不依赖机器人执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型范式系统引入超声成像这一强几何歧义、弱纹理、非稳态的医学影像模态，并完成从无标注视频到可控生成的闭环构建；实证含用户研究、多指标定量评估及动作判别任务，但仅覆盖单一器官（甲状腺）、未验证跨器官泛化、无真机闭环策略部署、代码未开源，尚未达到DreamerV3/WEAVER级工程完备性与领域普适性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在超声这一高难度模态上成功移植世界模型框架并完成位姿可控性验证，但受限于器官单一性、无跨域泛化、无真机闭环，尚属扎实的领域定向工程突破，非范式级突破。

papers.title: Disagreement-Guided Weak-to-Strong Routing
papers.abstract: Small language models are increasingly deployed on edge devices and robotic systems to meet cost and latency constraints, yet their limited capabilities can make reliable deployment challenging. Stronger models can provide assistance when needed, but deciding when to route a weak-model response to a stronger model often relies on signals of response correctness. In open-ended and agentic tasks, however, obtaining such signals can require costly ground-truth supervision that is difficult to obtain at scale. We revisit the foundations of weak-to-strong routing and ask whether routing decisions can instead be guided by signals that do not require ground-truth supervision. We first characterize the optimal weak-to-strong routing policy, while allowing for multiple weak-model responses generated through local inference. Building on this characterization, we derive a principled approximation to the optimal routing based on model-to-model comparison. In particular, we introduce a notion of model disagreement that can be measured directly from model-generated responses, without ground-truth supervision. Importantly, the approximation becomes increasingly accurate as the strong model becomes a better proxy for the ground-truth distribution. Across agentic and single-turn tasks, our approach effectively navigates the trade-off between routing cost and response accuracy without ground-truth supervision. Moreover, even when ground-truth correctness signals are available for training, disagreement-based routing can outperform methods trained directly to predict correctness

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需真实标签监督的弱模型到强模型路由机制，通过多个弱模型响应之间的‘分歧度’来判断是否需要调用强模型，从而在不依赖人工标注或真值的情况下动态平衡响应质量与计算开销。
analysis.claim: 模型间分歧（disagreement）可作为无监督信号替代真值监督，实现近似最优的弱到强模型路由决策。
analysis.input: 用户查询 + 多个弱语言模型生成的响应
analysis.output: 二元路由决策（是否调用强模型）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在LLM推理调度方向有清晰方法论贡献：首次将模型分歧系统化用于无监督路由，并在多任务上验证有效性；但未涉及机器人具身交互、未接入真实硬件闭环、未构建新数据集或仿真器，属AI×系统优化子方向扎实增量，未达具身智能/BCI/AI×Science领域里程碑门槛（如RT-2级需跨模态动作生成+真实部署+大规模泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模型分歧这一已有概念提炼为可计算的路由信号，在LLM边缘部署场景中做了严谨建模与实证，但未突破AI×科学/机器人等主赛道的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: RoboSemanticBench: Diagnosing Semantic Grounding in Action Prediction for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are built on the premise that semantic understanding from pretrained language or vision-language backbones should guide robot action prediction. Yet robot fine-tuning is optimized as imitation over task-specific action distributions, and many evaluations can be solved through visual or instruction-action shortcuts. We introduce RoboSemanticBench (RSB), an embodied benchmark for diagnosing semantic grounding in action prediction: whether post-trained VLA models can use complex instruction semantics to select and manipulate the correct physical target. In each episode, a robot receives a multiple-choice math or general-knowledge question, observes candidate answer blocks, and must grasp the block corresponding to the correct answer. RSB covers controlled arithmetic, grade-school mathematical understanding, and commonsense or factual understanding under four-choice and ten-choice suites. Across representative VLA models, we find that many policies learn to grasp candidate blocks but select the semantically correct block at near-random or below-random rates after controlling for grasp success, revealing a persistent gap between backbone-level semantic competence and action prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是构建了一个叫RoboSemanticBench的诊断型基准——让机器人读数学题或常识题，再从多个候选积木块里抓取正确答案对应的那一个，专门检测VLA模型是否真能把语言语义‘落地’成正确动作，结果发现主流VLA模型在语义选择上基本靠猜。
analysis.claim: 当前主流VLA模型虽具备语言/视觉骨干的语义能力，但在动作预测阶段无法可靠地将复杂指令语义映射到正确的物理操作目标上。
analysis.input: 多选题文本（数学/常识）+ RGB观测图像（含候选答案块）
analysis.output: 单步抓取动作（对应正确答案块的6D位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机械臂（未明说但benchmark默认基于PyBullet/Mujoco等标准仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯合成任务生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘语义到动作映射失效’的诊断型基准，设计精巧、有实证支撑（多模型在控制抓取成功率后仍随机选答案），但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未提出任何修复方案，属于高质量增量诊断工具，未达基石级（如RT-2/π0等需同时推进建模、训练、部署闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把语义理解与动作解耦诊断做得扎实，但仍是评估工具而非解决方案，不改变VLA建模范式。

papers.title: RescueBench: Can Embodied Agents Save Lives in the Wild ?
papers.abstract: Search-and-rescue (SAR) requires embodied agents to explore unfamiliar environments under multimodal uncertainty, perform multi-stage interactions, and retrieve spatial memory over long horizons. Existing benchmarks typically evaluate these capabilities in isolation, leaving unclear how failures compound when they must be composed in realistic workflows. We introduce RescueBench, a photo-realistic diagnostic benchmark that instantiates SAR as a four-stage pipeline: multimodal exploration, target rescue, memory-guided return, and final handoff. By combining sequential task composition with stage-level evaluation, RescueBench enables analysis of how exploration and memory failures propagate through embodied rescue workflows. It contains five progressive difficulty levels that vary in environmental complexity, clue ambiguity, and spatial hierarchy, along with an automatic episode generation and annotation pipeline for scalable evaluation and training. We evaluate seven baselines, an oracle reference, and human players, showing that no baselines complete the full task at the greatest difficulty. Stage-level diagnosis identifies autonomous exploration as the dominant failure mode and spatial memory as a second, independent bottleneck, suggesting that these limitations are not resolved by current topological visual-language navigation or map-based methods. Code is available in https://github.com/wukui-muc/RescueBench

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向野外搜救任务的、分阶段诊断型仿真基准RescueBench，用以暴露现有具身智能在多阶段组合任务中（探索→救援→记忆返回→交接）的级联失败问题，核心发现是自主探索和空间记忆是两个独立且未被解决的瓶颈。
analysis.claim: 当前具身智能方法在真实搜救工作流中失败的根本原因不是单一模块缺陷，而是多阶段任务组合下自主探索能力不足与空间记忆能力薄弱的双重、独立瓶颈，且二者无法被现有拓扑导航或地图方法缓解。
analysis.input: RGB-D观测+语言指令+环境线索（如声音/文本提示）
analysis.output: 动作序列（移动/交互/抓取/放置）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（基于Unity/Unreal的自定义具身代理，无指定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、结构清晰、有诊断深度的benchmark工作，但属于领域基础设施建设而非范式突破；未涉及真实机器人、未提出新模型/算法/架构，所有结论止步于对现有方法的归因分析，且7个基线中无一个SOTA级具身VLA模型（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA等），评估广度与前沿性不足。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——它把搜救任务拆解成可诊断的四阶段流水线并实证定位了两个关键瓶颈，但仍是纯仿真benchmark，未推动算法/部署/泛化边界，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: MAGI: Mechanistic Consequences of Genetic Variants via Genomic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Clinical variant interpretation requires mechanism-aware evidence to guide diagnosis and clarify the biological consequences of mutations. However, existing computational predictors and genomic foundation models largely function as black boxes, providing pathogenicity labels with limited mechanistic insight or clinical actionability. Here, we present MAGI (Mechanistic Annotation of Genomic Impacts), a novel method that bridges this interpretability gap by unifying clinically relevant variant interpretation with mechanistic genomic analysis. MAGI pipeline leverages a genomic transformer model to quantify the effects of DNA variants across 3,623 functional tracks, encompassing regulatory features, multi-omics datasets, including tissue specificity and chromatin states, and 21 additional molecular annotations of genes and transcripts. These signals are integrated through a deterministic logic layer that maps single-nucleotide variants and indels to explicit molecular consequences. We benchmark MAGI-derived consequences against clinical rationales curated from ClinVar and observe strong concordance that scales with the magnitude of functional disruption. MAGI accurately recapitulates canonical pathogenic mechanisms, including start codon loss, splice site disruption, and regulatory element perturbation, consistent with ClinVar annotations. We further present case studies addressing conflicting or incomplete mechanistic interpretations, as well as variants requiring complex inference. Notably, MAGI is also applicable to non-human genomes and was evaluated on multispecies OMIA pathogenic variants. Collectively, MAGI establishes a generalizable framework that extends beyond clinical diagnostics to enable mechanistic discovery in functional genomics, generating mechanistically grounded, testable hypotheses for variants of uncertain significance (VUS) and variants with discordant clinical interpretations. In several cases, MAGI proposes alternative explanations that challenge existing annotations, providing transparent rationales and experimentally tractable predictions.

papers.title: GIVE: Grounding Human Gestures in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Human communication is inherently multimodal, where language is often accompanied by non-verbal cues such as gestures to convey intentions. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models treat robotic manipulation as a pure text-driven task, overlooking the important role of gestures in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI). This often leads to inaccurate intent grounding and unreliable manipulation when language instructions are ambiguous or underspecified. To address this challenge, we propose GIVE (Gesture Intent via Visual-Semantic Enhancement), an effective approach that enhances pre-trained VLA models with human gesture understanding without architectural modifications. Specifically, GIVE incorporates gesture information through two complementary pathways: a visual pathway that overlays hand skeletons and fingertip rays onto robot observations for explicit object grounding, and a semantic pathway that generates high-level descriptions of human gestures and task instructions for robust intent grounding. By jointly leveraging visual and semantic guidance, GIVE enables VLA policies to better associate gestures with manipulation behaviors and adapt to dynamic interaction intents. In real-world HRI experiments, GIVE substantially outperforms the baseline, improving target object recognition accuracy by 40% and overall task success rate by 80%, while demonstrating strong robustness and generalization to unseen spatial layouts and diverse participants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人模型加了手势理解能力，不改模型结构，只通过在输入端叠加手部骨架+射线可视化、以及生成手势语义描述两种方式，让机器人能结合人比划的手势更准地听懂模糊语言指令并完成操作任务。

papers.title: BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models
papers.abstract: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将世界模型拆分为‘智能体模块’和‘背景模块’并通过可学习隐式接口耦合的结构化建模方法，使得背景动力学可以冻结复用、更换智能体时无需重训整个世界模型。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的全局动力学可解耦为功能独立的智能体与背景模块，通过隐式接口组合，实现背景动力学的跨智能体复用。
analysis.input: 观测序列（如图像或状态向量）
analysis.output: 预测的未来隐状态序列及动作策略

papers.title: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: A 3D World Model with Disentangled Ego-Motion
papers.abstract: Forecasting the evolution of dynamic environments is crucial for autonomous agents. While generative world models have recently achieved high photorealism in 2D video synthesis by mixing ego-motion and environmental dynamics within the image plane, they exhibit physical inconsistencies, such as morphing or vanishing objects, especially over long time horizons. In this paper, we propose FR3D, a world model that predicts a persistent 3D latent representation for future dynamic 3D reconstruction. Unlike prior works that treat the world as a sequence of image-based features, FR3D explicitly decouples the 3D evolution of the scene from the agent's trajectory, treating the inferred ego-motion as a latent proxy for action. This disentanglement resolves the ambiguities between self-motion and world-motion, ensuring geometric consistency into the future. Furthermore, we introduce a teacher-student distillation strategy that leverages the spatial "common sense" of off-the-shelf foundation models, leading to robust zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate FR3D's strong performance for future dynamic 3D reconstruction from monocular observations across multiple datasets, even 2 seconds into the future. Project page: https://fr3d-wm.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FR3D模型，从单目视频中预测未来2秒内动态场景的几何一致、物理合理的3D世界状态，核心是把智能体自身运动（ego-motion）和环境真实变化（world-motion）在3D潜空间里彻底解耦，避免传统2D视频生成模型中物体凭空消失或形变的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过在3D潜空间中显式解耦ego-motion与world-motion，并蒸馏视觉基础模型的空间常识，可实现几何一致、零样本泛化的未来动态3D重建。

analysis.output: 未来多时刻的动态3D隐式表示（如NeRF/3D Gaussian Splatting兼容的时空场）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需单目动态场景视频（如Waymo、nuScenes、KITTI衍生数据）

papers.title: HALOMI: Learning Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations, which can be collected at scale and naturally capture active hand-eye coordination, are a promising data source for learning humanoid loco-manipulation. However, directly transferring human demonstrations to humanoids requires a precise world-frame tracking controller, which is often brittle under Out-of-Distribution(OOD) targets, while human-to-humanoid gaps persist in both egocentric observation and action execution. To address these challenges, we present HALOMI, a scalable framework for learning humanoid loco-manipulation with active perception from human demonstrations. HALOMI extends Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with egocentric sensing to collect ego-view and wrist-view observations along with head-hand trajectories at scale. We further propose a manifold-constrained controller that plans in a learned latent behavior manifold to enable precise and robust head-hand tracking in the world frame. To bridge the human-to-humanoid gap, we perform ego-view alignment and introduce a controller-aware reference trajectory adaptation to reduce mismatch in both observation and action execution. We validate HALOMI on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot with an actuated neck across five real-world tasks involving navigation, grasping, bimanual manipulation, whole-body coordination, and dynamic behaviors. Across the three quantitatively evaluated tasks, HALOMI achieves an average success rate of 85\%, while additional qualitative demonstrations show its ability to support dynamic tossing and deep-squat grasping.

analysis.tldr: 用人类示范数据（头戴+手腕摄像头+轨迹）训练人形机器人做行走-操作一体化任务，通过自研的潜空间控制器和观测量/轨迹对齐方法，在Unitree G1真机上实现了85%平均成功率的多任务执行。

papers.title: AutoZyme: An Autonomous Agentic Framework to Optimize Bioinformatics Software
papers.abstract: Abstract Performance bottlenecks in widely used genomics and bioinformatics software present a substantial and growing burden as biological datasets continue to increase in size and number. Relieving these bottlenecks relies largely on expert manual optimization and therefore remains difficult to scale. Here we present AutoZyme, an agentic framework for scientific software optimization. Given a target function, AutoZyme builds benchmarks, identifies bottlenecks, and iteratively tests code changes, retaining only those that improve runtime while preserving output. We evaluated AutoZyme on 45 functions, improving runtime without substantial memory increases in over 95% of cases considered. Across 38 functions from Seurat, Scanpy and related packages in genomics and bioinformatics, AutoZyme reduced runtime by a median of 8.52-fold, with the largest reductions exceeding 676-fold. The optimized functions are distributed through AutoZyme-Library as drop-in replacements for existing analysis pipelines. We also release AutoZyme as a reusable framework for optimizing additional user-specified packages and functions.

analysis.tldr: AutoZyme是一个自动代理框架，能自动识别生物信息学软件（如Seurat、Scanpy）中的性能瓶颈，生成测试基准，反复修改代码并验证——只保留既加速运行又不改变计算结果的优化，最终将优化后的函数打包成即插即用的替代库。
analysis.org: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
analysis.claim: 无需人工干预，AI代理可全自动完成科学软件（尤其是基因组分析工具）的正确性保持型性能优化。

papers.title: Reference-Free Assessment of Physical Consistency in World Model-based Video Generation
papers.abstract: We introduce reference-free measures for evaluating the physical consistency of generated videos, combining relative and absolute approaches to assess fidelity. Although tools like WorldGym or WorldEval enable robotic simulation via video generation, physical fidelity gaps often prevent these environments from accurately reproducing real-world task success rates of VLA models. Unlike existing evaluation methods, which require costly human voting (Elo) or unavailable ground-truth references (FVD), our approach utilizes DROID-SLAM and SEA-RAFT to quantify physical inconsistencies, motivated by WorldScore. Videos filtered using our relative consistency assessment show an improvement in task success rates of over 8%, effectively narrowing the simulation-to-reality gap. Furthermore, our absolute assessment enables spatio-temporal localization, providing visualization of when and where physical artifacts occur.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种无需真实视频参考、也不依赖人工评分的自动评估方法，用SLAM和光流模型来检测生成视频中违反物理规律的帧和区域，从而量化世界模型生成视频的物理一致性，并验证该评估能提升仿真到现实的迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 无需参考视频或人工标注，仅通过DROID-SLAM和SEA-RAFT即可定量评估世界模型生成视频的物理一致性，并显著缩小sim2real任务成功率差距。
analysis.input: 生成的视频序列
analysis.output: 物理不一致性的时空定位图（像素级+帧级）及相对/绝对一致性得分
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个可定位、免参考的物理一致性评估框架，实证显示其筛选后的视频使任务成功率提升8%，但未开源代码/模型，仅靠项目页；方法依赖现成SLAM/光流模型（非原创），未在多世界模型或跨任务上验证泛化性，也未与FVD/Elo等基准做系统对比，属扎实但窄口径的评估工具创新，未触及世界模型架构或训练范式本身。

papers.title: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are a scalable data source for learning robot manipulation policies. However, common sources of human demonstration data, such as motion-capture trajectories and internet videos, capture mostly motion and appearance while missing the contact forces that are critical for force-sensitive manipulation. In this paper, we introduce ForceBand, a low-cost wrist-worn sEMG system that turns human muscle activity into force-enriched demonstrations. We first collect a 10-hour multimodal dataset containing egocentric video, sEMG, IMU, and fingertip force measurements across diverse actions and objects. Using this dataset, we pre-train an EMG2Force model that predicts per-finger forces from sEMG and IMU signals. After a short user-specific calibration, users can collect target-task demonstrations using only ForceBand and video; EMG2Force then labels these demonstrations with per-finger force traces, producing force-augmented demonstrations for robot policy learning. Experiments show that ForceBand recovers fine-grained fingertip interactions with over 50% lower force prediction error than vision-based baselines and achieves an 87% success rate on pick, squeeze, and place tasks that require object-specific force control across objects with diverse shapes, sizes, and weights. Project website: https://forceband-emg.github.io

analysis.tldr: 用低成本腕戴sEMG设备捕捉人手肌肉电信号，结合IMU和指尖力标定数据，训练模型将sEMG实时映射为每根手指的精细力轨迹，从而为机器人操作策略学习生成带真实力标签的示范数据，显著提升需精确力控的任务（如抓取、挤压、放置）成功率。
analysis.org: 马里兰大学/马克斯·普朗克研究所/加州大学伯克利分校（作者含Jitendra Malik、Cornelia Fermuller、Jiayuan Mao等；核心贡献单位为马里兰大学与MPIC，但跨机构合作中伯克利与马普所权重高；综合判断以马里兰大学为主，因第一作者Botao He隶属UMD，且项目主页域名未体现企业）

analysis.output: 每根手指的三维力时间序列轨迹（力向量随时间变化）

analysis.significance_reason: 在力感知示范学习领域实现关键工程突破：首次将sEMG用于细粒度多指力重建并闭环用于真实机器人操作（87%成功率），跨形状/尺寸/重量物体验证泛化性，误差比纯视觉基线低50%；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未接入通用策略架构（如ACT/Diffusion Policy），相比ALOHA/ACT（96分）或RealDexUMI（94分）仍属强应用级创新而非范式级突破。

papers.title: Position: Vision-Language-Action Models Cannot Be Verified to Perform Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, built on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), have shown rapidly improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. These gains are commonly interpreted as evidence that semantic representations learned from internet-scale data transfer to physical execution generalization. This position paper argues that the assumption underlying this interpretation -- that semantic generalization is sufficient to support physical action decisions -- has not been independently verified and cannot be tested under current evaluation protocols. We support this claim by decomposing VLA policies into semantic mapping and physical action decision, and showing that task success rate -- the dominant evaluation metric -- cannot distinguish between these two sources of capability. As a result, improvements in benchmark performance are consistent with multiple competing explanations, including semantic matching, distributional overlap, and genuine physical generalization. We further argue that this identifiability gap has been reinforced through narrative drift, whereby successive systems inherit and strengthen prior interpretations of performance gains without isolating the underlying causal mechanism. To address this limitation, we propose a research direction based on evaluation designs that introduce controlled variation to separately measure semantic and physical generalization. Such designs make it possible to causally attribute performance without requiring access to model internals, and to empirically assess the role of VLM backbones as semantic interfaces rather than implicit sources of physical competence. Our goal is not to refute the role of VLMs in robotics, but to clarify the conditions under which claims of physical generalization can be meaningfully evaluated.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操纵任务上的性能提升，并不能证明其具备物理推理能力，因为现有评测指标（如任务成功率）无法区分模型是靠语义匹配‘蒙对’了动作，还是真理解了物理规律；作者呼吁设计能分离评估语义泛化与物理泛化的新评测方法。

papers.title: Chronos: A Physics-Informed Full-History Framework for Non-Markovian Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot policies should be modeled as dynamical systems, yet many VLA and generative imitation policies still rely on present observations or short windows. This Markovian shortcut fails in memory-dependent manipulation: identical observations can demand different actions after different histories. We present Chronos, a physics-informed full-history framework for non-Markovian long-horizon manipulation. The key idea is to elevate observation history from auxiliary context to the latent state of the policy dynamics. At each physical control step, Chronos forms one state-representative token by fusing observation and proprioception, so the token sequence is aligned one-to-one with physical time. A selective state space model propagates this causal historical state, which conditions a multimodal coarse action prior through implicit maximum likelihood estimation (IMLE). This prior is then refined by a second-order Schrodinger-inspired bridge that predicts acceleration fields, yielding smoother and more physically grounded robot motion. Across 16 simulated tasks and 4 real-world experiments, Chronos is evaluated on precision insertion, general manipulation, and memory-dependent long-horizon control. On RMBench, where success requires remembering task phase, Chronos achieves 73.6% average success, outperforming Markovian VLA baseline pi0.5 by +62.4 percentage points, a 6.6x relative gain, while using 10x fewer parameters. It also surpasses the memory VLA Mem-0 by 22.8 points while using over 30x fewer parameters. In real-world dual-arm experiments using a single RGB camera, Chronos achieves 78% average success over four tasks, including 72% on the three memory-dependent tasks, whereas pi0.5 achieves 7% overall and 0% on the memory-dependent subset. These results suggest that history should not be treated as auxiliary context, but as the latent state of the manipulation policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出Chronos框架，把机器人操作的历史观测序列直接建模为动力学系统的隐状态（而非辅助上下文），用物理启发的时序模型+加速度场预测实现长程记忆型操作，在16个仿真任务和4个真实双臂实验中显著超越现有Markovian和memory-VLA基线。

papers.title: Spatial Attention: Adapting Execution Horizons for Diffusion Policies via Observation Sensitivity
papers.abstract: Sampling action chunks via generative models has become a widely adopted methodology for robotic learning from demonstration. However, existing methods often struggle to balance responsiveness and computational cost because they execute each action chunk for a fixed execution horizon. In this paper, we adaptively adjust the execution horizon of sampled action chunks, balancing responsiveness and computational efficiency. We introduce Spatial Attention -- defined as the expected squared norm of the gradient of the action log-likelihood with respect to the observation -- which indicates the sensitivity of the policy's action distribution to variations in the observation. We show that, under a fixed budget of chunk samplings, the execution horizon that minimizes the cumulative likelihood drop induced by disturbances decreases as Spatial Attention increases. By forecasting future Spatial Attention values alongside the action chunk, our framework dynamically assigns shorter execution horizons to phases with high Spatial Attention, and longer horizons to phases with low Spatial Attention. Experiments on standard and perturbed tasks, in both simulation and on a real robot, show that our method significantly improves success rates over fixed-horizon baselines while maintaining the average execution horizon.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫‘空间注意力’的指标，用来动态调整扩散策略采样出的动作块的执行时长——观测越敏感（空间注意力越高），动作块执行越短，反之越长，从而在保持平均执行时长不变的前提下提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过定义并预测观测敏感度（空间注意力），可自适应调节扩散策略的动作块执行时长，在固定采样预算下最小化扰动导致的累积似然下降。

papers.title: Quantum Encoding Strategies for Drug Response Prediction: An Exhaustive Benchmark on a 20-Qubit Superconducting QPU
papers.abstract: We present the first systematic, hardware-executed benchmark of twelve distinct quantum data-encoding strategies for drug-response prediction on a real superconducting quantum processing unit (QPU). All experiments were conducted on the IQM Garnet 20-qubit QPU via the IQM Resonance cloud platform, using the Qrisp quantum-software framework (v 0.8.2). Each encoding was evaluated on n = 50 stratified samples drawn from the Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer dataset (GDSC2, 242 036 drug-cell-line pairs), targeting the natural-log IC50 response variable. Variational weights were optimised offline with the gradient-free COBYLA algorithm before hardware submission. Every circuit was executed with 1024 shots; the regression signal is the zero-qubit Pauli expectation value (Z0). Results show that the QAOA-inspired encoding achieves the best RMSE of 3.314 and is statistically superior (p < 0.05, Wilcoxon signed-rank test) to six of the remaining eleven encodings. Hardware-efficient entanglement structures-specifically alternating cost and mixer layers-provide a systematic advantage over purely rotational or diagonal encodings under realistic noise conditions. This work constitutes a reproducible baseline for noise-aware quantum machine learning on pharmaceutical data; all code, data, and raw QPU outputs are publicly released.

analysis.tldr: 在真实20量子比特超导量子计算机上，系统测试了12种量子数据编码方法预测抗癌药物反应（IC50），发现QAOA启发式编码效果最好，并证明带交替成本/混合层的硬件高效结构在噪声下更鲁棒，所有代码、数据和原始量子硬件输出全部开源。
analysis.claim: 在真实超导QPU上，QAOA-inspired量子编码策略在药物响应预测任务中显著优于其他11种主流编码方式，且硬件高效纠缠结构（交替cost/mixer层）是噪声下性能鲁棒的关键设计因素。
analysis.input: GDSC2中的基因组特征（细胞系+药物组合）
analysis.output: 自然对数IC50值的回归预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖GDSC2公开组学与药敏数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实QPU上完成药物响应预测的量子编码系统性实证比较，证据扎实（真机+多编码+统计检验+全开源），但问题尺度小（n=50）、未超越经典基线、未解决量子优势核心争议（如是否比最优经典模型更好），属于高质量量子ML工程验证，尚未达到药物发现领域基石级分量（如AlphaFold2/ESM系列/RFdiffusion等90+分工作所解决的生物学建模根本难题）。

papers.title: G2-Nav: Grounded and Guarded Vision-Language Costmaps for Robot Social Navigation
papers.abstract: Social navigation requires the robot to reason and respond in complex real-world environments. While recent works attempt to incorporate human-level intelligence into robot planning using large Vision-Language Models (VLMs), end-to-end frameworks often create an unpredictable black-box, and existing instruction-following methods are not designed for full autonomy. To bridge this gap, we present G2-Nav, a novel framework that grounds abstract social reasoning and guards safe real-world deployment. Instead of asking the VLM for direct planning decisions, G2-Nav translates its semantic reasoning into a vision-language costmap with reliability and interpretability. The VLM evaluates traversable regions and social agents from open-set perception, mapping social context into the costmap. To improve real-world robustness, the VLM performs semantic verification on upstream tracking, and we introduce a high-frequency safety check to guard against system latency prior to trajectory generation. We demonstrate through real-world experiments that G2-Nav delivers safe, efficient, and socially compliant autonomous navigation in unstructured environments. Code will be made publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 提出G2-Nav框架，用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成带社会语义的可解释成本图（costmap），替代端到端黑箱决策，并加入语义验证和高频安全校验，实现在非结构化真实环境中安全、合规的社会导航。
analysis.claim: 将VLM的抽象社会推理显式编译为可解释、可验证的视觉语言成本图，并通过上游语义校验与实时安全守卫机制保障真实机器人部署的可靠性与社会合规性。
