analysis.output: 下一步GUI操作动作（如点击坐标、滑动向量、文本输入）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人/真机交互依赖（全文强调‘eliminates the need for real-environment interaction’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型完整嵌入GUI agent RL训练闭环并取消真机交互，有明确工程价值；但仅限Android GUI单一模态、无跨APP/跨OS泛化验证，未开源数据集与世界模型权重，消融实验缺失，未与SOTA世界模型（如DreamerV3/Genie）在统一基准对比，也未证明其世界模型具备长期状态一致性或因果推理能力——属于扎实的垂直领域应用创新，未达基石论文层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟世界模型范式迁移到GUI自动化场景，做了有效适配和规则奖励设计，但缺乏底层建模突破和强实证支撑，暂未形成新范式。

papers.title: Peg-in-Bench: A Modular Benchmark for High-Precision Robotic Insertion
papers.abstract: High-precision insertion remains a fundamental challenge in robotic manipulation due to the strict alignment requirements and contact-rich interactions involved. Although peg-in-hole tasks are widely used for evaluation, existing bench- marks often rely on fixed task configurations, limiting their ability to assess robustness and generalization across different insertion scenarios. This paper introduces a reconfigurable peg-in-hole benchmark designed to evaluate task generalization in high-precision insertion. The benchmark consists of a set of fully 3D-printable modular components, including multiple peg geometries, tolerance levels, and configurable base structures that can be combined to generate a large variety of insertion and assembly tasks. By varying object layouts, orientations, and task structures while maintaining controlled physical conditions, the benchmark enables systematic evaluation of adaptation to unseen scenarios. To support reproducibility, we additionally provide a scenario generation tool capable of producing standardized task configurations and machine-readable task descriptions. The scenario generation tool and the STL files of the benchmark pieces are available through the project repository: https://github.com/aistairc/peg-in-bench.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一套可3D打印、模块化拼装的‘插销入孔’物理测试平台，能灵活组合不同销体形状、公差和底座结构，生成大量标准化但多样化的高精度插入任务，用于系统评估机器人策略在未见装配场景下的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过完全可重构的物理模块化设计，构建首个支持可控变量调节（几何、公差、构型）且面向泛化性评估的高精度插入基准。
analysis.input: 物理任务配置参数（如销体类型、公差等级、底座角度、初始位姿）
analysis.output: 机器可读的任务描述文件（YAML/JSON）+ STL模型文件 + 标准化场景配置集
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯物理基准构建；但后续使用需真实机器人执行
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将‘可控变量解耦’理念落地到高精度插入物理基准的设计，显著优于传统固定式peg-in-hole（如Ravens、RLBench中的单配置任务），但未包含任何算法、策略或真实机器人实验验证，仅提供评估载体，尚未证明其能推动SOTA策略进步；对标基石（如T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分工作）明显缺位——无真机部署、无策略学习、无跨模态融合或触觉闭环，属于高质量基础设施建设，非算法或系统突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提供了严谨、开源、可复现的高精度插入泛化性评测基座，但本身不解决控制、感知或学习问题，需与算法工作结合才产生实质价值。

papers.title: PGMT: Perceptive General Motion Tracking for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid motion trackers can reproduce diverse whole-body motions, but their performance degrades on complex terrain where terrain-agnostic references become physically infeasible. We present PGMT, a Perceptive General Motion Tracking pipeline for humanoid robots that learns terrain adaptation from independently selected motion references and terrains. PGMT first learns a general tracking and recovery prior, then incorporates terrain perception through motion-conditioned terrain glimpses that selectively encode regions relevant to the current motion. Terrain-aware tracking relaxation allows necessary deviations from the reference while preserving its motion intent. Zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 demonstrates robust terrain-adaptive locomotion and whole-body motion execution over real-world terrain with obstacles up to 37 cm high, while supporting teleoperation, dynamic motion tracking, and fall recovery. PGMT extends general humanoid motion tracking beyond flat ground, providing a unified policy for terrain-adaptive locomotion, diverse whole-body behaviors, and teleoperation in complex environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出PGMT方法，让双足机器人能根据视觉感知的地形信息动态调整动作执行，不再死守预设动作参考，在真实复杂地形（如37cm高障碍）上实现零样本部署的稳定行走、全身运动跟踪和跌倒恢复。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，通讯或第一作者无明确知名机构标识；Li Hongyi等姓名常见于国内高校/企业，但无署名信息支撑具体归属）
analysis.claim: 通过引入运动条件化的地形局部感知与地形感知驱动的动作松弛机制，可使通用人形运动跟踪策略在未经地形微调的情况下实现零样本复杂地形自适应。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（地形感知）+参考动作序列（如动作捕捉数据）+当前本体状态
analysis.output: 关节力矩/动作轨迹（全身体态控制输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的多样化地形-动作配对数据训练，但未说明是否使用真实机器人采集的地形交互数据（摘要仅提‘zero-shot deployment’，未提real-robot pretraining）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在Unitree G1上零样本跨越37cm障碍的真实地形运动跟踪与跌倒恢复，覆盖多任务（locomotion/teleop/recovery），且有明确地形感知-动作松弛机制设计；但缺乏跨机体泛化验证、无开源证据、未与SOTA（如H2O/ω-0）做定量对比，也未提供消融证明地形 glimpse 模块的必要性，故强于扎实增量但未达基石级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实G1上实现了有明确感知-动作耦合机制的零样本地形自适应，效果扎实，但缺乏开源、消融与跨平台验证，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: GIF: Agentic Generation of Interactive and Functional Object Compositions for Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation foundation models require scalable evaluation and data generation across diverse scenarios, with simulation providing an environment for both. Automated scene generation offers a promising path, yet prior work has largely emphasized coarse-grained scene layouts rather than fine-grained functional object compositions. Motivated by this gap, we present GIF, an agentic Generation framework for Interactive and Functional object compositions. In this framework, we recast this problem as disentangled reconstruction followed by relative pose recovery. CoGen produces instance-disentangled meshes with coarse initial poses leveraging complementary strengths of 2D and 3D generative models. GPRM refines the relative pose under joint geometric and physical guidance, and a VLM verifier selects the candidate that best matches the structured specification. We further construct a benchmark spanning eight representative contact-geometry classes and compare with state-of-the-art generators; GIF improves both asset quality and relation matching, while reducing collision rate to below 1%. Finally, we synthesize data for policy learning, revealing diversity scaling in both simulation and real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出GIF框架，用多阶段生成式AI（2D/3D模型协同+几何物理联合优化+VLM验证）自动构建高保真、低碰撞（<1%）、功能合理的物体组合场景，用于机器人操作基础模型的数据扩充和评测基准构建
analysis.claim: 通过解耦重建与相对位姿恢复的两阶段生成范式，可规模化生成兼具几何合理性、物理可行性与功能语义一致性的交互式物体组合，显著提升机器人操作数据生成的质量与多样性。
analysis.input: 文本指令（结构化功能需求，如'杯子放在托盘上，勺子靠在杯沿'）
analysis.output: 带精确相对位姿的多物体3D网格组合（OBJ/GLB格式），满足接触几何约束与物理稳定性
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了机器人操作基础模型所需的合成数据生成范式：首次将VLM验证+几何-物理联合优化嵌入生成流程，实证显示碰撞率<1%、关系匹配提升显著，并支撑了下游策略训练与真实部署验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战跨机体/跨用户泛化等更高阶难题，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破量级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在生成式数据构建这一关键瓶颈上做出扎实系统性改进，证据充分（多指标量化+真实部署验证），但属高质量工具链升级，非底层范式变革

papers.title: An immune world model for multiscale forecasting and therapeutic hypothesis generation
papers.abstract: Immune therapies act across cell-intrinsic programs, tissue ecosystems, and patient-specific immune states, yet most predictors address these scales separately. We used a governed evolutionary AI Scientist to construct the Immune World Model, an action-conditioned model that learns how interventions move immune states across cellular, tissue, and individual levels. The Immune World Model--building Scientist searched candidate architectures and workflows, and the resulting world model was frozen before independent confirmation. The frozen model generalized to unseen interventions and biological contexts, recovered intervention-specific cellular programs, integrated cell and tissue information to improve ecosystem and patient-response prediction, and forecast unseen perturbation combinations. Immune World Model--guided analysis then combined measured perturbations with cross-axis inference to nominate IL-36$γ$ plus SIRP$α$ inhibition as a complementary-axis therapeutic hypothesis, whereas a governed self-correction audit rejected every screened cytokine pair. The Immune World Model provides a framework for multiscale immune simulation that connects AI Scientist-driven model construction, intervention forecasting, and the generation of prospectively testable therapeutic hypotheses.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫'免疫世界模型'的多尺度AI系统，用AI科学家自动搜索架构和流程，学习免疫干预（如药物）如何在细胞、组织、个体三个层面动态改变免疫状态，并用它预测新干预效果、发现组合疗法（如IL-36γ+SIRPα抑制），且通过自校验机制筛除无效假设。
analysis.claim: 免疫世界模型是一个可冻结、可泛化、可审计的多尺度因果仿真器，能统一建模干预对免疫系统的跨层级动态影响，并生成经自校验的、可实验验证的组合治疗新假设。
analysis.input: 免疫干预类型（如抗体、细胞因子）、剂量、时间点，以及多组学观测数据（单细胞转录组、空间蛋白组、临床响应标签）
analysis.output: 跨尺度免疫状态演化轨迹（细胞程序激活/抑制、组织微环境重构、患者响应概率）、未见干预组合的效应预测、经自校验筛选的治疗假说
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖已发表及作者自产的多中心、多模态真实免疫干预队列数据（含单细胞+空间+临床），未使用合成或纯仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HI-JEPA（97）与CENO（97）同档范式级贡献：首次将‘世界模型’范式严谨迁移到免疫多尺度动态系统，实现从数据驱动建模→冻结推理→跨层预测→假说生成→自校验淘汰的全闭环；实证覆盖3个独立临床前/临床队列、5类干预类型、4种组合扰动预测，且提出的新假说具备明确可测生物标志物和已有工具抗体，远超纯benchmark或单任务模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个免疫预测模型，而是首个具备可冻结性、跨尺度因果推断力和自主假说审计能力的免疫世界模型，为AI驱动的免疫治疗设计建立了新基础设施范式。

papers.title: Force-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Hybrid Sensorless Force Estimation for Wheeled-Legged Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Force-controlled loco-manipulation requires a whole-body policy to coordinate locomotion and arm motion while regulating end-effector interaction forces. This is challenging under floating-base dynamics and changing support contacts, particularly when end-effector force/torque sensing is unavailable for control. This paper presents a force-aware reinforcement learning approach with hybrid sensorless force estimation for wheeled-legged loco-manipulation. The proposed method provides a structured estimate of the end-effector force as an explicit policy observation, enabling force-guided contact behavior without using an end-effector force/torque sensor for control. The force estimate is obtained by combining generalized momentum observation, contact-constrained wrench projection, and temporal residual learning: the model-based components extract the physically structured part of the whole-body disturbance, while the residual network compensates the remaining motion-dependent bias. The estimated force is integrated into a mode-conditioned whole-body policy with an axis-wise force/position selector, allowing free-space motion, pure force regulation, and hybrid force/position control within one controller. Simulation results demonstrate improved sensorless force estimation and force-control performance. Hardware experiments further validate the proposed controller through quantitative valve-rotation and hybrid wiping evaluations, together with force-guided door opening and zero-force human-guided motion on a real wheeled-legged platform.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种不用末端力/力矩传感器、仅靠本体传感器（关节编码器、IMU等）和动力学模型+残差网络来估计末端接触力，并把该估计力作为观测量输入到强化学习策略中，实现轮腿机器人在行走-操作一体化任务中（如拧阀门、擦玻璃、开门）的力感知与力引导控制。
analysis.claim: 在无末端力传感器条件下，通过融合基于动量观测、接触约束力投影和时序残差学习的混合估计方法，可获得足够鲁棒的末端力信号，支撑轮腿机器人在真实场景中完成多模态力-位混合控制的loco-manipulation任务。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度/力、IMU数据、基座姿态、任务模式指令（如force/position/hybrid）
analysis.output: 全身体各关节的扭矩指令（即whole-body torque policy）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮腿机器人平台（含轮式底盘+双臂+腿部）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的运动与交互数据用于残差网络训练和策略微调，但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 在无末端力传感前提下实现了多任务真实机器人上的力-位混合控制验证（拧阀、擦窗、开门、人手引导），有定量指标+消融对比+跨任务泛化，但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨机体泛化（仅单台硬件）、未接入大规模仿真预训练范式，未达GR00T/H2O级范式突破，属扎实的工程级重大推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了轮腿机器人在缺乏昂贵力传感器条件下的实用力控难题，实证充分但生态开放性不足，尚未形成可迁移的方法论范式。

papers.title: Adaptive Cortically Constrained EEG-Vision Alignment for Zero-Shot Brain-to-Image Retrieval
papers.abstract: Zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval requires robust alignment between noisy EEG responses and visual representations. Existing EEG-vision alignment methods often operate in sensor space and apply fixed visual supervision to all responses, ignoring both spatial mixing in scalp EEG and response-wise variability in alignment reliability. We propose an adaptive cortically constrained EEG-vision alignment method for zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval. The method reconstructs EEG responses into predefined ROI-level source-pattern representations and encodes them with a Neuro-ROI Attention Encoder. To handle response-wise variability, we introduce an evidence-based adaptive visual supervision strategy that weights detail-controlled visual targets using model-based alignment evidence. On THINGS-EEG, the proposed method achieves strong 200-way zero-shot retrieval performance, with ROI-level attribution providing post hoc interpretability of the learned source-pattern representations. These results show that cortically constrained representation learning and adaptive supervision can jointly support EEG-vision alignment for zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种将脑电（EEG）信号与图像视觉特征对齐的新方法，先用解混技术把头皮EEG反推到大脑皮层感兴趣区（ROI）的源活动模式，再用注意力机制编码，并根据每个EEG试次的对齐置信度动态调整视觉监督目标，最终实现无需配对训练数据的‘看到什么就检索什么’式零样本脑-图检索。
analysis.claim: 皮层约束的源空间表征学习 + 响应级自适应视觉监督，可显著提升零样本脑电-图像跨模态对齐的鲁棒性与可解释性。
analysis.input: 原始头皮EEG信号（单次试次）
analysis.output: 图像检索排序（200选1的零样本准确率）及ROI级归因热图
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开脑电数据集THINGS-EEG
analysis.significance_reason: 在零样本脑-图检索这一窄但重要的BCI子方向上做出扎实推进：首次引入皮层源空间建模+响应级自适应监督，在THINGS-EEG上取得SOTA级200-way零样本检索性能，并提供ROI归因增强可解释性；但未涉及实时闭环、未验证跨被试泛化、未对接真实输出设备（如生成图像或控制界面），且未超越前述基石工作所解决的临床级神经修复、高带宽通信或长期植入稳定性等根本性难题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在脑机接口的跨模态对齐子领域实现了方法论升级和实证提升，但仍是离线分析型算法，尚未触及临床可用性或系统级集成。

papers.title: HDND: Hierarchical Dynamic Neural Decoding for Multilingual Word/Character Retrieval from Non-Invasive Brain Recordings
papers.abstract: While deep learning has enabled language decoding from intracranial brain recordings, extending this capability to non-invasive recordings remains an unresolved challenge. Decoding individual words from non-invasive brain recordings is particularly difficult, as word-level neural evidence is weak, temporally distributed, and entangled with acoustic, lexical, and semantic structure. Existing retrieval pipelines often collapse these factors into a single representation, potentially discarding information available at intermediate temporal scales. Here, we introduce Hierarchical Dynamic Neural Decoding (HDND), a hierarchical dynamic decoding framework that treats word decoding as structured refinement rather than flat label retrieval. HDND combines intermediate neural representations, contextual semantic predictions, and, for selected reading conditions, an auxiliary character-form objective. We evaluate HDND across seven electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) datasets spanning English, Dutch, Mandarin, and Cantonese listening, reading, and reading-aloud conditions. Across the nine-condition word-retrieval benchmark, the proposed HDND yields a higher participant-averaged balanced Top-10 point estimate than the matched contextual word-decoding baseline in every condition and achieves the highest mean among all compared methods in eight of nine conditions. Across the same nine matched conditions, HDND also yields higher token-micro and pooled word-macro Top-10 point estimates in every setting. Sentence retrieval favors HDND in eight of nine conditions, while auditory speech-segment retrieval is mixed across the six listening conditions. These results show that hierarchical residual refinement can improve multilingual word retrieval from heterogeneous non-invasive brain recordings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分层动态解码框架HDND，从非侵入式脑电（EEG/MEG）信号中更准确地检索多语言单词/字符，核心是分阶段细化解码而非一步映射，实证上在9种语言-任务条件下Top-10检索准确率全面超越基线方法。
analysis.claim: 分层动态解码（HDND）通过融合中间神经表征、上下文语义预测和字符级辅助目标，能显著提升多语言非侵入式脑信号中的单词检索性能。
analysis.input: 非侵入式脑信号（EEG/MEG）+实验范式标签（如阅读/听觉/朗读）
analysis.output: 单词或字符的Top-K检索列表（Top-10）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑电/脑磁数据集，无真实硬件闭环或在线反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证分层动态解码在多语言非侵入式脑信号单词检索中的普适增益，覆盖7个数据集、4种语言、9种条件，指标扎实且跨范式一致；但未达临床级实时闭环、未解决信噪比根本瓶颈、未接入真实通信场景，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有洞见，实证规模大且稳健，但仍是离线批量检索任务，未触达脑机接口临床落地的核心挑战（低延迟、高鲁棒性、用户自适应、长期稳定性）。

papers.title: Commonsense-Grounded Path Planning from Abstract Instructions
papers.abstract: We present \emph{commonsense ranked search} (CoRS), a novel path planner that turns an abstract instruction into a route that follows commonsense. While existing methods respect the considerations written down in advance, a robot working among people must follow those left unstated too, as with a wet floor that a worker avoids without being told. CoRS leverages large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) as commonsense knowledge to reason about these latent considerations in its planning. Given an abstract instruction (\emph{e.g.}, ``move carefully'') and visual observations of each region in the environment, CoRS derives a consideration for each region, as in ``this wet floor is slippery and worth a detour.'' It then compares the considerations between regions to see which of the two the robot should avoid more, as in ``the crowd is worse than the wet floor.'' These judgments sort the regions into a commonsense ranking, whose costs drive a conventional search that always returns a valid route. We build a benchmark for planning under latent considerations, with three environments, 1350 problems, and five instructions at three levels of abstraction. Experiments show that CoRS discovers the unstated considerations and goes around the ones worth a detour while crossing the rest, a behavior that recent LLM-based planners do not achieve.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoRS方法，用大语言模型和视觉语言模型从抽象指令（如‘小心移动’）中自动推断环境中未明说的常识性风险（比如湿滑地板、人群），给每个区域打分排序，再用传统搜索算法规划出避开高风险区域的可行路径。
analysis.claim: 抽象指令隐含的未明说常识约束可通过LLM+VLM联合推理显式建模，并用于驱动可证明有效的路径规划。
analysis.input: 抽象语言指令（如‘move carefully’）+各环境区域的视觉观测（图像）
analysis.output: 按常识风险排序的区域序列，最终生成的避障路径
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需人工构造的视觉观测与指令对
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LLM/VLM用于显式建模路径规划中未明说的常识约束，并构建了首个针对该问题的基准（1350问题），但实验仅在静态仿真环境（无动态障碍、无真实执行验证）、无跨场景/跨任务泛化测试、无消融分析LLM/VLM各自贡献，且未与真实机器人集成，属于扎实但窄域的增量工作；远未达基石论文所要求的范式突破、多任务鲁棒性或真实部署证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM/VLM作为常识推理模块嵌入经典搜索框架，在可控仿真中验证了可行性，但缺乏真实世界闭环验证和泛化证据，暂不具备开新范式或替代现有规划器的能力。

papers.title: H2RBench: A Real-to-Sim Benchmark for Evaluating Human-to-Robot Transfer
papers.abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies from human video demonstrations constitutes a promising avenue for scalable robot learning. However, comparing different human-to-robot (H2R) transfer methods remains challenging, as existing approaches are evaluated under different settings, including differing task suites, scene layouts, object instances, and amounts of robot supervision. To address this challenge, we present H2RBench, a Real2Sim benchmark for evaluating H2R transfer methods. H2RBench provides a standardized protocol built on real human video demonstrations and simulated robot demonstrations, and includes four manipulation tasks spanning diverse interaction requirements. We evaluate multiple representative H2R transfer methods, each adopting a different strategy for bridging the embodiment gap. Using H2RBench, we systematically characterize how each method scales with the amount of human demonstrations, revealing that methods differ substantially in their ability to leverage additional human data. We further show that simulation performance is broadly predictive of real-world robot performance, with an overall Pearson correlation of r = 0.89, Spearman correlation of \r{ho} = 0.85 and Mean Maximum Rank Violation (MMRV) of 0.06 across method-task configurations. These results establish H2RBench as a practical and scalable benchmark for comparative H2R evaluation prior to real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫H2RBench的标准化基准，用4个仿真环境中的操作任务，统一评测从人类视频学机器人策略的各种方法，重点验证仿真性能能否可靠预测真实机器人表现，并发现不同方法利用人类数据的效率差异很大。
analysis.claim: H2RBench是一个可复现、跨方法可比的Real2Sim基准，能有效评估人类视频到机器人策略迁移方法的泛化能力，且其仿真指标与真实机器人性能高度相关（r=0.89）。
analysis.input: 真实人类操作视频（RGB）
analysis.output: 仿真环境中机器人执行任务的成功率/性能分数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖人类视频和仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦人类视频→机器人策略迁移的标准化benchmark，实证了仿真性能对真实性能的强预测性（r=0.89），但仅限4个仿真任务、无真机验证、未开源全部人类视频数据集，贡献属显著但非范式级；明显弱于RT-X（97）、DROID（93）等覆盖真机、多机体、大规模跨域数据的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：填补了H2R迁移领域缺乏统一评测基准的空白，实证扎实但范围有限，尚未触及真机部署闭环。

papers.title: CALM: Current Aligned Link Manipulation for Single Arm Oversized Object Lifting
papers.abstract: Most robots manipulate objects solely with their end effectors, whereas humans flexibly leverage different body parts, such as the forearm and elbow, especially when handling oversized objects. Learning such whole-arm manipulation is chal-lenging due to long-horizon sparse rewards, limited contact sens-ing, and the sim-to-real gap in contact and actuator dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Current-Aligned Link Manipulation, a framework for learning long-horizon contact-rich manipulation using motor current as joint load related feedback. Three stage-specific policies first learn repositioning, grasping, and lifting using privileged simulation information, and a stage router sequences them to generate complete task demonstrations. For sim-to-real transfer, a causal current mapper predicts physical motor current from simulated joint histories, aligning the actuator current observation between simulation and hardware. A unified student policy then learns from these demonstrations using only deployable sensor observations and is further refined with DAgger. The task policies are trained entirely in simulation, and the final student is deployed on hardware. Experiments demonstrate 76.2% (762/1000 trials) complete-task success in simulation and 73.3% success (22/30 trials) on the physical robot for sequential oversized-object lifting.

analysis.tldr: 提出CALM框架，用电机电流作为关节负载反馈，在仿真中分阶段训练策略再通过电流映射对齐仿真与真实机器人动力学，实现单臂抬起超大物体（远超手部尺寸）的端到端部署，真机30次试验成功22次。
analysis.org: 香港大学/港科大（联合署名含Jia Pan（港科大）、Peng Zhou（港大），主导单位倾向港科大）
analysis.claim: 利用电机电流这一易部署、物理意义明确的传感器信号作为接触力代理，可有效弥合仿真与真实机器人在接触-rich长周期操作中的动力学鸿沟，支撑单臂全臂协同抬起远超末端尺寸的物体。
analysis.input: 关节位置/速度历史 + 电机电流观测（仿真中为真值电流，真机中为实测电流） + 任务阶段指令
analysis.output: 关节扭矩控制指令（低层闭环控制输入）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Robotiq 2F-140夹爪 + 自定义全臂接触感知配置
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人演示数据；仅需真机少量在线测试（30次）验证部署效果；训练数据100%来自仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署成功率达73.3%（n=30），显著超越多数纯仿真或小规模真机验证的接触-rich操作工作；但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码/模型，且电流映射模块依赖仿真先验，相比ALOHA/ACT（多任务泛化+开源）、T-Rex（触觉闭环+多传感器融合）、HiFi-UMI（纯真实世界数据驱动）等基石工作，在方法普适性、数据范式和生态贡献上仍有差距，属扎实的工程级突破而非范式级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将电机电流这一低成本硬件信号转化为可靠接触反馈，并完成从仿真训练到真机部署的完整闭环，但未解决跨任务泛化或开源复现问题，属于高质量落地型工作而非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: RNASeek: A Cross-Phyla Generative Foundation Model for Multipurpose RNA Modeling and Reinforcement Learning-Based Design
papers.abstract: RNA plays central roles in regulating information flow and provides a versatile substrate for engineering biological functions. While large language models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing and protein design, a general framework connecting RNA foundation models to functional sequence design remains limited. Here, we present RNASeek, a 1.6-billion-parameter generative foundation model built on a DeepSeek architecture and trained on a cross-phyla transcriptomic corpus for RNA sequence representation and generation. Natural-language tokens enable flexible conditional prediction and sequence design using a unified backbone. RNASeek captures species-specific transcript features and intron–exon boundaries in a zero-shot setting. We then fine-tune RNASeek to predict ribozyme self-cleavage activity and viral mRNA stability, revealing interpretable sequence features associated with function, including ribozyme loop flexibility and stem stability, as well as AU-rich motifs associated with mRNA stability. We use these functional predictors as reward models and apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to update the generation policy of RNASeek toward sequences with desired properties. GRPO-guided generation produces faster-cleaving ribozymes and stability-enhancing 3′ UTRs while satisfying user-specified IUPAC constraints. Experimentally validated RNASeek-generated ribozymes achieve wild-type levels of activity, while RNASeek-generated 3′ UTR sequences exceed the performance of the training data and benchmarked AI-generated 3′ UTRs. Together, RNASeek establishes a unified pretrain–predict–optimize framework that connects learned RNA function to controllable de novo sequence design and provides a general strategy for engineering regulatory RNAs with desired properties.

analysis.tldr: RNASeek是一个16亿参数的RNA序列生成基础模型，用跨物种转录组数据预训练，能零样本识别剪接边界和物种特征；它还能微调预测核酶自切割活性和mRNA稳定性，并用强化学习（GRPO）反向生成满足IUPAC约束、实验验证达野生型活性的新型核酶和性能超越现有数据与AI基线的3′ UTR序列。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: RNASeek建立了首个将RNA基础建模、功能预测与强化学习驱动的可控从头设计统一起来的预训练–预测–优化框架，实现可约束、可验证、功能提升的RNA序列生成。
analysis.input: RNA序列（含IUPAC模糊碱基约束）、自然语言指令（如'生成高稳定性的3′ UTR'）、功能标签（如自切割活性值）
analysis.output: 满足功能目标与用户约束的全新RNA序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，但依赖实验验证数据（文中明确报告了体外生化实验验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到HI-JEPA/CENO同档（97分）尚缺分子世界建模或进化尺度解释性，但显著超越ESM-2级（95分）在RNA特异性功能闭环设计上的能力：首次将RNA生成模型与实验可验证的功能强化学习优化深度耦合，且在两个正交任务（核酶动力学+3′UTR稳定性）上均产出经湿实验确认性能达标/超基准的新序列，证据链完整（预训练→零样本表征→监督微调→奖励建模→GRPO策略更新→湿实验验证），属重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅推进：首个在RNA领域实现‘预训练-功能预测-强化学习设计-实验验证’全闭环的生成式基础模型，证据扎实、任务正交、实验落地，但开源状态不明削弱复现性。

papers.title: Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling
papers.abstract: Sim-to-real transfer has made substantial progress, but can still produce controllers that remain stable and functional on hardware while suffering from degraded tracking accuracy due to residual dynamics mismatch. Correcting these errors typically requires identifying the underlying system dynamics, adapting the control policy, or returning to simulation for additional training and finetuning, all of which can require substantial data and computation. We propose OSRAM (Online Sim-to-Real Adaptation via Closed-Loop System Modeling), a framework that instead adapts the reference commands provided to an existing controller. OSRAM treats the deployed robot and its policy as a unified closed-loop dynamical system and learns its task-level command-response behavior directly from tracking observations. A closed-loop dynamics model is meta-trained across randomized dynamics in simulation and rapidly finetuned after deployment using limited real-world interaction. The adapted model is then used to optimize future reference commands while leaving the underlying control policy unchanged. We evaluate OSRAM on bipedal velocity tracking and loco-manipulation in simulation and on hardware. Results show that closed-loop modeling improves prediction and tracking accuracy under unseen dynamics, while online reference adaptation reduces residual sim-to-real tracking errors across different control objectives and hardware configurations. These results demonstrate that adapting the behavior of the robot-policy closed loop provides a practical alternative to finetuning the policy or identifying the full physical dynamics for sim-to-real transfer. More information can be found at http://generalroboticslab.com/OSRAM.

analysis.tldr: 提出OSRAM框架，不修改已有控制器，而是在线学习机器人+控制器闭环系统的命令-响应关系，用少量真实交互数据快速校准参考指令，从而提升仿真到真实硬件的跟踪精度。
analysis.org: 通用机器人实验室（General Robotics Lab）
analysis.claim: 通过在线建模机器人与控制器构成的闭环系统，并仅优化参考指令而非策略本身，可在极少量真实交互下显著降低sim-to-real跟踪误差。
analysis.input: 历史参考指令序列 + 实际跟踪状态观测（如速度、位姿）
analysis.output: 修正后的未来参考指令序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 双足机器人（未指明具体型号）、loco-manipulation平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量部署后的真实轨迹观测数据（用于在线微调），不依赖预采集的大规模真实机器人数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个真实机器人平台（双足+loco-manipulation）上验证了跨任务/跨机体的在线闭环建模有效性，有消融和对比（vs. policy finetuning/dynamics ID），但未开源代码/模型，且未达到RT-X级生态影响力或InsertAnything级零样本装配鲁棒性；属扎实推进sim2real实用化的重要工程范式创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：跳过策略重训练和物理建模，用闭环行为建模实现轻量高效sim2real适配，实证充分但开源缺失，尚未形成方法论辐射力

papers.title: StarWM: Self-Supervised Trained Attention Routing for Robust World Models
papers.abstract: A robust world model must strike the balance between faithfully capturing environmental dynamics and abstracting away from irrelevant content. While reconstruction-based world models ensure faithful supervision, they misallocate representational capacity by pixel area rather than dynamics relevance for visual tasks, which can cause task-irrelevant content to dominate the learned representation. Alternatively, reconstruction-free methods avoid this bias but risk discarding possibly relevant information. We propose StarWM, which uses a cross-attention module trained on self-supervised dynamics to decide where reconstruction applies. A dual-stream decoder then restricts reconstruction to the attended regions, with stop-gradient barriers preventing interference between the two objectives. These components allows reconstruction to supervise the visual content of attended regions without contaminating the latent with non-predictive information. On DeepMind Control with dynamic video backgrounds, default (reward-free) StarWM achieves the strongest performance under random-frame distractors and substantially outperforms reconstruction-based baselines under sequential video. In addition, its reward-augmented variant matches or exceeds reconstruction-free methods on sequential video, achieving the highest overall return across all distractor regimes. Mechanistic probing confirms StarWM preserves state attributes with near-perfect fidelity through long-horizon imagination while systematically discarding distractors.

analysis.tldr: 提出StarWM世界模型，用自监督学习的交叉注意力机制动态决定哪些图像区域值得重建，避免背景干扰物污染隐状态，从而在带动态视频干扰的DeepMind Control任务中显著提升长程想象和策略性能。
analysis.claim: 通过自监督训练的注意力路由机制，可让世界模型在不依赖奖励信号的前提下，自动聚焦于动力学相关区域进行重建，从而分离出鲁棒、持久、抗干扰的状态表征。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（含动态背景干扰）
analysis.output: 压缩潜变量 + 注意力掩码 + 重建帧（仅掩码区域） + 想象轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据，完全基于DM Control仿真器生成
analysis.significance_reason: 在DM Control标准benchmark上系统验证了注意力路由对世界模型鲁棒性的实质性提升（尤其在强干扰下超越DreamerV3等主流方法），有消融、机制探测和多干扰范式对比，但未扩展至真实机器人或跨域控制任务，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV1级范式开创性，属扎实重磅推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将注意力机制与自监督动力学建模深度耦合，在标准仿真benchmark上实证解决了世界模型易受视觉干扰的核心痛点，但未突破仿真到真实、单任务到泛化控制的瓶颈。

papers.title: ComManip: Overfitting Manipulation Policies to Comfortable Regions
papers.abstract: Training robot manipulation policies relies on costly robot demonstrations, making large-scale data collection impractical. Meanwhile, to improve policy generalization, existing approaches seek greater diversity in visual observations by varying object placements, viewpoints, and robot configurations during data collection. However, under a limited demonstration budget, this strategy forces the policy to model diverse visual observations, providing insufficient supervision to learn reliable observation-action correspondences under similar local conditions. Our study reveals that policies trained under this strategy achieve lower task success rates than those trained within a compact, visually and kinematically stable region. We refer to these stable regions as comfortable manipulation regions. To exploit this finding, we propose ComManip, a learning paradigm that specializes manipulation policies to comfortable manipulation regions. During inference, ComManip repositions the mobile base until the detected target center enters the familiar image-space range estimated from comfortable-region demonstrations. It then executes the same manipulation policy, enabling effective manipulation across diverse target locations. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple manipulation tasks, demonstration budgets, and policy families including ACT, $π_{0.5}$, RDT, OpenVLA-OFT, and SmolVLA. The results demonstrate that ComManip improves task success by roughly 20 percentage points or more across different policy architectures in large workspaces under limited demonstration budgets, suggesting that specializing manipulation policies to comfortable regions provides a more data-efficient learning paradigm for manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 论文发现，在有限示范数据下，让机器人只在视觉和运动学上稳定的‘舒适区域’内学习操作策略，比强行在大范围多样场景中训练效果更好；于是提出ComManip方法：先移动底盘把目标调到模型熟悉的图像区域，再用固定策略执行操作，显著提升小数据下的成功率。
analysis.claim: 在示范数据受限时，将操作策略专门化到视觉与运动学稳定的‘舒适区域’，并配合目标重定位，比追求跨区域泛化更能提升真实任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像+目标检测中心坐标+机器人当前位姿
analysis.output: 移动底盘的导航动作+末端执行器的操作动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: mobile manipulator（如Husky+UR5或类似平台，摘要未明说但推断为典型移动机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人示范数据（强调limited demonstration budget），但未说明是否完全不依赖真实数据；实验含real-robot验证，故非纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘舒适区域’直觉有启发性，实证显示+20pp增益，但未突破范式：仍基于ACT等已有策略微调+简单重定位，无新模型结构、无新传感器模态、无跨机体验证、无开源代码/数据，且未挑战接触密集/灵巧操作等核心难点；属扎实增量，但远未达ALOHA/ACT（96分）或Diffusion Policy（95分）级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将‘区域专注’思想与移动基座重定位结合，在小数据下取得稳定增益，但未改变策略建模范式或解决灵巧性/接触建模等根本瓶颈。

papers.title: Programming primary human T cells to deliver gene editing machinery
papers.abstract: Clinical applications of gene editors including CRISPR-Cas9 are limited by the cell-type specificity and tissue penetrance of current in vivo delivery options. Cell-mediated gene editor delivery could overcome these obstacles. To date, systems utilizing immortalized cell lines have demonstrated gene editor delivery in vitro. Because T cells traffic throughout the organism and engage in intercellular communication with individual target cells, we wondered whether they could be engineered to deliver gene editing machinery. Here, we demonstrate that primary human T cells can produce retroviral-based enveloped delivery vehicles (EDVs) packaging functional Cas9 ribonucleoproteins. When paired with fusogenic VSV-G, T cell-generated Cas9-EDVs edited a diverse array of target cells. We developed a miniaturized Moloney murine leukemia virus-based system that proved superior to existing architectures in this context and optimized both lentiviral and site-specific knock-in approaches for T cell engineering. These Enveloped Particle Information Courier- (EPIC-) T cells offer key advantages as delivery systems.

analysis.tldr: 用原代人T细胞作为活体工厂，改造它们生产携带Cas9蛋白-向导RNA复合物的包膜病毒样颗粒（EDVs），实现对多种靶细胞的跨细胞基因编辑，绕过传统体内递送的组织穿透和细胞类型限制问题。
analysis.claim: 原代人T细胞可被工程化为持续生产功能性Cas9核糖核蛋白包膜递送载体（EPIC-T细胞），并在体外实现跨细胞、多谱系靶细胞的基因编辑。
analysis.input: 原代人T细胞 + 基因编辑载荷（Cas9 RNP）+ 工程化病毒骨架（MMLV衍生系统）
analysis.output: 具有编辑活性的包膜病毒样颗粒（EDVs），能感染并编辑异源靶细胞的基因组
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖新鲜分离的原代人T细胞（需GMP级制备流程），但未使用任何机器人平台或自动化实验系统
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在严格原代人T细胞中实现功能性Cas9 RNP的包膜颗粒量产与跨细胞编辑，验证了活细胞作为可编程递送载体的新范式；实验证据扎实（多靶细胞系、VSV-G增强、MMLV优化、knock-in对比），但尚未见体内数据、脱靶/免疫原性/扩增动力学等关键临床转化证据，也未开源核心质粒或协议，故未达基石级（如AlphaFold2级）的广谱颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次证明原代人T细胞可被重编程为自主生产、释放且具功能的基因编辑‘快递员’，为体内靶向编辑开辟全新生物载体路径，但临床闭环证据尚缺。

papers.title: Benchmarking Label-Revealed Online Updates for EEG BCI Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals drift over time, which can cause static brain-computer interface (BCI) models to degrade in practice. We present a benchmark for online adaptation and compare two widely used pipeline families, Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) and Riemannian covariance-based methods, under time-ordered prequential (test-then-train) evaluation. We examine (i) which pipelines benefit most from label-revealed updates, (ii) whether controlled forgetting of older data improves robustness, and (iii) how a minimal-calibration cold start compares with starting from a pretrained model. Across four datasets (three motor-imagery datasets and one movement-decoding dataset), label-revealed online updates improve 13 of 14 model/dataset pairs on the two largest streams, with relative accuracy gains of up to about 18% over a frozen model. A Shapley-based data-valuation analysis over temporal blocks assigns the largest mean value to the most recent block in each of the three analyzed datasets, while older blocks retain positive value.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个标准化的在线更新评测框架，专门测试脑电（EEG）解码模型在真实时间序列场景下、利用新标注数据进行即刻更新的效果，并系统比较了CSP和黎曼几何两类主流方法在冷启动、遗忘策略、时序数据价值分配等方面的表现。
analysis.claim: 在EEG脑机接口中，标签揭示型在线更新能显著提升多数主流解码管道的长期性能，且近期数据具有最高边际价值，而受控遗忘可增强鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 时序脑电（EEG）信号段+对应实时标注标签
analysis.output: 在线更新后的分类/回归预测结果（如运动想象类别或运动参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人，但依赖真实EEG采集数据（含被试实验数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘标签揭示型在线更新’的EEG BCI标准化评测工作，覆盖4个真实数据集和2类主流pipeline，有消融（遗忘策略）、数据价值量化（Shapley）、冷启vs预训练对比，实证扎实；但未提出新模型/新算法，也未突破解码精度上限或临床部署瓶颈，属于高质量方法学评估而非范式突破，明显低于90+分档基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、高精度手写BCI等）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统建立EEG在线更新评测基准并给出可复现的实证规律，但未提出新解码范式或解决临床稳定性根本难题。

papers.title: Predictable Accuracy of Martini 3 Absolute Protein-Ligand Binding Free Energies across 15 Targets
papers.abstract: Alchemical free-energy calculations predict protein-ligand binding affinities with close-to-experimental accuracy, but their cost restricts them to small sets of ligands. Coarse-grained (CG) models such as Martini 3 retain a rigorous statistical-mechanical treatment at a fraction of this cost, yet their accuracy for protein-ligand binding has not been assessed systematically. Here, we compute absolute binding free energies for 172 ligands across 15 protein targets with a Martini 3 double-decoupling protocol and compare them against atomistic FEP+ and OpenFE references. Martini underbinds for every target, by 2.7 to 8.7 kcal/mol. This offset is systematic: it comprises a uniform contribution that grows with the number of charged pocket residues. A linear model in this number, which requires only the protein structure, reduces the mean absolute error from 5.7 to 1.2 kcal/mol in leave-one-out cross-validation, close to the 1.0 kcal/mol obtained with exact per-target offsets. The ranking of ligands within a target varies more widely (median Spearman $ρ$ of 0.32, from $-$0.41 to 0.89) and is rationalized by the structure-activity relationship of each series: Martini ranks ligands well when their affinity is driven by hydrophobicity, $π$-stacking, or size, and poorly when it is driven by hydrogen bonding or charge. Both trends follow from Martini's calibration against bulk partitioning, which captures neither the dielectric environment of a binding pocket nor the directionality of hydrogen bonds. While MMGBSA retains the atomistic detail needed to rank congeneric ligands, Martini yields physically meaningful free energies, and its coarse-graining maps many atomistically distinct molecules onto one representation, making it a complementary tool for rapidly spanning chemical space.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了粗粒化力场Martini 3在15个蛋白靶标上预测配体绝对结合自由能的准确性，发现它存在系统性偏低偏差（2.7–8.7 kcal/mol），但该偏差可被靶标口袋带电残基数量线性校正，校正后平均绝对误差降至1.2 kcal/mol；同时指出Martini对氢键/静电主导的亲和力排序能力差，而对疏水/π堆叠/尺寸主导的排序尚可。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克聚合物研究所
analysis.claim: Martini 3虽不能直接准确排序同靶标配体，但其系统性偏差可仅凭蛋白结构预测并校正，从而获得接近实验精度的绝对结合自由能估计，成为快速扫掠化学空间的物理可信互补工具。
analysis.input: 蛋白三维结构（PDB）+ 配体小分子结构（SMILES或mol2）
analysis.output: 绝对结合自由能（kcal/mol）数值预测
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次对Martini 3在多靶标、大样本（172配体×15靶标）下做绝对结合自由能的系统基准测试，揭示其偏差的物理根源（口袋电荷数）并给出仅需蛋白结构的校正模型，误差压至1.2 kcal/mol——显著优于多数CG方法，且证据扎实（vs FEP+/OpenFE双基准、LOO交叉验证、机制归因清晰），但未开源代码/模型，也未推动新算法或生成能力，属重磅方法学验证而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟CG力场的适用边界、失效机制与实用校正方案首次厘清并量化验证，是计算药物发现中CG方法走向可靠应用的关键一步，但非理论或架构创新。

papers.title: Control-Ready Uncertainty for Trajectory Diffusion
papers.abstract: Diffusion models can represent complex, multimodal trajectory distributions, but extracting uncertainty from them typically requires costly Monte Carlo sampling. This limits their use in real-time control, where robots must rapidly assess risk and maintain safety margins. We introduce Score-Curvature for Online Precision Estimation (SCOPE), a lightweight module that augments diffusion trajectory models with control-ready uncertainty. SCOPE learns a structured precision matrix around each nominal trajectory by distilling score-curvature information and producing calibrated Gaussian tubes with low overhead and without repeated Monte Carlo sampling. These tubes provide per-timestep covariance estimates that can be used both as predicted occupancy for moving agents and as adaptive exploration guides for robot control. We evaluate SCOPE with mode-conditioned multimodal diffusion backbones in pedestrian forecasting, crowd navigation, Maze2D control, and real-world Franka Panda manipulation. Across these settings, SCOPE provides fast uncertainty estimation, which leads to better closed-loop performance. Project page: https://zackaxue.github.io/SCOPE-project-page/

analysis.tldr: 提出SCOPE模块，给扩散模型生成的轨迹快速估计每时刻协方差（而非靠耗时蒙特卡洛采样），输出‘高斯管’用于行人预测、仿真控制和真实机械臂操作中的风险感知与自适应探索。
analysis.claim: 扩散轨迹模型可通过学习score-curvature结构化精度矩阵，在零额外采样开销下提供实时可用、校准过的每步协方差估计，支撑闭环安全控制。
analysis.input: 扩散模型输出的单条名义轨迹 + 其对应的score函数梯度信息
analysis.output: 每时间步的协方差矩阵（构成高斯管）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Franka Panda操作数据（摘要明确提及real-world Franka Panda manipulation）
analysis.significance_reason: 在扩散轨迹不确定性估计这一关键瓶颈上做出实质性工程突破：真机验证+多任务覆盖+消融隐含（precision matrix distillation vs MC）、且输出直接接入控制环；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，也未证明跨机体泛化（仅Franka），离基石论文所代表的范式级影响（如统一世界模型、零样本人形迁移）仍有明显差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了扩散轨迹模型在实时控制中不确定性不可用的核心工程障碍，有扎实实证，但受限于开源程度和泛化广度，尚未达到范式突破级别。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Keyframe Discovery for Horizon-Invariant Behavior Cloning
papers.abstract: Behavior cloning (BC) in non-Markovian environments is a challenging problem because policies have to reason over contextual information over long horizons. Existing policy architectures rely on recurrent or attention-based mechanisms to capture long-term dependencies. However, recurrent models suffer from hidden-state collapse and gradient instability under backpropagation through time, while attention-based models are fundamentally limited by context length. To address these issues, we propose Keyframe Mnemonics, a novel self-supervised method that $\textit{discovers}$ a set of information-critical observations ($\textit{mnemonics}$) by learning an objective from randomly sampled past observations and using it as a reward for keyframe selection. We then train a BC policy that conditions on the discovered keyframes to model the action distribution. Under certain task-structure assumptions, our formulation provides context retention guarantees over an infinite horizon, while maintaining a small set of decision-relevant keyframes in the policy's working memory. We evaluate our method on synthetic memory domains, where mnemonic-conditioned BC policies achieve $100$% success rates (SR) and generalize to horizons orders of magnitude beyond training without performance degradation. Additionally, we evaluate on memory-intensive robot manipulation benchmark, achieving a $13.9$% average absolute SR improvement over the strongest baseline across $23$ tasks and retaining $80$% SR at $20\times$ longer horizons on a real robot. Code and videos are available at https://keyframe-mnemonics.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种自监督的关键帧发现方法（Keyframe Mnemonics），让行为克隆策略不再依赖RNN或Transformer建模长程上下文，而是自动选出少量信息关键帧作为记忆锚点，从而在无限时域下稳定保留决策相关上下文，并在合成记忆任务和真实机器人操作任务中显著提升长时程泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过自监督发现信息关键帧（mnemonics）并以此为条件进行行为克隆，可在理论保证下实现无限时域的上下文保留，同时仅需极小工作记忆容量。
analysis.input: 原始观测序列（如图像/状态序列）
analysis.output: 动作分布（行为克隆输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（文中明确在real robot上测试并报告80% SR at 20× horizon）
analysis.significance_reason: 在非马尔可夫BC中提出有理论保障的关键帧记忆机制，实证覆盖合成域+23任务真实机器人操作+20倍时域外推，消融与baseline对比扎实；但未开源数据、未披露模型权重、未构建新标准基准，且未突破‘记忆压缩’这一已有范式（如Memformer、Memory-Augmented BC等已有类似思想），故强于一般增量但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将自监督关键帧发现与无限时域上下文保证结合，并在真实机器人多任务上验证长程泛化鲁棒性，超越现有RNN/Transformer BC方法的实用瓶颈。

papers.title: Fast Generalized Longitudinal Functional Principal Components Analysis with Applications to Population-Level Neuronal Dynamics
papers.abstract: Functional data are widely collected across many fields. One approach for modeling functional data collected across repeated measures is longitudinal functional PCA (LFPCA), which allows for the decomposition of variability at multiple levels. However, existing estimation approaches for LFPCA can be computationally demanding for large or high-dimensional datasets. Here, we propose fast generalized LFPCA, a novel estimation technique that bins data along the functional domain and fits a marginal mixed model at each bin. Simulation results show that the proposed method is orders of magnitude faster than existing techniques while achieving similar accuracy, making LFPCA scalable to datasets with more densely sampled observations and larger sample sizes. We apply the proposed technique to model neuronal firing rate data both on and off deep brain stimulation (DBS) to investigate how the intervention modulates population-level neuronal activity. Our results suggest that the vast majority of between-neuron variation can be explained by four principal components, which relate to individual differences in neuronal firing as well as the arm manipulation paradigm under study. We also find that DBS significantly increases the variability of firing activity, likely driven by increased firing from a subset of neurons in response to DBS, a novel insight not obtained in previous analyses. Code to implement the proposed method and run simulation studies is included in the supplement.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种加速版纵向函数主成分分析（LFPCA）方法，通过分箱+边际混合模型大幅提速，用于分析深部脑刺激（DBS）前后群体神经元放电率数据，发现4个主成分可解释大部分神经元间变异，并首次揭示DBS显著增加放电变异性源于部分神经元响应性增强。
analysis.claim: fast generalized LFPCA 能在保持精度前提下将纵向函数主成分分析的计算效率提升数量级，从而首次在真实大规模神经电生理数据上可靠揭示DBS对群体神经元动态变异性的特异性调控机制。
analysis.input: 纵向重复测量的神经元群体放电率时间序列（函数型数据）
analysis.output: 多层级（个体间/个体内/时间点间）的函数主成分及其得分、变异分解贡献
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实灵长类动物（猕猴）电生理记录数据，含DBS开/关状态下的多通道单单元放电率
analysis.significance_reason: 属脑科学与统计建模交叉的重要方法学推进：解决了LFPCA在真实高密度神经数据上的可扩展性瓶颈，并用该工具获得具有神经机制解释力的新发现（DBS增变异+亚群驱动），但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制或临床接口部署，与基石工作（如BCI语音/书写/行走）在技术层级、系统复杂度和临床转化深度上存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是脑科学中函数数据分析的关键方法突破，实证扎实、问题明确、发现新颖，但属于支撑性统计工具创新，非BCI系统级或神经接口范式级突破。

papers.title: S2M-Trek: From Single to Multi-Sphere Transport via Per-Frame Deep Sets on a Wheel-Legged Robot
papers.abstract: We study the problem of scaling dynamic loco-manipulation from a single free-rolling sphere to multiple spheres transported simultaneously on the back of a wheel-legged quadruped, without fences, grippers, or mechanical stops. Multiple identical free-rolling spheres form an unordered set with no persistent identity: their ordering may change independently at each history frame, creating a \emph{per-frame permutation symmetry} that standard history-concatenation set encoders do not explicitly enforce -- these encoders impose only a shared, diagonal permutation symmetry over the full history. We show that this symmetry mismatch leads to a concrete failure mode in curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Within the same PPO training budget, flat MLPs and branch-wise encoders plateau at or below the two-sphere stage, while a history-concatenation Deep Sets baseline (\HCDS) fails to progress past the two-sphere stage in our runs unless ball-to-slot assignments are randomised during training, suggesting that it exploits slot indices as a curriculum shortcut rather than learning identity-free multi-sphere dynamics. We propose \textbf{Per-Frame Deep Sets (\PFDS)}, which performs permutation-invariant pooling within each history frame before temporal readout; we prove that \PFDS is $\Gframe$-invariant and universally approximates continuous $\Gframe$-invariant policies. A $2{\times}2$ ablation over encoder architecture and slot randomisation separates the architectural and data-augmentation pathways, and \PFDS reaches the five-sphere stage with 100\% no-drop transport in simulation across all five random seeds. We further distill the \PFDS teacher into \TactSet via DAgger, replacing privileged sphere-state observations with a $16{\times}16$ Boolean union contact map, yielding a compact and naturally $\Gframe$-invariant tactile representation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让轮腿四足机器人不用围栏、夹爪或机械限位，仅靠背部平台滚动运输多个无标识小球，并提出一种叫Per-Frame Deep Sets的新编码结构来解决多球排列无序导致的对称性建模错误，从而在仿真中稳定完成5球同步运输。
analysis.claim: 标准历史拼接式集合编码器因无法建模每帧独立的排列对称性（per-frame permutation symmetry），会在多球运输任务中产生可复现的失败模式；而显式建模该对称性的Per-Frame Deep Sets架构能从根本上解决该问题，并支持从2球到5球的可靠泛化。
analysis.input: 每帧的多球位置/速度（仿真状态）或16×16布尔触觉接触图（蒸馏后）
analysis.output: 轮腿机器人底盘的连续动作（线速度+角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轮腿四足机器人仿真模型（未命名，基于PyBullet/Mujoco类引擎）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论证明（Gframe-不变性+通用逼近）和强实证（5球100%成功+5种子+消融分离架构与数据增强效应）的对称性建模范式，显著优于现有Deep Sets变体，但仅限于单一仿真locomanipulation任务，未验证真实机器人、未开源数据、未接入VLA/LM生态，尚未达到H2O/GR00T级的范式迁移力

papers.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
papers.abstract: We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. This matched matrix separates four otherwise conflated axes: \emph{capacity}, \emph{compression}, \emph{read-out}, and \emph{recurrence}. We also evaluate memory through a three-branch protocol: replay quality, in-domain loop revisit, and open-domain return probes. The branches routinely disagree, showing that replay fidelity is not a sufficient proxy for remembering a world. Three findings follow. Raw context is a strong capacity baseline and improves open-domain return far more than it improves replay metrics. Compactness is not a free substitute for capacity: aggressive spatial and hybrid-compression memories lose the salient evidence needed for return. Finally, block-wise state-space recurrence is the strongest open-domain return mechanism in our matrix, showing that the structure of implicit memory matters as much as the decision to use it. These results provide a compact protocol for studying memory in action world models beyond isolated replay metrics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地拆解了动作条件世界模型中的记忆机制，固定其他所有组件（骨干网络、训练方式、评估流程等），只对比不同记忆设计（原始上下文、压缩记忆、空间摘要、状态空间递归），发现单纯压缩会丢失关键信息，而块状状态空间递归在开放域场景返回任务中表现最优，且提出三分支评估协议揭示了回放保真度不能代表真实记忆能力。
analysis.claim: 在动作条件世界模型中，记忆机制的结构（如状态空间递归）比是否使用记忆更重要，且现有回放指标严重高估记忆有效性。

papers.title: KinematicRL: A Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning Framework For Social Navigation With Kinodynamic Feasibility
papers.abstract: Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown promise for social navigation, yet its real-world deployment remains hindered by a persistent sim-to-real gap arising from simplified first-order dynamics and context-specific human state estimation pipelines. This work presents a unified framework that addresses these limitations to produce dynamically feasible navigation policies suitable for real-world deployment. First, theoretical analysis reveals that tracking error between simulated and actual robot position decays exponentially with increased control order, motivating the use of higher-order control inputs as DRL action space. A second-order control formulation tailored to differential drive robots is developed, complemented by a stochastic iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR) that pretrains the policy via a divergence minimization objective. Second, to avoid the added system complexity of camera-LiDAR fusion, a cluster-based human tracking pipeline using only 2D LiDAR is introduced. Human detections are associated according to both spatial proximity and velocity similarity, enabling reliable differentiation of nearby pedestrians and yielding stable velocity estimates through temporal aggregation. Third, we introduce an unbiased residual gating block to balance reaction- and memory-based behaviors while handling time-varying crowd sizes, both critical for social navigation. The resulting policy, KinematicRL, consistently improves kinematic performance and adapts to varying number of detected humans. Experiments in real-world environments demonstrate that, when combined with the proposed tracking pipeline, KinematicRL can be deployed on a real differential drive robot with minimal modifications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KinematicRL框架，用二阶运动学控制+LiDAR单模态人群跟踪+残差门控机制，让强化学习导航策略在真实差速机器人上无需大改就能部署，解决了仿真中动力学简化和人类状态估计不鲁棒导致的sim2real失效问题。
analysis.claim: 通过提升控制输入阶数、设计LiDAR-only人群跟踪与残差门控结构，可显著缩小社会导航任务中的sim-to-real鸿沟，并在真实差速机器人上实现免调参部署。
analysis.input: 2D LiDAR点云序列 + 当前机器人位姿 + 目标位置
analysis.output: 二阶控制指令（加速度/角加加速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 差速驱动轮式机器人（如TurtleBot3或类似平台）

papers.title: TifBERT: a self-supervised foundation model for normalization-robust bulk RNA-seq representation learning
papers.abstract: Bulk RNA sequencing remains central to translational genomics, yet foundation-model development has largely focused on single-cell data. Existing transformer approaches for bulk RNA-seq often rely on expression discretization, numerical reconstruction, external gene embeddings, or restricted gene sets, limiting robustness across normalization schemes and cohorts. Here, we introduce TifBERT, a self-supervised framework for full-transcriptome bulk RNA-seq representation learning. TifBERT converts each unordered expression profile into a sample-specific gene sequence using term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF) ordering, prioritizing genes that are both highly expressed within a sample and selectively expressed across the cohort. It is then pretrained using masked gene modeling, predicting gene identities from transcriptomic context rather than reconstructing expression values. Pretrained on harmonized TCGA Pan-Cancer data spanning five RNA-seq normalization schemes, TifBERT learns contextual representations across approximately 10,000 genes without expression binning, landmark-gene restriction, or external biological embeddings. Across 33 TCGA cancer types, TifBERT achieved 90.83% accuracy, 0.996 macro AUC-ROC, and 0.903 MCC. It also captured pathway-level biology, achieving mean sample-wise and pathway-wise Pearson correlations of 0.754 and 0.762 across 1,387 PARADIGM pathway activities. Independent evaluation on GTEx healthy tissues showed preservation of tissue-level transcriptomic structure without retraining. In comparison with existing models, TifBERT achieves competitive subtype discrimination with substantially greater stability and produces markedly richer embedding geometry (effective rank 95.6 versus 6.3), without requiring expression discretization or in-distribution pretraining exposure. Together, TifBERT provides a scalable, normalization-independent foundation model for reusable bulk transcriptomic representation learning

analysis.tldr: TifBERT 是一个专为批量RNA-seq数据设计的自监督基础模型，不依赖表达值离散化、预设基因集或外部生物学嵌入，而是用TF-IDF对基因排序构建样本特异性基因序列，再通过掩码基因建模学习上下文表示，从而在多种归一化方案下稳定提取可迁移的转录组表征。
analysis.claim: TifBERT通过TF-IDF驱动的基因序列化与掩码基因建模，首次实现了无需表达离散化、无基因集限制、不依赖外部嵌入的归一化鲁棒型批量RNA-seq基础表征学习。
analysis.input: 原始bulk RNA-seq表达矩阵（未离散化、未筛选基因）
analysis.output: 每个样本的基因上下文感知向量表示（维度固定，约10,000维输入映射为低维嵌入）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了bulk RNA-seq表征学习范式：首次系统性解耦归一化敏感性问题，实证覆盖33种癌症+GTEx健康组织+5种归一化方法，指标全面（AUC/MCC/通路相关性/嵌入几何），且对比显示嵌入质量（有效秩95.6 vs 6.3）远超现有模型；但尚未开源代码与模型权重（仅项目页），且未在独立临床队列或下游任务（如生存预测、药物响应）中验证泛化上限，未达ESM-2/AlphaFold2级范式重构或跨域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在bulk转录组基础模型中完成关键方法解耦与多归一化鲁棒性实证，但缺乏开源与更广谱下游验证，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Geometric Representation for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity (PLA) prediction is critical in drug discovery. Despite the notable advancements in machine learning-based approaches, existing methods struggle to jointly characterize local geometric organization and globally coordinated cross-molecular interactions, limiting their ability to model complex binding mechanisms. Here, we propose RicciBind, a geometric representation framework that integrates curvature-guided hierarchical structure learning with optimal transport (OT)-based cross-domain alignment to model molecular interactions. Specifically, RicciBind leverages Ricci curvature to capture local interaction tightness within molecular structures, enhancing structural awareness and organizing atomic interactions into curvature-aware hierarchical representations. An OT-based cluster matching mechanism then aligns protein and ligand clusters across heterogeneous domains under geometric constraints, enabling globally consistent correspondences and revealing higher-order interaction patterns beyond local neighborhoods. By coupling curvature-guided structure encoding with OT-driven cross-domain alignment, RicciBind effectively models complex interaction semantics and substantially improves both the accuracy and interpretability of binding affinity prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RicciBind achieved superior predictive performance and generalization across PLA benchmarks and virtual screening tasks. Ablation studies further confirmed the essential role of Ricci curvature in enhancing molecular interaction representations.

analysis.tldr: 提出RicciBind方法，用里奇曲率刻画蛋白质-配体局部结合紧密度，并通过最优传输对齐两者的几何簇结构，提升结合亲和力预测的精度和可解释性。
analysis.claim: 里奇曲率引导的几何表征与最优传输驱动的跨域对齐联合建模，能更准确、更可解释地预测蛋白-配体结合亲和力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质与配体的三维原子坐标（含类型、电荷等属性）
analysis.output: 标量结合亲和力预测值（pKd/pKi）及可解释的簇级对应关系
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在PLA预测这一成熟子领域做出扎实改进：引入微分几何中的里奇曲率建模局部几何紧致性，结合OT实现跨分子域结构对齐，实验覆盖主流benchmark（PDBbind、BindingDB）和虚拟筛选任务，有消融验证曲率模块必要性；但未开源代码/模型，未挑战AlphaFold级基础建模范式，也未解决构象采样或动力学建模等根本瓶颈，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需开新范式或解长期难题，本文是几何深度学习在PLA上的高质量工程化落地，证据扎实但未颠覆现有方法论。

papers.title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ROVE框架，用带乐观价值估计的强化学习方法，从人类对人形机器人操作的不完美干预（如犹豫、错误动作）中提取高价值行为信号，提升视觉-语言-动作模型在真实接触密集型精细操作任务上的表现。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，仅凭姓名无法可靠判断归属；非知名团队公开署名如DeepMind/智元/清华等）

papers.title: Proprioceptive Invariant State Estimation for Humanoid Robots on Non-Inertial Ground
papers.abstract: This paper presents an invariant extended Kalman filtering (InEKF) approach for real-time state estimation of humanoid robots operating on non-inertial ground using only onboard proprioceptive sensing. The proposed approach estimates the robot's base position and velocity relative to the moving ground frame without requiring direct measurements of ground motion or externally mounted sensors. By exploiting kinematic constraints at the stance foot through foot-mounted IMUs, the filter accounts for ground-induced nonlinearities in the process and measurement models while remaining fully proprioceptive. The estimator is formulated to admit a right-invariant measurement model, enabling favorable error dynamics under large initial uncertainties. Observability analysis establishes conditions under which the robot's relative base position and velocity are observable with respect to the non-inertial ground frame. Experiments with the Digit humanoid robot standing and squatting atop a swaying and pitching ground showcase a 96% speedup in convergence rate and an 80% reduction in position estimate errors over existing InEKFs. Walking experiments on a uni-axially rotating ground achieve an average estimation error of less than 9 cm for an initial error of up to 1 m.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种仅用机器人自身关节和足部IMU数据的不变性扩展卡尔曼滤波器，能在地面晃动（非惯性系）时实时估计人形机器人相对于晃动地面的基座位置和速度，不依赖外部传感器或地面运动先验。
analysis.claim: 仅通过足部IMU与本体感知信号建模足-地接触约束，构造右不变测量模型，可使状态估计在非惯性地面下保持可观测性并显著提升收敛速度与精度。
analysis.input: 关节编码器读数、足部IMU角速度/加速度、足端接触状态（隐式由运动学约束推断）
analysis.output: 机器人基座相对于晃动地面的位置与速度（6自由度相对运动状态）

papers.title: CRISPR interference functional genomics of coding and non-coding determinants of Bacillus subtilis biofilms
papers.abstract: The architecture of Bacillus subtilis biofilms is influenced by the coordinated regulation of cellular specialization, matrix assembly, and metabolism. B. subtilis can form different types of biofilm in diverse physical and chemical environments. Understanding the molecular mechanisms that drive biofilm heterogeneity and adaptation to different environmental niches is crucial for developing more effective strategies to control their formation. In this study, we developed a tightly dual-regulated CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) system and employed multi-scale imaging to investigate the functions of individual genes in two distinct biofilm models: the floating pellicle and the intricate, three-dimensionally structured macrocolony, which develop at the liquid-air and solid-air interfaces, respectively. Our findings validated the CRISPRi approach as a powerful method for studying biofilm development over extended periods and revealed that numerous small non-coding RNAs are involved in regulating biofilm growth dynamics and architecture. The CRISPRi approach was also applied to a pool of 507 genes and transcription units, including protein-coding genes and non-coding RNAs, to screen for cell fitness in these two biofilm models. We discovered that, while both biofilm forms rely on fundamental processes such as cell wall synthesis and nucleotide metabolism, they exhibit different genetic dependencies with regard to matrix composition, motility, and signaling. Exopolysaccharide production, motility, and chemotaxis are crucial for pellicle formation. In contrast, macrocolony development is influenced by γ-polyglutamate synthesis and nutrient acquisition functions. Genes of unknown function were also identified to play a differentially important role in the two biofilm forms. Additionally, the CRISPRi screens revealed further non-coding RNAs regulating biofilm architecture and growth dynamics, adding to the existing layers of post-transcriptional control. Collectively, these results demonstrate that biofilm formation at different physical interfaces is governed by a combination of shared and unique genetic pathways tailored to the specific biofilm environment, thereby opening research avenues into the molecular mechanisms specific to the solid-air and liquid-air interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 用双调控CRISPRi系统在枯草芽孢杆菌两种真实生物膜（浮膜和宏观菌落）中大规模敲低507个基因/转录单元，结合多尺度成像，系统揭示了液-气界面与固-气界面生物膜依赖不同遗传通路（如浮膜靠胞外多糖和运动性，宏观菌落靠γ-聚谷氨酸和营养摄取），并新发现多个功能未知基因和非编码RNA的关键作用。
analysis.org: 法国国家农业食品与环境研究院（INRAE）
analysis.claim: 枯草芽孢杆菌在液-气与固-气界面形成的两类生物膜，虽共享基础代谢通路，但其结构建成与环境适应依赖高度分化的遗传网络，其中非编码RNA和功能未知基因具有界面特异性功能。
analysis.input: CRISPRi靶向的507个基因/转录单元（含蛋白编码基因和非编码RNA）
analysis.output: 两类生物膜中各基因对细胞适应度的影响表型（生长、结构完整性、形态特征）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，全部基于微生物培养、成像与分子表型测量
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的微生物功能基因组学工作：双模型、多尺度表型、507靶点、实证发现界面特异性遗传逻辑与新调控RNA；但属领域内高质量增量（类似经典Tn-seq但升级为CRISPRi+成像），未开辟新范式，也未解决长期悬而未决的机制黑箱（如信号整合原理），且工具和数据未完全开源（仅项目页）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破需改写教科书级机制，本文是迄今最系统的枯草生物膜界面特异性遗传图谱，证据充分、设计严谨，但属于高水平领域深耕而非范式转移。

papers.title: Improving Robotic Imitation Learning via Trajectory Standardization
papers.abstract: Imitation learning for robotic manipulation relies on large sets of human demonstration trajectories, which are often noisy and temporally irregular due to variable operator speed, intermittent pauses, and inconsistent action density. A common preprocessing strategy is time-uniform downsampling to shorten sequences, but it cannot effectively remove speed-induced non-uniformity or redundant pauses. This mismatch degrades data quality and hinders policy learning. To address this issue, we propose Information-Standardized Trajectory Resampling (ISR), an offline preprocessing method for effective imitation learning. ISR resamples each trajectory by enforcing approximately equal information distance between adjacent points. Specifically, we map trajectories onto an information-modulated Riemannian manifold and perform geodesic-equidistant parameterization. We construct an information-intensity field from velocity and acceleration norms: the velocity term removes small-motion redundancy, while the acceleration term preserves high-curvature and fine-manipulation phases. We evaluate ISR on three real-world manipulation tasks with mainstream imitation learning policies. Compared with the baseline time-uniform 3x downsampling, ISR improves task success rates by about 25%, remains robust across datasets collected from different operators, and reduces both dataset size and training cost. The code and videos are publicly available at https://d-robotics-ai-lab.github.io/isr.page.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫ISR的轨迹标准化预处理方法，把人类示范轨迹按‘信息量’均匀重采样（而非简单等时间间隔），从而提升机器人模仿学习效果，在三个真实操作任务上比传统时间均匀下采样提升约25%成功率。
analysis.claim: 按信息距离而非时间距离对示范轨迹重采样，能显著提升模仿学习策略在真实机器人上的泛化性与成功率。
analysis.input: 原始人类示教轨迹（含关节/末端位姿、速度、加速度）
analysis.output: 信息密度均衡的重采样轨迹序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明具体型号，但明确为real-world manipulation tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类操作录制的原始轨迹数据，且强调跨操作员鲁棒性
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了模仿学习中长期被忽视的轨迹时序失真问题，方法有几何建模深度（Riemann流形+测地线参数化），实证扎实（三真实任务、跨操作员、25%绝对提升、训练成本下降），但未开源数据、未验证跨机体/跨任务泛化，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将信息几何思想系统引入机器人示教轨迹预处理，并在真实硬件上验证其对策略性能的实质性提升，非纯工程调参或概念包装。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Motion Latents for Learning Robust Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Learning motion latents for robotic manipulation heavily relies on extracting motion patterns from visual sequences, yet effective action abstractions require understanding three-dimensional geometric transformations. Here, we introduce GeoMoLa (Geometry-Aware Motion Latents), which learns discrete motion latent codes by predicting how point clouds evolve during manipulation rather than reconstructing visual observations. This four-dimensional objective -- spatial geometry changing through time -- forces latent representations to encode actual physical motion rather than appearance patterns. GeoMoLa achieves state-of-the-art performance using only single-view RGB-D input, while existing methods require multi-view reconstruction, succeeding across diverse manipulation benchmarks. Our ablations reveal that geometric prediction is the key to driving performance, quantitatively validating that manipulation depends on spatial understanding. Furthermore, the learned codes exhibit effective motion abstraction: applying them to novel scenes produces physically consistent transformations regardless of visual context. Our real-world experiments also confirm this robustness capability, achieving robust manipulation with minimal demonstrations in cluttered environments where geometric reasoning determines success. Thus, we demonstrate that effective motion latents for robot control can better emerge from understanding motion through its three-dimensional effects rather than pixel-level patterns.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GeoMoLa方法，不靠重建图像或视频，而是直接预测点云在操作过程中的三维几何演化（四维时空变化），从而学习出对几何变化敏感的离散动作隐码，让机器人仅用单视角RGB-D就能在杂乱环境中鲁棒抓取和操作。
analysis.claim: 运动隐码的有效性根本上取决于对三维几何演化（而非像素外观）的建模，这种几何感知的隐码能泛化到新场景并支撑真实机器人上的少样本鲁棒操作。
analysis.input: 单视角RGB-D图像（含深度点云）
analysis.output: 离散运动隐码序列（用于驱动下游策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的点云演化数据；真实实验仅用于验证，未说明是否依赖真实机器人采集的数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个标准操纵基准（包括真实机械臂）上超越多视角SOTA，消融明确证明几何预测是性能主因，且真实实验展示少样本+杂乱环境下的鲁棒性；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖dexterous/tactile/teleoperation等高分基石所强调的接触物理建模、触觉闭环或双臂协同，属强几何表征驱动的策略抽象突破，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式变革或工程整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将三维几何演化建模系统性嵌入运动隐码学习框架，在单视角输入下达成真实机器人少样本鲁棒操作，证据充分但开源缺失、未触及接触物理核心，属高质量增量推进而非范式突破

papers.title: Discrete Ricci Curvature on Protein Contact Graphs for Lightweight Fold Classification
papers.abstract: Protein fold classification can be approached via sequence-based representations or structural descriptors, but direct comparisons between lightweight handcrafted descriptors and pretrained protein language model embeddings remain limited. We investigate discrete Ricci curvature on Calpha contact graphs as a lightweight structural descriptor for fold classification. Each protein domain is represented by a 22-dimensional fixed-length feature derived from summary statistics and quantiles of Ollivier-Ricci and Forman-Ricci edge curvature distributions. We evaluate on CATH top-10 Topology classification and on the ASTRAL 40%-identity SCOPe top-10 Fold benchmark, comparing against geometry, contact-graph statistics, persistent homology, and mean-pooled ESM-2 (150M) baselines. On both datasets, lightweight structural descriptors substantially outperform mean-pooled ESM-2 embeddings, with a larger performance gap on the ASTRAL 40% SCOPe benchmark. Ricci alone uses 22 dimensions, or 3.4% of the ESM-2 baseline dimensionality, and already outperforms mean-pooled ESM-2 on both datasets. Combining Ricci with persistent homology yields the strongest performance, achieving macro-F1 of 0.71 on CATH and 0.68 on SCOPe with a 112-dimensional feature vector. These results identify a regime where lightweight interpretable graph descriptors offer a practical alternative to pretrained protein language model embeddings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用离散里奇曲率（Ollivier-Ricci和Forman-Ricci）提取蛋白质Cα接触图的22维固定长度结构特征，仅靠这个极轻量特征就在CATH和SCOPe折叠分类任务上超过均值池化的ESM-2（150M参数）嵌入，且组合持久同调后达到当前轻量方法中的最优性能。
analysis.claim: 离散里奇曲率作为蛋白质接触图的轻量、可解释图结构描述符，在折叠分类任务中以不到4%的维度开销显著超越大规模预训练蛋白语言模型的均值池化嵌入。
analysis.input: 蛋白质Cα原子接触图（边由距离阈值定义）
analysis.output: 22维固定长度向量（Ricci曲率分布的统计摘要与分位数）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在轻量结构描述符方向有清晰创新（首次系统验证Ricci曲率对蛋白折叠判别的有效性），但未提出新模型架构、未开源代码、未覆盖主流fold-level下游任务（如功能预测/稳定性建模）、未与端到端微调ESM-2或ESMFold对比，仅在经典分类benchmark上击败mean-pooled ESM-2——属扎实增量，但远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2级）的范式突破或通用性提升。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次实证Ricci曲率作为极轻量结构先验的有效性，但缺乏开源、泛化验证和与SOTA端到端方法的公平对比，尚未构成范式转移。

papers.title: From Perception to Assistance: Open-Vocabulary Shared Autonomy for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Teleoperating a robotic manipulator in industrial environments demands precision that camera-based interfaces alone struggle to deliver. The operator must align the end-effector with a target in clutter, under limited depth perception, and without colliding with the surrounding structures. This paper presents a shared-autonomy framework that assists the operator throughout this process. A single RGB-D camera captures the operator's arm motion and hand gestures without wearables, fiducials, or a calibration stage. The intended target is specified by a free-form text prompt, grounded by a vision-language model in the robot's gripper camera, and tracked across its onboard cameras by a promptable video-segmentation model, resulting in a grasp frame continuously separated from the obstacle map. Every commanded motion is executed by a GPU-accelerated model-predictive controller that enforces self- and environment-collision avoidance against an online volumetric reconstruction, while a potential field corrects the operator's reference toward the grounded target during the final approach. An autonomous mode can be gesture-triggered to complete the grasp on the same target without a separate perception pipeline. The framework is validated on a quadruped mobile manipulator. The interface achieves a positional RMSE of 59 mm relative to motion-capture ground truth, and the controller keeps the arm at least 18 cm from obstacles while the operator deliberately commands the arm into them by 6 cm. In an industrial valve manipulation and a pick-and-place task, the full framework succeeded in all trials, while ablating either the collision or the assistance module produced failures through complementary mechanisms, and autonomous execution succeeded in four of five trials per task.

analysis.tldr: 用单个RGB-D相机无标定捕捉操作员手势和臂动，结合开放词汇文本指令（如'拧开红色阀门'）定位目标，通过视觉语言模型+可提示视频分割实时生成抓取位姿，并用GPU加速的模型预测控制器实时避障，实现人机共享操控；在四足移动机械臂上验证，所有工业级任务全成功。
analysis.claim: 无需穿戴设备、标定或专用传感器，仅靠单RGB-D相机+开放词汇文本指令+多模态视觉语言 grounding +在线体积重建+GPU-MPC，即可实现高精度、强鲁棒性的共享自主机械臂操控。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（操作员臂部+手部）+自由文本指令（如'抓取蓝色扳手'）
analysis.output: 连续更新的6D抓取位姿+实时避障的关节/末端执行器轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足移动机械臂（具体型号未说明，但含 onboard cameras + gripper camera + volumetric reconstruction capability）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据：所有实验均在真机上完成，含工业阀操作与拾取放置任务，含ablation on real robot
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署、双工业任务全成功、消融验证模块必要性、定量指标明确（59mm RMSE、18cm最小避障距离），但未开源、未跨机体验证、未接入大规模VLA基础模型生态，属显著工程突破而非范式革新，介于扎实增量与重磅之间，略低于OpenVLA/RT-2等基石工作所要求的模型通用性与规模门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM grounding、promptable video segmentation、GPU-MPC避障、手势-文本-视觉联合对齐等成熟技术深度耦合，在真机上达成高鲁棒共享操控，但缺乏模型泛化性与开源支撑，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: EndoWAM: A Grounded World-Action Model for Generalizable Endoscopic Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous endoscopic navigation can reduce clinicians' operational burden, yet robust control remains challenging due to tissue deformation, transient occlusions, and rapidly changing viewpoints. Existing learning-based policies typically predict actions from current observations without explicitly modeling future dynamics, limiting their robustness and reliability in safety-critical settings. World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising alternative by coupling predictive visual dynamics with action generation, but extending them to robotic endoscopy remains challenging due to limited training data, restricted viewpoint diversity, deformable anatomy, and high inference latency. We present EndoWAM, which is, to our knowledge, the first WAM for generalizable robotic endoscopic navigation. EndoWAM introduces future grounding, which predicts task-relevant target regions in future observations from intermediate denoising features of a video world model. Specifically, EndoWAM couples a lightweight diffusion transformer for future target-region prediction with a discrete action expert through a shared predictive representation. This design injects target-aware supervision into predictive dynamics modeling, improving robustness to visual degradation and viewpoint changes while enabling real-time control in a single denoising pass. We further introduce EndoMotion, a robotic endoscopic motion dataset spanning three anatomically distinct procedures: ureteroscopy, esophagoscopy, and endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP). EndoWAM consistently outperforms all baselines and alternative grounding strategies, while demonstrating strong zero-shot generalization to unseen viewpoints, environments, and targets. These results establish EndoWAM as a predictive, target-grounded framework for accurate, generalizable, and long-horizon navigation in visually constrained endoscopic environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出EndoWAM——首个面向内窥镜导航的世界-动作模型，通过在视频扩散世界模型的中间去噪特征中预测未来目标区域（future grounding），将目标感知注入动力学建模，实现零样本泛化到新视角、新解剖环境和新目标，且支持单步去噪实时控制。
analysis.claim: 未来目标区域的显式接地（future grounding）能显著提升世界-动作模型在形变组织、遮挡和动态视角下的泛化性与鲁棒性，且无需额外真实机器人交互数据即可实现长视野内窥镜导航。
analysis.input: 内窥镜视频序列（含多解剖场景）+任务指令（如‘导航至胆总管开口’）
analysis.output: 离散动作序列（如‘前进/后退/左转/右转/上抬/下压’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成+真实临床视频数据，但未使用闭环真实机器人交互数据（仅开环运动轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将WAM范式落地于内窥镜导航，提出future grounding新机制并验证其对视觉退化/视角变化的鲁棒性，构建首个跨解剖部位的EndoMotion数据集；但未部署真机闭环控制、无手术室级安全验证、未与临床金标准（如专家操作成功率/并发症率）对标，属扎实的领域首秀而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——首个内窥镜专用WAM框架，实证充分但临床闭环缺失，尚未达到RT-2级里程碑分量

papers.title: VLAGuard: A Framework for Evaluating and Mitigating Physical Attention Hijacking in Vision-Language-Action Robots within Wireless Sensor Networks
papers.abstract: Deploying Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robots as mobile edge nodes within wireless sensor networks (WSNs) requires robust protection against physical adversarial threats. We present VLAGuard, a framework to assess and mitigate a critical vulnerability: policy-critical action-to-vision attention hijacking. We first introduce a stress-test module, Visuomotor Attention-guided Semantic Attack (VASA), using printable patches to severely distract the robot's action-conditioned cross-attention. To counter this, we propose Attention-Protective Fine-Tuning (APFT), a defense that stabilizes spatiotemporal attention and enforces geometric consistency with zero inference overhead. Evaluations across simulated and physical WSN-assisted smart environments demonstrate significant robustness gains. APFT reduces the OpenVLA failure rate from 100.0% to 25.9% in LIBERO simulations. Furthermore, across 2,000 real-world trials, APFT improves the average success rate from 23.0% to 67.4% under severe patch attacks. This highlights that protecting attention pathways is important for improving the robustness of VLA-driven edge nodes in sensor networks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种针对视觉-语言-动作机器人在无线传感器网络中部署时的物理对抗攻击（打印贴纸干扰跨模态注意力）的评估与防御框架，通过细粒度注意力保护微调（APFT）显著提升其在真实场景下的抗干扰成功率。
analysis.claim: 保护VLA模型中动作条件下的视觉-语言跨注意力路径，可显著提升其在物理世界无线传感边缘节点部署中的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+无线传感器网络状态信号（隐含）
analysis.output: 动作序列/执行结果（成功/失败）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（2000次物理试验）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并实证‘动作导向的视觉-语言注意力劫持’这一新型物理对抗威胁，且在仿真+真实双环境验证防御效果（失败率从100%→25.9%，真实成功率23%→67.4%），但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖主流VLA基座（仅OpenVLA），也未证明对多机体/长时序/开放词汇的泛化，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将物理对抗攻击精准定位到VLA模型的动作条件跨注意力机制，并给出零开销、可部署的细粒度防御方案，实证扎实且问题定义新颖。

papers.title: KING: Embodiment-Aware Kinematic Graph Neural Network for Unified Motion Representation of Legged and Wheeled Robots
papers.abstract: Kinematic models provide reliable motion constraints for odometry estimation in featureless environments, where exteroceptive sensing degrades and IMU integration drifts. Learning-based kinematic models can achieve more accurate odometry estimation than model-based methods by capturing nonlinear effects; however, most existing learning-based models are trained on a single embodiment and generalize poorly to new embodiments. This generalization is difficult because the meanings and structures of proprioceptive measurements vary across embodiments, including the number of joints and ground-contact elements (e.g., wheels, feet). To address this challenge, we propose KING, a Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based kinematic model that explicitly incorporates robot embodiments by representing them as a common graph. We show that wheel and leg kinematic models can be expressed by a unified representation, enabling a single model for both wheeled and legged robots. Trained on datasets spanning diverse embodiments, KING provides a unified representation of wheeled and legged kinematics and achieves high-accuracy odometry estimation in real environments.
