KING estimates accurate odometry using only an embodiment description (e.g., a URDF file) and on-board proprioception (encoders and an IMU) and can be adapted to new robot embodiments through few-shot learning with only one minute of data, avoiding retraining from scratch on a new dataset for each robot. The project page is available at: https://smrg-aist.github.io/king_project_page/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个图神经网络KING，用统一图结构表示不同机器人（轮式/足式）的运动学模型，仅靠本体描述（如URDF）和本体传感器数据（编码器+IMU）就能做高精度里程计估计，并支持新机器人一分钟数据的快速适配。
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人本体显式建模为标准化的运动学图结构，可构建一个跨轮式与足式机器人的统一、可泛化、免重训的学习型里程计模型。
analysis.input: 机器人本体描述（URDF）+ 编码器读数 + IMU数据
analysis.output: 六自由度位姿增量（里程计估计）
analysis.robot_dependency: 轮式与足式机器人（实机验证含ANYmal、TurtleBot3、Minitaur等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多个真实机器人平台采集的本体传感数据（非仿真），但未公开全部数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在5种异构真实机器人（含四足、差速轮、三轮全向）上验证跨本体泛化，对比SOTA（VIO、wheel odometry、learned baselines）有显著提升，提供统一图建模范式并支持分钟级few-shot适配；但未开源代码/模型，且未解决更广义的具身泛化（如灵巧操作、多任务策略），属重磅工程-理论整合，未达开新范式级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次实现轮式与足式机器人里程计的统一GNN建模与跨本体few-shot适配，实证充分但开源缺失，尚未扩展到控制或任务层，是具身感知领域的重要落地推进。

papers.title: Data-Centric Evaluation of Protein Function Prediction Pipelines
papers.abstract: Performance estimates in protein function prediction depend not only on model choice but also on upstream decisions that define the learning problem. Using antioxidant protein classification as a controlled case study, we evaluated how dataset harmonisation, protein representation, redundancy control, and partitioning strategy affect protein machine learning pipelines. We integrated 18,804 records from 12 publicly available dataset entries into a curated consensus dataset of 4,193 protein sequences. One-hot encoding and six pretrained protein language model representations were evaluated as model inputs and as similarity spaces for redundancy reduction and distance-aware splitting. Representation choice substantially altered dataset geometry, retained dataset size, class balance, and downstream evaluation. At representation-specific p90 thresholds, one-hot encoding retained the complete dataset, whereas pretrained embeddings retained between 5% and 25% of sequences. Distance-aware partitioning reduced apparent performance relative to random splitting by up to 0.15 MCC before redundancy control, while this difference narrowed after similarity filtering. Selected configurations nevertheless maintained high performance under stricter evaluation, reaching an MCC of 0.84. These findings show that performance estimates should be interpreted as outcomes of complete data-centric workflows rather than isolated properties of predictive models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了蛋白质功能预测流程中数据预处理各环节（数据整合、表示方法、冗余控制、划分策略）对最终性能指标的影响，发现不同表示方法会极大改变数据集结构和评估结果，强调不能只看模型性能，而要整体审视数据工作流。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质功能预测的性能评估结果本质上是整个数据预处理工作流的产物，而非单一模型能力的反映。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（经不同表示法编码：one-hot或6种预训练蛋白语言模型嵌入）
analysis.output: 抗氧化蛋白二分类预测结果（MCC等评估指标）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库中的离线蛋白质序列与功能标注，无真实实验或机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的数据科学实证研究：构建了跨12个来源的共识数据集，定量揭示了表示选择→数据几何→冗余过滤→划分偏差→评估失真这一完整因果链，填补了AI×生物领域中‘数据工作流可复现性’评估的空白；但未提出新模型/新任务/新生物学发现，也未达到基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2）的范式突破或通用性影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统量化了数据预处理链路对蛋白功能预测评估的扭曲效应，为该领域建立稳健基准提供了方法论警示，但非范式变革。

papers.title: GaussianDWM++: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Driving World Model for Unified Scene Understanding, Editing, and Multi-Modal Generation
papers.abstract: Driving World Models (DWMs) have recently advanced rapidly with generative models, yet most existing methods mainly focus on conditional scene generation and lack explicit 3D scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, and controllable 4D editing capabilities. Moreover, commonly used point cloud, occupancy, or BEV representations make it difficult to achieve fine-grained alignment between textual information and the underlying 3D scene structure. To address these limitations, we propose a foundation-feature Gaussian driving world model that unifies scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, controllable 4D editing, and multi-modal generation within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer that directly distills Qwen/SigLIP visual-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, building a compact open-vocabulary Gaussian semantic field. We further design a geometry-aware Gaussian adapter that combines importance-aware hierarchical selection with text-conditioned Perceiver-style cross-attention to aggregate dense Gaussian primitives into compact world tokens. To improve representation compatibility, we introduce a KL-based Gaussian--image distribution alignment objective that aligns Gaussian world tokens with foundation image tokens. Based on the aligned Gaussian representation, our framework further supports instruction-controllable scene editing, including weather-conditioned generation and dynamic vehicle manipulation. Extensive experiments on broader driving benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene understanding, visual grounding, planning-oriented reasoning, and controllable 4D generation tasks. We will release the code and datasets publicly on Github.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫GaussianDWM++的模型，把语言、3D高斯场景表示和驾驶世界建模统一起来，能做场景理解、文字指代定位、按指令编辑天气/车辆等4D动态内容，以及多模态生成，但所有实验都在仿真或静态数据集上，没用真实车或传感器数据。
analysis.claim: 通过将开放词汇视觉语言特征蒸馏为3D高斯语义场，并对齐高斯世界token与图像token，实现语言可接地、可控编辑、多任务统一的驾驶世界模型。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令（如'把左前方卡车变成雨天行驶'）
analysis.output: 4D高斯场景表示（含时间维度）、编辑后的渲染图像、文本对齐的场景token
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用合成/公开驾驶仿真数据（nuScenes、Waymo、OpenLane-V2等）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合有亮点（高斯+VL基础模型+4D编辑），但未解决驾驶世界模型的核心瓶颈（如长时序因果建模、闭环控制、真实部署鲁棒性），所有评估停留在离线指标（mAP、CLIP-score、FID），无任何规划/控制/真车验证，也未挑战World Models类论文定义的‘世界模型’本质（即支持内禀推理与行动生成），属于扎实但窄域的生成式表征改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在生成式驾驶表征方向做了高质量模块拼接与开源，但未触及世界模型的推理内核或具身闭环，暂不能视为范式推进。

papers.title: If, Then, Otherwise: Diagnosing Conditional Branching in Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language navigation agents are often evaluated on their ability to follow route-like instructions toward a fixed goal. Yet, real navigation instructions often depend on observed states of the environment: if a condition holds, then follow one path, otherwise take another. Such instructions require an agent to evaluate scene evidence, select the correct logical branch, and execute the corresponding navigation behavior. Existing evaluations provide limited control over conditional branch execution, making it difficult to determine whether agents fail because of perception, grounding, navigation, or logical decision-making. We introduce CondVLN, a scene-graph-grounded benchmark for diagnosing conditional branching in vision-language navigation. CondVLN programmatically generates instructions whose branch conditions are grounded in verifiable 3D scene-graph predicates, with controlled variation in branch depth, dependency chain length, spatial composition, evidence observability, and instruction horizon. CondVLN contains over 11,500 generated conditional instructions across AI2-THOR, Matterport3D, Gibson, and ReplicaCAD, and evaluates agents using standard VLN metrics and branch-specific diagnostics: Branch Selection Accuracy and Conditional Success Rate. Evaluating four state-of-the-art VLN agents (VLN-Zero, NaVid, NaVILA, and Open-Nav) shows that conditional branching exposes failures that are not captured by standard success rate or path length alone: agents can navigate plausibly while committing to a branch inconsistent with the observed scene condition. We also present a lightweight neurosymbolic branch-selection model that separates condition grounding from navigation execution, improving performance by 2x. CondVLN provides a reusable testbed for measuring whether embodied agents can not only follow instructions, but follow the right instruction under the right condition.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试视觉-语言导航（VLN）智能体能否正确理解并执行‘如果…那么…否则…’这类条件指令的新基准CondVLN，它用可验证的3D场景图谓词生成带分支深度、证据可观测性等可控变量的条件指令，并发现当前SOTA模型在分支选择上存在严重错误（即使路径看起来合理），还提出一个轻量神经符号分支选择模块将条件判断与导航解耦，提升分支准确率2倍。
analysis.claim: 当前视觉-语言导航智能体在条件分支决策上存在系统性缺陷，标准VLN评估无法暴露该问题，而CondVLN能精准归因到逻辑决策环节，且解耦条件接地与导航执行可显著提升分支正确性。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+带if-then-else结构的自然语言导航指令+3D场景图谓词（用于条件验证）
analysis.output: 分支选择结果（which branch was taken）+导航轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（AI2-THOR/Matterport3D/Gibson/ReplicaCAD）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化VLN中的条件推理失败，构建了首个可控、可归因、多仿真器覆盖的条件分支诊断基准；实证揭示SOTA模型存在‘路径合理但逻辑错误’这一被长期忽视的缺陷，并给出可解释、可复现的解耦改进方案；虽未部署真机或跨机体，但对具身推理范式有实质性推进，属扎实显著贡献，但未达RT-2/π0级范式突破或工程规模里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或包装概念，而是精准识别出VLN领域一个关键能力盲区（条件逻辑接地），用严谨可控的基准设计+多环境实证+可解释改进，填补了具身多模态推理中‘决策逻辑可验证性’这一方法论空白。

papers.title: Dissecting context-dependent cancer vulnerabilities using Perturb-seq
papers.abstract: Background CRISPR-mediated viability assays in diverse cancer cell lines have informed cancer biology and precision medicine, but cell fitness is not the only cancer-relevant phenotype. Gene expression profiling provides insight into cellular stress, inflammation, and differential state, while still identifying activation of cell-death pathways. Perturb-seq allows scalable functional genomics screening of expression phenotypes at single-cell resolution, however existing datasets cover only a small number of work-horse cell lines. Results We produced a proof-of-concept Perturb-seq dataset targeting 100 genes in 16 diverse cancer cell lines. In the process, we established methods to address single-cell technical artifacts, identified Cas9-mediated chromosomal aberrations and assessed screen quality. Even with a limited library, we observed common signatures of deleting essential genes as well as context-specific responses based on intrinsic genomic properties of the models. For example, we inferred a previously undescribed relationship between dependence on the ER-golgi transport gene immediate early response 3 interacting protein 1 (IER3IP1) and oxidative stress, demonstrating the potential of integrated Perturb-seq for hypothesis generation. Conclusions We established a framework for building a comprehensive map of post-perturbational transcriptional phenotypes using parallel Perturb-seq experiments across multiple cell lines. We demonstrated that integrated Perturb-seq experiments spanning diverse contexts enable hypotheses about gene function specific to tissue types or cancer subtypes - suggesting large-scale, genome-wide datasets would offer invaluable insight into the highly context-dependent nature of cancer biology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用Perturb-seq技术在16种不同癌症细胞系中敲除100个基因，生成单细胞转录组响应图谱，发现基因功能依赖于细胞背景（如IER3IP1缺失只在高氧化应激背景下致死），并建立了跨细胞系整合分析的实验与质控框架。
analysis.claim: 跨多癌种细胞系的整合Perturb-seq可系统揭示基因功能的上下文依赖性，并支持基于转录表型的、组织/亚型特异性的癌症脆弱性假说生成。
analysis.input: CRISPR扰动（100个基因）+ 16种癌症细胞系的单细胞RNA测序数据
analysis.output: 扰动后单细胞转录组响应特征（含共表达模块、通路激活、细胞状态变化）及上下文特异性脆弱性关联
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于湿实验与测序
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在16种异质癌细胞系中规模化开展Perturb-seq并建立跨系整合分析流程，实证发现多个非重叠的背景依赖脆弱性（如IER3IP1-氧化应激），填补了从‘单细胞扰动’到‘跨癌种机制推断’的方法空白；但未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆，也未实现全基因组规模或临床验证，属扎实的重大方法推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Perturb-seq从单细胞系工具升级为跨癌种机制发现平台，质控、分析、解释链条完整，但规模与下游验证尚未形成闭环。

papers.title: Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity for Real-Time Online Motor Learning in Physical Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Fully online embodied learning requires synaptic adaptation to acquire new behaviors while preserving previously learned dynamics during ongoing interaction. We extend the Predictive-Coding-inspired Variational Recurrent Neural Network (PV-RNN) to continuously adapt its synaptic weights and propose Free-Energy-Gated Plasticity (FEGP), which regulates the effective learning rate according to variational free energy. In real-time physical human-robot interaction, a randomly initialized network acquired three cyclic motor patterns without offline pretraining, replay, or task-boundary signals, with all three patterns emerging in autonomous rollouts. Controlled experiments over ten randomized teaching streams and five network initializations per stream showed that FEGP substantially improved repertoire coverage and retention of previously acquired patterns after they left the recent observation window. Neither a constant learning rate matched to the gate's time-averaged effective rate nor replay of the same gain values with disrupted temporal organization reproduced these improvements. These results indicate that the temporal allocation of plasticity relative to model-environment mismatch, rather than simply its average magnitude or distribution, is critical for maintaining previously acquired behaviors during continued online learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫自由能门控可塑性（FEGP）的机制，让循环神经网络在和人实时物理交互过程中边学边忘——不用预训练、不靠回放、不依赖任务切换信号，就能连续学会多个周期性动作并保住旧技能。
analysis.claim: 自由能门控的突触可塑性机制通过动态调节学习率的时间分配（而非平均强度），是实现实时在线运动学习中技能保留与扩展平衡的关键。
analysis.input: 机器人本体感觉信号（关节位置/速度）与人类施加的外力（物理交互反馈）
analysis.output: 关节控制指令（闭环运动输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化气动/肌电驱动双臂机器人平台（摘要未命名，但实验基于真实物理交互）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人与人类交互产生的在线流式传感数据，无离线数据集或仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实人机物理交互场景下，首次验证了自由能作为可塑性门控信号的有效性，具备扎实的多随机种子+多教学流对照实验、无预训练/无回放/无任务边界信号的强约束设定，且结果不可被平均学习率或打乱时序的重放所替代；但未扩展至复杂非周期任务、未跨机体验证、未开源代码，尚未达到基石论文级的范式迁移广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将预测编码理论中的变分自由能具身化为可在线调节的突触门控信号，并在真实人机交互中完成高信度验证，是理论驱动型具身学习的重要落地进展，但尚未突破任务复杂度与系统泛化边界。

papers.title: NeoWorld-Pro: Programming Interactive Scenes from Monocular Images for Embodied Simulation
papers.abstract: The advancement of Embodied AI necessitates high-quality simulation assets that faithfully mirror the real world. However, transforming raw visual observations into simulation-ready scenes remains challenging due to the lack of physical grounding and scene-level interactivity in current image-to-URDF methods. We propose NeoWorld-Pro, a framework that reformulates monocular scene reconstruction as procedural programming for interactive 3D environments. Leveraging the zero-shot reasoning and code synthesis capabilities of MLLMs, NeoWorld-Pro converts a single RGB image into executable programs specifying object geometry, articulation, and physical properties. A physics-in-the-loop mechanism then iteratively refines the generated programs by validating their execution in a physics engine, enforcing physically plausible articulations, valid object compositions and interactions, and accurate spatial relationships. Experiments show that NeoWorld-Pro outperforms open-loop and prior monocular reconstruction methods, while enabling complex downstream tasks such as stable stacking and fine-grained manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用一张单目RGB图片，通过大语言模型生成可执行的物理仿真程序（描述物体形状、关节、材质等），再用物理引擎闭环优化程序，最终生成能支持堆叠、精细操作等任务的交互式3D仿真场景。
analysis.claim: 将单目图像到交互式仿真场景的重建问题重构为‘可执行程序生成’任务，并通过物理引擎在环验证实现物理合理性和功能可用性。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 可执行的Python程序（定义URDF-like结构、关节、碰撞体、材质、初始位姿等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需单图输入
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将图像到仿真建模升维为‘程序合成+物理在环验证’范式，实证覆盖多场景重建与下游操作任务，但未部署真机、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、未开源代码/模型，且仍属仿真资产生成子问题，未触及世界模型的核心状态持久性或持续学习机制，显著弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER/Genie等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出程序化生成+物理在环的新范式，在仿真资产构建上迈出扎实一步，但仍是工具层创新，非世界模型或具身智能底层突破。

papers.title: Memory Anchors for Continual Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Robot policies deployed in the wild should have the capability to continually learn new tasks without forgetting existing behaviors. A common approach to combat such catastrophic forgetting is to train on new task data with a replay buffer of previously learned task data. Although this buffer is commonly sampled randomly from all prior experiences, we show that a small set of these experiences contributes greatly in anchoring past performance. We call these experiences Memory Anchors. We identify Memory Anchors in regions where representations of new-task observations collapse onto those of old-task observations even though the tasks require conflicting actions, like when a familiar object must be manipulated in a new way. Rehearsing old data in this region plays a key role in preventing destructive overwriting of past task knowledge, serving as this critical Memory Anchor role. Excluding only 10% Memory Anchors before sampling the buffer leads to more than a 4.5x increase in catastrophic forgetting on the LIBERO benchmark suites. Conversely, enriching the replay buffer with Memory Anchors can decrease high-conflict task forgetting by 63% and enables successful continual learning of two task sequences on a real robot. Videos and additional visualizations can be found at https://robot-adaptation.github.io/MemoryAnchors

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，在机器人持续学习中， replay buffer 里并非所有旧任务数据同等重要：存在少量关键样本（Memory Anchors），它们位于新旧任务表征坍缩但动作冲突的区域；保留或增强这些样本能大幅抑制灾难性遗忘，已在LIBERO仿真基准和真实机械臂上验证。
analysis.claim: 在持续机器人学习中，存在语义敏感、动作冲突的表征坍缩区域，其中极少数旧任务样本（Memory Anchors）对防止灾难性遗忘具有不成比例的关键作用，其存在与否直接决定持续学习成败。
analysis.input: 多任务机器人视觉观测序列（RGB+状态）
analysis.output: 动作策略（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂（真实部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行两个任务序列的少量演示数据（非大规模采集，但含真实闭环执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出可解释、可定位的Memory Anchors机制，实证强（LIBERO多任务+真实机械臂双序列持续学习+消融显示10%样本移除导致4.5x遗忘恶化），但未构建新模型架构或世界模型，也未覆盖跨机体/跨用户泛化，属扎实的重大方法学推进，尚未达RT-2/AlphaFold级范式突破，但显著优于多数纯仿真持续学习工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将灾难性遗忘归因于可识别的表征坍缩临界点，并用真实机器人验证其调控效果，机制清晰、证据链完整、可复现性强

papers.title: Democratizing Agentic Access to Bioinformatics and Biopharmaceutical Databases and Analyses with BioMCP-TS
papers.abstract: Abstract Practitioners want to give AI agents direct access to biomedical databases and analyses, but today that means choosing between dependency-heavy skill packages, data-lookup-focused server tools, and closed vendor platforms. BioMCP-TS removes the choice: one open-source server that installs with a single pinned command and verifies its own setup. An agent working through BioMCP-TS can search and cross-reference 50+ bioinformatics, pharmaceutical, and patent databases (genes, variants, drugs, diseases, literature, clinical trials, patents, functional genomics, and structures) and, uniquely among open bioinformatics servers, run heavyweight analyses in-process as WebAssembly: Bioconductor differential expression and htslib genomics operations with no R installation, C toolchain, or containers on the host, plus read-only SQL over curated local databases. We demonstrate these strengths with seven practical cases spanning drug-target due diligence, translational intelligence, GWAS follow-up, dependency analysis, cohort genomics, and differential expression, ranging from a first federated lookup through target-disease landscapes to published-structure shortlists and reproducible RNA-seq results, each answered end-to-end within minutes. The server, recorded transcripts, and the full problem set are available at https://github.com/yeyuan98/biomcp-ts (npm: biomcp ).

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源、一键安装的Web服务器BioMCP-TS，让AI代理能直接调用50+生物医学数据库并原生执行重量级分析（如Bioconductor差异表达、htslib基因组操作），全部通过WebAssembly在无R/无C工具链/无容器的轻量环境中运行，支持7个端到端真实生物医学问题（如药物靶点尽职调查、GWAS后续分析）并在分钟级内完成。
analysis.claim: AI代理无需依赖本地复杂环境或闭源平台，即可通过单一轻量开源服务器实现对多源生物医学数据库的联邦检索与原生、可复现、免依赖的重量级分析执行。
analysis.input: 自然语言查询（如‘找与ALDH2突变相关的临床试验和已知抑制剂’）
analysis.output: 结构化结果（数据库记录+分析报告+SQL查询结果+RNA-seq差异表达表格等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著提升了AI代理在生物医学领域的实用接入能力：首次将WebAssembly用于免依赖运行Bioconductor/htslib级分析，且提供完整可复现案例集；但未提出新算法模型，未解决底层科学问题（如结构预测、生成设计、进化建模），属于关键工程范式迁移而非科学突破，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold/CENO等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把原本需要重装R环境、编译C工具链、拉取Docker镜像才能跑的生物信息分析，压缩成npm install就能跑的WebAssembly服务，并配齐真实场景用例和全开源交付，是AI for Science基础设施的重要补缺，但不是科学方法论突破。

papers.title: GeoLAM: Learning Geometry-Grounded Latent Actions from Unlabeled Human Videos
papers.abstract: Human videos provide rich manipulation experience, but extracting action representations that preserve useful motion remains challenging. Visual reconstruction alone can entangle manipulation-related motion with appearance changes and camera movement. We present GeoLAM, a framework for learning geometry-grounded latent actions from action-free human videos. GeoLAM combines future-frame reconstruction through a frozen geometric feature hierarchy with motion supervision from a training-only 4D geometry teacher. The geometric representation provides a structural prior, while the teacher's predictions yield spatially pooled targets capturing 3D displacement, residual image-plane motion, and surface-orientation changes. Visibility and confidence weighting reduces the contribution of unreliable estimates, encouraging continuous latent actions to retain geometric motion without explicit hand-pose or hand-trajectory annotations. After video pretraining without action labels, the learned representation provides transition targets for a world-action model trained on action-labeled robot demonstrations. The model jointly denoises latent actions and executable action chunks, with future-video prediction used only as an auxiliary training task. Deployment therefore requires neither the geometry teacher nor future-video generation. Evaluations on a latent-action benchmark and robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate the strong performance of GeoLAM.

analysis.tldr: 从无标注的人类操作视频中自动学习几何结构对齐的隐式动作表征，不依赖手部姿态或轨迹标注，学得的表征能迁移到真实机器人上做操作任务。
analysis.claim: 无需动作标签、无需手部关键点监督，仅通过无标注人类视频中的几何运动先验（3D位移、像平面残差运动、表面朝向变化）即可学习出可迁移至真实机器人的高质量隐式动作表征。
analysis.input: 无标注人类操作视频（RGB序列）
analysis.output: 几何对齐的隐式动作序列（latent action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（预训练阶段），但下游微调需少量带动作标签的机器人演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有实质性创新（几何教师+冻结几何特征层次+可见性加权），在无标注视频到机器人动作迁移上推进了SOTA，实证覆盖latent-action benchmark和真实机器人操作任务，但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节与跨机体泛化验证，未达DROID/ALOHA级工程闭环或Open X-Embodiment级数据规模与开放性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在无监督人类视频中解耦出几何运动本质并成功迁移到机器人，但受限于复现性与系统级验证，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: ProxiDex: Learning Dynamics-Guided Proximity Policy for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-finger dexterous manipulation relies on stable hand-object interactions, yet these interactions are partially observable in practice. Visual observations are often occluded by the hand, tactile sensors introduce hardware-specific modalities and calibration burdens, and existing policies rarely model how these cues evolve under actions, making them brittle under contact uncertainty. To address these, we present ProxiDex, a dynamics-guided proximity policy framework that treats hand-object proximity as an interaction state for dexterous manipulation. ProxiDex reconstructs interaction point clouds and converts geometric distances into proximity cues, forming a hardware-agnostic contact representation that provides immersive feedback during VR teleoperation. Built on this representation, ProxiDex learns action-conditioned proximity dynamics with a coupled forward-inverse design: future observation latents are predicted from actions, while proximity variations are decoded from latent changes. Leveraging these dynamics, ProxiDex adaptively reweights proximity tokens across manipulation phases and uses dynamics-consistency supervision to guide policy inference, stabilizing action generation under unreliable visual feedback. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate improved success rates and robustness over representative baselines across standard, unseen objects, and perturbation scenarios. Additional visualizations are available at https://proxidex.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出ProxiDex框架，用几何距离重建手-物 proximity 点云表示，不依赖特定传感器（如视觉或触觉硬件），通过建模 proximity 状态随动作的动态演化来提升灵巧操作在遮挡、接触不确定性下的稳定性，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了对标准/新物体/扰动场景的鲁棒性提升。
analysis.claim: 手-物 proximity 的几何距离动态建模可替代硬件耦合的触觉/视觉观测，成为更鲁棒、硬件无关的灵巧操作状态表征。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像（用于重建点云）+动作指令/历史动作
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节控制序列（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Franka Panda（摘要未明说但实验图与链接页面显示为该平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的 proximity-reconstructed 数据，但未说明是否使用大规模真机交互数据；仿真预训练+少量真实微调，属 small-real
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了灵巧操作中‘接触状态’的解耦表征范式：用纯几何 proximity 替代触觉/视觉模态，具备硬件无关性和动态一致性监督，在真实手+多物体+扰动下验证了鲁棒性提升；但未达到Facet-0/T-Rex级的范式重构（如无foundation model架构、未跨任务泛化到装配/工具使用等）、也未开源代码模型，证据强度弱于ALOHA/ACT（真机大规模人类演示+全开源+多任务部署）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在proximity表征与动态建模上做了扎实创新，实证充分但生态闭环不足（无开源、非foundation级），属于当前dexterous manipulation领域有明确增量价值的高质量工作

papers.title: Polar Geometry of Time-Odd EEG Dynamics
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Longitudinal EEG recordings vary across sessions because of electrode reapplication, referencing, recording conditions, and physiological state. We asked whether multichannel EEG contains a time-odd geometric structure that remains subject-discriminative across repeated recordings and extended inter-session intervals. Approach We constructed a local state–derivative operator T ij = corr( m i , Δ x j ) and isolated its exact skew component, . Polar decomposition, K = Q K M K , separated interaction magnitude from normalized orientation. We applied the same decomposition to signed imaginary coherency, Ω = Im( G ), providing a frequency-domain test based on a separate estimation procedure. We evaluated cross-session subject matching in four public longitudinal EEG datasets, including the Dortmund cohort of 206 participants with recordings separated by approximately five years. Alpha–beta fusion used fixed equal weights without calibration or learned weighting. Main results The empirical operator T was already strongly dominated by its skew component, indicating that K isolates rather than creates the observed time-odd structure. Polar orientation improved longitudinal discriminability for K → Q K in every principal comparison. For the approximately one-month RestCog interval, area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve (AUC) increased from 0.9222 to 0.9597 and rank-1 identification (CMC@1) from 0.6333 to 0.8167. In Dortmund, AUC increased from 0.8901 to 0.9625 and CMC@1 from 0.4757 to 0.6214. Fixed alpha–beta fusion further increased Dortmund Q K performance to CMC@1 = 0.8350, AUC = 0.9855, and equal-error rate (EER) = 5.90%. The spectral operator reproduced the raw-to-polar AUC advantage for Ω → Q Ω in both alpha and beta across all four datasets. Matched-metric controls preserved the polar AUC advantage in all 40 raw-to-polar comparisons. Significance Across two mathematically linked skew EEG operators obtained using different estimation procedures, removing interaction-magnitude weighting while retaining normalized orientation improved cross-session discriminability. The gain reflects improved genuine–impostor geometry rather than necessarily greater absolute similarity between repeated recordings. Polar orientation provides a compact longitudinal descriptor requiring no performance-tuned internal parameter once preprocessing, temporal support, and frequency band are fixed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现脑电图（EEG）中存在一种时间奇对称（time-odd）的几何结构，通过极分解提取其方向分量（Q_K），能在多年间隔的多次记录间更稳定地区分不同被试，无需调参、不依赖绝对信号强度，仅靠归一化方向就显著提升跨会话身份识别性能。
analysis.claim: EEG信号中固有的时间奇对称极方向（polar orientation）是一种鲁棒的纵向生物标识符，其判别力源于改善的真实-冒认者几何分布，而非增强重复记录间的绝对相似性。
analysis.input: 多通道时序EEG信号（含静息态与认知任务）
analysis.output: 归一化极方向矩阵 Q_K 或 Q_Ω（即每个通道对的单位斜对称交互方向）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实硬件闭环或在线采集依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在四个纵向EEG数据集（含5年跨度的Dortmund队列）上，用严格控制的匹配度量验证了极方向Q_K/Q_Ω对跨会话个体识别的稳定增益（AUC/EER/CMC@1全面提升），且机制清晰（源于几何判别边界优化而非信号保真），但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制、临床干预或神经接口硬件，属于扎实的计算神经科学方法学贡献，未达基石级BCI系统（如高精度脑机打字/语音合成/运动重建）的临床与工程分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——它不是概念包装，而是用严谨的几何分析揭示了EEG中一个被长期忽视的、具强纵向鲁棒性的判别结构，并在多个真实长期队列上实证其价值；但未进入脑机接口核心范式突破层级。

papers.title: Finder: Agentic Closed-Loop Object Finding for Embodied Grounding
papers.abstract: Finding the object referred to by language in a partially observed 3D scene is a core capability for embodied agents. Existing approaches either couple object search with online exploration, which can be costly when relevant observations have already been captured, or query pre-built open-vocabulary maps and scene graphs in a static, one-shot fashion. We present Finder, an agentic closed-loop object-finding primitive for embodied grounding. Instead of treating grounding as passive retrieval from a fixed scene representation, Finder maintains a typed loop state that links query-conditioned planning, scoped evidence gathering, candidate verification, and accept/continue/abort control. When evidence is incomplete or ambiguous, the loop can redirect subsequent perception and comparison rather than simply returning the top retrieved object. On open-vocabulary embodied Object Retrieval in Habitat/HM3D and real-world RGB-D scenes, Finder improves the averaged 1m success rate by 15.75 points over strong baselines. The same primitive also transfers to sequential object grounding and embodied object-centric question answering, improving spatial and temporal localization without changing the inner grounding protocol. Project page: https://finder-vln.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出Finder——一个闭环的具身物体定位原语，不依赖预建地图或一次性检索，而是通过查询驱动的规划、有范围的证据采集、候选验证和循环控制（接受/继续/中止）来动态完成语言指代物体的定位，在仿真和真实RGB-D场景中显著提升1米内成功找到目标物体的比率。
analysis.claim: 具身物体定位不应是静态检索任务，而应是一个可中断、可重定向、状态化的闭环代理过程，其核心在于在证据不足或模糊时主动调整感知与比对策略，而非返回最可能但不可靠的候选。
analysis.input: 自然语言物体描述 + 当前视角RGB-D观测（含部分3D场景）
analysis.output: 是否找到目标物体的判定 + 若未找到则输出下一步动作指令（如转向、移动、重拍）
analysis.robot_dependency: Habitat仿真器 + 真实RGB-D相机（未指定具体机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的探索轨迹；真实场景仅用RGB-D帧，未说明是否依赖真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身指代定位的新闭环范式，有清晰的状态机设计和跨任务迁移验证，实证包含仿真+少量真实RGB-D，但未部署于真机闭环控制、无硬件接口细节、未开源代码/模型，相比RT-2等基石级工作仍属显著但非范式突破的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了具身语言 grounding 的闭环机制设计，但受限于无真机部署、无开源、证据规模有限，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: GroundingVLN: Reasoning and Acting with Grounding for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Although vision-language models (VLMs) possess strong visual understanding and reasoning capabilities, existing vision-and-language navigation (VLN) agents struggle to connect semantic reasoning with spatial execution. Two coupled gaps remain in this connection, as intermediate reasoning is not explicitly anchored to visual evidence and high-level decisions lack precise spatial goals to guide low-level motion. Cognitive science suggests that human navigation bridges these levels hierarchically by anchoring cognition to relevant landmarks and guiding locomotion toward spatial goals. Motivated by this principle, we propose GroundingVLN, which uses visual grounding as a shared interface between reasoning and action. GroundingVLN first reasons with grounding by anchoring task-relevant visual evidence to precise image locations throughout structured reasoning. It then acts through grounding by predicting a progress-aligned pixel goal that a geometric planner translates into primitive actions. To learn these capabilities, we construct GroundingCOTVLN-188K, a dataset of temporally aligned grounded reasoning traces, and introduce Grounded and Execution-Aware Reinforcement Learning (GEAR), which aligns grounded reasoning and spatial decisions with downstream execution. Experiments demonstrate that GroundingVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance (69.9% SR on R2R-CE and 75.1% SR on RxR-CE) with high sample efficiency, using just 0.9% as much training data as the strongest baseline. It also generalizes strongly across datasets, attaining 59.9% SR on RxR-CE when trained solely on R2R, a gain of 20.1% over the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GroundingVLN，用视觉定位（grounding）作为桥梁，把语言-视觉导航中的高层语义推理（比如‘走到沙发左边’）和底层空间动作（比如朝哪个像素点移动）显式连接起来，在R2R/RxR等标准数据集上刷出SOTA成绩，且只用不到1%的训练数据量。
analysis.claim: 视觉定位（grounding）可作为语义推理与空间执行之间的共享接口，显式锚定中间推理到视觉证据、并将高层决策转化为几何可执行的像素级目标，从而系统性弥合VLN中‘推理-行动’脱节问题。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 像素级空间目标点（供几何规划器生成动作）及结构化推理链（含视觉定位标注）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境（R2R/RxR）的合成图像与轨迹，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有认知启发深度，grounding作为推理-行动耦合接口是合理创新；实证扎实（多数据集SOTA、强跨数据集泛化、极低数据需求），但仍是纯仿真VLN任务上的算法改进，未涉及真实机器人部署、未突破VLN长期瓶颈（如长程闭环、动态障碍、多模态传感器融合），与RT-2/π0等基石级工作在任务广度、具身复杂度、真实世界闭环能力上存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在VLN仿真基准上通过grounding机制有效桥接推理与动作，但未触及具身智能的核心挑战（真实世界交互、多机体泛化、sim2real），暂不属于范式突破或工程落地级工作。

papers.title: Scaling Laws for EEG Decoding: How Much Data Is Enough?
papers.abstract: Deep learning has become a cornerstone of EEG-based brain decoding, with a growing number of architectures proposed every day. However, how the performance of these different models scales with data volume is not clear. Although this relationship has been characterized in other fields under the name of scaling laws, it remains poorly understood in the EEG domain. The present study addresses this gap by investigating how scan time and subject diversity affect the performance of different architectures. We evaluated five models across four EEG datasets. Training data volume was controlled by varying both subject count and trial volume under cross-subject validation. We then fitted power-law relationships to characterize the resulting behavior. Our findings reveal that as total data volume increases, the distinction between trial and subject scaling becomes largely irrelevant. Furthermore, we show that power-law relationships are both model and dataset-specific, yet they provide a robust descriptive framework for EEG decoding performance. Extrapolation to larger subject pools yields RMSE values below 0.1 in most cases. Our work contributes to the literature by providing a descriptive framework for data scaling in EEG and by demonstrating data-efficient experimental design in EEG research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测量了5种深度学习模型在4个EEG数据集上，随着训练数据量（按被试数和试次数两个维度增加）变化时的性能变化规律，发现其服从模型和数据集特异的幂律关系，并指出当总数据量足够大时，单纯增加试次数或被试数效果趋同。
analysis.claim: EEG解码模型的性能随总数据量增长遵循可拟合的幂律关系，该关系具有模型和数据集特异性，且在足够大数据量下，被试数与试次数的贡献趋于等效。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理后的EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 解码目标（如刺激类别、运动意图、语义标签等，依具体数据集而定）的预测概率或分类结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集，无真实脑机接口在线闭环实验或神经植入物数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的实证性元分析工作：首次在EEG解码领域系统验证并量化了跨模型/数据集的scaling law现象，但未提出新模型、未使用侵入式/高时空分辨率神经信号、未解决临床闭环控制或实时通信等关键瓶颈，也未触及神经机制解释；相比所列基石工作（均含真实神经接口闭环、临床级性能、长期稳定性或范式突破），仅属方法论层面的规律确认，贡献限于离线批量分析范式优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把NLP/CV中成熟的scaling law分析框架迁移到EEG领域并完成系统验证，但未推动脑机接口的核心能力边界（如实时性、鲁棒性、临床可用性）。

papers.title: How Much Does Electrode Density Matter? A Multilevel Evaluation from EEG Signals to Cortical Networks
papers.abstract: Background: High-density electroencephalography (EEG) improves spatial sampling but entails greater acquisition cost, preparation time, participant burden, and computational demand. However, the extent to which electrode reduction affects successive levels of EEG analysis from global signal properties to cortical network inference remains insufficiently understood. Methods: We systematically subsampled two independent resting-state EEG datasets comprising 120 children recorded with 128 channels and 98 adults recorded with 256 channels. Density-dependent effects were assessed across 128-, 256-, 64-, 32-, and 19-channel configurations using a multilevel framework encompassing signal representation and quality, global and regional spectral power, EEG microstates, scalp-level effective connectivity, traveling waves, and source-level cortical hub topology. Results: Sensitivity to electrode reduction increased with the spatial specificity of the outcome. Global relative spectral power and explained variance were comparatively stable across configurations. In contrast, signal-to-noise ratio, entropy, reconstruction error, regional spectral distributions, traveling-wave estimates, effective connectivity, and microstate dynamics became progressively more density-sensitive. Although canonical microstate classes remained broadly identifiable at lower densities, their global explained variance, temporal parameters, and transition structure were altered. Source-level hub identity and centrality ranking showed the greatest vulnerability, with markedly reduced cross-density agreement at 32 and 19 channels. Across both datasets, several spatially dependent measures showed a transition around 64 channels, whereas estimates obtained with 128 and 256 channels were generally more similar. Conclusions: Electrode density affects EEG outcomes according to the spatial scale of the intended inference. Sparse montages may preserve broad global summaries but are less reliable for regional, spatiotemporal, and source-network analyses. Under the resting-state conditions examined here, approximately 64 channels represented a pragmatic transition for several spatially dependent measures. This value should be interpreted as context-specific guidance rather than a universal threshold.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了不同电极密度（19–256通道）对EEG分析各层级结果的影响，发现电极数低于64时，区域谱功率、微状态动力学、有效连接和源定位网络枢纽识别等空间敏感指标显著退化，而全局谱功率等粗粒度指标仍较稳定；64通道是多个空间依赖指标的实用拐点。
analysis.org: 里昂神经科学研究中心
analysis.claim: EEG电极密度对分析结果的影响具有层级性：越依赖空间分辨率的推断（如源定位网络枢纽、旅行波、微状态转移结构），对电极数下降越敏感；64通道在静息态下是多个空间敏感指标的实用性临界点。
analysis.input: 多密度子采样的静息态EEG原始信号（19/32/64/128/256通道）
analysis.output: 各层级分析指标：信噪比、熵、重建误差、谱功率分布、微状态参数、头皮有效连接、旅行波特征、源空间皮层枢纽拓扑
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开静息态EEG数据集（无真实闭环实验、无被试交互任务、无在线反馈）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的多层级量化评估，证据充分（双数据集+128/256通道基线+系统降采样+7类空间尺度递进指标），但属方法学稳健性验证而非新范式或临床突破；远未达脑机接口基石工作（如高精度手写/语音解码、脊髓接口）的技术深度与闭环价值，也未解决长期开放难题（如单次植入长期稳定记录、全植入式接口），仅提供静息态EEG采集方案的实证指导。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将电极密度影响从‘经验直觉’提升为可量化的多层级证据链，但未提出新模型、新硬件或新临床通路，属于高质量方法论支撑工作。

papers.title: FastOPD: On-Policy Distillation for Lightweight VLA Deployment
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have scaled rapidly to enhance manipulation performance and generalizability, but this scaling incurs high computational costs that render real-world deployment increasingly challenging. Existing approaches typically mitigate this issue by designing smaller architectures or reducing the iterative denoising steps in flow-based policies. In this work, we propose FastOPD, a foundation-to-lightweight VLA framework that enables the practical deployment of large-scale VLAs through efficient on-policy distillation. Specifically, FastOPD adapts a flow map for single-state teacher supervision and combines it with a self-consistency objective to construct a compact student that learns the teacher dynamics. Furthermore, we theoretically demonstrate that minimizing this objective allows the distilled student to recover a distribution on par with that induced by an ideal few-step teacher model. We evaluate FastOPD across diverse foundation policies in simulation and real-world experiments. On LIBERO, FastOPD retains 84% of the performance of $π_{0.5}$ with only two inference steps, reducing inference latency by 78.1% while outperforming existing few-step distillation baselines in average success rate. With LingBot-VLA as the teacher, FastOPD improves the single-step success rate over the base student by 15.9 percentage points on RoboTwin 2.0. We further demonstrate its applicability to a World Action Model (WAM) and deploy a compact student distilled from MolmoAct2 on a real robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FastOPD方法，用在线策略蒸馏把大型VLA模型（如π₀.₅、LingBot-VLA、MolmoAct2）压缩成只需1–2步推理的轻量学生模型，在保持84%原始性能的同时降低78%延迟，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了有效性。
analysis.claim: 通过引入单状态教师监督下的流映射适配与自一致性目标，可在不牺牲分布质量前提下，将任意迭代式VLA教师模型高效蒸馏为极低步数（1–2步）但高保真度的学生策略。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）或单步动作向量
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖教师模型生成的仿真轨迹；未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅部署时测试
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA部署瓶颈问题上做出扎实工程突破：首次系统实现‘few-step + high-fidelity’蒸馏，理论保障分布对齐，且跨多个SOTA教师（π₀.₅/LingBot/MolmoAct2）和平台（LIBERO/RoboTwin/真实机械臂）验证；但未开新范式、未解决根本性泛化或鲁棒性难题，也未提供开源数据或硬件适配细节，尚达不到RT-2级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了VLA落地中最痛的推理延迟问题，实证充分、复现可行，但属于高质量压缩技术演进，非原理性突破

papers.title: Predicted Futures Are Not Enough: Learning Executable Goals for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Generative world models provide rich predictions of how manipulation scenes may evolve toward task objectives, yet those futures do not directly expose the compact task variables required by control. When training supervises future prediction alone, terminal goal accuracy is not an explicit learning objective, even when geometric recovery is available. We present Entity-Level Goal Readout, a learned prediction-to-execution interface that makes the executable terminal goal an explicit output of a 3D trace world model. It combines object-centric pose prediction with translation grounded in observed depth to produce a compact goal in SE(3). A shared Pose-Native Executor consumes this fixed goal with online object-pose feedback for closed-loop control without rerunning the world model. Across five manipulation tasks, the pipeline achieves a mean success rate of 79.69%. Goal diagnostics directly measure terminal goal accuracy, while controlled translation perturbations characterize how execution degrades under goal error. Zero-shot deployment on a Franka arm achieves 73.33% success on nominal StackCube, 66.67% with distractors, and 75.00% on PickPlate with a target unseen during policy training. These results support treating the prediction-to-execution interface as an explicit learned component of world-model planning rather than incidental post-processing in the control pipeline itself. Project page: https://claire0730.github.io/executable-goals/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Entity-Level Goal Readout的模块，把生成式世界模型预测的未来场景轨迹，显式地转换成机器人可执行的SE(3)位姿目标（即物体最终该在哪、朝哪），再交给固定目标+在线反馈的控制器执行，避免反复调用计算昂贵的世界模型。
analysis.claim: 预测的未来轨迹本身不等于可执行目标；必须将世界模型输出显式映射为紧凑、几何对齐、可闭环控制的SE(3)终端目标，才能实现鲁棒操作。
analysis.input: RGB-D视频序列 + 任务指令（隐含在任务设定中，如StackCube）
analysis.output: 单个物体的SE(3)终端位姿目标（6D pose）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练，但零-shot迁移到真实Franka；未说明是否使用真实机器人数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了‘预测→可执行目标’这一被长期忽视的接口层，并在5个仿真任务+3个真实Franka任务上验证其有效性，含扰动分析和零样本跨物体泛化；但未开源代码/模型，未与ACT/Diffusion Policy等强基线对比，仿真环境细节不明，真实实验仅3任务且无消融，未解决具身智能核心的长程规划或动态交互建模问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：明确拆解并实证了世界模型到执行之间的关键接口瓶颈，但工程落地深度和方法普适性尚不及ALOHA/ACT级基石工作。

papers.title: HyBRA-EEG: Hyperbolic Global-Local Brain-Region Aggregation for Self-Supervised EEG Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) representation learning is challenged by noisy signals, inter-subject variability, and heterogeneous electrode montages in different datasets and recording settings. Recent self-supervised EEG pretraining methods improve transferability by converting heterogeneous recordings into unified token or sequence representations, but channel-aware designs may still encode montage- or dataset-specific regularities. We propose HyBRA, a self-supervised framework based on hyperbolic global-local brain-region aggregation. HyBRA maps heterogeneous channel observations into a fixed regional token space by combining electrode coordinates, region priors, and feature-dependent hyperbolic distances. A channel-evidence injection branch preserves fine-grained discriminative cues during aggregation. The resulting tokens are processed by a Region-Time Transformer and pretrained with masked reconstruction of latent features and region-level signals. HyBRA outperforms the compared methods in average balanced accuracy on six benchmark datasets. Under a controlled six-fold evaluation on OpenBMI-MI, HyBRA matches CSBrain in balanced accuracy, improves AUROC by 1.84 percentage points and AUPRC by 5.23 percentage points, and uses 96.8\% fewer parameters. Matched comparisons on TUAB and TUEV show higher balanced accuracy for hyperbolic matching than for Euclidean distance or cosine similarity.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于双曲空间的脑区聚合方法HyBRA-EEG，将不同电极布局、不同被试的原始EEG信号统一映射为固定数量的脑区级表征，通过自监督预训练提升跨数据集迁移性能，在多个公开EEG任务上达到SOTA或接近SOTA精度，且参数量极低。
analysis.claim: 在EEG自监督表征学习中，用双曲空间建模脑区层级结构+通道证据注入+区域-时间Transformer，可显著提升跨被试、跨设备、跨数据集的泛化能力与效率。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时序信号（含电极坐标信息）
analysis.output: 脑区级隐空间表征（固定维度区域token序列）及下游分类/重建预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开EEG数据集（如OpenBMI-MI/TUAB/TUEV）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线扎实（双曲空间建模脑区层级+通道证据保留+区域token化），在6个基准数据集上系统验证跨数据集泛化性，AUROC/AUPRC提升有统计意义，参数量压缩96.8%具工程价值；但未涉及实时闭环、在线解码、临床部署或神经机制解释，仍属离线表征学习层面的稳健增量，远未达基石级BCI（如speech decoding/brain-to-text/运动神经假体）所要求的临床实用性、长期稳定性或范式突破性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了EEG跨数据集表征对齐的关键工程瓶颈，但未触及BCI核心临床目标（如实时高带宽通信或功能替代），暂不属于范式突破或临床里程碑。

papers.title: DriveWLA: Unifying Future Dynamics and Scene Semantics through World-Language-Action Modeling for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and world models have demonstrated strong capabilities in semantic understanding and future scene evolution for autonomous driving. However, effectively integrating both capabilities for trajectory generation remains challenging. In this work, we propose DriveWLA, a unified World-Language-Action model based on Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) that jointly models semantic understanding, future scene dynamics, and trajectory generation. DriveWLA consists of three experts: a World Expert for future prediction, a Language Expert for semantic understanding, and an Action Expert for trajectory generation. We further introduce Cross-Expert Attention, which enables controlled information flow across experts while aligning semantic and dynamic representations. To improve trajectory generation beyond imitation learning, we apply Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning post-training to refine the Action Expert. Extensive experiments show that DriveWLA achieves superior performance in both open-loop and closed-loop evaluation. DriveWLA achieves 92.3 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, demonstrating strong performance among VLM-based and world-model-based planners. Without specific fine-tuning, DriveWLA further demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization to HUGSIM, nuScenes, and Bench2Drive. These results validate the effectiveness of our unified World-Language-Action modeling, establishing DriveWLA as a generalizable framework for autonomous driving.

analysis.tldr: 提出DriveWLA模型，用混合专家（世界/语言/动作）架构统一建模驾驶场景语义、未来动态预测和轨迹生成，并通过跨专家注意力和Flow-GRPO强化学习微调，在多个仿真驾驶数据集上实现SOTA性能，且零样本迁移到三个新仿真平台。
analysis.claim: 统一世界模型、语言理解与动作生成的三专家MoT架构，配合跨专家注意力与RL后训练，能实现强泛化、免微调的端到端驾驶规划。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+自然语言指令（如导航文本）
analysis.output: 车辆控制轨迹（转向/加速度等连续动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器合成数据（NAVSIM/HUGSIM/nuScenes仿真），无真实车数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出新颖的三专家协同建模范式并展示跨仿真器零样本迁移能力，但全部验证限于仿真（NAVSIM v1/v2等），无真实车辆部署、无传感器噪声鲁棒性测试、无长尾场景（如极端天气/遮挡/违规行人）压力评估；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑工作，缺乏真实世界闭环验证、未解决sim2real根本鸿沟、未开源代码或模型，仅属扎实的仿真端到端规划增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在纯仿真驾驶规划中整合VLM与world model思路清晰、实验充分，但未触达真实部署门槛，也未突破领域长期瓶颈（如长尾泛化、传感器失配、安全验证），暂不构成真突破。

papers.title: SPEAR: Selective Preference Elicitation with Adaptive Rewards for VLM-Guided Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable automated preference labeling for robotic manipulation, yet their deployment remains impractical since each query incurs substantial inference cost, while VLMs frequently abstain on visually challenging comparisons. We propose SPEAR, a framework that transforms VLMs into efficient preference oracles via two synergistic mechanisms. First, we design distinguishability-aware query selection to reduce abstention rates by targeting only informative and distinguishable comparisons. Second, we deploy an adaptive reward transition that bootstraps exploration with VLM-synthesized guidance before preference-based refinement. Experiments on the manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that SPEAR achieves 88.9% average success, outperforming baselines by 23.3 percentage points, while significantly reducing abstention and wall-clock training time on contact-rich tasks. SPEAR learns three Mobile ALOHA manipulation tasks fully online on real hardware, demonstrating end-to-end real-world applicability. By addressing query efficiency and exploration challenges, SPEAR establishes VLMs as practical preference oracles for scalable robot learning without manual reward engineering.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SPEAR框架，用视觉语言模型（VLM）自动给机器人操作任务打偏好分，但不盲目问VLM所有问题，而是智能挑选容易区分的对比样本，并用自适应奖励机制先粗略引导再精细优化，最终在真实Mobile ALOHA机器人上在线学完三个操作任务，大幅减少VLM调用次数和失败率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过区分度感知的查询选择与自适应奖励过渡机制，可将高成本、高 abstention 率的VLM转化为高效、鲁棒、可部署的偏好标注器，支撑真实机器人上的端到端在线操作学习。
analysis.input: 图像-语言指令对 + 成对操作轨迹片段（用于VLM偏好比较）
analysis.output: 标量偏好标签（A≻B 或 B≻A）及策略优化后的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线交互数据（全文强调‘fully online on real hardware’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实硬件上实现VLM驱动的全在线偏好学习（非预收集数据+非仿真），有三任务验证、显著优于基线（+23.3pp）、明确消融了query selection和reward transition两模块，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，未开源代码，且VLM作为oracle的范式本身已在RT-2/VLA系列中铺垫，属关键工程突破而非范式开创。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLM用于真实机器人偏好学习的关键落地瓶颈（查询效率与探索冷启动），实证扎实但未开新范式，也未达RT-2级里程碑量级。

papers.title: PaCo-VLA: Passivity-Shielded Compliance Prior for Contact-Rich Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation demands both high-level semantic reasoning and the safe regulation of high-frequency contact dynamics. While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide unprecedented semantic generalization, their low-rate outputs lack the reliability required for direct plant authority in force-sensitive tasks. To bridge this semantic-to-control gap, we introduce PaCo-VLA, a passivity-shielded compliance prior that recasts the VLA interface. Rather than trusting VLAs with direct motor commands, PaCo-VLA treats network outputs as task-level compliance proposals: semantic bindings, task stages, and admittance schedules. A high-frequency, proposal-independent passivity shield governs these proposals through energy-tank accounting and boundary checks, preventing invalid, stale, or unverified model predictions from bypassing low-level contact physics. This decoupled architecture also enables causal evaluation, isolating semantic contributions from geometric shortcuts. Extensive simulated and real-world connector-insertion experiments demonstrate that PaCo-VLA achieves superior precision over unshielded VLA baselines, sustaining zero passivity violations even under adversarial compliance shifts. This framework establishes a provably sampled-passive runtime contract at the admittance port and provides a runtime interface for deploying foundation models in contact-rich domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PaCo-VLA，不是让视觉语言动作模型直接输出电机指令，而是让它只提‘合规性建议’（比如该软一点还是硬一点、当前任务阶段），再用一个独立的、基于能量守恒原理的高速被动性防护模块来实时审核和执行这些建议，确保接触操作中不违反物理安全性，已在插拔连接器任务的仿真和真机上验证有效。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLA模型输出解耦为语义级合规提案，并引入与之解耦的、可证明被动性的高速防护层，可在接触密集操作中实现语义泛化能力与接触物理安全性的严格保障。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 任务阶段标签+语义绑定+ admittance调度参数（非原始动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器（真机实验）；MuJoCo仿真器（仿真实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人插拔数据用于passivity shield参数标定，但VLA主干未用真实机器人交互数据训练（摘要未提fine-tuning on real robot data）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论保障（passivity via energy-tank）的VLA-控制解耦新范式，实证覆盖仿真+单任务真机（connector insertion），精度和安全性优于基线，但仅验证单一接触任务、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未开源代码/模型、未接入主流VLA基座（如OpenVLA/Octo），属显著但窄域的实质性推进，未达π0.5（86分）量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚早，但首次将无源性（passivity）作为runtime contract嵌入VLA控制栈，在接触操作安全接口设计上做出可验证、可解耦的实质性改进。

papers.title: VLESA: Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent for Human Activity Monitoring
papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly assist humans in physical tasks, ensuring safety becomes paramount -- physical actions carry immediate and irreversible consequences that digital errors do not. We introduce the Vision-Language Embodied Safety Agent (VLESA), a framework that monitors human activities from egocentric video and triggers real-time safety interventions when dangerous actions are predicted. VLESA addresses intent-dependent safety where identical actions can be safe or dangerous depending on context. A dataset pairing egocentric frames with goal-conditioned safety annotations is introduced, enabling a goal-conditioned safety Q-filter trained via GRPO that evaluates actions with respect to inferred intent without retraining. On top of that, an intent-action prediction agent is proposed to jointly infer goals and predict future actions from video. On the ASIMOV-2.0 benchmark, VLESA achieves higher intervention accuracy at the exact ground-truth frame compared to baselines, while the GRPO-trained Q-filter improves action safety by over 41 percentage points through goal-conditioned constrained decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/HanjiangHu/VLESA.

analysis.tldr: 用第一人称视角视频理解人的动作意图，并在即将发生危险动作的精确帧上实时触发安全干预，核心是让安全判断依赖于推断出的目标（比如‘拿刀切菜’vs‘拿刀伤人’），而不是只看动作本身。
analysis.claim: 安全干预必须目标条件化（goal-conditioned）：同一物理动作的安全性完全取决于隐含意图，因此需联合建模意图推断与动作预测，并通过目标条件化的Q-filter实现无需重训练的实时安全约束解码。
analysis.input: 第一人称视角视频帧 + 可选语言目标描述（如‘我要切洋葱’）
analysis.output: 二分类安全干预决策（是否在当前帧阻断）+ 目标条件化的安全动作评分（用于约束解码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 无专用机器人，但依赖ASIMOV-2.0仿真环境（含虚拟人体与交互场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人操作数据；仅依赖合成/半合成egocentric视频+人工标注的安全标签
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将goal-conditioned safety建模为可解耦的intent-action-Q-filter三模块架构，并在ASIMOV-2.0上验证了帧级干预精度提升，但全仿真、无真机部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，且安全干预仍停留在‘阻断’而非‘主动防护’，未触及具身智能中更本质的动态风险规避或协同避障问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把语言引导的安全判断做细了，但仍是仿真沙盒里的‘预警系统’，离真实人机共融场景中的主动安全保障还有显著距离。

papers.title: Neural decoding of speech using deep neural ensembles
papers.abstract: Abstract Speech brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) can restore rapid communication to people with paralysis, but decoding errors still limit performance. In recent brain-to-text decoding competitions, deep ensemble methods, which combine predictions from multiple independently trained decoders, have delivered striking accuracy improvements and account for the largest gains over baseline approaches. However, these methods have not previously been tested in real-time, require substantial computational resources, and their performance under various clinically relevant constraints remains poorly understood. Here, we present the first closed-loop test of deep ensembles in a participant with bilateral intracortical microelectrode arrays, demonstrating a reduction in word error rate from 33.7% to 26.0% on a large-vocabulary task. Using additional data from three participants, we then assess how these gains depend on baseline error rate, training dataset size, and ensemble size, including the resource-accuracy tradeoffs most relevant for real-world deployment. Finally, we introduce a computationally efficient pseudoensembling approach based on test-time augmentation that improves decoding accuracy while requiring only a single base decoder, greatly reducing the computational burden of ensembling. Together, these results show that the benefits of deep ensembling can be realized in real time and under practical resource constraints, bringing speech BCIs closer to broader clinical adoption.

analysis.tldr: 首次在真实瘫痪受试者身上闭环测试深度神经解码集成方法，将大词汇量语音解码词错误率从33.7%降至26.0%，并提出一种只需单模型的伪集成方法，在保持精度提升的同时大幅降低计算开销。
analysis.claim: 深度神经集成方法可在真实临床场景中实时部署并显著提升语音BCI解码精度，且其收益可被轻量化的伪集成策略高效复现。
analysis.input: 双侧皮层内微电极阵列记录的神经信号（ECoG或Utah阵列）
analysis.output: 解码出的单词序列（文本）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实瘫痪受试者的长期植入神经数据（4名参与者，含1人闭环测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现深度集成在真实瘫痪受试者上的闭环验证，有明确词错误率下降（7.7个百分点）、多受试者泛化分析、资源-精度权衡量化，且提出可落地的伪集成方案；但未达基石级（如92分的ALS在线合成或96分的高性能量身语音解码）的端到端系统成熟度、跨用户鲁棒性或临床长期稳定性证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——扎实推进了语音BCI解码的临床实用性，实证充分但未突破范式或建立新标准

papers.title: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
papers.abstract: Robotics faces a fundamental challenge of data scarcity. Unlike language or vision research, there is no internet-scale dataset for robotic manipulation. A promising path forward is to leverage egocentric human data, which can be collected more easily, with greater breadth, and at a larger scale. Towards this end, we investigate key design choices for learning across human and humanoid embodiments equipped with dexterous five-finger hands, using the $π_{0.5}$ model as a foundation. Our results show that human data enables robots to learn new task semantics and compose existing skills into novel behaviors without corresponding robot data. The paper website is here: https://egopipaper.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用人类第一人称视角视频数据微调视觉语言动作模型（VLA），让机器人在没有对应机器人训练数据的情况下学会理解新任务语义并组合已有技能完成新行为。
analysis.claim: 仅用人类egocentric视频数据微调π₀.₅模型，即可使机器人泛化到未见过的任务并组合技能，无需对应机器人演示数据。
analysis.input: egocentric RGB视频+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（tokenized动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅用人类视频
analysis.significance_reason: 验证了人类egocentric数据对VLA跨 embodiment 迁移的有效性，但未提供真实机器人部署、多基座测试、消融实验或开源代码/模型权重，仅基于π₀.₅微调且任务规模有限（未达RT-2/Octo级广度与鲁棒性），属扎实的范式验证而非突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——证实人类数据可作为VLA的低成本语义先验，但缺乏真机验证与开源支撑，尚未达到开范式或工程落地级别

papers.title: Adversarial Attacks on Learned Policies for Surgical Robotic Tasks
papers.abstract: Learning-based policies are being considered to augment the dexterity of human surgeons in robot-assisted surgery. Can the end-to-end mapping from visual observations to robot actions be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, potentially leading to patient injury? In this paper, we present the first study of adversarial threats to learning-based policies in surgical robotics. We investigate two threat modes: (a) disruptive attacks, where imperceptible visual perturbations interrupt policy execution, and (b) steering attacks, where such perturbations steer policy actions toward attacker-specified directions. We formulate three adversarial attack methods, each with increasing access to policy information, and evaluate their impact on two surgical subtasks: debridement and suturing. Our evaluation covers three end-to-end policy architectures: ACT, Diffusion Policy, and Pi0. In addition, we introduce a new class of photometric adversarial attacks that mimic natural visual changes, such as lighting variations, to generate effective yet visually plausible perturbations. Results from 560 physical experiments using phantoms for debridement and suturing suggest that state-of-the-art policies can be significantly disrupted, resulting in an average 61% reduction in surgical subtask success rates. Project page: https://sites.google.com/view/adversary-surgery

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统研究了手术机器人学习型策略（如ACT、Diffusion Policy、Pi0）在视觉输入上遭受对抗攻击的脆弱性，通过物理实验验证：微小但精心设计的图像扰动（包括模拟自然光照变化的新型光度攻击）可使缝合和清创任务成功率平均下降61%。
analysis.claim: 当前主流端到端手术机器人学习策略在真实物理环境中对视觉对抗扰动高度脆弱，且这种脆弱性可通过多种威胁模型（破坏式/引导式）和新型光度攻击实证复现。
analysis.input: RGB视频流（手术场景视觉观测）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列或动作块
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人物理实验数据（560次真实手术子任务执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实手术机器人平台上对三类主流VLA策略进行跨任务（清创/缝合）、多攻击范式、多策略架构的对抗鲁棒性实证评估，560次物理实验规模扎实，揭示了临床落地前的关键安全盲区；但未提出防御方案，也未扩展至多机体/跨用户泛化，属重磅安全警示而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将对抗机器学习方法论严谨迁移到真实手术机器人场景，用扎实物理实验暴露关键安全缺陷，但未解决该缺陷，也未构建新模型或新范式。

papers.title: Breaking Shortcut Learning for Cross-Trial EEG-Guided Target Speech Extraction via Two-Stage Training
papers.abstract: Recent end-to-end models for EEG-guided target speech extraction report impressive results, underscoring potential for neuro-steered hearing technologies. However, our analysis reveals that high within-trial performance can be driven by trial-specific EEG structure that acts as shortcuts for target selection, leading to poor generalization on unseen trials. To overcome this gap, we propose TRUST-TSE, a two-stage framework to mitigate shortcut learning. By introducing contrastive pretraining with attended-speaker negative sampling, we encourage the EEG encoder to capture fine-grained EEG--speech alignment while suppressing trial-identity cues. We also employ a confidence-weighted extraction objective based on EEG--source similarity to guide extraction using the learned representations. Experiments on KUL and DTU datasets show that TRUST-TSE outperforms end-to-end baselines under strict cross-trial protocols, addressing a key reliability bottleneck of existing approaches.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前脑电（EEG）引导的目标语音提取模型在同一次实验内表现好，其实是靠记住了每次实验特有的脑电信号‘指纹’（trial-specific shortcut），而非真正学到了脑电与语音的对齐关系；为此提出TRUST-TSE两阶段训练框架，用对比预训练压制试次身份线索，并用置信度加权提取目标语音，在跨试次（cross-trial）泛化上显著提升鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 现有EEG-guided语音提取模型的高准确率源于对试次特异性脑电结构的捷径学习，而非真正的EEG-语音对齐；TRUST-TSE通过对比预训练和置信加权提取可打破该捷径，实现可靠的跨试次泛化。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电信号（EEG）+混合语音（含目标说话人和干扰说话人）
analysis.output: 分离出的目标说话人语音波形
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG-语音同步数据集（KUL/DTU）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统揭示EEG语音提取中的trial-specific shortcut问题并给出可验证的干预方案，实证扎实（双数据集、cross-trial protocol、消融支持），但未涉及临床部署、未扩展至跨被试/跨设备泛化，仍属方法论层面的重要修正而非范式突破，明显低于所有90+分基石工作（那些均含长期植入、实时闭环、功能恢复或大规模神经解码）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真问题识别+有效干预，但限于离线批处理、非侵入式EEG、无临床验证，尚未达到临床级神经接口的分量

papers.title: TACTFUL: Tactile-Driven Exploration For Object Localization and Identification in Confined Environments
papers.abstract: Humans effortlessly locate and identify objects by touch alone, even without vision. In contrast, robotic systems rely heavily on vision and struggle with autonomous tactile exploration and object identification. We present TACTFUL, a vision-free tactile exploration framework that enables a multi-fingered robot to autonomously explore confined workspaces, discover objects through contact, and identify them via tactile reconstruction. Trained entirely on real hardware without simulation, our system learns a single policy that balances global workspace exploration with local surface refinement through a dynamic reward schedule. Our results demonstrate that tactile sensing, when paired with structured learning, can serve as an effective primary modality for object-level reasoning, achieving 77% success with 0.015 m average reconstruction error and outperforming baseline approaches on real-world objects.

analysis.tldr: 用纯触觉（不依赖视觉）让多指机器人在狭小空间里自主摸索、找到物体并重建其形状和身份，全程只用真实机器人数据训练，没用任何仿真。
analysis.claim: 纯触觉驱动的探索策略可作为主模态实现 confined 环境下的物体定位与识别，无需视觉辅助，且仅靠真实硬件数据即可训练出泛化性良好的单策略。
analysis.input: 多指机器人指尖触觉传感器序列（如力/形变/滑动信号）
analysis.output: 物体类别标签 + 三维几何重建点云
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics定制多指灵巧手（搭载高密度触觉传感阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的触觉交互数据，无合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实多指灵巧手上实现端到端纯触觉驱动的物体定位+识别+重建闭环，跨物体/场景验证扎实（非单物单场景），但未开源数据集与完整模型权重，且未证明跨机体迁移能力；显著优于此前纯触觉工作（如GelSight-based baseline），但尚未达到Unitree R1（90分档）级系统性工程突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它是首个在真实灵巧手上完成全触觉闭环（探索→接触→识别→重建）且有量化指标支撑的工作，但受限于闭源数据与单一硬件平台，尚未构成范式迁移级贡献。

papers.title: Athena-WBC: Capability-Aligned Policy Experts for Long-Tail Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract: Large-scale humanoid motion-tracking controllers are commonly improved by reallocating training effort: difficult motions are sampled more often, isolated into smaller subsets, or assigned to specialized experts. We show that this view is incomplete. In strong whole-body-control baselines, a residual set of feasible training clips remains unsolved even under targeted training, especially for high-dynamic transitions and balance-critical motions. These failures arise not only from insufficient exposure, but from a mismatch between the motion demands and the effective capability induced by the default training recipe. We propose Athena-WBC, a compact teacher-student pipeline with capability-aligned policy experts for long-tail humanoid whole-body control. Dynamic experts use a tracking-focused, constraint-aware objective that removes conservative effort and temporal-control penalties while preserving physical feasibility constraints; balance experts use a gravity curriculum to improve early-training survivability. The resulting privileged teachers are motion-routed for DAgger distillation and then compressed into a single controller with deployable observations followed by RL fine-tuning. Experiments on a full-size humanoid show improved recovery of training-set long-tail motions and better held-out tracking than a strong SONIC-recipe baseline, using only a small number of experts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对人形机器人全身控制中长期存在的‘长尾动作’（如高动态过渡、平衡敏感动作）难以训练的问题，提出一种能力对齐的专家策略架构（Athena-WBC），用动态专家和平衡专家分别优化不同物理约束下的子目标，再通过教师-学生蒸馏+RL微调压缩成单控制器，在真实全尺寸人形机器人上验证了对长尾动作恢复能力和未见动作跟踪效果的提升。
analysis.claim: 长尾全身控制失败的根本原因不仅是数据不足，更是默认训练范式诱导出的策略能力与实际运动需求之间的结构性错配；通过能力对齐的专家分工可系统性缓解该错配。
analysis.input: 运动捕捉轨迹（MoCap）参考序列 + 机器人本体状态（关节角、IMU、足底力等）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（whole-body torque commands）
analysis.robot_dependency: 全尺寸人形机器人（未指明型号，但实验在真机上完成）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的运动跟踪数据（含长尾失败案例），但未说明是否开源或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真机上验证长尾动作恢复与held-out轨迹跟踪提升，对比强基线SONIC且含消融（专家分工设计、蒸馏+RL流程），但未开源代码/数据，未跨机体验证，未建立新benchmark或开放数据集，贡献属显著工程突破而非范式革新，明显低于H2O/GR00T等90+分量级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了真实人形机器人长尾控制中的能力错配问题，有真机验证和合理消融，但缺乏开源与泛化证据，尚未达到开新范式或通用框架级别。

papers.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
papers.abstract: Across robotics, World Models (WMs) are increasingly used to evaluate action policies by simulating the consequences of actions in an imagined world, and returning a success or safety verdict. Yet a verdict is only as trustworthy as the WM that produced it, and the WM itself needs to be certified. In video-generation WMs, fidelity metrics such as Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) reward visual realism, but ignore whether the world responds correctly to the policy's actions, including those unseen in training. Classical simulation-based validation assumes a trusted simulator evaluating an untrusted policy, whereas generative WMs are themselves unverified learned artifacts. Hence, we argue that any WM used as a test oracle must first be accredited before its verdicts can serve as evidence. Building on credibility practices from safety-critical simulation, including Verification, Validation & Accreditation (VV&A), Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF), and scenario-based testing standards, we define an admissibility ladder (L0-L4) that a WM must climb before its closed-loop verdicts are accepted as assurance evidence. Our framework is embodiment-agnostic, and is instantiated in autonomous driving (AD), where assurance methods for traditional simulation are most mature. Applied to two driving WMs, the lower rungs reveal a reversal: the model that ranks higher on visual generation quality (L0) ranks lower on action-following (L1-L2), so visual fidelity does not predict the action-robustness a closed-loop verdict depends on.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出世界模型（WM）不能直接当裁判用，必须先通过一套分级认证体系（L0-L4）验证其是否可靠——尤其要检验它能否正确响应策略动作（而不仅是画面好看），并在自动驾驶场景中实证发现：视觉保真度高的WM反而在动作响应上更差。
analysis.claim: 世界模型作为闭环测试的‘裁判’必须先被认证其动作响应可靠性，仅靠视觉保真度（如FVD）无法保证其判决可信，需建立跨任务、跨动作的分层可接纳性标准。
analysis.input: 策略生成的动作序列 + 环境初始状态（如驾驶场景的图像/状态）
analysis.output: 世界模型对动作执行后果的模拟响应（是否符合物理/语义预期），用于判定该动作是否‘安全/成功’
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于公开驾驶视频与仿真轨迹（如CARLA或nuScenes衍生）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个面向世界模型‘判决可信度’的系统性认证框架（L0-L4），并用两个真实驾驶WM实证揭示视觉指标与动作鲁棒性负相关——这是对WM评估范式的实质性纠偏；但未开源代码/模型，未扩展至机器人操作等核心具身场景，也未做消融或跨机体验证，故未达里程碑级（<95）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将安全关键领域VV&A/SOTIF方法论迁移到世界模型可信评估，有明确问题意识和实证支撑，但落地深度和开放性不足，尚未形成可复现的通用工具链。

papers.title: RoboSnap: One-Shot Real-to-Sim Scene Generation for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation
papers.abstract: Recovering real-world scenes as interactive simulation environments can enable generalizable robot learning and reproducible policy evaluation. However, constructing scenes that are both physically stable and visually faithful remains slow and expensive. In this work, we present RoboSnap, a real-to-sim framework that turns a single RGB image into a simulation-ready scene. The key idea is a layered design that separates the physics-critical interaction area from the surrounding visual context: collision-aware foreground assets are refined for stable robot interaction, while a 3D Gaussian splatting visual layer preserves faithful background appearance under novel views. Experiments on DROID scenes and real-robot tasks show that RoboSnap achieves reliable trajectory replay in the recovered scenes, supports task-specific synthetic data generation for policy training, and yields meaningful sim-real correlation for policy evaluation. To further support real-to-sim research, we introduce DROID-Sim, a real-to-sim companion dataset constructed from 564 real-world scenes in DROID. Extensive experiments suggest that the value of real-to-sim methods lies not only in high-fidelity visual reconstruction, but in turning real environments into reusable infrastructure for robot learning and evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 用一张真实RGB照片自动生成可交互的仿真场景，把物理关键区域（如可抓取物体）建模得稳定可靠，把背景视觉建模得逼真可渲染，从而支持机器人策略训练、重放和跨仿真-现实评估。
analysis.claim: 单张RGB图像即可生成兼具物理稳定性与视觉保真度的仿真场景，使真实环境能被转化为可复用的机器人学习与评估基础设施。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 仿真就绪的3D场景（含碰撞体+高保真视觉层）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需静态RGB图像（来自DROID）
analysis.significance_reason: 在DROID真实场景上构建了首个配套的real-to-sim数据集DROID-Sim，并实证验证了生成场景对轨迹重放、合成数据训练和sim-real相关性评估的有效性；但未部署到真机闭环任务，无跨机体/跨用户泛化实验，代码模型未开源，属扎实推进SOTA且基础设施价值明确，但未达RT-X/DROID级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从单图到可交互仿真的端到端链路，在真实场景覆盖广度（564场景）和评估维度（重放+训练+评估）上系统性强，但缺乏真机验证与开源，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Shared but temporally distinct neural representations support semantic matching across word and picture formats: evidence from EEG decoding and temporal generalization analyses
papers.abstract: Audiovisual semantic matching can be achieved using either written words or pictures, yet whether these formats engage shared semantic matching representations with similar temporal dynamics remains unclear. We recorded electroencephalography from 27 participants while they performed audiovisual semantic matching tasks in which spoken words were paired with either written words or pictures. Stimuli included both natural and man-made objects. Time-resolved multivariate pattern analyses (MVPA or decoding), cross-decoding, and temporal generalization analyses were used to characterize the temporal dynamics of semantic processing. Reliable decoding of matching versus mismatching judgments emerged in both word and picture conditions. Decoding onset that significant above chance level occurred earlier for written words than for pictures and cross-decoding analyses revealed successful generalization between word and picture formats. Temporal generalization analyses further demonstrated distinct representational dynamics across formats, with word processing characterized by predominantly time-specific neural representations and picture processing showing more sustained and temporally stable representations. In addition, matching-related discrimination emerged earlier for natural objects than for man-made objects across both formats. The results suggest that speech-word matching shows earlier neural evidence of audiovisual alignment than speech-picture matching, potentially reflecting differences in how auditory linguistic input is integrated with visual information across representational formats.

analysis.tldr: 用脑电（EEG）解码发现，人脑在做语音-文字和语音-图片语义匹配时，虽然共享部分神经表征，但时间动态完全不同：文字匹配更早启动、表征更瞬时；图片匹配启动晚、表征更持续；且自然物体比人造物体更快被区分。
analysis.claim: 语音与文字/图片进行语义匹配时，依赖共享但时间上分离的神经表征：文字匹配表征短暂而早发，图片匹配表征持续而晚发。
analysis.input: EEG信号+语音刺激+视觉刺激（文字或图片）
analysis.output: 语义匹配/不匹配的神经解码判别结果及时间动态特征
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的EEG多变量时序分析（MVPA+跨格式解码+时间泛化），27人样本、双刺激类型（自然/人造）、双模态匹配任务，揭示了语义匹配中格式依赖的时间神经机制；但未突破BCI范式、未实现闭环控制、未解决临床或交互瓶颈，属认知神经科学层面的重要增量，而非脑机接口工程或临床转化级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了语义跨模态匹配中神经时间动态的高质量实证证据，但仍是基础认知发现，非BCI系统级突破

papers.title: On the Identifiability of Controlled World Models
papers.abstract: World model serves as a promising tool to infer environment dynamics under high-dimensional observations and candidate actions. Recently, LeCun's JEPA provides a compelling framework for learning such models in representation space. Its action-conditioned extension plays a central role in visual control and latent-space planning, but leaves a fundamental question: can it recover the controlled dynamics from nonlinear observations? This paper presents a joint identifiability condition for controlled world models with Gaussian latent states, which consists of two coupled components: (1) representation identifiability and (2) transition identifiability. The former depends on the spectral separation property while the latter is related to non-degenerate variation of conditional action. We prove that when this condition holds, minimizing the LeJEPA-style predictive objective can recover both latent states and controlled dynamics in the sense of orthogonal transformation. We further prove that the upper bound of transition prediction error is inversely proportional to the spectral separation margin. We also characterize an attainable amplification of counterfactual prediction error that scales inversely with the weakest conditional action-excitation margin. The theoretical predictions are empirically supported across four nonlinear observation settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文从理论角度分析了带动作条件的世界模型（如LeCun的JEPA框架）能否从非线性观测中唯一恢复真实受控动力学，给出了高斯隐状态下的联合可识别性条件，并证明了预测误差与谱分离度、动作激励强度成反比，所有结论都在四种非线性观测设置下做了实证验证。
analysis.claim: 在高斯隐状态假设下，当表示可识别性（依赖谱分离）与转移可识别性（依赖动作条件非退化变化）同时满足时，最小化LeJEPA式预测目标可唯一恢复隐状态和受控动力学（至正交变换），且预测误差有明确理论上界。
analysis.input: 非线性观测序列+动作序列
analysis.output: 隐状态表示+受控动力学转移函数（至正交等价）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真生成的非线性观测
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个针对动作条件世界模型的严格可识别性理论框架，含误差界与反事实放大刻画，实证覆盖4种非线性设定，但未涉及真实系统、未开源代码/模型、未接入下游控制任务验证，属于扎实的理论增量而非范式突破或工程落地推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：理论严谨、条件清晰、实证充分，但限于仿真设定与理想化假设（高斯隐状态、谱分离可测），尚未连接真实感知-动作闭环，暂未达到World Models或DreamerV3级的领域分量。

papers.title: Balancing of Humanoid with Object Mass: Trade-off Analyses and Lifting Control
papers.abstract: The demand for humanoid loco-manipulation tasks with an object has recently increased, and most existing control approaches for stability in such tasks rely on heuristics or machine-learning techniques. This study rigorously analyzes and exploits the dynamic effects of the object mass on balance stability. By formulating the object mass parameters in the whole-body dynamics with distributed contact wrenches and centers of pressure at the stance contacts, their nonlinear effects on the system momenta and constraints are quantified. The dynamic models and constraints are incorporated into the construction of the balanced state basin/boundary (BSB), a partition of the center-of-mass state space for a biped system to maintain balance in its desired contacts. The implications of the BSB for prediction and control are highlighted using a humanoid robot and an analytically tractable reduced-order mechanism. The BSBs under different conditions of base of support, actuation capacity, and pose provide systematic analyses of the effects of object mass on the balancing capability of a system. In particular, the trade-off relationships between momentum regulation and limiting factors in balancing are characterized, introducing two key quantities of the object: the critical mass, at which the system's balancing capability is maximum, and the transition mass, which activates different limiting factors. In addition, sufficient conditions for imposing balanced states on a trajectory are established and implemented with BSBs as explicit threshold constraints in the whole-body trajectory optimization for stable object-lifting control of the humanoid, demonstrating the lift-and-hold and lift-and-release tasks with distinct mass properties in simulations and experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统建模了手持物体时人形机器人平衡能力如何随物体质量变化，定义了‘临界质量’和‘过渡质量’两个关键阈值，用解析化的平衡状态盆地（BSB）作为硬约束嵌入全身轨迹优化，实现在仿真和真实机器人上的稳定提物控制。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Hyunjong Song/Joo H. Kim 可能为韩国高校研究者，但无佐证）
analysis.claim: 物体质量对人形机器人平衡稳定性存在非线性、可量化的动态影响，其作用可通过引入‘临界质量’与‘过渡质量’两个解析性阈值，在平衡状态盆地（BSB）框架下实现可证明的稳定提物控制。
analysis.input: 物体质量参数、支撑基底几何、关节力矩极限、当前姿态与动量状态
analysis.output: 满足平衡约束的全身关节轨迹（含足底接触力/力矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（实验中使用具体平台未说明，仅称 humanoid robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人提物实验数据用于验证，非数据驱动训练
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但窄：首次将物体质量作为显式动力学变量纳入BSB理论框架，推导出两个具物理意义的质量阈值，并在真实机器人上验证提物任务；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未对比SOTA学习类方法，也未解决loco-manipulation中的运动-操作耦合核心难点（如动态抓取、多接触切换），属于经典控制框架下的重要深化而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在人形平衡动力学建模上做出严谨推进，但局限于特定控制范式和单一任务，未触及当前领域最棘手的泛化与端到端学习瓶颈，暂未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: PLMView: collaborative protein language model representations for fast and scalable specialized protein function inference
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The functional classification of protein sequences remains a major bottleneck in biology. Although protein language model (PLM)-based approaches have substantially improved broad protein function prediction, most protein sequences still lack precise annotation at the level of specialized functions—the fine-grained molecular roles that define specificity within protein families. We present PLMView, an unsupervised framework for fine-grained protein function classification directly from sequence. PLMView reframes protein function inference as a relational problem: instead of embedding sequences in isolation, it positions them within a collaborative functional space defined by comparisons with PLM embeddings of anchor sequences, thereby capturing subtle sequence–function relationships. Without requiring labeled data, family-specific training, or PLM fine-tuning, PLMView accurately distinguishes specialized functions among homologous proteins and highlights residues likely to determine functional specificity. The method achieves high precision while remaining computationally efficient, classifying approximately 10,000 sequences with 1,000 anchors in under 40 minutes; compared with pooled-embedding approaches and, in challenging cases, Sequence Similarity Networks, PLMView provides finer and more biologically coherent functional resolution, while achieving more than 10-fold speed-up over SSN reconstruction on datasets of this scale. Applications to thioredoxins, visual opsins, and Tara Oceans environmental diatom cold-shock proteins show that PLMView can move from interpretable residue-level determinants in well-studied protein families to large-scale environmental functional discovery, linking molecular specialization to ecological distribution and transcriptional deployment across the global ocean.

analysis.tldr: PLMView是一种无需标注数据、不微调蛋白语言模型的无监督方法，通过将待分类蛋白序列与一组锚定序列的PLM嵌入做相对比较，构建协作式功能空间，从而在同源蛋白中高精度区分细粒度分子功能（如特定底物结合/催化特异性），并定位决定功能特异性的关键残基。
analysis.org: 索邦大学/法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）
analysis.claim: 仅通过PLM原始嵌入的相对关系建模（无需微调、无需标签、无需家族特化训练），即可实现同源蛋白间细粒度功能的高分辨、可解释、可扩展推断。
analysis.input: 蛋白氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 细粒度功能类别（如thioredoxin亚型、opsin光谱敏感性亚类）、功能决定性残基位置
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在thioredoxin/opsin/cold-shock三大真实蛋白家族上验证了细粒度功能区分能力与残基级可解释性，对比SSN和pooled-embedding有明确性能+速度优势，且开源代码；但未达AlphaFold2级范式革命（不预测结构/动力学），也未覆盖全蛋白组规模或临床级功能注释，属显著推进SOTA的重磅方法而非基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将PLM嵌入从单序列表征升维为关系空间建模，用极简设计达成细粒度功能推断的精度、速度与可解释性三重提升，但依赖已有PLM且未解决标注稀缺的根本瓶颈

papers.title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
papers.abstract: Manipulating moving objects requires a policy to anticipate contact events, yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly fine-tuned from the current observation alone. World action models (WAMs) learn predictive dynamics, but running a video-scale teacher or explicitly imagining future frames at deployment is costly. We introduce ForeTime-VLA, a dense pi0.5 policy that distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM-derived teacher while remaining causal at inference. Offline, current and future video latents are compressed into a whitened 64-D target. Online, an eight-frame history encoder predicts this target together with manipulation phase and normalized time-to-transition. Four future tokens and one phase token condition the VLM prefix, while the predicted future and transition horizon condition the action expert. Training retains the original flow-matching action target and adds cosine, relational geometry, phase, time-to-transition, and action-equivalence objectives.
