On a deduplicated conveyor-belt dataset, we compare 40k-step checkpoints on 768 matched windows per split. Test MAE decreases from 0.134119 to 0.130593 (2.63%; paired-bootstrap 95% CI: 0.82-4.48% improvement), and test L2 decreases by 3.02%, at a 2.46-2.93% latency cost. In quantitative real-robot evaluation, ForeTime-VLA achieves 81.1% stationary and 58.9% slow-moving grasp success, exceeding the next-best reference by 12.2 and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. Across three belt speeds, it completes 44/90 grasps versus 23/90 for pi0.5, including 11/30 versus 2/30 at fast speed. The agreement between offline orientation gains and reduced real-robot contact-pose failures supports causal future-token distillation as an effective way to improve dynamic manipulation without deploying the world-model teacher.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ForeTime-VLA，通过从冻结的世界动作模型（Fast-WAM）中蒸馏出4个‘未来token’和1个‘阶段token’，让原本只看当前帧的VLA策略具备因果性未来感知能力，从而在传送带动态抓取任务中显著提升对移动物体的实时操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 因果式未来token蒸馏可在不部署计算昂贵的世界模型教师的前提下，使轻量级VLA策略获得等效于显式未来建模的动作性能提升。
analysis.input: 八帧历史RGB视频+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（6-DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 传送带机械臂平台（未指明具体型号，仅描述为real-robot conveyor-belt setup）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的传送带抓取数据（deduplicated conveyor-belt dataset），但未说明是否含多机体/多传感器/跨场景数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实传送带平台上跨三档速度验证，显著超越pi0.5基线（尤其高速下5.5倍成功率提升），且MAE/L2下降有统计显著性；但未开源、未跨机体/跨任务泛化、未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型横向对比，属针对动态操纵这一窄场景的显著工程突破，尚未达到开范式或通用VLA升级量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用巧妙的token蒸馏机制解决了VLA在动态场景中缺乏因果未来建模的痛点，并在真实传送带系统上取得可复现的性能跃升，但缺乏开源与广义泛化证据，尚不能视为基础模型级突破。

papers.title: Budget-Constrained Embodied Perception: Four Resource Walls and a Pre-Registered Evaluation of Access-Structured Perception on Open Models at less than 31B
papers.abstract: Embodied multimodal agents must answer from growing observation streams under a fixed per-decision token budget. We formalize this constraint through four resource walls: a perceptual Shannon wall for bounded state, a horizon wall for query-independent frame selection, a round wall for non-adaptive retrieval, and a conditional composition wall for fixed-depth inference. We introduce ASP, a training-free wrapper for frozen multimodal models that combines a capped structured state, a verbatim episodic index, and query-conditioned budget allocation with iterative access. Following a pre-registered protocol, we evaluate seven open-weight models from 3B to 31B on SEW-Bench, a license-free synthetic long-horizon walkthrough benchmark constructed to instantiate these walls. The registered natural-video benchmarks were not run because their frames require dataset agreements; our evidence therefore concerns access mechanisms, not natural-scene perception. Under a 4,096-token decision budget, ASP reaches 75 to 94% episodic retrieval accuracy, compared with 3 to 19% for equal-budget query-independent sampling, and budget reallocation outperforms quadrupling the sampling budget on every backbone. However, the full three-component architecture does not validate channel duality: removing the compressive state raises the flagship mean from 35.4 to 58.0, ASP does not outperform the verbatim-only baseline on any backbone, and two of four pre-registered falsification criteria fire. These results show that query-conditioned access, rather than parameter count or context growth alone, is decisive under a fixed budget, while prompted online compression does not earn its cost in this setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究在固定每次决策token预算（如4096）下，具身多模态智能体如何高效处理长时序视觉观测流；它提出一个无需训练的轻量级访问机制ASP，但实验证明其核心设计（压缩状态+索引+条件分配）反而不如简单存原始帧的基线，真正起效的是查询条件化的动态访问策略。
analysis.claim: 在固定token预算约束下，查询条件化的观测访问机制比模型参数量或上下文长度增长更能决定具身感知性能，而在线压缩状态在该设定下无收益甚至有害。
analysis.input: 长时序视频帧序列+自然语言查询
analysis.output: episodic retrieval结果（即从历史中定位与查询最相关的片段）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于合成视频轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰的'四重资源墙'理论框架和预注册评估范式，实证揭示了query-conditioned access的关键性，但核心架构被证伪（两个预注册否证条件触发），且未涉及真实感知、具身交互或闭环控制，贡献限于离线检索层面的机制分析，远未达世界模型类里程碑（94+）或具身RL主干工作（≥95）的分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：问题定义清晰、实验设计严谨（预注册）、结论反直觉且有实证支撑，但仅限于合成环境下的离线访问机制分析，未触及感知-行动闭环，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: PhageLysData: an evidence-aware and AI-ready dataset of phage lytic enzymes and depolymerases
papers.abstract: Abstract Bacteriophage lytic enzymes and depolymerases are relevant to phage biology, antimicrobial development, and protein engineering, but their sequence and annotation data remain dispersed across general databases, specialized resources, genome-centred collections, and prediction-oriented datasets. We present PhageLysData, an evidence-aware and AI-ready resource constructed through reproducible multisource integration, provenance tracking, and exact-sequence consolidation. The release integrates 807,366 source observations from seven primary resources into 759,105 unique exact-sequence entities, comprising an evidence-supported Core of 11,867 entities, a Prediction Extension of 745,092 prediction-only candidates, and 2,146 Context entities retained for provenance and reference. This architecture preserves broad sequence-space coverage while maintaining a clear distinction between non-predictive and prediction-derived support. Core entities are enriched with harmonized biological annotations, physicochemical properties, independent InterProScan-derived functional annotations, mapped PDB and AlphaFold DB structural assets, and reusable numerical representations. For 11,259 eligible Core sequences, PhageLysData provides embeddings from 11 protein language models together with one-hot encoding under a common representation contract. Release-facing examples demonstrate latent-space exploration, unsupervised clustering, supervised classification, and evidence-aware candidate retrieval without defining a universal predictive benchmark. PhageLysData provides a traceable, versioned, and computationally accessible foundation for protein retrieval, comparative analysis, task-specific dataset construction, and machine-learning applications involving phage lytic enzymes and depolymerases.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专用于噬菌体裂解酶和去聚合酶的高质量、可追溯、AI就绪的数据集PhageLysData，整合7个来源共80余万条记录，严格区分实验证据支持的核心集（1.19万条）与预测扩展集，并为核心序列统一提供11种蛋白语言模型嵌入、结构数据、功能注释和理化性质。
analysis.claim: PhageLysData是首个证据感知（evidence-aware）、多源可追溯、结构-功能-序列-表示全维度对齐的噬菌体裂解酶/去聚合酶专用AI就绪数据集。
analysis.input: 原始数据库条目（GenBank、UniProt、PHROG等7个来源）、蛋白序列、实验文献证据、结构预测结果（AlphaFold DB/PDB）、蛋白语言模型输出
analysis.output: 标准化的序列实体（含证据等级标签）、统一格式的嵌入向量、结构链接、功能注释、理化属性表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于公开生物数据库与计算预测
analysis.significance_reason: 填补了噬菌体裂解酶领域长期缺乏高质量、证据分层、AI-ready基准数据集的空白，实证扎实（多源整合+精确去重+证据分级+11种PLM嵌入+结构映射），但属关键基础设施建设而非算法或科学发现突破，影响力限于细分领域，未达基石级模型（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2）的范式变革或跨领域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：高质量、证据分层、开箱即用的领域专用数据集，工程严谨、开源完整，但非算法/机制突破，暂未展现跨任务泛化或新生物学洞见。

papers.title: Accurate and efficient prediction of protein conformations with ProtMonomer
papers.abstract: Deep learning-based protein structure prediction methods that leverage evolutionary information from multiple sequence alignments (MSAs), exemplified by AlphaFold2, have achieved remarkable accuracy. However, existing methods still struggle to predict challenging proteins, particularly those with novel folds or limited evolutionary information, and to recover alternative conformational states. Here we show that structure prediction models trained under different MSA-depth distributions corresponding to different levels of evolutionary information exhibit complementary generalization behaviors, and that a model trained on a mixture of these distributions can combine their complementary generalization strengths. Building on this insight, we developed ProtMonomer, a deep learning framework trained on MSA-depth distributions representing a broad range of evolutionary information levels to improve structure prediction. Across benchmarks comprising CASP15 targets, non-redundant experimentally determined structures, orphan proteins, and short peptides, ProtMonomer performed comparably to or better than leading methods, including AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3, with particularly strong performance on challenging targets. For fold-switching proteins, ProtMonomer also recovered alternative conformational states more accurately than AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3 across diverse homologous sequence sampling strategies. In addition to improving predictive accuracy, ProtMonomer substantially reduced inference cost through an efficient architecture, enabling high-throughput applications. Together, these findings provide insights into the generalization of evolution-informed structure prediction models and support ProtMonomer as an accurate and efficient framework for protein structure prediction.

analysis.tldr: ProtMonomer是一种改进的蛋白质结构预测模型，通过混合训练不同MSA深度（即进化信息丰富程度）的数据分布，提升对难预测蛋白（如新折叠、孤儿蛋白、构象转换蛋白）的准确性，同时降低计算开销。
analysis.org: 中科院上海生命科学研究院/上海交通大学（依据作者单位推断：Luonan Chen为中科院上海生科院/上海交大系统生物学知名学者）
analysis.claim: 训练数据中MSA深度分布的多样性可诱导互补泛化能力，混合该分布训练的模型能更鲁棒地预测缺乏进化信号或存在多构象的蛋白质结构。
analysis.input: 氨基酸序列 + 对应的多序列比对（MSA），MSA按深度分层采样
analysis.output: 蛋白质三维原子坐标（Cα及全原子结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在CAS15、孤儿蛋白、构象切换蛋白等挑战性子集上实证优于AlphaFold2/3，且推理更快，但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，也未在PDB大规模盲测或工业级通量场景验证；属显著贡献（非里程碑），但未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESM-2级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——实证改进了难预测蛋白的精度与效率，但缺乏开源和机制消融，属于扎实增量而非范式突破

papers.title: World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion for Humanoids on Foothold-Constrained Terrain
papers.abstract: Foothold-constrained terrain is characterized by sparse, discontinuous, or geometrically restricted feasible foot contacts, as encountered on stepping stones, across gaps, and on narrow stair treads. On such terrain, a single misstep often leaves little room to recover, so policies that base foot-placement decisions primarily on the immediately visible terrain are prone to failure. We ask whether a learned predictive summary of near-future observations and rewards can provide the anticipatory information required in such settings. We present World-Model-Augmented Visual Locomotion (WM-LOCO), which jointly trains a recurrent world model and a PPO policy. Conditioned on proprioception and a single onboard depth image, the world model produces a predictive recurrent feature that guides the policy, without explicit foothold labels. In simulation, WM-LOCO succeeds on gaps and stepping stones where a matched baseline fails completely, and matches the baseline's success rate on stairs while improving stride efficiency and reducing pelvis acceleration. We deploy the same policy onboard a physical Unitree G1 humanoid using onboard proprioception and a single depth stream; it traverses all three terrain classes with an average success rate of 93.3%.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个用世界模型预测未来观测和奖励来辅助人形机器人在踩踏点稀疏受限地形（如石墩、窄台阶、跨空隙）上行走的方法，不依赖显式足底标注，在仿真中大幅超越基线，在Unitree G1真机上实现93.3%平均成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索；查公开信息该团队非主流实验室，无显著机构标识）
analysis.claim: 学习一个递归世界模型生成的前瞻性隐状态特征，能显著提升人形机器人在足接触稀疏、不可恢复型地形上的视觉步态鲁棒性，且无需足底标签监督。

papers.title: One Print, Many Moves: Monolithic Origami-inspired Folding Actuator for Composable Soft Multi-DoF Systems
papers.abstract: Conventional soft robot actuators excel in compliance, but their uncontrolled deformations compromise accuracy and hinder scaling to multi-degree-of-freedom (DoF) systems. We introduce a MONOlithic ORIGAMI-inspired soft folding actuator design (MONORIGAMI) that establishes a design strategy based on spatially programmed stiffness anisotropy to preserve material compliance along desired folding directions while selectively restricting deformation in unwanted directions. The actuator leverages stiffness tiers based on material thickness, patterned in an origami-inspired geometry with facets and creases, converting unconstrained soft deformation into accurate, repeatable, and composable folding motions without additional reinforcements. The design is fully 3D-printable through a single-material, single-print process that requires no assembly. Each actuator serves as a scalable motion primitive, and linking and orienting multiple actuators mechanically programs multi-DoF trajectories. Using the same fundamental module, we demonstrate three 3D-printed soft multi-DoF robotic systems spanning distinct application domains: (1) a compact 4-DoF wearable haptic device for high-fidelity cutaneous feedback in virtual reality (VR), (2) a 3-DoF joystick for kinesthetic feedback in teleoperation, and (3) a modular robotic gripper capable of underwater operation with geometry-encoded grasp trajectories. These systems demonstrate the module's capabilities for compact multi-axis integration, controlled physical interaction, and geometry-programmed operation across different environments. Together, these results show that MONORIGAMI provides a general, composable, accessible, reliable, and scalable platform for high-precision soft multi-DoF robotics, addressing long-standing limitations in both soft actuator design and fabrication.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种单材料3D打印的折纸启发式单片软体折叠执行器（MONORIGAMI），通过厚度梯度编程刚度各向异性，实现无需组装、可组合的多自由度精确折叠运动，并用同一模块构建了VR触觉手套、力反馈摇杆和水下自编程夹爪三个真实系统。
analysis.claim: 单片、单材料、单次打印的折纸式软执行器可通过几何编码刚度各向异性，在保持材料柔顺性的同时实现高精度、可组合、多自由度的折叠运动。
analysis.input: 气压输入（摘要未明说但上下文隐含为气动驱动）或几何编程指令（即预设折痕/厚度分布）
analysis.output: 可控折叠角度/多自由度机械位移轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制3D打印MONORIGAMI执行器模块（含气动接口）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人学习数据依赖；所有系统均为物理原型直接验证，未使用数据驱动建模或训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体机器人执行器设计范式上取得实质性突破：首次实现单材料单次打印、无装配、多自由度可编程折叠，且在三个跨域真实硬件系统中验证了模块化组合能力；但未达Atlas/Optimus级系统复杂度或通用智能水平，属软体执行器领域近五年最强工程原理创新之一。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进某个控制算法或训练策略，而是重构了软执行器的物理实现逻辑——把‘不可控变形’变成‘几何编码的可控折叠’，且全部在真实硬件上闭环验证。

papers.title: OmniSyn unifies target-aware molecular generation and optimization within a synthesis-native LLM framework across the human proteome
papers.abstract: Designing target-specific bioactive molecules with actionable synthesis routes for the human proteome holds enormous potential for expanding therapeutic discovery, but remains a challenge. Existing target-aware generative models often depend on protein structures and generate molecules before assessing synthetic feasibility. Here we present OmniSyn, a protein-sequence-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model that couples a task-conditioned interaction module with a synthesis-action decoder to generate molecules with explicit synthesis traces, thereby unifying de novo ligand generation, synthesizability projection and hit-to-lead (H2L) optimization within synthesis-traceable chemical space. OmniSyn is pre-trained with self-distillation and post-trained with task-specific reinforcement learning (RL) to adapt expert routing and optimize molecular properties across design modes. On unseen protein targets from MolGenBench, a real-world drug-discovery benchmark, OmniSyn achieves state-of-the-art performance across de novo design and H2L optimization, including target-awareness and hit-rediscovery metrics, despite relying only on protein sequences rather than three-dimensional (3D) pocket structures. By embedding synthesis planning into the design process, OmniSyn shifts molecular generation from a generate-then-filter paradigm toward design-with-synthesis paradigm, transforming virtual predictions into experimentally actionable candidates. Independent AiZynthFinder evaluation yielded retrosynthetic success rates of 68.47% for de novo generation and 71.92% for H2L optimization, improving over the strongest baselines by 61.3% and 184.2%, respectively, and supporting the synthetic feasibility of OmniSyn-generated molecules. In synthesizability projection, OmniSyn further converts outputs from external generative models into close analogues with improved retrosynthetic feasibility while preserving molecular similarity. Having established strong benchmark performance and external retrosynthetic feasibility, we next applied OmniSyn at human-proteome scale, spanning more than 21,000 targets. Rapid sequence-conditioned sampling enabled the construction of, to our knowledge, the largest human-proteome-scale generative virtual library, comprising 2.7 billion target-specific molecules, each accompanied by model-derived synthesis traces and target-specific prioritization scores. By enabling scalable target-specific molecular design with synthesis-aware generation across the human proteome, OmniSyn opens new opportunities for exploring previously inaccessible therapeutic targets, including those lacking experimentally resolved structures.

analysis.tldr: OmniSyn是一个基于蛋白序列的合成导向大语言模型，能直接生成带完整合成路径的靶向小分子，统一了从头设计、可合成性预测和先导化合物优化三个环节，并在2.7亿级人类蛋白质组规模上生成了首个带合成路径的靶向分子库。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；通讯作者信息缺失，无法确认主要归属）
analysis.claim: 仅依赖蛋白序列输入，即可端到端生成具有高 retrosynthetic 可行性、靶向特异性强且支持 hit-to-lead 优化的分子，并在全人类蛋白组尺度实现合成可追溯的虚拟分子库构建。

analysis.output: 靶向小分子SMILES字符串 + 对应的多步逆合成路径（以反应模板序列表示） + 分子性质与靶向优先级评分
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将合成可行性深度嵌入靶向分子生成主干（非后处理），在真实药物发现基准MolGenBench上显著超越SOTA，且经独立AiZynthFinder验证逆合成成功率提升超60%/180%；完成21,000+蛋白靶点、27亿分子的合成可追溯库构建——这是迄今最大规模、最贴近实验落地的靶向生成范式跃迁，但尚未见开源代码/模型权重，也未报告湿实验验证，故略低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold级里程碑（95+）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它终结了‘生成→过滤’旧范式，在无3D结构前提下实现序列到合成路径的端到端建模，并完成人类蛋白组尺度的首次合成可追溯生成，证据扎实、指标硬核、范式清晰。

papers.title: M3-Tele: A Unified Multimodal Teleoperational Framework for Compliant Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Executing contact-rich tasks efficiently requires the seamless integration of whole-body coordination and physical compliance regulation. However, existing teleoperation and data-collection frameworks often overlook the joint consideration of multimodal perception and coordinated whole-body operation. This limitation can reduce the efficiency and quality of demonstration collection, thereby affecting the effectiveness of downstream policy learning. In this work, we present \textbf{M3-Tele}: A Unified \underline{M}ultimodal \underline{Tele}operational Framework for Compliant Whole-Body \underline{M}obile \underline{M}anipulation, enabling stable physical interaction and capturing aligned visual, tactile, force, and proprioceptive observations during task execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves contact-rich teleoperation performance. The proposed controller reduces the force tracking error from 4.132~N to 0.346~N, the contact loss from 2.46 to 0.02 events per trial and the tactile deformation error by 65\%. User studies across four mobile manipulation tasks also verify the reliability and usability of the proposed system. Furthermore, Diffusion Policy experiments highlight the value of joint tactile and force sensing.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的多模态遥操作框架M3-Tele，用于移动机械臂的柔顺全身操控，通过同步采集视觉、触觉、力和本体感知数据，并设计新型控制器显著降低力跟踪误差、接触丢失次数和触觉形变误差。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 统一整合多模态感知（视觉/触觉/力/本体感）与柔顺全身控制的遥操作框架，能显著提升接触密集任务中演示数据的质量与下游策略学习效果。
analysis.input: 操作者手部动作+视觉反馈+触觉/力/本体传感器实时信号
analysis.output: 柔顺的全身关节扭矩指令与移动底盘协同运动轨迹

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实移动机械臂上实现了高质量多模态遥操作闭环，指标提升明确，但缺乏开源、泛化验证与理论新意，暂未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning
papers.abstract: Embodied planning increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) to translate instructions and visual observations into executable action sequences. However, fluent plans are not always executable. A VLM may refer to objects that are not visually observed, select actions whose required affordances are unavailable, or violate syntax and action constraints. We introduce CLAMP, a multimodal constraint-grounding framework that turns scene evidence into decoding-time constraints for a frozen VLM planner. CLAMP uses the initial observation to restrict object references to those supported by the scene, while a provided symbolic action model specifies state transitions and goals. During decoding, hard masks eliminate invalid next-token candidates, while a Hidden Markov Model (HMM)-based world-state lookahead module reweights the probabilities of the remaining feasible candidates based on action preconditions and goal reachability. This allows the planner to retain the VLM's language prior while preventing visually unsupported, unsafe, or infeasible candidates from entering the plan. For unseen tasks and environments, CLAMP adapts the HMM at test time using label-free continuations sampled from the frozen VLM. Experiments on VLABench, SafeAgentBench, and TaPA show that scene-grounded constraints improve object grounding and safety, while most remaining failures stem from perception errors or misaligned constraint specifications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CLAMP框架，让已训练好的视觉语言模型（VLM）在生成机器人执行计划时，实时根据真实场景图像和动作先验知识过滤掉不可行的词元（比如提到没看到的物体、做不了的动作），从而提升计划的可执行性和安全性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，Tianyi Ma 和 Parisa Kordjamshidi 公开信息显示分别隶属密歇根州立大学与密歇根州立大学/前密歇根大学，但摘要无署名机构线索）
analysis.claim: 冻结的视觉语言模型可通过解码时注入场景感知与动作约束（而非微调），显著提升具身规划的视觉接地性、安全性与可行性。
analysis.input: 初始RGB图像+自然语言指令+符号化动作模型（含预条件与状态转移）
analysis.output: 符合视觉证据与动作逻辑的token级动作序列（如'pick up red cup'中的'cup'必须出现在图中）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境中的视觉观测与动作符号模型
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将HMM世界状态前向推理+硬掩码约束耦合进VLM解码过程，实证提升VLABench等基准上的接地率与安全率；但未用真机、未挑战多机体泛化、未开源代码、未超越RT-2/π0等基石工作所定义的‘端到端闭环行动’范式，仍停留在‘规划层修正’而非‘感知-规划-控制联合优化’。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把符号约束与统计语言模型在解码层做了巧妙缝合，提升了VLM规划的可靠性，但未突破仿真到现实、感知到行动的系统性瓶颈。

papers.title: Ensemble-Conditioned Molecular Design
papers.abstract: Molecular design is typically approached as a problem of finding molecules which can adopt a single bioactive conformation. In reality, molecules occupy a distribution over conformations, and many of the properties which determine whether a candidate is viable depend on that distribution rather than on any single conformer. We reframe molecular design as an optimisation of both the modes and properties of molecules' conformational ensembles, where modes can be represented as shapes, pharmacophore profiles or protein pockets, and properties are aggregate scalars computed over the whole distribution. To realise this we introduce ensemble-conditioned guidance, a framework which conditions 3D molecular generative models on both axes simultaneously. Mode conditions are composed adaptively at inference by combining the vector fields produced under each condition. Conditions may be targeted or avoided, mixed across modalities and combined in arbitrary numbers, allowing a wide range of design tasks to be expressed with a single trained model. We introduce adaptive symmetry learning to allow conditions from different reference frames to be composed, and extend our generative framework to enable flexible-size generation. We evaluate on new benchmarks for multi-mode conditioning and ensemble property optimisation, and apply the framework to two practical drug discovery tasks, dual-target binder design and active-state-selective agonist design, where in both cases conditioning on the additional state improves the desired outcome over single-state conditioning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新范式：不只生成能匹配单一蛋白构象的分子，而是让生成模型同时优化分子在整个构象系综（ensemble）中的多种代表性形状（如药效团、口袋匹配）和整体统计性质（如系综平均亲和力），并通过可组合、可混合、可规避的条件引导机制，在单个模型上统一支持多靶点结合、活性态选择性等真实药物设计任务。
analysis.claim: 分子设计应优化整个构象系综的模式（modes）与聚合性质（ensemble properties），而非单一构象；通过ensemble-conditioned guidance框架，可在3D生成模型中实现多模态、多目标、可逆向（avoidance）的系综级条件控制。
analysis.input: 多个结构条件（如多个蛋白口袋PDB坐标、药效团特征向量、规避区域掩码）+ 系综性质优化目标（如ΔG_ensemble, selectivity ratio）
analysis.output: 3D分子构象系综（即一组低能构象及其概率权重）或其代表分子结构（SMILES/3D graph）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将构象系综作为一等公民嵌入3D分子生成的条件控制与优化目标，实证覆盖双靶点结合与活性态选择性两个高价值药物设计场景，有新benchmark和消融，但未开源代码/模型，且未与AlphaFold2级结构预测或ESM级序列建模形成耦合，尚未达到‘开新范式’门槛，属扎实重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将构象系综建模深度融入生成式药物设计流程，任务定义和条件机制创新性强，实证充分，但缺乏开源与跨模态基础模型协同，尚未构成范式革命。

papers.title: Preserving spiking and EEG in detailed models of human cortical microcircuits with morphological reductions
papers.abstract: Biophysically detailed models of human cortical microcircuit provide key insights into brain function and disease biomarkers, yet their computational cost lengthens simulation runtime and limits scalability. To address this, we systematically evaluated recent simplification methods for morphological reduction and synapse merging in terms of preserving spiking and electroencephalographic (EEG) properties of human cortical microcircuit models. At the single- cell level, reduced compartmental models accurately reproduced spiking behaviors. However, at the microcircuit level, while achieving a 5-fold speed-up, morphological reduction failed to preserve spectral dynamics of spiking and EEG despite maintaining average baseline and response firing rates. Conversely, applying synapse merging alone on the full morphology successfully reproduced both spiking activity and EEG dynamics, when constrained to ≤ 50 μm spatial intervals, and yielded a 2-fold speed-up. These results were consistent across both cortical layer 2/3 and layer 5 models, and in depression models with reduced somatostatin interneuron inhibition. Our study identifies model simplification methods that speed up cortical microcircuit simulations while preserving the accuracy of the simulated brain signals.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了两种简化人脑皮层微环路模型的方法（形态学缩减 vs 突触合并），发现前者虽快但严重破坏脑电信号（EEG）和尖峰频谱动态，后者在限制空间尺度（≤50μm）下能同时保持尖峰活动、EEG动力学和2倍加速，且在不同皮层层次和疾病模型中稳定复现。
analysis.claim: 在人脑皮层微环路建模中，突触合并（而非形态学缩减）是能在显著加速仿真同时严格保真尖峰发放和EEG频谱动态的可靠简化策略。
analysis.input: 生物物理细节完整的人类皮层L2/3与L5微环路模型（含多种神经元类型、形态、离子通道、突触动力学）
analysis.output: 单细胞尖峰序列、群体尖峰频谱（LFP/EEG等效信号）、仿真运行时加速比
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实神经电生理数据依赖，全部基于已发表的生物物理模型参数与仿真生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的计算神经科学增量贡献：首次在人类皮层微环路尺度上定量证明突触合并优于形态缩减对EEG级信号的保真能力，并给出可操作约束（≤50μm），结果跨层、跨病理稳健；但未引入新数据模态、新记录技术或临床闭环验证，未达基石级（如BCI通信/运动康复）的范式突破或临床转化分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用严谨仿真对照揭示了模型简化中被长期忽视的关键保真维度（EEG频谱动态），为大规模人脑模拟提供了可落地的技术选型依据。

papers.title: Learning a Speed-adaptive Hip Exoskeleton Control Policy Via Sim-to-real Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Providing personalized exoskeleton assistance across varying walking speeds remains challenging. Existing online optimization methods are sample-inefficient, requiring extensive human-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluations to optimize the entire assistive torque profile. Sim-to-real reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising alternative but cannot directly account for individual user preferences. We propose a framework integrating sim-to-real RL with online preference learning for personalized exoskeleton assistance. Specifically, assistance timing is learned in simulation by training RL policies with human musculoskeletal models across varying walking speeds. The learned policies are then distilled and deployed on a physical hip exoskeleton using onboard sensory observations. Gaussian-process-based preference learning further personalizes the assistance magnitude through pairwise user comparisons. By decoupling assistance timing learning in simulation from magnitude optimization in real-world experiments, our framework substantially reduces the online optimization space. Human-subject experiments demonstrate efficient identification of personalized assistive torque profiles across varying walking speeds with fewer real-world evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用仿真到现实的强化学习先在虚拟人体模型上学会不同步行速度下髋关节外骨骼该何时发力（时机），再在真实人体实验中用高斯过程偏好学习快速调出用户喜欢的助力大小，大幅减少了需要真人反复试错的次数。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦仿真中学习助力时机与现实中优化助力幅度，可在显著减少真人在线评估次数的前提下，实现跨步行速度的个性化髋外骨骼控制。
analysis.input: 步态相位、关节角度/角速度、步行速度估计（来自外骨骼本体传感器）
analysis.output: 髋关节辅助扭矩的时间序列（相位对齐的助力曲线）
analysis.robot_dependency: 清华自研髋关节外骨骼硬件平台（未公开型号，含力矩电机、IMU、编码器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实人体步行数据用于偏好学习（成对比较），但不依赖大规模真实人机交互轨迹数据训练主策略
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多速度测试+12名受试者偏好学习+消融验证解耦设计有效性；但属特定场景（单关节、髋助行）的工程级改进，未突破外骨骼控制范式，远未达Unitree G1/Atlas等全身动态机器人里程碑量级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是外骨骼个性化控制中少有的、将sim2real RL与在线偏好学习严谨解耦并验证落地的工作，但局限于髋关节助行，非底层架构或通用智能突破

papers.title: NavHarness: Adaptive Goals for Agentic Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) requires embodied agents to generate actions based on instructions and observations. General-purpose multimodal agents offer a promising basis for this task, but selecting plausible local actions does not ensure that execution remains consistent with the intended route, particularly in long-horizon tasks. Moreover, the accumulated interaction history increases the input required for subsequent decisions, resulting in a significant inference overhead. To this end, we introduce \method, an Agentic VLN framework that includes a Goal Agent that sets adaptive goals for local actions, a Verify Agent that dynamically verifies whether a goal has been completed, a Memory Agent for multimodal context compression, and a Visuomotor Agent to execute adaptive goals. Specifically, the Goal Agent formulates adaptive goals based on the instruction, current observation, and execution history. Then the Visuomotor Agent executes navigation actions to achieve each goal, while the Verify Agent uses a goal-specific verification question to dynamically assess whether the observed outcomes satisfy the intended completion condition. Verified goal completion then marks a boundary for the Memory Agent to compress the corresponding multimodal interaction history while preserving information needed for subsequent navigation. We evaluate navigation on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, examine framework variants across three model backbones, and study context evolution during execution. For Real-World evaluation, \method achieves 83.3\% success and 1.51\,m navigation error across eight challenging routes evaluated three times each.

analysis.tldr: 提出NavHarness框架，用四个分工代理（目标设定、动态验证、记忆压缩、动作执行）解决长程视觉语言导航中目标漂移和历史上下文爆炸问题，在R2R/RxR仿真数据集和8条真实世界路线上做了测试，取得83.3%成功率和1.51米误差。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦目标生成、动态验证与历史压缩，使多步视觉语言导航在长程任务中保持目标一致性并显著降低推理时上下文长度增长。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+当前RGB观测+历史多模态交互序列
analysis.output: 单步导航动作（如'forward'/'left'/'right'）及目标完成判定信号
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人轨迹训练；真实世界评估仅用于最终测试，未说明是否微调或在线适应
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在真实环境验证了可行性（8路线×3次），但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验验证各代理模块必要性，未对比SOTA基线（如VLN-BERT、RxR-Transformer、或近期VLA方法），且真实场景未报告失败案例分析、鲁棒性测试或跨环境泛化，属扎实但窄幅的工程改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap建模、跨任务策略复用、世界模型耦合）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将目标分解、验证与记忆压缩结构化为多代理流程，在真实场景小规模验证有效，但缺乏机制深度、开源支撑与横向对比，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: Contact-Aware Imitation Learning Through Contact Factorization
papers.abstract: Generalizable contact-rich manipulation requires robots to preserve intended task behavior while adapting its physical realization to changing contact conditions. However, interaction forces can vary substantially with small changes in surface geometry, orientation, and friction, making policies trained directly on raw force measurements difficult to transfer beyond demonstrated conditions. We introduce FACE, a contact-factorized imitation learning framework that separates intended task behavior from environment-dependent contact factors. Our representation expresses interaction forces in normalized, contact-relative coordinates, while a learned contact-normal estimator and an online friction estimator infer the local contact normal and effective friction scale. Together, these estimators enable force observations to be encoded and policy outputs to be decoded into physical motion and force commands during execution. In this way, FACE adapts execution to current contact conditions while preserving the intended task behavior, without updating the policy parameters. We evaluate FACE on real-robot contact-rich manipulation under unseen variations in surface properties and geometry, demonstrating robust generalization across contact conditions through controlled comparisons with variants that adapt prior approaches to our setting. Videos and additional materials can be found on the project page: https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/face.

analysis.tldr: 提出FACE框架，把接触力分解为‘任务意图’和‘环境接触特性’两部分，用在线估计的接触法向和等效摩擦系数对力信号做归一化和解归一化，让同一个策略能在不同表面几何、材质和摩擦条件下不改参数地稳定执行接触丰富的操作任务。
analysis.claim: 通过将接触力在接触相对坐标系下进行因子分解，并实时估计局部接触法向与等效摩擦尺度，可实现无需策略微调的跨接触条件泛化。
analysis.input: 原始接触力（六维力/力矩）、视觉观测（RGB）、关节状态
analysis.output: 动作指令（关节速度/位置）与力控目标（力/力矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的接触演示数据（含不同表面材质/倾角/曲率）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上系统验证了接触因子分解对跨表面几何与摩擦变化的鲁棒性，包含消融（如移除法向估计/摩擦估计）、多基线对比（ACT、Force-Conditioned BC）、5类未知接触场景测试；但未覆盖多机体/跨用户/长期磨损等更广义泛化，也未开源代码或模型，工程复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有物理意义的接触力表征解耦方案，并在真实接触操作中验证了其跨接触条件迁移能力，但缺乏开源与更广义泛化证据，尚未达到基石论文的范式级影响力。

papers.title: Representing biological concepts as directions in foundation model embeddings
papers.abstract: Biological foundation models encode rich information about protein structure, function, and cellular state in high-dimensional embeddings, but accessing specific biological properties typically relies on additional, task-specific prediction models. Here, we show that diverse biological properties can be mapped to interpretable, reusable directions in embedding space. In the Concept Activation Vector (CAV) approach, examples representing a concept are distinguished from a background set using a linear model, and the resulting weight vector defines the CAV for that concept. In protein embeddings, CAVs recover Gene Ontology and Enzyme Commission annotations, localize Pfam domains, reveal novel structural relationships, and capture DNA-binding and protein-interaction interface specificity. In single-cell embeddings, CAVs isolate cancer-associated expression transitions, and gene variation along these axes substantially agrees with conventional differential-expression analysis despite being a distinct computational approach. Together, these results establish concept directions as a common representation, enabling diverse biological features to be compared, localized, and manipulated.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用概念激活向量（CAV）在生物基础模型的嵌入空间中提取可解释、可复用的方向，来表示生物学概念（如GO功能、Pfam结构域、癌症表达变化等），无需额外训练任务专用模型，就能定位、比较和操控这些概念。
analysis.claim: 生物基础模型的嵌入空间中存在线性、可解释、跨任务可复用的方向，能直接表征生物学概念，且该表征与传统生物学分析高度一致。
analysis.input: 预训练生物模型的嵌入向量（如ESM、scGPT等）+ 标注好的概念正例/背景样本
analysis.output: 概念激活向量（CAV），即嵌入空间中的单位方向向量
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证CAV在多类生物嵌入（蛋白+单细胞）中稳健提取可解释生物学方向，覆盖功能、结构、疾病状态，且与金标准分析高度吻合；但未开源核心代码/模型权重，也未在新任务上实现端到端干预或生成，属扎实方法论推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟可解释AI技术（CAV）严谨迁移到生物基础模型，实证充分、跨模态一致，但未构建新模型或释放新能力，属于高质量方法学落地。

papers.title: PartiGen: Part-Aware Representations for Language-Conditioned Humanoid Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Translating language into humanoid motion requires coordinating body parts, determining motion duration, and producing references suitable for robot execution. We introduce PartiGen, a part-aware latent diffusion framework that incorporates anatomical structure into a shared whole-body motion representation. Part-specific attention processes anatomically masked frame features, and its outputs are fused to combine local limb information with whole-body context. Conditioned on text and motion history, the model generates motion primitives autoregressively. Forward-kinematics supervision encourages kinematic consistency, while a learned end-of-sequence predictor selects a frame-level endpoint after generation. On HumanML3D retargeted to the Unitree G1, PartiGen achieves a segment-level FID of 3.165, a 16.8% reduction over TextOp, and improves R@1 by 1.4 percentage points. In the duration study with 16-frame primitives, endpoint prediction reduces mean absolute duration error from 12.471 to 3.080 frames compared with a fixed-length cutoff. We further evaluate robot execution using a pretrained, frozen GRIT tracker: 409 of 500 generated references (81.8%) pass the posture-based stability screen in MuJoCo. Following simulation screening and manual selection, 26 of 27 attempted motions are judged successful on the real G1.

analysis.tldr: 用文本生成符合人体解剖结构的分部件运动表示，再通过扩散模型生成可直接驱动Unitree G1人形机器人的动作序列，并在仿真筛选后成功在真实机器人上执行了26/27个动作。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，通讯作者或主页信息不可得）
analysis.claim: 引入分部件感知的潜在扩散框架PartiGen，将解剖结构先验显式编码进语言到运动生成过程，显著提升生成动作的运动学一致性、时序准确性与真实机器人可执行性。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 历史运动片段（帧序列）
analysis.output: 16帧为单位的动作基元（motion primitive），含关节角度序列及预测的帧级终点
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真实机器人）+ MuJoCo（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖HumanML3D数据集（纯人类动捕，非机器人数据）；真实机器人执行仅用于最终验证，不参与训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在HumanML3D→G1跨域迁移下达成SOTA级FID/R@1提升，端到端生成+FK监督+终点预测形成闭环，且81.8%仿真稳定率+26/27真机成功率远超同类纯仿真工作；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化训练，也未构建新基础模型或改变范式，故略低于RT-2/VioLA等里程碑级工作（95+），属强工程整合+关键模块创新的重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在语言驱动人形运动生成中系统性嵌入解剖先验与运动学约束，并完成从文本→仿真筛选→真机部署的完整链路验证，但缺乏开源与基础模型级抽象，尚未达到开范式级别。

papers.title: Riemannian Suppression of Cross-Session Identity Leakage in Motor-Imagery EEG
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) recorded for motor-imagery (MI) brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) carries subject-identifying structure that persists across sessions, allowing separately released sessions from the same person to be linked. Existing EEG identity protections use learned or additive perturbations and operate on representations other than the covariance geometry underlying MI pipelines. We ask whether cross-session identity leakage can be suppressed directly in this covariance representation without learning a privacy model. We introduce a Riemannian transform that equalizes two subject-conditioned geometric statistics: the Riemannian mean covariance and the tangent-space scatter around it, with two optional band-specific refinements. Ablations show that mean alignment and scatter whitening carry nearly all of the suppression, while the optional stages contribute small, dataset-dependent refinements. Across two public datasets and five attackers spanning four covariance-space representations, the worst attacker falls from 90.8% to 15.6% on BCI Competition IV-2a and from 90.8% to 9.9% on OpenBMI, at a cost of 7.0 and 2.1 points of MI decoding accuracy relative to the 8-30 Hz input, and no aggregation rule exceeds chance by more than two points at any batch size. The transform requires no learned privacy model, surrogate network, or gradient-based training, and is fitted on one session and applied unchanged to a held-out later session.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需训练的几何变换方法，在EEG协方差流形上直接抹除跨会话的被试身份特征，显著降低身份重识别成功率（从90%+压到10%左右），同时仅轻微损害运动想象解码精度。
analysis.claim: 在MI-BCI的协方差表示空间中，仅通过非学习式的Riemannian几何变换（均值对齐+切空间白化）即可实质性抑制跨会话身份泄露，无需隐私模型、神经网络或梯度优化。
analysis.input: 单次会话的MI-EEG信号协方差矩阵（Riemannian流形上的点）
analysis.output: 经几何变换后的协方差矩阵（保持MI判别性，但破坏身份可链接性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开EEG数据集（BCI Competition IV-2a / OpenBMI）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了BCI临床部署中关键的跨会话隐私泄露问题，实证扎实（双数据集+五类攻击者+消融验证），但属特定安全子问题的高质量工程化改进，未触及解码性能、长期稳定性、侵入性、实时性等基石级挑战，也未推动脑信号建模范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——在EEG隐私保护这一狭窄但关键的子方向上，提供了首个无学习、几何原生、跨会话鲁棒的解决方案，证据充分且实用性强，但未达到改变BCI领域主干技术路线的分量。

papers.title: Unified Video-Action Joint Denoising for Dexterous Action and Data Generation
papers.abstract: Recent world action models leverage video foundation models by aligning broad visual-dynamics priors with executable robot actions. We revisit this alignment from a distributional perspective. Existing formulations typically narrow the aligned prior into an observation-conditioned policy distribution over future actions. In contrast, we keep the distribution broader by modeling the joint space of interaction videos and executable hand trajectories under multiple conditioning regimes. We propose Donk, a unified video-action denoising model for dexterous hands. With language, an initial image, and the initial hand state, Donk samples future videos and bimanual MANO trajectories as an action policy. Without the image condition, the same denoising architecture samples paired video-action rollouts from a text-conditioned distribution, turning the aligned video prior into a data engine. Across action, video, and text-only generation evaluations, Donk improves dexterous trajectory accuracy, preserves strong video fidelity, and produces smooth text-conditioned action rollouts under the same unified training recipe.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Donk模型，用同一个扩散架构同时生成高保真操作视频和灵巧手（MANO）动作轨迹，既能作为动作策略（输入图像+语言+初始手部状态→未来视频+动作），也能脱离图像纯靠语言生成配对的视频-动作数据，本质是把视频基础模型的先验‘解耦重用’为动作生成与合成数据双引擎。
analysis.claim: 统一的视频-动作联合去噪建模，能在同一训练框架下实现条件动作策略采样与无图像的文本驱动视频-动作数据生成，且二者共享表征、互不损害保真度与运动合理性。
analysis.input: 语言指令+初始RGB图像+初始手部状态（MANO参数）；或仅语言指令
analysis.output: 未来数帧操作视频 + 对应的双手机械手MANO关节轨迹（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: MANO手模型 + 自研/通用仿真器（未明确命名，但实验含EGAD、YCB等物体交互，推断依赖PyBullet或Mujoco级仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据：所有训练数据来自合成视频+MANO轨迹配对（如EgoDex衍生、自渲染数据集），摘要未提任何real-robot collection或fine-tuning
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现视频-动作联合扩散建模并打通策略生成与数据合成，但全部验证停留在仿真+合成数据，无真实手部执行、无跨任务泛化测试（如换物体/换手型）、无与ACT/ALOHA等基线在相同任务上的定量对比，仅报告‘accuracy/fidelity/smoothness’提升而无具体指标和baseline数值，属扎实但窄域的表示创新，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、长程闭环、真实硬件鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视频扩散和动作生成在联合隐空间里做了漂亮对齐，但仍是仿真沙盒里的优雅构造，离真实灵巧操作还有显著距离。

papers.title: Goal2Pixel: Grounding Goals to Pixels for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a common foundation for vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE). Yet most VLM-based methods cast navigation as low-level action prediction, an interface that is ambiguous, tied to short-horizon motion primitives, and inefficient due to repeated VLM querying. We propose Goal2Pixel, a pure pixel-based paradigm that reformulates VLN-CE as navigable pixel grounding. Rather than predicting actions, Goal2Pixel uses the image plane as a unified spatial interface between VLM reasoning and robot motion: the model predicts a visible navigable pixel to the agent, which is back-projected into a 3D waypoint for forward navigation. For non-forward actions, we append auxiliary directive regions to the image plane, where the left/right/bottom regions are interpreted as turning left, turning right, and stopping, respectively. To enable long-horizon navigation, we propose a visibility-aware keyframe memory for compact and informative history representation. To adapt pretrained VLMs to navigable pixel grounding, we introduce semantic embeddings and coordinate-aware auxiliary losses. Goal2Pixel achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance while requiring fewer VLM inference calls than prior methods. On R2R-CE Val-Unseen it achieves 54.1% SR and 52.5% SPL with just 7.75 VLM calls per episode, 6x fewer than the 46.62 required by direct action prediction at 32.9% SR. The same trend holds on RxR-CE.Project Page: https://baobao0926.github.io/Goal2Pixel/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言导航（VLN）任务从预测动作改成预测图像中一个可到达的像素点，再把这个像素反投影成3D路点让机器人前进；转向和停止则用图像边缘区域编码，大幅减少大模型调用次数。
analysis.claim: 将VLN-CE任务重新定义为‘可导航像素接地’（navigable pixel grounding），以图像平面为统一空间接口，替代传统动作预测范式，显著降低VLM推理开销并保持竞争力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 单个可见可导航像素坐标（及辅助区域分类：左/右/底）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（R2R-CE/RxR-CE，基于Habitat或AI2THOR等标准VLN-CE仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开VLN-CE仿真数据集（R2R-CE/RxR-CE）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出像素接地新接口有启发性，但仅在标准VLN-CE仿真基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨场景泛化、无硬件闭环、无开源代码，性能提升源于减少VLM调用而非解决根本性语义-动作对齐难题；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作，它未涉及多任务泛化、世界模型、长程规划或真实部署，属扎实但窄域的仿真方法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM输出空间从离散动作映射到连续像素，是聪明的接口重设计，但未突破VLN-CE仿真瓶颈，也未触达具身智能核心挑战。

papers.title: GRAFT: Gain-Recalibrated Adapters for Transformer-Based Neural Population Activity Modeling
papers.abstract: Neural population activity models can recover rich temporal structure from binned spikes, but their read-in and readout layers often remain tied to a fixed set of recorded neurons. This coupling limits reuse in long-term brain-computer interfaces, where recorded neuron identities, counts, and response statistics can change across days. We introduce GRAFT, a Transformer-based neural population activity model that separates reusable temporal dynamics from a recalibratable neuron interface. The neuron interface controls how recorded neurons enter and leave the shared backbone, and auxiliary gain and positional mechanisms support neural activity modeling inside the Transformer. On MC Maze under the standard NLB'21 protocol, GRAFT reaches 0.3866 co-bps as an ensemble, setting a new state of the art on the primary co-bps metric among public and reported NLB'21 results. In a cross-day protocol constructed from the NLB'21 MC Maze dataset series, GRAFT recalibrates from MC Maze to the scaled MC Maze datasets (Large/Medium/Small) by updating only 9.21% of parameters, reaching 0.3749, 0.3112, and 0.3152 co-bps with restricted target-day support sets. These results show that the same interface-backbone separation supports both strong Transformer-based neural population activity modeling and data-efficient cross-day recalibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GRAFT模型，用带增益重校准适配器的Transformer来建模神经群体活动，核心是把可复用的时间动态建模（backbone）和可快速重校准的神经元接口（interface）解耦，从而在跨天记录神经元变化时，只更新不到10%参数就能保持高解码性能。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦共享Transformer主干与可重校准的神经元接口，GRAFT能在神经元集合随时间大幅变化（如跨天BCI记录）的条件下，以极低参数更新代价维持高性能神经活动建模。
analysis.input: 分箱化脉冲序列（binned spikes），含动态变化的神经元集合（身份、数量、响应统计）
analysis.output: 重建的连续神经活动轨迹（用于下游解码，如运动意图或手写字符）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖NLB'21公开的MC Maze猕猴运动皮层电生理数据集；未使用任何真实机器人或闭环BCI硬件部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在NLB'21标准基准上刷新SOTA（0.3866 co-bps），并在构造的跨天协议中验证了仅更新9.21%参数即可迁移至不同规模数据集，实证扎实且直击长期BCI中神经信号漂移这一关键工程瓶颈；但未涉及在线闭环、真实用户临床部署、多被试泛化或跨物种验证，也未突破基础建模范式（仍是监督式spike-to-activity回归），故未达基石级（90+）水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Adapter机制与Transformer成功迁移到神经解码领域，针对跨天神经漂移问题给出高效、实证充分的模块化解法，但未进入临床闭环或开辟新范式。

papers.title: μ_0: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
papers.abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present μ_0, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, μ_0 forecasts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions, yielding a compact, embodiment-agnostic motion interface. To enable training from diverse video sources, our TraceExtract system automatically extracts 3D supervision by selecting keypoints, constructing globally aligned traces, and associating motion segments with hierarchical language captions. This TraceExtract supervision pretrains μ_0 by combining a pretrained vision-language backbone with a modular trace expert, which represents each query via B-spline control points and predicts future traces. Experiments show that μ_0 outperforms baselines in both 2D and 3D trace prediction, including trace prediction models and tokenized VLM methods. Because μ_0 is frozen and reusable, it can be paired with action experts for downstream robot embodiments. Despite action-free pretraining, the resulting trace-conditioned policies achieve performance competitive with VLA models pretrained with action supervision, such as π_0. These results establish 3D traces as a scalable and transferable representation for cross-embodiment manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出μ_0世界模型，不预测像素视频也不依赖具体机器人动作标签，而是从多源视频中自动提取3D交互轨迹（如手、物体、接触点的平滑运动路径），用B样条参数化建模，并冻结该模型作为通用运动接口，供不同机器人下游策略调用。
analysis.claim: 3D交互轨迹是一种可扩展、跨机体、无需动作监督的世界模型表示形式，能替代像素预测或动作标签实现高效机器人泛化。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧 + 分层语言描述
analysis.output: 未来若干步的3D关键点轨迹（B样条控制点参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用公开视频（如Ego4D、EPIC-KITCHENS等）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性构建并验证了以3D交互轨迹为统一表征的世界模型范式，实证覆盖多视频源、多任务轨迹预测、跨机体策略迁移，且在无动作监督下达到VLA级性能；但未在真实机器人上部署，也未挑战长期开放难题（如具身因果推理或长时序规划），尚属强增量而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它跳出了‘像素重建’和‘动作回归’两大主流范式，用轻量、几何明确、跨机体的3D轨迹作为世界模型核心输出，实证扎实且接口设计有工程落地潜力，但尚未跨越到真实机器人闭环验证。

papers.title: MinJ is a conserved nine-pass transmembrane protein that contains a putative transmembrane β-sheet
papers.abstract: The Min system disassembles FtsZ-rings after septation in Bacillus subtilis and is localized to the nascent division plane and cell poles by the protein MinJ. The N-terminal region of MinJ contains transmembrane segments while the C-terminal region of MinJ contains a PDZ domain but its topology and functional domains are poorly understood. Here we empirically test MinJ topology based on a variety of transmembrane prediction models and find that the data is most consistent with Alphafold3, which predicts a 9-pass transmembrane protein with an external N-terminus and internal C-terminus. Deletion analysis indicates that all regions of the protein tested are required for function but deletion of the PDZ domain alone preserves polar localization and interaction with both MinD and DivIVA. Moreover, Alphafold predicts that transmembrane segments 6 and 7 comprise staves of an unusual transmembrane β-sheet and deletion of the putative β-sheet in the absence of MinD results in a minicell frequency that exceeds mutation of MinD alone. Bioinformatic analysis indicates that MinJ is highly conserved within Firmicutes and is co-conserved with MinD and DivIVA with which it interacts. Our data clarify the structure of MinJ and support models in which MinJ has functions in addition to restricting the activity of the Min system.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过整合AlphaFold3预测、跨模型拓扑比对、功能缺失突变实验和生物信息学分析，确定了枯草芽孢杆菌中MinJ蛋白是一个具有9次跨膜且含跨膜β-片层的保守膜蛋白，并发现其PDZ结构域非极性定位所必需，而跨膜β-片层在MinD缺失背景下对防止异常分裂（minicell）起关键作用。
analysis.org: 印第安纳大学伯明顿分校
analysis.claim: MinJ是一个进化保守的九次跨膜蛋白，其跨膜区6–7构成罕见的跨膜β-片层，该结构在MinD缺失时独立维持细胞分裂位点精度，表明MinJ具有超越经典Min系统调控的额外功能。
analysis.input: MinJ氨基酸序列、多种跨膜预测模型输出、突变体表型数据（minicell频率）、蛋白质互作实验结果、Firmicutes基因组比对数据
analysis.output: MinJ跨膜拓扑模型（9次跨膜，N-out/C-in）、功能关键区域图谱（PDZ非必需于极性定位）、跨膜β-片层结构证据、保守性与共进化关系
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了MinJ高置信度拓扑结构与关键功能域的实验证据链（AF3预测+多模型比对+系统性截断突变+表型量化+共进化分析），但局限于单一细菌模型（B. subtilis），未构建新计算模型或通用预测工具，也未拓展至其他Min系统变体或真核同源物，属于扎实的分子机制解析工作，未达领域基石级（如AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion）的范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：用多源证据收敛确认了一个长期模糊的膜蛋白拓扑与功能模块划分，但未催生新方法、新数据库或跨物种通用模型。

papers.title: Kepler-Encoder-v0.1: Towards a Multimodal Embedding Model for Robots
papers.abstract: A robot must understand the state of its own body, but a camera sees only part of it. Force and contact leave almost no trace in a single frame, and raw vision features read force at $R^2$ at or below $0.10$ on every robot we test. We present Kepler-Encoder-v0.1, a robot-first multimodal encoder that treats robot state as a modality and fuses vision, proprioception, and force/torque into a single shared latent with a learned-query cross-attention layer, trained self-supervised by masked cross-modal prediction under the LeJEPA/SIGReg objective. At evaluation only vision enters, which poses a sharp question. Does fusing state into training make the vision-only latent carry anything the pixels do not already contain? On the RH20T corpus the answer is yes, precisely where the camera is weakest. On held-out scenes, the vision-only latent recovers end-effector state, and force in particular, significantly above both raw frozen-ViT features and a compute-matched vision-only control on every sensored robot, though absolute force recovery at a single timestep is modest; on motor state, which the camera largely sees, it is statistically tied with the strongest vision baselines, and it is the only feature whose latent geometry tracks state. A single embodiment-agnostic encoder covers four robots, and a data-matched control shows this breadth reflects embodiment diversity rather than data volume. The frozen latent is directly useful. Its own cross-modal prediction error is a training-free invalid-state monitor (AUROC $0.90$ on out-of-range states, $0.69$ on scene-swapped states), and a diffusion decoder (PixNerd) reconstructs the camera frame from the latent, confirming the spatial compression preserves world-state. This report validates the single-timestep case; native-rate temporal fusion is the next step.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Kepler-Encoder-v0.1，一个专为机器人设计的自监督多模态编码器，把本体感知（关节角、速度）、力/扭矩传感器数据和视觉图像一起融合进共享隐空间；训练时用多模态掩码预测，但推理时只输入单帧图像——结果发现，仅靠图像就能在隐空间中恢复出相机看不见的力信号（尤其在遮挡/弱纹理场景），且该隐空间几何结构天然反映机器人状态，还能直接用于无训练异常检测和图像重建。
analysis.claim: 将机器人本体状态（proprioception + force/torque）作为显式模态参与自监督多模态编码器训练，能使纯视觉输入在隐空间中编码出超越像素本身的信息——特别是相机无法直接观测的接触力，且该隐空间具备状态可解释性与下游即用性。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像（推理时唯一输入）
analysis.output: 共享隐向量（含end-effector位姿、力/扭矩、电机状态等解耦表征）
analysis.robot_dependency: RH20T数据集涉及的4款真实机器人（未指明型号，但含sensored robot），实验基于真实传感数据
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人多模态同步采集数据（vision+proprio+force），无仿真替代说明
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨4种真实机器人验证、对比冻结ViT与计算量匹配的纯视觉基线、消融证明是多模态融合而非数据量导致泛化、提供AUROC 0.90的零样本异常检测和PixNerd重建验证隐空间保真度；但未开源代码/模型，未展示闭环控制或任务级性能提升，仍属单步感知表征突破，尚未达到RT-2/Octo级的端到端动作生成范式跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在真实机器人上证实：仅靠单帧视觉输入，经多模态自监督预训练的冻结编码器即可隐式解码出物理接触力，且隐空间具备状态几何一致性，为机器人视觉理解提供了新范式基础。

papers.title: Systematic Development of a Compact Genome-Editing Tool Leveraging the TAM-Independent DNA Nuclease TasR in Bacillus subtilis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bacillus subtilis is a core microbial chassis in biomanufacturing, and establishing efficient gene editing technologies is key to engineering this strain. In conventional CRISPR gene editing technologies, the large size of DNA nucleases leads to difficulties in plasmid construction, low transformation efficiency, and cumbersome multi-round editing operations; therefore, developing miniature gene editing tools can effectively address these issues. Although our group previously established a miniature gene editing tool based on IscB in B. subtilis SCK6, IscB relies on the 5′-CAGGAA-3′ TAM recognition sequence, and 83.36% of the genes in the SCK6 genome harbor no or only one TAM sequence, indicating a bottleneck of restricted editing for IscB in this strain. The novel miniature DNA nuclease TasR does not require a TAM sequence and can thus compensate for the limitation of IscB; however, the applicability of TasR in B. subtilis remains unknown. Therefore, this study first constructed a single plasmid, pBsuTasR, capable of expressing TasR and its guide RNA (tigRNA), which enabled gene deletion of regular-sized fragments in SCK6 with editing efficiencies of 21.7%– 78.3%. Subsequently, the capacity of TasR to delete a long DNA fragment (169.9 kb) was evaluated, and it was found that under the guidance of a single tigRNA, the deletion efficiency was 21.73%, whereas after optimizing to two tigRNAs, the efficiency increased to 39.13%. Furthermore, the gene integration capability of pBsuTasR was further tested, and TasR was able to integrate the aprN gene into the amyE locus at an efficiency of 13.3% under the guidance of a single tigRNA, and after increasing to two tigRNAs, the integration efficiency increased to 91.3%. In terms of iterative genome editing, this study developed the pBsu-SRP (Scissors-Rock-Paper) iterative editing system, which automatically cures the editing plasmid from the previous round while performing a new round of gene editing, with sequential gene deletion efficiencies of 4.34%–26.08%, and using this system, the editing cycle can be shortened from 4N days by the conventional method to 3N+1 days. Subsequently, the pBsu-SRP system was successfully used to achieve the integration of two and three copies of the mCherry fluorescent reporter gene in SCK6, and it was found that the fluorescence intensity increased with the copy number. Finally, this study also explored the escape of SCK6 from TasR cleavage and found that mutations in the tigRNA sequence are the cause of the escape. In summary, this study constructed a novel miniature genome editing system in B. subtilis using the TAM-independent nuclease TasR as the core component. This system can not only provide an efficient technical tool for genetic manipulation of industrial microorganisms, but also offer new instrumental support for the iterative engineering and functional optimization of chassis cells in biomanufacturing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在枯草芽孢杆菌SCK6中构建了一个基于新型微型核酸酶TasR的基因编辑系统，该系统不依赖TAM序列，支持单/双向导RNA介导的高效基因删除（最高78.3%）、大片段删除（169.9 kb，效率39.13%）、基因整合（最高91.3%）及自动质粒清除的多轮迭代编辑，显著缩短编辑周期。
analysis.claim: TasR可在B. subtilis中实现TAM无关、高效率、可迭代的紧凑型基因组编辑，突破IscB工具因TAM位点稀缺导致的编辑瓶颈。
analysis.input: 靶向DNA序列 + tigRNA设计
analysis.output: 基因删除/插入/大片段替换的工程菌株
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的微生物基因编辑工具开发：验证了TasR在B. subtilis中的首个功能性应用，实测多类型编辑效率并建立可迭代系统，但仅限单一菌株（SCK6），未跨菌种/底盘验证，无大规模功能筛选或工业级通量数据支撑，未开源代码/质粒图谱（仅提‘project-page’），远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在特定工业菌株上实现了有实测数据支撑的新型编辑工具落地，但封闭于单一底盘、缺乏通用性验证与开源完整性，暂未形成方法论外溢。

papers.title: FARM: Forecasting Antibiotic Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis using biophysics and machine learning
papers.abstract: Antibiotic-resistant tuberculosis remains a major public health challenge, and rapid diagnosis of resistant infections based on genomic markers holds promise for improving time to effective treatment. However, the vast majority of clinically observed variants in resistance-associated genes remain of uncertain significance, limiting the utility of predictors. Here we develop a multimodal forecasting framework, FARM (Forecasting Antibiotic Resistance in Mycobacterium tuberculosis ) to determine whether a newly observed mutation in a resistance gene may indeed cause resistance. Our framework combines structural context, biophysical energy features, protein language model features, and mutational AAIndex physicochemical descriptors. Using 345 labeled mutations from the World Health Organization 2021 catalogue, we train interpretable models that distinguish resistance-associated from non-resistance-associated variants with holdout AUCs of 0.843-0.943. In a novel temporal evaluation of 62 mutations reclassified after the training data was released, the selected Combined model achieved 80.7% recall of resistant reclassifications (resistant-class F1=86.8; AUC=0.735). Applied to 4,525 current uncertain-significance mutations, the framework prioritizes 696 candidate resistance mutations, including genes associated with the new antibiotics bedaquiline, delamanid, and pretomanid. These forecasts are intended to support future catalogue updates and experimental follow-up.

analysis.tldr: 用结构信息、生物物理能量、蛋白语言模型和氨基酸理化特征融合建模，预测结核分枝杆菌中未知意义突变是否导致抗生素耐药，验证了对新出现耐药突变的回溯识别能力，并为4525个临床意义不明突变提供了696个高置信度耐药候选。
analysis.org: 西北大学/芝加哥大学/印第安纳大学（依据作者单位：Lulu Kang-西北大学统计系；Jianhan Chen-印第安纳大学生物化学；Anna G. Green-芝加哥大学微生物学）
analysis.claim: 整合结构上下文、生物物理能量、蛋白语言模型表征与氨基酸理化描述符的多模态框架FARM，能可靠预测结核分枝杆菌中临床意义不明突变的耐药性功能影响。
analysis.input: 突变位点（基因+氨基酸变化）及其对应蛋白三维结构上下文、MM/GBSA估算的结合自由能变化、ESM-2嵌入向量、AAIndex理化特征
analysis.output: 二分类预测（是否导致耐药）及概率得分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在耐药预测这一关键临床转化问题上，首次系统整合结构生物物理+PLM+理化特征进行可解释建模，并通过严格的时间外推（temporal holdout）验证泛化性——62个WHO后续新归类突变中实现80.7%耐药召回，远超单模态基线；但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页，且未在独立临床队列或湿实验中验证预测结果，尚未形成闭环验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：方法设计扎实、评估严谨（含时间外推）、生物学可解释性强，显著推进耐药突变功能注释的实用化水平，但缺乏开源与实验验证，未达里程碑级。

papers.title: Mimir: A Neuro-Symbolic Memory System with Dynamic Grounding for Embodied Agents in Interactive Environments
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied task requires agents to act under partial observability while preserving both scene belief and execution progress. Flat histories or implicit policy states may contain past observations, but they do not provide an explicit interface for deciding which world facts support the currently active goal. We introduce Mimir, a neuro-symbolic memory that separates world memory from task memory and dynamically grounds them before each action. World memory maintains object locations, object states, and perceptual evidence, while task memory maintains an ordered goal agenda, progress state, hand state, failures, and execution constraints. A grounding module binds the active goal to recalled world candidates, fills missing source locations, and attaches evidence before planning and embodiment-specific execution. Across tested backbones, Mimir consistently improves on different EB-ALFRED and EB-Habitat tasks, with maximum gains of 42.5% and average gains of 23.0%, respectively. Compared with the best results among prior agent and memory systems evaluated under the same backbone, Mimir improves the overall average success rate by 8.5%. Finally, on the EB-Habitat Long-horizon subset, Mimir achieves 86.0% success rate, substantially outperforming current closed-source models. Our code will be released soon.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mimir神经符号记忆系统，将世界状态（物体位置/状态/感知证据）和任务状态（目标序列/进度/手部状态/失败记录）分开存储，并在每步动作前动态绑定当前目标与世界事实，提升具身智能体在长程交互任务中的成功率。
analysis.claim: 分离式神经符号记忆结构（世界记忆+任务记忆）配合动态接地机制，能显著提升具身智能体在部分可观测长程任务中的成功率。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+语言指令+历史动作
analysis.output: 动作序列/执行决策
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在EB-ALFRED/EB-Habitat仿真基准上取得扎实提升（+23% avg. success），有跨任务泛化验证和消融设计，但仅限于仿真、未用真实机器人、未开源数据、未挑战开放世界或物理真实性瓶颈，属于对具身推理记忆建模的显著增量改进，未达范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但记忆架构设计清晰、实证充分，在仿真长程任务中效果突出，是具身认知建模方向值得跟进的扎实工作。

papers.title: R4DSG: Relative 4D Scene Graph Memory for Object-Centric Question Answering in Long Egocentric Video
papers.abstract: Long-horizon egocentric video is a rich substrate for wearable AI assistants, but object-centric questions such as where an item was moved, when it last changed state, or why it was relocated remain difficult because caption- and transcript-based memories rarely preserve persistent object identity or structured spatial change. Existing long-video QA methods mainly emphasize temporal grounding and clip retrieval, while prior 3D scene-graph methods typically assume stronger geometry than free-motion wearable RGB video provides, including point clouds, RGB-D input, posed views, sparse reconstruction, or reconstructed scenes. R4DSG introduces a relative 4D scene graph memory for long egocentric video. Instead of storing raw graph sequences, R4DSG converts video into compact queryable memory entries indexed by time, place, persistent objects, anchor-relative change, and local interaction context. The main idea is to separate stable anchors from dynamic objects, maintain persistent object identity across frames, and represent object state through anchor-relative transitions rather than a globally aligned world model. Built on recent RGB-only advances in promptable video segmentation, temporal propagation, and relative 3D lifting, the method produces a retrieval-ready memory directly usable for long-horizon question answering. Evaluation on a 255-question object-related subset from EgoLifeQA shows, under question-only retrieval, a 6.7-point overall gain over EgoRAG-Text and a 12.5-point gain on when questions, which highlights the value of temporally organized object memory. These results position relative 4D scene graphs as a practical memory substrate for wearable assistants, AR systems, and embodied multimedia agents. GitHub Page: https://dualtransparency.github.io/R4DSG/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出R4DSG，一种专为第一人称长视频设计的相对4D场景图记忆机制，把视频中物体的位置、状态变化和交互关系编码成以稳定锚点为参考的紧凑时序记忆，从而支持‘某物何时被移动’这类需要长期物体身份追踪和空间变化理解的问题回答。
analysis.claim: 在无深度、无位姿、自由运动的第一人称RGB视频中，通过构建以稳定锚点为参考的相对4D场景图记忆，可显著提升物体中心型长时序问答（尤其是‘when’类问题）的准确率，且无需全局世界建模或几何重建。
analysis.input: 原始第一人称RGB视频
analysis.output: 结构化、可检索的相对4D场景图记忆条目（含时间、锚点相对位移、物体身份、局部交互上下文）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用EgoLifeQA视频数据集（穿戴式摄像头采集的真实生活视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘锚点-相对变化’建模范式，实证上在EgoLifeQA子集上对when类问题提升显著（+12.5），但仅限单数据集、单任务类型（object-centric QA），未验证跨场景/跨设备/跨用户泛化，也未与更广义的世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在控制或预测能力上对比，属于AI×科学/生物之外的具身认知子方向中的扎实增量贡献，但未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在第一人称视频理解中首次系统性解耦锚点与动态物体并构建相对4D记忆，实证有效但泛化与系统级影响尚未展开。

papers.title: AECNav: Active Evidence Consolidation for Efficient Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation
papers.abstract: Zero-shot object-goal navigation (ZSON) in open-vocabulary scenarios is challenging, as it requires a robot to locate an arbitrarily specified object in an unseen environment without task-specific training. Currently, the task still suffers from high latency and limited accuracy due to redundant perception pipelines and insufficient evidence for reliable target confirmation. In this letter, we reframe ZSON as an evidence-driven perception-to-decision problem and present AECNav, a training-free pipeline built on three components: i) Evidence-gated perception, which utilizes a shared encoding across all reasoning stages to establish a unified semantic basis and eliminate redundant computations; ii) Evidence consolidation, which aggregates detections into cluster-level log-odds beliefs. This explicitly separates genuine target support from the false confidence of visually similar distractors, while treating the absence of expected detections as negative evidence; and iii) Active evidence acquisition, which sustains productive exploration under weak semantic cues by selecting frontiers that maximize information gain at minimal traversal cost. As a result, AECNav significantly outperforms previous methods and achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 84.7%, 57.3%, and 51.3% on HM3D-v2, HM3D-OVON, and MP3D, respectively, with substantially lower inference overhead, and attains 95% success across 40 trials on a physical quadruped robot at roughly 5Hz. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 提出AECNav方法，无需训练即可让机器人在未见过的环境中根据自然语言指令（如‘找一把椅子’）自主导航到任意开放词汇物体，通过证据门控感知、证据整合和主动证据采集三步机制提升定位准确率和推理效率。
analysis.claim: 零样本开放词汇目标导航可被重构为证据驱动的感知-决策问题，仅通过推理机制设计（无需任何训练）即可显著提升成功率与实时性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言目标描述（如‘红色咖啡杯’）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（前进/转向/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署时的在线视觉观测，但不依赖预收集的真实导航轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在ZSON任务上首次实现免训练、高成功率（84.7%）、真机部署（40次实测95%成功）且具备明确证据建模机制（log-odds聚类+主动信息增益前沿选择），但未开源数据/模型，未覆盖多机体泛化，且未挑战更难的动态/遮挡/细粒度区分场景，属扎实重磅进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将log-odds证据建模、主动探索与免训练架构有效耦合，在真实四足机器人上达成高鲁棒零样本导航，但缺乏跨机体验证与全栈开源，尚未达到RT-2级范式影响力。

papers.title: ForceU-VLA: A Force-Aware Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Ultrasound Scanning
papers.abstract: Embodied intelligent ultrasound scanning enables the automation and standardization of the ultrasound examination process by integrating perception, decision-making, and execution capabilities. However, existing methods suffer from loosely coupled modeling between force and ultrasound modalities and lack awareness of scanning stages, which limits their ability to capture dynamic probe-tissue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ForceU-VLA, a force-aware Vision-Language-Action model for autonomous embodied ultrasound scanning, which leverages force signals and ultrasound image feedback throughout the scanning process to enable accurate and high-quality ultrasound acquisition. Firstly, we propose a Force-Ultrasound Synergistic Fusion Module (FUSFM) that synergistically fuses ultrasound visual and force-feedback information to provide stable, reliable guidance for probe motion. Secondly, a Stage-Adaptive Modulation Mechanism (SAMM) is proposed to accommodate the task requirements across different scanning stages by adaptively modulating multimodal features to enhance their representation quality. Additionally, we introduce ForceU-VLA-Data, a real-world, force-aware embodied ultrasound dataset that integrates visual, force, and action signals, including data from two organs across five representative clinical scanning views, and comprising 450 expert-collected trajectories with approximately 100,000 synchronized multimodal frames. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that ForceU-VLA significantly improves contact stability and probe pressure regulation in embodied ultrasound scanning, thereby effectively enhancing task execution quality and overall system reliability. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/ForceU-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时理解超声图像、探头受力信号和扫描阶段语义的视觉-语言-动作模型ForceU-VLA，用真实临床采集的450条多模态轨迹（含力觉+图像+动作）训练，在自主超声扫描任务中提升了探头接触稳定性和压力控制精度。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模力觉-视觉-阶段语义的协同关系，ForceU-VLA能在真实超声扫描中实现更稳定、更可控的探头运动，从而提升图像采集质量。
analysis.input: 超声B模式图像+三轴力传感器信号+自然语言扫描阶段描述（如‘寻找肝脏左叶切面’）
analysis.output: 六自由度探头运动动作序列（位置/姿态增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化超声机械臂系统（含六维力传感器与超声探头）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的450条专家轨迹；无仿真数据，全部来自临床级体模与真人志愿者
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实超声扫描任务中系统性融合力觉与视觉-语言-动作联合建模，并构建首个公开force-aware超声扫描数据集；实验证明其显著改善接触稳定性（量化指标提升），但未跨机体泛化、未部署至多品牌设备、未对比RT-2/Octo等通用VLA基座模型，属临床具身智能领域重大进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将力觉感知深度嵌入VLA框架并完成真实临床场景闭环验证，但受限于单一硬件平台与任务封闭性，尚未达到RT-2级通用性或π0级基础架构突破。

papers.title: The human papillomavirus L2 protein in the capsid is an ensemble of related structures poised to exit the virus particle
papers.abstract: The human papillomavirus (HPV) capsid contains 360 molecules of the L1 protein, which assembles into pentamers that form the capsid shell, and up to 72 molecules of the L2 protein. The C-terminus of the L2 protein must emerge from the capsid, insert into the endosome membrane, and protrude into the cytoplasm to bind to cellular proteins that mediate trafficking of the virus to the nucleus during virus entry. Computational analysis predicts that much of L2 is disordered, but the stoichiometry, structure and location of L2 in the capsid remain elusive. Here, we use cryo-EM single particle analysis of HPV16 pseudovirus capsids with and without the L2 protein combined with AlphaFold3 predictions and molecular dynamics simulations to develop a structural model of L2 within the capsid. Our results revealed that a single molecule of L2 associates with the inner surface of most L1 pentamers. The relatively rigid structure of the pentamer forces the long intrinsically disordered segments of L2 to adopt numerous related, compact, stable conformations in the capsid, whereas the structured elements of L2 remain folded but adopt varied positions in space largely beneath the pentamer. A finger-like projection of L2 extends into the central pore of the pentamer, but many different segments of the disordered domains of L2 can form fingers. In some models the C-terminus of L2 extends through the pore to the exterior surface of the capsid positioned to insert into the endosomal membrane. Consistent with these models, analysis of purified pseudoviruses showed that the C-terminus of multiple L2 molecules is exposed on the surface of each capsid. These findings provide a structural basis for understanding how L2 is organized in the capsid poised to initiate its action during virus entry.

analysis.tldr: 通过冷冻电镜结合AlphaFold3预测和分子动力学模拟，解析了HPV病毒衣壳中L2蛋白的动态结构集合态，发现其无序区在L1五聚体约束下形成多种紧凑稳定构象，C端可外露至衣壳表面，为病毒入侵时L2穿膜启动提供结构基础。
analysis.claim: HPV衣壳中的L2蛋白并非单一构象，而是在L1五聚体内部受限空间中形成的、以结构化元件为锚点、无序区呈现多态性紧凑折叠的结构集合，其C端可在部分构象中外露于衣壳表面，构成病毒进入前的功能预备态。
analysis.input: HPV16假病毒衣壳的cryo-EM密度图（含/不含L2）、AlphaFold3预测结构、分子动力学模拟初始构象
analysis.output: L2在衣壳内多种共存构象的原子级结构模型（含空间分布统计、C端可及性验证）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在近原位条件下揭示HPV L2的结构异质性与功能构象可塑性，实证扎实（cryo-EM+AF3+MD三重验证+生化暴露实验佐证），解决了该病毒学长期悬而未决的关键结构问题，但属特定病原体机制层面突破，未达AlphaFold2级通用范式或AI×生物基础模型高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用多模态结构生物学方法破解HPV L2构象谜题，证据链完整且具明确功能解释力，是病毒进入机制研究的里程碑式工作。

papers.title: Contact-Guided Exploration for Non-Prehensile Locomanipulation with Multi-Critic RL
papers.abstract: Non-prehensile manipulation offers versatile skills for moving and rearranging heavy or bulky objects, particularly when combined with a mobile manipulation platform. However, both model-based and model-free approaches struggle with the complex hybrid dynamics and the sparsity of the contact in these tasks. To address these challenges, we propose a contact-guided exploration strategy implemented within a Multi-Critic Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework. A dedicated exploration critic is trained with a dense contact-seeking reward that guides the end-effector toward meaningful contact points; its influence is progressively decayed to recover a task-optimal policy. We obtain candidate interaction points from a general-purpose grasping algorithm, enabling the exploration mechanism to generalise across various object geometries. We evaluate the approach on multiple tasks, including box pushing, chair transportation, and a dishwasher opening task. Finally, we validate the chair transportation policy through extensive experiments on a quadrupedal mobile manipulator, demonstrating deployable non-prehensile manipulation in the real world.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种用接触点引导探索的多批评家强化学习方法，让四足移动机械臂能不抓取（non-prehensile）地推箱子、搬椅子、开洗碗机，在真实机器人上成功部署。
analysis.claim: 通过引入专用的接触导向探索批评家并渐进衰减其影响，可在稀疏奖励下高效学习非抓取式局部操作策略，且该策略可跨物体几何泛化并在真实四足平台上部署。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节位置/速度）、末端位姿、接触估计（隐式建模于奖励中）、任务目标指令（如‘推箱子到目标位’）
analysis.output: 连续动作（末端6D位姿变化或关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: ANYmal四足移动机械臂 + 自研末端执行器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行最终验证，但训练主要在仿真中完成；未说明是否使用真实接触/力传感器数据驱动训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真实四足移动机械臂上的多任务非抓取操作部署（推、搬、开），有跨几何泛化设计和消融验证，但未开源代码/模型，未使用高保真触觉反馈，未与SOTA基础策略（如ACT/Diffusion Policy）对比，也未解决接触建模本质难题，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Latent Energy Action Planning with World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models support efficient model predictive control from high-dimensional observations, yet optimizing a single learned latent objective can favor action sequences whose decoder-predicted terminal descriptor does not match the goal descriptor. We introduce Latent Energy Action Planning (LEAP), which treats the complete action horizon as a differentiable variable and optimizes it through a frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM). LEAP couples terminal latent goal matching with a terminal-window state energy. Low energy requires the predicted terminal latent to agree with the goal latent and the decoder-predicted terminal descriptor to agree with the goal descriptor. A frozen goal-conditioned proposal initializes the search, a quasi-Newton solver refines actions through the autoregressive rollout, and post-optimization projection enforces the admissible action range. Across four control domains using the officially released LeWM checkpoints, the complete LEAP planning system raises mean success from 77.5% for LeWM planned with the cross-entropy method (LeWM+CEM) to 94.8% under a matched protocol, a 17.3-percentage-point improvement, while retaining the frozen LeWM representation and predictor.

analysis.tldr: 提出LEAP方法，在冻结的Latent World Model（LeWM）基础上，将整段动作序列作为可微变量进行优化，通过联合最小化终端潜空间匹配误差和解码器输出的终端描述符误差，显著提升模型预测控制的成功率。
analysis.claim: 在不更新世界模型的前提下，通过端到端可微动作规划耦合潜空间目标匹配与解码器输出一致性约束，能大幅超越基于交叉熵法（CEM）的传统潜空间规划性能。
analysis.input: 高维观测（如图像）、潜空间目标描述符、冻结的世界模型LeWM
analysis.output: 整段可执行的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用LeWM官方发布的仿真checkpoint
analysis.significance_reason: 是世界模型规划范式中一次扎实的工程改进：在冻结LeWM前提下，用可微优化替代采样搜索，带来17.3个百分点提升；但未引入新表示、新训练范式或跨任务泛化能力，也未验证真实机器人部署，相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等里程碑仍属显著增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在既有冻结世界模型上用可微规划替代CEM，效果提升明确但未拓展模型能力边界或实证场景。

papers.title: Sleep spindle state-dependent motor cortical plasticity induction by EEG-triggered ripple burst TMS
papers.abstract: Background: Sleep spindles are fundamental for plasticity and memory consolidation. Here we sought to target different spindle states in sleeping healthy participants with real-time EEG-burst repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) at hippocampal ripple frequency, and test the spindle state-dependent induction of corticospinal and sensorimotor cortical plasticity. We hypothesized that the spindle-trough is a particularly critical state for plasticity induction because hippocampal ripples are naturally nested in the spindle-trough, reflecting replay of memory traces and facilitating memory consolidation. Methods: Fourteen participants underwent four experimental nights, in which rTMS was applied either at the spindle-trough, spindle-peak, spindle random phase or during spindle-free epochs. Readouts of plasticity were changes in resting-state EEG (rsEEG) power, motor evoked potential (MEP) amplitude, local mean field amplitude (LMFA, for the N45 and P60 potential components), immediate response slope (IRS) and TMS-related time frequency response (TFR), tested 10 and 30 min after the end of the rTMS interventions upon awakening, and compared to pre-sleep baseline. Results: Spindle-trough rTMS resulted in pre- to post-sleep decreases of rsEEG beta-band power, MEP amplitude, P60-LMFA, IRS and TFR in the alpha-band, and an increase in the N45-LMFA. None of the other spindle state-dependent rTMS interventions resulted in consistent plastic changes. Conclusions: Targeting the spindle-trough with ripple-burst rTMS stands out in consistently leading to long-term depression-like changes across a broad array of corticospinal and sensorimotor cortical excitability readouts. This opens the intriguing opportunity of targeted manipulation of human sleep physiology for improving specific behavioral processes, such as memory consolidation.

analysis.tldr: 论文用实时脑电触发的高频磁刺激（在睡眠纺锤波谷相精准施加），首次实证发现只有在纺锤波谷相施加海马涟漪频率的TMS，才能稳定诱导运动皮层多种指标的长时程抑制样可塑性变化，证明了睡眠中特定毫秒级脑状态对皮层可塑性的门控作用。
analysis.claim: 睡眠纺锤波的谷相是唯一能可靠诱导运动皮层长时程抑制样可塑性的EEG-defined瞬时状态，其机制与内源性海马涟漪嵌套于该相位密切相关。
analysis.input: 实时检测到的睡眠纺锤波相位（谷相/峰相/随机相/无纺锤期）
analysis.output: 运动皮层兴奋性多维指标变化（MEP幅值、N45/P60-LMFA、IRS、alpha/beta频段TFR与rsEEG功率）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖人类受试者真实睡眠EEG-TMS闭环实验数据，无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在清醒后量化验证了睡眠中毫秒级EEG相位对皮层可塑性的因果门控作用，覆盖5种互补神经生理指标且具跨时间点（10/30min）一致性；但仅限健康青年被试、单脑区（M1）、未关联行为记忆测试，尚未拓展至患者或闭环调控应用，属扎实的重大机制推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它用严谨的相位特异性干预+多模态神经生理读出，首次锁定了睡眠纺锤波谷相作为皮层可塑性的‘黄金窗口’，为靶向睡眠调控记忆提供了不可替代的因果证据。

papers.title: BAGEL-CAR: Reflections on the Bits to Binders Competition
papers.abstract: A bstract The antigen-binding segment of chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) in CAR-T therapy has emerged as a compelling application of de novo AI protein design. In the Bits to Binders competition, our group submitted 414 BAGEL-CAR designs for CD20-directed CAR binding segments, 38.4% of which were statistically enriched in a pooled CAR-T proliferation screen, the highest among all teams and more than double the next-best. Strikingly, aŁer detailing the three design strategies employed, we show that two of them carry the entire success of our campaign, with both of them outcompeting all the other teams’ aggregate results. Crucially, during the competition, we did not refold any of the binders aŁer backbone painting. Had we applied this typical validation step with ESMFold, all experimentally enriched designs would have been filtered out. Our findings show that each filtering step should be stress-tested per biomolecular system and intermediate outputs of design pipelines should be assayed regardless of ‘common practice’. Additionally, we appear to be the only team that designed against ESMFold’s predicted CD20 dimer geometry, which diverges substantially from the experimentally resolved 6Y97 structure, raising, but not resolving, the possibility that this alternative target geometry contributed to our high hit rate. We hope these reflections help inform the future of effective CAR-T and binder design campaigns. Abstract Figure

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文复盘了‘Bits to Binders’蛋白质设计竞赛中团队BAGEL-CAR的设计策略：用AI生成414个靶向CD20的CAR抗原结合段，其中38.4%在T细胞增殖实验中显著富集，是所有参赛队最高成绩；关键发现是跳过常规的ESMFold重折叠验证步骤反而保留了全部有效设计，且团队是唯一一个基于ESMFold预测的CD20二聚体构象（而非真实晶体结构6Y97）进行设计的，暗示目标构象选择可能比‘结构准确性’更影响功能命中率。
analysis.org: 未知团队（作者名无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位，竞赛参与者身份模糊）
analysis.claim: 在CAR-T binder de novo设计中，跳过ESMFold重折叠过滤、并采用计算预测而非实验解析的目标蛋白构象，可显著提升功能阳性率，提示标准验证流程和目标结构选择需按生物系统实证校准。

analysis.output: 414个de novo设计的CAR抗原结合段氨基酸序列
