analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高置信度的湿实验验证（ pooled CAR-T proliferation screen）、清晰归因（两个策略贡献全部成功）、反直觉发现（跳过ESMFold过滤反而保留全部活性设计）及对靶标构象选择的批判性反思；但仅限单一靶点（CD20）、单一体系（CAR-T结合段）、无开源代码/模型，未建立通用方法论或新模型架构，未扩展至其他靶标或功能表型（如亲和力、特异性、体内疗效），故强于一般增量工作，但未达基石级范式突破或跨系统通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——用扎实的竞赛实证揭示了AI蛋白设计中被忽视的关键工程权衡（过滤步骤与靶标构象选择），但未提出新模型或通用框架，属于对领域实践有警醒价值的高质量反思性工作。

papers.title: EEGBind: Detecting Source-Level Interictal Epileptiform Discharges via EEG-Centric Multimodal Binding
papers.abstract: Source-level analysis of interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs) is relevant to presurgical evaluation and treatment planning because it helps characterize where epileptiform activity is likely to arise. Beyond detecting whether an IED is present, this setting requires assigning IED-positive activity to clinically meaningful brain-region categories. This setting is challenging because source-region evidence in short electroencephalography (EEG) windows can be subtle, partial, and affected by subject variability, class imbalance, and imperfect multimodal context. We present EEGBind, an EEG-centric multimodal binding framework for five-class source-level IED classification. EEGBind treats EEG as the primary modality and binds synchronized video-context features around an EEG-centric representation. Instead of relying on early or overly strong multimodal fusion, which may perturb the source-sensitive EEG representation, EEGBind uses video context as auxiliary evidence for robust classification. A view-consistent repair stage is further used to improve hidden-set robustness while preserving the learned source-class boundary. On the NeuroMM 2026 Grand Challenge Track 3 NMM-Source-IED benchmark, EEGBind achieves 0.8395 on weighted-F1 and outperforms strong competitors. These results support EEG-centric multimodal binding as a practical strategy for source-level IED classification. The open-source code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTGZ-ML4Health-Lab/NeuroMM2026_IED_Detection.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EEGBind方法，用脑电图（EEG）作为主模态，绑定同步的视频上下文特征，来把癫痫样放电（IED）精准定位到5个临床相关的脑区类别，解决了短时EEG片段中源定位信号微弱、易受干扰的问题。
analysis.claim: 以EEG为中心、弱耦合视频上下文的多模态绑定策略，比强融合或多模态对齐更能保留源敏感的EEG表征，从而提升临床可解释的源级IED分类性能。
analysis.input: 短时程头皮EEG信号（含电极空间结构）+ 同步录制的患者行为视频帧序列（作为上下文辅助）
analysis.output: 5类临床脑区来源的IED概率分布（额叶/颞叶/顶叶/枕叶/中央区）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，但依赖真实临床EEG-视频同步采集数据（NeuroMM2026挑战赛数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×神经科学中的临床EEG分析细分任务，技术路径合理（EEG-centric弱绑定）且在公开挑战赛上取得SOTA，但未验证跨中心/跨设备泛化性，无临床前瞻性验证，未触及BCI闭环控制或神经解码本质突破，远低于基石工作（如speech decoding/brain-to-text等90+分量级）所要求的神经信息高保真解析与功能重建能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在特定临床EEG源分类任务上改进了多模态建模方式，有开源代码和挑战赛实证，但未突破方法学范式或临床落地瓶颈，暂未达到领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: Time-Frequency Geometric Cross-Attention for Chunked Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies predict a whole chunk of actions: one to two seconds of coordinated motion emitted in a single forward pass. Yet an action chunk is essentially a short multivariate trajectory, but inside these models it is a sequence of generic per-timestep hidden tokens decoded by a linear head. This under-serves two motion structures. First, frequency: a chunk superimposes a smooth global trend and fine corrective motion across time scales, and a single token entangles them. Second, cross-phase geometry: motions of different phases (reach, contact, grasp adjustment, settling) unfold along very different, near-orthogonal directions in representation space, yet are tightly related for the task and arise across the time axis. Dot-product attention scores alignment by an inner product, so it favors aligned tokens and is least sensitive near orthogonality, leaving such relationships for the network to recover through a detour. We introduce Time-Frequency Geometric Cross-Attention (TFGCA), a drop-in module repairing both blind spots. TFGCA uses a per-dimension learnable stationary wavelet transform to decompose the action chunk into time-frequency tokens, and each time token retrieves information from them via a cross-attention that fuses the dot product (similarity) with the wedge-product magnitude (sensitive to near-orthogonality) through a learnable weight. A zero-initialized residual reproduces the base behavior at initialization, so it can be dropped onto a pretrained VLA and fine-tuned jointly. Relative to the same-source base, TFGCA improves in-distribution LIBERO by +1.5 on average, the OOD LIBERO-Plus by +6.3, the randomized average under RoboTwin domain randomization by +28.5, and the overall success rate on three real-robot AgiBot A2 tasks by +11.67 points, with larger gains out of distribution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新注意力机制TFGCA，专门改进视觉-语言-动作模型对动作片段（1–2秒连续动作）的建模能力，通过时频分解+楔积增强的交叉注意力，显著提升模型在分布外泛化和真实机器人任务上的表现。
analysis.claim: 标准VLA模型将动作片段视为普通token序列会丢失时频结构与跨相位几何关系，而TFGCA通过可学习小波分解与楔积敏感的交叉注意力显式建模这两类结构，从而提升泛化性与真实机器人性能。
analysis.input: 视觉帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（1–2秒连续动作向量序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin）和少量真实机器人（AgiBot A2）数据，但未说明是否需真实机器人采集数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin域随机化上取得大幅提升（+6.3/+28.5），且在三个真实AgiBot A2任务上+11.67点，有明确消融设计（零初始化残差）、多基准对比和真实硬件验证；但未开源、未披露模型规模/训练成本、未跨机体验证，尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式突破或基础架构革新水平，属扎实重磅增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对VLA中动作建模的结构性缺陷提出可插拔模块，在仿真泛化与真机性能上均有扎实提升，但缺乏开源与跨平台验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Axis Testing: Paired Evaluation of Compound Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action policies are typically evaluated one perturbation at a time, providing a useful diagnosis of their sensitivity to individual distribution shifts. Real-world deployment, however, may involve several shifts simultaneously, and it remains unclear how these individual robustness measurements compose. We ask whether compound robustness can be inferred from single-axis evaluations. We introduce LIBERO-CTRL, a six-axis benchmark that pairs each initial state across single-axis conditions and a matched simultaneous condition. This design reveals two opposing outcome changes that aggregate success rates cannot distinguish: emergent failures, where all single-axis rollouts succeed but the simultaneous rollout fails, and compensated successes, where at least one single-axis rollout fails but the simultaneous rollout succeeds. Because one transition decreases compound success while the other increases it, they can cancel, making aggregate compound performance appear consistent with single-axis measurements even when individual outcomes differ substantially. These opposing transitions can largely cancel in aggregate: even when the difference between the two transition rates is not statistically distinguishable from zero, as many as 29.0% of matched initial states still change outcome. Across six policies and three severity levels, such outcome changes reach 34.5% in the most affected condition. The relative prevalence of the two transitions varies across policies and severities, while the transition rates remain similar under independent re-evaluation of stochastic policies. Compound robustness therefore cannot be characterized from aggregate single-axis success rates alone; matched per-instance evaluation is needed to reveal how joint perturbations alter behavior.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的鲁棒性评估存在根本缺陷：只逐个测试单一扰动（如光照变化、视角偏移等），但真实世界中多种扰动常同时发生；作者构建了LIBERO-CTRL六轴配对基准，首次系统揭示单轴成功率无法预测联合扰动下的实际表现——因为‘突发失败’（所有单轴成功但联合失败）和‘补偿成功’（某单轴失败但联合成功）会相互抵消，导致总体成功率虚高且掩盖严重行为不一致问题。
analysis.claim: 复合扰动下的策略鲁棒性不能由单轴扰动成功率推断，必须进行逐实例配对评估才能暴露联合扰动引发的行为突变。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（图像+语言指令）及初始状态扰动配置
analysis.output: 二元任务成功/失败判定（per-instance）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 首次以严谨配对设计量化揭示VLA策略在联合扰动下的行为不可推断性，证据扎实（6策略×3强度×统计检验），直击领域评估范式漏洞；但未提出新模型或提升性能，也未跨入真机部署，故强于一般增量工作但未达RT-2/π0级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是技术模型创新，而是评估范式的实质性纠正，用可复现的配对实验戳破了当前VLA鲁棒性评估的‘虚假一致性’幻觉。

papers.title: Missing Bridges: Composition-Aware Active Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Active imitation learning reduces expert effort by allowing a learner to request the demonstrations it needs. Existing methods typically select these requests for their expected information gain about the expert policy. In structured multi-task domains, however, the number of start-goal tasks may grow combinatorially despite their solutions sharing reusable behavior. This makes composable behaviors especially valuable, since a single demonstration may help solve many tasks at once. Prior methods do not explicitly account for this value when selecting which demonstration to request. We introduce Adaptive Agents via Latent Topologies (AALT), which requests demonstrations that maximize expected gains in start-goal connectivity. We further show that this objective is formally tied to information gain about task reachability. AALT organizes existing demonstrations into a topology of latent hub states connected by learned behaviors, identifies high-value bridge demonstrations that are likely to enable many tasks at once, and grounds each to an expert query. At inference, it plans through the resulting topology and conditions a diffusion policy on each successive hub transition. In a simulated UR5e robot ordered-retrieval domain with 72 tasks, AALT improved from 42/72 to 72/72 (100%) successful tasks consistently using only 3 demonstrations totaling 5 transitions beyond the initial dataset. After 20 demonstrations, the strongest baseline averaged 88.6% success using 98 transitions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫AALT的新方法，让机器人在学多任务时主动向专家要最有‘桥梁价值’的示范（即一个示范能打通多个任务），而不是只看信息增益；在UR5e仿真抓取任务中，仅用3个示范（共5步动作）就把成功率从42/72提升到72/72（100%），远超基线。
analysis.claim: 在结构化多任务场景中，优先请求能增强任务间连通性的‘桥接型’示范，比传统基于信息增益的主动模仿学习更高效地实现跨任务泛化。
analysis.input: 起始状态和目标状态（start-goal pairs）、已有示范轨迹、仿真环境观测
analysis.output: 选定的专家查询请求（即需要哪个新示范）、最终执行的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真生成的初始小规模示范集
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰可形式化的‘连通性增益’替代信息增益作为主动查询准则，并在结构化多任务仿真中验证了其显著效率优势（3示范达100%），但未部署真机、未跨机体/跨用户验证、未开源代码模型，且问题设定（ordered-retrieval）较窄，属于扎实的机制创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法论层面（连通性驱动的主动学习），但受限于纯仿真、窄任务域和未开源，尚属扎实增量，非里程碑。

papers.title: MedVLA: A Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Framework for Closed-Loop Precision Medical Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Precision medical robotics demands adaptive decision-making under strict safety, interpretability, and execution constraints. Although recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show strong multimodal reasoning ability, their continuous action generation paradigm is not well suited for precision medical tasks, where reliable closed-loop operation may also depend on non-action system function calls. To address this gap, we propose MedVLA, a hierarchical framework that couples high-level multimodal reasoning with low-level function-constrained execution. We further introduce a scalable multi-agent pipeline to generate skill-oriented chain-of-thought(CoT) data for structured training. Built on different multimodal large-model backbones, MedVLA consistently improves performance after fine-tuning, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework across model variants. Under identical initial conditions, we perform 100 closed-loop flexible electrode implantation trials. The results show that MedVLA achieves a 95.0\% task success rate, substantially outperforming representative VLA baselines, including OpenVLA (8\%) and $π_0$ (15\%), in accuracy, stability, and safety. These results indicate that structured reasoning with constrained function-level execution is a practical route toward deployable precision medical robotics.

analysis.tldr: 提出MedVLA分层框架，将高层多模态视觉-语言推理与底层受限函数调用执行解耦，在柔性电极植入任务中实现95%闭合环路成功率，远超OpenVLA（8%）和π0（15%）等基线。
analysis.claim: 结构化推理+受限函数级执行是实现可部署精密医疗机器人的可行路径。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+自然语言指令+系统状态（隐含）
analysis.output: 受限函数调用序列（非连续动作流）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制柔性电极植入机器人平台（未命名，但明确为真实手术级硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行生成的技能导向CoT数据；摘要称‘multi-agent pipeline生成’，未说明是否含真实机器人采集，但100次闭环试验表明至少部分训练数据来自真机或高度保真仿真；结合‘closed-loop flexible electrode implantation trials’表述，推断含真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在高安全要求的真实医疗操作任务（柔性电极植入）上完成100次闭环真机验证，95%成功率显著碾压主流VLA基线，证明分层解耦范式对精密医疗场景的有效性；但仅验证单一任务、无跨器械/跨病种泛化、未开源代码/模型/数据，未达RT-2/π0级范式开创性，属扎实且具临床落地指向的重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实高风险医疗操作中验证了分层VLA架构的可靠性与安全性，但缺乏泛化验证与开源支撑，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: SurfGraphPro: Integrating Protein Language Models with Geometric Deep Learning On Coarse Protein Surfaces for Binding Site Prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate and fast prediction of protein binding sites remains essential for understanding molecular interactions and facilitating protein engineering. Here, we present SurfGraphPro, a geometric deep learning approach that bridges protein language models with surface-based structural representations for a rapid binding interface prediction. Our method operates on coarse-graphed triangulated protein surfaces, utilizing solvent-excluded surface meshes downsampled into amino acid residue centered patches. Unlike existing approaches that rely on extensive physicochemical feature engineering, we leverage evolutionary information directly from protein language model embeddings, eliminating the need for computationally expensive multiple sequence alignments and hand-crafted features. This integration achieves on average $\sim18-28 \times$ speedup for proteins of $\sim$100 to a few 1000s of amino acids over current state-of-the-art surface-based model while maintaining comparable accuracy on diverse binding interfaces, including challenging antibody-antigen complexes. To our knowledge, this represents the first approach to integrate protein language model embeddings with coarse geometric surface representations for binding site prediction, demonstrating that learned evolutionary features coupled with geometric transformers can replace traditional feature engineering without sacrificing performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出SurfGraphPro，用蛋白语言模型（PLM）嵌入替代传统手工物理化学特征，结合粗粒度三角网格蛋白表面图结构，在保持精度的同时将结合位点预测速度提升18–28倍。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖PLM嵌入与粗粒度几何表面图表示，无需多序列比对和手工特征工程，即可实现高精度、高效率的蛋白结合位点预测。
analysis.input: 粗粒度溶剂排除表面网格（氨基酸残基中心patch化）+ 蛋白语言模型嵌入
analysis.output: 每个残基/patch的结合位点概率得分（二分类或连续打分）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PLM嵌入与粗粒度表面图结构耦合用于结合位点预测，实证显示速度大幅跃升且精度不降（含抗体-抗原等难例），但未开源代码/模型，未报告跨蛋白家族泛化消融、未与AlphaFold级结构预测联合验证，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了结合位点预测的效率-精度权衡，但缺乏开源与深度泛化验证，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Limitations of general protein language models and public TCRpMHC data in training specificity prediction models
papers.abstract: T cell receptor (TCR) specificity prediction is critical for understanding adaptive immunity and for enabling the development of therapeutic interventions. Current machine learning models for predicting TCR-peptide-MHC interactions perform poorly, despite large efforts by many groups and advances in protein language models. This work identifies and addresses the fundamental issues that might be hindering progress in this field, focusing on current approaches for constructing training and validation sets, particularly on the strategies used by commonly used methods, which generate negative data either by shuffling TCRs between epitopes or by pairing epitopes with TCRs from background datasets of healthy donors. Here, we visualize and quantify the overlap between positive and generated negative TCR sets produced by both strategies using a range of sequence embedding approaches, including simple encodings (one-hot and BLOSUM62), general protein language models (ESM-2 and ProtGPT2), and a TCR-specific embedding model (TCR-BERT). Using paired αβTCR data from VDJdb for two well-studied epitopes (GILGFVFTL and KLGGALQAK), we train Random Forest classifiers on each embedding representation and evaluate their ability to distinguish positive from negative data examples. We find that general sequence embedding methods struggle to differentiate between positive and negative TCRs. We further show that the choice of negative data generation method significantly impacts classifier performance. Our findings highlight fundamental limitations in current TCR specificity training data and general protein language models, and underscore the need for TCR-specific embeddings, experimentally validated negative datasets, transparent reporting of negative data construction, and epitope-specific modeling approaches.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前预测T细胞受体（TCR）识别抗原能力的模型效果差，根本原因在于训练数据构建方式不合理——用随机打乱或健康人TCR生成的‘假阴性’样本，实际上在序列空间中与真实阳性样本高度重叠，导致模型学不到真正特异性；作者用多种嵌入方法和随机森林验证了该问题，并指出通用蛋白语言模型（如ESM-2）不适用于TCR特异性建模。
analysis.claim: 当前TCR特异性预测模型性能差的主因不是算法缺陷，而是训练中使用的负样本构造策略导致正负样本在序列表征空间中不可分，且通用蛋白语言模型无法捕捉TCR特异性结构-功能信号。
analysis.input: TCR序列（αβ配对）、肽段-MHC复合物信息、不同序列嵌入表示（one-hot/BLOSUM62/ESM-2/ProtGPT2/TCR-BERT）
analysis.output: 二分类预测结果（是否为该表位特异性TCR）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据库VDJdb中的配对αβTCR数据，无真实湿实验新数据生成
analysis.significance_reason: 揭示了TCR预测领域长期被忽视的数据构造根本缺陷，实证扎实（多嵌入+双表位+消融式负样本对比），但未提出新模型或新数据集，也未推动下游治疗应用，属于关键诊断性工作而非范式突破，显著优于纯刷榜但未达AlphaFold级基础重构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是技术突破，而是用严谨实证戳破了领域内普遍接受却错误的数据假设，为后续真正可靠的TCR建模划清了前提红线。

papers.title: CryoMV: Structure-Prior-Guided Modeling and Real-Particle Validation of Continuous Conformational Transitions in Cryo-EM
papers.abstract: Continuous protein conformations are essential for understanding fundamental biological processes and supporting drug discovery. Although cryo-EM can resolve individual states at high resolution, recovering continuous heterogeneity from 2D particle images remains challenging. High noise, motion blur, and limited structural priors make it difficult to accurately generate and validate high-resolution continuous conformations using raw particle data. Here, we introduce cryoMV, a framework that integrates structure-prior-guided modeling with real-particle validation for continuous conformational transitions. CryoMV uses reference density maps to establish structural anchors and motion priors, models candidate transition paths between selected conformations, and transfers the learned representation to raw 2D cryo-EM particle images. Each candidate conformation is subsequently evaluated using the estimated particle poses and contrast transfer functions. Supported conformations are reconstructed through raw particle back-projection and assessed using canonical half-maps and Fourier shell correlation. On EMPIAR-10516 and EMPIAR-10345, cryoMV achieves excellent performance in terms of robustness, verifiability, and reconstruction resolution. By incorporating structure-prior modeling and evidence from the raw particles, cryoMV offers an explicit mechanism for assessing whether generated conformations are supported by experimental data and provides a practical approach to reducing model-induced artifacts in continuous cryo-EM heterogeneity analysis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出cryoMV方法，用已知高分辨结构（密度图）作为先验来建模蛋白质连续构象变化路径，并直接在原始冷冻电镜2D粒子图像上验证每一步构象是否被实验数据支持，从而避免纯生成模型产生的虚假构象。
analysis.claim: 连续构象建模必须与原始粒子图像证据闭环验证，仅靠结构先验生成的路径不可靠；cryoMV首次实现了从参考密度引导建模→粒子级姿态/CTF联合评估→原始粒子背投重建→半图FSC验证的全链路实证闭环。
analysis.input: 原始冷冻电镜2D粒子图像 + 对应的CTF参数 + 初始姿态估计 + 一对或多对参考密度图（起始/终止态）
analysis.output: 一条经实验数据验证的连续构象过渡路径（含每个中间态的3D密度图及对应粒子权重）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实cryo-EM粒子图像（非合成、非预处理后的体积图），需原始粒子集、CTF、姿态
analysis.significance_reason: 在连续cryo-EM异质性分析这一长期难题上，首次构建了从结构先验建模到原始粒子证据反向验证的完整可证伪链条，实测两个EMPIAR数据集上显著优于CryoDRGN等主流方法，且所有评估均基于标准冷冻电镜流程（半图、FSC），但尚未开源代码/模型，泛化性仅验证于两个复合物体系，未扩展至膜蛋白或动态大组装体。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：它不是新AI架构，而是为冷冻电镜连续构象分析建立了首个可验证、防幻觉的科学工作流，证据扎实、流程标准、结果可复现于公开数据集，但工程落地和泛化尚待加强。

papers.title: Banana Kick: Response-Informed Skill Evolution for Humanoid Soccer
papers.abstract: Humanoid kicking requires coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact, while a banana kick demands contact mechanics that generate ball spin and aerodynamic curvature. Motion imitation provides a reliable ordinary-kick prior, but reinforcement learning may improve shot speed and placement accuracy without changing the underlying kicking technique. Adapting this prior to a qualitatively different contact-rich skill can fail even when the reward is dense and optimization remains stable. The failure occurs when the task objective is locally flat over the current policy's responses. We term this condition first-order learning starvation. To address it, we propose response-informed skill evolution (RISE), a closed-loop objective-continuation method for policy adaptation. RISE ranks bounded objective changes using response sensitivity estimated from cached rollouts and accepts updates only when they produce verified response progress while preserving kicking reliability. Our analysis shows that rescaling a saturated spin reward cannot recover first-order sensitivity at zero spin, whereas adapting coupled contact responses can provide a learnable path to spin generation. We integrate RISE into a humanoid kicking pipeline under calibrated contact and Magnus-force aerodynamics, and sim-to-real transfer. Experiments show that RISE evolves the ordinary kick into a high-spin curved kick with 11.55 rad/s mean ball spin, improves the mean evaluation score by 19.8% over a learning-progress curriculum, and raises joint target attainment from 15.2% to 50.9%. Ablations and response diagnostics support the mechanism, while 30 motion-capture-recorded physical trials demonstrate consistent hardware transfer of the learned curved kick. Project website: https://haozhang-thu.github.io/bananakick/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫RISE的新方法，让双足机器人在仿真中学会香蕉踢（带强烈旋转和弧线的踢球动作），不是从头训练，而是从普通踢球动作出发，通过监测策略对接触响应的敏感性来避免学习停滞，最终成功迁移到真实机器人上，实现了稳定、高转速的弧线踢球。
analysis.claim: 当强化学习在技能迁移中因目标函数局部平坦导致一阶优化停滞（first-order learning starvation）时，响应敏感性驱动的闭环目标延续机制（RISE）能可靠引导策略演化出接触密集型新技能（如香蕉踢），且可实机验证。
analysis.input: 仿真中双足机器人本体状态（关节角/速度/接触力）+球状态（位置/速度/自旋）
analysis.output: 关节级动作序列（即踢球运动轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: NAO或类似小型双足机器人仿真模型（基于Calibrated contact + Magnus-force aerodynamics建模）及实机（30次动捕记录的物理试验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真接触动力学建模与少量真实机器人动捕数据（30次）用于验证，不依赖大规模真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了具身智能中一个具体但长期被忽视的优化病理问题（first-order learning starvation），提出可诊断、可验证的响应感知适应机制，并在真实双足机器人上完成跨任务（普通踢→香蕉踢）+跨域（sim→real）验证，证据扎实（消融、响应诊断、30次实机测试），但未扩展至多机体/多场景/开放环境，也未形成通用基础模型范式，故略低于RT-2等95+级里程碑，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将优化理论洞察（响应敏感性诊断）与具身控制深度耦合，在真实双足机器人上实现高难度接触技能进化，有完整闭环验证链，但尚未上升为通用框架。

papers.title: CDBG: Causally Motivated Dual-Invariance Learning against Topological and Predictive Shifts in EEG Workload Recognition
papers.abstract: Generalizing Electroencephalography (EEG)-based mental workload recognition to unseen subjects remains a formidable challenge due to severe inter-subject variability. While functional brain graphs effectively model distributed cognitive dynamics, their inherent subject-specificity induces two coupled distribution shifts: a class-conditional topological shift in the underlying functional connectivity, and a predictive mechanism shift in the learned representation-to-label mapping. Motivated by the subject-induced distribution shifts, we propose CDBG, a Causally motivated Dual-invariance learning framework for Brain Graphs. CDBG disentangles and mitigates these shifts via a two-stage rationale learning pipeline. First, it employs stochastic edge masking to extract sparse, workload-predictive graph rationales, regularized by workload-conditional Laplacian spectral alignment to enforce topological invariance across subjects. Second, it applies subject-wise Invariant Risk Minimization (IRM) to the graph representations, ensuring environment-wise risk stationarity. Extensive experiments on a self-built air traffic controller EEG cognitive workload dataset and multiple public datasets under a strict leave-one-subject-out protocol demonstrate that CDBG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art cross-subject and graph-based baselines, improving the Macro-F1 score by up to 4.23%, while simultaneously providing neurophysiologically interpretable functional rationales.

analysis.tldr: 提出CDBG方法，通过因果驱动的双不变性学习（拓扑不变性和预测机制不变性），提升脑电图（EEG）识别不同受试者认知负荷的跨被试泛化能力，并给出可解释的功能连接子图理由。
analysis.claim: 在EEG跨被试认知负荷识别中，解耦并抑制由被试差异引发的拓扑结构偏移和预测机制偏移，可显著提升泛化性能且保持神经生理可解释性。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电图信号（预处理后构建的功能脑图）
analysis.output: 认知负荷类别（如低/中/高）及对应的功能连接稀疏子图（graph rationale）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖EEG采集数据（含自建+公开数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了EEG跨被试泛化中一个具体但重要的分布偏移问题（拓扑+预测双重偏移），有严格leave-one-subject-out验证、多数据集对比和消融，但未涉及实时闭环、临床部署或长期稳定性，也未突破BCI基础范式（如解码粒度仍为粗粒度负荷等级，非语义/运动意图），远低于基石工作所要求的临床级鲁棒性、长期植入兼容性或高信息带宽通信能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法设计合理、实验严谨，但属特定场景（静态EEG负荷分类）下的算法改进，未触及脑机接口核心瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、神经可塑性适应、侵入式长期稳定性），暂不具备范式突破或临床转化分量。

papers.title: Biological rationales from language models enable leakage-resistant forecasts of target-indication success
papers.abstract: Identifying which target-indication (T-I) hypotheses can translate into clinical success remains a central challenge in drug discovery. We present PRIORITI (Prospective Rationale-Informed Outcome Reasoning for Integrated Target-indication Intelligence), a leakage-resistant framework that separates upstream biological evidence synthesis from outcome prediction. Given only a target gene and disease indication, a domain-instructed large language model (LLM) synthesizes drug-agnostic human genetics across prespecified channels. These evidence were embedded and combined with static entity context derived from gene summaries and disease definitions. The resulting representation is used to fit a supervised model trained on 6,784 temporally curated historical T-I outcomes, which is one of the largest cohorts assembled for this task. On a held-out historical test set of 1,696 T-I pairs, PRIORITI achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.883 and an expected calibration error (ECE) of 0.023, outperforming both a static target and indication context baseline and a human-curated genetic-evidence reference. On a strictly post-cutoff out-of-time benchmark of 765 T-I pairs, the largest such evaluation cohort reported to date, performance remained robust, with ROC-AUC 0.817, PR-AUC 0.357 and ECE 0.044, exceeding static target and indication context baseline and direct zero-shot LLM forecasting. A label-blinded LLM-based explainer further converted locked predictions into auditable prioritization rationales. Together, PRIORITI provides a calibrated, biology-first probability together with decision-oriented rationales for T-I prioritization before downstream translational investment.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型从人类遗传学文献中自动提取靶点-适应症的生物学证据，再结合静态知识训练预测模型，实现不依赖未来泄露信息的、可解释且校准良好的临床转化成功率预测。
analysis.claim: 分离生物学证据合成与结果预测两个阶段，可构建抗数据泄露、校准良好、具备可审计生物学理由的靶点-适应症优先级预测框架。
analysis.input: 靶点基因名 + 疾病适应症名称
analysis.output: 该靶点-适应症组合临床成功的概率预测值及对应生物学理由文本
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性实现‘生物学证据驱动+时间隔离验证+概率校准+可解释归因’四要素闭环，在765对严格out-of-time测试集上保持AUC>0.81，远超零样本LLM和静态特征基线；但未开源代码/模型权重，且未在前瞻性盲测中验证，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证扎实、设计严谨、验证严格，显著推进靶点优先级预测的可信度与可操作性，但开源不足限制复现与生态扩展。

papers.title: Ultrafast and Accurate Selection of High-Quality Protein Complex Models from Large-Scale Prediction
papers.abstract: In the post-AlphaFold era, advances in protein complex structure prediction have enabled the generation of thousands of candidate models per target, making the accurate and efficient selection of high-quality models from large candidate pools a critical challenge. Existing model-selection approaches commonly employ estimated model accuracy (EMA) methods, which include single-model and consensus-based methods. The former lack cross-model comparative information, whereas the latter often incur high computational costs from pairwise structural alignments and are influenced by candidate-pool quality. Here, we present DeepUMQA-Selection, a two-stage framework combining single-model accuracy estimators for preliminary selection with Ultrafast Shape Recognition (USR)-based structural alignment for consensus selection. Preliminary selection enriches the candidate pool with high-quality models and reduces subsequent structural comparisons, while USR-based structural alignment enables efficient consensus selection without explicit structural superposition. On the retrospective CASP16 QMODE3 benchmark dataset, DeepUMQA-Selection outperformed all participating methods and predictor-derived confidence metrics, as measured by mean Top-5 weighted penalty. The advantage was particularly pronounced for heteromeric targets, with a 13.9% improvement in model-selection performance relative to the best-performing CASP16 participating method. Furthermore, a confidence-assisted strategy enabled the framework to accommodate larger protein complexes while maintaining superior model-selection performance over competing methods, supporting its scalability. Runtime benchmarking showed that the proposed USR-based structural alignment achieved a substantial 317-fold speedup over US-align for candidate pools containing 1,000 models, demonstrating its computational efficiency for large-scale model selection. Our results demonstrate that DeepUMQA-Selection enables accurate and computationally efficient selection of high-quality protein complex models from large-scale candidate pools.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeepUMQA-Selection框架，用单模型精度估计+超快USR形状匹配替代传统耗时的结构比对，在大规模蛋白复合物预测结果中快速挑出高质量模型，尤其在异源多聚体上比CASP16最好方法提升13.9%，速度比US-align快317倍。
analysis.claim: 通过融合单模型精度估计与无需结构叠合的超快形状识别（USR），可在保持高选择准确率的同时，将大规模蛋白复合物模型筛选的计算开销降至可扩展水平。
analysis.input: 大量预测的蛋白复合物3D结构模型（PDB格式）
analysis.output: 按质量排序的Top-K高置信度模型列表（含加权惩罚分）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程改进：显著加速并提升蛋白复合物模型选择性能，实证扎实（CASP16 QMODE3基准、异源体专项提升、317×加速），但未突破‘选择’这一子任务的本质范式（仍是EMA+consensus），也未解决更根本的复合物建模准确性问题，未开源数据/模型权重，未验证泛化到非CASP场景或新靶标类型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前蛋白结构后处理流程中稀缺的、经严格基准验证的高效选择器，但属于关键环节的稳健优化，而非新范式或底层突破。

papers.title: Staircase Policy: Streaming Inference for World-Action Models with Large Action Chunks
papers.abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by conditioning action generation on predicted future observations, but future prediction adds further inference overhead to already expensive iterative action generation. Action chunking can amortize this cost over multiple actions, yet performance degrades over long execution horizons because later actions remain conditioned on stale observations. We introduce STAIRCASE POLICY, a streaming inference and training framework that turns a flow-matching VLA into a JEPA-style WAM and partitions a large action chunk into sub-chunks at staggered denoising stages. Near-term actions are executed as soon as they become available, while later actions continue to be refined. At each sub-chunk boundary, the future latent is re-predicted from the latest observation and used to update all unexecuted actions, enabling long-horizon execution without repeated full policy inference. The resulting future-prediction error can further serve as a signal for adaptive chunking. S-WAM achieves 97.7% on LIBERO and 87.9% on LIBERO-Plus, and improves performance across multiple policy backbones and real-robot tasks. It reaches 292.7 executed actions per second, $3.62\times$ the throughput of conventional execution at comparable accuracy, while reducing time-to-first-action from 123.6 to 73.3 ms. With additional inference optimizations, throughput further increases to 642.9 actions per second.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫STAIRCASE的流式推理框架，把大动作块拆成错开的子块，在去噪不同阶段逐步输出近程动作、同时持续用最新观测更新远程动作的预测，从而在不重复全量推理的前提下实现低延迟高吞吐的长视野世界-动作建模。
analysis.claim: 通过在扩散式世界-动作模型中引入分阶段、可更新的流式动作生成机制，可在显著降低首动作延迟和提升每秒动作吞吐量的同时，维持甚至提升长程任务执行准确率。
analysis.input: 视觉观测序列（如RGB帧）+任务指令
analysis.output: 分阶段流式输出的动作子块（连续控制动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提real-robot tasks但无采集/微调细节
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（JEPA-style + staggered denoising + latent re-prediction），在LIBERO系列benchmark上达到SOTA级准确率且实测吞吐翻3.6倍、首动作延迟降41%，证据扎实；但未开源代码/模型，未披露真实机器人实验细节（如平台、任务数、失败分析），也未与世界模型基石工作（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在统一设定下对比长期状态一致性或记忆衰减问题，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程创新强、实证充分，但缺乏开源与真实系统深度验证，暂未达里程碑水平

papers.title: FreeSpeed: Training-Free Speed Control for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Online control of execution speed is essential for deploying robot policies in real-world scenarios, as robots may need to speed up under time constraints or slow down to facilitate human interaction and improve safety. However, imitation-learned policies inherit the execution speed of their demonstrations, and test-time speed modification can introduce unrecoverable out-of-distribution observations, reducing task success. We observe that the directional inconsistency of action chunks reflects task-phase criticality, indicating how aggressively action step lengths can be modified while preserving task success. Based on this observation, we introduce FreeSpeed, a training-free module that post-processes action chunks from pretrained policies. FreeSpeed resamples each predicted chunk at the requested rate, then uses directional inconsistency between adjacent actions as the primary signal for rescaling. This signal adaptively determines how closely the execution speed can approach the requested speed, allowing flexible speed adjustment within the evaluated limits without compromising task success. Across three policy families and 50 simulated tasks, FreeSpeed supports online speed changes, with realized execution rates spanning 0.22x to 2.53x among settings that preserve per-task success. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, FreeSpeed achieves an average success rate of 94.0%, matching the frozen policy's 93.8%, while realizing execution rates from 0.38x to 1.97x.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需重新训练的后处理模块FreeSpeed，通过分析预训练策略输出的动作块之间的方向不一致性来动态调整执行速度，在保持任务成功率的前提下实现0.2x到2.5x的在线速度调节，已在50个仿真任务和4个真实机器人操作任务上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 无需任何训练、仅靠动作方向不一致性这一几何信号即可安全地对任意预训练生成式机器人策略进行实时速度缩放。
analysis.input: 预训练策略输出的动作块序列（含时间戳或隐式时序）
analysis.output: 重采样并缩放后的动作块序列（对应目标执行速率）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents（依据真实实验描述推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据；仅复用原策略训练时的数据（未新增收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机+多任务+跨策略家族验证+明确速度-成功率权衡边界，且方法轻量、训练无关、即插即用；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节（如方向不一致性是否唯一有效信号）、未与基线速度控制方法（如时间扭曲、LSTM重采样）对比，也未挑战高难度接触密集任务（如插入、缠绕），分量略逊于InsertAnything/PhyVisGen级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动作几何结构（方向不一致性）转化为可泛化的速度调控信号，落地扎实但创新深度未达范式突破级别

papers.title: RoboQuest: Generalist Physical Agents that Search, Inspect and Test
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models have made them capable generalist physical agents for a range of manipulation tasks. However, successful operation in an unfamiliar environment may require an agent to seek task-relevant information through interaction when it is absent from the observations: it may need to determine where a relevant object is, inspect an unobserved property, or discover the effect of an unfamiliar tool. We thus introduce RoboQuest, a benchmark for goal-directed embodied exploration, where agents must actively acquire task-relevant information through physical interaction, use the resulting evidence to adapt subsequent actions, and autonomously decide when to commit to task completion. RoboQuest comprises ten mobile manipulation tasks centered on three forms of uncertainty: search, manipulation-based inspection, and interactive testing. We evaluate five frontier multimodal agents through a common visuomotor interface, as well as a $π_{0.5}$ policy fine-tuned on the full-episode demonstrations we release. The best agent succeeds in only 23\% of the episodes, and the fine-tuned policy almost never succeeds. Isolated tests of the execution skills the tasks are built from, with the hidden information supplied, show that the agents can carry out most of the required actions, and our failure analysis attributes only a minority of the failures to execution. Our failure analysis further finds that the agents often stop exploring too early as they make decisions before observing the required evidence for task completion. We also find that agents rarely prevent or repair the disturbances caused by their exploration. Moreover, learning by trial and error remains difficult for most models.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboQuest基准，测试具身智能体在未知环境中主动探索（搜索物体、检查隐藏属性、测试工具效果）以消除三类不确定性并自主决定何时完成任务的能力，发现现有前沿多模态智能体在此类目标导向探索上表现极差（最高仅23%成功率），失败主因是过早终止探索和无法修复探索引发的扰动。
analysis.claim: 当前多模态具身智能体缺乏目标导向的主动信息获取能力，其在需动态推理‘该交互什么、何时停止探索’的任务中存在系统性缺陷。
analysis.input: RGB-D观测+语言任务目标+机器人本体状态
analysis.output: 移动与操作动作序列（含探索性交互决策）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人平台（未指明具体平台，但依赖移动机械臂仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并量化‘目标导向探索’这一关键缺失能力，构建了有认知层次（搜索/检查/测试）的十任务基准，实证揭示主流模型的决策逻辑缺陷（非执行失败而是证据不足即终止），但仅限仿真、无真机验证、未提出新模型或训练范式，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准诊断了当前具身智能体在主动感知-决策闭环中的核心短板，但仍是诊断性基准工作，非突破性方法或系统。

papers.title: The effects of temporal smoothing and interpolation on EEG microstate parameters, syntax, and our view of resting-state brain dynamics
papers.abstract: Microstate analysis studies dynamic brain activity through a discrete representation of electroencephalographic (EEG) signals and their topography. While the body of literature describing findings in diverse experimental and clinical settings is growing rapidly, the effects of several core components of the microstate algorithm are still insufficiently understood. This study systematically investigates how two common temporal smoothing algorithms, parametric smoothing and GFP peak interpolation, influence a wide range of microstate sequence parameters, and how they shape the integrated picture of brain dynamics inferred from these metrics. We study eyes-closed resting-state EEG recordings from N=201 healthy subjects from a public EEG database. For the elementary temporal metrics, we find that widening smoothing windows markedly increase microstate duration, reduce occurrence rates, but leave coverage mostly unaffected. In terms of simple syntax properties, smoothing windows above 30 ms yield an inconsistent picture with a memoryless, first-order Markov structure at short time scales, but a positive Hurst phenomenon suggestive of long-range correlations at long time scales. Evidence of asymmetry and non-equilibrium dynamics are suppressed by smoothing. At intermediate time scales, microstate periodicity was only observed up to a window size of 28 ms. Smoothing had a strong impact on the complexity metrics entropy rate and excess entropy, decreasing the former and increasing the latter. For most metrics, the effects of GFP peak interpolation were comparable to those of smoothing windows in the range between 28 ms and 44 ms. In conclusion, elementary and higher-order microstate parameters must be interpreted in the context of preprocessing, as many parameters change continuously with smoothing intensity. This limits the comparability of microstate parameters obtained with different preprocessing settings. Strong smoothing with a window size above 30 ms or GFP peak interpolation yields a fundamentally different picture of resting state brain dynamics, i.e. that of a memoryless, aperiodic, time-reversible first-order Markov chain. Since insights from other neurophysiological modalities suggest that time series memory and time-irreversibility are markers of normal brain activity, our recommendation is to avoid intense smoothing to minimize alterations of the initial sequences.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统检验了EEG微状态分析中两种常用时间平滑方法（参数化平滑和GFP峰值插值）对各类微状态参数的影响，发现它们会显著扭曲脑动态的统计特性（如抹除时间不可逆性、长程相关性和周期性），并警告：超过30ms的强平滑或GFP插值会将真实脑活动错误建模为无记忆、可逆的一阶马尔可夫链，从而误导对静息态脑功能的理解。
analysis.org: 德国法兰克福大学医院
analysis.claim: EEG微状态分析中的时间平滑与GFP插值并非中性预处理步骤，而是会系统性地、连续地改变从微状态序列中推断出的脑动力学本质，导致对静息态脑活动的错误物理解释。
analysis.input: 201例健康人睁眼/闭眼静息态EEG原始信号（含电极拓扑）
analysis.output: 微状态参数序列（持续时间、出现率、覆盖率、转移概率、熵率、超熵、Hurst指数、时间不可逆性指标等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据库（如TUH EEG Corpus或类似）的离线脑电记录
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实揭示了EEG微状态领域长期被忽视的关键方法学陷阱：平滑操作不是‘去噪’而是‘改写动力学’；证据充分（N=201、多尺度参数、跨时标对比、与神经生理先验一致性验证），但属方法论纠偏而非新范式或临床突破，未提出新算法/新硬件/新解码框架，也未解决BCI闭环控制或实时通信等核心工程问题，分量明显低于所列基石（全部涉及高精度、实时、闭环、临床级神经接口）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次以大规模实证量化了平滑对微状态动力学语义的系统性扭曲，为该领域建立方法学基准，但非突破性技术或临床进展。

papers.title: Human Metalloenzymes Are Disproportionately Linked to Disease: The HEAM Structural Annotation Resource
papers.abstract: Catalytic metal-binding sites are established drug targets for many human diseases, yet systematic study of how metal function relates to disease is limited by the lack of a resource combining structural localization of human metal-binding sites with catalytic annotation at scale. We introduce HEAM (the Human Enzymatic Annotation of Metalloproteins), a structurally annotated dataset of 1,933 human metalloenzymes and 1,171 non-catalytic metalloproteins. HEAM incorporates annotated metals into protein structures at their corresponding binding sites and classifies each site as catalytic or non-catalytic using the machine learning classifier MAHOMES II. HEAM more than quadruples the human site-level coverage of the largest prior metalloenzyme database. Using HEAM, we show that human metalloproteins are significantly enriched in KEGG disease pathways relative to the human proteome, and that metalloenzymes specifically are significantly enriched in ClinVar pathogenic variants -- a distinction obscured in prior, catalytically unresolved metalloprotein datasets. These pathogenic variants are concentrated in metabolic disorders, indicating that metabolic dysfunction is a substantial contributor to metalloenzyme-linked disease. By pairing 3D structural annotation with catalytic classification, HEAM provides both a foundation for structure-guided drug design against metal-binding sites and a resource for determining how catalytic and non-catalytic metal function contribute to human disease.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个名为HEAM的高质量结构数据库，系统标注了1933个人源金属酶和1171个非催化金属蛋白的三维金属结合位点，并用机器学习模型MAHOMES II区分其催化性；首次揭示金属酶（而非所有金属蛋白）在临床致病突变中显著富集，尤其集中在代谢类疾病，为靶向金属位点的药物设计提供了可直接使用的结构-功能资源。
analysis.claim: 人类金属酶（而非广义金属蛋白）在致病突变中特异性富集，且这种富集仅在结构+催化双重注释下才能被揭示，HEAM是首个实现该尺度与精度的资源。
analysis.input: PDB结构文件、UniProt序列、已知金属结合位点信息、MAHOMES II预测输入特征（如几何/配位环境/进化保守性）
analysis.output: 带原子级金属定位与催化性标签（catalytic/non-catalytic）的结构化金属蛋白条目
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了金属蛋白疾病关联研究的范式：首次将结构定位与催化功能解耦并量化验证其病理特异性，证据扎实（ClinVar/KEGG统计显著性、对比旧数据库的遮蔽效应、代谢病聚焦），但属高质量资源构建而非算法或机制突破，未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆，强于多数benchmark但弱于CENO/HI-JEPA等世界模型级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它不是新算法突破，而是以严谨结构计算+临床数据交叉验证，把长期模糊的‘金属蛋白=致病’认知升级为‘催化性金属位点=精准致病靶标’，资源本身即生产力。

papers.title: Prior Availability in Industrial Visual Sim-to-Real: A Review of CAD-Guided and CAD-Unavailable Regimes
papers.abstract: Industrial visual sim-to-real is often described as transferring from synthetic images to real images, but industrial deployment usually involves a broader mismatch between available evidence and required decisions. A system may be built from CAD renderings, simulated RGB-D observations, normal reference images, synthetic defects, pretrained feature spaces, or language prompts, yet deployed under different sensors, lighting, materials, fixtures, calibration, production variation, and rare defect modes. This review reframes industrial visual sim-to-real as a domain-gap problem organized by prior availability. We distinguish CAD-available settings, where explicit object geometry can support rendering, calibration, pose estimation, segmentation, and test-time geometric verification; CAD-unavailable settings, where geometry is replaced by normal-reference appearance, feature distributions, teacher-student residuals, synthetic anomaly assumptions, foundation features, or vision-language priors; and boundary-prior settings, where approximate models, templates, reference views, or semantic correspondences preserve only part of the CAD role. This framing connects CAD-based detection and 6D pose-estimation literature with industrial anomaly and surface-inspection literature that is usually reviewed separately. To make the taxonomy concrete, we use empirical anchors on T-LESS/BOP, MVTec AD, and VisA. The anchors show that CAD render count alone does not close transfer; source-distribution design, detector capacity, and small real calibration can matter more. They also show that CAD at test time creates a distinct verification channel through mask, pose, and depth consistency, whereas CAD-unavailable inspection relies on calibrated normality and feature deviation. The review therefore argues against a single cross-task leaderboard and instead asks what prior grounds the deployment decision.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新方法，而是对工业视觉领域sim-to-real问题做概念重构：按‘先验可用性’（尤其是CAD模型是否可用）把现有工作分成三类，指出CAD是否在训练/部署时存在会根本改变技术路径和评估逻辑。
analysis.claim: 工业视觉中的sim-to-real本质是先验可用性差异导致的域偏移问题，CAD是否可用决定了技术路线、验证机制与评估范式，不能用统一跨任务排行榜衡量。
analysis.input: 工业图像（合成/真实）、CAD模型、正常样本、语言提示等多源先验
analysis.output: 分类框架与评估原则建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开工业视觉数据集（T-LESS/BOP/MVTec AD/VisA）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了有实证支撑（T-LESS/MVTec等锚点）的分类学框架，厘清了CAD在工业视觉中作为结构先验的核心作用，但未提出可复现的新算法/模型/系统，也未解决任何具体任务性能瓶颈，属于高质量综述性分析而非技术推进；显著弱于World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作（后者定义新范式并开源可扩展架构），也不具备UniPi/DreamZero级的跨模态具身决策整合能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的工业视觉文献按先验结构重新组织，揭示了CAD可用性对技术选择的决定性影响，但无新模型、无真机验证、无开源实现，属于高水平领域认知梳理，非技术突破。

papers.title: MoDex: A Diffusion Policy for Sequential Multi-Object Dexterous Grasping
papers.abstract: This work addresses sequentially grasping multiple objects with a single dexterous hand without releasing those already held. Most dexterous grasping methods commit all of the hand's degrees of freedom to a single object, underutilizing its dexterity and leaving no redundancy for subsequent grasps. The proposed solution, MoDex, is a diffusion policy that predicts the next gripper pose directly from observations, conditioned on an opposition space and point cloud. The opposition space condition specifies which fingers participate in the current grasp, enabling the gripper to use only a subset of its available degrees of freedom while reserving the remaining degrees of freedom for subsequent grasps. To facilitate sim-to-real transfer, MoDex is trained in two stages: first through imitation learning on expert demonstrations, and subsequently through reinforcement learning fine-tuning, which consistently improves success rates over the pre-trained policy. We evaluate MoDex in simulation on a MuJoCo-based Franka Emika Panda robot equipped with an Allegro Hand and on the corresponding real-world hardware platform. Across both simulation and real-world experiments, MoDex achieves higher success rates than the evaluated learning-based baselines, improving performance by 2.92-17.92% and 6.67-17.78%, respectively. Project page: https://modex2026.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoDex扩散策略，让灵巧手在不松开已抓物体的前提下，依次抓取多个物体，通过‘对立空间’条件控制哪些手指参与当前抓取，从而保留其余自由度用于后续操作，并在仿真和真实Franka+Allegro平台上验证了其多物体连续抓取的成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可配置的‘对立空间’条件机制，扩散策略能显式保留灵巧手未使用的自由度，实现无需释放的顺序多物体灵巧抓取，且sim2real迁移有效。
analysis.input: 点云+当前夹爪观测+对立空间条件（指定参与抓取的手指子集）
analysis.output: 下一时刻夹爪6D位姿
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + Allegro Hand灵巧手
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真专家演示数据（MuJoCo）和少量真实机器人微调数据（摘要称RL fine-tuning在real-world平台进行，但未说明是否用真实交互数据采集）

papers.title: EAGG: Embodiment-Aligned Grasp Generation via Geometry-Aware Graph Conditioning
papers.abstract: Cross-end-effector grasp generation seeks a unified model that generalizes across objects and across embodiments ranging from parallel grippers to dexterous end effectors. Existing grasp generators are typically designed for a fixed embodiment or encode embodiment identity with a static descriptor, which weakens transfer when topology, actuation coupling, and contact geometry differ substantially. We present EAGG, an embodiment-aligned grasp generator that represents each embodiment with a topology-aware end-effector graph and an embodiment-specific low-dimensional end-effector control space. A frozen end-effector-cognition backbone converts the current articulated state into geometry-aware tokens that act as a reusable morphology prior, and iterative geometry injection refreshes these tokens throughout sampling so that conditioning remains synchronized with the evolving end-effector geometry. On the MultiGripperGrasp benchmark, EAGG reaches 56.17% average success across six training end effectors, remaining within 1.10 percentage points of specialized training while preserving transfer to finetuning and zero-shot end effectors. Iterative geometry injection further reduces the pooled median contact distance from 0.239 cm to 0.189 cm. These results show that cross-end-effector grasp generation is strengthened by aligning embodiment structure inside a shared generator rather than suppressing embodiment differences. Code is available at https://github.com/wanhaoniu/EAGG.

analysis.tldr: 提出EAGG方法，用图结构显式建模不同机器人末端执行器的拓扑与几何特性，并在生成抓取姿态时动态注入实时几何信息，实现单模型跨多种末端执行器（平行夹爪到灵巧手）的泛化抓取。
analysis.claim: 跨末端执行器的抓取生成性能提升源于在共享生成器内部对执行器形态结构进行显式、动态对齐，而非忽略或静态编码形态差异。
analysis.input: 物体点云+当前末端执行器关节状态+末端执行器图结构表示
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿（位置+旋转）及关节配置
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中多末端执行器（包括Franka、Allegro、Shadow Dexterous Hand等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（MultiGripperGrasp基准），无真实机器人实验
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将末端执行器建模为几何感知图并引入迭代几何注入机制，在统一生成框架下实现强跨执行器泛化（6种训练末端+零样本迁移），但仅在仿真基准验证、无真机部署、无接触力/触觉/动态交互验证，未触及操作闭环或任务级泛化，显著弱于T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等基石工作（均含真机多任务闭环、触觉/视觉-动作联合学习、大规模人类演示或部署验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计扎实、泛化实证充分（仿真内跨6种末端+零样本），但限于纯仿真、无物理交互验证，属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Decoupling Semantics and Geometric Grounding: Spatial Visual Prompts for Language-Conditioned Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: While end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise in robotic manipulation, their monolithic paradigm inherently couples semantic reasoning and spatial control. This creates a severe alignment bottleneck, limiting precise target disambiguation in data-constrained imitation learning. To overcome this, we propose SVP-IL, a decoupled architecture that explicitly extracts spatial visual grounding from the action generation loop. By leveraging vision-language foundation models, we parse instructions into zero-shot geometric masks, translating language into explicit Spatial Visual Prompts (SVP). These priors are injected into a continuous action generator via a lightweight direct feature-level fusion mechanism. This integration provides explicit and uncorrupted spatial gradient guidance while ensuring highly stable optimization under low-data regimes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVP-IL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art VLAs and pure visuomotor baselines. Trained on as few as 50 to 100 demonstrations, SVP-IL improves average success rates on highly ambiguous language-conditioned tasks from 24.0% to 39.5%, achieving 67.8% on standard benchmarks. Real-world robotic experiments further validate its robustness and data efficiency in unstructured physical environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种解耦语义理解和空间定位的新架构SVP-IL，用视觉语言基础模型自动生成几何掩码作为空间视觉提示，注入动作生成器，在仅50–100条演示数据下显著提升语言指令驱动的机器人操作成功率，尤其在目标歧义任务上效果突出。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、项目名或致谢线索；姓名均为中文名但无 affiliation 信息）
analysis.claim: 解耦语义解析与几何空间接地可突破语言条件模仿学习中的对齐瓶颈，使小样本下语言驱动的机器人操作具备高精度空间控制能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（末端执行器轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据（50–100条），但未说明是否使用真实机器人采集过程细节（如传感器类型、标定方式、失败案例覆盖等）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有明确洞见（解耦语义与几何），实证包含真实机器人部署和跨任务/场景验证，且在极低数据量（50–100 demo）下取得实质性提升（+15.5% success on ambiguous tasks）；但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据，未报告消融实验细节（如SVP模块各组件贡献度）、未对比同量级基线（如ACT变体或RT-1微调）、未说明任务复杂度（是否含遮挡/多物体/动态干扰等），整体推进扎实但未达基石级——远低于ALOHA/ACT（96分）或Diffusion Policy（95分）所确立的通用性、鲁棒性与工程完备性门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在语言条件模仿学习中有效融合VLM空间先验与动作生成，实证充分但闭源且缺乏机制级消融，属高质量增量改进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Verifiable Foundation Models for Robot Safety
papers.abstract: Deploying foundation models for robot control raises a central challenge: the expressive power that enables rich, multimodal perception also makes these models opaque and difficult to analyze formally, rendering them intractable for existing verification tools. In this paper, we present FEARL (Foundation-Enabled Assured Robot Learning), a framework that addresses this tension through a modular architectural decomposition. FEARL separates the policy into a large Controller (C) responsible for high-dimensional perception and task reasoning, and a small Safety module (S) that receives low-dimensional observations from dedicated safety sensors together with a bounded context embedding from C and produces the final action. Since many robot safety requirements, such as collision avoidance and workspace boundary constraints, can be expressed over these safety sensor observations, formal verification can be applied to S rather than to the full foundation-model backbone. This makes formal analysis tractable with existing tools while preserving the Controller's expressive power for task reasoning. To show that the decomposed policy remains capable of solving diverse tasks, we evaluate FEARL on three simulated robotic domains using multiple Controller backbones and training procedures, including pretrained off-the-shelf vision-language-action models. We further transfer the learned policy from one of our simulated tasks to a physical robot, suggesting that the low-dimensional safety interface supports practical sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FEARL框架，把机器人控制策略拆成两部分：一个大而强但难验证的感知-推理控制器（C），和一个小而精、只处理安全传感器低维数据的安全模块（S）；用形式化方法验证S即可保障关键安全属性（如防碰撞），同时保留C的多模态能力，还在仿真中验证了多任务性能，并成功迁移到真机。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将基础模型驱动的机器人策略解耦为可验证的小型安全模块与不可验证但高表达力的控制器，可在不牺牲任务能力的前提下实现对关键安全属性的形式化验证。
analysis.input: 安全传感器低维观测（如激光测距、边界开关）+ 控制器生成的有界上下文嵌入
analysis.output: 最终动作（带安全约束的动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（MuJoCo/PyBullet等未明说但典型）+ 1台物理机械臂（未指明型号，仅称 'physical robot'）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；安全模块训练/验证仅用仿真生成的低维安全信号；真机迁移仅做单任务部署验证，无在线真实数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实际工程意义的安全解耦范式，首次在基础模型+机器人控制中系统性将形式验证锚定在低维可建模接口上，并完成跨仿真任务验证及单任务真机迁移；但未开源代码/模型，未在标准benchmark（如RT-X、Open-X）上评测，也未与主流安全基线（如CBF、reachability）做对比，验证范围限于几何约束类安全（非动力学/时序/多智能体），尚未构成新范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了基础模型用于机器人时‘能力与可验证性不可兼得’的关键矛盾，设计合理、实证扎实，但缺乏开源与广义安全验证，尚未达到World Models级的范式开创性。

papers.title: kmerRRR: A k-mer based tool for functional genomics in Repeat Rich Regions
papers.abstract: Highly repetitive sequences pose problems for genome assembly and analysis. While advances in long-read sequencing technologies have helped reveal the organization of repetitive genomic sequences at unprecedented resolution, their functional characterization remains difficult because molecular assays that probe protein-DNA interactions and characterize expression often rely on short read sequencing. The repetitive nature of these regions poses major challenges for methods relying on sequence mapping, which is exacerbated for short reads. Repetitive genome regions often have low mappability, leading to substantial information loss during downstream filtering. To address this challenge, we developed a bioinformatic tool -kmerRRR- that leverages k-mer frequency analyses to enhance the mappability of repetitive regions. KmerRRR compares k-mer frequencies within user-defined loci to their frequencies across the genome to identify repetitive sequences that are overrepresented locally relative to the global background. This approach quantifies locus uniqueness, allowing users to distinguish sequences that are globally repetitive from those that are repetitive, but restricted to specific genomic loci. We demonstrated the utility of this method by reanalyzing chromatin profiling data from human, Drosophila, and Arabidopsis centromeres and small RNA sequencing data. Our results show that incorporating local k-mer ratio information enhances read retention and signal interpretation within repetitive regions, thereby recovering biologically meaningful information that is typically lost in conventional analyses. The tool is freely available under MIT license in github: (https://github.com/LarracuenteLab/kmerRRR).

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个叫kmerRRR的工具，用k-mer频率比（局部vs全基因组）来量化重复区域的‘局部特异性’，从而提升短读测序数据在着丝粒等高重复区的比对保留率和信号可解释性，避免传统mapping因低mappability导致的信息丢失。
analysis.claim: 通过局部与全局k-mer频率比值，可有效区分‘全局重复’与‘局部富集重复’，从而在不依赖长读或改变实验的前提下，显著提升短读测序数据在重复区域的功能解析能力。
analysis.input: 短读测序FASTQ/FASTA文件 + 基因组参考序列 + 用户定义的基因组区间（如着丝粒）
analysis.output: 每个输入区间的k-mer局部/全局频率比值（k-mer ratio）、mappability校正建议、增强后的信号可视化/定量结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开的短读测序数据（ChIP-seq, small RNA-seq）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了重复区域短读分析中长期存在的mappability信息丢失问题，方法简洁、跨物种验证扎实（人/果蝇/拟南芥），开源且有实证提升（读保留率+信号解释），但未颠覆范式（仍是mapping后处理工具，非端到端建模），也未引入新实验模态或生成能力，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典k-mer统计思想精准落地到重复基因组功能解析痛点，代码可用、验证充分，但未突破方法论边界

papers.title: Current as Touch: Proprioceptive Contact Feedback for Compliant Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Compliance is essential for dexterous manipulation, yet existing solutions often rely on external tactile or force sensors that are costly, fragile, and difficult to deploy on low-cost robot hands. We propose a proprioception-driven framework that learns contact-aware compliance cues from motor current and joint states. Since motor current is closely related to actuator torque, it provides an intrinsic signal for perceiving contact force, object resistance, and grasp stability without additional sensing hardware. Rather than estimating external wrenches or commanding torque, our method predicts a compliance reference position: an ideal joint-position target for a standard PD controller whose induced position error generates appropriate grasping force. This position-based formulation is compatible with mainstream teleoperation and policy-learning pipelines, while enabling the robot to adapt interaction forces from real-time proprioceptive feedback. Thus, motor current serves not only as a force proxy but also as a learnable proprioceptive contact signal for compliance reference prediction. Experiments on multiple dexterous hands and contact-rich tasks, including fragile object handling, sustained surface contact, thin-object retrieval, and dynamic load adaptation, show stable compliant grasping, safer and more efficient teleoperation, and improved downstream policy learning without external tactile or force sensors.

analysis.tldr: 用电机电流和关节状态代替昂贵脆弱的触觉/力传感器，让灵巧手在抓取易碎物、维持表面接触等任务中实现自适应柔顺控制，全程不依赖外部触觉硬件。
