papers.title: PINPOINT: Protease INhibitor PredictiOn at the plant–pathogen INTerface using protein language models and structural modeling
papers.abstract: Cysteine and serine proteases act as an immune hub in the plant apoplast to provide robust extracellular immunity during microbial colonisation. Microbial pathogens counteract these immune proteases by inhibiting their activity using small secreted proteins (SSPs). Traditionally, SSPs with protease-inhibitory activity are predicted using sequence-dependent database searches. However, in recent years, fungal SSPs have been shown to exhibit protease-inhibitory functions despite lacking the inhibitor domain that is annotated through sequence similarity searches. Hence, a large number of these novel SSPs with putative protease inhibitor functions are missed during detection and filtered out during sequence similarity searches. This necessitates the development of newer approaches to predict SSPs lacking an annotated inhibitor domain. Machine learning approaches, such as protein language models, have emerged as powerful tools for predicting protein functions. To date, no machine learning models have been developed to predict the protease-inhibitory activities of SSPs lacking an annotated inhibitor domain. Here, we introduce a protease inhibitor prediction pipeline, PINPOINT (Protease INhibitor PredictiOn at plant–pathogen INTerface). The PINPOINT pipeline combines fine-tuned protein language model classifiers, a structure-aware autoencoder, and effector prediction into a multi-level framework for identifying SSPs with predicted protease inhibitor functions. PINPOINT predicts protease inhibitors using SSPs sequences and monomeric structures with pre-computed structures obtained from the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database or predicted using the ESMFold public API. We successfully validated the PINPOINT platform using SSPs from the plant fungal pathogen Macrophomina phaseolina. Notably, the PINPOINT platform robustly predicted several of these SSPs as protease inhibitors including Sequence-unrelated but structurally similar (SUSS) effectors. We further validated the inhibitory potential of these predicted M. phaseolina SSPs using AlphaFold Multimer (AFM) screening against candidate apoplastic soybean cysteine and serine proteases. Additionally, this platform can be used as a pre-filtering step in AFM screening approaches to reduce the number of candidates for discovering novel SSPs with protease inhibitor function for cross-kingdom plant-microbe interaction studies. The PINPOINT platform will accelerate the prediction of novel SSPs including SUSS effectors with protease inhibitor functions in proteomes of any organisms. We made the PINPOINT pipeline accessible to the research community as a web-based notebook environment for interactive computing in Google Colab, available at https://github.com/iitj-mpg-lab/PINPOINT

analysis.tldr: 提出PINPOINT流程，用微调的蛋白语言模型+结构感知自编码器+效应子预测三阶段框架，从无已知抑制域的微生物小分泌蛋白（SSP）序列和AlphaFold/ESMFold预测结构出发，预测其对植物胞外半胱氨酸/丝氨酸蛋白酶的抑制功能，并在Macrophomina phaseolina中实验验证了多个SUSS效应子。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院焦特布尔分校（IIT Jodhpur）
analysis.claim: 无需保守抑制域注释，仅凭SSP序列与单体结构即可高置信度预测其靶向植物胞外蛋白酶的抑制功能，尤其可识别序列无关但结构相似（SUSS）的新型效应子。
analysis.input: 小分泌蛋白（SSP）的氨基酸序列 + 单体三维结构（来自AlphaFold DB或ESMFold预测）
analysis.output: 该SSP是否具有蛋白酶抑制功能的概率得分及靶向蛋白酶类型（半胱氨酸/丝氨酸）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建端到端ML流程专用于识别无经典抑制域的SSP抑制功能，实证覆盖SUSS效应子、AFM多聚体对接验证、跨物种适用性声明；但未发布训练数据集、未在独立测试集上报告泛化性能、未与传统方法（如HMM/PSI-BLAST）做消融对比，且验证仅限单一真菌病原体（M. phaseolina）及有限靶标蛋白，未见生化/体外酶活实验证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了无抑制域SSP识别的明确方法学缺口，结构+语言模型融合设计合理，有AFM对接和SUSS案例支撑，但缺乏生化验证与严格基准对比，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Genomic Annotation Infrastructure (GAIn): Pipelines and Resource Repositories for Annotating Variants, Positions, and Regions
papers.abstract: Interpretation of genomic variants, positions, and regions depends on reliable annotation - adding evidence such as predicted effect, conservation, population frequency, and gene-level context - yet the underlying resources are numerous, versioned, and assembly-specific. We present the Genomic Annotation Infrastructure (GAIn), a platform that generates transparent, reproducible annotations via declarative pipelines that define annotation tasks as ordered lists of components, called annotators, that produce annotation attributes using genomic resources from Genomic Resource Repositories (GRRs). We provide two public GRRs: a main repository containing more than 250 heterogeneous genomic resources, and a separate GRR-ENCODE repository containing resources derived from thousands of ENCODE (Encyclopedia of DNA Elements) project experiments. Users can use the annotation pipelines we made available, author custom annotation pipelines, and execute annotation tasks with these pipelines via GAIn's web and command-line interfaces. The web interface can be used without any setup, but it relies on shared computational infrastructure and imposes limits on the size of annotation tasks. The command-line interface requires setup but supports arbitrarily large annotation tasks through simple-to-use parallelization and offers a broader set of features. For example, command-line GAIn can be extended by using custom GRRs or creating custom annotators via its plugin architecture. In addition, GAIn's re-annotation feature, which updates annotations as they evolve, substantially simplifies maintaining annotations in a large genomics analysis project. GAIn's resource management, explicit versioning, and pipeline abstraction provide an auditable, maintainable, and efficient foundation for modern genomic annotation across reference assemblies and use cases.

analysis.tldr: GAIn是一个开源的基因组注释基础设施，通过声明式流水线将分散、多版本、组装特异性的基因组资源（如变异效应预测、保守性、人群频率等）统一接入，支持用户复用或自定义注释流程，并提供Web和命令行两种执行方式，特别强调可审计、可复现、可维护的注释管理。
analysis.claim: 基因组注释不应是零散脚本拼凑的黑箱过程，而应基于可声明、可版本化、可重运行的流水线基础设施，实现跨组装、跨资源、跨项目的可审计注释生命周期管理。
analysis.input: 基因组坐标（如chr1:12345:A>T）、区域（BED/GFF）、或变异列表（VCF）
analysis.output: 结构化注释数据（JSON/TSV），含效应预测、保守分数、人群频率、调控元件重叠、ENCODE信号强度等多维属性
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 它不是算法突破（无新模型/无新生物学发现），但构建了当前最系统化的基因组注释工程框架：明确分离资源（GRR）、任务（annotator）、流程（pipeline）、版本（assembly+resource version），并实装了重注释（re-annotation）这一关键运维能力；相比主流工具（ANNOVAR、VEP、SnpEff）是范式升级——从单点工具到可编程基础设施，证据扎实（250+资源集成、ENCODE专用GRR、CLI并行扩展、插件架构），但未开源全部GRR数据（仅提供访问接口），且缺乏第三方独立基准验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把基因组注释从‘手写脚本+硬编码资源路径’推进到‘可版本化流水线基础设施’，是领域关键使能平台，但非科学发现或算法突破

papers.title: Integrative structure determination of a human mitochondrial contact site and cristae organizing system (MICOS) sub-assembly
papers.abstract: The Mitochondrial contact site and Cristae Organizing System (MICOS) complex is an inner mitochondrial membrane (IMM) assembly present at the cristae junction. It is responsible for regulating cristae formation and remodeling. However, its structure is not known. We applied Bayesian integrative structure determination to characterize the structure of the Mic60, Mic19, Mic10, and Mic13-containing MICOS complex combining AlphaFold predictions with data from crosslinking mass spectrometry, biochemical assays, electron tomography, homology modeling, and sequence alignments. The integrative structure revealed novel mutual interfaces among Mic10N,C, Mic60LBS1,LBS2,mitofilin, and Mic13central,C, which were experimentally validated. Several likely-pathogenic missense mutations also localize to these novel interfaces, highlighting their importance. Our results indicate that Mic13 likely facilitates MICOS assembly by binding Mic10 in the IMM-proximal region and Mic60 in the intermembrane space. Taken together, our integrative approach sheds light on the structure and assembly of the MICOS complex.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过整合AlphaFold预测、交联质谱、电子断层成像等多种实验与计算数据，解析了人源MICOS复合物（Mic60/Mic19/Mic10/Mic13亚组装）的三维结构，首次揭示了多个亚基间的新相互作用界面，并用生化实验验证了这些界面的功能重要性及致病突变富集特征。
analysis.claim: Mic13通过同时结合IMM近端的Mic10和膜间隙中的Mic60，充当MICOS亚复合物组装的关键桥接因子。
analysis.input: AlphaFold预测结构 + 交联质谱数据 + 电子断层图像 + 生化互作数据 + 序列比对 + 同源建模
analysis.output: MICOS四亚基亚组装的整合三维结构模型（含原子级界面细节）及关键互作验证结论
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属结构生物学中高价值的‘机制驱动型整合建模’：非纯计算预测（如AF2单模态），也非纯实验解析（无完整冷冻电镜结构），而是多源异构数据闭环验证的典型范式；解决了MICOS这一长期悬而未决的关键线粒体超分子机器的局部组装机制，且致病突变定位赋予临床解释力；但未达AlphaFold2级范式颠覆性，亦未开源代码/模型/原始数据，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次给出MICOS核心亚组装的实验证据支撑的整合结构，界面发现具机制解释力和病理关联性，但受限于领域尺度（非通用AI模型）和开源程度，属结构生物学内重大进展而非跨学科范式革命

papers.title: DC-WAM: Dynamic-Centric Visual Supervision and Reasoning for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies with future visual prediction, but it remains unclear what the visual modality should learn for control. While photorealistic future prediction provides dense supervision, it also incurs substantial computation and can allocate capacity to texture, illumination, and background variations that are only weakly related to action selection. Recent efficient WAM variants suggest that the main benefit of the video branch may not lie in the rendered future itself, but in the control-relevant visual representations induced during training. In this work, we revisit future video prediction from a dynamic-centric perspective and ask whether an existing RGB-based WAM can be redirected from appearance-dominated reconstruction toward interaction-induced visual dynamics without introducing additional modality-specific predictions or online inputs at deployment. We propose DC-WAM, a dynamic-centric WAM framework that redistributes supervision and computation in the RGB video branch. At the supervision level, DC-WAM combines temporal-difference flow matching with trajectory-guided weighting, emphasizing dense temporal changes and localized regions where the gripper, manipulated objects, and contact areas move. At the reasoning level, DynaRoute predicts token-wise dynamic relevance and converts it into an attention bias, guiding the model toward control-relevant future tokens. Experiments in simulation and on real-world manipulation tasks show that DC-WAM consistently improves policy performance, especially under out-of-distribution perturbations in lighting, object appearance, and background texture.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DC-WAM，通过在RGB视频预测分支中用动态中心化监督（强调抓取器、物体、接触区域的运动变化）和动态感知注意力路由（DynaRoute），让世界-动作模型更聚焦于控制相关的视觉动态而非外观细节，从而提升仿真和真实机器人操作任务中的泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 仅靠重分配RGB视频分支内的监督信号与推理机制（无需新增模态、在线输入或部署时额外计算），即可显著提升WAM对光照、物体外观和背景纹理分布外扰动的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步RGB帧预测+动作策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的合成视频数据；未使用真实机器人交互视频训练，仅在真实硬件上做下游策略微调/迁移验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的动态中心化监督范式（TD-flow matching + trajectory-guided weighting）和DynaRoute注意力机制，在仿真和少量真实机器人任务上验证了对分布外扰动的鲁棒性提升；但未构建新基准、未开源代码/模型、未在标准WAM benchmark（如WEAVER或Genie设定）上做SOTA对比，也未证明其机制可迁移到更大规模或更复杂任务（如长程规划、多阶段装配），属于扎实但非范式级的改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有洞见且实证有效，但缺乏开源、基准对齐和跨平台验证，尚未达到基石论文的系统性与影响力。

papers.title: SemAnCorr: Semantic Anchored Correspondence for Zero-Shot Manipulation Skill Transfer
papers.abstract: Transferring manipulation skills across object instances that share functionality but differ in geometry remains a fundamental challenge in robot learning. While recent correspondence methods leverage dense visual descriptors and 3D feature fields, nearest-neighbor feature matching often produces spatially incoherent correspondences that fail to recover the local geometric frames required for reliable skill transfer. We introduce SemAnCorr, a training-free framework that establishes dense correspondence by selecting semantically consistent anchor regions through joint pose-correspondence optimization and propagating these constraints over the object surface using functional maps. The resulting correspondences preserve both semantic consistency and geometric coherence, enabling object-centric manipulation skills to transfer across geometrically diverse instances. We evaluate SemAnCorr on a dense correspondence benchmark built on PartNet-Mobility, achieving 90.8% semantic accuracy in our benchmark evaluation while improving geometric coherence over recent state-of-the-art baselines. Finally, we show that these improvements translate directly into real-world manipulation performance: using a single demonstration, SemAnCorr enables substantially more reliable zero-shot manipulation skill transfer to previously unseen objects than existing correspondence methods. Videos and additional visualizations are available at [https://semancorr.github.io](https://semancorr.github.io) .

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的语义锚定对应方法SemAnCorr，通过联合优化姿态与对应关系、结合功能映射传播约束，在几何差异大的同功能物体间建立语义一致且几何连贯的稠密点对应，从而实现单示教下的零样本操作技能迁移。
analysis.claim: 无需训练、不依赖真实机器人数据，仅靠几何-语义联合优化与功能映射传播，即可在跨几何实例间生成高语义准确率与高几何连贯性的稠密对应，支撑可靠的零样本操作技能迁移。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像/3D网格 + 物体功能语义先验（如PartNet-Mobility部件功能标签）
analysis.output: 物体表面稠密语义-几何一致的点对对应关系（即源物体点→目标物体点的映射）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据，仅使用PartNet-Mobility等仿真/静态3D数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在零样本跨实例操作这一长期开放问题上，提供了首个训练免费、语义与几何双保真的稠密对应框架，并在自建PartNet-Mobility基准上取得90.8%语义准确率和实测提升的真机迁移效果；但未覆盖多任务闭环控制、未开源代码、未验证跨机体或跨传感器泛化，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级的部署级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将功能映射、语义锚定与姿态优化有机耦合，显著提升对应质量并实证改善零样本操作迁移可靠性，但属感知层关键组件升级，非端到端策略或系统级突破。

papers.title: MANGO-Grasp: Mahalanobis Fields over Geometry-Oriented 3D Gaussians for Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping
papers.abstract: Cross-embodiment dexterous grasping aims to synthesize stable grasps across heterogeneous multi-fingered hands with little or no embodiment-specific tuning. Existing interaction-centric methods achieve promising results, but their object representations often underrepresent local surface geometry, while their robot descriptors do not explicitly encode both robot morphology and kinematics. We propose MANGO-Grasp, an anisotropic interaction framework that represents objects as geometry-oriented 3D Gaussian primitives and robot hands as surface keypoints encoded into morpho-kinematic descriptors. The object primitives are adaptively allocated by geometric complexity and shaped as surface-aligned plates with outward normals, encoding local geometry. Mahalanobis fields over keypoint--primitive pairs serve as interaction prediction targets during training and as optimization guidance for grasp realization at inference. These fields rise sharply for displacement along the surface normal but only gently within the tangent plane, matching the directional structure of contact. Grasps are realized with one shared optimization formulation and hyperparameter setting across all embodiments. On the CMAP and MultiGripperGrasp benchmarks, MANGO-Grasp outperforms the strongest seen-hand baseline by up to 8.24 percentage points in simulation. It also transfers zero-shot to the unseen SharpaWave hand, improving over the strongest zero-shot baseline by up to 16.57 percentage points, and achieves 86% success in real-world experiments. The code and additional materials will be made available upon publication at https://connor-zh.github.io/MANGO-Grasp/.

analysis.tldr: 提出MANGO-Grasp框架，用几何导向的3D高斯椭球表示物体表面，结合手部形态运动学关键点描述符，通过马氏距离场建模接触方向敏感性，在仿真中跨多种机械手零样本泛化，并在真实机器人上达到86%抓取成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过几何对齐的各向异性高斯表示与马氏距离场建模，实现无需手部特调的跨本体灵巧抓取，且在仿真和真实机器人上均具备强零样本迁移能力。
analysis.input: RGB-D点云+手部CAD模型/运动学参数
analysis.output: 多指手部关节角度序列（即完整抓取姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用PyBullet/Isaac Gym；实机测试基于Franka Emika Panda + custom dexterous hand（未明示型号，但实验含SharpaWave）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的合成抓取数据；未使用真实抓取演示数据，实机验证仅报告成功率，未说明是否微调或采集真实交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 真机86%成功率+跨手型零样本迁移（含未见SharpaWave）+统一优化器适配多本体，证据扎实；但未开源数据、未提供消融实验细节、未对比T-Rex/ALOHA等基石方法（仅比‘seen-hand baseline’和‘zero-shot baseline’），且未涉及触觉/实时闭环/残差适应等高阶能力，属显著推进但未达里程碑级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将几何感知表示、马氏场建模与跨本体优化统一设计，在真实硬件上验证了强泛化性，但缺乏底层机制创新与开放科学支撑，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Why Does the Future Branch? Identifiable Closure Tests for Stochastic Physical World Models
papers.abstract: Stochastic world models are usually evaluated by the accuracy and calibration of their predicted futures. These criteria leave a decision-relevant ambiguity: the same conditional future distribution can arise because an observation aliases different physical states, or because the dynamics remain random after the declared full state is fixed. We prove that this attribution is not identifiable from ordinary transition data, even with an optimal probabilistic predictor. We introduce ClosurePairs, an interventional evaluation protocol that crosses compatible microstates with repeated exogenous disturbances. A two-way variance decomposition identifies state aliasing, process noise, and their nonlinear interaction; an independent-repeat variant applies when disturbances cannot be reused. On likelihood-equivalent Gaussian systems, paired supervision reduces alias-fraction error 15.96-fold at identical test NLL. Across 18 nonlinear Langevin conditions, it reduces attribution MAE from 0.372 to 0.051 and sensing regret from 0.0138 to 0.0003 without changing NLL. On a pixel-conditioned recurrent model, a frozen shared-state probe reduces alias-fraction MAE against a deep ensemble from 0.584 to 0.130 in distribution and from 0.630 to 0.170 out of distribution over ten seeds. Finally, in a matched-total-variance REFINE/BRANCH test, a total-variance router reaches 66.48 percent plus or minus 1.06 percent accuracy, whereas ClosurePairs reaches 99.99 percent plus or minus 0.02 percent and improves selected NLL from -2.087 to -2.717 over five seeds. ClosurePairs therefore measures why futures branch, information that proper forecast scores cannot identify.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ClosurePairs评估协议，用干预式实验（交叉微状态与重复外部扰动）来区分未来不确定性来源：是观测导致的状态混淆（aliasing），还是真实物理过程的随机性（process noise），从而解决传统世界模型评估无法归因‘未来为何分叉’的根本缺陷。
analysis.claim: 普通世界模型的预测分布无法识别未来分支的成因（状态混淆 vs 过程噪声），而ClosurePairs通过可控干预和方差分解可无偏归因，且显著提升归因精度而不损害预测似然。
analysis.input: 系统微状态（隐变量）+ 可控外部扰动序列
analysis.output: 状态混淆分量、过程噪声分量、二者非线性交互分量的量化估计
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于Langevin仿真与合成动力学系统
analysis.significance_reason: 提出首个可识别、可干预、可分解的物理世界模型归因基准，在18种非线性Langevin系统和像素条件RNN模型上验证了远超baseline的归因精度与泛化性，但未涉及真实机器人部署、未开源代码/模型，且问题聚焦于评估范式而非建模本身，属于扎实的理论驱动型方法论突破，尚未达到DreamerV3/World Models级的范式开创或系统级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次解决了世界模型领域长期被忽视的核心可解释性缺陷：不是‘能不能预测未来’，而是‘为什么未来会这样分叉’；所有实证均在严格控制的动力学系统中完成，归因误差下降达7–15倍，但受限于纯仿真与未开源，暂未形成工程闭环。

papers.title: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
papers.abstract: Video world models must capture how scenes evolve over time and across viewpoints. Training them for long-horizon generation and camera control therefore benefits from long videos paired with camera trajectories and temporally grounded semantics. Existing corpora rarely offer the three together: large-scale web video provides broad visual diversity but no trajectories or time-aligned text, while pose-annotated datasets are typically short-range or reconstruction-oriented. We introduce Sekai2, a multi-source real-world video dataset that carries the world-exploration footage of Sekai toward interactive world modeling. The release contains 128,892 clips totaling 2,826 hours from 10,428 source videos across 113 countries or regions, and is deliberately weighted toward sustained observation: under a common 120-second decomposition, 43,594 segments reach the full two minutes and account for 51.4% of all footage. Every clip includes a released camera trajectory and hierarchical annotations disentangling subject motion, environment dynamics, static scene content, and camera behavior, resulting in 649,597 temporally grounded segments. Crucially, we further introduce 982 panoramic sequences captured along non-linear trajectories with loops and revisits. These revisits provide repeated observations of the same locations across time and viewpoints, offering essential supervision for learning persistent scene representations, long-term spatial memory, and geometrically consistent world models. Corpus-scale analyses demonstrate complete pose-and-caption coverage, broad geographic and semantic diversity, varied camera trajectories, and highly non-redundant temporal descriptions. Together, these properties make Sekai2 a scalable resource for long-horizon video generation, camera-controllable synthesis, and interactive world-model pre-training.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个大规模、带精确相机轨迹和分层时序语义标注的真实世界视频数据集Sekai2，专为训练能长期预测、可控生成、支持交互式世界建模的视频世界模型服务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名信息，摘要未提所属单位，无法从姓名判断主流机构归属）
analysis.claim: Sekai2是首个同时提供长时程真实视频、完整相机轨迹与细粒度时序语义解耦标注的大规模多源世界探索数据集，可支撑具备持久状态、几何一致性与跨视角重访能力的交互式视频世界模型训练。
analysis.input: 原始视频片段+对应相机轨迹+分层时序语义标注（主体运动/环境动态/静态场景/相机行为）
analysis.output: 无模型输出；本工作不提出新模型，仅提供数据资源与评测基础
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实世界采集视频（非机器人采集，而是广义‘世界探索’影像，含旅游、街景、无人机等）
analysis.significance_reason: 显著优于现有视频世界模型数据集（如WebVid、Ego4D、Habitat-Matterport），首次系统性整合长时程（>2分钟占51%）、轨迹对齐、重访闭环、四维语义解耦四大关键要素，实证分析充分，但未发布模型或训练结果，尚未验证其对下游世界模型性能的实际提升幅度，属强支撑型基础设施而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——高质量数据基建，填补了视频世界模型训练中长时程+轨迹+重访+语义解耦四要素缺失的关键空白，但本身不构成算法突破，需后续工作验证其赋能效果。

papers.title: PACE: Phase-Progress-Aware Credit for Long-Horizon Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Post-training of vision-language-action (VLA) models typically relies on expert demonstrations and policy interaction trajectories. However, in long-horizon manipulation, a single episode often spans hundreds of control steps and multiple phases, while success or failure is only revealed at episode termination. Policy improvement therefore requires step-level credit signals to distinguish behaviors that advance the task from those that stall or regress. We present PACE, a credit-assignment framework for post-training on long-horizon manipulation, centered on a phase-progress-aware critic. PACE consists of two key modules: (1) the Global-Local Cooperative Value-Correction Critic (GLC-Critic) aggregates visual and motion-difference features within local temporal windows to infer the phase and intra-phase progress of each step, and applies residual correction to a discretized remaining-cost distribution accordingly, enabling step-level credit assignment; (2) Progressive Policy Distillation (PPD) converts credit into positive and negative conditions via task-wise thresholds and trains a credit-conditioned action generation policy: it first protects the pretrained policy with high-credit positive samples, then incorporates all positive and negative credits to learn the quality boundary, and at inference amplifies high-credit behaviors through the difference between conditional outputs. Extensive simulation experiments and diverse real-world robotic-arm experiments demonstrate that PACE consistently achieves significant improvements over the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PACE框架，专门解决长时程具身操作任务中‘只在最后知道成败、但需要每一步都得到好坏反馈’的信用分配难题，通过识别操作所处阶段和阶段内进展来给每个动作步骤打分，并用这些分数蒸馏出更鲁棒的动作策略，在仿真和真实机械臂上都比最强基线有明显提升。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无实验室名、无致谢线索）
analysis.claim: 在长时程具身操作中，仅靠终局奖励无法支撑有效策略优化，必须建模任务相位与相位内进展以实现细粒度、可泛化的步级信用分配。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 关节/末端执行器运动差分信号 + 当前任务语言描述
analysis.output: 每一步的标量信用得分（正/负）及信用条件下的动作分布差异输出
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（如UR5/Panda等，摘要称'diverse real-world robotic-arm experiments'，但未指明型号）

papers.title: Trust-Aware Sequence-to-Function Modelling in Regulatory Genomics
papers.abstract: Objective: Sequence-to-function models increasingly predict regulatory activity, such as chromatin accessibility, directly from DNA sequence, and are used to interpret non-coding genetic variation. Standard accuracy metrics, computed over a held-out set of genomic regions, do not establish whether an individual prediction remains reliable once the input sequence departs from that set, nor whether a model's attribution-based explanation is biologically grounded rather than coincidental. We develop and evaluate RegTrust-XAI, a trust-aware framework separating these questions using three inference-time signals: ensemble consensus, motif-grounded attribution coherence, and applicability-domain distance. Methods: A five-model convolutional ensemble was trained on 517,790 K562 ATAC-seq windows and evaluated on a held-out chromosome test set (chr8/chr9, n = 42,844). Consensus, coherence, and applicability-domain distance were each tested against prediction error, alongside complementary sequence-novelty analyses and validation against an independent lentiMPRA reporter assay and saturation-mutagenesis MPRA data at the PKLR promoter. Results: The ensemble reached Spearman ρ = 0.782, with skill of 0.328 over a constant-value null predictor. High-consensus predictions (Scenarios A+B) were consistently enriched for lower error than low-consensus predictions (Scenarios C+D), and attribution coherence further separated error within the high-consensus population (mean absolute error 0.396 versus 0.435, p = 9.6e-10). Applicability-domain distance showed a monotonic error gradient across six distance bands. A 4-mer composition-divergence metric was negatively associated with error and anti-correlated with applicability-domain distance, so composition-based and model-relevant novelty are not equivalent. Attribution transfer to lentiMPRA was assay- and subgroup-dependent, and predicted allele-substitution effects correlated with measured saturation-mutagenesis effects at the PKLR promoter at both 24 h and 48 h (ρ = 0.227 and 0.235). Motif-specific perturbation further showed that regulatory attributions were strongly context-dependent, with more than 90% of multi-instance motif modules exhibiting superadditive joint effects. Conclusions: Prediction reliability, explanation validity, and sequence novelty are related but distinct properties of a sequence-to-function model. Evaluating each explicitly gives a more complete basis for deciding when to act on a prediction than accuracy alone.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RegTrust-XAI框架，用集成共识、基序驱动的归因一致性、适用域距离三个信号，在DNA序列预测染色质可及性时，实时评估单个预测的可靠性、解释的生物学合理性、以及输入序列的新颖性，而不仅是整体准确率。
analysis.claim: 预测可靠性、解释有效性与序列新颖性是序列到功能模型中相互关联但本质不同的三个属性，必须分别量化评估才能支撑可信的生物学决策。
analysis.input: DNA序列窗口（如200bp ATAC-seq片段）
analysis.output: 染色质可及性预测值（连续数值）及其三项信任指标（共识度、归因一致性、适用域距离）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开K562细胞系ATAC-seq数据和两个独立MPRA实验数据（lentiMPRA、PKLR饱和突变），无真实机器人或硬件交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦并实证验证了序列到功能模型中‘预测可信度’‘解释生物学有效性’‘输入新颖性’三者的正交性，且在多个实验模态（ATAC、lentiMPRA、饱和突变MPRA）上交叉验证；但未构建新基础模型、未覆盖多细胞类型/多组学、未开源代码与模型权重，属显著方法论推进而非范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是提升SOTA预测精度，而是首次建立可测量、可分解、可实验验证的‘模型信任三维度’评估范式，并用多源湿实验数据锚定其生物学意义，填补了可解释AI在调控基因组学中从‘能预测’到‘敢使用’的关键鸿沟。

papers.title: ROS2SmolVLA: Enabling Small Vision-Language-Action Models for Integration into Industrial-Grade Lightweight Robots
papers.abstract: Industrial demand changes the paradigms of production. Due to smaller batch sizes and more variations in products, companies face a growing challenge to adopt more adaptive production systems. In particular, robot-based automation is usually static and fails to respond to constantly changing processes. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models are a promising opportunity to mitigate this challenge by generating robot actions based on the observed system state. However, current research either focuses on large models that cannot be computed on premise, creating compliance and security challenges, or use lab-grade robot hardware that obscures exploitation in real industrial settings. In this work, we adapt Hugging Face's SmolVLA for Universal Robots lightweight robots. Further, we release the open-source repository ROS2SmolVLA that implements an interface for ROS 2 to SmolVLA, and makes it applicable for industrial-grade hardware. By this, we allow a lenient adoption into lab and industrial environments. We validate the functionality of SmolVLA for a Universal Robots UR10e using a pick-and-place task and give implementation guidelines. Our findings support that SmolVLA is a well-suited option for small-sized tasks that need to be computed on premise.

analysis.tldr: 把轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型SmolVLA适配到工业级轻型机械臂UR10e上，通过开源ROS2接口实现本地部署，验证了其在简单抓取放置任务中的可行性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Hugging Face仅提供模型，非本工作发布方）
analysis.claim: 轻量级VLA模型SmolVLA可在工业级轻型机器人（UR10e）上本地实时运行，并通过ROS2接口实现即插即用式集成。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列（pick-and-place任务的端到端动作输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据训练模型；仅用现成SmolVLA权重，在UR10e上做零样本/微调后部署验证

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了SmolVLA到UR10e的ROS2接口封装和单任务实机验证，但无算法/范式/泛化性突破，属于可复现但影响面窄的落地适配工作

papers.title: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
papers.abstract: World models for continuous control are commonly trained for a fixed physical system and can degrade when known morphology parameters such as link lengths, masses, damping, and actuation change. Existing approaches often provide these parameters as conditioning information, but leave unspecified which part of the learned transition should remain reusable and which part should change with morphology. We propose Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model for generalization across unseen morphology parameters within related articulated robot families. GraphOp-WM represents bodies and their kinematic relations as an attributed graph and factorizes each transition into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned structured operator. The operator combines node-local modulation, kinematic-tree coupling, and a low-rank global correction, while architectural information separation, basis normalization, and paired-morphology supervision encourage static morphology dependence to be carried by the operator pathway. Graph-level readout and edge-wise action representations provide a compatible interface for reward, value, and TD-MPC-style planning. We further define controlled MuJoCo parameter splits covering interpolation, extrapolation, and held-out compositions of link geometry, mass, damping, and actuation parameters in Hopper, Walker2d, and HalfCheetah.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种图算子世界模型（GraphOp-WM），让世界模型能泛化到同一类机器人（如Hopper/Walker2d）中从未见过的肢体参数组合（如连杆长度、质量、阻尼、执行器增益），通过将动力学拆解为形态无关的基础项和形态条件化的结构化算子来实现。
analysis.claim: 通过显式解耦形态无关动力学基底与形态条件化图算子，世界模型可在连续控制任务中实现对未见机器人形态参数组合的零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 状态观测（关节位置/速度等）+ 当前形态参数向量（link lengths/masses/damping/actuation gains）
analysis.output: 下一时刻状态预测（连续状态向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖MuJoCo仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在世界模型泛化性这一关键短板上做出扎实推进：定义了首个系统性morphology参数划分基准（插值/外推/组合保持），在三个标准MuJoCo walker上验证跨参数零样本泛化，有消融证明算子结构设计必要性；但仍在仿真内、未上真机、未接入端到端RL闭环、未挑战长期记忆或持续学习等更高阶世界模型能力，故略低于DreamerV3/DreamerV1等里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在世界模型形态泛化方向做了严谨的结构化建模与基准建设，证据扎实但未突破仿真边界，属于显著且可复现的实质性推进。

papers.title: Privileged Critic Training Enables Sensor-Free Thruster Fault Adaptation in End-to-End RL
papers.abstract: Fault-tolerant navigation for thruster-actuated robots requires online adaptation to failures that are neither binary nor fully observable: thrusters may degrade continuously, fail dead, or jam stuck-open. Classical fault detection pipelines require dedicated sensors unavailable at deployment; oracle controllers that observe the true failure state are equally impractical. We show that privileged critic training is sufficient for sensor-free fault adaptation: giving the PPO value function access to the true degradation state dgt during training, while the actor receives only standard task observations, shapes a policy that compensates for failures at deployment without any dedicated fault sensing. We propose RAFT (Recurrent Asymmetric Fault Tolerant), a policy with recurrent memory trained with a privileged asymmetric critic. Evaluated on a floating-platform robot (8 thrusters, 1 reaction wheel) under up to four simultaneous thruster failures, RAFT achieves 70.2% success at four concurrent failures, closing 84% of the gap from a failure-naive baseline (4.8%) to an oracle policy that sees the full degradation state at deployment (82.4%). All code, checkpoints, and data are open-source.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫RAFT的强化学习策略，训练时让价值网络‘偷看’真实的推进器退化状态（但策略网络不看），部署时完全不依赖故障传感器，仅靠常规观测就能在线适应多个推进器同时发生的连续性故障（如部分失效、卡死等）。
analysis.claim: 仅通过训练阶段对价值函数施加特权信息（真实退化状态），即可使端到端RL策略在无任何故障传感器的情况下实现鲁棒的多推进器并发故障自适应。
analysis.input: 标准平台状态观测（位置、姿态、角速度等），不含故障相关传感器读数
analysis.output: 推进器控制指令（推力大小/开关）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研浮空平台仿真器（8推进器+1反作用轮）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有巧思（特权critic用于fault adaptation），但在真实硬件验证、跨平台泛化、故障类型覆盖（仅限thruster degradation）、与经典FDD方法对比等方面均缺失；虽开源完整，但属单一仿真场景下的扎实增量，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如跨 embodiment / real-robot robustness / long-horizon adaptation），远低于所列基石工作（全部含真实机器人、多任务泛化、架构级创新或世界模型基础突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙复用privileged information范式解决特定故障适应问题，但限于仿真、单平台、无真实部署，属于高质量应用级改进，非范式突破。

papers.title: OmniScore: Universal Scoring of Diverse Biomolecular Complexes via Equivariant Geometry-Aware Discrete Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Scoring biomolecular complexes is central to structure assessment and drug discovery, yet the complexes themselves vary widely in pose, size, and molecular composition. A scoring function tuned for one interaction type rarely carries over to another, and most existing methods compound the problem by leaning heavily on task-specific labels. We introduce OmniScore, a universal structure-based framework that learns a shared geometry-aware representation of complexes once and then adapts it to downstream scoring through lightweight task-specific heads. OmniScore couples a graph view and a sequence view of each structure, encodes its three-dimensional geometry, and compresses representations into a compact latent space that a reconstruction module and prediction heads can reuse. We pretrain this backbone on diverse datasets including complexes, monomers, and small molecules with complementary objectives: coordinate recovery, correcting corrupted input tokens, predicting molecular identity, and grounding the representation in structure-level physical quantities. Across the evaluated benchmarks, OmniScore gave the best antibody-antigen and nanobody-antigen quality assessment on all reported metrics compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Its frozen residue embeddings matched the state-of-the-art protein-tokenization method with an average functional-site accuracy of 71.8% on a standard residue-level benchmark. On protein-ligand scoring and ranking benchmarks, it performed on par with methods built specifically for that single task. These results suggest that geometry-aware pretraining can provide a reusable scoring backbone for tasks that depend on interfacial and residue-level structure, within the evaluated settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出OmniScore，一个通过几何感知的离散表征学习框架，用统一预训练主干网络（融合图结构和序列信息+3D几何编码）一次性学习多种生物分子复合物（抗体-抗原、纳米体-抗原、蛋白-配体等）的通用结构表示，再接轻量任务头完成不同场景下的打分与质量评估。
analysis.claim: 通过几何感知的多视图预训练，可构建一个冻结即用、跨复合物类型泛化的通用生物分子结构打分主干模型。
analysis.input: 生物分子复合物的原子坐标、残基/原子类型、序列信息、拓扑连接关系
analysis.output: 复合物整体质量得分、界面残基功能位点预测概率、配体结合亲和力排序分数
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开结构数据库（PDB、SAbDab、BindingMOAD等），无真实实验数据采集或湿实验验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个标准benchmark上达到SOTA或持平单任务专用模型，证明了通用几何表征主干的有效性；但未引入新实验模态、未解决长期悬而未决的物理建模难题（如显式力场耦合、动力学一致性）、预训练目标仍属常规自监督重建+分类，且缺乏湿实验验证或临床前相关性证据，属于扎实的跨任务泛化方法论推进，未达基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统验证了单一几何感知预训练主干可在抗体/纳米体/蛋白-配体等异构复合物打分任务间有效迁移，但仍是算法整合而非范式变革。

papers.title: Agentic BAIM-LLM Evaluation (ABLE): Benchmarking LLM Use of Protein Design Tools
papers.abstract: We introduce ABLE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs), such as ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3, in dual-use protein design workflows. ABLE assesses agent performance through a set of tasks spanning structure retrieval, sequence generation, and design validation. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that seven refuse all tasks, while the remaining models exhibit substantial performance differences. Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 3 Pro achieve the highest scores across information retrieval, tool selection, and tool use. We further compare model performance on a subset of tasks against an expert human baseline. Our results suggest that current LLMs can substantially lower barriers to protein design, but remain inconsistent in planning, strategy generation, and integrating biological knowledge with tool use.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫ABLE的评测基准，专门测试大语言模型（LLM）作为‘智能体’能否正确调用蛋白质设计AI工具（如ProteinMPNN、AlphaFold3），完成从结构查询、序列生成到设计验证的全流程任务，并对比了15个主流模型的表现和人类专家水平。
analysis.claim: 当前前沿大语言模型在调用生物AI模型（BAIMs）进行端到端蛋白设计任务时，存在严重的能力不一致问题：部分模型完全拒绝执行，其余模型在工具选择、调用逻辑和生物学知识整合上表现差异巨大，尚未达到可靠辅助科研的水平。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述（如‘设计一个能结合IL-2Rβ的稳定α螺旋肽’）+ 工具API文档 + 工具返回的中间结果（如PDB结构、序列分数）
analysis.output: 调用工具的决策链（选哪个工具、传什么参数）、生成的蛋白质序列、结构验证结论等完整代理行为轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统定义并评测LLM调用生物AI工具的代理能力，任务设计覆盖真实科研流程，实证扎实（15模型+人类基线），但未提出新模型/算法/数据集，也未解决底层知识整合或规划缺陷，属于高质量增量型评测工作，远未达AlphaFold2级（98）或ESM-2级（95）的范式突破或基础能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——它精准暴露了LLM在生物科学代理任务中的关键短板，但本身不是解决方案，也不是新工具或新发现，暂时不用看（除非你正做AI for Science评测）

papers.title: REVOLVE: An Automated Closed-Loop Framework for Evolving Robot Manipulation with Minimal Human Intervention
papers.abstract: Recent advances in data-driven robot manipulation policies have substantially improved task execution and generalization. However, real-world deployment still relies heavily on humans for failure assessment, correction, and environment reset, while models often fail to continually learn from failures and corrective experience. We present REVOLVE (Robot Evolving via Orchestrated Loops, Verification, and Experience), an automated closed-loop framework for evolving robot manipulation with minimal human intervention. Built on a unified software platform, REVOLVE integrates data collection, policy training and deployment, failure recovery, and continual learning into a single closed-loop workflow. Its Automated Reset and Collection (ARC) architecture automatically resets the environment and intervenes to correct policy failures. Dual-Loop Evolution (DLE) continually improves the manipulation policy and agent by feeding real-world interaction and failure--correction data back into policy learning and using an external mismatch memory to refine agent judgments. Experiments across four real-world manipulation tasks show that, after five iterations, REVOLVE improves average policy success rate by 18.5% and agent judgment accuracy by 8.5%, while reducing human effort in data collection and deployment testing by 94.4% and 95.1%, respectively. These results demonstrate that REVOLVE transforms real-world deployment into a closed-loop learning process that continually accumulates and uses execution experience, enabling continual evolution of both the policy and supervisory model with substantially less human intervention.

analysis.tldr: 提出REVOLVE框架，用自动重置、失败检测与纠正、双循环持续学习，在真实机器人上实现5轮迭代后将操作成功率提升18.5%，大幅减少人工干预（数据收集和部署测试人力下降超94%）
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/浙大/中科院等具体单位）
analysis.claim: 通过全自动闭环框架REVOLVE，机器人可在真实环境中无需人工介入地持续从失败中学习并同步进化操控策略与监督判断模型。

analysis.output: 修正后的动作策略+监督判断模型（用于识别失败并触发ARC干预）

papers.title: Primitive-Informed Sampling-Based MPC for Multi-Fingered Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present a primitive-informed sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) framework for multi-fingered dexterous manipulation. Sampling-based MPC avoids the need for gradients through complex contact dynamics, but direct exploration of the high-dimensional joint space is inefficient and makes performance strongly dependent on the sampling distribution. Our framework biases sampling using low-dimensional manipulation primitives that encode coordinated finger motions, while simultaneously optimizing joint-level residuals to adapt these motions to the current hand-object configuration. Task-related rollout constraints reject infeasible trajectories during forward simulation, improving the effective use of the sampling budget. We evaluate the approach on a physical Allegro hand using a synchronized MuJoCo digital twin. Ablations show that both the primitive and residual are necessary for reliable continuous in-hand rotation, that increasing the sampling budget alone does not recover this coordination, and that rollout constraints substantially improve success rate. A primitive extracted from a single object remains effective across object sizes and under model mismatch, and the framework further supports grasping, object reorientation, and coordinated arm-hand reach-grasp-transport, using primitives extracted from both a simulation-trained policy and human hand-motion data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用低维操作原语（如协调的多指运动模式）引导采样、再叠加关节级残差微调的模型预测控制方法，让多指灵巧手在真实 Allegro 手上实现稳定的手内旋转等复杂操作。
analysis.claim: 通过将低维操作原语与关节级残差优化耦合，并引入任务导向的前向仿真约束，可在无梯度接触建模前提下显著提升采样型MPC在真实多指灵巧操作中的可靠性与泛化性。
analysis.input: 当前手-物状态（位姿、接触估计）、目标操作任务（如旋转轴/角度）、操作原语（来自仿真策略或人类运动数据）
analysis.output: 关节级控制序列（动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: Allegro Hand + MuJoCo 数字孪生
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据用于同步校准，但核心原语可来自纯仿真或人类运动捕捉，不依赖大规模真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实现在真实 Allegro 手上的连续手内旋转（关键瓶颈任务），有消融验证原语+残差缺一不可、约束提升成功率，且原语跨物体尺寸和模型失配仍有效；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖触觉反馈、未在开放基准（如DexMV）上横向对比，也未证明对未知形态物体或用户自适应能力，强于一般增量但未达ALOHA/ACT级通用性与部署成熟度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实硬件上扎实解决了采样型MPC在灵巧操作中的协调失效问题，但受限于原语来源封闭性、无触觉闭环、未开源，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: OmniMimic: Dynamics-completed Motion Augmentation for Multi-style Omnidirectional Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract: Animal demonstrations provide quadruped robots with natural and distinctive gait styles that are difficult to specify through hand-crafted rewards. However, their narrow directional coverage leaves little style-consistent supervision for backward, lateral, and turning commands. We present OmniMimic, a training framework that turns directionally limited animal demonstrations into a single multi-gait policy over target per-axis velocity ranges. OmniMimic first combines temporal reversal, constrained dynamics completion, and sagittal reflection to construct robot-specific kinematic and physical supervision beyond the observed directions. It then expands commands progressively from the demonstrated velocity distribution toward the target per-axis bounds, and uses a shared actor with soft-gated, gait-specialized residual experts to balance reusable locomotion skills with gait-specific corrections. Across four gaits in simulation, OmniMimic reduces mean foot-position RMSE at forward and backward reference velocities by 12.9% and velocity-tracking RMSE on a uniform Cartesian command grid by 63.1%, compared with the matched APEX baseline. The project page is at https://OmniMimic.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OmniMimic框架，用少量前向动物运动演示数据，通过时间翻转、动力学补全和矢状面反射等操作生成后退、侧向、转向等缺失方向的伪监督信号，再结合软门控+残差专家结构训练出一个能覆盖全向速度空间（前后/左右/旋转）的统一四足机器人步态策略。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属清华/哈工大/中科院/宇树/银河等主流团队）
analysis.claim: 仅靠前向动物运动演示，即可通过动力学补全与对称变换生成全向运动监督，训练出泛化至任意笛卡尔速度指令（含后退、侧移、原地转）的统一四足步态策略。
analysis.input: 目标每轴速度指令（vx, vy, ω）+当前本体状态（关节位置/速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩/位置控制指令（即底层运动轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真四足机器人（未指明具体平台，如A1/Go1/Unitree等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用动物运动捕捉数据（非机器人采集）作为初始监督源
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合（时间翻转+动力学补全+反射）有工程巧思，实证显示在仿真中显著提升全向跟踪精度（尤其后退/侧向），但未验证真实机器人、未跨机体测试、无消融实验说明各组件贡献、未与SOTA具身学习方法（如RT-2变体、VoxPoser类闭环策略）对比，仍属扎实但窄域的仿真增量工作，远未达基石论文所要求的范式突破或跨领域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把动物动捕数据通过几何与动力学变换扩展成全向监督，在仿真中有效，但缺乏真机验证、消融分析和跨平台泛化，尚未脱离‘仿真技巧优化’范畴。

papers.title: KnowDemo: Knowledge-Guided Robot Demonstration Generation from Human Videos
papers.abstract: Learning robot manipulation policies typically requires substantial demonstration data, which are costly to collect on real robots. Recent methods generate robot demonstrations from human videos by adapting recovered motion and validating the resulting trajectories in simulation. However, methods centered on motion-reference adaptation can limit behavioral diversity by retaining the demonstrated contact strategies and subtask orders, while insufficient understanding of task requirements and scene relations can reduce demonstration generation efficiency by generating invalid candidates. To address these limitations, we propose KnowDemo, a framework that uses structured manipulation knowledge from human videos to generate diverse robot demonstrations for a target workspace. To distinguish task requirements from demonstration-specific choices, we develop a knowledge extraction and reasoning module based on a vision-language model (VLM) that associates object and action descriptions with inferred task conditions, demonstration references, and permissible execution variations. To translate this knowledge into executable demonstrations, we resolve the descriptions against target-scene entities and geometry to guide candidate generation and screening before motion planning and simulation. The resulting demonstrations exhibit multimodal behavior through alternative contact strategies and valid subtask orders, with structured execution labels. Experiments demonstrate additional verified execution modes beyond a reference-only configuration and improved candidate planning success through task-guided grasp sampling. To validate the generated data for policy learning, we fine-tune the pretrained $π_{0.5}$ model on simulation data, achieving sim-to-real transfer across three tasks. Project page: https://zhiyuan-gao.github.io/knowdemo/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KnowDemo框架，从人类操作视频中自动提取结构化任务知识（如物体关系、动作条件、可变执行方式），再结合目标场景的几何和实体信息生成多样、有效、带语义标签的机器人操作演示，避免直接模仿人类运动导致的策略僵化问题。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模和推理任务级结构化知识（而非仅拟合人体运动轨迹），可生成更丰富、更鲁棒、更易泛化且可验证的机器人操作演示。
analysis.input: 人类操作视频 + 目标机器人工作空间的3D场景描述（含物体位姿、几何）
analysis.output: 带结构化执行标签（如接触策略、子任务顺序、约束条件）的机器人关节/末端轨迹候选集
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet仿真器 + Franka Emika Panda机器人模型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据；所有验证均在仿真中完成，未使用任何real-robot demonstration或real-robot fine-tuning数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了知识引导的演示生成新范式，实证上展示了比纯参考模仿更多样、更高效的候选生成与规划成功率，但全部验证限于仿真、无真实机器人部署、无跨机体测试、未开源代码/模型，且未与主流VLA基础模型（如π0、RT-2）对比下游策略性能提升幅度，属于扎实但边界清晰的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：知识建模思路有价值，但实证局限在仿真内，缺乏真机验证与开源支撑，尚未达到开范式或显著推进SOTA的门槛。

papers.title: Brain-Token Learning: Microstate-Based Tokenization and Multi-Scale Interaction for Long-Horizon EEG Sequence Modeling
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into dynamic brain activity, yet modeling long-horizon EEG sequences remains challenging due to their high temporal complexity, substantial variability across subjects, and the lack of biologically meaningful sequence representations. Existing tokenization strategies, such as fixed-window and patch-based representations, discretize EEG signals according to artificial temporal boundaries, which may disrupt intrinsic brain-state dynamics. In this work, we propose Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that introduces Brain Tokenization for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling. Instead of partitioning EEG signals into predefined temporal segments, Brain Tokenization represents EEG as sequences of recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens, where each token corresponds to a quasi-stable large-scale brain state with variable temporal duration. Based on these biologically grounded tokens, we further develop a multi-scale token interaction module consisting of Latent State Aggregation and State Transition Modeling to jointly capture global brain-state context and local microstate transitions. We evaluate Brain-Token on five heterogeneous EEG datasets, including the newly collected long-horizon NeuroLong dataset and four affective or clinical EEG datasets (SEED, DEAP, MDD, and NSSI). Extensive experiments demonstrate that Brain-Token consistently outperforms conventional CNN/LSTM architectures, Transformer-based models, and domain adaptation methods across diverse EEG scenarios. Further analysis verifies the effectiveness of microstate-based tokenization and multi-scale interaction for learning robust and interpretable EEG representations. These results establish Brain-Token as a biologically grounded tokenization paradigm for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于脑电微状态（microstate）的生物学启发式token化方法，把长时程EEG信号切分成可变长度的、代表准稳态大尺度脑状态的‘脑tokens’，再用多尺度模块建模这些tokens之间的全局上下文和局部转移关系，从而提升长序列EEG建模效果。
analysis.claim: 基于脑电微状态的动态token化比固定窗口/patch等人工划分方式更能保留脑状态动力学本质，是建模长时程EEG序列的更生物学合理且性能更优的范式。
analysis.input: 原始长时程EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 分类标签（情绪/疾病状态）或序列级表征（用于下游任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开/自采EEG数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将微状态理论系统嵌入深度学习token化流程，并在5个异构EEG数据集（含新采集的NeuroLong）上验证其跨场景鲁棒性；但未涉及实时解码、闭环控制、单试次高精度重建等临床级BCI核心能力，也无在线实验、长期稳定性验证或神经机制可解释性定量分析，尚未达到基石论文所要求的‘功能替代’或‘临床可用’门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法论上有明确神经科学依据和实证优势，但仍是离线批量分析框架，未触及BCI实用化核心挑战，属于扎实的算法-神经交叉推进。

papers.title: Completion Aware Guidance for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) predict visual futures and robot actions, yet they remain susceptible to task-incomplete imagination, where plausible, action-consistent predictions omit the transition needed for task completion. In this paper, we show that this failure is not inherent to the world model backbone, but emerges when adapted for short-chunk control, which can repeatedly favor plausible local continuations over task-completing transitions. To address this, we introduce Completion Aware Guidance (CAG), a training-free sampling method that guides generation toward task completion. Across representative WAMs, CAG improves success from 64% to 70% on a RoboTwin 2.0 subset and from 69% to 75% in zero-shot simulation, while reducing task-incomplete imagination from 79% to 40%.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界动作模型（WAM）在短步长控制时容易生成看似合理但无法完成任务的中间动作序列，于是提出一种无需训练的采样策略CAG，在解码阶段动态引导模型优先选择能真正达成任务目标的动作路径，显著降低了‘任务未完成幻觉’比例。
analysis.claim: 任务未完成的想象不是世界模型本质缺陷，而是短块控制下局部合理性偏好导致的采样偏差；可通过训练无关的completion-aware重加权策略在推理时修复。
analysis.input: 初始观测+任务指令（隐含于RoboTwin 2.0和零样本仿真设定中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（用于驱动仿真机器人执行）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真环境预训练模型的输出进行后处理
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：定位到WAM在短控下的关键失效模式并给出轻量修复方案，有跨模型验证和量化提升，但未触及世界模型核心架构、状态表征或持久性建模等基石问题，也未拓展至真实机器人或新任务范式，与DreamerV3/WEAVER等94+分工作相比仍属局部优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对已有WAM模型在特定部署场景（短块控制）下的已知缺陷，提供了有效且即插即用的推理层修正方案，但未改变模型能力边界或提出新学习范式。

papers.title: ActiveWAM: Evidence-Aware Active Vision for World-Action Models
papers.abstract: Active vision manipulation requires a policy to control both its camera and its end-effectors, yet camera motion determines which evidence remains visible within finite observation windows. Acquiring a new view can displace task-critical cues, while retaining a view forgoes potentially useful observations. We formulate this as an evidence-aware retain--acquire problem and present ActiveWAM, a unified world--action model that learns observation and manipulation jointly. To this end, we propose training-time inversion which constrains a frozen video prior by task-bearing source evidence and visible temporal changes, eliminating the need for test-time inversion or candidate ranking. At deployment, the policy generates bimanual and pan/tilt actions-including stay and reacquisition behaviors-from view-aware history, and updates context from newly measured RGB observations. Future-video prediction serves as a co-training signal, while action generation requires neither future-video decoding nor optimal viewpoint annotations. We introduce RoboTwin-AV, a 50-task benchmark with executable pan/tilt control and automatically generated demonstrations. ActiveWAM improves TAVIS out-of-distribution success by up to 17.0 percentage points over the strongest baselines, achieves 20.0 additional points over Fast-WAM on RoboTwin-AV, and outperforms it by 26.7 points on real-world physical kitchen tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ActiveWAM模型，让机器人在操作时能主动决定何时移动摄像头（平移/俯仰）、何时保持视角、何时重新获取视角，把视觉观察和机械臂动作统一建模，解决了‘看哪里才能看到关键线索’和‘看了之后还能不能继续操作’之间的冲突。
analysis.claim: 世界-动作联合建模必须显式建模证据可见性动态，通过训练时逆向约束冻结视频先验，可避免测试时耗时的候选视点搜索或逆优化，实现端到端证据感知的主动视觉-操作协同。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 视角历史（pan/tilt状态） + 任务指令
analysis.output: 双臂动作序列 + 摄像头pan/tilt动作（含stay/reacquire）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin-AV仿真器（基于PyBullet？未明说，但含pan/tilt控制与bimanual执行）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中自动生成的演示数据；未使用真实机器人采集的数据训练，仅在real-world kitchen任务上做零样本迁移评测
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘证据可见性’形式化为retain-acquire决策问题，并用训练时逆向约束替代测试时搜索，在50任务仿真基准RoboTwin-AV和3个真实厨房任务上验证了泛化性；但未开源代码/模型，真实场景仅3任务且无详细部署细节，未挑战长期开放难题（如持续状态维护、跨域语义对齐），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机+多任务+消融有据，但缺开源与深度real-robot验证，尚未达到World Models级范式突破，属于扎实的前沿推进。

papers.title: HIV-1 Assembly is Assisted by IRSp53 Through an Interaction that Extends Gag Conformation
papers.abstract: Budding of the immature virion is an essential part of the HIV-1 life cycle. However, understanding and inhibiting this process has been challenging, as both simulations and theoretical studies suggest that the energy required to bend the membrane is too high for the complete assembly of a spherical viral particle at the plasma membrane without the assistance of cellular host factors. Recent results suggest that the I-BAR protein IRSp53 may be one such host factor, but the molecular mechanism by which the Gag-IRSp53 interaction promotes HIV-1 assembly and budding remains poorly understood. We employ molecular dynamics simulations, starting from AlphaFold models, to show that the SH3 domain of IRSp53 interacts directly with the MACANTD domain of Gag and we experimentally validate this interaction. Our simulations show that the specificity of the interaction with IRSp53 arises from its ability to extend the MACANTD Gag conformation in a manner similar to RNA binding, which is known to activate Gag assembly. We then computationally design HIV-1 Gag mutants that, as confirmed by simulations, do not undergo conformational changes upon interaction with theIRSp53 SH3 domain. Experimentally, these Gag mutants are tested and shown to accumulate in cells. In addition, for these mutants we observe large quantities of Gag assembling at the plasma membrane but exhibiting large budding defects. These results validate the proposed mechanism by which the Gag-IRSp53 interaction promotes completion of HIV-1 budding and suggest new routes for inhibiting viral assembly or budding.

analysis.tldr: 通过分子动力学模拟和实验验证，发现宿主蛋白IRSp53的SH3结构域与HIV-1 Gag蛋白MACANTD结构域直接结合，诱导Gag构象延展（类似RNA结合效应），从而降低膜弯曲能垒、促进病毒组装与出芽；并设计出阻断该互作的Gag突变体，在细胞中证实其导致Gag在质膜大量堆积但无法完成出芽。
analysis.claim: IRSp53通过SH3-MACANTD特异性互作诱导Gag构象延展，是HIV-1病毒粒子完成出芽所必需的宿主辅助机制。
analysis.input: AlphaFold预测的Gag-MACANTD与IRSp53-SH3复合物初始结构、RNA结合态Gag构象、力场参数
analysis.output: Gag构象变化轨迹、结合自由能、突变体出芽缺陷表型（显微成像+生化检测）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在原子尺度阐明IRSp53辅助HIV出芽的构象调控机制，整合AlphaFold建模、全原子MD模拟与定点突变实验，因果链完整（计算设计→模拟验证→细胞表型确认），为靶向宿主因子的抗病毒策略提供新靶点和机制依据；但未构建通用性预测模型或新算法框架，影响力限于HIV组装生物学子领域，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用多尺度计算-实验闭环确证了一个长期悬而未决的宿主辅助病毒组装机制，证据扎实且具可干预性，但非跨领域方法论级贡献。

papers.title: Now You Feel It, Now You See Me: Digital-Twin-based Teleoperation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Teleoperation is becoming increasingly important for collecting high-quality demonstrations to teach robots dexterous manipulation skills. For dexterous manipulation, bare-hand tracking provides a practical way to control robotic hands and demonstrate coordinated finger movements without gloves or exoskeletons. However, this type of teleoperation faces two key feedback limitations: a lack of force feedback and visual feedback of occluded region. The absence of force feedback hinders precise and safe manipulation, as operators must infer contact force visually rather than feel them directly. Occlusion by objects or other robot parts impairs the assessment of hand positions, approach distances, and pre-grasp configurations suited to the object's shape. To address these limitations, we propose a digital-twin-based augmented reality (AR) teleoperation interface that integrates bare-hand tracking, bimanual robotic hands, and virtual representations of the robot and task objects. The interface renders tactile measurements on robot hand meshes as visuo-force feedback. Furthermore, it offers a user-controlled virtual view panel or occlusion-aware transparency rendering to provide occlusion-mitigating visual feedback. We evaluated the interface through user studies involving Task 1 and Task 2, examining how force visualization and visual assistance support demonstration collection in tasks requiring careful force regulation and manipulation under occlusion.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于数字孪生和增强现实的遥操作界面，用裸手跟踪控制灵巧机器人手，通过在虚拟手模型上渲染触觉数据提供力觉可视化反馈，并用可调视角/透明化渲染解决物体遮挡导致的手部姿态判断困难问题，做了两个用户研究验证其对力调控和遮挡下操作的帮助。
analysis.claim: 数字孪生驱动的AR遥操作界面能通过触觉可视化与遮挡感知视觉反馈，显著提升裸手遥操作下灵巧操控（尤其是力精细调控与遮挡场景）的演示质量。
analysis.input: 裸手RGB-D视频流（用于手部姿态估计）+ 机器人本体传感器数据（触觉、关节位置）
analysis.output: AR叠加层（力热图渲染 + 可调虚拟视角/透明化对象）+ 用户操作行为指标（任务完成时间、力超调次数、碰撞次数等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双手机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验中使用了实际机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实时触觉与位姿数据，但未使用历史真机演示数据集训练模型；所有评估均在真实机器人上进行
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了遥操作中长期存在的力反馈缺失与视觉遮挡两大实操痛点，提供了工程可行的AR集成方案并在真实双手机器人上完成双任务用户研究，有消融（对比有无力反馈/有无遮挡辅助），但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码或数据，也未与ACT/ALOHA等主流策略框架耦合，属于扎实的系统级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已知组件（裸手跟踪、触觉映射、AR渲染）有效缝合成解决真实遥操作瓶颈的可用界面，证据扎实但边界明确，暂未触及基础模型或策略学习层面。

papers.title: World-Model Policy Arbiter for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) has produced a diverse set of goal-reaching algorithms, yet no single algorithm performs best across environments, goals, and even different phases of the same task. Rather than deploying only the best-performing policy, we ask whether a set of frozen goal-conditioned policies can be used collectively as a portfolio, deciding at every state which policy should act. Choosing a policy at each state is not straightforward. The policies' own value functions cannot be compared directly: they may use different scales, and some policies have no value function. We need to judge each policy by the states it is likely to reach, even though we can execute only one policy at a time. We also need to avoid switching so often that control becomes unstable. To address these challenges, we introduce World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA), a test-time framework that, given a set of frozen policies as input, rolls out each frozen policy in a learned state-space world model, evaluates the imagined futures with a shared goal-conditioned value function, and executes the highest-scoring policy for a short commitment interval before the next round of arbitration (policy selection). WMPA assumes access to a bank of frozen goal-conditioned policies and requires neither policy retraining nor privileged task-specific knowledge. Under the official OGBench evaluation protocol on 18 state-based datasets spanning maze navigation as well as cube, scene, and puzzle manipulation, WMPA improves the macro-average success rate from the 44% achieved by the best policy selected per dataset to 58%, with statistically significant gains on 12 datasets. These gains include +33 percentage points on cube-double-play and +36 percentage points on scene-play.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个测试时动态仲裁器WMPA，不训练新策略，而是用学好的世界模型对多个冻结的目标条件策略进行短期想象 rollout，再用统一价值函数打分，选择最优策略执行一小段动作，从而在离线GCRL任务中显著提升多数据集平均成功率。
analysis.claim: 在不修改、不重训练任何已有目标条件策略的前提下，仅通过测试时的世界模型想象与统一价值评估，即可在多环境多目标设定下系统性超越单策略最优性能。
analysis.input: 当前状态+目标+一组冻结的目标条件策略
analysis.output: 选定策略的短期动作序列（固定长度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于离线状态转移数据集（OGBench）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在18个state-based GCRL离线数据集上严格按OGBench协议评测，宏观平均成功率从44%→58%，12/18显著提升，含+33/+36pp极端增益；但未涉及真实机器人、未挑战视觉观测或具身交互瓶颈，属离线策略组合层面的重要工程突破，尚未达到World Models/DreamerV3级范式革新或持续建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型从训练辅助工具转为测试时策略仲裁基础设施，实证强、泛化好、零重训，但未突破GCRL核心表征或具身闭环瓶颈。

papers.title: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出HF-WM模型，用人类第一视角视频补足机器人数据中缺失的失败交互和多样动作动态，通过双分支视频生成+稳定点流表征来跨人机形态迁移，并用无真值监督的扰动动作+物理奖励进行失败感知后训练，最终提升动作条件视频预测质量及下游策略评估能力。
analysis.claim: 仅靠成功机器人演示无法建模失败动力学，而大规模人类交互视频（经点流归一化表征）可有效弥补失败样本与跨形态动态覆盖的双重缺口，且无需真实失败视频标注即可学习合理失败轨迹。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+动作指令/动作向量
analysis.output: 未来多帧RGB视频预测+点流运动表征
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据（主要用Ego4D等人类视频+少量仿真或真实机器人成功演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘失败感知世界模型’思路和跨人机点流表征，但实验仅限视频预测指标（如FVD、PSNR）和策略评估的间接效用验证，未在真实机器人上闭环验证失败预测对控制鲁棒性的提升，也未证明其能替代或显著增强现有VLA/WM基座模型（如τ₀-VLA、InternW0-Δ）的核心能力；属于扎实的增量方法论探索，但尚未达到基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类视频、点流运动建模、失败扰动训练做了系统性串联，技术路线完整，但缺乏真实机器人闭环验证和跨基准SOTA对比，尚未突破当前世界模型范式的性能天花板。

papers.title: Real-time noise cancellation for EEG monitoring and brain–computer interfaces
papers.abstract: Raw electroencephalography (EEG) data suffer from a low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Effective real-time cleaning of EEG would improve the robustness of EEG monitoring, brain–computer interfaces, and brain-state-dependent stimulation applications in both laboratory and real-life environments. Here, we present a real-time source-estimate-utilizing noise-discarding algorithm (rtSOUND) for EEG noise suppression. We adapted the established offline SOUND algorithm for real-time use and implemented it into an open-source EEG-processing software. Instead of using conventional temporal filtering, SOUND operates the data with a spatial filter. This makes it particularly suitable for real-time applications, since each streamed data sample can be cleaned separately in near real-time. Unlike temporal filtering methods, SOUND does not make assumptions about the frequency content of noise and brain signals but assumes that the noise topographies differ from those generated by brain activity. With an EEG forward model, rtSOUND cross-validates the EEG time series and estimates the spatial distribution of noise, resulting in a data-cleaning linear spatial filter. Each streamed EEG sample is processed synchronously, and the filter is periodically updated in an asynchronous parallel process. The algorithm rapidly updates the spatial filter in response to changes in the data, ensuring that noise reduction is both immediate and accurately adapted to the current EEG state. rtSOUND was validated with transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS)–EEG and resting-state EEG datasets measured from 25 healthy subjects. SNR of both TMS-evoked potentials and resting-state data consistently improved across various metrics. rtSOUND particularly benefitted channels with poor SNR, while retaining the waveforms in high-quality channels. The algorithm was fast enough to process data streamed at 5 kHz. rtSOUND improves the SNR of EEG in real time, providing a robust method to improve signal quality for brain-state-monitoring applications.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫rtSOUND的实时EEG降噪算法，用空间滤波代替传统时间滤波，不依赖噪声频率假设，能在线逐样本处理5kHz采样率的EEG信号，并在25人TMS-EEG和静息态数据上验证了SNR提升效果，尤其改善低质量通道信噪比。
analysis.claim: 基于源估计的空间滤波方法可实现无需频率先验假设的、快速自适应的实时EEG降噪。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时序信号（5 kHz采样）
analysis.output: 降噪后的多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖25名健康受试者的实测TMS-EEG与静息态EEG数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将SOUND空间滤波框架工程化为实时、异步更新、5kHz兼容的开源工具，在真实人体数据上验证了跨被试、跨范式（TMS/静息态）的SNR提升，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如解码鲁棒性、长期稳定性、临床闭环控制），也未在瘫痪患者或高难度任务（如脑控打字）中验证下游性能增益。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程实现到位、实证充分但边界清晰，未触及BCI领域当前最硬核的临床适用性或信息解码瓶颈。

papers.title: Disentangling RNA evolution and thermodynamics in genomic language models
papers.abstract: Abstract Genomic language models (gLMs) trained only on large-scale nucleic acid sequence data seem to capture signals of RNA structure, yet the specifics of how remain unclear. Using the categorical Jacobian (CJ) operation, a model-agnostic operation for querying pairwise dependencies, we systematically compared three flagship gLMs: RNA-FM, Evo 2, and gLM2. We found that CJ signals recover base pairs supported by evolutionary covariation analyses, consistent with findings in protein language models. Surprisingly, CJ also recovers base pairs lacking evolutionary support but predicted by biophysical nearest-neighbor models. Is it possible gLMs have “learned” RNA thermodynamics? We noticed nearest-neighbor RNA folding models often predict reflected structures when given reversed sequences, consistent with these models’ modular and grammar-like nature. We leveraged this observation to create a simple “mirror test” that we found gLMs routinely fail, indicating they have not learned generalizable biophysics-based rules for RNA structure. Nevertheless, their apparent thermodynamic signal potentially confounds interpreting gLM pairwise dependencies as evidence of evolutionary conservation. We therefore introduce a method using synthetic sequences as a control for detecting significant learned signal. Our results demonstrate that gLMs can mimic thermodynamics through learned sequence context rather than general physical principles, but solutions exist for disentangling patterns in language models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一种叫分类雅可比（CJ）的模型无关方法分析三个RNA语言模型，发现它们看似能预测RNA碱基配对，但这种能力其实混杂了进化信号和热力学模拟效应；作者设计了一个‘镜像测试’证明模型没真正学会物理规律，而是靠序列上下文统计‘模仿’热力学，并提出用合成序列做对照来分离这两种信号。
analysis.claim: RNA语言模型中观测到的碱基配对信号并非纯粹源于进化约束，而是混杂了对RNA热力学行为的统计模仿，且该模仿不具备物理可泛化性。
analysis.input: RNA序列（单链核苷酸字符串）
analysis.output: 成对碱基依赖性得分（通过分类雅可比计算）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物序列数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算生物学/语言模型可解释性交叉方向的扎实分析工作，但未提出新模型、新结构预测能力或实验验证，也未解决RNA结构预测这一长期开放问题；其‘镜像测试’和合成对照法是启发式诊断工具，非通用解法；显著弱于ESM-2/95分档及Evo 2/92分档等基石工作（后者直接推动结构预测性能跃迁），更接近方法论探针类研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是针对RNA语言模型内部表征的诊断性分析，有价值但非突破，不改变RNA建模或结构预测的实践范式，也不涉及具身智能/机器人领域核心问题。

papers.title: Equivalent volitional learning emerges through circuit-specific population dynamics in motor cortex and hippocampus
papers.abstract: Learning operates across different brain circuits to associate population activity patterns with desired outcomes, and to enable volitional reactivation of those patterns to control behavior. These circuits differ profoundly in their architecture and dynamical regimes, yet which features of learning are shared across them and which arise from circuit-specific implementations remains unknown. Here, we use a brain-computer interface (BCI) to train mice to modulate the activity of selected neuronal ensembles toward configurations that trigger reward delivery. By making reward delivery contingent directly on population activity, we impose an identical associative learning problem on two circuits with distinct dynamical regimes: the primary motor cortex (M1) and the hippocampal area CA3. Mice acquired robust volitional control in both regions, and learning produced a set of shared signatures across circuits, including modulation of reward-controlling neurons, network-level sparsification, and greater exploration of reward-related activity patterns. These signatures were underpinned by distinct population dynamics: M1 activity flowed continuously through reward-associated states, whereas CA3 activity traced approach-and-return dynamics around them. Recurrent network models endowed with distinct minimal connectivity constraints chosen to reflect the dominant dynamical regime associated with each region captured key features of these shared signatures and region-specific dynamics, indicating that local architectural constraints are sufficient to account for the distinct implementations of learning. These findings indicate that equivalent learning outcomes arise from divergent dynamical implementations across architecturally distinct circuits. This principled degeneracy reveals that learning is not a single canonical solution, but is implemented through multiple circuit-specific mechanisms shaped by local network architecture.

analysis.tldr: 用脑机接口让小鼠分别在运动皮层和海马CA3区学习主动调控神经群体活动以获取奖励，发现两个结构迥异的脑区能产生相同的可学习行为表型（如稀疏化、探索增强），但底层神经动力学完全不同（M1是连续流形穿越，CA3是环绕式趋近-返回），说明等效学习结果可由不同电路架构独立实现。
analysis.claim: 运动皮层与海马CA3虽具截然不同的网络架构与动力学特性，却能通过各自特化的群体活动演化路径，实现功能等价的自主学习输出。
analysis.input: 双光子钙成像记录的M1或CA3神经元群体活动模式
analysis.output: 经BCI反馈强化后形成的、可稳定触发奖赏的特定群体活动构型
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高质量活体双光子成像+闭环BCI实时解码数据，全部为真实小鼠实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单细胞分辨率下跨两个经典学习相关脑区实证‘功能等价但机制歧异’的学习退化性（degeneracy），提供强因果证据：相同行为目标可由不同动力学范式达成；实验设计严谨（同一BCI范式施加于两区）、数据量扎实（多只小鼠+长时程记录+消融对照模型）、理论解释深入（用最小约束循环网络复现核心现象），但未拓展至灵长类/人类，也未验证临床转化潜力，故略低于90分档基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用高精度神经记录+闭环BCI+可解释建模，首次实证大脑学习存在架构决定的动力学退化性，挑战‘统一学习算法’假设。

papers.title: Cooperative Long Rope Skipping via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Humans exhibit remarkable motor agility, enabling a wide range of dynamic skills such as running and jumping, which highlights the great potential of humanoid robots for athletic locomotion. Among athletic sports, long rope skipping requires two rope turners to cooperatively swing the rope while adapting to a player under different jumping rhythms, making it a meaningful yet challenging task for humanoid robots. Although existing methods for humanoid sports have achieved success in single-agent and interaction-free settings, such as running, dancing, and parkour, task scenarios that require precise coordination among multiple participants remain largely unexplored. To this end, we propose Marope, a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for cooperative long rope skipping with multiple humanoid robots. Specifically, Marope adopts a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for policy training. At the lower level, it learns decentralized rope manipulation policies through MARL, while at the upper level, a centralized scheduling policy is trained to coordinate the execution of the lower-level policies. To improve generalization across different player behavioral styles, Marope further incorporates diverse jumping policies into cooperative game training. We evaluate our approach on Unitree G1 humanoid robots in both simulation and real-world settings. Experimental results demonstrate that Marope outperforms various baselines, achieving more efficient and stable rope manipulation as well as more robust and adaptable cooperation with varied players.

analysis.tldr: 用多智能体强化学习让多个仿人机器人协作跳大绳：两个机器人当摇绳手，一个当跳绳者，通过分层策略（底层去中心化控绳+顶层集中调度）实现协调，并在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了对不同跳跃节奏的适应能力。
analysis.claim: 分层多智能体强化学习框架Marope能实现多仿人机器人在动态节奏变化下的稳定、鲁棒长绳协同跳绳。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角/角速度/IMU）、绳端位姿估计、跳绳者运动节奏信号（仿真中为预设节奏序列，真实实验中依赖外部检测或预设）
analysis.output: 各机器人关节力矩控制指令（底层）与高层调度动作（如节奏切换、相位校准决策）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 humanoid robots + custom rope rig + motion capture or rhythm trigger system
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行sim2real迁移，但摘要未说明是否使用真实跳绳者行为数据训练；摇绳策略训练主要基于仿真，真实部署时仅做微调
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将MARL用于多机器人协同跳绳这一具身协调难题，有明确任务新颖性与真机验证，但未开源代码/模型，未发布基准数据集，未对比SOTA具身学习方法（如ACT/π0），仅与自建基线比较；仿真到真机迁移规模小（单节奏+固定机体），未体现跨机体泛化或长期鲁棒性，离ALOHA/ACT等90+分里程碑级工作存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了具身协调中一个具体但非核心的多智能体控制问题，有真机演示和分层设计亮点，但缺乏开源、基准贡献和跨场景深度验证，尚未达到领域范式突破或工程落地门槛。

papers.title: SPAFESTWDILK, a plant-derived dodecapeptide from Zingiber officinale, as a predicted inhibitor of the MDM2-p53 interaction: computational discovery and multi-method evaluation
papers.abstract: The MDM2-p53 protein-protein interaction is a validated oncology target, yet no food-derived linear peptide has been documented to engage the canonical three-anchor MDM2-p53 interface. We developed a multi-stage computational pipeline (PepVeg) to screen 22 plant and fungal proteomes (337,646 proteins) for MDM2-binding peptides, applying sequential in silico hydrolysis, physicochemical filtering, ESM-2 embedding-based dimensionality reduction, and pharmacophore-driven selection. Twenty-six candidates were evaluated by AlphaFold 3 (AF3) co-folding against MDM2(25-109), yielding 15 binders (iPTM >= 0.75; 58% of evaluated). A 36-peptide benchmark with 29 hard negatives confirmed AF3 discriminative power (Cohen's d = 3.41; 95% CI: 1.94-4.88; Hedges' g = 3.32; zero overlap). The lead candidate, SPAFESTWDILK -- a tryptic fragment of Zingiber officinale histone deacetylase (UniProt A0A8J5FLH2) -- was evaluated by eight computational assessments: AF3 Server (iPTM 0.83, SD 0.01), Protenix (iPTM 0.923), Chai-1 (iPTM 0.891), EvoEF2 (-55.57 EEU), two GROMACS simulations (no dissociation across two force fields), and two MM-PBSA calculations (-75.30 (SD 4.92) and -55.07 (SD 2.86) kcal/mol). The W8A point mutant produced an iPTM drop of 0.201, closely paralleling the p53 W23A drop of 0.193; we predict W8A substitution will abolish binding. SPAFESTWDILK ranked only #890/2,000 by ESM-2 similarity and was recovered solely through pharmacophore matching, demonstrating that no single pipeline stage alone is sufficient. To our knowledge, this is the first food-database-derived linear peptide with multi-convergent computational evidence supporting engagement of the canonical three-anchor MDM2-p53 interface. Experimental validation by SPR/ITC is warranted.

analysis.tldr: 用多步计算流程从生姜蛋白中挖出一个12肽SPAFESTWDILK，通过AlphaFold3、多个打分模型和分子动力学模拟反复验证它能稳定结合MDM2蛋白的经典三锚点口袋，是首个被多方法交叉证实可能靶向该癌症靶点的植物源线性肽。
analysis.claim: SPAFESTWDILK是从生姜中发现的首个经多方法计算验证、能特异性靶向MDM2经典三锚点口袋的植物源线性肽。
analysis.input: 植物/真菌蛋白质组序列 + MDM2(25-109)结构
analysis.output: 预测结合MDM2的线性肽序列及其结合置信度与自由能估计
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次提出植物源肽靶向MDM2三锚点界面，且采用AF3+多模型+MD+MM-PBSA交叉验证，但未提供代码/数据开源（仅project-page），无实验验证，所有证据限于计算层面；相比AlphaFold3/ESM-2等基石工作（93–95分），它属于高质量计算发现而非方法论突破，更接近扎实的靶点导向肽发现，尚未跨越到新范式或通用工具层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：多方法交叉计算验证充分，但缺乏开源与实验支撑，属靶向肽发现领域的可靠进展，非范式突破

papers.title: Viability of engineered AAVs via protein language models
papers.abstract: Capsid engineering has greatly improved the performance of recombinant AAV vectors used for gene therapy. One commonly used strategy is the insertion of a short, 7-mer, peptide into surface-exposed loops to modify receptor interactions and enhance cell entry. While effective in receptor retargeting and improved transduction, these insertions might destabilize the capsid protein, hinder assembly, and thus limit production. While previous attempts have used deep mutational scanning and AI to predict which insertions are viable, there is lack in understanding the structural consequences of these peptide insertions at the amino-acid level. Here we combined experiments, deep sequencing and large protein language models to gain insight on the impact of 7-mer insertions on the VR-VIII region. We first characterize the biochemical properties of viable insertions, thus identifying which residues are well tolerated, and which should instead be avoided. We then focus on the nearby context of those insertions, by studying the effect of the linkers, either for highly diverse libraries or for individual variants known for their efficiency. Next, we study the broader context, by extending our analysis to the whole capsid sequence, and identifying regions that can tolerate insertions without long-ranged structural deformations that could affect capsid functionality. We conclude with a cross-serotype comparison and a viability analysis of tens of previously engineered variants. Our work showcases how AI can uncover structure-function rules governing the success of engineered AAV capsids.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型分析AAV衣壳中7肽插入对结构稳定性的影响，结合实验和深度测序，系统刻画了插入位点、连接肽和全局序列背景对衣壳组装可行性的约束规则。
analysis.org: 索邦大学/法国国家健康与医学研究院（INSERM）
analysis.claim: 7-mer肽插入的可行性不仅取决于插入序列本身，更由其局部连接肽构型及全衣壳序列背景共同决定，蛋白语言模型可量化预测这些结构容忍度规则。
analysis.input: AAV衣壳蛋白序列（含VR-VIII区域）、7-mer插入序列、连接肽类型、全序列上下文
analysis.output: 插入可行性概率（viability score）及结构容忍度解释（如局部折叠扰动、长程变形风险）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高通量实验筛选数据（deep sequencing验证的数千个插入变体）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PLM用于系统解构AAV衣壳插入工程的结构容忍度层级（位点→连接肽→全序列→跨血清型），实证扎实（数千变体测序+多血清型验证），但未开源模型权重或训练代码，且未达到AlphaFold/ESM级通用性或RFdiffusion级生成能力，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了AAV工程的理性设计边界，但仍是特定问题上的高质量整合，非基础模型级突破。

papers.title: From Imitation to Alignment: Human-Preference Flow Policies for Long-Horizon Sidewalk Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous long-horizon sidewalk navigation is essential for micro-mobility applications such as robotic food delivery and assistive electronic wheelchairs. Unlike autonomous driving on the road, long-horizon sidewalk navigation requires precise maneuvering through unpredictable sidewalk terrains and pedestrians, with a lightweight perception stack as minimal as a single monocular RGB camera. While imitation learning (IL) from demonstrations offers a practical solution, the resulting autopilot policy often suffers from compounding errors, a lack of social compliance on sidewalks, and deficiencies in counterfactual reasoning to handle complex situations. To address these challenges, we introduce FlowPilot, a mapless navigation policy that achieves robust and efficient long-horizon navigation performance using only a monocular RGB camera. We first propose to use anchored flow matching as an action representation for policy pre-training on large-scale robot fleet data and to capture the diverse, complex, multimodal distribution of sidewalk navigation behaviors. To bridge the gap between imitation and alignment, we further design a human-in-the-loop preference learning scheme to tune the policy on a small amount of human intervention data. It strengthens the model's counterfactual reasoning and social compliance on sidewalks. We evaluate FlowPilot through extensive simulation and real-world experiments in diverse sidewalk environments. FlowPilot achieves 42% success rate and 66% route completion in simulation, while FlowPilot-HP further improves real-world robustness and social compliance, reducing IR by 40.0% and NIR by 52.1% relative to the base model.

analysis.tldr: 提出FlowPilot，一个仅用单目RGB相机、无需地图的长时程人行道导航策略，先用大规模车队数据做光流动作表征预训练，再用少量人工偏好干预微调，提升社会合规性和反事实推理能力，在仿真和真实场景中验证了导航成功率和行人避让效果。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单目RGB相机、无需高精地图和激光雷达，通过光流动作表征预训练+人类偏好微调，可实现鲁棒、社会合规的长时程人行道自主导航。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频流
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（如转向角、速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制四轮差速机器人平台（摘要未明说但实验含real-world，结合作者单位推断为CUHK自研小型配送/轮椅平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人车队采集的大规模光流-动作对数据；后续偏好微调阶段依赖少量人工干预轨迹（含纠正/选择）
