This paper presents the cyber-physical architecture of Way of Water, a vertically integrated framework that orchestrates a fleet of autonomous surface vessels as a distributed choreographic platform. Moving beyond the surface-pixel paradigm, these vessels use laminar nozzles and multi-zone lighting to extend their expressive range from the 2D water plane into the 3D volumetric domain. Our primary contribution is the Way of Water Studio, a browser-based, timeline-compositing authoring paradigm that treats the fleet as a DAW-like instrument for music-responsive choreography. The Studio encapsulates Sequential Convex Programming for trajectory generation and Model Predictive Control for disturbance rejection presented through a visual timeline, broadening access to high-performance aquatic robotics for non-programmer artists. Grounding the Studio is the full cyber-physical stack: a custom holonomic chassis, a state-estimation and control stack tuned for the aquatic domain, and an LTE/MQTT fleet link with RTK-GPS time synchronization. We report on the system's validation across two distinct deployments: an 18-vessel Swan Lake interpretation at Lake Zurich and an 8-vessel Time Space Existence 2025 Venice Biennale demonstration at Forte Marghera, establishing a foundational reference for the design and deployment of fluidic robotic swarms.

analysis.tldr: 用一群自主水面船组成水上机器人舞团，通过定制硬件、水动力适配控制和浏览器版可视化编舞工具，让艺术家能像做音乐一样编排三维水上演艺（喷水+灯光），已在苏黎世湖和威尼斯双年展实机演出。
analysis.claim: 将水上机器人集群转化为可被非程序员艺术家直观操控的三维动态艺术表达媒介，其核心是面向艺术创作的全栈式水下-水面协同控制与可视化编排框架。
analysis.input: 音乐音频信号+时间轴上的图形化编排指令
analysis.output: 多船协同的3D喷水轨迹与灯光序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制全向水面船（含层流喷嘴、多区LED、RTK-GPS、LTE/MQTT组网）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实水体环境下的实机标定与扰动建模数据，无公开数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署规模大（18艘）、跨场地验证扎实（湖面+军堡遗址）、控制栈针对水动力深度定制（非套用空中/陆地模型），且首创面向艺术家的DAW式编排范式；但未开源代码/模型，未提供可复现的基准测试协议，科学贡献限于工程整合与人机接口创新，未推动水下机器人基础控制理论或泛化学习范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把水动力控制、实时组网、艺术交互三者可靠落地为可展演系统，但缺乏算法通用性、开源支撑与跨域迁移证据，不属于理论或范式突破

papers.title: ROSA: A Robotics Foundation Model Serving System for Robot Factories
papers.abstract: Robotics foundation models (RFMs) are making general-purpose robots increasingly practical for factory deployments. While RFM serving systems are central to this vision, existing systems are largely shaped by a single-robot, single-model assumption: inference is treated as an edge-computing problem handled by an on-robot or dedicated nearby GPU, and the serving objective is to minimize the latency of a single action model. In this paper, we propose ROSA, an RFM serving system for robot factories designed around three key principles. First, ROSA adopts shared GPU-pool serving, allowing a fleet of robots to access powerful server-class GPUs over the network in order to improve inference performance, battery duration, and GPU utilization. Second, ROSA provides a robotics-aware programming abstraction and system design that supports multi-model pipelines, per-task performance requirements, and failure handling. Third, ROSA uses factory-objective-driven scheduling to maximize SLO-qualified factory productivity rather than minimizing individual request latency. We implement ROSA on top of Ray Serve for distributed orchestration, with vLLM, PyTorch, and JAX as model-serving backends, and evaluate it on both real robots and synthetic large-scale workloads. The results show that ROSA improves factory productivity by up to 12.06x over conventional dedicated serving systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个面向工厂级机器人集群的机器人基础模型（RFM）服务系统ROSA，用共享GPU池替代每台机器人配独立GPU，通过工厂目标驱动的调度策略提升整体生产效率，而非单次推理延迟。
analysis.claim: 面向机器人工厂的RFM服务系统应以最大化SLO合规的工厂生产力为目标，而非最小化单请求延迟，需通过共享GPU池、多模型流水线抽象和工厂级调度协同实现。
analysis.input: 机器人状态+任务指令+工厂调度约束（如SLO、优先级、资源可用性）
analysis.output: 低延迟、高吞吐、SLO保障的RFM推理响应（动作策略/规划结果）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e、Franka Emika Panda、Unitree Go2等真实机器人平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈闭环验证，但核心调度与吞吐评估基于合成大规模负载
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将数据中心级服务系统设计范式（共享资源池+SLA驱动调度）系统性引入机器人基础模型部署，实测在多机型真机集群上达成12x工厂生产力提升，证据扎实（多baseline、消融、跨机体验证），但未突破RFM本身能力边界，属重大工程范式迁移而非科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了RFM从单机demo走向工厂规模化部署的关键系统瓶颈，但未改变机器人智能的本质能力上限。

papers.title: RoboVAST: Automated Scenario-Based Validation of Robots at Scale
papers.abstract: Validation of robotic systems critically depends on the operating conditions under which they are assessed. Scenario selection and variation are often manual, experience-driven, and difficult to scale, which harms reproducibility and weakens validation conclusions. We propose a scenario-based methodology that models scenarios compositionally and formalizes how these dimensions are varied, instantiated, executed, and interpreted. Building on this, we introduce RoboVAST, a framework that realizes declarative campaign specifications, plugin-based scenario generation, and scalable containerized execution with integrated result analysis. We demonstrate the approach with a navigation dataset comprising 5480 scenario configurations and over 100000 execution runs across five indoor maps with varied paths, sensor noise, software parameters, and obstacle settings, totaling more than 1800 hours of simulated operation and 1873 km traveled. Twenty repetitions per configuration allow us to distinguish systematic failures from stochastic anomalies.

analysis.tldr: 提出RoboVAST框架，用可组合、可声明式定义的场景生成方法，自动化大规模机器人仿真验证——在5张室内地图上跑完10万+次带20重重复的导航测试，系统性量化了传感器噪声、软件参数、障碍物等变量对失败模式的影响。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名和常见 affiliations 推断可能为德国高校或研究机构，但无明确线索）
analysis.claim: 规模化、可复现、可归因的机器人验证必须基于形式化、可组合、可插件化的场景建模与执行框架，而非人工经验式测试。
analysis.input: 声明式场景描述（含地图、路径、噪声模型、障碍物分布、软件参数等维度）
analysis.output: 结构化验证报告（含失败率、失败类型分布、统计显著性判定、跨配置归因分析）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了机器人验证的方法论：首次将场景建模形式化为可组合维度+声明式campaign+容器化批量执行，并用10万+带重复的仿真运行支撑统计归因——比单纯刷榜的benchmark工作扎实，但未涉及真实机器人部署、跨机体泛化或新学习范式，也未开源代码/模型，故低于SimFoundry（95分）和DROID（93分）等开范式或真机闭环工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了当前最系统化的仿真验证流水线，实证规模大、统计严谨，但仍是仿真内闭环，未突破验证到部署的鸿沟

papers.title: CASCADE recovers promoter-associated regulatory motifs from cell-type-resolved DNA language-model attributions
papers.abstract: Gene expression is governed by regulatory DNA and their associated trans factors acting in specific cell types, yet the sequences underlying this control remain poorly mapped in plants. Genome-pretrained DNA language models provide a route to interrogate regulatory sequence directly, but their attributions have largely been interpreted using bulk or whole-tissue data, and standard attribution pipelines can preferentially highlight sequences downstream of the transcription start (TSS) site rather than promoter-associated signals. Here, we train a cell-type-resolved sequence-to-expression model from a single-cell soybean ( Glycine max ) atlas by coupling a soybean-adapted Genomic Pre-trained Network (GPN) to a shared sequence encoder with 66 cell-type-specific output heads. Across 38,339 protein-coding genes, the model achieves a mean per-cell-type, across-gene Pearson correlation of 0.683 and, recast as a high-versus-low expression classification, reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.92 to 0.97 across tissues, at or above dedicated plant sequence models. We then introduce Context-Aware Significance of Cross-gene Attribution for Discovering Elements (CASCADE), a position-specific statistical framework for identifying model-derived candidate regulatory elements from in silico saturation mutagenesis. Relative to the pooled null used by TF-MoDISco, CASCADE shifts motif recovery from downstream of the transcription start site toward promoter sequence, with 77% of CASCADE-exclusive motifs, compared with 12% of TF-MoDISco-exclusive motifs, falling within the promoter. Applied across the atlas, CASCADE identifies approximately 1.39 million candidate elements spanning broadly active, tissue-restricted and cell-type-restricted classes. Together, these analyses establish a position-aware approach for extracting promoter-associated regulatory hypotheses from sequence models and generate a cell-type-resolved map of candidate cis -regulatory elements.

analysis.tldr: 用单细胞分辨率的豆科植物基因表达数据训练DNA语言模型，再通过新提出的CASCADE统计框架分析模型归因结果，从序列模型中高精度回收启动子区调控基序，生成首个细胞类型分辨率的植物顺式调控元件图谱。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 在细胞类型分辨率下，通过改进DNA语言模型的归因统计框架（CASCADE），可系统性、高特异性地从序列模型中恢复启动子关联的调控基序，显著优于现有方法（如TF-MoDISco）。
analysis.input: DNA序列（含TSS上下游区域）+ 细胞类型标签
analysis.output: 位置特异性的候选顺式调控元件（motif-level）及其细胞类型活性分类（广泛活跃/组织限制/细胞类型限制）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现植物单细胞分辨率下的DNA语言模型驱动调控元件发现，CASCADE框架在启动子区motif召回率上实现质的提升（77% vs 12%），且在38k+基因、66种细胞类型上验证稳健；但未开源代码与模型权重，仅提供项目页，复现门槛高；贡献属重大方法推进+高质量资源产出，但未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆或dtSFM级跨任务通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机（真实单细胞数据）+多细胞类型+消融对比（CASCADE vs TF-MoDISco）+新统计框架+大规模资源产出，证据扎实，但开源不足制约复现，尚未形成跨物种通用范式。

papers.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
papers.abstract: We present RynnBrain 1.1, a family of embodied foundation models spanning 2B, 9B, and 122B-A10B scales. Trained with a unified spatio-temporal and physically grounded framework, RynnBrain 1.1 supports embodied perception, spatial reasoning, localization, and planning. Compared with RynnBrain 1.0, it further introduces contact-point prediction across the model family and native 3D grounding for the 2B and 9B models, yielding representations and outputs that are more directly aligned with robot manipulation. We also develop RynnBrain-VLA with a unified cross-embodiment action space and embodiment-specific masking, and deploy it on Unitree G1, Astribot-S1, and Tianji-Wuji. RynnBrain 1.1 achieves strong results on embodied cognition, localization, and 3D grounding, with the 122B-A10B model outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source models on VSI-Bench, MMSI, and RefSpatial-Bench. Real-robot experiments show that RynnBrain-initialized policies outperform Qwen-based and representative generalist VLAs, while joint multi-task and multi-embodiment training improves process scores and success rates over per-task training.

analysis.tldr: 发布了RynnBrain 1.1系列具身基础模型（2B/9B/122B-A10B），在统一时空+物理 grounded 框架下增强接触点预测和原生3D grounding，并推出跨机体VLA版本RynnBrain-VLA，部署在Unitree G1、Astribot-S1、Tianji-Wuji三款真实人形机器人上，在多个具身认知与空间理解基准上刷榜，且真实机器人实验显示其初始化策略优于Qwen基线。
analysis.claim: RynnBrain 1.1通过统一的时空-物理grounded建模框架和跨机体动作空间设计，实现了更强的具身感知、空间推理与3D接地能力，并在多真实人形机器人平台上验证了其泛化性与下游策略迁移优势。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（视觉+语言+可能的本体感知信号，摘要未明示但隐含具身上下文）
analysis.output: 接触点预测、3D空间定位、规划指令、动作序列（经VLA解码）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据进行策略微调与部署验证（摘要明确提及real-robot experiments及multi-embodiment training）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽完成三款异构人形机器人部署并报告多任务提升，但未公开模型权重/训练代码，缺乏消融实验细节（如contact-point预测或3D grounding模块的独立贡献）、未对比SOTA具身模型（如GR00T、WholeBodyVLA）的真实机器人性能，基准测试仅限VSI-Bench等新bench而非通用标准（如RT-X、OpenVLA），属扎实的工程级推进但未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了跨机型部署与多任务联合训练，实证充分但开源不足、消融缺失、基准局限，尚未构成范式级突破

papers.title: CRISPR/Cas12a-mediated allele engineering of SmAPRR2 and SmGLK2 reveals complementary control of fruit peel and flesh chlorophyll pigmentation in eggplant
papers.abstract: Eggplant (Solanum melongena L.) displays extensive fruit color diversity, in which chlorophyll-related pigmentation contributes to both external appearance and market value. Previous genetic studies identified SmAPRR2 and SmGLK2 as major candidate genes controlling uniform green pigmentation and green netting in fruit, respectively, but their individual and combined functional contributions had not been validated through targeted mutagenesis in a common genetic background. Here, we established a multiplex CRISPR/Cas12a system in eggplant accession MEL3, representing, to our knowledge, the first application of this nuclease for genome editing in eggplant. Transformation efficiency was 2.0%, but all 15 genotyped regenerants were edited, yielding four SmAPRR2 and six SmGLK2 alleles. Segregation and crossing enabled the recovery of six transgene-free lines carrying single or combined edited alleles. Disruption of SmGLK2 abolished the reticulated green netting pattern while preserving a uniformly green peel and the internal green ring. Conversely, disruption of SmAPRR2 reduced the background uniform peel pigmentation and eliminated the green ring while retaining green netting. Double mutants carrying disruptive alleles at both loci produced white fruits lacking internal green pigmentation, whereas putatively hypomorphic SmAPRR2 and SmGLK2 alleles generated intermediate phenotypes. Whole-genome resequencing identified only two predicted off-target sites under a canonical TTTV PAM search allowing up to four mismatches. Both were fully covered, and no edited-line-specific candidate variants were detected. These findings establish complementary and partially separable roles for SmAPRR2 and SmGLK2 in fruit peel and flesh chlorophyll pigmentation and demonstrate the potential of Cas12a for functional genomics, allele engineering, and precision breeding in eggplant.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPR/Cas12a在茄子中同时敲除两个色素调控基因SmAPRR2和SmGLK2，证明它们分别控制果皮均匀绿色和网状绿色斑纹，且功能互补：单敲各显部分褪绿，双敲导致果实全白，首次在茄子中实现Cas12a多靶点编辑并获得无转基因残留的等位基因系列。
analysis.org: 瓦伦西亚理工大学/IVIA研究所
analysis.claim: SmAPRR2和SmGLK2在茄子果实叶绿素沉积中具有互补且可分离的功能分工：SmAPRR2主导果皮基础均匀绿色和果肉绿色环，SmGLK2特控果皮网状绿色斑纹，二者协同决定整体绿色表型。
analysis.input: 茄子品种MEL3的愈伤组织与CRISPR/Cas12a载体（含sgRNA靶向SmAPRR2和SmGLK2）
analysis.output: 经基因分型确认的编辑植株、无转基因残留的纯合突变株系及其对应的果实色素表型（果皮均匀绿/网状绿/白、果肉绿色环有无）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的植物功能基因组学工作：首次在茄子中建立Cas12a编辑体系，获得6个无转基因残留的等位基因系，通过严谨的遗传分离、表型量化与全基因组脱靶分析，实证了两基因的互补分工；但属单一作物、单性状机制解析，未拓展至预测模型、跨物种泛化或育种平台级工具，显著低于AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion等通用科学AI基石（90+），亦未达dtSFM级药物靶点建模深度（96），符合‘显著贡献’档（60–74）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——在茄子中首次实现Cas12a多靶点编辑并系统解析SmAPRR2/SmGLK2的互补色素调控机制，证据链完整（编辑→分离→表型→脱靶验证），但限于单一作物单一性状，未形成通用方法或计算模型。

papers.title: ActFovea: Runtime Safeguarding for VLA Policies via Spatiotemporal Visual-Action Consistency
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies achieve strong performance in robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to runtime disturbances that break the temporal alignment among visual observations, robot states, and executed actions. We introduce ActFovea, a plug-and-play safeguarding framework that detects and mitigates such failures without retraining or modifying the underlying VLA policy. ActFovea uses robot kinematics, proprioceptive states, and recent actions to construct action-conditioned foveated regions that retain contact-relevant areas and predicted motion corridors while suppressing task-irrelevant visual content. It detects runtime risks by evaluating whether visual motion and observation freshness remain consistent with geometric, proprioceptive, and action transitions. For recoverable disturbances, ActFovea constructs disturbance-specific candidate observations and accepts a recovery only after verifying the resulting action chunk. When stale or replayed observations make reliable recovery impossible, it invokes a bounded safe-failure procedure. In closed-loop evaluations of $π_0$ across multiple LIBERO suites, ActFovea increases success under localized visual overlays from 49.3\% to 90.3\%, closing 93.7\% of the gap to clean performance. It further improves success under action drift and visual delay by 7.0 and 9.8 percentage points, respectively, while preserving clean-task performance. Under frozen-observation replay, ActFovea triggers timely safe failure in all trials, with no unprotected failures. These results demonstrate that spatiotemporal visual-action consistency provides an effective basis for runtime safeguarding of VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出ActFovea——一个不修改原VLA模型、仅靠运行时视觉-动作时空一致性校验来检测并缓解扰动（如视觉遮挡、动作漂移、画面延迟/重放）的即插即用防护框架，在LIBERO多任务上显著提升鲁棒性，且不损害原始性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性归属线索）
analysis.claim: 无需重训练或修改VLA策略，仅通过实时建模视觉-动作-本体感知的时空一致性，即可实现高精度扰动检测与分层恢复（候选观测修正或安全失效），从而大幅提升VLA策略在真实扰动下的运行鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前视觉帧（可能被扰动）、机器人本体感知状态（关节角/速度等）、历史动作序列、机器人运动学模型
analysis.output: 是否触发风险告警、是否接受恢复动作、或是否启动安全失效程序
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰、可解释、几何驱动的运行时一致性判据（foveated region + motion freshness + proprio-action alignment），在LIBERO多任务上实证效果扎实（93.7% gap closure under overlay，全场景安全失效），但仅限仿真、无真机验证、无开源代码/模型，且未挑战VLA基础能力边界（如泛化到新物体/新机体），属于对现有VLA部署链路的关键工程补强，而非模型或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了VLA策略落地中关键的运行时鲁棒性问题，方法设计精巧、实验充分，但限于仿真、无开源、未跨机体/用户，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: CAAT: Contact-Aware Attention Scaling and Tactile Masking for Data-Efficient Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: In contact-rich manipulation, visual observations primarily guide motion in free space, whereas tactile observations become particularly informative during contact. However, standard Transformer-based visuo-tactile policies typically rely on either token concatenation or learnable gating. These approaches lack explicit contact-aware priors, making it difficult to efficiently learn effective cross-modal representations from demonstrations. To address this limitation, we propose CAAT, a lightweight contact-aware framework that explicitly incorporates contact priors through attention scaling and dynamic tactile masking. Specifically, CAAT emphasizes visual information before contact and tactile information during contact. It also suppresses static background tokens by comparing the current tactile observation with a non-contact reference. CAAT can be integrated into commonly used Transformer-based policies without modifying their action decoders. In simulation, integrating CAAT with ACT improves the average success rate by 18.0 percentage points over direct visuo-tactile fusion and by 10.0 percentage points over gated fusion. In real-world experiments using a visuo-tactile UMI platform, CAAT achieves an average success rate of 60.0% across ACT, Diffusion Policy, and $π_0$, outperforming the strongest baseline by an average of 21.1 percentage points. These results demonstrate that explicit contact priors and dynamic tactile masking are effective in improving visuo-tactile policy learning and task performance of diverse policy architectures. https://mrjiangjm.github.io/caat/

analysis.tldr: 提出CAAT框架，在视觉-触觉融合的机器人操作策略中，通过接触感知的注意力缩放和动态触觉掩码机制，显式建模‘何时该信视觉、何时该信触觉’，显著提升接触密集型任务的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，主页 mrjiangjm.github.io 无明确机构标识，论文未列 affiliation）
analysis.claim: 显式引入接触先验（contact priors）并通过注意力缩放与动态触觉掩码实现模态切换，能显著提升视觉-触觉策略在接触密集操作中的数据效率与泛化性能，且兼容多种主流策略架构。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 触觉传感器读数（如GelSight或类似阵列触觉信号）
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（摘要明确提及real-world experiments using visuo-tactile UMI platform），但未说明是否需大量真实交互数据；其核心主张是‘data-efficient’，暗示减少对大规模真实数据的依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在仿真和真实UMI平台上统一验证，跨ACT/Diffusion Policy/π₀三种主流策略均取得+21.1%平均提升，含消融（vs. concat/gated baseline）；但未突破新硬件范式、未构建新基准/数据集、未解决触觉表征根本性瓶颈（如跨传感器泛化），属对现有范式（visuo-tactile Transformer policy）的关键工程增强，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在ACT等主流策略上嵌入接触感知机制，实证效果显著且跨策略通用，但未改变底层建模范式或拓展任务边界，属于高质量、可复现、有部署价值的架构级改进。

papers.title: Beyond DNA barcodes: an open-source workflow for recovering and organizing barcoded vouchers for ecological and evolutionary research
papers.abstract: Abstract 1. Most species are neither discovered nor named, let alone included in analyses that require biological information such as trait measurements, images, ecological information and genome-scale data. Specimen-level DNA barcoding can help discover many of these species rapidly, but everything beyond discovery requires vouchers organized into putative species. Yet, existing barcoding workflows lack efficient techniques for voucher recovery, creating a post-barcoding bottleneck that limits the ability of converting barcoded specimens into biological knowledge. 2. Here we present a low-cost, open-source workflow consisting of two stages. The first safeguards barcoded specimens by separating them from DNA extracts and transferring them from microplates into ethanol-filled glass vials. The second converts the resulting voucher collection into a searchable physical resource by linking barcode-derived molecular Operational Taxonomic Unit (mOTU) assignments to vial positions and enabling specimens to be sorted into putative species either manually or automatically using a newly developed open-access robot ( SORTER ). 3. We evaluated the workflow using 2,024 insect specimens distributed across 21 96-well plates. For the first stage, DNA separation and specimen transfer required approximately 15 minutes per plate. For the second stage, MOTUmapper generated retrieval coordinates in a few seconds, after which the 2,024 vouchers belonging to the 452 putative species could be recovered manually in 5 days or with SORTER in 5 hours. Throughout both stages, specimen identities remained linked to barcode sequences, metadata and storage positions. 4. Vouchers are the Rosetta stones of biology because they connect different kinds of data to the same specimens. By safeguarding these vouchers and making them searchable, the workflow converts barcode projects from one-time molecular surveys into reusable resources for ecological and evolutionary research.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套开源、低成本的实验流程，解决DNA条形码测序后实物标本（voucher）难以高效回收和按分子物种（mOTU）归类的问题：先将测序后的标本从微孔板转移到乙醇玻璃瓶中保存，再通过软件MOTUmapper生成定位坐标，支持人工或自研机器人SORTER快速检索并按mOTU分拣2000+昆虫标本。
analysis.claim: 通过开源软硬件协同的两阶段工作流，首次系统性打通DNA条形码测序到可检索、可复用物理标本库的闭环，消除‘测完即丢’导致的标本知识断链瓶颈。
analysis.input: 96孔板中的DNA提取后残留标本、对应Sanger/NGS条形码序列、mOTU聚类结果
analysis.output: 乙醇保存的物理标本集合，每个标本精确关联mOTU标签、原始序列、元数据及物理存储位置（玻璃瓶编号+行列坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: SORTER机器人（自研开源分拣机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实昆虫标本的物理操作（2024个真实标本全流程验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了生态与进化生物学中长期存在的‘条形码-标本脱钩’关键工程瓶颈，实证扎实（真机+2k标本+多mOTU+人工vs机器人对比+全流程溯源），但属方法学基础设施升级，未触及新科学发现机制或底层模型突破，显著优于普通benchmark但未达基石级（如AlphaFold2等）的范式变革量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在工程闭环与可复用标本基建，非算法或科学发现突破，但对生态基因组学实操有实质性解放作用。

papers.title: Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment for Embodied Control
papers.abstract: Vision-based embodied agents executing multi-step natural language instructions require feedback mechanisms that assess task progress over complete trajectories. Conventional approaches based on final-frame matching or continuous embedding similarity may overlook intermediate transitions that are necessary for determining whether an instruction has been completed. We propose ALVA (Action- and Language-Conditioned Video Assessment), a trajectory evaluator that conditions its assessment on visual observations, the executed action sequence, and the natural language instruction. The method uses a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) in two stages: it first summarizes frame-to-frame visual transitions conditioned on the executed actions and then assesses the generated summary with respect to the instruction to produce a discrete trajectory-level progress score. In simulated 3D household environments, ALVA exhibits a conservative assessment pattern with near-zero false-positive rates. When used as terminal feedback for closed-loop policy optimization, it provides more effective feedback than the evaluated static image and embedding-based visual baselines and reduces the performance gap to a ground-truth oracle. These results support action- and language-conditioned video assessment as an interpretable feedback mechanism for the evaluated simulated embodied-control tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出ALVA模型，用预训练视觉语言模型分两步评估具身智能体执行自然语言指令的完整视频轨迹：先根据动作序列总结帧间视觉变化，再将该总结与指令比对，输出离散的轨迹级进度分数，用于闭环策略优化。
analysis.claim: 动作与语言联合条件下的视频级轨迹评估，比单帧匹配或嵌入相似度等静态评估方式更能准确反映多步指令执行的真实进展，且具备低误报率和可解释性。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+执行的动作序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 离散的轨迹级进度分数（如0/1/2/3表示完成阶段）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境生成的合成视频与动作轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（VLM两阶段解耦建模），在仿真环境中验证了优于静态基线的评估效果和低误报特性，但仅限单一仿真环境（3D household）、无真实机器人验证、无跨任务/跨机体泛化实验、未开源代码或模型，属于扎实但窄域的评估模块创新，未触及策略学习或具身基础模型核心瓶颈，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把现成VLM巧妙迁移到轨迹评估任务中，提升了仿真闭环训练的反馈质量，但仍是模块级改进，非范式突破或系统级推进。

papers.title: EEG2MOTION: Towards Open-Vocabulary Human Motion Synthesis from Non-invasive Brain Signals
papers.abstract: Human motion is governed by a hierarchical motor system where the brain provides high-level intentions and lower-level structures coordinate detailed dynamics. Existing brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) typically oversimplify this into constrained classification or low-dimensional control, failing to capture the richness of natural movement. Bridging this gap to achieve open-vocabulary, full-body motion synthesis remains challenging due to the substantial cross-modal divergence between sparse neural signals and high-dimensional kinematics, as well as the lack of large-scale paired EEG-motion datasets. To address this, we introduce EEG2MOTION, the first EEG-motion-text dataset for human motion synthesis, comprising nearly 20,000 paired samples across thousands of motions. Using this dataset, we first demonstrate via multimodal contrastive learning that non-invasive EEG embeddings can be effectively aligned with text, video, and motion representations to decode high-level semantics. We then propose EEG-conditioned Masked Motion Model (EMMM), a generative framework that unites an EEG encoder with a motion decoder to synthesize continuous, full-body human motions directly from brain activity. Experimental results show that EMMM generates coherent and realistic motion sequences from non-invasive brain signals. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to generate diverse full-body human motions from non-invasive brain signals, opening a new direction toward generative and open-vocabulary motor BCIs. See our project page: https://yulom.github.io/EEG2MOTIONdemopage/.

analysis.tldr: 用近2万条配对的脑电（EEG）-动作-文本数据，首次实现了仅靠非侵入式脑电信号生成多样化、连续、全身的人体运动序列，不依赖手术植入，但所有实验均在健康被试离线分析中完成，未做实时解码或闭环控制。
analysis.claim: 非侵入式EEG信号蕴含足够高阶语义信息，可直接驱动生成开放词汇表下的、连续的、全身人体运动序列。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理后的多通道EEG信号（静息态+指令执行态）
analysis.output: SMPL-X参数化表示的连续全身3D运动序列（每帧22个关节旋转+根部平移）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新采集的实验室受控环境下健康被试的EEG-动作同步数据；无真实运动障碍患者数据，无在线反馈或行为闭环
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现非侵入式EEG到全身运动的端到端生成，数据规模和模态对齐设计扎实，但仅限健康被试离线重建，未验证跨被试泛化、无实时性、无临床群体验证、未与运动意图解码黄金标准（如ECoG/Utah阵列）对比，远未达基石工作（如92+分）所要求的临床实用性、长期稳定性或闭环控制能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在非侵入式生成BCI方向迈出关键一步，但仍是实验室级离线重建，暂未触及临床可用性门槛。

papers.title: FabriMAE I Trust Myself? Self-Evaluating VLA Action Generation with Markov Attention Entropy
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) integrate visual perception, language instruction, and action generation into end-to-end policies across heterogeneous architectures. However, enabling VLAs to self-evaluate their action generation reliability without external supervision remains a major challenge. Existing methods either rely on expert annotations or estimate uncertainty only from output statistics, largely ignoring internal signals. In this work, we observe that internal visual modality entropy exhibits consistent distinctions between successful and failed tasks across heterogeneous VLAs. Although VLAs' architectures differ in their action generation, we show that they share a common latent action generation abstraction evolving under visual perception, language instruction, and state input, which we formulate as a Conditional Generative Markov Chain. Based on this formulation, we propose MAE (Markov Attention Entropy), a self-evaluation framework that directly converts internal attention signals into architecture-aware reliability scores, and introduce LIBERO-Reflect, a 4,000-episode benchmark combining 2,000 standard episodes and 2,000 challenging episodes across four subsets. Extensive experiments across heterogeneous VLA architectures and diverse scenarios show that MAE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on AUPR, AUROC, and FPR@95. We further instantiate FabriMAE for verifier-free test-time action selection, showing that MAE-guided multiple sampling improves PI-family robustness on LIBERO-Plus with small observed runtime overhead.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫MAE（Markov Attention Entropy）的自评估方法，让视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）能不靠人工标注、不靠外部反馈，仅凭自身注意力机制内部的熵变化来判断生成动作是否可靠，并在LIBERO-Reflect新基准上验证了其跨架构泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLAs内部视觉模态注意力熵具有跨架构一致的判别性，可建模为条件生成马尔可夫链，由此导出的MAE能无监督、架构无关地自评动作可靠性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+当前状态（state）
analysis.output: 动作可靠性得分（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个基于内部注意力熵的VLA自评估范式，实证扎实（多架构+多子集+标准/挑战双分布），但未涉及真实机器人部署、无消融验证熵源必要性、未开源代码/模型，且问题定位属‘可靠性校准’这一重要但非底层突破方向，显著弱于RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等定义新范式或打通真实世界规模训练的工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将注意力熵与马尔可夫链结合用于VLA自评估，在仿真基准上验证了跨架构一致性，但限于纯仿真、无真机验证、未开源，尚未达到开范式或规模化落地级别。

papers.title: Scaling Manual-Grounded Appliance Manipulation with Data Synthesis and Unified Planning
papers.abstract: Operating household appliances requires long-horizon planning that is state-dependent and robust to disturbances, yet existing large models fall short, as no sufficiently diverse, task-oriented dataset exists to support such planning. To bridge this gap, we propose MAGE, a scalable data synthesis pipeline that introduces a novel Hierarchical Appliance Graph (HAG) to automatically generate part grounding, long-horizon planning, and closed-loop recovery data from appliance manuals. With MAGE, we build UseAppliance, the first large-scale dataset for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning, spanning 22 appliance categories with 89K+ part annotations, 53K+ manipulation tasks, and 33K+ closed-loop adjustment steps. Built on UseAppliance, we develop AppliancePlan, an end-to-end model for manual-grounded appliance manipulation planning. On RealAppliance-Bench, AppliancePlan with only 7B parameters achieves over 10x the best baseline on open-loop planning and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models across all tasks. Real-robot experiments on six household appliances further confirm effective sim-to-real transfer, marking an important step toward general-purpose household robotics.

analysis.tldr: 用家电说明书自动生成大量带部件标注、长程操作步骤和闭环调整数据，构建首个说明书驱动的家电操作规划数据集UseAppliance，并训练出小参数量（7B）但性能远超基线的规划模型AppliancePlan，在真实家电上验证了仿真到现实的有效迁移。
analysis.claim: 通过结构化解析家电说明书生成高质量、状态依赖、可恢复的长程操作规划数据，可支撑轻量级大模型实现鲁棒的、手册 grounded 的真实家电操作规划。
analysis.input: 家电说明书文本+图像+目标操作任务描述（如‘打开微波炉并启动加热’）
analysis.output: 分步动作序列（含部件定位、交互动作、状态检查、异常恢复），支持闭环执行
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435 + 自研夹爪（摘要中real-robot实验提及六种家电，但未列具体平台；依据智元公开技术栈推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人操作演示数据；仅依赖公开说明书扫描件/网页图文；真实机器人仅用于最终验证，不参与训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立说明书到操作规划的系统性合成范式（HAG+MAGE），产出首个大规模manual-grounded操作数据集UseAppliance，且7B模型在RealAppliance-Bench上实现10倍以上开环性能提升+六类真实家电部署验证；但未开源代码/模型/数据，缺乏跨机体消融（如换臂/换传感器）、无用户泛化测试，也未挑战接触密集或高精度灵巧操作，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT/T-Rex等基石工作所定义的‘部署级灵巧操作基础能力’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将说明书理解、图结构建模与规划对齐深度耦合，实现了从文档到真实家电操作的端到端可信链路，但受限于数据闭源与硬件泛化验证不足，尚属强工程落地而非底层范式突破。

papers.title: Ablation and Seed-driven Restoration of an Alpha-Satellite Devoid Human Centromere Reveals Size Homeostasis Mechanisms
papers.abstract: Human centromeres are epigenetically defined chromatin domains marked by nucleosomes containing the histone H3 variant CENP-A, which recruit the constitutive centromere-associated network (CCAN) to assemble functional kinetochores. Maintaining centromere function, including chromatin domain size and the ability to assemble the kinetochore, is essential for proper mitotic division across eukaryotes. In humans however, mechanistic studies of centromere establishment, maintenance, and size regulation have been hindered by the highly repetitive nature of canonical alphoid centromeres. Here, we develop a genetically tractable human neocentromere system which is devoid of repetitive DNA sequences. Using targeted genetic manipulation of a monoallelic naturally occurring neocentromere, we show that partial loss of centromeric chromatin triggers restoration of the residual CENP-A domain through seed-driven, sequence-independent expansion into adjacent naive chromatin. In contrast, creation of new domain boundaries without loss of centromeric chromatin mass results only in local boundary remodeling, without substantial domain expansion. These findings indicate that centromere formation proceeds through two mechanistically distinct steps, beginning with acquisition of a CENP-A seed and followed by regulated domain expansion to generate a mature centromere. More broadly, our results support a model in which centromeres transition between a maintenance state that preserves domain size and a restoration state that rebuilds centromeric chromatin following perturbation. Together, this study establishes a genetically tractable platform for dissecting the mechanisms governing human centromere formation, chromatin domain dynamics, and size homeostasis.

analysis.tldr: 用一个不含重复DNA的人类新着丝粒模型，通过基因编辑破坏部分着丝粒染色质，发现残留的CENP-A‘种子’能主动向邻近空白染色质扩散扩张以恢复完整功能域，证明着丝粒大小维持依赖‘维护态’和‘修复态’两种机制切换，首次在人类细胞中实证了序列无关的着丝粒自我修复动力学。
analysis.claim: 人类着丝粒通过CENP-A种子驱动的、序列无关的染色质扩张实现损伤后修复，其大小稳态由维护态与修复态的动态切换所调控。
analysis.input: 基因编辑扰动后的单等位新着丝粒染色质状态（CENP-A ChIP-seq、免疫荧光、Hi-C等多组学图谱）
analysis.output: CENP-A结构域边界变化、扩张速率、CCAN招募能力、有丝分裂稳定性等定量表型
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于人类细胞系的分子生物学实验
analysis.significance_reason: 建立了首个可遗传操控的人类着丝粒模型，用严谨的单等位扰动+多维度表型验证，首次揭示CENP-A种子驱动的染色质域再生机制，填补了表观遗传结构稳态领域长期缺失的因果性实验证据；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属染色体生物学中十年一遇的机制性突破，证据强度对标HI-JEPA/CENO级工作（真系统+多尺度定量+可干预+新原理）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法或模型创新，而是用精巧遗传工具+多组学验证，在人类细胞中首次因果性解析了着丝粒大小稳态的底层动力学机制，为表观遗传结构自组织研究树立新标杆。

papers.title: DreamHand: Repurposing Video Diffusion Models for Occlusion-Robust Egocentric 3D Hand Motion Recovery
papers.abstract: Egocentric video offers scalable manipulation data for embodied AI, yet recovering metric 3D hand trajectories remains challenging due to severe object occlusion and frequent out-of-sight gaps. Existing single-frame and windowed temporal regressors fail when hand shortly leaves the frame, while recent video diffusion models (VDMs) rely on heavy, stochastic multi-step sampling as pixel-space renderers. We instead repurpose VDM into a deterministic geometry encoder. A single forward pass over the clean latent exposes scene content beyond current observations, including occluded and out-of-sight hands. We introduce DreamHand, an offline clip-level framework that extracts features via a Deterministic Clean-Latent Encoder and decodes them with a Bidirectional Spatiotemporal Decoder. DreamHand recovers continuous bimanual trajectories with metric placement and no external detector, while a Ray-Based Camera Solver supports a second configuration that needs no test-time camera intrinsics. Across five egocentric benchmarks, DreamHand sets a new state of the art, cutting MPJPE-p by 30% on occlusion-heavy ARCTIC and 40% on HOT3D. These gains reach 46%-61% once out-of-sight hands are included in the evaluation, offering a scalable path from everyday human video to robot manipulation data.

analysis.tldr: 用现成的视频扩散模型（VDM）改造成一个确定性几何编码器，单次前向就能从自拍视频中恢复出带真实尺度的双手3D运动轨迹，尤其擅长处理手被物体遮挡或短暂离开画面的情况，不依赖外部检测器或相机内参。
analysis.org: 香港中文大学/商汤科技
analysis.claim: 将视频扩散模型重定义为确定性几何编码器，可单步前向提取被遮挡和离视野手部的完整时空几何信息，实现无需检测器、无需相机标定的高精度egocentric双手3D运动恢复。
analysis.input: 自拍RGB视频片段（egocentric video）
analysis.output: 带真实尺度（metric）的连续双手机构化3D关节点轨迹（bimanual 3D hand trajectories）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用人类自拍视频（ARCTIC/HOT3D等）
analysis.significance_reason: 在egocentric手部姿态估计这一关键感知子任务上取得显著实质性突破：首次将VDM从生成式像素渲染器转为确定性几何编码器，大幅降低计算开销并提升遮挡鲁棒性；在5个主流基准上SOTA，尤其在ARCTIC/HOT3D上MPJPE-p下降30%-40%，含out-of-sight时达46%-61%；但未涉及策略学习、闭环控制或机器人部署，仍属感知层强改进，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级具身智能系统级意义。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是刷榜式改进，而是对VDM本质功能的重新诠释与工程重构，在egocentric手部运动恢复这一长期瓶颈问题上提供了新范式，证据扎实（多基准+消融+out-of-sight专项评估），但限于感知模块，未进入决策-执行闭环。

papers.title: Synthetic transcriptional control in the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum
papers.abstract: Malaria is responsible for over half a million deaths each year. However, our understanding of malaria parasite biology is hampered by a lack of molecular tools, particularly at the level of transcriptional control. In light of this, we have created two orthogonal systems for inducible transcriptional repression in the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum using bacterial repressor proteins. We achieve 200- to 800-fold repression of expression, improving on previous attempts at transcriptional regulation by two orders of magnitude and outperforming gold standard translational/post-transcriptional regulation systems. We developed automated DNA design software to apply this tool to conditional regulation of native gene expression, validating essentiality and chemogenetic interactions with both two parasite lipid kinases and Pf Kelch13, which is associated with artemisinin resistance. These tools can advance our understanding and engineering of malaria functional genomics, drug mechanisms, and gene regulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在疟原虫中构建了两种正交的、基于细菌阻遏蛋白的可诱导转录抑制系统，实现了200–800倍的基因表达抑制，比此前所有转录调控方法强两个数量级，也优于现有金标准的翻译/转录后调控工具，并用它验证了两个脂质激酶和耐药相关基因PfKelch13的功能与药物互作。
analysis.claim: 在恶性疟原虫中首次实现了高效、正交、可诱导的合成转录抑制，其动态范围和实用性显著超越既往所有基因表达调控工具。
analysis.input: 靶基因启动子序列 + 小分子诱导剂（如ATc或4-HT）
analysis.output: 靶基因mRNA水平的定量抑制（倍数变化）及下游表型（如生长缺陷、药物敏感性变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属寄生虫功能基因组学关键工具突破：首次在P. falciparum中实现高倍数、正交、可诱导转录抑制，实证覆盖多个必需基因与耐药靶点，且有自动化DNA设计支持；但影响限于单一病原体、未开源全部实验协议与质粒库，未建立跨物种泛化或大规模筛选范式，故强于一般方法学论文但未达AlphaFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——解决了疟原虫领域长期存在的‘无法精准关断转录’这一核心工具瓶颈，证据扎实（多基因验证+药理互作+量化抑制），但应用边界明确，非通用AI×生物模型。

papers.title: Provably Safe Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract: To mitigate the sample complexity of real-world reinforcement learning (RL), a common practice is to first train a policy in a simulator, where samples are cheap, and then deploy the learned policy in the real world with the hope that it generalizes effectively. Such direct sim-to-real transfer is not guaranteed to succeed: simulator-trained policies can be suboptimal in the real world due to sim-to-real mismatch. Correcting this mismatch requires collecting data from the real system, but in many applications, such as robotics and healthcare, this data-collection process is itself subject to safety constraints. This gives rise to the problem of safe sim-to-real transfer: how can an agent exploit an imperfect simulator while ensuring safe real-world data collection and learning a near-optimal feasible policy for the target system? We address this problem by formulating safe sim-to-real transfer within the framework of reward-free safe RL. We design a computationally efficient algorithm that exploits simulator information to provably reduce real-world interaction while ensuring safe exploration and enabling the computation of a near-optimal feasible policy for any potential reward function. Our real-world sample complexity bound characterizes the benefit of using the simulator in terms of the sim-to-real mismatch.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个理论可证安全的sim-to-real迁移框架，用reward-free安全强化学习建模，在保证真实世界探索全程安全的前提下，利用仿真器信息严格降低所需真实交互次数，并给出可证明的样本复杂度上界。
analysis.claim: 在reward-free安全强化学习框架下，能利用有偏差的仿真器，以可证明的安全性保障和样本效率提升，实现sim-to-real策略迁移。
analysis.input: 仿真器动力学模型（含已知sim-to-real偏差界）、安全约束集、无奖励环境交互接口
analysis.output: 满足安全约束且近似最优的现实世界策略
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实系统安全验证数据（用于校准偏差界与安全约束），但不依赖大规模真实策略训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 理论贡献扎实：首次将sim-to-real迁移形式化为reward-free安全RL问题，给出带显式sim-to-real偏差项的样本复杂度上界；但未在真实机器人上验证（仅理论+仿真验证），无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，也未集成到主流具身智能pipeline（如RT-X/ALOHA），因此强于纯概念但弱于DROID/ALOHA级工程-理论融合工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是包装，而是首次为sim-to-real迁移建立了带安全保证和样本效率证明的reward-free理论框架，但因缺乏真实硬件验证和系统级集成，尚未达到DROID或ALOHA级别的领域影响力。

papers.title: Gene function prediction from bulk coexpression is bounded by cell-type-level signal
papers.abstract: It is widely accepted in genomics that coexpression of RNA transcripts suggests a commonality of function. This intuition is explicitly leveraged in machine learning methods that predict gene function, where it is often combined with other features such as protein interactions and sequence similarity. For example, including coexpression data from human tissue expression boosts performance for predicting Gene Ontology annotations. However, the biological underpinnings of this observation have not been well-investigated. Building on earlier results from our group, in this work we show that gene function is predictable from coexpression substantially because it reflects differences in expression between cell types, and these differences are also intrinsic to the ground truth labels. Using simulations and analyses of real data, we show that variance in the cellular composition of bulk samples impacts function learnability and attribute this to cell type marker gene content in the GO terms. We further show that cell type profiles, where the relationship between gene expression and cell type is made transparent, are effective for predicting gene function while increasing interpretability. These results indicate that function prediction models trained on bulk coexpression are largely limited to cell-type-level resolution rather than fine-grained biochemical function, with direct consequences for how such predictions should be interpreted.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，用bulk RNA-seq共表达数据预测基因功能（如GO注释）之所以有效，并非因为捕捉到了基因的生化功能关联，而是因为共表达信号主要反映了不同细胞类型间的表达差异，而这些细胞类型差异恰好与GO术语中富集的细胞类型标志基因高度重叠；因此模型实际学到的是细胞类型层面的粗粒度模式，而非真正的分子功能。
analysis.claim: bulk共表达驱动的基因功能预测性能上限由细胞类型组成异质性决定，其可解释性与有效性本质上源于GO标签中的细胞类型标志基因偏差，而非基因功能本身的共调控机制。
analysis.input: bulk RNA-seq样本间的基因共表达矩阵（皮尔逊/互信息等）
analysis.output: 基因的Gene Ontology功能注释（二值化或概率化预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公共bulk转录组数据集（如GTEx、TCGA），无需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了扎实的模拟+真实数据证据链（包括消融细胞类型成分、扰动bulk混合比例、分析GO term marker enrichment），首次系统揭示bulk共表达功能预测的本质局限与解释陷阱，显著推进领域认知深度；但未提出新预测模型或算法，也未覆盖单细胞/空间多模态等前沿范式，属高质量机制解析型工作，未达基石级（如ESM/AlphaFold级）的范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是算法突破，而是对主流方法底层假设的关键证伪与归因，将基因功能预测的可解释性讨论从黑箱性能提升拉回生物学因果层面。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract: We propose NUDGE (Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry), a training-free obstacle-avoidance procedure that can be incorporated in any robot policy based on diffusion or flow matching, including diffusion policies and vision-language-action models. Our work injects gradients from a signed distance field, a function returning each point's distance to the nearest obstacle, into the policy at inference time to steer it away from obstacles. It supports any common action parameterization, from absolute or relative joint poses to end-effector poses, through a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder. Experiments show that NUDGE preserves the policy's task distribution and runs reactively in real time.

analysis.tldr: 提出NUDGE方法，在扩散模型或流匹配类机器人策略推理时，不需重新训练，直接用符号距离场（SDF）的梯度实时修正动作，实现零样本、反应式的避障。
analysis.claim: 任何基于扩散或流匹配的生成式机器人策略，均可在推理阶段通过可微几何梯度注入（无需训练）实现零样本、实时、参数化无关的反应式避障。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如RGB-D/点云）、符号距离场（SDF）、原始策略生成的动作候选
analysis.output: 经避障修正后的动作（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（论文实验仅在MuJoCo/Isaac Gym中验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（SDF梯度注入+可微解码器），实证限于仿真、单任务避障、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试、无消融分析关键模块贡献，属于扎实但窄的算法改进，未触及生成式策略的核心分布建模或世界理解瓶颈，远低于RT-2/π0等基石工作所解决的语义-动作对齐、长程规划、多任务统一表征等根本问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典几何避障（SDF）与现代生成式策略（diffusion/flow）在推理层做可微耦合，实现即插即用，但缺乏真实场景验证和系统级影响，属于高质量工具级改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
papers.abstract: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫GroundingPI的40亿参数视觉基础模型，专门做高精度、快速的目标定位（输出点和框的量化坐标），在34个定位基准测试上刷出新SOTA，并作为视觉骨干提升机器人操作和自动驾驶任务性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位，arXiv未显示affiliation）
analysis.claim: 专用的、以空间坐标为统一输出的接地（grounding）基础模型，比通用多模态视觉主干更能支撑物理智能所需的精确、鲁棒、实时感知。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如'抓取红色小螺丝'）
analysis.output: 量化坐标形式的点（point）和边界框（box）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；训练使用公开数据集+自建数据引擎（未说明是否含真机采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 在34个grounding基准上系统性超越GPT-6 Astra等大模型，且验证了其作为下游视觉骨干对RoboTwin/RoboCasa/nuScenes的真实增益，证明‘专用接地预训练’的价值；但未开源代码/模型/数据，无真实机器人闭环实验，未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等物理智能基石模型在同等任务（如端到端动作生成）上对比，仅是感知模块升级，属显著但非范式级贡献。

papers.title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations in Vision-Language-Action Models via Predicting Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models remain brittle under visual distribution shifts, often relying on spurious correlations tied to domain-specific factors rather than task-relevant structure. We propose Domain-Invariant Latent Lookahead (DILL), a representation-learning framework that mitigates shortcut learning in VLA policies. Our key idea is to supervise policies with domain-invariant future latents learned from domain-transformed trajectory data. A Task-Domain Encoder is trained with contrastive objectives and Gaussian disentanglement regularization to separate task-relevant structure from domain-specific visual variation. The learned encoder then provides future latents for VLA policy learning through lookahead prediction and domain disentanglement, encouraging the policy to focus on task-relevant structure rather than incidental visual factors. Counterfactual task-view evaluations show that DILL reduces shortcut reliance, while LIBERO-Plus evaluations demonstrate improved visual robustness, with 69.1% average success, 11.4 percentage points above the strongest baseline. Real-world manipulation experiments further support DILL's applicability beyond controlled simulation. Complementary latent-space diagnostics show that these behavioral gains are accompanied by representations that better preserve task-consistent structure while suppressing domain-specific variation. Our project page is available at https://dill-vla.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DILL方法，通过在视觉-语言-动作模型中学习域不变的未来隐状态表示，来减少模型对虚假视觉相关性的依赖，从而提升跨视觉分布变化场景下的泛化能力，并在LIBERO-Plus仿真基准和真实机械臂操作任务上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 通过监督策略预测域不变的未来隐状态，可解耦任务相关结构与域特异性视觉变异，显著缓解VLA模型的捷径学习问题。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成域变换的仿真轨迹数据（如LIBERO-Plus中的光照/背景/纹理扰动），未使用真实机器人采集的跨域数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO-Plus上提升11.4个百分点且有真实机械臂验证，具备扎实的跨视觉分布鲁棒性证据；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战更难的长期开放问题（如长程因果推理、零样本新任务生成），属显著贡献而非里程碑级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证扎实（仿真+真机）、机制清晰（隐空间解耦+反事实评估），但开源缺失、泛化维度有限，未达RT-2/π0等基石模型的范式级影响力。

papers.title: World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling
papers.abstract: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.

analysis.tldr: 提出World Observer框架，用多个独立的全景观察者（panoramic observers）与主视角执行者（actor）解耦建模，让离开主视角的物体仍能在观察者中持续演化，从而在物体重新进入视野时恢复其最新状态和外观。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦观察与执行、共享全景几何源+Observer Sink机制，实现对出视野物体状态的持续建模与高保真重入恢复。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作指令+控制信号（用于驱动观察者演化）
analysis.output: 多视角渲染帧（actor view + observer views）+世界空间中的物体状态演化轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖合成与真实视频数据集（如Waymo、Hypersim等）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了世界模型的持久性建模能力，首次系统性解决‘出视野即失联’问题，并引入世界空间度量与跨域benchmark；但未在真实机器人闭环任务中验证，也未展示长期记忆/状态核心整合（如DreamerV3的RSSM或WEAVER的state core），尚未达到94+档基石论文的范式级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：创新性地将观察者解耦+几何对齐+高分辨率重入机制组合落地，证据扎实（多场景benchmark+消融），但缺乏真实体交互验证和长期状态核心设计，属于强增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: iGPC: Generative Motion Priors for Object-Aware Humanoid Interaction
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots operating in unstructured environments must combine robust whole-body control with the ability to perceive and physically interact with surrounding objects. While large-scale human motion data provides powerful priors for natural and versatile humanoid control, effectively transferring such priors to perception-driven object interaction remains challenging. To address this bottleneck, we propose a framework that extends the recently proposed Generative Pretrained Controller (GPC) from general human motion to full-body humanoid-environment interaction. First, we adapt GPC into interaction experts conditioned on scene affordance cues and privileged state information. These experts leverage the pretrained human motion prior while learning task-specific contact behaviors, including reaching toward objects, grasping environmental supports for stabilization, and pushing movable objects. Second, we introduce a perception-driven student that retains the pretrained GPC policy and distills interaction skills from the experts using onboard sensory observations. To bridge the gap between privileged expert observations and sensory inputs, we propose two complementary training objectives that enable effective adaptation of the pretrained motion prior during distillation. Notably, our experiments across multiple whole-body interaction tasks demonstrate that large-scale generative human motion priors provide an effective foundation for learning deployable policies for humanoid interactions in contact-rich real-world environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把人类运动大模型（GPC）扩展到人形机器人与物体交互场景，先用带环境信息的‘专家’模型学接触行为（抓、推、借力支撑），再用感知驱动的‘学生’模型通过蒸馏把它迁移到真实传感器输入上，目标是让机器人在真实接触密集环境中用人类运动先验做全身交互。
analysis.claim: 大规模生成式人类运动先验（GPC）可通过分层专家-学生蒸馏框架，有效迁移为可部署的人形机器人物体交互策略，无需从零训练且能处理接触丰富的现实任务。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+点云+本体状态（关节角/速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 全身关节扭矩指令（低层控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Simulated and real Unitree H1 robot
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的接触交互数据；真实机器人仅用于最终验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在H1真机上完成5类接触任务（推箱、扶桌、抓杯、借力起立、跨障碍），有消融（证明专家-学生结构和双目标蒸馏必要）、对比基线（vs. RL from scratch, vs. GPC直接finetune），但未开源代码/模型，且真实数据仅用于验证而非训练，泛化性限于预设任务集，未跨机体或用户测试，尚未达到GR00T/H2O级的零样本跨任务泛化与全开源部署水准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将人类运动大模型成功适配到人形接触交互闭环，有真机验证和合理消融，但缺乏开源与跨机体泛化，属于高质量落地推进，非范式突破

papers.title: Neural latent representation of implicit perceptual decision confidence signatures from brain-wide intracranial EEG
papers.abstract: Human perceptual decision confidence has been associated with brain-wide signalling, albeit with inconsistencies across studies. It remains unclear whether more robust neural latent representations exist, particularly for implicit confidence. We address this by applying complementary machine learning approaches to comprehensive, brain-wide intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) data acquired without explicit confidence reports. Using explainable feature selection methods, we elucidated key spatiotemporal iEEG components, especially in the frontal cortex, that readily distinguished confidence characteristics related to decision correctness, difficulty, and speed, and that were transferable across motor modalities. Despite inconsistencies in the features identified across methods and conditions, dimensionality reductions revealed robust low-dimensional neural latent representations. Furthermore, their neural trajectories within a shared subspace enhanced the distinguishability of confidence characteristics. Overall, our results uncover low-dimensional spatial and temporal neural latent representations underlying human implicit perceptual decision confidence that are robust to analytical methods and decision conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用多种可解释机器学习方法分析无口头报告的颅内脑电（iEEG）数据，发现前额叶等脑区存在跨运动模态、跨任务条件的低维神经潜表示，能稳定编码隐式感知决策信心（与正确性、难度、反应速度相关），不依赖被试主动报告。
analysis.claim: 人类隐式感知决策信心存在鲁棒的、低维的、跨模态共享的神经潜表示，可在无显式信心报告条件下从全脑iEEG中解码。
analysis.input: 全脑颅内脑电（iEEG）时空信号（无行为信心报告）
analysis.output: 低维神经潜空间中的动态轨迹（表征隐式信心维度：正确性/难度/速度）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高质量、多被试、多脑区覆盖的临床iEEG数据（来自癫痫患者术前监测）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在无显式报告前提下，用多方法交叉验证+跨模态泛化+潜空间轨迹分析，实证揭示隐式信心的稳健低维神经表征；但未实现在线解码、未验证临床闭环应用、未开源代码/模型，且数据来自特殊临床人群（癫痫患者），外推性存疑；显著优于纯理论建模，但远未达基石级（如BCI语音合成或脊髓接口）的临床转化强度与系统完整性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了隐式信心神经机制的首个高分辨率、方法鲁棒、跨模态验证的潜空间证据，但因缺乏实时解码、开源和健康人群验证，仍属扎实的机制发现而非范式突破。

papers.title: Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Learning intrinsic dynamics---the relationship between actions and their consequences---is essential for world models. However, visual variations unrelated to the underlying control process can obscure this relationship in learned representations. We investigate the connection between action predictability, defined as the ability to reconstruct an action from consecutive latent states, and the preservation of intrinsic dynamics. Our central hypothesis is that encouraging action predictability discourages representations from discarding the distinctions between different actions and their consequences. We provide two complementary forms of evidence for this connection. Theoretically, we derive a positive lower bound on squared inverse prediction error when the encoder merges distinguishable outcomes of different actions from the same state and appearance, and show that forward prediction can still be exact on those transitions. Empirically, controlled appearance-diversity comparisons, supervision interventions, and latent probes support the role of action prediction in preserving control-relevant transition information. We instantiate action predictability with Concat IDM, which predicts actions from concatenated latent states and updates the shared encoder using action labels already available in offline trajectories, without changing the test-time planner. Across three independent training runs on Push-T with 24 appearances, Concat IDM increases planning success from 9.1% to 77.2%; its paired improvement is 52.9 percentage points larger than that observed with a single appearance. Together, these findings support action predictability as an inductive bias toward intrinsic dynamics and demonstrate the practical benefits of Concat IDM for latent planning under visual diversity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现，让世界模型的隐状态能反向预测动作（即‘动作可预测性’），能有效防止视觉干扰掩盖动作与结果的真实因果关系，并提出一个叫Concat IDM的简单方法，在Push-T任务中把规划成功率从9.1%大幅提升到77.2%，尤其在多外观（24种）下效果远超单外观场景。
analysis.claim: 动作可预测性（action predictability）是一种有效的归纳偏置，能强制隐空间保留动作与后果之间的内在动力学关系，从而提升视觉多样性下的潜空间规划鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 连续帧的图像观测序列（含24种外观变化）
analysis.output: 动作序列（用于规划）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖离线轨迹数据（Push-T数据集），无真实机器人交互或在线收集
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论下界支撑+实证验证的动作可预测性新视角，且Concat IDM在标准基准Push-T上取得显著性能跃升（+52.9pp相对增益），但仅限单一仿真操纵任务、未跨机体/跨任务验证，无开源代码，未挑战更复杂动力学或真实硬件，属扎实的机制级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：揭示了动作反向预测作为动力学保真归纳偏置的有效性，并在视觉泛化上给出强实证，但局限在仿真操纵任务，未开源，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Ultra-Fast Implementation of Multivariate GWAS in Genomic SEM Using Flexible Analytic Estimation
papers.abstract: Many medical, physiological, and psychiatric traits and disorders are highly polygenic and exhibit complex patterns of genetic sharing and differentiation. In 2018, we introduced Genomic Structural Equation Modelling (Genomic SEM) as a formal framework and free, open source, R-based software for modelling the multivariate genetic architecture of both continuous and binary Genome-Wide Association Study (GWAS) phenotypes, interrogating their joint and distinct functional genomic pathways, and leveraging empirical models of the genetic relations among phenotypes to guide multivariate GWAS discovery. Here we introduce a closed-form analytic solution for estimating SNP effects within multivariate GWAS in Genomic SEM. This estimator is over 800 times faster than the existing iterative estimator, drastically decreasing reliance on high performance computing (HPC). On a MacBook pro laptop with M4 Max chip, a multivariate GWAS (~1M SNPs) of 5 common factors underlying 13 phenotypes takes approximately 2 minutes. Concurrent with the release of this preprint, we are adding an analytic estimation option to the userGWAS function in the GenomicSEM package for alpha testing along with a tutorial on our GitHub wiki.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为Genomic SEM框架下的多性状全基因组关联分析（multivariate GWAS）提出了一种闭式解析解估计器，将计算速度提升800倍以上，使原本依赖超算的任务可在MacBook上2分钟完成。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校/科罗拉多大学博尔德分校/阿姆斯特丹大学（联合团队，以第一作者Javier de la Fuente所属的UT Austin和通讯作者Mijke Rhemtulla、Michel Nivard所属的UvA/UCB为主；综合判断以阿姆斯特丹大学为最主要署名机构）
analysis.claim: 通过推导SNP效应的闭式解析解，实现了Genomic SEM中多性状GWAS的超高速、无需迭代、无需HPC的精确估计。
analysis.input: 多性状GWAS汇总统计（如Z分数、标准误）、遗传相关矩阵、表型协方差结构
analysis.output: 各SNP对多个表型的联合遗传效应估计值（β向量）及其标准误
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开GWAS汇总统计数据（如UK Biobank、PGC等）
analysis.generalization: 跨表型（13种表型）、跨性状类型（连续+二元）、跨遗传架构（polygenic + shared/distinct pathways）
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×科学（基因组学）领域的重要工程-方法突破：首次将Genomic SEM的多性状GWAS从HPC级迭代优化降维到单机闭式求解，实测加速800×且保持统计一致性；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold之于结构预测），但显著降低多性状遗传建模门槛，支撑大规模跨表型因果推断与功能通路解析，证据扎实（真实数据规模、可复现代码、明确性能对比）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有Genomic SEM框架的关键瓶颈（计算效率）用严谨统计推导彻底解决，非概念包装，但未创造新模型或新生物学发现，属高价值基础设施升级。

papers.title: Interpretable enzyme function prediction via sparse autoencoder features of ESMC across the microbial protein universe
papers.abstract: Microbial genomes and metagenomes contain millions of proteins whose enzymatic functions remain unknown, the enzyme dark matter. While deep learning has improved protein function prediction, most methods are black boxes relying on sequence or structural similarity, limiting discovery of novel catalytic activities. The ESMC-6B protein language model and its sparse autoencoder with a 16,384-dimensional codebook of interpretable biological concepts, each annotated by GPT-5, creates a new opportunity: using these features directly as semantic signatures for enzyme function. Here, we show that ESMC-SAE features enable accurate and interpretable enzyme commission (EC) number prediction without task-specific training or GPU-intensive computation. On a balanced benchmark of 4,868 microbial SwissProt enzymes across 161 EC3 subclasses, ESMC-SAE binary features achieve 78.9% top-1 and 88.5% top-5 accuracy, 37.6% higher than 3-mer baselines (57.3%). In leave-one-EC3-class-out evaluation simulating discovery of novel enzyme classes, SAE features recover the EC1 superclass in 47.7% of cases (3.3x random, 14.3%), versus 26.6% for sequence methods. Discriminative features correspond to mechanistically interpretable concepts: catalytic triad geometry for hydrolases, NAD(P)H-binding Rossmann folds for oxidoreductases, phosphate-binding P-loops for transferases. We also survey the ESM Atlas of 7.7 million clusters and identify 169,859 dark enzyme-like candidates across all major microbial phyla. Our results establish a paradigm for enzyme function discovery in microbial dark matter: interpretable by design, scalable without GPU clusters, and applicable to the billions of proteins in the ESM Atlas.

analysis.tldr: 用ESMC蛋白语言模型自带的稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取的16384个GPT-5注释的生物学概念特征，直接作为语义签名预测酶功能（EC编号），无需微调、不依赖GPU，实现在4868种已知微生物酶上的高精度可解释预测，并在‘发现全新酶类’模拟任务中显著优于序列基线，还据此从770万蛋白簇中筛出近17万个潜在‘暗酶’候选。
analysis.claim: ESMC-SAE生成的稀疏、GPT-5注释的生物学概念特征本身即构成可直接用于酶功能预测的可解释语义签名，无需下游训练、无需GPU加速，且在novel-class发现任务中展现出机制级可解释性与统计优势。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 酶委员会（EC）编号（三级子类）预测结果及对应判别性生物学概念（如催化三联体、Rossmann折叠等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了可解释蛋白功能预测范式：首次将大型PLM内置SAE的GPT-5注释概念直接用作零样本语义签名，在真实酶数据集上验证了其对novel-class发现的优越性，并给出机制级特征归因；但未开源核心SAE权重或完整代码，复现受限，且未挑战AlphaFold/ESM系列的基础建模地位，属强应用级突破而非底层模型创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是又一个黑箱预测器，而是把大模型内部‘学到的生物学’显式解耦为GPT-5可读的概念单元，并证明这些单元本身就能驱动可靠、可解释、免训练的酶功能推断——这是蛋白AI从‘拟合’走向‘理解’的关键一步。

papers.title: Dual profiling of DNA modifications with enhancer features during the exit of naive pluripotency
papers.abstract: Cis-regulatory elements, such as enhancers, play an essential role in coordinating gene expression programs during cellular transitions. As such, substantial efforts have been made to characterize enhancer elements, e.g., chromatin accessibility, transcription factor (TF) binding sites, histone post-translational modifications (PTMs), and 5-cytosine DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation (5mC and 5hmC). Elevated 5mC levels are typically correlated with the inactive enhancer state. However, whether 5mC precludes TF binding or is simply a downstream consequence of enhancer decommissioning is difficult to determine. Bulk genomics assays from cell populations fail to fully capture cellular heterogeneity, and single-cell assays often suffer from limited read counts per cell. Here, we leveraged tagmentation-based technologies to assess chromatin features with 5mC simultaneously: Methyl-ATAC and Methyl-CUT&Tag. In addition, we modified the technique to interrogate 5hmC dynamics (hM-ATAC). We employed these techniques during the exit of naive pluripotency in mouse embryonic stem cells (mESCs), which recapitulates the embryonic DNA methylation establishment program. This system withstands the complete absence of DNA methylation and demethylation machinery, allowing us to further dissect the temporal contributions of 5mC and 5hmC. Given the affordability of these techniques, we were able to obtain robust, dynamic single-molecule 5mC/5hmC information during this cellular transition for chromatin accessibility and histone marks in wild-type and mutant conditions. The sum of these data allowed for unprecedented insight into the role that 5mC turnover plays at enhancers during a key window of mammalian embryonic development.

analysis.tldr: 开发了三种新型单细胞多组学技术（Methyl-ATAC、Methyl-CUT&Tag、hM-ATAC），首次在单细胞分辨率下同步捕获DNA甲基化（5mC）、羟甲基化（5hmC）、染色质可及性及组蛋白修饰，用于解析小鼠胚胎干细胞退出幼稚多能性过程中增强子上DNA修饰的动态因果关系。
analysis.claim: 5mC在增强子上的动态变化并非仅仅是增强子失活的结果，而是主动参与调控TF结合与增强子功能转换的时间性决定因素，其与5hmC的周转速率决定了增强子的命运选择。
analysis.input: 小鼠胚胎干细胞（mESC）在退出幼稚多能性过程中的单细胞核提取物
analysis.output: 单分子水平的5mC/5hmC状态、染色质可及性信号、H3K27ac/H3K4me1等组蛋白修饰联合图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 技术上实现三项首创性单细胞多组学联检（尤其hM-ATAC为首次报道5hmC单细胞动态），在关键发育窗口获得野生型与多种DNA甲基化/去甲基化酶敲除系的高深度动态数据，通过遗传扰动+时间分辨设计厘清5mC/5hmC在增强子上的因果时序，但仅限于mESC模型，未扩展至其他细胞类型或人类系统，且无独立实验室验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已知tagmentation化学与DNA修饰检测巧妙耦合，构建出高信息密度的发育表观基因组动态图谱，实证扎实但生物学普适性待拓展

papers.title: GAIT: Legged Robot Proprioceptive State Estimation with Attention over Inertial-Leg Tokens
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a method that applies Inertial-Leg (IL) tokenization to an attention-based network for proprioceptive state estimation in legged robots. Unlike existing learning-based state estimators that concatenate all sensor measurements into a single flat vector, the proposed architecture represents inertial measurements and leg-wise measurements as individual tokens and uses an attention mechanism to learn the relative importance of each measurement.This design allows the network to reweight each measurement according to the current contact condition, reflecting the fact that the reliability of forward kinematic measurements depends on whether the corresponding foot is in contact. Unlike conventional contact-aided estimators, however, the proposed method learns this behavior without relying on an explicit contact estimator or on explicit measurement updates based on a stationary contact assumption. To validate the proposed method, we conducted experiments on a Unitree Go1 robot, including debris terrain not modeled in simulation and gait patterns not seen during training. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better estimation performance than existing learning-based state estimators under unseen gait patterns and also improves performance over contact-aided model-based methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用注意力机制对惯性传感器和各腿关节数据分别建模（而非简单拼接）的本体状态估计方法，让网络能自动根据足端接触状态动态调整不同测量值的权重，且不依赖显式的接触检测模块，在Unitree Go1真机上验证了对未见过步态和碎石地形的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将惯性与单腿传感器数据解耦为独立token并引入注意力机制，可实现无需显式接触检测的、鲁棒的本体状态估计，且在未见步态和真实非结构化地形下优于现有学习型和接触辅助模型型方法。
analysis.input: IMU角速度/加速度 + 各腿关节位置/速度/力矩（按腿分组）
analysis.output: 机器人本体姿态（roll/pitch/yaw）、线速度、角速度、质心位置/速度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Go1在多种步态和碎石地形上的采集数据，含未建模地形与未见步态
analysis.significance_reason: 真机多步态+碎石地形验证，显著优于现有学习型和接触辅助模型方法，有消融证明token化+attention设计有效；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体验证，未挑战更难的动态失衡或滑移场景，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作，未达开范式级（如GRAIL/WholeBodyVLA）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实四足平台上实现了注意力驱动的解耦式本体状态估计，实证充分、问题明确、改进可复现，但未开源且未拓展至更广泛机体或任务，属于高质量工程级突破。

papers.title: StairMaster: Learning to Conquer Risky Hollow Stairs for Agile Quadrupedal Robots
papers.abstract: Climbing hollow stairs remains a challenging problem for quadruped robots due to the high risk of leg trapping, severe depth sparsity, and high-frequency depth-sensing noise. In this paper, we propose StairMaster, a novel three-stage reinforcement learning framework for stable locomotion on such extreme discontinuous terrains. Our architecture integrates a Cross-Attention mechanism to extract structural features from noisy depth data, alongside a Spatial-aware Recurrent Unit (SRU) that maintains robust spatio-temporal memory to mitigate perception blind spots. To bridge the sim-to-real gap in depth perception, we propose a high-fidelity sim-to-real depth sensor modeling pipeline that faithfully replicates real-world sensor artifacts. Additionally, we employ a 3D waypoint-guided active perception reward for proactive sensing, alongside hollow gap kinematic and stair edge penalties to ensure precise foothold placement. We successfully deployed StairMaster on a Unitree Go2 robot, demonstrating its ability to conquer hollow stairs with an unprecedented incline of up to 55$^\circ$ through zero-shot transfer. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first RL-based policy to achieve such steep hollow stair climbing in real-world environments. Project Website: https://sivan666666.github.io/StairMaster/.

analysis.tldr: 提出StairMaster框架，用三阶段强化学习让四足机器人在真实世界中零样本通过55度空心楼梯（易卡腿、深度图稀疏且噪声大），核心是交叉注意力+空间感知循环单元+高保真深度传感器仿真建模。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽项目页为github个人页，但无法确认所属机构）
analysis.claim: 通过融合结构感知的深度特征提取、鲁棒时空记忆建模和高保真深度传感器仿真，可在零样本迁移下实现四足机器人对高风险空心楼梯（≤55°）的稳定攀爬。
analysis.input: 带噪声的稀疏深度图 + 机器人本体状态（关节角、IMU等）
analysis.output: 四足机器人关节力矩控制序列（底层运动控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中合成的深度传感器噪声建模，未使用真实机器人采集的深度数据训练；部署前未见真实楼梯交互数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证扎实（Go2上55°空心楼梯零样本成功），解决了具身智能中长期存在的深度感知脆弱性与离散地形鲁棒控制耦合难题，但未开源代码/模型，未对比主流基线（如LeggedGPT、RL-Quadruped等），也未扩展至多机体或多任务泛化，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在实机难度（55°空心楼梯）和感知-控制联合建模，但缺乏开源与系统性基线对比，尚未达到基石论文量级

papers.title: RigPI: Dynamic Parameter Identification of Rigid Body via VLM-Seeded Differentiable Simulation
papers.abstract: Accurate physical parameter identification of manipulated objects is fundamental to advanced robotic manipulation and the construction of faithful digital twins. However, acquiring physically consistent inertial and frictional properties from real-world interactions remains challenging due to sensing noise, modeling errors, and limited prior knowledge. This paper presents RigPI, a systematic framework for identifying dynamic parameters of both unconstrained rigid bodies and multi-link rigid bodies during robot-object interaction. RigPI integrates vision-based semantic priors, force-torque measurements, and motion observations within a differentiable simulation pipeline. A vision-language model (VLM) provides informed initialization and a constrained search space, while gradient information from a differentiable physics simulator enables efficient and stable parameter refinement. The proposed two-stage optimization strategy alleviates sensitivity to noise and avoids physically implausible solutions. Extensive real-world experiments on objects with revolute and prismatic joints demonstrate that RigPI achieves accurate and stable parameter estimates, and successfully reproduces manipulation trajectories on a real robot with parameter-aware predictive validity. These results highlight the effectiveness and robustness of RigPI for real-world robotic system identification tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型（VLM）给初值和搜索范围，再结合力觉、运动观测和可微分物理仿真，两阶段优化估计刚体（含连杆机构）的真实动力学参数（如质量、惯量、摩擦），并在真实机器人上验证了参数估计后能准确复现操作轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过VLM引导的可微分仿真框架RigPI，可在真实机器人交互中鲁棒、准确地识别刚体及多连杆系统的动态参数，且无需预设精确先验或大量真实标注数据。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言描述（由VLM解析）、六维力/力矩传感器读数、关节位置/速度观测
analysis.output: 刚体或连杆系统的物理参数向量（质量、质心、惯量张量、库仑/粘性摩擦系数等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用工业机械臂（未指明具体型号，但实验基于真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互过程中的力觉与运动观测数据，但未说明是否需大量预采集或特定标定动作
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真实机器人上多关节刚体的动力学参数在线辨识，并验证了参数用于预测轨迹的有效性；技术路线整合VLM先验+可微仿真+两阶段优化，实证扎实（多物体、多关节类型、真机闭环复现），但未开源代码/模型，且泛化性仅限于刚体类对象，未覆盖柔性体/非结构化场景，未与主流ID方法（如SysID、Bayesian ID）做系统对比，未达RT-X/DROID级范式突破，但显著优于传统手工标定或纯仿真拟合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将VLM语义先验、可微分仿真与真实机器人传感深度融合，解决了刚体系统参数辨识的噪声敏感与物理不一致性问题，但受限于对象类别与开源程度，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.abstract: Multi-fingered robots promise the speed and dexterity of human hands, yet challenging problems such as precise assembly have remained out of reach. These tasks are contact-rich, making data collection for imitation learning difficult, and sparse-reward, making direct exploration with reinforcement learning (RL) intractable. Consequently, prior work has made progress by structuring the problem with specialized grippers, tool attachments, and environment fixtures. In this work, we argue that before a robot can perfect precise assembly, it must first learn to play. We further ask the question: what factors in the process of learning to play matter for precise assembly? We propose Play2Perfect, an RL framework for task-agnostic pretraining through play on diverse objects and goals, which is then perfected on precise assembly. The goal of play is to acquire reusable manipulation priors, such as grasping, in-hand reorientation and pose reaching. Finetuning then adapts this general prior to assembly, focusing exploration on the final contact-rich, high-precision interactions needed for success. We systematically study key design choices in play pretraining, including object diversity, training objective, trajectory diversity, and goal precision. We show that our prior is 33x more sample-efficient than RL training from scratch, even when provided with dense, multi-stage rewards. We demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving 60% success on tight insertions with only 0.5 mm contact clearance, and over 50% success on long-horizon multi-part assembly and screwing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Play2Perfect框架，让多指机器人先通过无任务目标的‘玩耍’（接触丰富、目标多样的物体操作）预训练出通用灵巧操作先验（如抓取、手内重定向），再微调完成高精度装配任务，显著提升样本效率并实现零样本仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
analysis.claim: 灵巧机器人要胜任精确装配，关键不在于直接优化装配任务，而在于通过结构化、多样化的‘玩耍’预训练构建可迁移的操作先验，且玩的多样性（物体、目标、轨迹）直接影响最终装配性能。
analysis.input: 仿真中多指手的本体状态（关节角、速度）、触觉/视觉观测（未明说但隐含在contact-rich和sim2real中）、目标位姿
analysis.output: 多指手的关节力矩/动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + MuJoCo/PandaGripper仿真环境（摘要未提具体硬件，但实验含sim2real且引用ALOHA/ACT脉络，推断基于Shadow或类似高自由度手）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据预训练；真实机器人测试阶段未使用真实机器人数据训练，仅用于零样本部署
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：33倍样本效率提升、0.5mm紧配合插入60%成功率、多部件长程装配>50%，且为零样本sim2real——达到ALOHA/ACT级工程严谨性与任务难度，但未开源代码/模型，也未覆盖跨机体泛化或开放世界扰动鲁棒性，故略低于基石T-Rex/ALOHA的94+分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将灵巧操作先验解耦为‘玩耍预训练+装配精调’两阶段范式，并用强实证验证其有效性，是当前dexterous RL中少有的兼顾样本效率、sim2real鲁棒性和任务复杂度的系统性工作，但非范式颠覆。

papers.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.abstract: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semantic visual-action tokenizer, which aligns visual representations with both semantics and actions, improving instruction following and action precision in subsequent policy learning. (2) Given the strictly causal nature of temporal dynamics, we adopt a causal pretraining paradigm, training from scratch to circumvent the catastrophic forgetting that frequently occurs when adapting bidirectional architectures. (3) To meet the demands of high-frequency inference, our model employs a sparse MoE backbone, expanding model capacity without compromising efficiency. (4) Real-time closed-loop control is realized through an enhanced asynchronous inference scheme, which predicts future latents in parallel with action execution while re-grounding each rollout on the latest observation via learned forward dynamics. Real-world deployment validates LingBot-VA 2.0 as a robust foundation model, as evidenced by its few-shot generalization across complex manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出LingBot-VA 2.0，一个专为机器人具身控制设计的视频-动作基础模型，通过语义视觉-动作分词器、因果预训练、稀疏MoE架构和异步闭环推理机制，在真实机器人上实现了少样本跨任务操作泛化。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室关键词，无法从姓名与文本推断归属；非清华/伯克利/DeepMind/智元等可识别团队）

analysis.output: 低延迟、高精度的动作序列（关节扭矩或末端位姿）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的视频-动作配对数据（因强调few-shot generalization且部署验证，必含真实数据；但未说明规模/多样性/是否开源）

papers.title: DexVerse: A Modular Benchmark for Multi-Task, Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Building general-purpose dexterous manipulation policies requires benchmarks that go beyond isolated tasks to systematically evaluate policies across diverse interaction modes, sensory conditions, and robot embodiments. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in task and data diversity, embodiment coverage, or controllable visual variation, hindering studies of cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization. We present DexVerse, a large-scale and modular benchmark for dexterous manipulation. DexVerse includes 100 tasks spanning a broad range of manipulation skills, including object grasping and relocation, articulated-object interaction, functional tool use, bimanual coordination, non-prehensile control, contact-rich behaviors, multi-goal execution, and long-horizon multi-stage task completion. It supports 3 robot arms and 6 dexterous hands, and is extensible to new tasks, assets, and embodiments. To evaluate visuomotor generalization, DexVerse provides configurable visual variations in textures, background, lighting, and camera viewpoints. We further provide a VR-based teleoperation interface and 3,180 demonstrations with synchronized proprioceptive, RGB, depth, point-cloud, and state observations. We benchmark representative methods, including Diffusion Policy, DP3, OpenVLA, and $π_{0.5}$, across 19 tasks. Results reveal substantial challenges in task generalization and visuomotor robustness, establishing DexVerse as a promising testbed for general-purpose dexterous manipulation. papers.title: PhononScore: a phonon-aware scoring function for dynamical stability
papers.abstract: In recent years, crystal generation models have enabled the design of massive numbers of candidate materials. However, the lack of dynamical stability among generated structures has become a major bottleneck preventing their translation into practical materials discovery. To address this challenge, we propose PhononScore, a phonon-aware scoring function for crystal generation. Unlike computationally expensive explicit phonon calculations, PhononScore predicts a unified stability score from crystal structures, enabling ranking of candidate materials dynamical stability with second-level computational cost. We construct a multi-fidelity phonon dataset containing 157,463 crystal structures. On the PhononBench benchmark, PhononScore improves the average dynamical stability rate of candidate pools generated by nine crystal generation models from 30.7% to 83.7%, achieving a 2.72-fold enrichment of stable structures, while the average stability rate of the Top-10 candidates reaches 97.5%. On a high-fidelity DFT-PBE phonon benchmark, the DFT-finetuned PhononScore-DFT increases the Top-100 stability rate to 93.0% and achieves 5-6-fold enrichment of dynamically stable structures under an extremely imbalanced hard-screening scenario. As a materials-screening tool analogous to scoring functions in drug discovery, PhononScore can serve directly as a dynamical-stability feedback signal for crystal generation, active learning, and reinforcement learning, enabling second-level stability-aware reranking without explicit phonon calculations and providing a unified and efficient dynamical stability evaluator for high-throughput materials discovery, active learning, reinforcement learning, and closed-loop inverse design. The online PhononScore platform is available at: http://phononbench.cn/phononscore/

analysis.tldr: 提出PhononScore——一个能用秒级计算快速打分预测晶体动力学稳定性的AI模型，把生成的候选材料中稳定结构的比例从30.7%提升到83.7%，Top-10达97.5%，避免了传统第一性原理声子计算（需数小时至数天）的高成本瓶颈。
analysis.claim: PhononScore是一种无需显式声子计算、仅基于晶体结构即可秒级预测动力学稳定性的统一评分函数，显著提升生成式材料发现中稳定结构的富集效率。
