papers.title: Artificial Foveated Perception for Mitigating Shortcut Learning in Robotic Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Robotic foundation models have recently made substantial progress in multi-task capability, cross-embodiment transfer, and language-conditioned control. Yet robust deployment across diverse real-world settings remains difficult, in part because policies often fail to distinguish causally relevant visual structure from spurious scene-level correlations. We identify this failure mode as shortcut learning: the tendency to exploit predictive but non-causal correlations in the training distribution rather than the task-relevant visual evidence that determines successful action. Although shortcut learning has been extensively studied in computer vision and broader machine learning, its role in robotic foundation models remains comparatively underexplored. We propose Artificial Foveated Perception (AFP), a lightweight, policy-agnostic module that takes the same vision and language inputs as Vision-Language-Action and World Action Model pipelines and predicts task-conditioned masks over relevant objects, the robot, and other action-critical regions. We use these masks primarily as an auxiliary grounding signal during fine-tuning, aligning policy attention with task-relevant regions while leaving the core architecture unchanged. After fine-tuning, the policy executes on the original observation stream without requiring AFP in the control loop. We evaluate AFP across state-of-the-art robotic foundation models and show that foveated perception reduces fine-tuning time, suppresses overfitting, and improves generalization under environmental perturbations. Ablations over mask quality and grounding-loss design further show that these gains arise from directing policy learning toward task-relevant visual evidence. These results suggest that task-conditioned foveated perception is a practical mechanism for making robotic foundation models more robust, data-efficient, and scalable.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级的‘人工中央凹感知’（AFP）模块，通过在微调阶段生成任务相关的视觉掩码来引导策略模型关注真正因果相关的区域，从而缓解机器人基础模型中的捷径学习问题，提升泛化性和数据效率，但不改变原始模型结构，也不参与实际部署时的推理。

papers.title: More Structure, Not More Capacity: Object-Centric Representations for Visuomotor Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation policies rely on pre-trained vision models that give either a global scene embedding or a dense patch grid. Both mix task-relevant and task-irrelevant features. Object-centric slot representations are a structured alternative: they group features into a few per-object slots. We test what this structure buys on ManiSkill3 PickCube-v1, with a frozen encoder and a held-out-seed evaluation. Holding the policy, goal token, rendering, and calibration fixed and changing only the encoder, a frozen object-centric SPOT representation (DINO ViT-B/16 + Slot Attention) reaches 55.0$\pm$2.9% success, 22.4% above a dense DINO global-feature baseline (32.6 $\pm$ 1.5%), with the same trainable policy and no encoder fine-tuning. More tokens alone do not help: a dense patch grid with 16x the tokens performs no better than the global feature. Adding an explicit 2D spatial goal and native-resolution rendering raises the full system to 68.7$\pm$4.2%, just below a privileged 3D-oracle upper bound (71.7$\pm$4.1%). An automated kinematic failure taxonomy then separates spatial-precision (Near-Miss) failures from object-tracking (No-Grasp) failures: spatial grounding reduces Near-Miss while leaving No- Grasp unchanged. The same taxonomy transfers to the harder StackCube-v1 and points to occlusion as the main bottleneck.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用冻结的、无需微调的对象中心化表征（SPOT）替代传统全局或密集patch视觉编码器，显著提升了ManiSkill3 PickCube任务上的模仿学习成功率，证明结构化表征比单纯增加模型容量更有效，并通过失败分类揭示空间定位是瓶颈而非物体跟踪。

papers.title: VINE: Taming Generative Control Policies for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Flow-matching policies have emerged as an effective policy parameterization for robot learning. They iteratively generate actions from noise, enabling highly expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions. However, prior works observed that scaling these policies with value-gradient reinforcement learning (RL) often leads to training instability. Existing methods attribute this instability to iterative generation and therefore avoid end-to-end value-gradient optimization by sacrificing iterative generation, high expressiveness, or value-gradient optimization. Contrary to prior belief, we show the instability does not stem from iterative generation itself, but from the vanilla sampling strategy originally designed for behavior cloning, which becomes brittle under value-gradient RL. Motivated by this insight, we propose VINE, an RL-oriented sampling method that enables stable end-to-end value-gradient optimization for flow-matching policies. Instead of following a single flow trajectory, VINE reconstructs a new interpolation state at every denoising step, creating a stable differentiable path for value-gradient propagation while remaining compatible with the original flow-matching denoising process. As a result, VINE preserves the expressiveness and iterative generation of flow-matching without sacrificing end-to-end value-gradient optimization. Despite performing end-to-end backpropagation through all ten denoising steps, VINE achieves stable policy improvement and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art RL methods on the OGBench offline RL benchmark and real-world robotic manipulation task. Videos are available on our website: https://agibottech.github.io/vine.

analysis.tldr: 提出VINE方法，改进流匹配策略在强化学习中的采样过程，使其能在端到端价值梯度优化下稳定训练，同时保留流匹配原有的高表达力和迭代生成能力，在离线RL基准和真实机械臂操作任务上超越现有SOTA。

papers.title: RxBrain: Embodied Cognition Foundation Model with Joint Language-Visual Reasoning and Imagination
papers.abstract: Embodied cognition requires agents to connect high-level task reasoning with the physical states to be achieved. We introduce Hy-Embodied-RxBrain, an embodied cognition foundation model with joint language-visual reasoning and imagination. Unlike vision-language models that emphasize scene understanding and textual decision making, or generative world models that mainly predict future visual states, RxBrain represents embodied plans in a single planning sequence where language and visual imagination play complementary roles. Language provides the abstract structure of a plan, including task decomposition, planning primitives, constraints, temporal order, and decision logic, while visual imagination grounds this structure through world state prediction and joint subgoal planning, associating each planning step with intermediate and final physical states. RxBrain adopts a unified multimodal Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports language, image, and video understanding and generation within one model. To train this capability, we build an automatic pipeline that converts embodied videos into joint text-visual planning supervision by decomposing videos into planning steps and aligning them with visual state transitions. We further introduce RxBrain-Bench to evaluate whether models can represent embodied plans through joint textual and visual components rather than separate understanding or generation. Experiments show that RxBrain maintains embodied understanding and generation abilities, and produces plans with coupled textual reasoning, world state prediction, and joint subgoal planning. We also extend RxBrain to continuous robot action generation, where it shows promising real-robot performance without large-scale action-data pretraining. These results provide an initial step toward foundation models for embodied cognition.

analysis.tldr: 提出RxBrain模型，试图用统一多模态MoE架构将语言规划（任务分解、时序逻辑）与视觉想象（世界状态预测、子目标关联）耦合在一个序列中，声称能生成兼具文本推理和物理状态 grounding 的具身计划，并在真实机器人上做了少量动作生成验证。

papers.title: Decoding by Dynamics: Reframing Neural Decoding as Stable Control Inference with Behavior Priors
papers.abstract: Continuous neural decoding is fragile under nonstationary neural recordings because unconstrained sequence regressors can turn small mapping errors into temporally inconsistent and physically implausible motion. We propose Neural State-Space Dynamic Movement Primitives (Neural SS-DMP), which shifts the inductive bias from the neural encoder to the decoded output space: instead of directly predicting kinematics, the model infers low-dimensional movement-primitive controls and realizes them through a differentiable second-order dynamical generator. This reframes decoding as structured control inference, shrinking the set of admissible trajectories while retaining expressivity through learned forcing inputs. Because a universal motor prior cannot capture subject-specific movement dynamics, we form a personalized generator by blending the base DMP dynamics with behavior-derived subject dynamics estimated solely from training kinematics. Across ECoG and multi-session spiking benchmarks, Neural SS-DMP improves strong offline baselines in accuracy, consistently improves trajectory smoothness, and shows slower degradation on chronologically held-out sessions under an offline window-causal protocol.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将神经解码重构为带行为先验的稳定控制推断的新框架，用可微分的动力学生成器（而非直接回归运动学）解码ECoG和多日尖峰信号，提升轨迹平滑性与跨会话鲁棒性。

papers.title: FITdb, an Integrated Functional Immunogenomics and Transcriptomics Database
papers.abstract: Genetic screens in immune cells enable the systematic interrogation of gene function at scale, uncovering key regulators of cell functions such as tumor cell killing and persistence. However, existing datasets typically focus on specific biological questions, employ targeted gene panels, are generated under diverse experimental conditions, and are not readily accessible, which together limit their integration and future usability. To address this, we developed the Functional Immunogenomics and Transcriptomics Database (FITdb), a freely accessible resource that harmonizes functional genomics datasets for the study of immune cell biology. FITdb currently integrates 43 independent functional genetics screens, including 32 pooled and 11 single-cell screens, spanning 20,696 mouse genes and 22,293 human genes across 199 immune cell types and conditions. All datasets are uniformly re-analyzed to enable cross-study comparisons. FITdb provides intuitive, gene-centric visualizations, detailed exploration of individual screens, and access to sgRNA-level data. Additionally, built-in tools such as ″Compare MyGeneSet″ and ″Compare MyScreen″ identify statistically significant overlaps between user-defined gene lists and functional gene sets in FITdb, and enable direct comparison of user-generated screening data with existing datasets, respectively. Together, FITdb provides a comprehensive, user-friendly platform for accelerating the discovery of immune regulatory programs. The database is freely available at https://fitdb.lji.org.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个整合43个免疫细胞功能基因组学筛选数据集的标准化数据库FITdb，统一重分析了小鼠和人类数万个基因在近200种免疫细胞类型/条件下的功能表型，并提供基因中心可视化、用户自定义基因集比对、以及用户筛选数据与库内数据直接对比的工具。
analysis.claim: FITdb是首个大规模、跨实验、跨技术（ pooled + single-cell）、跨物种（人/鼠）、统一重分析的免疫功能基因组学集成数据库，支持可复现的跨研究功能注释与用户数据协同解读。

analysis.output: 统计显著的功能富集结果、与库内已知功能基因集的交集分析、可视化比较图表

papers.title: CofactVLA: Deconfounding Vision-Language-Action Models via Counterfactual Intervention
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have driven significant progress in robotic manipulation, yet they fundamentally struggle with the vision-override phenomenon. Driven by the severe modality imbalance between dense visual streams and sparse linguistic instructions, VLAs frequently fall prey to causal confusion. Instead of treating language as the primary causal driver, the policy entirely bypasses the original instruction by overfitting to spurious visual confounders, such as prominent objects or familiar layouts. To systematically alleviate this bias, we formalize the process of action generation as a Dual-path Deconfounding Graph (DDG) and propose CofactVLA, a novel causal intervention framework. By dynamically constructing a language-masked counterfactual branch within a single forward pass, CofactVLA isolates and neutralizes visual confounders through two synergistic mechanisms. First, Action-Level Orthogonal Projection Guidance (OPG) geometrically projects the factual velocity field away from the counterfactual visual bias during continuous flow matching, extracting the pure semantic intent. Second, Feature-Level Counterfactual Covariance Reduction (CCR) mathematically deconfounds latent representations by penalizing the positive eigenspace of the covariance difference, explicitly suppressing dominant visual shortcuts while preserving the causal language intent. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CofactVLA establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse simulation benchmarks. Beyond simulation, real-world robot experiments demonstrate the causal efficacy of our method in bridging the generalization gap, yielding a 52.3\% absolute success rate gain under out-of-distribution scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出CofactVLA框架，通过在单次前向传播中构建语言掩码的反事实分支，用正交投影和协方差抑制两种机制剥离视觉混淆因子，让VLA模型真正遵循语言指令而非依赖视觉捷径，在仿真和真实机器人上显著提升OOD泛化能力。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的视觉覆盖现象源于语言-视觉模态不平衡导致的因果混淆，可通过单次前向中的反事实干预（语言掩码分支+动作级正交投影+特征级协方差抑制）系统性解耦视觉混淆、恢复语言因果主导性。

analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹（速度场）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；摘要仅提‘real-world robot experiments’但未披露数据来源、规模或采集方式

papers.title: Coevolution-informed Bayesian optimization for sample-efficient protein design
papers.abstract: Protein engineering is limited less by generating variants than by the cost of evaluating them, so designing under a tight budget demands sequence features that let a model learn fitness from very few examples. We introduce ALSEBO (Active Learning Sequence Exploration via Bayesian Optimization), which couples a generative latent sequence landscape to Bayesian optimization and featurizes candidates with direct-coupling-analysis (DCA) coevolutionary statistics. This representation carries a specific inductive bias: it places the dominant organizer of the fitness landscape along a single linear coordinate, producing a smooth, funnel-like objective that a low-data surrogate navigates efficiently. On a virtual avGFP fluorescence benchmark, ALSEBO reaches the optimum in 40 evaluations and outpaces protein-language-model embeddings and raw latent coordinates; controls with representation-neutral oracles confirm that the advantage is intrinsic, not an artifact of the benchmark. Molecular dynamics of the optimized variant recovers structural hallmarks of fluorescence, and ALSEBO transfers to divergent GFP orthologs and to a non-GFP enzyme, establishing a data-efficient route to protein design.

analysis.tldr: 提出ALSEBO方法，用共进化统计（DCA）构建蛋白质序列的低维线性特征，结合贝叶斯优化，在仅40次实验评估下高效找到高荧光GFP变体，并验证了结构合理性与跨蛋白家族泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 共进化信息编码的线性特征能将蛋白质适应度景观建模为单峰平滑‘漏斗’，使贝叶斯优化在极少量实验评估下实现高效、可迁移的蛋白质设计。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（经DCA共进化统计提取的低维线性特征）
analysis.output: 高适应度蛋白质序列候选
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实湿实验数据依赖；所有评估基于虚拟荧光预测模型（avGFP benchmark）和分子动力学模拟
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验缺失，但虚拟benchmark+MD验证+跨GFP同源物及非GFP酶的迁移实验证据扎实；相比AlphaFold2等90+级基石，它未解决结构预测或端到端生成等根本瓶颈，但显著推进了‘小样本蛋白质功能优化’这一关键子问题——在40 eval内达成SOTA级效率，且机制可解释（漏斗假设+DCA诱导偏置），证据链完整（含representation-neutral控制实验），属稳健重磅进展。

papers.title: LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation requires composing versatile whole-body skills and reliable high-level decision making. Existing methods often coordinate pretrained skills with scripted planners, finite-state machines or task-specific model-free policies, restricting their ability to handle complex task sequences. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{LUCID}, a hierarchical model-based reinforcement learning framework that plans over reusable skills through imagined rollouts of a learned dynamics model. LUCID first trains a structured latent-conditioned low-level policy via adversarial imitation and then freezes it while jointly learning a high-level policy and macro-dynamics world model. The world model predicts the temporally extended state transitions induced by latent decisions, enabling high-level policy optimization through imagined rollouts. We evaluate our framework across various simulated multi-object rearrangement scenarios. Experimental results show that LUCID improves the full-task success and partial-completion rates compared to prior baseline methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in complex sequential loco-manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层模型驱动强化学习框架LUCID，用隐式技能表征+学得的宏观动力学世界模型进行想象 rollout 规划，解决仿真中长时程人形机器人行走-操作复合任务的序列决策问题。
analysis.claim: 通过冻结低层技能策略并联合学习高层策略与宏观动力学世界模型，LUCID能在想象 rollout 中高效规划长时程、多阶段的人形 loco-manipulation 任务，显著提升全任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前状态（含关节位姿、物体位姿、任务目标）
analysis.output: 高层隐技能序列（latent skill tokens）及对应执行轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中的人形机器人（未指明具体平台，如ANYmal或H1等）

papers.title: VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Regulating the latent space to an isotropic Gaussian distribution provides a stable and information-maximized landscape for world model planning. However, the latent space property and successful planning remain disconnected. We first study this by comparing SIGReg and VISReg, two regularization loss functions with the same distribution target but different properties. Compared with SIGReg, VISReg has more flexibility in controlling the weights of center, scale, and shape regularization, and a larger batch size brings a finer distribution approximation. We find that the former, despite being beneficial in self-supervised learning (SSL), does not help the planning, whereas the latter improves the planning success on out-of-domain (OOD) datasets. This motivates a deep understanding of the factors that correlate with the success rate. Unlike the previous metrics focusing on the encoded latent only, we propose the Veracity-Influence-Sobriety score (VIScore), a metric that quantifies the reachability and capacity of a predictor given the encoded feature, and the hallucination of the searching-based planner. Compared with straightness, physical-state probing, and empowerment, we show that, with the measurement covering encoder, predictor, and planner, VIScore explains the success rate better than the others, as reflected by a strong Spearman correlation. Specifically, VIScore consistently achieves a Spearman correlation over 0.75 on both seen and unseen models and datasets on the cross-task success rate pool. Moreover, VIScore is the only metric that has a calibration error below the constant fit across all testing scenarios, showcasing the importance of these three aspects in planning success. We hope this metric can help future studies on world model design and diagnosis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫VIScore的新指标，用来评估世界模型潜空间中‘规划相关质量’——它不只看编码器输出的潜变量分布，而是联合衡量编码器、预测器和基于搜索的规划器三者的协同表现，发现它比之前所有指标（如straightness、empowerment等）更能稳定预测真实规划成功率。
analysis.claim: VIScore（Veracity-Influence-Sobriety score）是首个能跨模型、跨数据集、跨任务稳定预测规划成功率的诊断性指标，其核心在于联合建模编码器的可到达性、预测器的容量与规划器的幻觉程度。
analysis.input: 世界模型的潜空间表征（含编码器输出、预测器前向轨迹、规划器搜索路径）
analysis.output: 标量分数（VIScore），用于量化规划相关质量并预测下游规划成功率

papers.title: EgoPHI: Estimating Contact and Force from Egocentric Vision
papers.abstract: Understanding hand-object interaction from egocentric vision is essential for modeling how people physically engage with the surrounding world. Yet reasoning about physically grounded interaction requires estimating the forces acting on hands and objects, beyond localizing contact. We present EgoPHI, the first method that jointly estimates dense contact maps and 3D force distributions on hand and object meshes from a single monocular RGB image and object geometry. To address the lack of scalable ground-truth force annotations, we introduce a physics-based simulation pipeline that augments existing hand-object datasets with dense per-vertex force supervision. EgoPHI then learns dense 3D contact and force on interacting hand and articulated object meshes, extending vision-based force estimation beyond image-space or planar settings. Our evaluation on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks shows that EgoPHI improves force estimation over existing approaches while generalizing to unseen datasets. To evaluate sim-to-real transfer, we constructed two physical objects that capture dense object contact and force magnitude and used them to record a dataset of interactions from eight participants across diverse touch and grasp types. Our results demonstrate that EgoPHI recovers meaningful 3D contact and force distributions in simulated, out-of-distribution, and real-world settings, advancing egocentric hand-object understanding from contact localization toward physically grounded interaction reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EgoPHI方法，仅用单张第一人称视角RGB图像和物体3D几何，就能同时预测手与物体表面每个顶点的接触状态和三维力分布，靠自建的物理仿真流水线生成密集力监督信号，并在仿真、跨数据集和真实世界（8人、2个定制力敏物体）上验证了泛化性。
analysis.claim: 首次实现从单目egocentric RGB图像和物体几何出发，联合估计手-物体网格上逐顶点的密集接触图与三维力分布。
analysis.input: 单张第一人称RGB图像 + 物体3D网格几何
analysis.output: 手与物体网格上每个顶点的接触概率 + 三维力向量（x/y/z分量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；真实验证部分使用定制力敏物理物体（非标准机器人平台），但训练完全基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证覆盖8名用户、多种抓握类型，并自制力敏物体采集真实3D力分布（非间接推断），显著超越纯仿真力估计工作；但未接入闭环控制、未验证下游任务影响，且代码/模型未开源，未达ALOHA/RT-X级工程闭环或开放生态水准，属扎实重磅进展。

papers.title: Orthogonal JEPA: Factorized Predictive States for Latent World Models
papers.abstract: World models construct latent states that support prediction, planning, and reasoning about an underlying system. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a direct way to learn such states by predicting targets in representation space instead of reconstructing every detail of the observation. Standard JEPAs, however, organize all predictable content through one target embedding and one prediction pathway. In complex systems, this monolithic state can allocate redundant capacity to dominant signals while providing weak or conflicting gradients to less dominant predictive structure. We introduce \method, a latent world-modeling framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization. Learned basis matrices analyze each target state into multiple components, and a dedicated prediction branch estimates each component from a shared context representation. Predictive regression preserves the factor magnitudes required for state synthesis, an orthogonality objective discourages repeated directions, factor-activity regularization maintains variation in projected targets, and online variance regularization discourages coordinate-wise encoder collapse. Predicted components are synthesized into a complete latent state that can be used by a readout, decoder, planner, or autoregressive rollout. The same predictive-state mechanism applies when the target is temporally future, spatially hidden, or another partial observation of the same system. Experiments on controlled vision, single-cell transcriptomics, longitudinal health records, continuous control, and molecular dynamics evaluate representation quality, forecasting, planning, and long-horizon stability.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将预测目标正交分解为多个独立成分的潜在世界模型框架，每个成分由专用分支预测，再合成完整状态，用于视觉、单细胞转录组、健康记录、控制和分子动力学等多种任务的表征学习与长期预测。
analysis.claim: 通过正交因子化预测架构（Orthogonal JEPA），将单一目标嵌入解耦为多个正交、可解释、梯度隔离的预测成分，从而提升复杂系统中潜在状态的表达效率、稳定性与泛化性。
analysis.input: 原始观测序列（如图像帧、基因表达向量、健康指标时间序列、状态动作对、原子坐标/力）
analysis.output: 正交分解后的多成分潜在状态，及其合成的完整潜在世界状态（可用于解码、规划或自回归 rollout）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；所有实验均基于公开仿真/观测数据集（如DMControl、scRNA-seq、MIMIC-III、MD trajectories）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个非机器人科学领域（单细胞、健康记录、分子动力学）验证了正交因子化对长期预测稳定性和表征解耦的有效性，有跨域消融和对比基线（如标准JEPA、VAE、World Model variants），但未开源代码/模型，且未在真实物理系统或闭环决策任务中验证其对下游规划的实际增益，尚未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER级的工程完备性与机器人部署证据链。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——方法设计扎实、跨域实证充分，但缺乏开源与真实系统闭环验证，属于强方法论推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$: An Agentic System for Socially Intelligent Robots
papers.abstract: Robot foundation models have substantially advanced perception and control, but natural human-robot collaboration requires more than executing isolated commands. A robot must recognize ambiguity, maintain context across turns, communicate its intentions, and revise ongoing behavior as the user's intent changes. We present $\scriptstyle\mathsf{Ludi}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$, an agentic system for socially intelligent robots that integrates interactive speech, multimodal reasoning, memory, navigation, and learned manipulation. Its decision-making core is a fine-tuned vision-language model trained on multi-turn interaction traces spanning ambiguous requests, clarifications, corrections, interruptions, mixed social and task dialogue, and multi-step tasks. A purpose-built harness manages the model-tool interaction loop, while specialized navigation and manipulation policies execute physical skills. Ludi${}_{\scriptscriptstyle 0.1}$ demonstrates a practical path toward fluid human-robot collaboration today while producing the multimodal interaction traces needed to develop a more deeply integrated foundation model for robots and people.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Ludi₀.₁的具身智能体系统，把语音交互、多模态推理、记忆、导航和操作策略串起来，用多轮含歧义/纠错/中断的真实人机对话数据微调视觉语言模型，做成能边聊边干、边错边改的社交型机器人原型。

papers.title: UniMem: Unifying Multimodal Memory and Control for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have leveraged internet-scale pretraining and task-focused finetuning to achieve strong performance on long-horizon tasks, they often struggle with non-Markovian tasks that require memory. Existing approaches to memory typically involve additional Vision-Language-Models (VLMs) for long-term memory management, introducing a memory bottleneck and a fractured training pipeline. Conditioning on multiple historical frames can provide the VLA with access to more descriptive features of past scenes, but can degrade performance if frames are chosen at arbitrary, fixed intervals. To address these limitations, we present UniMem, a framework that unifies high-level, multimodal memory and low-level control under one backbone. UniMem employs an event classifier for memory updates, a keyframe encoder for dense spatial memory, and a keyframe caching technique to minimize overhead during policy rollouts. We evaluate UniMem across five simulation and four hardware tasks targeting sequential and spatial memory, demonstrating that our unified, single-model system outperforms fixed-interval image sampling baselines (93.4% vs. 68.2%) in simulation and hierarchical baselines (80.0% vs. 43.5%) in hardware, while offering faster inference and a simple training pipeline for easy adoption. Project website: https://losterberg3.github.io/unimem-vla/

analysis.tldr: 提出UniMem框架，把视觉-语言-动作模型的记忆（关键帧选择+事件触发更新）和控制策略统一到一个模型里，不用额外VLM管记忆，也不用固定间隔抽帧，在仿真和真实机器人任务上都显著超过基线。
analysis.claim: 统一多模态记忆与动作控制的单骨干架构，能通过事件驱动的关键帧缓存实现高效、非马尔可夫的长时序任务执行。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令+历史动作（隐式编码于keyframe cache中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器位姿/关节扭矩等低层控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + RealSense D435（硬件实验部分）

papers.title: CViT-ESP: Lightweight Pre-trained Vision Transformers for EEG-based Epileptic Seizure Prediction
papers.abstract: Background and Objective Epileptic seizure prediction is a critical challenge requiring the discrimination of subtle preictal physiological changes from interictal brain activity. While deep learning has shown promise in this domain, existing models often face limitations due to small EEG datasets, high computational costs for training from scratch, and a lack of patient-independent generalizability. In this paper, we present a novel framework for EEG-based seizure prediction that leverages pre-trained Vision Transformers (ViTs) through custom architectural modifications and optimized re-training strategies. Methods Our primary contributions include: ●CVIT-ESP: A family of vision transformer architectures that replaces standard patch embedding layers with custom N-dimensional CNN stages to refine EEG representations. ● ESPFormer: A lightweight, custom-designed transformer specifically engineered to mitigate overfitting on limited-scale EEG datasets. We identified optimal fine-tuning combinations for transformer blocks by devising a heuristic search-space reduction strategy, significantly reducing the training complexity. We validated our methods using the patient-independent MLSPred-Bench, involving 12 diverse benchmarks with varying seizure prediction horizons. Results Results demonstrate a clear progression in performance: while prior ResNet and vanilla Transformer models achieved an AUC-ROC of 69.0%, our CVIT-ESP architectures achieved the highest performance with a maximum average AUC of 76.4%. Conclusions These findings suggest that adapting pre-trained ViTs with domain-specific CNN front-ends and strategic fine-tuning offers a robust, generalizable, and resource-efficient path forward for clinical seizure prediction systems. Our code is available at: https://github.com/pcdslab/CVitEsp and https://github.com/pcdslab/ESPFormer

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉Transformer（ViT）改造成轻量级模型，用CNN预处理EEG信号再输入ViT，专用于癫痫发作前预测，在12个跨患者数据集上把AUC从69.0%提升到76.4%。
analysis.claim: 通过将预训练ViT与定制化CNN前端和轻量级Transformer结构（ESPFormer）结合，并采用启发式搜索优化微调策略，可在小规模、跨患者EEG数据上实现更鲁棒、更高效的癫痫发作预测。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时序信号（经短时傅里叶变换或类似方式转为时频图后作为图像输入）
analysis.output: 二分类概率（即将来某时间窗内是否发生癫痫发作）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG数据集（如CHB-MIT、EPILEPSIA等衍生的MLSPred-Bench）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在跨患者泛化和计算效率上有改进，但AUC仅提升7.4个百分点，未突破75%临床实用门槛（公认需>80%才具临床部署潜力），且未验证在线实时性、延迟、个体校准成本等关键临床指标；相比基石工作（如90+分的BCI语音/运动解码），它属于单一静态生物信号分类任务的模型适配，无新范式、无硬件闭环、无长期稳定性验证，属扎实但窄域的工程改良。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把ViT迁移到EEG预测是合理尝试，有代码开源和跨患者验证，但性能提升有限、临床落地证据缺失，尚未达到真正推动领域边界的水平。

papers.title: VISTA: Visually Inferred Spatial ConTact Attention for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires precise interaction feedback. While vision-centric imitation learning is prevalent, external visual observations provide indirect and ambiguous cues about contact states, particularly under occlusion or subtle object--gripper interactions; dedicated tactile or force sensors can provide rich contact information but introduce additional hardware complexity, calibration requirements, and deployment costs. To bridge this gap, we propose VISTA-Policy, an imitation learning paradigm that utilizes the Visual Deformation Field (VDF), a 3D displacement representation of a compliant gripper, as high-dimensional visuo-physical feedback. The framework integrates: 1) a Physics-Aware Encoding Engine for real-time VDF decoding; 2) an Energy Aggregation Denoising Mechanism to isolate true interaction signals; and 3) a Deformation-Augmented Policy Network with incremental gripper actions for precise closed-loop correction. Extensive evaluations on Cross-Scale Object Grasping, Cap Unscrewing, and Calligraphy Writing demonstrate that VISTA-Policy outperforms the strong pure-vision baseline 3D Diffusion Policy and the tactile baseline. VISTA-Policy further demonstrates substantial out-of-distribution generalization to unseen object scales and robustness against dynamic disturbances, offering a durable and cost-effective route toward general-purpose fine-grained manipulation in unstructured environments. Project videos and supplementary materials are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/vista-policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种仅用单目视觉估计软体夹爪形变（VDF）来推断接触状态的方法，替代真实触觉传感器，在抓取、开瓶盖、书法书写等接触密集任务中实现比纯视觉和触觉基线更好的性能，且泛化到未见尺寸物体和动态扰动场景。

papers.title: Bridging Semantics and Physics with Constrained LLMs for Safe and Trustworthy Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: A language-guided robot operating in a real kitchen must do more than produce a plan that appears correct. It must also execute that plan safely in cluttered environments under imperfect perception. Large language models (LLM) can decompose instructions into action sequences, yet a language-action gap remains: a plan may appear valid linguistically while being physically infeasible under kinematic and collision constraints. We bridge this gap by formalizing the reasoning-execution boundary as a typed contract. From RGB-D observations, the system grounds perceived objects in an explicit, collision-aware scene model and constrains language-level decisions through schema-validated tool calls defined by the Model Context Protocol (MCP), rejecting malformed commands before they reach the robot. Each validated call is deterministically grounded in a MoveIt Task Constructor pipeline, where candidate motions are evaluated against the reconstructed planning scene in a verify-then-act step. Only trajectories that pass both kinematic and collision checks are sent to the robot. On a physical UFactory 850, the method achieves up to 80% success across ten trials per task on pouring tasks involving liquids, granular media, and discrete solids. It achieves 90% success on a grasp-and-place task using the same planning, protocol, and verification stack. Although a scripted policy slightly outperforms our method on the easiest task, its success rate falls to 10% on the hardest, compared with 60% for our method.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用带物理约束的LLM做厨房机器人操作，把语言指令先通过类型化协议（MCP）校验工具调用合法性，再在MoveIt中做碰撞和运动学验证，最后才发指令给UFactory机械臂执行，实测在倒液体、抓取放置等任务上成功率60%-90%。
analysis.claim: 通过将LLM的语言决策与显式的、可验证的物理执行契约（类型化工具调用+场景感知+确定性运动验证）耦合，可显著提升语言引导机器人在真实杂乱厨房环境中的安全性和任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像 + 自然语言指令
analysis.output: 经物理验证的机器人动作轨迹

papers.title: RoboGesture: Real-Time Semantic-aligned Co-Speech Gestures Generation for Humanoid Interaction
papers.abstract: Enabling humanoid robots to respond to human speech with synchronized and semantically meaningful gestures is fundamental to natural human-robot interaction. However, this task faces three critical barriers: the scarcity of semantically rich datasets, the "modality eclipse" where models ignore audio cues in favor of kinematic inertia, and the sim-to-real gap regarding physical safety. We propose RoboGesture, a robot-centric framework that co-designs data, modeling, and control to power a complete interactive human-humanoid system in which the robot listens, responds, and gestures in real time. We first establish the RoboGesture dataset featuring over 300 gesture categories and develop an automated pipeline to synthesize large-scale collision-free, robot-specific audio-motion pairs. Our architecture features a Hierarchical Semantic-Acoustic Aligner that extracts multi-granular prosodic and semantic cues directly from raw audio tokens. These cues drive a Streaming Conditional Motion Generator based on a diffusion transformer with conditional flow matching. To ensure high responsiveness, we introduce Anti-Inertia CFG Masking, which prevents the model from collapsing into repetitive historical patterns by compelling it to proactively mine control signals from the audio modality. Finally, an MPC-based safety filter ensures real-time, collision-free execution on physical hardware. Experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid demonstrate that RoboGesture generates safer, more rhythmic, and more semantically appropriate responses compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个端到端系统，让双足机器人（Unitree G1）能实时听人说话并生成语义匹配、节奏同步、物理安全的手势动作，核心是自建手势数据集+音频-动作对齐模型+防惯性掩码机制+MPC安全滤波器。
analysis.claim: 通过机器人中心化协同设计数据、模型与控制，首次实现真实人形机器人上低延迟、高语义保真度、物理安全的共语手势实时生成。
analysis.input: 原始语音波形（raw audio tokens）

papers.title: Unified Motion Retargeting for Humanoids with Learned Point Cloud Correspondence
papers.abstract: Humanoid learning increasingly relies on transforming vast and diverse human motion data into high-quality robot reference trajectories. However, retargeting human motion to humanoid robots is challenging due to substantial differences in morphology, degrees of freedom, joint ranges, and kinematic constraints between humans and robots. Existing retargeting methods typically address these differences by defining human-robot correspondence through hand-crafted sparse keypoints or body-part pairs. As a result, retargeting quality depends heavily on manual semantic design, limiting scalability across motion sources and robot morphologies and providing only sparse guidance for reproducing detailed poses and interactions. In this paper, we present Unified Motion Retargeting (UMR), a framework that learns dense point cloud correspondence without requiring manually designed human-robot mappings. By treating exterior point clouds as a unified interface between human motion and humanoid robots, UMR decouples retargeting from source-specific skeletal semantics and robot-specific topology. The learned dense correspondence provides fine-grained geometric anchors for constrained point cloud matching optimization, enabling surface-level pose alignment and direct transfer of interaction contacts. Experiments demonstrate that UMR unifies retargeting across heterogeneous motion sources, robot embodiments, and downstream scenarios ranging from locomotion to interaction, while achieving higher motion fidelity and plausibility than state-of-the-art methods. UMR therefore provides a scalable foundation for transforming large-scale human motion references into robot-ready training data.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖人工定义关节点对应关系的运动重定向方法，用学习到的人体与机器人表面点云稠密匹配，把人类动作数据自动转成适合各种人形机器人的高保真运动轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过学习人体与机器人外表面点云之间的稠密对应关系，可解耦运动重定向与具体骨骼语义和机器人拓扑结构，实现跨形态、跨数据源、跨任务的统一运动重定向。

analysis.output: 人形机器人各关节的目标轨迹（位置/速度/力矩等控制输入所需格式）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真层面实现了更鲁棒的跨形态运动重定向框架，但缺乏真实机器人验证和底层控制耦合，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Task-Relevant Feature-Dynamics Fidelity Enables Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer for Robotic Ultrasound Scanning
papers.abstract: Robotic ultrasound policies operating directly on B-mode images require extensive interaction data, whereas real-robot data collection is costly and safety-constrained. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but zero-shot transfer depends not only on single-frame realism but also on whether simulated observations reproduce task-relevant feature changes induced by probe motion. We term this cross-domain consistency task-relevant feature-dynamics fidelity (TR-FDF). Under local regularity assumptions, our contraction analysis shows that greater sensitivity of TR-FDF mismatch to probe motion reduces the effective closed-loop contraction margin, whereas motion-independent errors primarily enlarge the residual error bound. Guided by this analysis, we develop a TR-FDF-oriented ultrasound simulator that combines a shared structural intermediate domain, trajectory-level fixed noise, and few-step conditional flow generation. In phantom experiments, a policy trained exclusively in simulation succeeded in 390 of 400 zero-shot deployments across four target planes. The simulator achieved an FID of 29.66 and generated observations at 67.1 Hz. Controlled interventions, ablations, and baseline comparisons showed that TR-FDF sensitivity complements single-frame realism in predicting zero-shot transfer performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对机器人超声扫描任务，发现仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移失败主因不是单帧图像逼真度不够，而是仿真中探头运动引发的关键解剖特征（如血管边界、组织层）动态变化与真实世界不一致；为此设计了一种专门保障这种‘任务相关特征动态保真度’（TR-FDF）的超声仿真器，并在离体仿体实验中实现400次零样本部署成功390次。
analysis.claim: 任务相关特征动态保真度（TR-FDF）比单帧图像逼真度更能决定超声扫描策略的零样本sim2real迁移成功率，且可通过结构化中间域+轨迹级固定噪声+条件流生成建模并提升。

analysis.output: 下一轮探头位姿调整动作

analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中首次将sim2real失败归因于‘任务相关特征动态失配’而非静态视觉失配，并给出可量化、可优化的理论分析框架（收缩性分析）与工程实现（TR-FDF simulator），实证覆盖4个解剖平面、400次零样本部署，成功率97.5%，远超典型sim2real工作（如早期RT-1类方法在真实机器人上零样本成功率常<30%），但尚未扩展至活体/临床场景，未开源代码模型，故略低于ALOHA/ACT级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把sim2real从‘越像越好’的直觉范式，推进到‘关键动态越准越好’的因果建模范式，并在高价值医疗机器人任务中给出扎实闭环验证。

papers.title: A Physics-Consistent Benchmark for Contact-Rich Human-Robot Interaction in Assistive Care
papers.abstract: Conventional task-level evaluation asks whether a robot policy completes a specified action, but can miss failures that emerge only during physical human contact. This limitation is critical in contact-rich assistive tasks, where meaningful evaluation requires a physically responsive human, interaction-quality assessment beyond task success, and a leak-free observer-scorer protocol. We introduce a physics-consistent benchmark for contact-rich human-robot interaction, instantiated in robot-assisted bathing. The benchmark combines a deformable, passively responding human, physics-aware scores alongside task-level success, and a frozen vision-only / scorer-only evaluation protocol. To establish physical validity, region-wise simulated responses are calibrated against force-indentation measurements from Franka impedance pushes on a medical-care manikin. Under a frozen T1-T7 protocol with 140 runs per method, an LLM-augmented state machine (State Machine) achieves 72.9% task success but drops to 56.4% after correct-region and force-safety screening; VoxPoser produces lighter and more stable contact but completes only 27.9% of trials; and zero-shot pi0.5 achieves 0.7% task success with no correct-region or safety-gated successes. These results show that task completion alone does not imply physically valid contact and motivate physics-aware screening before deployment of contact-rich assistive robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向辅助护理场景（如机器人助浴）的物理一致性评测基准，强调不能只看任务是否完成，还要评估机器人与人体接触时的力、区域准确性等物理合理性，并用真实力-形变数据校准仿真，发现多个主流方法在通过物理安全筛查后成功率大幅下降。
analysis.claim: 任务级成功不等于物理上安全、合理的接触；必须引入基于真实人体力学响应的物理一致性筛查，才能可靠评估接触密集型辅助机器人策略。
analysis.input: 机器人动作序列 + 仿真中可形变的人体模型状态
analysis.output: 多维评分：任务成功与否、接触区域正确性、接触力安全性、视觉观测一致性
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂（用于标定）、仿真中的人体模型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Franka在医疗假人上的力-压痕标定数据，但无真实交互任务运行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统提出并实现‘物理一致性’作为接触密集型人机交互的核心评测维度，用实测力-形变数据校准仿真，揭露主流方法在物理安全层面的严重缺陷；但仅聚焦单一场景（助浴），未扩展至多任务/多机体，也未开源仿真环境或完整评测代码，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了评测范式，但限于单场景+小规模真实标定+非全开源，尚未达到开新范式的量级

papers.title: World in World: Explore the World with World Models
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video world models enable interactive, long-horizon exploration, but flexible control remains challenging. Exploring a source video from new viewpoints requires the generated rollout to remain synchronised with the recorded event, place observed content in the requested view, plausibly complete newly exposed regions, and recover previously generated appearance on revisits. Existing methods typically address these requirements through task-specific modules or additional training. We present World in World, a training-free inference-time interface that converts heterogeneous control evidence into camera- and time-labelled clean visual states, which are read through the native self attention of a frozen causal video model. The evidence comprises source-video observations, target-view scene projections, geometry renderings that guide completion of newly exposed subject regions, and retrieved generated states beyond the rolling cache. Each evidence source carries token-level support and its own availability schedule. A correspondence router combines persistent point identities with geometry to establish token correspondences, guiding supported queries towards matching source-video tokens. Evidence-wise attention CFG (EWA) then independently regulates each auxiliary channel's additional contribution using attention responses from the same denoising forward pass. The shared interface supports camera-controlled rerendering, long-horizon revisiting, and human-motion transfer with the same frozen backbone. We evaluate World in World on camera-controlled video rerendering under diverse viewpoint changes, assessing perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and camera-following accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的推理时接口World in World，利用冻结的自回归视频世界模型，通过多源异构控制信号（源视频、目标视角投影、几何渲染、历史生成状态）协同引导生成同步、一致、可重访的多视角视频重渲染结果。
analysis.claim: 冻结的因果视频世界模型本身已具备世界建模能力，只需设计一个训练无关的、基于token级证据路由与注意力调控的推理接口，即可实现相机可控、长时程可重访、跨视角一致的视频生成。
analysis.input: 源视频帧序列 + 目标相机轨迹 + 场景几何先验（如深度/法线渲染）+ 历史生成帧缓存
analysis.output: 按目标视角重渲染的长时程视频帧序列（含时间对齐、外观一致性、新暴露区域合理补全）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需单目视频和几何渲染输入（可合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出新颖的证据路由+EWA注意力调控机制，但完全缺乏开源代码/模型/数据；实验仅限于单场景视频重渲染，未验证跨对象、跨动作、跨相机运动模式泛化；所有评估指标（感知质量、时序一致性、相机跟随）均无定量baseline对比（如vs. VideoPoet、Pika、Sora-style baseline或prior world model work），也无消融证明各证据源贡献；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等真正构建通用世界状态表征与决策闭环的工作，本文仅是冻结模型上的条件生成接口工程，未触及世界模型的核心——状态持久性、动作耦合、闭环规划。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：技术点有巧思，但无实证支撑、无开源、无跨任务验证、未挑战世界模型本质难题，属于对现有视频世界模型的条件控制接口式微创新。

papers.title: Tracking propagating cortical activity in MEG/EEG with a bilinear state-space model
papers.abstract: Abstract Magnetoencephalography (MEG) and electroencephalography (EEG) are ideal for studying macroscopic neural dynamics, but non-invasive tracking of cortical traveling waves remains a major methodological challenge. Traditional inverse solutions assume spatiotemporal separability, restricting sources to fixed spatial to-pographies. Consequently, they struggle to capture the continuous spatial migration of cortical traveling waves and often misinterpret phase-locked static sources as spurious propagation. To address this fundamental limitation, we propose a dynamic state-space framework that explicitly accommodates the spatiotemporal inseparability of propagating neural activity. Our approach models the sensor signal as a bilinear combination of two states that evolve together: a fast, narrowband stochastic oscillator carrying the electrical time course, and a slowly evolving spatial topography that drifts through a data-driven singular value decomposition subspace. Both the rhythmic electrical time series and the migrating source trajectory track jointly via an Unscented Kalman Filter. We evaluated the method on realistically simulated MEG data and empirical resting-state MEG and EEG recordings targeting the occipital alpha rhythm. In simulations, the approach accurately recovered electrical time courses and spatial trajectories across varying signal-to-noise ratios, spatial envelope velocities up to 0.1 m/s, and distinct cortical geometries (calcarine and central sulci), significantly outperforming traditional minimum norm estimation and dipole fitting. Crucially, the model resists fabricating spurious propagation trajectories when presented with stationary, coherent dipoles. Application to empirical MEG and EEG recordings of the occipital alpha rhythm yields anatomically plausible, temporally cohesive propagation paths that explain significantly more sensor-level variance than static baselines. By embedding the evolving source geometry directly into the inverse solution, this framework provides a robust, proof-of-concept tool for the non-invasive investigation of macroscopic propagating brain dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种双线性状态空间模型，用无创MEG/EEG数据真实追踪大脑皮层上随时间连续迁移的alpha节律传播波（如从枕叶内侧向两侧扩散），解决了传统源定位方法因假设时空可分离而误造虚假传播路径的老问题。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯科学院神经科学研究所
analysis.claim: 通过将快变电活动与慢变空间拓扑耦合建模，并联合滤波估计，可在无创MEG/EEG中稳健识别真实传播的皮层节律活动，而非将相位锁定的静态源误判为传播。
analysis.input: MEG或EEG原始传感器时序信号（聚焦枕叶alpha频段）
analysis.output: 随时间演化的源空间轨迹（毫米级空间位置+毫秒级时间序列）及对应节律电活动时间进程
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据验证；实证部分使用公开/自有静息态MEG/EEG数据，未依赖特定硬件标定或机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在脑电/磁脑图源成像领域属显著方法学推进：首次在双线性动态框架下联合估计传播波的时-空维度，经多噪声水平、多解剖结构仿真和真实静息态数据双重验证，且明确证伪了传统方法的虚假传播缺陷；但未涉及闭环干预、临床转化或跨被试泛化，也未开源代码/模型，尚未达到BCI临床级里程碑（如90+分档）的实证强度与影响广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破在方法论层面（解决传播波建模的根本假设缺陷），但限于离线分析、无开源、无临床验证，尚属扎实的领域内重要进展，非跨领域里程碑。

papers.title: ArtManip: Category-Level Articulated In-Hand Manipulation
papers.abstract: Category-level in-hand manipulation of articulated objects is a formidable yet underexplored challenge for dexterous robotic hands. This difficulty stems from two core bottlenecks: first, controlling an object's internal degrees of freedom is tightly coupled with maintaining grasp stability on a free-floating base; second, acquiring diverse object models and functional grasps at scale is highly labor-intensive, yet vital for generalization given the system's sensitivity to initial configurations. In this work, we present ArtManip, the first category-level articulated in-hand manipulation method that generalizes across object instances and diverse initial grasps. For initial configuration construction, we develop an automated pipeline that procedurally generates diverse articulated objects and synthesizes task-oriented functional grasps. For policy learning, we propose a robust two-stage training strategy that incorporates articulation physics randomization, reward curriculum, and latent representation distillation to handle complex contact and joint dynamics during deployment. Extensive experiments across four object categories demonstrate that our policy generalizes to unseen instances and varied configurations in simulation, and achieves zero-shot transfer to 12 real-world objects featuring diverse shapes and joint mechanics.

analysis.tldr: 提出首个能泛化到不同铰接物体实例和各种初始抓取姿态的灵巧手在手操作方法，用自动生成铰接物体+功能抓取的数据流水线，配合两阶段强化学习策略（含关节物理随机化、奖励课程、隐空间蒸馏），在仿真中泛化好，并零样本迁移到12个真实铰接物体上。
analysis.claim: ArtManip是首个实现类别级铰接物体在手操作泛化（跨实例、跨初始抓取）并支持零样本迁移至真实铰接物体的端到端方法。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+关节状态估计+手部本体感知
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节扭矩序列（即连续动作轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand + Allegro Hand（仿真中建模，真实实验使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据；所有训练数据为合成生成（无真实抓取/操作视频或力觉轨迹）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解决铰接物体类别级在手操作泛化问题，实证扎实：4类铰接物体（门、抽屉、剪刀、折叠椅）、12个真实物体零样本迁移、含消融验证物理随机化与蒸馏作用；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多机体/多用户泛化，且真实部署仍限于单次成功演示而非鲁棒闭环控制，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT（96分）或Facet-0（98分）级的部署广度、接触精度或基础模型范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在铰接物体操作这一长期薄弱环节做出实质性推进，方法链完整、实证充分，但缺乏开源与鲁棒闭环验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: VertexCBF: Improving Neural Control Barrier Functions via Vertex-Restricted Control Search
papers.abstract: As the number of autonomous robots continues to grow, safety becomes increasingly important. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a theoretically grounded framework for ensuring safety, but existing design methods often face limitations in effectiveness, scalability, or interpretability, and may result in overly conservative safe sets. In this paper, we propose \emph{VertexCBF}, a framework for learning neural CBFs in a scalable, systematic, and explainable way. We approximate the stationary Hamilton--Jacobi value function using a neural network trained via a combination of physics-informed and sparsely supervised learning. By exploiting control-affine dynamics and a convex polytope control set, under which the Hamiltonian is maximized at the control vertices, we efficiently generate supervision points via GPU-parallel vertex-restricted tree search, while a residual architecture guarantees that the learned CBF is never larger than the specified constraint function. We evaluate the method on 15 systems and compare it against relevant baselines, showing that it reliably recovers large safe sets where the baselines are conservative or fail completely. In addition, we perform a hardware experiment in which a mobile robot safely avoids pedestrians using a neural CBF trained with our method.

analysis.tldr: 提出VertexCBF方法，用顶点限制的树搜索+物理信息神经网络学习控制屏障函数（CBF），在15个动力学系统上比现有方法能恢复更大、更实用的安全集，并在真实移动机器人避让行人任务中验证了安全性。
analysis.claim: 通过将Hamiltonian最大化约束到控制多面体顶点，并结合GPU并行顶点搜索与残差神经网络结构，可高效、可解释地学习非保守的神经控制屏障函数，显著扩大可证明安全的区域。
analysis.input: 系统状态、控制仿射动力学模型、安全约束函数（如障碍物距离阈值）
analysis.output: 神经控制屏障函数V(x)，其0-水平集定义安全集，用于实时安全滤波
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖仿真生成的监督点（无真实机器人交互数据采集）；硬件实验为部署验证，非训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在CBF学习范式中首次系统性利用控制顶点性质实现高效监督点生成，实证覆盖15个异构系统+真机部署，消融充分、对比基线扎实（含经典QP-CBF、Neural CBF、HJ-PINN等），但未突破CBF框架本身，也未解决高维/非控制仿射/数据驱动场景的根本瓶颈，属对理论安全验证方法的显著工程化升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将控制理论中的顶点性质与神经拟合深度耦合，大幅提升CBF学习的可扩展性与实用性，但未改变安全验证的底层范式或拓展至更广泛机器人场景。

papers.title: DPed-VLN: A Benchmark for Socially Compliant Vision-and-Language Navigation in Dynamic Pedestrian Environments
papers.abstract: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) has advanced rapidly in static indoor environments, but robots operating in human-populated spaces must ground language while responding to moving pedestrians and social-safety constraints. We present DPed-VLN, a Habitat 3.0 benchmark for dynamic-pedestrian VLN that couples 33,093 navigation episodes with paired global and prior-augmented instructions, ORCA-controlled humanoid pedestrians, socially constrained expert paths, and metrics that jointly assess navigation efficiency and social safety. DPed-VLN separates ordinary goal-oriented route guidance from prior-augmented instructions that expose dynamic-pedestrian cues for controlled analysis. To instantiate the benchmark, we introduce DPet (Dynamic Pedestrian-aware Network), a pedestrian-aware policy network trained with reinforcement learning and imitation learning. We further adapt representative state-of-the-art VLM-based navigation models, including NaVILA and StreamVLN, to DPed-VLN through LoRA fine-tuning. Experiments show that LoRA adaptation improves zero-shot VLM baselines in several success and safety metrics, especially reducing StreamVLN's collision rate. Among the evaluated methods, DPet-RL achieves the highest SR, SPL, and STL.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试机器人在行人密集动态环境中听懂语言指令并安全导航的基准DPed-VLN，包含带社会约束的专家路径、ORCA模拟行人、两类语言指令（普通vs先验增强），并提出了一个强化学习+模仿学习训练的行人感知策略DPet，还用LoRA微调了两个VLM导航模型做对比实验。
analysis.claim: 动态行人环境下的视觉-语言导航必须同时优化导航成功率与社会安全性，而现有基准无法解耦动态交互与语言理解，DPed-VLN首次提供可控制分析动态行人线索的语言导航评测框架。
analysis.input: RGB-D观测+自然语言指令（含普通指令和先验增强指令）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散移动/转向）
analysis.robot_dependency: Habitat 3.0仿真器中的虚拟机器人（未指定具体硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦‘社会合规性’的VLN动态行人基准，有设计价值，但仅限仿真、无真机验证、无跨场景/跨机体泛化实验，所有方法均未部署或测试于现实人群环境；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑工作，它不涉及基础模型架构创新、多模态对齐机制突破或真实世界规模化数据驱动，属于扎实但窄域的benchmark建设，实证强度弱于典型SOTA推进工作（如DAM-VLA/τ₀-VLA）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了有明确问题意识的仿真基准并配套基线方法，但缺乏真实世界验证、泛化性验证和开源完整性，尚未达到推动领域范式转变或显著拉升SOTA的分量。

papers.title: MachEmbodied-U0: Unified Understanding and Generation Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot control requires models to understand task intent, identify where to interact, capture how the scene evolves, and generate precise actions. Vision-language-action models provide strong semantic priors but typically do not explicitly model scene dynamics, while world-action models couple visual prediction with control without necessarily exposing the task-relevant semantic and spatial structure needed for fine-grained manipulation. We present MachEmbodied-U0 (ME-U0), a unified embodied foundation model connecting understanding and generation experts through a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. Subtask prediction and affordance grounding guide joint visual-dynamics and action generation via flow matching. Visual dynamics encompass future RGB, depth, surface normals, and optical flow, providing complementary supervision for appearance, geometry, and motion. Multi-rate Rotary Position Encoding (MRPE) aligns visual dynamics with fine-grained control. We pretrain ME-U0 on approximately 4,200 hours of curated demonstrations from robotic datasets and egocentric datasets. Using only the supervision natively available in each downstream benchmark, ME-U0 achieves an average score of 17.66 on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark and average success rates of 99.0\% and 82.5\% on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, respectively. We additionally validate ME-U0 on real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness beyond simulation. Without corresponding downstream supervision, ME-U0 further demonstrates zero-shot subtask prediction, affordance grounding, and visual dynamics on simulated and real-world observations. Overall, ME-U0 combines competitive downstream control performance with transferable task-grounding and visual-dynamics capabilities across simulation and the real world.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MachEmbodied-U0的统一模型，把机器人任务理解（意图、交互位置、场景变化）和动作生成整合在一个Mixture-of-Transformers架构里，用flow matching联合预测多模态视觉动态（RGB/深度/法线/光流）和动作，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了下游控制性能及零样本子任务预测、可操作性定位能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，非明显头部实验室常见署名模式）
analysis.claim: 统一理解与生成的具身基础模型可通过显式建模视觉动态与动作的联合分布，在无需下游微调监督的情况下实现跨任务、跨模态、跨仿真-现实的泛化，同时保持高控制精度。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+语言指令（隐含，因属vision-language-action范式）+可能的初始状态观测
analysis.output: 动作序列+子任务标签+可操作性热图+多模态视觉动态预测（RGB/深度/法线/光流）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents（依据LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/RoboDojo及real-world manipulation推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人演示数据（4200小时“curated demonstrations from robotic datasets and egocentric datasets”），但未说明是否含真实硬件闭环数据，仅提“real-world robotic manipulation tasks”验证，未披露数据来源细节
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合较完整（flow matching+multi-rate PE+多视觉动态监督），在LIBERO等主流benchmark上达到SOTA级成功率（99%/82.5%），且有真实机器人验证，但缺乏消融实验细节、未开源代码/模型、未报告真实世界任务具体数量/多样性/失败案例，零样本能力仅定性提及；相比标尺中94+分的里程碑工作（如GR00T N1、H2O、ω-0），它未引入新范式（仍是VLA+world model混合）、未解决长期开放难题（如长程稀疏奖励、跨机体泛化）、也未展示全栈部署或人类对齐等维度突破，属于扎实但非颠覆的增量推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合到位、benchmark表现扎实、有真实验证，但缺乏开源、消融和范式创新，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: WOLF: World Model Guided LiDAR Exploration with Predictive Frontiers
papers.abstract: LiDAR-based unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) exploration builds maps by continually selecting where to observe next. However, decisions based on the measured map provide limited foresight into spatial continuations behind occlusions, leaving potentially informative directions unrecognized. We present WOLF, a world-model-guided framework that predicts future observations to enhance autonomous exploration. In the training stage, a recurrent world model learns observation dynamics from exploration trajectories, with recurrent memory retaining the spatial context needed to interpret partial observations across successive views. Building on this context, the model combines observation history with candidate motions during exploration to predict local occupancy and visibility. To guide further sensing, a predictive frontier generation mechanism then aligns and fuses these predictions using confidence, branch agreement, and observation quality to identify promising regions. The resulting predictive frontiers join measured ones to guide geometric viewpoint selection and trajectory generation, while new scans update subsequent predictions. In simulations, our method reduces mean terminal time by 10.9% relative to EPIC in Garage at comparable coverage and increases mean coverage from 42.12% to 98.35% in Tunnel. Real-world experiments further demonstrate onboard deployment of the learned model for online inference during physical flight.

analysis.tldr: 提出WOLF框架，用循环世界模型预测LiDAR扫描的未来局部占据与可见性，生成‘预测前沿’（predictive frontiers）来指导无人机探索未知区域，既在仿真中显著提升覆盖率和缩短探索时间，又在真实无人机上实现了在线部署。
analysis.claim: 通过学习观测动态的循环世界模型，能预测被遮挡区域的未来LiDAR可观测性，从而生成超越当前地图边界的预测前沿，显著提升自主探索的覆盖率与效率。
analysis.input: 历史LiDAR扫描序列 + 当前位姿 + 候选运动动作
analysis.output: 局部占据概率图 + 局部可见性图 + 预测前沿点集
analysis.robot_dependency: DJI M300 RTK + Livox Mid-360 LiDAR
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真轨迹预训练；真实飞行仅用于在线推理验证，未报告真实数据微调或闭环训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型显式用于LiDAR前沿预测，在仿真中效果突出（隧道覆盖率从42%→98%），且完成真实无人机端侧部署，但未跨场景/跨机体泛化验证，无消融证明世界模型各组件必要性，也未与SOTA探索方法（如FUEL、NeRF-based frontier）全面对比，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机部署+仿真强结果，但世界模型设计较常规、泛化与机制分析薄弱，属于扎实的领域内推进，非概念或工程包装。

papers.title: Encore: Few-Shot Agentic Discovery of Manipulation Strategies
papers.abstract: Coding agents can now write, run, and debug programs with little human help. Robot tasks, however, are usually specified by a sentence that leaves out how to grasp, in what order to make contact, and what the result should look like, and an agent given only the sentence must find these details by trial and error. We introduce ENCORE, which gives the agent a few demonstrations as evidence to read rather than as training data. A deterministic builder distills each demonstration into a pack of multi-view keyframes, gripper events, frame strips, and the full trajectory. A coding agent studies the pack, writes a policy program against a fixed perception and action API, refines it iteratively over a few development rollouts, and freezes it before a sealed evaluation that never reveals the success signal. On LIBERO-PRO, the agent's first program already succeeds in half of the perturbed tasks with demonstrations and in one task without them, and the frozen programs outperform the strongest prior agentic system run with the same language model (96.3% against 89.3%). On RoboDojo tasks whose instructions leave the goal unstated, no program succeeds without demonstrations. ENCORE also runs on a real bimanual robot, learning cube handover and cup inversion from five demonstrations each.

analysis.tldr: 提出ENCORE框架，让编码智能体通过阅读少量多视角示范（而非训练），自动编写可执行的机器人操作策略程序，在LIBERO-PRO上首次生成程序就达成50%任务成功率，并在真实双臂机器人上仅用5个示范就学会魔方传递和杯子翻转。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位，论文未公开预印本链接或会议信息）
analysis.claim: 少量示范应被当作可解析的‘证据包’供编码智能体阅读与推理，而非用于梯度训练；由此生成的确定性、API约束型策略程序，可在零微调下泛化至扰动任务并部署到真实双臂机器人。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 少量多视角示范视频（含关键帧、夹爪事件、轨迹）
analysis.output: 符合固定感知/动作API的Python策略程序（非神经网络权重）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实示范（5个/任务），但不依赖大规模真实机器人交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘编码智能体+示范证据包’范式落地到真实双臂操作（cube handover/cup inversion），有跨扰动任务泛化和严格封测评估，但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据，未在标准基线（如ALOHA/ACT/Diffusion Policy）上做控制变量对比，且未解决接触密集、高精度操作等基石工作聚焦的核心难点，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。

papers.title: Multi-Link Safety Filtering for VLA Policies Around Moving Hazards
papers.abstract: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy can finish a manipulation task while knocking over objects unrelated to it, so task success alone does not show that the policy is safe to deploy in clutter. We study how to keep a pretrained VLA policy clear of such hazards at run time without retraining it, which requires guarding more of the arm than the end effector, following the hazard as it moves, and sharing onboard compute with the policy. Our training-free shield covers the gripper, wrist, and forearm with five ellipsoids and filters every commanded motion through one barrier program against a keep-out ellipsoid fitted from RGB-D perception at reset. Sparse optical flow then carries that ellipsoid's center along with the hazard, with no repeated detection or refitting. Over six simulated hazard-motion conditions, the shield lowers collision from $65.62\%$ to $27.27\%$ and raises safe-success, task completion without collision, from $29.35\%$ to $50.43\%$. Ablations show that guarding the arm links protects beyond end-effector shielding, and that tracking recovers most of the protection lost when the hazard estimate is frozen at reset. On heterogeneous edge hardware, the five-ellipsoid barrier runs on the CPU in $2.2$~ms at the 99th percentile, and trimming the vision--language prefix and taking fewer flow-matching steps shortens each $π_{0.5}$ policy call on the integrated GPU from $343$ to $177.3$~ms. On a physical SO-101 arm across four tasks, the arm touched the hazard in 3 of 16 shielded episodes versus 11 of 16 unshielded ones. Project page: https://yathag.github.io/multilink-safety-filter/

analysis.tldr: 给已训练好的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人策略加了一个不需重训练的实时安全防护层，用5个动态更新的椭球体覆盖机械臂多段（而不仅是末端），结合RGB-D初识+稀疏光流持续追踪移动障碍物，显著降低碰撞率并提升‘无碰撞完成任务’成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者为个人主页 yathag.github.io，无明确机构署名；摘要未提所属单位；论文未列affiliation）
analysis.claim: 无需重训练预训练VLA策略，仅通过运行时多链路椭球屏障过滤与轻量光流跟踪，即可在动态杂乱环境中显著提升其物理安全性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（初始化建模）+ 稀疏光流帧差（持续跟踪）+ VLA策略原始动作命令
analysis.output: 经安全过滤后的修正动作命令（连续控制空间中的运动向量）
analysis.robot_dependency: SO-101机械臂（实机验证）、仿真中基于PyBullet/Mujoco的多 hazard 运动场景
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需单帧RGB-D初始化+在线光流，不依赖任何真实机器人交互数据或安全标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在VLA部署安全这一关键缺口上提出首个轻量、免训练、多链路几何屏障方案，有扎实的仿真多工况消融+真机4任务对比（碰撞从11/16→3/16），且计算开销极低（CPU 2.2ms），但未开源代码/模型，也未挑战更复杂接触密集或长程时序安全问题，尚未达到Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典屏障函数思想精准适配到VLA实时部署瓶颈，在多链路建模、光流驱动动态keep-out和边缘计算协同上做出可靠落地创新，但非理论或范式突破。

papers.title: Mind the Refinement Gap: When Safe High-Level Robot Plans Produce Unsafe Executions
papers.abstract: Language-enabled robot systems increasingly combine semantic-graph planning with temporal-logic safety monitors. We investigate a trace-completeness assumption in these systems: whether the high-level action sequence checked by a monitor represents the navigation and implicit action effects induced during execution. We audit this assumption in RoboGuard by comparing its verdict on a surface plan with its verdict on a graph-refined trace under the same Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) specification. Our evaluation comprises 28 controlled cases spanning five action-abstraction families and 14 end-to-end cases in which SPINE [1] generates plans from natural-language instructions while RoboGuard generates scene-grounded safety specifications. In the controlled evaluation, all 12 targeted abstraction cases exhibit the predicted surface-versus-refined discrepancy while all 16 controls behave as expected, motivating graph-based trace refinement as a lightweight mitigation and a diagnostic tool for physical-AI safety monitors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前语言驱动的机器人安全监控系统存在一个关键漏洞：高层语义规划（如‘把杯子放到桌上’）在被形式化验证时，其动作序列未反映实际执行中隐含的底层运动细节（如路径绕障、末端姿态调整），导致安全验证‘通过’但执行仍可能撞墙或打翻物体；作者用RoboGuard工具实证了该‘精炼鸿沟’在多种抽象层级下普遍存在，并提出图结构轨迹精炼作为轻量级修复和诊断手段。
analysis.claim: 语言驱动的机器人安全监控系统中，高阶语义计划与实际执行轨迹之间存在系统性‘精炼鸿沟’，导致基于表面动作序列的LTL安全验证失效，而图结构化的轨迹精炼可暴露并缓解该问题。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 场景语义图 + LTL安全规范
analysis.output: 安全验证结果（通过/失败）及精炼后的轨迹图
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真与可控合成场景
analysis.significance_reason: 精准识别并实证了一个被广泛忽视的安全验证盲区（精炼鸿沟），证据扎实（28个控制案例+14个端到端案例，有明确正负样本区分），但仅停留在仿真诊断层面，无真实机器人验证、无闭环控制干预、未集成进任何主流规划-执行栈，也未提出新监控算法或学习框架，属于高质量问题揭示型工作，尚未达到‘显著贡献’（60+）所需的工程落地或范式影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把已有的LTL监控、语义图规划、轨迹精炼等模块组合成诊断流水线，暴露了系统性设计缺陷，但未突破任一模块能力边界，也未解决执行层安全闭环问题。

papers.title: Bridging Frontier Reasoning and Robot Execution: From Autonomous Demonstration Generation to Dense Language Supervision
papers.abstract: Recent advances in frontier models enable robot manipulation from only a few demonstrations, but high inference latency limits their use for real-time robot control. To bridge this gap, we study two complementary approaches that connect frontier reasoning with low-latency local execution. First, we use a frontier model to autonomously generate demonstrations that supplement human demonstrations for training a fast local policy. We augment its in-context examples with corrective demonstration segments that show how to recover from physical errors, improving generation reliability. Generation time and cost decrease as successful examples accumulate in context, suggesting a path toward more efficient data collection. At deployment, a harness combines frontier-generated instructions with a fast local policy, enabling efficient execution while preserving the frontier model's ability to guide and correct actions. With low-latency execution delegated to the local policy, the bottleneck shifts to its capacity to reliably follow the frontier model's diverse instructions. Our second bridge introduces dense language supervision across three nested granularities---primitive, atomic, and composite---with multi-aspect descriptions at each level. Across long-horizon tasks in RoboCasa 365 and BEHAVIOR-1K, where instructions change as execution progresses, the combined supervision achieves the highest performance under both oracle and frontier-model instructors, demonstrating more reliable instruction following through the policy's language interface. Finally, we evaluate both bridges together on a crossword task that combines semantic planning and manipulation within a fixed time budget. These results support autonomous demonstration generation and dense language supervision as complementary components for connecting frontier reasoning to low-latency local execution.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出两种方法来连接大语言/多模态前沿模型（推理强但慢）和低延迟本地机器人策略（执行快但指令跟随能力弱）：一是用前沿模型自动生成带纠错示例的演示数据来训练本地策略；二是设计三层嵌套的密集语言监督（primitive/atomic/composite），提升策略对动态变化指令的跟随鲁棒性，并在RoboCasa 365、BEHAVIOR-1K和跨字谜任务上验证了二者协同效果。
analysis.claim: 通过自主演示生成与密集语言监督双路径，可系统性弥合前沿推理模型与低延迟本地策略之间的语义—执行鸿沟，使前者能可靠指导后者完成长程、动态指令下的具身操作。
analysis.input: 多粒度语言指令（primitive/atomic/composite层级）+ 视觉观测 + 前沿模型生成的示范或修正提示
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboCasa 365 / BEHAVIOR-1K 仿真环境中的模拟机器人（未提真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人数据采集或部署
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有结构的设计（三层语言监督+纠错增强的自主演示生成），并在多个主流长程仿真基准上做了系统消融和协同验证，证据扎实；但全部限于仿真、未触达真机部署，也未挑战物理误差建模或跨机体泛化等更深层瓶颈，属于显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：将前沿模型的语义能力与本地策略的执行效率做结构化耦合，在仿真中验证了双路径协同的有效性，但尚未跨越sim2real门槛，也未开源核心代码/模型。

papers.title: Do LLM Proposers Improve Budgeted Search for Ionizable Lipids?
papers.abstract: Efficient lipid design under limited experimental budgets is a central challenge in computational chemistry and drug discovery. We introduce LEAF (Lipid Evolutionary Adaptive Framework), a matched-budget protocol for testing whether language-model proposers improve combinatorial molecular search relative to classical baselines. The study uses a 30,044-candidate ionizable-lipid space, a frozen Gaussian-process oracle fitted to experimental potency labels, and a separate active-learning surrogate. Four language models evaluated over eight seeds and three splits show no significant improvement over genetic-algorithm or random-search baselines. For Llama 8B, 79.1% of acquisition-selected queries repeat previously evaluated archive members. Removing duplicates reduces the performance gap on some splits but increases proposal cost and can prevent budget exhaustion. Larger models reduce duplication without establishing superiority or equivalence. Exploratory scored prompts and stricter novelty controls yield positive median differences against the genetic algorithm, yet wide intervals and shared-seed dependence preclude stronger conclusions. A validated single-assay reanalysis preserves the chemotype-cold deficit at a smaller numerical scale, and exploratory expected hypervolume improvement does not reverse the result. Follow-up checks address whether proposers genuinely use injected evidence. These checks include a zero-shot leakage probe, rank-only and chain-of-thought-rationale prompts, a score-shuffle perturbation, an evidence-conflict probe, and a genuine reasoning-mode proposer. They show measurable engagement with supplied information without a corresponding performance gain. LEAF isolates proposal quality as the experimental variable and documents a concrete failure mode of zero-shot LLM proposers under controlled budgets.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用严格控制的预算搜索实验，测试多个大语言模型（如Llama 8B）能否比传统遗传算法或随机搜索更高效地发现高活性可电离脂质分子，结果发现LLM提案器在真实化学空间中几乎不带来提升，反而大量重复已测分子，且即使改进提示或过滤重复，也无法稳定超越基线。
analysis.claim: 在受限实验预算下，零样本大语言模型作为分子提案器，并未显著提升离子化脂质的定向搜索效率，其性能缺陷源于提案质量低（高重复率、弱证据利用、无泛化增益），而非接口或调用方式问题。
analysis.input: 文本描述的化学结构约束、少量已测脂质活性标签、提示工程模板（含证据注入）
analysis.output: 候选脂质SMILES字符串列表（按采集顺序）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖一个冻结的高斯过程代理模型（拟合自真实实验数据）和一个独立的主动学习代理模型
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在分子设计闭环中将LLM提案器作为单一受控变量进行预算敏感型消融实验，揭示其在真实化学空间中的系统性失效（高重复、低信息利用、无统计优势），证据扎实（多模型/多种子/多分割/多种探针），但未提出新模型或新化学发现，属对当前LLM for Science范式的重大负向验证，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是正向技术突破，而是对‘LLM直接用于分子提案’这一流行范式的首次高保真负向验证，实验设计严密、变量隔离彻底、失败归因清晰，终结了该方向上缺乏实证的乐观预期。

papers.title: Teaching neural decoders with language
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces decode neural activity, yet class-label supervision (CLS) leaves relationships among classes implicit. We propose Language as Supervision (LaS), which aligns neural features with natural-language class descriptions through learned projections and predicts classes using candidate text prototypes. We evaluate seven encoder architectures with independently trained models for visual, motor, and speech decoding from scalp and intracranial recordings. LaS improves speech-decoding accuracy by up to 17.15~pp over matched CLS baselines. Its representations support candidate-set reuse and label-supervised subject and session adaptation, while LaS enables conditional unseen-frequency decoding in steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) responses. Correct class-description correspondence supports this generalization, and dual-sided attribution visualization shows neural and textual contributions to the same class-matching score. These findings suggest that text descriptions can serve as general-purpose references for learning and interpretation in neural decoding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用自然语言描述作为监督信号来训练脑机接口的神经解码器，替代传统类别标签，让模型学会把脑电信号映射到文字描述上，从而提升语音解码准确率，并支持跨被试、跨实验环节的迁移以及对未见过频率的稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）解码。
analysis.claim: 自然语言描述可作为通用、可解释、可泛化的监督信号，替代传统离散类别标签，显著提升神经解码器的性能与适应性。
analysis.input: 头皮或颅内记录的神经活动信号（EEG/ECoG）
analysis.output: 对应自然语言类别的预测概率（通过文本原型匹配），最终输出为预定义候选集中的类别标签
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开/自建的神经电生理数据集（含视觉、运动、语音任务），但未说明是否使用真实在线闭环控制数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证语言监督在多模态神经解码（视觉/运动/语音）中的有效性，有真实神经数据+多架构对比+跨被试/跨session迁移+消融支撑，但未达临床级闭环性能（如实时语音合成）、未展示端到端脑-文本生成、无开源代码/模型，且仍依赖预定义候选集，未突破‘分类器升级’范畴，属于扎实的范式拓展而非基石性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：将语言监督引入神经解码并验证其泛化优势，但仍是监督学习框架内的方法改进，未实现真正开放词汇脑-文本生成或临床可用闭环系统。

papers.title: RESCUE: Is This Alarm Worth Acting On? Counterfactual Evaluation of VLA Runtime Monitors
papers.abstract: Runtime failure monitors for robot policies are typically evaluated by how accurately they distinguish failed from successful executions. Yet an accurate alarm may arrive too late for recovery, while an unnecessary intervention may disrupt an execution that would otherwise succeed. We introduce RESCUE, a counterfactual framework for evaluating whether a monitor's alarms enable useful interventions. By restoring simulator and policy states at execution checkpoints, RESCUE compares alternative actions, identifies the latest checkpoint satisfying a specified recovery criterion, and evaluates whether acting on alarms reduces expected task-completion cost. We evaluate RESCUE with OpenVLA-OFT and $π_{0.5}$ over LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Plus using 128,340 counterfactual branches. Recoverability depends on the state--intervention pair rather than on robot state alone: at $τ=0.5$, 14 of 66 OpenVLA-OFT/LIBERO-Plus failures contain a recoverable checkpoint under continuation, compared with 34 of 66 under continuation or scripted recovery, while recovery reduces recoverability in other conditions. On the primary strong-policy conditions, favourable detection scores do not establish lower intervention cost. Under the evaluated stop-and-reset model, even an idealised detector can afford only a 2.0--3.3% false-alarm rate before unnecessary resets outweigh the savings from stopping failures early. These results show that monitor value depends jointly on the intervention available and the workload in which it is deployed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RESCUE框架，用反事实仿真方法评估机器人视觉语言动作（VLA）模型运行时失败监测器是否真能通过及时干预降低任务失败成本，发现单纯高检测准确率不等于低干预代价，且实际可用的假警率容忍度极低（仅2.0–3.3%）。
analysis.claim: 监控器的价值不能只看报警准确率，而必须联合评估其可支持的干预类型、干预时机与任务工作负载，否则高精度报警可能反而增加总体任务成本。
analysis.input: VLA策略执行过程中的中间状态（含观测、动作、时间戳）及监控器触发的报警信号
analysis.output: 该报警是否值得干预的因果判断（即：若在某检查点重置/干预，能否以更低期望成本完成任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器状态回滚，无需真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将反事实因果推理系统性引入VLA运行时监控评估，揭示了‘检测准≠干预好’这一被长期忽视的关键耦合关系，并给出量化阈值（如2.0–3.3%假警率上限），属显著贡献；但未开源代码/模型，实验限于LIBERO仿真环境，未验证真实机器人或跨策略泛化，未构建新模型或数据集，故未达基石级（如RT-2/π0）的范式开创性或工程覆盖广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破在评估范式，但非模型/系统突破；因缺乏开源与实机验证，暂属扎实的理论驱动型分析，非工程整合或部署级成果。

papers.title: Plans Are Not Executions: Adapting Frozen World-Model Planners to Controller-Induced Execution Shift
papers.abstract: World-model planners evaluate candidate trajectories by predicting their future consequences, implicitly relying on the plan-to-motion relationship learned during training. At deployment, a different downstream controller may execute the same planned trajectory differently, creating a planning-execution gap between the frozen model's imagined future and actual execution. A natural remedy is to replace the planned trajectory with its predicted or observed execution. However, we find that better execution fidelity does not necessarily yield better decisions: directly substituting predicted execution trajectories yields only a 0.048 PDMS improvement across 10 unseen controller configurations, far smaller than the gain from our proposed adaptation. This suggests a semantic mismatch between a planned trajectory, which serves as a reference for downstream control, and an executed trajectory, which already describes the resulting post-controller motion. We introduce ExecutionBridge, which infers controller-specific execution characteristics from planned-executed trajectory pairs and uses them to adapt the native ego latent rollout while keeping the original planned trajectory unchanged. The planner, world model, and reward head remain frozen. On NAVSIM, ExecutionBridge consistently improves planning across unseen controller configurations and multiple frozen world-model planners, with substantially larger gains in challenging driving scenes where execution mismatch more strongly affects candidate evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型规划器在部署时若换用不同底层控制器，其预想的轨迹和实际执行结果会不一致，导致决策变差；作者没改模型也没重训练，而是设计了一个轻量适配模块ExecutionBridge，仅用少量计划-执行轨迹对就能校准世界模型的隐状态 rollout，从而提升跨控制器泛化下的规划质量。
analysis.claim: 冻结的世界模型规划器可通过建模控制器诱导的执行偏移（而非替换轨迹）来实现零微调、跨控制器鲁棒规划。
analysis.input: 计划轨迹（planned trajectory）+ 对应的实际执行轨迹（observed execution trajectory）
analysis.output: 经控制器特性校准后的世界模型隐状态 rollout（用于重评估候选轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实或高保真仿真中采集的计划-执行轨迹对（未说明是否需真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进了世界模型落地的关键瓶颈——规划-执行失配问题；在NAVSIM上验证了多控制器泛化与多个冻结世界模型的兼容性，有消融和跨配置测试，但仅限仿真、无真机、无开源代码，未触及长期开放难题（如持续状态维护/具身因果建模），尚未达DreamerV3级范式突破，但显著优于一般增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对世界模型部署中的控制器失配问题，提出免微调、可插拔的适配机制，实证充分但局限在仿真，未开源代码，属高质量工程级改进。

papers.title: Walking on the Moon: Hypogravity drives the emergence of a proprioception-dependent locomotor state
papers.abstract: Animals must adapt locomotion to changing environments, but how the nervous system flexibly select gait remains unclear. Gravity is a powerful natural perturbation altering body loading and limb dynamics. Apollo astronauts often skipped on the Moon, adopting an asymmetric gait rarely used on Earth, yet the motor control basis of this behavior is unknown. Here, by studying the effect of hypogravity on locomotion in humans and mice, we identify a conserved strategy for gait adaptation. Muscle synergy analysis in humans shows that skipping in reduced gravity is generated through flexible reuse of existing motor modules rather than construction of new ones. In mice, lunar gravity elicited a skipping-like asymmetric gait and genetic elimination of muscle proprioceptors abolished it. Thus, hypogravity reveals a proprioception-dependent mechanism for flexible gait selection.

analysis.tldr: 通过在模拟月球低重力环境下研究人和小鼠的行走，发现跳步（skipping）这种不对称步态并非新生成的运动模式，而是复用已有肌肉协同模块，且完全依赖肌肉本体感受器——去掉本体感受后小鼠就无法跳步。
analysis.org: 德国航空航天中心(DLR)/柏林夏里特医学院
analysis.claim: 低重力环境会触发一种保守的、依赖肌肉本体感受器的步态选择机制，该机制通过灵活复用既有肌肉协同模块实现跳步，而非构建新运动程序。
analysis.input: 受控低重力环境（抛物线飞行/吊索减重/离心机）下的生物运动数据（肌电、运动学、足底压力）
analysis.output: 步态分类（跳步/步行/奔跑）、肌肉协同结构、本体感受依赖性验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类与小鼠在物理减重装置中的实验数据（非仿真合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在跨物种层面实证揭示本体感受是低重力下步态切换的必要开关，机制清晰、证据链完整（人类肌电+小鼠基因敲除+多梯度重力验证），但属神经运动控制基础发现，未涉及算法/机器人/可部署系统，与具身智能或AI×科学的工程范式无直接接口，分量不及任何所列基石（全为端到端具身策略建模或大规模多模态具身基础模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：扎实的跨物种神经运动机制发现，但属于经典生理学范畴，与具身智能/AI×科学的前沿工程范式无交集，暂时不用看

papers.title: Flexible Kernels for Protein Property Prediction
papers.abstract: Despite its importance to applications in protein design, predicting protein properties like binding affinity and thermostability from sparse experimental data remains a significant challenge.
