Accordingly, we introduce a class of sequence kernels that exploit evolutionary substitution matrices as well as local linearity and demonstrate that the resulting Gaussian processes provide data-efficient models of protein property landscapes, frequently outperforming alternatives that rely on foundation model embeddings. Furthermore--by learning what are in effect structure-aware substitution matrices--we show that our kernels can readily incorporate structural information from foundation models. We demonstrate that these structure-conditioned kernels are well suited to multi-task learning across multiple protein property landscapes and can decisively outperform local supervised learning methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一类基于进化替换矩阵和局部线性假设的柔性核函数，用于蛋白质属性预测（如结合亲和力、热稳定性），用少量实验数据训练高斯过程模型，比直接用ESM等基础模型嵌入效果更好，并能融合结构信息实现多任务学习。
analysis.org: 哈佛大学/达纳-法伯癌症研究所
analysis.claim: 柔性核函数（而非端到端深度模型）能更高效地利用稀疏蛋白质实验数据建模属性景观，且通过学习结构感知的替换矩阵，可自然融入结构先验并支持跨属性多任务泛化。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（可选配结构感知的替换矩阵或基础模型结构特征）
analysis.output: 标量蛋白质属性预测值（如ΔΔG、Tm等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实湿实验数据（如突变体亲和力/稳定性测量），不依赖高通量测序或大规模结构测定
analysis.significance_reason: 方法在稀疏数据场景下实证优于ESM嵌入+MLP等基线，有消融（核设计、结构条件化）、多属性验证（binding/thermostability/folding）和真实突变数据测试，但未开源数据集、未与AlphaFold/ESM3/RFDiffusion等基石模型在同等任务上做系统对比，属扎实的机器学习方法创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在蛋白质属性预测的小样本建模中，用核方法+进化先验做出有实证支撑的实质性改进，但未动摇当前以foundation model embedding为主流的范式。

papers.title: A Fully Endovascular Neural Interface
papers.abstract: Electrical stimulation of neural circuits is expanding therapeutic strategies to modulate brain, autonomic, and immune functions. Devices delivered endovascularly offer a less invasive alternative to conventional implanted electrodes, while delivering spatio-temporal specificity superior to noninvasive techniques. We demonstrate a fully endovascular sub-1-mm3 implant, utilizing ultrasound for wireless power delivery and data telemetry in a fashion invariant to device orientation. The implant consists of piezoelectric transducers, an energy storage capacitor, an application-specific integrated circuit, and electrodes packaged on a 7-um-thick polyimide scaffold. The implant can be delivered through a microcatheter in a manner analogous to conventional neurovascular stents, and self-expands upon deployment to appose the vessel walls. We demonstrate intravascular stimulation of the autonomic nervous system from the carotid artery, achieving modulation of blood pressure in rabbits. This approach establishes a broadly applicable platform for neural interfaces enabling both stimulation and recording.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一种小于1立方毫米、可通过微导管经血管植入的超小型神经接口器件，用超声无线供电和传数据，无需对准方向，靠自膨胀贴合血管壁，在兔颈动脉内成功电刺激自主神经系统并实时调控血压。
analysis.org: 哥伦比亚大学/麻省理工学院/哈佛医学院（多机构合作，以Ed Boyden和Elisa Konofagou为核心；Boyden属MIT+McGovern，Konofagou属Columbia；摘要作者含Sisti/Orbach/Connolly等临床神经血管专家，综合判断主导为哥伦比亚大学与MIT联合团队）
analysis.claim: 首次实现完全血管内植入、超小型、无线超声供能、无需定向、可进行在体自主神经调控的闭环神经接口平台。
analysis.input: 外部超声波发射信号（用于供电与双向通信）
analysis.output: 血管内电刺激脉冲（用于调控血压）及可能的神经电生理响应信号（摘要未明确展示记录功能实证，但声称‘enabling both stimulation and recording’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖兔活体血管解剖与血流动力学环境，需真实动物手术操作与生理监测，但未使用机器人系统
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了迄今最小、真正全血管内部署、无需穿透脑膜或开颅、且在活体兔中完成闭环血压调控的神经接口硬件范式突破；虽未做长期稳定性、多物种验证或高通量记录，但解决了长期存在的‘微创性-特异性-鲁棒性’三角矛盾，是继ECoG、DBS、硬膜外EEG后又一新植入路径里程碑，显著优于多数纯仿真或体外贴片类BCI，但尚未达到Brain-to-text（97）级的信息带宽与语义解码深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将功能性神经接口压缩至亚毫米尺度并全程经血管部署，用物理层创新（超声定向无关供能+超薄聚酰亚胺支架）绕过开颅/开胸瓶颈，在活体实现可重复的自主神经闭环调控。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
papers.abstract: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可动态重配置视觉输入策略和任务模式的导航大模型Qwen-RobotNav，通过训练时随机化参数实现零修改适配多种导航任务（指令跟随、目标搜索、跟踪等），并在多个基准上刷出SOTA，声称能零样本迁移到真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 一个无需架构修改即可在推理时任意组合任务模式与视觉编码策略的可扩展导航基础模型，能通过联合多任务训练形成共享空间规划表征，并实现跨任务家族迁移和真实机器人零样本泛化。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频流+语言指令+可调视觉token预算与相机权重
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（离散/连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅泛称‘real-world robots’
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖15.6M合成与真实导航数据，但未说明真实机器人数据占比及采集细节
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（参数化接口+多任务联合训练），有scaling趋势和跨任务迁移证据，但缺乏真实机器人多任务闭环验证、无消融证明参数化设计必要性、未公开代码/模型/数据，且‘zero-shot real-robot generalization’仅泛泛而谈无定量结果（如具体机器人型号、环境数量、成功率），远未达RT-2/Octo/CHORUS级范式突破或工程鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将VLA范式系统性拓展到导航领域并做参数化解耦，但实证深度不足，尚未构成真突破

papers.title: Task-Error Residual Learning for Real-Robot Five-Ball Juggling
papers.abstract: For residual learning that refines existing behavior, sample efficiency depends on two things: how much information each rollout returns, and how efficiently the learner uses that information. Reinforcement learning's standard scalar reward carries far less information than the directional task error that defines the task. Random exploration further discards whatever information each rollout returns. Through residual learning with directional task-error supervision and a task error model that drives sample selection, we achieve stable three-, four-, and five-ball juggling on anthropomorphic Barrett WAM arms. Despite planning and controlling through a simple, idealized stack, the system converges from the second attempt. The first attempt drops, after which task error decreases monotonically without further failures. In comparison, five-ball juggling typically takes humans years of practice. We compare residual learners across two ternary axes, the directional information in the learning feedback and the commitment of the analytic prior, spanning Newton-style Jacobian updates, Composite Bayesian Optimization, and stochastic search methods. Both axes prove necessary: neither directional feedback nor an informative prior suffices alone, and the simplest method that combines them, a fixed-Jacobian Newton update, is the most reliable. The learned residual tolerates substantial prior misalignment and degraded joint tracking, affecting mainly convergence speed. The bottleneck for residual learning on real robots is therefore the information content of the supervision signal and how the learner uses it, not the accuracy of the surrounding stack. Video documentation of all experiments is available at https://kai-ploeger.com/residual-juggling.

analysis.tldr: 用任务误差（而非标量奖励）作为方向性监督信号，结合固定雅可比更新的残差学习方法，在真实Barrett WAM机械臂上仅用2次尝试就稳定实现五球杂耍，全程无失败重启，且对先验模型失准和关节跟踪退化鲁棒。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 残差学习的性能瓶颈不在底层运动学/动力学模型精度，而在监督信号的信息维度（方向性任务误差）与学习器对信息的利用效率（如样本选择+解析先验耦合），二者缺一不可。
analysis.input: 当前状态下的任务误差向量（位置/姿态偏差）
analysis.output: 关节空间残差控制增量
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据，无仿真预训练、无离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人上以极低样本（2次rollout）达成高难度动态操作（五球杂耍），实证确立了‘方向性误差监督+轻量解析先验’范式的有效性；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验完整、视频可验证、消融对比清晰，显著优于纯RL或纯解析方法，但未扩展至多机体/跨传感器/开放任务，尚未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典控制直觉（雅可比更新）与现代学习框架（残差学习）在真实高维动态任务中做出极致可靠的落地，非概念包装，但未开源且任务单一，暂未构成新范式

papers.title: Better data, better trees: GenBank-GISAID deduplication and source-specific artifact masking in viral genomics
papers.abstract: Abstract GenBank and GISAID are the primary repositories for viral genomic data, but integrating records across them remains a challenge. The same sequence could be made available in both databases without any cross-reference linking the two entries. Consequently, there is no systematic way to identify this redundancy, which compromises the compilation of representative, non-redundant large-scale datasets. In parallel, the growth of viral genomic data has increased the risk of systematic technical artifacts introduced during sequencing or assembly. These artifacts can inflate substitution rate estimates and degrade temporal signal, biasing evolutionary rate estimates. To address both challenges, here we present a formal, reproducible workflow integrating two newly developed complementary tools: G2G matcher for cross-repository harmonization and Lab-Specific Bias FILTer (LSBFILT) for masking of laboratory-specific artifacts. Using the Eastern/Central/South African (ECSA) chikungunya virus lineage as a proof-of-concept, we demonstrate that our integrated workflow restores temporal signal and provides a robust, curated dataset for downstream phylodynamic analyses. Critically, restricting masking of homoplastic sites to specific sequences reduces the substitution rate estimate from an inflated 8.517 × 10 −4 to 5.078 × 10 −4 substitutions/site/year and increases the coefficient of determination (R 2 ) of the root-to-tip regression analysis from 0.353 to 0.677. By enabling systematic cross-repository harmonization and source-specific artifact masking, we provide the molecular epidemiological community with scalable tools to reconcile fragmented genomic data and reduce technical biases, fostering more accurate and reproducible phylogenetic analysis. G2G matcher is available at https://github.com/andrezaleite/G2G-Matcher , and LSBFILT at https://github.com/khourious/LSBFILT .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了两个开源工具G2G Matcher和LSBFILT，用于自动去重GenBank与GISAID中重复的病毒基因组序列，并针对性地屏蔽不同实验室引入的测序/组装技术假象，从而提升病毒分子钟估算和系统发育分析的准确性。
analysis.claim: 跨数据库冗余消除与实验室特异性技术假象屏蔽的联合流程，能显著恢复病毒基因组数据的时序信号并校正被高估的进化速率。
analysis.input: GenBank和GISAID中的病毒基因组序列及其元数据（如采样时间、实验室来源、测序平台）
analysis.output: 去重后的非冗余序列集 + 经实验室特异性掩码过滤后的碱基位点集（即标记为可疑的同源平行突变位点）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于公开数据库序列和元数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了病毒基因组领域长期存在的跨库冗余与实验室偏倚两大实操痛点，有扎实的量化改进（R²从0.35→0.68，速率校正达40%），但属方法学优化而非范式变革；未涉及新模型架构或生成式建模，影响力限于分子流行病学数据预处理环节，远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等底层模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是理论突破，但在病毒演化分析的关键数据清洗环节提供了可复现、可扩展、经实证有效的工程化解决方案

papers.title: DeepCDS: Ab initio coding sequence prediction in prokaryotic short reads
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate coding sequence prediction in short prokaryotic metagenomic reads remains challenging due to sequence fragmentation, unknown sequence origins, and sequencing errors. Here we introduce DeepCDS, a deep learning-based ab initio coding sequence predictor trained on short prokaryotic sequences with and without simulated Illumina-like sequencing errors. DeepCDS integrates ESM-2 protein language model embeddings with nucleotide-level information to predict complete and fragmented coding sequence regions. Benchmarking on 215 phylogenetically diverse prokaryotic organisms demonstrates that DeepCDS consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in coding sequence detection, start and stop codon localization, and robustness to different sequencing error profiles, while remaining operational at shorter sequence lengths than existing tools support. These findings demonstrate that protein language models capture distinct signals relevant for nucleotide-level coding sequence detection, especially at very short lengths. Ultimately, DeepCDS may help uncover the functional potential of the vast microbial diversity that remains genomically uncharacterized.

analysis.tldr: 用ESM-2蛋白语言模型的嵌入向量+核苷酸序列信息，构建深度学习模型DeepCDS，在短至30–100 bp的原核宏基因组测序片段上，从头预测编码区（CDS）及其起止密码子，不依赖参考基因组或同源比对。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型（ESM-2）的嵌入能有效迁移至核苷酸级CDS预测任务，在极短读长下显著提升从头预测的准确性、鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: 长度30–300 bp的DNA序列（含模拟Illumina错误）
analysis.output: 每个核苷酸位置是否属于CDS、是否为起始密码子、是否为终止密码子的三元分类标签
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在短读长CDS预测这一长期瓶颈问题上，首次系统验证并工程化利用ESM-2嵌入实现跨物种泛化，实证覆盖215个原核物种、多类错误谱、低至30 bp输入，性能全面超越Prodigal/MetaGeneMark等主流工具；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属AI×微生物基因组学中证据扎实、任务定义清晰、可复现性强的重磅方法学推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅贡献：首次将蛋白语言模型嵌入成功迁移到极短DNA片段的从头CDS预测，实证充分、泛化可信、工程可用，显著突破现有工具的长度下限与鲁棒性瓶颈。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from visual observations and language instructions, but adapting them to new environments still depends on costly action-labeled demonstrations. To reduce this dependence, we study semi-supervised VLA adaptation under limited supervision signals, where only a small portion of trajectories contain robot actions and the remaining trajectories provide action-unlabeled vision-language observations. Unlike standard semi-supervised learning, the missing supervision is an embodied action signal that must be visually grounded, language-consistent, physically feasible, and temporally stable. To address this problem, we propose SemiVLA, a self-distilled teacher-student framework that learns from reliable pseudo-actions on unlabeled trajectories. SemiVLA introduces a VLA-specific reliability controller to assess vision-language alignment, action feasibility, and temporal transition consistency, and further updates the teacher through a Bottleneck-Projected Alignment Update to avoid noisy feedback contamination. With OpenVLA as the backbone, SemiVLA consistently improves multiple PEFT strategies across LIBERO and CALVIN. Under 10\% labeled trajectories, SemiVLA with Selective LoRA achieves 89.0\% average success on LIBERO, outperforming supervised LoRA by 8.0 points without extra inference cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出SemiVLA框架，在仅有10%动作标注轨迹的情况下，利用未标注的视觉-语言数据自生成可靠伪动作，提升VLA模型在新环境中的泛化能力，无需额外推理开销。
analysis.claim: 通过VLA专属的可靠性控制器和瓶颈投影对齐更新机制，可在极低动作标注率（10%）下，用伪标签有效蒸馏未标注视觉-语言轨迹，显著提升PEFT-VLA模型在跨任务基准上的成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF+gripper）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人动作标注轨迹（10%），但未说明是否使用真实机器人采集数据，仅报告在LIBERO/CALVIN仿真基准上的结果
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有VLA特异性（动作可行性+时序稳定性+语言-视觉对齐联合评估），在LIBERO/CALVIN上实证有效，但完全基于仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源代码/模型、未挑战跨机体或跨场景泛化，属于扎实的半监督学习在VLA领域的适配性改进，未触及RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的架构或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了VLA领域标注成本高的实际痛点，但限于仿真、无开源、未拓展到真实机器人或新机体，属于高质量工程适配而非范式突破。

papers.title: OpenGerminal: an open-source implementation of the Germinal antibody design pipeline
papers.abstract: Germinal is a recently described computational pipeline for de novo antibody design that combines AlphaFold-Multimer hallucination with antibody language model guidance to generate epitope-targeted antibodies. Germinal identified binders with nanomolar-to-low-micromolar affinities by testing only 43-101 designs per target across four diverse antigens, establishing it as a practical tool for epitope-directed antibody design accessible to standard academic laboratories. As this architecture is itself very recent, systematic replacement and benchmarking of its individual components remains largely unexplored, yet offers a valuable opportunity to probe the robustness of the underlying design. We present OpenGerminal, which replaces PyRosetta with a fully open-source stack comprising OpenMM 8.5.1, FreeSASA, FASPR, Biopython, and sc-rs v1.0.0, and adopts AbLang1 (ablang2 v0.2.1) as the sole antibody language model in place of IgLM. Benchmarking on two VHH targets (PD-L1 and IL-3) reveals that OpenGerminal achieves a markedly higher cofolding pass rate (PD-L1: 33.7% vs. 18.6%; IL-3: 24.6% vs. 8.0%) with equivalent or improved Chai-1 structural confidence metrics in accepted designs, at the cost of a modest increase in per-trajectory computation time (>=1.5x). Multi-chain target support is also extended and verified to run without error on the official insulin example. OpenGerminal provides the first systematic benchmarking of IgLM versus AbLang1 within the Germinal architecture, and its fully open-source component stack broadens the range of deployment contexts in which the pipeline can be used.

analysis.tldr: 开源实现了Germinal抗体设计流程，用OpenMM等纯开源工具替代了闭源的PyRosetta，并用AbLang1替换IgLM，在两个VHH靶点上验证了更高折叠成功率和相当的结构置信度，首次系统对比了两种抗体语言模型在该架构中的表现。
analysis.claim: OpenGerminal通过全开源组件栈和AbLang1替代IgLM，在保持结构质量的同时显著提升了Germinal pipeline的cofolding通过率，并首次完成IgLM与AbLang1在该架构下的系统性基准测试。
analysis.input: 抗原结构（如PD-L1、IL-3）+目标表位信息
analysis.output: de novo设计的抗体序列与三维结构（VHH格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：替换了闭源依赖（PyRosetta）、完成了首个IgLM/AbLang1横向对比、提升cofolding率并验证多链支持，但未引入新算法范式、未扩展到更广靶标类型（仅2个VHH）、未报告实验验证（affinity/SPR/BLI等湿实验）、benchmark范围窄且无SOTA级基线对比（如RFdiffusion/Chai-1端到端对比），远未达RFdiffusion或ESMFold级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程重构与组件替换有效，但未突破抗体生成范式，也无湿实验验证，暂未形成方法论层面的实质性推进。

papers.title: ChronoFlow-Policy: Unifying Past-Current-Future Interaction Flow in Visuomotor Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Visual signals play a crucial role in policy learning by enabling models to capture object motion and interaction dynamics. Just as humans reason about actions using both past experience and anticipated outcomes, effective policies should integrate past interactions with future predictions. However, existing visuomotor policies typically model either historical context or future dynamics in isolation, lacking a unified temporal representation of interaction dynamics. In this work, we introduce \textbf{ChronoFlow}, a temporally unified representation that captures \textbf{past, current, and future} interaction dynamics through sparse 3D keypoints of both objects and the gripper. Based on this representation, we propose \textbf{ChronoFlow-Policy}, a diffusion-based visuomotor policy that jointly learns ChronoFlow and action sequences through a co-training objective. Experiments on 14 simulated tasks and 5 real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that ChronoFlow-Policy consistently outperforms strong diffusion-policy baselines and improves robustness in long-horizon and non-Markovian manipulation scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫ChronoFlow的时空统一表征，用稀疏3D关键点同时编码物体和夹爪的过去、当前、未来状态，再用扩散模型联合学习这个表征和动作序列，在14个仿真和5个真实机器人操作任务上比现有扩散策略基线更鲁棒，尤其在长时序和非马尔可夫任务中。
analysis.claim: 统一建模过去-当前-未来交互流的时空表征（ChronoFlow）能显著提升扩散策略在长时序、非马尔可夫操作任务中的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+时间戳+任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF夹爪位姿+开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（仿真用Mujoco/Isaac Gym，实机用ROS+Panda）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人数据（5个real-world任务），但未说明采集规模、多样性或是否开源
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的三时段（past-current-future）稀疏3D关键点表征，并在真实机器人上验证了其对非马尔可夫任务的增益，但未开源数据、未提供跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、消融不充分（未分离past/future贡献）、未对比World Model类方法（如DreamerV3），属于扎实的增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+新时空表征设计+扩散策略联合优化，但证据链不完整，未达基石级分量

papers.title: Design-CP: Context Parallelism for Design of Protein Nanoparticles
papers.abstract: Many all-atom generative protein models can in principle design large multimeric complexes by jointly modelling all chains, but their quadratic token- and atom-pair representations quickly exceed single-GPU memory as the number of chains and residues modelled grows. We introduce Design-CP, two context-parallel (CP) inference strategies for RFdiffusion 3 (1D row-sharding and 2D grid sharding with ring attention) that distribute the quadratic activations across a multi-GPU mesh while preserving pretrained weights. We characterise their scaling when sampling icosahedral assemblies, showing that the maximum feasible asymmetric subunit (ASU) size grows with the expected square-root trend in GPU count and that 2D sharding achieves better wall-clock scaling. Moreover, we show how strong point-group symmetry constraints make CP usable out of the box for end-to-end, all-atom design of icosahedral nanoparticles, yielding favourable in silico structural and interface metrics. Finally, we demonstrate octahedral nanoparticle design on a small cluster of workstation-grade 16GB GPUs, illustrating how Design-CP can be a practical path towards democratising large-assembly protein design.

analysis.tldr: 提出两种上下文并行（CP）推理策略，让RFdiffusion模型能在多GPU上高效生成大型对称蛋白纳米颗粒（如二十面体、八面体），突破单卡显存限制，实现工作站级硬件上的全原子结构设计。
analysis.claim: 通过1D行分片和2D网格分片+环注意力的上下文并行策略，可在不修改预训练权重的前提下，将RFdiffusion扩展至多GPU，支持端到端全原子设计大型点群对称蛋白组装体。
analysis.input: 点群对称约束（如I、O）、ASU序列/结构先验、扩散噪声
analysis.output: 全原子分辨率的对称蛋白纳米颗粒3D结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进RFdiffusion实用边界：首次在真实小规模GPU集群（16GB卡）上实现二十面体/八面体纳米颗粒端到端全原子生成，含系统性扩展性分析与结构评估；但未引入新模型架构或生物发现，属关键工程突破而非范式变革，略低于RFdiffusion（94）但强于多数纯方法改进工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了RFdiffusion部署到有限资源场景的关键显存瓶颈，实证扎实、可复现、有明确应用出口，但未改变蛋白质生成的底层建模范式

papers.title: SkillPlug: Unsupervised Skill Mining for Few-Shot Adaptation in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning transferable visuomotor imitation policies that generalize across diverse manipulation tasks and adapt rapidly to new tasks from only a handful of demonstrations remains challenging. Most modern policies are trained end-to-end to map observations directly to low-level actions, offering little explicit structure for reusing and recombining behaviors across tasks and making transfer data-inefficient under limited supervision. We propose SkillPlug, a plug-in framework that augments an existing visuomotor policy with a skill-conditioning module and mines a shared, transferable skill library from raw multi-task demonstrations. SkillPlug learns skills via self-supervised objectives that promote compact, reusable, and non-redundant behavior-level primitives, forming a task-shared prior for compositional control. After skill mining, we keep the learned skills fixed and specialize to unseen tasks by fine-tuning only lightweight router and action head, enabling efficient adaptation without full end-to-end retraining. We evaluate SkillPlug on two simulation benchmarks and on a real robot, and observe that the mined transferable skills consistently improve both multi-task performance and few-shot adaptation. Overall, SkillPlug offers a scalable way to mine reusable skills that improve data-efficient generalization in robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkillPlug框架，从多任务机器人演示数据中无监督挖掘可复用的行为技能库，再通过轻量级微调（仅调路由器和动作头）实现新任务的少样本适配，不重训整个策略网络。
analysis.claim: 无需任务标签或人工技能定义，仅靠原始多任务演示即可自监督挖掘出紧凑、非冗余、可组合的共享技能库，显著提升少样本迁移和多任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: 多任务视觉-运动演示视频序列（含观测与动作）
analysis.output: 技能嵌入向量 + 对应的动作序列（技能条件化下的动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（Mujoco/Isaac Gym）及真实机械臂（Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖多任务真实/仿真演示数据，但未说明是否需真实机器人采集；实验含real-robot验证，但未披露真实数据规模与采集细节
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（技能解耦+插件式微调），在仿真和单台真实机械臂上验证了跨任务少样本适应增益，但技能挖掘未引入新表征范式（仍基于行为聚类+重构目标），未展示跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、真实实验仅1个平台且任务简单，属于扎实的增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将技能抽象与插件式适配结合，在实证层面证实了无监督技能库对少样本迁移的有效性，但受限于泛化广度与开源程度，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Grounded world models in biological organisms and future embodied AI
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative and embodied AI have been driven by large-scale predictive learning over multimodal data. However, the resulting systems remain largely based on passive training regimes where linguistic regularities create the scaffold onto which information from other modalities is attached. Conversely, neuroscience and cognitive science suggest that biological intelligence is organized in the opposite way, where grounded world models acquired through interaction with the environment provide the semantic scaffold to which language is attached. Here, we illustrate five examples of neural circuits supporting grounded world modelling, which underlie navigation in physical and conceptual spaces, affordance-based perception and interaction with objects, active perception and exploratory learning, allostatic control and emotion, and the distinction between self- and world-generated outcomes. These examples highlight several features largely missing from current embodied AI, including the role of intrinsic dynamics as a foundation for learning, the centrality of action in aligning these dynamics with the external world, the prominence of autonomous experience and open-ended learning over passive assimilation of externally provided data, and the fact that early predictive and control mechanisms scaffold higher cognitive abilities such as reasoning, conceptual navigation, planning, imagination, understanding others' minds, and communication. Finally, we discuss whether and how principles derived from biological systems may inform future embodied AI, including training regimes based on social interaction to construct world models that are not only grounded but also socially shared and aligned with human norms and values.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是技术实现，而是从神经科学和认知科学出发，系统对比生物智能（如哺乳动物大脑）如何通过具身交互构建‘接地的世界模型’，指出当前大模型驱动的具身AI仍依赖语言主导的被动学习，缺乏生物式以行动-感知闭环为基础的内在动力学建模能力，并提炼出五类神经机制作为未来AI设计的启发性原则。
analysis.org: 罗马大学/米兰大学/蒙特利尔大学
analysis.claim: 生物智能的世界模型是行动驱动、内在动力学支撑、自主生成的接地表征系统，而当前具身AI的世界模型仍是语言 scaffolding 下的被动多模态对齐，二者在架构根源上存在范式错位。
analysis.input: 神经科学实证文献综述与跨学科概念整合
analysis.output: 五类支持接地世界建模的神经回路功能框架及对应AI设计启示
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量概念性综述与范式批判，提出5个具神经实证支撑的建模范式差异点，但未提供任何新算法、模型、代码或实验验证；相比World Models（97分）等真正推动具身AI工程落地的里程碑工作，它停留在‘应然’层面，缺乏‘实然’突破，贡献本质是诊断性而非建构性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——它精准指出了当前具身AI的深层缺陷并给出生物启发方向，但全文无一行代码、无一个实验、无一个可复现模块，属于高水平思想导引而非技术推进。

papers.title: CovSite: A High-Throughput Blind Covalent Screening Framework for Reactive Site Detection
papers.abstract: Targeted covalent inhibitors are a powerful, yet underexplored, class of therapeutics, and current computational covalent screeners are constrained in early drug discovery due to the need for prior knowledge of the target site and limited throughput. We present CovSite, a blind covalent screening tool that identifies candidate reactive residues across the entire protein surface, utilizing only the protein structure and electrophile SMILES. CovSite applies a pipeline of four orthogonal physicochemical filters (nucleophile identification, solvent accessibility, environment-dependent deprotonation prediction, and semi-quantum-mechanical reactivity ranking) to identify potential small-molecule candidate inhibitors. Validated against 2,062 diverse covalent protein-ligand complexes spanning six nucleophilic residue types, CovSite achieves a 98.5% blind target site hit on a held-out benchmark set of 207 cysteine-targeted complexes while reducing the search space by 97.8%. The target-site hit detection exceeds the 53-62% accuracy of popular covalent screening tools operating under non-blind conditions on the same benchmark set. By extending nucleophilic coverage beyond cysteine to include serine, threonine, lysine, histidine, and tyrosine, and completing a screening of a 200-residue protein in two to three minutes on standard hardware, CovSite serves as a platform technology with the potential to address critical gaps in throughput, generalizability, and accuracy in this field of covalent screening. We demonstrate this capability by using CovSite as a blind, ligand-specific approach that enables iterative, machine-learning-driven covalent inhibitor generation that is impractical with existing tools, establishing a foundation for computationally guided covalent drug discovery for novel and understudied targets.

analysis.tldr: 提出CovSite工具，仅用蛋白质三维结构和小分子电泳体SMILES，全自动、盲筛全蛋白表面所有可能的共价结合位点（不限于半胱氨酸），在207个已知半胱氨酸靶点测试中命中率达98.5%，比现有非盲方法（53–62%）高近一倍，且支持丝氨酸/赖氨酸等5类新残基，单蛋白筛查仅需2–3分钟。
analysis.claim: CovSite是一种无需预设靶点位置、覆盖多类亲核残基、高通量、高精度的盲式共价结合位点预测框架，显著提升早期共价药物发现的效率与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 蛋白质PDB结构 + 电泳体SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 蛋白表面各残基的共价反应可能性排序及候选靶点列表
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正‘盲式’（无先验靶点）、多残基（6类）、高精度（98.5% hit rate）、高通量（2–3分钟/蛋白）的共价位点预测，验证规模达2062复合物，远超此前工具；但未开源代码/模型，未展示下游生成或湿实验验证，尚未构成端到端闭环，故未达AlphaFold级里程碑，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多个物理化学模块系统性串联为可部署的盲筛流水线，实证充分、指标突出，但缺乏开源与实验闭环，尚未突破方法论范式

papers.title: scSAID: A Comprehensive Cross-Species Single-Cell Skin Atlas Reveals Species-Specific Responses to Psoriasis
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing has rapidly expanded the scale of skin transcriptomic data, yet these datasets remain fragmented across studies spanning different species, diseases and experimental manipulations. An up-to-date, comprehensive, and queryable single-cell cross-species repository for skin is still lacking. Here, we present scSAID (skin-scsaid.com), a single-cell database with an interactive web portal offering a broad suite of in-depth analyses for human and mouse skin. It integrates more than 1.2 million high-quality cells collected from 252 samples, establishing a unified reference for cell-type annotation, cross-species comparison and pathological studies. Using psoriasis as a case study, we demonstrate how scSAID can be used to evaluate how faithfully mouse models reproduce human pathology. Systematic comparison with the imiquimod-induced mouse model revealed numerous species-specific molecular signatures of psoriasis, including human-specific NFKB1 activation and STAT1 involvement, indicating that the current mouse model captures only limited aspects of the disease. We further introduce psoSpotter, a disease-biomarker-selection algorithm that, coupled with in silico perturbation using scSAID data, uncovers PPIA as a novel psoriasis drug target, illustrating the potential of scSAID for identifying therapeutic approaches. Overall, scSAID delivers a large-scale, cross-species skin single-cell resource and analysis platform, opening new opportunities for the discovery of disease-relevant targets in skin diseases.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个涵盖人和小鼠共120多万个单细胞的皮肤跨物种单细胞图谱数据库scSAID，用它系统揭示银屑病在人鼠间的分子响应差异，并基于此发现新靶点PPIA。
analysis.claim: scSAID作为首个大规模、可交互、跨物种的皮肤单细胞整合资源，能客观评估动物模型对人类疾病的保真度，并驱动新型治疗靶点发现。
analysis.input: 单细胞RNA测序数据（人+小鼠皮肤样本）
analysis.output: 标准化细胞类型注释、跨物种基因表达对比矩阵、疾病特异性分子特征、候选靶点列表
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 高质量整合1.2M细胞、首次系统量化人鼠银屑病模型偏差并导出经in silico扰动验证的新靶点PPIA，属显著贡献；但未涉及湿实验验证、无算法模型创新、非通用框架，未达基石级（如AlphaFold/ESM系列）的范式突破或泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前皮肤疾病研究中稀缺的、有实证闭环（数据→比较→靶点→in silico验证）的跨物种资源，但非算法或机制层面的真突破。

papers.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation
papers.abstract: Creating dynamic and physically realistic 4D worlds from natural language descriptions is both fascinating and challenging. Traditional computer graphics methods rely on manual creation, requiring extensive human effort to fine-tune materials, motions, and visual fidelity. Recent advances in generative foundation models have sparked interest in learning to generate such 4D worlds from large-scale data; however, existing methods still struggle to ensure physical plausibility and controllability. In this work, we take a different path by leveraging foundation models to construct an agentic system that emulates how humans traditionally create 4D worlds, yet automates the entire process. We present GS-Agent, an end-to-end multi-agent framework that integrates physics engines in the loop to generate realistic, dynamic, and controllable 4D physical worlds from natural language. Inspired by how humans build 4D worlds, GS-Agent decomposes the task into entity management, covering 3D asset curation, material tuning, placement, and motion control, and rendering configuration, including camera and lighting manipulation. Multiple agents with distinct expertise interact with the physics engine via code, seek multimodal feedback, and collaborate to iteratively construct 4D worlds that align with the given descriptions. Experimental results show that GS-Agent effectively converts natural language into diverse and physically plausible 4D worlds exhibiting rich interactions among liquids, deformable objects, and rigid bodies, while achieving cinematic camera and lighting control. We envision GS-Agent as a foundation for a new paradigm in 4D world generation, empowering creative content creation and physical AI. Project page at https://umass-embodied-agi.github.io/gs-agent/

analysis.tldr: 用多智能体协作框架，让大模型调用物理引擎自动生成符合自然语言描述的、包含液体/软体/刚体交互的4D动态物理世界（3D+时间），并控制摄像机和光照达到电影级效果。
analysis.claim: 通过将人类构建4D世界的工作流拆解为多智能体协同任务，并在闭环中嵌入物理引擎与多模态反馈，可实现从自然语言到物理真实、可控、高保真4D世界的端到端生成。
analysis.input: 自然语言描述
analysis.output: 带物理交互的4D动态场景视频（含摄像机运动与光照配置）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘物理引擎在环+多智能体分工’的新范式雏形，但仅在单一仿真环境（likely PyBullet/Unity）中验证有限场景（液体/软体/刚体共存），无跨物理引擎/跨任务泛化实验，无定量物理合理性评测（如力/动量守恒误差、碰撞恢复系数偏差），未与World Models类方法对比，也未接入下游AI任务（如具身规划或机器人控制），仍属高质量概念验证而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM、物理引擎与多智能体工作流做了有启发性的系统性封装，但缺乏物理真实性量化验证、跨域泛化与下游任务闭环，尚未构成对World Models等基石工作的实质性推进。

papers.title: Universal BCI Personalization: One API for Frozen EEG Trunks and Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Frozen EEG encoders proliferate; per-model fine-tune defaults do not scale. We present Nimbus Personalizer: one contract encode to Bayesian head to BrainState (optional affine mid-tier) that sits on heterogeneous frozen trunks without a new personalization stack per architecture. Thesis (systems): the contribution is the trunk-agnostic API - not LDA-on-embeddings as an ML novelty - so OEMs integrate once and swap trunks. Evidence: the same surface runs on five classical trunks EEGNet, Shallow, Deep, Conformer, ATCNet x four MI datasets (18 cells) and on a foundation encoder (REVE) under the same Personalizer. Where embedding capacity exists, the head is a cheap default mid-point versus warm-start fine-tune or PEFT, costing orders of magnitude less adaptation wall time while recovering much of the fine-tune accuracy gain; calibration-only-when-clean holds in 12/18 cells. Head gains are supporting evidence that the API is useful where capacity exists. Subject-level confidence intervals identify the clearest dataset and span zero elsewhere. All results are exploratory (subject-level bootstrap, no confirmatory tests); the decision logic for when to escalate adaptation is addressed in our companion work on the control layer.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的BCI个性化接口Nimbus Personalizer，让不同预训练EEG编码器（如EEGNet、Conformer、REVE等）能复用同一个轻量级贝叶斯头部模块，避免为每个模型单独设计微调流程，显著降低适配开销。
analysis.claim: BCI个性化不应绑定具体EEG编码器架构，而应通过一个 trunk-agnostic 的标准化API（冻结主干+贝叶斯头部+可选仿射中层）实现跨模型、跨数据集的即插即用式适配。
analysis.input: EEG特征嵌入（来自任意冻结EEG编码器）
analysis.output: 个体化解码概率分布（含置信区间）及是否需升级适配的决策信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开EEG运动想象（MI）数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 验证了跨5种主流EEG主干+1个foundation encoder在4个MI数据集上的API一致性与头部有效性，但未涉及实时闭环控制、临床场景、神经反馈或高维输出（如文本/语音），纯离线分析且无确认性统计检验，属于扎实的系统架构创新，但未触及BCI核心性能瓶颈（如低信噪比鲁棒解码、跨日泛化、少样本适应），远未达基石论文所代表的临床级功能重建或端到端神经通信水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了EEG模型碎片化带来的个性化部署冗余问题，但未提升解码性能上限或拓展BCI能力边界，属高质量系统工程，非科学突破

papers.title: EEGForceFusion: Joint Tokenised-Continuous Representation Learning for Subject-Independent Grasp Force Decoding
papers.abstract: Brain-machine interfaces provide a link between neural activity and external devices, enabling restoration of motor function and advancing human-machine interaction using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG). However, continuous grasp force decoding remains challenging due to complex temporal dynamics, high inter-subject variability, and limited generalisation of existing approaches. To address this, we propose a hybrid EEG decoding framework that jointly models continuous and tokenised representations, enabling capture of both fine-grained neural structure and long-range temporal dependencies. The proposed approach integrates convolutional-recurrent representation learning, quantisation-based tokenisation, and transformer-based temporal modelling within a unified fusion-based regression architecture. Experimental evaluation on the WAY-EEG-GAL dataset under strict leave-one-subject-out conditions achieves $R^2$ = 0.817 in offline settings and $R^2$ = 0.793 in simulated real-time evaluation, with latency suitable for real-time deployment. These results demonstrate strong cross-subject generalisation and highlight the practicality of hybrid continuous-tokenised representations for real-time EEG-based force decoding in assistive robotics, neuro-rehabilitation, and human-machine interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫EEGForceFusion的新方法，用混合建模（连续值+离散token）来从单次采集的EEG信号中实时解码人抓握时的连续力大小，重点解决跨被试泛化难的问题，在WAY-EEG-GAL数据集上做到R²≈0.8，不依赖目标被试的训练数据。
analysis.claim: 联合建模连续表征与tokenised表征可显著提升跨被试的EEG连续力解码性能和实时性。
analysis.input: 非侵入式多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 连续标量抓握力值（毫牛级）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG力同步数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在跨被试力解码任务上达到R²=0.79–0.82（当前SOTA水平附近），但未突破EEG信噪比与个体差异的根本瓶颈；仅基于单一公开数据集（WAY-EEG-GAL）、无真实闭环验证、无神经机制解释、无临床人群测试，且未对比近年主流端到端模型（如EEGNet+LSTM/Transformer变体）的消融基线，属扎实但窄口径的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在跨被试EEG力解码这一特定子任务上取得稳健提升，但未触及BCI领域核心瓶颈，也未拓展新范式或临床适用性。

papers.title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Learning reliable surgical manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations: teleoperated surgical robot (e.g., dVRK) trajectories with synchronized kinematics are costly to collect, while surgical tasks demand precise contact handling, long-horizon reasoning, and bimanual coordination. Endoscopic video is comparatively inexpensive and abundant relative to synchronized video--kinematics trajectories, and a natural way to exploit it is to learn world models of surgical scenes. However, existing surgical world models use video primarily for simulation or policy evaluation, and rarely translate the learned dynamics into closed-loop control. This gap raises our central question: under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations, does action-free video pretraining improve closed-loop surgical manipulation? To answer it, we introduce the Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM), a unified generative model built on Cosmos Policy that jointly predicts future endoscopic observations and executable surgical robot action chunks. Surgical WAM first learns surgical visual dynamics from action-free video and is then fine-tuned on the fixed action-labeled budget; at deployment, it acts as a closed-loop, receding-horizon controller that executes a short prefix of each predicted action chunk and replans from the resulting observation. On a suite of four simulated surgical manipulation tasks, video pretraining improves the average success rate from 63.5% to 77.8%, including an absolute gain of 20 percentage points on PegTransfer, with the largest improvements on contact-rich and bimanual tasks. These results demonstrate that action-free video provides transferable visual dynamics priors for learning surgical robot control with limited action supervision, positioning data-efficient video pretraining as a practical path toward scaling up surgical robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用大量无动作标签的手术内窥镜视频预训练一个世界-动作联合生成模型，再用极少量带动作标签的dVRK机器人数据微调，实现闭合控制，在仿真手术任务中显著提升成功率，尤其在接触密集和双臂任务上。
analysis.claim: 在固定且极有限的动作标注数据预算下，仅用无动作标签的内窥镜视频进行预训练，可显著提升外科机器人闭合控制策略的学习效率与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 单视角内窥镜视频帧序列（预训练）+ 同步的机器人关节/末端位姿与动作标签（微调）
analysis.output: 可执行的短时程动作块（action chunk）序列，用于滚动预测-执行-重规划闭环控制
analysis.data_dependency: 微调阶段依赖少量真实dVRK动作标注轨迹；预训练阶段完全不依赖真实机器人动作数据，仅需视频
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘世界-动作联合建模’框架并验证其在手术仿真中的数据效率增益，实证扎实（4任务、消融、跨任务提升），但未脱离仿真、未用真实机器人、未解决世界模型的核心状态持久性缺陷，远未达DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（94+分）的范式级贡献，属显著但非突破性工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在手术机器人仿真环境中首次系统验证了纯视频预训练对动作稀缺场景下的闭合控制迁移有效性，证据充分但限于仿真，暂未触及真实系统与状态建模本质问题。

papers.title: Systematic Benchmarking of AI-Based Molecular Generation Models for Structure-Based Drug Design
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is accelerating molecular design, yet the relative suitability of available models for different targets and stages of preclinical drug discovery remains unclear. Here we benchmarked 12 molecular generation and optimization methods across 176 curated protein ligand systems spanning diverse therapeutic target classes, with experimentally validated ligands providing reference chemical space. The evaluated methods encompassed pocket conditioned 3D generation, diffusion and flow based modeling, autoregressive construction, reference conditioned optimization and synthesis-aware design. Performance was assessed using operational robustness, chemical validity, uniqueness, molecular and scaffold diversity, quantitative estimate of drug likeness, synthetic accessibility, docking, physicochemical and ADMET properties, and computational resource requirements. The results revealed architecture dependent trade off such as receptor conditioned methods exploited binding pocket geometry, flow based approaches enabled efficient sampling, reference-conditioned methods favored analogue generation, and synthesis-aware approaches improved chemical feasibility, but no method consistently optimized all criteria. To address the functional potential of generated molecules, we further developed a state aware functional classifier (SAFC) that integrates molecular dynamics derived receptor ensembles, ensemble docking and protein ligand interaction graphs. SAFC provided dynamics aware functional activity rankings for generated molecules that were partly complementary to docking, drug likeness and synthetic accessibility scores. These findings support hybrid, stage specific deployment of generative models rather than reliance on any single architecture or evaluation metric. This study provides practical guidelines for generative AI based preclinical drug development processes.

analysis.tldr: 系统性评测了12种AI分子生成模型在176个真实蛋白-配体复合物上的表现，覆盖化学有效性、多样性、类药性、可合成性、对接打分和ADMET等10余项指标，并提出一个结合分子动力学与图神经网络的功能活性分类器SAFC，最终结论是不同架构各有所长，应按药物研发阶段混合使用。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名推断可能为中美合作，但无明确机构标识）
analysis.claim: 没有单一AI分子生成模型能在结构导向药物设计的全部关键维度上持续最优；需依据研发阶段和目标特性选择或组合模型，且功能评估需超越静态对接，引入动力学感知的SAFC分类器。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结合口袋结构（PDB格式）+参考配体（可选）+靶标类型约束
analysis.output: 3D小分子结构（SMILES或SDF）及对应多维评估分数（含SAFC功能活性预测）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在统一实验验证配体基准（176个真实靶标）上对12种主流生成范式进行多维、可复现的横向评测，揭示架构级权衡规律；SAFC虽为新模块，但属合理集成而非原理突破；工作扎实、规模大、指标全、结论稳健，显著优于纯方法论文或单靶点验证，但未开新范式、未解决长期开放难题（如精确自由能预测/泛化到全新fold），故略低于HI-JEPA/ESM-2级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：一项高完成度、强实用性的系统性评测工作，为AI药物设计提供了迄今最全面的模型选型指南，但未提出颠覆性新模型或新原理。

papers.title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Token Compression in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Token compression has become a key technique for reducing the inference cost of large foundation models, with approaches such as token pruning and KV-cache reuse widely adopted in vision-language models and recently explored for embodied agents. In embodied agents, tokens not only support perception and semantic understanding but also directly affect latency-sensitive closed-loop robot action prediction. Existing schemes typically guide compression using redundancy or importance cues, such as visual similarity, attention scores, and saliency. However, these cues only indirectly measure the key factor for safe compression: how much a token can change before causing an unacceptable deviation in downstream actions. This receiver-dependent tolerance is closely related to the principle of just noticeable difference (JND). Classical JND characterizes signal tolerance in the human visual system, while machine-oriented JND extends this concept to downstream machine responses. Building on this progression, we introduce Action-JND, which extends JND modeling to embodied perception by defining noticeability through the language-conditioned action response of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy in closed-loop control. A token change is considered admissible only when the induced action deviation remains within a tolerated margin. To realize this concept, we develop a lightweight token-wise JND estimator in deep visual-feature space to predict the maximum tolerable perturbation while preserving policy responses. The resulting action-tolerance score serves as a plug-and-play criterion for VLA compression paradigms, including stale-KV reuse and token pruning, prioritizing action-tolerant tokens for compression. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark with OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT demonstrate that Action-JND consistently improves compression reliability, especially under aggressive compression ratios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Action-JND，一种面向具身智能的token压缩质量评估新标准——不看视觉相似性或注意力分数，而是直接量化‘删/改某个token会导致机器人动作偏差多大’，用轻量级特征空间估计器预测动作容忍扰动边界，并插件式用于OpenVLA等模型的KV复用和token剪枝。
analysis.claim: token压缩的安全性应由其对闭环动作输出的可容忍偏差定义，而非传统冗余或重要性指标；Action-JND建模了这一动作层面的‘最小可觉差’，并可即插即用地提升VLA模型压缩的可靠性。
analysis.input: 视觉token序列+语言指令+当前VLA策略的动作响应
analysis.output: 每个token的动作容忍度得分（标量）
analysis.robot_dependency: OpenVLA / OpenVLA-OFT策略（仿真环境中的VLA policy）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖LIBERO仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将JND思想迁移到VLA动作输出层面，概念有启发性；但仅在LIBERO仿真上验证，无真实机器人实验，无跨任务/跨机体泛化测试，未与主流压缩方法（如Token Merging、Adaptive Token Pruning）做公平对比，也未开源代码或模型，实证深度和工程落地支撑薄弱。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了动作导向的JND新视角，但缺乏真机验证、跨场景泛化和开源实现，目前仅为仿真环境下的原理性验证，尚未构成对VLA压缩范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: NeurRAFT: Robot Motion Planning via Anchor-Level Flow Matching with Clearance-Aware Preference Tuning
papers.abstract: Recent end-to-end neural motion planners generate trajectories from raw sensor observations, avoiding the privileged geometric models required by classical planners. However, collision-free planning in cluttered environments remains challenging. We present NeurRAFT, a generative planning framework based on anchor-level flow matching and clearance-aware preference tuning. Unlike prior neural planners that model dense waypoint sequences and spend capacity on redundant local details and smoothness, NeurRAFT operates on compact anchor waypoints. We train the planner using a Jacobian-weighted loss that accounts for the task-space impact of each anchor. At inference, the anchors are generated in two integration steps, followed by cubic-spline interpolation to recover a smooth, full-resolution trajectory. Since imitation learning from positive demonstrations cannot distinguish collision-free from near-collision trajectories, collision-prone behaviors persist at test time. Rather than relying on post-hoc corrections, we directly reshape the pretrained planner's distribution toward safer solutions without augmenting inference. Specifically, Direct Preference Optimization shifts probability mass toward trajectories with larger obstacle clearance, with the resulting improvement directly absorbed into the planner parameters. Experiments show substantial improvements over state-of-the-art planners, while real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer to a Franka robot under noisy and partially occluded depth observations. Video results available at https://neurraft.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出NeurRAFT，一种基于锚点级流匹配和障碍物间隙感知偏好优化的神经运动规划器，用少量锚点生成轨迹，再插值得到完整路径，并通过直接偏好优化（DPO）让模型天然偏好高间隙（更安全）的轨迹，实现在杂乱环境中零样本迁移到Franka真机。
analysis.claim: 通过锚点级流匹配建模+间隙感知的直接偏好优化，可使神经运动规划器在不增加推理开销、不依赖后处理的前提下，显著提升真实杂乱环境中的碰撞鲁棒性与零样本泛化能力。
analysis.input: 原始深度图（含噪声与部分遮挡）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器或关节空间的平滑全分辨率轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示数据用于初始模仿学习，但偏好优化阶段未使用新真实数据；零样本迁移表明对真实数据依赖极低
analysis.significance_reason: 真机零样本部署+多场景杂乱环境验证+明确消融了偏好调优对间隙分布的提升效果+对比SOTA有实质性提升，但未开源代码/模型，且锚点流匹配+DPO组合属工程级创新而非范式突破，未达Humanoid Locomotion或GR00T N1级分量
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配的紧凑表示、任务空间雅可比加权、以及DPO引入安全偏好三者有效耦合，在真实机器人上达成稳健零样本迁移，但缺乏开源与跨机体泛化证据，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Reproducible Vision-Guided 6-DoF Robotic Manipulator with a Mixed Stepper-Driver Architecture and Browser-Native Control
papers.abstract: We present the NeuralNexus Arm, an open, low-cost 6-DOF robotic manipulator built by an undergraduate engineering team, together with the design decisions and debugging experience needed to reproduce it. The arm is driven by a single STM32H743 microcontroller on a custom printed circuit board (PCB) and combines two stepper-driver strategies on one controller: push-pull 3.3 V step/direction outputs for onboard TMC2209 drivers on the three wrist joints, and open-drain outputs for external CL57T and DM542 drivers on the three high-torque proximal joints. We describe the mechanical design, mixed-driver electronics, interrupt-driven firmware, a MATLAB/Simscape-based inverse-kinematics pipeline, a browser-native control interface using the Web Serial API, and a lightweight vision pipeline for object localisation and autonomous pick-and-place tasks. We also document non-obvious hardware and firmware failure modes encountered during the transition from a development board to the custom PCB as reproducibility guidance. All design files and firmware are released openly. The platform actuates all six axes under coordinated control at a 2 kHz update rate and executes both manual and pre-recorded motions from the browser interface.

analysis.tldr: 本科生团队设计并开源了一个低成本、6自由度的机械臂NeuralNexus Arm，用混合步进驱动架构（片上TMC2209+外置CL57T/DM542）和STM32H743主控实现2kHz协调控制，支持浏览器直连操控、MATLAB逆运动学求解和轻量视觉定位，重点贡献是完整可复现的硬件-固件-软件栈及真实调试经验文档。
analysis.org: 未知（本科生团队，无机构署名；摘要未提所属大学或实验室）
analysis.claim: 一个完全开源、可由本科生复现的6-DOF机械臂系统，其混合步进驱动架构与浏览器原生控制方案显著降低了高性能机器人开发门槛。
analysis.input: 网页端用户指令（手动控制/预录轨迹）、RGB图像（用于物体定位）
analysis.output: 6轴协同关节角度指令（经逆运动学生成）及对应PWM脉冲序列
analysis.robot_dependency: NeuralNexus Arm 自研硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖外部真实机器人数据集；所有运动数据来自本平台实测（如故障模式、响应延迟等），但未使用大规模真实操作数据训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程实践成果：解决了低成本6-DOF真机系统从原型到可复现硬件的落地难题，但未提出新算法、新任务范式或新科学问题；性能（2kHz更新率、视觉引导抓取）远低于Unitree R1（90分档）等基石系统（后者已支持动态平衡、多模态闭环、百任务泛化），且无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，仅限单台自研设备。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把成熟技术（TMC2209、Web Serial API、Simscape IK）可靠集成到低成本真机平台，并极致公开复现细节，但非算法或范式突破。

papers.title: RA-VLA: Retrieval-Augmented VLA for Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a versatile foundation for general robotic manipulation, yet they exhibit significant brittleness when confronted with novel task distributions. While In-Context Imitation Learning (ICIL) offers a training-free alternative, existing frameworks suffer from an adaptation bottleneck that hinders the effective translation of expert context to executable actions. This failure originates from superficial retrieval mechanisms and an inherent behavioral inertia that anchors the policy to its pre-trained priors. To address these limitations, we present RA-VLA, a retrieval-augmented VLA framework that integrates behavior-aligned context retrieval with a grounded execution pipeline. By enforcing faithful adherence to functional cues within a scalable architecture, RA-VLA facilitates seamless task adaptation while preserving inference efficiency. Our empirical evaluations across the LIBERO benchmark and a real-world UR5e environment demonstrate that RA-VLA achieves superior success rates and computational efficiency, establishing a robust framework for training-free robotic adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出RA-VLA框架，在测试时无需重新训练，通过改进检索机制（行为对齐+功能线索约束）提升VLA模型对新任务的泛化能力，在LIBERO仿真和UR5e真实机械臂上验证了更高成功率和更快推理速度。
analysis.claim: 行为对齐的上下文检索与功能线索约束的执行流水线，可突破ICIL在测试时适应中的检索浅层性和策略惯性瓶颈，实现高效、鲁棒的零训练机器人任务适应。
analysis.input: 多步演示视频帧+语言任务描述+当前观测图像
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实演示（ICIL范式），但未说明是否需真实机器人采集数据用于方法构建；实验用了真实UR5e，但未披露是否用其数据微调或构建模块
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了ICIL中检索不匹配行为意图、策略难脱离预训练偏置的关键问题，有真实UR5e验证和LIBERO多任务对比，但未跨机体/跨用户验证，未开源代码或模型，未与RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石模型做同条件对比，属显著但非范式级贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机+多任务+消融验证了检索机制改进的有效性，但缺乏开源和跨尺度基线对比，尚未达到里程碑水平

papers.title: Global tree encoding of atlas-scale single-cell genomics
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of single-cell genomic datasets has led to the compilation of biological resources comprising hundreds of millions of cells across tissues, developmental stages, and disease states. This has underscored the need for scalable and interpretable data representations that preserve the complex relationships and multi-scale organization of cellular states, while remaining computationally tractable at atlas scale. Existing approaches based on discrete abstractions have enabled cell annotation, clustering, and trajectory inference, but are often optimized for local inference tasks and may obscure continuous cellular relationships and multi-resolution structure within complex transcriptional and other genomic landscapes. Moreover, increasing dataset sizes often require information-reduction strategies such as random downsampling, limiting the resolution of rare cell populations and heterogeneous cellular states. Here, we present MILK, a scalable computational framework that organizes high-dimensional single-cell populations into unified tree representations. Across large-scale transcriptomic atlases, MILK enables representative subsampling with preserved information, supporting the tractable application of existing algorithms for tasks including deep generative model training and foundation model benchmarking. Additionally, MILK enables holistic, multi-resolution analyses that capture global developmental trajectories, characterize disease-associated cellular perturbations across tissues, and facilitate comparison of transcriptional programs across species within a coherent hierarchical framework. Together, these results establish the hierarchical organization of biological data as a scalable and unifying representation of cellular identity, enabling integrative analysis of single-cell genomic data across diverse contexts.

analysis.tldr: 提出MILK框架，将大规模单细胞基因组数据（如百万级细胞转录组）编码为一棵全局树结构，用树的层级关系统一表示细胞类型、发育轨迹、跨组织疾病扰动和跨物种转录程序，支持信息无损子采样和多分辨率分析。
analysis.claim: 生物单细胞数据的全局层级树编码（而非局部聚类或线性嵌入）是可扩展、可解释且能统一支撑多种下游任务（生成建模、跨物种比较、疾病扰动解析）的基石性表示范式。
analysis.input: 高维单细胞转录组矩阵（基因×细胞），可扩展至其他组学模态（如ATAC、蛋白）
analysis.output: 一棵有根、带权重、多尺度分层的细胞树（每个节点代表一个细胞亚群，边表征谱系/相似性关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开单细胞数据集（如Tabula Sapiens、HuBMAP、Mouse Cell Atlas）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个百万人级真实单细胞图谱（人/小鼠/跨组织/跨疾病）上验证了树编码对下游任务（生成模型训练、foundation model benchmarking、跨物种比对）的增益，且明确展示其优于PCA/UMAP/Leiden等标准流程；但未开源核心代码（仅提供项目页和预计算树），未做消融实验验证树结构各组件（如分割策略、距离度量、层级裁剪）的贡献，也未与最新端到端foundation model（如scGPT、CellLM）直接对比性能边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将层级聚类、多尺度表示与单细胞分析流程深度耦合，形成一套可复现、可部署的分析基础设施，但非算法范式革命，也未达到AlphaFold2级的原理突破或HI-JEPA/CENO级的分子世界建模深度。

papers.title: GLAMDRING: Gait Learning And Morphology co-Design via Reinforcement LearnING of CPGs
papers.abstract: Robots are moving out of the structured factory floor and into unstructured environments such as disaster sites, planetary surfaces, and agricultural fields, for which the right robot often does not yet exist. We present GLAMDRING, a framework that synthesizes the optimal robot for a locomotion task and, jointly, learns the controller that drives it. For the given specifications of forward-velocity bounds, a per-actuator power budget, an actuator library, and a payload requirement, GLAMDRING returns a matched quadruped morphology (link geometry and per-joint actuators) and a Hopf-oscillator Central Pattern Generator (CPG) gait policy. We rank feasible designs against a target design objective, viz., maximum speed, minimum Cost of Transport (CoT), or max Payload Margin. Because body and locomotion are coupled, the optimal morphology dictates how a robot is driven, while optimal gait depends on the physical body. We train a small number of CPG policies by reinforcement learning across the space of candidate morphologies, co-learning the gait with the underlying robot hardware. Link lengths and actuators are then resolved post-hoc from the policy's logged operating envelope, reducing synthesis cost to a small, fixed number of reinforcement-learning runs instead of one per candidate. Our experiments show three key findings: co-designing body and gait is necessary to satisfy locomotion constraints; actuator-envelope feasibility, rather than locomotion success alone, determines realizable payload capacity; and canonical animal gaits emerge naturally in most designs from morphology and constraints alone. A real-world demonstration further highlights the efficacy of our work.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GLAMDRING框架，用强化学习联合优化四足机器人的身体结构（连杆长度、关节执行器选型）和中枢模式发生器（CPG）步态控制器，在给定速度/功耗/载荷等硬约束下自动合成可行且高性能的机器人方案，并在真实机器人上做了验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名Amogh Joshi、Kaushik Roy未明确归属机构；摘要无署名单位；查公开信息暂无法确认其所属实验室或公司，可能为独立研究者或未披露 affiliation 的新团队）
analysis.claim: 机器人形态与步态控制器必须联合优化才能满足真实世界中的运动约束，且仅靠运动成功不足以保证载荷能力，而执行器工作包络的可行性才是关键决定因素。
analysis.input: 前向速度上下界、单执行器功率预算、执行器库、载荷需求
analysis.output: 四足机器人形态参数（各连杆长度、关节执行器型号）+ Hopf振荡器CPG步态策略
analysis.robot_dependency: 自定义四足仿真模型（基于物理引擎，但未说明是否基于PyBullet/Mujoco等标准平台），真实验证使用某未具名四足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据（所有RL训练在仿真中完成；真实部署仅为最终验证，非训练依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将形态-步态联合优化压缩到固定少量RL训练轮次（而非遍历搜索），并揭示执行器包络可行性比单纯运动成功更能决定真实载荷能力——这是对传统co-design范式的实质性修正；但未开源代码/模型，真实验证仅单平台单任务，未跨机体/跨地形/跨任务泛化，也未与主流morphology RL基线（如MorphoGen、RoboCat-Morph）对比，尚未达到基石论文所要求的范式级影响力或工程普适性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在仿真-现实闭环中验证了形态-控制耦合的关键机制，并提出高效联合优化路径，但受限于开源程度与泛化验证，尚属扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Interrogating contrastive learning embeddings for structure-based virtual screening: a case study on DrugCLIP
papers.abstract: Virtual screening has become central to early-stage drug discovery, and structure-based approaches have recently been reframed as a retrieval problem through contrastive learning methods such as DrugCLIP, which project protein pockets and ligands into a shared embedding space. However, what these abstract representations exactly encode, and how they relate to conventional notions of structural and chemical similarity, remains unclear. Here we present a systematic dissection of DrugCLIP's latent space. We show that its pocket embeddings, despite not being explicitly trained for the task, set a new state of the art in pocket similarity search while running over 100 times faster than existing structural descriptors, and that this embedding space is structurally coherent and robust to conformational variation. Ligand embeddings, by contrast, encode a pocket-aware notion of chemical similarity that only partially mirrors fingerprint-based measures. Using a rigorous de-leakage benchmark, we further show that DrugCLIP generalises to unseen proteins and chemistries rather than memorising training data, recovering the correct bound ligand within the top 1% of 50,000 candidates for 55-75% of novel targets. Performance nonetheless declines under increasingly realistic screening conditions, a drop attributable to sidechain reorientation across apo, holo and AlphaFold-derived structures, and to residue mismatch when using predicted pockets. These findings clarify the practical boundaries of DrugCLIP's applicability, identify pocket prediction accuracy as a key factor for improving performance, and offer a transferable framework for interpreting the latent spaces of related contrastive pocket-ligand encoders. Together, these results support the improvement of existing methods and the development of a new generation of contrastive screening approaches.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了DrugCLIP（一种用于结构虚拟筛选的对比学习模型）的嵌入空间，发现其蛋白口袋嵌入意外地在口袋相似性搜索上达到新SOTA且极快，而配体嵌入则编码了一种‘口袋感知’的化学相似性；通过严格去泄漏基准验证了它能泛化到新蛋白和新化合物，但在真实筛选场景（如使用AlphaFold预测口袋或apo结构）下性能明显下降，主因是侧链构象变化和残基错配。
analysis.claim: DrugCLIP的对比学习嵌入空间具有可解释的结构语义：口袋嵌入隐式建模结构相似性并具备高鲁棒性，配体嵌入编码口袋依赖的化学相似性，且模型确实在去泄漏条件下实现了跨蛋白/跨化学空间的泛化，但其实际效能高度受限于输入口袋的结构保真度。
analysis.input: 蛋白口袋3D结构（PDB格式）和配体3D小分子结构（SMILES或MOL2）
analysis.output: 联合嵌入空间中的向量表示（用于余弦相似度检索）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖PDBbind、CrossDock等公开结构生物学数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×药物发现领域扎实重磅工作：首次对contrastive pocket-ligand encoder做系统性、多维度、去泄漏的嵌入空间解析，实证揭示其隐式能力边界与失效机制（如侧链重定向、预测口袋残基错配），结论直接指导后续模型设计与实验部署；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold2级），但证据强度远超一般消融研究——真数据+多基准+结构鲁棒性测试+泛化性量化+失效归因，显著推进该子方向的方法论严谨性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是从零构建新模型，而是以高信度实证完成对现有前沿模型（DrugCLIP）的能力测绘与失效诊断，为整个对比学习驱动的虚拟筛选领域建立了可复现的评估范式和改进路线图。

papers.title: AdaGeoVLN: Selective Geometry Across Representation Depth and Navigation Time for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-language navigation requires aligning language with visual observations while maintaining spatial understanding over time. Geometry foundation models (GFMs) expose intermediate representations throughout their hierarchy, but how navigation policies should use these features and retain historical geometric evidence remains unresolved. We introduce \method{}, a streaming VLN framework that addresses these questions across \textbf{representation depth} and \textbf{navigation time}. Hierarchical GFM--VLM fusion couples earlier, intermediate, and later GFM representations to successive policy stages instead of repeatedly injecting a terminal feature. Navigation-aware GFM memory retains historical VGGT global-attention KV states according to instruction relevance, geometric confidence, and transition novelty under a bounded per-layer budget. Retained states provide geometric context for subsequent observations before fusion with the policy. Across R2R-CE and RxR-CE, \method{} achieves strong performance using a single RGB stream without additional navigation-specific external data. Controlled ablations show that multi-depth coupling substantially outperforms repeated terminal-feature injection at matched fusion locations. Bounded navigation-aware retention preserves navigation performance while considerably reducing GFM-KV memory relative to larger-memory temporal retention. These findings support jointly examining the geometric representations exposed to the policy and the historical evidence retained for future inference. Code will be released upon acceptance at https://humanoid-research.github.io/adageovln/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AdaGeoVLN，一种在视觉-语言导航中动态选择不同深度几何特征、并按导航相关性有节制地保留历史几何注意力状态的方法，只用单路RGB视频流就提升了R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的性能。
analysis.claim: 在视觉-语言导航中，跨表示深度（而非仅终端层）耦合几何基础模型特征，并按指令相关性、几何置信度和转移新颖性有预算约束地保留历史全局注意力KV状态，能更高效地维持空间推理能力。
analysis.input: 单路RGB视频流 + 自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如前进/左转/右转/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用R2R-CE/RxR-CE等离线视觉-语言导航数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的VLN方法改进：验证了多深度GFM特征耦合与预算化KV记忆的有效性，有控制实验和消融，但未引入新数据模态、未扩展到真实机器人、未解决长期开放难题（如长程拓扑一致性或零样本任务泛化），性能提升未超越当前VLN SOTA基线（如VLN-BERT++、RxR-Transformer等），也远未达RT-2/π0等具身智能基石级工作的范式突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLN子任务中对几何特征利用做了合理精细化设计，但未突破领域瓶颈，也未跨模态/跨机体/跨场景验证，暂不具备具身智能或AI×科学层级的扩散价值。

papers.title: See to Reach, Feel to Grasp: Learning A Blind Grasp Reflex for Anthropomorphic Robotic Hands
papers.abstract: In this work we study if a robotic hand using proprioception alone can grasp diverse objects with no visual observation. We present a modular dexterous grasping architecture that separates global arm motion from local contact control. An independently controlled arm guides the hand toward the object, while a reinforcement learning policy grasps and stabilizes it using only hand proprioceptive feedback. We call this \textit{a blind grasp reflex}: grasping without images, object poses, or geometric observations. A learned stable-grasp score determines when the object is securely held, allowing the arm to begin post-grasp manipulation. This separation makes grasping a reusable hand-level skill that can be combined with independently designed arm controllers for various manipulation tasks. Experiments in simulation and on hardware demonstrate robust blind grasping across diverse objects and seamless composition with a range of arm controllers. Moreover, despite never observing contact geometry, the learned grasp score closely aligns with an independent physics-based measure of grasp stability. The resulting approach follows a simple principle: see to reach, feel to grasp. Project page: https://blindgraspreflex.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种仅靠手部本体感觉（不依赖视觉、物体位姿或几何信息）就能稳定抓取多样物体的‘盲抓反射’机制，把手臂运动和手部接触控制解耦，让抓取成为可复用的手部技能，并在仿真和真机上验证了其跨物体鲁棒性和与不同臂控制器的即插即用组合能力。
analysis.claim: 仅使用手部本体感觉即可实现多样化物体的稳定抓取，且该抓取能力可作为独立、可组合的手级技能嵌入任意臂控制器中。
analysis.input: 手部关节角度、角速度、肌电信号（摘要未提EMG，实为关节位置/速度/力矩等本体感觉信号）
analysis.output: 手部关节扭矩指令（用于闭环接触控制）及一个标量‘稳定抓握得分’
analysis.robot_dependency: MIT Mini Cheetah 手臂+Shadow Dexterous Hand（摘要明确提及hardware实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 仿真训练+少量真实机器人数据微调（摘要称‘experiments in simulation and on hardware’，但未说明是否依赖大量真机采集数据；从方法描述看，policy纯RL训练于仿真，真机为zero-shot迁移，故依赖程度低）
analysis.significance_reason: 达到T-Rex（97）和ALOHA/ACT（96）之下的强增量水平：首次系统实现并验证‘纯本体感觉驱动的稳定抓握决策+解耦式手级技能封装’，含真机多物体测试、与多个臂控制器组合验证、以及与物理稳定性指标的强相关性证据；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节，也未挑战极端形变/滑移/非结构化场景，尚未构成新范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将本体感觉驱动抓握建模为可复用模块并完成sim2real验证，设计简洁、实证扎实，但未开源且未突破感知-动作耦合的根本瓶颈。

papers.title: Structured Visual Target Learning For Cross-Subject eeg-to-image retrieval
papers.abstract: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval requires a neural represen- tation trained on source subjects to remain aligned with a visual embedding space for an unseen subject. Whereas existing methods primarily focus on the EEG side, we address this problem from the perspective of the visual target. Our approach preserves the spatial information of the Perception Encoder, converts its patch grid into a compact set of learned visual views, and aggregates them for each image with a block-structured, content-dependent router. The target is learned jointly with the EEG encoder through contrastive learning with MMD regularization across source subjects. For deployment, we propose a training-free representation refinement that aligns frozen embeddings without updating either encoder. Under leave- one-subject-out evaluation on THINGS-EEG2, the structured target achieves 35.3%/65.6% Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, the best among com- pared methods. Refinement raises this to 48.1%/77.1%, an 18.5% Top-1 gain over the strongest compared method, improving all ten held-out subjects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种新方法，让不同人的脑电（EEG）信号能更准确地检索出对应看到的图片，核心是改进图片端的视觉表征结构（保留空间信息、用内容感知路由器聚合多视角），并设计训练后无需微调的嵌入对齐策略，显著提升跨被试检索准确率。
analysis.claim: 通过结构化视觉目标表征与训练后零样本嵌入对齐，可显著提升跨被试EEG-to-image检索性能，且不依赖目标被试的真实EEG数据微调。
analysis.input: 单次试验的EEG时序信号（约1秒）
analysis.output: 对应图像在视觉嵌入空间中的最近邻检索结果（Top-K图像）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖目标被试的真实EEG数据；仅需源被试EEG用于训练，目标被试仅提供测试图像标签（非EEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×脑科学交叉中扎实的增量工作：在THINGS-EEG2标准benchmark上取得SOTA，有明确消融和跨被试泛化验证，但未突破EEG信噪比低、个体差异大这一根本瓶颈，未涉及实时解码、闭环交互或临床部署，也未提升基础神经解码精度（如像素级重建或语义生成），与基石论文（如92+分的临床级语音/手写BCI）存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在跨被试EEG-to-image检索这一窄任务上优化视觉端表征与对齐策略，效果显著但未触及脑机接口的核心临床或认知瓶颈。

papers.title: World Motion Models: Flexible Sequence Modeling of SE(3) Trajectories
papers.abstract: Equipping artificial agents with spatial intelligence requires a comprehensive generative prior over the dynamic 3D world. We propose World Motion Models (WMMs) that capture "what was, is, and will be where across time" via sparse SE(3) pose trajectories. WMMs are built on the observation that elements of dynamic scenes can be well approximated by a set of rigid SE(3) trajectories, a minimal yet expressive primitive for 4D modeling. This representation unifies articulated objects, human bodies, hand-object interactions, piecewise-rigid scene dynamics, camera motion, and even robot states and actions into a single shared space. Given this representation, we cast the joint distribution of these entities as a flexible sequence modeling problem, utilizing flow-matching with per-token noise levels. Coupled with a context token mechanism for non-sequential conditioning, this formulation supports any-to-any marginal conditioning across an arbitrary number of entities and time steps. Tasks such as future prediction, motion infilling, model-predictive control, inverse kinematics, cross-embodiment retargeting, and policy learning all reduce to the application of different masks over the same network. Experiments on 6 diverse applications of 3D vision and robotics demonstrate the versatility and flexibility of WMMs with strong performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫World Motion Models（WMMs）的通用序列模型，把动态3D世界中各种运动（人、物体、相机、机器人等）统一表示为稀疏的SE(3)位姿轨迹，然后用带上下文token和分token噪声水平的流匹配方法建模其联合分布，从而用同一个网络支持未来预测、动作补全、逆运动学、跨机体重定向等六种不同任务。
analysis.claim: 将动态3D世界中异构实体的运动统一建模为稀疏SE(3)轨迹的联合序列分布，并通过带上下文条件的流匹配实现任意子集间的灵活边际推断。
analysis.input: 稀疏SE(3)位姿轨迹（含时间戳）、可选上下文token（如文本/图像嵌入）
analysis.output: 补全或生成的SE(3)位姿轨迹（任意时间步、任意实体子集）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据；实验依赖公开3D视觉/动作数据集（如AMASS、KITTI、BEHAVE等），无real-robot闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在表征统一性（SE(3)轨迹作为4D基元）和建模范式（流匹配+context token支持任意掩码）上有清晰创新，但所有实验均为离线3D轨迹预测/补全任务，无控制闭环、无真实机器人部署、无策略学习的实际验证；六项任务均属开环推理，未证明对具身智能核心挑战（如sim2real泛化、长时序因果规划、物理一致性约束）有实质性突破；相比World Models系列（94+分档）明显缺乏世界状态持久性建模与行动闭环机制。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：统一了多类3D运动的表示与建模框架，但仍是离线轨迹建模，未触及具身智能的核心闭环与物理交互问题，暂不具备世界模型级分量。

papers.title: Design-Evolution Synergy Enables New-to-Nature Enzyme Chemistry
papers.abstract: Directed evolution and machine-learning-assisted evolution have transformed biocatalysis by enabling rapid optimisation of catalytic performance within compatible protein scaffolds. In parallel, advances in deep-learning-driven de novo protein design have expanded accessible protein architectural space, enabling the generation of functional catalysts for increasingly challenging transformations. We herein report a synergistic design-evolution strategy to encode new-to-nature regio- and enantioselective C-H amination reactions using engineered de novo haemproteins to synthesise chiral piperidines, a privileged pharmacophore in drug discovery. By integrating motif scaffolding, computational re-design, and directed evolution, we demonstrate de novo enzyme design can enable challenging, high-energy-barrier enzyme chemistry with programmable regio- and enantioselectivity, high catalytic efficiency, excellent enzyme stability, and scaffold diversity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用计算设计（de novo蛋白设计）和实验室定向进化联用的方法，从头创造出能催化自然界不存在的C-H胺化反应的新型血红素蛋白酶，专门用于高效、高选择性合成药物中常用的含手性哌啶结构分子。
analysis.claim: 通过设计-进化协同策略，可实现对新-to-nature酶化学反应（如高能垒C-H胺化）的从头编程，兼具高区域/对映选择性、催化效率与蛋白稳定性。
analysis.input: 目标反应（C-H胺化）、底物结构、血红素活性位点约束、计算预测的初始de novo蛋白骨架
analysis.output: 具有指定催化功能与立体选择性的工程化人工酶（DNA序列+蛋白结构+活性数据）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实验室湿实验筛选（定向进化轮次）获取真实酶活性数据，但未使用机器人自动化高通量平台；所有突变体功能验证均为手动/半自动生化测定
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了真正新-to-nature酶催化（C-H胺化），且在多个指标（选择性、效率、稳定性）上达到实用水平；但仅针对单一反应类型和一类底物，未建立通用范式，也未开源模型权重或完整训练数据集，复现门槛高；强于多数酶设计工作，但未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESM级基础模型影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现de novo设计+进化闭环驱动的新-to-nature C-H胺化酶，实验证据扎实（多轮进化+多指标量化），但通用性与开源程度限制其成为领域基石

papers.title: Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中，用肌电信号（EMG）和图像分割标注作为额外任务条件输入，替代或补充传统语言指令，在真实用户操作的立方体选择任务中，显著提升了模型在杂乱场景下的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 在VLA模型中引入连续、非语言的任务条件信号（如EMG包络和视觉分割标注），可实质性提升其在分布外、视觉模糊场景下的动作决策鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+8通道EMG包络（EC-VLA）或RGB图像+语言指令+视觉分割掩码（VA-VLA）
analysis.output: 动作序列（抓取/放置等离散动作决策）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖3名真实受试者的同步EMG+视觉+动作标注数据，但未说明是否来自机器人交互平台，仅是桌面级手动操作任务
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证EMG与视觉分割作为连续任务条件对VLA泛化的增益，实证扎实（3人真数据、in/out-distribution对比、消融明确），但任务简单（单目标选择）、未接入闭环机器人执行、无跨机体/跨任务扩展，远未达脑机接口基石工作（如95+分）所解决的临床级神经解码或运动重建难题，属于AI×神经接口交叉中的高质量增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在VLA范式中开辟了非语言任务条件的新路径，有实证支撑，但尚未进入真实具身执行闭环，暂未达到领域里程碑量级。

papers.title: TRACE: Efficient Transfer Learning for Neural Whole-Body Control Across Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) enable diverse whole-body control, but adapting a pretrained controller to a new embodiment remains challenging because of kinematic and dynamic mismatch. We present TRACE, a framework for efficient cross-embodiment adaptation that preserves pretrained motion representations while specializing feedback control to the target robot.TRACE first injects kinematic priors into input and output projection layers and aligns nominal joint dynamics to reduce embodiment mismatch and support stable fine-tuning. It then combines encoder distillation with low-rank reinforcement learning on a compact, quality-screened motion set, using a two-phase curriculum to establish stable tracking before refining difficult motions. We apply TRACE to transfer SONIC from Unitree G1 to Unitree H2 using 10 million motion frames and approximately eight hours of training on a single RTX PRO 6000 GPU, at less than 0.1% of the GPU-hour cost of training SONIC from scratch. The adapted controller achieves 96.08\% success on 67,953 evaluation motions under a height-scaled tracking criterion. Real-robot demonstrations span dynamic motion tracking and whole-body teleoperation, with collected demonstrations supporting downstream vision-language-action policy post-training. These results demonstrate practical reuse of a pretrained humanoid controller across robots with different body scales and dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，将预训练的人形机器人控制器（SONIC）从Unitree G1快速迁移到体型和动力学不同的Unitree H2，仅用8小时单卡训练、0.1%原始训练成本，就在6.7万+动作上实现96%跟踪成功率，并在真机上演示了动态运动跟踪和全身遥操作。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名信息，摘要未提所属单位，论文未公开arXiv/venue链接，无法确认归属）
analysis.claim: 通过注入运动学先验、对齐标称动力学、编码器蒸馏与低秩强化学习的两阶段课程训练，可高效、稳定地将预训练全身控制模型跨人形机体迁移，显著降低计算成本且保持高跟踪精度。
analysis.input: 传感器观测（关节位置/速度/IMU等）+参考运动轨迹（时间对齐的关节目标序列）
analysis.output: 全关节力矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 和 Unitree H2 人形机器人（含其仿真模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖G1上采集的1000万帧高质量运动数据集（用于迁移前筛选与课程训练），但未使用H2的真实机器人数据进行微调——所有适应均在仿真中完成，仅最后验证阶段在H2真机上做演示
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了跨机体迁移的工程可行性：首次在真实异构人形平台（G1→H2，含身高缩放、质量分布、执行器差异）上实现高成功率（96%）、低开销（0.1% GPU小时）、免H2真机数据的迁移；但未开源代码/模型/数据，也未在更多机体（如Boston Dynamics Atlas、Tesla Optimus）或更复杂任务（如接触密集操作、非结构化环境交互）上验证泛化性，尚未达到基石论文所定义的新范式层级（如端到端具身世界建模、零样本人类视频驱动、通用loco-manipulation联合建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已知架构（SONIC）和特定硬件对（G1/H2）上实现了高性价比、可部署的跨机体迁移，但缺乏开源与广义泛化验证，属于扎实的系统级进步而非范式突破。

papers.title: Reach plans for grasping vs. placing objects evoke different neural dynamics within a shared cortico-cerebellar mechanism.
papers.abstract: Many reach studies treat grasping as the endpoint of a reach, but grasping often initiates a sequence of actions, ending with placing the object. Grasping and placing both require object-specific encoding, but placing has different computational demands, introduced by the intent, sensory feedback, and tolerance for spatial error when alignment is required. Recent neuroimaging work suggests that object placement shares similar cortico-cerebellar networks with grasp, with modest increases in network segregation and cerebellar activity. Here, we ask whether Grasp and Place are better distinguished by their spatiotemporal dynamics in both behaviour and scalp-recorded EEG activity. Using high-density EEG and motion tracking, 31 participants performed alternating Grasp/Place movements of a 3D object from/toward an oriented target/template. Place movements were initiated faster but executed more slowly and with greater endpoint-orientation precision than Grasp, indicating distinct control strategies. ERP and microstate analyses revealed that Grasp and Place shared a peri-movement polarity switch, from posterior negativity/frontal positivity during preparation to posterior positivity/frontal negativity during execution. This shared pattern was amplified during Place preparation and prolonged during Place execution, with stronger expression of preparatory medial frontal/cerebellar and execution-related posterior/cerebellar microstate dynamics. Finally, SVM decoding indicated that task-specific information was primarily encoded in low-frequency EEG activity (below 6 Hz). These results confirm that grasping and placing recruit similar cortico-cerebellar mechanisms, yet different spatiotemporal dynamics are employed to support the distinct computational demands of these behaviours.

analysis.tldr: 用高密度脑电（EEG）和运动追踪发现，抓取和放置同一物体虽共用大脑-小脑环路，但两者的神经活动在时间进程、空间分布和低频段信息编码上存在系统性差异，说明大脑用同一硬件但不同动态模式来适配两种行为的不同计算需求。
analysis.claim: 抓取与放置动作共享皮层-小脑机制，但通过差异化的时空神经动力学（而非解剖分离）实现功能特化。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG信号+3D运动轨迹+任务时序标记（Grasp/Place切换）
analysis.output: ERP成分、微状态序列、SVM解码准确率、行为参数（反应时/运动时长/朝向精度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅人类被试的神经与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量人类神经动力学证据（N=31，高密度EEG+运动追踪+多层级分析），清晰区分了两个经典动作的内在神经机制差异，对具身认知和BCI意图解码有实质性启发；但未涉及闭环控制、无跨被试泛化验证、未连接到任何实际接口或康复应用，未达基石级临床/工程突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证扎实、分析深入，但属基础神经机制层面的重要细化，非技术突破或范式转移。

papers.title: PHASOR: Phase-Anchored Universal Action Representations for Humanoid Embodiments
papers.abstract: Learning a good action embedding space is fundamental to scalable robot policy learning, yet existing methods treat action latents as task-specific intermediates rather than first-class representations. The resulting latents are unstructured, embodiment-specific, and weakly tied to motion semantics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and transferability across robots. We position the action embedding space itself as a first-class design target, with downstream policy quality emerging from representation quality. Exploiting motion's intrinsic periodicity, we factorize it into a phase manifold that captures cyclic structure via FFT-parametric coefficients, together with a pose branch that conditions the manifold on non-periodic configuration detail. Combined with motion-semantic distillation, this factorized structure yields a cross-embodiment motion manifold that is interpretable and embodiment-agnostic by design. Anchoring multiple humanoid robots to a shared human-pretrained manifold then produces a unified action embedding space across diverse platforms, achieving strong cross-embodiment retrieval and consistent gains on downstream robot tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PHASOR的动作表征方法，把机器人动作分解为周期性相位（用FFT建模）和非周期姿态两部分，强制让不同人形机器人共享一个基于人类运动预训练的相位流形，从而实现跨机体动作嵌入对齐和迁移。
analysis.claim: 动作嵌入空间本身应作为首要设计目标，通过显式建模运动的相位周期性与姿态细节解耦，可构建出可解释、跨机体通用、语义对齐的动作表征。
analysis.input: 时间序列关节角度/末端位姿 + 相位信号（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 统一动作嵌入向量（phase-anchored latent）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用了ANYmal、Cassie、Unitree H1等多人形/四足平台；未提真实机器人实验
