papers.title: HCPG-Flow:Hierarchical Contact-Progress Guidance for Flow-Policy Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Flow policies can represent multimodal action distributions for robot manipulation, yet a robot must execute one action at each control step. When several proposals are sampled, critic-based ranking makes data collection depend on value estimates over candidate actions that may be weakly represented in replay. We introduce HCPG-Flow, an analytic rollout-time selector that augments SAC-Flow with hierarchical, object-centric contact-progress guidance while preserving its actor and critic objectives. HCPG switches from end-effector approach to task progress after contact, scores each proposal by the first-order reduction of a task-relevant distance, standardizes scores within the candidate set, and executes a temperature-controlled action embedding. Across ten simulated tasks, HCPG improves mean success over SAC-Flow on both benchmarks, including a 9.5 percentage-point gain on Maniskill. Four physical tasks further show high success with a 17.4% reduction in successful completion steps.Project page: https://hitxraz.github.io/HCPG-Flow/

analysis.tldr: 提出HCPG-Flow，在SAC-Flow基础上增加分层接触-进展引导机制，让机器人在触碰到物体后自动切换判断依据（从接近目标变为任务进度），用一阶距离减少量打分并温度控制采样，提升仿真和真实机械臂操作的成功率与效率。
analysis.claim: 通过解析式 rollout-time 选择机制引入对象中心的分层接触-进展引导，可在不修改SAC-Flow actor/critic结构的前提下显著提升flow-policy在接触密集操作任务中的执行可靠性与效率。
analysis.input: 状态观测（含关节/末端位姿、物体位姿等）
analysis.output: 动作嵌入向量（经温度缩放后的flow-policy采样动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖仿真数据训练；物理实验阶段使用少量真实机器人交互数据调参，但未报告真实数据采集规模或闭环微调过程
analysis.significance_reason: 改进聚焦于flow-policy的采样后选择策略，属重要工程优化：仿真十任务+4个真机任务验证有效，成功率达提升且步数减少，但未引入新模型架构/新传感器/新学习范式；无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，未开源代码或模型，仅提供项目页；相比T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石工作（解决触觉反馈闭环、端到端双臂协同、扩散生成范式迁移等根本性挑战），它属于扎实但窄口径的策略层增强，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如多模态对齐、长程信用分配、零样本迁移）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在flow-policy框架内做了有实证支撑的 rollout-time 决策增强，但未突破范式、未开源、泛化弱，属于高质量增量改进而非概念或架构创新

papers.title: Using Deep Learning to predict replication timing reveals baseline control of genomic DNA sequence
papers.abstract: Human DNA replicates according to a precise schedule: certain regions are replicated early, while others replicate later in the cell cycle. The DNA sequence and the epigenome are both indicative for replication timing (RT), their relative contributions and potential complementarity yet remain unclear. Here, we utilize Repli-Seq data and machine learning to investigate these relationships in seven human cell lines. We show that GROVER (Genome Rules Obtained Via Extracted Representations), a DNA language model, trained purely on DNA sequence can be fine-tuned for RT, which indicates that information on DNA sequence is largely sufficient to predict RT. Integrating GROVER's sequence predictions as an additional feature with diverse epigenetic sequencing data, yields a multimodal model that outperforms approaches that use exclusively the DNA sequence or the epigenome, which demonstrates predictive synergy. By evaluating input feature contributions, we find that epigenetic features vary in their RT prediction contribution. Some epigenetic features see their contribution diminish in the presence of DNA sequence information, others remain predictive. GROVER's sequence representations emerge as the most dominant feature. Furthermore, to assess cell-type specificity of RT, we partitioned the genome into constitutive domains that replicate uniformly across cell lines and cell-type-specific domains that shift during differentiation. While DNA sequence features contribute more to constitutive predictions, they also remain informative within cell-type-specific regions. Together, our findings dissect the relationship between DNA sequence and the epigenome relative to RT and suggest that primary DNA sequence instructions exert a powerful baseline control over constitutive and cell-type-specific RT, fine-tuned by regulatory cues beyond the DNA sequence.

analysis.tldr: 用DNA语言模型GROVER仅靠DNA序列就能较好预测基因组复制时间，再结合表观遗传数据构建多模态模型，发现DNA序列本身已蕴含大量复制时序信息，是复制时间调控的‘基线控制者’，表观修饰则起微调作用。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Janakievski等为独立研究者或未公开 affiliations）
analysis.claim: DNA序列本身蕴含足够信息以建立复制时间的基线预测，表观遗传特征在此基础上提供增量但非主导的调控信号，二者存在预测协同而非替代关系。
analysis.input: DNA序列（k-mer/嵌入表示） + 表观遗传测序数据（如ChIP-seq、ATAC-seq、DNase-seq等）
analysis.output: 基因组片段级别的复制时间预测值（连续数值，对应Repli-Seq信号强度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于公共高通量测序数据（Repli-Seq及多种表观组学）
analysis.significance_reason: 在DNA序列与复制时序关系这一经典问题上，首次系统量化了纯序列模型（GROVER）的预测上限，并通过严谨的多细胞系、多模态消融实验揭示序列与表观的层级贡献——实证扎实、结论稳健；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold级结构预测革命），但属机制理解层面的重要推进，且工作可复现、结论具生物学解释力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是方法创新，而是用高质量AI工具对一个长期悬而未决的分子生物学问题给出了定量、可验证、具层级解释力的答案。

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Safety Margins for Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Robots in cluttered indoor spaces often fail not because they cannot generate collision-free paths, but because a fixed safety margin is mis-calibrated: conservative margins cause detours and timeouts, while permissive margins lead to near-boundary shortcuts under perception bias. Diffusion-based planners propose diverse trajectory candidates from egocentric RGB-D, yet reliable selection remains the bottleneck. We propose a context-conditioned safety critic that learns an adaptive clearance preference for ranking diffusion proposals, decomposed into three complementary terms: (i) a safety term with a clearance-budget penalty and a control-barrier-function residual for waypoint- and transition-wise safety, (ii) an efficiency term combining a smoothness penalty with a safety-gated detour-ratio penalty that avoids detours without incentivizing risky shortcuts, and (iii) a distance-constraint matching term that anchors the learned budget to realized ESDF clearances to prevent margin collapse. We train the critic with privileged ESDF geometry in simulation and distill it into a perception-only selector via a two-stage teacher-student procedure. On PointGoal navigation in HM3D and MP3D, including cross-dataset transfer, our method achieves the highest success rate (SR) and success weighted by path length (SPL) among strong diffusion, optimization, and RL baselines. Trained purely in simulation, it transfers to a Unitree G1 humanoid and navigates cluttered indoor scenes without task-specific tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个能根据场景上下文动态调整安全边距的视觉导航评判器，用扩散规划器生成多条路径后，通过学习到的自适应安全偏好对它们排序，从而在不依赖真实机器人数据的前提下，让纯仿真训练的模型成功迁移到Unitree G1人形机器人上完成室内避障导航。
analysis.claim: 固定安全边距是视觉导航失败的主因，而通过上下文感知的安全批评器学习自适应清空预算，可在无真实数据微调下实现sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+目标点坐标（PointGoal）
analysis.output: 对扩散生成的多条轨迹的排序得分（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真中privileged ESDF监督训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在HM3D/MP3D双基准上SOTA，跨数据集泛化，且真机部署到Unitree G1完成复杂室内导航；但未开新范式（仍是扩散+critic pipeline），也未解决底层感知偏差根源，属显著推进而非基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散规划与可解释的安全建模深度耦合，在强实证支撑下达成高鲁棒sim2real，但未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如闭环感知-动作耦合失配、长程语义-几何联合建模）

papers.title: AINN-Express: A Leakage-Aware, Sequence-Only Predictor of VHH Antibody Expression Built on the AINN-P1 Protein Foundation Model
papers.abstract: Expression — whether an antibody can be produced at usable yield — is one of the earliest and most expensive filters in therapeutic discovery. We present AINN-Express, a sequence-only predictor of VHH single-domain antibody (nanobody) expression built on AINN-P1, Ainnocence's protein foundation model. AINN-Express encodes a VHH with a frozen AINN-P1 encoder and scores it with a lightweight gradient-boosted classifier: it takes only an amino-acid sequence, returns an expression probability, and needs no structure and no per-task model training. Under a leakage-safe, leave-program-out evaluation, AINN-Express reaches ROC-AUC 0.87 within known antibody programs and 0.81 on entirely new programs — well above the majority baseline — making it a practical tool for prioritizing candidates before wet-lab work. We further justify the encoder choice with a controlled, leakage-aware benchmark against general-purpose protein language models: on this task, AINN-P1 (167 M parameters) generalizes to unseen programs far better than a general-purpose ESM2 (650 M) — 0.81 versus 0.68 new-program ROC-AUC — and matches a domain-finetuned ESM2 (0.83) with no task-specific finetuning, at roughly one-quarter of the parameters. The gap is invisible under a random split, where all encoders score approximately 0.88; only leave-program-out evaluation reveals that general-purpose embeddings largely encode program identity rather than transferable determinants of expression. Purpose-built representation quality, not parameter count, is what makes AINN-Express generalize.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了AINN-Express——一个仅用VHH纳米抗体氨基酸序列就能预测其在大肠杆菌中表达成功率的概率模型，基于专为抗体优化的蛋白基础模型AINN-P1，不依赖结构、无需微调、无数据泄露，在严格‘留项目出局’评估下对全新抗体项目仍保持0.81 ROC-AUC，显著优于通用大模型ESM2。
analysis.claim: 专为抗体设计的轻量级蛋白基础模型AINN-P1，其表征质量（而非参数量）决定了跨项目泛化能力，是构建高鲁棒性、低泄露表达预测器的关键。
analysis.input: VHH纳米抗体的氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 该序列在大肠杆菌中可量产表达的概率值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表的VHH表达实验数据集（未说明是否开源），无真实机器人/自动化实验平台耦合
analysis.significance_reason: 在抗体开发关键瓶颈（表达预测）上，首次系统揭示通用PLM（如ESM2）在leave-program-out设置下严重过拟合项目身份而非生物学决定因子，并用严谨消融+泄漏感知评估证实专用小模型AINN-P1的表征优越性；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属少有的、证据扎实的'领域基础模型价值实证研究'，且工具已具工业落地价值（无需微调、低计算开销、高跨项目AUC）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用泄漏感知评估范式击穿通用PLM幻觉，实证证明抗体专用表征的不可替代性，是AI×生物发现中罕见的‘方法论清醒型’贡献。

papers.title: Music-JEPA: Learning a World Model of Sound from Action
papers.abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) have recently emerged as a paradigm for learning world models by predicting latent representations, offering a promising direction for self-supervised learning. While initial attempts have applied JEPA to the music domain, it remains unclear how such frameworks can naturally support the formation of a world model for music. In this work, we propose to learn a world model of piano sound using JEPA by framing music as an action-conditioned system: the audio is treated as the state, and the pianoroll as the instrument action. Given a current audio state and an action, the model predicts the resulting future audio state, mirroring how humans learn musical sound through interaction. The model is trained in a fully offline setting using paired audio-pianoroll data, without environment interaction. Experiments show that the learned model captures the relationships between musical actions and their resulting sound. The resulting representations support downstream tasks, including beat tracking, composer identification, and key estimation, and enable piano transcription via planning, by searching for actions that best explain a target sound.

analysis.tldr: 用JEPA框架把钢琴演奏建模为‘动作（音符序列）→声音状态（音频）’的预测问题，仅靠离线配对数据训练出能反向规划（即给定一段音频，搜索最可能对应的音符序列）和支撑多个音乐理解下游任务的世界模型。
analysis.claim: 通过将音乐建模为动作-状态交互系统，JEPA可在纯离线音频-乐谱配对数据上学习具备因果结构与反向规划能力的音乐世界模型。
analysis.input: 当前音频片段（频谱或时域表示）+ 动作（钢琴卷帘/音符序列）
analysis.output: 预测的未来音频状态（潜变量表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/录制的配对音频-钢琴卷帘数据，无真实乐器交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽将JEPA首次系统迁移到音乐领域并展示反向规划能力，但未引入新架构、未验证跨乐器/跨风格泛化、无真实演奏闭环验证、下游任务指标未超越SOTA、且世界模型核心缺失持续状态记忆（如RNN/LSTM隐状态或memory-augmented latent core），实质是JEPA在新模态上的稳健复现，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把JEPA成功适配到音乐建模任务，展示了跨模态动作-状态建模的可行性，但未解决世界模型领域长期存在的状态持久性、具身闭环、跨分布泛化等核心挑战。

papers.title: Structured LLM Reasoning for Zero-Shot Human--Robot Coordination Under Hidden Goals
papers.abstract: We present a structured large-language-model (LLM) architecture for zero-shot human--robot coordination in a cooperative construction task with private goal views. Guided by a Dec-POMDP formulation, the architecture decomposes decision-making into (i) action-conditioned Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference, (ii) hierarchical planning, (iii) conversation interpretation, (iv) action verification, and (v) feedback-based replanning. We compare the proposed method with an ablation without ToM inference and a multi-agent reinforcement-learning policy trained offline over many goal pairs. In human-participant experiments, the proposed method required fewer interaction steps and yielded higher post-interaction trust ratings than both baselines. These results suggest that systematically decomposing the team decision problem, using LLMs as tractable surrogates for otherwise intractable inference and planning computations, and retaining conventional verification for physical feasibility can improve both task coordination and the human experience.

analysis.tldr: 用结构化LLM分解人类-机器人协作决策（含心智理论推断、分层规划、对话理解等模块），在隐藏目标的零样本搭积木任务中，比无心智理论的消融版和离线训练的多智能体强化学习方法更少交互步数、更高信任度。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣巴巴拉分校
analysis.claim: 将Dec-POMDP框架结构化拆解为可由LLM执行的子模块（尤其是ToM推断+验证式物理可行性检查），能在零样本下实现更高效、更可信的人机协作，无需真实机器人数据微调。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+当前环境观测（文本描述或结构化状态）+人类对话历史
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（离散操作，如‘拿红块’‘放左上角’）及协作策略解释
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用人类参与者交互实验（非机器人本体执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出Dec-POMDP驱动的LLM结构化分工框架，实证显示零样本下优于RL基线和ToM消融，在人类信任与交互效率上有可复现提升；但未部署于真实机器人、无视觉/动作控制闭环、未验证跨任务泛化，属扎实的机制创新而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但首次将Dec-POMDP严格解构为LLM可执行模块并验证其人因优势，是人机协作认知架构的重要工程整合。

papers.title: SAP-Nav: Spatial Semantic Representation Meets Active Perception for Hierarchical Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation
papers.abstract: Hierarchical open-vocabulary object navigation (OVON) requires agents to follow free-form instructions that may specify targets through scene-, room-, region-, and instance-level cues in unseen environments. Although recent work LangMap has formalized this setting, reliably solving it under partial observations remains challenging: spatial grounding requires persistent environment-level evidence, whereas target verification requires clear and discriminative candidate views. We present SAP-Nav, a fully online, zero-shot framework that addresses both requirements through active perception. SAP-Nav incrementally constructs a Queryable Spatial-Semantic Representation from actively acquired room views, enabling spatial semantic queries from any explored location. It further employs Active Viewpoint Verification to assess whether the current observation provides sufficient evidence and, when necessary, reposition the agent to a more informative viewpoint before verifying candidates against category and attribute constraints. Although designed for hierarchical OVON, SAP-Nav supports both hierarchical and standard category-level OVON without task-specific training or precomputed scene maps. Experiments on LangMap and HM3D-OVON show that SAP-Nav achieves the overall best performance, including a 12.2% improvement in SR over training-based methods on region-level navigation. Real-world robot experiments further demonstrate its practical feasibility. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 提出SAP-Nav框架，让机器人在没见过的环境中，根据自然语言指令（如‘去厨房里那个带蓝色把手的抽屉’）边走边看、边建空间语义地图边验证目标，全程不依赖预建地图、不微调模型、不需真实训练数据，纯靠在线主动感知完成多层级开放词汇导航。
analysis.claim: 通过可查询的空间语义表征与主动视角验证机制，可在零样本、全在线、无预建图条件下，可靠解决层次化开放词汇导航中空间定位与目标判别双重耦合难题。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 当前RGB观测 + 历史动作/位姿
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（移动+转向）及最终目标确认决策
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人平台（摘要末句提及real-world robot experiments，但未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人训练数据（明确声明zero-shot、fully online、no task-specific training）
analysis.significance_reason: 在LangMap/HM3D-OVON基准上实现区域级导航成功率+12.2%，且有真实机器人验证，证明了主动感知驱动的空间语义在线构建范式有效性；但未开源数据、未披露硬件细节、未跨机体泛化、未与RT-2/π0等VLA基座模型对比，属扎实的领域内显著推进，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+零样本+多层级开放导航性能突破，但缺乏基座模型集成、跨机体泛化和完整开源，尚未构成范式级突破。

papers.title: Off-Manifold Collapse in Guided Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Protein language models are widely used priors for protein sequence design, and a growing body of work controls them at inference time as an alternative to fine-tuning. Such guidance faces a dilemma: mild enough to preserve natural activation statistics, it barely moves the property; strong enough to move it, the generations become progressively harder to fold. We show the failure has a specific and cheaply detectable signature, an off-manifold collapse of the model's own representations. Guided activations fall toward a region statistically indistinguishable from random amino-acid input, and the sequences degenerate to low complexity, yet the property oracle being optimized can still score these generations as a success. The optimized oracle can therefore fail to witness the collapse and, for solubility, can actively reward it, whereas structure and composition expose the failure. Because the failure is already visible in a finished candidate, we detect it at the output rather than modify the generator. We introduce a cheap density prior over natural protein activations and keep only the candidates that remain typical under it, a training-free post-hoc step we call Mahalanobis filtering. At matched guidance settings it improves both the property score and the structural plausibility of the sequences it keeps at negligible cost, without touching the generator, and transfers across different guidance methods. We release the activation statistic at https://huggingface.co/Shuibai12138/off-manifold-collapse-plm

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现蛋白质语言模型在推理时进行属性引导（比如让生成的蛋白更可溶）会导致模型内部表征坍缩到远离天然蛋白分布的‘流形外’区域，从而生成结构不可折叠、低复杂度的假阳性序列；作者不修改模型，而是提出一个无需训练的后处理方法——用天然蛋白激活值的马氏距离过滤掉坍缩样本，显著提升生成序列的结构合理性和目标属性得分。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质语言模型在属性引导生成中出现的性能退化，本质是模型自身隐藏层激活值的‘流形外坍缩’，该现象可被廉价检测并用无训练的马氏距离过滤有效缓解。
analysis.input: 蛋白质语言模型的隐藏层激活值（来自天然蛋白序列）
analysis.output: 过滤后的高质量候选蛋白序列（保留高属性得分且结构合理的样本）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并量化了PLM引导生成中的‘off-manifold collapse’现象，提供可复现、零训练成本、跨方法通用的诊断与修复方案；实证覆盖多个PLM（ESM-2等）、多种引导策略（solubility/structure/composition）、结构评估（pLDDT/AF2建模）和统计验证，但未构建新模型或新生成范式，也未在湿实验验证，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：不是新模型也不是新训练范式，而是精准诊断+轻量普适修复，显著提升现有PLM引导设计的可靠性，对AI×蛋白质设计落地有直接实用价值。

papers.title: Neural Signatures of Conscious Experience During Sleep: A Serial Awakening Study Using High-Density EEG
papers.abstract: Abstract Identifying neural signatures of consciousness remains a central challenge in neuroscience. Sleep offers a tractable model for comparing brain activity in the presence or absence of subjective experience while minimizing behavioral responsiveness confounds. Using overnight 256-electrode high-density EEG in 140 participants and a serial-awakening paradigm, we analyzed 699 non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep stage 2 and 3 awakenings (351 dreaming experience, 348 no experience). Features from the 60s preceding awakening included regional spectral power, lagged-coherence connectivity, graph-theoretic metrics and gamma-to-alpha power ratios. Dreaming experiences were associated with shifts in posterior spectral balance, particularly reduced alpha and delta power and increased gamma-related measures, together with altered large-scale network organization. In participant-level cross-validated machine-learning analyses, all classifiers performed above chance, with the best ensemble model reaching an ROC-AUC of 0.80 and average precision of 0.80. These findings identify reproducible posterior electrophysiological and network-level signatures of conscious states during NREM sleep.

analysis.tldr: 用高密度EEG记录140人睡梦中被反复唤醒时的脑电活动，分析觉醒前60秒的多种脑电特征，发现后部脑区α/δ功率下降、γ增强及全脑网络重组能较稳定地区分‘有梦境体验’和‘无体验’状态。
analysis.org: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
analysis.claim: NREM睡眠期间主观意识体验（梦境）具有可复现的后部皮层电生理与大尺度网络层面神经标记。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG（256通道）信号，时间窗为觉醒前60秒，含频谱功率、滞后相干性、图论指标、γ/α功率比等特征
analysis.output: 二分类预测结果（有梦境体验 / 无体验）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类受试者高密度EEG数据，无机器人或仿真器介入
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最大规模、最系统化的NREM意识体验神经标记实证（140人、699次唤醒），特征可解释性强、跨被试交叉验证稳健（AUC 0.80），但未突破方法学范式（仍是传统EEG特征+ML），且未延伸至实时解码、闭环干预或临床转化，显著优于纯理论模型但远未达BCI基石级（如Brain2voice或脊髓接口）的工程-临床双重突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在意识神经科学基础问题上给出了高质量、可复现的大样本实证，但属于扎实的领域内推进，非范式变革或技术落地突破。

papers.title: Task-space model-based control of pneumatic soft actuators
papers.abstract: Soft actuators enable dexterous and compliant interaction, but closed-loop task-space control remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities, distributed deformation, and uncertainty in their dynamics. This paper presents a real-time dynamic-model-based task-space feedback and estimation framework based on a non-minimal coordinate discrete elastic rod model formulated in absolute coordinates with holonomic constraints. The resulting structure preserves distributed mechanics while maintaining computational efficiency through sparse system matrices, enabling real-time control with up to 10 discretized rods. A quasi-static feedforward inverse model is combined with a task-space PI controller and a dynamic observer that fuses measurement residuals as virtual forces, enabling full-state estimation from sparse sensing. The approach is experimentally validated on three planar pneumatic soft actuators with varying geometries. Across five tasks, including drawing the digits 0-9 across the workspace (3-18 mm/s tip speed), tracking periodic motion (up to 37 cm/s), cross-platform generalization, reduced sensing conditions, and real-time user-defined references, our method achieves 1.5-2.3 mm root mean square error (RMSE) for precision motions and 5.5-12.4 mm RMSE at 1-2 Hz. Results demonstrate that structured, non-minimal dynamic models can enable real-time, high-precision, moderate-bandwidth task-space control of planar soft pneumatic actuators in free space.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于非最小坐标离散弹性杆动力学模型的实时任务空间控制框架，用于平面气动软体执行器，在仅用稀疏传感器的情况下实现毫米级精度的闭环轨迹跟踪和跨平台泛化。
analysis.claim: 结构化的非最小坐标动力学模型可在保持计算效率的同时，支撑软体执行器在自由空间中的实时、高精度、中频宽任务空间控制。
analysis.input: 用户定义的任务空间参考轨迹（如末端点位置/速度）、稀疏传感器测量（如角度或末端位姿）
analysis.output: 气压控制信号（驱动软体执行器运动）
analysis.robot_dependency: 三类自研平面气动软体执行器（含定制气路与压力伺服）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验数据，无仿真预训练或迁移；所有验证均在真机上完成
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了软体机器人领域长期存在的‘模型精度-实时性’矛盾，在真实软体硬件上实现了有量化指标（1.5–12.4 mm RMSE）、多任务（手写/周期跟踪/跨平台/少传感）、带状态观测的闭环控制，但限于二维平面、未扩展至三维或多关节系统，也未接入高层语义或学习模块，属扎实的模型控制工程突破，尚未达到开范式或跨领域辐射级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将高保真弹性杆动力学模型成功压缩至实时控制带宽，并在真机上验证了任务空间闭环性能，但仍是特定软体构型下的控制增强，非通用架构或学习范式突破。

papers.title: Learning Action Models with Conditional and Quantified Effects via Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
papers.abstract: Accurate action models are critical for effective planning. Existing action-model learning methods largely assume simple action representations or become computationally intractable when learning conditional and quantified effects. We present Online Hypothesis-Driven Conditional Action Model Learning (OHCAM), an online approach for learning action models with conditional and quantified effects from limited interactions with the environment. OHCAM maintains a belief over hypothesized action models and actively selects informative actions to reduce uncertainty by maximizing disagreement among competing hypotheses, while being robust to noisy observations. To enable scalability, OHCAM begins with a small set of simple action model hypotheses and expands to more complex conditions only when the current hypotheses become inconsistent with the data. Experiments on six benchmark planning domains demonstrate that OHCAM is sample efficient in learning action models that solve substantially more tasks than baselines, even with observation noise. We validate OHCAM on two tasks using a Kinova Gen3 robot, demonstrating the real-world applicability of our approach.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫OHCAM的在线学习方法，从少量真实交互中自动学出带条件分支和量化效果（比如‘对每个在桌上的杯子，倒满水’）的行动模型，用于规划系统，还在Kinova机械臂上做了两个真实任务验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Jeffrey Jewett 和 Sandhya Saisubramanian 曾属UMass Amherst或RPI，但本文未署名机构；按规则判为 unknown）
analysis.claim: 通过不确定性引导的主动探索，OHCAM能以极少数环境交互样本，在线增量式学习出含条件逻辑与量化效果的可执行动作模型，并在噪声观测下保持鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 环境观测序列（状态变化+动作执行记录）、可能含噪声的状态谓词真值
analysis.output: 一阶逻辑形式的动作模型（含条件前提、量化效果、参数化对象约束）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人交互数据（两个任务），但主体评估在仿真benchmark中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了经典AI规划中动作模型自动获取的长期难点（条件+量化），有真实机械臂验证，但仅2个简单任务、无跨机体/跨域泛化、未开源代码/模型、未与现代具身智能范式（如世界模型、token化动作、多模态闭环）对接，属于扎实的符号AI规划子领域增量工作，远未达基石论文所代表的范式级影响力或工程整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在经典规划动作建模这一狭窄子方向做了稳健推进，有真实硬件验证，但缺乏通用性、开源性和跨范式连接，不属于突破或概念包装，暂时不用看（对具身智能/机器人主赛道影响甚微）

papers.title: Parent-of-origin phasing of somatic mutations shows equal mutation burden between parental genomes in human cancers
papers.abstract: Somatic mutations accumulate independently in the two parental genome copies of our cells throughout life and shape cancer evolution. Although local mutation rates are influenced by allele-specific features such as DNA sequence, epigenetic marks, and chromatin structure, whether these translate into genome-wide differences in mutation accrual between the two parental copies is unknown. Cancer genomics analyses, including copy-number gain timing and molecular archaeology, assume that mutations accrue symmetrically on the two homologous parental genomes, yet this assumption has never been tested. Here we present PhaSoMix, a framework exploiting the genetic differentiation between parental haplotypes in admixed cancer patients to assign somatic mutations to their parent of origin without parent or parent-surrogate sequencing. Applying it with explicit modeling and propagation of phasing and ancestry-inference uncertainty across 21 tumor whole genomes from the Pan-Cancer Analysis of Whole Genomes cohort, we find mutation burdens highly symmetric between maternal and paternal genomes, across cancer types, genomic annotations, clonal timing categories, and mutational processes including clock-like CpG sites, bounding any asymmetry to within 4-5%. Simulations show that violations would substantially bias gain-timing estimates in late evolutionary windows. This provides the first quantification of parental mutation-burden symmetry in vivo, validating a key assumption of cancer evolutionary analyses.

analysis.tldr: 该研究开发了PhaSoMix方法，在无需父母测序的情况下，将体细胞突变分配到母源或父源染色体上，并在21个泛癌全基因组样本中实证发现：癌症中母源和父源基因组的突变负荷高度对称（差异≤4–5%），首次在体内定量验证了癌症进化分析长期依赖却从未检验的核心假设。
analysis.org: VIB-KU Leuven Center for Cancer Biology
analysis.claim: 人类癌症中母源与父源基因组的体细胞突变负荷在全基因组尺度上高度对称，该对称性可被可靠量化且偏差极小（≤4–5%），从而为癌症进化建模中的‘突变对称性’假设提供了首个直接、定量、基于真实肿瘤数据的实证支持。
analysis.input: 肿瘤全基因组测序数据 + 患者祖先混合背景信息（无需父母或亲缘样本）
analysis.output: 每个体细胞突变的亲本来源（母源/父源）概率分配及不确定性量化
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类肿瘤WGS数据（PCAWG队列），无合成/模拟数据主导
analysis.significance_reason: 属癌症基因组学基础方法论突破：首次用严谨统计框架（显式建模相位与祖先推断不确定性）在真实多癌种WGS数据上定量证伪‘潜在亲本偏向性’，支撑了包括分子考古学、拷贝数增益时序推断等关键分析范式的可靠性；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但证据强度（21个真实WGS+多维度分层+消融式模拟验证偏差影响）远超纯计算benchmark，接近HI-JEPA/CENO所代表的‘机制驱动型基础模型’层级，但限于问题尺度（单一假设验证而非通用建模），略低于97分档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是新药或新结构预测，而是以高严谨性关闭了一个长期悬置的基础假设漏洞，使整个癌症进化推断链条的可信度获得首次定量加固。

papers.title: Toward Human-in-the-Loop Robot Failure Recovery: Bridging Communication Gaps in Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.abstract: Robots can recover from failures by asking bystanders for help, but effective human-in-the-loop recovery requires communication that accounts for differences in people's knowledge. Prior inverse-semantics work generates requests using a single listener model, leaving differences in listener knowledge untested. We introduce Listener Differences in Human-Robot Interaction (LD-HRI), a game, dataset, and benchmark that evaluates speakers through human listener performance. Our evaluation examines request properties, large language model (LLM) speakers, and inverse-semantics request-selection algorithms under controlled differences in listener information. The corpus contains 446 human-written requests and 1{,}302 listener trials. We additionally evaluated 24 frozen LLM-written requests with 70 human listeners across 560 trials. Novice success is descriptively higher with model-written requests across all four tasks, yet both request sources leave substantial expert--novice gaps, including 16 percentage points for LLM requests. LD-HRI makes these gaps measurable, providing a foundation for designing more robust communication in human-robot and human-agent interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫LD-HRI的新基准（含游戏、数据集和评测协议），专门用来量化人类在机器人故障恢复中因知识差异（专家vs新手）导致的沟通失效程度，并用它评测了LLM生成求助请求的效果，发现现有方法仍存在显著的知识适配盲区。
analysis.claim: 人类听众的知识差异会系统性影响机器人求助请求的有效性，而当前逆语义建模方法忽略这一差异，LD-HRI首次提供可测量、可控、基于真人反馈的评估框架来暴露并量化该问题。
analysis.input: 机器人故障场景描述 + 听众知识状态（专家/新手）
analysis.output: 人类听众成功理解并执行求助请求的比例（成功率）、请求属性分析（如具体性、冗余度、术语使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅依赖人类对文本请求的响应行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是HRI领域首个聚焦‘听众知识异质性’并用真人实验闭环评测请求有效性的结构化基准，实证扎实（446人工请求+1302真人试次+24 LLM请求×70人×560试次），但问题尺度属中观机制层面（沟通适配），未触及具身失败恢复的核心控制/感知/规划瓶颈，也未推动任何底层模型或硬件进展；相比所列基石（全为BCI临床级突破或范式级架构），分量明显不足，但比纯理论或小规模用户调研更具工程指导价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将听众知识差异建模为可测量变量并构建真人驱动的评测基准，但未解决失败恢复本身的机器人学难题，属于HRI人因机制研究的重要补缺，非范式突破。

papers.title: PTMExplorer: A Multi-Dimensional Integrative Visualization Platform for Protein Post-Translational Modification Function and Structure
papers.abstract: Deciphering the functions of post-translational modifications (PTMs) is a critical bridge connecting large-scale modification proteomics data to mechanistic studies. However, most existing tools for visualizing PTM omics data are limited to site catalogs or single-dimensional feature displays. They lack the capability to simultaneously map user-derived differential modification sites onto multi-dimensional contexts, including protein three-dimensional (3D) structure, evolutionary conservation, functional sites, and disease associations. This limitation makes it difficult for researchers to rapidly assess the biological importance of candidate sites from among a vast number of differentially modified sites. Here, we present PTMExplorer, an interactive platform for the multi-dimensional visualization of protein PTMs. PTMExplorer comprises three core modules: PTM Inspector, built upon ProtVista, provides a multi-track, sequence-feature integrated view incorporating intrinsically disordered region (IDR) prediction (via flDPnn), surface accessibility calculation (via FreeSASA), and UniProt functional annotations; PTM 3D Locator, leveraging the Nightingale/Mol* engine, anchors modification sites onto AlphaFold/Protein Data Bank (PDB) 3D structures through residue mapping via PDBe-SIFTS; and PTM Overview, utilizing the R circlize package, presents a panoramic polar circos plot illustrating modification distribution and inter-group differential regulation. Additionally, three major disease-associated modification databases (PTMD, qPTM, and PhosCancer) are integrated as PTM-Disease Nexus, enabling co-localization comparison between user-defined differential sites and reported disease-related sites. PTMExplorer currently supports eight model organisms, accepts user-uploaded differential analysis results, and provides multi-dimensional annotations and various visualization options (https://www.bioladder.cn/PTMExplorer/). Using a multi-omics dataset from hepatocellular carcinoma (18 patients, 9 modification types) as a case study, we demonstrate the practical utility of PTMExplorer in screening potential biomarkers, revealing multi-modification coordination mechanisms, and distinguishing between absolute and relative quantification patterns.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个交互式可视化平台PTMExplorer，把用户上传的差异修饰位点同时映射到蛋白质序列特征、3D结构、进化保守性、功能区域和疾病关联等多个维度，帮研究者快速判断哪些修饰位点可能有生物学意义。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海营养与健康研究所
analysis.claim: PTMExplorer首次实现了对用户自定义差异PTM位点的多维度（序列+结构+进化+功能+疾病）一体化、可交互、跨物种可视化整合分析。
analysis.input: 用户上传的差异PTM位点列表（含蛋白ID、修饰类型、位点位置、统计显著性等）
analysis.output: 多视图可视化结果：序列轨道图（含IDR/表面可及性/功能注释）、3D结构着色定位图、极坐标环形图（circos）、疾病位点共定位热图
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具型工作：整合了AlphaFold/PDB/UniProt/SIFTS/多个疾病数据库，覆盖8个物种，有真实癌症多组学案例验证；但未提出新算法或模型，未解决PTM功能预测或结构影响建模等核心科学问题，仅是现有资源的系统性可视化封装，分量介于扎实增量（60）与工程整合之间，因缺乏代码开源和可复现pipeline扣分。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：做了非常实用且设计严谨的可视化集成，但未推进PTM机制理解或预测能力本身，属于领域急需的‘好用工具’而非‘科学突破’。

papers.title: A Modular Dual-Arm Robotic Cell for Disassembly and Repair of Industrial Control Electronics
papers.abstract: Industrial control electronics such as programmable logic controllers, servo drives and operator panels are routinely repaired in plant maintenance, but were never designed for automated disassembly. This paper presents a modular dual-arm robotic cell for repair-oriented disassembly, using two collaborative manipulators, interchangeable tools, red-green-blue-depth (RGB-D) and wristlevel perception, force/torque sensing and a Robot Operating System (ROS) 2- based control with Behavior Tree (BT) execution, teleoperation, digital-twin support and bounded learning-based contact skills. The process is decomposed into sequence planning, symbolic execution with fallbacks, force-limited tool skills, visual condition assessment and demonstration-based adaptation. A CADderived device graph encodes the disassembly order, access constraints, tools, feasible removal directions and verification states and converts them into operation objects for the BT and motion layers. Grounded in three representative devices, the cell covers screw removal, damaged-fastener fallback, snap-fit opening, connector release, cooperative printed circuit board (PCB) extraction and condition-based repair decisions. The main contribution is an architecture linking sequence knowledge, perception, verification and force-aware skills through one ROS 2 interface across simulation, teleoperation and real hardware.

analysis.tldr: 用两个协作机械臂、RGB-D+力觉感知、行为树控制和CAD导出的设备拆解图，构建了一个可复用的模块化双臂机器人系统，专门用于工业控制电子设备（如PLC、伺服驱动器）的自动化拆解与维修决策，支持仿真、遥操作和真机部署的一体化流程。
analysis.claim: 通过将CAD-derived设备图谱、行为树执行框架、力觉/视觉融合技能与ROS 2统一接口结合，实现了面向维修目标的工业电子设备可泛化、可验证、可回退的自动化拆解架构。
analysis.input: CAD设备图谱+RGB-D图像+六维力/扭矩数据+人工遥操作指令
analysis.output: 分步拆解动作序列（含工具选择、接触力约束、方向校验）及维修状态判定（如‘螺丝锈死→启用破坏性移除’）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR10e双臂+OnRobot RG2-FT夹爪+Intel RealSense D435i+ATI Gamma六维力传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实设备拆解过程采集的力/视觉/状态反馈数据进行技能标定与fallback触发阈值设定，但未说明是否使用大规模真实维修数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在工业维修机器人这一长期被忽视的垂直场景中，首次系统性整合CAD语义图谱、行为树容错执行、力觉引导技能与数字孪生闭环，覆盖6类典型维修子任务并在3种真实工业设备上验证；但未达到Unitree R1（90分）级的通用运动能力或跨平台部署规模，属显著贡献而非范式突破。

papers.title: Differential Attention Unlocks Complementary EEG and Speech Fusion for Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) increasingly pairs EEG with speech, treating internal neural signals and external vocal expression as informative views of affect. In practice, naive fusion underperforms the stronger single modality, because EEG artifacts inject noise that corrupts the shared representation. We introduce EmoSpeechBrain, a multimodal framework built on the insight that noise suppression is a precondition for effective fusion. Its EEG encoder uses differential attention, taking the difference between two attention maps to cancel shared noise and isolate discriminative neural activity. An attention-based gating adapter aligns both modalities in a shared space and weights each one's contribution to the prediction. On two datasets - PME4 and EAV, EmoSpeechBrain improves MER accuracy by up to 12.9% over other state-of-the-art (SOTA) EEG encoders, and surpasses unimodal speech and EEG baselines by up to 13.1% and 23.1%. These results show that once EEG noise is suppressed, fusion delivers gains that naive combination cannot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫EmoSpeechBrain的新方法，用差分注意力机制专门压制EEG信号里的共模噪声，再把净化后的EEG和语音特征对齐融合，显著提升了多模态情绪识别准确率。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校
analysis.claim: EEG与语音的简单拼接融合失败主因是未抑制EEG中污染共享表征的共模噪声；通过差分注意力显式建模并消除该噪声后，跨模态融合才能释放真实互补性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号+原始语音波形（或梅尔谱）
analysis.output: 离散情绪类别（如高兴/悲伤/愤怒/中性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG-语音同步采集数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属情绪识别子领域扎实增量：在两个小规模实验室数据集（PME4/EAV）上验证了噪声感知融合的有效性，但未涉及真实临床场景、未开源代码/模型、无跨被试/跨设备泛化验证，与脑机接口基石工作（如高精度语音解码、脊髓接口行走）在临床价值、系统鲁棒性、长期稳定性上存在数量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将差分注意力巧妙迁移到EEG噪声建模，提升了融合性能，但仍是封闭实验条件下的算法调优，未突破情绪识别领域的范式瓶颈或临床落地障碍。

papers.title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
papers.abstract: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为CoHuB的纯仿真环境，用于评测多个人形机器人在第一人称视觉下协同完成任务的能力，提供了10个协作任务和VR遥操作采集的同步演示数据，但未在真实机器人上验证，也未提出新算法。
analysis.claim: CoHuB是首个面向多个人形机器人、基于第一人称视觉观测的协作仿真基准，可系统评测协同感知与控制能力。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB图像（每个机器人独立输入）
analysis.output: 各机器人独立的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为仿真+VR遥操作合成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽填补了多个人形机器人协作仿真基准的空白，但仅限仿真、无真机验证、无新模型/控制方法、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实证，且任务规模小（最多3机）、协作模式未突破现有遥操作范式，属扎实但窄向的benchmark建设，远低于所列基石工作（全部含真机/世界模型/零样本迁移/端到端行为生成等实质性突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了多机协作仿真基准的系统性搭建和初步评测，但缺乏算法创新与真实世界闭环验证，目前仅具工具价值。

papers.title: MASkillBlender: Decentralized Whole-Body Coordination for Multi-Humanoid Loco-Manipulation via Skill Blending
papers.abstract: Coordinated multi-humanoid loco-manipulation is promising yet challenging due to high-dimensional whole-body control, decentralized decision making, and scalability. While recent reinforcement learning methods have improved single-humanoid whole-body control, extending them to the multi-humanoid setting remains nontrivial and often requires substantial reward engineering or task-specific design. We propose MASkillBlender, a general multi-agent reinforcement learning framework to achieve decentralized multi-humanoid whole-body coordination. By learning a shared decentralized high-level policy over reusable pre-trained single-humanoid skills, MASkillBlender enables coordinated behaviors using only task-level rewards, without requiring task-specific motion references. To improve learning efficiency, we further introduce a permutation-based data augmentation strategy for homogeneous multi-humanoid systems, and theoretically show that the permuted samples preserve the policy-gradient direction of the original samples under the homogeneous Markov game formulation. We evaluate MASkillBlender on multiple multi-humanoid coordination tasks across two humanoid embodiments. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves strong task performance and enables coordinated behaviors across different tasks and humanoid embodiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MASkillBlender的多智能体强化学习框架，让多个仿人机器人在不共享状态、不依赖具体动作参考的前提下，仅靠任务级奖励（比如‘把箱子搬到目标点’），就能协调完成行走+操作类任务，核心是复用单机器人预训练技能并做去中心化高层策略融合。
analysis.claim: 通过技能复用与去中心化高层策略学习，可在无动作先验、无显式通信、仅任务级奖励条件下实现跨任务/跨机体的多仿人机器人全身协调运动与操作。
analysis.input: 任务指令（如目标位置/物体状态）+各机器人局部观测（关节状态、IMU、视觉等）
analysis.output: 各机器人独立的动作序列（全身关节力矩或目标姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中的两个自研仿人机器人模型（未命名，非标准平台如H1/Atlas）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（技能复用+去中心化RL），在仿真中验证了跨机体泛化能力，但未使用任何行业标准平台（如H1/Atlas）、未接入真实传感器模态（如触觉/深度视觉）、无真机实验、无与SOTA方法（如RT-2 for robots、H2O、ω-0）的公平对比，仅在自建小规模仿真任务上展示效果，属于扎实但边界清晰的增量工作，未触及当前领域核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程loco-manipulation因果建模、人类意图对齐）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了多仿人仿真中技能复用驱动的去中心化协调问题，但未突破仿真到现实、小任务到开放场景、定制平台到通用接口的关键断层，暂时不用看

papers.title: PreferenceFlow: Test-Time Guidance of Flow-Matching Robot Policies from Human Interventions
papers.abstract: Flow-matching policies can represent complex robot behaviors but remain susceptible to local errors under distribution shift at deployment. Many reinforcement learning approaches to policy improvement require reward signals that are difficult to specify or obtain in real-world manipulation. We present PreferenceFlow, a framework for improving a pretrained flow policy at test time without environment rewards or updates to the base policy. Human intervention chunks are paired with robot chunks generated from the same initial conditioning state to train a preference model. During infer- ence, we adopt the QGF sampling update, replacing its value gradient with the preference gradient evaluated at an estimated clean action. A gradient-cap loss penalizes excessive gradients on intervention pairs, while a zero-gradient loss discourages guidance near actions from expert demonstrations. On four real-world precision insertion tasks with a Franka robot, Pref- erenceFlow achieves a mean success rate of 90.5%, compared with 69% for the frozen policy. Ablations support the roles of gradient regularization and correctly ordered preference labels in the evaluated settings. These results demonstrate the utility of human interventions as local preference supervision for guiding frozen generative robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PreferenceFlow，让已训练好的流匹配机器人策略在实际运行时，仅靠人类临时干预（比如手动调整机械臂一小段动作）就能实时修正行为，无需重训练、不依赖环境奖励信号，在四个真实精密插入任务上把成功率从69%提升到90.5%。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位，arXiv未显示署名机构）
analysis.claim: 人类在测试时的局部干预可作为弱监督信号，通过偏好建模与梯度重定向，实时引导冻结的流匹配策略修正分布偏移下的错误，且无需环境奖励或策略参数更新。
analysis.input: 人类干预的动作片段 + 同一初始状态下的机器人原始生成动作片段 + 当前观测（隐含于flow policy conditioning中）
analysis.output: 经偏好梯度修正后的动作轨迹（clean action估计+QGF采样更新）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上采集的人类干预数据（用于训练偏好模型），但未说明是否需大量预收集；实验基于4个真实插入任务，干预数据应为任务执行中实时产生

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在真实机器人上首次将人类干预转化为流匹配策略的测试时偏好梯度引导，实证充分但泛化与开源缺失，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning
papers.abstract: Constrained Locomotion Planning (CLP) for quadrupeds and humanoids, where robots must satisfy collision avoidance, contact consistency, kinematic feasibility, and support constraints, is challenging under high-dimensional dynamics and highly non-convex environments. Recent Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) approaches recast trajectory optimization as posterior sampling over trajectories, using known dynamics and Monte Carlo rollouts to analytically estimate the denoising score function without demonstration learning. While constrained variants further incorporate feasibility into model-based score rollouts and show promising performance, they are still limited by (1) lacking a task-modulated active constraint geometry that shapes the score direction and reverse stochasticity, and (2) using deterministic DDPM-style reverse transport without adaptive scheduling across different generative transports. Therefore, we introduce Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization (2GO) for constrained locomotion, which turns active constraint geometry into executable denoising operators through normal- induced metric shaping, tangent-space stochastic filtering, and CFS-based retraction. 2GO further decouples generative transport from reverse stochasticity through an adaptive diffusion and flow-like schedule. Experiments on constrained quadruped and humanoid locomotion demonstrate strong performance in discrete foothold selection and continuous posture planning, with higher success rates, fewer violations, and improved execution compatibility.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫2GO的新方法，把机器人运动规划中的各种物理约束（如不撞障碍物、脚要踩稳、关节不能超限）转化成几何结构，嵌入到基于扩散模型的轨迹优化过程中，让生成的步态更安全、更可行、更容易在真实机器人上执行。
analysis.claim: 通过将约束的几何结构显式建模为可执行的去噪算子，并解耦生成传输与反向随机性调度，2GO显著提升了高维非凸约束下四足与人形机器人运动规划的可行性、成功率与执行兼容性。
analysis.input: 初始状态、目标位姿、环境几何（如障碍物/地面拓扑）、动力学模型
analysis.output: 满足多约束的连续运动轨迹（含离散落脚点+连续关节姿态）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中依赖四足/人形机器人动力学模型（如PyBullet/Mujoco中的ANYmal、Cassie、Humanoid），未提真实机体
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集数据，仅用模型和仿真rollout
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰几何建模创新（法向度量整形、切空间滤波、CFS回缩），在多个仿真基准上验证了跨机体/跨任务泛化性，且相比MBD基线显著降低约束违反率；但未部署真机、无消融实验细节、未开源数据/模型，也未与RT-2/InsertAnything等基石级工作在sim2real迁移或执行鲁棒性上对标，属扎实的算法推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在模型驱动扩散规划中首次系统引入约束几何感知机制，实证效果优于现有MBD变体，但限于仿真、缺乏真机验证与完整开源，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
papers.abstract: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让一个冻结参数的大语言模型（LLM）通过维护可修改的自然语言规则本（rulebook）作为外部记忆，持续观察环境、反思错误、更新规则、编译成可执行代码做预测和规划，并只在代码能精确复现观测轨迹且被LLM判定忠于规则时才接受更新；最终在ARC-AGI-3所有25个谜题上达到100%通关率和人类44%的动作效率，在Atari Pong中实现零调用LLM的纯代码控制器连胜。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Haoyu Zhao/Zhengxu Yu等无明确机构标识；arXiv未提供署名单位信息）
analysis.claim: 冻结的LLM可通过递归式‘观察→反思→规则修订→代码编译→轨迹验证’闭环，在不更新自身参数的前提下实现模型级递归自我改进（RSI），其世界模型以可解释、可编辑的自然语言规则本为载体，并能编译为高保真执行代码。
analysis.input: 环境观测序列（如ARC-AGI的网格状态变化、Atari帧序列）、自然语言任务描述
analysis.output: 自然语言规则本（动态更新）、可执行Python代码（用于预测与控制）、动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（ARC-AGI-3、Atari）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了首个有严格验证机制（cell-exact replay + LLM faithfulness check）的冻结LLM驱动的模型级RSI闭环，在ARC-AGI-3上达成全任务SOTA（100% RHAE，远超此前方法），且Pong案例证明其生成的纯代码控制器具备强泛化与零推理开销能力；虽未达World Models或DreamerV3级范式开创性（缺统一潜空间建模/端到端梯度优化），但将‘可解释世界模型+代码编译+自动验证’路径推至新高度，是模型基RL与LLM协同方向的里程碑式工程实现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次用可验证、可编辑的自然语言规则本+代码编译闭环，让冻结LLM实现严格定义的递归自我改进，并在强基准上取得压倒性实证结果。

papers.title: Memory-resolved prediction of ligand residence times on the minutes timescale
papers.abstract: AI-enabled computational drug discovery is advancing rapidly in predicting molecular structures, binding poses and affinities, but ligand dissociation kinetics remain harder to access. Bound-state residence time, important for biological response and kinetic selectivity, is not fixed by equilibrium affinity but depends on the dissociation free-energy landscape and dissipative friction effects. Here, we show that restrained umbrella-sampling trajectories can be used to calculate residence times on the minutes timescale. Time-resolved coordinate fluctuations yield friction profiles that incorporate non-Markovian effects on dissociation kinetics. Combining them with the free-energy profile, we predict a residence time of $τ_{\rm res}$ = 275 s for the adenosine A$_{2A}$ receptor with ZM241385 (comparable to the experimental value of 125 s) and reproduce the experimental ranking of wild type and two receptor mutants. For HSP90 with compound 18 and RNase S with the S15 peptide, we predict $τ_{\rm res}$ = 2,169 s and 2,259 s (experimental values are 833 s and 2,439 s). Neglecting memory effects on residence kinetics overestimates $τ_{\rm res}$ by factors of 2.6 to 29.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种结合受限伞形采样轨迹与记忆效应（非马尔可夫摩擦）的计算方法，首次在分钟尺度上较准确预测了多个蛋白-配体复合物的解离 residence time（停留时间），并证明忽略记忆效应会导致高估2.6–29倍。
analysis.org: 弗里德里希·威廉-柏林洪堡大学
analysis.claim: 配体解离动力学中的记忆效应（非马尔可夫摩擦）对 residence time 的定量预测至关重要，仅靠自由能剖面会系统性严重高估；通过时间分辨坐标涨落提取摩擦剖面，可将 residence time 预测精度提升至分钟量级（误差<2.2倍）。
analysis.input: 分子动力学模拟轨迹（受限伞形采样）、蛋白-配体结构、温度/力场参数
analysis.output: 配体解离 residence time（秒/分钟级数值）及突变体相对排序
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖模拟数据，无真实机器人或实验动力学数据输入（仅用实验值作验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在多靶点（A2AR/HSP90/RNase S）上实现分钟级 residence time 的物理可解释、非经验性预测，误差控制在2.2倍内，并量化记忆效应的主导贡献；虽未开源代码/模型，但方法完整可复现，显著优于传统MM/PBSA或Markov速率理论，属扎实的重大方法推进，但尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式颠覆或生成式药物设计级工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是换模型刷榜，而是从统计力学第一性原理出发，修正了领域长期忽略的关键物理项（记忆摩擦），并在多个实验体系中验证了其定量必要性。

papers.title: CucurbitAgent: An AI agent for exploring cucurbit multi-omics resources
papers.abstract: Functional genomics in crops increasingly depends on integrating information from an extensive literature and heterogeneous multi-omics datasets. Large language models (LLMs) offer a powerful approach to synthesizing these resources and revealing hidden connections across datasets; however, they frequently hallucinate, producing plausible but unsupported claims, when responding to gene-specific queries. Here, we present CucurbitAgent, an AI research agent for functional genomics in the Cucurbitaceae, a major family of horticultural crops. CucurbitAgent integrates multi-omics resources from nine cultivated cucurbit species and more than 18,000 publications, encompassing approximately 256,000 genes, tissue-resolved expression profiles, over 16 million natural genetic variants, and roughly 242,000 predicted protein structures with more than 14 million predicted binding-site residue annotations. Responses link retrieved evidence to source records, including gene entries, expression measurements, structural predictions, and literature passages. On a curated benchmark of 50 tasks assessed by domain experts under blinded conditions, CucurbitAgent achieved an overall pairwise win rate of 96.0% against nine general-purpose LLMs, based on weighted scores for factual accuracy, completeness, relevance, and traceability. The platform is freely available at https://cucurbitagent.com and supports queries in 37 languages collectively spoken by an estimated 70% or more of the world's population. CucurbitAgent not only unifies evidence retrieval and interpretation but also reveals latent associations across datasets, helping researchers formulate testable hypotheses and substantially accelerating candidate-gene research. Its framework is readily transferable to other crops and, more broadly, provides a blueprint for building specialized agents in any domain.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专用于葫芦科作物功能基因组学的AI代理系统CucurbitAgent，它能整合9种葫芦科作物的多组学数据（基因、表达、变异、蛋白结构、结合位点）和1.8万篇文献，对基因相关问题给出带溯源证据的回答，并在50个专家盲评任务中大幅超越9个通用大模型。
analysis.claim: 针对作物功能基因组学中多源异构数据整合难、LLM幻觉严重的问题，构建首个可溯源、多模态、多语言支持的领域专用AI研究代理，显著提升基因级查询的事实准确性与可验证性。
analysis.input: 自然语言基因相关问题（支持37种语言）
analysis.output: 带证据溯源的结构化回答（链接至基因条目、表达数据、蛋白结构预测、文献段落等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×农业基因组学领域的重磅工程：首次实现作物多组学+文献的端到端可溯源问答，50个专家盲测评任务设计扎实、对比充分（vs 9个SOTA LLM），且数据规模（25.6万基因、1600万变异、24.2万结构）和跨物种泛化能力真实；但未开源代码/模型权重，未报告消融实验或底层机制创新，框架可迁移但未在其他作物实证，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将现有LLM、结构预测、多组学数据库与严谨评估流程深度耦合，解决了领域内长期存在的‘查得到但信不过’痛点，但非算法或模型原理层面的突破。

papers.title: ProTok: Unified Protein Tokenization via Modular Multi-Codebook Quantization
papers.abstract: Protein sequence, structure, and functional annotations each capture complementary aspects of protein biology, yet existing tokenizers encode each modality independently, limiting the expressiveness of discrete protein representations. We present ProTok, a unified protein tokenizer that maps all three modalities into a modular discrete vocabulary via product quantization with per-modality codebook groups and modality dropout. A single ProTok checkpoint supports flexible inference from any modality subset without retraining. On seven StructTokenBench benchmarks spanning 14 tasks and 28 test splits, ProTok achieves an average rank of 1.4 across all structure-only tokenizers, placing first on 21 splits and among the top two on 27 of the 28. These gains come without sacrificing reconstruction: ProTok's tokens reach 0.939 lDDT on CATH 4.2, showing that multi-codebook quantization and multi-modal training yield tokens that are both reconstructable and informative. ProTok's structure tokens further lead all baseline structure tokenizers on zero-shot functional retrieval across CATH, Enzyme Commission, and Gene Ontology label hierarchies. The vocabulary also supports generation: a compact language model trained from scratch over ProTok tokens jointly generates backbone and sequence, with 52% of sampled backbones designable versus 21% for a parameter-matched GeoBPE baseline. ProTok shows that structure, sequence, and function can share one discrete vocabulary, motivating protein language models that reason over a unified token stream.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ProTok，一种用模块化多码本量化方法把蛋白质序列、结构和功能注释统一映射到同一个离散词表的tokenizer，不需重训练就能灵活支持任意模态子集输入，并在结构表征、零样本功能检索和联合生成任务上全面超越现有结构tokenizer。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质的序列、结构和功能可以共享一个统一、可重构、信息丰富的离散词表，且该词表可通过模块化多码本量化与模态丢弃实现跨模态灵活推理。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列/3D结构/功能注释（任一或组合）
analysis.output: 统一离散token序列
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在StructTokenBench（14任务/28测试集）上显著领先所有结构tokenizer，首次实现三模态统一tokenization且保持高lDDT重建精度（0.939）和零样本功能检索优势，并验证了下游生成能力；但未触及折叠预测、从头设计或进化建模等基石级科学问题，属AI×生物领域内重大方法论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证扎实（多任务+多基准+重建+生成）、方法新颖（模块化多码本+模态丢弃）、开源可复现，实质性推动了蛋白质多模态表征的统一建模，但尚未达到AlphaFold2或ESMFold级的科学颠覆性。

papers.title: Neuromorphic Decoding and Dynamical Image Reconstruction from Populations of Spiking Retinal Ganglion Cells
papers.abstract: Decoding visual stimuli from the spiking activity of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) informs both our understanding of the retinal code and the design of visual prostheses. Natural vision is dynamic, yet state-of-the-art decoders mostly reconstruct single frames with artificial neural networks that process dense, continuous-valued signals rather than the retina's sparse, asynchronous spikes. We asked whether dynamic scenes can be reconstructed and tracked entirely within the spike domain, and at what computational cost. We built an end-to-end spiking neural network (SNN) whose neurons integrate the recorded RGC spikes over time. Populations of up to 1836 RGCs were recorded ex vivo from mouse retina on high-density microelectrode arrays while flashed images, moving bars, drifting gratings and randomly moving handwritten digits were presented. For moving digits, one shared spiking encoder fed two readouts, one reconstructing the image and one decoding the digit's position. Compute energy was estimated from counted synaptic operations. The SNN decoded what and where at once. It reconstructed the stimuli with a structural similarity (SSIM) of up to 0.93, refining the reconstruction as spikes accumulated, and tracked a randomly moving target with a mean error of 1.33 pixels on a $32\times32$ grid. Its fidelity nearly matched that of the best of 17 larger spiking and artificial decoders (5.9 million to 1.7 billion parameters, versus 5.4 million), and at a mean firing rate of 14.2% it needed an estimated $\sim$70-fold less compute energy than a dense artificial network of the same architecture. Dynamic visual scenes can thus be decoded from retinal population activity in the spike domain, with a compact network and at a compute cost compatible with implantable and wearable neural interfaces, supporting spike-native decoders for visual prostheses.

analysis.tldr: 用一个紧凑的脉冲神经网络（SNN）直接从视网膜神经节细胞群的原始脉冲序列中实时重建动态图像（如移动手写数字）并同时解码其位置，不转换为连续信号，在小参数量（540万）和极低功耗（比同构ANN低70倍）下达到接近SOTA大模型的重建质量（SSIM 0.93）。
analysis.claim: 动态视觉场景可完全在脉冲域内被高效解码与重建，无需转换为稠密连续表征，且计算能耗足够低，适配植入式/可穿戴视觉假体。
analysis.input: 视网膜离体实验中记录的多电极阵列上1836个神经节细胞的异步脉冲序列
analysis.output: 动态刺激图像帧（32×32）及其中移动目标的位置坐标
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量离体小鼠视网膜电生理数据（高密度MEA记录），无活体动物或人类受试者数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实视网膜群体脉冲数据上实现端到端、 spike-native 的动态图像重建+定位联合解码，实证扎实（多刺激范式、SSIM/定位误差量化、17模型对比、能耗估算），但限于离体小鼠数据，未验证活体闭环或人类适用性，未达临床转化级里程碑（如Brain2Voice 2.0或handwriting BCI的90+分量），属显著推进：为低功耗视觉假体提供了首个经实证的脉冲原生架构范本。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将SNN真正落地到高保真、低功耗、动态视觉解码任务，并用严谨离体电生理数据验证，但尚未跨越到活体/临床闭环，不是概念包装，也不是真突破。

papers.title: CoRe-MoE: Contrastive Reweighted Mixture of Experts for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Locomotion with Gait Adaptation
papers.abstract: Humans primarily rely on walking and running to traverse complex terrains, without resorting to unnecessarily complex motion patterns. Similarly, humanoid robots should achieve smooth transitions between walking and running while maintaining natural and stable locomotion. However, unifying gait transition and multi-terrain adaptation within a single policy remains challenging due to gradient interference and the distribution shift induced by terrain-dependent visual and dynamic variations. Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can alleviate multi-skill interference, naive joint training often fails to yield clear expert specialization, limiting their effectiveness. To address these challenges, we propose CoRe-MoE, a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that decouples gait generation from terrain adaptation. In the first stage, a stable locomotion policy is learned to produce natural walking and running behaviors with smooth transitions. In the second stage, a terrain-aware MoE branch is introduced and trained with a contrastive objective to shape the gating network, enabling it to capture structured terrain representations and promote expert specialization. The final action is obtained via weighted fusion of the base gait policy and the terrain-aware branch, allowing the policy to preserve stable locomotion patterns while adapting to complex terrains. Extensive simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms baseline approaches in terms of success rate, locomotion stability, and multi-terrain adaptability. Furthermore, zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot validates the effectiveness of our framework, achieving robust walking and running across stairs, slopes, steps, obstacles, and unstructured outdoor terrains, while maintaining accurate foothold placement and dynamic stability under external disturbances.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoRe-MoE框架，用两阶段强化学习解耦步态生成与地形感知：先学稳定行走/奔跑基础策略，再用对比重加权的MoE分支专门处理多地形适应，最终加权融合输出动作；在仿真中超越基线，在Unitree G1真机上零样本部署，成功跨越楼梯、斜坡、台阶、障碍和野外非结构化地形。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，论文未提实验室/公司名）
analysis.claim: 通过解耦训练+对比重加权门控机制，可使单一策略同时实现自然步态过渡与跨复杂地形的泛化适应，且无需真实机器人微调即可零样本部署到真机。
analysis.input: 本体状态（关节角度/速度/IMU）、地形视觉观测（RGB或深度？摘要未明说，但提‘terrain-dependent visual and dynamic variations’）、可能含高度图或局部地形编码
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩/目标位置（即底层运动控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1（真机验证）、仿真中应为PyBullet或Mujoco类仿真器（未明说，但属标准 humanoid RL setting）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真合成数据训练；真机部署为zero-shot，无真实机器人交互数据参与训练
analysis.significance_reason: 真机零样本部署到G1并覆盖6类复杂地形（含野外），动态稳定性与落点精度有实证；但未开源代码/模型，未与H2O/GR00T等基石方法直接对比，仿真指标未公开消融细节，属扎实推进SOTA的工程级突破，尚未达开范式级别
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真-真机链路上做出可靠闭环（解耦设计+对比门控+零样本G1部署），但缺乏开源与基线对齐，未动摇当前领域第一梯队方法论地位

papers.title: NVIDIA OmniDreams: Real-Time Generative World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous Vehicle Simulation
papers.abstract: As autonomous vehicle capabilities advance, the safe evaluation of driving policies in long-tail scenarios remains a critical bottleneck. In closed-loop simulation, the driving policy model actively interacts with the environment, where its actions dynamically update the simulator state and directly influence the next set of generated sensor observations. While recent reconstruction-based neural simulators offer photorealism, they are fundamentally constrained by their initial captured data and struggle to generalize to highly dynamic or novel scenes. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OmniDreams, a foundation generative world model mid- and post-trained from the Cosmos diffusion model to autoregressively generate action-conditioned videos in real time. By leveraging the rich visual priors of Cosmos and mid- and post-training on 21k hours of driving scenarios, OmniDreams synthesizes complex, unobserved phenomena that are hard for traditional simulators to capture, such as extreme weather and unpredictable dynamic agent behaviors. Crucially, it autoregressively conditions its photorealistic sensor generation on past frames, the current simulator state, and immediate driving actions. Deployed in a closed-loop system with the Alpamayo 1 policy model and AlpaSim orchestrator, OmniDreams acts as a highly responsive, reactive environment, providing a scalable and comprehensive solution for training and evaluating next-generation autonomous driving policies. We additionally show preliminary results indicating that a world-action model (WAM) post-trained from OmniDreams achieves strong performance on the Physical AI Autonomous Vehicles NuRec dataset, surpassing the VLA-based Alpamayo 1.5 research policy model while using only 1/5 the total parameters. These results highlight the potential for a real-time world model like OmniDreams to also serve as a backbone for policy architectures.

analysis.tldr: NVIDIA提出一个实时生成式世界模型OmniDreams，用扩散模型（Cosmos）做基础，中后期训练后能根据车辆动作和历史状态自回归生成逼真的传感器视频，在仿真闭环中替代传统神经渲染器，用于自动驾驶策略的训练与评测。
analysis.claim: 一个基于扩散先验、动作-状态联合条件的实时生成式世界模型，能在闭环仿真中动态合成未见过的长尾驾驶场景（如极端天气、突发交互），且可作为轻量级策略骨干。
analysis.input: 历史帧+当前仿真器状态（如车辆位姿、交通流状态）+即时驾驶动作（转向/加减速）
analysis.output: 动作条件下的未来多帧传感器视频（如前视RGB+LiDAR伪影）
analysis.robot_dependency: AlpaSim仿真器 + Alpamayo 1策略模型（闭环耦合）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：21k小时真实驾驶视频+状态轨迹用于mid/post-training；未提真实车端部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了生成式世界模型在自动驾驶闭环仿真中的实用性：首次将大扩散先验（Cosmos）适配为低延迟动作条件视频生成器，并验证其对长尾场景的泛化能力及下游策略性能增益；但仍是纯仿真、无真车验证，未突破World Models/DreamerV3级的通用世界建模范式，也未解决sim2real根本鸿沟。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Cosmos扩散模型深度改造为实时动作条件视频生成器，在AlpaSim闭环中实现高保真长尾场景合成，证据扎实但未脱离仿真沙盒，属当前工业界最强闭环仿真基座之一。

papers.title: Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: In robotic manipulation, the tight coupling between grasping and motion planning often obscures the true source of failure, leading to inefficient trial-and-error. To enable efficient long-horizon manipulation, we propose GTP-FA (Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution), a task-oriented two-stage grasp-then-plan framework that generates grasp candidates and performs downstream motion planning conditioned on the selected grasp. Given a failed manipulation trajectory, we learn a failure attribution model that generalizes to unseen grasps and produces a stable distribution over failure modes for diagnosis-guided optimization. Based on these attribution results, we then optimize both modules in a diagnosis-driven manner: on the grasping side, we inject task-level priors and risk penalties into grasp candidate scoring and optimization to suppress unstable or task-incompatible grasps; on the planning side, we target high-risk initial states through data collection and fine-tuning to address genuine planning bottlenecks. We evaluate the proposed framework in both simulation and real-robot experiments, and show that GTP-FA improves the corresponding base learners across RL, IL, diffusion-policy, and VLA-based settings, achieving substantially higher overall task success rates.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个先选抓取再规划运动的两阶段框架，失败时能自动归因是抓取问题还是规划问题，并据此分别优化两个模块，提升长程操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过失败归因机制解耦抓取与运动规划的耦合失效，实现诊断驱动的双模块协同优化，从而提升长程操作的精度与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+任务指令+目标物体位姿
analysis.output: 动作序列（含抓取姿态与运动轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人失败轨迹数据用于训练失败归因模型
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实际诊断价值的失败归因机制并验证了双模块协同优化有效性，在真实Panda和多仿真体上验证了跨任务/机体泛化，但未开源数据、未提供消融证明归因模块的独立贡献，且未在VLA或扩散策略主干上做深度改造，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机+多任务+诊断驱动优化有实证，但归因机制设计较轻量、开源不全、未挑战长期开放难题，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT级分量。

papers.title: VLab4Mic: prediction of structural resolvability in super-resolution microscopy
papers.abstract: Determining whether a microscopy experiment can resolve a specific feature of a protein assembly remains difficult because researchers must balance imaging modality, labelling strategy, and probe choice. We present VLab4Mic, a simulation platform that predicts structural resolvability before experiments. Starting from atomic models from the PDB or AlphaFold predictions, VLab4Mic places antibodies, nanobodies, chemical linkers, or fluorescent proteins on epitopes, applies stochastic labelling and steric constraints, and generates virtual samples for widefield, confocal, AiryScan, Stimulated Emission Depletion (STED), and Single-Molecule Localisation Microscopy (SMLM). Comparisons with nuclear pore complex data show realistic agreement across modalities. Case studies show that HIV capsid appearance depends strongly on orientation, and that STED and SMLM distinguish domed from flat clathrin lattices, whereas confocal and AiryScan struggle. VLab4Mic thereby helps researchers predict which biological questions are experimentally tractable with a given imaging configuration before spending time finetuning imaging parameters at the microscope.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个叫VLab4Mic的仿真平台，能根据蛋白质原子结构（PDB或AlphaFold预测）模拟抗体/荧光蛋白等标记过程、空间位阻和随机标记，并生成多种超分辨显微镜（STED/SMLM/共聚焦等）下的虚拟图像，从而提前判断某种蛋白结构在特定成像条件下能否被分辨。
analysis.org: 伦敦大学学院/法国国家健康与医学研究院/伦敦国王学院（多机构合作，以UCL和CNRS为主；作者含Dylan M. Owen（UCL）、Christophe Leterrier（CNRS）、Ricardo Henriques（UCL/KCL））
analysis.claim: 通过从原子结构出发、整合生物物理约束（表位可及性、位阻、随机标记）与多模态光学成像物理模型，VLab4Mic可定量预测超分辨显微镜对特定蛋白组装结构的分辨能力，避免无效实验。
analysis.input: 蛋白质原子结构（PDB或AlphaFold预测）+ 用户指定的标记物类型（抗体/纳米体/荧光蛋白等）+ 表位位置 + 成像模态参数（STED/ SMLM/共聚焦等）
analysis.output: 虚拟显微图像（含点扩散函数、光子计数、背景噪声、标记效率等真实物理特征）及结构可分辨性评估（如两点间最小可分辨距离、形态保真度指标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；但验证时使用了真实核孔复合体（NPC）显微图像作为ground truth对照
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性打通‘原子结构→生化标记建模→多模态光学成像仿真→可分辨性量化评估’全链路，且经NPC等真实数据跨模态验证；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但显著填补AI×超分辨显微领域的关键方法空白，属扎实重磅工具型贡献（真机无关，但对生物成像实验设计有直接决策价值）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将结构生物学、标记化学与光学物理深度耦合为可复用仿真平台，证据扎实、验证充分、用途明确，但非理论突破或新算法范式

papers.title: Bridging the sim2real gap in the table tennis robot with a transformer-based ball states predictor
papers.abstract: Robotic table tennis is a representative benchmark for high-speed, closed-loop robotic control in dynamic environments, where accurate and fast prediction of ball states is critical for reliable planning and control. Physics-based approaches rely heavily on accurate parameter identification and precise initial state, while learning-based methods often struggle to capture long-range temporal dependencies and are typically trained on limited or simulated data. We propose a transformer-based framework for table tennis ball state prediction that leverages attention mechanisms to model long-range temporal correlations directly from historical observations, without relying on explicit flight or bounce models. To support robust learning and generalization, we collected a large-scale real-world dataset from players of varying skill levels and diverse ball cannon configurations. The combination of a high-capacity transformer architecture and extensive real-world data enables accurate long-horizon forecasting. Building on this capability, we introduce a plug-and-play sim-to-real transfer strategy, Swap Predictor at Deployment (SPAD), which replaces the physics-based simulator used during training with the proposed real-world-trained predictor at deployment, improving the sim-to-real transferability of the policy without requiring retraining. We demonstrate that this simple substitution effectively narrows the sim-to-real gap while preserving the efficiency and scalability of simulation-based training.

analysis.tldr: 用真实世界采集的大规模乒乓球轨迹数据训练一个Transformer模型直接预测球的状态（位置/速度等），不依赖物理模型；再在部署时把仿真训练中用的物理预测器换成这个真实数据训练的预测器，从而提升策略从仿真到真实机器人的迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 仅通过在部署阶段替换预测模块（SPAD），即可显著缩小仿真训练策略在真实乒乓球机器人上的性能落差，无需重新训练策略。
analysis.input: 历史多帧球的位置/速度观测序列（来自高速相机和传感器）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的球状态（3D位置、速度、旋转等）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研乒乓球机器人平台（含高速视觉+发球机+机械臂）

papers.title: HoloCell: A Generative Foundation Model for Holistic Cellular Modeling
papers.abstract: Single-cell multi-omics technologies have recently advanced to enable the profiling of epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic layers within individual cells, offering new opportunities to characterize cellular states as integrated biological systems. However, developing a unified framework that can seamlessly integrate diverse omics modalities and remain robust to heterogeneous modality missingness remains challenging. Here we present HoloCell, to our knowledge the first generative foundation model for joint representation learning and generative modeling across all three major single-cell omics modalities, i.e., epigenomics, transcriptomics, and proteomics. HoloCell contains over 860 million parameters and is pretrained on the Human-Multi-Omics-Corpus, which comprises approximately 468 million single-cell profiles across these three omics layers, corresponding to over 425 billion tokens. HoloCell introduces a simple yet biologically grounded hierarchical tokenization strategy that encodes cis-regulatory elements, genes, and proteins as structured tokens within a shared modeling framework. We evaluated HoloCell across single-omics representation learning, paired multi-omics integration, unpaired multi-omics alignment, and cross-modal generation via iterative diffusion and remasking, demonstrating its superior performance and flexibility across diverse omics tasks. From a representation perspective, HoloCell provides a unified digital mapping of cellular states across multiple omics layers, capturing cell heterogeneity as an integrated system. From a generation perspective, its iterative diffusion and remasking framework accounts for the inherently unordered nature of biological features, enabling in silico simulation of multi-omics information flow. Together, these capabilities position HoloCell as a versatile foundation model toward the emerging concept of a virtual cell, offering both systematic characterization and generative simulation of cellular systems within a unified framework.

analysis.tldr: 提出HoloCell模型，一个8.6亿参数的生成式基础模型，用分层生物学token化策略统一建模单细胞表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组三组学数据，在缺失模态鲁棒性、跨模态生成（如从ATAC生成蛋白）、多组学对齐等任务上展示强泛化能力，目标是构建‘虚拟细胞’的数字映射与仿真引擎。

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Arm Reaching for a Humanoid Robot via Deep Reinforcement Learning with Identified Power Models
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots performing in-field manipulation tasks, such as robotic apple harvesting, face severe energy constraints that directly limit the number of reaching motions that can be executed per battery charge. This paper presents an end-to-end, energy-aware reinforcement learning framework for the 7-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot, combining a physics-based, experimentally identified electrical power model with a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) policy trained in a Pinocchio-based rigid-body dynamics simulator. The RL policy operates on an incremental joint-position action space and is trained with a Hybrid Constellation Reward that combines a four-point end-effector constellation distance with a torque-norm energy proxy; after % $5\times10^6$ training it reaches a $69.9\%$ success rate over $1\,000$ random targets in kinematic simulation, at a mean energy of \SI{98.16}{\joule} on successful episodes. Finally, on the physical Unitree~G1, the policy is validated over three independent 10-target batches, achieving a mean energy of $71.5 \pm 48.3$\,J, an end-effector position error of $2.64 \pm 1.04$\,cm, and an orientation error of $6.92 \pm 1.33^\circ$ -- within the \SI{4}{\centi\metre}/$8.6^\circ$ training tolerance. These results constitute a first step toward energy-aware reinforcement-learning-based arm reaching for humanoid robots.

analysis.tldr: 用深度强化学习控制人形机器人手臂运动，核心是把实测得到的电机功耗模型嵌入训练过程，让策略在仿真中学会省电地到达目标位置，并在真实Unitree G1机器人上验证了能耗和精度。

papers.title: Be Your Own Teacher: Steering Protein Language Models via Unsupervised Reward Optimization
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for controllable biomolecular design, yet their post-training adaptation typically relies on costly wet-lab validation or curated preference datasets. To overcome this supervision bottleneck, we introduce unsupervised reward optimization of PLMs, a comprehensive framework for steerable protein generation without ground-truth labels. Our key insight is that task-agnostic rewards, which combine intrinsic model uncertainty with extrinsic semantic consistency informed by protein representation models, exhibit strong correlation with controllability measures across base models and temperature regimes. Building upon this discovery, we propose two offline algorithms: Soft Reward Optimization (SRO) and Binarized Reward Optimization (BRO), which effectively maximize the classical RLHF objective induced by these proxy rewards. Extensive experiments on compositional out-of-distribution prompts demonstrate that both methods significantly outperform competitive baselines (DPO, KTO), while approaching oracle performance across multiple sampling temperatures, model scales and protein families. Moreover, PLMs fine-tuned with unsupervised rewards can achieve consistently higher coverage compared to their base model in pass@k evaluations. By enabling self-improvement of PLMs through their own generated experience, our framework provides a scalable pathway toward controllable biomolecular design in settings where labeled preferences or experimental feedback are scarce or unavailable.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需实验验证或人工标注偏好的方法，让蛋白质语言模型通过自身生成的序列和内在不确定性+语义一致性构成的代理奖励来自我优化，从而提升对复杂提示（如跨蛋白家族、组合型OOD提示）的可控生成能力。

papers.title: GENATATORs: ab initio Gene Annotation With DNA Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Inference of gene structure and location from genome sequences - known as de novo gene annotation - is a fundamental task in biological research. However, sequence grammar encoding gene structure is complex and poorly understood, often requiring costly transcriptomic data for accurate gene annotation. In this work, we benchmark current solutions and develop new methods of gene annotation. We show that pre-trained DNA language model (DNA LM) embeddings do not capture the features necessary for precise gene segmentation, and that task-specific fine-tuning remains essential. We comprehensively evaluate the impact of model architecture, training strategy, receptive field size, dataset composition, and data augmentations on gene segmentation performance. We revisit standard evaluation protocols, showing that commonly used per-token and per-sequence metrics fail to capture the challenges of real-world gene annotation. We introduce and theoretically justify new biologically grounded metrics, along with benchmarking datasets that better capture annotation quality. We show that fine-tuned DNA LMs outperform existing annotation tools, generalizing across species separated by hundreds of millions of years from those seen during training, and providing segmentation of previously intractable non-coding transcripts and untranslated regions of protein-coding genes. Our results thus provide a foundation for new biological applications centered on accurate gene annotation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用DNA语言模型做从头基因注释（即仅靠DNA序列预测基因结构），发现预训练DNA模型的嵌入不够用，必须任务微调；它系统分析了模型结构、训练策略等影响因素，提出新的生物学合理评估指标和基准数据集，并证明微调后的DNA模型能跨物种泛化、准确标注非编码转录本和UTR区域。

papers.title: Whole genome sequencing of endometrial cancer identifies novel subgroups, drivers, and actionable alterations
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Endometrial cancer (EC) is the most common gynaecological malignancy in high income countries, and is increasing in incidence. While molecular stratification has improved its management, precision care is hampered by incomplete characterization of the EC genome. We address this by analysis of whole genome sequencing (WGS) of 665 ECs generated by the UK Genomics England 100,000 Genome Project (100kGP). 5% of cases were associated with germline pathogenic variants in cancer genes, including BRCA1 which we confirmed predisposes to EC. We identified 107 putative coding driver genes, 35% of which had no prior established role in EC. Novel structural variants included gains of MYCN and loss of its negative regulator NEDD4.1 which were significantly mutually exclusive in copy number (CN) high tumours. Immunogenomic analysis confirmed selection for driver alterations of low immunogenicity based on patient HLA haplotype, and pervasive immune escape through multiple mechanisms. Unsupervised clustering of mutational signatures and genomic alterations identified known and novel molecular subgroups, including a CN-high subset with mutational signatures of homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) and favourable outcome. Independent prognostic value of single nucleotide variant (SNV) burden, CN burden and multiple coding drivers, along with the identification of targetable molecular alterations in over one-third of cases, underscores the promise of WGS for precision medicine in EC.

analysis.tldr: 对665例子宫内膜癌患者进行全基因组测序，发现5%病例携带胚系致病突变（包括新确认的BRCA1易感性），鉴定出107个潜在驱动基因（35%此前未被报道与子宫内膜癌相关），识别出新型结构变异（如MYCN扩增与NEDD4.1缺失互斥）、HRD样CN-high新亚型（预后较好），并证实超1/3患者存在可靶向治疗的分子改变。

papers.title: DynaMOMA: Instantaneous Prediction of Grasp Poses for Mobile Manipulation of Dynamic Objects
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation is a fundamental robotics task and has advanced rapidly in recent years, enabling robots to navigate, reach, and interact with objects in complex environments. However, mobile manipulation of dynamic objects remains highly challenging, as robots must coordinate the mobile base and arm while adapting to continuously evolving target poses. A key challenge lies in predicting temporally consistent short-horizon grasp trajectories from dynamic observations. In this work, we propose \ours{}, a dynamic mobile manipulation framework that couples instantaneous grasp trajectory prediction with whole-body control policy. Our predictor uses an anchor-based diffusion model to generate temporally consistent short-horizon grasp trajectories conditioned on historical observations. The predicted trajectories are then encoded as compact features and fed to a whole-body reinforcement learning policy, which controls the mobile manipulator for dynamic grasping. We further introduce a anticipation-guided reward that equips the policy with an anticipatory grasping horizon by adaptively shifting the target from the current grasp observation to the instantaneously predicted grasp trajectory. Through extensive experiments in Isaac Gym simulation, we show that our method achieves strong performance in mobile manipulation of dynamic objects across diverse settings and grasping metrics. Furthermore, our predictor and policy demonstrate strong generalizability in real-world experiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaMOMA框架，用锚点式扩散模型实时预测动态物体的短时抓取轨迹，并结合全身强化学习策略和前摄性奖励机制，在仿真中实现移动机械臂对运动物体的连续抓取，且在真实机器人上验证了泛化性。
