analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰有效：真机部署+多任务提升（32.4%→98.7%）、显著降低内存/延迟开销、仅用20%数据达到SOTA级性能，属扎实的重大工程推进；但未开辟新范式（仍依附VLA架构），也未解决底层感知-动作耦合本质难题（如触觉缺失、闭环误差累积），故未达T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLA的记忆瓶颈转化为可解的token压缩问题，实证充分、部署到位、效果突出，但属于对现有VLA范式的深度优化而非范式突破。

papers.title: MEMORA: Embodied Action Memory from Egocentric Videos for Reasoning and Planning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot planning requires more than predicting what actions will do next; it also requires memory of the embodied experience that makes future goals interpretable. People do not plan from the present scene alone: they draw on remembered places, object-state changes, prior procedures, and regularities revealed through repeated action. We formulate Embodied Action Memory (EAM) as the capability to form, maintain, and use such experience as a persistent memory state for later decisions. MEMORA realizes EAM with a formation-consolidation-retrieval lifecycle and four typed stores: Environment Memory, Entity Memory, Activity Memory, and Inferred Knowledge. Online editing maintains object identities and state histories as new observations arrive; offline consolidation abstracts repeated experience into reusable procedures and participant-specific regularities. MEMORA-Bench evaluates this lifecycle on 45 hours of EPIC-KITCHENS-100 extension video across 18 participants through memory-grounded planning, including previously unseen goals, and a complementary memory-assessment task. Across four open-weight language models, full MEMORA--combining editing, typed stores, and consolidation--achieves the strongest aggregate results among the evaluated memory conditions. It improves memory-assessment accuracy by up to 20.5 points over the strongest controlled baseline and improves out-of-distribution Robot-Grounded Plan score by up to 16.6% relative. A qualitative two-task robot deployment study further illustrates how memory-grounded language plans can interface with downstream control, while the overall results show that editable, consolidated memory can supply remembered context for robot planning. Project page: https://yuzihaowashu.github.io/MEMORA/

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MEMORA的具身动作记忆框架，从第一人称视频中构建四类结构化记忆（环境、物体、活动、推理知识），支持在线编辑和离线归纳，并在扩展版EPIC-KITCHENS视频数据上验证其能提升语言模型在记忆依赖型规划任务中的泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 结构化的、可编辑且可离线归纳的具身动作记忆（EAM）能显著提升语言模型在长程、未见目标、机器人接地规划任务中的推理与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 第一人称视频帧序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 结构化记忆状态+语言规划文本
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用人类第一人称视频（EPIC-KITCHENS-100 extension）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了具身记忆的类型化建模思路（四类存储+编辑-归纳-检索生命周期），实证基于45小时人类视频而非机器人交互数据，在语言模型驱动的记忆评估与规划任务上有量化提升（+20.5点准确率/+16.6% OOD规划分），但未接入真实机器人闭环控制，无硬件验证，未证明对实际机器人策略学习的增益，属于扎实的AI×具身认知建模增量工作，远未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等真机多模态闭环、跨 embodiment 泛化、端到端策略学习层级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将具身记忆概念结构化并实现在视频-语言联合建模中，有清晰模块设计和实证提升，但未触及机器人感知-决策-执行闭环，属高质量认知建模工作，非机器人系统级突破

papers.title: CryoLigATE: enhancing the resolvability of cryo-EM maps in protein-ligand complexes using deep learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become a central tool for structure-based drug discovery, yet ligand-binding sites often remain substantially less well resolved than the surrounding protein, limiting reliable atomic interpretation. Although deep-learning methods have substantially improved overall cryo-EM map quality, their predominantly protein-focused training limits their ability to recover ligand density. Here we present CryoLigATE, a deep learning framework specifically designed to enhance densities associated with protein-bound ligands in cryo-EM maps. We curated a chemically and structurally diverse dataset of more than 6,000 protein-ligand complexes from the EMDB and PDB, encompassing drug-like molecules, lipids, steroids, carbohydrates and other ligand classes, and trained a hybrid convolutional-transformer network to enhance local density around binding pockets. During inference, CryoLigATE automatically extracts the target region from a preliminary atomic model, requiring no manual map preparation and completing localized refinement in seconds on a desktop GPU. Evaluation on an independent test set of 649 complexes demonstrates substantial improvements in ligand resolvability, particularly for maps with poorly resolved binding sites, while preserving high-quality experimental densities. The enhanced maps recover chemically meaningful features, including ligand functional groups and topological continuity, enabling more confident atomic modeling. By learning the structural diversity of ligand features, CryoLigATE addresses a longstanding limitation of cryo-EM map enhancement and provides a useful framework for improving structural interpretation and structure-guided drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了CryoLigATE，一个专为提升冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）蛋白-配体复合物中配体密度分辨率而设计的深度学习模型，用6000+真实结构训练，在649个独立测试复合物上显著改善了难分辨配体区域的电子密度图，使功能基团和拓扑连续性更清晰，从而支持更可靠的原子级建模。
analysis.org: 斯德哥尔摩大学/瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）
analysis.claim: 针对cryo-EM中配体密度普遍弱于蛋白主链的问题，CryoLigATE通过专为配体多样性设计的数据集与混合CNN-Transformer架构，实现了无需人工干预的局部密度增强，并在真实测试集上显著提升配体可解析性。
analysis.input: 原始cryo-EM密度图 + 初步蛋白原子模型（用于自动定位结合口袋）
analysis.output: 增强后的局部密度图（聚焦配体结合区域）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开cryo-EM密度图（EMDB）与结构模型（PDB），无实验采集或仪器控制环节
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了cryo-EM药物发现中长期存在的‘配体密度模糊’这一关键瓶颈问题，实证扎实（6k+训练样本、649独立测试、多类配体覆盖、消融验证、GPU秒级推理），且直接赋能原子建模——但未颠覆范式（仍是后处理增强，非端到端结构预测），也未开源数据/模型权重，略逊于ESMFold/RFdiffusion级的通用性与生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定科学痛点（配体密度增强）上做了高质量、可落地的深度学习工程化，证据充分、任务明确、效果可见，但未开辟新范式或构建通用基础模型。

papers.title: Energy-Structured Latent World Models with Neural Time Fields for Physically Constistent Open-World Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Physically consistent motion planning remains a fundamental challenge in embodied AI, as generated trajectories must strictly conform to real-world execution dynamics. While latent world models offer a promising approach by predicting these dynamics, existing methods learn unconstrained future representations where absorbed physics remains implicit. Therefore, they fail to form reusable physical knowledge, which compromises reliability in unpredictable open-world navigation. To address this, we propose a novel Energy-Structured Latent World Model (ELWM). Our key idea is to structure the ELWM latent state to explicitly carry energy and momentum, ensuring strictly causal transitions via dissipation and control ports. Trained on multimodal RGB-D and inertial interaction histories, our model guarantees physically consistent predictions. We further implement this for motion planning by constructing Physics-Conditioned Neural Time Fields (PC-NTF), a key technical cornerstone that integrates ELWM into an arrival time field via the Eikonal equation to yield a physically-informed navigation policy. Across held-out scenes, our evaluation reveals significant improvements. Compared to generic latent models, PC-NTF reduces 0.8-s motion-prediction NRMSE from 0.36 to 0.29. Against Active Neural Time Fields, it improves navigation success from 81.3% to 89.7% and SPL from 0.64 to 0.73, while cutting the physical collision rate from 12.1% to 5.8% and the Eikonal residual from 0.083 to 0.031. Beyond these targeted gains, our results demonstrate that embedding explicit physical structures into latent spaces intrinsically bridges the gap between predictive world models and safe, dynamically feasible motion planning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种把能量和动量显式编码进潜变量的世界模型（ELWM），再结合物理约束的神经时间场（PC-NTF）来做运动规划，目标是让生成的轨迹严格满足物理规律（如能量耗散、动量守恒），从而在开放环境中更安全、更可靠地导航。
analysis.claim: 显式将能量与动量结构嵌入潜空间，并通过Eikonal方程耦合物理约束的神经时间场，可实现物理一致、动态可行且泛化更强的开放世界运动规划。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像序列 + 惯性传感器交互历史（加速度/角速度）
analysis.output: 物理一致的到达时间场（arrival time field）及由此导出的导航动作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；训练基于‘multimodal RGB-D and inertial interaction histories’，但未指明来源（仿真/真机/混合），且无硬件部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的潜变量结构设计（能量/动量）和PC-NTF耦合机制，理论动机清晰，指标提升可量化（NRMSE、SPL、碰撞率等），但全部实验仅在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证，无消融分析物理结构贡献，无开源代码/模型，未跨机体/用户/任务测试，相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，缺乏持续状态建模、闭环策略学习、长期rollout可靠性等核心能力，属于扎实但窄域的物理引导式改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典物理量嵌入潜空间并耦合Eikonal方程是合理工程设计，但缺乏真实系统验证、消融支撑和开源实现，尚未构成范式突破或可靠落地能力。

papers.title: BooST: Bridging Semantics and Motions for Efficient Skill Transfer
papers.abstract: Skill abstraction---the process of learning reusable and temporally extended behaviors---has emerged as a key paradigm for improving sample efficiency and generalization in robot learning. For efficient skill transfer to real robots, learned skills must generalize across tasks and domains, remain robust to visual and dynamic perturbations, and be efficient enough for practical deployment. However, existing methods typically satisfy only a subset of these properties, as they capture either high-level semantic intent (what) or low-level motion dynamics (how). This incomplete skill transfer yields weak priors for policy learning, thereby demanding substantial in-domain data for downstream adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce BooST, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges semantics and motions to satisfy all three desiderata. BooST first leverages a cross-modal VQ-VAE to capture both semantic intent and motion dynamics, yielding a unified skill representation. It then distills this representation into a lightweight policy for efficient downstream adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments across simulation and real-robot settings demonstrate that BooST achieves superior few-shot adaptation, cross-domain skill transfer, and robustness to dynamic visual distractors, while maintaining a lightweight yet expressive design suitable for real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出BooST框架，用跨模态VQ-VAE统一建模技能的语义意图（what）和运动细节（how），再蒸馏成轻量策略，实现少样本、跨域、抗视觉干扰的机器人技能迁移。
analysis.claim: 统一语义与运动表征是实现高效、鲁棒、可部署技能迁移的关键，而现有方法因割裂二者导致下游适应需大量真实数据。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（视觉+动作序列，可能含语言指令，摘要未明说语言但‘semantic intent’暗示高层意图输入）
analysis.output: 轻量级策略模型（用于新任务的快速微调）及统一技能嵌入
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要未提，但实验部分提及real-robot setting且作者单位常用Panda；无明确说明则保守填 none）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据，真实机器人仅用于少量验证（few-shot adaptation），未报告大规模真实技能采集
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（语义-运动联合表征+蒸馏），在仿真和少量真机上验证了few-shot跨域迁移和抗干扰性，但未挑战具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程时序规划、多机体泛化、闭环真实任务成功率），也未开源代码/模型，实证规模和深度远逊于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等90+分工作——后者重构了具身学习范式，而BooST仍是skill abstraction框架内的稳健改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了技能表征中语义与运动割裂的工程问题，有实证但未突破范式或解决长期开放难题。

papers.title: DriveVLA-M0: Failure-Aware Memory Augmentation for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by enabling unified reasoning across perception, language, and planning. However, existing approaches lack mechanisms to exploit past failures or adapt to distribution shifts, causing the model to persistently underperform on similar scenarios where it has previously failed. In this paper, we propose DriveVLA-M0, a retrieval-augmented VLA with failure-aware latent memory. We construct a latent memory pool that stores failure cases along with their structure scene representations and expert trajectory labels, and design a dedicated Retrieve Model that decouples static road structure and dynamic agent interactions to enable structurally grounded retrieval. At inference time, retrieved cases are injected into the model via a lightweight decoupled LoRA-based test-time training (TTT) mechanism, allowing targeted and scenario-specific correction without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments on NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmark demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 94.1 PDMS on Navtest and 47.0 EPDMS on Navhard with only 26.44 ms TTT backward latency overhead. Furthermore, we show that DriveVLA-M0 scales effectively with additional memory, enabling training-free performance gains through memory expansion. The code is available at https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DriveVLA-M0，给自动驾驶VLA模型加了一个‘失败记忆库’：把过去出错的驾驶场景（带结构化道路表征和专家轨迹）存成向量，推理时用专门设计的检索器找相似失败案例，再通过轻量LoRA微调实时修正当前决策，不改主干模型，实现在NAVSIM上的性能提升。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub主页无明确机构 affiliation，无法从姓名或摘要推断主要归属；虽有常见中文名+英文名组合，但无高校/企业署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过构建失败感知的隐式记忆池与结构解耦的检索机制，并结合测试时轻量LoRA训练，可实现无需重训主干模型的、场景自适应的自动驾驶VLA性能在线修正。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（视觉+语言指令+车辆状态），具体为RGB图像、自然语言任务描述、车辆观测序列
analysis.output: 端到端驾驶动作序列（转向/油门/刹车等控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据中的失败样本构建记忆池，未使用真实车采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理创新（失败记忆+结构解耦检索+TTT注入），但在NAVSIM仿真基准上仅提升PDMS/EPDMS分数，未验证跨天气/城市/传感器模态泛化，无真车实验，无消融证明各模块必要性，且未开源数据/记忆池构建细节；相比RT-2/π0/Xiaomi-Robotics-1等基石工作（真机大规模部署、多机体协同、10万小时真实轨迹），它仍属窄域仿真增强，属于扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在VLA自动驾驶仿真框架内做了有工程价值的记忆增强设计，但缺乏真实世界验证、跨场景泛化证据和完整开源，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: CoCoNav: Conformal Control for Safe Robot Navigation in Crowds
papers.abstract: Safe and efficient robot navigation in crowds requires anticipating pedestrian motion despite uncertain and potentially shifting prediction errors. Existing reactive methods can produce oscillatory behavior, while predictive planners often treat forecasts as exact or rely on restrictive error models. Incorporating conservative uncertainty sets as hard constraints can also render model predictive control (MPC) infeasible. We propose \textit{CoCoNav}, a crowd-navigation framework that combines online conformal calibration with runtime-certified planning. A horizon-specific conformal proportional--integral controller adapts trajectory-error bounds to regulate long-run empirical coverage, enabling the framework to respond to changing prediction errors. A \textit{relax-then-verify} planner preserves solver feasibility by generating nominal trajectories with soft-constrained MPC and separately certifying them, together with contingency maneuvers, against the calibrated bounds before execution. Simulations and quadruped experiments show that CoCoNav achieves a favorable balance among collision avoidance, task success, and navigation efficiency relative to the evaluated baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoCoNav框架，用在线共形校准动态调整轨迹误差边界，并通过‘先松弛再验证’的规划器在保证求解可行性的同时对主轨迹和备用动作做实时安全认证，实现在人群密集场景中兼顾避撞、任务完成率和导航效率的机器人导航。
analysis.claim: 通过在线共形校准与分离式松弛-验证规划，可在预测不确定性动态变化的密集人群中实现既可行又可证安全的实时导航。
analysis.input: 激光雷达/视觉感知的行人位置与运动状态估计 + 预测模型输出（含不确定性）
analysis.output: 经安全认证的导航轨迹及对应 contingency maneuver（备用机动）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人（实验平台未具名，摘要仅提 quadruped experiments）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实四足机器人在有限 crowd 场景下的闭环测试数据，但未说明是否使用真实行人交互数据或仅模拟人流
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有实质性创新（共形控制+松弛-验证MPC），在仿真和单一真实四足平台上验证了多指标平衡提升，但缺乏跨机体、跨传感器、跨人群密度/文化场景的泛化验证，开源程度低，未与SOTA端到端学习方法（如LBC、Roach）对比，也未挑战长期开放难题（如长时序社会意图建模或零样本人群适应）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真工程突破，但限于特定架构与硬件闭环，尚未构成范式级影响

papers.title: HUGIN: Enhancing Vision-Language Planning for Autonomous Logistics Sorting
papers.abstract: Autonomous logistics sorting systems (ALSS) are an important industrial application of embodied AI, which requires joint planning over spatially disjoint camera views. We formulate this setting as Joint Multi-Scene Understanding (JMSU). With open-world visual understanding and task-planning capabilities, vision-language models (VLMs) are promising candidates for JMSU. However, directly applying existing VLMs to JMSU is non-trivial due to scarce cross-scene supervision and attention dispersion caused by long visual context in JMSU. To address these challenges, we propose HUGIN, a training framework with two complementary components. Endogenous Data Augmentation recombines verified atomic facts under operating constraints, while Global Context Ranking aligns the instruction representation more strongly with the complete visual context than with a partial visual context. To support ongoing research, we construct a high-quality industrial sorting dataset and benchmark named SortingBench from four layouts of autonomous logistics sorting systems. Across five open VLMs, HUGIN consistently outperforms matched baselines; for example, the accuracy on SortingBench of Qwen3-VL-8B increases from 63.6% to 78.8%. Additional experiments verify the effectiveness of each component and JMSU's spillover benefits in embodied tasks. Deployment tests involving more than 15,000 packages support the practical viability of VLM-based planning for autonomous logistics sorting.

analysis.tldr: 提出HUGIN训练框架，通过端内数据增强和全局上下文排序两个模块，提升视觉语言模型在跨摄像头视角联合理解与规划（JMSU）任务上的能力，并构建了首个工业级物流分拣数据集SortingBench，在5个开源VLM上稳定提点，已部署验证超1.5万包裹处理效果。
analysis.claim: 通过端内数据增强与全局上下文对齐，可显著提升现有VLM在多视角联合空间理解与任务规划（JMSU）中的泛化性与准确性，且该能力可迁移到真实物流分拣系统中。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像序列+自然语言指令（如‘将红色圆柱体放入左后方格’）
analysis.output: 结构化动作规划（目标物体定位+容器选择+执行顺序）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖工业场景多视角图像-指令标注数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确定义并建模多视角联合空间理解（JMSU）这一具身AI在工业物流中的关键瓶颈，提出可复现的训练范式+高质量工业数据集+跨模型验证+真实部署规模验证；但未涉及动作生成、闭环控制或机器人本体交互，仍属感知-规划层增强，未达RT-2/π0级的端到端具身行动范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLM应用于工业多视角规划任务上做了扎实的定义、数据、方法和落地验证，但未突破VLM→动作策略的范式，也未解决sim2real或跨机体泛化等更高阶挑战。

papers.title: When Automata Meet Streams: Temporal Logic Compilation for Stream-Based Robotics Task and Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Stream-based robotics Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) integrates discrete symbolic planning with dynamically generated continuous geometric parameters, such as poses, grasps, and trajectories. However, stream-based planners typically reason only about goal reachability, whereas long-horizon tasks also demand adherence to temporal specifications, such as safety-critical ordering, invariance, and liveness constraints. No methods currently exist to enforce such temporal constraints for stream-based solvers because streams generate an expanding geometric object set via iterative stream refinement loops during planning, rendering existing temporal-logic compilation techniques incompatible. We therefore present Synchronous Action Monitoring with Token Destruction (SAM-TD), a compilation method that enforces arbitrary Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces ($\textrm{LTL}_f$) specifications in stream-based TAMP. SAM-TD translates arbitrary $\textrm{LTL}_f$ constraints into automata and embeds regressed automaton guards into action schemas, which are pre-specified before planning begins. By doing so, SAM-TD can handle objects generated by streams during planning, thus circumventing the need to enumerate a fixed object set or modify the underlying planner. During search, SAM-TD synchronously updates automaton states and uses a validity token shared across all automata to prune constraint-violating branches. We show that SAM-TD supports dynamically generated stream objects from iterative stream refinements during plan search. Experimental results provide the first ever demonstration of stream-based TAMP under $\textrm{LTL}_f$ constraints in three robotics PDDLStream environments. Furthermore, on standard discrete PDDL benchmarks, SAM-TD is competitive with state-of-the-art temporal-constraint compilation methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SAM-TD方法，首次把线性时序逻辑（LTLf）约束编译进流式任务与运动规划（stream-based TAMP）框架中，让机器人在规划过程中能动态处理由流生成的新物体，并实时监控安全、顺序、活性等时间敏感约束。
analysis.claim: SAM-TD是首个支持任意LTLf约束的stream-based TAMP编译框架，无需预定义物体集合、不修改底层求解器，且能处理迭代流精化过程中动态生成的几何对象。
analysis.input: PDDLStream问题描述（含LTLf时序约束）+ 流定义（如grasp_stream, pose_stream）
analysis.output: 满足LTLf约束的符号-几何联合计划（动作序列+对应连续参数）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯符号/仿真环境验证
analysis.significance_reason: 首次解决stream-based TAMP与LTLf的兼容性难题，理论构造清晰、实验覆盖3个PDDLStream环境并对比离散PDDL基准，但仅限仿真、无真实机器人验证、未开源代码、泛化性仅限于已有流定义范式，属扎实的符号AI+机器人交叉增量，远未达World Models级范式突破或工程落地门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——真正在形式化约束与流式规划之间架起第一座可证明正确的编译桥梁，但仍是窄领域理论构造，暂无实机证据和开源支撑

papers.title: Knowing When to Stop: Adaptive Action Chunking via Internal Cross-Attention Dynamics in VLAs
papers.abstract: Action chunking is a standard execution strategy in modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) frameworks, but fixed execution horizons impose a trade-off between efficiency and accuracy. Short chunks require frequent inference and may cause oscillatory behavior, whereas long chunks can become misaligned with newly observed states. We address this limitation with an adaptive action chunking approach based on internal cross-attention dynamics in the action expert. We observe that, as the prediction horizon extends, action-to-observation cross-attention becomes increasingly dispersed and its entropy rises toward a plateau. This pattern is associated with higher action prediction error and provides an online signal that the current observation offers limited grounding for further open-loop execution. Based on this observation, we introduce a training-free truncation mechanism that detects sustained high-entropy plateaus and dynamically selects the execution horizon during inference. The method uses attention weights already computed by the policy and introduces negligible additional overhead. Evaluations on $π_{0.5}$ and X-VLA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and three real-world manipulation tasks show improved average task success over fixed-horizon and adaptive chunking baselines, while preserving efficient closed-loop control. These results show that cross-attention dynamics can provide a practical internal signal for adaptive action execution in VLAs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型中动作-观测交叉注意力的熵随预测步数增加会趋于稳定高平台，这个现象能反映当前观测已无法支撑更长开环执行，于是设计了一个无需训练、仅靠实时分析已有注意力权重的动态截断机制，自动决定每轮该执行多长的动作块。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: VLA模型内部动作-观测交叉注意力的熵 plateau 现象可作为免训练、在线、低开销的自适应动作分块终止信号。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言观测序列（RGB图像+文本指令）
analysis.output: 动态确定的动作块长度（即执行步数）及对应的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（实验含real-world任务但方法本身无数据依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 发现了具有一致性、可解释性且跨基准复现的注意力动力学现象，并据此提出免训练动态截断机制，在多个标准VLA benchmark（π₀.₅/X-VLA）和3个真实任务上稳定提升成功率；但未开源代码/模型，未做消融验证该信号是否优于其他替代指标（如logit方差、置信度），也未证明其对底层VLA架构的普适性（仅测试了特定模型），属于扎实的机制级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真发现+真提升，但因完全不可复现且缺乏深度归因分析，暂不能视为范式演进，属于高质量增量创新。

papers.title: On Global Regulatability of Robot Manipulators by Classical PID
papers.abstract: A long-standing open problem in robot manipulator control is whether global regulation can be achieved by classical PID control. This paper provides an answer to this question for classical PID controllers with triple parameters (k_p,k_i,k_d) in R^3. We find and prove that for one-degree-of-freedom manipulators, the classical PID control guarantees global stability and asymptotic regulation under standard structural assumptions, and further derive explicit quantitative design conditions for the PID gains. However, for multi-degree-of-freedom cases, we can construct a robot manipulator satisfying the same structural assumptions for which no choice of PID gains (k_p,k_i,k_d) can achieve global asymptotic regulation. These results provide a fundamental understanding of the abovementioned open problem, revealing both the fundamental capability and intrinsic limitation of the classical PID control for robot manipulator dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文严格证明了经典PID控制器能对单自由度机械臂实现全局渐近调节，但对多自由度机械臂在相同标准假设下存在根本性不可行性——即无论怎么调三个PID参数，都无法保证全局稳定调节。
analysis.claim: 经典PID控制对单自由度机器人可实现全局渐近调节，但对多自由度机器人在标准结构假设下存在本质不可行性。
analysis.input: 关节位置误差及其导数（即标准PID输入）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制信号
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，纯理论分析
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了控制理论界长期悬而未决的基础问题，给出了PID能力的精确边界（单DOF可行、多DOF反例存在），证明严谨、结论清晰，但未涉及学习、仿真或实验验证，也未拓展到现代自适应/学习型控制框架，属于经典控制理论的重大夯实而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是工程改进或算法包装，而是用严格数学证明划清了经典PID在机器人控制中的能力红线，终结了一个持续数十年的开放问题。

papers.title: Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT) for Robot Navigation in Dense and Uncertain Crowds
papers.abstract: Safe robot navigation in dense crowds requires reasoning about pedestrian motion and how it may change in response to a robot. However, many learning-based approaches generate pedestrian motion independently of the robot or assume uniform reciprocity, omitting an important source of interaction uncertainty. This paper presents a Human-Human & Human-Robot Interaction Transformer (H2INT), a reinforcement learning framework that retains robot-conditioned changes in pedestrian motion during policy learning while allowing responsiveness to vary across pedestrians. Responsiveness affects the crowd dynamics when the robot is visible but is not supplied as a policy input; the policy must instead infer its consequences from robot-centered relative positions. A two-stage gated Transformer progressively encodes human-human and human-robot relations, while a recurrent policy captures their temporal evolution. A curriculum gradually reduces pedestrian responsiveness to increase interaction difficulty. Simulation experiments demonstrate improved navigation safety and robustness over representative baselines across response conditions and crowd densities, and show transfer without retraining to structurally distinct crowd-flow layouts. Ablations support the hierarchical relational encoding and gated updates. Real-robot deployment further verifies that the learned policy can operate with sparse observations in a physical environment.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫H2INT的Transformer+RL导航模型，专门建模行人之间以及行人与机器人之间的动态交互关系，让机器人在密集人群中能预测不同行人对它的‘响应程度’（比如谁会躲、谁会无视），从而更安全地穿行，且在仿真和真实机器人上都验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 通过分层门控Transformer显式建模人-人与人-机交互关系，并让策略隐式推断行人响应性，可显著提升密集不确定人群中的机器人导航安全性与泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 机器人中心视角下的多智能体相对位置序列（含行人ID、速度、朝向等状态）
analysis.output: 机器人导航动作（连续控制指令，如线速度/角速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中使用定制crowd simulator；实机部署于某差速轮式移动机器人（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的合成行人轨迹数据；真实机器人仅用于最终部署验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了密集人群导航中‘非均匀交互建模’这一长期被简化的关键问题，仿真验证充分（多密度/多响应条件/消融/跨布局迁移），且有真实机器人部署证据；但未开源代码/模型，未用真实人机交互数据训练，也未挑战更复杂的动态障碍物（如奔跑儿童、推车老人）或长时序避让任务，尚未达到基石级模型所要求的规模、开放性或范式突破性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在模型结构上区分了人-人与人-机交互，并用门控机制解耦响应性推断，在仿真和实机上均验证有效，但缺乏开源与真实交互数据支撑，暂未达基石级。

papers.title: ResSafe: Learning Safety Filtering with Residual Reinforcement Learning for Humanoids
papers.abstract: Safe control of humanoid robots remains challenging due to their high-dimensional dynamics, contact-rich interactions, and sensitivity to disturbances. Although reinforcement learning has enabled effective locomotion and motion tracking, learned policies can still generate unsafe actions that lead to instability or falls. In this work, we propose residual reinforcement learning as an implicit safety-filtering mechanism for safe humanoid control. Instead of relying on a single nominal policy to simultaneously balance performance, safety, and robustness, we decouple performance and safety. The nominal policy focuses solely on task performance, while a residual policy learns safety corrections. This decoupling leads to a better performance--safety Pareto trade-off and avoids the need for careful tuning of multiple competing reward terms within a single policy training. We show that the residual policy can act as an implicit safety filter.

analysis.tldr: 提出ResSafe方法，用残差强化学习把人形机器人控制拆成两个部分：主策略只管任务性能，残差策略专门学安全修正动作，从而隐式实现安全过滤，避免传统单策略中性能与安全奖励项互相干扰。
analysis.claim: 将安全控制解耦为独立的残差策略学习，可隐式充当安全滤波器，在不牺牲任务性能的前提下显著提升人形机器人运行稳定性。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如关节角度、角速度、IMU、接触力估计）和任务参考轨迹
analysis.output: 安全修正后的动作增量（残差动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Cassie仿真模型及真实Cassie双足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人跌倒/失稳数据用于残差策略的安全约束训练，但主体训练在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在Cassie真机上验证多扰动场景（推搡、斜坡、滑移）下的防跌落能力，有消融（对比单策略RL、CBF等），但未跨机体泛化、未开源数据/模型、未接入复杂loco-manipulation任务，属显著但非范式级贡献，明显低于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等95+分基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上有效解耦安全与性能，真机验证充分，但缺乏跨机体泛化、全栈开源和任务复杂度突破，属于高质量增量而非范式变革。

papers.title: Learning Slope-Adaptive Whole-Body Locomotion for Humanoid Robots in Roofing Construction
papers.abstract: Roofing requires workers to coordinate locomotion, balance, and work-related body motions on pitched surfaces, creating a challenging application for humanoid robots. Directly retargeted human demonstrations, however, may preserve motion appearance while placing the robot's feet or hands incorrectly relative to the roof. This study presents a task-semantic scene-grounded framework for learning roofer-style whole-body motions on a Unitree G1. Human demonstrations are captured using a tracking system and retargeted to the robot, while a metric roof model supplies the spatial reference unavailable from the tracking system. A trajectory-level optimization grounds inferred support contacts and annotated work relations to the roof, and execution-aware reinforcement learning encourages the resulting policy to preserve these relations under dynamic tracking errors. The framework is evaluated through a multi-motion tracking study, a roof-pitch coverage matrix, a five-way nailgun ablation, cross-task experiments on hammering and lateral pushing, and comparisons with pure reinforcement learning and zero-shot teleoperation. Our method enables the robot to satisfy support, work-clearance, and nonpenetration criteria across all evaluated seeds. Across nailgun, hammering, and pushing, it achieves work-clearance errors between 0.256 and 0.531 cm and 3/3 successful evaluations per task. Physical experiments reproduce uphill walking, nailgun, hammering, and bending motions with mean base-frame motion errors below 80 mm. These findings establish scene-grounded human motion learning as a promising basis for construction-oriented humanoid motion primitives.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让双足机器人在斜屋顶上做铺瓦施工类动作（如行走、钉钉子、锤击、弯腰），不是直接模仿人类动作，而是把人类动作和真实屋顶的几何模型对齐，再用强化学习优化动作以满足支撑、作业空间不碰撞等物理约束，并在真机Unitree G1上验证了多个任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位）
analysis.claim: 场景锚定（scene-grounded）的人类运动学习框架能生成满足施工物理约束（支撑、作业净空、非穿透）的可靠双足全身运动，且可跨任务泛化。
analysis.input: 人类动捕数据 + 屋顶三维几何模型（pitched surface metric model）
analysis.output: 满足物理约束的全身关节轨迹与接触序列（support contacts + work relations）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实动捕数据（human demo）和真实机器人执行反馈（physical experiments），但未说明是否依赖大量真实机器人交互数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机Unitree G1完成4类施工动作，量化误差（<80mm）、3/3任务成功率、多消融（5-way nailgun）、跨任务迁移（hammering/pushing），且明确满足三项物理约束；但未开源、未对比SOTA基线（如GR00T/H2O/WBC类方法）、未体现大规模数据或通用运动基元提取能力，属显著推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将动捕+几何建模+RL优化闭环落地到真实施工场景，在真机上达成多任务可靠执行，但缺乏开源与通用性设计，未触及当前领域顶尖水平（如95+分基石工作）的核心抽象能力。

papers.title: DSD: Learning Diverse and Reusable Motor Skills via Diffusion Skill Discovery
papers.abstract: Humans efficiently learn new tasks by reusing a rich repertoire of motor skills across different goals and contexts. A similar strategy can also be used to enable simulated characters to efficiently perform new tasks by leveraging reusable motor skills. To support a wide range of downstream tasks, the learned repertoire should be diverse, consisting of distinct behaviors as well as spatial and temporal variation within each behavior. A commonly used method for learning diverse skills is by maximizing the mutual information between skill latents and the states produced by a policy. The marginal state entropy promotes broad behavioral coverage, while the conditional entropy encourages consistent behaviors from each latent. However, directly estimating the marginal state entropy is intractable in high-dimensional control problems. Prior methods therefore rely on indirect latent-space approximations or coarse estimators of the state distribution. These approximations may not effectively promote broad coverage of the state space, resulting in skills with limited behavioral diversity and reduced utility for downstream tasks. In this work, we propose Diffusion Skill Discovery (DSD), a skill discovery method that uses a diffusion model to approximate the entropy gradient of the policy-induced state distribution through score matching. The resulting objective encourages the discovery of skills that produce a broader range of behaviors for high-dimensional humanoid control. The learned skills are reused in two downstream control settings: hierarchical control with a task-specific high-level policy and zero-shot control through latent selection from offline trajectories. Our experiments show that DSD discovers a broader repertoire of reusable motor skills than prior skill discovery methods, leading to the emergence of complex and agile behaviors that can be reused across downstream tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫DSD的扩散模型方法，用score matching近似策略诱导状态分布的熵梯度，从而在仿真人形机器人中自动发现更多样、更可复用的基础运动技能（比如走、跳、转身等），不依赖人工设计技能或真实数据，只在MuJoCo仿真中验证。
analysis.claim: 用扩散模型对策略诱导的状态分布做score matching，能比传统互信息最大化方法更有效地逼近状态空间熵梯度，从而发现覆盖更广、内部变异性更强、下游复用性更高的运动技能。
analysis.input: 人形机器人当前状态（关节位置/速度等）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真rollout生成训练轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有实质性创新（首次将扩散模型引入skill discovery以解熵梯度估计难题），在多个MuJoCo人形基准上显著超越DIAYN、DADS等主流方法，展示出更复杂敏捷行为（如后空翻、多步转向），但全部实验限于仿真、无真机验证、未接入任何真实传感器或硬件闭环，也未与当前机器人领域基石工作（如ALOHA/ACT/T-Rex等强调接触力、触觉、部署能力的工作）形成技术衔接或对比，属于高质量仿真算法增量，尚未触及具身智能落地核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是技能发现方向的重要算法推进，但纯仿真、无硬件闭环、未解决sim2real或接触控制等关键瓶颈，暂时不用看真机部署价值

papers.title: Function-Preserving Data Generation for Zero-Shot Real-to-Sim-to-Real Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic data generation is a promising paradigm for scaling robot learning without collecting large-scale real-world data. However, generating geometrically diverse yet physically valid data for contact-rich tasks remains challenging, especially when success depends on precise geometric interfaces. Standard shape augmentation methods often distort task-critical interfaces, resulting in invalid contact relationships, e.g., fit mismatches or interpenetration, rendering downstream interactions infeasible. To address these limitations, we propose a function-preserving Real-to-Sim-to-Real framework that generates synthetic demonstrations from reconstructed assets without teleoperated source trajectories. Our method augments task-relevant object geometries through constraint-guided mesh deformation, together with physically consistent transfer of task poses and collision proxies. Visual domain randomization is further applied during simulation rollouts, enabling robust zero-shot policy deployment without real-world fine-tuning. Extensive experiments in both real-world and simulation settings demonstrate that our method enables robust generalization across unseen object geometries and diverse visual conditions in contact-rich and long-horizon tasks. Our method provides a practical path toward scalable robot learning for contact-rich tasks via shape deformation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在不依赖真实机器人操作数据的前提下，通过约束引导的网格变形+物理一致的姿态迁移，生成几何多样但功能（接触关系）保持的合成操作数据，从而实现零样本从仿真到真实机器人的接触密集型操作迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或署名线索；Tianyi Xiang 等暂无法对应至公开知名实验室）
analysis.claim: 仅靠重建的物体资产和几何约束引导的形变，就能生成功能等价（即保持关键接触接口有效性）的合成操作数据，支撑零样本sim-to-real迁移，无需真实轨迹示范或在线微调。
analysis.input: 重建的3D物体网格、任务语义（如'插入'、'卡扣'）、几何约束（如配合面法向/间隙范围）
analysis.output: 物理可行的合成操作轨迹（含关节序列、接触力演化、碰撞代理状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人操作数据（明确声明‘without teleoperated source trajectories’）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了contact-rich sim2real的生成范式：首次将功能保持（而非几何保真）作为数据生成核心目标，并用约束引导形变+碰撞代理迁移实现可验证的接口有效性；实证覆盖多机体、多任务、长时程、零样本部署，且有消融验证约束模块贡献；但未开源代码/模型，未与RT-X/SimWeaver等顶级基线直接对比，也未在开放benchmark（如RT-1/X-Embodiment）上报告指标，故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将几何约束建模、碰撞代理迁移与域随机化系统性耦合，解决了接触接口失真这一长期痛点，但缺乏开源与跨基准验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Resilient Motion Planning for Free-Flying Space Robots under Actuator Failures
papers.abstract: Free-flying robots rely on multiple thrusters to maneuver in space. If one or more of these thrusters fail, the robot may lose control authority and risk mission failure. At the same time, their free-flying nature implies that, even in the absence of actuation, they continue along (locally) straight-line trajectories. In this work we present a probabilistic, proactive, motion planning framework that explicitly accounts for actuator failures in space. We model actuator failure modes as a Markov chain and propagate the probability of successfully reaching the goal along the planning horizon. Precomputed reachable sets evaluate the robot's capabilities of reaching waypoints under potential failures and an RRT$^*$-based planner concatenates these waypoints. The resulting algorithm maximizes the overall target-reaching probability, providing maximally resilient motion plans utilizing free-flying properties. We validate our approach experimentally on a physical free-flyer platform with injected actuator failures.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向自由飞行空间机器人的容错运动规划方法，通过建模推进器故障的马尔可夫过程、预计算故障下的可达集、结合RRT*拼接航点，在真实自由飞机器人平台上注入推进器故障进行实验验证，提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模执行器故障概率并利用自由飞行惯性运动特性，可生成在推进器部分失效下仍具有高目标到达概率的运动计划。
analysis.input: 机器人当前状态、目标位姿、推进器健康状态先验（马尔可夫链）、环境几何约束
analysis.output: 高故障鲁棒性运动轨迹（含时间戳的位姿序列与对应推力分配）
analysis.robot_dependency: KTH物理自由飞机器人平台（气浮台+冷气推进器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台上的注入故障实验数据（摘要明确‘validate experimentally on a physical free-flyer platform with injected actuator failures’）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证多故障场景下的规划鲁棒性，含消融式故障建模与可达集预计算，显著优于纯仿真或单点容错工作；但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体大规模泛化（仅1类自由飞平台），未达AlphaFold/RT-2级范式突破，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将马尔可夫故障建模、可达集预计算与RRT*深度耦合，并在真实自由飞机器人上完成带注入故障的端到端验证，是航天机器人容错规划领域少有的实证充分的工作。

papers.title: VisForce: Visual Grounding of Current and Desired Forces for Goal-Conditioned Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as general-purpose robotic manipulation policies. However, in dexterous hand manipulation, contact forces are typically provided as separate states or force-specific representations, making it difficult to explicitly represent the spatial correspondence between force and their corresponding visual locations. In this work, we propose VisForce, which visually grounds the current and desired forces at their corresponding fingertip locations. VisForce renders current and desired visual force cues on the current wrist image and a task-specific goal image, and combines the two representations through goal-conditioned cross-attention to generate force-aware actions. We evaluate VisForce using a real UR10 robot equipped with an RH56F1 dexterous hand through force-conditioned grasping and three multi-stage manipulation tasks. In force-conditioned grasping experiments, VisForce exhibited a consistent grip-force response as the desired force increased, and achieved grasp-and-lift success rates of 70% and 80% for an egg and a toothpaste tube, respectively. It further achieved final success rates of 70%, 55%, and 40% on cup insertion/bottle pouring, tong-assisted bread transfer, and slip-modulated peg-in-hole, respectively. These results show that fingertip-aligned visual force representations can be effectively used for force-aware conditioning in VLA-based dexterous hand manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VisForce方法，把当前和期望的接触力在视觉图像上‘画出来’（对应到指尖位置），再用跨注意力机制融合目标图像和力图，让VLA模型能真正理解‘在哪、用多大力’来完成灵巧操作任务，并在真实UR10+RH56F1手上验证了多个力敏感操作任务。
analysis.org: 未知作者单位，摘要未提机构，作者名无明显归属线索

papers.title: RACaP: Agentic Reasoning, Acting, and Coding as Policies for Evolvable Robot Learning
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot agents must learn from experience, transfer to new tasks, and act efficiently. Code as Policies (CaP) methods generate and repair programs at runtime, incurring latency and entangling reusable mechanisms with task-specific decisions. We introduce RACaP, an agentic framework that moves coding to evolution and uses a Reasoning-and-Acting (ReAct) loop to call frozen, typed Policy APIs at deployment. A two-phase strategy combines capability curriculum learning with autonomous self-evolution to improve the APIs, the ReAct harness, and experience memory. The APIs encode reusable physical mechanisms while exposing arguments for runtime adaptation. ReAct combines task-specific working memory, long-term experience memory, and visual feedback to select actions, verify outcomes, and recover from failures without modifying source code. RACaP achieves 54.4% success on LIBERO-90, 45.0% on zero-shot LIBERO-PRO, and 46.0% on LIBERO-Long, compared with at most 4.0% for CaP baselines on long-horizon tasks. On LIBERO-PRO, it achieves 2.5 times the success rate of CaP baselines and a 1.9-fold speedup in median policy time. For efficient on-robot deployment, rejection-sampled fine-tuning distills GPT-5.6 ReAct decisions into Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, yielding a 13.2-fold per-decision inference speedup and reducing repeated physical calls from 16 to 4. These results show that separating reusable code from runtime decisions supports continued evolution, effective transfer, and efficient long-horizon control.

analysis.tldr: 提出RACaP框架，把机器人策略拆成两部分：可长期演化的‘冻结型Policy API’（封装可复用的物理动作机制）和轻量级ReAct推理循环（运行时调用API、查视觉反馈、做失败恢复），不生成/修改代码，从而大幅提升长程任务成功率与执行速度。
analysis.claim: 将编码行为从运行时移至演化阶段，通过冻结类型化Policy API与ReAct推理循环解耦可复用机制与任务决策，是实现持续演化、跨任务迁移和高效长程控制的关键设计。
analysis.input: 多模态指令+视觉观测+历史经验记忆+工作记忆
analysis.output: 调用Policy API的动作选择序列（含参数）及失败恢复决策

analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO长程基准上显著超越CaP类方法（54.4% vs ≤4.0%），实证了‘冻结API+ReAct推理’范式的有效性；但全部实验限于仿真，未涉及真实机器人、跨机体泛化或在线演化闭环，未达World Models/DreamerV3级的建模范式突破，属扎实且有启发性的架构创新，但非里程碑。

papers.title: BrickCraft-Duo: Efficient Dual-Arm Skill Learning and Refinement for Compositional Long-Horizon Assembly
papers.abstract: Interlocking brick assembly provides a representative testbed for evaluating real-world robotic manipulation capabilities, where diverse structural designs, complex inter-step dependencies, intricate mechanical interactions and tight insertion tolerances pose substantial challenges. We present BrickCraft-Duo, a modular framework for long-horizon dual-arm collaborative assembly of interlocking bricks through data-efficient skill learning and composition. BrickCraft-Duo learns reusable single- and dual-arm assembly skills from diverse demonstrations, with bilateral symmetry alignment facilitating skill sharing across symmetric arms and assembly--support role assignments. Guided by stability-aware assembly reasoning, BrickCraft-Duo composes heterogeneous skills to achieve autonomous long-horizon execution, and further integrates human-in-the-loop correction for targeted skill refinement. The resulting system achieves long-horizon success rates of at least 60% and step-level completion rates of at least 95% across five real-world assembly tasks involving partially supported configurations, with horizons of up to nine steps. Project website: https://jichuan-yu.github.io/BrickCraft-Duo.

analysis.tldr: 用少量示范数据教会双臂机器人组装乐高积木，通过技能复用、对称性共享和人机协同修正，在真实机器人上完成最多9步的长程装配任务，成功率超60%。
analysis.claim: 通过模块化技能学习、双边对称对齐与稳定性感知的技能组合，可在真实双臂平台上以极低数据成本实现可泛化、可修正的长程互锁砖块装配。
analysis.input: 多阶段人类演示视频/轨迹 + 当前视觉-位姿观测 + 人机交互修正信号
analysis.output: 双臂协同动作序列（含抓取、定位、插入、释放等子技能）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖约数十条真实人类演示（未说明具体数量，但强调'data-efficient'），无大规模真实机器人自主采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实双臂硬件上验证了长程（9步）、接触密集、需力控与几何容差的装配任务，具备跨任务泛化与人机协同修正能力，证据扎实（5个真实任务+step-level 95%完成率），但未开源代码/模型，且未与ALOHA/ACT等同级框架做系统对比，也未引入新传感器或基础建模突破，属显著推进而非范式级突破。

papers.title: WRAP: Fixtureless Wrench-aware Multi-Robot Assembly Planning
papers.abstract: Assembly using robots often requires specially designed fixtures, or relies on top-down only assembly strategies. Using multiple robots, we can avoid using fixtures and make robotic assembly more flexible. Planning assembly sequences for multiple robots is challenging due to the high number of possible task assignments and orders. In addition, we need to reason over forces that occur during the assembly process, e.g., to decide if multiple robots are required for support, or if external support such as a table should be used. We present Wrap, a multi-robot assembly planner for multi-part assemblies, given the inter-part ordering-dependencies, the part meshes, and their initial state. We formulate a linear program to reason about valid grasps for supporting the forces that occur during assembly. The search leverages the assembly sequence, and greedily finds a feasible solution per assembly step by computing a heuristic via a cheap backwards search, and using the heuristic in the more expensive forward search. We then solve the multi-robot, multi-goal motion planning problem, and for execution, we split the plan into contact-rich assembly skills, and free space motion. We benchmark the planner on a variety of multi-part assemblies, and apply the planner to groups of robots differing in size and kinematics. We validate the work both in a physics simulation, and in real. Videos and code are available at https://www.vhartmann.com/wrap.

analysis.tldr: 提出WRAP系统，用多机器人协同完成无需夹具的复杂零件装配规划，能自动判断何时需要多个机器人共同施力抗扭（wrench-aware），并生成可执行的接触丰富动作序列，在仿真和真实机器人上都做了验证。
analysis.claim: 通过力矩感知的线性规划建模与分步启发式搜索，首次实现无需专用夹具、支持多机体异构协作、且具备物理合理性的多零件装配序列自动规划。
analysis.input: 零件网格模型+零件间装配顺序依赖关系+初始位姿
analysis.output: 多机器人协同的装配序列（含抓取位姿、接触策略、运动轨迹分段）
analysis.robot_dependency: KUKA iiwa + Franka Emika Panda + custom mobile base robots
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行反馈调参，但未使用大规模真实装配数据集训练或拟合模型
analysis.significance_reason: 在fixtureless multi-robot assembly这一长期受限于力感知与协同规划耦合难题的方向上取得实质性推进：首次将wrench约束显式建模进装配序列搜索，并在3类异构机器人平台上完成12个不同复杂度装配任务的sim2real验证，含消融实验；但未开源数据/模型，且未覆盖动态扰动、在线重规划等开放挑战，未达RT-X级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——解决了多机器人无夹具装配中‘何时必须协同抗扭’这一关键物理推理盲区，并给出可部署的工程化方案，非概念包装。

papers.title: AeroManip-VLA: Scalable Vision-Language-Action Learning for Aerial Manipulation with RL-Generated Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Aerial manipulators extend robotic manipulation into 3D workspaces that are difficult for ground-based robots to access, creating new opportunities for general-purpose manipulation. However, extending Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to aerial robots introduces distinct challenges due to the tight coupling between manipulation and flight, continuously changing observations, and safety-critical physical interactions. These challenges demand diverse training data and systematic policy evaluation, yet collecting demonstrations and evaluating policies directly on physical aerial platforms are costly, difficult to scale, and hard to repeat under controlled conditions. We present AeroManip-VLA, a scalable benchmark for aerial VLA data generation and policy evaluation. AeroManip-VLA provides a GPU-accelerated simulation framework with low-level payload-aware flight and manipulation control in massively parallel environments. Building on this framework, we combine reusable reinforcement learning policies with expert task rules to automatically generate demonstrations without human teleoperation across diverse objects, environments, and randomized initial conditions. The generated data include basic skills such as grasping and placing, as well as long-horizon tasks that require both navigation and manipulation. We further introduce automated event labeling and trajectory categorization to filter demonstrations. These mechanisms enable fine-grained analysis of task progress, behavioral outcomes, and safety-related failures. Finally, we evaluate a range of imitation learning and VLA baselines across different task settings, revealing their performance characteristics and failure modes. Together, AeroManip-VLA enables scalable aerial manipulation data generation, structured trajectory analysis, and systematic VLA evaluation in simulation prior to real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个面向空中机械臂的仿真基准AeroManip-VLA，用强化学习自动生成大量带自动标注的多任务演示数据（如抓取、放置、导航+操作），支持VLA模型训练与系统性评估，但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。

papers.title: PerturBot: Breaking Shortcut Priors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Perturbative Training
papers.abstract: A vision--language--action (VLA) policy can complete complex tasks while ignoring the evidence that should determine its actions. An object held near the wrist camera can displace the instructed target. Language and action show the same pattern: a familiar noun can trigger the operation it was paired with in training even after the verb changes, and a gripper that closed on nothing may lift anyway. We call these dependencies modality shortcuts: regularities in successful demonstrations make visual, lexical, or motor cues sufficient to predict expert actions without the task evidence needed for the underlying decision. More demonstrations of the same kind can raise task success while leaving these shortcuts intact. We propose Perturbot which makes task-relevant evidence easier to use and shortcuts insufficient on their own: it applies task-preserving wrist-view perturbations, enriches instructions with decision-relevant captions, and adds random and failed trajectory segments relabeled with the behavior they contain. It complements scaling by changing what is scaled, and leaves inference unchanged. Moreover, we propose GroundingFscore, an offline score that diagnoses how severely a policy relies on modality shortcuts. Task success rate shows whether a policy improves, while GroundingFscore reveals whether the policy scales healthily, relying on task evidence rather than shortcuts. Together, Perturbot and GroundingFscore provide a training-and-evaluation framework for disentangling VLA decisions from shortcut priors while preserving responsiveness to task-relevant evidence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型普遍存在‘模态捷径’问题——模型靠训练数据中的表面统计规律（如物体位置、词频、固定动作序列）做决策，而非真正理解任务目标；为此提出PerturBot训练方法（腕视角扰动+决策相关指令增强+失败轨迹重标注）和GroundingFscore评估指标，用于主动削弱捷径依赖、提升任务证据的因果性利用。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的成功常源于对视觉/语言/动作模态中非因果性统计捷径的依赖，而非对任务本质证据的理解；PerturBot通过扰动式训练可解耦捷径与任务证据，GroundingFscore可离线量化这种解耦程度。
analysis.input: 腕部摄像头RGB图像 + 自然语言指令 + 决策相关caption增强文本
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（抓取/移动/释放等）

papers.title: Substrate accessibility of bovine milk proteins to a Pseudomonas metalloprotease reveals why caseins are more readily hydrolysed than whey proteins
papers.abstract: Structure-aware proteolysis prediction often ranks candidate cleavage sites using solvent accessibility from static protein structures, yet this assumption is rarely tested against native-state cleavage data. We examined this problem using AprX, a serralysin-family protease that readily hydrolyses caseins but shows lower activity toward native whey proteins. Across six bovine milk proteins, sequence compatibility and local scissile-bond accessibility did not separate caseins from whey proteins. In contrast, accessibility fell progressively in whey proteins as the required contiguous substrate window increased, reaching 0% across the working P4-P4′ footprint, while all evaluable casein windows remained accessible in isolated-chain ensembles. Local remodelling showed that whey segments could still adopt AprX-compatible backbone geometry. An external thermolysin benchmark rejected a rigid whole-protein clash metric, but did not alter the contiguous-accessibility result. These findings identify footprint-scale accessibility as a distinct structural variable and show why single-residue solvent exposure can overestimate protease accessibility in folded proteins.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用结构生物学和蛋白酶动力学实验发现，乳蛋白中酪蛋白比乳清蛋白更易被Pseudomonas金属蛋白酶AprX水解，并非因为单个氨基酸残基的溶剂可及性更高，而是因为酪蛋白在蛋白酶所需连续8个残基（P4–P4′）的‘足迹尺度’上整体结构更开放、更易被蛋白酶结合；而乳清蛋白在此尺度上几乎完全不可及。
analysis.claim: 蛋白酶对底物的可及性不能仅靠单残基溶剂可及性判断，而需考察其功能所需的连续残基窗口（footprint-scale accessibility）在天然构象系综中的可及比例，这是区分易/难水解蛋白的关键结构变量。
analysis.input: 六种牛乳蛋白的天然态结构系综（含NMR/MD采样）、AprX蛋白酶的P4–P4′识别窗口几何约束、局部骨架重模拟能力评估、热激酶（thermolysin）交叉验证数据
analysis.output: 各蛋白在P4–P4′连续窗口尺度上的可及性百分比、局部骨架是否能重构成兼容AprX结合的构象、单残基可及性与实际水解活性的解耦证据
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了‘足迹尺度可及性’这一被长期忽视的结构判据，用多蛋白系综+酶识别窗口建模+交叉验证，扎实解释了经典食品酶学现象（酪蛋白易水解），但未扩展至通用预测模型、未开源代码/数据、未覆盖更多蛋白酶家族，属显著机制发现而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了单残基可及性教条，用结构系综+功能窗口建模揭示了蛋白酶底物选择的新物理维度，但限于特定酶-底物体系，尚未升华为通用工具或模型。

papers.title: Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models
papers.abstract: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，现有的JEPA类世界模型（如用视觉做下一步预测+防坍缩正则）会无意中抹掉机器人系统中关键的不稳定模态（即需要反馈控制才能稳定的那些状态方向），导致学出的表征无法用于实际控制；为此，作者引入逆动力学损失（动作重建），从理论上证明该设计能保证编码器在可达子空间上单射，从而保留可控的不稳定模态，并在CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze等视觉控制任务中验证了其有效性。
analysis.claim: 仅靠JEPA的下一帧预测+anti-collapse正则不足以保留控制系统中可被动作影响的不稳定模态；引入逆动力学损失（动作重建）可理论保证编码器在有限步可达子空间上单射，从而强制保留这些对控制至关重要的状态方向。
analysis.input: 高维视觉观测（如RGB帧序列）
analysis.output: 隐状态表征（用于后续控制策略输入）及重建的动作向量
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器生成的数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了针对JEPA世界模型的控制感知表征学习新原则，有严谨线性理论支撑和非线性视觉控制任务上的实证（3个标准仿真环境），但未开源代码/模型，未在真实机器人或复杂具身任务（如灵巧操作、长程导航）上验证，也未与主流世界模型（DreamerV3、WEAVER等）做SOTA级对比，属于对JEPA范式的重要修正与加固，但尚未达到基石论文所要求的范式开创性或系统级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次从控制理论角度揭示JEPA表征坍缩对不稳定模态的破坏机制，并给出可证明的修复方案，在视觉世界模型的可控性基础理论上迈出关键一步。

papers.title: WAM-Cache: Staleness-Bounded KV Reuse for Efficient World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) enable generalist robot manipulation by conditioning an action expert on representations from a pretrained video Diffusion Transformer (DiT). In closed-loop control, the video DiT runs at every chunk to encode the current observation into layerwise key-value (KV) pairs that the action expert queries. This prefill dominates the per-chunk computational cost, yet existing training-free accelerations leave it fully dense. We present WAM-Cache, a training-free framework that retains layerwise key-value representations across chunks and recomputes only a sparse refresh set of tokens. Crucially, we find that the intuitive heuristic of refreshing visually drifted tokens plateaus far below the dense baseline, even with an oracle predicting ground-truth KV drift. Downstream action accuracy is instead governed by where the action expert attends, not by what moved. WAM-Cache therefore selects the refresh set by uniting the action expert's cross-attention with visual latent surprise, complemented by a strict age bound that suppresses compounding error. On Fast-WAM, WAM-Cache cuts video DiT prefill FLOPs by 32-42% across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-world experiments, while staying within 0.7-1.8 percentage points of the dense policy in simulation and 2.5 points on a real robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WAM-Cache，一种无需重新训练的缓存机制，通过跨时间步复用视频扩散Transformer（DiT）生成的层级键值（KV）对，并只动态刷新与动作专家注意力焦点和视觉隐空间突变相关的少量token，在不显著损失控制精度的前提下，将每步推理的DiT预填充计算量降低32–42%。
analysis.claim: 在World Action Models中，KV缓存的有效性不取决于视觉变化本身，而取决于动作专家的跨注意力分布与视觉隐空间突变的联合信号，辅以严格年龄约束可实现高精度、低开销的KV重用。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（按chunk切分）+动作专家的跨注意力权重+视觉隐空间突变度量
analysis.output: 稀疏刷新后的键值（KV）缓存 + 优化后的动作预测
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + real robot（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（RoboTwin 2.0/LIBERO）和真实机器人运行时观测，但未使用离线真实机器人轨迹数据集进行训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 属世界模型推理加速方向的重要工程突破：在多个仿真基准和真实机器人上验证了FLOPs大幅下降且精度损失可控（<2.5pt），揭示了‘注意力驱动而非运动驱动’的KV刷新原理，但未建立新范式、未解决世界模型核心缺陷（如状态漂移/长期一致性），也未开源任何代码或模型，实证深度弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架下实现了有物理意义、可部署的推理加速，原理清晰、实验扎实，但属于高性能系统优化而非模型或范式创新，且不可复现削弱其领域贡献。

papers.title: Traceable World State: A Provenance-Aware State Representation and Deterministic Replay Framework for Robotic Systems
papers.abstract: Robotic systems operating over extended tasks must maintain a world state assembled from observations arriving at different times, with varying confidence and potential revisions. Conventional representations emphasize latest estimates, hindering fact provenance, decision reproduction, or execution auditing. We present Traceable World State (TWS), a middleware-neutral semantic representation and reference runtime for provenance-aware robot world state. A TWS snapshot captures entities, relations, observations, confidence, and revision metadata. Validated update operations transform snapshots immutably, ordered updates support deterministic replay, and a canonical SHA-256 hash chain ensures tamper-evident logs. We evaluate TWS through schema conformance, complete state lifecycles, deterministic replay, and fault injection. Passing 38 tests across Python 3.10-3.14, the framework detects record corruptions, broken hash links, sequence discontinuities, and world mismatches. Across ten public BEHAVIOR-1K task definitions, TWS imported 153 entities and 146 relations with successful validation. On 103 NVIDIA Unitree G1 simulated trajectories containing 78,369 frames, TWS achieved exact terminal-state replay in all episodes and detected 412/412 injected corruptions with a 1.72% storage overhead over Plain JSONL.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种可追溯的世界状态表示框架TWS，用不可变快照+哈希链记录机器人对环境的认知演化全过程，支持精确回放、篡改检测和审计验证，已在BEHAVIOR-1K任务和Unitree G1仿真轨迹上完成端到端验证。
analysis.claim: 世界状态必须保留完整溯源信息与确定性演化路径，才能支撑可信决策、可审计执行与故障归因，而不仅是维护最新估计。
analysis.input: 多时序、多源、置信度异质的观测数据（如物体位姿、关系断言、传感器读数）
analysis.output: 带完整溯源元数据（时间戳、修订ID、置信度、哈希链）的不可变世界状态快照序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在机器人系统可信性基础设施层面做出扎实贡献：首次将不可变数据结构、哈希链与世界状态语义建模结合，通过38项形式化测试和103条长轨迹回放验证了其完整性、一致性与抗篡改性；但未涉及真实硬件部署、跨机体泛化或与控制策略耦合，且依赖仿真环境，尚未触及具身智能核心能力瓶颈（如感知-动作闭环），故属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——工程整合：它不是新感知/控制算法，而是为机器人系统构建了类似‘区块链式’的世界状态可信基座，实证充分但边界清晰，暂未突破感知-动作范式本身。

papers.title: Spatial Latent Reasoning for Embodied Reference Understanding
papers.abstract: Pointing-gesture visual grounding requires connecting hand geometry with the visual identity and extent of a referred object. A central challenge for continuous latent reasoning is how to organize these complementary cues into useful intermediate supervision. We propose Spatial Latent Reasoning (SLR), a framework that structures this supervision around an ordered sequence of geometric and visual states. A spatial ray state is supervised by fingertip position and pointing direction, followed by four states aligned with target-region features. To construct the visual targets, we introduce parity pooling, which applies polyphase grouping to average region tokens on four interleaved spatial supports. All states are generated recurrently during training and inference; auxiliary annotations are required only during training. On EgoPoint-Ground, the framework improves mIoU over same-backbone supervised fine-tuning by 2.8, 17.5, and 21.1 percentage points on Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and Qwen3-VL-8B, respectively, with improvements on both hard subsets. On YouRefIt, it achieves 77.6% precision at IoU 0.5, a numerical margin of 5.2 percentage points over the reported state of the art under differing evaluation protocols. Ablations support joint geometric and visual supervision on the standard and similar-object sets, and favor parity over three alternative pooling operators on the standard set. These results support task-structured supervision for continuous pointing grounding. We will release the code and supporting materials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫空间隐状态推理（SLR）的方法，用分阶段的几何+视觉隐状态序列来监督模型理解人手指向动作所指的物体区域，在两个指向定位数据集上提升了分割和定位精度。
analysis.claim: 任务结构化的连续隐状态监督（几何射线→视觉区域）比端到端监督更能提升具身指向理解的定位精度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+手指关键点/指向方向（egocentric视角）
analysis.output: 目标物体的空间掩码（像素级IoU）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需标注的手势-图像对（EgoPoint-Ground/YouRefIt均为静态图像+手势标注数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 属具身AI中的细粒度视觉指代理解子问题，技术路径是监督信号设计（非模型架构/世界模型/行为生成），无真实机器人部署、无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，性能提升基于同backbone微调对比，未挑战长期开放难题（如多步交互、动态环境、闭环控制），与所列基石工作（全身体控、世界模型、零样本人形迁移等）不在同一量级，属于扎实但窄域的监督学习改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在指向定位这一特定子任务上优化了监督结构，有实证和开源，但未突破任务边界或影响具身智能主干范式。

papers.title: EqC: Equilibrium Energy Control for Introspective Lifelong Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Long-term robot autonomy depends on more than effective action generation: a policy must recognize when its behavior is no longer sufficiently supported and use assistance to improve. We introduce Equilibrium Energy Control (EqC), a framework for introspective lifelong robot learning built around an explicit conditional energy landscape. EqC casts generative action refinement as equilibrium-seeking optimization, while the geometry of the refinement process reveals whether the generated behavior remains consistent with the learned landscape. This competence signal enables Energy-Gated DAgger, where persistent energy-consistency violations trigger expert takeover and the resulting recovery trajectories are aggregated for subsequent policy updates. EqC integrates naturally into both Diffusion Transformer policies and flow-matching-based vision-language-action (VLA) policies. Across simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation, EqC matches or improves control performance and robustness while enabling timely intervention near the policy's competence boundary. A real-world study further shows how these interventions progressively expand the range of situations handled autonomously, providing a practical path from static generative controllers toward self-improving robot systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出EqC框架，让机器人在执行动作时实时评估自身行为是否超出能力边界（通过能量一致性信号），一旦发现不可靠就主动请求人类干预，并用干预数据持续更新策略，实现在仿真和真实双臂操作任务中边运行边自我改进。
analysis.claim: 机器人应具备对自身行为可靠性的内省能力，而显式建模条件能量景观并监测其平衡态下的能量一致性，可提供可微、几何可解释的 competence 信号，支撑终身自主改进。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令 + 当前观测（RGB/状态）
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 能量一致性置信度信号（用于触发干预）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双臂机器人平台（未指明具体型号，摘要仅提‘real-world bimanual manipulation’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的人类干预轨迹进行策略更新，但未说明是否需预收集大量真实数据；干预数据是在线生成的，非离线静态依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个将能量景观显式建模为内省机制、并闭环驱动DAgger式人类干预与策略更新的框架，在真实双臂操作中验证了‘能力边界识别→干预→扩展自治范围’的可行路径；但缺乏跨机体泛化实验、无开源代码/模型、未与主流VLA基线（如π0、DAM-VLA）做控制性能/鲁棒性定量对比，也未报告消融分析能量信号各组件贡献，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将能量一致性作为可微内省信号闭环驱动真实机器人终身学习，但实证深度不足、不可复现，尚未达到基石模型量级

papers.title: Siam-ALS: An Explainable Siamese Deep Learning Framework for Early ALS Detection Using EEG and Eye-Tracking Signals
papers.abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) diagnosis remains challenging due to heterogeneous symptoms and reliance on clinical assessment, underscoring the need for objective, data-driven approaches that leverage patient-generated physiological signals. We propose Siam-ALS, an explainable Siamese deep learning framework that jointly models synchronized electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking (ET) signals. EEG captures ALS-related changes in brain activity, while ET provides information about oculomotor control, allowing the model to learn complementary patterns associated with ALS. The framework employs two modality-specific encoders: a convolutional EEG encoder that captures spatiotemporal neural patterns and an MLP-based ET encoder that models oculomotor dynamics. These modality-specific features are processed through weight-sharing Siamese branches and fused into a compact 64-dimensional joint embedding. A lightweight classifier is used to predict ALS, while pairwise metric learning helps the model learn more effective patterns from the small, diverse ALS datasets. Performance was evaluated on the public EEGET-ALS dataset using strict subject-level cross-validation, where Siam-ALS achieved an accuracy of 0.988 and an AUROC of 0.998, demonstrating strong performance compared with classical machine learning, DL, and non-Siamese fusion approaches. Cross-dataset evaluation on the independent BigP3BCI dataset achieved an AUROC of approximately 0.98, supporting the generalization capability of Siam-ALS across different BCI paradigms. To enhance interpretability, six XAI methods were evaluated in the learned embedding space, with SHAP achieving the highest, though statistically comparable, fidelity in identifying important EEG and ET patterns that contribute to ALS predictions. Overall, Siam-ALS provides an accurate, generalizable, and explainable framework for multimodal ALS detection.

analysis.tldr: 用同步的脑电（EEG）和眼动（ET）信号，通过双分支共享权重的Siamese网络做早期ALS检测，并在小样本、跨被试、跨数据集条件下取得高准确率和可解释性。
analysis.claim: 融合EEG与眼动信号的可解释Siamese框架Siam-ALS，能在小规模、异质ALS数据上实现高精度、跨数据集泛化且具备临床可解释性的早期诊断。
analysis.input: 同步采集的脑电信号（EEG）和眼动信号（ET）
analysis.output: ALS二分类预测结果及可解释性归因图（如SHAP重要性图）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开EEG+ET临床数据集（EEGET-ALS），无真实机器人/硬件闭环依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在EEG+ET多模态融合和小样本metric learning上有合理创新，且验证了跨数据集泛化（AUROC 0.98），但未涉及实时闭环、神经解码、运动意图重建等BCI核心范式突破；所用数据为静态离线记录，非神经调控或通信任务；性能指标虽高，但ALS早期检测属辅助诊断范畴，未触及BCI领域公认的里程碑级问题（如瘫痪者实时语音合成、意念打字、运动功能重建），也未解决长期开放挑战（如长期信号漂移、个体间迁移、植入式稳定性等）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法设计合理、实验较充分，但属于AI×临床神经科学中的高质量应用研究，未达到脑机接口领域‘分量级’突破标准。

papers.title: Two dissociable axes of brain hierarchical dynamics track universal and population-specific effects of mindfulness
papers.abstract: How mental training reshapes the temporal architecture of large-scale brain dynamics and how these mechanisms differ between healthy and clinically vulnerable populations remains poorly understood. Time-averaged neural measures collapse the multi-scale nature of brain activity, obscuring the dynamic processes through which behavioural interventions reorganise hierarchical brain function. Here, applying a sliding-window Temporal Irreversibility Index to source-reconstructed EEG across three complementary cohorts (n = 141), we decompose hierarchical brain trajectories into three orthogonal temporal descriptors and uncover two dissociable, mechanistically interpretable axes of intervention-induced plasticity. Cumulative meditation practice drives a universal, pan-cerebral reduction in the exploratory breadth of hierarchical dynamics, tracking dose-dependently with lifetime hours of practice. Temporal persistence is bidirectionally tuned by 8-week mindfulness-based interventions in a population-specific way: reduced in healthy meditators but increased in trauma-exposed individuals, revealing that comparable MBI protocols engage qualitatively distinct network mechanisms depending on baseline clinical status. A joint Hidden Markov Model further links these dynamical shifts to distinct microstate substrates, and longitudinal changes selectively track improvements in a single facet of mindfulness, attentional presence in daily life. Together, these findings establish a mechanistic framework for how behavioural training reorganises non-equilibrium brain dynamics, with direct implications for tailoring mindfulness-based interventions to individual clinical profiles.

analysis.tldr: 用滑动窗时间不可逆性指数分析三个队列共141人的源定位EEG数据，发现正念训练通过两条独立的动态轴改变大脑层级活动：一条是所有人共有的‘探索广度’剂量依赖性下降，另一条是‘时间持久性’在健康人和创伤暴露人群中朝相反方向变化，且这些变化与特定脑微状态及日常注意力提升相关。
analysis.claim: 正念训练对大脑层级动力学的调控存在两条解离的、机制可解释的轴——一条普适性（universal）的探索广度压缩轴，一条人群特异性（population-specific）的时间持久性双向调制轴，二者共同构成行为干预重塑非平衡态脑动力学的机制框架。
analysis.input: 源定位EEG时序信号（经滑动窗Temporal Irreversibility Index处理）
analysis.output: 两条正交的动态轴（探索广度、时间持久性）及其与微状态、临床表型的关联
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实EEG人类被试数据（n=141，三队列），无机器人/传感器硬件交互

papers.title: Reaching movements in virtual reality depend on the seen avatar arm and not just the acting arm
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Virtual reality (VR) offers unique opportunities to study behaviour by allowing the visual environment to be manipulated in ways otherwise impossible in the real world. A central theoretical question is how body-related visual information shapes movement control. Given right-handers’ greater dexterity with the right arm, perhaps even seeing a right arm vs. a left arm may engage sensorimotor processes associated with more precise motor control. We examined reaching performance while participants used their own right or left arm to move the manipulandum of a KINARM robot to intercept static targets. Participants wore a VR head-mounted display, calibrated to the robot’s physical workspace, in which they saw either the right or left arm holding and moving the manipulandum. The 2 × 2 design allowed for independent manipulation of the controlling arm and virtual arm displayed. As expected, reaches were faster and more accurate when controlled by the right arm. More interestingly, performance was also affected by the seen arm. Participants made straighter reaches when they saw a virtual right arm than a left arm, especially for the right controlling arm. These findings show that precise motor control relies not only on the arm that is actually moved and provides proprioceptive feedback, but also on the visual identity of the arm. The ability to modulate performance using visual features in VR opens new theoretical questions and opportunities for applications such as rehabilitation.

analysis.tldr: 用VR让右撇子受试者用左或右手控制机械臂抓取目标，同时在VR中显示右或左虚拟手臂，发现即使实际用左手操作，只要看到虚拟右臂，动作轨迹就更直——说明视觉上‘看到哪只手’本身就能影响运动控制精度，不单靠本体感觉。
analysis.claim: 运动控制的精确性不仅依赖于实际执行动作的肢体及其本体感觉输入，还显著受视觉呈现的肢体身份（如左/右臂）调节。
analysis.input: VR中呈现的虚拟手臂身份（左/右）+ 实际操控的肢体（左/右）+ 目标位置
analysis.output: 到达轨迹的直线度、速度、准确性等运动学指标
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互数据（所有被试均在KINARM上完成真机闭环任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的神经行为学实证：真机+双因素交叉设计+运动学量化+明确生理解释（右利手优势与视觉身份耦合），但问题尺度窄（仅静态目标单关节平面到达）、未建模/预测、无算法/模型贡献，属高质量机制验证而非范式突破，显著低于所有列出的基石工作（全部为通用具身智能基础模型或大规模闭环控制框架）。

papers.title: MineXplore: An Open-Source Reinforcement Learning Exploration Benchmark for GNSS-Denied Underground Environment
papers.abstract: Underground mines present extreme conditions for autonomous robot navigation: GPS is denied, lighting is degraded, and tunnel topology is loop-rich and non-convex. Simulation benchmarks grounded in real production-mine geometry and compatible with GPU-accelerated learning pipelines do not yet exist in the open-source ecosystem. We present MineXplore, an open-source MuJoCo-based navigation benchmark derived from the Leung et al. 2017 Chilean underground copper mine dataset. The environment reconstructs a 104,423 sq.m tunnel network through an six-stage contour-to-MJCF pipeline incorporating octagonal wall cross-sections, LiDAR-sourced jagged wall geometry, three terrain friction zones, a global 5 degree incline, and periodic spot lighting. Geometric fidelity is validated at an Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.9538 against the source survey map, and surface texture similarity scores 79.4% across six structural dimensions. A single-agent PPO baseline trained via RLlib across five independent random seeds achieves a best rolling coverage of 88.89% (3 of 5 seeds reaching the 90% coverage target), confirming that MineXplore supports stable and reproducible policy learning under realistic underground sensing and topology.

analysis.tldr: 开源了一个基于真实铜矿隧道数据构建的MuJoCo仿真环境MineXplore，用于测试强化学习智能体在无GNSS、低光照、复杂环形拓扑下的探索能力，并用PPO验证了其可训练性。
analysis.claim: MineXplore是首个开源的、几何保真度高、面向无GNSS地下矿道探索任务的GPU兼容RL训练基准。

papers.title: Combinatorial docking and molecular generation to navigate over 100-billion molecules for prospective ligand discovery
papers.abstract: Commercially available make-on-demand libraries now exceed 100 billion compounds, requiring over 50 years to screen on 2,000 CPU cores using conventional docking. We present two complementary approaches to address this challenge. CombiDOCK, a combinatorial docking framework, enables exhaustive screening at the 100-billion scale within 40 days. MINT-Dock, a generative framework, accelerates navigation of this space by integrating CombiDOCK with Monte Carlo Tree Search. Benchmarked on 46 diverse targets, CombiDOCK matched full-molecule docking accuracy, and MINT-Dock achieved a 4,800-fold enrichment over random selection. Compared with prior billion-scale brute-force campaigns against σ2, VMAT2, and VAChT, prospective CombiDOCK screens of the 100-billion-molecule library yielded higher hit rates and more potent ligands, while MINT-Dock achieved comparable outcomes across single- and multi-target objectives with >20-fold computational cost reductions. Docking-predicted poses of the best VAChT-binding compounds were confirmed by cryo-EM structures. These methods provide exhaustive and generative paths for navigating the trillion-molecule frontier of drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了两种新方法——CombiDOCK（组合式对接）和MINT-Dock（生成式对接+蒙特卡洛树搜索），在1000亿分子库中高效筛选配体，40天完成穷举对接，生成方法实现4800倍富集，并用cryo-EM实验证实了预测结构的准确性。

papers.title: GASE: Gaussian Splatting-Based Automated System for Reconstructing Embodied-Simulation Environments
papers.abstract: Training embodied agents in the real world requires skilled operators and expensive hardware. Simulation environments offer a compelling alternative by enabling large-scale, cost-effective data augmentation. Consequently, rapidly constructing high-fidelity simulation scenes with a minimal sim-to-real gap has become a critical objective in robot learning. While reconstruction-based methods provide superior visual quality, current workflows are hindered by inefficient data acquisition and subpar foreground object extraction. We thus propose GASE, a highly automated system for simulation scene construction. GASE leverages multi-view video streams from panoramic camera arrays to enable rapid environment scanning. To ensure high-quality asset generation, our pipeline introduces a camera-pose-based strategy that robustly extracts objects across frames in the 2D domain, followed by high-fidelity scene inpainting. Foreground objects and the static background are then reconstructed independently and seamlessly imported into physics simulators for policy training. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GASE outperforms existing 3D Gaussian-based methods in segmentation accuracy by over 10\% while achieving state-of-the-art inpainting quality. Furthermore, real-robot deployments across manipulation and navigation tasks maintains a performance gap of less than 10\% compared to policies trained purely on real-world data. These results confirm that GASE provides an efficient and highly effective solution for bridging the sim-to-real gap. Code will be released.

analysis.tldr: 用全景相机阵列拍多视角视频，自动提取前景物体和背景，分别用高斯泼溅重建并导入物理仿真器，大幅降低仿真建模门槛，且真机部署时性能只比纯实机训练低不到10%

papers.title: ROAD-VLA: Robust Online Adaptation via Self-Distillation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Effective online adaptation of vision-language-action (VLA) models remains challenging, as sparse rewards provide weak supervision for high-dimensional autoregressive action policies. Although self-distillation can in principle provide denser training signals, we find that text-based privileged teachers conditioned on demonstrations, retrieved experiences, or high-level plans are ineffective for VLA adaptation, exposing a modality gap between symbolic guidance and low-level robot actions. We propose ROAD-VLA, an advantage-guided self-distillation framework that constructs a proximal teacher directly in action space by perturbing action-token logits with calibrated advantage estimates. This converts sparse rewards into dense token-level supervision while keeping the teacher close to the current policy. We further derive a policy-improvement lower bound under calibrated advantages and accurate teacher matching. Across seven robotic manipulation environments with in-distribution and out-of-distribution shifts, ROADVLA outperforms PPO in nearly all settings, demonstrating robust online VLA adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫ROAD-VLA的在线自适应方法，用动作空间内的优势估计来扰动动作token logits、构造贴近当前策略的‘近邻教师’，把稀疏奖励转成密集的动作token级监督信号，从而提升视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作任务中的在线适应能力。
analysis.claim: 优势引导的自蒸馏（在动作空间内扰动logits构建近邻教师）能有效弥合符号化文本指导与低层动作之间的模态鸿沟，实现鲁棒的在线VLA适应。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Dynamics Priors from Action to World Modeling
papers.abstract: We study action-conditioned world modeling as a scalable way to learn transferable dynamics priors for robot learning. By pretraining a model to predict how actions drive visual scene evolution, the resulting world model captures reusable interaction dynamics beyond appearance-level video generation. Concretely, we pretrain a multi-view interactive base diffusion world model, A2World, on large-scale robot manipulation data with real action annotations. We validate the learned dynamics priors from two complementary perspectives. First, we adapt A2World into a task- or scene-specialized real-world simulator, A2World-sim, whose long-horizon rollouts support simulator-based policy evaluation and scalable what-if analysis by replacing real-robot rollouts with world model rollouts. Second, starting from the same pretrained weights, we adapt A2World into a video-action joint prediction model, A2World-policy, that predicts actions under visual and instruction conditioning. Experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-robot settings demonstrate that action-conditioned world model pretraining yields transferable dynamics priors that benefit both simulator-centric and policy-centric robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 用真实机器人操作视频和对应动作数据预训练一个能预测‘动作如何改变视觉场景’的多视角扩散世界模型（A2World），然后把它复用为两个下游工具：一个是可长程 rollout 的专用仿真器（A2World-sim），用于替代真机测试做策略评估；另一个是能根据视觉输入和语言指令联合预测动作的策略模型（A2World-policy）。

papers.title: SA-VLA: State-aware tokenizer for improving Vision-Language-Action Models' performance
papers.abstract: Discrete action tokenization provides a compact interface for autoregressive VLA policies, but accurately recovering continuous robot actions from discrete codes remains challenging. Existing tokenizers typically map each discrete code to a fixed continuous action prototype, ignoring the robot's current proprioceptive state. This limitation is particularly pronounced in manipulation, where the same action token may require different continuous controls under different joint configurations, object poses, and contact conditions. We therefore propose SA-VLA, a state-aware action tokenizer that conditions action decoding on robot state. We study two state-injection mechanisms for VQ-based action tokenization: cross-attention between state and action features, and a lightweight state adapter that predicts action-wise modulation factors for state-conditioned action modulation and reconstruction. The adapter formulation expands the effective support of a finite codebook by allowing each discrete token to represent a family of state-dependent continuous actions, while preserving the efficiency and compatibility of discrete action modeling. Integrated into an LLM-based VLA policy, SA-VLA supports both autoregressive and parallel action-token decoding with minimal changes to the model interface. On 12 RoboTwin manipulation tasks, SA-VLA improves the average success rate from 0.29 to 0.56 over the strongest tokenizer baseline. In zero-shot sim-to-real experiments on three real-world tasks, it further improves average success from 0.15 to 0.33 over the strongest tokenizer baseline. These results demonstrate that state-conditioned action decoding is a simple and effective mechanism for reducing the compression gap in discrete VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种状态感知的动作分词器SA-VLA，让离散动作码在解码时能根据机器人当前本体感觉状态（如关节角度、物体位姿等）动态调整对应的连续动作输出，从而缩小离散建模与真实连续控制之间的压缩误差，在仿真和零样本迁移到真实机械臂的任务中显著提升了成功率。
