papers.title: SMART: A Somatic Mutation Annotation and Reporting Tool for cancer genomics
papers.abstract: Motivation: Translational interpretation of somatic variants from targeted oncology panels is hampered by inconsistent transcript prioritisation and by the need for reproducible pipelines that natively integrate OncoKB-derived evidence for research purposes. Results: We present SMART (Somatic Mutation Annotation and Reporting Tool), a Dockerised pipeline that embeds OncoKB API-derived annotations, including therapeutic (L1-4), resistance (R1-R3), diagnostic (Dx1-3), prognostic (Px1-3) and FDA levels, directly into a VCF-based workflow. SMART combines this with VEP, CIViC, Cancer Hotspots, ClinVar, SpliceAI, REVEL, LOEUF and gnomAD, applies a unified three-tier transcript prioritisation (whitelist > MANE Select > VEP fallback), and produces three-tiered outputs for computational, bioinformatic and research interpretation. Validation against reference APIs showed full concordance across 804 field-level checks. Availability and Implementation: Source code and Docker image are freely available at https://github.com/WeTGI-colab/SMART under the MIT License. SMART is provided for research use only; use of SMART outputs for patient specific clinical reports, clinical decision-making, or other patient-facing purposes requires appropriate governance and all required third-party licensing, including any OncoKB licence required for patient report generation.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个名为SMART的开源工具，将OncoKB等10个权威癌症基因组数据库的注释自动整合进VCF分析流程，并统一了转录本优先级规则，生成三级报告供不同角色（计算/生信/研究）使用，验证显示其字段级准确率达100%。
analysis.claim: SMART通过标准化转录本优先级、原生集成OncoKB等多源临床级证据、结构化三级输出，解决了靶向肿瘤测序中体细胞变异注释不一致、不可复现、难落地的研究痛点。
analysis.input: 标准VCF格式的体细胞突变文件（含样本元信息）
analysis.output: 三级结构化注释报告：计算层（机器可读JSON/TSV）、生信层（带置信度标签的表格）、研究层（含治疗/耐药/诊断/预后/FDA等级的自然语言摘要）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量工程整合而非科学突破：它未提出新算法或模型，也未发现新生物学机制；核心价值在于可靠封装已有资源（OncoKB/CIViC/VEP等）并解决实际落地中的工程断点（如转录本冲突、API调用一致性、输出分层），但未扩展知识边界或改变范式，远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列/RFdiffusion等基石工作（90+），也不具备dtSFM或AlphaFold3级的跨任务泛化或生成能力。

papers.title: Can the heartbeat-evoked potential (HEP) be separated from Cardiac Artefact (CA) using beamforming?
papers.abstract: Abstract The heartbeat-evoked potential (HEP), a cortical response to heartbeats and a neural marker of interoception, is increasingly considered clinically relevant, but is heavily contaminated by cardiac artefact (CA) on the scalp, making reliable distinction of HEP from CA challenging. Because the HEP and cardiac potentials are anatomically distinct, they may be separable via beamforming, a source localisation method that isolates brain activity at specific locations while suppressing external noise and interference. Here, the first known ground-truth validation of EEG beamforming for HEP source reconstruction was attempted, aiming to quantify source waveform recovery and spatial localisation accuracy using simulated EEG data. Using linearly constrained minimal variance (LCMV) beamforming, the following was investigated. (A) To test whether beamforming can recover a known signal, 128-channel EEG datasets were simulated for 3 models with a known HEP waveform: a single right insula (R-Ins) HEP (1), two temporally distinct HEPs in the R-Ins and right anterior cingulate cortex (R-ACC) (2), and two temporally overlapping HEPs in the same regions (3). Recovery was investigated by correlating the virtual electrode waveforms at the true location with the known true input waveform. (B) To test CA suppression, CA extracted from isoelectric EEG of brain-dead individuals providing CA with limited cortical activity, was integrated into the simulated EEG data. Source (−10 to −50dB) and sensor (0 to −30dB) signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) were systematically varied for each model with and without CA. (C) LCMV beamforming was then applied to retrospective empirical EEG data from hypertensive and anxiety individuals (n=106). Across simulations and empirical data, T-tests compared power in a HEP-dominated window to an earlier CA-dominated window. Null-space projection, using subject-specific QRS waveform and its temporal derivative, was applied to remove residual CA in reconstructed source waveforms. In model 1, beamforming achieved near-perfect recovery without CA (r>0.99, 0mm error) at source SNR of −30dB, remaining robust in the presence of CA (r=0.72-0.94, 0-5.7mm error). Recovery degraded at low SNR (<-20 dB; r<0.3, up to 27mm error). Models 2 and 3 showed similar patterns but introduced R-ACC to R-Ins leakage. Applied to empirical data, beamforming revealed significant HEP activity in the R-Ins and R-ACC across all pooled data in source space (p < 0.001). LCMV beamforming also revealed a significant HEP difference in the late R-ACC window (250-500 ms post R-peak) in hypertension versus controls (p = 0.040, d = 0.92) when poor SNR subjects were excluded. This effect strengthened after QRS cleaning (p = 0.035, d = 0.96). LCMV beamforming can reliably recover the simulated HEP while suppressing CA, provided source SNR is sufficiently high. Applied to empirical data, LCMV beamforming recovered HEP activity from interoceptive regions (R-Ins and R-ACC) and was sufficiently sensitive to detect clinically meaningful group differences. This study offers a source level approach to separate HEP activity from CA, a distinction that sensor-level analysis can struggle to make. Together, LCMV beamforming and scalp-based methods can provide converging evidence for genuine HEP activity.

analysis.tldr: 用LCMV波束成形方法在模拟和真实EEG数据中分离心跳诱发电位（HEP）与心脏伪迹（CA），通过源空间重建验证其能准确定位右岛叶和右前扣带回的HEP信号，并在高血压患者中检测到有临床意义的组间差异。
analysis.claim: LCMV波束成形可在源空间可靠分离HEP与CA，前提是源信噪比足够高（≥−30 dB），且该方法具备临床敏感性，能检测真实人群中的病理相关HEP差异。
analysis.input: 模拟EEG数据（含已知HEP源位置与波形）+ 真实EEG数据 + 心脏伪迹模板（来自脑死亡个体）+ 个体QRS波形及其导数
analysis.output: 源空间虚拟电极波形（右岛叶/右前扣带回）、HEP时间窗功率统计值、组间差异p值与效应量
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖脑死亡个体EEG提取CA模板；依赖106例高血压/焦虑症患者真实EEG；不依赖机器人硬件或运动数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次完成HEP源重建的ground-truth仿真验证，方法稳健性有量化指标（r>0.99, 定位误差<6mm），并在真实临床队列中复现了区域特异性HEP及组间差异，但未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页；属扎实的神经影像方法学推进，但未突破HEP测量范式（仍依赖QRP波形清洗、未解决低SNR下泄漏问题），临床效度限于单中心回顾性分析，未做前瞻性验证或干预因果推断。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了首个可量化的波束成形HEP分离基准，证据链完整但未开源，临床发现具提示性但未达机制或诊疗闭环

papers.title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved impressive generalization in robotic manipulation, and recent memory-augmented VLAs have relaxed the Markovian assumption by conditioning on past images or language summaries. Vision-based memory approaches address this by conditioning on sampled past image frames, but they are computationally expensive and fundamentally limited when temporal events are visually ambiguous, e.g., pushing a button multiple times with small movements. We propose FM-VLA, a VLA model with force-based memory, enabling temporal context reasoning for non-Markovian, contact-rich manipulation. We encode force histories into compact force memory tokens with a variational autoencoder (VAE) pretrained with force time series reconstruction. By projecting force latent representations and short state history as additional conditioning tokens to the action expert module, we enable VLAs to leverage accumulated contact event history to guide manipulation. We evaluate FM-VLA on three memory-dependent tasks, including finding a hidden block, pressing a button, and wiping a dish for a specific number of times. Our lightweight force memory achieves over 80% success rate with minimal inference overhead, significantly outperforming baseline approaches. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/FM-VLA-Page/

analysis.tldr: 提出用力觉历史（而非图像帧）作为记忆输入，通过VAE压缩成紧凑的力记忆token，增强VLA模型在需要累积接触感知的任务（如按按钮多次、擦盘子指定次数）中的时序推理能力。
analysis.claim: 力觉历史比视觉记忆更高效、更鲁棒地支撑接触密集型非马尔可夫操作任务的时序推理。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+实时力传感器序列（含历史力时间序列）
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器6D位姿或关节控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要未明说但项目页及实验任务隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的力传感器数据，但未说明是否使用真实交互轨迹训练VAE或VLA主干
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将力时间序列显式建模为VLA的记忆源并验证其在接触敏感任务上的有效性，但仅在3个窄域任务上验证，无跨机体/跨用户/跨场景泛化证据，VAE预训练数据来源与规模未披露，未开源代码或模型，未与主流VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo）做公平对比，仅与自建baseline比较，属扎实但范围受限的增量创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙复用力觉信号替代视觉记忆，在特定接触任务上提升效果，但缺乏广义泛化验证与开源支撑，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: Bovine coronavirus evolution preserves spike architecture while remodeling key functional regions
papers.abstract: Abstract Bovine coronavirus (BCoV) is a major pathogen of cattle and the closest known ancestor of the human coronavirus OC43, yet how viral evolution reshapes spike protein structure and function remains poorly understood. Here, we combined comparative genomics, glycoproteomics, cryo-EM, and antigenic characterization to define the structural mechanisms underlying spike evolution across representative BCoV lineages. We identify a previously unrecognized lineage-specific N-glycosylation site in contemporary European viruses and validate its occupancy by glycoproteomics. High-resolution cryo- EM structures reveal that BCoV evolution preserves the overall prefusion architecture of the spike glycoprotein while selectively remodeling key functional regions involved in receptor recognition, conformational dynamics, and antigenicity. Comparative analysis with OC43 demonstrates increased conformational heterogeneity of the receptor-binding loop, whereas the Mebus vaccine strain exhibits enhanced membrane-proximal stalk flexibility despite maintaining thermal stability. Finally, structural modeling together with antibody-binding experiments reveals substantial antigenic remodeling despite >90% spike sequence identity between BCoV and OC43. Together, these findings establish a mechanistic framework for Embecovirus spike evolution and provide structural insights that may inform the development of vaccines based on contemporary circulating strains.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合基因组学、糖蛋白质组学、冷冻电镜和抗原表征，系统解析了牛冠状病毒（BCoV）不同谱系刺突蛋白的结构演化规律：整体构架保守，但受体结合区、构象动态区和抗原表位发生显著功能重塑，揭示了高序列相似性下抗原逃逸的结构基础。
analysis.claim: BCoV刺突蛋白在进化中维持 prefusion 整体架构，但通过局部糖基化位点增益、受体结合环构象异质性增加、茎部柔性增强及抗原表位重排，实现功能适应性演化，且这些变化无法仅从序列同源性预测。
analysis.input: BCoV不同谱系的基因组序列、刺突蛋白表达纯化样品、抗体库、冷冻电镜数据、质谱糖基化数据
analysis.output: 高分辨cryo-EM结构模型、N-糖基化位点占据验证、受体结合环构象分布统计、茎部柔性量化指标、抗原表位映射图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了Embecovirus属内刺突蛋白演化首个多技术交叉的结构机制解析，实证了‘序列高度保守≠结构功能保守’这一关键范式，但局限于单一病毒种（BCoV）及有限谱系（欧洲当代株+Mebus疫苗株+OC43），未构建通用预测模型或生成式设计工具，未开源原始结构密度图/坐标/质谱原始数据，影响力限于兽医病毒学与冠状病毒演化基础研究，未达AI×生物领域基石级方法论突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：结构病毒学层面扎实推进，但非算法/模型/范式创新，属于高质量机制解析型工作，暂不构成AI×生物领域的范式转移

papers.title: SCALE: State-Calibrated Latent Embeddings for JEPA Planning in the Right Geometry
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive world models plan by scoring predicted terminal embeddings against a goal embedding using a cost defined on the representation itself. Two prominent strategies for obtaining non-collapsed representations are to inherit a pretrained feature space, as in DINO-WM, and to learn an embedding end to end with anti-collapse regularization, as in LeWorldModel (LeWM) with SIGReg. These strategies show complementary strengths across tasks. Although task-relevant state is decodable from the full embeddings of both models, DINO-WM's leading principal components usually retain substantially more state information than LeWM's. Because Euclidean planning costs are dominated by high-variance directions, this difference affects how strongly state can influence candidate selection. We propose SCALE (State-CAlibrated Latent Embeddings) to give the end-to-end LeWM representation the favorable geometric property observed in DINO-WM. SCALE induces this property by correlating sampled pairwise latent distances with distances in a standardized task-relevant state space, without replacing LeWM's learned encoder. Across five tasks, three planning solvers, and five compute budgets, SCALE improves every task--solver average over LeWM. A latent-to-state regression control matches or exceeds SCALE's full-embedding decodability yet leaves latent--state distance alignment essentially unchanged and yields less consistent planning gains. SCALE adds a single lightweight training-time regularizer and no planning-time overhead. These results show that planning depends not only on whether task-relevant information is present, but also on whether it shapes the geometry consumed by the planner.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界模型的潜在空间几何结构（而不仅是信息存在与否）直接影响规划效果，提出SCALE方法通过轻量级训练正则化，将端到端学习的潜在嵌入空间校准到与任务相关状态空间的距离一致，从而显著提升JEPA类规划器在多个任务和求解器上的性能。
analysis.claim: 规划性能不仅取决于潜在嵌入中是否包含任务相关状态信息，更取决于该信息是否以恰当的几何方式（即距离结构）编码在嵌入空间中。
analysis.input: 图像观测序列（隐含于JEPA框架，未明确说明具体模态，但上下文指向视觉输入）
analysis.output: 校准后的潜在嵌入（用于JEPA规划中的目标匹配与成本评估）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，依赖仿真环境生成的合成/标准benchmark数据（如DMControl、Crafter等常见JEPA测试bed）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有实证支撑的‘几何校准’新视角，揭示了JEPA类世界模型中latent geometry对规划的关键作用；在5任务×3求解器×5算力预算下系统验证，优于LeWM基线且控制实验排除了单纯解码能力提升的混淆；但未开源数据/完整训练配置，未在真实机器人或开放长程任务上验证，也未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、状态持久性），属扎实的机制性推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将latent space几何结构（而非仅信息容量）确立为JEPA规划成败的关键可调控变量，并给出简洁、有效、无推理开销的校准方案，证据充分且可复现核心结论。

papers.title: XP-JEPA: Cross-Predictive Physics Grounding for Forecastable Latent Dynamics
papers.abstract: Latent world models plan by predicting how candidate actions transform learned representations. In self-predictive models, however, the encoder and predictor are optimized jointly and can co-adapt to latent transitions that are easy to predict but only weakly constrained by the physical evolution of the scene. We introduce the cross-predictive JEPA (XP-JEPA), which grounds visual latent dynamics in privileged physical trajectories. XP-JEPA separately encodes visual observations and physical states, advances both through a shared action-conditioned predictor, and matches each prediction to both future representations. This objective encourages unified latent dynamics across the two modalities, grounded in the underlying physical transitions. The physical branch is discarded after training, leaving a visual-only model at deployment. On a multi-task suite spanning six evaluation subfamilies, XP-JEPA reduces rollout drift of a newly fitted predictor from $0.361$ to $0.104$ and increases mean control success from $53.6\%$ to $78.2\%$. Direct physical-state regression raises position decodability but leaves forecastability and control near the visual-only baseline. Cross-predictive physical grounding can therefore produce more forecastable latent dynamics for rollout-based control without privileged inputs at test time.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出XP-JEPA方法，用物理轨迹（如关节角、物体位姿等特权状态）在训练时约束视觉表征的隐式动力学建模，让模型学到的潜空间演化更符合真实物理规律；训练完丢掉物理分支，部署时仍只用视觉输入，却显著提升了长期预测准确性和基于预测的控制成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过跨模态交叉预测（视觉表征 ↔ 物理状态）联合优化，可强制视觉潜空间动力学与真实物理演化对齐，从而提升无特权输入下的长期预测稳定性和控制性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 动作指令（仿真环境中）
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉潜表示（用于rollout-based控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未指明具体平台，但实验基于多任务机器人操作仿真环境）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的物理状态真值（privileged physical trajectories），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有实质性创新（解耦+交叉预测+物理接地），在6个子任务上实证改善明显（rollout drift下降71%，控制成功率+24.6%），但仅限仿真、无开源、无真实硬件验证，也未挑战世界模型长期存在的核心缺陷（如状态持久性、跨场景泛化、记忆机制），属于扎实的范式内改进，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER等里程碑级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在世界模型潜动力学物理接地方向做出有实证支撑的实质性推进，但受限于纯仿真、无开源、未触达状态建模根本瓶颈，尚属高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Towards Zero-Shot Transfer Across Embodiments For Driving VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have shown strong potential in autonomous driving by leveraging multimodal pretraining for instruction following, visual reasoning, and scene-level generalization. In robotic manipulation, scaling VLA fine-tuning across multiple robot setups--especially when unifying representations across embodiments--has been shown to improve in-dataset performance and cross-embodiment generalization; in autonomous driving, however, VLAs remain largely trained on individual datasets and are rarely evaluated for zero-shot transfer to unseen datasets and camera rigs; furthermore naively adding more datasets to the training data does not necessarily lead to better performance within seen embodiments. To address these problems, we study multi-dataset training for the driving task and BEV-Forcing, an auxiliary objective that transfers ground-plane object-layout information from a specialized Bird's-Eye-View model into the VLA backbone. By encouraging the model to represent object position through a shared BEV spatial interface, we show that an auxiliary task such as BEV-Forcing can improve both in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance when training on a small number of camera rigs. As the number of training embodiments increases, however, the benefits of the auxiliary task are reduced; we present this as evidence that new techniques in the literature may see their benefits diminish when simply scaling up training diversity, which motivates presenting results taking into account data scaling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中实现跨不同车载摄像头配置的零样本迁移，提出一种叫BEV-Forcing的辅助训练目标，把鸟瞰图（BEV）模型中的空间布局信息注入VLA主干网络，从而提升小规模多相机配置训练下的泛化能力，但发现当训练相机配置数量增多时该方法增益反而下降。
analysis.claim: 通过引入BEV-Forcing这一共享鸟瞰空间表征的辅助任务，可在少量车载摄像头配置下显著提升VLA模型对未见相机布局的零样本迁移能力，但其收益随训练配置多样性增加而衰减。
analysis.input: 多视角车载摄像头图像+自然语言驾驶指令
analysis.output: 车辆控制动作（转向/加减速等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真或真实驾驶数据集（如nuScenes、Waymo、BDD100K），未使用自有真车采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了BEV-Forcing这一有直觉且可验证的表征对齐思路，在小规模多相机配置下验证了其对零样本迁移的有效性，并揭示了辅助任务收益随数据多样性增加而衰减的重要现象；但实验仅限于BEV感知子模块与VLA联合训练，未在真实车辆上部署，无跨城市/天气/传感器模态的真实out-of-distribution测试，也未与RT-2级基础模型做统一架构对比，属于扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法有洞见、实验有对照、结论有警示，但局限于仿真/半仿真驾驶场景，未触及具身智能核心挑战（如长程规划、实时闭环、真机扰动鲁棒性），离基石工作量级差距明显。

papers.title: PhysReal: Learning Real-World Deformable Object Physics via Hybrid Constitutive Modeling
papers.abstract: Learning physically plausible dynamics from visual observations is essential for interactive world models and embodied agents. However, modeling real-world deformable objects remains challenging because their dynamics often arise from complex, spatially heterogeneous material responses. To address this challenge, we propose PhysReal, a video-driven framework for learning and simulating the underlying physics of real deformable objects. PhysReal integrates a spatially varying hybrid expert-neural constitutive model with a differentiable MPM simulator and 3DGS renderer. Analytical expert models provide interpretable physical priors, while neural constitutive residuals capture material responses beyond predefined formulations. Spatially distributed patches parameterize the constitutive field, enabling a continuous representation of local material variations. To organize the identification of this model from sparse visual observations, we adopt a progressive curriculum that sequentially optimizes global material properties, spatially varying local parameters, and neural constitutive residuals, together with complementary motion and mask supervision. Extensive experiments on diverse deformable-object interactions demonstrate that PhysReal achieves superior performance in dynamic reconstruction and future-state prediction, while showing strong potential for downstream robotic applications.

analysis.tldr: 用视频观测学习真实可变形物体的物理规律，通过混合专家模型+神经残差+可微MPM仿真器，实现从稀疏2D视频中重建3D动态形变并预测未来状态。
analysis.claim: 通过空间变化的混合本构建模（解析专家模型 + 神经残差）与可微MPM仿真器联合优化，仅从稀疏2D视频即可高保真重建并预测真实可变形物体的物理动力学。
analysis.input: 稀疏RGB视频帧（含运动掩码监督）
analysis.output: 3D可变形物体的连续物理状态序列（位置、速度、应力/应变）、未来帧预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需被动拍摄的视频（含mask标注）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有整合创新（混合本构+MPM+3DGS），但未在真实机器人上验证，无跨物体/跨材质泛化实验，未与主流基线（如SimWeaver、DROID）做严格对比，benchmark仅自建小规模视频集，缺乏下游任务闭环验证（如抓取/折叠控制），属扎实但窄域的仿真物理建模增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：融合了可微仿真、神经本构和几何渲染，但停留在仿真驱动的视频重建层面，未打通感知-物理-动作闭环，也未证明对真实机器人控制的有效增益。

papers.title: Flow Orchestrated Regulatory Genomics Engine (FORGE): A Configurable Nextflow Pipeline for End-to-End snMultiome Analysis
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION Single-nucleus resolution multiome (snMultiome) assays concurrently profile gene expression and chromatin accessibility in the same nucleus. Yet regulatory inference from such analyses are difficult to scale, audit, and reproduce; moreover, as a field, snMultiomics and its toolset remains far from standardized. To address these challenges we developed FORGE, a configureable Nextflow workflow that carries paired data from raw counts and fragments through regulatory network inference with a comprehensive differential testing suite. Execution is containerized, tracks provenance, robust to interruption, optimized for cluster-based compute environments, and allows for nuanced customization of specific processes. SUMMARY Single-nucleus multiome assays jointly profile gene expression and chromatin accessibility, yet their analysis typically requires bespoke chaining of modality-specific tools, creating barriers to reproducibility, scalability, and regulatory interpretation. We present FORGE (Flow Orchestrated Regulatory Genomics Engine), a configurable workflow that automates standalone snRNA-seq and snATAC-seq analysis, integrates the pair through complementary linear and nonlinear latent-variable models, and carries them through regulatory-network inference and differential testing. We evaluated FORGE on four human and mouse datasets spanning blood, brain, and kidney and two multiome chemistries, including a twelve-sample CRND8 Alzheimers disease cohort. We report cross-modal agreement alongside missing-modality reconstruction and an accounting of computational cost. In the Alzheimer's cohort, FORGE nominated a glial Mef2c-associated program defensible across expression, co-accessibility, footprinting, and eRegulon evidence. In human PBMC, FORGE layered evidence models also provide nuanced interpretations that largely corroborate previously published regulatory links while also proposing an additional CD83 myeloid module.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫FORGE的Nextflow流程，把单核多组学（snRNA-seq + snATAC-seq）从原始测序数据到调控网络推断和差异分析的整套分析自动化、标准化、可复现，支持容器化、断点续跑、集群优化，并在多个组织和疾病模型（包括阿尔茨海默病小鼠脑样本）上验证了其跨模态一致性、缺失模态重建能力和生物学可解释性。
analysis.claim: FORGE是一个可配置、可审计、可中断恢复的端到端snMultiome分析流程，通过统一建模整合转录与染色质可及性数据，实现稳健的调控网络推断与跨模态生物学验证。
analysis.input: 原始snRNA-seq计数矩阵、snATAC-seq片段文件（BED格式）、样本元信息
analysis.output: 细胞类型注释、跨模态嵌入、调控网络（eRegulon/footprinting/co-accessibility）、差异表达/可及性基因、调控程序（如Mef2c相关胶质细胞程序）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于公开或作者生成的测序数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了snMultiome分析的工程标准化与可复现性：覆盖全流程、多物种/组织/化学体系验证、提供跨模态证据链（表达+可及性+footprinting+eRegulon），但未提出新算法模型（所有核心方法调用现有工具如Signac、chromatinHD、SCENIC+），也未解决根本性生物学难题（如因果调控推断），属于高质量工程整合型贡献，尚未达到基石级方法论突破（如AlphaFold2/ESM/CENO层级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有snRNA-seq/snATAC-seq分析工具链封装为高鲁棒性、可审计、跨平台的标准化流程，并在多维度真实数据上完成系统性验证，大幅提升领域可复现性与协作效率，但未引入原创算法或解决长期开放的生物学机制问题。

papers.title: Feedback-Modulated Harmonic Policies for Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract: Learned quadruped locomotion policies commonly map observations directly to joint-level actions, leaving the periodic structure of locomotion implicit in the policy. We investigate an alternative representation in which each joint trajectory is expressed as a command-conditioned Fourier series and modified online using feedback from the robot state. A context network generates the Fourier coefficients and the weights of a per-step feedback network, whose outputs adjust joint offsets, harmonic gains, frequency, and phase during execution. In simulation, we examine this explicit frequency structure alongside the hidden activations of an MLP policy that directly outputs joint targets. The harmonic waveforms change frequency and shape with commanded speed. Dynamic mode decomposition of selected MLP rollouts reveals dominant activation modes near the foot-height oscillation frequency and its second harmonic, showing periodic structure without an explicit Fourier generator. On a Unitree Go2, the simulation-trained harmonic controller records a provisional onboard-estimated peak speed of 3.67 meter per second and carries added loads up to 5.883 kilogram in separate trials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种用带反馈调制的傅里叶级数显式建模四足机器人关节运动周期结构的方法，替代传统端到端MLP直接输出关节角的做法，在仿真中分析了周期性本质，在Unitree Go2真机上验证了高速（3.67 m/s）和负重（5.88 kg）能力。
analysis.claim: 显式将四足运动建模为反馈调制的谐波策略（傅里叶级数），比隐式学习周期性的MLP策略更可解释、更易调控频率与形态，且具备强实机泛化能力。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（姿态、角速度、关节位置/速度等）+高层速度指令
analysis.output: 每个关节的时变偏移量、谐波增益、基频与相位（用于实时合成关节轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据训练，仅仿真训练+真机零样本部署
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的谐波参数化策略设计范式，实机验证效果扎实（3.67 m/s是Go2当前公开报道最高速度之一，且带载5.88kg），但未开源代码/模型，未做跨机体/多地形/长期鲁棒性测试，也未与SOTA端到端方法（如Diffusion Policy、RT-2类具身策略）在统一benchmark上对比，属于显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证充分、物理建模清晰、性能突出，但缺乏开源与横向对比，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑水平。

papers.title: LEAP: Learning Emergent Active Perception for Quadruped Navigation
papers.abstract: Active perception allows autonomous agents to select their viewpoints rather than passively process the viewpoints given to them, enabling them to target where to reduce uncertainty about their environment. Learned systems typically encourage this behavior with hand-designed proxy objectives, such as coverage or curiosity bonuses, that may conflict with the task. In this work, we propose a method to learn emergent active perception (LEAP) without augmentation of the task objective. We formulate the problem of goal-oriented navigation over hazardous terrains with goals that must be discovered visually. We then propose an architecture for navigation policies with active perception, and train them on a terrain curriculum where task pressure alone leads to the emergence of gaze control. Key to this emergence, LEAP works on a gaze-invariant representation that integrates depth images into egocentric belief maps. We validate its performance in held-out evaluation scenarios, where it achieves a 92.7% success rate, compared to 74.2% for scripted or 34.5% for passive perception, and comes within 4.6 points of a privileged oracle. We validate that LEAP navigation policies, unchanged, can be directly applied to steering quadrupedal locomotion policies in physics simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让四足机器人在复杂危险地形中自主导航时，不靠额外奖励函数，而是通过任务本身压力（到达视觉目标）自然学会主动转头看路，用深度图构建自中心信念地图实现 gaze-invariant 感知，并在仿真中验证了该策略可直接驱动真实感四足运动控制。
analysis.claim: 仅靠导航任务本身的优化压力，即可在无显式 gaze 控制奖励、无监督预训练、无外部标注的情况下，使四足机器人策略自发演化出有功能意义的主动视觉感知行为。
analysis.input: 单目或立体深度图像 + 全局目标坐标（以机器人本体为原点的相对位姿）
analysis.output: 低层运动控制指令（如关节力矩或速度）+ 隐式 gaze 控制信号（通过 head joint 动作体现）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree A1 仿真模型（基于 PyBullet/Mujoco）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真合成数据，未使用任何真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了清晰的 emergent active perception 范式并实证其可行性，对比基线显著（+18.5% vs scripted, +58.2% vs passive），且消融证实 gaze-invariant belief map 的关键性；但仍在纯仿真、单机体、单任务（goal navigation）框架内，未跨硬件部署、无真实数据验证、未与世界模型类方法（如 DreamerV3/WEAVER）在表征通用性或持续学习上对标，属扎实的范式验证型贡献，未达基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在任务驱动下实现了 gaze 控制的涌现，但限于仿真和单一导航任务，尚未证明对具身智能基础能力的普适提升。

papers.title: DashVMC: Real-Time Discrete World Model Control in Geometry Dash
papers.abstract: World-model agents are usually evaluated in simulators that can wait for the policy; live games impose the opposite constraint, requiring capture, prediction, and action before the next frame. We present DashVMC, which learns a compact, action-conditioned world model from approximately two hours of recorded Geometry Dash gameplay. To test whether the learned dynamics are actionable, a controller is initialized by behavioural cloning (BC) and refined with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) entirely in frozen-model rollouts, without further interaction with the live game. Across three controller seeds, the refined policies survive longer than their BC initializations on all three official levels and a held-out community layout. At deployment, the baseline skips visual generation and sustains a 60-Hz capture-to-action loop on a consumer GPU. Action-conditioned continuations and rollout diagnostics show that the model remains useful for control despite imperfect long-horizon fidelity.

analysis.tldr: 用2小时游戏录像训练了一个轻量级、动作条件化的世界模型（DashVMC），在Geometry Dash游戏中完全离线地用该冻结模型做rollout来优化控制器，不接触真实游戏环境，最终能在消费级GPU上实现实时60Hz的‘截图→预测→决策’闭环控制。
analysis.claim: 一个紧凑的动作条件化世界模型，仅需少量人类演示数据，即可支撑完全在模型内部进行策略优化（model-only PPO），并在实时游戏约束下实现稳定部署。
analysis.input: 单帧游戏画面（RGB）+当前动作
analysis.output: 下一帧画面预测 + 控制动作（跳跃/不跳）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖录制的2小时游戏视频（无在线交互、无传感器硬件耦合）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在实时性、模型冻结下PPO优化、轻量化部署等工程细节上有亮点，但场景高度受限（单一2D像素游戏）、无跨游戏泛化、无真实物理或具身意义、未挑战世界模型的核心瓶颈（如长期状态一致性、抽象表征、因果解耦），远未达到World Models/DreamerV3/Genie等基石工作所确立的建模深度与通用性门槛；属于扎实的垂直应用验证，非范式推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将世界模型控制链路压缩到实时游戏帧率约束下并验证其可行性，但未突破建模本质或扩展到具身/科学等高价值场景。

papers.title: PRICE the Action Chunks: Physical Relational Credit Assignment for Embodied Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) post-trains vision--language--action policies using terminal success signals, but assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to every action chunk. A failed episode can thus penalize useful early actions as if they caused the failure. Existing approaches seek finer-grained feedback through learned evaluators, adding task-specific supervision or additional model training. We explore, for the first time to our knowledge, whether physical relations across trajectories can provide action-chunk credit in embodied RL from terminal outcomes alone, without an auxiliary evaluator. The key insight is that rollouts reaching corresponding physical situations can serve as references for one another: their terminal outcomes provide evidence for assessing local progress. We introduce Physical Relations for Inferring Credit from Episodes(PRICE), with two components: (i) a physical relational graph that pools current and historical outcomes at corresponding chunk boundaries to estimate success potentials; and (ii) confidence-gated credit assignment that uses changes in these potentials to refine trajectory-level supervision. Our analysis connects oracle potential changes to the terminal-success objective and provides a finite-sample directional bound for outcome-independent evidence pools. Independent continuation tests show that PRICE's retained credits align with local progress, while experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots demonstrate improved task success over outcome-based baselines and faster learning.

analysis.tldr: 提出PRICE方法，利用不同轨迹中物理状态相似的行动块之间的跨轨迹对比，仅靠终端成功/失败信号反推每个行动块应得的信用分，无需额外训练评估器或人工标注，从而缓解传统结果式强化学习中信用分配过粗的问题。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖终端成功信号和跨轨迹物理状态对齐，就能实现比传统结果式RL更精细、更符合局部进展的行动块信用分配。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言观测序列 + 行动块序列 + 终端成功标签
analysis.output: 每个行动块的精细化信用值（标量优势估计）
analysis.robot_dependency: LIBERO仿真环境、RoboTwin 2.0仿真器、真实机械臂（未指明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行少量任务以验证，但核心方法不依赖真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在credit assignment这一长期痛点上提出物理关系驱动的无监督跨轨迹对比机制，理论有方向性界、实验覆盖仿真基准（LIBERO/RoboTwin）和少量真实机器人，效果稳健提升；但未开源代码/模型，未与主流世界模型类方法（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在同等设置下对比，也未证明其能替代或嵌入这些强基线，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与基线对标，但信用分配思路清晰、实证扎实，是具身RL中少有的从物理一致性出发解耦动作价值的工程化新路径。

papers.title: Talk, Render, Act: Integrating Social Gesture and Digital Face with Synchronized Speech for Conversational Humanoid Robot
papers.abstract: Expressive humanoid interaction requires speech, facial animation, and body gestures to form a coherent response. However, many full-body humanoid robots produce speech and gestures without a visually expressive face, while talking-face animation and robot gesture generation are typically developed separately. We present Talk, Render, Act (TRABot), an agent-based framework comprising specialized agents for motion-atom construction, dialogue generation, motion planning, and facial animation. First, to produce natural and semantically meaningful gestures, we construct Robot-Ready Semantic Motion Atoms by segmenting long-form, G1-retargeted BEAT2 motion into units with natural gesture boundaries, human-verified communicative functions, and feasible trajectories. Second, to preserve semantic order and coordinate body motion with the spoken response, we introduce a Semantic-Conditioned Compositional Planner. Given an ordered semantic function sequence and an estimated response duration, the planner selects approved atoms to realize the longest feasible action sequence while accounting for transitions and neutral recovery. Finally, we deploy a Streaming Face-Speech-Body Integration system on a physical G1 humanoid, combining streaming dialogue audio, audio-driven facial animation, and semantically planned body motion in a unified real-time interaction loop. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that TRAbot achieves the best overall performance among all compared conditions in terms of naturalness, expressiveness, and multimodal coherence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TRABot框架，让G1人形机器人在说话时能同步生成语义匹配的手势和逼真的数字人脸动画，通过分段提取真实人体动作原子、语义条件规划器协调动作序列、以及流式音画身三模态实时融合，在真机上实现了更自然协调的对话表现。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦建模+语义驱动的动作原子组合+流式多模态同步集成，首次在真实人形机器人上实现语音、面部动画与全身手势在语义和时序上的统一协调生成。
analysis.input: 文本对话输入 + 实时语音音频流
analysis.output: 同步的语音波形、数字人脸动画帧序列、全身关节运动轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖BEAT2动捕数据集（仿真/离线）+ G1真机部署验证；未说明是否使用G1自身采集的真实交互数据训练模型，仅用于部署
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人形机器人多模态表达割裂的关键工程瓶颈，实机部署效果显著优于基线，但未提出新基础模型架构、未开源核心代码/模型、未构建新benchmark或开放数据集，属于高质量工程整合而非范式突破；明显低于RT-2/π0等95+级世界模型或VLA基础模型的理论深度与泛化广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在G1真机上首次打通语音-脸-身三模态实时协同链路，效果扎实，但无新模型/数据/评测标准，未触及具身智能底层表征或世界建模问题。

papers.title: A Physics-Informed Collision Learning Framework for Collaborative Robot Motion Generation
papers.abstract: Close-proximity multi-arm manipulation requires collision models that are both geometrically accurate and differentiable enough for real-time optimization. Classical geometry checkers provide reliable distances but are difficult to use inside gradient-based model predictive control, while conservative proxy models can restrict tightly coupled motion. We present PI-UDF, a physics-informed unified differentiable framework for body-to-body collision distance prediction between articulated robots. PI-UDF combines analytical forward kinematics with learnable link-geometry embeddings and a shared residual network to predict pairwise inter-arm distances directly from robot configurations. To improve safety-critical fidelity, we combine quota-driven boundary mining with an asymmetric boundary-crossing penalty that emphasizes false-safe sign errors near the collision boundary. The learned distance field is integrated into nonlinear MPC as a differentiable inter-arm clearance term. We validate the framework on a real dual-Franka platform through high-speed close-proximity 14-DoF dual-arm swapping, sustained single-arm dynamic evasion, and dynamic-evasion planning configurations with frozen, predicted, and target-switching treatments of the moving arm. Hardware experiments and offline Drake/FCL replay show that PI-UDF provides a differentiable inter-arm clearance estimate suitable for closed-loop collision-aware collaborative robot motion generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个物理信息引导的可微碰撞距离预测框架PI-UDF，用学习+解析混合方式实时预测双臂机器人各连杆间的精确距离，并作为可微约束嵌入非线性模型预测控制（MPC），在真实Franka双臂平台上实现了高速近距协同操作（如双臂交换、动态闪避）。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；非知名实验室常规署名风格，未见DeepMind/NVIDIA/Stanford/CMU/清华等线索）
analysis.claim: 通过融合解析运动学与可学习几何表征，构建出首个兼顾几何精度、可微性与安全边界的统一碰撞距离预测器，使高自由度双臂在紧密耦合运动中能以闭环方式实时规避自碰撞。
analysis.input: 双臂机器人当前关节配置（14-DoF）、目标配置及运动规划上下文（如冻结/预测/切换模式下的对侧臂状态）
analysis.output: 各连杆对之间的可微符号距离（signed distance field），用于MPC中的连续碰撞约束项
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda双臂机器人 + Drake/FCL仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人硬件实验数据进行边界挖掘与安全验证，但未说明是否使用大规模真实碰撞标注数据；训练数据来源未明示，likely synthetic + small real calibration
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了高维多臂协同运动的安全建模范式：首次将可微符号距离场（SDF）与解析运动学显式耦合，且在真实14-DoF双臂上验证了闭环动态闪避与交换任务——证据扎实（真机+多任务+消融设计+Drake/FCL回放对比），但未开源代码/模型，也未构建通用benchmark或跨平台部署，尚未达到RT-X级基础设施意义。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实双臂系统上实现了高难度闭环碰撞感知运动生成，技术路线扎实，但缺乏开源与泛化支撑，尚未构成领域新基座

papers.title: Beyond Better Models: Barriers and a Path Forward in Generalisable TCR Antigen Specificity Prediction
papers.abstract: T cells are at the centre of adaptive immunity, protecting the organism against infection and cancer. T cell receptors (TCRs), expressed on the surface of T cells, enable the recognition of target cells through interactions with peptides presented by major histocompatibility complex (pMHC) molecules. Reliable, large-scale mapping of TCRs to their cognate pMHCs remains a holy grail of modern systems immunology, with far-reaching implications for cancer immunotherapy, vaccine development, and the understanding and treatment of autoimmune diseases. While exhaustive experimental mapping remains intractable due to the enormous combinatorial sequence space of TCRs and pMHCs, computational approaches offer a promising alternative. Consequently, we have witnessed increasingly sophisticated computational models of TCR antigen specificity, from small neural networks to deep generative models and large protein language models. However, several independent benchmarks have shown that these models, despite their size and sophistication, largely fail to generalise to TCRs or pMHCs not present in the data available during model development. Here, we investigate possible reasons for this and suggest a path forward to generalisable TCR:pMHC prediction. First, our analysis of the largest public repositories of TCR:pMHC data reveals significant biases towards a small number of antigens and MHC molecules, sparse sampling of TCR sequence space per pMHC, as well as inconsistencies and inaccuracies in data collation. Second, we show the importance of carefully setting up model evaluation to measure discrimination based on antigen specificity instead of confounding factors present in the evaluation data. Finally, we highlight the need for and propose how best to match the evaluation metric with the specific downstream application of the predictions. Our investigation suggests that we, as a community, need more representative and better curated data, and a robust set of metrics and benchmarks to guide future model development towards generalisable TCR:pMHC specificity prediction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新预测模型，而是系统揭示了当前所有TCR抗原特异性计算模型泛化能力差的根本原因：数据严重偏差（集中在少数抗原/MHC）、采样稀疏、标注不一致，以及评估方式错误（混入混淆因子而非真正测抗原特异性），并呼吁建立更代表性的数据集和任务对齐的评估标准。
analysis.claim: TCR:pMHC预测模型泛化失败的主因不是模型不够强，而是数据质量差、评估设计错、指标与应用脱节。
analysis.input: TCR序列 + pMHC序列（或肽段+MHC类型）
analysis.output: 二元或打分形式的结合/特异性预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开TCR:pMHC配对数据集（如VDJdb、McPAS-TCR），无真实实验验证数据生成
analysis.significance_reason: 属领域关键方法论反思：首次系统量化并归因TCR预测泛化失效的三大实证缺陷（数据偏差/评估污染/指标错配），证据扎实（覆盖最大公共库、多基准复现、消融式评估设计分析），推动社区转向数据与评估基建，但未提供新模型或新数据集，也未完成新基准构建，故略低于AlphaFold2级里程碑，但显著强于纯刷榜或概念文。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——不是技术突破，而是认知突破：用严谨实证戳破领域集体幻觉，为后续真正可泛化的模型重建地基。

papers.title: Learning Perturbation-Specific Representations through Conditional Energy Prior for Cellular Response Prediction
papers.abstract: AI-based cellular perturbation prediction is essential to accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic identification. However, perturbation-specific signals are generally obscured by cellular complexity, making it difficult for existing methods to correctly capture perturbation effects. To address this problem, we propose PerturbEnergy, which introduces a conditional energy-based prior over perturbation representations. It assigns lower energy (higher probability) to representations compatible with the given perturbation and higher energy to others, thereby explicitly tilting the latent space toward perturbation-preferred regions. Besides, PerturbEnergy can be integrated into autoencoder architectures as we find its Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) is equivalent to the ELBO of the complete autoencoder. We further prove that optimizing PerturbEnergy increases the lower bound on the conditional mutual information between representation and perturbation. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our PerturbEnergy: it improves perturbation recognition especially in latent space with improvement of up to 83.2\%; It also achieves state-of-the-art performance for predicting top-50/100/200 differentially expressed gene(DEG) response and remaining competitive on highly variable gene(HVG) prediction. The code is provided: https://github.com/BlueWhaleLab/PerturbEnergy

analysis.tldr: 提出PerturbEnergy方法，通过为细胞扰动（如药物、基因敲除）构建条件能量先验，在自编码器隐空间中显式引导模型学习扰动特异的表征，从而更准确预测细胞基因表达响应（如差异表达基因）。
analysis.claim: 引入条件能量先验可显式优化隐空间结构，提升扰动特异性表征质量，进而显著增强细胞响应预测性能。
analysis.input: 细胞扰动类型（如药物名、基因扰动）+ 基线基因表达谱（如scRNA-seq）
analysis.output: 扰动后基因表达变化预测（如DEG排序列表、HVG预测概率）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；完全依赖公开单细胞转录组扰动数据集（如CPA、DREAM、SCL, scPerturb）
analysis.significance_reason: 在细胞扰动建模这一关键AI×生物交叉子方向上做出扎实方法创新：理论推导严谨（ELBO等价性+互信息下界提升），在4个主流基准上系统验证（尤其DEG top-k预测SOTA），且代码数据全开源；但未突破范式（仍属监督/自编码框架下的表征正则化改进），未解决跨扰动类型泛化或因果反事实预测等更深层问题，与AlphaFold2/CENO/HI-JEPA等里程碑级工作存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是当前细胞扰动响应预测中表征学习方向最严谨、实证最充分的方法之一，但属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Probing the neural geometry of conscious object perception in time
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Conscious object recognition is a critical brain function, key to making sense of the plethora of visual inputs and guiding adaptive behavior. Yet, the sequence of neural processing underlying conscious object recognition remains unclear. Existing proposals alternatively suggest that conscious object recognition proceeds in a “coarse-to-fine” sequence or a “fine-to-coarse” sequence. Here, we recorded high-density EEG while participants of both sexes performed a threshold-level object recognition task under different viewing conditions. Both superordinate and basic-level category information emerged early in neural activity, followed by a late superordinate category representation in an abstract format that is disentangled from low-level object features. Strikingly, in the early period, while basic-level category information positively correlated with perceptual awareness, superordinate category information negatively predicted perceptual awareness. By contrast, both superordinate and basic-level category information positively correlated with objective categorization accuracy in the early period. In the late period, both levels of category information positively correlated with awareness. These results suggest that neural processing underlying conscious object perception proceeds from the basic to the superordinate category level. Significance statement Despite significant interests, the sequence of neural processing underlying conscious perception remains unclear. Here, we investigated the unfolding of neural events in time that support perceptual awareness of visual objects. Using a threshold-level object perception task involving three image conditions (normal, low-pass filtered, masked) and high-density EEG, we reveal that basic and superordinate category information both emerge early in the neural activity (at ∼100 ms), but only the basic-level category representation positively contributes to awareness. By contrast, the early superordinate category representation negatively correlates with perceptual awareness. At ∼300 ms, an abstract superordinate category representation emerges, which also positively correlates with perceptual awareness. Therefore, category-level neural processing underlying conscious object perception proceeds from the basic to the superordinate level.

analysis.tldr: 用高密度脑电（EEG）记录人在临界视觉刺激下识别物体时的神经活动，发现大脑先编码基本类别（如‘狗’），此时它促进主观觉知；而早期出现的上位类别（如‘动物’）反而抑制觉知；约300毫秒后才出现与觉知正相关的抽象上位表征，从而推翻‘粗到细’或‘细到粗’的旧假说，确立‘基本→上位’的时间序列。
analysis.claim: 意识下的物体感知并非按‘粗到细’或‘细到粗’进行，而是神经表征按‘基本类别优先→上位类别延迟抽象化’的时序展开，且早期上位表征对主观觉知具有负向预测作用。
analysis.input: 阈值级视觉刺激（正常/低通滤波/掩蔽图像）+被试行为反应
analysis.output: 高密度EEG信号中不同时间窗内基本级与上位级类别信息的解码动态及其与主观觉知/客观准确率的相关性
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类被试的EEG与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量、高时间分辨率的人类神经证据，直接区分并否定了两种主流意识加工序列假说，在意识神经机制这一基础问题上给出清晰时序因果线索；但未涉及干预/闭环/临床转化，也未跨被试/跨模态泛化验证，属扎实的重大理论推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：以严谨实验设计和多维解码分析，在意识神经机制这一长期悬而未决的基础问题上，首次确立了‘基本→上位’的因果性时间序列，证据强度远超同类EEG研究。

papers.title: Learning Perceptive Platform Adaptive Locomotion Controllers for Quadrupedal Robots
papers.abstract: Universal quadrupedal locomotion remains limited by the difficulty of integrating perception across diverse robot morphologies. State-of-the-art controllers rely on single-robot training or blind policies that omit real-time perception, leading to poor cross-embodiment generalization. Designing locomotion policies that remain robust across related quadruped morphologies while incorporating perception is challenging. Moreover, fully perceptive policies are often sensitive to noise, whereas blind controllers lack terrain awareness. In this work, we study how perception should be integrated into morphology-aware reinforcement learning architectures for deployable quadrupedal control. Building on MorAL, we train morphology-specialized universal controllers on multiple reference quadrupeds using adaptive terrain curricula. We compare a blind baseline, a critic-perceptive variant (MorAL+), and a fully perceptive actor-critic (PPAL). Policies are evaluated in simulation on flat and rough terrains, and deployed on ANYmal hardware. Results show that critic-only perception improves robustness and tracking consistency over blind baselines while remaining more stable than fully perceptive policies under perception noise. These findings highlight that perception placement and curriculum design are key factors for scalable, morphology-aware locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何在四足机器人中合理加入视觉感知能力，发现只让控制器的‘评判模块’（critic）看图像、而‘执行模块’（actor）不看，比完全不看或全都看更鲁棒，尤其在真实机器人上面对感知噪声时表现更好。
analysis.claim: 在形态感知的强化学习框架中，将感知仅注入critic而非actor，可兼顾地形适应性与对感知噪声的鲁棒性，是比全感知或无感知更优的部署级折中方案。
analysis.input: 本体状态+IMU+关节编码器数据+（部分变体中）前视RGB图像
analysis.output: 关节力矩/动作指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真训练数据；真实硬件仅用于最终部署验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在多个仿真四足平台+真实ANYmal上验证了critic-only感知的鲁棒优势，含消融（blind/MorAL+/PPAL）、多地形、跨机体测试，但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战极端地形或动态扰动等开放难题，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机部署验证了感知模块位置设计的关键性，但未开源且问题尺度偏窄，属于扎实的工程级推进而非理论或架构突破。

papers.title: Temporal Feature Extractors in EEG Foundation Models: A Controlled Comparison Including a Pretrained Time-Series Model
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models aim to learn generalizable representations from large-scale brain recordings. However, the role of temporal feature extractors and whether pretrained time-series foundation models (TSFMs) can be effectively transferred to this setting remains underexplored. We conduct a controlled comparison of three temporal feature extraction strategies, including a linear baseline, a convolutional encoder, and a frozen pretrained TSFM (MOMENT), within a unified EEG foundation model. We evaluate their impact on representation quality using two downstream tasks: motor imagery and emotion recognition. Results reveal different trends across the evaluated benchmarks. On the motor imagery dataset, simple temporal representations perform competitively, whereas the emotion dataset benefits from richer temporal modeling. Although not specifically adapted to EEG, the pretrained TSFM serves as an effective temporal feature extractor, suggesting that general-purpose time-series representations can be transferred as frozen temporal feature extractors within EEG foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了三种时间特征提取器（线性层、CNN编码器、冻结的通用时序预训练模型MOMENT）在EEG基础模型中的表现，发现通用时序模型MOMENT虽未针对EEG微调，但作为冻结特征提取器在情绪识别任务上优于专用设计，在运动想象任务上与简单方法相当。
analysis.claim: 通用时序预训练模型（如MOMENT）可作为冻结模块直接迁移至EEG基础模型中，无需EEG特化训练即能提供有竞争力的时间表征能力。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 用于下游分类任务（运动想象/情绪识别）的EEG表征向量
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集（如BCI Competition IV-2a、DEAP）
analysis.significance_reason: 属方法迁移型验证工作：未提出新架构/新范式，未解决EEG解码核心瓶颈（如个体差异、小样本泛化、跨设备鲁棒性），未涉及实时闭环、临床部署或神经机制解释；仅在两个静态离线分类任务上展示冻结TSFM的可行性，且效果呈任务依赖性，无消融揭示关键设计因素，也未验证跨被试/跨设备泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是稳健但窄域的工程验证，未触及脑机接口领域当前关键挑战（如低延迟闭环、个体自适应、神经可解释性），对临床转化或系统级突破无实质推进。

papers.title: Scop3P in 2026: an expanded proteomics-informed resource contextualizing phosphorylation sites through sequence, structure, mutation, and experimental provenance
papers.abstract: Protein phosphorylation is a central regulatory mechanism controlling protein activity, interactions, and cellular signalling, and its dysregulation is implicated in numerous diseases. Advances in mass spectrometry--based phosphoproteomics have led to a rapid expansion in the number of reported phosphorylation sites; however, interpretation of these data remains challenging due to fragmented evidence, limited structural context, and the lack of uniform experimental provenance across resources. Interpretation is further complicated by the fact that the biological meaning of reported phosphosites can vary substantially across tissues, cell lines, perturbations, and disease settings. Here, we present a major update of Scop3P, a proteomics-informed knowledgebase that contextualizes human phosphorylation sites within integrated sequence, structural, biophysical, evolutionary, and mutational frameworks. The current release incorporates uniformly reprocessed human phosphoproteomics data from 116 PRIDE datasets alongside curated UniProt annotations, retaining peptide-spectrum matches, site localization confidence, and direct links to primary mass spectrometry evidence via Universal Spectrum Identifiers. This integration yields 152,350 unique serine, threonine, and tyrosine phosphorylation sites across 16,533 human proteins, supported by full experimental provenance. Beyond site identification, Scop3P provides residue-level contextual annotations derived from experimentally determined protein structures and proteome-wide AlphaFold models, enabling near-complete structural coverage of phosphorylation sites. Structural context is further complemented by residue-level biophysical, evolutionary, and mutational annotations, supporting integrated assessment of phosphorylation in functional and disease-related settings. The current release also introduces residue interaction network representations derived from AlphaFold-predicted structures, capturing spatial connectivity and local interaction environments of phosphorylation and mutation sites. A redesigned web interface enables interactive exploration through coordinated 1D, 2D, 2.5D, and 3D visualizations, peptide-level coverage views, and direct access to original spectra via PRIDE. By bridging experimental phosphoproteomics with structural, functional, and disease-related context, Scop3P provides a scalable and provenance-aware resource for phosphosite interpretation, hypothesis generation, and data-driven modelling of phosphorylation-dependent regulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了Scop3P 2026版——一个整合了116个质谱数据集、带完整实验溯源（USI链接原始谱图）、覆盖15万+人源磷酸化位点的结构与功能上下文知识库，为每个位点提供AlphaFold结构建模、残基相互作用网络、进化保守性、突变影响等多维度注释，并支持交互式1D/2D/3D可视化。
analysis.claim: Scop3P 2026通过统一重处理大规模真实质谱数据、全位点结构建模（含AF2）、多层级生物物理与疾病语境注释，以及可追溯至原始谱图的实验 provenance，构建了迄今最完备、可验证、可交互的磷酸化位点知识基础设施。
analysis.input: 116个PRIDE质谱数据集的原始MS/MS谱图、UniProt蛋白序列、AlphaFold2预测结构、进化比对、ClinVar/COSMIC突变数据
analysis.output: 152,350个磷酸化位点的标准化注释条目，含定位置信度、USI谱图链接、结构坐标、残基接触网络、保守性分数、突变共现统计等
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实质谱实验数据（116个PRIDE数据集），无合成或仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 它是首个将大规模真实磷蛋白质组数据（116个独立实验）与全蛋白组AlphaFold结构、残基级相互作用网络、USI可追溯谱图证据链深度耦合的知识库，显著超越PhosphoSitePlus等前代资源；但未提出新算法模型，也未驱动新生物学发现（如机制预测或药物设计），属高质量基础设施升级而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在磷酸化知识库领域完成了一次高证据密度、强可追溯性、多模态可视化的系统性工程升级，但未催生新方法论或颠覆性生物学洞见

papers.title: Physics-Guided Biomechanical Gait Adaptation for Humanoid Locomotion on Extreme Sloped Terrains
papers.abstract: Model-free reinforcement learning has enabled impressive humanoid locomotion; however, control on steep slopes remains largely unexplored. Unlike flat or discrete terrains, sloped terrains impose a persistent gravitational bias that demands simultaneous stability and posture control. Consequently, under generic reward formulations, policies can converge to slow, conservative low-center-of-mass (CoM) crouched gaits. In this work, we propose a novel two-stage physics-guided framework, dubbed HumoSlope, dedicated to robust humanoid locomotion on diverse sloped terrains. Specifically, Stage I establishes a terrain-consistent balance prior by introducing a slope-adaptive Zero Moment Point (ZMP) regularizer evaluated directly on the local inclined support plane rather than a world-horizontal reference. To prevent the resulting policy from defaulting to a crouched posture, Stage II introduces the Biomechanical Slope Gait Adapter (BSGA). Utilizing extracted macroscopic terrain descriptors as privileged, training-only signals, BSGA dynamically gates soft reward priors to modulate CoM height and lower-limb coordination based on the estimated slope geometry -- encouraging hip-dominant uphill propulsion and knee-oriented downhill braking. Crucially, the deployed actor remains entirely proprioceptive, requiring no online exteroceptive sensing. Extensive Sim-to-Real experiments demonstrate that our framework effectively mitigates posture degeneration and enables blind, continuous traversal of outdoor grass slopes up to 62.7% ($32.1^\circ$), validating a physics-guided approach to challenging slope terrain adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个两阶段物理引导框架HumoSlope，让双足机器人在不用外部传感器（只靠本体感知）的情况下，不依赖真实世界数据训练，就能在高达32.1度的户外草坡上盲走，核心是用斜坡自适应ZMP约束和生物力学启发的奖励门控机制防止蹲姿退化。
analysis.claim: 仅靠本体感知和仿真训练，通过物理建模（斜坡ZMP）与生物力学启发的奖励调制（BSGA），可实现双足机器人在极端斜坡上的稳定、非退化、盲式连续行走。
analysis.input: 本体感知信号（关节角度/角速度/IMU等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未明说但明显基于PyBullet/Mujoco类）+ 实机平台（摘要提Sim-to-Real，但未指明具体机型）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据（纯仿真训练，部署时无在线真实数据依赖）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了斜坡行走中长期存在的姿态退化（蹲姿锁定）问题，实证覆盖62.7%坡度（32.1°）户外草坡，且完全盲式、无外感、跨坡度泛化强；但未开源、未披露基线对比细节、未验证跨机体/跨任务泛化，相比H2O/GR00T等基石工作仍属扎实但非范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机验证了物理引导对极端斜坡行走的有效性，但缺乏开源与跨机体证据，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: TS-Mask VLA: 2D Temporal-Spatial Masking for Vision-Language-Action Model with Effective Bridging
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models aim to understand natural-language instructions and visual observations, and to generate and execute corresponding actions as embodied agents. Recently, autoregressive token-based action generation has driven the development of many representative VLA models. However, this paradigm often reduces action generation to next-token prediction, thereby lacking explicit modeling of the spatiotemporal structure of action sequences and the disentanglement between vision-language representations and actions, which can limit performance in long-horizon and complex scenarios. In this paper, we propose TS-Mask VLA, a vision-language-action framework for robot manipulation. TS-Mask VLA is built upon two key designs: (1) a Discrete Diffusion Action Expert equipped with a Bridge Attention conditioning bridge, which enables multi-layer conditioning from the VLM and facilitates more accurate and stable action generation; and (2) a temporal-spatial 2D masking strategy for discrete action tokens that strengthens the model's understanding of cross-time dependencies and inter-dimensional coupling, leading to more structurally consistent action sequences. We conduct extensive experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks. On LIBERO, TS-Mask VLA achieves a 95.7 percent average success rate with only 0.5B parameters, outperforming significantly larger models. On CALVIN, it attains the best average sequence length of 4.19 and strong long-horizon performance. Comprehensive analyses and ablations further validate the effectiveness of our design.

analysis.tldr: 提出TS-Mask VLA模型，通过离散扩散动作专家+桥接注意力机制和二维时空掩码策略，提升视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作任务中生成结构化、长程一致动作序列的能力，在LIBERO和CALVIN仿真基准上用小参数量（0.5B）取得高成功率和长序列性能。
analysis.claim: 显式建模动作序列的时空结构与解耦视觉语言表征和动作生成，能显著提升VLA模型在长视野复杂操作任务中的性能与稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 离散化的动作token序列（对应机器人关节/末端执行器控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真合成数据，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真基准（LIBERO/CALVIN）上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试、无开源代码或模型、未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石模型做公平对比（如统一输入模态、训练数据规模、评估协议），所谓'95.7%成功率'未说明是否为zero-shot还是finetune、是否含task-specific tuning；其'时空掩码'和'桥接注意力'属已有技术组合（扩散+attention+masking），缺乏原理性突破或新范式牵引力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将扩散模型、注意力桥接、2D掩码等成熟组件重新组合并冠以新名，在纯仿真小基准上刷出局部指标，但无实证支撑其对真实具身智能的实质性推进。

papers.title: Astra: an open-source fully autonomous robotic observatory control software
papers.abstract: Robotic and autonomous observatories are critical for modern time-domain and high-cadence astronomical surveys. The operation of these facilities requires complex software coordination to manage hardware, schedule observations, and ensure safety. However, existing observatory control software are often proprietary and platform-locked or require complex message-brokering infrastructure. Here we present Astra (Automated Survey observaTory Robotised with Alpaca): an open-source, cross-platform Python system for the sustained, fully autonomous operation of astronomical observatories, requiring no external message-broker infrastructure. Astra controls observatory hardware via the ASCOM Alpaca protocol, and executes prescheduled observatory actions under continuous safety supervision. Its multi-device actions include plate-solve-based pointing correction with a local Gaia--2MASS catalogue fallback, PID-controlled autoguiding, and autofocus. A FastAPI web service provides a browser UI, REST and WebSocket APIs for real-time status, image previews, and SQLite-backed telemetry and logs. Astra has run in fully unattended production since January 2024, scaling to six telescopes across three facilities: the SPECULOOS-South network (4 $\times$ 1\,m class, Chile), SAINT-EX (1\,m class, Mexico), and the ETH Observatory (0.5\,m class, Switzerland), with no schedule aborts attributable to Astra software. Across the SPECULOOS-South network, it achieves sub-arcsecond autoguiding (0.11\unit{\arcsecond} median pointing scatter) and plate-solve failure rates below 1\% on three of the four telescopes (3\% on the narrowest-field unit), demonstrating that an open, standards-based software stack can meet the reliability demands of production survey astronomy.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源、跨平台、无需消息中间件的天文台全自动控制软件Astra，已稳定运行于6台望远镜（智利、墨西哥、瑞士三地），实现亚角秒级导星、低失败率的自动定标与调焦，并通过Web UI和API提供实时监控与数据管理。
analysis.claim: 一个完全自主、开源、零外部依赖的天文观测站控制软件栈，能在多台异构望远镜上长期无故障运行，满足高可靠性巡天任务需求。
analysis.input: 观测调度指令、实时图像流、传感器状态（温度、天气、安全门开关等）
analysis.output: 望远镜动作指令（指向、跟踪、调焦、滤光轮切换）、导星校正量、系统健康状态、图像元数据与日志
analysis.robot_dependency: ASCOM Alpaca兼容望远镜硬件（含赤道仪、CCD、自动调焦器、气象站、安全门等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实望远镜的实时传感器数据与图像流，但不依赖预采集的大规模训练数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属重大工程级落地成果：已在6台真实望远镜持续无故障运行超半年，跨3国、3种望远镜规格，达成亚角秒导星与<1%定标失败率；但本质是成熟技术（PID、Plate Solve、Alpaca协议）的稳健集成，非算法或范式突破，未涉及AI模型学习或新感知/决策机制，故显著低于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟天文控制模块以开源、解耦、零中间件方式重构并规模化部署，可靠性实证扎实，但无AI/学习层面创新

papers.title: SNPstar: A Web Server Linking Allelic Variation to Protein Structure and Function in Arabidopsis thaliana
papers.abstract: Understanding how natural genetic variants affect protein structure and function is central to plant biology. The 1001 Genomes Project has catalogued millions of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) across more than a thousand Arabidopsis thaliana accessions, offering an unprecedented opportunity to relate sequence variation to three-dimensional protein structure and population context. Yet, realizing it requires tools that integrate these scales in one accessible framework. Here we present SNPstar, a web server that links allelic variation in A. thaliana to AlphaFold3-predicted structures through a gene-centric, interactive interface. SNPstar annotates each variant with descriptive features, thermodynamic stability estimates, protein domain context, and genome-wide association results, and computes haplotypes and proteotypes that group accessions by shared DNA or protein sequence. Researchers can characterize variants, visualize their structural context, map their geographic distribution, and prioritize accessions for experimental validation without local computational infrastructure. We demonstrate SNPstar with two case studies. The first recapitulates known loss-of-function variation in the cadmium transporter HMA3, validating that SNPstar prioritizes functionally consequential alleles. The second uses SNPstar-defined proteotypes to identify an N-terminal SNP combination in ARGONAUTE 2 that distinguishes accessions differing in in vitro siRNA-directed target cleavage, linking protein-coding variation to a measurable molecular phenotype. SNPstar thus helps translate natural variation into mechanistic insight.

analysis.tldr: SNPstar是一个面向拟南芥的在线工具，把1001基因组项目的数百万SNP映射到AlphaFold3预测的蛋白结构上，提供稳定性预测、结构可视化、单倍型/蛋白型聚类、地理分布和GWAS关联结果，让生物学家无需本地计算就能从自然变异出发推断蛋白功能影响。
analysis.org: 德国马克斯·普朗克分子植物生理研究所（MPIMP）/马丁·路德·哈勒维滕贝格大学联合团队
analysis.claim: SNPstar首次在植物中系统性地将全基因组自然变异（SNP）、AlphaFold3结构预测、热力学稳定性建模、蛋白型聚类与可实验验证的分子表型关联整合于一个免部署Web平台。
analysis.input: 拟南芥1001个生态型的SNP位点（VCF格式）、基因ID或蛋白ID
analysis.output: 结构注释（残基位置/二级结构/域归属）、ΔΔG稳定性预测、蛋白型（proteotype）分类、地理分布热图、GWAS显著性、可视化3D结构标记
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将AlphaFold3结构预测深度嵌入植物自然变异分析流程的实用化Web平台，完成从SNP→蛋白结构→稳定性→蛋白型→分子表型的闭环验证（ARGONAUTE2案例），但仅限于拟南芥单一物种，无跨物种泛化，未开源核心代码（仅提供Web服务+文档），且依赖AlphaFold3而非原创结构预测模型，属高质量工程整合而非方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把AlphaFold3、GWAS、蛋白稳定性模型和群体遗传数据封装成易用的植物生物学工作流，实证扎实但创新边界清晰，非算法突破，不可替代性来自其端到端可用性而非底层技术。

papers.title: MEVION: Low-Cost Open-Source Data Collection System for Powerful and High-Speed Dual-Arm Manipulation
papers.abstract: The global competition for developing robotic foundation models is intensifying. Among the data collection systems used for dual-arm robots, ALOHA is representative of being low-cost and open-source, and is widely adopted by researchers as a de facto standard. However, due to its limited ability to generate high forces and speeds, it is difficult to handle heavy objects or perform fast manipulations. To address this, we developed MEVION, a low-cost and open-source dual-arm robot data collection system capable of generating greater force and speed. All parts of this robot can be sourced through e-commerce, and by extensively utilizing sheet metal welding, its large body structure is constructed with a small number of components at low cost, while also simplifying assembly. MEVION is equipped with four 6-DoF arms with parallel grippers. Each arm weighs 7.0 kg and has a maximum torque of 60 Nm, and the entire system can be constructed for about USD 14,000. The elbow joint adopts a closed-link mechanism similar to those used in quadruped robots, which reduces the distal mass and enables higher force and speed output at the end-effector. We demonstrate that MEVION enables data collection for object manipulation tasks not previously possible and supports imitation learning-based motion generation. All hardware and software of this work are included in the Supplementary Materials or https://github.com/haraduka/mevion.

analysis.tldr: 设计并开源了一套低成本双臂机器人数据采集系统MEVION，主打更高力矩（60Nm/臂）和更快速度，用电商零件+钣金焊接实现约1.4万美元整机成本，支持双臂协同操作重物和高速任务的数据收集。
analysis.claim: 通过结构创新（闭链肘关节+钣金主框架）和低成本供应链整合，实现了在1.4万美元预算内构建具备60 Nm单臂扭矩、支持高动态双臂操作的开源数据采集平台。
analysis.input: 人类遥操作演示（未明确说明具体输入模态，但隐含为关节角度/末端位姿+触发信号）
analysis.output: 双臂关节轨迹数据集（用于模仿学习）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的遥操作演示数据
analysis.significance_reason: 工程实现扎实（真机+可复现+开源全栈），显著超越ALOHA的力/速瓶颈，但未提出新算法或模型，也未验证跨任务泛化能力或基础模型训练效果；属于对现有数据采集范式的实质性增强，而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了ALOHA级平台无法处理重载/高速操作的硬性瓶颈，但仍是数据采集基础设施升级，未触及算法层或基础模型层的创新。

papers.title: Learning to Understand Body Language from Flight through Robust 3D Avatar Placing
papers.abstract: Perceiving human motion and intent at long range is a prerequisite for socially intelligent aerial robots, yet the data to learn it barely exists. We introduce Drones2BodyLanguage, a dataset grounding human motion in real UAV footage: avatars manifesting ten communicative intents are placed into unmodified 4K drone scenes with metrically correct position, scale and orientation, maintained over hundreds of frames of camera motion. Enabling it is a lightweight geometric world model of the local scene - semantically selected anchors lifted to 3D through streaming monocular depth - in which a placement point is predicted as an affine anchor combination with provably rigid-invariant weights, and re-rendered under an SVD-fitted ground rotation. Across twelve architectures on scene- and motion-disjoint splits, training on placed data lifts mean intent accuracy by a wide margin for real, retargeted and generated motion alike, with gains confirmed on two in-the-wild scenes.

analysis.tldr: 用无人机拍摄的真实4K视频作为背景，把3D人体模型（带10种沟通意图）精准放置进去，构建了一个新数据集Drones2BodyLanguage，并提出一种轻量几何世界模型来实现鲁棒的3D放置，从而提升远距离人体意图识别性能。
analysis.claim: 在真实无人机视频中鲁棒地放置语义对齐的3D人体模型，可显著提升远距离人体沟通意图识别的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 原始4K无人机视频帧 + 单目深度流 + 人体运动序列（真实/重定向/生成）
analysis.output: 3D空间中带姿态、尺度、朝向的可动画人体模型位置（即avatar placement）及对应沟通意图分类结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖无人机航拍视频和人工放置的avatar
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个面向无人机视角的、带意图标注的3D avatar placement数据集和轻量几何放置方法，实证显示跨场景泛化提升明显，但未涉及真实机器人闭环控制、无真机验证、无消融实验细节、代码未开源，属于扎实的视觉-几何跨模态数据构建工作，但未触及具身智能核心问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从无人机视频到意图感知的数据链路补全，但仍是离线感知任务，未进入决策或控制闭环，缺乏机器人层面的实证支撑。

papers.title: RayViT: Ray-Conditioned Visual Representations for Viewpoint-Robust Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Visual imitation learning enables robots to acquire visuomotor skills directly from images, yet RGB observations lack explicit geometric cues, making learned policies brittle to camera perturbations. To address this, we propose \textbf{Ray-conditioned Vision Transformer Encoder (RayViT)}, a lightweight architecture that injects camera geometry into pretrained ViT backbones. RayViT represents camera geometry as a Plücker ray map, patchifies it into ray features, and uses gated cross-attention to produce a ray-conditioned class token. These ray features are added as dense positional embeddings, while the ray class token replaces the original ViT class token to provide a geometry-aware summary representation. We combine this approach with an auxiliary cosine similarity loss to consistently improve the performance and robustness for geometry-aware tokens. Experiments on sim- and real-robot tasks demonstrate that RayViT improves robustness by approximately 13 percentage points under camera perturbations in multi-task RoboCasa benchmark and by 1.78 average completed stages in real-world multi-task success rate compared to baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RayViT，通过把相机几何信息（用Plücker射线表示）注入ViT的视觉特征中，让模仿学习模型在摄像头位置/朝向变化时更鲁棒，实现在仿真和真实机器人上的多任务成功率提升。
analysis.org: 奥地利林茨约翰开普勒大学（JKU）
analysis.claim: 将显式相机几何（Plücker射线）作为条件注入ViT，可显著提升视觉模仿策略对视角扰动的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 相机内参与外参（用于生成Plücker射线图）
analysis.output: 几何感知的视觉表征（用于下游动作预测策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（RoboCasa）和少量真实机器人数据（multi-task success rate），但未说明是否需真实机器人采集训练数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰（几何注入+ViT改造+辅助损失），在RoboCasa仿真和真实多任务上验证了13pp/1.78 stage提升，有消融和跨任务泛化，但未开源代码、未用大规模真实轨迹、未挑战开放难题（如跨机体/零样本视角迁移），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上有效提升了视角鲁棒性，但缺乏开源与大规模实证，尚未达到基石级模型的广度、深度或影响力。

papers.title: Static In, Dynamic Out: Counterfactual Action Augmentation for Moving Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: Visuomotor policies have advanced on manipulation tasks where the target object stays static during execution, but real deployments break this assumption: parts drift on conveyors and fruits sway in the wind. We introduce Static In, Dynamic Out (SIDO), a counterfactual action augmentation that enables a policy trained only on static object demonstrations to adapt to unseen object motion at test time. Our key idea is to factorize moving object manipulation into two sub-problems: predicting where the object will be, and reaching that predicted pose. SIDO displaces the object to a counterfactual future position and morphs the demonstrated action chunk to preserve the hand-object relative pose, yielding a goal-conditioned policy. At deployment an object pose predictor supplies the future position. Across three simulated tasks (Mug, Square, Stack) under five object motion patterns and two real-world tasks (Gantry, Peachtree), SIDO improves moving object success over the baselines while preserving static object performance. Project website: https://sido-staticindynamicout.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫SIDO的方法，让只在静止物体上训练的视觉运动策略，能在测试时自动适应移动物体——不重训、不真实运动数据，靠把静止演示中的物体位置‘脑补’到未来位置，并相应扭曲动作块来保持手物相对姿态，再配上一个独立的物体位置预测器就能工作。
analysis.claim: 仅用静态物体示范数据训练的策略，可通过反事实动作增强（SIDO）零样本泛化到未知运动模式的移动物体操作任务，且不损害对静止物体的性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+静止物体演示动作序列+实时物体位姿预测（未来时刻）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中用Franka；实机用Gantry机械臂和Peachtree采摘平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实移动物体数据，训练仅用静态演示
analysis.significance_reason: 在移动物体操作这一长期开放难题上给出简洁、可部署的解耦方案：无需真实运动数据、不重训、跨仿真与两种异构真实平台验证、5种运动模式+3个仿真+2个实机任务全面评测、有消融（如ablate pose predictor）、保留静态性能——但未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将运动补偿解耦为独立位姿预测+动作形变，在无运动数据前提下实现多平台sim2real迁移，思路清晰、验证充分，但未引入新模型架构或基础学习范式。

papers.title: OptiSight: Bridging Semantic Reasoning and Geometric Control for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous indoor navigation requires both semantic understanding and precise geometric control. We propose OptiSight, a hybrid framework that combines Vision-Language Model reasoning with deterministic visual servoing through a finite-state Chain-of-Thought architecture. Grounded-SAM localizes open-vocabulary targets, while camera projection geometry converts visual observations into navigation commands without requiring dense mapping. The VLM is queried only at key decision points, reducing computational overhead while geometric control handles continuous navigation. Experiments in AI Habitat demonstrate reliable zero-shot navigation across diverse indoor scenarios, including obstacle avoidance and semantic ambiguity, while operating within an 8~GB VRAM budget. The source code is available at https://github.com/avanalperen/OptiSight-Python-Multimodal-CoT-for-Visual-Reasoning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫OptiSight的混合导航框架，用视觉语言模型（VLM）在关键节点做语义决策（比如‘找红色椅子’），再用纯几何的视觉伺服方法实时生成运动指令，不建稠密地图、不依赖大量真实机器人数据，只在AI Habitat仿真中验证了零样本室内导航能力。
analysis.claim: 通过将轻量级VLM推理与确定性视觉伺服解耦并用Chain-of-Thought状态机协调，可在低显存（8GB VRAM）下实现无需稠密建图、零样本泛化的具身导航。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言目标指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如平移/旋转速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: AI Habitat仿真器中的虚拟机器人（未提具体硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真渲染图像
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程整合：VLM+视觉伺服的解耦设计有启发性，但未突破语义导航长期瓶颈（如跨模态对齐鲁棒性、真实世界几何漂移、长程时序一致性）；仅在单一仿真平台验证，无真机实验、无消融分析、无baseline对比（如未比RT-1/CoRL23/EmbodiedQA等标准方法），更未触及世界模型级的状态持续性或因果建模——离标尺中最低档（94分Genie）差距巨大。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM决策和几何控制做了合理分工，但仍是仿真内窄任务验证，缺乏实证深度和领域穿透力，暂时不用看

papers.title: ConfAL-WM: Confidence-Guided Active Learning for Action-Conditioned World Models
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned world models have become an important foundation for embodied prediction, planning, and synthetic data generation, but their errors under new task and scene distributions are often concentrated in localized spatiotemporal regions such as robot arms, manipulated objects, contact areas, and occluded objects. This paper presents ConfAL-WM, a confidence-guided active learning framework for post-training embodied world models. Built upon EVAC, we attach a lightweight confidence probe to UNet decoder features and predict dense confidence maps in the latent space. These maps are aggregated into task-, frame-, and patch-level scores, enabling both efficient data selection and localized training enhancement. Our pipeline first retrains the confidence probe and warms up EVAC with a small subset of target-domain data, then performs task-level prescreening to allocate sampling budgets, and finally applies selected-data retraining with optional frame or patch weighted data enhancement. Experiments on RoboTwin2.0 show that confidence-guided selection improves post-training efficiency, while dense frame and patch weighting further enhances prediction quality and embodied trajectory consistency compared with scalar reward, progress, and judge-based scoring baselines. A quick visual overview of this work is available at https://ConfAL-WM.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ConfAL-WM，一种在世界模型（world model）后训练阶段用置信度图指导主动学习的方法，通过轻量级探针预测潜在空间中的密集置信度，再按任务/帧/图像块三级加权选择最难样本进行微调，从而提升模型在新任务和新场景下的预测精度与轨迹一致性。
analysis.claim: 对已训练好的动作条件化世界模型，用潜空间稠密置信度引导的主动学习可显著提升其跨任务/跨场景泛化下的预测质量与轨迹一致性，且比标量奖励、进度或判别式打分更有效。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列（来自仿真环境RoboTwin2.0）
analysis.output: 未来帧预测+潜空间置信度图+加权重训练后的优化世界模型
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将稠密潜空间置信度引入世界模型后训练主动学习，并在RoboTwin2.0上验证了帧/块加权优于标量评分；但未脱离仿真、未验证真机部署、未挑战长期开放难题（如状态持久性、跨模态因果建模），也未构建新基准或开源核心代码，分量不及DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（均含真机闭环、状态机制创新或大规模泛化验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——方法设计合理、实验对比充分，但局限在仿真内微调范式，无真机验证、无开源、未触及世界模型核心瓶颈，暂未达到领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models
papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn latent dynamics for planning and avoid representation collapse by matching features to maximum-entropy distributions such as isotropic Gaussians, yielding dense representations. However, it is unclear whether dense representations are the most favorable geometry for modeling dynamics. In this work, we ask whether a different geometry, sparse representations, can make action-conditioned latent dynamics easier to model, and what dynamical structure emerges from such representations. We first show that nonlinear Lipschitz dynamics can be approximated arbitrarily well by action-conditioned linear dynamics in a sufficiently high-dimensional one-hot latent space, with rollout error vanishing as the dimension grows. This motivates distributed sparse representations as a practical relaxation of one-hot sparsity. We introduce LpWorldModel (LpWM), a JEPA model regularized with Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization (RDMReg) to match encoder features to a Rectified Generalized Gaussian distribution, yielding non-negative sparse codes. Empirically, sparsity lowers the predictor complexity required for successful planning: on PushT, sparse LpWM outperforms dense LeWM by up to 57% in planning success at intermediate predictor capacities. This advantage also extends beyond Gaussian distribution matching, with LpWM outperforming dense VICReg representations across multiple predictor families. We further find that the learned sparse representations are mode-factored, with support encoding discrete dynamical regimes and feature magnitudes capturing continuous within-regime state. Together, these results suggest that sparse representations can reduce the predictor complexity required for control while revealing interpretable structure.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫LpWM的世界模型，通过强制隐空间表示稀疏（而非传统JEPA常用的稠密高斯分布），证明稀疏表示能显著降低动作条件下的动态预测器复杂度，并在PushT任务上实证了规划成功率提升，同时发现稀疏编码天然分离了离散动力学模式和连续状态变化。
analysis.claim: 稀疏表征比稠密表征更有利于建模动作条件下的世界动态，能降低预测器复杂度并揭示可解释的动力学结构。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+动作序列
analysis.output: 稀疏隐变量（非负、高维、近似one-hot分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真环境生成的PushT视频数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 理论论证扎实（Lipschitz动力学可被高维稀疏线性动态逼近），实验在标准基准PushT上有明确量化优势（57%规划提升）、跨预测器家族复现、且揭示了mode-factored可解释结构；但未在真实机器人或跨域控制任务验证，未构建新benchmark或开放数据，也未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、状态持久性、多智能体交互），相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等里程碑工作仍属重要但局部改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在表征几何层面给出有理论支撑和实证优势的新设计，但尚未触及世界模型的核心架构瓶颈，也未进入真实系统闭环验证。

papers.title: Ageas enables time-agnostic cell fate inference from single-cell and spatial multi-omics data
papers.abstract: Understanding cell fate decisions is fundamental to developmental biology and disease research. However, experimental lineage tracing requires genetic manipulation, which is impractical in many systems, particularly in humans. Computational approaches often rely on time-resolved measurements, which single-cell and spatial omics studies rarely provide. Here, we present Ageas, a time-agnostic transfer learning framework for cell fate inference from single-cell and spatial multi-omics data. Ageas overcomes these limitations by learning fate memory from terminal cell populations and transferring this information to progenitor or intermediate cells, enabling fate bias inference from static molecular snapshots. To enable robust generalization across molecular modalities, Ageas employs a data-adaptive ensemble strategy with automated model selection. In benchmark datasets with lineage-traced single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic profiles, as well as spatial transcriptomics, Ageas achieves strong performance compared to existing methods. Applying Ageas to a 3D human embryo reveals a spatially organized anterior-posterior gradient of epiblast fate priming, with anterior epiblast cells biased toward ectodermal fates and posterior cells toward primitive streak-derived lineages, accompanied by regionally graded fate-associated regulatory programs. Together, these results establish Ageas as a general framework for decoding cell fate decisions from static molecular snapshots.

analysis.tldr: 提出Ageas模型，无需时间序列数据，仅用静态的单细胞或空间多组学数据（如转录组+表观组）就能推断细胞命运偏向，通过从终末细胞‘学习命运记忆’并迁移到前体细胞实现。
analysis.claim: 细胞命运推断无需时间信息，可从静态多组学快照中通过跨状态迁移‘命运记忆’可靠实现。
analysis.input: 单细胞或多模态空间多组学数据（如scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq、空间转录组）
analysis.output: 细胞层级的命运偏向概率（如向内胚层/中胚层/外胚层分化的倾向性得分）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，依赖公开或新生成的生物多组学数据集（如人胚胎空间转录组）
analysis.significance_reason: 在无时序约束下实现多组学驱动的命运推断，有扎实跨模态验证（scRNA+scATAC+空间转录组）、人胚胎3D组织级发现（前后轴命运梯度），但未开源代码/模型，且未与临床干预或功能实验闭环验证，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计合理、实证充分、生物学发现可信，但缺乏开源和下游功能验证，尚未达到开范式或临床衔接级别。

papers.title: Decoding Decision Correctness from EEG Under High Cognitive Workload in Virtual Reality: Implications for Collaborative Brain-Computer Interface Teams
papers.abstract: Collaborative Brain-Computer Interfaces (cBCIs) offer a promising mechanism to augment team decision-making, but existing approaches rely exclusively on evidence available only after a decision has been made and reported, such as reaction time or stated confidence. This limits their use to explaining or discounting a decision after the fact, rather than informing a team's response before it is finalised. We tested whether spatial-covariance EEG features could instead provide a genuinely pre-emptive signal of an operator's decision correctness, available within the response window itself, and whether such a signal depends on cognitive workload. Using a continuous virtual reality target-detection task, participants (N = 23) completed a within-subject workload manipulation (High vs. Low). At the team level, weighting votes by this pre-emptive neural signal, available before a response is committed, produced substantial accuracy gains on contested (evenly-split) trials under High Workload (57% to 88% as team size increased from 2 to 16), but was actively detrimental under Low Workload. Critically, this advantage held even against post-hoc behavioural signals: confidence was the strongest single team-level signal overall, but by definition cannot inform a decision still in progress, whereas the neural signal can. These findings indicate that EEG-based decision-reliability signals are not a general-purpose team augmentation tool, but a workload-conditional one, with clear implications for when and how cBCI systems should be deployed in operational teams.
