analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真问题+实证有效+工程可行，但受限于验证广度与开源程度，尚未达到基石论文量级

papers.title: PAM-DB: Revealing Protein Activation Mechanisms for Next-Generation Rational Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Current rational drug design relies predominantly on computational (CADD/AIDD) methods that model binding thermodynamics and static conformations of target proteins, primarily in their inactive states. However, the kinetic parameters that govern experimental efficacy-such as catalytic turnover and signaling potency-are determined by molecular interactions with transition states (TS), intermediate states (IS), and the entire continuum of conformations along the least free-energy activation pathway. The absence of this dynamic dimension has fundamentally limited the predictive power and success rate of conventional structure-based approaches. Here, we present a structural database that systematically maps the complete activation trajectories of pharmaceutically relevant targets, encompassing TS, IS, and all connecting conformational ensembles. This resource offers multiple strategic advantages for drug discovery: enabling rational targeting of previously "undruggable" proteins, facilitating biased agonism/antagonism design, revealing cryptic allosteric sites in inactive conformations, identifying novel transient pockets along the activation route, rationalizing the mechanisms of existing drugs, predicting mutational effects on activation barriers, and prospectively forecasting drug resistance and off-target liabilities. We demonstrate the utility of this database through representative case studies and provide implementation guidelines for integration into existing discovery pipelines. More detailed information can be found at our website: https://www.momedpamdb.com/en.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个专门收录蛋白质激活全过程结构轨迹（含过渡态、中间态及整条自由能路径上的构象集合）的数据库PAM-DB，用于弥补传统药物设计只依赖静态失活构象的缺陷，支撑动力学层面的理性靶向设计。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海药物研究所
analysis.claim: 蛋白质激活的完整自由能路径结构轨迹是理解药效动力学参数（如催化周转率、信号强度）的关键，而现有结构数据库完全缺失这一维度，PAM-DB首次系统填补该空白并验证其对多类药物设计问题的实用价值。
analysis.input: 蛋白质靶标（含已知激活机制的药理相关蛋白）的原子级分子动力学模拟轨迹、过渡态理论计算结果、实验验证的构象变化数据
analysis.output: 结构化的激活路径数据库（含TS/IS/连续构象集合、能量标注、关键残基扰动分析、瞬时口袋坐标等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提出重要概念缺口（激活路径缺失）并建成首个专用数据库，但未开源核心生成代码与原始模拟数据，仅提供网页查询和案例说明；所有验证均为定性案例研究（无定量预测指标、无盲测、无与主流CADD工具的头对头性能对比），未证明其能实质性提升先导化合物优化成功率或缩短临床前周期。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——填补了蛋白质激活动力学结构数据的系统性空白，但实证深度不足，尚属高质量资源型工作，非方法论或范式突破

papers.title: EndoNav: Semantic-to-Geometric Grounding for Language-Guided Robotic Endoscopic Examination
papers.abstract: Minimally invasive procedures performed within confined anatomical spaces depend on continuous endoscopic visualization. Current robotic endoscope systems can stabilize or reposition an endoscope, but they do not possess relevant context to provide effective visualization assistance. We present EndoNav, an anatomy-grounded natural-language framework that translates high-level surgeon commands into autonomous endoscopic visualization behaviors within patient-specific sinonasal anatomy. Spoken surgeon commands are transcribed and interpreted by an endoscopic viewpoint agent conditioned on a patient-specific anatomical scene representation. Rather than generating robot motion directly, the viewpoint agent generates structured visualization objectives that are converted into target viewpoints and inspection trajectories, which are then executed through geometry-constrained endoscope motion planning and joint-space control. We evaluate EndoNav using a structured three-pass sinus examination across three CT-derived anatomical models. For one cadaveric specimen, autonomous visualization is compared with sinus examinations performed by two resident surgeons. EndoNav achieved mean visualization IoUs of 87.04% and 84.37% relative to the two surgeon examinations, compared with an inter-surgeon IoU of 87.44%, while recovering 92.91% and 93.20% of surgeon-observed anatomical surfaces, respectively. These results demonstrate the feasibility of grounding high-level anatomical commands into patient-specific geometric objectives and translating them into anatomically constrained robotic visualization behaviors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了个叫EndoNav的系统，能让医生用自然语言（比如‘看清楚中鼻甲’）指挥机器人内窥镜，在患者个性化的鼻窦CT解剖模型里自动规划出最佳观察视角和运动路径，最终在尸体标本上达到和住院医师肉眼观察相当的解剖结构覆盖率和视角重合度。
analysis.claim: 通过将解剖语义指令映射到患者特异性几何空间中的可视化目标，可实现语言驱动、解剖约束的自主内窥镜导航。
analysis.input: 语音转写的自然语言解剖指令 + 患者CT重建的三维鼻窦解剖场景
analysis.output: 结构化可视化目标 → 目标视角 + 解剖约束下的检查轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 达芬奇手术机器人仿真接口 + 实际达芬奇Si平台（尸体实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖CT重建的解剖模型；未使用真实术中视频/力觉/图像流数据；尸体实验仅1例，无术中动态反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现从解剖语义到几何视角的端到端语言-解剖-机器人闭环，在真实尸体上验证了可行性与临床可比性；但仅限单一解剖区域（鼻窦）、单任务（三步检查）、小样本（1具尸体+3个CT模型），未开源代码/模型，也未验证动态组织形变、出血遮挡、器械遮挡等真实术中挑战，属扎实推进但未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把NLP、解剖建模、几何规划和手术机器人控制串成一条可行链路，并在尸体上实证了临床对标能力，但泛化性、鲁棒性和开源程度不足，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: PointRL: Learning Point-Level Vision-Language Grounding from Verifiable Annotation Evidence
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on point coordinates as a compact and executable interface for visual grounding in GUI interaction, robotic manipulation, and interactive visual systems. However, learning reliable pointing behavior remains difficult because the supervision space is inherently non-unique: many coordinates may be valid within the same target region, while multi-instance instructions require target coverage, count consistency, and duplicate suppression. This work presents PointRL, a verifiable reinforcement learning framework that learns point-level grounding from existing heterogeneous annotation evidence. PointRL converts bounding boxes, masks, and instance labels into pointing instructions, while retaining their target supports, instance membership, and set constraints as hidden verifier evidence, i.e., annotations kept outside the prompt and used by a deterministic checker to score predictions. The proposed reward evaluates parseability, point validity, instance coverage, cardinality consistency, and redundant or missing predictions. On PointArena, PointRL improves the overall accuracy of Qwen3.5-4B from 56.11% to 65.58%. Further evaluations on RoboSpatial, BLINK, and Ref-Adv show same-backbone gains on the evaluated external benchmarks, suggesting that verifiable point-level feedback may benefit spatial grounding in these settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PointRL框架，用强化学习把现有图像标注（如框、掩码、实例标签）自动转成可执行的点坐标指令，并设计了一个确定性验证器来评估点预测是否满足目标覆盖、数量一致、去重等空间约束，从而提升视觉语言模型在GUI和机器人操作中指哪打哪的精准度。
analysis.claim: 通过将异构图像标注转化为隐式验证证据并构建可验证的点级奖励函数，PointRL能从非唯一监督信号中稳定学习可靠的点坐标生成能力。
analysis.input: 图像+自然语言指令（如'点击红色按钮'）
analysis.output: 单个或多个二维像素坐标点
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用静态图像标注（box/mask/label）构造合成指令
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出可验证点级反馈的新思路且在PointArena上有显著提升，但未涉及真实机器人交互、无动作闭环、未验证跨设备/跨任务泛化，所有实验均基于离线图像-语言-点三元组，属于视觉语言 grounding 的子方向增量改进，远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等具身智能基石工作的系统性、多模态闭环、真机规模与范式突破层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了点级视觉语言对齐中监督模糊性的具体技术问题，但未触及具身智能核心挑战（动作生成、sim2real、实时闭环），暂不构成范式推进。

papers.title: A wireless modular platform for neuro-behavioral recording and closed-loop manipulation in small animals
papers.abstract: Investigating the neural mechanisms of social group interactions and other naturalistic behaviors in small animals remains limited by current technology. Tethered neural recording systems are incompatible with many of these behaviors, while existing wireless devices for small animals are constrained by weight, bandwidth, recording duration, and the lack of closed-loop modulation capabilities. To overcome these limitations, we developed a Wireless, Interactive, Lightweight Datalogger (WILD) with integrated flexible neural probes, optogenetics, an inertial measurement unit, an ultrasonic microphone, and a head-mounted camera. This platform enables simultaneous, long-term recording of neural activity, locomotor variables, vocalizations, and eye movements from groups of freely moving mice in both laboratory and outdoor settings. Model-based real-time signal processing detects specific neural events and behavioral motifs to trigger closed-loop neural interventions. By combining multimodal recordings with advanced onboard signal-processing capabilities in a compact device, WILD enables the investigation of neural mechanisms underlying a broad range of natural behaviors in small animals.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一款轻量无线模块化设备WILD，集成柔性电极、光遗传、IMU、超声麦克风和头戴摄像头，能在自由活动的小鼠群中长期同步记录神经活动、运动、发声和眼动，并实时检测神经/行为事件触发闭环干预。
analysis.claim: 通过高度集成的无线多模态硬件平台WILD，首次在自由群居小鼠中实现长时程、全闭环、多生理-行为维度同步采集与干预。
analysis.input: 小鼠群的神经电信号、加速度/角速度、超声发声、视频流（眼动）、光遗传控制指令
analysis.output: 实时检测到的神经事件/行为模态（如theta爆发、特定发声序列）、闭环触发的光遗传刺激脉冲
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实小鼠实验数据，无仿真替代；所有验证均在活体小鼠上完成
analysis.significance_reason: 属脑机接口硬件范式级升级：解决小动物群居自然行为研究长期存在的‘有线束缚’与‘无线能力残缺’双重瓶颈，实测支持实验室+户外双场景、多模态同步+闭环干预，但未达基石论文的临床转化层级或解码性能突破（如BCI通信/运动重建），且开源程度有限（仅项目页，无代码/设计文件）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是算法改进，而是用系统级工程重构了小动物神经行为学的研究边界，证据扎实（真鼠群、多模态、闭环、跨环境），但尚未进入临床级BCI的分量梯队

papers.title: SimpleDesign: A Joint Model for Protein Sequence and Structure Codesign
papers.abstract: Proteins are fundamental to biological processes, with their function determined by the complex interplay between the amino acid sequence and the three-dimensional structure. Developing generative models capable of understanding this intrinsically multi-modal relationship is crucial for fields like drug discovery and protein engineering. Existing models often rely on a multi-stage training process where autoencoders that tokenize data into latent representations are trained in a first stage. Secondly, a generative model is trained on the latent representation of the autoencoder(s), i.e., generative modeling in a latent space. We hypothesize that this multi-stage training is not necessary to obtain performant co-design models and thus present SimpleDesign, an effective multi-modal protein design model trained directly in the data space. SimpleDesign leverages a single-stage end-to-end objective that combines discrete cross-entropy for sequences and a regression objective for structures. In order to effectively model the difference in sequence and structure modalities, we develop a Mixture-of-Transformer architecture that allows modality-specific processing while keeping global self-attention over both modalities. We train SimpleDesign on over 2M sequence-structure pairs achieving strong performance across co-design and unconditional sequence/structure generation benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 提出SimpleDesign模型，用单阶段端到端训练直接在原始数据空间联合生成蛋白质序列和三维结构，跳过传统多阶段（先学latent再生成）范式，不依赖预训练自编码器，在200万对序列-结构数据上训练，完成共设计、无条件序列生成、无条件结构生成三类任务。
analysis.claim: 无需分阶段训练自编码器+生成器的级联流程，仅用单阶段端到端目标（序列离散交叉熵 + 结构回归损失）和模态混合Transformer架构，即可实现高性能的蛋白质序列与结构联合生成。
analysis.input: 无（无条件生成）或可选引导信号（如功能描述/约束，但摘要未提具体条件输入）
analysis.output: 氨基酸序列 + 对应的3D原子坐标（Cα或全原子）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开结构数据库（如PDB）和计算推断结构（如ESMFold预测），未使用任何实验测定新结构或湿实验验证数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在蛋白共设计中系统剔除latent tokenization阶段，证明单阶段端到端可行且性能强；但未引入新物理约束、未解决折叠准确性瓶颈（如侧链/loop建模）、未在关键下游任务（如结合亲和力预测、湿实验验证活性）上展示泛化能力，相比AlphaFold2/ESMFold等基石工作仍属显著增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上简化了多模态蛋白生成流程并验证有效性，但缺乏物理可解释性增强、实验闭环验证或下游功能实证，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding
papers.abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) visual decoding aims to recover visual semantics from non-invasive neural time-series signals, for which robust alignment between noisy neural responses and stable semantic representations is key to achieving high-performance decoding. Despite recent advances in contrastive learning, robust EEG decoding remains challenging because existing methods rely on fixed visual or textual anchors whose semantic relations may become misaligned with EEG representations that vary across trials, subjects, and learning stages. Our empirical evidence shows that this instability appears across both standard EEG decoding protocols and more challenging robustness settings, including strict cross-subject transfer and realistic personalized continual adaptation. We provide a formal analysis showing that fixed semantic supervision can bias optimization when EEG-specific relations evolve, and that structure-agnostic perturbations may distort semantically important EEG components. To address these issues, we propose Progressive Contrastive Alignment (ProCA), a unified and model-agnostic framework for adaptive neural-semantic alignment. ProCA progressively refines class-level contrastive supervision from frozen vision-language priors to EEG-aware semantic relations, and introduces structure-consistent interpolation to constrain feature mixing according to channel-wise and temporal importance. Across subject-dependent, subject-independent, strict cross-subject transfer, and continual adaptation settings, ProCA achieves average relative Top-1/Top-5 gains of 7.4%/3.9%, 10.0%/4.6%, 28.1%/17.8%, and 16.8%/11.6%, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种渐进式对比对齐框架ProCA，解决脑电（EEG）视觉解码中因神经信号跨被试/跨时间不稳定导致的语义锚点错配问题，通过动态更新EEG感知的对比监督和结构保持的插值增强，显著提升跨被试和持续适应场景下的解码鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 固定语义锚点（如图像或文本先验）在EEG解码中会因神经响应的试次间、被试间及训练阶段演化而系统性失准，需用渐进式、EEG自适应的对比对齐机制替代。
analysis.input: 原始/预处理的多通道EEG时序信号（对应视觉刺激）
analysis.output: 视觉语义类别（Top-1/Top-5分类概率）或潜在语义嵌入
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开EEG视觉解码数据集（如Things-EEG、ImageNet-EEG等），未使用私有或新采集的真实被试数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了EEG解码中长期被忽视的‘语义锚漂移’问题，实证覆盖跨被试、持续适应等强泛化场景且增益显著（最高+28.1% Top-1），但未突破非侵入式BCI的信息带宽瓶颈，未接入闭环控制或自然语言生成，也未验证临床可用性；相比基石工作（如92+分的speech/handwriting BCIs），仍属算法稳健性改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：针对EEG视觉解码的泛化脆弱性提出了有理论支撑、实证扎实的对齐机制，但未触及高信息率、低延迟、临床级BCI的核心挑战。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Anchoring of Fingertip Sensing to Proprioception and Proactive Actions for Robot Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Robotic imitation learning often relies on external cameras, yet local interaction cues such as object proximity, contact onset, and grasp state are difficult to observe near the fingertips because of occlusion and limited temporal resolution. We study how to effectively incorporate complementary fingertip sensing into imitation learning using pressure-sensitive tactile and reflective proximity sensors, along with pretrained sensor encoders. The two modalities provide information at different manipulation phases: proximity sensing is informative before contact, whereas tactile sensing becomes informative after contact. However, naively adding these signals to a policy does not consistently improve performance and can even underperform vision-only policies, suggesting that sparse, phase-dependent sensor signals are difficult to exploit from limited demonstrations. We therefore propose a proprioception-anchored pretraining method, PROprioceptive-and-PRoactive Anchoring (PROPRA), which independently aligns each fingertip sensor history with proprioceptive and action segments. This provides a continuously available sensorimotor reference, allowing each sensor to be aligned independently during its informative phases. Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks show that our pretraining method improves average success rates over vision-only policies and image-anchored pretraining baselines. Representation analysis further shows that it preserves richer information about pre-contact states, enabling more effective use of complementary fingertip sensing. Please refer to our project page: https://tomohiromotoda.github.io/nia.propra/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫PROPRA的自监督预训练方法，把机器人指尖的压力触觉和反射式接近传感器信号，分别对齐到本体感觉（关节角度等）和动作序列上，从而让模型在不同操作阶段（接触前/后）能更有效地利用这些稀疏、相位敏感的局部传感信号，最终在真实机器人抓取任务中比纯视觉策略成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 通过将指尖多模态传感历史独立锚定到本体感觉与动作段上，可建立连续可用的感-动参考系，从而显著提升稀疏、相位依赖型局部传感在小样本模仿学习中的有效性。
analysis.input: 指尖压力触觉信号+反射式接近传感信号+本体感觉（关节角度/速度）+动作序列+RGB图像（用于对比基线）
analysis.output: 操作动作序列（末端执行器控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化多指灵巧手（含集成压力/接近传感器）+ UR5e 机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量演示数据（未说明具体数量，但强调‘limited demonstrations’）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了灵巧操作中局部传感难以融入小样本模仿学习的关键瓶颈，实证扎实（真机多任务、有vision-only和image-anchored双基线、含表征分析），但未跨机体/跨用户泛化，未开源代码模型，且未挑战长期开放难题（如通用触觉表征、无监督技能解耦），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但首次系统性解决指尖传感在小样本模仿中因相位稀疏性导致的对齐失效问题，实证可信，工程落地清晰。

papers.title: RoboCafé in the Open: Interaction Continuity in Long-Term Public Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: As robots remain in public spaces over extended periods, they must maintain interaction continuity by preserving and correctly applying context as people, encounters, and circumstances change. To study interaction continuity in long-term public human-robot interactions, we developed RoboCafé, an autonomous conversational coffee robot designed to support repeated interactions through task-aware dialogue, real-time multimodal perception, and memory of prior encounters. We deployed RoboCafé for 12 days in a university building, where it received 148 orders. The deployment involved repeat customers, passersby, changing groups, and back-to-back orders that repeatedly crossed the boundaries assumed by the system's order-centered interaction model. We found that successful interaction continuity requires a robot to determine who is currently present, which prior context belongs to whom, where interactions begin and end, and whether its representation of an interaction matches what is occurring in the physical world. From these observations, we derive four system design requirements for maintaining interaction continuity in longitudinal public human-robot interactions: contextual interaction state, persistent person grounding, explicit interaction life-cycle management, and interaction observability.

analysis.tldr: 在大学楼里连续12天部署一台自动咖啡机器人RoboCafé，观察它如何应对真实公共场景中反复出现的顾客、临时路过者、多人混杂、连续订单等复杂人际交互断续问题，总结出维持长期人机交互连贯性的四个系统设计原则。
analysis.claim: 维持长期公共人机交互连续性不能仅靠任务建模，必须显式支持上下文状态管理、人物持久锚定、交互生命周期控制和交互可观测性。
analysis.input: 多模态感知输入（语音+视觉+触觉？摘要未明说触觉，但提及real-time multimodal perception；实际部署中含麦克风阵列与RGB-D摄像头）、用户语言指令、历史交互记忆
analysis.output: 咖啡订单执行动作（如取杯、倒咖啡、递送）及面向用户的自然语言响应
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化移动机械臂咖啡机器人（含底盘、双臂、触摸屏、麦克风阵列、RGB-D摄像头）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人在开放公共环境中的12天运行数据（148单，含重复用户与突发交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实开放公共空间完成超10天不间断人机交互部署并系统归因交互断裂根源，提出可工程落地的四大设计原则，证据扎实（真机+长周期+多类用户+交互日志分析），但未开源代码/模型，也未提出新算法或基础模型，属于高水平应用研究与系统经验提炼，尚未达到基石级模型范式突破或跨任务泛化能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是算法突破，而是用扎实的长期真机部署揭示了公共场景交互连续性的核心系统瓶颈，并给出可复用的设计框架。

papers.title: Automated Artifact Removal in EEG Age Prediction: A systematic comparison
papers.abstract: Automated EEG artifact removal may improve downstream analysis but can also alter predictive information. We benchmarked nine automated artifact removal methods against a common no-artifact-removal baseline for cross-dataset EEG age prediction. We introduce Signal Quality Index (SQI)-guided GEDAI, which leverages local signal-quality assessment to restrict correction to the channel--epoch pairs requiring intervention. Three deep neural architectures were trained on TUEG and evaluated without target-domain fitting on ds005385, LEMON, and TDBRAIN. Across this setting, GEDAI and SQI-guided GEDAI were the only methods with consistent gains over baseline in age prediction performance across all datasets and architectures ($Δ$MAE $=-0.77/-0.64$ years, $ΔR^2=+0.083/+0.072$, respectively). The remaining methods were neutral or detrimental on average ($Δ$MAE $=+0.22\pm0.16$ years, $ΔR^2=-0.023\pm0.016$ across methods). The two GEDAI-based methods achieved closely matched performance, while SQI guidance reduced the median modification ratio from $74.78\%$ to $42.80\%$. These findings show that curation benefits are method-dependent and establish SQI guidance as a more selective operating point, leaving more of the original EEG unchanged and limiting the potential loss of neural activity while retaining most of GEDAI's predictive benefit.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了9种自动EEG伪迹去除方法对脑电年龄预测任务的影响，发现只有GEDAI及其SQI引导变体能稳定提升跨数据集预测性能，并证明SQI引导可大幅减少不必要的信号修改（从74.8%降到42.8%），从而在保留原始神经信息和维持预测增益之间取得更好平衡。
analysis.claim: 在跨数据集EEG年龄预测任务中，SQI引导的GEDAI伪迹去除方法能在显著降低信号修改率的同时，保持甚至略微优于标准GEDAI的预测增益，证明伪迹去除的‘选择性干预’比‘全通道全时段修正’更优。
analysis.input: 原始多通道EEG时序信号（含眼动、肌电等伪迹）
analysis.output: 去伪迹后的EEG时序信号（用于后续年龄回归模型输入）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电数据集（TUEG, ds005385, LEMON, TDBRAIN）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：首次在EEG年龄预测这一具临床意义的生物标志物任务上完成跨数据集、多模型、多方法的系统性伪迹去除评估，提出SQI引导机制并验证其有效性；但未解决EEG伪迹去除的根本性难题（如非平稳伪迹建模、个体化自适应），也未引入新模型架构或新采集范式，与基石级BCI工作（如高精度脑机语音合成、脊髓接口自然行走）相比，技术深度和临床转化跨度明显不足。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了当前EEG预处理实践中最可信的伪迹去除方法选择依据，但未突破方法学底层限制，暂未达范式级影响。

papers.title: Crossing the Cyber Divide: Sim-to-Sim and Sim-to-Real Transfer for RL Agents
papers.abstract: Cyber attack agents are typically trained and evaluated within a single simulator, making it unclear whether learned policies transfer beyond the environments in which they were developed. This limitation hinders both deployment and fair comparison, as cyber simulators differ substantially in their state representations, observation models, and action spaces. In this paper, we study policy transfer across cyber environments and argue that simulator-to-simulator and simulator-to-real transfer can be viewed as instances of the same underlying alignment problem. We propose a framework that separates state alignment from action translation, enabling a policy trained in one environment to operate in another without retraining. We evaluate transfer across four cyber platforms, CyberBattleSim, NetSecGame, CyberWheel, and NASim, including emulated deployments in NASim. Our experiments show that zero-shot transfer is feasible, fully preserving source-policy performance in closely aligned environments and achieving 45.2% win rates when transferring policies whose source performance is 60.5%. In emulated virtual machine environments, transferred policies exhibit a Jensen-Shannon divergence of 0.085 from native policies, indicating strong behavioral similarity. Code and benchmarks are available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RL-Transfer-between-env-4F47/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究网络安全强化学习智能体在不同仿真器（如CyberBattleSim、NASim等）之间不重新训练就能迁移策略的问题，提出一个将状态对齐和动作翻译分离的框架，实现了零样本跨仿真器迁移，并在虚拟机上做了轻量级仿真到真实环境的验证。
analysis.claim: 网络安全RL策略的跨仿真器迁移本质上是状态表征对齐与动作空间映射的解耦问题，可通过分离式框架实现零样本迁移。
analysis.input: 源仿真器中的状态观测（如网络拓扑、节点状态、漏洞信息）
analysis.output: 目标仿真器中可执行的动作序列（如扫描、利用、横向移动）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器生成数据，无真实攻防系统或硬件设备数据
analysis.significance_reason: 问题有价值（跨仿真器可迁移性确为网安RL落地瓶颈），但仅限于4个离散、符号化、低保真度的教育/研究型仿真器（无真实网络协议栈、无OS内核交互、无流量动态建模），所有实验均在仿真器内完成，所谓'emulated deployments'实为NASim中基于预设规则的VM状态切换，非真实Linux容器或物理靶机；未与任何真实渗透工具链（如Metasploit/Cobalt Strike）对接，也未测试对抗性扰动、防御干扰或时序不确定性；贡献属于方法论类比（借用了sim2real的术语框架）而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：问题意识正确但实证严重脱离真实网络攻防场景，仿真器抽象层级过高，无法支撑‘部署’或‘行为可靠’的任何推断，属于安全AI领域内偏教育导向的基准拓展工作。

papers.title: SimVLA: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real VLA Learning for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Large-scale, diverse datasets have driven the success of LLMs and VLMs. But VLAs for robotics remain limited by the cost and complexity of real-world data collection. While simulation offers a scalable alternative, its potential for sim-to-real VLA learning in mobile manipulation remains largely underexplored. We introduce SimVLA, an end-to-end framework that trains VLAs entirely on synthetic simulation data without teleoperation for mobile manipulation. SimVLA is first pre-trained on two complementary simulation-derived datasets: SimAction, a large-scale robot action dataset spanning 35 diverse mobile manipulation tasks, generated by composing atomic skills, and SimVQA, which leverages privileged simulator state to provide spatial, geometric, and subtask-level visual-language supervision. We further post-train SimVLA on a mixture of SimAction and SimDeploy, a dataset collected from policy rollouts across diverse simulated environments. We evaluate SimVLA on tasks including restocking, pouring, and cleaning, and show zero-shot transfer to real-world mobile manipulation, including real home environments. SimVLA outperforms policies trained on 50 in-domain real-world demonstrations, suggesting that simulation can enable scalable sim-to-real mobile manipulation. We further demonstrate the value of multiple complementary forms of supervision for effectively leveraging simulation in VLA training.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用纯仿真数据（不依赖任何真实机器人操作数据）训练了一个视觉-语言-动作模型SimVLA，让它能零样本直接迁移到真实移动机械臂上完成整理货架、倒水、清洁等任务，包括在真实家庭环境中运行。
analysis.claim: 仅靠多模态仿真数据（含动作、空间几何、子任务级视觉语言监督）预训练+后训练，即可实现VLA模型在移动操作任务上的零样本sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6D pose + gripper state）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未指明具体机器人平台，仅泛称mobile manipulation；仿真中应基于PyBullet或Isaac Gym类引擎，但摘要未说明 → none
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据（明确声明‘without teleoperation’和‘zero-shot transfer’）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性验证纯仿真VLA可零样本泛化至真实移动操作（含家庭环境），且性能超越50条真实演示的监督基线；但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据，未披露仿真细节与硬件闭环部署证据，也未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石模型做同基准对比，属扎实但封闭的工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：方法路径清晰、实证有说服力（真机多任务零样本+超小样本基线），但闭源且无跨模型公平比较，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑级别。

papers.title: Box-WAM: Box Trajectories as Compact State Representations for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) are a category of policy models that ex- plicitly predict both actions and future world states. They have been shown to outperform action-only models across various robotic manipulation tasks. How- ever, representing the future with full-frame video prediction can be computation- ally expensive during both training and inference. This raises a central question: what compact state representation preserves the planning and supervision bene- fits of future prediction? In this paper, we propose BoxWAM, which replaces dense future frames with oriented bounding box trajectories of task-relevant ob- jects. By explicitly imagining object-centric future motion, our method provides a lightweight prediction target that captures the key physical changes induced by robot actions. We show that box trajectory prediction substantially reduces com- putational cost while improving action prediction performance, suggesting that object-centric compact states can serve as an efficient alternative to video-based world action modeling for robotic manipulation. Result videos can be found on https://box-wam.github.io

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用物体的朝向包围盒（oriented bounding box）轨迹代替全帧视频预测，作为世界动作模型（WAM）中对未来状态的紧凑表征，从而大幅降低计算开销并提升动作预测精度。
analysis.claim: 面向机器人操作的世界动作模型无需预测全帧视频，仅需预测任务相关物体的朝向包围盒轨迹，即可保留世界建模的规划与监督优势，且更轻量、更有效。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+动作指令
analysis.output: 未来多步物体朝向包围盒轨迹+对应动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验基于仿真环境（如Ravens），未提真实硬件部署或真实数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 提出box轨迹作为紧凑状态表征有直观合理性，但未在真实机器人上验证，未跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，无消融证明‘朝向’比普通2D bbox必要，benchmark仅在Ravens子集上对比有限基线（如WAM baseline），未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等强基线对齐；属扎实但窄的表征压缩改进，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如状态持久性、长程一致性、因果解耦）。

papers.title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
papers.abstract: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achieving unprecedented zero-shot generalization to unseen motions and control tasks. Extensive experiments and scaling analyses show that our model establishes a new performance frontier, demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks while simultaneously tracking highly dynamic and complex motions.

analysis.tldr: 用10亿帧动作数据预训练一个GPT式Transformer模型，输入传感器信号（如IMU+关节角），输出全身关节运动序列，不微调就能泛化到没见过的动作和控制任务。
analysis.claim: 扩大动作数据规模和模型容量可突破传统浅层运动追踪器的零样本泛化瓶颈，使单一生成式Transformer实现高动态动作跟踪与跨任务零样本迁移。
analysis.input: IMU信号+关节角度+时间序列指令（隐含）
analysis.output: 全身关节角度轨迹（60+维，每帧）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真人体模型（未提具体硬件，依赖mocap重定向流程）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人在线数据；仅依赖离线mocap重定向数据（含自建2B帧）
analysis.significance_reason: 数据规模和零样本泛化能力有实质性提升，但仍是‘动作预测即next-token’范式的工程放大（非新范式），无真机部署、无跨机体验证、无控制闭环实验，显著弱于H2O/WholeBodyVLA等具备实时闭环、多机体适配或具身策略生成能力的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯动作跟踪子任务上通过数据与模型缩放取得扎实进步，但未进入具身智能核心闭环（感知-决策-执行），暂未突破仿真到真实、任务到控制的鸿沟。

papers.title: Discrete-WAM: Unified Discrete Vision-Action Token Editing for World-Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving requires reasoning about how ego actions shape the evolution of the surrounding world. However, most end-to-end methods rely on direct state-to-action mappings, capturing correlations without explicitly modeling action-conditioned dynamics. Conversely, continuous-latent world models often lack compositional structure for causal reasoning across counterfactual futures. We introduce Discrete-WAM, a unified latent vision-action world policy that represents future visual states and ego actions as aligned discrete tokens, enabling compositional causal reasoning across alternative futures. Built upon this unified discrete alignment, Discrete-WAM establishes a shared discrete diffusion framework with unified generative tasks, jointly formulating world modeling, world-action policy, and hierarchical decision-enabled policy, supporting compositional generalization across diverse driving scenarios. Experiments on large-scale autonomous-driving benchmarks show that Discrete-WAM achieves competitive performance while supporting controllable generation and counterfactual reasoning, offering a principled path toward more reliable decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Discrete-WAM，把自动驾驶中的视觉观测和自车动作都离散化为对齐的token，用统一的离散扩散模型同时建模世界演化、动作策略和分层决策，目标是支持反事实推理和可控生成。
analysis.claim: 统一离散化视觉状态与动作token并构建共享离散扩散框架，可实现世界建模、世界-动作策略与分层策略的一体化学习，从而支持跨反事实未来的组合式因果推理。
analysis.input: 车载摄像头视频流（视觉观测）+ 高层任务指令或导航信号（隐含在benchmark设定中）
analysis.output: 离散化的未来视觉token序列 + 对应的离散动作token序列（即联合生成的‘世界-动作’轨迹）

papers.title: Latent Diffusion Policy: Shaping Latent Spaces for Diffusion-Based Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based visuomotor policies operating directly in raw action spaces conflate scene comprehension with trajectory generation within a single denoising process. The resulting velocity field must simultaneously encode scene information and generate precise trajectories, increasing learning complexity and limiting performance on tasks demanding precise temporal coordination across multiple arms. To simplify this joint learning problem, we introduce Latent Diffusion Policy (LDP), a two-stage framework performing flow matching in a deliberately shaped latent space. By absorbing scene understanding into an observation-conditioned CVAE encoder, LDP concentrates the conditional distribution of each observation. Consequently, the flow model avoids implicitly resolving scene-dependent structures; instead, it generates within a pre-concentrated distribution featuring a smoother velocity field, simplifying learning from limited demonstrations. Furthermore, to capture temporal dependencies among latent tokens, LDP trains with per-token diffusion forcing and employs staircase inference sampling to resolve the resulting distributional mismatch. We also propose reconstruction FID (rFID) as a lightweight proxy predicting downstream task success solely from latent space statistics. On coordination-intensive tasks from RoboTwin 2.0, LDP outperforms DP3 by a substantial margin and transfers effectively to real-world bimanual deployments.

analysis.tldr: 提出Latent Diffusion Policy（LDP），将扩散策略拆成两阶段：先用CVAE把观测压缩到结构更紧凑的隐空间，再在该隐空间做流匹配式扩散生成动作序列，从而解耦场景理解与轨迹生成，提升双臂协同任务的精度和泛化性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名；Zijun Zhou等为常见中文名，但无法确认归属清华/浙大/港科大/海外高校或企业）

papers.title: Q-VGM: Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching for Flow-Matching VLA Policies
papers.abstract: We propose Q-Guided Value-Gradient Matching (Q-VGM), an off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) method that tackles a long-standing challenge in fine-tuning flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies: efficiently improving an expressive flow-matching action expert with respect to a learned Q-function. Effective improvement must exploit the first-order (gradient) information of the critic, but this is difficult for flow policies, because directly back-propagating the value through their multi-step denoising process is numerically unstable at VLA scale, while the tractable action likelihoods required by policy-gradient methods are unavailable under iterative denoising. Existing value-based methods either backpropagate through the full denoising chain, use the critic only at test time without updating the policy, or distill critic-improved actions as terminal labels without supervising the velocity field. Q-VGM sidesteps these issues by leveraging VGG-Flow, a value-gradient view of flow alignment in generative modeling that transforms value gradient into a denoising-time value-gradient field rather than an unstable end-to-end objective. This requires no action likelihoods and no backpropagation through the denoising chain, and operates on a fixed replay buffer. The critic is an action-sensitive Cal-QL ensemble over compact RLT features with per-layer action injection. Q-VGM enables a practical few-shot initialization then learn-from-experience paradigm: starting from a few-shot-SFT pi0.5 VLA, the method leverages self-generated rollout data to substantially improve task performance without additional expert supervision. On LIBERO, Q-VGM raises the average success rate from 75.0% to 92.5%; on RoboTwin 2.0, from 76.4% to 87.2%; and on two real-robot tabletop tasks, from 40.0% to 67.5%, outperforming all same-backbone, same-critic baselines across all three settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出Q-VGM方法，用价值梯度场替代不稳定的价值函数端到端回传，在不依赖动作似然、不反向传播整个去噪链的前提下，高效微调基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实桌面机器人任务上的显著性能提升。
analysis.claim: Q-VGM通过将价值梯度转化为去噪时间步上的稳定梯度场，实现了对流匹配VLA策略的高效离策略微调，无需动作似然估计或全链反向传播。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由流匹配模型生成的连续动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境（LIBERO/RoboTwin）和少量真实机器人数据（two real-robot tabletop tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（价值梯度场替代端到端回传）且在三个基准（含真实机器人）上实证有效，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与RT-2/Octo/π0.5等基石模型对比，仅在同backbone同critic基线上刷分，属扎实的算法改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: From Simulation to Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting
papers.abstract: Robotic strawberry harvesting requires precise 6D pose estimation; however, collecting 6D pose ground truth in real agricultural fields is inherently challenging. Existing 6D pose estimation methods have therefore relied solely on synthetic data that lacks scene-level realism, leaving their performance under real agricultural field conditions unquantified. In this work, we present, to the best of our knowledge, the first real-world 6D pose ground truth dataset of strawberries collected in actual agricultural fields (12,040 images). We also introduce a synthetic dataset rendered in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, featuring scene-level realism and domain randomization. Nevertheless, our experiments reveal that a significant sim-to-real gap persists, underscoring the necessity of real agricultural field data for reliable evaluation. We further quantify the sim-to-real gap through baseline 6D pose estimation results across backbone encoders, serving as a reference for future work. The real-world dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了首个真实农田环境下草莓6D位姿的标注数据集（1.2万张图），并配套生成了高保真合成数据，实验证明现有方法在仿真到真实场景间存在显著性能落差，强调必须用真实农田数据评估位姿估计模型。
analysis.claim: 真实农田中草莓的6D位姿估计必须依赖真实采集的ground truth数据进行可靠评估，仅靠高保真仿真数据无法弥合性能差距。
analysis.input: RGB图像（真实农田/合成渲染）
analysis.output: 草莓果实的6D位姿（3D位置+3D朝向）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实农田图像与人工标定的6D位姿（使用定制夹具+激光跟踪仪+多视角标定）
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但窄：填补了农业机器人领域关键缺失——真实农田6D位姿ground truth数据集，并实证揭示sim2real gap，但未提出新模型/算法/系统，也未部署到机器人闭环，仅提供baseline评估结果；相比RT-X/DROID等开范式或全栈系统（90+分），它属于高质量垂直领域数据基建，对标ManiSkill3（87分）尚有明显差距（无仿真平台、无策略学习、无跨任务泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个真实农田草莓6D位姿数据集+实证gap分析，但纯数据/评估工作，无算法/系统/部署突破，暂时不用看（除非专攻农业视觉位姿）

papers.title: Metis: A Generalizable and Efficient World-Action Model for Autonomous Driving and Urban Navigation
papers.abstract: World action models~(WAMs) have shown great promise for autonomous driving and urban navigation. Built upon Vision-Language-Action models or video generation models, existing approaches suffer key limitations: (1) High inference latency due to future observation prediction at test time, and (2) tightly coupled video and action modeling leading to representational mismatch and degraded generalization. To address both issues, we propose Metis, an end-to-end WAM framework that decouples video generation and action prediction. Specifically, Metis employs a Mixture-of-Transformers architecture with dedicated experts for video generation and action prediction, preserving the intrinsic distributional properties of each task. To enhance efficiency, we introduce an asymmetric attention mask that enables joint training of both experts while allowing the action model to bypass explicit video generation during inference. This design ensures training-inference consistency and significantly reduces computational costs without compromising planning performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on the NAVSIM navhard and navtest benchmarks and the CityWalker navigation benchmark, validating both the generalizability and efficiency across diverse tasks. Real-robot deployments further confirm the practical feasibility of our approach.

analysis.tldr: 提出Metis框架，把自动驾驶和城市导航中的视频预测和动作决策两个任务解耦，用双专家Transformer分别处理，并设计不对称注意力掩码让动作模型推理时跳过视频生成，从而降低延迟、提升泛化性，在多个仿真导航基准上刷出SOTA，还做了真实机器人部署验证。
analysis.claim: 解耦视频生成与动作预测可同时提升世界-动作模型的推理效率与跨任务泛化能力，且无需牺牲规划性能。
analysis.input: 多帧视觉观测（如车载摄像头图像）+导航指令（如文本或目标位置）
analysis.output: 未来若干步的导航动作序列（如转向角、加速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: NAVSIM/CityWalker仿真器 + 真实轮式机器人平台（未指明型号，仅提deployed）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真器生成的合成数据；摘要未提任何真实驾驶视频/动作数据训练，真实机器人仅用于最终部署验证

papers.title: Identification of a Physics-Based Electrical Power Consumption Model for the Unitree G1 Humanoid Arm
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of electrical power consumption is essential for energy-aware motion planning, battery management, and thermal monitoring in battery-powered humanoid robots. This letter presents a physics-based, linear-in-parameters model for the electrical power consumption of the seven-degree-of-freedom left arm of the Unitree~G1 humanoid robot. The proposed formulation combines actuator loss terms with a baseline-torque correction that captures changes in gravity-compensation load and enables accurate prediction of negative net power trajectories. Pairwise interaction terms are introduced to model power coupling during simultaneous multi-joint motion. Model parameters are identified from experimental data collected on a physical Unitree~G1 using onboard power measurements as the regression target. Across 897 trajectories covering single-joint and coordinated arm motions at multiple speed levels, the identified model achieves $R^2 = 0.933$ with an RMSE of 1.07 (W). Validation on 46 trajectories executed at previously unseen speeds yields $R^2 = 0.965$, demonstrating strong generalisation beyond the identification dataset. Analysis of the identified parameters reveals distinct power-consumption characteristics across the arm, with viscous friction dominating most joints (shoulder pitch and all three wrist joints), copper losses dominating shoulder yaw and the elbow, and shoulder roll uniquely dominated by Coulomb friction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为Unitree G1人形机器人左臂建立了可解释的物理驱动电功率消耗模型，用真实机器人实测数据拟合出含摩擦、铜损、重力补偿耦合项的线性参数模型，在897条轨迹上R²达0.933，并在未见过的速度下泛化R²达0.965。
analysis.org: 阿根廷国立科技大学（UTN）/CITeS研究所
analysis.claim: Unitree G1七自由度手臂的电功率消耗可通过一个物理结构明确、含关节间耦合项的线性参数模型高精度建模，且该模型具备跨速度泛化能力。
analysis.input: 关节角度、角速度、角加速度、电机电流指令（隐含于扭矩基准项）、重力补偿负载变化量
analysis.output: 单个电机或整臂的实时电功率（瓦特）

analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：全部参数均基于Unitree G1真机实测功率数据回归得到，无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 属具身智能中能源建模的关键子问题——首次为G1手臂提供经大规模真机验证、带物理可解释性、支持负功率预测的功率模型；虽未开新范式，但填补了当前主流开源人形平台（G1）在能耗建模上的实证空白，支撑后续能量感知运动规划，但仅限单一机型、未开源代码/数据、未集成进控制栈
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了Unitree G1真实能耗建模这一被长期忽视的工程瓶颈，证据扎实（真机+多轨迹+跨速验证），但影响范围限于特定硬件，尚未形成工具链级输出

papers.title: Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While these policies achieve state-of-the-art manipulation performance in-distribution, they remain brittle to minor spatial, semantic, and task variations. In this work, we address the inability of current models to decouple the declarative (i.e., concepts and entity semantics) from the procedural knowledge (i.e., how to do something) encoded in their parameters, which is a fundamental bottleneck for zero-shot skill transfer to novel objects. To address this, we propose w$^{2}$VLA, a new VLA model with restructured information flow. Rather than feeding all multimodal tokens from the VLM encoder into a large, opaque transformer-based action expert, our approach modulates the robot state sequence with visual, spatial, and skill information in a compositional and interpretable manner. Unlike popular, state-of-the-art VLAs, we show that our modular approach successfully decouples knowledge representations, enabling robust behavior cloning and unprecedented zero-shot skill transfer capabilities across dissimilar, unseen objects.

analysis.tldr: 提出w²VLA模型，通过模块化信息流设计将视觉语言模型中的‘是什么’（ declarative）和‘怎么做’（procedural）知识显式解耦，从而在不依赖新物体真实数据的情况下，实现跨物体的零样本技能迁移。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 当前VLA模型性能瓶颈源于declarative与procedural知识在参数中混杂编码，而w²VLA通过结构化模块化设计实现二者解耦，从而支持真正零样本、跨物体的行为克隆。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（如关节位置/末端位姿）
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号或离散动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真或真实机器人行为克隆数据（但未说明是否含真实机器人数据）

papers.title: Flatness Preserves Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have the potential for open-world generalization by leveraging pretrained vision-language representations, yet downstream finetuning on limited robot data often degrades these representations, leading to brittle policies that ignore language instructions in favor of visual shortcuts, a failure mode we term instruction blindness. We hypothesize that standard finetuning with limited data applies gradients to a sparse set of points, which manifests as a sharp loss landscape with high-curvature minima. We propose to address this directly through flatness-preserving optimization while finetuning on the exact same data, where learning a flatter landscape results in a model more robust to perturbations in the weight space. Specifically, we demonstrate that simply applying sharpness-aware minimization during VLA finetuning significantly improves instruction following by over 60% across multiple simulation and real-world benchmarks without additional data, architectural modification, or retraining. We further analyze the effect of selective sharpness, quantify its effects, and show that our approach is complementary to existing guidance techniques. Project page can be found at https://haochenz11.github.io/papers/flatness-vla/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在小样本机器人数据微调时容易‘听不懂指令’（只看图不看话），提出用sharpness-aware minimization（SAM）这种扁平化优化方法，在完全不改模型结构、不加数据、不换训练流程的前提下，显著提升模型对语言指令的遵循能力。
analysis.claim: 通过在VLA模型微调阶段引入flatness-preserving优化（如SAM），可显著缓解instruction blindness，且无需额外数据、架构修改或预训练调整。

analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector控制或关节扭矩）

papers.title: LaST-HD: Learning Latent Physical Reasoning from Scalable Human Data for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-hand demonstrations provide a direct and scalable source of physical interaction data for robot learning. While manual retargeting is indispensable for establishing kinematic action correspondence across different morphologies, robust transfer requires going beyond geometry to address the underlying alignment of physical dynamics between human and robot manipulation. To address this, we introduce LaST-HD, a novel human-to-robot action learning paradigm that extends reasoning-before-acting VLA by aligning human-hand and robot demonstrations in a shared latent reasoning space. Rather than mimicking human kinematics, LaST-HD trains an auxiliary action-conditioned world model on unpaired human-hand and robot trajectories to synthesize unified latent targets. After aligning cross-embodiment representations in this shared forward-dynamics space, these targets supervise LaST-HD's latent reasoning process, enabling it to internalize shared physical dynamics and drive efficient human-hand action learning. Moreover, we develop Out-of-Lab (OOL) Glove, a low-cost motion-capture glove tailored to LaST-HD for human-hand data collection. The captured human data provide precise keypoints and serve as universal action supervision across grippers and dexterous hands. Armed with the aligned latent space and high-fidelity human-hand data, we develop a progressive mixed-to-human training recipe comprising mixed human-robot co-training and human-hand online correction post-training. Through mixed co-training, LaST-HD improves generalization to novel objects, scenes, and positions using only human-hand demonstrations. With online correction, LaST-HD further adapts to novel environments and achieves over 90\% accuracy using only 20 minutes of OOL glove data.

analysis.tldr: 提出LaST-HD框架，通过构建人类手部与机器人动作共享的潜在物理推理空间，用未配对的人类手套数据驱动机器人操作学习，仅需20分钟真实人类数据就能在新环境中达到90%以上成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有中文名但无法确认归属）

papers.title: USS: Unified Spatial-Semantic Prompts for Embodied Visual Tracking with Latent Dynamics Learning
papers.abstract: Embodied Visual Tracking (EVT) requires an agent to continuously follow a specified target while actively moving through dynamic environments. However, prevailing EVT paradigms predominantly rely on language-based target indication. While language is expressive and convenient, cluttered scenes often contain multiple objects that satisfy the same semantic description, leading to ambiguous target grounding. We therefore propose a paradigm shift, reframing target indication in EVT from text-only specification to unified spatial-semantic prompting. Based on this paradigm, we introduce Unified Spatial-Semantic Prompts for Embodied Visual Tracking with Latent Dynamics Learning, USS, an end-to-end embodied tracking framework that supports text, point, bounding box, and mask prompts within a unified architecture. USS encodes heterogeneous prompts with modality-specific encoders, fuses prompt tokens with visual features through hybrid attention, and decodes compact prompt-conditioned representations into egocentric waypoints. To further improve temporal robustness, USS incorporates a latent world model that predicts future representations through self-supervised alignment. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that explicit spatial target cues yield higher success rates than text-only prompts, particularly in scenarios involving similar distractors and longer-horizon tracking where maintaining instance-level target identity is critical. In the simulation benchmark, USS also achieves state-of-the-art performance among non-MLLM-based methods and competitive results against recent MLLM-based approaches with faster inference speed. Our findings reveal that spatial-semantic prompting provides a more precise and flexible target indication interface for embodied visual tracking. Project site: https://arescheah.github.io/uss-project-page/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种统一处理文本、点、框、掩码等空间-语义提示的具身视觉跟踪框架USS，用多模态提示融合+潜动力学建模提升真实机器人在干扰物多、长时程场景下的目标跟踪鲁棒性。

papers.title: Legible and Intuitive Multi-modal Robot State and Intent Communication Validated in Online and Real-world Studies
papers.abstract: Effective robot-to-human communication can increase transparency and trust, reduce uncertainty, and contribute to safer collaboration in shared workspaces. Designing and validating an effective robot communication strategy is challenging due to the varying and often limited communication modalities across robots, differences in how diverse recipients interpret messages, and the underexplored virtual-to-real gap in studies of communication legibility. We present a systematic, large-scale comparative validation of existing communication strategies for a mobile non-humanoid robot across message types and settings (online and in-person). Based on the prescribed message types in the existing standards for industrial robots, we realize and compare a low-expressive, unimodal LED-based strategy with a highly expressive, multimodal one that leverages robotic gaze, gestures, and voice. For each strategy, we analyze the communication of a turning intention, an attention request, error status, whether the robot is stuck, and whether it is functioning normally. We evaluate these strategies in replicated online and in-person experiments. We find strong evidence that highly expressive multimodal communication is perceived as more legible and intuitive than unimodal LED-based communication. Comparing the online and real-world study findings, we observe a notable decrease in overall legibility, particularly for signaling with LEDs. Similarly, confidence in message interpretation decreases during the real-world evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了工业移动机器人用LED单模态 vs. 眼神+手势+语音多模态方式传达5种关键状态/意图（如转向、卡住、报错）的效果，在线上众包实验和真实机器人现场实验中验证：多模态更易懂更直观，但所有方式在真实场景中表现都比线上差，尤其LED方式下降明显。
analysis.claim: 高度表达性的多模态机器人状态与意图通信（融合凝视、手势、语音）显著提升人类对机器人行为的可理解性与直觉判断，且该优势在真实世界中虽被削弱但仍稳健存在。

papers.title: OpenSPM: An Environment-Transferable Robotic Key Spatial Pose Memory and Closed-Loop High-Frequency Flow-Matching Action Generation Model
papers.abstract: Open-environment tabletop robotic manipulation requires systems to possess semantic understanding, precise geometric pose estimation, and high-frequency action generation. While end-to-end vision-language-action (VLA) models excel at semantic generalization, they often lack explicit geometric constraints for fine-grained tasks and require costly training. To bridge the gap between high-level semantics and low-level physical execution, we propose OpenSPM, an open environment spatial persistent memory framework consisting of spatial pose memory and flow-matching action generation model. OpenSPM first leverages semantically conditioned 3D perception and Kalman filtering to track continuous 6D poses. It then extracts key spatial poses from human demonstrations, keeping them as transferable, object-centric spatial persistent memory entries. During inference, OpenSPM retrieves relevant memory entries in terms of natural language instructions, transfers the spatial poses to new scenes using SE(3) transformations, and generates high-frequency action chunks via a lightweight conditional flow-matching model. Combined with real-time proprioceptive state feedback and terminal residual correction, the system effectively suppresses trajectory error accumulation. Evaluated on ten LIBERO-GOAL tasks, OpenSPM achieves an 85.6% success rate and an equivalent control frequency of 1033.3 Hz, while requiring minimal inference AI computing power. Extensive ablations illustrate that structured spatial persistent memory and closed-loop residual correction play a crucial role in reliable, high-frequency robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出OpenSPM框架，用人类示范中提取的可迁移关键空间位姿作为‘空间持久记忆’，结合SE(3)跨场景位姿迁移和轻量条件流匹配模型，在开放桌面环境中实现高频率（等效1033Hz）、闭环纠偏的机器人操作，无需大量训练即在LIBERO-GOAL上达到85.6%成功率。
analysis.claim: 结构化的、可跨场景迁移的物体中心空间持久记忆 + 闭环残差校正，是实现开放环境高频率鲁棒机器人操作的关键，且能大幅降低对大规模端到端训练的依赖。

papers.title: Grasp-Oriented Non-Prehensile Manipulation via Learning a Graspability Field
papers.abstract: Non-prehensile manipulation is often used as a preparatory step for robotic grasping, yet existing approaches typically require a predefined target object pose. In practice, however, objects admit multiple graspable configurations and the desired pose is not known in advance. We reformulate non-prehensile manipulation for grasping as optimizing an object centric graspability objective rather than reaching a specific pose. We construct a graspable set from synthesized grasps and define a graspability field that measures how suitable an object configuration is for successful grasp execution. The scalar measure provides a dense learning signal for reinforcement learning and determines when to terminate manipulation. This yields a closed-loop manipulation-to-grasp pipeline driven by a single policy. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot show that the policy reliably reconfigures objects into graspable states and transitions to grasping without external planners or manually specified stopping conditions. The predicted graspability distance correlates with real world grasp success, which indicates that the learned representation captures grasp feasibility of object configurations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用‘可抓取性场’（graspability field）替代传统非抓取式操作中预设目标位姿的做法，让机器人通过强化学习自主优化物体位姿直到达到高可抓取状态，再无缝切换到抓取，整个流程由单一策略驱动，无需外部规划器或人工设定停止条件。
analysis.claim: 非抓取式操作应被建模为对物体中心化可抓取性场的优化过程，而非朝向固定位姿的运动规划。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+物体姿态估计+当前机械臂状态
analysis.output: 连续动作（推/滑/旋转等非抓取操作）及隐式终止信号

papers.title: High-Fidelity One-Step Generative Visuomotor Policy via Recursive Correction, Frequency Consistency, and Contrastive Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Generative models such as diffusion and flow matching have advanced robotic visuomotor policies by modeling multimodal action distributions, but their multi-step sampling or ODE solving introduces inference latency. Existing one-step acceleration methods often compress the whole generation process into a single large update, leading to spatial deviation, frequency distortion, and mode averaging. This paper proposes a high-fidelity one-step generative visuomotor policy framework that addresses these issues with three complementary mechanisms. Recursive Consistent Action Flow (RCAF) uses recursive correction to compensate for spatial truncation errors and align one-step predictions with refined flow trajectories. Dual-Timestep Frequency Consistency (DTFC) preserves high-frequency manipulation details through adaptive spectral consistency across flow timesteps. Contrastive Flow Matching (CFM) separates entangled action flows with a margin-based repulsive objective, reducing ambiguous actions in multimodal manipulation. Experiments on RoboTwin, RoboTwin 2.0, Adroit, DexArt, and real-world robot platforms show that the proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance compared with strong 10-step generative policy baselines while requiring only one forward pass (1 NFE), enabling low-latency visuomotor control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种能在单次前向传播中生成高质量机器人视觉-运动策略的方法，通过递归修正、频域一致性约束和对比流匹配三个技术，解决现有单步生成方法因压缩过猛导致的空间偏差、高频细节丢失和多模态动作模糊问题，在多个仿真和真实机器人平台上达到甚至超过10步扩散策略的性能。
analysis.claim: 通过递归修正、双时间步频域一致性与对比流匹配，可在单次网络前向传播（1 NFE）下实现与多步生成策略相当甚至更优的高保真视觉-运动控制性能。
