papers.title: A Glycan-Aware Diffusion Model for Carbohydrate and Glycoprotein Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Biomolecular diffusion models can now predict proteins and heterogeneous complexes, but glycans remain difficult because their branched topology, conformational flexibility, and strict stereochemical rules must be captured simultaneously. We developed SweetFold, a glycan-aware adaptation of Boltz-1x for the structure prediction of free glycans, glycoproteins, and protein-glycan complexes. SweetFold represents glycans as pseudo-polymers rather than generic ligands, preserving monosaccharide identity, anomeric state, glycosidic connectivity, and atom-level stereochemistry. We pair this representation with glycan-specific architecture, stereochemical supervision, and a sugar-centric training curriculum. Across monosaccharide, oligosaccharide, lectin, and glycoprotein benchmarks, SweetFold improves structural metrics relative to baseline all-atom diffusion models while retaining protein-only benchmark performance. These results show that chemically localized representation and supervision can extend biomolecular diffusion models to carbohydrate chemistry.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了SweetFold，一个专为糖类分子（游离寡糖、糖蛋白、蛋白-糖复合物）结构预测设计的扩散模型，通过将糖链建模为‘伪聚合物’并引入糖化学特异性架构、立体化学监督和糖中心训练策略，显著提升了糖结构预测精度，同时不损害蛋白质结构预测能力。
analysis.claim: 化学局域化表征（保留单糖身份、异头构型、糖苷键连接与原子级立体化学）结合糖特异性建模，可使扩散模型真正泛化到糖类生物大分子结构预测。
analysis.input: 糖序列（含单糖类型、连接位点、异头构型、糖苷键构型）及对应蛋白结构（如适用）
analysis.output: 原子级全原子3D糖结构或糖蛋白复合物结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性解决糖类分子在扩散建模中的拓扑（分支）、构象（柔性）与立体化学（α/β、手性、环构象）三重耦合难题，实证覆盖单糖→寡糖→糖-蛋白复合物多层级基准，且未牺牲蛋白预测性能；但尚未开源代码/模型，训练数据细节未公开，缺乏独立第三方复现验证，未达AlphaFold2/RFdiffusion级范式颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是把现有蛋白扩散模型简单套用到糖上，而是重构了糖的表征范式与训练逻辑，并在多个糖结构预测任务上取得实质性提升，填补了AI×糖科学的关键空白。

papers.title: IMBench: A Benchmark for Intuitive Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans combine reasoning and motor control to solve complex manipulation tasks under diverse constraints. They build an understanding of the physical world that helps them convert reasoning into actions and quickly adapt to new scenes, tasks, and rules. We refer to this capability as intuitive manipulation. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this integration: they evaluate physical reasoning in isolation from execution, or measure policy performance without requiring explicit reasoning. We introduce IMBENCH, a benchmark designed to evaluate intuitive manipulation as an integrated capability spanning perception, physical reasoning, action generation, and iterative execution. Our tasks require models to infer task-relevant physical structure and generate feasible action sequences under explicit constraints, including contact-rich manipulation, tool use, and multi-stage dependencies. We introduce a benchmark of 35 tasks, 14K filtered trajectories, and scalable tools for generating diverse scenarios. Experiments reveal a consistent gap: vision language models show partial physical reasoning ability but fail to produce executable plans, while state-of-the-art vision-language-action models struggle to satisfy task constraints and generalize across scenarios. These results identify intuitive manipulation as a missing axis in current foundation models and generalist robot policies, and position IMBENCH as a step toward evaluating and enabling more integrated, adaptive physical intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫IMBench的新基准，专门测试机器人是否具备‘直觉操作’能力——即把物理推理、感知、动作生成和迭代执行整合起来解决带约束的复杂操作任务（如工具使用、多阶段接触操作），但本身不提新模型或算法，只提供35个任务、1.4万条筛选轨迹和场景生成工具。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv提交者多为个人或未标注单位）
analysis.claim: 当前机器人基础模型和通用策略模型缺乏对‘直觉操作’这一整合型物理智能能力的评估，IMBench首次系统定义并量化该能力维度。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（视觉+语言指令+任务约束描述）
analysis.output: 可行的动作序列（含物理可行性与约束满足性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（所有轨迹来自仿真生成，摘要未提真实数据采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次明确定义‘直觉操作’并构建覆盖接触操作/工具使用/多阶段依赖的任务集，但纯仿真、无真机验证、无新算法、无开源代码（仅项目页）、未在跨机体/跨用户等维度验证泛化，实质贡献限于概念框架+基准建设，远未达T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石级工作（需真机、多任务闭环、强实证、开源、可部署）的工程深度与科学分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：做了有价值的基准设计，但缺真机验证、缺开源、缺算法创新，属于扎实的benchmark建设，而非突破或可落地的技术推进

papers.title: Hippocampal theta distinguishes between memory-guided and exploratory saccades in humans
papers.abstract: Abstract Memory shapes how we explore the visual world, but the neural mechanisms linking mnemonic processes to eye movements during naturalistic viewing are not well understood. Theta-band oscillatory activity in the hippocampus is time-locked with eye movements in primates, suggesting a putative mechanism for coordinating mnemonic processing and oculomotor behaviour. Yet, it remains unknown whether this coupling generalises to episodic memory-guided viewing in humans, whether slow (3–6 Hz) and fast (6–10 Hz) theta bands play dissociable functions, and whether this coupling is sensitive to the direction of upcoming eye movements. Here, we used intracranial EEG and eye-tracking data from 11 neurosurgical patients of either sex (Keles et al., 2024) to address these questions. Using fixation-locked analyses, we found that hippocampal theta dynamics differentiate memory-guided from memory-independent fixations of episodically encoded naturalistic scenes (i.e., movies) through power and coherence mechanisms that are both temporally and spectrally dissociable. First, immediately after fixations (∼0 to 250 ms), slow-theta power was more strongly suppressed during memory-guided trials (i.e., true positive, TP) than correct memory-independent trials (i.e., true negative, TN). Second, in the period around fixations (-80 to 60 ms), theta phase coherence increased independent of power during TP vs TN trials. This increase in coherence was most pronounced for contraversive relative to ipsiversive fixations, consistent with direction-sensitive hippocampal–oculomotor coordination during memory-guided viewing. Together, these findings suggest that hippocampal theta plays dissociable, time-locked roles in memory-guided fixations during naturalistic visual retrieval, supporting an ecologically relevant role for the hippocampus in coordinating memory and active visual behaviour. Significance statement Memory influences how we sample the visual environment, but the brain signals that link memory systems to eye movements are poorly understood. Using intracranial recordings from the human hippocampus during visual exploration of naturalistically encoded scenes, we demonstrate that theta-band activity differentiates memory-guided from memory-independent fixations in two ways: increased theta synchrony around fixation onset and reduced theta power modulations after fixation onset. These results reveal novel insights into how hippocampal theta helps coordinate memory-guided visual exploration.
authors: Matthijs A. A. van der Meer

analysis.tldr: 通过颅内脑电和眼动追踪，发现人类海马theta振荡在记忆引导的注视（如回忆电影场景）和纯探索性注视中存在两种可分离的神经标记：注视起始前后theta相位一致性升高，注视后慢theta功率抑制更强，且该效应随注视方向变化。
analysis.claim: 人类海马theta振荡通过时间-频谱双分离机制（相位一致性增强 + 慢theta功率选择性抑制）特异性编码记忆引导型注视，且该编码具有方向敏感性。
analysis.input: 颅内EEG信号（海马区）+ 眼动轨迹（注视起止时间、方向）
analysis.output: 记忆引导 vs 记忆无关注视的二元判别指标（基于theta功率/相位相干性的时间-频谱特征）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖11例癫痫患者术中颅内电极采集的真实神经数据与同步眼动数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在人类颅内记录中确立海马theta对记忆引导注视的方向敏感性双参数编码（相位+功率），证据扎实（真实病人数据、固定锁时分析、TP/TN对照、方向对比），但仅限单一脑区、单一行为范式（电影回溯注视），未构建解码器或闭环干预，未跨被试泛化，属高质量机制发现而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了人类海马theta调控记忆-眼动耦合的关键实证证据，但局限于机制刻画，未延伸至解码或干预，不属于突破性技术或临床范式革新。

papers.title: CAPT: A Multi-task Continuous Autoregressive Transformer enabling Cross-dataset and Cross-species Transfer for Calcium Population Dynamics
papers.abstract: Large-scale calcium imaging has created an opportunity to build foundation-style models for neural population dynamics, but a central question remains unresolved: \textbf{whether a model pretrained on one collection of recordings can generalize to new datasets, experimental paradigms, and even species.} Existing approaches are often designed for specific tasks and evaluated on a single dataset, making it unclear whether their learned representations are reusable for new calcium trace datasets. To tackle this gap, we present \textbf{CAPT}, a \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{A}utoregressive \textbf{P}opulation \textbf{T}ransformer for calcium population dynamics. CAPT models continuous calcium traces directly through a continuous patch tokenization strategy and is trained autoregressively, enabling end-to-end pretraining and adaptation to diverse downstream tasks. We first pretrain CAPT on a large-scale mouse calcium imaging dataset and evaluate its transferability across independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and \textit{C. elegans} datasets collected by different laboratories. In these transfer settings, the pretrained backbone is frozen and only adaptation modules are updated. Across neural population forecasting and behavior decoding tasks, CAPT consistently outperforms specialized and general-purpose baselines. Alongside predictive performance, multimodal analyses using NeuroPAL annotations in \textit{C. elegans} datasets show that CAPT embeddings form a shared functional space across datasets and capture anatomical cell-identity-related structure. These results suggest that the continuous autoregressive modeling opens up possibilities for a simple route towards general-purpose neural foundation models for calcium imaging, which can generalize across datasets, experimental paradigms, and species.

analysis.tldr: 提出CAPT模型，用连续自回归Transformer直接建模钙成像时间序列，在小鼠数据上预训练后，冻结主干网络，仅微调适配模块，就能跨数据集、跨实验范式、跨物种（小鼠/斑马鱼幼虫/线虫）泛化到神经活动预测和行为解码任务，并在神经元功能表征上展现出跨物种的解剖一致性。
analysis.claim: 连续自回归建模钙信号时间序列可构建具备跨数据集、跨实验范式、跨物种泛化能力的神经群体动力学基础模型。
analysis.input: 原始钙成像时间序列（连续浮点值向量，含多神经元通道）
analysis.output: 未来时间步的钙信号预测值 + 行为标签概率（下游任务适配后）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人硬件或实时控制数据，仅依赖离线公开钙成像数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在钙成像领域系统验证跨物种迁移可行性，实证覆盖3个物种+多实验室独立数据+多任务（预测+解码）+神经解剖可解释性分析；但未开源代码与模型权重，仅提供项目页，且未与最先进专用模型（如NeuroGPT、CaImAn+LSTM混合架构）做公平消融，基础模型设计（连续patch+AR）属合理演进而非范式颠覆。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将自回归Transformer成功迁移到钙成像多物种泛化场景，证据扎实但未达AlphaFold级范式突破，开源不足削弱复现门槛。

papers.title: MDIR: A Task-Manifold Impedance Retargeting Method for Contact-Rich Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Fixed Cartesian impedance makes contact-rich teleoperation demonstrations practical, but gains that secure progress and contact support also determine impact and force variability. We study single-demonstration controller-to-controller impedance retargeting. Given one fixed Cartesian impedance command sequence {K0, D0, xcmd}, Manifold-Decomposed Impedance Retargeting (MDIR) deterministically reparameterizes the recorded controller into an executable task-channel variable-impedance command. MDIR targets this local retargeting problem by preserving projected task-channel responses near the demonstrated trajectory. It represents the source response in operational work, exertion, and support channels with a passive residual complement under a control-chain metric, computes an executable Cartesian-to-Manifold Retargeting (C2M) baseline, and applies Manifold-Constrained Parameter Optimization (MPO) to select a feasible representative with lower wrist-force peaks, impulse, force variability, and nominal controller power. Across planar wiping, pick-and-place, and pushing on a Franka Panda, the full MDIR controller passes Task Check in all 15 closed-loop executions and reduces all four aggressiveness metrics relative to the fixed-impedance demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出MDIR方法，仅用一次固定阻抗的遥操作演示数据，自动重映射出变阻抗控制指令，在Franka Panda上完成擦拭、抓放、推动物体等接触密集任务，降低了腕部力峰值、冲量、力波动和控制器功耗。
analysis.claim: 仅需单次固定阻抗遥操作演示，即可通过任务流形分解与约束优化，生成更安全、低冲击的变阻抗执行指令，显著改善接触-rich任务中的力行为。
analysis.input: 单次录制的固定笛卡尔阻抗指令序列（K0, D0, xcmd）及对应操作轨迹
analysis.output: 可执行的、任务通道自适应的变阻抗控制指令序列（含时变刚度/阻尼）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的单次演示数据（非大规模采集，但为真机闭环执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实Franka Panda上验证了3类接触密集任务，有闭环执行成功率（15/15 Task Check）、4项力学指标系统性下降，且含C2M基线与MPO消融逻辑；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/用户验证，未与主流端到端策略（如ACT/ALOHA）对比，属扎实的控制层改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是接触密集遥操作中阻抗在线重映射方向的扎实推进，实证充分但生态封闭，未达基石级通用性或部署广度。

papers.title: EpiLENS: Patient-Relative Epileptogenic Zone Localization from Multi-Center Intracranial EEG
papers.abstract: Drug-resistant epilepsy remains a major clinical challenge, as successful neurosurgery depends critically on accurate epileptogenic zone (EZ) localization accounting for substantial variability across patients, seizures, implantation layouts, recording systems and clinical centers. Existing intracranial electroencephalogram (iEEG) methods typically rely on channel-wise classifiers trained globally, which often obscure patient-specific electrophysiological abnormalities and exhibit instability under severe class imbalance and noisy clinical annotations. To address these limitations, we present EpiLENS, a primary-guided asymmetric dual-branch framework for patient-relative epileptogenic localization. Its localization strategy, Conservative Dual-Evidence Localization (CDEL), asymmetrically combines independently trained but complementary branches at inference: the Patient-Relative Quantile Network (PRQ-Net), which captures seizure-consistent deviations from each patient's internal electrophysiological baseline, and the Boundary-Coverage Ranking Network (BCR-Net), which emphasizes ambiguous epileptogenic zone or non-epileptogenic zone boundaries and recovery of the patient-specific epileptogenic set. CDEL retains PRQ-Net as the primary branch while incorporating complementary patient-wise ranking evidence from BCR-Net. Experiments on a heterogeneous four-center cohort demonstrate improved balanced localization over classical feature-based and raw-iEEG neural baselines, while component ablations and within-patient permutation analyses support the contributions of patient-relative normalization, lower-tail seizure aggregation, and boundary-coverage ranking. Cross-seizure and leave-one-center-out generalization experiments further confirm that the proposed patient-relative evidence remains robust across repeated recordings and transfers effectively to unseen clinical centers.

analysis.tldr: 提出EpiLENS方法，用双分支神经网络从多中心颅内脑电（iEEG）数据中定位每位癫痫患者的致痫区（EZ），核心是不依赖全局统计而是以患者自身脑电基线为参照，结合异常偏离度和边界模糊区域排序来提升定位鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 患者个体化的电生理基线参照比全局训练的通道分类器更能稳定、准确地定位致痫区，尤其在跨中心、跨发作、标注噪声大、类别极度不平衡的临床iEEG场景下。
analysis.input: 多中心颅内脑电（iEEG）时间序列（含电极位置与解剖信息）、患者个体基线期脑电段
analysis.output: 每个电极或皮层区域的致痫概率得分（用于EZ空间定位）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实临床iEEG数据（含手术验证标签），但未使用实时闭环干预或机器人执行
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实多中心临床iEEG数据上实现了显著优于传统特征法和端到端模型的平衡定位性能，有严谨的消融（患者基线归一化、低尾聚合、边界覆盖排序）、跨中心泛化和患者内置换验证；但未开源代码/模型，且未进入临床部署或影响手术决策流程，属扎实推进SOTA的重磅方法学贡献，尚未达基石级（如BCI语音合成/行走控制等直接恢复功能的里程碑）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将患者相对建模、双证据融合与临床iEEG异构性痛点深度对齐，实证充分，但缺乏开源与临床闭环验证，尚未突破方法到临床价值的最后一公里。

papers.title: SurgLAT: Surgical Latent Attention Tracking for Depth-Aware Robotic Laparoscope Control
papers.abstract: Autonomous laparoscopic camera control requires continuous understanding of the surgeon's operative intent in dynamic surgical scenes, where the target operative region is not a stable physical object but a latent and temporally evolving attention state. In this work, we present Surgical Latent Attention Tracking (SurgLAT), a causal online framework for latent surgical attention modeling and autonomous laparoscopic view control. SurgLAT uses a frozen DINOv3 encoder and a state-conditioned spatial token mixer to extract operative evidence under a memory-guided spatial prior, while a selective causal latent memory module jointly models short-term motion continuity and long-horizon surgical intent evolution through dynamic retrieval of current, recent, and historical latent states. The learned latent surgical attention state is decoded into a probabilistic attention heatmap and operative region for downstream endoscope guidance. Beyond perception, we further introduce a robotic deployment framework with explicit laparoscopic Remote Center of Motion (RCM) constrained control based on virtual-axis formulation, together with redundancy-aware null-space initialization for stable and smooth manipulator motion. We validate the full system on real laparoscopic surgical videos and a physical robotic laparoscope platform. Experimental results demonstrate robust online operative-region tracking and stable autonomous endoscopy adjustment under occlusion, rapid motion, and target transitions, highlighting the effectiveness of latent surgical intent modeling for surgical autonomy.

analysis.tldr: 提出SurgLAT框架，用冻结的DINOv3+空间token mixer+因果潜存记忆模块，在动态腹腔镜视频中在线建模外科医生隐含的、随时间演化的注意力状态，并驱动真实机器人腹腔镜按RCM约束稳定跟踪操作区域。
analysis.claim: 外科手术中操作意图是隐含、时变、非物态的注意力状态，直接建模该潜态并耦合RCM约束控制，可实现鲁棒的自主腹腔镜视角调控。
analysis.input: 单目腹腔镜视频流（RGB）+历史潜态记忆
analysis.output: 概率化注意力热图 + 操作区域坐标 + RCM约束下的机械臂关节速度指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实腹腔镜机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但摘要明确‘physical robotic laparoscope platform’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实腹腔镜手术视频（用于训练/验证潜态模型），但未说明是否依赖真实机器人交互数据（如手眼标定、力反馈、闭环轨迹标注）；仅提及‘validate on real videos and physical platform’，未提采集闭环真实机器人带标签数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘潜注意力’作为外科意图核心建模对象，引入因果记忆机制处理长程意图演化，并在真实腹腔镜机器人上验证RCM约束控制——但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨中心/多术式泛化结果，无消融证明各模块必要性，也未与主流基线（如RT-1变体、VIMA、Lerobot）对比，实证深度弱于World Models系列所设标杆（94+分档）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了腹腔镜场景下非刚性、非物态意图建模这一关键瓶颈，且完成真机部署，但实证广度与开源程度不足，尚未达到开范式或里程碑级

papers.title: ARCHER: Amortized cross-specimen pose estimation for cryo-electron microscopy
papers.abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) pose estimation is traditionally solved anew for each dataset, where iterative refinement is done from scratch while the estimator learns to store the molecule in its weights. In this work, we show that pose inference is a generalizable, specimen-agnostic operation when conditioned explicitly on a reference volume. We introduce ARCHER , an amortized contrastive classifier that models the pose posterior over a discrete rotation grid. Trained across a variety of protein structures, it operates zero-shot without retraining per structure . This transferability is grounded in Fourier-space information mechanics, where all specimen dependence is captured by the reference structure's power spectrum and spatial extent. ARCHER achieves a median angular error of 5.0° on 100 held-out test structures and 2.5° on experimental particles, matching dedicated estimators within 0.16Å in 3D reconstruction. Crucially, downstream conformational signal is preserved. The leading conformational coordinate correlates at 0.97 with deposited benchmarks, faithfully reconstructing free-energy basins and mobile domains. These results overall demonstrate that cryo-EM pose estimation can be generalized across different structures.

analysis.tldr: 提出ARCHER模型，用一个统一的、跨蛋白结构的零样本分类器替代传统cryo-EM中每个新蛋白都要从头训练的迭代姿态估计流程，直接在离散旋转网格上做对比学习分类，输入是2D粒子图像和参考体积，输出是3D旋转姿态，且在真实实验数据上达到与专用模型相当的精度和下游构象解析保真度。
analysis.claim: cryo-EM单颗粒姿态估计可被建模为一个 specimen-agnostic 的、可零样本泛化的条件分类任务，其可迁移性有傅里叶空间信息力学基础（仅依赖参考体积的功率谱与空间范围）。
analysis.input: 2D冷冻电镜粒子图像 + 参考三维体积（含其功率谱与空间范围特征）
analysis.output: 离散旋转网格上的姿态后验概率分布（即3D旋转欧拉角）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖公开cryo-EM实验粒子图像与结构数据集（如EMPIAR、PDB衍生体积）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现真正跨蛋白结构的零样本cryo-EM姿态估计，在100个未见蛋白结构上中位角误差5.0°，实验粒子达2.5°，且关键验证了下游构象信号（自由能盆地、动态域）完整保留，证据扎实（多结构测试+实验粒子+3D重建FSC/分辨率对比+构象坐标相关性0.97），但尚未开源代码/模型，未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，属显著推进SOTA的重磅工作，介于ESMFold（95）与HI-JEPA（97）之间但实证广度略窄。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅工程整合：用 amortized contrastive classification 替代传统迭代优化，在科学实证（精度+构象保真）上全面达标，但缺乏开源与更大规模基准验证，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid: Bipedal Locomotion with Linear-Quadratic Control and Learned Cost Functions
papers.abstract: The Poppy Humanoid is an open-source, low-cost robot suitable for research and education in artificial intelligence. However, we are unaware of any published methodology that achieves reliable, unassisted bipedal locomotion on the standard Poppy hardware. This paper contributes a functional closed-loop walking controller for Poppy, based on the linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) framework for trajectory tracking. Starting with data collected from open-loop playback of a nominal walking trajectory, our proposed method learns a quadratic cost function for an LQR controller that substantially improves the reliability of the motion. The closed-loop controller is validated empirically, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in walking performance compared to open-loop trajectory playback.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为低成本开源人形机器人Poppy实现了首个可靠的闭环双足行走控制器，用真实机器人采集的开环轨迹数据训练出一个适配LQR的二次型代价函数，显著提升了行走稳定性。
analysis.claim: 通过在真实Poppy机器人上学习LQR的二次代价函数，可将开环行走提升为稳定、可靠、统计显著的闭环双足步行。
analysis.input: Poppy机器人本体状态（关节角、角速度等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实Poppy机器人采集的开环轨迹数据（非仿真、非预设模型生成）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了Poppy平台长期缺失可靠行走的实操问题，但仅限单一低自由度人形、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、未接入感知或环境交互、无多baseline对比或消融实验，属于扎实但窄域的工程实现；远低于标尺中任意一篇（全部≥94），甚至未达到典型SOTA工作门槛（如需多场景/多机体/与大模型协同/世界模型集成等）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：首次在真实Poppy上跑通闭环行走，有实机验证和统计显著性，但技术深度、泛化性和系统级贡献有限，暂未构成方法论突破。

papers.title: Two evolutionary histories in one nucleus: genome remodeling and allelic regulation underlying heterosis in hybrid oil palm
papers.abstract: Oil palm (Elaeis) is the primary source of global vegetable oil. Interspecific hybrids of Elaeis exhibit pronounced heterosis by integrating two distinct subgenomes into a single nucleus, effectively combining the high yield of African oil palm (E. guineensis) with the high unsaturated fatty acid content and disease resistance of American oil palm (E. oleifera). However, the genetic basis underlying heterosis is still unclear. Here, we combine phased genome assembly, comparative genomics, evolutionary genomics and haplotype-aware transcriptomics to unravel the genetic architecture of heterosis of hybrid oil palm. We assemble the highly heterozygous F1 genome ('Reyou 40', 3.75% heterozygosity) into a complete 1.73 Gb T2T haplotype (HapG) and a 1.84 Gb near-T2T haplotype (HapO with17 gaps). Despite 91.56% sequence identity, HapG and HapO diverged in LTR-RT occurrence and PAV affected genes, showing complementary biases in lipid metabolism and stress responses, respectively. Evolutionary genomics revealed that ancient WGDs preserved the palm family. Whereas lineage-specific lipid-related gene expansions in oil palm. Six ancient introgressed regions (~64 Mb) in HapG were reshaped by transposable elements and tandem duplication, showing an enrichment of genes related to resistance and lipid metabolism. Transcriptomically, 82.2% of allelic gene pairs maintained balanced expression, accompanied by parental functional complementarity and dosage buffering, revealing a potential regulatory basis for coordinating parental genetic differences in the hybrid genome. These haplotype-resolved genomic resources offer vital targets for understanding heterosis and accelerating oil palm molecular breeding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过端到端单倍型分型组装和多组学分析，首次在油棕杂交种中解析出两个亲本亚基因组（非洲型HapG和美洲型HapO）在结构变异、转座子动态、古老渐渗区重塑及等位基因表达平衡上的系统性互补机制，揭示了杂种优势的基因组与转录调控基础。
analysis.claim: 油棕杂种优势源于两个高度相似但功能互补的亚基因组在结构演化（LTR-RT分布、PAV、古老渐渗区TE重排）、基因家族扩张（脂代谢/抗性）和等位基因表达调控（82.2%平衡表达+剂量缓冲+功能互补）三个层面的协同作用。
analysis.input: 高杂合F1油棕基因组测序数据（PacBio HiFi+Hi-C）、亲本重测序、RNA-seq（含等位特异性表达）
analysis.output: 单倍型完全分型的T2T/Near-T2T基因组（HapG/HapO）、结构变异图谱、等位基因表达偏倚矩阵、古老渐渗区注释、功能富集结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现油棕F1杂交种单倍型完全分型组装（T2T级），结合进化基因组与等位感知转录组，实证揭示杂种优势的多层级遗传机制；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但在作物多倍体/杂种优势研究中属罕见的全链条高质量实证（真基因组+真转录+真进化推断），且资源已公开支撑育种，但仅限单一物种、无跨物种验证或算法通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在油棕这一重要经济作物中完成迄今最完整的杂种优势机制实证，数据深度与多组学整合扎实，但领域普适性有限，尚未形成可迁移方法论。

papers.title: SMILE: Smooth Motion for Improved Long-Horizon VLA Execution
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models reduce inference cost by executing multiple actions per call, but longer horizons often degrade accuracy because raw chunks contain jitter and outliers. We introduce SMILE, an architecture-preserving interface that predicts B-spline coefficients and decodes them into smooth action sequences. SMILE changes only the action representation, enabling longer fixed horizons while retaining each baseline's backbone and model scale. We apply SMILE to SmolVLA, Evo1, VPP, and DAWN, improving accuracy and amortized inference efficiency across LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world experiments. SMILE-Evo1 reaches 98.0% with a 1.1x speedup on LIBERO, while SMILE-VPP reaches an average length of 4.42 with a 1.5x speedup on CALVIN. At a matched execution horizon of 10, SMILE-SmolVLA reduces non-boundary acceleration by 78.6% and velocity sign-change rate by 42.3%. Real-world xArm tests show higher success, fewer drops, and fewer contacts. These results establish smooth coefficient-space generation as a route to accurate, efficient long-horizon VLA execution. Project page: jongwoopark7978.github.io/smilevla

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SMILE方法，把VLA模型输出的动作序列从原始离散动作块改为B样条系数，再解码成平滑动作轨迹，从而在不改动模型结构的前提下提升长步长执行的准确性和效率。
analysis.claim: 在不修改VLA模型骨干网络和规模的前提下，仅通过将动作表示空间从离散动作块映射到B样条系数空间，即可显著提升长时域执行的运动平滑性、任务成功率和推理效率。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令
analysis.output: B样条系数（经解码后为连续平滑动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人微调/验证数据（xArm实验），但未说明是否依赖大规模真实机器人训练数据；主结果基于仿真benchmark（LIBERO/CALVIN）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在LIBERO/CALVIN两大标准benchmark及真实xArm上验证了4个主流VLA模型（SmolVLA/Evo1/VPP/DAWN），量化指标覆盖精度、速度、运动学平滑性（加速度/符号翻转率）、成功率、接触/掉落次数；但未开源代码或模型，且未挑战跨机体泛化或部署级鲁棒性，未开新范式，属对VLA动作表征层的重要工程改进而非基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用B样条重参数化动作空间，在多个SOTA VLA模型上稳定提效，证据充分但未开源、未拓展至多机体/长期部署，是高质量的系统级优化而非范式创新。

papers.title: ContrasTED: contrastive domain embeddings for scalable remote homology classification
papers.abstract: Protein structure prediction has expanded structural databases to hundreds of millions of domains. Classifying these domains into homologous superfamilies reveals evolutionary and functional relationships that can persist despite low sequence similarity. As the size of structural databases continues to grow, homology classification requires methods that combine scalability with accuracy. Here we present ContrasTED, which uses CATH-supervised center-contrastive learning to project structure-aware embeddings into a domain-level metric space for nearest-centroid superfamily assignment. On a sequence-filtered S20 benchmark (n = 1,028), superfamily assignment accuracy reached 92.9% (1-NN) and 91.4% (nearest centroid), exceeding sequence search, profile HMMs, Foldseek, and a classifier trained on embeddings. The learned latent space separates superfamilies while retaining structural information below 20% sequence identity, with the largest gains among sparsely represented superfamilies. ContrasTED produces 4.67 million new candidate assignments across 3,796 superfamilies in The Encyclopedia of Domains (TED), extending annotation coverage beyond previous structure-based methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ContrasTED方法，用CATH数据库监督的对比学习，把蛋白质结构嵌入映射到一个能按超家族聚类的度量空间，实现快速准确的远程同源分类，在S20基准上达到92.9%准确率，并为3796个超家族新增467万条结构域注释。
analysis.claim: 通过CATH监督的中心对比学习，可构建一个结构感知、超家族可分、低序列相似性下仍保持判别力的蛋白质域级嵌入空间，显著提升远程同源分类的准确性与可扩展性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构域的三维结构表示（经结构编码器生成的嵌入）
analysis.output: 结构域所属CATH超家族的预测标签（最近质心分配）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在远程同源分类这一经典但长期棘手的问题上，首次将中心对比学习与CATH层级监督结合，实证显示对低序列相似性（<20%）和稀疏超家族有显著提升，且在S20上全面超越Foldseek等主流工具；但未开源训练数据、未提供预训练模型权重、未在更大规模真实部署验证（如全TED或AlphaFold DB），也未与ESM-2/ESMFold等端到端结构感知模型做公平消融，属扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真推进了结构驱动同源分类的精度与可扩展性边界，但受限于数据/模型未完全开源及缺乏跨架构基线对比，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: EEG-Driven Decoding Framework for Passenger Hazard Perception in Highly Automated Vehicles
papers.abstract: Reliable risk assessment remains a central challenge for Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). Despite advances in automation, passenger cognition provides a non-intrusive auxiliary signal that improves both objective and perceived safety without requiring active human intervention. We introduce an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) that decodes passenger neural responses for both Risk Prediction (RP) and Danger Identification (DI), explicitly modeling humans as passengers to match real-world AV use. To achieve this, we propose the Passenger Cognitive Model (PCM), Risk-aware Sequential Labeling (RSL), and the Passenger EEG Decoding Strategy (PEDS), which integrates a 3D Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (3D-CRNN) model for joint EEG decoding. Experimental results show that 3D-CRNN achieves a Balanced Accuracy (BA) of $95.3\% \pm 2.7\%$ in RP and improves single-subject DI from $80.9\% \pm 3.9\%$ to $85.0\% \pm 3.2\%$ with RSL. Event-wise analyses further show that 3D-CRNN consistently outperforms other models across different event types in RP and DI. In generalization experiments, 3D-CRNN achieves $77.0\% \pm 5.3\%$ BA in cross-session DI and $77.4\% \pm 1.1\%$ BA on seen subjects in cross-subject evaluation, while maintaining a $64.9\% \pm 8.5\%$ BA on unseen subjects, demonstrating promising generalizability and transferability across both intra-subject and inter-subject variability. These findings establish an Electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding framework for AV passenger hazard perception and suggest that passenger cognitive signals can provide auxiliary supervision for future AV decision-making and Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) support.

analysis.tldr: 用乘客脑电（EEG）实时解码其对自动驾驶汽车中潜在危险的感知，构建了一个专为乘客角色设计的脑机接口框架，能预测风险并识别具体危险事件，且在跨会话和跨被试上展现出一定泛化能力。
analysis.org: 北京交通大学/清华大学（联合署名，第一作者Yingkai Yang与通讯作者Xiaorong Gao、Jianqiang Wang均来自国内高校；Xiaorong Gao为清华生物医学工程知名学者，Jianqiang Wang为北交大智能交通与人因方向带头人；摘要未提企业，主导单位应为清华/北交大混合）
analysis.claim: 乘客的EEG信号可被高精度、鲁棒地解码以反映其对自动驾驶场景中真实危险的主观感知，该信号可作为AV安全功能（SOTIF）的辅助监督源。
analysis.input: 多通道头皮EEG时序信号（含事件标记）
analysis.output: 风险预测概率（二分类）和危险事件识别标签（多类时序标注）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实验室受控驾驶模拟器中采集的真实EEG数据，无真实车辆或机器人平台交互
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统构建面向AV乘客角色的EEG解码框架，提出PCM/RSL/PEDS等结构化方法，实证覆盖RP/DI双任务、跨会话/跨被试泛化，并报告了较扎实的消融式性能对比（如3D-CRNN vs 其他模型），但未开源代码/数据，未接入真实AV系统闭环验证，也未证明其输出如何实际提升AV决策或SOTIF——仍属高质量实验室验证，未达‘工程嵌入’或‘临床级鲁棒性’门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计完整、实验严谨、泛化分析充分，但停留在离线解码验证阶段，缺乏真实系统集成与因果性验证，尚未构成范式突破或落地级影响。

papers.title: MuJoCable: Reduced-Order Surface-Routed Cable Transmission for Tendon-Driven Robots
papers.abstract: Tendon transmissions reduce distal inertia and add compliance, yet routing, slack, and friction govern motion and force transfer. Mainstream rigid-body robotics simulators such as MuJoCo do not jointly resolve moving noncircular contact, unilateral tension, and segment friction. We present MuJoCable, which adds a reduced-order, configuration-dependent cable transmission to MuJoCo. Its routing algorithm jointly optimizes an ordered path across moving analytic and mesh surfaces. A unilateral axial law, directional Capstan propagation, and nodal virtual work map this path to segment tensions and body forces. The warm-started engine plugin applies these forces during simulation and exposes route and load states for design. Pulley benchmarks recover analytical transmission relations with a Capstan-ratio error below 0.5%. On the underactuated 18-joint SpiRobs, MuJoCable reveals friction-driven load growth and proximal redistribution of joint rotation that the native tendon does not represent. Hardware tests on SpiRobs and a tendon-route-coupled finger reproduce observed motion sequences. By making physical threading executable, MuJoCable brings transmission sources of the simulation-to-reality gap into route, cable, and actuator design before fabrication.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫MuJoCable的MuJoCo插件，能高保真模拟肌腱驱动机器人中电缆在复杂移动表面上的绕线路径、单向张力传递、方向性摩擦（Capstan效应）和节点受力，填补了主流仿真器无法联合建模非圆接触、单向拉力和分段摩擦的空白，并在真实机器人上验证了其对运动偏差和负载分布的预测能力。
analysis.claim: MuJoCo原生不支持肌腱在动态非刚性表面（如滑轮、导槽、软组织包络面）上的物理一致路由与张力传播建模；MuJoCable通过配置依赖的降阶模型，首次在MuJoCo中实现了可微、可导出、可硬件验证的表面绕线-摩擦-力传递联合仿真。
analysis.input: 肌腱起止点、绕行表面几何（解析曲面或三角网格）、关节构型、驱动端张力
analysis.output: 各肌腱段张力分布、作用于关节/连杆的等效力与力矩、绕线路径坐标序列
analysis.robot_dependency: SpiRobs机器人、 tendon-route-coupled finger（自研手指）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人运动序列与张力测量数据用于验证，不依赖大规模真实肌腱数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了具身智能中长期被忽视但关键的‘传动层失真’问题——不是算法或控制层面的SOTA刷新，而是让仿真真正逼近物理肌腱行为的底层建模突破；已在两个不同构型的肌腱机器人（18自由度SpiRobs和定制手指）上完成sim2real闭环验证，含定量误差分析（Capstan误差<0.5%）和现象复现（摩擦致负载增长、近端旋转重分配），但未开源代码/模型，且未覆盖工业级复杂绕线（如多滑轮串并联+包络缠绕），故未达90+里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在主流机器人仿真器中实现物理一致的表面绕线-摩擦-张力联合建模，并经多机体实证，显著收窄传动环节的sim2real鸿沟。

papers.title: UniExo: Unified Multi-Skill Policies for Musculoskeletal Locomotion and Co-Adaptive Exoskeleton Control
papers.abstract: Daily locomotion encompasses diverse activities and frequent transitions between them, yet most exoskeleton controllers are designed for a single activity or a narrow set of related movements. Changes in activity therefore typically require explicit mode switching and separately tuned or retrained controllers. Simulation-based learning reduces the need for hardware-based tuning but generally retains this limitation. Here we present UniExo, a framework that first constructs a multi-skill musculoskeletal human policy and then jointly trains an exoskeleton control policy with it. Four single-skill imitation experts for walking, turning, running and backward walking are distilled into a single network structured by a skill latent and subsequently fine-tuned through reinforcement learning on transition sequences. The resultant unified human policy achieves a mean tracking success rate of 94.7% on unseen clips of the four skills and exhibits greater robustness to perturbations than its constituent experts. A single hip exoskeleton controller (UniExo) is initialized from hip moment prediction of the human policy and co-adapted with it through multi-agent reinforcement learning across the four skills. This co-adaptation shifts the timing of the assistance torque and raises the fraction of positive work delivered to the hip. When deployed on a custom hip exoskeleton, the controller generalizes across four treadmill speeds in six participants and assists one participant through a continuous route of all four skills and their transitions, without skill labels or explicit mode switching. UniExo thus provides a step towards replacing activity-specific controllers with unified, user-specific controllers that support diverse locomotor activities and the transitions between them.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniExo框架，用多技能人体肌肉骨骼运动策略蒸馏+强化学习微调，再与髋关节外骨骼控制器联合训练，实现单个控制器无缝支持行走、转向、跑步、倒走及其自然过渡，无需模式切换，在6名受试者 treadmill 多速测试和1人连续四技能路线上实机验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Yifei Yuan等无明确机构标识；Wolf/Androwis/Zhou未见于主流外骨骼团队公开署名记录）
analysis.claim: 统一多技能人体运动策略与外骨骼控制器的协同训练，可消除活动切换时的显式模式切换需求，并提升辅助扭矩时序与正功比例，实现跨技能、跨速度、跨用户的泛化控制。
analysis.input: 人体运动学/动力学状态（来自仿真中肌肉骨骼模型）、任务上下文（隐式技能潜变量，无显式指令或标签）
analysis.output: 髋关节外骨骼的实时辅助力矩（标量时间序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制髋关节外骨骼（硬件原型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的肌肉骨骼运动数据（未使用真实人类EMG或运动捕捉数据训练主体策略）；真实机器人部署仅用于最终验证，非训练依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实外骨骼上实现无标签、无模式切换的四技能连续过渡控制，含多速度跨用户泛化与扰动鲁棒性提升，但未开源代码/模型，且人体策略完全基于仿真（未耦合真实生理信号），未与SOTA外骨骼控制器（如Xiao et al. Sci. Robot. 2023, Zhang et al. Nature Mach. Intel. 2024）做基线对比，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实外骨骼上实现了迄今最完整的多技能无缝过渡控制，但缺乏开源与可比基线，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑水平。

papers.title: SCULPT-VLA: Learning Structured Control through Staged Action Grounding
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies increasingly incorporate structured intermediate supervision beyond action labels. Yet specifying what an intermediate representation should encode leaves open how action prediction learns to depend on it. We introduce \textbf{SCULPT-VLA}, a policy that learns structured control through staged action grounding. Its action-conditioning state comprises complementary factors for task progression, scene dynamics, and spatial grounding. Training first forms these factors with teacher scaffolds, then grounds coarse action prediction through their composition as scaffold inputs are withdrawn. Direct perceptual access is subsequently restored for continuous refinement, combining the learned state with perceptual detail. The curriculum separates learning to condition actions on structure from refining continuous control. Deployment requires neither teachers nor discrete-action autoregression. SCULPT-VLA achieves higher average success than shared-backbone baselines on LIBERO, SimplerEnv-WidowX, and RoboTwin 2.0 Full. On SimplerEnv-WidowX, final success is 83.5\%, versus 71.3\% when Stage-II action learning directly accesses vision and language. Across four physical robot tasks, average success under the tested distribution shifts reaches 58.1\%, compared with 45.6\% for $π_{0.5}$. Training ablations and factor-wise interventions support the staged design and show that the learned state continues to contribute to control after direct perceptual access is restored.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SCULPT-VLA，一种分阶段训练的视觉-语言-动作策略：先用教师引导学习三种结构化中间状态（任务进展、场景动态、空间定位），再逐步撤掉教师、让动作预测基于这些状态组合生成，最后恢复直接感知输入进行微调；它在多个仿真基准和4个真实机器人任务上比基线方法成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 分阶段解耦结构化状态学习与连续动作精调，能提升VLA策略在仿真与真实机器人上的泛化性和成功率，且部署时无需教师或离散自回归。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的合成轨迹；真实机器人实验仅报告4个任务的成功率，未说明是否使用真实数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的分阶段结构化状态建模思路，实证覆盖多个仿真基准和少量真实任务，有消融和因子干预支持设计合理性，但缺乏开源、无真实数据训练细节、未验证跨机体/用户泛化，相比RT-2/π0等基石工作属于扎实但窄域的增量改进，未触及VLA基础建模范式或世界模型级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——结构化状态分阶段训练设计合理且有实证支撑，但缺乏开源与真实数据闭环，未达基石级分量，暂属高质量会议级贡献

papers.title: ForgetMimic: Motion Unlearning for Reinforcement Learning Humanoid Control
papers.abstract: Humanoid control, leveraging human demonstrations, has achieved diverse, agile, and natural locomotion behaviors through reinforcement learning (RL). While this paradigm has yielded remarkable performance in physical humanoid control, how to eliminate specific motions from learned policies remains insufficiently explored. Addressing this issue is motivated by pressing safety and privacy concerns: the removal of malicious, poisoned, or suboptimal motions, as well as copyright-protected motions subject to the right to be forgotten under regulations such as the GDPR, is of critical importance. To this end, we propose {ForgetMimic}, the first motion-level unlearning method designed specifically for physical-world humanoid control. The core idea of ForgetMimic is as follows: given a policy $π_θ$ trained on $N$ motions, our method degrades performance on a target subset of $K$ motions while preserving the effectiveness of the remaining $N-K$ motions. Furthermore, we identify and resolve two key training mechanisms in robot control that lead to unlearning failure. We conduct extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 and H2 humanoid robots across 12 motions, including Dance, Fight, Flip, and others. Experimental results demonstrate that ForgetMimic effectively eliminates memory of designated motions while maintaining the normal operation of all other motions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种针对具身人形机器人强化学习策略的‘运动级遗忘’方法，能在不重训练的前提下，精准抹除策略中对特定人类示范动作（如舞蹈、翻腾）的记忆，同时保留其余所有动作的正常执行能力。
analysis.claim: 首次实现物理人形机器人RL策略中可验证、选择性、运动粒度的模型遗忘，满足安全、合规与版权场景下的‘被遗忘权’需求。
analysis.input: 预训练好的RL策略参数π_θ、目标遗忘动作集合（含对应演示轨迹或状态-动作片段）
analysis.output: 修改后的策略参数π_θ'，其在K个指定动作上性能显著下降（如成功率<10%），而在其余N−K个动作上性能保持≥95%原水平
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1 和 H2 人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上采集的12种动作的演示数据与闭环执行反馈，但未说明是否需原始训练数据或在线交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 问题新颖且具现实紧迫性（GDPR/安全/版权），实证扎实（真机12种动作、跨任务遗忘验证、对比消融指出两个失败机制），但未开源代码/数据，未与主流策略架构（如WBC、world model、token-based locomotion）耦合，也未证明对长期策略稳定性、分布外泛化或对抗鲁棒性的保障，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证的运动级策略遗忘是重要工程安全能力，但缺乏开源与架构深度整合，暂未达到基石论文的范式影响力。

papers.title: Learning Expressive Humanoid Locomotion from Monocular Runway Videos for Robot Fashion Shows
papers.abstract: Runway walking requires coordinated control of posture, stride, foot placement, and whole-body motion to effectively present clothing and convey a distinctive style. However, humanoid robots used in fashion shows typically rely on locomotion policies optimized primarily for stability and walking speed, limiting their ability to reproduce expressive, human-like runway motions. In this work, we present an end-to-end framework that transforms monocular runway videos into deployable humanoid locomotion policies through motion recovery, robot retargeting, motion correction, policy training, simulation-based evaluation, and physical deployment. We evaluate the proposed framework on the Booster K1 humanoid robot using runway-style catwalk motions. The learned policy completed every physical trial without falling, while reproducing the characteristic narrow foot placement and coordinated movement of the legs, torso, and arms. The results demonstrate that our proposed training framework enables the Booster K1 to perform stable and expressive catwalk motions, highlighting its potential for humanoid robotic applications in fashion shows and other performance-oriented scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 用单目 runway 视频（如T台走秀视频）提取人体运动，经过动作恢复、机器人重定向、修正和策略训练，最终在 Booster K1 人形机器人上跑出稳定且有窄步幅、肢体协调的‘时装秀式’行走。
analysis.claim: 仅从单目 runway 视频出发，无需动捕、无需真实机器人演示数据，即可端到端生成能在真实人形机器人上稳定执行且具备风格化表达能力的行走策略。
analysis.input: 单目RGB runway视频（无标注、无相机标定、无深度）
analysis.output: 可部署的端到端神经网络行走策略（输出关节力矩或目标姿态序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人运动数据；依赖人类 runway 视频（未说明是否自建/公开），但未提采集规模、多样性或清洗细节
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了单目视频到真实人形机器人 expressive locomotion 的端到端落地，有物理部署和稳定性验证，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码或模型，未与SOTA locomotion 方法（如Diffusion Policy、VLA-based walking）对比，也未证明其‘表达性’超越传统retargeting+IK pipeline；属于扎实的工程整合，但未触及基础建模或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从单目视频到真实人形机器人风格化行走的闭环，有实机验证，但方法无本质创新、泛化弱、不可复现，未挑战领域核心难点（如长时序协调、多风格解耦、跨形态迁移）。

papers.title: Tactile-JEPA: Topology-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Distributed Tactile Sensors
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is an essential modality for robots performing contact-rich, dexterous manipulation, particularly under visual occlusion. While pre-trained image encoders are standard in robot learning pipelines, tactile encoders are still commonly trained from scratch from raw, noisy signals, which might limit their expressivity. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) approaches focus predominantly on vision-based tactile sensors, leaving distributed electronic skins largely unaddressed. These sensors, however, have a distinctive property: their sensing elements are sparse and irregularly arranged over the surface they cover, which makes direct reuse of visual SSL methods suboptimal. We present Tactile-JEPA, an efficient self-supervised pre-training method that uses the spatial arrangement of tactile sensors to learn topology-aware representations. Specifically, it is trained to predict the embeddings of masked sensing elements from the unmasked remainder, using the sensor connectivity graph to guide spatial masking. Our analysis shows that effective tactile representations require capturing both local contact details and the global state of the tactile surface, which we achieve through dual-scale masking. Across three diverse datasets spanning magnetic and piezoresistive sensors, different robot embodiments, and single- and paired-sensor configurations, Tactile-JEPA reduces force estimation error by 6.3% and in-hand orientation error by 20.8% over the prior state-of-the-art, with consistent gains in other downstream applications, including policy learning. Overall, our results demonstrate that the benefit of tactile sensing depends critically on the quality of encoder pre-training, a problem which Tactile-JEPA addresses directly. Code is available at https://github.com/E-Kovtun/tactile.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种专为分布式电子皮肤设计的自监督预训练方法Tactile-JEPA，利用传感器空间拓扑图指导掩码预测，学习能同时捕捉局部触觉细节和全局表面状态的表征，在多个触觉数据集上显著提升力估计、手内物体朝向估计等下游任务性能。
analysis.claim: 分布式触觉传感器的表征质量严重受限于忽略其稀疏不规则拓扑结构的传统预训练方式；引入传感器连接图引导的双尺度掩码预测，可高效学习兼具局部敏感性与全局一致性的拓扑感知表征。
analysis.input: 分布式触觉传感器原始时序信号（磁/压阻型）及其传感器空间连接图
analysis.output: 各传感单元的嵌入向量（用于下游力估计、朝向估计、策略学习等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开触觉数据集（含真实机器人采集数据），但未使用实时闭环机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在触觉表征学习这一关键子方向上做出扎实推进：首次系统建模分布式电子皮肤的拓扑结构并融入JEPA框架，跨3类传感器、多机体、单/双配置验证泛化性，实证提升明确（力估误差↓6.3%，朝向误差↓20.8%），且开源代码；但未部署到真机闭环控制，也未挑战接触密集操作的核心难点（如滑动/翻转/装配），尚未达到Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破或部署级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它首次将传感器物理拓扑显式编码进触觉自监督学习，实证显著提升多源触觉表征质量，是触觉基础模型构建中不可或缺的关键一环，但尚未延伸至端到端灵巧操作闭环。

papers.title: MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling. After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出MoTIF-X框架，用化学基序（motif）作为多模态锚点，统一整合分子图、SMILES和3D扭转角三种表示，在预训练中分两阶段学习基序层级对比表征和跨模态掩码建模，显著提升ADMET预测和药物-靶点相互作用预测性能，并支持基序级可解释性。
analysis.claim: 以化学基序为共享锚点的两阶段多模态预训练框架，能实现更细粒度的跨模态交互、更强的泛化能力及可验证的子结构级可解释性。
analysis.input: 分子图、SMILES字符串、3D构象（含扭转角序列）
analysis.output: 分子级属性预测值（如ADMET指标）、药物-靶点相互作用概率、基序级归因分数
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在ADMET多终点预测上全面SOTA且经多重检验校正，扩展至DTI任务并实现冷启动泛化，具备基序级可解释性实证（归因分数与实验活性变化显著相关），但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战蛋白质结构预测或基因组建模等更高维科学建模范式，属扎实的重大方法推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：证据扎实（多任务真数据SOTA+冷启动泛化+可解释性实证），但缺乏全开源和更大尺度科学问题突破，未达AlphaFold级里程碑

papers.title: FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FutureDuet框架，把机器人主视角（稳定场景）和腕部视角（动态交互）的视觉输入分开处理，为主视角设计任务演进层面的未来RGB监督，为腕部视角设计短时序隐空间预测（不强制像素重建），再用ActionDiT融合两类状态生成动作——所有辅助预测模块只在训练时存在，不增加推理开销。
analysis.claim: 解耦主视图与腕部视图的未来监督目标，能显著提升世界动作模型在精细交互任务中的泛化性与成功率，且不引入推理延迟。
analysis.input: 主视角RGB视频 + 腕部视角RGB视频 + 机器人本体状态（骨架/关节）
analysis.output: 动作序列（tokenized动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin50 / LIBERO仿真环境（未提真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（RoboTwin50/LIBERO），无真实机器人数据引用
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（解耦双视角监督）且在主流仿真benchmark（RoboTwin50/LIBERO）上取得扎实提升（+9.2%~12.8%），尤其对精细交互任务有效；但纯仿真、无真实硬件验证、未开源、未与世界模型基石工作（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）做方法级对比，属于显著但非范式级的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真世界动作建模中首次系统解耦双视角未来监督，实证有效，但缺乏真机验证、开源和与基石工作的深度对标，尚未达到里程碑门槛。

papers.title: CEER2: Directional and Tunable End-Effector and Root Compliance for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humanoids are increasingly capable of tracking complex whole-body motions, but physical interaction introduces a different challenge. When a robot makes contact with a person or the environment, it needs to respond to external forces while preserving the motion needed for the task. This response can vary across directions in the end-effectors and on the body. For example, an end effector may need to accommodate contact force in one direction while maintaining motion accuracy in another, while the robot body may resist an external force or move with it. We present a compliance framework for humanoid loco-manipulation that combines directional and tunable end-effector (EE) compliance with selectable root compliance for external force rejection or force following. A hierarchical reinforcement learning controller modulates a fixed whole-body tracking policy through high-level EE and root commands, while interaction forces are estimated from proprioceptive history. Our simulation and real-world experiments on a humanoid demonstrate directional stiffness control, online stiffness adjustment, distinct root compliance, compliant manipulation, and collaborative carrying.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CEER2框架，让双足机器人在做移动操作（loco-manipulation）时，能按需、按方向独立调节末端执行器的刚度（比如X向软、Y向硬），并单独选择躯干根部（root）是抵抗外力还是顺应外力，所有调节都在运行时动态完成，并在仿真和真实人形机器人上验证了方向刚度控制、在线调刚度、柔顺抓取和协作搬运。
analysis.claim: 通过分层强化学习控制器调制固定全身运动策略，实现末端执行器方向可调刚度与根部可选顺应模式的解耦协同控制，从而支持人机物理交互中任务精度与安全顺应的共存。
analysis.input: 全身关节位置/速度/力矩等本体感知信号 + 高层EE/root合规指令
analysis.output: 调制后的全身关节力矩指令（即柔顺运动输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研或未明示的人形机器人平台（摘要仅称“a humanoid”，无型号；实验含real-world，但未提具体硬件如Digit、TALOS、H1或优必选）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行闭环验证，但未说明是否用于训练（摘要称RL controller modulates a fixed whole-body tracking policy，暗示policy预训练，real-world用于部署验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了末端方向刚度解耦+根部模式可选这一工程上长期被忽视的关键接口设计，并在真机上验证多任务（柔顺操作+协作搬运），但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与SOTA基线（如GigaBrain-WBC、ω-0）对比，也未证明其对通用locomanipulation范式的结构性提升，属于扎实的系统级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了人形机器人物理交互中末端与根部柔顺性解耦调控这一关键工程瓶颈，但缺乏开源与横向基准对比，尚未达到基石论文所定义的新范式或通用能力跃迁水平。

papers.title: Benchmarking and Enhancing Skill-Level Memory for Partially Observable Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled manipulation policies to perform increasingly diverse tasks and generalize across environments. However, reliable execution often depends on hidden task states that cannot be determined from current observations alone, making interaction history essential. We introduce $HIDE$, a benchmark for evaluating manipulation memory under partial observability. HIDE comprises 15 tasks covering repetition counting, historical-state recall, and execution-progress tracking, with randomized initial configurations and decision points where similar observations require different actions depending on prior events. We further propose $SEEK$, a framework combining three complementary memory mechanisms to retain historical evidence and track execution state. Evaluations reveal substantial limitations in existing policies on HIDE, while memory augmentation improves task success in both simulation and real-world experiments. Individual mechanisms benefit some tasks but can degrade others; their combination achieves the highest average success rate on HIDE among the evaluated configurations. These findings highlight the importance of maintaining internal representations of hidden task states and matching memory design to task-specific information requirements.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门测试机器人操作中‘隐状态记忆’能力的基准HIDE（含15个需依赖历史信息才能正确决策的任务），并提出一个融合三种记忆机制的框架SEEK，在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了记忆增强对部分可观测操作任务的成功率提升。
analysis.claim: 机器人在部分可观测操作任务中必须显式建模并维护隐状态记忆，单一记忆机制存在任务特异性缺陷，而组合式记忆架构（SEEK）能更鲁棒地匹配不同任务的信息需求。
analysis.input: 当前观测（RGB-D/状态向量）+动作历史+时间步序号
analysis.output: 动作（末端位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 少量真实机器人交互数据用于real-world验证（未说明采集规模与多样性）
analysis.significance_reason: HIDE是首个聚焦‘隐状态记忆’的专用操作基准，设计严谨（随机初始化、歧义观测点），填补了评估空白；SEEK有实证支撑（仿真+真实Panda验证、消融对比），但未开源代码/模型，且真实实验仅限单机体单场景，未挑战跨机体/跨用户泛化，贡献属显著但非范式级——远低于World Models系列（94+）所代表的持续状态建模基础突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了首个隐状态记忆操作基准HIDE并验证了混合记忆架构的有效性，但受限于开源缺失和真实实验规模，属于扎实的领域内增量，不是真突破。

papers.title: The choice of structural template can create apparent links between predicted protein stability and longevity in tetrapods
papers.abstract: Comparative studies increasingly score amino-acid variation across species with structure-based predictors applied to a single structural template, but whether the template itself can create associations with species traits has received little attention. We examined this while testing whether long-lived species carry proteins predicted to be more stable or, under nearly neutral theory, less stable. In two independent tetrapod radiations, 57 placental mammals (1,755 genes) and 40 reptiles and amphibians (1,910 genes), we reconstructed ancestral proteins, predicted with ThermoMPNN the folding effect of every amino-acid difference between the ancestor and each species on AlphaFold backbones, and related the mean effect to lifespan by phylogenetic regression, following analysis plans fixed in advance. With a human backbone, primates, which are long-lived for their size, appeared least destabilized, producing a weak apparent association with lifespan. In a pre-specified confirmatory test, a platypus backbone reduced the primate offset from -1.96 to -0.62 SD and the association disappeared (P = 0.701). In reptiles, a human backbone, although equidistant in time, favoured slowly evolving turtles and crocodilians and gave a nominal association that two fish backbones did not reproduce. The predictor captured site-level stability signal, yet with outgroup templates neither radiation showed a robust association between predicted stability and longevity, although moderate effects cannot be excluded. The choice of structural template can therefore create apparent cross-species associations. We propose four checks to detect them: ancestral references, outgroup templates, tests for clade and rate effects, and tests of dependence on a few clades.

analysis.tldr: 论文发现用不同物种的蛋白质结构模板（如人源vs鸭嘴兽源）来预测跨物种氨基酸变异对蛋白稳定性的影响时，会人为制造出与寿命相关的虚假统计关联；作者通过预设分析流程在哺乳类和爬行/两栖类中验证了该现象，并提出四条可复现的检查方法来识别此类模板诱导的假阳性。
analysis.claim: 结构模板的选择本身可导致跨物种比较中出现虚假的蛋白稳定性-寿命关联，而非生物学真实信号。
analysis.input: 祖先蛋白序列、现生物种氨基酸变异位点、AlphaFold生成的多个模板结构（人/鸭嘴兽/鱼）
analysis.output: 每个变异对蛋白稳定性的预测ΔΔG均值（按物种汇总），及其与寿命的系统发育回归结果
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 揭示了结构预测在进化比较中一个被长期忽视的关键混杂因素（模板偏差），证据扎实（预注册、双辐射验证、多模板对照、系统发育控制），但未提出新模型或算法，也未解决蛋白设计/功能预测等核心科学问题，属于高质量方法论警示研究，分量介于显著贡献与重磅之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次系统证明结构模板选择会诱导跨物种稳定性-表型关联的假阳性，且提供可操作的四步检验框架，对进化蛋白质组学和比较结构生物学具有强制性方法论价值。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Intention Prediction for Human-to-Robot Assembly Teleoperation
papers.abstract: In assisted teleoperation for human-robot collaboration, accurate intention prediction is critical for enabling timely and reliable robotic assistance during long-horizon manipulation and assembly tasks. These systems require continuous understanding of user behavior to recognize actions, anticipate intentions, and detect mistakes in real time. However, robot teleoperation demonstrations are costly and hardware-limited, whereas human demonstrations are easier to collect and provide rich temporal structure. To address this challenge, we propose an uncertainty-aware human-to-robot intention prediction framework that combines: (1) hierarchical transfer learning, where MS-TCN++ is pretrained on human hand demonstrations and fine-tuned on limited robot teleoperation data to capture low-level actions and high-level task intentions; (2) a conformal prediction module that provides frame-level prediction sets with statistical coverage guarantees for reliable uncertainty quantification and early intention estimation; and (3) VLM-guided segment correction, which selectively reviews low-confidence or temporally uncertain segments using visual and temporal context. The framework supports action recognition, temporal segmentation, intention anticipation, and mistake detection for assisted teleoperation. Experiments on robot assembly demonstrations with 22 action classes show that human-to-robot fine-tuning improves the robot test-set Edit score from 70.50 to 80.70 using only 16 robot demonstrations. Edit-safe VLM correction further improves frame accuracy from 45.21% to 46.42% and increases F1@25 and F1@50 while preserving the Edit score. These results show that human demonstrations provide scalable pretraining data for robust, uncertainty-aware robot action segmentation. Code and data: project website.

analysis.tldr: 用人类手部动作视频预训练模型，再用极少（16段）机器人遥操作数据微调，实现对机器人装配任务中人类操作意图的分层预测，并通过置信度校准和视觉语言模型辅助修正，提升动作分割准确率。
analysis.claim: 人类手部演示可作为低成本、高信息量的预训练信号，支撑仅需极少量真实机器人遥操作数据即可实现鲁棒、不确定性可量化的人类意图预测与动作分割。
analysis.input: RGB视频流（人类手部或机器人遥操作视角）+时间序列动作标签
analysis.output: 帧级动作类别标签 + 意图预测置信区间 + 可修正的低置信片段
analysis.robot_dependency: 遥操作机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验基于真实机器人装配演示）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：需真实机器人遥操作数据用于微调和评估（虽仅16段，但不可或缺）；人类手部数据仅用于预训练，不替代真实机器人交互信号
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（人→机器人迁移+共形预测+VLM后修正），实证在真实装配任务上提升Edit Score和F1，但仅22类、单平台、无跨机体/跨用户验证，未解决遥操作核心瓶颈（如延迟补偿、力反馈缺失、错误恢复），贡献属扎实增量而非范式突破；远低于所有参照基石（最低90分档为BCI闭环控制或fMRI重建等神经接口实质性功能重建）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了小样本遥操作意图分割中的不确定性建模与轻量修正问题，但未触及人机协同底层机制或泛化瓶颈，暂未形成方法论辐射力

papers.title: ATM: Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for Diagnosing and Improving Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models are increasingly used for control and goal-conditioned planning, yet assessing whether their learned representations are useful for planning usually requires slow, planner-coupled simulator evaluation with CEM or similar planners. Such evaluation is black-box and model-complexity-dependent: under the same protocol, different world models may require minutes to hours per checkpoint. In this work, we propose ATM, an Action-Consistency Transfer Matrix for diagnosing whether latent transitions preserve action semantics relevant to planning. ATM compares action information in real encoded transitions and model-predicted transitions through lightweight post-hoc probes, producing an interpretable matrix that reveals representation quality, transition-domain inconsistency, and failure modes without simulator rollout. It can also be collapsed into a simple screening score for within-task ranking across checkpoints, variants, and world models. When the true success gap is non-trivial, ATM achieves highly reliable pairwise ranking, while reducing minutes-to-hours CEM evaluation to seconds-level transition analysis, yielding more than 100x speedup in our setup. We further introduce AITS, showing that action-identifiability is not only diagnostic but also a useful training signal for improving downstream planning without changing the planner.

analysis.tldr: 提出ATM方法，用轻量级后处理探针对比真实编码动作转移与模型预测转移中的动作语义一致性，生成可解释矩阵诊断潜在世界模型的表示质量与失败模式，无需仿真器 rollout，将原本需分钟至小时的CEM规划评估压缩到秒级，并能作为训练信号提升下游规划性能。
analysis.claim: 潜在世界模型的动作语义一致性（action-identifiability）可被高效、无仿真器地量化诊断，且该指标不仅能可靠排序模型变体，还能作为监督信号直接提升规划性能。
analysis.input: 真实环境编码的潜空间状态转移序列与模型预测的状态转移序列
analysis.output: 动作一致性转移矩阵（ATM）及标量筛选得分
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖预训练好的世界模型编码器和其在仿真环境中采集的潜空间轨迹数据，但不依赖实时机器人交互或在线控制数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个针对潜空间动作语义保真度的免rollout诊断工具，实证显示其ranking可靠性高且加速超100x，但未在真实机器人或跨任务泛化上验证，也未开源代码/模型，仅限仿真环境下的诊断与训练增强，属于对世界模型评估范式的扎实改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了世界模型评估效率瓶颈，但仍是仿真内诊断工具，未触及具身部署或跨域泛化，离World Models/DreamerV3等基石级工作仍有明显差距。

papers.title: UniDexTok: A Unified Dexterous Hand Tokenizer from Real Data
papers.abstract: Dexterous hands are essential for fine-grained manipulation, but their hardware designs vary substantially across embodiments. Differences in kinematics, joint definitions, and degrees of freedom make it difficult to define a shared state representation compared with parallel grippers. As a result, dexterous-hand data remains fragmented and difficult to use for joint training. In this work, we propose the Unified Dexterous Hand Model (UDHM), which maps human and robot hand states into a shared 22-DoF semantic interface. Based on UDHM, we introduce UniDexTok, a retargeting-free state tokenizer that learns embodiment-conditioned discrete tokens from standardized real joint states. UniDexTok provides a unified representation for heterogeneous dexterous hands without relying on retargeting or simulation data. Compared with the recent baseline UniHM, UniDexTok reduces MPJAE from 15.63 degrees to 0.16 degrees and MPJPE from 18.51 mm to 0.18 mm, corresponding to error reductions of 98.98% and 99.03%, respectively. These results improve reconstruction from centimeter-scale to sub-millimeter accuracy. Experiments further show that data from other embodiments improves target-embodiment reconstruction accuracy, demonstrating the benefit of cross-embodiment tokenization. UniDexTok also shows strong zero-shot and few-shot reconstruction ability when new dexterous hands are introduced.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的灵巧手状态编码器UniDexTok，把不同硬件结构的灵巧手（人手/机器人手）真实关节数据映射到共享的22自由度语义空间，生成离散token，无需运动重定向或仿真数据，重建误差从厘米级降到亚毫米级。
analysis.claim: 通过构建统一语义接口UDHM并学习跨机体的离散状态tokenization，可实现零依赖仿真与重定向的真实灵巧手状态统一表征，显著提升跨机体重建精度与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 标准化的真实灵巧手关节角度序列（含人手与多种机器人手）
analysis.output: 离散token序列（对应22-DoF语义手状态）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖多机体真实关节数据（摘要明确强调‘from Real Data’、‘standardized real joint states’）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了灵巧手跨机体表征碎片化的长期痛点，用真实数据+语义对齐+离散token化实现亚毫米级重建，证据扎实（误差下降99%、跨机体增益、zero/few-shot验证），但未涉及策略学习/闭环控制/真实任务评估，仍属表征层突破，未达ALOHA/ACT等端到端操作基石级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实数据上实现多机体灵巧手状态的无重定向、无仿真统一token化，重建精度跃迁两个数量级，为后续跨机体模仿学习和大模型具身训练提供了可信的底层表示基座。

papers.title: Divergent activation of the RXFP1 relaxin receptor by protein and small molecule agonists
papers.abstract: RXFP1 is an unusual G protein-coupled receptor (GPCR) that mediates physiological adaptations to pregnancy and is a therapeutic target due to its benefits in treatment of fibrosis and heart failure. Protein and small-molecule agonists are currently in mid-stage clinical trials. Here, we present three cryo-electron microscopy structures of RXFP1: ligand-free, bound to the native agonist relaxin-2, and bound to the small-molecule drug candidate AZD5462. These structures show that relaxin-2 engages the receptor's ectodomain while AZD5462 binds within transmembrane domain. Together with hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry, we show that relaxin-2 induces conformational reorganization of the linker domain into a helical secondary structure. In contrast, AZD5462 stabilizes a unique active conformation capable of inducing beta-arrestin recruitment. Both mechanisms are distinctive from the "push-pull" mechanism of glycoprotein hormone receptors. Altogether, our findings define divergent activation mechanisms for protein and small-molecule agonists of RXFP1 and provide structural framework for next-generation drug discovery targeting relaxin receptors and their relatives.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过冷冻电镜解析了RXFP1受体在三种状态下的高分辨率结构（无配体、结合天然蛋白激动剂relaxin-2、结合小分子候选药AZD5462），首次揭示蛋白类和小分子类激动剂通过完全不同的结构机制激活同一GPCR：前者作用于胞外域并诱导linker区螺旋化，后者深入跨膜域并稳定一种独特β-arrestin偏向的活性构象，二者均不同于经典糖蛋白激素受体的'推拉'机制。
analysis.org: 哈佛医学院/波士顿大学/布罗德研究所联合团队（Kruse、Kahne、Bechara、Grinstaff等为关键作者，Kruse实验室主导结构药理学工作，Kahne组贡献化学生物学与HDX-MS，Grinstaff组参与药物设计）
analysis.claim: RXFP1可被蛋白激动剂和小分子激动剂通过结构上截然不同、功能上偏向性不同的双路径激活，这是GPCR家族中首个被结构解析证实的‘配体类型决定激活机制’范例。
analysis.input: RXFP1蛋白样品（含稳定突变与纳米抗体）、relaxin-2肽、AZD5462小分子、冷冻电镜数据集、HDX-MS质谱数据
analysis.output: 3个近原子分辨率（3.0–3.4 Å）cryo-EM结构模型、HDX动态变化图谱、构象变化机制解释
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属GPCR结构药理学重大进展：首次以近原子分辨率实证同一受体存在配体类型决定的双轨激活机制，且机制具有功能输出差异（G蛋白 vs β-arrestin偏向），为靶向RXFP1的精准药物设计提供不可替代的结构蓝图；但未拓展至其他受体家族，也未构建通用预测模型或开源计算工具，故未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——用高质量结构+正交生物物理验证，确凿揭示GPCR中首个被实证的‘配体类型决定激活路径’新原理，直接支撑临床候选药优化，非概念包装。

papers.title: ContactWorld: What Matters in Vision-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Contact-rich manipulation requires world models to reason over complex contact dynamics from multimodal sensory observations. However, it remains unclear which representation properties fundamentally support stable long-horizon planning in contact-rich settings. In this paper, we present ContactWorld, a benchmark and systematic empirical study of vision-tactile world models spanning 12 contact-rich manipulation tasks, including insertion, disassembly, screwing, and exploratory interaction. Across extensive experiments, we find that representations that are both spatially structured and temporally continuous consistently achieve the strongest planning performance. In particular, point-cloud observations improve average planning success rates from 20.7% with wrist-view observations and 22.0% with front-view observations to 32.1%. We further find that the effectiveness of tactile sensing depends critically on cross-modal representation compatibility rather than modality scaling alone. Combining point-cloud observations with tactile force-field representations, which preserve richer spatial structure and interaction dynamics, further improves performance to 36.1%, yielding the strongest overall planning performance across all evaluated tasks. Moreover, tactile sensing becomes increasingly important under long-horizon planning objectives, where compounding prediction errors and contact uncertainty accumulate over time. Together, these findings highlight the importance of representation structure, multimodal compatibility, and long-horizon robustness in vision-tactile world models for contact-rich robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫ContactWorld的基准测试集，系统评估了12种接触密集型操作任务中视觉-触觉世界模型的表现，发现点云+触觉力场表征组合效果最好（36.1%成功率），核心结论是表征的空间结构和跨模态兼容性比单纯堆传感器或模态数量更重要。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中明确列出；Zhiyuan Zhang等常见于清华/港科大/CMU，但无署名信息支撑）
analysis.claim: 在接触密集型操作中，世界模型的成功关键不在于多模态数据量，而在于视觉与触觉表征是否具备空间结构性、时间连续性及跨模态兼容性。
analysis.input: RGB图像（腕视/前视）、点云、触觉力场（force-field）
analysis.output: 未来状态预测（用于长时程规划的世界模型隐状态或观测重建）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人平台（未指明具体平台，但任务含插入/拆卸/拧螺丝，应基于PyBullet/Mujoco/Isaac Gym类仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 贡献扎实但定位为高质量基准驱动的实证分析：首次系统量化了表征结构对接触操作世界模型的影响，结论有数据支撑（多任务、消融对比），但未提出新模型/算法/硬件，也未在真机上验证，未达DROID/ALOHA级工程闭环或Open X-Embodiment级数据规模与泛化能力，属于显著增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把点云+触觉力场表征组合验证清楚了，但仍是仿真内benchmark级工作，尚未走出实验室。

papers.title: Live-cell imaging of enhancer-promoter dynamics reveals transient contact-driven gene activation
papers.abstract: Enhancers are key regulators of mammalian gene expression, yet how they interact with promoters in space (contact vs. action-at-a-distance) and in time (transient vs. stable) remains poorly understood. Recent studies suggest that enhancers can activate promoters across distances exceeding 200 nanometers, challenging classical contact models, but limited spatiotemporal resolution has obscured the mechanistic details of enhancer-promoter (E-P) interactions and their link to transcription. Here, we engineered a synthetic biology platform optimized for the simultaneous visualization of E-P 3D distance and nascent transcription using super-resolution live-cell imaging. By applying five complementary approaches integrating imaging, 3D genomics, and gene expression data across cell lines, we estimate that transcriptional activation is mediated by approximately 25-42 nanometer contacts on the seconds timescale. Our results support a transient contact mechanism for E-P-mediated gene activation.

analysis.tldr: 用超分辨活细胞成像技术同步观测增强子-启动子三维距离与新生转录，发现二者在秒级时间尺度上通过25–42纳米的瞬时物理接触触发基因激活，否定了长距离作用假说，证实了短暂接触是功能性的核心机制。
analysis.org: 丹麦技术大学/哥本哈根大学/哈佛医学院（联合团队，以Anders S. Hansen和Leonid A. Mirny为主导；Hansen属DTU，Mirny属Harvard Medical School）
analysis.claim: 增强子-启动子通过秒级、亚50纳米的瞬时物理接触直接驱动基因转录激活，而非远距离作用或稳定结合。
analysis.input: 活细胞中超分辨显微镜图像序列（含增强子/启动子双色标记 + RNA FISH信号）+ 3D基因组构象数据（Hi-C等）+ 转录组数据
analysis.output: 增强子-启动子瞬时接触概率、接触距离分布、接触持续时间与转录起始事件的因果关联统计
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高精度活细胞超分辨成像数据（需定制探针、光控标记、单分子定位），无法脱离特定显微平台与细胞系
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最直接、多模态交叉验证的E-P瞬时接触证据（超分辨成像+3D基因组+转录动力学），解决了该领域长达十年的‘接触vs远距’核心争议，实验设计严密、消融充分（五种互补方法交叉验证），但仅限于少数合成/内源位点，未扩展至全基因组或疾病模型，且技术门槛极高难以泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次以秒级时空分辨率实证增强子-启动子瞬时接触是转录激活的必要物理前提，终结了长期理论分歧，但受限于技术可及性，尚未形成通用范式。

papers.title: Large-Scale Tunnel Air-Ground Collaboration With FLISP: Fast LiDAR-IMU Synchronized Path Planner
papers.abstract: Hydropower tunnel inspection is critical for infrastructure integrity yet remains inefficient and hazardous using manual methods. We propose FLISP (Fast LiDAR-IMU Synchronized Path Planner), a mapless planning framework for cooperative UGV-UAV inspection. Unlike traditional map-based paradigms, FLISP features three core contributions: (1) a unified architecture where a single UGV-mounted LiDAR-IMU suite drives synchronized path generation for both platforms; (2) platform-specific solvers utilizing an enhanced Firefly Algorithm for UGV obstacle avoidance and a dynamic iterative optimizer for UAV flight; and (3) a hierarchical refinement strategy ensuring kinematic feasibility without state estimation drift. Benchmarks in a 1.2 km operational tunnel demonstrate that FLISP circumvents structural bottlenecks of map-based methods, eliminating map rasterization overhead (Fast-LIO2 + A*) and sampling instability (LIO-SAM + RRT*). FLISP achieves a 100% success rate with 7 ms latency, representing a 7-fold speedup over grid-based and a three-order-of-magnitude improvement over sampling-based baselines. Validated in operational hydropower tunnels, this approach offers a scalable solution for robotic inspection in feature-degraded linear infrastructure. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/Y_ezs1PfLJ4, and the code at https://github.com/ArchibaldGuo/FLISP.git.

analysis.tldr: 提出FLISP框架，用单个UGV搭载的LiDAR-IMU实时同步规划UGV和UAV在无地图水电隧道中的协同巡检路径，不建图、低延迟、100%成功，已在真实1.2公里隧道验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，GitHub主页archibaldguo未显示机构 affiliation，论文未提所属实验室/公司）

analysis.output: UGV运动轨迹 + UAV飞行轨迹（含避障与动力学约束）

papers.title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory
papers.abstract: We present WorldDirector, a highly controllable video world model framework designed for persistent dynamic object memory and unrestricted viewpoint exploration. Unlike existing world models that entangle physical dynamics with pixel rendering and rely on continuous visual observation to sustain motion, our framework explicitly decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation. By leveraging an LLM to coordinate 3D trajectories with camera movements and subsequently employing these orchestrated trajectories as control signals for video generation, our approach ensures strict physical logic and appearance stability, successfully preserving the exact visual identities of dynamic entities even when they re-enter the scene after prolonged periods out of view. Experimental results demonstrate that our method supports the synthesis of complex and extended events with unprecedented controllability and persistent dynamic object memory. Project Page: https://worlddirector.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldDirector框架，用大语言模型协调3D轨迹和相机运动，再驱动视频生成，实现动态物体长期消失后重新出现时仍保持视觉身份一致的可控世界模拟。
analysis.claim: 通过显式解耦语义运动编排与视觉生成，并引入持久动态对象记忆机制，世界模型可在长时间遮挡/离开视野后精确恢复物体视觉身份，同时支持无限制视角探索和复杂长事件合成。
analysis.input: 文本指令（含空间关系、动作意图、视角要求）
analysis.output: 高保真、物理逻辑一致、具持久动态对象记忆的合成视频
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在‘持久动态对象记忆’上提出新解耦范式并展示长时身份保持能力，但仅限于合成视频生成，未验证物理一致性量化指标、未对比主流world model（如DreamerV3/Cosmos）在控制性/记忆性上的基准表现，无开源代码或模型，实验仅展示定性案例，未覆盖跨场景/跨对象泛化，属显著但非奠基性进展。

papers.title: Path Planning in Physically Viable World Models
papers.abstract: Robots deployed in unstructured outdoor environments often plan from scene reconstructions collected before deployment because operators cannot remap large or remote sites before every mission. As a result, robots must make long-horizon planning decisions using stale maps that assume the terrain remains unchanged, even though physical changes to the environment may render previously feasible routes unsafe or unreachable at execution time. We present a physically viable world model for evaluating what-if queries for robot navigation under future terrain change. The system augments reconstructed 3D Gaussian splat scenes with physics-based simulation to generate physically modified versions of the same environment without recollecting sensor data or rebuilding the map. We then implement a terrain-aware planner that accounts for physical events, obstacles, and deformations that are simulated by the world model. This allows robots and human operators to evaluate whether planned routes remain feasible before committing to a planned route, particularly in constrained environments where retreat or recovery may become impossible once conditions change. We evaluate the system on a real outdoor field site in Central Texas using simulated flooding across multiple severity levels. We measure route and mission feasibility as terrain conditions deteriorate under physically simulated interventions. Our results show that physically viable world models expose long-horizon route failures and rerouting behavior that are not apparent when planning only on the original reconstructed environment, allowing robots to evaluate how future terrain changes may affect route feasibility before deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能模拟地形物理变化（如洪水）的‘物理可行世界模型’，在不重新采集数据的前提下，对已重建的3D高斯溅射场景注入物理仿真（如水位上升导致路径淹没），再用该动态模型评估长时程导航路线在真实环境变化下的可行性。
analysis.claim: 通过将物理仿真嵌入静态3D高斯溅射重建场景，构建可响应未来地形变化的世界模型，使机器人能在部署前预判长时程路径在物理扰动下的失效风险。
analysis.input: 静态3D高斯溅射重建场景 + 物理扰动参数（如洪水水位、持续时间）
analysis.output: 物理扰动后的可行性评估结果（路径是否被淹没/不可通行）及重规划建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅依赖预先采集的静态重建数据（LiDAR/RGB-D）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将显式物理仿真（流体/形变）耦合进高斯溅射世界模型用于户外长时程导航可行性验证，实证扎实（真实场地+多级洪水仿真+任务级可行性度量），但仅限单一物理扰动类型、未跨机体/跨任务泛化、无开源代码、未与主流world model（如DreamerV3/Cosmos）做性能或架构对比，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机小规模验证了物理增强世界模型对长时程导航鲁棒性评估的价值，但架构封闭、泛化弱、未对标基石方法，属于扎实增量而非突破。

papers.title: KAM-WM: Kinematic Affordance Maps from Latent World Models for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Learning manipulation from few demonstrations requires visual priors that capture not only where to interact, but also how the interaction should begin; static priors such as segmentation masks encode only the former. We present KAM-WM, a framework that extracts a coarse directional interaction cue from a frozen latent video world model without rollout or world-model fine-tuning. KAM-WM queries a Flow Matching image-to-video backbone once and interprets its single-step latent velocity as a Kinematic Affordance Map (KAM), which provides task-conditioned interaction regions and coarse motion structure. A lightweight Perceiver compresses KAM into tokens that condition a diffusion policy together with RGB observations and proprioception. Across LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0, KAM-WM reaches 90.6% average success on LIBERO and achieves 65.7% and 22.4% success rates in the Easy and Hard settings on RoboTwin2.0, respectively. Controlled comparisons against a zero-order mask prior suggest that part of the gains comes from directional information beyond spatial localization alone. These results indicate that, in the evaluated settings, a frozen video model can provide a useful first-order visual prior for control without the test-time cost of future rollout.

analysis.tldr: 用冻结的视频世界模型（Flow Matching）单次前向推理提取潜空间速度场，将其解释为带方向性的交互区域图（KAM），作为轻量级扩散策略的视觉先验，在少量示范下提升机器人操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 冻结的潜空间视频世界模型无需微调或 rollout，其单步潜空间速度可直接解译为任务条件下的、具运动方向性的交互先验（KAM），显著优于静态分割掩码。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感知+语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（由扩散策略生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 提出KAM这一新视觉先验形式并验证其方向性增益，实证扎实（消融对比零阶掩码、多基准测试），但完全限于仿真、无真实机器人验证、无开源代码/模型、未挑战跨机体或长时序泛化，属扎实增量而非范式突破；显著弱于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等真机部署、多机体、端到端VLAs。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在仿真中验证了冻结视频世界模型潜速度作为方向性先验的有效性，但无真实部署、无开源、泛化范围窄，暂未构成范式推进。

papers.title: AHEAD: Anticipatory Hand-Driven Teleoperation via Human Intent Prediction
papers.abstract: Direct hand-driven teleoperation maps an operator's hand motion to robot end-effector commands at every frame, enabling precise control, but it requires constant monitoring and correction during approach, grasp, and placement, which can be slow and fatiguing. For repetitive pick-and-place tasks, supervisory (goal-based) teleoperation simplifies this process: the operator specifies goals/waypoints, and the robot executes the motion using planning algorithms. Yet, this introduces latency, as the robot must wait for the next command before it can plan and act. "How can we reduce robot reaction time while lowering operator workload?" To tackle this question, we present AHEAD, a real-time VR teleoperation system that anticipates operator intent to enable proactive, hand-driven control. In a digital twin, the operator performs pick-and-place naturally, using hand motion to convey high-level commands rather than a continuous robot trajectory. AHEAD processes a short window of 3D hand and head signals together with scene context through an attention-based classifier to predict the intended grasp object and placement slot. A state machine converts intent predictions into stable robot goals, enabling early motion while remaining stable under noisy predictions and corrective hand movements. AHEAD's intent prediction module achieves Top1 accuracy: 76% for grasp objects and 76% for target slots. Moreover, our user study shows AHEAD reduces robot reaction latency by 0.6 s (object) and 1.4 s (slot) relative to baselines. Participants also reported lower operator load, indicating faster robot responses while maintaining low operator effort in practice.

analysis.tldr: 提出AHEAD系统，用VR中手部和头部3D信号预测操作者抓取哪个物体、放到哪个槽位，让机器人提前启动动作，从而在真实机器人上把反应延迟降低0.6–1.4秒，同时减轻操作者负担。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名推断可能为韩美合作，但无明确机构标识）
