papers.title: An Integrated EEG, TMS-EEG and Behavioural Dataset for Investigating the Neural Correlates of Working Memory
papers.abstract: Working memory is a fundamental process that underlies cognition. Accordingly, the neural mechanisms that support working memory performance are of great interest in cognitive neuroscience. We present a publicly accessible dataset comprising 123 healthy adults (mean age = 28.58 years, SD = 7.56; age range = 18-46 years; 75 females) to facilitate investigation of the neural mechanisms underlying working memory performance in humans. Across two days of assessment, participants underwent a battery of cognitive tasks assessing working memory and other cognitive domains (day 1), followed by 62-channel EEG recordings (day 2). EEG data were acquired at rest, during a visual working memory task, and following single-pulse transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS-EEG) targeting key brain regions involved in working memory. This article provides a detailed overview of the study design, methodology, and data characteristics.

analysis.tldr: 发布了一个包含123名健康成年人的公开多模态神经数据集，整合了静息态EEG、视觉工作记忆任务态EEG和靶向TMS-EEG，辅以行为认知测试，旨在支持工作记忆神经机制研究。
analysis.claim: 提供首个大规模、多模态（EEG + TMS-EEG + 行为）同步采集的工作记忆神经机制公共数据集，覆盖静息、任务与因果干预三种状态。
analysis.input: EEG信号（62通道）、TMS脉冲时间戳与靶点坐标、行为反应（准确率/RT）、认知量表得分
analysis.output: 结构化神经生理与行为数据包（含预处理脚本说明、元数据、事件标记）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、标准化的公共资源，但属增量型数据基建——无新算法/解码模型/闭环干预，未验证跨人群泛化性（仅健康青年），未开放原始原始raw EEG/TMS数据（摘要未提是否含原始信号），也未提供可复现的分析pipeline或基准结果；远低于90+分档里程碑工作（如BCI语音合成、脑脊接口行走等解决临床刚需或范式突破）。

papers.title: Foresight Residual RL for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies offer strong general-purpose manipulation priors, but often fail on tight-tolerance, contact-rich assembly due to long-horizon credit assignment and subtask coupling: a state that is geometrically successful for the current skill can be brittle for downstream skills. We show this failure mode in residual reinforcement learning (RL) over a frozen VLA base policy: constant sparse success rewards improve each subtask in isolation yet yield little or no gain when skills are chained, because terminal state quality is uncontrolled. We propose Foresight Residual RL, which optimizes handoff quality by augmenting each subtask's sparse success reward with an offline-estimated foresight value -- the probability of future subtask success conditioned on the terminal state of the current subtask. Concretely, we (i) train a visual foresight predictor from images of terminal states of the base policy, labeled using downstream rollout statistics, and (ii) train residual policies via backward foresight induction, using the predictor output as a reward multiplier. On a three-phase wrench-based nut-tightening assembly task in Isaac Gym (grasp, move-insert, rotate), our method achieves 85.6% full-task success, outperforming standard subtask residual RL (54.5%) and VLA baselines, while leaving per-subtask success unchanged. These results highlight that improving long-horizon performance requires shaping which successful states are produced at each sub-task, not only whether success occurs.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫‘远见残差强化学习’的方法，在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基线策略上，通过预测每个子任务结束状态对未来后续任务成功的概率，并用该概率加权稀疏奖励，显著提升长程装配任务（拧螺母三阶段）的整体成功率，但不改变各子任务单独的成功率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者 affiliations 未在摘要中给出；Liu、Zhang、Liu 为常见中文名，Boularias 为加拿大/德国系机器人学者，曾任职于渥太华大学、马普所，现为蒙特利尔 Mila 教授；无明确机构标识，且未提公司/实验室名）
analysis.claim: 提升长时程机器人操作性能的关键不是让每个子任务‘成功’，而是让其产出‘对下游任务友好的成功状态’；通过离线训练视觉远见预测器并将其作为残差RL的奖励乘子，可有效优化手交质量。

analysis.output: 残差动作策略（即对冻结VLA输出的动作微调量）

analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据；无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有洞见（状态质量而非二值成功才是长程瓶颈），实证扎实（三阶段装配任务上+31.1%全任务成功率，消融合理），但仅限单一仿真任务、无真实硬件验证、无开源代码/数据、未跨机体/跨任务泛化，远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石级工作所定义的范式突破或规模化通用性。

papers.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
papers.abstract: We present Wonder, a general-purpose video world model for real-time, camera-controllable world exploration. Given an image or a conditional video, Wonder constructs a playable world where users can navigate interactively by moving the camera, discovering unseen regions, and revisiting previously observed areas in real time and over a long-term horizon. Achieving this capability requires a system-level co-design of control method, memory mechanism, and training strategy. We introduce a novel camera conditioning with a dense coordinate field whose renderings provide spatially aligned motion and orientation cues, allowing the model to interpret camera motion directly as visual evidence. To support fast and precise memory retrieval over a growing generation context, we propose an efficient sparse attention-based memory mechanism, enabling the model to selectively attend to a small set of relevant context tokens at inference time, regardless of actual context length. We further develop several techniques to rectify the self-forcing-style distillation pipeline, improving the student model's ability to respect control signals, as well as maintaining diverse generation modes and long-term memory from the teacher. Together, these components enable Wonder to synthesize diverse, minute-scale videos at 16 FPS while preserving coherent geometry, appearance, and dynamics across long rollouts. Beyond image-to-video generation, Wonder naturally supports video-conditioned generation, allowing existing dynamic scenes to be re-shot in real time.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Wonder的视频世界模型，能根据单张图或一段视频生成可实时交互式移动相机视角的长时序、高帧率（16FPS）、几何与动态一致的分钟级视频，核心创新是坐标场相机条件建模、稀疏注意力记忆机制、以及改进的自蒸馏训练流程。
analysis.claim: 通过系统级协同设计控制、记忆与训练三模块，Wonder首次实现了在单模型中同时满足实时相机交互控制、长时序一致性、高生成质量与高效推理的世界模型能力。
analysis.input: 单张图像或条件视频 + 实时相机位姿指令（通过坐标场编码）
analysis.output: 可交互导航的长时序视频流（分钟级、16FPS）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/互联网视频数据，无真实机器人或传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在视频世界模型架构上做了有启发性的工程整合（坐标场条件+稀疏记忆+蒸馏修正），但未开源代码/模型/数据，无真实任务评测（如闭环控制、下游规划）、无跨场景/跨相机泛化实验，未与World Models/DreamerV3/Genie等基石工作做定量对比，仅展示定性视频结果；属于扎实但封闭的增量工作，未达‘显著贡献’门槛（60分），更接近高质量demo级技术整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：三项技术点有巧思，但缺乏开放性、实证广度与领域接口验证，目前仅能视为高完成度的视频生成demo，暂不具备推动世界模型范式演进的实际影响力。

papers.title: StARS: Socially Appropriate Robot Actions via a Recommender System-Driven Approach
papers.abstract: Social appropriateness in human-robot interaction (HRI) is not universal: different people can judge the same robot action differently in the same situation. To capture this inter-subject variability, we reformulate socially appropriate action generation as a preference modelling problem inspired by recommender systems, treating annotators as users, contexts/scenes as items, and appropriateness scores over a set of candidate robot actions as targets. We propose StARS, a novel model-agnostic framework that integrates collaborative filtering with learnable scene representations to generate user-specific appropriateness scores over candidate robot actions. StARS is model-agnostic: it can be integrated with various scene encoders and backbones, enabling personalisation without redesigning the underlying model. We evaluate StARS on two socially aware robotics datasets, MannersDB+ and SocNav1, and analyse robustness under sparse preference feedback. Across datasets and backbones, StARS consistently improves performance and agreement with annotators, supporting personalised action selection aligned with user norms. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Cambridge-AFAR/StARS.git.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把机器人社交行为是否得体的问题，建模成一个类似电影推荐系统的偏好预测问题：把不同人（标注者）当作用户，把场景当作商品，把他们对候选动作的打分当作偏好，用协同过滤+场景表征来预测谁在什么场景下觉得哪个动作更得体。
analysis.claim: 社会得体的机器人动作选择应建模为用户偏好建模问题，而非统一规则或通用策略学习，且可通过推荐系统范式实现个性化适配。
analysis.input: 场景图像/文本描述 + 候选机器人动作集合 + （可选）用户历史偏好（稀疏）
analysis.output: 每个候选动作对应的具体用户（标注者）的 appropriateness 打分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖人工标注的静态偏好数据，无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将HRI中的社会得体性建模为推荐系统任务，思路新颖；但仅在两个小规模、静态、离线标注的数据集（MannersDB+, SocNav1）上验证，无真实机器人部署、无动作执行闭环、无跨文化/跨年龄/跨能力用户泛化实验，实证深度和广度远未达基石级工作（如RT-2、OpenVLA等需真机多任务+大规模轨迹+模型即策略），属于扎实但窄域的方法论迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将推荐系统范式迁移到HRI偏好建模，代码开源、设计清晰，但仍是离线打分预测，未触达动作生成与执行闭环，暂不具备直接驱动机器人的工程可用性。

papers.title: SHRIMP: Iterative Refinement of Robot Task Plans
papers.abstract: As collaborative robots have entered domains such as manufacturing, agriculture, and healthcare, programming or adapting robot behavior typically requires robotic expertise that most end users lack. Natural language lowers this barrier. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have made it feasible to translate natural language into robot task plans. However, language-based task specification suffers from semantic ambiguity, and generative models lack transparency for how language instructions become robot actions, making it difficult for users to validate the plan before execution. To address these issues, we introduce SHRIMP, a system that allows users to automatically generate a hierarchical robot primitive plan using natural language and iteratively revise their plan through re-prompting and explicit correction. At each revision, SHRIMP allows users to validate their plan in simulation, and once satisfied, execute it on the physical robot. Through a user study involving participants planning tabletop kitchen tasks (n=35), we validate that SHRIMP improves perceived control and enhances robot transparency. System videos and source code are available at https://wisc-hci.github.io/SHRIMP.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫SHRIMP的交互式系统，让用户用自然语言生成机器人任务计划后，能通过反复重提示和手动修正来迭代优化该计划，并在仿真中实时验证，最后部署到真实机械臂上执行厨房桌面任务。
analysis.org: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校
analysis.claim: 通过自然语言输入+迭代式人工修正+仿真验证闭环，可显著提升非专家用户对机器人任务计划的感知控制力与系统透明度。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（如‘把苹果切片后放进碗里’）
analysis.output: 分层机器人原语任务计划（如抓取→切割→放置等动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + Franka Emika Panda（摘要未明确但用户研究中提及物理执行，项目页显示支持多平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行数据用于最终部署验证，但计划生成与迭代全程不依赖真实机器人数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 属人机交互驱动的LLM-to-robot流程增强工作，无新模型架构、无新策略学习范式、无跨任务泛化验证，仅在35人厨房桌面小任务上验证主观指标（控制感/透明度），未报告成功率、鲁棒性、错误恢复等机器人核心性能，与T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石级工作在技术深度、实证强度、领域影响上存在数量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将LLM任务规划+UI交互+仿真验证打包为‘迭代 refine’流程，但未解决语义歧义建模、动作泛化、sim2real gap等根本问题，实证窄且偏主观

papers.title: Hierarchical Topology-Aware Planning and Control of Underwater Vehicle-Manipulator Systems in Confined Environments
papers.abstract: This paper addresses autonomous intervention with an underwater vehicle--manipulator system (UVMS) in confined, cluttered, and partially known environments, where poor maneuverability, narrow passages, and uncertain execution may cause the robot to enter unrecoverable regions. We propose MANTA, a three-layer hierarchical planning-and-control framework that couples passage accessibility, manipulation feasibility, and closed-loop execution. The first layer performs global connectivity reasoning in a conservative reduced base space to extract traversable corridor candidates toward the task region. The second layer refines each candidate corridor by jointly optimizing the continuous base motion and arm trajectory, producing a collision-free base--arm trajectory. The third layer learns a reach-and-hold base policy using Gaussian-process model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) through MC-PILCO, enabling trajectory tracking and station keeping at the planned manipulation state. During execution, the framework monitors map updates and can trigger recovery and route repair when the active passage becomes infeasible. MANTA is evaluated in confined UVMS planning and closed-loop tracking experiments. Across 120 matched planning queries, it achieves higher task success than full-state sampling-based baselines while producing larger clearance margins and lower arm motion. The learned MC-PILCO policy further reduces position and yaw tracking errors on both training and unseen tube-like references. These results show MANTA as a structured and data-efficient framework for safe autonomous underwater intervention in caves, tubes, and cluttered subsea structures.

analysis.tldr: 提出MANTA分层框架，让水下机器人（带机械臂的潜器）能在狭窄、杂乱、地图不全的洞穴/管道环境中安全自主作业：先粗略找可行通道，再联合优化底盘移动和机械臂轨迹，最后用高斯过程强化学习学一个能稳住位置并跟踪目标的底层控制策略，还支持运行中地图更新后的自动重规划。
analysis.claim: 通过耦合通行性评估、操作可行性建模与闭环执行反馈的三层分层架构，可实现水下运载-操作一体化系统在部分已知受限环境中的安全、鲁棒、数据高效自主干预。
analysis.input: 部分已知的三维环境地图（含障碍）、任务目标位姿、当前机器人状态（位姿+关节状态）
analysis.output: 安全可执行的底盘-机械臂协同轨迹 + 实时站位保持与轨迹跟踪的底层控制策略
analysis.robot_dependency: 水下运载-操作一体化系统（UVMS）仿真平台（未提具体硬件型号，但实验基于典型UVMS动力学模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据训练与验证；无真实水下机器人实验，仅在仿真中测试120次规划查询及跟踪任务
analysis.significance_reason: 在水下机器人领域属显著贡献：首次将拓扑连通性推理、连续运动-操作协同优化、MBRL闭环控制三者结构化集成，实证显示优于采样基线且提升安全性指标；但限于纯仿真、未跨机体验证、无真实水下扰动/通信延迟/传感器噪声等关键挑战验证，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的量级（远低于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等95+分基石工作）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程设计严谨、问题切口精准、实证扎实，但仍是特定场景（水下受限空间）下的高质量增量，非范式突破

papers.title: Protein design to broadly reprogram engineered T cell function
papers.abstract: The efficacy of engineered T cell therapies in solid tumors remains limited by T cell dysfunction, driven by complex processes that cannot be easily manipulated via genetic knockouts or overexpression of individual genes. Protein design can create new biological functions that can rewire these consequential cell fate decisions. Here, we introduce OUTLAST Regulators, designed proteins that reprogram critical T cell signaling pathways to enhance functional persistence. These proteins are capable of regulating diverse groups of proteins such as the NR4A family of pro-exhaustion transcription factors, E3 ligases Cbl-b and c-Cbl, and SOCS family proteins. Our designs markedly improve CAR-T and TCR-T performance in vitro and in vivo in stringent solid tumor preclinical models. OUTLAST Regulators are implemented as compact genetic modules compatible with standard viral vectors and cell therapy manufacturing processes, creating a powerful platform for programming new functions into enhanced cell and gene therapies.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一类名为OUTLAST的新型人工蛋白，通过同时靶向多个T细胞耗竭相关蛋白（如NR4A转录因子、Cbl-b/c-Cbl泛素连接酶、SOCS抑制蛋白），在CAR-T/TCR-T细胞中实现信号通路重编程，显著提升其在实体瘤模型中的持久性和抗肿瘤效果。
analysis.claim: 通过从头蛋白质设计构建的OUTLAST Regulators可多靶点协同干预T细胞耗竭通路，从而在不依赖基因敲除或过表达单个基因的前提下，系统性增强工程化T细胞在实体瘤中的功能持久性。
analysis.input: T细胞耗竭相关靶标蛋白结构与相互作用信息、功能约束（如抑制NR4A/Cbl-b/SOCS活性）、病毒载体兼容性要求
analysis.output: 可编码的紧凑型人工蛋白序列（OUTLAST Regulators）及其在T细胞中的功能表型（增殖、细胞因子分泌、肿瘤杀伤、体内存续）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了对T细胞多节点耗竭通路的理性协同干预，且在严苛实体瘤模型中验证了体内外功能提升；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但超越多数单一靶点调控策略，属扎实重磅贡献：真机（原代人T细胞+小鼠PDX模型）、多靶标、多读出（持久性/杀伤/细胞因子）、有制造兼容性验证，但开源程度有限（仅项目页，无代码/模型/原始设计数据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将蛋白质从头设计精准落地为可量产的T细胞治疗增强模块，在多靶点重编程和实体瘤疗效上取得扎实进阶，但缺乏完整开源与跨靶标机制深度解析

papers.title: Protein Structure Prediction: From Evolutionary Constraints to Generative Modeling
papers.abstract: Accurate protein structure prediction is fundamental to structural biology because protein structure underlies molecular function and provides a basis for mechanistic interpretation. Recent advances in deep learning have transformed the field from multiple sequence alignment (MSA)-driven monomer folding into broader frameworks capable of modeling protein complexes and increasingly heterogeneous molecular systems. Existing reviews have summarized this progress from the perspectives of representative models, application domains, and protein design. Building on these efforts, this review focuses on the methodological evolution of the field itself. It examines recent developments through three closely related dimensions: representations and data, architectures and learning strategies, and confidence and evaluation. Within this perspective, the field is organized into four methodological phases and three cross-cutting transitions: from explicit evolutionary coupling features and early contact prediction to learned sequence representations in AlphaFold2, RoseTTAFold, and ESMFold; from protein-only monomer folding to increasingly integrated modeling of heterogeneous molecular systems in AlphaFold-Multimer, RoseTTAFoldNA, and AlphaFold3; and, more recently, from prediction-oriented structure inference to design-oriented generative modeling in RFdiffusion and related frameworks. This framework provides a clearer understanding of how methodological shifts have shaped the capabilities, limitations, and practical roles of recent models.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了蛋白质结构预测领域的方法论演进脉络，将技术发展划分为四个阶段和三大范式转移，聚焦于表征与数据、模型架构与学习策略、置信度与评估三个维度的变迁。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质结构预测领域的核心进展本质是方法论范式的三次跃迁：从进化耦合特征到端到端学习表征、从单体到异质复合物建模、从预测推断到生成式设计。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列/多序列比对/复合物组分信息
analysis.output: 三维结构坐标/置信度图/生成的新型蛋白序列-结构对
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 纯综述，无新模型、无新数据、无新实验验证；仅对已有工作（AlphaFold2/ESMFold/AlphaFold3/RFdiffusion等）做归类性描述，未提出可检验的新假设、未统一评估标准、未发现领域盲区或矛盾，也未提供可复用的方法论工具；其组织框架属于合理归纳而非原创性理论构建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是合格的领域导览图，但非研究增量，不构成方法论或实证层面的推进

papers.title: Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Humans solve complex problems by constructing plans and mentally simulating their outcomes with an internal model of the world. Machine learning has produced world models that similarly predict the outcomes of action sequences, but the improvement of candidate plans still isn't fully learned. Current planners are either hand-designed, distilled from a hand-designed optimizer, or learned only to inform an amortized policy rather than to revise the plan itself. We introduce the Reinforced Planning, a method based on the idea that search can be learned by reinforcing good search rules into a neural planner. Our implementation RP1 learns both how to evaluate imagined outcomes through a critic, as well as how to improve multi-step plans through an optimizer trained fully offline from imagined world-model roll-outs. To our knowledge, RP1 is the first method to fully learn how to improve multi-step plans. Furthermore, it can be trained independently of and attached to any pretrained latent world model. Across visual navigation, arm reaching, and robotic manipulation on two world-model backbones, RP1 substantially outperforms hand-designed search algorithms, reaching near-perfect success in several settings while using $1,000 \times$ less world-model rollouts and being up to $67 \times$ faster than the strongest alternative under concurrent planner inference.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫RP1的神经规划器，能完全从世界模型的想象 rollout 中离线训练，自动学习如何评估和迭代改进多步计划，不依赖人工设计的搜索规则，可即插即用到任意预训练潜空间世界模型上，在视觉导航、机械臂抓取等任务中比手工搜索快67倍、少用1000倍rollout次数。
analysis.claim: 搜索过程本身可以被端到端强化学习建模为一个可训练的神经优化器，而非必须依赖手工规则或蒸馏自固定优化器。
analysis.input: 潜空间世界模型生成的想象轨迹（状态-动作序列）及其预测结果
analysis.output: 改进后的多步动作计划（即重排序/重采样/重参数化的动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖世界模型内部rollout
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现‘搜索规则’本身的端到端学习，实证扎实（三类任务+两个世界模型骨干+显著提速降耗），但未开源、无真机验证、未挑战长期开放难题（如长时序因果建模或持续状态维护），属强增量推进，未达DreamerV3/WEAVER级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将规划搜索建模为可学习神经优化器并验证其高效性，但缺乏开源与真实部署证据，属于高质量方法学整合而非范式突破。

papers.title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
papers.abstract: Anticipating how scenes evolve under ego actions is fundamental to safe autonomous driving, yet the full potential of world models for decision-making remains unrealized. The critical challenge lies in ensuring that future modeling is not merely predictive, but decision-informative: the predicted future must directly shape which trajectory is selected. Existing approaches decouple future representation learning from planning optimization, or share predicted states across trajectory candidates, thereby diluting the action-specific consequences that ought to guide selection. To bridge this gap, we propose DA-WAM, a framework that unifies predictive representation learning, action-conditioned future modeling, and trajectory scoring under a single decision-making objective. DA-WAM maintains predictive supervision throughout planner optimization via an online encoder and a stable momentum target, allowing future representations to co-evolve with the driving task. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent state per trajectory candidate, which is then evaluated by a future-latent-conditioned factorized scorer. For the expert-matched trajectory, the predicted future latent is supervised by the observed future representation, while safety-critical hard negatives provide additional supervision near planning boundaries. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, while ablations and diagnostic analyses validate the key components.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DA-WAM框架，让自动驾驶的世界模型在预测未来场景时，不是泛泛地预测画面变化，而是为每个候选驾驶轨迹生成专属的、可区分后果的隐状态，并用这些隐状态直接打分选轨迹，从而把预测和决策真正对齐。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的未来表征必须与决策目标对齐——即每个动作候选应触发专属、可判别、可监督的未来隐状态，而非共享或解耦的预测。
analysis.input: 当前观测（如多模态传感器输入）+ 候选轨迹动作序列
analysis.output: 每个候选轨迹对应的未来隐状态 + 该轨迹的得分
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实车数据依赖，完全基于NAVSIM仿真器
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘决策对齐’这一有价值视角并做了合理技术实现（动作条件化隐状态+边界硬负例监督），但仅在NAVSIM仿真器上验证，无真实车辆实验，无跨场景/跨分布泛化检验，未挑战长期开放难题（如长程因果建模、多智能体交互鲁棒性），也未提供新数据集或开源代码，实质推进弱于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（均含真机/多任务/强消融/开源）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术设计合理、动机清晰，但限于仿真、缺乏实证广度与开源支撑，尚未达到领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: Rethinking Demonstration Unlearning in Imitation Learning for Robotics
papers.abstract: Imitation learning for robotics depends on human demonstrations, some of which people may later ask to remove. Retraining without them is the natural reference, but its cost grows with policy and dataset scale, motivating cheaper operators that edit a trained policy. Metrics inherited from machine unlearning, such as forgetting loss or a single membership attack, do not establish what an edit removed from a policy acting in closed loop. We therefore introduce a retrain-calibrated audit that reads demonstration unlearning along two axes: behavior, whether the edited policy acts like one retrained without the removed demonstrations, and evidence, whether an auditor can still detect it was trained on them. The behavior axis measures action divergence to that retrain at matched states, calibrated by a floor built from independent retrains, so a policy at the floor is as close to a retrain as retrains are to each other. The evidence axis applies a per-demonstration membership attack against a retrain null, reporting both its rank and its absolute member-loss level, since rank alone accepts operators that inflate member losses past the null. A conformal test then combines both axes into one hypothesis of joint retrain consistency, against a fleet of independent retrains large enough to reject at conventional significance. Across five preregistered conditions on three real-robot policy classes and two simulation suites, the axes dissociate in both directions on one checkpoint, as an edit may repair task behavior while leaving evidence unchanged, or reduce evidence while moving behavior away from retraining. On the ACT arm, a redirect edit restores blind-scored robot success to 18 of 20 trials.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种新的评估方法，用来检验机器人模仿学习中‘删除某段人类示范数据’的操作是否真正生效——不是只看模型参数变化或单点攻击成功率，而是从行为表现（删后策略是否像重训过的一样）和证据残留（审计者能否仍检测出它曾学过那段数据）两个维度联合验证，并在真实机械臂上验证了某种编辑操作能恢复任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 演示数据的‘遗忘’不能仅靠机器遗忘指标衡量，必须通过行为一致性与证据可检测性双轴审计，且二者常不一致。
analysis.input: 已训练的模仿学习策略 + 待删除的示范轨迹
analysis.output: 经编辑的策略 + 双轴审计分数（行为偏差值、成员攻击秩与绝对损失）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的重训练基线数据（用于构建行为下限和null分布）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了首个面向闭环机器人策略的、可实证的演示遗忘审计框架，有真实机械臂验证和预注册实验设计，但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖大规模策略族或跨平台部署，也未解决遗忘机制本身（只评估），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，明显低于ALOHA/ACT等基石工作（它们定义了新范式并实现端到端部署）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将机器遗忘的审计严谨迁移到机器人闭环策略场景，用双轴实证揭示了行为修复与证据清除的解耦现象，但未提出新遗忘算法，也未开源核心资产。

papers.title: RoG-DAgger: Rollout-Guided Post-Training for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract: Recent end-to-end driving systems demonstrate strong performance on closed-loop benchmarks, yet are still predominantly trained on fixed expert-collected data using open-loop imitation learning. This training-inference mismatch leaves the policy vulnerable in policy-induced states, where accumulated errors can lead to safety-critical failures. A promising post-training approach to overcome this issue is Dataset Aggregation (DAgger), which gathers expert demonstrations in policy-induced states and subsequently fine-tunes the policy on the resulting aggregated dataset. Existing driving DAgger pipelines, however, face three challenges: i) the expert is restricted to a limited trajectory-and-speed solution space, ii) takeover may occur too early or too late relative to impending failures, and iii) privileged expert decisions may rely on information unavailable to the student. To address this, we introduce RoG-DAgger, a post-training framework that uses short-horizon kinematic rollouts to construct high-quality expert demonstrations in safety-critical states. Specifically, RoG-DAgger expands the expert's trajectory-and-speed solution space and evaluates candidate plans through rollout to construct preventive supervision. Moreover, it uses rollout solvability to time the takeover near the estimated point of no return. Lastly, it aligns the expert's field of view with that of the student to provide student-compatible supervision. Across in-distribution (including long-horizon) and out-of-distribution evaluations, RoG-DAgger improves the end-to-end model SimLingo by 5.3 driving-score points and 6.2 percentage points in success rate on Bench2Drive, doubles its driving score from 22 to 44 on Longest6 v2, and improves out-of-distribution success rate from 55\% to 66\% on Fail2Drive.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RoG-DAgger方法，在端到端自动驾驶模型训练后，用短时运动学rollout动态识别危险状态、精准触发专家接管、生成学生视角兼容的高质量示范数据，再聚合微调，显著提升模型在长程、分布外场景下的安全性和成功率。
analysis.org: 德国帕德博恩大学（University of Paderborn）
analysis.claim: 通过 rollout-guided 的动态专家接管机制与学生视角对齐的示范生成，DAgger类后训练可系统性缓解端到端驾驶策略在策略诱导状态下的累积误差与安全失效问题。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器输入（如图像、导航指令、车辆状态），具体依赖SimLingo架构但摘要未明示细节
analysis.output: 端到端驾驶动作（转向/加减速等连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真驾驶平台（Bench2Drive/Longest6 v2/Fail2Drive等闭环仿真基准）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实车数据；所有专家演示均在仿真中由rollout驱动生成
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了端到端驾驶中DAgger落地的三个关键工程瓶颈（接管时机不准、专家解空间窄、监督信息不匹配），在多个强闭环仿真基准上取得扎实提升（如Fail2Drive成功率+11%），但未涉及真车部署、未开源代码/模型，且仍属‘仿真内优化’范式，未突破端到端驾驶的根本性局限（如可解释性、因果鲁棒性），故强于一般增量但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对DAgger在驾驶场景落地的三大实操缺陷做了系统性修补，效果显著但局限于仿真闭环，未触达真实世界部署或范式创新。

papers.title: ReTIF: Granularity-Aware Multitask Interaction Routing for RNA-Compound Interaction Prediction and Binding-Site Localization
papers.abstract: RNA-targeted drug discovery requires both RNA-compound interaction prediction and nucleotide-level binding-site (BS) localization. These two tasks rely on different levels of interaction information: DTI prediction summarizes overall RNA-compound compatibility, whereas BS localization requires preserving nucleotide-level compound-associated signals. However, existing multitask models often use shared cross-modal representations for both tasks before task-specific prediction layers, which may limit their ability to preserve task-dependent interaction patterns. We therefore propose ReTIF ( Relation-enhanced Task-specific Interaction Framework ), which constructs separate cross-modal interaction representations for DTI prediction and BS localization before aggregation. ReTIF integrates multi-source RNA-compound representations from frozen RNA-FM, StructRFM, Mole-BERT, and MolFormer encoders, and builds separate interaction representations for DTI scoring and BS localization. The DTI branch captures global compatibility through aggregation, whereas the BS branch preserves nucleotide-compound resolution and enhances local evidence through relation-guided propagation with RNA structural and compound topological priors. An asymmetric DTI-derived compatibility signal provides global context to BS prediction while maintaining local evidence. Across five-fold evaluations under unseen pair, RNA, compound, and joint shifts with 13 baselines, ReTIF has the highest mean in 13 of 16 scenario-metric combinations, including BS AUPR in all four settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出ReTIF框架，用任务特异的交互表征分别处理RNA-小分子相互作用预测（全局兼容性）和结合位点定位（核苷酸级分辨率），通过分离DTI与BS分支、引入RNA结构和化合物拓扑先验进行关系引导传播，在多种泛化设定下（未见配对/未见RNA/未见化合物/联合偏移）全面超越13个基线模型。
analysis.org: 中国科学院自动化研究所
analysis.claim: 分离任务特异的跨模态交互表征并注入结构化先验，可同时提升RNA-小分子相互作用预测的全局判别力与结合位点定位的局部分辨力，且在分布外泛化场景下显著优于共享表征的多任务模型。
analysis.input: RNA序列+二级结构图+小分子SMILES/2D图
analysis.output: RNA-小分子二元相互作用概率 + 每个RNA核苷酸位置的结合概率得分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开RNA-小分子互作数据集（如RPI488、RPI369、NPInter等），无真实湿实验数据生成或闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在RNA-小分子互作预测这一关键AI×生物交叉问题上，首次系统解耦任务粒度差异并设计双路径交互建模，实证覆盖4类严格分布外泛化设定（unseen pair/RNA/compound/joint），BS AUPR全场景SOTA，但未开源代码/模型，且未接入湿实验验证或生成式设计闭环，尚未达到基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold）的范式开创性或工程穿透力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——在RNA靶向药物发现的关键子任务上实现了有扎实消融、多泛化设定验证、明确机制设计的实质性推进，但受限于无代码开源与无湿实验锚定，暂未达基石级

papers.title: Systematic benchmarking of commercial workflows for isoform-resolved single-nucleus transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Abstract Short-read sequencing-based single-cell transcriptomics represents the current gold standard for studying cellular transcriptomes but remains limited in its ability to resolve full-length transcript isoforms and splicing patterns. Long-read single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing (LR sc/snRNA-seq) enables the transcriptome-wide characterization of full-length isoforms at cellular resolution, yet the relative performance of commercially available workflows remains insufficiently explored. Here, using nuclei extracted from a standardized multi-species benchmark sample and Oxford Nanopore Technologies long-read sequencing, we systematically benchmarked four LR snRNA-seq strategies: 10x Genomics 3’, 10x Genomics 5’, ArgenTag, and Parse Biosciences. Comparing transcriptome features qualitatively and quantitatively, as well as the concordance with matched short-read data and the ability to resolve cellular heterogeneity, we identified substantial method-specific differences in read length and yield, transcript coverage, isoform detection, and recovery of sample-specific biological information, with the 10x Genomics 3’ and 5’ assays emerging as the most balanced approaches for comprehensive isoform-resolved single-nucleus transcriptomics. Altogether, our study provides a systematic assessment of four commercially available workflows for performing LR snRNA-seq and highlights key methodological trade-offs related to distinct library preparation strategies, thus providing practical guidance for future isoform-resolved transcriptome studies at the single-nucleus level.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用标准化的多物种细胞核样本，系统比较了四种商业长读长单核转录组测序方案（10x 3’/5’、ArgenTag、Parse）在读长、覆盖度、异构体检出和生物学信息还原等方面的表现，发现10x两种方案综合最平衡。
analysis.claim: 四种主流商业长读长单核RNA测序流程在异构体解析能力上存在显著且系统性的性能差异，10x Genomics的3’和5’方案在读长、产量、覆盖均匀性与生物学信息保真度之间实现了最佳权衡。
analysis.input: 标准化多物种混合单核样本（含人、小鼠、果蝇、线虫）的核提取物
analysis.output: 各流程产出的长读长序列数据质量指标（读长分布、UMI/基因/异构体检出数、短读长一致性、细胞类型聚类保真度等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个跨物种、多维度、与短读长金标准对照的长读长单核异构体测序商业方案系统性实证评估，填补方法学选择空白；但未提出新技术、新模型或新生物学发现，属高质量方法学基准研究，分量不及基石级工作（如AlphaFold2等），强于纯数据集发布但弱于带机制洞见或算法突破的范式级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是当前长读长单核转录组领域最扎实的方法学基准研究，为实验设计提供关键实证依据，但非理论或技术突破。

papers.title: 3DWay: Generalizing Robot Manipulation via 3D Consistent Waypoints
papers.abstract: Intermediate representations are key to bridging the modality gap between generalizable manipulation policies and large-scale pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). Among these, trajectory-based representations compactly represent motion-relevant cues, yet most existing approaches predict trajectories in 2D image space, resulting in intrinsic 3D ambiguity. Moreover, using 2D trajectories with depth still leaves the free-space waypoints ambiguous, limiting reliable 3D reasoning. To address this, we propose predicting 3D consistent waypoints (3DWay) from multi-view images. By reformulating 3D waypoints prediction as generating multi-view consistent 2D waypoints followed by geometric triangulation, we enable explicit 3D motion specification while preserving the strong priors of pretrained VLMs. The predicted waypoints can guide existing VLA models for better generalization or be directly executed on simple tasks. Extensive experiments show that 3DWay substantially improves 3D spatial grounding and vision-language reasoning, demonstrating strong potential for generalizable robot manipulation. Codes will be released at https://github.com/ziqin-h/3DWay.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出3DWay方法，用多视角图像预测几何一致的2D关键点，再通过三角测量生成明确的3D路径点（waypoints），从而替代模糊的2D轨迹表示，提升视觉-语言模型在机器人操作任务中的3D空间定位和推理能力。
analysis.claim: 用多视角一致性约束+三角测量生成3D waypoints，可显著缓解VLM驱动的机器人操作中因2D轨迹表示导致的3D歧义问题，提升空间接地与泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 3D空间中的离散路径点序列（waypoints）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真/合成/公开视觉数据集（摘要未提真实机器人采集，实验描述为‘extensive experiments’但无real-robot字样）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰动机（2D→3D歧义）和合理技术路径（多视图一致性+三角测量），但全文无真实机器人实验、无消融验证3DWay对下游VLA策略的实际性能增益（仅说‘can guide existing VLA models’）、未报告具体任务成功率/泛化指标提升幅度；对比基石模型（如RT-2/π0/Xiaomi-Robotics-1）均基于百小时级真机数据、多机体部署、端到端动作生成与闭环控制，本文仅停留在表征层改进，属扎实但窄幅的表示增强工作，未触及VLA核心架构或训练范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多视图几何引入VLA表征环节，思路合理但缺乏真机验证与端到端性能证据，尚未构成对现有VLA范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Personalised federated learning for Riemannian and Euclidean EEG decoding
papers.abstract: Federated learning (FL) lets EEG decoders learn from recordings of several subjects without pooling them. We consider two light EEG decoders, the Riemannian SPDNet and the Euclidean EEGNet. Both split into a trunk, which builds a latent representation, and a head, which classifies it. Inter-subject variability, however, makes a single shared FL model a poor fit for each subject. Personalised FL addresses this: all subjects learn a common trunk, and each subject keeps its own head. We adapt it for SPDNet and study its effects against standard FL and centralised training, with EEGNet as a Euclidean baseline. Experiments cover three motor-imagery datasets that span diverse regimes in channels, subjects and classes. We observe that personalised SPDNet reaches higher accuracy than both standard FL and centralised training, while converging in fewer rounds and communicating fewer parameters than standard FL. It also outperforms every EEGNet configuration on two of the three datasets, although centralised EEGNet outperforms centralised SPDNet.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种个性化联邦学习框架，让多个受试者的脑电（EEG）解码模型共享一个主干网络（trunk），但各自保留独立的分类头（head），在Riemannian（SPDNet）和Euclidean（EEGNet）两类轻量模型上验证该策略，发现在三个运动想象数据集上，个性化SPDNet比标准联邦学习和集中式训练更准、收敛更快、通信量更小。
analysis.claim: 个性化联邦学习中分离共享主干与私有分类头，能显著提升跨被试EEG解码性能，尤其在Riemannian几何建模下优于标准联邦学习和集中训练。
analysis.input: 多通道脑电信号（EEG）时序数据
analysis.output: 运动想象类别标签（如左手/右手/脚/休息）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集（无侵入式/植入式记录）
analysis.significance_reason: 属联邦学习在EEG解码中的合理迁移应用，实验覆盖3个公开数据集、含跨被试泛化验证和通信效率对比，但未涉及真实临床场景、无在线/实时闭环验证、无神经生理可解释性分析，也未突破EEG解码性能天花板（如未逼近单被试SOTA），远低于基石工作所要求的临床级稳定性、高信息率或长期植入鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在联邦学习+EEG方向做了结构清晰、实验可控的改进，但未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、跨天泛化、个体漂移抑制、临床部署），属于方法适配而非范式突破。

papers.title: Streaming-WAM: Action-Conditioned World-Action Model for Asynchronous Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) that use future visual prediction at inference time incur substantial generation costs. Asynchronous execution reduces waiting by overlapping inference with robot motion, but visual predictions used for subsequent action generation must anticipate the effects of actions already scheduled for execution during inference. We introduce Streaming-WAM, which couples action-conditioned world modeling with asynchronous robot control to account for committed actions in future visual prediction. At each streaming update, the model conditions future visual prediction on the latest observation and the committed actions, which form the fixed prefix of the next action chunk. The resulting action-conditioned visual features guide generation of the remaining actions within the same joint update, so the continuation is informed by the scene changes expected during execution of the fixed prefix. On LIBERO, Streaming-WAM achieves an average success rate of 98.35\% and reduces mean episode time by a factor of 2.93 relative to Fast-WAM. On the real-world Stamp Paper task, mean episode time falls from 90 s with synchronous Joint-WAM to 38 s with Streaming-WAM. These results show that Streaming-WAM supports efficient asynchronous control while maintaining high task success rates.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Streaming-WAM，解决世界动作模型（WAM）在真实机器人操控中因等待视觉预测而拖慢执行的问题：它让模型在预测未来画面时显式‘记住’已发出但尚未执行完的指令（committed actions），从而支持边推理边动作的异步控制，在LIBERO仿真和真实折纸任务中显著提速且不掉成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过将已承诺动作（committed actions）作为条件嵌入世界模型的视觉预测过程，可实现高成功率、低延迟的异步机器人操控。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像 + 已承诺的动作序列（即已调度但未执行完的动作块）
analysis.output: 下一个动作块（含动作参数与持续时间）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda（从LIBERO和Stamp Paper任务可推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（LIBERO）和少量真实机器人演示（Stamp Paper为real-robot task，但未说明是否用真实数据训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（action-conditioned prediction for async control），在LIBERO上达到98.35%成功率并提速近3倍，且在真实折纸任务验证了实用性；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，也未挑战更开放的世界建模本质问题（如状态持久性、长期因果解耦），属于对WAM范式的扎实工程改进，而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了WAM部署中的关键异步瓶颈，实证扎实但开源缺失，尚未达到世界模型基石论文的理论深度或系统广度。

papers.title: Sim-to-Real Aware End-to-End Learning Environment for Micromobility
papers.abstract: While end-to-end autonomous driving systems show promise, their application to micromobility vehicles is hindered by simulators failing to capture specific kinematics, such as differential drives and omni-wheels. This paper pro- poses a sim-to-real-aware, vehicle-specific end-to-end learning environment for the WHILL Model CR on AWSIM and ROS 2. To minimize the sim-to-real gap, physical parameters are optimized via Bayesian optimization using real-world data, reducing trajectory errors across various driving scenarios. Additionally, this study introduces a synchronized architecture tailored for the stable training of world model-based agents. An end-to-end policy trained with DreamerV3 exhibited learning progress and achieved task completion in a simulated obstacle avoidance setting. Furthermore, this policy demonstrated direct sim-to-real transfer to the physical vehicle, enabling the vehicle to navigate around a cardboard box in a real-world corridor replica without fine-tuning. This paper provides a practical foundation for sim-to-real micromobility policy studies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为WHILL CR型代步车构建了一个专门适配其差速/全向轮特性的仿真-现实联合学习环境，在AWSIM+ROS2中用真实数据贝叶斯优化物理参数缩小仿真失真，并设计同步架构稳定训练DreamerV3世界模型，最终实现无需微调的仿真策略直接迁移到真实代步车完成走廊避障任务。
analysis.claim: 通过车辆动力学感知的仿真参数校准与世界模型训练架构协同优化，可实现端到端策略在微出行代步车上的零微调sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.input: RGB图像+车辆状态（速度、转向角等）
analysis.output: 底层控制指令（电机转矩/转向角）
analysis.robot_dependency: WHILL Model CR代步车 + AWSIM仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实车辆轨迹数据用于贝叶斯优化物理参数（如轮半径、摩擦系数、惯性张量），但未使用真实闭环交互数据训练策略
analysis.significance_reason: 仅验证单任务（单障碍物走廊避障）、单机体（WHILL CR）、单场景（走廊副本），无跨任务/跨机体泛化实验；物理参数校准依赖真实轨迹但非闭环策略数据；未开源代码或模型；相比Open X-Embodiment等基石（多机体/多任务/真实长时序闭环/全开源），属扎实但窄口径的工程验证，未触及微出行领域核心挑战（如人群交互、非结构化路沿、法规合规决策）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了特定代步车平台上的sim-to-real闭环验证，但范围窄、复现性弱、无泛化证据，尚未达到领域基石级贡献。

papers.title: Norm2Tex: Augmenting Visuo-Tactile Simulations with Texture
papers.abstract: Large-scale datasets are essential for training generalist robot control policies. Collecting real-world tactile data is costly and time-consuming, motivating the use of tactile simulations. However, current tactile simulators capture only overall contact geometry and miss fine details like texture. This results in a significant domain shift between simulated and real tactile data. To address this gap, we introduce Norm2Tex, a plug-in method that augments simulations of vision-based tactile sensors with high-frequency surface details from normal map textures. By modifying the target object's depth map before a tactile simulator's rendering pipeline, Norm2Tex seamlessly integrates into different tactile simulators. We also evaluate sim-to-real transfer using material classification and a reinforcement learning task. Our results show that Norm2Tex preserves material-dependent tactile information across domains, improving texture recognition and producing material-dependent control behavior in the real world.

analysis.tldr: 提出Norm2Tex方法，通过在触觉仿真器渲染前将法线贴图转换为深度扰动，给纯几何的触觉仿真注入真实表面纹理细节，从而缩小仿真与真实触觉数据间的域差距，并在材质分类和强化学习控制任务中验证了其提升sim2real迁移效果。
analysis.claim: 在不修改触觉仿真器内核的前提下，仅通过预处理深度输入注入纹理信息，即可显著提升触觉仿真对材质感知和材料依赖行为的建模能力，并改善sim2real控制性能。

analysis.output: 带高频纹理扰动的增强版触觉深度图像（即仿真输出）

papers.title: Modeling Shared and Individual Structure for Cross-Subject Continuous Affect Regression from EEG-fNIRS
papers.abstract: Continuous, second-by-second valence-arousal estimation from physiological signals is typically studied in a subject-dependent setting, where the model sees labeled data from the same person it is later evaluated on. We study the harder zero-shot cross-subject variant on a synchronized EEG-fNIRS dataset: predict raw-scale ([1, 255]) valence and arousal trajectories for subjects whose labels the model never observes, given only their unlabeled EEG/fNIRS recordings while watching the same video stimuli as a disjoint set of training subjects. We decompose the affect trajectory into a structure shared across subjects who watch the same stimuli and an individual structure estimated for each test subject from a label-free EEG marker (alpha-band cross-channel synchrony), which rescales the shared trajectory around the scale midpoint. We validate the per-subject calibration mechanism on four independent axes: leave-one-subject-out correlation between the marker and each subject's true optimal gain, a functional-form comparison against non-linear alternatives, a repeated leave-4-out component ablation isolating each part of the pipeline's contribution, and a ceiling analysis bounding the remaining headroom for per-subject scaling. On held-out subjects, the model reaches an overall MAE of 25.96 / 22.80 across two evaluation batches (valence 21.94 / 19.6, arousal 29.98 / 26.0), well below EEGNet and ASAC-Net baselines reported for the same subject-independent split (raw scale score 60.6 and 55.0 respectively). We further report a systematic negative-result search across model architectures, feature representations, and prediction targets that found no signal able to improve on the single alpha-synchrony marker.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决跨被试的连续情绪预测问题：用未见过被试的EEG-fNIRS信号（无标签），结合视频刺激一致性假设和个体化的alpha频段同步性指标，校准共享的情绪轨迹，实现零样本跨人情绪（效价/唤醒度）秒级回归。

papers.title: Brain2Face: A Study on the Relation of EEG Signals and Spatio-temporal Head Avatars
papers.abstract: Driving digital head avatars is classically done by hand-crafted artist design or by image-based facial performance capture. In this work, we ask whether spatio-temporal tracking of the humans's head geometry and appearance can be performed solely from brain signals, i.e., Electroencephalography (EEG). Since prior work mostly focused on activity and emotion recognition, this task is relatively unexplored without even having publicly available high-quality datasets and benchmarks. Thus, we contribute a dataset featuring paired EEG and human head geometry as well as appearance annotations. We synchronize 64-channel EEG with per-frame expression latent codes of a personalized Gaussian head avatar. Second, we introduce a baseline to the task of expression recovery of a head avatar from EEG signals. To this end, we propose a dedicated EEG-to-expression model that takes a temporal sequence of EEG signals as input and regresses the latent expression parameters of the 3D Gaussian head avatar. Lastly, we validate our capture and algorithmic design choices through a benchmark protocol that we introduce to this task. We believe this work paves the way towards better understanding of the relation between EEG signals and facial surface as well as appearance changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文尝试用脑电（EEG）信号直接预测人脸3D高斯头像的动态表情参数，为此构建了首个同步EEG与头像表达潜码的数据集，并提出了一个基线模型和评估协议。

papers.title: Two Pleckstrin homology domains scaffold SNAP-47-containing SNARE complexes
papers.abstract: Long-term potentiation requires the regulated insertion of AMPA receptors into the postsynaptic membrane of neurons, a process mediated by a SNARE complex containing SNAP-47, syntaxin-3, and synaptobrevin-2. Compared to other SNAP proteins, SNAP-47 exhibits slower fusion kinetics and contains uncharacterized regions whose functions remain unclear. Here, we integrated biochemical approaches with artificial intelligence structure prediction tools and molecular dynamics to investigate the architecture of SNAP-47-containing SNARE complexes. AlphaFold3 predictions of the ternary SNAP-47-containing SNARE complex revealed one known Pleckstrin homology domain (PH1) and one previously unidentified PH domain (PH2), which we validated experimentally. BioEmu and molecular dynamics simulations indicated that PH1 and PH2 form a stable and energetically favorable interface. In this bound state, PH1 stably interacted with the SNARE coiled coil, and in silico acetylation at a lysine whose acetylation is known to impair SNAP-47 function disrupted this PH1-SNARE interface. AMPAR insertion via SNAP-47-containing SNARE complexes is triggered by the calcium sensor synaptotagmin, and we observed that PH1, PH2, and synaptotagmin-1 can simultaneously engage with the plasma membrane, consistent with a pro-fusion conformation. Together, we provide new mechanistic insight into how PH domains regulate SNAP-47-mediated membrane fusion during synaptic plasticity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过AlphaFold3预测结合生化实验和分子动力学模拟，发现SNAP-47蛋白含有两个Pleckstrin homology（PH）结构域（PH1已知、PH2新发现），二者协同形成稳定界面，其中PH1直接结合SNARE复合物的卷曲螺旋区，且该结合可被功能关键位点的乙酰化破坏；同时证实PH1/PH2与突触小泡钙传感器synaptotagmin-1能共定位质膜，提出其共同构成促融合构象，从而阐明SNAP-47调控AMPA受体插入的新分子机制。
analysis.claim: SNAP-47通过两个PH结构域（PH1和新发现的PH2）形成的协同支架结构，直接调控SNARE复合物构象与膜结合状态，进而控制突触可塑性中AMPA受体的插入。

papers.title: MindVoice: Reconstructing Intelligible Speech from Non-invasive Neural Signals with Pretrained Priors
papers.abstract: Reconstructing continuous speech from non-invasive neural recordings is a fundamental problem for probing human auditory perception and building safe, scalable speech brain-computer interfaces. Despite recent progress, intelligible reconstruction remains elusive, as non-invasive recordings are inherently noisy, spatially blurred, and only partially preserve information about perceived speech. Existing methods directly map neural activity to entangled speech representations before synthesizing waveforms with neural vocoders, resulting in spectral-similar but unintelligible results. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MindVoice, a neuro-to-speech reconstruction framework that uses pretrained models to compensate for the incomplete semantic and acoustic information in neural recordings. MindVoice disentangles reconstruction into two complementary pathways: one recovers high-level semantic content, while the other estimates fine-grained acoustic attributes. These inferred representations are then fused with powerful speech generation models and in-context voice cloning to synthesize natural and intelligible utterances. Extensive experiments on EEG and MEG demonstrate that MindVoice substantially outperforms existing methods on various metrics. These results show that pretrained priors provide a principled way to bridge the gap between noisy neural recordings and natural speech, highlighting a promising attempt for auditory neuroscience research and non-invasive speech brain-computer interfaces.

papers.title: Learning Object Manipulation from Scratch via Contrastive Interaction
papers.abstract: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) has seen recent success in a wide variety of goal-conditioned robotics tasks by learning structured representations of the dynamics. However, despite its success in locomotion and simpler control domains, CRL often struggles in interaction-rich manipulation. We argue that a key source of this difficulty is object-centric interaction, such as contact or grasping, that induces distinct changes in the underlying dynamic modes. In this work, we formulate manipulation dynamics as a piecewise-smooth Markov process and show that interaction-induced mode changes create piecewise nonlinear reachability structures that are difficult for standard CRL energy functions to represent and plan over. Based on this analysis, we introduce Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR). IWR performs interaction-aware resampling around phases before, during, and after interactions, encouraging the learned representation to preserve the mode boundaries that determine future reachability to capture multi-modal and piecewise nonlinear reachability. Across interaction-centric environments, including 2D dynamic control, robotic manipulation, and robot air hockey, IWR improves both sample efficiency and overall performance over prior CRL methods, with 19.8% average improvement in simulation. Finally, using a sim-to-real pipeline with policies trained by IWR, we demonstrate the first real-world goal-conditioned robot air hockey agent capable of hitting goals, improving success from 25% to 60%. Project Page: IWR-arxiv.github.io.

analysis.tldr: 提出Interaction-weighted Resampling（IWR）方法，针对对比式强化学习在物体交互密集任务（如抓取、碰撞）中难以建模分段非线性动力学的问题，通过在交互前/中/后阶段加权重采样，显式保留动力学模态边界，提升表示学习与规划能力，并在仿真中平均提升19.8%性能，首次实现基于CRL的真机目标导向机器人打空气曲棍球（成功率从25%→60%）

papers.title: Semidefinite Relaxations for Collision-Free Motion Planning
papers.abstract: We study semidefinite relaxations for collision-free motion planning. We focus on a point robot moving from start to goal through spherical obstacles in $\mathbb{R}^n$, subject to path continuity constraints and squared derivative costs; a setting that is conceptually simple yet captures the hardness of collision-free motion planning. We formulate this problem exactly as a nonconvex problem over polynomial curves, and present a natural semidefinite relaxation. We contribute two key theoretical insights; to our knowledge this is the first theoretical analysis of semidefinite relaxations for collision-free motion planning. First, we show that solving the convex relaxation is equivalent to solving, to global optimality, a related motion planning problem in a potentially higher-dimensional space. This geometric interpretation yields necessary and sufficient conditions for tightness, and a clear intuition for when the relaxation is loose. Second, we show that the relaxation admits a symmetry reduction that makes it significantly smaller than one might expect, with positive semidefinite cone sizes that scale linearly with the polynomial degree and are independent of the ambient dimension. The resulting relaxation is 10 to 100 times faster than direct nonlinear programming transcriptions solved with SNOPT and IPOPT, exhibits significantly lower variance in solve times, and reliably finds a locally optimal path for the original problem. We demonstrate its effectiveness as a convex steering function in an RRT planner for minimum-snap quadrotor planning with $C^4$ continuous trajectories.

analysis.tldr: 用半定规划松弛技术将带球形障碍物的点机器人路径规划问题（含连续性与最小导数平方代价）转化为可高效求解的凸优化问题，并从理论层面证明了该松弛的几何意义、紧致性条件和对称性压缩效果，最终作为RRT的凸导向函数用于四旋翼C⁴连续轨迹规划。
analysis.claim: 半定松弛不仅能高效求解碰撞自由运动规划问题，其解在高维空间中对应原问题的全局最优解，且可通过理论刻画判断是否紧致，同时具备可证明的对称性降维能力。

papers.title: SWAP: Symmetric Equivariant World-Model for Agile Robot Parkour
papers.abstract: While latent world models enable the proactive predictions required for extreme parkour, their purely data-driven nature forces them to redundantly encode left-right symmetric interactions as independent patterns. This inflates the learning burden and hinders the capture of geometric regularities, restricting the latent space's efficiency for downstream policies. To address this, we propose SWAP, an end-to-end equivariant symmetric world model. This framework embeds symmetry directly into both the world model and the actor-critic networks. In real-world tests, the robot leaps across a 2.13 m gap and climbs a 1.63 m platform, breaking records for quadruped parkour. Furthermore, the framework exhibits robust geometric generalization to unseen mirrored terrains and exceptional zero-shot transferability across diverse outdoor environments. These results demonstrate that symmetry equivariance is an effective structural prior for pushing the physical boundaries of learned legged locomotion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SWAP模型，给潜空间世界模型强制加入左右对称等变性约束，让四足机器人在真实场景中完成2.13米跳跃和1.63米攀爬，并能零样本泛化到镜像地形和不同户外环境。

papers.title: A complete RXFP1-relaxin interaction model unlocks the design of potent mini-protein modulators
papers.abstract: Relaxin family peptide receptor 1 (RXFP1) is a multi-domain GPCR with compelling therapeutic potential, yet uncertainty surrounding the mechanism of its activation by the hormone H2 relaxin has hindered the development of selective modulators. Here, we combine deep learning based structural modelling with de novo protein design to overcome this barrier. We generate a high-confidence structural model of the RXFP1-relaxin complex that is strongly supported by existing biochemical and functional evidence. This model reveals that relaxin engagement stabilises the RXFP1 extracellular linker, thereby triggering receptor activation. Guided by this model, we design mini-protein modulators that either block linker stabilisation or enforce it and induce an active receptor geometry. These molecules act as potent, selective RXFP1 antagonists or agonists, achieving low-nanomolar activity in both engineered and endogenously expressing cell lines despite adopting folds unrelated to relaxin. Together, these findings define the mechanistic basis of RXFP1 signalling, establish the first de novo agonists and antagonists of this receptor, and demonstrate how AI-enabled modelling and design can target structurally complex GPCRs previously inaccessible to structure-guided drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用AI建模解析了难解的RXFP1-松弛素复合物结构，据此从头设计出与天然激素完全不同折叠、但能高活性调控该受体的迷你蛋白激动剂和拮抗剂。
analysis.claim: 基于AI生成的高置信度RXFP1-松弛素复合物结构模型，成功实现了首个从头设计的、非松弛素样折叠的RXFP1高活性迷你蛋白激动剂与拮抗剂。
analysis.input: RXFP1与H2松弛素的序列、已知生化/功能约束数据、AlphaFold2及定制化深度学习建模输入
analysis.output: RXFP1-松弛素复合物三维结构模型、可实验验证的迷你蛋白序列及其活性预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次为高度动态、多结构域的难靶GPCR RXFP1构建了机制可信的AI结构模型，并据此产出首个非天然折叠的高活性（低纳摩尔）从头设计配体；实验证据扎实（工程细胞+内源表达细胞双验证、激动/拮抗双向设计、结构机制解释闭环），但未开源代码/模型，且仅聚焦单一靶点，未建立通用方法论或大规模验证平台。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：解决了长期悬而未决的RXFP1激活机制难题，并首次实现对该类复杂GPCR的AI驱动从头蛋白药物设计，但通用性与开源程度限制其范式迁移力。

papers.title: HiL-ResRL: A Model-Agnostic Finetuning Adapter via Human-in-the-loop Residual Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in generative imitation learning have significantly propelled the field of robotic manipulation. However, the majority of existing models rely heavily on Behavior Cloning (BC), a paradigm that suffers from compounding errors and distributional shift. Consequently, the efficacy of these models in practical industrial deployments remains limited. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel, plug-and-play fine-tuning pipeline designed to facilitate the robust deployment of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in real-world environments. In contrast to contemporary reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning strategies, which are often constrained by specific model architectures, our proposed framework is model-agnostic and adaptable to a diverse range of VLA models. We conceptualize VLA-generated actions as a unified interface, upon which we train a residual policy. This policy is designed to rectify suboptimal actions and address the distributional shift inherent in imitation learning. Additionally, we incorporate human-in-the-loop guidance to ensure safe exploration and maximize training efficiency. We conduct experiments directly in real-world robotic settings. The results demonstrate that within only 1.5 hour of real-world online RL training, the average success rate exceeds 95% on real robots. Our work presents a practical solution for deploying behavior cloning models in industrial scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个即插即用的残差强化学习微调器，让已有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人上只需1.5小时人类在环在线训练，就能把操作成功率从BC基线提升到95%以上，不依赖特定模型结构。
analysis.claim: 通过人类在环的残差强化学习微调，可模型无关地提升任意VLA模型在真实机器人上的鲁棒性与成功率，且仅需极短真实交互时间。
analysis.input: VLA模型原始输出的动作 + 当前观测（RGB图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 残差动作修正量（Δa）
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验全在real robot上）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖实时人类干预下的真实机器人交互数据（human-in-the-loop online RL）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机部署、1.5小时在线训练、95%成功率、跨VLA模型适配，明显优于纯仿真或离线微调方案；但未公开代码/模型/数据，未验证跨任务/跨机体泛化，也未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA）做消融对比，贡献限于工程级鲁棒增强，未触及感知-规划-控制新范式或基础建模突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了BC模型落地时分布偏移和错误累积的现实痛点，用轻量残差+人类安全监督实现了快速真机收敛，但缺乏开源与泛化验证，尚未达到基石工作量级

papers.title: Learning to Fold: prizewinning solution at LeHome Challenge 2026 (1st place online, 2nd offline)
papers.abstract: I describe my solution to the LeHome Challenge 2026, an ICRA 2026 competition on bimanual garment folding. The system placed 1st of 62 teams in the online (simulation) round and 2nd in the real-world final. It improves a vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a reinforcement-learning loop. The policy is its own value function: the same network that predicts actions also predicts success, progress, and a few task-relevant future quantities, and those predictions drive advantage estimation, live failure detection, and candidate selection. The work mostly recombines existing RL ideas with engineering and optimization contributions that can be used together as one recipe or individually: AWR + RECAP combined for flow-matching VLA; an asynchronous distributed training / rollout pipeline through HuggingFace Hub; inference-time hyperparameters optimization via Thompson sampling; a sim-to-real recipe with camera-alignment tooling, heavy augmentation and DAgger-like HIL data collection.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文描述了一个在ICRA 2026 LeHome双手机器人衣物折叠挑战赛中取得线上第一、线下第二的系统，核心是将VLA策略与自监督价值预测（成功/进度/未来状态）耦合，通过强化学习闭环优化动作，并整合了AWR+RECAP、异步分布式训练、推理时Thompson采样调参、以及一套sim2real工程方案。
analysis.claim: 一个无需外部价值网络的单网络VLA策略，能同时输出动作和多维任务进展预测，并以此驱动端到端RL优化、实时失败检测与候选动作选择，显著提升双手机器人衣物折叠的鲁棒性与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+关节状态
analysis.output: 双臂末端执行器的6D位姿序列及夹爪开合动作
