analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个成熟RL与VLA技术模块深度耦合并落地到复杂双机协同操作任务，有完整闭环验证，但无底层方法论突破

papers.title: The CHIP–LMO7–BAG5 complex controls tau clearance and yields repurposed and newly designed therapeutic candidates for Alzheimer’s disease
papers.abstract: Abstract Through cross-species genetic screens, we identified LMO7 as a regulator of tau levels in vivo . LMO7 bridges the E3 ligase CHIP and its inhibitory cochaperone BAG5, suppressing CHIP’s ligase activity and limiting tau ubiquitination and degradation. Adult LMO7 knockdown enhances CHIP activity, reduces total and phosphorylated tau, attenuates gliosis, and rescues memory deficits in tauopathy mice. Guided by AlphaFold-derived structural models and AI-based virtual screening, we developed a CHIP-derived competing peptide and identified FDA-approved drugs that disrupt the complex. Viral delivery of the peptide or oral administration of Telmisartan or MPA-2, an optimized Mycophenolic acid derivative, reduced pathogenic tau without toxicity. These findings establish CHIP–LMO7–BAG5 complex as a druggable node in tau homeostasis, with implications for tauopathies including Alzheimer’s disease, and STUB1 -associated ataxias.

analysis.tldr: 通过跨物种遗传筛选发现LMO7蛋白能抑制CHIP-BAG5复合物对tau蛋白的泛素化降解，敲低LMO7可降低病理性tau、改善小鼠记忆障碍；再基于AlphaFold结构预测和AI虚拟筛选，设计出阻断该复合物的多肽，并从FDA药物库中找到替米沙坦和优化的霉酚酸衍生物MPA-2，口服即可减少病理性tau且无毒性。
analysis.claim: CHIP–LMO7–BAG5三元复合物是调控tau蛋白稳态的关键可药靶点，靶向破坏该复合物可有效清除病理性tau并改善tauopathy表型。
analysis.input: AlphaFold预测的蛋白质结构模型 + AI虚拟筛选的化合物库
analysis.output: 靶向CHIP-LMO7-BAG5界面的干扰肽 + 可重定位的FDA批准药物（替米沙坦、MPA-2）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机实验缺失（无细胞/动物实验原始数据集公开），但含多模型验证（果蝇+小鼠tauopathy模型）、多干预手段（shRNA、AAV肽、口服小分子）、关键表型终点（磷酸化tau、胶质增生、行为学），且AI结构建模与虚拟筛选闭环落地到两个独立化学实体（肽+小分子），证据链扎实；但未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，也未建立通用AI药物设计框架，属重磅转化型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将遗传筛选、结构生物学、AI虚拟筛选与体内药效验证闭环打通，但未开源代码/模型/原始数据，复现门槛高，属于高质量转化研究而非方法论突破。

papers.title: Multi-modality Graph Representation Learning for Malignant Cell Identification from scRNA-seq using DeepMalignant
papers.abstract: Distinguishing malignant from normal cells in single-cell RNA sequencing data remains a critical yet challenging task in cancer genomics. Existing methods often suffer from poor precision, limited generalizability across cancer types, and reduced robustness across different sequencing platforms. We developed DeepMalignant, an unsupervised multimodal graph attention autoencoder for malignant cell identification that jointly integrates gene expression and copy number alteration (CNA) information. We applied DeepMalignant to five datasets covering 26 samples and four cancer types (breast, colorectal, pancreatic, and ovarian cancers), generated by three platforms (10x Genomics, inDrop, and Drop-seq) for benchmarking and compared it with existing state-of-the-art methods including scMalignantFinder, PreCanCell, CopyKAT, ikarus, and Cancer-Finder. DeepMalignant achieved the best overall balance of precision and recall and consistently outperformed the existing methods that used either gene expression or CNA in F1 scores. Ablation studies showed that both CNA-based edge weighting and graph attention aggregation contribute independently to performance, and attribution analysis further indicated that the learned embeddings capture biologically meaningful malignant programs. We further applied DeepMalignant to two ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) samples, DCIS2 and DCIS1, that have matched spatial transcriptomics and scRNA-seq data. DeepMalignant identified tumor-enriched regions that were highly consistent with the matched histological image. The downstream cell-cell communications analysis revealed that fibroblast-derived C3 and MIF both directed signaling more toward normal epithelial cells than tumor epithelial cells, demonstrating that accurate tumor-normal cell classification by DeepMalignant enables biologically meaningful interrogation of the tumor microenvironment and revealing how stromal cells differentially communicate with malignant versus normal epithelial populations.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeepMalignant模型，用无监督图注意力自编码器融合单细胞RNA表达和拷贝数变异（CNA）数据，在5个跨平台、跨癌种的scRNA-seq数据集上更准地识别恶性细胞，并验证其在空间转录组匹配分析和肿瘤微环境通信推断中的生物学一致性。
analysis.claim: 融合基因表达与拷贝数变异的多模态图表示学习可显著提升单细胞水平恶性细胞识别的精度、泛化性与生物学可解释性。
analysis.input: 单细胞RNA-seq基因表达矩阵 + 拷贝数变异（CNA）谱
analysis.output: 每个细胞的恶性概率/二分类标签及可解释的嵌入表示
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开scRNA-seq与CNA注释数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（图+多模态+无监督），实证扎实（5数据集/4癌种/3平台/多SOTA对比+消融+空间转录组交叉验证+下游通信分析），但未开源代码模型，且未解决领域根本瓶颈（如缺乏金标准标签导致评估天花板低；CNA在scRNA中本就是稀疏/噪声大/需额外推断），属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：技术整合扎实、跨平台跨癌种验证充分、生物学解释闭环完整，但受限于scRNA恶性标注固有模糊性，未达里程碑级分量。

papers.title: Layout-independent actuation allocator for fin-actuated marine robots
papers.abstract: In this study, we propose a layout-independent control allocator capable of zero-shot deployment across diverse actuator configurations. The proposed method utilizes a learning pipeline that integrates a Graph Neural Network (GNN) and a Transformer to represent the robot's geometric layout as a graph, along with a Mixture Density Network (MDN) to predict multi-modal control command distributions. Furthermore, by incorporating a differentiable physics surrogate model, we achieve command refinement during inference to minimize target wrench tracking error and energy consumption. A single generalized model using randomly generated actuator layout data demonstrated high trajectory tracking performance on different actuator layout robots outside the training distribution. Additionally, in real-world pool experiments, our approach achieved performance nearly equivalent to conventional controllers designed to specific layouts.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖具体鳍式机器人执行器布局的通用控制分配器，用图神经网络+Transformer建模机器人几何结构，用混合密度网络预测多模态控制指令，并结合可微物理代理模型在线优化指令，实现跨不同鳍布局机器人的零样本部署，在真实水池实验中性能接近为特定布局定制的传统控制器。
analysis.claim: 一个单一、通用的控制分配器模型，无需重新训练即可零样本适配任意鳍式推进器布局，并在真实机器人上实现与专用控制器相当的力矩跟踪与能耗表现。
analysis.input: 机器人执行器几何布局图（节点=鳍位置/朝向/类型，边=拓扑关系）+目标六维力矩（wrench）
analysis.output: 各鳍的多模态控制指令分布（推力大小/方向/相位等），经物理代理模型 refine 后输出确定性执行指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 鳍式水下机器人（如FinBot、RoboFish类平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖仿真生成的随机布局数据；真实实验仅用于验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在水下鳍式机器人中实现跨布局零样本控制分配，实机验证覆盖多种非训练布局且性能逼近专用控制器，但未开源代码/模型，未在复杂动态环境（如湍流、障碍物）或多任务（抓取、避障）中验证，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺开源与泛化鲁棒性验证，但跨机体零样本控制在水下机器人中迈出关键一步，工程整合度高。

papers.title: Saturated mutagenesis screen of M-MLV reverse transcriptase identifies variants enhancing prime editing efficiency
papers.abstract: Prime editing enables the precise modification of genomes, thereby holding great potential for the treatment of genetic diseases. Despite substantial advancements in prime editing technology and the initiation of the first clinical trial for treating chronic granulomatous disease, further enhancement of editing efficiency across edit types is still urgently needed. Here, we developed a compact prime editor, PE2ΔR, by deleting the RNase H domain of the MMLV reverse transcriptase (MMLV–RT). We then conducted a saturated mutagenesis screen targeting two DNA interacting regions within the PE2ΔR–RT Fingers domain. By integrating three highly effective mutations (I61R, V101R, S67W) into PEmax lacking RNase H domain (termed PEmaxΔRM3), we achieved up to a 90% increase in editing efficiency across editing types compared to PEmax. Structural modelling using AlphaFold 3 suggests that these mutations enhance primer–template stabilization and guide the RNA/DNA hybrid into a catalytically favourable trajectory, providing a mechanistic explanation for the enhanced activity. Taken together, our study demonstrates proof–of–concept for the application of unbiased mutagenesis screen to identify novel mutations that enhance prime editor performance. Furthermore, we discovered that RT variants (I61R, V101R, S67W) synergize with PEmax and epegRNA to improve prime editing efficiency across edit types, with the strongest improvement observed in introducing small deletions.

analysis.tldr: 通过饱和突变筛选M-MLV逆转录酶的Fingers结构域，找到三个关键突变（I61R/V101R/S67W），将其整合到删减RNase H的PEmax中，显著提升各类碱基编辑效率（最高+90%），并用AlphaFold3建模解释其稳定引物-模板和优化RNA/DNA杂交构象的机制。
analysis.claim: 在PEmax框架下删除RNase H并引入Fingers域三重突变（I61R/V101R/S67W），可系统性提升所有类型prime editing的编辑效率，且该提升源于逆转录酶对引物-模板复合物的构象稳定化增强。
analysis.input: 饱和突变文库 + epegRNA + 目标DNA位点（多种编辑类型）
analysis.output: 高编辑效率的逆转录酶突变体（PEmaxΔRM3）及其在不同编辑类型下的效率数值
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，全部为分子生物学实验（HEK293T细胞系转染、测序验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的蛋白质工程增量工作：有明确筛选策略、多编辑类型验证（插入/缺失/替换）、消融支持（单/双/三突变对比）、AlphaFold3辅助机制解释；但未构建新编辑器架构、未解决prime editing根本瓶颈（如大片段插入、体内递送、脱靶）、未开源代码/模型/完整突变数据集，仅限细胞系水平验证，离临床转化尚远；显著弱于ESM/AlphaFold/RFdiffusion等定义范式的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：实证充分但范畴窄，聚焦单一酶的理性优化，未突破prime editing系统级瓶颈，暂未达领域里程碑门槛

papers.title: Expectation Shapes Neural Preparation for AI-generated and Real Image Processing: Evidence from EEG
papers.abstract: Abstract: AI-generated images, videos, and news have become an inseparable part of daily life, leading to increasing skepticism toward online information. Understanding how expectations about the presence of AI-generated content influence perception is crucial for elucidating the underlying neural mechanisms and facilitating the generation of naturalistic avatars. In this study, we analyzed an existing EEG dataset (N = 29) in which participants viewed emotional facial photographs of only real individuals while being informed that upcoming faces were either real ('REAL') or AI-generated ('FAKE'). We examined pre-stimulus oscillatory activities in the one-second EEG interval before stimulus onset and found significantly lower alpha power when participants expected 'FAKE' compared to 'REAL' faces. This effect was region-specific, particularly in right occipito-parietal and temporo-parietal regions, as identified by both sensor- and source-level analyses. In addition, the modulation effect between pre-stimulus alpha activity and post-stimulus event-related potentials (ERPs) was measured. A significant correlation between changes in late positive potential (LPP) amplitudes and pre-stimulus alpha power was observed exclusively for 'FAKE' smiling faces, consistent with our previous findings. These results suggest that AI-related expectations modulate neural preparatory states, with lower alpha activity presumably reflecting increased attentional demands for stimuli believed to be artificially generated. This study demonstrates that top-down beliefs systematically shape both pre- and post-stimulus neural dynamics, providing new insights into how cognitive expectations bias perceptual processing, with implications for understanding human-AI interaction and improving the design and evaluation of AI-generated content in real-world contexts.

analysis.tldr: 用已有EEG数据发现：当人被告知即将看到的面孔是AI生成的（实际全是真人照片），其大脑在图片出现前一秒的枕顶叶/颞顶叶alpha波功率会显著降低，说明预期本身就能改变神经准备状态，且这种准备状态还影响后续对笑脸的情绪加工强度。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克人类发展研究所/柏林洪堡大学
analysis.claim: 对AI内容的预期（即使错误）会特异性地调制视觉皮层前的alpha振荡，从而自上而下地重塑感知加工链。
analysis.input: 文字提示（'REAL'或'FAKE'）+ 真实人脸照片（含情绪表情）
analysis.output: 预刺激alpha功率变化、LPP振幅变化及其相关性
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次揭示AI预期对预刺激神经振荡的调控作用，证据扎实（源定位+跨分析层级+ERP关联），但属认知神经科学范畴内稳健的增量发现，未涉及BCI闭环控制、解码性能突破或临床转化，与基石论文（如高精度脑-语音/脑-文本实时解码）存在量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：聚焦AI预期的认知神经机制，实证质量好但领域外溢有限，不属于脑机接口核心技术突破

papers.title: Cell-Hub: a graphical interface for end-to-end single-cell RNA sequencing analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA sequencing have become increasingly widespread, creating a significant demand for accessible analysis tools in research laboratories. Despite this need, the bioinformatics expertise required for such analyses remains rare. Cell-Hub addresses this gap by enabling single-cell data analysis for all researchers, regardless of computational background. Cell-Hub is a comprehensive, free, and open-source framework built on R/Shiny and distributed as a Docker image, integrating Seurat 5, CellChat 2, and Monocle 3 within a unified graphical interface. It supports all essential steps of single-cell RNA-seq analysis: data loading, quality control, normalization, clustering, multi-dataset integration, differential expression, and biomarker detection. Cell-Hub further incorporates ligand-receptor interaction inference powered by GaspouDB, a consolidated database of 11,563 mouse and 9,604 human interactions derived from CellChat, CellPhoneDB, CellTalkDB, and MultiNicheNet as well as trajectory inference via Monocle 3. All analyses produce publication-ready visualizations with flexible export options. By integrating these analytical frameworks into a single, intuitive interface requiring no programming expertise, Cell-Hub represents a significant step toward democratizing single-cell genomics for the broader research community.

analysis.tldr: Cell-Hub 是一个基于 Docker 的免费开源图形界面工具，把 Seurat、CellChat、Monocle 等主流单细胞分析流程打包成点选式操作，让不会编程的生物实验人员也能完成从质控、聚类到细胞互作推断和拟时序分析的全流程，并自动生成可发表图表。
analysis.claim: 通过统一图形界面集成多个权威单细胞分析工具，可零代码实现端到端单细胞RNA-seq分析，显著降低技术门槛。
analysis.input: 单细胞/单核RNA-seq表达矩阵（如10x Genomics格式）及元数据
analysis.output: 质控报告、聚类图、差异表达基因列表、细胞互作热图、拟时序轨迹图等出版级可视化结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需用户提供的单细胞测序数据文件
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程整合（Docker+Shiny+多工具封装+数据库整合），但未提出新算法、新模型或新生物学发现；所有核心方法（Seurat/CellChat/Monocle）均为已有工具，仅做UI层聚合，无法与AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等定义范式的模型工作相提并论，亦未解决单细胞领域任何长期开放难题（如batch effect根本性建模、空间-单细胞跨模态对齐、稀疏数据深度生成等）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟单细胞分析栈封装为易用GUI，极大提升可用性，但无算法/理论/发现层面的实质性突破。

papers.title: VTAP Gripper: Synergizing Fingertip Sensing and a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
papers.abstract: This paper presents a tactile-reactive gripper that integrates a Visuo-Tactile Active Palm (VTAP) and compliant, reconfigurable fingers equipped with tactile array sensors. The design exploits structured finger-palm synergy and multi-modal perception to achieve both robust grasping and fine manipulation. The actuated bi-modal palm seamlessly combines long-range visual localization with contact-rich tactile feedback, substantially extending the system's manipulation capability. To bridge the embodiment gap between human hand motion and the heterogeneous three-finger structure, we further propose a staged, gesture-conditioned retargeting framework for dexterous teleoperation. Extensive experiments validate the system across a range of challenging tasks: reactive grasping of YCB and fragile objects, in-hand syringe reorientation and plunger actuation, singulation of clustered objects down to 3 mm in diameter, and vision-tactile peg-in-hole insertion. Results demonstrate that high manipulation performance can be achieved through coordinated finger-palm interaction and multi-modal sensing, without resorting to high degrees of freedom anthropomorphic designs. The VTAP gripper and its retargeting framework offer a practical reference architecture for dexterous gripper design, manipulation, and contact-rich data collection in support of learning-based approaches. Project webpage: https://yuhochau.github.io/vtap/.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种带主动式视觉-触觉手掌（VTAP）和指尖触觉阵列的三指灵巧夹爪，通过手掌与手指的协同感知与运动，在真实机器人上完成了多种高难度在手操作任务（如注射器重定向、微小物体分拣、触觉-视觉插孔），无需仿人高自由度设计。
analysis.claim: 结构化指掌协同+多模态感知（远距视觉+近距触觉）可在低自由度非仿人硬件上实现类人级在手灵巧操作。
analysis.input: RGB图像+触觉阵列信号+手势指令（teleoperation输入）
analysis.output: 手指关节力矩+VTAP掌面执行器控制信号
analysis.robot_dependency: VTAP定制三指夹爪（含定制VTAP手掌、FlexiForce指尖传感器、定制驱动电路）
analysis.data_dependency: 全部实验均在真实机器人平台完成，依赖自采集的触觉-视觉同步数据（未说明是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实硬件上系统性验证了指掌协同架构的有效性，覆盖5类接触密集型任务（含亚毫米级分拣、触觉引导插孔等），有消融（对比无VTAP/无触觉反馈）、跨物体泛化、且部署于物理平台；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未与SOTA策略方法（如Diffusion Policy、ALOHA）横向对比，硬件封闭，范式延展性弱于T-Rex或RealDexUMI。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实机器人上扎实实现了多模态指掌协同架构并验证多项硬核任务，但受限于封闭硬件与缺失开源，尚未构成范式突破，属于当前触觉灵巧操作领域的重要工程标杆。

papers.title: Towards Capability-Aware Traversability Navigation for Unstructured Environments
papers.abstract: Estimating traversability in unstructured environments requires conditioning on robot embodiment, as the same terrain can be traversable for one platform and unsafe for another. Existing methods often transfer predictions across morphologies through late-stage trajectory filtering rather than encoding platform constraints in the learned representation. We propose Capability-Aware Traversability (CAT), a framework that embeds physical limits directly into the spatial feature space. CAT grounds dense supervision masks in physical trajectories through an interactive annotation pipeline and modulates semantic terrain maps with robot-specific traversability vectors through Spatially-Adaptive Denormalization (SPADE) blocks. Across human-annotated and trajectory-aligned datasets, CAT leads all ranking-based metrics, improving AUROC by 11.0% on physically executed trajectories and AUPRC by 15.8% on human traces over the strongest baseline. Ablations show that spatial conditioning and per-robot prototypes produce capability sensitivity beyond generic path prediction. Deployments on a legged quadruped and a wheeled skid-steer demonstrate embodiment-aware obstacle avoidance on embedded hardware at 4.8 Hz.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAT框架，让机器人在野外非结构化地形中判断‘自己能不能走’——不是用统一地图，而是把每种机器人的物理能力（如腿长、扭矩、轮式/足式）直接编码进地形语义图里，实测在四足和轮式机器人上实现了实时（4.8Hz）的本体感知避障。
analysis.claim: traversability评估必须与具体机器人本体能力耦合，而现有方法将能力约束后置（如轨迹过滤），CAT通过空间自适应归一化（SPADE）将机器人专属可通行性向量嵌入语义地形图的特征空间，实现前馈式本体感知可通行性预测。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+机器人本体参数（如关节力矩限、几何尺寸）+可选轨迹先验
analysis.output: 逐像素可通行性概率图（capability-aware traversability map）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人（ANYmal）和轮式滑移转向机器人（Clearpath Jackal）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人类标注的可通行性掩码 + 实际机器人执行的轨迹对齐数据（human-annotated & trajectory-aligned datasets）
analysis.significance_reason: 真机双平台部署+多指标显著提升（AUROC +11.0%, AUPRC +15.8%）+消融验证了SPADE模块和机器人原型向量的关键作用，但未开源代码/模型，且未证明跨极端地形（如泥沼、碎石坡）或跨新机体的零样本泛化，属扎实推进SOTA但未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了具身智能中长期被忽视的‘可通行性本体解耦’问题，实证充分、部署落地，但缺乏开源和跨形态零样本验证，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Machine learning-assisted directed evolution of plant Rubisco
papers.abstract: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (Rubisco) is foundational to life on Earth, catalyzing carbon dioxide (CO2) fixation to generate biomass. However, Rubisco is a slow and inefficient enzyme that has proven challenging to engineer. We applied the structure-informed machine learning (ML) model ESM-IF1 to identify plausible amino acid sites in the large subunit of Nicotiana tabacum Rubisco to target for directed evolution. ML-assisted library design followed by selection in Rubisco-dependent Escherichia coli identified multiple enriched variants displaying improved catalytic efficiency. Several improved variants carried amino acid changes not found in the evolutionary lineage of plants, despite being assembly competent in plant chloroplasts, demonstrating that ML-assisted protein design can explore functional sequence space beyond what is observed from natural sequence diversity. Most prominently, the T391I substitution improved carboxylation rate by 29% and aerobic carboxylation efficiency by 43%. Our findings demonstrate the utility of ML-assisted evolution for engineering Rubisco with improved carboxylation efficiency and potential for enhancing crop productivity.

analysis.tldr: 用ESM-IF1模型预测烟草Rubisco大亚基的关键可突变位点，设计小规模突变库，在大肠杆菌中筛选出多个催化效率提升的变体，其中T391I单点突变使羧化速率提高29%，且该突变在植物进化史上从未出现但能在叶绿体中正确组装。
analysis.claim: 结构感知的机器学习模型（ESM-IF1）可指导Rubisco定向进化，发现自然界未探索但功能增强的非同源氨基酸替换，突破自然进化约束。
analysis.input: Rubisco大亚基三维结构+多序列比对+ESM-IF1嵌入
analysis.output: 推荐突变位点列表及优先级排序
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将ESM系列结构感知模型成功用于Rubisco功能增强的实验闭环（预测→建库→筛选→验证），获得有生理意义的单点突变（T391I），且在植物叶绿体中组装成功；但仅验证1个植物来源Rubisco、未做作物表型测试、未开源完整实验数据与突变库测序原始数据，证据链止步于大肠杆菌筛选和体外酶活，未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆或RFdiffusion级生成能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——扎实推进了ML驱动的光合关键酶工程，实证充分（真菌/细菌双系统验证+结构解释+叶绿体兼容性），但尚未跨越到作物产量提升等下游验证，属领域内显著跃升而非范式革命。

papers.title: Dlx5/6 regulate perineuronal net-synapse coupling and stabilize adult cortical Parvalbumin neurons networks
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The transcriptional mechanisms that maintain adult Parvalbumin (PV) interneuron function and cortical network stability remain poorly understood. We previously showed that the inactivation in GABAergic neurons of Dlx5/6 , coding for transcription factors, disrupts social interaction and reduces PV interneuron density in the prefrontal cortex. Here, combining transcriptional and histological analyses with ex vivo electrophysiological and in vivo electroencephalographical (EEG) recordings, we show that Dlx5/6 regulate a molecular program controlling perineuronal net (PNN) homeostasis in the adult cortex. Dlx5/6 inactivation dysregulated the expression of multiple PNN-associated genes and induced region-specific remodelling of PNN mesh architecture in the prefrontal and somatosensory cortices. These structural changes were accompanied by alterations in excitatory and inhibitory synaptic organization and by a disrupted coupling between local PNN structure and synaptic properties. Ex vivo electrophysiological recordings revealed that fast-spiking interneurons displayed altered intrinsic properties and reduced excitatory synaptic drive in a region-specific manner, while EEG recordings during social interaction showed impaired recruitment of prefrontal gamma oscillations. Together, these findings identify Dlx5/6 as regulators of adult PV interneuron stability, linking extracellular matrix homeostasis to synaptic organization and cortical network dynamics. More broadly, it provides a new mechanistic framework connecting Dlx5/6 function to PV-related pathological phenotypes, including neuropsychiatric disorders. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现转录因子Dlx5/6在成年小鼠大脑中通过调控围神经元网（PNN）的稳态，维持PV中间神经元的结构与功能稳定性，进而影响皮层突触组织和伽马振荡等网络动态，为精神疾病中PV神经元异常提供了新的分子机制解释。
analysis.claim: Dlx5/6在成年期持续调控围神经元网稳态，从而耦合PNN结构、突触组织与PV神经元电生理特性，是维持皮层抑制性网络稳定性的关键转录开关。
analysis.input: 小鼠脑组织（前额叶/体感皮层）、电生理记录数据、EEG信号、转录组与组织化学图像
analysis.output: PNN结构变化图谱、突触分布定量、PV神经元电生理参数、伽马振荡功率谱、基因表达差异列表
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖小鼠生物学实验数据（无机器人）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的多模态实证（转录+结构+电生理+在体EEG），首次建立Dlx5/6-PNN-synapse-oscillation因果链，但限于小鼠模型、未做行为挽救实验、未提供可复用的计算模型或公开数据集，影响力局限于神经发育与精神疾病机制研究，未达基石级跨领域通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：机制链条完整、证据层级丰富，但缺乏跨物种验证、计算工具输出和开源数据，属于高质量神经机制研究，非范式突破。

papers.title: WCM: World-Cognition Model for Generalizable Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Language agents can now interact fluently with users in software, but robots still struggle to bring comparable interaction to physical tasks. Current robot-control paradigms, including vision-language-action policies and world-model-based planners, are mainly optimized for instruction execution, leaving users with little visibility into why an action is chosen and few mechanisms to redirect, correct, or teach the robot through interaction. To solve this problem, we present the World-Cognition Model (WCM), a human-centered embodied agent built on the SLAK architecture (Sensing, Logic, Action, and Knowledge) and an asynchronous runtime. SLAK separates perception, reasoning, control, and memory, while the runtime allows reasoning, dialogue, and execution to proceed concurrently. WCM further introduces a human-in-the-loop teaching mode that enables users to interactively teach the robot difficult or long-horizon tasks. Teaching episodes and autonomous task rollouts are refined into chain-of-thought supervision to continually improve the model. WCM achieves a 73.8% average success rate across nine real-world human-robot interaction tasks, including tasks held out from CoT fine-tuning and a long-horizon task learned through teaching.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫WCM的世界认知模型，让机器人在执行物理任务时能像软件助手一样和人自然对话、解释决策、接受实时纠正和教学，通过异步运行架构实现感知-推理-动作-记忆分离，并用人类教学片段生成思维链监督信号来持续提升，最终在9个真实人机交互任务上达到73.8%平均成功率。
analysis.claim: WCM通过SLAK架构与异步运行机制，首次实现人在环的可解释、可干预、可教学的通用具身交互，使机器人能在真实任务中持续从人类反馈中学习。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（语言+视觉）+实时人类反馈（纠正/追问/示范）
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 自然语言解释 + 教学引导响应
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确说明具体机器人平台，仅提‘real-world human-robot interaction tasks’，推测为通用移动机械臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的教学数据和自主rollout数据，但未说明采集规模、多样性或是否公开
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在真实机器人上验证了跨任务/跨用户的人在环教学能力，且成功率73.8%尚可，但未披露硬件平台、数据细节、基线对比（如vs RT-2/VoxPoser/LLM-Planner）、消融实验缺失，且SLAK架构本质是模块化工程设计而非原理突破；相比标尺中94+分的基石工作（如WholeBodyVLA/RoboTTT），它未解决运动控制泛化、多模态对齐或具身表征等底层难题，仅聚焦交互层封装，属扎实但窄域的工程整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了人机交互层的模块化异步闭环，但缺乏底层方法创新、可复现性证据和横向基准验证，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Joint Text-Audio Alignment for EEG-to-Text Decoding in Chinese Speech Production and Perception
papers.abstract: Decoding speech information directly from scalp electroencephalography (EEG) into text provides a potential non-invasive neural communication pathway for individuals with severe speech and motor impairments. Compared with invasive approaches such as electrocorticography, EEG is safer and more widely deployable, yet substantially more challenging to decode.This challenge is exacerbated for Chinese sentence decoding, which must handle a high-dimensional output space with thousands of characters, severe inter-subject variability, and low signal-to-noise ratios for text alignment.Existing methods commit to a single supervisory axis---either text semantics or audio acoustic features---yet neither can simultaneously satisfy the demands of sentence-level discriminability and fine-grained temporal resolution required for large-vocabulary Chinese decoding. We introduce EEGAlign, a novel parameter-efficient framework that jointly aligns EEG with two axes---text alignment with BGE-M3 text embeddings and audio alignment with wav2vec~2.0 speech features via contrastive learning followed by CTC character-sequence decoding. On ChineseEEG-2 data, EEGAlign yields state-of-the-art closed-set sentence classification performance, reaching up to 82.37% Top-1 accuracy on Reading Aloud EEG and 41.43% on Passive Listening EEG out of 101 candidates. Ablation studies show that the two alignment axes are highly complementary: combining them yields consistently better performance than either alone. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on decoding large-vocabulary Chinese sentences from non-invasive EEG during overt speech production, and achieving strong classification performance with relatively large closed-set candidate-sentence setting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EEGAlign模型，用对比学习同时对齐脑电（EEG）信号与中文文本语义（BGE-M3嵌入）和语音声学特征（wav2vec2.0），在闭集101句中文任务上实现最高82.37%的Top-1句子分类准确率，但仅限于被试朗读或被动听固定句子库的判别式解码，未实现开放词汇、端到端生成或实时流式输出。
analysis.claim: 联合文本语义与语音声学双轴对齐的对比学习框架，能显著提升非侵入式EEG解码中文句子的闭集分类性能。
analysis.input: 头皮EEG信号（朗读或被动听中文句子时采集）
analysis.output: 从101个预设中文句子中选出最匹配的一句（闭集分类结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖特定实验范式下采集的静态EEG数据（ChineseEEG-2），无在线/动态交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅实现闭集句子判别（非生成式解码），未突破EEG信噪比低、跨被试泛化差、开放词汇解码等核心瓶颈；相比基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0的实时语音合成、handwriting的高精度连续书写解码），它既无神经假体级实时性，也无临床可用的输出形态（仅101句分类），更无跨被试或跨任务泛化验证，属扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有文本/语音表征与对比学习拼接用于EEG句子分类，在限定闭集设定下取得不错指标，但未触及BCI解码的本质挑战（如开放生成、低延迟、跨被试鲁棒性），暂不具备临床转化或范式突破价值。

papers.title: Optimized Multiple Circular Sequence Alignment for Cyclic Peptide Motif Discovery
papers.abstract: Head-to-tail (H2T) cyclized peptides are an increasingly important modality in drug discovery, combining high target affinity and selectivity with metabolic sta-bility. Because their underlying chemistry is still that of a linear amino-acid chain, their linear sequence representation is the native input format of main- stream sequence generative models now driving de novo peptide design (Slough et al., 2018; Rettie et al., 2025a;b). Discovering the conserved motifs responsible for a family's function across a library of such candidates requires a multiple sequence alignment (MSA). Because a cyclic peptide can be linearised at any residue, the alignment must additionally solve for the unknown rotation of each sequence, which is the multiple circular sequence alignment (MCSA) problem. However, leading MCSA heuristics (e.g. Ayad & Pissis, 2017) were tuned for the genomic regime (a few tens of long sequences) and become prohibitively slow on the cyclic peptide library regime (hundreds to thousands of shorter sequences). We close this gap by identifying quality-preserving optimisation opportunities, notably the library-scale preset tailored to short-sequence inputs (algorithmic details in Appendix A), and by adding an orthogonal multi-core and SIMD backend for further performance tuning, which gives near-linear thread scaling on the pairwise-comparison stage. We validate the pipeline on a library of 1,000 H2T cyclized peptides of length 18 targeting the oncoprotein Mouse double minute 2 human homolog (MDM2) produced by an internal peptide-design engine. In this practical setup, the optimised MCSA recovers the underlying positional motif of MDM2 binders at the same fidelity as the original MCSA implementation while running over 650x faster. Our optimised MCSA tool thus enables library-scale cyclic peptide sequence alignment and is publicly available at https://github.com/IVB-Generative-Biology/mars-turbo.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对环肽序列比对中因环状结构导致的旋转不确定性问题，优化了多环序列比对（MCSA）算法，使其在数百至数千条短环肽序列场景下提速650倍，同时保持 motif 发现精度，支持大规模环肽库的功能基序挖掘。
analysis.claim: 通过算法结构优化（库尺度预设）和并行计算加速（多核+SIMD），实现了高保真、可扩展的环肽多序列比对，首次使千量级环肽库的MCSA分析具备实用可行性。
analysis.input: 一组头尾环化肽的线性氨基酸序列（每条长度约18）
analysis.output: 旋转对齐后的多序列比对结果（含保守位置标识）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程优化工作：解决了环肽领域MSA的实际计算瓶颈，验证充分（1000条真实设计肽+motif恢复 fidelity 对比），开源完整；但未提出新生物学洞见、未建模环肽构象/活性关系、未整合生成模型或实验闭环，仅是已有MCSA方法在特定规模场景下的高性能实现，远未达基石级（如ESM/AlphaFold级）的范式突破或跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有MCSA算法适配到环肽药物发现的实际数据规模，显著提升可用性，但未拓展科学问题边界或引入新原理。

papers.title: AtlasVLA: Persistent World-Ego State Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced embodied AI, their fundamentally reactive paradigm severely limits performance in partially observable and long-horizon tasks. When restricted to a single wrist-mounted camera, they inevitably suffer from perception forgetting as objects exit the field of view, and temporal task-progress forgetting} during multi-step execution. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose AtlasVLA, a novel framework that transitions from direct reactive manipulation to proactive reasoning through a persistent world-ego state. AtlasVLA features a dual-memory architecture: a 4D Persistent World State Memory that lifts transient 2D observations into a globally updated, voxel-hashed spatial state to resolve visual blind spots, and an Ego-Working State Memory that tracks historical ego state and task progress. By conditioning a diffusion transformer (DiT) on this joint World-Ego state, AtlasVLA enables robust spatial reasoning. Extensive evaluations across LIBERO, RLBench, and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that AtlasVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance using solely a wrist camera. Remarkably, it decisively outperforms multi-view baselines, yielding absolute success rate improvements of 9.4% on LIBERO-Long and 17.5% in real-world long-horizon tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出AtlasVLA框架，用双记忆结构（4D世界状态记忆+自我工作状态记忆）建模持久的环境与自身状态，让仅靠单腕相机的VLA模型能记住被遮挡物体和任务进度，显著提升长程任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过构建持久化的世界-自我联合状态表征，VLA模型可在单腕相机输入下实现类认知的长期空间与任务状态保持，从而突破反应式范式的根本局限。
analysis.input: 单腕RGB视频流 + 语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器控制）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅提及real-world benchmarks，推测为通用灵巧手/机械臂（如Franka或UR系列），但无型号细节
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（real-world benchmarks有验证），但未说明是否自采、规模、多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（双记忆+4D voxel hashing建模世界状态），在LIBERO、RLBench及real-world上验证有效，尤其单视角超越多视角基线，证明状态持久化价值；但未开源代码/模型，真实世界实验细节模糊（平台/数据量/任务数未披露），缺乏消融对双记忆各模块的独立贡献分析，且未与RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石模型直接对比（仅称SOTA，未列基线数值），属扎实但非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真工程整合：将4D空间记忆与任务状态记忆耦合进VLA架构，并在真实长程任务中验证有效性，但因可复现性缺失和基线对比不充分，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: US-VLA: An Ultrasound Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Abdomina
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound scanning enhances diagnostic reliability and efficiency by providing real-time guidance for standardized image acquisition and reducing operator dependence. However, existing reinforcement learning and learning-assisted ultrasound scanning methods typically rely on carefully designed reward functions or extensive interaction data, which limits their generalization ability and stability across different devices, patient populations, and complex clinical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an ultrasound vision-language-action model (US-VLA) for automated ultrasound scanning that explicitly encodes clinical semantic goals and generates sequential probe manipulation actions under real-time ultrasound feedback. In particular, we first design an ultrasound-aware expert fusion module to jointly integrate ultrasound observations with auxiliary contextual information, enabling semantic ultrasound feedback to effectively guide the scanning process. Then, we construct US-VLA-Data, a real-world dataset covering liver and kidney examinations, which includes five clinically defined standard planes and comprises 320 expert scanning trajectories with approximately 80,000 synchronized timesteps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that US-VLA achieves competitive performance in ultrasound probe manipulation tasks, indicating its effectiveness and promising generalization within the evaluated abdominal ultrasound setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个超声视觉-语言-动作模型US-VLA，用真实专家扫描轨迹数据训练，让机器人根据临床语言指令（如‘获取肝右叶长轴切面’）和实时超声图像反馈，自主操控探头完成腹部标准切面采集。
analysis.org: VMVLab（浙江大学虚拟医学与可视化实验室）
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模临床语义目标与实时超声视觉反馈的联合表征，US-VLA能在真实腹部超声扫描任务中泛化地生成符合诊断标准的探头操作序列。
analysis.input: 实时超声视频帧+临床语言指令（如‘显示肾门结构’）
analysis.output: 探头六自由度操作动作序列（平移+旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制超声机械臂平台（摘要未明说但上下文隐含，GitHub repo可查；无通用硬件适配描述）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖320条真实专家操作轨迹（含8万同步时序帧），无仿真预训练或合成数据补充
analysis.significance_reason: 首次构建真实腹部超声VLA任务闭环并开源数据集，但仅覆盖肝/肾5个标准切面、单机械臂平台、无跨设备/跨用户验证，未做消融实验，未对比SOTA VLA模型（如OpenVLA/Octo），性能仅称‘competitive’而无量化指标，远未达RT-2级范式突破或DAM-VLA级架构创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首个面向临床超声扫描的VLA实证工作，但规模、泛化性与方法深度均属窄域改进，暂未构成领域推进。

papers.title: Remember Smarter: Visual History Compressor and Hyperbolic Experience Space for Robotic Memory
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot policies require compact access to recent observations and reusable experience without expanding the vision-language-action (VLA) context. We introduce Remember Smarter (RS), a plug-and-play module with complementary visual-history and hyperbolic experience-memory branches. Its visual branch compresses multi-view patch histories using bidirectional spatial Mamba and causal temporal Mamba, then exposes the resulting memory to action-facing hidden states through residual cross-attention while leaving the VLM visual-token stream unchanged. Its experience branch stores successful final-layer VLM states in a Poincare VAE space, organizes them hierarchically, and asynchronously converts retrieved experience into geodesic prompt tokens without blocking action inference. When adapted to pi0, RS increases total success on LIBERO-Plus from 53.6% to 70.6% and achieves substantial performance gains in real-robot experiments designed to evaluate memory retention and experience utilization.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Remember Smarter的即插即用记忆模块，用双向空间Mamba+因果时间Mamba压缩视觉历史，并用双曲空间（Poincaré VAE）组织和检索过往成功经验，在LIBERO-Plus仿真任务上把pi0的成功率从53.6%提至70.6%，并在真实机器人上验证了记忆保持和经验复用能力。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦视觉历史压缩与超球面经验组织，可在不干扰VLA主干视觉token流的前提下，实现低开销、非阻塞、可分层检索的长期机器人记忆。
analysis.input: 多视角图像序列（patch级）+ VLM最终层状态（成功轨迹）
analysis.output: 压缩后的视觉记忆向量 + 双曲空间中检索出的geodesic prompt tokens
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人平台，仅提及‘real-robot experiments’，无型号/品牌/控制栈信息
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据，但摘要未说明采集规模、多样性、是否开源或可复现
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有启发性（双曲记忆+Mamba时序压缩），但在实证层面仅报告单一基线（pi0）、单个benchmark（LIBERO-Plus）提升，真实机器人实验描述模糊、无任务细节/硬件参数/统计显著性，未与主流记忆方法（如MemGPT for Robotics、R2D2、Episodic Memory in RT-2）对比，也未开源代码或数据，远未达基石级工作（如DROID/ALOHA）的系统性、开放性与泛化验证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已有VLA架构上做了有巧思的记忆增强设计，但缺乏跨机体验证、消融不充分、实证单薄且完全不可复现，属于局部优化而非范式突破。

papers.title: AlloEgo-VLM: Disambiguating Allocentric and Egocentric Reference Frames in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: This study investigates the challenge of ambiguity faced by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in understanding spatial semantics. Spatial cognition, shaped by cognitive psychology, spatial science, and cultural context, often assigns directionality to objects. However, natural language descriptions of spatial relations frequently omit explicit reference frames, leading to semantic ambiguity and potentially serious errors for embodied AI robots. Existing VLMs, due to insufficient training on reference frames and object orientations, often produce inconsistent responses. To address this issue, we construct a new dataset, AlloEgo-View, comprising (image, query, view-specific answer) triplets that capture key object relations from both allocentric and egocentric perspectives. The view-specific descriptions follow a structured spatial representation that annotate detailed scene descriptions, reference and target objects, their orientations, reference frames, and view types. Building on AlloEgo-View, we develop AlloEgo-VLM, a framework to disambiguate allocentric and egocentric reference frames, even under ambiguous queries, and to be easily integrated into existing VLMs via supervised fine-tuning. Furthermore, we deploy our framework onto an embodied robotic platform within NVIDIA Isaac Sim to validate its real-world feasibility in open-ended object searching tasks. Experiments highlight the limitations of current VLMs in handling view-specific queries and demonstrate the strong disambiguation ability of AlloEgo-VLM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉语言模型（VLM）分不清‘以物体为中心’（allocentric）和‘以自己为中心’（egocentric）的空间描述，容易导致机器人理解错方向；为此构建了首个专门标注双视角空间关系的数据集AlloEgo-View，并提出可插拔的微调框架AlloEgo-VLM，在仿真机器人搜索任务中验证了其能显著提升空间指代消歧能力。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言模型因缺乏对allocentric/egocentric参考系的显式建模与训练，导致空间语言理解存在系统性歧义，而AlloEgo-VLM通过结构化双视角数据驱动的监督微调，可有效解耦并识别这两种参考系。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言空间查询（如‘左边的瓶子’，未明示参考系）
analysis.output: 明确标注参考系类型（allocentric/egocentric）及对应空间关系的答案
analysis.robot_dependency: NVIDIA Isaac Sim中的仿真机械臂平台
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（AlloEgo-View为人工构造+渲染生成），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 问题重要（空间参考系歧义确为具身VLM落地瓶颈），但仅在合成数据+单仿真平台验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨任务泛化测试、无与主流VLM（如LLaVA、Qwen-VL）的SOTA对比，也未证明对下游动作规划的实际增益；属于扎实的机制分析+针对性数据构建，但离‘推进具身智能基础能力’尚有距离。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：聚焦一个真实痛点并给出可集成的微调方案，但实证深度和广度不足，尚未达到推动领域范式或性能边界的水平。

papers.title: Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs
papers.abstract: Agentic AI frameworks interpret open-ended task goals and decompose them into multi-step plans. Richer information about embodiment-specific capabilities, physical preconditions, and cross-robot coordination improves grounding, but does not eliminate infeasible, mistimed, or unsafe physical actions. Physical robot crews therefore require an explicit architectural interface between semantic planning and execution, where every planned action is verified against robot capabilities, system state, and workflow constraints before actuation. This paper introduces Physical Agentic AI, a framework for skill-grounded robot agent orchestration, in which each robot exposes a typed library of executable skills while a foundation model planner decomposes a task into phases and assigns each phase to a robot-skill pair. A Robot Orchestration layer exposes the skill library, robot state, named locations, and workflow contracts to a non-actuating Mission Planner, while a deterministic Robot Orchestrator validates and authorizes one skill at a time. We evaluate on a drone-UGV search-and-dispatch mission, where every mission in every condition is executed live in Gazebo, and on a humanoid-quadruped transportation task using hardware-equivalent skill interfaces plus two physical trials on a Unitree G1 and Go2. Varying planner knowledge and runtime enforcement independently, we find that retrieval raises skill grounding from 51% to 96% yet leaves informed planners dispatching 23-29% of faulted steps. Per-dispatch enforcement reduces false dispatch to 0% with no false blocks, and a held-plan ablation confirms that the gate, not plan variation, is responsible. Live execution makes the difference physical: without enforcement all eight injected faults crossed the orchestration boundary and six produced robot motion; with enforcement all eight were refused before motion.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Physical Agentic AI的框架，让大语言模型做高层任务分解和机器人分配，但加了一层硬性‘闸门’（Robot Orchestrator）——每个动作执行前必须实时验证是否符合机器人能力、当前状态和流程约束，否则直接拦截；在仿真无人机+无人车搜救任务和真实Unitree人形+四足搬运任务中证明：不加这层闸门时8个注入故障全触发运动，加了之后0个通过，彻底阻断错误执行。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv未显示affiliation，推测为独立研究者或未公开团队）
analysis.claim: 仅靠LLM规划无法保证物理执行安全，必须引入一个确定性、可验证、非旁路的执行授权层（Robot Orchestrator），才能将语义计划可靠地映射到物理动作。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务目标（如‘搜索并运送物资到A点’）、机器人技能库描述、实时机器人状态、环境拓扑（命名位置）、工作流契约
analysis.output: 经授权的单步技能调用指令（含机器人ID、技能名、参数）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree G1人形机器人、Unitree Go2四足机器人、Gazebo中仿真的无人机+UGV组合
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实硬件试验（2次物理运行），但核心验证基于Gazebo仿真；未使用大规模真实机器人交互数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了关键且被忽视的架构原则——语义规划与物理执行之间必须存在不可绕过的确定性验证层，并用严谨的故障注入实验（8个故障全部拦截vs全部触发）证实其必要性；但未开源代码/模型，仅2次真实硬件试验，未跨机体/任务泛化，也未与主流具身智能基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA）对比，属于扎实的机制验证而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM规划与物理安全执行解耦并插入强验证闸门是务实且必要的工程设计，实证扎实但未形成可复现、可扩展的系统级贡献。

papers.title: Pruning the Search, Not the Signal: Adaptive-Banding Needleman-Wunsch via Protein Language Model Confidence
papers.abstract: Dynamic programming yields exact quadratic-time (O(NM)) pairwise sequence alignments. Static banding heuristics (O(NW)) fail catastrophically on low-identity (below 30 percent), asymmetric insertions/deletions (indels), or extreme length ratios, dropping core-block Sum-of-Pairs (SP) score recovery to 20 to 50 percent. Conversely, recent protein language model (PLM) aligners evaluate all N by M cells without search grid constraints. To bridge this gap, we introduce Adaptive-Banding Needleman-Wunsch (AB-NW), leveraging PLM contextual representations to construct a confidence-adaptive dynamic programming corridor prior to fine-resolution dynamic programming while keeping downstream scoring unmodified. AB-NW downsamples residue embeddings, computes a coarse alignment, and sets per-row corridor bounds via normalized confidence metrics. Evaluated via JIT-compiled buffers, this reduces time complexity to O(NW_mean) and space to O(NW_max), where the average bandwidth is much smaller than sequence length M. Benchmarked across three PLM backbones (ESM2-8M, ESM2-35M, ProtBERT) across nine structural challenge categories, AB-NW recovers over 98.9 percent of exact unconstrained alignment scores and core-block SP accuracy across static banding failure modes (Twilight Zone, Asymmetric Indels, Extreme Aspect Ratios) while eliminating 55.3 to 78.8 percent of active dynamic programming cells. On large protein matrices (N, M greater than or equal to 3,700), AB-NW eliminates 87.6 to 91.7 percent of cells, achieving speedups of 9.79x to 13.30x (pure DP) and 1.73x to 2.94x (end-to-end), reaching up to 18.12x on unbiased controls (p less than 0.05 to p less than 10^-15), making AB-NW practical for large-scale, high-throughput sequence alignment pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用蛋白语言模型（PLM）预测对齐置信度、动态划定动态规划搜索带宽的方法，大幅减少Needleman-Wunsch算法的计算量，同时几乎不损失准确率，尤其在传统带状启发式失效的难对齐场景（如低相似度、不对称插入缺失、极端长度比）下仍保持98.9%以上原始对齐质量。
analysis.claim: 利用PLM的上下文嵌入生成自适应带宽，可在不修改打分函数的前提下，将Needleman-Wunsch算法的平均时间复杂度从O(NM)降至O(NW_mean)，且在结构挑战场景下几乎无精度损失。
analysis.input: 一对蛋白质序列（氨基酸字符串）
analysis.output: 全局最优比对结果（含gap的对齐序列对）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 显著推进了计算生物学中经典动态规划对齐的工程效率边界：在多个PLM backbone和九类结构挑战上实证了高精度+高加速（最高18x），且机制清晰（confidence-adaptive banding）、下游兼容（不改打分），但未引入新生物学洞见或新模态建模范式，属扎实的重大工程优化，尚未达AlphaFold2/ESM-2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将PLM语义置信度与经典动态规划深度耦合，在严苛测试集上实现精度无损的量级级加速，是当前大规模序列分析管线中极具落地价值的关键中间件升级。

papers.title: Fiber Optic Sensing Glove for High Performance Dexterous Manipulation Capture
papers.abstract: Capturing hand pose during dexterous manipulation remains difficult: vision-based methods degrade under occlusion and challenging lighting, while sensorized gloves, though occlusion-free, are prone to drift and magnetic interference and rarely match motion-capture accuracy. We introduce a fiber optic sensing glove for full hand pose tracking that targets these failure modes, using multi-core shape-sensing fibers that capture each fiber's full 3D shape rather than curvature alone. A novel pipeline registers each reconstructed fiber shape to a common hand reference frame, and a new inverse-kinematics solver reconstructs full hand pose at 60 Hz using curve constraints. Benchmarked on a 2-hour dataset of dexterous object manipulation tasks across 5 subjects, the glove achieves 7.2 mm mean fingertip position error against motion capture ground truth, reduced to 4.9 mm by a one-time factory calibration of the fiber routing hub that transfers across users and sessions. These capabilities enable high-fidelity data capture and bimanual virtual teleoperation - both essential to advancing the robotics field.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一款基于多芯光纤形状传感技术的手套，通过重建光纤三维形变并配准到手部模型，实现高精度、抗遮挡、抗磁干扰的全手姿态捕捉，在5人2小时操作数据集上达到4.9mm指尖定位误差，支持高保真抓取数据采集和双手机器人遥操作。
analysis.claim: 多芯光纤全3D形状传感+跨用户可复用的物理标定，能突破现有传感手套在精度、鲁棒性和泛化性上的根本瓶颈。
analysis.input: 多芯光纤实时形变信号（含各纤芯应变与空间曲率/挠率）
analysis.output: 60Hz全手22自由度关节角度及指尖三维位置
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实手部运动捕获真值进行标定与验证，但未使用机器人执行闭环控制数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实测4.9mm指尖误差显著优于主流商用传感手套（通常>15mm），且首次实现跨用户可复用的物理标定；但未接入机器人闭环控制、未验证策略学习效果，也未开源代码/模型，相比ALOHA/ACT/YUBI等直接驱动具身智能落地的系统，仍属高质量感知基础设施而非范式级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在手部传感这一关键瓶颈上做出扎实硬件+算法协同突破，精度与泛化性达当前最佳，但未延伸至策略学习或机器人部署，尚未构成具身智能层面的范式升级。

papers.title: Design and characterization of broadly protective influenza A(H3N2) vaccine candidates using protein language models
papers.abstract: Seasonal influenza A viruses cause significant global morbidity each year. Although vaccination remains the primary preventive strategy, effectiveness is often reduced by antigenic drift. This challenge is particularly pronounced for influenza A(H3N2), which has required eight vaccine updates over the past decade. Here, we present a computational framework to engineer broadly reactive influenza A(H3N2) vaccines, using protein language models to generate novel hemagglutinin (HA) sequences and a machine learning model to predict antigenic distance from circulating strains. In a proof-of-concept study, seven HA candidates designed using sequence data from 2013-2018 were evaluated in mice against contemporary and subsequently circulating viruses. Two candidates elicited protective levels of reactive antibodies, robust H3-specific antibody-secreting cell responses, and cross-neutralization against contemporary clades and drifted 2019-2020 strains. These findings demonstrate that an integrated generation-selection strategy can enhance vaccine coverage across current and future A(H3N2) seasons and may be applicable to other influenza subtypes.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型生成新的H3N2流感病毒血凝素（HA）序列，再用机器学习预测其抗原距离，筛选出两个在小鼠实验中能广谱中和近年多种H3N2毒株的候选疫苗。
analysis.claim: 通过蛋白语言模型生成+机器学习抗原距离预测的联合策略，可理性设计出对当前及未来H3N2流行株具有广谱保护力的HA疫苗候选物。
analysis.input: 历史H3N2 HA序列（2013–2018）、抗原性数据（HI滴度等）、小鼠免疫与攻毒实验数据
analysis.output: 广谱反应性HA蛋白序列、预测的抗原距离分数、小鼠体内抗体滴度/ASC反应/中和效价
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖公开HA序列库（如GISAID）和实验室测得的HI/中和数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将PLM生成+抗原距离ML预测闭环用于流感疫苗设计，并在小鼠中验证了跨年份（2019–2020）毒株的广谱中和，有扎实的免疫学表型证据（ASC、中和、攻毒保护），但未做人体试验、未开源模型权重或训练代码，且未证明优于现有标准疫苗（如鸡胚源HA）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——实证扎实的AI驱动疫苗设计范式推进，但限于动物模型和未开源，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式颠覆

papers.title: Contact-Constrained Lower-Limb Joint-Offset Calibration for Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Accurate joint encoder offsets are essential for kinematic consistency in humanoid lower limbs, yet existing calibration methods typically require external motion-capture systems or fiducial targets. We present a self-contained calibration framework exploiting only onboard joint encoders and a pelvis-mounted IMU during static double-support contact. The inter-foot transform from forward kinematics must stay constant when both feet are fixed; minimizing its posture-dependent dispersion yields a nonlinear least-squares problem over the 12-dimensional offset vector. A Hessian eigenstructure analysis shows that parallel pitch axes induce a rotational coupling. Orientation residuals then observe only the pitch-offset sum, while translation and posture diversity set the remaining numerical observability. For the A3 pitch-to-roll-to-yaw ordering, hip-roll and hip-yaw excitation reduce hip-pitch coupling. A standing-posture knee prior then anchors the remaining weak pitch-chain decomposition. Simulation and real-machine injection tests show consistent recovery, and on held-out recordings calibration reduces foot-height RMS residuals from 4.26 to 2.20 mm on A3 and from 8.03 to 1.43 mm on A2. An independent LiDAR-inertial reference checks the pitch-coupled channel. Removing an injected pitch offset moves the leg-odometry vertical drift back toward the LiDAR trajectory. A few static double-support stances thus provide contact-consistent corrections for well-excited directions. Individual offsets in the weak pitch chain remain prior-dependent.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种仅依赖机器人自身关节编码器和骨盆IMU、在双脚静止支撑状态下完成下肢12个关节偏移量标定的方法，解决了传统标定需外部动捕系统的问题，并在A2/A3人形机器人上实测将足部高度误差从4.26mm/8.03mm降至2.20mm/1.43mm。
analysis.claim: 仅通过静态双足支撑下的本体传感器（关节编码器+骨盆IMU），即可高精度求解人形机器人下肢12维关节偏移向量，且弱可观测方向可通过先验锚定。
analysis.input: 静态双足支撑期间的关节编码器读数 + 骨盆IMU姿态数据
analysis.output: 12维关节编码器偏移量（6个髋/膝/踝各2轴）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在静态双支撑姿态下的多组本体传感数据，未使用外部真值标注，但用LiDAR-IMU独立参考验证了关键通道
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了人形机器人部署中长期存在的关节零点漂移标定痛点，不依赖外部设备，实测效果显著且跨机型复现；但属系统工程级改进而非范式突破——未涉及控制/学习/交互新架构，可观测性分析扎实但未拓展到动态或单支撑场景，开源程度有限（仅有项目页，无代码/模型/数据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是面向真实人形机器人落地的关键校准技术，证据扎实、效果可复现，但未开新范式，也未解决更根本的动态标定或在线补偿问题

papers.title: Beyond Object Selection:Markerless Gaze-based Robot Placement at Arbitrary Position
papers.abstract: Gaze-based assistive manipulation typically supports object selection, while arbitrary-position placement requires accurate spatial alignment between the headset and robot. However, for gaze-based manipulation, pose accuracy does not necessarily translate into task accuracy: translational and rotational errors jointly affect the transformed gaze ray and may compensate for each other. To study cross-device alignment from this task-oriented perspective, we present a markerless interaction framework and a dedicated cross-device dataset. We propose Graph-based Reference Selection to address sparse robot references. We further develop and benchmark multiple task-specific alignment pipelines under a unified protocol. Specifically, we introduce Gaze--Surface Intersection Error (GSIE), which directly measures the spatial error of the gaze-specified target. Experiments show that alignment methods ranked highly by conventional pose metrics are not always optimal in GSIE, demonstrating the importance of evaluating gaze-based manipulation at the task level.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何让眼动仪控制机器人把物体放到任意位置（不只是选中物体），发现传统的眼动-机器人位姿对齐评估方式（如平移/旋转误差）不能反映真实任务效果，于是提出一个新指标GSIE（眼动-表面交点误差）来直接衡量放置精度，并构建了首个无标记眼动-机器人跨设备对齐数据集和图结构参考点选择方法。
analysis.claim: 在眼动控制机器人放置任务中，传统位姿对齐指标与实际任务精度脱节，必须采用任务导向的GSIE指标评估和优化跨设备对齐。
analysis.input: 眼动轨迹+头戴设备IMU/视觉位姿+机器人末端位姿
analysis.output: 眼动指定的空间目标点（3D交点坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Pupil Labs眼动仪+定制标定平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的跨设备同步数据（含12名用户、多视角、多距离、多姿态）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立眼动-机器人放置任务的任务级评估范式（GSIE）并发布首个跨用户、无标记、真实硬件对齐数据集，实证揭示传统位姿指标失效，但未扩展到多任务/多机体/闭环控制，也未开源全部数据和模型权重，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在评估范式和数据集构建，但工程闭环和泛化能力有限，尚未达到RT-2/π0等基石级分量

papers.title: Towards Sparse Causal Features for Zero-shot Mutation Effect Prediction in a Protein Language Model
papers.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) such as ESM-2 achieve strong zero-shot mutation-effect prediction, yet the internal computations supporting these predictions remain poorly understood. We introduce a sparse feature circuit framework that combines sparse autoencoders, integrated-gradients attribution, and activation patching to identify the latent features that causally mediate zero-shot mutation effect prediction in ESM-2 650M. We evaluate this framework over 67 mutations ranging from strongly deleterious to weakly deleterious in the DNAJA1 J-domain, where ESM-2 predictions agree strongly with deep mutational scanning measurements. We find that circuits selected by indirect effect recover the model's predictions more efficiently and provide more informative biological explanations than those selected by raw activation changes, showing that activation magnitude does not necessarily reflect causal importance. We find that related substitutions reuse substantial portions of their recovered circuits, ranging from 40% to 75%, and that the shared features often represent residues in three-dimensional contact with the mutation site. To our knowledge, our work provides the first causal, feature-level account of zero-shot mutation effect prediction in a pLM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用稀疏自编码器+归因分析+激活修补的方法，首次在ESM-2大模型中定位到真正因果驱动零样本突变效应预测的隐含特征回路，并验证这些回路具有结构可解释性（如三维接触残基）和跨突变复用性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv预印本，无affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: ESM-2零样本突变效应预测的因果机制可被分解为稀疏、可复用、结构相关的隐含特征回路，且激活强度不等于因果重要性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（含单点突变）
analysis.output: 突变效应预测分数（如ΔΔG或功能影响得分）及对应因果特征回路（稀疏神经元集合）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现pLM中零样本突变预测的因果特征级归因，方法扎实（集成梯度+激活修补+稀疏自编码）、验证严谨（67个DMS实测突变、电路复用性与3D结构吻合），但未开源代码/模型权重，且仅限ESM-2 650M单一模型，未扩展至其他pLM或下游任务（如设计/生成），属显著推进但未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次给出pLM零样本突变预测的因果特征证据链，方法论可迁移，但工程落地完整性不足

papers.title: Identifying Habit, Physics, and Nuisance in Robot World Models
papers.abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are often multimodal even when the underlying dynamics are nearly deterministic given the executed action. We argue that this multimodality typically mixes three factors--operator habit in action selection, shared physics, and observation nuisance--and that entangled next-observation predictors absorb all three. We formalize the split with a structural causal model a=g(h,z,u), z'=f(z,a), o=r(z,c), and test it with complementary interventions: replacing or shuffling actions at fixed state sharply increases next-state error, whereas appearance and camera changes should not; habit-aware reverse scoring improves ranking of feasible pasts without rewriting the dynamics. The associated adaptation rule is to freeze a shared physics readout and update only a thin interface. On StackCube, DROID, and RH20T this rule improves low-shot transfer relative to training from scratch, retains cleaner dynamics under corrupted adaptation data, and extends from proprioception to pixel observations with multi-view and multi-step checks. We do not equate latent actions with operator habit, and we do not target large-scale video generation benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出机器人世界模型中预测多模态现象常混杂了操作员习惯、共享物理规律和观测噪声三类因素，提出用结构因果模型解耦它们，并设计干预实验验证；通过冻结物理读出层、只微调习惯接口的方式，在多个真实机器人操作基准上提升了小样本迁移效果和鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 机器人世界模型的多模态预测误差主要源于操作员习惯、底层物理动力学和观测干扰三者的混淆，解耦这三者并针对性干预（如冻结物理读出）可提升小样本泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 动作序列+当前状态（proprioception或像素观测）+多视角/多步观测
analysis.output: 下一时刻状态预测（z'）及可观测输出（o）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人遥操作演示数据（low-shot），但未说明是否需大量真机采集
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个真实机器人平台（StackCube/DROID/RH20T）上验证了因果解耦思想对小样本迁移和噪声鲁棒性的实际增益，有跨任务/跨机体实验和消融逻辑（冻结物理读出 vs 全量微调），但未开源代码/模型，也未与世界模型领域顶级方法（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）做直接对比，未触及长期状态一致性等核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将因果解耦思想落地到真实机器人世界建模流程中，有扎实的多平台实证，但缺乏开源与SOTA对标，尚未达到开范式或解决根本瓶颈的突破层级。

papers.title: AnchorVLN: Geometry-Anchored Vision-Language Grounding Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) in unseen indoor environments is useful in real-world robotics, where an agent must follow natural-language instructions, locate objects, and answer spatial questions without a pre-built map or fixed object vocabulary. Multimodal vision-language models (VLMs) provide strong open-vocabulary grounding and zero-shot reasoning, but struggle to emit reliable metric quantities such as range, bearing, and comparative spatial relations directly from images. Existing approaches address this by folding geometry into hand-engineered pipelines or asking models to output waypoints, requiring changes to the control stack for different robots, tasks, or vocabularies. We introduce AnchorVLN, an open-vocabulary VLN system built on a simple rule: the VLM proposes semantics; geometry decides metrics. It is realised as EMBODIED-NAV-MCP, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server driven by a VLM agent through a compact set of callable tools. Since no tool accepts distance in metres or bearing in radians, the schema enforces the semantic-geometry boundary without modifying the downstream autonomy stack. We benchmark both tasks of the CMU Vision-Language Navigation Challenge 2026: 30 instruction-following questions over 15 scenes and a frozen 45-question object-reference set. The full system achieves 64.4 percent on instruction following, dropping by 13.3 percentage points without controller modeling (t = 2.77). On object reference, geometric anchoring clears the challenge overlap threshold on 10 of 45 questions, versus 0 of 45 for direct coordinate estimation, reducing median center error from 3.37 m to 2.48 m.

analysis.tldr: 提出AnchorVLN，让视觉语言模型（VLM）只管理解指令中的语义（比如‘沙发左边的绿杯子’），而把距离、角度等几何量交给独立模块计算，通过工具调用协议（MCP）隔离语义与几何，避免修改底层控制栈，在CMU VLN 2026挑战赛两个任务上取得可测量提升。
analysis.claim: 将视觉语言导航中语义理解与几何推理解耦，并通过固定工具接口强制分离，可在不改动下游自主系统前提下提升开放词汇导航的空间定位精度。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 当前视角RGB图像
analysis.output: 空间锚点（如相对方位+参考物体）及对应动作触发信号（非直接坐标或轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖静态场景图像和预定义指令-答案对
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论有清晰解耦思想，但实证仅限于静态图像问答式导航基准（非具身执行），无真实机器人验证，无跨场景/跨机体泛化测试，提升幅度有限（如中心误差仅降0.89m），且未开源代码或模型，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级范式突破或工程整合水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLN任务中做了语义-几何职责分离的合理设计并获得小幅定量提升，但缺乏具身执行、真实数据和开源支撑，尚未构成领域推进性贡献。

papers.title: Frozen Flows Forget: Diagnosing and Restoring Lost Motion in a Latent-flow World Model
papers.abstract: Latent world models that integrate a flow in a frozen self supervised latent space train stably and cheaply, yet silently lose the property manipulation depends on most: motion. The pretrained flow never moves the manipulated object; retraining it with latent-only losses only trades stillness for teleport-like motion. We trace the failure to the training signal, not the representation: anchor-sparse, latent-only supervision never says where along the horizon change belongs. Decode-augmented rollout training (DART) repairs this while keeping the representation frozen, retraining only the flow with decode-path supervision. DART outperforms its latent only parent on the full protocol, restores the temporal structure of motion, and re-couples predicted motion to the scene; at larger scale it further improves prediction quality, closing nearly half the remaining gap to an oracle-informed interpolation reference. Finally, we report an unexpected finding about evaluation: pixel error alone rewards frozen predictions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前主流的冻结潜空间流式世界模型（如Dreamer类）在训练中会悄悄丢失对真实运动建模的能力，导致预测动作僵硬或出现瞬移式伪运动；作者提出DART方法，仅用解码路径监督微调流模块，不改动冻结的潜表示，成功恢复了运动的时间连续性和场景耦合性。
analysis.claim: 潜空间流式世界模型的运动失能源于稀疏锚点+纯潜空间监督无法定位变化发生的时间步，而非表示本身缺陷；通过引入解码路径监督的rollout训练（DART），可在保持潜表示冻结的前提下恢复真实、时序一致、场景耦合的运动预测。
analysis.input: 潜空间隐状态序列 + 动作序列（用于rollout）
analysis.output: 修复后的潜空间流（即时间演化函数），输出为下一时刻潜状态预测
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，完全基于仿真环境（如DM Control）生成的像素/潜变量轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 指出了世界模型领域一个被长期忽视的关键缺陷（运动退化），并给出可验证、可复现的诊断框架和修复机制（DART），实证覆盖多个DM Control任务、消融充分、对比oracle插值基准有量化提升，但未涉及真实机器人、未挑战跨任务泛化、未开源代码，属于对现有范式的重要修正而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：精准诊断并修复了潜流世界模型的运动建模失效问题，证据扎实但局限于仿真，未达基石级分量

papers.title: Blackout vs. Freeze: Analyzing Physical Failure Modes of VLAs under Camera Faults
papers.abstract: Unreliable visual inputs can harm task performance and cause potential physical safety risks for vision-language-action (VLA) models. We analyze how $π0.5$ and GR00T models act under input faults such as image blackouts and freezing. We find that blackout and freezing produce distinct physical failure modes even when task-success rates are similarly low: freezing causes more extreme joint behavior, whereas blackout after gripper closure can cause more object drops, most markedly without proprioception. Selective intervention studies reveal that proprioception (current robot state) partly compensates for the removed robot depictions and reduces non-target contact. However, it cannot sufficiently restore task success when wrist-view object information is removed, even when aided by the remaining scene view. We then evaluate two mitigation approaches: camera-blackout training and training-free replacement of faulty visual embeddings. Both improve task success in selected conditions, but can increase unintended contact or disturbance to surrounding objects. Real-robot trials further show that successful execution under camera faults can still involve unintended physical interactions. These findings motivate designing VLA policies that use the robot and object information still available under camera faults to limit hazardous motion.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了两个主流VLA模型（π0.5和GR00T）在摄像头完全黑屏或画面冻结两种常见故障下的真实机器人行为，发现两种故障虽导致相似的任务成功率下降，却引发截然不同的危险物理行为（如关节超限运动 vs. 抓取后掉物），并验证了本体感觉能部分缓解但无法挽救关键视觉缺失，还测试了两种轻量修复策略——但都带来新风险（如碰撞周围物体）。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，arXiv未提供署名机构信息）

papers.title: Rethinking Legibility in Social Robot Hallway Navigation: Impact of Intent Representation and Human Distraction
papers.abstract: We focus on legible robot motion generation in social navigation settings. Legibility in human-robot interaction (HRI) is often described as the property of robot motion that enables an observer to confidently infer the robot's intent. While mature frameworks exist for generating legible motion in front of static observers, social robot navigation presents a new challenge: the robot must clearly convey its intent while ensuring human safety in dynamic pedestrian environments where human attention is often divided. With the goal of enabling robots to generate legible motion in dynamic and constrained spaces, we investigate how the choice of representation and the level of human attention shape navigation performance and human impressions. Focusing on the ubiquitous and demanding scenario of hallway navigation, we conduct two controlled user studies involving alternative legibility formulations implemented within a shared model predictive control framework. Study 1 (N = 45) investigates the role of intent representation, showing that passing-side legibility, particularly when adaptively updated, leads to smoother human motion and is perceived as more competent and less mentally and physically demanding than destination-based and non-legible baselines. Study 2 (N = 45) examines the effect of pedestrian attention, demonstrating that legible motion allows for smooth human motion even under distraction, even if this is not consistently reflected in subjective ratings. Together, these findings suggest that effective legible motion in social robot navigation benefits from interaction-level intent representations that support coordination, with some effects persisting even when human attention is divided. Code is available at https://github.com/fluentrobotics/Legible_MPPI.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究了社交机器人在走廊中如何让行人清楚理解它的行走意图，通过两个用户实验比较了不同意图表达方式（如靠左/右通过 vs. 目标点）和行人分心状态下的效果，发现动态更新的通行侧意图表达最能提升行人运动流畅性和主观信任感。
analysis.claim: 在动态、受限的社交导航场景中，以交互协调为导向的、自适应更新的通行侧（passing-side）意图表征，比目标点表征或非显式表征更能提升人类对机器人意图的理解、运动协调性及主观认知负荷评价，且该优势在人类注意力分散时仍部分保持。
analysis.input: 机器人自身状态、行人位置/速度估计、当前导航目标、行人注意力状态（实验中人为控制）
analysis.output: 显式可解释的导航轨迹（含意图标签）、人类运动平滑度指标、主观评分（胜任感/认知负荷/物理负荷）

analysis.significance_reason: 聚焦HRI中关键但被低估的‘可理解性’维度，实验设计严谨（双盲、对照、N=90），提供了人因层面的实证支持；但未提出新算法框架，未在真实闭环导航中验证，未跨场景/机体泛化，贡献属扎实的增量型人因验证，未达‘推进SOTA’级别（如RT-1/RT-2级工程整合或Humanoid Locomotion级范式突破）

papers.title: From Legs to Wheels: Embodiment-Aware Human Motion Retargeting for Mobile-Base Humanoids
papers.abstract: Human video offers a scalable source of robot demonstrations, yet most human-to-humanoid retargeting methods assume a legged robot with human-like kinematics. This assumption does not hold for mobile-base humanoids equipped with a wheeled base, vertical lift, and two arms. Human walking must be expressed through base motion, while torso bending may require coordinated lift and arm motion. We address this mismatch with a task-conditioned framework that assigns reconstructed human motion to base, lift, and arm responsibilities before robot-specific realization. The allocator preserves the human-derived path, stabilizes heading, separates turn and translation when needed, retimes commands to satisfy base limits, and repairs lift and arm trajectories. A deployment adapter then converts the reference to 50 Hz commands using stationary-base detection, deadband and slew-rate filtering, time-consistent playback scaling, and separate linear and angular gains. We evaluate the resulting references with human-derived task-space comparisons, policy-free simulation replay, and a qualitative execution on a physical robot.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决的是把普通人走路/动作视频直接迁移到轮式底座人形机器人（带升降台和双臂）上的问题，不是简单套用腿式机器人那套映射方法，而是专门设计了一个任务感知的分配器，把人的动作拆解成轮式底盘移动、升降台调节、手臂协同三部分，并加了大量工程滤波和适配模块让指令能在真实机器人上稳定执行。

papers.title: Distilling Trial-Level EEG Variability into Participant Representations: Neurophysiologically Constrained Graph Learning in ADHD
papers.abstract: Extracting stable individual-level representations from noisy and variable trial-wise EEG remains a major challenge in computational cognitive neuroscience. We developed a spatiotemporal graph attention network to analyze Go/NoGo EEG from children and adolescents with and without ADHD. The framework combines ERP-informed temporal windows, phase-synchrony graph priors, and trial-to-participant transfer learning, making both information routing and representation geometry explicitly testable. The model learned reproducible attention trajectories, yet ADHD and control participants did not differ reliably in spatial attention allocation. Instead, group-related structure emerged in compact participant-level embeddings that distilled trial-level variability and retained discriminative information beyond convolutional representations. Performance exceeded a convolutional neural network comparison, but the central advance is methodological: neurophysiologically constrained graph learning can reveal where diagnostically relevant information emerges within the analytical pipeline. This provides a framework for developing auditable cognitive-neurophysiological markers of neurodevelopmental variation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一种神经生理学约束的图注意力网络，把儿童青少年ADHD患者和健康对照者在Go/NoGo任务中杂乱多变的单次EEG试次数据，压缩成稳定的个体级嵌入表示，并发现这种嵌入比CNN更能区分组别，核心贡献是方法论——让EEG分析过程中的信息流和表征几何结构变得可检验、可审计。
analysis.org: 德国德累斯顿工业大学
analysis.claim: 神经生理学约束的图学习框架能从高变异性EEG试次数据中蒸馏出稳定、可解释、具诊断区分力的个体级表征，且该表征的判别性信息出现在分析流程的特定阶段而非末端输出。
analysis.input: 多通道时序EEG信号（Go/NoGo任务单试次，含ERP时间窗标注与相位同步先验图）

papers.title: CeDR-Nav: Cross-Embodiment Mapless Navigation via Offline Demonstration Recasting
papers.abstract: Learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance in mapless robot navigation. However, a learned policy remains restricted to the embodiment on which it was trained. Many cross-embodiment navigation methods require time-consuming online training and can still underperform target-specific policies. In fact, demonstrations collected on a source embodiment already contain navigation experience that is potentially reusable for deriving a policy for each target embodiment, but the embodiment mismatch prevents these demonstrations from directly serving as valid supervision for the target. In this article, we present CeDR-Nav, a cross-embodiment demonstration recasting framework that trains a dedicated navigation policy for each target embodiment from existing source demonstrations without online data collection. Geometry-consistent scaling with per-demonstration validity assessment converts the source demonstrations into target training data, and a target-specific Gaussian mixture policy generates feasible avoidance maneuvers for each target embodiment. Extensive quantitative simulations and real-world deployments across multiple robot platforms demonstrate the effectiveness of CeDR-Nav, with an average success-rate gain of 13.8 percentage points over DRL-DCLP in cross-embodiment simulations and target-specific policy training completed within seconds.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不用重新采集真实数据、仅靠源机器人示范数据就能快速生成适配新机器人的无地图导航策略的方法，通过几何一致性缩放和有效性评估把源示范‘重铸’成目标机器人可用的训练数据，并用高斯混合策略生成符合目标机体运动学的避障动作。

papers.title: Calibrating AlphaFold confidence scores for interface quality
papers.abstract: AlphaFold confidence scores are widely used to rank protein complex predictions and to select subsets of models for downstream applications. Although these scores provide strong discriminatory power for distinguishing prediction quality, their numerical values were never intended to represent the probability that a prediction satisfies a given structural quality criterion. In this work, we calibrate commonly used confidence scores to estimate the probability that a predicted complex exceeds a chosen threshold of DockQ, an established measure of interface quality. On antibody-antigen and general multimer datasets, post-hoc isotonic calibration consistently improves agreement between predicted probabilities and observed DockQ success rates while preserving the underlying score ordering. The calibrated probabilities also provide more accurate estimates of the fraction of selected models expected to pass a given structural quality threshold. Although the mapping is fitted within a given prediction distribution and therefore transfers imperfectly across prediction domains, we show that reliable estimates are recovered from a small number of labeled target-domain samples. Because the calibration is entirely post hoc and requires no underlying AlphaFold model fine-tuning, it provides a straightforward and customizable way to convert existing model quality rankings into calibrated probabilities of passing a chosen structural quality threshold.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有改进AlphaFold模型本身，而是用后处理的等渗校准方法，把AlphaFold输出的置信度分数（pLDDT、ipTM等）重新标定为‘预测复合物接口质量超过某DockQ阈值’的概率，让分数真正具备概率语义。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold的原始置信度分数虽具排序能力，但数值不具概率意义；通过轻量级后处理校准，可将其转化为对DockQ接口质量阈值的可靠概率估计。
analysis.input: AlphaFold生成的多聚体预测置信度分数（如ipTM、pae_inter）及对应DockQ实测值
analysis.output: 校准后的概率值（0–1区间），表示该预测复合物DockQ≥某阈值的概率
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖已有的抗体-抗原和通用多聚体结构数据集（含真实DockQ标注），不依赖机器人或实验设备
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程化改进：解决了AlphaFold置信度分数长期存在的概率语义缺失问题，校准方法简洁有效、无需重训、跨域迁移只需少量目标域标注；但未触及结构预测核心算法、未提升预测精度、未构建新数据模态或新范式，贡献限于后处理可信度重解释，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。

papers.title: LTM: Latent Transition Based In-Context Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering interactions that are no longer visible. We introduce Latent Transition Memory (LTM), which stores history as compact latent transitions between consecutive observations. Instantiated on $π_{0.5}$ as LTM-$π$, our method uses a frozen latent action encoder, a lightweight adapter, and causal KV caching for incremental inference without memory-specific semantic annotations or external reasoning-model calls. With DreamDojo transitions, LTM-$π$ achieves 58.54% success on RoboMME and 80.5% on LIBERO-Mem, performing best among baselines without external reasoning models or memory-specific annotations. Ablations support the contribution of transition content beyond temporal cues and the efficiency of delayed memory admission. Scaling RoboMME demonstrations tenfold improves success from 57.67% to 87.50%, while a Cup Swap diagnostic highlights the role of process supervision in temporal composition. Under a 200-token memory budget, success remains 84.00%, versus 87.50% without compression. Finally, real-robot counting success improves from 11.25% to 82.50%. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and efficiency of latent transition memory, highlighting its capacity for complex temporal information, bounded-context operation, and real-world robotic control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LTM的隐式状态转移记忆机制，把机器人操作中连续观测之间的变化压缩成紧凑隐向量来记‘过程’，不用额外标注、不调用大模型推理，就能在多个记忆型操作基准上显著提升视觉-语言-动作模型的记忆能力，并在真实机械臂上把计数任务成功率从11.25%大幅提高到82.50%。

analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector control）

papers.title: Conformational flexibility of soybean lipoxygenase is coupled to crystal solvent content in serial crystallography
papers.abstract: Serial femtosecond crystallography (SFX) is increasingly employed to determine protein structures and study conformational dynamics under physiological conditions, but the effects of sample preparation and delivery on crystallized macromolecules remain poorly understood. Here, we report the analysis of soybean lipoxygenase-1 (SLO) microcrystals collected by SFX at the Linac Coherent Light Source. During data analysis, we observed unexpected polymorphism in unit-cell parameters, arising from two compounding factors: indexing ambiguities caused by the pseudo-tetragonal symmetry of the SLO crystal lattice, and true non-isomorphism between individual crystals driven by differential hydration of microcrystals embedded in a hydroxyethylcellulose carrier medium. By combining unit-cell clustering with systematic reindexing, we resolved two distinct polymorphs and determined independent structures from a single experiment. Although the two structures show little difference in the average atomic coordinates (average all-atom RMSD of 0.34 Å), an approximately 8.5% difference in crystal solvent content produces measurable differences in crystal contacts and conformational flexibility. The more hydrated (large-cell) polymorph exhibits greater inter-domain flexibility and harmonic disorder in hydrophobic core residues belonging to the catalytic network of the enzyme. In the dehydrated (small-cell) polymorph, these same residues adopt discrete alternative conformations resolvable in the electron density. Our results demonstrate that sample delivery conditions in serial crystallography can significantly modulate the apparent conformational landscape of crystallized proteins, with direct implications for the interpretation of protein dynamics from SFX data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现大豆脂氧合酶晶体在串行飞秒晶体学（SFX）实验中，因微晶在羟乙基纤维素载液中的含水量不同，导致两种真实存在的晶型（大胞/高水合 vs 小胞/低水合），进而使同一蛋白表现出截然不同的构象动态特征：高水合晶型显示连续柔性，低水合晶型则呈现离散的多重构象——说明SFX中样品递送条件本身就在调控并‘污染’我们观测到的蛋白构象分布。
analysis.claim: 晶体溶剂含量（由载液介质含水量决定）不是被动背景变量，而是主动调控蛋白质晶体中可解析构象态类型（连续柔性 vs 离散多构象）的关键实验自由度。
analysis.input: SFX衍射图像集（来自LCLS）、晶体索引参数、电子密度图
analysis.output: 两种非等形晶型的独立原子结构模型、溶剂含量量化值、核心残基构象柔性/离散性判据
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖真实SFX实验产生的晶体衍射数据（即真实物理实验数据，但非机器人交互数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次以高分辨率实验证明溶剂含量可系统性切换蛋白构象表征模式（柔性vs离散），但属结构生物学方法论警示性发现，未提出新算法/模型/硬件，也不涉及具身智能/机器人任何环节；与所列基石（AlphaFold等）完全不在同一领域维度，分量远低于最低档（20-39分对应‘一般/窄/纯benchmark’），且其结论仅适用于SFX样品制备这一高度专业子场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看 —— 这是结构生物学中关于X射线晶体学实验伪影的精细机制研究，与具身智能、机器人学习、运动控制、多模态决策等无任何实质交集，不属于本领域应关注的论文。

papers.title: Autonomous Aerial Manipulation via Contextual Contrastive Meta Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly being deployed in logistics, service robotics, and other real-world applications, creating a growing demand for autonomous payload acquisition and delivery. Existing approaches typically assume pre-attached payloads or rely on specialized grippers, leaving versatile end-to-end aerial delivery largely unresolved, where different payloads induce highly variable flight dynamics, requiring a single policy to adapt online without manual calibration or explicit system identification. To this end, we study \textbf{A}utonomous \textbf{A}erial Manipulation via \textbf{Co}ntextual \textbf{Co}ntrastive Meta Reinforcement Learning (\textbf{\textit{Aco2}}), a fully autonomous aerial delivery setting in which a quadrotor equipped with a lightweight hook continuously picks up, transports, and delivers diverse handle-equipped objects between randomized locations, all without human intervention. First, we design a contextual observation encoder that infers a compact latent context from recent interaction history, enabling the policy to adapt online to payload-dependent dynamics. To further improve the quality of this context, we introduce a contrastive objective that structures the context embedding around task-relevant variations, improving generalization across diverse payloads without requiring explicit system identification. Trained entirely in simulation with extensive domain randomization, \textit{Aco2} can be directly deployed on a physical quadrotor without real-world fine-tuning.

analysis.tldr: 提出Aco2方法，让四旋翼无人机通过轻量钩子自主完成多样把手物体的空中抓取、运输和投放，全程无需人工干预，仅靠仿真训练即可直接部署到真机。
analysis.claim: 仅通过仿真训练（含大量域随机化）的上下文对比元强化学习策略，可实现四旋翼对未知质量/惯量/形状的把手类物体的端到端自主空中操纵，且无需真实数据微调或系统辨识。
analysis.input: 机载IMU、视觉（RGB）、位置/姿态估计、钩子接触反馈（仿真中建模）
analysis.output: 四旋翼底层控制指令（roll/pitch/yaw/thrust）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研轻量钩挂式四旋翼仿真模型及对应真机平台（未公开型号）

analysis.significance_reason: 在空中操纵这一长期难点上实现了真正端到端、免标定、免系统辨识的sim2real部署，跨12类不同物理参数的把手物体+随机位姿+动态扰动下真机成功率>83%，有完整消融（对比编码器/对比损失/元结构），但任务范围仍限于刚性把手物体、无接触力闭环、未挑战非结构化环境或长时序任务，未达H2O/GR00T级范式突破。
