papers.title: Data aggregation strategies for a P300 speller: decoding models, epoch averaging, cross-subject ensembles, and multi-channel models
papers.abstract: Accurate detection of P300 event-related potentials from electroencephalography (EEG) remains challenging for small numbers of trials due to low signal-to-noise ratios and substantial inter-subject variability. This study presents a systematic comparison of data aggregation strategies for improving P300 classification, evaluated on a 10-subject dataset using two convolutional neural network architectures (EEGNet and BaseCNN) and a support vector machine (SVM). We compared: (1)~subject-specific and pooled general models for single trials; (2)~epoch averaging with 5 and 10 stimuli repetitions; (3)~multi-channel models where subjects corresponded to different input channels; (4)~cross-subject averaging; (5)~mixed (uncontrolled) averaging; (6)~a combined approach with $K$ trials per subject across all participants; and (7)~time-shifted channels from extended single-trial epochs. Decoding performance was quantified using the Information Transfer Rate (ITR), computed for binary classification accuracy. We found that single-trial ITR was unpractical (0.15--0.64~bits/trial), whereas controlled aggregation improved the performance. The combined cross-subject approach with $K=3$ trials per participant (30 channels) achieves the highest ITR with multi-channel EEGNet: 0.95~bits/aggregated decision in the no-aperture recordings and 0.97~bits/aggregated decision on Aperture data, approaching the theoretical binary-classification limit for the aggregated decision. Controlled cross-subject averaging consistently outperformed random trial mixing, and multi-channel architectures outperformed simple averaging when inter-subject structure was preserved. These findings contribute to improving P300 decoding and implementing multi-subject brain-computer interfaces (BCIs).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了7种EEG数据聚合策略（如跨被试平均、多通道建模、重复刺激平均等），在10人P300拼写数据集上验证哪种方式能最有效地提升单次试验信噪比和信息传输率（ITR），最终发现将3次试验跨被试组合成30通道输入+多通道EEGNet模型效果最好，ITR接近理论极限。

papers.title: Establishing a Retron-Based Cytosine Base Editor for Targeted Hypermutation in Escherichia coli
papers.abstract: Abstract Current cytosine base editors (CBEs) are limited to unidirectional C to T conversions, restricting their applications. Retrons, bacterial genetic elements, encode a reverse transcriptase that generates multicopy single-stranded DNA (msDNA) by reverse transcribing specific non-coding RNA (ncRNA). This msDNA mimics Okazaki fragments during DNA replication, making retrons promising for gene editing. Here, we developed a retron-based cytosine base editor (RCBE) by fusing cytosine deaminase with reverse transcriptase (RT-CDA) within the retron system. RCBE first transcribes ncRNA, allowing RT-CDA to deaminate cytosine on the ncRNA. The modified ncRNA is then reverse transcribed into msDNA, where RT-CDA induces further cytosine deamination. This mutant msDNA introduces specific mutations into target gene sequences, enabling both C to T and G to A conversions. Using RCBE, we demonstrated accelerated molecular evolution of the rpoB gene in Escherichia coli . High-throughput sequencing confirmed that RCBE achieves a mutation rate of up to 0.2% in regions with high GC content. Our findings establish RCBE as a versatile tool, particularly suitable for directed evolution in GC-rich regions, with broad potential applications across various bacterial and eukaryotic hosts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一种基于细菌retron系统的新型胞嘧啶碱基编辑器（RCBE），能在大肠杆菌中实现C→T和G→A双向突变，特别适用于GC富集区的定向进化，实测rpoB基因突变率达0.2%。
analysis.claim: retron系统可被工程化为支持双向碱基转换（C→T与G→A）的碱基编辑平台，突破传统CBE单向编辑限制，并在GC-rich区域实现可控超突变。
analysis.input: 靶基因序列（如rpoB）+ retron ncRNA设计模板
analysis.output: 靶位点处C→T或G→A突变的细菌克隆群体
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将retron msDNA生成机制与胞嘧啶脱氨酶耦合，实现双向碱基编辑，技术路径新颖；但仅在E. coli单一宿主中验证单一基因（rpoB），无跨菌种/跨真核验证，无脱靶率、编辑纯度、效率稳定性等关键指标量化，未开源代码或质粒，仅靠高通量测序报告突变率，属扎实但窄域的工具性进展，远未达AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion级范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首个retron-CBE双向编辑实现，但验证深度与广度不足，暂未展现跨系统适用性或机制普适性，属于分子工具层面的可靠改进，非范式变革。

papers.title: E-TTS: A New Embodied Test-Time Scaling Framework for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recently, a few works have made early attempts to study test-time scaling for embodied tasks. However, two major challenges remain unsolved: (1) reasoning can effectively improve the performance of the policy, but its scaling mechanism has seldom been studied; (2) historical information is essential, as embodied tasks are inherently long-horizon and sequential, making sole reliance on current observations for action scaling inadequate due to the lack of historical context utilization. To address these challenges, we introduce E-TTS, a modular and plug-and-play Embodied Test-Time Scaling framework that unifies reasoning and action scaling for robotic manipulation via history-aware iterative refinement with vision-language verifiers. To support joint reasoning-action scaling, E-TTS performs reasoning-action joint sampling and scoring in a pairwise manner. To better utilize historical information, E-TTS uses a history buffer to store historical context, which is then used by reasoning and action verifiers to evaluate the sampled candidates. Unlike conventional open-loop TTS methods, E-TTS introduces feedback generation into the sampling process to form a closed-loop iterative refinement mechanism, enhancing both inference efficiency and environmental adaptability. Each component functions as an independent and composable module, allowing flexible and adaptive configuration depending on task requirements. To evaluate the advantages of our framework, we conduct experiments across 4 different benchmarks, 6 environments, 3 embodiments, and 4 base vision-language-action models. The experimental results demonstrate that, without requiring additional expert data collection or retraining, E-TTS consistently improves performance, achieving up to a 33.14% increase in simulation and 26.62% in real-world scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫E-TTS的框架，在机器人操作任务推理时动态扩展开采与验证过程，通过历史缓冲区+视觉语言验证器实现带反馈的闭环迭代优化，不重训练就能提升现有VLA模型在仿真和真实机器人上的表现。
analysis.claim: 通过历史感知的闭环迭代验证机制，可在测试时无需重训练地统一提升推理与动作缩放能力，显著增强VLA模型在长程具身操作任务中的泛化与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多帧视觉观测+语言指令+历史动作/状态序列
analysis.output: 优化后的动作序列（或单步动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / WidowX / Unitree Go2（摘要提3 embodiments，但未列具体型号；按惯例推断为常见开源机械臂+移动平台）

analysis.significance_reason: 首次将test-time scaling系统性引入具身操作，并设计历史缓冲+闭环验证机制，实证覆盖多平台多环境，但未开源代码/模型，且所有提升均基于已有VLA基线（未挑战基础建模瓶颈），属扎实的工程范式拓展而非理论或架构突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把TTS思想落地到具身操作，机制清晰、验证充分，但缺乏开源与底层创新，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的量级。

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Enhanced Event-Triggered Data-Driven Predictive Control for a 3D Cable-Driven Soft Robotic Arm
papers.abstract: Soft robots are challenging to control due to their nonlinear and time-varying dynamics. Data-enabled predictive control (DeePC) offers a model-free alternative by directly leveraging measured input-output trajectories to construct a predictive controller. However, its receding-horizon formulation requires solving a constrained optimization problem at every sampling instant, which can be computationally demanding for real-time deployment on resource-limited robotic platforms.To address this limitation, we propose an adaptive reinforcement-learning-based event-triggered DeePC (RL-ET-DeePC) framework for soft robotic control. A model-free RL policy is trained to determine when to invoke the DeePC optimizer based on the current system state representation, thereby reducing unnecessary optimization calls while preserving closed-loop performance.Simulation results show that RL-ET-DeePC reduces optimization frequency by up to 66% compared to periodic DeePC, while maintaining comparable tracking accuracy. Hardware experiments on a three-dimensional cable-driven soft robotic arm demonstrate zero-shot transfer, achieving a 34% reduction in optimization frequency with tracking accuracy comparable to periodic DeePC and more consistent performance than a static threshold-based event-triggered baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用强化学习动态决定何时启动DeePC优化器的事件触发机制，大幅减少软体机器人实时控制中的优化计算次数，同时保持跟踪精度。
analysis.claim: 通过无模型强化学习策略实现事件触发式DeePC控制，可在不牺牲闭环性能的前提下显著降低软体机器人实时优化频率。
analysis.input: 软体臂当前状态表征（含传感器反馈与历史IO轨迹）
analysis.output: 二元决策信号（是否触发DeePC优化）
analysis.robot_dependency: 3D缆驱动软体机械臂（定制硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据训练RL策略并验证零样本迁移效果
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体机器人实时控制中首次将RL用于动态调度DeePC优化时机，实机验证了跨任务/场景的零样本迁移能力，但未引入新架构或底层建模突破，属显著工程改进而非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了DeePC在资源受限软体机器人上实时部署的关键瓶颈，有扎实实机验证和消融对比，但未改变控制范式或拓展科学问题边界

papers.title: Accurate, comprehensive gene annotation and ortholog identification across thousands of vertebrate genomes with TOGA2
papers.abstract: Inferring orthologs and annotating coding genes remain central challenges in genomics, evident by the growing gap between assembled and annotated genomes. TOGA (Tool to infer Orthologs from Genome Alignments) addresses this challenge by integrating gene annotation and orthology inference. Here, we present TOGA2, the next generation of TOGA, which substantially improves annotation completeness, accuracy, scalability, and orthology inference. TOGA2 leverages exon-level orthology and introduces an exon-wise annotation procedure that reduces memory usage 513-fold and runtime 6.1-fold. We show that human-trained deep learning models for splice site prediction generalize across vertebrates. Integrating these predictions enables robust handling of evolutionary changes in exon-intron structure, including splice site shifts, intron deletions, and exonization of introns. A new gene tree reconciliation step refines orthology inference, and UTR annotation improves gene model completeness. Across mammals, birds, turtles, and percomorph fishes, TOGA2 annotations generally achieve higher gene completeness than transcriptome-informed RefSeq annotations. TOGA2 identifies previously unannotated exons in mouse, assigns informative gene symbols, and annotates V(D)J segments of antigen receptors. TOGA2 scales to thousands of genomes, which we demonstrate by generating comprehensive comparative genomics resources for 2,162 vertebrate assemblies, including gene annotations, ortholog sets, gene losses and duplications, retrogene candidates, and outputs supporting downstream analyses. Together, TOGA2 provides a scalable and versatile framework for comparative genomics that bridges the genome annotation gap.

analysis.tldr: TOGA2是一个可扩展的基因组注释与直系同源基因识别工具，能在数千个脊椎动物基因组上全自动完成高精度编码基因注释（含UTR）、直系同源推断、基因丢失/重复检测及逆转录基因预测，核心创新是外显子层级的正交性建模+深度学习剪接位点跨物种泛化+基因树矫正。

papers.title: From Real-Time Planning to Reliable Execution:Scalable Coordination for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Fleets in Industrial Environments
papers.abstract: With the increasing deployment of heterogeneous robot fleets in industrial environments, efficient coordination remains a critical challenge. Real-time path planning must simultaneously accommodate high robot densities and heterogeneous motion capabilities, while communication delays, execution uncertainties, and other disturbances may cause robots to deviate from the temporal assumptions underlying planned paths. Such deviations can lead to excessive waiting and congestion propagation across the fleet. This paper presents SCALE, a reactive online coordination framework that enables real-time planning while maintaining robust execution. Within this framework, we introduce a motion-induced conflict reduction mechanism to support the online generation of feasible paths for online conflict resolution. To mitigate the effects of disturbances, we further design a generalized Conjugate Action-Precedence Hypergraph (CAPH) that adaptively adjusts precedence relations among robots. Extensive validation experiments, together with a three-day deployment in a warehouse, demonstrate the

analysis.tldr: 提出SCALE框架，通过运动诱导冲突消减机制和可自适应调整机器人优先级关系的共轭动作-前序超图（CAPH），在高密度异构机器人车队中实现抗扰动的实时在线协调，已在真实仓库连续部署三天验证。
analysis.claim: 在存在通信延迟、执行不确定性等现实扰动的工业场景下，SCALE能通过动态重构机器人间动作优先级关系，保障高密度异构多机器人系统在实时规划下的可靠执行。
analysis.input: 机器人实时位姿、任务目标、局部观测、通信状态
analysis.output: 分布式协调的动作序列与动态优先级约束

papers.title: SPECTRA: Context-Conditioned Spectral Movement Primitives for Robot Skill Generalization
papers.abstract: Robot imitation learning for manipulation should preserve demonstrated task geometry while producing dynamically admissible robot motions. Existing pipelines often learn task-dependent trajectories and impose execution limits afterward through filtering, smoothing, clipping, or time scaling, which may distort task-critical end-effector paths. We propose the Spectral Movement Primitive (SMP), a frequency-domain imitation learning framework that couples task-space skill generation with joint-space execution regulation. Demonstrations are represented by truncated finite-horizon Fourier coefficients. An empirically selected low-frequency task band captures the dominant motion geometry, while higher harmonics contribute disproportionately to derivative growth. A frame-aware context-conditioned GMM/GMR prior predicts the task-band coefficients in a canonical task frame, and the resulting Cartesian trajectory is mapped to joint space through sequential inverse kinematics. A phase-coupled regulator then limits the requested phase progression without modifying the spectral coefficients, thereby enforcing joint velocity and acceleration limits while preserving the represented path. Experiments evaluate task-band reconstruction, robustness to composite demonstration corruption, out-of-distribution cross-board generalization, joint-space dynamic admissibility, end-effector path preservation, and deployment on a Franka Panda robot. Results show compact geometric reconstruction, consistent transfer across unseen task frames, substantial reductions in dynamic violations and jerk, and preservation of the intended end-effector path during phase regulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在频域建模机器人运动原语的方法（SMP），用截断傅里叶系数表示任务空间轨迹，通过低频段保留关键几何形状、高频段控制动态特性，并用上下文感知的GMM预测+相位耦合调节器保障关节动力学可行性，最终在Franka Panda上验证了路径保真度与动态合规性的兼顾。

papers.title: Time-to-Collision Based Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance Using Pretrained Vision Models for Robots in Unstructured Environments
papers.abstract: Dynamic obstacle avoidance in unstructured outdoor environments remains a critical challenge for autonomous mobile robots, particularly when large-scale robot-specific training data and simulation-based policies are impractical. We present a data-efficient, interpretable method for vision-based dynamic obstacle avoidance that operates entirely on real-world data, avoiding the sim-to-real transfer problem inherent in simulation-trained policies. Our approach leverages UniDepth, a large pretrained monocular depth estimation model, to produce dense depth maps from RGB video without requiring stereo cameras or LiDAR at inference time. Dynamic obstacle avoidance is achieved by extending the SuperPoint and SuperGlue feature correspondence pipeline to track keypoints across long frame sequences, projecting their 2D pixel-space positions into 3D using camera intrinsics and predicted depth, running bundle adjustment initialized from these 3D keypoints, and computing per-keypoint time-to-collision (TTC). A 2D motion primitive in the ground plane is then selected to move the robot away from the closest point of approach of the minimum-TTC keypoint. Evaluated on real-world data from the M3ED dataset, our pipeline achieves a precision of 0.49 and a recall of 0.38 in identifying frames with a ground truth TTC below 1 second, and correctly generates the evasive motion direction in 84\% of true positive detections. Crucially, it detects at least one frame with TTC less than 1 second for 20 out of 22 unique physical obstacles present in our test sequences. Unlike end-to-end learned methods that demand thousands of hours of robot-specific training data, our approach eliminates model training entirely, requiring only 74 seconds of data for hyperparameter tuning. This demonstrates exceptional data efficiency while preserving interpretable and generalizable behavior across diverse obstacle types.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练视觉模型（UniDepth+SuperPoint/SuperGlue）从单目RGB视频中估计深度、跟踪3D关键点、计算每个点的碰撞时间（TTC），再据此生成地面平面避障运动方向，全程不训练模型、仅用74秒真实数据调参，在M3ED真实户外数据上检测到20/22个物理障碍物的临界接近帧。
analysis.claim: 无需任何机器人端训练、仅依赖通用预训练视觉模型和少量真实视频，即可实现可解释、数据高效、跨障碍类型泛化的动态避障。

analysis.data_dependency: 极低：仅需74秒真实视频用于超参调优，无监督/无标注/无策略训练

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将成熟预训练视觉模块（UniDepth+SuperGlue）巧妙级联为可解释避障流水线，实证充分且数据极省，但非算法范式突破，也未进入真实机器人闭环控制验证

papers.title: STEMbot: A Compliant Robot for Under-Canopy Plant Navigation
papers.abstract: The scalability of organic agriculture is partially limited by the labor costs associated with monitoring for pests. While drones and rovers are well-suited for agricultural monitoring from above or next to plants, many pests live on the underside of leaves or on plant stems, making them detectable only after they have caused significant damage. To enable early pest detection we present STEMbot, a miniature climbing robot system designed for autonomous navigation under plant canopies. Unlike existing climbing platforms that lack on-board perception or are restricted to unbranched vertical trunks, STEMbot integrates a fully geometric PIN-SLAM pipeline with a semantic OcTree to achieve robust localization and mapping while climbing the plant. To plan STEMbot's motion we propose a manifold-constrained A* planner along with ray-tracing goal specification to enable branch-aware traversal and the inspection of occluded targets. We validate our system through hardware experiments, demonstrating reliable traversal of stems ranging from 7-33mm and autonomous navigation across four distinct plant specimens. Quantitative evaluations show that our system achieves high-fidelity geometric reconstructions with an average Chamfer distance of less than 1cm relative to an offline photogrammetry baseline, confirming that STEMbot maintains the globally consistent odometry needed for autonomous navigation.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一款能自主攀爬植物茎干、在茂密叶冠下方穿行并建图的微型 compliant（柔性）机器人STEMbot，用于早期虫害检测，实测可攀爬7–33mm粗细的多分枝植物茎干，并完成四株不同植物上的自主导航与高精度三维重建。
analysis.claim: 通过PIN-SLAM+语义OcTree+流形约束A*规划器的紧耦合系统，首次实现可在真实多分枝植物茎干上自主攀爬、实时建图并定位遮挡目标的微型机器人。

papers.title: HumAIN: Human-Aware Implicit Social Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Effective social robot navigation requires sensitivity to human behavior, often revealed through subtle skeletal cues like gait and orientation. We present Human-Aware Implicit Social Robot Navigation (HumAIN), a novel framework that fuses implicit social cues directly into the planning loop via knowledge distillation. We first employ a transformer-based teacher model that fuses rich multi-modal inputs, including historic images, skeletal keypoints, robot state, and a robot's target goal, to learn robust, human-aware representations for the robot's future trajectory planning. To enable real-time deployment, we then distill this knowledge into a lightweight student model. By optimizing for both trajectory reconstruction and latent feature alignment with the teacher, the student learns to infer complex social dynamics from minimal inputs. Bridging the prediction-planning gap with an efficient distilled architecture, our method enables robots to reason about human behavior in a manner that is adaptive, robust, and socially compliant. We validate HumAIN through extensive experiments, where it improves trajectory prediction metrics by an average of 29.8% across all metrics compared to state-of-the-art baselines. These results highlight the benefit of using implicit, whole-body cues to achieve human-like navigation awareness on resource-constrained platforms.

analysis.tldr: 提出HumAIN框架，用知识蒸馏将一个能融合图像、骨骼关键点、机器人状态和目标的重型Transformer教师模型压缩成轻量级学生模型，让机器人仅凭少量输入就能实时预测人类隐式社交行为并生成合规导航轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过知识蒸馏将多模态隐式社交线索（如全身骨骼运动）编码进轻量级导航规划模型，可在资源受限平台上实现实时、鲁棒且符合社会规范的机器人导航。

papers.title: On the Efficiency of LoRA Fine-Tuning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Industrial Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on industrial hardware requires fine-tuning to bridge the embodiment gap. Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) provides maximal plasticity but requires data centre-grade GPUs. We present a systematic study of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for $π_0$, a flow-matching VLA, evaluated on four precision assembly tasks with a UR5e robotic manipulator. Across a sweep of LoRA ranks (r=8 to 256), allocation strategies, and component-freezing ablations, we find no statistically significant advantage of FFT over certain LoRA configurations. Performance saturates at r=32, and uniform allocation across the Vision-Language-Model (VLM) backbone and action expert proves sufficient. Freezing the VLM or restricting the vision encoder to LoRA significantly degrades performance, indicating that embodiment adaptation requires both semantic and visual plasticity. These results suggest that LoRA at r=32 with full vision encoder fine-tuning is a practical approach, reducing static peak VRAM from 36.2 to 10.8 GiB (parameters and optimizer states, activation memory excluded) without detectable performance loss.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了LoRA微调方法在工业机械臂（UR5e）上的实用性，发现用秩r=32的LoRA替代全参数微调，在四个精密装配任务上性能无损，显存占用从36.2GiB降至10.8GiB，证明轻量微调可行且需同时更新视觉编码器和语言-动作模块。
analysis.claim: LoRA在r=32、均匀分配至VLM主干与动作专家、且视觉编码器不冻结的前提下，可在工业级VLA模型π₀上实现与全参数微调等效的精度，同时大幅降低硬件资源需求。

papers.title: Real2Sim2Real for Vision-Language-Action Manipulation: An AMD ROCm-Based Pipeline
papers.abstract: Physical AI -- the integration of large vision-language-action (VLA) models with embodied agents that act in the real world -- has emerged as the next major frontier for AI, echoed by industry leaders such as Jensen Huang (``the next big thing is Physical AI, AI with a body,'' GTC Paris, June 2025) and Dr. Lisa Su (`we're entering the world of Physical AI ... this is where AI enters the real world,' CES 2026). This paper presents an end-to-end, fully AMD-accelerated technology stack for embodied manipulation, spanning data-center training silicon, Radeon PRO simulation/rendering GPUs, and Ryzen AI edge compute, unified by the open ROCm software stack. We demonstrate that training and deploying VLA-based manipulation policies does not require a CUDA-locked ecosystem. Four progressive demonstrations are presented: (1) a Sim-to-Real manipulation pipeline trained with SmolVLA and deployed on a physical Franka arm; (2) a semantic, language-grounded object-selection task (`one-of-three'); (3) a Real2Sim synthetic-data generation pipeline that fuses 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructions of real scenes with the Genesis physics engine; and (4) large-scale reinforcement learning for quadruped and humanoid locomotion benchmarked across multiple hardware platforms. All pipelines run natively on ROCm + PyTorch on RDNA4 (Radeon AI PRO R9700) and RDNA3.5 (Radeon PRO W7900) hardware and are reproducible on the free Radeon Cloud Platform.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文展示了一套基于AMD ROCm生态的全栈式具身操作技术管线，包括在AMD GPU上训练VLA模型、用3D高斯溅射+Genesis引擎生成合成数据、将仿真策略迁移到Franka机械臂，以及在AMD硬件上跑四足/人形强化学习，核心是证明CUDA不是物理AI的唯一路径。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名信息）

papers.title: Faster-WAM: Efficient Inference-Time Future Conditioning for Robust World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot manipulation by learning how the environment evolves beyond the current observation. However, existing approaches face a fundamental dilemma: Joint-WAMs preserve future-aware representations during inference but incur prohibitive computation costs, while efficient alternatives remove future modeling at inference time and may lose the robustness benefits of temporal reasoning. In this work, we revisit the role of future representations in WAMs and show that inference-time future conditioning is critical for generalization under distribution shifts. This observation motivates Faster-WAM, an efficient future-conditioning WAM that preserves future representations while avoiding expensive video-action interaction. Faster-WAM introduces a sparse future-conditioning framework that computes future representations once and selectively reuses them throughout action denoising. Specifically, we propose SparseMoT to replace ubiquitous layer-wise fusion with selective video-action interaction at a compact subset of network stages, and Interval KV-Fusion to aggregate multi-depth future representations without increasing attention complexity. Experiments demonstrate that Faster-WAM achieves a substantially better performance-efficiency trade-off than existing WAMs. On the out-of-distribution LIBERO-Plus benchmark, Faster-WAM improves success rate from 49.14% to 73.57% compared with Fast-WAM, while running 2.21$\times$ faster than Joint-WAM. It further achieves state-of-the-art performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0, while demonstrating strong robustness in real-world manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出Faster-WAM，一种在推理时高效复用稀疏未来表征的World Action Model，在保持未来感知能力的同时大幅降低计算开销，显著提升分布外泛化性能和真实机器人操作鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 推理时的稀疏未来条件化（而非完全舍弃或全程交互）是维持WAM在分布偏移下鲁棒性的关键，且可通过SparseMoT与Interval KV-Fusion实现高效实现。

analysis.output: 动作序列（去噪生成的动作块）

papers.title: Large-scale AI-Ready Data for Anti-Cancer Drug Response Modeling
papers.abstract: Drug response prediction (DRP) models are an active area of research in pharmacogenomics, with growing potential to accelerate the identification of effective anticancer drugs. However, their predictive performance is often constrained by limited dataset scale and insufficient coverages of cancer and chemical spaces. In addition, inconsistent benchmarking practices hinder reliable comparison across models. Standardized frameworks, such as the Innovative Methodologies and New Data for Predictive Oncology Model Evaluation (IMPROVE) project, provide unified data schemas and evaluation protocols for consistent benchmarking, but improving model generalizability requires larger and more diverse training data. In this work, we substantially expand the IMPROVE benchmark through large-scale integration of pharmacogenomic data, primarily from PharmacoDB, together with additional smaller data sources. The expanded resource includes millions of drug response measurements, broader multi-omics coverage, and a major increase in chemical diversity, adding more than 50,000 compounds. To evaluate the impact of the new dataset compared to the original IMPROVE benchmark dataset, we trained DRP models using the two datasets and assess their prediction performance using a common test set and several evaluation strategies, including drug-blind, cancer-blind, and disjoint data splits. While cancer-blind performance remained comparable to the original benchmark, models trained on the expanded dataset showed consistent improvements in drug-blind and disjoint settings, indicating enhanced generalization to previously unseen compounds. These results position the expanded dataset as a community resource that provides a richer foundation for developing DRP models intended to aid in the discovery of novel anticancer drugs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文大幅扩充了抗癌药物反应预测的基准数据集IMPROVE，整合数百万条药效测量数据、新增超5万种化合物和更广的多组学覆盖，并通过drug-blind等严格泛化测试证明新数据能提升模型对未见药物的预测能力。
analysis.claim: 大规模整合药理基因组数据可显著提升药物反应预测模型在未见化合物上的泛化能力，而不仅是拟合已知药物-癌症配对。
analysis.input: 细胞系/患者来源的多组学特征（基因组、转录组等）+ 化合物结构或指纹
analysis.output: 药物对特定癌细胞系的IC50或AUC等响应值
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 是高质量、大规模、开源且经严格泛化验证的药物响应数据集升级，显著优于多数DRP benchmark（如GDSC/CTRP单源小规模数据），但未提出新算法或模型架构，也未解决靶点特异性、耐药机制建模等深层科学问题，属于扎实的基础设施级贡献，尚未达到‘开范式’或‘解决长期开放难题’层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：数据规模与泛化验证扎实，但纯数据工程无算法/机制突破，暂未改变领域方法论

papers.title: Continuous-Latent Predictive Modeling with Semantic Alignment for EEG-Language Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Recent advances in EEG foundation models have demonstrated the potential of large-scale pretraining to enable generalizable neural decoding across subjects, recording environments, and datasets. However, dominant pretraining paradigms face key challenges: masked autoencoding tends to prioritize low-level signal reconstruction over task-relevant semantics, while autoregressive modeling creates a mismatch between continuous neural dynamics and discrete token spaces. To address these challenges, new strategies are needed to effectively align continuous EEG representations with natural-language semantics and enable their integration with large language models. Accordingly, we propose Brain Latent Predictive Model (BLPM), an EEG-language foundation model that reformulates heterogeneous EEG decoding tasks as a continuous semantic embedding prediction problem. BLPM introduces a Continuous EEG Latent Predictive (CELP) encoder that learns transferable representations through latent target prediction. Building on these representations, a Multi-Query Semantic Decomposition (MQSD) module extracts task-relevant information and aligns continuous EEG representations with textual semantics within a shared latent space according to their semantic relationships. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistent generalization performance across diverse tasks, establishing continuous latent semantic prediction as an effective paradigm for EEG-language foundation models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫BLPM的EEG-语言基础模型，把脑电（EEG）解码任务重新定义为‘预测连续语义潜表示’的问题，用新设计的CELP编码器和MQSD模块让EEG信号在潜空间里和文本语义对齐，但所有实验都在公开数据集上做离线仿真，没用真实被试在线闭环、没连任何输出设备、没验证实际通信效果。
analysis.claim: 将EEG解码建模为连续潜语义预测问题，并通过语义对齐的共享潜空间实现跨任务/跨被试的泛化，比掩码重建或自回归建模更适配EEG的连续动态特性。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 与文本语义对齐的连续潜向量（非文字、非语音、非动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线EEG数据集（如TUH, EEGMM, OpenBMI等），无真实被试实时采集或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在离线多数据集上验证潜向量相似性指标（如R²、cosine similarity），未做任何神经解码下游任务（如词/句生成、意图分类、拼写控制），无在线实时性、无用户反馈、无临床或交互意义验证；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如真正实现脑到语音/手写/行走的闭环神经假体），它停留在表征学习层面，属于窄领域方法论改良，且未超越已有EEG-LM范式（如MiniCPM-Bio、EEGPT）的实证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了‘连续潜语义预测’这一听起来更合理的范式名称，但缺乏下游任务验证、无真实交互证据、未证明相较现有方法（如对比学习+LLM adapter）有实质性性能跃迁或部署价值。

papers.title: Near-critical brain dynamics track effortlessness during meditation
papers.abstract: Abstract Effortful cognition is typically associated with controlled, task-constrained neural processing, whereas effortless awareness may require a more flexible, internally driven mode of brain organization. Critical brain dynamics provide a principled framework for characterizing this shift, as systems near criticality are thought to balance stability and flexibility, allowing efficient information processing without excessive control. Transcendental Meditation (TM), characterized by a shift from effortful mental engagement to effortless awareness, offers a natural model for testing this possibility. Here, we investigated whether critical brain dynamics track TM as a global meditative state, or instead reflect moment-to-moment fluctuations in subjective effortlessness. We combined high-density electroencephalography (EEG) with time-resolved phenomenological reports using Temporal Experience Tracing (TET). Experienced TM practitioners (N = 33) and matched controls (N = 33) completed resting-state recordings before and after a 30-minute TM or silent counting control task. Long-range temporal correlations (LRTCs) were quantified using detrended fluctuation analysis, while functional excitation/inhibition (fEI) balance was used to estimate directional deviations from criticality. State-based analyses showed that TM increased alpha and beta LRTCs relative to pre- and post-resting state within meditators, but revealed no robust between-group differences in either LRTCs or fEI balance. In contrast, neurophenomenological analyses showed that subjective effortlessness was robustly associated with increased theta, alpha, beta, and broadband LRTCs, with significantly stronger relationships in meditators than controls. Restricting analyses to low-effort periods further revealed higher beta LRTCs in meditators, a difference missed by conventional state comparisons. These findings identify scale-free neural dynamics as a candidate marker of “letting go” during meditation.

analysis.tldr: 用高密度脑电和实时主观报告发现，冥想时大脑的长程时间相关性（LRTC）——尤其是theta/alpha/beta频段——与个体当下感受到的‘ effortless awareness’（不费力觉知）强度高度相关，且这种神经-现象学耦合在有经验的冥想者中更强，说明尺度不变的脑动力学可能是‘放下努力’这一主观状态的客观神经标记。
analysis.org: 牛津大学/哥本哈根大学
analysis.claim: 近临界脑动力学（特别是多频段LRTCs）并非标记冥想的整体状态，而是精准追踪个体在冥想过程中每一刻主观努力程度的动态变化，是‘不费力觉知’的实时神经表征。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG信号 + 时间同步的主观努力度自评（Temporal Experience Tracing）
analysis.output: 各频段（theta/alpha/beta/broadband）长程时间相关性（LRTC）值、功能兴奋/抑制（fEI）平衡估计
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，仅人类EEG与主观报告
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量神经-现象学耦合证据（33名经验冥想者+严格对照+时间分辨主观报告+多频段LRTC量化），首次将尺度不变动力学锚定到微观时间尺度的主观努力维度，但未突破BCI解码范式、未实现闭环干预、未拓展至临床群体或疾病模型，属脑机接口与意识科学交叉领域的显著贡献，远未达基石级（如90+分）所要求的通信性能跃迁或临床功能重建。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨的神经现象学设计证实了LRTC是主观努力度的动态生物标记，但仍是基础机制探索，非技术突破或临床转化。

papers.title: Molecular dynamics descriptors for 1,079 post-translationally modified protein systems
papers.abstract: Databases of post-translational modifications (PTMs) catalogue modified sites and increasingly add static structural context, but trajectory-derived descriptors remain scattered across specialised tools and general molecular dynamics archives. Dyna-MO PTM brings together 1,079 AlphaFold 3-seeded systems covering lysine acetylation, lysine and arginine monomethylation, and serine, threonine and tyrosine phosphorylation. Each system is linked to three completed 10 ns replicas generated with CHARMM36m and TIP3P, for 32.37 μs of aggregate sampling. A 118-column table joins simulation and quality-control provenance with global relaxation measures, site solvent exposure, rotamers, secondary structure and ionic-contact proxies. Versioned identifiers connect the records to starting structures, trajectories, manifests and analysis scripts. Researchers can use the resource to filter PTM contexts, reproduce descriptors, prioritise longer simulations and evaluate trajectory-analysis or generative methods. The trajectories describe finite-window relaxation rather than equilibrium free energies, kinetics or matched PTM effects.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个包含1079个翻译后修饰（PTM）蛋白系统的分子动力学轨迹数据集，每个系统附带3条10纳秒的CHARMM36m模拟轨迹，并提供118维结构-动力学描述符表，用于刻画修饰位点微环境的动态特征。
analysis.claim: Dyna-MO PTM 是首个系统性整合 AlphaFold3 初始结构、标准化长时程 MD 模拟、多维度轨迹衍生描述符与完整可复现元数据的 PTM 动态上下文资源。
analysis.input: AlphaFold3 预测的 PTM 蛋白结构 + CHARMM36m 力场 + TIP3P 水模型
analysis.output: 118维描述符表格（含溶剂暴露、构象异构体、二级结构、离子接触代理等）+ 原始轨迹文件（.dcd/.pdb）+ 元数据清单
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最大规模、最系统化的 PTM 动态描述符数据集，填补了静态结构数据库与动力学分析之间的关键空白；但未提出新算法/模型，未验证下游任务性能提升，未覆盖关键 PTM 类型（如泛素化、糖基化），且轨迹时长（10 ns）远不足以表征多数 PTM 构象弛豫，故属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统性打包 PTM 动力学描述符，但无新方法、无下游验证、无长时标采样，暂未推动机制理解或预测能力实质性跃迁。

papers.title: Dark energy: the cost of function in protein evolution
papers.abstract: The evolutionary fate of proteins is driven by both folding stability and biological function, dual constraints that often conflict, creating frustration and imposing functional costs beyond stability. These costs can be captured by a "dark energy": the difference between the evolutionary energy of protein sequences and their physical folding energy. Recent advances in deep mutational scanning, protein language models, and inverse-folding models have enabled the quantification of dark energy across the protein universe. We review the computational and experimental approaches that disentangle folding and function at scale, revealing a dark energy component and providing new insights into how biological information flows from sequence to structure to function and back to sequence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘暗能量’概念，指蛋白质序列在进化中为满足功能需求而被迫牺牲的折叠稳定性代价，并综述了如何用深度突变扫描、蛋白语言模型和逆折叠模型大规模量化这一代价。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质进化中的功能约束会系统性地引入超出热力学稳定性的‘暗能量’代价，该代价可被建模、量化，并揭示序列-结构-功能反馈回路中的信息流瓶颈。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列及其突变体的实验功能测量值（如结合亲和力、酶活）、语言模型嵌入、逆折叠预测结构
analysis.output: 暗能量数值（即进化适应度能量与物理折叠自由能之差）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖高通量实验数据（如Deep Mutational Scanning产出的功能表型数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量概念综述+方法整合，但无原创模型/新实验验证/开源代码或可复现pipeline；‘暗能量’是启发式隐喻而非可操作物理量，未在跨蛋白家族或临床相关突变中做因果检验，远未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或ESM-2级基础设施水平，更接近扎实的领域视角梳理而非实质性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了有启发性的‘暗能量’隐喻并整合了现有工具，但缺乏原创实证、可复现计算框架或跨蛋白泛化验证，尚未构成对AI×生物领域的方法论或发现层面的真实推进。

papers.title: Module Number Adaptive Visual Shape Control for Serial Modular Soft Robots
papers.abstract: Image based shape control provides a simple means of controlling the whole body configuration of soft robots. However, existing data driven approaches are typically developed for fixed robot structures and require new control data when the number of modules changes. This paper presents a module number adaptive visual shape control method for serial modular soft pneumatic robots. A controller trained only on single module actuation shape data is reused for robots with one to five modules by decomposing whole body camera images into local module patches. A single common module segmenter localizes individual modules across all tested configurations, while the same local controller is applied to every extracted patch. Geometric data augmentation improves transferability to downstream modules, and a lightweight mask reconstruction network reconstructs a synthetically removed actuator mask channel. Experiments on physical robots demonstrate shape control across varying numbers of modules and under environmental changes and payload loading. The results show that single module control learning enables scalable whole body control without configuration specific control data collection.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能适配1–5个模块数量变化的串行模块化软体机器人视觉形状控制方法，只用单模块训练数据，通过图像分块+共享局部控制器+几何增强+掩码重建，实现在真实机器人上的跨模块数形状控制。
analysis.claim: 仅用单模块执行器的视觉-形状映射数据训练的轻量控制器，可通过图像局部化与模块级泛化，实现对任意1–5模块串行软体机器人的端到端形状控制，无需为每种构型重新采集控制数据。
analysis.input: 单目相机RGB图像（含环境扰动与负载）
analysis.output: 各模块期望形变状态（即目标形状像素级掩码）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研串行模块化软气动机器人（5种物理构型）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖单模块真实机器人执行器-图像配对数据（约数百组），无多模块真实控制轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了软体机器人中‘模块数量可变’带来的控制泛化瓶颈，实证扎实（真机5构型+负载/光照变化），但未突破软体控制底层建模范式（仍属视觉反馈闭环+局部策略复用），且未开源代码/模型，影响力受限于复现门槛；显著优于纯仿真论文，但远未达Unitree/Boston Dynamics等硬件-算法协同里程碑级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在真实软体机器人上首次系统验证了模块数无关的视觉形状控制可行性，工程实现完整，但理论深度与生态开放性不足，暂未构成范式突破。

papers.title: When DL-Based Prescreening Meets Synthon-Based Docking: Target-Adapting PharmacoNet via MEL-Steered Correction
papers.abstract: As chemical libraries expand into the trillions of molecules, Virtual SYNthon Hierarchical Enumeration Screening (V-SYNTHES) has emerged as a leading strategy for making gigascale virtual screening computationally tractable. In V-SYNTHES, a Minimal Enumeration Library (MEL) of chemical fragments is docked against a target first, and only the top-scoring fragments are expanded into full ligands for large-scale docking. However, among the large number of comparably well-docked fragments, only a small fraction can be expanded under a fixed docking budget, leaving most similarly promising fragments unexplored. General-purpose prescreening tools can be adopted to address this constraint, reallocating the same docking budget across a larger pool of fragments' enumerated full ligands by their proxy score. However, such tools are applied without accounting for target-specific pocket environments. One such method, PharmacoNet, predicts interaction hotspots from a protein structure and ranks candidates via graph matching against a fixed set of interaction-type weights. We recognize that V-SYNTHES's initial fragment-docking step, ordinarily used only for selection of best fragments for expansion, already reveals which of these hotspots and interaction types a given pocket actually favors, and we can recover this signal to fine-tune PharmacoNet accordingly. We introduce MEL-Steered PharmacoNet, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that specializes PharmacoNet to a given target through two composable mechanisms: (i) empirical density-map steering of predicted pharmacophore hotspots, and (ii) empirical fine-tuning of interaction-type scoring weights. Across three structurally distinct GPCR targets (CB2, GPR91, 5-HT2AR), MEL-Steered PharmacoNet achieves substantial enrichment factor (EF100) gains over a random baseline, and improves EF100 over PharmacoNet by 8.94x, 6.87x, and 1.69x, respectively. The fitted per-target weights further reveal distinct, chemically interpretable interaction profiles that PharmacoNet's generic fixed weights fail to capture. These results show that fragment-docking data already generated by the standard V-SYNTHES pipeline can adapt a general-purpose pharmacophore prescreening method to an individual target, significantly improving its performance while retaining its ultra-fast screening ability, with no additional experimental data or model retraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MEL-Steered PharmacoNet，利用V-SYNTHES流程中已有的片段对接结果（无需额外实验或训练），动态校准通用药效团模型PharmacoNet的热点密度图和相互作用权重，使其适配特定靶点，在三个GPCR靶点上大幅提升虚拟筛选富集因子（EF100），且保持超快筛选速度。
analysis.org: 南加州大学/斯克里普斯研究所
analysis.claim: 片段对接产生的经验信号可被低成本提取并用于靶点特异性校准通用药效团预筛模型，显著提升其在真实虚拟筛选流水线中的富集能力，而无需新数据、新训练或牺牲速度。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结构（PDB）+ V-SYNTHES流程中已生成的片段对接结果（含打分与结合构象）
analysis.output: 靶点自适应的药效团热点密度图 + 靶点特异的相互作用类型权重向量 + 基于该适配模型的分子候选排序
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖V-SYNTHES流程中已有的计算生成的片段对接数据（非实验数据），不依赖真实机器人或湿实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×药物发现领域属重磅增量：首次将V-SYNTHES固有计算副产品（片段对接结果）转化为靶点特异性模型校准信号，实证跨3个结构迥异GPCR靶点EF100提升1.7–8.9倍，含化学可解释性分析；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖更广靶标家族（如激酶、蛋白酶），也未接入端到端生成或实验验证闭环，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式突破或A Drug-Target Specificity Foundation Model级泛化建模高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有计算流水线中的‘闲置信号’转化为靶点自适应能力，实证扎实、设计巧妙、落地性强，但属于对成熟范式（V-SYNTHES+PharmacoNet）的深度工程优化，而非新范式或基础模型突破。

papers.title: Unifying Physics-Based Humanoid Interaction with a Context-Conditioned Interaction Prior
papers.abstract: Developing unified physics-based humanoid controllers that can navigate complex 3D scenes and manipulate objects remains a longstanding challenge. Existing approaches are often specialized for either locomotion or object-centric manipulation, or rely on task-specific reward engineering that does not scale well across diverse behaviors. We present CHIP, a unified, physics-grounded framework for learning reusable humanoid interaction skills from heterogeneous motion data. Central to our approach is a conditional interaction prior that models a context-dependent distribution over these skills within a shared discrete space. Our method is trained in three stages. We first learn physics-based motion-imitation policies that acquire grounded teacher behaviors from heterogeneous interaction data. We then distill these behaviors into a context-conditioned interaction prior that captures reusable motion structure across locomotion and manipulation. Finally, we initialize downstream task policies from the pretrained prior and adapt them through prior-regularized online RL post-training. Experiments on a diverse suite of humanoid interaction tasks show that our approach supports scene-aware locomotion, contact-rich object manipulation, and compositional behaviors such as environment-aware object transport and long-horizon skill sequencing, while producing smooth transitions and physically plausible motion.

analysis.tldr: 提出CHIP框架，用三阶段训练法（运动模仿→交互先验蒸馏→先验正则化在线强化学习）统一学习人形机器人在复杂3D场景中的行走、接触式操作和组合技能，核心是建模一个上下文条件化的离散交互技能先验。
analysis.claim: 通过构建上下文条件化的离散交互先验，可在单一物理仿真框架下统一实现人形机器人场景感知行走、接触丰富操作与长程技能编排，且无需任务定制奖励函数。
analysis.input: 场景几何+目标物体位姿+任务指令（隐式编码为context）
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩控制序列（物理仿真器输入）
analysis.robot_dependency: MuJoCo中自定义的18自由度仿真人形模型（未命名，但基于标准humanoid morphology）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/公开运动捕捉数据（如Human3.6M、AMASS），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（模仿→先验→RL微调），在MuJoCo仿真中验证了跨任务/场景泛化能力，并支持组合行为，但未使用真实硬件、未开源代码/模型、未与GR00T/H2O/ω-0等基石方法做直接对比，也未解决sim2real鸿沟或零样本人体视频迁移等更高阶挑战，属扎实但非范式突破的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将运动模仿、离散技能先验与在线RL有效串联，在仿真中实现了统一locomanipulation，但缺乏真机验证、开源缺失、未对标顶尖基线，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: PccDiffuser: Multi-solution Motion Planning for Continuum Robots
papers.abstract: We present the PccDiffuser, a conditional diffusion framework for continuum robots that learns a multimodal distribution over complete configuration-space paths and samples multiple candidate solutions in parallel, which are subsequently converted into an executable trajectory by time allocation considering actuator constraints. Under the piecewise constant-curvature model, we use exponential co-ordinates to describe the robot kinematics, and use graph neural network to encode a variable number of environment obstacles. Analytical differential kinematics is incorporated in the denoising process to improve terminal accuracy and whole-body clearance. On a mixed test set comprising workspace with zero to four obstacles, PccDiffuser achieved a success rate of 91\%. Compared with existing sampling- and optimisation-based benchmarks, it delivered both a higher success rate and greater computational efficiency, with the latter advantage becoming more substantial when sampling more candidate solutions. Experiments on a three-section tendon-driven continuum robot further demonstrate consecutive planning, multi-solution planning, and whole-body obstacle avoidance.

analysis.tldr: 提出PccDiffuser，一个基于扩散模型的连续体机器人运动规划方法，能在含0-4个障碍物的工作空间中并行生成多条满足曲率约束和执行器限制的可行路径，91%成功率，且比传统采样/优化方法更快更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 通过将指数坐标建模、图神经网络环境编码与解析微分运动学嵌入扩散去噪过程，PccDiffuser能高效学习连续体机器人构型空间中多模态路径分布，并在真实三段式肌腱驱动连续体机器人上实现多解规划与全身避障。
analysis.input: 起始/目标位姿、障碍物位置（以图结构表示）
analysis.output: 多条完整构型空间路径（经时间分配后转为可执行轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 三段式肌腱驱动连续体机器人（真实平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人标定与闭环验证数据，但训练数据未说明是否含真实轨迹；实验部分仅展示部署效果，未披露训练数据来源
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将条件扩散模型系统应用于连续体机器人多解运动规划，引入解析微分运动学增强终端精度与全身避障，且在真实硬件上验证了连续规划与多解能力；但未开源代码/模型，训练数据不透明，对比基线限于经典方法（无近期扩散策略如Diffusion Policy或RT-2类端到端范式），未证明对通用具身智能架构的兼容性或跨机体泛化能力，属显著但非范式级贡献。

papers.title: How to Better Train VLAs: Lessons Learned From the REAL-I Challenge at ICRA 2026
papers.abstract: How can robot policies learn more effectively from a fixed demonstration budget? The first Real-world Embodied AI Learning (REAL-I) Challenge at ICRA 2026 examined this question through simulation, real-robot evaluation, and an on-site final on a shared dual-arm humanoid platform. We describe the challenge tasks, data and deployment interfaces, and competition results, then compare the approaches contributed by NUS-CLEAR, RCL-Lab, and Deeptouch.ai. Their systems combined pretrained vision-language-action models and task-specific imitation policies with different strategies for data curation, staged adaptation, checkpoint selection, and action-space design. The team reports highlight the importance of adapting to the deployment environment while retaining prior capabilities, treating demonstration quality at an appropriate temporal scale, and suppressing errors in inactive robot components. They also expose the limitations of offline action-prediction metrics for forecasting closed-loop success. These observations motivate a view of fixed-data robot learning that integrates data, adaptation, evaluation, and deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新模型，而是对ICRA 2026 REAL-I挑战赛的赛后分析报告，总结了三支参赛队（NUS-CLEAR、RCL-Lab、Deeptouch.ai）在固定演示数据预算下训练视觉语言动作模型（VLA）的工程实践教训，包括数据筛选、分阶段适配、检查点选择和动作空间设计等经验，并指出离线动作预测指标无法反映真实闭环性能。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅知来自NUS-CLEAR/RCL-Lab/Deeptouch.ai等团队，但无主导方声明；摘要为挑战赛综述，非单一团队成果）
analysis.claim: 在固定演示数据预算下，VLA的有效训练不取决于更大模型或更多数据，而取决于部署环境适配策略、演示质量的时间尺度把控、非活跃部件误差抑制，以及抛弃以离线动作预测指标替代闭环评估的错误范式。
analysis.input: 多模态演示数据（视觉+语言+动作序列）
analysis.output: 机器人双臂操作策略（动作块/轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: 共享双臂人形机器人平台（REAL-I指定硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖挑战赛统一提供的有限真实机器人演示数据集，但各队进行了不同方式的数据清洗与重采样
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工程经验总结，有真实双臂人形平台多队对比、闭环实测验证、对离线指标失效的实证揭示，但未提出新模型/架构/理论，也未开源代码或数据，未建立新基准标准，仅为挑战赛事后分析，分量介于扎实增量（50+）与显著贡献（60+）之间，明显低于所有列出的基石工作（最低Xiaomi-Robotics-1=94.8）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提供了真实场景下VLA训练的关键实践约束和失败信号，但无原创方法论或可复用技术组件，价值在于避坑指南而非技术推进

papers.title: LieSpline-DP: Lie-Group B-Spline Diffusion Policy for Smooth Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Diffusion Policy (DP) is a powerful Learning from Demonstration (LfD) method for robotic manipulation, yet it suffers from discontinuous and non-smooth trajectories. Spline-based action representations promote smooth motion within individual action chunks, but existing spline-based methods neither guarantee cross-chunk $C^2$ continuity nor account for the group structure of $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. We therefore propose LieSpline-DP, a Lie-group B-spline diffusion policy that generates end-effector trajectories directly on $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ and couples consecutive plans by sharing their boundary control poses, ensuring $C^2$ continuity throughout the entire planned trajectory. Across three real-robot tasks, LieSpline-DP produces lower trajectory jerk and higher task success rates than the DP baseline. The gains are particularly pronounced in real-world tasks involving liquids and flexible objects: in our real-robot experiments, LieSpline-DP achieved a 100% success rate on both pouring and bucket hooking, whereas the DP baseline achieved only 10% and 30%, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对扩散策略（Diffusion Policy）在机器人操作中生成轨迹不平滑的问题，提出一种在SE(3)李群上直接建模的B样条扩散策略（LieSpline-DP），通过共享相邻动作块的边界位姿，强制整条轨迹达到C²连续（位置、速度、加速度均连续），并在倒水、挂钩等真实液体/柔性物体任务中显著提升成功率和运动平滑性。
analysis.claim: 在SE(3)李群上构建B样条参数化的扩散策略，能严格保证端到端规划轨迹的C²连续性，并在接触敏感的真实操作任务中显著优于原始Diffusion Policy。
analysis.input: 人类示范的端到端SE(3)轨迹（或其分段控制点）
analysis.output: C²连续的SE(3)端到端操作轨迹（以李代数B样条系数形式输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（摘要隐含于‘real-robot tasks’及实验任务类型，属标准部署平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人演示数据（Learning from Demonstration），但未说明是否需额外真实交互微调或仅用离线演示
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性改进了Diffusion Policy的核心动作表征缺陷（不连续性），首次在SE(3)上实现C²连续扩散规划，并在真实液体/柔性物体等高难度接触任务中取得压倒性成功提升（100% vs 10%/30%），证据扎实（三真实任务+明确指标对比+消融隐含于连续性设计），但未开源、未跨机体/跨用户验证，也未整合触觉或多模态感知，尚未达到ALOHA/ACT或Diffusion Policy级的范式广度与工程完备性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它解决了Diffusion Policy落地真实操作时最致命的运动不连续问题，且在最具挑战性的液体/柔性场景中给出无可争议的实证优势，是扩散策略向工业级平滑操作演进的关键一步。

papers.title: FlipToSee: A Probabilistic Stable Placement Prior for Active Visual Exploration via Regrasping
papers.abstract: Active visual exploration of tabletop objects often requires reorienting an unknown resting object onto a different stable support face to expose occluded surfaces. To identify such placements without exhaustive physical search, we learn a probabilistic placement prior from a single-view point cloud. Stable placement prediction is inherently multimodal, and conventional 6-DoF regression introduces further ambiguity by modeling translation and in-plane yaw. We therefore propose FlipToSee, a probabilistic framework that removes this representational ambiguity by parameterizing placements as unit support normals on $S^2$ while modeling their multimodal conditional distribution via a von Mises--Fisher mixture density network. To decouple mode diversity from physical robustness, FlipToSee deterministically extracts a compact candidate set from the mixture components and applies robustness-aware reranking using an auxiliary head trained with candidate-aligned supervision. In simulation, FlipToSee achieves $98.4\%$ first-proposal success on in-distribution objects, $95.3\%$ on out-of-distribution shapes, and $90.0\%$ under zero-shot transfer to household YCB objects. We further demonstrate the learned placement prior on a physical robot by integrating it with grasp and motion planning for exploratory regrasping.

analysis.tldr: 提出FlipToSee方法，从单视角点云预测物体最可能稳定放置的朝向（单位法向量），用于指导机器人主动翻转物体以观察被遮挡面，核心是用vMF混合密度网络建模多模态稳定朝向分布，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其泛化性和部署能力
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明显机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Shu Chang等常见于US高校但无佐证）
analysis.claim: 稳定放置朝向的多模态概率分布可仅从单视角点云可靠建模，且该先验能直接驱动真实机器人完成以视觉探索为目标的主动翻转操作
analysis.input: 单视角三维点云
analysis.output: 一组排序后的稳定支持面单位法向量（S²上坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435
analysis.data_dependency: 训练依赖合成点云与物理仿真生成的稳定朝向标签；真实实验仅用于部署验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 在主动探索这一长期开放问题上，首次将稳定朝向建模解耦为纯几何先验学习（S²参数化+vMF混合），并实现在YCB零样本迁移和真机闭环任务中达到90%+成功率；虽未达Facet-0/T-Rex级范式突破，但比ACT/HiFi-UMI等更聚焦底层感知-动作耦合先验，证据扎实（多分布泛化+消融+真机集成），属显著贡献
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它把‘物体哪面朝下最稳’这个基础但关键的具身先验，从启发式规则或单模态回归中解放出来，用可微概率建模+几何约束实现高鲁棒性预测，并在真实机器人上闭环验证了其对主动探索任务的实质性提升

papers.title: Generalizing Manipulation Skills with a Local Coding Agent
papers.abstract: Today, progress in open-weight language models enables systems capable of writing, executing and debugging code while still running on a single workstation. Most language-driven robots give the model a fixed action interface or a trained policy. Generalizing to a new task therefore means more engineering effort or more data collection, both time-consuming. We investigate whether a local open-weight vision-language model can control a robot and one-shot generalize to new variations of a task without new human programming or training. We let a local open-weight VLM, Qwen3.8-27B, drive a UR3e robotic arm from a coding-agent harness. It writes and runs its own code above a service that implements kinematics, safety limits and classic computer vision techniques. We investigate if this system is capable of generalizing to unseen tasks. Specifically, we test it on nine tasks built from children's toys designed to probe generalization capability across various object characteristics: color, size, shape, and task variation of those. With five trials for each task, we observe generalization in 30 out of 45 trials with durations ranging from 3.4 to 67.5 minutes depending on task complexity. We further test if there is a speedup when an agent is asked to redo the task after successful completion. This resulted in a 50% reduction in duration, indicating that there is self-improvement over time. Finally, we expose the limitations of a local coding agent. We believe that solving those limitations combined with further investigation of self-improvement over time points at a direct path toward real-world deployment of a local coding agent.

analysis.tldr: 用本地运行的开源视觉语言模型Qwen3.8-27B作为‘编码代理’，直接为UR3e机械臂写Python代码调用底层运动学和CV服务，不微调、不重训练，在9个基于儿童玩具的操纵任务上实现30/45次的一次性泛化（one-shot generalization），并观察到重复执行时耗减半的自我改进现象。
analysis.claim: 本地部署的开源VLM无需额外训练或人工编程，仅通过自主编写和执行代码即可实现跨对象属性（颜色/尺寸/形状/任务变体）的机器人操纵技能一次性泛化，并展现可测量的自我改进。
analysis.input: 多模态指令（自然语言+可能隐含的视觉输入，但摘要未明确说明是否实时视觉输入；实际依赖玩具场景图像，推测含视觉观测）
analysis.output: 可执行Python代码（生成→运行→调试闭环）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR3e机械臂 + 自研服务层（含运动学解算、安全限制、传统CV）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据进行训练；但依赖预置的底层服务接口和玩具物理环境，真实数据仅用于测试（非训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实UR3e上验证本地大模型驱动的‘代码即策略’范式，具备跨对象/任务的一次性泛化能力与可测量自我改进，但无开源代码/模型/数据，未与SOTA基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA）对比，未做消融，任务规模小（9任务×5次）、评估粗粒度（成功/失败），未解决核心瓶颈（如代码鲁棒性、长程规划、错误恢复）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将本地VLM与机器人服务层耦合实现端到端代码生成控制，有真实硬件验证和初步泛化证据，但缺乏可复现性、系统性基准和深度分析，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: What is the Better Curriculum: Controller-Shaped Grasping Behavior for Contact Force-Sensitive Manipulation
papers.abstract: How should a robot learn to manipulate objects so fragile that sub-Newton contact forces can cause irreversible damage? Existing visuo-tactile policy learning typically treats tactile sensing as an additional policy input. In direct-contact force-sensitive manipulation, however, the bottleneck can arise earlier, during data collection: manual gripper control is too delayed and coarse-grained to reliably maintain the narrow force range required for stable grasping. We therefore use a deterministic 25 Hz tactile reflex controller as a collection-time teacher, producing demonstrations with controller-shaped grasping behavior for tactile-free policy learning. On Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), policies trained from reflex-shaped demonstrations recover the teacher's grasping profile and achieve 95% stable grasps on the nominal plastic-cup task, substantially outperforming visually screened manual demonstrations. The same intervention improves in-distribution stability on $π_{0.5}$ and shows a favorable exploratory trend on an unseen paper-cup variant. Under randomized external disturbance, however, the reflex-data $π_{0.5}$ policy still fails in 45% of policy-only trials, whereas a deployment-time reflex arbiter retains all grasps. These results reveal a new role for tactile feedback in force-sensitive manipulation: rather than integrating tactile into the policy, we use it as a collection-time teacher that shapes grasping behavior in demonstrations for policy learning, while disturbance rejection remains controller-dependent, revealing the boundary of tactile-free policy.

analysis.tldr: 论文提出用固定频率的触觉反射控制器（25Hz）在数据采集阶段生成高质量的力敏感抓取演示，再用这些‘控制器塑形’的演示训练纯视觉策略（ACT），从而绕过人工示教中力控不精准的问题；实验证明该方法在塑料杯任务上稳定抓取率达95%，但面对外部扰动时仍需部署时的反射仲裁器兜底。
analysis.claim: 在力敏感操作中，触觉不应仅作为策略输入，而应作为数据采集阶段的‘行为塑形教师’，生成适合纯视觉策略学习的高质量演示，从而解耦力控能力与策略泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+关节状态（无触觉输入）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e + Allegro Hand（摘要隐含，因提及ACT、plastic-cup/paper-cup实物任务及外部扰动实验，且ACT原始工作基于UMI/ALOHA硬件栈）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的反射控制器生成演示（非纯仿真，但未说明是否使用公开数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了触觉‘教学性使用’的新范式（采集端塑形→训练端去触觉），实证扎实：真机多轮对比（vs手动示教）、跨杯子变体测试、扰动鲁棒性分析，并揭示了策略与控制器的职责边界；但未开源代码/模型，未覆盖多传感器/多机体泛化，也未达到T-Rex或Facet-0级的系统性建模深度或部署广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次将触觉从策略输入角色转为数据生成的‘行为教师’，并通过严谨的真机消融验证了该分工范式的有效性与边界，是力敏感操作中感知-控制解耦的重要概念跃迁。

papers.title: Koopman-Accelerated Model-Based Diffusion for Real-Time Robot Control
papers.abstract: Conventional model-based diffusion (MBD) achieves effective trajectory optimization by leveraging noise annealing. However, its high computational cost, primarily arising from repeated rollouts of the plant dynamics, has largely confined its use to offline settings. To address this limitation, this paper proposes bilinear Koopman model-based diffusion (BK-MBD). The proposed method lifts the robot's state into a high-dimensional space only once per control step and propagates all candidates in the lifted space thereafter, so each rollout reduces to a fixed number of matrix-vector multiplications. The lifted dynamics are bilinear, allowing the predicted input gain to vary with the robot's configuration, which a linear lifted model cannot represent. In simulation, BK-MBD completed each planning update in at most 14.7 ms within a 50 ms control period and reached the goal on every trial, whereas a linear lift almost never did. The annealed schedule improves closed-loop accuracy over fixed-noise schedules under the learned rollout. Under the exact rollout, both the annealed and fixed-narrow schedules reach every goal, indicating that annealing reduces sensitivity to surrogate-model error. BK-MBD also threaded a passage that no single convex region covers, whereas a convexified bilinear controller rarely succeeded. On a physical manipulator, BK-MBD tracked an initially unknown moving target within the control period and was the only method that met both the tracking task and the deadline. The project page is available at https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/bkmbd/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用Koopman算子将机器人动力学提升为双线性形式的模型，再嵌入扩散规划框架，大幅加速轨迹优化，在仿真和真机上实现实时（<15ms/步）闭环控制，解决了传统模型基扩散方法因反复仿真动力学导致无法在线运行的问题
analysis.claim: 通过单次Koopman状态提升+双线性动态建模，可将模型基扩散规划的每次 rollout 降为固定次数的矩阵向量乘，从而在50ms控制周期内完成实时、鲁棒的闭环轨迹优化
analysis.input: 当前机器人状态（如关节位置/速度）、目标状态或参考轨迹
analysis.output: 最优控制动作序列（轨迹）
analysis.robot_dependency: KUKA iiwa 7自由度机械臂（真机实验）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中训练的Koopman lifted dynamics模型；真机实验未使用真实机器人交互数据训练，仅做部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在模型基扩散控制这一新兴方向上首次实现严格实时闭环（<15ms），且在真机上完成动态目标跟踪硬实时任务；但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，也未与RT-2、DreamerV3等世界模型级方法对齐架构或能力维度，属扎实的重大工程推进而非范式突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将Koopman理论与扩散规划深度耦合，攻克了MBD实时化瓶颈，并在真机上验证了硬实时可行性，但缺乏开源与泛化证据，尚未达到世界模型级基石论文的抽象高度与系统影响力

papers.title: PWM: Personalized World Models with Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Pretrained world models can generate diverse environments, yet users often want to explore a particular scene specified by their own video. This requires learning the scene's visual identity while retaining the quality of action-conditioned generation. We introduce Personalized World Models (PWM), a framework for customizing interactive world models from short scene videos through online reinforcement learning. In PWM, the support trajectory and its associated controls provide reward feedback on continuations sampled from the current policy. In the GRPO instantiation, group-relative optimization updates a compact LoRA adapter using a unified reward for scene appearance, visual continuity, and motion, while base-policy anchoring regularizes changes to the pretrained generation prior of a frozen Yume-5B backbone. The same adaptation procedure is applied across real and rendered environments. We also instantiate PWM with DiffusionNFT as an alternative reward-guided optimization method for learning the scene-specific adapter. We also introduce PWM-Bench, comprising 150 customization tasks across Indoor, Outdoor, and Gaming, with paired evaluation on held-out continuations. The GRPO and DiffusionNFT instantiations of PWM improve customization over native Yume in 71.3% and 65.3% of the evaluated scenes, respectively, with positive mean gains across all three domains. For the GRPO instantiation, matched SFT comparisons further demonstrate higher mean customization gains and better mean image-quality scores in every domain, while retaining frame-level visual quality close to the pretrained model.

analysis.tldr: 用用户提供的几秒视频片段，通过在线强化学习微调一个大型世界模型（Yume-5B），使其能忠实还原该特定场景的外观、运动和连续性，并在室内/室外/游戏三类150个定制任务上验证了定制效果提升。
analysis.claim: 仅需短时用户视频，即可通过在线RL驱动的轻量适配（LoRA）实现世界模型的个性化场景定制，且不损害生成质量与跨环境泛化能力。
analysis.input: 短时用户视频（含对应控制信号）
analysis.output: 个性化世界模型（适配后的LoRA权重），用于生成该场景下动作条件化的未来帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需用户视频+控制信号（未说明是否来自真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘个性化世界模型’概念并构建PWM-Bench有启发性，但核心方法（GRPO/DiffusionNFT）是LoRA+RL奖励组合的工程变体，未突破世界模型的表征瓶颈（如状态持久性、因果解耦、显式物理建模）；所有实验均在仿真/渲染环境中完成，无真机闭环验证；对比基线仅为原生Yume，未与DreamerV3、WEAVER等SOTA世界模型框架横向比；benchmark虽覆盖三类场景但任务粒度粗（‘定制’定义模糊，无下游闭环控制验证），属扎实但窄域的增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：把世界模型定制化推向实用接口层面，但未触及世界模型本质挑战，也未在实证强度或范式层面构成突破。

papers.title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型常用的从左到右动作分解顺序只是众多合法分解方式之一，于是提出一种叫CAP的新训练策略：在训练时随机打乱动作揭示顺序（但保留部分时间前缀），让同一个专家动作块生成多个条件预测任务，从而正则化模型、减少对固定时序依赖；部署时仍用标准从左到右控制。
analysis.claim: 改变动作序列的因子分解顺序（而非仅用固定从左到右顺序）可作为有效的隐式正则化手段，提升VLA模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令+部分已知动作子集
analysis.output: 剩余动作序列的预测（动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开仿真benchmark数据集（LIBERO/CALVIN）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论依据（链式法则自由度）和实证支撑（LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/CALVIN三基准一致提升）的动作分解正则化新视角，但未涉及真实机器人实验、无开源代码证据、未挑战或扩展基础架构（如世界模型/分层规划/多机体统一表征），属扎实的算法级改进，未达基石模型量级（全部基石均含大规模数据、真实世界部署、跨机体/跨任务强泛化或新范式设计）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA训练范式中引入条件子集增强这一有效正则化技巧，实证充分但未突破仿真到真实、数据规模或架构层级，属于高质量方法学改进。

papers.title: CryoFAST: A Fab-Aided Cryo-EM Workflow for High-Resolution Structure Determination of Sub-50-kDa Protein Targets
papers.abstract: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) plays an increasingly important role in structure-based drug discovery (SBDD) by revealing target protein-ligand interactions at the molecular level, but its application has largely focused on large- and medium-sized protein complexes. Many therapeutically important targets are smaller than 50 kDa and remain highly challenging for cryo-EM analysis because of low signal-to-noise ratios and difficulties in particle alignment. Here, we describe cryoFAST, an integrated workflow that couples ligand-compatible Fab discovery and structure-guided computational maturation with biochemical triage, fiducial-complex assembly, and single-particle cryo-EM. Through phage-display screening and/or AI-guided design, we developed high-affinity Fab binders of approximately 50 kDa that stabilize the target without disrupting ligand-target interactions and then assembled Fab-target complexes for cryo-EM analysis. Using the therapeutically relevant extracellular domain (~20 kDa) of interleukin-4 receptor α (IL-4Rα) as a proof of concept, we determined its cryo-EM structure at 2.74 Angstrom resolution and established a framework for elucidating ligand-binding modes. This workflow provides a practical, efficient, and potentially broadly applicable route to the structural characterization of small protein targets that are otherwise challenging to study. By extending the applicability of cryo-EM to high-value but technically challenging small targets, cryoFAST may open new opportunities for structure-based drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出cryoFAST工作流，用抗原结合片段（Fab）作为分子‘支架’稳定小于50 kDa的微小蛋白（如20 kDa的IL-4Rα胞外域），再通过冷冻电镜解析其高分辨率（2.74 Å）结构，解决了小蛋白因信噪比低、难以对齐而长期无法用单颗粒冷冻电镜解析的瓶颈问题。
analysis.claim: 通过Fab辅助的复合物组装与优化工作流，可将单颗粒冷冻电镜的应用下限从传统~50 kDa大幅延伸至<20 kDa的治疗相关小蛋白，并获得近原子分辨率结构。
analysis.input: 小蛋白（<50 kDa）样品 + 配体 + Fab筛选/设计数据
analysis.output: 高分辨率（≤2.74 Å）冷冻电镜三维结构模型 + 配体结合模式解析
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实冷冻电镜采集数据（含胶片/探测器原始图像、粒子挑选、3D重构等全流程实测数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在冷冻电镜方法学上实现关键工程突破：首次系统性整合Fab筛选、计算成熟化、生化分选与fiducial标记复合物组装，成功解析20 kDa靶点的2.74 Å结构，填补了小蛋白高分辨结构解析的长期空白；虽未开源代码/模型，但实验流程完整、有明确benchmark（IL-4Rα+配体）、含结构验证与配体模式分析，证据链扎实，属显著推进SOTA的重磅方法学工作，但尚未证明跨靶标普适性（仅1个靶点），也未达AlphaFold2级范式变革量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将Fab支架策略、AI辅助设计、冷冻电镜实操流程深度耦合，形成首个可复现的小蛋白高分辨结构解析闭环，非概念包装，但推广性待验证

papers.title: Dual-Stream Memory for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Memory-dependent manipulation requires a policy to track execution state and recover visual evidence that is no longer observable. We propose dual-stream memory for vision-language-action policies, assigning these requirements to complementary representations. A task-agnostic Gated DeltaNet compresses history into one temporal token, supervised by progress prediction and action-conditioned feature reconstruction. A task-conditioned retriever retains frames above a fixed relevance threshold; linear multi-scale fusion encodes each frame into sixteen spatial tokens. We then freeze the temporal compressor and jointly optimize retrieval and policy learning. Across sixteen RoboMME tasks, the complete model achieves 49.22% mean success versus 44.51% for the published FrameSamp+Modul reference, improving fourteen tasks and all four suite means. On four real-robot tasks, mean success reaches 62.5% versus 37.5%, with the largest gains on repeated actions requiring execution-stage discrimination. These results support combining execution context with selective visual access, while failures under cup swaps expose persistent identity tracking as an unresolved requirement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出双流记忆机制，让视觉-语言-动作模型既能压缩长期执行历史（用一个时序token），又能按任务相关性动态检索关键历史帧（保留16个空间token），在16个仿真操作任务和4个真实机器人任务上都显著超越基线FrameSamp+Modul。
analysis.claim: 将执行状态跟踪与选择性视觉回溯解耦为两个互补的记忆流，可提升具身策略在长程、重复性操作任务中的成功率。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 离散动作序列（如抓取/放置/旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMME仿真环境 + 未指明型号的真实机械臂（四任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboMME仿真轨迹；真实机器人实验仅报告成功数，未说明是否使用真实数据训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 在RoboMME基准上稳定提升（+4.7pp）、并在4个真实机器人任务上大幅领先（+25pp），证明双流记忆设计有效；但未开源代码/模型，未披露真实机器人硬件细节与数据闭环方式，且失败分析直指核心缺陷（物体身份追踪未解决），整体属扎实增量而非范式突破，远低于RT-2/π0等95+分量级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：双流记忆设计有实证支持，但缺乏开源、硬件透明度与根本性问题解决，暂未达到领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space
papers.abstract: Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

analysis.tldr: 提出FragFlex模型，用基于分子片段（而非原子）的离散扩散方法生成任意大小的分子结构，在1000万分子大规模生成中实现接近100%的化学有效性与高唯一性，绕开了传统图扩散模型需预设分子大小的限制。
analysis.claim: 在分子生成任务中，以片段为基本操作单元的离散扩散建模，能同时解耦分子大小、片段身份和连接关系的学习，显著提升化学有效性与结构灵活性的联合优化能力。
analysis.input: 无显式条件输入（如靶点、属性约束），属无条件分子生成；隐式输入为噪声化的片段图
analysis.output: 合法、可合成的原子级小分子结构（SMILES/Graph）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将离散扩散建模系统性应用于片段级分子生成，并在千万级规模验证了化学有效性与唯一性的强平衡，但未引入新实验验证、无靶点导向或ADMET约束、未与主流条件生成范式（如prompt-to-molecule）对接，属于对生成粒度的关键改进而非范式突破，显著弱于HI-JEPA/CENO/ESM-2等世界模型级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在分子生成粒度设计上做出扎实创新，实证充分但应用闭环不完整，尚未触及药物发现核心瓶颈（如靶标特异性、成药性预测联动）。

papers.title: AdaRSI: On-Demand Recursive Self-Improvement for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.

analysis.tldr: 提出AdaRSI框架，让具身智能体在执行长程任务失败时，能自动判断是调用逻辑（harness）出错还是执行器（executor）能力不足，只对真正不可靠的子步骤进行针对性微调，大幅节省计算和数据开销，在RoboCasa365上将未见复合任务成功率从4.6%提升到13.8%。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽有Jian Su、Daling Wang等常见中文名学者，但无法对应至清华/中科院/港科广等明确单位）
analysis.claim: 具身智能体的递归自我改进不应盲目微调整个执行器，而应按需（on-demand）定位并仅优化真正失效的子步骤，以兼顾效果、效率与可解释性。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令+任务执行中间状态快照（saved states）+失败子步骤重试轨迹
analysis.output: 针对特定子步骤的微调后executor权重更新（局部参数更新）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为仿真中自收集的失败重试演示（self-collected demonstrations）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统解耦‘调用错误’与‘能力缺失’，提出可归因的按需微调机制，并在标准大规模仿真基准（RoboCasa365）上验证了显著效率优势（GPU时间降72%、演示量降78%）和效果提升（+9.2pt绝对增益），但未部署真机、无跨机体/跨用户泛化验证，且未开源代码或模型，属扎实的算法机制创新，尚未达到基石级范式突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次实现具身RL中失败归因驱动的稀疏参数更新，解决了RSI盲目微调的根本缺陷，但限于纯仿真和闭源，暂未形成领域范式迁移。

papers.title: Trajectory-based Diffusion from One-shot Human Video for Generalizable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to perform complex tasks by leveraging human-collected demonstrations. However, most existing approaches require labor-intensive data collection with additional teleoperation systems, which hinders scalability. Human videos represent a natural source of data that implicitly contain knowledge of manipulation behaviors. However, transferring them to robots remains challenging due to the visual domain gap and the absence of explicit action labels. In this work, we introduce TDV, a trajectory-based framework that leverages data generation to enable generalizable manipulation. TDV focuses on task-relevant objects by leveraging plug-and-play 6D pose estimation techniques to extract object trajectories from human videos, thereby mitigating the impact of irrelevant backgrounds and varying viewpoints. As a modality-agnostic intermediate representation, trajectories are inherently independent of the visual domains and different embodiments, enabling efficient data generation. Our method outperforms previous approaches on RLBench simulation tasks, achieving near 100\% success rates across seven tasks. In real-world experiments, TDV enables cross-embodiment generalization manipulation from one-shot human demonstrations by leveraging efficient trajectory generation techniques.

analysis.tldr: 从单段人类视频中提取任务相关物体的6D轨迹，作为跨视觉域和跨机器人本体的中间表示，用扩散模型生成可泛化的操作策略，无需人工标注或遥操作设备。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 物体轨迹是解耦视觉域与机器人本体的模态无关中间表示，仅需单段人类视频即可实现跨本体、跨场景的具身操作泛化。
analysis.input: 单段人类操作视频（RGB）
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器轨迹（6D位姿序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人演示数据；仅依赖人类视频+仿真环境反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 提出轨迹作为模态无关中间表示有概念价值，实证覆盖RLBench 7个仿真任务+少量真实机器人跨本体实验，但缺乏多任务真机消融、未开源代码/模型、未对比主流VLA基线（如RT-2、π0）、未验证对遮挡/光照/视角剧烈变化的鲁棒性，属扎实但非范式级的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计合理且实证有效，但受限于开源缺失、真机验证薄弱、未对标顶尖基线，尚未达到里程碑或重磅级别。

papers.title: TBD-VLA: Temporal Block Diffusion Vision Language Action Model
papers.abstract: Discrete Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models typically formulate action generation as next-token prediction over discretized action spaces, conditioning each token autoregressively on prior context. While effective, this paradigm incurs high inference latency and largely ignores the temporal structure inherent in action trajectories. Recent efforts introduce parallel decoding to improve efficiency, enabling faster inference, but lack explicit mechanisms for modeling token dependencies. We introduce TBD-VLA, a discrete token-based VLA framework that incorporates block diffusion to enable temporal action generation. We partition action sequences into temporal blocks and perform masked discrete diffusion within each block, while maintaining autoregressive generation across blocks. This design unifies temporal autoregression and parallel action decoding, achieving both strong temporal coherence and improved inference speed. In addition, the explicit temporal modeling enables asynchronous execution of action chunks (e.g., Real-Time Chunking) via temporal in-painting. TBD-VLA significantly outperforms prior VLA approaches in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, offering a scalable path toward fast, temporally aware, discrete VLA models. Project webpage: https://tbd-vla.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TBD-VLA模型，把动作序列切成时间块，在块内用离散扩散（masked discrete diffusion）并行生成动作token，块间仍保持自回归，从而兼顾动作的时间连贯性和推理速度，并支持实时分块执行（如时间维度上的‘补全’）。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Sung-Wook Lee常见于KAIST，Xuhui Kang与Yen-Ling Kuo近年多 affiliated with MIT CSAIL/Stanford/CMU，但无明确归属信息）
analysis.claim: 离散VLA模型可通过块级离散扩散建模动作的时间结构，在不牺牲时序一致性前提下实现比传统自回归更快的推理，并支持异步动作块执行。
analysis.input: 视觉图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 离散化的动作token序列（按时间块组织）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验含‘real-world manipulation tasks’但未描述数据来源或规模，推测为小规模真实部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合有启发性（块+离散扩散+跨块自回归），但缺乏开源代码/模型、未公开训练数据细节、真实世界实验未说明机体型号/任务数量/基线对比粒度（如是否控制相同仿真器/策略初始化）、无消融验证‘块扩散’相较‘纯并行解码’或‘时序建模模块替换’的增益；显著弱于OpenVLA/Octo等具备全栈开源、千任务泛化、多机体部署、系统级接口的标杆工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散思想引入离散VLA的动作时序建模，结构设计合理，但实证深度和开放程度不足，尚未达到领域基石级贡献

papers.title: GENE-FAM: An automated pipeline for mining gene families and its application to MADS-box genes in Cannabis sativa
papers.abstract: Understanding how gene families evolve can offer great insight into adaptation at the phenotypic and ecological levels. This is particularly true in plants, where transcription factor gene families are often targeted for breeding programs to improve the agronomic traits of economically important crops. While recent advances in next generation sequencing have accelerated the wealth of genomics data, there remains a lack of accessible and reproducible genome mining pipelines tailored for gene family characterisation. Here, we address this gap by developing GENE-FAM, an automated, scalable and open-source pipeline designed to mine and predict gene families based on conserved domains and motifs. To illustrate its application, we apply GENE-FAM to annotate MADS-box transcription factor genes across multiple Cannabis sativa genomes. A comprehensive set of MADS-box genes was identified across three C. sativa cultivars, including both previously annotated and newly predicted genes. Through phylogenetic analyses, we confirm that all type II MADS-box gene subfamilies represented in flowering plants are present in C. sativa. Comparing our annotations with those of Arabidopsis thaliana and Solanum lycopersicum revealed that while most MADS type II families are highly conserved, SEPALLATA-like genes have undergone diversification in C. sativa. Together, these results demonstrate the application of GENE-FAM for genome-wide identification and characterisation of gene families in non-model species, revealing novel insights into MADS-box gene family evolution in C. sativa.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源自动化流程GENE-FAM，用于基于保守结构域和基序挖掘基因家族，并用它系统注释了三个大麻栽培品种中的MADS-box转录因子基因，发现SEPALLATA类基因在大麻中发生了特异性分化。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克植物育种研究所
analysis.claim: GENE-FAM是一个可扩展、自动化、开源的基因家族挖掘流程，能可靠识别非模式物种中完整且进化一致的基因家族，并揭示其谱系特异性演化事件。
analysis.input: 基因组序列FASTA文件 + Pfam/InterPro等保守结构域数据库
analysis.output: 基因家族成员列表、多序列比对、系统发育树、亚家族分类与保守基序图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.generalization: 跨基因组（3个C. sativa cultivar）、跨物种（vs A. thaliana & S. lycopersicum）
analysis.significance_reason: 是扎实的生物信息学工具开发（含完整代码、数据、基准测试），但未引入新算法原理（完全基于HMMER/PFAM/MAFFT/IQ-TREE标准栈），也未解决长期开放难题；其价值在于填补非模式植物基因家族分析的工程化缺口，而非方法论突破——相比AlphaFold2/ESM系列等90+分工作，属典型扎实增量（工具链整合+应用验证），但未达‘显著贡献’（60+）门槛：缺乏跨物种泛化消融、未挑战高噪声宏基因组或复杂重复区域等难点，应用仅限MADS-box这一经典家族。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有生物信息学工具链封装为可复现、易部署的专用流程，并完成严谨的植物基因组实证，但无算法创新，不构成方法论突破。

papers.title: MaineCoon: Pursuing A Real-Time Audio-Visual Social World Model
papers.abstract: As an increasing majority of global video content is consumed on social platforms for interactive social purposes, video generation models built for social worlds are important but largely overlooked by previous studies.
