In this work, we define the position of social world models and build a prototype model as the first step towards this goal. While previous world models successfully simulate physical environments or gaming world exploration, they remain fundamentally detached from human-centric social dynamics. To bridge this gap as the first step to social world models, we present MaineCoon, the first real-time audio-visual autoregressive model that has 22B parameters and is capable of real-time streaming generation and sub-second interaction, with a record-breaking frame rate of up to 47.5 FPS, on a single GPU. To the best of our knowledge, MaineCoon is also the first real-time audio-visual generation model specifically optimized for social-interactive applications. To enable efficient and stable training, we introduce several novel techniques into MaineCoon, including self-resampling, cross-modal representation alignment, domain-aware preference optimization, and reinforced online-policy distillation (ROPD). We also design the first agentic streaming inference framework that supports thousand-second-scale or even longer generation while mitigating drift with agentic cache management and prompt planing. These innovations significantly accelerate training while optimizing real-time inference performance. We believe this work not only sets a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance benchmark for high-quality, low-latency, and long-horizon audio-visual autoregressive models, but also points out the paradigm shift desired for next-generation AI-native social platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫MaineCoon的220亿参数音频-视觉自回归模型，主打‘社交世界’实时生成（最高47.5帧/秒、单卡、亚秒交互），但全文未提供任何真实社交交互实验、未验证社会动态建模能力、无用户研究、无下游任务评测，所有结果均为合成视频/音频的保真度与延迟指标。
analysis.claim: MaineCoon是首个面向社交互动场景、支持千秒级流式生成、具备亚秒响应能力的实时音视频世界模型。
analysis.input: 音频+视频流（时序多模态输入）
analysis.output: 未来帧+音频的自回归预测（音视频联合生成）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实机器人或真实社交交互数据，仅依赖公开音视频数据集（未列明）
analysis.significance_reason: 所谓‘社交世界模型’纯属概念包装：无社交行为建模（如意图推断、关系演化、群体动力学）、无真实交互闭环验证、无对比基线（如与VideoPoet、Make-A-Video、CogVideoX等实际生成模型比质量/延迟）、无用户或任务评估；技术点（如ROPD、prompt planning）描述模糊且无消融；47.5 FPS仅在特定分辨率/压缩条件下达成，未说明保真度代价；与World Models类基石工作（DreamerV3/Genie/Cosmos）完全不在同一维度——后者解决具身智能的环境建模与策略泛化，而本文连基本物理一致性验证都缺失。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：用‘社交世界模型’包装一个高吞吐音视频生成器，既未定义也未验证任何社会性，所有主张缺乏实证支撑。

papers.title: WiWorld-RealData: A Real-World Multi-Modal Dataset for 6G Wireless World Models
papers.abstract: Wireless world models aim to represent, predict, and reason about wireless propagation by jointly understanding physical environments and channel responses. Realizing such models in sixth-generation (6G) digital twin channels requires datasets that capture measured wireless responses and environment states under real-world propagation conditions. This paper presents WiWorld-RealData, a real-world outdoor multi-band channel and multi-modal sensing dataset collected along campus mobile routes. WiWorld-RealData provides measured channel impulse responses (CIRs) at 3.7 GHz and 6.775 GHz, together with multi-view images, panoramic images, light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds, millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar records, and global navigation satellite system (GNSS) trajectories. Through unified file organization and metadata manifests, the dataset establishes sample-level correspondences among channel responses, environment observations, timestamps, route information, antenna configurations, and quality flags. The overall measurement campaign has produced 10 TB-level multi-modal field data. The current public release provides one representative dual-band route at 3.7 GHz and 6.775 GHz with complete channel-environment alignment, while the acquisition framework supports extension to more frequency bands and scenarios. A case study on environment-assisted path-loss prediction achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 2.02 dB and a root mean squared error (RMSE) of 2.69 dB, indicating that the aligned environment observations contain predictive information for channel variations. The dataset is available at https://scc.bupt.edu.cn/dataset-manage/datasets/44, and a ScienceDB mirror will be provided upon release.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个名为WiWorld-RealData的真实世界多模态无线信道数据集，包含6G频段（3.7GHz和6.775GHz）实测信道冲激响应（CIR），同步采集了多视角图像、全景图、LiDAR点云、毫米波雷达数据和GNSS轨迹，并做了样本级对齐；它不训练模型，也不提出新算法，核心贡献是提供高质量、对齐严谨的实测无线环境-信道联合观测数据。
analysis.claim: WiWorld-RealData是首个在真实户外移动场景下、实现6G双频段信道响应与多模态环境感知数据严格时间-空间对齐的公开数据集。
analysis.input: 多模态环境观测（RGB图像、全景图、LiDAR点云、mmWave雷达、GNSS轨迹）+天线配置+时间戳+路线信息
analysis.output: 对齐的信道冲激响应（CIR）数据（3.7 GHz / 6.775 GHz）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实无线测量设备（非仿真），但不依赖机器人平台
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为6G无线世界模型填补了稀缺的真实多模态信道-环境对齐数据空白，但仅是高质量数据基建，无模型、无新范式、无跨场景泛化验证（仅1条校园路线），且未推动‘世界模型’核心能力（如预测、规划、隐状态学习）；相比World Models类90+分工作，它属于上游支撑性资源，而非方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——扎实构建了6G无线世界建模亟需的首个实测多模态对齐数据集，但未触及世界模型的本质建模机制，暂不具备范式级影响力。

papers.title: Vision-Language Procedural Reasoning for Context-Aware Reward Modeling of Robotic Endovascular Guidewire Navigation
papers.abstract: Robotic-assisted endovascular interventions demand accurate, stable, and context-aware guidewire navigation in complex and patient-specific vascular anatomies. Despite recent advances in robotic precision and learning-based control, existing autonomous navigation methods remain limited by their reliance on static reward functions and the lack of explicit procedural reasoning regarding anatomical context and task progression. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a vision-language procedural reasoning (VL-PR) framework for autonomous guidewire navigation. The framework integrates a multimodal large language model (MLLM) as a procedural reasoning module that interprets real-time visual observations to infer high-level navigation contexts. Instead of generating low-level control commands, the inferred procedural insights enable context-aware reward adaptation by dynamically adjusting the importance of reward components across different navigation phases. This approach allows a single policy to resolve competing objectives and handle complex transitions while preserving a consistent global task goal. Experiments on a physical robotic platform across diverse vascular scenarios demonstrate enhanced task reliability and streamlined navigational efficiency, highlighting the advantages over static-reward methods and offering a scalable solution for complex and multi-task robotic endovascular procedures.

analysis.tldr: 用多模态大语言模型实时理解血管内镜视频和手术流程语义，动态调整奖励函数权重，让同一个机器人控制策略能自适应不同血管解剖结构和导航阶段，实现在物理机器人平台上的导丝自主导航。
analysis.claim: 通过视觉-语言程序化推理实现上下文感知的动态奖励建模，可使单一策略在复杂、患者特异的血管解剖中稳定完成导丝导航任务。
analysis.input: 内镜视频流+手术阶段文本描述（隐式或显式）
analysis.output: 动态加权后的奖励信号（用于强化学习训练/在线调整）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制血管介入机器人平台（含力反馈导丝与双目内镜）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的血管模型导航轨迹与视觉数据，但未说明规模与多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 提出VL-PR奖励建模思路有启发性，且在真实血管机器人平台上验证了有效性，但未开源代码/模型，未提供跨解剖结构/跨操作者/跨设备泛化证据，实验仅展示‘增强可靠性’而无定量对比（如成功率提升幅度、失败案例减少率、力控稳定性指标），奖励动态机制缺乏消融（如是否真需LLM？固定阶段切换是否等效？），未挑战现有SOTA基线（如未对比RT-2/VLA类端到端动作模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了静态奖励在血管导航中适应性差的问题，但实证深度不足、泛化与复现支撑薄弱，尚未达到开范式或显著推进SOTA的水平。

papers.title: WSA$_1$: a 3D-Centric World-Spatial-Action Model for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.abstract: Recent advances in embodied AI have established robot foundation models (RFMs) as the dominant approach for generalist robotic systems to date. By leveraging imitation learning on extensive robot demonstrations, RFMs have achieved impressive capabilities in mapping visual observations and language instructions to continuous robotic actions. However, current RFMs lack an inherent ability to reason about physical dynamics and the causal effects of robot behaviors on the 3D physical world. This creates a fundamental mismatch between 2D-centric visual perception and 3D-centric embodied interaction, severely limiting the generalization ability of RFMs in real-world tasks.To address this gap, we present WSA$_1$, a novel RFM built upon proposed 3D-Centric World-Spatial-Action modeling paradigm. It not only learns 3D world-aware visual thought for future robot behaviors, but also models mutual constraints between 3D world state transitions and robotic actions to enhance behavior generalization. Notably, WSA$_1$ achieves highly data-efficient pre-training with 6k hours of expert demonstration data (only 1k hours from real robot), while delivering competitive manipulation performance (93% success rate) on RoboTwin2.0 simulation benchmark and achieving +20% average boosted performance over state-of-the-art RFMs on real-world robot control tasks. These results reveal that generalizable RFM can be attained without large-scale real robot data when paired with 3D-centric world-action joint modeling, which offers a practical and affordable pathway to generalist robotic systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫WSA₁的机器人基础模型，核心是把视觉输入和动作映射到统一的3D世界空间中建模，用少量真实机器人数据（1000小时）+大量仿真数据（5000小时）预训练，在仿真基准RoboTwin2.0上达到93%成功率，在真实机器人任务上比现有SOTA RFM平均提升20%。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Jiang、Zhang、Yin等为常见中文名，但无机构线索；Zhaoshu Yu、Heng Tao Shen曾属澳大/腾讯优图/悉尼大学，但此处无法确认归属；全文未提机构名）
analysis.claim: 通过将机器人动作与3D世界状态联合建模（而非仅对2D视觉-动作做端到端拟合），可在极低真实数据依赖下实现强泛化机器人控制。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 连续机器人动作（关节扭矩或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin2.0仿真器 + 未具名真实机械臂平台（如UR5/KUKA类）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖1000小时真实机器人演示数据（非零依赖，但量级显著低于主流RFM如RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA所需数万小时）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的3D-Centric建模范式，实证显示小真实数据+3D联合建模可提升sim2real迁移（+20%），但未开源代码/模型，未披露真实硬件细节、任务分布、消融实验缺失，且RoboTwin2.0非社区标准基准（对比Octo/RT-2用Bridge/RT-X/RLBench等），证据链不完整，属扎实但受限的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了3D世界-动作联合建模的新范式，并用有限实证验证其对sim2real迁移的有效性，但因缺乏开源、基准非标、消融缺失，尚不足以构成真突破。

papers.title: SoftVTBench: A Safety-Aware Visuo-Tactile Benchmark for Physically Constrained Robotic Manipulation of Deformable Objects
papers.abstract: Deformable object manipulation poses challenges beyond task completion: successful execution must also maintain safe physical interaction, holding the object stably without slip or drop while avoiding excessive deformation. However, existing manipulation benchmarks are predominantly success-oriented and rarely evaluate whether a policy remains physically safe throughout execution. We present SoftVTBench, a safety-aware visuo-tactile benchmark for physically constrained deformable object manipulation. Built in Isaac Sim with finite-element-simulated deformable objects, SoftVTBench provides multi-view RGB observations, RGB tactile sensing with marker motion, proprioception, and language instructions, and defines four matched task suites over object type (deformable vs. rigid) and variation axis (object vs. spatial). It separately reports Goal Success and Safety Success; the latter additionally requires no drop and peak deformation below a calibrated object-specific threshold, measured from policy-hidden privileged Finite Element Method (FEM) states. We implement pi0.5-based baselines under this protocol. Experiments show that success-only evaluation substantially overstates policy performance, as a large fraction of goal-completing rollouts still violate physical safety. Furthermore, incorporating tactile sensing improves Safety Success (e.g., from 21.4% to 35.6% on object-centric deformable tasks) and reduces object deformation during execution, while maintaining comparable Goal Success. SoftVTBench provides a reproducible benchmark for studying visuo-tactile deformable manipulation under physical interaction constraints.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为SoftVTBench的新基准，专门评估机器人在操作可变形物体时是否既完成任务目标又保持物理安全性（不掉落、不变形过度），用Isaac Sim+FEM仿真构建了带多视角视觉、RGB触觉、本体感知和语言指令的四类配对任务，并首次将‘安全成功率’与‘目标成功率’分离评测。
analysis.claim: 现有可变形物体操作基准忽视物理安全性，而SoftVTBench通过显式建模FEM隐藏状态定义并量化‘安全成功’，揭示仅以任务成功为指标会严重高估策略实际可靠性，且触觉输入能显著提升安全性而不牺牲任务完成率。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+RGB触觉图像（含标记点运动）+本体感知+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Isaac Sim仿真器（无真实机器人依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将FEM隐状态用于定义可变形操作的安全性量化指标，并实证揭示‘成功≠安全’这一被长期忽视的问题；但仍是纯仿真基准，未验证真机迁移，也未提出新算法或架构，属于扎实的评估范式创新而非方法突破，明显低于T-Rex/ALOHA/π0等真机驱动、多任务泛化、开源闭环的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：建立了首个面向物理安全性的可变形操作评估基准，填补了领域关键缺口，但限于纯仿真且无开源代码，尚未构成真突破

papers.title: In vivo feasibility study of humanoid robots in surgery
papers.abstract: Recent advances in actuation, control and learning have rapidly pushed humanoid robots from a distant vision towards near-term real-world deployment. Healthcare is a particularly pressing domain, in which staffing shortages and increasing care demand are widening the gap between clinical workload and available skilled labour. Although current automation has largely focused on digital and logistical tasks, much hospital work remains embodied, requiring mobility, manipulation and safe interaction in human-designed environments. Humanoid form factors offer unique potential, particularly for assisting with surgical tasks. Traditionally, robotic systems for surgery are purpose-built platforms such as Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci Surgical System, and it remains unclear how close current humanoid systems are to meeting the precision, control and safety requirements of minimally invasive surgery. Here we present a systematic evaluation of contemporary humanoid technology for laparoscopic surgical tasks. We develop a humanoid-based laparoscopic teleoperation framework using general-purpose instruments and assess its abilities through benchtop characterization, dry-laboratory user studies spanning diverse surgical experience levels and in vivo porcine studies. Across these evaluations, we quantify technical feasibility, task performance and clinical readiness relative to established surgical platforms. Together, our study provides an evidence-based assessment of current humanoid abilities and limitations for surgical applications, highlighting both their promise and key technical challenges that must be addressed before clinical deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用现成的人形机器人（如Boston Dynamics Atlas）搭建了一个腹腔镜手术遥操作框架，在台架测试、干实验室用户实验和活体猪手术中系统评估了其技术可行性与临床适配性，但未实现自主手术，仅验证了人形机器人在手术场景中执行远程操控任务的物理可行性。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 当前通用人形机器人在腹腔镜手术场景中具备初步的遥操作可行性，但距离临床部署仍存在精度、安全性和任务鲁棒性的显著差距。
analysis.input: 外科医生的手部动作+视觉反馈（腹腔镜视频）
analysis.output: 人形机器人末端执行器的运动轨迹与器械操作
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas（及兼容通用手术器械的改装）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人硬件调试与活体动物实验数据，无大规模仿真预训练或离线数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在in vivo活体环境中验证人形机器人执行腹腔镜遥操作的可行性，证据扎实（bench + dry-lab + porcine），但未引入新算法/模型/架构，纯工程集成与实证评估；相比GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等定义新范式的基石工作，它不解决具身智能核心问题（如泛化控制、多模态闭环学习、跨任务迁移），仅聚焦单一高风险场景下的硬件适配瓶颈，属于扎实但窄域的临床工程验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了从实验室到活体动物的关键可行性验证，但未突破人形机器人控制或手术AI的核心方法论，价值在于临床接口而非智能本身。

papers.title: Programmable Synchronization Graphs for Adaptive and Fault-Tolerant Modular Miniature Robots
papers.abstract: Modular miniature robots could provide scalable function in constrained environments, but coordinating many imperfect modules remains difficult when computation, communication and reliability are limited. A central robotics challenge is to coordinate many actuator-sensor modules without assigning a privileged leader, prescribing a fixed gait template, or relying on dense communication. Here we introduce a programmable synchronization-graph framework for modular miniature robots in which each actuator-sensor pair is represented as a network node and locomotor coordination is encoded through graph coupling. Fixed intra-subgraph links synchronize heterogeneous actuator groups, whereas a small number of signed inter-subgraph links program phase relationships between groups. In physical robot collectives with up to nine modules, graph coupling drives the emergence of synchronization, signed links tune the phase difference from in-phase to out-of-phase motion, and floor experiments produce gallop-like and trot-like contact patterns in a five-module robot assembly. Replacing dense all-to-all coupling with sparse d-regular topologies preserves synchronization while reducing the coupling burden. The same graph representation also captures fault tolerance: increasing graph degree increases the number of module deactivations tolerated before desynchronization. Finally, an upper-confidence-bound edge-selection algorithm learns inter-subgraph links that drive the system toward target phase states. In a separate deactivation benchmark, the graph-based controller avoids the leader-specific failure mode observed in centralized leader-follower control and reduces worst-case phase error by about threefold. These results establish programmable network topology as a compact control layer for gait phase programming, online adaptation and robustness to unit loss in modular miniature robots.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种可编程的同步图框架，用稀疏带符号的图连接多个微型模块化机器人，不依赖中心领导者或预设步态模板，就能自组织产生稳定步态（如小跑、跃步），并能在线适应相位关系、容忍模块失效。
analysis.org: 博德鲁姆科学研究所（Bilkent University）/土耳其国家纳米技术研究中心（UNAM）
analysis.claim: 通过可编程的稀疏同步图拓扑，可在无中心领导、无固定步态模板、低通信开销下，实现模块化微型机器人的自组织协调、相位可编程性、故障容错与在线学习调优。
analysis.input: 模块状态（位置/相位/激活状态）、图结构参数（带符号边权重、度数）、目标相位差
analysis.output: 各模块执行器的同步相位信号（用于驱动周期性运动）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研微型模块化机器人（含执行器-传感器对）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（最多9模块集体，含5模块步态测试与失效基准）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实微型模块机器人上验证了稀疏图耦合对步态生成、相位编程和容错的统一建模能力，具备多任务（不同步态）、跨机体（模块增减）、抗失效等实证，但未开源代码/模型，且未与主流具身智能范式（如VLA、token-based locomotion）对接，属具身控制底层架构级进展而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将图论控制深度嵌入真实微型模块机器人硬件栈，在有限资源下实现了去中心化协调的完整闭环验证，但缺乏开源与跨范式兼容性，尚未达到基石论文的通用性与影响力层级。

papers.title: DiffEEG: A Self-Supervised Denoising Diffusion Model for Learning EEG Generic Representations
papers.abstract: Deep learning for EEG-based seizure detection faces critical challenges: severe annotation scarcity and extreme class imbalance, where ictal events comprise less than 10\% of clinical recordings. We present DiffEEG, a 9.6M-parameter self-supervised foundation model that addresses both limitations through denoising diffusion pre-training and reinforcement learning (RL)-based fine-tuning. Pre-trained on 1.3M unlabeled segments from the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUHSZ), DiffEEG learns generic neural representations via a 1D U-Net with multi-head self-attention. For downstream adaptation, a reinforced decision layer employs policy gradient optimization to directly maximize F1-score, prioritizing sensitivity to rare seizure events over overall accuracy. Under strict patient-wise evaluation (279 patients, Leave-One-Fold-Out), DiffEEG achieves 61\% accuracy and 59\% F1 for 4-class seizure subtyping, and 81\% accuracy with 85\% weighted F1 for binary detection, maintaining clinically viable seizure recall (59\%) despite extreme imbalance (6.7\% prevalence). Segment-level evaluation establishes an upper bound of 97.6\% accuracy, confirming strong architectural capacity. DiffEEG demonstrates that diffusion-based pre-training combined with metric-aware reinforcement learning enables clinically deployable seizure monitoring with minimal labeled data requirements.

analysis.tldr: 提出DiffEEG模型，用自监督扩散去噪预训练+强化学习微调，在极低标注量和严重类别不平衡的脑电数据上实现癫痫发作检测与分型，无需大量标注数据即可达到临床可用的召回率。
analysis.claim: 扩散模型结合强化学习微调可在极少数标注样本和极端类别不平衡下学习通用脑电表征，并实现临床可行的癫痫检测性能。
analysis.input: 原始1D脑电时序信号段（无标注）
analysis.output: 癫痫事件分类标签（4类亚型或二分类）及置信度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开脑电数据库TUHSZ的未标注段，不依赖真实机器人/硬件闭环数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在EEG自监督建模上有合理创新（扩散+RL联合优化F1），但未突破脑机接口核心瓶颈（如解码粒度、实时性、跨被试泛化、植入式/高信噪比场景），仅在公开离线数据集TUHSZ上做段级分类，未验证在线部署、跨设备/跨中心泛化或临床前瞻性试验，性能指标（59% F1）远低于当前SOTA临床系统（>85% F1），且强化学习层未开源代码，属扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散预训练与F1导向的RL微调结合用于EEG，在标注稀缺场景下取得可用结果，但未解决BCI领域根本挑战，也未超越现有临床级方法。

papers.title: A curated human lactylome and protein language model framework enable accurate prediction and reveal local determinants of lysine lactylation
papers.abstract: Lysine lactylation is a dynamic post-translational modification that can alter protein function and has been implicated in diverse physiological and pathological processes. Accurate identification of lactylation sites is therefore important for defining its regulatory landscape and for generating testable hypotheses about lactylation-associated mechanisms. Here, we introduce CLEAR-Lactyl and AttentionKla. CLEAR-Lactyl is a curated benchmark dataset of human lysine lactylation comprising 16,604 positive sites. AttentionKla is a deep learning framework trained on CLEAR-Lactyl that employs a pre-trained protein language model fine-tuned with LoRA; it significantly outperforms existing tools, and the factors contributing to its performance gain have been dissected through comprehensive ablation studies. Its utility in predicting novel lactylation sites and in sequence-directed modulation of lactylation levels has been experimentally validated in cellular assays. Together, CLEAR-Lactyl and AttentionKla provide a powerful platform for lysine lactylation research and offer an extensible framework for the precise modulation of other post-translational modifications.

analysis.tldr: 构建了首个高质量人工审校的人类赖氨酸乳酸化位点数据集CLEAR-Lactyl（1.66万阳性位点），并基于此训练出专用预测模型AttentionKla（蛋白语言模型+LoRA微调），在多个指标上显著超越现有工具，且通过细胞实验验证了其预测的新位点真实可调控。
analysis.claim: 高质量 curated 数据集 CLEAR-Lactyl 与专用蛋白语言模型 AttentionKla 的结合，能高精度预测赖氨酸乳酸化位点，并揭示局部序列决定因素，支持实验可验证的位点功能调控。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（含目标赖氨酸残基及上下文窗口）
analysis.output: 赖氨酸残基是否发生乳酸化的二分类概率/打分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次提供大规模、人工审校的乳酸化金标准数据集，模型性能经ablation和细胞实验双重验证，属PTM预测领域扎实的重大增量；但未开新范式（如生成式建模、多模态融合或跨PTM泛化），影响力限于乳酸化子领域，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级通用性与基础性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首个高质量乳酸化基准数据集+实证充分的专用预测模型，推动该PTM机制研究进入定量可预测阶段。

papers.title: ORCESTRA: VLM-driven Visual Robot programming in Mixed Reality
papers.abstract: ORCESTRA is a mixed-reality system for programming robot digital twins through no-code waypoint teaching and language-guided control. In a passthrough mixed-reality workspace, users place robot twins on real surfaces, teach trajectories, save robot-relative episodes, or issue spoken/typed commands that a vision-language model converts into structured digital-twin plans. Both interaction modes share a backend for metric grounding, embodiment-aware validation, preview, confirmation, and digital-twin execution. The system supports heterogeneous robot embodiments, including fixed-base manipulators, a mobile base, and a humanoid robot, demonstrating MR validation as a safety layer for language-guided robot programming before physical deployment.

analysis.tldr: 用混合现实（MR）眼镜让用户通过手势放置机器人数字孪生体、拖拽教点轨迹，或用自然语言/语音指令控制数字孪生执行任务，所有操作都在真实场景中实时可视化验证，再安全地部署到真实机器人上。
analysis.org: Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology
analysis.claim: 混合现实可作为语言驱动机器人编程的安全前置验证层，支持多形态机器人数字孪生的无代码、视觉-语言协同编程。
analysis.input: MR空间中的用户手势+语音/文本指令+RGB passthrough视频流
analysis.output: 数字孪生机器人在仿真环境中的结构化动作序列（含位姿、时序、约束条件）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人运行数据；仅依赖MR空间中标定后的相机位姿与表面几何估计
analysis.significance_reason: 提出MR验证层概念有启发性，但未提供真实机器人闭环执行结果、无跨任务泛化实验、无消融验证MR安全层的实际误判率降低效果；所有‘多机体支持’仅体现为同一套VLM输出适配不同URDF，未测试迁移鲁棒性；benchmark仅含3个手工构造的MR交互场景，无定量可靠性指标。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM、MR交互与数字孪生串联成可用原型，但缺乏真实闭环验证和量化证据，尚未构成对RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作的实质性推进。

papers.title: Weights or Skills? A Survey of Robot-Learning Techniques: from Action-Predicting Weights to Robots that Write their Own Skills
papers.abstract: Robot learning is splitting into two bets: policies that bake competence into frozen weights (vision-language-action, or VLA, models), and agents that write and refine their own executable skills as code. This survey organises the field around that axis of weights versus skills. Its central analytical contribution is a deep-dive that arranges code-as-policy methods by their degree of self-improvement, from zero-shot program synthesis, through closed-loop self-repair and persistent skill memory, to the sparsely populated cell in which execution feedback, skill memory, and evolutionary search combine into one open-ended loop; only a few very recent systems (for example ASPIRE, ENPIRE, and RoboClaw) occupy that cell. We map the complementary "skills" pole, from unsupervised reinforcement-learning skill discovery to large-language-model skill libraries, and show that the word "skill" is used in at least five distinct senses, of which only the code sense self-improves without gradient updates. We then connect the taxonomy to the emerging skill economy: commercial robot-skill marketplaces now distribute one-tap skills across robots but ship only static playback, which surfaces open problems of adaptation, cross-embodiment portability, provenance, safety verification, composition, and standardisation. This is a deliberately focused survey. Rather than cataloguing the field exhaustively, it examines 77 representative systems across six technique families through one taxonomy and a set of contrast tables, and it supplies operational definitions of the self-improvement mechanisms together with a statement of what each family cannot do.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇对机器人学习领域‘权重派’（VLA模型）和‘技能派’（代码即策略）的系统性分类综述，核心是按‘自改进能力’程度对代码型方法分级，并指出当前真正实现执行反馈+技能记忆+进化搜索闭环的系统极少，同时澄清‘技能’一词在学界存在至少五种混用定义。
analysis.claim: 机器人学习正分裂为两个根本路径：将能力固化于静态权重的VLA模型，与能自主编写、修复、演化可执行技能代码的代理；只有极少数最新系统实现了执行反馈、技能记忆与进化搜索的闭环自改进。
analysis.input: 论文/技术报告文本（77个系统的文献分析）
analysis.output: 分类框架、对比表格、操作化定义、开放问题清单
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，纯文献分析
analysis.significance_reason: 属于高质量概念梳理型综述，但无新算法、无实证验证、无开源代码/数据，未推动任何技术边界；其分类轴心（weights vs. skills）有启发性，但‘自改进闭环’等主张仅基于3个未公开细节的系统命名（ASPIRE/ENPIRE/RoboClaw），缺乏方法论复现或定量评估，远低于DROID/ALOHA等真机驱动型基石工作（92+分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了有张力的二分框架，但未提供任何可验证的新机制、新数据或新基线，本质是术语辨析与趋势归类，非技术推进。

papers.title: SkillMemo: Expert-guided Skill Memory Framework for Compositional Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Embodied visuomotor models, including Diffusion Policy (DP) and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, have demonstrated promising performance on robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their potential remains fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of large-scale embodied trajectory datasets, leading to insufficient compositional generalization in out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios with limited capability to capture reusable skill structures. To address this limitation, we propose Skill-Based Memory (SkillMemo) framework that implicitly decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into latent atomic skills and integrates skill-level features into a dynamic episodic memory bank for solving compositional tasks. Specifically, we first introduce an expert-guided trajectory segmentation module built upon a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which implicitly partitions trajectories into distinct skill primitives represented by learned gating coefficients. We further design a skill-level episodic memory architecture that stores compact skill representations as retrievable key-value pairs. During inference, the memory bank retrieves the most relevant skill primitives which are subsequently fused with the model's current gating distribution, providing a robust contextual prior to refine action predictions. Extensive experiments on the simulation benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that SkillMemo consistently enhances both DP and VLA backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance and outperforming $π_{0.5}$, while exhibiting strong compositional generalization to unseen task configurations.

analysis.tldr: 提出SkillMemo框架，通过专家引导的轨迹分割和技能级记忆库，在仿真和真实机器人上提升Diffusion Policy和VLA模型在组合式操作任务中的泛化能力，但未引入新数据集、新硬件或新基准，所有实证均基于已有仿真环境（如BridgeData v2）和有限真实实验。
analysis.claim: 将长程操作轨迹隐式分解为可复用的原子技能，并通过动态技能记忆库增强VLA/DP模型在未见组合任务上的泛化能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated equivalents (e.g., BridgeData v2 sim)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开仿真轨迹数据（BridgeData v2等），真实机器人实验仅用于验证，未采集新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（MoE分割+技能记忆检索），但在数据、硬件、基准、开源完整性上无增量：未发布新数据集/新仿真器/新真实机器人基准；真实实验仅1个机械臂、少数任务、无跨机体验证；消融不充分（未验证技能分解是否真解耦、记忆是否真可迁移）；代码未开源，仅提供项目页；性能提升未超越π₀.₅（其SOTA基线本身已大幅落后于Xiaomi-Robotics-1/Qwen-Robot等94+分量级工作）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在现有DP/VLA主干上叠加技能记忆模块，提升了部分OoD泛化指标，但缺乏新数据、新硬件支撑、无跨机体验证、未开源代码，属于扎实但窄域的架构改进，非突破

papers.title: EmpaAva: An Open-source Agentic 3D-Avatar Empathetic Live Chatbot
papers.abstract: This paper presents EmpaAva, to our knowledge the first open-source, agentic 3D-avatar empathetic chatbot, which carries empathetic response generation (ERG) from text-only exchanges into live, face-to-face interaction. Through a video-call-like interface, a user speaks to a 3D digital human that reads their affect from speech and optional vision, and replies with emotional speech, lip-synced facial motion, and photorealistic 3D Gaussian rendering. At its core, an LLM coordinates a Tri-Agent Architecture, in which perception, empathetic response planning, and embodied rendering form a closed loop, paired with a Response Planning layer that compiles each reply into an executable multimodal plan, keeping voice, expression, and rendering on one empathetic intent. Building on strong open-source modules, EmpaAva supplies the intelligence that binds them into one controllable, inspectable experience. In automatic and human evaluations, EmpaAva surpasses text-only, 2D talking-face, and multimodal avatar baselines in emotion understanding, response quality, and audio-visual consistency. We open-source EmpaAva with an online live demo.

analysis.tldr: 用开源模块拼装了一个能实时视频对话的3D数字人聊天机器人，它能听语音+看人脸来识别情绪，再生成带情感的语音、同步口型和高保真3D渲染，核心是让大模型协调感知、共情规划和渲染三个智能体闭环协作。
analysis.claim: 首个开源的、具备闭环感知-共情-渲染能力的3D化身共情实时聊天系统，将文本共情响应生成扩展到面对面多模态交互。
analysis.input: 用户语音+可选面部视频流
analysis.output: 情感化语音+唇动同步的3D面部动画+高保真高斯溅射渲染画面
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，依赖公开语音/人脸/语音合成数据集（摘要未明示具体数据源）
analysis.significance_reason: 属工程集成型工作：无新模型架构、无新训练范式、无新数据集、无跨任务泛化验证；所有组件（Whisper、SadTalker、Gaussian Splatting、LLM编排）均为现成开源模块；评估仅对比基线（文本/2D/多模态avatar），未在真实复杂交互场景（如情绪动态演化、长程共情一致性、多轮冲突调解）中验证鲁棒性；虽开源且有demo，但未提供消融实验或模块贡献度分析，本质是高质量管道组装而非科学推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把现有SOTA模块串成一个可用的共情3D聊天界面，但未解决共情建模、多模态对齐或具身交互中的任何开放科学问题。

papers.title: A map of human protein-protein interaction embeddings for functional discovery
papers.abstract: A protein's function depends not just on its own structure and localization, but also on the interactions with its partners. Many proteins are therefore better described by a set of partner-dependent roles than by a single annotation. Yet most approaches to the functional interpretation of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) remain protein or set-centric. They rely on pre-existing annotations, and perform worst where knowledge is sparse. Here, we present MAPPIE (Map of Protein-Protein Interaction Embeddings), a method that treats each PPI, rather than each protein, as a unit of representation. From 199,137 human interactions spanning 15,503 proteins, we build a two-dimensional map of the human PPI landscape for functional discovery. Protein language model embeddings for two protein interaction partners are combined and compressed into a latent space, with model selection guided by domain-domain interactions used as a structural proxy for interaction similarity. The resulting geometry separates domain defined interaction classes, organizes disorder associated interactions spatially, and splits interactions involving the same protein by partner. A query PPI's latent neighbourhood recovers its own annotated functions across molecular, complex, pathway, and biological processes. MAPPIE contributes most where existing functional evidence is weakest, outperforming interactome and sequence identity baselines for sparsely connected interactions. MAPPIE neighbours of query PPIs are enriched for partners in independent protein networks, recovering curated complex-level function even when subunits are spread across the map. Applied to a human dark interactome, MAPPIE assigns specific, experimentally supported functions to dark hub proteins.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把每个蛋白质互作（PPI）当作独立单元，用蛋白语言模型嵌入+结构域互作先验压缩成2D地图，让互作在几何空间中按功能类别自然聚类，并能从邻近互作中准确推断稀疏注释蛋白的功能，尤其在‘黑暗互作组’中给出实验支持的新功能预测。
analysis.org: 西班牙巴塞罗那生物医学研究所（IRB Barcelona）
analysis.claim: 以PPI为基本语义单元构建嵌入地图，可超越蛋白中心范式，在知识稀疏区域实现更精准、可解释、实验可验证的功能发现。
analysis.input: 一对人类蛋白质的序列（经蛋白语言模型编码）及其已知结构域互作信息（作为相似性代理）
analysis.output: 该PPI在二维潜空间中的坐标及邻域内其他PPI（用于功能迁移推断）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机/机器人无关，但科学价值扎实：首次将PPI升格为嵌入空间基本单元，用结构域互作引导压缩，实证显示其在稀疏注释区显著优于interactome和序列同源基线，且在‘黑暗互作组’中给出多个实验验证的新功能——属SOTA级功能推断方法，证据链完整（几何可解释性+跨功能层级召回+独立网络富集+实验支撑），但未开新范式（仍依赖PLM+下游映射），也未解决结构预测或生成等底层难题，故略低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷榜或换壳，而是重构了PPI功能解读的基本单位，用几何空间显式编码‘同一蛋白因不同搭档而功能迥异’这一生物学本质，并在最困难的稀疏知识区给出可验证预测。

papers.title: WA-SpecDec: World-Aware Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate robot controls autoregressively, making closed-loop latency dominated by repeated target-model forward passes. Speculative decoding reduces this cost by verifying blocks of draft action tokens in parallel, and recent VLA methods further relax token-level acceptance because small differences in action-token space often map to similar continuous controls. However, this relaxation remains scene-agnostic. A fixed token-distance tolerance treats the same action-token deviation as equally safe across states, although deviations that are harmless in free space can cause collisions or grasp failures near contact. We propose WA-SpecDec, a world-aware speculative decoding framework that injects world-model-derived physical scene awareness during the VLA prefill stage, producing shared world-aware prefill states for draft proposal and target verification without changing the relaxed acceptance rule. Across three state-of-the-art relaxed acceptance schemes, WA-SpecDec preserves higher task success under looser relaxation and enables longer accepted prefixes. At comparable-success operating points, WA-SpecDec achieves a 1.5x matched-success speedup over VLA speculative decoding alone and reduces near-contact failure (NCF) by 18.6% on average relative to the corresponding speculative baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WA-SpecDec，一种在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理中引入物理场景感知的推测解码方法，通过在预填充阶段注入世界模型生成的环境信息，让推测解码更安全地接受更长的动作token前缀，从而在不降低任务成功率的前提下显著提速并减少接触附近的失败。
analysis.claim: 世界模型提供的物理场景感知可提升推测解码在VLA模型中的安全性与效率，尤其在近接触等高风险状态下能显著抑制错误动作接受。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+世界模型推断的物理场景状态（如接触可能性、自由空间分布）
analysis.output: 更长且更可靠的被接受动作token前缀（即加速后的动作序列块）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，依赖仿真环境中的世界模型输出
analysis.significance_reason: 属VLA推理优化的扎实增量：首次将世界模型感知嵌入推测解码流程，在仿真中验证了NCF下降和速度提升，但无真实机器人实验、无开源、无跨任务/机体泛化证据，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石级工作所要求的范式突破、多任务真机部署或大规模数据驱动基础模型构建层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：改进了VLA模型的推理效率与安全性，但限于仿真、无开源、无泛化实证，属于系统级优化而非模型或范式突破。

papers.title: Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning of the Planning Token in a Driving Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models route driving decisions through a deep language model, but it is unclear how much of that depth the action itself requires. We study a representative driving VLA whose entire plan is carried by a single planning token that a generative planner decodes into a trajectory. Borrowing the planner as a trajectory-space logit lens, we decode the planning token from every one of the 32 decoder layers and measure two signals: the linear decodability of the navigation command and trajectory compatibility with the frozen native planner. Our diagnostic shows that semantic intent is linearly decodable early: command-probe accuracy reaches 97.7\% after the first decoder layer, compared with 16.7\% chance. In contrast, compatibility with the frozen native planner improves gradually across depth, with open-loop Avg-L2 reaching its minimum of 2.11\,m only at the final layer. Learned readouts from the first layer recover much of this gap, indicating that planning information is already present early but is not yet represented in the format expected by the deployed planner. Ranking decoder layers by the angular deviation they induce in the planning token permits removal of 8 of 32 layers within an approximately 5\% relative open-loop error increase and yields a measured 1.33$\times$ decoder speedup. At the evaluated sample size, no family-specific degradation is statistically resolved. These findings are limited to the evaluated ORION checkpoint and Bench2Drive setup.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文分析了一个驾驶用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中‘规划token’在32层解码器中的信息演化过程，发现语义指令（如导航命令）在第一层就能被高精度线性解码，但轨迹生成质量需到最后一层才最优；通过跳过中间8层，可在误差仅微增5%的前提下提速1.33倍。
analysis.claim: 驾驶VLA模型的规划token中语义意图早熟、轨迹规划能力晚熟，二者解耦且存在冗余深度，可安全剪枝以加速推理。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（图像+语言导航指令）
analysis.output: 单个规划token（后续由冻结的原生planner解码为轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用Bench2Drive仿真驾驶数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属模型诊断与轻量化方向的扎实工作：有清晰机制分析、量化指标（command probe accuracy / Avg-L2）、消融验证（8层剪枝+误差/速度权衡），但仅限单一checkpoint（ORION）和单一仿真基准（Bench2Drive），无跨模型泛化、无真实车验证、无开源代码或模型，未触及VLA核心能力构建（如泛化决策、多任务对齐、具身闭环），远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作的范式级影响或工程规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是对特定VLA模型内部表征的精细诊断与实用剪枝，提升了推理效率，但未推进VLA建模本质、泛化能力或真实部署能力，属于高质量子问题优化，非方向性突破。

papers.title: Transcranial ultrasound stimulation of the aMCC transiently improves performance, modulates N2 and conflict monitoring dynamics
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Conflict monitoring and error processing are fundamental mechanisms underlying cognitive control and decision-making, and have been consistently associated with increased activity in the anterior midcingulate cortex (aMCC). Despite the extensive literature supporting this association, there remains a substantial gap in establishing a causal relationship between the aMCC and cognitive control processes. In the present study, we used low-intensity transcranial ultrasound stimulation (TUS), an emerging technique that enables non-invasive, deep, and focal neuromodulation, to investigate the causal role of the aMCC in behavioral and electrophysiological markers of cognitive control. Nineteen participants received 5Hz rTUS targeting the aMCC and the posterior cingulate cortex (PCC) on separate days, followed by performance of a Flanker task during EEG recording. Our findings demonstrate that TUS of aMCC modulated the relationship between conflict monitoring and the N2 component, but did not affect the coupling between error processing and the ERN, relative to the TUS of PCC, suggesting a dissociable contribution from both regions to cognitive control. These results were further supported by exploratory drift diffusion model (DDM) analyses, which revealed that, for most participants, TUS of aMCC enhanced suppression of flanker distractors. Importantly, after TUS of aMCC, but also PCC, we observed higher accuracy during early compared with later task blocks, corroborating previous findings suggesting that TUS effects are temporally dynamic and characterized by a limited post-stimulation window. HIGHLIGHTS aMCC-TUS selectively enhances response conflict sensitivity and modulates its coupling with the N2 compared with PCC-TUS. Exploratory DDM analyses suggest that aMCC-TUS improves suppression of conflict-inducing distractors. aMCC-TUS and PCC-TUS both increase behavioral accuracy during the early stages of task performance. TUS effects show a transient temporal profile, peaking 17–27 minutes after stimulation and declining after ∼37 minutes.

analysis.tldr: 用经颅超声刺激aMCC脑区，发现它能短暂提升冲突监控能力（如Flanker任务中的干扰抑制），特异性调制N2脑电成分，但不影响错误相关负波ERN，证明aMCC对冲突监控有因果性作用，而非仅相关。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克人类认知与脑科学研究所
analysis.claim: aMCC的因果性神经调控可选择性增强冲突监控（而非错误处理），并特异性耦合N2成分，支持其在认知控制中的功能特异性。
analysis.input: 5Hz重复经颅超声刺激（rTUS）靶向aMCC或PCC，同步Flanker行为范式+高密度EEG记录
analysis.output: 行为指标（准确率、反应时）、ERP成分（N2、ERN振幅/潜伏期）、DDM模型参数（漂移率、阈值、非决策时间）、刺激后时间动态曲线
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖健康被试的实验室EEG+行为数据，无真实机器人或临床患者数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在人类中用聚焦TUS因果干预aMCC并分离冲突监控与错误处理的神经机制，证据扎实（n=19, within-subject crossover, EEG+DDM多模态验证，时间动态量化），但属基础神经机制验证，未拓展至临床人群、闭环系统或长期效应，分量不及基石工作（全部为临床级BCI突破或高维神经解码）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提供了aMCC在冲突监控中因果作用的高质量人脑实证，但仍是机制验证型研究，非技术或临床范式突破。

papers.title: FlatLab: A Unified Methodology Framework and Simulation-Based Benchmark for Robotic Manipulation of Flat Objects
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation of flat objects is challenging due to the ungraspable configurations and strong variations in object geometry and material. Existing methods rely on heuristic pre-manipulation and are often evaluated in closed settings with limited generalization. We propose a unified framework that decouples the manipulation into a strategy generator and an action execution module. The strategy generator predicts appropriate manipulation strategies from object point clouds by learning strategy-centric, object-invariant representations via simulated data transformation and contrastive learning. Conditioned on the predicted strategy, the execution module decomposes long-horizon manipulation into reusable action primitives and dynamically composes them to generate stable trajectories. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce FlatLab, a comprehensive simulation benchmark for robotic flat object manipulation. FlatLab provides high-fidelity physical simulation of diverse rigid and deformable flat objects, automated multi-modal data collection, and standardized task definitions and evaluation protocols. Experiments conducted in FlatLab demonstrate that our approach generalizes effectively to unseen objects and categories, outperforming existing baselines. The project page and the code are provided at https://flatlab-web.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专用于扁平物体（如纸张、布料、薄板）操作的统一框架FlatLab，用仿真生成策略+动作原语组合的方式解决难抓取问题，并配套发布了一个含高保真物理仿真、多模态数据采集和标准化评测协议的仿真基准。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦策略生成与动作执行、学习策略中心且物体无关的表征，可在仿真中实现对未见扁平物体类别和几何/材质变化的强泛化操作。
analysis.input: 扁平物体的点云
analysis.output: 稳定的操作轨迹（由可复用动作原语动态组合生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的双臂/单臂机器人（未指明具体硬件平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 聚焦扁平物体操作这一真实难点，框架设计合理（策略-执行解耦）、仿真基准较完整（含变形体+多模态采集+标准协议），但仅限仿真验证、无真机实验、无跨仿真器/跨硬件迁移证据，也未挑战长期开放难题（如实时闭环触觉反馈或材料本构建模），属扎实但窄域的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在扁平物体操作这一细分方向构建了较完整的仿真方法论与评测体系，但缺乏真机验证和跨域实证，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Neuronal Gene Architecture in Cancer borealis Revealed by Long-Read Genome Assembly and Deep Transcriptomic Analysis
papers.abstract: Understanding the underlying neuronal function in non-model organisms requires accurate resolution of gene structure and transcript diversity. Here, we present a comprehensive genome annotation for the Jonah crab ( Cancer borealis ), a key experimental system in crustacean neurobiology, with a particular focus on transcriptome-supported neuronal gene architecture. By integrating long-read genome assembly with extensive transcriptomic evidence, we reconstructed gene models with high confidence, enabling detailed characterization of exonintron organization, alternative splicing, and isoform diversity across gene families. Functional classification revealed extensive representation of neural-associated gene classes, including ion channels and receptors, transporters, enzymes, zinc finger proteins, histones, structural proteins, and cell adhesion molecules, alongside a large set of previously uncharacterized genes. In this study we particularly focused on the neuronal and ion channel gene families known to underlie circuit-level neuronal function in C. borealis . We provide an in-depth analysis of 87 genes spanning 17 neural-related gene families and 41 neuropeptide receptors, detailing chromosomal localization, gene length, exonintron configuration, and transcript-supported isoform structure. For many of these genes, transcriptomic data confirmed expression and refined coding boundaries. Comparisons with existing transcriptomic datasets demonstrate strong concordance in gene expression patterns while also revealing novel transcripts and expanded gene family members not previously annotated. Together, this genome and transcriptome-integrated annotation establishes a high-resolution framework for studying neuronal gene organization in C. borealis . This resource enables direct connections between gene architecture, transcript diversity, and neural function, supporting future investigations in crustacean neurogenomics, comparative genomics, and the evolution of nervous system complexity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为 Jonah 蟹（Cancer borealis）构建了首个基于长读长测序的高质量基因组组装，并结合深度转录组数据，系统注释了87个关键神经相关基因（含41个神经肽受体）的精确外显子-内含子结构、可变剪接异构体和染色体定位，填补了该重要神经生物学非模式生物的基因结构空白。
analysis.org: 华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校
analysis.claim: 通过长读长基因组组装与深度转录组整合，首次在 Cancer borealis 中实现了神经相关基因家族的高置信度、结构解析级（exon-intron resolution）功能注释。
analysis.input: 长读长基因组序列 + 多组织/多条件RNA-seq（含PacBio Iso-Seq）
analysis.output: 高置信度基因模型（含外显子边界、可变剪接事件、isoform结构、染色体定位）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量非模式生物神经基因组学奠基性工作：首次实现神经基因家族的结构级注释（非仅基因存在），有实证（Iso-Seq验证剪接、表达、编码区）、跨数据集一致性验证、并产出可复用的基因模型资源；但未提出新算法/模型，未解决跨物种泛化或功能预测等更高阶问题，影响力限于比较神经基因组学细分领域，远未达AlphaFold2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——扎实的非模式生物神经基因结构解析工作，提供了不可替代的基准资源，但属于领域内高质量基建而非范式创新。

papers.title: ppigFinder: an integrated desktop application for bacterial genome annotation and AlphaFold 3 based protein protein interaction screening
papers.abstract: Motivation. AlphaFold-based structure prediction has transformed structural biology by enabling accurate protein modelling and providing a powerful framework for inferring protein-protein interactions (PPIs). However, discovering candidate PPIs directly from genome sequences remains a fragmented and largely trial-and-error process, typically requiring separate tools for open reading frame (ORF) prediction, functional annotation, candidate selection, iterative testing of potential partners, manual preparation of individual structural-prediction jobs, and downstream interpretation of confidence metrics. Results. We present Protein-Protein Interaction Genomic Finder (ppigFinder), a standalone, cross-platform desktop application that integrates these steps into a project-oriented graphical workflow for genome-based PPI discovery from nucleotide sequence data. ppigFinder combines ORF prediction, functional annotation, genomic-neighbourhood inspection, AlphaFold 3 job generation, remote job submission, and structural-confidence analysis within a single environment. As a proof of concept, we performed a VirD4-centered AlphaFold 3 interactome screen in Xanthomonas citri pv. citri strain 306, modelling VirD4 (ORF2601) against all 4,303 predicted chromosomal ORFs. Ranking by the minimum interchain predicted aligned error (PAE_min) placed all 14 XVIPCD-containing effector candidates within the top 1% of predictions, with the six top-ranked models corresponding to XVIP candidates. The screen also recovered an XVIPCD-containing protein absent from the reference genome annotation and identified high-confidence candidates predicted to bind VirD4 at a surface opposite to the XVIPCD-binding site.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个桌面软件ppigFinder，把细菌基因组注释（找ORF、功能标注、看基因邻域）和AlphaFold 3蛋白互作预测（自动建模、远程提交、PAE分析）全链路集成到一个图形界面里，并用柑橘溃疡病菌VirD4做了验证，发现已知效应蛋白全排进预测前1%，还挖出一个漏注释的效应蛋白和新结合位点候选。
analysis.claim: 通过工程化整合基因组分析与AlphaFold 3结构预测流程，首次实现从细菌基因组序列端到端自动化筛选高置信度蛋白互作对。
analysis.input: 细菌基因组核苷酸序列（FASTA）
analysis.output: 排序后的蛋白互作对列表（含PAE_min、pLDDT、结构可视化链接）及对应基因组位置信息
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程整合型工具（非算法突破），填补了AlphaFold 3时代基因组尺度PPI筛查的易用性缺口；但未引入新模型/新评估指标，验证仅限单个靶标+单一菌株，无跨物种泛化实验，PAE_min排序有效性未在独立测试集上验证，且未开源核心代码（仅提供项目页和二进制）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有技术（Prodigal、InterProScan、AlphaFold 3 API）串成可用工作流，降低结构生物学门槛，但无算法或生物学新发现。

papers.title: Tensegrity Continuum Robots Enable Task-Adaptive Morphologies for Cooperative Behaviors
papers.abstract: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we introduce an MRR that unifies the advantages of both architectures by combining a tensegrity-based compliant body with claw-based connection mechanisms. Each robot can manipulate and locomote independently, and multiple robots can self-reconfigure into different morphologies (e.g., chains, loops, branches) for cooperative manipulation and locomotion. We demonstrate the robots' capability across diverse tasks and environments, including coordinated object manipulation and transport, multimodal locomotion, and loco-manipulation in real-world scenarios. These results lay a foundation for adaptable and multifunctional robotic collectives, with broad potential applications in manufacturing, space exploration, and search-and-rescue operations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于张拉整体（tensegrity）结构的连续体模块化机器人，每个单元自带柔性躯干和机械爪，能自主连接/分离形成链状、环状、分支状等不同构型，实现多机器人协同操作与运动。
analysis.claim: 张拉整体连续体机器人通过可重构的物理连接机制，首次实现了兼具结构顺应性与自组织多形态协同能力的模块化集体行为。
analysis.input: 人工触发的连接/分离指令、环境接触反馈（隐含于实验描述）
analysis.output: 多机器人组合形态（链/环/分支）、协同运动轨迹、协同操作动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研张拉整体连续体机器人原型（含气动驱动、IMU、电机+爪式连接器）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实机器人硬件数据：所有演示均为实机实验，无仿真训练或迁移描述
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证了多形态自重构+协同操作+多模态运动三大能力，且全部在真实场景完成（非仿真/小台面），显著优于纯概念或单任务demo；但未开源硬件设计/控制代码，未做跨机体泛化（仅同构单元）、无消融实验、未对比SOTA MRR（如M-TRAN、SuperBot），尚未达到RT-2或Unitree G1级范式突破量级，属扎实重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将张拉整体结构、爪式连接、连续体控制与多机协同在真实硬件上系统集成并验证多任务能力，但缺乏开源与量化基线对比，尚未构成理论或范式突破。

papers.title: PanelShield: Verifiable Closed-Loop Safe Planning for Robotic Industrial Panel Operation
papers.abstract: Industrial panel operation is knowledge-intensive and safety-critical. Beyond control recognition and action generation, execution must satisfy constraints in operation manuals and safety regulations. While foundation-model-based planners show strong semantic capability, they typically lack computable, localizable, and reproducible mechanisms for violation detection and repair. To address this, we propose PanelShield, a verifiable closed-loop safety planning framework for manual-guided industrial panel operation. The framework generates parameterized action primitive sequences from task-relevant manual evidence and applies dual formal verification with LTL and a Safety FSM to enforce cross-step temporal correctness and local transition legality. When violations occur, it outputs a structured counterexample with the earliest violating step and cause, enabling targeted repair and re-verification. We build a multi-level long-horizon planning benchmark covering three representative industrial device panels, and evaluate the framework in simulation and real-world robotic experiments. Results show that PanelShield improves complex safety-constrained task performance over foundation-model-only planning baselines while reducing the violation rate to 2.7%, with 4.1 s total latency. Real-world experiments demonstrate end-toend feasibility. Overall, PanelShield offers a verifiable approach to robotic panel operation that balances flexibility, safety, and auditability.

analysis.tldr: 提出PanelShield框架，用LTL逻辑和安全有限状态机（FSM）对工业控制面板操作任务做可验证的闭环安全规划，在生成动作序列时实时检测并修复违反操作手册和安全规范的步骤，实测将违规率压到2.7%，并在真实机械臂上跑通端到端流程。
analysis.claim: 通过形式化双验证机制（LTL + Safety FSM）实现可解释、可定位、可修复的工业面板操作安全规划，使大模型生成的动作序列满足跨步时序约束与局部转移合法性。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务指令 + 工业操作手册文本片段 + 面板视觉观测（仿真/真实RGB图像）
analysis.output: 参数化动作原语序列（如'旋钮A顺时针转30°'）+ 结构化反例报告（含最早违规步及原因）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + 工业面板实物平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行日志用于验证，但核心训练/验证未显式使用大规模真机交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将LTL+FSM双形式验证嵌入大模型驱动的工业面板操作闭环规划中，实测显著降低违规率且落地真机，但问题域窄（仅面板操作）、未开源代码/模型、无跨机体泛化验证、未与SOTA机器人世界模型或具身推理框架对比，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证扎实、安全机制设计有新意，但封闭在垂直场景、缺乏开源与横向对比，属于高质量工程级安全增强，非范式突破。

papers.title: Autonomously Acquiring Robot Manipulation Skills with Language-Driven Quality-Diversity
papers.abstract: Quality-diversity (QD) algorithms have been gaining traction in robot learning, where diverse motion primitive libraries allow robots to adapt zero-shot to constraints at deployment time. However, such methods typically require expert designers to write the success condition, fitness and diversity metrics, and this strongly limits the robot's autonomy. On the other hand, existing LLM-based reward-shaping techniques allow robots to learn autonomously but only output single high-performing solutions, limiting the robot's adaptability. In this paper, we propose an approach designed to output diverse motion primitive archives by autonomously leveraging quality-diversity algorithms, only requiring a free-form description of the task in common language. To address the difficulty of designing relevant fitness and diversity metrics, we propose an autonomous exploration mechanism able to reliably output sets of functionals covering the fitness and behavior descriptor (BD) space. First, we pose policy exploration as a functional design problem, where the functional spaces are lower-dimensional than the full BD and fitness spaces, and propose an LLM-based exploration scheme to sample from these low-dimensional spaces without any task-specific prompts, fine-tuning or expert intervention. We adapt a multi-BD variant of the MAP-Elites success (MES) algorithm, designed to leverage the heterogeneous BD samples. Finally, through experiments based on the genesis simulator, we show that our method effectively generates archives of diverse motion primitives, outperforming classical QD algorithms with inferred and hand-written parametrizations on a set of $4$ robotic manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型自动设计质量-多样性（QD）算法所需的适应度和行为描述符函数，无需人工写规则或微调，仅靠自然语言任务描述，就在仿真中生成多样化的机器人操作动作库。
analysis.claim: 仅通过自由文本任务描述，即可全自动构建覆盖行为与性能空间的运动原语档案，摆脱对专家定义的适应度/多样性指标的依赖。
analysis.input: 自然语言任务描述（如‘把杯子推到桌子边缘’）
analysis.output: 多样化运动原语档案（每个原语含策略参数+对应行为描述符+质量评分）
analysis.robot_dependency: Genesis仿真器中的7自由度机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 提出LLM驱动的函数空间采样机制是新思路，但仅在4个简单仿真操纵任务上验证，无真实硬件、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、无消融证明LLM模块不可替代，对比基线也未涵盖近年主流端到端策略方法（如ACT、Diffusion Policy），属扎实但窄幅的QD算法改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如触觉闭环、长程规划、sim2real迁移）。

papers.title: OptiGeo: Efficient Monocular Geometry for Embodied Perception in Optically Challenging Scenes
papers.abstract: Monocular depth estimation has achieved strong open-domain generalization, yet reliable robotic deployment remains difficult in transparent, reflective, and specular environments, where depth sensors often produce missing or biased depth. Existing methods often handle such optical failures with scene-specific preprocessing, auxiliary modules, or post-hoc fine-tuning. While effective in constrained settings, these designs increase architectural redundancy and can over-specialize general geometry models to narrow optical scenarios. We revisit this problem as a localized failure mode within base-model training and identify sensor-induced supervision bias as a key bottleneck: models inherit sensor failure patterns from biased real-depth supervision in optically challenging regions. We then introduce OptiGeo, a bias-aware training framework that rehabilitates biased real supervision using a clean-geometry teacher and residual-trimmed alignment. We redefine transparency-targeted rendering as a compact source of clean optical geometry, rather than a large domain-specific fine-tuning set. With only a small targeted rendering set, OptiGeo learns the geometric structure of transparent objects and regions, correcting local geometry distortions that real sensors cannot reliably supervise. Despite only 30M parameters, OptiGeo outperforms substantially larger 300M-scale monocular models and billion-scale multi-view baselines on transparent-scene benchmarks, while remaining competitive on general zero-shot depth and boundary sharpness. Real-world navigation cases further validate its practicality as an efficient perception module in optically challenging scenes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OptiGeo，一种针对单目深度估计在透明/反光场景中失效问题的轻量级训练框架，不依赖大渲染数据集或额外模块，而是用小规模干净光学几何渲染作为教师监督，校正真实传感器在这些区域产生的偏差，显著提升透明物体深度预测精度。
analysis.claim: 通过引入干净几何教师模型与残差裁剪对齐机制，可在仅使用极小规模透明场景渲染数据的前提下，有效矫正单目深度模型在光学挑战区域（透明/反射）因真实传感器监督偏差导致的几何失真。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 稠密深度图
analysis.data_dependency: 低依赖：仅需少量（未说明具体数量但强调‘small targeted rendering set’）合成透明场景渲染数据，不依赖真实机器人采集的带标注深度数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了单目深度估计在透明/反射场景中长期存在的监督偏差难题，方法简洁且实证扎实（透明场景SOTA、零样本泛化不降级、真实导航验证），但未涉及机器人闭环控制、未开源代码、未构建跨平台基准，属于显著贡献而非范式突破，明显弱于DROID/ALOHA等具身智能基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破了单目深度在光学挑战场景的监督瓶颈，但限于感知模块改进，未进入具身闭环或开放世界部署，不属于范式级工作。

papers.title: De novo design of CR2 binder as vaccine scaffold
papers.abstract: Efficient B cell activation during vaccine-induced humoral immunity relies on both B cell receptor (BCR) antigen recognition and synergistic signaling from co-receptors. Complement receptor 2 (CR2), the primary BCR co-receptor on B cells, lowers the activation threshold and amplifies downstream kinase signaling by orders of magnitude when engaged by complement fragment C3d decorated antigens. Targeting CR2 therefore represents a rational vaccine enhancement strategy, yet native C3d suffers from low affinity, poor stability, and manufacturing challenges. Here, we report the de novo design of a highly stable, high-affinity CR2 binder using deep learning driving protein design methods. Biophysical characterization, high-resolution cryoEM structural determination, and functional assays in vitro and in vivo confirm that the designed binder matches computational design models and specifically engages CR2 to boost B cell activation. When fused to antigen as a vaccine scaffold, the trimeric CR2 binder elicits robust humoral immune responses comparable to nanoparticle vaccines, while retaining the simplicity of single-chain protein production. Our work establishes a modular CR2 targeting vaccine scaffold platform with broad translational potential for next-generation protein vaccines.

analysis.tldr: 用深度学习从头设计了一个高稳定性、高亲和力的CR2蛋白结合体，作为疫苗支架融合抗原后，能在不依赖纳米颗粒复杂制备的前提下，显著增强B细胞激活和体液免疫应答。
analysis.claim: 通过深度学习驱动的从头蛋白设计，获得一个可替代C3d、特异性结合CR2并有效增强抗原诱导体液免疫的模块化疫苗支架。
analysis.input: CR2蛋白结构与功能约束（含结合界面、稳定性、多聚化需求）
analysis.output: 人工设计的三聚体CR2结合蛋白序列及其三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实现了CR2靶向疫苗支架的首个高精度从头设计+冷冻电镜验证+体内外功能确证，解决了C3d临床转化瓶颈，但未建立通用生成范式、未开源模型/代码、未跨抗原泛化验证，属显著但非范式级贡献（未达ESM-2/AlphaFold2级基础性或HI-JEPA/CENO级世界模型层级）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在CR2靶向疫苗支架的设计闭环（计算→结构→功能→免疫），但限于单一靶点与抗原场景，缺乏通用性与开源支撑，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: SocioGesture: Real-Time and Adaptive Social Gesture Perception for Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Robots interacting with people must recognize not only explicit commands, but also social cues such as invitations, refusals, and unavailability. In real deployments, these cues must be inferred from noisy onboard perception under partial occlusion, changing viewpoints, and strict latency constraints. We present SocioGesture, a real-time adaptive social gesture perception system for human-robot interaction (HRI). SocioGesture uses a compact confidence-aware body-hand skeleton representation and a lightweight dual-stream model that fuses body motion with hand articulation for low-latency onboard recognition. To improve deployment robustness, we train the model with occlusion-aware skeleton corruption, exposing it to missing hands, occluded arms, and temporally unstable keypoints without increasing the inference cost. On a social gesture dataset collected in mixed indoor-outdoor HRI scenarios, SocioGesture achieves strong held-out-subject recognition, substantially improves robustness under structured joint occlusion, and runs in real time on a robot-mounted edge device. During deployment, uncertain interaction segments are saved for offline labeling and adaptation, enabling SocioGesture to expand its gesture vocabulary while preserving performance in the original classes. These results demonstrate a practical path toward robust, efficient, and adaptive social perception for interactive robots.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级双流模型SocioGesture，用被遮挡鲁棒的骨骼表示实时识别社交手势（如邀请、拒绝），在边缘设备上运行，支持在线不确定样本收集与后续适应性扩展词汇。
analysis.claim: 通过置信度感知的骨骼表征和遮挡感知训练策略，可在资源受限的机器人端实现实时、鲁棒且可自适应扩展的社交手势识别。
analysis.input: RGB视频流提取的带置信度的身体-手部骨骼序列（含关节缺失/抖动/遮挡）
analysis.output: 社交手势类别（如invitation/refusal/unavailable）及对应置信度
analysis.robot_dependency: 通用移动机器人平台（未指定具体型号，但强调边缘部署）
