papers.title: Locus-Level Transposable Element Profiling Resolves Division-Coupled Transcriptional Dynamics During Human Endoderm Specification
papers.abstract: Background: Transposable elements (TEs) constitute nearly half of the human genome and are now recognized as significant contributors to mammalian gene regulatory networks. Despite this, most transcriptomic studies quantify TE expression at the subfamily level, which may obscure meaningful variation arising from individual insertion sites. Whether resolving TE expression to individual loci can reveal biologically distinct signals during stem cell differentiation has not been systematically characterized. Results: We re-analysed a published RNA-seq time course of FUCCI-h9 human embryonic stem cells differentiating into definitive endoderm (0 to 72 hour, seven time points, three division cycles, three biological replicates), quantifying expression in parallel at two complementary resolutions: TE subfamilies using TEtranscripts and individual TE loci using TElocal. The primary finding is that individual TE loci capture heterogeneous transcriptional responses at cell division boundaries that are entirely absent at the subfamily level. Within-division-state PC1 variance for TE loci was substantially elevated at the first division cycle (6.72; 95% bootstrap CI 0.63 - 8.48) compared with TE subfamilies (0.22; CI 0.04 - 0.34), with non-overlapping confidence intervals providing statistically robust support for the resolution advantage. Differential expression analysis identified over 18,000 dynamic TE loci across the time course, exceeding the 268 differentially expressed subfamilies, with alternating phases of silencing and reactivation resolved only at locus resolution. Differentially expressed TE loci were non-randomly enriched at superenhancers (fold enrichment: 9.1 - 23.5-fold; p < 0.001 by permutation), with peak overlap at 36-48 hours coinciding with the second cell division and endoderm commitment. ERV1-class elements, particularly HERVH-int, were the dominant contributors, and representative loci near the endoderm regulators MIXL1 and ID3 showed differentiation-induced RNA-seq signal within proximal superenhancer domains. Conclusions: TE loci exhibit heterogeneous transcriptional responses at cell division boundaries, a signal with non-overlapping bootstrap confidence intervals relative to TE subfamilies at the first division cycle that is entirely masked by subfamily-level aggregation. This division-boundary resolution advantage, together with permutation-confirmed enrichment of dynamic loci at superenhancers during a discrete 36-48 hour endoderm commitment window, supports broader adoption of locus-resolved TE quantification as a complement to conventional gene expression analysis in developmental genomics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用 locus-level（单个插入位点）而非传统 subfamily-level（TE亚家族）方法分析转座子表达，发现在人类内胚层分化过程中，单个TE位点的表达在细胞分裂边界呈现高度异质性动态，这种信号被亚家族平均完全掩盖，且这些动态位点显著富集于超级增强子区域，尤其在36–48小时的关键命运决定窗口。
analysis.claim: TE表达的生物学意义必须在单个基因组插入位点（locus）分辨率下才能被可靠捕获，亚家族水平的聚合会系统性抹除与细胞分裂耦合的转录动态信号。
analysis.input: FUCCI-h9人胚胎干细胞向定型内胚层分化的RNA-seq时间序列数据（0–72小时，7个时间点，3个生物重复）
analysis.output: 每个转座子插入位点的定量表达值及差异表达状态（激活/沉默）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法学上确证了locus-level TE量化对发育转录动力学的不可替代性——提供了bootstrap非重叠CI、超增强子富集p<0.001、18k+动态位点vs仅268个亚家族的强对比证据；但局限于单一分化体系（内胚层）、未开源代码/模型，未拓展至其他谱系或疾病模型，属扎实但边界明确的机制发现，未达基石级广度或技术通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以统计稳健方式证明TE位点分辨率是解析分裂耦合转录动态的必要条件，推翻亚家族聚合的常规实践，但限于特定发育场景，尚未形成可迁移工具链。

papers.title: Surface electrostatic networks control hydrophobic core remodeling in a pH-dependent switching protein
papers.abstract: Communication between protein surfaces and their buried cores is central to protein structure and function, yet this phenomenon remains challenging to predict and control at high resolution. Changes in the protonation of surface ionizable residues communicate with the hydrophobic core, for example, in diverse pH-dependent protein functions. Hisactophilin, a histidine-rich actin- and membrane-binding protein, provides a general model for exploring such communication as it exhibits a finely tuned pH-regulated myristoyl-switching function. Upon reversible proton binding, the myristoyl group shifts between being sequestered in the hydrophobic core and more solvent accessible. In the current study we utilize experimental and computational approaches we uncover how binding of ~1.5 net protons alters electrostatic interactions involving ionizable residues distributed across much of the protein surface. These changes are transmitted to the hydrophobic core through dynamic communities of ionizable and hydrophobic residues which substantially rearrange upon switching. The effects of mutating individual ionizable residues are weaker than those of core hydrophobic residues, and only combined mutation of multiple ionizable residues caused substantial functional change. Together, these results reveal how communication between surface ionizable residues and the hydrophobic core is mediated by extensive interaction networks that reorganize in response to changes in protonation. These results may provide general insights for understanding protein cooperativity and the coupling of surface and core residues in protein function, disease, evolution, engineering, and design.

analysis.tldr: 通过实验和计算结合，解析了组蛋白hisactophilin如何通过表面带电残基形成的动态静电网络，在pH变化时远程调控疏水核心重构，揭示了表面-核心长程通信的网络化机制而非单点控制。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质表面离子化残基并非孤立作用，而是构成动态静电网络，通过跨区域残基协同重排将质子化信号传递至疏水核心，驱动功能构象切换。
analysis.input: pH梯度下的实验结构数据（NMR、X射线）、分子动力学模拟轨迹、静电势与残基互作网络分析
analysis.output: 表面-核心通信路径的动态网络拓扑图、关键残基突变对构象切换自由能的影响量化、pH依赖性构象分布概率
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高分辨率实验证据+多尺度模拟验证的表面-核心通信机制范例，但仅限单一蛋白模型（hisactophilin），未构建通用预测模型或生成工具，也未拓展到疾病/设计等下游应用，属扎实的机制解析型工作，显著优于纯计算推测但未达AlphaFold级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用多模态实验证据确证了蛋白质长程电控构象切换的网络化本质，但尚未外推为可工程化的通用原理或工具。

papers.title: FSDBN: Foreground-Aware EEG--Visual Alignment via Dynamic Brain Networks
papers.abstract: EEG-based visual decoding provides a non-invasive pathway for interpreting visual semantics. However, existing methods often overlook the perceptual asymmetry between foreground and background in complex scenes, leading to background interference and semantic misalignment. EEG signals also exhibit rapid temporal dynamics and nonstationary spatial patterns, making it difficult to capture the time-varying brain connectivity associated with focal visual attention. To address these limitations, we propose FSDBN, a unified framework for robust EEG-visual decoding. FSDBN introduces Semantic-Consistent Saliency Alignment to separate semantically relevant foreground regions from background noise under joint saliency and semantic constraints. It further employs Semantic-Prior Dynamic Gating Foreground Fusion to adaptively regulate the contributions of foreground and background features. In parallel, EEG signals are modeled as adaptive spatiotemporal brain networks whose functional connectivity dynamically reorganizes to capture neural responses to salient foregrounds. Experiments on zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval demonstrate that FSDBN achieves 69.0 percent top-1 accuracy and 92.2 percent top-5 accuracy, outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/LiuYiheng1/FSDBN-EEG.

analysis.tldr: 提出FSDBN模型，通过前景感知的EEG-视觉对齐方法，在零样本脑到图像检索任务中提升解码准确率，核心是分离前景语义、动态建模脑网络连接以匹配视觉显著区域。
analysis.claim: 前景感知的动态脑网络建模能显著提升EEG信号对复杂视觉场景中语义前景的解码鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号 + 对应观看的自然图像
analysis.output: 检索出的最匹配图像（零样本脑到图像检索）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需EEG+图像配对数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一零样本脑到图像检索任务上提升top-1/5准确率，无跨被试/跨设备/跨范式泛化验证，未涉及实时闭环、临床适用性或神经机制解释，对比基石工作（如92+分的临床级语音/书写BCI）属窄域算法改进，且未开源数据与模型权重，实证深度不足。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯算法改进，无神经科学新发现、无临床接口验证、无跨被试泛化、无硬件部署，仅在一个benchmark上刷分，证据链单薄。

papers.title: A Preparation-Free Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Protein-Ligand Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract: Protein-ligand affinity (PLA) prediction is central to AI-driven drug discovery, but precise interaction-based methods require costly conformation preparation and data encoding, limiting their throughput. To reconcile accuracy with efficiency, we first investigate whether pre-trained molecular representation models can replace complex encoders. A unified and diverse assessment of sequence‑, graph‑, and image‑based representations reveals both strong overall performance and family‑wise variability, delivering the first practical guidance for encoder selection in PLA tasks. Next, to achieve high computational efficiency without sacrificing expressiveness, we adopt the mixture‑of‑experts (MoE) strategy from large language models. Systematic ablation studies uncover key design principles for deploying MoE in molecular prediction. The resulting model, HydrAffinity, is an interaction‑free, dynamic sparse model that uses pre-trained encoders and MoE for parameter‑efficient learning. It outperforms all interaction‑free methods and matches state‑of‑the‑art interaction‑based methods on CASF‑2016. Routing analysis confirms that MoE develops distinct, family‑specific activation patterns, providing interpretable evidence of dynamic parameterization across protein classes. Zero‑shot tests on DUDE‑Z and LIT‑PCBA further show strong EF5% performance, making HydrAffinity a practical, scalable solution acting as an effective early‑stage pre‑filter.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个无需蛋白质-配体复合物构象准备、不依赖交互式特征计算的蛋白质-配体亲和力预测模型HydrAffinity，用预训练分子表征（序列/图/图像）+动态稀疏MoE架构，在保持高精度的同时大幅提速，能在早期药物筛选中当高效预过滤器用
analysis.claim: 无需构象准备和交互编码的MoE框架，能以参数高效方式实现与SOTA交互式方法相当的亲和力预测精度，并具备跨蛋白家族的可解释动态路由能力
analysis.input: 单独的蛋白质序列/结构图/2D图像 + 单独的配体SMILES/图/图像（无复合物构象、无交互特征）
analysis.output: 标量亲和力预测值（pKd/pKi）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在PLA领域首次系统评估多模态预训练编码器并成功嫁接MoE实现交互自由下的SOTA级性能，有扎实的跨数据集（CASF-2016/DUDE-Z/LIT-PCBA）验证和消融分析，但未开源代码/模型，且未解决根本性瓶颈（如物理可解释性、绝对亲和力误差分布），属显著贡献而非里程碑
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将MoE与多源预训练表征巧妙结合，实证上达成交互自由与精度平衡，但缺乏开源与机制深度，尚未达到开范式或解决长期开放难题的突破层级

papers.title: Hand-Object Interaction in the Age of Large Foundation Models:Reconstruction, Generation, and Embodied Transfer
papers.abstract: Hand-object interaction (HOI) modeling remains challenging because it requires joint reasoning about hand articulation, object geometry, contact, semantics, and dynamics under severe visual uncertainty. Foundation models introduce transferable prior knowledge learned from large-scale cross-domain data, offering new ways to address these challenges beyond task-specific data and models. However, the rapidly growing literature remains fragmented, and existing studies typically describe these methods simply as ``using large models'' without systematically characterizing what knowledge is introduced, where it enters the HOI pipeline, or which HOI uncertainty it helps reduce. This survey presents the first systematic review of foundation-model priors for HOI. We organize the literature into six HOI tasks spanning reconstruction and generation. More importantly, we establish a taxonomy of eight foundation-model sub-priors grouped into geometric, semantic, and visual families. Geometric priors encompass shape retrieval, shape reconstruction, and spatial reconstruction; semantic priors include semantic grounding and language reasoning; and visual priors cover visual representation, image generation, and video generation. Based on this taxonomy, we systematically analyze how different priors are represented, injected, and adapted across HOI pipelines and tasks. Beyond how foundation models empower HOI, we further examine how HOI-derived knowledge is used in robot learning, including human-data pretraining, human-to-robot skill transfer, and HOI-to-robot data generation. Finally, we summarize datasets and evaluation protocols, and discuss limitations and future directions toward more generalizable HOI systems. To support long-term progress, we curate a live repository that continuously aggregates emerging methods and benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇系统性综述论文，首次对大模型如何赋能手-物交互（HOI）任务进行了结构化梳理，提出八类基础模型先验知识的分类法（几何/语义/视觉三大家族），并分析其在HOI各任务中的注入方式与作用机制，同时探讨HOI知识反哺机器人学习的路径。
analysis.claim: 大模型对HOI的赋能不能笼统归为‘用大模型’，而应按先验知识类型（几何/语义/视觉）及其在HOI流水线中的注入位置和作用对象进行系统解耦与归因。
analysis.input: HOI相关论文、方法、数据集、评估协议
analysis.output: HOI领域中基础模型先验知识的分类体系、注入机制分析、跨领域迁移路径总结
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于文献与公开方法分析
analysis.significance_reason: 是HOI+大模型方向首个系统性 taxonomy 工作，填补了方法论归因空白，但本质是高质量综述而非技术突破；无新模型/新数据/新实验，未解决任何HOI具体技术瓶颈（如接触建模、实时性、泛化性），也未在机器人端验证所提框架的有效性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次建立HOI大模型先验的系统分类与作用机制分析框架，但属方法论梳理而非实证突破，暂未推动HOI性能或机器人部署边界。

papers.title: Macroscale dynamics of EEG microstates determine the periodic and aperiodic features of the neural power spectrum
papers.abstract: The global signal characteristics of scalp-recorded electroencephalography (EEG) are composed of periodic oscillatory rhythms and aperiodic broadband fluctuations that together constitute the neural power spectrum. Spectral decomposition of these features has long served as the primary window into the macroscale characteristics of human brain activity. However, prevailing interpretations of spectral features lack a unifying mechanistic framework and often conflate activity resulting from distinct neural sources. Here, we propose that the primary periodic rhythms and majority share of broadband spectral power within the brain's dominant frequencies originate from the brain network architecture responsible for generating EEG microstates. These microstates consist of a small repertoire of quasi-stable topographic voltage configurations that each reflect the momentary functional state of the cortex, and it is their dynamics that generate periodic and aperiodic spectral features. To computationally test this generating mechanism, we isolated and removed the spatial projections of microstates from high-density EEG using orthogonal subspace projection applied to both the surface scalp recordings and their modeled cortical generators. Spectral parameterization of the residual power spectral density revealed that removing seven distinct microstates strongly attenuated alpha and theta rhythms and features of the aperiodic 1/f background. Selectively removing specific topographic configurations also demonstrated that each microstate possesses independent oscillatory generators and unique 1/f aperiodic structures. Together, our findings suggest that dominant periodic and aperiodic spectral features are more accurately understood as the frequency-domain expressions of the distributed brain networks generating EEG microstates.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出脑电微状态（EEG microstates）的动力学是头皮脑电功率谱中周期性节律（如alpha/theta）和非周期性1/f背景的共同源头，并通过正交子空间投影从高密度EEG中逐个剔除7种微状态，实证显示其移除显著削弱了这些频谱特征。
analysis.claim: EEG微状态的动力学机制统一生成了功率谱中的周期性振荡（alpha/theta）和非周期性1/f背景，二者并非独立神经源，而是同一分布式皮层网络活动在频域的表达。
analysis.input: 高密度头皮EEG信号及其源建模得到的皮层生成器信号
analysis.output: 剔除微状态后的残差功率谱密度参数（周期性峰值强度、1/f斜率与偏移）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开或自采集的高密度静息态EEG数据（未说明是否多中心/大样本），无机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了微状态与全脑频谱特征间的因果性证据（通过可逆剔除操作），挑战了传统将周期/非周期成分割裂解释的范式，但仅基于静息态EEG、未验证任务态泛化、未开源代码/模型、未跨被试/跨设备验证，属扎实的机制性发现而非范式突破，远低于脑机接口领域90+分量级工作（如实时语音解码、行走闭环控制等临床级应用）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——用严谨的信号处理方法将微状态动力学与经典频谱特征建立可验证的生成关系，但限于离线分析、缺乏临床或交互场景验证，尚未构成新范式或实用接口。

papers.title: Long-Horizon Embodied Decision-Making via Multimodal Memory Compression
papers.abstract: Agents are increasingly expected to act not only as task executors, but also as decision-makers on behalf of human users. This shift requires agents to accumulate evidence over long horizons, interpret implicit user preferences, and compare multiple candidates under partial observations. In this work, we propose DunphyBench, a new benchmark for evaluating agents on long-horizon human-centered embodied decision-making, where the agent must navigate through multiple embodied housing environments and make decisions that align with multi-dimensional human preferences. Unlike standard embodied reasoning tasks that often focus on procedural planning or immediate goal completion, our setting requires agents to integrate multimodal, multi-source input into coherent knowledge that supports complex reasoning across long horizon. The evaluation results reveal that there is a substantial gap between current agents and human performance. Furthermore, our diagnosis of state-of-the-art VLM-driven agents reveals that memory management is one of the bottlenecks, where raw multimodal history introduces noise that hinders decision quality. Motivated by this finding, we design MeMento, a preference-conditioned multimodal memory compressor that selectively compresses decision-relevant information from long-horizon history based on user preferences with a fixed set of memory tokens. Experiments show that MeMento helps VLM-driven agents improve accuracy by 7.18%, while reducing memory usage by 85.38% compared to the strongest baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫DunphyBench的新评测基准，用于测试具身智能体在多房间住宅环境中、基于长期交互历史和隐含人类偏好做复杂决策的能力；发现现有视觉语言模型（VLM）因记忆冗余导致决策质量下降，于是设计MeMento压缩器，用固定数量的记忆token按偏好筛选并压缩多模态历史，显著提升决策准确率且大幅降低内存开销。
analysis.claim: 长期具身决策的核心瓶颈是未受偏好引导的多模态记忆冗余，通过偏好条件化的固定token记忆压缩（MeMento），可在不牺牲决策质量前提下实现高效长程推理。
analysis.input: 多模态长程交互历史（RGB图像、文本指令、动作反馈、环境状态等）+ 用户偏好描述（文本）
analysis.output: 结构化决策结果（如选择哪个房间/物品/方案，附带理由）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真环境（DunphyBench）
analysis.significance_reason: DunphyBench首次系统定义‘长程人类中心具身决策’这一新任务范式，有明确认知维度（偏好建模、部分可观测比较、证据累积），MeMento机制简洁有效且有消融验证；但仍是纯仿真、无真机验证、未接入闭环控制、未挑战物理交互或时序动作生成，与World Models/Dreamer系列在建模深度、持续状态维护、闭环策略耦合等根本能力上存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：建立了首个聚焦人类偏好驱动的长程具身决策评测框架，并提出可解释的记忆压缩机制，但限于纯仿真和决策层输出，尚未触及具身智能的感知-动作闭环核心。

papers.title: Multiplex Genome Editing Overcomes Photoperiod Sensitivity in Tropical Maize
papers.abstract: Tropical maize is a rich source of genetic diversity that could enhance temperate maize breeding programs, but its sensitivity to long-day photoperiods, resulting in delayed flowering, limits its widespread use. To overcome this barrier, the Genome Engineering to Sustain Crop Improvement (GETSCI) project used CRISPR/Cas9 to mutate three flowering repressor genes, ZmCCT9, ZmCCT10, and ZmRAP2.7, in the tropical inbred Tzi8. A single sgRNA targeting the first exon of each target gene was combined with an excision cassette carrying the morphogenic genes Babyboom (Bbm) and Wuschel2 (Wus2) to enable efficient transgenic plant regeneration. Transgenic plants carrying frameshift edits in each target gene were recovered, and subsequent crosses produced two non-transgenic genotypes: a double-edited zmcct10, zmrap2.7 line and a triple-edited zmcct9, zmcct10, zmrap2.7 line. Multiple flowering traits were measured for the edited genotypes and unedited Tzi8 inbred in short-day (Hawaiʻi) and long-day (Iowa) field conditions. Both edited genotypes flowered significantly earlier than Tzi8 in both environments. Notably, under long-day conditions, flowering of the two edited lines overlapped with that of the temperate inbred B73, whereas Tzi8 did not. Together, these results demonstrate that targeted, multiplex gene editing can reduce photoperiod sensitivity in a tropical inbred, expanding access to previously untapped genetic diversity for temperate maize improvement.

analysis.tldr: 用CRISPR/Cas9同时敲除热带玉米Tzi8中的三个开花抑制基因，获得不带外源DNA的双/三基因编辑株系，使其在长日照（爱荷华）下开花时间接近温带玉米B73，从而消除光周期敏感性障碍，释放热带玉米遗传资源用于温带育种。
analysis.claim: 通过多重靶向基因编辑同步失活ZmCCT9、ZmCCT10和ZmRAP2.7，可彻底解除热带玉米的光周期敏感性，且无需残留转基因元件。
analysis.input: 热带玉米自交系Tzi8的愈伤组织+三靶点sgRNA+含Bbm/Wus2的切除型载体
analysis.output: 非转基因的双/三基因编辑纯合玉米植株及其田间开花表型数据
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真田间多地点（夏威夷/爱荷华）、多基因组合、非转基因后代、与标杆温带材料B73直接比对；但属作物育种中已验证策略（多基因编辑解耦光周期）的成熟应用，未提出新机制、新工具或跨物种泛化能力，贡献在于成功落地而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是农业基因编辑从‘能做’到‘可用’的关键实证，但未开辟新方法论或解决基础生物学难题，属于高完成度的转化型工作

papers.title: Slower cardiac-coupled cortical dynamics link depressive symptoms to inflexible affective updating
papers.abstract: Depression is marked by blunted affective responses to context, which interoceptive accounts trace to altered neural representations of bodily states. Yet this evidence mainly concerns response magnitude, not how quickly affect is updated when contexts change. Here we tested whether depressive symptom severity is related to delayed affective updating, and whether cortical dynamics tracking cardiac states account for this delay. To this end, we applied a movie-watching paradigm with independently defined contextual shifts, continuous affect ratings, electroencephalography, and electrocardiography in individuals spanning a continuum of depressive symptoms. Combining deep representation learning and a dynamical systems framework, we quantified how quickly (speed) and how sharply (angle) cardiac-coupled cortical representations reorganized at each shift. Greater symptom severity predicted longer latency to enter the context-congruent affective state across contextual shifts, regardless of valence. In a cross-sectional mediation analysis, slower speed, but not angle, accounted for this association. This mediation was specific to depressive symptoms, contextual shifts, and cardiac-coupled neural dynamics. These findings extend the embodied account of depression from blunted affective intensity toward its inflexible updating at moments of contextual shift, and offer a broadly applicable framework for quantifying brain-body dynamics across affective dysfunctions.

analysis.tldr: 研究发现抑郁症状越重，人脑对情绪情境变化的更新越慢，这种‘情绪更新迟滞’与大脑皮层追踪心跳节奏的动态变慢直接相关，用电影观看+连续情绪评分+脑电+心电数据证实了身体信号处理速度如何导致情绪灵活性下降。
analysis.claim: 抑郁症状严重程度通过减慢心脏耦合的皮层动态更新速度（而非方向锐度），导致情绪状态在情境切换时更新滞后，揭示了具身情绪失调的新机制。
analysis.input: EEG+ECG同步信号、电影片段中的独立标注情境转换点、被试连续情绪评分（效价/唤醒）
analysis.output: 心脏耦合皮层表征的动态更新速度（latency/speed）和角度（reorganization angle）量化值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类神经生理与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将抑郁的情绪僵化归因于心脏-皮层耦合动态的时间维度（更新速度），而非传统强度维度；实证扎实（N=52，多模态同步采集，交叉验证+中介分析），但属机制深化型工作，未开辟新范式、未解决临床干预难题、未构建通用工具链，显著优于一般心理学相关论文，但远未达BCI/神经解码类里程碑（如Brain2Voice/BCI-speech）的工程与临床分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨的神经动力学方法把抑郁的情绪僵化锚定到具身节律更新延迟，是具身认知与临床神经科学的重要交叉推进，但非突破性技术或范式革新。

papers.title: From Code to Cure: Computationally Designed BMP-2 Binders Using AI-Integrated Pipelines for Controlled Bone Regeneration
papers.abstract: Nonunion fractures remain a costly and persistent challenge in regenerative medicine, with current treatments limited by donor-site morbidity, restricted graft availability, and severe adverse effects associated with supraphysiological bone morphogenetic protein 2 (BMP-2) delivery, including ectopic ossification and inflammation. Endogenous BMP-2 signaling is tightly regulated in adult tissues, constraining the precision and scalability of approaches based on transcriptional upregulation or bolus growth factor administration. To address these limitations, we developed a two-phase integrated computational-experimental pipeline for the de novo design of protein binders targeting the BMP-2 knuckle epitope, a receptor-binding surface corresponding to BMPR-II engagement, enabling affinity-tuned modulation of BMP-2 activity rather than uncontrolled pathway activation. Phase I employed PyRosetta-based β-strand motif grafting and physics-based docking protocols to generate 264 candidate binders, followed by deep-learning-driven refinement in Phase II using partial RFDiffusion and ProteinMPNN with AlphaFold2 validation, yielding 22 candidates with stable β-sheet architectures consistent with knuckle-epitope targeting. Experimental validation demonstrated dose-dependent BMP-2 binding, with the lead construct exhibiting an apparent KD of 2.07 nM toward BMP-2. Targeted alanine substitutions revealed differential residue contributions, with mutation of T42 significantly disrupting binding, while other substitutions had more modest effects, indicating a partially hotspot-driven interface supported by other interactions.

analysis.tldr: 用AI驱动的计算流程从头设计出能高亲和力结合BMP-2关键功能表位（knuckle epitope）的新型蛋白结合剂，实验证实其纳摩尔级结合能力，并揭示结合界面存在关键热点残基。
analysis.claim: 通过分阶段AI整合计算管线（PyRosetta嫁接+RFDiffusion/ProteinMPNN优化+AlphaFold2验证），可从头设计出结构稳定、靶向BMP-2受体结合表位、且具备可调亲和力的新型蛋白结合剂，从而实现对BMP-2信号的精准调控而非失控激活。
analysis.input: BMP-2三维结构（PDB）、knuckle表位区域定义、物理约束（如β-strand兼容性）、深度学习先验（RFDiffusion部分采样、ProteinMPNN序列生成）
analysis.output: 22个预测结构稳定、靶向knuckle表位的蛋白结合剂序列与结构模型
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将RFDiffusion（部分）、ProteinMPNN与PyRosetta物理建模闭环用于BMP-2表位特异性结合剂设计，并获实验验证（KD=2.07 nM）和界面突变分析；但仅针对单一靶点单一体系，未构建通用平台、未验证功能调控效果（如细胞分化/骨再生），也未开源代码或模型，显著弱于ESMFold/AlphaFold2等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法整合扎实、靶点选择临床相关、实验验证到位，但限于单靶点、无功能表型、无开源，尚未达到范式级突破

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Continuous Action Representation for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: We propose CAT, a trajectory-level continuous action representation framework for robotic manipulation. Existing visuomotor systems often entangle action representation with control frequency or rely on fixed temporal parameterizations. This leads to representational redundancy at high sampling rates and limits the modeling of critical motion. CAT instead encodes action trajectories within a fixed real-time interval into a set of continuous latent tokens. To ensure temporal consistency across varying control frequencies, we further incorporate a frequency-aware positional encoding that establishs a shared temporal coordinate system. Trajectory-level regularization further stabilizes the latent representation. This approach prevents representation growth with timestep density and avoids reliance on predefined temporal parameterizations. Extensive system-level evaluations on LIBERO, MimicGen, and real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that CAT-based policies consistently outperform both competitive VQ-based and continuous visuomotor baselines under matched training settings. Across various model backbones and control frequencies, CAT consistently improves success rates. These results highlight the advantages of trajectory-level continuous action modeling for scalable robotic manipulation across varying control rates.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAT框架，把机器人操作的动作不再表示成一帧一帧的离散控制指令，而是压缩成固定时长内的一条连续轨迹（用几个隐变量表示），并用频率感知的位置编码来适配不同控制频率，从而避免动作表示随采样率升高而膨胀，提升跨频率泛化能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 将动作建模为固定时间窗口内的连续轨迹而非离散时序控制信号，可消除对预设时间参数化的依赖、抑制表征冗余，并提升跨控制频率的策略泛化性与成功率。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（RGB图像）+任务指令（文本或示范）
analysis.output: 连续动作轨迹的隐空间表示（latent tokens），解码后生成控制序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真与真实机器人平台（LIBERO/MimicGen/real-world long-horizon tasks）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据（明确提到 real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（轨迹级连续表征+频率感知位置编码），在多个标准benchmark和真实长程任务上验证了跨频率鲁棒性与成功率提升，有消融和多骨干网络验证，但未开源代码/模型，未披露硬件细节或部署规模，也未挑战接触密集、高自由度灵巧操作等基石工作所覆盖的难度层级，属于显著但非范式级的表示层改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了动作表示随控制频率膨胀的工程痛点，在多基准和真实任务上实证有效，但缺乏开源与底层硬件适配细节，未触及灵巧操作核心瓶颈，暂未达基石工作量级。

papers.title: Temporal Forcing: 4D Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) methods improve manipulation performance by aligning their representations with 3D scene geometry. However, these methods often struggle with long-horizon manipulation and observation aliasing between visually similar states due to a lack of temporal information: the 3D scene geometry captures only the current state, rather than how it has evolved over time. To resolve this, we present Temporal Forcing, a 4D representation alignment method for VLA models. Specifically, we first introduce a history pathway that enables a vanilla VLA model to summarize observation history into temporally aware latent representations. Then, the latent representations are aligned with the geometric features extracted by a pretrained 4D foundation model, which captures the evolving 3D world through temporally consistent geometric representations, enabling a deeper understanding of dynamic environments. Temporal Forcing reaches 98.8% on LIBERO, outperforming its base model by 2.2 points. On a physical hidden-placement task, it raises full-task success from 20.0% to 43.3%. Code will be publicly available.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘时间强制’（Temporal Forcing）方法，给现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型加了一条历史信息通路，并用预训练的4D基础模型（建模随时间演化的3D几何）对齐其时序表征，从而缓解长程操作中因视觉相似状态导致的动作混淆问题。
analysis.claim: 引入4D（时空）表征对齐可显著提升VLA模型在长时程、易混淆动态场景中的泛化与操作成功率，关键在于将观察历史与演化几何结构联合建模。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言指令+历史观测（隐式）
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；LIBERO为仿真benchmark，物理hidden-placement任务提及但无数据规模/采集细节
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在LIBERO（纯仿真）和一个未公开细节的小型物理任务上验证，无跨机体/跨场景/多基线消融，4D对齐依赖黑盒预训练4D模型且未开源，相比RT-2/π0等里程碑工作缺乏真机规模化验证、世界模型整合或架构级创新，属扎实但窄域的表征增强思路。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已有VLA框架上叠加时序建模模块并借用外部4D特征，有实测增益但未突破范式、未解决核心sim2real鸿沟，也未提供可复现的4D建模能力。

papers.title: Learning to infer and manipulate through distributed whole-arm interaction in a soft robot
papers.abstract: In animals such as elephants and octopuses, acquiring non-visual information about an object and physically engaging with it are inseparable processes mediated by rich, large-area interactions between compliant appendages and the environment. Soft robots provide a natural platform for translating this principle into engineered systems. Yet current robotic intelligence makes limited use of physical interaction, treating it primarily as a disturbance to be rejected or, at best, as a means of compensating for object misalignment. Here, we introduce a physical intelligence framework in which distributed compliant interactions jointly reveal task-relevant information and organize manipulation behavior. This results in an intrinsically partially observable problem: key task-relevant information is never measured directly, but must instead be inferred from the history of physical interactions. We propose a reinforcement-learning architecture that addresses this challenge by learning a memory-based control policy end-to-end. The key innovations making this possible are (i) a pretrained exploration policy that provides a reference for broad workspace exploration, (ii) joint optimization that integrates exploration and grasping objectives within a single recurrent policy, and (iii) a two-stage sim-to-real adaptation including observation mapping and policy fine-tuning. We demonstrate this principle through blind whole-arm grasping with a hybrid rigid-soft robotic arm that we equip with IMUs embedded directly within its compliant structure, providing its only source of proprioceptive sensing. The learned policy successfully identifies and grasps various objects by autonomously coordinating workspace exploration, object encounter and localization, inference of grasp-relevant properties, and stable whole-arm wrapping.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让一个混合刚-软机械臂在完全不依赖视觉的情况下，仅靠嵌入软体结构内部的IMU感知自身形变，通过整臂触觉交互（而非指尖抓取）自主探索、接触、推断物体属性并完成包裹式抓取，整个过程由端到端记忆型强化学习策略驱动。
analysis.claim: 分布式全臂柔顺交互本身既是感知信息源又是操控执行器，可构建无需外部视觉、仅靠本体感测历史即可推理并完成操作的物理智能闭环。
analysis.input: IMU序列（嵌入软体结构内的多点角速度/加速度）、时间步序号、隐状态
analysis.output: 关节力矩指令（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研混合刚-软机械臂（含嵌入式IMU阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的IMU-交互数据用于sim2real适配；但核心训练在仿真中完成，真实数据仅用于后期微调和映射
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实软体机器人上实现纯本体感知驱动的端到端盲抓（无视觉/外部传感），具备明确物理智能范式意义；但任务单一（仅全臂包裹抓取）、泛化限于数类物体、未跨机体/场景验证，且代码未开源，实证规模与鲁棒性不及GigaBrain-WBC或H2O等95分档工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真正在真实软体平台上验证了‘交互即感知+操控’的物理智能闭环，但受限于任务窄、泛化弱、开源缺失，尚未达到里程碑级分量。

papers.title: Continuous Actions from Discrete Minds: Latent-Aligned Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Bridging the gap between the discrete reasoning of Vision-Language Models and the continuous, physics-constrained nature of autonomous driving remains a significant challenge. In this work, we introduce LaPla, a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework featuring latent-aligned planning to seamlessly ground semantic understanding in precise motion execution. We first design an action tokenizer based on a residual vector-quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE), capturing vehicle kinematics and encoding trajectory features into a structured latent space. Rather than discrete codebook lookups that inevitably introduce quantization errors, LaPla repurposes this representation as a physical prior to bridge the modality gap between high-dimensional semantics and the raw action space. Specifically, given multimodal inputs integrating multi-view images, historical actions, and textual instructions, LaPla incorporates concurrent action queries to causally attend to the multimodal context in a single forward pass, projecting hidden states directly into the pretrained VQ-VAE latent space. The frozen decoder then translates these continuous latents into actions, effectively eliminating quantization errors and ensuring physically plausible trajectories while bypassing time-consuming autoregressive generation. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that LaPla achieves competitive open-loop performance, reducing long-horizon L2 error by 15.52% compared to state-of-the-art VLA methods. Closed-loop evaluations on the NVIDIA AlpaSim simulator further confirm its superior capability in ensuring smooth driving progress, improving the success rate by 33.34 percentage points with significantly reduced inference latency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LaPla框架，用VQ-VAE学出的连续潜在空间替代传统离散动作码本，让视觉语言模型能直接输出物理合理的连续驾驶动作，避免量化误差和自回归延迟，在nuScenes开环预测和AlpaSim闭环仿真中提升了精度和成功率。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 通过将VQ-VAE的潜在空间作为物理先验而非离散码本，可实现视觉语言模型到连续、物理可行驾驶动作的端到端无缝映射，消除量化误差并支持单次前向生成。
analysis.input: 多视角图像+历史动作+文本指令
analysis.output: 连续车辆控制动作（转向/加减速等）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实车数据，仅依赖nuScenes公开标注数据与AlpaSim仿真器
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路合理（用latent作物理先验而非codebook）且在标准仿真评测中取得扎实提升（L2降15.5%，成功率+33.3pp），但完全限于仿真、无真实车验证、未跨场景/天气/传感器泛化、未开源代码模型，属于针对VLA驱动范式中量化失真问题的高质量增量改进，未达基石级所要求的范式突破或真实世界部署证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了VLA在驾驶任务中因离散化导致的动作失真问题，但仅在仿真中验证，未触及真实世界复杂性，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: MobileVLA-R1 2.0: RL-Enhanced Reasoning for Mobile Robot Control
papers.abstract: Grounding natural-language instructions into reliable and executable actions remains a fundamental challenge for vision-language-action (VLA) systems on mobile robots, due to the persistent gap between high-level semantic reasoning and low-level locomotion and manipulation control. Existing approaches often rely on implicit reasoning or monolithic action prediction, making it difficult to maintain coherent long-horizon decision making while producing precise and adaptable robot actions. To address this challenge, we propose MobileVLA-R1 2.0, an RL-enhanced VLA framework that explicitly couples structured embodied reasoning with executable mobile robot control. The framework learns multi-granularity reasoning over embodied trajectories through supervised Chain-of-Thought (CoT) alignment and reinforcement learning, improving reasoning-to-action consistency beyond purely behavioral supervision. To support both locomotion and manipulation, we further introduce a reasoning-conditioned action decoder that maps multimodal reasoning representations to task-level action targets, which are subsequently translated into embodiment-specific commands by robot controllers. This design provides a unified perception-reasoning-action interface while decoupling high-level action generation from robot-specific actuation. We conduct extensive evaluations on language-guided navigation, quadruped control, and humanoid mobile manipulation, covering VLN-CE, QUARD, and real-world deployments on Unitree Go2 and G1 robots. MobileVLA-R1 2.0 consistently outperforms strong VLA baselines, achieving an average 1.6 point improvement in SR on VLN-CE and a 10.0 point improvement in full-task success on real-world G1 mobile manipulation tasks over MobileVLA-R1, while demonstrating robust long-horizon instruction following and closed-loop execution across different robotic platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文升级了MobileVLA-R1，用强化学习增强链式思维（CoT）推理，让移动机器人能更连贯地理解长指令并生成适配不同机体（四足/人形）的动作，但在真实机器人上只测了两个机型（Go2/G1）、任务类型有限、无跨平台消融、未开源代码或模型。
analysis.claim: 通过RL增强的多粒度具身链式推理与解耦的动作解码器，可提升语言指令到跨机体动作的一致性与长程连贯性。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB视觉观测
analysis.output: 任务级动作目标（如'打开抽屉'），再由底层控制器转为具体电机指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据（但未说明采集规模、多样性或是否公开）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽实现跨机体控制且在G1上提升10点成功率，但未提供训练数据量、消融实验缺失（如RL增强vs CoT对齐的独立贡献）、无跨任务泛化验证（仅导航/四足/人形操纵三类）、未开源核心代码或模型，显著弱于RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石工作（后者均含大规模真实轨迹、多基准SOTA、完整开源或系统级部署证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：工程上整合了CoT与RL并验证了跨机体可行性，但缺乏数据、消融、开源等关键实证支撑，尚未达到领域基石水准

papers.title: Gene conversion facilitates rapid evolution of inversions across avian immunoglobulin loci
papers.abstract: The genomic architecture of immunoglobulin (IG) loci in birds has received remarkably little attention, despite their relevance to infectious disease susceptibility. One of the few exceptions is the domestic chicken, which has been found to use a completely different mechanism to generate a diverse IG repertoire than most vertebrates; rather than relying on V(D)J recombination, chickens primarily use somatic gene conversion. Whether this is true of all birds has remained unknown and untestable at scale until now. And importantly, it is not known how this alternative mechanism for antibody generation shapes, and is shaped by, genome evolution in birds. Leveraging IG locus annotations from 122 bird species generated through the Vertebrate Genomes Project and 17 species from the California Conservation Genomics Project, we show that avian IGH loci display a striking, previously unreported architecture of recurrent inverted duplications that generate direct and inverted copies of the same repeat unit, found in no other vertebrate lineage. Inversion density varies considerably across species, and population-level analyses reveal that these inversions evolve rapidly. We propose a model in which these inversions are actively maintained because they continuously replenish a pool of highly similar pseudogenes that serve as donors for somatic gene conversion, substituting for the large functional V gene repertoires other vertebrates use to generate IG diversity. This model makes a direct prediction: IGH loci should harbor few functional genes and many pseudogenes, while IGL loci, which typically lack this inversion architecture, should show the opposite pattern. Our cross-species analysis confirms this. To test the model at the level of the expressed repertoire, we generated paired whole-genome and Iso-seq data from a single wild-caught Red-winged Blackbird. Consistent with our predictions, a single terminal IGLV gene is diversified through gene conversion from surrounding pseudogenes, while IGH carries a large donor pool at which we also detect gene conversion. Together, these findings reveal that the molecular evolution of IG in birds is governed by fundamentally different constraints and processes than in the rest of known vertebrates.

analysis.tldr: 本文通过分析139种鸟类的免疫球蛋白（IG）基因组数据，发现鸟类IGH位点普遍存在快速演化的倒位重复结构，这种结构能持续产生大量高度相似的假基因，作为体细胞基因转换的供体，替代其他脊椎动物依赖的庞大功能性V基因库，从而揭示鸟类抗体多样性生成机制与基因组演化之间全新的因果关系。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校
analysis.claim: 鸟类IGH位点中广泛存在的倒位重复结构并非中性变异，而是被正向选择维持的适应性架构，其核心功能是为体细胞基因转换持续供应高同源性假基因供体，从而支撑抗体多样性生成。
analysis.input: 139个鸟类物种的高质量基因组组装、IGH/IGL位点注释、群体遗传变异数据、单只红翅黑鹂的全基因组+Iso-seq全长转录组数据
analysis.output: 跨物种倒位密度图谱、倒位-假基因丰度相关性证据、体细胞基因转换事件在IGH/IGL中的实证检测结果、支持‘倒位维持供体池’模型的统计与序列比对证据
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在全鸟纲尺度建立IGH倒位架构与体细胞基因转换功能的因果模型，提供多层级实证（基因组架构→群体演化速率→个体表达谱→序列水平转换事件），但未开发新算法或预测工具，也未实现跨物种机制干预验证，属扎实的重大生物学发现而非方法论突破，略低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold级范式变革，但显著强于纯描述性比较基因组学。

papers.title: Beyond Noise Steering: Dual-Latent Space Reinforcement Learning for Generative Robot Policy
papers.abstract: Pretrained generative robot policies learn expressive action priors from demonstrations. However, existing reinforcement learning methods only steer the noisy space but fail to modulate intermediate action representations during the generation process, resulting in performance degradation and inefficiency. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Dual-Latent Space Reinforcement Learning (DLSRL) framework, which complements initial-noise steering with representation-level control inside the frozen generator. Specifically, our actor network predicts two distinct latent variables: an initial-noise latent variable that steers behavior generation, and an action-representation latent variable for intermediate feature modulation. Moreover, this representation latent variable is mapped to adapter features and ingeniously injected into the hidden states of intermediate action tokens via residual connections. Our dual-control design enables direct adjustment of action representations without updating the base policy. Experiments across generative policy architectures and robotic manipulation tasks show that DLSRL effectively accelerates online robot policy adaptation and achieves competitive performance. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/DLSRL}{https://github.com/xianchaoxiu/DLSRL}.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种双隐空间强化学习框架（DLSRL），在冻结的生成式机器人策略基础上，不更新主模型，而是通过控制两个独立隐变量（初始噪声+中间动作表征）来实时调节动作生成过程，从而加速在线策略适应。
analysis.claim: 在不微调冻结的生成式机器人策略主干的前提下，通过引入可学习的动作表征隐变量并将其以残差方式注入中间token状态，能比仅调节初始噪声更高效、更稳定地实现在线策略优化。
analysis.input: 视觉-语言指令 + 当前观测（隐含）
analysis.output: 动作序列（生成式输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提‘robotic manipulation tasks’但无数据来源细节
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有启发性（分离噪声与表征控制），但缺乏真机验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化证据、未与主流VLA基线（如π0、Qwen-RobotManip）对比、消融不充分、仅称‘competitive performance’而无量化指标；相比标尺中94+的基石工作，它属于局部机制改进，未触及架构范式、数据规模、多体协同或世界模型等关键维度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在生成式机器人策略的噪声调控范式上做了合理延伸，但实证薄弱、边界模糊，尚未构成对当前SOTA范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: ZYT-World: A Real-Time Controllable World Model for Closed-Loop Autonomous-Driving Simulation
papers.abstract: Generative world models offer controllable and repeatable closed-loop simulation for end-to-end and vision-language-action driving policies, but production deployment exposes three unresolved requirements: faithfully reproducing a mixed fisheye-pinhole rig at native resolutions; reconciling causal, per-timestep interaction with long-horizon stability and low latency; and preserving scene identity when a location is revisited. We present ZYT-World, a single architecture that natively generates four fisheye views with field of view > 180° and three pinhole views. Projection-specific Plucker adapters encode camera geometry, ego-motion adaptive layer normalization provides global motion control, and a lightweight pixel-aligned layout conditions traffic participants and signals through instance-level boxes, headings and colors. Heterogeneous training combines full-rig geometric coverage with high-resolution detail. Teacher forcing, causal consistency distillation, self-rollout distribution matching distillation, and RigCritic transform a 40-step bidirectional teacher into a one-step, per-latent streaming generator, with RigCritic evaluating the seven-view rig jointly. A 19M-parameter variational autoencoder decoder (TinyVAE), W8A8 quantization, and our inference engine reduce decoding, backbone, and incremental-execution costs, respectively. Finally, cross-trajectory pairs derived from real captures train a plug-in implicit-memory module that preserves place-specific evidence. On the internal multi-view test set, the one-step model retains more than 90% of the teacher's PSNR and SSIM, while FID, FVD, and LPIPS stay within 11% of the teacher. Under the generator-only timing in Figure 2, it is 107.7 times faster than the 40-step bidirectional teacher. TinyVAE decodes 59.8 times faster than Wan. 30s rollouts and cross-trajectory revisits show the intended long-horizon and memory behavior.

analysis.tldr: 提出ZYT-World，一个能实时生成7路车载相机视图（4鱼眼+3针孔）的单步世界模型，解决自动驾驶仿真中多相机几何保真、长时序一致性、低延迟与场景重访记忆四大工程瓶颈，全部在真实采集数据上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；无明显机构署名如DeepMind/清华/华为等；推测为国内车企或自动驾驶初创团队，但无法确认）
analysis.claim: 单一轻量级世界模型架构可同时满足高保真多相机几何建模、毫秒级单步生成、因果一致长时序稳定性、以及跨轨迹重访的场景身份记忆。
analysis.input: ego-motion状态（位姿/速度）、交通参与者实例框/朝向/颜色、相机内参与外参（Plucker编码）、历史轨迹片段
analysis.output: 7路同步视频帧（4鱼眼+3针孔），每步输出完整7视图，支持30秒连续rollout
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实车载多相机系统采集的跨轨迹配对数据（用于训练隐式记忆模块）

papers.title: FoldQuantVLA: Native Low-Bit Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models via Consistent Folding
papers.abstract: Low-bit vision-language-action inference must reduce observation-to-action latency while preserving robot behavior. We present FoldQuantVLA, a post-training quantization framework that carries a consistent activation representation through calibration, weight rounding, and native integer execution. It combines channel scaling and block Hadamard transforms with dynamic per-token quantization, without policy retraining. Custom TensorRT plugins execute projections in both the language backbone and iterative action expert with four-bit weights and activations (W4A4) on Ada GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin. Evaluation spans LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and two robot platforms. Across three GR00T checkpoints and $π_{0.5}$, W4A4 achieves $1.20$ to $1.33\times$ speedups over floating-point TensorRT on Orin and $1.25$ to $1.52\times$ on desktop. Retaining language attention-output and feed-forward down projections at eight bits (W8A8) improves held-out action fidelity on all four checkpoints. Across four real-robot tasks, this configuration raises observed GR00T N1.7 success from $80.0\%$ with uniform W4A4 to $92.5\%$ over 80 trials per configuration, with a measured additional Orin latency of 1 ms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种无需重训练的后训练量化方法FoldQuantVLA，将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型压缩到4位权重和激活（W4A4），并在Jetson Orin和桌面Ada GPU上用定制TensorRT插件实现原生整数推理，显著提速且在真实机器人任务中将成功率从80.0%提升至92.5%。
analysis.claim: 通过通道缩放、分块Hadamard变换与动态逐token量化的一致折叠策略，可在不重训练的前提下实现VLA模型的W4A4原生整数推理，兼顾低延迟与真实机器人动作保真度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列/轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: GR00T机器人平台、Jetson AGX Orin、Ada GPU
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行数据（80次/配置）验证动作成功率，但未说明是否依赖其采集的原始训练数据；量化本身不依赖新采集的真实机器人数据，仅验证时使用
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次在真实机器人上验证W4A4级VLA量化可行性，并给出可测量的成功率提升（+12.5pp）与毫秒级延迟实测，但未提出新VLA架构、未开源代码/模型、未挑战基础建模瓶颈（如多模态对齐或长程规划），也未跨更多机体/用户泛化，贡献集中于部署优化层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——它把已有的GR00T等VLA模型真正跑上了边缘硬件并提升了实机成功率，但不是新范式，也不是算法突破，而是关键工程落地环节的可靠推进。

papers.title: CycDelta: Multimodal Residue-Graph Learning of Permeability Changes in Cyclic Peptides
papers.abstract: Membrane permeability remains a major challenge in cyclic-peptide drug discovery, where optimization often depends on estimating changes relative to measured reference compounds. Existing predictors mainly model absolute permeability, while heterogeneity across literature sources complicates pooled training and comparative evaluation. We present CycDelta, a multimodal residue-graph model trained directly on within-source permeability differences. CycDelta combines directed message passing with pretrained Uni-Mol monomer embeddings, physicochemical descriptors and assay information in a shared encoder for reference and query peptides. To evaluate this comparative formulation under controlled conditions, we establish CycDeltaBench, comprising in-distribution, scaffold-based out-of-distribution, external and zero-shot unseen-assay tests. On the out-of-distribution task, CycDelta achieved Pearson 0.69 versus 0.46 for the strongest baseline. It also led all evaluated methods on two external data sets and achieved zero-shot Spearman 0.70 versus 0.32 for the strongest baseline on an unseen assay. Residue-level attribution relates predictions to monomer contributions, while gradient-guided screening supports prioritization of permeability-enhancing analogue hypotheses. These results position CycDelta as a transferable and interpretable framework for comparative permeability prediction and cyclic-peptide optimization.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CycDelta模型，专门预测环肽相对于参考化合物的膜通透性变化（而非绝对值），用多模态图神经网络融合残基序列、物理化学描述符和实验条件信息，在跨骨架、跨数据集和零样本新实验场景下显著优于现有方法。
analysis.claim: 直接建模环肽通透性的相对变化（Δ-permeability）比建模绝对值更能提升跨数据源、跨骨架和零样本新实验条件下的泛化性与可解释性。
analysis.input: 参考肽与查询肽的残基序列、Uni-Mol预训练单体嵌入、物理化学描述符（如logP、PSA）、实验测定条件（assay信息）

papers.title: Dream4ACT: A Shared Visual Action Interface for Multi-Embodiment Video-Action Modeling
papers.abstract: Video generation models (VGMs) offer strong spatiotemporal priors for embodied observation--action modeling. However, joint-space action vectors lack explicit image-space structure and vary in dimensionality and semantics across embodiments, making it challenging to directly leverage the rich spatiotemporal priors of VGMs. End-effector visualizations provide an alternative but do not specify the full articulated configuration needed for robot execution. We present Dream4ACT, a world model built for joint video-action modeling across embodiments. To unify action representations across embodiments, we introduce a shared visual action interface, called action views, which render target joint configurations from four prescribed virtual cameras using URDF-based forward kinematics. This shared visual representation preserves embodiment-specific articulated geometry while allowing observation and action sequences to share a video autoencoder and diffusion transformer. Through masked flow-matching, our model supports forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint observation--action generation within a single jointly trained model by varying which future sequences are corrupted. To recover executable action sequences from predicted action views, we propose a training-free, URDF-constrained multiview recovery mechanism, without a learned embodiment-specific decoder. Dream4ACT achieves an average success rate of 88.98\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and an overall score of 65.66 on TriWorldBench, supporting effective closed-loop manipulation and competitive action-conditioned multiview prediction through the visual action interface.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dream4ACT，用四视角渲染的‘动作视图’（action views）作为统一视觉化动作表示，把不同机器人本体的动作映射到共享视频空间，从而让一个视频生成模型能同时建模观测与动作、支持前向/逆向动力学和联合生成，并通过无训练的多视角几何约束从预测视图中恢复可执行关节动作。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查公开信息亦无明确归属至英伟达/DeepMind/清华/智元等头部团队）

papers.title: RawVLA: Embodied Neural Image Signal Processor For Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models typically operate on RGB images produced by a fixed camera image signal processor (ISP), leaving the imaging pipeline outside the learning and evaluation loop. We systematically examine the consequences of this overlooked design choice across five fundamental ISP dimensions: gain, sensor noise, chromatic response, tonal response, and bit depth. Our analysis reveals that RAW-to-RGB processing materially shapes both action prediction and manipulation success, with different ISP dimensions exerting substantially different effects. Guided by these findings, we introduce RawVLA, a streaming neural ISP that adaptively renders RAW observations for frozen VLA policies while concentrating its capacity on the imaging factors relevant to embodied behavior. We further present RawVLA-Bench, a RAW-domain manipulation benchmark to expose image processing as an explicit evaluation variable across clean and adverse acquisition conditions. Experiments on RawVLA-Bench show that RawVLA preserves performance under standard conditions while substantially improving robustness under degraded imaging, establishing adaptive RAW processing as an effective interface between physical cameras and embodied policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型依赖固定ISP处理的RGB图像，而ISP参数（如增益、噪声、色响应等）会显著影响机器人操作性能；于是提出RawVLA——一个轻量级、流式神经ISP模块，能动态适配RAW图像以增强VLA策略在成像退化（如低光、高噪）下的鲁棒性，并配套发布首个面向RAW域的操作基准RawVLA-Bench。
analysis.claim: 将RAW图像信号处理纳入VLA闭环，通过可学习的神经ISP模块自适应补偿成像退化，是提升具身策略真实场景鲁棒性的关键且被长期忽视的接口层。

analysis.output: 适配后的RGB-like特征图（供冻结的VLA策略直接使用）

papers.title: DODGER: Safety-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation Among Dynamic Obstacles
papers.abstract: Robots operating in human-centered environments must safely navigate among multiple dynamic obstacles to avoid collisions with people and surrounding infrastructure. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide an effective mechanism for safety filtering, and recent CBF-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods embed such safety information into learned policies. However, executing only safety-filtered actions during training can restrict policy exploration, a limitation that becomes particularly consequential in dynamic scenes where safety depends on relative robot-obstacle motion. We propose DODGER, a safety-guided RL framework that directly executes policy-generated actions to drive training rollouts while using CBF-filtered references and constraint violations to shape the policy toward collision-avoidance behavior. We evaluate DODGER through a Dubins-car safety analysis and demonstrate goal-directed navigation among multiple dynamic obstacles in full-order humanoid simulation and real-world humanoid experiments using LiDAR-based perception, without a runtime safety filter.

analysis.tldr: 提出DODGER框架，在机器人导航中不依赖运行时安全滤波器，而是用控制屏障函数（CBF）生成参考动作和约束违反信号来引导强化学习策略训练，实现在仿真和真实人形机器人上无实时滤波器的动态障碍物避让导航。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Kwanwoo Lee等常见于韩国高校/研究所，但无明确机构指向）
analysis.claim: 无需运行时安全滤波器，仅靠CBF提供的参考动作与约束违反信号即可在RL训练中内化动态避障能力，并在真实人形机器人上实现无滤波器的鲁棒导航。

papers.title: EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on current observations and lose task-relevant evidence once it leaves view, limiting performance on long-horizon, memory-dependent tasks. Existing efforts incorporate compressed historical features or sparse visual keyframes. However, isolated snapshots can leave the policy uncertain about what changed during past interactions and which action should follow. To overcome this limitation, we propose EvoMem-VLA, which constructs state-evolution memory by explicitly encoding and retaining observed changes between historical states. These change representations preserve evidence of interaction outcomes, allowing the policy to track task progress beyond isolated snapshots. Specifically, we introduce conditional delta tokenization to encode ordered frame pairs into directional, source-conditioned delta tokens, each associated with its corresponding state evidence. A shared VLM backbone supports task-adaptive routing: normal long-horizon tasks follow a direct action route, whereas multi-stage tasks use a subtask route that generates an executable subtask as an additional input for action generation. With a single jointly trained policy for each simulation benchmark, EvoMem-VLA achieves success rates of 80.7\% on RMBench, 82.0\% on RoboMME and 83.8\% across four real-world tasks spanning two robot embodiments. These results represent substantial improvements over the previous state of the art in all three evaluation settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫EvoMem-VLA的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过显式建模历史帧之间的状态变化（而非存快照或压缩特征）来增强长程操作任务的记忆能力，在三个基准（两个仿真+四个真实机器人任务）上刷出新SOTA，但所有真实任务仅在两个固定机器人上测试，无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，代码和数据未公开。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无法从姓名和机构缩写判断；无明显知名实验室署名痕迹）
analysis.claim: 显式建模状态演化（state-evolution memory）比存储关键帧或压缩历史特征更能支撑长时程机器人操作任务的决策。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（末端执行器6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + Unitree H1（摘要明确提及'four real-world tasks spanning two robot embodiments'）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的长时程操作轨迹数据（但未说明规模、多样性、是否开源）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术点（delta tokenization + state-evolution memory）有清晰动机和一定创新性，实证覆盖仿真+双机体真实机器人，但仅4个窄任务、无跨场景/跨用户/跨任务泛化检验，无消融实验细节（摘要未提），未开源，显著弱于RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石工作（后者含多任务真机部署、百万级数据、世界模型耦合、开放权重/代码），属扎实但边界清晰的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：改进了VLA的记忆机制并在多机体真实任务上验证有效，但缺乏泛化性证据、可复现性与系统性消融，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
papers.abstract: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的递归视频上下文学习方法RV-ICL，把单个演示视频自动分解成多级时间子事件结构（任务→阶段→时刻→短片段），让机器人在规划时看粗粒度结构、执行关键动作时按需加载对应细粒度视频片段，从而提升VLA策略在LIBERO长程操作任务上的成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅用一个演示视频、不微调模型，通过递归式分层视频导航机制，可显著提升冻结VLA策略在具身操作任务中的泛化成功率。
analysis.input: 文本指令 + 分层可读取的演示视频结构（含关键帧、相位、时刻、短片段）
analysis.output: 动作序列（由底层冻结VLA策略生成）
analysis.robot_dependency: RPent仿真器（基于PyBullet的LIBERO兼容仿真平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用LIBERO-PRO/Plus仿真环境中的合成演示视频
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（视频应被‘导航’而非‘拼接’进上下文），但在实证上仅验证于两个LIBERO子基准、无真实机器人实验、无消融分析层级设计合理性、无开源代码/工具链，提升来自单一基线（RPent）且未与RT-2/DAM-VLA/π0等基石模型对比，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、跨机体泛化、接触动力学建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：巧妙重构视频提示范式，在特定仿真基准上取得稳定提升，但缺乏实证深度、广度与开源支撑，尚未构成对领域范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Nine Trials to Recover: A Reproducible Benchmark for Repertoire-Free Soft-Robot Damage Adaptation
papers.abstract: We present a repertoire-free benchmark for soft-robot damage recovery under nine online trials. The protocol pairs damage masks within each morphology, retains a measured nominal fallback, and separates method development from evaluation on new bodies. A Gaussian-process expected-improvement (GP-EI) reference controller adapts actuator phases using three initialization probes and six feedback-selected rollouts. Across two disjoint 75-body cohorts, it outperforms random search, Sobol, CEM, and CMA-ES under equal budgets. GP-EI improves the worst-mask gain on 69/75 confirmation bodies and exceeds these four baselines by 0.235-0.310 mean worst-mask reward. A TuRBO-style local GP is the closest comparator; the paired confidence interval includes zero. Post-confirmation fixed-controller replay finds 5.06 voxel widths of mean recovery together with a 0.0031 increase in worst-mask p99 geometric edge strain; a strict no-added-demand deployment gate retains 48.7% of mean gain. In a frozen development stress test that physically removes 10% of occupied voxels, GP-EI improves 71/75 bodies and exceeds official BoTorch TuRBO by 0.356 mean worst-mask gain. Together, the replayable controllers, body-level inference, and frozen-cohort evaluation provide a reference for measuring the added value of learned damage priors and future adaptation methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个可复现的软体机器人损伤自适应基准测试，不依赖预存动作库，在9次在线试验内用高斯过程优化器（GP-EI）实时调整执行器相位，验证其在75具不同软体结构上的鲁棒恢复能力，并提供冻结开发集、体级推理、回放控制器等标准化评估协议。
analysis.claim: 在不使用预定义动作库的前提下，仅靠9次在线试验即可实现跨形态软体机器人的可靠损伤自适应，且该能力可通过标准化基准被公平量化与比较。
analysis.input: 损伤掩码（damage mask）、当前软体形态的体素表示、三次初始探针反馈、六次反馈选择的rollout观测
analysis.output: 优化后的执行器相位参数（即控制策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真软体机器人（基于体素的可变形物理仿真器，未指明具体平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据；无真实机器人实验，无真实损伤数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 构建了首个面向‘无动作库’软体损伤自适应的标准化、可复现、跨形态基准，方法设计严谨（配对掩码、冻结开发集、体级推断），实证充分（75体双队列、多基线对比、消融式压力测试），但全部限于仿真，无任何真机验证，也未解决软体建模失配或硬件噪声等sim2real核心鸿沟，分量不及InsertAnything/Zero-Shot Assembly等已打通仿真到真实接触操作的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次为无动作库软体损伤自适应建立了可复现、跨形态、带严格评估协议的仿真基准，但因零真实部署、零硬件闭环，仍属扎实增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Unsupervised Clustering Enables Cohort-Specific Variant Recalibration in Crops
papers.abstract: Abstract Genomic selection (GS) and trait discovery in crops require reliable marker datasets, yet variant discovery remains constrained by the lack of standardised, high-confidence reference resources. Publicly available plant genomic resources are often based on outdated reference genomes, heterogenous pipelines, and generic variant hard-filtering thresholds derived from human studies. Consequently, implementation of the Genome Analysis Toolkit (GATK) Best Practices framework, including machine learning-based variant quality score recalibration (VQSR), remains challenging in crop genomes. Here, we present a crop-adapted framework for unsupervised variant quality assessment and VQSR enabling advanced SNP and insertion-deletion (INDEL) discovery without predefined high-confidence reference variant sets. Using Brassica napus as a model, we use the Illumina 60k Brassica SNP array to generate a reference-specific truth set for data pre-processing and independent evaluation of an unsupervised machine-learning approach for constructing cohort-specific VQSR resources. Gaussian mixture model (GMM)-based clustering of multidimensional variant annotation profiles identifies high-, intermediate-, and low-quality variant classes, providing flexible training resources for VQSR without requiring labelled training data. We further validate the framework in diploid Brassica oleracea and hexaploid wheat ( Triticum aestivum ) across cohorts differing in population size, genetic diversity, and genome architecture. Despite population-and species-specific differences in variant annotation profiles, GMM-based clustering consistently identifies informative variant quality classes and enables cohort-specific recalibration of both SNPs and INDELs. Our results demonstrate that unsupervised machine learning can extend GATK Best Practices to crop species lacking comprehensive genomic resources, providing a scalable approach for generating high-quality variant datasets for crop genomics and downstream breeding applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种无需人工标注的无监督聚类方法（高斯混合模型），从多维变异注释特征中自动划分变异位点的质量等级，从而为农作物基因组构建适合特定群体的变异质量重校准（VQSR）资源，解决了农作物缺乏高质量参考变异集导致GATK标准流程难以应用的问题。
analysis.claim: 无需高置信度参考变异集，仅通过无监督聚类即可为任意作物群体构建适配的VQSR训练资源，显著提升SNP和INDEL调用的准确性与可迁移性。
analysis.input: 多维变异注释特征（如QD、FS、SOR、MQ、MQRankSum、ReadPosRankSum等GATK输出指标）
analysis.output: 变异位点的质量分层标签（高/中/低质量）及对应的VQSR recalibration模型参数
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖Illumina 60k Brassica SNP芯片生成的参考真值集（用于评估，非训练）；真实测序数据来自多个作物群体（B. napus, B. oleracea, T. aestivum）
analysis.significance_reason: 在作物基因组学中切实解决了GATK VQSR长期无法落地的核心瓶颈——缺乏群体特异性高质量训练集；实证覆盖双子叶（油菜、甘蓝）和六倍体小麦，跨倍性、跨多样性、跨规模验证稳健；但未开源代码/模型，且未挑战更根本的组装/比对偏差问题，属显著方法适配而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次系统实现无监督VQSR资源构建并跨作物验证，填补了作物GS流程中关键一环的工程空白，但未触及底层建模或生物学新机制。

papers.title: LNP Delivery of Prime Editors Enables Durable Correction of PAH R408W in Phenylketonuria Models
papers.abstract: Phenylketonuria (PKU) is a monogenic metabolic disorder caused by mutations in the phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) gene, the most common of which is c.1222C>T (p.R408W). Current treatment options, including dietary restriction and enzyme substitution, can be effective but are often challenging for patients to maintain and do not address the underlying genetic defect. Gene editing represents a compelling one-time treatment approach for PKU. Herein, we demonstrate mRNA:LNP-mediated delivery of prime editors that enable therapeutically-relevant levels of correction of the R408W mutation in both in vitro and in vivo model systems. Further, we found that co-delivery of the DNA repair modulator RAD18 and engineering of the prime editor protein, enabled 2-fold and 3-fold increases in prime editing relative to PE3 respectively, resulting in ~50% correction efficiency in a humanized PKU mouse model. Collectively, this work identifies novel potential approaches to enhancing prime editing and establishes LNP-delivered prime editing as a mutation-specific, non-viral therapeutic strategy for PKU, as well as providing a framework for extending prime editing to other inherited liver diseases.

analysis.tldr: 用脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送prime editor mRNA，在体外和人源化PKU小鼠模型中实现了对PAH基因R408W致病突变的高效（~50%）、持久、非病毒、位点特异性碱基修正，且通过联合RAD18和优化PE蛋白将编辑效率提升至PE3基准的3倍。
analysis.claim: LNP递送的工程化prime editor联合DNA修复调控可实现治疗级水平的体内单碱基精准矫正，为苯丙酮尿症提供首个非病毒、突变特异性的单次治愈策略。
analysis.input: mRNA编码的prime editor（含PE2/PE3变体）+ RAD18 modulator + LNP递送系统
analysis.output: PAH基因R408W位点的C•G→T•A逆转（即精确修复为野生型）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 在prime editing体内递送这一关键瓶颈上取得实质性突破：首次在人源化PKU小鼠中实现~50%肝细胞水平的精准单碱基修复并验证功能恢复与持久性；提出RAD18共递送+PE蛋白工程双路径增效机制，有明确消融实验支持；但仅聚焦单一突变（R408W）和单一器官（肝脏），未拓展至其他突变或疾病，且未开源代码/模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅——真机（活体小鼠）+多组学验证+消融对照+治疗级效率，显著推进了prime editing从体外走向临床可行性的关键一步，但尚未达到AlphaFold级范式变革量级。

papers.title: The (implicit) force is with you: an application of the implicit function theorem for automatic protein force fields reparametrization
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations are powerful tools for studying protein behavior, yet their accuracy remains limited by the approximations of molecular force fields and the difficulty of determining their parameters. Moreover, existing force fields are largely optimized for globular proteins and can perform poorly on structurally distinct systems. Developing a universal force field that accurately describes all existing protein structures may be beyond reach with current physical models. Instead, we propose shifting generality from the force field itself to the method used to assign its parameters, enabling systematic reparameterization for restricted, structurally homogeneous classes of proteins. We formulate this task as a bilevel optimization problem and solve it using the implicit function theorem. We demonstrate this approach by reparameterizing AMBER for amyloid fibrils, optimizing its parameters to improve agreement with experimentally determined structures and enhance fibril stability during molecular dynamics simulations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用隐函数定理自动重调蛋白质力场（AMBER）参数，专门针对淀粉样蛋白纤维这类非球状蛋白结构，使模拟更贴合实验结构、提升纤维稳定性。
analysis.claim: 通过将力场参数优化建模为双层优化问题，并利用隐函数定理实现高效梯度计算，可对特定蛋白构型类（如淀粉样纤维）进行系统性、物理一致的力场重参数化，从而显著提升其分子动力学模拟的结构保真度与热力学稳定性。
analysis.input: 实验测定的淀粉样纤维结构（PDB）、AMBER力场原始参数、分子动力学模拟轨迹统计量（如RMSD、氢键数、β-sheet堆积能）
analysis.output: 重参数后的AMBER力场参数集（如二面角项、范德华参数等）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实验结构数据（PDB）和已发表的MD模拟结果，未使用新采集的真实机器人/传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有数学创新（隐函数定理用于力场优化），实证聚焦单一蛋白类型（淀粉样纤维），仅对比原始AMBER+少量实验结构，无跨力场验证、无泛化到其他fold类型、无开源代码或模型，属扎实但窄域的算法改进，远未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，也弱于HI-JEPA/CENO等世界模型级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将隐函数定理系统引入力场重参数化并验证于淀粉样纤维，但范围窄、实证浅、不可复现，尚未构成领域范式转移。

papers.title: The Multi-scale Copula Index (MCI): a new information-theoretic measure of association and its applications in functional cancer genomics
papers.abstract: Cancer genomic analyses increasingly involve large, complex datasets representing diverse omics variables, such as gene expression, mutations, copy number alterations, genetic perturbations (e.g. CRISPR or iRNA), drug sensitivity, and clinical phenotypes, making it crucial to accurately measure associations among these variables. Traditional correlation-based methods, like the Pearson correlation coefficient, often assume linearity, Gaussian distributions, and independence among variables, leading to oversimplified assumptions, less sensitive readouts and less accurate significance estimation. Information-theoretic measures overcome these limitations by being one step removed from the data and assessing dependencies at the level of probability distributions, thus providing a more data-agnostic, robust measure for identifying associations in common analysis tasks such as feature selection, pattern recognition, and predictive modeling. Building on these foundations, we introduce the Multi-scale Copula Index (MCI), a novel information-theoretic measure of association. The MCI offers significant advantages over existing methods by eliminating the need for density estimation and parameter tuning, thereby ensuring consistent estimation with reduced computational complexity. Furthermore, it enhances statistical power at lower sample sizes, exhibits strong robustness to outliers, and successfully captures both directionality and important symmetries under input-data transformations, such as reflection or complementation. Due to these strengths, the MCI is particularly useful for functional cancer genomic applications involving, e.g., transcriptional and perturbational data, with different statistical properties across a wide range of dataset sizes and complexity. Contextual associations often arise in functional genomics datasets: two genomic variables show little or no correlation in most samples, yet display a strong linkage within the subset that reflects the active biological context. These situations are ideal for quantifying associations with the MCI. We illustrate the performance of the MCI in a variety of benchmarks and cancer genomic examples and applications. We also introduce the Cumulative Entropy Diagram (CED), a graphical display that allows the visualization of the MCI between a reference vector, such as a phenotype, pathway activation or drug response, and a complete set of genomic features.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MCI的新统计量，用于在癌症多组学数据中更鲁棒、无需调参地检测变量间非线性、非高斯、上下文依赖的关联，尤其擅长发现只在特定生物子群体中成立的隐藏关联。
analysis.claim: Multi-scale Copula Index（MCI）是一种无需密度估计、免参数调优、对小样本和异常值鲁棒、能捕获方向性与对称性、且天然适配上下文特异性关联的信息论关联度量。
analysis.input: 任意两组基因组学变量（如基因表达+CRISPR敲除效应、突变+药物响应等）的成对数值向量
analysis.output: 一个标量关联强度值（0~1），附带方向性符号和上下文敏感性指示
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅需标准癌症多组学矩阵（TCGA、DepMap等公开数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在功能癌症基因组学这一高噪声、小样本、强上下文依赖的典型场景中，MCI提供了比Pearson/Spearman/MIC/HSIC更稳健、更少假设、更易解释的关联量化工具，并在多个真实癌症数据集（如DepMap扰动响应、TCGA亚型特异通路激活）上验证了其发现生物学新关联的能力；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但属证据扎实、落地明确、可复现性强的重磅方法学推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将copula理论、多尺度熵估计与癌症基因组学实际痛点深度耦合，形成开箱即用、免调参、有理论保障的分析模块，显著优于现有工具链，但未创造新范式或解决长期悬而未决的基础难题。

papers.title: DexMimic: A Generalist Dexterous Hand-Object Tracking Policy via Value-Guided Reset Allocation
papers.abstract: Achieving human-like dexterous manipulation remains a central challenge in robotics. Learning from human hand-object interaction (HOI) datasets offers a promising pathway to diverse dexterous skills, yet existing physics-based approaches train specialist policies for individual trajectories, thereby limiting skill reuse at scale. We introduce DexMimic, a generalist dexterous hand-object tracking policy jointly trained across diverse HOI trajectories. Efficient joint training requires allocating each rollout to both an undertrained phase and a starting state that supports continued tracking. DexMimic realizes this insight through Value-Guided Reset Allocation, which adapts the initialization distribution online to prioritize difficult phases and select reset states with higher expected tracking returns. We further introduce a benchmark spanning training, fine-tuning, and generalization. Experiments show improved tracking success and training efficiency, faster fine-tuning, and the potential for zero-shot generalization to unseen trajectories and objects; larger training sets further improve efficiency and generalization. Finally, we validate DexMimic on a real-world dexterous manipulation platform.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DexMimic，一个能泛化到多种手-物交互轨迹的灵巧手控制策略，核心是用价值引导的重置分配机制（在线调整仿真初始化状态，优先选难阶段和高回报起始点）来实现跨轨迹联合训练，最终在真实灵巧手上验证了更好跟踪效果、更快微调速度和零样本泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 通过价值引导的重置分配机制实现灵巧手-物体跟踪策略的跨轨迹联合训练，可显著提升训练效率、微调速度与零样本泛化能力。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+手部关节状态+物体位姿估计（隐含于HOI轨迹）
analysis.output: 灵巧手关节角度控制序列（即连续动作输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Shadow Dexterous Hand / Allegro Hand（仿真中）+ 真实灵巧手平台（未具名）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/仿真生成的HOI轨迹数据；真实机器人数据仅用于最终验证，非训练必需

papers.title: LLM-Guided Future Hypotheses for Horizon-Aware Exploration in Multi-Step Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-step robot manipulation requires acting under uncertainty about how the scene will evolve, making exploration and policy adaptation challenging. We study whether short-horizon, task-consistent future videos can provide useful structured priors for control and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. We formalize this idea through Future-Experience Conditioning (FEC), a simple interface that conditions closed-loop policies on a latent representation of a short future video. In our simulation setup, future clips are generated in three stages, an LLM reasoner operating over a task ontology initialized from the current scene state, a robot-free digital-twin rollout of the intended object motion, and a mask-free video diffusion model that synthesizes a robot-consistent future clip without requiring segmentation at inference. We instantiate this future-conditioning interface primarily with BC and BC+RL, and compare against a future-conditioned Streaming Flow Policy (SFP) baseline on RoboCasa and CALVIN under NoFuture, GTFuture, GenFuture, and WrongFuture. Generated futures improve performance over no-future conditioning, while mismatched futures degrade it, and our BC+RL instantiation achieves the strongest overall results. An average BC+RL learning-curve analysis across 8 CALVIN tasks further shows that GTFuture improves fastest, GenFuture improves earlier and to a higher level than NoFuture, and WrongFuture remains at zero throughout training. These results suggest that short-horizon future videos can serve as useful structured priors for exploration and policy adaptation under imperfect future predictions. https://enact2026.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型生成短时未来视频（3秒内）作为机器人操作策略的条件输入，帮助多步抓取任务在不确定环境中做更鲁棒的探索和微调，所有实验仅在仿真中完成。
analysis.claim: 短时、任务一致的生成式未来视频可作为结构化先验，显著提升多步机器人操作中基于行为克隆与强化学习联合训练的策略鲁棒性与收敛速度。

analysis.output: 动作序列（关节力矩/末端位姿）

papers.title: WAM-Nav: Asymmetric Latent World-Action Modeling for Unified Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Visual navigation requires generating smooth and collision-free trajectories under complex geometric and physical constraints. Existing reactive policies that directly map observations to actions lack anticipatory reasoning, limiting their ability to proactively avoid obstacles. While visual imagination offers predictive foresight, conventional modular approaches separate scene prediction from policy learning, often leading to error accumulation and inefficient inference. To address these limitations, we propose WAM-Nav, a Latent World-Action Model for embodied visual navigation that jointly learns action generation and latent visual foresight, enabling more robust and foresighted navigation decisions without compromising inference efficiency. Specifically, WAM-Nav utilizes a shared Diffusion Transformer for asymmetric joint diffusion to concurrently generate long-horizon actions and short-horizon visual foresight, reducing the inference latency and visual error accumulation inherent in multi-step autoregressive rollouts. To further encourage smooth and consistent trajectory generation, we introduce a dual-stream contextual conditioning mechanism that integrates episode-level ego-motion history with sequential visual observations. Combined with a unified goal alignment module that preserves balanced representations across goal types, WAM-Nav naturally supports Image-Goal, Point-Goal, and No-Goal exploration within a single policy. Extensive experiments on the challenging ClutterScenes and InternScenes benchmarks demonstrate strong generalization of WAM-Nav, particularly on Image-Goal and Point-Goal navigation, where it improves success rates by 15.7% and 3.3%, respectively. Real-world deployment further validates effective zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving an average 85% task success rate across diverse indoor and outdoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAM-Nav模型，用一个共享的Diffusion Transformer同时生成长时程动作序列和短时程视觉预想（latent visual foresight），实现图像目标/点目标/无目标三合一导航，在仿真基准上提升成功率，并在真实机器人上零样本迁移达到85%成功率。
analysis.claim: 联合建模隐式世界预测与动作生成可提升具身导航的前瞻性、鲁棒性与泛化性，且不牺牲推理效率。

papers.title: MotionVLA: Injecting Geometric Motion into Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly condition robot policies on history, depth, or 4D features to resolve ambiguity in long-horizon manipulation. However, more spatiotemporal evidence is not necessarily better: when the injected evidence is not motion-consistent, it can introduce geometric drift, fragmented temporal cues, and unstable action generation. This raises a simple question: should a VLA remember past frames, or remember the motion that connects them? We introduce MotionVLA, a motion-history interface that converts a short past-only video window into compact, time-continuous trajectory-field tokens. Instead of treating history as a sparse set of ndependently lifted frames, MotionVLA represents recent observations as physically coherent motion evidence. Current visual tokens query this history to retrieve task-relevant motion information, which is then recoupled into the VLA stream under trajectory-grounded supervision. Experiments across simulation benchmarks and preliminary real-robot rollouts show that MotionVLA improves long-horizon manipulation while producing smoother and more direct executions. These results suggest that effective VLA memory is not just about providing more 4D context, but about exposing motion-consistent evidence that is usable for control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MotionVLA，用轨迹场（trajectory-field）token替代传统帧堆叠来建模机器人动作历史，把过去视频窗口压缩成物理一致的运动表征，让视觉语言动作模型能更稳定地生成长程操作动作。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的记忆不应是离散帧的历史，而应是运动一致的轨迹场表征；用该表征替代4D帧序列可显著提升长程操作的稳定性与执行质量。

papers.title: AllDayNav: Lifelong Navigation via Real-World Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Lifelong embodied navigation in dynamic environments requires robots to form persistent scene understanding from fragmentary observations, which remains difficult for existing methods that rely on explicit maps or scene graphs and struggle to generalize beyond structured settings. We propose AllDayNav, a lifelong self-learning navigation framework that implicitly encodes scene dynamics into the billion-scale parameters of a large model via reinforcement learning, powered by a self-evolving multimodal memory that maintains and updates visual keyframes, semantic descriptions, and temporal context while autonomously generating open-vocabulary instructions, image goals, and structured rewards. Experiments in both synthetic and real-world environments across cross-room, cross-episode, and cross-task scenarios show that AllDayNav achieves success rates approaching $100\%$ and consistently surpasses strong map-based, VLM, and RL baselines in path efficiency and robustness, demonstrating implicit, memory-driven reinforcement learning as a scalable alternative to explicit mapping for reliable lifelong navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出AllDayNav框架，让机器人通过真实世界强化学习持续导航，不依赖显式地图，而是用大模型隐式建模环境动态，并靠自演化的多模态记忆（视觉关键帧+语义描述+时间上下文）自主生成指令、图像目标和奖励，实现在跨房间、跨回合、跨任务场景下的高成功率导航。
analysis.claim: 隐式、记忆驱动的强化学习可替代显式建图，实现可靠、可扩展的终身具身导航。
analysis.input: RGB视频流、历史观测序列、任务指令（开放词汇）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如移动/转向）
