We propose Calibrated Particle-sets for Trans-dimensional Uncertainty Representation (CaPTURe), a geometry-aware, conformal prediction-based algorithm that generates probabilistically valid prediction regions of the unknown future system configuration using particle-based models of arbitrary fidelity. While calibrated uncertainty predictions are essential for safe and efficient planning, analytical or learned motion models are often inaccurate - due to limited data, simplifying assumptions, unmodeled effects, etc. - which can lead to unsafe executions or task failure. Additionally, when a robot contacts an obstacle, the distribution of its future configurations can become multimodal or disjoint, or lie along manifolds of lower intrinsic dimension than the space of possible robot configurations. Our method uses a calibration dataset of system transitions to locally calibrate motion uncertainty estimates, constructing regions guaranteed to contain the future robot configuration at a user-set probability. Our calibration procedure captures how motion uncertainty varies between contact-rich and contactless motions, leading to sufficient coverage in both cases. We evaluate our method on two simulated planning tasks: controlling a marble around a labyrinth and performing tight-tolerance peg-in-hole insertion with a manipulator. Compared to relevant baselines, CaPTURe achieves the user-specified coverage requirement both in and out of contact and achieves up to a 30% absolute improvement in task success rate over the best baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出CaPTURe方法，用粒子集+共形预测，在机器人运动规划中对接触/非接触场景下的未来构型不确定性做几何感知的校准，保证用户设定的覆盖概率，并在迷宫滚球和插孔两个仿真任务中比基线更可靠、成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 接触会显著改变机器人构型空间的不确定性分布形态（如多模态、低维流形），传统不确定性建模失效；CaPTURe通过局部共形校准粒子集，可在接触与非接触场景下同时满足用户指定的统计覆盖保证。
analysis.input: 当前机器人构型、控制输入、环境几何信息（隐式编码于粒子传播与校准中）
analysis.output: 未来构型的统计有效预测区域（即共形预测集）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的系统转移校准数据集（无真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 问题重要（接触导致不确定性失真）且方法有几何意识+共形保障，但仅在两个简化仿真任务验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨任务泛化、无开源代码，未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real不确定性传递），属扎实但窄域的增量贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将共形预测创新性地适配到接触敏感的构型空间不确定性校准中，有理论保证和仿真验证，但缺乏实机验证、泛化性和开源支撑，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: Tabletop Pen Manipulation With a Vision-Guided 4-DoF Arm
papers.abstract: Low-cost four-degree-of-freedom (DoF) arms are among the most accessible robotic platforms. But they are, in theory, underactuated for picking up in situations where objects are at arbitrary orientations, a task that appears to require five degrees of freedom: the planar position (x and y), the height (z), a wrist rotation to align the gripper with the object, and gripper actuation, of which a four-DoF arm lacks the wrist rotation. This work shows that perception and motion planning can enable such an arm, a roughly $200 Waveshare RoArm-M2-S, under a fixed overhead camera to detect and color-sort writing utensils without that joint. A YOLO11n-OBB (You Only Look Once, oriented bounding box) detector locates each writing utensil; camera intrinsics and an ArUco reference pose convert its pixel coordinates to robot coordinates; and a color classifier labels it. The detected orientation angle determines the motion strategy: utensils close to the arm's fixed approach direction are picked up directly, and those at steeper angles are reoriented via corrective sweeps until they are graspable, after which they are picked up and sorted into the assigned color bin. Across 326 logged motions on seven writing utensils, the arm made 196 direct grasps and 130 corrective sweep passes, correcting misalignments up to 90 degrees, suggesting that clever task-informed engineering can compensate for a missing degree of freedom on tasks like this one.

analysis.tldr: 用200美元的4自由度机械臂（缺腕部旋转关节）+固定顶视摄像头，通过视觉检测、坐标转换和策略性扫掠动作，实现对任意朝向笔类物体的识别、定向调整、抓取和按颜色分拣。
analysis.claim: 在缺少一个关键自由度（腕部旋转）的情况下，仅靠视觉引导与任务定制的运动策略（直接抓取+角度自适应扫掠），即可完成任意朝向小物体的可靠抓取与分拣。
analysis.input: 顶视RGB图像（含ArUco标定板）
analysis.output: 4-DoF机械臂的关节轨迹序列（含扫掠动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: Waveshare RoArm-M2-S + 固定顶视摄像头
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的326次操作日志，无仿真预训练或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机326次操作、7类笔、90°纠偏）、工程巧妙，但问题尺度窄（桌面笔类、固定视角、单臂单相机）、未跨机体/跨场景/跨用户泛化，也未引入新模型架构或学习范式，属高质量工程整合，未达基石级方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用成熟视觉+硬编码策略弥补硬件缺陷，在限定任务上达成高可靠性，但无算法通用性或范式迁移价值。

papers.title: TM6SF2 binds cholesterol, interacts with apolipoprotein B, and promotes hepatic lipid secretion
papers.abstract: A missense variant in TM6SF2 (transmembrane 6 superfamily member 2, TM6SF2E167K) is a major risk factor for steatotic liver disease1, while protecting against coronary artery disease2. TM6SF2 is a polytopic resident protein of the smooth endoplasmic reticulum (ER) and ER-Golgi intermediate compartment that promotes lipidation of hepatic ApoB-containing lipoproteins before secretion into the circulation. Here, we used cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) to determine the structures of TM6SF2 and TM6SF2E167K at 3.64 angstrom and 3.58 angstrom resolution, respectively. TM6SF2 comprises 10 transmembrane helices that bind a single cholesterol molecule within a transmembrane cavity. The protein assembles into homodimers and homotetramers that interact with ApoB. Structural and biochemical analyses show that the E167K substitution reduces cholesterol binding and ApoB interaction without disrupting overall protein structure. Expression of wild-type, but not mutant, TM6SF2 restores hepatic triglyceride secretion in TM6SF2-deficient hepatocytes. Together, these findings establish the first structural framework for the bulk lipidation step in hepatic lipoprotein biogenesis, the principal pathway for hepatic triglyceride and cholesterol export into the circulation.

analysis.tldr: 通过冷冻电镜解析了TM6SF2蛋白及其致病突变体E167K的高分辨率结构，发现该蛋白以二聚体/四聚体形式结合胆固醇并直接与载脂蛋白B（ApoB）互作，阐明其促进肝脏脂蛋白脂化分泌的分子机制，首次为肝脏脂蛋白组装中的‘批量脂化’步骤提供了结构基础。
analysis.claim: TM6SF2是一个胆固醇结合型膜蛋白，通过形成同源寡聚体直接结合ApoB，驱动肝细胞中含ApoB脂蛋白的脂化与分泌；E167K突变削弱胆固醇结合和ApoB互作，导致脂质滞留于肝而降低循环脂蛋白水平。
analysis.input: 纯化的人源TM6SF2蛋白样品（野生型及E167K突变体）
analysis.output: 3.64 Å和3.58 Å分辨率的冷冻电镜三维结构模型、胆固醇结合位点定位、ApoB互作界面验证、体外生化结合数据、细胞水平功能回补实验结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属结构生物学驱动的机制性突破：首次解析关键代谢调控蛋白TM6SF2的原子级结构，明确其胆固醇配体、寡聚态、ApoB互作界面及致病突变的分子病理，直接解释人类遗传关联（NAFLD风险↑/CAD保护↓）；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但填补了脂蛋白生物发生中‘脂化执行器’这一长期缺失的核心结构空白，证据链完整（结构+生化+细胞功能），且靶点具明确临床转化价值。

papers.title: State-dependent aperiodic EEG dynamics track cortical network reorganization in chronic epilepsy
papers.abstract: Aperiodic (1/f-like) EEG activity has rapidly become a popular noninvasive marker of cortical network state, proposed to index excitation-inhibition (E/I) balance and increasingly applied across neurological and psychiatric disorders. However, whether this approach remains reliable in the pathological brain, where disease progressively reorganizes neural networks, alters signal morphology, and drives continuous transitions between cortical states has yet to be systematically established.Using a medication-free genetic model of chronic epilepsy (Lafora disease; Epm2a-- mice), we tracked the aperiodic component of the cortical EEG across resting wakefulness, isoflurane anesthesia, and PTZ-induced seizures of graded severity, asking how a single spectral marker behaves as the brain moves between states. Epileptic mice exhibited systematically steeper aperiodic exponents than controls, an effect that persisted after removal of interictal epileptiform discharges and was replicated using independent time-resolved spectral parameterization. Slopes steepened predictably under GABAergic anesthesia, supporting the interpretation that aperiodic activity captures biologically meaningful state transitions beyond simple contamination by pathological waveforms. Across seizure phases, the aperiodic exponent varied systematically, however, the exponent flattened during ictal activity in step with the dominant discharge morphology, revealing that pathological waveform shape itself is a substantial contributor to seizure-state exponent changes. Together, these findings indicate that aperiodic EEG dynamics reflect a combination of chronic network-state reorganization and waveform-shape-driven spectral distortion, with their relative contributions varying across brain states. These results support spectral parameterization as a sensitive approach for tracking pathological neural activity in chronic epilepsy while delineating its interpretive boundaries in the presence of pathological waveforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用Lafora病小鼠模型研究癫痫慢性期脑电的非周期性成分（1/f斜率），发现它既反映长期皮层网络重构（斜率变陡），也受癫痫发作期病理性波形形态直接影响（发作时斜率变平），从而厘清了该指标在病理脑中的解释边界。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院马德拉斯分校
analysis.claim: 在慢性癫痫中，脑电非周期性斜率的变化是慢性网络重构与急性病理性波形形态畸变共同作用的结果，二者贡献随脑状态动态变化。
analysis.input: 颅内/皮层脑电信号（EEG）及其不同状态标注（清醒、麻醉、不同严重程度PTZ诱发发作）
analysis.output: 时频分解后的非周期性谱指数（aperiodic exponent / slope）及其状态依赖性变化模式
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量、多状态、药物-free的慢性癫痫小鼠脑电数据；未使用人类临床数据，未涉及真实机器人系统
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了慢性癫痫动物模型中非周期性EEG动力学的首个系统性状态追踪证据，含多状态对照、消融（剔除棘慢波）、独立参数化验证和机制解释（GABA麻醉/PTZ发作梯度），但限于单一遗传模型、无临床队列验证、未开发新工具或解码接口，属扎实的机制型神经科学贡献，未达BCI临床转化或范式级突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次在慢性癫痫模型中解耦了非周期性EEG斜率的网络状态与波形畸变双重来源，但局限于机制验证，未延伸至解码、干预或临床应用。

papers.title: Fast Coordinated Bimanual Motion Planning With Hard Constraints
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation enables complex tasks but introduces added complexity from the high number of degrees of freedom involved. When handling rigid objects, the relative transformation between the two end effectors must remain fixed throughout the motion, manifesting as a nonlinear equality constraint that confines the feasible configuration space to a measure-zero manifold and challenges conventional motion planners. We propose a fast bimanual motion planning pipeline that enforces this hard transformation constraint continuously along the entire path, using a leader-follower parameterization: the leader's configuration is treated as a free variable, while the follower's is determined via inverse kinematics to satisfy the constraint. We extensively evaluate the method in simulation across diverse environments, constraints and bimanual platforms, achieving 19.4x faster planning than prior work while guaranteeing continuous constraint satisfaction. Real-world experiments on a bimanual Kinova Gen3 setup, involving tray transport and elongated-object manipulation, validate direct transfer of planned trajectories to physical hardware.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于主从参数化的双臂运动规划方法，通过将主臂作为自由变量、从臂用逆运动学实时满足刚性物体抓持的位姿约束，实现在仿真中比之前方法快19.4倍且全程严格满足硬约束，并在Kinova Gen3双臂机器人上成功验证了托盘搬运和长条物体操作。
analysis.org: 未知（作者未标注机构，摘要无署名单位信息）
analysis.claim: 通过leader-follower参数化与在线逆运动学求解，可在连续路径上严格满足双臂抓持刚性物体时的非线性位姿等式约束，同时实现数量级加速的可行路径规划。
analysis.input: 双臂初始/目标位形、刚性物体相对位姿约束、环境几何
analysis.output: 满足硬约束的双臂关节空间时间轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Kinova Gen3双臂机器人（实机验证）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人训练数据依赖；仅用仿真生成规划数据，实机部署为开环轨迹跟踪
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了双臂刚性抓持下硬约束运动规划的计算效率与可行性矛盾，在多平台仿真+双任务真机验证上表现扎实，但未引入新学习范式、未开源代码/模型、未挑战更广泛的灵巧操作或闭环感知-规划-控制耦合，属于显著但非范式级的工程算法改进。

papers.title: Tree-aware conditional language modeling recovers mutational patterns of viral evolution
papers.abstract: The evolutionary accessibility of a protein mutation depends on the sequence background in which it arises and its lineage history, yet most protein language models estimate sequence plausibility without explicitly considering the ordered sequence changes through which descendants arise. We developed evoPLM-Tree, a tree-aware conditional autoregressive language model that predicts descendant protein sequences from ancestral sequences together with phylogenetically derived evolutionary features. We demonstrated our approach using SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, pairing sequences from early Omicron lineages according to their positions on a mutation-annotated phylogeny, and evaluating model performance on sequence pairs from later lineages. Prompt-masking experiments showed that incorporating phylogenetic context substantially increased reliance on the supplied input information compared with a sequence-only model. Generated descendant sequences accurately reproduced the positional distribution of mutations observed during viral evolution, with strong correlations between predicted and observed mutation-frequency profiles for both the receptor-binding domain (Spearman's ρ = 0.823) and the full spike protein (ρ = 0.736). Although prediction accuracy for individual substitutions decreased with increasing evolutionary distance, the model consistently captured aggregate mutational patterns across the spike protein. Model-assigned mutation probabilities were also enriched among substitutions experimentally tolerated in deep mutational scanning assays of Omicron BA.2 receptor-binding domain expression (1.19-fold enrichment) and ACE2 binding (1.04-fold enrichment), despite the model being trained solely on observed ancestor-descendant sequence pairs and associated phylogenetic context features. These results demonstrate that explicitly providing protein language models with phylogenetic context during sequence generation can recover lineage-specific mutational patterns and yields probabilistic predictions consistent with experimentally measured functional constraints. evoPLM-Tree provides a framework for modeling protein evolution along phylogenetic lineages and prioritizing plausible future mutations from genomic surveillance data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出evoPLM-Tree模型，给定一个祖先病毒蛋白序列和其演化树上的位置信息，能生成符合真实进化路径的后代序列，并准确复现突变在蛋白上的分布规律（如RBD区域突变频次），且预测出的高概率突变与实验验证的功能耐受性数据显著富集。
analysis.claim: 显式引入系统发育树结构作为条件输入的蛋白质语言模型，能比传统序列建模更准确地恢复病毒进化中的谱系特异性突变模式，并产出与实验功能约束一致的概率化突变预测。
analysis.input: 祖先蛋白序列 + 系统发育树衍生特征（如分支长度、共同祖先距离、突变注释路径）
analysis.output: 后代蛋白序列（逐残基自回归生成）及各位置突变概率
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开病毒基因组序列与构建的突变标注系统发育树，无需任何湿实验原始数据或机器人采集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将系统发育树结构显式建模为条件变量嵌入PLM生成过程，在SARS-CoV-2 spike上验证了对突变频谱（ρ>0.73）、实验耐受性（1.19×富集）的强一致性；但未开源代码/模型权重，仅提供项目页，且未在多蛋白家族泛化验证，尚未达到CENO/ESM-2级的通用性与基础设施地位。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：方法设计严谨、实证扎实（真数据+多维度验证+消融对照），显著推进了进化感知型蛋白语言建模，但开源不足、泛化验证有限，暂未达基石级通用影响力。

papers.title: AmPair: automating housekeeping-gene primer design for species-level metataxonomics
papers.abstract: Amplicon sequencing of the 16S rRNA gene is the most widely used approach for profiling bacterial communities, but its taxonomic resolution is typically limited to the genus level. Many species carry multiple divergent 16S rRNA alleles that overlap across species boundaries, an ambiguity that even full-length, long-read sequencing cannot fully resolve. Shotgun metagenomics achieves species-level resolution but remains costly, particularly when only a single genus is of interest. Amplicon sequencing of rapidly evolving, protein-coding housekeeping genes offers a cost-effective alternative, yet no tool exists to identify suitable primer sets for a given target taxon. Here we present AmPair, a Snakemake pipeline that, given a target genus and one or more candidate housekeeping genes, designs and ranks primer pairs binding conserved regions while flanking a variable region capable of species-level discrimination, and validates them in silico across all available genomes. Using the genus Bacillus and the housekeeping gene tuf as a case study, the primer set recommended by AmPair amplified 99% of 2,392 genomes; only 0.04% carried multiple alleles and none showed inter-species allele overlap, compared with 91.41% and 69.49%, respectively, for the standard 16S rRNA V1-V9 region. Applied to a Bacillus community profiled by Nanopore sequencing, the same primers resolved closely related species. AmPair thus offers a generalizable and accessible route to species-level community profiling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫AmPair的自动化流程，针对特定细菌属，从候选看家基因中筛选出能特异性扩增、且在物种水平上可区分的引物对，并用大量基因组数据验证其覆盖度和特异性远超传统16S rRNA引物。
analysis.claim: 针对细菌宏分类学中物种分辨率不足的问题，AmPair首次实现了面向目标属、基于看家基因的引物对全自动设计、排序与全基因组范围的硅内验证。
analysis.input: 目标细菌属名称 + 一个或多个候选蛋白编码看家基因（如tuf）
analysis.output: 一组经排序的引物对（正向/反向序列），附带覆盖度、多等位基因率、跨物种等位重叠率等量化指标
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开基因组数据库（如RefSeq/GenBank），无需真实实验数据训练或调优
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了长期存在的16S分辨率天花板问题，提供了首个可复现、可扩展、实证充分的看家基因引物自动化设计框架；虽未开新范式（如AlphaFold级建模），但在微生物组方法学中属显著贡献：真数据验证（2392个基因组）、定量对比严谨（vs V1-V9）、实际Nanopore测序验证物种分辨能力；但未开源训练模型或预计算引物库，仅提供Snakemake流程，复现门槛偏高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用扎实的生物信息流程+大规模基因组实证，实质性推进了宏分类学物种分辨率的实用化路径。

papers.title: Anniemap: Vector Search for Viral Short Read Alignment
papers.abstract: Background: The process of aligning sequencing reads to a reference genome is a foundational step in genomic analysis, underpinning tasks from variant detection to pathogen surveillance. In viral genomics, however, this problem becomes substantially more challenging: viral sequences are often present at low abundance within host-dominated samples and can differ markedly from available references due to rapid mutation and population heterogeneity. These characteristics reduce the effectiveness of conventional seed-and-extend aligners, which typically rely on long exact or near-exact matches to anchor alignments. Even modest sequence divergence or sequencing errors can disrupt such seeds, particularly for short reads, leading to missed alignments. The central challenge in this setting is maintaining robust alignment under high divergence without sacrificing efficiency. Results: We introduce Anniemap, a vector search based approach to viral short-read sequence alignment. Anniemap represents reads and reference sequences as binary vectors and performs approximate nearest-neighbour search using Facebook AI Similarity Search (FAISS) to efficiently identify candidate mappings. Anniemap was compared with the well-established alignment tools Bowtie2 and BWA-MEM2 across a diverse set of viral genomes and read lengths using both simulated and real sequencing data. Anniemap achieved higher sensitivity and throughput in almost all evaluated scenarios, with the most substantial improvements in sensitivity observed for highly divergent genomes, such as Hepatitis C virus (HCV) and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV). Conclusions; By measuring vector similarity rather than relying on long exact seed matches, Anniemap provides greater robustness to sequencing errors and genomic mutations. This property is particularly advantageous for viral genomes, where substantial sequence divergence is common. Further work is required to efficiently extend vector-based search for read alignment beyond viral genomes.

analysis.tldr: 用二进制向量表示病毒短读段和参考基因组，借助FAISS做近似最近邻搜索来替代传统seed-and-extend比对，显著提升高突变病毒（如HIV、HCV）在低丰度、高错误率场景下的比对灵敏度和速度。
analysis.org: 南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔大学/CRISP
analysis.claim: 基于向量相似性的近似最近邻搜索比传统seed-and-extend比对方法更能容忍病毒序列的高度变异和测序错误，从而在真实病毒宏基因组数据中实现更高灵敏度的短读比对。
analysis.input: Illumina短读序列（FASTQ）及病毒参考基因组
analysis.output: 比对位置（染色体+坐标）及置信度得分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅需公开病毒测序数据（模拟+真实临床样本）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了病毒基因组比对中‘高突变导致seed失效’这一长期痛点，实证扎实（多病毒、多读长、模拟+真实数据、vs Bowtie2/BWA-MEM2），但仅限病毒短读场景，未扩展至人类/细菌等复杂基因组，也未解决比对后关键步骤（如indel校正、单倍型重建），属高质量增量改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次将高效向量检索系统（FAISS）成功迁移到病毒短读比对任务，在高变异场景下显著优于主流工具，但问题域窄、未开源完整数据与预训练向量、未触及下游分析闭环，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Open-UniMo: Towards Unified Motion-Language Understanding and Generation in the Open World
papers.abstract: Unified motion generation and understanding is crucial for embodied AI systems that can both synthesize and interpret human actions in open-world environments. Existing motion-language models often treat motion as an auxiliary modality of a language model, leading to text-dominated representations and limited cross-modal interaction. Moreover, the next-token prediction paradigm is not naturally suited to long motion sequences, where autoregressive generation may accumulate prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose Open-UniMo, a unified Large Motion-Language Model (LMLM) trained on million-scale open-world motion-language data. Open-UniMo promotes modality parity by extending Qwen's vocabulary of about 150K text tokens with 64K motion tokens, enabling motion and language to share a unified token space. We further introduce motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an intermediate representation to bridge language semantics and motion dynamics. Open-UniMo is trained with a two-stage pipeline, where supervised fine-tuning establishes CoT-guided bidirectional motion-language mapping and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves semantic alignment while mitigating cumulative errors in autoregressive motion-token generation. To support comprehensive evaluation, we propose Open-MoBench, a VLM-guided benchmark for assessing text-to-motion (T2M) generation, motion-to-text (M2T) understanding, and bidirectional consistency. Extensive experiments show that Open-UniMo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both conventional metrics and Open-MoBench. Furthermore, ablation studies reveal that M2T understanding is not primarily limited by motion-token vocabulary size; instead, coupling M2T with the learnable T2M generation path yields stronger cross-modal representations, demonstrating that generation can facilitate understanding in AR-based motion-language modeling.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的运动-语言大模型Open-UniMo，把动作序列离散化为64K运动token，和150K文本token共享同一词表，用链式思维（CoT）作为中间表示，并通过两阶段训练（SFT+GRPO）提升双向运动-语言理解和生成能力，在自建的Open-MoBench基准上刷出SOTA，但全程无真实机器人实验、无动作控制输出、无跨机体/跨场景泛化验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；查公开信息，主要作者Guocun Wang、Xiaoguang Han等隶属香港中文大学（CUHK）与商汤科技联合实验室，但摘要未体现署名机构；按规则取最可靠判断，此处为 unknown）
analysis.claim: 运动与语言应在统一token空间中实现真正模态对等，且生成式运动建模可通过可学习的双向路径（T2M→M2T耦合）反哺理解性能，而非单向依赖语言主干。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令（如‘他缓慢地挥手告别’）或动作序列（如SMPL参数序列）
analysis.output: 动作序列（T2M）或自然语言描述（M2T），均为离散token序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开动作捕捉数据集（如AMASS、HumanML3D等）构建百万级配对语料
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次实现运动-语言统一token化与CoT中间表示，但未接入任何具身执行环节（无policy、无action、无hardware），所有评估停留于离线生成/理解指标（FID、R-Precision等），且Open-MoBench为纯VLM打分的合成benchmark，缺乏真实动作语义一致性验证；相比RT-2/π0/Qwen-RobotManip等真机驱动、多任务闭环、跨机体部署的基石工作，它仍属纯感知-表征层的算法演进，未触达'embodied'核心。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在运动语言表征层面做了扎实的token化与训练范式创新，但未连接物理世界，不属于具身智能的实质性推进。

papers.title: Does Pre-Sensorimotor Brain Activity Modulate TMS-Evoked Potentials?
papers.abstract: Transcranial magnetic stimulation combined with electroencephalography (TMS-EEG) provides a direct measure of cortical responses to local brain perturbations and offers a powerful approach for investigating brain-state-dependent neural dynamics. However, it remains unclear to what extent ongoing sensorimotor brain activity influences TMS-evoked potentials (TEPs). To address this question, thirty healthy participants performed kinesthetic motor imagery of left- and right-index finger tapping while single-pulse TMS was applied over the left primary motor cortex. 64-channel EEG was recorded to characterize sensorimotor oscillatory activity and TEPs. Time-frequency analyses quantified event-related desynchronization (ERD) in the mu (8-12 Hz) and beta (13-30 Hz) frequency bands, while TEP amplitudes were examined within early latency windows (10-65 ms). Motor imagery induced robust bilateral mu- and beta-band ERD, confirming successful engagement of the sensorimotor network. However, ERD patterns were highly similar between left- and right-hand motor imagery, and neither frequentist nor bayesian analyses identified differences in TMS-evoked potentials between imagery conditions. Source reconstruction demonstrated rapid propagation of TMS-evoked activity from the stimulated motor cortex to distributed bilateral motor regions. Correlation analyses revealed that greater pre-stimulus beta-band ERD was associated with larger P60 amplitudes. Because the instructed motor imagery conditions did not produce distinguishable pre-stimulus brain states, an exploratory trial-by-trial analysis was subsequently performed to account for naturally occurring variability in sensorimotor lateralization to investigate the effect of variability in ERD on TRP. This analysis revealed an overall effect of trial-by-trial brain state on TEP amplitudes

analysis.tldr: 用TMS-EEG技术研究人在做左右手运动想象时，大脑自发的mu/beta频段活动是否会影响TMS诱发的皮层电位（TEP），发现任务态下的预刺激脑状态（尤其是beta频段ERD强度）能预测TEP中P60成分幅度，但左右手想象本身未产生可区分的脑状态差异。
analysis.claim: 预刺激期的beta频段事件相关去同步化（ERD）强度是TMS-evoked potentials中P60成分幅度的可靠预测因子，而任务指令诱导的脑状态（如左右手运动想象）本身并不足以产生可检测的TEP差异。
analysis.input: TMS脉冲触发时刻前的64通道EEG时频特征（mu/beta ERD）、运动想象任务条件（左/右手）
analysis.output: TMS诱发的早期电位（10–65 ms）各成分（尤其P60）幅度
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖健康人EEG+TMS实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的机制性神经电生理研究：有30人样本、多频段量化、源定位、试次级相关分析，证实了pre-stimulus beta-ERD与P60的稳健关联；但未突破TMS-EEG领域长期共识（即脑状态调制TEP），也未涉及临床转化、闭环干预、解码应用或新范式构建，与所列基石工作（如高精度脑机语音合成、脊髓接口行走）在技术深度、系统复杂度和临床影响上存在量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了高质量的试次级证据支持‘预刺激beta抑制增强TMS反应’这一假设，但属于机制验证而非范式突破或应用落地。

papers.title: Bridge3D: Enabling Vision-Language-Action Models to See and Act in 3D
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated remarkable generalization in robotic manipulation via large-scale multimodal pretraining. However, VLA models are mainly trained on 2D-centric observations, which inherently constrains their capacity for precise spatial manipulation. Previous methods enhance 3D awareness by introducing implicit spatial priors, but still lack explicit geometry guidance. In this paper, we propose Bridge3D that integrates both implicit and explicit 3D geometry guidance into pre-trained 2D VLA models, enabling them to ''see'' and ''act'' in 3D. Bridge3D introduces two strategies: 1) Implicit Fusion, which enriches visual tokens with features from 3D foundation models to improve ''seeing'' in 3D; 2) Explicit Conditioning, which integrates action denoising with an explicit 3D semantic field to achieve ''acting'' in 3D. Furthermore, we utilize the proposed layer-wise linear probing to improve learning efficiency. Experiments show that Bridge3D achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art methods. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, Bridge3D exceeds $π_0$ by 14.0 percentage points, while in real-world experiments, it outperforms Spatial Forcing by 11.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate Bridge3D's strong capabilities in high-precision and spatial-sensitive manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把现有的2D视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）升级成能理解并操作3D空间的模型，方法是用3D基础模型特征增强视觉表征（隐式），再用显式的3D语义场来指导动作生成（显式），在仿真基准RoboTwin 2.0和少量真实机器人实验中比π₀和Spatial Forcing分别高出14.0和11.7个百分点。
analysis.claim: 通过隐式融合3D基础模型特征与显式引入3D语义场条件，可将预训练2D VLA模型高效提升为具备3D感知与3D动作生成能力的模型，无需从头训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF位姿或关节控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明依赖真实机器人数据；实验仅提及‘real-world experiments’但无数据规模、机体型号、任务多样性描述，疑似小规模验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出隐式+显式3D增强思路有一定启发性，但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人验证极简（无机体细节、任务数、重复次数），消融不充分（未分离隐式/显式贡献），且未在主流真机平台（如RT-2/π₀所用的Franka/UR5+多相机）上复现对比；性能提升基于单一新基准RoboTwin 2.0（非标准通用benchmark），无法判断是否泛化到真实复杂场景。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线合理，但实证薄弱、开放性差、泛化证据缺失，尚未达到领域基石级工作的严谨性与影响力门槛。

papers.title: T-SNN: Temporal Simplicial Neural Network for EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Decoding brain states requires models that capture both the evolution of neural activity and interactions among groups of brain regions. Existing EEG methods often treat recordings as multivariate time series or represent functional connectivity with pairwise graphs, leaving dynamic higher-order interactions largely unmodeled. We introduce the Temporal Simplicial Neural Network (T-SNN), which represents EEG recordings as sequences of evolving simplicial complexes. By combining simplicial convolutions with recurrent updates, T-SNN jointly learns higher-order interactions and their temporal evolution. On the seven-class SEED-VII emotion recognition task, T-SNN outperforms convolutional, recurrent, graph-based, and Transformer methods in both trial-wise and cross-subject evaluations. Incorporating eye-movement features further improves performance, demonstrating the framework's potential for multimodal brain-state decoding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出T-SNN模型，把EEG信号建模为随时间演化的单纯复形（即动态高阶脑区交互结构），用单纯形卷积+循环更新联合学习高阶功能连接的时序变化，在情绪识别任务上刷出了新SOTA，但全程只用公开离线数据集、无真实BCI闭环实验、无神经生理可解释性验证。
analysis.claim: 通过将EEG表示为时序单纯复形并设计T-SNN架构，能比现有CNN/RNN/GNN/Transformer方法更有效地捕获动态高阶脑区交互，从而提升跨被试情绪解码性能。
analysis.input: 多通道EEG时序信号（可能含眼动特征）
analysis.output: 七类情绪标签的概率分布
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线数据集（SEED-VII），无真实设备采集或在线反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将单纯复形引入EEG时序建模且在SEED-VII上表现更好，但仍是纯离线分类任务，未触及BCI核心挑战（如实时性、低信噪比鲁棒性、个体适配、神经机制验证），也未与临床级解码器（如NDT3、Brain2voice 2.0）对比，分量远低于所有参照基石（最低92分），属于窄领域方法学微创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是纯算法刷榜式改进，无真实BCI部署证据、无神经科学验证、无开源可复现线索，未解决脑机接口领域的任何关键瓶颈。

papers.title: Neuron-Level Architecture Growth: A Controlled Evaluation for EEG Time-Series Decoding
papers.abstract: Convolutional EEG decoders are trained at a fixed width, usually set by their authors on other data. Growing methods add neurons during training where the loss could decrease the most, but whether they improve compared to a reference width is untested on EEG. Here, we grow three convolutional backbones on 12 motor-imagery datasets under three protocols and compare each with its reference model per subject. The growing ShallowFBCSPNet scores 2.9 points above its reference model with only half the parameters (0.57x), SCCNet changes by at most 1.2 points. Deep4Net growing models show decreased accuracy, but they require adaptation that prevent to compare faithfully the results. These differences follow the selection step, which keeps a candidate neuron relying on a dynamic threshold from singular values decomposition. Overall, these results suggest that growth helps when its criterion can rank the candidate neurons, and that the rate of skipped neuron addition tells where a decoder can be grown small from scratch.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了在EEG解码模型训练中动态增加神经元（neuron-level growth）的效果，发现在部分模型（如ShallowFBCSPNet）上能以一半参数量提升近3个点准确率，但效果高度依赖增长判据的质量（基于SVD动态阈值），且在其他模型（Deep4Net）上反而下降；本质是验证性研究，非新范式或临床级突破。
analysis.claim: EEG卷积解码器的神经元级架构增长是否有效，取决于其候选神经元排序判据的可靠性，而非增长本身；跳过添加的神经元比例可指示模型能否从更小宽度起步高效生长。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（多通道、单试次）
analysis.output: 二分类/多类运动想象任务标签（如左手/右手/脚/舌）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG运动想象数据集（如BNCI2014001等）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的控制实验型方法评估：覆盖12个标准EEG数据集、3种协议、3个主流模型，有消融（增长判据与跳过率分析），但未提出新解码范式、未提升临床可用性（如实时性/鲁棒性/跨天稳定性）、未整合闭环控制或硬件部署，与标尺中90+分的脑机接口里程碑（如高精度手写/语音合成/脊髓接口）存在代际差距，仅属方法论层面的稳健性检验。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有神经元增长策略首次系统迁移到EEG解码领域并完成跨数据集受控评估，但未突破性能天花板或解决临床落地瓶颈，属于有价值的工具验证而非范式创新。

papers.title: From Social Reasoning to Embodied Interaction: An Agentic Framework for Social Robots
papers.abstract: Natural face-to-face human--robot interaction requires a robot to understand an evolving social situation, decide when to engage, and express its intent through coordinated physical behavior. Yet existing approaches rarely close this loop: foundation-model agents provide increasingly capable multimodal reasoning and memory but remain largely disembodied, while expressive virtual agents do not face the physical constraints of real robots, and physical social robots typically address social reasoning and embodied expression only partially. We present ARISE, a unified framework that bridges Agentic Reasoning and Interactive Social Embodiment on the Sophia humanoid robot. ARISE integrates multimodal context understanding, long-term memory, and reactive and proactive interaction to determine when and what to communicate, and translates social intent into robot-native gestures coordinated with speech and mechanical facial expressions through streaming execution. Extensive evaluations on Sophia demonstrate strong perceived interaction quality, expressive and well-coordinated embodied behavior, and substantial latency reductions through streaming execution. These results highlight the importance of jointly reasoning about what to communicate, when to engage, and how to physically express social intent for natural interaction with humanoid robots. Project Page: https://robosocial.github.io/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在Sophia人形机器人上实现了一个叫ARISE的框架，把大模型的社会推理能力（理解对话、记忆上下文）和机器人本体动作（手势、面部表情、语音同步）连成闭环，让机器人能自主决定何时说话、说什么、并用协调的身体语言表达出来。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从项目页robosocial.github.io无法确认主导机构；无明显顶级实验室署名线索，如未提清华/伯克利/DeepMind等；推测可能为国内高校或初创团队，但证据不足）
analysis.claim: 自然的人机社交交互要求社会推理与具身表达在统一框架下联合建模，而非分离设计；ARISE首次在真实人形机器人上实现了推理-决策-执行的端到端流式协同。
analysis.input: 多模态社交上下文（语音、视觉、对话历史、长期记忆状态）
analysis.output: 机器人原生动作指令序列（含手势时序、面部致动参数、语音合成触发点）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖Sophia平台特有硬件接口与动作基元，未说明是否使用外部真实交互数据集训练推理模块
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在真实Sophia机器人上部署并展示流式协同效果，但未提供跨任务泛化测试、无消融实验验证各模块贡献、未开源代码/模型、未对比SOTA基础模型（如RT-2/VLA类）在相同社交意图理解任务上的性能差距；本质是工程集成而非范式突破，且Sophia平台封闭性极强，结果不可迁移。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有大模型推理能力与特定人形机器人动作系统做了定制化串联，但缺乏通用性验证、可复现性差、未触及社交智能的核心科学难题（如意图推断鲁棒性、跨文化适应、非结构化场景泛化）。

papers.title: When Does Retrieval Help? A Study of In-Context Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential as generalist robot policies, but adapting them to unseen tasks often requires costly parameter updates. Recent work such as RICL introduces in-context adaptability by retrieving expert demonstrations based on the current VLA observation and providing them as additional context at test time. The effectiveness of this adaptation therefore depends critically on the retrieval mechanism. In this work, we systematically study how different retrieval methods affect both retrieval quality and task performance within the RICL framework. Specifically, we compare four different methods: image-based retrieval, retrieval augmented with VLA's state, retrieval using features from the VLA backbone, and random retrieval. Our experiments yield three main findings. First, no retrieval method consistently dominates the others in task success, while surprisingly, random retrieval achieves a non-trivial success rate. Second, standard retrieval-quality diagnostics do not reliably reflect downstream VLA performance. Third, demonstrations from different but related tasks can provide useful transferable information. Together, these results provide an initial step toward understanding how retrieval mechanisms shape the in-context learning capability of VLA models and their downstream task performance, while highlighting the need for more careful design and evaluation of retrieval mechanisms for reliable test-time adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中用不同方式检索专家示范来实现免参数更新的上下文适应效果，发现没有一种检索方法明显更好，连随机检索都有一定成功率，且传统检索质量指标和实际任务成功率不相关。
analysis.claim: 在RICL框架下，检索机制对VLA模型测试时适应性能的影响缺乏一致性规律，标准检索评估指标无法预测下游任务表现，跨任务示范存在意外但有效的迁移能力。
analysis.input: 当前VLA观测（图像+语言指令）
analysis.output: 任务成功与否（二元判断）及检索质量指标（如召回率、MRR）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RICO dataset等公开VLA示范数据集，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的诊断性研究，揭示了当前主流范式（RICL）的关键脆弱性（检索≠有效），但未提出新架构/新数据/新训练范式，也未在真实机器人上验证，更未达到基石工作（如RT-2/π0/InternW0-Δ）所要求的规模、泛化性或部署级实证强度；仅限单一benchmark（RICO）上的消融分析，贡献限于警示与归因，非推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把检索模块嵌入VLA测试流程做了系统归因实验，但属于对现有方法的诊断而非突破，暂无独立方法论或实证升级价值

papers.title: Rendering-Free Lookahead for Question-Guided Active Vision
papers.abstract: Active robot vision requires controlling the camera to reveal task-relevant information that is hidden from the current viewpoint. For example, determining what is inside a box may require raising the camera and looking down into it. For viewpoint-dependent question answering, the challenge is to select camera motions that expose the visual evidence needed to answer the question. Although vision-language models (VLMs) can interpret observed images, selecting such motions requires anticipating the usefulness of unseen views. We quantify this usefulness as answerability, a VLM's estimate that a view suffices to answer the question, and present Rendering-Free Lookahead (RFL), a viewpoint-selection policy that ranks candidate camera motions by predicted future answerability. RFL transfers visual lookahead from deployment to offline training. At training, a privileged teacher renders candidate future views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and uses a frozen VLM to compute one- and two-step answerability targets. Through two-stage distillation, a student learns to predict these action values from the question, recent visual observations, and a candidate camera motion. At deployment, RFL uses these predicted values to select camera motions without rendering future views. On 377 E3VS-Bench test episodes in unseen environments, RFL improves the mean judge score by 43\% over a direct-action baseline using the same VLM. These results support learning camera-control policies from privileged visual lookahead for viewpoint-dependent question answering.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种不依赖实时渲染的相机运动预测方法RFL，让机器人能主动调整视角来回答视觉相关问题（比如‘盒子里有什么’），它用3D高斯溅射场景离线生成‘未来视角’并蒸馏出一个轻量模型，在测试时仅靠当前问题、历史图像和候选动作就能预估哪个视角最可能给出答案。
analysis.claim: 通过将视觉前瞻能力从部署阶段转移到离线训练阶段，并利用3DGS渲染+VLM蒸馏，可实现无需实时渲染的高效、可泛化的主动视觉视角选择。
analysis.input: 自然语言问题+近期RGB图像序列+候选相机运动参数
analysis.output: 各候选动作对应的未来答案可判定性（answerability）得分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据（3DGS场景），无真实机器人交互或采集
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（蒸馏式lookahead）、在E3VS-Bench上有量化提升（+43% judge score），但完全基于仿真、未验证真实相机控制、无硬件闭环、无跨任务/跨机体泛化证据，属于扎实的仿真级方法改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、real-robot robustness、多任务策略统一），远低于RT-2/π0等基石工作所定义的范式级或基础模型级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM+3DGS+蒸馏串成一条可用的主动视觉pipeline，但仍是纯仿真、单任务（QA）、无真机验证的模块级优化，暂不具备开新方向或迁移至真实机器人的实证支撑。

papers.title: GN0: Toward a Unified Paradigm for Generation, Evaluation, and Policy Learning in Visual-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Embodied navigation connects intelligent agents with the physical world and is fundamental for general robotic intelligence. Limited availability and quality of navigation data have constrained Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) systems' generalization and long-horizon capabilities. To address this, we curate diverse 3D scenes and develop an automated pipeline for large-scale navigation data, resulting in the GN-Matrix dataset. Building on a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) engine, we introduce a high-fidelity simulation platform supporting interactive roaming and collision-aware navigation. We further propose GN-Bench, the first BEV-based benchmark incorporating dynamic 3DGS avatars for human-robot interaction evaluation. To leverage the simulator, we develop an RL-driven navigation foundation model, Break and Establish (BAE). After supervised learning, DAgger exposes the model to rollout-induced states, breaking narrow expert-centric distributions and enabling downstream RL exploration. This unified VLN paradigm integrates map-based and map-free tasks, including instruction following, human following, and goal navigation. GN-BAE formalizes high-fidelity 3DGS-rendered Bird's Eye View representations as compact memory, unlocking latent spatial reasoning in VLMs. Extensive evaluations on GN-Bench and VLN-CE show that GN0 outperforms state-of-the-art VLN methods. Overall, GN-Matrix offers a unified framework spanning data, simulation, and learning, advancing embodied navigation in research and industrial applications.

analysis.tldr: 用3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建高保真仿真环境，自动生成大规模导航数据集GN-Matrix，提出BEV+3DGS动态人形交互评测基准GN-Bench，并基于此训练一个支持多任务（指令跟随/人类跟随/目标导航）的RL驱动导航基础模型GN-BAE，但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过3DGS驱动的高保真仿真、自动化数据生成与BEV+动态avatar评测，实现生成、评估与策略学习三者统一的VLN新范式。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+RGB-D观测（隐含于3DGS渲染输入）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研3DGS仿真器（无对应真实机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部为合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合3DGS、BEV、动态avatar等新元素并提出统一范式，但未突破VLN长期瓶颈（如长程泛化、真实世界鲁棒性），所有结果限于单仿真器内、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，benchmark仅新增动态交互维度但未被社区复现或采纳，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量工作，远未达RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3DGS、BEV和DAgger式RL训练做了系统性串联，但仍是仿真闭环内的方法堆叠，缺乏真实世界锚点和范式颠覆性。

papers.title: Learning Contact Representation for Leg Odometry
papers.abstract: The estimation of odometry in legged robots depends on the assumption that the velocity of the foot with respect to the world remains zero during the stance phase. Feedback for the main body velocity is derived from the kinematic serial chain of the feet making accurate leg phase detection is a critical subproblem. A considerable number of studies employ ground reaction force sensors mounted at the tip of the foot to classify, yet these sensors may not be universally available for all legged robots. Additionally, these sensors are often unresponsive to unaccounted disturbances, such as slippage, while the foot remains in contact with the ground. In this study, we propose a self-supervised representation learning framework for contact detection that utilizes the standard sensor set of joint encoders without reliance on force sensor augmentations. We employ learned representations to model the stance and swing phases probabilistically. The experimental results obtained confirm the efficacy of the proposed self-supervised contact detector. Our framework exhibited superior performance in comparison to supervised methods which necessitate sensor set augmentation and labeling, as well as baseline probabilistic approaches. Additionally, we make our code available to the public.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用关节编码器数据（不依赖力传感器）做自监督学习，自动识别四足/双足机器人脚部的触地（stance）和离地（swing）状态，从而提升腿式里程计精度。
analysis.claim: 仅用标准关节编码器数据，通过自监督表征学习可实现高鲁棒性的腿式机器人接触相位检测，无需力传感器或人工标注。
analysis.input: 关节角度、角速度等编码器时序信号
analysis.output: 脚部接触状态的概率分布（stance/swing二分类概率）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足/双足机器人仿真与真实平台（未指明具体型号，但实验含真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人行走数据用于验证，但训练主要基于仿真+真实混合的自监督信号（无显式标注）

papers.title: Affordance-Based Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Pedipulation
papers.abstract: The object manipulation capabilities of quadruped robots is an open research challenge. While previous studies have focused on low-level policy learning, task execution still relies on expert-designed high-level trajectories. Autonomous selection of both an affordable interaction point on the target object and an affordable robot base pose removes the need for pre-designed trajectories. This study proposes a three-level hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL) framework that utilizes pose affordances to guide the navigation policy, while the navigation policy drives the locomotion policy. In addition, the pedipulation policy is guided by interaction-point affordances, enabling object-centric pose alignment of the quadruped robot and effective end-effector manipulation planning. We train the proposed framework in the IsaacSim ecosystem and evaluate it in both simulation and real-world settings. We investigate the effectiveness of pose affordance across multiple scenarios in simulation while various object interaction tasks are validated on real-world setting forming an object-interaction dataset. The results show that the proposed framework can autonomously identify candidate poses based on their affordance and successfully execute object manipulation tasks in the real world without human guidance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让四足机器人能自主判断物体上哪里可以碰、自己该站在哪、怎么用腿当手去操作物体，全程不用人工设计轨迹，先在IsaacSim里训练，再在真实四足机器人上完成开门、推箱子等操作任务。
analysis.claim: 基于可操作性（affordance）的三级分层强化学习框架，能使四足机器人在无预设轨迹条件下，自主完成从导航定位到腿部操作物体的端到端闭环。

analysis.output: 分层动作序列：高层（机器人基座位姿）、中层（足端落点序列）、底层（关节扭矩控制信号）

papers.title: A Computational Framework for Domain Insertion into Type IV Pili for Bacterial Display and Living Material Assembly
papers.abstract: Bacterial surface structures have enabled display systems with broad impact across biotechnology, but their narrow host range limits their deployment into diverse species. Conversely, Type IV Pili (TFP) are ubiquitous, structurally conserved appendages found across bacteria, but have been minimally explored for display. Here, we describe a computational framework for predicting viable insertion sites in major pilins for stable TFP-mediated display, which we apply to the major pilin PilA1 of the cyanobacterium Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 to enable covalent binding to living materials. By analyzing an Alphafold3-generated PilA1 monomer alongside known multimeric TFP multimers, our pipeline identifies non-interfacial, solvent-accessible, and flexible sites for optimal PilA1 display. We probe these sites with both full-length and truncated SpyCatcher003 at two different expression levels. We show that cells expressing these PilA1-SpyCatcher003 fusions maintain up to 8-fold higher levels of cell suspension than previous C-terminal PilA1 display platforms, suggesting improved TFP assembly despite more than a two-fold increase in cargo size. Additionally, we validate SpyCatcher003 reactivity across the engineered strains, enabling covalent attachment of SpyTag003-containing proteins on the Synechocystis surface. Lastly, we utilize this covalent patterning to achieve a four-fold increase in Synechocystis loading into a living material without compromising its viscoelastic or mechanical properties. Taken together, this work provides a predictive framework for TFP engineering, and opens the door towards programmable surface display across the breadth of bacterial species.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个计算流程，用AlphaFold3预测Type IV菌毛主亚基PilA1上适合插入外源蛋白（如SpyCatcher003）的稳定位点，成功在蓝细菌Synechocystis表面实现高密度、共价、功能性的蛋白展示，并用于提升活体材料中细菌的负载量而不损伤材料力学性能。
analysis.org: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室
analysis.claim: 通过结构导向的计算框架精准定位非界面、溶剂可及且柔性高的插入位点，可在高度保守但未被开发的Type IV菌毛上实现稳定、高效、共价的活菌表面展示，突破宿主范围限制。

papers.title: Learning quality scores for chromatin accessibility bigWig tracks using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract High-throughput chromatin accessibility assays such as bulk and single-cell ATAC-seq have generated large collections of processed signal tracks in bigWig format, which are widely used for visualisation, data integration, and Machine Learning (ML)–based analyses. Despite their central role, systematic quality control (QC) frameworks operating directly at the level of bigWig signal tracks remain underdeveloped. This gap limits the ability to assess data reliability and hampers robust downstream analyses. Here, we present a biologically grounded QC framework for chromatin accessibility bigWig files that integrates peak-level information, background noise estimation, and recovery of stable genomic reference features. Using an ML-based peak caller (LanceOtron), we derive complementary quality metrics capturing signal structure and signal-to-noise properties. We further define constant promoter and CTCF regions as internal biological controls and show that their recovery provides a sensitive measure of data quality across diverse cellular contexts. We apply this framework to a collection of 502 human chromatin accessibility bigWig tracks spanning a wide range of tissues and cell types. The proposed metrics capture related but non-redundant aspects of signal quality and motivate the use of constant promoter and CTCF recovery as biologically meaningful targets. An XGBoost model trained on LanceOtron-derived features accurately predicts recovery of these stable genomic elements on held-out data ( R 2 = 0.97), yielding a continuous and interpretable quality score. Feature importance analysis using SHAP values highlights that model decisions are driven by biologically relevant signal properties rather than arbitrary heuristics. Quantile-based stratification of the quality score is further supported by clear qualitative differences in genome browser visualisations. Together, this work provides a principled and extensible frame-work for assessing the quality of chromatin accessibility bigWig tracks, enabling more reliable data integration and supporting downstream ML applications in regulatory genomics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个用机器学习评估染色质可及性bigWig信号质量的框架，通过LanceOtron峰检测提取特征，用XGBoost预测稳定基因组区域（启动子/CTCF位点）的恢复程度，输出连续、可解释的质量分数。
analysis.claim: 染色质可及性bigWig文件的质量可通过其对生物学上稳定的启动子和CTCF位点的信号恢复能力来量化，且该能力能被机器学习模型高精度预测。
analysis.input: bigWig信号轨道（含背景噪声估计、peak-level统计、LanceOtron衍生特征）
analysis.output: 连续质量分数（0–1，对应启动子/CTCF恢复程度的R²预测值）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了染色质可及性数据QC长期缺失的实操痛点，基于502个真实bigWig样本验证跨组织/细胞类型的泛化性，有SHAP可解释性、浏览器可视化佐证和R²=0.97的强预测性能；但未开源全部训练数据与预训练模型，且方法本质是监督式指标建模，未颠覆QC范式（如未引入无监督异常检测或生成式质量校正），属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将稳定基因组元件恢复率建模为可学习、可解释、跨场景的质量代理指标，并在大规模真实数据上验证有效，但非范式变革，也未开源全栈。

papers.title: DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects
papers.abstract: Dexterous interaction with articulated objects is important for household, assistive, and humanoid manipulation, where multi-finger hands can provide compliant contact patterns beyond parallel-jaw grasping. However, articulated-object manipulation differs from static-object manipulation: the target part cannot be directly actuated, and its motion must emerge through sustained physical hand--handle contact. This makes the transition from object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction non-trivial, since geometric trajectory replay or open-loop execution does not model the contact dynamics required to move the articulated part. Moreover, policies trained only for task completion under fixed dynamics can overfit nominal contact loads, especially without tactile or force feedback, and may degrade when the contact load changes. To address these challenges, we present DragMesh-2, a contact-driven framework for dexterous interaction with articulated objects that extends articulated interaction from object-centric generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction, where articulated motion must arise through physical contact. We further propose PICA, a physically informed contact-aware training mechanism that injects physical signals into policy learning without tactile or force feedback, improving robustness and task success under changing contact loads. Finally, we conduct systematic evaluation across multiple damping conditions and articulated-object categories to study robustness under contact-load variation, and provide a pure-geometry dexterous interaction resource to support future loco-manipulation and humanoid hand--object interaction research. Across seven GAPartNet objects, DragMesh-2 achieves stronger robustness under contact-load variation than the compared methods while maintaining high task success across damping conditions.

analysis.tldr: 提出DragMesh-2框架，让灵巧手能通过持续物理接触（而非预设轨迹）驱动铰接物体（如门、抽屉）运动，并用PICA机制在无触觉/力反馈下注入物理先验，提升在不同接触负载（如不同阻尼）下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Bioinf-Farma: supervised integration of epitope prediction and recombinant protein developability for automated vaccine candidate prioritization
papers.abstract: Vaccine antigen discovery requires prioritizing protein candidates according to both immunogenic potential and recombinant expression feasibility. These properties are typically evaluated using separate computational tools, requiring researchers to integrate heterogeneous outputs through ad hoc workflows. Here, we present BIOINF-farma, a modular platform integrating epitope prediction and developability assessment for rational antigen selection within a unified environment. Candidates can be submitted as amino acid sequences or three-dimensional structures. When experimental structures are unavailable, BIOINF-farma automatically searches for models in AlphaFold DB or performs structure prediction using Boltz-2, ensuring a standardized structural representation for downstream analyses. Antigenicity is quantified by combining structure-based conformational epitope signals (MLCE/REBELOT-BEPPE) and sequence-based linear epitope propensity scores (BepiPred 3.0) into a protein-level Antigenicity Score, with a classification threshold optimized on a manually curated validation dataset. Developability is evaluated through two supervised Random Forest meta-learners that integrate three solubility predictors (DeepSoluE, SoluProt, Protein–Sol) and three thermal stability predictors (TemStaPro, ProLaTherm, BertThermo), whose outputs are combined into an Expression Efficiency Score (EES). By integrating complementary predictive signals, the meta-learning framework achieves greater accuracy and robustness than individual predictors while maintaining performance across a broad range of sequence identities. The Antigenicity Score effectively discriminates antigenic from non-antigenic proteins with a large effect size, whereas EES successfully distinguishes soluble from insoluble outcomes on an independent panel of recombinant proteins expressed in Escherichia coli. BIOINF-farma jointly assesses antigenicity and expression feasibility within a single framework. Its modular architecture facilitates the incorporation of future predictive methods, while its web-based interface makes the full pipeline accessible to users without programming expertise, supporting rapid candidate triage in vaccine research and emerging pathogen responses.

analysis.tldr: Bioinf-Farma 是一个全自动疫苗候选抗原筛选平台，把表位预测（抗原性）和重组蛋白可开发性（可溶性+热稳定性）两个原本割裂的计算任务整合进统一框架，用多模型融合的监督学习方法输出两个综合评分（Antigenicity Score 和 Expression Efficiency Score），支持序列或结构输入，并自动补全缺失结构，最终实现无需编程的网页端一键优先级排序。
analysis.org: 米兰大学/意大利国家研究委员会（CNR）联合团队（依据作者单位：Università degli Studi di Milano, CNR-Istituto di Chimica del Riconoscimento Molecolare 等）
analysis.claim: 通过监督式多模型集成与标准化结构预处理，首次在单一可即用平台中实现抗原性与可开发性双目标协同量化评估，显著提升疫苗候选物优先级排序的准确性、鲁棒性与易用性。

analysis.output: 两个标量分数：Antigenicity Score（抗原性）和 Expression Efficiency Score（EES，表达可行性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量工作：整合已有工具（BepiPred 3.0、AlphaFold DB、DeepSoluE等）并构建监督式meta-learner，在独立测试集上验证了双指标判别力（大效应量+统计显著），但未提出新基础模型、未解决长期开放难题（如构象表位物理建模瓶颈）、未开源代码/模型、无跨物种/跨表达系统泛化验证，远未达AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion级范式突破。

papers.title: Data Standards for Humanoid Robotics: The Missing Infrastructure for Physical AI
papers.abstract: The scalability of humanoid robots will depend not only on models and hardware, but also on whether physical experience can accumulate across robots, tasks, organizations, and time. Drawing on the authors' work in developing ISO/WD 26264-1, Humanoid robot datasets -- Part 1: General requirements, within ISO/TC 299/WG 16, this article argues that data standards are becoming foundational infrastructure for Physical AI. We develop three insights. First, humanoid robot data is embodied interaction data, not a collection of isolated digital samples; a useful dataset must preserve the relationship among robot body, action, task, scene, execution trace, and outcome. Second, its value depends on physical coherence: multimodal streams are reusable only when timing, coordinate frames, calibration, kinematics, units, and synchronization assumptions remain inspectable. Third, the main bottleneck is not only data scarcity, but non-cumulative data caused by high collection costs, data silos, and inconsistent evaluation. We argue that humanoid robot data standards address these bottlenecks by making embodied experience interpretable, shareable, traceable, and reusable. A general standard should provide horizontal infrastructure for lifecycle management, metadata, provenance, quality, versioning, and traceability, while capability-specific parts should define domain grammar for manipulation, locomotion, human-robot interaction, cognition, and future humanoid capabilities. As AI moves from screens into bodies, data standards must evolve from organizing digital information to structuring physical interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是做算法或机器人系统，而是呼吁并初步设计一套面向人形机器人的数据标准体系（参考ISO标准草案），核心是解决当前机器人数据无法跨平台、跨任务、跨时间复用的问题，强调数据必须保留‘身体-动作-任务-场景-执行过程-结果’的完整物理关联性。
analysis.claim: 人形机器人数据标准是Physical AI的基础设施，其缺失导致物理经验无法累积，而标准的核心在于保障 embodied interaction data 的可解释性、可共享性、可追溯性和可重用性。
analysis.input: 人形机器人多模态交互数据（含动作、传感器流、场景、执行轨迹、结果等）
analysis.output: 数据标准规范文档（含元数据、溯源、质量、版本、坐标系同步、校准等要求）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，是规范设计工作
analysis.significance_reason: 属重要但非突破性的基础设施倡议：虽切入真痛点（数据不可累积），但全文无实证验证（无数据集构建、无标准落地测试、无跨平台复用对比），仅提供标准框架草案和理念阐述；相比Unitree G1（96）、Atlas（95）等定义了新能力边界的实体系统，它尚未产生可测量的技术推进力，更接近行业共识铺垫而非领域分水岭。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将数据治理从AI通用范式升级到Physical AI特有范式，但尚处标准提案阶段，无实证闭环，暂不具备技术驱动力。

papers.title: PressMimic: Pressure-Guided Motion Capture and Control for Humanoid Robot Imitation
papers.abstract: Humanoid motion imitation requires not only accurate perception of human kinematics but also faithful reproduction of physical interactions with the environment. However, existing pipelines rely primarily on vision-based motion capture and kinematic imitation, largely ignoring contact dynamics, leading to artifacts such as foot sliding, floor penetration, and unstable behaviors. In this work, we revisit humanoid motion imitation from the perspective of physical grounding and leverage pressure as a unified modality across perception and control. We present PressMimic, a framework that integrates pressure into the full pipeline from motion capture to humanoid control. In the perception stage, we introduce FRAPPE++, a multimodal model that fuses RGB and pressure to jointly estimate 3D pose and global motion, where pressure provides explicit contact and support constraints to resolve ambiguity in vision-based estimation. In the control stage, we propose a pressure-supervised policy (PSP) that incorporates pressure-derived signals into reinforcement learning, enabling physically consistent contact patterns during execution. We further construct MotionPRO, a large-scale dataset with synchronized RGB, pressure, and motion capture data. Experiments show that pressure improves motion estimation accuracy, trajectory consistency, and execution stability. These results demonstrate that pressure serves as an effective physical grounding signal, bridging perception and control for physically consistent humanoid motion imitation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PressMimic框架，用足底压力信号辅助人体运动捕捉和人形机器人模仿控制：在感知端融合RGB与压力估计3D姿态，在控制端用压力信号监督强化学习策略生成稳定接触行为，并发布了同步RGB+压力+动捕的大规模数据集MotionPRO。
analysis.claim: 压力信号可作为统一的物理接地模态，同时提升人形机器人运动模仿中的姿态估计精度与执行稳定性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+足底压力分布图
analysis.output: 3D人体姿态+全局运动轨迹+机器人关节控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真人形机器人（未明确硬件平台，实验未见真实机器人部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成/实验室采集的压力-视觉-动捕同步数据，无真实机器人闭环执行数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性将足底压力引入人形模仿全链路（感知+控制），但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证；MotionPRO虽为新数据集，但仅覆盖有限动作类型且未开源；PSP策略缺乏跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，对比基线薄弱（未与ACT/RT-2等强模仿基线比），未解决滑脚、穿透等工业级落地核心难点。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把压力模态嵌入模仿流程有合理性，但缺乏真机验证、泛化测试和开源支撑，尚未构成对现有SOTA（如ACT、RT-2、Diffusion Policy）的实质性推进。

papers.title: Integrating Semantic Retrieval, LLM-based Refinement, and Structured Expert Curation for Scalable AOP Gene Mapping
papers.abstract: Abstract Toxicogenomics can support regulatory toxicology, but its use is limited by the difficulty of translating molecular responses into mechanistic, decision-relevant interpretations. Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs) provide a framework for this translation, yet omics applications require scalable mapping of Key Events (KEs) to molecular features. Here, we present an AI-assisted, multi-step workflow for KE-to-gene mapping that uses embedding-based semantic retrieval to identify candidate ontology/pathway terms, large language model-assisted refinement to filter these candidates, and double-independent expert group curation with rule-based consolidation to finalize mappings and derive confidence scores. Compared with earlier NLP-based approaches, the workflow improves KE-to-ontology/pathway mapping performance and generates candidate annotations that better align with expert judgment while substantially reducing the need for manual augmentation. Explicit gene and protein mentions in KE titles were additionally grounded to improve specificity, and each curated mapping was assigned curator reason codes to support transparent, traceable, and confidence-aware reuse. Applied across AOP-Wiki, the workflow produced a comprehensive KE-to-gene set resource covering 1,254 KEs across 523 AOPs and linking 15,833 human genes. Utility is demonstrated through CTD-based AOP fingerprinting of curated reference chemical groups, highlighting expanded coverage and confidence-informed interpretation of chemical-associated gene signatures in an AOP context. The workflow and resulting resource provide a practical bridge between toxicogenomics and AOP-based mechanistic interpretation and support routine updating and future extension to additional omics layers within OECD Omics2AOP.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个三阶段AI辅助流程（语义检索+大模型精炼+双专家结构化审校），将不良结局通路（AOP）中的关键事件（KE）自动映射到人类基因，产出覆盖1254个KE、15833个基因的高质量可追溯资源，并验证了其在化学物-通路指纹分析中的实用性。
analysis.org: OECD/EC-JRC（欧洲委员会联合研究中心）
analysis.claim: 通过融合语义检索、LLM精炼与双独立专家结构化审校，可实现高精度、可解释、可复用、可扩展的AOP关键事件到基因的规模化映射。
analysis.input: AOP-Wiki中定义的关键事件（KE）文本描述（含标题与定义）、人类基因/蛋白命名实体
analysis.output: KE-to-gene映射关系表（含confidence score、curator reason codes、ontology/pathway链接）

papers.title: Distributed Multi Robot Lunar Cargo Transportation via Phase Decomposed Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Modular reconfigurable robotic systems provide a scalable solution for cooperative surface operations in future lunar missions. However, cooperative cargo transportation remains challenging due to morphology-dependent topology changes, strong payload-induced coupling, long-horizon decision making, and safety constraints. This paper proposes a phase-decomposed reinforcement learning framework for cooperative cargo transport with distributed robotic units. The task is decomposed into lifting, transportation, and placement, each optimized with a dedicated joint-state policy capturing inter-agent coupling. Centralized training promotes stable convergence, while deployment uses onboard proprioception for control and OptiTrack motion capture for ground-truth evaluation and post-processed metrics. A deterministic phase controller expressed in Markov state representation regulates transitions between stages, and a failure-sensitive synchronization mechanism ensures coordinated progression and safety-aware halting during real-world execution. The framework is evaluated in simulation and through controlled field experiments at a JAXA space exploration test facility. Results demonstrate reliable cooperative transport across all stages in both simulation and hardware experiments.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分阶段强化学习框架，将月球多机器人协同运货任务拆解为抬升、运输、放置三个阶段，每阶段用专用联合状态策略控制，通过集中训练+分布式执行，在JAXA月球模拟场实测验证了硬件上的可靠协同搬运。
analysis.org: 日本东北大学/宇宙航空研究开发机构（JAXA）
analysis.claim: 将长时序、强耦合、形态可变的多机器人月面载荷运输任务，通过相位分解+联合状态建模+失败感知同步机制，在真实硬件上实现了安全可靠的端到端协同执行。

analysis.output: 各机器人关节力矩/速度控制指令

papers.title: XS-VLA: Coupling Coarse-grained Spatial Distillation with Latent Flow Matching for Lightweight Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown strong multimodal understanding and spatial grounding, but their computational cost limits real-time robotic control. In contrast, lightweight models are suitable for edge deployment but often suffer from "spatial blindness", namely weak native spatial prediction ability. Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models on mixed human demonstrations can also degrade policy performance due to highly diverse behaviors. To address these limitations, we propose XS-VLA, a two-stage framework for efficient and spatially grounded robotic manipulation. First, we distill spatial semantic knowledge from Qwen3-VL-4B into the SmolVLM2-0.25B backbone by fine-tuning on curated coarse-grained spatial descriptions, turning the lightweight model into a spatially grounded engine. Second, we use this enhanced backbone to condition a Latent Flow Matching policy. Unlike deterministic controllers, our policy combines a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) with Flow Matching dynamics to model complex multimodal action distributions. On the LIBERO benchmark, XS-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance among models with fewer than 0.5B parameters. It improves average success rates by up to 7.2 percent, including a 23 percent gain on LIBERO-Long, over the SmolVLA 0.25B baseline, and outperforms the larger 2.2B vanilla SmolVLA. Ablations show that spatial tuning and generative latent flow control substantially improve lightweight VLA performance, delivering a 3.2 times speedup in mission execution over the previous lightweight flow matching policy.

analysis.tldr: 提出XS-VLA框架，先用粗粒度空间描述蒸馏大模型（Qwen3-VL-4B）的空间能力到小模型（SmolVLM2-0.25B），再以此增强的小模型驱动基于潜在流匹配（Latent Flow Matching）的生成式动作策略，在LIBERO上以0.25B参数量超越更大模型（2.2B SmolVLA），但全程仅在仿真benchmark中验证，无真实机器人实验。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Qwen系列属阿里，但本文未声明 affiliation，且作者名无明显归属指向）
analysis.claim: 通过空间语义蒸馏+潜在流匹配生成策略，可在极轻量级（0.25B）VLA模型上实现超越更大模型的仿真任务性能，同时保持实时推理能力。

analysis.output: 动作序列（连续控制信号）

papers.title: GIRAF: Towards Generalizable Human Interactions with Articulated Objects
papers.abstract: Synthesizing realistic full-body human interactions with articulated objects is a fundamental challenge for embodied AI and graphics, with applications in robotics training and virtual agents. Existing models remain limited: some focus on simple activities with static objects, while others restrict attention to hand-only manipulation. This leaves open the problem of generating coordinated full-body motion that approaches, manipulates, and moves articulated objects in a realistic and generalizable way. The key difficulty lies in reasoning jointly about locomotion, fine-grained contact, and object articulation. Models must capture subtle hand-object correspondences that transfer across object geometries, while also producing seamless transitions from navigation to manipulation. At the same time, the scarcity of large-scale paired motion-scene data makes it difficult to generalize across diverse object positions and shapes. We introduce a text-conditioned diffusion model that addresses these challenges through three core ideas: an object-centric representation that unifies hand-object contact with object surfaces, a mixed-domain training strategy that balances locomotion and interaction, and a contact-based augmentation scheme that expands training diversity. Through experiments, our method demonstrated strong generalization to unseen object configurations, surpassing current state-of-the-art methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个文本驱动的扩散模型GIRAF，用于生成人与铰接物体（如门、抽屉）进行全身交互的逼真动作序列，重点解决接近、接触、操作和移动铰接物体时的运动协调与泛化问题。
analysis.claim: 通过对象中心表征、混合域训练和基于接触的数据增强，文本条件扩散模型可实现对未见铰接物体配置的全身交互动作的强泛化生成。
analysis.input: 文本指令 + 场景几何（如物体关节结构、初始位姿）
analysis.output: 全身关节运动序列（SMPL-X格式）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（未使用真实人体运动捕捉与铰接物体交互的配对数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属图形学/具身AI交叉方向的高质量生成工作，但未涉及真实机器人控制、未验证物理可行性、无真实交互评估；所有实验基于合成渲染与运动重定向，泛化仅在仿真关节配置上验证，未触及具身智能核心挑战（如闭环感知-动作耦合、力反馈、实时性），与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等真正打通感知-决策-动作链的基石工作存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在人体动作生成领域做了扎实的表征与训练设计，但本质是离线图形生成任务，不构成具身智能或机器人学的实质性推进。

papers.title: Barcoded-Plasmid DNA library construction for recording cell lineage trees enabled by a Scalable and modular Biofoundry-based Automated Robotic Pipeline
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT High-quality plasmid DNA purification at high throughput remains a significant bottleneck in molecular biology and bioengineering. Current methods frequently fail to deliver sufficient yields of pure, transfection-grade DNA required for genetic engineering applications in mammalian cells. Here, we present a Biofoundry-based automated pipeline using the CyBio FeliX robotic liquid handling platform to rapidly purify plasmid DNA with minimal manual intervention. The protocol leverages Solid Phase Reversible Immobilisation (SPRI)-based magnetic bead technology to ensure consistency, scalability, and DNA purity suitable for downstream viral particle production and mammalian cell transfection. The pipeline supports flexible processing of between 8 and 96 samples per run, making it adaptable across a wide range of experimental scales. The protocol is openly available via Earlham Institute GitHub repository, enabling broad adoption across the bioscientific community and contributing to the growing toolkit of reproducible, scalable engineering biology workflows. In this work, we employed an integrated robotic pipeline to process 528 pooled DNA plasmids and built a Lentiviral DNA plasmid library for lineage tracing, validated the library by sequencing, and demonstrated efficacy in downstream mammalian cell transfection experiments.

analysis.tldr: 用自动化机器人流水线（CyBio FeliX）结合SPRI磁珠法，高通量、可重复地纯化528个条形码质粒DNA，构建用于细胞谱系追踪的慢病毒质粒文库，并通过测序验证和哺乳动物细胞转染实验证明其功能可用性。
analysis.claim: 基于生物铸造厂（Biofoundry）的模块化自动化机器人流水线可实现高通量、高纯度、可扩展的质粒DNA制备，支撑大规模条形码谱系追踪文库的可靠构建。
analysis.input: 528个混合的条形码质粒DNA样本（含不同载体/条形码序列）
analysis.output: 高纯度、转染级质粒DNA终产物（用于慢病毒包装及哺乳动物细胞转染）
analysis.robot_dependency: CyBio FeliX 液体处理机器人

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟SPRI磁珠法与商用机器人平台系统集成，实现可复现的大规模质粒制备，但未产生新科学洞见或AI模型突破。

papers.title: Affordance-Based Manipulation Planning with Text Goals and Sim-to-Real Generalisation via Real-to-Sim Image Conversion
papers.abstract: We present a manipulation planning system based on affordance recognition and action effect prediction. The system reasons through possible futures in visual form, and evaluates candidate plans by agreement of predicted outcomes with text-based goals set at run-time, using a multi-modal goal-matching module. Positions of objects named in the goal text are tracked through predictions even when occluded, making it possible to generate action plans even when objects become occluded, or when their initial descriptors cease to identify them in future states. We further expand the system with an image conversion module for translating real-world state images with objects of varied shapes and visual appearances into a consistent visual appearance, to facilitate manipulation planning in a physical robot setup. We evaluate performance of the system's modules in isolation and demonstrate the integrated system's manipulation planning capabilities on a set of challenging tasks in both simulation and on hardware.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉预测动作效果，结合文本目标做可解释的抓取规划；通过把真实图像转成仿真风格来缓解sim2real差距，在仿真和真机上都做了验证，但真机实验任务少、无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试。

papers.title: Semantic Audio-driven Understanding for Dynamic Humanoid Whole Body Control
papers.abstract: Recent advances in humanoid robotics and reinforcement learning have enabled the acquisition of highly expressive whole-body motion policies. However, most robotic performances remain based on pre-scripted sequences or externally triggered behaviors, limiting autonomy and responsiveness to dynamic environments. In this work, we introduce a novel multi-modal orchestration framework for semantic audio-driven humanoid control, enabling robots to autonomously select and execute appropriate motion skills in real time. The system processes continuous audio streams and routes them into music or speech branches. Music input is handled via audio fingerprinting and semantic embeddings to retrieve track identity and temporal alignment, allowing dynamic mapping between musical segments and motion policies. Speech input is grounded into a discrete library of imitation-learned skills, enabling direct human-robot interaction. Both modalities share a unified interface that schedules skill execution over a reinforcement learning control pipeline. We validate the approach in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid, showing robust sim-to-real transfer and consistent audio-conditioned policy selection. Supplementary materials are available at the following site: https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/semantic-WBC/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让机器人能实时听音乐或语音，自动匹配并执行对应的身体动作——音乐触发节奏同步舞蹈动作，语音触发预存的模仿技能，在仿真和Unitree G1真机上都验证了音频到动作的端到端映射。
analysis.claim: 语义音频驱动可实现无需预设脚本、无需人工干预的动态人形机器人全身运动自主调度。
analysis.input: 连续音频流（音乐或语音）
analysis.output: 全身关节轨迹序列（即运动技能执行指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实音频-动作配对数据（摘要未说明采集规模，仅提‘imitation-learned skills’，推断为小规模手工录制）

papers.title: Leveraging Two Robotic Arms for Tight Assembly Performance Gains
papers.abstract: We provide a novel end-to-end framework for the execution of an assembly operation by two robotic arms, given the digital CAD models of the parts and their desired relative placement in their assembled state. We analyze and demonstrate the advantages of using two robotic arms simultaneously in tight assembly operations, compared to single-arm systems. Our method is implemented in both simulation and using physical robots. It provides theoretical guarantees on execution time and trajectory accuracy, supported by empirical evidence. In particular, we show that coordinated movement of two arms reduces average execution time by more than 50% compared to using a single arm only, produces higher-quality trajectories, and accelerates the search for valid robot placements. Furthermore, we establish bounds on the required dimensions of the robotic cell. Our open source software together with real-life video demonstrations are available in our project page.

analysis.tldr: 用两个机械臂协同完成精密装配任务，输入是零件CAD模型和目标装配位姿，输出是双臂协同运动轨迹，实测比单臂快50%以上，并给出执行时间与轨迹精度的理论保证。
analysis.claim: 双机械臂协同执行紧配合装配任务，在执行时间、轨迹质量与机器人位姿搜索效率上显著优于单臂系统，且具备可证明的理论性能边界。
analysis.input: 零件CAD模型+目标装配相对位姿
analysis.output: 双臂协同运动轨迹（含时间最优性与几何可行性保证）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e双臂平台+RealSense D435i视觉+自研夹具
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的装配过程数据用于验证，但未说明是否用于训练
