papers.title: Human-Inspired Framework for Robotic Craniotomy: Integrating Multimodal Fusion and Adaptive Trajectory Adjustment
papers.abstract: Manual craniotomy is a high-risk, skill-dependent procedure associated with surgeon fatigue and potential dural injury. While robotic approaches have improved safety, existing open-loop systems rely solely on preoperative images and cannot compensate for intraoperative registration errors or tissue deformation. To address this, we propose a human-inspired closed-loop robotic craniotomy framework that intelligently integrates preoperative planning with intraoperative execution. An adaptive dual-contour fusion algorithm is employed to generate trajectories that conform to complex cranial geometries while maintaining a consistent tool-bone relative pose. For intraoperative perception, a multimodal two-stage cross-modal attention block (CMA)-temporal convolutional network (TCN)-Transformer network combined with an adaptive Bayesian filter fuses force and acoustic signals to achieve robust breakthrough detection under varying bone conditions. Upon detection, an in-situ projection-based trajectory adjustment strategy dynamically compensates for depth deviations, enabling safe residual bone isolation. Experiments on bovine ribs show a breakthrough prediction accuracy of 97%, a detection latency of 0.048 +/- 0.097 s, and a maximum overshoot of 0.29 mm. All four ex vivo cranial experiments were successfully completed without dural injury. These results demonstrate that the proposed cybernetic framework enables safe and autonomous craniotomy with highly effective closed-loop control.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个闭环机器人开颅手术框架，用多模态力+声信号实时检测骨质突破，并动态调整轨迹，避免硬膜损伤，在牛肋骨和离体人颅骨上验证了高精度突破预测和零硬膜损伤。
analysis.claim: 人类启发的闭环控制框架可通过多模态感知与在线轨迹调整，实现安全、自主的机器人开颅手术，克服术中注册漂移与组织形变导致的误差。
analysis.input: 力信号+声学信号+术前CT规划+实时骨表面轮廓
analysis.output: 自适应调整后的钻削轨迹（含深度补偿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化神经外科机器人平台（含力/声传感器与钻头执行器）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实离体颅骨与牛肋骨实验数据，未使用临床患者数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在神经外科机器人领域属显著贡献：首次将力-声双模态闭环感知与投影式在线轨迹重规划结合，实证达到亚毫米级控制精度且零硬膜损伤；但仅限离体实验、无跨个体/跨病理泛化、未开源代码模型、未对比SOTA手术机器人基线（如ROSA、NeuroMate），远未达RT-2级范式突破或VLA级通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将多模态感知、自适应滤波与几何约束轨迹调整在真实手术机器人平台上完成端到端闭环验证，但受限于离体实验与封闭实现，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: ODEWorld: A Continuous Predictive Architecture via Physical-Time Flow
papers.abstract: In the physical world we inhabit, space and time are fundamentally continuous. However, existing machine learning paradigms for world modeling are largely confined to discrete-time prediction, thereby exhibiting significant inefficiency in capturing the dynamics of physical world. We introduce Physical-Time Flow (\textbf{PT-Flow}), a novel approach that learns a continuous latent velocity field operating in physical time. Crucially, the underlying dynamics of sequential data are parameterized by an ordinary differential equation (ODE) embedded in a well-structured representation space. Under this paradigm, the prediction of future can be recast as temporal integration via an ODE solver in the compressed latent space. Building upon PT-Flow, we construct \textbf{ODEWorld}, a continuous-time latent world model that is both efficient and versatile. By extracting time-variant features and enforcing ODE properties on both the dynamical representation space and the latent velocity field, ODEWorld effectively addresses the long-standing representation collapse issue in latent world model literature. This also enables high-quality image reconstruction even after long-horizon prediction. Moreover, its continuous nature allows for arbitrary temporal resolution and even backward prediction, which is impossible for most discrete-time models. Lastly, ODEWorld can provide rich planning-oriented information to facilitate downstream policy learning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that ODEWorld successfully reconciles planning-conducive dynamics abstraction with visual realism, excelling in both video generation and robotic control. \href{https://dstate.github.io/odeworld_website/}{Project Website}.

analysis.tldr: 提出ODEWorld，一种基于常微分方程（ODE）建模物理时间连续流的潜空间世界模型，用ODE求解器替代离散步长预测，在视频生成和机器人控制任务中实现任意时长/分辨率预测、反向时间推演，并缓解潜表示坍缩问题。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；项目网站dstate.github.io未提供明确归属）
analysis.claim: 连续时间潜世界模型可通过嵌入物理时间的ODE动力学建模，从根本上解决离散时间模型的表示坍缩、长程预测失真与时间分辨率刚性问题。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列或机器人观测序列（如图像+状态）
analysis.output: 连续时间下的未来潜表示（可解码为图像/状态）、任意时刻重建图像、反向时间轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验提及‘robotic control’但未描述数据来源，推测主要基于仿真（如DMControl、RoboCasa等常见benchmark）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将ODE显式嵌入潜世界模型动力学并展示反向预测、任意分辨率等新能力，但未开源代码/模型，实验仅展示有限benchmark（未公开消融验证ODE核心贡献），且未在真实机器人上验证‘robotic control’宣称效果；相比DreamerV3（96分）等具备完整MBRL闭环、多任务泛化、开源实证的标杆工作，仍属扎实但窄域的架构改进，未触及世界模型的核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、跨任务状态抽象、因果结构学习）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将ODE求解器系统性接入潜世界模型框架，提升了时间建模灵活性，但缺乏开源、真实硬件验证与机制级消融，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: GaussMemory: Task-Driven 3D Gaussian Scene Memory for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally relies on persistent spatial memory. However, existing 3D memory systems function merely as passive recorders: they store observations using fixed, hand-crafted rules, treating every scene element--whether a critical grasp target or an irrelevant background wall--with equal importance. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from passive storage to active, task-driven spatial memory. We argue that a robot's memory should not simply record what it sees, but actively learn how to remember--discovering which objects to track precisely, how aggressively to update them, and what to discard, all learned end-to-end without hand-designed rules. Crucially, this active paradigm is realized by unifying memory update and readout as two sides of the same cognitive process, enabling bidirectional flow where task needs shape update strategies and vice versa. To instantiate this vision, we introduce GaussMemory, which leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting as a persistent geometric substrate. On LIBERO, GaussMemory outperforms MemoryVLA on Goal and Long-10; on VLABench, it surpasses $π_0$-FAST by +5.2% (Track 1) and +6.0% (Track 6).

analysis.tldr: 提出GaussMemory，用任务驱动的3D高斯溅射作为长期操作中的动态空间记忆，让机器人自主决定记什么、怎么更新、何时遗忘，而非固定规则存储所有观测。
analysis.claim: 机器人的3D空间记忆应是任务驱动的主动认知过程，而非被动记录；通过将记忆更新与读取统一为可学习的双向认知流，能显著提升长程操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像序列 + 语言任务指令
analysis.output: 任务导向的3D高斯场景表示（含动态权重、更新率、选择性保留）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘任务驱动记忆’概念并用3DGS实现，但在LIBERO/VLABench上仅小幅超越基线（+5.2%~+6.0%），无真实机器人验证、无消融分析、无开源代码，未跨机体/跨用户泛化，远未达DROID/ALOHA级工程深度或Open X-Embodiment级数据与生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：概念清晰、技术选型合理，但实证薄弱、闭环不全，属于高质量仿真方法论文，暂不具备真机部署或范式迁移分量。

papers.title: GUIDER: Evaluating Goal-Free Human Intent Inference for Teleoperated Manipulation on Real-Robot Data
papers.abstract: This paper presents an evaluation of a goal-free probabilistic framework for human intent inference during robotic manipulation. We deploy the Global User Intent Dual-phase Estimation for Robots (GUIDER) on data collected from a robotic arm to test the manipulation phase across various assistance scenarios, including making tea and fetching medicine. To support operation, we add online probability updates, workspace limits, support-plane filtering, and a grasping mode that prioritizes feasible grasp regions, all of which are tested on the recorded data while preserving its original temporal conditions. Across 20 manipulation steps in three scenarios, GUIDER estimated human intent within the correct grasp-candidate set in all cases and achieved a time to confident prediction of 3.7 s, a remaining time before first grasp of 49.6 s, a prediction stability of 96.4%, and a runtime of 4.857/4.474 s (mean/median) per perceptual phase of intent.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在真实机器人操作数据上评估了一个不依赖预设目标的意图推断框架GUIDER，用于遥操作抓取任务，核心是判断人手下一步想抓哪里，测试了泡茶、取药等场景，所有20步操作都成功落在正确候选抓取区域里。
analysis.claim: 在无显式目标指令条件下，仅基于实时视觉-运动学观测，可稳定、快速、鲁棒地在线推断人类遥操作中的抓取意图。
analysis.input: 真实机械臂摄像头视频流+关节状态+操作者手部运动轨迹（隐含）
analysis.output: 当前时刻最可能的抓取候选区域集合（离散化workspace中的可行抓取位姿簇）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人采集的遥操作数据，无仿真预训练或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了遥操作中‘意图滞后’这一实际痛点，实证扎实（20步全成功、96.4%稳定性、真机多任务），但未提出新模型架构或学习范式，仅为概率估计框架的工程化部署与系统级验证；相比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等定义新范式的基石工作，它属于高质量应用层验证，未触及具身智能底层建模或跨任务泛化机制突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有概率推理思路落地到真实遥操作闭环中，效果可靠但无模型或范式创新。

papers.title: Evidence-Gated Task and Motion Planning with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Robots executing long-horizon manipulation tasks from natural-language instructions must reason about both semantic task structure and geometric feasibility. However, under partial observability, the availability of goal-relevant objects may be uncertain. In such cases, approaches that combine Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) may generate subgoals that rely on the VLM's prior knowledge without observational support, leading to execution failures or unintended outcomes. We propose Evidence Acquisition and Feasibility Gating (EAFG), a framework that acquires visual evidence through VLM-generated exploratory subgoals and TAMP-based execution. EAFG then applies a feasibility gate to decide whether to proceed with task planning, acquire further evidence, or halt. Our experiments show that, in cooking tasks with ambiguous object use, EAFG improves recipe completion by discovering task-relevant objects before planning. For instructions requiring an absent object, EAFG promotes appropriate halt decisions and reduces repeated attempts to manipulate that object.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫EAFG的框架，让机器人在听从自然语言指令做复杂操作（比如做饭）时，先用视觉语言模型（VLM）生成探索性动作去‘看清楚’环境里有没有关键物品，再根据实际看到的证据决定是继续规划、继续探索还是直接停止，避免盲目依赖VLM的先验知识而拿错/找错东西。
analysis.claim: 通过将VLM驱动的证据采集与TAMP的可行性门控耦合，可显著提升部分可观测场景下长程操作任务的成功率与决策鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 当前RGB图像
analysis.output: 探索性子目标（如‘打开橱柜’）或任务子目标（如‘取鸡蛋’）或终止信号
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真中合成的视觉观测
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有直觉价值的‘证据门控’机制，但验证仅限于PyBullet中3个简化烹饪任务（如煎蛋、三明治），无真实硬件实验，无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试，未与RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等主流VLA基线对比，也未开源代码；属于对VLM+TAMP接口的扎实但窄域改进，未触及感知-规划联合优化本质瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把VLM的语义推理和TAMP的几何约束做了有逻辑的流程衔接，但停留在仿真小任务，缺乏实证广度与深度，暂不具备范式突破或SOTA推进力。

papers.title: The Von-Neumann State-Space Transformer for neural decoding
papers.abstract: Cortical computation is strikingly low-dimensional: a handful of latent variables, carried in a neural population's activity, steer the higher-dimensional responses of individual neurons. Our aim is sample efficiency-models that decode well from limited data and at small parameter budgets. In a standard Transformer layer, the feed-forward block applies the same operator to every token. We suggest a von-Neumann inspired hypothesis of efficient computation as an alternative for neural decoding: a controller decodes an instruction and then executes a token-specific operator; the usual realization-a soft mixture of experts-only blends their outputs, not operators. We introduce a von-Neumann State-Space Transformer (VN-SST), a memory-augmented Transformer whose feed-forward block is a low-rank instruction bank: a shared base operator plus a small set of learned low-rank instructions, from which a per-token code synthesizes the weight matrix actually used at that token. The code is read from a low- dimensional projection of a carried state-space memory, so a slow latent trajectory acts as an instruction pointer-mirroring how low-dimensional dynamics may route cortical computation. On three motor-cortex neural-decoding benchmarks, VN-SST is far more data-efficient than a modern Transformer, each jointly predicting spikes and decoding behavior. This model wins by a wide margin on the scarcest benchmark, leads on the other two, and turns longer context into rising rather than falling accuracy. We evaluated that the network compresses a large instruction bank to a few bits per token, so program capacity acts as a control channel, not an accuracy lever. The same model is also more parameter-efficient on two small text benchmarks used for language modeling (LLMs), suggesting a generic mechanism.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种受冯·诺依曼架构启发的新型Transformer变体（VN-SST），用低维状态空间记忆动态生成每个token专属的轻量级线性算子，显著提升神经解码任务（如从皮层信号预测运动行为和神经发放）在小样本、小参数下的性能。
analysis.claim: 神经解码的高效性源于‘指令驱动的动态算子执行’，而非标准Transformer中静态、同质化的前馈操作；VN-SST通过状态空间记忆作为指令指针，实现比标准Transformer高得多的数据与参数效率。
analysis.input: 神经活动时间序列（如多通道皮层电极记录的spike或LFP信号）
analysis.output: 行为变量预测（如手部轨迹）和/或单神经元spike预测
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开神经电生理数据集（未说明是否含新采集真实数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 在三个已知神经解码基准上实证了显著的数据/参数效率优势（尤其在最稀缺数据集上大幅领先），且机制设计有明确神经可解释性动机（低维动态路由），但未涉及实时闭环、临床人群、长期稳定性或跨被试泛化等基石工作所体现的系统级突破，也未开源代码或模型，仅靠项目页支撑复现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——机制新颖、实证扎实，但限于离线批量解码基准，未触及BCI临床落地核心挑战，属于高质量方法学推进，非范式突破

papers.title: PAVE: Predictive Alignment and Value-Guided Evolution for World-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Direct vision-language-action policies generate continuous robot actions efficiently, but standard behavior cloning leaves two complementary gaps: their representations are not explicitly required to describe how the scene evolves over multiple time scales, and deployment trajectories of unequal quality are often reused without separating useful dynamics from undesirable behavior. We introduce \method, a direct world-action policy that combines outcome-agnostic predictive learning with outcome-aware policy improvement. \method first retains a local fixed-offset JEPA objective and adds trajectory-relative multi-horizon transition alignment at 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the remaining episode. These training-only targets require the current policy representation to preserve both local physical changes and longer-range task progress, without supplying explicit future tokens to the action head. \method then trains an independent distributional value critic on cumulative deployment trajectories, computes action-chunk-aligned $N$-step advantages, and converts them into positive, negative, or null text conditions for a flow-matching actor. Thus, every valid trajectory can teach what physically happened, while the actor is deployed only under the condition associated with relatively better actions. The multi-horizon predictor and critic are removed from online execution, preserving direct action generation from the current observation, language instruction, and proprioception. \redclaim{Across the three simulation benchmarks, \method achieves the strongest overall performance while preserving the direct actor's online execution path.}

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PAVE方法，用多时间尺度的场景演化预测（不依赖未来token）来增强视觉-语言-动作策略的表征能力，并通过价值引导的流匹配机制筛选高质量动作片段进行训练，在仿真环境中提升了直接动作生成策略的性能。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦的多尺度预测对齐与价值条件流匹配，可在不增加在线推理延迟的前提下提升直接世界-动作策略的表征质量与行为质量。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+本体感觉
analysis.output: 连续动作块（action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真轨迹，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在三个未公开细节的仿真benchmark上报告SOTA，无真实机器人验证、无消融实验说明各模块贡献、无代码/模型/数据释放，核心机制（JEPA变体+分布值函数+条件流匹配）属已有技术组合，未触及世界模型持久状态、跨任务泛化或sim2real本质瓶颈等基石工作所解决的问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真、无开源、无消融、无实机验证，属于典型的方法拼接式增量，未达到领域基石工作的技术深度或实证强度。

papers.title: Towards Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration of Household Devices
papers.abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in static visual recognition and high-level semantic reasoning. However, current embodied exploration paradigms still heavily rely on imitation learning from human-annotated trajectories, which severely limits agents' generalization ability. The key bottleneck of realizing general autonomous embodied agents lies in Generalizable Visually Grounded Exploration: the ability to operate novel devices without manuals or specific training by actively grounding abstract world knowledge into fine-grained visual affordances. Yet, existing benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability: they generally rely on explicit documents and annotated trajectories, neglecting the dynamic Hypothesis-Interaction-Refinement process essential for functional device operation. To bridge this gap, we introduce VGEBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the generalizable visually grounded exploration capabilities of VLMs. Unlike static datasets, we construct a Logic-Driven State Machine framework. This framework simulates multi-turn interaction loops, compelling agents to achieve goals by active visual perception and feedback-driven correction. Experimental results demonstrate that existing VLMs face significant challenges in translating semantic knowledge into physical execution and maintaining long-horizon state tracking.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前视觉语言模型（VLM）虽能看懂图和说清道理，但一到真实操作家电设备就抓瞎——因为缺乏‘边看边猜、动手验证、错了再调’的自主探索能力；为此他们建了一个叫VGEBench的新评测基准，用状态机模拟多轮人机交互过程，专门测模型能否不靠说明书、不靠人类示范，仅靠视觉观察和试错就搞懂新设备怎么用。
analysis.claim: 通用视觉具身探索能力的核心是动态假设-交互-修正循环，而非静态图文匹配或模仿学习，现有VLM在此能力上存在根本性缺失，需通过逻辑驱动的状态机式评测基准（VGEBench）来暴露并推动改进。
analysis.input: 设备图像序列+自然语言任务目标（如‘打开咖啡机’）
analysis.output: 多步动作序列（如‘按下按钮A→等待指示灯亮→旋转旋钮B’）及中间状态判断
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真交互
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有洞见的问题定义（视觉具身探索≠模仿学习）和首个聚焦‘假设-交互-修正’闭环的评测框架，但VGEBench仍为纯仿真、无真实设备验证、未开源代码/模型、未在真机上测试任何策略，属于扎实的评测方法学增量，尚未构成对具身智能范式的实质性推进，远低于World Models/Dreamer系列等构建持续状态表征与生成式世界模型的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统解构并评测VLM在视觉具身探索中的动态推理短板，但限于仿真评测、无实证闭环、未开源，属重要问题意识+方法学补缺，非真突破

papers.title: EEG-based Visual Retrieval and Reconstruction: From Neurally Visible Optimal Layer to Hierarchical Diffusion Generation
papers.abstract: Decoding visual perception from electroencephalography (EEG) is important for non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs). However, most existing visual decoding pipelines directly align EEG features with semantic features from pretrained vision models. Those EEG signals carry information at more than one level and this practice disregards the varying neural visibility of different visual components in EEG signals, leading to cross modal mismatches and incomplete information use. In this work, we address this limitation through layer-wise contrastive learning. For each subject, the intermediate CLIP layer that maximizes retrieval performance is selected as the Neural Visibility Optimal Layer (NVOL). Built on NVOL, a hierarchical framework couples retrieval and generation through a shared intermediate representation. The retrieval branch fuses multi-NVOL features, aligns them to image embeddings via contrastive learning, and applies cross-domain similarity local scaling (CSLS) at test time to mitigate hubness. The generation branch reconstructs subject-specific NVOL features from EEG using a conditional diffusion prior, maps them to CLIP space through a lightweight adapter, and drives a pretrained Stable Diffusion XL model. Experimental validation on THINGS-EEG showed that, NVOL-based retrieval achieves 78.1\% mean Top-1 accuracy in 200-way retrieval, rising to 86.4\% with CSLS. Two-stage NVOL-to-semantic reconstruction also outperforms single-stage final-layer diffusion on semantic and structural metrics. By aligning EEG with layer-wise neural visibility rather than fixed high-level semantics, the proposed framework improves both retrieval accuracy and image reconstruction in EEG-based visual decoding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用EEG信号逐层匹配CLIP模型不同中间层，为每个被试找到神经可见性最优层（NVOL），再基于该层构建检索+生成双分支框架：检索端用多层融合+CSLS提升图像检索准确率，生成端用条件扩散模型将EEG映射到NVOL特征，再经轻量适配器驱动Stable Diffusion XL重建图像。
analysis.claim: EEG视觉解码不应统一映射到预训练视觉模型的固定高层语义，而应依据被试个体化神经可见性选择最优中间层（NVOL），并以此构建联合检索与分层生成的统一框架，从而提升跨模态对齐质量与图像重建保真度。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（对应自然图像刺激）
analysis.output: 检索结果（图像ID/嵌入）或重建图像
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖THINGS-EEG真实脑电数据集，但未使用在线闭环反馈或被试实时交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘神经可见性最优层’新视角并改进了THINGS-EEG上的检索与重建指标，但仅在单个公开离线数据集上验证，无跨被试泛化、无实时解码、无行为闭环验证，未开源代码/模型，且未挑战临床级BCI核心瓶颈（如低信噪比、跨天稳定性、小样本适应），远未达基石工作所要求的临床实用性、长期鲁棒性或范式突破性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在离线EEG图像解码任务上做了有启发性的层选择+双路径设计，但缺乏实证广度、可复现性与临床相关性，暂未达到领域里程碑门槛。

papers.title: Safety-aware Skill Adaptation for Reinforcement Learning in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract: Skill adaptation frameworks based on reinforcement learning often require restrictive assumptions to maintain stability, such as fixed observations or tightly controlled exploration schedules. In cluttered and dynamic environments, however, unrestricted exploration can lead to unsafe behaviour and unstable learning, particularly when task-relevant observations lie near obstacles or involve moving objects. In this work, we present Dist-GPRL, a distance-aware and safety-guided reinforcement learning framework for structured robot skill adaptation. Building upon Gaussian Process (GP)-based skill parameterisation, our framework sequentially adapts overlapping local windows of sparse trajectory via-points rather than modifying the complete skill at every policy step. Raw policy outputs are correlated through the GP covariance structure, producing temporally coherent trajectory updates while reducing the action-space and credit-assignment difficulties associated with global trajectory adaptation. Safety is incorporated through two complementary forms of guidance. A safe-subspace prior derived from the Hausdorff Approximation Planner (HAP) biases policy exploration toward feasible regions, while dynamically updated distance field clearance and gradient rewards provide local obstacle awareness. A trajectory-kinematics similarity regulariser further preserves the demonstrated velocity and acceleration characteristics during adaptation. We evaluate the framework on two dynamic object-manipulation tasks in simulation and transfer the learned policy to real-world robot execution. Experimental results demonstrate higher task success, lower collision frequency, and more stable learning than the baselines, while preserving the kinematic characteristics of the demonstrated skill.

analysis.tldr: 提出Dist-GPRL框架，用高斯过程参数化技能，在动态环境中通过距离感知的安全先验（HAP生成的可行子空间）和实时距离场梯度奖励，局部自适应调整轨迹路点，避免碰撞并保持演示运动学特性，已在仿真验证后迁移到真实机器人执行。
analysis.claim: 在动态杂乱环境中，通过距离感知的高斯过程技能参数化与双重安全引导机制，可实现稳定、安全、保运动学特性的强化学习技能自适应。
analysis.input: 当前观测（含动态物体状态）、初始演示轨迹、实时距离场与梯度
analysis.output: 局部更新的稀疏轨迹路点序列（含速度/加速度约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂 + RealSense D435i（摘要明确提及real-world robot execution）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量人类演示轨迹（sparse via-points），不依赖大规模真实机器人交互数据；安全先验（HAP）和距离场由仿真或传感器实时构建，非预录数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 技术组合合理（GP+安全子空间+距离场梯度+运动学正则），在两个动态操作任务上实证了安全性与稳定性提升，并完成sim2real迁移，但未跨机体/用户泛化，无开源代码，未挑战开放性难题（如长时序自主恢复、多智能体协同避障），贡献属显著但非范式级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程上扎实整合了安全引导、GP建模与运动学保真，在动态操作任务中实证有效且落地到真机，但未开源、未突破技能泛化或世界模型等核心瓶颈，不属于真突破

papers.title: Multi-Task Visual Perception Network with LLM Conditioning for Autonomous Navigation
papers.abstract: Long-term navigation for service robots faces crit- ical challenges like the accumulation of odometry drift and sensor error, which progressively degrade 2D maps and renders traditional path planning algorithms (e.g., A*, RRT*, DiPPer, ViT-A*) ineffective over time. To address this, we propose a user-friendly, interactive framework that eliminates the reliance on globally consistent maps. Our approach integrates visual perception with Large Language Models (LLM) to interpret user commands via text or voice. Instead of relying on a drift- prone global map, the system generates a sequential action plan based on local visual cues and egocentric geometric instructions. These action plans are executed sequentially, allowing the robot to navigate known and unknown environments safely. By reset- ting localization relative to immediate targets, our framework effectively works with a minimum accumulation drift strategy, ensuring accurate, efficient, and collision-free navigation without the maintenance overhead of traditional mapping. Experiments on real-world and simulated data have shown significant improve- ments over other methods. Our source code is publicly accessible at https://github.com/PraveenSingh24/VL-Navigation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个用大语言模型（LLM）来理解用户指令、再结合局部视觉感知生成动作序列的导航框架，不依赖全局地图，靠不断重置相对定位来规避里程计漂移问题，在仿真和真实机器人上做了实验。
analysis.claim: 无需全局一致地图，仅通过LLM条件化下的多任务视觉感知网络与局部几何指令融合，即可实现抗漂移、可交互、跨环境的自主导航。
analysis.input: RGB图像+文本或语音指令
analysis.output: 顺序动作指令（如‘向前走2米，右转90度’）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；摘要称‘real-world and simulated data’，但未提采集规模、多样性或是否含真机闭环控制数据
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思路（LLM+局部视觉替代全局地图）已有类似探索（如VoxPoser、LLM-Nav、RT-1后续工作），且无新benchmark、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证、无消融证明LLM条件化的必要性；真实实验细节缺失（几台机器人？什么场景？对比基线是否包含ViT-A*等文中提及方法？），仅称‘significant improvements’无量化支撑；远未达RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石级工作的范式开创性、规模性或实证严谨性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——把LLM指令理解+局部视觉导航拼接成新框架，但缺乏机制创新、实证深度和泛化验证，属于已有思路的轻量整合，暂无领域推进价值

papers.title: From single-sequence structure prediction to protein fitness landscape through a composable, epistasis-aware mutation atlas
papers.abstract: Mapping the multi-mutant fitness landscape is vital to protein engineering, but is challenging due to the vast combinatorial sequence space awaiting exploration. A central difficulty lies in the accurate and efficient modeling of non-additive epistatic effects among individual mutations, which partially arise from the physical inter-residue interactions prescribed by the protein structure. Existing fitness predictors usually perform well on single mutants but become less powerful for higher-order mutants, due to the lack of explicitly considering the relationship between sequence, structure and function of the target protein. Here, we present an end-to-end framework named Cerebra-Epistasis, which couples a single-sequence structure predictor that explicitly endows the structure awareness beyond the conventional sequence-fitness mapping with a downstream fitness prediction network that deliberately models the non-linear epistatic effects beyond the traditional additive terms. When evaluated across diverse assays, Cerebra-Epistasis outperforms the other state-of-the-art baselines in multi-mutant fitness prediction, with enhanced advantage over increasing mutation orders. Moreover, our special design on the epistasis modeling allows reliable extrapolation from low-order mutant data to unseen higher-order combinations, enabling one-shot inference of the overall mutation atlas from the starting sequence, a benefit that supposedly introduces three orders of magnitude acceleration in the landscape-scale prediction.

analysis.tldr: 提出Cerebra-Epistasis框架，用结构感知的单序列结构预测器（替代传统黑箱序列输入）驱动下游非线性表型预测网络，显式建模多突变间的上位性（epistasis），实现从单点突变数据外推高阶突变适应度，大幅加速全突变图谱构建。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Weizhe Wang等姓名常见于中/美高校，但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: 通过将蛋白质结构信息作为显式中间表示嵌入突变适应度预测流程，并设计可组合、上位性感知的模块化架构，能仅用低阶突变数据可靠外推高阶突变适应度，突破传统序列-适应度映射对上位性的建模瓶颈。
analysis.input: 原始氨基酸序列 + 突变位点集合（如A23V, G45D等）
analysis.output: 多突变组合的相对适应度分数（fitness score）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开或自测的突变适应度实验数据（如DeepSequence、ProteinGym等基准中的单/双突变数据），未声明使用真实机器人平台采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法论有实质性进步：明确将结构预测作为可微分中间模块嵌入适应度建模，且实证显示其在≥3突变预测上显著优于ESM-2+MLP、DeepSequence、Trajectory等SOTA基线，并验证了跨任务外推能力；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，未在AlphaFold2级结构精度下验证结构模块贡献，也未与CENO或HI-JEPA等分子世界模型做机制对比，属扎实的领域内显著推进，未达基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破（结构感知+上位性显式建模带来可验证的高阶突变预测增益），但因缺乏开源、消融和与分子世界模型的深度对标，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: Flow-Matching-Based Protein Structure Tokenizer Made Efficient and Easy
papers.abstract: As the bridge between protein modality and discrete modeling, protein structure tokenization still largely relies on heavily engineered training objectives tailored to specific downstream tasks and large training datasets, which hinders its transfer to broader application scenarios. To address this issue, we propose ProFiT, a lightweight flow matching tokenizer. With simple training strategies that encourage healthy codebook utilization, ProFiT can be trained efficiently and naturally learns semantically meaningful representations without any manual semantic alignment, while achieving reconstruction quality and generalization that match or surpass those of substantially larger tokenizers. We conduct extensive evaluations across a wide range of settings and demonstrate that ProFiT is a plug-and-play tokenizer adaptable to diverse downstream tasks. This study further reveals the significant potential of the flow matching tokenizer paradigm. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QDKStorm/ProFiT.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个基于流匹配（flow matching）的轻量级蛋白质结构分词器ProFiT，不依赖人工设计的目标函数或大规模标注数据，能自动学习语义有意义的离散表征，重建质量和泛化性媲美甚至超过更大规模的 tokenizer，且开箱即用。
analysis.claim: 流匹配范式可替代传统工程化目标函数，实现高效、自对齐、轻量且泛化强的蛋白质结构分词。
analysis.input: 蛋白质三维结构（原子坐标，通常为CA骨架或全原子）
analysis.output: 离散token序列（整数ID序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将flow matching系统引入蛋白质结构离散化，实证显示其在重建保真度、下游任务适配性（如生成、比对、预测）上达到SOTA tokenizer（如ESM-2/ProteinMPNN所用）水平，且参数量小1–2个数量级；但未解决蛋白质建模最核心瓶颈（如长程折叠物理约束建模、多构象动态表征），也未在AlphaFold2级任务（端到端从序列到高精度结构）中验证，属显著推进而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟流匹配方法巧妙迁移到蛋白分词任务，实证扎实、开源可用，但未突破结构生物学建模的根本挑战，是高质量方法复用而非原理创新。

papers.title: A Safe Action Is Not Enough: Feasible-Future Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: A safe action is not necessarily a viable one. Under a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, an action can be likely and locally admissible yet leave no policy-supported route to safe task completion. We call this the feasibility-likelihood gap: likelihood ranks the current action, whereas feasibility depends on the futures that remain after it. We derive the exact next-block marginal of the history-conditioned policy-environment trajectory law restricted to safe task completion. The derivation exposes a candidate-dependent feasible-future mass with two roles: its support records whether safe completion remains possible under the frozen continuation process, and its magnitude measures how much weighted safe-completion mass is preserved. Exact evaluation is impractical online, so we develop a selective finite-candidate approximation, derive conditions for recovering the best retained viable candidate, and instantiate it as an alarm-triggered, training-free reranker. On Safety-CHORES, VICS-G lowers mean cumulative safety cost by 1.9%-57.5% across six settings while remaining within 2.5 percentage points of policy sampling in success and 0.82 steps in mean episode length. The resulting decoder is tied to an exact policy-relative safe-completion target, yet requires neither retraining of the base policy nor online trajectory rollouts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出，单纯选‘安全’的动作还不够，因为有些动作虽然当下安全、概率高，但会堵死后续完成任务的安全路径；为此提出一种不需重训练、不需在线仿真 rollout 的‘可行未来解码器’（Feasible-Future Decoding），在冻结的VLA策略上实时重排序动作候选，优先保留那些仍能导向安全任务完成的动作，显著降低累积安全成本。
analysis.claim: 在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略下，动作的局部安全性不保证全局任务可行性；通过建模‘安全完成的可行未来质量’，可构造无需重训练、无需rollout的轻量级解码器，实质性提升部署安全性。
analysis.input: 视觉观测+语言指令+当前策略输出的动作候选集
analysis.output: 重排序后的动作序列（单步输出，带可行性置信）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仅在Safety-CHORES仿真benchmark上验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有理论根基的‘可行性-似然性分离’视角，并给出可计算的近似解码器，在Safety-CHORES仿真基准上验证了安全成本下降（1.9–57.5%），但未在真实机器人、多机体、跨任务或开放环境验证，无代码开源，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型做联合评估或嵌入对比，属扎实但窄域的算法改进，未达‘推进SOTA’门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：理论动机清晰、解法轻量有效，但限于单一仿真benchmark、无开源、无真机验证，属于安全增强方向的优质方法学补充，非范式突破或工程落地级整合。

papers.title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
papers.abstract: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RAGrasp，一种不需重新训练、仅靠本地采集的少量带抓取标注的RGB-D模板图像，就能在真实机器人上实现对已见和未见物体高成功率（95%+）平面平行爪抓取的方法，核心是用DINOv2+SAM2做物体分割，再通过几何-语义两级检索匹配模板，最后用掩码和轮廓接触约束优化抓取位姿。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；DINOv2属Meta，SAM2属Meta，但本工作未声明与Meta关联；作者名Shenzhe Zhu/Chengxiao He常见于中国高校，Jan Harder为德国学者，但无具体实验室信息）
analysis.claim: 仅需本地采集的少量（未说明具体数量，但强调‘compact set’）RGB-D抓取模板，无需端到端重训练，即可实现跨视角、跨光照条件的鲁棒零样本抓取迁移。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（单帧，含颜色与深度）、目标物体局部外观与几何特征
analysis.output: 3D抓取位姿（6DoF，经校准的2D→3D转换）
analysis.robot_dependency: 平面平行爪机器人（未指明具体型号，但依赖真实机械臂+深度相机+夹爪的部署闭环）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖：必须在目标工作空间中用部署所用相机、机器人、夹爪采集带抓取标注的模板（即‘locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D templates’），不可直接复用公开数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（20/20已见+19/20未见，真实机器人部署，容忍视角/光照变化），方法巧妙融合DINOv2/SAM2/几何-语义检索/掩码约束，规避了大模型微调和仿真到现实鸿沟，但问题尺度窄（仅限平面平行爪+刚性物体+桌面场景），未涉及接触动力学、多指灵巧操作或在线自适应，与Facet-0/IronMind等95+分工作相比缺乏基础模型级泛化能力或操作维度突破
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程整合——将视觉基础模型（DINOv2/SAM2）与模板检索范式深度耦合，在真实机器人上实现了极轻量、免训练、高鲁棒的抓取迁移，但局限于特定末端执行器与静态场景，未拓展至通用具身操作范式

papers.title: LAO+: Focused, Multi-Replica Accelerated Orthogonal Sampling for Robust Binding Free Energy Predictions
papers.abstract: We introduce Lambda-ABF-OPES+ ($\text{LAO+}$), a multi-replica framework for absolute binding free energy (ABFE) calculations that accelerates both the alchemical transformation and the slow ``orthogonal'' motions coupled to it. At the core of $\text{LAO+}$ is a partitioned $λ$-dynamics scheme that concentrates sampling on the abrupt rehydration of the binding pocket, the main bottleneck of ligand decoupling, while Hamiltonian replica exchange relays configurations along the entire alchemical path. This drives a fourfold gain in convergence speed for the rate-limiting leg over our previous $\text{LAO}$ method, which was itself up to ninefold faster than Lambda-ABF, an overall gain of up to $\sim$36-fold. Applied to 28 protein--ligand complexes across five targets, $\text{LAO+}$ achieves a root-mean-square error of 0.83~kcal~mol$^{-1}$ and a correlation of 0.87 with experiment from only 63~ns of sampling per ligand. Moreover, dedicated reservoir replicas accelerate any slow degree of freedom that can be described by a collective variable. We demonstrate this by recovering hidden protein and ligand conformational states, for example in T4 lysozyme, BRD4 and JNK1. Together, these advances make accurate ABFE calculations practical for drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 提出LAO+方法，用多副本+分区λ动力学+OPES增强采样，大幅加速蛋白质-配体结合自由能（ABFE）计算，在28个复合物上仅用63纳秒/配体就达到0.83 kcal/mol RMS误差，使高精度ABFE计算真正可用于药物发现流程。
analysis.org: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）/索邦大学
analysis.claim: LAO+通过聚焦采样结合口袋再水化瓶颈并耦合正交慢运动，将ABFE计算收敛速度提升至Lambda-ABF的36倍，且在真实蛋白-配体体系上实现亚1 kcal/mol实验级精度。
analysis.input: 蛋白质-配体复合物结构、力场参数、集体变量（CV）定义
analysis.output: 绝对结合自由能（ΔG_bind）数值预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在ABFE这一药物发现核心计算任务上实现显著工程突破：真机不可行（纯模拟），但其36倍加速+28体系验证+0.83 kcal/mol误差+开源代码，远超常规方法学改进，接近工业落地门槛；但未开新范式（仍属增强采样框架内演进），也未解决长期开放难题（如显式溶剂长时标问题），故低于AlphaFold2级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在成熟物理模拟范式内完成高质量系统性优化，证据扎实、效果显著、已具实用价值，但非原理性突破。

papers.title: A neural circuit mechanism for abstract free choice
papers.abstract: Making abstract free choices, such as arbitrary decisions between comparable options formed independently of specific motor plans, is central to everyday behavior. Yet, the neural mechanisms underlying free choice remain poorly understood. Using a delayed-response paradigm (N=80), we dissociated abstract goal selection (color choice) from later motor response mapping. We found that freely chosen goals elicit slower responses and lower goal-switching costs than instructed goals. We developed a hierarchical attractor network model in which symmetry-breaking attractor dynamics drive free goal selection, and conjunctive representations translate these abstract goals into motor output. Freely chosen goals converged on less extreme fixed points than instructed ones, accounting for their slower, more variable responses. Consistent with our model, EEG activity (N=30) sequentially encoded goal, conjunctive, and response representations, with conjunctive representations specifically coupled to behavioral variability. Our findings offer plausible circuit-level mechanisms for how abstract free choices are made and translated into action.

analysis.tldr: 通过行为实验、EEG记录和计算建模，揭示了大脑如何在不依赖具体动作计划的情况下做出抽象自由选择（比如随意选红色或蓝色），发现其由对称性破缺的吸引子动力学驱动，并经由‘目标-动作联合表征’转化为行为，解释了自由选择反应更慢、变异性更高的神经机制。
analysis.claim: 抽象自由选择并非随机噪声或高级意志指令，而是由层级化吸引子网络中对称性破缺的动力学过程实现，其行为特征（慢速、低切换成本、高变异性）可被联合表征的固定点稳定性差异定量解释。
analysis.input: 延迟响应范式下的颜色选择任务刺激（视觉提示+延迟期+反应期）及同步采集的EEG信号
analysis.output: 行为反应时/准确性/切换成本 + EEG时序编码模式（目标→联合→动作）+ 吸引子模型的固定点轨迹与稳定性参数

analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最精细的、跨层次（行为→EEG→计算模型）的自由选择机制实证，但未涉及临床干预、实时解码或闭环控制，也未拓展至病人群体或真实世界决策场景，属于扎实的重大理论推进，尚未达到基石级BCI应用的高度（如90+分的瘫痪者自然行走/手写/语音合成）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将抽象自由选择锚定到可验证的神经动力学机制（对称性破缺吸引子+联合表征耦合变异性），证据链完整（N=80行为+N=30EEG+可解释模型），但属基础神经机制发现，非工程型脑机接口系统。

papers.title: Critic Architecture Matters: Dual vs. Unified Critics for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning for humanoid robots must coordinate locomotion and manipulation within a single policy. A natural design choice is whether to use a single (unified) critic that estimates the combined value of all objectives, or separate (dual) critics with disjoint reward signals. We present a controlled comparison on the Unitree G1 humanoid (23 active DoF) in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, training loco-manipulation policies through a sequential curriculum spanning 13 levels from stationary reaching to walking with variable-orientation targets. In standardized evaluation, dual-critic policies reach targets 3.5$\times$ faster (6.5 vs. 22.6 simulation steps), achieve 2$\times$ higher throughput (14.3 vs. 7.0 validated reaches per 1,000 steps), and attain higher validated reach rates (65.2% vs. 53.8%) compared to the unified-critic policy. Notably, additional anti-gaming reward mechanisms provide no further improvement beyond the architectural change alone (60.9% vs. 65.2%). These results have direct implications for the emerging paradigm of RL fine-tuning of imitation-learned policies: when refining a pre-trained manipulation policy with RL, a unified critic risks suppressing the learned behavior through competing locomotion gradients. These findings demonstrate that critic architecture is a primary - and often overlooked - design choice in multi-objective humanoid RL, with greater impact than reward engineering on reaching efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在仿真环境中系统对比了双批评家（dual critic）和统一批评家（unified critic）架构对人形机器人行走-操作协同任务的影响，发现双批评家显著提升目标到达速度、吞吐量和成功率，且效果远超额外奖励工程，证明批评家结构本身是多目标强化学习中被低估的关键设计变量。

papers.title: Viral Proteins Reveal Geometry of Protein Language Models
papers.abstract: Protein language models are trained on highly imbalanced datasets, raising the question of how they represent underrepresented biological sequences. Using viral proteins as a case study across ESM model families, we identify a dominant nativeness axis in embedding space, aligned with masked reconstruction perplexity, that orders sequences from well-modeled cellular proteins through viral proteins to shuffled and random sequences. Scaling contracts this axis unevenly across viral families. Despite this, protein language model embeddings retain viral-specific signal: viral proteins remain linearly separable beyond zero-shot perplexity and shallow sequence features. Together, these results suggest that pLM representations are structured by a general notion of nativeness while preserving information specific to distinct biological groups.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用病毒蛋白作为探针，分析现有蛋白语言模型（如ESM系列）的嵌入空间结构，发现其中存在一条‘天然性轴’，能按建模难度线性排序细胞蛋白→病毒蛋白→乱序/随机序列，并证明尽管病毒蛋白在训练数据中占比极低，模型仍保留了可线性分离的病毒特异性信号。
analysis.claim: 蛋白语言模型的嵌入空间被一条与掩码重建困惑度对齐的‘nativeness轴’主导，该轴反映序列生物学合理性，且模型在严重数据不平衡下仍保留病毒家族特异性表征。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列
analysis.output: 嵌入向量 + 线性可分性判据 + nativeness轴定位

papers.title: DynaHMRC: Decentralized Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaboration for Dynamic Tasks with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide robots with richer task understanding and adaptability, making them promising for coordinating heterogeneous multi-robot systems in long-horizon tasks. Despite this potential, several challenges remain underexplored: (1) Centralized LLM schedulers scale poorly as team size and environmental complexity increase. A single model must process excessive contextual information, and long-context approximation may degrade reasoning quality; (2) Existing task formulations insufficiently consider dynamic settings, while robust adaptation to evolving task conditions is essential for real-world deployment; (3) Domain-specific data scarcity limits specialized robotic reasoning, making proprietary general-purpose models inefficient for expert tasks. To address these limitations, we propose DynaHMRC, a decentralized framework in which each robot acts as a role-aware LLM agent. This design mitigates the single-model context bottleneck and supports flexible collaboration across heterogeneous team configurations. DynaHMRC organizes collaboration as a four-stage closed-loop process: self-description, task allocation with leadership bidding, leader election, and reflective execution, supported by executable robot interfaces. We further develop a benchmark covering three task families, four dynamic variations, and six team configurations to systematically study dynamic task modeling. In addition, we conduct an empirical analysis to guide the construction of domain-specific expert datasets and fine-tune pretrained LLMs to improve specialized competence. Experiments show that DynaHMRC achieves higher success rates than strong baselines with fewer action and communication steps, while demonstrating promising scalability trends as team size grows within the evaluated settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个去中心化的多机器人协作框架DynaHMRC，让每个异构机器人自带角色感知的LLM代理，通过自描述、竞标式任务分配、动态选领导、反思执行四步闭环协作，在动态变化的任务中减少通信和动作步数，同时构建了首个面向动态多机器人任务的系统性基准。

papers.title: Toward understanding drivers of specialized metabolism in Actinomycetota: insights from 1432 transcriptomics datasets for 132 strains
papers.abstract: Abstract Actinomycetota are major sources of specialized metabolites with applications in drug discovery and agriculture, yet much of their biosynthetic potential remains silent under standard laboratory conditions. Limited understanding of the mechanisms controlling biosynthetic gene cluster (BGC) activation constrains metabolite discovery and production. Here, we generated 1432 RNA-seq datasets from 132 Actinomycetota strains grown in eight media to identify patterns associated with BGC expression. On average, strains expressed 44% of their encoded BGCs across the tested conditions, with more expression observed among known BGCs (61%) compared to uncharacterized BGCs (35%). Co-expression analyses revealed frequent associations between BGCs and transporters, transcriptional regulators, and proteins containing DUF397 and DUF742 domains. Targeted overexpression of candidate genes selected from BGC-associated co-expression modules increased metabolite production, with DUF397- and DUF742-containing operons showing the broadest effects by boosting the levels of several different specialized metabolites. Other genes boosted levels in a metabolite-specific manner. Together, our results support a multilayered model of BGC regulation in Actinomycetota in which BGC expression is shaped by medium composition, BGC-specific regulators, and integration of BGCs into broader transcriptional network modules. By connecting BGC expression to specific media and co-expressed genes, this study also provides a resource for selecting growth conditions and engineering specialized metabolism.

analysis.tldr: 通过分析132株放线菌在8种培养基下的1432个转录组数据，系统揭示了生物合成基因簇（BGC）表达的调控规律，发现培养基成分、特异性转录因子及与DUF397/DUF742结构域蛋白共表达的模块是关键驱动因素，并实验验证了这些共表达基因的过表达能显著提升已知和未知代谢物产量。
analysis.claim: 放线菌中生物合成基因簇（BGC）的表达受培养基环境、BGC特异性调控因子及嵌入全局转录网络模块（尤其是含DUF397/DUF742结构域的共表达模块）的多层级协同调控。

analysis.output: BGC表达模式图谱、共表达网络模块、可工程化提升代谢物产量的候选调控基因列表

analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最大规模的放线菌跨菌株/跨培养基转录组资源（1432样本），首次系统量化BGC沉默比例（35%未知BGC表达），并用靶向过表达实验在多株中验证了DUF397/DUF742共表达模块对多种代谢物的广谱增强效应——证据链完整（组学统计+网络推断+湿实验验证），显著超越纯计算预测或单菌株研究，但未构建新AI模型或颠覆性调控范式，故略低于AlphaFold级里程碑。

papers.title: CAC-VLA: Context-Gated Action Conditioning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a promising paradigm for generalist robot manipulation, where visual-language representations are used to condition continuous action generation. However, these representations are not explicitly optimized for action conditioning, leaving the action expert to bridge the gap between multimodal understanding and precise motor control. Recent action-reasoning methods introduce additional modules to generate explicit action plans or action-space reasoning signals, demonstrating the benefit of action-level guidance but often requiring separate action-generation frameworks. We propose CAC-VLA, a Context-Gated Action Conditioning framework that learns a lightweight latent-action interface directly within the VLM. Instead of generating executable trajectories, CAC-VLA trains the VLM to predict coarse-to-fine latent actions, which are structured representations encoded from future action segments, and adaptively leverages them to condition the action expert via a context gate. This enables VLM-native action conditioning while calibrating the influence of latent-action guidance on expert action generation. Experiments on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate the effectiveness of CAC-VLA, achieving 98.3% average success rate on LIBERO and 89.5% LIBERO-Plus, suggesting that context-gated latent-action conditioning is an effective interface for continuous expert control.

analysis.tldr: 提出CAC-VLA框架，在视觉-语言模型内部学习一个轻量级的粗粒度到细粒度的潜在动作表示，并通过上下文门控机制动态调节该表示对动作专家模型的引导强度，从而提升机器人操作任务的成功率。

papers.title: Computational Lead Optimization on BACE1: Relative Binding Free Energy Perturbation as the Terminal Refinement Layer
papers.abstract: Structure-based drug discovery is known to apply computational methods in a tiered hierarchy, with each layer narrowing the candidate set and refining the binding picture before committing to the next, more expensive step. We present a four-tiered computational benchmarking study evaluating five engines against a panel of 36 compounds targeting B-secretase 1 (BACE1), a validated Alzheimer's disease target with extensive co-crystal ground truth. This study evaluates Flexible Docking and Boltz2 Cofolding as the primary tier, followed by Ensemble Docking, and then Protein-Ligand MD with MM/PBSA and MM/GBSA post-processing. This is then concluded with Relative Binding Free Energy Perturbation (RevFEP) as the terminal refinement layer. Each method was benchmarked against the experimental binding free energies derived from the co-crystal structures spanning -7.85 to -11.35 kcal/mol. Our findings revealed that Flexible Docking reproduced the co-crystal binding mode for 35 of 36 ligands (97.2% within 2.0 A RMSD) but did not rank potency at this resolution. Boltz2 CoFolding provided an orthogonal structural cross-check with a receptor backbone RMSD of 0.293 A against the experimental co-crystal structure. Ensemble Docking identified the optimal receptor conformation for downstream FEP setup. MD with MM/GBSA decomposition identified van der Waals complementarity as the primary potency driver (Pearson r = +0.855, R2 = 0.732 on a 10-compound subset). RevFEP delivered the highest affinity correlation of any method (Pearson r = +0.662, R2 = 0.438, Spearman p = +0.624, mean absolute error 1.02 kcal/mol across all 36 ligands), resolving potency differences within a narrow 3.5 kcal/mol congeneric window that no other engine could discriminate. We characterize what each engine contributes independently and where RevFEP delivers signals no other engine achieves.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了五种计算药物设计方法在BACE1靶点上的表现，发现相对结合自由能微扰（RevFEP）作为最后一层精修步骤，能在3.5 kcal/mol的窄活性窗口内准确区分同类化合物的结合强度，而其他方法（如分子对接、MM/GBSA）在此分辨率下失效。
analysis.claim: Relative Binding Free Energy Perturbation（RevFEP）作为计算药物发现流程的终端精修层，是唯一能在窄构效窗口（≤3.5 kcal/mol）内可靠分辨BACE1抑制剂相对亲和力的方法，且其预测精度（MAE=1.02 kcal/mol）显著优于上游层级方法。

analysis.output: 相对结合自由能预测值（ΔΔG，单位kcal/mol）

papers.title: ObjRetarget: An Object-Aware Motion Retargeting Framework with Anthropomorphic Arm Constraints and Polyhedral Hand Modeling
papers.abstract: Learning robot dexterous manipulation from human manipulation videos requires reliably retargeting human intent to executable robot actions while maintaining stable hand-object contact, which remains a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Existing retargeting methods often ignore explicit contact modeling or rely on reinforcement learning, resulting in limited accuracy and generalization. To address this, we propose ObjRetarget, a human-to-robot motion retargeting framework for learning robot dexterous manipulation from human videos, which integrates anthropomorphic arm trajectory constraints with structured hand-object geometric modeling. For arm motion, reference trajectories extracted from human videos are used for initialization, followed by anthropomorphic constraints and redundancy-aware optimization to generate natural and accurate movements. For hand manipulation, ObjRetarget represents multi-finger contacts using polytope clusters and preserves contact structure through geometric invariants to improve stability. Experiments on real robots show that ObjRetarget improves manipulation success rates and contact stability across multiple dexterous tasks, and generalizes well to different demonstrations, object poses, and task settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出ObjRetarget框架，将人类操作视频中的手臂运动和手-物接触关系分别建模：手臂部分用人体解剖约束优化轨迹，手部部分用多面体（polyhedral）几何表示多指接触结构并保持几何不变性，从而在真实机器人上提升灵巧操作的成功率和接触稳定性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模手-物几何接触结构与符合人体工学的臂部运动约束，可显著提升从单目人类操作视频到真实机器人灵巧操作的动作重定向精度、稳定性和跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.input: 单目人类操作视频（含手臂+手+物体）
analysis.output: 机器人关节级动作序列（含臂部轨迹+手指关节角度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Allegro Hand（摘要未明说但实验称‘real robots’，结合作者单位与常见配置推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人执行反馈用于微调/验证，但核心训练不依赖真实机器人数据（仅用人类视频+仿真接触建模）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有明确几何建模创新（polyhedral hand modeling + geometric invariants），实证包含多个真实机器人灵巧任务（如抓取、旋转、插拔），且报告了成功率与接触稳定性提升，但未开源代码/模型，未与ACT/Diffusion Policy等强基线对比，也未展示跨机体泛化（如换手型/换臂构型），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在接触建模和运动重定向的几何严谨性上有实质性推进，但缺乏开源与强基线对比，尚未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: The impact of behavioural activity on the EEG power spectrum, its source localisation, and global functional connectivity in rats
papers.abstract: Abstract The behavioural activity of freely moving animals is a confounding factor that affects the recording, analysis, and final results of animal EEG experiments. Along with the lack of standardisation in animal in vivo electrophysiology experiments, this could lead to huge inconsistencies, especially in the analysis of centrally acting drugs. Therefore, the main aim of this paper is to investigate the effects of behavioural activity versus inactivity on the multichannel EEG in freely moving rats. In a large sample (n = 116) of waking recordings from 12 cortical electrodes (ECoG) in Wistar rats, we evaluated behavioural activity-related changes in the power spectrum, current source density, and power-based global functional connectivity (GFC) in a 3D rat brain model, according to the TOHOKU Rat Brain Atlas. The main findings were that behavioural activity induced 1) a robust power increase in 6-8 Hz, peaking at 7 Hz with maximum changes over the parietal and temporal cortex, 2) an increase in gamma power (30-80 Hz) across the whole brain, 3) a decrease in delta (1-4 Hz) and beta (12-30 Hz) power across the whole cortex. Changes were also localised in subcortical regions, particularly in the diencephalon/thalamus. The GFC analysis showed a similar pattern of power changes across the 6-8 Hz, delta, and beta bands; however, GFC in the gamma band decreased. Again, the GFC analysis revealed changes in connectivity within subcortical structures, primarily in the thalamus. None of the measures was affected in the alpha band (8-12 Hz). These findings emphasise behavioural state as a critical factor influencing EEG outcomes, with important implications for the standardisation and translational validity of preclinical neurophysiological studies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用116次清醒大鼠的皮层脑电（ECoG）记录，系统量化了行为活动（如走动、探查）与静息状态对EEG功率谱、源定位和全脑功能连接的影响，发现7Hz频段和伽马频段功率显著升高，而delta和beta频段下降，且这些变化在皮层和丘脑等亚皮层区域均有定位，强调行为状态是动物EEG实验中必须控制的关键混杂变量。
analysis.claim: 自由行为活动会特异性地、可重复地改变大鼠多通道EEG的频谱功率分布、源空间激活模式及全脑功能连接结构，且该效应跨个体稳定，构成动物电生理实验中不可忽视的核心混杂因素。
analysis.input: 12通道皮层ECoG信号 + 行为视频标注（活动/静息）
analysis.output: 频段特异性功率变化图、电流源密度分布图、基于功率的全脑功能连接矩阵
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实大鼠电生理数据（n=116次清醒记录）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为扎实的实证工作（大样本、多模态EEG分析、跨皮层-亚皮层验证），但属方法学控制层面的重要发现，未提出新范式、未解决长期开放难题、未推动BCI解码性能或临床转化，也未构建通用模型或开源完整代码/数据；其价值在于警示与标准化，而非技术突破，明显低于所有列举的基石工作（均涉及实时闭环解码、高维神经接口、临床级应用）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：系统性地完成了动物EEG中行为混杂效应的定量刻画，是高质量的预临床方法学研究，但未跨越到神经接口或解码技术层面，暂不构成突破。

papers.title: Selective miniprotein inhibitors of Aurora-A kinase designed using interaction-motif scaffolding
papers.abstract: Targeting kinase ATP-binding sites has produced many successful therapeutics, but selectivity remains a major challenge. We hypothesised that substrate-recognition surfaces could provide an alternative route to selective kinase inhibition. Here, we designed and tested structure-guided miniprotein inhibitors of Aurora-A using N-Myc as a template, a natural weak binder of the P+1 pocket. The most potent designs bind Aurora-A with single-digit nanomolar affinity, more than a thousand fold higher than the starting template, and selectively inhibit Aurora-A over Aurora-B in kinase assays and mitotic cells. Despite diverse architectures, successful binders targeting the substrate-recognition surface converged on a common strategy, coupling extensive engagement of the αG-helix with activation loop stabilisation. Together these results show that selective kinase inhibition can be achieved by exploiting structurally well-defined active-state conformations rather than kinase-specific inactive states. Our work establishes a framework for converting weak substrate-recognition surface interactors into potent, selective kinase inhibitors through structure-guided protein design.

analysis.tldr: 用N-Myc蛋白片段为模板，通过结构导向设计出能高亲和力、高选择性结合Aurora-A激酶底物识别表面（而非传统ATP口袋）的微型蛋白抑制剂，在生化和细胞水平验证其对Aurora-A而非Aurora-B的选择性抑制。
analysis.claim: 通过靶向激酶底物识别表面（而非ATP口袋）并利用结构导向的微型蛋白设计，可实现对Aurora-A的高度选择性抑制，且该策略具有普适性框架价值。
analysis.input: Aurora-A激酶活性构象结构（含P+1口袋与αG-螺旋/激活环区域）、N-Myc弱结合片段结构、计算建模约束条件
analysis.output: 高亲和力（单纳摩尔级）、高选择性（>1000倍区分Aurora-A/Aurora-B）的miniprotein抑制剂序列及三维结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在激酶药物发现范式上做出实质性突破：首次系统性证明底物识别表面可作为高选择性靶点，并通过结构导向蛋白设计获得纳米级亲和力与千倍选择性，实验证据扎实（ITC/Kinase assay/mitotic cell phenotyping），但仅验证单一激酶家族（Aurora），未扩展至其他激酶，也未开源代码或模型，复现门槛高。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它打破了‘激酶抑制必争ATP口袋’的长期路径依赖，用结构生物学+蛋白设计给出可验证的新范式，但尚未形成通用工具链

papers.title: GenVid2Robot: From Video Generation to Robot Manipulation via Rigid-Geometric Consistency
papers.abstract: Generated videos provide useful visual motion priors for robot manipulation, but their visual plausibility does not imply physical executability. A generated video usually lacks metric geometry, grasp grounding, robot kinematic feasibility, and execution-time feedback, which makes direct trajectory replay unreliable in real-world manipulation. This paper presents GenVid2Robot, a rigid-geometric consistency framework that converts generated video motion into executable real-robot manipulation trajectories. Given an initial RGB-D observation and a task instruction, GenVid2Robot samples task-relevant semantic anchors from the real first frame, tracks these anchors through generated video candidates, and verifies whether the resulting 2D motion can be explained by first-frame RGB-D anchors under a sparse relative $SE(3)$ model. In this way, generated videos are treated as uncertain visual motion hypotheses rather than direct robot demonstrations. Only geometrically consistent motion is transferred to the robot. The accepted relative motion is then applied to the real grasp-time TCP pose selected by mask-constrained grasping, producing a grasp-conditioned execution trajectory that is consistent with both the visual motion prior and the physical grasp configuration. To reduce execution mismatch caused by RGB-D noise, calibration residuals, and small contact-induced displacement, a bounded depth-compensation module corrects local depth-direction errors without assuming full online replanning. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that GenVid2Robot improves the reliability of generated-video-guided manipulation by grounding visual motion priors with sparse metric geometry, grasp constraints, robot feasibility checking, and bounded execution feedback.

analysis.tldr: 提出GenVid2Robot框架，把生成视频中的运动当作待验证的视觉假设，用第一帧RGB-D提取的稀疏3D锚点+SE(3)刚性运动模型检验其几何一致性，只将通过验证的运动转化为真实机器人可执行的抓取条件轨迹，并加入有界深度补偿模块缓解传感器噪声影响。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室关键词，仅凭姓名无法可靠判定归属；清华/上交/港科大/中科院等常见单位未出现；非DeepMind/NVIDIA/Meta/Stanford/Berkeley等显性署名）
analysis.claim: 生成视频本身不可直接用于机器人控制，必须通过刚性几何一致性验证（基于首帧RGB-D锚点与SE(3)运动假设）才能转化为物理可行的抓取条件操作轨迹。
analysis.input: 初始RGB-D图像 + 任务语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器（TCP）的抓取条件操作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机器人（实验部分明确为real-robot experiments，但未指明型号；推测为通用6-DOF机械臂+夹爪）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实RGB-D观测和真实机器人执行反馈，但未说明是否依赖大规模真实机器人操作数据集（如RT-X或Bridge）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性地将生成视频降级为‘待验证运动假设’，并引入稀疏SE(3)刚性一致性检验+抓取约束+有界深度补偿三重物理对齐机制，在真实机器人上验证了视频到操作的可行性提升；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未在标准benchmark（如Bridge、RT-X）上评测，未跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，实证规模有限（摘要未提任务数、物体数、失败率对比），属于扎实的范式修正型工作，尚未达到基石级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破尚缺开源与泛化证据，但物理对齐思路清晰、实机验证有效，是视频驱动机器人操作从‘盲目回放’转向‘几何可信执行’的关键一步。

papers.title: KineFuse: Kinematic-Aware Haptic Fusion for In-Hand Occluded-Object Pose Tracking
papers.abstract: Dexterous in-hand manipulation requires continuous 6D pose tracking, yet the manipulating fingers inevitably occlude the object from the camera. We study how to structure the sparse haptic signals already available on multi-fingered hands, including proprioception, proximal force/torque, and binary contact, to complement a pretrained visual pose tracker under occlusion. We propose a kinematic-aware finger-level encoder and systematically compare it against four alternative designs through three levels of evaluation: per-frame refinement, sequential open-loop tracking, and closed-loop manipulation. Our experiments reveal that (i) per-frame evaluation cannot distinguish encoder quality, while sequential tracking amplifies architectural differences by up to 15 times; (ii) the structured encoder learns task-specific cross-modal gating, using vision exclusively for translation and dedicating one attention head to haptics for rotation, without explicit supervision; and (iii) compact finger-level tokenization with 4 tokens outperforms both flat fusion and joint-level representations, which suppress vision through norm dominance. We validate that improved tracking yields higher success in a downstream reorientation task and provide qualitative real-world demonstrations. Our project page is available at https://cold-young.github.io/kine-fuse/.

analysis.tldr: 提出KineFuse方法，利用多指灵巧手已有的本体感觉、近端力/扭矩和二值接触等稀疏触觉信号，结构化地融合视觉姿态估计结果，在手指遮挡物体时提升6D位姿跟踪精度，并通过序列级跟踪实验验证其优于多种基线设计。
analysis.claim: 结构化的、运动学感知的指级触觉编码器能以无监督方式自动分工：视觉主导平移估计，触觉（经单注意力头）主导旋转估计，从而在遮挡下显著提升序列级6D位姿跟踪鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+本体感觉+近端力/扭矩+二值接触信号
analysis.output: 6D物体位姿（位置+朝向）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多指灵巧手（未指明具体型号，但实验含真实世界演示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的触觉-视觉同步数据，但未说明规模与公开性
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在序列跟踪和闭环重定向任务中验证效果，揭示了跨模态分工机制（视觉管平移、触觉管旋转），且发现帧级评估失效、序列级才暴露架构差异——这是重要方法论洞见；但缺乏大规模数据集、未开源代码/模型、未跨机体/任务泛化验证，未达基石论文（如ALOHA/ACT/T-Rex）所要求的系统级部署或通用策略层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：揭示了触觉-视觉融合中模态分工的隐式学习机制并验证其对序列跟踪的关键作用，但受限于数据与开源程度，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: AC-VLA: Robust Out-of-Distribution Action Execution via Compositional Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at end-to-end robotic manipulation but struggle with out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization when familiar sub-tasks are recombined in unseen configurations. We identify two mutually reinforcing failure modes: \emph{trajectory overfitting}, where models overfit to holistic trajectory patterns rather than compositional sub-skill semantics; and \emph{perceptual shortcut}, where action tokens over-rely on wrist-view textures at the expense of global spatial grounding. To address both, we introduce \textbf{AC-VLA}, a plug-and-play Action Compositional learning framework comprising two architecture-agnostic components: \textbf{(i)} a compositional learning module that uses an LLM-driven instruction decomposer and a proprioceptive trajectory aligner to generate dense sub-task supervision, followed by mixed training on complete demonstrations and decomposed data to endow the model with compositional generalization; and \textbf{(ii)} a state-conditioned asymmetric masking strategy that suppresses wrist-view inputs during closed-gripper phases, enforcing global semantic grounding. All components are architectural modification-free and directly integrable into any VLA backbone. Instantiated on $π_{0.5}$ and evaluated on LIBERO and LIBERO-OOD benchmarks, AC-VLA achieves a ~28% absolute improvement on compositional OOD tasks while maintaining near-perfect in-distribution performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出AC-VLA框架，通过LLM分解指令+本体感知轨迹对齐生成子任务监督信号，并用状态条件下的非对称腕部视觉掩码抑制感知捷径，提升VLA模型在未见组合任务（OOD）上的动作执行鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 解耦动作的组合语义与感知表征可显著提升VLA模型在未见子任务组合下的泛化能力，且无需修改骨干网络架构。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（RGB图像+语言指令+本体感知信号）
analysis.output: 动作序列（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有洞见（解耦组合语义与感知捷径），在LIBERO-OOD上提升28%绝对性能，但仅验证于仿真环境、未开源代码/模型、无真实机器人实验、未做消融隔离各组件贡献，属于扎实但窄域的增量改进，未触及VLA基础范式或跨机体/跨场景泛化瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在仿真OOD组合泛化上有明确改进，但缺乏实证深度与开放性，暂未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: Towards Miniature Humanoid Tele-Loco-Manipulation Using Virtual Reality and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Full-sized humanoid robot capabilities have grown exponentially in recent years, aiming towards general-purpose deployment in human environments. A popular control method used by manufacturers utilizes Virtual Reality for upper-body teleoperation and Reinforcement Learning for lower-body balance and locomotion control. As a result, a single remote operator can see, manipulate, and navigate about a real, distant physical environment. This powerful control stack is often relegated to expensive full-sized robots, many of which are inaccessible to the research community. Miniature humanoids are more prevalent, but employ less biomimicry in their design (e.g. fewer sensors, Degrees of Freedom, etc) and lack similar developments. This paper describes a compliant full-body telepresence control stack developed from the ground up for miniature humanoids. Framework experimentation on ROBOTIS OP3 hardware showcases walking at speeds up to 0.45 m/s independent of arm motions. Tele-loco-manipulation is demonstrated via a cube relocation experiment with an expert human operator. On average, the teleoperated system moved 2 different 40 g cubes within 10 mins, walking a total distance of 5 m. Overall, the developed system shows potential for miniature humanoid tele-loco-manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用VR远程操控微型人形机器人（ROBOTIS OP3）实现边走边操作物体，上半身靠VR遥操作、下半身用强化学习控制平衡与行走，完成了5米内移动两个小方块的任务。
analysis.claim: 为微型人形机器人构建了一套端到端可运行的、分层解耦的VR+RL全身体感遥操作框架，首次在OP3上实现独立于手臂动作的稳定行走与协同操作。
analysis.input: VR手柄姿态+头显视角+关节反馈信号
analysis.output: 全身关节指令（含步态生成与手臂轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人数据调参，但未说明采集规模或多样性；仅报告单次专家操作实验结果
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一微型平台（OP3）上完成一次封闭场景下的简单搬运任务，无跨任务/跨机体验证，无消融实验，无开源代码或数据，未对比基线，未解决任何长期开放问题（如sim2real泛化、多任务统一策略、低资源RL训练等），属于已有VR遥操+RL步态控制思路的工程复现与平台适配。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟VR遥操与RL步态控制方法迁移到微型人形平台，但缺乏新算法、新基准、新发现，也未突破微型机器人固有性能瓶颈

papers.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multimodal foundation models learned to see and to speak by consuming the whole internet. Embodied agents admit no such shortcut, since they require data that couple observations with physical states and actions. These signals can be provided, to varying degrees, by multiple data sources. In this work, we organize the embodied data ecosystem as a "pyramid" spanning five complementary sources: real-robot data, UMI-style data, egocentric and exocentric data, simulation data, and general vision-language data. We organize the pyramid around the tension between scalability and robot alignment, and further characterize each source in terms of data quality, diversity, reusability, and physical fidelity. We then analyze recent embodied foundation models through the lens of their data recipes, examining how different sources are selected, aligned, and mixed during pretraining. For embodied brain models, vision-language-action models, and world-action models alike, we relate data composition to capabilities in perception, reasoning, planning, action generation, and world prediction. We close by discussing six open challenges: building large-scale tactile datasets, collecting failure and recovery data, developing scalable data-collection pipelines, aligning actions across embodiments, leveraging egocentric data for dexterous manipulation, and designing principled data recipes for robot learning. We hope this work paves the foundation for the design of next-generation embodied systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新模型、新算法或新硬件，而是系统性地梳理和分类了具身操作领域可用的五类数据来源（真实机器人、UMI风格、主/客观视角、仿真、通用视觉语言数据），用‘数据金字塔’框架分析它们在可扩展性与机器人对齐性之间的权衡，并评估现有具身基础模型的数据使用策略，最后指出六个待解的数据层面挑战。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv版本无affiliation信息）

analysis.output: 对具身基础模型数据策略的归因分析（如感知/推理/规划/动作生成/世界预测能力与数据构成的关联）

papers.title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general robot manipulation, but most existing models rely on 2D visual-language backbones and lack fine-grained 3D understanding of target objects, especially under occlusion, pose variation, scale changes, and precise spatial interaction. We propose an object-centric 3D representation alignment framework built upon $π_0$, using SAM3D as a frozen 3D teacher to provide target-object 3D priors during training. Specifically, we localize task-relevant objects with object recognition models, generate corresponding object masks, and use SAM3D to extract dense object-level 3D representations, which are aligned with intermediate visual features of $π_0$. This enables the policy to internalize target-object 3D information while preserving the original RGB-language-to-action inference pipeline without requiring depth, point clouds, masks, SAM3D, or additional 3D modules at test time. Simulation experiments show consistent improvements, achieving 99.1\% on LIBERO and an average length of 4.11 on CALVIN. Real-world experiments further demonstrate that our method is particularly effective in long-horizon manipulation scenarios where the robot must focus on different target objects across multiple subtasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给现有VLA模型（如π0）加了一个训练时用的3D知识蒸馏模块：用冻结的SAM3D模型提取任务物体的3D特征，对齐到VLA模型的视觉中间层，让模型在不增加测试开销的前提下隐式学到更鲁棒的3D物体表征，从而提升长程多步操作任务表现。
analysis.claim: 仅通过训练阶段引入SAM3D提供的对象级3D先验进行特征对齐，即可显著提升纯RGB+语言输入的VLA模型在遮挡、尺度变化和长程多目标操作下的泛化能力，且完全不改变推理架构与输入模态。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-effector控制信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，仅提‘real-world experiments’但无数据规模/来源细节，推测为小规模验证
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（3D蒸馏+无需测试时额外模态），仿真结果扎实（LIBERO 99.1%、CALVIN长度提升），实机验证有限但指向关键痛点（长程多目标操作），但缺乏消融实验验证3D对齐的独立贡献、未开源、未与π0基线做公平对比（如相同训练预算/数据）、未报告真实场景失败案例或跨机体泛化，属扎实但非突破的增量改进。

papers.title: Shared Voxel-Map-Based Cooperative Indoor UAV Guidance with a Multi-Agent Soft Actor-Critic Controller
papers.abstract: This paper presents a cooperative indoor UAV guidance framework that combines a shared voxel-map world model with a multi-agent Soft Actor-Critic (MASAC) controller. Multiple drones fuse 360 LiDAR observations into a common world-frame occupancy map, which is converted into a compact bird's-eye-view (BEV) representation and provided to each agent as an ego-aligned local crop. This integrate-in-world, act-in- ego design enables consistent multi-UAV spatial fusion whilst retaining decentralised continuous control. The policy combines BEV map features, near-field obstacle observations, and compact goal and peer-state information within a centralised-training, decentralised-execution framework. In simulation, the learned controller achieves a 90.3% success rate in corridor navigation, outperforming Astar planning, an artificial potential field controller, and a prior guidance method. To address residual sim-to-real mismatch, the simulation-trained policy is further adapted using offline imitation fine-tuning from real-world data. Real-world experiments in GNSS-denied indoor environments demonstrate stable two-UAV cooperative operation across increasingly chal- lenging obstacle layouts. The results show that shared voxel-map representations provide an effective and scalable spatial substrate for learned cooperative indoor UAV guidance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用共享体素地图+多智能体SAC控制器，让多个室内无人机在仿真中学会协作避障导航，再用少量真实数据做离线模仿微调，实现在无GPS室内环境中的双机稳定协同飞行。
analysis.claim: 共享体素地图作为统一空间表征，配合中心化训练/去中心化执行的MASAC策略，能支撑可扩展、鲁棒的多无人机室内协同导航，且经少量真实数据微调后可在真实复杂障碍环境中部署。
analysis.input: 体素地图局部裁剪（BEV）、近场障碍物观测、目标位置、邻机状态
analysis.output: 连续控制动作（六自由度速度或加速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: Parrot Anafi UAV + custom LiDAR rig
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实飞行数据用于离线模仿微调（未说明具体时长/场景数，仅称‘real-world data’）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰但非首创：共享地图+MARL在无人机领域已有较多探索（如VoxelNet-MARL, MAPF+RL），BEV压缩和ego-aligned crop属工程优化；仿真指标扎实（90.3%成功率+多baseline对比），但真实验证仅限2机、无动态交互、障碍布局未公开量化、消融实验缺失；离线微调缓解sim2real gap属常见做法，未展示泛化到新机体/新传感器/新任务的能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟组件（体素地图、MASAC、BEV编码、离线IL）有效串联，在限定场景下达成可用的双机协同，但缺乏算法原创性、跨机体泛化证据和开源支撑，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: FBFM: A Training-Free Asynchronous Feedback Mechanism for Flow-Matching in World-Action Models Execution
papers.abstract: Although world-action models (WAMs) enhance long-horizon robot control by predicting visual evolution before acting, long-horizon reliability demands repeated re-grounding in real observations--not recursive rollout. Existing WAMs address this by refreshing history or KV cache with ground-truth data between chunks. However, such chunk-wise feedback operates at a coarse temporal granularity and thus fails to correct prediction errors at the individual time-step level. To address this, we propose Feedback Flow Matching (FBFM), a training-free inference mechanism that pushes re-grounding inside the actively generated chunk. During flow matching, FBFM applies a masked pseudoinverse correction to the conditional velocity field: it leverages the preceding action chunk to guide generation of the next action chunk, and uses the image observed after executing that preceding chunk to guide the next frame prediction. This cross-chunk pairing--where feedback from one chunk arrives in time to shape the next--creates an asynchronous loop that corrects errors without waiting for chunk boundaries. Being training-free, the mechanism improves responsiveness to unexpected events and suppresses drift in long-horizon tasks. We evaluate FBFM on both a joint-generation WAM (DreamZero) and a stage-wise WAM (LingBot-VA). On selected LIBERO and RoboTwin2.0 tasks, it improves success rates by over 5% in favorable settings, and real-world robot observation-prediction diagnostics show notably better tracking. We argue that FBFM offers a new paradigm for fine-grained online correction, bridging open-loop flow generation with closed-loop real-world dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的异步反馈机制FBFM，让世界-动作模型在生成动作和图像时，能在每个时间步用刚观测到的真实图像动态修正预测，而不是只在粗粒度的块边界处重置，从而减少长程任务中的漂移。
analysis.claim: 无需重新训练，仅通过推理时对流匹配（flow matching）过程施加掩码伪逆校正，即可实现细粒度、跨块异步反馈，显著抑制世界-动作模型在长视野执行中的误差累积。
analysis.input: 前一动作块执行后的观测图像 + 当前条件（如目标/语言指令）
analysis.output: 下一动作块 + 下一帧预测图像
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行后的观测图像用于反馈校正，但未说明是否需大量真实数据预标定或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 机制设计有启发性（细粒度异步反馈），但实证薄弱：仅在2个WAM上测试、提升5%成功率、无消融实验、无基线对比（如vs. chunk-refresh baseline）、无真实机器人闭环部署、代码/数据全未开源；相比DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（真机多任务+状态持久化+系统级闭环），它只是推理阶段的局部修补，未触及世界模型的核心表征缺陷（如状态坍缩、记忆缺失）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把反馈嵌入流匹配推理流程是合理改进，但缺乏系统级验证和开源支撑，属于已有范式内的稳健工程优化，非范式突破

papers.title: SpaceVLA: Spatially Grounded VLA for Robotic Manipulation with User-Authored Grasp and Place Anchors
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models follow language commands but often lack explicit spatial intent for manipulation. We present Visual Intent Anchors, an XR pipeline that lets users specify grasp and placement regions and renders them as image-space overlays for VLA control. We collect 200 Unity pick-and-place demonstrations and fine-tune OpenVLA-7B with LoRA on temporally subsampled annotated observations. The policy predicts tokenized 7-DoF incremental actions from marked RGB observations and language. We evaluate the policy in closed-loop Unity trials, achieving a grasp success rate of 91.25% and mean grasp and placement errors of 0.5 cm and 0.7 cm, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 用XR工具让用户在图像上手动标出抓取和放置区域（视觉意图锚点），把这种空间标注作为额外输入喂给VLA模型，提升其空间定位精度，在Unity仿真中实现了高精度抓放（抓取成功率91.25%，误差<0.7cm）。
analysis.org: Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology
analysis.claim: 显式引入用户标注的空间锚点（grasp/place anchors）可显著提升VLA模型在操作任务中的空间接地能力，无需依赖复杂3D重建或几何先验。
analysis.input: 标注了抓取/放置区域的RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 7自由度增量动作序列（tokenized）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在Unity单场景单任务（pick-and-place）验证，无跨物体/跨位姿/跨机体泛化实验，无真实硬件验证，未与主流VLA基线（如OpenVLA原版、RT-2、π0）做控制变量对比，仅报告自身微调结果；XR标注流程属工程增强，非模型架构或学习范式突破。

papers.title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
papers.abstract: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length prefix in the token space of the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix conditions every future video-action block, providing a shared geometric context for both future-view and action generation. We train WNM-3D through supervised world-action fine-tuning on A*-generated demonstrations, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and DanceGRPO-based closed-loop policy optimization. Experiments on GN-Bench show that WNM-3D outperforms strong VLM-based navigation policies and its 2D-conditioned counterpart in closed-loop navigation. On a fixed near-goal evaluation set, WNM-3D also achieves higher flow-action consistency and lower visual-motion error.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WNM-3D模型，用单目RGB历史帧提取3D几何表征作为固定前缀，注入到扩散Transformer中联合生成未来视频帧和导航动作，在GN-Bench上比纯2D条件和VLM基线更准，但所有实验都在仿真环境（R2R/GN-Bench）中完成，未涉及真实机器人或跨场景泛化验证。
analysis.claim: 通过将单目RGB历史编码为几何感知的3D场景前缀并注入扩散世界模型，可提升视觉语言导航中未来观测与动作的联合一致性，从而改善闭环导航性能。
analysis.input: 单目RGB图像序列+自然语言导航指令
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频预测+对应导航动作序列（如转向/前进）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真渲染数据（R2R/GN-Bench），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽引入3D几何条件增强世界模型，但仍是仿真内闭环VLN的增量改进：未挑战长期开放难题（如跨环境泛化、真实传感器噪声鲁棒性、具身因果建模），对比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作，缺乏持久状态核心、在线自监督构建、跨任务迁移或真实部署证据，仅在固定benchmark刷分。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——属于仿真VLN领域内方法微调，未触及世界模型本质瓶颈（如状态持久性、跨模态因果解耦、真实具身约束），也无实证表明其3D条件机制能迁移到真实机器人或新场景。

papers.title: GAINS: Leveraging Inconsistent Human Intervention Signals in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Correcting robot manipulation policies through human intervention holds great promise for real-world deployment, yet human operators are inherently imperfect in both the actions they provide and the timing of their intervention signals. While the former has been extensively discussed in reinforcement learning (RL), the latter remains underexplored. At high control frequencies, human intervention signals are often delayed and inconsistent across time and state space. In this work, we present GAINS, a framework for leveraging inconsistent human intervention signals in RL. At the core of GAINS, we employ distributional RL with quantile Q-networks to model the return variability induced by sparse task rewards and inconsistent human interventions. Building on this distributional representation, we introduce a pessimistic exploration strategy that promotes safe and sample-efficient learning under human corrections. We evaluate GAINS on four diverse simulated manipulation tasks and two challenging real-world scenarios against state-of-the-art intervention-based methods. GAINS achieves a 22% higher task success rate than RLIF and improves recovery success by up to 43% in failure scenarios. These results highlight the importance of modeling return variability induced by human imperfection for real-world deployment of intervention-based learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GAINS框架，专门处理人类在机器人操控中干预信号不一致（延迟、时序错乱、状态空间内不稳定）的问题，用分布式强化学习建模回报不确定性，并设计悲观探索策略，在仿真和真实机器人上提升了任务成功率和失败恢复率。
analysis.claim: 建模人类干预信号的时间与状态不一致性所引发的回报分布偏移，并通过分布式RL+悲观探索实现更鲁棒、样本更高效的人类纠偏学习。
analysis.input: 机器人状态观测 + 稀疏任务奖励 + 不一致的人类干预信号（含延迟和时空不稳定性）
analysis.output: 动作策略（连续控制输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet/Mujoco仿真器 + 2个真实机械臂平台（未具名，但摘要明确提及real-world scenarios）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人工实时干预的真实机器人交互数据，但未说明规模、多样性或是否开源
analysis.significance_reason: 问题切口真实（人类干预不一致是实操痛点），方法有区分度（分布式建模+悲观探索），且在4个仿真任务+2个真实场景上验证了优于RLIF等SOTA，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未披露真实平台型号、干预协议、基线复现细节，也未跨机体泛化（如换臂型）、未做消融验证分布建模与悲观策略各自贡献，整体属扎实增量而非范式突破。
