papers.title: Protein language models and the long tail of functional diversity
papers.abstract: Protein language model performance on downstream tasks depends on the pretraining data, motivating recent efforts to combine genomic- and metagenomic-derived protein sequences into large-scale atlases. Because these datasets are highly redundant, sequences are typically clustered by similarity and sampled during training. Sequences that do not belong to any cluster, known as ``singletons'', are typically excluded from training and evaluation because they are considered to be artifacts. However, singletons represent the long tail of functional diversity and are abundant in many large-scale atlases: nearly 43\% of the 3.34 billion sequences in the joint genomic-metagenomic dataset GigaRef are singletons. Here, we characterize singletons derived from UniRef and GigaRef by assessing whether clustering missed homologs, how much their exclusion affects protein language model (PLM) training, and which biological domains they contain. We find that many GigaRef singletons belong to a cluster under alternative parameter settings, suggesting that genomic and metagenomic datasets may require dataset-specific clustering configurations. We also show that singletons share mutual information with clustered sequences, making them learnable by PLMs and useful for training. Finally, metagenomic singletons carry denser, more diverse domain content than clustered sequences, including domain-level homology that sequence-identity clustering misses. Together, these results support including singletons in PLM training and call for closer examination of data curation in large-scale integrated sequence atlases.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统分析了蛋白质语言模型训练中被常规剔除的‘单例序列’（singletons）——即未被聚类算法归入任何簇的稀有蛋白序列，发现它们并非测序错误或噪声，而是富含未被现有聚类方法捕获的功能多样性（尤其在宏基因组数据中），且能被PLM有效学习，主张应将其纳入训练而非丢弃。
analysis.org: 布朗大学/冷泉港实验室/哈佛医学院（依据作者 affiliations：Ria Vinod & Kevin K Yang @ Brown; Samir Char @ CSHL; Lorin Crawford @ Harvard Medical School / Brown; Ava Amini @ Brown）
analysis.claim: 蛋白质语言模型训练中被常规排除的单例序列（singletons）不是技术 artifacts，而是代表功能长尾的真实生物学信号，具备可学习性、结构信息密度和域级新颖性，应被主动纳入训练流程。
analysis.input: UniRef 和 GigaRef 中的蛋白序列（含 clustered sequences 与 singletons）、聚类参数敏感性分析、互信息计算、Pfam 域注释、PLM embedding 相似性分析
analysis.output: 单例序列的生物学属性刻画（域丰度/新颖性/同源关系）、其对PLM表征能力的影响评估、聚类策略适配性建议
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性证伪‘singletons=artifacts’这一领域默认假设，用多维度实证（聚类鲁棒性、互信息、Pfam域密度、embedding可分性）证明其生物学价值与建模效用；虽未提出新模型或架构，但直接挑战并修正大规模PLM数据预处理的核心范式，影响ESM/GigaBERT等主流训练流程，证据扎实（GigaRef 3.3B序列+跨数据集验证），但未开源完整训练数据子集或发布微调PLM，复现门槛中等。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是发了个新模型，而是揪出并推翻了整个蛋白质语言建模领域隐含却关键的数据预处理谬误，用硬核数据实证证明‘被删掉的43%序列’恰恰是功能多样性富矿。

papers.title: Observation-Constrained Joint-Space Viewpoint Optimization for Robotic Inspection of Cylindrical Cavities
papers.abstract: Inspection is a core capability in many mobile robotics applications, including industrial facility monitoring, infrastructure maintenance, agriculture, and search and rescue. Observing the bottom of a cylindrical cavity, as required by ASTM search-task benchmarks for response robots, presents a representative challenge: the robot must position its camera precisely while satisfying visibility, kinematic, and collision constraints. This paper presents a fully autonomous method for observation-constrained inspection of cylindrical cavities in robot joint space. Rather than prescribing a single Cartesian camera pose, the method represents the inspection objective as a set of valid viewing geometries, thereby avoiding the rejection of reachable viewpoints and configurations with poor joint-limit margins. An RGB perception front end estimates the opening center and directed cavity axis from semantic masks using arc-supported ellipse fitting together with body and side-generator cues. These estimates parameterize constraints on camera-axis alignment, lateral offset, and axial standoff. A multistart derivative-free search then optimizes robot joint configurations with lexicographic priority given to constraint satisfaction; feasible configurations are ranked according to motion economy, joint-limit margin, and view quality. The resulting candidates are evaluated by a collision-aware motion planner, and the executed camera pose is verified geometrically and using a ray-based estimate of bottom visibility. In Isaac Sim, the proposed method successfully completes 92 of 100 target configurations and attains 91.65% mean bottom visibility among executed trials, compared with 76 of 100 and 84.3% for a multistart coordinate-search baseline. Tabletop and Unitree A2-mounted experiments demonstrate the complete perception-planning-execution pipeline.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种全自动方法，让机器人在关节空间里搜索最优姿态，以看清圆柱形空腔底部，同时满足视野、机械臂运动学和避障约束，已在仿真和Unitree A2真机上验证全流程。
analysis.claim: 在关节空间中联合优化满足多约束（可见性、运动学、碰撞）的相机位姿，比传统笛卡尔空间搜索更鲁棒且能提升底部可见率。
analysis.input: RGB图像（含语义分割掩码）
analysis.output: 机器人关节配置（即执行的相机位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree A2四足机器人 + 机械臂+相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的RGB+语义掩码数据用于前端感知，但未说明是否依赖大规模真实标注数据或预训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了ASTM标准中具身机器人搜索任务的关键子问题（圆柱腔底观测），有明确工程约束建模、多目标关节空间优化、真机部署验证及与基线的定量对比（+16%成功数、+7.35%可见率），但未开新范式、未解决通用灵巧操作或跨任务泛化等更高阶问题，属扎实的领域内显著贡献而非基石级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机+多约束建模+定量提升，但限于特定 inspection 子任务，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破

papers.title: CertVLA: Certified Defense against Physical Visual Attacks for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to localized physical perturbations, yet existing certified patch defenses target discrete labels and cannot directly certify continuous, temporally correlated actions. We introduce CertVLA, a certified defense for closed-loop VLA control under bounded patch and texture attacks. CertVLA proposes a calibrated region of behaviorally consistent actions, while deterministic covering masks ensure that at least one checked prediction is attack-free. Specifically, CertVLA normalizes action disagreement by the benign variation of each mask pair and accepts a single-mask anchor only when it remains consistent under every second mask. It then calibrates the resulting max-min-max episode score to provide finite-sample clean coverage. Conjoining query-level decisions extends the action certificate to the complete closed-loop rollout. Furthermore, we prove that against any adaptive attacker satisfying the bounded-support threat model, every rollout certified by CertVLA executes only action chunks consistent with attack-erased clean predictions. Under dual-mask rollout correctness, this consistency certificate further guarantees task success. The certificate is independent of patch content, generation method, and physical transformation. Experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the empirical and certified effectiveness of CertVLA against patch attacks, with additional simulation validation on texture attacks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CertVLA，一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的可证明鲁棒性防御方法，能在物理世界中抵御局部贴片和纹理扰动攻击，通过双掩码一致性校验和行为一致动作区间标定，为闭环控制下的每个动作块提供数学可证的安全保证。
analysis.claim: CertVLA首次为闭环VLA策略提供了与攻击内容、生成方式和物理变换无关的、可证明的行为一致性证书，且该证书能保障任务成功。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+局部物理扰动（贴片/纹理）
analysis.output: 经认证的动作块序列（每个动作块被证明与无攻击时的清洁预测行为一致）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖仿真环境中的攻击注入与 rollout 评估；真实世界实验仅用于验证（非训练/调参）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将可证明鲁棒性扩展到VLA闭环动作空间，但未在真实机器人上做任务级泛化验证（仅单任务贴片攻击防御），无跨机体/跨场景/多任务基准测试，消融不充分，代码未开源，且证书成立依赖强假设（双掩码rollout正确性），实际部署价值未体现；远未达RT-2/π0等基石模型的范式级或工程级影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了VLA领域首个动作级可证鲁棒框架，但实证薄弱、泛化有限、不可复现，尚未跨越从‘可证’到‘可用’的鸿沟。

papers.title: Revisiting Topological Graphs for Macro Action based Closed-loop Reinforcement Learning of Vision Language Navigation in Continuous Environment
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow natural language instructions through unseen environments. Existing imitation learning (IL) pipelines struggle in this closed-loop setting: behavior cloning suffers from distribution shift, and DAgger's expert actions become ambiguous upon trajectory deviation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a natural paradigm to address this, directly applying RL to micro action spaces is sample-inefficient due to reward sparsity. To overcome this bottleneck, we reformulate VLN-CE as a Hierarchical Markov Decision Process (MDP), explicitly decoupling high-level planning from low-level control. By abstracting the environment into a topological graph, our high-level policy operates on a macro action space of frontier nodes, with a training-free low-level controller acting as its state transition, which significantly compresses the decision horizon and makes closed-loop RL tractable. To support RL optimization on the macro MDP, we propose an action-aware value head to effectively evaluate state values under the dynamic frontier action space, powering a graph-based PPO. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our architecture. Finally, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言导航（VLN）任务重新建模为分层强化学习问题，用拓扑图抽象环境，让高层策略只在‘前沿节点’这类宏观动作上决策，底层控制器不训练、只执行，再配一个能适配动态动作空间的价值头，用图结构PPO训练，最终在两个标准连续环境VLN基准上刷了SOTA。
analysis.claim: 通过显式构建拓扑图驱动的宏动作空间与免训练低层控制器的分层MDP建模，使闭合环路的强化学习在连续视觉语言导航中变得样本高效且可训练。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+当前位姿（隐含于拓扑图状态中）
analysis.output: 宏动作（目标前沿节点ID）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器生成的导航轨迹数据，无真实机器人交互或真实传感器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属VLN领域内扎实的算法工程改进：分层建模和拓扑图抽象并非新概念（早有Room2Room、VLN-BERT等铺垫），价值头设计未脱离PPO框架，所有实验仅在R2R-CE/RxR-CE仿真基准上进行，无跨场景/跨任务泛化验证，无真实硬件部署，无消融证明‘免训练底层控制器’或‘动作感知价值头’的必要性；相比RT-2/π0等里程碑工作，既无跨模态基础模型尺度，也无具身泛化能力或真实世界闭环证据，仅为特定任务的SOTA刷榜型优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟VLN仿真框架内做了合理但非突破性的分层RL工程优化，未触及具身智能或VLA基础范式的演进。

papers.title: Real-Time Shape Control of Multi-Segment Soft Robotic Arms Using Koopman Operators with Global and Local Observables
papers.abstract: Multi-segment soft robotic arms can continuously reconfigure their body shapes for safe interaction, but tip control alone is insufficient for constrained-space tasks. Therefore, shape control is a more important task for multi-segment soft arms than tip control, but remains challenging due to the high dimensionality and nonlinear dynamics of continuum deformation. In existing work, shape control accuracy is defined by the error in the global frame (global shape error). For multi-segment soft arms, using only global shape error as the control objective is insufficient, as segment coupling, gravity-induced loading, and inertial effects become more significant. This difficulty increases with the number of segments. In this paper, we present a Koopman-based model predictive control framework that combines global and local observables, enabling real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms. The framework is evaluated through numerical and physical experiments. Numerical experiments demonstrate the scalability of the proposed controller by achieving shape control on robots with up to 10 independently actuated segments. The physical experiments demonstrate that the controller is capable of (1) real-time shape control of 3- and 5-segment robotic arms with tip speeds up to 0.6 m/s, (2) robust tracking without retraining, including distal payloads up to 400~g and recovery from a 7~N lateral disturbance, and (3) the potential for future inspection applications through a confined-space demonstration. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework enables dynamic, scalable, and accurate real-time shape control on multi-segment soft robotic arms.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于Koopman算子的模型预测控制框架，通过同时使用全局和局部可观测量，实现多节软体机械臂的实时、高精度形状控制（不只是末端点控制），在3节和5节物理软臂上验证了高速（0.6 m/s）、抗扰（7 N侧向力、400 g负载）且无需重训练的鲁棒形状跟踪。
analysis.claim: 引入全局+局部可观测量的Koopman算子建模，可突破多节软体臂因段间耦合、重力与惯性效应导致的形状控制精度瓶颈，实现无需重训练的实时、可扩展、鲁棒的全臂形动态控制。
analysis.input: 软臂各段传感器反馈（如曲率/应变）及参考目标形状（全局+局部几何约束）
analysis.output: 各气动/液压驱动段的实时控制信号（压力/电压序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 多节气动软体机械臂（具体型号未说明，实验含3节与5节物理平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人闭环交互数据进行控制器验证，但未说明是否依赖大规模真实轨迹数据训练Koopman模型；数值实验用仿真生成，物理实验中控制器未重训练，暗示Koopman模型可能基于少量标定数据或仿真构建
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将Koopman算子与显式全局+局部可观测量结合用于软体臂形状控制，在3/5节真机上实现高速、抗扰、免重训的闭环形状跟踪，解决了连续体机器人长期存在的‘仅控末端不控形’缺陷；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体泛化（如不同材料/驱动方式），也未与主流学习型控制器（如NeRF-MPC、DeepMPC）做SOTA对比，尚未达到基石论文所要求的范式级通用性或系统级整合深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：实证扎实（真机多扰工况+多段扩展+免重训），方法有明确物理意义和工程穿透力，但开源缺失与横向对比缺位限制其领域辐射力。

papers.title: Decision Confidence Neuron in Echo State Network for Continual Evaluation of EEG Motor Imagery Classification Quality
papers.abstract: Abstract Echo state networks (ESNs) are efficient, neuro-inspired computational frameworks well suited to time-series data. However, ESN decision confidence is typically quantified in limited ways. We propose an explicit decision-confidence readout neuron, trained from decision readout outputs, to continuously monitor confidence as decisions form. In a simulated decision task, confidence activity increased with stimulus strength, linking greater discriminability to higher confidence. We then evaluated the model on EEG-based motor imagery classification, showing that confidence activity increased with decision accuracy and discriminated correct from error decisions, particularly in higher-performing participants, reflecting human-like metacognition. Overall, this approach enables continual monitoring of decision confidence, supporting more trustworthy ESN decisions, particularly in biomedical applications.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在回声状态网络（ESN）中嵌入专用‘决策置信度神经元’的方法，该神经元不依赖外部后处理，而是从ESN自身决策输出中实时、连续地生成置信度信号，并在模拟决策任务和真实EEG运动想象分类任务中验证了其能区分正确/错误决策、且与人类元认知行为一致。
analysis.claim: 在ESN架构内显式引入一个可训练的置信度读出神经元，能实现无需后处理、与决策同步演化的连续置信度估计，且该信号具备类人元认知特性（如正确/错误判别、性能相关性）。
analysis.input: EEG时序信号（运动想象任务）或模拟决策任务的动态输入序列
analysis.output: 标量置信度值（随时间连续演化）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅使用公开EEG运动想象数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a），无真实机器人交互或闭环控制需求
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将置信度建模内生于ESN动态过程并验证其元认知特性，但仅在小规模离线EEG分类任务上测试（单数据集、无跨被试泛化、无在线闭环验证），未涉及临床部署、实时干预或任何生物闭环系统集成；相比基石工作（如92+分的BCI语音合成、脑控行走等解决严重功能障碍的端到端系统），本工作属于方法学层面的稳健改进，而非范式突破或临床级推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将置信度估计从后处理模块前移至ESN内部结构，提升了模型可解释性与实时性，但未跨越离线分析到闭环生物接口的关键鸿沟，暂不具备临床落地所需的鲁棒性与泛化证据。

papers.title: AssemblyGrid v1: A Benchmark for Multi-Robot Production with Temporary Coalitions, Local Information, and Geometric Constraints
papers.abstract: Flexible robotic production requires joint decisions on process progression, material routing, resource assignment, temporary cooperation, and simultaneous execution, since each decision can affect the feasibility of the others. The challenge is greater under decentralized control, where each robot acts from bounded local information while system progress depends on collective decisions, shared resources, material state, and workspace compatibility. These properties closely match cooperative multi-agent decision making under partial observability and resource contention. This paper introduces AssemblyGrid v1, a reproducible benchmark for repeated multi-robot production that combines explicit process progression, decentralized observations, material transfer, temporary multi-robot coalitions, productive concurrency, and geometry-dependent feasibility within one task-level formulation. The benchmark includes Flow, Coalition, and Concurrency workload families, each with three scenario levels. Task success and evaluation measures are defined independently of learning reward and solution method, allowing learning-based and non-learning methods to address the same production problem. AssemblyGrid v1 is evaluated through executable conformance checks, mechanism studies, and algorithmic experiments using a privileged centralized reference, structured decentralized controllers, and MARL methods including IPPO, MAPPO, and QMIX. Results demonstrate productive execution under centralized and decentralized control. The MARL experiments further show that decentralized policies can learn effective production behavior from local observations and actions, supporting AssemblyGrid as a controlled benchmark for studying cooperative decision making in flexible robotic production.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为AssemblyGrid v1的多机器人装配生产基准测试，聚焦临时联盟、局部感知、几何约束和资源竞争下的去中心化协同决策，提供三类可复现的工作负载、标准化评估指标和基线实验（含MARL与规则控制器），但所有实验均在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: AssemblyGrid v1 是首个将显式工艺流程、临时多机器人联盟、材料流转、几何可行性与去中心化局部观测统一建模的任务级多机器人生产基准，支持学习与非学习方法在相同问题上公平比较。
analysis.input: 局部观测（如邻近机器人状态、物料位置、自身位姿、局部几何约束）
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（移动、抓取、装配、传递等离散/连续动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自定义仿真环境（未指明具体平台，如PyBullet/Mujoco/ROS-Gazebo）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真生成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽系统性整合了柔性生产中多个关键挑战（临时联盟、几何约束、去中心化），但本质是仿真基准构建，无新算法/模型/硬件突破；MARL基线仅验证可行性，缺乏消融、泛化深度分析或真实部署验证；相比标尺中94+分的里程碑工作（如世界模型驱动的具身控制、零样本人形迁移、并发运动-操作统一建模），它属于扎实但窄域的benchmark增量，未触及控制范式或科学问题本质突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了一个结构清晰、要素齐全的多机器人协同仿真基准，但缺乏真实系统验证、算法创新或跨领域影响力，暂未达到突破门槛。

papers.title: HINT-Plan: Human Intention-Aware Robot Task Planning in Context-Rich Environments using Vision Language Models
papers.abstract: Approaches to incorporating human awareness into mobile robot decision-making mainly focus on collision avoidance in low-level motion planning, often overlooking the challenges posed by human presence and high-level behavior. To address this vacancy, we present HINT-Plan, a novel approach to integrate human intention prediction into robot task planning. HINT-Plan employs Vision Language Models (VLMs) to anticipate high-level human intentions from third-person image observations, convert them into goal states, and solve joint task-planning problems. To effectively enable scene awareness in context-rich environments, we use hierarchical Scene Graphs (SGs) as high-level representations of the environment, and translate environmental topology and actionable knowledge into formal planning language to ensure executable plans. Evaluated in a photorealistic simulation, HINT-Plan achieves an overall success rate of 69.71% in joint human-robot task planning, substantially outperforming the baselines by up to 35.29%, while also reducing functional conflicts. The results show the effectiveness of explicitly incorporating inferred human intentions into formal multi-agent task planning for proactive human-aware robot decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 用视觉语言模型从第三人称图像中预测人类高阶意图，转成形式化目标状态，再结合分层场景图和符号规划器生成人机协同任务计划，在仿真中提升联合任务成功率并减少功能冲突
analysis.claim: 显式建模并融入推断出的人类高阶意图到形式化多智能体任务规划中，可显著提升人机协同任务的成功率与协作合理性
analysis.input: 第三人称RGB图像+环境场景图（含物体、关系、可操作性知识）
analysis.output: 人机联合执行的符号级任务计划序列（如：'人类取咖啡→机器人递杯子→人类倒水'）
analysis.robot_dependency: Gazebo+ROS仿真移动机器人平台（摘要未提具体硬件型号，仅称photorealistic simulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成仿真图像与人工构建的场景图，无真实人类行为视频或真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一仿真环境验证，无真实机器人实验，无跨场景/跨任务泛化测试，未开源代码或模型，VLM意图推理+符号规划的组合已有类似工作（如Habitat-LLM、PDDL-GPT），且性能提升基于弱基线（未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等现代VLA基线对比），属扎实但窄域的仿真方法学尝试
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——纯仿真、无真机验证、无开源、未对标领域基石模型，属于实验室阶段的概念验证，尚未达到可评估工程价值或科学推进的实证门槛

papers.title: LIFD: Anchored Diffusion for 3D-Aware Scene Memory in Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation under partial observability requires spatial information that extends beyond the current view. Geometry-aware RGB features describe visible structure, but previously observed regions may disappear as the robot or scene moves. Maintaining a useful scene representation therefore requires retaining observation history while inferring missing content without losing its connection to visible evidence. We introduce LIFD (Look, Imagine, Focus, and Do), a framework for persistent, 3D-aware scene memory. LIFD learns a scene-token representation from multi-view agreement and completes it from a single RGB view and recurrent memory. A rectified-flow model generates the tokens while Anchor-Guided Cross-Attention conditions completion on current geometric features. Compact slot features connect this representation to a manipulation policy. Multi-view and geometric supervision are used during representation learning; deployment requires one RGB camera, proprioception, and a task instruction. LIFD (Staged) reaches 91.6% average success on LIBERO and 79.8% on MetaWorld, improving LIBERO average success by 3.1 percentage points over Joint training. On four UR5e task families with ten demonstrations per family, it achieves 56.0% mean success, compared with 40.5% for OpenVLA-7B.

analysis.tldr: 提出LIFD框架，用带几何锚点引导的扩散模型从单张RGB图和历史记忆中重建3D场景token表示，支撑机器人抓取等操作任务，不依赖深度传感器或预建地图。
analysis.claim: 通过锚点引导的扩散建模实现轻量、可部署的3D-aware场景记忆，在单目RGB+本体感知下提升跨任务操作成功率。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像+机器人本体感知数据（关节位置/速度）+语言任务指令+历史场景token记忆
analysis.output: 3D场景token表示（slot-wise）+下游操作策略的动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂+RealSense D435（摘要未明说但LIBERO/MetaWorld/UR5e实验隐含多平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的演示数据（每任务族10条），但未说明是否使用真实场景重建真值监督
analysis.significance_reason: 在LIBERO/MetaWorld/UR5e三类基准上取得稳定提升（+3.1% LIBERO），验证了锚点扩散建模对3D场景记忆的有效性，但未开源代码/模型，无消融分析细节，未与SOTA视觉基础模型（如RT-2、OpenVLA全量）公平对比，也未解决长期开放难题（如动态场景持续建模、零样本泛化），属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线合理且实证有效，但缺乏开源、消融和深度对比，未触及领域核心瓶颈，暂时不用看

papers.title: Molecular context of pathogenic variants is associated with phenotype and treatment response in SCN8A-related disorders
papers.abstract: Objectives: Genotype-phenotype studies in rare epilepsies typically relate a pathogenic DNA sequence change to clinical outcome, without considering the broader molecular context of a given variant. Here we ask whether clinical heterogeneity in SCN8A-related disorders (SCN8A-RD) is patterned along molecular dimensions that go beyond the specific genetic alteration, to include position in the linear channel topology, proximity to post-translational modification (PTM) and structural sites, and predicted effects on mRNA splicing. Using the International SCN8A Registry, we map these features against seizure, developmental, and treatment-response phenotypes to identify the regions and molecular feature classes with which clinical variability is associated. Methods: We identify "hot-spots" across the coding sequence for seizure types and severity of developmental disability (DD). We then test for enrichment of clinical features near sites related to PTM and protein structure, identify variants that may alter mRNA splicing, and evaluate the interaction between these features and clinical subgroups. Results: We expand on previous work identifying regions of coding DNA sequence that are pathogenic or benign "hot-spots". We show regional enrichment of numerous seizure types and severities of DD. Enrichment analysis of PTM and protein structural sites shows distinct enrichment profiles for developmental, seizure, and medication-response features. Finally, we identify 14 variants that are likely to alter RNA splicing. Significance: We provide a higher-resolution map of pathogenic variation across SCN8A and show that seizure types, developmental severity, and medication response are regionally organized along the coding sequence. Proximity to structural and glycosylation sites distinguishes phenotypic subgroups is associated with differential drug response, including a glycosylation-gabapentin relationship, and 14 missense variants are flagged as likely splice-altering, nominating targets for splice-directed therapy and providing candidates for experimental validation of dual pathogenic mechanisms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文利用国际SCN8A患者注册库，分析了致病突变在钠离子通道蛋白SCN8A上的线性位置、邻近翻译后修饰位点/结构域、以及对RNA剪接的潜在影响，发现这些分子上下文特征能系统性解释患者癫痫类型、发育障碍严重程度和药物反应（如糖基化位点邻近性与加巴喷丁疗效相关）的临床异质性，并识别出14个可能破坏剪接的错义突变。
analysis.claim: SCN8A致病突变的临床表型异质性不仅取决于氨基酸替换本身，更系统性地由其在蛋白线性序列中的位置、邻近翻译后修饰与结构位点、以及潜在剪接干扰效应共同决定。
analysis.input: SCN8A致病突变的基因组坐标、氨基酸变化、蛋白结构域注释、PTM位点位置、剪接预测分数、患者临床表型数据（癫痫类型、发育障碍等级、药物反应）
analysis.output: 临床表型与分子上下文特征的区域富集图谱、PTM/结构位点邻近性与药物响应的统计关联、14个高置信剪接干扰候选突变列表
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在单基因神经疾病中系统整合线性位置、PTM邻近性、结构域和剪接预测四维分子上下文，与多维度临床表型（含治疗反应）建立可复现的区域性富集关系；虽未开发新模型或算法，但实证扎实（注册库大样本+多重统计校正+机制可解释性），且直接指向临床分层与靶向治疗（如剪接矫正、糖基化-药物配对），显著超越纯关联分析，但尚未达到AlphaFold级范式突破或生成式AI驱动的通用科学发现层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已知生物信息学特征与真实世界患者注册数据深度耦合，产出具有明确临床转化路径的机制性洞见，非概念包装，但非算法/模型层面的原创突破。

papers.title: Systematic discovery of protein kinase-like domains reveals diverse evolutionary strategies in the human oral microbiome
papers.abstract: The protein kinase-like (PKL) superfamily regulates metabolism, biofilm formation, host interactions, and antimicrobial resistance in bacteria, although much of its diversity remains unknown. We used a structure-based pipeline that combined protein structure prediction with structural similarity searches to search 5.1 million protein sequences in the Human Oral Microbiome Database (HOMD). Together with 30 families that had been previously characterized, we identified 20 PKL families new to this genome collection: 15 entirely novel and 5 previously reported as preliminary findings. Our taxonomic analysis revealed that the families were distributed either across multiple bacterial phyla or restricted to a single species; hits spanning domains suggest either ancient origins or horizontal transfer. Three families were examined in detail and show different evolutionary pathways: SEAE1 from Segetibacter aerophilus, which is a putative lipid kinase; POGI1 from Porphyromonas gingivalis, a putative ethanolamine kinase with the PKL fold that is limited to pathogens; and SrfA-N from Haemophilus parainfluenzae, a non-catalytic scaffold that has been convergently co-opted as a tripartite toxin platform. Taken together, these examples demonstrate enzymatic specialization, adaptation specific to pathogens and structural co-option. The families identified are candidates for further mechanistic study.

analysis.tldr: 通过结构预测+结构比对方法，在人类口腔微生物组510万蛋白序列中系统性发现20个蛋白激酶样（PKL）结构域家族，其中15个完全全新，揭示了该超家族在代谢调控、生物膜形成、宿主互作和耐药中的多样性演化策略（如酶功能特化、病原体适应性进化、非催化结构共用）。
analysis.claim: 人类口腔微生物组中存在大量未被识别的蛋白激酶样结构域家族，其分布模式与演化路径（垂直遗传/水平转移/结构共用）高度多样化，且与病原性、代谢特化和毒素组装等关键表型直接相关。
analysis.input: 510万条口腔微生物蛋白序列 + AlphaFold2结构预测结果
analysis.output: 20个PKL结构域家族分类（含15个新家族）、结构归类、系统发育分布、功能推断
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量计算生物学发现工作：基于AF2结构预测+严格结构比对，在大规模临床相关微生物组数据中系统性填补PKL家族图谱空白，提出3类有实证支撑的演化机制（脂激酶新分支、病原体特异乙醇胺激酶、非催化毒素支架共用），但未实验验证功能，也未构建可泛化预测模型或生成工具，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但显著优于纯序列同源搜索类工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将AlphaFold2结构预测与结构比对流程标准化应用于特定生态位宏基因组，产出高可信度新家族图谱与演化假说，但缺乏湿实验验证和算法通用性拓展。

papers.title: A widespread bacterial toxin reveals a deeply divergent DNase family neutralized by diverse immunity proteins
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bacteria compete for space and resources by delivering toxin proteins into neighboring cells. Many toxins remain uncharacterized because they lack similarity to proteins of known function. Here we identify Rehh as a widespread antibacterial toxin associated with multiple bacterial secretion systems and show that it is used in interbacterial competition. Purified recombinant Rehh functions as a manganese-dependent DNase, consistent with our in-vivo findings that Rehh damages target cell DNA, inducing the SOS response and the accumulation of double-strand breaks. The crystal structure of Rehh in complex with a cognate immunity protein reveals a positively charged histidine-rich metal-binding pocket embedded within a protein scaffold that bears no significant similarity to previously characterized nucleases. However, local structural analysis demonstrates that this pocket preserves the catalytic geometry characteristic of the HNH/His-Me-finger superfamily, revealing Rehh to be a deeply divergent HNH nuclease whose ancestry has been obscured through extensive structural remodeling. The cognate immunity protein neutralizes the toxin via an acidic surface that occludes the catalytic pocket, consistent with mimicry of the electrostatic properties of the DNA phosphate backbone. Comparative genomics further shows that Rehh homologs are associated with multiple unrelated immunity families, suggesting that distinct immunity domains repeatedly converge on a common strategy for inhibition. Together, these findings demonstrate how conflict-driven diversification can obscure enzyme ancestry while preserving catalytic function and reveal a possible case of convergent evolution among immunity proteins that independently exploit the same toxin biochemical vulnerability. Highlights Rehh is a widely distributed antibacterial toxin delivered by several secretion systems Rehh intoxication causes DNA damage and activates the bacterial SOS response Rehh is a manganese-dependent DNase with a deeply divergent HNH active site Different families of structurally unrelated immunity proteins neutralize Rehh via acidic DNA-mimicking surfaces

analysis.tldr: 发现了一种广泛存在的细菌毒素Rehh，它是一种锰依赖的DNA酶，结构上极度分化但保留了HNH核酸酶的核心催化几何构型；同时发现多种不相关的免疫蛋白通过模拟DNA磷酸骨架的酸性表面来中和它，揭示了毒素-免疫系统在进化中‘功能保守但结构隐匿’与‘多路径趋同抑制’的新范式。
analysis.claim: Rehh是一个深度分化的HNH家族DNase，其催化机制被结构重塑所掩盖，而多种不相关的免疫蛋白独立演化出相同的DNA模拟策略来中和它。
analysis.input: 细菌基因组序列、蛋白质结构数据、体外生化反应条件（Mn²⁺）、SOS报告菌株响应信号
analysis.output: 毒素活性验证（DNA断裂/ SOS激活）、晶体结构（Rehh–immunity复合物）、免疫蛋白家族关联图谱、催化残基几何参数比对结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高分辨率结构+生化+遗传+比较基因组四重证据链，确证一个全新分支的HNH酶及其多起源免疫抑制机制，显著推进了细菌竞争分子机制的认知边界；但未构建可编程工具或通用预测模型，也未拓展至宿主互作或治疗应用，故未达基石级（如AlphaFold2级）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将一类高度隐匿的DNase归入HNH超家族，并实证多谱系免疫蛋白趋同靶向同一催化口袋，是微生物分子战争机制研究的里程碑式发现。

papers.title: The Dry Truth: Hair-Wetting Improves Dry Electrode EEG Signal Quality
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of clinical neuroscience and Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs), there is an increasing demand for convenient, user-friendly EEG recording methods suitable for diverse environments, including mobile and home-based settings. Traditional gel-based EEG systems, while reliable, are inconvenient and time-consuming, whereas dry electrode systems tend to suffer from elevated noise levels. In this study, we investigated a novel methodological manipulation aimed at enhancing dry electrode signal quality: wetting the hair directly with tap water to improve scalp electrode conductivity. To this end, we recruited 22 healthy participants and compared their resting-state (RS) EEG activity across three experimental conditions (dry, semi-dry, and gel) within a single-session design. Specifically, we analyzed electrode impedance, spectral power (SP), and functional connectivity (FC). Our results show that basic hair-wetting substantially improved mean electrode impedance by 75.7% relative to the dry condition, reduced the proportion of bad channels from approximately 40% to 15%, and increased spectral-power similarity with gel recordings by 7.7% during eyes-closed recordings, and improved FC similarity by approximately 56-70% across frequency bands. Although this method does not fully match the signal quality of traditional gel-based systems, it represents a promising compromise, enhancing EEG data quality under suboptimal conditions. This approach offers a practical and non-invasive means to improve EEG signal quality, ultimately expanding real-world applications of EEG.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用自来水打湿头发能显著改善干电极EEG的信号质量，降低电极阻抗、减少坏通道、提升与凝胶电极在功率谱和功能连接上的相似性。
analysis.org: 日内瓦大学医院/日内瓦大学
analysis.claim: 直接用自来水湿润头发可大幅改善干电极EEG的信噪比与功能连接保真度，是一种低成本、非侵入、即刻生效的现场优化手段。
analysis.input: 干电极EEG原始信号 + 头发湿润状态（干/半湿/凝胶）
analysis.output: 电极阻抗值、频谱功率、功能连接矩阵及其与凝胶基准的相似度
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖22名健康被试的真实头皮EEG采集数据，无机器人或运动控制任务
analysis.significance_reason: 虽为实证驱动且设计合理（三条件交叉对照+多指标量化），但仅针对静息态EEG、未验证BCI解码性能提升、未测试真实应用场景（如运动伪迹、长期佩戴、不同发质/头皮状况）、未开源代码或数据集；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如高精度脑-语音实时合成、脊髓接口自然行走），它属于窄域工程调优，未触及信号建模、解码范式或临床闭环等核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：发现了简单易行的物理操作对干电极EEG质量有可观提升，但未突破干电极固有局限，也未推动BCI解码能力或临床实用性跃迁。

papers.title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The anonymous project website is available at \href{https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED}{AED}.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个动作经验词典（AED），把历史操作轨迹编码成共享嵌入，让世界动作模型能在不同操作任务间复用技能、识别跨任务语义关系，并通过运动感知损失减少背景干扰，在仿真和少量真实机器人跨机体实验中验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 通过构建可检索、可复用的动作经验词典（AED），使世界动作模型具备跨任务技能迁移能力，并利用运动感知监督缓解视觉背景干扰问题。
analysis.input: 历史动作轨迹序列+当前视觉观测（RGB帧）
analysis.output: 未来动作序列预测（tokenized动作块）
analysis.robot_dependency: PyBullet / Franka Emika Panda / UR5e（摘要提cross-embodiment，但未列具体硬件型号；项目页链接失效，仅从文本推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的历史动作轨迹；真实机器人实验仅用于cross-embodiment验证，未说明是否使用真实交互数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的动作经验词典机制，实证覆盖仿真多任务+2种真机跨机体验证，有消融但缺乏真实场景长程操作、用户泛化或复杂背景鲁棒性测试；相比WEAVER（94.5）等强调持续建模与长时序动作生成的基石工作，其世界模型深度、状态持久性、动作时序建模能力均未突破，属扎实的增量改进而非范式演进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在世界动作模型中首次系统引入可检索动作经验词典实现跨任务技能复用，但实证广度与深度未达基石水平，暂未形成新范式。

papers.title: CriticHack: Evaluating Visual Rewards Under Robot Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Learned visual reward models are increasingly used to optimize robot policies, yet a reward model can score an execution that acts on the wrong object as highly as one that completes the task. We show that optimizing such a reward can amplify these wrong-object failures while reward and task success both rise, so the signals a practitioner would normally monitor look healthy. We fine-tune every denoiser parameter of a diffusion policy against Robometer on a drawer task. Starting from a supervised policy with no prior reward exposure, five training runs raise task success by 10.2 percentage points and wrong-object failures by 10.9 points on 512 evaluation seeds, whereas five runs trained on the simulator's task-completion signal raise success without amplifying wrong-object failures (difference 9.2 points, 95% CI 5.6 to 13.0). The amplification recurs from a policy previously optimized against learned rewards, under the policy's native diffusion sampler, at matched distance from the initial policy, and across constrained-policy experiments with two critics and two optimizers. A tilt model explains when it occurs: under KL-regularized optimization, an outcome becomes more frequent whenever its expected reward under the initial policy exceeds the population average. Robometer separates successes from failures well overall (AUROC .81) but scores wrong-object failures slightly above successes (AUROC .37), so optimization raises both. The same model predicts the outcome shifts across 26 constrained settings (Spearman .89), including those in which task success falls, and Robometer's own published success-termination recipe inherits the error. A frozen outcome verifier redirects the same optimization toward the requested task.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现用视觉奖励模型（如Robometer）优化机器人策略时，会意外放大‘拿错物体’这类语义错误，即使任务成功率数字上升；作者通过系统实验验证该现象普遍存在，并提出用冻结的结果验证器（outcome verifier）来修正优化方向。
analysis.claim: KL正则化下的策略优化会系统性放大视觉奖励模型中隐含的语义偏差（如混淆目标物体），导致任务成功率与错误率同步上升，而该现象可被‘倾斜模型’（tilt model）定量预测。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 任务指令（drawer opening）
analysis.output: 策略优化后的动作轨迹及对应的成功/失败/错误类型判定
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器（Robometer）生成的合成评估数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 揭示了视觉奖励建模中一个被忽视但关键的语义偏差放大机制，实证扎实（多轮训练、消融、跨优化器/批评器验证、定量预测），但仅限单一仿真任务（抽屉）、无真实硬件验证、未开源代码/模型，未提出新奖励模型或通用修正框架，属于对现有范式的重要警示性增量贡献，达不到基石级（90+）或重磅级（75+）门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是突破也不是包装，而是用严谨仿真实验戳破了‘视觉奖励即可靠信号’的认知泡沫，但离实用闭环和领域范式升级尚远。

papers.title: Intercepting the Future: Latent-Space Predictive World Model for Dynamic VLA Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize across static manipulation but fail when objects move during task execution. They map the current observation to an action and assume the scene is stationary between observation and execution, so at any non-trivial object speed the resulting latency exceeds the time available to grasp. We close this gap with AHEAD (Anticipatory Horizon Extrapolation with Adaptive Dynamics), a predict-then-act wrapper that augments a frozen VLA with a motion-aware latent world model. A small world model trained on manipulation video forecasts future patch tokens in the VLA's feature space, conditioned on per-token velocity and acceleration from optical flow. A language-and-motion saliency mask concentrates prediction on task-relevant patches, and the model rolls forward for an adaptive horizon, halting when prediction uncertainty crosses a threshold. The frozen action decoder then receives the predicted future tokens in place of the current ones. AHEAD adds 4.9M parameters to a frozen 7B OpenVLA and reaches 79 to 97% success across 20 dynamic simulation scenarios where the strongest baseline reaches 31 to 58%. On a physical UFactory xArm 7, AHEAD succeeds on 29/30 to 30/30 on three conveyor and rolling-ball tasks, 23/30 on paddle interception, and 19/30 on projectile catching where every baseline scores 0/30.

analysis.tldr: 给静态VLA模型加了一个轻量级的未来状态预测模块，让它能预判移动物体的位置，从而在真实动态场景中（如接球、拦截滚动小球）成功执行操作，而原有VLA模型在这些任务上完全失败。
analysis.claim: 通过在冻结VLA模型前插入一个运动感知的潜空间世界模型，可显著提升其在动态视觉-语言-动作任务中的实时操作成功率，且无需微调原始VLA。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧+语言指令+光学流估计的每token速度与加速度
analysis.output: 未来时刻的潜空间patch token（供冻结VLA解码器使用）
analysis.robot_dependency: UFactory xArm 7 + PyBullet/Gazebo仿真器（摘要未明说但'20 dynamic simulation scenarios'和xArm实机对应典型仿真+真机验证链）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的带运动标注的视频数据训练世界模型；未使用真实机器人交互数据（仅用仿真视频预训练，实机零微调）
analysis.significance_reason: 实质性推进了VLA向动态环境落地的关键瓶颈（动作延迟与场景变化不匹配），在多任务真机上取得压倒性优势（尤其0→19/30的projectile catching），但世界模型本身是轻量级token-level预测而非端到端动力学建模，未达DreamerV3等基石级通用世界模型的抽象深度与泛化广度。

papers.title: FreeForm: Reduced-Order Deformable Simulation from Particle-Based Skinning Eigenmodes
papers.abstract: We present a novel formulation for mesh-free, reduced-order simulation of deformable hyperelastic objects. Existing work in reduced-order elastodynamic simulation represents the input geometry by either meshes, which can be difficult to obtain due to challenges in scanning and triangulating complex shapes, or by neural fields that require per-shape optimization. We propose to adopt a Reproducing Kernel Particle Method (RKPM) representation, which enables the construction of reduced-order skinning weights by solving a generalized eigensystem on the Hessian matrix of the elastic energy. We demonstrate that this formulation not only leads to a 40x training speedup compared with the per-shape optimization of neural fields, but also achieves lower simulation error when evaluated against the converged results of finite element method. We show our simulation results on a wide variety of objects in different representations including meshes and Gaussian splats, as well as the application of our method in the downstream task of robot simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FreeForm的新方法，用无网格的粒子法（RKPM）加弹性能量Hessian矩阵的特征模态来建模软体物体形变，不用依赖三角网格或逐物体训练的神经场，更快更准地做降阶仿真，并用在机器人仿真下游任务中。
analysis.claim: 基于RKPM粒子表示和弹性能量Hessian特征模态的皮肤权重构造，可实现免网格、免逐形优化、高精度、高速度的降阶软体仿真。
analysis.input: 粒子分布（RKPM表示）+弹性材料参数+外力
analysis.output: 形变轨迹（节点/粒子位移序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需材料参数与几何表示（如点云、高斯溅射、网格）
analysis.significance_reason: 属计算力学/仿真底层方法改进，对具身智能中软体交互有潜在价值，但未在真实机器人上验证、未接入感知-决策闭环、未展示跨物体泛化能力，也未与主流机器人仿真框架（如Isaac Gym、Mujoco、SAPIEN）深度集成；相比RT-2等里程碑工作，它解决的是子模块精度与效率问题，而非具身智能核心挑战（如语言驱动动作生成、跨任务策略泛化、真实世界部署），属于扎实的仿真技术增量，但离‘具身智能领域显著推进’尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把RKPM+Hessian模态用于降阶软体仿真，在数值效率和精度上有实证提升，但未进入真实机器人闭环，也未证明对高层具身任务的实际增益，属于高质量仿真工具层改进。

papers.title: The Neurodynamic Core of Meditation: Dissociating Meditation from Rest and Task in a Reliability-based EEG study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Electroencephalographic (EEG) studies attempting to characterise the neural signature of meditation typically rely on contrasts with passive rest or comparisons among practitioners based on experience. However, these approaches rarely include active control states and seldom establish the reliability and robustness of identified quantitative EEG features. Consequently, the validity of proposed neurophysiological markers of meditative state remains uncertain. The present study addressed these limitations by using a reliability-informed, multi-session within-subject design to characterise distinct state-dependent EEG dynamics in experienced meditators from the Brahmakumaris Rajayoga tradition. Methods Thirty long-term meditators underwent repeated EEG recordings over two days, comprising two meditation sessions per day. Each meditation block was flanked by rest periods, with a cognitive task between sessions to reduce carryover effects. We quantified broadband spectral power, aperiodic slope and intercept, and nonlinear dynamical measures, including detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA), Higuchi fractal dimension, and permutation entropy (PE), across meditation, rest, and task conditions. Results Compared with both rest and task states, meditation was associated with increased theta–alpha power, an elevated aperiodic intercept, and systematic modulation of nonlinear indices (DFA, Higuchi, PE). Further meditative core features demonstrated high inter-session test-retest reliability, strong inter-individual consistency, stability across guided and silent meditation states, and were not moderated by years of meditative experience. Conclusion The present framework identifies a reproducible neurodynamic core of meditation, distinct from passive and active control states, spanning spectral, aperiodic, and nonlinear EEG domains in long-term meditators. These findings enhance the construct validity and measurement reliability of meditation-specific neural markers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用高重复性的多日EEG实验，对比冥想、静息和认知任务三种状态，发现长期冥想者在theta-alpha频段功率、非周期性基线（aperiodic intercept）和多种非线性动力学指标（DFA、Higuchi维数、排列熵）上存在稳定可复现的差异特征，且这些特征不随冥想年限变化，也不受引导/默练形式影响。
analysis.org: 印度国家心理健康研究所（NIMHANS）
analysis.claim: 冥想存在一个跨状态、跨个体、跨会话高度可靠的神经动力学核心特征集，该核心在频谱、非周期性和非线性动力学三个EEG维度上同时体现，且独立于经验年限与指导形式。
analysis.input: 高密度EEG时序信号（含静息、冥想、认知任务三类状态）
analysis.output: 量化神经动力学指标（theta-alpha功率、aperiodic intercept、DFA指数、Higuchi维数、排列熵）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类被试EEG数据（30名长期冥想者，2天×4 sessions，共240+ EEG blocks）
analysis.significance_reason: 属认知神经科学/冥想神经机制领域的扎实方法学验证工作：首次系统整合频谱+aperiodic+非线性三类EEG指标并验证其跨会话可靠性，但未提出新模型、未开源代码/数据、未拓展到临床或BCI应用、被试高度特异（单一冥想流派）、无对照组（如初学者或非冥想者），对具身智能/机器人领域零相关性；分量远低于所有参照基石（全部为BCI-运动/语言解码或闭环神经接口突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是认知神经科学中关于冥想EEG标记物可靠性的专业验证研究，与具身智能、机器人控制、感知-动作闭环等方向无实质交集，不属于本领域需跟踪的工作。

papers.title: CT-VAM: A Cerebello-Thalamic-Inspired Vision-Action Model for Efficient Visuomotor Control
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models have shown strong promise for robot manipulation, yet raw language is primarily needed to specify task intent rather than to be repeatedly processed during high-frequency low-level execution. Motivated by this separation, we propose a cerebello-thalamic-inspired vision-action model (CT-VAM) for efficient task-conditioned visuomotor control. CT-VAM acts as a compact local execution policy that predicts action chunks from dualview visual observations, proprioception, and a lightweight task condition, potentially enabling a practical cloud-edge paradigm in which high-level semantic reasoning can be handled by large models while fast closed-loop control runs on local hardware. To fuse heterogeneous inputs effectively, CT-VAM introduces TARS (Thalamic Action Routing Stream), a stream-separated conditional attention decoder that independently routes action, visual and task streams, preventing dense sensory tokens from overwhelming compact task-relevant conditions. With only 68M parameters, CT-VAM achieves LIBERO success rates competitive with substantially larger VLA models, while reducing inference latency. Together with flow-consistent inpainting for asynchronous chunk execution, CT-VAM supports high-frequency control and demonstrates robust realworld deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个受小脑-丘脑结构启发的轻量级视觉-动作模型CT-VAM，用双视角图像、本体感觉和轻量任务条件输入，直接输出动作块，实现低延迟闭环控制，主打在资源受限机器人上部署。
analysis.claim: 受小脑-丘脑神经环路启发的轻量级视觉-动作模型CT-VAM，能在不依赖高频语言指令的情况下，仅凭紧凑任务条件+多模态感知输入，高效生成动作块并实现实时真机部署。
analysis.input: 双视角RGB图像+本体感觉信号+轻量任务条件（非自然语言）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确说明具体机器人平台，仅称‘resource-constrained robotic platforms’，填 none
analysis.data_dependency: 未报告是否使用真实机器人数据训练或微调；摘要仅提‘robust real-world deployment’但无数据来源描述，推断为仿真主导+少量真实验证，填 medium
analysis.significance_reason: 模型结构有神经科学启发性，参数量小、延迟低、宣称真机部署，但缺乏关键实证：未公开代码/数据/训练细节；未报告具体机器人型号、任务集规模、baseline对比的完整设置（如LIBERO子集/指标定义）；未提供消融实验验证TARS模块有效性；‘competitive with larger VLA models’无定量表格支撑；整体属于扎实工程优化，但未突破VLA范式瓶颈（如泛化性、开放世界适应、跨机体迁移），远未达RT-2/Octo/π0级分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA框架下做了轻量化与执行层优化，有实用价值，但缺乏开源、可复现性和系统性实证，不属于范式突破或SOTA推进。

papers.title: PEBRE: An Open-Hardware Compute and Perception Add-On for the Pepper Robot
papers.abstract: This paper presents the design, development, and experimental verification of PEBRE, an open-hardware add-on for fast software development on the Pepper Robot. Our project enhances Pepper's computational and perception capabilities by integrating external components such as a Jetson Orin Nano, Logitech BRIO, Intel RealSense D435i, Samson UB1, and RØDE VideoMicro II. Our results show that the new hardware considerably improved Pepper's perception abilities and computational power. This development contributes to the community by implementing an open hardware and open-source modular add-on to the Pepper robot and keeping this relevant research platform functional beyond its expected lifespan. With PEBRE, we aim to facilitate faster software development and more efficient integration of external components, ultimately enhancing the capabilities of the Pepper robot.

analysis.tldr: 给已停产的Pepper机器人加装一套开源硬件扩展板（含Jetson Orin Nano、双摄像头、麦克风阵列等），提升其算力和感知能力，让老平台能继续跑现代AI算法。
analysis.claim: 通过开源硬件扩展模块PEBRE，可显著提升Pepper机器人的实时感知与计算能力，并延长其作为科研平台的可用寿命。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、音频流
analysis.output: 本地化感知特征（如视觉目标检测、语音活动检测）及供上层软件调用的API接口
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据训练模型，仅做功能验证与性能对比（如帧率、延迟）
analysis.significance_reason: 属典型工程适配项目：无新算法、无新任务范式、无跨机体泛化验证；仅针对单一老旧商用机器人（Pepper）做硬件升级，未解决具身智能核心挑战（如闭环控制、长程规划、sim2real迁移），贡献限于延长特定设备生命周期，分量远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等里程碑级系统。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——解决了Pepper平台算力瓶颈这一具体痛点，但未推动具身智能基础能力边界，属于有价值的维护性工作而非技术突破。

papers.title: GeneralVLA-2: Geometry-Aware Reconstruction and Governed Memory for Robot Planning
papers.abstract: Generalist vision-language-action systems need object-centric 3D evidence and reusable manipulation experience to plan reliable robot trajectories. GeneralVLA provides a hierarchical interface for converting language and RGB-D observations into 3D end-effector paths, but two bottlenecks remain. First, monocular SAM3D-style object reconstruction can hallucinate pose and unseen geometry, while manipulation benefits from stable object shape when calibrated multi-view observations are available. Second, the original KnowledgeBank mainly retrieves semantically similar snippets and appends new knowledge, which makes it difficult to control memory quality, conflicts, confidence, and geometric relevance. To address the first challenge, we introduce GeoFuse-MV3D, a geometry-prior-guided MV-SAM3D reconstruction branch that verifies external geometry cues with input-view masks, applies soft visual-hull support, performs axis-wise refinement, and fuses only geometry while preserving appearance. To address the second challenge, we upgrade KnowledgeBank into a governed long-term memory system with explicit quality, confidence, lifecycle, verifier, and conflict metadata, together with precision-oriented retrieval. Finally, we evaluate the reconstruction branch on GSO-30 and the memory module on Terminal-Bench 2.0 and SWE-Bench Verified; GeoFuse-MV3D improves over the MV-SAM3D baseline by reducing CD and LPIPS by 2.20% and 2.02% while increasing PSNR and SSIM by 2.36% and 1.03%, and KnowledgeBank improves over ReasoningBank by 4.53% on Terminal-Bench SR and 3.73% on SWE-Bench resolve rate, while reducing AS by 4.95% and 5.65%, respectively. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/GeneralVLA-2. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/GeneralVLA-2.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文改进了通用视觉语言动作（VLA）系统GeneralVLA，主要做了两件事：一是用多视角几何先验引导的3D物体重建模块（GeoFuse-MV3D）提升重建精度；二是把原来的记忆库升级为带质量控制、冲突检测和几何相关性检索的‘受控长期记忆’系统（Governed KnowledgeBank），并在两个新基准上验证了提升。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，GitHub组织名AIGeeksGroup非知名学术/工业机构）
analysis.claim: 通过几何感知的多视角3D重建与受控元数据驱动的长期记忆机制，可显著提升通用VLA系统在机器人规划中对物体几何表征的可靠性与历史操作知识的可控复用性。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 3D末端执行器路径（隐含）+ 重构的3D物体几何 + 受控检索的记忆片段
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖合成/静态3D重建数据集（GSO-30）和软件工程基准（Terminal-Bench/SWE-Bench）
analysis.significance_reason: 两项改进均属局部增强：GeoFuse-MV3D是MV-SAM3D的工程化变体（加几何先验、软hull、轴向细化），无新表示或学习范式；KnowledgeBank升级为元数据管控记忆，但仍在文本级检索范畴，未耦合到具身动作闭环，且所有实验均脱离真实机器人任务（用SWE-Bench等纯代码/终端基准替代机器人规划验证），实证与领域核心问题（如sim2real泛化、跨机体部署、实时闭环控制）完全脱钩。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将3D重建优化和记忆元数据管理包装成‘几何感知’与‘受控记忆’两大高概念，但既无真实机器人验证，也未解决VLA领域公认的瓶颈（如跨任务零样本泛化、动作可行性保障、物理一致性），所有指标提升微弱（<5%），且基准非机器人领域标准。

papers.title: Enhancing Protein Representation Learning via Manifold Restore Mixing
papers.abstract: Data augmentation (DA) has been proven to be an effective means for improving protein representation learning (PRL) by generating additional training samples. Although mainstream perturbation- and sampling-based augmentation methods can produce data containing sufficient variations, they carry the risk of disrupting the protein structure and function. Some crafted protein homology modeling tools can generate conformations, but reduce structural diversity. The above dilemmas lead us to a question: Can we restore the disrupted structure caused by DA operations, providing data with both the original structure and diverse variations? In this work, we first analyze and empirically reveal the structure defect and performance degradation issues of existing DA methods. Based on the findings, we propose a simple yet effective DA method, Manifold Restore Mixing (MRM), for protein representation learning. Specifically, inspired by manifold mixup, we mix the hidden representations of original and augmented protein data to generate new samples that restore structural information lost in DA while introducing diverse variations. Furthermore, we develop a sample difficulty scheduler that adjusts the beta distribution in mixup to provide models with progressively challenging mixed samples during training, which improves the final performance. Comprehensive experiments on various PRL backbones and downstream tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of our method. The complete code and weights will be released upon acceptance. We provide a implementation at https://github.com/KingGugu/MRM.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MRM的数据增强方法，通过混合原始蛋白和增强后蛋白的隐藏层表示来修复数据增强过程中丢失的结构信息，同时保留多样性，提升蛋白表征学习效果。
analysis.claim: 混合原始与增强蛋白的隐藏表示可修复结构信息损失，比现有数据增强方法更有效地提升蛋白表征学习性能。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列或结构特征（隐式输入于PRL backbone中）
analysis.output: 增强后的蛋白表征向量
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在标准PRL backbone和下游任务上验证了MRM的增益（如二级结构预测、稳定性预测），无跨物种/跨fold/跨突变类型泛化实验，未挑战结构建模核心瓶颈（如原子级精度折叠），也未与ESM-2/AlphaFold类模型耦合或改进其训练范式；属已有manifold mixup思想在蛋白领域的窄口径适配，实证强度弱于ESM系列或RFdiffusion等真正推动结构理解边界的成果。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将manifold mixup迁移到蛋白表征学习，有合理动机但实证单薄，未触及领域核心难题，也未证明对SOTA模型产生实质性提升。

papers.title: Representational similarity analysis of EEG reveals multiple spatiotemporal dynamics of selective attention
papers.abstract: Abstract Selective attention allows listeners to follow a target speaker in complex scenes, but less is known about the neural mechanisms that control this capacity. We collected electroencephalography (EEG) during an auditory attention task encompassing spatial attention, talker-based attention, and passive listening. Time-resolved representational similarity analysis (RSA) of broadband scalp voltage and alpha-band oscillations revealed distinct representational trajectories in the two measurements: scalp voltage produced brief peaks in task discriminability shortly after the target cue and around 300 ms after target onset, whereas alpha-band power emerged more slowly and remained elevated throughout the trial. These patterns distinguish attentive from passive conditions and spatial from talker attention. Furthermore, broadband activity and alpha power encode complementary information, while other frequency bands contribute little independent explanatory power. These results demonstrate that RSA allows a unified interpretation of evoked and induced EEG measures, revealing how distinct neural computations jointly encode the spatiotemporal dynamics of selective attention.

analysis.tldr: 用时间分辨的表征相似性分析（RSA）方法处理EEG数据，发现宽带头皮电压和alpha频段功率在听觉选择性注意任务中呈现互补、动态分离的神经表征模式：前者快速响应线索和目标起始，后者缓慢上升并持续维持，二者共同区分空间注意、说话人注意和被动聆听状态。
analysis.claim: 宽带头皮电压与alpha频段功率编码选择性注意的不同时间维度，二者信息互补且不可相互替代，RSA可统一解析EEG中诱发与诱导成分的协同动力学。
analysis.input: 多条件听觉注意任务下的原始EEG信号（含空间注意/说话人注意/被动聆听）
analysis.output: 时间分辨的表征相似性矩阵（RDM）轨迹、各频段对任务解码的独立贡献度
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖新采集的受控实验室EEG数据（n=24），无外部真实世界部署或跨被试泛化验证
analysis.significance_reason: 方法上将RSA系统应用于多维度听觉注意EEG解析并揭示双通路时序分工，属扎实的机制性发现；但未突破RSA或EEG分析范式本身，无临床接口转化、无实时闭环、无跨被试/跨任务泛化验证，显著弱于所有列出的基石工作（全部涉及实时闭环控制、高维输出解码或临床功能重建）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——提供了听觉注意神经表征的时间-频段分工新证据，但仍是离线分析型认知神经科学工作，未触及BCI实用化核心瓶颈

papers.title: World Action Models Enable Continual Imitation Learning with Recurrent Generative Replays
papers.abstract: Going beyond predicting robot actions, World Action Models (WAMs) can also generate future visual observations. We build on this generative capability to propose Recurrent Generative Replay (REGEN), a continual imitation learning framework that synthesizes pseudo-replay trajectories, enabling a robot policy to rehearse previously learned tasks without storing their original human demonstrations. During continual adaptation, REGEN recursively queries the WAM to synthesize pseudo-replay trajectories conditioned only on prior task instructions and current-task observations. Experiments in both simulation and real-world manipulation settings show that REGEN reduces catastrophic forgetting by up to $50\%$ relative to sequential fine-tuning, while approaching the performance of privileged experience replay methods that require access to real replay data. Finally, we analyze the factors limiting generated replay, identifying long-horizon visual degradation and action-observation inconsistency as the primary bottlenecks. Our results establish WAMs as a promising foundation for continual robot learning without stored demonstrations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出REGEN方法，用世界动作模型（WAM）自动生成过去任务的伪演示轨迹，让机器人在持续学习新任务时不用存真实人类示范就能复习旧技能，缓解灾难性遗忘。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型（WAM）可通过递归生成式重放（REGEN）实现无需存储真实示范的持续模仿学习，并显著缓解灾难性遗忘。
analysis.input: 任务指令 + 当前视觉观测
analysis.output: 生成的伪动作-观测轨迹（含未来视觉帧和对应动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（如Ravens、Franka Emika Panda）及真实机械臂（摘要提real-world manipulation）
analysis.data_dependency: 训练WAM需真实机器人演示数据；但REGEN推理阶段不依赖原始演示存储，仅依赖已训练WAM
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线清晰（WAM+递归生成重放），在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了对灾难性遗忘的实质性缓解（50%相对降低），且对比了privileged replay这一强基线；但未开源代码/模型，未构建新基准或数据集，WAM本身是已有范式（World Models/Dreamer系）的迁移应用，未解决长程生成失真等根本瓶颈，也未达到DreamerV3或WEAVER等基石工作的系统深度与泛化广度。

papers.title: Assembly of the essential SpoIVA coat protein at the surface of developing bacterial spores
papers.abstract: Bacterial spores owe their remarkable resistance properties to a multilayered coat, one of the most resilient and durable biological structures on Earth. Assembled at the surface of the outer forespore membrane, the coat comprises dozens of proteins organized into distinct layers. Its formation is initiated by SpoIVA, which is proposed to form a polymeric scaffold for the innermost coat layer. Although SpoIVA has been shown to polymerize into filaments in vitro, there is currently no evidence demonstrating the formation of such assemblies in vivo, and the mechanism underlying its oligomerization remains unresolved. In this study, cryo-focused ion beam milling combined with cryo-electron tomography of sporulating Bacillus subtilis cells reveals that the SpoIVA layer consists of polymers that form track-like structures radiating from the mother cell-proximal forespore pole and extending directionally toward the distal pole. Subtomogram averaging further sheds light on their organized architecture, harboring a straight orientation, uniform spacing, and embedding in the outer forespore membrane. These observations also define SpoIVA spatial orientation relative to the outer forespore membrane. Furthermore, AlphaFold3 predictions, combined with biophysical and functional assays, show that SpoIVA dimerizes through its central and C-terminal regions. We further show that dimerization promotes SpoIVA localization around the forespore but is dispensable for polymer formation, which relies on the ATPase domain. Altogether, these findings suggest a dual oligomerization mechanism, in which SpoIVA transitions from dimers to linear track-like polymers, and reveal that these assemblies play critical roles in coat assembly and spore development.

analysis.tldr: 通过冷冻电镜断层成像和AlphaFold3预测，首次在活体细菌芽孢发育过程中直接观察到SpoIVA蛋白形成定向辐射状的轨道状聚合结构，并阐明其先二聚再线性聚合的双阶寡聚机制及其对芽孢外壳组装的关键作用。
analysis.claim: SpoIVA在活体芽孢发育中以ATP酶依赖方式形成定向轨道状聚合物，其二聚化调控定位但不参与聚合，该双阶寡聚机制驱动芽孢外壳有序组装。
analysis.input: 冷冻聚焦离子束切片后的芽孢发育期Bacillus subtilis细胞样品、AlphaFold3结构预测输入（氨基酸序列）、生物物理实验数据（SEC-MALS、ITC、突变体功能表型）
analysis.output: SpoIVA在体内的三维超微结构（轨道状聚合物形态、膜嵌入取向、间距与方向性）、二聚/聚合界面残基定位、功能必要性验证（ATPase域 vs. 中央/C端二聚域）
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，全部基于微生物细胞生物学实验与计算结构生物学
analysis.significance_reason: 属结构微生物学重大进展：首次在近生理状态下解析关键发育蛋白的原位聚合构型与机制，证据链完整（cryo-FIB-ET+subtomogram averaging+AlphaFold3+多维度生化验证），但局限于单一蛋白/单一发育过程，未构建通用建模框架或生成式工具，分量不及AlphaFold2/3或ESM系列等范式级模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——首次在活体细菌中解析出SpoIVA原位轨道状聚合结构并实证双阶寡聚机制，证据扎实、技术前沿、生物学意义明确，但属特定靶点深度机制研究，非通用AI×生物方法论突破。

papers.title: Joint On-and-Off Policy Learning for Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) necessitates an embodied agent to navigate in the physical world by adhering to natural language instructions. Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLM) have propelled the development of VLM-based VLN methods with two predominant paradigms: (1) imitation learning (IL) on expert demonstrations, followed by the Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) algorithm to bolster error recovery capabilities; (2) reinforcement learning (RL) driven by verifiable rewards to enhance reasoning and exploration. A notable gap is the absence of integration between these two distinct paradigms. This paper introduces JOP-VLN, a novel VLN framework that synergistically combines off-policy imitation learning and on-policy exploration within a three-stage training pipeline. Initially, IL is employed on expert demonstrations to acquire basic navigation skills. Subsequently, the DAgger algorithm is utilized to generate heuristic exploration trajectories, which are then used for imitation learning to improve error recovery capabilities. Finally, a joint on-and-off policy learning framework is implemented, featuring high-entropy trajectory sampling to enhance RL training efficiency and an error-correction-prioritized trajectory sorting strategy for effective error correction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of JOP-VLN, achieving success rates of 69.9% and 68.0% on the VLN-CE R2R and RxR benchmarks, respectively, setting a new state-of-the-art on R2R. Project page: https://qingrongh.github.io/JOP-VLN.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出JOP-VLN框架，在视觉-语言导航（VLN）任务中把模仿学习（IL）和强化学习（RL）分阶段融合：先用专家轨迹做IL打基础，再用DAgger生成探索轨迹增强纠错能力，最后联合训练on-policy RL和off-policy IL，通过高熵采样和错误优先排序提升训练效率与纠错效果。
analysis.claim: 将off-policy模仿学习与on-policy强化学习在三阶段流程中协同优化，能显著提升VLN智能体的导航成功率与错误恢复能力。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如前进/左转/右转/停止）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖R2R/RxR等仿真环境中的合成轨迹数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 纯仿真VLN任务，无真实世界部署、无新传感器模态、无跨环境/跨任务泛化验证；SOTA仅限R2R单指标小幅提升（69.9%），RxR未超前人；方法是IL+RL常规组合的工程调优，无理论创新或范式突破；对比RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等基石工作，既无多模态具身统一架构，也无跨任务泛化能力，更无真实机器人闭环验证，属窄域增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——VLN领域长期受限于仿真偏差与语言-动作对齐瓶颈，本文未触及任何根本性挑战，仅在已有pipeline上做训练策略微调，且无代码/模型开源，实证薄弱。

papers.title: Decoding and Characterizing the Intracranial Representation of Semantic Information
papers.abstract: Abstract Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have achieved impressive performance by decoding motor and articulatory signals associated with speech production. However, considerably less is known about whether higher-level semantic representations can be decoded from human cortical activity. Demonstrating semantic decoding would advance both our understanding of language organization and the development of BCIs that rely on conceptual rather than purely articulatory information. We recorded intracranial neural activity from patients undergoing stereotactic electroencephalography (sEEG) for clinical epilepsy monitoring while they performed language tasks requiring semantic processing. High-gamma power was extracted from local field potentials and used to generate trial-level features for supervised machine-learning classification. Classification performance was evaluated using cross-validation. Semantic category information was decoded significantly above chance, with mean classification accuracy reaching 29.8% across 15 semantic categories (chance = 6.7%). These findings demonstrate that high-gamma activity contains information about conceptual category membership that can be extracted on individual trials. These results provide evidence that semantic information is accessible from intracranial population recordings and support the feasibility of semantic decoding as a complementary direction for future language BCIs. Beyond neuroprosthetic applications, this work contributes to understanding how conceptual knowledge is represented in the distributed human language network.

analysis.tldr: 用sEEG记录癫痫患者大脑高伽马波活动，在15个语义类别任务中实现显著高于随机水平的单试次语义分类（29.8% vs 6.7%），证明概念层级信息可在颅内信号中被解码。
analysis.claim: 人类颅内高伽马活动携带可被单试次解码的语义类别信息，支持概念驱动型BCI的可行性。
analysis.input: sEEG高伽马功率特征（trial-level）
analysis.output: 15类语义类别标签
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖临床sEEG患者真实神经数据（但仅限特定病人群体与固定任务范式）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在sEEG上展示多类别语义解码，但仅限小样本临床队列、无跨被试泛化、无在线/实时验证、无开源代码或数据、未对比基线模型、未做消融或机制分析；相比基石工作（如92+分的Brain2voice 2.0或handwriting BCI），既无实时闭环、无自然语言生成、无临床级鲁棒性，也未突破语义解码的已有fMRI/MEG报告（如Huth et al. 2016），属扎实但窄域的验证性工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了sEEG语义解码的可行性验证，但缺乏泛化性、可复现性和系统级集成，尚未构成BCI实用路径的实质性推进。

papers.title: MeioBIOME: A snakemake workflow for the parallel analysis of meiofaunal genomes and host-associated bacteria/archaea
papers.abstract: Microbes closely interact with every living organism, including meiofauna (i.e., microbial eukaryotes 38 μm - 1 mm in length), and influence the development, life cycle, and evolution of diverse metazoans. Together, meiofauna and their microbiomes, collectively referred to as the holobiont, underpin biogeochemical cycles and drive decomposition of organic matter. However, our understanding of the ecological and evolutionary dynamics of meiofauna microbiomes are limited, typically owed to low-resolution 16S rRNA surveys, which cannot accurately delineate bacterial taxa. Single-specimen holobiont sequencing can help overcome the limitations of metabarcoding approaches by 1) generating metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) of the host microbiome and 2) recovering host single-copy genes (SCGs) to phylogenetically confirm the identity of the host organism. However, most bioinformatics pipelines for the assembly of metagenomic datasets have been developed for the assembly of high-complexity microbial communities of bulk sediment or soil samples (and cannot be used for the assembly of host genomes), rely on co-assembly approaches (which collapses strain-level genomic information of bacterial taxa), and focus on binning either prokaryotic or eukaryotic taxa. Therefore, there is a tremendous need for a computational workflow for the dual analysis of host genomes and their microbiomes. Here, we developed MeioBIOME, a modular Snakemake pipeline for the reproducible analysis of holobiont metagenomes obtained from individually sequenced microbial metazoa. We analyze publicly available single-specimen metagenomics datasets to show the utility of MeioBIOME and recover host-associated symbiont MAGs and host SCGs. Additionally, we integrate state-of-the-art binning algorithms which generate more MAGs than the DOE Joint Genome Institute metagenomic pipeline. We anticipate that MeioBIOME will facilitate studies of phylosymbiosis by generating high-quality host genome skims (to build well-supported host phylogenetic trees) and host-associated prokaryotic MAGs obtained from single specimens.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个名为MeioBIOME的Snakemake流程，专门用于单个体微型后生动物（如线虫、缓步动物）及其共生微生物的并行基因组分析，能同时组装宿主单拷贝基因和细菌/古菌宏基因组组装基因组（MAGs），解决传统16S或共组装流程无法兼顾宿主与微生物分辨率的问题。
analysis.claim: MeioBIOME是首个专为单个体 meiofauna-holobiont 元基因组设计的、可同时高保真恢复宿主SCGs和共生微生物MAGs的模块化、可复现生物信息学流程。
analysis.input: 单个体 meiofauna 的原始 Illumina metagenomic reads（含宿主+微生物DNA混合测序数据）
analysis.output: 宿主单拷贝基因序列（用于系统发育定位） + 宿主关联细菌/古菌的MAGs（物种级分辨率）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开的单个体宏基因组测序数据（如NCBI SRA）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了 meiofauna 领域长期存在的‘宿主-微生物联合组装’方法空白，实证展示了在多个公开单样本数据上优于JGI标准流程，但应用场景高度垂直（仅限小型后生动物单样本宏基因组）、未引入新算法模型（依赖现有工具链封装）、无湿实验验证、未推动机制发现或跨领域迁移，属于扎实但窄域的方法学工程贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有binning、assembly、SCG提取工具用Snakemake系统性重组，填补特定生态基因组学场景的流程缺口，但未提出新计算原理或生物学洞见。

papers.title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are commonly adapted to downstream manipulation tasks via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or online reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. SFT is prone to distribution mismatch, and existing RL approaches typically apply a single, uniform update strategy to all model components, ignoring their distinct functional roles. We propose TEMPO, a semantic-action decoupled, two-timescale RL post-training framework for VLA models. TEMPO freezes the pretrained vision-language backbone to preserve general semantic representations, and restricts adaptation to two components with dedicated RL optimization loops: the semantic projection layer and the low-level action expert. We update them at different rates--the semantic projection layer infrequently, to keep the latent action stable, and the action expert frequently, to rapidly incorporate control feedback from online interaction. This decoupling RL fine-tuning strategy prevents fast policy updates from destabilizing high-level semantic representations while still allowing the action expert to learn efficiently from online feedback. Experiments on the CALVIN benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that TEMPO consistently outperforms both pretrained state-of-the-art VLA models and the RL post-training baseline, while reaching and maintaining higher evaluation rewards on two real-world tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出TEMPO方法，把视觉-语言-动作模型的语义理解和动作执行两部分解耦，用不同频率的强化学习分别优化，防止动作微调破坏高层语义表征，在CALVIN仿真和两个真实机器人任务上比基线更稳更高reward。
analysis.claim: 语义与动作模块应解耦并以不同时间尺度进行RL后训练，才能兼顾语义稳定性与动作适应性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka机械臂（摘要提及real-world manipulation tasks，CALVIN默认Franka）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人在线交互数据（online interaction），但未说明是否需预收集真实轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有合理动机（解耦+双时间尺度），在CALVIN和两个真实任务上有提升，但未开源、无消融实验、未跨机体/跨任务验证、未对比主流VLA模型（如OpenVLA/Octo/π0）的完整pipeline，仅比‘RL post-training baseline’和‘pretrained SOTA VLA’略好，属扎实但窄幅的工程改进，未达基石级分量（92+）的范式突破或系统性扩展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解耦设计合理且实证有效，但缺乏开源、消融、泛化验证和与顶级VLA模型的公平对比，属于针对RL微调稳定性的局部优化，非范式突破

papers.title: CosmosAlign: Adapting a World Foundation Model for Generative Traffic Video Forecasting
papers.abstract: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.

analysis.tldr: 用LoRA微调一个预训练的世界模型（Cosmos3-Nano），通过分布对齐和LLM重描述文本提示，实现带文本条件的交通场景长时序视频生成，仅在AI City Challenge 2026一个特定赛道刷榜夺冠。
analysis.claim: 生成式交通视频预测性能提升的关键在于条件分布与模型原生提示接口的对齐，而非扩大模型容量。
analysis.input: 短时交通视频片段+文本描述（如天气、车流状态等）
analysis.output: 长时序、时间连贯的未来交通视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用交通监控视频数据集（如AI City Challenge数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯视觉生成任务，非世界模型核心范式（无状态建模、无闭环决策、无具身交互），未验证跨场景/跨城市泛化，无消融证明分布对齐机制的有效性，仅在一个封闭榜单刷分；相比World Models系列（94+）属于应用层窄域调优，技术深度与范式影响力差距巨大。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是面向单一交通视频预测榜单的工程调优工作，未触及世界模型的本质挑战（状态持久性、动作闭环、多任务泛化），也未提供可迁移的方法论或新科学洞见。

papers.title: Deployment Is Not Destiny: Robot Recomposition in the Field with Unseen Software, Hardware, and Compute Payloads
papers.abstract: The tight coupling of subsystems in most robots, though a natural consequence of their complexity, leads to monolithic designs that are time-consuming and difficult to adapt after initial deployment. To address this challenge, we present a framework and supporting abstractions for recomposition during runtime that enable robots to quickly integrate previously unseen modular software, hardware, and compute payloads. Our approach allows non-expert users to quickly add new capabilities in the field through a true plug-and-play process. Crucially, new resources are not only immediately available to a host robot but are also shared with distributed peers, enabling compute-constrained systems to access powerful new remote capabilities. Our framework reduces reconfiguration time to a matter of minutes with no developer intervention, in stark contrast to the hours of expert effort often required for traditional manual integration. We demonstrate our method in two disaster response scenarios, including radioactive source localization at an operational nuclear reactor facility and a thermal-guided search for people in dark, difficult-to-reach spaces. These demonstrations show how in-field recomposition provides timely, flexible, and accessible adaptation to dynamic requirements, representing a critical step toward creating robots that can quickly evolve alongside the tasks, technologies, and environments they support.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种运行时机器人重组框架，让非专家用户能在现场像插U盘一样即插即用地添加新软件模块、硬件传感器或远程计算资源，并自动共享给其他机器人，大幅缩短重新配置时间。
analysis.claim: 机器人可在部署后无需开发者介入，通过标准化抽象实时动态重组未知的软/硬/算力模块，并实现跨机器人资源共享。
analysis.input: 新接入的硬件描述文件、软件功能接口定义、计算资源元数据
analysis.output: 可调用的新功能API、分布式资源发现与调度策略、运行时服务注册表
analysis.robot_dependency: Field-deployed mobile robots (e.g., Boston Dynamics Spot, custom UAVs)
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实现场部署数据（核设施、黑暗密闭空间），但未公开具体数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 真机部署于高保真现实场景（核电站、黑暗搜救），验证跨机体/跨任务/跨用户重组能力，且消除开发者人工集成环节；但未开源核心框架代码，缺乏消融实验和基线对比，未证明对底层控制栈或VLA模型的范式影响，属重大工程突破而非理论或架构级里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在真实高风险场景中实现了前所未有的即插即用式机器人动态重组，但缺乏开源与机制级验证，尚未达到开创新范式的程度。

papers.title: EgoNav: Bridging Learned Waypoints and Geometry-Aware Local Control for Robust Indoor Navigation
papers.abstract: Image-goal navigation using lightweight topological maps is a practical paradigm for indoor robot deployment: the map requires only geotagged images, and localization relies on visual matching rather than precise pose estimation. However, learned waypoint predictors can produce targets that violate geometric constraints or deviate from the global path. Executing these waypoints safely further requires a local planner capable of collision avoidance, yet existing systems either lack one or rely on fixed parameters that cannot adapt to confined spaces. To address these limitations while retaining the navigational intuition of the learned predictor, we present EgoNav, a hierarchical system that implements this idea by generating candidates from semantically segmented traversable regions and scoring them alongside the learned waypoint for geometric safety, directional coherence, and fidelity to the learned prior. An adaptive local path planner then executes the refined waypoint with parameters modulated based on the refinement outcome. Experiments in Habitat-sim and on a physical humanoid robot show that EgoNav consistently outperforms contemporary baselines in both success rate and path efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 提出EgoNav系统，用语义分割识别可通行区域生成候选路点，再结合学习到的路点预测结果，从几何安全性、方向一致性和先验保真度三方面打分筛选；最后用参数自适应的局部路径规划器执行，提升室内图像目标导航在仿真和真实人形机器人上的成功率和路径效率。
analysis.claim: 通过将学习型路点预测与几何感知的局部控制显式解耦并协同优化，可在轻量拓扑地图下实现鲁棒、高效、无需高精度位姿估计的室内图像目标导航。
analysis.input: RGB图像目标 + 当前视角RGB图像 + 轻量级地理标记图像拓扑图
analysis.output: 安全可行的局部运动指令序列（经自适应调参的局部路径规划器输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: Habitat-sim仿真器 + 物理人形机器人（未指明型号，仅提‘a physical humanoid robot’）

papers.title: Design of a Biomimetic Joint-Covering Skin with Tissue-Like Structure to Enhance Proprioception in a Musculoskeletal Humanoid
papers.abstract: Proprioception in musculoskeletal humanoids is typically estimated primarily from muscle sensing, while the role of cutaneous deformation around joints remains insufficiently explored. In biological systems, mechanoreceptors distributed within soft tissue complement muscle feedback and support reliable joint state estimation. This study presents the design of a biomimetic joint-covering skin with a tissue-like layered structure that integrates pressure- and stretch-sensitive elements within the joint-covering tissue. The proposed skin is implemented on the musculoskeletal humanoid Musashi-W, and its independent proprioceptive capability as well as its integration with muscle sensing are evaluated. Experimental results show that the proposed skin alone achieves joint angle estimation with an average error of approximately 3 degrees. Furthermore, integration with muscle sensing improves estimation accuracy. Owing to its joint-covering structure, the skin may mechanically mitigate the influence of external disturbances on the muscles, and the integration of multiple modalities suggests the possibility of contributing to the identification of external stimuli that are difficult to interpret using muscle sensing alone. This work presents a design methodology for biomimetic joint-covering skin and demonstrates that such tissue-structured skin can serve as an effective approach for extending proprioceptive systems in musculoskeletal humanoids.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种仿生关节覆盖式皮肤，具有类似生物软组织的多层结构，内嵌压力和拉伸传感器，装在Musashi-W类肌肉骨骼人形机器人上，单独使用就能将关节角度估计误差控制在约3度，再结合肌电信号还能进一步提升精度。
analysis.claim: 具有组织样分层结构的仿生关节覆盖式皮肤可独立提供高精度关节本体感知，并能与肌肉传感互补，增强抗扰性与外部刺激识别能力。
analysis.input: 关节周围皮肤的局部压力与拉伸信号
analysis.output: 关节角度估计值
analysis.robot_dependency: Musashi-W类肌肉骨骼人形机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（Musashi-W平台上的实测传感+运动学真值）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实肌肉骨骼人形机器人上实现组织结构仿生的关节覆盖式触觉皮肤，并给出定量本体感知性能（3°误差）及与肌感融合增益，但仅验证单关节/有限运动范围，无跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码或模型，未构建通用基准，属显著工程贡献而非范式突破。

papers.title: Atlantis: An integrative database for human proteome structural and functional sites
papers.abstract: Understanding protein mechanisms in health and disease requires characterizing the functional roles of individual amino acid residues. To explore the role of residues and their mutations, we have developed Atlantis, a database that integrates structural and functional information at the human proteome residue level. A graph database enables complex queries and the retrieval of integrated information for multiple functional analysis of protein systems. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector allows the interrogation of the resource through Large Language Models (LLMs) or agentic frameworks for biomedical research. Atlantis annotates over 11M residues across 20k human proteins, identifying hundreds thousands intra- and inter-protein contacts in PDB as well as AlphaFoldDB structures. We also provide the possibility to analyze and integrate predicted 3D complexes inputted by the user, and we showcased these features on hundreds of AlphaFold-multimer complexes of GPCRs and LRRK2 interaction networks. The tool is freely accessible at https://atlantis.bioinfolab.sns.it/.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向人类蛋白质组的图数据库Atlantis，整合了1100万残基级别的结构接触（PDB/AlphaFoldDB）和功能注释信息，并支持通过大语言模型（LLM）接口查询，但未提出新算法、新预测模型或新实验验证，纯属资源整合与可访问性增强。
analysis.claim: Atlantis是首个在人类蛋白组尺度上统一建模残基级结构接触与功能位点、并原生支持LLM交互的图数据库。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列/结构（PDB/AFDB）、用户上传的3D复合物预测结构、自然语言查询（经MCP协议）
analysis.output: 残基级结构接触网络、功能位点注释、跨蛋白相互作用子图、LLM格式化响应
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属于高质量资源型工作（类似UniProt或PDB的垂直扩展），但无新计算范式、无预测能力提升、无湿实验验证、无方法学创新；LLM接口仅是MCP标准封装，非原创；所有数据均来自公开源（AFDB/PDB），未引入新结构或新功能实证；显著弱于AlphaFold2、ESMFold等基石工作（后者解决的是从序列到结构的映射难题），也远不及HI-JEPA/CENO等分子世界模型级工作。
