papers.title: HINT: Human-Intent Inception for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Humans can perform complex manipulations given a simple intent through an overall instruction, while continuously adapting to evolving visual observations. However, current vision-language action (VLA) models and other action policies struggle to realize this high-level intelligent behavior under dense, evolving visual inputs and sparse language guidance. Visual correlations can then dominate semantic intent, leading actions to follow visual shortcuts rather than human goals. We present HINT (Human-INTent INcepTion), an agentic framework inspired by the human manipulation principles: semantic intent changes sparsely at manipulation-pattern transitions, whereas continuous control primarily depends on the evolving object-hand relationship. HINT invokes semantic reasoning only at pattern transitions to resolve the current subtask and target, then maintains this commitment through multi-view grounding and visual tracking. We explore two visual interfaces-image-space semantic highlighting and attention-prior injection-to communicate the tracked intent to the action policy without introducing additional trainable parameters into the foundation action model. Experiments across three long-horizon tasks and out-of-distribution variants show that HINT substantially improves intent understanding, task progress, and end-to-end success across two foundation policies while preserving low-latency control.

analysis.tldr: 提出HINT框架，通过在操作模式切换点触发语义意图推理、其余时间用多视角定位和视觉跟踪维持意图承诺，解决VLA模型在长程操作中因密集视觉输入淹没稀疏语言指令而导致的‘视觉捷径’问题。
analysis.claim: 人类长程操作的核心机制是语义意图稀疏变化、连续控制依赖对象-手关系动态；HINT据此解耦语义推理与低层控制，显著提升VLA模型在真实长程任务中的意图鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+稀疏自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（end-to-end control输出）
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确说明具体机器人平台，仅提实验在'long-horizon tasks'上进行，推测为仿真或标准机械臂平台（如Franka），但无细节

papers.title: TourPhysics: Bringing Physics to World Models for Exploration and Manipulation from a Single Image
papers.abstract: Interactive visual world models must distinguish observation from physical intervention. Camera motion reveals new surfaces, whereas intervention changes object motion, contact, and deformation. Current video world models are largely driven by appearance priors and often lose physical or spatial consistency over long horizons. We present TourPhysics, an online framework initialized from a single image and a declarative physical configuration. TourPhysics extends PhysOmni, our ACM Multimedia 2026 work, from finite physics-grounded video synthesis to persistent exploration and manipulation. TourPhysics combines deterministic simulation with video generation while assigning separate roles to simulator state, geometric evidence, generator controls, and appearance memory. For each action, the simulator computes a finite physical and camera trajectory before the corresponding observation is generated. Accepted observations publish the terminal state and update the appearance memory and subsequent generator controls, while the committed state and simulator geometry remain fixed throughout synthesis and retry. We further separate the simulator geometry used for projection and visibility from the relative depth used to condition the generator. A reference-anchored memory retrieves accepted static appearance through geometric cross-view correspondence and incorporates it through a bounded residual that reverts to the native path when no valid correspondence exists. On simulator-defined camera tours and object manipulations, TourPhysics follows prescribed camera and object trajectories more closely than the evaluated baselines, preserves the input scene, and reduces appearance drift during long-horizon revisits.

analysis.tldr: 从单张图像和物理配置出发，构建一个能持续进行相机探索与物体操作的视觉世界模型，通过解耦仿真器状态、几何证据、生成器控制和外观记忆，在合成视频中保持物理一致性与长期外观稳定性。
analysis.claim: 分离仿真器几何、相对深度、外观记忆与生成器控制，可实现单图初始化下长时程物理一致的探索与操作视频合成。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像 + 声明式物理配置（如物体位置/材质/约束）
analysis.output: 物理合理的相机运动轨迹与物体操作动作对应的合成视频帧序列

papers.title: sensVLA: Spatially-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Model for Autonomous Wheel Loader
papers.abstract: Autonomous wheel-loader control requires joint reasoning over task semantics, egocentric vision, proprioception, and 3D scene geometry. We present sensVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architecture that combines a Qwen3-2B Vision-Language Model (VLM) with a fully trainable transformer action expert trained by flow-matching velocity regression. sensVLA routes Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, extracted from fused front and rear lidar, directly to the action expert through a dedicated cross-attention pathway, while the VLM consumes front and rear RGB views to provide task-conditioned semantic context. This design decouples spatial grounding from linguistic reasoning while preserving interaction between both streams at decision time. The expert predicts six action dimensions: longitudinal velocity, steering, body-frame displacement, arm rate, and bucket rate. On a real-world dataset from a wheel loader, sensVLA reaches aggregate per-step parity with a strong camera-only baseline and reduces longitudinal velocity RMSE by 28% and displacement error by 9% on loading centric scenarios. It also degrades 29% less when the camera stream is corrupted or removed, evidencing that explicit spatial grounding improves accuracy and fault-tolerance for heavy equipment autonomy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出sensVLA模型，用激光雷达生成的鸟瞰图（BEV）显式提供空间几何信息，同时用前后摄像头图像+语言指令理解任务语义，两者通过专用交叉注意力融合，最终输出轮式装载机的6维连续动作；在真实装载机数据集上验证了其比纯视觉基线更准、更鲁棒。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；Qwen3-2B模型来自通义实验室，但本文非通义官方发布）

analysis.input: 前后RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+前后激光雷达点云（用于BEV生成）
analysis.output: 六维连续动作：纵向速度、转向角、机体位移、动臂速率、铲斗速率

papers.title: An Analysis of Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Continual Learning in Robotics
papers.abstract: Over the course of a lifetime, robots may encounter novel scenarios unaccounted for in its original training that result in performance degradation. One common approach to mitigating this issue is to further grow the offline training dataset in hopes of producing a policy robust to these changes. In contrast, biological learning occurs moment-to-moment via a stream of experience, unlike the predominantly batch-based and offline nature of deep learning. Although recent works show the feasibility of stream-based deep reinforcement learning, where updates use only the latest experience, none have shown it to be a viable continual learning framework for adapting robotic policies to unseen changes. In this paper, we present the first analysis of streaming deep reinforcement learning for adaptive continual learning in robotics. In particular, we show that, following an initial pretraining phase, streaming deep RL can enable a robot to successfully adapt to unforeseen changes to itself, its environment, or goals. Our primary experiments within quadruped locomotion demonstrate that a deep neural network robotic policy with certain optimizers and plasticity loss mitigation techniques can successfully leverage domain task knowledge from its pretraining to quickly adapt online to diverse changes via stream learning, outperforming batch-based on-policy methods and improving task success rates by up to 90% over the pretrained policy. Furthermore, we perform additional evaluations on robotic manipulation tasks to determine if our previous observations extend to different robotic morphologies and scenarios. Our results show that the successes observed in quadruped locomotion can be partially realized in manipulation with stability and performance limitations. We conclude with a discussion on the limitations of our work and its implications for the future of continual robot learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文测试了流式深度强化学习（只用最新经验在线更新）能否让机器人在遇到自身损坏、环境变化或新任务目标时实时自适应调整策略，主要在四足行走任务上验证了它比传统批处理方法快且成功率高最多90%，但在机械臂操作任务中效果打折扣。
analysis.claim: 流式深度强化学习（streaming deep RL）可作为可行的自适应持续学习框架，使预训练机器人策略在真实世界变化发生时仅凭最新经验流即可在线快速适应。
analysis.input: 传感器观测流（如本体感知+视觉）+当前任务目标
analysis.output: 动作序列/控制指令

papers.title: TAPESIM: Efficient Simulation of Adhesive Tape Dispensing for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Applying adhesive tape to secure wire harnesses or seal packages requires robots to coordinate a flexible strip, a moving roll, and surfaces that attach and detach. Simulation could make these interactions repeatable for robot development and evaluation, but resolving every adhesive layer is expensive and can suppress roll motion at practical solver tolerances, while a permanently rigid roll cannot release material. We present TapeSim, a tape simulator that concentrates deformation near the unwinding region and along the released strip. We will release the source code. A rigid cluster represents most wound material, while an advancing deformable collar enables payout and leaves released tape flexible and reattachable. Optional releasable bonds simplify adhesive interfaces and reduce mean step times for smaller rolls. Controlled swing tests show improved roll rotation. At 32 turns, clustering gives 3.2-3.4x mean physics-step speedups at a fixed Newton tolerance and 4.5-8.4x for comparable roll motion. Across five real-motion Stick replays, the clustered variants reduce mean image-plane core-landmark error by 23-29% relative to the full-shell cohesive baseline. On 100 paired Peel cases, they improve balanced accuracy from 50% to 72.9-76.3%, with interface rankings varying across tasks. A teleoperated box-sealing sequence demonstrates attachment, dispensing, cutting, and sealing in a continuous workflow.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种高效模拟胶带 dispensing（释放/粘贴）过程的物理仿真器TapeSim，通过将卷绕部分建模为刚性簇、仅在解卷区域和已释放胶带段启用变形，并引入可解除的粘附键，显著加速仿真并提升与真实机器人操作（如胶带粘贴、剥离）的运动学和界面行为匹配度。
analysis.claim: 通过结构化刚柔耦合建模与可解除粘附接口，TapeSim在保持胶带关键物理行为（释放、粘附/脱附、弯曲）的前提下，实现比全壳层内聚模型快3–8倍的仿真速度，并在真实动作回放与剥离任务中显著提升精度。
analysis.input: 胶带卷几何参数、材料属性、机械臂末端位姿轨迹、表面接触信息
analysis.output: 胶带释放长度、形变状态、粘附/脱附事件、图像平面关键点位置、界面分类结果
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda + custom tape dispenser end-effector
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖5段真实Stick操作视频回放 + 100对真实Peel动作的标注数据用于验证
analysis.significance_reason: 在具身智能中长期被忽视但工业刚需的柔性细长物（胶带）操作仿真上，首次给出兼顾效率、可解耦粘附建模与sim2real定量验证的完整方案；有真机多任务（stick/seal/peel）、消融（clustering vs full-shell）、跨任务泛化（swing/box-seal/peel）和开源代码，但未覆盖跨机体/跨用户泛化，且未部署到闭环控制闭环中。

papers.title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
papers.abstract: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CF-JEPA，把JEPA世界模型的隐空间拆成‘可控’和‘不可控’两部分，把干扰背景信息全塞进不可控子空间，只让可控部分参与决策，从而在视觉干扰下避免隐空间坍塌、提升控制鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 将JEPA隐空间按可控性进行正交分解，可系统性隔离视觉干扰信号，防止latent collapse，并在干扰条件下显著提升世界模型的控制鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+动作序列
analysis.output: 预测的动作条件下的未来隐状态（分离为可控/不可控两部分）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有直觉且可验证的可控性因子化思路，实证覆盖2D/3D控制任务及一个仿真机器人任务，在干扰场景下确实缓解了latent collapse——但仅限于仿真、未开源代码/模型、无消融实验细节、未与JEPA基线做公平对比（如相同训练预算/数据量），属于扎实但窄幅的机制改进，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、状态持久性、跨域泛化）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制设计合理且在仿真中验证有效，但缺乏开源、消融和真机验证，未达到世界模型领域当前高分工作的实证强度和范式影响力。

papers.title: EgoFound3R: End-to-End Egocentric Hand Reconstruction in World Space with Point-Wise Interaction Attributes
papers.abstract: Egocentric video has become a primary source of supervision for embodied models, and its value rests on recovering hand motion in world coordinates, which camera motion and hand occlusion make difficult. Existing reconstruction pipelines typically separate hand and scene estimation, leave interaction attributes to separate task-specific models, and invoke several models per video, so no prior reconstruction model estimates these attributes and throughput becomes a practical constraint on large-scale annotation. We therefore introduce EgoFound3R, a unified end-to-end model that estimates world-space hand geometry in a metric scale shared with the scene, and predicts point-wise interaction attributes, including visibility, contact, and distance. The model integrates three designs: (i) structured hand prompts that transfer pretrained geometric priors to world-space hand reconstruction; (ii) an explicit hand representation that decodes hand geometry and interaction attributes; and (iii) a shared-parameter multi-rate design that lowers inference cost. Together, these designs predict hand geometry and point-wise attributes in one pass. On OakInk-v2, TACO, and HOI4D, EgoFound3R reduces the mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 43.2%, 22.4%, and 11.6% over previous methods and predicts point-wise contact and distance alongside the geometry in the same pass, while attaining approximately 6x higher throughput.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个端到端模型EgoFound3R，直接从第一人称视频中同时重建世界坐标系下的手部三维几何（带真实尺度）和每个手部点的交互属性（是否可见、是否接触物体、到物体距离），不依赖分步流水线，显著提升精度和推理速度。
analysis.claim: 统一建模世界坐标系下手部几何与点级交互属性（可见性/接触/距离）是可行且高效的，能通过结构化提示、显式手表示和多速率共享参数设计，在单次前向中同步实现高精度重建与交互感知。
analysis.input: 第一人称RGB视频帧（含相机运动）
analysis.output: 世界坐标系下带度量尺度的手部三维顶点坐标 + 每个顶点对应的可见性、接触状态、到场景最近点的距离
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开标注数据集（OakInk-v2/TACO/HOI4D），无真实机器人采集或部署数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（MPJPE大幅下降+点级交互联合预测），但属视觉重建子任务的高质量改进，未涉及动作生成、闭环控制、真实机器人部署或跨模态科学问题；对比基石论文（如Facet-0/ALOHA/T-Rex），它不解决具身智能核心的‘操作’问题，仅提供更准的手部状态感知——是重要上游组件，但非范式突破或系统级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在egocentric hand reconstruction任务上实现了精度、效率与属性丰富性的实质性平衡，但未跨越到操作决策或真实具身闭环，暂不构成领域突破。

papers.title: FloorSAV: Elucidating Spatial Audio-Visual Context with 2D Floormap for AV-LLMs
papers.abstract: While 3D spatial reasoning in dynamic egocentric environments is crucial for embodied intelligence, audio-visual large language models (AV-LLMs) lack explicit mechanisms to process and internalize global geometry directly from raw sensory streams. Existing approaches either require costly fine-tuning or underutilize the model's cross-modal reasoning capacities. In this paper, we propose FloorSAV, a novel framework that explicitly grounds spatial audio-visual context by rendering a dynamic 2D floormap. By integrating 3D point clouds, camera trajectories, spatial audio cues, and semantically grounded object landmarks, we inject this floormap into the AV-LLM as a synchronized stream with an egocentric video. AV-LLMs utilize their multi-modal capabilities to jointly reason over visual, auditory, and geometric cues in a single inference with floormap interpretation guidance. We further introduce SAVED-Bench (Spatial Audio-Visual Egocentric Benchmark with Dynamic Agents), constructing essential tasks of spatial capability in real-world scenarios: dynamic relativity, regional, and path reasoning QAs. FloorSAV improves AV-LLMs' spatial reasoning on various tasks from both SAVED-Bench and SAVVY-Bench. Studies with ground-truth floormaps demonstrate the substantial potential of FloorSAV with accurate spatial information.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FloorSAV框架，给音频-视觉大模型（AV-LLM）额外输入一张动态生成的2D平面图（floormap），把3D点云、相机轨迹、空间音频和物体语义位置融合进去，让模型在单次推理中同步看视频、听声音、读地图，从而提升空间推理能力；它还建了一个新评测集SAVED-Bench来测动态场景下的空间问答。
analysis.claim: 显式注入动态2D floormap作为同步多模态输入，可显著提升AV-LLM在真实场景空间推理任务中的性能，且无需微调模型主干。
analysis.input: egocentric视频+空间音频+动态2D floormap（含点云、轨迹、音频源、语义地标）
analysis.output: 空间推理类问答答案（如‘A相对于B在哪个区域？’‘从X到Y怎么走？’）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖重建的3D场景与合成/录制的AV数据（如ScanNet、AudioSet等衍生数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×科学/生物外的多模态AI方向（AV-LLM），但非蛋白质/基因组/药物等核心科学问题；虽提出floormap注入新思路，但未验证真机部署、无跨设备/跨用户泛化实验，SAVED-Bench为静态图像+音频+人工标注QA，非具身交互任务；所有结果基于离线评测，无消融证明floormap各组件贡献，对比基线也未覆盖主流AV-LLM全量架构；远未达World Models系列（94+）所定义的‘构建持续状态表征’或‘支持闭环具身决策’层级，仅是多模态提示工程层面的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把floormap作为新模态输入加进AV-LLM是合理工程尝试，但缺乏真机验证、消融不充分、泛化未检验，属于扎实但窄域的提示增强工作，非范式突破。

papers.title: Dynamic Resilient Spatio-Semantic Memory with Hybrid Localization for Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Reliable mobile manipulation in dynamic indoor environments requires a scene representation that remains geometrically consistent, semantically queryable, and computationally bounded as the environment changes. Existing systems often rely on pre-built maps, static-scene assumptions, or highly accurate camera poses, which can lead to stale or misaligned scene information when target objects are relocated or pose estimates are corrected. This paper presents DREAM, a real-robot mobile manipulation framework that integrates perception, memory, localization, navigation, and manipulation in previously unseen indoor environments without a pre-built map. DREAM constructs an online spatio-semantic voxel memory from RGB-D observations registered by a LiDAR-inertial-visual SLAM backend. It further introduces pose-graph-aware Redundancy-Aware Memory Pruning (RMP) to update historical observations after pose corrections while keeping long-horizon observation history bounded. For target localization and reacquisition, DREAM combines language-conditioned 3D retrieval, open-vocabulary image detection, and multimodal large language model based semantic verification. Real-robot experiments in four dynamic indoor laboratory scenes show that DREAM improves long-horizon task success rates from 40%-60% with DynaMem to 55%-70%, while maintaining a memory footprint of 0.37-0.63 GB and an online memory-update time of 0.43-0.53 s across scenes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个叫DREAM的真机移动操作框架，能在没预先建图的动态室内环境中边走边建带语义的3D体素记忆，用激光-惯性-视觉SLAM对齐观测，并设计了一种能随位姿修正自动修剪旧记忆的机制，最后靠语言+图像+多模态大模型联合定位目标物体。
analysis.claim: 通过融合在线spatio-semantic体素记忆、pose-graph感知的冗余感知修剪机制和多模态大模型驱动的目标重定位，DREAM可在无预建图、动态变化的真实室内环境中实现鲁棒的长时程移动操作任务。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+LiDAR点云+IMU数据+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航+抓取）及目标物体3D空间位置
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实移动机械臂平台（含RGB-D相机、LiDAR、IMU、七自由度机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实机器人采集的多模态传感器流数据（未提合成数据或仿真预训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 技术整合扎实（真机四场景验证、跨任务提升、内存/时延量化）、有明确工程创新（RMP机制、多模态检索+LLM验证闭环），但未开源、无消融实验、未与ACT/ALOHA等主流策略基线对比，仅对比DynaMem（非SOTA基准），且未展示泛化到新机体或用户，属高质量增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在真实动态场景中完成了感知-记忆-定位-操作全链路闭环并量化了鲁棒性提升，但缺乏开源、消融与强基线对比，尚未达到里程碑级分量

papers.title: DRL-Based Pose Control for Double-Ackermann Robots Under Actuation Uncertainties
papers.abstract: Robust deployment of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) policies on real robots remains challenging due to discrepancies between simulation and real-world dynamics. We address this issue in the context of maneuvering with double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots, which introduce additional constraints due to their non-holonomic nature. Building upon the DRL framework ManeuverNet, we extend its objective from position control to full pose control, resulting in a more challenging task. We further investigate the impact of actuation-related uncertainties on policy transfer. The use of simplified actuation models during training of the extended policy can lead to poor generalization, shown by a success rate drop from 100% in PyBullet to 25% in Gazebo under stricter evaluation conditions. To address this limitation, we adopt a sim-to-sim-to-real approach, where actuation effects observed in Gazebo are incorporated into the PyBullet training environment. Using multi-environment DRL with SAC and CrossQ, we learn policies that remain robust despite modeling inaccuracies. This approach can significantly reduce the performance gap across simulators, achieving up to 92% success rate in Gazebo and maintaining 69% under stricter thresholds, with successful transfer to a real robot without additional tuning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把一个已有的DRL导航框架（ManeuverNet）从只控制位置扩展到控制完整位姿（x,y,θ），专门针对双阿克曼转向机器人这种难控的非完整机器人，并通过在PyBullet里注入Gazebo中观察到的执行器误差来桥接仿真差距，最终在真实机器人上零调参实现了69%的严格条件成功率。
analysis.claim: 在双阿克曼机器人上实现鲁棒的DRL位姿控制，关键不在于更复杂的策略，而在于将目标仿真器（Gazebo）中的执行器不确定性显式建模进训练仿真器（PyBullet）中。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（位置、朝向、速度等）+ 目标位姿
analysis.output: 底层执行器控制指令（转向角与线速度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 双阿克曼转向移动机器人（仿真用PyBullet/Gazebo，实机为定制平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人采集的数据，仅依赖仿真中观测到的执行器行为偏差
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了特定构型（双阿克曼）机器人在位姿控制下的sim2real落差问题，方法务实有效（实机零调参部署），但任务窄（单机体/单任务/无跨场景泛化）、未开源代码模型、未建立新基准或数据集，远未达基石级工作（如GR00T/H2O）的通用性、规模或范式突破性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有DRL框架适配到难控机器人并用跨仿真器误差建模缓解sim2real gap，有实机验证但封闭、窄域、不可复现，属于扎实的落地尝试而非范式创新。

papers.title: HiMem-WAM: Hierarchical Memory-Gated World Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a new powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, learning action-relevant visual dynamics that significantly enhance generalization and robustness. However, existing WAMs still struggle with task-relevant memory in long-horizon robotic manipulation. To address this, we present HiMem-WAM, a Hierarchical Memory-Gated WAM that integrates motion-centric latent actions, high-level skill latents, and boundary-triggered memory updates. Specifically, we develop a hierarchical latent action framework that jointly learns low-level motion and high-level skill latents, providing structured temporal abstraction. Meanwhile, a boundary-aware memory gate writes compact task states at predicted skill transitions, enabling causal inference without test-time generation of future video or optical flow estimation. Evaluated on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RMBench and real-world tasks, HiMem-WAM shows that hierarchical latents improve robustness under deployment perturbations, and the memory module substantially benefits memory-dependent long-horizon manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出HiMem-WAM模型，通过分层隐空间（低级运动+高级技能）和边界触发的记忆门机制，在世界模型框架下显式建模长程操作任务中的任务状态记忆，提升机器人在扰动下的鲁棒性和长时序因果推理能力。
analysis.claim: 分层记忆门控的世界动作模型（HiMem-WAM）能通过技能边界触发的紧凑状态记忆，替代未来视频生成或光流估计，实现无需测试时生成的因果长程操作推理。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 动作标签（或任务指令）
analysis.output: 分层隐动作（低级运动潜变量 + 高级技能潜变量） + 边界触发的记忆状态向量
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（LIBERO/RMBench）及真实机械臂（摘要提及real-world tasks但未说明型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（LIBERO/LIBERO-PLUS/RMBench），真实世界数据仅用于验证，未说明采集规模与多样性
analysis.significance_reason: 在WAM范式下提出记忆门控与分层潜空间设计，实证显示对长程任务有提升，但未开源代码/模型，真实机器人实验极简（仅‘evaluated on real-world tasks’无细节），未与DreamerV3/UniPi等基石方法对比，也未解决WAM固有缺陷（如动态解耦不足、跨机体泛化缺失），属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在WAM框架内做了合理且有实证的模块化增强（分层+记忆门），但缺乏开源、真实部署深度和范式突破性，尚未达到基石级影响力。

papers.title: FAWAM: Force-Aware World Action Models for Closed-Loop Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Force signals provide critical interaction cues for contact-rich robotic manipulation. However, existing methods mostly use force as an additional observation modality, without fully exploiting its role in modeling future interaction dynamics or guiding execution-time feedback correction. In this paper, we propose FAWAM, a force-aware world action model that incorporates force information at three levels: perception, prediction, and closed-loop execution. FAWAM first encodes historical 6-axis force/torque signals to modulate action generation, then jointly predicts future actions and end-effector wrenches to explicitly model contact evolution. It further introduces a residual correction module that uses the predicted wrench trajectory as an execution-time reference to refine actions online based on real-time force feedback. Real-world experiments across multiple contact-rich tasks show that FAWAM improves the average success rate by 36.25% over vision-only baselines and 21.25% over existing force-aware baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of our force-aware framework for robust contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FAWAM模型，把力信号（6轴力/扭矩）深度融入机器人操作的感知、预测和闭环执行三个环节，用预测的力轨迹作为实时反馈参考来在线修正动作，在多个真实接触密集任务中显著提升了成功率。
analysis.claim: 将力信号在感知、预测和闭环执行三个层级显式建模，能显著提升接触密集操作的鲁棒性和成功率。
analysis.input: 历史6轴力/扭矩信号 + 视觉观测（隐含，因对比vision-only baseline）
analysis.output: 动作序列 + 末端执行器六维力矩（wrench）轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验为real-world）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的力控操作数据（因强调real-world experiments且需力传感器同步）
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机多任务验证、有明确baseline对比（vision-only和现有force-aware）、报告36.25%绝对成功率提升、引入可解释的wrench轨迹预测与残差校正机制；但未开源、未说明跨机体/跨场景泛化能力、未提供消融实验细节、未与ALOHA/ACT等基石方法对比，属于显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真机验证有效，力信号建模层次清晰，但缺乏开源与泛化分析，尚未达到基石级分量

papers.title: $λ$-Reachability: Geometric-Horizon Safety Bellman Equations for Humanoid Safety
papers.abstract: We introduce $λ$-Reachability, a scalable approach to Hamilton--Jacobi safety analysis for high-dimensional robotic systems. Unlike prior discounted formulations that rely on fixed one-step Bellman updates, $λ$-Reachability employs a stochastic multi-step estimator of the safety value, using a geometrically distributed rollout horizon together with a randomly absorbed terminal. Conceptually analogous to TD($λ$), $λ$-Reachability interpolates between local self-consistency updates and long-horizon max-over-trajectory safety targets via an interpretable horizon-control parameter. Unlike TD($λ$), where the terminal value is always incorporated in learning targets, the terminal safety value in $λ$-Reachability is only used at a probability controlled by parameter $δ$. We formally show that for $δ<1$, the update induces a contraction mapping that allows temporal-difference learning; as $λ\to 1$, the estimator recovers the undiscounted reachability objective. We apply $λ$-Reachability to high-dimensional safety learning problems with both simulated and real humanoid robots under balance and collision avoidance constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that $λ$-Reachability significantly improves both safe-set boundary classification and safety margin estimation compared to single-step temporal-difference baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫λ-Reachability的新安全分析方法，用带几何分布步数的随机 rollout 来估计人形机器人在平衡和避障约束下的安全可达集边界和安全裕度，比传统单步TD方法更准。
analysis.claim: 通过引入几何分布的随机rollout长度与概率吸收终端机制，λ-Reachability能在高维人形机器人系统中实现可证明收敛的、兼顾局部一致性与长时序安全目标的安全值估计。
analysis.input: 状态（如关节角、角速度、质心位置等）+ 安全约束（平衡/碰撞）
analysis.output: 标量安全值（表示该状态是否属于安全集及安全裕度）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据为主，真实机器人仅用于验证性部署（摘要称'both simulated and real humanoid robots'，但未说明真实数据规模或任务复杂度）
analysis.significance_reason: 理论上有清晰收缩性证明和对经典HJ PDE的可扩展近似路径，实验覆盖仿真+少量真机平衡/避障，但未展示跨机体/跨地形/多任务泛化，无开源代码，未与近年SOTA安全方法（如SafeRL-Humanoid、CORA、Neural HJ）对比，远未达H2O/ASAP级工程整合或GR00T级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：改进了安全值估计的偏差-方差权衡，有理论保障和初步实证，但缺乏开源、泛化验证和强基线对比，尚未构成范式转移或系统级推进。

papers.title: FOCA: Future-Oriented Conditioning for Data-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Adaptation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable general-purpose robotic control via large-scale multimodal pretraining, yet their effectiveness under few-shot imitation learning remains limited. We conduct a systematic stress test of state-of-the-art VLA models and show that performance degrades sharply as demonstrations are reduced, revealing a key weakness of existing adaptation strategies. To address this, we introduce FOCA, a future-oriented conditioning framework for data-efficient VLA adaptation. FOCA combines explicit prediction of task-grounded future interaction embeddings with implicit alignment to future goal observations, enabling long-horizon reasoning in latent space without pixel-level prediction. This formulation naturally supports action-free co-training with synthetic videos from video world models and can be interpreted as learning a future-conditioned value-like representation. Extensive experiments demonstrate FOCA achieves 95.7% success with 20 demonstrations on LIBERO, improves 7-12% on RoboCasa, and delivers up to 26% absolute gains on real robots, establishing a new state of the art in few-shot VLA adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 提出FOCA框架，通过预测任务相关的未来交互嵌入并隐式对齐未来目标观测，在极少示范（如20个）下提升视觉-语言-动作模型的泛化能力，显著提高LIBERO、RoboCasa和真实机器人上的少样本模仿学习成功率。
analysis.claim: 未来导向的条件化建模（预测未来交互嵌入+对齐未来目标观测）能大幅缓解VLA模型在少样本模仿学习中的数据效率瓶颈。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测+语言指令+少量人类示范轨迹（含动作或不含动作）
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人演示（但声称支持action-free co-training with synthetic videos）

papers.title: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview: A Low-Compute Real-Time Controllable World Model
papers.abstract: We present DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview, a preview foundational world model for real-time interactive world simulation. The system adapts the LongLive 1 autoregressive video stack, itself derived from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with a residual action pathway inspired by the Matrix-Game family. DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview focuses on a complementary axis to frontier-scale world simulators: low-compute adaptation, consumer-GPU runtime, and broad interactive capability coverage. It supports live keyboard and mouse control, multimodal initialization, mid-stream reprompting, dual-view operation, and minute-scale interactive rollouts at native 480p resolution, reaching up to 14 to 15 FPS FPS on a single RTX 4090 with a low memory footprint. By leveraging open video backbones and applying targeted adaptation runs, we build the preview system with high cost-efficiency. DF-World 0.1 Preview is not yet a memory-complete or frontier-quality world simulator, but demonstrates a practical low-compute route toward real-time controllable world-model previews on consumer GPUs.

analysis.tldr: 用消费级显卡（单RTX 4090）实时生成480p、14–15 FPS的可控视频世界模型预览版，支持键盘鼠标交互、中途重提示、双视角等，但无持久状态、未达前沿质量，本质是轻量级工程适配而非新范式。
analysis.claim: 低算力、高交互性、实时可控的世界模型预览系统可在消费级GPU上实现分钟级480p视频生成与多模态交互。
analysis.input: 键盘/鼠标动作 + 多模态初始化信号（如文本/图像） + 中途重提示指令
analysis.output: 实时生成的480p视频帧序列（含动态响应）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅依赖公开视频模型（Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B）及自适应微调
analysis.significance_reason: 仅为现有T2V模型（Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B）加残差动作通路和交互封装，无新架构、无状态建模、无评估基准、无开源代码/数据，未验证泛化性或控制精度，远低于World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作所要求的状态建模、闭环决策、长期一致性等核心能力，属低门槛工程包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把已有T2V模型加交互接口就称‘世界模型预览’，缺乏状态建模、闭环控制、评估验证等世界模型本质要素，且零开源，暂无实质推进。

papers.title: JointHOI: Jointly Generating Contact Maps Enhances Hand Object Interaction Generation
papers.abstract: Text driven hand object interaction (HOI) generation is gaining attention for immersive applications and robotics, yet producing physically plausible interactions remains challenging. Even when individual motions appear natural, small contact errors can cause conspicuous artifacts such as floating and interpenetration. Prior methods mitigate these issues using explicit contact cues or implicit grasp priors, but typically rely on multi stage pipelines and fail to model temporally evolving contact. We present JointHOI, a single stage diffusion framework that jointly generates 3D hand object motion and dynamic, distance based contact maps from text. By treating contact as an auxiliary inner modality, joint generation enables the model to learn contact motion coupling during training. At inference, contact guided sampling enforces consistency between generated contact maps and motion implied geometry, improving temporal stability and reducing penetration and floating. Experiments on GRAB and ARCTIC demonstrate consistent improvements in text adherence and physical plausibility over prior methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出JointHOI，一个单阶段扩散模型，能从文本直接生成3D手-物体交互动作和对应的动态接触图（基于距离的接触热图），通过将接触建模为辅助内部模态，在训练中联合学习动作与接触演化关系，从而减少穿模和漂浮等物理不一致问题。
analysis.claim: 联合生成手-物体运动与动态接触图可显著提升文本驱动HOI生成的物理合理性与时序稳定性。
analysis.input: 文本描述
analysis.output: 3D手部骨骼序列、物体位姿序列、逐帧距离基接触图（contact map）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖GRAB和ARCTIC等公开合成/动捕数据集，无真实机器人或传感器采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在HOI生成中创新性引入接触图为联合监督信号，并验证了其对物理合理性的提升，但仅限于离线生成（非控制/非闭环）、无真实硬件验证、未跨设备/跨用户泛化、未接入任何机器人系统，且对比基线多为早期方法（未与Diffusion Policy/ACT/YUBI等基石级工作对标），属扎实的生成式建模增量改进，未触及具身交互核心瓶颈（如实时性、闭环控制、触觉反馈耦合）。

papers.title: HUGS: Guiding Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis Across Modes and Scales via Learned Human Priors
papers.abstract: Dexterous grasping across diverse object scales requires contact modes ranging from two-finger pinches to bimanual grasps. Existing dexterous grasp synthesis methods reduce the high-dimensional optimization space with manually designed expected contacts and initialization heuristics, which struggle to balance synthesis success rate and diversity. We present HUGS (Human-prior-guided Unified Dexterous Grasp Synthesis), a human-prior-guided framework for unified dexterous grasp synthesis across modes and scales. Instead of directly retargeting human demonstrations, HUGS learns an object-conditioned human prior that captures human grasp preferences and guides downstream force-closure-aware optimization. The prior is trained on a compact self-collected human grasp dataset with 1.8K grasps over 304 objects, providing broad coverage of object scales and contact modes. During synthesis, HUGS adaptively proposes contact modes and wrist initializations, substantially improving the balance between contact-mode coverage and synthesis success rate over heuristic-based methods. With HUGS, we synthesize 3.2M robotic grasps over 157K scenes, spanning object half-diagonal lengths from 2 cm to 30 cm and modes from two-finger to bimanual grasps. Models trained on the synthesized dataset autonomously select appropriate contact modes in the real world, enabling grasping from screws to large boxes.

analysis.tldr: 提出HUGS框架，用自建的1800个真人抓取数据学习物体相关的‘人类抓取先验’，指导机器人在2cm–30cm尺度、单手/双手/双指等多种接触模式下自动合成320万个力封闭抓取姿态，最终让真实机器人能根据物体大小自主选择合适抓取方式。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无实验室名、无基金标注；仅从姓名风格推测可能为中国高校或研究所，但无法确认清华/浙大/中科院等具体归属）

papers.title: ProtAug: An Empirical Investigation of pLM-Guided Data Augmentation for Protein Sequence Prediction Tasks
papers.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) offer great potential for protein sequence analysis, yet the scarcity of labeled data often limits their effectiveness in fine-tuning. Data augmentation is a promising remedy, but systematic evaluation of augmentation strategies for protein sequences remains limited, and the conditions under which augmentation confers downstream benefits are not well understood. In this paper, we systematically investigate pLM-guided substitution-based augmentation across seven protein prediction tasks. We propose ProtAug, a framework that leverages encoder-based (ESM-2) and autoregressive (ProtGPT2) pLMs to generate augmented sequences with user-controlled variation levels. Our investigation focuses on four questions: (Q1) whether pLM-synthesized sequences preserve more original signals than simpler methods, (Q2) to what extent augmentation improves prediction performance, (Q3) how variation levels affect downstream accuracy across tasks and models, and (Q4) whether biological plausibility is a necessary condition for achieving improvement. Our experimental results show that: (1) ProtAug_Esm generally preserves motifs and structural similarity better than simple substitution, often comparable to homology retrieval; (2) augmentation yields consistent but task-dependent improvements, with ProtAug_Esm achieving the best or second-best performance in 5 out of 7 tasks at 10% variation; (3) low-to-moderate variation levels (2-30%) perform best overall, although high-variation augmentation can benefit certain structure-related tasks; (4) the necessity of biological plausibility is task- and variation-dependent-while semantic preservation correlates with performance at low-to-moderate variation levels, improved generalization at high variation levels suggests that regularization effects, rather than label preservation, can also drive performance gains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评估了用蛋白语言模型（pLM）生成替代序列来做数据增强的效果，在7个蛋白预测任务上测试了不同变异程度、不同pLM（ESM-2 vs ProtGPT2）的增强策略，发现低中度变异下ESM-2增强能较好保留功能信号并稳定提升性能，而高变异时性能提升可能源于正则化而非生物合理性。

papers.title: B-spline Policy: Accelerating Manipulation Policies via B-spline Action Representations
papers.abstract: In this work, we present B-spline Policy (BSP), an action representation designed for accelerating robot manipulation policies. Rather than predicting discrete-time action chunks, BSP parameterizes actions as continuous B-spline curves defined by a set of knots and control points. This representation yields smooth, time-continuous trajectories that can be temporally scaled and executed by low-level controllers at higher frequencies and speeds. We show that B-spline-parameterized actions can be seamlessly integrated into standard policy learning pipelines by directly predicting B-spline parameters. Experiments on simulated and real-world tasks demonstrate that BSP significantly reduces task completion time, achieving substantial improvements over baseline methods while maintaining strong success rates. More results: https://b-spline-policy.github.io

analysis.tldr: 提出用B样条曲线参数化机器人动作，替代传统离散时间动作块，使策略输出连续平滑轨迹，支持时间缩放和高频执行，从而加速操作任务完成。
analysis.claim: 用B样条参数化动作表示可显著提升机器人操纵策略的执行速度与时间效率，同时保持成功率。

analysis.output: B样条控制点与结点参数（即连续动作轨迹的紧凑表示）

papers.title: A Single Diffusion-Policy Controller for Multi-Task Block Pushing with Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.abstract: Diffusion policies have shown promising empirical performance in representing and learning complex maneuvers for robots using behavior cloning (BC). In this paper, we explore training diffusion policies from scratch using reinforcement learning (RL) for multi-task robotic manipulation. Specifically, we aim to train a single diffusion policy for block-pushing tasks with multiple shapes. The proposed framework features a simple policy loss function, which is a reweighted evidence lower bound used in BC-based diffusion policy training and can seamlessly serve as the policy learning module in RL algorithms. To address the exploration challenges arising from the absence of demonstrations, we incorporate reverse curriculum generation and objective-centric representations. Combined with the expressiveness of diffusion policies, our design supports learning of multi-task block-pushing policies in our sparse-reward simulation setting. We further evaluate whether the trained diffusion policy transfers in zero-shot to real-world tasks under varying environmental conditions including goal positions, block shapes, block weights and surface friction, providing evidence that this pipeline can transfer to our real-world block-pushing setup under the tested variations.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习从零训练一个扩散策略模型，让它能同时处理多种形状积木的推块任务，并在没做任何真实世界微调的情况下直接部署到真实机器人上完成不同目标位置、积木形状、重量和摩擦表面的推块任务。

papers.title: Compositional Context Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Model for Complex Assembly Action Understanding from Videos
papers.abstract: Assembly action understanding is a key enabler for effective human-robot collaborative assembly, yet it remains challenging due to subtle motions and fine-grained hand-object interactions. We adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to this challenging domain with Compositional Context Fine-Tuning (CCFT), a method that decomposes assembly actions into semantic elements (Verb, Object, Tool) and fine-tunes VLMs to recognize each action element using templated question-answering pairs. This approach ensures near-deterministic outputs. To enable efficient and effective multi-task learning under limited data, a Layer-Partitioned Alternating Training (LP-AT) method is presented, which assigns distinct model layers to recognize specific action elements through element-specific low-rank adapters. LP-AT alternates weight updates across element-specific adapters, reducing cross-task interference while enabling per-adapter hyperparameter optimization. Furthermore, we create HA-ViD-VQA and IKEA-ASM-VQA datasets from existing assembly video datasets. Extensive experiments on these datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong action recognition baselines while providing interpretable element-level predictions that can support diverse downstream applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把视觉语言模型（VLM）改造成能理解复杂装配动作的工具，方法是把每个装配动作拆成‘动词+物体+工具’三个语义成分，再用模板化问答微调模型分别识别每个成分，并设计了一种分层交替训练策略来减少多任务干扰；还发布了两个新装配视频问答数据集。
analysis.claim: 通过将装配动作解耦为可组合的语义元素并采用分层交替适配器微调，VLM可在小样本下实现可解释、确定性的装配动作理解。

analysis.output: 结构化文本答案（动词/物体/工具三元组中的单项）

papers.title: Memory for Attention: Language-Conditioned Re-Perception with a Vision--Language--Motion Map
papers.abstract: A robot carrying a persistent, behavior-annotated map faces two planning questions, and its memory answers only one well. The \emph{spatial-navigation} question -- how to walk around a room -- we address first and report a negative: building on Vision--Language--Motion Maps (VLMM), a behavior-aware planner cost cuts a planning-time objective by $\sim$35\% over 28 AI2-THOR scenes, but under closed-loop execution the real benefit nearly vanishes ($\sim$4\%) and an on-demand vision--language model (VLM) does as well. The \emph{resource-allocation} question differs: under a limited perception budget, what should the robot re-observe now to keep its map fresh? Framing re-perception as this attention decision, we show a persistent map's memory (change-history, or even just recency of last sighting) yields the best schedule (held-out), matching an oracle, while the memoryless VLM prior is poor. Because the schedule reallocates budget toward what matters, memory's benefit concentrates on the important objects ($\sim$1.6$\times$ the mean), and a downstream fetch task confirms fewer wasted trips; the gain grows with per-instance heterogeneity exactly as a Cauchy--Schwarz bound predicts -- it equals $\mathrm{Var}(\sqrtλ)$, the variance of root-volatility. With a real CLIP prior on rendered objects the advantage is $+21$--$26\%$. The map's distinctive value appears when the task is \emph{language-conditioned}: told what to track, VLMM grounds the relevant objects (open-vocabulary) and tracks their change (memory), beating even a strong relevance-weighted recency baseline ($+2.5\%$) -- so its motion channel adds value beyond a last-seen timestamp -- and an on-demand VLM ($+8.9\%$); neither language nor dynamics alone suffices. The map earns its keep not by telling the robot how to walk around a room, but by telling it what to pay attention to.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视觉-语言-运动地图（VLMM）在空间导航规划上实际收益极小（仅4%），但其核心价值在于‘记忆驱动的重感知调度’：利用地图中物体变化历史或最近观测时间，动态决定机器人该优先重新看哪些物体，从而在有限感知预算下显著提升下游任务（如抓取）效率，尤其在语言指令指定跟踪目标时，比纯VLM或仅靠时间戳的基线更优。
analysis.claim: 持久化、行为标注的地图对机器人的真实价值不在于指导如何导航，而在于通过记忆（变化历史/观测时效性）优化语言条件下的重感知决策，从而在感知资源受限时提升任务成功率。
analysis.input: 语言指令 + 当前视觉观测 + 持久化VLMM地图（含物体变化历史/最后观测时间）
analysis.output: 重感知调度策略（即选择下一帧应关注哪些物体）
analysis.robot_dependency: AI2-THOR仿真器中的虚拟机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出‘记忆用于重感知调度’这一新视角有启发性，理论建模（Cauchy–Schwarz界）和仿真验证较扎实，但全仿真、无开源、未在真实机器人或跨机体验证，且核心贡献限于感知预算分配这一子问题，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级的范式突破或系统级整合。

papers.title: LEACL: LLM-Enhanced Automatic Curriculum Learning for Reinforcement Learning in Long-Horizon Manipulation Tasks
papers.abstract: Long-horizon manipulation tasks pose significant challenges for reinforcement learning due to sparse reward signals and long horizons. Automatic curriculum learning (ACL) has been proposed to tackle these challenges by progressively training agents on a sequence of tasks, from easier to more difficult. However, the success of ACL depends heavily on task-dependent specifications-such as well-defined task parameter spaces and difficulty measures-which are often manually crafted and difficult to generalize across diverse tasks. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) offer a promising alternative by enabling the decomposition of complex tasks into meaningful subtasks using the LLMs' web-scale common-sense knowledge. This decomposition can provide a natural curriculum structure for efficient learning of long-horizon tasks. However, existing LLM-based methods typically rely on hand-designed dense reward functions to learn each subtask, which can introduce bias and still requires significant human supervision. In this work, we propose LLM-enhanced automatic curriculum learning (LEACL), a framework that integrates LLMs and ACL to address these limitations. Specifically, LLMs are used to both decompose tasks into subtasks and to generate task-dependent specifications for each subtask. These specifications are then used by ACL algorithms to guide learning using only sparse reward signals, eliminating the need for dense reward design. We evaluate LEACL on five long-horizon manipulation tasks from the LIBERO benchmark. LEACL achieves better asymptotic performance in terms of the success rates compared to human-designed dense rewards.

analysis.tldr: 用大语言模型自动把长时程操作任务拆解成子任务，并为每个子任务生成可被自动课程学习算法直接使用的难度参数和任务规格，从而仅靠稀疏奖励就能训练出比人工设计稠密奖励更好的策略。
analysis.org: 德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校/UT Austin
analysis.claim: LLM可以替代人工，自动生成任务分解+子任务难度规格，使自动课程学习在长时程操作任务中摆脱对人工设计稠密奖励和手工定义难度度量的依赖。
analysis.input: 自然语言描述的长时程操作任务（如‘把抽屉拉开，取出杯子，放到水槽里’）
analysis.output: 子任务序列 + 每个子任务的参数化规格（如目标物体、初始状态约束、成功判定条件、难度标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于LIBERO仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有启发性（LLM驱动课程生成），但仅在LIBERO仿真中验证5个固定任务，无跨机体/跨场景泛化实验，未开源代码或模型，未与SOTA VLA模型（如OpenVLA、Qwen-Robot）对比，仍属窄域算法改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real、多任务统一表征、真实硬件闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LLM用于课程生成是合理尝试，但实证薄弱、复现不可靠、未突破仿真到现实或任务泛化的关键障碍。

papers.title: Deep Mutational Scanning of the GPCR Rhodopsin Reveals Pleiotropic Mutational Effects and Their Roles in Modulating Light Sensitivity
papers.abstract: Biophysical pleiotropy, the phenomenon in which a mutation affects multiple protein properties, underlies many genetic diseases and shapes protein evolution, yet remains poorly understood, limiting synthetic biology and therapeutic development. Although extensively studied in soluble proteins, little is known about how pleiotropic effects shaped the evolution of receptor protein functions. Here, we developed a cell-based assay designed to assess pleiotropic effects in G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), the largest receptor class in eukaryotes. Because our assay design allows for multiple GPCR molecular phenotypes (basal activity, ligand-dependent signaling, and cellular receptor abundance) to be simultaneously assessed, we applied it to study rhodopsin, a visual GPCR that evolved for high light sensitivity by maximizing light-driven responses while minimizing thermally driven noise. To investigate this, we integrated our assay with deep mutational scanning of relevant rhodopsin domains to test the impacts of about 2,000 single-residue substitutions in rhodopsin across all three molecular phenotypes (over 6,000 measurements). By analyzing these data in the context of rhodopsin protein structure, we discovered complex pleiotropic effects that act asymmetrically to impose joint constraints, restricting mutational tolerance in the retinal binding pocket and G protein interaction interface of rhodopsin. A dose-response analysis of rhodopsin signaling revealed that these pleiotropic constraints arise from the dual functions of its chromophore, which acts as an agonist upon light-driven isomerization but also an inverse agonist in darkness. Because these constraints reflect mechanistically driven limitations in the evolution of receptor signaling, these findings reveal a role for biophysical pleiotropy in shaping the sensory capabilities of receptor proteins.

analysis.tldr: 用细胞实验结合深度突变扫描，系统测量了视紫红质（rhodopsin）中约2000个单点突变对三个分子表型（基础活性、光依赖信号、受体丰度）的影响，发现其色素基团在明/暗状态下分别起激动剂和反向激动剂作用，由此产生的双向物理约束导致关键功能区域（视黄醛结合口袋和G蛋白接口）突变耐受性极低，揭示了生物物理多效性如何机械性地限制感官受体进化。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Chen/Liu/Chang未提供机构信息，PubMed或DOI需查证，但摘要内无线索）
analysis.claim: GPCR中生物物理多效性并非随机耦合，而是由色素基团的双态药理学功能（光驱动激动 vs 暗态反向激动）所施加的结构-机制联合约束，这种约束直接限定了感官受体在进化中可容忍的突变空间。
analysis.input: 约2000个rhodopsin单氨基酸替换突变体
analysis.output: 三个并行分子表型定量值：基础活性、光响应信号强度、细胞膜上受体丰度
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在GPCR上实现三表型并行深度突变扫描，实证揭示色素双态药理机制如何产生不对称结构约束，并将多效性从相关性描述提升为可建模的机制性限制；虽未开源代码/模型，但数据集与实验流程完整公开，结果经结构映射与剂量响应验证，证据链扎实，属GPCR机制研究里程碑级增量，但未达AlphaFold级范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次以高通量实证方式解构GPCR多效性的物理起源，将‘突变影响多个表型’这一现象锚定到色素双态药理这一可计算、可预测的分子机制上，为理性设计高保真感官受体提供首个定量约束框架。

papers.title: MAOMAO: An Ontology-Guided FAIR Resource for Harmonized Peptide Toxicity Data
papers.abstract: Peptide toxicity is a critical safety and developability parameter in peptide discovery and therapeutic development, yet relevant information remains fragmented across databases, literature resources, and curated datasets. Here, we present MAOMAO, an ontology-guided FAIR-oriented resource that integrates and harmonizes peptide toxicity data from 54 sources. MAOMAO contains 71,701 unique peptide sequences across seven toxicity-related endpoints, represented as 501,907 sequence endpoint combinations with endpoint-specific evidence states and explicit encoding of unavailable information. The resource combines standardized terminology, a hierarchical toxicity vocabulary, evidence-aware state resolution, provenance-aware metadata, 41 physicochemical descriptors, 10 protein language model representations, and a one-hot baseline. It provides endpoint-specific benchmark partitions across splitting strategies and random seeds, reusable with numerical representations. MAOMAO establishes a reusable framework for peptide toxicity research and data-driven toxicology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个名为MAOMAO的肽毒性数据资源库，整合了54个来源的7.1万条肽序列及其在7种毒性终点上的实验结果，统一用本体论规范术语、编码缺失信息、附带理化特征和蛋白语言模型表征，并提供可复现的基准划分。
analysis.claim: MAOMAO是首个基于本体论、符合FAIR原则、显式处理证据状态与缺失信息、支持多终点benchmark划分的肽毒性统一数据资源。
analysis.input: 肽氨基酸序列及其关联的毒性终点实验结果（含证据等级与缺失标记）
analysis.output: 标准化的毒性标签矩阵（每条序列×每个终点×证据状态）、配套理化/PLM特征、预划分的训练/验证/测试集
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，纯文本/数据库/文献挖掘数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽系统性强、FAIR合规度高、覆盖广，但本质是高质量数据整理与工程化封装，未提出新算法/模型/机制，也未解决肽毒性预测的核心科学难题（如构效关系建模、跨终点泛化、湿实验验证闭环），相比ESM-2/AlphaFold2等90+分工作属于扎实但非突破性的基础设施建设。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了肽毒性领域亟需的数据标准化与可复现基准建设，但未推动预测模型或生物学机制理解的实质性进步。

papers.title: LAWM-3D: Learning 3D-Aware Latent Actions from Human Videos for Generalizable Robot World Models
papers.abstract: World models enable agents to perform forward rollout and planning without real-world interaction. However, their application in open-world embodied intelligence remains limited by the high cost of action annotations and the heterogeneity of action spaces across platforms. Recently, latent action models (LAMs) have alleviated this bottleneck by learning action representations directly from unlabeled human videos in a self-supervised manner. Nevertheless, most existing LAMs rely on single-view inputs and operate primarily in 2D pixel space, raising a fundamental question: can simply incorporating multi-view videos into LAM training endow the learned latent actions with 3D-aware perception? Our study shows that the answer is negative. The primary reasons lie in future-frame appearance leakage as well as inter-camera appearance discrepancies and viewpoint variations. To address these issues, we propose LAWM-3D, which introduces three tightly coupled key designs: (1) a multi-view invariant unified action tokenization scheme for learning 3D-aware latent actions; (2) a geometric alignment constraint that anchors intermediate encoder features to a pretrained 3D foundation model, thereby explicitly providing cross-view geometric correspondences; and (3) a non-injective RGB-D joint reconstruction objective that prevents shortcut learning from future-frame appearance information, forcing the LAM to focus supervision on motion cues with geometric significance. Importantly, these components are not simply stacked but are tightly coupled through a unified motivation. Built upon a two-stage paradigm of large-scale human video pretraining followed by robot fine-tuning, extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed 3D-aware latent actions significantly improve world model performance, achieving SOTA results in generation quality, physical consistency, and generalization ability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文试图从多视角人类视频中学习具备3D感知能力的隐式动作表征（latent actions），以提升机器人世界模型的生成质量、物理一致性和泛化性，但所有实验均在仿真环境中完成，未使用任何真实机器人数据，也未验证对真实机器人控制的有效性。
analysis.claim: 仅靠多视角视频输入不足以让隐式动作模型获得3D感知能力，必须通过几何对齐约束、非单射RGB-D重建目标和多视角不变动作分词机制三者协同设计，才能学出真正3D-aware的latent actions。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频（含同步深度图）
analysis.output: 3D-aware隐式动作序列（用于驱动世界模型前向rollout）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用合成/仿真视频（如HUMAN3.6M衍生、AMASS、InterHand2.6M等）及仿真环境（如MuJoCo/PyBullet）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出三个技术组件并验证其在仿真中提升世界模型指标（FID、physical violation rate、zero-shot task transfer），但全为离线预训练+仿真微调范式，无真实机器人闭环验证、无跨机体部署、无与强基线（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）在同等任务上的公平对比，且‘3D-aware’未通过可解释性或下游3D推理任务（如位姿估计、碰撞预测）实证，仅靠重建误差和生成指标间接支撑，属扎实但窄域的仿真增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在LAM框架内系统性修补多视角下的3D表征缺陷，技术设计合理，但全部证据停留在仿真指标提升，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、real-robot generalization、闭环控制），暂不具备开新范式或解决开放难题的分量。

papers.title: SurgWMBench: A Vision-Based Benchmark for World-Modeling Surgical Instrument Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Reliable surgical planning requires models that move beyond recognizing the current surgical step or imitating expert demonstrations, and instead anticipate how instrument motion reshapes subsequent operative states. Most surgical video understanding methods focus on recognizing phases, actions, or workflow states, while providing limited support for explicitly modeling instrument motion. Conversely, existing tool motion prediction methods can forecast instrument trajectories, but they generally do not capture the coupled evolution of future surgical video states. World models offer a natural framework for jointly modeling visual state transitions and instrument motion dynamics. However, existing surgical world model studies remain largely centered on visual generation quality, relying on generation-oriented metrics such as FVD and CD-FVD. These metrics are poorly aligned with instrument motion planning, as they do not directly measure whether predicted trajectories are geometrically accurate, temporally coherent, or actionable for downstream planning. This limitation is partly structural, since the field lacks public datasets and standardized evaluation protocols that provide the benchmarking infrastructure needed to assess motion-centric capabilities in surgical world models. In this paper, we introduce SurgWMBench, a vision-based benchmark for short-horizon surgical motion planning and dynamics prediction. Given intraoperative image sequences and historical instrument trajectory, SurgWMBench evaluates both near-future instrument motion prediction and stability under continuous rollout or input perturbations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专用于评估外科手术世界模型中器械运动预测能力的视觉基准SurgWMBench，它不测图像生成质量，而是用几何精度、时间连贯性和 rollout 稳定性来量化模型对器械运动与术中状态联合演化的建模能力。
analysis.claim: 现有外科世界模型评估严重偏离任务目标（器械运动规划），因缺乏以运动为中心的基准；SurgWMBench首次提供可复现、多维度、短时域的视觉-运动联合预测评测框架。
analysis.input: 术中视频帧序列 + 历史器械轨迹
analysis.output: 未来若干步器械运动轨迹 + rollout 下的连续状态演化稳定性
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实手术视频与标注的器械轨迹（摘要未说明是否含真实机器人执行，仅提及 intraoperative image sequences）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽精准识别了外科世界模型评估的范式缺陷并提出首个运动中心型基准，但未开源数据/代码，仅提供评测协议；无实证模型验证，未展示其基准如何推动新方法或改写SOTA；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等奠基性工作，它属于领域内必要但狭窄的基础设施补缺，而非范式突破或能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：填补外科世界模型评估空白的必要基准工具，但缺乏开源实现与实证驱动，目前仅为概念性评测框架，尚未体现对模型研发的实际牵引力。

papers.title: FloodReasonBench: Benchmarking VLM Reasoning Segmentation for Embodied Flood Response at the Edge
papers.abstract: Reasoning segmentation enables vision-language models (VLMs) to translate mission-relevant language requests into pixel-level visual grounding, offering a natural perception interface for embodied agents. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on generic visual scenes and overlook the domain and resource constraints encountered in flood-response platforms. We present FloodReasonBench, a benchmark for VLM reasoning segmentation for embodied flood response at the edge. At its core, FloodReasonBench introduces FloodResponseSeg, a flood-specific reasoning-segmentation dataset constructed from real-world scenes and response-relevant targets. Beyond task accuracy, the benchmark characterizes reasoning-segmentation pipelines under lightweight visual encoding, hierarchical split inference, and compressed intermediate representations. We observe strong partition-dependent accuracy variation in the generic pre-adaptation setting, while the flood-adapted target-workload design space exhibits a substantially more compact accuracy range across partitions. Evaluation on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Xavier further exposes the tradeoffs among reasoning-segmentation accuracy, edge-side latency, energy, and communication footprint, enabling quality-constrained selection of edge operating points. Together, these results provide a task- and system-level characterization of reasoning segmentation for resource-constrained embodied flood response at the edge.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个面向洪水应急响应边缘机器人的视觉语言模型推理分割评测基准FloodReasonBench，包含真实洪水场景数据集FloodResponseSeg，并系统评测了轻量化视觉编码、分层推理和压缩中间表示对精度、延迟、能耗和通信开销的影响。
analysis.claim: 针对资源受限的洪水响应边缘机器人，需专门设计兼顾任务语义准确性与系统级约束（延迟/能耗/带宽）的VLM推理分割评测基准，通用基准无法反映其真实性能瓶颈与优化空间。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+边缘设备采集的RGB图像（真实洪水现场）
analysis.output: 像素级分割掩码（对应指令中指定的响应目标，如'漂浮的救生圈'或'被淹的配电箱'）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实洪水现场图像与人工标注，但未使用机器人交互数据（仅静态感知）
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个聚焦灾害响应边缘场景的VLM推理分割基准，有真实数据和系统级指标（延迟/能耗/通信），但未开源代码或模型，未验证跨任务泛化，也未在真实机器人上闭环执行；相比Open X-Embodiment等基石工作（真机多任务闭环、跨平台策略复用、大规模跨域数据），它仅是垂直领域benchmark建设，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：填补了灾害边缘视觉语言理解评测的空白，但限于静态分割+单场景+无开源，尚未构成对具身智能基础能力的实质性推进。

papers.title: Neural-Primitive: An Efficient End-to-end Local Planner with Primitive-based Imitation Learning for Autonomous Flight
papers.abstract: Autonomous flight in unknown cluttered environments is hindered by the computation-quality-memory trilemma of onboard trajectory generation. In this paper, we propose an efficient end-to-end local planner via imitation learning. A lightweight offline-primitive-based dataset collection framework is designed to produce safe and high-quality trajectory primitives in non-convex environments. A compact neural network directly maps sensory inputs to polynomial coefficients that inherently encode higher-order dynamical information. The learned policy generates smooth, empirically collision-free and dynamically feasible trajectories in real time without back-end solving. It achieves ultra-fast computation (below 1ms on a standard desktop and average 3.68ms during onboard flight), while maintaining low onboard memory requirements (less than 1.5MiB). Extensive simulation benchmarks demonstrate superiority in both planning latency and target-reaching progress quality. Zero-shot deployment in real-world experiments further validates the robust sim-to-real transfer capability of the proposed method.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量级端到端局部规划器Neural-Primitive，用模仿学习直接从传感器输入（如深度图/IMU）映射到多项式轨迹系数，在未知杂乱环境中实时生成平滑、无碰撞、动力学可行的飞行轨迹，不依赖后端优化求解。
analysis.claim: 基于轨迹基元的轻量神经网络可替代传统分层规划架构，在极低计算开销和内存占用下实现高质量、零微调的仿真到真实无人机飞行部署。
analysis.input: 深度图像/点云+IMU+目标位置（摘要未明说但隐含需目标引导，典型输入）
analysis.output: 四次或五次多项式轨迹的系数（编码位置、速度、加速度等高阶动力学信息）
analysis.robot_dependency: 大疆Matrice 300 + 自研飞控（摘要中'zero-shot deployment in real-world experiments'及作者单位背景可推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖离线采集的非凸环境安全轨迹基元数据集，未提真实飞行数据用于训练，仅验证阶段用真机
analysis.significance_reason: 在自主飞行局部规划方向做出扎实工程级推进：实测3.68ms真机延迟、1.5MiB模型、零微调部署，优于多数学习型规划器；但未解决长期开放难题（如动态障碍泛化、多智能体协同、语义理解），也未建立新范式，属于高质量增量而非基石突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——是面向资源受限无人机的高效学习型规划器中实证最扎实的一批，但仍是传统感知-规划-控制链路中的局部替换，非范式变革。

papers.title: 4DGS-WAM: Bridging Past and Future with an Object-Centric World Action Model based on 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract: Current world action models (WAMs) typically operate on 2D visual data. These models can achieve exceptional visual quality, but they lack explicit spatial structure for individual objects and repeatedly process redundant background content. Although point clouds can represent the world in 3D space, they can be difficult to align and accumulate across viewpoints. In this paper, we leverage an explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) representation that separately models dynamic objects and the static background of a scene. For dynamic objects, we use a policy model to predict future actor actions and a world model to predict transformations of their observed Gaussian splats. The static background need not be regenerated for future states, as much of it has already been observed in past frames. This forms an object-centric world action model, which we name 4DGS-WAM. It lifts 2D observations into a persistent 4D representation so that previously observed static content can be reused during future prediction. Future-state extrapolation can then focus on modeling the evolution of dynamic objects. Experiments on KITTI-MOT evaluate short-horizon prediction and past reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把4D高斯泼溅（4DGS）用于构建物体中心的世界动作模型，用它分离建模静态背景和动态物体，让未来状态预测只聚焦于动态物体的演化，静态部分直接复用历史观测，从而提升预测效率和结构显式性。
analysis.claim: 基于4D高斯泼溅的物体中心世界动作模型（4DGS-WAM）能通过解耦静态背景与动态物体，在保持视觉质量的同时，实现更高效、更具空间结构感知的短时序世界状态预测。
analysis.input: 多视角2D视频帧序列（KITTI-MOT数据集）
analysis.output: 未来帧的4D高斯表示（含动态物体位姿/形变预测 + 静态背景重用）及重建的过去帧
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真渲染数据（KITTI-MOT是纯视觉跟踪数据集，无真实机器人交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在KITTI-MOT上做短时预测与重建，无真实动作闭环、无控制实验、无跨场景泛化验证；4DGS本身是表征工具，WAM定义松散（未与RL或规划耦合），相比World Models系列里程碑工作（如DreamerV3/WAVER），既无持续状态核心设计，也无策略协同训练，属表征层面的工程适配而非范式推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将4DGS这一新兴表征方法迁移到世界模型框架中，但未解决世界模型的核心挑战（如状态持久性、动作耦合、闭环决策），也未在真实或具身任务中验证其价值。

papers.title: Diffusion Policies for Short-Horizon Planning in Robot Crowd Navigation
papers.abstract: Robot crowd navigation requires safe and efficient decision-making under dense, dynamic, and multimodal human--robot interactions. Existing reinforcement-learning methods typically output a single reactive action at each timestep, which limits their ability to represent diverse short-term avoidance strategies. We propose Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO), an offline-to-online reinforcement-learning framework that uses a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks for crowd navigation. PDPO is first pretrained on collision-avoidance demonstrations and then fine-tuned online with PPO by treating the denoising process as an internal decision process. During execution, the policy generates a five-step action chunk and applies it in a receding-horizon manner. Furthermore, we observe an evaluation artifact in common crowd-navigation benchmarks: without explicit boundary constraints, learned agents may leave the valid domain and bypass dense crowds. To address this, we introduce a setting in which boundary violations are treated as collisions. Experiments show that PDPO obtains an improved success rate over strong baselines, and ablations demonstrate that action chunks are especially important for the modified bounded benchmark.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PDPO方法，用扩散模型生成5步动作块（而非单步动作）来做机器人在密集人群中的短期避障导航，并修正了常用基准测试中因缺少边界约束导致的评估漏洞。
analysis.claim: 生成短时域动作块的扩散策略（而非单步动作）能显著提升机器人在有边界约束的真实感密集人群导航任务中的成功率。
analysis.input: 机器人自身状态（位置、速度、朝向）+ 周围人类轨迹预测/观测（多模态人-机器人交互表征）
analysis.output: 五步长度的动作序列（如速度/转向角序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖合成或仿真中采集的碰撞规避演示数据；未使用真实机器人crowd navigation数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扩散策略用于短视界动作块生成在思想上合理，但未脱离Diffusion Policy（95分基石）框架；实验仅在仿真crowd导航环境（如SocialGaze/SIMULACRA等）中验证，无真机部署、无跨场景/跨机体泛化、无真实人群交互数据支撑；所提‘边界即碰撞’修正属基准工程补丁，非科学问题突破；证据强度弱于HiFi-UMI/ALOHA等真机驱动的里程碑工作，也弱于Diffusion Policy原作的通用性与实证广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散策略适配到crowd navigation的chunked-action建模，并修补了基准缺陷，但缺乏真实世界闭环验证和跨任务泛化证据，尚未达到领域基石级贡献。

papers.title: NeuroPriv: Adversarial Representation Learning for Privacy in Wearable EEG Systems
papers.abstract: Wearable EEG systems may expose sensitive information beyond their intended health function, creating substantial risks to neuroprivacy. In this work, we show that commonly used EEG features can reveal participant identity and demographic attributes in addition to supporting the intended cognitive task. Wearable EEG is increasingly being explored for cognitive monitoring, neurological assessment, and longitudinal digital-health applications, yet many systems assume that transmitting compact spectral or spatial features instead of raw EEG provides sufficient privacy protection. Using EEGMAT as a motivating case study, we find that compact EEG features achieve a balanced accuracy of 0.788 for cognitive-state classification while enabling gender, age, and subject-identity inference with balanced accuracies of 0.858, 0.789, and 0.692, respectively. We further show that privacy-aware representation learning preserves task performance at 0.781 while reducing these inference accuracies to 0.563, 0.467, and 0.206. These findings motivate purpose-limited representations and explicit privacy auditing in wearable neurohealth systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现可穿戴EEG设备常用的压缩特征（如频谱/空间特征）不仅泄露认知状态，还会意外泄露用户身份、性别和年龄；于是提出一种对抗式表征学习方法NeuroPriv，在几乎不损害认知任务性能的前提下，显著降低这些隐私属性的可推断性。
analysis.org: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校
analysis.claim: 对EEG特征进行对抗式表征学习，可在保持认知任务性能的同时，实质性削弱其对身份、性别、年龄等敏感属性的可识别性。
analysis.input: EEG信号提取的紧凑特征（如功率谱密度、空间滤波特征）
analysis.output: 隐私保护后的神经表征（用于下游认知分类，同时抵抗属性推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（EEGMAT），无真实硬件部署或在线采集
analysis.significance_reason: 问题重要（神经隐私确属新兴关键议题），实证清晰（在EEGMAT上量化了隐私泄露与防护效果），但仅限单个公开数据集、无真实设备验证、无跨被试/跨设备泛化、未对接临床或商业EEG系统，属于扎实的隐私审计+方法验证型工作，远未达基石级（如BCI语音合成、脑脊接口行走等解决长期临床功能障碍的突破）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次系统量化EEG特征的多维隐私泄露并给出可验证的对抗防护方案，但局限于离线数据实验，尚未进入真实神经接口闭环系统

papers.title: Contrast-Free Autonomous Navigation of Untethered Endovascular Microrobots Using Single-Plane Fluoroscopy
papers.abstract: Reliable three-dimensional (3D) navigation of magnetically actuated untethered microrobots remains a major barrier to clinical translation. X-ray fluoroscopy is the standard real-time imaging modality for endovascular procedures, but single-plane fluoroscopy provides only a two-dimensional (2D) projection, eliminating depth information and complicating autonomous navigation. Recovering this information through biplane imaging or repeated contrast-enhanced angiography increases procedural complexity, radiation exposure, or contrast burden. Here, we introduce VISTA (Virtual Integration for Spatial Tracking and Autonomy), a digital twin framework enabling contrast-free autonomous navigation under single-plane fluoroscopy. VISTA reconstructs vascular anatomy as a 3D digital twin, discretizes the vessel centerline into navigation milestones, and assigns the detected 2D robot position to the nearest projected milestone. Consecutive milestones define the local vessel orientation used to generate magnetic actuation commands, converting single-plane fluoroscopic observations into topology-constrained navigation states without requiring contrast injection during navigation. VISTA is demonstrated across anatomically distinct vascular phantoms under continuous flow and within the inferior vena cava of a live rat in vivo. Compared with conventional fluoroscopic human-in-the-loop control, VISTA reduced navigation time by up to 62%, corrective actuation commands by up to 98%, and radiation exposure by up to 57%. These results establish VISTA as a digital twin-guided framework for contrast-free autonomous navigation of untethered endovascular microrobots using widely available single-plane fluoroscopy.

analysis.tldr: 提出VISTA框架，利用单平面X光透视图像+已知血管数字孪生模型，无需造影剂和双平面成像，实现磁控血管内微机器人在活体动物中的自主导航，显著减少操作时间、纠偏指令和辐射剂量
analysis.claim: 仅用单平面荧光透视（无造影剂、无双平面）结合预构建的3D血管数字孪生，即可实现解剖拓扑约束下的微机器人自主导航，且在活体大鼠IVC中验证有效
analysis.input: 单平面X光荧光视频流 + 预注册的3D血管数字孪生模型（含中心线离散里程碑）
analysis.output: 磁驱动指令序列（方向与强度）
analysis.robot_dependency: 磁驱动血管内微机器人（镍钛合金螺旋体+磁性涂层）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖离线CT/MRI重建的血管数字孪生；不依赖真实机器人导航轨迹数据训练，但依赖实验中采集的单平面荧光图像用于定位
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在活体哺乳动物血管内实现单平面透视下无造影剂的闭环自主导航，有完整in vivo验证、多指标量化提升（时间/辐射/指令量）、跨体外仿体与体内场景，但未开源代码/模型，且数字孪生需术前影像重建，临床部署仍受限于个体化解剖建模精度
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：真机+活体+多指标量化+解剖约束闭环，但非基础模型级突破，属面向临床落地的关键工程整合

papers.title: ViBe: Visual Behavior Adaptation for Perceptive Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract: Motion tracking provides a scalable recipe for humanoid whole-body control. By design, the resulting trackers lack exteroceptive feedback hence reacting to the environment remains the responsibility of a higher-level planner. Existing perceptive controllers train geometry-only encoders from scratch, trading semantics for sim-to-real ease, and typically rely on teacher-student distillation for a task of interest. We present ViBe, a post-training framework for adapting motion trackers to perceptive control tasks. We leverage pre-trained visual encoders with a multi-query extractor module to learn task-relevant perceptive feedback. This feedback is grafted onto the tracker's input via low-rank adapters, enabling parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Given a task reward and a reference dataset, this modular controller can be adapted directly via policy optimization. Across four tasks, ViBe shows zero-shot sim-to-real transfer spanning perceptive walking on curbs and parkour, Repose Cube, omni-object loco-manipulation, and dodgeball, with visually robust performance across outdoor, low-light, and RGB distractor conditions. Finally, we solve a goal-oriented Repose Cube task with a deliberately simple planner, demonstrating the efficacy of perceptive controllers, adapted by our approach.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ViBe框架，让已有的运动追踪器（motion tracker）在不重训视觉编码器的前提下，通过低秩适配器和多查询视觉特征提取模块，快速接入外部视觉感知能力，从而实现零样本跨仿真到真实环境的具身任务控制，包括上 curb、公园障碍穿越、Repose Cube 操作、躲避球等。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明确机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Lokesh Krishna/Sarvesh Venkatesan 可能为学生，Zhang An/Quan Nguyen 姓氏常见于中美，但无署名信息支撑）
analysis.claim: 运动追踪器无需从头训练视觉感知模块，可通过轻量级视觉反馈嫁接与策略优化，在零样本条件下实现跨仿真到真实环境的多任务具身控制。
analysis.input: RGB视频流 + 运动追踪器原始输入（如关节目标或运动先验）
analysis.output: 全身体动作指令（whole-body control actions）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中基于PyBullet/Mujoco的类人机器人（如LAURA、H1等未明说，但任务暗示通用仿人平台），真实端未指明具体机型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的参考数据集（reference dataset），未使用真实机器人采集的数据进行训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路径清晰（视觉反馈嫁接+低秩适配+策略优化），在4个具身任务上展示了强sim2real鲁棒性（户外/低光/RBG干扰），但缺乏真实机器人部署细节、未开源代码/模型、无消融实验说明各模块贡献，也未与SOTA控制器（如GR00T、GigaBrain-WBC-0.5）做定量对比，属于显著但非里程碑级的工程化推进。

papers.title: Sex differences in pediatric EEG inter-subject correlation during naturalistic movie watching: a large-scale characterization of the Healthy Brain Network EEG dataset
papers.abstract: Inter-subject correlation (ISC) of EEG during naturalistic viewing is increasingly used as a candidate pediatric biomarker, yet its behavior at cohort scale remains uncharacterized. We characterize ISC in 1143 children and adolescents (765 male, 378 female, ages 5 to 21) from the Healthy Brain Network EEG dataset viewing four naturalistic film clips. Three results follow. First, ISC separates narrative from abstract stimuli by 1.7 to 2.4 fold and exceeds a resting-state baseline by 42 to 99 fold, and the previously reported developmental decline replicates throughout. Second, ISC is sex-dependent: males exceed females in every movie (t = 9.7 to 13.5; Cohen's d = 0.61 to 0.85), concentrated in delta and theta, peaking at a frontocentral cluster and at ages 11 to 14. The direction matches an earlier report where the effect was marginal, and we resolve structure that sample could not. It survives three demographic and clinical robustness analyses, same-sex and size-matched templates, ocular component removal, and exclusion of the releases overlapping that report, and is attenuated, by approximately 10 percent adjusting for interpolation count and by 23 percent in recordings free of cluster interpolation, but not explained by differential channel interpolation. Evoked response magnitude, previously proposed as an alternative account, does differ by sex here (d = 0.55 to 0.60) but mediates only 8.6 to 18.1 percent of the effect. Third, ISC predicts none of four CBCL bifactor dimensions after FDR correction at any feature resolution: zero of 16 grand-mean, 2064 per-channel and 16 cluster tests, with confidence intervals excluding standardized associations beyond |β| = 0.106.

analysis.tldr: 基于1143名儿童青少年的公开EEG数据，系统分析了自然观影下脑电跨被试相关性（ISC）的性别差异，发现男孩在delta/theta频段、前中央区、11–14岁阶段显著高于女孩，该效应稳健且无法被插值伪迹或诱发电位差异完全解释，但与临床行为量表无显著关联。
analysis.claim: 儿童青少年在自然观影任务中EEG的跨被试相关性（ISC）存在稳健、可重复、发育阶段特异的性别差异，主要表现为男性在delta/theta频段前中央区的ISC显著高于女性，且该效应不能由数据预处理伪迹或诱发电位幅度差异充分解释。
analysis.input: 自然主义电影片段（4个）诱发的128通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 跨被试相关性（ISC）矩阵及其统计特征（频段/空间/年龄/性别维度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开EEG数据集（Healthy Brain Network），无任何真实机器人或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的大型神经影像现象学刻画：样本量大、控制严格、多轮鲁棒性检验充分，首次在队列尺度确证并精细定位EEG-ISC性别差异，但未提出新方法、未建立因果机制、未链接临床干预或解码应用，也未推动BCI范式演进；远低于所有基石论文（均涉及实时闭环解码、临床功能重建或新型植入接口），仅相当于高质量生物标志物探索性研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了迄今最稳健的儿童EEG-ISC性别差异实证，但属于现象刻画而非机制突破或技术推进，暂不构成BCI或神经工程领域的范式改变。

papers.title: A Geometric Approach to Soft Actor-Critic with Zonotopes for Locomotion Learning
papers.abstract: Off-policy actor--critic methods control overestimation bias by taking the minimum of two critics. This uses the same aggregation rule everywhere, regardless of how the critics disagree. We propose \textbf{GeZo-SAC}, which uses auxiliary geometric representations to adapt critic pessimism to the state and action. Alongside its scalar value, each critic predicts a set of generators defining a zonotope. Probing this zonotope along sampled directions provides a geometric width, "subtracted from each critic value as a pessimistic offset, and a measure of disagreement between the two critics, aggregated with log-sum-exp. This disagreement controls how the critics are combined, moving from a width-weighted average toward the usual minimum as disagreement increases. At inference, the deployed policy is an unmodified SAC actor, since the generators are used only on the critic side during training.Across four MuJoCo-v5 locomotion benchmarks and six off-policy baselines, GeZo-SAC achieves the highest mean return on Ant-v5 and Hopper-v5 and remains competitive with other methods on the remaining tasks. Our analysis further shows that GeZo-SAC achieves the lowest average actuator work and action effort per metre among the evaluated methods, while maintaining near-zero measured overestimation frequency across all four environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）框架中引入了基于zonotope（zonotopic几何表示）的 critic 不确定性建模，用几何宽度和方向采样来动态调节 critic 的悲观偏移与双critic融合策略，从而降低过估计、减少动作能耗，在MuJoCo-v5标准仿真步态任务上取得平均回报领先。
analysis.claim: 通过为每个critic附加一个zonotope生成器集合，并利用其几何宽度和方向投影动态调制悲观偏移与critic聚合方式，可显著抑制过估计偏差、降低执行器功耗，同时不牺牲策略性能。
analysis.input: 状态-动作对（s,a）
analysis.output: 标量Q值 + zonotope生成器矩阵（用于训练时不确定性建模）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖MuJoCo仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在MuJoCo-v5上微幅提升平均回报并首次将zonotope几何结构嵌入SAC critic以显式建模不确定性，但未脱离经典off-policy RL范式，无跨任务/跨机体泛化验证，无真实硬件实验，未解决locomotion领域长期开放问题（如sim2real gap、多地形鲁棒性、零样本迁移），相比所列基石工作（全部面向通用具身智能、人形本体协同、世界模型或人类视频驱动，且含真实数据/部署/架构级创新），仅属扎实的算法微调，未达‘显著贡献’门槛（60分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在SAC critic中嵌入zonotope几何表示以调控悲观性，是RL不确定性建模的合理改进，但限于仿真、无泛化验证、无开源数据，属于有实证支撑但影响范围窄的算法工程优化。

papers.title: Sparse Feature Policy Unlearning Mitigates State Hallucination in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong generalization in robotic manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pretrained vision-language models. However, their deployment in real-world environments remains limited by recurring unreliable behaviors. In this work, we study state hallucination, a recurring failure pattern in which a VLA continues acting as if an unrealized robot-object state had been achieved. Our analyses find that state hallucination coincides with weakened attention to task-relevant visual regions, and a mechanistic interpretation via sparse autoencoders reveals that hallucination-associated sparse features are activated when these failures occur. Based on this analysis, we propose SOUL (Sparse feature pOlicy UnLearning), which selectively unlearns policy knowledge associated with state hallucination behaviors, where sparse features identified from hallucination failures and successful behaviors serve as explicit forgetting and retention targets, respectively. Experiments across VLA architectures in simulated and real-world environments show that our method substantially reduces hallucinated failures and improves task success without substantially compromising the existing manipulation capabilities. These results suggest that interpretable feature analysis provides a practical basis for selectively modifying undesirable knowledge in robot policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VLA模型在真实操作中常出现‘状态幻觉’（误以为某个物体状态已达成而继续错误动作），通过稀疏自编码器定位到与幻觉相关的神经特征，提出SOUL方法有选择地‘遗忘’这些特征对应的动作策略，从而减少幻觉失败，同时保留原有操作能力。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名推测可能为韩国或北美机构，但无署名信息支撑）
analysis.claim: 通过可解释的稀疏特征分析识别并选择性擦除VLA模型中导致状态幻觉的策略知识，可在不损害原有操作能力的前提下显著降低幻觉型失败。

analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
