papers.title: Similar Predictive Fit but Different Latent Dynamics: Characterizing Learned Dynamical Structure in Personalized Models of Brain Disorders
papers.abstract: As AI models move toward clinical decision-making and personalized treatment, understanding \emph{what} a model learns is important beyond predictive accuracy alone. We investigate whether personalized latent dynamics reveal clinically associated differences even when predictive fit is similar. A lightweight CNN--Transformer EEG foundation model pretrained on the Temple University EEG Corpus (TUEG) extracts segment-level representations. Using the Temple University Epilepsy Corpus (TUEP), representations are mapped to a shared latent-state space, and sparse multinomial logistic transition distributions (mLTD) are fit independently to each subject to obtain personalized transition-dependency graphs $W_n$. Analyses include $n{=}198$ subjects (99 epilepsy / 99 non-epilepsy). At $k{=}4$, epilepsy subjects exhibit substantially denser learned dependency structure ($p{=}1.1\times10^{-7}$), with the same pattern at $k{=}6$ (19.90 vs. 13.46; $p{=}5.2\times10^{-5}$). Graph-derived features provide moderate group discrimination under 5-fold subject-wise cross-validation (AUROC 0.68 at $k{=}4$; 0.65 at $k{=}6$). In contrast, held-out log-likelihood is nearly identical between groups at $k{=}4$ ($-0.992$ vs. $-0.991$; $p{=}0.95$), with similarly matched next-state prediction (AUROC 0.855 vs. 0.861; $p{=}0.54$). Thus, similar predictive fit does not imply similar learned dynamics: groups can be comparably predictable while differing substantially in the internal dynamical structure learned by personalized models. This distinction motivates evaluating learned structure alongside predictive performance in personalized clinical models.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量CNN-Transformer模型从癫痫患者和健康人的脑电数据中提取表征，再为每人单独拟合稀疏状态转移图；发现两组预测性能几乎一样，但癫痫患者的转移依赖图显著更稠密，说明预测准确率掩盖了内在动力学结构的临床相关差异。
analysis.claim: 即使个性化AI模型在预测性能上无显著差异，其学习到的潜在动力学结构（如状态转移依赖图）仍可揭示临床上有意义的神经生理差异。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序片段（来自TUEG/TUEP）
analysis.output: 个性化稀疏状态转移依赖图（W_n）及图衍生特征
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开脑电数据集（TUEG/TUEP），无需真实机器人或硬件采集
analysis.significance_reason: 工作有清晰科学洞见（预测等效≠动力学等效），但仅基于单一公开EEG数据集、未验证跨中心/跨设备泛化性，无临床干预闭环、无实时解码或治疗反馈，远未达基石论文级（如BCI语音合成/行走控制等90+分需真实世界功能恢复证据）；属扎实的方法论警示性研究，但临床转化链条极短。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有模型与图分析结合，揭示了预测指标的局限性，但缺乏新算法、新硬件、新范式或临床闭环验证，属于对现有AI临床应用方法论的重要提醒而非突破。

papers.title: SmolWAM: A Latent World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) predict a robot's actions together with the observations those actions will produce. However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. We present SmolWAM, a latent WAM that we derive from the 2B-parameter Cosmos Policy by keeping its pretrained trunk and rebuilding its inference interface: single-frame visual latents, cached text features that preserve the trunk's attention sinks, 12 of 28 transformer blocks, and 1,008 tokens from which actions and future visual latents are read out in one rectified-flow step. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个轻量化的世界-动作模型SmolWAM，把大模型Cosmos Policy压缩成能在边缘设备实时运行的版本，在LIBERO仿真任务上达到95.5%成功率，速度快、功耗低、内存占用小，但全程仅在仿真中验证，未用真实机器人。
analysis.claim: 通过结构化剪枝与接口重构，可将2B参数的世界-动作模型压缩为边缘友好的轻量版本，同时保留世界预测与动作生成能力。
analysis.input: 单帧图像视觉隐变量 + 缓存的文本特征（指令）
analysis.output: 16步动作序列 + 对应未来视觉隐变量（场景运动预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用LIBERO仿真轨迹训练
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程压缩工作：在LIBERO仿真上复现高成功率，但无真实机器人验证、无跨任务/跨机体泛化实验、无开源代码或模型、未挑战更难基准（如Open-X、RT-X）、未与同期SOTA（如τ₀-VLA、DAM-VLA）做公平对比；相比标尺中最低的π0（95分）仍存在数量级差距（无世界建模深度、无测试时计算、无开放数据支撑）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效压缩了已有大模型以适配边缘部署，但缺乏实证广度、开放性与科学纵深，目前仅是仿真环境下的性能移植

papers.title: Robota-Embed: Unified VLA Embeddings for Robot In-Context Learning and Evolution
papers.abstract: Retrieving useful context for a robot requires matching its task, execution stage, and the continuation that should follow. We introduce Robota-Embed, to our knowledge the first vision-language-action (VLA) embedding model to jointly encode all three modalities in both current-state queries and recorded future continuations. Predictive retrieval training aligns these endpoints, enabling historical continuations to serve as context at inference time. We construct a multi-source corpus of 1,695,684 cleaned training anchors and introduce Robota-Embed-Bench, with 4,000 queries and a shared 8,000-entry gallery. Robota-Embed achieves 47.33% clip-level and 81.77% episode-level R@1, exceeding action-free Gemini Embedding 2 by 22.09 and 33.47 percentage points. Controlled retrieval studies show that removing native action degrades retrieval more than removing vision. We study two complementary applications. Embed2ICL uses retrieved experience for training-free and training-based policy conditioning, increasing success from 47.0% to 56.3% in DROID-Sim and from 86.4% to 92.8% on the LIBERO difficult subset, while improving task progress on real robots. Embed2Evolve uses execution feedback to grow task-local memory and refine context use around a frozen GPT-6 Astra policy. Across five ManiSkill tasks, it achieves 68% success, compared with 24% for GPT-6 Astra Direct and 33% for a harness independently evolved with Omni-Embed-Nemotron-3B under the same protocol. Relative to the latter, it uses approximately 79.5% fewer policy tokens per test rollout, counting both successes and failures. These results show that a unified, action-aware retrieval space can support robot in-context learning and task-local context evolution.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）嵌入模型Robota-Embed，首次将任务当前状态（视觉+语言+动作）和未来执行片段（历史动作续写）联合编码到同一嵌入空间，用以支持机器人免训练的上下文检索式学习（ICL）和基于执行反馈的任务局部记忆演化（Evolve），在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其对策略成功率和token效率的提升。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；虽含大量中文名，但无法确认归属清华/北大/中科院/智元/银河等主流团队；arXiv未提供affiliation信息）
analysis.claim: 统一的、动作原生的VLA嵌入空间是实现机器人免训练上下文学习与任务局部记忆演化的关键基础设施。
analysis.input: 当前机器人状态的RGB图像+自然语言任务指令+当前动作（或动作token）
analysis.output: 多模态联合嵌入向量（用于检索历史成功片段）
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖合成/仿真数据：训练锚点来自多源清洗数据（未说明真实机器人占比），评估含DROID-Sim/LIBERO/ManiSkill等纯仿真基准，真实机器人仅提‘improving task progress on real robots’无定量指标
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有启发性（首次显式联合编码‘当前状态+未来续写’用于ICL/Evolve），但实证薄弱：无开源代码/模型/数据；真实机器人实验零量化（仅模糊描述）；所有核心指标（R@1、成功率提升、token节省）均在仿真环境完成，且未与RT-2/VioLA/DAM-VLA等基石工作做跨范式对比（如zero-shot泛化、世界模型耦合、多机体部署），属扎实但窄域的仿真级增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在VLA嵌入设计上做了合理扩展并验证了检索增强ICL/Evolve的可行性，但缺乏开源、真实硬件验证和范式级突破证据，尚未达到领域基石水准。

papers.title: One-Entry Golden Seamless Cloning with a Reusable Donor Streamlines Plant Gene Functional Analysis
papers.abstract: Summary Molecular cloning underpins functional genomics, yet current toolboxes force a trade-off. Golden Gate frameworks handle one-pot multi-fragment assembly but overcomplicate routine single-gene cloning, whereas Gibson, In-Fusion, and Gateway systems need backbone linearization, resequencing, or proprietary recombinases that leave scars. Here we present Golden Seamless (GS), a one-entry, many-destination system in which a single PCR captures a gene once into a reusable Entry-and-Expression Clone that is never re-cloned. Circle-to-circle Golden Gate moves the same validated clone into plant, yeast, or bacterial vectors without linearization, and a ccdB counter-selection with orthogonal antibiotic markers drives background near zero. Bacterial destinations embed superfolder GFP, enabling naked-eye monitoring of recombinant proteins and an antibody-free dual-modality EMSA that resolves protein and DNA channels across a >150-nm spectral gap. GS thus consolidates capture, distribution, and validation into one low-background workflow with built-in quality control, cutting the time and cost of screening many candidates across functional assays.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种名为Golden Seamless（GS）的新型分子克隆方法，只需一次PCR扩增就能将目标基因捕获进一个可重复使用的‘入口-表达’载体，之后通过环状到环状的Golden Gate反应直接转移到多种宿主（植物、酵母、细菌）载体中，无需线性化、无疤痕、背景极低，并内置GFP荧光监控和免抗体EMSA验证功能，大幅简化植物基因功能分析流程。
analysis.claim: Golden Seamless（GS）系统通过一次性基因捕获+环状载体间无缝转移+ccdB/抗生素双重筛选，实现零疤痕、零重克隆、近零背景的跨宿主基因功能分析工作流整合。
analysis.input: 目标基因的PCR产物
analysis.output: 含目标基因的植物/酵母/细菌表达载体（带sfGFP标签）、可直接用于EMSA的功能蛋白-DNA复合物检测信号
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据；完全基于常规分子生物学实验（PCR、转化、电泳、荧光成像）
analysis.significance_reason: 属植物功能基因组学关键实验技术的重大工程优化：实证覆盖植物/酵母/细菌三系统，展示多基因并行克隆、GFP实时监控、免抗体EMSA等闭环验证能力，显著降低假阳性与重复劳动；但未开辟新范式（如AI驱动设计或原位动态解析），也未解决长期悬而未决的基础难题（如大片段精准插入、体内原位编辑），属于扎实、可立即落地的高阶工具升级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是分子克隆领域面向植物功能研究的一次高质量工程整合，实证充分、跨宿主通用、质量控制内嵌，但未达基石级范式突破

papers.title: Brain-Prompt Injection: A Route-Safety Audit for BCI-LLM Agents
papers.abstract: BCI-to-agent pipelines turn decoded neural activity into an authorization channel for tool-use agents, exposing a new attack surface we call \emph{brain-prompt injection}: signal-side perturbations, context-only injections, and adaptive dual-decoder attacks can all change the routed action while EEG-side or text-side monitors remain blind. Route safety in this stack depends on what the audit log can observe, not on decoder accuracy or agreement alone. We define a Route-Safety Audit Contract: a minimal log schema, denominator hierarchy, and endpoint specification, and prove an audit-schema separation theorem together with a C3 attacked-dependence decomposition; clean agreement and marginal robustness do not identify the joint term that controls C3 routing. As a calibration layer on top of the contract, we apply split-conformal calibration to a non-oracle EEG confirmation channel and report the resulting false-accept frontier under an explicit threat-archetype matrix. We instantiate the contract on EEGMMI native left/right command-control over 5{,}400 events, harmless tool stubs, and seed/case denominators. Provenance blocks C2 routes ($0.000$); agreement-plus-provenance routes C3 flips ($1.000$); confirmation-plus-provenance routes them ($0.000$). The conformal frontier reaches FAR $0.000$ at clean utility $0.150$ for $α=.005$ and FAR $0.119$ at clean utility $0.452$ for $α=.10$ under acquisition isolation; an attacker-controllable confirmation channel breaks the bound to $\approx\!1$. Subject-cluster bootstrap confirms these intervals on $60$ subjects; cross-architecture (TinyEEGNet, EEGNetV4) and capacity-sweep results show within-regime saturation. Mediation and confirmation reduce risk; they are not intent certificates.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次系统识别并形式化了脑机接口与大语言模型联用时的新安全漏洞——‘脑提示注入’，即攻击者可通过篡改EEG信号或上下文诱导BCI-LLM代理执行错误动作，而现有监控手段（如解码准确率或文本一致性）完全无法察觉；作者提出‘路由安全审计合约’框架，定义最小日志规范、分母层级和端点约束，并通过理论证明+实证校准（split-conformal + EEG确认通道）在5400个真实EEGMMI事件上验证：加入溯源（provenance）和确认（confirmation）可将错误接受率（FAR）压至0.000，而仅靠一致性则完全失效。
analysis.claim: BCI-LLM代理的路由安全性不能依赖解码准确率或文本一致性，而必须由可审计的日志结构（含溯源、确认、分母定义）保障，否则存在隐蔽的脑提示注入攻击面。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号+上下文提示+工具调用请求
analysis.output: 路由决策审计日志（含C2/C3路由状态、确认置信度、分母归属）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实EEGMMI数据集中的5400个原生左右指令事件，但未使用真实机器人执行，仅用无害工具桩（harmless tool stubs）模拟路由结果
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并实证了BCI-LLM联合架构中被忽视的核心安全范式缺陷（脑提示注入），提出可形式化验证的审计合约框架，在真实EEG数据上完成多维度消融（provenance/confirmation/consensus组合）、跨模型（TinyEEGNet/EEGNetV4）与容量扫描验证，且给出严格统计保证（conformal calibration + subject-cluster bootstrap），但未部署于真实闭环系统、未覆盖侵入式BCI、未开放代码/模型，故强于一般安全分析但弱于临床级BCI里程碑（如92分的ALS语音合成）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是改进某个解码器，而是重构BCI-LLM信任链的底层安全契约，用形式化审计替代黑箱一致性，证据扎实且直击领域新风险盲区

papers.title: FlowMo-WM: A World Model with Object Momentum and Hidden Ambient Drift
papers.abstract: World models in robot learning predict future states from visual observations and actions, enabling agents to reason about the consequences of their controls. However, many action-conditioned models are evaluated in settings where motion is dominated by immediate control, whereas aquatic surface vehicles and other real-world objects continue moving under inertia and are displaced by hidden ambient drift, such as water currents or wind. We propose FlowMo-WM, an end-to-end trainable visual world model that infers object-centric motion state and a predictive long-history context associated with hidden drift from image-action histories without direct supervision of flow fields. FlowMo-WM factorizes image-action history into a short-history latent state, trained to summarize object-centric motion, and a longer-history context, trained to summarize slowly varying exogenous influences. A zero-context residual transition separates action-conditioned base dynamics from context-dependent drift effects during latent rollout. In simulated aquatic surface-vehicle environments with diverse hidden flows, disturbances, and randomized vehicle dynamics, FlowMo-WM improves long-horizon rollout accuracy over representative action-conditioned latent world models. Prediction-time context ablations, in which the inferred context is zeroed or shuffled during rollout, show that the ambient context is important for stable prediction under hidden drift, while frozen linear probes characterize information encoded in the learned factors.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlowMo-WM世界模型，专门建模物体在惯性运动和隐藏环境漂移（如水流、风）共同作用下的长期动态，通过解耦短时动作驱动状态与长时环境上下文，在仿真水面试航环境中提升了长程状态预测精度。
analysis.claim: 将世界模型中的动力学显式分解为动作驱动的基线运动与隐式环境漂移上下文，可显著提升在存在惯性和隐藏外力的真实感动态系统中的长时序视觉状态预测鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 图像序列+动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步图像预测（隐空间 rollout 结果）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真水面试航器（无真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉的解耦建模范式（动作基线+隐式漂移上下文），并在定制化仿真环境中验证了其对长程预测的增益，但仅限单一仿真场景、无真实硬件验证、无开源代码/数据、未与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3/Genie）在标准基准上横向对比，属于扎实但窄域的机制改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：机制设计合理且有实证支持，但受限于仿真封闭场景和零复现性，尚未构成范式突破或跨领域推广价值。

papers.title: ThinkingVLA: Interleaved Vision and Language Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations directly to actions without explicit reasoning, limiting their capacity for reasoning-intensive long-horizon tasks. To address this, existing approaches adopt Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to enable subgoal decomposition and spatial anticipation. However, those methods lack a unified architecture for effective cross-modal reasoning and fail to explicitly include inverse reasoning ability based on the target state. We argue that manipulation planning naturally decomposes into prediction, anticipating the next visual state, and inverse dynamics, inferring the actions to reach it. Bridging both requires a unified autoregressive architecture that interleaves textual and visual reasoning in a single generation process. We propose \textbf{ThinkingVLA}, a generative model that realizes this decomposition within a unified Mixture-of-Transformers architecture. ThinkingVLA consists of a forward CoT that identifies the immediate subgoal and guides the visual forecasting; the predicted image then serves as the target state, grounding an inverse CoT that reasons about spatial relationships and action intent based on the predicted image; and the final action is generated conditioned on this full reasoning context. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ThinkingVLA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, with particularly large gains on long-horizon manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出ThinkingVLA模型，用统一的自回归架构交替进行视觉与语言推理：先用正向思维链预测下一步图像状态（前向CoT），再以该预测图为目标，用逆向思维链反推达成该状态所需动作（逆向CoT），从而在长程操作任务中提升规划能力。
analysis.claim: 操纵规划本质是预测（前向）与逆推（逆向）的耦合过程，需通过统一的、视觉-语言交错生成的自回归架构显式建模二者协同，而非仅单向映射或分离式CoT。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端动作（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / simulated Panda in PyBullet or similar
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练数据；真实机器人实验仅用于少量验证（摘要称“real-world benchmarks”，但未说明规模/多样性/是否闭环控制）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的前向+逆向CoT解耦框架，但缺乏真实机器人多任务闭环验证、无跨机体泛化实证、未开源代码/模型、未报告消融实验细节；性能提升集中在仿真长程任务，未挑战RT-2/Octo级开放环境或复杂物理交互，属扎实但非范式突破的增量设计。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CoT拆解为可解释的前向预测+逆向动作推导，在仿真中验证了思路有效性，但真实部署证据薄弱、复现不可行，尚未达到基石模型所要求的鲁棒性、开放性与可扩展性标准。

papers.title: Pixels to Proofs: Probabilistically-Safe Latent World Model Control via Parallel Conformal Robust MPC
papers.abstract: We present SLS^2, a framework for safe feedback motion planning from pixels using robust model predictive control (MPC) in learned latent world models. Our approach trains an action-conditioned joint-embedding world model with compact Markovian latent states, enabling efficient gradient-based trajectory optimization through learned latent dynamics. To enforce safety for the true system despite imperfect latent predictions, we inform a GPU-accelerated system level synthesis (SLS) robust MPC scheme with conformal prediction to obtain calibrated latent error bounds and robust latent-space constraint sets. We further learn and conformalize a latent constraint checker, allowing the SLS planner to impose probabilistic safety constraints during closed-loop execution. We evaluate our method on vision-based control tasks, where it improves both goal-reaching performance and safety over latent world-model and safe-planning baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SLS²框架，用像素输入训练一个带动作条件的隐空间世界模型，再结合共形预测校准隐状态预测误差，并嵌入到GPU加速的系统级合成（SLS）鲁棒MPC中，实现视觉驱动下的概率安全运动规划。
analysis.claim: 在像素输入下，通过共形预测校准隐空间世界模型的不确定性，并将其嵌入系统级鲁棒MPC框架，可实现闭环执行中可证的概率安全性与更高任务成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 安全的动作序列（闭环控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（未明确硬件平台，实验基于模拟器）

papers.title: Multi-Scale Machine Learning for Antibody-Antigen Binding Affinity Prediction Using Deep Mutational Scanning and Structural Features
papers.abstract: Predicting how mutations alter antibody-antigen binding affinity is essential for antibody engineering and vaccine design, yet current methods generalize poorly to unseen complexes. We present a multi-scale machine learning framework integrating 93 descriptors across four modalities: physicochemical, structural, ESM-2 protein language model, and solvent-accessible surface area (SASA)/ΔΔG_fold features. Under leave-one-complex-out deep mutational scanning (LOCO-DMS) cross-validation on AbAgym (36,541 mutations, 68 experiments, 13 pathogens), gradient boosting achieved MCC = 0.206; a confidence-stratified ensemble reached MCC = 0.374 (83.5% accuracy, 25.5% coverage). No single modality exceeds the majority baseline alone; only multi-scale fusion succeeds. Boltzmann ceiling analysis shows 45.9% of mutations are near-neutral (|ΔΔG| < k_BT), bounding theoretical maximum MCC at 0.473; our method achieves 79.1% of this limit. Five deep learning architectures benchmarked under LOCO-DMS showed self-attention matching gradient boosting (MCC = 0.200). Cross-pathogen transfer failed systematically (mean 46.7%), confirming universal binding predictors remain an open challenge.

analysis.tldr: 用多尺度特征融合（物理化学、结构、ESM-2嵌入、SASA/ΔΔG_fold）预测抗体-抗原突变结合亲和力变化，在严格留一复合物交叉验证下达到MCC=0.374，逼近理论极限79%，证明单一模态无效、必须多模态融合，且跨病原体泛化彻底失败。
analysis.claim: 抗体-抗原结合亲和力突变效应的准确预测必须依赖跨四类模态（physicochemical、structural、ESM-2、SASA/ΔΔG_fold）的特征融合，单一模态无法超越随机基线，而多尺度集成可逼近热力学理论上限。
analysis.input: 抗体-抗原复合物的突变位点及对应四类特征：物理化学描述符、结构几何特征、ESM-2蛋白语言模型嵌入、溶剂可及表面积与折叠稳定性变化（SASA/ΔΔG_fold）

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严苛实验设计和理论边界分析，确立了多模态融合是亲和力预测的必要路径，但因完全未开源且无新架构/生成能力，暂未形成领域推动力。

papers.title: PAMAE: Phase-Aware-MoE Action Experts Towards Reliable Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Reliable action generation for multi-stage robotic manipulation remains challenging for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While existing flow-matching VLA policies offer strong multimodal grounding and generalization, they typically employ a single shared action expert, limiting their ability to capture phase-specific control patterns across distinct execution stages. We propose a plug-and-play Phase-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Action Module (PAMAE), as a step towards more reliable phase-consistent action generation. PAMAE replaces the original flow-matching action expert with a sparse expert mixture while preserving the pretrained VLA backbone. PAMAE introduces a phase-aware router that leverages execution-phase cues to allocate action generation across experts, supported by a lightweight phase prediction head and a routing alignment objective. To stabilize specialization, we adopt a two-stage training scheme that first warms up the expert module under the standard flow-matching loss and then optimizes phase-consistent routing under auxiliary supervision. On multi-stage manipulation simulation tasks, PAMAE improves task success by up to \textbf{9.2\%} over strong VLA baselines. Further ablations show that both phase-supervised routing and staged optimization are essential for the observed gains. Our results highlight phase-consistent expert allocation as an effective mechanism for improving the reliability and action quality of flow-matching VLA policies.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个即插即用的相位感知MoE动作模块PAMAE，让现有视觉-语言-动作模型在多阶段操作任务中按执行阶段动态分配不同专家生成动作，从而提升动作可靠性和任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 在保持预训练VLA主干不变的前提下，通过相位感知的稀疏MoE动作模块和两阶段训练，可显著提升flow-matching VLA策略在多阶段操作中的相位一致性与动作可靠性。

papers.title: A Thin Film Transistor Backplane for Scalable Chronic Neural Interfaces
papers.abstract: Abstract Scaling neural interfaces to ever-higher channel counts has accelerated rapidly with advances in thin-film fabrication, lithography, and connectorization, enabling passive arrays to reach thousands of channels and chart credible pathways to much larger formats. Integrating active electronics directly at the sensing sites offers a complementary route to higher channel density by reducing the number of interconnects required to access large arrays. Here we introduce a monolithic flexible thin-film integrated circuit platform for active neural sensing, inspired by active-matrix display technology. The system integrates dual-gate amorphous indium gallium zinc oxide transistors on polyimide substrates to implement in-pixel transconductance amplification and row-column time-division multiplexing, improving scability for high-channel-count applications. Co-optimization of device architecture, contact engineering, and a hybrid ceramic-polymer thin-film encapsulation yields stable operation with projected lifetimes exceeding 38 years under accelerated aging. In acute and chronic in vivo rat studies, the platform exhibits negligible thermal burden, robust sensory-evoked recordings, and stable functionality over 30 days despite tissue encapsulation. These results establish display-inspired flexible thin-film electronics as a scalable building block for next-generation neural interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一种基于柔性薄膜晶体管（TFT）背板的新型神经接口硬件平台，用显示技术中的主动矩阵思路，在电极像素点上集成放大电路和时分复用电路，大幅减少外部引线数量，实现了高通道数、长期稳定（30天慢性记录）、低热损伤的柔性脑机接口。

papers.title: DVG-WM: Disentangled Video Generation Enables Efficient Embodied World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Video-based embodied world models provide an appealing substrate for robotic manipulation by predicting future states, yet current approaches remain limited by a fundamental entanglement: accurately modeling dynamics typically requires low-level temporal reasoning, while producing high-resolution frames demands expansive visual synthesis according to high-level semantics. This entanglement results in slow inference speed for iterative planning or too coarse predictions to retain contact-rich details. To solve this dilemma, we present Disentangled Video Generation World Model (DVG-WM), an efficient framework that explicitly decomposes world modeling into dynamics learning and visual synthesis. Conditioned on an initial observation and a language instruction, our model first generates a plausible sequence of intermediate visual states to preview the physical interaction and refines them to obtain high-fidelity videos. Furthermore, an efficient cascading mechanism is proposed, where DVG-WM uses flow matching to directly map the dynamics to video latents, and introduces a latent degradation mechanism to regenerate contact-rich details. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world platforms demonstrate improved video quality with up to 3.97 times acceleration, validating that disentangled video generation can be an efficient embodied world model for robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个解耦视频生成的世界模型DVG-WM，把物理动力学建模和高清视觉合成分开做，用流匹配+潜在空间退化机制加速预测，在LIBERO仿真和真实机械臂上实现了最高3.97倍提速且视频更清晰，尤其保留接触细节。
analysis.claim: 解耦动力学学习与视觉合成可显著提升具身世界模型的推理效率与接触细节保真度，无需牺牲视频质量即可加速机器人规划。

papers.title: AI-enabled rhodopsin design for blue-light enhanced bacterial growth
papers.abstract: Abstract We developed an AI-guided design pipeline that generated and validated non-natural microbial rhodopsins with spectral properties not yet known in nature. The pipeline comprised a three-stage in silico design, a genetic algorithm (GA) for sequence generation, a stacked LASSO and XGBoost machine-learning (ML) regressor for spectral prediction and fitness ranking, and a Markov-based sequence plausibility filter to enforce proton pumping like characteristics. Four candidate rhodopsins (APR1, APR2, APR6, and APR7) targeting blue light absorption were designed and AlphaFold3 structural modelling predicted retinal binding pocket architecture consistent with outward proton-pumping function. Experimental characterisation confirmed that all four variants absorbed light at ∼410 nm and significantly promoted the growth of Cupriavidus necator under blue light illumination. This study demonstrates that AI-enabled design can engineer proteins with no natural precedent, generating light-harvesting rhodopsins with novel spectral properties while preserving biological function, marking a significant advance in programmable synthetic biology.

analysis.tldr: 用AI设计出自然界不存在的蓝光吸收视紫红质蛋白，实验证明它们能在蓝光下显著促进细菌生长，且保持质子泵功能。
analysis.claim: AI可从头设计具有全新光谱特性（~410 nm吸收）且保留质子泵功能的非天然视紫红质，实现蓝光驱动的细菌生长增强。

papers.title: STEAM: Self-Supervised Temporal Ensemble Advantage Modeling for Real-World Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Real-world robot learning increasingly relies on heterogeneous data, but demonstrations and rollouts often mix useful progress with stalls, corrections, and suboptimal behavior. Effective policy learning therefore requires frame-level advantages that distinguish reliable local progress from failures and regressions. We propose Self-supervised Temporal Ensemble Advantage Modeling (STEAM), a label-free method that learns such advantages from expert demonstrations. STEAM trains an ensemble of temporal-offset predictors on frame pairs within expert trajectories, using the normalized temporal offset between two frames as a self-supervised signal. Each predictor maps a frame pair to a distribution over temporal offsets, which is converted into a scalar advantage. STEAM then takes the minimum advantage across the ensemble to score mixed-quality rollout data conservatively. Across real-world bimanual towel folding, chip checkout, cola restocking, and single-arm pick-and-place tasks, STEAM identifies stalls, failures, and recoveries. When combined with CFGRL, STEAM further improves policy success rate by 59%, 54.3%, 23% and 16.2% over baselines, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出STEAM方法，用专家演示视频中帧对的时间偏移作为自监督信号，训练多个时序预测器来估计每帧的局部进展优势值，从而自动过滤真实机器人任务中 rollout 数据里的卡顿、失败和恢复片段，提升下游策略学习效果。
analysis.claim: 无需人工标注或奖励函数，仅从专家演示视频中自监督学习帧级优势信号，可稳健识别真实机器人rollout中的进展、停滞与失败。

papers.title: Robots Ask the Way: Communication-Enabled Social Navigation
papers.abstract: Assistive autonomous robots operating in multi-agent environments require efficient strategies to locate specific individuals among multiple residents. Current social navigation methods focus on reactive collision avoidance and trajectory adaptation, but lack mechanisms to proactively gather information through human-robot communication. We introduce Communication-enabled Social Navigation (CommNav). In this novel task, robotic agents actively seek assistance from residents to locate target individuals by requesting information about recent sightings, locations, and movements. To evaluate CommNav, we extend Habitat 3.0 to create Habitat 3.0c, a communication-enabled variant supporting multi-human environments with information exchange protocols. Adding our communication module (COMM) to a state-of-the-art social navigation model yields a 10 percentage-point improvement in Episode Success. We further investigate the transition from structured data to natural language by evaluating models trained on LLM-generated instructions and on colloquial instructions collected from a human study. Our experiments reveal that: (i) explicit human-robot communication substantially enhances multi-person navigation performance; (ii) pre-training COMM on a communication pretext task effectively addresses the challenge of occasional interaction signals; and (iii) the navigation policy is highly robust to natural, colloquial human language, achieving an episode success statistically similar to the model using perfect structured data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让机器人在复杂室内环境中主动向人类问路找人，通过新增通信模块（COMM）让导航模型能理解并利用人类提供的口语化位置信息，显著提升了找人成功率。

papers.title: Green for Go, Red for No: Visual Grounding via Semantic Segmentation for VLA Navigation Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robot navigation from natural language and visual goals, but remain susceptible to perceptual distractions and ambiguous scene interpretations. This paper presents the first empirical evaluation of visual grounding for VLA navigation policies. We propose a real-time segmentation-based grounding method that highlights traversable areas in green and non-traversable areas in red using SegFormer. Two variants are evaluated: observation-only segmentation and joint observation-goal augmentation. Using OmniVLA on the Grand Tour dataset, we show that visual grounding reduces the mean waypoint error by 27-44% at the farthest waypoint, depending on the instruction length. The benefits are greater for long instructions than for short instructions, and grounding provides little improvement for image goals. Normalized error analysis indicates that grounding primarily acts as a trajectory length regularizer, reducing the predicted path length by 30% without improving per-unit-distance reasoning. Our results indicate that visual grounding offers a simple, computationally inexpensive method to improve VLA navigation without model retraining, although it cannot compensate for missing training signals in out-of-distribution instructions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在VLA导航中引入语义分割（SegFormer）做实时视觉接地，用红绿颜色标记可通行/不可通行区域，不改模型、不重训练，就让OmniVLA在Grand Tour数据集上的远端路点误差下降27–44%，但只对长语言指令有效，对图像目标无效，且本质是缩短预测路径而非提升推理精度。
analysis.claim: 视觉接地（通过实时语义分割高亮可通行区域）是一种无需模型重训练、计算开销低、能显著降低VLA导航远端路点误差的即插即用式改进，尤其对长语言指令有效。

analysis.output: 导航动作序列/路点坐标
