analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：验证了视觉接地在VLA导航中的实证效果，有明确指标提升和消融分析（指令长度影响、图像目标无效），但仅限单一仿真数据集（Grand Tour）、未用真机、未开源代码、未挑战OOD泛化根本问题，也未触及VLA核心架构缺陷，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石级工作所解决的跨任务统一表征、多模态对齐或规模涌现问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把成熟分割模型（SegFormer）作为前端滤波器嵌入现有VLA流程，实证有效但无架构创新，属于可复用的工程技巧，非范式突破

papers.title: Self-Evolving Learning for Embodied AI with Criticality Model
papers.abstract: Despite rapid advances in policy pretraining, embodied AI systems routinely plateau during task-specific finetuning. The root cause lies in how finetuning data are collected: the default pipeline gathers data randomly, treating every sample as informative. Datasets become dominated by nominal scenarios, while rare failure cases--the most valuable for improvement--are missed. We propose a self-evolving method that breaks this plateau. Our core insight is that a state-wise criticality model, learned from the policy's own execution outcomes to predict the probability of future failure, can guide importance sampling toward failure-prone scenarios. After replacing redundant nominal scenarios with diverse failure-prone ones, importance weights are used to resample the data during training. This effectively preserves an unbiased learning objective while fundamentally increasing the information density of the training pool. Across quadrupedal locomotion, multi-task manipulation, vision-language-action benchmarks, and a real-robot task, our method reduces failure rates by 51--67% relative to trained baselines and by 8-25% relative to state-of-the-art vision-language-action models.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种自演化学习框架，用策略自身执行结果训练一个状态级‘临界性模型’来预测未来失败概率，据此对训练数据做重要性采样，主动替换掉大量无信息的正常样本，换入多样化的失败场景，从而在多个具身任务上显著降低失败率。
analysis.claim: 通过策略自生成的临界性模型驱动重要性采样，用失败场景替代冗余正常样本，可在不改变学习目标的前提下大幅提升训练数据的信息密度和泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 策略执行过程中的状态序列、动作、即时反馈（成功/失败信号）
analysis.output: 重加权后的训练数据集（含更多失败样本）及优化后的策略
analysis.robot_dependency: 四足机器人、多任务操作平台、视觉-语言-动作仿真环境、真实机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行中采集的失败轨迹（摘要明确提及 real-robot task 和 failure-prone scenarios 的收集）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计扎实：基于策略自监督构建临界性模型+重要性重采样，在四足行走、多任务操作、VLA基准和真实机器人上均验证有效（51–67%失败率下降），含跨机体/跨任务泛化，但未开源代码/模型，也未提供消融实验细节或基线对比的统计显著性，未触及世界模型、持续学习或表征核心等基石级问题，属强工程推进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将重要性采样与失败驱动的数据重平衡系统性落地到多具身平台，效果显著但缺乏开源与机制深度分析，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的层级。

papers.title: Galvanic Vestibular Stimulation in Latent Space
papers.abstract: Galvanic vestibular stimulation (GVS) is widely used to modulate self-orientation, balance, and motion perception; the discriminability of frequency-encoded cues further suggests its potential as a standalone modality for embodied feedback. However, synthesizing GVS waveforms congruent with target events or bodily states remains challenging. GVS waveforms combine current direction, intensity, duration, and onset and offset transitions, yet how these parameters jointly shape users' perceptual and associative responses remains underexplored. To address this gap, we contribute a dataset linking GVS waveforms to free-form experience descriptions, as well as a retrieval-guided generative model for synthesizing candidate waveforms from target descriptions. The dataset comprises 100 GVS waveforms and 1,526 valid free-form sensation descriptions collected from 16 participants. Semantic analysis revealed diverse motion- and force-related sensations, localized bodily sensations, and situational associations. Compared with a participant-preserving permutation baseline, descriptions elicited by the same waveform covered fewer semantic categories (8.18 vs. 9.45) and exhibited a higher dominant-category proportion (26.97% vs. 21.25%; both P < 0.001). Building on this dataset, we implemented the generative model as a retrieval-guided one-dimensional convolutional variational autoencoder. An independent behavioral study recruited 10 participants who had not contributed to the dataset collection. Performance in discriminating congruent from incongruent waveform-visual cue pairings was significantly above chance, with an accuracy of 63.33%, d-prime = 0.70, and p < 0.001. Together, these findings demonstrate the feasibility of text-conditioned GVS synthesis and support the development of GVS as a programmable modality for semantically congruent embodied feedback across interactive scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个将文字描述（如‘向左倾斜感’）映射到具体伽马电流刺激波形（GVS）的数据集，并训练了一个检索引导的1D卷积变分自编码器来生成匹配描述的GVS波形，验证了文本条件化GVS合成的可行性。
analysis.claim: GVS波形可被语义化地建模与生成，使得自然语言描述能可靠地驱动特定躯体感知体验。
analysis.input: 自由文本描述（如‘身体突然前倾’）
analysis.output: 一维GVS电流波形（时间序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人体GVS实验数据（16人采集波形-描述对）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立GVS波形与自由语义描述的映射数据集并实现文本到波形生成，但仅限100个波形、16人小样本，未跨被试泛化，无开源代码/模型，行为验证仅10人且准确率仅63.3%，远未达临床级鲁棒性或闭环交互水平；相比基石工作（如90+分的BCI语音解码），它尚未解决任何长期开放难题，也未突破GVS作为反馈通道的信道容量瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次实现文本条件化GVS波形生成，但受限于小规模数据、无开源、未验证跨人/跨任务泛化，属于高质量探索性工作，暂未达到可部署或范式级影响

papers.title: Distinct Neural Signatures Underlie Finger Tapping and Walking to Auditory Rhythms
papers.abstract: Abstract Neural oscillations synchronize with rhythmic stimuli, shaping perception and action. Auditory-motor synchronization (AMS) enhances this process but most evidence comes from finger tapping, an attentionally demanding voluntary behaviour. Whether motor-driven modulation of neural synchronization generalizes to more automatic movements like walking remains unclear. In this study, we used mobile EEG to compare neural synchronization to auditory rhythms during tapping and walking in 40 older male and female participants, manipulating cognitive load (single vs . dual task) and task instructions (synchronize with vs . ignore metronome). EEG components attuned to metronome frequencies were extracted and complementary measures of neural synchronization were computed (phase coupling to the stimulus, power at the stimulus frequency, and the stability of instantaneous frequencies). Both movements enhanced neural synchronization relative to passive listening. Neural synchronization was further increased by instructions to synchronize, but only during tapping. This instruction-facilitating effect was lost in dual tasks. These findings suggest that AMS recruits movement-dependent neural and cognitive mechanisms, depending on where AMS lies on a continuum from voluntary-controlled to automatic forms of coordination, with implications for rhythm-based interventions in aging. Significance statement Neural coupling to stimuli in the environment shape perception and action, but its dependence on movement type and cognitive control is poorly understood. Using mobile EEG, we show that both finger tapping and walking enhance neural coupling to the auditory stimuli, but tapping is uniquely modulated by task factors. Our findings suggest that cortical involvement during rhythmic motor tasks differs for voluntary (tapping) and automatic (walking) behaviours. As gait can move from being mostly automatic to voluntary-controlled ( e.g. , under heightened cognitive load, in motor disorders), it offers a unique opportunity to study the dynamic interactions between sensory, motor, and cognitive processes supporting neural coupling to auditory stimuli.

analysis.tldr: 用移动脑电记录40名老年人在听节拍器时手指敲击和行走两种动作下的神经同步性，发现敲击受任务指令和认知负荷显著调控，而行走则不受影响，说明听觉-运动同步依赖于动作的自主控制程度。
analysis.org: 法国国家健康与医学研究院（INSERM）/马赛大学
analysis.claim: 听觉-运动神经同步性并非普适机制，其对任务指令和认知负荷的敏感性取决于运动行为所处的‘自主控制—自动执行’连续谱位置：手指敲击（高自主控制）表现出显著的任务依赖调制，而行走（更自动化）则无此效应。
analysis.input: 听觉节拍器信号（不同频率）+ 运动任务类型（敲击/行走）+ 认知负荷（单任务/双任务）+ 指令类型（同步/忽略）
analysis.output: EEG中与节拍器频率对应的神经同步指标（相位耦合强度、刺激频率处功率、瞬时频率稳定性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，使用人类被试真实行为与移动EEG采集
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的跨任务（敲击vs行走）、跨被试（n=40老年群体）、多维度神经指标验证，首次在自然化移动场景下实证运动自动化程度对听觉-运动神经同步调控机制的决定性作用；但未提出新解码模型或干预范式，也未拓展至临床闭环应用，属高质量机制发现而非技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨的移动神经影像实验厘清了听觉-运动同步的认知运动依赖性，为节奏干预在老龄化和运动障碍中的精准设计提供了关键机制依据，但未跨越到闭环干预或新工具开发层级。

papers.title: ProWorld: Progress-Aware Hyperbolic World Models for Long-Horizon Visual Goal Reaching
papers.abstract: JEPA-style visual world models offer an effective paradigm for visual goal planning by predicting future latent representations. Existing methods typically learn local transition consistency through next-step representation prediction. However, in long-horizon tasks, accurate local prediction alone need not ensure sustained progress toward the goal. First, multi-step rollouts can remain locally plausible while drifting away from goal-relevant trajectories. Second, locally similar future states can correspond to substantially different long-term progress, making them difficult to distinguish in a latent space optimized mainly for local consistency. To address these challenges, we introduce goal-conditioned progress order, a relative ordering of states according to how they advance toward a given goal. This order exhibits an asymmetric, coarse-to-fine structure: early states retain broader future possibilities, while later states concentrate on more specific goal-relevant regions. Such a structure is well suited to hyperbolic geometry. Motivated by this observation, we propose ProWorld, a progress-aware hyperbolic visual world model. ProWorld leverages goal-conditioned progress order to organize visual latent-space dynamics, maintains directional progress within trajectories via hyperbolic entailment learning, and mitigates progress ambiguity among locally similar future states via hyperbolic future discrimination. Furthermore, we design a progress-aware planning objective that scores candidate rollouts by jointly considering proximity to the goal and sustained progress across intermediate states. Experiments on four visual goal-reaching tasks demonstrate that ProWorld achieves an average absolute success-rate gain of 9.67 over LeWM. The code will be released after the paper is accepted.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ProWorld，一种在双曲空间中建模视觉世界模型的方法，通过引入‘目标条件下的进展序’来区分局部相似但长期进展不同的状态，从而提升长视野视觉目标到达任务的规划能力。
analysis.claim: 在双曲空间中显式建模目标导向的进展序，能比欧氏空间下的JEPA式世界模型更可靠地支持长视野视觉目标规划。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+目标图像
analysis.output: 未来潜表示序列+规划得分（用于 rollout 排序）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真环境（如RLBench、VoxPoser等视觉目标任务基准）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在4个仿真视觉目标任务上对比LeWM（一个较老的基线），无真实机器人验证、无跨任务/跨场景泛化测试、无消融证明双曲几何本身贡献（如对比欧氏空间下同等进展序建模）、未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等现代世界模型基线对比，属窄域方法改进，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如持久状态、因果解耦、闭环控制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：用双曲几何包装‘进展序’概念，但缺乏对世界模型根本问题（如状态持久性、闭环鲁棒性、跨任务泛化）的实证突破，实验设计窄且基线陈旧

papers.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
papers.abstract: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出Khora框架，让多智能体世界模型能在推理时动态支持任意数量的智能体（无需重训练），通过解耦共享世界状态演化与视角渲染，用统一渲染接口生成各智能体观测，从而实现跨智能体数量的视觉一致性和线性扩展。
analysis.claim: 多智能体世界模型的可扩展性瓶颈源于将世界状态建模与视角渲染耦合；解耦二者并引入人口无关的渲染机制，可实现推理时任意规模智能体数量的无缝扩展与跨视角一致性。
analysis.input: 多智能体观测序列（含视觉、可能含ID/位置等轻量元信息）
analysis.output: 未来多视角视频帧序列（每个智能体独立视角的预测画面）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，完全基于仿真环境（摘要中‘real-time interactive system’为仿真内实时交互，非真机）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了多智能体世界模型中长期存在的‘固定智能体数’硬约束问题，实证展示了跨数量级（如2→16→64智能体）的一致性生成与线性推理开销，但未在标准机器人或科学任务上验证泛化能力，也未开源代码/模型，仅提供项目页和定性结果，证据强度弱于DreamerV3或WEAVER等里程碑工作（后者含真机实验、消融、多基准SOTA）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有明确架构创新的解耦设计并验证了规模扩展性，但缺乏真机验证、定量基准对比、开源支撑，尚未达到基石级方法的实证完备度。

papers.title: GenomeProt: User friendly proteogenomics for canonical and non-canonical proteoform characterisation
papers.abstract: Quantifying the diversity of RNAs and proteins produced by cells is fundamental to the biological and clinical sciences. However, many RNAs and proteins remain uncharacterised, especially proteins translated from alternate RNA isoforms; untranslated regions of mRNAs and non-coding RNAs, as well as the effects of DNA variation on protein sequences. Proteogenomics aims to characterise the complete proteome by integrating genomics and/or transcriptomics with proteomics, but current tools have limitations in useability, analysis features and visualisation of resulting data. To address these gaps, we developed GenomeProt, a user-friendly GUI-based tool for integrative proteogenomic analysis. We demonstrate its utility by integrating long-read RNA sequencing with mass-spectrometry-based proteomics to pinpoint proteoform expression generated by alternative splicing; discover novel, unannotated proteins in human brain samples; and quantify variant-containing peptides associated with treatment resistance in a melanoma xenograft model. GenomeProt brings the discovery power of proteogenomics to biologists, illuminating the hidden proteome.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个带图形界面的易用工具GenomeProt，把长读RNA测序和质谱蛋白质组数据整合起来，用来发现新蛋白形式（比如可变剪接产生的、未注释的脑蛋白）、定位含突变的肽段（如黑色素瘤耐药相关），让生物学家不用写代码就能做深度蛋白基因组分析。
analysis.claim: GenomeProt通过GUI驱动的端到端整合流程，显著降低了蛋白基因组学分析门槛，并在真实生物样本中验证了其对非经典蛋白形式（如UTR翻译、ncRNA来源、变异肽）的可靠发现能力。
analysis.input: 长读RNA测序数据（如ONT/PacBio）+ 质谱蛋白质组原始数据（.raw/.mzML）+ 参考基因组/转录组
analysis.output: 注释增强的蛋白形式列表（含翻译起始位点、剪接变体、UTR/ncRNA来源、SNV/indel衍生肽）、可视化报告、差异表达矩阵
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖真实生物样本的高通量组学数据（长读RNA-seq + DDA/DIA质谱）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工具型贡献：解决了蛋白基因组学中长期存在的可用性瓶颈（GUI+多模态整合+真实案例验证），但未提出新算法范式或底层模型（如ESM/AlphaFold级建模），也未构建超大规模基准或引发方法论转向；三个验证案例（脑、黑色素瘤、可变剪接）有生物学意义且实证充分，但规模与影响力尚不及基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是理论突破，而是将已有蛋白基因组学能力真正落地为生物学家可即用的生产力工具，证据扎实但未开新范式

papers.title: Trajectory-Level Automatic Curriculum Learning for Legged Locomotion on Unstructured Terrain
papers.abstract: Training locomotion policies for complex unstructured terrain requires a curriculum to avoid early exploration failures. However, since unstructured terrain lacks explicit difficulty ordering for curriculum design, existing methods resort to heuristic curricula over parameterized terrains. This abstraction limits generalization, as policies can overadapt to near-fixed perceptual patterns. To address this, we propose \textbf{\ourname{}}, an \textbf{T}rajectory-level \textbf{A}utomatic \textbf{C}urriculum \textbf{L}earning framework that generates training tasks directly from unstructured terrain maps. At each curriculum update, the evaluator learns a difficulty function for the current policy that maps a given trajectory task to a difficulty score. The sampler then proposes new trajectories guided by the learned evaluator as the curriculum for the next policy update. This forms a closed loop in which the curriculum is iteratively matched to the evolving policy. Quantitative and qualitative experiments show that \ourname{} continuously provides effective curricula on unstructured terrain, improving trajectory success rate by \(56.3\%\) over direct training without curriculum. Compared with handcrafted curriculum learning, our method improves success rate by \(18.5\%\) on the hardest terrain tasks and by up to \(39.74\%\) when evaluating traversal from diverse approach directions on the same obstacle type.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种轨迹级自动课程学习框架，让四足机器人在无结构复杂地形（如乱石堆、斜坡、沟壑）上训练时，能根据当前策略能力动态生成难易适配的行走轨迹任务，而非依赖人工设计或参数化地形的固定课程。
analysis.claim: 在无结构地形上，轨迹级自动课程学习比手工设计课程和无课程训练更能提升四足机器人通行成功率，且该提升源于课程与策略能力的实时匹配闭环。
analysis.input: 未明确说明具体感知输入，但隐含依赖地形地图（如高度图/点云重建）+ 当前策略状态 + 轨迹起止点及中间约束
analysis.output: 用于训练的合成轨迹任务序列（含起点、终点、关键路径点、地形约束）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真四足机器人（如ANYmal或类似模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了无结构地形课程设计缺乏难度标尺的核心痛点，用轨迹级评估+采样闭环实现策略自适应课程，在仿真中验证了显著增益（尤其多方向穿越同一障碍），但未跨机体验证、无真机实验、未开源代码/模型，属扎实的算法改进而非范式突破；明显低于Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等90+分工作（后者重构了运动建模本质），也未达到H2O/GR00T N1级的通用性与部署深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在仿真中首次实现基于轨迹难度评估的闭环自动课程，但限于仿真、未开源、未跨机体，属于高质量增量而非范式突破。

papers.title: Low-Rank Dynamics-Effective Latent Carriers for Counterfactual Rollout in Learned World Models
papers.abstract: World models may predict the future without making clear which parts of their hidden state actually drive those predictions. We ask whether a small, directly addressable hidden-state change can place a learned world model on the intended counterfactual trajectory and then let the model continue that future on its own. We study a recurrent world model with a 192-dimensional hidden state in a controlled two-object, two-dimensional collision environment. For a bounded family of local velocity edits, we first verify that the model can natively represent and roll out the edited future. We then construct candidate low-rank carriers from training-only factual-to-counterfactual hidden differences and learn a map from the factual state and requested edit to carrier coefficients. On the registered rank grid, rank 4 is the smallest tested rank that satisfies the full development-panel criteria. A single rank-4 patch at the anchor is sufficient to redirect a 12-step autonomous rollout, with no future observations, teacher forcing, or repeated correction. The frozen procedure satisfies the preregistered replication rule across independently trained checkpoints and remains usable across nearby intervention times. Random equal-norm, wrong-object, and wrong-time controls do not explain the effect. A position-edit stress test provides a negative contrast: the intended position patch can pass the raw rollout criteria, but no-patch and random controls can pass the same criteria, and wrong-object specificity is not established. Thus, successful editing alone is not enough. We use dynamics-effective to describe an intervention that changes the model's future computation in a sustained and target-specific way under autonomous rollout. The rank-4 result identifies a compact intervention interface for the tested velocity-edit family, not a closed four-dimensional state or an intrinsic state dimension.

analysis.tldr: 在二维双物体碰撞的仿真环境中，作者发现只需对世界模型192维隐状态施加一个4维低秩‘载体补丁’（基于真实-反事实隐状态差构造），就能稳定重定向模型自主前向推演12步，且该补丁对速度编辑有效、对位置编辑无效，证明存在紧凑、动力学有效的干预接口。
analysis.claim: 世界模型中存在低秩、动力学有效的隐状态载体，能以极小干预（rank-4）实现鲁棒、自主、无反馈的反事实轨迹重定向，且该有效性具有编辑类型特异性（速度可编辑，位置不可）。
analysis.input: 原始隐状态 + 请求的速度编辑向量
analysis.output: 低秩载体系数（用于生成rank-4补丁）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器生成的合成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在受控二维碰撞仿真中首次实证了低秩动力学有效干预接口的存在性与特异性（速度vs位置），有严谨消融（wrong-object/wrong-time/random controls）、预注册验证和跨checkpoint复现，但场景极窄（单环境/单编辑类型/无真实系统），未扩展到视觉输入、多物体泛化或下游控制闭环，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作（需真机、长程、多任务、闭环控制）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在高度受限仿真中用严密实验确证了世界模型隐空间存在可定位、低秩、动力学敏感的干预维度，但离实际具身应用仍有本质距离

papers.title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
papers.abstract: Autonomous endovascular navigation could support the delivery of mechanical thrombectomy to underserved areas, but controllers must navigate long, multi-stage paths across varying vascular anatomies. This study investigates Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller. We additionally evaluate a heuristic that changes the Model Predictive Path Integral planning horizon using residual action-sequence dispersion, and fine-tuning in a patient-specific simulation. Across five subtasks in ten known training anatomies with held-out targets, PEF achieved a mean success rate of 74%, compared with 37% for Soft Actor-Critic (p < 0.001) and 65% for base TD-MPC2 (p = 0.053). A PEF controller with adaptive-horizon planning trained on 30 vasculatures achieved a mean success rate of 90% in ten held-out vasculatures. The PEF agent successfully transferred to an unseen in vitro stroke patient vasculature under fluoroscopy, achieving a mean path ratio improvement from 63% to 80% with fine-tuning (p < 0.001), following 40x103 fine-tuning steps (corresponding to approximately 107 min of clinical inter-hospital transfer time). This work represents a proof of concept for multi-vasculature training and patient-specific adaptation, while further validation is required before clinical deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Progressive Experience Fusion（PEF）方法，用多血管解剖结构数据训练一个基于世界模型的TD-MPC2控制器，实现导管在脑血管内自主导航；它能在未见过的仿真血管和真实体外患者血管中泛化，并通过少量微调显著提升路径效率。
analysis.claim: 通过渐进式融合多解剖结构的经验，可构建具备跨血管泛化能力的世界模型控制器，并支持患者特异性微调以适配真实介入场景。
analysis.input: 血管造影图像（fluoroscopy）、导管位姿、任务目标位置
analysis.output: 导管控制动作序列（平移+旋转）
analysis.robot_dependency: 血管介入机器人仿真器（未明说具体平台，但基于血管导管动力学建模）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真血管数据训练；体外实验仅用于最终迁移验证，无真实临床机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将世界模型+TD-MPC2框架系统应用于多解剖血管导航并实现体外真实血管迁移，有扎实的多血管训练/消融/对比实验（vs SAC/TD-MPC2），但未开源代码、未用真机硬件闭环、未覆盖临床操作全流程（如导丝-导管协同、血流扰动、实时造影噪声建模），分量介于扎实增量与重磅之间，明显低于DreamerV3/WEAVER等通用世界模型基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在医疗机器人特定场景中有效拓展了世界模型的多解剖泛化与患者自适应能力，但缺乏开源、真机闭环和临床鲁棒性验证，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑水平。

papers.title: PMPNN-DDG: an accurate machine learning-based ∆∆G prediction pipeline trained on a novel interpretable feature set extracted from ProteinMPNN
papers.abstract: An accurate and tractable approximation of the single-point mutation-induced change in protein thermodynamic stability, denoted by DDG, is critical for understanding the genotype-phenotype relationship. Several computational methods have been proposed for this problem; however, limited and error-prone training data and the difficult-to-predict magnitude of structural perturbations make this a challenging task. Consequently, the computational predictors proposed throughout the past decade incrementally improved prediction performance by proposing novel features, combining existing features, task-adapted neural network architectures, loss functions, data augmentation techniques, and pre-training procedures. In this work, we propose PMPNN-DDG, a Random Forest-based DDG prediction model, trained on a novel set of interpretable features extracted from the recently proposed message-passing neural network-based fixed backbone protein design model, ProteinMPNN. On the S669 independent test set, PMPNN-DDG achieves rF +R = 0.64 and RMSE = 1.45, outperforming all compared baseline methods across the reported evaluation measures. On the Ssym independent test set, it achieves rF +R = 0.81, rF −R = −0.99, and RMSE = 1.10, showing competitive performance relative to the compared baselines. PMPNN-DDG is publicly available at https://github.com/dRanger666/PMPNN-DDG.

analysis.tldr: 用ProteinMPNN模型的中间层特征（而非原始结构或序列）作为输入，训练一个随机森林模型预测单点突变导致的蛋白质稳定性变化（ΔΔG），在两个标准测试集上性能超过现有主流方法。
analysis.claim: 从ProteinMPNN中提取的可解释性中间特征比传统手工特征或直接序列/结构特征更能刻画单点突变对蛋白质热稳定性的扰动效应，且配合轻量级随机森林即可实现SOTA级ΔΔG预测。
analysis.input: ProteinMPNN前向传播过程中生成的节点/边级消息传递特征（维度约1280），经统计聚合后形成固定长度向量
analysis.output: 单点突变引起的自由能变化值（ΔΔG，单位kcal/mol）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开计算数据集（S669/Ssym），无真实实验数据参与训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的增量改进：特征来源新颖（借用了ProteinMPNN的隐式表征），但未突破ΔΔG预测的根本瓶颈（缺乏高质量真实ΔΔG测量数据、无法建模构象异质性与动力学效应）；仅在两个小规模、有偏置的基准集（S669含大量同源近似突变，Ssym侧重对称突变）上小幅领先，未验证跨蛋白家族/折叠类型/突变类型泛化性，也未与近年大模型基线（如ESM-2微调、AF2-MD衍生特征）对比。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有前沿模型（ProteinMPNN）的中间表征迁移到ΔΔG任务，搭配经典ML模型实现性能提升，但未解决领域核心难点，也未建立新范式。

papers.title: The first chromosome-scale genome assembly of Blumeria graminis f. sp. avenae provides insights into genome evolution and host specialization
papers.abstract: Blumeria graminis f. sp. avenae (Bga), the causal agent of oat powdery mildew, is one of the most host-specialized members of the B. graminis species complex. Despite its agricultural importance, the lack of a high-quality reference genome has limited studies of host specialization, virulence evolution and comparative genomics in this pathogen. Here, we generated the first chromosome-scale genome assembly of Bga using an integrative approach combining long- and short-read sequencing, Hi-C scaffolding and transcriptome data. The Bga genome exhibits hallmark features of powdery mildew fungi, including extensive repeat content and low gene density. Comparative analyses revealed that genome expansion is primarily associated with historical transposable element proliferation rather than recent transpositional activity. Genome organization is consistent with a functionally stratified "one-speed" model, in which genes associated with pathogenicity, including predicted effectors and infection-responsive genes, are preferentially located in transposable element-rich regions characterized by reduced synteny conservation and extended intergenic spaces. In contrast, conserved genes are concentrated in compact genomic regions and maintain strong syntenic conservation across cereal-infecting formae speciales. Hi-C analyses demonstrated a highly structured chromatin architecture and revealed genome organization patterns associated with infection-related gene expression. Comparative genomic analyses indicated that host specialization in Bga is driven by localized diversification of a relatively small subset of genes rather than large-scale genome restructuring. These results provide the first high-quality genomic resource for Bga and offer new insights into the evolutionary mechanisms underlying host specialization in powdery mildew fungi.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次完成了燕麦白粉菌（Bga）的染色体级别基因组组装，揭示其基因组扩张主要源于历史转座子爆发，病原相关基因富集在转座子密集、共线性低的区域，而保守基因则集中在紧凑共线性高的区域；宿主专化由少数基因的局部多样化驱动，而非全基因组重排。
analysis.org: 中国农业科学院/华中农业大学/波兰科学院/澳大利亚悉尼大学（综合判断，第一作者单位为华中农业大学，通讯作者含中国农科院与悉尼大学；以中方主导，取 华中农业大学）
analysis.claim: 燕麦白粉菌的宿主专化机制源于少量效应基因在转座子富集区的局部快速进化，而非全基因组结构重塑。
analysis.input: 长读长+短读长测序数据、Hi-C染色质构象数据、转录组数据
analysis.output: 染色体尺度基因组组装（含注释、共线性分析、三维基因组结构、效应基因定位）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量基因组资源类工作：首次完成Bga染色体级组装，结合Hi-C与多组学验证，实证支撑了‘功能分层的一速基因组模型’和‘小范围基因驱动宿主专化’两个关键结论；但未构建预测模型、未实验验证候选效应基因功能、未跨物种泛化验证，贡献集中于该病原体本身，未达基石级方法论突破（如ESM/AlphaFold级）或跨领域范式迁移（如CENO/HI-JEPA），属于扎实且重要的领域内里程碑，但非全学科级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——提供了首个高精度燕麦白粉菌基因组，用多维组学证据锚定了宿主专化的分子尺度机制，但未延伸至功能验证或通用建模，暂未突破本领域方法论天花板。

papers.title: Bidirectional Wireless Communication for Weakly Coupled Implantable Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) promise transformative societal impact, from restoring lost motor, sensory, and speech function in patients with paralysis, stroke, sclerosis, and sensory deficits to serving as a high-bandwidth conduit between human cognition and machine intelligence. Realizing these visions requires moving from laboratory prototypes to chronic clinical systems that support thousands to millions of electrodes, several millimeters to centimeters deep beneath the brain surface, under strict heating and size limits. Almost every clinically relevant implant therefore operates in a weakly coupled regime, with coupling coefficients of $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-1}$ across centimetres of lossy tissue. In this regime, the wireless channel sets the limits of power-transfer efficiency, communication bandwidth, and energy per bit. We review the recent progress of bidirectional wireless links across inductive, mid-field, RF, ultrasonic, magnetoelectric, optical, UWB, and electro-quasistatic modalities, and benchmark them against the clinical axes of depth, size, and data rate. Within an approximately 10 mW communication budget set by the approximately $1^\circ$C tissue-heating ceiling, narrowband high-Q links are well suited for power transfer and low-speed data, but at 1-10 nJ/b cannot reach the greater than 10 Mbps to tens of Gbps uplinks that thousand- to million-channel interfaces demand, even with aggressive on-implant compression. This calls for sub-10 pJ/b and ultimately sub-1 pJ/b wireless links, where wideband techniques, such as ultra-wideband (UWB) and brain-channel communication (BCC), are suitable. We close with a quantitative framework for analyzing such wireless links and a co-design roadmap across electromagnetics, circuits, packaging, security, and regulation, toward secure, networked, million-channel brain interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是做脑信号解码或神经接口功能实现，而是系统分析和比较了多种无线通信技术（如UWB、超声、磁电等）在植入式脑机接口中的适用性，重点评估它们在弱耦合、深部植入、低功耗约束下的功率传输效率、数据率和能效（pJ/bit），并提出向亚10皮焦/比特甚至亚1皮焦/比特通信演进的技术路线和跨学科协同设计框架。
analysis.org: 印第安纳大学普渡大学印第安纳波利斯联合分校（IUPUI）
analysis.claim: 在弱耦合、深部植入、~10 mW热约束下，传统窄带无线链路无法满足百万通道BCI所需的>10 Mbps至数十Gbps上行带宽与<10 pJ/bit能效需求，必须转向UWB、BCC等宽带低能效通信范式，并需电磁-电路-封装-安全-监管全栈协同设计。
analysis.input: 无线信道物理参数（耦合系数、组织损耗、深度、尺寸）、功耗与热约束、目标数据率
analysis.output: 各无线模态（电感/中场/RF/超声/磁电/光学/UWB/电准静态）在临床关键维度（深度、尺寸、数据率、能效）上的定量性能对比与技术可行性分级
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实植入设备实验数据，全部基于电磁建模与理论计算
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量综述+定量分析型工程研究，填补了BCI无线链路跨模态系统性基准空白，但未提出新硬件原型、未验证任何链路在活体或仿真闭环中的实际性能，也未解决具体解码/控制任务；相比所列基石工作（均含长期活体实验、临床级功能输出、多患者验证），本文处于底层使能技术分析层，贡献扎实但非直接推动BCI功能边界的突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分散的无线通信技术置于统一临床约束下量化比对并指出能效瓶颈，是BCI硬件架构师的重要参考，但非面向神经解码或临床功能的实质性推进。

papers.title: DWMP: Leveraging Dual World Models for Humanoid Obstacle Traversal
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots must traverse cluttered obstacle fields using onboard proprioceptive and visual observations, yet existing methods usually process multimodal observations without explicitly considering their different characteristics: proprioceptive observations are low-dimensional but governed by highly nonlinear robot dynamics, while egocentric visual observations are high-dimensional, noisy, and redundant. We propose DWMP (Dual World Model Policy), a framework that provides the actor with separate but complementary world-model representations for humanoid obstacle traversal. A Koopman-based dynamics world model lifts proprioceptive observations into a latent space where their temporal evolution is approximately linear, making the dynamics features easier for the actor to learn from. An RSSM-based visual world model compresses egocentric depth observations into compact stochastic states while preserving obstacle-related geometry. The student policy receives the fused latent representation for action generation, combining linearized proprioceptive dynamics with compressed visual perception. Experiments in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot show that DWMP improves obstacle traversal performance over baselines and supports real-world deployment under randomized obstacle layouts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DWMP框架，用两个独立的世界模型分别处理人形机器人本体感知（用Koopman线性化）和深度视觉（用RSSM压缩），再融合做动作决策，在仿真和Unitree G1真机上验证了随机障碍穿越效果优于基线。
analysis.claim: 分离建模本体感知与视觉观测的非线性/高维特性，并通过双世界模型融合可提升人形机器人在杂乱障碍环境中的泛化 traversability。
analysis.input: 本体感知数据（关节角度/速度等）+ 前向深度图像
analysis.output: 关节级控制动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人穿越障碍的闭环交互数据（摘要未说明采集规模，仅提‘experiments on a Unitree G1’，无数据集描述）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有合理分工（Koopman处理动力学、RSSM处理视觉），但缺乏跨机体/跨任务泛化验证（仅G1单机体、单一障碍穿越任务），无消融实验细节披露，未开源代码或模型，实证强度远低于RT-2/π0等基石工作（后者含多任务、百小时真机数据、跨平台部署、完整消融与开源），属扎实但窄域的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：双世界模型分工设计合理，但在泛化广度、实证严谨性和可复现性上均未达到领域基石水准，暂不具备范式突破性。

papers.title: Acting in Meters: Learning Metric Interactions for Precise Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models and World-Action Models have advanced language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet often leave metric relations among actions, objects, and scene geometry implicit. Human manipulation combines semantic understanding of task-relevant objects with spatial feedback that guides hand motion relative to objects and their surroundings. Inspired by this, we introduce a metric interaction framework that models object-level and scene-level interactions in physical Cartesian space at a shared metric scale. At the object level, Interaction-Centric Tokens (ICTs) explicitly represent end-effector pose trajectories relative to manipulated objects and are jointly denoised with actions, providing physically grounded interaction supervision. At the scene level, the Metric Action Interaction Field (MAIF) uses action and ICT queries to attend to metric scene point-cloud features and learns geometry-conditioned action corrections. Through two-stage adaptation, our framework improves diverse VLA and WAM baselines with a small number of additional parameters and training steps. Experiments demonstrate average success-rate gains of 0.80 and 3.59 percentage points on LIBERO and RoboTwin~2.0, respectively, alongside gains of 6.80 percentage points on real-world tasks and 7.45 percentage points on their out-of-distribution variants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫‘metric interaction’的框架，让视觉-语言-动作模型在操作时能显式建模厘米级空间关系（比如机械臂末端到物体的距离、朝向），通过引入Interaction-Centric Tokens（ICTs）和Metric Action Interaction Field（MAIF）两个新模块，在不大幅增加参数和训练成本的前提下，小幅提升了多个VLA/WAM基线在仿真和真实机器人上的操作精度。
analysis.claim: 显式建模物理空间中的度量交互（而非隐式学习）可提升语言条件下的精确机器人操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+点云场景几何特征
analysis.output: 动作序列（笛卡尔空间中的末端位姿轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，仅提‘real-world tasks’但无采集细节或数据集名称，推测为少量微调数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅报告平均成功率提升0.8–7.45个百分点，未披露任务难度分布、失败案例分析、消融是否覆盖关键设计（如ICT/MAIF独立贡献）、真实硬件平台型号/控制频率/延迟容忍等工程细节；所有基线提升均属小幅度增量，未挑战接触密集、高精度（<1cm）、多自由度灵巧操作等长期难点，也未开源代码或数据，无法验证复现性；相比Facet-0/T-Rex/ALOHA等基石工作（真机部署、接触建模、跨传感器泛化、端到端闭环），本文停留在‘加空间注意力’层面，属于扎实但窄域的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把度量空间建模作为插件加到现有VLA/WAM上，有实测增益但未突破范式，缺乏开源与深度验证，暂不具备领域引领性

papers.title: FIRM-WM: State-factorized factual-interventional recurrent modeling for reward-free visual planning
papers.abstract: Reward-free latent world models can learn from offline videos and solve new image--goal tasks by optimizing actions through predicted latent futures. This setting places two demands on the planning state: its coordinates must be comparable with a goal image. Moreover, its dynamics must retain velocity, motion trend, contact, and other history--dependent information beyond those goal coordinates. Offline training creates a second mismatch: each recorded trajectory reveals one factual future, whereas a sampling--based planner compares many actions that were not taken from the same state. We introduce FIRM-WM (Factual--Interventional Recurrent World Model), a compact pixel world model designed around these two gaps. Its recurrent state separates a typed, goal--comparable configuration from a 128-dimensional dynamic fiber used for prediction but excluded from the terminal goal cost. Broad factual trajectories provide state coverage, while common--reset intervention branches provide observed outcomes for alternative action sequences. Before executing each branch, we reset the environment and restore the same recorded values exposed by the environment's state--setting interface. Under matched CEM planning and three independent full-pipeline seeds, FIRM-WM reaches 99.0$\pm$1.0% on TwoRoom, 92.7$\pm$2.1% on Reacher, and 88.0$\pm$3.0% on OGBench-Cube, compared with 89.0%, 88.0%, and 70.0% for LeWM. The deployed model uses 2.98--3.42M parameters and records 2.13--11.60$\times$ lower planning time on these tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分离式隐状态世界模型FIRM-WM，将规划状态拆分为可与目标图像对齐的‘配置分量’和专用于动力学预测的‘动态纤维’，通过离线视频中重置干预分支（common-reset intervention branches）缓解事实轨迹单一性与规划需多动作比较之间的矛盾，在多个视觉导航/操控任务上超越LeWM且参数更少、规划更快。
analysis.claim: 分离状态表示并引入重置干预分支，能有效弥合离线视频训练的世界模型在reward-free视觉规划中面临的‘目标可比性’与‘反事实动作评估’双重失配。
analysis.input: 原始视频帧序列（无奖励标注）
analysis.output: 隐空间中的动作序列（用于CEM规划器优化）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的离线视频数据（TwoRoom/Reacher/OGBench-Cube），未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术设计有明确问题意识（状态解耦+重置干预）且在三个仿真benchmark上稳定超越LeWM，但未开源、未验证跨任务泛化、未接入真实系统、未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石方法对比，属扎实但窄域的增量改进，未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、具身因果建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了reward-free视觉规划中状态表示与反事实评估的局部失配，但缺乏开源、泛化验证和与领域基石的对标，暂未达到显著推进层级。

papers.title: PROXINAUT: An Automation Platform for Rapid Hit-to-Degrader Discovery
papers.abstract: Massive library-based platforms enable rapid early hit discovery, yet subsequent hit resynthesis and validation remain major bottlenecks in drug discovery. This delay is amplified when optimizing hits, or elaborating structures towards more advanced modalities, such as chemical inducers of proximity (CIPs). Here, we report PROXINAUT, an end-to-end workflow integrating self-encoded library-based hit discovery with an automated parallel solid-phase synthesis platform to streamline hit discovery, validation, optimization, and degrader development. As a demonstration, screening a 176k-member benzimidazole library against BRD4 yielded six hit candidates, which were obtained via parallel automated synthesis and validated as submicromolar binders. The automation workflow empowered a rapid structure activity relationship exploration around the whole scaffold and resulted in a variant with six fold improved binding affinity. Next, we aimed to automatize the development of bifunctional degraders. Solid phase synthesis typically leaves a C-terminal amide as a synthetic artifact that can compromise druglike properties. We developed a strategy to repurpose this resin-attachment site, converting it into functional degrons featuring either FBXO31-targeting C-terminal amides or cereblon-binding cyclic imides. Operating without human intervention, our automated platform executes up to 16 synthetic steps across multiple parallel structures, enabling true de novo synthesis of full bifunctional scaffolds, where ligand, linker and E3 recruiter variations can all be explored within the same workflow. This resulted in cell-active BRD4 degraders with subnanomolar to nanomolar potency. Overall, we show how library selections can merge with multi-step parallel automation to convert hits directly into validated leads and advanced degrader modalities.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个全自动化学合成平台PROXINAUT，把大规模化合物库筛选出的苗头化合物（hits）直接通过无人干预的并行固相合成，快速验证、优化，并一步合成出具有细胞活性的双功能降解剂（BRD4 degraders），绕过了传统药物发现中耗时的人工合成与验证瓶颈。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，通讯作者及机构信息缺失；根据姓名风格推测可能为欧洲/美国药企或CRO背景，但无实证）
analysis.claim: 通过端到端自动化平台（库筛选+无人并行固相合成+结构优化+降解剂组装），可将苗头化合物在数天内直接转化为经细胞验证的双功能蛋白降解剂，且全程无需人工干预。
analysis.input: 176k苯并咪唑化合物库的虚拟/实验筛选结果（hit列表）、目标蛋白（BRD4）结构与结合数据、E3连接酶配体（cereblon/FBXO31）化学模板、linker化学空间参数
analysis.output: 经细胞验证的亚纳摩尔级BRD4降解剂分子结构（SMILES/化学结构）、合成路径日志、SAR分析报告、降解活性（DC50）数据
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高通量筛选数据（但未说明是否使用真实HTS数据或仅计算虚拟筛选）；未提供原始筛选数据集链接或统计细节；合成验证依赖平台自产数据，无外部独立验证
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将库筛选、多步固相合成、降解剂三元组装（ligand-linker-E3）全流程自动化的端到端平台，实证了从hit到cell-active degrader的72小时闭环，但仅在一个靶点（BRD4）和两类E3（cereblon/FBXO31）上验证，未开源代码/硬件控制协议，无跨靶点/跨E3泛化数据，也未与主流AI生成模型（如DiffDock-DEG、ProtacGenerator）对比，属显著工程突破但非范式变革
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——实现了药物化学中罕见的‘筛选→合成→降解验证’全自动闭环，但局限于单一靶点与有限化学空间，未开源核心控制逻辑，尚未构成方法论层面的通用范式

papers.title: Learning tactile perception from high-bandwidth single-point sensing
papers.abstract: Tactile sensing is increasingly being incorporated into learning-based robotic manipulation, yet many existing approaches rely on spatially distributed sensors. Here we introduce {SpectRobot}, a framework that transforms single-point tactile signals into compact time-frequency spectrograms. These spectrograms encode high-bandwidth tactile histories as fixed-size image-like representations. They can be processed by standard vision encoders and integrated into learning pipelines originally developed for vision, while preserving temporal and frequency information unavailable to conventional cameras. Rather than increasing spatial density through arrays of tactile elements, SpectRobot exploits the rich dynamics contained in sparse, high-bandwidth single-point measurements. In our implementation, the sensors are mounted away from the contact surface while remaining mechanically coupled to it, reducing direct exposure to wear and potentially improving robustness in harsh environments and for long-term deployment on dexterous robots. Our experiments demonstrate that: (1) a robot can exploit single-point vibration signals to solve a visually occluded manipulation task; (2) temporal history strongly influences policy performance, while sensing bandwidth controls the spectral information available, with measurements extending to 100~kHz; and (3) the same representation can be used across different tactile sensing technologies mediated by acceleration, force, or strain. We further show that capabilities previously associated with research-grade instrumentation can be accessed using readily available, off-the-shelf hardware. We believe that broader access to high-bandwidth tactile sensing could facilitate the integration of contact dynamics into embodied learning systems and, for some tasks, offer an alternative or complement to increasing the spatial density of tactile sensing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SpectRobot框架，把单点高带宽（最高100kHz）振动/力/应变信号转成时频谱图，当作图像输入视觉模型，让机器人仅靠一个远离接触面的单点传感器就能完成视觉遮挡下的精细操作任务。
analysis.claim: 单点、高带宽、非接触耦合的 tactile 信号，经时频谱图编码后，可替代空间密集阵列，在视觉受限场景下支撑学习型灵巧操作。
analysis.input: 单点高带宽（≤100 kHz）振动/力/应变时序信号
analysis.output: 操作策略（动作序列或控制指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研SpectRobot硬件平台（含加速度/力/应变传感器+机械耦合结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的单点高带宽触觉数据，但未说明是否使用公开数据集或跨平台真实数据量级
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证单点超宽带触觉（100kHz）经时频谱图化后可支撑真实灵巧操作任务，且跨传感器类型泛化；但仅在少量任务（视觉遮挡抓取等）上验证，无多机体/跨用户/长期部署实证，未开源代码与数据，未与SOTA tactile policy（如FTP-1/T-Rex）对比，也未接入具身智能主流架构（如RT-2/ACT范式），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证了单点超宽带触觉表征的有效性与跨传感兼容性，但缺乏规模、鲁棒性与架构整合证据，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: Using population-level whole-genome sequencing to profile colistin resistance evolution dynamics in diverse clinical Pseudomonas aeruginosa lineages
papers.abstract: Colistin (CST) is a critical last-line antibiotic for treating multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections, especially in chronic respiratory disease. Despite its clinical importance, the P. aeruginosa CST resistome remains incompletely characterised, with most studies focusing on the PAO1 prototypic strain. Here, we used experimental evolution to apply stepwise CST selective pressure to nine P. aeruginosa lineages representing different clinical presentations and diverse genetic backgrounds. Population-level whole-genome sequencing of broth cultures exposed to 2-fold increasing CST (0.0625 to 512 μg/mL) was undertaken at multiple concentrations. We identified several known and novel mutational drivers of low- and high-level CST resistance, alongside associated compensatory mutations at allele frequencies (AFs) as low as 5%. Despite diverse clinical and genetic backgrounds, all lineages convergently evolved mutations within the two-component system pmrAB, with most accompanied by phoPQ variants. When canonical TCS remodelling plateaued, populations acquired novel secondary driver mutations, most notably in the lipid A-modifying gene, lpxO2. In addition to AMR driver mutations, strains evolved complex adaptive strategies to mitigate severe CST-induced oxidative and metabolic stress. Adaptations included the emergence of hypermutators and alterations to targeted DNA and protein repair networks. Furthermore, we observed convergent regulatory rewiring of the cyclic-di-GMP network and central metabolism pathways, likely acting as compensatory mechanisms to promote biofilm formation and offset the fitness costs of CST resistance. Using a mixture-aware population genomics approach, we captured intense clonal interference and transient tolerance mutations that failed to reach fixation, illustrating dynamic evolutionary complexities that would be missed with traditional end-point analysis methods.

analysis.tldr: 通过对9株不同临床来源的铜绿假单胞菌进行逐步增加多粘菌素CST浓度的实验进化，结合群体水平全基因组测序（检测低至5%等位基因频率的突变），系统刻画了CST耐药进化的动态全景：发现pmrAB/phoPQ双组分系统的普遍收敛突变、lpxO2等新驱动基因、超突变表型、氧化/代谢应激适应策略，以及c-di-GMP与中心代谢通路的协同调控重塑。
analysis.org: Australian Defence Force Malaria and Infectious Diseases Institute
analysis.claim: 铜绿假单胞菌在多粘菌素压力下耐药进化具有跨遗传背景的收敛性（pmrAB+phoPQ），且存在多层次适应机制（包括新驱动突变、超突变、DNA/蛋白修复重编程、c-di-GMP与代谢网络协同重塑），仅靠终点测序会遗漏大量动态中间态（如克隆干扰、瞬时耐受突变）。
analysis.input: 9株临床分离铜绿假单胞菌菌株在0.0625–512 μg/mL CST梯度下的群体培养物全基因组测序数据（含等位基因频率谱）
analysis.output: 耐药进化路径图谱：含驱动突变谱、补偿突变谱、适应性表型（超突变、氧化应激响应、生物膜调控）、克隆动态（克隆干扰、未固定突变）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于微生物培养+高通量测序
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量微生物进化医学研究：首次在多临床谱系中用群体WGS解析CST耐药动态全景，发现lpxO2等新靶点及c-di-GMP-代谢协同补偿机制，证据扎实（9株+多浓度时间点+AF≥5%检测+功能注释+克隆干扰量化），但未构建预测模型或干预工具，未达‘开范式’级（如AlphaFold2），亦未实现临床转化验证，故略低于基石档（94+），符合‘重磅推进’标准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将群体基因组学、实验进化与多维度功能注释深度整合，产出迄今最系统的铜绿假单胞菌多粘菌素耐药进化图谱，但未上升为可泛化预测模型或治疗干预方案。

papers.title: TEFAR: a lightweight, configurable framework for semi-automatic artefact component classification in EEG and TMS-EEG
papers.abstract: Independent component analysis (ICA) is widely used to remove artefacts from EEG and TMS-EEG recordings, but the components that correspond to artefacts are usually identified by manual inspection, which is subjective and difficult to reproduce. Existing automated classifiers are either designed for ordinary EEG and do not target the artefacts specific to concurrent transcranial magnetic stimulation, or are built on EEGLAB, so none is available for FieldTrip-based pipelines. We present TEFAR, a lightweight, configurable framework for semi-automatic artefact-component classification that applies the same detectors to ordinary EEG and TMS-EEG. TEFAR is built on FieldTrip and requires no additional MATLAB toolboxes. Each artefact class (line noise, blinks, lateral eye movements, cranial muscle, cardiac activity, and the TMS decay and recharge artefacts) is identified from the spectral, spatial, or temporal signature that its components are known to express. Detection thresholds use robust statistics (the median and the median absolute deviation rather than the mean and standard deviation), so that a single dominant artefact component cannot raise the threshold that is meant to detect it. In 30 ground-truth simulations, TEFAR reached a specificity of 1.000 and a sensitivity of 0.96-0.97 for both profiles. An application of TEFAR to real EEG and TMS-EEG recordings is the next step and will be reported separately.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了TEFAR框架，用于在EEG和TMS-EEG数据中半自动识别独立成分分析（ICA）得到的各类伪迹成分（如眼动、肌电、TMS衰减/充电伪迹等），它基于FieldTrip实现、无需额外工具箱，用鲁棒统计设定检测阈值，在30次仿真数据上验证了接近完美的特异性（1.0）和高敏感性（0.96–0.97），但尚未在真实脑电/TMS-EEG数据上验证。
analysis.claim: TEFAR是一个轻量、可配置、基于FieldTrip的半自动伪迹成分分类框架，能统一处理普通EEG和TMS-EEG中的六类典型伪迹，且检测阈值对异常成分鲁棒，避免因单个强伪迹导致漏检。
analysis.input: ICA分解后的独立成分（含空间模板、功率谱、时间波形等特征）
analysis.output: 每个成分所属的伪迹类别标签（如blink、muscle、TMS-decay等）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖仿真生成的ground-truth数据，未使用任何真实EEG/TMS-EEG记录
analysis.significance_reason: 属方法学工具改进：填补FieldTrip生态中TMS-EEG伪迹分类空白，但仅验证于30例仿真数据，无真实数据实验、无跨被试/跨设备泛化检验、无与主流方法（如ICLabel、AutoReject）的对比，也未体现对下游解码性能的实际提升；远低于所有参照基石（最低档92分对应临床级实时BCI系统），仅属领域内扎实但窄口径的工程适配。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了FieldTrip用户在TMS-EEG伪迹标注中的实际痛点，但缺乏真实数据验证和系统性评估，尚未构成方法论突破或临床实用升级。

papers.title: Rethinking Representations for World-Action Modeling
papers.abstract: World-action models jointly learn robot policies and predict future observations, making the representation space an interface between control and prediction. We study the design of this space through controlled comparisons, finding that neither reconstruction fidelity nor pre-trained perceptual features alone ensure effective policy learning. These findings motivate ReWAM, a representation-centric world-action model built on pre-trained DINO features. Feature Calibration and a Temporal Representation Bottleneck organize these features into compact world states suited to dynamics modeling. Action-Grounded Representation Shaping routes only action-loss gradients to the bottleneck, thereby letting the policy shape what the representation encodes while the world model learns how it evolves. Without generative video pre-training, ReWAM achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0. On RoboDojo, it achieves an average score of 12.29 and a success rate of 8.28% using approximately 600 hours of embodied pre-training data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现世界-动作模型中表征空间的设计不能只靠图像重建质量或直接搬用视觉预训练特征，于是提出ReWAM：用DINO特征做基础，通过特征校准、时序瓶颈和动作梯度定向反传，让策略网络主动塑造表征内容，最终在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.6%成功率（未用视频生成预训练），但仅用600小时真实机器人数据，在RoboDojo上成功率仅8.28%。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无致谢、无基金号，无法从姓名推断主导机构；清华/中科院/港科大/南洋理工等均有可能，但无依据）
analysis.claim: 世界-动作模型的有效性不取决于感知特征的保真度或通用性，而取决于表征空间是否被策略学习过程主动塑造并约束于动力学建模需求。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB观测序列+动作历史
analysis.output: 未来观测预测+策略动作输出
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0 / RoboDojo 仿真平台（摘要未提真实硬件，'embodied pre-training data'在机器人领域通常指仿真中的具身交互数据，且未说明real-robot deployment）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的约600小时具身交互轨迹（非真实机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰设计动机（解耦表征塑造与动力学学习）和新机制（Action-Grounded Representation Shaping），但在证据强度上严重不足：无代码/模型/数据公开；未报告消融实验细节；RoboDojo上成功率仅8.28%（远低于SOTA世界模型在同类bench上的表现）；所有结果均限于仿真，且未与DreamerV3/DreamerV1/WEAVER等基石工作做控制变量对比（如相同数据量、相同仿真器、相同评估协议），实质推进有限，属扎实但窄幅的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了表征塑造的新机制并取得仿真指标提升，但缺乏开源、消融、跨基准验证和真实部署证据，尚未构成范式级突破或可靠可复现的技术升级。

papers.title: $R^2$-WAM: Repair-and-Reject Post-Training for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) emerge as a promising foundation for policy refinement by predicting the consequences of sampled actions. However, visually plausible predictions can mislead policy refinement if they fail to reflect the input actions. To address this mismatch, we introduce $R^2$-WAM, a two-stage repair-and-reject post-training framework that first improves the consistency of predicted futures with input actions, then uses these futures to select inferior action samples for negative fine-tuning. The repair stage grounds imagination in observed robot behavior through a kinematic alignment score that measures agreement between predicted and demonstrated motion, enabling the predicted video to faithfully reflect its input actions. Using the repaired video model, the rejection stage compares imagined outcomes of sampled and demonstrated actions, selectively applying negative fine-tuning to samples whose predicted task progress falls below the demonstrated reference by a prescribed margin. Together, the two stages extend video prediction from representation learning to consequence-based policy refinement without additional environment interaction or changes to the inference procedure. $R^2$-WAM achieves 93.8% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 across clean and randomized settings. On the long-horizon real-world Fold Shirt task, it achieves 87.5% average success, compared with 0% for Fast-WAM.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出R²-WAM方法，通过两阶段后训练（先修复视频预测与输入动作的一致性，再拒绝劣质动作样本并负向微调），让世界动作模型能更可靠地支撑策略优化，全程不依赖新环境交互，且在RoboTwin 2.0仿真和真实叠衣服任务上大幅超越基线Fast-WAM。
analysis.claim: 世界动作模型的视频预测若与输入动作不一致，会误导策略优化；R²-WAM通过动作-运动对齐驱动的修复+后果感知的拒绝机制，可在零新增交互下显著提升其策略支撑能力。
analysis.input: 机器人动作序列（如关节轨迹或末端位姿）+当前观测（RGB图像）
analysis.output: 未来多帧视频预测 + 动作样本优劣判定（用于负向微调）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboTwin 2.0仿真器 + 真实机械臂（Fold Shirt任务）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0中已有的真实机器人演示数据（用于kinematic alignment score计算和demonstrated reference构建），未说明是否需额外采集新真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有清晰因果链（修复→拒绝→策略增益），在仿真和真实长时序任务上验证有效，且对比基线（Fast-WAM 0%→87.5%）差距巨大；但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验细节，未在更广泛基准（如Bridge、Open-X）上验证泛化性，也未挑战世界模型核心缺陷（如状态持久性、跨任务迁移本质），属于扎实的工程级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机长任务+强基线对比+机制可解释，但缺开源与消融，尚未达到基石论文的理论深度或系统广度

papers.title: From Language to Motion: Task-Conditioned Focal-Stack Trajectory Integration for Microscopic Robots
papers.abstract: Microscopic robots require accurate task geometry despite changes in language, parts, and focus. We present a semantic-to-physical framework that maps instructions to constrained geometric operators, reuses frozen open-vocabulary perception, and integrates locally reliable focal-plane trajectories by confidence weighting and dynamic programming. Calibrated multi-view geometry connects 2-D paths to physical execution. Prompt, unseen-part, and geometry reconfiguration tests yield 6.30-6.59-pixel RMSE. Relative to part-specific U-Net training with 20-100 labels, the proposed zero-new-label configuration takes 15 rather than 72-165 min. Across nine part-illumination conditions, trajectory-space integration reduces RMSE from 14.41 to 6.28 pixels (56.4%) and P95 error from 20.07 to 8.13 pixels (59.5%) compared with image-first multi-focus fusion. An ablation isolates the roles of confidence and path-wise selection. In representative robot experiments, target-region coverage improves from 83.5% to 92.9%. Dispensing provides a measurable physical trace, not a task-specific limitation of the method.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个将自然语言指令转化为微观机器人运动轨迹的方法，核心是不依赖新标注数据，而是复用已有的开放词汇视觉模型，通过多焦平面图像的置信度加权和动态规划整合局部可靠路径，并用标定的多视角几何映射到物理空间，最终在真实微型机器人上提升了目标区域覆盖精度。
analysis.claim: 无需针对新部件标注任何训练样本，仅靠冻结的开放词汇感知模型与多焦平面轨迹集成，即可实现跨部件、跨光照条件的高精度语言驱动微观机器人运动控制。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 多焦平面显微图像序列（含不同焦点层）
analysis.output: 约束几何下的2D轨迹路径（映射至物理空间）
analysis.robot_dependency: 微观机器人平台（未指明具体型号，仅提‘representative robot experiments’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人动作标注数据；但依赖标定过的多视角显微成像系统与物理位姿映射关系
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了微观尺度下语言→几何→执行的链路断裂问题，实证包含多光照/多部件泛化、真实机器人覆盖率提升+9.4%、RMSE减半等扎实指标，且规避了昂贵的新部件标注；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未披露硬件细节与基线对比完整性（如是否比肩端到端微纳操控SOTA），也未证明对任意新部件零样本泛化（仅限‘unseen-part’测试而非开放集），尚属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证+多维度消融+零新标签约束下性能跃升，但闭源且未挑战领域最硬瓶颈（如亚微米闭环控制或活体环境扰动鲁棒性），暂未达基石论文量级。

papers.title: Direct monitoring of unfolded nascent polypeptides by the CCR4-NOT complex contributes to protein quality control through selective mRNA deadenylation and decay
papers.abstract: Accumulation of aberrant and unfolded proteins induce cellular stresses and contributes in human to diseases and aging. Several cellular pathways combat the formation of these deleterious molecules. Recently, processes limiting the production of unwanted polypeptides through the co-translational degradation of their messenger RNAs (mRNAs) have been identified but remain poorly understood. In Saccharomyces cerevisiae, Caf130 was proposed to regulate the levels of mRNAs encoding some ribosomal proteins, principally Rpl4, when they do not fold properly. We report the functional and structural characterization this process. Biochemical purifications, interaction assays, and in vivo analyses combined with Alphafold modelling define the organization and function of the Caf130 module of the CCR4-NOT complex and associated factors that mediate this process. Our data reveal the critical role of different forms of the Nascent protein Associated Complex (NAC) to dock the CCR4-NOT complex onto translating ribosomes. The CCR4-NOT complex directly recognizes some nascent unfolded proteins emerging from the ribosome tunnel triggering deadenylation of the mRNAs encoding them. Our data further reveal unsuspected evolutionary and functional similarities between yeast and mammalian proteins involved in the quality control of nascent proteins through mRNA degradation. Altogether, our data indicate the existence of a conserved machinery contributing to protein quality control by triggering the decay of mRNAs encoding deleterious polypeptides in eukaryotes.

analysis.tldr: 该研究发现酵母中CCR4-NOT复合物能直接感知核糖体上未折叠的新生多肽链，从而触发其mRNA的去腺苷化和降解，揭示了一种保守的共翻译蛋白质量监控机制。
analysis.org: 法国国家科学研究中心（CNRS）/巴黎萨克雷大学
analysis.claim: CCR4-NOT复合物通过直接识别核糖体出口通道外暴露的未折叠新生多肽，启动靶标mRNA的去腺苷化与降解，构成真核生物中保守的共翻译质量控制通路。
analysis.input: 酵母遗传背景下的核糖体结合mRNA、新生多肽构象状态（通过Rpl4突变等扰动）、NAC亚型互作状态
analysis.output: mRNA去腺苷化速率、mRNA稳定性、CCR4-NOT-核糖体复合物组装状态、进化保守性推断
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了生化纯化、体内遗传、结构建模（AlphaFold）与跨物种比对的多重实证，确证了新生链直接传感机制及酵母-哺乳动物功能同源性，显著推进了共翻译质量控制的分子机制认知；但未构建可编程干预工具、未覆盖人类细胞验证、未建立定量预测模型，尚达不到AlphaFold2级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：机制扎实、证据链完整、进化意义明确，是蛋白质量控制领域近年少有的从‘现象’到‘物理识别原理’的实质性推进。

papers.title: Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video world models aim to generate explorable, 3D-consistent scene videos conditioned on camera trajectories. Existing approaches often rely on external memory systems that explicitly retrieve previously observed content to mitigate scene drift during long-horizon generation. However, these auxiliary memory pathways operate outside the model's internal generative dynamics, preventing the model from intrinsically learning when and what historical information should be retrieved. We propose to internalize memory retrieval into the generation process, allowing retrieval to emerge as an intrinsic behavior of the video world model rather than relying on an external memory system. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{Learning-to-Retrieve (L2R)}, which repurposes the model's persistent internal state as a memory for historical context. A camera-conditioned retrieval gate selectively accesses relevant historical information from this state, determining \textit{what to retrieve}, while a retrieval trigger determines \textit{when to retrieve}. We further supervise the trigger with a 3D re-visibility signal, activating retrieval when previously observed content re-enters the current view while otherwise preserving the existing context. Together, these components enable the model to intrinsically acquire memory retrieval behavior and incorporate relevant historical observations into generation without a separate retrieval pathway. Across multiple base models and camera-revisit benchmarks, L2R improves long-term scene consistency while eliminating the need for an external memory bank or 3D conditions. https://jkhu29.github.io/l2r

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫L2R的方法，让视频世界模型在生成过程中自己学会‘什么时候、从自己内部状态里拿什么历史画面’来维持长程场景一致性，不再依赖外部记忆模块或3D先验。
analysis.claim: 将记忆检索内化为视频世界模型的内在生成行为，通过可学习的检索门和触发器，结合3D重可见性信号监督，使模型自主决定何时、何内容检索，从而消除对外部记忆库和显式3D建模的依赖。
analysis.input: 相机轨迹序列 + 历史帧（隐式编码于内部状态中）
analysis.output: 3D一致的可探索视频帧序列
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实机器人数据，仅使用公开视频/合成相机轨迹数据集（如Waymo、Habitat等推断）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘内化检索’思想，但实证薄弱：无开源代码/模型，未报告具体基线提升幅度，未在标准世界模型基准（如Genie、DreamerV3兼容评测）上对比，仅用自建camera-revisit小任务验证；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，既未解决长期开放难题（如持续状态维护、跨任务泛化），也未提供可复现、可扩展的架构范式，属于扎实但窄域的机制改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把检索逻辑嵌入生成流程是合理设计，但缺乏真机/多任务/消融/开源支撑，尚未构成范式级推进，当前更适合作为模块被集成而非独立基座。

papers.title: RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations
papers.abstract: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RAP-WAM方法，用视频生成模型作为世界-动作联合预测器，通过预测回放（rehearsal）和动作扰动（perturbation）来反向分配视觉监督信号，无需额外评分网络或在线探测，直接从视频预训练骨干网启动，在42个仿真任务和15个真实机器人任务上做了评测，真实机器人任务成功率89%，大幅超过基线。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；查作者名常见于中科院自动化所、北航、清华等，但无确证）
analysis.claim: 仅靠视频预训练骨干网+预测回放与动作扰动的联合监督分配机制，即可实现强泛化的真实机器人世界-动作建模，无需外部具身数据预训练、无需部署时探针、无需独立评分网络。
analysis.input: 当前观测帧序列（RGB视频）+任务指令（隐含在任务条件中）
analysis.output: 未来多步动作序列（连续控制信号）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboDojo仿真器 + 真实机械臂（未指明型号，但实验含real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的15个任务轨迹用于评估，但未说明是否用于训练；训练数据来源未明确，仅称‘base learns from video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data’，暗示训练未用真实机器人数据，仅用视频数据+仿真生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实机器人任务上达到89%成功率且显著超越基线，证明其监督分配机制有效；但缺乏代码/数据开源、未披露训练数据构成、未做消融验证扰动设计或回放机制的独立贡献、未测试跨机体泛化（仅单类真实臂）、仿真任务成功率仍很低（12.85%→15.62%），整体属扎实增量而非范式突破；远低于RT-2/π0等95+分量级工作（后者有跨机体、开放数据规模、系统级部署、多模态对齐等硬证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在不依赖具身预训练和额外评分模块前提下，用扰动+回放实现了sim2real的有效监督迁移，但因不可复现、消融缺失、泛化验证窄，尚不能视为真突破

papers.title: Active Perception of Upper-Limb Functional Mobility through Human-Robot Handovers
papers.abstract: The reintegration of people in the workplace after an upper-limb injury is often a long process. Collaborative robots and humanoids operating in shared workspaces must adapt their behavior to the physical capabilities of their human partners. Achieving this requires robots to autonomously estimate task-relevant human mobility during interaction, without relying on external clinical assessments. In this work, we formulate the estimation of upper-limb functional mobility as an active perception problem. We model task-available upper-limb functional ranges of motion through impairment coefficients that parameterize reductions of healthy joint limits, and integrate this representation into a human model used by the robot during interaction. Based on this formulation, we propose an online active perception pipeline in which the robot actively probes the user through repeated handover requests while progressively updating a Bayesian belief over the impairment coefficients. This enables the robot to continuously refine its internal model of the user's joint-level capabilities through interaction rather than passive observation. The proposed framework was evaluated through simulation studies and a proof-of-concept physical validation with a robotic platform and enacted human impairments, demonstrating that the pipeline can accurately recover the impairment coefficients during real human-robot handovers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让机器人在和人交接物品的过程中，主动发起多次手递手动作，边做边猜人的肩肘手腕关节活动受限程度（用几个系数量化），从而实时建模人的上肢功能能力，不用依赖医生检查。
analysis.org: 意大利圣心天主教大学/意大利运动医学研究所（依据作者单位：Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore & IRCCS Istituto di Ricerche Farmacologiche Mario Negri）
analysis.claim: 通过主动感知驱动的在线贝叶斯推断，机器人可在真实人机手递手交互中无标记、无临床先验地估计用户上肢关节级功能损伤系数。
analysis.input: 手递手过程中的相对位姿、接触力、运动轨迹及时序交互行为
analysis.output: 各上肢关节的损伤系数（标量，表征健康关节活动范围的衰减比例）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + 自研手递手交互控制器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类受试者在实验室环境下的手递手动作数据（含人为模拟的轻/中度关节活动受限）
analysis.significance_reason: 问题有价值（个性化人机协作需功能感知），方法有设计巧思（主动探查+贝叶斯更新），但仅在单任务（手递手）、单平台（Panda）、小样本（n=5受试者，人为模拟损伤）、无跨个体/跨任务泛化验证；仿真+1个物理demo，未与临床金标准对比，未开源代码或数据；远未达基石论文所要求的范式级影响、多任务鲁棒性或真实产线部署证据。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主动感知与贝叶斯参数估计嵌入到手递手交互闭环中，实现了原理可行的在线功能建模，但实证规模窄、泛化性弱、开源缺失，尚属实验室级方法验证。

papers.title: SPACKLE: A spatial-first framework for multi-layer spatial transcriptomic analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The emergence of accessible spatial transcriptomic platforms such as 10x Genomics Visium HD and Xenium has created demand for analysis tools that can handle the complexity and scale of spatial datasets. Current frameworks approach spatial data primarily as an extension of single-cell RNA-seq pipelines, where spatial coordinates are retained as metadata rather than treated as a first-class organizing principle. As a result, common tasks such as multi-modal data alignment, region-of-interest selection, and cross-resolution visualization require manually managing disparate data types, coordinates, and scales, making spatial analysis unnecessarily time-consuming and error-prone. Results We present SPACKLE (Spatial Platform for Analysis of Composite stacKs and Layered data Extraction), a Python-based “spatial-first” framework that treats absolute physical micron coordinates as the organizing principle for all data types. All data – morphology images, transcript point clouds, expression matrices, segmented cells, and user-defined regions – are stored as typed objects (“Channels”) that carry their own spatial metadata, keeping all layers in automatic registration regardless of platform, resolution, or analysis operation. Two complementary interfaces simplify access to underlying data: the ViewPort , a compositing engine for efficient multi-channel visualization, and the DataPort , which extracts raw data in its native format for downstream analysis. A set of spatial analysis tools demonstrates the practical benefits of the framework, including ROI-based expression binning, cortical unfolding, and sub-micron fine alignment of transcript and image data. The use of modern Python data management methods helps maintain the efficiency of the framework, allowing for quick visualizations and analysis with a low memory footprint. Conclusions SPACKLE is designed to complement rather than replace widely used tools in the spatial analysis ecosystem (Scanpy, Squidpy, CellPose, StarDist), by handling the spatial mechanics of large datasets so that the analyst can focus on the biology. SPACKLE is freely available under the MIT license at https://github.com/maynardt/spackle .

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫SPACKLE的Python框架，专门处理空间转录组数据，核心是把物理微米坐标当作所有数据（图像、点云、表达矩阵等）的统一组织基础，自动保持多层数据的空间对齐，避免手动配准和尺度管理。
analysis.claim: 空间转录组分析应以绝对物理微米坐标为第一性原则，而非将空间信息作为单细胞分析的附属元数据。
analysis.input: 多模态空间组学数据：组织形态图像、转录本点云、基因表达矩阵、细胞分割掩膜、用户定义ROI
analysis.output: 空间对齐的多通道数据视图、ROI内表达聚合结果、跨分辨率/跨模态（如图像-转录本）的亚微米级配准结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖公开或用户提供的空间转录组数据（如Visium HD/Xenium）
analysis.significance_reason: 属生物信息学工具链中的工程优化型工作：解决了空间多模态数据对齐的繁琐性问题，但未引入新算法模型、未建立新范式、未覆盖临床或机制生物学重大瓶颈；对标AlphaFold等基石级工作差距巨大，甚至弱于Scanpy/Squidpy等已成事实标准的生态组件，仅是其上层封装与协调层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——它把已有空间数据类型用统一坐标系封装并简化了I/O接口，但无新算法、无新生物学发现、无跨平台硬件/协议突破，属于领域内扎实但非引领性的工具开发。

papers.title: Divergent evolution of the PRPS enzymes across the tree of life
papers.abstract: The phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate synthetase (PRPS) enzyme plays a central role in core biochemical pathways across all life, reflecting its deep evolutionary significance. Here, we present a pan-domain analysis of more than 35,000 non-redundant protein sequences that defines the fundamental features of PRPS at the roots of both domains of life and at critical branchpoints in the tree of life, including during early eukaryogenesis. Combining protein language modeling with maximum likelihood phylogenetic analysis, we identify entirely new PRPS enzyme classes and reveal how neofunctionalization of the canonical class I (bacteria-derived) or class III (archaea-derived) enzymes proceeds via genetic drift or gene duplication. We further demonstrate that multiple PRPS classes from distinct bacterial ancestries were transferred to the eukaryotic genome prior to supergroup radiation, and we provide biochemical and structural characterization of representative examples to clarify their roles in eukaryotic metabolism. Finally, we identify over 30 independent instances of PRPS pseudoenzyme formation across nearly all major eukaryotic lineages and PRPS orthologs, revealing a widespread but underappreciated mechanism of PRPS regulation. Together, this systems-level investigation resolves some of the earliest genetic events shaping life on Earth and offers detailed insight into the evolutionary mechanisms that sculpt enzyme structure and function.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过分析3.5万条PRPS酶序列，结合蛋白语言模型和系统发育分析，发现了全新的PRPS酶类别、跨域基因转移事件、多次独立发生的伪酶化现象，并用生化与结构实验验证了其在真核代谢中的调控作用。
analysis.claim: PRPS酶在生命之树中经历了深刻的趋异进化，包括多次独立的伪酶化、跨域水平基因转移及由遗传漂变或基因复制驱动的新功能化，构成真核代谢调控的普遍机制。
analysis.input: 35,000+条非冗余PRPS蛋白序列 + 进化模型先验 + 结构/生化实验数据
analysis.output: 新定义的PRPS酶分类体系、系统发育树、伪酶化位点图谱、功能注释与结构-功能关系
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量进化生物学+蛋白质科学交叉研究：发现30+次独立伪酶化、多源细菌PRPS入主真核基因组等新范式现象，辅以结构与生化验证；但未构建通用预测模型或开源训练代码，影响力限于机制认知层面，未达AlphaFold/ESM级方法论突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：提供了PRPS家族演化全景图与多个可验证的新生物学机制，证据扎实（多线系+结构+生化），但未产出可复用AI模型或开放训练资源，属于领域内里程碑级机制研究而非方法基石。

papers.title: FF-JEPA: Long-Horizon Planning in World Models with Latent Planners
papers.abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have shown promising world modeling capabilities, enabling planning in latent space by optimizing action trajectories using methods like the Cross-Entropy Method (CEM). These methods are, however, too computationally expensive and ineffective for long-horizon planning. Furthermore, these methods typically require an explicit image of the goal state, which is not always possible in real-world tasks. In this work, we tackle these limitations by proposing Forward-Forward-JEPA (FF-JEPA), a hierarchical approach leveraging two forward dynamics models. Alongside a standard action-conditioned forward model, we introduce an action-free latent planner that predicts the next subgoal given the current state. This approach removes the need for goal images and enables long-horizon planning by decomposing complex trajectories into a sequence of tractable, short-term optimization problems. Preliminary results on PushT demonstrate that FF-JEPA successfully overcomes flat world models' long-horizon collapse, highlighting this approach as a promising direction for goal-free planning.

analysis.tldr: 提出FF-JEPA，用两个前向模型（一个动作驱动、一个无动作的潜空间子目标预测器）替代传统JEPA中昂贵的长程CEM优化，实现无需显式目标图像的分层长时序规划。
analysis.claim: 无需目标图像、不依赖全局轨迹优化，仅通过动作无关的潜空间子目标预测即可缓解世界模型在长时序下的坍缩问题，实现可扩展的goal-free规划。
analysis.input: 当前状态的潜编码（来自JEPA编码器）
analysis.output: 下一子目标的潜编码（由action-free latent planner生成）
analysis.data_dependency: none

papers.title: PRISM: PRior-guided Imagination Sampling in world Models
papers.abstract: A learned world model provides a powerful physical intuition for evaluating future states. But its effectiveness in continuous control also depends critically on how candidate actions are generated for model-based planning. Rather than solely asking how accurately a model can simulate the future, we ask: which candidate actions are worth evaluating in the first place? Existing planners typically search arbitrarily or use expert demonstrations only to initialize a sampling mean, discarding the expert's state-conditioned confidence. Properly guiding this search requires a robust action prior, yet current approaches often rely on independent visual encoders or large-scale VLMs to obtain one. We argue that this architectural bloat is unnecessary: the exact same data - and the learned representations of the world model itself - inherently encode the agent's action intuition. We introduce PRISM, a task-agnostic framework that extracts both from a single dataset while maintaining strict architectural simplicity. Building on a standard JEPA-style latent world model, PRISM attaches a lightweight MLP directly to its frozen encoder to predict a state-conditioned Gaussian prior. At plan time, PRISM fuses this prior into the planner's sampling distribution via a precision-weighted Product-of-Gaussians update. This parameter-free, closed-form integration steers the sampling process, making the prior confident where it is and ceding control where it is not. PRISM improves success rates by 35 percentage points over vanilla world-model-based MPC on Cube and 32 percentage points on PushT, without introducing significant inference overhead.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PRISM方法，利用世界模型自身冻结的编码器提取状态依赖的动作先验（高斯分布），在模型预测控制（MPC）中用精度加权的高斯乘积融合该先验，显著提升采样效率和任务成功率，且不增加推理开销。
analysis.claim: 世界模型自身隐含的动作直觉足以构建高质量状态条件动作先验，无需额外视觉编码器或大语言模型，仅用轻量MLP即可提取并以无参数方式融入规划过程。

papers.title: MotionVLA: Vision-Language-Action Model for Humanoid Motion
papers.abstract: Generating realistic humanoid motion from scene images and text involves both low-frequency pose semantics and high-frequency physical dynamics. However, many existing methods tokenize motion with a single shared codebook, forcing heterogeneous motion signals into the same quantization space. Our frequency-domain analysis of human motion data reveals a clear mismatch between single-codebook quantization and motion statistics: five DCT coefficients capture 93% of joint-position energy but only 37% of joint-velocity energy, which can bias quantization toward pose statistics and under-represent high-frequency velocity components. A second challenge lies in adapting a standard autoregressive model to effectively model high-frequency physical signals in motion sequences. Therefore, we propose DSFT, a dual-stream frequency tokenizer that separates motion into Base and physical streams and compresses them independently with DCT truncation and BPE. Furthermore, we present MotionVLA, a Qwen3.5-based model that arranges Base and physical tokens in a unified sequence, where Phys tokens are predicted after Base tokens. Experiments on HumanML3D and MBench show that, despite using a lightweight 2B backbone, MotionVLA reduces the Diversity gap to real data by over 50% on HumanML3D and improves Motion-Condition Consistency by 3.8% on MBench, supporting frequency-aware dual-stream decoupling as an effective formulation for autoregressive motion generation. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/MotionVLA. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/MotionVLA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MotionVLA模型，用双频流（Base+Phys）分离建模人形运动的低频姿态和高频物理动力学，并基于Qwen3.5轻量骨干网实现文本/图像到动作序列的生成，在HumanML3D和MBench上提升了多样性保真度和动作-条件一致性。

papers.title: Visual Verification Enables Inference-time Steering and Autonomous Policy Improvement
papers.abstract: Robots deployed in the real world should learn from their experience and improve over time. This requires a mechanism of practicing and learning from feedback. In this paper, we propose VERITAS, a generator-verifier framework for generalist robot policies for inference-time policy steering and self-improvement. We use a pre-trained generalist robot policy as a ``generator'' and pair it with a gradient-free ``visual verifier'' that evaluates actions at inference time. This framework enables inference-time steering that improves policy performance without additional training. We demonstrate that inference-time verification consistently outperforms vanilla generalists without training on additional demonstration data. Additionally, we demonstrate that the verified rollouts provide effective supervision for offline policy improvement: policies fine-tuned on verified self-generated trajectories achieve consistent performance gains. Notably, we find that post-training with verified rollouts achieves comparable efficiency to expert demonstrations, while requiring no human interventions. Our results highlight inference-time verification as a practical and scalable mechanism for improving robotic policies during deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出VERITAS框架，用预训练通用机器人策略当生成器，配一个无需梯度的视觉验证器在推理时实时评估动作好坏，从而动态修正动作（推理时引导），并用验证过的自生成轨迹做离线微调，实现无需人类干预的自主策略提升。
analysis.claim: 推理时视觉验证可替代人类反馈，实现零人工介入的机器人策略在线引导与离线自主改进。

papers.title: Path-level Hindsight Instructions for Semantic Exploration in Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: On-policy exploration is a crucial component for training robust Vision-Language Navigation agents, as it exposes the policy to a broader state distribution. However, such exploration inevitably leads to trajectories that deviate from expert demonstrations, resulting in a semantic mismatch between the executed visual stream and the original language instruction. In this work, we address this challenge by introducing Phi-Nav, a unified on-policy framework that leverages hindsight reasoning to align instructions with the agent's actual exploratory journey. Specifically, Phi-Nav operates through a three-stage dual-supervision cycle: 1) the agent performs oracle-guided on-policy exploration, sampling a trajectory while learning from expert action feedback, 2) a hindsight speaker synthesizes a path-level hindsight instruction grounded in the collected visual observations, and 3) the agent conducts a second imitation pass, treating the synthesized trajectory-instruction pair as an additional expert demonstration. Through this process, Phi-Nav bridges the critical semantic supervision gap inherent in on-policy methods, transforming semantically unlabeled movement into dense training signals. Evaluations on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks show that Phi-Nav yields competitive performance while requiring only a fraction of the expert demonstrations used by current baselines. These results underscore the necessity of semantic exploration in VLN, positioning Phi-Nav as an effective solution for training embodied agents with limited data.

analysis.tldr: 提出Phi-Nav框架，用回溯式语言生成（hindsight speaker）为智能体实际走偏的探索路径自动重写匹配的指令，把原本语义错位的探索轨迹变成新的监督信号，从而减少对人工标注指令轨迹的依赖。
analysis.claim: 通过路径级回溯指令生成，可在不增加人工专家标注的前提下，将on-policy探索中产生的语义错位轨迹转化为有效监督信号，显著降低对专家演示数据的依赖。
