papers.title: Scalable multi-group nonnegative spatial factorization for spatial genomics data with cell-type heterogeneity
papers.abstract: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies enable the study of gene expression within the spatial context of tissues, providing insights into tissue structure, cellular interactions, and disease progression. However, existing dimension reduction methods often overlook spatial information or struggle to distinguish spatial gene patterns from those driven by cell-type differences, limiting biological interpretability by convolving differences in gene expression patterns with differences in cell-type proportions. To address these challenges, we introduce the scalable multi-group nonnegative spatial factorization (smNSF), a computationally-tractable probabilistic framework that integrates spatial coordinates and cell-type labels into a unified matrix factorization model. By using multi-group Gaussian processes (MGGPs) as priors, our model captures complex spatial variation in a cell-type specific way while enforcing nonnegativity to enhance interpretability. We develop a variational inference framework for MGGPs that supports scalable optimization and improves the numerical stability of smNSF. Across seven spatial transcriptomics datasets spanning diverse technologies and tissues, smNSF recovers sparse, interpretable spatial factors and, through its cell-type conditional posteriors, organizes them into cell-type enriched, cell-type specific, and universal spatial programs that are not apparent from marginal factors alone. Given cell-type labels in ST data, smNSF enables cell-type aware spatial decompositions and supports cell-type conditional posteriors for in silico exploration of relationships between spatial patterns and cellular identity. Author summary Most current analysis methods for spatial transcriptomics either ignore spatial structure or fail to separate gene-driven spatial patterns from cell-type driven differences. In this work, we develop a method that uses spatial coordinates and cell-type labels together to better uncover patterns of gene expression. Our approach, scalable multi-group nonnegative spatial factorization (smNSF), uses Gaussian processes to model spatial structure, which we extend to capture both spatial structure and cell type within a unified framework called multi-group Gaussian processes. Applying smNSF to spatial transcriptomics datasets from mouse brain and human tissues, we find that conditioning on different cell types reveals spatial patterns that are invisible in standard analyses: some cell types suppress a pattern, others sharpen it, and some reveal structure that only emerges after conditioning. This helps us understand how cell-type specific spatial programs contribute to tissue organization. To make this analysis tractable on the scale of modern spatial experiments, we also introduce a new computational approximation for Gaussian processes that is directly applicable in principle to other latent variable GP models. Together, these tools help disentangle biological sources of variation and support in silico exploration of how gene expression might change under different tissue or cell-type compositions.

analysis.tldr: 提出smNSF方法，用多组高斯过程先验+非负矩阵分解，把空间转录组数据中混杂的‘空间位置效应’和‘细胞类型比例效应’解耦，从而发现细胞类型特异的空间基因表达程序。

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是刷指标，而是用严谨概率建模解决了领域长期存在的‘空间-细胞类型混杂’根本性解释瓶颈，并给出可复现、可条件推断的生物学新发现。

papers.title: SegDiff: Segmented Trajectory Diffusion for Consistent and Adaptive Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to acquire manipulation skills from demonstrations by mapping observations to actions. Existing approaches predict either short-horizon continuous action sequences or discrete keyposes. However, continuous prediction methods suffer from compounding errors due to short prediction horizons and struggle with multi-modal action distributions, whereas keypose-based methods necessitate an external planner, constraining real-time applicability. To address these challenges, we introduce SegDiff, a closed-loop visuomotor policy that integrates the strengths of both paradigms. SegDiff decomposes demonstrations into motion segments between keyposes and learns to predict the continuous trajectory from the current state to the next keypose, enabling long-horizon prediction with real-time refinement. Furthermore, we leverage the capability of diffusion models and DDIM inversion to propose a Dynamic Temporal Ensembling mechanism, which allows the policy to efficiently respond to dynamic environments and mitigate discontinuities caused by inconsistent multi-modal sampling. SegDiff demonstrates significant performance gains over existing approaches across various simulated and real-world scenarios, indicating its strong ability to reason over extended temporal dependencies while maintaining real-time adaptability and control stability.

analysis.tldr: 提出SegDiff方法，将机器人操作轨迹按关键姿态分段，用扩散模型预测每段内的连续动作轨迹，并引入动态时间集成机制来应对环境变化和多模态采样不一致问题，在仿真和少量真实机器人实验中提升了长时序操作的稳定性和实时适应性。

papers.title: Wearing A Coat: Dual-Arm Robot-Assisted Dressing with Differentiable Clothing Simulation
papers.abstract: The development of assistive robots for dressing tasks serves to augment human convenience and improve the quality of life for individuals with physical impairments. However, due to the intricate contact interactions between garments and the human limbs during dressing, most robot-assisted dressing algorithms treat clothing as an assembly of discrete segments, thereby struggling to manage the partial worn garments under contact constraints. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel robotic dressing control algorithm that integrates realtime differentiable clothing simulation. The simulation algorithm employs explicit iterative scheme with intentionally introduced higher-order perturbations to enhance computational efficiency while maintaining stability under large time-step conditions. Through simulation, we resolve the garment state under contact constraints, which then enables a multi-phase control strategy for successful coat dressing assistance. To further improve real-time performance, we introduce a constrained local model along with its corresponding optimization solver, permitting high-frequency local compensation for the differentiable simulation based global controller. Finally, we experimentally validate our approach through both simulated and physical dressing scenarios, conclusively demonstrating its feasibility and efficacy

analysis.tldr: 用可微分的布料仿真实时建模衣服与人体接触，结合双臂机器人控制策略，实现外套穿戴辅助任务，在仿真和真实机器人上都做了验证。

papers.title: Design, Modeling and Experimental Validation of a Miniature Hybrid Underwater Glider With Large-Range Foldable Deflectable Wings
papers.abstract: Miniature hybrid underwater gliders have attracted increasing attention for long-endurance ocean observation and confined-space inspection. Large-range wing reconfiguration offers a promising yet largely unexplored approach for simultaneously enhancing maneuverability and shape adaptability in constrained underwater environments. However, such morphing introduces substantial challenges in mechanical integration, dynamic modeling, and hydrodynamic characterization. This paper presents FoDeGlider, a miniature hybrid underwater glider equipped with two independently actuated wings capable of large-range folding and deflection. To capture configuration-dependent variations in mass distribution, center-of-geometry location, and hydrodynamic loading, a multibody dynamics model is developed by treating wing configuration as a structural variable. A composite rigid body algorithm (CRBA)-based projection formulates the composite inertia, wrench transformations, and component-level hydrodynamics into a unified Fossen-form dynamic model applicable to arbitrary wing configurations. A sequential parameter-identification framework is further proposed to estimate fuselage and wing hydrodynamic coefficients, resulting in an open benchmark dataset for model identification and validation. Extensive experiments are conducted, the results of which demonstrate accurate dynamic modeling and parameter identification across diverse morphing configurations. Gate traversal experiments further validate FoDeGlider's ability to actively reconfigure its morphology during locomotion, enabling enhanced navigation in confined underwater environments.

analysis.tldr: 设计并实测了一款带大范围可折叠/可偏转机翼的微型混合式水下滑翔机FoDeGlider，建立了能随机翼构型实时变化的多体动力学模型，并通过实验证明其在形态动态变化过程中仍能准确建模与导航。
analysis.claim: 通过将翼构型作为结构变量嵌入多体动力学建模框架，实现了对大范围形态变化水下滑翔机的高保真、配置自适应动态建模与实机验证。

analysis.significance_reason: 属水下机器人形态自适应控制的扎实增量：首次实现大范围翼构型连续变化下的Fossen型统一建模+实机多构型验证，但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，无开源代码，仅限单一平台；远未达Unitree/Boston Dynamics级系统级突破，也未解决水下长时自主导航等根本性开放问题。

papers.title: RAVEN: Reinforcement-Adaptive Visibility-Graph Planning for Robust Humanoid Navigation with Collision-Free MPC
papers.abstract: Humanoid navigation in dynamic environments requires long-horizon planning while respecting short-horizon dynamic and safety constraints. Classical visibility-graph planners combined with model predictive control (MPC) can efficiently generate collision-free trajectories, but their performance depends on manually tuned parameters and accurate system modeling. In real robotic systems, control delays, state-estimation noise, and locomotion uncertainties can cause overshoot and constraint violations even when the nominal path is geometrically optimal. We propose RAVEN, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (RL)-MPC framework for robust humanoid navigation. Unlike prior approaches that use learning to tune cost weights or replace planning entirely, RAVEN employs RL to adapt the geometric construction of a visibility-graph planner by modifying obstacle inflation and related graph parameters. By directly reshaping the free-space geometry, the learned planner alters the topology of the global path to compensate for delay and tracking imperfections. A collision-free MPC layer then tracks the planned trajectory while explicitly enforcing velocity bounds and obstacle-avoidance constraints. By training under realistic delays and observation noise, RAVEN learns planning adaptations that improve robustness while retaining explicit long-horizon geometric planning and constrained optimization, in contrast to end-to-end learning approaches. We evaluate RAVEN against a manually tuned visibility-graph MPC baseline and a pure RL navigation policy. Results demonstrate reduced overshoot near obstacles, improved robustness in narrow passages, and more reliable navigation under delay and noise. These findings indicate that reinforcement-adaptive graph construction combined with constrained MPC provides an effective and interpretable alternative to end-to-end learning for robust humanoid navigation.

analysis.tldr: 提出RAVEN框架，用强化学习动态调整可见性图规划器的障碍物膨胀参数和图结构，让全局路径在几何上就‘绕开’控制延迟和跟踪误差带来的风险，再用带显式约束的MPC跟踪该路径，从而在真实扰动下提升人形机器人导航鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 通过RL自适应地重塑可见性图的自由空间几何结构（而非仅调参或替换规划器），可使经典几何规划器与约束MPC协同获得比手动调参和端到端RL更鲁棒、更可解释的人形导航性能。
analysis.input: 激光雷达/深度图构建的障碍物地图 + 当前位姿估计
analysis.output: 碰撞规避的全局路径 + MPC跟踪的关节级控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Boston Dynamics Atlas仿真模型（摘要未提实机，但作者团队长期用Atlas；实验未明确说明是否真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中注入的真实延迟与状态噪声，未使用真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有清晰洞见（用RL改几何而非调权重），在仿真中验证了对延迟/噪声的鲁棒性提升，但仅限单一人形平台（Atlas）、窄场景（窄通道/近障），无跨机体/跨任务泛化，无真实硬件验证，未开源代码，未与当前SOTA（如GR00T、H2O等具身通用策略）对比，属扎实但边界明确的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：将RL嵌入传统几何规划流程的设计合理且有实证，但局限于仿真、单平台、窄任务，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程任务编排、多模态闭环、跨 embodiment 泛化），暂不构成范式突破。

papers.title: Fungal microbial enrichment method enables fungal metagenomics directly from human clinical samples
papers.abstract: Abstract Fungi play important roles in health and disease, but current methods such as culture, PCR, and amplicon sequencing cannot provide genome-level characterization directly from clinical samples. Although metagenomic sequencing could overcome these limitations, it remains impractical in clinical samples where fungal DNA is present at low abundance relative to human DNA. Here, we extend a recently described microbial enrichment method (MEM)(1) to fungi (fungal Microbial Enrichment Method; fMEM) and test the method in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) samples to demonstrate direct-from-sample fungal metagenomic analysis and metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) recovery. In BAL samples, fMEM depleted human DNA by more than 1000-fold while preserving fungal DNA within 10-fold, enabling shotgun sequencing from samples with fungal biomass as low as 10 pg fungal DNA per 200 µL BAL. fMEM enabled de novo recovery of fungal MAGs from three of four sequenced BAL samples, including two near-complete MAGs (>90% BUSCO completeness) and one 82.1% complete MAG, with low BUSCO-estimated contamination (≤1.5%). Fungal MAGs recovered by fMEM also resolved potentially clinically-relevant genes, not fully predictable from taxonomy alone and revealed genomic content absent from currently-available same-species reference genomes. fMEM is compatible with a whole-genome amplification (including long-read sequencing workflows). Long reads from fMEM-processed samples provided high coverage (>10X) over fungal assemblies. fMEM’s compatibility with long-read sequencing enables recovery of genes that would be difficult to assemble with short reads alone. fMEM may enable new insights into the role of human-associated fungi, impacting public health, clinical management, and research into complex diseases with suspected fungal roles. Importance Fungi influence human health, infectious disease, and the microbiome, but direct genome analysis from clinical samples has remained impractical because fungal DNA is often overwhelmed by human DNA. We developed a fungal microbial enrichment method (fMEM) that enables direct-from-sample fungal metagenomic sequencing and genome recovery from bronchoalveolar lavage samples without requiring culture for genome assembly. fMEM recovers genome-level features not predicted by taxonomy or current same-species reference genomes and is compatible with long-read sequencing workflows that can recover loci missed by short-read sequencing. fMEM opens new opportunities for culture-independent fungal genomics, clinical microbiology, comparative genomics, and mechanistic studies of human-associated fungi.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一种针对真菌的微生物富集方法（fMEM），能从人源临床样本（如肺泡灌洗液）中特异性去除>1000倍的人源DNA，同时保留真菌DNA，从而首次实现无需培养、直接从低生物量临床样本中完成真菌宏基因组测序和高质量宏基因组组装基因组（MAG）回收，并兼容长读长测序。
analysis.claim: fMEM方法可实现临床样本中真菌DNA的选择性富集，使原本被宿主DNA淹没的真菌基因组得以直接、无培养地完成宏基因组组装与功能基因解析。
analysis.input: 原始人源临床样本（支气管肺泡灌洗液BAL）
analysis.output: 高质量真菌宏基因组组装基因组（MAG）、完整度>90%的近完整基因组、长读长覆盖的组装序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床BAL样本（n=4），但未说明是否公开共享原始测序数据或样本元信息
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了真菌宏基因组学长期存在的‘宿主DNA压制’核心瓶颈，在真实临床BAL样本上实现了无培养、高完整性MAG回收（含两个>90% BUSCO的近完整基因组）和长读长验证，证据扎实（多样本、BUSCO/contamination量化、功能基因发现），但适用范围目前限于BAL且未开源原始数据/协议细节，尚未扩展至粪便/皮肤等其他临床样本类型，也未在独立实验室复现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真实临床样本上系统性破解真菌宏基因组低丰度建库难题，提供可验证的实验流程与基因组级新发现，非概念包装

papers.title: Fixation-evoked potentials reveal neural signatures of hierarchical belief-updating during decision-making
papers.abstract: Many decisions require maintaining beliefs across multiple levels of representation, from sampling and integrating information to forming action plans. To elucidate these processes and reveal the neural mechanisms supporting them under naturalistic free-viewing conditions, we combined EEG and eye-tracking in a multi-attribute choice task. Leveraging our recently developed Multi-Attribute Search and Choice (MASC) model, we generated fixation-level predictions for value-belief updating processes encompassing attribute, option, and preference states. Behavioral and eye-tracking data confirmed search and choice dynamics as predicted by MASC. Crucially, fixation-evoked potentials (FEPs) revealed distinct neural signatures along the processing hierarchy. While attribute-level and option-level updates were reflected in an early fronto-central positivity and a centro-parietal positivity, respectively, emerging preferences were expressed in lateralized motor-preparatory activity. Our preregistered study elucidates a hierarchy of neural belief-updating processes linking information sampling to decision formation and opens new research avenues for investigating neural attention and choice dynamics in naturalistic free-viewing paradigms.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG+眼动追踪记录人在自由浏览多属性选择任务中的每次注视，发现不同层级信念更新（属性→选项→偏好）对应不同时间/空间特征的脑电响应（FEP），验证了MASC计算模型预测的神经层次结构。
analysis.claim: 人类在自然自由注视下的决策过程中，存在可分离的、层级化的神经信念更新机制，分别对应属性级、选项级和偏好级的动态表征。
analysis.input: 每次注视的起始时间、位置、持续时间 + 对应被注视选项的属性值 + 当前选择状态
analysis.output: fixation-evoked potentials (FEP) 的时序波形特征（如早前额中央正波、中顶正波、侧化运动准备电位）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类被试EEG+眼动数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将注视锁定为信念更新的时间锚点并揭示层级FEP标记，但仅在一个高度受控的实验室选择范式中验证，无跨任务/跨人群泛化，未接入闭环干预或临床场景，也未超越现有BCI基石工作（如高精度脑-语/脑-字解码）在信息通量、实时性或临床价值上的量级，属扎实的认知神经科学增量，非BCI技术突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将计算建模、眼动与高时间分辨率EEG精细对齐，实现了决策神经机制的层级解析，但未产生新接口能力或临床适用性，暂不构成BCI领域实质性推进。

papers.title: NEO: NeRF It Once, Edit It Many Times for Continuous Object Manipulation
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present NEO, a unified framework providing language-guided NeRF editing for robotic manipulation. Our paper introduces (i) a language-guided object removal that combines neural field resampling with multiview-consistent progressive inpainting, (ii) a direct NeRF weight editing method utilizing knowledge distillation, composing original and edited NeRFs via a teacher-student model, enabling coherent modeling of future scene states before a robot executes an action, and (iii) the first benchmark (NEO-Dataset) for quantitatively evaluating NeRF scene editing methods suitable for robot manipulation. We show that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in scene editing tasks, including object removal and pick-and-place robotic experiments, yielding visually coherent and geometrically consistent edits that reduce artifacts commonly introduced by prior methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出NEO框架，用语言指令驱动NeRF场景编辑（比如移除物体、模拟抓取后的场景），让机器人能在执行动作前‘预演’编辑后的3D场景，并构建了首个面向机器人操作的NeRF编辑评测基准NEO-Dataset。
analysis.claim: 语言引导的NeRF场景编辑可被系统化用于机器人操作前的状态预测与规划，且其质量可通过多视角一致的渐进式修复与知识蒸馏式权重编辑显著提升。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+自然语言指令（如'移除桌上的杯子'）
analysis.output: 编辑后的NeRF场景表示（含几何与外观）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅需静态多视角图像和语言标注
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将NeRF编辑与机器人操作意图关联并构建专用基准，但未接入真实机器人闭环控制，所有实验停留在仿真渲染/视觉评估层面，无动作生成、无物理交互验证，也未证明其编辑结果能提升下游操控性能（如抓取成功率）；相比RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等真正打通感知-语言-动作链的里程碑工作，它只覆盖了‘感知侧预演’这一孤立环节，且未在真实硬件或标准机器人任务上验证价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把NeRF编辑、语言引导、多视角一致性做了有条理的串联，并产出首个相关benchmark，但未触达机器人操作的核心闭环问题，属于高质量子模块工具，非范式突破。

papers.title: Evaluating Agentic Bioinformatics through Function, Evidence, and Validation
papers.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly plan, execute, and interpret biological analyses, yet fluent responses, successful tool calls, and benchmark performance alone do not establish scientific credibility. Existing reviews primarily organize biological agents by application, architecture, and agentic capability, but do not jointly operationalize the accountability of agent-generated workflows. We address this gap by treating the inspectable workflow trajectory, rather than architecture or final output alone, as the primary unit of analysis. We introduce the Function--Evidence--Validation (FEV) framework, which separates demonstrated workflow operations, traceable support for actions and claims, and use-case-specific validation. Using FEV, we map 109 agentic or agent-adjacent systems and 28 benchmark or evaluation resources, representing 128 unique publications across genomics, single-cell and spatial omics, protein science, drug discovery, computational pathology, and general bioinformatics automation. Across domains, planning and tool-mediated execution have advanced more rapidly than replayability, provenance, robust scientific assessment, external validation, and prospective empirical testing. We therefore argue that agentic bioinformatics should be assessed through workflow correctness rather than final-answer correctness alone. FEV provides a practical basis for comparing systems and designing transparent, auditable, and scientifically accountable bioinformatics workflows.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没做新模型或新实验，而是提出一个叫FEV的评估框架，用来系统性检查生物信息学AI代理生成的工作流是否真正科学可信——看它每一步有没有明确功能、可追溯证据、以及针对具体用途的验证。
analysis.claim: 评估生物信息学AI代理的科学可信度，应以可检查的完整工作流轨迹（而非最终答案或架构）为单位，并通过Function-Evidence-Validation三维度联合衡量。
analysis.input: 已发表的109个生物信息学AI代理系统及其28个评估资源的文献与技术描述
analysis.output: FEV三维评估框架、跨6个生物子领域的系统性映射图谱、对当前领域薄弱环节（如可重放性、外部验证、前瞻性实证）的诊断结论
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 是首个将工作流可审计性作为核心科学问责标准的系统性框架，覆盖128篇文献并揭示领域共性缺陷，但未提供开源代码/模型/可运行评估工具，也未在真实科研闭环中验证FEV能否提升结果可靠性；相比AlphaFold2等基石级工作（解决根本性科学问题并产生实验级影响），它属于方法论层面的重要反思与分类学建设，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把分散的代理评估实践升维成可操作的三维问责框架，但缺乏代码实现和实证闭环，尚未形成可复现、可部署的评估基础设施。

papers.title: Learning Social Robot Navigation By Sensing Human Legs
papers.abstract: Robots navigating among pedestrians typically sense their surroundings with a 2D LiDAR mounted close to the ground. At that height, the sensor mostly sees moving legs rather than whole people, yet most learning-based navigation methods still treat pedestrians as simple shapes like circles. This paper addresses that gap with CALF (Convolutional Attention for Leg Features), an end-to-end neural architecture that combines convolutional layers, attention, and MLP to interpret leg motion directly from LiDAR scans and produce safe navigation commands. The CALF policy is trained using deep reinforcement learning algorithms within LegNav, a custom lightweight 2D simulator that combines 2D LiDAR ray tracing with a novel pedestrian gait model. The resulting policy is compared against classical and learning-based baselines in terms of navigation performance and social compliance. The approach is validated through real-world experiments via zero-shot deployment on a TurtleBot 4, yielding smooth and socially compliant trajectories. Written in JAX, the LegNav simulator enables the training of a deployment-ready CALF policy in under an hour on a single consumer GPU.

analysis.tldr: 提出CALF模型，直接从低矮LiDAR扫描中提取行人腿部运动特征（而非将人建模为圆），用轻量级自研2D仿真器LegNav训练强化学习策略，并零样本迁移到TurtleBot 4实机上实现社交合规导航。
analysis.claim: 直接解析LiDAR中腿部运动特征比抽象建模行人形状更能提升社交导航的安全性与合规性。
analysis.input: 2D LiDAR扫描点云（聚焦腿部区域）
analysis.output: 机器人导航动作指令（速度/转向）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人训练数据，仅零样本部署；仿真训练依赖合成腿部运动数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了LiDAR低视角下腿部信息被忽视的问题，但方法限于2D简化场景、无跨机体/跨人群泛化验证，实机仅单平台零样本演示，未对比主流三维感知或端到端视觉方案，贡献属扎实的局部改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将腿部运动建模、轻量仿真与RL策略结合并完成小规模实机验证，但未触及社交导航的核心开放难题（如意图推断、群体动力学建模、多模态对齐），也未超越现有SOTA方法的性能边界。

papers.title: Learning Molecular Representations from Cellular Phenotypes with Structure Preservation
papers.abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery enables the discovery of functional relationships between molecular structures and cellular responses. However, existing multimodal representation learning methods often optimize cross-modal alignment without considering the intrinsic organization of chemical space, resulting in distorted molecular representations and loss of structural information. We propose \textbf{PhenMol}, a structure-preserving framework for phenotype-aware molecular representation learning. PhenMol disentangles molecular and cellular representations into shared and private components, enabling phenotype-guided alignment while preserving chemical structures through a dedicated molecular branch. This design integrates cellular phenotype information without disrupting molecular neighborhood organization. Experiments on approximately $3.04 \times 10^{4}$ molecule--cell morphology pairs demonstrate that PhenMol improves molecular property prediction across 270 bioactivity tasks, molecule--phenotype retrieval, and clinical trial outcome prediction. Moreover, ECFP4-based structural analysis shows that PhenMol better preserves molecular neighborhoods and reduces embedding distortion compared with existing multimodal alignment methods. These results highlight the importance of structure-aware constraints in multimodal molecular representation learning and provide an effective approach for integrating cellular phenotypes with chemical knowledge for drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PhenMol方法，用细胞表型数据（如形态变化）来学习分子表示，但强制保持分子化学结构的邻近关系不被破坏，从而在预测分子性质、检索分子-表型关联、预测临床试验结果等任务上比现有多模态对齐方法更准、更鲁棒。
analysis.claim: 在利用细胞表型学习分子表示时，显式保留化学空间结构（如ECFP4邻域）比单纯优化跨模态对齐更能提升下游生物医学任务性能与表示保真度。
analysis.input: 分子结构（SMILES/图）+ 对应细胞表型图像或定量形态特征
analysis.output: 结构保持的分子嵌入向量
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了结构感知的解耦表征学习机制，在3万级分子-表型对上验证了其在270个生物活性任务和临床试验预测中的提升，并用ECFP4做结构保真度量化分析——属显著贡献，但未开源代码/模型，未与SOTA药物基础模型（如DT-SFM、ESM-Mol）对标，也未生成新分子或解释机制，尚未达到基石级分量（90+）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计有洞见、实证较扎实，但缺乏开源与前沿基线对比，暂未构成范式突破

papers.title: GraphThink: Graph-Enhanced LLM Thinking for Long-Horizon Embodied Task Planning
papers.abstract: Embodied agents using LLM-based planners often struggle with physical hallucinations, poor generalization to long-horizon tasks, and lack of environmental awareness. We propose GraphThink, a novel framework that integrates a task graph to provide structured knowledge for robust planning and a scene graph to maintain environmental memory for event-driven replanning. Specifically, the task graph guides LLM thinking through contextual prompting and iterative refinement, effectively mitigating planning hallucinations. Furthermore, within the GRPO framework, the task graph offers delicate reward design to train the LLM planner, enhancing long-horizon planning capabilities and improving generalization. Finally, an event-driven replanning module, powered by the scene graph, enables closed-loop environment awareness and error correction. GraphThink achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ALFRED benchmark. In particular, our high-level planner surpasses leading API-based LLMs on both the validation set and held-out long-horizon tasks, underscoring its robust zero-shot and few-shot capabilities. Additional evaluations further demonstrate strong out-of-distribution generalization to novel tasks and environments.

analysis.tldr: 提出GraphThink框架，用任务图引导LLM做结构化推理、用场景图实现环境记忆和事件驱动重规划，提升具身智能体在长周期任务中的零样本泛化与抗幻觉能力，在ALFRED上刷出SOTA。
analysis.claim: 通过显式引入任务图与场景图双图结构，约束LLM的具身任务规划过程，显著缓解物理幻觉、提升长周期任务的零样本泛化与闭环环境适应能力。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+当前观测（ALFRED中隐式状态）
analysis.output: 高层动作序列（如'go to fridge, open fridge, take apple'）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用ALFRED仿真环境数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在ALFRED上取得SOTA且展示跨任务/环境泛化，但仍是纯仿真、纯高层规划（无底层控制）、无真实机器人验证；图结构增强LLM规划是合理方向，但未突破‘LLM for planning’范式瓶颈（如缺乏可验证的因果建模、未解决符号-神经鸿沟、未提供可解释性机制），相比World Models系列（构建持续状态核心/梦回放/持续学习）或DreamerV3（端到端MBRL闭环）等基石工作，属于扎实但窄域的工程改进。

papers.title: Policy-Induced Hand Priors in Humanoid Dual-Arm Manipulation: Diagnosing and Mitigating Initial-Pose Dependence
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are expected to operate robustly across variations in the robot's initial configuration, yet aggregate task success can conceal pose-specific failures and inappropriate hand selection. This work investigates initial-pose dependence in VLA-based humanoid dual-arm manipulation. We characterize the initial-condition-dependent early hand preference as a policy-induced hand prior and quantify it using HandPriorScore, residual hand bias, and target responsiveness. Evaluations across multiple policies and 17 initial configurations reveal strong initial-pose--policy interactions: the same pose produces substantially different success rates across policies, while a single policy exhibits large performance variation across poses. Specific initial arm configurations can suppress or induce an asymmetric hand preference, with the resulting effect varying in direction and strength across policies. Wrist-camera observations also influence hand selection and task performance. Expanding initial-pose coverage in the training dataset substantially improves robustness, while targeted augmentation around a low-performing configuration increases its success rate. Comparisons across training configurations show that sufficient exposure to the target simulation task is beneficial, whereas the effect of real or auxiliary data depends on pose coverage, simulation ratio, and observation availability. These findings characterize a pose-conditioned hand prior, identify a localized initial arm configuration as a causal handle on hand-selection behavior, and demonstrate how data coverage and training composition affect initial-pose robustness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现并量化了VLA策略在人形双臂操作中对初始姿态的隐性依赖，即同一初始姿态下不同策略手部选择差异巨大，同一策略在不同初始姿态下成功率波动剧烈；作者定义了'策略诱导手部先验'概念，提出HandPriorScore等指标，并证明通过扩大训练数据中的初始姿态覆盖范围可显著提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: Temporal GRPO: Beyond Trajectory-Level Credit in Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Outcome-driven reinforcement learning offers a scalable way to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) policies from sparse task-success feedback. In common GRPO-based VLA post-training, one rollout-level advantage is applied to every action in the trajectory. A rollout that completes several valid stages but fails later can therefore penalize the actions that produced its earlier progress. We call this trajectory-level credit aliasing. Temporal GRPO addresses this problem by constructing detectable task stages, aligning each rollout with stage-specific action intervals, and comparing only rollouts that have entered the same stage. The resulting stage advantages are applied to their corresponding intervals in a single policy update. On RoboTwin 2.0, Temporal GRPO improves task success and sample efficiency, with consistent gains across task horizons. Controlled updates on LIBERO-Long preserve shared prerequisite stages and concentrate improvement at the first stage where rollout outcomes diverge.

analysis.tldr: 提出Temporal GRPO方法，通过将任务分解为可检测的阶段，为每个阶段单独计算优势函数，避免传统GRPO中因整条轨迹成败而错误归因动作价值的问题，从而提升VLA策略在稀疏奖励下的训练效率和成功率。
analysis.claim: 轨迹级信用分配会导致早期有效动作被后期失败惩罚，而按任务阶段对齐并分段计算优势可显著缓解该问题，提升VLA策略的样本效率与泛化性。

analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）

papers.title: Real-World Cooperative Bimanual Dexterous Grasp of Large Objects from Single-View Observations
papers.abstract: Bimanual dexterous grasping of large objects is a critical challenge in robotic manipulation. However, most existing studies focus on sequential manipulation rather than cooperative grasping, and methods addressing such bimanual tasks have largely been limited to simulation. These limitations stem from the difficulty of acquiring full 3D object models and generating physically plausible grasping actions. To fill this gap, we propose a real-world bimanual grasping framework that includes: a multimodal dataset capturing joint angles, visual observations and force signals; a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)-based module that generates joint-level grasp configurations from segmented point clouds; and an execution strategy that integrates motion planning with online grasp refinement to ensure physical stability and feasibility. Our approach enables the synthesis of executable bimanual grasps from single-view inputs, reducing dependence on complete 3D object models and ensuring stable real-world performance. Experiments on a dual-arm robot demonstrate high success rates across unseen objects with varying geometries and poses, and ablation studies confirm the contributions of key components of our system.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个能在真实双臂机器人上直接从单张RGB-D图像（分割点云）生成稳定双手协同抓取大物体动作的端到端框架，不依赖完整3D模型，包含新采集的多模态真实数据集、基于DDPM的抓取构型生成模块和在线抓取优化执行策略。

papers.title: PDE3A-SLFN12 Molecular Glues Target Multiple KIT D816V Cell Types in Preclinical Models of Mast Cell Malignancies
papers.abstract: A drug discovery approach was used to specifically target malignant cells with KIT D816V mutation, which is the predominant disease-causing mutation in clonal mast cell malignancies. To this end, KIT D816V cells derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPS cells) of KIT D816V patients were employed to screen a library of FDA approved and experimental drugs for specific killing of KIT D816V cells. We discovered the novel compound LDC 3416, which targets multiple malignant KIT D816V cell types, including hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells and mast cells. Importantly, by exploring the LDC 3416 targeting profile, we identified the phosphodiesterase 3A-Schlafen 12 (PDE3A-SLFN12) molecular glue pathway as a novel approach for specific targeting of malignant KIT D816V cells. We found that the KIT D816V mutant protein leads to increased expression of PDE3A and SLFN12 and thus confers a selective molecular vulnerability to PDE3A-SLFN12 molecular glues. Primary malignant mast cells of KIT D816V patients with indolent and advanced systemic mastocytosis also exhibit increased expression of PDE3A and SLFN12. We extended our study to include additional PDE3A-SLFN12 molecular glues and demonstrate their synergistic action with KIT D816V selective tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) in killing KIT D816V cells. Furthermore, the PDE3A-SLFN12 molecular glues also target KIT D816V megakaryocytes, a cell type that has been underestimated in malignant mast cell pathophysiology and molecular targeting. The identified molecular glues, along with their synergy with TKIs and their simultaneous targeting of multiple KIT D816V cell types, open novel treatment options for KIT D816V mast cell malignancies and other KIT D816V associated diseases.

analysis.tldr: 发现一种新型分子胶LDC 3416，通过激活PDE3A-SLFN12通路特异性杀伤携带KIT D816V突变的多种恶性细胞（包括肥大细胞、造血干/祖细胞、巨核细胞），该通路在患者原代恶性细胞中高表达，且与现有靶向药联用有协同效应。

papers.title: A single-channel EEG classification system for multiscale characterization of mouse vigilance state
papers.abstract: Long–term analysis of mouse sleep is constrained by the dependence of conventional scoring on expert interpretation of electroencephalographic (EEG) and electromyographic (EMG) recordings. We developed a channel–agnostic, EEG–only framework that combines cross–animal sleep–stage classification, causal temporal organization, and probabilistic hypnodensity analysis from a single cortical EEG signal. Motor, somatosensory, and visual cortical recordings were treated independently by a convolutional–recurrent classifier, and generalization was evaluated using nested leave–one–mouse–out cross–validation in eight mice, with each test animal excluded from training, normalization, and model selection. The primary model achieved 0.897 ± 0.058 accuracy and 0.856 ± 0.076 macro–F1 across previously unseen animals while preserving the principal features of expert EEG/EMG–supported sleep architecture. Causal temporal smoothing reduced fragmented predictions and restored physiologically coherent episode durations, counts, and transition structure. Beyond categorical staging, the 4–s causal EEG window was advanced in 1–s steps to generate continuous Wake, NREM, and REM hypnodensity profiles. This representation preserved overall classification performance while revealing increased probability ambiguity and state mixing around expert-defined sleep transitions. The framework was subsequently deployed without supervised adaptation in six additional mice with 32–33 recorded days per animal, where it retained organized daily sleep architecture and probabilistic sleep structure over extended recordings while remaining sensitive to changes in recording conditions. Together, these results establish a single-channel EEG framework for robust cross–animal sleep staging, physiologically structured long-term analysis, and second–by–second characterization of sleep-state probabilities in mice.

papers.title: Development and validation of an SDA-500 Anopheles stephensi cell line for molecular studies
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Malaria control is increasingly challenged by the urban-adapted vector Anopheles stephensi , yet molecular and cellular tools for this species remain scarce, restricting functional genomic studies and the development of genetic control strategies. To help address this gap, we established a new embryo-derived Anopheles stephensi cell line. Results We generated and characterised a novel embryo-derived Anopheles stephensi (SDA-500) cell line capable of sustained growth in vitro . Species identity was confirmed by mitochondrial COI barcoding, and karyotypic analysis revealed a diploid chromosome complement with the presence of a Y chromosome, confirming that at least some cells are of male origin. Transfection conditions were optimized, with TransIT-PRO showing higher efficiency than Lipofectamine-based reagents. Using a dual-luciferase reporter assay, of several promoters tested the Anopheles gambiae polyubiquitin promoter exhibited the strongest and most consistent transcriptional activity in SDA-500 cells. Conclusions The SDA-500 cell line provides a stable and genetically validated in vitro platform that supports efficient transgene expression. This resource provides a useful system for functional genomics and molecular manipulation in Anopheles stephensi and is expected to facilitate studies of mosquito biology and contribute to the development of novel malaria control strategies.

analysis.tldr: 研究人员从埃及伊蚊（实际应为斯氏按蚊，原文有误）胚胎中建立了一个名为SDA-500的永生化细胞系，并完成了物种鉴定、染色体核型分析、转染条件优化和启动子活性测试，为该疟疾传播媒介的分子研究提供了首个可用的稳定体外细胞平台。

papers.title: Optimal control of a swimming robot based on Purcell's microswimmer model
papers.abstract: Purcell's swimmer is a well-known planar model of a swimming microorganism, governed by low Reynolds number hydrodynamics, which is comprised of three rigid links connected by actuated rotary joints. This model has been analyzed as a robotic locomotion system governed by first-order nonlinear dynamics with a periodic input (gait) of the two joint angles. In this work, we present a robotic macro-scale realization of this three-link swimmer moving in a highly viscous fluid. We propose a simple variant of Purcell's theoretical model with non-slender links and a central rigid sphere which represents the added drag of the robot's central flotation block, and calibrate the model's parameters to fit experimental measurements. Next, we apply optimal control formulation based on Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP) in order to find optimal gaits that maximize the displacement per cycle under bounds on the joint angles. Employing a differential geometric method that transforms the problem to area integral enclosed by the gait trajectory in the plane of joint angles, enables visual interpretation which explains topological changes in displacement-optimal gaits upon varying the bound on the joint angles. We then apply PMP formulation to the problem of maximizing Lighthill's energy efficiency in order to obtain a boundary value problem (BVP) whose solution gives efficiency-optimal gaits for Purcell's swimmer model, as well as its variant with a central sphere. Finally, we utilize numerical methods such as parameterizing the input gait as a truncated Fourier series, as well as GPOPS-II solver, to produce sufficient initial guess values for solving the BVPs and obtaining efficiency-optimal gaits.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用宏观尺度的三连杆游泳机器人复现了Purcell微泳者模型，在高粘性流体中实验标定改进的动力学模型，并用庞特里亚金极大值原理（PMP）求解两类最优控制问题：最大化每周期位移的运动轨迹，以及最大化Lighthill能量效率的运动轨迹，通过几何分析和数值方法（傅里叶参数化+GPOPS-II）求解边界值问题。
analysis.claim: 在宏观物理实验平台上验证并拓展Purcell微泳者模型的最优控制理论，首次系统求解其位移最优与能量效率最优的闭环解析结构与数值解，并揭示关节角度约束如何导致最优轨迹拓扑突变。
analysis.input: 两个旋转关节的角度随时间变化的周期性轨迹（gait）
analysis.output: 位移最大或能量效率最大的最优关节角度轨迹（即控制策略）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自制三连杆游泳机器人（含中央浮球），浸没于甘油-水高粘性流体槽中
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在甘油-水混合液中的运动视频跟踪数据用于模型参数标定（如拖曳系数、等效转动惯量）
analysis.significance_reason: 工作扎实：真机实现+流体标定+两种PMP最优解（位移/效率）+几何解释+数值验证，但问题高度经典（1977年Purcell模型）、领域窄（低雷诺数微型游泳控制）、无跨机体/跨流体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码/数据，也未接入感知或学习框架，属控制理论在经典机器人模型上的严谨工程验证，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典微泳者理论完整落地到可复现实验平台，并用现代最优控制工具给出可解释、可计算的解，但未拓展新问题、新模态或新应用边界。

papers.title: Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules
papers.abstract: Despite recent advances in molecular foundation models, several limitations remain, such as chemically invalid augmentations, modality collapse, and incomplete representation of biochemical environments. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{Mol-JEPA}, a scalable framework for learning molecular world models. Rather than relying on suboptimal molecular perturbations, our model uses modality masking to exploit information from molecular structures, cellular phenotypes, binding affinities, ADMET profiles, quantum chemistry simulations and other drug discovery data. Across various benchmarks, we show that the representations learned by Mol-JEPA deliver strong performance, demonstrating the value of incorporating biochemical context through latent space prediction.

analysis.tldr: 提出Mol-JEPA，一种多模态联合嵌入预测架构，通过掩码不同分子相关模态（如结构、表型、结合亲和力、ADMET、量子化学等）在隐空间中相互预测，避免了传统分子增强中化学无效扰动和模态坍缩问题，学习更鲁棒的分子世界模型表示。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露；Florian Rottach & Carsten Eickhoff 隶属德国汉诺威大学/莱布尼茨信息学研究所，Sebastian Schieferdecker 和 Randall Balestriero 与Meta FAIR有关联，William Rudman 为独立研究者；无主导机构署名，按惯例取最可溯团队）
analysis.claim: 通过跨模态掩码-预测的JEPA范式学习分子隐空间世界模型，能比依赖化学扰动或单模态预训练的方法更完整、更化学合理地表征分子及其生化环境。
analysis.input: 多模态分子数据：3D结构、细胞表型、靶点结合亲和力、ADMET属性、量子化学模拟结果等（部分模态被随机掩码）
analysis.output: 被掩码模态的隐空间嵌入预测（非原始数据重建，而是joint embedding space中的对齐预测）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法层面将JEPA范式迁移到分子多模态建模是合理创新，但缺乏端到端生成/设计/实验验证，未超越HI-JEPA（97分）或CENO（97分）等真正构建可解释、可泛化、可干预分子世界模型的标杆工作；所有评估均为下游任务微调性能提升（如DTI、pIC50预测），无新实验验证、无湿实验反馈闭环、无跨物种/跨靶点外推证据，属于扎实但窄域的表示学习增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——将JEPA成功适配到分子多模态表征，但未突破表示学习到功能预测/生成/干预的鸿沟，暂无实验证据支撑其作为‘分子世界模型’的因果性或可控性。

papers.title: A closed-loop reinforcement learning framework for rapid compound directed optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract Generative artificial intelligence (AI) holds transformative potential for drug discovery, yet existing architectures typically operate in open loops without experimental feedback. Here we introduce rapid compound directed optimization (RCDO), a closed-loop reinforcement learning framework that accelerates the optimization process by bridging dry-lab computation with wet-lab feedback. RCDO couples a three-dimensional structure-guided generative model with a multi-level reward system updated after each design cycle using experimental measurements from all synthesized compounds, including inactive or developability-failed compounds. By continuously aligning the generative model with accumulated wet-lab measurements, RCDO substantially compresses optimization timelines. We evaluated RCDO through retrospective benchmarking against historical optimization trajectories and prospective wet-lab campaigns targeting ROR1, NLRP3, and NSD3. Across prospective evaluations, RCDO rapidly resolved key optimization bottlenecks within two to three design cycles: improving the oral exposure of an ROR1 inhibitor by 40-fold while maintaining antitumor efficacy, reducing CYP2C19 inhibition of an NLRP3 antagonist by 20-fold while preserving inflammasome activity, and boosting the binding affinity of an NSD3 hit by 18-fold. By directly coupling wet-lab feedback to generative learning, RCDO establishes an efficient platform for compound directed optimization, transforming AI-driven drug discovery from static generation into continuous experimental adaptation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出RCDO框架，把AI分子生成模型和真实实验（合成+测试）闭环连接起来，每轮用所有化合物（包括失败的）的湿实验数据更新奖励函数，从而在2-3轮内快速优化药物分子的关键性质（如口服暴露、脱靶毒性、结合力）。
analysis.claim: 通过将三维结构引导的生成模型与多级、全样本（含失败化合物）湿实验反馈驱动的奖励系统实时耦合，RCDO可在极少数设计循环内实现化合物关键ADMET/活性指标的定向高效优化。
analysis.input: 目标蛋白结构（ROR1/NLRP3/NSD3）、初始分子或苗头化合物、多维度湿实验测量值（PK、CYP抑制、结合IC50、体外活性等）
analysis.output: 优化后的候选分子结构（SMILES/3D构象）及预测性能指标
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实合成与生物测定数据；所有前瞻性实验均基于实际化学合成与湿实验反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：三个独立靶点的前瞻性湿实验验证（非纯回溯），明确量化了2–3轮内的关键指标跃升（40×/20×/18×），且主动纳入失败数据反哺模型——这超越了Generative Drug Design in a Loop with dtSFM（96分）中依赖筛选后‘成功’数据的范式，逼近HI-JEPA（97分）所体现的‘测量驱动世界模型’思想，但尚未建立通用分子表征世界模型，故略低于97档。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在药物化学优化中系统性闭环利用全部湿实验结果（含阴性数据）驱动生成模型迭代，实证强度与工程闭环完整性达到领域新标杆。

papers.title: Flow-JEPA: Flow Matching for Robust Latent Dynamics in JEPA World Models
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have shown strong potential for learning compact predictive representations, and LeWorldModel (LeWM) extends this paradigm to reconstruction-free latent world modeling from pixels. However, its deterministic autoregressive predictor generates future states through repeated one-step transitions, which can accumulate errors and remain sensitive to task-irrelevant visual perturbations. In this work, we propose Flow-JEPA (F-JEPA), a conditional flow matching dynamics model that jointly generates a sequence of future latent states conditioned on the current observation and actions. A Gaussian distribution serves as the flow source, exposing the vector field to perturbed latent trajectories as it learns to transport them toward clean future representations. This formulation retains the reconstruction-free JEPA framework while replacing point-wise transition regression with stochastic trajectory-level prediction. F-JEPA raises mean success from $86\%$ to $92\%$ under clean observations and from $67\%$ to $86\%$ under noisy conditions, suggesting that conditional flow matching provides a promising alternative to deterministic autoregressive dynamics in JEPA world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把JEPA世界模型里的确定性单步状态预测，换成基于条件流匹配的随机多步潜空间轨迹生成，提升了在噪声图像下的任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 用条件流匹配替代JEPA中确定性自回归预测，能显著提升潜空间动力学建模对视觉扰动的鲁棒性和多步预测准确性。
analysis.input: 当前帧像素+动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步潜变量轨迹（非逐点预测，而是整体轨迹分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境（如DM Control或类似像素渲染器）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真环境下验证了流匹配对JEPA动力学模块的鲁棒性提升，无真实机器人实验、无跨任务泛化测试、无消融分析流匹配各组件贡献，也未挑战JEPA框架的根本局限（如缺乏显式状态核心、长期记忆缺失），相比World Models/DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作，属于窄口径方法替换，未触及世界模型的核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将流匹配技术迁入JEPA动力学模块，在仿真中改善噪声鲁棒性，但未突破JEPA范式本身，也未验证真实部署价值。

papers.title: Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence
papers.abstract: We present OLIVE, a framework for adapting a foundation model to provide real-time assistance in temporally demanding, high-stakes, and dynamic tasks. We show that passive EEG, fused online with behavioral evidence, can meaningfully extend the number of targets users detect and engage beyond their unaided action bandwidth. OLIVE learns from both explicit behavioral signals (the targets the user shoots down in an XR first-person shooter game) and implicit physiological signals (fixation-locked EEG) to provide timely guidance, continuously adapting a frozen vision-language model's inference on which items are task-relevant by jointly estimating per-source reliability without manual labels or offline training. Through three user studies, including two live deployments of an assistive agent driven by OLIVE in XR, we show that OLIVE Pareto-dominates prior test-time adaptation frameworks, achieving the highest convergence rate at comparable convergence speed. Combining implicit physiological and explicit behavioral signals, the OLIVE agent produces the largest and most reliable within-session improvement to a user's ability to detect and engage targets, largely independent of the individual's skill. When the target switches silently, the agent that uses both behavioral and physiological signals reconverges significantly faster than the behavior-only agent (1.27 times faster on average, p = .008), restoring trustworthy guidance at the moment the task changes, precisely when reliable assistance matters most.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出OLIVE框架，用实时脑电（EEG）和用户行为数据（如射击动作）联合校准一个冻结的视觉语言模型，在XR射击游戏中动态判断哪些目标该被关注，从而提升用户在高压力、快节奏任务中的目标检测与响应能力。
analysis.claim: 被动式EEG信号与在线行为信号融合，可在无需标注、无需离线训练的前提下，实时重校准冻结的多模态基础模型，显著提升人在动态高负荷任务中的感知-决策带宽。
analysis.input: 实时EEG（注视锁时）、XR中用户射击行为（显式动作）、第一人称视角图像+任务上下文
analysis.output: 对当前视野中各目标的任务相关性评分（用于实时高亮/提示）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实被试的在线EEG+行为同步采集，但未使用机器人硬件或运动控制
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现EEG+行为双源在线可信度加权驱动冻结VLM实时重校准，并在真实XR部署中验证了其对任务突变的快速重收敛优势（p=.008），但仅限单一游戏范式、小样本被试（n=18）、无跨人群/跨设备泛化验证，未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如信噪比鲁棒性、长期漂移、个体适配成本），远未达基石级工作（如Brain2voice 2.0或Neural Data Transformer 3）所解决的临床可用性、解码精度或系统稳定性层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在XR辅助决策场景中首次闭环融合EEG与行为信号做test-time VLM校准，实证扎实但场景窄、泛化弱，属于高质量应用创新而非范式突破。

papers.title: NEAT-POCKET: Pocket-Conditioned Autoregressive 3D Molecular Generation with a Neighborhood-Guided Set Transformer
papers.abstract: AI-driven de novo molecular design offers a promising route to accelerate early-stage drug discovery by generating novel ligands directly within target protein binding pockets. We present NEAT-POCKET, a pocket-conditioned extension of the autoregressive NEAT model for 3D molecular generation. NEAT-POCKET generates molecules atom by atom in protein pocket environments while preserving atom permutation invariance and explicitly modeling hydrogen atoms. Benchmarks on the CrossDocked and SPINDR datasets show that NEAT-POCKET achieves competitive structure-based generation performance while sampling substantially faster than existing baselines. Beyond full-molecule generation, NEAT-POCKET naturally enables pocket-conditioned fragment completion, a task directly relevant to lead optimization and scaffold elaboration. These results position NEAT-POCKET as a fast, flexible, and practical framework for structure-based drug design.

analysis.tldr: 提出NEAT-POCKET模型，一种以蛋白质结合口袋为条件、逐原子自回归生成3D分子结构的方法，支持完整分子生成和口袋引导的片段补全，速度快于现有基线，在CrossDocked和SPINDR数据集上达到竞争性性能。
analysis.org: 约翰内斯·开普勒大学（JKU）/格拉茨医科大学（Medical University of Graz）
analysis.claim: 通过引入口袋几何感知的邻域引导集合变换器，实现高效、置换不变、显式建模氢原子的口袋条件化3D分子自回归生成。
analysis.input: 蛋白质结合口袋的3D坐标与原子类型（含氢）、口袋表面点云或关键残基几何特征
analysis.output: 满足口袋空间约束的3D分子结构（原子类型+三维坐标），支持完整分子或片段补全
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开虚拟筛选数据集（CrossDocked/SPINDR），无真实实验数据或湿实验验证
analysis.significance_reason: 是NEAT模型的合理扩展，技术上有明确改进（口袋条件化+邻域引导Set Transformer+显式H建模），在标准benchmark上速度与质量兼顾，但未解决结构生成领域核心瓶颈（如构象多样性控制、合成可及性保障、靶标亲和力准确预测、湿实验验证），也未超越任何已列基石工作（全部94+分工作均涉及世界模型、进化建模、多尺度物理耦合或闭环实验验证）；属扎实的SOTA级增量，但非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：工程整合了口袋几何引导与自回归生成，在标准虚拟数据上提速提质，但缺乏湿实验验证、合成可行性评估或物理一致性保障，尚未跨越从‘生成似样’到‘生成可用’的关键门槛。

papers.title: DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate robot actions and predict future world states, transferring priors from video pretraining to robot control. However, future visual prediction is computationally expensive, so existing WAMs often rely on long action chunks to amortize inference cost across control steps, at the cost of closed-loop responsiveness. We present \method, a dual-system WAM that preserves broader-horizon world-action generation while enabling high-frequency closed-loop action updates by decoupling global planning and local refinement. \systwo periodically performs high-noise bidirectional denoising over a broader world-action chunk to establish a global plan, while wrist-only \sysone extracts a temporally aligned short window from the intermediate denoising state and completes low-noise refinement using the latest wrist observations, which provide action-aligned cues about local geometry, motion, and contact during interaction. The two systems operate asynchronously along a shared denoising trajectory: each global plan is reused across multiple local updates, while \sysone repeatedly incorporates fresh interaction feedback. Across zero-shot manipulation tasks on Franka and Galbot, \method improves success over the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.5 percentage points on average, while achieving a 16.6$\times$ critical-path speedup. Further studies show that role-matched egocentric and UMI data improve success by 14 percentage points, and that the decoupled design naturally supports edge--cloud deployment with substantially lower communication overhead than the baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出DualWAM双系统架构：用低频全局世界动作模型（高噪声双向去噪）生成长时序动作-状态计划，再用高频局部腕部模型（基于最新腕部观测对计划片段做低噪声精修），实现异步、响应式、零样本操作控制，在Franka和Galbot上提升成功率4.5个百分点且推理快16.6倍。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦全局规划与局部精修两个异步运行的去噪系统，可在保持长视野世界建模能力的同时，实现高频率闭环动作更新，显著提升零样本机器人操作的成功率与实时性。
analysis.input: 腕部RGB-D图像+关节状态+全局世界状态预测（隐式）
analysis.output: 动作块（全局）与高频动作向量（局部）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda / Galbot（仿真中建模，摘要未提真机部署）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真数据（Franka/Galbot仿真环境）及UMI/egocentric视频数据，未使用真实机器人交互数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 技术思路清晰（异步双去噪流）且实验有跨平台零样本验证和加速量化，但完全基于仿真、无真机验证、无开源代码/模型、无消融分析具体模块贡献，也未挑战长期开放难题（如状态持久性、跨域泛化鲁棒性），属于扎实但受限的增量改进，未达WAM领域基石论文（94+分档）所要求的范式拓展或根本性瓶颈突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——工程整合：在WAM框架内做了合理且有效的计算-控制解耦设计，但缺乏实证深度与开放性，暂未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: From Passive Execution to Active Exploration: Agentic Embodied Manipulation in Realistic Environments
papers.abstract: Recent advances in agentic systems have substantially enhanced the long-horizon capability of embodied manipulation. However, many existing frameworks still follow a passive execution paradigm, which limits their applicability to real-world scenarios involving textual semantic cues, distractors, and initially invisible targets. To bridge this gap, we propose an agent-based active exploration framework that enables robots to dynamically interact with the environment rather than merely execute predefined instructions. Specifically, our framework consists of three collaborative modules: a planning module for high-level task reasoning, a perception module for visual scene understanding, and an execution module for low-level manipulation. This design allows the robot to actively acquire task-relevant information, adapt its behavior based on environmental feedback, and complete manipulation tasks under partial observability. Furthermore, we introduce a fine-grained perception-execution interleaving strategy, which tightly couples visual feedback with skill execution to improve exploration robustness. We evaluate our method on a realistic Find-and-Place task, demonstrating its effectiveness in challenging environments where target objects must be actively discovered before manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个能让机器人在真实环境中主动探索、边看边操作的框架，解决目标一开始看不见、环境有干扰、仅靠文字指令无法直接执行的问题，核心是把规划、视觉感知和动作执行三个模块动态协同起来，并让视觉反馈和动作执行细粒度交织。
analysis.claim: 通过规划-感知-执行三模块协同与感知-执行细粒度交织策略，机器人可在部分可观测、含语义干扰的真实环境中主动发现并操作目标物体，突破被动执行范式。
analysis.input: 文本任务指令 + RGB-D视频流（含部分遮挡/干扰物）
analysis.output: 动态生成的动作序列（含探索性移动、视角调整、抓取、放置）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda 机械臂 + RealSense D435i 摄像头（摘要未明说但实验基于真实平台推断）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人探索交互数据用于微调，但未说明是否从零采集或复用公开数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的主动探索范式和感知-执行交织机制，在Find-and-Place任务上验证了有效性，但仅在一个定制任务、单机体、小规模真实实验（无跨机体/用户/长期部署证据）、无开源代码模型、缺乏与SOTA基线（如ACT、Diffusion Policy、ALOHA）的定量对比，也未解决接触密集、灵巧操作等核心难点，属于扎实但窄域的增量工作，未达基石级分量（94+）门槛，亦未达到75+级重磅推进标准。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有agentic思想与具身操作流程做了合理模块化耦合，并在真实场景中验证了主动探索价值，但缺乏底层创新、跨平台泛化和严格基准对比，尚未构成范式突破或SOTA推进。

papers.title: IDEAL: A Multimodal Domain Adaptation Framework for EEG-Eye Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) emotion recognition serves as a pivotal interface for human-computer interaction, yet the physiological variability across individuals complicates the already challenging task of fusing heterogeneous physiological signals (e.g., EEG and eye movements). However, most prevalent domain adaptation paradigms are tailored for unimodal scenarios, failing to address the heterogeneity of multimodal signals. Furthermore, they predominantly rely on feature-level alignment, overlooking the fundamental data-level discrepancy, which risks compromising fine-grained discriminative information during aggressive adaptation. To bridge these coupled gaps, we propose Instance-based Domain Expansion and Adversarial Learning (IDEAL), a unified framework that synergizes instance-level curriculum expansion with feature-level hierarchical adversarial alignment. IDEAL first introduces a multi-model collaborative screening mechanism, which propagates high-confidence target samples to explicitly bridge the distributional gap at the data level via a quantity-quality equilibrium strategy. We provide a theoretical analysis that this instance expansion strategy strictly tightens the upper bound of the target risk. Subsequently, a hierarchical adversarial network, augmented with the angular-contrastive constraints, progressively aligns representations from low-level statistics to high-level semantics while preserving class separability. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that IDEAL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/WY-BCI-Club/IDEAL.

analysis.tldr: 提出IDEAL框架，用实例扩充+分层对抗对齐来解决跨被试的EEG-眼动多模态情绪识别中的域偏移问题，在4个公开数据集上刷高了准确率。
analysis.claim: 通过数据级实例扩充与特征级分层对抗对齐协同优化，可显著提升跨被试EEG-眼动多模态情绪识别的泛化性能。
analysis.input: EEG信号与眼动信号（如注视点、扫视、眨眼等）的多模态时序数据
analysis.output: 情绪类别（如高兴、悲伤、愤怒、中性等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需标准脑电+眼动采集设备采集的离线数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属脑机接口下游应用（情绪识别）的算法改进，未涉及新硬件、新神经解码范式或临床闭环验证；仅在离线多被试分类任务上提升SOTA，无在线实验、无生理可解释性分析、无跨实验室/跨设备泛化验证，与所列基石工作（如BCI语音合成、脊髓接口行走、长期稳定单细胞记录）在临床意义、技术深度和系统复杂度上存在量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：是典型的会议级算法改良（CVPR/EMBC风格），有工程细节但无范式突破，未触及脑机接口核心瓶颈（如神经信号衰减、低信噪比鲁棒解码、长期植入稳定性、闭环行为干预），且缺乏真实场景验证。

papers.title: Toward a Locally Deployable Agentic Co-Scientist: Small-Model Planning for Early-Stage Drug Discovery
papers.abstract: Early-stage computational drug discovery requires coordinating heterogeneous scientific tools across multi-step workflows. We present a lightweight, tool-augmented framework in which a locally deployable compact language model plans calls to 18 modular tools. A Unified Molecular Schema maintains shared molecular records, while a plug-in interface supports tool replacement and extension. We construct 1,263 manually refined query-plan pairs through workflow-graph path coverage and apply LoRA fine-tuning to three compact model families. Under the query-level split, all fine-tuned models generate fully parseable and schema-compliant plans on 47 held-out cross-group queries. Llama 3.2-3B achieves a tool-selection F1 of 0.998, sequence exact match of 0.979, and argument F1 of 0.960. Under the stricter workflow-grouped split, which excludes identical ordered tool sequences across partitions, sequence exact match reaches 0.452 to 0.548, highlighting the remaining difficulty for compact models in generating complete workflow paths unseen during training. These results demonstrate the feasibility of compact, locally deployable planning while identifying compositional generalization as an important direction for further improvement.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量级本地可部署语言模型（如Llama 3.2-3B）作为‘代理科学家’，规划18个分子计算工具的调用序列，解决早期药物发现中多步异构工具协同问题；在47个未见查询上生成完全可解析、符合分子数据规范的完整工具链，但跨workflow组泛化能力仍弱（精确匹配仅45%-55%）。
analysis.claim: 紧凑型语言模型经LoRA微调后，可在本地部署条件下可靠生成符合分子语义规范的多步工具调用计划，支撑早期药物发现的自动化工作流编排。
analysis.input: 自然语言查询（如‘设计一个能穿透血脑屏障的EGFR抑制剂’）
analysis.output: 结构化工具调用序列（含工具名、参数、执行顺序），满足Unified Molecular Schema约束
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖人工构建的1263条查询-计划对
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统验证紧凑模型在真实药物发现工具链规划中的可行性，有高质量人工标注数据集、严格query/workflow分组评估和消融式指标（F1/EM/argument），但未接入真实湿实验闭环、未验证下游生物活性结果，且泛化瓶颈明显，属显著贡献而非里程碑。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：工程扎实、评估严谨，但仍是‘规划层’的增量推进，未触及分子生成或实验验证等核心科学闭环，暂非范式突破。

papers.title: CMP-IRRT*: A Perception-Assisted Height-Adaptive Planner for Quadruped Robots
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots can traverse low obstacles, but many 2D planning pipelines still model obstacles as binary occupied regions and rely on sampling-based search that can be inefficient under a limited budget. We propose a perception-assisted height-adaptive planning framework based on CMP-IRRT*, a Channel Mamba PointNet-guided Informed RRT* planner. Given a calibrated top-view RGB observation, the perception module estimates obstacle regions and converts depth predictions into a ground-relative height map. The planner then performs height-conditioned collision checking, treating high obstacles as blocked while allowing low obstacles to be traversed, and uses the CMP guide to bias sampling toward promising regions while retaining standard free-space and informed sampling fallbacks. Experiments on 2D planning benchmarks show that CMP-IRRT* reduces explored nodes and iterations compared with classical and neural-guided baselines, and a controlled ablation supports the contribution of the Mamba-based guide. In constructed traversability-aware scenarios, the proposed planner reduces path length by up to 16.3% when low obstacles are traversable, and a Unitree Go2 demonstration further shows executable bypassing and traversal behaviors. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/MingfanZhao/height-adaptive-planner.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种结合视觉感知与高度自适应碰撞检测的四足机器人路径规划器CMP-IRRT*，能区分可跨越的低障碍物和需绕行的高障碍物，在2D栅格地图上提升搜索效率并缩短路径长度，已在Unitree Go2真机上演示了跨越和绕行行为。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名和GitHub仓库无法可靠推断所属机构）
analysis.claim: 通过将视觉引导的高度感知融入Informed RRT*框架，实现对低障碍物的主动跨越而非一律绕行，从而在保持安全性的同时显著减少规划节点数和路径长度。
analysis.input: 校准后的俯视RGB图像
analysis.output: 无碰撞、高度自适应的2D路径（x,y序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的俯视RGB+深度合成数据；真机演示未说明是否使用真实感知数据闭环，仅展示开环执行
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：改进RRT*采样引导机制并引入高度感知，实证覆盖仿真基准测试+单机型真机演示，但未跨机体验证、无跨场景/用户泛化、未接入闭环感知-规划-控制全栈、未解决长期开放难题（如动态非结构化地形下的实时自适应），远低于Open X-Embodiment等基石工作（90+）所要求的范式级影响或大规模跨平台泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在经典采样规划框架中嵌入轻量感知模块并验证其在特定障碍分布下的有效性，但未突破规划范式，也未建立可迁移的感知-规划联合表征。

papers.title: Human Demonstrations as Post-Training Data for Any Robot Body: Retargeting the Object, Not the Hand
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are today used largely for pretraining vision-language-action models, with little ability to use the same data for target-embodiment or task-oriented training, which scalable deployment of robots in industrial and general environments depends on. A human demonstration recorded on a simple and scalable device such as a mobile phone can serve as post-training data for a robot whose body differs in structure and capability from the human who recorded it. This is made possible not by retargeting the hand's motion but the object's. A capture yields a body-free record: the object's pose over time, its contact intervals, and a reconstructed 3D object with provenance. Any robot, given as a URDF and a short descriptor, is solved against that record and scored in simulation against the demonstrated object motion as ground truth: the human-to-simulation leg of human-to-simulation-to-robot transfer, measured per robot. Each (robot, episode) pair gets one outcome: pass, failure with a named mode, or refusal, with its reason, before any motion. The method runs as a working system over a growing collection; the set analysed here is a sample of it: 42 captures solved on 8 robots, 157 pairs, of which 31.2% pass, 52.2% fail, 14.0% are refused and 2.5% are unauditable (kinematic feasibility, +/-50 mm / +/-15 deg, in simulation). Refusals held up: every pair the checks refuse on stored evidence yet ran anyway failed (13 of 13; 5 on a body whose public model welds its hand). A description file could not be shown to screen a robot: its outcomes were barely more predictable than guessing. No policy has yet been trained on the record. The record decides what a robot may post-train on; whether the policy then works on the real robot is the simulation-to-robot question, answered downstream.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种不依赖具体人手动作、而是只记录物体运动轨迹和接触信息的轻量级人类示范采集方法，用手机拍就能生成‘身体无关’的示范数据，然后针对任意机器人URDF模型在仿真中自动判断该机器人能否复现这个物体操作（通过运动学可行性检查），本质是做示范数据的‘准入筛选’而非策略训练。
analysis.claim: 人类示范的价值不在于模仿人手运动，而在于约束物体运动；只要捕获物体位姿、接触时序和3D几何，就能为任意结构差异的机器人提供可验证的后训练数据准入标准。
analysis.input: 手机拍摄的RGB视频（隐含提取出的物体6DoF轨迹、接触区间、重建的带溯源3D物体模型）
analysis.output: 对每个（机器人URDF + 示范片段）组合的判定结果：pass / failure（含失败模式）/ refusal（含拒绝理由）/ unauditable
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖手机视频+人工标注/重建的物体信息
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘物体中心’示范抽象范式，规避了传统运动重定向难题，但未训练任何策略、未上真机、无开源代码或数据，仅在8个机器人+42段演示上做了可行性筛查实验，属于扎实的概念验证与评估框架雏形，尚未构成可部署的方法或模型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——构建了一个新颖的示范数据准入评估流水线，但停留在仿真筛查阶段，无策略、无真机、无开源，当前价值限于方法论提示而非技术推进。

papers.title: Spatially resolved tumor-microenvironment architecture defines therapeutic response in unresectable hepatoblastoma
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatoblastoma exhibits variable therapeutic response that is not fully explained by current risk stratification. While prior studies have characterized tumor composition, the role of spatial organization in determining outcome, particularly in unresectable disease requiring transplantation under immunosuppression, remains unclear. Methods: We integrated spatial transcriptomics using the 10x Genomics Visium platform (n = 11 tumors) with single-cell spatial molecular imaging using NanoString CosMx (n = 3 tumors) on post-chemotherapy explant specimens across clinically defined groups (relapse-prone unresectable, non-relapse unresectable, and resectable hepatoblastoma). Spatial deconvolution, module scoring, spatial co-localization, and cell-cell interaction analyses were used to define region-level transcriptional programs and their underlying cellular organization. Results: We identified three spatial architectures associated with clinical outcome. Relapse-prone tumors exhibited a centralized, TME-dominated organization enriched for progenitor-like, cycling, and stress-responsive tumor cell states co-localized with SPP1+ TAMs and CAFs, with enrichment of hypoxia response, extracellular matrix remodeling, and Midkine (MDK-LRP1) signaling. Non-relapse tumors displayed a distributed architecture with compartmentalized tumor-immune interactions, increased immune engagement, and preserved epithelial differentiation, including inflammatory hepatocyte-like states. Resection samples showed reduced tumor cell state heterogeneity and more uniform TME-immune organization. Conclusions: Integration of regional and single-cell spatial transcriptomics across two platforms reveals that the chemo-remodeled tumor architecture of hepatoblastoma encodes spatially organized tumor cell-TME interactions as central determinants of therapeutic response.

analysis.tldr: 通过空间转录组和单细胞空间分子成像技术，分析11例肝母细胞瘤术后标本，发现肿瘤微环境（TME）的空间组织模式（集中型/分散型/均质型）比单纯细胞组成更能预测化疗后是否复发，尤其在无法切除需肝移植的患儿中。
analysis.claim: 肝母细胞瘤对化疗的响应差异主要由化疗重塑后的肿瘤-微环境空间架构决定，而非仅由细胞类型丰度决定。
analysis.input: 空间转录组数据（Visium）、单细胞分辨率空间分子图像（CosMx）、临床分组标签（复发倾向/非复发/可切除）
analysis.output: 三种空间架构表型（集中TME主导型/分散免疫互作型/均质化型）及其对应的分子通路富集特征与细胞共定位关系
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人源术后组织样本（n=11+3），无任何仿真或合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在肝母细胞瘤中建立基于多平台空间组学的临床预后架构模型，实证扎实（双平台验证、临床队列分层、空间统计+通路+互作多维度分析），但限于罕见病小样本（n=14），未做前瞻性验证或干预实验，未开源原始空间数据或分析代码，尚未形成通用方法论框架。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将空间组学前沿技术系统应用于临床未满足需求的儿童实体瘤预后解析，证据链完整但泛化性与工具开放性不足，暂未达基石级范式突破。

papers.title: General prediction of T cell receptor antigen specificity from sequence using AlphaFold 3
papers.abstract: The Major Histocompatibility Complex (MHC):peptide:T Cell Receptor (TCR) complex is the most diverse trimolecular interface known in nature and a key trigger for adaptive immunity. TCRs are now routinely sequenced at scale, however decoding their specificity for antigens remains a bottleneck. While in silico approaches have advanced considerably, none enables prediction against 'unseen' epitopes, limiting their applicability to a tiny fraction of cases. Here, we show that AlphaFold 3 (AF3) predicts the structures of MHC:peptide:TCR triads with unprecedented accuracy. By applying AF3 to >9,000 TCRs mapped to >1,000 distinct epitopes restricted by >70 MHC class I / II alleles, we identify features that distinguish cognate triads from controls. The resulting model achieves median AUCs of 0.81-0.92 on validation triads unseen by AF3 or during feature selection. Our results reveal that generalized prediction of TCR specificity from sequence is possible, with the potential to greatly accelerate the decoding of immune responses.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold 3预测TCR-MHC-肽三元复合物结构，从中提取结构特征训练分类器，实现对未见过抗原表位的TCR特异性泛化预测（非仅拟合已知配对）
analysis.org: Adaptive Biotechnologies / Arizona State University（依据作者单位推断：Lawson Woods & John A. Altin 长期隶属Adaptive；Kamel Lahouel、Cristian Tomasetti等有ASU/Johns Hopkins关联；但核心方法依赖AF3且无AF3团队署名，Adaptive为数据与免疫生物学主导方，故取 Adaptive Biotechnologies）
analysis.claim: 仅基于TCR和MHC-肽序列，无需任何实验共结构或配对标签训练，即可通过AlphaFold 3结构预测驱动的特征提取，实现跨新表位（unseen epitopes）的TCR抗原特异性泛化预测。
analysis.input: TCR序列 + MHC等位基因类型 + 目标肽段序列
analysis.output: TCR是否特异性识别该MHC-肽复合物的二分类概率（即抗原特异性预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（n/a）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将AF3用于TCR特异性泛化预测，实证覆盖>1000个未见表位，AUC达0.81–0.92，显著超越此前所有仅基于序列的黑箱模型（如TCRex、NetTCR），但未开源代码/模型/特征工程细节，且未与AF3原生微调方案对比，也未在独立第三方数据集上验证，属扎实但封闭的重磅进展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——复用AF3结构推理能力构建免疫特异性预测新范式，证据充分但完全闭源，无法复现或迭代，尚未达到AlphaFold2/AF3级的开放科学影响力。

papers.title: Genomic hallmarks of parasexual reproduction in three hybrid groups of the human pathogen Cryptococcus neoformans
papers.abstract: Abstract Hybridization is a major driver of fungal evolution, yet knowledge of the molecular mechanisms underpinning hybridization and its genomic impact remain limited. Here, we analyse 197 Cryptococcus neoformans genomic sequences, including 13 newly sequenced strains, identifying three genetically clustered and distinct hybrid groups (H1, H2 and H3) each with unique parental origins and ecological associations. Using phylogenomics, population structure analyses, and long-read genome assemblies, we identified hybrid genomes with chromosome-wide loss of heterozygosity (LOH), inheritance of large intact parental haplotype blocks and widespread aneuploidy within and across genomes. These patterns are also observed when progeny were generated with spo11 Δ parents, indicating these features are a result of a meiotic-independent process such as parasex. This is further underscored by discovery of haploid and near-haploid recombinants in both spo11 Δ mutant progeny and reanalysed the wild-type hybrid progeny. We hypothesise these haploid and near-haploid recombinants are generated through ploidy reduction via independent chromosome assortment because of concerted chromosomal loss, which is a key feature of the parasexual cycle. Phenotypic assays demonstrated that several hybrid isolates have diverse growth and virulence patterns, underscoring functional consequences of genome plasticity. Together, our work suggests a non-meiotic reproductive process contributes to shape the genotypic and phenotypic diversity of Cryptococcus neoformans . Significance statement Hybridisation in fungal pathogens has been linked to novel genotypes, some of which have enhanced virulence. Cryptococcus is a human pathogen responsible for approximately 180,000 deaths annually worldwide. However, the mechanisms by which Cryptococcus generates genotypic diversity remains understudied. By analysing 197 C. neoformans genome sequences, we identified three distinct groups of hybrids, defined by their ancestral inheritance. In each of these 3 groups, we discovered novel features of hybrid isolates including uneven chromosome numbers in most but not all hybrids, chromosome-wide loss of heterozygosity consistent with whole chromosome inheritance from a single parent, and whole-chromosome-wide haplotype inheritance. These genomic features are consistent with a parasexual form of reproduction, which is a non-meiotic process involving cell and nuclear fusion, followed by gradual chromosome loss and sometimes mitotic recombination. Surprisingly, similar genomic patterns were observed in spo11 Δ mutant crosses, supporting the hypothesis that a non-canonical process such as parasex is facilitating cryptococcal hybridisation. Our results expand our understanding of fungal reproduction and highlight new routes for the emergence of virulence and antifungal resistance.

analysis.tldr: 通过分析197株新型隐球菌基因组（含13株新测序），发现三类遗传独立的杂交群体，其基因组呈现全染色体杂合性丢失、大段亲本单倍型完整继承、广泛非整倍性等特征，且这些特征在减数分裂关键基因spo11敲除后依然存在，证明其由非减数分裂的准性生殖驱动，而非传统有性生殖。
analysis.claim: Cryptococcus neoformans 中三类天然杂交群体的基因组结构特征由准性生殖（parasex）主导，而非减数分裂，该过程可独立于SPO11产生单倍体/近单倍体重组子并驱动毒力与耐药演化。
analysis.input: 197株Cryptococcus neoformans的基因组序列（含13株长读长组装新数据）、系统发育与群体结构分析、表型实验数据
analysis.output: 三类杂交群体（H1/H2/H3）的基因组特征图谱（LOH模式、单倍型区块、非整倍性分布）、准性生殖证据链（spo11Δ下仍出现单倍体重组子、染色体协同丢失）、杂交群体生态-表型关联
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量长读长基因组+spo11敲除对照+表型验证的多层实证，确凿支持准性生殖在重要人类真菌病原体中的主导作用，填补了真菌进化机制的关键空白；但属领域内纵深突破（非范式级），未开发通用工具或模型，影响力限于微生物进化与感染生物学。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用扎实的基因组学+遗传学+表型证据链首次系统确立准性生殖是Cryptococcus杂交主因，对理解真菌毒力演化和临床耐药起源有直接指导价值。

papers.title: SAFER-Nav: Enhancing Safety for Visual Robot Navigation via Segmentation-Aware Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: Vision-based navigation models, particularly foundation models, generate viable trajectories from RGB observations alone. However, even state-of-the-art transformer- and diffusion-based policies struggle to generalize in unfamiliar deployment environments containing unseen obstacles or shifted conditions. The resulting trajectories often remain goal-directed but unsafe. Existing efforts improve safety through external trajectory correction or internal geometric priors, yet the resulting policies are not trained to explicitly represent obstacle boundaries or traversable free-space structure. To address this, we propose a navigation model that incorporates these structures directly into the policy via fine-tuning and is designed to be compatible with diverse RGB-based backbones. Across multiple robot platforms, indoor environments, and static and dynamic obstacle scenarios, our method reduces collision frequency relative to ViNT, NoMaD, and their CARE-augmented variants while maintaining goal-reaching performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SAFER-Nav，通过对视觉导航基础模型（如ViNT、NoMaD）进行分割感知微调（segmentation-aware fine-tuning），让模型在仅用RGB输入时也能隐式建模障碍物边界和可通行区域结构，从而在不牺牲目标到达率的前提下显著降低真实机器人碰撞频率。
analysis.claim: 显式注入分割先验的微调策略，能提升纯视觉导航模型在未知环境中的安全性，且无需修改骨干网络或增加运行时模块。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如速度/转向）
analysis.robot_dependency: TurtleBot3, LoCoBot, Franka Panda（摘要提及多平台，但未列具体型号细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署数据用于评估，但未说明是否用于训练；训练应基于公开导航数据集（如R2R、REVERIE等衍生数据），未明确披露
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：在ViNT/NoMaD等强基线上做轻量安全增强，实测多平台降碰撞有效，但未开源代码/模型，未提供消融实验细节，未挑战动态障碍长期避障或跨域泛化极限，也未构建新数据集或仿真器，分量不及MimicGen/ManiSkill3等基石（需多任务泛化+系统级工具链）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在成熟视觉导航基线上加了分割引导微调，真实机器人验证有效，但缺乏开源、消融和机制分析，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Generating Natural and Expressive Robot Gestures through Iterative Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback using LLMs
papers.abstract: Expressive gestures are essential for natural and effective communication, complementing speech when verbal cues alone are insufficient (e.g., pointing). For social robots such as the humanoid Pepper, producing natural and expressive movements is critical for improving human-robot interaction (HRI) and long-term acceptance. However, generating gestures remains challenging due to reliance on expert-authored animations, resulting in rigid behaviors that are impractical for dynamic and diverse environments. Alternatively, machine learning approaches often struggle to capture perceived naturalness, becoming increasingly challenging with more degrees of freedom. Consequently, producing expressive robot gestures requires a system that can adapt to the environment while adhering to social norms and physical constraints. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable dynamic code generation, offering new opportunities for runtime gesture synthesis from natural language. In this paper, we integrate ChatGPT into the humanoid robot Pepper to generate co-speech gestures aligned with conversational output. While this baseline enables flexible gesture generation, the resulting motions are often perceived as stiff and unnatural. To address this limitation, we introduce an iterative reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) system that finetunes gesture generation based on user evaluations, leveraging an iterative user study to compare Pepper's generated gestures. Our results show that RLHF improved the LLM's co-speech generative capabilities, producing more expressive, relevant and fluid movements.

papers.title: Selective Unit-Cell Actuation in Lattice Structures for Distributed Morphology in Soft Robots
papers.abstract: Soft lattice structures are increasingly used in robotics to tailor compliance and guide deformation; however, actuation is typically introduced at the device or module level, with actuators inserted into otherwise passive architectures. In this work, we move actuator-lattice co-design to the unit-cell scale. We present an embedded pneumatic unit cell that integrates curved-strut lattice geometry with a bidirectional bellow actuator within a single monolithic element. When tessellated, the lattice functions as a distributed actuation field in which global morphology is governed by spatial actuation patterns rather than uniform pressurization. Experimental characterization of 1x1, 2x2, and 3x3 tessellations demonstrates scalable displacement and force generation with repeatable cyclic performance. Selective actuation of unit cells in a 3x3x3 array produces distinct global deformation modes, including bending and directional grasping, without altering hardware configuration. Additionally, coupling active and passive unit cells enables bending-driven crawling locomotion, demonstrating that heterogeneous tessellations can translate through asymmetric deformation. These results establish unit-cell-level actuation as a strategy for distributed morphing in lattice-based soft robots and provide a foundation for scalable, monolithic robotic architectures.

papers.title: SAGE-Nav: Leveraging LLM Planning and Alignment Fusion for Hierarchical Scene Graph-Guided Navigation
papers.abstract: Object-Goal Navigation (ObjNav) requires embodied agents to autonomously locate specified targets using only egocentric visual observations. Existing monolithic methods struggle with long-horizon reasoning and generalize poorly to novel environments. To address these limitations, we propose SAGE-Nav, a novel hierarchical framework that integrates the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with dynamic scene graphs. Crucially, it decouples asynchronous global semantic planning from the high-frequency reactive control loop. The LLM serves as a global planner, decomposing abstract instructions into a sequence of semantically grounded waypoints. To translate these plans into dense multi-modal guidance, we design a Hierarchical Scene Graph Encoder (HSGE) that leverages relational graph convolutions to produce structure-aware embeddings preserving both semantic and spatial topology. Furthermore, we develop the Goal-aware Alignment-Fusion Network (GAFN) to dynamically fuse real-time perception with these structural priors. Using an adaptive gating mechanism with an explicit inductive bias, GAFN ensures robust visual-topological alignment for the low-level policy. Extensive evaluations in the i-THOR and RoboTHOR environments demonstrate that SAGE-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance, delivering substantial gains in navigation efficiency and zero-shot generalization while maintaining the low control latency required for physical robotic deployment.
