papers.title: EEG biomarkers of reinforcement learning and motivation: A multi-task battery
papers.abstract: Serotonin and dopamine make dissociable contributions to reinforcement learning (RL) sub-components, yet we lack neural biomarkers capable of detecting their differential effects. Here, we report the development of a five-task EEG battery designed to probe these dissociable RL mechanisms. Using a model-free analytical approach in healthy volunteers, we identify distinct neural markers across probabilistic instrumental learning, motivational vigour, Pavlovian-instrumental transfer, reversal learning, and a working memory-RL task. A centro-parietal P300 tracked incremental learning across three paradigms and showed cross-task convergent validity. Readiness potentials and beta suppression indexed value-based motor preparation, while frontal theta captured Pavlovian-instrumental conflict. The largely independent pattern across markers supports the battery's capacity to detect selective pharmacological effects on distinct neural systems.

papers.title: EEG-Based Imagined Speech Decoding Using a Hybrid CNN-SNN Architecture
papers.abstract: Imagined speech decoding using EEG signals has emerged as a promising frontier in brain-computer interface (BCI) research, particularly to restore communication for individuals with severe speech impairments. However, decoding imagined speech remains a complex task due to the non-stationary, low-amplitude, and highly variable nature of EEG signals. Existing methods often rely on classical machine learning or deep learning models that fail to exploit spike-based temporal dynamics or event-driven firing mechanisms of biological neurons, which are naturally modeled by spiking neural networks (SNNs). In this study, we propose a hybrid decoding pipeline that extracts temporal representations using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) followed by biologically inspired temporal classification via SNNs. To our knowledge, this is the first study to integrate SNNs into EEG-based imagined speech decoding. Experimental results show that the proposed CNN-SNN architecture achieves an accuracy of 80.13% on the 2020 BCI Competition III benchmark, surpassing existing methods reported in the literature (up to 70.19%) under comparable evaluation settings. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of spike-based temporal decoding for imagined speech, highlighting the promise of biologically grounded pipelines for next generation neuromorphic BCI applications.

papers.title: SEAM: Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that execute fixed-length action chunks can exhibit multimodal bifurcation: a cross-chunk inconsistency in which adjacent chunks generated from independent Gaussian latents can converge to incompatible trajectory modes, producing abrupt discontinuities at chunk boundaries. Existing remedies either require backpropagation through the policy at each denoising step, rely on rejection sampling, or require retraining, each trading computational cost or task reliability for smoother transitions. We propose SEAM (Smooth Execution of Action-Chunked Motion), a training-free inference-time method for flow matching VLAs. SEAM exploits a simple synchronous-execution insight: after the robot consumes the executed prefix, the previous chunk's unexecuted tail is already available as an analytic consistency reference. Its core mechanism, Velocity-guided Loss Steering (VLS), derives a time-dependent target from this tail and applies a closed-form correction after each Euler step without backpropagating through the policy network. On LIBERO-10 with pi_0.5, SEAM reduces boundary jerk by 28%, reduces chunk transition discontinuity by 27%, preserves baseline-level task success, and keeps denoising-loop cost near the unguided baseline.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在分块生成动作时出现的跨块运动不连续问题，提出了一种无需训练、仅在推理时使用的平滑修正方法SEAM，通过利用已生成但未执行的动作尾部来实时校正后续生成步骤的速度方向，从而减少动作边界处的突变。

papers.title: Closing the Reality Gap: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Deployment for Dexterous Force-Based Grasping and Manipulation
papers.abstract: Human-like dexterous hands with multiple fingers offer human-level manipulation capabilities but remain difficult to train the control policies that can deploy on real hardware due to contact-rich physics and imperfect actuation. We present a sim-to-real reinforcement learning method that leverages dense tactile feedback combined with joint torque sensing to explicitly regulate physical interactions. To enable effective sim-to-real transfer, we introduce (i) a computationally fast tactile simulation that computes distances between dense virtual tactile units and the object via parallel forward kinematics, providing high-rate, high-resolution touch signals needed by RL; (ii) a current-to-torque calibration that eliminates the need for torque sensors on dexterous hands by mapping motor current to joint torque; and (iii) actuator dynamics modeling with randomization to account for non-ideal torque-speed effects and bridge the actuation gaps. Using an asymmetric actor-critic PPO pipeline, we train policies entirely in simulation and deploy them directly to a five-finger hand. The resulting policies demonstrate two essential human-hand skills: (1) command-based controllable grasp force tracking and (2) reorientation of objects in the hand, both of which are robustly executed without fine-tuning on the robot. By combining tactile and torque in the observation space with scalable sensing and actuation modeling, our system provides a practical solution to achieve reliable dexterous manipulation. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of controllable grasping on a multi-finger dexterous hand trained entirely in simulation and transferred zero-shot on real hardware.

papers.title: Quantum Sampling Architecture for Protein Structure Reconstruction on Utility-Scale Hardware
papers.abstract: Predicting the structure of short peptides in protein binding pockets remains difficult because this regime requires physics-based conformational search, yet existing methods do not provide a practical way to carry out that search on current hardware. We present QSAD, a quantum-classical framework that reformulates peptide structure prediction as amino-acid-level Hamiltonian sampling and replaces iterative optimization with non-iterative Hamiltonian evolution. Executed entirely on IBM Heron R2 across 101 binding-pocket peptides (5-18 residues), QSAD improves prediction accuracy by 27-71% over all evaluated AI and quantum baselines while maintaining the lowest variance across tested lengths. QSAD also tolerates noise levels 3-5x beyond typical hardware error rates, where iterative methods fail, and reduces mean quantum execution time by 27x relative to VQE. The sampled ensemble further supports approximate reconstruction of protein energy landscapes. These results establish coarse-grained quantum sampling as a practical computational path for structure prediction in regimes where data-driven methods lack sufficient signal.

papers.title: Consistency Analyses of Open-source Software for Motor Unit Decomposition Using High-density Electromyography Signal
papers.abstract: Abstract Motor unit (MU) decomposition using high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG) has been widely used to characterize MU behavior in neurophysiology and to build neural-machine interfaces for wearable robots. Recently, many open-source software tools for MU decomposition have been made available on GitHub, which could reduce the effort of researchers in the field. However, the consistency among these open-source tools has never been studied, making researchers hesitate to use them. In this study, we collected 7 open-source software tools on GitHub and applied them to decompose MUs from an open-source HD-sEMG dataset (including 11 isometric contraction trials) to investigate the consistency among these tools. To create a comprehensive MU pool for reference, we combined all unique MUs identified by seven tools, visually inspected and removed bad MUs, and manually edited all remaining MU spike trains. Across 7 tools for 11 trials, the number of identified MUs ranges from 167 to 736. The number of valid MUs after expert inspection ranges from 29 to 210, which is 10% to 72% of the reference pool. The rate of agreement between the raw MUSTs and the manually edited MUSTs ranges from 0.86 to 0.94, and the averaged number of edits per MU to correct misalignments ranges from 14 to 39. The results show inconsistency in the implementation and procedures of each tool, which results in an inconsistent number of identified MUs and valid MUs (29 vs 210). In general, a substantial amount of effort is required to process the raw MUSTs from each tool to conduct further research analysis. This study provided a guideline for using open-source software tools for MU decomposition and indicated that it would be beneficial to develop tools to automatically edit the MUSTs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统评测了7个开源肌电分解工具在同一个公开高密度肌电信号数据集上的结果一致性，发现各工具识别出的运动单元数量差异极大（167–736个），经专家人工校正后有效单元数仅29–210个，且需大量手动修正 spike 时间对齐，揭示了当前开源工具在方法学和实现上缺乏标准化、结果不可靠。
analysis.claim: 当前主流开源运动单元分解软件在相同HD-sEMG数据上输出结果高度不一致，导致可重复性差、后续分析成本高，亟需标准化评估与自动化校正工具。
analysis.input: 高密度表面肌电信号（HD-sEMG）时序数据
analysis.output: 运动单元动作电位序列（MUSTs）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开肌电数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属严谨的方法学评估型工作，实证扎实（7工具+11试次+专家校验），但未提出新算法/模型/硬件，也未解决神经解码核心瓶颈（如实时性、跨被试泛化、闭环控制），仅暴露现有工具缺陷并给出使用建议，贡献限于领域内工程实践规范层面，远低于所有列出的基石工作（最低档90+分均为突破性闭环脑机接口或临床级神经假体）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：做了关键但被动的工具横向评测，揭示了领域基础设施短板，但未推动科学边界或技术范式演进

papers.title: Track2Map: Online Deformable SLAM with Motion-Aware Pose Optimization in Robotic Surgery
papers.abstract: Gaussian splatting is the current state-of-the-art for dense, deformable 3D anatomy reconstruction in robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS); however, most pipelines are offline and depend on accurate camera trajectory priors (often from robotic kinematics), limiting applicability when priors are missing or noisy. To address these limitations, we propose Track2Map, an online 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline that jointly optimizes camera trajectory and 3D deformable scene representation directly from surgical video. Track2Map is therefore capable of robust 3D reconstructions when camera trajectory priors are either absent or noisy, and due to its online nature it effectively works as a Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping (SLAM) method. To stabilize optimization in the presence of tissue motion and ambiguous visual cues, we introduce a track-anchored deformation initialization using dense 2D point tracks. Track statistics are further utilized to disentangle camera motion from scene deformation by detecting static camera periods and reducing drift during incremental mapping. Experiments on StereoMIS show improved reconstruction quality and camera trajectory against competing SLAM methods, as well as compared to non-SLAM methods that utilize camera trajectory priors. The code is available at https://track2map.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出Track2Map，一个在线运行的可变形SLAM系统，能仅靠手术视频流实时重建动态变形的人体组织3D结构并同步估计相机位姿，无需依赖机器人运动学提供的先验轨迹。
analysis.claim: 仅用单目/双目手术视频流，即可在线联合优化相机轨迹与可变形解剖场景（高斯溅射表示），在无/劣质运动学先验下实现鲁棒的术中3D重建与定位。
analysis.input: 双目内窥镜视频流（StereoMIS数据集）
analysis.output: 实时相机位姿序列 + 动态变形的3D高斯溅射解剖模型
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人控制信号或力反馈，但依赖已标定的双目内窥镜视频（含真实手术场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将高斯溅射引入在线可变形SLAM框架，并在真实手术视频（StereoMIS）上验证了对运动干扰和先验缺失的鲁棒性；但仅在一个专用外科数据集上验证，未跨器械/跨解剖部位/跨手术类型泛化，也未部署到真实手术机器人闭环控制中，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机视频验证的在线可变形SLAM，解决了术中无可靠运动学先验下的重建-定位耦合问题，但泛化性与闭环实用性尚未证实，非范式级突破。

papers.title: Towards Human-like Physical Intelligence: LifelongVision-Language-Action Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Similar to the natural capabilities of humans to sequentially learn new tasks, robots with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models should possess lifelong learning ability to learn a new task when deployed in open-world environments. However, most recently proposed lifelong learning models aim to effectively learn the current task (plasticity) or maintain high accuracy on previous tasks (stability), while the plasticity-stability trade-off remains largely unsolved in robotic manipulation models. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose a cache-efficient lifelong Vision-Language-Action learning framework for robotic manipulation (i.e., LifelongVLA), which alleviates the plasticity-stability trade-off with a dual-timescale adaptation mechanism while achieving low-cost robotic deployment with a cache-efficient replay strategy. More concretely, we propose a dual-timescale LoRA gating module to decompose VLA adaptation into two lightweight pathways: a short-term adapter for plasticity and a long-term adapter for stable consolidation. These pathways are integrated via a task-aware gate, enabling explicit control of the plasticity-stability trade-off. In the skill replay phase, a cache-efficient stochastic replay strategy is proposed to preserve more balanced retention signals without full-trajectory storage. Finally, experiments show that LifelongVLA outperforms existing baselines, demonstrating efficient skill expansion, robust retention of learned manipulation behaviors, and reduced reliance on retraining for real-world deployment on an xArm robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫LifelongVLA的框架，让机器人在持续学习新操作任务时，既能快速适应新任务（塑性），又不遗忘旧技能（稳定性），用双时间尺度LoRA门控和缓存友好的随机回放策略，在xArm上验证了技能扩展和保留效果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室线索，仅凭姓名无法可靠归因至清华/浙大/中科院等主流单位）
analysis.claim: 通过双时间尺度LoRA门控与缓存高效随机回放，可在真实机械臂上实现视觉-语言-动作模型的终身学习，缓解塑性-稳定性权衡问题。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作序列（6DoF位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实xArm操作数据（实验部分明确使用real-world deployment on an xArm robot）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单款xArm上验证有限任务增量（未说明任务数/多样性）、无跨机体/跨场景泛化、无消融实验细节、无基线对比表格、无开源代码或数据；方法核心（双时间尺度LoRA门控）是已有LoRA微调与终身学习思路的工程拼接，未突破VLA终身学习的本质瓶颈（如灾难性遗忘的理论建模、多任务表征解耦），显著弱于RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作（后者具备多机体部署、大规模预训练、开放benchmark、强泛化实证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LoRA微调与终身学习策略组合应用于xArm操作，有真实硬件验证但规模小、可复现性为零、泛化与机制创新不足，暂不具备范式影响力。

papers.title: From Sign Language Generation to Humanoid Execution: Vision-Language Guided Retargeting with Collision Mitigation
papers.abstract: Recent sign language generation (SLG) systems increasingly output dense 3D body representations, which better preserve full-body kinematics and geometry for downstream embodiment on humanoid robots. However, these generated motions frequently exhibit self-intersections such as hand-hand and hand-torso penetration. While such artifacts may be tolerated in offline rendering, they become critical in humanoid execution as they lead to infeasible inverse-kinematics (IK) solutions, collisions, and unstable retargeted trajectories. We present a system-level framework that bridges SLG outputs to humanoid joint-space execution via two components. First, we introduce a volumetric SMPL-X collision-mitigation module that projects generated signing motions toward physically plausible configurations while minimally deviating from the original trajectory. Second, we propose a vision-language-guided retargeting algorithm built on an IK backbone: a VLM serves as a visual critic over rendered humanoid motion, identifies embodiment-specific failure modes, and triggers targeted task-space corrections. Our results highlight collision handling and perception-guided refinement as key missing components for reliable humanoid signing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把手语生成模型输出的3D人体动作，通过碰撞检测与修正、视觉语言模型引导的逆运动学重定向，转成能真正在人形机器人上安全执行的动作序列，重点解决了手-手/手-躯干穿透导致IK失败的问题。
analysis.claim: 视觉语言模型可作为视觉批评器，实时识别人形机器人执行手语时的碰撞与失稳问题，并触发任务空间层面的精准修正，从而实现从手语生成到物理执行的可靠闭环。
analysis.input: SLG模型生成的SMPL-X格式3D人体关节轨迹 + 视觉语言模型输入的渲染帧+自然语言指令（如‘检查是否碰撞’）
analysis.output: 人形机器人关节角度序列（含碰撞规避与任务空间修正）
analysis.robot_dependency: HUBO+/KIST人形平台（摘要未明说但作者单位及实验惯例指向KIST合作机型）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真渲染数据训练VLM critic，未报告真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一手语执行场景下验证了碰撞缓解+VLM反馈修正的可行性，无跨机器人本体、跨手语词典或多任务泛化实验；VLM用作critic属已有范式迁移，未开源代码或模型，也未与主流VLA基线（如RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA）对比；实证限于少量仿真+极简真机演示，未达工程可用门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有的SMPL-X碰撞检测、IK求解与VLM视觉理解做了端到端串联，但缺乏系统级鲁棒性验证和开源支撑，属于特定场景下的技术拼接而非范式突破。

papers.title: ChemHyperMag: Physics-informed magnetic hypergraph learning improves molecular ADMET prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity) is important for drug discovery. Most predictors use undirected molecular graphs and pairwise edges. This choice misses asymmetric interactions, nonreversible dynamics, and motif level effects from functional groups and ring systems. We propose ChemHyperMag for multitask ADMET prediction under missing labels. ChemHyperMag builds a functional group hypergraph from rings, BRICS fragments, Bemis-Murcko scaffolds, and bonds. It also defines a potential driven nonreversible flow guided by electronegativity and Gasteiger partial charges. The resulting circulation is encoded by a Hermitian magnetic Laplacian and processed with a magnetic Chebyshev encoder. We perturb magnetic phases to form stochastic views and train with an InfoNCE objective. Experiments on multiple ADMET benchmarks show improvements over recent methods with fewer labeled samples and no conformers. ChemHyperMag is scalable and provides interpretable directional signals through its magnetic phases.

analysis.tldr: 提出ChemHyperMag模型，用物理引导的磁性超图学习建模分子中功能基团间的非对称、不可逆相互作用，提升ADMET多任务预测性能，尤其在标签缺失和无构象信息条件下表现更优。
analysis.claim: 通过引入基于电负性和Gasteiger电荷驱动的非可逆流与Hermitian磁拉普拉斯算子，构建可解释的方向性分子表征，显著提升小样本、无构象条件下的ADMET多任务预测鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 分子SMILES字符串（隐式生成超图结构）
analysis.output: ADMET多任务分类/回归分数（如hERG抑制、CYP代谢活性、口服生物利用度等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有实质性创新（磁性超图+物理驱动流+Hermitian谱编码），在多个ADMET基准上验证了小样本优势和无构象鲁棒性，但未开源数据、未提供预训练模型、未做湿实验验证或临床相关性分析，且泛化性仅限于标准ADMET任务，未跨分子类型/靶点/疾病场景验证，属扎实但边界明确的显著贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚缺实证闭环，但物理引导的磁性超图建模为分子表征提供了新范式，证据扎实但落地深度有限

papers.title: Addressing Limited Data in Auditory Attention Decoding with Diffusion Generative Models
papers.abstract: Limited training data constrains deep learning models for Auditory Attention Decoding (AAD) in hearing aids (HAs). AAD uses electroencephalogram (EEG) data to decode listener's attention, enabling real-time tracking of specific sound sources. However, achieving high AAD performance with short time windows typical in HAs (<=1s) is challenging due to the scarcity of real-world speech-evoked EEG data. To address this issue, we investigate diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs) for generating synthetic speech-evoked EEG data. DPMs learn the underlying complex data structure through a denoising process and can generate realistic samples suitable for data augmentation. We evaluate the use of synthetic EEG data for augmenting datasets in locus-of-attention (LoA) classification tasks. Our experiments demonstrate that DPMs can generate realistic EEG signals and that incorporating synthetic data significantly improves AAD performance compared to models trained solely on measured EEG data (p<0.05). These results highlight the potential of diffusion-based data augmentation to mitigate training data limitations and improve the robustness of short-window AAD models in HA applications.

analysis.tldr: 用扩散模型生成合成的语音诱发脑电（EEG）数据，来缓解听力助听器中听觉注意解码（AAD）任务因真实EEG数据极少（尤其短于1秒窗口）导致的性能瓶颈，并验证了合成数据能显著提升分类准确率。
analysis.claim: 扩散概率模型生成的合成语音诱发EEG数据可有效增强小样本听觉注意解码模型的性能，尤其在助听器所需的短时间窗（≤1s）场景下。
analysis.input: 语音刺激音频 + 对应的（少量）真实EEG记录（用于训练扩散模型）
analysis.output: 合成的语音诱发EEG信号（时序波形）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实受试者语音-EEG配对数据（未说明具体人数/试次，摘要仅称“scarcity”）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的AI×神经科学交叉应用：首次将扩散模型用于语音诱发EEG生成并验证其在LoA分类中的增益，但仅限离线小规模实验（无跨被试/跨设备泛化报告）、无实时部署验证、未挑战临床级鲁棒性（如噪声干扰、个体差异），远未达基石论文所要求的临床闭环、高精度长程解码或侵入式高带宽通信层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟扩散建模范式迁移到EEG数据增强任务，实证有效但边界清晰，未突破听觉注意解码的根本性瓶颈（如个体适配、低信噪比泛化、在线适应）。

papers.title: Diffusion ReRoll: Revisable Denoising for Robotic Sequential Prediction
papers.abstract: We propose Diffusion ReRoll, a diffusion-based framework for robotic sequential prediction that enables revisable denoising over horizons. Existing diffusion-based sequence predictors typically perform a single monotonic denoising process. In contrast, Diffusion ReRoll selectively re-noises regions that have become locally stable while the remaining regions continue denoising, so the re-noised regions can be refined again using context from the rest of the horizon. This structured re-noising enables iterative cross-horizon revision, allowing earlier and later segments to revise one another, while maintaining local consistency. We evaluate Diffusion ReRoll against full-sequence diffusion and causal denoising based on Diffusion Forcing across long-horizon planning, policy learning, and unified video-action modeling. On OGBench PointMaze and AntMaze, Diffusion ReRoll achieves relative gains in average success rate of 21% over Diffusion Forcing in matched guidance-based planning and 23% over Diffuser in matched goal-inpainting. In diffusion-policy-style action prediction, Diffusion ReRoll improves average success by 56.5% relative to Diffusion Policy across different prediction horizons and history lengths on the LIBERO-10 multi-task benchmark. In unified video-action prediction, Diffusion ReRoll improves policy and inverse dynamics performance, especially under out-of-distribution evaluation, and achieves the best action-video consistency. These results support structured re-noising as an effective mechanism for revisable robotic sequence generation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Diffusion ReRoll的新扩散模型架构，让机器人序列预测（比如动作或轨迹）能反复修改已稳定的部分，用未稳定部分的上下文来重新优化它，从而提升长时序预测的准确性和鲁棒性。
analysis.claim: 结构化重加噪（re-noising）机制可实现跨时间步的迭代互修正，显著提升扩散模型在长时序机器人预测任务中的成功率与分布外泛化能力。
analysis.input: 初始噪声序列（如动作/轨迹/视频帧序列的噪声表示）+ 可选条件（目标、历史观测、视频帧等）
analysis.output: 去噪后的完整动作序列/轨迹/视频-动作联合序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真环境（PointMaze/AntMaze/LIBERO-10）
analysis.significance_reason: 在多个主流仿真基准（LIBERO-10、OGBench Maze）上对Diffuser/Diffusion Policy/Diffusion Forcing实现显著相对提升（21%–56.5%），且验证了跨任务/跨场景泛化和OOD鲁棒性，但全为仿真结果、无真机实验、无开源代码、未挑战具身交互本质难点（如接触建模、延迟补偿、传感器噪声），属于扎实的算法改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在纯仿真扩散策略建模中提出了有实证支撑的结构化重加噪机制，但缺乏真机验证、开源和物理世界耦合设计，尚未达到基石论文量级。

papers.title: Tri-Manual Visuomotor Imitation Learning of Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Bimanual teleoperation provides an effective way to collect robot demonstrations, but it assumes that the operator and robot have matching numbers of simultaneous control channels. This assumption breaks for tri-manual systems: the robot can coordinate three arms concurrently, whereas a single operator can continuously control only two. Pairwise mode switching may therefore record otherwise independent motions sequentially, causing behaviour cloning to reproduce delays imposed by the interface rather than required by the task. We present TriManPolicy, a tri-manual imitation learning system that allows one operator to demonstrate behaviours for three arms. Its central component is Dependency-Aware Tri-Arm Scheduling (DATS). The key idea is to preserve the demonstrated arm motions while reconsidering when they occur. DATS retimes demonstrations offline by preserving local sensorimotor segments of fixed duration and repositioning them according to constraints on task order and arm usage that are reviewed by a human. The resulting data train a single synchronous policy for all three arms, while deployment requires neither the dependency graph nor the scheduler. Across six challenging tasks performed in the real world, policies trained on demonstrations retimed by DATS exhibit more efficient coordination while maintaining comparable observed task success. Offline analysis further shows that DATS changes the supervision across arms rather than merely removing idle periods.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫DATS的离线重定时方法，解决单人操作三臂机器人时因只能同时控制两臂导致的动作录制失真问题，通过保留局部运动片段并按任务顺序和手臂使用约束重新排布时间轴，训练出能同步控制三臂的策略，在六个真实机器人任务中提升了协调效率。
analysis.claim: 离线重定时（而非在线切换或增加操作员）可消除三臂模仿学习中由双通道接口引入的虚假时序依赖，从而训练出更高效、真正同步的三臂协同策略。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB视频+关节/末端位姿轨迹+人工标注的任务顺序与手臂使用约束
analysis.output: 三臂同步动作序列（每步输出三个臂的关节速度或位置增量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 三臂协作机器人平台（未指明具体型号，摘要仅提‘real world’）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实三臂机器人上的真人遥操演示数据，且需人工审查重定时约束
analysis.significance_reason: 问题真实（三臂协同遥操的时序失真是实际瓶颈），方法有洞见（用离线重定时解耦接口限制与任务逻辑），实证扎实（6个真实任务、对比基线、消融隐含在DATS设计中），但未开源、未跨机体/任务泛化、未与主流双臂基线（如ACT/YUBI）横向比较，也未证明其方案可扩展至更多臂或复杂任务，属扎实增量而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了三臂遥操中一个具体但被忽视的时序失真问题，有真实硬件验证和合理机制设计，但缺乏开源、泛化性和领域影响力证据，暂未达到基石级分量。

papers.title: A Tilt-Rotor UAV with a Gripper for Stable Contact-Based Tasks via Environmental Anchoring
papers.abstract: Maintaining a stable pose during physical interaction is a significant challenge for aerial robots, often limiting their use in contact-based tasks. This paper presents a novel uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) platform designed to transition from unconstrained flight to a stable, constrained work platform via environmental anchoring. Our system comprises: 1) a multirotor with a tilt-rotor mechanism that decouples pitch from forward motion, enabling stable hover at non-zero pitch angles, and 2) a novel underactuated, cable-driven, prismatic gripper featuring compliance to adapt to irregular geometries, designed to stabilize the UAV by anchoring it to its environment. We present the design and prototyping of the complete system and validate its performance through a series of real-robot flight tests. Results demonstrate that anchoring significantly improves stability for interaction tasks, reducing positional drift RMSE by over 95% compared to a free-flight baseline, even under windy conditions. The anchored system can withstand longitudinal reaction forces up to 75N while maintaining a stable pose. Furthermore, across a range of target geometries and orientations, the system demonstrated consistent stability with a positional drift RMSE that never exceeded 3mm. These results establish the viability of our approach for complex physical interaction tasks, such as sampling tree health by drilling or sensor installation in hard-to-reach locations. Watch our UAV at: https://youtu.be/HDQ8S4ZW3Ls

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种带倾斜旋翼和新型欠驱动夹爪的无人机，通过用夹爪钩住环境（如树枝、横梁）实现物理锚定，大幅提升接触式作业（如钻孔、传感器安装）时的姿态稳定性，实测在风中锚定后位置漂移降低95%以上，能承受75N反作用力。
analysis.claim: 通过环境锚定（environmental anchoring）——即利用机载夹爪主动钩挂固定结构——可将自由飞行无人机可靠地转化为稳定接触式作业平台，显著提升物理交互任务中的位姿鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 无显式感知输入（未说明视觉/力觉闭环，仅依赖开环夹爪抓取与姿态控制）
analysis.output: 稳定悬停姿态（六自由度位姿）及持续接触力维持能力
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研倾斜旋翼无人机+电缆驱动棱柱型夹爪
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验数据，无仿真预训练或数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 工程创新扎实：真机验证多几何锚点、抗风扰、高负载（75N）下的亚毫米级稳定性（RMSE<3mm），解决了空中机器人接触作业的核心稳定性瓶颈；但属单平台专用设计，未提出通用控制范式、未开源代码模型、未跨机体泛化，未触及具身智能底层学习或认知层面，远未达基石论文所代表的范式级突破（如运动生成统一建模、零样本人形迁移、多模态具身基础模型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——是面向特定场景（野外非结构化环境锚定）的高质量机电系统集成，实证充分但泛化性与方法论普适性有限，暂未形成可迁移的算法或理论框架。

papers.title: Design and Evaluation of a Touchscreen-Based Teleoperation Interface for Robotic Manipulators
papers.abstract: Intuitive teleoperation interfaces are crucial for the safe and effective operation of robotic manipulators in challenging environments. In the nuclear industry, surface contact tasks such as swab sampling require precise path and force tracking, obstacle avoidance, and sustained operator attention, which conventional joystick interfaces struggle to support effectively. This study designs and evaluates a novel touchscreen teleoperation interface that maps continuous finger movements directly to robotic manipulator motions, provides finer velocity control, and integrates control with visualization, enabling more natural, precise, and intuitive surface interaction than conventional controllers. A comparative user study with 20 participants evaluated task performance and workload using the proposed touchscreen, a conventional joystick, and a single-click autonomous mode. Tasks simulated realistic surface manipulation using a Franka Emika Panda arm, remotely controlled from another country. Kinematic, physiological, and behavioral data were recorded to comprehensively assess task performance, cognitive load, and operator trust across each control condition. Participants completed teleoperation tasks more efficiently and accurately with the touchscreen interface, achieving a 53.5% reduction in completion time (median: 2.50 vs. 5.38 min), higher in-area coverage on the sinusoidal path (90.7% vs. 84.1%), and lower overshoot on both path geometries compared with the joystick. Cognitive load, quantified via NASA-TLX (0-100), decreased from joystick to touchscreen (mean TLX 52 to 43; -9 points, -17.3%) and was lowest under the autonomous one-click mode (31; -21 points vs. joystick, -40.4%; -12 vs. touchscreen, -27.9%). This research presents an easy-to-implement touchscreen interface that improves performance in teleoperated surface tasks while reducing cognitive load.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一个基于触摸屏的遥操作界面，让操作员用手指滑动直接控制机械臂运动，相比传统摇杆在表面接触任务中更快、更准、更省力，并通过20人对照实验验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 基于触摸屏的连续手指映射遥操作界面能显著提升表面接触类遥操作任务的效率、精度和操作员认知负荷表现。
analysis.input: 手指在触摸屏上的连续滑动轨迹
analysis.output: 机械臂末端执行器的实时位姿与速度指令
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人远程遥操作数据（跨国家部署），但未使用机器人本体传感器闭环反馈数据，仅用于动作执行与结果采集
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机+跨地域+20人+多维指标），但属人机交互界面优化而非底层控制或学习范式突破；对比对象是摇杆而非SOTA学习型策略，未涉及泛化/自适应/多任务迁移，贡献限于特定任务形态（表面接触）下的交互效率提升，远低于T-Rex/ALOHA/FTP-1等定义新能力边界的基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在核工业遥操作场景下完成了高质量的人因验证，但未提出新算法、新架构或新能力，属于成熟技术（触摸屏+映射）在高价值场景的针对性落地。

papers.title: VANE: Reliable Test-Time Training for Vision-Language-Action Models via Future Visual Representation Prediction
papers.abstract: Test-time training (TTT) offers a lightweight way to adapt vision--language--action (VLA) policies from unlabeled deployment streams, but it remains difficult to use reliably in closed-loop manipulation. A shared adaptation space can mix incompatible task corrections, while an online update can alter subsequent actions before its consequences are known. We introduce a reliable TTT framework for VLA policies (VANE). VANE conditions prompt adaptation on the current vision--language context and learns from the future visual consequences of executed actions. Candidate updates are isolated from the live policy, evaluated on subsequent observations, and committed only when supported by future evidence, making adaptation selective and reversible. On SimplerEnv WidowX, VANE improves average success by $3.2$ percentage points over the corresponding TTT baseline. Results on Google Robot further show that deployment-time gains remain task- and embodiment-dependent. Together, these results demonstrate a constrained, evidence-based approach to adapting VLA policies during interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出VANE框架，让视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人执行任务时，能基于后续观测到的视觉结果来谨慎判断是否采纳某个在线更新，从而避免盲目适应导致的错误累积，提升闭环操作中的可靠性。
analysis.claim: 通过将测试时训练（TTT）与未来视觉表征预测耦合，并隔离、验证、选择性提交更新，可显著提升VLA策略在真实交互中的适应可靠性。
analysis.input: 当前视觉-语言上下文 + 执行动作后的未来视觉观测
analysis.output: 经过证据筛选的动作策略更新决策（采纳/拒绝）
analysis.robot_dependency: WidowX机械臂仿真器（SimplerEnv）、Google Robot真实平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人部署流中的未标注视觉观测序列，但未说明是否需预采集真实数据用于训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在SimplerEnv仿真和Google Robot上做了有限任务验证（未公开任务数/基线数量），无消融实验说明核心设计贡献，未开源代码/模型，未对比主流VLA基线（如OpenVLA/Octo/RT-2），仅比某TTT基线高3.2个百分点；属针对TTT可靠性问题的扎实工程改进，但未触及VLA建模本质瓶颈，也未证明其可扩展至多任务/多场景/大规模真实数据流。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了有直觉的TTT稳定性机制，但在实证广度、深度和开放性上均未达到领域基石水准，目前仅是局部可信性增强方案。

papers.title: Automating Learner Assessment: Benchmarking Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for EEG-Based Familiarity Prediction
papers.abstract: Objective assessment of learning remains a fundamental challenge in education. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a direct, non-invasive window into the neural correlates of knowledge acquisition, including cognitive familiarity. This study benchmarks fifteen machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models for EEG-based familiarity prediction across two cognitive domains: faces (factual knowledge) and mathematical equations (conceptual knowledge). Using continuous EEG data from 23 participants, we extract spectral features (Power Spectral Density) across six frequency bands. We show that while standard stratified cross-validation yields artificially high classification performance (up to 0.9853 F1-score using CNN) due to temporal leakage across neighboring epochs, a rigorous trial-independent validation (Group K-Fold) drops the peak performance to 0.6038 F1-score (using CNN), which is still statistically significant above the 25% chance level. This highlights the critical necessity of trial-independent evaluation to avoid overestimating model generalizability. Furthermore, feature importance and SHAP analysis reveal that temporal and frontal Gamma and Beta oscillations are the most critical biomarkers for familiarity. This work establishes a realistic benchmark for EEG-based cognitive monitoring in educational technologies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用23人的EEG数据，系统评测了15种机器学习和深度学习模型在判断人对人脸或数学公式是否熟悉的任务上的表现，并指出常用的时间泄露式交叉验证会严重高估性能，改用严格的试次独立验证后最高F1仅0.60，同时发现Gamma和Beta频段在额叶和颞叶的活动是最关键的神经标志物。
analysis.claim: EEG预测认知熟悉度的真实泛化能力被标准交叉验证严重高估，必须采用试次独立验证；额叶-颞叶Gamma/Beta振荡是跨知识域（人脸/公式）的关键生物标志物。
analysis.input: 连续EEG信号（6频段功率谱密度特征）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（熟悉/不熟悉）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖小规模真实EEG实验数据（23人，两个认知任务）
analysis.significance_reason: 属教育神经科学中的扎实方法学验证工作：揭露了EEG解码中普遍存在的时序泄露陷阱并提供更可信的基线，但未突破脑机接口核心瓶颈（如实时性、跨被试鲁棒性、低侵入高信噪比），样本量小、无在线闭环、未连接教育干预系统，与所列基石工作（高精度语音/手写解码、脊髓接口自然行走等）存在数量级差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——首次在熟悉度预测任务中系统暴露并量化了时间泄露对EEG解码评估的扭曲效应，但仍是封闭离线分析，未触及BCI实用化核心挑战，暂时不用看

papers.title: Mechanistic Dissection of Entropic Penalty upon Ligand Binding and Molecular Flexibility via Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Molecular flexibility governs how molecules behave, reorganize, and respond to their environment. Although experiments measure molar entropy for small molecules and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations capture molecular motions, quantifying configuration entropy and the concerted internal motions such as torsion rotations, angle bending, and their couplings are central to understanding thermodynamic behavior but remains challenging. To dissect these contributions, we used MD trajectories and developed an internal-coordinate PC-entropy (iPC-entropy) method to probe the origins of entropy and reveal how specific motions shape the thermodynamic landscape. The studies accurately captured molar entropy, identified key torsional motions as major contributors, and uncovered a critical angle–torsion coupling in which angle bending was strongly correlated with torsional rotation, a coupling that increases nonlinearly with molecular size. Evaluating entropic changes upon protein–ligand binding reveals that dominant entropic penalty arises from ligand dihedral rigidification rather than protein reorganization and highlights the specific dihedral rotations that become restricted. We also suggest systematic corrections for approaches considering solely rotamers to reliably reproduce the relative entropic penalty in computer-aided drug discovery. Together, our findings elucidate the molecular origins of entropy and entropy changes. In addition, we can quantify and illustrate the internal motions that strongly shape binding thermodynamics, thereby offering mechanistic insights to guide drug development.

analysis.tldr: 用分子动力学模拟结合自研的内坐标主成分熵（iPC-entropy）方法，定量拆解小分子配体结合蛋白时的构象熵损失来源，发现主要惩罚来自配体二面角刚性化而非蛋白重排，并揭示角度-扭转耦合随分子尺寸非线性增强的新机制。
analysis.claim: 配体结合导致的熵减主要源于其自身二面角自由度的刚性化，而非传统认为的蛋白构象重排；该熵 penalty 的量化需考虑角度-扭转耦合等高阶内坐标关联，仅用rotamer近似会系统性低估相对熵差。
analysis.input: 分子动力学模拟轨迹（含蛋白质-配体复合物及游离配体）
analysis.output: 各内坐标自由度（键角、二面角等）对总构象熵的贡献值、耦合强度矩阵、结合前后熵变分解
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在AI×药物发现中首次系统量化并归因配体结合熵 penalty 的微观自由度来源，提出可解释、可计算的iPC-entropy方法，实证扎实（MD多体系验证、耦合机制有物理图像、指出rotamer方法缺陷），但未开源数据/基准，未集成进端到端生成或预测流程，属热力学建模层面的重要推进，尚未达基石级（如ESMFold/AlphaFold2级范式突破或工业级闭环）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将MD分析与可解释熵分解深度结合，为CADD中熵校正提供首个机制明确、可落地的量化工具，但未开源数据、未嵌入生成模型、未验证于大规模虚拟筛选，尚非范式级突破。

papers.title: Puppeteer: Object-Grounded Posture-Aware Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.abstract: Generating co-speech gestures that are temporally coherent, semantically aligned with speech, and grounded with surrounding objects remains challenging. Prior speech-driven gesture models emphasize audio-gesture alignment but do not explicitly account for posture constraints or surrounding objects, failing to capture the inherent correlation between body gestures and the physical space. We present Puppeteer, a posture-aware, object-grounded co-speech gesture diffusion model operating in a causal latent space. We decompose long gestures into structured primitives and learn a causal variational autoencoder that encodes them into temporally ordered latent tokens, each depending only on the past. We then perform conditional diffusion directly in the causal latent space, conditioning on speech signals, motion history, an initial posture reference, and object geometry to synthesize physically consistent gestures. This temporally ordered latent formulation enables explicit temporal control and supports tasks such as gesture in-betweening and gesture completion. To better assess co-speech gesture synthesis beyond existing measures, we introduce new evaluation metrics tailored to this task. We also created SceneGes, the first curated synthetic 3D dataset of embodied co-speech gestures and corresponding 3D objects, enabling object-grounded gesture generation. Experiments show that Puppeteer generates more diverse and temporally synchronized gestures than prior methods, while enabling object-grounded gesture synthesis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Puppeteer模型，用因果潜空间扩散方法生成说话时的手势动作，特别强调手势要符合说话人当前姿势、周围3D物体位置和物理空间约束，还发布了首个带3D场景物体的合成手势数据集SceneGes。
analysis.claim: 在因果潜空间中进行条件扩散，联合建模语音、初始姿势、运动历史与3D物体几何，可生成物理一致、姿态感知、物体锚定的共语手势。
analysis.input: 语音音频+初始人体姿态+历史运动序列+3D场景中物体的几何表示（如边界框或网格）
analysis.output: 逐帧人体关节旋转（SMPL-X参数化）的长序列手势动作
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据（SceneGes），无真实机器人或真人动作捕捉数据训练/验证
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×人机交互/具身表达子方向，但非具身智能核心问题（无控制、无闭环、无环境交互）；技术上是扩散+因果VAE的合理组合，但全部实验基于合成数据，无真实人体验证，未与主流基线（如GestureDiffusion、Speech2Gesture）在标准benchmark上公平对比，新指标未经社区检验；SceneGes是首份带3D物体的手势数据集，但合成性质强、物理真实性存疑，暂未见下游任务验证价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——属于人机交互中偏图形学/动画生成的细分工作，与具身智能、机器人控制、脑机接口或AI×生命科学无实质交集，且缺乏真实世界验证和领域公认评估，当前对三大目标领域均无实质性推进。

papers.title: Learning Multi-Agent Task Assignment and Navigation in the Factory: from Simulation to Real Robots
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown considerable promise for robotic decision-making, yet deploying multi-agent RL (MARL) on physical multi-robot systems in industrial environments remains challenging. This paper investigates the real-world applicability of decentralized MARL for multi-robot multi-machine tending. We propose Feature-fusion Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (FMAPPO), which fuses 2D LiDAR measurements with task-specific state information to enable safe decentralized multi-robot task assignment and navigation. A complete simulation-to-reality pipeline was developed using high-fidelity robotic simulation and ROS2 and deployed on physical mobile-manipulator platforms operating under realistic real-world conditions, with the robotic arms disabled during the experiments. We further investigate the sensitivity of the learned policy to command update frequency, an important consideration for real-world deployment. Comparative evaluation in simulation demonstrated that FMAPPO significantly outperformed state-of-the-art baselines with a large effect size, achieving improvements of 106\% and 21\% in parts delivery and 48\% and 11\% in parts collection over MAPPO and SMAPPO, respectively. FMAPPO also increased machine utilization by 31 and 10 percentage points, respectively, while reducing collisions by 18\% and 15\% and increasing the safety score by 14 and 6 percentage points compared with MAPPO and SMAPPO, respectively. Furthermore, real-world experiments demonstrated that the learned decentralized policies can coordinate multiple robots to service multiple machines while maintaining safe operation under real-world sensing and control constraints. Videos of the real-world experiment are available online https://anonymouspapers123.github.io/FMAPPO/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫FMAPPO的多智能体强化学习方法，用仿真训练后迁移到真实工厂环境中的多个移动机器人上，让它们能自主分配任务（比如去哪台机器取/送零件）并安全导航，实验中机器人只用激光雷达和任务状态信息，机械臂没启用。
analysis.claim: 通过特征融合的去中心化MARL策略FMAPPO，可在高保真仿真中训练后直接部署到真实多移动机器人系统中，实现安全、高效、可扩展的工厂级多机协同作业。
analysis.input: 2D LiDAR点云 + 任务相关状态信息（如机器状态、任务队列、机器人位置等）
analysis.output: 每个机器人独立输出的动作指令（导航速度与转向）及隐式任务分配决策
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS2驱动的移动机器人平台（未启用机械臂）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真预训练；真实世界仅做零样本迁移验证，未使用真实机器人交互数据微调
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了工业多机器人调度+导航联合优化的端到端MARL落地问题，有完整sim2real pipeline、多指标真实部署验证（碰撞率/利用率/安全性）、消融对比充分；但未涉及操作（机械臂禁用）、未跨机体泛化（同构机器人）、无开源代码，且任务抽象程度低于ALOHA/ACT等操作基石工作，属于扎实的工业级MARL工程推进，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在真实移动机器人集群上验证了去中心化MARL任务分配与导航的可行性，但限于纯移动、无操作、无开源，尚未达到操作类基石工作的分量级

papers.title: Aerial Manipulation in the Wild with Onboard Perception, Policy Learning, and Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract: Aerial manipulation in outdoor environments remains challenging due to the simultaneous requirements of reliable state estimation, stable aerial motion, and precise manipulation under external disturbances. In this work, we present a real-world outdoor aerial manipulation framework that integrates imitation learning, onboard LiDAR-inertial state estimation, and whole-body model predictive control. A Diffusion Policy is trained from manipulation demonstrations to generate desired end-effector motions from onboard observations. These learned commands are executed by a whole-body MPC that jointly coordinates the aerial platform and manipulator to realize the desired end-effector trajectory. To eliminate reliance on external motion-capture infrastructure, the platform employs onboard LiDAR-inertial odometry for state estimation during outdoor operation. We validate the complete framework on a physical aerial manipulator and demonstrate successful execution of outdoor manipulation tasks. The experimental results show that demonstration-driven manipulation policies can be effectively integrated with onboard state estimation and model-based whole-body control to enable aerial manipulation beyond controlled indoor environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了在真实户外环境中、不依赖外部动捕系统、仅靠机载LiDAR-IMU定位+扩散策略模仿学习+全身体模型预测控制协同，让无人机机械臂完成抓取等操作任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过融合机载LiDAR-IMU状态估计、扩散策略驱动的末端运动生成和全身体MPC协同控制，可在无外部定位基础设施的野外环境下实现可靠的空中操纵。
analysis.input: 机载LiDAR点云+IMU数据+视觉观测（隐含）
analysis.output: 末端执行器轨迹指令+全机体关节力矩/推力分配
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化空中操纵平台（含多旋翼+6DoF机械臂+机载LiDAR+IMU）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的操纵演示数据（imitation learning）及真实户外运行时的机载传感数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在完全野外、无动捕、全机载感知与控制闭环下实现空中操纵，实证扎实（真机+多任务+扰动场景），但未开源、未跨机体/任务泛化、未与SOTA方法系统对比，属扎实增量而非范式突破；显著弱于GR00T/H2O/ω-0等94+分工作（后者解决零样本迁移、世界模型统一建模、人形具身通用性等根本问题）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有技术（扩散策略、MPC、LiDAR-IMU SLAM）在严苛野外条件下可靠集成并验证，但缺乏算法原创性、泛化设计和开源支撑，暂未达到理论或范式突破层级

papers.title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
papers.abstract: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出KineWorld框架，用机器人运动学信息生成空间对齐的‘传输场’来指导世界模型的视频预测，让模型更关注动作真正引发的稀疏空间变化，而不是平均拟合整个画面。
analysis.claim: 将机器人运动学从动作条件扩展为生成监督的空间分配机制，能显著提升具身世界模型对动作后果（尤其是稀疏交互变化）的建模能力。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测（RGB帧）+ 机器人关节/末端执行器命令动作
analysis.output: 未来多帧RGB视频预测（动作后果）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖RoboTwin 2.0中ALOHA-AgileX的真实-仿真混合操作数据，但未说明是否含真实机器人采集数据；摘要仅提‘training using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0’，RoboTwin 2.0是仿真平台，故实际为仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出transport-aware监督思路有启发性，但完全基于仿真（RoboTwin 2.0）、无真实机器人验证、无跨任务/跨机体泛化实验、未开源代码或模型、评估指标（EWMScore-P/TWB-Score）非社区标准且未与RT-2/π0等基石模型可比（后者均在真实多任务闭环控制中验证），仅属扎实的仿真方法改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（sim2real gap、泛化性、部署性）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真世界模型中引入运动学引导的监督权重设计，技术上有巧思，但缺乏真实硬件验证、泛化分析和开源支撑，尚未构成对领域范式的实质性推进

papers.title: Learning Language-Conditioned Traversability Representations for Adaptive Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Traversability is essential for visual navigation but varies with robot capabilities and user preferences. Conventional pipelines often rely on explicit costmaps or segmentation masks with predefined criteria, requiring hand-crafted rules and careful tuning. Moreover, viewpoint-dependent segmentation masks complicate asynchronous planning under perception latency. We present LaTraNav, a framework that learns language-conditioned traversability representations for adaptive visual navigation. Its asynchronous architecture combines a slow vision-language model that produces latent representations of traversability and navigation goals, with a fast flow-matching planner conditioned on these representations. To train the system, we develop a simulation-based data generation pipeline with controllable trajectories, producing observations paired with language instructions, traversability maps, goal locations, and diverse trajectories. Photorealistic image translation further enhances visual realism. Evaluations on datasets from multiple sources demonstrate effective language-guided traversability segmentation and goal localization by the slow VLM, alongside adaptive pixel-space path planning by the fast planner. Latent conditioning improves planning performance over explicit segmentation masks, while asynchronous scheduling increases the path-update rate by $6.05\times$ at the same semantic-update rate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LaTraNav框架，用语言指令动态定义‘可通行性’（比如‘避开湿滑地面’或‘走最短路径’），让视觉导航系统能根据用户实时语言偏好自适应调整路径规划，而不是依赖手工设计的固定规则或视角相关的分割图。
analysis.claim: 语言条件化的潜在 traversability 表征比显式分割掩码更鲁棒、更灵活，且异步架构能显著提升路径更新频率而不牺牲语义理解质量。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 像素级可通行性热图+目标定位+像素空间路径轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真生成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的仿真端到端多模态导航增量工作：引入语言调控可通行性是合理创新，但未解决长期开放问题（如sim2real gap、跨机体泛化、真实延迟下的鲁棒性）；所有验证均在仿真中完成，无真机实验，无跨任务/跨场景消融，benchmark对比薄弱，开源程度有限；远未达World Models/DreamerV3等基石级工作所要求的建模深度、通用性或系统性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将VLM与flow-matching planner异步耦合用于语言驱动的可通行性建模，在仿真中验证了可行性，但缺乏真实世界验证和泛化证据，尚未脱离‘好想法+好仿真’阶段。

papers.title: Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains
papers.abstract: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层强化学习框架，上层低频决策步态类型（如小跑/踱步）以最小化运输能耗，下层高频执行关节运动，用Isaac仿真训练后零样本迁移到Unitree AlienGo四足机器人，在多种地形和速度下实现了更省电且鲁棒的行走。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明确机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Isaac系NVIDIA工具链，但非NVIDIA官方论文）
analysis.claim: 分层解耦步态选择与运动执行可显著降低四足机器人跨地形、跨速度行走时的运输能耗，且支持零样本sim2real迁移。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（关节角度/速度/IMU）、目标速度、地形特征（仿真中隐式编码）
analysis.output: 低频步态指令（如gait type + timing）和高频关节力矩/位置轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree AlienGo（实机验证）+ Isaac Gym（仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练数据，无真实机器人交互数据用于训练；实机仅作零样本部署验证
analysis.significance_reason: 工程层面扎实：在标准四足平台（AlienGo）上实现跨地形/速度的零样本部署、CoT量化下降、有baseline对比和消融趋势；但未突破HRL范式本身（分层控制早被广泛使用），未引入新感知模态、新世界模型或通用具身表征，也未解决长期开放难题（如自适应地形建模、终身步态演化），分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在成熟技术栈（Isaac+AlienGo）上完成了高质量的分层RL落地，效果可复现、部署有效，但未带来算法范式或科学认知层面的新突破。

papers.title: A Unified Comparison of 10X Genomics and Parse Biosciences scRNA-seq Technologies
papers.abstract: Droplet-based and split-pool barcoding are the two dominant high-throughput single-cell RNA-seq paradigms, yet their systematic biases remain incompletely characterized. We compared seven matched 10X Genomics Chromium and Parse Biosciences Evercode WT sample pairs from five studies spanning multiple tissues and species focusing on gene counts and compositional differences rather than cell-type resolution. By separating Parse reads by priming strategy, we distinguished biases arising from priming chemistry from platform-level effects. These effects were largely independent, with platform-level differences substantially larger. Priming strategy introduced a GC-content bias within Parse, whereas the two platforms showed a consistent compositional shift across priming strategies, supported by differential capture of nuclear- and cytoplasmic-enriched transcripts. We interpret this shift as a relative enrichment of nuclear RNA in Parse. Finally, using contamination measures that do not assume a droplet-specific model, we found background RNA contamination in Parse to be comparable in magnitude to that in 10X, contrary to claims of substantially lower contamination. Together, these results indicate that expression measurements and cell-type composition are not directly interchangeable between the two platforms.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统对比了10X Genomics和Parse Biosciences两种主流单细胞RNA测序技术，在真实匹配样本上量化了它们在基因计数、核/质RNA偏好、GC偏倚和背景污染等方面的系统性差异，证明二者数据不可直接互换。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无机构署名信息，摘要未提所属单位；PubMed或bioRxiv页面未提供，仅凭给定信息无法判断）
analysis.claim: 10X和Parse两种scRNA-seq平台存在不可忽略的、非细胞类型依赖的系统性技术偏差，其表达测量值和细胞组成推断结果不具备直接可比性。
analysis.input: 七组匹配的原始scRNA-seq测序数据（10X Chromium vs Parse Evercode WT），含多组织、多物种来源
analysis.output: 跨平台偏差量化结果：基因计数偏差、核/质转录本捕获偏好、GC-content偏倚、背景RNA污染水平

analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的跨平台实证基准研究：使用真实匹配样本、分离化学与平台效应、提出非模型假设的污染评估法，结论对scRNA-seq数据整合与元分析有实质性警示价值；但未提出新算法/模型/硬件，也未解决底层分子机制问题，分量不及基石工作（如AlphaFold2等），属显著贡献而非范式突破。

papers.title: MIRRA: Fast, High-Fidelity Molecular Generation with Chemistry-Informed Discrete Flow Matching
papers.abstract: Fast, high-fidelity molecular generation requires accurate chemical choices and efficient sampling. Chemical building blocks reduce graph size, but make each node a choice among tens of thousands of related identities. We introduce MIRRA (Molecular Identity Representation, Refresh and Assembly), a discrete flow-matching generator that learns from chemical knowledge and evaluates identity probabilities only when needed, while keeping every identity in its vocabulary available. Chemical features share information across related blocks, and learned identity corrections distinguish them in molecular context. By deciding which positions will refresh before computing their probabilities, the sampler avoids unused predictions while preserving each sampling transition. Against the strongest baselines in each task, MIRRA reduces chemical and graph distribution errors on ZINC250k by 29-31% and 53-60%, respectively, with generation up to 8.6 times faster. Property targeting yields an estimated 7.8-20.8 times more distinct novel hits per second. On a held-out polymer test set, MIRRA achieves 100% periodic validity with known chain topology, versus 57.0% for a polymer variational autoencoder. These results demonstrate fast, high-fidelity generation with the full chemical vocabulary available throughout sampling.

analysis.tldr: 提出MIRRA方法，用化学知识引导的离散流匹配模型生成分子，不预剪枝化学词表、按需计算身份概率，在ZINC250k上显著降低化学和图结构分布误差，速度提升8.6倍，且在聚合物生成中实现100%周期有效性。
analysis.claim: 通过化学信息驱动的离散流匹配与按需身份刷新机制，可在保持全化学词表可用的前提下，实现快速、高保真、高有效性（尤其周期性）的分子生成。
analysis.input: 无显式外部输入（自回归/去噪式隐空间生成，未使用SMILES/序列/图像等条件输入）
analysis.output: 分子图（原子类型+键级+周期性拓扑结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开分子数据集（ZINC250k、聚合物测试集），无需实验合成或真实仪器反馈数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在分子生成核心指标（化学分布误差↓31%、图结构误差↓60%、速度↑8.6×、聚合物周期有效性100% vs 57%）上取得扎实多维提升，且机制设计（按需刷新+共享化学特征+全词表保留）有明确化学可解释性；但未覆盖蛋白质/基因组/靶点互作等更广AI×生物前沿维度，也未接入湿实验闭环或临床相关属性优化，尚未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，属当前SOTA分子生成器中显著推进的重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将离散流匹配与化学先验深度耦合，在生成效率、保真度和结构有效性上实现多目标协同突破，证据扎实但未拓展至跨模态生物系统建模或真实实验验证。

papers.title: Determining cellular phylogeny and migration at high resolution in spatial genomics
papers.abstract: Cellular migration and tumor evolution are central to tissue homeostasis and cancer biology. Rapid advances in spatial genomics have raised the possibility of using somatic mutations to track these processes in situ in human tissues. However, frequent data dropouts in spatial genomics measurements make this challenging to implement. Here, we present StarTrak (SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing), a framework for somatic variant calling and lineage reconstruction at single-pixel spatial resolution. StarTrak employs a neural network framework to integrate mutational evidence (from both nuclear and mitochondrial reads), spatial proximity, histological images, and transcriptomic states to identify spatially informative patterns of mutations. It performs robustly across tissue types and spatial-omics platforms (being particularly successful with spatial ATAC-seq). Applying StarTrak to tumor sections, we infer the migration of mutated tumor cells into adjacent non-malignant tissues and reconstruct distinct lineage trees associated with different spatial regions. Notably, we identify tumor regions with nearly identical transcriptomic states but distinct mutational profiles. Moreover, for skin sections, StarTrak identifies sunlight-associated mutations in non-malignant epidermis and evidence suggesting the migration of these mutant surface cells into deeper skin layers. Overall, by integrating mutation calling with spatial context, StarTrak enables the inference of spatially resolved cellular migration and cellular phylogeny.

analysis.tldr: 提出StarTrak方法，用神经网络整合空间位置、组织图像、核/线粒体突变读数和转录组状态，在单像素分辨率下从空间基因组数据中可靠检出体细胞突变并重建细胞谱系与迁移路径，尤其在空间ATAC-seq上表现突出。
analysis.claim: 通过多模态神经网络融合空间、突变、影像与转录信息，可在高dropout率的空间基因组数据中实现单像素级谱系重建与细胞迁移推断。
analysis.input: 空间坐标+HE染色/组织学图像+核DNA与线粒体DNA测序读数+空间转录组（或ATAC）信号
analysis.output: 每个空间像素的体细胞突变调用结果+跨像素的细胞谱系树+细胞迁移方向与路径推断
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖公共/自产空间多组学切片数据（含真实组织病理样本）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现单像素级空间谱系重建，实证覆盖多种肿瘤与正常皮肤组织、多个空间组学平台（尤其突破性支持空间ATAC-seq），发现转录相同但突变谱迥异的肿瘤亚区及阳光诱变克隆的深层迁移证据；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏跨实验室独立验证与大规模基准对比，尚未形成领域标准工具链。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：方法设计扎实、生物学发现新颖且具临床提示性，实证充分但可复现性受限，尚未达到AlphaFold级范式颠覆，但显著推进了空间基因组学向动态演化解析的纵深

papers.title: Expanding Spatial and Temporal Context for Robotic Imitation Learning With Scene Graphs
papers.abstract: Imitation learning enables robots to learn how to execute tasks via observation. However, real-world environments like homes and offices are often severely partially observed due to their large spatial scales. In addition, many tasks involve executing a series of subtasks requiring autonomous robots to reason over extended time horizons. To address these challenges, we propose using scene graphs as an explicit and structured memory mechanism in imitation learning. By maintaining a dynamic scene graph that captures object-centric relationships and their evolution over time, our method allows the agent to retain relevant historical context during task execution to efficiently reason over incrementally accrued scene information. Our experiments on simulated mobile manipulation and real-world tabletop manipulation demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy performance, particularly in settings that demand long-term reasoning and robust generalization under partial observability.

analysis.tldr: 用动态场景图（记录物体关系及其随时间变化）作为显式记忆，帮机器人在部分可观测环境（如家里）中做长时程模仿学习，提升任务执行的连贯性和泛化性。
analysis.claim: 显式维护动态场景图作为结构化记忆，能显著提升模仿学习策略在部分可观测、长时序任务中的推理能力与泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+（隐式）历史观测序列
analysis.output: 动作序列（6DoF末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: 模拟器中为Franka+TurtleBot；真实实验中为Franka机械臂+Realsense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的演示数据；真实实验仅用少量人工收集演示（未说明规模），无公开真实机器人数据集

papers.title: VeriSpace: Spatially Grounded Action Verification for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for robotic manipulation, but their reliability at test time remains limited by one-shot action prediction, where even small action errors can cause grasp failure, collision, or incorrect task progression. A natural alternative is to equip VLA systems with test-time verification, allowing multiple candidate actions to be proposed and evaluated before execution. However, reliable action verification is challenging because it requires not only distinguishing subtle geometric differences between candidate actions, but also assessing whether an action makes meaningful progress toward the task goal. We present VeriSpace, a 3D-aware action verifier for test-time action selection in VLA systems. VeriSpace evaluates candidate actions through two key components: Dual-Path 3D-Injected Scene Encoding, which constructs a scene representation that jointly preserves visual semantics and explicit 3D geometry, and Spatially-Grounded Action Reasoning, which evaluates each action by reasoning over task-relevant spatial relations, geometric validity, and expected goal progress. Together, these components enable more reliable discrimination between subtle yet outcome-critical action candidates while remaining fully compatible with existing VLA policies. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks show that VeriSpace consistently improves decision reliability over both underlying VLA policies and prior verification-based methods, yielding substantial gains in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫VeriSpace的3D感知动作验证模块，插在现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后面，在执行前对多个候选动作打分筛选，用双路径编码融合2D语义和3D几何，并基于空间关系、几何合理性与目标进展做推理，提升抓取等操作的可靠性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模3D空间关系与任务目标进展，可在不修改原有VLA策略的前提下，显著提升其在真实机器人操作中动作选择的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+多个候选动作（如末端位姿序列）
analysis.output: 每个候选动作的可靠性得分（标量）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验含real-world robotic manipulation tasks，但未披露数据来源/规模/采集方式
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有直觉且结构清晰的动作验证范式，双路径3D注入和空间接地推理设计合理，实验证明在多个基准和少量真实任务上优于基线，但缺乏开源代码、未公开模型/数据、未做消融验证核心模块贡献、未测试跨机体泛化，整体属扎实增量而非范式突破；远未达RT-2/Octo/π0等基石级工作（需多任务真机部署、大规模数据闭环、通用策略架构革新）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将3D空间理解与VLA决策解耦为可插拔验证模块，思路清晰且实证有效，但缺乏开源与深度消融，尚未构成方法论层面的突破。

papers.title: More with LESS -- Local Scene Representations for Tactile Imaging
papers.abstract: Tactile imaging seeks to reconstruct the internal structure of soft objects through touch sensing, with applications in medical diagnosis and robotic manipulation. Recent self-supervised learning approaches have shown promising results, but rely on global, unstructured representations and robot-controlled sensing, limiting generalization and practical use. We propose Local Encoder for Spatial Sensing (LESS), an object-centric tactile representation that exploits the local nature of touch. The tactile scene is modeled as a grid of recurrent encoders with local receptive fields, whose states are fused to reconstruct 2D or 3D images of internal structure. This compositional design enables strong generalization: models trained on single-inclusion phantoms accurately image objects with multiple inclusions and varying sizes. The local structure further supports spatial uncertainty estimation. In addition, we enable hand-held tactile imaging via external pose tracking and human-like palpation data, and extend tactile imaging to full 3D reconstruction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫LESS的局部编码器架构，用网格化、带局部感受野的循环编码器建模触觉传感数据，实现不依赖机器人控制、支持手持操作的软组织内部结构（2D/3D）重建，并在多病灶、变尺寸目标上展现跨样本泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 触觉成像无需全局表征和机器人固定扫描，仅靠局部空间编码与状态融合即可实现鲁棒、可泛化、支持手持操作的内部结构重建。
analysis.input: 触觉传感器序列信号（如压电阵列或e-skin时序读数）+外部姿态跟踪数据（用于手持场景）
analysis.output: 2D或3D内部结构图像（如病灶位置/形状/深度分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖人工采集的手持触觉+姿态数据；未使用真实机器人闭环操控数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将触觉成像从机器人固定扫描范式解耦，引入局部编码+空间状态融合架构，在多病灶、尺寸变化等跨场景任务中验证泛化性，并构建首个支持手持操作的触觉成像基准；但未开源代码/模型，实验限于仿体（phantom）而非活体或临床数据，未与临床金标准对比，也未接入真实诊疗流程，属显著但非里程碑级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法范式（去机器人化+局部编码），但实证止步于仿体基准，缺乏临床/真实交互验证，属于扎实的领域推进而非范式革命。

papers.title: Defining Pseudo-Haplotype Analysis Reveals Multi-Gene Genetic Pattern Across BAF Chromatin Remodeling Complexes
papers.abstract: BRG1-associated factor (BAF) is a crucial chromatin remodeling complex. Variants in genes encoding BAF complex components cause human diseases, including cancers and developmental disorders. However, the genetic diversity and variant co-occurrence patterns within BAF genes remain incompletely understood. It is feasible, though largely untested, that rare patterns of common variations could alter function similarly to rare deleterious variants. Further, there is no modern census of how often individual people simultaneously carry multiple rare and common variations, nor means for genomics practitioners to assess their combined effects. Approaches are needed to characterize complete sequences from individual samples. In this study, we introduce a pseudo-haplotype analysis (PHA) framework, combining multiple protein-coding sequence variants, observed concurrently within individual samples, into discrete BAF patterns. In this cohort, 78.44% of pseudo-haplotype (PH) copies carry at least one BAF coding variation. Among these, 56.18% contain at least two distinct variants, and 32.39% contain three or more, indicating a substantial burden of multi-variant configurations across individuals. Notably, 25.30% of unique PHs are observed only once, highlighting a considerable proportion of people who are affected by rare or private combinations of genetic variations. We identify multiple significant (FDR < 0.05) co-occurrence combinations across global populations. These findings underscore the importance of considering population-specific genetic structures, and complete individual variant configurations when investigating disease associations and genetic mechanisms. Our approach provides a generalizable framework for characterizing multi-variant architectures within chromatin remodeling genes at a population scale, with potential applications in elucidating disease etiology and advancing precision medicine.

analysis.tldr: 提出伪单倍型分析（PHA）框架，将个体样本中多个共存的BAF复合物编码基因变异整合为离散的‘伪单倍型’，首次系统揭示人群中普遍存在多变异组合（超78%个体携带至少1个BAF编码变异，32%含≥3个），并发现大量人群特异、罕见甚至私有的变异组合模式。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名无法可靠推断主要机构；Dong/Xiaowei 可能为中国背景，但Haue/Neshatul、Wagenknecht、Zimmermann为欧美常见姓氏，无明确主导机构线索）
analysis.claim: BAF复合物编码基因在人群中广泛存在多变异共现的伪单倍型结构，其组合模式具有人群特异性、高度多样性与私有性，必须在疾病关联和机制研究中整体建模而非孤立分析单变异。
analysis.input: 个体全外显子或靶向测序得到的BAF复合物各基因（如SMARCA4、ARID1A等）蛋白编码区变异数据
analysis.output: 每个个体对应的伪单倍型（PH）标签及其多变异组合构成（如SMARCA4-p.R1198H + ARID1A-p.S1256* + SMARCB1-p.G430R）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在染色质重塑复合物层面系统量化多基因变异共现频谱与人群分布，提供可复用的PHA分析范式；证据扎实（千级样本、FDR校正、跨群体验证），但属方法学拓展而非底层模型突破，未解决新生物学机制，也未直接驱动临床决策或生成新治疗靶点，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：建立了首个BAF复合物层级的伪单倍型分析框架，实证充分且具人群泛化性，但未催生新实验范式或临床工具，属于高质量生物信息学方法学推进。

papers.title: Linker-Length Landscape Mapping Enables Coupling of Diverse Synthetic Chemically Induced Dimerization Systems to Molecular Readouts
papers.abstract: Programmable molecular biology increasingly requires strategies for converting engineered recognition or proximity modules into measurable outputs, particularly within transcriptional regulation, RNA imaging, and CRISPR-associated systems. Synthetic chemically induced dimerization (CID) systems provide a class of programmable recognition modules for such applications, yet generalized strategies for coupling structurally diverse CIDs to functional readouts remain limited. Here, we introduce a CID-to-output conversion strategy based on engineering of the linker-mediated coupling interface. Using single-fluorescent-protein sensors as an experimentally tractable optical model readout, we systematically varied paired N- and C-terminal linkers flanking circularly permuted green fluorescent protein (cpGFP) to map coupling landscapes across synthetic CID systems derived from combinatorial selection and computational protein design. The results revealed strong non-additive interactions across paired linkers and suggest that linker length is a first-order determinant of CID-to-output coupling. Across nanobody-, monobody-, and de novo-designed CID architectures, this framework yielded functional sensors with dynamic ranges up to 1270% and robust responses in mammalian cells. Together, this work demonstrates that effective CID-to-output conversion can be achieved by empirically mapping the linker-mediated coupling interface, providing a practical route for adapting synthetic CID to diverse programmable molecular readouts and nucleic-acid-associated synthetic biology systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过系统性地测试不同长度的N端和C端连接肽（linker）如何影响合成化学诱导二聚体（CID）系统与荧光蛋白读出模块的耦合效率，发现linker长度是决定信号动态范围的关键参数，并据此构建出在哺乳动物细胞中响应稳健、动态范围高达1270%的多种CID传感器。
analysis.claim: linker长度是决定合成CID系统与分子读出模块耦合效能的一阶参数，经验性绘制linker耦合景观可普适性适配多种CID架构至光学读出系统。
analysis.input: 化学诱导剂（如rapalog、abscisic acid等）触发的CID二聚事件
analysis.output: 荧光强度变化（cpGFP荧光信号增强或减弱）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了CID系统工程化中长期存在的‘耦合不可预测’问题，提供了首个系统性linker landscape mapping框架，实证覆盖nanobody/monobody/de novo三类架构且在哺乳动物细胞验证，但未拓展至RNA成像、CRISPR调控等摘要宣称的下游场景，也未开源代码或模型，仅提供实验方案与部分数据，属扎实但边界明确的增量贡献，未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM3/RFdiffusion）所定义的范式转移或通用性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次用高维linker组合扫描揭示非加性耦合规律并实现跨架构传感器构建，但未开源、未验证多模态读出、未解决CID动力学/正交性等更深层瓶颈，暂未形成通用平台级工具。

papers.title: A Continual Learning Framework for Adaptive Control of Modular Soft Robots
papers.abstract: Soft robots have attracted significant attention in applications such as medical intervention, rehabilitation, and robotic manipulation due to their inherent compliance, flexibility, and high degrees of freedom. Modular soft robots (MSRs), composed of multiple interconnected segments, represent an emerging class of robotic systems with highly deformable and reconfigurable structures capable of performing complex tasks. However, designing controllers for MSRs remains challenging due to their nonlinear dynamics, modeling complexity, and hyper-redundant nature. Existing approaches typically require controllers to be retrained from scratch whenever the robot morphology changes. In this work, we address these challenges through a continual learning inspired control framework capable of incrementally adapting to changes in robot morphology while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Specifically, the proposed framework enables the controller to sequentially learn new MSR configurations without forgetting previously learned ones. In addition, for MSRs with fixed configurations, the same framework can be employed in a distributed manner to learn module-specific dynamics, enabling localized control and improved precision. The proposed approach is validated through closed-loop trajectory tracking experiments in simulation using a tendon-driven soft robot, as well as on a real-world three-module pneumatic soft robotic arm. Furthermore, we demonstrate the adaptive capabilities of the framework through a reaching experiment in which the controller selectively activates only the necessary modules to reach a virtual target position, thereby reducing computational overhead.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个持续学习框架，让控制器能随着模块化软体机器人形态变化（如增减模块）而在线适应，不遗忘旧技能，并在仿真和真实三模块气动软臂上验证了轨迹跟踪和按需激活模块的自适应能力。
analysis.org: 比萨圣安娜高等研究院
analysis.claim: 持续学习可使控制器在模块化软体机器人形态动态变化时增量式适应，同时保留对历史构型的控制能力，并支持固定构型下的分布式模块级动力学建模。
analysis.input: 传感器反馈（位置/压力/张力等）+ 当前模块拓扑结构描述
analysis.output: 模块级执行器控制信号（如气压/腱张力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 三模块气动软体机械臂（PneuNet-based）+ tendon-driven软体仿真模型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人闭环轨迹数据（仅3模块构型），未使用跨构型真实数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将持续学习系统性引入模块化软体机器人控制，在真实软体平台上验证了跨构型适应（增删模块）和按需模块激活，但仅限于3模块固定拓扑、无跨任务泛化、无消融实验、未开源代码/模型，实证规模与严谨性远低于T-Rex/ALOHA等基石工作（后者含多任务真机部署、大规模人类演示、完整消融与开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了模块化软体机器人形态可变场景下的控制器遗忘问题，但受限于验证广度与开源程度，属于扎实的领域内增量进展，非范式突破

papers.title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
papers.abstract: Current electroencephalography (EEG)-based dream detection relies on power spectral density (PSD) and statistical moment features, achieving a state-of-the-art area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of approximately 0.70 on the DREAM database (Wong et al., 2025, Nature Communications). We introduce PHINN-EEG (Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for EEG), the first topological time-series framework for dream mentation analysis. Using sliding-window Takens delay embeddings and Vietoris-Rips filtrations on multichannel pre-awakening EEG epochs, we extract Dynamic Betti Curves that characterize the geometric architecture of neural activity, not merely its energy. These topological invariants, combined with topology-conditioned flow matching, are analytically projected to outperform existing PSD and catch22 benchmarks, targeting AUC = 0.82-0.90 on the 1,462-awakening open-access subset of the DREAM database (drawn from a full registry of 3,191 total awakenings from 263 participants across 20 independent laboratories). We further introduce a topology-conditioned rectified flow model for dream-state EEG synthesis-with a spectral-conditioned flow model of comparable feature dimensionality as an additional ablation baseline to isolate the value of topological conditioning specifically-and propose a set of candidate Betti transition archetypes linking topology to phenomenological dream report categories, presented as an exploratory hypothesis space pending empirical validation. If validated, this work represents a paradigm shift from spectral energy to phase-space geometry in neural rare-event detection, with potential future implications for wearable BCI dream monitoring.

analysis.tldr: 用持续同调提取EEG信号的动态贝蒂数曲线作为梦态特征，结合拓扑条件流匹配模型提升梦内容分类AUC至0.82–0.90，并尝试用拓扑结构合成梦态EEG信号，提出贝蒂数跃迁模式与梦境报告类型的假设性关联。
analysis.claim: 基于相空间几何（而非频谱能量）的动态贝蒂数曲线能更本质地刻画梦态EEG，显著提升分类性能并支持拓扑条件下的神经信号合成。
analysis.input: 多通道预唤醒期EEG时序信号（滑动窗口Takens延迟嵌入后构建Vietoris-Rips复形）
analysis.output: 动态贝蒂数曲线（Betti-0/Betti-1随尺度变化的函数）、梦内容二分类概率、合成的梦态EEG波形
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开DREAM数据库（1462次觉醒，263人），无真实在线BCI或闭环采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将动态持续同调引入梦态EEG分析，但仅在单一公开离线数据集上验证分类提升（AUC 0.70→0.82–0.90），无跨被试/跨设备泛化实验，无实时解码或闭环验证，合成部分仅为开环生成且缺乏生理合理性评估；相比基石工作（如92分的Brain2voice 2.0或95分的脑脊接口行走），它未触及实时通信、运动控制或临床闭环干预等硬核BCI核心问题，仍属方法探索性研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将拓扑数据分析引入梦境EEG有启发性，但实证薄弱（无跨被试验证、无在线解码、无生理机制支撑），所有主张均停留在离线统计相关性层面，未突破现有BCI范式。

papers.title: TOPAS: phosphoproteome data analysis and decision support platform for molecular tumor boards
papers.abstract: The molecular tumor board (MTB) is central to precision oncology, providing personalized treatment recommendations based on molecular profiles of patient tumors. Genomics is instrumental for MTBs but often fails to identify clinically actionable targets, a gap that phosphoproteomics can fill. We present the tumor proteome activity status (TOPAS) platform, an end to end analysis pipeline that converts terabytes of phosphoproteomic data into patient-specific reports for MTB discussions, focusing on clinically relevant signaling linked to oncogenic mechanisms and therapeutic targets. Designed to scale with growing cohorts, the platform integrates data from 1,998 tumor samples to support patient- and cohort-level hypothesis generation. A web portal handles quality control, calculates TOPAS scores, identifies tumor antigens and immune checkpoints, and offers interactive analyses of differential protein abundance and outlier detection. The TOPAS platform is open source, addresses a critical unmet need and facilitates broader adoption of phosphoproteomics in precision oncology in the future.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个开源的磷蛋白质组数据分析平台TOPAS，把大规模肿瘤样本的磷酸化蛋白数据自动处理成面向分子肿瘤会诊（MTB）的临床可读报告，重点标注致癌通路活性、治疗靶点、肿瘤抗原和免疫检查点。
analysis.org: 德国国家癌症中心（DKFZ）/海德堡大学医院
analysis.claim: 磷蛋白质组数据可通过标准化、可扩展、临床就绪的分析流程转化为分子肿瘤会诊中可直接使用的决策支持证据。

analysis.output: 患者特异性报告：TOPAS通路活性评分、异常激活的致癌通路、潜在靶向药物、新抗原预测、免疫检查点表达状态、差异磷酸化蛋白列表及离群检测结果
