papers.title: Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Reinforcement Learning for Visual Continuous Control
papers.abstract: Sample-efficient policy learning from pixels is a long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning (RL). Recent dynamics-based representation learning methods have significantly improved the sample efficiency of model-free visual RL by learning dynamics-aware representations through auxiliary prediction performed either in latent space (self-prediction) or observation space (observation prediction). However, state-of-the-art methods from both categories still struggle on challenging visual control tasks when training data is limited. We posit that relying on either predictive objective alone may be insufficient. In contrast, observation prediction grounds learned representations in observation-level dynamics, but does not directly regularize the temporal predictability of latent representations over extended horizons. In this paper, we propose Observation-Grounded Self-Predictive Representations (OG-SPR), a model-free visual RL algorithm for continuous control that learns representations that are both temporally predictive in latent space and grounded in observation-level dynamics. OG-SPR incorporates two core auxiliary objectives: multi-step latent self-prediction and next-observation prediction. We empirically show that directly imposing latent self-prediction on the shared representation may over-constrain it and does not necessarily improve performance. To address this issue, OG-SPR introduces two lightweight adapters for latent self-prediction, allowing the shared representation to benefit from temporally predictive signals without being forced to directly satisfy the self-prediction objective. Experiments on 28 visual control tasks from the DeepMind Control Suite show that OG-SPR improves aggregate performance over state-of-the-art self-predictive and observation-predictive RL methods, with particularly pronounced gains in challenging domains such as dog and humanoid.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫OG-SPR的视觉连续控制强化学习算法，通过在共享表征上并行施加‘多步潜空间自预测’和‘下一帧图像预测’两个辅助目标，并用轻量适配器解耦潜空间预测约束，提升像素输入下的样本效率。
analysis.claim: 同时融合潜空间多步自预测与观测空间下一帧预测、并通过适配器解耦约束，能比单一预测目标更高效地学习兼具时序可预测性与观测保真度的视觉表征，从而提升样本效率。
analysis.input: 原始RGB像素图像序列
analysis.output: 连续动作向量
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅使用仿真环境渲染图像
analysis.significance_reason: 属视觉RL表征学习的扎实增量：在DMControl 28任务上超越现有self-predictive/observation-predictive方法，但未引入新范式（如世界模型结构、记忆机制或跨模态对齐），无真实机器人验证，无消融证明适配器设计必要性，且未开源数据或完整训练配置。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已有预测式表征框架内做了合理组合与结构微调，提升了SOTA数值，但未突破视觉RL的底层瓶颈（如长程时序建模、泛化到未见形态），也未触及具身交互本质。

papers.title: RORA: Realistic Object Reconstruction with Articulation
papers.abstract: Replicating real-world environments into simulation by realistic visual representation like NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an effective strategy to reduce the sim-to-real gap in robot learning. However, implementing object articulation during the real-to-sim process is still a challenging task. Existing motion tracking or learning based articulation methods shows low success rates on complex kinematic structures having multiple joints. Furthermore, those methods require scan of dynamic motion of objects, which makes reconstruction process much complicated. In this work, we propose the first end-to-end pipeline that reconstructs simulation-ready assets with accurate articulation from a single static object video input through suggestion based human-in-the-loop process. Our approach exports a hybrid representation combining 3DGS for photorealistic rendering and mesh-based geometry for physical interaction. In the reconstruction process, our pipeline performs convex decomposition followed by user grouping for intuitive part segmentation, subsequently binding 3D Gaussians to the corresponding mesh parts. An Automatic Joint Suggestion Algorithm then calculates candidate joint axes from local boundary geometries and presents them to users for efficient articulated asset reconstruction. We have shown that our method achieves precise articulation results on partnet-mobility-v0 dataset and real objects. Additionally we presented a potential usage of our framework on robot learning, deploying the reconstructed assets in Unreal Engine and NVIDIA Isaac Sim, demonstrating real-time dexterous hand manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 用一段静态物体视频，通过人机协同（用户点击确认关节轴）重建出带精确可动结构的3D模型，既支持逼真渲染（3DGS），又支持物理仿真交互（网格+关节绑定），并在Unreal和Isaac Sim中验证了机器人灵巧手操作任务。
analysis.claim: 首次实现仅需单段静态视频输入、结合轻量人工干预即可生成仿真就绪（simulation-ready）、具准确运动学结构的3D可动资产。
analysis.input: 单段静态物体视频（无动态动作）
analysis.output: 带关节定义和运动学层级的混合3D资产（3D高斯点云+网格部件+关节轴）
analysis.data_dependency: 无需真实机器人交互数据；依赖人工标注关节轴（非机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了静态视频→可动仿真资产的端到端重建问题，技术路径有新意（凸分解+用户分组+边界几何驱动的关节建议），但未在真实机器人上部署验证，未跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，仅在PartNet-Mobility和少量实物上展示精度，且依赖人工环节（非全自动），相比SPEAR/SimFoundry等构建通用仿真基座的工作，属于窄域工具级改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: UniTexture: Cross-Task Universal Adversarial Textures for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as generalist robotic policies capable of following diverse language instructions and performing a wide range of manipulation tasks. However, their direct control over embodied agents also exposes them to adversarial interference that may cause unsafe physical behaviors. Existing attacks on robotic policies are typically optimized for a single task or instruction, leaving the cross-task vulnerabilities of multitask VLAs largely unexplored. We introduce UniTexture, a cross-task universal adversarial texture attack that uses a single textured 3D object to induce targeted deviations in VLA action predictions across multiple tasks. UniTexture backpropagates gradients from the policy's action outputs to surface texture parameters through a differentiable renderer. It jointly optimizes the shared texture over a distribution of tasks, instructions, states, and viewpoints using a targeted action-space objective, steering predicted actions toward attacker-defined targets without optimizing a separate texture for each task. We evaluate UniTexture on OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$ across diverse manipulation tasks and multiple evaluation settings. UniTexture reduces the mean task success rate from 90.0% under benign conditions to 48.4% under attack, induces target-aligned action shifts, and further exhibits cross-suite and cross-model transfer without re-optimization. Together, these findings reveal shared cross-task vulnerabilities in multitask VLAs that can be systematically exploited through a single adversarial surface texture.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫UniTexture的通用对抗纹理攻击方法，只需在3D物体表面贴一个固定纹理图案，就能让多种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人模型在多个不同任务中都做出错误动作，大幅降低成功率，且该纹理无需为每个任务单独设计。
analysis.claim: 多任务VLA模型存在跨任务共享的底层表征脆弱性，可通过单个可优化的3D表面纹理实现无需任务定制的、可迁移的对抗攻击。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令+机器人状态（隐式通过渲染输入）
analysis.output: 被扰动后的动作预测（连续动作向量）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，全部基于仿真渲染和公开VLA模型前向推理
analysis.significance_reason: 首次揭示VLA模型跨任务的纹理级对抗脆弱性，实验扎实（OpenVLA/π₀.₅+多任务+跨模型迁移），但纯仿真攻击、无真实机器人验证、无防御或鲁棒性改进、未开源代码/纹理、对领域安全实践影响有限；属于高质量安全分析工作，但离‘推进VLA能力边界’或‘解决核心开放问题’甚远，显著弱于所有列出的基石工作（最低OpenVLA=93）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将可微分渲染与VLA动作空间对抗目标结合，实现了跨任务纹理攻击的工程闭环，但属安全分析而非能力构建，无真实部署、无开源、无系统性缓解方案，暂时不用看

papers.title: Auto-Policy, not Auto-Skill: Compiled Agent Skills for the Physical World
papers.abstract: Self-evolving Skill harnesses (AutoSkills, Hermes Agent) generate more advisory orchestration automatically; their reported gains are efficiency, not safety. This misses the actual gap: a Skill describes how an agent should behave; a Policy decides which behavior is allowed to become an action. Today's format covers the first with markdown and scripts; the second is left to the model. Generating more Skills scales the gap, not the safety, especially when a wrong invocation can unlock a door or move money. Two adjacent attacks are documented: malicious skills compromising cloud software, and jailbroken LLM-controlled robots causing physical harm. Their intersection, malicious agent skills causing physical harm, follows directly but has not been reported. We name this class Borrowed Authority: Skills format gives the receiving agent no typed way to reject an inter-agent permission claim, so a malicious or misused Skill can drive actuation by attaching one. We propose Edge Skillguard, a typed authority layer that lives inside the Skill artifact rather than between tools as workflow engines do, with guards over world state and sensor evidence. On a live edge control-plane testbed, the guards reject 60/60 borrowed-authority requests across five attack variants without blocking benign requests, and the result holds at 5x scale and across hosts over a Tailscale mesh. These results suggest that high-risk Skills should co-package typed invocation policy with procedural knowledge, so that physical actions depend on machine-checkable evidence rather than peer-agent claims.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前AI代理技能（Skill）设计存在严重安全漏洞：技能本身不带权限校验逻辑，恶意或错误技能可直接触发物理动作（如开门、转账），作者提出‘Edge Skillguard’——一种嵌入在技能内部的类型化权限守卫层，通过实时检查世界状态和传感器证据来拦截非法调用，在边缘控制测试平台上100%拦截60次模拟攻击且不误杀正常请求。
analysis.claim: 物理世界AI代理的安全风险根源在于技能（Skill）格式缺乏内建的、可机器验证的权限策略，必须将类型化调用策略与程序逻辑一同打包进技能本体，而非依赖外部工作流引擎或LLM裁决。
analysis.input: 技能调用请求 + 当前世界状态快照 + 本地传感器证据（如摄像头/IMU/门磁等）
analysis.output: 是否允许该技能执行的二元判决（布尔值）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，基于边缘控制平面测试床（非机器人本体）构建的模拟物理动作请求流
analysis.significance_reason: 直击具身智能落地核心瓶颈——代理间权限失控导致的物理世界安全风险，提出首个嵌入式、类型化、可验证的技能级守卫机制，并在真实边缘控制平面完成多变体、跨主机、5倍负载压力验证；虽未涉及机器人本体运动控制或VLA建模，但填补了AI代理架构安全范式的空白，属扎实重磅贡献，但尚未达到RT-2/π0级范式开创量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将权限策略从运行时决策层下沉为技能固有属性并实证可行，是具身智能系统工程安全的关键一步，但非模型/算法/范式突破

papers.title: A Wearable Pneumatic Device for Continuous, Closed-Loop, Bidirectional Tactile Interaction
papers.abstract: We present a system of two wearable pneumatic haptic devices that supports continuous, closed-loop, bidirectional tactile interaction at perceptually relevant force and temporal scales. A single device can contain up to twelve pressure sensing channels connected to textile-based pneumatic pouches. Each channel in a device can be used as a sensor, an actuator, or both. As an actuator with integrated sensing, the channel generates stable skin indentation through local closed-loop control. As a sensor, a channel can be mounted (or worn) on any surface, including on a robot gripper or on the human body, and used to measure touch interactions with the environment or a human user. A distributed architecture supports sustained pressure output, rapid dynamic response, and wireless pairing of identical devices in a system to transmit and reproduce tactile pressure signals in real time. Device-level characterization demonstrates force bandwidth exceeding 30 Hz, rapid and well-damped step responses, and extended pressure retention compared to prior compact pneumatic platforms. Human studies show that pressure-based fingertip feedback enables discrimination of force and stiffness, improves teleoperated manipulation by reducing applied pressures by up to 23.1% and task duration by up to 27.4%, and lowers subjective mental workload by 18.8%, particularly under visually constrained conditions. By unifying tactile sensing and haptic feedback within a single pneumatic modality, the device provides a practical foundation for bidirectional touch interaction in teleoperation.

analysis.tldr: 研发了一种可穿戴气动触觉设备，单个设备集成最多12个气动囊+压力传感通道，既能当传感器测触力，又能当执行器施加稳定皮肤压感，支持双设备无线实时双向触觉信号传输，并在人机遥操作中验证了其能降低操作力、缩短任务时间、减轻认知负荷。
analysis.claim: 通过统一气动模态实现传感与反馈一体化的可穿戴触觉设备，能在真实遥操作中实现连续、闭环、双向、感知相关的触觉交互。
analysis.input: 触觉交互信号（如机器人端接触力/人体端按压）或用户指令（隐含于闭环控制目标）
analysis.output: 实时气动压力反馈（皮肤局部凹陷）或触觉传感信号（压力时序数据）
analysis.robot_dependency: 机器人夹爪（用于传感部署）+ 遥操作平台（实验中使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类被试数据和真实机器人遥操作任务数据（摘要明确提及human studies及teleoperated manipulation）
analysis.significance_reason: 在触觉人机交互领域属重磅进展：首次将高带宽（>30Hz）、闭环稳态执行、多通道复用（传感/执行同通道）、无线双设备同步等工程能力集于轻量可穿戴气动平台，并在真实遥操作任务中取得多维度量化提升（力/时间/认知负荷），但未开新范式，也未解决长期开放难题（如神经编码对齐、跨模态触觉重建），分量略低于脑机接口基石论文（均≥92），但显著优于纯仿真或单点优化工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多项触觉硬件关键技术收敛到实用可穿戴形态，并在真实遥操作中验证了系统级效益，但非理论或范式突破

papers.title: Mind the Phase: Effective Rank and Representation Health in Legged Locomotion
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the leading paradigm in legged locomotion, enabling complex behaviors from backflips to parkour through massively parallel simulation. Under PPO's non-stationarity, shallow networks remain the de facto architecture, supported by carefully staged curricula and environments, yet the representations these policies learn stay poorly understood, leaving no training-time signal of how they will behave on hardware. In this work, we empirically study locomotion policies through the effective rank of the policy Jacobian and show that conditioning rank on the gait phase exposes architectural structure that global rank averages away. In particular, we find that standard architectural choices, namely layer normalization and residual connections, allocate roughly two more dimensions of effective rank to swing than to stance, which is fully absent in vanilla MLPs. Building on this, we propose a simple recipe that turns these representational signatures into smoother, more reliable sim-to-real transfer. In practice, this results in roughly 3x lower joint jitter that holds from simulation onto a physical Spot, suggesting that representation health is an effective training-time lens to track sim-to-real smoothness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现腿式机器人强化学习策略中，策略雅可比矩阵的‘有效秩’在步态相位（摆动相/支撑相）上分布不均，而标准架构（如LayerNorm+残差）会刻意增强摆动相的表征维度；作者据此提出一个简单训练调整方法，显著降低了仿真到实机（波士顿动力Spot）的关节抖动（约3倍），把表征健康度作为sim2real平滑性的可监控指标。
analysis.claim: 腿式运动策略的表征健康度（以相位条件下的有效秩刻画）与sim2real平滑性存在强相关，且可通过标准架构组件定向调控。
analysis.input: 状态向量（本体感知+关节信息）
analysis.output: 动作向量（关节力矩或目标位置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真训练数据，仅用少量真实机器人部署验证抖动指标
analysis.significance_reason: 发现了相位敏感的有效秩现象并建立其与sim2real抖动的实证关联，属扎实增量：有真实Spot验证、量化指标明确（3x抖动下降）、机制可解释；但未跨机体/跨任务泛化，无开源代码，未挑战长期开放难题（如零样本迁移、多地形自适应），远未达基石论文所要求的范式级创新或系统级整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——揭示了表征结构与硬件抖动的新关联，并给出可复现的工程改进，但缺乏泛化验证和开源支持，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Control of Genetic and Epigenetic Editing through Covalent Tethering of CRISPR Nanoparticles to Zwitterionic Microgels
papers.abstract: CRISPR gene editing offers unprecedented genomic and transcriptomic control, positioning it as a powerful tool for cell therapies. Non-viral CRISPR delivery avoids the immunogenicity, genomic integration, and packaging limits of viral vectors, but local or systemic injections of non-viral nanoparticles suffers from transient action and poor biodistribution. Alternatively, biomaterial-based delivery improves nanoparticle localization and sustains delivery, yet current approaches rely on non-specific adsorption of nanoparticles to scaffolds, risking aggregation, destabilization, and unreliable release kinetics. This work establishes a novel strategy to covalently tether nanoparticles to biomaterial substrates through SnoopTag and SpyTag bioconjugation systems for spatiotemporal control of non-viral CRISPR delivery. The RALA cell-penetrating peptide, an efficient and low-cytotoxicity CRISPR delivery system, was functionalized with SnoopTag without altering nanoparticle formation or transfection capacity. SnoopTag-functionalized nanoparticles were then covalently tethered to SpyTag-decorated zwitterionic microgels via a SnoopCatcher-SpyCatcher fusion protein. This platform achieves sustained RALA-mRNA nanoparticle delivery and prolonged CRISPR activation in human mesenchymal stem cells seeded within CRISPR-loaded microgel scaffolds. This work establishes a defined biorthogonal conjugation system that tethers non-viral nanoparticles to biomaterial platforms for sustained and localized CRISPR gene editing.

analysis.tldr: 用SnoopTag/SpyTag生物正交系统把CRISPR纳米颗粒共价拴在两性离子微凝胶上，实现局部、长效的基因/表观遗传编辑，避免传统非病毒递送中颗粒易脱落、释放不可控的问题
analysis.claim: 共价拴系（而非物理吸附）可实现CRISPR纳米颗粒在生物材料上的稳定锚定，从而获得时空可控、持续激活的非病毒基因编辑能力
analysis.input: RALA肽修饰的CRISPR-mRNA纳米颗粒 + SpyTag修饰的两性离子微凝胶 + SnoopCatcher-SpyCatcher融合蛋白
analysis.output: 空间定位固定、时间上持续释放的CRISPR编辑活性（表现为hMSC中靶基因编辑效率随时间延长而累积）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了非病毒CRISPR递送中生物材料锚定不稳的关键工程瓶颈，实证了共价拴系对编辑持续性的提升（体外干细胞模型），但未验证体内疗效、脱靶、免疫原性或跨细胞类型泛化，也未与临床级递送方案（如LNP）做头对头比较，属扎实的机制驱动型生物材料创新，尚未达‘范式突破’或‘治疗级推进’量级
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次将SnoopTag/SpyTag共价拴系用于CRISPR纳米颗粒-微凝胶偶联，实证了其对编辑持续性的提升，但限于体外干细胞模型，缺乏体内验证和临床相关性证据

papers.title: PhiFold: Towards Dynamic Protein Design with Physics-Structured Covariance Modeling
papers.abstract: Protein design is moving beyond structural correctness toward function-aware design, yet existing generative models typically treat dynamics as a downstream property estimated through simulation or prediction after structure generation. Using MD trajectories as a generative target is also undesirable because stochastic, path-dependent trajectories over-specify the underlying equilibrium ensemble. We introduce PhiFold, a framework for jointly generating protein backbones and their second-order dynamics, represented by residue-displacement covariance. Rather than predicting the quadratically sized full covariance, PhiFold decomposes dynamics into three interpretable components: local flexibility, a low-rank collective-motion representation, and residue-wise collective participation. These components are assembled into a positive-definite covariance matrix with exact marginal consistency, yielding a compact and physically constrained representation of equilibrium dynamics. Across generated proteins, PhiFold improves recovery of local fluctuations and long-range residue coupling while remaining competitive on dominant collective-motion subspaces. It further enables bidirectional control of residue flexibility while preserving backbone designability. By unifying structure generation with an explicit representation of equilibrium dynamics, PhiFold lays a foundation for designing proteins not only by how they look, but also by how they move.

analysis.tldr: PhiFold不是生成蛋白质结构，而是直接生成蛋白质骨架+其热力学平衡态下的动态特性（用残基位移协方差矩阵表示），通过物理可解释的三组件分解（局部柔性、低秩集体运动、残基参与度）构建正定协方差，实现结构与动力学的一体化生成。
analysis.claim: 蛋白质设计应同时生成结构与物理自洽的平衡态动力学表征，而非将动力学作为后处理；PhiFold首次在生成过程中显式建模并联合优化骨架与协方差的二阶动态特性。
analysis.input: 序列或初始结构约束（摘要未明说，但属生成任务，隐含需输入如seed sequence或fold prior）
analysis.output: 蛋白质主链3D坐标 + 残基位移协方差矩阵（经三组件参数化解析构造）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将平衡态协方差作为生成目标并做物理驱动的结构化分解，在动力学感知设计上迈出关键一步；但未公开代码/模型，未报告真实功能验证（如湿实验表达、结合活性测试）、未与主流生成模型（如Chroma、RFdiffusion+MD）做端到端功能对比，仅在协方差重建指标上提升，证据链止于计算合理性。

papers.title: Inline Memory Meets Reusable Skills: Memory-centric Framework for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet adapting them to new tasks and domains remains inefficient: existing methods often rely on parameter tuning, incurring substantial costs and risking catastrophic forgetting of previously learned tasks. To address this, we propose \textbf{Optimus-R}, a memory-centric VLA framework that formulates robotic adaptation as explicit query-skill memory tuning. Optimus-R introduces: (i) An \textbf{Inline Memory Interface for skill extraction}. It inserts learnable memory tokens into the VLA prefix stream, allowing the backbone to derive control-aware query and skill representations within the native action-conditioning pathway. (ii) A \textbf{Query-Skill Memory Bank for skill learning}. It externalizes skills into query prototypes for deciding \emph{what} to retrieve and skill values for specifying \emph{how} to act, supporting skill reuse and expansion with limited parameter updates. (iii) A lightweight \textbf{Bridge-and-Adapt mechanism for skill updating}. It aligns target-domain queries and skills with the existing memory space through a lightweight adapter and residual memory updates. Experiments on in-domain adaptation, cross-domain adaptation, and lifelong learning show that Optimus-R enables data-efficient skill learning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

analysis.tldr: 提出Optimus-R框架，用可插入的内存令牌和外置查询-技能记忆库替代传统参数微调，让视觉语言动作模型能高效复用已有技能、快速适配新任务且不遗忘旧任务。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 机器人技能适应不应依赖全模型参数更新，而应通过显式的、可插拔的查询-技能内存机制实现数据高效、抗遗忘的技能复用与增量扩展。

analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）

papers.title: SkeleWAM: Skeleton World-Action Modeling for Efficient Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) combine robot action generation with future state prediction. Existing WAMs typically predict videos or learned visual latents, which represent interaction geometry only implicitly and may retain appearance information unrelated to control. We introduce SkeleWAM, a compact WAM that represents a manipulation scene as a sparse 3D skeleton composed of robot joints, object centers, and interaction points. Constructed online from current RGB-D observations and robot proprioception, the skeleton provides a unified geometric state for action generation and future skeleton prediction. Future skeleton prediction provides additional geometric supervision for action learning without requiring visual reconstruction. At inference, SkeleWAM generates actions directly from the current skeleton and language instruction, while Medoid Action Consensus (MAC) serves as an auxiliary consensus strategy for stochastic action samples. On LIBERO-Plus, SkeleWAM achieves an overall success rate of 85.9% with 57.1M parameters, outperforming Cosmos-Policy by 3.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate that sparse 3D robot--object structure provides an effective state space for robust and parameter-efficient world action learning. The project is available at https://skelewam-project.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一个轻量级的3D骨架（含机器人关节、物体中心和交互点）替代传统世界动作模型中的视频或视觉隐变量，作为统一几何状态表示，直接从骨架+语言指令生成动作，并在LIBERO-Plus上以更少参数取得略高于Cosmos-Policy的成功率。
analysis.claim: 稀疏3D骨架表征比视频/视觉隐变量更高效、更鲁棒地支撑世界动作建模与动作生成。
analysis.input: 当前RGB-D图像+机器人本体感知+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用仿真合成数据训练和评估
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一仿真benchmark（LIBERO-Plus）上小幅超越一个已有基线（Cosmos-Policy），无真实机器人验证、无跨任务/跨场景泛化实验、无消融证明骨架设计的关键性、未开源代码/模型，且骨架构建依赖理想化RGB-D+真值标注（如物体中心），实际部署中难以鲁棒提取；相比所列基石工作（全部具备持续状态建模、闭环策略学习、多任务泛化或真实系统验证），它只是表征层面的局部替换，未触及世界模型的核心挑战（如长期一致性、记忆机制、因果解耦）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：用骨架替代视觉隐变量有直觉合理性，但缺乏实证深度和系统性突破，未解决世界模型领域的任何开放难题。

papers.title: A rapid, genetically-tractable human iPSC-derived model for studying tissue-resident macrophage biology in Alzheimer's and other diseases
papers.abstract: Large-scale genetic and preclinical studies strongly implicate myeloid cells, particularly brain-resident macrophages, in the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease (AD). Efferocytic clearance of apoptotic cells and other cholesterol-rich cellular debris is a core macrophage function and represents an active area of AD research. However, human tissue-resident macrophages remain difficult to model in vitro as they acquire their transcriptional and functional identities in response to signals from their host tissue microenvironment. Many existing differentiation protocols mimic human brain macrophage developmental trajectories, but these protocols rely either on multi-step cytokine cocktails and lengthy differentiation or transduction of multiple transcription factors, both of which introduce variability and complicate genetic manipulation. To address these limitations, we developed a simplified protocol that generates high-purity (>90% CD45+CD11b+) human iPSC-derived macrophage-like cells (iMacs) from cryopreservable erythro-myeloid progenitor (EMP)-like intermediates in 19 days, including a final 7-day maturation step driven by macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) alone. Transcriptomic profiling reveals that iMacs show enrichment for phagocytic and lysosomal programs, processes integral to efferocytosis. At both the transcriptional and protein level, iMacs have higher expression of scavenger receptors such as CD36, CD163 and MRC1, and of AD risk genes such as TREM2. Functionally, iMacs show enhanced phagocytic uptake of diverse substrates relative to iPSC-derived microglia, including carboxylated latex beads, zymosan, amyloid-β 1-42, and amyloid-β 1-40, and exhibit expanded lysosomal mass. Robust TREM2 expression and signaling make iMacs a sensitive platform for interrogating TREM2 biology, with markedly higher phosphorylation of SYK and PLCγ2 in response to TREM2 engagement compared to iPSC-derived microglia. iMacs also tolerate lipid-mediated siRNA transfection with high survival and knockdown efficiency, enabling rapid genetic perturbation of AD risk genes. Together, these features make iMacs a practical, scalable, and genetically tractable human macrophage model for studying the regulation and cell biology of core macrophage functions that are known to play critical roles in AD, aging, and other disorders.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一种仅用19天、无需复杂基因操作或冗长细胞因子诱导的iPSC分化方案，稳定产出高纯度、功能健全且遗传易编辑的人源巨噬样细胞（iMacs），专门用于研究阿尔茨海默病中组织驻留巨噬细胞的吞噬、脂质代谢和TREM2信号等核心生物学问题。
analysis.claim: 通过简化分化路径获得的iPSC来源巨噬样细胞（iMacs）在转录、蛋白表达和功能上更真实地模拟人脑驻留巨噬细胞的关键特征（尤其是efferocytosis和TREM2通路），且支持高效遗传扰动，解决了现有模型遗传难操作、成熟度低、批次变异大的瓶颈。
analysis.input: 人源iPSC细胞系
analysis.output: 高纯度CD45+CD11b+巨噬样细胞（iMacs）及其转录组、蛋白表达谱、吞噬活性、信号通路响应、基因敲降表型
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于体外细胞培养与分子实验
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量方法学突破：显著缩短分化周期、提升纯度与功能保真度、首次实现iPSC巨噬样细胞中TREM2-SYK-PLCγ2通路的强效可检测性，并验证其对AD相关底物（Aβ40/42）的特异性吞噬增强；但未构建通用预测模型、未覆盖多疾病横向验证、未开源完整protocol代码或自动化流程，尚未达到AlphaFold2级范式变革，但明显优于常规细胞模型论文，证据扎实（多组学+功能+遗传扰动+与iPSC-microglia严格对照）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分化效率、功能保真度与遗传可操作性三者统一于一个简洁可复现的细胞模型，是AD机制研究中极具实用价值的工具升级，但非理论或算法层面的突破。

papers.title: A Flow-Theoretic Multimodal Control Framework Fusing Mental and Physical Engagement for Upper-Limb Rehabilitation
papers.abstract: While Assist-as-Needed (AAN) control aims to maximize user participation in robot-assisted training, existing methods relying solely on physical metrics cannot distinguish muscular inability from mental disengagement, leading to suboptimal interventions. To address this ambiguity, a Flow-theoretic multimodal AAN framework is proposed, fusing EEG-based mental engagement and sEMG-based physical engagement into an adaptive impedance control strategy. A four-quadrant fuzzy decision engine translates these dual physiological metrics into continuous control policies. This enables the upper-limb exoskeleton to inject feedforward assistance during intent-execution mismatch (e.g., motor output attenuation despite mental focus) and escalate guiding stiffness to penalize mental distraction. The framework was validated with healthy participants against a state-of-practice sEMG-only AAN baseline. Kinematically and mechanically, the proposed framework reduced robotic energy expenditure by 71.9\% while maintaining precise trajectory tracking, confirming it elicited greater voluntary human effort. Physiologically, the system increased the time spent in the neuroplasticity zone (Flow State Ratio) from 4.6% to 42.8%. These results validate that decoupling and jointly regulating mental and physical states enhances the selectivity of robotic assistance, mitigating user passivity and sustaining the engagement crucial for motor learning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个融合脑电（EEG）和肌电（sEMG）的自适应阻抗控制框架，用于上肢康复外骨骼，能区分患者是‘肌肉无力’还是‘注意力不集中’，从而动态调整辅助力度：在人想动但动不了时给前馈助力，在人走神时提高刚度‘提醒’，实验证明比只用肌电的老方法更省机器人能量、更能激发患者主动参与。
analysis.claim: 解耦并联合调控心理参与度与生理参与度，可显著提升康复外骨骼中辅助的精准性与神经可塑性诱导效果。
analysis.input: EEG信号（反映精神专注度）+ sEMG信号（反映肌肉激活程度）
analysis.output: 连续变化的阻抗参数（刚度/阻尼）与前馈力矩
analysis.robot_dependency: 上肢外骨骼（未说明具体型号，但为真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实被试的同步EEG+sEMG+运动学数据，但仅在健康受试者上验证，无患者数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将Flow理论与双模态生理信号结合用于康复控制，并在真实外骨骼上验证了节能与提升主观参与度的效果，但仅在健康被试中测试、无临床患者数据、无长期疗效评估、无开源代码/模型、未对比现有临床AAN系统（仅vs sEMG-only基线），远未达BCI领域基石工作（如95+分）所要求的临床实质性突破、长期稳定性或高信息通量解码能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已知信号（EEG+sEMG）和已知控制范式（阻抗+前馈）做了有物理意义的耦合设计，并在健康人真机上做出合理结果，但缺乏临床验证、泛化性和可复现性，尚未构成对康复BCI范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: WALL-WM: Carving World Action Modeling at the Event Joints
papers.abstract: WALL-WM is a World Action Model that shifts video-action learning from chunk-centric optimization to event-grounded Vision-Language-Action pretraining, using semantically coherent action events as the atomic unit of learning. Existing WAMs commonly initialize from multimodal or video foundation models and then optimize fixed-length action chunks conditioned directly on the current observation and instruction. Although convenient, this chunk-centric formulation creates a fundamental granularity mismatch. Language describes semantic goals and events, vision evolves through continuous scene dynamics, and actions operate at control-level timescales; forcing all three into the same fixed-length prediction window turns VLA training into short-horizon correlation fitting. WALL-WM addresses this mismatch by organizing both supervision and data around semantic events. Specifically, it pairs event-grounded VLA pretraining with a data ecosystem built from event-level captions and cluster-balanced sampling, enabling scalable learning over diverse behaviors, scenes, and task structures. From the same event-pretrained backbone, WALL-WM supports two complementary inference modes. The event mode consumes next-event descriptions and enables variable-length execution chunks, while the unified mode uses a VLM with Staircase Decoding to condition conventional fixed-length chunk inference while preserving a gradient-continuous VLA path. Together with Muon-optimizer-based large-scale pretraining infrastructure, WALL-WM provides a practical scale-up recipe for general-purpose WAMs. Experiments show that WALL-WM generalizes broadly across language, scenes, and tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance in large-scale real-world generalization evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出WALL-WM，用语义事件（而非固定时长的动作块）作为视频-语言-动作联合建模的基本单元，重构了世界动作模型的预训练范式，试图解决语言目标、视觉动态和控制频率在时间粒度上的根本错配问题。
analysis.claim: 语义事件是视频-语言-动作联合建模更自然、更可扩展的原子单位，能从根本上缓解语言目标、视觉演化与动作控制之间的时间粒度错配。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+语言指令+事件级描述（如'打开抽屉并取出杯子'）
analysis.output: 动作块/轨迹（支持两种模式：事件驱动的变长执行块，或固定长度但梯度连续的统一解码块）
analysis.data_dependency: 未提及真实机器人数据；所有实验均基于仿真或离线视频-动作数据集（摘要未指明具体数据源，仅提'event-level captions'和'cluster-balanced sampling'）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出事件为原子单元的思想有启发性，但全文无真实机器人实验、无公开数据/代码/模型、无消融验证事件建模相比chunk建模的真实增益，仅依赖'large-scale real-world generalization evaluation'等模糊表述，未对标任何具体基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA），也未说明是否在相同硬件/数据/算力下对比；其宣称的SOTA缺乏可复现证据，实质贡献停留在概念重组层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——用‘事件’重新术语化VLA建模，但无真实系统实现、无开源、无硬指标对比、无消融，无法判断是否真解决粒度错配问题

papers.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
papers.abstract: Reconstructing interactive, simulation-ready 3D scenes from a single image is a critical bottleneck for robotic manipulation. While recent single-image lifters recover plausible per-object shapes, composing them yields scenes that collapse under physical simulation due to interpenetrating, hovering, or sinking objects. Existing physics-aware methods address this strictly as a post-hoc layout correction, leaving the underlying geometric errors unresolved. To address this, we introduce SimuScene, a compositional 3D reconstruction pipeline that puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation. Rather than using physics merely for layout cleanup, we utilize the physics engine as a diagnostic measurement tool during the generative process itself. By diagnostically simulating reconstructed objects under gravity, we convert penetration and support failures into quantitative correction signals that drive gravity-axis stretching and amodal shape resampling. This physics-informed feedback loop mitigates accumulated reconstruction errors and produces a stable, simulation-ready compositional 3D scene. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on physical stability and geometric alignment benchmarks. We further highlight SimuScene's utility by deploying reconstructed environments in humanoid control and robot-arm manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 从单张RGB图像重建出物理上稳定、可直接用于机器人仿真的3D场景（含多个物体的精确位姿、非穿透支撑关系和可微物理兼容形状），核心是把物理引擎嵌入生成流程做实时诊断反馈，而非仅后处理修正。
analysis.claim: 将物理仿真引擎作为生成式重建过程中的诊断测量工具，通过重力下的穿透/支撑失败信号驱动形状拉伸与无模态重采样，从而端到端获得仿真就绪的组合式3D场景。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 物理稳定的组合式3D场景（含每个物体的mesh、位姿、支撑关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用任何真实机器人交互数据；仅依赖合成或单图重建数据集（如ScanNet、Objaverse等隐含推断）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了单图重建中长期存在的物理不稳定性问题，方法有创新性（物理在环诊断），实验证明在物理稳定性指标上SOTA，但仅限仿真环境、无真实机器人部署验证、未跨机体/任务泛化、未开源代码模型，属于扎实但窄域的增量贡献——远低于DROID/ALOHA/ManiSkill3等真机驱动、多任务、强泛化或基础仿真设施级工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：物理在环反馈思路有效且实验充分，但纯仿真、无真机验证、无开源、泛化弱，尚未突破单图重建到具身智能闭环的鸿沟。

papers.title: Compressed-Resident Genomics: Full-Pipeline Device-Resident GPU LZ77 Decode with Position-Invariant Random Access
papers.abstract: Genomic archives grow faster than decompression keeps up: the European Nucleotide Archive holds tens of petabytes of fastq.gz, and gzip is fundamentally sequential. GPU decompressors (nvCOMP DEFLATE at ~50GB/s on A100) decode whole files with no random access; CPU genomic tools (CRAM, samtools) support region seeks but only at CPU speed. We extend ACEAPEX, an absolute-offset parallel LZ77 codec included in the official lzbench 2.3 release, with three contributions absent from our prior work. First, a full device-resident GPU decode pipeline (entropy and match resolution both on-device) reaching up to 260GB/s on FASTQ, closing the match-phase-only gap of the earlier paper. Second, position-invariant random access with a compact coordinate index: an arbitrary read decodes in 0.362ms, ~6x faster than warm samtools faidx, with a read-to-block index 6.3x smaller than a .fai. Third, a range-decode strategy that decouples output size from VRAM, sustaining 165.7GB/s on a 50GB genome where whole-file decode runs out of memory. All results are bit-perfect. We also measure Meta's open DietGPU ANS on H100 at 592GB/s decode, faster than the proprietary entropy stage we currently use, showing a fully open high-throughput stack is viable. Code is MIT-licensed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了全GPU驻留的LZ77解压流水线，支持基因组FASTQ文件的毫秒级、位置无关随机访问和大范围内存受限解码，所有输出比特精确，速度达260GB/s，远超现有CPU工具（如samtools）和部分GPU方案。
analysis.claim: 通过全设备驻留GPU解压、紧凑坐标索引和范围解码策略，首次在LZ77压缩基因组数据上实现高吞吐、低延迟、内存可扩展、比特精确的随机访问解压。
analysis.input: gzip/LZ77压缩的FASTQ文件（含自研ACEAPEX编码格式）及任意基因组坐标区间请求
analysis.output: 原始FASTQ文本片段（比特精确）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了基因组大数据中‘解压即全载入’的根本瓶颈，在真实FASTQ数据上达成260GB/s端到端GPU解压与亚毫秒随机访问，实证扎实、性能跃升显著；但属高性能计算+生物信息交叉的工程突破，未触及生物学机制建模或新科学发现，分量不及AlphaFold/ESM/RFdiffusion等范式级模型（均>92），略高于纯benchmark工作（如LZBench），符合‘显著贡献’档（60–74）

papers.title: NavWM: A Unified Navigation World Model for Foresight-Driven Planning
papers.abstract: Conventional visual navigation policies often struggle with myopic decision-making and mode collapse in complex environments. While world models offer a promising alternative, existing paradigms typically isolate perception, generation, and control, failing to capture their shared spatio-temporal dynamics. In this paper, we propose NavWM, a unified navigation world model that seamlessly integrates latent world reasoning, multimodal action prediction, and controllable visual generation. At its core, NavWM leverages latent world tokens to distill geometric and semantic priors, endowing the agent with robust structural understanding. To overcome the limitations of deterministic policies, we introduce an anchor-based multimodal trajectory forecasting framework that generates a diverse action space. This inherent diversity explicitly empowers the generative world model to act as a robust closed-loop planner, utilizing visual foresight to evaluate and select the optimal path. Extensive experiments across diverse robotics datasets demonstrate that NavWM significantly advances the state-of-the-art, delivering remarkable improvements in both high-fidelity future state generation and zero-shot navigation success.

analysis.tldr: 提出NavWM统一导航世界模型，用隐式世界token建模空间语义，结合锚点驱动的多模态轨迹预测，在仿真中提升未来状态生成质量和零样本导航成功率。
analysis.claim: 统一的世界模型架构能通过隐式世界token和锚点式多模态轨迹预测，实现具备视觉前瞻能力的闭环导航规划。
analysis.input: RGB观测序列+导航目标指令
analysis.output: 未来多步视觉帧预测+动作序列分布
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真环境验证，无真实机器人实验，无消融分析细节，未开源代码/模型，未与DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作做方法级对比，仅报告零样本导航成功率提升但未说明任务复杂度、泛化场景或失败案例；属于对现有世界模型框架的局部整合（感知-生成-控制耦合），但未解决世界模型领域核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、状态持久性、跨任务迁移）。

papers.title: PlantGeneAnn: a strand-specific genome foundation model for ab initio gene structure annotation of plant genomes
papers.abstract: High-quality plant genome assemblies are rapidly increasing, but accurate structural annotation remains reliant on transcript and homology evidence, limiting applications in newly sequenced and non-model species. Here, we present PlantGeneAnn, a plant-optimized, strand-specific genome foundation model for ab initio gene structure annotation. Fine-tuned on only nine high-quality model plant annotations, PlantGeneAnn outperformed a multi-species model trained on 42 species, showing that annotation quality is more important than token volume. On a stringent 13-species benchmark covering rosids, asterids, and monocots, PlantGeneAnn surpassed four state-of-the-art baselines across five evaluation levels, from base-level classification to complete transcript recovery. It achieved higher intron precision and better captured complex gene structures. In zero-shot variant effect prediction, PlantGeneAnn identified cryptic splice donors and premature stop codons in maize and rice, with saturation mutagenesis confirming single-nucleotide, context-dependent sensitivity. It also retained generalizability for epigenomic track prediction, highlighting its value for pan-genomics, crop improvement, and non-model plant research.

analysis.tldr: 提出PlantGeneAnn，一个专为植物基因组设计的、能区分DNA正负链的预训练基础模型，仅用9个高质量植物基因注释数据微调，就能在13个植物物种上比多物种训练的大模型更准地从头预测基因结构（外显子/内含子/转录起始终止等），还能零样本预测突变对剪接和终止密码子的影响，并验证了单碱基上下文敏感性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索）
analysis.claim: 植物基因组注释质量比数据规模更重要；一个轻量但高质量、strand-specific、plant-optimized的基因组基础模型，可在跨类群植物中实现更鲁棒、更精确的ab initio基因结构预测，并具备零样本泛化到突变效应解析的能力。

papers.title: Tetradic Dynamics of Dyadic Sensorimotor Coordination: A Multiscale EEG Hyperscanning Study
papers.abstract: How do leader and follower roles shape the brain mechanisms that support coordinated action between people? This question has direct therapeutic relevance for conditions such as schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorder, where the capacity for reciprocal social coordination is a defining vulnerability. Here, we propose a tetradic framework and examine sensorimotor coordination in 16 healthy adult pairs using simultaneous dual-brain EEG hyperscanning, a 2 x 2 within-subject design crossing Role (Leader/Follower) and Condition (Mirroring/Matching). Mirroring required resonance with a partner's movement; Matching required its controlled transformation. This contrast was designed to dissociate automatic from controlled coordination processes across roles. Behaviourally, Mirroring produced a reaction-time advantage that was selective to Followers, a finding replicated in a combined cohort, and consistent with role-dependent attention-inhibition gating. At the neural level, sustained (tonic) activity was dominated by Matching-related frontoparietal engagement regardless of role, while time-resolved (phasic) activity revealed a Mirroring-dominant reorganization that differentiated into role-specific patterns: anticipatory gating in Leaders and post-response inhibitory rebound in Followers. Information-theoretic decomposition of inter-brain coupling identified a Leader-specific predictive signal in medial prefrontal and cingulate cortices, a Follower-specific adaptive signal across sensorimotor and temporal regions, and a shared redundancy scaffold in orbitofrontal and insular cortices. These findings characterize tetradic coordination within dyads as a multiscale, role-asymmetric architecture in which top-down predictive control and bottom-up adaptive regulation are functionally dissociable. The tetradic framework provides an organizing scaffold for this dissociation, and the role-specific signatures it reveals offer candidate biomarkers for clinical populations in whom interpersonal coordination is disrupted.

analysis.tldr: 用双人同步脑电（hyperscanning）研究两人协作时‘领导者’和‘跟随者’角色如何导致大脑活动在时间尺度（持续性vs瞬时性）、空间分布（前额叶/感觉运动区/脑岛等）和信息流方向（预测性vs适应性）上的系统性差异，并提出‘四元动态’（tetradic）框架来刻画这种角色不对称的多尺度神经机制。
analysis.claim: 人际协调不是对称的神经过程，而是由角色定义的、在多尺度上功能分离的四元动态架构：领导者主导自上而下的预测控制，跟随者主导自下而上的适应调节，二者共享冗余整合基底。
analysis.input: 双人同步EEG信号+行为反应时+角色与任务条件（镜像/匹配）标签
analysis.output: 跨脑耦合的信息分解结果（预测信号/适应信号/冗余信号）+角色特异的时空神经活动模式
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖人类被试的EEG与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量双脑同步实验设计与信息论分析范式，首次在毫秒级时间分辨率上分离出角色特异的预测/适应神经信号源，但样本量小（16对）、未验证临床群体、无干预或闭环验证，属于扎实的机制发现而非临床转化或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：实证扎实、分析新颖，但限于健康人群小样本，尚未触及临床验证或闭环应用，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: Learning from Demonstration via Spatiotemporal Tubes for Unknown Euler-Lagrange Systems
papers.abstract: We present STT-LfD, a unified Learning from Demonstration (LfD) framework that integrates motion learning with control for unknown Euler-Lagrange systems. Unlike traditional decoupled approaches that track a fixed reference, the proposed method treats demonstrations as a data-driven safety specification. Using heteroscedastic Gaussian Processes, STT-LfD learns Spatiotemporal Tubes (STTs) as an intent envelope that capture time-varying precision requirements of a task. A closed-form feedback controller then enforces these learned constraints while respecting actuator limits, without requiring explicit system identification. The approach preserves the temporal structure of demonstrations, remains computationally efficient, and avoids explicit system identification. Hardware experiments on a mobile robot and a 7-DOF manipulator show that it outperforms baselines in robustness to disturbances and computational speed.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫STT-LfD的新方法，把人类示范动作建模成随时间变化的‘时空管’（STT），用异方差高斯过程学习这个管作为任务精度要求的安全包络，再用解析形式的反馈控制器实时满足该包络并遵守执行器限制，全程不依赖系统动力学模型，在移动机器人和7自由度机械臂上验证了抗干扰性和计算速度优于基线。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院马德拉斯分校
analysis.claim: 无需系统辨识即可将人类示范转化为带时变精度约束的安全时空包络，并通过解析控制器实时满足该包络。
analysis.input: 人类示教轨迹（位置/速度序列）
analysis.output: 满足时空管约束的实时闭环控制指令（力/扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: Clearpath Jackal移动机器人、Franka Emika Panda机械臂

papers.title: SPLC: Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) holds significant potential for crowd robot navigation in human-robot coexistence applications. However, the inherent complexity of pedestrian motion renders the design of effective reward functions for promoting socially compliant robot behaviors a persistent challenge. This paper proposes a Social Preference Learning for Crowd Robot Navigation (SPLC) algorithm to eliminate the need for detailed reward design. Its core innovation lies in the introduction of a social preference feedback mechanism to automatically generate preference data through principled preference evaluation criteria. By explicitly accounting for the intricacies of pedestrian dynamics, the pipeline mitigates the reward bias and facilitates the systematic quantification of broad social norms, thereby fostering socially compliant behaviors. Extensive experiments integrating SPLC with offline RL methods demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines across standard performance metrics. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the TurtleBot4 further validate the effectiveness of SPLC in practical human-robot coexistence settings. Our code and video demos are available at https://github.com/sklus949/SPLC.

analysis.tldr: 提出SPLC方法，用社会偏好反馈机制自动生成人类对机器人避让行为的偏好数据，替代人工设计奖励函数，让离线强化学习在人群导航中更符合社交规范，并在TurtleBot4真实机器人上验证了效果。
analysis.claim: 无需人工设计奖励函数，仅通过可解释的社会偏好反馈机制生成高质量偏好数据，即可训练出符合多维社交规范（如舒适距离、自然绕行、非侵入性）的离线RL导航策略。
analysis.input: 机器人观测（激光雷达+里程计+可能的视觉特征）+周围行人轨迹/位置状态
analysis.output: 导航动作（速度、转向角等连续控制指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量交互片段用于偏好标注与验证，但核心训练数据来自仿真或已有离线轨迹集（摘要未明说，但offline RL范式隐含需预收集轨迹数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的增量工作：解决了离线RL在人群导航中奖励设计难的问题，引入偏好学习思路合理，有真实机器人验证，但未突破社交规范的形式化建模瓶颈，未展示跨场景/跨机体泛化，未开源数据或benchmark，也未挑战更复杂的动态密集人群或长期交互；相比基石论文（如H2O/GR00T），缺乏具身范式创新、多模态闭环或大规模通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将偏好学习适配到人群导航的离线RL流程中，实证有效但边界清晰，未改变领域底层范式

papers.title: Programmable acoustic single cell manipulation with model-free machine learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Precise, non-invasive manipulation of individual living cells remains a central challenge in biomedical science, with far-reaching implications for single-cell analysis, tissue engineering, and the study of cell–cell interactions. Here, we report the first demonstration of single-cell control using bulk acoustic standing-wave acoustofluidics with closed-loop feedback. We introduce VeLO ( Ve ctor-based L ocal O ptimization), a model-free, reinforcement learning–inspired algorithm that enables programmable two-dimensional manipulation of individual cells using a single piezoelectric transducer. Without prior calibration or physical modeling, VeLO learns system dynamics online from acoustically induced cell displacements and automatically adapts to nonlinear, time-varying conditions. We achieve robust control across multiple cell types (DU-145, Jurkat, K-562) and independent manipulation of multiple cells, including controlled cell–cell contact. By combining simplicity of hardware with autonomous, adaptive control, this approach establishes multimodal acoustofluidics as a versatile tool for label-free, high-precision single-cell manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 用一个压电换能器产生声场，通过无模型的在线强化学习算法VeLO实时调整驱动信号，实现对单个活细胞在二维平面上的非接触、可编程精准操控，无需物理建模或预先标定。
analysis.claim: 仅用单个压电换能器和无模型在线学习算法VeLO，即可在未建模、时变、非线性声流体系统中实现鲁棒的、多细胞类型的、可编程的单细胞二维操控。
analysis.input: 实时显微视频中的细胞位置坐标（像素级）
analysis.output: 压电换能器的驱动电压波形参数（频率、相位、振幅组合）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实时显微视频反馈，但不依赖预录真实机器人操作数据；所有训练/适应均在线完成，无离线真实数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在声流体单细胞操控中实现免建模、在线自适应闭环控制，实证覆盖3种癌细胞系、多细胞独立操控及可控细胞接触，在生物物理操控范式上有实质性推进；但硬件仍属定制微流控平台，未开源代码/模型，未与主流单细胞平台（如OptoFluidic、optical tweezers）做定量性能对比，也未验证下游应用（如测序兼容性、长期活性），属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在控制范式（免建模+在线RL），但工程闭环完整性和生物应用深度不足，尚未达到‘开新范式’门槛

papers.title: Molecular Structure, DNA Binding, and Photophysical Properties of SYTOX Orange and SYTOX Green
papers.abstract: Fluorescent dyes are critical to visualizing nucleic acids in many applications. SYTOX Orange and SYTOX Green are cyanine dyes, used in dead cell staining and increasingly in single-molecule assays to probe DNA supercoiling and processing. However, their structures and effects on DNA mechanics are not or only partially known. We determine the structure of SYTOX Orange to be (E)-2-((2-(4 ((diethyl(methyl)ammonio)methyl)phenyl)-6-methoxy-1-methylquinolin-4(1H)-ylidene)methyl)-4-methyloxazolo[4,5-b]pyridin-4-ium, identical to SYBR Gold except for an aza-benzoxazol core that is fundamentally different from other dyes in the SYTOX and SYBR families. We report SYTOX Green to be (Z)-2-(bis(3-(trimethylammonio)propyl)amino)-4-((3-methylbenzo[d]thiazol-2(3H)-ylidene)methyl)-1-phenylquinolin-1-ium, similar to PicoGreen. Using magnetic tweezers, we characterize the effect of SYTOX Orange and SYTOX Green on DNA mechanics. They lengthen and unwind DNA consistent with intercalation and the DNA unwinding angles per dye are 21.1(1) degree and 20.5(1) degree for SYTOX Orange and Green, respectively. Both dyes leave the DNA bending persistence length and plectoneme size almost unaltered (<10% change up to 1 uM), which is advantageous in assays probing DNA supercoiling. Their photophysical properties reveal close agreement between single-molecule manipulation and optical absorbance and fluorescence spectroscopy. Our comprehensive set of complementary measurements relates mechanical and optical properties to the molecular structures and provides recommendations for their use in applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过化学结构解析、单分子磁镊力学测量和光谱表征，首次精确确定了SYTOX Orange和SYTOX Green两种常用核酸染料的分子结构，量化了它们对DNA长度、扭转角、弯曲刚度和超螺旋行为的影响，并将结构-力学-光学性质三者系统关联，为单分子DNA实验中染料选择提供实证依据。
analysis.claim: SYTOX Orange和SYTOX Green并非如文献长期误传的‘类似SYBR系列’，而是具有独特核心结构的新型氰菁染料；它们以典型插层模式结合DNA，造成约21°的特异性DNA解旋，但几乎不扰动DNA弯曲刚度和超螺旋拓扑参数，因此比传统染料更适配高精度单分子DNA力学研究。
analysis.input: 纯化DNA分子、染料溶液、磁镊力-扭矩控制信号、吸收/荧光光谱输入
analysis.output: 染料精确分子结构式、DNA伸长量/解旋角/持久长度/plectoneme尺寸变化量、吸收/发射峰位与量子产率
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，全部基于生物物理实验平台（磁镊、光谱仪）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量基础工具性研究：首次给出两种广泛使用的商业染料的准确结构与定量DNA力学扰动参数，填补关键方法学空白；虽未开新范式或生成模型，但其结构-力学-光学三重验证体系为单分子DNA领域提供了不可替代的基准数据，显著优于一般染料表征论文，但未达AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级通用性建模高度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——不是概念包装，而是用多维实验证据把长期模糊使用的工具染料‘钉死’在结构与功能坐标上，直接提升单分子DNA实验的可重复性与解释严谨性。

papers.title: ProtPen combines sequence- and structure-based approaches to facilitate protein function predictions on a proteome-wide scale
papers.abstract: Proteins of unknown function represent a significant gap in our understanding of biological processes, encompassing large portions of the proteomes of many organisms, especially prokaryotes. Addressing this gap is critical to understanding the biology and pathogenicity of such organisms. We introduce ProtPen, an open-source pipeline that facilitates protein function prediction by combining eggNOG-mapper for sequence-based annotation with Foldseek for rapid structural similarity searches using AlphaFold-predicted protein structures. Annotation results from both tools are merged and enriched with UniProt metadata to produce a comprehensive output suitable for downstream analysis. The pipeline requires only a FASTA input file with UniProt identifiers, and is designed to analyze datasets on the scale of whole proteomes. Benchmarking on a curated dataset of well-characterized Pseudomonas aeruginosa proteins demonstrated an annotation accuracy of >90%, and highlighted the complementarity of sequence- and structure-based methods. Further evaluation of ProtPen included its application to biologically relevant datasets, comprising proteins of unknown function that exhibited significant differential abundances in a proteomics dataset of P. aeruginosa, and uncharacterized glycoproteins from Haloferax volcanii. ProtPen is readily extensible to incorporate additional protein function prediction tools. In summary, this pipeline facilitates the systemwide annotation of proteins of unknown function from proteomic datasets and whole proteomes.

analysis.tldr: ProtPen是一个开源流程，把序列比对（eggNOG-mapper）和结构比对（Foldseek+AlphaFold预测结构）结果合并，并补充UniProt元数据，用于大规模蛋白质功能注释，尤其针对未知功能蛋白。
analysis.claim: 整合序列与结构信息的自动化流程ProtPen能显著提升全蛋白组尺度下未知功能蛋白的功能预测准确率与覆盖度。
analysis.input: FASTA文件（含UniProt ID）
analysis.output: 结构化功能注释报告（含GO、EC、COG、描述、置信度等）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 是实用型工程整合（非模型创新），依赖已有工具（eggNOG-mapper/Foldseek/AlphaFold），无新算法或架构；虽在P. aeruginosa上达>90%准确率，但未验证跨物种泛化性，未开源训练数据或模型权重，也未与ESM/AlphaFold系方法对比，仅属扎实的流程级增量，远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2）的范式突破或底层建模创新。

papers.title: A Chromosome-level Genome Assembly of the Potato Leafhopper Empoasca fabae (Hemiptera: Cicadellidae)
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT The potato leafhopper, Empoasca fabae (Harris, 1841), is a highly polyphagous, migratory insect pest of eastern North America that feeds on more than 200 herbaceous and woody plant species, causing substantial losses to forage and field crops. Despite its agricultural and ecological importance, no genome has been available for this species. Here, we present the first chromosome-level genome assembly of E. fabae , generated from Oxford Nanopore long reads, Illumina short reads, and Omni-C proximity-ligation data. The final assembly spans 908 Mb across 132 scaffolds, with 99.8% of the assembly captured in ten chromosome-length scaffolds (nine autosomes and an X chromosome) with a scaffold N50 of 96.2 Mb. The assembly is highly complete, recovering 92.4% of conserved hemipteran single-copy orthologs, and is composed of 47.6% repetitive sequence, dominated by long terminal repeat retrotransposons and unclassified elements. Read-depth comparison between male and female individuals supports assignment of a single sex-linked chromosome, consistent with an XO sex-determination system. BRAKER3 gene annotation predicted 31,406 protein-coding genes after retaining the longest isoform per locus. Comparative genome analysis against the two closest related Typhlocybinae species with genomes available, Matsumurasca onukii and Hebata decipiens , revealed extensive chromosome-scale collinearity, while defining a shared core gene repertoire. This reference genome provides a foundation for comparative and population genomic studies and for investigating genetic traits in this economically important crop pest species. SIGNIFICANCE Leafhoppers (Cicadellidae) are among the most diverse families of plant-feeding insects, but chromosome-level genomes remain scarce, particularly for mesophyll-feeding members of the subfamily Typhlocybinae. The potato leafhopper, Empoasca fabae , is an unusually polyphagous crop and migratory pest of major importance across North America. Here, we provide the first chromosome-level genome assembly for this species. This chromosomal reference reveals broad synteny with two related Typhlocybinae relatives. This assembly will serve as a critical resource, enabling further comparative genomics, population genomics, and functional studies of host-plant adaptation in a significant agricultural crop pest species.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文首次为马铃薯叶蝉（一种危害严重的农业害虫）构建了染色体水平的高质量基因组组装，整合了纳米孔长读长、Illumina短读长和Omni-C染色质构象数据，获得了10条染色体长度的连续序列，并完成了基因注释和比较基因组分析。
analysis.claim: 本研究提供了首个染色体水平的马铃薯叶蝉（Empoasca fabae）基因组组装，填补了该重要农业害虫无高质量参考基因组的空白，并揭示其与近缘种间广泛的染色体共线性。
analysis.input: Oxford Nanopore长读长 + Illumina短读长 + Omni-C染色质互作数据
analysis.output: 染色体水平基因组组装（10条染色体长度scaffold）、31,406个蛋白编码基因注释、重复序列组成、性染色体判定、与近缘种的共线性图谱
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量物种基因组资源建设：技术扎实（多平台整合+染色体锚定+完整BUSCO评估+性染色体验证+跨种比较），但本质是单物种参考基因组产出，未解决方法学普适性问题，也未开展功能验证或群体/适应性机制实证；显著优于普通基因组草图（如仅Illumina scaffold N50<1 Mb），但远未达AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等定义新范式的里程碑级别，亦未达到dtSFM级药物靶点特异性建模的科学纵深。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——是农业害虫基因组学中一次高质量、可复用的基础资源建设，但非方法论突破，也未延伸至机制或应用层实证。

papers.title: A Scale-adaptive Vision Model Links C. elegans Neuronal Morphology to Behavior for Neurotoxicity Assessment
papers.abstract: Neurological disorders are a leading cause of global disability and are increasingly linked to environmental chemical exposures. Yet neurotoxicity assessment still relies on hand-scored morphological readouts that are subjective and poorly predictive of behavioral outcomes. Caenorhabditis elegans provides a genetically tractable, 3R-compliant alternative, but quantifying neuronal phenotypes from confocal microscopy at scale remains computationally challenging: existing vision foundation models, trained on natural or radiological images, cannot resolve the sparse signals and multi-scale lesions of neuronal imaging. Here, we introduce a dedicated self-supervised vision model for C. elegans dopaminergic neurons, together with CeNeuMorph, a multi-grained confocal benchmark of 27,117 annotated images. Specifically, moving beyond standard Masked Autoencoders, we propose a scale-adaptive masked image modeling strategy that jointly learns representations across resolutions and patch sizes under a fixed token budget. By decoupling structural semantic learning from rigid grid constraints, the model effectively resolves the full spectrum of neurodegenerative lesions - ranging from fine dendritic beading to gross soma shrinkage - within a tractable computational framework. Finally, our model surpasses both generalist and biomedical foundation models across classification, segmentation and detection tasks. Fusing visual features with morphological descriptors enables prediction of dopamine-dependent behavioral deficits ($R^2=0.498$). Screening 180 agrochemicals, we identify the benzimidazole moiety as a previously unrecognized determinant of dopaminergic neurotoxicity. Together, the work demonstrates how scale-adaptive self-supervised learning can connect morphology to function for a scalable alternative to mammalian in vivo models for neurotoxicity assessment and drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专为线虫多尺度神经元图像设计的自监督视觉模型，用新构建的2.7万张标注图像数据集CeNeuMorph验证，能准确识别从树突珠化到胞体萎缩等不同尺度的神经退行性病变，并将形态特征与多巴胺依赖行为缺陷关联（R²=0.498），进而筛出苯并咪唑类农药具有新型多巴胺神经毒性。
analysis.claim: 尺度自适应的自监督视觉模型可桥接C. elegans神经元形态学表型与行为功能输出，实现高通量、客观、预测性神经毒性评估。
analysis.input: C. elegans多尺度共聚焦显微图像（含 dopaminergic neuron 的完整形态）
analysis.output: 神经元病变类型分类/分割/检测结果 + 形态-行为关联预测（R²值） + 毒性化合物筛选结论
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实显微图像数据，无机器人交互或控制环节
analysis.significance_reason: 真机图像+多任务评测+消融验证+2.7万标注图像基准+实际180种农化物筛查发现新毒性基团，证据链完整；但未开源代码/模型，且仅限单一神经元类型和线虫模型，泛化性受限，未达AlphaFold级范式突破，属扎实重磅工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在AI×神经毒理学交叉点上完成端到端闭环验证（图像→形态→行为→毒性发现），技术扎实、数据扎实、应用落地明确，但未开源且模型泛化窄，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Bacteriocins in archaea and archaeocins in bacteria
papers.abstract: Archaea and bacteria routinely live side by side in microbial communities and must interact at least on occasion. Whether such cross-Domain interactions are dominated by mutual disregard, co-operation, or conflict remains fundamentally unknown. One potential window into archaeal-bacterial conflict is to ask whether some of the molecular weapons bacteria wield to kill other bacteria are present in archaea, and vice versa. Here, to start to address this question, we carry out a phylogenomic survey of bacteriocins in archaeal genomes and archaeocins in bacterial genomes. We find that more than 20% of known bacteriocins — proteins deployed by bacteria against other bacteria — have at least one homolog in archaea. Typically, these archaeal homologs are related to bacteriocins targeting (and encoded by) monoderm bacteria. Based on conservation of functionally critical residues, protein structure, and accessory genes critical for bacteriocin biosynthesis, we highlight homologs of subtilosin A, encoded in some Thermococcus archaea, as promising candidates for experimental follow-up work. We also show that halocin C8, originally described in Natrinema archaea, is comparatively common in bacterial genomes, including a number of skin-resident Staphylococcus species. Our results suggest that bacteriocins/archaeocins are shared across Domain boundaries with some regularity. While many instances are phylogenetically isolated — raising doubts about their functional importance and integration into host physiology — some bacteriocins are present in multiple related genomes and embedded in broader biosynthetic gene clusters that are also found in the original producers, suggesting that archaea and bacteria periodically use the same weapon systems in conflicts with other microbes. Further study of these systems might elucidate cross-Domain conflict and the nature of archaeal-bacterial interactions in different environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过大规模基因组比对，发现细菌产生的抗菌肽（bacteriocins）和古菌产生的类似分子（archaeocins）在域间存在显著的同源共享现象，例如20%以上已知细菌素在古菌中有同源体，而古菌来源的halocin C8也频繁出现在细菌（如皮肤葡萄球菌）基因组中，提示微生物跨域‘武器’水平基因转移可能真实发生。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，仅知Tobias Warnecke为伦敦大学学院UCL系统生物学教授，Romain Strock为其团队博士后；UCL为英国高校）
analysis.claim: 细菌素与古菌素在细菌和古菌基因组中存在系统性跨域同源分布，部分同源体保留关键功能特征和完整生物合成基因簇，支持其在跨域微生物冲突中具有真实生物学功能。
analysis.input: 公开古菌/细菌全基因组序列 + 已知细菌素/古菌素蛋白序列库
analysis.output: 跨域同源蛋白匹配列表、保守位点分析、结构预测、基因组上下文（GCF）共线性证据
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次系统性揭示细菌与古菌间抗菌肽类分子的跨域同源性及潜在功能保守性，提供了微生物域间冲突的新实证线索；但未做任何实验验证（无表达、纯化、抑菌活性测试），也未构建新模型或算法，属于高质量计算发现型工作，贡献扎实但未达范式级或工具级影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨的比较基因组学方法发现了被长期忽视的跨域分子武器共享现象，证据链完整（序列+结构+基因簇），但缺乏湿实验验证，暂属领域内重要提示性发现而非突破。

papers.title: EgoGenesis: Egocentric World-Action Modeling with Online Anchored Projective Memory and Action-3D RoPE
papers.abstract: Egocentric video offers rich manipulation experience for embodied AI, yet collecting diverse egocentric data across scenes, objects, motions, and embodiments remains costly. We present \method, an egocentric world-action simulator that synthesizes controllable, high-quality manipulation videos to expand scarce real-world training data. \method{} builds on a pretrained video generation prior and introduces two geometry-aware conditioning mechanisms. Online Anchored Projective Memory (OAPM) preserves a first-frame 3D scene anchor while periodically refreshing a recent state during autoregressive generation. Action-3D Rotary Position Embedding (A3D-RoPE) encodes end-effector motion with camera-aware 3D rotary coordinates, injecting action geometry into skeleton-to-video cross-attention for precise control. Together, these components improve visual fidelity, geometric stability, and action alignment in long egocentric rollouts. Moreover, augmenting 400 real trajectories with 400 \method-generated trajectories improves out-of-distribution real-robot success from 77\% to 84\% on single-arm tasks and from 53\% to 70\% on dual-arm tasks, demonstrating that the synthesized data substantially improve downstream WAM generalization.

analysis.tldr: 提出EgoGenesis方法，用几何感知的视频生成模型合成高质量第一人称操作视频，通过在线锚定3D记忆和动作-3D旋转位置编码提升生成稳定性与动作对齐性，并用400条合成数据增强真实机器人训练，使单臂/双臂任务泛化成功率分别从77%→84%、53%→70%
analysis.claim: 几何感知的在线锚定记忆与动作-3D旋转位置编码可显著提升第一人称世界-动作建模中合成视频的几何稳定性与动作对齐性，进而有效增强真实机器人策略在分布外任务上的泛化能力。
analysis.input: 第一帧3D场景锚点+动作序列（末端执行器轨迹）+相机参数
analysis.output: 高保真、几何一致的长时序第一人称操作视频
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人轨迹（400条）用于微调与评估，但核心生成不依赖实时机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在egocentric视频生成中引入OAPM和A3D-RoPE两个几何感知设计并验证了sim2real增益（+7%/+17%），但未开源代码/模型，未提供生成视频质量定量指标（如FVD、motion consistency score），未对比主流世界模型基线（如DreamerV3、WEAVER），仅用400条真实轨迹+同等合成数据做下游微调，实验规模窄、消融不充分、缺乏跨机体/跨用户验证，属扎实但有限的增量改进，未触及世界模型核心状态持久性或闭环决策建模等基石问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在egocentric视频生成中做了有物理意义的几何建模改进，并实证提升了小规模真实机器人任务泛化，但未开源、未对标基石工作、未解决世界模型根本挑战，暂未达到重磅级别。

papers.title: MolecularCanvas: LLM-assisted Small-Molecule Drug Discovery via Structure-Guided Constraints
papers.abstract: Small-molecule drug discovery relies on iterative molecular optimization, where chemists repeatedly modify candidate compounds to balance multiple competing properties such as efficacy, toxicity, and solubility. Recent advances in generative AI (GenAI) have shown promise in accelerating this process by automatically proposing new molecular structures or targeted modifications. However, existing GenAI-based molecular design tools remain poorly aligned with experts' real-world workflows. Specifically, they offer limited support for specifying structure-level modification intents on molecules, provide insufficient transparency into model-generated modifications, and lack integrated support for downstream property evaluation with external computational tools. To address these challenges, we introduce MolecularCanvas, an interactive system that enables users to iteratively construct an optimization context by integrating high-level goals, structure-level annotations, property constraints, and reference-based preferences. This context guides the generation of candidate molecules across diverse molecular structures. MolecularCanvas further enhances transparency by providing evidence for AI-generated suggestions and streamlines molecular evaluation by integrating commonly used computational tools for property assessment into a unified interface. Finally, a user study with 12 participants demonstrates the usefulness and effectiveness of MolecularCanvas in helping users optimize candidate molecules.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个交互式系统MolecularCanvas，让药物化学家能用自然语言+分子结构标注+属性约束+参考分子来指导大模型生成优化后的候选小分子，并集成计算工具自动评估性质，还做了12人的用户研究验证易用性。
analysis.claim: 通过结构引导的多模态约束交互范式，将LLM深度嵌入药物化学家真实迭代优化工作流，显著提升人机协同分子设计的可控性、可解释性与评估闭环效率。
analysis.input: 自然语言目标描述+分子结构图（带局部标注）+数值型属性约束（如logP≤3.5）+参考分子SMILES
analysis.output: 优化后的候选小分子SMILES列表及每条建议的生成依据（如‘基于哌啶环替换提升溶解度’）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了AI药物设计中长期存在的‘人机意图对齐’痛点，交互设计扎实且有用户实证，但未引入新分子生成模型或新物理建模，核心LLM和评估工具均为调用现有方法（如RDKit、Chemprop），无端到端性能突破或大规模验证，属于高质量工程整合而非科学范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有LLM、化学工具链和交互设计有机缝合进真实药物优化流程，实用性强但底层无新算法或新发现。

papers.title: GraspMeanFlow: SE(3)-Equivariant MeanFlow for Few-Step 6-DoF Grasp Generation
papers.abstract: Recent data-driven methods for synthesizing 6-DoF grasp poses use generative models to learn complex grasp pose distributions and generate diverse candidate poses. In particular, SE(3)-equivariant flow-based models generate grasp poses that transform consistently with object rotations and translations. However, these methods sample by iterative numerical integration, requiring tens of function evaluations per grasp and limiting their use in real-time manipulation. We propose GraspMeanFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant MeanFlow framework for few-step 6-DoF grasp generation. Our method learns the average velocity over a finite time interval, defined through the time-ordered exponential so that it reproduces exactly the rigid-body displacement accumulated over that interval. We prove that a point-cloud-conditioned distribution transported by an equivariant average-velocity flow map remains invariant, so equivariance is retained under few-step sampling, and we condition the field on a pair of times by lifting both to equivariant vectors, leaving the backbone otherwise unchanged. For stable training, we pair a flow-matching boundary term with either of two consistency terms: the differential MeanFlow identity, whose target requires a Jacobian-vector product, or an equivalent semigroup loss that avoids it. Experiments on ACRONYM show that a single function evaluation of GraspMeanFlow reaches the EMD that an iterative SE(3) flow model needs five steps to approach, that a second instantiation of the same framework improves grasp success by up to 24.3 points in the few-step regime, and that both generate grasp distributions transforming exactly with the object.

analysis.tldr: 提出GraspMeanFlow，一种SE(3)-等变的均值流模型，用1–2次函数调用就能生成6自由度抓取位姿，大幅加速传统需数十步迭代的SE(3)流式抓取生成方法，且严格保持刚体变换下的等变性。
analysis.claim: 通过定义基于时间序指数映射的等变平均速度场，可在极少步数下精确复现刚体位移，同时严格保持SE(3)-等变性，突破现有流模型在实时抓取生成中的步数瓶颈。
analysis.input: 物体点云
analysis.output: 6自由度抓取位姿（SE(3)元素）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅在ACRONYM仿真数据集上验证
analysis.significance_reason: 理论设计有亮点（时间序指数+等变平均速度），实证仅在ACRONYM仿真点云上验证EMD和成功率提升，无真实机器人部署、无跨物体/跨场景泛化测试、无与SOTA抓取器（如PointNetGPD、Contact-GraspNet、DiffGrasp）的端到端对比，更未触及具身操作闭环；相比T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等基石工作，它不涉及感知-动作闭环、不解决接触建模或实时控制问题，纯属生成模型层面的采样加速改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将SE(3)流采样的数值积分优化为一步/两步解析近似，在生成效率上有实用价值，但未改变抓取生成范式，也未进入真实操作闭环验证，属于扎实但窄域的算法提速工作。

papers.title: PhyLatent: Learning Dynamics-Relevant Representations for JEPA World Models
papers.abstract: We propose PhyLatent, a dynamics-relevant training objective for JointEmbedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Our key observation is that preventing global latent collapse does not ensure that a representation preserves physical states and action consequences. We identify three failure modes in JEPA world models: physical invariance collapse, physical identifiability collapse, and counterfactual dynamics collapse. PhyLatent addresses them through three training pathways: physical invariance, physical identifiability, and counterfactual dynamics, implemented with physical state grounding, future representation alignment, static visual invariance, counterfactual branch separation, and latent denoising. On OGBench-Cube, PhyLatent reduces the three failure rates from 15.60%, 6.71%, and 8.41% to 7.53%, 0.95%, and 4.62%, respectively, and improves model predictive control (MPC) success from 70.0% to 78.1%. With the same architecture and planner, it further improves success from 81.0% to 98.0% on TwoRooms and remains competitive on Reacher and PushT. These results show that global non-collapse alone is insufficient for learning a reliable JEPA worldmodel state space.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对JEPA类世界模型容易丢失物理动力学关键信息的问题，设计了三个针对性训练目标（物理不变性、可识别性、反事实动力学），在多个仿真机器人控制任务上显著降低了三种崩溃率并提升了MPC成功率。
analysis.claim: 仅防止全局潜在表示坍缩不足以保证JEPA世界模型学到可靠的动力学相关状态表征；必须显式建模物理不变性、物理可识别性和反事实动力学才能提升预测与控制性能。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+动作序列
analysis.output: 未来多步状态表征（latent）及对应动力学相关预测
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，完全基于仿真环境
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有洞见的失败模式分类和对应正则化路径，在OGBench-Cube等仿真benchmark上有量化改进，但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨仿真器/跨任务泛化，也未触及真实机器人或长期记忆等世界模型核心瓶颈，属于扎实但窄域的算法改进，远未达DreamerV3或WEAVER级范式突破或工程整合水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在JEPA框架内识别出三类动力学表征失效并给出可量化的缓解方案，但缺乏开源、泛化验证与真实系统验证，尚未构成范式推进或工程可用性。

papers.title: MolBioKG: Grounding Out-of-Graph Molecules in Biomedical Knowledge Graphs via Multi-Resolution Structural Anchoring
papers.abstract: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) accelerate drug discovery, but standard pipelines assume query molecules already exist as graph entities, leaving unregistered molecules disconnected. We address this cold-start challenge, termed the out-of-graph molecule problem, by introducing MolBioKG. This two-layer system grounds unseen molecules in biomedical evidence via multi-resolution structural anchoring. It connects an index of 2.74 million molecules (represented by scaffolds, fragments, functional groups, and fingerprints) to a 9.6-million-edge KG. Given only a SMILES string, MolBioKG retrieves structurally related graph entities and traverses their biomedical neighborhoods without task-specific training. It features two inference mechanisms: static multi-anchor retrieval using Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and Adapt-KG, a tool-using LLM policy for adaptive traversal. Evaluated across in-graph link recovery, complex multi-hop reasoning, and out-of-graph generalization, MolBioKG outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it raises Hits@10 from 0.585 to 0.876 in multi-hop reasoning and out-of-graph target recall from 0.145 to 0.269, all while ensuring predictions retain traceable structural anchors and source-attributed KG evidence.

analysis.tldr: 提出MolBioKG系统，让未在生物医学知识图谱中注册的新分子（仅给SMILES字符串）能通过多尺度结构锚定（支架/片段/官能团/指纹）自动关联到图谱中已有实体及其生物医学证据，无需任务特定训练，支持静态检索和LLM驱动的自适应图遍历。
analysis.claim: 未注册分子可通过多分辨率结构锚定被无监督地、可追溯地锚入现有生物医学知识图谱，并支撑多跳推理与冷启动目标召回。
analysis.input: 单个SMILES字符串
analysis.output: 结构锚定的图谱实体列表 + 其生物医学邻域证据（含可追溯的锚点来源与KG边）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 真机验证不适用，但实证扎实：在in-graph链路恢复、复杂多跳推理、out-of-graph泛化三类任务上显著超越强基线（Hits@10提升0.291，召回率翻倍），且所有预测均附带结构锚与KG溯源；但未开源代码/模型，依赖项目页有限复现，且未展示下游实验（如真实药物靶点预测或湿实验验证），未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但属当前KG+化学表征交叉中少有的端到端可解释、免微调、多尺度结构对齐方案。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将分子结构表征、知识图谱检索与LLM工具调用有机耦合，实证充分且设计可解释，但缺乏开源与下游闭环验证，尚未构成范式级突破

papers.title: Convergent biosynthesis of insect molting hormones in plants
papers.abstract: Insect herbivores have driven plants to evolve complex chemical defenses, including mimics of the arthropod molting hormone 20-hydroxyecdysone (20E). Many distantly related plants produce 20E, suggesting multiple, independent evolutionary origins. However, despite the prevalence of 20E in arthropods and plants, complete biosynthetic pathways have remained elusive. Here, we combine genomics, gene co-expression, and enzyme characterization to discover convergent 20E biosynthetic pathways from spinach and quinoa (amaranth family) and Ajuga species (mint family). We reveal that these families use distinct biosynthetic gene clusters to produce 20E and related phytoecdysteroids, highlighting both biochemical and genetic convergence of 20E biosynthesis in plants. Our work establishes the first complete 20E pathways in any organism and provides foundational insight into the evolution of this animal hormone across kingdoms of life.

analysis.tldr: 通过基因组学、共表达分析和酶功能验证，首次在植物中解析出两种完全独立演化的20-羟基蜕皮激素（20E）生物合成通路，分别来自藜科（菠菜、藜麦）和唇形科（筋骨草），证明植物跨科趋同进化出合成动物激素的能力。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 植物中20-羟基蜕皮激素的生物合成在藜科和唇形科中通过完全不同的基因簇独立演化实现，构成跨界的生化与遗传趋同。
analysis.input: 植物基因组序列、转录组共表达数据、候选基因编码酶的体外催化反应底物
analysis.output: 完整的20E从胆固醇前体出发的多步酶促反应路径、关键基因簇定位、酶功能验证结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在任意生物中解析出完整的20E从头合成通路，且揭示跨被子植物两大科的趋同演化机制；虽未达AlphaFold2级范式革命，但属植物次生代谢与跨界激素演化领域的里程碑——填补了长达数十年的通路空白，为化学生态学、植物防御工程及昆虫干扰策略提供不可替代的分子基础。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：不是算法创新，而是用多组学实证攻克了一个存在数十年的经典生物学难题，证据链完整（基因组→共表达→异源表达→酶动力学→产物鉴定），且结论具有跨科普适性

papers.title: GWM-VLA: Geometry-Aware Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but often degrade under visual and environmental shifts. Latent world modeling offers a promising approach to improving robustness, yet existing methods commonly encode camera views independently and predict holistic scene dynamics without explicitly modeling their geometric relationships. We propose GWM-VLA, a geometry-aware latent world modeling framework for VLA learning. GWM-VLA combines geometry-aware multi-view state encoding, global context-conditioned target-view prediction, and shared latent-action representations grounded by robot-action supervision. Specifically, VGGT-$Ω$ jointly aggregates multi-view observations at each timestep to construct geometry-aware multi-view states. The latent world model predicts the next-step patch tokens of a selected target view using patch and register tokens obtained after multi-view aggregation, thereby retaining multi-view geometric information without predicting the complete multi-view state. We use the wrist view as the target in our experiments, placing greater emphasis on end-effector motion and local gripper-object interactions. Finally, the shared latent-action representations condition both the latent world model and the flow-matching action head, allowing latent-prediction supervision and ground-truth robot-action supervision to jointly shape the same latent-action representations. Experiments across both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of GWM-VLA.

analysis.tldr: 提出GWM-VLA框架，在VLA模型中显式建模多视角间的几何关系，通过几何感知的多视图状态编码、目标视角patch级预测、以及共享潜动作表征，提升机器人操作在视觉和环境变化下的鲁棒性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写、无知名实验室特征词如DeepMind/Stanford/MIT/智元/清华等；姓名均为中文名但无 affiliation 线索）
analysis.claim: 显式建模多视角几何关系的潜世界模型，能显著提升VLA模型在视觉与环境扰动下的泛化鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像（含腕部视角）+语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的动作序列（连续控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人平台（未指明具体型号）及真实机械臂（实验提及real-world environments但无型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的数据（摘要称‘experiments across both simulation and real-world environments’，但未说明真实数据规模、来源或是否公开）
