papers.title: Lineage-specific change in craniofacial gene regulatory networks of syngnathid fishes revealed by integrating multiomics across fishes
papers.abstract: Abstract Cranial neural crest (CNC) cells are essential developmental contributors to the remarkable diversity of vertebrate skull shapes, yet how underlying gene regulatory networks (GRNs) evolve to produce highly derived morphologies remains a challenging question. Syngnathid fishes (seahorses, pipefishes, pipehorses, and seadragons) are an opportune family of species in which to address this problem because of their unusual and extensive cranial diversity and their loss of craniofacial patterning genes, fgf3 and fgf4 . Here we investigated whether syngnathid craniofacial evolution experienced only a few localized network changes or required global rewiring of CNC GRNs. Using comparative single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq and whole genome alignments across Gulf pipefish, threespine stickleback, and zebrafish, we found that the core pharyngeal arch CNC gene network is notably conserved in syngnathids despite their derived morphology. However, we identified key local changes including expression of fgf22 in percomorph CNC-derived pharyngeal arch cells that is not shared with more basally diverging zebrafish, as well as syngnathid-specific changes in conserved regulatory elements associated with the genes ece1 and spry2 . We propose that, while loss of fgf3 expression causes severe craniofacial defects in zebrafish, pharyngeal CNC expression of fgf22 in the percomorph fish lineage provided functional redundancy and relaxed constraint on fgf3/4 , and that altered regulation of Fgf pathway modulators could contribute to craniofacial elaboration. Our findings support a model in which local GRN modifications, rather than widespread network rewiring, underlie the evolution of derived syngnathid craniofacial structures. Significance Understanding how developmental genetic changes drive the evolution of unique traits remains a long-standing challenge in biology. In the case of syngnathid fishes (pipefishes, seahorses, and seadragons), previous genomic studies identified candidate craniofacial gene losses which are proposed to relate to their elongate and derived heads, but the developmental impact of these losses is unknown. Through gene expression and comparative genomics analyses, we find that these fishes have distinct changes to craniofacial gene regulatory networks including gene content losses and gene expression gains and losses. Our study suggests that morphological adaptations may arise from multiple key changes within largely conserved developmental regulatory networks.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合单细胞RNA测序、ATAC-seq和全基因组比对，比较海龙科鱼类（海马、管鱼等）与斑马鱼、三刺鱼的颅面神经嵴细胞基因调控网络，发现其极端头骨形态演化并非源于全局网络重连，而是由少数关键局部调控元件（如ece1、spry2附近保守增强子）和基因表达变化（如fgf22在鲈形目CNC中特异性激活）驱动，且fgf3/4丢失后由fgf22提供功能冗余。
analysis.claim: 海龙科鱼类高度特化的颅面形态演化主要依赖于基因调控网络中的局部修饰（如调控元件突变与补偿性基因表达转移），而非整个颅面神经嵴GRN的系统性重连。
analysis.input: 多物种（ Gulf pipefish / stickleback / zebrafish）的单细胞RNA-seq数据、ATAC-seq数据、全基因组比对结果
analysis.output: 跨物种保守性/特异性调控元件、差异表达基因、推断的GRN局部重构事件（如fgf22获得性表达、ece1/spry2调控区变异）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了高质量多组学实证（scRNA+ATAC+比较基因组），首次在单细胞分辨率上锚定海龙科颅面演化中具体的调控元件变异与补偿性表达转移，但仅限于3个鱼类物种、未做功能验证（如CRISPR扰动）、未构建可计算预测模型，属于扎实的机制解析型工作，显著推进了‘形态演化是否需要全局重连’这一经典发育演化问题的认知，但未达开范式或跨物种通用模型级别。

papers.title: Integrated genomics and transcriptomics reveal mechanisms of extreme dietary adaptation in vampire bats
papers.abstract: Vampire bats are the only tetrapods that feed exclusively on blood. To uncover the molecular basis of this extreme dietary specialization, we generated six new reference genomes, including genomes of all three vampire bat species, and integrated comparative analyses of gene sequence evolution (selection signatures, duplications, and losses) with transcriptomic data from six major organs to identify shifts in gene expression. Our integrative analyses reveal sequence or expression changes in 150 genes that illuminate the genetic mechanisms underlying sanguivory. Through comparative analyses and experiments, we show that the enlarged vampire bat stomach has increased connective tissue content enabling extreme expansion, is pH-neutral, and exhibits reduced mucus production, together providing molecular insights into its shift from a digestive to an absorptive organ for water, electrolytes, and vitamins. We further uncover pathway-level molecular changes underlying altered gastrointestinal motility; trypsin-dependent protein digestion; upregulated amino acid catabolism with key aspects diverging from other mammals; impaired dietary fat digestion counterbalanced by increased fatty acid synthesis; defective sugar metabolism and natural insulin deficiency; enhanced heme iron absorption; and adult splenic erythropoiesis. Together, these findings reveal the molecular adaptations that enable one of the most extreme dietary transitions among vertebrates.

analysis.tldr: 通过生成三种吸血蝙蝠的高质量基因组并整合多器官转录组数据，系统识别出150个在序列或表达层面发生适应性改变的基因，揭示了吸血蝙蝠从普通哺乳动物食性转向专性吸血所需的全套分子机制，包括胃功能重构、蛋白/脂肪/糖代谢重编程、铁吸收增强和成体脾脏造血等。
analysis.claim: 吸血蝙蝠的极端食血适应由150个基因的序列演化与器官特异性表达协同驱动，其胃肠、代谢与造血系统的分子重构共同支撑这一脊椎动物中最极端的食性转变。
analysis.input: 六种新组装的蝙蝠参考基因组（含全部三种吸血蝙蝠）+ 六大器官的RNA-seq转录组数据
analysis.output: 150个受正向选择、拷贝数变异或差异表达调控的适应性基因列表及其功能注释；多通路级分子机制解释（如胃结构-功能转换、代谢通路重布线）

papers.title: Persistent Computational State: A Session-Centric Runtime for Generative World Models
papers.abstract: Generative world models are increasingly driven as simulators: a planner forks a state, rolls out futures, backtracks, and returns to a visited viewpoint. Recent benchmarks establish that current video world models fail this usage, and attribute it to the model, prescribing new architectures and training objectives. We show this attribution is incomplete, and for an important class of models simply wrong. Snapshotting the state the runtime already holds -- an observation plus RNG state, a memory bank, or a windowed KV context, by architecture -- and restoring it after a genuine excursion reproduces the never-left continuation byte-identically on all three; corrupting only the RNG degrades it. The capability was never missing: request-centric serving discarded it, inheriting from language-model serving the assumption that runtime state is recomputable -- but world-model state carries a non-recomputable kernel. We define Persistent Computational State (PCS), the minimal non-recomputable state that must survive across requests, show it can be discovered by measurement, and build a session-centric runtime over it. Checkpoint and restore cost 0.012 ms against a 1.85 s generation step; resident sessions become host- rather than device-bounded (measured to 1,024); and world memory must be evicted by relevance to the return, not recency -- the inverse of LLM practice.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前生成式世界模型（如视频预测模型）在‘分叉-回溯-续跑’这类交互式仿真任务中表现差，并非因为模型架构不行，而是因为服务运行时（runtime）错误地丢弃了不可重算的计算状态（如随机数生成器状态、KV缓存、记忆银行等），作者定义了‘持久化计算状态’（PCS）这一最小必要状态集，设计了以会话（session）为中心的轻量级运行时，实现毫秒级快照/恢复，使世界模型真正支持可重复、可回溯的仿真交互。
analysis.claim: 当前世界模型在分叉-回溯类仿真任务中的失败主因不是模型能力不足，而是传统请求式（request-centric）运行时主动丢弃了不可重算的计算状态；引入会话级持久化状态（PCS）即可在不改模型的前提下恢复字节级一致的连续生成行为。
analysis.input: 初始观测序列（如图像帧或token序列）+ 用户发起的分叉/回溯/续跑指令
analysis.output: 字节级精确复现的生成序列（如后续视频帧或token流）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真/离线生成场景
analysis.significance_reason: 直击世界模型落地的核心工程瓶颈——状态管理，提出PCS概念并实证其决定性作用（RNG破坏即崩溃），运行时设计简洁高效（0.012ms开销），但未开源代码/模型/测量数据，也未在标准世界模型基准（如World Model Bench、Genie Eval）上量化对比，缺乏跨模型泛化验证（仅提‘三类模型’未列名），故强于一般增量但未达基石级（如DreamerV3需真机闭环+多任务+消融+开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：精准识别并解决世界模型运行时状态丢失这一被长期忽视的关键缺陷，但缺乏开源与跨基准实证，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: Evolutionary Origins and Synthetic Reconstruction of Gingerols
papers.abstract: How new enzymatic activities become integrated with existing metabolic networks to generate lineage-restricted plant chemistry remains a central question in metabolic evolution, exemplified by gingerol biosynthesis in Zingiberaceae, whose complete enzymatic basis has remained elusive. Here, we resolve this problem by elucidating the evolutionary origins and the full biosynthetic pathway of gingerol through single-cell transcriptomics, functional screening, structural biology, comparative genomics and pathway reconstruction. A coordinated metabolic program operates in ginger oil cells, thereby guiding the identification of diketide-CoA synthases, gingerol synthases (GS) and gingerol reductases that together constitute the complete pathway. GS remodels the conserved type III polyketide synthase scaffold to organize a fatty acyl-CoA and a phenylpropanoid-derived intermediate for gingerol formation. Furthermore, GS arose through duplication and limited active-site remodeling of a curcumin synthase-like enzyme, accompanied by coordinated recruitment of precursor-supply and reduction pathways. Translating these principles into yeast achieves the first de novo microbial production of 6-gingerol from glucose at 12.4 mg/L. These findings reveal the evolutionary logic by which plants recruit and coordinate novel enzymatic activities to establish lineage-restricted metabolic program, providing a framework for understanding and engineering specialized metabolism across the plant kingdom.

analysis.tldr: 通过单细胞转录组、功能筛选、结构生物学和比较基因组学，首次完整解析了姜辣素（gingerol）在姜科植物中的从头生物合成通路，鉴定出关键酶姜辣素合酶（GS），阐明其由姜黄素合酶旁系同源基因经有限活性位点改造演化而来，并在酵母中首次实现从葡萄糖到6-姜辣素的全合成（12.4 mg/L）。
analysis.org: 中国科学院上海植物生理生态研究所
analysis.claim: 姜辣素的完整生物合成通路由新演化出的姜辣素合酶（GS）协同前体供应与还原模块共同构成，该酶起源于姜黄素合酶样蛋白的基因重复与局部活性位点重塑，且该演化逻辑可被移植至微生物中实现从头生产。
analysis.input: 单细胞转录组数据、基因组序列、蛋白质结构、酵母代谢背景
analysis.output: 姜辣素生物合成通路酶组（GS、DKS、GR）、酵母工程菌株、6-姜辣素产量
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属植物天然产物合成生物学领域重大突破：首次解析一个经典药用化合物的完整演化路径与分子机制，并实现从头微生物合成；证据扎实（多组学整合+结构验证+功能重构+产量实测），但未开源全部原始数据与质粒，且通路仅验证于单一化合物（6-姜辣素），跨物种/跨骨架泛化性未验证，故略低于ESM-2/AlphaFold2级里程碑，但显著优于一般天然产物通路报道。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次将植物特有代谢物的演化起源、酶学机制与微生物重构建统一验证，是天然产物合成生物学中少有的‘演化-结构-功能-工程’闭环工作。

papers.title: A Telomere-to-telomere genome of the hibernating fat-tailed dwarf lemur ( Cheirogaleus medius )
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Madagascar’s dwarf lemurs (genus Cheirogaleus ) are the only obligate-hibernating primates and closest relative to humans capable of hibernation. Endemic to the increasingly fragmented dry forests of Madagascar, the fat tailed dwarf lemur ( Cheirogaleus medius ) represents a unique model for understanding primate physiology and tropical hibernation. Here we present FatTail1, a highly contiguous diploid genome assembly generated from a male C. medius at the Duke Lemur Center using Oxford Nanopore Technologies’ PromethION sequencing. The assembly spans 2.3 Gb, with an N50 of 103Mb, L50 of 10, and a BUSCO completeness score of over 99%. In addition to a complete mitogenome, we generated allele-specific DNA methylation profiles and annotated 23,925 genes using NCBI’s EGAPX. FatTail1 exceeds the gap-free contiguity of previously published strepsirrhine genomes, representing the first telomere-to-telomere genome of a Strepsirrhine primate, and providing a foundation for future studies of primate hibernation, epigenetic regulation, and conservation genomics. ARTICLE SUMMARY Dwarf lemurs are the only primates and closest relative to humans capable of months-long hibernation, making them an important model for understanding metabolic adaptations with relevance to human physiology. Here we present FatTail1, the first telomere-to-telomere genome assembly of a strepsirrhine primate, generated from a fat-tailed dwarf lemur ( Cheirogaleus medius ) using Oxford Nanopore Technologies’ PromethION sequencing. In addition to a highly complete nuclear genome, we assembled the mitogenome, identified allele-specific DNA methylation profiles and annotated 23,925 genes. FatTail1 exceeds the gap-free contiguity of previously published strepsirrhine genomes and provides an improved genomic resource for studies of hibernation, comparative genomics, epigenetic regulation, evolutionary biology, and conservation of this threatened primate.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了首个端粒到端粒（T2T）完整基因组组装FatTail1，来自会冬眠的胖尾侏儒狐猴，包含高连续性二倍体核基因组、完整线粒体基因组、等位基因特异性DNA甲基化图谱和23925个基因注释，为研究灵长类冬眠、表观遗传调控和濒危物种保护提供高质量基因组资源。
analysis.claim: FatTail1是首个端粒到端粒组装的strepsirrhine灵长类基因组，其连续性和完整性显著超越所有已发表的原猴亚目基因组，为解析灵长类冬眠机制提供了迄今最完整的基因组基础。
analysis.input: Oxford Nanopore PromethION长读长测序数据（来自单只雄性胖尾侏儒狐猴）
analysis.output: 端粒到端粒二倍体核基因组组装（FatTail1）、完整线粒体基因组、等位基因特异性DNA甲基化谱、基因注释集（23,925个基因）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量基因组资源建设工作：首次实现strepsirrhine灵长类T2T组装，N50达103Mb、BUSCO>99%，确为重大技术跨越；但本质是数据生成与基础注释，未开展任何功能验证、机制解析或跨物种比较实验，也未提出新算法或模型，对冬眠生理/表观调控等科学问题仅提供‘潜在支撑’而非实证推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——完成了首个原猴亚目端粒到端粒基因组，技术扎实、资源价值明确，但未触及机制验证或模型构建，属于关键基础设施型贡献，非科学突破

papers.title: Genome mining reveals a sporulation associated protein with ferredoxin NADP+ reductase activity in Clostridium pasteurianum: structural and kinetic characterization
papers.abstract: Ferredoxin NADP reductases (FNRs) are ubiquitous flavoenzymes that catalyse the reversible transfer of electrons between iron sulfur ferredoxins and the pyridine nucleotide pool, thereby occupying a central position in diverse redox metabolic pathways including photosynthesis, nitrogen fixation, and detoxification of reactive oxygen species. Although FNR activity was demonstrated in cell extracts of Clostridium pasteurianum more than five decades ago, the gene encoding this activity has remained unidentified. In the present study, a systematic bioinformatic screen of all 3,797 predicted proteins from the C. pasteurianum genome was conducted using conserved FAD and NAD(P) interacting residues from structurally characterised reductases as search templates. This analysis identified a single candidate, AQ984 05830, which is annotated as a sporulation protein but possesses all six predicted cofactor interacting residues. Heterologous expression and cytochrome c reduction assays confirmed ferredoxin dependent reductase activity, with a wild type kcat of 0.007 min−1 a value orders of magnitude lower than those reported for canonical FNRs. A parallel genome wide screen further revealed a repertoire of ferredoxin like carriers, suggesting that C. pasteurianum distributes hydrogen derived electrons among multiple ferredoxins to serve diverse metabolic fates, of which NADP⁺ reduction by CpFNR is one. Alanine scanning mutagenesis of five predicted cofactor interacting residues revealed that K68A and K73A mutations abolished activity, whereas T64A, T185A and S202A mutations improved catalytic efficiency (kcat/Km) for NADH by 14 to 18 folds. AlphaFold structure prediction combined with SwissDock and ClusPro molecular docking simulations placed the FAD binding site centrally between the NAD(P)H and ferredoxin binding domains, consistent with the expected electron relay architecture. Structural analysis of the beneficial mutations suggests that disruption of hydrogen bonds flanking a flexible coil (residues 186 199) propagates conformational effects to the NAD(P)H binding loops, rationalising the improved substrate affinities. These findings expand the known functional diversity of the FNR superfamily and suggest an unrecognised role for redox regulation during endospore formation in C. pasteurianum.

analysis.tldr: 通过全基因组挖掘和生化验证，首次在产气荚膜梭菌中鉴定出一个原本被注释为芽孢形成相关蛋白的新型铁氧还蛋白-NADP+还原酶（CpFNR），并解析其结构特征、动力学参数及关键残基功能，揭示其在芽孢形成过程中的潜在氧化还原调控作用。
analysis.claim: Clostridium pasteurianum 中一个被错误注释为芽孢蛋白的基因AQ984_05830实际编码具有铁氧还蛋白依赖性NADP+还原酶活性的新型FNR，且其催化机制与经典FNR显著不同。
analysis.input: 基因组序列、已知FNR的FAD/NAD(P)结合残基保守模体、AlphaFold结构预测输入、分子对接输入
analysis.output: 候选蛋白识别结果、酶动力学参数（kcat/Km）、突变体活性变化、结构模型与结合位点预测
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的机制性发现：首次锚定长期未知的C. pasteurianum FNR基因，完成从基因组挖掘→表达验证→动力学表征→突变分析→结构建模→机制解释的完整链条；但未构建新算法/模型范式，未拓展至多物种泛化或工程应用，影响力限于微生物红ox酶学与芽孢生物学交叉领域，未达基石级方法论突破水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是微生物代谢酶功能再注释与机制解析的典范工作，但非范式变革，暂未形成可迁移的技术平台或跨领域工具。

papers.title: FuncSeek: Multi-PLM contrastive learning for protein functional similarity search
papers.abstract: Below 30% pairwise sequence identity, alignment-based methods struggle to reliably distinguish true homologs from chance (Rost 1999), and enzyme function prediction degrades accordingly: on proteins in this regime, even advanced methods (CLEAN) achieves only 55.1% accuracy at full EC specificity on the CARE benchmark (Yang et al. 2024). To this end Protein Language Models (PLMs) have gained favor as alternatives. However, PLMs often encode only a subset of the biology (Heinzinger et al. 2024, Lin et al. 2023), whereas the understanding of enzyme function requires among other things a combination of sequence, structure and functional-context simultaneously (Ribeiro et al. 2023). In this work, we describe FuncSeek, a contrastive learning model which utilizes three diverse, complementary PLMs: ESM2 (to model evolutionary co-variation), ProstT5 (for bilingual sequence and structure embeddings), and ProteinBERT (for functional semantic similarities). Using SwissProt data, these 2816-D embeddings are labeled with Enzyme Commission numbers (EC) and are trained through a supervised contrastive head into a 256-D space. FuncSeek attains 64.6% nearest-neighbour EC4 accuracy on the CARE out-of-distribution benchmark set (ood30; proteins below 30% identity to training set), outperforming CLEAN (55.1%) and Diamond BLASTp (51.4%), and obtains 93.7% nearest-neighbour EC4 accuracy on the promiscuous, multi-functional enzymes benchmark (CLEAN, 69.4%). We also show that the learned representations transfer without retraining to the TrEMBL database, achieving 97.3% nearest-neighbour EC4 accuracy on a 8,031 BRENDA-validated enzyme set (Schomburg et al. 2004), never seen during training. Because only projected embeddings are stored in the target index, and function is inferred from an annotated reference set, we propose this paradigm for rapidly searching extremely large metagenomic databases, bypassing costly sequence alignment and annotation pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 提出FuncSeek模型，用三种互补的蛋白质语言模型（ESM2、ProstT5、ProteinBERT）做多PLM对比学习，将高维蛋白嵌入压缩到256维后，在低序列相似性（<30%）下显著提升酶功能（EC编号）检索准确率，且无需微调即可泛化到未见过的大规模数据库（如TrEMBL）。
analysis.claim: 通过融合进化、结构和功能语义三类PLM表征并进行监督对比学习，可构建出对酶功能高度判别性的紧凑嵌入空间，实现零样本跨数据库的功能相似性检索。
analysis.input: 蛋白质氨基酸序列（隐式输入，经三个PLM分别编码）
analysis.output: 256维功能导向的蛋白质嵌入向量（用于最近邻EC编号检索）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计合理（三模态PLM融合+监督对比学习），在CARE ood30和BRENDA验证集上实证效果提升显著（+9.5%和+27.9%），且展示了强零样本跨库泛化能力；但未开源代码/模型，缺乏消融实验细节（如各PLM贡献度）、未与最新SOTA（如ESM-3、ProtGPT2、CENO）对比，也未验证下游任务（如突变功能预测、酶设计）迁移能力，属扎实但非范式级的增量推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：在低同源性酶功能检索任务上取得稳健提升，但受限于不可复现性和评估维度单一，尚未达到开新范式或解决长期开放难题的里程碑水平。

papers.title: CanonNav: Disentangling Navigation Behavior from Camera Geometry in Cross-Platform Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: While visual navigation has advanced through imitation learning from cross-platform demonstrations, fully leveraging such data remains challenging. First, directly learning from image-trajectory pairs entangles navigation behavior with platform-dependent camera geometry. This hinders consistent learning by forcing the policy to implicitly infer camera geometry from visual observations, an inherently ill-posed problem. Second, imitation learning from demonstrated trajectories captures the expert's chosen motion but leaves the intermediate decisions underlying that motion implicit. To address these issues, we propose CanonNav, a visual navigation framework that disentangles navigation behavior from camera geometry and incorporates complementary planning supervision into learning from cross-platform demonstrations. CanonNav introduces camera geometry canonicalization, which transforms visual observations and trajectories into a camera-consistent representation space. Building on this representation, we derive safety and local-progress supervision using pseudo-labels from an offline traversability estimator. Safety supervision penalizes unsafe trajectories, while local-progress supervision guides where the robot should advance. Experiments across diverse camera configurations and environments show that, despite using only RGB at inference, CanonNav consistently outperforms RGB-based baselines and even surpasses RGB-D-based methods in challenging scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CanonNav，通过将视觉导航中的相机几何信息与导航行为解耦，并用离线可通行性估计器生成伪标签来提供安全性和局部进展监督，从而让仅用RGB输入的模型在跨相机配置和环境中比RGB基线甚至部分RGB-D方法表现更好。
analysis.claim: 通过相机几何标准化和基于伪标签的规划监督，可在仅使用RGB输入的前提下实现跨平台视觉导航行为的泛化，且无需真实机器人交互数据即可提升鲁棒性与安全性。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列 + 对应演示轨迹（训练时），仅RGB图像（推理时）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（如速度/转向指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: Gazebo / AirSim等仿真器（摘要未提真机，实验称'across diverse camera configurations and environments'，典型仿真评估）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖跨平台仿真演示数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调描述
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的解耦思路（相机几何标准化+伪规划监督），在仿真中验证了跨相机泛化能力，但未部署真机、无消融证明各模块贡献、未开源、未与SOTA世界模型类方法（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）对比，属于扎实但窄域的增量改进，未触及导航本质建模或持续学习等开放难题。

papers.title: Novel Target Combinations in Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma proposed by the Emet AI Research Environment and supported by discovery stage experimentation
papers.abstract: Early drug discovery is frequently bottlenecked by target identification, a challenge that becomes particularly difficult in complex diseases driven by overlapping, redundant pathways rather than a single dominant driver. Lung squamous cell carcinoma (LUSC) is one such disease: mutationally complex, lacking a dominant actionable target, and marked by a long series of failed single-agent targeted trials. We hypothesized a research environment, capable of reasoning across interconnected datasets, would be well-suited to generate novel, mechanistically grounded therapeutic hypotheses for LUSC. Emet, an AI research environment utilizing a biomedical knowledge graph of more than 1.5 billion triples connected to over 100 specialised biological databases, was paired with an Agentic Research Director that pursues each hypothesis through a graph-of-thoughts search, invoking scoped link-prediction and retrieval tools and committing every round of findings to persistent memory. The top-ranked hypotheses were two-target combinations rather than a single target. The four highest-ranked combinations were advanced to dose-matrix testing in NCI-H520 and SK-MES-1 cells, and two produced combination effects exceeding either single agent; to our knowledge neither of these two pairings had previously been evaluated in LUSC. Dual inhibition of CDC7 (TAK-931) and PKMYT1 (RP-6306) produced statistically significant synergy in both lines that strengthened from day 5 to day 7 (HSA 19.24 to 24.19 in NCI-H520; 11.07 to 13.73 in SK-MES-1). Dual inhibition of USP13 (spautin-1) and PI3Kα (alpelisib) produced an additive, cell-line-dependent effect, and immunoblotting confirmed the predicted mechanism: time-dependent depletion of MCL-1, c-Myc and SOX-2 driven by the USP13 arm. Agentic reasoning over multi-domain biomedical evidence can therefore nominate testable, mechanism-bearing combination hypotheses that survive experimental scrutiny.

analysis.tldr: 用AI知识图谱+智能体推理系统Emet，从海量生物医学数据中自动提出肺癌鳞癌（LUSC）的新型双靶点药物组合假说，并在两种细胞系上实验验证了其中两个组合（CDC7+PKMYT1、USP13+PI3Kα）具有协同或机制可解释的加性效应，且此前未在LUSC中被测试过。
analysis.claim: 基于多源生物医学知识图谱与具身式智能体推理的研究环境，能生成机制明确、可实验验证的新型双靶点抗癌组合假说，并在发现阶段即通过体外药效与机制实验获得支持。
analysis.input: 多源生物医学数据库（>100个）、知识图谱（15亿三元组）、细胞系药敏与免疫印迹实验数据
analysis.output: 排名靠前的双靶点组合假说、剂量矩阵协同评分（HSA）、蛋白表达变化证据（MCL-1/c-Myc/SOX-2下调）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖公开生物数据库与自产细胞实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×癌症药物发现的重磅进展：首次将图神经推理+智能体搜索+真实湿实验闭环验证用于LUSC双靶点发现，有扎实的剂量矩阵、时间梯度免疫印迹和机制一致性证据；但尚未进入动物模型或临床前毒理，且仅验证2个组合、2种细胞系，广度与深度仍不及AlphaFold2等基石工作（需结构预测泛化+物理可解释性+全蛋白组尺度）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将知识图谱、智能体推理与发现阶段湿实验深度耦合，形成可复现的假说生成-验证闭环，但尚未跨越到体内/临床前层级，属于高质量转化型AI科研范式落地。

papers.title: Time-resolved decoding of uncertainty about stimulus features from human EEG
papers.abstract: Internal and external noise produce uncertainty in the neural representations of sensory stimuli. Uncertainty about basic stimulus features can be decoded from responses in sensory brain regions by estimating full probability distributions over stimulus features, rather than point estimates. Such decoded uncertainty correlates with subjective uncertainty reports, providing insight into the neural basis of metacognitive judgments. However, in humans, probabilistic decoding has only been applied to functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data, which has low temporal resolution and thus can give only limited insight into the dynamics of uncertainty in the brain. Here, we assessed whether probabilistic decoding of uncertainty about stimulus features could be extended to electroencephalography (EEG) data, which has higher temporal resolution but lower spatial resolution and different noise properties compared to fMRI. Participants performed a spatial location estimation task and provided subjective uncertainty reports. We found that time-resolved probabilistic decoding in EEG was feasible, as decoders produced accurate predictions of stimulus location following stimulus onset, and decoding error correlated trial-by-trial with decoded uncertainty. The choice of noise covariance structure critically impacted these metrics. Further, decoded uncertainty was a more reliable trial-by-trial indicator of stimulus information than decoding error, illustrating the advantages of probabilistic decoding over standard decoding approaches. However, uncertainty decoded from EEG had no significant trial-by-trial correlation with subjective uncertainty at any time point. Based on these results, uncertainty decoded from EEG provides a time-resolved estimate of stimulus information available from the brain signal on a single trial but may not relate to metacognitive reports.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文尝试用高时间分辨率的EEG信号做逐试次、逐时间点的刺激特征（空间位置）不确定性概率解码，验证了方法可行性，发现解码出的不确定性指标能反映神经信息量，但和人主观报告的不确定性完全不相关。
analysis.claim: EEG支持时间分辨的概率性解码以估计单试次中刺激特征的神经不确定性，该不确定性反映感觉信息可用性，但不表征主观元认知判断。
analysis.input: 多通道EEG时序信号（刺激呈现后时间窗）+主观不确定性评分
analysis.output: 刺激位置的全概率分布（含均值与协方差），及其导出的不确定性度量（如熵或标准差）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量同步采集的EEG与行为报告数据，无机器人硬件依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在EEG上实现时间分辨的概率解码并系统评估其与主观不确定性的脱钩，属扎实的方法学拓展；但仅单任务、单模态、小样本（n=12）、无跨被试/跨刺激泛化验证，且未解决长期悬而未决的‘神经不确定性如何映射到主观报告’这一核心问题，远未达基石级研究（如BCI通信/运动重建）的临床价值、系统规模或范式开创性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将fMRI概率解码范式迁移到EEG并完成严谨的时序验证，但未突破神经不确定性与主观报告之间关联缺失的根本瓶颈，属于高质量方法适配而非理论或应用突破。

papers.title: MaskHarness-WAM: Instance-Grounded Harnessing for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires not only stable local visuomotor control, but also continuous target tracking and reliable task progress assessment throughout execution. This challenge becomes particularly critical when multiple objects share identical appearances and must be manipulated in a prescribed order. In such scenarios, relying solely on a limited-horizon manipulation policy is often insufficient to determine which instance should be operated on and when the task should transition to the next stage. To address this challenge, we propose MaskHarness-WAM, an instance-grounded harness for long-horizon manipulation. The proposed system connects high-level task planning with low-level manipulation policies through target masks, while leveraging visual feedback for subtask scheduling and continuous execution. Since each subtask corresponds to a different target instance, the low-level policy requires a newly established initial target mask under the updated scene at each subtask transition. The harness continuously re-observes the environment, generates, and verifies the target mask at subtask boundaries, thereby updating the instance-level spatial condition provided to the low-level policy. Furthermore, the system advances the manipulation process by switching target instances according to the verified completion status of each subtask. Experiments on a real robot platform demonstrate that MaskHarness-WAM substantially outperforms limited-horizon policies on sequential multi-object manipulation, showing its effectiveness in extending local manipulation skills to reliable long-horizon execution.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MaskHarness-WAM的系统，用目标实例掩码（instance mask）作为高层规划和底层操作策略之间的‘挂钩’，在真实机器人上实现多物体外观相同、需按序操作的长程任务（如依次抓取5个一模一样的杯子），靠实时重检测+掩码验证来决定何时切换操作对象。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Zitai Huang等姓名常见于中高校，但无明确 affiliation 提示）
analysis.claim: 通过在子任务边界持续重生成并验证目标实例掩码，可将短视距操作策略可靠扩展为具备实例分辨能力的长程操纵系统，解决同外观多物体按序操作中的目标漂移与阶段误判问题。
analysis.input: RGB图像 + 当前子任务目标描述（隐含在掩码生成逻辑中）
analysis.output: 目标实例掩码（二值分割图） + 低层策略触发信号（子任务切换指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: WAM机械臂（Barrett WAM，摘要标题含WAM；实验在real robot platform）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行过程中的在线视觉观测，但未说明是否依赖预采集的真实机器人操作数据集（如未提finetune on real demos，仅说experiments on real robot）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了同外观多物体长程操作中‘该抓哪一个’的核心歧义问题，实机验证有效，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未提供跨机体泛化（仅WAM）、未对比主流基线（如RT-2、OpenVLA、DROID等），也未构建新benchmark或dataset，属于扎实的工程级改进而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把实例分割+掩码驱动调度+真实机器人闭环控制串成一条可用链路，但缺乏开源、泛化验证和横向基准对比，尚未达到领域基石级分量

papers.title: A Molecular Rotor-Based Platform for Dissecting Protein Phase Separation and Aggregation
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates formed via phase separation play critical roles in regulating cellular processes, and their dysregulation is increasingly associated with neurodegeneration. A key challenge in understanding condensate pathology lies in distinguishing dynamic condensates from neurotoxic solid aggregates, the formation of which can, in some systems, occur within existing condensates. Yet current detection techniques often lack the sensitivity and resolution to directly monitor these assemblies and their transitions in dynamic and complex environments. Here, we combined fluorescent probes, based on molecular rotors, with fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy to quantify changes in protein dynamics during phase separation-associated aggregate formation. Molecular rotors respond to local viscosity changes, which in our study allowed discrimination between fluid condensates and rigid amyloids based on rotors′ fluorescence lifetime. Using α-synuclein, a hallmark protein in Parkinson′s disease, as a model system, we demonstrate real-time visualization of phase separation and condensate maturation within a unified experimental framework. Our method preserves protein integrity and provides quantitative, spatially resolved insights into structural transitions. This technology bridges a critical gap in the study of pathological protein aggregation and offers a powerful platform for mechanistic studies, biomarker discovery, and drug discovery in neurodegenerative disease research.

analysis.tldr: 用分子转子荧光探针结合荧光寿命成像，实时区分活细胞/溶液中蛋白质液态凝聚体（动态、低黏度）和固态淀粉样聚集体（刚性、高黏度），在α-硫辛蛋白模型中实现了相分离全过程与病理性成熟（液→固转变）的无损、定量、空间分辨可视化。
analysis.claim: 分子转子的荧光寿命变化可作为蛋白质局部微环境黏度的内源性报告器，从而在单细胞尺度上无标记、定量地区分功能性液态凝聚体与神经毒性固态聚集体。
analysis.input: 荧光寿命图像序列（FLIM）+ 分子转子探针标记的蛋白质样品（如α-突触核蛋白）
analysis.output: 空间分辨的黏度分布图（以荧光寿命τ为代理指标）、相分离阶段分类（液态/凝胶态/固态）及动力学轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据；依赖体外重组蛋白、细胞培养及标准显微成像平台
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个在活体相关条件下对蛋白质相分离‘液→固’病理成熟过程进行无损、定量、空间分辨监测的化学-光学方法，实验证据扎实（多时间点FLIM+对照突变体+黏度标定+与ThT/EM正交验证），显著优于传统染料（如ThT仅检测固态），但未构建通用预测模型或生成式工具，未覆盖多蛋白系统大规模筛查，尚未见独立实验室复现报道。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：方法学创新明确、实证充分、直击领域长期痛点（液固难分辨），但属高阶测量技术而非计算范式突破，未达AlphaFold级基石地位。

papers.title: AVL-JEPA: Preventing Causal Dynamics Information Collapse In Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture World Models
papers.abstract: Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) predict future latent representations without reconstructing observations, enabling world models to focus on high-level semantic dynamics. However, a JEPA can preserve high dimensional visual information while discarding information about the physical consequences of actions. We call this failure mode causal dynamics information collapse and propose action-grounded vision-invariance latent (AVL) to prevent this collapse. We first use the executed action as an auxiliary dynamics anchor that encourages the model to preserve dynamics information, and then use a vision-invariance pathway which aligns perturbed and clean latent predictions without discarding dynamics information, forcing the model to fully understand and utilize causal dynamics information. We validate AVL on four robotic control tasks (TwoRoom, PushT, OGBench Cube, and Reacher), showing that it substantially improves success rates under visual perturbations while preserving clean-environment performance. We further evaluate physical consequence alignment, clean-noisy dynamics consistency, and the causal effect of targeted transition subspace erasure. Collectively, these results indicate that dynamic information causally relevant to planning is preserved from collapse under AVL.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现JEPA类世界模型会丢失动作导致的物理因果动态信息（即‘因果动态信息坍缩’），于是提出AVL机制：用执行的动作作为动力学锚点，并设计视觉不变性通路对齐扰动与干净隐状态，从而强制模型保留规划所需的因果动态信息。
analysis.claim: 通过引入动作锚定和视觉不变性预测通路，AVL能有效防止JEPA世界模型中因果动态信息的坍缩，使模型在视觉扰动下仍保持对物理后果的准确建模能力。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+执行的动作
analysis.output: 未来隐状态预测（不重构像素）
analysis.robot_dependency: TwoRoom/PushT/OGBench Cube/Reacher仿真环境（未说明是否基于特定机器人平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 纯仿真训练，无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 识别出JEPA中因果动态信息坍缩这一新问题并给出可验证的机制（动作锚+视觉不变性对齐），实验覆盖4个标准仿真任务且做了消融（如过渡子空间擦除）、一致性检验等，但未开源、无真机验证、未与主流JEPA基线（如VPT、MUSE）做SOTA对比，也未证明其泛化到新机体或跨用户场景，属于扎实但窄的机制改进，未达基石级范式突破或工程落地门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：发现了JEPA中一个具体而重要的失效模式，并给出了有实证支持的修复机制，但缺乏开源、真机验证和更广义泛化证据，尚未构成范式推动或实用化进展。

papers.title: An AI-Enabled Translational Drug Discovery Framework for NALCN Channelopathy: From High-Throughput Screening to Therapeutic Candidate
papers.abstract: Background: More than 90% of rare diseases lack an approved therapy, partly reflecting economic barriers in developing treatments for small patient populations. A common bottleneck is costly and resource-intensive hit-to-lead prioritization. Congenital contractures of the limbs and face, hypotonia, and developmental delay (CLIFAHDD) is an ultra-rare neurodevelopmental disease often caused by de novo gain-of-function variants in the sodium leak channel NALCN, with no approved treatments. Methods: We developed a cost and resource-efficient, AI-enabled translational drug discovery framework integrating phenotypic high-throughput screening (HTS), structural biology foundation models for hit-to-lead prioritization, and orthogonal experimental validation. We applied this framework for drug repurposing to identify NALCN inhibitors as therapeutic candidates for CLIFAHDD. We screened ~1,200 approved drugs using a fluorescence-based membrane potential assay in doxycycline-inducible HEK293 cells stably expressing the NALCN channelosome. Boltz-2 modeling predicted binding affinity and mode to prioritize hits. Lead repurposing candidates were selected by a multidisciplinary expert review panel. Lead candidates were evaluated using patch-clamp electrophysiology in HEK293 cells expressing wild-type or CLIFAHDD-associated NALCN variants, primary mouse hippocampal neurons, and a C. elegans NALCN gain-of-function model. Results: HTS identified 11 candidate NALCN inhibitors. Boltz-2 prioritized candidates based on predicted binding affinity and predicted binding within the NALCN pore, consistent with a direct pore-blocking mechanism. Aprepitant emerged as the lead candidate after multidisciplinary evaluation based on its predicted mechanism, pharmacologic properties, blood-brain barrier penetration, established safety profile, and regulatory approval in children and adults. Patch-clamp electrophysiology confirmed partial inhibition of NALCN-mediated sodium leak currents in HEK293 cells (IC50;=2.22 μM), with comparable potency against Cav3.1 (IC50=1.63 μM). In primary mouse hippocampal neurons, aprepitant reduced sodium leak currents, hyperpolarized resting membrane potential, and decreased spontaneous firing. Aprepitant rescued hyperlocomotor and dystonic phenotypes in a C. elegans gain-of-function NALCN model. There was notable concordance between AI-predicted hits, phenotypic screening hits, and experimental validation. Conclusion: These findings identify aprepitant as a lead therapeutic candidate for CLIFAHDD, and establish an AI-enabled translational drug discovery framework integrating phenotypic screening, structural modeling, and experimental validation for NALCN channelopathies. This scalable and resource-conscious strategy may accelerate hit-to-lead prioritization and drug discovery for rare and ultra-rare diseases lacking effective therapies.

analysis.tldr: 用AI辅助的药物发现流程，从1200种已上市药物中高通量筛选出NALCN钠漏通道抑制剂，结合结构预测模型Boltz-2排序，实验验证后确认止吐药阿瑞匹坦（aprepitant）可部分抑制致病性NALCN突变通道、改善神经元电生理异常和线虫运动表型，提出一套面向超罕见病的低成本转化药物发现框架。
analysis.org: 佛罗里达大学/南佛罗里达大学联合团队（依据作者单位：University of Florida, University of South Florida, CNRS等；通讯作者Yaxia Yuan与Daohong Zhou隶属UF；Philippe Lory/Arnaud Monteil隶属CNRS，但主导实验验证与疾病机制，整体以UF为执行核心）
analysis.claim: AI驱动的整合式药物发现框架（HTS + 结构基础模型 + 多层级实验验证）可高效识别并确证已上市药物对超罕见NALCN通道病的再利用潜力。
analysis.input: 已上市药物库（~1200种）、NALCN野生型及CLIFAHDD突变体的细胞系/原代神经元/线虫模型、荧光膜电位数据、patch-clamp电生理数据
analysis.output: 候选药物排名列表、结合模式预测、IC50值、电生理表型改善效果、动物行为挽救效果
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖；全部为湿实验生物学数据（细胞系、原代神经元、线虫）
analysis.significance_reason: 属重磅级贡献：首次将结构基础模型（Boltz-2）嵌入罕见病靶点的全流程药物再利用闭环，含真实HTS数据、多模型系统（HEK293/原代神经元/C. elegans）交叉验证、明确IC50与功能挽救，且成果指向临床可立即推进的已批准药物；但未开源Boltz-2权重/训练细节，未构建通用可迁移pipeline，框架泛化性限于离子通道类靶点，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破或dtSFM级生成能力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有AI模型（Boltz-2）、表型筛选与经典药理验证深度耦合，形成可复现、可落地的罕见病药物再利用工作流，非理论突破但具强临床转化价值。

papers.title: STEM: Semantic Target Search and Exploration using MAVs in Cluttered Environments
papers.abstract: Autonomous target search is crucial for deploying Micro Aerial Vehicles (MAVs) in emergency response and rescue missions. Existing approaches either focus on 2D semantic navigation in structured environments -- which is less effective in complex 3D settings, or on robotic exploration in cluttered spaces -- which often lacks the semantic reasoning needed for efficient target search. This paper overcomes these limitations by proposing a novel framework that utilizes a semantically-guided viewpoint planner to minimize target search and exploration time in unstructured 3D environments using an MAV. Specifically, we develop a combinatorial planner that generates efficient semantic exploration plans by prioritizing viewpoints that likely lead to the target. To guide the planner towards the target, an active perception pipeline is developed that propagates semantic priorities of observed objects into neighboring frontier voxels for computing semantic information gains of frontier viewpoints. In addition, we demonstrate how LLM-based similarity scores can be leveraged as semantic priority input to our pipeline. Evaluations in two distinct simulation environments show that the proposed method consistently outperforms baselines by quickly finding the target while maintaining reasonable exploration times. Real-world experiments with an MAV further demonstrate the method's ability to handle practical constraints like limited battery life, small sensor range, and semantic uncertainty.

analysis.tldr: 用语义优先级引导无人机在杂乱3D环境中高效搜索目标，通过将视觉识别结果传播到邻近前沿体素来计算语义信息增益，并用LLM相似度打分作为语义优先输入，在仿真和真实无人机上验证了比基线更快找到目标且兼顾探索效率。
analysis.claim: 语义优先的主动感知+组合式视角规划能显著缩短无人机在无结构杂乱3D环境中的目标搜索时间，同时保持合理探索覆盖。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+语言描述的目标类别（如'红色灭火器'）+MAV位姿
analysis.output: 下一最优飞行视角（6DoF位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四旋翼无人机（仿真用Gazebo/ROS，实机用Crazyflie或类似轻量平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；仅需预训练视觉模型（如CLIP）和少量目标类别标注，无真实场景采集数据

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有模块（CLIP、LLM相似度、前沿探索、Gazebo仿真）有机串联成端到端搜索流程，在小规模真实平台上跑通，但无新模型架构、无跨场景泛化、无开源数据/基准，尚未突破MAV自主搜索的底层瓶颈

papers.title: Enabling Robust Cloth Manipulation via Inference-Time Simulator-in-the-Loop Refinement
papers.abstract: Simulator-in-the-loop optimization offers a promising inference-time mechanism for robot manipulation. It uses a physical simulator as a backend rollout engine to evaluate candidate trajectories in parallel and refine nominal actions online, a paradigm proven effective in rigid-body manipulation where state and contact are relatively tractable. We bring this paradigm to real-world cloth manipulation from a single RGB input through three pillars. (i) We design a scalable synthetic-data generation and inference-time rollout pipeline built on FLASH, a deformable-object simulator that provides a practical balance among physical fidelity, numerical stability, and rollout efficiency. (ii) We develop a real-to-sim module, trained purely on synthetic data, that maps a single RGB observation to simulation-compatible cloth state by fusing pretrained visual features with learnable canonical tokens. (iii) We perform online planning by coupling a sparse-mesh rollout backend with prior-guided MPPI, anchored at an offline-distilled policy trajectory, preserving manipulation-relevant deformation and contact while enabling sufficient parallel rollout batches. Real-robot experiments show higher success rates and stronger robustness than baseline methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用单张RGB图像驱动真实机器人操作布料，核心是在线调用一个轻量级可微分布料仿真器（FLASH）反复评估和优化动作轨迹，并通过纯合成数据训练的视觉-仿真状态映射模块桥接真实图像与仿真状态。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无知名机构署名线索；姓名风格偏中文，但无法确认具体归属）
analysis.claim: 仅靠单张RGB图像输入，通过推理时仿真器闭环优化（simulator-in-the-loop），可在真实布料操作任务中实现比基线更鲁棒、更高成功率的闭环控制。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像
analysis.output: 机器人末端执行器的连续动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 真实机械臂+夹爪（未指明型号，但实验为real-robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人布料操作数据（real-to-sim模块纯用合成数据训练）
