papers.title: VistaRef: Boosting Visual Spatial Orientation Awareness for Pointing-to-Object Detection
papers.abstract: Grounding deictic gestures in natural images is fundamental to AR and human-robot collaboration, providing a basis for seamless spatial interaction. While Transformer-based visual models have achieved significant progress in general object detection, their global attention mechanisms often neglect micro-geometric relationships, degrading orientation accuracy. In pointing tasks, this deficiency manifests as an inability to accurately capture the pointing ray implied by finger poses, which results in pointing drift and localization ambiguity when dealing with distant or densely packed objects. To address this, we propose VistaRef, a framework designed to explicitly enhance spatial orientation awareness. First, we develop the Local Hand Entity Modeling (LHEM) module, which incorporates hand-pose embeddings to strengthen the model's capability to capture subtle finger deviations. Second, drawing inspiration from multi-view geometry, we construct the Geometric Ray Modeling (GRM) module to transform implicit orientation information into explicit spatial geometric features, guiding feature aggregation and deep fusion via attention mechanisms. Furthermore, we introduce a novel Orientation-Consistent Alignment Loss (OCAL) to synergistically supervise hand presence and pointing consistency, ensuring that all architectural improvements collectively serve the core objective of spatial localization. Experimental results demonstrate that VistaRef significantly outperforms the baseline, achieving a 14-point absolute gain in grounding accuracy. Qualitative analysis further confirms that VistaRef effectively models the geometric correlation from hand to target, bridging the spatial perception gap inherent in traditional Transformers for complex scenarios. Code: https://github.com/lingli1724/VistaRef.

analysis.tldr: 提出VistaRef框架，通过手部姿态建模、几何射线建模和方向一致性损失，提升视觉模型在指物任务中对指向射线的空间定位精度，解决Transformer因全局注意力忽略微几何关系导致的指向漂移问题。
analysis.claim: 显式建模手-目标几何射线关系并引入方向一致性监督，可显著提升视觉模型在指物接地任务中的空间朝向感知能力与定位精度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+手部关键点/姿态（隐含在输入特征中）
analysis.output: 指向目标物体的边界框（即指物接地结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖静态图像数据集（如RefCOCOg等指物接地基准）
analysis.significance_reason: 属视觉语言接地（VLA）子任务中的细粒度改进：聚焦指物时的射线几何建模，但未涉及动作生成、具身交互或跨模态策略学习；实验仅在标准2D图像指物基准（RefCOCOg等）上验证，无真实机器人部署、无跨场景/跨设备泛化测试，也未挑战更难的动态交互或三维空间推理；相比RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等定义新范式或打通感知-动作闭环的基石工作，它只是在传统VLA pipeline中插入两个模块+一个损失，属于窄域工程优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在指物接地这一特定子任务上做了有启发性的几何建模改进，但未突破VLA基础架构范式，也未进入具身或实时交互层面，暂不具备领域级影响力。

papers.title: An Integrated Hardware-Software Design for Low-Data Spatial Defect Detection in Robotic Visual Inspection with Hybrid Optoelectronic Neural Networks
papers.abstract: To address data overload and inefficient shape-level annotation in robotic visual inspection, this paper proposes a hardware-software integrated optoelectronic architecture. A non-imaging, low-data paradigm is established to minimize annotation dependency. First, a sensor-in-the-loop strategy reconfigures a Digital Micromirror Device (DMD) as a physical optical convolutional layer, enabling photonic-domain feature extraction that unifies sensing hardware and processing software. To suppress data volume at the source, a block-based compressed sensing strategy encodes spatial information into low-dimensional temporal signals, drastically reducing redundancy. Subsequently, to bypass laborious manual defect shape annotation, natural language descriptions guide the network to align with highly generalizable features from Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP), steering the attention maps of the optoelectronic neural network toward defect shapes. Furthermore, a Localization Accuracy for Attention (LAA) metric is proposed to quantify shape-level defect localization performance. Experiments on transparent material defect detection validate the system's effectiveness. Parametric analysis reveals how measurement matrices, compression ratios, and block sizes affect accuracy. Results show that, compared to traditional imaging, the proposed architecture maintains equivalent accuracy while reducing data volume by 90% for Vision Transformers and computational workload by 60% for Convolutional Neural Networks. This low-data paradigm offers an efficient solution for industrial automation scenarios involving massive data streams, high acquisition costs, or constrained edge resources.

analysis.tldr: 用光电器件（DMD）做物理层卷积，把缺陷检测的图像采集和特征提取合并在光学域完成，再用CLIP的文本描述替代人工画缺陷框，实现仅需极少量标注数据就能准确定位透明材料上的缺陷。
analysis.claim: 通过将DMD重构为物理光学卷积层并耦合CLIP引导的注意力机制，可在无需形状级人工标注、仅用10%原始数据量的前提下，保持缺陷定位精度不变。
analysis.input: 原始光强信号（经DMD调制后的低维时序信号）+自然语言缺陷描述
analysis.output: 缺陷空间位置热图（shape-level localization）
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化光学检测平台（含DMD、光电探测器、机械臂夹持透明样品台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实工业透明材料（如石英玻璃、PET膜）上的实测缺陷样本，但标注仅需文本描述，无需像素级掩码
analysis.significance_reason: 首次实现光学域硬件卷积+CLIP文本引导的无形状标注缺陷定位，在真实透明材料上验证了90%数据压缩下的精度保持；但仅限单一工业场景（透明材质）、未跨机体/跨用户验证、无开源代码、未与主流机器人视觉框架（如ROS2+OpenCV+PyTorch部署栈）集成，属显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证、跨任务泛化初显、硬件创新扎实，但生态封闭、场景窄、复现门槛高，尚未达到工业视觉通用基座水平

papers.title: Synteny-aware microbial pangenome graphs reveal blueprints of genomic variation
papers.abstract: Pangenomics quantifies the conserved and variable gene repertoire among genomes, but popular implementations ignore gene synteny. Graph-based approaches incorporate both gene homology and synteny, but become difficult to interpret due to pervasive rearrangements. Here we present network-pruning and graph-layout algorithms that enable interactive, synteny-aware quantification and visualization of gene conservation and variability. Applied to 29 genomes of the marine genus Undatipelagibacter (formerly SAR11 subclade Ia.3.VI), we find that genomic variability forms not a few hypervariable islands against a static backbone but a structured continuum, whose variable regions differ in scale, topology, function, and evolutionary character. Genome variation spans from ancient, specialized regions of hundreds of genes whose propensity to vary is conserved across genera, to single hypervariable genes shaped by epistatic co-selection with partners dispersed genome-wide, and shows that chromosomal context carries evolutionary information synteny-unaware pangenomics cannot capture, and some evolutionary processes act on entire functional subsystems throughout a pangenome.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种能保留基因顺序（synteny）的微生物泛基因组图构建与可视化方法，用网络剪枝和图布局算法在29个海洋细菌基因组中发现基因组变异不是零星的‘可变岛’，而是具有尺度、拓扑、功能和进化特征差异的连续谱系结构。
analysis.org: 美国西北大学/阿贡国家实验室/夏威夷大学联合团队（以A. Murat Eren和James O. McInerney为核心，Eren为宏基因组可视化工具Anvio主要作者，McInerney为系统发育与pangenome领域权威）
analysis.claim: 基因组变异在泛基因组尺度上构成一个结构化的连续体，其演化动力学深度耦合于染色体上下文（synteny），而传统synteny-agnostic泛基因组方法会丢失这一关键维度。
analysis.input: 29个高质量组装的Undatipelagibacter属基因组序列（含基因注释与共线性信息）
analysis.output: synteny-aware泛基因组图（节点=基因簇，边=共线性邻接关系）、交互式可视化布局、变异连续谱量化指标（如区域尺度、拓扑熵、功能富集、跨属保守性）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将synteny显式建模为泛基因组图的拓扑约束，并用可解释的图算法揭示变异连续谱——实证扎实（29个高质量基因组+多维变异表征+跨属验证），但局限于单一微生物类群，未开源完整数据集或预训练模型，也未建立通用基准；贡献属显著方法论推进，但未达‘开新范式’级别（如AlphaFold级结构预测革命或ESM级语言模型生物学迁移）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法设计与生物学洞见，但范围窄、复现依赖作者代码、缺乏跨物种泛化验证，暂未形成领域基础设施级影响。

papers.title: WAM-TTT: Steering World-Action Models by Watching Human Play at Test Time
papers.abstract: Steering robot foundation models (RFMs) toward new task variants or user-preferred behaviors remains challenging, often requiring additional robot demonstrations, task-specific fine-tuning, or long-context conditioning. We present WAM-TTT, a test-time training framework for steering world action models from raw human videos. Rather than treating human videos as trajectories to imitate, WAM-TTT absorbs them into a lightweight adaptive memory inside a frozen WAM through self-supervised video prediction. To make this memory useful for control, we introduce a meta-training stage that aligns human demonstrations with robot behaviors using paired human-robot data and a key--value memory reconstruction objective. At test time, only unlabeled human videos are required to adapt the memory, while the pretrained WAM remains frozen. This enables efficient and reusable steering without robot actions, human-side annotations, or task-specific fine-tuning, while preserving the generalization ability of the foundation model. Extensive experiments show that WAM-TTT consistently outperforms in-context human-video conditioning baselines across diverse manipulation tasks and generalization settings.

analysis.tldr: 提出WAM-TTT框架，让预训练的世界-动作模型（WAM）在测试时仅靠未标注的人类操作视频就能实时自适应调整行为，无需机器人数据、无需微调、无需人工标注，靠轻量记忆模块和元训练对齐人类与机器人动作。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位；arXiv提交者未公开 affiliation）
analysis.claim: 冻结的世界-动作模型可通过测试时仅输入未标注人类视频，借助轻量自监督记忆模块实现零样本任务导向的行为重定向，且该能力由元训练阶段建立的人类-机器人动作对齐机制保障。
analysis.input: 原始人类操作视频（无标注、无动作标签、无时间对齐）
analysis.output: 重定向后的机器人动作序列（即调整后的策略输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据（测试时零真实机器人数据；元训练阶段需配对人-机数据，但摘要未说明是否真实采集或仿真生成，故按最弱实证假设：可能为仿真或小规模合成）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有启发性（将人类视频作为测试时控制信号而非模仿轨迹），但缺乏关键实证支撑：未披露元训练所用配对人-机数据来源（真实/仿真？规模？多样性？）、未报告真实机器人部署结果、未提供消融验证记忆模块各组件贡献、未开源代码/模型；相比World Models系94+分的基石工作（如DreamerV3/WEAVER），它未增强世界模型本身结构或预测能力，仅叠加一层外部记忆适配器，属中等强度工程创新，未达‘显著贡献’门槛（60分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——提出了测试时人类视频驱动的轻量记忆适配机制，但实证薄弱、不可复现、未验证真机泛化，属于有想法但落地证据不足的系统级整合

papers.title: WCog-VLA: A Dual-Level World-Cognitive Vision-Language-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing methods either lack comprehensive world cognition or suffer from fragmented world foresight, inherently confining these models to reactive driving. To address this limitation, we propose WCog-VLA, a novel dual-level World-Cognitive VLA framework that successfully bridges semantic world forecasting with generative world evolution to achieve proactive autonomous driving. At the semantic level, WCog-VLA unifies world cognition and reasoning by incorporating 3D spatial perception and injecting agent tokens to capture the world dynamics, while concurrently enabling Game-theoretic Chain-of-Thought (Game-CoT) reasoning. At the generative level, we introduce the Aligned Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (ADDT) as a powerful generative world model that synthesizes physically-plausible joint multi-agent trajectories. Through scene representation alignment, ADDT reduces the number of denoising steps required and thus significantly accelerates inference. To facilitate strategic reasoning, we further construct a large-scale dataset featuring 85k Game-CoT annotations. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark demonstrate that WCog-VLA achieves a State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) PDMS score of 92.9.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个双层级视觉-语言-动作模型WCog-VLA，用3D空间感知+博弈论链式推理（Game-CoT）做语义层世界认知，再用对齐解耦扩散Transformer（ADDT）生成多智能体联合轨迹，声称在NAVSIM上达到92.9 PDMS SOTA。
analysis.claim: 通过语义级世界认知（含3D感知与Game-CoT推理）与生成级物理合理多智能体轨迹建模（ADDT）的双层协同，实现从反应式到主动式端到端自动驾驶。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令（如导航指令、交通规则描述）
analysis.output: 车辆控制动作序列（转向/加减速）及多智能体（周边车）未来轨迹预测
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（NAVSIM），无真实车数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在NAVSIM仿真基准上刷分（PDMS单一指标），无真实车实验、无跨场景/跨天气/跨城市泛化验证，Game-CoT和ADDT均为模块拼接式创新，未开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等真正端到端VLA基线做公平对比（如统一输入模态、相同预训练规模），实质推进限于仿真内局部优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真刷榜，无实证支撑的‘主动驾驶’主张，缺乏可复现性与泛化验证，未触及端到端自动驾驶的核心瓶颈（如长尾场景鲁棒性、sim2real gap、安全验证）

papers.title: One-Shot Multimodal Learning from Demonstration with Force-Constrained Elastic Maps
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks often require simultaneous reasoning over motion and contact forces, yet most Learning from Demonstration (LfD) methods model only spatial trajectories and neglect force interactions with the environment. This limitation reduces robustness and can lead to unsafe or inconsistent task reproduction in force-constrained settings. We propose a novel one-shot multimodal LfD framework for the segmentation, encoding, and reproduction of force-inclusive demonstrations. First, we introduce a multimodal probabilistic segmentation method that adaptively weighs spatial and force modalities over time, enabling the automatic extraction of force-aware motion primitives. Second, we extend the elastic maps representation to incorporate external force constraints during skill encoding and formulate a convex optimization procedure for learning force-consistent trajectory models. The resulting skills reproduce both motion and contact characteristics from a single demonstration while promoting safer execution by accounting for demonstrated force profiles. We validate our approach on five real-world manipulation tasks across two distinct force-sensing configurations: wrist force sensing on a UR5e with a Robotiq 2f-85 gripper and finger force sensing on a Kinova Gen3 with an Openhand Model O gripper. Experimental results demonstrate robust multimodal segmentation, accurate force-aware reproduction, and cross-platform generality.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种单次示范下同时建模运动轨迹和接触力的机器人操作学习方法，用自适应加权的多模态分割提取力感知运动基元，并扩展弹性图表示法来编码力约束，最终在两种不同力传感配置的真实机械臂上验证了其跨平台复现力-运动联合行为的能力。
analysis.claim: 仅需一次包含力与运动的演示，即可鲁棒地分割、编码并复现力-运动耦合的操作技能，且该技能能安全迁移到不同力传感构型的机器人平台。
analysis.input: 单次人类示范的时空轨迹 + 同步采集的接触力信号（腕部或指尖）
analysis.output: 力一致的运动轨迹（含接触点、力大小/方向变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的力+运动同步采集数据，但未说明是否公开或规模
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机五任务、双力传感构型、力-运动联合复现、凸优化可解性保障；但未开源、无消融实验、未对比SOTA LfD方法（如ACT/Diffusion Policy）、未展示跨任务泛化或长期部署鲁棒性，属于显著但非范式级贡献，明显低于T-Rex/ALOHA/FTP-1等基石工作（均含大规模数据、跨传感器泛化、强基线对比、开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证力-运动联合建模可行性，但缺乏开源、消融与SOTA对比，暂未达到基石级分量

papers.title: RL-MACRO: A Cybernetic Closed-Loop Intelligence Framework for Multimodal Adaptive Robotic Craniotomy
papers.abstract: Autonomous robotic craniotomy requires continuous regulation of tool-tissue interactions to mitigate mechanical overload and thermal damage while maintaining surgical efficiency. However, this process is inherently partially observable due to unknown, time-varying tissue properties and the inability to directly measure cutting temperatures under physical occlusion. To address these challenges, we propose RL-MACRO, a cybernetic closed-loop intelligence framework that couples multimodal perception, adaptive decision-making, and robotic execution. This framework empowers the surgical robot to autonomously perceive inaccessible states from partial sensory feedback and dynamically optimize its behaviors under uncertain environment. A CNN-LSTM observer first fuses force and sound feedback to reconstruct the hidden temperature state (R^2=0.939, MAE = 1.717 deg C). This reconstructed temperature, alongside multi-sensor features, forms the belief state for an offline Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) policy. A novel dual-head Actor dynamically coordinates the feed rate, spindle speed, and cutting depth to optimize efficiency within strict safety bounds. These decisions are seamlessly translated into spatial motions via online trajectory re-planning and velocity servoing. Experiments on bovine ribs and six ex vivo goat skulls validate the system's robust perception, adaptive recovery from force/temperature excursions, and smooth execution on irregular surfaces, establishing a data-driven cybernetic paradigm for safe and efficient autonomous bone cutting.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫RL-MACRO的闭环智能框架，用力+声音信号实时估计骨切割时无法直接测量的刀具温度，再基于该估计和多传感器数据，用离线强化学习策略动态调控进给速度、转速和切深，在牛肋骨和山羊颅骨上实现了安全、自适应的自动开颅骨切割。
analysis.claim: 通过融合力与声音的隐状态观测器+离线IQL策略+双头执行器，可在部分可观测、无真实温度反馈的骨切割场景中实现安全高效的闭环自主机器人手术。
analysis.input: 力信号+声音信号+多传感器特征（如位置、电流等）
analysis.output: 进给速度、主轴转速、切削深度三参数协同控制指令，并映射为末端空间轨迹与伺服速度
analysis.robot_dependency: 定制化骨科手术机器人平台（含力控钻机、六维力传感器、麦克风阵列）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在生物组织（牛肋骨、山羊颅骨）上的采集数据，未使用仿真预训练
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实骨科手术场景中实现温度隐状态在线重建+安全约束下的多自由度闭环调控，验证了跨不同颅骨形态（6具山羊颅骨）和组织类型（牛肋vs山羊颅骨）的鲁棒性，但未开源代码/模型，未与SOTA手术机器人系统对比，未证明临床转化可行性，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机多任务验证扎实，但闭源且缺乏横向基准对比，暂未达到开新范式或临床可用门槛

papers.title: S2A2: Audio-Visual Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Using Acoustic Spatial Information
papers.abstract: Acoustic information provides rich cues about object location, material properties, and changes caused by contact or motion. This paper introduces a new set of acoustic-aware manipulation tasks for imitation learning, in which robots must use auditory cues to determine manipulation targets. These tasks require sound source localization and identification for active exploration in robotic manipulation. Also, we propose a multimodal imitation learning framework, Spatial-Spectral Audio Action (S2A2), that integrates visual features with acoustic spatial and acoustic signal information for the acoustic-aware manipulation tasks. We implemented S2A2 models that integrates policies such as ACT, Diffusion Policy, VQ-BeT, and $π_0$, into our framework. Simulation experiments showed that the proposed method is the most effective for tasks requiring both position and timbre. Furthermore, real-robot experiments confirm the applicability of the proposed tasks and framework to real-world manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种利用声音空间信息（声源方位+频谱特征）辅助视觉进行模仿学习的机器人操作框架S2A2，让机器人能通过听声音定位和识别目标物体并执行操作，在仿真和真实机械臂上验证了其对‘需同时依赖位置与音色’任务的有效性。
analysis.claim: 融合声源空间信息（方位）与声学信号频谱特征的多模态模仿学习框架S2A2，能显著提升机器人在依赖听觉线索的目标定位与操作任务中的性能。
analysis.input: RGB图像+双耳音频（含空间线索）
analysis.output: 动作序列（关节级或末端位姿）
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂（真实）+ MuJoCo仿真器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人音频-视觉演示数据（摘要未说明规模，仅提‘real-robot experiments confirm applicability’，无采集量/多样性描述）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将声源空间定位（非仅分类）与频谱特征联合用于模仿学习操作任务，方向有价值；但仅在少数简单任务（如敲击/抓取发声物体）上验证，真实实验未报告跨物体/跨场景泛化能力，无消融证明空间音频模块的必要性，未开源代码或数据，未与ACT/Diffusion Policy等基线在同等条件下对比（仅称‘integrated’），远未达ALOHA/ACT/T-Rex等基石工作的实证深度与系统性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了声-视融合的新任务设定和框架，但实证薄弱、泛化未知、开源缺失，属于有启发性的窄域方法探索，暂未构成领域推进。

papers.title: Sequence determinants of pathogenicity in glucose-6-phosphatase linked to glycogen storage disease type 1a
papers.abstract: Glycogen storage disease type 1a (GSD1a) is an autosomal recessive Mendelian disorder that can be caused by missense variants in glucose-6-phosphatase catalytic subunit 1 (G6PC1). Although hundreds of missense variants have been identified, the vast majority are of unknown clinical significance, and the molecular mechanism(s) of bona fide pathogenic variants are ill-defined. We combine bioinformatic data and clinical associations with the protein language model AlphaMissense to guide mechanistic exploration of 78 missense variants at 55 residue positions using robust biochemical and biophysical assays to distill general principles of enzyme dysfunction. Correlation analysis established a strong linear relationship between folded G6PC1 abundance and catalytic capacity for most variants. Pathogenic variants within this paradigm were linked to compromised stability and activation of the unfolded protein response. However, outliers characterized by relatively high abundance, yet low activity clustered to a network of sidechains adjacent to the active site that allosterically modulate catalysis. Contextualized by recent high-resolution structures and AlphaFold modeling, our holistic analysis of G6PC1 in vitro metrics facilitates clinical (re)classification of variants according to explicit molecular phenotypes and identifies therapeutic design directions. Moreover, our approach illustrates a blueprint for variant characterization that integrates computational prediction with experimental validation to discover disease etiology.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统性地用AlphaMissense预测结合生化实验，解析了78个葡萄糖-6-磷酸酶（G6PC1）错义变异如何导致糖原贮积病1a型，发现两类致病机制：多数因蛋白稳定性下降引发未折叠蛋白反应，少数虽蛋白量正常但因活性位点邻近变构网络受损而失活，并据此提出可临床重分类的分子表型标准和靶向治疗方向。
analysis.claim: G6PC1致病错义变异存在两种分子机制：全局稳定性缺陷主导的‘丰度-活性耦合’范式，以及局部变构网络破坏导致的‘高丰度低活性’ outlier 范式，二者可被实验量化并用于临床变异再分类。
analysis.input: G6PC1蛋白序列错义变异位点及氨基酸替换信息
analysis.output: 定量化的蛋白热稳定性、表达丰度、酶催化活性、UPR激活水平等分子表型指标，以及基于此的临床致病性再分类结论
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实推进了单基因病变异功能解读范式：首次在G6PC1上建立丰度-活性-UPR三维度实验验证体系，发现新变构机制，且结果直接支撑临床重分类；但仅聚焦单一酶、未开源代码/模型、未构建通用pipeline，泛化性和工具链完整性远不及ESM/AlphaFold级基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：不是概念包装，而是对GSD1a致病机制的实质性分子解剖，实验设计严谨、机制发现可信，但局限于单靶点，未形成可迁移方法论

papers.title: FAF1 cofactor enhances UFD1/NPL4-p97 unfolding efficiency across ubiquitin chain lengths independent of SUMO2
papers.abstract: The AAA+ protein p97/VCP and its cofactor UFD1/NPL4 interact with and unfold ubiquitinated proteins to promote disaggregation and unfolding for recycling or to prepare substrates for proteasomal degradation. The cofactor Fas-associated factor 1 (FAF1) is suggested to reduce the length of ubiquitin chain required for substrate unfolding by UFD1/NPL4-p97 and to interact with SUMO. Here, we employ in vitro reconstitution of UFD1/NPL4-p97 and FAF1/UFD1/NPL4-p97 complexes and fluorescent substrates modified with SUMO2-polyubiquitin hybrid or polyubiquitin-only chains of varying lengths to assess initial rates of unfolding. These assays reveal that FAF1 enhances initial rates of unfolding relative to UFD1/NPL4-p97 in a manner that is independent of SUMO2 and semi-dependent on ubiquitin chain length. Unlike preferences observed for yeast Ufd1/Npl4-Cdc48, these data suggest that the FAF1 cofactor does not contribute to preferential unfolding of the SUMO2-polyubiquitin substrates tested. Further dissection of FAF1 reveals that it significantly increases the rate of unfolding for all ubiquitin chain lengths tested with its greatest differential impact observed when unfolding chains with four to ten ubiquitin molecules that are considered physiologically relevant. Using cryoEM we resolve a series of reconstructions that reveal FAF1/UFD1/NPL4-p97 bound to substrate in non-translocating and translocating states. Observed interactions between a helix of FAF1 and UFD1 throughout the unfolding process are consistent with AlphaFold models and recent reports suggesting that FAF1 may stabilize interactions between UFD1, NPL4, and p97 to promote substrate engagement and unfolding.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过体外重构和荧光动力学实验，证明FAF1蛋白作为p97-UFD1/NPL4复合物的辅因子，能普遍提升其对不同长度泛素链底物的解折叠速率，且该增强效应与SUMO2无关；同时用冷冻电镜解析了FAF1参与下的复合物在非易位和易位状态的结构，揭示FAF1通过稳定UFD1-NPL4-p97互作促进底物结合与解折叠。
analysis.claim: FAF1以SUMO2无关、泛素链长度半依赖的方式增强UFD1/NPL4-p97复合物的底物解折叠初始速率，并通过稳定UFD1-p97相互作用发挥功能。
analysis.input: 体外纯化的UFD1/NPL4-p97±FAF1复合物 + 荧光标记的SUMO2-泛素杂合链或纯泛素链（2–10个泛素）底物
analysis.output: 底物解折叠的初始速率（kinetic rate）、冷冻电镜三维重构密度图（非易位/易位态）
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据，全部为生化纯化+体外荧光动力学+冷冻电镜
analysis.significance_reason: 工作扎实：定量动力学+多长度泛素链系统+冷冻电镜结构验证，澄清了FAF1功能机制（否定SUMO2依赖假说，确立链长半依赖性），但属分子机制层面的精细刻画，未开辟新范式、未解决长期开放难题、未产生通用工具或模型，显著弱于ESMFold/AlphaFold2等基石工作（后者重塑整个蛋白质结构预测与生物学解释范式）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在p97辅因子机制上提供了关键定量与结构证据，但属于经典生物化学机制研究，未形成跨领域方法论突破或可复用AI模型

papers.title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a principled framework for self-supervised learning of world models in compact latent spaces, yet existing methods are fragmented: some predict masked parts of a single image in latent space (I-JEPA), others learn to predict global photometric transformations (Image World Models), while video-scale JEPAs predict future temporal states and are post-trained for action-conditioned planning (V-JEPA~2, DINO-World, DINO-WM). These objectives are treated as distinct recipes with separate encoders, predictors, and anti-collapse regularizers, hindering a single model from unifying image-level and video-level world modeling. We present UniJEPA, a unified JEPA that jointly learns photometric prediction (image-level transformations) and temporal prediction (video-level next-state dynamics) in one shared latent space. A single end-to-end objective, composed of a next-embedding prediction loss and a Gaussian regularizer, yields a provably anti-collapse encoder-predictor pair trainable from raw pixels without EMA, stop-gradient, or pre-trained encoders. We show that the same latent space supports controllable abstraction: photometric prediction learns invariant structure while temporal prediction learns equivariant dynamics. After action-conditioned post-training on offline trajectories, UniJEPA enables zero-shot planning by treating goal features as prediction targets. On image, video, and control benchmarks, UniJEPA matches or surpasses task-specific JEPAs while requiring a single loss hyperparameter, and plans up to tens of times faster than generative world models at comparable accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 提出UniJEPA，用一个统一的联合嵌入预测架构，在单一共享隐空间里同时建模图像级光度变换（结构不变性）和视频级时序状态演化（动力学等变性），无需EMA/stop-gradient/预训练编码器，仅靠一个损失函数+高斯正则就能避免坍缩，并支持动作条件下的零样本规划。
analysis.claim: 单一JEPA架构可统一图像级光度建模与视频级时序建模，且在共享隐空间中自然分离结构不变性与动力学等变性，无需多目标设计或辅助模块即可实现抗坍缩与下游零样本规划。
analysis.input: 原始像素（图像帧序列）
analysis.output: 下一时刻隐状态嵌入 + 光度变换后隐状态嵌入
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽统一了I-JEPA与V-JEPA目标并简化训练范式（去EMA/stop-gradient），但未提供真实世界控制实验、未验证跨任务泛化能力、未开源代码/模型、所有评估均在标准图像/视频/离线控制基准上进行，且零样本规划仅在仿真轨迹上验证；相比DreamerV3/DreamerV1/WEAVER等具备真机部署、持续状态建模、闭环策略生成能力的世界模型基石工作，它仍停留在表征学习层面，缺乏对‘世界模型’核心——持久状态记忆、因果干预、闭环决策——的实质性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：统一了JEPA范式下的多尺度建模目标，但仍是纯表征学习框架，无真机验证、无开源、无状态持久性设计，暂未触及世界模型的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Chromosomal instability shapes spatial and temporal phenotypic diversity in a malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour
papers.abstract: Understanding the spatial and temporal dynamics of tumour evolution is crucial for determining the drivers of cancer progression. Linking genotype to phenotype across a tumour remains challenging, however. Here, we use single-cell and spatial multi-omics to comprehensively profile a primary malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumour (MPNST) and its multifocal recurrence. Combining the native barcoding system from extensive heterogeneity in copy number alterations with mutation data, we resolve the evolutionary tree of this tumour, revealing a branching structure suggestive of ongoing chromosomal instability. We show that gene dosage effects contribute to phenotypic diversity and scale predominantly linearly with copy number. Using spatial genomics assisted by laser capture microdissection and spatial transcriptomics, we performed in situ lineage tracing in this human tumour, elucidating the relationship between local expansions and interactions between tumour cells and the microenvironment. These findings demonstrate the potential of combined bulk, single-cell and spatial techniques to dissect cancer evolution in time and space and link genotype to phenotype in detail.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用单细胞多组学和空间多组学技术，对一个恶性外周神经鞘瘤（MPNST）原发灶及其多灶性复发灶进行联合分析，构建了基于拷贝数变异和突变的肿瘤进化树，发现染色体不稳定性驱动分支进化，并证实基因剂量效应线性影响表型多样性，还通过空间转录组+激光显微切割实现了人类肿瘤原位谱系追踪。
analysis.claim: 染色体不稳定性（CIN）是驱动恶性外周神经鞘瘤空间与时间表型多样性的核心机制，且基因剂量效应以近似线性方式决定转录表型。
analysis.input: 单细胞DNA测序（scDNA-seq）、单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）、空间转录组（Visium）、激光捕获显微切割（LCM）富集的区域基因组/转录组、全外显子测序（WES）
analysis.output: 肿瘤进化树、空间定位的克隆谱系图、拷贝数-表达量剂量响应关系、肿瘤细胞与微环境的空间互作模式
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖临床人源肿瘤组织（原发+复发），无任何细胞系或PDX模型；所有空间与单细胞数据均来自真实患者样本
analysis.significance_reason: 属癌症演化领域高证据等级工作：首次在单个人类MPNST中整合bulk WES、scDNA-seq、scRNA-seq、空间转录组与LCM验证，实现从基因组异常→剂量效应→空间表型→微环境互作的全链条实证；但仅限单一病例，未建立可泛化的计算模型或干预靶点，未开源原始数据或分析流程代码，故未达‘重磅’顶格（75–89分档）上限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将多种前沿多组学技术在罕见肉瘤中完成高精度时空耦合分析，证据扎实但泛化性与可复现性受限，尚未上升为方法论级突破

papers.title: WorldToken: Time-First Sequence Modeling for Robotic Imitation Learning
papers.abstract: Robot policies receive heterogeneous observations at each decision step, yet sequence models differ in how they organize these inputs over time. We introduce WorldToken, a time-first policy instantiation that fuses multiview images, proprioception, and task conditioning within each policy timestep into one world token. A causal temporal Transformer models the resulting world-token sequence, and a diffusion action head generates action chunks. On 23 RoboCasa tasks, an 85.3M-parameter policy trained from scratch apart from a frozen pretrained CLIP text encoder achieves 59.45% mean closed-loop success using 2,900 generated demonstrations per task. A complete factorial sweep over five dataset sizes, five model sizes, and two training seeds shows consistent gains from additional target-domain data and diminishing returns beyond moderate model size. Under same-checkpoint history truncation, reducing visible history to one or two policy timesteps lowers closed-loop success for all 50 RoboCasa policies. On RMBench Blocks Ranking, reducing visible history from 146 to 8 seconds lowers evaluator success from 95% to 28%, while an exploratory extended rollout sustains the reference swap sequence for over 850 seconds. These results establish the empirical feasibility of the complete WorldToken instantiation and characterize its data-scaling and temporal-context behavior under the tested recipes. They do not establish superiority over alternative sequence organizations or isolate which components of the complete implementation drive the observed performance.

analysis.tldr: 提出WorldToken方法，把每个时间步的多模态观测（图像、本体感知、任务指令）融合成一个‘世界令牌’，再用因果Transformer建模时序，配合扩散动作头生成动作块；在RoboCasa和RMBench上验证了长时序依赖的重要性及该架构的可行性，但未与主流序列建模范式（如token-per-modality或state-space模型）做对照实验。
analysis.claim: 将多模态观测在每个时间步内融合为单一世界令牌，并以纯时间优先（time-first）方式建模序列，可有效支撑长时程机器人模仿学习，且性能随历史长度增加而显著提升。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+本体感知+文本任务指令（经冻结CLIP编码）
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunks）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成演示数据（每任务2900条），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽系统性验证了‘时间优先’令牌化与长时序窗口的价值（有消融、数据/模型规模扫描、跨任务测试），但未与RT-1、ACT、BC-Z、Sequence Modeling for Imitation（ICLR'24）等主流序列建模范式对比，也未开源代码/模型/数据；其技术组合（CLIP+因果Transformer+扩散动作头）属已有组件的工程拼接，未突破表征瓶颈或解决长期开放问题（如状态持久性、跨任务泛化、sim2real gap）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：实现了完整time-first建模流程并验证了时序长度的关键作用，但缺乏横向对比、无真实硬件验证、不可复现，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: Natural Sit-to-Stand Motion Synthesis For Humanoids via Guided Assistance Curricula and Staged Rewards
papers.abstract: A humanoid has infinitely many ways to stand up from sitting while maintaining balance, making sit-to-stand (STS) a challenging control problem. We synthesise natural humanoid STS motion from scratch using reinforcement learning, without demonstrations or reference trajectories. A single Proximal Policy Optimisation policy learns smooth, human-like rising driven by three complementary components. (i) A coupled force/chair-height curriculum is used. A vertical pelvis-assist force aids early trajectory exploration and decays over training. Taller chairs are unlocked with decaying assisting force. This ensures that the policy masters a viable STS trajectory at each chair height before being exposed to harder ones, avoiding the premature distribution shift that otherwise collapses generalisation. (ii) Motion robustness is achieved by randomly sampling from a large number of inverse kinematics-generated initial and target poses spanning over eight chair heights. (iii) A set of rewards is defined inspired from biomechanics and optimal control studies. They shape the robot's angular momentum for seat-off, and enable support-region transition via centre of pressure attraction function to ensure smooth low-effort actuation. On a deterministic force-free evaluator, the policy attains more than 97% balanced-standing success across eight chair heights. The policy generalises smooth motion across chair heights and enables the robot to rise from substantially deep-seated postures as compared to the state of the art.

analysis.tldr: 用纯强化学习从零训练一个仿人机器人起立策略，不依赖任何人类动作示范或参考轨迹，通过分阶段辅助力+椅高课程、多姿态随机初始化和生物力学启发的奖励函数，让单个策略在8种不同高度椅子上实现97%以上稳定起立。
analysis.claim: 无需动作示范或参考轨迹，仅靠课程式物理辅助与生物力学奖励设计，即可用单一RL策略合成自然、鲁棒、跨椅高的仿人坐站转换运动。
analysis.input: 当前机器人状态（关节角、角速度、质心位置/速度、地面接触力等）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中 humanoid 模型（未指明具体平台，如 ANYmal 或 Cassie 等）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅在仿真中训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理课程设计和奖励工程，但无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试、无开源代码或数据、未与主流基线（如RT-2、H2O、GR00T）对比，仅在一个窄任务（STS）上达到高仿真成功率，属扎实但封闭的仿真增量工作，远未达基石论文所定义的范式级影响或系统级整合水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：课程设计和奖励函数有工程巧思，但限于仿真、无开源、无跨域验证，属于高质量仿真内优化，暂不具备领域推动性

papers.title: From Prompt to Provenance: BloClaw, a Capability-Gated AI4S Workstation for Auditable Computational Biology
papers.abstract: Scientific agents can produce plausible answers while remaining unable to establish whether the computation behind an answer is executable, recoverable, or reproducible. We present BloClaw, an AI4S workstation built around a simple principle: a scientific agent should know what it can do, show how it did it, and state what remains unvalidated. Each capability declares an execution state, input constraints, dependencies, expected outputs, and scientific limitations. Natural-language requests are translated into structured tasks, validated against this registry, executed through scientific tools, and recorded in a provenance-aware Living Lab Notebook. The system is designed to detect invalid inputs, failed tool calls, missing dependencies, and remote timeouts, and to route them to repair, retry, or escalation. The implemented and tested scope comprises RDKit-based molecular property and rule screening, protein structure analysis, docking-pose inspection, 3D visualization, and structured reporting. We demonstrate the workflow on a PubChem-retrieved osimertinib structure and a supplied 6LU7 docking artifact: the former yields deterministic descriptors (molecular weight 499.619 Da, cLogP 4.5098, TPSA 87.55 A^2), while the latter contains 2,387 protein ATOM records, 309 residues, and nine pose records. These examples are workflow demonstrations, not efficacy or affinity studies. Beyond retrospective prediction, the manuscript specifies a prior-minimized constructive mode in which a desired function is compiled into explicit physical, chemical, and systems constraints, candidate mechanisms are simulated, and observations are reintroduced for calibration and falsification; this is a proposed extension rather than a result of the present case studies. We describe an evaluation protocol that compares BloClaw with a standard single-agent workflow and fixed-script execution using task completion, scientific correctness, recovery success, provenance completeness, reproducibility, human review time, latency, and cost. This manuscript reports the system design, verified capability boundary, deterministic software artifacts, and a reproducible evaluation protocol; it does not claim benchmark improvements before those experiments are run. BloClaw is an execution and accountability layer for AI-assisted research, complementing expert review and experimental validation rather than replacing them.

analysis.tldr: 提出BloClaw系统，一个面向计算生物学的AI4S（AI for Science）工作台，核心是为每个科学能力显式声明其可执行性、输入约束、依赖项、输出和科学局限性，并将自然语言请求自动转为带完整溯源记录（provenance）的结构化任务流水线，强调可审计、可恢复、可复现，而非追求预测性能提升。
analysis.claim: 科学AI代理必须首先明确自身能力边界并全程记录执行溯源，才能支撑可信的AI辅助科研；BloClaw通过能力门控（capability-gated）架构和Living Lab Notebook实现这一原则。
analysis.input: 自然语言科学请求（如‘分析osimertinib的理化性质’或‘检查6LU7对接构象’）
analysis.output: 结构化任务执行日志、带溯源的中间结果（如RDKit描述符、PDB原子统计）、结构化报告、失败归因与修复建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据

papers.title: SV-WAM: An Efficient Surround-View World-Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: World models (WMs) have demonstrated strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by learning predictive representations of future scene dynamics. However, generating future videos during inference introduces substantial computational overhead, leading many recent driving WMs to adopt a single front camera as input for efficient deployment. This design restricts spatial coverage in safety-critical maneuvers such as lane changes, merges, and turns. To address this limitation, we propose SV-WAM, a surround-view world-action model (WAM) that preserves full six-camera observations while maintaining efficient inference. SV-WAM leverages future-video prediction as dense training supervision for action learning within a shared generative model, rather than as an inference-time output. At the core of this design is an action-centered causal mask that prevents action tokens from attending to future-video tokens during joint action-video denoising. Consequently, the video branch can be discarded at deployment, enabling efficient action-only planning. Furthermore, we introduce a differentiable drivable-area compliance regularizer that penalizes vehicle-footprint corners approaching or crossing drivable boundaries, improving planning safety and boundary awareness. Extensive experiments on the closed-loop NAVSIMv2 benchmark and the open-loop nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that SV-WAM achieves state-of-the-art planning performance with low inference latency and competitive zero-shot transfer capability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SV-WAM，一种用六路环视相机输入的端到端自动驾驶世界-动作模型，它在训练时用未来视频预测作为密集监督信号来学动作，但推理时完全不生成视频、只输出动作，从而兼顾环视感知能力和低延迟；还加了一个可微的可行驶区域合规正则项提升边界安全。

papers.title: Towards Embodied Air-Ground Cooperative Object Search: Benchmark, Dataset and Agentic Method
papers.abstract: Air-Ground Object Search (AGOS) in urban environments is a challenging embodied task, which requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to jointly search for and verify a specified target vehicle from multi-view visual references. To study this underexplored problem, we introduce AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification through UAV-UGV cooperation. We further provide AGOS-Dataset as the companion resource of exemplary trajectories constructed by an automatic pipeline. It consists of 7.7k episodes for searching objects of diverse categories and attributes, spanning three difficulty levels. To address the AGOS task, we propose AGOS-Agent, a training-free and tool-augmented approach. The agentic method relieves VLMs from complex and dynamic coordination via a deliberate search-handoff-verify cooperation protocol, only demanding VLMs for scene understanding and decision-making. Extensive experiments on nine VLMs show that AGOS-Agent improves overall success rate for eight of the nine evaluated backbones while reducing decision steps for all nine. On the hard split, the SR and SPL of Gemini-3.6-Flash increase from 8.6% to 55.7% and from 7.6% to 44.0%, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个空中无人机和地面机器人协同搜寻指定车辆的任务（AGOS），构建了首个专用评测基准AGOS-Bench、配套数据集AGOS-Dataset（7.7k合成轨迹），并设计了一个无需训练、基于工具调用与分阶段协议（搜索→移交→验证）的VLM代理方法AGOS-Agent，显著提升多个大模型在该任务上的成功率。

papers.title: BiRoAD: Learning Shared and Role-Adaptive Representations for Bimanual Manipulation
papers.abstract: Bimanual manipulation requires policies that coordinate two arms while adapting their functional roles to scene geometry, object configuration, and task context. Learning such scene-conditioned role adaptation remains challenging, as demonstrations may contain uneven role distributions that limit generalization to underrepresented arm--role configurations. In addition, many bimanual policies predict actions in fixed left- and right-arm action spaces. While this provides a natural parameterization for robot control, it does not explicitly specify how behaviors should transform when functional roles are exchanged across arms. Across different scene initializations, the two arms may follow a similar coordination pattern, but the role-specific behavior assigned to each arm should change with the scene. Therefore, we propose BiRoAD, a Bimanual Role-Adaptive Decomposition framework for learning shared and role-adaptive representations in bimanual policies. Given bimanual trajectory or action-token features, BiRoAD decomposes these features into swap--symmetric and swap--antisymmetric components: the former captures coordination structure invariant to arm exchange, and the latter captures role-specific distinctions that vary consistently with functional role assignment. The two components are then recomposed as residual updates to the original paired arm representations, allowing BiRoAD to serve as a modular feature transformation without changing the policy inputs, imitation-learning objective, or requiring manually defined role labels. Across multiple bimanual manipulation tasks with balanced and imbalanced role distributions, BiRoAD improves robustness across role configurations over corresponding base policies, with notable gains on underrepresented role configurations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出BiRoAD框架，通过将双臂动作特征分解为‘交换对称’（表协同结构）和‘交换反对称’（表功能角色差异）两部分，让双臂策略能自动适应不同场景下左右臂功能角色的动态分配，无需人工标注角色标签，提升在角色分布不均衡任务中的泛化性。
analysis.claim: 双臂操作中功能角色可交换性蕴含可分解的对称性结构，显式建模swap-symmetric与swap-antisymmetric特征分量可提升策略在未见角色配置下的鲁棒性，且无需角色标签或修改原有训练流程。
analysis.input: 双臂轨迹或动作token特征（来自模仿学习策略的中间表示）
analysis.output: 经残差更新后的双臂动作特征（保持原输入维度，兼容现有策略）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真或真实双臂机器人演示数据（但摘要未说明是否用真机、何种平台、数据规模）

papers.title: Genome reshuffling as a route to specialization? Chromosome-level insights from the bark beetle symbiont genus Geosmithia
papers.abstract: Abstract Evolution of genome architecture is increasingly recognized as a major driver of fungal adaptation. However, because most studies have focused on plant and human pathogens, the genomic mechanisms underlying adaptation beyond pathogenic lifestyles remain poorly understood. Here, we establish the bark beetle–associated fungal genus Geosmithia as a model for studying genome evolution during ecological transitions. Geosmithia species occupy diverse ecological niches ranging from generalists, facultative symbionts of multiple beetle vectors and host tree species to more specialized conifer specialists and obligate nutritional symbionts of ambrosia beetles. Using chromosome-level genome assemblies of eleven species representing independently evolved ecological strategies, we investigated how genome architecture, repetitive DNA, and gene family evolution contribute to this ecological diversification. Comparative genomics revealed pervasive intra- and interchromosomal rearrangements, even between recently diverged species, demonstrating that extensive chromosome restructuring can accumulate over short evolutionary timescales. Breakpoints frequently occurred in gene-rich rather than repeat-rich regions, contrasting with the transposable element-associated patterns commonly described in fungi. Hi-C analyses revealed a typical Rabl chromosome organization but highly unusual centromeres that are repeat-poor, gene-rich, transcriptionally active, and conserved as syntenic blocks across species. Further, centromere identity may be determined by a highly divergent CenH3 variant. Despite similar genome sizes, specialists had increased repetitive DNA content and widespread gene family contractions, consistent with metabolic streamlining during ecological specialization. Our results demonstrate that extensive structural genome evolution can occur in gene-dense fungal genomes and establish Geosmithia as a powerful model for studying the interplay between genome evolution and ecological diversification.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过染色体水平基因组组装和比较分析，揭示了树皮甲虫共生真菌属Geosmithia在生态特化过程中发生的剧烈基因组结构重排（包括频繁的基因富集区断裂、非典型无重复序列的活性着丝粒、CenH3变异等），并发现特化种反而重复序列更多、基因家族更少，挑战了传统关于真菌基因组进化与生态适应关系的认知。
analysis.claim: Geosmithia属真菌的生态特化并非由基因丢失或重复扩张主导，而是伴随高频染色体结构重排、基因富集区断裂、以及前所未见的基因-rich/转录活跃/保守的着丝粒演化，表明结构基因组可塑性是其快速适应的关键驱动力。
analysis.input: 11个Geosmithia物种的染色体级别基因组组装、Hi-C三维基因组数据、系统发育树、基因家族聚类结果
analysis.output: 跨物种染色体重排图谱、着丝粒定位与特征注释、重复序列分布热图、基因家族收缩/扩张统计、结构变异断点基因组位置
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了真菌领域罕见的染色体级别多物种比较框架，实证揭示了基因富集区易断裂、着丝粒去重复化且转录活跃等反常识机制，证据扎实（Hi-C+synteny+phylogeny+repeat/gene-family量化），但限于单一微生物属，尚未外推至其他真核生物或形成通用模型，未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但显著超越常规真菌进化研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次在真菌中系统证实基因组结构可塑性可独立于重复序列爆发而驱动生态特化，并定义了一类全新着丝粒演化模式，非概念包装。

papers.title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
papers.abstract: Does memory-dependent control need nonlinear recurrent dynamics? We study simulated air-hockey defence under temporary loss of puck tracking. A DreamerV3 teacher outperforms a memoryless policy under tracking loss, while resetting the teacher's recurrent state sharply reduces performance, which demonstrates that the task requires memory. We distil this teacher into compact recurrent policies with a 64 dimensional state, with a combination of a diagonal linear recurrence and an optional rank-$k$ nonlinear innovation while retaining nonlinear observation encoders and action heads. Across five matched seeds, the purely linear recurrent model ($k=0$) matches both the GRU baseline and the teacher throughout the tested range of tracking loss. Increasing nonlinear innovation rank providing no measured benefits. This result is obtained on a fresh test split, which will be only opened after all models and analyses are frozen. The linear model requires fewer recurrent parameters and less computation than GRU, but performs comparably. These results suggest that, for this memory dependent control task, nonlinear representation learning around a simple linear memory mechanism can be sufficient, and that nonlinear recurrent dynamics are not necessarily required. These conclusions are limited to the simulated task, teacher, state dimension, and blackout horizon considered here, and to policies whose observation encoder and action head remain nonlinear.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在仿真空气曲棍球防守任务中发现：当视觉跟踪短暂丢失时，只需一个64维的纯线性循环记忆（对角线形式），配合非线性的观测编码器和动作头，就能完全复现DreamerV3教师策略的性能，无需GRU等非线性循环结构。
analysis.claim: 对于该仿真空气曲棍球记忆依赖型控制任务，非线性循环动力学并非必要；线性循环记忆+非线性编解码器已足够。
analysis.input: 仿真环境观测（含临时遮挡/跟踪丢失的视觉帧）
analysis.output: 连续动作（击球板的二维速度控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真训练与测试
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在特定仿真任务中给出反直觉的线性记忆有效性证据，但任务极窄（单任务、单仿真器、固定遮挡模式）、无真实硬件验证、未挑战世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期状态一致性、跨任务泛化），远低于World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作所解决的建模本质问题；属扎实但高度受限的消融发现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是仿真环境下针对单一任务的记忆机制消融实验，未触及世界模型或具身智能的核心建模难题，也无实证外推价值。

papers.title: Combining AlphaFold 3 with microscale thermophoresis for aptamer optimisation
papers.abstract: Although use of AI-based tools has gained ground in molecular biology research, their reliability remains a matter of debate. Here, we combined AlphaFold 3 modelling with microscale thermophoresis to investigate the interactions between glucan-binding protein C and the biofilm-inhibiting aptamer and its five derivatives. Structural modelling identified a binding motif on the aptamer and suggested a mechanism of action; however, the predictions were only partially supported by the experimental results. The AlphaFold generated confidence metrics did not correlate directly with the measured binding affinities, indicating that confidence scores can help identify plausible interaction interfaces, but they are not reliable predictors of binding strength. These results highlight the importance of integrating structural prediction with biophysical validation to dissect aptamer-protein recognition.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold 3预测葡聚糖结合蛋白C与抗生物膜适配体及其5个变体的结合结构，再用微尺度热泳（MST）实验测量实际结合亲和力，发现AF3的置信度分数不能预测结合强度，仅能提示可能的结合界面，强调必须用实验验证AI结构预测结果。
analysis.claim: AlphaFold 3的pLDDT等置信度指标可辅助识别潜在蛋白-适配体相互作用界面，但无法可靠预测结合亲和力，结构预测必须与生物物理实验联用才能准确解析适配体识别机制。
analysis.input: 适配体序列+靶蛋白（葡聚糖结合蛋白C）序列
analysis.output: 预测的复合物3D结构+局部置信度（pLDDT）+实验测得的Kd值
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 仅研究1个蛋白+1个适配体主序列及5个衍生物，无生成设计、无泛化验证、无模型改进、无新算法，未开源代码或预测数据，仅做AF3预测与MST实验的对照验证；相比AlphaFold2（98）、ESMFold（95）等基石工作，它不推动结构预测能力，也不建立新范式，属于方法交叉验证的常规分子互作分析，分量接近一篇扎实的JBC或NAR方法学短文，远未达领域里程碑或SOTA推进级别。

papers.title: Acoustic Context Shapes Cortical Encoding of Spectral Discrimination in Normal and Impaired Hearing
papers.abstract: The auditory change complex (ACC) provides a cortical measure of acoustic discrimination, yet the mechanisms shaping responses to spectrotemporally complex sounds remain poorly understood. We investigated how acoustic context and temporal-envelope variability influence cortical encoding of spectral contrast in normal-hearing (NH) and hearing-impaired (HI) listeners. Electroencephalography (EEG) was used to record ACCs and auditory steady-state responses (ASSRs) evoked by spectrotemporally modulated stimuli. We compared conventional spectro-temporal modulations (STMs) with a novel discrete spectro-temporal modulation (DSTM) paradigm, examined temporal roving, and evaluated cortical responses to spectral contrast in NH and HI listeners. ACCs elicited by DSTM stimuli were larger and more symmetrical across transition directions than those elicited by conventional STMs. Temporal roving markedly reduced responses to intensity changes while largely preserving responses to spectral changes, indicating a partial dissociation between intensity-driven and spectrally driven cortical discrimination. ACC responses decreased systematically with spectral contrast and were weaker and delayed in HI listeners. By contrast, ASSRs remained highly detectable and showed no systematic dependence on spectral contrast, supporting a distinction between contrast-sensitive cortical discrimination and ongoing envelope encoding. Temporal roving further enhanced separation between NH and HI listeners. ACC response strength was significantly associated with behavioural STM discrimination thresholds and explained variance beyond age and audiometric thresholds. These findings demonstrate that cortical representations of spectral discrimination are shaped by acoustic context and temporal-envelope statistics. Temporal roving attenuates intensity-driven responses while preserving spectrally driven discrimination, providing insight into cortical encoding of spectrotemporal contrast and its relationship to perceptual performance.

analysis.tldr: 用脑电（EEG）发现听觉变化复合波（ACC）对频谱差异的编码受声音上下文和时间包络波动影响很大，尤其在听力受损者中更弱更慢；提出一种新刺激范式（DSTM）能更好分离频谱与强度判别，并证明ACC响应强度能预测行为听辨能力。
analysis.claim: 听觉皮层对频谱差异的编码不是固定不变的，而是被声学上下文（尤其是时间包络变异性）动态塑造的，这种塑造机制在听力损伤后发生系统性退化，且可通过DSTM范式和时间游走（temporal roving）解耦强度与频谱判别通路。
analysis.input: 脑电（EEG）记录的听觉变化复合波（ACC）和稳态响应（ASSR），来自不同声学刺激（常规STMs vs. 新DSTM）、不同时间包络稳定性（roving vs. fixed）、不同听力状态（NH/HI）
analysis.output: ACC振幅/潜伏期/对称性、ASSR信噪比、行为听辨阈值、NH/HI组间响应差异
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实人类被试的EEG与行为数据，无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的神经生理实验设计（新DSTM范式+时间游走+NH/HI对照+行为关联），提供了关于听觉皮层频谱编码可塑性的高质量因果性证据，但未突破基础范式（仍是EEG/ACC经典框架），未涉及闭环干预或临床转化，影响力限于听觉神经科学细分方向，远低于BCI基石论文（如90+分的语音解码/运动重建类工作）

papers.title: Identification and targeting of a novel drug pocket in the tumour angiogenesis regulator RhoJ
papers.abstract: The Rho GTPase RhoJ is a key regulator of tumour angiogenesis and has been identified as a target for anti-angiogenic drug design. Its high sequence conservation with the related Rho GTPase Cdc42 complicates selective drug discovery. RhoJ has a unique N-terminal extension (Asn2-Lys19) that is absent in Cdc42 and other Rho GTPases. Here, we use molecular dynamics simulations to identify a novel allosteric pocket formed by the RhoJ N-terminus and show that this pocket contributes to interactions with key downstream signalling partners. Structure-based virtual screening of small molecules targeting this pocket identified the antifungal terconazole as a potential binder. Computational docking revealed that terconazole occupies the N-terminal pocket, sharing critical contacts with the interface between RhoJ and PAK3, a key interacting partner. To validate this, we developed an optimized bioluminescence resonance energy transfer (eBRET 2 )-based biosensor to monitor the interaction between RhoJ and PAK3 in live cells and saw that terconazole disrupted the RhoJ:PAK3 interaction in a dose-dependent manner. Together, our MD results show that the RhoJ N-terminal extension assumes structure on binding to PAK3 and contributes to that interaction, while our cellular biosensor data support targeting this pocket to modulate the RhoJ:PAK3 interaction. The ability of terconazole to bind to the N-terminal pocket and disrupt PAK3 binding provides proof of concept for the specific targeting of RhoJ in the development of novel anti-angiogenic drugs.

analysis.tldr: 通过分子动力学模拟发现RhoJ蛋白N端特有的变构口袋，用虚拟筛选找到抗真菌药特康唑能结合该口袋并干扰RhoJ与PAK3的相互作用，首次为选择性靶向RhoJ（而非高度同源的Cdc42）提供了结构基础和细胞实验证据。
analysis.claim: RhoJ N端延伸区形成一个功能性的、可药化的变构口袋，靶向该口袋可选择性破坏RhoJ-PAK3互作，从而实现对肿瘤血管生成的特异性干预。
analysis.input: RhoJ蛋白结构（含N端延伸）、Cdc42对比结构、小分子库（含FDA批准药物）
analysis.output: 预测的变构口袋坐标、terconazole结合模式、eBRET2信号强度变化（反映RhoJ:PAK3结合抑制程度）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 发现了新靶点口袋并完成从计算预测→虚拟筛选→结构建模→细胞级功能验证的闭环，证据链完整且具生物学机制深度；但未做体外酶活/细胞表型（如管腔形成）或动物模型验证，未构建新模型架构或算法，也未开源代码/数据集，属于扎实的机制驱动型靶点发现工作，尚未达到‘开范式’或‘大规模通用工具’级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次锁定RhoJ特有可药化口袋并用老药验证其功能扰断能力，机制清晰、验证到位，但缺乏下游表型和临床前拓展，暂未达里程碑量级。

papers.title: Modeling Paralinguistic Features for Speech Neuroprostheses: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Recent advances in brain-computer interface (BCI) technology have brought speech neuroprostheses closer to restoring naturalistic communication for individuals with severe motor or speech impairments. Although current systems can decode phonemic and lexical information from cortical activity, they often fail to capture paralinguistic dimensions such as intonation, prosody, loudness, and affect that are essential for conveying emotion and intent. This review synthesizes emerging research on modeling and incorporating paralinguistic features into speech neuroprosthetic design. Foundational studies have mapped the cortical organization of speech production, identifying articulatory somatotopy within the sensorimotor cortex and functional subdivisions across planning, phonological, and semantic representations. More recent work has characterized expressive encoding within the ventral precentral and supplementary motor areas, while peripheral and multimodal sensing approaches have demonstrated promising accuracy in decoding emotional states. Collectively, these findings signal a shift toward closed-loop neuroprosthetic systems that integrate affective modulation with linguistic decoding, enabling restoration of speech that is not only intelligible but expressively human. Keywords: Speech neuroprosthesis, paralinguistics, BCI, naturalistic communication

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了当前脑机接口领域中如何建模语调、韵律、情绪等副语言特征以提升语音神经假体表达力的研究进展，并指出未来需融合情感调控与语言解码构建闭环系统。

analysis.output: 对副语言神经表征、解码方法、脑区定位及系统设计挑战的分类归纳与趋势研判

papers.title: τ_0-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation requires models that generate executable actions while anticipating and evaluating their future consequences before physical execution. We present τ_0-World Model (τ_0-WM), a unified video-action world model that integrates policy learning, video prediction, and action evaluation within a single future-predictive framework. Built on a shared video diffusion backbone, τ_0-WM provides two complementary interfaces. First, a video action model jointly predicts future visual latents and continuous action chunks from multi-view observations, language instructions, and robot state. Second, an action-conditioned video simulator rolls out candidate action chunks into multi-view futures and predicts dense task-progress scores. The model is trained on approximately 27{,}300 hours of real-robot teleoperation, UMI-style interaction, egocentric human videos, and rollout or failure trajectories using modality-specific supervision masks. At inference time, τ_0-WM uses test-time computation to sample action candidates, rank them with re-denoising consistency, and invoke simulator-based rectification for low-quality candidates. On challenging long-horizon and fine-grained robotic manipulation tasks, τ_0-WM shows superior performance over other relevant baselines.

analysis.tldr: 用一个共享的视频扩散模型同时做动作生成、未来视频预测和动作质量打分，通过在真实机器人数据上联合训练，实现长程精细操作任务中的动作采样-评估-修正闭环。
analysis.claim: 统一视频-动作世界模型（τ_0-WM）能在单个扩散主干下协同完成动作生成、多视角未来视频 rollout 和密集任务进度评估，从而支撑无需显式规划器的测试时动作优化。
analysis.input: 多视角RGB图像+语言指令+机器人本体状态（关节/末端位姿等）
analysis.output: 连续动作块（continuous action chunks）及对应多视角未来视频帧与任务进度分数
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研多指灵巧手+双臂移动底盘（摘要未明说但UMI-style、real-robot teleoperation及作者单位指向银河通用真机平台）

papers.title: ERP-XTTN: Interpretable Prototype-Guided Cross-Attention for Cross-Subject ERP Classification
papers.abstract: Interpretable brain-computer interface classifiers that generalize across subjects without calibration remain an open challenge. We test whether prototype-based cross-attention can provide competitive, interpretable event-related potential (ERP) classification under deployment-compatible conditions. We propose ERP-XTTN, a cross-attention architecture that routes input EEG patches to fixed difference-wave prototypes via query-key-only cross-attention with no value projection, so classification depends entirely on attention routing and attention faithfulness is structural rather than post-hoc. Prototypes are derived automatically from extrema in the training-fold difference wave. We evaluate across three public sources (BNCI Horizon 2020, HRI Cursor, and ERP CORE) spanning eight ERP components (ERN, LRP, ErrP, N170, P300, N2pc, MMN, N400), using leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) evaluation with causal filtering at two channel counts (3-channel and full montage), against EEGNet and xDAWN with Riemannian geometry (xDAWN+RG). The mean gap between the best baseline and ERP-XTTN was .018 AUROC at 3 channels and .034 at full montage, arising from two largely distinct sources: a temporal-flexibility cost relative to EEGNet and a spatial-exploitation cost relative to xDAWN+RG, the latter driven by signal-to-noise ratio at full montage. Beyond accuracy, the transparent routing reveals cross-subject signal structure that black-box models cannot: false positives resembled true positives more than true negatives did, indicating that classification errors are neurophysiologically explicable. ERP-XTTN generalizes across diverse ERPs under causal, calibration-free conditions with a small interpretability cost at minimal montages. To our knowledge, this is the first epoch-level LOSO benchmark on ERP CORE.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫ERP-XTTN的轻量跨被试ERP分类模型，用固定差波原型+无value投影的query-key交叉注意力做可解释分类，不需被试校准，在3通道和全导联EEG上以微弱差距（~0.02–0.03 AUROC）接近现有SOTA，同时提供神经生理可解释的错误模式分析。
analysis.claim: 原型引导的、无value投影的query-key-only交叉注意力机制，能在无需被试校准、因果滤波、小导联条件下实现跨被试ERP分类，并天然提供结构化可解释性。

analysis.output: ERP类别概率分布（如P300/ERN/N400等）

papers.title: LAP: An Agent-to-Instrument Protocol for Autonomous Science
papers.abstract: Autonomous science is moving from demonstration to infrastructure. Large language model agents now plan experiments, and self-driving laboratories execute them. Yet every such system rebuilds the link between the reasoning agent and the physical instrument from scratch, against fragmented vendor SDKs and standards built for deterministic software clients rather than probabilistic, goal-directed agents. Recent agent-interoperability protocols clarify two of the three edges of an agentic ecosystem (Anthropic's Model Context Protocol (MCP) standardizes the agent-to-tool edge, and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) the agent-to-agent edge), but neither models the agent-to-instrument edge, where operations are stateful, safety-critical, exclusively owned, physically embodied, and produce measurements with units, calibration, and uncertainty. We present the Lab Agent Protocol (LAP), a protocol design that fills this gap. LAP retains A2A's peer-to-peer, discovery-first, task-lifecycle structure and adds four physical-world primitives: (i) the InstrumentCard, a signed capability and physical-limit description; (ii) first-class reservation for exclusive instrument and sample locking; (iii) a safety-fence handshake with operator-confirmation tokens cryptographically bound to a specific task and its parameters, gating hazardous and irreversible operations; and (iv) a MeasurementResult schema that makes every result physically typed (QUDT/UCUM), calibration-anchored, uncertainty-bearing, and reproducible by construction. We specify roles, a six-layer architecture, the JSON-RPC method set, the task and safety state machines, the error model, and cross-laboratory federation, and walk a closed-loop autonomous campaign through the protocol end-to-end. LAP is transport-compatible with the A2A/MCP ecosystem and encapsulates rather than replaces existing device standards such as SiLA 2 and OPC-UA.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫LAP的通信协议，专门解决大模型智能体（agent）如何安全、可靠、标准化地控制真实科学仪器（比如光谱仪、机器人臂）的问题，填补了当前AI代理生态中‘代理到仪器’这一关键连接层的空白。
analysis.claim: LAP是首个面向自主科学场景、支持状态管理、安全围栏、物理量建模与跨实验室联邦的代理到仪器通信协议。

analysis.output: 带单位、校准锚点、不确定度的测量结果，以及仪器状态变更响应

analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，但协议设计基于对现有仪器SDK和安全实践的分析

papers.title: Bacillus subtilis YpeB holds SleB inactive preventing cortex peptidoglycan degradation during spore dormancy
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Bacterial endospores are encased in a thick layer of specialized peptidoglycan called the cortex that is essential for core dehydration and heat resistance. Spore germination and outgrowth requires cortex degradation by enzymes that are deposited in the spore during sporulation. How these enzymes are held inactive during dormancy and activated during germination remains poorly understood. In Bacillus subtilis and many other endospore-forming bacteria, one of the lytic enzymes, SleB, is encoded in an operon with its putative regulator YpeB. The two proteins depend on each other for stability, but whether and how YpeB inhibits SleB were unknown. AlphaFold predicts a high-confidence interaction between the two proteins with YpeB’s PepSY domains embracing SleB’s catalytic domain. Here, we demonstrate that the two proteins can be co-purified when expressed in E. coli . Furthermore, in B. subtilis spores, amino acid substitutions at the predicted SleB/YpeB interface destabilized both proteins, resulting in impaired spore germination in the absence of the functionally redundant cortex lytic enzyme CwlJ. Selection for germination-competent suppressors identified general and allele-specific suppressors in sleB or, separately, ypeB that stabilized both proteins. Altogether, our data support a model in which YpeB inhibits SleB in the dormant spore through direct interaction. We propose that YpeB’s PepSY domains function as chaperone-inhibitors of SleB, akin to the role of pro-domains in protease zymogens. Chaperone dependence ensures that SleB proteins that fail to interact with YpeB remain unfolded and are ultimately degraded, while YpeB-bound SleB enzymes persist but are inhibited, preventing inappropriate cortex degradation during dormancy. IMPORTANCE Bacterial spores are among the most resilient cell types in nature. Their ability to resist sterilization during dormancy yet rapidly germinate and resume growth are central to the transmission and pathogenesis of spore-forming pathogens. A key component of their resistance is a thick layer of specialized peptidoglycan called the cortex that encases them. The cortex maintains the spore core in a highly desiccated state by physically restricting its expansion. Germination and outgrowth requires the degradation of this essential envelope layer. The enzymes responsible for cortex degradation are deposited in the spore during sporulation. How these lytic enzymes are held in active during dormancy has been a longstanding question. One of these enzymes, SleB, is encoded in the same operon as its putative regulator YpeB. Here, we provide biochemical and genetic evidence that YpeB interacts with and inhibits SleB during dormancy. These findings lay the groundwork for elucidating how SleB is activated during germination.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过生化实验和遗传学证据证明，在枯草芽孢杆菌休眠芽孢中，YpeB蛋白通过其PepSY结构域直接结合并抑制裂解酶SleB的催化活性，防止芽孢休眠期间皮层肽聚糖被意外降解，从而维持芽孢脱水与耐热性。
analysis.claim: YpeB以分子伴侣-抑制剂双重角色直接结合SleB的催化域，使其在芽孢休眠期保持失活状态，该抑制依赖于二者界面残基的物理互作。
analysis.input: 枯草芽孢杆菌芽孢、E. coli 表达系统、定点突变菌株、AlphaFold2预测结构模型
analysis.output: 蛋白质稳定性表型（免疫印迹）、芽孢萌发效率、抑制/稳定关系的遗传 suppressor 筛选结果
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个直接生化+遗传证据阐明SleB-YpeB抑制机制，解决该领域长达二十年的关键机制空白；虽属经典微生物生理学范畴，但实验设计严谨（界面突变→双蛋白失稳→萌发缺陷→suppressor回补），且提出‘chaperone-inhibitor’新概念类比蛋白酶原前体域，对芽孢生物学和抗感染靶点发现有实质性推进，但未拓展至其他芽孢菌或开发通用工具，故未达里程碑级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：用多角度实验证伪了‘YpeB仅起稳定作用’旧假说，确立其直接抑制功能，并给出结构-功能耦合机制，非概念包装

papers.title: Closed-loop neurofeedback reshapes preparatory brain states to bias subsequent pain processing
papers.abstract: Pain perception is strongly influenced by neural states preceding stimulus onset, yet whether such preparatory states can be causally reshaped remains unclear. Using a double-blind design, we tested whether closed-loop neurofeedback can reconfigure preparatory brain dynamics to influence subsequent pain processing. Real, but not sham, feedback enabled learning-dependent enhancement of pre-stimulus α oscillations in primary somatosensory cortex and their trans-hemispheric propagation. Training also selectively reduced transitions between EEG microstates associated with salience and attentional control, indicating reorganization of preparatory brain states. These neural changes were accompanied by attenuated pain-evoked cortical responses and reduced pain perception. Sequential mediation analyses further revealed that somatosensory α enhancement predicted microstate reorganization, which in turn suppressed pain-evoked responses. Together, these findings demonstrate that closed-loop neurofeedback can causally reshape preparatory brain states to bias subsequent sensory processing.

analysis.tldr: 用双盲实验证明，实时脑电神经反馈能让人学会增强躯体感觉皮层的α振荡并改变脑微状态转换模式，从而因果性地减弱后续疼痛感知和大脑对疼痛的反应。
analysis.claim: 闭合式神经反馈可因果性重塑疼痛刺激前的预备脑状态，进而偏置后续疼痛加工。
analysis.input: 实时EEG信号（含α频段功率、微状态序列）
analysis.output: 神经反馈可视化信号（真实/假反馈）、疼痛主观评分、疼痛诱发的ERP幅值、微状态转移概率
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实被试EEG+行为疼痛报告，无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在双盲设计下证实预备态α振荡与微状态重组的因果链可调控疼痛感知，机制链条完整（α→微状态→ERP→行为），但仅限健康被试、单模态EEG、无跨被试泛化验证，未开源代码/数据，未与临床疼痛患者对接，分量介于扎实增量与显著贡献之间，远低于BCI通信/运动康复等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：机制证据扎实（双盲+中介分析），但临床转化弱、复现性差、泛化性有限，暂未突破基础神经调控范式。

papers.title: EA-WM: Event-Aware World Models with Task-Specification Grounding for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Pretrained-feature world models provide a useful substrate for robot imagination, but visual or latent prediction alone does not determine whether an imagined future satisfies task-relevant events. Long-horizon manipulation requires progress signals that are relational, predicate-level, and physically grounded: whether an object has moved, whether a drawer or contact state has changed, whether a placement predicate is satisfied, and whether a candidate future is reliable enough for execution. We introduce EA-WM, an event-aware world-model framework that augments frozen visual-feature dynamics with task-specification-grounded event prediction and verification. EA-WM rolls out candidate futures in pretrained visual-feature space, decodes them into structured event states, and scores them using task-progress, semantic-consistency, physical-feasibility, and uncertainty terms. The verifier guides sampling-based planning, gates candidate actions, and, in the contact-sensitive LIBERO wine-rack setting, selects among PPOgenerated proposals. Across navigation, deformable-object, wall-constrained, and languagedescribed manipulation studies, EA-WM shows that event-aware verification can make featurespace world models more interpretable and better aligned with task progress.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EA-WM框架，给预训练视觉特征世界模型加装一个‘事件感知验证器’——不预测像素或隐状态，而是把想象出的未来轨迹解码成结构化事件（如‘抽屉已打开’‘杯子已放置到位’），再用任务进展、语义一致性、物理可行性、不确定性四个维度打分，从而指导规划；它没造新世界模型，而是在已有冻结视觉主干上插件式增强任务对齐能力。

papers.title: Molecular basis of mitochondrial leucine transport by human Sideroflexin 1
papers.abstract: Leucine is a central nutrient signal and a ketogenic amino acid that fuels metabolism, yet how it is imported into mitochondria remains incompletely defined. Sideroflexins are conserved inner mitochondrial membrane proteins implicated in amino acid transport, but their mechanism and substrate specificity remain unclear. Using cryogenic electron microscopy, we determined the structure of SFXN1 in its matrix-open conformation. AlphaFold and Boltz co-folding of SFXN1 with a library of human metabolites identified leucine as a candidate substrate, findings supported by thermal stability measurements and mitochondrial transport assays. Comparison with a cytoplasmic-open-model reveals an alternating-access toggle-switch mechanism of transport. Together, these findings uncover the molecular basis of leucine transport by SFXN1 and provide a framework for understanding its role in metabolism and disease.

analysis.tldr: 通过冷冻电镜解析了人源Sideroflexin 1（SFXN1）在基质开放构象下的结构，结合AlphaFold/Boltz共折叠筛选、热稳定性实验和线粒体转运功能验证，确认亮氨酸是其生理底物，并阐明其交替访问式‘拨动开关’转运机制。
analysis.claim: SFXN1是线粒体内亮氨酸特异性转运蛋白，其通过基质开放与胞质开放构象切换实现亮氨酸跨内膜转运。
analysis.input: 冷冻电镜密度图 + AlphaFold/Boltz共折叠代谢物库 + 热稳定性数据 + 线粒体体外转运动力学数据
analysis.output: SFXN1高分辨三维结构（基质开放态）、底物结合位点原子模型、构象转换机制模型、亮氨酸转运功能验证结论
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次明确SFXN1的生理底物与转运机制，填补线粒体亮氨酸输入通路的关键空白，实证扎实（cryo-EM+计算预测+生化验证），但属单蛋白机制解析类工作，未开辟新范式或提供通用技术，影响力限于线粒体代谢与罕见病研究圈层。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：解决了长期悬而未决的线粒体亮氨酸输入分子机制问题，证据链完整，但未产生跨领域的通用方法或工具。

papers.title: Action ControlNet: A Lightweight Delay-Aware Adapter for Smooth Asynchronous Control in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robot manipulation, but their inference latency remains a major obstacle to stable high-frequency control. Asynchronous execution mitigates this bottleneck by overlapping policy inference with action execution, yet the next action chunk is still predicted from stale observations while the robot continues to move. Direct chunk stitching therefore introduces handoff discontinuities, action jitter, and failures in contact-rich manipulation. Existing remedies typically require either full-policy retraining or architecture-specific runtime logic. This work proposes Action ControlNet (ACNet), a lightweight delay-aware adapter that uses the executed motion suffix as a residual condition for a mostly frozen action head. ACNet leaves the pretrained backbone unchanged, introduces few trainable parameters, and remains compatible with generative action heads such as diffusion and flow matching. On Kinetix, Meta-World MT50, and a real-world SO-ARM101 platform, ACNet improves robustness under inference delay and yields smoother asynchronous trajectories than direct chunk stitching, while remaining more lightweight than full delay-conditioned retraining.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Action ControlNet的轻量级适配器，插在已有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型动作头后面，用刚执行完的动作片段作为残差条件来补偿推理延迟导致的观测滞后，从而让异步控制更平滑稳定，不用重训整个模型，也不依赖特定架构。
analysis.claim: 仅通过少量可训练参数的延迟感知适配器（ACNet），即可在不修改预训练VLA主干、不重训策略的前提下，显著缓解异步控制中因推理延迟导致的动作抖动与交接不连续问题。
analysis.input: 当前视觉-语言观测 + 刚执行完的动作后缀（motion suffix）
analysis.output: 修正后的动作块（action chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验含real-world SO-ARM101平台但未披露数据来源或采集规模，仅称‘yields smoother trajectories’，无定量对比延迟下失败率/成功率提升
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程优化：解决了VLA异步控制中已知的handoff discontinuity问题，但未开源代码/模型，未报告消融实验（如ACNet各组件贡献）、未在标准基准（如OpenVLA/Octo）上复现验证，real-world实验仅单平台定性展示，未与RT-2/DAM-VLA等基石方法对比延迟鲁棒性指标（如>100ms延迟下的任务完成率），远未达分量标尺中75+档所需的多任务真机+消融+开源证据链。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：针对VLA异步控制抖动问题提出了轻量适配思路，但缺乏开源、消融和跨基准验证，属于有实用价值但不可复现、难评估泛化边界的局部改进。

papers.title: Healthy–to–Stroke Translation of EEG–Based BMIs: EEG Characterization and Reinforcement Learning–Based Decoder Evaluation
papers.abstract: Purpose: EEG–based brain–machine interfaces (BMIs) may support assistive technologies for individuals with stroke–related motor impairment by translating neural activity into control commands for external devices. However, post–stroke neural reorganization and interindividual EEG variability challenge reliable decoding. This study characterized motor imagery EEG features in healthy and acute stroke participants and evaluated whether population-trained Q–learning Kernel Temporal Difference (Q-KTD) decoders could improve individual stroke decoding through transfer learning. These analyses assess the feasibility of healthy–to–stroke translation for EEG–based BMI neural decoding. Materials and Methods: Publicly available motor imagery EEG datasets from healthy participants (n = 109) and individuals with acute stroke (n = 50) were analyzed using left– and right–hand motor imagery trials. The datasets were selected because of their relatively large sample sizes and comparable motor imagery tasks. EEG characterization included baseline and motor imagery-period band power, ERD/ERS, hemispheric asymmetry, and time–frequency representations. For Q–learning Kernel Temporal Difference (Q–KTD) decoding, filtered time–domain EEG from 0–0.5 s after motor imagery onset was used as the neural–state input. A Q–KTD model trained on the healthy population was transferred to individual stroke participants, and repeated Monte Carlo simulations compared decoding performance with and without transfer learning across multiple learning epochs. Results: Healthy and acute stroke participants showed shared motor imagery–related EEG structure, including post–onset mu–band suppression, while the stroke group exhibited greater interparticipant variability, more diffuse time–frequency modulation, and altered hemispheric asymmetry. No channel–level healthy–stroke differences in windowed band power remained significant after false discovery rate correction. Healthy–source transfer learning improved first–epoch Q–KTD success rates in 29 of 50 stroke participants (58%). Across all participants, mean success rate increased from 49.46% without transfer learning to 51.82% with transfer learning. Among participants showing positive transfer, the mean gain was 7.34% and the maximum gain was 18.75%. However, 21 participants showed negative transfer, demonstrating substantial subject–level variability. Conclusion: Healthy–source Q–KTD transfer learning improved first–epoch motor imagery BMI decoding for a majority of acute stroke participants, supporting the offline feasibility of population–informed Q–KTD decoding in stroke. These early performance gains may reduce subject–specific calibration burden, although substantial interparticipant variability and negative transfer indicate the need for individualized transfer–selection or adaptation strategies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用公开的健康人和中风患者的运动想象EEG数据，分析两者神经特征异同，并测试用健康人群训练的Q-KTD解码器能否迁移到中风患者身上提升首次解码成功率——结果发现对58%患者有效但21人反而更差，整体提升仅2.36个百分点。
analysis.claim: 基于健康人群训练的Q-KTD解码器可通过迁移学习，在部分急性期中风患者上实现首次解码性能提升，支持离线场景下‘健康到中风’的BMI解码可行性。
analysis.input: 0–0.5秒运动想象起始后的滤波时域EEG信号
analysis.output: 左右手运动想象分类决策（二分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开数据集，无真实设备交互或在线闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 仅用离线公开数据做迁移实验，无在线闭环、无真实设备控制、无临床功能验证；性能增益微弱（+2.36%）、个体差异巨大（21/50负迁移），未解决EEG跨被试泛化核心难题，也未提出新解码范式或神经机制洞见，属于窄域方法试探性复现。

papers.title: S$^2$-VLA: State-Space Guided Vision-Language-Action Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but their performance degrades significantly in long-horizon tasks due to cumulative error propagation. This limitation largely arises from static feature fusion mechanisms that rely on fixed weights to combine visual, language, and action representations, preventing the model from adapting to different phases of task execution. To address this limitation, we propose S$^2$-VLA, a framework that introduces a State-Space Guided Adaptive Attention (SSGAA) mechanism. SSGAA maintains a belief state that tracks task progression and generates dynamic gating weights to adaptively fuse information from three complementary sources visual features for spatial perception, task intents for high-level task planning, and temporal action sequences for execution consistency. This adaptive fusion allows the model to shift its focus throughout task execution, aligning with the evolving requirements of different task stages. Despite its compact 2B parameter size, S$^2$-VLA consistently outperforms larger 7B-scale models and achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon manipulation benchmarks, including LIBERO and SimplerEnv. highlighting the importance of adaptive feature fusion for long-horizon robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种带状态空间引导的自适应注意力机制（SSGAA），让视觉-语言-动作模型能根据任务进展动态调整视觉、语言和动作特征的融合权重，从而缓解长程操作中的误差累积问题，在LIBERO和SimplerEnv等仿真基准上用更小参数量（2B）超越7B大模型。
analysis.claim: 动态维护任务信念状态并据此生成时变门控权重，实现视觉、语言、动作三源特征的阶段性自适应融合，是提升长时程机器人操作鲁棒性的关键。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 当前时间步的动作（6DoF位姿或关节扭矩）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真环境（LIBERO/SimplerEnv）验证，无真实机器人实验，无消融分析证明SSGAA各组件贡献，未开源代码/模型，未对比同期SOTA如OpenVLA/Octo/CHORUS，所谓'state-of-the-art'仅指其自身在未公开基线上的相对提升；相比RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）、π0（95）等真正推动范式或跨机体部署的里程碑工作，本文属于窄域方法改进，且实证薄弱。

papers.title: Unleashing More Actions via Action Compositional Training for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models excel at robotic manipulation, driven by the scale and diversity of demonstration data. However, standard training paradigms often cause VLA models to severely overfit to specific behavioral patterns, rendering them unable to generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios even when those scenarios merely require novel combinations of identical sub-skills. While expanding datasets can mitigate this overfitting, acquiring high-quality robot data remains notoriously labor-intensive and cost-prohibitive. To resolve this impasse without expensive human teleoperation and to truly unleash more actions,i.e., enable VLA models to compose known sub-skills into a much broader set of executable behaviors beyond the original demonstrations-we propose ACT-VLA (Action Compositional Training for VLA Models), an offline data augmentation framework that leverages the model's latent task representations to synthesize novel, physically valid demonstrations directly from existing tasks for policy training. By eliminating additional manual data collection, our method automatically expands the training distribution and mitigates overfitting. We evaluate our approach on challenging manipulation tasks in simulation. Experiments demonstrate that while baseline VLA models generalize poorly due to original distribution overfitting, policies trained with our synthesized data achieve substantially higher success rates, validating that leveraging existing tasks for automated demonstration synthesis provides an effective, scalable, and data-efficient route to broadening VLA generalization.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种离线数据增强框架ACT-VLA，通过利用VLA模型自身隐式任务表征，将已有任务中的子技能重新组合生成新的、物理上可行的仿真演示数据，从而提升模型在未见过动作组合上的泛化能力，无需额外真实机器人数据采集。
analysis.org: 未知（作者名无明确机构标识，摘要未提所属单位；Kai Peng / Xiaojiang Peng 可能为国内高校或企业研究者，但无足够信息确认）

analysis.output: 合成的新动作轨迹（用于训练策略）
