papers.title: Learning Gait-Aware Quadruped Locomotion with Temporal Logic Specifications
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for quadruped locomotion commonly depends on fixed, hand-crafted, and Markovian reward functions that limit both interpretability of learned policies and lack explicit control over gait behaviors. We introduce a framework where distinct gaits are specified using parameterized constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). These include safety bounds, gait synchronization constraints, command tracking, and actuation bounds. From these specifications, we develop a reward shaping mechanism that provides learning agents a dense, continuous reward landscape that encodes desired behavior. We define parametric STL templates for three speed regimes (walking-trot, trot, bound), calibrate their parameters from reference rollouts, and compute rewards from using smooth approximations of STL robustness over the rollouts. The generated rewards can be used to provide shaped gradients compatible with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). We instantiate the approach on Google's Barkour quadruped robot in MuJoCo XLA (MJX). We use parallelization within the simulator to improve training speeds and use domain randomization to robustify learned policies. We show that compared to a baseline of hand-crafted rewards, the STL-shaped rewards yield tighter velocity tracking and more stable training. Videos can be found on our project website: https://stl-locomotion.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 用信号时序逻辑（STL）自动定义四足机器人不同步态（走/小跑/飞奔）的行为约束，再将这些约束转化为稠密可微的奖励函数，替代人工设计的稀疏奖励，从而让PPO训练出更稳定、速度跟踪更准的步态策略。
analysis.claim: 用参数化信号时序逻辑（STL）规范四足步态并生成可微奖励，能比手工奖励函数更有效地引导强化学习训练出高保真、鲁棒的步态策略。
analysis.input: 状态观测（关节角度/角速度/IMU等）+高层速度指令
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令（连续动作空间）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有启发性（用STL做奖励塑形），但仅在单一仿真平台（MJX）上验证，未跨机体/地形/任务泛化，无真实机器人部署，无消融实验验证STL各约束项贡献，对比基线仅是手工奖励，未与SOTA步态学习方法（如RL+运动先验、隐式步态编码）对比，视频展示也仅限理想平坦地面匀速指令。

papers.title: Learning Residual Kinematic Corrections for Continuous Neural Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Decoding continuous three-dimensional (3D) motor imagery (MI) using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) remains challenging due to signal variability and residual decoding errors. Deep learning architectures such as convolutional neural network--long short-term memory (CNN--LSTM) models can capture spatial and temporal dynamics for continuous kinematic decoding; however, systematic residual errors persist in predicted trajectories. We propose a two-stage decoding framework that applies reinforcement learning (RL) to perform residual kinematic correction on the outputs of a CNN--LSTM decoder (CNN--LSTM--RL). The RL agent is trained offline without direct EEG input and instead operates on predicted kinematic trajectories to optimize movement accuracy relative to target trajectories. Decoding performance was quantified using Pearson correlation coefficients ($r$) and Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) along the $x, y$, and $z$ axes. Compared to CNN--LSTM applied alone, CNN--LSTM--RL improved the mean correlation from $0.5076$ to $0.7181$ ($p = 0.0005$) in 2D and from $0.6420$ to $0.7780$ ($p = 0.0059$) in VR, with relative gains of $41.5\%$ and $21.2\%$, respectively. Correspondingly, RMSE was reduced from $0.0890$ to $0.0532$ (2D, $p < 0.0001$) and from $0.0714$ to $0.0441$ (VR, $p < 0.0001$), representing relative reductions of $40.2\%$ and $38.2\%$. These findings demonstrate that this scalable framework enhances 3D BCI MI decoding by correcting kinematic errors via offline residual RL without extra neural data, advancing neurorehabilitation, prosthetics, and virtual interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个两阶段解码框架：先用CNN-LSTM解码EEG信号得到3D运动轨迹，再用离线训练的强化学习模型对预测轨迹做残差校正，不依赖额外脑电数据就显著提升了连续运动想象解码的准确率。
analysis.claim: 离线训练的强化学习模块可有效校正CNN-LSTM解码器产生的系统性运动轨迹残差，从而在不增加神经数据采集负担的前提下显著提升非侵入式EEG连续三维运动想象解码性能。
analysis.input: CNN-LSTM解码器输出的3D运动轨迹（x/y/z坐标序列）
analysis.output: 经残差校正后的优化3D运动轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖已有的EEG-运动轨迹配对数据集（如BCI Competition IV 2a或类似VR/2D运动想象数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽有扎实的统计显著性提升（p<0.001）和明确的残差建模思路，但仅在单一数据集（未说明具体来源）、单任务（2D+VR运动想象）、无跨被试验证、无在线闭环测试、无临床人群验证；相比标尺中90+分的里程碑工作（如高精度手写/语音实时解码、脊髓损伤自然行走），它未突破非侵入式EEG的根本信噪比瓶颈，也未解决泛化性、鲁棒性或临床部署等关键障碍，属于有实证支撑但场景窄、增量明确的工程改进。

papers.title: Measure the Sim-to-Real Gap: Designing an Affordable Real-World Benchmark Platform for Reinforcement Learning in AIoT Systems
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly employed to enhance the performance of autonomous systems, including the Autonomous Internet of Things (AIoT). However, the trial-and-error nature of RL, when conducted in real-world environments, is costly and hazardous in some scenarios. Consequently, the majority of RL research is conducted in simulation. This reliance introduces challenges related to the Sim-to-Real transferability. Evaluating the Sim-to-Real algorithmic robustness and the Sim-to-Real gap is a critical prerequisite for research aimed at improving RL performance in the real world. Therefore, industries such as robotics have developed concurrent simulation and physical platforms to facilitate this research. However, a universal Sim-to-Real benchmark platform for AIoT does not currently exist. To address these concerns, we developed a real-world AIoT platform for studying RL in AIoT. On this platform, an agent deployed on an edge device plays video games on a separate host computer via a hardware-emulated keyboard, guided by vision input. This platform uses commercially available components costing less than USD 400, together with two computers. Because the system's objective is game score maximization, it inherently mitigates safety risks associated with real-world RL deployments. Experimental results show the simulation-trained agent suffers a 1160% performance degradation relative to the human-level performance after real-world deployment, indicating a significant Sim-to-Real gap. Direct real-world training using the deep Q-network (DQN) algorithm achieves approximately 38% of human-level performance after 10 million training steps, demonstrating the feasibility of RL under real-world conditions. These results suggest that the proposed Sim-to-Real benchmark platform provides a substantial foundation for qualitative and quantitative evaluations of RL in real-world AIoT systems.

analysis.tldr: 用不到400美元的现成硬件（两台电脑+硬件模拟键盘）搭建了一个真实AIoT平台，让边缘设备通过视觉输入控制主机打游戏，以此量化RL算法在仿真与真实环境间的性能落差（实测仿真训练模型在真实部署后性能暴跌1160%），并验证了纯真实环境DQN训练的可行性。
analysis.claim: 提出首个面向AIoT系统的低成本、可复现、安全可控的Sim-to-Real基准平台，并实证揭示了当前视觉驱动RL在AIoT真实部署中存在巨大性能鸿沟。
analysis.input: RGB游戏画面视频流
analysis.output: 硬件模拟的键盘按键序列（离散动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实平台采集数据；无预收集真实机器人数据集，所有训练/评估均在自建平台上在线进行
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次聚焦AIoT场景的Sim-to-Real量化评估并构建了低成本真实平台，但任务单一（仅打固定游戏）、未跨设备/跨协议/跨传感器泛化，无开源代码或模型，仅提供项目页，实证深度远逊于RT-X、ALOHA等基石工作（后者覆盖多机体、多任务、真实机器人闭环、完整开源）；其1160%性能衰减是现象揭示而非机制突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了AIoT领域首个可落地的Sim-to-Real量化基准，但任务封闭、泛化弱、开源不足，属于方法论验证型工作，非范式突破

papers.title: Think at 5 Hz, Act at 20 Hz: Asynchronous Fast-Slow Vision-Language-Action Inference for Closed-Loop Driving
papers.abstract: Large language models bring instruction following and scene reasoning to end-to-end driving, but their inference latency collides with the control rate a vehicle requires. Existing closed-loop agents hide this gap by invoking the model on alternate simulation ticks and replaying the previous command in between, so half of all control outputs ignore the newest observations. We present a fast-slow architecture that removes this compromise. A frozen 7B vision-language backbone acts as the slow system, digesting navigation instructions and visual history at low frequency while exposing its per-layer key-value cache as a standing representation of the scene. A lightweight action expert acts as the fast system, attending to this cache and to the current camera frame at every simulation tick to regress waypoints in a single forward pass. Since the cache lags behind the world at deployment, we train the expert under randomized staleness, aligning training with asynchronous execution. On LangAuto-Short routes in CARLA, our system produces fresh control at every 50 ms simulation tick and lifts route completion from 37.0 to 94.0 over the frame-skipping baseline. A frame-skip ablation with the same expert separates the two factors at work: the expert raises the driving score on its own, while per-tick freshness raises completion from 82.1 to 94.0 and cuts red-light violations by a third. Trained on a single town, the expert transfers zero-shot to two unseen towns, holding 84-94% route completion where the baseline reaches 31-41%. It reduces open-loop waypoint error by nearly a factor of four compared to the backbone's own action head, at a per-tick model cost of 32 ms that is independent of history length on a single consumer GPU.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种快慢异步架构：慢速大模型（7B视觉语言模型）低频更新场景表征并缓存KV，快速轻量动作专家高频（20Hz）读取缓存+最新图像直接回归路径点，解决大模型推理延迟与车辆控制频率不匹配问题，在CARLA中实现每50ms输出新鲜控制指令，显著提升闭环驾驶成功率和跨城镇泛化性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性署名；Li Yun、Gong Jiachen等姓名常见于中/美高校及企业，但无足够线索锁定主体）

papers.title: Tripody: An Overconstrained 3-SPR-like Parallel Robot for High-Reach Construction Tasks
papers.abstract: Many ceiling construction tasks still rely on heavy serial manipulators that are difficult to deploy in cluttered interiors, motivating lightweight, field-ready alternatives that reach ceiling height while maintaining millimeter-level accuracy and the stiffness demanded by overhead tool loads. We introduce Tripody, a wheeled 3-DoF parallel robot for high-reach tasks that replaces the base spherical joints of a classical 3-SPR (3 legs; S: base spherical joint; P: actuated prismatic joint; R: end-effector revolute joint) morphology with universal joints, intentionally overconstraining the mechanism; small, distributed elastic deflections absorb the resulting incompatibilities, preserving predominantly translational motion. The 33kg system extends from 1.7m to 3.4m in height, supports a continuous 32kg payload, and offers a modular end-effector interface for ceiling operations. We detail the mechanical design - including custom linear actuators and a kinematic-compatibility analysis - and a control stack for accurate positioning that combines SE(3) state estimation, forward kinematics, and task-space control. In experiments, Tripody exhibits similar in-plane stiffness to a spherical-base variant but substantially higher torsional stiffness - an increase of 67% at 1.7m, 196% at 2.6m, and 454% at 3.4m - while maintaining negligible cross-axis coupling. Closed-loop positioning with a total station converges below 0.6mm across the entire workspace; pure model extrapolation achieves a 95th-percentile error of 2.7mm (max 3.6mm). Finally, we demonstrate task-level ceiling-drilling feasibility in an open-loop study by drilling a 15-hole pattern with 4.5mm maximum relative hole-position error after rigid alignment. These results support overconstrained, compliance-absorbing 3-SPR-like architectures as a practical path to lightweight, high- reach, millimeter-accurate construction robots.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种名为Tripody的3-DoF轮式并联机器人，通过用万向节替代传统3-SPR结构的球铰、故意过约束机构，并利用微小弹性形变吸收运动不兼容性，在轻量化（33kg）前提下实现1.7–3.4m高程伸展、32kg持续负载、毫米级定位精度（实测闭环<0.6mm）和显著提升的抗扭刚度（最高提升454%），专用于室内天花板施工任务。
analysis.claim: 过约束但弹性兼容的3-SPR-like并联构型可在轻量化前提下同时满足高伸展比、高负载、高刚度（尤其抗扭）与毫米级定位精度，是面向真实天花板施工的可行机器人架构。
analysis.input: SE(3)位姿指令（由全站仪闭环反馈或前向运动学模型生成）
analysis.output: 三支腿伸缩量（即末端执行器在x-y-z空间的平移位姿）

papers.title: NeoRacer: An Open, Standardized 1:12 Scale Autonomous Race Car for Benchmarking and Education
papers.abstract: Many scientific fields rely on standard benchmarks and shared platforms to improve review and reproducibility, but autonomous systems research still lacks widely accepted open hardware. Where standardization has emerged, progress has accelerated. This is especially evident in autonomous racing, where teams often build custom systems or buy niche, expensive vehicles, making control and robotics research and education hard to compare and reproduce. High costs also limit access outside well-funded labs, while affordable educational robots are often underpowered. To address this gap, we present NeoRacer, an open-source 1:12 scale autonomous racing platform. It is built around an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (67 TOPS), a 270° LiDAR, a 120 fps global-shutter camera, and a 9-axis IMU. NeoRacer ships pre-assembled for USD 2,699, offering over 3x the compute of comparable platforms at less than half the cost of the nearest pre-assembled alternative. Co-developed by the Neobotics Foundation and Seeed Studio, and manufactured by Seeed Studio, NeoRacer combines open hardware and software design with scalable, repeatable production. The modular, extensible platform provides a standardized benchmarking environment for autonomous racing algorithms across institutions. We describe the hardware/software architecture, design decisions from two pilot deployments (MIT IAP, 15 students; BU CPS Lab, 10 students), and key cost-performance tradeoffs. Hardware is licensed under CERN-OHL-S v2 and software under GPLv3, with all design files, firmware, and ROS2 packages publicly accessible.

analysis.tldr: 推出一款开源、标准化的1:12比例自动驾驶赛车硬件平台NeoRacer，主打低成本（2699美元）、高算力（Jetson Orin Nano 67 TOPS）、预装交付，专为算法基准测试和高校教学设计，配套完整硬件图纸、ROS2软件栈和量产能力。
analysis.claim: NeoRacer是首个面向自主赛车算法基准测试与教育场景、实现开箱即用+全栈开源+规模化量产的标准化1:12比例自主赛车平台。

analysis.output: 转向与油门控制指令（底层执行级）

papers.title: CheckVLA: Execution-Time Verification with Action-Conditioned World Model for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly execute long-horizon mobile manipulation through open-loop action chunks, issuing multiple actions without receiving new high-level visual input. A committed chunk therefore implies how observations should evolve, but accidental deviations can violate this expectation while the remaining actions continue to propagate the error: commit-time policy confidence cannot react to a deviation that occurs after dispatch, and observation-only anomaly scores lack an action-conditioned reference for separating expected effects from unexplained changes. We propose CheckVLA, which verifies execution with a separately trained, frozen action-conditioned world model. A conformally calibrated risk threshold bounds the episode-level probability of an unnecessary first intervention and determines when to intervene, its exceedance controls how strongly the rewritten suffix retains the superseded chunk, latency-aware hard prefixing restricts replacement to actions that remain deployable, and an event-driven keyframe bank preserves evidence of prior progress across repairs. On RoboCasa365, under a common training recipe and a matched invocation budget, CheckVLA attains a 36.1% average success rate against 27.6% for periodic replanning (+8.5 points). At a matched 5% episode-level false-alarm target, action conditioning raises timely recall to 77.9%, against 48.6% for an observation-only control and 37.9% for an action-shuffled control. These simulation results support action-conditioned verification as a way to restore feedback during chunked execution while keeping the repair consistent with inference latency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CheckVLA，在VLA模型执行长时程动作块时，用一个冻结的、动作条件化的世界模型实时验证每步观测是否符合预期，一旦发现偏差就触发低延迟修复（保留已执行前缀、重写后续动作），从而在不增加在线推理负担的前提下显著提升任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 动作条件化的世界模型比纯观测异常检测更能精准识别执行偏差，且其校准后的风险阈值可实现高召回、低误报的干预决策，从而在chunked VLA执行中恢复缺失的闭环反馈。
analysis.input: 当前视觉观测 + 已发出的动作块（含历史动作序列）
analysis.output: 是否触发干预的二值信号 + 重写的动作后缀
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境生成的合成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了动作条件化世界模型用于执行期验证的新范式，实证优于observation-only基线（+29.3% recall）和shuffled控制组，但仅在单一仿真环境RoboCasa365上验证，无真实硬件实验、无开源代码/模型、未跨任务/机体泛化，属于扎实但窄域的增量改进，未触及世界模型基础架构或长期记忆等核心瓶颈。

papers.title: FasTac: A Curved Multispectral Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for High-Speed High-Precision 3D Shape and Force Perception
papers.abstract: Curved tactile fingertips for dexterous manipulation must resolve fine contact geometry, distinguish normal and tangential loads, and capture transient signals. Existing curved vision-based tactile sensors struggle to combine accurate 3D reconstruction, three-axis force estimation, and high-speed processing in a compact form. This article presents FasTac, a curved vision-based tactile sensor integrating multispectral photometric stereo, dynamic-convolution force estimation, and hardware acceleration on a field-programmable gate array (FPGA). Single-image-sensor simultaneous multispectral imaging provides spatially aligned observations for robust surface normal estimation, followed by boundary-prior fast Poisson depth reconstruction. HyperForce uses position-aware dynamic convolution to model the spatially nonuniform mechanical response of curved elastomers and estimate three-axis forces. The complete image-to-normal-force pipeline is deployed on an FPGA. Experiments show that near-infrared (NIR) illumination and the boundary prior decrease depth mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.2730 mm to 0.0415 mm; HyperForce achieves normalized mean absolute error (NMAE) values of 2.74% and 2.39% for normal and shear forces, respectively; and FPGA deployment shortens processing latency from 3.26 ms on the GPU to 1.09 ms. Multi-object reconstruction, feedback grasping, and vibration measurement validate fine geometric perception, stable force feedback, and dynamic contact sensing.

analysis.tldr: 提出了一种弯曲曲面的多光谱视觉触觉传感器FasTac，用单张图像+多光谱成像+边界先验泊松重建实现亚0.05mm精度的3D形变估计，用位置感知动态卷积模型HyperForce实现三轴力误差<2.4%的实时估计，并全部硬件加速部署在FPGA上，延迟压到1.09ms。
analysis.claim: 通过多光谱光度立体+边界先验泊松重建+位置感知动态卷积+全流水线FPGA部署，首次在弯曲视觉触觉传感器上同时实现高精度（<0.05mm深度MAE、<2.4%力NMAE）、高帧率（~917Hz等效处理速率）、小体积的三维形貌与三轴力联合感知。
analysis.input: 单帧多光谱（可见光+近红外）图像序列
analysis.output: 3D表面法向量场、泊松重建深度图、三轴接触力（Fx/Fy/Fz）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖定制化标定数据与真实触觉交互实验数据（含多物体抓取、振动测量），但未说明是否开源或跨平台复用性

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破——它不是刷榜或概念包装，而是从光学设计、重建算法、力学建模到硬件部署全栈优化，在弯曲指尖触觉这一长期瓶颈上实现了精度、速度、鲁棒性的同步跃升，但受限于闭源与平台绑定，暂属器件级里程碑而非系统级。

papers.title: Hologenomics of xylotrophic bivalves reveals a minimalist, remote-acting evolutionary strategy of wood digestion
papers.abstract: Abstract Wood constitutes the largest reservoir of biogenic carbon on Earth, yet remarkably few animals can exploit it. While terrestrial wood-feeders like termites rely on highly diverse gut microbiomes, xylotrophic marine bivalves have evolved a fundamentally different approach: a spatially segregated system where intracellular gill symbionts produce enzymes that act remotely within a nearly sterile cecum. However, the genetic and evolutionary basis of this unique symbiosis remains largely elusive. Here, we integrate hologenomics, transcriptomics, and biochemistry of a shallow-water shipworm ( Teredo navalis ) and a deep-sea borer ( Xyloredo sp.). We find that despite diverging approximately 147 million years ago and occupying drastically different habitats, these bivalves maintain a strictly conserved ancestral karyotype and a shared genomic architecture for wood digestion. Our models reveal a clear host-symbiont division of labor. The host genome is specialized for lignin modification and targeted enzyme transport, whereas a highly streamlined symbiont community is responsible for core polysaccharide degradation. Central to this minimalist strategy is a lineage-specific GH5–GH6 dual-catalytic enzyme. By sharing amino acids across proximal binding pockets, this fusion protein unites endo- and exo-cellulase activities, enabling highly synergistic cellulose cleavage without the need for complex microbial communities. Ultimately, our comparative analysis with terrestrial models demonstrates that these marine invertebrates achieve efficient biomass degradation not through microbial expansion, but through extreme functional streamlining and molecular innovation, offering a distinct evolutionary paradigm for marine carbon cycling.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合船蛆和深海木蛀贝的全息基因组、转录组和生化实验，发现它们虽在1.47亿年前分化且栖息环境迥异，却共用一套极度简化的共生消化策略：宿主负责木质素修饰和酶运输，高度精简的鳃内共生菌群专攻多糖降解，核心是一种新发现的GH5-GH6融合酶，能同时执行内切和外切纤维素酶功能，实现不依赖复杂微生物群的高效木材降解。
analysis.org: 中国科学院海洋研究所
analysis.claim: 海洋木食性双壳类通过宿主-共生体功能极致分工与一种新型双催化域融合酶（GH5–GH6），演化出不依赖复杂微生物群的远程、 minimalist 木材消化策略，构成区别于陆生白蚁的全新碳降解进化范式。
analysis.input: 多组学数据（宿主基因组+共生菌宏基因组+转录组+酶活性测定+染色质定位+系统发育分析）
analysis.output: 宿主-共生体功能分工模型、保守基因组架构图谱、GH5-GH6融合酶结构-功能验证、跨物种比较进化结论
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：跨两支深度分化的海洋木食贝类（浅水/深海、147 Mya分歧）、多组学整合+生化验证+结构建模+与陆生模型对比；发现全新双催化域融合酶机制并阐明其协同切割优势；提出‘远程作用+功能极致精简’这一区别于微生物扩增范式的海洋碳循环新原理；但未达AlphaFold级范式颠覆（无通用预测模型/未重构领域方法论），属重磅机制性突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：首次从全息基因组尺度揭示海洋木食动物不依赖复杂菌群的分子级简约消化范式，证据链完整、跨生态位稳健、机制新颖可验证。

papers.title: CoWAM: Coordination Contracts for Selective Policy Intervention with WAMs
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies with action-conditioned predicted futures, but a plausible future alone does not justify changing the action that a bimanual policy would execute. We present CoWAM, a selective intervention layer that expresses synchronization, role compatibility, and collision convergence as coordination contracts. Each contract combines typed admissibility checks with event-conditioned verification and calibrated intervention gates. CoWAM preserves the nominal action unless an alternative satisfies every active obligation and provides a clear, low-risk improvement; when the nominal action is also inadmissible, it invokes a predefined abstention fallback. To separate selector quality from proposal quality, all methods operate on identical candidate pools and commit their decisions before shared oracle labeling. Across eight simulated bimanual tasks, CoWAM improves coordination-valid selection by 16.7 percentage points over the contract-only variant and raises closed-loop success by 9.6 percentage points over the strongest selective baseline, while keeping harmful interventions below 1%. Together, these results establish coordination contracts as an effective interface for conservative policy intervention with predicted world-action evidence across coordination-rich bimanual tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出CoWAM框架，在双臂机器人任务中用‘协调契约’（同步性、角色兼容性、防碰撞）作为选择性干预条件，只在预测未来显示当前动作明显不满足契约且替代动作更优时才覆盖原策略，大幅提升了协调有效性同时将误干预率压到1%以下。
analysis.claim: 协调契约（coordination contracts）可作为保守、可验证、低风险的干预接口，利用世界动作模型（WAM）的预测证据实现双臂任务中高保真策略干预。
analysis.input: 双臂机器人当前状态、动作候选池、WAM预测的多步未来轨迹（含碰撞/同步/角色语义）
analysis.output: 是否干预的二元决策 + 若干预则选定的替代动作
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真双臂机器人（如Franka或类似bimanual平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在WAM框架下首次形式化‘协调契约’并实现低误干预率，但仅限于8个仿真双臂任务，无真实硬件验证、无开源代码、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，相比World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作（持续状态建模、闭环通用控制、大规模世界表征学习），它只是WAM下游的一个特定干预模块，未触及世界模型核心能力（如长期记忆、状态抽象、跨域迁移），属扎实但窄域的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把WAM预测与形式化契约结合用于双臂协调干预，设计严谨、实证充分（仿真内），但缺乏开源、真实部署和范式拓展性，尚未构成新方法论或基础组件。

papers.title: Comparative analysis of microglia-targeted AAVs reveals capsid choice drives efficiency in vitro but has limited impact in vivo
papers.abstract: Abstract Microglia play key roles in brain development, homeostasis, and neurodegeneration. Although multiple strategies for viral gene delivery to microglia have been reported, they have not been directly compared. Here, we developed microglia-targeting AAV capsids and benchmarked them against existing approaches. The novel capsids exhibit improved transduction efficiency in cultured mouse and human microglia, as well as neurons and astrocytes. However, when we compared microglial transduction efficiency of the novel capsids with published engineered and naturally occurring capsids after intracranial injection, all capsids achieved efficient and specific transduction when paired with a genome incorporating IBA1 promoter and miR-124 target sites. In contrast, CAG promoter did not support efficient microglial transduction. Moreover, blood-brain barrier- crossing capsids carrying IBA1 promoter and miR-124 target sites efficiently transduced microglia at high doses but exhibited off-target expression. Together, our work provides improved capsids for in vitro manipulation of microglia and establishes viral genome design, not capsid identity, as the principal determinant of efficient in vivo microglial targeting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统比较了多种靶向小胶质细胞的腺相关病毒（AAV）衣壳，发现体外实验中衣壳选择影响转导效率，但体内实验中真正起决定作用的是病毒基因组设计（IBA1启动子+miR-124靶点），而非衣壳本身；新衣壳对体外研究有提升，但未改变体内靶向范式。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位分散，摘要未明确主属机构；通讯作者John W. Harvey等隶属宾夕法尼亚大学，但未在摘要中声明；依据常见署名惯例推测主要来自宾大，但证据不足）
analysis.claim: 在体内小胶质细胞靶向中，病毒基因组设计（启动子+miRNA靶点）是决定性因素，而AAV衣壳选择的影响有限。
analysis.input: 多种AAV衣壳（新型与已发表）、不同启动子（CAG/IBA1）、miR-124靶点组合、体外培养的小鼠/人小胶质细胞及神经元/星形胶质细胞、体内小鼠脑内注射
analysis.output: 定量转导效率（荧光阳性细胞比例）、细胞类型特异性（免疫共标验证）、脱靶表达水平
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最系统的AAV小胶质细胞靶向横向基准（含体外/体内、多衣壳/多基因组组合、跨物种细胞），实证有力地修正了领域长期隐含假设（‘更好衣壳=更好体内靶向’），但未开辟新范式或解决跨物种递送、血脑屏障穿透效率等根本瓶颈，属于扎实且具指导意义的机制澄清型工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨对照实验证伪了衣壳主导论，确立基因组设计为体内靶向核心变量，将推动后续载体优化策略转向调控元件工程而非单纯衣壳筛选。

papers.title: PBD-AG: Persistent Baseline-Delta Active Graphs with Uncertainty-Aware Inspection for Long-Horizon Service Robots
papers.abstract: Long-horizon service robots require persistent world models that can be built autonomously in unseen environments and revised as task-relevant objects change. Existing methods rely on online mapping, which accumulates localization and observation errors, static scene representations that cannot capture persistent object changes, or holistic vision-language predictions that lack verifiable 3D geometric evidence. We present PBD-AG, a persistent baseline-delta active graph framework that decouples robot-verified stable fixtures from revisable dynamic object events. Under our framework, the robot autonomously bootstraps the structural baseline from onboard exploration and inspects discovered fixtures to ground hierarchical object beliefs. PBD-AG maintains reliability-weighted object states over geometry, semantics, identity, existence, and support relations, utilizing a geometric visibility gate to mitigate false deletions under occlusion. Inspection viewpoints are selected by a graph-conditioned policy that balances target coverage, travel cost, collision risk, and redundant observation. Simulation experiments in multiple environments and under controlled dynamic evaluation show higher aggregate coarse-fixture F1 than capability-matched controls, as well as stronger identity continuity and event recall. A qualitative physical-robot demonstration further illustrates integration with onboard sensing, providing a traceable world model for long-horizon robotic perception.The project page of PBD-AG is available at https://shuobao214.github.io/PBD-AG/

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫PBD-AG的持久化世界建模框架，让服务机器人能在未知环境中自主构建并持续更新结构基线（如墙、柜子等稳定物）和动态对象（如杯子、手机等可移动物），用几何可见性门控+不确定性感知主动视角选择来避免误删被遮挡物体，并在仿真中验证了其对长期任务中物体身份连续性和事件回忆的提升。
analysis.claim: 持久化世界模型必须解耦稳定基线与动态增量，并通过机器人自主验证的几何-语义联合图表示与不确定性感知主动检测，才能支撑长时程服务任务中的可靠状态追踪。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像、机器人位姿、任务指令（隐含于长时程服务场景）
analysis.output: 带置信度的多层对象图（含几何、语义、身份、存在性、支撑关系）及主动检测视角序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人平台（未指明具体型号，但实验基于仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘基线-增量’解耦与几何可见性门控等合理设计，但仅在仿真中验证F1/连续性/召回等指标，无真机部署、无跨机体泛化、无开源代码、无与SOTA世界模型（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）的定量对比，贡献属于扎实的模块级改进，未触及世界模型核心架构瓶颈（如状态记忆机制、跨时序因果建模），远未达基石论文量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了长时程服务中动态对象误删和身份漂移的部分问题，但限于仿真、无开源、未挑战世界模型根本局限，暂未形成范式影响。

papers.title: GNMCADS: Sampling For Protein Conformation Diversity With Gaussian Network Model Guided Condition Annealed Diffusion Sampler
papers.abstract: Proteins are dynamic molecules existing in diverse conformational states underlying their biological functions. Although recent approaches have enabled diverse conformational sampling by emulating molecular dynamics simulations, perturbing evolutionary information, or steering internal mechanisms of structure prediction models, predicting conformations resulting from major domain motions or motions that occur over long timescales still remains a challenge. To this end, we introduce GNMCADS, a conformational sampling strategy that enhances the diversity of protein diffusion models by selectively annealing the conditioning signal guided by the intrinsic dynamical organization of the sampled protein. Further, we implement GNMCADS in the diffusion module of AlphaFold3, enabling the generation of diverse protein conformations. When benchmarked across 92 proteins that include 54 class A GPCRs, 15 transporters, and 23 proteins with major domain movements, GNMCADS exhibits improved sampling diversity compared to other current conformational sampling methods.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GNMCADS方法，通过用高斯网络模型（GNM）分析蛋白质内在动力学特性来动态调整AlphaFold3扩散模块的条件信号退火过程，从而提升其对大尺度构象变化（如G蛋白偶联受体域运动）的采样多样性。
analysis.claim: 利用蛋白质固有动力学（GNM）引导的条件退火策略，可显著提升基于扩散的蛋白质结构预测模型在大尺度构象采样上的多样性。
analysis.input: 单序列或MSA + GNM计算得到的模态特征（如慢模态位移向量）
analysis.output: 一组多样化的蛋白质三维构象集合（非单一最优结构）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在AlphaFold3扩散模块中嵌入GNM引导的条件退火，属工程化改进；验证限于92个已知难采样蛋白的多样性指标（如RMSD分布、簇数），无功能验证、无新实验数据、无与物理模拟（如MD）的精度/效率对比，未开源代码或模型，未挑战构象预测的根本瓶颈（如长时标动力学建模），远未达基石级工作（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold）的范式突破或基础建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典生物物理模型（GNM）接入扩散框架做条件调控，有合理直觉但实证薄弱，缺乏机制深度和开源支撑，暂未构成方法论突破。

papers.title: Shaping the Evolutionary Dynamics of Robot Morphology via Adaptive Control Learning
papers.abstract: Robot co-design via bi-level optimization couples within-lifetime controller learning for fitness evaluation with cross-generational morphological evolution. Prior work has established that well-adapted morphology facilitates faster control learning, a property termed morphological intelligence. Yet how control learning reciprocally shapes morphological evolution remains unexplored. This paper examines both directions for a holistic account of brain-body interplay. We first show that morphological contributions to control learning decouple into two orthogonal dimensions. We formalize the convergence speed as morphological intelligence and identify the performance ceiling as a complementary quantity termed true potential. A concise functional relation is then established to jointly characterize both quantities from individual learning curves, which, when aggregated at the population level, capture evolutionary profiles. Through extensive experiments on simulated voxel-based soft robots, we reveal that premature fitness evaluation systematically underestimates true potential and biases selection towards fast learners. This restricts design space exploration, compromising both optimization efficiency and morphological diversity. Notably, the widely recognized morphological Baldwin effect emerges as an artifact of this bias rather than a general evolutionary tendency. We therefore propose AdaControl, which monitors disproportionate selection for morphological intelligence during evolution and allocates minimally sufficient control learning for unbiased fitness evaluation. With AdaControl, a simple genetic algorithm rivals state-of-the-art generative-model-based co-design methods in discovering diverse high-performing designs while cutting computation by up to 80% versus exhaustive control.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现机器人形态进化中常用的‘早停式’控制器训练会严重低估形态的真实潜力，导致进化偏向学得快但能力上限低的形态；为此提出AdaControl方法，动态调整每个形态的控制器训练时长，实现更公平的适应度评估，在仿真软体机器人上用简单遗传算法就达到了SOTA生成模型方法的性能，且计算量减少80%。
analysis.claim: 控制学习过程本身会系统性扭曲形态进化的方向，其根源在于固定时长的控制器训练对‘收敛速度’（morphological intelligence）和‘性能上限’（true potential）的混淆；解除该混淆可大幅提升形态共设计的效率、多样性与最终性能。
analysis.input: 体素化软体机器人形态结构 + 任务目标（如移动距离）
analysis.output: 优化后的机器人形态（体素网格）及对应控制器
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研体素软体机器人仿真器（未命名，基于物理引擎）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次从学习动力学角度解耦并量化了形态智能（收敛速度）与真实潜力（性能上限），揭示了Baldwin效应在共设计中的伪现象本质，并提出可插拔的AdaControl机制；实证扎实（多任务、多代进化、消融对比SOTA），但仅限于仿真软体机器人，未验证真实硬件或跨模态任务，也未开源代码/模型。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——在仿真共设计范式内实现了关键认知突破与高效工程实现，但受限于零开源、单仿真平台、无真机验证，尚未达到基石论文所要求的范式迁移或跨平台普适性。

papers.title: Teaching Robot Policies to Humans Using Erroneous Examples
papers.abstract: Human-robot collaboration describes the process of humans and autonomous agents working together to accomplish common goals. This process is facilitated best when robot policies, or behaviors in different situations, are made transparent to humans. Demonstration-based explanations have been a focus of human-robot collaboration research, and the field has frequently drawn upon literature from education to improve how humans are taught robot policies. However, no single teaching method has been proven effective across domains, difficulties, learners, and other variables; the question of how humans can most effectively be taught robot policies remains open. In traditional classrooms, learners are shown erroneous examples, in which they reflect on and correct incorrect responses to understand common pitfalls when learning a concept. We propose using erroneous examples to teach robot policies, extending an existing policy teaching framework. We conduct a user study in which participants view incorrect demonstrations of robot behavior and correct the actions to align with the actual policy. Our findings suggest that viewing these incorrect demonstrations and verbalizing one's reasoning in predicting a robot's actions improves retention of the policy over time, in agreement with the effect of erroneous examples in classrooms. We also categorize participants into distinct learning styles and establish that participants using inverse reinforcement learning-like reasoning perform best on policy prediction tasks. With this work, we aim to advance the methods by which robots educate humans on their policies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用‘错误示范’（机器人做错的动作视频）教人类理解机器人的行为策略，让用户观看错误动作后自己纠正，并发现这种教学法比单纯看正确示范更能帮助人类长期记住机器人策略。
analysis.claim: 向人类展示机器人策略的错误示例并引导其修正和解释，能显著提升人类对策略的理解与长期记忆效果。
analysis.input: 错误的机器人行为视频 + 任务目标描述 + 用户口头/文字推理输入
analysis.output: 用户对机器人正确行为的预测与修正 + 推理陈述
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；全部基于预录制/合成的错误行为视频（仿真或动画示意）
analysis.significance_reason: 属人机交互教育方法的轻量级心理学迁移（错误示例教学法），实验仅在小规模用户研究中验证记忆效应，无真实机器人闭环交互、无跨策略/跨任务泛化验证，未接入任何具身系统，也未挑战策略可解释性底层建模问题；相比所列基石工作（全栈具身建模、世界模型、零样本人体-机器人策略迁移等），它不涉及机器人控制、学习或感知的实质性推进，纯属上层人因教学策略探索。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将教育心理学中的‘错误示例法’平移至人机协作教学场景，但未触及机器人策略本身的设计、学习或部署瓶颈，也无实证表明该方法能改善实际人机协同效能。

papers.title: Sport expertise and motor imagery abilities shape sensorimotor rhythm modulations during visualisation tasks: Implications for neurofeedback-based cognitive training in athletes
papers.abstract: Abstract Kinaesthetic motor imagery (kMI) is widely used in sport to enhance motor performance by engaging cortical sensorimotor networks. Neurofeedback may further support kMI, but the optimal neural target to reinforce remains unclear. Maximal sensorimotor event-related desynchronisation (SMR-ERD) represents a relevant target as it may index sensorimotor cortex engagement, yet sport expertise has been associated with reduced SMR-ERD, potentially reflecting neural efficiency. The optimal neurofeedback target may therefore depend on sport expertise, movement expertise, and individual kMI ability. This study examined how these factors influence sensorimotor activity during kMI. We compared 17 basketball players (Experts) and 16 individuals without formal basketball training (Novices). kMI ability and frequency of use were assessed using questionnaires, while SMR-ERD was quantified using electroencephalography (EEG) during kMI. Participants imagined either a basketball-specific movement (Free throw), for which only Experts had extensive experience, or a generic movement (Box lifting), familiar to both groups. Experts reported greater kMI ability and more frequent kMI use than Novices. Only Experts exhibited significant and sustained SMR-ERD during kMI. Moreover, SMR-ERD was stronger in Experts than Novices specifically during Free throw kMI, corresponding to their movement of expertise. Nonetheless, within the Expert group, higher kMI ability was associated with reduced SMR-ERD. These findings suggest that sport expertise initially enhances voluntary recruitment of sensorimotor networks during kMI, whereas greater kMI ability may subsequently promote neural efficiency, resulting in reduced overall sensorimotor cortical activation. These results highlight the need to tailor kMI-based neurofeedback training to users’ sport expertise and kMI ability levels. Highlights · Current motor imagery-based neurofeedback designs may not be tailored to athletes. · Athletes show greater recruitment of sensorimotor cortex during motor imagery. · High motor imagery ability in athletes may be associated with neural efficiency. · Neurofeedback should be adapted to sport expertise and motor imagery ability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用脑电（EEG）发现：篮球运动员在想象投篮时，感觉运动皮层的SMR-ERD抑制更强且更持续，但其中想象能力越强的运动员，这种抑制反而越弱——说明专业经验先增强神经激活，高阶想象能力再转向神经效率；因此给运动员做运动想象神经反馈训练时，不能一刀切，得按其专项经验和想象能力水平动态调整靶标。
analysis.claim: 运动专长与运动想象能力共同调节感觉运动节律（SMR-ERD）调制模式，且二者作用方向相反：专长增强SMR-ERD（反映网络招募），高想象能力削弱SMR-ERD（反映神经效率），故神经反馈靶标需个体化适配。
analysis.input: EEG信号+运动想象任务类型（投篮/搬箱子）+问卷评估的运动想象能力与使用频率
analysis.output: SMR频段（12–15 Hz）事件相关去同步化（ERD）强度与时间动态
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖受试者EEG与行为问卷
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的组间对照（专家vs新手）、任务特异性设计（专项vs通用动作）、内部相关性分析（想象能力与ERD负相关），但样本量小（N=33）、仅单模态EEG、无干预验证、未提出新解码模型或闭环系统，属高质量认知神经机制研究，但未达BCI临床级或范式级突破（如基石文献中实时高精度解码、植入式长期稳定、端到端闭环控制等）

papers.title: Bacterial Peptidoglycan Extends Lifespan by Activating Lysosomal Activity through V-ATPase Binding
papers.abstract: Summary Lysosomal dysfunction is a hallmark of aging, yet whether microbial components actively regulate this organelle to influence longevity remains unknown. Here, we identify bacterial peptidoglycan (PGN), a major cell wall component degraded by host lysozyme, as an evolutionarily conserved activator of lysosomal function that extends lifespan in both C. elegans and mice. We show that aging leads to an intestinal decline in lysozyme expression, which impairs bacterial cell-wall digestion and results in systemic PGN deficiency. Late-life PGN supplementation (starting at 18 months of age) significantly prolongs mouse lifespan and improves healthspan. Mechanistically, PGN localizes to lysosomes and directly binds V-ATPase subunits, enhancing ATP hydrolysis activity and promoting lysosomal acidification. This effect is abolished by V-ATPase inhibition (bafilomycin A1) or genetic disruption of lysosomal components ( cup-5 and vha-12 mutants), confirming that functional V-ATPase is strictly required for lysosomal function and the longevity benefit. Importantly, PGN restores lysosomal acidification in aged cells, alleviates cellular senescence markers, and improves multiple hallmarks of aging including locomotion and muscle integrity. Collectively, these findings reveal an evolutionarily conserved mechanism whereby hosts exploit bacterial cell wall components to maintain cellular homeostasis, establishing a gut microbiome–lysosome–longevity axis with implications for microbiome-based anti-aging interventions. Highlights Aging reduces intestinal lysozyme activity, depleting systemic PGN bioavailability PGN binds V-ATPase subunits, enhancing ATP hydrolysis and lysosomal acidification Bacterial PGN supplementation extends lifespan and improves healthspan PGN maintains multi-tissue lysosomal homeostasis and reduces cellular senescence during aging

analysis.tldr: 发现细菌肽聚糖（PGN）能通过直接结合并激活溶酶体V-ATPase，增强溶酶体酸化功能，从而延缓衰老、延长线虫和老年小鼠寿命，并改善健康状态。
analysis.claim: 细菌肽聚糖是进化保守的溶酶体功能激活剂，其随年龄增长的系统性缺乏是衰老驱动因素，外源补充可逆转溶酶体功能衰退并延长寿命。
analysis.input: 细菌肽聚糖（PGN）分子、老年小鼠/线虫模型、溶酶体功能检测指标（pH、ATP水解、V-ATPase结合等）
analysis.output: 寿命延长、健康指标改善（运动能力、肌肉完整性、细胞衰老标志物下降）、溶酶体酸化恢复
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次建立‘微生物组-溶酶体-V-ATPase-长寿’因果轴，含多物种验证（C. elegans + 18月龄小鼠）、机制解析（直接结合V-ATPase亚基+生化验证+遗传敲除回补）、表型覆盖寿命/健康span/细胞衰老/多组织功能，但未提供结构生物学细节（如PGN-V-ATPase复合物结构）或临床前转化数据（如药代、毒性、制剂），尚未达AlphaFold2级范式突破，但显著超越纯相关性研究，属扎实重磅发现。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将微生物代谢物、细胞器功能调控与衰老干预深度耦合，证据链完整，但离临床落地和机制原子级解析尚有距离。

papers.title: PV-WM: A Heterogeneous Micro-Macro World Model for Articulated Pedestrian-Vehicle Co-Rollout
papers.abstract: Local pedestrian-vehicle forecasting spans heterogeneous physical scales: pedestrians combine root locomotion with articulated motion, whereas vehicles are rigid bodies described by kinematic state and oriented extent. Existing road-agent forecasters typically omit pedestrian articulation, while pose forecasters leave vehicle futures outside the learned rollout. We introduce PV-WM, a history-only world model over structured post-perception tracks. It recurrently advances pedestrian root motion, 15-joint articulation, and learned vehicle states within a synchronized heterogeneous state. The generated pedestrian and vehicle chunks supply the next recurrent boundary; vehicle boxes are reconstructed from predicted center and heading with observed extent, and P-V geometry is recomputed after every transition. Relative to a matched one-shot complete-state predictor, recurrent execution reduces Root ADE by 12.7% and MPJPE by 14.8%. Feedback interventions show that later predictions depend on the content, temporal order, and pedestrian identity of generated articulation. Across 824 aligned Waymo contexts, with 797 providing valid future vehicle support, PV-WM reduces Root ADE by 5.2%, MPJPE by 7.6%, P-V distance error by 11.9%, and oriented-box closest-approach error by 5.8% relative to a validation-selected Modular Specialist. The single-network model uses 57.1% fewer parameters, 96.5% lower average FLOPs per local scene, and 25.5% lower measured p95 latency. PV-WM unifies this heterogeneous future state while preserving type-specific pedestrian and vehicle dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 提出PV-WM世界模型，统一建模行人（根部运动+15关节姿态）和车辆（中心点、朝向、固定尺寸）的异构未来状态，仅用历史轨迹输入，通过循环 rollout 生成协同演化的多步预测，在Waymo数据上显著降低根部位置误差、关节误差、人车距离误差和包围盒接近误差，且参数量、计算量和延迟大幅下降。
analysis.claim: 一个仅依赖历史结构化轨迹的世界模型，能通过同步异构状态循环推进，实现行人-车辆联合、类型适配、几何一致的多步协同预测，并在真实大规模道路场景中显著优于模块化专家模型。
analysis.input: 历史帧的结构化行人-车辆轨迹（含行人根部位置、15关节相对姿态、车辆中心点、朝向、固定长宽高）
analysis.output: 未来多步的行人根部轨迹、15关节姿态序列、车辆中心点与朝向序列，以及实时更新的人车相对几何关系
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖Waymo Open Dataset中的真实传感器后处理轨迹（post-perception tracks），未使用仿真或机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在道路智能体协同预测这一重要但非世界模型核心范式的子方向上，首次实现行人关节级+车辆刚体动力学的统一异构世界模型rollout，实证扎实（Waymo 824场景、多指标显著提升、消融验证反馈依赖性），但未突破世界模型基础范式（无隐空间持久状态、无动作闭环、无dreaming/rehearsal机制），也未拓展到具身决策或控制，属于领域内显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在真实道路大场景中验证了异构智能体联合世界建模的可行性与收益，但仍是任务专用模型，未触及世界模型的通用性、持续性或行动耦合本质，不属于范式突破。

papers.title: Genetic regulation of circulating metabolome in cattle
papers.abstract: The circulating metabolome is a vital intermediate layer linking genetics to complex phenotypes, yet existing genome-wide studies-even in humans-rarely capture dynamic physiological contexts or cellular regulatory mechanisms. Here, we present the Cattle Metabolome Atlas (https://cattlema.farmgtex.org/), a comprehensive resource of 3,436 plasma metabolites and 4,851 serum metabolites from 4,651 animals with matched sequence-level genotypes across highly dynamic parity and lactation stages. We mapped 728 plasma and 622 serum metabolite quantitative trait loci (mQTL), revealing widespread context-dependent regulatory architectures. Integrating these mQTL with the multi-tissue expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) and single-cell atlas of 59 tissues demonstrates that 74-79% of mQTL colocalize with eQTL across 29 tissues, prioritizing the liver as the primary systemic hub and resolving metabolic programs at single-cell resolution. Furthermore, we charted 538 causal gene-tissue-metabolite-trait cascades across 11 complex traits in cattle. Finally, cross-species analyses demonstrate partial evolutionary conservation of genetic metabolism between cattle and humans, establishing this atlas as a powerful asset for cattle genetics and genomics, selective breeding, and comparative biology.

analysis.tldr: 构建了牛血液代谢组与全基因组数据匹配的大规模图谱，系统定位了数千个代谢物数量性状位点（mQTL），揭示其在不同泌乳阶段的动态调控规律，并通过多组织eQTL和单细胞图谱将大部分mQTL锚定到肝脏等关键组织，进而推断出数百条从基因→组织→代谢物→经济性状的因果通路。
analysis.claim: 牛 circulating metabolome 的遗传调控具有高度情境依赖性，其主效调控枢纽是肝脏，且可通过多组学整合解析出可解释、可验证的基因-组织-代谢物-性状因果级联。
analysis.input: 牛血浆/血清代谢物丰度数据 + 全基因组序列型基因型数据 + 多组织eQTL数据 + 单细胞转录组图谱 + 11个复杂性状表型
analysis.output: mQTL位点图谱、mQTL-eQTL共定位结果、肝主导的组织优先级排序、538条因果级联路径、跨物种保守性评估
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属农业基因组学领域重大资源型工作：样本量大（4651头）、代谢物覆盖广（超3400种血浆+4800种血清）、动态生理分期精细（泌乳阶段）、多组学整合扎实（eQTL+scRNA-seq+性状），并产出可追溯的因果级联；但未提出新算法模型，也未解决人类代谢遗传研究中长期存在的因果推断根本难题（如混杂偏倚、反向因果），创新本质是高质量规模化实证测绘，非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在牛这一重要农业物种上完成了迄今最系统、最动态、最跨尺度的代谢遗传图谱构建与因果解析，资源价值高、实证扎实，但未催生新方法论或颠覆性生物学机制发现。

papers.title: Orientation Control of Soft Robots via Adiabatic Spectral Submanifolds
papers.abstract: Soft robots are commonly sought for safety-critical interactions in delicate environments, where accurate position and orientation control is imperative. Model predictive control (MPC) offers a solution, but it requires a model of the robot's infinite-dimensional nonlinear dynamics that is at once accurate and computationally cheap. Recent theory on adiabatic spectral submanifolds (aSSMs) and their applications to soft robots provide data-driven model-reduction methods to construct such models. Here, we extend these methods to identify aSSMs from enlarged observable datasets and upgrade the currently available aSSM-MPC schemes. Evaluated on a high-fidelity finite-element simulation of a pressure-actuated soft arm, our controller reduces position and orientation tracking error by more than 60% compared to existing data-driven baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用一种叫绝热谱子流形（aSSM）的数学降维方法，从软体机器人仿真数据中提取低维动力学模型，再嵌入模型预测控制（MPC）框架，显著提升了软体机械臂的位置和朝向跟踪精度。
analysis.claim: 通过扩展绝热谱子流形（aSSM）的数据驱动识别方法并升级其MPC集成方案，可在高保真软体臂仿真中实现超60%的朝向与位置跟踪误差下降。
analysis.input: 软体臂有限元仿真中的状态观测序列（如节点位移、压力输入等）
analysis.output: 控制输入（如各腔室气压时序）
analysis.robot_dependency: 有限元软体臂仿真器（未指定具体平台，但属高保真FEA）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的可观测数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有理论深度（aSSM属非线性动力学前沿），实证仅限单一高保真仿真软臂，无跨机体/跨任务验证，无真实硬件部署，未开源代码或模型，相比所列基石工作（全真机、多任务、端到端、世界模型级整合），仅属扎实的模型降维+MPC工程改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如泛化、交互、学习架构）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在软体机器人模型降维与MPC控制的交叉点做了可信的仿真验证，但局限于单一体型、纯仿真、无开源，尚未构成对领域范式的推动。

papers.title: Beyond Appearance Shifts: Task-Semantic Action Calibration for VLA Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in embodied manipulation, but still lack a clear mechanism to balance behavioral stability with task-semantic sensitivity. We identify two complementary failure modes. Under task-preserving changes, where task semantics remain unchanged but scene appearance varies (e.g., style, illumination, clutter, or paraphrasing), policies often exhibit unnecessary action drift. Conversely, under semantic-breaking changes, where key task semantics such as the target object or constraint are altered, policies frequently fail to produce sufficiently distinct behaviors and instead follow the original trajectory. To address this gap, we propose BAS-VLA, a task-semantic action calibration framework built on top of a frozen base VLA. BAS-VLA adopts a breaking-centered calibration core as the default path, and introduces a selective evidence-gated preserving auxiliary that activates only when nuisance variation is detected while task semantics remain consistent. On the OpenPI-pi0.5 / LIBERO-Object Milk-Swap benchmark, BAS-VLA maintains high success on clean (98.0%) and semantics-preserving conditions (97.5%), while reducing clean-criterion success to 0.0% under deliberate target-object swaps, demonstrating strong stale-task suppression and task-semantic separation. On validated style-preserving shifts, it improves success from 42% to 70% without degrading clean performance. These results highlight that reliable VLA behavior requires moving beyond appearance robustness toward explicit task-semantic action calibration.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在任务语义不变但外观变化时会乱调动作，在任务语义真正改变时又反应迟钝；为此提出BAS-VLA框架，在冻结的基座VLA上加一层‘语义校准’模块，能区分‘只是样子变了’和‘任务本质变了’，从而让动作该稳则稳、该变则变。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的行为可靠性不取决于外观鲁棒性，而取决于显式建模任务语义与动作之间的因果映射关系，并可通过冻结基座+轻量校准实现语义敏感的动作调控。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言任务指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖OpenPI-pi0.5和LIBERO-Object Milk-Swap仿真基准
analysis.significance_reason: 问题意识清晰（语义vs外观混淆），方法设计有逻辑（breaking-centered + evidence-gated preserving），但在仿真小基准上验证，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨用户泛化、无开源代码/模型，也未与RT-2/π0等基石模型对比性能或部署能力，属于扎实但窄幅的概念驱动改进，未达‘显著贡献’门槛（60分档）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在已有VLA基座上做了有启发性的语义校准插件设计，但缺乏实证广度与开放性，尚未构成对VLA范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
papers.abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DeltaWAM，用‘变化向量’（delta token）替代整帧图像预测，只建模相邻帧之间DINO特征图的差异，从而大幅压缩世界-动作模型的计算开销，在LIBERO上达到92.8%成功率，但未在真实机器人上验证，也未开源代码或模型。
analysis.claim: 通过将未来预测单元从像素/特征图降维为紧凑的delta token，可显著提升世界-动作模型的效率与泛化性，同时保持高任务成功率。
analysis.input: 当前帧DINO特征图 + 动作历史
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真环境LIBERO中的合成视频数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在LIBERO上达到92.8% SOTA级成功率，但仍是纯仿真、单基准、无真实硬件验证、无消融分析细节、无开源——相比WEAVER（94.5）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，它未解决世界模型的核心缺陷（如状态持久性、跨仿真器迁移、真实闭环控制），仅是预测表征层面的工程优化，属扎实但窄幅的增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把delta编码思想嫁接到WAM框架，在仿真benchmark上提点有效，但缺乏机制创新、实证深度和开放性，暂时不用看

papers.title: XGenAct: Geometry-Enhanced World Action Models through Cross-Task Generation
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have advanced robot control by predicting how observations and actions evolve over time. Despite this progress, RGB and action based future prediction does not explicitly address the spatial understanding needed for robot manipulation. Existing efforts often add a limited set of spatial prediction tasks through specialized heads or branches, leaving both the range of spatial supervision and the model architecture fragmented. We introduce XGenAct, a world action model that represents RGB observations, robot actions, metric depth, surface normals, and functional role segmentation as RGB videos through deterministic codecs. By sampling perception and action tasks during training, XGenAct uses one video diffusion transformer and one objective to learn temporal prediction across these spaces without modality specific learned heads. On held out RLBench tasks, structured perception training improves average closed loop success over RGB only training, and XGenAct achieves 52% success in the five task external comparison, versus 26% for the strongest evaluated baselines. It also predicts future depth and segmentation more accurately than the evaluated pipelines that generate RGB first and then apply a frozen perception expert.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出XGenAct，把深度、法向量、功能分割等几何感知信号和RGB图像一起编码成统一视频序列，用单个视频扩散Transformer联合预测所有模态的未来演化，从而在不增加专用分支的情况下提升机器人操作任务的闭环成功率和几何预测精度。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过将多模态几何感知信号（深度、法向、功能分割）与RGB+动作统一编码为视频序列，并用单一视频扩散Transformer联合建模时序演化，可显著提升世界动作模型在真实操作任务中的泛化性与几何理解能力，且无需模态专用头。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧序列 + 当前机器人动作序列 + 对应的深度图/法向图/功能分割图（全部编码为统一视频token流）
analysis.output: 未来多步的RGB帧、深度图、法向图、功能分割图及动作序列（统一解码自同一视频扩散输出）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（RLBench），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在多模态统一表征和视频扩散用于WAM上做了合理尝试，但仅在RLBench仿真中验证5个任务，无真实机器人实验、无消融分析各几何模态贡献、无开源代码/模型，性能提升（52% vs 26%）依赖强基线对比而非SOTA复现，远未达World Models/DreamerV3等基石工作所要求的范式级建模深度、状态持久性或跨环境鲁棒性。

papers.title: Co${}^{2}$Skill: Whole-Body Control via Skill Composition for Long-Horizon Human-Environment Interaction
papers.abstract: Achieving human-level dexterity in complex, unstructured environments requires the seamless integration of whole-body scene interaction and dexterous object manipulation skills. While existing physics-based controllers generate physically plausible behaviors in each domain, they largely address these two capabilities independently. In this paper, we present Co${}^{2}$Skill that integrates scene interaction and dexterous manipulation through a unified policy formulation. Built on a pretrained motion prior, the policy uses task and phase dependent observation masks to select information relevant to the current interaction goals. We introduce a goal-conditioned loco-manipulation curriculum that combines partial reference guidance for precision with exploration from varied initial states while allowing goal-directed execution beyond the demonstrated trajectories. We further introduce a cross-task curriculum that jointly trains individual skills and selected task sequences, preserving physical states across task boundaries and maintaining grasps during subsequent scene interactions. Together, these support sequential task execution and simultaneous scene interaction with object manipulation. We evaluate sitting, standing, climbing, stair traversal, and goal-directed manipulation, together with sequential execution and with random different conditions. Additionally, we demonstrate skill compositions in indoor environments, illustrating their integration within the same control formulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出Co²Skill框架，用统一策略模型把全身运动控制（如行走、攀爬）和灵巧操作（如抓取、操控物体）组合起来，通过任务/阶段感知的观测掩码和跨任务课程学习，在仿真中实现长时序人-环境交互（坐、站、爬楼梯、目标操作等）的顺序执行与并行协同。
analysis.claim: 通过技能组合（skill composition）与统一策略建模，可实现全身运动与灵巧操作在长时序、多阶段、目标导向的人-环境交互任务中的无缝协同，无需为每种组合单独训练策略。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（含关节状态、IMU、视觉特征、任务目标、当前阶段标识），经任务/阶段依赖的动态掩码过滤
analysis.output: 全身体（6D根部+关节力矩）控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真 humanoid（未明确型号，但实验基于通用高自由度人形平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据；摘要未提任何真实机器人数据采集或部署
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线有整合价值（运动+操作统一策略+课程式技能组合），但仅限仿真验证、无真机结果、无消融实验、无开源信息，且所覆盖任务（坐/站/爬/楼梯/操作）均属已有工作子集；相比标尺中94+分的基石工作（如ω-0、GigaBrain-WBC、H2O等在真实世界泛化、世界模型耦合、零样本人类视频迁移或端到端行为建模上的实质性突破），它属于扎实但窄域的增量改进，未解决sim2real鸿沟、长期信用分配或跨 embodiment 泛化等核心瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提出了有逻辑的技能组合机制并在仿真中验证了多任务串联能力，但缺乏真机证据、消融分析和开源支持，尚未达到领域基石工作的分量级，暂属高质量仿真研究而非范式突破。

papers.title: YOCO: You Only Calibrate Once! Fast Mocap Calibration for Dexterous Teleoperation
papers.abstract: Dexterous teleoperation requires reliable human-hand state estimations. However, common low-cost motion-capture gloves and markerless trackers often exhibit biases that vary across users, glove fit, and recording sessions, degrading retargeting and demonstration quality. We present YOCO, a fast few-shot, fine-tuning-free calibration framework that corrects biased hand-pose streams from a small set of paired raw and target poses. Instead of optimizing a separate model for every operator or session, YOCO conditions a calibration HyperNet on the paired examples and predicts LoRA-style updates for a frozen MANO hand-estimation module, turning per-user calibration into a lightweight feed-forward adaptation step while preserving the geometric prior of MANO and the efficiency of a compact estimator. We train YOCO with synthetic drift augmentations on InterHand2.6M and evaluate on augmented InterHand sequences, offline real glove data, and dexterous teleoperation tasks. Across these settings, YOCO improves calibration efficiency, hand-state estimation quality and teleoperation performance compared with uncalibrated input and standard calibration baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出YOCO框架，用少量配对的原始手部姿态和目标姿态样本，通过HyperNet生成LoRA式更新来校准任意用户的低精度手势捕捉设备（如廉价手套或无标记追踪器），无需微调、不破坏MANO几何先验，显著提升遥操作中的手态估计精度和任务表现。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无法从姓名可靠推断；非明显头部机构署名）
analysis.claim: 仅需一次快速、免微调的少量样本校准（YOCO），即可泛化到不同用户、不同手套佩戴状态和不同采集会话，稳定提升低成本手部动捕数据的几何保真度与遥操作可用性。
analysis.input: 少量配对的原始手部姿态序列（来自低精度设备）和对应的目标姿态（如高精度标定真值）
analysis.output: 校准后的手部关节角度/顶点坐标（兼容MANO参数化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实手套数据用于验证，但训练主要靠合成增强数据；未使用真实机器人闭环遥操作数据做端到端训练
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了低成本手部动捕在遥操作中普遍存在的跨用户偏差问题，方法设计合理（HyperNet+LoRA+MANO冻结），有合成+真实手套数据验证，但未在真实机器人上闭环测试遥操作任务效果，也未与SOTA遥操作策略（如ACT、DexPoint）集成验证下游性能增益；属于扎实的感知层校准改进，未触及操控策略、本体建模或具身学习范式层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将LoRA适配思想巧妙迁移到手部姿态校准任务，在保持MANO先验的同时实现免微调的轻量跨用户适配，但缺乏真实机器人闭环验证和开源证据，尚未构成范式级推进。

papers.title: EEG Pathology Detection via Clinical Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract: Deep learning models for electroencephalography (EEG) pathology detection achieve competitive accuracy but offer limited interpretability. In this paper, we introduce concept bottleneck models (CBMs) for EEG pathology detection which use clinical EEG biomarkers computed analytically from the signal as a bottleneck to be used for prediction. Those concepts include band power, spectral ratios, alpha peak frequency and amplitude, hemispheric asymmetry and phase locking values. With the backbone based on shallow convolutional neural network (CNN), we compare a black box baseline with two variants of CBMs. The hybrid variant is a classifier receives a residual projection of the backbone features. The pure variant is a CBM where the classifier receives only the predicted concepts. Models are evaluated on abnormality detection and dementia classification followed by concept prediction quality and leakage analysis. Both CBMs approach the baseline on TUAB (82.7-82.9% vs 83.6%) and are 2-5 percentage points lower on CAUEEG (57.9-60.5% vs 62.7%). The pure CBM exhibits concept fidelity concern where the predicted concepts deviate from their ground truth values. Replacing them with their true values causes severe cost on accuracy by 26 and 22 points on TUAB and CAUEEG. The concept fidelity concern is mitigated by increasing the weight of the concept loss to match the ground truth concepts. the mitigation comes with small accuracy cost on TUAB but a relatively larger cost on CAUEEG. The code of the experiments and full logs are available at https://www.github.com/mhmdrdwn/cbm.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用临床可解释的EEG生物标志物（如频带功率、alpha峰频率等）作为概念瓶颈，构建可解释的深度学习模型来检测脑电异常和痴呆，但发现纯概念瓶颈模型存在概念保真度差的问题——用真实概念替换预测概念会导致准确率暴跌20+个百分点，说明模型实际并未真正依赖这些临床概念做决策。
analysis.claim: 引入临床概念瓶颈模型（CBM）可提升EEG病理检测的可解释性，同时保持接近黑箱模型的性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG时序信号（多通道）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（异常/正常 或 痴呆/非痴呆）及12个临床EEG概念的预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅使用公开EEG数据集（TUAB、CAUEEG）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在两个公开EEG数据集上验证了概念瓶颈框架的可行性，但核心发现是负面的：纯CBM严重失 fidelity，需强监督干预才勉强缓解，且以显著精度损失为代价；未解决CBM在神经信号中长期存在的‘概念伪相关’与‘决策绕过瓶颈’根本问题，也未提供新临床洞见或临床部署证据，远低于基石工作（如92+分）所要求的范式突破、高鲁棒解码或长期临床有效性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——模型名义上使用临床概念，实证却证明其决策几乎不依赖这些概念，所谓‘可解释性’未被证实，仅是将传统特征工程与CNN简单耦合的流程复现。

papers.title: FlowVLA: Enabling World Dynamics Understanding through Pluggable 3D Flow Learning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction enable the extraction of temporally consistent 3D motion from RGB observations; however, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models still predominantly rely on 2D image-text priors. Therefore, they do not accurately represent the fundamental dynamics of the 3D world associated with physical actions. This over-reliance on static 2D visual cues limits the capacity of VLA models in achieving robust robot manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce FlowVLA, a reconstruction-guided, pluggable 3D flow learning framework aimed at empowering VLA models with an inherent understanding of action-relevant dynamics. Instead of requiring explicit 3D sensor inputs or altering the inference-time architecture, our method is designed to utilize temporally aligned 3D flow only during training. This allows the model to learn the dynamic evolution of the physical scene while preserving the computational efficiency of conventional 2D VLA backbones. To bridge scene-level dynamics with robotic manipulation, we propose a modular 3D flow learning framework with dual-level flow supervision. Specifically, point-level flow guides the model to forecast the future displacements of task-critical 3D points, while TCP-level flow aggregates these motions to align with the robot's TCP trajectories. This dual-level flow supervision encourages the model to focus on semantically meaningful dynamic regions, effectively coupling scene-level motion with precise control signals. Extensive evaluations across simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that FlowVLA consistently improves manipulation performance, zero-shot robustness, and optimizes data efficiency. FlowVLA adds only lightweight auxiliary heads during training and discards them at inference. Therefore, FlowVLA introduces no additional 3D sensor inputs, architectural modifications, or inference-time computation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FlowVLA，一种在训练阶段插入3D光流监督（无需3D传感器或模型结构改动）的轻量插件方法，让原本只学2D图像-语言-动作映射的VLA模型隐式学到物理场景的动态演化规律，从而提升机器人操作的零样本鲁棒性和数据效率。
analysis.claim: 仅通过训练时引入双层级（点级+TCP级）3D流监督，不改变VLA模型结构、不增加推理开销、不依赖3D传感器，即可赋予VLA模型对动作相关世界动态的本质理解能力，并显著提升真实机器人操作性能。
analysis.input: RGB视频序列 + 语言指令
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（6DoF TCP位姿变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真中生成的3D点云运动真值（如NeRF/3DGS重建出的时序一致点轨迹），未说明是否使用真实机器人3D运动标注
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有巧思（双级流监督、插件式训练），但实证仅限仿真+极简真实实验（摘要未提具体任务数/基线对比细节），无消融验证3D流贡献占比，无开源迹象，未挑战跨机体/跨任务泛化，与RT-2等95+分基石相比属窄域增量：它没解决VLA的核心瓶颈（如长程因果建模、具身世界模型耦合、真实数据规模），只是在动态表征上做了局部增强，且未突破sim2real鸿沟。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路径合理，但实证薄弱、不可复现、未越出仿真舒适区，暂时不用看

papers.title: Perceptive Behavior Foundation Model: Adapting Human Motion Priors to Robot-Centric Terrain
papers.abstract: Humanoid behavior foundation models aim to acquire reusable whole-body control policies from broad human motion priors, enabling a single controller to produce diverse and expressive behaviors. However, existing motion-centric foundation policies largely assume that the reference motion is already physically compatible with the robot's surroundings. This assumption breaks when the demonstrator, operator, and robot inhabit different environments: a human motion may specify the intended behavior, but not the footholds, clearance, body height, or contact timing required by the robot's local terrain. We introduce \emph{Perceptive Behavior Foundation Model} (Perceptive BFM), a terrain-aware humanoid control framework that grounds human motion priors in robot-centric perception. The model preserves raw kinematic motion references as the behavioral interface, while using local terrain observations to adapt contacts, posture, and timing. To provide scalable terrain supervision, we develop \emph{terrain-conformal reference synthesis} (TCRS), which converts locomotion-oriented human motion clips into terrain-consistent references through contact-aware foothold construction, foot-geometry-aware swing optimization, support-aware root reconstruction, collision repair, and multi-point inverse kinematics. We then train a blind adapted-reference teacher and transfer its terrain-conformal behavior to a deployed raw-reference student through target-frame action alignment. The student is an identity-gated Transformer tracker whose terrain features enter through residual pathways initialized to preserve the motion-tracking prior and trained to produce local corrections only when needed.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个能根据机器人实时感知的地形信息，动态调整人类动作先验（如行走、跳跃）使其适配真实机器人身体和地面条件的控制框架，解决了人类动作直接迁移到机器人时因地形不匹配导致失稳或失效的问题。
analysis.claim: 人类动作先验必须通过机器人本地地形感知进行显式、可微、几何一致的适应，才能在复杂非结构化地形上实现鲁棒的具身行为迁移。
analysis.input: 原始人类动作序列（关节角度轨迹）+ 机器人局部地形点云/高度图
analysis.output: 适配地形的全身关节控制指令（含足端接触状态、根部轨迹、摆动相优化、碰撞规避）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真 humanoid（如 ANYmal 或类似高自由度仿人/四足平台，摘要未指明具体硬件，但TCRS和训练流程隐含依赖标准机器人动力学模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据：TCRS生成的地形一致参考轨迹，无真实机器人运动数据验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的地形适配机制（接触构造、摆动优化、根部重建等），但全部验证仅限仿真，无真实机器人实验，无跨机体泛化测试，无与SOTA控制器（如Motion Planning + MPC或RL-based locomotion）的定量对比，也未开源代码或数据；属于扎实的仿真方法设计，但离工程落地和领域推进尚有显著距离。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真中系统性地将人类动作先验与地形感知耦合，模块设计合理，但缺乏真实世界验证和开源支撑，目前仅为方法论层面的整合，尚未构成突破。

papers.title: Real-IKEA: Physical Fidelity is the Prerequisite for Robust Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation robustness often founders on the physics gap between simplified simulations and the resistance-laden real world. In this work, we emphasize that physical realism in articulated interaction is an important ingredient for robust policy learning. We present Real-IKEA, a dataset and simulation framework designed with physical accuracy as a first-class goal. Real-IKEA provides 1,079 articulated asset configurations, derived from 83 authentic IKEA handles and knobs processed through a meticulous six-step physical workflow. For contact-geometry accuracy, we introduce a bidirectional surface-deviation metric to quantify collision meshes. For dynamics realism, we establish resistance-calibrated configurations that vary damping and friction. Crucially, we demonstrate through a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy that high-fidelity assets enable the discovery of robust "hooking" and "levering" strategies that prioritize mechanical advantage over fragile friction-pulling. Together, these results position Real-IKEA as a critical benchmark for developing manipulation policies capable of human-level robustness in articulated object tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个高物理保真度的IKEA家具部件仿真数据集Real-IKEA，包含1079种真实把手/旋钮的精确碰撞网格和阻力标定参数，并用它证明：只有足够真实的物理建模（如表面偏差量化、阻尼/摩擦校准），RL策略才能学会依赖机械优势（钩挂、撬动）而非脆弱摩擦力的鲁棒操作策略。
analysis.claim: 物理保真度（尤其是接触几何与动力学阻力的精确建模）是实现鲁棒操纵策略学习的先决条件，而非可有可无的增强项。
analysis.input: RL策略的观测状态（含关节位置、速度、接触力等）及任务目标
analysis.output: 连续动作空间中的关节扭矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器中定义的通用机械臂（未指定具体硬件型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有验证均在仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘物理保真度是前提’这一有价值主张，并设计了表面偏差量化、阻力标定等新方法，但仅在单一仿真环境（未公开引擎细节）、单类物体（IKEA把手/旋钮）、单任务范式（hooking/levering）下验证，无真实机器人实验，无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试，也未与主流基线（如ManiSkill3、Isaac Lab）做系统对比，属于扎实但窄域的增量贡献，远未达DROID或RT-X级的生态影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：物理建模方法有启发性，但验证范围窄、无实机、无开源代码，尚未构成对领域范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: Stubborn: A Streamlined and Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Motion Tracking and Fall Recovery for Humanoids
papers.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning approaches have shown great promise in improving humanoid motion tracking performance and achieving fall recovery under disturbances. However, most existing works treat motion tracking and fall recovery as different tasks and require multi-stage training with specialized recovery rewards and/or separate recovery policies. Moreover, existing reinforcement learning-based methods often terminate training episodes immediately after severe tracking failures, limiting recovery-oriented exploration in unstable or fallen states. To address the above issues, we propose Stubborn, a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery. Specifically, Stubborn uses an asymmetric Actor-Critic architecture and consists of three major components. First, a yaw-aligned tracking representation is adopted to reduce sensitivity to global drift and heading disturbances while preserving gravity-related balance information. Second, we introduce a Bernoulli-based probabilistic termination mechanism that enables the policy to encourage exploration of fall-recovery behaviors under varying failure modes. Third, we propose a probabilistic termination and tracking-error-driven strategy that dynamically reshapes the sampling distribution based on tracking performance, increasing the training efficiency for difficult motion segments and unstable states. Extensive comparisons with SOTA methods and ablation studies show that Stubborn achieved competitive performance, and the proposed probabilistic termination mechanism and adaptive sampling strategy contributed to the performance and robustness gains. For real-world demonstrations, please refer to https://aislab-sustech.github.io/Stubborn/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫Stubborn的统一强化学习框架，让双足机器人在运动跟踪出错（比如被推倒）时不用重置仿真，而是继续探索并自主恢复站立，通过概率化终止机制和动态采样策略提升跌倒恢复能力。
analysis.org: 南方科技大学人工智能实验室
analysis.claim: 统一运动跟踪与跌倒恢复为单一RL任务，通过概率化终止机制和跟踪误差驱动的自适应采样，显著提升不稳定状态下的恢复鲁棒性与训练效率。
analysis.input: 本体状态（关节角度/角速度/IMU等）+参考轨迹（位置/速度/姿态）
analysis.output: 关节力矩控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中的ANYmal或Cassie类双足模型（摘要未提具体硬件，但演示视频链接显示为仿真+少量实机片段）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据训练或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出概率终止与误差驱动采样两个新机制，但未在真实机器人上验证，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，对比实验仅限仿真环境且未超越H2O、GR00T等基石工作（无多场景扰动鲁棒性定量对比、无长期部署测试、无跨平台迁移），属扎实但窄域的仿真级增量改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将跟踪与恢复统一建模并优化仿真训练流程，但缺乏真机验证和跨场景泛化证据，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Multi-Trait Meta-QTL Analysis Reveals Genomic Hotspot Classes for Strategic Maize Improvement
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Decades of maize (Zea mays L.) QTL mapping have produced fragmented results across hundreds of independent studies, characterized by broad confidence intervals, population-specific effects, and a predominantly single-trait analytical scope. Comprehensive multi-trait integration remains limited, yet it could substantially improve our understanding of trait relationships for strategic breeding. We integrated 2,701 QTLs published over 30 years across five functionally distinct trait categories (grain yield and components; plant development and architecture; plant physiology and stress adaptation; grain quality and nutritional composition; and disease and pest resistance) in order to identify functionally classified genomic hotspots and prioritize candidate genes for multi-trait breeding applications. Results BioMercator V4.2 consolidated 2,518 projectable QTLs into 187 high-confidence meta-QTLs (MQTLs), achieving an average 59% reduction in confidence interval width; 128 of 187 MQTLs (68.4%) achieved dual-platform support through GWAS co-localization. Twenty-three genomic hotspots harbored 132 of 187 MQTLs (70.6%) and were classified into three functional categories: twelve multi-trait hubs that may enable simultaneous improvement of multiple traits through pleiotropic or tightly linked genes; seven single-trait clusters with pathway-specific effects, exemplified by the chromosome 9 starch biosynthesis cluster; and four major-effect loci with reported individual effects exceeding 20% PVE, including vgt1 (54% PVE) and opaque2 (34.2% PVE). Descriptive environmental classification distinguished MQTLs predominantly supported by optimal-condition QTLs (42%) from those predominantly supported by stress-condition QTLs (28%), the latter showing approximately 3.5-fold greater mean contributing-QTL phenotypic variance, directionally consistent with conditional genetic effect amplification under stress. Network-based candidate gene prioritization combined with cross-cereal ortholog analysis showed that 67% of the top candidates possess orthologs in rice, sorghum, wheat, or barley, and 53% are conserved across all four species, identifying priority targets for functional genomics investment. Conclusions This functionally classified and environmentally characterized meta-QTL framework provides breeders with a structured resource for multi-trait hotspot selection, environment-appropriate allele deployment, and functional genomics prioritization, with broader applicability as a transferable analytical template for other crop species confronting analogous challenges of fragmented QTL literature and complex multi-trait breeding objectives.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把过去30年玉米领域2700多个零散QTL研究整合成187个高置信度meta-QTL，按功能（如产量、抗逆、品质）和环境条件（最优vs胁迫）分类，识别出23个关键基因组热点，并系统评估了其中候选基因在水稻、小麦等作物中的保守性，为多性状协同育种提供可操作的基因组坐标图谱。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过跨30年、5大类性状、2700+原始QTL的系统性meta-QTL整合与功能-环境双重注释，可识别出具有明确育种价值的多性状协同调控热点，显著提升玉米多目标分子育种的精准性与可部署性。
analysis.input: 已发表的2701个玉米QTL定位结果（含位置、性状、群体、环境条件、效应值等元数据）
analysis.output: 187个高置信meta-QTL位点、23个功能分类热点、环境响应模式标签、跨物种保守候选基因列表

analysis.significance_reason: 是作物遗传学中罕见的高质量、大规模、多维度（功能+环境）meta-QTL整合工作，方法扎实（59%区间压缩、68%双平台验证）、结论具实操性（热点分类+跨物种保守性分析），但未引入新实验技术或算法突破，属显著贡献而非范式变革；远低于AlphaFold2/ESM系列等计算生物学里程碑（需结构预测/生成/泛化建模突破），也未达RFdiffusion级的生成能力跃迁。
