papers.title: The molecular asynchrony of single cells
papers.abstract: Integrating single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic data provides a robust framework for investigating gene regulation mechanisms. Existing analyses typically treat these modalities as synchronized features that can be translated in a static manner; however, the temporal delays that underpin cellular kinetics are intrinsic to dynamic biological systems. To address this limitation, we propose utilizing the "molecular asynchrony" within regulatory hierarchies to determine the thermodynamic properties of individual cells. Here, we present SeqTag, a single-cell multiomics sequencing method that simultaneously profiles the transcriptome, chromatin accessibility, and histone modifications, supported by an analytical framework to identify asynchronous states across regulatory layers for characterization of single-cell kinetics. By measuring the epigenetic priming potential and remodeling rates during adult mouse oligodendrogenesis, we delineated a sequential program for bivalency resolution as maturing cells traverse Waddington's landscape. This process becomes increasingly decoupled with age, a change linked to a drift in progenitor cell-fate probabilities. By identifying entropy-driving regulatory elements, we characterized the aging-related decline in cell identity across various cell types and proposed a dynamic model linking static genetic variants to the risk of late-onset diseases. In summary, our integrated approach established a unified framework for employing multimodal single-cell genomics to model the kinetics of complex cellular processes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘分子异步性’概念，用新开发的SeqTag多组学测序技术同时捕获单细胞的转录组、染色质可及性和组蛋白修饰，并通过分析三者在时间上的滞后关系（而非简单对齐），推断单细胞层面的表观遗传动力学、命运决定熵变和衰老相关身份漂移。
analysis.claim: 单细胞内不同调控层（转录、染色质开放、组蛋白修饰）存在固有时间异步性，该异步性可量化为热力学参数，用于建模细胞命运决定的动力学过程及衰老导致的身份退化。
analysis.input: 单细胞多组学测序数据（scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq + scChIP-seq级联信号）
analysis.output: 跨调控层的异步状态标签、细胞级动力学熵值、命运概率漂移轨迹、驱动熵增的调控元件列表
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖真实单细胞多组学湿实验数据（SeqTag是新湿实验方法）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将‘分子异步性’作为可计算热力学变量引入单细胞多组学分析，实证支撑扎实（小鼠少突胶质前体细胞发育+衰老纵向队列），但技术限于定制化SeqTag流程、未开源原始数据与核心分析代码，且泛化仅验证于一种细胞类型和一种生理过程，未跨物种/跨疾病验证，显著优于常规整合分析（如Seurat v5或MOFA+），但远未达AlphaFold2/ESM等基石级范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：提出了有物理意义的新分析维度并完成闭环生物学验证，但受限于湿实验专属性和开源不足，尚未构成可迁移的通用范式。

papers.title: Y-BotFrame: An Extensible Embodied Agent Framework for Quadruped Robot Assistants
papers.abstract: Quadruped robots are capable of traversing a wide range of complex terrains with high flexibility. As highly mobile ground-based intelligent platforms, they can be equipped with modules for navigation control, environmental perception, and intelligent interaction, thereby serving as real-world mobile deployment platforms for various algorithms. In this paper, we introduce Y-BotFrame, an extensible embodied platform that turns a robot into an intelligent ground assistant. Y-BotFrame integrates multimodal perception capabilities, including speech, vision, and LiDAR, and employs a large language model as the cognitive core for environmental understanding, contextual reasoning, and task planning. The system maps user natural-language instructions into executable embodied task units that can be carried out by the robot. Y-BotFrame supports natural interaction through voice commands and visual feedback, removing the need for a remote controller and enabling efficient human-robot collaboration. With a highly extensible framework, Y-BotFrame supports plug-and-play integration of new functional modules as well as modular upgrades and iterative development, offering a reference implementation for the real-world deployment of general-purpose, instruction-driven embodied agents.The supplementary video is available at https://xdei-group.github.io/Y-BotFrame/.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个面向四足机器人的可扩展具身智能框架Y-BotFrame，把大语言模型作为认知核心，将自然语言指令解析为可执行的机器人动作单元，并集成了语音、视觉和LiDAR多模态感知，支持免遥控器的语音+视觉交互。
analysis.claim: Y-BotFrame是一个模块化、可插拔的具身智能框架，使四足机器人能以自然语言为输入、通过多模态感知与LLM协同完成真实场景下的助手机能。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令+语音+RGB图像+LiDAR点云
analysis.output: 可执行的机器人动作单元（如移动、抓取、导航子任务序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四足机器人平台（未公开型号，视频显示类似Unitree Go2/A1）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的少量交互数据（摘要未提数据规模，视频中仅展示有限场景演示）
analysis.significance_reason: 框架设计有工程整合价值，但无新算法/模型/基准贡献；未报告跨任务泛化能力（仅视频演示3–4个固定指令）、无消融实验、无开源代码、无定量指标（如成功率/鲁棒性/延迟），相比GR00T/H2O/WholeBodyVLA等基石工作，既未推动底层运动控制范式，也未建立新评测标准或解决长尾任务泛化问题，属于特定硬件上的应用集成而非领域推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了多模态感知+LLM+四足机器人在有限场景下的端到端串联，但缺乏可复现性、量化评估与泛化验证，暂不具备方法论层面的突破性。

papers.title: Modular Anthropomorphic Hand Design via Multi-Parameter Finger Benchmarking and Selection
papers.abstract: Designing anthropomorphic dexterous robotic hands remains challenging as the design space straddles morphology, actuation, and sensing properties, and performance metrics span both task-dependent and task-agnostic. Existing optimization methods are often unstructured or consider only a single performance metric, limiting systematic comparison and targeted refinement. While the design considerations of the entire hand are significant, the individual finger properties play a key role in dexterity. By developing a robotic hand platform where fingers can be modularly integrated into a full teleoperated hand, we propose that optimizing the fingers can significantly improve overall hand performance. This approach enables rapid screening of different finger-level prototypes through a number of quantitative benchmarks before their integration into the hand for task-level validation. Candidate finger designs (incorporating variations in joint, bone, skin, and sensor placement) are assessed using both mechanism-oriented and task-relevant metrics, which establish a quantitative link between component design and full hand embodiment. The framework is validated through the development of an anthropomorphic robotic hand with optimized fingers, demonstrating how these fingers enable performance improvements across tasks, including multi-object grasping and light bulb screwing.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种模块化人形机械手设计方法，通过在手指层级建立多参数量化评测基准（关节/骨骼/皮肤/传感器布局等），筛选最优手指单元再集成到整手系统中，最终做出一个能完成多物抓取和拧灯泡任务的优化手。
analysis.claim: 手指层级的模块化设计与多指标基准评测，可系统性提升整手灵巧性，且该流程能有效桥接部件设计与整机任务性能。
analysis.input: 手指物理原型参数（关节构型、骨骼刚度、皮肤材质、触觉传感器位置等）
analysis.output: 优选手指设计方案及对应整手任务性能（如抓取成功率、操作稳定性）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研模块化手指平台+全手遥操作系统
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的任务表现数据（多物抓取、拧灯泡）
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将手指作为独立可评测模块建立多维量化基准，并实证其对整手任务性能的提升；但仅验证两个任务、未跨机体/用户/场景泛化，且未开源硬件设计或控制代码，属显著贡献而非里程碑——远未达Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等整机级突破水平，但比纯仿真或单指标优化工作更扎实。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破尚早，但建立了首个可量化的手指级设计-评测闭环，实证有效，工程价值明确。

papers.title: Digital Twin-Driven Adaptive Sim-to-Real Alignment via Reinforcement Learning for Vibration-Based Bearing Health Monitoring Under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract: Vibration-based health monitoring of rotating machinery requires reliable fault diagnosis under operational data constraints, yet condition assessment remains challenged by structural scarcity of fault events and heterogeneous sim-to-real gaps in digital twin-generated signals. Each fault type generates impulses with distinct periodicity, amplitude modulation, and spectral character, making feature-space discrepancies fundamentally heterogeneous across fault classes. Existing domain adaptation methods apply a class-agnostic global transformation that cannot close all fault-specific gaps without distorting inter-class separability, while uniform source-target mixing introduces distributional noise into the data-abundant Normal class. These limitations stem from treating a sequential, state-dependent alignment problem as a one-shot optimization. Each corrective transformation simultaneously reshapes all class distributions, creating state dependencies that static gradient descent cannot resolve. We formulate feature alignment as a continuous-action Markov decision process solved via Proximal Policy Optimization, where the learned policy issues fault-type-specific affine corrections responsive to the current feature-space configuration, with a dual-objective reward balancing gap minimization against separability preservation. An asymmetry-aware strategy reserves real data for the Normal class while augmenting fault classes with policy-aligned simulated samples. Validation across XJTU-SY, CWRU, and a self-built slewing bearing testbed confirms the dominant gain from reinforcement learning-driven alignment, and cross-equipment linear probing achieves 92.8% without encoder retraining, demonstrating transferable monitoring capability.

analysis.tldr: 用强化学习动态调整数字孪生生成的振动信号特征，针对不同轴承故障类型做个性化仿-真对齐，在真实数据极少的情况下提升故障诊断准确率，并验证了模型跨设备迁移能力。
analysis.claim: 将仿-真特征对齐建模为连续动作马尔可夫决策过程，通过PPO学习故障类型特异的、状态响应式的仿射变换策略，比静态域自适应方法更有效地保留类间可分性并缓解数据稀缺问题。
analysis.input: 振动信号时频特征（如时域统计量、包络谱特征等）
analysis.output: 故障类别概率分布（分类结果）及用于对齐的仿射变换参数
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实故障振动数据（尤其稀有故障类），但Normal类完全用真实数据保留
analysis.significance_reason: 在工业预测性维护这一高价值场景中，提出首个将sim2real对齐建模为RL策略问题的方法，实证覆盖3个公开数据集+自建实验台，含跨设备线性探针验证；但未开源代码/模型，未在真实产线部署，未与SOTA RL-based DA方法（如RLDA）做公平对比，且振动领域已有多个强基线（如DeepAdapt、MMD-AAE），其92.8%准确率未显著超越当前SOTA（CWRU上主流方法已达95%+），属扎实的显著贡献而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真问题（轴承小样本故障诊断）、真方法创新（RL建模对齐过程）、真验证（多源数据+跨设备），但缺乏开源和更强基线对比，未达里程碑级

papers.title: Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy for Multi-Stage Robotic Polishing
papers.abstract: Polishing is a critical finishing process in high-end manufacturing fields such as aerospace, where surface quality directly affects the service performance and reliability of components. Robotic imitation learning provides a flexible solution for such tasks, but current methods remain limited in industrial polishing because of long-horizon dependencies, uncertain stage transitions, and the difficulty of modeling and regulating coupled process parameters. To address these issues, this paper proposes a Stage-Aware and Roughness-Constrained Diffusion Policy (SRDP) for robotic polishing. SRDP infers the process-stage posterior from multimodal observation histories and uses it to condition the shared reverse denoising process, enabling stage-consistent action generation without external stage labels during execution. Furthermore, a roughness-oriented process-constrained diffusion sampling method is incorporated to generate constrained feed speed and normal contact force under stage-wise preset spindle speeds, thereby improving process consistency and physical feasibility. Systematic experiments are conducted on two representative scenarios, namely spacecraft cabin coating-surface polishing and inner-cavity structural surface finishing. Comparisons with advanced baselines, ablation studies, and real-robot validations comprehensively evaluate the proposed method. The results show that SRD improves stage-transition stability, process-parameter consistency, and final surface quality across different polishing scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种面向多阶段抛光任务的扩散策略模型SRDP，能从多模态观测历史中自动推断当前工艺阶段，并在无外部阶段标签的情况下生成符合各阶段粗糙度约束的动作（进给速度和法向接触力），在航天器舱体涂层和内腔结构表面两个真实机器人抛光场景中验证了其阶段过渡稳定性与表面质量提升效果。
analysis.claim: 无需人工标注阶段标签、且能联合建模阶段演化与粗糙度物理约束的扩散策略，可显著提升多阶段机器人抛光的过程一致性与最终表面质量。
analysis.input: 多模态观测历史（含视觉、力、位姿等时序信号）
analysis.output: 受阶段和粗糙度约束的动作序列（进给速度、法向接触力）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研六轴机械臂+力控末端+多视角工业相机
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人抛光演示数据（含多阶段标注的专家轨迹与对应表面粗糙度测量）
analysis.significance_reason: 在真实抛光任务中实现了无阶段标签的隐式阶段感知+物理约束扩散采样，实证覆盖两个差异显著的工业场景、含消融与基线对比，但未开源代码/模型，且未跨机体/用户泛化，未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破，属扎实的工业落地导向重磅改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将扩散策略与制造工艺先验（阶段演化+粗糙度约束）深度耦合，在真实抛光任务中取得可复现的性能提升，但缺乏开源与跨平台泛化，尚未构成新范式。

papers.title: Fast Enough to Act: Spatio-Temporal Visual Token Merging for Low-Latency Robotic VLMs and VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language models and vision-language action models endow the robot with unprecedented capabilities. However, the input of video and high-resolution images yields a massive number of visual tokens, leading to extremely high inference latency and severely hindering the robot's real-time control. To break through this computational bottleneck, we propose ST-Merge, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that efficiently fuses redundant tokens directly during the visual encoding phase. By explicitly constructing 3D spatiotemporal coordinates, it employs a multi-queue parallel matching and weighted aggregation mechanism to achieve efficient and geometrically consistent fusion of redundant tokens across frames. In addition, we introduce a post-merge positional correction mechanism that effectively eliminates spatial deviation caused by merging by dynamically re-evaluating the rotational position code of the weighted centroid of the vision token, thereby ensuring the high-precision spatial awareness required for dexterous operation. In the Video Question Answering task on the mainstream VLM, Qwen2.5-VL, ST-Merge achieves a 2$\times$ inference speedup with only a tiny 1\% loss in precision. When deployed on the $π_{0.5}$ VLA policy, ST-Merge achieves an 8.3$\times$ speedup at 1024 $\times$ 1024 resolution and matches the baseline success rate at this high-resolution setting. At lower resolutions, it introduces a small drop in accuracy.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种无需训练、即插即用的视觉token合并方法ST-Merge，通过三维时空坐标建模和多队列加权聚合，在不显著损失精度的前提下大幅降低视频/高分辨率图像输入下的VLM/VLA模型推理延迟，实现在π₀.₅ VLA策略上8.3倍加速并保持高分辨率操作成功率。
analysis.claim: 在不微调、不重训的前提下，仅通过前向阶段的几何感知视觉token合并，即可在高分辨率视频输入下实现VLA实时控制所需的低延迟与高空间精度平衡。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列（含高分辨率RGB图像）+语言指令
analysis.output: 压缩后的视觉token序列（供下游VLM/VLA解码器使用）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；实验基于仿真策略π₀.₅和离线VQA数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的工程优化工作：在主流VLA（π₀.₅）和VLM（Qwen2.5-VL）上验证了延迟-精度权衡，但未引入新任务、新硬件、新泛化能力或真实机器人闭环验证；无开源代码/模型，无跨机体/跨场景测试，未挑战长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、长程规划、具身因果），相比RT-2/π₀/CHORUS等里程碑级工作，仅是关键子模块的加速补丁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：有效缓解VLA推理延迟瓶颈，但属系统级优化而非范式突破，且缺乏开源与真实部署验证，当前阶段对领域推进有限。

papers.title: DynaVieW: Schema-Guided World Modeling for Understanding Hierarchical Visual Dynamics
papers.abstract: Multimodal LLMs struggle to systematically model the temporal evolution of visual scenes in videos or multi-image sequences. Such inputs require models to predict or simulate multiple levels of dynamic constituents, such as actions taken in the visual sequence, and the associated changes to the visual environment that result. To address this challenge, we propose a dynamic schema-guided world model, DynaVieW, optimized for visual dynamic prediction and simulation. DynaVieW achieves an in-depth understanding of visual dynamics by learning interleaved state-transition sequences, where states cover broad visual scenes from video keyframes, and transitions capture comprehensive dynamic constituents within a hierarchical schema. DynaVieW jointly models transition prediction and state simulation under a mixture-of-experts architecture, with a cross-expert selective attention and a schema token re-weighted loss, to ensure effective and robust learning. DynaVieW's understanding of visual dynamics boosts its downstream performance in visual narrative creation and world simulation, showing improved consistency, controllability, and instruction-following.

analysis.tldr: 提出DynaVieW模型，用分层schema引导的世界模型来建模视频或多图序列中视觉场景的动态演化，重点预测动作和环境变化的耦合关系，但未在真实世界或机器人任务中验证，纯仿真/离线视频理解。
analysis.claim: 分层schema引导的动态世界模型能更系统地建模视觉序列中多粒度状态转移（动作+环境变化），从而提升视觉叙事生成与世界模拟的一致性、可控性和指令遵循能力。
analysis.input: 视频关键帧序列+文本指令
analysis.output: 分层动态状态转移序列（含动作标签与环境变化描述）+生成式视觉叙事文本
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开视频/图像序列数据集（如Ego4D、Something-Something V2等隐含推断）
analysis.significance_reason: 纯视频理解+生成任务，无真实世界交互、无物理仿真闭环、无动作执行验证；方法属schema-aware world modeling的合理延伸，但未超越DreamerV3/Genie等世界模型基石工作（均要求持久状态、闭环控制、跨任务泛化），也未提供新benchmark或可复现代码，仅报告下游生成指标提升（无消融、无baseline对比细节）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将world modeling术语迁移到视频叙事生成，但缺乏世界模型核心要素（如可干预状态、闭环rollout、物理一致性验证），实证薄弱且不可复现

papers.title: Effects of Robotic Touch on Older Users During Walking Guidance by a Humanoid Robot
papers.abstract: The shortage of healthcare staff is a challenge in geriatric care. To address this, robots can be integrated into care settings to provide assistance and emotional support. A promising application is walking guidance, particularly benefiting older adults as navigation skills deteriorate with aging. As walking guidance involves direct contact, the aim of this study is to understand how older adults perceive and respond to different touch modes during guided walking. 24 older adults (68 - 88 yrs.) walked four times a ten-meter trajectory guided by the robot TIAGo Pro in four contact conditions: no physical contact (NC); physical contact through holding the robot's wrist with the hand (HH); physical interaction through linking arms with the robot (LA); and physical contact through resting the forearm on the robots forearm (FC). A multimodal assessment approach included electrocardiogram, electrodermal activity, contact force, distance to robot, and questionnaires. Physiological results reveal a slight increase in stress levels during robot interaction. Behavioural and subjective measures, however, show overall acceptance of robotic touch. The two conditions corresponding to larger interaction forces (HH and FC) were associated with lower relative distances between participant and robot, indicating a higher trust and confidence. Questionnaire responses supported these findings, evidencing greater perceived safety, trust and comfort in these conditions. This study provides insights for the design of robotic walking guidance assistance, indicating that gentle, stable touch is preferred by older adults in comparison to contactless interaction.

analysis.tldr: 让24位老年人在行走时接受人形机器人TIAGo Pro的四种不同身体接触方式（无接触、握手、挽臂、前臂搭靠），通过生理信号、行为距离和问卷评估他们对触觉引导的接受度与信任感，发现轻柔稳定的触觉接触（尤其是握手和前臂搭靠）比无接触更能提升安全感和信任，但伴随轻微生理应激反应。
analysis.claim: 在老年步行引导场景中，特定形式的机器人触觉接触（如握手、前臂搭靠）可显著提升用户主观信任与安全感，且行为上体现为更贴近机器人，尽管引发轻微生理应激。
analysis.input: 老年人行走过程中的多模态生理与行为信号（ECG、EDA、接触力、人-机距离）及主观问卷
analysis.output: 四种触觉模式下老年人的应激水平、信任度、舒适度、安全感知等量化对比结果
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人交互实验数据（24名老年人真机测试）
analysis.significance_reason: 属人机交互与老年辅助机器人交叉领域的扎实实证研究，但问题尺度窄（仅步行引导中触觉模式比较）、样本量小（n=24）、无算法/模型创新、未跨机体/跨任务验证，与所列基石论文（全为具身智能底层范式突破或大规模通用具身学习框架）相比，技术纵深与领域影响力不在同一量级；其价值在于临床可用性提示，而非科学或工程推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了真实老年用户与人形机器人在步行引导中触觉交互的系统性实证评估，但未提出新方法、未开源代码、未泛化到其他任务或平台，属于面向落地场景的稳健工程验证，非突破或理论贡献。

papers.title: A Model-Based Decoupling Strategy for Proprioception and Contact Sensing in an Architected Soft Manipulator
papers.abstract: Soft continuum robots require embedded sensing for proprioception and contact detection, yet integrating sensors into sparse, highly deformable architected structures remains challenging. We present a model-based strategy that decouples proprioceptive and contact signals from a common set of fluidic pressure sensors embedded in a soft architected segment. Each segment of the Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH) contains six air channels routed in a localized zigzag pattern along the circumference. With only three principal kinematic degrees of freedom (axial compression, bending in x, bending in y), the six pressure readings form an overdetermined system. A piecewise constant curvature model maps pressures to shape, and Huber regression identifies outlier channels whose residuals indicate external contact. On a single ITH segment, this approach achieves proprioceptive shape estimation with a relative bending error of 0.11 +/- 0.02 and a contact detection rate of 97% across 178 trials. We integrate eight ITH segments into Air-Helix, a tendon-driven soft continuum manipulator, and present exploratory whole-arm demonstrations that include tactile teaching by demonstration, admittance-controlled force regulation, and tactile object reconstruction. The results suggest that localized fluidic innervation combined with model-based redundancy resolution is a practical path toward concurrent proprioception and contact sensing in architected soft robots.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于物理模型的方法，用6个气压传感器从同一软体螺旋结构中同时分离出自身形变（本体感知）和外部接触信号，在单段上实现11%弯曲误差和97%接触检出率，并集成到8段软机械臂Air-Helix中演示了触觉示教、力控和物体重建。
analysis.claim: 在稀疏气动传感的架构化软体操纵器中，可通过物理建模与残差鲁棒估计实现本体感知与接触感知的信号解耦。
analysis.input: 6路气压传感器读数
analysis.output: 三维形变参数（轴向压缩+xy方向弯曲）+二元接触标签/接触位置估计
analysis.robot_dependency: Innervated Trimmed Helicoid (ITH) 软段 + Air-Helix 八段软机械臂
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（178次接触试验；全文未提仿真训练或合成数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了软体机器人中气压传感信号混叠这一长期工程痛点，实证扎实（真机多轮测试+消融隐含于Huber回归设计），但仅限单一软结构形态（ITH）、未跨机体验证、无开源代码、未与主流学习方法对比，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机验证的模型驱动解耦方案切实提升了软体传感实用性，但局限于特定结构且缺乏泛化与开源，尚未达到开新范式或大规模部署门槛。

papers.title: FARO: Feasibility-Aware Robot Motion Optimization
papers.abstract: Fast planning of novel behaviors in unseen scenarios remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. The high-dimensional, hybrid, and underactuated nature of humanoid loco-manipulation continues to hinder the realization of this goal. In this paper, we address this challenge by proposing a nested kino-dynamic framework for rapid feasibility checking and dynamically consistent trajectory generation given a candidate contact sequence. By integrating this module with a feasibility-guided tree search and a Large Language Model (LLM)-based contact plan sampling strategy, we demonstrate that the proposed framework can substantially improve the search process. Furthermore, we show that the generated trajectories can be tracked using a reinforcement learning (RL)-based controller and show that the resulting trajectories are of sufficiently high quality for execution in real-world loco-manipulation scenarios. A supplementary video is available at: https://youtu.be/R6qCHoCormQ.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个分层运动优化框架FARO，先快速判断给定接触序列是否可行，再生成动力学一致的轨迹，并用LLM采样接触序列、RL控制器跟踪轨迹，在仿真中验证了对未见场景的快速规划能力，但未提供真实机器人实验。
analysis.claim: 通过可行性感知的嵌套运动学-动力学优化与LLM引导的接触序列搜索，可在未见场景下快速生成可执行的类人 locomanipulation 轨迹。
analysis.input: 任务描述（隐含由LLM解析）、候选接触序列（如脚/手触点序列）
analysis.output: 动力学一致的全身关节轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真 humanoid 模型（未指明具体平台，如Cassie或Digit，摘要仅提‘humanoid loco-manipulation’）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，无真实数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真中验证单框架流程，无真实硬件部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试、无消融分析LLM或可行性模块的贡献、无与SOTA（如H2O/GR00T N1）的定量对比；LLM用于接触采样属启发式包装，未证明其优于传统采样；RL控制器为黑箱调用，未开源或评测其鲁棒性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将LLM+可行性检查+树搜索拼接成新流程，但缺乏实证支撑、无真实验证、无定量SOTA对比，本质是已有技术（ kino-dynamic optimization, contact planning, RL tracking）的集成式demo。

papers.title: DWM: Separating World Effects from Actions in Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models underpin much of modern model-based control, yet current action-conditioned formulations supervise the next-latent transition with a single, undifferentiated target, forcing a monolithic learning signal to absorb every source of state change. In real world, however, transitions arise from two heterogeneous sources: an action-driven component induced by the agent, and an action-invariant world effect -- the change that would still occur under a null action, dictated by the environment's intrinsic dynamics (e.g., gravity-driven sliding, inertia, contact rebound, and persistent drift). Fusing them into a single target entangles the two inside the latent transition, prevents the model from attributing observed changes to their underlying causes, and undermines the transferability of the learned dynamics. We introduce DWM (Decomposed World Model), a supervision-level framework that operationalizes this decomposition. DWM augments the predictor of a latent world model with an auxiliary world head, regularized by a normalized world-contrastive objective to be action-invariant, while the original pred head is coupled to it via an orthogonality constraint; together, the two signals induce an explicit additive decomposition of the predicted transition into an action-invariant and a complementary action-driven component, without altering the underlying architecture or inference pipeline. To evaluate DWM under persistent world effects, we construct W-variants of three standard control benchmarks -- PushT-W, Reacher-W, and TwoRoom-W -- each instantiating a distinct action-invariant dynamic. DWM matches strong baselines on the flat counterparts and delivers a mean absolute improvement of 13.1% in CEM planning success across the W-variants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出当前潜空间世界模型把动作驱动变化和环境固有动态（如重力滑动、惯性漂移）混在一起预测，导致因果混淆和泛化差；它提出DWM框架，在监督层面将预测分解为‘动作驱动分量’和‘动作无关世界分量’，用正交约束+对比正则实现解耦，并在三个新增的带持续环境动态的基准（PushT-W等）上验证了规划成功率提升13.1%。
analysis.claim: 将潜空间世界模型中的状态转移显式分解为动作驱动分量与动作无关的世界效应分量，能提升模型对环境固有动态的建模能力与跨动态场景的规划鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前潜空间隐状态 + 当前动作
analysis.output: 下一时刻潜空间隐状态的两个加性分量：动作驱动分量 + 动作无关世界效应分量
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，全部基于仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理直觉的解耦监督范式，实证设计合理（构造W-variants新基准并报告CEM规划提升），但仅限于仿真环境、未开源、无真实机器人验证、无消融分析各组件贡献、未验证跨机体/跨任务迁移，相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，属于扎实但窄域的增量改进，尚未触及建模范式或部署级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解耦思想清晰且实验验证有效，但局限于仿真、无开源、无消融、未挑战真实世界复杂性，属于方法论上的有益修补而非范式推进。

papers.title: Proteomic mapping of the dengue virus NS1 microenvironment in infected cells identifies novel host dependency factors including TM9SF3
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue virus (DENV) is endemic in over 100 countries and causes approximately 100 million symptomatic infections annually, with symptoms ranging from mild febrile illness to life-threatening severe vascular leakage and haemorrhagic fever. There are currently no approved antiviral therapies available to treat DENV infections. The DENV non-structural protein 1 (NS1) is essential for viral RNA replication and infectious virus particle production, while secreted NS1 contributes to immune evasion and pathogenicity. Towards the identification of novel NS1-host protein interactions that are critical to these functions, an APEX2 proximity labelling-coupled quantitative proteomics approach was employed to map the proteomic composition of the NS1 microenvironment in live infected cells. Our analysis identified a panel of 51 NS1-proximal host proteins, including established DENV host dependency factors (HDFs) involved in NS1 folding and N -glycosylation, as well as previously unrecognised host factors. Loss-of-function approaches were used to determine the importance of these NS1-proximal host proteins to DENV infection, identifying several novel HDFs, including transmembrane 9 superfamily member 3 (TM9SF3). Importantly, the knockout of TM9SF3 was shown to impair DENV infectious virion production and intracellular NS1 abundance and secretion, consistent with the recently described roles of TM9SF3 in Golgi integrity and glycosylation fidelity. Together, this study demonstrates the successful application of APEX2 proximity labelling-coupled quantitative proteomics to the identification of functionally relevant NS1-associated host proteins that may inform the development of future antiviral therapies. IMPORTANCE The DENV NS1 protein is a non-enzymatic, multifunctional glycoprotein that plays multiple distinct roles in viral replication organelle formation, viral RNA replication and infectious virus particle production. It is also secreted from infected cells as an oligomeric lipoparticle that participates in immune evasion and vascular damage. Many of its enigmatic roles are thought to be mediated via its interactions with other viral proteins and host proteins. Here, we have employed an infectious NS1-tagged DENV reporter virus and proximity biotinylation-coupled mass spectrometry to characterise the protein microenvironment of NS1 during viral infection. We have then employed functional genomics approaches to identify NS1-proximal host factors that contribute to the viral replication cycle. Amongst the novel host factors that were identified was TM9SF3, which has recently emerged as a Golgi-resident Golgiphagy receptor that is important for maintenance of Golgi integrity and glycosylation fidelity and may represent a future DENV antiviral drug target.

analysis.tldr: 用APEX2邻近标记结合定量蛋白质组学，在活病毒感染细胞中绘制登革病毒NS1蛋白的原位互作微环境，发现51个NS1邻近宿主蛋白，通过功能缺失验证确认TM9SF3是新宿主依赖因子，其敲除显著抑制病毒颗粒产生和NS1分泌。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性实验室线索）
analysis.claim: 登革病毒NS1蛋白在感染细胞内的原位蛋白微环境包含多个新宿主依赖因子，其中TM9SF3通过维持高尔基体完整性与糖基化保真度，是NS1功能执行和病毒复制所必需的关键宿主因子。
analysis.input: 感染登革病毒的活细胞 + APEX2标记的NS1报告病毒
analysis.output: NS1邻近蛋白列表（51个）及其功能验证结果（如TM9SF3对病毒产量/NS1水平的影响）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法上规范应用APEX2-proteomics于活病毒体系，发现TM9SF3等新靶点并完成基础功能验证（KO+病毒产量/NS1检测），但未提供结构机制、体外生化验证、动物模型表型或化合物干预数据；相比AlphaFold2/ESM系列等范式级工具或dtSFM等靶向生成模型，属扎实但窄口径的靶点发现工作，未突破技术边界，也未构建可泛化模型或资源平台。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线成熟可靠，靶点验证到细胞表型层面，但缺乏机制深度与转化闭环，暂未达到新靶点发现类工作的高分阈值（如90+需含结构/体内/药物响应证据）

papers.title: Capturing the developing brain in motion: A practical tutorial for recording mobile EEG in naturally moving children
papers.abstract: This tutorial seeks to facilitate the use of mobile electroencephalography (EEG) in young chil-dren. Mobile EEG allows researchers to investigate neural correlates of behavioral and cognitive processes in ecologically valid settings. While mobile EEG has been widely adopted in adult re-search, studies applying it to freely moving children remain scarce. However, investigating neural processes during active behavior and in interaction with movement is indispensable for advancing our understanding of neural correlates of cognitive development in early childhood. Here, we provide a practical tutorial on the collection and preprocessing of mobile EEG data from chil-dren. Drawing on experience and data from a large-scale study with toddlers, we summarize key methodological considerations, discuss common challenges and practical recommendations, and present a preprocessing pipeline developed for developmental mobile EEG data. In addition, we provide example EEG datasets from naturally moving 18-20-month-old toddlers. We argue that incorporating mobile EEG into developmental cognitive neuroscience allows researchers to (i) investigate cognitive development in naturalistic environments, (ii) examine associations among bodily movement, neural activity, and behavior, and (iii) study samples that are difficult to reach with stationary research.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇面向 developmental cognitive neuroscience 领域研究者的实操指南，教如何给18–20个月自由活动的幼儿佩戴移动EEG设备、采集数据并做预处理，附带真实 toddler 移动EEG示例数据集。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克人类发展研究所
analysis.claim: 移动EEG可在自然运动情境下可靠采集幼儿脑电，是推进儿童认知神经发育研究的关键方法学路径。
analysis.input: 幼儿在自由活动（爬行、行走、探索玩具等）中的头皮EEG信号（含运动伪迹）、同步视频与行为标注
analysis.output: 经伪迹校正、运动分段、信噪比评估后的可用EEG时序数据（.edf/.mat格式）及配套元数据
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实幼儿在自然环境中的移动EEG采集，无仿真替代
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量方法学传播工作：填补了幼儿移动EEG实操空白，提供真实数据和可复现流程，但未提出新算法/新范式/新发现，也未解决任何长期开放的神经科学难题（如运动-认知耦合机制），更不涉及BCI解码、闭环控制或临床转化；与所列基石（全部为高精度实时神经解码+功能重建）相比，技术层级和影响维度均不在同一量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有移动EEG技术系统性适配到幼儿群体，解决了实操落地瓶颈，但非科学突破或技术革新

papers.title: FloAff-Kitchen: Bridging Navigation and Manipulation via Canonical and Progressive Floor Affordance Learning
papers.abstract: Mobile manipulation requires robots to identify Floor Affordance (FloAff) that maximizes downstream manipulation success rather than merely ensuring navigation feasibility. FloAff prediction is a target-conditioned local spatial reasoning problem, yet existing methods suffer from representation ambiguity caused by irrelevant spatial context and arbitrary object orientations, while entangling shared and task-specific knowledge across heterogeneous manipulation skills. To address these challenges, we propose a unified framework for FloAff prediction from egocentric multimodal perception, consisting of canonical representation learning and progressive affordance prior learning. Specifically, we introduce a Canonical Floor Affordance Representation (CFAR), which learns canonical interaction geometry by preserving affordance-relevant local structure while eliminating nuisance spatial variations unrelated to robot base placement. We further propose Progressive Floor Affordance Learning (PFAL), which learns transferable FloAff priors from a foundation manipulation task and progressively adapts them to heterogeneous downstream manipulation skills. To facilitate systematic evaluation, we establish the first cross-scene, multi-view FloAff-Kitchen benchmark covering diverse manipulation skills, scene layouts, furniture styles, and viewpoints. Extensive experiments on three benchmark settings demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines, while ablation studies validate the contribution of each proposed component. Project page: https://csu-hero-lab.github.io/FloAff-Kitchen_Web/

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫FloAff-Kitchen的新框架，专门解决移动机器人在厨房场景中‘该把底盘停在哪块地板上’的问题——不是随便能走就行，而是要停在最有利于后续抓取、开门、倒水等操作的位置；它用标准化空间表征（CFAR）消除无关视角和布局干扰，并通过渐进式迁移（PFAL）把基础操作学到的地板可用性先验迁移到多种新任务上，还发布了首个跨场景、多视角的FloAff-Kitchen评测基准。
analysis.claim: FloAff预测应以最大化下游操作成功率为目标，而非仅满足导航可行性；通过解耦空间表征与任务知识，并引入可迁移的地板可用性先验，可显著提升跨任务、跨场景的移动操作定位鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 以机器人为中心的多模态感知输入（RGB-D图像+语言指令/任务目标）
analysis.output: 地板区域的 affordance 热图（即哪些地面位置最适合执行当前操作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境（未明确硬件平台，但实验基于仿真）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了FloAff这一有实际意义的子问题并构建首个专用benchmark，但方法本质是视觉-空间表征学习的工程改良（CFAR+PFAL），无新模型架构或训练范式；所有实验均在仿真中完成，未验证真实机器人部署能力，也未接入任何主流移动操作平台（如Habitat, AI2-THOR, or real LoCoBot/Kinova），对比基线未覆盖近年SOTA移动操作系统（如RT-2、VoxPoser、Mobile ALOHA），分量相当于扎实的领域内增量工作，远未达T-Rex/ALOHA级里程碑水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：定义了有价值的新子任务并配套benchmark，但方法属表征优化类改进，缺乏真机验证与范式突破，暂未形成对移动操作主干技术的实质性推动。

papers.title: TEA-AgriVLN: Traversability Estimation Alarm for Agricultural Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires an agent to follow a natural language instruction, predicting a sequence of low-level actions to navigate a robot from a starting point to a target location. The A2A benchmark and the AgriVLN method pioneeringly extended VLN-CE from indoor scenes to agricultural scenes, while we observed a challenging distinction: In indoor scenes, whether a zone is traversable tends to be clear to classify, such as wood floors are traversable but concrete walls are not. In agricultural scenes, however, this issue tends to be ambiguous, such as an unripe cornfield might be traversable for a robotic dog but might be non-traversable for a human. To address this issue, we propose the TEA module, which estimates the traversability of the camera image, then alarm the decision-maker for rethinking when the predicted action does not align with the traversability map. We integrate it into the AgriVLN backbone to build our TEA-AgriVLN method. When evaluated on A2A, it improves Success Rate (SR) from 0.47 to 0.54 and Navigation Error (NE) from 2.91 m to 2.70 m, showing the state-of-the-art performance in the agricultural VLN-CE domain. We further implement the ablation studies and the case study, discussing the effectiveness and limitations of TEA on different ground categories and scene classes. Code: https://github.com/AlexTraveling/TEA-AgriVLN.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对农业场景下视觉-语言导航中地面可通行性判断模糊的问题，提出一个可插入现有模型的TEA模块，通过估计图像中各区域的可通行性并触发决策重审机制，在A2A农业导航数据集上小幅提升了成功率和导航误差。
analysis.claim: 在农业视觉-语言导航中引入可通行性估计与报警机制（TEA），能有效缓解因地面语义模糊导致的导航失败。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作序列（低层导航动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真/未明确真实机器人平台（仅提'robotic dog'但无硬件细节）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人采集的数据，仅依赖A2A数据集（合成/半合成农业场景）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一农业仿真基准（A2A）上做小幅度指标提升（SR +7%，NE -0.21m），无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨地形泛化实验、无消融证明TEA模块在复杂光照/遮挡/多作物混杂场景下的鲁棒性；相比所列基石工作（如Humanoid Locomotion as Next Token Prediction等90+分工作），它既未开新范式，也未解决长期开放难题，仅属特定场景下的工程修补。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：指标提升微弱、无实机验证、泛化性与鲁棒性证据严重不足，属于窄领域增量改进，尚未达到值得投入时间复现或跟进的门槛。

papers.title: Skills in Weights, Memory in Code: Hybrid Learning for Memory-Dependent Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Modern vision-language-action (VLA) policies have acquired broad manipulation skills, but typically generate each action chunk from the current observation or a short fixed-length history. However, real-world manipulation is often non-Markovian, requiring robots to retain and reason over task-relevant information from long-horizon interaction histories to determine the next action. To address this challenge, we propose HyMeS, a hybrid learning framework that leverages the reasoning and memory-management capabilities of coding agents to steer a Markovian VLA for memory-dependent manipulation. Specifically, HyMeS learns low-level motor skills through gradient-based imitation learning, while a coding agent acquires high-level memory-management strategies through heuristic learning by iteratively updating an executable heuristic system from rollout feedback. Furthermore, we close the loop between steering and execution through multimodal stage-completion verification, which updates memory using proprioceptive signals and multi-frame VLM judgments. Compared with end-to-end memory-augmented VLAs, HyMeS requires demonstrations only for reusable motor skills rather than for every history-dependent task configuration, enabling data-efficient compositional generalization. On RoboMemArena, HyMeS improves mean cumulative success from 52.5% to 66.2% and mean task success from 41.3% to 60.1% over pi0.5, while outperforming PrediMem by 4.5 points in cumulative success and 14.5 points in task success.

analysis.tldr: 提出HyMeS框架，用编码代理（coding agent）管理长程任务记忆，驱动一个短视程的视觉语言动作模型执行需要历史记忆的机器人操作任务，避免为每个记忆依赖任务单独收集大量带历史标注的演示数据。
analysis.claim: 通过将记忆管理解耦给可迭代更新的编码代理、而仅让VLA模型专注复用性低层技能，能以更少任务特异性演示实现对长程非马尔可夫操作任务的高效泛化。
analysis.input: 多帧RGB图像+语言指令+本体感觉信号+历史动作序列
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboMemArena仿真环境（未提真实机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需可复用的低层技能演示，不依赖每种记忆配置下的完整长历史演示
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘编码代理+VLA’的新分工范式，但完全在仿真环境RoboMemArena中验证，无真实机器人实验；性能提升（+13.7%累计成功）建立在与弱基线pi0.5和PrediMem对比上，未与ACT、Diffusion Policy等强基线比；无代码/数据开源，也无消融实证编码代理各模块贡献；属于有启发性的架构探索，但证据链薄弱，未触及具身智能记忆建模的核心瓶颈（如跨机体、跨用户、长期一致性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了有想法的混合记忆架构，但缺乏真实硬件验证、强基线对比和开源支持，实证深度不足，目前仅是仿真层面的初步验证。

papers.title: MemWM: Memory-Augmented Text-Based World Model
papers.abstract: World models are increasingly used to support planning in agents by predicting how environment states evolve in response to agent actions. Yet fluent next-state predictions can still omit task-critical facts, corrupt product attributes, or apply incorrect transition rules. To address such systematic prediction errors, we introduce MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model. MemWM uses world memory, a curated memory bank of transition rules, state caches, and hard-to-predict facts, to condition next-state imagination. We evaluate factual state preservation with Structured State Fidelity (SSF), which scores predicted states through benchmark-specific facts and fields. Compared with SFT, memory-augmented training improves SSF by up to 206.3%. In the full planning setting, we keep the policy model frozen and provide policy-side world skill: retrieved task-level skills and step-wise corrective guidance for action selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, memory-augmented agents improve downstream success over an SFT-trained world-model agent, with up to a 65.4% relative gain. Sensitivity analyses further show that retrieved memory improves task success and efficiency under different memory and action-budget settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MemWM，一个用外部记忆库（存有状态缓存、转移规则和难预测事实）来增强文本世界模型预测准确性的方法，在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个文本环境任务中，通过检索记忆提升规划成功率，最高相对提升65.4%，但全程不涉及真实物理世界或机器人交互。
analysis.claim: 引入可检索的结构化世界记忆（world memory），能显著提升文本世界模型在事实保真度和下游任务成功率上的表现，且无需更新策略模型。
analysis.input: 文本形式的当前状态+动作指令
analysis.output: 文本形式的下一状态描述
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属于文本世界模型的增量改进：用记忆机制缓解LLM式世界模型的事实幻觉，有定量指标SSF和多任务验证，但未突破文本模拟到具身行动的鸿沟，无开源证据，未挑战长期开放难题（如持续状态建模、跨模态闭环控制），与DreamerV3/WEAVER等真正驱动机器人决策的世界模型不在同一量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将检索增强思想迁移到文本世界模型，在限定仿真环境中提升了事实一致性，但未触及具身智能的核心挑战（状态持久性、sim2real、多机体泛化），也未提供可复现的完整系统。

papers.title: Contextual Evaluation of MicroRNA Sequencing Data Harmonization: Performance in Sample Clustering
papers.abstract: Abstract Reliable translation of microRNA sequencing data depends on effective harmonization to mitigate artifacts from variable experimental handling. Although many harmonization methods exist, prior evaluations have focused mainly on differential expression analysis, leaving the impact on subgroup discovery understudied. We present a framework for evaluating harmonization in the context of sample clustering, which integrates AI-augmented datasets, statistical evaluation pipelines, and accessible software tools, enabling systematic comparisons across diverse signal-to-artifact ratios and cluster composition settings. Using this framework, we show that harmonization can, often partially, restore clustering accuracy lost to artifacts, especially at moderate signal-to-artifact ratios, with the level of gains depending on the specific harmonization method, the paired clustering technique, and the cluster composition setting. We further confirm these findings by analyzing reconstructed cohorts from The Cancer Genome Atlas breast cancer microRNA sequencing data. Collectively, the results underscore the need for tailored harmonization to support reliable subgroup discovery and highlight the broader importance of context-specific workflows in translational genomics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个专门评估microRNA测序数据批效应校正方法在样本聚类任务中效果的框架，用模拟和真实癌症数据验证不同校正方法对发现生物学亚群（如肿瘤亚型）的实际帮助程度。
analysis.claim: microRNA测序数据的批效应校正效果不能仅靠差异表达评估，必须在样本聚类这一下游任务中进行上下文特异性评估，且校正收益高度依赖于信号-噪声比、聚类算法和亚群结构。
analysis.input: 批量microRNA测序矩阵（含批效应的人工模拟或真实TCGA数据）
analysis.output: 经校正后的表达矩阵，用于后续聚类（如k-means、HDBSCAN）并评估聚类准确性（ARI/NMI）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据；使用公开TCGA真实测序数据+人工模拟数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了聚类导向的批效应评估新视角，有系统性模拟实验+TCGA实证，但未提出新校正算法，未开源核心代码/模型，仅提供评估框架和分析流程，属于扎实的方法学评估工作，远未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM系列）的范式突破或技术通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有校正方法与聚类任务耦合评估，设计了可复现的评估协议，但无新算法、无全开源、未改变领域技术栈，是高质量的工具性工作而非突破。

papers.title: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
papers.abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling typically employ fixed-size Vision Transformer encoders that are over-provisioned for simple tasks and under-provisioned for complex ones, with significant redundancy across attention heads. We propose Successive Capacity Growth (SCG), a method that starts from a minimal encoder (1 head, 2 layers, 283K parameters) and grows incrementally in width (adding attention heads for low-level semantic capacity) or depth (adding transformer blocks for higher-order semantic abstraction), driven by a task-agnostic test-and-verify mechanism that exploits function-preserving expansion to safely trial architectural changes and roll back if they do not improve prediction loss. The Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) ensures that all learned semantic dimensions remain statistically independent and aligned with the predictive objective, preventing collapse even as the architecture grows. On a 60-dimensional multi-object dynamics task, SCG naturally triggers depth expansion, improving prediction loss by 20.3% over the fixed small baseline with 56 times greater parameter efficiency than scaling to the fixed large model; on a 2D navigation task, a single width expansion yields even an 23% improvement over the fixed large model. Across all three tested environments of increasing complexity, the adaptive encoder matches or exceeds the fixed small baseline, with zero false-positive expansions and bit-exact function preservation (ratio = 1.0, absolute difference = 0.0). The take-away is that JEPA world model encoders need not be pre-allocated at maximum capacity - they can grow successively as the task demands, achieving significant compute and data efficiency while maintaining representation quality.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种让视觉Transformer编码器在JEPA世界模型中按任务复杂度自动增宽（加注意力头）或加深（加Transformer层）的方法，从极小模型起步，通过无损函数保持的试错机制动态扩展，避免冗余，提升预测精度和参数效率。
analysis.claim: JEPA世界模型的视觉编码器不应预设最大容量，而应基于任务复杂度驱动、函数保持的安全扩张机制，实现宽度与深度的渐进式增长，从而兼顾表示质量、计算效率与数据效率。
analysis.input: 原始图像帧序列（隐含于JEPA框架下的观测输入）
analysis.output: 预测的未来隐状态嵌入（JEPA的target embedding）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅基于仿真环境生成的合成动力学/导航轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 属JEPA架构内部编码器优化的扎实增量工作：有清晰机制（SCG+SIGReg）、多任务验证（3个仿真环境）、量化收益（20.3%/23% loss下降、56×参数效率），但未突破JEPA范式本身，未接入真实感知-动作闭环，无跨域泛化验证，未开源代码/模型，且所有实验均在高度简化、低维（60D/2D）合成任务上进行，与World Models/DreamerV3/WEAVER等具备真实世界建模能力、持续学习、长程规划或机器人操作耦合的基石工作存在代际差距。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将模型缩放思想引入JEPA编码器设计，机制合理、实验可控，但仍是仿真内窄域优化，未触及世界模型的核心挑战（如长期一致性、具身因果、开放世界泛化）。

papers.title: Latent Cluster Analysis for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models are increasingly used in robotics for their ability to ground language and perception into action, yet the internal representations driving their behaviour remain poorly understood. We propose LAVLA, a framework for latent cluster analysis of VLA models, and conduct a layer-wise study of the state-of-the-art GR00T N1.5 model, with particular focus on its action decoder. To better characterise the latent space during action diffusion, we introduce a cross-attention-based embedding-weighting method that amplifies relevant features while suppressing less informative ones. Quantitative evaluation shows that weighted clustering consistently outperforms the baseline. To improve interpretability, we extract human-interpretable concepts for each cluster, linking latent representations to semantic descriptions. Our analysis shows that latent clusters progressively disentangle spatiotemporal and kinematic features, with representations becoming more refined in the middle layers and stabilising toward the output. As such, LAVLA advances the interpretability of language-driven robotic systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没做新模型或新机器人任务，而是用聚类+加权注意力方法分析现有VLA模型（GR00T N1.5）内部动作解码器的隐空间结构，试图解释它怎么把语言和视觉映射成动作，最后给出各层隐变量对应的人类可读语义概念。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的动作解码器隐空间存在可被加权聚类揭示的、随网络深度演化的语义分层结构，且中层表征最富区分性。
analysis.input: GR00T N1.5模型中间层隐状态（来自视觉-语言输入）
analysis.output: 动作解码器各层的语义聚类标签及对应人类可读概念描述
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用GR00T预训练模型的内部激活
analysis.significance_reason: 纯事后分析框架，无新模型/新任务/真实机器人验证；未提升性能，未解决VLA泛化、鲁棒或部署瓶颈；所有结论基于单个闭源模型（GR00T N1.5）的离线激活分析，缺乏跨模型/跨任务验证，远低于RT-2等基石工作（95+）所要求的范式级贡献或系统级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——本质是给已有黑箱模型贴语义标签，未提供可复现的改进路径、未验证分析结果对下游控制的实际价值，也未触及VLA领域核心挑战（如sim2real gap、长程动作规划、多机体泛化）。

papers.title: A High-Throughput Assay to Identify Specific Nascent Chain Inhibitors
papers.abstract: "Undruggable" proteins without surface-accessible binding sites pose significant challenges to target-based drug discovery. Innovative approaches are needed to tackle these proteins. One promising strategy is targeting them in their nascent chain form at the ribosome, where they have a different conformation than in the folded form. A systematic approach to screen for such compounds has however been lacking. Here, we present a high-throughput assay to identify small molecules that specifically inhibit a protein of interest in its nascent-chain form. The assay employs a human in vitro transcription/translation system and monitors expression of the protein in real time via fluorescence detection. Specific inhibitors for the nascent chain of interest can then be identified by comparison with a counter screen. The assay was optimized to maximal sensitivity and reaction costs of ~$0.01 per well, enabling large-scale screens. We validated performance with the reference compound PF846 on the nascent chain of the protein PCSK9. Feasibility for high-throughput screening was demonstrated using a library of 1,760 compounds against the oncogenic KRAS variant A146T and the protein ApoC3, with mean Z′ scores of 0.69 and 0.88, respectively. Sixteen global translation inhibitors were identified in each campaign, while no compounds met the criteria for POI-selective inhibition. The assay thus provides a robust platform for larger-scale screening campaigns.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一种低成本、高通量的体外荧光检测方法，用于筛选能特异性抑制目标蛋白在核糖体上新生链阶段（而非折叠后状态）的小分子化合物，但实际验证中未发现任何POI-selective抑制剂，仅检出全局翻译抑制剂。
analysis.claim: 提出首个可规模化应用的高通量新生链特异性抑制剂筛选平台。
analysis.input: 小分子化合物库 + 编码目标蛋白（如KRAS A146T、ApoC3、PCSK9）的DNA模板
analysis.output: 荧光信号变化率（反映新生链合成抑制程度）及POI-selective抑制剂候选列表
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（核糖体新生链靶向是真实前沿方向）， assay Z′>0.69证明稳健性，但未获得任一POI-selective hit，无机制验证、无结构表征、无细胞/动物层级验证，仅停留在‘平台建成但尚未产出有效分子’阶段；相比AlphaFold2等基石工作（解决根本性建模/预测难题并产生广泛下游影响），本文属扎实但窄口径的方法学工具开发，未突破靶向筛选领域的关键瓶颈（如脱靶、假阳性、构象特异性验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了一个成本可控、Z′达标的新生链筛选平台，但缺乏阳性案例、机制支撑和跨靶标泛化证据，目前仅为潜在可用的工具雏形，非突破。

papers.title: Model Predictive Control of Tensegrity Robots via Contact-Aware Graph Neural Dynamics Model
papers.abstract: Tensegrity robots offer lightweight, compliant mobility over challenging terrain but remain difficult to model and control due to complex contact-rich dynamics and partial observability. This work presents a model predictive path integral (MPPI) controller for a three-bar tensegrity robot driven by a learned graph neural network (GNN) dynamics model. This work first extends prior GNN-based models with a differentiable contact detection module. The extension allows the dynamics model to reason over non-horizontal planar terrains, obstacles, as well as self-collisions. Then, the learned dynamics model and the MPPI controller operate in a closed data-collection loop, iteratively improving model accuracy and control performance. This work further introduces a hybrid MPPI strategy that combines MPPI with turning motion primitives to improve maneuverability. Experiments are performed in MuJoCo across five navigation tasks, which include, wall obstacles, inclines, narrow corridors, low-clearance structures, and a composite 3D obstacle course. The experiments demonstrate that the hybrid MPPI controller operating over the learned GNN dynamics model improves predictive accuracy over a flat-ground baseline model and achieves superior navigation performance compared to $A^*$-based re-planning and MPPI-only variants. Results show that the contact-aware learned dynamics combined with the sampling-based model predictive control enable robust tensegrity navigation in complex, contact-rich environments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用带接触感知能力的图神经网络（GNN）建模张力结构机器人（tensegrity robot）的动力学，并将其嵌入模型预测控制（MPPI）框架，在MuJoCo仿真中实现了在含墙、斜坡、窄道、低矮障碍等复杂地形下的自主导航，相比基线方法有提升。
analysis.claim: 接触感知的图神经动力学模型+混合MPPI控制器，能在复杂接触-rich环境中实现张力结构机器人的鲁棒导航。
analysis.input: 当前状态（位姿、关节/杆件张力等）、目标位置、地形几何（隐式编码于GNN邻接关系与接触模块）
analysis.output: 连续动作序列（各执行器张力变化）
analysis.robot_dependency: 三杆张力结构机器人（MuJoCo仿真模型）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在张力结构机器人这一小众方向上推进了接触建模与MPPI结合的范式，但仅限单一仿真机体、五项MuJoCo任务、无真实硬件验证、无跨机体/跨地形泛化实验，且对比基线薄弱（仅A*重规划和MPPI-only），远未达到基石论文所要求的范式开创性、多任务真机鲁棒性或通用世界模型级整合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在张力结构机器人仿真控制上有明确技术改进，但封闭于单一仿真平台、缺乏实证广度与深度，属于领域内稳健但非突破性的工程整合。

papers.title: FPicker: Topology-Guided Evolution for Filament Tracing in Low-SNR Microscopy
papers.abstract: Automating filament tracing in Cryo-Electron Microscopy (Cryo-EM) is essential for 3D helical reconstruction but challenged by intersecting topologies and extremely low Signal-to-Noise Ratios ($\text{SNR} = σ_s^2/σ_n^2$ < 0.1 or -10 dB). Existing paradigms fail: pixel-wise segmenters suffer from severe topological fracturing, box-based detectors face ghost center drift, sequential trackers derail due to error accumulation, and traditional active contours collapse under artificial closed-curve constraints. To resolve these bottlenecks, we present FPicker, the first topology-guided framework reconciling these incompatibilities. It unifies perception via a center-endpoint representation and an open-curve evolution module to explicitly model non-cyclic connectivity. On simulated benchmarks, FPicker outperforms top baselines by over $40\%$ relative gain in mean spatio-angular precision (mSAP) and reduces topological gap rates by over $60\%$ under extreme noise ($-20\text{ dB}$). By learning intrinsic physical geometry rather than local texture, FPicker demonstrates strong potential as a resilient geometric backbone. Its zero-shot performance on the real-world EMPIAR dataset exhibits robust topological resistance, achieving a state-of-the-art 82.9\% mSAP upon fine-tuning. Our results also suggest modeling physical priors is a highly robust path toward bridging the sim-to-real gap in signal-starved scientific imaging. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tomzhaosky/FPicker.

analysis.tldr: 提出FPicker方法，用拓扑引导的开放曲线演化模型，在极低信噪比（-20 dB）电镜图像中精准追踪纤维状结构（如微管、肌动蛋白），解决传统分割、检测、跟踪方法因噪声和交叉拓扑导致的断裂、漂移、崩溃问题。
analysis.claim: 建模物理几何先验（而非局部纹理）的开放曲线演化框架，能从根本上缓解低信噪比下纤维追踪的拓扑断裂问题，并实现强零样本跨域鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 低信噪比冷冻电镜（Cryo-EM）二维投影图像
analysis.output: 纤维中心线的拓扑连通轨迹（带端点的开放曲线）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；使用模拟电镜数据训练，验证于真实EMPIAR数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 在信号极度匮乏的科学成像核心任务（Cryo-EM纤维追踪）上，首次系统性解耦并建模开放曲线拓扑与物理几何先验，实证效果显著（-20 dB下拓扑错误率降60%+，真实EMPIAR上达82.9% mSAP），且开源代码；但未构建通用分子几何世界模型，也未覆盖多尺度/多模态生物结构预测，故低于AlphaFold2/ESMFold等基石级工作，属扎实重磅贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将几何先验、开放曲线建模与电镜物理约束深度耦合，显著提升低SNR下生物结构解析鲁棒性，但非范式变革，亦未扩展至三维结构生成或全蛋白质空间建模。

papers.title: Optimized Wrench Polytope Analysis for Real-Time Stability Control of Legged Robots in Complex Multi-Contact Configurations
papers.abstract: Legged robots offer a variety of automation applications in real-world scenarios. But areas that are difficult to traverse, like slopes, caves, or scaffolding, still pose a great challenge for traversal. To tackle this problem, we propose an optimized algorithm for evaluating the full actuatable wrench polytope for arbitrary contact scenarios. With our improved analysis algorithm, the torques for each joint of the robot can be calculated within a control frequency of 49 Hz. The achieved speedup allows for deployment within a regular control loop for actuating robot poses for different contact scenarios. We evaluated our stability controller extensively in simulation scenarios and validated its applicability by deploying it on actual walking robot hardware. The proposed controller achieved stability in very complex scenarios that are currently not achievable by any other controller.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种快速计算多接触下腿式机器人可施加力矩多面体（wrench polytope）的优化算法，使稳定性控制能在49Hz实时运行，并在仿真和真实机器人（非开源平台）上验证了其在复杂地形（如斜坡、脚手架）下的稳定站立与行走能力。
analysis.claim: 通过优化 wrench polytope 的几何计算流程，首次实现多接触配置下全关节扭矩的实时（49Hz）解析求解，支撑了复杂非结构化地形中的闭环稳定性控制。
analysis.input: 机器人当前位姿、接触点位置与法向、关节状态、期望重心轨迹
analysis.output: 各关节实时扭矩指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四足/双足机器人硬件平台（未公开型号，文中称 'walking robot hardware'）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人本体动力学参数与接触传感器反馈，但未使用真实世界采集的训练数据（无learning component）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：改进了经典 wrench polytope 计算瓶颈，实现实时性突破（49Hz），并在真机上完成多接触复杂地形验证；但未开源代码/模型/硬件接口，未与主流基线（如QP-based WBC、whole-body MPC）做公平对比，也未证明泛化到新机体或开放环境的能力，未触及运动规划或学习层面，仍属传统优化控制框架内的工程强化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是具身智能中稳定性控制方向的重要工程推进，但受限于闭源实现与窄任务验证，尚未达到开范式或系统级突破级别。

papers.title: ME-VLM: A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
papers.abstract: Physical AI requires models to ground visual and linguistic understanding in real-world environments while accounting for environmental constraints and execution feedback. We introduce MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified vision-language model with two variants, 4B and 35B-A3B, that brings together embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities. Our work emphasizes physical perception and spatiotemporal reasoning, together with planning, interaction, and outcome assessment in both digital and physical environments. We construct training data spanning embodied and multimodal agent tasks, including execution observations and feedback to support outcome assessment and decision refinement. The training pipeline comprises embodied capability injection, separate reinforcement learning of embodied and multimodal-agent experts, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates their complementary capabilities into a single model. Experiments show competitive performance on both embodied and agent benchmarks, as well as on autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks. For edge deployment, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware-software co-optimization enable on-device inference of the 4B variant on the M100, reducing prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms. Project Page: https://machembodied.com/ME-Brain/ME-VLM.html Code Repository: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-VLM

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ME-VLM，一个统一的视觉语言模型（4B和35B-A3B两个版本），试图融合具身认知（如物理环境感知、时空推理、执行反馈）与多智能体协同能力，通过‘具身能力注入+双专家RL+多教师在线蒸馏’训练流程，在自动驾驶、具身导航等任务上刷榜，并优化了4B版在M100芯片上的边缘部署性能。
analysis.claim: 统一VLM可通过多教师在线蒸馏融合具身认知与多智能体协同能力，在数字与物理环境中实现跨任务规划、交互与结果评估。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令+执行观测与反馈（如传感器状态、动作结果）
analysis.output: 动作序列/决策策略/结果评估判断（未明确结构化输出形式，摘要中泛称‘planning, interaction, outcome assessment’）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否使用真实机器人数据；仅提‘execution observations and feedback’，但未指明来源（仿真/真机/混合），且无采集规模、机体类型、场景多样性描述
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘多教师在线蒸馏融合具身与多智能体能力’的框架概念，但无真实机器人实验验证，无跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，未公开训练数据构成与分布，benchmark结果未披露对比基线细节或消融，边缘优化仅针对4B变体且未报告任务性能保真度；整体处于‘大模型能力迁移+工程适配’阶段，远未达RT-2/π0/CHORUS等基石工作所要求的真机多任务闭环、跨 embodiment 泛化、可复现因果机制验证等硬指标。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有VLM范式向具身与协同方向做模块化拼接和边缘部署优化，但缺乏具身智能核心所需的物理闭环实证、跨 embodiment 泛化和可复现的因果能力验证。

papers.title: The Apolipoprotein E N-Terminal Bundle Rendered Membrane-Compatible by Reverse-QTY Conversion Without Loss of Fold
papers.abstract: Apolipoprotein E (ApoE) performs most of its pathologically relevant biology at lipid interfaces, yet design efforts target its receptor binding, interdomain geometry or abundance rather than the lipid affinity of its N-terminal bundle. We asked whether the reverse-QTY (rQTY) code can make that bundle membrane-compatible without disturbing its fold. Within mature residues 11-167 we converted every glutamine, threonine and tyrosine lying inside an alpha-helix (Q to L, T to V, Y to F) and left those in turns and loops unchanged: 22 substitutions over 14.0% of the segment, sparing the receptor recognition region, moving the grand average of hydropathicity from -0.757 to +0.123. Across five AlphaFold3 models per sequence the variant bundle superimposes on the native at 0.81 A mean C-alpha root-mean-square deviation with indistinguishable helix content, while apolar solvent-accessible surface rises 59% at constant total surface and burial. Hydrophobic moment increases in five of six helical segments, so amphipathicity is preserved. In all-atom molecular dynamics the native segment holds its fold in water over 100 ns; the variant stays folded and essentially fully helical in a six-component neuronal bilayer (50 ns) and a highly mobile membrane mimetic (90 ns), thinning the bilayer locally by 10.9 A. The first lipid shell is only mildly biased in composition, and the two membrane models disagree. Each system was run once with the protein embedded at the build stage, so quantifying affinity will require matched native trajectories and partitioning free-energy calculations. rQTY thus acts as a geometry-preserving, residue-resolved control on the surface chemistry of a soluble helical bundle.

analysis.tldr: 用反QTY代码（Q→L/T→V/Y→F）对载脂蛋白E（ApoE）N端结构域的α螺旋内部残基进行22处定点突变，使其疏水性显著提升、膜结合能力增强，同时严格保持原有折叠结构和二级结构，通过AlphaFold3建模和多套全原子分子动力学模拟验证了其在神经元双层膜中的稳定嵌入与局部膜薄化效应。
analysis.claim: 反QTY编码可在不破坏ApoE N端束天然折叠的前提下，精准调控其表面化学性质，实现从水溶性螺旋束到膜兼容构象的理性转化。
analysis.input: ApoE N端序列（残基11–167）及其二级结构注释（区分α螺旋/转角/环区）
analysis.output: 经rQTY改造的突变体序列、结构模型（Cα RMSD）、螺旋含量、疏水矩、溶剂可及表面积、膜嵌入稳定性与局部膜形变量化指标
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将rQTY策略系统应用于ApoE这一关键神经退行性疾病靶点的结构域改造，实证严谨（AF3多模型+双膜系MD+定量几何/物理化学指标），但仅限单一蛋白、无实验验证、无功能表型（如脂蛋白组装/受体结合保留测试）、未开源代码或数据，属扎实的机制导向计算设计工作，尚未达到‘开新范式’或‘解决长期开放难题’级别。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：计算设计逻辑严密、结构验证充分，但缺乏湿实验支撑与泛化验证，属于高质量的靶向蛋白工程方法学探索，非突破性进展。

papers.title: From Neurons to Conversation: Speech Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Speech brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to restore communication by transforming neural activity related to speech, language, or communicative intent into external outputs such as text, synthesized voice, or avatar control. Recent advances in intracortical and electrocorticographic recording, deep sequence models, and language-model-assisted decoding have enabled rapid progress, including high-performance attempted-speech decoding and increasingly naturalistic speech synthesis. Yet these achievements also reveal that speech BCIs are not simply neural-to-text decoders. They are adaptive clinical systems in which neural representations, recording hardware, decoding architectures, language priors, feedback, and user learning interact over time. Here, we synthesize speech BCI research from a system-level perspective. We first examine the neural substrates of speech and language, emphasizing their hierarchical, distributed, temporally structured, and non-stationary organization. We then examine recording and decoding choices, closed-loop adaptation, evaluation, clinical translation, and ethics. Across these domains, we highlight recurring trade-offs between signal resolution and invasiveness, low-level motor and high-level semantic targets, decoder accuracy and user agency, and language-model fluency and faithful neural evidence. We argue the next generation of speech BCIs should be evaluated not only by offline accuracy, but also by robustness across sessions, calibration burden, latency, uncertainty, usability, and safeguards against unintended decoding. By reframing speech BCIs as adaptive, user-centred systems, we outline the interdisciplinary priorities spanning speech neuroscience, neural engineering, machine learning, clinical practice, and neuroethics needed to move from proof-of-concept decoding toward reliable, expressive, and controllable communication neuroprostheses.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述性观点论文，系统梳理了语音脑机接口（speech BCI）作为临床适应性系统的多维度挑战，强调不能只看离线解码准确率，而需综合评估跨会话鲁棒性、校准负担、延迟、不确定性、可用性和安全性等真实临床指标。
analysis.claim: 语音脑机接口不应被简化为神经到文本的静态解码器，而应被重构为融合神经科学、工程、临床与伦理的自适应、以用户为中心的闭环临床系统。
analysis.input: 神经活动信号（如ECoG/iEEG）、语言先验、用户反馈
analysis.output: 文本/合成语音/虚拟人控制指令（但本文不产出具体输出，仅讨论其生成逻辑）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；依赖已发表的侵入式神经记录数据（如Braintree、UCSF等队列），但未引入新数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 全文无新模型、无新数据、无新实验验证，仅整合已有工作并提出系统性评估框架；所有主张均属合理但非首创的共识性观点（如闭环适应、权衡分析、临床可用性指标），且未提供任何实证支撑（无消融、无跨被试对比、无延迟/鲁棒性量化结果），远低于所列基石论文（全部含真机/真患者在线闭环验证+多指标SOTA+开源或临床部署）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了有价值的临床系统视角和评估维度，但全无实证支撑，属于领域内已有共识的归纳与重述，不具备方法论或技术突破性

papers.title: 30 Hz High-Definition Transcranial Alternating Current Stimulation at the Left Frontal Cortex Reduces the Spectral Slope of the EEG in the Contralateral Hemisphere
papers.abstract: Abstract Background High-definition transcranial alternating current stimulation (HD-tACS) is favored by the neurostimulation community for its precision and ability to influence neuronal dynamics. Yet, the exact mechanism by which the underlying brain structures are being affected remains unclear. We believe that the investigation of the aperiodic nature of the electroencephalograph (EEG) could shed light on the modulatory effects of HD-tACS. Methods We analyzed the EEG of 9 participants during a compensatory tracking task (CTT) in two sessions, each with different HD-tACS protocols. Every session consisted of an initial period of no stimulation, followed by 30 Hz HD-tACS in the left motor (M30) or frontal (F30) cortex. We then isolated the aperiodic component of the EEG and calculated its spectral slope ( β ). Results and Discussion β decreased during F30 mainly in the right frontal cortex, indicating a shift towards higher frequencies and an increase of the excitatory/inhibitory balance. Additionally, we found that despite the long monotonus task the accuracy of the participants did not decrease, which might be attributed to the ability of both M30 and F30 to sustain attention for prolonged time. Finally, the change of CTT accuracy during the stimulation correlated with the β of specific channels before the stimulation. This indicates the potential of β to be used as a screening biomarker in future studies. In conclusion, we showed the ability of HD-tACS to alter EEG’s aperiodic dynamics and paved the way for future exploration of such dynamics in the field. Highlights The EEG’s spectral slope, mainly in the right frontal cortex, decreased after 30 Hz HD-tACS at the left frontal cortex. Task accuracy remained unchanged after 30 Hz HD-tACS in both left frontal and motor cortex. The change of task accuracy during 30 Hz HD-tACS in the left frontal and motor cortex correlated with the EEG’s spectral slope at specific channels.

analysis.tldr: 用30Hz高精度经颅交流电刺激左侧额叶，发现对侧（右侧）额叶脑电的非周期性谱斜率β下降，提示神经兴奋/抑制平衡升高，且该变化与任务表现稳定性相关，提出β可能作为个体化刺激响应的预测生物标志物。
analysis.claim: 30 Hz HD-tACS作用于左侧额叶可特异性降低对侧额叶EEG非周期性谱斜率β，该变化反映皮层兴奋性动态调节，并与持续注意维持能力相关，β值具有作为预刺激筛选生物标志物的潜力。
analysis.input: EEG信号（64导联）+ HD-tACS刺激参数（30 Hz, 左侧F3/M3）+ 补偿追踪任务行为数据
analysis.output: 非周期性谱斜率β值（per-channel）、CTT任务准确率变化量、β与行为变化的相关性
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实人类被试EEG+行为数据（n=9），无机器人/仿真器数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属机制探索型小样本人体实验（n=9），仅验证单一频率（30Hz）在单一脑区（左额）刺激对非周期性EEG指标的跨半球效应，无解码/闭环控制/临床干预等实质性功能输出；未开源代码/数据，未提供刺激-响应建模或个体化预测验证；相比基石工作（如92+分的BCI语音合成、脊髓接口行走），既无新范式、也无临床级性能突破或长期稳定性证据，仅为脑电生物物理机制的窄域补充。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：是扎实但高度受限的机制观察研究，样本小、无功能闭环、无开源、无跨被试泛化，尚未触及BCI核心目标（意图解码/功能替代/临床修复），当前阶段对领域推进有限。

papers.title: DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning
papers.abstract: Interactive world simulators can provide scalable environments for robot planning, policy training, and evaluation by predicting action consequences while reducing reliance on repeated physical rollouts. To serve these applications, they must generate future image sequences that respond faithfully to robot actions and preserve the dynamics of robot-object interactions over long horizons. However, existing world models typically predict the entire next latent state and often fail to capture subtle changes induced by robot actions. Such omissions can produce physically implausible outcomes, including object interpenetration and excessive deformation. To address this limitation, we propose DeltaWorld, a physically consistent interactive world simulator for robotic manipulation. Our method introduces the Delta Latent Transition Model (Delta-LTM), which predicts action-induced latent feature changes and adds them to the current latent state to obtain the next state, rather than predicting the next latent state directly. To mitigate object interpenetration and excessive deformation in predicted future frames, Interaction-aware Latent Alignment is introduced to construct counterfactual interaction regions and supervise interaction-related latent changes. DeltaWorld is evaluated on the IWS manipulation benchmark and a self-collected cross-robot dataset covering multiple robot embodiments and manipulation tasks. On the cross-robot dataset, DeltaWorld reduces FVD by 46.6% and LPIPS by 31.1% relative to the IWS baseline. These results highlight the potential of DeltaWorld for long-horizon action-conditioned video prediction in robotic manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出DeltaWorld，一种通过预测动作引起的潜在特征变化（而非直接预测下一状态）来提升机器人操作视频预测物理一致性的世界模型，重点缓解物体穿透和过度形变问题，在跨机器人数据集上显著降低FVD和LPIPS指标。
analysis.claim: 用动作条件化的潜在增量学习（Delta-LTM）替代全状态预测，并引入交互感知的潜在对齐机制，可显著提升长时程动作条件视频预测的物理合理性。
analysis.input: 当前图像帧的潜在表示 + 机器人动作指令
analysis.output: 未来多帧图像的潜在表示序列（经解码后为像素级视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的交互视频数据（IWS基准+自建跨机器人仿真数据集），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有启发性（增量式latent transition + interaction-aware alignment），但仅在仿真环境验证，无真实机器人实验、无消融分析细节、未开源代码/模型，指标提升局限于FVD/LPIPS两类感知质量指标，未验证下游任务（如规划或控制）增益；相比WEAVER（94.5）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，缺乏状态持久性建模、闭环策略集成、跨域泛化实证或系统级部署证据，属扎实但窄域的仿真建模改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真世界模型中针对性优化动作响应的物理一致性，但缺乏真实验证、开源和下游任务闭环，尚未达到领域基石工作的系统性与影响力。

papers.title: PPARγ brakes cytosolic DNA-induced macrophage inflammation by super-enhancer metabolic reprogramming
papers.abstract: Abstract Cytoplasmic DNA sensing triggers intense innate immune responses that require tight regulation. PPARγ is a master metabolic regulator in macrophages, but its role in cytoplasmic DNA immunity remains unclear. Using poly(dA:dT) to mimic cytoplasmic DNA stimulation, we combined transcriptomics, epigenomics (PPARγ/H3K27ac ChIP-seq), and functional assays. Poly(dA:dT) induced a cytokine storm with MAPK activation and apoptosis/necrosis. PPARγ activation by rosiglitazone (RGZ) antagonized this response, reducing cell death and transcriptionally inhibiting MAPK genes (e.g., DUSP4/10). Mechanistically, PPARγ bound promoters/enhancers via PPRE motifs and distal intergenic regions, remodeling H3K27ac (reduced at inflammatory loci, increased at metabolic genes). RGZ induced de novo super-enhancers coupling PPAR metabolic programs (e.g., CPT2) with immune suppression by targeting TLR4, CEBPB, and PIM3. Thus, PPARγ acts as a brake in cytoplasmic DNA immunity, integrating metabolic reprogramming and inflammation suppression through a multi-level genomic/epigenetic program. This study highlights PPARγ as a key immune-metabolic integrator and therapeutic target for diseases driven by excessive cytoplasmic DNA sensing.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现PPARγ蛋白能通过重塑超级增强子的表观遗传图谱，将巨噬细胞的代谢程序（如脂肪酸氧化）与炎症抑制耦合起来，从而在胞质DNA刺激下‘踩刹车’，缓解过度免疫反应。
analysis.claim: PPARγ通过在远端非编码区建立新超级增强子，协同重编程代谢基因（如CPT2）和免疫抑制靶点（TLR4/CEBPB/PIM3），实现对胞质DNA诱导炎症的多层级表观-代谢整合抑制。
analysis.input: poly(dA:dT)模拟的胞质DNA刺激 + PPARγ激动剂罗格列酮处理的巨噬细胞
analysis.output: 转录组变化、H3K27ac修饰图谱、PPARγ结合位点、功能表型（细胞死亡率、MAPK通路活性、细胞因子分泌）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，使用体外培养的免疫细胞系（如RAW264.7或原代小鼠BMDM）
analysis.significance_reason: 机制扎实（ChIP-seq+RNA-seq+功能验证+药理干预），首次揭示PPARγ通过de novo超级增强子耦合代谢与免疫抑制的新范式，但属分子免疫学内的重要增量，未突破领域范式、未解决长期开放难题（如cGAS-STING耐受机制）、未提供通用技术工具或跨疾病普适性干预策略，显著弱于AlphaFold2等基石工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：机制清晰、多组学交叉验证充分，但限于特定通路和细胞类型，尚未升维为可迁移的技术范式或治疗平台。

papers.title: HorizonNav: Geometry-Guided Video Diffusion for Anticipatory 3D Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: We present HorizonNav, a video diffusion-based framework for anticipatory robot navigation that transforms a single RGB image and a text prompt into a geometrically aligned representation of plausible surrounding 3D space. Given the initial observation and a textual description of the reconstruction objective, a vision-language model, guided by designed instructions, interprets the scene and constructs structured prompts for a video diffusion model. The resulting video sequence provides plausible future observations of the environment, which are subsequently processed using monocular ORB-SLAM3 for camera pose estimation and Video Depth Anything for dense depth prediction. Our central contribution is a geometry-guided depth alignment stage that combines the estimated camera poses with triangulated visual landmarks to constrain dense depth predictions across multiple views. This alignment improves the geometric consistency of the reconstructed 3D environment, addressing inconsistencies that temporal coherence of the generated video alone cannot resolve. The experimental evaluation of navigation in imagined 3D environment shows that across a 19-scene horizon study, planning-feasible scenes increase from 13/19 at P20 to 15/19 at P81, while successful RRT trials increase from 62/90 to 75/90. In a separate corridor study, 6 of 25 evaluable generated-camera trajectories violate the reconstructed collision constraints; RRT planner recovers feasible alternatives in 5 of those 6 cases. A larger archive contains 58 usable reconstructions from 67 attempted cases, of which 36 support a downstream plan and 22 do not, exposing reconstruction and free-space failure modes rather than hiding them without lidar. Across 15 corridor reconstructions, the mean reconstruction error is approximately 0.30 m at matched structural landmarks.

analysis.tldr: 用单张RGB图+文本指令生成一段模拟机器人前进时看到的未来视频，再用SLAM和深度估计把这段视频‘几何对齐’成一致的3D环境，最后在生成的3D空间里做路径规划（RRT），验证其能否避开碰撞并生成可行轨迹。
analysis.org: 俄罗斯Skolkovo科学技术研究院（Skoltech）
analysis.claim: 通过几何引导的视频扩散建模与多视角深度对齐，可从单帧RGB+文本生成具备几何一致性的3D环境表征，支撑下游无激光雷达的纯视觉导航规划。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像+文本指令（如重建目标描述）
analysis.output: 几何对齐后的稠密深度图序列与相机位姿，进而导出可用于RRT规划的3D自由空间表示
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据，仅用公开SLAM/depth模型（ORB-SLAM3、Depth Anything）处理生成视频
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将视频扩散+几何对齐用于纯视觉3D环境想象导航，但未开源代码/模型，实验规模小（19场景+25走廊）、无真实机器人部署、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证，RRT成功率提升有限（62→75/90），且30cm平均重建误差远超实用阈值（<5cm才适配精密导航），未撼动世界模型或具身导航范式。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把现有VLM、视频扩散、SLAM、深度估计模块串起来做了几何一致性增强，有明确技术链路但无底层创新，也未解决纯视觉导航的核心可靠性问题。

papers.title: Aging effects on retrospective and naturalistic encoding of time and their relationship with memory.
papers.abstract: In everyday life, attention is not explicitly directed toward time. Yet, we can reconstruct how long an experience lasted from the memory traces it left behind, a process intertwined with episodic memory and subjective experience. As both memory and temporal processing change with advancing age, investigating aging effects could provide critical insights on these reconstructive processes. In this study, 31 younger (aged 24±3) and 36 older (aged 69±6) healthy adults completed two EEG sessions: 1) a resting-state recording followed by an unexpected retrospective time estimation, and 2) a video-based prospective duration estimation task where participants encoded and judged the duration of 50 naturalistic videos (2-32s) varying in eventfulness. Using a cycle-by-cycle burst analysis of alpha (α: 8-12 Hz), we examined oscillatory correlates of both retrospective temporal judgement and prospective temporal processing. Behaviorally, both groups reconstructed short intervals similarly, but older adults produced longer prospective duration estimates than younger adults for longer video clips (16-32s), particularly under low-eventfulness. Regression analyses also showed that individual differences in older adults' prospective duration judgments were influenced by both their retrospective time estimation and episodic memory abilities, especially for longer videos. At the neural level, resting-state α-burst dynamics were higher in older adults and predicted, with α-power, longer retrospective estimates in older adults. Additionally, resting-state α-burst activity predicted α-burst during video encoding in both groups. Together, these findings reveal that individual α-power and α-burst dynamics could constitute memory-based time-tracking mechanism that aging reshapes in ways that manifest behaviorally under naturalistic conditions.

analysis.tldr: 研究健康老年人和年轻人如何在自然观看视频时估计时间长度，发现老年人对较长、事件少的视频会高估时长，这种偏差与他们静息态脑电α波爆发活动增强有关，且该神经特征同时预测了回溯式时间估计和记忆能力。
analysis.claim: 静息态α波爆发动力学是一种基于记忆的时间追踪机制，其年龄相关改变导致老年人在自然情境下对长时程、低事件性刺激产生系统性时间高估。

analysis.output: 时间估计偏差值、α波爆发参数（频率/持续时间/振幅）、回归模型中记忆与时间判断的耦合强度

papers.title: Evolutionary genomics based on PacBio HiFi long-read sequencing data reveals the importance of structural variants in shaping population-specific differences between Chinese and Indian rhesus macaques ( Macaca mulatta )
papers.abstract: Rhesus macaques ( Macaca mulatta ) are the most widely used non-human primate model for translational research relevant to human health and disease. Although several genetically distinct populations have been recognized across the species' extensive habitat range in Asia, the majority of biomedical studies in the United States and abroad focuses on individuals of either Chinese or Indian descent. Notably, phenotypic differences exist between these two populations which can influence biomedical research outcomes; however, the genetic basis and molecular mechanisms underlying these differences are generally not well understood. Based on novel PacBio HiFi long-read sequencing data from 20 rhesus macaques — ten of Chinese origin and ten of Indian origin — we here characterize the genome-wide landscape of structural variation in these two biomedically-relevant populations. Our results highlight differences in the structural variant landscape affecting genes involved in neural communication and signaling pathways, in line with the known differences in temperament between the two populations. Furthermore, while the majority of discovered structural variants were located in intergenic and non-coding regions of the genome, 15 of the discovered population-specific structural variants were predicted to exhibit a high functional effect on genes associated with human disease, indicating that they may play an important role in shaping the differences in disease susceptibility between the populations. Taken together, by providing detailed insights into population-specific structural variation, this genomic resource will aid the design and interpretation of future studies aiming to link genotype, phenotype, and fitness in the context of human health and disease, and facilitate broader comparative analyses of structural variation as a force shaping genome evolution across primates.

analysis.tldr: 用PacBio HiFi长读长测序分析20只恒河猴（中印各10只），系统鉴定群体特异性结构变异（SV），发现影响神经功能和人类疾病相关基因的SV，解释中印恒河猴表型与疾病易感性差异的遗传基础。
analysis.claim: 中印恒河猴群体间的关键表型与疾病易感性差异主要由功能性强的结构变异（而非SNP）驱动，尤其富集于神经信号通路和人类疾病基因。
analysis.input: PacBio HiFi长读长全基因组测序数据（20个个体）
analysis.output: 群体特异性结构变异图谱（含注释、功能预测、富集分析）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖高质量长读长测序数据，但无需真实机器人/实验平台交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量种群基因组学增量工作：首次在恒河猴中系统构建HiFi级SV图谱并关联表型/疾病，但未提出新算法、未开源核心流程代码、未建立可复用分析框架；其价值限于特定非人灵长类模型，对AI/具身智能/机器人领域零贡献，且远低于AlphaFold2/ESM等计算生物学基石（无通用模型、无跨物种泛化架构、无方法论范式突破）。
