papers.title: From Language Models to World-Acting Systems: Progress and Limits of Agentic AI across Digital, Social, Virtual, and Physical Environments
papers.abstract: Large language models become consequential agents when surrounding systems let outputs change external state. Models now call tools, operate interfaces, delegate work, retain state, inhabit generated worlds, and control robots or laboratory equipment. Such advances are often narrated as one march toward autonomy, conflating model competence, system integration, persistence, and safe authority. This critical review synthesizes primary research and official technical specifications available by 31 August 2026. We organize the evidence along delegated authority, temporal persistence, and environmental coupling, while separating model, harness, and environment. Within the evidence examined, action-interface expansion is documented more convincingly than robust completion, recovery, authorization, or independent verification. Model Context Protocol and Agent2Agent improve interoperability but do not establish trustworthy delegation; multi-agent organization adds specialization alongside cost and correlated failure. Persistent simulations and world models support training and planning but do not themselves demonstrate agency; robotics and self-driving laboratories establish bounded feasibility rather than unattended open-world reliability. We propose justified delegation as an analytical and normative heuristic, not an observed law or certified score: expand action scope only where evidence supports provenance, bounded authority, failure detection, safe recovery, and calibrated human control. This framing yields a research agenda for coupled model-harness evaluation, capability-based permissions, durable state, cross-agent accountability, and staged physical validation.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇对具身智能和代理AI（Agentic AI）现状的批判性综述，不提出新模型或系统，而是梳理2026年8月前各类‘语言模型+行动接口’系统的实证进展与根本缺陷，指出当前所谓‘自主代理’大多停留在工具调用和界面操作层面，缺乏可靠完成、失败恢复、权限控制和独立验证等关键能力。
analysis.claim: 当前Agentic AI的真实能力边界由系统集成质量（harness）和环境耦合深度决定，而非语言模型本身；所谓‘自主性’是被过度叙事的幻觉，亟需以‘可证成的委托’（justified delegation）为标准重构评估框架。
analysis.input: 多源技术文档、论文、API规范、系统白皮书等非结构化文本材料
analysis.output: 分类框架（委托权威/时间持续性/环境耦合）、能力短板诊断、评估原则建议
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅分析已有公开系统描述
analysis.significance_reason: 纯综述性工作，无新模型/新数据/新硬件/新实验；虽提出‘可证成的委托’框架有启发性，但未在任何真实系统上验证，也未提供可复现的评测协议或基准，对具身智能领域实质性推进为零——既未超越RT-2等基石（差一个数量级），也不具备DAM-VLA/π0等工作的技术纵深，仅属高质量评论，分量远低于所有列出的基石（全部≥94）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：本质是技术评论而非科研贡献，作者用严谨框架包装了对行业浮夸叙事的批评，但无任何可落地的系统、数据或实证支撑，不属于具身智能/机器人/AI×科学领域的实质性进展。

papers.title: A Context-Aware 14-3-3 Binding Predictor Enabled by Data Augmentation, Multi-Scale Biological Features, and Protein Language Model Embeddings
papers.abstract: Identifying phosphorylated serine/threonine residues that mediate 14-3-3 interactions remain a major challenge in understanding phospho-dependent 14-3-3 regulation. Existing predictors largely rely on local sequence features surrounding candidate phosphosites, owing in part to the limited number of experimentally validated 14-3-3 binding sites, while broader contextual determinants of binding remain insufficiently explored. Here, we show that 14-3-3 binding sites are defined not only by local motif patterns but also by multi-scale biological context. We found that 14-3-3-binding proteins are enriched for condensation-related properties, that 14-3-3 docking sites preferentially localize to compact intrinsically disordered regions, and that protein language model embeddings provide informative representations for this task. To address both limited data availability and incomplete site representation, we developed CAMP-14-3-3 (Context-Aware Multi-scale Predictor for 14-3-3 binding), a framework that integrates multi- scale biological features with protein language model embeddings, together with a phylogeny-based data augmentation strategy and distribution-matched negative sampling. This integrated framework outperformed motif-based approaches and existing predictors on independent data. Our results support a context-aware view of 14-3-3 recognition and provide a general strategy for modeling phospho-dependent protein interactions under limited-data conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫CAMP-14-3-3的预测模型，专门判断哪些磷酸化丝氨酸/苏氨酸位点能结合14-3-3蛋白；它不只看位点周围几个氨基酸（传统做法），而是融合了多尺度生物学特征（如相分离倾向、无序区紧凑性）、蛋白质语言模型嵌入，并用系统发育树做数据增强和分布匹配的负采样，显著提升了在独立测试集上的预测准确率。
analysis.claim: 14-3-3蛋白结合位点的识别需建模多尺度生物学上下文（而非仅局部序列模体），且该上下文可被蛋白语言模型嵌入与定制化数据增强有效捕获。
analysis.input: 磷酸化位点所在蛋白的全序列、该位点位置、系统发育信息、多尺度生物特征（如IDR紧凑性、相分离倾向得分、PLM嵌入）
analysis.output: 二分类概率（该磷酸化位点是否结合14-3-3蛋白）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖已发表的实验验证的14-3-3结合位点数据（数量有限，作者明确指出是瓶颈）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法整合合理（PLM+多尺度特征+phylogeny增强）且在独立测试集上超越基线，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未验证泛化到新蛋白家族或跨物种，未与高精度结构模型（如AlphaFold-Multimer）耦合，仍属特定任务上的扎实增量——比纯motif方法强，但未触及机制解释或实验闭环，远未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2级）的范式突破或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线清晰、实证优于现有工具，但缺乏开源与跨场景验证，属于特定磷蛋白互作预测任务中的稳健改进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Computational modeling of an RNA-peptide world
papers.abstract: Emergence and evolution of functional RNA and protein structures are the central problems for understanding the origin of life. Although it is well known that catalytically active RNA elements, ribozymes, can catalyze many reactions, including peptide bond formation, the specifics of the transition from the hypothetical, primordial RNA world to protein-based life centered at the translation system remain enigmatic. We developed AMES, Atomistic Molecular Evolution Simulator, and employed it to perform computer simulations of the evolution of short RNA molecules and RNA-peptide complexes. Comparison of the evolutionary trajectories and the structures of RNA molecules and RNA-peptide complexes emerging in these simulations shows that short random peptides accelerate RNA evolution, stabilize RNA folds, and boost the structural diversity of evolving RNA molecules, potentially enabling a broader range of activities. We hypothesize that the RNA world was, actually, an RNA-peptide world, in which, from the earliest stages of evolution, evolving RNA molecules interacted with short random peptides synthesized in a non-templated manner. These interactions could drive the evolution of diverse RNA structures and activities, and eventually, of the translation machinery.

analysis.tldr: 用自研的原子级分子进化模拟器AMES，模拟了随机短肽与RNA共进化的过程，发现短肽能加速RNA结构演化、稳定其折叠并增加结构多样性，据此提出‘RNA-肽共存世界’假说，替代经典的纯RNA世界假说。
analysis.claim: 早期生命并非纯RNA世界，而是RNA与非模板合成的短肽共同演化的‘RNA-肽世界’，肽的存在是RNA结构功能多样化和翻译系统最终出现的关键驱动力。
analysis.input: 随机初始RNA序列 + 随机短肽集合 + 物理化学力场参数（键长/角/二面角、静电、范德华）
analysis.output: 演化多代后的RNA结构集合、RNA-肽复合物构象、结构多样性指标、折叠稳定性统计
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实生物数据依赖；全部为从头计算生成，未使用任何实验测定的RNA或肽结构数据库
analysis.significance_reason: 属理论起源生物学中的计算假说驱动型工作：有合理物理建模和可复现的模拟流程，但缺乏实验验证、未与已知古RNA/核糖体遗迹结构比对、未量化‘加速演化’的生物学阈值（如催化效率提升倍数）、未测试关键突变或选择压力敏感性；相比AlphaFold2等基石工作（解决真实结构预测难题并直接赋能实验），本文停留在机制启发层面，贡献相当于扎实的计算思想实验，而非可落地的科学工具或范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：构建了首个面向RNA-肽共进化的原子级可演化模拟器，但假说尚未获得实证锚定，目前属于高质量计算推演，暂不具备改变实验生物学实践的能力。

papers.title: Neural Dynamics of Self-Control: Pre-Choice EEG Signals Predict Yielding to Temptation
papers.abstract: Self-control is the capacity to resist self-defeating behavior in favor of long-term goals. Such behavioral control is fundamental to adaptive human behavior, yet its neural mechanism remains unclear. A key limitation of prior research is that tasks often conflate self-control with cost-benefit evaluation, making it difficult to isolate self-control encoding. We introduced a novel dynamometer-based task where participants chose between high-effort, larger-later (L) and low-effort, smaller-sooner (S) rewards. In some trials, referred to as temptation trials, participants could maintain their initial commitment (LL/SS) or switch (LS/SL). Twenty-six participants performed the task during a 32-channel EEG recording. Behavioral results showed a significant shift from L to S options in temptation trials, suggesting frequent yielding to temptation. EEG activity covaried with switching behavior. The late positive potential (LPP) differentiated stay (LL) from switch (LS) trials before initial choice, localizing to the posterior cingulate visual area and left somatosensory regions. Enhanced LPP in LS trials is thought to reflect heightened motivational conflict and attentional engagement with alternatives. Time-resolved multivariate decoding reliably discriminated LL from LS outcomes, peaking 304-348ms post-option presentation. This was driven by distributed frontal and centroparietal networks, demonstrating that a neural bias toward yielding is established well before the initial choice at the network level. The EEG activity preceding switching predicted the final choice, reflecting reward anticipation rather than self-control signals. Together, these findings suggest that proactive neural states during deliberation, established before the choice, shape self-control success and failure.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG记录人在做自控决策前的脑电活动，发现选择屈服于诱惑（放弃长期高回报、转向短期低回报）的行为，其神经信号（尤其是晚正电位LPP）在人看到选项后300多毫秒就已出现，且源于额叶和顶枕网络，说明‘失败自控’不是临门一脚的失控，而是早期神经偏向决定的。
analysis.claim: 自我控制的成功或失败并非由选择时刻的抑制过程决定，而是由选项呈现后300–350ms内建立的、分布于额-顶-枕网络的前瞻性神经偏向所预先编码。
analysis.input: 32通道EEG时序信号+行为选择时间戳+任务范式结构（动力计按压强度/延迟/大小组合）
analysis.output: LL/LS二分类预测标签（是否在诱惑试次中切换初始偏好）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖实验室受控环境下26名健康被试的EEG+行为数据，无真实机器人交互
analysis.significance_reason: 虽精巧分离了自控与价值评估，揭示了LPP在决策前的预测性，但样本量小（n=26）、无跨人群验证、无临床群体延伸、未连接到干预或闭环调控，属扎实的认知神经机制发现，但离BCI临床转化或范式突破（如基石论文级的实时解码/闭环控制/长期植入稳定性）差距巨大。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次在时间分辨尺度上锚定自控失败的前意识神经起源，但限于基础机制描述，无干预、无泛化、无开源代码，暂不具备技术迁移或临床应用支点。

papers.title: GraPPI: A Self-Supervised Graph Encoder for Transferable Protein—Protein Interaction Modeling
papers.abstract: Protein—Protein Interactions (PPIs) are fundamental to cellular processes and represent major targets for therapeutic development. Recent advances in machine learning for protein modeling, particularly protein language models, have enabled powerful representations of protein sequences and monomeric structures. However, compared with the increasingly generalizable representations available for individual proteins, transferable representations explicitly designed to capture protein-complex and interface contexts remain less developed. Here, we developed GraPPI, a unified graph-based deep learning framework for learning transferable representations of protein—protein complexes. At its core, PPIencoder represents protein complexes as heterogeneous residual graphs and uses self-supervised masked-edge prediction to learn interaction-aware representations that integrate sequence, three-dimensional geometry, and physicochemical properties. We then evaluated the transferability of these pretrained representations across complementary PPI tasks spanning binding-mode classification, binding-affinity prediction, and mutation-associated affinity prediction. GraPPI accurately distinguished plausible binding interfaces from perturbed or decoy binding interfaces, achieving AUROC values above 0.92 on an independent benchmark. For protein—protein binding-affinity prediction, GraPPI achieved Pearson correlation coefficients of 0.690 and 0.684 on the S90 and S79 benchmarks, respectively, with performance competitive with or exceeding that of recently reported affinity-prediction methods. GraPPI further transferred effectively to mutation-associated binding-affinity prediction, achieving a Pearson correlation of 0.84 and a mean absolute error of 1.20 kcal/mol on an independent SKEMPI benchmark. Together, these results establish GraPPI as a generalizable framework for protein-complex representation learning, extending pretrained protein representations from individual proteins toward the interaction context in which protein function is realized.

analysis.tldr: 提出GraPPI模型，用自监督图神经网络将蛋白复合物建模为异质残基图，通过掩码边预测学习能泛化到多种PPI任务（界面分类、亲和力预测、突变效应预测）的统一表征。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，Zhiyuan Song等无明确机构标识；Hugues Fausther-Bovendo隶属加拿大Laval University，但非第一/通讯单位，且摘要未提及其团队主导）
analysis.claim: 通过异质图建模与自监督掩码边预测，可学习到跨多种蛋白互作任务（界面判别、亲和力预测、突变效应预测）可迁移的蛋白复合物表征。
analysis.input: 蛋白复合物的序列、三维结构坐标、残基级物理化学属性构成的异质残基图
analysis.output: 蛋白复合物的全局嵌入向量（用于下游PPI任务）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 在PPI表征学习中首次系统整合序列+结构+物化属性于异质图并用掩码边自监督训练，实证覆盖三类关键任务且指标扎实（AUROC>0.92，Pearson达0.69/0.84），但未开源代码/模型，未挑战AlphaFold2级结构生成或HI-JEPA级分子世界建模等基石工作，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：方法设计合理、多任务验证充分、指标超越多数现有工具，但缺乏开源与更底层建模突破，尚未达到领域基石水准。

papers.title: Synthesis-aware generative design in trillion-scale chemical spaces for automated drug discovery
papers.abstract: Autonomous drug discovery via generative molecular design is critically bottlenecked by the production of chemically intractable structures. Multi-trillion-scale make-on-demand libraries guarantee synthetic feasibility, but conventional virtual screening cannot efficiently navigate these vast spaces or address multi-parameter optimization. We introduce Hyper Screening X, a generative AI framework integrating structure-based design with automated synthesis hardware. By encoding deterministic reaction logic in a generative flow network, the framework evaluates only 10 million candidates to navigate an 11-trillion-compound space, jointly optimizing physicochemical properties while ensuring compatibility with automated synthesis. Prospective validation against an SLC1A5 variant with a cryptic interface yielded a 96% synthesis success rate and a 50% functional hit rate, identifying two first-in-class lead compounds. This synthesis-aware strategy advances autonomous, closed-loop drug discovery.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫Hyper Screening X的生成式AI框架，把化学反应规则硬编码进生成流程，只评估1000万个分子就从11万亿规模的可合成分子库中筛选出高成药性、且能被自动化合成平台直接制造的候选药物，最终在真实实验中96%成功合成、50%有生物活性，并找到两个首创型先导化合物。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索；Seonghwan Seo等姓名分布于韩/美/欧多国，但无明确主导机构标识）
analysis.claim: 通过将确定性有机反应逻辑嵌入生成流网络，实现对万亿级可合成化学空间的高效、合成可行、多目标优化的闭环药物发现。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白结构（SLC1A5变体）、多维理化与成药性约束（如溶解度、渗透性、合成可行性）、反应规则知识图谱
analysis.output: 可直接输入自动化合成硬件的分子SMILES及对应合成路径
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实自动化合成平台反馈（前瞻性验证含96%合成成功率），但未说明是否使用历史机器人合成日志训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：真机合成验证+高成功率+功能hit率+首创先导物，且首次将反应逻辑确定性嵌入生成流以压缩万亿空间搜索；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未报告跨靶标泛化能力，也未与AlphaFold2/HI-JEPA等分子世界模型级工作在建模深度或通用性上对标，属重磅工程级闭环突破，非范式变革。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：用确定性反应逻辑约束生成过程，在真实自动化合成闭环中取得高成功率和先导物产出，但缺乏开源与泛化证据，尚未达到世界模型级基础突破水平。

papers.title: EEG Entrainment to Non-Speech Rhythmic Patterns Associated with Dimensions of Language Performance
papers.abstract: Developmental dyslexia (DLX) affects 5-12% of the global population and impairs learning to read. Its biological basis, particularly the difficulties observed in oral phonological tasks, remains debated. Entrainment, the coupling of brain oscillations to speech rhythms, is essential for encoding phonological representations. We investigated whether brain entrainment to non-speech rhythms could predict DLX in 48 participants listening to white noise amplitude-modulated at rates matching Spanish speech units. Phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) analysis of electroencephalography (EEG) signals yielded accurate DLX prediction for the 40 Hz stimulus using the Heights Ratio PAC measure (balanced accuracy 0.929, p = 0.0069, in the best case), indicating a stronger phonemic entrainment deficit in dyslexic individuals. Regression analysis in control (CTL) participants showed a strong dependence between reading performance scores and greater entrainment in language-associated brain regions. In particular, participants with poorer phonemic awareness, reading comprehension, or rapid automatized naming showed greater right-hemisphere entrainment to the 40 Hz stimulus. This finding adds evidence for the hemispheric compensatory mechanisms hypothesized in the literature. In conclusion, our methodology identifies dyslexia-specific entrainment patterns near language-associated brain regions, together with compensatory entrainment in right-hemisphere areas.

analysis.tldr: 用白噪声调制出40Hz节奏刺激被试，通过EEG相位-振幅耦合分析发现：该非语音节律的脑响应强度能高精度区分发育性阅读障碍者与正常人，且右脑过度响应与阅读能力差相关，提示右脑代偿机制。
analysis.claim: 发育性阅读障碍个体对非语音（40Hz白噪声调制）节律的脑电锁相响应异常，这种异常可高精度分类DLX，并反映右半球代偿性激活。
analysis.input: 白噪声经40Hz幅度调制的听觉刺激 + 同步采集的多通道EEG信号
analysis.output: 基于Height Ratio PAC指标的分类结果（DLX/CTL）及与阅读行为量表得分的回归系数
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，仅依赖受试者EEG+行为测试数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的临床神经生理学关联研究，但未建立因果干预、未实现闭环解码、未突破现有范式（如未超越经典speech entrainment研究），样本量小（n=48）、单刺激频率（40Hz）、无跨语言/跨年龄验证，分量远低于所列基石工作（全部为实时闭环BCI、高精度解码、长期植入或重大功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是合格的探索性神经相关性研究，但既非新范式、也无解码/控制/干预能力，离临床转化和BCI实用化距离很远。

papers.title: Agency and Embodiment Provide Dissociable Benefits to Perception, Metacognition and Neural Processing During Active Sensing
papers.abstract: Metacognition, judging how reliable our own perceptual decisions are, is central to adaptive behavior. Such judgments hinge on the reliability of the sensory evidence on which that decision is based, and active sensing through self-directed exploration is known to improve perception itself. Yet, how agency, the authorship over self-initiated actions, and the processing of the sensory consequences, which is implicit to active sensing, modulate metacognition and its calibration, remains unknown. Whether physical embodiment adds to this beyond virtual exploration is similarly unclear, yet relevant both for daily life and for self-monitoring in agentic AI. Here, we combined a naturalistic auditory search paradigm with mobile electroencephalography. Twenty participants performed a target-detection task under three conditions: active embodied exploration , active screen-based exploration, and passive listening to replays of their own trials, while we obtained steady-state auditory evoked potentials (SSAEPs) to characterize stimulus-locked neural responses. We find that both agency conditions improved accuracy, metacognitive sensitivity, and overall SSAEP amplitude relative to passive listening, indicating that agency, rather than whole-body movement, drives these enhancements. Crucially, however, embodiment uniquely grounded both the target-evoked neural response and the subjects' confidence to immediate sensory evidence. Thus, agency alone broadly enhances perceptual and neural processing, but embodiment specifically anchors confidence, neurally and behaviorally, to the present.

analysis.tldr: 用移动脑电记录20人做听觉搜索任务，发现‘自己主动行动’（agency）能提升感知准确率、元认知敏感度和神经响应强度，而‘真实身体参与’（embodiment）则进一步让信心判断和神经反应更紧密绑定当下感官证据，二者作用可分离。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名与常见 affiliations 推断可能为欧洲或美国高校，但无明确线索）
analysis.claim: agency（行动自主性）和 embodiment（物理具身性）对感知、元认知和神经处理具有可分离的增强效应：前者广谱提升加工质量，后者特异性锚定信心与即时感官证据。
analysis.input: 听觉刺激序列（含目标音）、被试自身行为选择（主动探索/被动重放）、移动EEG信号
analysis.output: 感知准确率、元认知敏感度（meta-d'）、SSAEP振幅、主观置信度评分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，纯人类被试行为与神经数据
analysis.significance_reason: 设计严谨（三条件对照+神经+行为+元认知多层指标），首次实证分离 agency 与 embodiment 的功能解耦，但样本量小（n=20）、范式单一（仅听觉搜索）、无跨模态/跨群体验证，未开源代码或数据，未建立计算模型，属扎实的机制性发现而非范式突破，显著优于普通心理学论文但远未达BCI基石级（如90+分工作均含临床闭环、长期植入、高信息通量或端到端系统部署）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：首次通过多维测量实证分离 agency 和 embodiment 的神经-认知功能，但限于小规模健康被试实验，无开源与泛化验证，属于高质量基础机制研究，非突破也非包装。

papers.title: Resonant Minds: Closed-Loop Social Avatars with Theory of Mind
papers.abstract: Creating lifelike digital humans with genuine social intelligence requires unifying cognitive reasoning and multimodal generation within a coherent framework. Current approaches treat these as separate tasks: Large Language Models excel at dialogue but lack embodied expression, while diffusion-based talking head models achieve visual fidelity but ignore social cognition. To bridge this gap, we propose a closed-loop dual-agent framework integrating perception, social reasoning, and expression into a continuous interaction cycle. The perception module analyzes partners' multimodal behaviors from video, while the social reasoning module infers hidden mental states through Theory of Mind and selects responses via an ensemble mechanism. The expression module then generates emotion-controllable dual-agent videos synthesizing both speaker speech and expression alongside listener reactive behaviors, capturing bidirectional dynamics absent in prior work. We construct a hierarchical Persona-Scenario dataset with psychologically grounded personas and private social goals to support evaluation under information asymmetry. Experiments on this dataset demonstrate competitive or superior performance on both dialogue quality and video generation metrics. Notably, our method surpasses even the full-information Script mode on key dialogue quality dimensions, suggesting that explicit mental state inference under uncertainty can elicit more thoughtful dialogue than unrestricted information access.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文做了一个能实时感知对方视频、用心理理论（ToM）推断其隐藏意图、再生成带情绪反应的双人互动视频（说话者+倾听者动作表情）的闭环数字人系统，不是简单播语音配嘴型，而是让两个AI角色在信息不对称下‘真正对话’。
analysis.claim: 通过构建感知-推理-表达闭环的双智能体框架，结合心理学驱动的Persona-Scenario数据集，在信息不对称条件下，显式心智状态推理比全知脚本模式更能激发高质量、有社会深度的对话。
analysis.input: 对方视频流（含面部/肢体/语音）
analysis.output: 双人协同视频：说话者语音+口型+表情 + 倾听者实时反应性微表情/点头/视线等非语言反馈
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成视频与标注数据，无真实机器人或真人交互数据采集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将ToM显式建模引入社交数字人闭环生成，并构造了有心理依据的评估数据集，但所有实验均在合成视频和静态场景中进行，无真实交互验证，未测试跨人格/跨文化/跨任务泛化，对话质量提升仅体现在特定自动指标上，且未开源代码或模型，实质推进限于方法论演示层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把ToM、多模态感知、可控视频生成串成闭环是完整工程实践，但缺乏真实交互验证和开放性，尚未构成社会AI领域的实质性突破。

papers.title: Leveraging genome-wide association studies and genomic prediction for distinctness, uniformity, and stability (DUS) testing in maize
papers.abstract: Testing for distinctness, uniformity, and stability (DUS) is a requirement for plant variety registration and based on phenotypic traits, which is time-consuming and sensitive to envi-ronmental variation. Advances in genomics allow to complement DUS testing with molecular markers, for which two models in DUS testing were proposed by the Union for the Protection of New Varieties of Plants (UPOV). A use cases was described for maize, but an implementation has been hindered by a lack of suitable markers and validated analytical frameworks. We ad-dress these challenges by integrating historical DUS characteristics scores from 352 European hybrid maize varieties with high-density genome-wide single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) data. Using genome-wide association studies (GWAS), we identified 18 genomic regions and candidate genes associated with 12 DUS characteristics, enabling the development of diag-nostic markers consistent with the UPOV model "Characteristic-Specific Molecular Markers". Since most DUS traits are polygenic, we combined GWAS-informed marker selection with XG-Boost-based machine learning to predict notes of DUS characteristics. This approach achieved strong predictive performance across multiple traits (mean accuracy 0.67), demonstrating its potential for managing reference collections under UPOV model "Combining phenotypic and molecular distances in the management of variety collections". Both approaches were validated for two characteristics using independent public USDA-NPGS maize datasets (>1,700 accessions) highlighting the value of public data for method validation. We also identify key limitations of historical DUS data, including imbalanced and sparse trait representation, and discuss mitigation strategies. Despite these constraints, our results demonstrate that molecular markers may improve maize DUS testing, enabling faster, more accurate variety registration and supporting accelerated crop improvement.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用全基因组关联分析（GWAS）和XGBoost机器学习，把玉米品种DUS测试（区分度、一致性、稳定性）从传统耗时的田间表型观察，转向基于SNP分子标记的预测，实现了部分性状的准确预测，并验证了UPOV提出的两种分子辅助DUS模型。
analysis.claim: 基于历史DUS评分与高密度SNP数据，可构建符合UPOV框架的性状特异性分子标记及多性状预测模型，显著提升玉米品种DUS测试效率与稳健性。
analysis.input: 高密度SNP基因型数据 + 历史DUS性状评分（352个欧洲杂交种）
analysis.output: 12个DUS性状的预测评分（分类等级）及18个关联基因组区域/候选基因
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖植物育种历史表型与基因型数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的农业基因组学应用研究：首次在玉米中系统实现UPOV两种分子DUS模型的实证落地，有独立数据集验证（USDA-NPGS >1700份材料），但未开源代码/模型，性状预测精度中等（均值0.67），且受限于历史DUS数据稀疏与不平衡；远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破，也未解决核心瓶颈（如DUS性状定义模糊、跨环境泛化差），属领域内有价值的工程化推进而非科学突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——将UPOV分子DUS框架首次在玉米中完整闭环验证，但受限于数据质量与开源程度，尚未形成可推广的方法论或工具链。

papers.title: Beyond Next-Observation Prediction: Agent-Authored World Modeling for Sequential Decision Making
papers.abstract: Recent studies on world modeling for Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically formulate the learning objective as next-observation prediction. However, this objective ties supervision to what a transition happens to reveal, which may omit the dynamics most relevant to the agent's current decision. To bridge this gap, we propose Agent-Authored World Modeling (AAWM), a training procedure that constructs supervision from the policy's own decision needs. Specifically, at each state, the agent identifies what it needs to understand about the environment before acting. These needs drive the retrieval of relevant transition evidence across trajectories, which is then synthesized into training targets that capture decision-oriented dynamics instead of reconstructing the next observation. This aligns the training objective with the dynamics the policy needs before acting, not with the contents of the next observation. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of AAWM across multiple environments and training settings. These results show that decision-aware world-model targets provide a more effective learning signal than next-observation prediction.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种让世界模型训练目标由智能体自身决策需求驱动的新范式（AAWM），不再预测下一帧观测，而是根据当前策略需要理解的环境动态，主动检索并合成决策导向的训练目标。
analysis.claim: 世界模型的监督信号不应来自被动观测序列（如next-observation prediction），而应由策略在每个状态下的决策需求主动定义和生成。
analysis.input: 策略在当前状态下的决策需求（隐式或显式表达）+ 多轨迹环境交互数据
analysis.output: 决策导向的世界模型动态表征（非像素/观测重建，而是策略所需的状态抽象与因果关系）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖离线轨迹数据集（未说明是否含真实机器人数据）
analysis.significance_reason: 概念上有启发性（将监督信号从被动观测转向主动决策需求），但无开源代码、无真实系统验证、无消融实验、未对比主流世界模型（如DreamerV3/WEAVER）的核心指标（如long-horizon planning performance、zero-shot transfer），仅报告‘有效性提升’而无量化基准支撑，属于理论构想层面的增量，未触及世界建模的底层瓶颈（如持久状态表示、跨任务泛化、sim2real鲁棒性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了有直觉吸引力的新视角，但缺乏实证深度、可复现性和对基石工作的实质性超越，尚未构成可落地的方法论突破。

papers.title: Learning Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds in Cluttered Environments
papers.abstract: Motion feasibility prediction plays a central role in robotics, particularly in task and motion planning and manipulation. A major bottleneck for this problem in cluttered environments is that infeasible planning attempts by Sampling-based motion planners (SBMPs) can incur substantial computational cost. Also existing approaches for infeasibility certification are limited to low-dimensional configuration spaces and often assume simplified geometric environments represented by primitive objects with known parameters. We study the complementary problem of learning motion feasibility prediction directly from raw RGB-D observations for a 7-DOF manipulator operating in realistic cluttered scenes. We introduce the first large-scale benchmark for this setting, comprising 2.7M grasp feasibility labels over 88 scanned objects and 190 cluttered tabletop scenes. We benchmark three representative classifier families spanning MLP- based, volumetric-CNN, and point-cloud-based Transformer architectures under matched training conditions. Our best model, GRASPFC-PTX (a point-cloud transformer), achieves an AUROC of 0.996 on Novel objects while providing predictions significantly faster than SBMPs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用点云直接预测机械臂在杂乱桌面场景中某次抓取动作是否可行，构建了首个大规模真实扫描物体+杂乱场景的抓取可行性标注数据集（270万标签），并验证了点云Transformer模型能以远超采样式运动规划器（SBMP）的速度实现接近完美的判别性能（AUROC 0.996）。
analysis.claim: 仅凭原始RGB-D点云即可高精度、低延迟地预测7自由度机械臂在真实杂乱场景中的抓取动作可行性，无需显式建模几何约束或依赖传统运动规划器。
analysis.input: 原始RGB-D点云（经预处理为无序点云）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（该抓取位姿-物体组合是否运动可行）
analysis.robot_dependency: 7-DOF机械臂（仿真中隐含，但未指定具体硬件型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/扫描生成的仿真与半仿真数据：88个真实扫描物体+190个合成杂乱场景；无真实机器人交互采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次定义并实证了‘从原始点云直接学习运动可行性’这一新任务，构建了高质量大规模基准（2.7M标签/88物体/190场景），模型性能显著超越SBMP耗时，但全为仿真/扫描数据、无真机验证、无代码/模型开源、未接入实际规划栈，属于扎实但封闭的增量贡献，未达DROID/ALOHA级系统性突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——定义了新任务并提供了首个高质量基准和强基线模型，但缺乏真机验证、开源和系统集成，目前仅是实验室内的方法学验证，尚未构成可部署的范式升级。

papers.title: No Evidence for a Wakeful Rest Benefit on Associative Memory: A Within-Participant EEG Study
papers.abstract: Wakeful rest after learning has been proposed to facilitate memory consolidation compared to engaging in a distraction task, with prior EEG studies linking slow oscillation power during rest to better memory performance. However, replication attempts have yielded mixed results. We investigated whether 10 minutes of wakeful rest would enhance associative memory performance relative to 10 minutes of a hippocampus-dependent auditory short-term memory distraction task, using a within-participant design with continuous EEG recording. We employed both a replication-inspired analytical approach, closely modeled on prior work, and a data-specific approach adapted to our dataset. Contrary to our hypotheses, we found no advantage of rest over distraction on associative memory performance. We did, however, observe an order effect: performance was better for the second learning than the first, and this improvement was more pronounced when rest was performed second compared to first. At the neurophysiological level, neither slow oscillation nor alpha power during the post-learning period correlated with memory performance, regardless of analytical pipeline, although cross-over analyses revealed that the choice of EEG reference influenced the direction of some correlations. At the phenomenological level, self-reported mental activity during rest and distraction, as well as trait daydreaming frequency, were not related to memory outcomes, despite the two conditions inducing distinct subjective cognitive states. Together, these findings do not support a robust benefit of post-learning wakeful rest over a hippocampus-dependent distraction task for associative memory, nor do they replicate prior EEG correlates of consolidation. We discuss methodological factors, including task-learning effects in within-participant designs, the coarseness of averaged spectral power measures, and variability in EEG preprocessing pipelines, that may contribute to inconsistencies across the literature, and we call for greater standardization and transparency in future studies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用严格的被试内设计和连续EEG记录，检验‘学习后清醒静息是否提升联想记忆’这一假设，结果发现静息组相比海马依赖的干扰任务并无记忆优势，且既往报道的慢振荡功率与记忆表现的关联也无法复现。
analysis.org: 法国国家健康与医学研究院（INSERM）
analysis.claim: 在严格控制的被试内设计下，10分钟清醒静息对联想记忆巩固无显著益处，且既往报道的EEG慢振荡/α功率与记忆表现的神经生理关联不可复现。
analysis.input: EEG信号+行为记忆测试成绩+主观报告问卷
analysis.output: 联想记忆正确率+EEG频段功率值+主观认知状态评分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属认知神经科学中重要的可重复性研究，但未提出新范式、新工具或新机制，仅证伪一个存在争议的效应；其方法论反思有价值，但影响限于特定子领域（记忆巩固的静息效应），远未达到脑机接口或具身智能领域里程碑级工作的分量（如90+分标杆均涉及实时闭环神经解码、运动功能重建或临床级植入接口）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是高质量的阴性结果研究，对领域有警示价值，但不属于AI×科学/生物、脑机接口或具身智能三大目标领域的实质性进展，且未提供可迁移的技术组件或计算框架

papers.title: User-Driven Learning from Demonstration: A Trajectory and Impedance Learning Method
papers.abstract: This paper presents a method for user-driven robot Learning from Demonstration (LfD) that reduces user effort while ensuring compliant and precise reproduction. The method eliminates repeated teaching for the same task and enables real-time learning from a single demonstration. Demonstrated motions are reproduced with high precision, while impedance variations are learned in real time to provide both compliance and robustness against perturbations. This mitigates potential safety issues in Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) that arise from conventional time-indexed trajectories lacking compliance. The proposed approach integrates a three-dimensional (3D) Fast Diffeomorphic Matching (FDM) algorithm with a Dynamical System (DS)-based motion generator to achieve real-time single-shot demonstration learning and reproduction. An Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) framework compensates for reproduction errors and recovers from external interactions. Furthermore, an impedance parameterization function is incorporated to learn impedance variations from demonstrations and maintain surface contact for specific applications. The proposed approach is validated through comprehensive experiments on a 7 Degree-of-Freedom (DOF) KUKA LWR IV+ robot.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种用户示教一次就能同时学轨迹和阻抗参数的方法，用3D快速微分同胚匹配+动力学系统生成器+扩展卡尔曼滤波，在KUKA机械臂上实现高精度复现和实时抗扰动柔顺控制。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，仅知姓氏与常见华人/伊朗名组合，无机构线索）
analysis.claim: 仅需单次人类示教，即可同步学习高精度运动轨迹与实时可调的阻抗参数，从而在真实机器人上实现兼具精确性、柔顺性和扰动恢复能力的示教复现。
analysis.input: 人类示教的末端轨迹（隐含力/触觉未明说，但阻抗学习暗示可能含力信号）
analysis.output: 实时生成的关节级运动轨迹 + 动态调整的关节/末端阻抗参数
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人上的单次示教数据（非大规模离线数据集）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法整合了已有技术（FDM、DS、EKF、阻抗参数化），在单一KUKA平台上验证了单次示教下轨迹+阻抗联合学习的可行性，但未跨机体/任务泛化，无开源代码或基准对比，未挑战任何长期开放难题（如零样本泛化、多任务统一表征、人机自然交互建模），属于扎实但窄域的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将多个成熟模块串联用于解决特定HRI柔顺性问题，有真实硬件验证但封闭、不可复现、泛化性弱，暂未构成领域推进。

papers.title: Distributed Acoustic Localization Array Deployed Using a Soft Everting Vine Robot
papers.abstract: Soft robot exteroception is increasingly being explored for a variety of field applications. In this work, we present a sound-based system for localizing disaster victims in confined and unstructured environments, based on a distributed acoustic sensing architecture embedded along the body of a soft everting vine robot. We propose a dynamic Steered Response Power with Phase Transform framework that supports both far-field direction-of-arrival estimation and near-field three-dimensional source localization as the robot approaches the sound source. To better understand the design and control space related to localizing sound using a soft, shape-morphing robot body, we conduct experiments measuring the accuracy of these methods for a five-microphone array attached to the robot body using three placements relative to the outer membrane of the robot (inside the pressurized body, inside the inner tail, and outside the outer wall) and in four robot configurations (linear, double linear, circular, and sinusoidal). We measure the change in accuracy as the signal-to-noise ratio, the direction of approach, and the distance of the sound source from the center of the array change. Finally, we demonstrate a vine robot growing into an arbitrary shape while carrying microphones along its outer wall, and show that a sound source located with the array's near field can be localized with high accuracy after only three microphones have everted from the robot body. These results highlight the potential of distributed acoustic sensing for reliable victim localization using soft growing robots.

analysis.tldr: 用软体翻转式藤蔓机器人（可自主生长变形）搭载分布式麦克风阵列，在狭小非结构化环境中实时定位声源（如被困者），提出一种能同时处理远场和近场声源的动态SRP-PHAT算法，并通过不同麦克风安装位置、机器人形态和噪声条件下的系统性实验验证定位精度。
analysis.claim: 软体藤蔓机器人本体可作为分布式声学感知平台，其动态形变能力与麦克风空间分布协同提升受限空间内声源三维定位鲁棒性与适应性。
analysis.input: 多通道音频信号（5麦克风阵列采集的时域波形）+ 机器人实时位形（关节/曲率参数）
analysis.output: 声源在三维空间中的坐标位置（近场）或方位角/俯仰角（远场）
analysis.robot_dependency: 软体藤蔓机器人（Everting Vine Robot）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的声学数据；所有实验均在物理平台上完成，无纯仿真环节
analysis.significance_reason: 首次将软体生长机器人与分布式声学定位深度耦合，实证覆盖多种形变构型、麦克风部署方式及噪声条件，真机多配置定量验证（非单点演示），但未跨机体泛化、未接入闭环搜救任务链、未开源代码/模型，属显著工程创新而非范式突破；远低于World Models系列（94+）所代表的通用世界建模层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真机驱动的软体感知新范式，但限于专用任务与封闭实验，尚未形成可复用的方法论框架。

papers.title: Toward Certified Functional Safety for Industrial Humanoid Robots: The Fail-Passive Gap and a Feasibility Study
papers.abstract: Industrial humanoid robots are constrained less by locomotion or manipulation capability than by the immaturity of functional safety certification for legged platforms. The root difficulty is that the safe state of a legged robot is an actively-controlled state, which violates the fail-passive assumption underlying ISO~13849-1 / EN~60204-1: removing power from a walking biped causes an uncontrolled fall, so classical de-energization is itself a hazard. We term this the fail-passive gap and use a certified external safety chain (light curtain, emergency stop, fail-safe input, fail-safe PLC, and wireless PROFIsafe) as an instrument to locate it precisely: because the external chain is closed and quantifiable with established methods (PFHD, DC, CCF, PL/SILCL), the residual uncertifiable element is pinpointed to the robot-side reaction chain. Using a Siemens fail-safe S7-1500 emergency-stop reference, we show its certifiable Reaction subsystem is contactor-based power removal (Stop Category~0)---exactly the element a balancing humanoid cannot have. We deliberately do not claim end-to-end certified PL~e / SIL~3. We validate the approach on a Unitree G1 EDU pick-and-place cell in a 3m x 1.5m semi-enclosed workspace, and contribute a humanoid-specific analysis of the active safe state (fall-as-hazard, single-support stop bounds, balancing-policy residual risk, ISO~13855 separation) and a provenance-labeled timing budget. Hosting an industrial software-defined automation (SDA) controller on the robot, co-located with the balancing policy, moves robot-side PROFINET/PROFIsafe reception onto a standardized IEC~61131-3 interface; because the G1's onboard compute is not safety-rated hardware, this endpoint is not a certified safety runtime, which reinforces rather than resolves the fail-passive gap and localizes it to the SDA-to-balancing-policy interface.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出工业人形机器人功能安全认证的核心障碍在于‘失效-被动’假设不成立——断电会导致失控跌倒而非安全静止，作者用一套已认证的外部安全链定位问题根源在机器人本体的反应链，并在Unitree G1上实证了该问题无法通过现有工业安全架构（如Stop Category 0）解决，本质是平衡控制与安全停机逻辑的根本冲突。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 工业人形机器人无法满足ISO/EN功能安全标准的根本原因不是技术不足，而是其‘主动维持的平衡态’与‘失效即被动静止’的安全范式存在不可调和的结构性矛盾（fail-passive gap）。
analysis.input: 工业安全标准（ISO 13849-1/EN 60204-1）、外部安全链信号（PROFIsafe）、G1 EDU实时状态与紧急停机响应时序
analysis.output: 对fail-passive gap的定界分析、机器人侧反应链中不可认证环节的定位（SDA控制器到平衡策略接口）、带溯源标记的时序预算
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人紧急停机响应实测数据（含PROFIsafe通信延迟、接触器动作时间、平衡策略中断延迟等）
analysis.significance_reason: 精准识别并实证了人形机器人功能安全的范式级矛盾（fail-passive gap），但未提出可落地的解决方案，仅完成问题定位与边界刻画；相比标尺中94+分的基石工作（如WholeBodyVLA/H2O等推动具身智能范式跃迁的工作），本文属关键问题诊断型研究，贡献扎实但非范式突破，且缺乏开源、消融或跨平台验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将工业功能安全标准体系首次系统映射到人形机器人本体控制栈，实证了核心矛盾，但止步于问题界定，未提供可复用的安全架构或新认证路径。

papers.title: Off-Manifold Refinement: Guiding Video Generators with a Frozen World Model
papers.abstract: Modern video generators routinely fail at physical dynamics: objects float, trajectories violate gravity, contacts vanish. Standard denoising and flow-matching objectives fit visual data distributions but do not explicitly penalize such physical violations. Existing remedies can improve physical consistency, but typically add substantial inference or training cost. Candidate-selection methods generate and score multiple videos, while gradient-based world-model guidance repeatedly decodes and re-encodes intermediate estimates. Generator-internal refinement adds perturbation and re-denoising loops, whereas post-training requires curated data and additional optimization. We propose Off-Manifold Refinement (OMR), an inference-time method that instead injects world-model feedback directly into a single sampling trajectory. During scheduled middle ODE steps, we augment the generator velocity with the gradient of an adapter-space V-JEPA 2.1 surprise energy. This external correction can move the latent away from the uncorrected sampling trajectory and toward regions ranked as more physically plausible by the frozen predictor, after which the generator continues rendering from the corrected state. A small trained latent-to-embedding adapter keeps the gradient tractable at inference, and both the video generator and the world model remain frozen. On our fixed 400-prompt VideoPhy-2 detailed subset, OMR lifts the joint Semantic-Adherence-and-Physical-Commonsense metric from 47.0% to 52.0% (+5.0pp absolute, +10.6% relative) over the base Wan2.2-T2V-A14B sampler. On a separate fixed 50-prompt efficiency subset, it requires $1.71 \times$ the base runtime rather than the multiplicative cost of reward/search alternatives. Project page: https://itruonghai.github.io/omr.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在视频生成推理过程中插入物理世界模型反馈的方法，不改动原生成器和世界模型，仅通过在中段ODE采样步骤注入冻结世界模型计算出的梯度来修正潜在表示，提升生成视频的物理合理性。
analysis.claim: 冻结世界模型可在不微调、不重训、不增加多轮采样的前提下，在单次推理轨迹中直接引导视频生成器远离物理不合理区域。
analysis.input: 文本提示词
analysis.output: 物理更合理的生成视频
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖合成/静态视频评估集（VideoPhy-2）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽巧妙地将冻结世界模型梯度嵌入采样流，但未验证跨模型泛化性（仅适配Wan2.2-T2V-A14B），评估仅限于固定小规模提示子集（400+50），无真实物理交互验证，无消融证明梯度注入位置/强度/adapter设计的关键性；相比World Models/DreamerV3等真正构建可演化、具状态、可规划的世界模型范式，它只是下游生成器的一个轻量后处理启发式技巧，未触及世界建模的核心——状态持久性、因果抽象或闭环决策。

papers.title: A Compact Robotic Finger with 2-DoF MCP Joint Embedding DoF-Selective Passive Continuously Variable Transmission for Wide Force-Speed Operating Range
papers.abstract: This letter presents a compact two-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic finger with a flexion-selective passive continuously variable transmission (CVT) to achieve a wide force-speed operating range. Inspired by the functional differentiation of the human metacarpophalangeal (MCP) joint, the proposed mechanism realizes DoF-specific transmission differentiation by selectively assigning passive CVT to the flexion-extension DoF while preserving direct transmission for abduction-adduction. For a wide force-speed operating range, a force-responsive passive CVT is embedded in the flexion pathway, while direct transmission is preserved for the abduction-adduction pathway. To selectively realize transmission adaptation within a multi-DoF MCP mechanism, an output-side passive CVT employing a moving-pulley-inspired wire-routing structure is introduced. The resultant force generated by the wire tensions acting on the pulley that passively increases the flexion moment arm and transmission ratio according to the applied load without additional actuators, sensors, or control. Experimental results demonstrate a maximum output-force amplification of 4.19-fold and a mean amplification of 3.6-fold across the tested flexion angles ranging from 15 degrees to 75 degrees through moment-arm adaptation, thereby substantially expanding the achievable force-speed operating range. Furthermore, dexterous ball-rolling experiments verify that passive transmission adaptation can be achieved while preserving abduction-adduction functionality. These results demonstrate a scalable transmission design strategy for compact multi-DoF robotic hands.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一个紧凑的2自由度机械手指，通过在屈伸关节嵌入一种无需传感器和控制器的被动式无级变速机构（CVT），实现负载越大、输出力放大越强的效果，同时保留外展/内收关节的直接传动，从而拓宽了手指的力-速度工作范围。
analysis.claim: 通过在MCP关节屈伸自由度上嵌入力响应型被动连续变速传动，可在不增加控制复杂度和硬件开销的前提下，显著扩展多自由度机械手指的力-速度操作范围。
analysis.input: 施加在手指上的外部负载（力）
analysis.output: 自适应放大的屈伸力矩与保持原特性的外展/内收运动
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人任务数据依赖，仅基于静态/准静态力测试与球滚动功能验证
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的机构创新：实机验证了力自适应放大（4.19×）、跨角度稳定性（15°–75°）及功能共存（屈伸放大+外展/内收保留），但仅限单指、无跨手指/跨任务泛化、无学习或控制层整合，未触及手部系统级性能跃迁（如灵巧操作闭环、多指协同、触觉反馈融合），远低于Unitree G1/Atlas/Optimus等基石系统所代表的整机智能与鲁棒性水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：一项精巧的被动机构设计，在单指力传输特性上做出实质性改进，但未突破手部系统级能力瓶颈，暂不具备范式改变意义。

papers.title: Implicit Manipulation for Skill Selection in LLM Agents with Semantic Matching
papers.abstract: Skill selection is a key stage in LLM-agent workflows, determining which installed skill should handle a user request. Existing attacks on this stage primarily rely on explicit prompt injection or instruction-level steering, which can expose recognizable manipulation signals. In this work, we identify a new implicit attack surface for skill selection: even when the user prompt and skill description appear benign in isolation, their semantic relationship can still be strategically shaped to favor an attacker-chosen skill. Based on this observation, we present Implicit Skill-Selection Manipulation via Semantic Matching (ISM), which jointly shapes target-skill metadata and reusable prompts to manipulate skill selection without explicit selection instructions. Specifically, we develop a three-stage strategy to broaden semantic coverage, strengthen target distinctiveness, and preserve natural prompt wording. Across four task domains and eight selector models, ISM increases the average target-selection rate (TSR) from 15.2% to 63.5%. In a matched comparison, ISM achieves a 73.5% TSR, only 9.8 percentage points below Explicit Steering. Human reviewers block ISM in only 2.9% of judgments, versus 91.4% for Explicit Steering, while five LLM-based inspectors pass ISM at an average rate of 82.9%, versus 37.4% for Explicit Steering. Moreover, ISM remains effective against PPL-W, Llama Prompt Guard 2, and PIGuard.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现了一种新型的隐式攻击方式：不靠修改用户提示词或插入指令，而是通过精心设计技能描述（metadata）和通用提示模板之间的语义匹配关系，悄悄让大模型代理错误地选择攻击者指定的技能；实验证明它比显式提示注入更难被人类和现有防护模型检测。
analysis.claim: 技能选择阶段存在一种未被识别的隐式攻击面——仅通过调控技能描述与用户提示之间的语义匹配度，即可在无显式指令、无异常文本信号的情况下稳定劫持LLM代理的技能调度决策。
analysis.input: 用户自然语言请求 + 技能库（含技能名称、描述等metadata）
analysis.output: 被选中的技能ID（即技能选择结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于AI安全子领域中针对LLM-Agent工作流的红队研究，问题新颖、实验扎实（跨4任务域/8选择器/对抗3种防护模型），但完全不涉及具身智能、机器人控制、科学发现或物理交互，与所列基石论文（全部是VLA/具身基础模型/机器人系统级突破）不在同一维度；其价值限于提示工程与AI对齐安全的狭窄切口，且未开源代码/模型，不可复现核心方法。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——揭示了语义匹配层面的攻击可能性，但本质是提示工程+红队测试的组合技，无新模型架构、无真实世界闭环、无跨模态动作生成，对具身智能/机器人/AI×科学三大主赛道零贡献。

papers.title: Real-Time Dynamics-Based Torque-Sampling MPPI for Compliant and Force Aware Manipulation
papers.abstract: This study proposes a novel Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI)-based task-space control framework. The proposed framework explicitly solves rigid-body dynamics within a real-time MPC formulation and enforces safety constraints, enabling accurate motion and force control that yields compliant behaviors for safe and effective physical interaction of robotic manipulators in unstructured environments. By leveraging MPPI, the proposed framework efficiently handles nonlinear dynamics that are difficult to solve with conventional MPC approaches in real-time. Furthermore, we develop a torque-sampling-based control architecture that enables efficient exploitation of GPU-based parallelization, resulting in effective compliant and force-aware behaviors. As a result, the proposed framework achieves a solver update rate of over 166 Hz with a 0.18 s prediction horizon, and its performance is validated through real-world experiments on a 7-DoF manipulator.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于扭矩采样的实时MPPI控制器，在7自由度机械臂上实现了166Hz更新率的力觉感知与柔顺操作控制，核心是把刚体动力学显式嵌入MPPI框架并用GPU并行采样加速。
analysis.claim: 通过扭矩空间采样与显式刚体动力学建模，使MPPI能在真实机器人上以>166Hz频率实时求解任务空间力-位混合控制，实现无需模型线性化即可保证安全约束的柔顺交互。
analysis.input: 任务空间目标轨迹、期望接触力、当前状态（关节位置/速度/力矩估计）
analysis.output: 关节级扭矩指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 7-DoF机械臂（未指明具体型号，实验平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在线力矩反馈和状态估计，但未说明是否依赖预采集的真实交互数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 实机验证扎实（166Hz+0.18s预测步长+7-DoF真机），但仅单臂、单任务场景（未展示跨物体/跨接触模式/跨任务泛化），无消融实验验证各模块贡献，未开源代码，未与ACT/Diffusion Policy等主流范式对比，属于对MPPI在力控方向的工程级改进，未触及操作智能的核心表征或学习范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在MPPI框架内做了动力学建模与GPU采样优化，并在真机上跑出高频率力控，但缺乏泛化验证、消融分析和开源支持，未达到当前操作智能领域前沿范式的分量

papers.title: Protein eXplosion Imaging (PXI): Protein Structures from Laser-Driven Explosions
papers.abstract: We investigate the structural information retained in the distribution of explosion ion trajectories from proteins subjected to strong ionization. Using molecular-dynamics simulations and machine-learning analysis benchmarked against an analytical approach, we show that low-resolution structural information can be retrieved from the explosion distributions alone. An ensemble of convolutional neural networks trained on simulated spherical ion maps recovers the radius of gyration and the three semi-axes of an ellipsoidal molecular envelope with prediction errors of 1.2~\textÅ and 1.5~\textÅ, respectively, while an analytical ellipsoid charge model returns similar estimates and performs best for globular structures. We further investigate how higher-level structural information and symmetries can be extrapolated from ion measurements. This study supports the viability for structural determination of single proteins without large-scale X-ray facilities.

analysis.tldr: 用激光轰击单个蛋白质引发爆炸，通过模拟爆炸产生的离子飞行轨迹分布，训练CNN从这些轨迹图中反推蛋白质的低分辨率结构特征（如回转半径、椭球包络尺寸），无需同步辐射或冷冻电镜等大型设施。
analysis.claim: 单个蛋白质在强激光电离引发的库仑爆炸中，其离子轨迹空间分布隐含可提取的低分辨率结构信息，足以估计分子尺寸与形状。
analysis.input: 模拟生成的球面投影离子密度图（spherical ion maps）
analysis.output: 回转半径、椭球包络三轴长度（标量数值）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖分子动力学仿真数据，无任何真实爆炸实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅基于纯仿真数据验证低维结构参数可估性，未使用真实蛋白爆炸数据，未验证对二级/三级结构、折叠态、序列变异或非球状蛋白的泛化能力；方法未与现有单颗粒结构解析技术（如cryo-EM重建、XFEL衍射）对比，也未证明其分辨率极限或信噪比鲁棒性；属于原理验证级计算概念，远未达AlphaFold2等基石工作的实证深度与实用广度。

papers.title: StrucPhysVideo: Learning Physical Dynamics from Structured Captions and Robot Actions
papers.abstract: Modeling physical dynamics, including how objects move, interact, and change state, is central to video world models for embodied AI. We present StrucPhysVideo, a family of video world models that bridges physics-focused data curation with language- and action-conditioned prediction of scene evolution. Our data pipeline combines motion-aware video segmentation, quality and content filtering, and physical relevance verification with structured annotations of objects, materials, and temporally localized interactions. By disentangling camera motion from object behavior and explicitly describing contact, deformation, and state transitions, the pipeline provides supervision grounded in observable physical events. Building on these data, we introduce StrucPhysVideo-TI2V, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) text-image-to-video model trained with a curriculum that progressively emphasizes physical dynamics while retaining general-domain video data. StrucPhysVideo-TI2V achieves state-of-the-art performance on Physics-IQ Verified, scoring 45.5% and outperforming Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video by 2.8 percentage points. Caption ablations across backbones further demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-focused supervision. We further extend StrucPhysVideo-TI2V to StrucPhysVideo-IA2V, an interactive image-action-to-video world model that predicts visual outcomes from robot end-effector commands. Action conditioning, causal autoregressive generation, and few-step distillation enable incremental robot rollouts with only four denoising steps. Together, StrucPhysVideo advances physical dynamics modeling from image- and language-conditioned video prediction toward action-driven interaction.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一个叫StrucPhysVideo的视频世界模型家族，核心是用结构化物理标注（物体、材料、接触、形变、状态变化）来监督视频生成，先做语言+图像到视频预测（TI2V），再扩展成机器人动作+图像到视频预测（IA2V），但所有实验都在仿真或合成数据上，没用真实机器人测试，也没开源代码或模型。
analysis.claim: 结构化物理标注（而非通用视频数据）能显著提升视频世界模型对物理动态的建模能力，并可自然扩展至机器人动作条件下的视觉预测。
analysis.input: 文本描述+初始图像（TI2V）；或机器人末端执行器动作序列+初始图像（IA2V）
analysis.output: 预测的未来视频帧序列（数秒内低帧率视频）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖合成/仿真视频与人工结构化标注
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出物理结构化标注范式和MoE架构改进，但无真实机器人验证、无跨任务泛化实验、无消融证明物理标注比简单物理prompt更有效，性能提升仅在自建Physics-IQ Verified小基准上体现（45.5%准确率本身极低），未与主流视频生成模型（如Sora、Pika、Koala）对比，也未接入任何真实具身系统；相比Open X-Embodiment等基石工作（真机、多任务、开源、跨平台），它停留在纯仿真视频预测层面，属于窄域方法论包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：用‘物理结构化’重新包装视频生成任务，但缺乏物理因果验证、真实交互闭环和可复现基础，尚未触及具身智能中物理动态建模的核心挑战。

papers.title: An Unexpected Robot Policy: Early Evaluations of GPT-6 Astra on RoboDojo and Beyond
papers.abstract: Embodied AI systems are often organized into System 1 and System 2. System 1 is typically a pretrained policy that generates actions at high frequency, whereas System 2 is often instantiated as a vision-enabled language model for high-level planning. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can act as the policy for robot manipulation without task-specific finetuning. We call this setting LLM as policy. We evaluate three LLMs on all 42 RoboDojo tasks and compare their scores with 40 public policies. Astra and GPT-5.5 use the official 50-episode-per-task protocol; DeepSeek-Flash uses 10 episodes per task. GPT-6 Astra achieves 22.48% average success rate and 28.97 Score over 2,100 trials, ranking above every public entry. Yet GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-Flash reach only 0.88% and 1.92% average success rate with the same post-processing. We find that Astra exhibits a sharply polarized capability profile. It generalizes well to tasks that require semantic understanding but not high-precision control. In contrast, it performs poorly on tasks that require precision, dynamic control, or complex bimanual coordination. In-context experiments show no aggregate benefit from one-shot demonstrations, while selected interaction traces show within-episode corrections under perturbations. Overall, the evaluated LLMs vary substantially in manipulation performance. Astra stands out and provides initial evidence for the potential of a general-purpose manipulation model, although reliable precision and dynamic control remain limitations in the evaluated setting.

analysis.tldr: 用GPT-6 Astra这个大语言模型直接当机器人操作策略（不微调），在RoboDojo的42个仿真任务上测试，平均成功率22.48%，超过所有已公开的40个策略，但只在语义理解类任务上有效，在需要高精度、动态控制或双手协调的任务上几乎失效。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构署名线索，非知名实验室常见署名模式，无法可靠推断为清华/智元/银河等）
analysis.claim: 一个未经任务微调的纯文本大语言模型（GPT-6 Astra）可作为端到端机器人操作策略，在部分具身操作任务上超越现有专用策略。

analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续未明，但按RoboDojo协议应为7维末端执行器位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboDojo仿真器（基于Isaac Gym/ManiSkill？未明说，但RoboDojo是标准仿真benchmark）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据（全文未提real-robot实验，仅‘2,100 trials’均为仿真）

papers.title: Automatic Labelling for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract: Semantically meaningful subtask labels can provide useful contexts for long-horizon policies, but automatically identifying both reliable temporal boundaries and broad semantic descriptions for annotations remains difficult. We present an automatic labelling pipeline that assigns temporal localisation to deterministic trajectory analysis and semantic interpretation to vision-language (VL) reasoning. The pipeline segments synchronised kinematic signals into phases, performs phase-localised VL reasoning to describe the contents, and aggregates the outputs for the base, left arm, and right arm actions. We evaluate this pipeline primarily on 29 real Galaxea bimanual mobile-manipulation tasks. Repeating the VL reasoning three times first produces the same output value for 87.4% on selected tasks. A review by nine participants across all 29 tasks then judgements on the labelled phases and shows positive acceptance of temporal divisions (90.5%), body labels (90.7%), and arm labels (78.7%). The results indicate that the segmentation-VL design can produce structured annotations while preserving asynchronous bimanual behaviour, providing a basis for richer semantic subtask identification and state-based verification.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个自动标注流程，用运动学信号分段+视觉语言模型（VL）描述，给双臂移动操作任务打上带时间戳的语义子任务标签（比如‘左手抓取杯子，右手打开柜门’），在29个真实机器人任务上验证了时间分割和语义标签的人工接受度较高。
analysis.claim: 通过将运动学信号时序分割与视觉语言模型语义推理解耦并协同，可自动生成高接受度、保留异步特性的双臂移动操作子任务结构化标注。
analysis.input: 同步采集的基座+左臂+右臂运动学信号（位置/速度/力矩）+对应视频帧
analysis.output: 带时间戳的三路语义子任务标签（基座动作、左手动作、右手动作）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行的29个任务的同步kinematic+video数据；未说明是否需人工演示或预标定，但评估基于真实采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅完成自动标注流程验证（非策略学习/控制/部署），无下游任务性能提升证据；虽用真实机器人数据且有人因评估，但未开源代码/模型/数据，未对比基线方法，未验证标注对策略训练的实际增益，属于窄口径工具链探索，远低于ALOHA/ACT等定义新范式的基石工作（96分档）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：是标注方法的可行性验证，非算法/控制/部署突破，缺乏可复现性与下游价值实证，当前阶段对具身智能研究推进有限

papers.title: Best Practices in EEG Analysis: Preprocessing, Modeling, and Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) analysis requires careful choices in preprocessing, statistical modeling, and machine learning because EEG signals are highly susceptible to artifacts, volume conduction, low signal-to-noise ratio, and substantial inter-subject variability. This chapter provides a practical and methodological guide to modern EEG analysis, spanning EEG preprocessing, artifact removal, filtering, bad-channel detection and interpolation, re-referencing, independent component analysis (ICA), and preprocessing of simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings. We review major approaches for computational EEG analysis, including event-related potentials (ERPs), time-frequency analysis, functional and effective connectivity, source localization, multivariate decoding, permutation testing, and multiple-comparison correction. We then examine machine-learning methods for EEG, from feature-based classifiers to deep learning and emerging EEG foundation models, with emphasis on cross-subject generalization, limited-data regimes, data leakage, evaluation metrics, and fair benchmarking. Reproducibility is treated as a core requirement throughout, including transparent preprocessing, BIDS-EEG data organization, standardized derivatives, preservation of raw data, and FAIR data practices. The chapter is intended as a practical reference for researchers developing reliable, interpretable, and reproducible EEG analysis and machine-learning pipelines.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇面向EEG研究者的综述性方法指南，系统梳理了从预处理、统计建模到机器学习的全流程最佳实践，强调可重复性、跨被试泛化和防数据泄露等实操要点，但未提出新算法、新模型或新实验验证。
analysis.claim: 现代EEG分析的可靠性与可重复性取决于严格遵循涵盖预处理、建模、机器学习和FAIR数据实践的一整套方法学规范。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（含EEG-fMRI同步记录）
analysis.output: 清洗后的EEG数据、特征表示、分类/解码结果、统计显著性结论
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法论综述，无新模型/新数据/新实验验证；未解决任何长期开放难题（如单次trial解码、跨被试零样本迁移、低信噪比鲁棒重建），也未达到脑机接口领域里程碑工作的任意一档（全部基石工作均含真实被试在线闭环验证+临床级性能+跨日稳定性）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——属于领域内标准操作手册式综述，非原创研究，对技术前沿无实质性推进。

papers.title: ROG-Grasp: Root-Oriented Geometry for Robotic Grasping and Placement
papers.abstract: Orientation-aware manipulation is essential in post-harvest agricultural processing, where produce must be grasped and placed in consistent configurations. This paper presents ROG-Grasp, a geometry-based robotic grasping and placement framework that estimates the produce orientation from root surface geometry using RGB-D perception. A YOLO-based root detector and point cloud plane fitting are used to infer the root normal, enabling stable grasp pose generation and orientation-constrained Cartesian motion planning. Experiments on tomatoes and onions demonstrate high success rates and stable execution time in both isolated and cluttered scenarios. Compared with vision-language-action (VLA) policies, the proposed method achieves more reliable and accurate grasp completion with faster execution. These results highlight the effectiveness of geometry-driven perception for practical orientation-controlled manipulation tasks. A video of our paper is available online https://youtu.be/Ir2UtGODdMo.

analysis.tldr: 用RGB-D相机识别果蔬根部几何结构（如根尖方向），通过拟合根部表面平面估计法向量，从而生成稳定抓取位姿和朝向约束的运动轨迹，专用于农业采后加工中要求一致朝向的抓取与摆放任务。
analysis.claim: 果蔬根部表面几何（而非语义或纹理）是可靠且计算高效的朝向感知线索，可替代大模型VLA策略实现更鲁棒、更快的定向抓取与放置。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像（含深度点云）+果蔬类别（番茄/洋葱）
analysis.output: 6D抓取位姿 + 朝向约束的笛卡尔运动轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: Franka Emika Panda机械臂 + RealSense D435i
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人采集的番茄/洋葱根部点云数据（摘要未提合成数据，实验均在真机完成）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决农业定向操作这一窄领域实际问题，方法清晰、真机验证扎实（多场景/多物体/对比VLA），但未开源代码/模型，无跨机体泛化（仅Panda）、无长期部署证据，技术组件均为成熟组合（YOLO+PCA平面拟合+IK），未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程规划、开放词汇理解、世界建模）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——在特定农业操作场景下用几何先验替代大模型VLA取得实效，但技术深度与通用性远未达到ALOHA/ACT等基石工作量级，属高质量应用级工程推进。

papers.title: LRP2: A proteogenomics pipeline for long-read informed protein isoform analysis and discovery
papers.abstract: Most human genes produce multiple RNA isoforms, yet it remains unclear which isoforms are translated into stable, functional proteins. Long-read RNA-sequencing resolves full-length transcript structures and, when paired with mass spectrometry, can provide empirical evidence of isoform translation. Despite this opportunity, comprehensive workflows integrating isoform discovery, open reading frame prediction, peptide identification, and protein inference remain limited, leaving users to handle these steps piecemeal. Here, we present LRP2, a modular, end-to-end long-read proteogenomics pipeline built in Nextflow. LRP2 scales transcript discovery to hundreds of samples via PacBio's latest Isocall tool, removes technical artifacts with SQANTI QC, generates and classifies predicted proteomes via CPAT and SQANTI Protein, performs multi-group differential expression and usage analysis via edgeR, DRIMSeq and a long-read adaptation of LeafCutter, and integrates protein-level evidence from DDA and DIA MS data through FragPipe. For cross-dataset comparison of novel isoforms, LRP2 employs deterministic splice-junction, coordinate-based isoform identifiers.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫LRP2的生物信息学流程，把长读长RNA测序数据和质谱蛋白质组数据自动串联起来，从RNA转录本发现、开放阅读框预测、肽段鉴定到蛋白异构体推断全链路自动化，目标是找出哪些RNA异构体真能翻译成稳定蛋白。
analysis.claim: LRP2是首个支持大规模样本、端到端整合长读长RNA测序与质谱数据以系统性发现和验证蛋白异构体的可复现、模块化proteogenomics流程。
analysis.input: PacBio长读长RNA-seq数据 + DDA/DIA质谱原始数据
analysis.output: 经实验证据支持的蛋白异构体列表（含确定性splice-junction标识符）及差异表达/使用分析结果
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯计算生物学）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具链工程整合（Nextflow+PacBio+SQANTI+CPAT+FragPipe），但未提出新算法模型，无新实验验证，未建立领域新范式或解决长期开放难题；相比AlphaFold2等90+分基石工作，它只是将已有工具标准化串联，且仅面向小众proteogenomics子领域，影响力有限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已有的长读长RNA分析和质谱分析工具用Nextflow封装成流水线，提升了可复现性，但无算法/生物学新发现，不属于突破。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Inner-loop Dynamics Estimator for Aerial Manipulation under Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Aerial manipulators enable physical interaction in hard-to-reach environments; however, the combined problem of direct whole-body aerial manipulation under rapid arm motion, payload changes, and related unknown dynamic uncertainty remains a largely unsolved problem. We present a hierarchical control framework that combines Reinforcement Learning (RL) with an inner-loop dynamics estimator to address this problem. The RL outer loop maps desired 6-degrees-of-freedom (DOF) end-effector targets to coordinated whole-body commands, enabling direct task-driven control without relying on a fully accurate coupled dynamic model in the policy layer. An inner loop then tracks these commands while compensating for transient inertial shifts and uncertainty during execution via a dynamics estimator scheme without requiring system model knowledge. We validate the proposed approach on a custom quadrotor equipped with a 3-DoF manipulator through hardware experiments under varying payload conditions. Compared with RL+PID and RL+INDI+PID baselines, the proposed method reduces end-effector tracking error and improves task success rate across the tested hardware conditions. These results show that combining learned whole-body coordination with estimator-based low-level compensation improves the precision and robustness of aerial manipulation under changing operating conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个分层控制框架，外层用强化学习把末端目标映射成整机动作指令，内层用无需精确模型的动力学估计器实时补偿飞行器-机械臂耦合系统在载荷突变、快速运动下的动态不确定性，并在自研四旋翼+3自由度机械臂硬件上做了真实实验验证。
analysis.claim: 无需精确耦合动力学模型的分层架构（RL外环 + 数据驱动动力学估计内环）可显著提升空中机械臂在载荷变化和动态不确定性下的末端跟踪精度与任务成功率。
analysis.input: 6自由度末端期望位姿、当前状态观测（含IMU/关节编码器等）
analysis.output: 整机协调控制指令（旋翼推力+关节扭矩）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四旋翼+3-DoF机械臂硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在不同载荷下的闭环执行数据用于训练和验证
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了空中机械臂在真实载荷扰动下的鲁棒操作问题，有实机多工况验证和基线对比，但仅限单一平台、未开源、无跨机体/跨任务泛化证据，属于扎实的垂直领域工程改进，远未达H2O/GR00T等具身智能基石级工作所定义的新范式或通用能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定空中机械臂硬件上实现了带动力学估计的RL分层控制，实证有效但封闭、不可复现、泛化范围窄，尚未构成方法论层面的突破。

papers.title: LaGO: Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for planning and sequential decision-making, but prior work often relies on using them as direct controllers, which requires precise action generation and can be unreliable in practice. This paper proposes Latent Action Guidance for Online Reinforcement Learning (LaGO), a framework that uses a pretrained LLM as a latent action prior to softly guide online policy optimization, rather than treating the LLM as an explicit planner or controller. Experiments on both a discrete-control benchmark, CLEVR-Robot, and a continuous-control benchmark, Meta-World, demonstrate that LaGO consistently improves both reward and success rate over Vanilla PPO. In particular, LaGO increases the average success rate from 15.1% to 27.2% on CLEVR-Robot and from 2.7% to 15.2% on Meta-World. Our analysis further shows that stronger pretrained LLMs provide more effective guidance, suggesting that LLM knowledge can improve planning and online decision-making.

analysis.tldr: 用预训练大语言模型作为隐式动作先验，在线强化学习过程中软性引导策略优化，不直接生成动作，而是在策略梯度更新中注入LLM的语义规划知识，提升离散和连续控制任务的成功率。
analysis.claim: 将预训练大语言模型用作隐式动作先验（latent action prior）而非显式控制器，可在在线强化学习中稳定提升策略优化效果，且LLM能力越强，引导效果越好。
analysis.input: 任务指令文本 + 当前观测（图像或状态向量）
analysis.output: 策略网络的梯度更新方向（即被LLM先验调制后的策略改进信号）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖，仅使用仿真环境输出
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在两个纯仿真benchmark（CLEVR-Robot/Meta-World）上验证，无真实机器人实验、无消融分析LLM先验的具体作用机制、未开源代码/模型、未对比LLM-guided RL的主流基线（如LLM-Planner+RL、RT-X类架构），提升幅度虽显著但属单一技术路径的有限增益，远未触及世界模型或端到端具身智能范式级突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：方法有直觉合理性但实证薄弱，缺乏可复现性、机制分析和跨平台验证，属于LLM+RL方向的早期探索性工作，尚未构成可靠技术增量。

papers.title: Interpretable Concept-Guided Polynomial Tabular Kolmogorov-Arnold Network for EEG-Based Mild Cognitive Impairment Detection
papers.abstract: Early and scalable detection of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) remains an unresolved clinical challenge. Existing EEG-based screening approaches are constrained by handcrafted feature pipelines that discard neurophysiologically meaningful domain structure and deep learning classifiers that sacrifice interpretability for performance. No existing work unifies physiologically organized concept encoders, cross-concept interaction modeling, and nonlinear tabular classification in a sleep EEG-based MCI detection framework. This study proposes Concept-guided Polynomial-transformed Tabular learning using Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (CPTabKAN), which maps heterogeneous EEG-derived features into domain-informed concept representations, expands them via degree-2 polynomial transformation to expose first- and second-order interactions, and applies a Fourier-parameterized TabKAN classifier to learn nonlinear decision boundaries. CPTabKAN was evaluated on the Study of Osteoporotic Fractures cohort (372 subjects, overnight polysomnography), using 1,379 features organized into ten physiologically motivated concept groups. Under 10-fold cross-validation, CPTabKAN-Second Order achieved a weighted F1-score of 0.9038 (SD 0.034), outperforming GradientBoosting by 5.65 percentage points (t(9)=1.934,p=0.043, one-sided paired test), with advantages persisting under SMOTE-based balancing. Ablation analysis confirmed independent contributions from each component. Concept importance analysis revealed that power spectral density, multi-scale entropy, and Hjorth parameters dominated first-order weights, while cross-concept interactions involving Lempel-Ziv-Welch complexity, statistics, demographics, and slow oscillations exceeded all first-order scores. These results demonstrate that concept-structured, interaction-aware tabular learning surfaces physiologically coherent reasoning, supporting clinical trust.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种可解释的、基于生理概念分组的多项式增强型Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（CPTabKAN），用于从睡眠EEG多维特征中检测轻度认知障碍（MCI），在真实临床队列上实现0.904加权F1，显著优于梯度提升，并通过消融和概念重要性分析揭示了神经生理学上可解释的交互模式。
analysis.claim: 将EEG衍生特征按生理概念分组后，经二阶多项式显式建模跨概念交互，并用傅里叶参数化的TabKAN进行非线性分类，可在保持高精度的同时提供临床可解释的决策依据。
analysis.input: 1379维睡眠EEG衍生特征（分为10个生理概念组）
analysis.output: MCI二分类预测结果及各概念/交互的重要性得分
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开临床队列（SOF）的离线静态EEG特征表，无实时采集或硬件闭环
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在真实临床数据上验证且有消融与可解释性分析，但仅针对单一静态队列、未开源代码/模型、未验证泛化到其他中心/设备/人群，方法属工程级改进（概念分组+多项式+KAN组合），未触及脑机接口核心瓶颈（如低信噪比解码、在线适应、神经机制建模），远低于所有参照基石（均涉及实时闭环、高维神经信号直接解码、临床植入级系统）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有组件（概念分组、多项式交互、KAN）组装成一个可解释的EEG分类流程，在单个队列上跑出不错指标，但无开源、无泛化、无机制新发现，临床落地尚远

papers.title: SlipSense: Multimodal Sensing for Online Slip Detection in Legged Robots
papers.abstract: Legged robots rely on accurate ground interaction awareness to traverse variable terrains, such as slippery surfaces. Existing slip detection methods often rely on kinematics and proprioception, which lack the sensitivity to detect early-stage slips that occur prior to catastrophic instability. Thus, this paper presents SlipSense, a novel framework for online force-based slip detection using a custom lightweight sensorized foot for quadrupeds to detect slip. The framework integrates a multimodal sensor design with a LSTM-based model to infer ground reaction forces and detect slip-indicative anomalies during locomotion. The proposed framework is deployed on a Unitree Go1 quadruped to demonstrate blind online slip detection over a slippery terrain. Our method detects early-stage slips down to an average displacement of 24.1 +/-6.4mm with an overall accuracy of 85.9%. This represents a 3.3-fold finer detection resolution and a 24% relative accuracy improvement over a standard kinematic baseline that uses foot velocity inferred through state estimation. The work in this paper serves as a foundation for force-aware gait adaptation in legged robotic locomotion, allowing future controllers to estimate terrain friction and adjust constraints, thus improving the overall stability of the system.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文给四足机器人（Unitree Go1）装了一个定制的轻量力觉脚部传感器，结合LSTM模型实时分析多模态传感数据，在不依赖视觉的情况下在线检测滑动——能发现仅24毫米位移的早期滑动，比传统基于运动学的方法精度高3.3倍、准确率高24%。
analysis.claim: 通过定制多模态脚部传感器+LSTM时序建模，可在无视觉条件下实现亚厘米级位移的在线滑动检测，显著优于纯运动学推断方法。
analysis.input: 脚部多模态传感信号（应变、压力、IMU等）
analysis.output: 滑动发生与否的二分类判断及时间戳
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree Go1 四足机器人 + 自研传感器硬件
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在滑溜地面的实测数据（摘要明确说‘deployed’和‘blind online slip detection over slippery terrain’）
analysis.significance_reason: 实机部署、量化提升明确（24mm位移检测+85.9%准确率+对比基线）、工程闭环完整（传感器→模型→Go1运行），但仅针对单一机体（Go1）、单一任务（滑动二分类）、未开源、未验证跨地形/跨步态泛化，属扎实增量而非范式突破；远未达Unitree R1（90分）等基石系统层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：真机验证有效，但局限于特定硬件与任务，无开源与泛化证据，尚未构成可迁移的技术基座。

papers.title: Plan Right, Then Plan Tight: Symbolic RL for Efficient Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract: Embodied task planning asks an agent to turn a natural-language instruction into an executable sequence of actions in a physical scene, and is a building block for household, assistive, and service robots. Recent prompting-based and reinforcement-learning planners generate fluent action text but lack a cheap deterministic check that the produced plan is valid in the target world, while high-fidelity simulation is too slow to serve as an inner-loop training signal. The general problem is therefore how to obtain verifiable supervision and rewards for embodied planners without relying on string-level matching or full simulation. Here we show that a single BDDL specification, automatically constructed from open-world video evidence or curated tasks, can serve as a shared interface for data construction, plan verification, and reward design. A video-to-BDDL parser, an LLM verifier, and a lightweight symbolic engine together supply dense feedback at millisecond latency. We further introduce GroupAdapt, a difficulty-aware length schedule that uses the in-batch group pass rate as a zero-cost signal so that hard prompts get wider length tolerance and automatically tighten as their pass rate improves. Under the guidance of the proposed verifier and GroupAdapt schedule, the 8B planner attains a Strict-Pass score of 97.3 on BEHAVIOR-1000, yielding a 25.9 percent relative improvement over the Qwen3-8B baseline. This result exceeds the strongest large-model baseline by 3.5 percent, while simultaneously compressing the response length by 79 percent to 207 tokens, demonstrating both effectiveness and efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出用BDDL符号规范作为统一接口，把视频转成符号描述、用LLM验证计划合理性、再用轻量符号引擎实时打分，配合一种自适应长度调度策略GroupAdapt，让8B规模的具身规划模型在BEHAVIOR-1000上达到97.3%严格通过率，比Qwen3-8B基线提升25.9%，同时输出长度压缩79%。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖BDDL符号规范、视频到符号解析器、LLM验证器和轻量符号引擎构成的毫秒级反馈回路，即可在不调用高保真仿真或字符串匹配的前提下，实现高效、可验证、紧凑的具身任务规划训练。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 当前场景视觉输入（隐含于视频证据或BEHAVIOR仿真）
analysis.output: 动作序列文本（如'pick up apple, place in bowl'）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（BEHAVIOR-1000），未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在BEHAVIOR-1000上刷出新SOTA（97.3% Strict-Pass），但未脱离纯仿真闭环，无真实机器人验证，无跨任务/跨机体泛化测试，未开源代码或模型，且BDDL+LLM验证范式在2023年已有类似工作（如PDDL+LLM Planner、VoxPoser后续工作），属扎实工程优化而非范式突破；相比RT-2（97）、π0（95）、Qwen-RobotManip（94.5）等真机驱动、多模态对齐、开放部署的里程碑工作，其分量明显不足。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把BDDL符号验证、LLM检查与长度自适应调度打包成高效训练闭环，在仿真benchmark上取得显著指标提升，但缺乏真实世界验证、泛化性证明和开源支撑，尚未触及具身智能的核心瓶颈。

papers.title: Exp2VLA: Enabling Vision-Language-Action for Drone Navigation from Expert Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models open a new path toward intuitive robot control by directly linking perception, language, and action in a single end-to-end framework. Yet for UAVs, practical adoption remains difficult because existing solutions are either computationally heavy or insufficiently capable in complex environments. In this work, we propose a practical expert-distillation pipeline (Exp2VLA) for language-conditioned drone navigation. The core idea is to distill expert behavior, obtained from reinforcement learning, teleoperation, or other controllers, into training data that can be used to fine-tune compact VLA models. This allows existing control strategies to be transferred into a unified language-guided navigation model, reducing manual system integration and lowering the barrier for deploying new robot behaviors. Experiments in both sim-to-sim and simulation-in-the-loop settings across multi-object scenes show that the fine-tuned models can handle varied semantic commands and generalize to unseen target compositions. The proposed framework demonstrates how expert-policy distillation can help mechatronic systems move from specialized control modules toward more flexible and reusable robot intelligence.

analysis.tldr: 用专家控制器（如强化学习或遥操作）生成的演示数据蒸馏出轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，让无人机能根据自然语言指令在仿真环境中导航，但未在真实无人机上验证。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，仅知为学术研究者，无明确机构署名）
analysis.claim: 通过专家策略蒸馏构建轻量级VLA模型，可将已有无人机控制策略转化为统一的语言条件导航能力，降低系统集成复杂度。
analysis.input: RGB图像+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 无人机控制动作（如速度/姿态指令）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真无人机（如Gazebo/CoppeliaSim等，摘要未指明具体平台，但属sim-in-the-loop）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成专家演示数据，无真实无人机数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真中验证多目标场景下的语义指令泛化，无真实硬件实验、无开源代码/模型、无与SOTA VLA模型（如OpenVLA/Octo/π0）的定量对比，本质是VLA范式在无人机领域的窄口径迁移应用，未解决任何VLA核心瓶颈（如跨模态对齐鲁棒性、长程动作规划、具身因果建模），也未突破无人机导航特有挑战（如动态避障、视觉惯性耦合、低延迟控制）。
