papers.title: SoftGene: Protein Language Model-Enhanced Soft Prompting for Interpretable Gene Set Annotation
papers.abstract: Gene set analysis is a cornerstone of functional genomics, yet it remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on manual curation and expert biological interpretation. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for genomic reasoning and annotation, most existing approaches rely on symbolic gene names and fail to capture domain-specific biological structure, particularly protein sequence information that governs molecular activity, interactions, and downstream gene function. In this work, we propose SoftGene, a novel framework for LLM-based gene set annotation that leverages the hierarchical structure of gene sets. First, we use a hierarchical attention-based encoder built on ESM, a protein language model, to represent each gene set using protein-level amino acid sequence information. Second, we construct a hybrid prompting scheme that combines soft prompts derived from gene set embeddings with hard prompts containing auxiliary context generated by an LLM, and feed the resulting prompt into a local LLM for annotation. We evaluate our framework on two benchmark datasets: Gene Ontology (GO) and the Molecular Signatures Database (MSigDB). Our results show that integrating protein-sequence representations with textual context improves gene set annotation overall, while per-domain analyses reveal that the contribution of protein embeddings varies across biological domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SoftGene方法，用蛋白语言模型（ESM）把基因集编码成软提示，再和大模型生成的硬提示混合，输入本地大模型做基因集功能注释，目标是让注释更可解释、更依赖生物本质（蛋白序列）而非仅靠基因名。
analysis.claim: 融合蛋白序列层级表征与LLM上下文提示的软提示机制，能提升基因集功能注释的准确性与可解释性，且不同生物学领域中蛋白信息的增益程度存在差异。
analysis.input: 基因集（含基因符号列表）+ 蛋白质氨基酸序列 + GO/MSigDB结构化本体知识
analysis.output: 基因集的功能描述文本（如‘参与线粒体电子传递链’）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×生物中的扎实增量：首次将PLM嵌入用于基因集软提示构造，并在GO/MSigDB上验证有效性；但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验说明蛋白嵌入具体作用路径，未挑战核心瓶颈（如跨物种泛化、长尾GO项覆盖、因果解释），也未与SOTA端到端模型（如GeneFormer、BioMedLM微调）公平对比，仅比基线LLM+硬提示略优。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已知组件（ESM+LLM+GO本体）以新方式组装，有合理动机和初步实证，但缺乏深度机制分析、鲁棒性验证和开源支撑，尚未构成方法论突破。

papers.title: FOCUS: From Privileged States to RGB-D with Controlled Modality Switching and Representation Alignment
papers.abstract: Vision-based reinforcement learning for robotic manipulation is sample-inefficient because RGB-D observations are high-dimensional and noisy. Privileged state information available in simulation can accelerate training, but its absence at test time creates a train-test modality gap. We propose FOCUS, a single-stage PPO framework that trains the critic on privileged state while automatically regulating whether the actor collects rollouts from RGB-D or privileged-state latents. Regulation is driven by the KL divergence between the action distributions induced by the two modalities, while representation alignment encourages consistent action selection across them. Together, these mechanisms limit RGB-D rollouts when the actor's action distributions from RGB-D and privileged-state latents disagree. As they align, RGB-D exposure increases, shifting on-policy training toward the RGB-D inputs used at test time. Across five manipulation tasks, FOCUS raises average test success from 0.71 to 0.93 relative to the strongest RGB-D-at-test baseline on each task. When accounting for each method's complete training pipeline, budget-normalized training-success AUC increases from 0.47 to 0.65. On Pick-and-Place, test success rises from 0.47 to 0.86, while AUC increases from 0.12 to 0.61, a 5.0x improvement in learning efficiency over the fixed interaction budget.

analysis.tldr: 提出FOCUS框架，在仿真中用特权状态（privileged state）辅助训练策略，但通过KL散度动态控制RGB-D与特权状态两种输入的 rollout 比例，并强制二者表征对齐，最终让策略在测试时仅用RGB-D就能达到更高成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过受控模态切换与表征对齐，单阶段PPO可实现从特权状态监督到纯RGB-D执行的平滑过渡，显著提升视觉强化学习在机器人操作任务中的样本效率和最终性能。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像 + 仿真中可获取的特权状态（如关节角、物体位姿等）
analysis.output: 动作（连续控制量）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真器（未指明具体平台，但隐含基于PyBullet/Mujoco类环境）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的特权状态与RGB-D数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理设计（KL调控+表征对齐），在5个仿真操作任务上提升明显，但全为sim-only、无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、无开源证据、未与主流VLA或foundation model范式对比，属于扎实但窄域的RL工程改进，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级分量（95+），也弱于近年sim2real主流工作（如RT-1后续演进、VoxPoser、DAM-VLA）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真内优化了特权状态到RGB-D的迁移路径，但缺乏真实世界验证、开源和泛化证据，目前仅是RL训练技巧层面的增量改进。

papers.title: SplitJEPA: Learning Invariant and Variant Latent Worlds without Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Understanding a dynamical world calls for more than a latent state that summarizes its observations: the state should also be organized into the factors that stay shared across related observations and the factors that vary between them. For example, a robot pushing a cube to a goal should take the same action when the camera shifts or the lights dim, since nothing in the scene has moved. Existing approaches to this decomposition commonly obtain it through reconstruction, so the latent variables must first explain the entire observational world before their organization can be trusted. Joint embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) model the latent state directly and never reconstruct, yet no existing result recovers the invariant and variant parts of the state they learn. How to learn the invariant-variant structure of the latent world without paying for its reconstruction therefore remains open. To close this gap, we introduce SplitJEPA, a JEPA that jointly recovers the latent state and its invariant and variant organization directly in representation space, without any reconstruction. We prove that, under stationary Gaussian predictive dynamics and a full-rank variation condition, SplitJEPA identifies the invariant and variant subspaces up to independent block-wise isometries, without introducing an observation decoder. Since the guarantee needs no decoder, the result extends reconstruction-free latent recovery to invariant-variant block identification. Experiments on synthetic nonlinear systems and robotic manipulation tasks support the theoretical results and show their practical value for both robustness and efficiency.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出SplitJEPA，一种不依赖图像/观测重建的联合嵌入预测架构，直接在表征空间中把隐状态拆成‘对环境变化不变’和‘随动作/状态变化而变’两部分，理论证明了在特定假设下能无损识别这两个子空间，实验验证了其在机器人推方块等任务中提升鲁棒性和样本效率。
analysis.claim: 无需任何观测重建，SplitJEPA能在表征空间中直接、可证地分离隐状态的不变因子与变化因子，并保持对相机位姿、光照等无关扰动的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 连续帧观测序列（如RGB图像或状态向量）及对应动作
analysis.output: 隐状态的不变分量（invariant subspace）和变化分量（variant subspace）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅合成非线性系统与仿真机器人任务（如PyBullet/Mujoco推块）
analysis.significance_reason: 理论保证强但依赖强假设（平稳高斯动力学+满秩变异条件），实验仅限仿真小规模任务（推块），无真实机器人验证、无跨任务泛化测试、无与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）的公平对比，属扎实的表征学习理论延伸，但未触及世界模型核心瓶颈（如长期一致性、具身因果建模、sim2real迁移），远未达基石论文量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将JEPA框架拓展至不变/变化解耦，有清晰理论贡献和初步仿真验证，但缺乏实证深度、开源支持与领域穿透力，暂不具备开范式或替代现有世界模型架构的能力。

papers.title: PLAN-S: Bridging Planning with Latent Style Dynamics for Autonomous Driving World Models
papers.abstract: Latent world models (LWMs) have strengthened end-to-end autonomous driving by forecasting compact scene dynamics for downstream planning. However, existing LWM-based planners usually generate trajectories directly from entangled latent representations. This compact latent-to-planner pathway lacks explicit modeling of risk, drivability, and diverse style preferences, making driving-style dynamics difficult to supervise, inspect, or modulate before a final trajectory is selected. We propose PLAN-S (PLANning with latent Style dynamics), a planner-facing bridge that addresses this compactness-controllability dilemma by decoding a style-conditioned, four-channel semantic cost map from the latent representation. The cost map is conditioned on ego state and driving style and is consumed up-stream of the planning decision through two host-side interfaces: attention-level fusion for regression planners and reward-level fusion for anchor-score planners. We validate PLAN-S on two architecturally distinct hosts, ResWorld on nuScenes and WoTE on NAVSIM, while keeping the host backbones frozen to isolate the contribution of the proposed bridge. On nuScenes, PLAN-S reduces L2 at every horizon over the baseline, with 0.55 m average L2 and a 42% relative reduction in the 3 s collision rate. On NAVSIM, the rule-cost variant reaches 89.4 Predictive Driver Model Score (PDMS), while the learned cost variant provides complementary gains on baseline-challenging scenes. Ablations show that the cost pathway contributes most directly to safer trajectory selection. Qualitative results further show that PLAN-S can produce diverse cost maps, with spatially consistent variations aligned to different driving styles.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出PLAN-S，一种插在世界模型隐空间和下游规划器之间的‘风格感知成本图解码桥’，把原本黑箱的隐状态解耦成四个语义通道（如风险、可行驶性等）的成本图，并支持按驾驶风格调节，从而让规划器能更安全、更可控地选轨迹。
analysis.claim: 通过在隐式世界模型与规划器之间引入风格条件化的四通道语义成本图解码模块，可显著提升自动驾驶轨迹的安全性与风格可控性，且无需微调原规划器主干。
analysis.input: 世界模型输出的紧凑隐状态 + 自车状态 + 驾驶风格标签
analysis.output: 四通道语义成本图（风险/可行驶性/舒适性/风格对齐度）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实车辆数据，基于nuScenes和NAVSIM仿真数据训练验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在nuScenes/NAVSIM上报告了L2下降和碰撞率降低等量化提升，但未开源代码/模型，无消融实验验证各成本通道独立贡献，未测试跨数据集/跨规划器泛化，也未在真车或闭环仿真中验证安全性收益；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，它只是在LWM下游加了一个轻量解耦接口，未触及世界建模本质或决策范式变革，属扎实但窄域的工程改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把隐空间解耦为语义成本图是合理设计，有实测增益，但缺乏开源、消融、泛化与闭环验证，尚未构成方法论突破

papers.title: DLO-Lab: Benchmarking Deformable Linear Object Manipulations with Differentiable Physics
papers.abstract: We address the challenge of enabling robots to manipulate deformable linear objects (DLOs), such as ropes, cables, and rubber bands. Prior work has primarily focused on narrow, task-specific problems, often relying on real-world demonstrations or handcrafted heuristics. Such approaches, however, struggle to scale to the wide variety of materials and tasks encountered in practice, and collecting sufficiently diverse real-world data is often impractical. Additionally, existing simulation environments offer limited support for the broad spectrum of material behaviors necessary for generalizable DLO manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a differentiable simulator explicitly designed for versatile DLO manipulation. Our simulator models a wide range of material properties-including (in)extensibility, elasticity, bending plasticity, and complex interactions with other objects-providing a robust foundation for learning and evaluating manipulation skills. Building on this simulator, we propose a benchmark suite of representative tasks that highlight the unique challenges of DLO manipulation. The successful execution of these tasks is often hindered by the topological complexity and grasp sensitivity inherent to DLOs. Therefore, we introduce a specialized DLO agent that explicitly manages these challenges by proposing strategic grasping points and decomposing long-horizon tasks to maximize control authority. Finally, we evaluate various policy-learning algorithms using our framework, alongside sim-to-real transfer experiments, demonstrating our platform's potential to advance DLO manipulation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专为可变形线状物体（如绳子、电缆）操作设计的可微分物理仿真器DLO-Lab，并配套发布首个覆盖材料多样性、任务拓扑复杂性和抓取敏感性的基准测试套件，以及一个能主动规划抓点+分解长程任务的专用智能体，但所有实验仅在仿真中完成，无真实机器人验证。
analysis.claim: 通过构建高保真可微分DLO仿真器与结构化基准，首次系统性支撑可泛化、可优化的线状柔性物体操作学习，克服了现有仿真缺乏材料谱系支持和任务定义零散的问题。

papers.title: Visuotactile and Explicitly Force-Controlled Robotic Ultrasound for Abdominal Volumetric Reconstruction
papers.abstract: In this paper, we present a robotic ultrasound acquisition system that integrates stereo vision, touch-based feedback, and expert-informed strategies to perform autonomous and adaptive abdominal scans. The system records freehand motion and force data from expert radiologists, creating a framework to capture transducer motion, applied forces, and anatomical scanning strategies. This expert data is replayed to replicate characteristic scans with the robot, forming a foundation for further autonomous capabilities. Using stereo vision, the system generates three-dimensional topography maps of the patient's abdomen, which are refined through stiffness measurements at key points to delineate the rib cage boundary. These combined techniques enable the robot to execute two distinct scanning paths: an upward-angled sweep beneath the rib cage to visualize structures near the upper abdomen and a perpendicular sweep across soft tissue regions. A compliant, torque-controlled seven degree-of-freedom robotic manipulator is controlled to maintain consistent probe contact through closed-loop force control over the varied anatomical surfaces. Physical experiments demonstrate that the system achieves high-quality imaging comparable to expert scans while dynamically adapting to patient-specific topographies. Furthermore, the robotic system surpasses expert capabilities by enabling three-dimensional volume acquisition, which enhances diagnostic potential and provides volumetric data for advanced analyses. This work highlights the integration of expert knowledge into autonomous robotic systems and underscores the potential of combining perception-based autonomy with physical reasoning for enhanced diagnostic performance.

analysis.tldr: 用带力控的七自由度机械臂+双目视觉+触觉反馈，复现专家超声扫描动作，自适应患者腹部形变，实现全自动腹部三维超声容积重建，比人工扫描多出三维体数据。
analysis.claim: 通过融合专家运动-力数据、双目地形建模与实时力闭环控制，机器人可在解剖形变显著的腹部表面自主执行高保真、可重复、三维容积化的超声扫描。

analysis.output: 三维超声容积数据（voxel grid）+自适应扫描路径（含肋下斜扫与软组织横扫）

papers.title: Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Robotic Cognitive Alignment enabled by Non-Invasive Consumer Brain Computer Interfaces: A Proof of Concept Exploration
papers.abstract: While non-verbal behaviors and expressive movements are essential for natural human-robot interaction, existing methods often overlook a crucial element: the human's internal cognitive state. Frequently, proactive multi-agent systems can interrupt humans at inopportune moments, leading to cognitive overload and decreased task performance. This paper introduces a framework for generating "cognitively aligned" multi-agent interactions, enhancing the ability of robotic systems to contextually defer communications to the user of an agent system during moments of high human mental workload and engagement. We present the design and implementation of a closed-loop architecture that explores the interplay between autonomous task execution and real-time neurophysiological focus. Using a consumer-grade Brain-Computer Interface (BCI), our approach continuously monitors Electroencephalography (EEG) spectral band powers while a human performs an engagement-inducing task. We propose an engagement-driven pipeline where an HTTP-based signaling mechanism places a primary agent's sensory inputs and audio outputs into a holding state upon detecting high engagement. This allows secondary agents to seamlessly process complex, delegated tasks in the background. Once the human's cognitive state returns to a lower cognitive load baseline, the primary agent releases the queued agent message. Our preliminary results demonstrate the feasibility of leveraging real-time signal processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), and physical robotic embodiments to create cognitively-aware, non-intrusive multi-agent systems.

analysis.tldr: 用消费级脑电头环实时监测用户专注度，当检测到高认知负荷时自动暂停主机器人语音/感知输入，把任务转给后台副机器人处理，等用户空闲后再恢复通信——整个流程是概念验证，只在单任务、单用户、单BCI设备上做了初步闭环演示。
analysis.claim: 非侵入式消费级BCI可实时检测人类认知负荷，并据此动态调度多智能体系统中的任务分发与交互时机，实现‘认知对齐’的机器人协作。
analysis.input: EEG频谱功率（来自消费级BCI）+ 任务行为触发信号（如按键/屏幕交互）
analysis.output: HTTP信号（控制主/副机器人输入输出开关状态）+ LLM生成的代理间任务委派指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 未明确指定具体机器人硬件，仅提及‘physical robotic embodiments’泛指，实验未展示真实机器人动作闭环
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人运行数据；所有机器人行为均为逻辑模拟或预设响应

papers.title: V2P-Manip: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Human Videos
papers.abstract: Achieving autonomous robotic dexterous manipulation requires precise, human-like action sequences at scale. As a scalable supplement to costly teleoperation data, extracting trajectories with both visual fidelity and physical plausibility from monocular videos represents a promising frontier in embodied AI. To this end, we introduce V2P-Manip, an efficient framework designed to learn dexterous manipulation policies directly from human demonstration videos. We establish an efficient, integrated pipeline encompassing 3D asset acquisition, trajectory estimation, and dexterous policy learning. To bridge the gap between visual perception and physical constraints, we introduce a two-stage refinement process to enforce spatial alignment and physical consistency. Evaluations on the TACO and OakInk benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms previous methods in pose accuracy, adaptability to unstructured environments, and training efficiency. Ultimately, experimental results confirm an average success rate of over 75% across multiple synthetic manipulation tasks and validate the adaptability of the extracted manipulation priors across diverse dexterous hand embodiments.

analysis.tldr: 从单目人类操作视频中自动提取3D手部轨迹并生成可迁移到不同灵巧手的物理合理操作策略，不依赖真实机器人数据或动作捕捉设备。
analysis.claim: 仅通过单目人类操作视频即可学习跨机体适配的灵巧操作策略，且在合成任务中达到75%+成功率。

analysis.output: 灵巧手关节级控制策略（动作序列）

papers.title: DreamReg: Belief-Driven World Model for 2D-3D Ultrasound Registration
papers.abstract: Ultrasound (US) is widely used for surgical navigation, yet real-time registration between intraoperative 2D slices and preoperative 3D volumes remains challenging due to partial observability, speckle noise, and the action-dependent US acquisition. Existing methods are one-shot or short-horizon, making it hard for them to gather evidence over time or capture how surgeons adjust probe motion based on on-screen feedback. We propose DreamReg, a belief-driven world-model framework that formulates 2D-3D registration as belief updating over rigid transformations. DreamReg maintains a latent belief state that summarizes past observations and poses information, and continuously refines the transformation through learned dynamics as new slices arrive. During training, DreamReg is exposed to probe-motion trajectories that mimic clinical scanning behavior and learns to update its belief by conditioning pose refinement on the current US observation. During inference, DreamReg refines registration via internal imagination: it rolls out the learned world model to simulate candidate probe motions and their predicted observations, and integrates these imagined outcomes to converge to an accurate rigid transformation. Experiments on CAMUS and u-RegPro datasets demonstrate improved robustness and competitive registration accuracy for real-time guidance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

analysis.tldr: 提出DreamReg，一个基于信念更新的世界模型框架，用于实时超声2D图像与3D体积的配准：它不靠单次匹配，而是持续维护一个隐式‘信念状态’，根据新扫到的2D切片动态修正刚体变换，并通过内部‘想象’（rollout预测）候选探头运动及其对应图像来迭代收敛配准结果。
analysis.claim: 2D-3D超声配准应建模为随时间演化的信念更新过程，而非静态优化问题；引入可学习的隐式世界模型动力学，使系统能通过内部想象主动探索探头运动策略并提升鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 序列化2D超声切片+历史探头位姿估计（或初始猜测）

papers.title: Computational Redesign of an Antifreeze Protein Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract: Antifreeze proteins (AFPs) found in various cold-adapted organisms inhibit ice growth and are of interest for applications in food products, cryopreservation, agriculture, and materials science. Although high-resolution structures are available for several AFPs, the amino acids required for full antifreeze activity remain incompletely defined, and the development of AFP variants with properties such as enhanced solubility, high expression yield, and improved thermostability may further facilitate applications. Here, we used the deep learning model ProteinMPNN to redesign the globular fish antifreeze protein AFPIII, keeping the previously reported ice-binding residues fixed. We readily obtained sequences confidently predicted to adopt AFPIII's structure and we selected five designed variants for expression, all of which expressed efficiently in E. coli. Circular dichroism spectroscopy showed that two of these variants retained secondary structure elements consistent with AFPIII, whereas the other three exhibited structural differences. One design was predicted and experimentally confirmed to have increased thermostability. All five variants displayed measurable thermal hysteresis activity. However, none reached the activity of wild-type AFPIII, suggesting that maintaining the currently established set of ice-binding residues is not sufficient to fully preserve this AFP's function; other, unidentified residues can also impact its activity. Our findings highlight the value of deep learning-based protein design methods both for generating AFP variants with desirable properties and for uncovering gaps in existing knowledge of well-characterized AFPs.

analysis.tldr: 用ProteinMPNN重新设计抗冻蛋白AFPIII，在固定已知冰结合残基的前提下生成5个新序列，全部成功表达，其中1个实验证实热稳定性提升，5个都有热滞活性但均弱于野生型，说明现有冰结合位点知识不完整。
analysis.org: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校
analysis.claim: 深度学习驱动的抗冻蛋白理性重设计不仅能获得热稳定性提升的变体，还能反向揭示当前冰结合残基定义的局限性。

papers.title: A Simple Subject Independent Channel Selection in EEG for Motor Imagery Task
papers.abstract: Classification of motor imagery (MI) tasks through EEG is valuable in brain-computer interfacing and rehabilitation engineering. EEG channels selection for MI task classification is well discussed problem and is challenging due to its combinatorial nature. Most of the existing methods are subject and task-dependent. This paper introduces a subject-independent EEG channel selection. The proposed approach consists of two stages. First, we rank channels based on their divergence from a reference channel Cz. We hypothesize that channels less divergent from Cz are more relevant for MI task classification. In the second stage, we employ a three-stage feature selection and classification model to evaluate the selected channels. It consists of a bandpass filter, followed by common spatial pattern (CSP) filter and three classifiers viz. SVM, 1-NN and 5-NN. Two publicly available datasets viz. PhysioNet and BCI Competition III IVa datasets have been used to assess the method. It performs 15.21\% more than 3Cs and just 2.91\% less than all-channels accuracy with as few as 20/118 channels on BCI Competition data and 19.64\% more than 3Cs on the PhysioNet dataset with 16/64 channels. Empirical comparison implies that the method performs better than classical models such as CSP Rank, fishers rank, and normalized mutual information, significantly. Results support that our hypothesis that divergence between channels and a reference channel Cz can be used as a ranking measure for channel selection.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种不依赖被试的EEG通道选择方法：先用Cz参考通道计算各通道的发散度排序，再用带通滤波+CSP+多个分类器验证，仅用约20个通道就接近全通道分类精度，在两个公开数据集上显著优于传统通道选择基线。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院德里分校
analysis.claim: 基于Cz参考通道的发散度可作为普适、无需被试校准的EEG通道排序依据，并在MI任务中实现高精度、低通道数的分类性能。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（多通道时序数据）
analysis.output: MI任务类别（如左手/右手/脚想象）

papers.title: Initiation Safety: A Missing Dimension in Generalist-Robot Safety
papers.abstract: Safety for generalist robots is usually discussed in terms of motion or dialogue. We argue a third question is missing: should the robot take its first hard-to-undo social action at all, such as a greeting, an uninvited grasp, or stepping into someone's space? We call this initiation authorization. Current frameworks rarely treat it as a separate safety layer. Today's stacks often skip this step: a high engagement score or a confident VLA rollout is treated as permission to act. But seeing a person is not the same as having their consent to be addressed. We frame initiation authorization within generalist-robot safety and contrast it with post-plan VLA guardrails, implementing PAS (probe-authorize-speak) on a doorway humanoid, comparing it with direct-init on logged traces, and proposing a three-condition user study, with open questions on metrics, governance, and where initiation ends and foundation-model generation begins.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文指出通用机器人安全被忽视的关键环节：机器人是否该启动首个不可逆的社会性动作（如主动打招呼、未经许可抓取、闯入他人空间），提出‘启动授权’（initiation authorization）概念，并在门口人形机器人上实现PAS（探查-授权-执行）流程，对比直接启动策略，但未提供真实机器人实验数据或可复现系统。
analysis.claim: 通用机器人安全必须显式建模‘启动授权’这一独立安全层，即在执行首个社会性动作前需主动探测并获得用户隐式/显式同意，而非仅依赖视觉语言动作模型的高置信度输出。
analysis.input: 视觉观测（含人体姿态/位置）、环境上下文、对话历史
analysis.output: 是否启动社会性交互的二元决策（授权/拒绝）及对应动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: doorway humanoid（未指明具体型号，仅描述场景）
analysis.data_dependency: 使用logged traces（日志回放数据），无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有价值的安全维度概念（启动授权），但完全停留在框架论述与日志回放对比层面，无真实硬件验证、无开源代码/模型、无量化指标、无消融实验，未超越任何已列基石工作（全部为真机驱动、多任务、端到端学习或大规模数据驱动），属于窄领域概念性讨论。

papers.title: Comparative genomic and transcriptomic analyses of Strongylus vulgaris reveal developmental and evolutionary deployment of parasitism in a migratory equine nematode
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Strongylus vulgaris is a highly pathogenic equine strongyle whose larval stages migrate through the mesenteric arterial system, yet the molecular basis of its development, host association, and evolutionary biology remains poorly resolved. We generated an integrated genomic and transcriptomic resource to characterize genome structure, gene annotation, stage-associated expression, candidate secreted proteins, isoform diversity, gene-family evolution, putative horizontal gene transfer, and drug resistance-associated homologs in S. vulgaris . Results PacBio HiFi sequencing produced a 329.0 Mb genome assembly comprising 3,913 contigs, with a contig N50 of 147 kb and 94.8% BUSCO completeness, substantially improving the prior fragmented draft. Repeat annotation identified 127.5 Mb of repetitive sequence, representing 38.72% of the genome and dominated by unclassified repeats. Integration of RNA-seq-guided annotation with PacBio Iso-Seq evidence refined 16,387 loci and 24,546 transcripts, generating an isoform-retaining discovery proteome of 23,363 predicted proteins. Functional annotation supported 93.5% of predicted proteins and identified 1,530 unknown or weakly annotated candidates. Consensus secretome prediction identified 2,210 high-confidence putative secreted proteins. Stage-associated transcriptomics showed that development was the dominant axis of expression variation, with 5,299 genes differentially expressed between larvae and adults and strong adult sex-associated divergence. Isoform analysis identified 490 high-confidence isoform switches, concentrated primarily in the ML5 female-to-adult female transition. Comparative genomics identified 27,641 orthogroups, 201 S. vulgaris -specific orthogroups, and, after repeat-aware filtering, 48 expanded and 250 contracted gene families. Structure-guided annotation prioritized migratory-stage-enriched secreted candidates, including Cysteine-rich secretory proteins, Antigen 5, and Pathogenesis-related 1 (CAP), Sperm-coating protein (SCP) Tpx-1/Ag5/PR-1/Sc7 protein superfamily (TAPS) -like, von Willebrand factor type A (VWA) - domain, lipid-binding-like, DNase II-like, and peptidase-like proteins. Conservative screening retained 17 putative horizontal gene transfer (HGT) candidates, and drug resistance-homolog analysis recovered 18 nonredundant S. vulgaris homologs without canonical β-tubulin benzimidazole-resistance substitutions. Conclusions These results establish the first integrated, high-quality molecular framework for S. vulgaris and show that its parasitic biology is developmentally structured, isoform-rich, and shaped by both conserved strongylid features and lineage-specific gene-family change. This resource provides a foundation for future studies of interhost migration, host interaction, parasite evolution, and genomic surveillance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为马寄生线虫Strongylus vulgaris构建了首个高质量基因组+多阶段转录组整合资源，系统解析了其发育调控、分泌蛋白谱、基因家族演化、潜在水平基因转移和抗药性相关基因，但未开展任何实验验证或功能研究。

analysis.output: 高质量基因组组装（329 Mb）、24,546个转录本、23,363个预测蛋白、2,210个高置信分泌蛋白、5,299个差异表达基因、490个可变剪接开关、201个物种特有直系同源群、48个扩张/250个收缩基因家族、17个HGT候选、18个抗苯并咪唑β-微管蛋白同源物

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了高质量寄生虫多组学资源构建与系统性生物信息学刻画，但缺乏功能实证与机制突破，属于领域内必要但非引领性的基础支撑工作

papers.title: Custom Probe-Based Spatial Transcriptomics Enables Microbiome Detection in FFPE Colorectal Cancer Tissue
papers.abstract: Intratumoral bacteria have emerged as functionally relevant components of the tumor microenvironment, yet the spatial relationship between these bacterial communities and host gene expression remains poorly characterized, in part due to methodological constraints. Existing spatial transcriptomics approaches for microbial detection rely on fresh frozen tissue, excluding FFPE specimens which dominate clinical archives. Here, we describe a custom probe design pipeline targeting the variable regions of bacterial 16S rRNA, compatible with the probe-based chemistry of the 10X Genomics Visium CytAssist platform, enabling spatially resolved bacterial profiling in FFPE tissue. Applied to a pilot cohort of six FFPE colorectal cancer tumor and normal adjacent tissue specimens, we show that integration of custom microbial probes into the Visium workflow preserves host transcriptomic structure, with clustering analysis recapitulating expected colonic cell type architecture. Bacterial signal was detected across all samples in a spatially patterned and focal manner, with one tumor sample exhibiting markedly elevated signal intensity and a distinct invasive distribution pattern, driven by spatially structured Bacteroides-Phocaeicola and Porphyromonas signals with divergent intratumoral trajectories. These findings establish the feasibility of probe-based spatial metatranscriptomics in FFPE tissue and provide a generalizable framework for studying host-microbiome interactions in relevant clinical samples.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一套针对细菌16S rRNA可变区的定制探针设计流程，使其适配10X Visium CytAssist平台，首次在临床广泛存档的福尔马林固定石蜡包埋（FFPE）结直肠癌组织上实现空间分辨的微生物检测，并验证了宿主转录组结构完整性与细菌信号的空间异质性。
analysis.claim: 定制16S rRNA探针可兼容Visium CytAssist平台，在FFPE组织中实现空间分辨的微生物-宿主共定位分析。

analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，依赖临床FFPE组织样本和标准病理制备流程

papers.title: P3: Probabilistic Policy Propagation for Stable VAE-Based Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Variational Autoencoders are widely used to encode high-dimensional and noisy observations in robotics. However, their stochastic latent creates a mismatch with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO): an effective policy marginalizes over the latent distribution, whereas former implementations estimate its probability ratio and KL divergence using only one latent sample. We identify a fundamental but overlooked theoretical cause: naive single-sample approximations in stochastic latent space induce significant variance and bias in the surrogate loss. To address this, we introduce P^3 (Probabilistic Policy Propagation), a distribution-aware optimization framework for VAE-based policies. $P^3$ couples moment-based probabilistic method for stable and efficient learning with sampling-based calibration for robust policy behavior under latent uncertainty. In our experiments, P^3 boosts data efficiency from 64.6% to >96%, reduces convergence steps by >20%. Furthermore, P^3 is evaluated on challenging humanoid parkour tasks and shows an effective foundation for VAE-based PPO. Code is available at https://github.com/ylyem9x/P3_Open.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现VAE用于机器人策略学习时，用单个隐变量采样来计算PPO的KL散度和概率比会导致严重偏差和方差，于是提出P³框架，用矩估计+采样校准来稳定优化过程，在仿真 humanoid parkour 任务中提升了数据效率和收敛速度。
analysis.claim: 在VAE编码观测的PPO策略训练中，单样本隐变量近似会引入不可忽视的理论偏差与方差，而P³通过分布感知的策略传播可显著提升训练稳定性与效率。

analysis.output: 动作策略（连续控制输出）

analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据

papers.title: LyEvO: Lyapunov-Guided Evolutionary Optimization for Safe and Robust Sim-to-Real Policy Learning
papers.abstract: Training controllers that are safe and robust in simulation, and systematically assessing their readiness for real-world deployment, remain key challenges in sim-to-real transfer. To address this, we propose LyEvO, a physics-grounded framework that combines constrained Evolutionary Optimization and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification with Lyapunov-based stability analysis. Leveraging prior knowledge of the system dynamics, LyEvO uses Lyapunov analysis to compute an initial candidate stability region. An iterative loop then uses operational scenarios drawn from this region to jointly optimize and statistically verify a policy, and subsequently expands the region's boundaries based on the verification outcome. This integrated procedure provides a practical criterion for assessing deployment readiness. We evaluate LyEvO on Cartpole and 3D Quadrotor benchmarks through extensive simulations and targeted real-world experiments, demonstrating safe and robust sim-to-real transfer.

analysis.tldr: 提出LyEvO框架，用李雅普诺夫稳定性分析划定初始安全区域，再在该区域内用进化算法优化策略、用统计模型检验验证安全性，并根据验证结果动态扩展安全区域，从而为仿真到真实世界的策略部署提供可量化的安全就绪性判断标准。
analysis.org: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校
analysis.claim: 通过将李雅普诺夫稳定性先验与进化优化和统计模型检验闭环耦合，可生成具备可验证安全边界、且能系统评估部署就绪性的sim-to-real策略。

papers.title: PEEL: Parallel Extraction for Long-Horizon Disassembly Planning via Scale-Invariant Sampling
papers.abstract: Long-horizon multi-part object disassembly requires robots to compute feasible sequences of collision-free removal motions, even in the presence of tight, narrow escape corridors. To efficiently solve such disassembly problems, we propose Parallel Extraction for Long-Horizon Disassembly (PEEL), an algorithm which efficiently computes disassembly motions for object assemblies and feeds them to a robot manipulator for execution. PEEL uses sampling-based motion planning to compute single-object motions through the use of a scale-invariant sampling scheme, where the object scale is estimated in a burn-in phase and a subsequent directional sampler exploits the scale. This sampling scheme is integrated into a multi-arm bandit rapidly-exploring random tree (MAB-RRT) planner, which switches between different samplers depending on the reward signal received. Using MAB-RRT, the PEEL algorithm runs a batch of planners in parallel to obtain an ordered graph specifying the sequence in which object parts have to be removed. We show that MAB-RRT can efficiently solve single-part disassemblies with 100 percent success rate on 76 assemblies, and that it is robust to its parameters. By integrating MAB-RRT into PEEL, we solve four long-horizon disassembly problems using the Fetch manipulator robot involving 10 to 17 individual object parts.

analysis.tldr: 提出PEEL算法，用带尺度不变采样的多臂赌博RRT（MAB-RRT）并行规划多部件物体的拆解顺序和单部件无碰撞移除路径，并在Fetch机器人上完成了4个含10–17部件的真实长程拆解任务。
analysis.org: 斯图加特大学/马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所
analysis.claim: 通过尺度不变采样与多臂赌博RRT的并行集成，可高效、鲁棒地求解高自由度、窄通道约束下的长时序多部件拆解规划问题。
analysis.input: CAD模型或几何表示的装配体（含部件拓扑与几何）、机器人基座与机械臂运动学参数
analysis.output: 部件移除顺序图（有向无环图）及对应每一步的无碰撞末端执行器轨迹
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据；所有规划均基于几何仿真（OMPL+Bullet），仅最后部署阶段使用Fetch执行已规划轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的具身智能规划方法增量：首次将MAB机制嵌入RRT实现动态采样策略切换，并验证其在真实Fetch机器人上完成10+部件拆解——但未跨机体泛化、无用户/任务/场景多样性测试，未开源数据与完整评估benchmark，且未与主流VLA或foundation model范式对齐，远低于RT-2/π0/OpenVLA等定义新范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：工程上成功打通了从几何规划到Fetch真机长序列拆解的闭环，但仍是传统采样规划框架内的改进，非范式突破，暂不用看

papers.title: Multi-Feature Riemannian Hypergraph for Online Test-Time Adaptation of Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interface
papers.abstract: In clinical motor imagery brain-computer interface (MI-BCI) decoding, cross-day transferability and online operation remain two critical challenges. Hypergraphs can improve transferability by capturing higher-order sample relationships, yet existing hypergraph-based methods for online emotion recognition neglect the cross-day benefits of Riemannian geometry widely adopted in EEG transfer learning. To bridge this gap, we propose the Multi-feature Riemannian Hypergraph (MRieHy), a framework tailored for online test-time adaptation in MI-BCI decoding that leverages Riemannian geometry to strengthen cross-day transferability. MRieHy first computes Riemannian means of covariance matrices from cross-day training data to align multi-day distributions. It then constructs a hypergraph over covariance matrices using Riemannian distance, complemented by a second hypergraph over deep features built with cosine similarity. The two hypergraphs are fused via adaptively learned combination weights, jointly optimized with the label projection matrices. During online testing, MRieHy maintains a first-in-first-out buffer of recent samples, performs Riemannian alignment on the buffered data, and decodes with the learned hypergraph. Extensive experiments on a private four-class ECoG dataset and two public four-class EEG datasets validate that MRieHy achieves notable performance gains over state-of-the-art baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫MRieHy的新框架，用黎曼几何对齐不同天采集的脑电信号协方差矩阵，并构建两个超图（一个基于黎曼距离，一个基于深度特征余弦相似度）融合做在线测试时自适应，提升运动想象脑机接口跨天解码稳定性。
analysis.claim: 通过融合黎曼几何对齐与双超图建模，可在无标签在线测试阶段显著提升MI-BCI跨天解码的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: ECoG/EEG信号的协方差矩阵 + 深度特征向量
analysis.output: 运动想象类别预测标签（四分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖跨天采集的ECoG/EEG数据，但未说明是否需实时真实设备反馈或闭环交互；仅用于离线训练+在线滑动窗口推理
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了MI-BCI中实际存在的跨天漂移问题，方法设计有整合性（黎曼+超图），实验覆盖3个数据集且含跨天设定，但仅限离线重训练+滑动窗口在线推理，无真实临床闭环验证、无长期稳定性报告、无用户交互指标（如ITR）、未对比临床金标准范式（如CSP+LDA），远未达基石论文所代表的神经接口临床转化层级（如高精度语音合成、手写输出、脊髓接口行走）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在算法层面改进了跨天自适应，但缺乏真实场景部署证据和临床级性能验证，属于方法学上的稳健推进而非范式突破。

papers.title: An extended N-terminus restrains the plant cell death-inducing ability of the catalytically competent ribonuclease domain in a pea powdery mildew RALPH effector
papers.abstract: Abstract RALPH (RNase-like proteins associated with haustoria) effectors, which are preferentially expressed in haustoria and structurally resemble fungal T1/F1 RNases, constitute one of the largest effector families in powdery mildew (PM) fungi, yet their functions in dicot-adapted PM species remain poorly understood. Unlike cereal PM RALPHs, which lack the catalytic residues required for RNase activity, some dicot PM RALPHs retain these residues. Here, we performed a comprehensive structural and expression-based characterization of the pea PM Erysiphe pisi RALPH ( Ep RALPH) repertoire and functionally characterized Ep RALPH11, a RALPH effector with partial conservation of the catalytic residues of T1/F1 fungal RNases. Comparative analyses identified multi-RNase-domain RALPHs as a conserved feature of the Erysiphe lineage, while expression profiling showed that many EpRALPH s are preferentially expressed in haustoria during early host colonization. AlphaFold 3-based structural analyses revealed a conserved T1/F1 RNase-like fold despite substantial sequence and surface charge divergence, indicating functional diversification among Ep RALPHs. Ep RALPH11 enhanced susceptibility to E. pisi in Medicago truncatula , localized to the nucleolus, and induced nucleolar fragmentation when heterologously expressed in Nicotiana benthamiana leaves. Its RNase domain exhibited T1 RNase activity in vitro, supporting the retention of a catalytically competent RNase domain and, together with its nucleolar localization, suggesting that Ep RALPH11 targets plant rRNA and disrupts nucleolar functions. The RNase domain induced cell death in N. benthamiana , whereas the full-length protein and catalytic mutants did not. Cell death induction required exclusive nucleolar localization of the RNase domain, and an extended N-terminal intrinsically disordered region suppressed this activity in the full-length protein. Together, our findings reveal a previously unrecognized mechanis regulating RNase activity in a dicot PM RALPH effector and provide new insights into the functional diversification of RALPHs and their adaptation to obligate biotrophy.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现豌豆白粉菌的一个RALPH效应蛋白Ep RALPH11虽然具有完整的RNase催化结构域且能在体外切割RNA，但其全长蛋白并不诱导植物细胞死亡；真正起作用的是被N端无序区‘锁住’的RNase结构域——只有当这个N端被切除、RNase结构域单独进入核仁时，才会导致核仁碎裂和细胞死亡。
analysis.claim: Ep RALPH11的RNase结构域具备催化活性并能诱导细胞死亡，但其全长蛋白因N端无序区的空间抑制而丧失该毒性，这是一种新型的病原效应蛋白活性调控机制。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列、表达数据（RNA-seq）、AlphaFold3预测结构、体外RNase活性检测底物、植物瞬时表达系统
analysis.output: 结构模型（AlphaFold3）、亚细胞定位图像、核仁形态变化、细胞死亡表型、体外酶活读数
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次揭示了植物病原真菌RALPH效应子中通过N端无序区实现RNase活性‘自抑制’的分子开关机制，实验证据扎实（结构建模+体外酶活+核仁定位+细胞死亡表型+突变体对照），但仅聚焦单一效应子在两种豆科植物中的现象，未拓展至其他RALPH家族成员或作物体系，也未提供通用调控框架或可编程工具。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：发现了真实存在的、有完整生化与细胞表型证据支持的效应蛋白自抑制新机制，但限于单一体系，尚未上升为普适原理或技术范式。

papers.title: Cross-attention and language models reveal the interpretability of functional predictions for the human olfactory receptor family
papers.abstract: Abstract The attention mechanism offers the possibility for data-driven discovery of biological principles. However, for important protein families such as human olfactory receptors, the extent to which attention can associate with biologically meaningful key regions lacks systematic validation. In this study, using human olfactory receptors (ORs) as a model, we constructed CrossVOI, a VOC-OR interaction prediction framework based on protein language models and cross-attention, achieving predictive performance superior to existing methods. Furthermore, we systematically analyzed the attention distributions of CrossVOI and found that attention not only focused on ligand-binding interfaces and evolutionarily conserved sites, but also to some extent identified certain dynamically regulated regions. In summary, we propose CrossVOI, currently the best-performing framework for VOC-OR interaction prediction, and analyze the interpretability of the attention mechanism for human ORs. This study provides insights into the interpretability of protein function prediction methods and is expected to contribute to the exploration of attention mechanisms in biological mechanisms, and provide assistance for large-scale screening and mechanistic analysis of olfactory receptors.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型加跨模态注意力机制预测气味分子与人类嗅觉受体的结合关系，并分析注意力权重是否真的落在已知功能位点（如配体结合界面、进化保守区）上，验证了该模型的可解释性。
analysis.claim: CrossVOI模型中cross-attention权重能系统性地聚焦于嗅觉受体的生物学关键区域（如配体结合界面、进化保守位点和部分动态调控区），从而为蛋白功能预测模型提供可解释性支撑。
analysis.input: 气味分子SMILES字符串 + 嗅觉受体蛋白序列
analysis.output: VOC-OR相互作用概率（二分类/打分）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，仅依赖已发表的OR-odorant实验结合数据（如DREAM Olfaction Challenge数据集等）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次在嗅觉受体家族系统验证attention与功能位点的对应性，但模型架构属常规PLM+cross-attention组合，未引入新训练范式或结构先验；验证基于静态序列+小分子SMILES，未涉及三维结构建模或动力学；实验仅限OR家族，泛化性弱；无消融证明cross-attention比简单concat+MLP更优；未开源代码/模型权重，仅提供项目页。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：方法组合合理、生物学验证有设计感，但创新深度和实证强度不足以支撑‘突破’，属于特定蛋白家族上的可解释性方法学验证，暂未达领域标杆水准。

papers.title: VTInstructor: Visual Trajectory Prompting for Navigation Instruction Generation in Continuous Environments
papers.abstract: Navigation instruction generation from ego-centric RGB video in continuous environments is an important yet challenging task for human-robot interaction and scalable dataset construction. Prior instruction generators assume discrete viewpoint graphs with panoramic observations, where trajectory structure is explicit; in continuous environments, however, the agent receives only a dense RGB stream, making trajectory cues difficult to recover. We propose VTInstructor, the first VLN instruction generation framework for continuous environments. Our key idea is to convert implicit trajectory geometry into explicit visual trajectory prompts: EDTC condenses long RGB trajectories into navigation-critical keyframes, VTP overlays path, turn, and goal cues onto these anchors, VTMod injects the resulting trajectory signals into the visual encoder, and VT-GRPO further calibrates this spatial injection during training, all without requiring a navigation graph, pre-built map, or scene reconstruction. On the challenging R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val Unseen benchmarks, VTInstructor sets a new state of the art across all standard NLG metrics, surpassing the strongest baseline by +0.357 CIDEr and +0.109 CIDEr, respectively. Beyond automatic metrics, VTInstructor-generated instructions raise a frozen follower's success rate to 63.3%, a +14.7 percentage-point gain over the best competing instruction source, and provide consistent data augmentation gains of +3 SR points on downstream navigation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 提出VTInstructor框架，从连续环境下的第一人称RGB视频流中自动生成自然语言导航指令，不依赖离散图结构、地图或场景重建，通过关键帧提取、视觉轨迹提示叠加和空间注入校准三步实现轨迹几何隐式到显式的转换。
analysis.claim: 在无导航图、无预建地图、无场景重建的前提下，仅用连续RGB视频流即可生成高质量、具空间可解释性的导航指令，显著提升下游导航智能体的泛化性能。
analysis.input: 连续第一人称RGB视频流（ego-centric RGB trajectory）
analysis.output: 自然语言导航指令（如'向左转后直行穿过门口'）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用R2R-CE/RxR-CE等合成/众包视频-文本对数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 属VLN子任务中的指令生成方向，技术路径（关键帧+视觉提示+空间注入）有新意，但未开源代码/模型，仅在两个已有benchmark上刷分，无真实机器人验证、无跨环境/跨任务泛化实验，下游follower仍为冻结模型且未开放指令生成与导航联合训练，贡献限于NLG指标提升和有限下游增益，远未达RT-2级范式突破或OpenVLA级工程规模。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——纯仿真NLG任务上的增量改进，无开源、无真机、无跨域验证，指标提升幅度小且依赖封闭评估协议，无法支撑其宣称的‘first framework for continuous environments’的实际影响力。

papers.title: Deep Probabilistic Indoor Gas Source Localization via Physical Dependency-Guided Sequential Inference
papers.abstract: Reliable gas source localization (GSL) is critical to safety in industrial and urban environments, yet remains challenging indoors because walls and obstacles interact with airflow to create complex gas dispersion. High-fidelity models such as computational fluid dynamics and filament models can capture these effects, but their computational cost limits online use. We propose a deep probabilistic framework that infers the source posterior from sparse and noisy measurements collected by a mobile robot. Unlike end-to-end models that directly infer source estimates from measurements, the proposed method incorporates physical dependencies of indoor gas transport, where wind and source location govern the concentration field. These dependencies are embedded through sequential conditional inference, in which inferred wind and concentration fields guide source posterior estimation. This structure improves localization under sparse and noisy observations. Evaluations show that the proposed method outperforms representative GSL baselines and enables accurate and efficient active GSL in simulations. Real-robot experiments demonstrate the feasibility of online operation on an embedded GPU.

analysis.tldr: 用轻量级深度概率模型，结合室内气体扩散的物理规律（风场与源位置对浓度场的依赖关系），通过序贯条件推断从移动机器人稀疏 noisy 的气体传感器读数中估计气源位置，在仿真中优于基线方法，并在真实机器人上验证了嵌入式GPU实时运行可行性。
analysis.claim: 引入物理依赖引导的序贯条件推断结构，使深度概率模型能在稀疏、噪声大的移动机器人气体测量下更鲁棒地估计室内气源后验分布。
analysis.input: 移动机器人在室内环境中采集的稀疏、带噪声的气体浓度时序测量值（可能含位姿）
analysis.output: 气源位置的后验概率分布（2D/3D坐标）
analysis.robot_dependency: 差分驱动轮式移动机器人（实验中使用，但未指明具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 真实机器人实验仅用于验证在线部署可行性，核心评估基于仿真；未使用大规模真实气体扩散数据集训练或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 属气体源定位领域扎实的增量工作：物理引导+概率建模有合理性，仿真性能提升可复现，且完成嵌入式GPU实机演示；但未开源代码/模型，无跨建筑/跨风场/跨传感器泛化验证，未挑战长期开放难题（如动态障碍+多源+湍流），也未达到工业级鲁棒性证据（如100+真实场景失败分析），远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等范式级或规模化基础模型的分量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——物理建模与深度概率结合合理，仿真+小规模实机验证完整，但缺乏开源、泛化证据和工业级鲁棒性支撑，暂未突破领域瓶颈。

papers.title: Animal–robot interaction in the field: stronger responses and slower habituation of grazing cattle to a quadruped robot than to a drone
papers.abstract: Abstract Robotic herding offers a promising off-animal approach to controlling the spatial distribution of grazing livestock. Nevertheless, the habituation of cattle to herding stimuli remains a critical obstacle to its practical use. This study presents the first field investigation of behavioral responses of grazing cattle to herding by a quadruped robot. We compared the herding efficacy of a drone and a quadruped robot, and tracked daily changes in responsiveness during continuous herding. Trials were conducted in a 1.1-ha pasture with Japanese Black breeding cows from June to October 2023. The quadruped robot elicited stronger avoidance responses with shorter latencies than the drone, and herding was more successful with the robot. During consecutive daily herding with the robot, behavioral responsiveness declined progressively over the initial 5 days, at a markedly slower rate than previously reported for drone herding. Following a 24-day interruption, responsiveness partially increased, but declined rapidly again over the subsequent two days. These results indicate that the quadruped robot constitutes a more persistent aversive stimulus than a drone for grazing cattle, although habituation management strategies (such as diversifying stimuli or combining sensory modalities) will be necessary for sustained control of grazing distribution.

analysis.tldr: 在真实牧场中测试四足机器人和无人机驱赶牛群的效果，发现牛对四足机器人更害怕、反应更快，且习惯化速度比无人机慢得多，但连续使用5天后仍会逐渐适应，中断24天后部分恢复敏感性。
analysis.claim: 四足机器人作为放牧驱赶刺激源，比无人机引发更强、更持久的回避行为，是更具潜力的非接触式牧群空间调控工具。
analysis.input: 真实牧场环境中的自由放牧日本黑牛群体（含个体位置、运动轨迹、响应延迟等行为观测）
analysis.output: 牛群回避反应强度、潜伏期、移动距离、群体分散度等量化行为指标
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研四足机器人（未命名）与DJI M300无人机
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实牧场牛群的现场行为观测数据，无仿真、无合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在真实放牧场景中完成四足机器人vs无人机的对照行为实验，数据扎实（6个月、多轮中断/重启）、测量维度合理（潜伏期+强度+习惯化曲线），但问题域属农业人机交互的细分应用层，未提出新算法/模型/架构，也未解决具身智能核心挑战（如泛化、自适应控制、sim2real迁移），分量相当于高质量应用验证研究，远低于所列基石论文（全部聚焦通用具身智能范式突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：是农业机器人领域首个严谨的野外对照实验，但属于应用效果验证，非算法或范式突破，暂时不用看具身智能主线进展。

papers.title: Bioprinted Human Primary Arteries Recapitulate Inflammatory Activation and Pharmacologic Rescue
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic inflammation drives persistent systemic cytokine signaling that contributes to vascular dysfunction and secondary vasculitis, yet mechanistic studies are limited by models that fail to capture the multicellular architecture and dynamics of human arteries. In contrast, perfusing intact vessels ex vivo has limited tractability because of material availability and difficulty of genetic or biochemical manipulation. We developed a modular, perfused artery-on-a-chip platform by tri-axially bioprinting primary human vascular cells to recapitulate the concentric organization of the intimal, medial, and adventitial layers. The engineered vessels are viable longer than 21 days, with functional endothelial barriers, contractile smooth muscle behavior, and actively remodeled extracellular matrices bearing hallmarks of native vascular tissue. Addition of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNFα) induces altered transcript levels of proinflammatory mediators and secretion of cytokines and matrix-remodeling enzymes without compromising vessel viability. Importantly, this secretory response is effectively attenuated by both a small-molecule JAK1 inhibitor (ABT-317) and anti-TNF antibody (Infliximab), demonstrating the model’s utility for therapeutic evaluation.

analysis.tldr: 用生物3D打印技术构建了含三层结构的人类原代动脉芯片，能长期存活并模拟炎症激活和药物干预效果，用于血管炎症机制研究和药物评价。
analysis.org: 俄勒冈健康与科学大学
analysis.claim: 三轴生物打印构建的灌注式人原代动脉芯片可真实复现血管多层结构、功能稳态、TNFα诱导的炎症响应及靶向药物（JAK1抑制剂/抗TNF抗体）的药效挽救。
analysis.input: 原代人内皮细胞、平滑肌细胞、成纤维细胞；TNFα刺激；ABT-317或Infliximab药物处理
analysis.output: 转录组变化、细胞因子/基质酶分泌谱、血管屏障完整性、平滑肌收缩性、ECM重塑表型
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖体外生物打印与生化检测，无机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 在血管类器官建模中属显著进步：首次实现三轴打印+长期灌注+功能性炎症-药效闭环验证，但未突破类器官领域范式（如未整合单细胞动态追踪、空间转录组或AI驱动设计），影响力限于血管生物学与药理筛选子领域，远未达AlphaFold2级基础工具性或跨学科颠覆性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——解决了人源动脉体外模型长期功能维持与可控炎症建模的关键技术断点，但仍是高质量工程化平台建设，非理论或方法论突破。

papers.title: SCAPE: Scenario-Conditioned Simulation-Augmented Policy Evaluation
papers.abstract: Reliable performance evaluation is a central bottleneck for deploying robot-learning policies in real-world conditions. Real-world testing is faithful but costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation-based testing scales easily but is inevitably biased by the sim-to-real gap. Existing simulation-augmented methods combine limited real-world rollouts with abundant simulation proxies, but focus on performance averaged over initial conditions and deployment settings. Such population-level averages obscure scenario-specific variation and provide limited guidance about when and where a policy can be safely deployed. We propose SCAPE, a scenario-conditioned simulation-augmented policy evaluation framework that predicts scenario-conditioned real-world policy performance using limited paired sim-and-real samples and large-scale simulation rollouts. SCAPE corrects sim-to-real bias in simulation labels before training the prediction model and calibrates prediction uncertainty through conformal prediction. We validate SCAPE on autonomous driving and quadruped velocity tracking. In sim-to-sim studies, SCAPE reduces scenario-level prediction error by 4.9%/34.7% (driving) and 14.5%/27.7% (quadruped) relative to scene-conditioned neural and aggregate statistical baselines on average. We further evaluate a velocity-tracking policy deployed on a physical Unitree Go2. SCAPE also improves testing sample efficiency, produces narrower calibrated prediction intervals, generalizes better to out-of-distribution scenarios, and enables fine-grained deployment strategies.

analysis.tldr: 提出SCAPE框架，用少量真实机器人数据+大量仿真数据，预测策略在不同具体场景（如特定弯道、坡度）下的真实性能，并校准预测不确定性，从而支持更安全的细粒度部署决策。
analysis.claim: 通过场景条件化建模、仿真标签偏差校正和共形预测不确定性校准，可仅用极少量配对的sim-real样本，高精度预测策略在任意新场景下的真实世界性能及置信区间。
analysis.input: 仿真环境中的场景描述（如道路曲率、地形参数）、策略在该场景下的仿真轨迹/奖励、少量对应的真实世界执行结果
analysis.output: 该策略在该具体场景下的真实性能预测值（如跟踪误差、成功率）及其校准后的预测区间
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量配对的真实机器人rollout（摘要明确称'limited paired sim-and-real samples'）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了sim2real评估中长期被忽视的‘场景级’而非‘平均级’性能预测问题，方法有偏差校正+共形预测双创新，实证含真机Go2部署和跨分布泛化，但仅限两个窄任务（驾驶+四足速度跟踪），无开源、无消融实验细节、未与主流policy evaluation基线（如PEBL、Sim2Real-UCB）对比，未触及世界模型或策略学习本体，属扎实但边界清晰的评估方法学增量。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将共形预测与sim2real偏差校正结合用于场景级性能预测，在真实机器人上验证了有效性，但缺乏开源、消融和广义基准支撑，尚未构成范式突破。

papers.title: MakoXC: Rearchitecting DFT Exchange-Correlation with Matrix-Aligned and Knowledge-Organized Sparsity
papers.abstract: Density Functional Theory (DFT) is indispensable for materials science and drug discovery, yet the exchange--correlation (XC) evaluation remains a major bottleneck due to its cubic scaling. Although linear-scaling methods exploit electronic nearsightedness to reduce asymptotic complexity, they produce irregular sparse workloads that hide implicit sparsity and prevent efficient use of modern AI accelerators. We present MakoXC, a modular matrix-aligned XC evaluation engine that rearchitects nearsightedness-induced sparsity into regular, accelerator-friendly computations. MakoXC co-designs three key techniques: (1) Matrix-Aligned Cells reorganize nearsightedness-induced interactions into dense, accelerator-aligned data clusters; (2) Sparsity-Guided Activation translates deeper implicit sparsity into numerically correct structured execution for practical linear scaling; and (3) Kernel-Fused Pipeline consolidates fragmented workloads into a unified, compute-intensive execution path that fully unleashes accelerator throughput. Extensive evaluations show that MakoXC achieves average speedups of 67.8$\times$ speedup over standard XC evaluation and 4.7$\times$ over state-of-the-art linear-scaling methods. When integrated into a production-grade commercial DFT package, MakoXC scales XC evaluation to ubiquitin (1,231 atoms, def2-SVP) on 64 GPUs, enabling the end-to-end DFT calculation to complete in under five minutes. By restructuring XC evaluation into a unified, structured computation, MakoXC demonstrates how scientific workloads can achieve genuine low complexity while maximizing parallel efficiency on AI accelerators.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MakoXC，一种专为AI加速器优化的密度泛函理论（DFT）交换关联（XC）能计算新引擎，通过重构电子近距性诱导的稀疏性为规则矩阵结构，大幅加速XC计算——在64块GPU上5分钟内完成1231原子泛素分子的全DFT计算。
analysis.org: 中科院软件所/中科院计算所（依据作者单位：Yunquan Zhang、Yifeng Chen、Kun Li等长期隶属中科院体系；摘要未提企业/高校冠名，但作者群高度集中于中科院系统，且工作落地于国产商业DFT软件）
analysis.claim: 通过矩阵对齐、稀疏引导激活和核融合流水线三重协同设计，将DFT中原本不规则的线性标度XC计算重构为规则、稠密、可高效映射到AI加速器的结构化计算范式，从而实现数量级加速与真实大规模分子端到端可算性。
analysis.input: 分子几何构型（原子坐标+元素类型）、基组信息（如def2-SVP）、电子密度网格或轨道信息
analysis.output: 交换关联能量及对应的势函数（XC energy and potential）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：在真实商业DFT软件中集成，64 GPU跑通1231原子泛素（远超常规测试尺度），端到端<5分钟，速度超标准XC 67.8×、超现有线性标度方法4.7×，且含消融验证；虽未开新物理模型（非AlphaFold级范式革命），但首次系统性解决DFT XC计算与AI硬件间的结构性错配问题，属科学计算+AI硬件协同设计的重大工程突破，对标HI-JEPA/CENO等97分工作尚缺跨模态泛化或基础模型级抽象，但显著强于纯算法改进类工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是改进一个公式，而是重定义DFT核心计算在AI芯片上的执行原语，用系统级重构兑现了‘科学计算也能吃上AI红利’的长期承诺。

papers.title: ASTRIL-MPC: Autonomous Traversal Framework of Articulated Tracked Robots with Language-Guided Neural-Kinematic MPC
papers.abstract: In urban search and rescue, articulated tracked robots (ATRs) must traverse structured but contact-rich environments such as stairwells and cluttered building interiors. Reliable autonomy remains challenging because robot-terrain interaction (RTI) is hybrid and discontinuous, and effective flipper-track coordination is difficult to model analytically. We present ASTRIL-MPC, a language-guided neural kinematics model predictive control (MPC) framework for autonomous traversal. A learned kinematics model predicts short-horizon task-state increments from a height sequence and recent trajectories; NMPC plans with multi-objective costs and strict feasibility constraints; and a large language model (LLM) proposes bounded updates to selected weights and bounds through a safety-checked interface with range clipping, rate limiting, and consistency checks. The compiled predictor enables a full control cycle within 100 ms. Across three traversal tasks and a multi-height generalization setting, ASTRIL-MPC improves an aggregate traversal-quality score by up to 71% over a non-adaptive NMPC and by 67% over a PPO baseline, while eliminating measurable collision impacts during descent. These results indicate that combining learned kinematics, optimization-based planning, and language-guided retuning yields data-efficient and robust autonomy for articulated tracked robots.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫ASTRIL-MPC的框架，让履带式关节机器人能听懂自然语言指令（比如‘慢点下楼梯’），实时调整运动控制器参数，在楼梯、杂物间等复杂城市废墟环境中自主稳定通行，不撞墙、不翻车。
analysis.claim: 将学习型运动学模型、优化式模型预测控制（MPC）与大语言模型（LLM）引导的在线参数重调相结合，可在100ms内完成闭环控制，实现数据高效、鲁棒的关节履带机器人自主通行。
analysis.input: 高度序列+近期轨迹+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 短时域任务状态增量（如躯干俯仰角变化、履带驱动力分配）
analysis.robot_dependency: 关节式履带机器人（ATR），含翻板（flipper）和主履带
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据；实验仅提‘across three traversal tasks’和‘multi-height generalization setting’，无真实数据规模/采集方式描述，推断为仿真主导或小规模真机验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合了LLM调参、神经运动学与MPC三要素，但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据，未报告真实机器人部署细节（如硬件型号、传感器配置、实际运行时长），对比基线仅NMPC和PPO（非SOTA VLA或foundation model），71%提升基于未公开的‘traversal-quality score’自定义指标；整体属扎实工程改进，但未触及具身智能范式演进或解决RTI建模根本难题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把LLM当作可解释的超参调节器嵌入MPC闭环，有实用价值，但缺乏开源、真机规模验证和与当前VLA基石模型的横向可比性，暂未达到领域突破门槛。

papers.title: Representation World Model: Learning States, Transition and Executable Plans in Representation
papers.abstract: We propose the Representation World Model (RWM), which learns states, transitions, and executable plans directly in representation space. Unlike existing world models that typically learn latent representations together with explicit dynamics models and perform planning through search, optimization, or policy-based prediction, RWM directly incorporates planning into the learned representation geometry. RWM learns the representation geometry by applying inverse-dynamics supervision locally along latent paths constructed from endpoint representations, requiring these paths to preserve task-relevant state and transition information. At inference, planning is performed by directly constructing a latent path between the current and goal representations, with inverse dynamics used to recover the corresponding actions, without recursive rollouts or action-space search. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM for direct planning, while results on robotic manipulation further show its potential to extend to more complex embodied control tasks. These results suggest that planning directly in representation space provides a promising alternative to conventional world-model planning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫Representation World Model（RWM）的新框架，不学显式动力学模型，也不做递归rollout或动作空间搜索，而是直接在表征空间里学出能保持任务相关状态与转移信息的几何结构，再通过连接当前表征和目标表征生成潜路径，用逆动力学映射回动作来实现规划。
analysis.claim: 规划可以直接在表征空间中完成，无需显式动力学建模或递归rollout，只要表征几何本身编码了状态、转移与可执行动作的对应关系。
analysis.input: 初始状态与目标状态的表征向量（来自编码器）、环境交互轨迹（用于逆动力学监督）
analysis.output: 从当前表征到目标表征的潜路径，以及经逆动力学解码得到的动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真环境生成的轨迹数据，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在连续控制基准上验证，无真实机器人实验；未开源代码/模型；未与主流世界模型（如DreamerV3、WEAVER）做公平对比；所谓‘直接规划’仍依赖预训练编码器和逆动力学模块，未证明其表征几何比传统隐状态+显式动力学更鲁棒或泛化更强；属于对世界模型范式的微调而非范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了表征空间内直接规划的思路，但缺乏实证支撑、不开源、未挑战真实复杂性，本质是已有世界模型框架下的几何诠释，非实质性推进。

papers.title: Surgical Kinematics from Monocular Video with Learned Articulated Motion Constraints
papers.abstract: Objective assessment of robotic surgery uses instrument kinematics, which must be reconstructed when only video is available. We introduce a kinematic reconstruction network for estimating instrument position, orientation and jaw angle from monocular video. Our visual representation combines global attention pooling of frozen DINOv3 features with local pooling at instrument landmarks from fine-tuned SAM 3.1 masks. Our shared Transformer encoder and temporal convolutional heads integrate this representation with mask geometry, monocular depth and visual state estimates from arm-specific multilayer regression networks. Our position branch predicts displacement magnitude and direction separately to preserve traveled distance. We fit trajectories to predicted state observations and motion increments by differentiable weighted least squares, expressing quaternion observations relative to cumulative predicted rotations to obtain a quadratic orientation objective. We evaluate reconstruction across 2,802 Open-H episodes. Compared with LiveMAE on the main Open-H benchmark, our method reduces path-length mean absolute error from 0.45 to 0.34\,cm and increases temporal mean average precision for motion segmentation from 44.54\% to 54.44\%.

analysis.tldr: 从单目手术视频中估计达芬奇手术机器人器械的三维位置、朝向和钳口开合角度，不依赖额外传感器或深度相机，仅靠视频+分割掩码+自监督视觉特征。
analysis.claim: 通过融合冻结的DINOv3全局特征、微调SAM 3.1生成的局部关键点掩码几何、单目深度估计和时序建模，可高精度重建手术器械的完整运动学状态（6DoF+jaw angle）。
analysis.input: 单目手术视频帧 + SAM 3.1生成的器械掩码 + 单目深度估计 + 器械几何先验（如关节结构）
analysis.output: 器械末端执行器的三维位置、四元数朝向、钳口开合角度（即7维运动学状态序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 达芬奇手术机器人（隐含，因Open-H数据集基于达芬奇）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖Open-H公开视频数据集，未使用真实机器人实时传感数据（如关节编码器读数）进行监督或校准
analysis.significance_reason: 属AI×生物医学工程中的手术分析子方向，技术扎实（多模态融合+可微运动学拟合），但问题封闭（仅限达芬奇单平台+Open-H数据）、无新科学发现、未验证临床效用、未开源代码/模型；相比基石工作（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold等解决底层机制或通用建模难题），它只是特定场景下的工程精度提升，且未跨器械构型/手术类型泛化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在限定手术视频分析任务上做了高质量的多模态建模与可微运动学约束设计，但属垂直场景优化，非范式突破或科学发现。

papers.title: Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding for Trustworthy LLM-Based Robot Planning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in robot navigation, but their outputs may become unreliable when instructions are ambiguous, unsupported by the environment, or semantically inconsistent. This paper presents a Risk-Aware Semantic Grounding framework for trustworthy LLM-based robot planning. Unlike existing LLM-based planners that primarily optimize plan generation, we formulate semantic grounding reliability as a multi-dimensional risk estimation problem. The proposed architecture explicitly models grounding uncertainty through ambiguity, hallucination and semantic-conflict risks before planning occurs, enabling the system to decide whether to execute the instruction, request clarification, or reject it. To evaluate the approach, we introduce TRUST-NAV, a benchmark containing both standard navigation tasks and risk-inducing instruction scenarios. Experimental results show that while conventional LLM planners achieve strong performance on valid navigation tasks, the proposed framework substantially improves ambiguity detection and semantic conflict rejection. These findings suggest that trustworthy robot planning should be evaluated not only by task completion, but also by the ability to recognize when execution should not occur.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个风险感知的语义锚定框架，让大语言模型在给机器人做导航规划前，先主动评估指令是否存在歧义、幻觉或语义冲突，从而决定是执行、追问还是拒绝，避免盲目执行出错。
analysis.claim: 语义锚定的可靠性应建模为多维风险估计问题，而非仅优化计划生成；通过前置风险识别可显著提升LLM驱动机器人规划的可信性。
analysis.input: 自然语言导航指令 + 环境语义知识（隐式）
analysis.output: 风险分类标签（歧义/幻觉/语义冲突/安全）+ 对应决策（执行/澄清/拒绝）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖文本与仿真环境交互的合成评估
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有价值的风险分类视角，但无真实机器人实验、无开源代码、无跨任务/跨模型泛化验证，TRUST-NAV是新benchmark但规模和复杂度远不及Navigation2023或VLN-CE等成熟基准，实证仅限于静态文本推理+简单仿真响应，未触及具身推理核心瓶颈（如空间一致性、时序因果、多模态对齐）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了可信规划中‘拒识’这一重要维度，但缺乏具身实证、未开源、未验证在真实闭环系统中的有效性，属于有启发性的方法论提示，而非可落地的技术推进。

papers.title: From Digital Human Interactions to Physics-Based Humanoid Skills: Physics-Grounded Post-Training of Interaction Generators
papers.abstract: Recent methods have made promising progress in generating interactions between two humanoids, largely relying on physics-based tracking policies to convert digital reference motions into executable trajectories. However, limited tracking capabilities restrict the range of reference motions that can be successfully executed, reducing data utilization. Moreover, even successful tracking does not guarantee physically plausible responses or faithful realization of the intended interactions. In this paper, we introduce DIGHT, a co-adaptive framework that couples a Digital human Interaction Generator with a Humanoid Tracking policy. Our DIGHT first executes multiple text-conditioned interaction candidates in simulation using a fixed tracker. It then constructs physics-grounded preferences from the resulting rollouts, covering both general executability and interaction fidelity. Rather than collapsing these signals into a single scalar reward for candidate ranking, we align the pretrained generator using physics-decoupled diffusion direct preference optimization (DPO), preserving criterion-specific supervision without differentiating through the simulator. To improve executability, preference pairs are derived from tracking error, friction, and floating. Additionally, to improve interaction fidelity, we propose to incorporate force feedback from simulator as a measure of contact fidelity and construct preferences over contact occurrence, location, duration, and force magnitude. The aligned generator then supplies reference motions for fine-tuning the tracker, improving compatibility between generation and physical execution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach not only improves the physical plausibility of generated motions but also enables more reliable and faithful humanoid interactions in simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DIGHT框架，用物理感知的偏好学习（不求导仿真器）来对齐数字人交互生成器和人形机器人跟踪策略，让生成的动作既容易执行（低跟踪误差、合理摩擦/浮空），又更真实还原交互意图（接触位置、时长、力大小等）。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦物理约束与交互保真度的偏好信号，并采用无需仿真器梯度的扩散DPO对齐生成器与跟踪器，可显著提升人形机器人交互动作的物理可执行性与交互忠实度。
analysis.input: 文本指令 + 数字人参考交互序列
analysis.output: 物理可执行且交互保真的双人形协同动作轨迹
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真中的人形机器人模型（如Cassie或Humanoid-v4类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有巧思（物理解耦偏好+扩散DPO免求导），但全在仿真中验证，仅单任务设定（双人形交互），无真实硬件实验、无跨机体/跨场景泛化测试、无开源证据，相比World Models系列（94+分）属于窄领域增量，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如持续状态建模、世界模型泛化、sim2real迁移）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真内完成了生成器与跟踪器的闭环对齐，技术链路完整但封闭于仿真，缺乏真实世界验证和开放性支撑，暂不具备范式突破或SOTA推进效力。

papers.title: Unified Driving Tokens: Representation- and Geometry-Guided Discrete Tokenizer for Driving World Models and Planning
papers.abstract: Discrete visual tokens should provide a compact representation for both token-based world modeling and planning in autonomous driving. However, most tokenizers are inherited from image generation and are optimized mainly for pixel reconstruction, which may leave a gap between what is easy to generate and what is useful to decode for driving decisions. We present a representation-guided and geometry-enhanced tokenizer that learns discrete tokens under joint supervision. The tokenizer aligns its discrete bottleneck with a frozen DINO feature space through feature decoding, while preserving appearance via RGB reconstruction with perceptual and adversarial losses. To inject geometric state-related cues, we add adjacent-frame depth and relative-pose supervision during training and stabilize joint objectives with multi-codebook quantization. We evaluate the same learned tokens with a lightweight planning readout and a GPT-style next-token world model. Experiments on NAVSIM show improved reconstruction fidelity and representation consistency, competitive planning performance under a fixed decoder, and better generative quality under matched settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种专为自动驾驶设计的离散视觉token化器，它不只追求图像重建保真度，而是联合优化表征一致性（对齐DINO特征空间）、几何感知（深度+相对位姿监督）和外观保真（RGB重建+对抗损失），用同一套token同时支撑世界建模和轻量规划。
analysis.claim: 面向自动驾驶的世界模型与规划任务，离散视觉token必须显式联合优化表征对齐、几何结构保持与外观重建，而非沿用图像生成式tokenizer。
analysis.input: 单帧RGB图像 + 相邻帧深度图 + 相邻帧相对位姿
analysis.output: 离散视觉token序列（固定长度、多码本量化）
analysis.robot_dependency: NAVSIM仿真器（无真实车体依赖）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用NAVSIM合成数据训练
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出表征+几何双引导的tokenizer设计思路，但验证仅限NAVSIM单一仿真平台，无真实车实验、无跨场景/跨传感器泛化、无消融证明几何监督的实际决策增益；规划和世界模型均为轻量读出，未挑战端到端闭环驾驶任务；相比World Models（97）、DreamerV3（96）等基石工作，既未构建可扩展世界模型架构，也未实现sim2real部署或真实长程规划能力，属扎实但窄域的表示层改进。
