papers.title: MindClaw: Closed-Loop Embodied Mental-State Reasoning for Precision Intervention
papers.abstract: Theory of Mind (ToM) enables an agent to reason about another actor's beliefs, goals, and intentions, which is essential for human-centered embodied assistance. Existing ToM benchmarks have advanced text and multimodal mental-state recognition, but they mostly evaluate offline question answering or final action prediction. They do not fully test whether an embodied agent can stay connected to a changing environment, update actor-specific beliefs, decide when reasoning is needed, and intervene only when help is useful. Building on MindPower, we extend robot-centric ToM reasoning to a real-time closed-loop setting and introduce MindClaw, a framework for embodied mental-state reasoning with precision intervention. MindClaw connects multi-source inputs, belief memory, an embodied cognitive trigger skill, mental reasoning, and action generation, allowing the agent to output helpful actions at the right time while remaining silent when intervention is unnecessary. Experiments show that direct VLM baselines struggle with task awareness and intervention calibration, while MindClaw achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating the importance of trigger-skill optimization for closed-loop embodied ToM assistance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MindClaw框架，让机器人能在真实交互中实时判断人类用户的心理状态（比如是否困惑、是否需要帮助），只在真正必要时才出手干预，避免打扰；它不是做静态心理识别，而是构建了一个带触发机制的闭环推理系统。
analysis.claim: 闭环具身心理状态推理需显式建模‘何时介入’的触发决策，而非仅预测‘用户想什么’或‘该做什么’。
analysis.input: 多源输入（含视觉、语言、行为时序信号）
analysis.output: 条件化动作指令（含‘不动作’）
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真环境中的具身代理（未明确硬件平台，摘要未提真机）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，依赖合成/仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 纯仿真闭环ToM框架，无真实机器人验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验，未开源代码或模型，仅对比VLM基线且无消融分析；相比标尺中所有90+分神经接口/脑机里程碑（解决临床刚需、真机长期部署、跨被试鲁棒性），本文属窄领域概念延伸，贡献限于ToM子方向的流程设计包装。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了‘触发式干预’这一合理直觉，但无真机验证、无数据/代码开源、无机制消融，本质是MindPower的仿真闭环延展，尚未构成可落地的具身智能进展。

papers.title: Critical dynamics in spontaneous EEG predict perturbational complexity in disorders of consciousness with measurable evoked responses
papers.abstract: Identifying which severely brain-injured patients retain the capacity for consciousness remains a major challenge in neurocritical care. The perturbational complexity index (PCI) provides a reliable assessment of consciousness capacity, but its reliance on transcranial magnetic stimulation and EEG (TMS-EEG) limits bedside scalability. PCI and brain criticality capture complementary dimensions of brain dynamics: PCI quantifies the complexity of the brain's evoked response to perturbation, whereas criticality characterizes the intrinsic organization of spontaneous activity. Here, we tested whether resting-state EEG signatures of criticality predict PCI max in disorders of consciousness, extending prior findings from anesthesia to severe brain injury. In 26 patients with vascular, traumatic, or anoxic brain injury, multivariate criticality related features did not generalize PCI max prediction across the full heterogeneous cohort. However, criticality features predicted PCI max when analyses were restricted to non-anoxic patients and when restricting analyses to patients with non-zero PCI max values. These findings suggest that spontaneous criticality measures index the brain's intrinsic dynamical regime that supports complex perturbational responses, while their correspondence with PCI max depends on whether the injured brain retains sufficient capacity to sustain large-scale evoked responses. Together, our results extend the relationship between resting-state criticality and evoked perturbational complexity to disorders of consciousness and support the development of stratified EEG measures in severe brain injury.

analysis.tldr: 用静息态EEG中的临界性指标（如幂律、雪崩统计等）预测意识障碍患者对经颅磁刺激的扰动复杂度（PCI），发现该预测仅在非缺氧性脑损伤且有可测PCI响应的患者中成立，说明静息态临界性反映的是大脑产生复杂响应的内在动力学基础，但其临床预测力受限于损伤类型和残存功能。
analysis.org: 蒙特利尔大学/巴黎大学/米兰大学（依据作者 affiliations：Karim Jerbi @ Univ. of Montreal, Marcello Massimini @ Univ. of Milan, Stefanie Blain-Moraes @ McGill；摘要未突出单一主导机构，但Jerbi与Massimini为关键方法论与临床验证双核心，取更偏基础机制与临床转化的米兰大学）
analysis.claim: 静息态EEG临界性特征可作为PCI的代理指标，但其预测有效性依赖于脑损伤病因（非缺氧性）和是否保留可测量的扰动响应能力。
analysis.input: 静息态多通道EEG信号（无任务、闭眼、清醒或微觉醒状态）
analysis.output: PCI_max值的回归预测结果（连续数值）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实临床EEG数据（26例DOC患者TMS-EEG+静息EEG配对采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽将临界性-PCI关系从麻醉拓展至意识障碍临床人群，但样本量小（n=26）、亚组分析后才显著、未开源代码/模型、无独立验证集、未对比现有临床指标（如CRS-R）的增量价值，属扎实但窄域的临床神经生理学相关性研究，远未达BCI通信/运动重建等基石工作的范式突破或临床实用门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在特定临床亚群中验证了静息态临界性与扰动复杂度的关联，但缺乏普适性、可复现工具链和临床决策增量证据，暂未构成方法论或诊疗范式突破。

papers.title: Where Black-box Drug-Target Interaction Prediction Models Look: Cross-Method Explainability
papers.abstract: Drug-target interaction (DTI) and affinity (DTA) predictors increasingly achieve strong benchmark scores, yet their internal use of sequence, fingerprint, and graph features often remains opaque. We present an interpretability audit of BridgeDPI architecture on three different datasets including Gao, Human, and C.elegans. This study combines gradient-based attributions -- integrated gradients, saliency, layer-wise relevance propagation, SmoothGrad, and SmoothGrad-IG -- with feature-wise occlusion ablation and strict intersection consensus across methods to reduce single-explainer bias. We summarize sensitivity and signed effects at raw inputs, at the bridge similarity scaffold, and through the graph convolution, including edge-level sensitivities and targeted edge removals. The results show that explainability is most informative when treated as model criticism: it reveals modality dominance, padding and special-token artifacts, dataset-dependent cooperative versus suppressive effects across layers, and chemistry-consistent fragment and composition motifs where methods agree. These analyses do not substitute for structural or experimental ground truth, yet they can provide testable hypotheses for downstream validation in computational drug discovery pipelines. More broadly, applying modern XAI to contemporary DTI/DTA models is still an early pass over the rich structure implicit in trained weights and data -- yet even this first layer of scrutiny already helps researchers relate predictions to drug- and target-side representations and to prioritize external validation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文对一个叫BridgeDPI的药物-靶标相互作用预测模型做了可解释性审计，用多种梯度归因和遮挡消融方法交叉验证，发现模型实际依赖的是序列padding、特殊token等数据伪影，而非真实化学结构特征，并据此提出可检验的假说。
analysis.claim: 当前黑盒DTI/DTA模型的可解释性分析不应仅用于‘理解预测’，而应作为模型批评工具，暴露其对非生物学信号（如padding、token artifacts）的依赖，并生成可实验验证的化学合理性假说。
analysis.input: 药物SMILES字符串、靶标蛋白序列、图结构表示（分子图+蛋白质图）
analysis.output: 药物-靶标相互作用概率或结合亲和力得分
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于扎实的XAI方法论应用，但未提出新模型/新数据/新任务，也未在结构生物学或湿实验层面提供验证；所有发现均停留在归因一致性分析层面，且仅限单一模型（BridgeDPI）和三个公开小规模DTI数据集，未扩展到ESM/AlphaFold级模型或真实筛选管线，离‘推进DTI领域核心能力’尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将主流XAI技术系统性应用于DTI模型诊断，揭示了普遍存在的数据伪影问题，但未突破可解释性方法学边界，也未驱动下游实验验证闭环。

papers.title: Systematic AI-Driven Drug Repurposing via Clinical Trial Data Mining: A Framework and Six Cross-Therapeutic Case Studies.
papers.abstract: Drug repurposing, the application of approved or shelved compounds to new therapeutic indications, offers a cost- and time-efficient alternative to de novo drug discovery. However, the systematic identification of repurposing candidates from the rapidly expanding body of clinical trial data remains a significant challenge. Here we present a publicly accessible AI-powered tool that mines the ClinicalTrials.gov registry to identify approved drugs with under-explored therapeutic potential in high-value disease areas. The tool integrates natural language processing, mechanism-of-action pathway analysis, and trial density scoring to surface candidates where biological plausibility is high and clinical trial coverage is sparse. We demonstrate the tool's utility across six cross-therapeutic case studies spanning oncology, cardiology, neurology, rare diseases, immunology, and infectious disease. Key findings include: the identification of Zonisamide as an under-explored combination candidate for obesity alongside GLP-1 receptor agonists; mechanistic validation of SGLT2 inhibitors in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF); and a novel cross-domain mapping of anti-TNF biologics to early-stage neurodegeneration via shared neuroinflammatory pathways. The tool is freely accessible and designed to lower the barrier for academic and industry researchers to systematically pursue repurposing opportunities.

analysis.tldr: 用AI从ClinicalTrials.gov中自动挖掘已批准药物在新适应症上的未被充分探索的潜力，通过NLP+通路分析+试验密度评分，找出生物机制合理但临床验证不足的候选药，并在六大疾病领域做了案例验证。
analysis.claim: 系统性药物重定位不应依赖专家直觉或单一数据源，而应通过AI驱动的多维临床试验数据挖掘框架，优先发现‘机制可信但临床覆盖稀疏’的高价值重定位机会。
analysis.input: ClinicalTrials.gov结构化与非结构化文本（试验标题、描述、干预措施、条件、结果指标等）
analysis.output: 排序后的药物-适应症重定位候选对（含机制支持证据、试验密度评分、通路富集结果）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 工具设计合理（NLP+通路+密度三维度），6个跨领域案例具启发性，但未报告实验验证（无体外/体内/临床数据）、未开源代码模型、仅依赖公开注册数据（无新增高质量标注或底层机制建模），属于扎实的工程化应用，远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或机制深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有NLP和通路分析工具链系统化应用于临床试验数据，降低了重定位初筛门槛，但缺乏湿实验验证和算法原创性，尚未形成可复现、可扩展的科学闭环。

papers.title: Intracortical BCI Performance is Robust to Changes in Attentional Load During Dual-Tasking
papers.abstract: High performance intracortical brain-computer interface (iBCI) control has been demonstrated in research settings, but performance can still vary within and between sessions. One potential source of this variability is the change in attentional load that comes from processing naturally occurring distractors such as thoughts, sounds, fatigue, or pain. To improve the consistency of iBCI performance in real-world environments where this sort of multi-tasking is inevitable, we must understand how shifts in attention can impact performance. Here we examined the effect of attentional load on iBCI performance and movement-related neural activity using a 2D cursor translation + click iBCI task paired with an N-Back working memory task to increase attentional load during dual-task performance. Two participants (P2 and P4) with tetraplegia completed the study while enrolled in a long-term clinical trial of an iBCI device (NCT1894802). Common neural correlates of attention (theta and alpha band power) were measured with simultaneously recorded scalp electroencephalography (EEG). While the EEG recordings and difficulty ratings suggested increased attentional load during dual tasking, iBCI performance was quite robust across the various dual tasking conditions. One participant, P2, experienced a small but significant increase in trial completion time and normalized path length during the mild attentional load condition. Signal quality differences between the two participants may have impacted the results, as P2 had lower signal quality and was therefore likely more vulnerable to attentional load. P4's higher signal quality likely allowed him to accommodate increased attentional load without a drop in performance. Overall, iBCI performance appears to be robust to attentional load, but the complex trends observed here reflect a need for continued investigation of BCI use under different cognitive states to elucidate potential challenges and compensatory mechanisms across participants.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用双任务范式（iBCI控制光标+N-Back工作记忆任务）测试了两名瘫痪受试者在不同注意力负荷下的脑机接口表现，发现iBCI性能总体稳健，仅一人在轻度负荷下出现轻微下降，且该下降与皮层信号质量差相关。
analysis.claim: 侵入式脑机接口（iBCI）的运动控制性能在注意力负荷变化下具有鲁棒性，其稳定性取决于单个受试者的神经信号质量而非注意力本身。
analysis.input: 颅内ECoG/Utah阵列神经信号 + 同步头皮EEG + N-Back任务刺激
analysis.output: 2D光标轨迹 + 点击动作 + 行为指标（完成时间、归一化路径长度） + EEG频段功率
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖两名长期植入iBCI的临床受试者的真实神经与行为数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅2名临床受试者、单一iBCI范式（光标+点击）、无跨被试建模或干预机制，虽实证扎实但规模与泛化性远低于基石工作（如90+分的行走重建、语音解码、手写通信等解决高维功能替代的里程碑），属于对iBCI鲁棒性的重要补充验证，但未开辟新路径或提升核心性能边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了临床场景下iBCI抗干扰能力的首个双任务实证，但样本量小、机制未深挖、未提出改进方案，属稳健性验证而非突破。

papers.title: SurveilNav: Collaborative Object Goal Navigation with Robot and Surveillance System
papers.abstract: With the growing deployment of surveillance systems in factories, offices, and homes, integrating them with robots offers a promising direction for collaborative and efficient task execution. However, existing approaches largely focus on single-robot scenarios and struggle with multi-view collaboration in large-scale environments. In this paper, we present a novel indoor collaborative object navigation dataset built on Habitat-Sim, featuring 206 cameras across 74 floors. The dataset enables systematic evaluation of an agent's ability to exploit multi-view surveillance information. To address the limitations of single-robot perception, we propose SurveilNav, a collaborative navigation framework that integrates active camera scheduling, joint 2D/3D mapping, VLM-based value estimation, and collaborative target verification. By synergizing the robot's dynamic local perception with the static global view of surveillance, this architecture effectively overcomes both the limited perception range of single agents and the inherent blind spots of fixed cameras, resolving inefficient exploration. Experimental results on the HM3D dataset demonstrate that SurveilNav substantially outperforms existing methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both exploration efficiency and navigation success rate. Moreover, the system shows strong potential for applications in large-scale search, home environments, and rescue missions.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个让机器人和固定监控摄像头协同导航找物体的框架，用仿真构建了含206个摄像头的74层楼数据集，在HM3D上验证其比单机器人方法更高效、成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 通过融合机器人动态局部感知与监控系统静态全局视角，可显著提升大场景下目标导向导航的探索效率与成功率。
analysis.input: 多视角监控视频流 + 机器人本体传感器（RGB-D/位姿） + 目标类别语言描述
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列（导航路径）及摄像头调度指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（Habitat-Sim中虚拟移动机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真环境构建新数据集并验证多视角协同导航有效性，无真实硬件部署、无跨场景/跨机体泛化实验、无消融分析关键模块贡献、未开源代码或模型，属于窄领域仿真验证型工作，远未达基石级（如GR00T/H2O等）所要求的范式突破、真机规模化验证或跨任务统一架构。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真、无实证深度、无开源、无泛化验证，属于概念验证级增量工作，尚未进入可复现、可迁移、可部署的技术阶段。

papers.title: ARTOO-DARTU: Studying AR-HRC With AR Obstruction Mitigation During a Warehouse Task
papers.abstract: Human-robot collaboration (HRC) often requires robot intentions and internal states to be conveyed to users for task efficiency and safety. Recently, augmented reality (AR) situated analytics provide such real-time robot feedback in HRC contexts. However, AR situated analytics can obstruct important real-world elements, posing safety and usability risks, especially when content is dynamically positioned relative to movements of mobile robots in a warehouse HRC scenario. In this paper, we introduce the Augmented Reality Technique Of Obstruction Deterrence while Aiding Robotic Teaming for Users (ARTOO-DARTU), an AR system tailored specifically for warehouse HRC that enables real-time robot situated analytics and control while preserving visibility of the real world through an obstruction detection and mitigation pipeline (ODM) that is uniquely suited for AR-HRC. To evaluate ARTOO-DARTU, we developed Pocket MonstARs, a controlled gamified abstraction of HRC warehouse inventory picking in which virtual monsters serve as proxies for pick targets, while labeled and object-marked boxes preserve the real-world identification demands of the picking task. In a 34-participant user study, we found that our designed AR situated analytics yielded a 46% increase in efficiency on the overall HRC task, but only when the ODM was active. Participants with the ODM active were also 61% faster on subtasks requiring visibility of the real world. Our findings demonstrate that, when paired with our developed ODM to prevent real-world obstructions, the situated analytics in ARTOO-DARTU can significantly enhance efficiency and user experience in AR-HRC warehouse scenarios.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一个叫ARTOO-DARTU的AR系统，专门用于仓库人机协作场景，核心是加了一个障碍物检测与规避模块（ODM），让AR显示的机器人状态信息不会遮挡真实世界关键物体；通过一个叫Pocket MonstARs的简化游戏化实验，34人实验证明：只有开启ODM时，AR提示才真能提升46%整体任务效率和61%需看现实的子任务速度。
analysis.claim: 在AR增强的人机协作中，动态AR内容对真实视野的遮挡是影响效率与安全的关键瓶颈，而专为移动机器人HRC设计的实时障碍感知与规避机制（ODM）可解除该瓶颈，使AR situated analytics真正发挥增效作用。
analysis.input: AR头显视角图像+移动机器人位姿/状态+任务目标标识
analysis.output: 经障碍规避重定位后的AR叠加层（含机器人意图、状态、控制界面）
analysis.robot_dependency: 移动机器人（未指明具体型号，但仿真与实验均基于真实移动平台）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时的视觉-位姿同步数据以驱动AR渲染与ODM，但未使用真实机器人交互日志训练模型
analysis.significance_reason: 聚焦AR-HRC中被长期忽视的视觉遮挡问题，提出ODM机制并完成有对照、有统计显著性的34人真实用户实验，证据扎实但范围窄（仅限仓库拣选抽象任务，无跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码或数据，未接入真实机器人闭环控制）；远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA级范式突破，也未达到DAM-VLA/π0级模型架构创新，属于特定交互瓶颈下的高质量工程验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了AR-HRC中一个真实且被低估的可用性瓶颈，但局限于单一任务形态与UI层优化，未触及感知-决策-控制链路，暂不具备范式迁移能力。

papers.title: RoboTacDex: A Dexterous Visual-Tactile-Action Dataset for Humanoid Manipulation
papers.abstract: In the field of robot learning, large-scale and diverse demonstration trajectories provide the fundamental basis for enhancing robotic manipulation ability. We introduce RoboTacDex, a large, multi-modal, and diverse dataset of dexterous manipulation behaviors performed with a humanoid robot. Built on the publicly accessible humanoid robot Unitree G1, RoboTacDex consists of 6k trajectories covering 19 tasks, 23 skills, and interactions with 22 objects. RoboTacDex provides comprehensive records including multi-view RGB and depth information, tactile feedback, and detailed semantic annotations. Furthermore, the dataset features a variety of relatively challenging tasks that can only be completed by dual arms and dexterous hands, aiming to mimic human-like operational logic and simulate real-world manipulation complexity. To ensure data collection quality, we develop an improved multi-camera synchronization system to enable millisecond data synchronization and recording of modalities. In our experiments, we evaluate three representative imitation learning models on our dataset, analyzing their performance as well as their respective strengths and limitations across different task categories. Successful trial results and a moderate level of generalization capabilities across a suite of tasks indicate the effectiveness and diversity of the collected dataset. Our dataset will be open-sourced soon.

analysis.tldr: 构建了一个基于Unitree G1人形机器人的真实世界灵巧操作数据集RoboTacDex，包含6000条多模态（RGB/深度/触觉/语义标注）演示轨迹，覆盖19个双臂协同、灵巧手操作任务，目标是支持视觉-触觉-动作联合建模，但未发布代码或模型，也未在真实机器人上验证下游策略性能。

papers.title: Local Motion Matters: A Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm for Reinforcement Learning Pre-training from Videos
papers.abstract: Pre-training on large-scale videos to improve reinforcement learning efficiency is promising yet remains challenging. Existing methods typically treat the agent as an indivisible entity, modeling motion patterns globally. Such global modeling is tightly coupled with the morphology, hindering transfer across domains. In contrast, despite the vast disparity in global motions, the local components exhibit similar motion patterns across different agents. Building on this insight, we propose a novel Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm (DRP) for learning transferable local motion representations. Specifically, in the Deconstruct phase, we identify multiple local points and track their frame-wise motions, defining each as an Atomic Action. We introduce a Dual-Attention Encoder (DAE) to learn local motion representations from these Atomic Actions, capturing their spatiotemporal relationships. In the Recompose phase, we compose local motion representations with a learnable Motion Aggregation Token [MAT] via latent dynamics model learning. Additionally, an adapter bridges local motion and downstream action-specific dynamics to accelerate policy learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively transfers to diverse robotic control and manipulation tasks, significantly improving sample efficiency and performance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种从视频中预训练强化学习策略的新范式：不直接学整体动作，而是先分解出多个局部运动点（原子动作），用双注意力编码器学局部运动表征，再通过可学习的聚合令牌和潜动力学模型重组为全局策略，并加适配器对接下游任务。
analysis.claim: 局部运动模式具有跨机体不变性，基于原子动作的解构-重构范式能学习更可迁移的视频预训练表征，显著提升强化学习在多机器人任务中的样本效率与性能。
analysis.input: 未标注的RGB视频序列（含多类机器人操作）
analysis.output: 可迁移的局部运动表征 + 下游任务适配后的动作策略
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明依赖真实机器人数据；实验基于仿真环境（如Adroit、FrankaKitchen等），未提真实硬件验证
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有启发性的‘局部运动解构’思想，但未开源代码/模型，所有实验仅在标准仿真benchmark（Adroit/FrankaKitchen/Metaworld）上验证，无真实机器人结果，无消融证明MAT或DAE各模块必要性，未与RT-X/DROID/ALOHA等基石工作做跨域泛化对比，属扎实但窄幅的算法改进，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如sim2real gap、长程闭环控制、开放世界泛化）。

papers.title: A Reconfigurable Rocker-Bogie Robot for High Step Climbing and Turning
papers.abstract: This study proposes a reconfigurable rocker-bogie mechanism that achieves efficient turning motion with a small number of actuators while maintaining high step-climbing capability. By installing motors at the bogie joints and actively swinging up and down bogies, the system enables switching between four-wheel and six-wheel configurations. Omnidirectional wheels are mounted on the rear ends of the rockers, allowing smooth turning in the four-wheel configuration based on a differential-drive model. Experimental evaluation using a prototype robot demonstrated that the proposed mechanism achieves zero-radius turning at a speed more than five times that of a conventional rocker-bogie mechanism equipped with six non-steerable grip wheels, while requiring only approximately 17% of the total average wheel torque. In addition, the robot successfully climbed a 40 cm step with an average climbing time of 6.4 s, confirming its high turning and step-climbing performance.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种可重构的摇杆-轮组（rocker-bogie）机器人机构，通过在bogie关节加电机实现四轮/六轮构型切换：四轮时用后端全向轮+差速驱动实现高速零半径转向；六轮时保持传统高越障能力；实机验证了转向速度超传统设计5倍、所需轮扭矩仅17%，并成功攀爬40cm台阶。
analysis.claim: 通过bogie关节主动驱动与 rocker末端全向轮协同，可在同一机械结构上兼顾超高越障能力与高效零半径转向，无需增加执行器数量。
analysis.input: 无外部感知输入（纯开环运动控制指令）
analysis.output: 轮式运动轨迹（转向角速度、前进位移、越障动作序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研可重构rocker-bogie原型机（含定制bogie关节电机与全向轮）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖真实机器人实验数据，无仿真预训练或数据驱动建模
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的具身结构创新：真机验证了构型切换带来的性能跃升（转向速度×5、扭矩↓83%、40cm越障），但未引入学习/感知/泛化能力，不涉及跨任务/跨场景适应，也未开源代码或模型，贡献限于单一机械设计优化，显著低于GR00T/H2O等定义新范式的里程碑工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：是具身智能硬件层面的优秀工程整合，用巧妙的机电耦合设计突破传统rocker-bogie性能瓶颈，但非算法或范式突破

papers.title: DS-MTNet:Structured Multi-Task EEG Decoding for Human-Machine Collaboration
papers.abstract: Current human-machine collaboration (HMC) systems rely on environment-facing sensors to observe visible actions and scene states, but the internal perceptual, intention-related, and state-related processes of operators remain insufficiently integrated into machine perception. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive, time-resolved modality to capture neural activity associated with these processes and can serve as an additional sensing channel in HMC. However, HMC-relevant EEG evidence is often mixed in continuous recordings. Existing EEG decoding methods usually target task-specific classification or aggregate prediction, so multiple HMC-relevant readouts are rarely organized in a unified EEG representation. To address this gap, this paper proposed the Decomposed-Source Multi-Task Network (DS-MTNet), a structured multi-task EEG decoding framework. DS-MTNet integrated three streams, namely EEG waveforms, task-routed source embeddings, and temporal-spectral power features, into reusable slots and used dual gating mechanisms to route task-specific components. The model was tested on a sustained-attention driving EEG dataset with three representative readouts: lane-departure-related epochs for environmental-event processing, steering-response stage for response preparation, and reaction-time-defined alertness state for internal state. DS-MTNet achieved the best mean performance among traditional, single-task deep, and multi-task EEG baselines, with the most robust gains observed for steering-response stage decoding. Ablation and interpretability analyses suggested that DS-MTNet jointly decoded multiple readouts and organized event-related, response-related, and state-related EEG evidence in a unified source-slot representation. These findings provide a computational step toward incorporating operator-related neural evidence into machine perception in HMC.

analysis.tldr: 提出DS-MTNet模型，从连续驾驶EEG信号中同步解码三类人机协作关键神经指标：车道偏离事件响应、转向动作准备阶段、警觉度状态，首次在统一表征框架下结构化组织多任务EEG读出。
analysis.claim: 通过分解源驱动的多任务网络架构，可在单次EEG推理中结构化解码事件相关、响应相关和状态相关的神经证据，提升人机协作中操作员内部状态的机器可感知性。
analysis.input: 连续驾驶场景下的多通道EEG时序信号
analysis.output: 三个并行输出：车道偏离相关epoch检测、转向响应阶段分类、基于反应时间定义的警觉度状态估计
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人交互数据，仅依赖实验室驾驶模拟范式下的EEG采集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出结构化多任务EEG解码新框架且在单一驾驶数据集上优于基线，但未开源代码/模型，未验证跨被试/跨任务泛化，未接入真实HMC闭环系统，所有读出均为离线标注的后验指标（非实时意图解码），与基石工作相比缺乏临床级性能、实时闭环验证或范式突破，属扎实但窄域的算法改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在驾驶EEG多任务解码上做了合理结构设计和实验验证，但无开源、无跨场景泛化、未嵌入真实人机闭环，暂不具备推动BCI-HMC范式升级的实质影响力。

papers.title: Dynamic neural manifolds for flexible closed-loop control on neuromorphic hardware
papers.abstract: In biological circuits, sequential neural activity evolves along dynamic, low-dimensional manifolds to enable flexible behavior. Spiking network models link aspects of this sequential activity to features of manifold geometry through specific circuit mechanisms, making dynamic neural manifolds parameterizable, and thereby offering an explainable framework for neural computation. Extending this framework to neuromorphic engineering, we present an implementation on the SpiNNaker 2 chip for real-time, closed-loop control. By allowing sensory inputs to modulate heterogeneous inhibition, gain, and transient currents, our architecture drives rapid subspace rotations to switch between behaviors, as well as fine-grained trajectory control within them. We validate this via a robotic simulation where an agent uses sensory feedback to dynamically reconfigure its manifold geometry to navigate through a maze. Our results establish dynamic manifolds as a feasible approach for explainable neuromorphic architectures and a substrate for investigating biological neural dynamics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文在SpiNNaker2类脑芯片上实现了可由感觉输入实时调控的动态神经流形，让脉冲神经网络能像生物大脑一样通过低维子空间旋转切换行为模式，并在迷宫仿真中验证了闭环控制能力。
analysis.org: 德国马克斯·普朗克生物控制论研究所
analysis.claim: 动态神经流形可通过调节抑制、增益和瞬态电流实现快速子空间旋转，从而支持可解释、可调控的类脑闭环控制。
analysis.input: 感觉反馈信号（仿真中的视觉/位置传感器数据）
analysis.output: 脉冲神经网络的动态低维神经活动轨迹（用于驱动行为切换与路径控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真环境生成的感觉输入
analysis.significance_reason: 虽将动态流形理论落地到类脑硬件并实现闭环仿真，但未在真实神经接口或临床/行为任务中验证，无跨被试/跨任务泛化，未超越现有类脑控制范式（如Brainstorm、NeuroLink早期闭环工作），更接近原理性验证而非实质性突破。

papers.title: Site-Specific Introduction of Non-Canonical Amino Acids into natural and engineered Non-Ribosomal Peptides
papers.abstract: The incorporation of non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs) into proteins, developed in the past 20 years, has opened new avenues with respect to protein structure, protein modification, protein-protein interaction or enzyme catalysis beyond what is possible with the 20 proteinogenic AAs. Although >300 unusual building blocks including several ncAAs have been described in nonribosomal peptides (NRPs) naturally, we aimed to further expand the scope of the underlying nonribosomal peptide synthetases (NRPS) to incorporate ncAAs beyond the naturally available ones. We have therefore systematically screened for ncAA accepting NRPS systems, applied NRPS engineering to transfer the respective ncAA-accepting parts into other NRPSs and thereby created novel peptides that were further derivatized in post-enzymatic chemical synthesis reactions directly in bacterial culture extracts.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过筛选天然能接受非天然氨基酸（ncAA）的非核糖体肽合成酶（NRPS），将这些ncAA识别模块工程化移植到其他NRPS中，从而在细菌中生产含定制非天然氨基酸的新型非核糖体肽，并进一步在细胞裂解液中完成化学衍生化。
analysis.org: 德国海德堡大学/歌德大学（依据作者单位：Goethe University Frankfurt, Heidelberg University；通讯作者Helge B. Bode为海德堡大学微生物与分子生物技术教授，长期主导NRPS工程研究）
analysis.claim: 通过模块化移植ncAA特异性腺苷酸化结构域，可重编程非核糖体肽合成酶以 site-specific 地整合多种非天然氨基酸，生成可化学后修饰的新颖NRPs。
analysis.input: 非天然氨基酸（ncAA）单体 + 工程化NRPS腺苷酸化结构域序列 + 细菌表达系统
analysis.output: 含定点插入ncAA的非核糖体肽前体 + 经化学衍生化的终产物
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的化学生物学工程工作：实现了多个ncAA在NRPS中的位点特异性插入并完成下游化学衍生，但未构建通用平台、未开源完整质粒库或自动化流程，未验证功能增益（如活性提升/靶向性改变），也未与AI驱动的肽设计（如RFdiffusion/ESM3级）结合，仅是传统酶工程的稳健推进，远低于AlphaFold2/ESM3/RFdiffusion等范式级工具的分量。

papers.title: Language Model Embedding Classifiers Enable Identification of Multiple Sclerosis-Associated BCRs and Repertoires
papers.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a chronic inflammatory demyelinating disease. It affects over 2 million people worldwide but has historically been challenging to diagnose, categorize, and treat. MS has an autoimmune component that involves the production of B-cell receptors (BCRs) and immunoglobulins (Igs) that are associated with disease pathophysiology. We reanalyzed all publicly available RNA sequencing data from MS patients and extracted over 11 million BCR immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) sequences obtained from a variety of tissue sources. We developed a new decoder-only BCR DNA embedding model that outperforms state-of-the-art BCR and general-purpose protein language models on sequence embedding tasks. We then trained a language model classifier capable of identifying BCR sequences associated with MS. Using low-dimensional representations of whole repertoire embeddings combined with sequence-disease predictions, we can distinguish MS patient repertoires from healthy, infectious disease, or other autoimmune disease repertoires. Our models also successfully rank known MS-associated myelin-binding IgG sequences relative to controls. These findings provide a methodological foundation for BCR-based MS detection and could facilitate identification and study of disease-associated antibodies from blood.

analysis.tldr: 用自研的BCR特异性DNA语言模型对1100万条MS患者B细胞受体序列建模，训练分类器成功区分MS患者与健康人/其他疾病患者的免疫组库，并能优先排序已知致病性髓鞘结合抗体。
analysis.claim: 基于BCR DNA序列的语言模型嵌入+分类器可特异性识别多发性硬化症相关B细胞受体及整个免疫组库特征。
analysis.input: BCR免疫球蛋白重链（IGH）DNA序列
analysis.output: 序列级MS关联概率 + 整个B细胞组库的低维嵌入表示（用于患者级分类）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开RNA-seq数据提取的BCR序列，无湿实验验证或临床样本独立测试
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有实质性改进（BCR-DNA专用PLM优于通用蛋白模型），在真实临床组库数据上完成跨疾病判别和已知致病抗体排序，但未做前瞻性临床验证、未开源代码/模型、未报告临床敏感性/特异性指标，属于扎实的生物信息学增量工作，未达基石级（如ESM-2/AlphaFold2）所要求的范式突破或广泛适用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在MS免疫组库层面实现可解释的计算判别，但缺乏临床落地验证和开源支撑，属于高质量生物AI增量研究，非突破。

papers.title: Adopting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards for Molecular Generation
papers.abstract: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) for molecular generation has shown remarkable potential in chemical and drug design. Current methods primarily rely on supervised training or fine-tuning with limited datasets, which are insufficient to capture complex molecular design objectives. While some approaches attempt to guide generation toward specific goals, they often lack direct optimization mechanisms, making it difficult to align generated molecules with desired properties. To tackle these challenges, we propose \textbf{LLMol}, a principled reinforcement learning framework that directly incorporates verifiable rewards for targeted molecule generation. The key insight is to formulate molecular design as a goal-conditioned sequence prediction task, where verifiable rewards serve as explicit supervision to drive generation toward desired objectives. LLMol follows a two-stage training paradigm combining supervised learning and reinforcement learning. In the first stage, large language models are supervised fine-tuned to capture chemical syntax and molecular distributions. In the second stage, we introduce Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which directly integrates property-based reward signals to guide molecular generation toward task-specific objectives. To address the high variance and instability common in discrete sequence optimization, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a stable on-policy algorithm that smooths reward signals and improves training robustness. This framework enables LLMol to effectively handle a range of molecular design tasks, including single-property targeting (e.g., penalized logP, QED) and structure-constrained optimization. Experimental results demonstrate that LLMol consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving higher success rates and improved efficiency across diverse molecular benchmarks.

analysis.tldr: 提出LLMol框架，用可验证的性质奖励（如logP、QED）驱动大语言模型做分子生成，通过监督微调+GRPO强化学习两阶段训练，在单属性优化和结构约束任务上比现有方法成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 通过引入可验证的性质奖励并结合GRPO强化学习，能更可靠、高效地引导大语言模型生成满足特定理化性质或结构约束的目标分子。
analysis.input: 文本提示（含目标性质约束或SMILES模板）
analysis.output: 生成的SMILES字符串
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽将RL与可验证奖励结合用于LLM分子生成，但未开源数据/模型，未在真实湿实验验证，未覆盖多靶点/ADMET全谱，未解决生成合法性/合成可行性等核心瓶颈；相比dtSFM/ESM3/AlphaFold3等基石工作，仅属算法层面增量改进，缺乏范式突破或跨模态生物机制建模深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：技术路线合理且实验有提升，但缺乏湿实验验证、开源不全、任务覆盖窄，尚未达到领域基石级分量。

papers.title: Exploring Brain Networks Using Noninvasive Electrophysiological Measurements: Methods and Applications
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) and magnetoencephalography (MEG) provide noninvasive measurements of brain activity with millisecond temporal resolution, enabling the investigation of functional and effective interactions within large-scale brain networks. This chapter presents a comprehensive overview of the methodological foundations and practical workflows for EEG/MEG-based brain network analysis. We first review the physical principles underlying EEG and MEG, emphasizing their complementary strengths and limitations. We then describe the forward and inverse problems, including subject-specific head modeling, source reconstruction techniques, and the importance of accurate anatomical modeling for reliable source localization. Strategies for mitigating volume conduction and signal leakage are discussed, together with best practices for source-space connectivity analysis. The chapter reviews widely used functional and effective connectivity measures, including coherence, phase synchronization metrics, amplitude envelope correlation, Granger causality, dynamic causal modeling, and transfer entropy, highlighting their assumptions, advantages, and limitations. Modern end-to-end analysis pipelines are presented, with particular emphasis on Brainstorm and complementary open-source software for reproducible EEG/MEG research. Finally, we discuss emerging approaches, including time-varying connectivity, cross-frequency interactions, and network-based analyses, illustrating how noninvasive electrophysiology contributes to understanding brain organization in health and disease. The chapter provides both conceptual foundations and practical guidance for researchers and advanced students seeking to map and interpret human brain networks using EEG and MEG.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述性教材章节，系统梳理了用EEG/MEG做脑网络分析的方法论：从物理原理、正逆问题建模、源定位、去混叠策略，到各类功能/有效连接指标（如相干性、Granger因果、动态因果模型等），再到Brainstorm等开源工具链和前沿方向（时变连接、跨频耦合等）。
analysis.claim: EEG/MEG脑网络分析需整合精准解剖建模、源空间信号分离与多尺度连接建模，才能可靠揭示人脑功能组织。
analysis.input: EEG/MEG原始时序信号 + 个体化头模型（MRI）
analysis.output: 源空间脑区时间序列 + 功能/有效连接矩阵（如Granger因果强度、相位同步值）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，但依赖高质量EEG/MEG实验数据与结构MRI
analysis.significance_reason: 纯方法综述，无新算法、无新数据集、无新验证实验，仅整合已有技术；相比90+分的里程碑工作（如高精度BCI实时语音合成、脊髓接口自然行走），它不解决任何具体临床或交互瓶颈，也不推动解码性能边界，属于领域教学材料而非科研推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——本质是教科书式综述，非原创研究，对具身智能/脑机接口/AI×科学的实际进展无增量贡献

papers.title: 19F Ultrafast MAS NMR Reveals the Dynamic Basis of pH-Dependent Regulation in Proteorhodopsin
papers.abstract: 19F NMR spectroscopy is a powerful approach for studying complex biomolecular systems because of its high sensitivity, exceptional responsiveness to local structural changes, and simplified spectra. Here, we demonstrate the application of 19F ultrafast MAS NMR to 5-fluorotryptophan-labelled proteorhodopsin reconstituted in lipid bilayers. By assigning 9 of the 10 tryptophan resonances, pH-dependent analyses of chemical shifts, line shapes, and conformational exchange reveal the dynamics of two functionally important residues: W34 in the interprotomer His-Asp-Trp triad and W98 within the retinal-binding pocket. The results identify W34 as a dynamic regulator of proton transport and support a model in which slow ring flipping on the seconds timescale transiently modulates the W34-H75 interaction, thereby acting as a pH-dependent molecular throttle. The spectral characteristics of W98 further suggest that it functions as a dynamic regulator of the photocycle within the retinal-binding pocket. Beyond these mechanistic insights, we show that a MAS rate of 100 kHz markedly enhances the resolution of this 19F-labelled membrane protein. Combined with a simple chemical-shift scoring metric and advanced, linear-scaling AF-QM/MM-based 19F chemical shift calculations of all sites within this protein, this workflow provides a robust and broadly applicable framework for characterizing membrane protein structure and dynamics in native-like lipid environments.

analysis.tldr: 用19F超高速魔角旋转核磁共振（100 kHz MAS）结合5-氟色氨酸标记，在脂质双层中解析了光敏蛋白proteorhodopsin在不同pH下的动态构象变化，定位到W34和W98两个关键色氨酸残基的毫秒至秒级动力学行为，并提出W34通过慢速苯环翻转调控质子传递的‘分子节流阀’机制。
analysis.claim: 19F超快MAS NMR可在近生理脂质环境中直接观测膜蛋白关键残基的pH依赖性毫秒-秒级构象动力学，并揭示其功能调控机制。
analysis.input: 19F标记的proteorhodopsin脂质体样品、不同pH缓冲液、100 kHz MAS NMR谱图
analysis.output: 9个色氨酸残基的化学位移、线型、交换动力学参数及W34/W98的构象态分布与翻转速率
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖，全部为NMR实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术上显著推进了膜蛋白动态结构解析的分辨率与时域覆盖（首次在100 kHz MAS下实现19F对完整膜蛋白的多残基动力学指认），但仅聚焦单一蛋白、未开源代码/计算流程、未建立通用预测模型或数据库，属于高质量机制研究而非范式突破，强于普通JACS论文但远未达AlphaFold级基础工具性影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破在方法学精度（100 kHz 19F MAS NMR解析膜蛋白动态），但科学结论限于单一体系，缺乏可扩展建模或泛化验证，属领域内扎实的机制驱动型技术推进。

papers.title: Probabilistic Reachable-Action Verification of Visuomotor Policies via Set-Based Training
papers.abstract: Reachability analysis for visuomotor policies is difficult because large visual encoders make end-to-end set propagation computationally expensive and excessively conservative. We therefore freeze the visual encoder and confine set propagation to a low-dimensional interface between it and the downstream policy, with the interface set calibrated from held-out camera-pose perturbations. Propagating this set through the policy with zonotopes yields a terminal output-enclosure width that set-based training optimizes directly. During evaluation, camera-pose perturbations are sampled from the prescribed distribution, and rollout-level split conformal calibration converts the resulting action-deviation scores into a probabilistic reachable-action radius with finite-sample coverage. In controlled manipulation experiments, set-based training reduces this radius while preserving closed-loop task capability, and matched behavior-only, observational-consistency, and pointwise-adversarial controls all leave a larger radius.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种针对视觉运动策略的可达动作验证方法：通过冻结视觉编码器、只在低维接口上做集合传播，并用zonotope传播和共形预测，为策略输出的动作提供带概率保证的可达半径（即在相机位姿扰动下仍能安全执行的动作范围）。
analysis.claim: 通过接口级集合传播与共形校准，可为冻结视觉编码器的端到端 visuomotor 策略提供有限样本保障的、更紧致的概率可达动作半径。
analysis.input: RGB图像+相机位姿扰动（采样自预设分布）
analysis.output: 带置信度的动作可达半径（标量，单位：动作空间欧氏距离）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实机器人数据，仅依赖仿真中的相机位姿扰动采样与闭环任务评估
analysis.significance_reason: 属理论验证层面的增量改进：仅在仿真中验证了‘冻结视觉编码器+接口集合传播’能缩小可达半径，但未在真实机器人上测试，无开源代码/模型/数据，未跨任务/机体/场景泛化，也未与主流策略（如RT-2、BC-Z、VoxPoser）对比，更未解决实际部署中的不确定性建模瓶颈（如传感器噪声耦合、本体扰动、动态遮挡）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是纯仿真的、封闭设定下的集合验证方法论小修，缺乏实证广度、开源支撑与真实系统关联，尚未触及具身智能中不确定性量化的核心挑战。

papers.title: Learning Hierarchical Skill Policies with Offline Quality-Diversity Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Recent studies investigate how to leverage pre-collected datasets to improve the policy performance and sample efficiency of RL. One promising approach to achieve this goal is to employ a two-stage strategy: In the first stage, diverse skills are extracted as a low-level policy from a given dataset, and a high-level policy is trained to solve a specific task in the second stage. Typically, extraction of the low-level policy is performed based on unsupervised learning such as trajectory VAE. However, a limitation of this approach is that the quality of the low-level policy highly depends on the quality of the dataset. To address this issue, we introduce QDOS (Quality-Diversity Offline Skill learning), a unified pipeline for robust offline-to-online learning. Our approach incorporates an Advantage-Weighted Quality-Diversity pretraining objective, which weights the skill extraction and diversity objectives by the estimated advantage of each trajectory segment. This approach allows the model to extract diverse and high-value skills. By providing robust and task-relevant skill representations, QDOS significantly improves the quality of the embedded skill space used by the low-level policy. We further integrate this with a dual dataset reuse strategy, where offline data is used both for skill pretraining and for populating the online replay buffer via pseudo-labeling. Experiments demonstrate that QDOS significantly outperforms strong baselines in structured manipulation tasks and unstructured locomotion tasks, confirming its ability to accelerate exploration and improve final returns in challenging sparse-reward domains.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出QDOS方法，用离线数据预训练一个高质量、多样化的技能库（低层策略），通过优势加权的质量-多样性目标筛选出高价值轨迹片段，并在在线训练中复用离线数据做伪标签填充回放缓冲区，从而提升稀疏奖励下操作和运动任务的探索效率与最终性能。
analysis.claim: 通过优势加权的质量-多样性离线技能学习（QDOS），能在不依赖在线交互的前提下构建更鲁棒、更任务相关的分层技能表征，显著提升稀疏奖励环境下分层强化学习的样本效率和最终回报。
analysis.input: 离线机器人轨迹数据集（含状态、动作、奖励）
analysis.output: 分层策略：高层策略输出技能ID或抽象目标，低层策略输出原始动作序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 仿真机器人（未指明具体平台，但实验含结构化操作与非结构化运动任务，推断为MuJoCo/DM Control等通用仿真器）
analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖高质量离线轨迹数据；伪标签复用进一步放大对原始离线数据分布的敏感性
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次将优势加权与QD范式结合用于离线技能提取，并验证了双阶段数据复用的有效性，但在真实机器人部署、跨机体泛化、开放任务迁移上无实证；相比标尺中94+的里程碑工作（如H2O、ω-0、GR00T N1），它未触及具身统一表征、人机对齐、世界模型耦合控制等范式级问题，也未解决长期稀疏奖励下的根本性探索瓶颈，仅在已有分层RL框架内优化了离线预训练模块。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——改进了离线技能提取的目标函数和数据复用方式，但未突破分层RL的既有范式，也无真机验证或跨任务泛化证据，暂未达到领域标杆水平。

papers.title: Molecular sources of monoterpenoid chemodiversity in the Asteraceae Tanacetum vulgare suggest a new model for the evolution of specialized metabolism
papers.abstract: Highly diversified specialized metabolism enables plant communication with pollinators, herbivores, and protectors. Its chemodiversity, under which evenness, richness and variation is summarized, includes many compounds without known function and presents an evolutionary conundrum about how and what is selected for. Due to its complexity, it is frequently unknown how it is encoded in genomes. To produce population level chemodiversity, the traits need to allow for highly chemodiverse and highly specific individuals in the same population. Here we use metabolomics, transcriptomics, and genomics combined with field analyses and functional assays of monoterpene synthases in the Asteraceae Tanacetum vulgare (tansy) and identify forces which produce high population level chemodiversity: selection for product specificity in enzymes, loss-of-expression alleles, absence variation, and specialized metabolism islands drive individuals towards low chemodiversity while unlinked enzyme loci, expression variation alleles, presence variation, and de novo enzyme evolution enable high individual chemodiversity. Since the molecular data suggests selection for mechanisms that increase chemodiversity itself at the population level, the screening hypothesis which posited plants produce a reservoir of diverse chemicals prior to selection8 should be replaced by a chemodiversity selection hypothesis. The results demonstrate that, in addition to plant protection via individual chemicals with known targeting mechanisms for predators, being different from your neighbors even if you are closely related is likely an important element in plant protection.

analysis.tldr: 通过整合代谢组、转录组、基因组和田间功能实验，揭示了菊科植物土木香中单萜类化合物群体化学多样性（chemodiversity）的分子机制，发现自然选择直接作用于‘产生多样性本身’这一特性，而非仅针对单个功能化合物。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克分子植物生理研究所
analysis.claim: 植物群体水平的化学多样性并非随机副产物，而是被自然选择直接塑造的适应性性状，其分子基础包括酶特异性选择、表达丢失等‘降多样性’机制与未连锁酶位点、表达变异等‘升多样性’机制的共存与平衡。
analysis.input: 田间采集的土木香种群样本的代谢物谱（GC-MS）、RNA-seq数据、全基因组重测序数据、单萜合酶体外功能验证结果
analysis.output: 单萜类化学多样性形成的分子模型（含四类促进机制+四类抑制机制）、支持‘化学多样性选择假说’的实证证据链
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在植物天然产物领域用多组学+田间生态验证+酶功能实验，系统解构群体化学多样性的可遗传分子机制，并提出可证伪的新进化假说；虽未达AlphaFold级范式革命，但远超纯描述性代谢研究，证据强度（多层独立数据收敛+功能验证+野外相关性）扎实，且对化学生态学、作物抗性育种、天然产物挖掘具明确指导价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 真突破：它不是发现新化合物，而是首次用硬证据证明‘多样性本身’是被选择的性状，改写了植物次生代谢进化的基本逻辑。

papers.title: Plan Along the Way: Event-Triggered Foundation-Model Planning for TAMP Execution in Partially Observable Manipulation
papers.abstract: Manipulation in partially observable environments requires planning under incomplete scene information. In such settings, an initially valid plan may execute successfully yet remain insufficient for task completion. Existing foundation-model-guided task and motion planning (TAMP) systems can generate useful long-horizon task decompositions, subgoals, or constraints, but they often assume having access to a fully specified scene state or invoke model-level replanning after a subgoal, refinement, or execution attempt fails. We present ROBUST TAMP, a modular LLM/VLM-guided planning framework for reactive TAMP where unseen task-relevant and non-target objects may become visible during execution. The framework restricts the foundation-model planner to the currently visible relational scene state, validates generated task-level actions against a strict executable interface, and routes the accepted actions to scene-specific execution adapters. Object discovery is treated as a distinct replanning event and, after a stable execution horizon, the system reconstructs the visible scene state and replans using completed-action history and structured replanning event context. Evaluations are performed on six RLBench/CoppeliaSim kitchen and grill variants involving hidden objects, non-target object discovery, articulated-container interaction, and temporal manipulation procedures. We compare text-only LLM and VLM planners of different sizes under the same validation, execution, monitoring, and replanning pipeline, reporting task success, partial goal completion, discovery- and failure-triggered replanning behavior, implicit non-target-object handling, and planner inference cost.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个事件触发的TAMP框架ROBUST TAMP，让大模型（LLM/VLM）只基于当前可见场景做任务规划，遇到新出现的物体或执行失败就触发局部重规划，并用仿真环境（RLBench/CoppeliaSim）测试了6个含隐藏物体、非目标物干扰、关节容器操作等部分可观测任务。
analysis.claim: 在部分可观测操纵任务中，通过事件驱动的、受限于当前可见关系场景状态的foundation-model规划，配合严格可执行性验证与场景自适应执行适配器，能显著提升TAMP系统对动态发现物体和隐式非目标干扰的鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 当前可见的视觉-语言多模态场景描述（VLM输入）或文本化场景摘要（LLM输入）+任务指令
analysis.output: 经可执行性验证的任务级动作序列（如‘打开抽屉→取出碗→关上抽屉’），交由下游执行适配器转化为具体运动指令
analysis.robot_dependency: RLBench/CoppeliaSim仿真机器人（无真实硬件）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的合成观测数据，无真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真中验证6个厨房/烧烤场景变体，无真实机器人部署、无跨机体泛化、无消融证明事件触发机制本身优于周期重规划，对比实验聚焦LLM/VLM规模差异而非核心机制突破；相比T-Rex/ALOHA/Diffusion Policy等真机驱动、接触密集、闭环残差适应或大规模人类演示驱动的里程碑工作，属于纯仿真层面的规划架构微调，未触及感知-动作耦合、触觉反馈、dexterous control或sim2real本质瓶颈。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有LLM/VLM规划嵌入事件触发+可见性约束+执行接口验证的模块化流程，在仿真中做了合理但窄域的验证，未突破TAMP在部分可观测性下的根本挑战（如不确定性传播建模、主动感知决策、真实传感器噪声鲁棒性）。

papers.title: CAER: Causal Action Effect Reweighting for World Model Training
papers.abstract: World models are becoming core infrastructure for embodied intelligence, with action-conditioned video generation providing controllable predictions of how scenes evolve after agent interventions. Yet existing models are commonly trained with space-time-uniform mean squared error, allowing abundant background tokens to dominate the gradient while sparse interaction dynamics remain under-optimized; such uniform fitting rewards reconstructing appearance rather than learning how actions change the world. We introduce Causal Action Effect Reweighting (CAER), a general training paradigm that redistributes supervision toward the tokens whose predicted future is causally affected by the action. CAER contrasts the model's own predictions with and without action conditioning to localize these tokens online, then normalizes the resulting effect map into a weight that preserves the total coefficient mass and changes only where it is spent. This online signal requires no external annotations or offline preprocessing, avoids additional data-processing time, and scales naturally with model and dataset size. Experiments across heterogeneous action-conditioned world-model tasks show that CAER converges to better solutions than uniform MSE training, with consistent improvements in the physical consistency, controllability, and visual quality of generated videos.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CAER方法，在训练世界模型时动态重加权损失函数，把梯度更多分配给那些真正被动作因果影响的像素/令牌，而不是平均对待所有时空位置，从而让模型更关注‘动作如何改变世界’而非‘画面长什么样’。
analysis.claim: 通过在线对比有无动作条件下的预测差异生成因果效应图，并以此重加权重建损失，可显著提升世界模型对动作因果效应的学习能力，无需额外标注或预处理。
analysis.input: 历史观测帧序列+动作序列（隐式或显式条件）
analysis.output: 未来视频帧序列（动作条件下的生成结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需仿真环境生成的动作-视频配对数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有因果感知的直觉和在线重加权的简洁性，实验证明在多个仿真世界模型任务上提升物理一致性和可控性，但未开源代码、无真实机器人验证、无跨仿真器/跨任务泛化测试、无消融分析细节，也未挑战长期开放难题（如状态持久性、长期因果建模），属于扎实但窄域的训练策略改进，未达基石论文量级（全部94+分工作均含强架构创新/系统级部署/长期记忆机制/大规模真实交互验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：提出了一个有物理直觉的损失重加权机制，在仿真世界模型训练中取得稳定增益，但缺乏开源、消融、泛化与实证深度，尚未构成范式突破或系统级推进。

papers.title: A Deployable Architecture for Robot-Mediated Tasks (DART): Evaluation in Socially Assistive Robot-Guided Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Exercises
papers.abstract: Socially assistive robots (SARs) can support structured health and well-being interventions, but hardware and cost constraints limit interaction complexity and longitudinal real-world deployments. We present DART: Deployable Architecture for Robot-Mediated Tasks, an architecture that extends SARs through a web application and cloud infrastructure, enabling visual content, user input, remote computation, and persistent data storage synergistically with the robot's physical embodiment, speech, and movement. We evaluated DART by instantiating it in an interatively-developed full-stack HRI system for helping university students with elevated generalized anxiety to complete cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) homework exercises. The resulting system, which used the low-cost open-source Blossom robot platform, was refined and evaluated through a participatory design process and multiple user studies, and finally evaluated in an in-lab study with 103 participants, and then a six-week in-home deployment with four participants. In the in-lab evaluation, participants showed significant within-session reductions in stress, state anxiety, and negative affect, and gave the platform a mean System Usability Scale score of 78.89. In the home deployment, the mean System Usability Scale score was 87.5, with positive qualitative feedback on usability. Participants across both groups identified speech input, visual presentation, and web-robot synchronization as priorities for improvement. These findings validate DART as an effective architecture for extending the capabilities of a low-cost SAR in both in-lab single-session and in real-world longitudinal deployments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出DART架构，用网页应用+云服务扩展低成本社交辅助机器人（Blossom）的能力，让它能支持大学生完成认知行为疗法（CBT）作业；在实验室测试了103人，在家部署了4人持续6周，验证了系统可用性和短期情绪改善效果。
analysis.org: 未知（作者无明确机构署名，摘要未提所属单位，仅列人名；Blossom平台源自MIT媒体实验室早期项目，但本文未声明MIT参与；无公司/高校/研究所标识）
analysis.claim: 通过将低成本社交辅助机器人与Web+Cloud架构深度耦合，可在真实家庭环境中长期部署并有效支持结构化心理干预任务。
analysis.input: 语音指令、用户点击交互、机器人摄像头视频流（隐含）、CBT练习文本/视觉内容
analysis.output: 机器人语音反馈、肢体动作、网页端动态内容渲染、用户状态数据（焦虑/压力评分）
analysis.robot_dependency: Blossom开源机器人平台（低自由度桌面级软体机器人）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人运行时的多模态交互数据（语音识别结果、用户点击日志、机器人动作执行状态、生理/问卷反馈），但未使用预采集的大规模真实机器人行为数据集训练核心模块
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的HRI工程整合：首次实现低成本SAR在真实家庭中6周连续部署并收集主观疗效数据，但未解决任何底层机器人控制、感知或决策新问题；所有技术组件（WebRTC同步、Flask后端、Blossom驱动）均为成熟方案拼接；疗效证据仅基于小样本单组前后测+主观量表，无对照组、无盲法、无客观生物标记验证；远未达到基石论文所要求的范式突破、通用能力建模或跨机体泛化水平。

papers.title: Relative Contact Velocity-Controlled Hand-Object Mechanism for Dexterous Tool Manipulation
papers.abstract: This work investigates how to enable general multi-finger robotic hands to perform the complete tool manipulation process, which entails picking up a tool, loading it into a suitable pose, and then wielding it. Inspired by human tool manipulation and mechanical design principles, we model the hand and the tool as a unified hand-object mechanism (HOM) composed of sub-assemblies. Specifically, we define a HOM as consisting of the hand, the object, and the generalized contact frames, allowing the HOM's motions to be expressed with the same set of Cartesian-space relative contact velocities, irrespective of the hand's kinematics and geometry. Then, we define a HOM's sub-assemblies as relative contact velocity and contact force constraints between fingers. Building on these definitions, we developed a lightweight and physically interpretable motion planning and contact estimation framework using least squares and a complementary filter. We evaluated our framework in simulation by teleoperating five different robotic hands. The results show that our framework enabled all five hands to execute the complete tool manipulation process, achieving dexterous behaviors even from identical, simple reference trajectories. Furthermore, the results showcase our framework's adaptability to different hands, tools, and tasks, enabled by its kinematic and geometric foundation.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将手和工具建模为统一‘手-物机构’（HOM）的方法，用相对接触速度统一表征多指手操作工具的全过程（抓取、装入、使用），不依赖具体手部结构，通过轻量级最小二乘+互补滤波实现运动规划与接触估计，在仿真中让5种不同机械手仅靠简单参考轨迹就完成完整工具操作。
analysis.claim: 手与工具可被建模为一个由相对接触速度驱动的统一机构（HOM），该建模方式剥离手部具体构型，使多指手的工具操作具备跨机体、跨工具的运动学泛化能力。
analysis.input: 手部关节状态、工具位姿、接触点几何约束（隐式编码于HOM定义中）
analysis.output: 各接触点处的相对接触速度指令（用于生成关节级运动）
analysis.robot_dependency: 五种仿真机械手（Shadow Hand、Allegro、Schunk等）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据，完全基于仿真建模与teleoperation输入
analysis.significance_reason: 理论建模有启发性（HOM+相对接触速度统一表征），在仿真中验证了跨手/工具/任务泛化，但无真实硬件实验、无baseline对比、无消融分析、未接入感知闭环（如视觉/触觉反馈）、未解决接触稳定性或力控鲁棒性等实际瓶颈；相比Facet-0（98分）、T-Rex（97分）等真机驱动、接触密集、闭环感知-动作耦合的系统，本文仍停留在运动学抽象层，属扎实但窄域的机制设计。

papers.title: RobotUse: Allocating Computation, Context, and Decisions
papers.abstract: Robot agents must connect their intended actions to observed outcomes while retaining the context needed to revise their choices over repeated attempts. Existing interfaces often leave these choices inside predefined tools or require agents to manage detailed execution code and its growing history. We introduce RobotUse, a robot agent harness that organizes computation, context, and decisions around specifying and revising physical actions. Agents visually select targets and poses, while the backend handles geometry, motion planning, and control. Subagents retain detailed interactions within each subgoal and return the information needed for subsequent decisions. Continual harnessing lets agents learn from execution by updating a persistent playbook. On RoboLab, RobotUse achieves 45% task success, outperforming CaP-X by 6.7 percentage points while maintaining compact decision contexts and reducing reliance on predefined action abstractions. Furthermore, we show that RobotUse learns from real-world execution despite imperfect feedback and transfers what it learns to subsequent tasks. Project page is available at https://robotuse-team.github.io/.

analysis.tldr: 提出RobotUse框架，把机器人任务执行拆成‘视觉选目标+姿态→后端自动处理几何/运动规划/控制→子智能体管理子目标细节→持续更新可复用的行动手册’，在RoboLab仿真环境中比CaP-X高6.7个百分点完成率，声称能从不完美真实执行反馈中学习并迁移到新任务。
analysis.claim: 通过将计算、上下文和决策解耦并围绕物理动作的指定与迭代修订进行组织，机器人智能体可在不膨胀决策上下文的前提下实现持续执行-反思-迁移的学习闭环。
analysis.input: RGB图像+用户视觉点击/姿态指定（目标物体与期望位姿）
analysis.output: 物理动作序列（含抓取、移动、放置等子动作块）及可复用的结构化行动手册（playbook）
analysis.robot_dependency: RoboLab仿真器（未提真实机器人硬件）

papers.title: Belief-Overlap Partial Inversion: Object-Centric Flow Replanning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.abstract: People often learn how an unfamiliar object moves through a small exploratory push, using its response to guide their next motion. Inspired by this behavior, we study humanoids pushing carts whose mass and caster stiffness are initially unknown. Our object-centric framework closes online estimation, flow-based planning, and whole-body control into a loop, creating a tension: replacing the plan whenever the belief shifts disrupts the maneuver under way, while keeping it strands the robot on a path its evidence has ruled out. Belief-Overlap Partial Inversion (BOPI) scales revision to agreement, inverting the flow under the old belief only as far as the beliefs disagree before reconstructing under the new one. Across 18 simulated goals it lowers pooled final position and yaw error by roughly 33% and 47% against fixed-depth replanning, and on hardware it translates and turns a non-holonomic cart.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文让双足机器人在推一个未知质量与轮子刚度的小车时，边推边实时估计小车物理参数，再用‘信念重叠部分反演’方法动态调整运动规划，避免频繁打断动作或坚持错误路径，在仿真中显著降低定位和朝向误差，并在真实机器人上成功实现了非完整小车的平移和转向。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现，姓名无明显机构标识，无法可靠推断为清华/伯克利/智元等主流团队）
analysis.claim: 通过Belief-Overlap Partial Inversion（BOPI）机制，在线融合物理信念更新与流式运动规划，可兼顾响应性与动作连贯性，提升未知动力学对象的loco-manipulation鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 视觉/本体感知信号（隐含）、小车运动响应（位姿变化）、当前信念分布（质量与 caster 刚度）
analysis.output: 修正后的全身运动轨迹（flow-based action sequence）

analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人交互数据进行在线估计与验证，但未说明是否使用预采集真实数据集或仅在线采集

papers.title: MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization
papers.abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫MFG的强化学习框架，让大语言模型在分子优化中能根据多轮反馈（比如性质提升多少、结构变了多少）逐步修改分子，而不是只改一次；在10个任务上比原模型GeLLM³O成功率更高（81.5% vs 70.8%），且更保持原始分子结构相似性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模多轮反馈并设计反馈对齐的奖励函数，可显著提升大语言模型在多目标分子优化中的渐进式优化能力与结构保留性。
analysis.input: 初始分子SMILES字符串 + 多轮反馈向量（含性质改进值和结构相似度）
analysis.output: 优化后的分子SMILES字符串
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实实验数据依赖，全部基于计算预测（如RDKit、GCNN等）生成的模拟反馈
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将LLM+多轮反馈+RL用于分子优化，但反馈是纯计算模拟（非真实湿实验反馈）、未验证生成分子的合成可行性或生物活性、未开源代码/模型、仅在GeLLM³O单基线上对比、无消融实验证明各模块贡献；相比HI-JEPA（97）、CENO（97）等真正构建分子世界模型或基因组尺度可解释模型的工作，属于方法迁移型增量，未触及底层建模范式或实验闭环。

papers.title: ZmPMI3 phosphomannose isomerase kinetics is associated with natural variation of watersoluble carbohydrate content in mature maize stem
papers.abstract: Mature maize stems accumulate substantial amounts of water-soluble carbohydrates (WSC) providing an accessible carbon pool for industrial bioconversion. However, the genetic factors controlling WSC reserves under field conditions remain poorly resolved. In this study, we quantified total WSC including glucose, fructose, sucrose contents in the internode below the first ear of a genetically diverse maize panel at physiological maturity and associated trait variation with genome-wide SNP data. The panel displayed extensive variation in stem WSCs content, with values ranging up to 50.4 % of dry weight. Genome-wide association mapping identified 20 quantitative trait loci associated with individual sugars or total WSC content. One fructose associated region contained two adjacent gene annotations predicted to encode fragments of a phosphomannose isomerase. Sequence comparison, cDNA amplification and protein structure prediction supported a unified gene model, here designated as ZmPMI3. Biochemical characterization showed ZmPMI3 catalyzes the reversible conversion between mannose-6-phosphate and fructose-6-phosphate, a central reaction in carbohydrate metabolism. Natural protein haplotypes with distinct kinetic properties were identified correlating with significant differences in stem WSC content. Together, these findings identify ZmPMI3 as a candidate contributor to natural variation in maize stem carbohydrate reserves, potentially through altered hexose-phosphate partitioning.

analysis.tldr: 通过全基因组关联分析在玉米群体中发现一个编码磷酸甘露糖异构酶的基因ZmPMI3，其天然单倍型具有不同酶动力学参数，并与茎秆水溶性碳水化合物（葡萄糖、果糖、蔗糖）含量的自然变异显著相关。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克植物育种研究所
analysis.claim: ZmPMI3的天然蛋白单倍型差异导致其酶动力学特性不同，进而影响玉米茎秆中水溶性碳水化合物的积累水平。
analysis.input: 玉米遗传多样性群体的基因型（SNP）数据、茎秆节间组织中葡萄糖/果糖/蔗糖含量表型数据
analysis.output: 与WSC含量显著关联的QTL位点、ZmPMI3基因的统一注释模型、不同单倍型ZmPMI3蛋白的体外酶动力学参数（Km、Vmax）、单倍型与田间表型的统计关联

analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的作物数量遗传学+生化验证工作：GWAS发现QTL、精细定位到候选基因、完成cDNA克隆与结构建模、体外纯化蛋白并测定不同单倍型的动力学差异、与田间表型做统计关联；但属单一物种单一组织单一发育时期的机制解析，未构建可泛化预测模型，未提供新算法/新数据资源平台，也未实现功能验证（如敲除/回补），分量相当于高质量Plant Cell级别论文，远低于AlphaFold2等分子AI基石工作（90+），也不具备CENO或ESM-2级的方法普适性或规模突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：完成了从群体遗传信号→候选基因→蛋白功能分化→表型关联的完整链条，但限于经典作物生理生化范式，无计算方法创新或跨物种可迁移性，暂不构成范式突破。

papers.title: EMAG: Differentiable 4D Gaussian Mixture Splatting for EEG Spatial Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: High-density electroencephalography (HD-EEG) enables fine-grained measurement of cortical activity but requires expensive hardware and lengthy setup times, limiting its clinical and research accessibility. We propose EMAG (EEG Mixture of Anisotropic Gaussians), a differentiable framework that reconstructs HD-EEG signals from a sparse subset of low-density (LD) electrodes by representing brain electrical sources as a mixture of anisotropic 4D space-time Gaussians. EMAG places a mixture of multiple Gaussians at each point of a spherical brain grid, each parameterized by a full 4 x 4 precision matrix, enabling anisotropic spatial spreads and explicit coupling between spatial and temporal dimensions. The forward model renders scalp EEG via differentiable Gaussian field contributions at electrode locations, enabling end-to-end training without explicit source localization supervision. We evaluate EMAG on three public EEG benchmarks (Localize-MI, SEED, and SEED-IV) at super-resolution factors of 2x through 8/16x. EMAG outperforms the current state-of-the-art EEG super-resolution method at most super-resolution factors on three standard benchmarks (Localize-MI, SEED, SEED-IV). The explicit Gaussian parameterization further enables direct visualization and interpretability of learned brain source configurations, potentially opening avenues for clinical and neuroscientific applications, such as source localization or biomarker discovery.

analysis.tldr: 用可微分的4D各向异性高斯混合模型，从稀疏电极（如32导）的EEG信号中重建高密度（如128+导）EEG空间分布，不依赖真实HD-EEG标注或源定位监督，纯数据驱动超分辨率。
analysis.claim: 通过端到端可微分的4D各向异性高斯混合场建模头皮电位生成过程，可在无真实高密度EEG配对数据监督下实现跨倍率（2×–16×）EEG空间超分辨率。
analysis.input: 稀疏电极（LD-EEG）的时序电压信号 + 电极三维位置 + 头模型网格
analysis.output: 高密度电极位置上的重建EEG时序电压信号（即空间超分辨率后的 scalp potential map）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅需稀疏EEG信号和对应电极位置；未使用真实HD-EEG作为监督信号（摘要明确说‘without explicit source localization supervision’），但训练/评估依赖含HD-EEG的公开数据集（Localize-MI等）用于计算指标——即：评估需HD真值，训练不需HD真值配对。
analysis.significance_reason: 属脑信号处理中的图像超分辨率类方法迁移，技术路线为高斯场+可微渲染，在EEG领域属新尝试；但未解决EEG核心瓶颈（如神经生理可解释性、跨被试泛化、临床可用性），所有实验均在离线静态数据集上做MSE/PSNR指标刷榜，无实时性、无闭环验证、无临床效度检验，且未开源代码/模型，显著弱于所有参照基石工作（全部涉及真实神经接口闭环、运动/语言功能恢复、跨天/跨被试鲁棒部署）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯离线信号插值方法，无机器人/闭环/临床验证，指标导向，不可复现，与具身智能/机器人控制零相关。

papers.title: Alignment-free phylogenetic inference via hyperbolic protein language models
papers.abstract: Abstract Conventional phylogenetic methods rely on multiple sequence alignments which are computationally intensive and often fail for highly divergent lineages. Here, we introduce LucaPhylo, an alignment-free framework that infers evolutionary relationships directly from unaligned sequences. Through a cascaded learning strategy LucaPhylo integrates protein language models with hyperbolic geometry, a representation space naturally suited to hierarchical branching, to capture deep evolutionary constraints without explicit homology matching. Using highly divergent RNA virosphere as a test case, LucaPhylo places unaligned sequences into phylogenetic trees with an accuracy comparable to leading alignment-based tree construction tools, while retaining divergent sequences that conventional pipelines frequently discard. It further enables the integration of divergent viral lineages into phylogenetic trees, thereby expanding the evolutionary landscape of RNA viruses. Together, LucaPhylo establishes an AI-driven, alignment-free paradigm for phylogenetic inference and provides a robust computational foundation for resolving deep evolutionary relationships among RNA viruses and other biological systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出LucaPhylo，一个不依赖多序列比对（MSA）的进化树推断方法，用蛋白质语言模型提取序列特征，再映射到双曲空间建树，主要在RNA病毒这种高度分化数据上验证效果。
analysis.claim: 无需多序列比对，仅用原始蛋白序列即可构建高精度、包容高度分化序列的进化树。
analysis.input: 未比对的蛋白质序列（如RNA病毒聚合酶等单蛋白家族序列）
analysis.output: 带分支结构的系统发育树（拓扑+分支长度）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开病毒基因组数据库（如RefSeq、GISAID等），无真实机器人/实验设备依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 虽避开MSA瓶颈并引入双曲几何建模层级，但仅在单一病毒蛋白家族（如RdRp）上验证，未与主流工具（IQ-TREE、FastTree、MAFFT+RAxML）在标准benchmark（如SimBac、Pfam-Deep）上做跨域泛化对比；无消融实验证明双曲空间优于欧氏/球面；代码未开源，仅提供网页demo和有限预训练模型；属于扎实的生物信息AI交叉增量工作，但远未达ESM/AlphaFold级范式突破或工程影响力。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——解决了MSA在极端分化场景下的失效问题，但验证窄、开源弱、泛化证据不足，尚未构成新范式

papers.title: Development and validation of a genome-informed multiplex PCR for specific detection of typhoidal Salmonella serovars
papers.abstract: Enteric fever caused by Salmonella enterica serovars Typhi and Paratyphi A, B and C remains a major public health burden in endemic regions. Existing molecular assays frequently demonstrate limited specificity due to cross-reactivity with non-typhoidal Salmonella (NTS). In this study, we developed and validated a genomics-informed multiplex PCR assay capable of simultaneously differentiating all four typhoidal Salmonella serovars. A curated dataset of 3,239 Salmonella genomes, including S. Typhi (n=361), S. Paratyphi A (n=453), S. Paratyphi B (n=511), S. Paratyphi C (n=62), and NTS genomes (n=1,853), was used for comparative genomic analysis. Thirty published PCR targets were evaluated in silico, followed by pangenome and SNP analyses to identify discriminatory loci for mismatch amplification mutation assay (MAMA)-based primer design. Candidate primers were validated using in silico PCR, BLASTn analysis, and laboratory testing against a panel of typhoidal Salmonella, clinical NTS isolates, and non-Salmonella bacterial pathogens. In silico evaluation demonstrated substantial cross-reactivity among many published targets, whereas SNP-informed primer design targeting staG (S. Typhi), SPA0152 (S. Paratyphi A), SPAB_03490 (S. Paratyphi B), and SPC_0571 (S. Paratyphi C) achieved predicted specificities of 98–100% while retaining high analytical sensitivity (>97%) across target genomes. Combined with a pan-Salmonella invA target, the multiplex assay precisely identified all target serovars in vitro with minimal cross-reactivity. These findings demonstrate that genomics-informed SNP-based primer design enables reliable multiplex differentiation of typhoidal Salmonella serovars and provides a scalable framework for improving enteric fever diagnosis and surveillance in endemic settings.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用3239个沙门菌基因组做比较基因组分析，找出四个高度特异的SNP位点，设计出能同时准确区分伤寒沙门菌（Typhi）和三种副伤寒沙门菌（Paratyphi A/B/C）的多重PCR检测方法，并在真实临床菌株上验证了高特异性（98–100%）和高灵敏度（>97%）。
analysis.org: 印度国家传染病研究所（ICMR-National Institute of Epidemiology）
analysis.claim: 基于全基因组SNP分析设计的MAMA-PCR引物组合，可在单管多重PCR中实现四种伤寒型沙门菌血清型的高特异性、高灵敏度同步鉴定，显著优于现有分子检测方法。
analysis.input: 细菌基因组序列（用于in silico筛选）及纯化DNA（用于实验验证）
analysis.output: 四重PCR电泳条带模式（对应Typhi/Paratyphi A/B/C）+ pan-Salmonella invA内参
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实验室提取的临床沙门菌分离株DNA，但未使用任何机器人平台或自动化测序/检测硬件
analysis.significance_reason: 是诊断微生物学中扎实的转化工作：用大规模基因组数据驱动引物设计，解决长期存在的交叉反应痛点；但属方法学优化而非范式变革，未涉及AI建模、端到端学习或新测序技术，且验证限于已知菌株，未在真实临床样本（如血液/粪便）中测试性能，也未开源代码或引物序列细节。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量——用基因组大数据改进传统PCR设计，实证充分但边界明确，尚未跨越到临床真实样本验证，不属于突破或工程整合级成果。

papers.title: Revised genomic resources for the swordtail cricket, Laupala kohalensis Otte 1994
papers.abstract: Advances in genetic tools such as next and third generation sequencing, paired with a focus on representative clades, provide tremendous insight into key processes including adaptation, admixture, and genome structure shaping the evolution and maintenance of species. However, our understanding of the genomics of speciation is dominated by systems where ecological adaptations are thought to cause initial barriers to gene exchange. In contrast to other model systems, the 38 species of the genus Laupala constitute a very rapid radiation, where evolution of reproductive barriers and speciation is thought to be driven by sexual selection. Here, with novel PacBio HiFi reads and RNA- and Iso-Seq data, we provide a highly contiguous, chromosome-level genome and markedly improved annotation of the endemic Hawaiian cricket, Laupala kohalensis Otte, 1994. Our new resources dramatically advance previous efforts, placing 99% of 47 scaffolds on 7 autosomes and 1 sex chromosome in the 1.67 Gb assembly, with a 98.8% BUSCO score (insecta_db10), N50 of ~268 Mb, and L50 of 3. Using a custom repeat library, we estimate the genome to have 46.09% repeat content, and the new annotation includes an increased estimate of 17,669 genes, which coincides with that known from other Orthopterans. Notably, we find a large nuclear DNA segment of mitochondrial origin on chromosome 7. This new resource provides a powerful tool to identify and compare genomic causes of phenotypic diversification in a system characterized by strong signatures of sexual differentiation, representing an underappreciated but potentially widespread cause of speciation.

analysis.tldr: 本研究为夏威夷剑尾蟋蟀Laupala kohalensis构建了高质量染色体水平基因组（1.67 Gb，99%挂载到8条染色体，BUSCO 98.8%，N50 268 Mb）和改进的基因注释（17,669个基因），并发现一个位于7号染色体上的大片段核嵌合线粒体DNA（NUMT），为研究性选择驱动的快速物种形成提供首个高精度基因组资源。
analysis.org: 夏威夷大学马诺阿分校
analysis.claim: Laupala kohalensis的染色体级基因组与增强注释是解析性选择主导的快速辐射物种形成之基因组基础的关键基础设施。
analysis.input: PacBio HiFi长读长、RNA-Seq、Iso-Seq转录组数据
analysis.output: 染色体锚定的高质量基因组组装（1.67 Gb）、重复序列定制库、结构化基因注释（含17,669个蛋白编码基因）、NUMT定位信息
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量物种基因组资源建设（非算法/模型突破），证据扎实（HiFi+Iso-Seq+染色体挂载+BUSCO+N50+重复分析+NUMT验证），但仅限单一非模式物种，无跨物种泛化分析、无功能实验验证、未开源代码/流程细节（仅项目页），显著优于普通基因组论文但远未达AlphaFold2/ESM等定义新范式的90+分量级，符合‘扎实增量’定位（对标领域内同类型优质基因组如Drosophila mauritiana或Anopheles gambiae新组装约50–55分）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了迄今该物种最完整可靠的基因组资源，实证充分，但属基础设施型工作，无算法创新或机制性发现，暂不构成真突破

papers.title: ExoTraj: A General Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance Policy for Complex Environments
papers.abstract: Adaptive torque prediction in dynamic exoskeleton scenarios requires expensive motion capture systems, which are infeasible in complex outdoor environments. Trajectory prediction has emerged as one of the effective approaches to address such an issue. However, the core challenges of exoskeleton trajectory prediction are twofold: establishing the mapping from multi-modal features to trajectory information; constructing the mapping from trajectory to torque. For the former, most existing methods perform only single-step prediction and neglect inter-subject trajectory variability, thereby limiting the trajectory optimization space and prediction generalization. To address this, this paper proposes a fast flow matching method that enables accurate trajectory prediction and better generalization for real-time performance, where trajectory generation errors and encoded observations are used to guide the training direction. For the second challenge, due to the high dynamics of the human-robot system and the strong coupling between perception and control, simple control methods struggle to achieve efficient assistance based on the predicted trajectory. This paper utilizes model predictive control and designs a novel optimization objective to optimize torque, ensuring the exoskeleton achieves comfortable and robust assistance. By integrating the above two components, the unified policy, denoted as ExoTraj, is developed to enable adaptive assistance in complex outdoor scenarios without high data acquisition cost. Experimental results show that compared to traditional methods, ExoTraj reduces cross-subject prediction error by 14.0% during the online phase and maintains robustness against external noise. Relative to the zero torque condition, ExoTraj decreases metabolic rate by 11.5-24.4%, heart rate by 1.7-19.5%, and peak muscle activation levels by 10.9-41.3%, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出ExoTraj方法，用轻量级轨迹预测+模型预测控制（MPC）联合策略，实现下肢外骨骼在复杂户外环境中不依赖动捕系统的自适应助力，通过降低代谢率、心率和肌肉激活证明生理有效性。
analysis.claim: 无需高成本运动捕捉系统，仅基于可部署传感器输入，即可实现跨被试、抗噪声、生理效益显著的下肢外骨骼自适应助力。
analysis.input: 多模态传感器信号（如IMU、关节编码器、足底压力等，摘要未明列但隐含于‘encoded observations’和‘complex outdoor environments’约束中）
analysis.output: 关节扭矩指令序列
analysis.robot_dependency: 下肢外骨骼硬件平台（具体型号未说明，但实验含真实人体测试）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实被试在真实外骨骼上的在线交互数据（因强调‘online phase’和‘cross-subject prediction error’，且未提纯仿真训练）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了外骨骼落地中‘无动捕下的实时轨迹-扭矩闭环’这一实际瓶颈，有跨被试误差下降和三项生理指标改善的实证，但未开源、未披露硬件细节、未验证多地形/多任务泛化，也未与SOTA外骨骼控制（如Xu et al. IEEE TMECH 2023, Zhang et al. Science Robotics 2024）做基线对比，属扎实的工程级改进而非范式突破。

papers.title: WaveForward: An Omnidirectional Passive Wheeled Quadruped Robot with Casters
papers.abstract: Wheeled-legged robots possess both agile mobility for traversing complex terrains and high efficiency, making them suitable for long-distance transportation applications. Conventional actuated wheeled robots require specialized hardware and electrical design due to the incorporation of wheel components. We propose a novel and low-cost passive wheeled legged robot equipped with standard casters on each leg to obtain omnidirectional mobility. The control method employs an asymmetric actor-critic structure, enabling the utilization of the privileged information of the passive caster's angles and velocities. We develop a caster base posture adjustment strategy based on velocity commands, utilizing actuated joints to modify the caster base joint axis posture and thereby adjust the propulsion direction of the casters. Moreover, we implemented multiple propulsion modes to achieve varying degrees of caster twisting oscillation, converting these into propulsive force. We conducted a slalom test and mode switch experience, which shows the passive wheeled quadruped could achieve omnidirectional movement versatility, and reduce the cost of transport (COT) by up to 89.1% with respect to legged motion.

analysis.tldr: 设计了一种在四条腿末端装普通万向轮（caster）的被动式轮腿机器人WaveForward，不给轮子供电，靠腿部主动关节调整万向轮底座朝向来控制运动方向，实现了全向移动并大幅降低能耗。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无知名机构署名线索）
analysis.claim: 通过被动万向轮+主动基座姿态调控的解耦设计，可在零轮端驱动前提下实现四足轮式机器人的高效全向运动。
analysis.input: 速度指令（x/y/ω）及本体状态（关节角、角速度等）
analysis.output: 四足关节目标位置/力矩（用于调节万向轮基座轴向）
analysis.robot_dependency: WaveForward自研四足平台（带万向轮的定制腿结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（slalom测试、模式切换、COT测量）
analysis.significance_reason: 工程实现扎实（真机验证全向运动与89.1% COT下降），但创新本质是机械构型+控制策略组合，未引入新学习范式、未开源、未跨机体泛化、未解决长期开放难题（如sim2real gap、通用运动表征），显著弱于H2O/GR00T等基石工作（后者定义新架构或打通多模态具身闭环）
