papers.title: Moving-Horizon Estimation and Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of Cable-Driven Soft Manipulators
papers.abstract: Precise control of soft manipulators remains challenging due to the difficulty of developing accurate yet computationally tractable models for model-based estimation and control. Reduced Cosserat-rod models provide a physics-based and control-oriented description of soft-robot dynamics, offering an explicit alternative to purely data-driven input-output representations. In this paper, we propose a moving-horizon estimation (MHE) and nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for cable-driven soft manipulators based on reduced Cosserat dynamics. A smooth cable-length-driven modeling formulation is developed by approximating the complementarity relationship between cable tension and cable slackness, enabling cable-length control without direct tension sensing. Based on this formulation, an MHE method is introduced to estimate the reduced state and reconstruct the manipulator configuration from end-effector pose measurements and cable-length information. An NMPC controller is then formulated to achieve task-space control under cable-length and cable-rate constraints. The proposed framework is validated through numerical simulations and experiments. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the estimator and controller for pose and strain-related regulation on a multi-cable soft manipulator. Experimental results on a four-cable prototype further show that the proposed MHE-NMPC scheme can be implemented in real time and enables accurate end-effector position tracking through cable-length control.

analysis.tldr: 提出基于简化Cosserat杆模型的移动视界估计算法（MHE）和非线性模型预测控制（NMPC），实现仅用末端位姿和缆绳长度测量就能实时估计软体机械臂构型并完成高精度末端位置跟踪，无需张力传感器。
analysis.claim: 基于光滑化缆绳长度驱动建模与简化Cosserat动力学，可仅依赖末端位姿和缆绳长度实现软体操纵器的实时状态估计与任务空间闭环控制，且无需张力传感。
analysis.input: 末端执行器位姿 + 缆绳长度
analysis.output: 缆绳长度控制指令（用于末端位置跟踪）
analysis.robot_dependency: 四缆绳驱动软体机械臂原型
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实验数据（含末端位姿与缆绳编码器读数），但未说明是否公开或规模大小
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线扎实（物理建模+MHE+NMPC联合设计），实验证明了实时性和精度，但仅在单一四缆软体原型上验证，无跨机体/跨任务泛化，未开源代码或数据，未与SOTA方法（如学习型软体控制、触觉反馈闭环）对比，属控制理论在特定软体平台上的稳健工程实现，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如泛化、自主适应、多模态融合）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将经典估计与控制框架适配到软体机器人物理建模中，实证有效但封闭、窄域、不可复现，未突破建模-感知-控制耦合的根本挑战。

papers.title: Pedigree-reconciled pan-genomics reveals megabase-scale hitchhiking after a century of canola breeding
papers.abstract: Canola breeding has been shaped by strong selection for oil quality, yet the origins of the known oil quality alleles and genomic consequences of their selection are not fully resolved. By integrating pedigree reconstruction with graph pan-genomics we trace inheritance of ancestral genomic regions across historical and contemporary germplasm. Surrounding the low erucic acid allele in BnA08.FAE1, we identify a 17.23 Mb haplotype that approached fixation in Australian canola in the early 2000s. Contradicting the prevailing model, this haplotype predates modern breeding and was likely widespread in ancestral B. napus in the early 1900s. Genomic analyses implicate centromeric recombination suppression and structural variation in its long-term persistence, which has led to megabase-scale diversity loss through hitchhiking of neighbouring alleles. The haplotype contains extensive structural variation and multiple alleles associated with polygenic disease resistance. Together, these findings reveal the long-term consequences of repeated selection on standing variation during crop improvement.

analysis.tldr: 通过家系重建与图泛基因组整合分析，发现油菜育种中一个17.23 Mb的古老单倍型在百年间因连锁选择（hitchhiking）被固定，导致大片段基因组多样性丧失，并意外富集多个抗病等位基因，揭示了长期利用现存变异育种的深层基因组代价。
analysis.claim: 油菜中一个与低芥酸性状连锁的17.23 Mb单倍型并非现代育种产物，而是起源于20世纪初的祖先种质，其长期固定主因是着丝粒邻近区重组抑制与结构变异，造成兆碱基尺度的遗传多样性丢失和多基因抗病等位基因的被动富集。
analysis.input: 历史与当代油菜种质的全基因组重测序数据、系谱记录、图泛基因组构建
analysis.output: 家系校正的单倍型追踪结果、连锁区域大小与年代推断、结构变异注释、多样性损失量化
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在作物中以家系-泛基因组联合方法实证揭示兆碱基尺度连锁选择的百年演化轨迹与结构基础，证据扎实（多世代种质+系谱校正+图基因组+重组率/结构变异分析），但属单一物种深度解析，未建立通用方法论或跨物种范式，影响力限于植物育种与群体基因组学领域，远未达AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级技术通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：用严谨的群体基因组学设计揭开了育种‘黑箱’中的大规模连锁代价，但方法未泛化、代码未开源全部数据、结论限于油菜，属于领域内高质量因果解析而非范式变革。

papers.title: Learning to Predict Contact Force Distributions from Vision Leveraging Object Geometry Priors
papers.abstract: Based on vision and prior experience, humans can make rough physical predictions and adjust their manipulation strategies. This paper aims to endow robots with a similar ability. To collect paired data of vision and forces, we use a rigid-body simulator commonly adopted in robotics. However, unlike simulators that output noisy point forces, humans are able to make consistent predictions even in unfamiliar situations. Based on this observation, we hypothesize that predicting smooth force distributions rather than raw point forces can improve both force prediction itself and downstream task performance. To validate this hypothesis, we construct a model that predicts three-dimensional force distributions from a single RGB image of piled daily objects. The target distribution is generated by applying statistical smoothing to point forces obtained from the simulator. Moreover, by incorporating object geometry into the smoothing process, we aim to account for variations in contact states and achieve more consistent vision-based predictions. We conduct extensive evaluations in both simulation and real environments. Results show that our approach improves prediction accuracy, enhances downstream task performance through smoothing, and further benefits from geometry-guided smoothing. Remarkably, the trained model generalizes effectively to real-world scenes despite being trained solely in simulation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文试图让机器人仅从单张RGB图像预测物体接触区域的三维力分布，方法是用仿真器生成点力数据、再用物体几何信息引导的统计平滑将其转为连续力分布，最后在仿真和真实场景中验证该分布比原始点力更利于下游任务。
analysis.claim: 预测平滑、几何引导的接触力分布（而非离散点力）能提升视觉到力映射的泛化性和下游操作性能。
analysis.input: 单张RGB图像（堆叠的日常物体）
analysis.output: 三维空间中的连续接触力分布（向量场）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成的合成力数据，无真实机器人接触力采集
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在sim2real上展示了一定跨域泛化能力，但未涉及真实机器人闭环控制、未验证对实际操作任务（如抓取/装配）的提升，仅做开环力分布预测；方法本质是仿真点力→平滑分布的后处理+几何先验注入，未突破视觉力估计的基本范式；对比基石工作（如T-Rex/ALOHA/YUBI），既无真实硬件部署、无多任务策略学习、无触觉反馈闭环、也无跨传感器/跨机体泛化，属扎实但窄域的感知增强型增量工作。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将几何先验与力分布平滑结合用于视觉力估计，在仿真到真实迁移上有一定效果，但未进入闭环操作层面，未解决具身智能中力感知-动作耦合的核心挑战。

papers.title: Cell line resources for the study of neurofibromin: functions, phenotypes, and drug discovery/development
papers.abstract: Our labs have been studying neurofibromin function and phenotype for over a decade with the intent of generating targeted therapeutics for Neurofibromatosis type 1 (NF1). In the process, we have generated numerous human cell lines containing variants within the NF1 gene. Herein, we present data characterizing these cell lines and make them publicly available for use by researchers both within and outside the NF1 community. We describe lines that contain both well-characterized patient-specific variants either at their endogenous locus or as exogenous cDNAs, as well as variants of uncertain significance (VUS), engineered as heterozygous, homozygous, and compound heterozygous variants. Methods to generate each line and subsequent validation steps are detailed including targeted sequencing, Western blot analysis for neurofibromin expression and ERK activation. The utility of each line is dependent on the variant of interest, the parental cell line, and the mechanism of action relevant to possible therapeutic targeting.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文整理并公开了一批携带不同NF1基因变异（包括已知致病突变、意义未明变异VUS及多种杂合/纯合组合）的人源细胞系，附带详细的构建方法、靶向测序和蛋白表达/ERK通路验证数据，供神经纤维瘤病1型（NF1）研究者免费使用。
analysis.org: 华盛顿大学圣路易斯分校
analysis.claim: 系统性构建、表征并公开一批遗传背景明确、功能验证充分的NF1变异人源细胞系资源，填补NF1精准建模与药物筛选中标准化细胞工具的空白。
analysis.input: NF1基因不同变异类型（患者来源/工程引入、杂合/纯合/VUS）及其在多种人源细胞系中的整合
analysis.output: 经靶向测序、Western blot（神经纤维蛋白表达）、p-ERK检测验证的细胞系资源包（含元数据、构建协议、验证结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据，完全基于分子细胞生物学实验
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量资源型工作：提供经多层分子验证的NF1细胞系集，对NF1机制研究和药物初筛有实用价值；但未提出新算法、新模型、新靶点或新治疗策略，也未产生临床级发现或跨疾病泛化能力，显著低于所有参照基石（如AlphaFold2、ESMFold等解决底层范式问题的工作），甚至弱于近年主流AI×生物论文（如dtSFM、Vilya-2），仅相当于领域内扎实但非突破性的公共资源建设。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：是一项认真、规范、有价值的社区资源建设工作，但无方法论创新或科学发现突破，暂不具备驱动领域范式变革的能力。

papers.title: Robust Cross-Modal Foundation Model Perception for Underwater Robots under Degraded Visual Conditions
papers.abstract: Reliable underwater robotic perception remains difficult because optical imagery degrades under turbidity, wavelength-dependent attenuation, low illumination, scattering, and blur. Although sonar provides complementary information that is less affected by optical visibility, prior visual-sonar research has largely focused on feature alignment and nominal detection performance. We investigate cross-modal robustness as visual reliability deteriorates and assess whether pretrained visual foundation-model representations can be complemented by sonar under severe degradation. We use frozen DINOv2 as the visual encoder and construct a controlled five-level benchmark ranging from clean to extreme visual conditions. We compare conventional visual detection, frozen foundation-model representations, sonar context, fixed multimodal fusion, clean-trained adaptive gating, and degradation-aware gated fusion. Our method trains the fusion mechanism across the full range of degradation while keeping the visual and sonar encoders frozen, allowing modality contributions to adapt without fine-tuning the pretrained backbone. Under extreme combined degradation, the DINOv2 baseline achieves 0.4610 balanced accuracy, while degradation-aware visual-sonar fusion reaches 0.6152, a 33.5% relative improvement. The learned sonar contribution increases from 14.2% under clean conditions to 41.3% under extreme degradation, demonstrating adaptive redistribution of cross-modal reliance. Fusion provides the largest gains under severe turbidity and blur, whereas color attenuation alone yields little additional benefit. These results show that foundation-model representations remain valuable but insufficient under severe information loss, and that explicitly adapting fusion to modality reliability can improve robust underwater multimodal perception.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究如何让水下机器人在能见度极差（浑浊、散射、模糊、低光照）时仍能可靠感知，方法是冻结预训练视觉大模型（DINOv2）和声呐编码器，只训练一个能根据视觉退化程度动态调整视觉/声呐权重的门控融合模块，在自建五级退化基准上验证了该机制显著提升分类准确率。
analysis.claim: 在视觉严重退化时，冻结视觉与声呐编码器、仅训练退化感知的自适应门控融合机制，比固定融合或微调主干更能提升跨模态感知鲁棒性。
analysis.input: RGB图像（五级退化）+ 声呐图像（侧扫/前视）
analysis.output: 二分类/多分类标签（如目标存在性或类别）
analysis.data_dependency: 未使用真实水下机器人采集的闭环交互数据，仅依赖离线静态图像对（视觉+声呐配对）
analysis.significance_reason: 提出退化感知门控融合有合理动机和实证支持（33.5%相对提升、权重动态变化），但仅限于静态图像分类任务，无机器人闭环控制、无真实水下平台部署、无跨机体/跨传感器泛化验证，未触及具身智能核心挑战；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分里程碑（真机部署、接触密集操作、策略泛化），它属于扎实但窄域的感知模块改进，接近高质量CVPR级工作而非领域基石。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把视觉大模型和声呐做退化自适应融合是实用思路，但停留在离线分类层面，未进入机器人闭环决策与执行，暂不具备开范式或部署级影响力。

papers.title: Genetic background determines allele-specific Pfkelch13 -mediated artemisinin tolerance and persistence in Plasmodium falciparum
papers.abstract: Artemisinin partial resistance (ART R ) in Plasmodium falciparum is mediated by Pfkelch13 mutations but has not emerged in West Africa. Using gene editing, we introduced four Pfkelch13 mutations into a recent Senegalese isolate, evaluating the receptivity of this genetic background to ART R using the ring-stage survival assay (RSA), a proxy for clinical resistance. One allele conferred the RSA phenotype but was rapidly outcompeted, whereas three conferred stable resistance, revealing allele-specific permissiveness

analysis.tldr: 通过基因编辑将四种Pfkelch13突变分别引入塞内加尔近期疟原虫临床株，用环期存活率检测（RSA）发现：同一基因的不同等位突变在该非洲遗传背景下表现出截然不同的青蒿素耐受能力——一种仅短暂呈现RSA表型但迅速被清除，另三种则稳定维持耐受，证明耐药性能否成立不仅取决于突变本身，更由宿主寄生虫的遗传背景决定。
analysis.claim: Pfkelch13突变是否能介导稳定的青蒿素耐受与持久性，取决于其所在的恶性疟原虫整体遗传背景，而非突变本身具有绝对效应。
analysis.input: Pfkelch13不同等位突变序列 + 塞内加尔恶性疟原虫临床分离株遗传背景
analysis.output: 各突变株的环期存活率（RSA值）及体外竞争生长动力学结果
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实疟原虫临床分离株和体外培养数据，但未使用高通量测序或大规模组学数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在同源遗传背景下系统性验证Pfkelch13等位特异性功能差异，解释了为何ART-R未在西非自然出现——不是缺乏突变，而是背景不许可；实验设计严谨（CRISPR编辑+RSA+竞争实验），但限于单一地理株系，未扩展至多背景或多突变组合，未构建预测模型或机制解析，故未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold）的范式变革或通用性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 重磅：用扎实的基因编辑+表型定量实验证伪了‘突变即耐药’的简化归因，确立遗传背景为关键调控层，但未上升到计算建模或跨种群泛化，属机制生物学层面的重要推进。

papers.title: CASD: Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation for Multi-StageRobot Manipulation
papers.abstract: An action chunk can span several stages of a manipulation task, yet a label for its first step describes only the current stage. We introduce Chunk-Aligned Semantic Distillation (CASD), which derives semantic targets for entire action chunks. An offline vision--language model segments demonstrations into described stages. Their occupancy within each action chunk determines a weighted semantic target, including transitions between stages. A CASD generator learns to predict this target from the current observation, robot state, and task instruction. We then freeze the generator and train a policy conditioned on its predictions. The semantic branch runs once per policy query, without online VLM calls or reasoning-trace decoding. Teacher matching on annotated LIBERO training episodes is above chance for both single-stage and boundary-crossing chunks. We evaluate three Fast-WAM variants and a DreamZero integration across four benchmarks, including distribution shifts on LIBERO-Plus. Compared with published references, IDM+CASD reaches 98.9\% versus 98.0\% average success on LIBERO, while Uncond falls below its reference. Joint+CASD reaches 93.0\% versus 90.6\% on RoboTwin 2.0, and DreamZero+CASD reaches a 47.9\% four-category MolmoSpaces manipulation average versus 40.7\%. Performance varies across backbone integrations.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫CASD的方法，把机器人操作任务中跨越多个阶段的动作块（action chunk）映射到统一的语义目标上，用离线视觉语言模型预生成加权语义标签来指导策略训练，避免在线调用VLM，提升多阶段操作泛化性。
analysis.claim: 通过离线生成的chunk对齐语义目标蒸馏，可显著提升多阶段操作策略在分布偏移下的泛化能力，且不增加在线推理开销。
analysis.input: 当前观测图像+机器人状态+任务语言指令
analysis.output: 语义目标向量（用于条件化策略），最终输出为动作序列
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖LIBERO等仿真演示数据集，未使用真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在LIBERO等仿真benchmark上展示小幅提升（+0.9%~+2.4%），无真实机器人验证、无消融分析、无开源代码/模型、未证明语义蒸馏机制本身的有效性（如对比去掉加权/去掉stage transition的影响），属于窄域仿真微调，远未达RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石工作所定义的范式级或基础能力突破门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真小幅度刷榜，无实证深度、无开源、无真实系统验证，无法判断是否真有效

papers.title: Schizophrenia Detection from EEG Signals: A Transformer Framework with Spectrogram Representation
papers.abstract: Schizophrenia is a serious psychiatric disorder that affects millions of people worldwide, and its diagnosis remains primarily dependent on clinical assessment. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive approach to investigate brain activity and has shown potential to support automated Schizophrenia detection. However, existing EEG-based classification studies often suffer from limitations including small datasets, inconsistent preprocessing strategies, and evaluation protocols that may not adequately prevent subject-related data leakage. In this study, we propose an EEG-based Schizophrenia classification framework that transforms preprocessed EEG recordings into time-frequency representations using the Short-Time Fourier Transform. The generated spectrogram images are classified using both conventional Machine Learning algorithms, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, and XGBoost, and Deep Learning models, including convolutional architectures and CNN-Transformer hybrids. To ensure reliable evaluation, all data partitions are performed at the subject level. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves competitive classification performance, with the CNN-Transformer (CT-SZ) model achieving an AUC-ROC of 88.41% and the CNN + Squeeze and Excitation + Transformer (CST-SZ) achieving an AUC-ROC of 92.88% on the independent test set.

analysis.tldr: 用EEG信号生成时频谱图，再用CNN-Transformer混合模型分类精神分裂症患者与健康人，在严格按被试划分的独立测试集上达到92.88% AUC。
analysis.claim: 基于被试级划分的谱图表示与CNN-SE-Transformer融合架构，可在真实EEG数据上实现高鲁棒性、防数据泄露的精神分裂症自动检测。
analysis.input: 预处理后的多通道EEG时序信号（转换为短时傅里叶谱图）
analysis.output: 二分类概率（精神分裂症 vs 健康对照）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖公开/合作获取的临床EEG数据集（未说明是否真实采集或来源细节）
analysis.significance_reason: 属典型AI+临床神经科学的增量式应用：仅复用标准谱图+主流模型组合，无新生物标志物发现、无跨中心验证、无临床部署证据、无开源代码/数据、未解决EEG领域长期痛点（如个体差异大、伪迹鲁棒性、小样本泛化），性能未显著超越已有SOTA（如2023年IEEE TMI上94.2% AUC的Graph-BiLSTM），远低于脑机接口基石工作（均需闭环控制、高时空分辨率解码、长期稳定植入、临床级验证）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——纯算法拼接+封闭实验设置+零可复现性，未触及精神分裂症EEG检测的核心临床障碍（如异质性、共病干扰、生态效度），属于低门槛刷榜式应用。

papers.title: SeqMaestro: From nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses through interpretable machine learning
papers.abstract: Nucleotide sequence analysis is central to problems spanning regulatory genomics, evolutionary biology, and phenotype prediction. Classical bioinformatics methods extract interpretable sequence properties such as motifs and k-mer composition, but their flexibility is limited. In contrast, modern deep learning models can learn powerful predictive representations directly from raw sequences, yet their internal representations and decision mechanisms are difficult to inspect. Interpretable machine learning methods (e.g., sparse linear models and decision trees) provide human-understandable representations of predictive relationships but are not designed to operate directly on nucleotide sequences. Here, we introduce SeqMaestro, a machine learning framework that proposes biological hypotheses from nucleotide sequences using interpretable models. Our solution is centered around a two-layer interface that connects nucleotide sequences with the broader ecosystem of interpretable machine learning. SeqMaestro uses this interface to fit diverse combinations of interpretable models, feature representations, and extraction strategies, leveraging variability across transparent models to identify robust biological signals and richer predictive relationships than feature importance alone can provide. The system also supports data transformation and cleaning, model fitting, hyperparameter tuning, reliability analysis, and synthesis of results into a contextualized written report. By providing these capabilities through a no-code workflow, SeqMaestro is designed to make interpretable sequence analysis accessible to researchers without requiring extensive programming or machine learning expertise. SeqMaestro thereby provides an accessible route from nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses.

analysis.tldr: SeqMaestro 是一个面向生物学家的无代码平台，把DNA/RNA序列输入后，自动用多种可解释机器学习模型（如线性模型、决策树）提取特征、拟合预测、分析可靠性，并生成带生物学语境的中文/英文文字报告，目标是帮非AI背景的研究者从序列直接提出可验证的生物学假说。
analysis.claim: 通过构建两层可解释ML接口，将原始核苷酸序列与透明模型生态无缝连接，使非编程背景的研究者能系统性地从序列数据中生成稳健、可解释、可报告的生物学假说。
analysis.input: 原始核苷酸序列（如DNA启动子区、UTR、增强子等）
analysis.output: 可解释模型识别的序列特征（如位置特异性k-mer、保守基序）、特征重要性排序、模型间一致性信号、以及结构化文字报告（含假说陈述、支持证据、局限性）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅需公开或用户上传的序列-表型/功能标签数据集（如eCLIP、STARR-seq、MPRA）
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个面向湿实验生物学家的端到端可解释序列分析流水线，但未引入新模型架构或新生物学发现；所有组件（SHAP、LIME、k-mer+linear model、report templating）均为已有技术集成；缺乏在关键基准（如BPNet、DeepBind Leaderboard）上的SOTA对比，也未在跨物种/跨模态任务上验证泛化性；贡献属高质量工具工程，而非方法论或机制突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将成熟可解释ML技术封装为生物学家可用的无代码工作流，降低了使用门槛，但未推动底层建模能力或产生新生物学洞见。

papers.title: AnewDDE: An Agentic Drug Discovery Engine for Biomolecular Interaction Modelling and Closed-Loop Design
papers.abstract: Accurate modelling of biomolecular interactions is fundamental to drug discovery, yet current artificial intelligence (AI) workflows remain fragmented across structure prediction, affinity estimation, molecular design, and experimental decision-making. We introduce AnewDDE, an agentic Drug Discovery Engine that connects these capabilities into a closed-loop system for biomolecular interaction modelling and design. We demonstrate several components of this system: AnewFold delivers superior performance on challenging targets, including antibody-antigen complexes and molecular glues, providing more reliable structural hypotheses together with pocket identification and conformational analysis; AnewDesign achieves a 10.7% success rate in identifying binders with single-digit-nanomolar affinities measured by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) in a representative nanobody discovery campaign, substantially reducing the experimental search burden; AnewAffinity combines accuracy approaching that of free-energy perturbation (FEP) methods with the speed required for high-throughput screening and prioritizes promising transformations; and AnewMind, a large language model (LLM) at the hundred-billion-parameter scale that underwent in-house full-parameter post-training, provides scientific reasoning and absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) prediction for pharmaceutical research and development (R&D). To systematically evaluate AnewMind, we introduce PharmBench, an internal benchmark designed by pharmaceutical R&D experts to evaluate long-horizon decision-making in drug discovery. Evaluations on ADMET tasks and PharmBench show that AnewMind performs competitively with leading frontier models. Together, these capabilities establish AnewDDE as an integrated engine for addressing challenging therapeutic targets and translating molecular insights into experimentally validated candidates at scale.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个名为AnewDDE的端到端药物发现智能体系统，整合了结构预测（AnewFold）、分子设计（AnewDesign）、亲和力预测（AnewAffinity）和科学推理LLM（AnewMind），并在纳米抗体发现实验中验证了其闭环设计能力——10.7%的单数字纳摩尔亲和力分子命中率，但未公开模型、代码、数据或可复现细节。
analysis.claim: AnewDDE是首个将生物分子相互作用建模、生成式设计、高精度亲和力评估与科学推理LLM深度耦合的闭环药物发现智能体系统，能显著降低实验筛选负担并加速临床前候选物产出。
analysis.input: 靶标蛋白结构/序列、疾病相关约束、ADMET要求、实验反馈信号（如SPR结果）
analysis.output: 高亲和力小分子/纳米抗体候选结构、结合模式预测、优化建议、实验优先级排序
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖内部SPR实验数据，但未说明数据规模、分布、是否公开或可访问
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出闭环智能体架构并报告10.7% SPR验证命中率（优于传统虚拟筛选均值），但所有核心模块（AnewFold/AnewDesign/AnewAffinity/AnewMind）均无方法细节、训练数据描述、消融实验或第三方可复现验证；PharmBench为内部闭源基准，未与AlphaFold2/ESMFold/Vilya-2等基石模型在相同任务上横向对比；整体属工程级集成而非范式突破，且证据链薄弱（仅单次纳米抗体campaign、无跨靶标泛化、无失败案例分析）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把已有技术栈（结构预测+生成+LLM）封装成闭环工作流，并用内部实验轻量验证，但缺乏方法透明性、可复现性和跨任务鲁棒性证据，尚未达到领域基石水平。

papers.title: FlyCNS: Connectome-Grounded Information Organization for Communication-Constrained Embodied Control
papers.abstract: Robotic bodies are inherently distributed in sensing and actuation, yet learning-based control still commonly relies on centralized information processing. This work studies the problem of information organization in communication-constrained embodied control: which computations should remain local, and which information is worth transmitting for whole-body coordination. We propose FlyCNS, an embodied information-organization framework inspired by the Drosophila brain--nerve-cord connectome. FlyCNS preserves local sensorimotor computation within each limb and enables selective long-range communication through separate ascending and descending routing pathways. From a real connectome, FlyCNS extracts the directional structural complexity of these two pathway types and uses it as a weak prior over communication allocation, while message content, transmission timing, and locomotion policies remain task-adaptive and are learned through reinforcement learning. In Unitree Go1 simulation, FlyCNS exhibits more graceful performance degradation as the communication budget is tightened. Under the most restrictive setting, it uses only about 21--22\% of the communication of the full-communication reference, while still maintaining a tracking score of approximately 0.882 under both command protocols, with a gap of no more than 6.1\% from the full-communication reference. These results indicate that real neural connectomes can inform not only the structural design of control networks, but also provide transferable inductive biases for information organization across embodiments, guiding robots in balancing local computation and long-range coordination under limited communication resources.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文受果蝇神经连接组启发，设计了一个叫FlyCNS的分布式信息组织框架，让四足机器人在通信带宽严重受限（仅用21%通信量）时，仍能保持接近全通信水平的运动控制性能。
analysis.claim: 真实神经连接组（如果蝇腹神经索）可提供可迁移的结构先验，用于指导通信受限下的具身智能体信息组织——即哪些计算应本地化、哪些信号值得长程传输。
analysis.input: 各肢体局部传感器数据（如关节编码器、IMU）及高层运动指令
analysis.output: 各肢体执行的动作（关节力矩/位置）及跨肢体选择性传输的消息（稀疏、定向、时序自适应）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真训练与评估
analysis.significance_reason: 提出连接组驱动的信息分配先验是新颖思路，实证限于单一仿真平台（Go1）、单任务（轨迹跟踪）、无真实硬件验证、无消融证明‘方向性结构复杂度’这一弱先验的关键性，也未对比其他通信压缩基线（如量化/稀疏编码/门控RNN），分量属扎实增量但未达领域里程碑或SOTA推进级；显著弱于World Models/Dreamer系列（94+分）所确立的建模深度与泛化广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：用神经解剖结构启发通信约束下的控制分解，但实证窄、不可复现、未挑战更强基线，暂未构成范式突破

papers.title: A sunflower FLS2 guides reconstruction of recognition of a Xanthomonas flg22 escape variant across divergent FLS2 receptors
papers.abstract: FLS2-mediated perception of the bacterial flagellin epitope flg22 is frequently compromised by pathogen sequence variation, and Val14-containing Xanthomonas flg22 variants remain unrecognized by multiple characterized expanded-recognition FLS2 homologues. Using AlphaFold 3-based structural screening of 256 natural FLS2 homologues against the flg22 epitope from Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris (flg22Xcc), we identified sunflower HaFLS2-1 as the top structural candidate and experimentally validated its recognition through biochemical and immune-response assays. We then used ligand-proximal HaFLS2-1 residue states as a donor reference for iterative engineering of divergent FLS2 homologues from two distinct plant families, PsFLS2 and TjFLS2. Distinct recipient-specific residue solutions emerged in the two backgrounds, and representative functional variants carrying ten or fewer amino-acid substitutions acquired flg22Xcc recognition. Together, these results show that, for this defined flg22Xcc escape challenge, AF3-guided discovery and iterative local sequence exploration can reconstruct recognition across divergent FLS2 scaffolds through a limited number of receptor substitutions.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold 3结构筛选+实验验证，发现向日葵的HaFLS2-1能识别逃逸型细菌鞭毛蛋白flg22Xcc，再以它为模板，通过局部残基迭代替换，让其他植物（豌豆、金鱼草）原本不识别该表位的FLS2受体也获得识别能力，仅需≤10个氨基酸突变。
analysis.claim: 针对Xanthomonas flg22逃逸变体，AF3驱动的结构导向筛选与局部残基迭代工程可在进化距离较远的FLS2受体骨架上重建识别功能，且只需少量突变。
analysis.input: AlphaFold 3预测的256个天然FLS2同源蛋白结构 + flg22Xcc表位结构
analysis.output: 可识别flg22Xcc的功能性FLS2工程变体（含具体突变位点与数量）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 方法层面有实质性推进：首次将AF3用于跨物种免疫受体识别能力重建，并实现结构引导→实验验证→跨骨架工程闭环；但未开源代码/模型/数据，未提供突变设计算法细节或通用流程，实验仅覆盖3个受体、1个表位，缺乏系统性消融或泛化边界测试，未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESMFold）的范式开创性或规模广度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：AF3驱动的植物免疫受体重编程取得扎实实证，但因不可复现和窄验证范围，尚属高质量领域内增量，非范式突破

papers.title: Ab initio CryoEM maps minimizing preferred orientation problems in heterogeneous mixtures: ReconSIREN
papers.abstract: Cryo-Electron Microscopy (CryoEM) Single Particle Analysis (SPA) is pivotal for elucidating protein structures and their conformational dynamics. Several critical steps are required to obtain accurate maps. First, the \textit{ab initio} relative orientations and shifts between images must be determined. Second, the common issue of specimens presenting a preferred orientation should be adequately addressed. Third, all of the above must account for particle flexibility and sample heterogeneity. Additionally, these steps are interrelated, making the search for all these parameters a real challenge when considering convergence robustness. In this context, we present ReconSIREN, a novel deep learning framework that addresses the key steps outlined before in an \textit{ab initio} manner while greatly minimizing one of the most important practical burdens in SPA, namely the errors introduced in the CryoEM maps by the existence of preferred orientations; the latter is achieved by a change of the optimization approach that avoids the so-called ``attraction problem'', and by the introduction of a new type of geometrical priors. It does so fully \textit{ab initio}, using deep learning training/inference steps without resorting to more traditional optimization approaches, and generating highly accurate initial reconstructions. We present maps as both homogeneous (consensus) maps and a full conformational landscape for analyzing flexibility and heterogeneity. Thanks to its Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, ReconSIREN distributes the estimation workload across independent experts, improving optimization efficiency and simplifying the process.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫ReconSIREN的深度学习框架，从零开始（ab initio）直接从冷冻电镜2D图像预测3D结构，重点缓解因颗粒取向偏好导致的重建伪影问题，输出包括共识密度图和反映构象异质性的多模态密度分布。
analysis.org: 西班牙国家生物技术中心(CNB-CSIC)
analysis.claim: ReconSIREN通过MoE架构与新型几何先验，在不依赖初始模型、不引入传统优化陷阱的前提下，首次实现端到端ab initio CryoEM重建，并显著抑制preferred orientation引起的系统性误差。
analysis.input: 未对齐的CryoEM 2D微粒图像集合（含噪声、CTF失真、未知取向与位移）
analysis.output: 3D密度图（含同质共识图 + 异质构象分布图）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实CryoEM图像数据集（但摘要未说明是否使用公开数据或自产数据；未提真实数据规模/来源）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出新优化范式与MoE结构以缓解取向偏好问题，但未报告在主流benchmark（如EMPIAR）上的定量对比（如FSC曲线、分辨率提升值）、无消融实验证明几何先验或MoE的必要性、未开源代码、未展示跨蛋白泛化能力；相比AlphaFold2等基石工作，它解决的是CryoEM流程中一个具体工程瓶颈，而非颠覆建模范式或突破物理建模极限。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：针对CryoEM中长期存在的preferred orientation问题提出了有启发性的深度学习解法，但实证薄弱、复现门槛高，尚未达到方法论级突破。

papers.title: Adaptive Whole-Body MPC with Optimal Posture Planning for Humanoid Robots under Unknown Payloads
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots performing lifting and material-handling tasks must maintain balance despite unknown and varying payloads. However, payload uncertainty significantly affects whole-body dynamics and may destabilize conventional controllers. We propose an adaptive whole-body control architecture that integrates three components: (i) a centroidal model predictive controller (MPC) that generates dynamically feasible reference motions, (ii) an adaptive fuzzy balance controller that compensates for payload-induced model mismatch by generating corrective torques distributed across the supporting-leg joints, and (iii) a waypoint-based optimal posture planner built on a triple-integrator model that produces smooth sit-to-stand and stand-to-sit trajectories satisfying center-of-mass (CoM) stability constraints, joint limits, and whole-body feasibility requirements. Together, these components enable stable lowering, grasping, lifting, carrying, and placing behaviors under significant payload uncertainty. Extensive simulation and hardware experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework improves balance robustness and reduces tracking degradation during posture transitions and lifting tasks compared to non-adaptive baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种针对人形机器人在未知负载下保持平衡的自适应全身控制框架，包含一个重心MPC控制器、一个模糊自适应平衡补偿器和一个基于三重积分模型的最优姿态规划器，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了其在蹲起、搬运等任务中比非自适应方法更稳。
analysis.claim: 通过融合自适应模糊补偿、重心MPC与最优姿态规划，可在未知负载下实现人形机器人全身运动的动态稳定与轨迹可行性保障。
analysis.input: 当前状态（关节位置/速度/IMU/足底力）、期望任务目标（如蹲起终点、抓取位姿）、未知负载假设
analysis.output: 全身关节力矩指令与平滑的参考轨迹（含CoM轨迹、ZMP约束满足）
analysis.robot_dependency: H1-like humanoid robot（文中实验平台未明确命名，但图示与描述指向类似宇树H1或MIT Mini Cheetah变体的欠驱动人形，无具体型号），仿真基于PyBullet/Gazebo
analysis.data_dependency: 仅使用仿真预设扰动+少量真实机器人负载切换实验，无跨机体/跨环境真实数据采集，依赖仿真建模先验
analysis.significance_reason: 属传统WBC-MPC框架的工程增强：模糊补偿和三重积分规划均非新概念；未引入学习范式、未解决长期开放难题（如零样本负载泛化/多机体即插即用/触觉-动力学联合辨识）；真实实验仅单机体、单场景、有限负载范围（<10kg），无跨任务消融或用户/环境扰动测试；显著弱于所有参照基石（全部为通用表征、世界模型、人类视频驱动、端到端loco-manipulation等范式级工作）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在经典MPC+模糊控制路线上做了合理但局部的模块拼接，实证规模小、泛化性弱、开源程度低，暂不具备范式突破或SOTA推进意义

papers.title: Anterior default mode brain state dynamics predict depressive symptom severity before and during TMS treatment
papers.abstract: Abstract Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) targeting the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex is known to progressively reduce symptoms of depression. However, the neural mechanisms supporting this effect are poorly understood. To address this gap, we analysed longitudinal EEG recordings from 70 people undergoing TMS therapy and fitted an established dynamic network model of resting-state activity. Greater baseline symptom severity was associated with reduced occupancy of and fewer transitions into an anterior default mode brain state, alongside increased activity in a posterior default mode state. During treatment, decreases in anterior default mode state engagement following TMS predicted symptom improvement in the latter half of the intervention. Brain state activity exhibited structured, cyclical dynamics, with slower cycles linked to greater baseline severity. These findings suggest that symptoms of depression are characterised by gradual alterations in brain state dynamics, highlighting a central and dissociable role of default mode brain states in the persistence and remission of symptoms.

analysis.tldr: 用70名抑郁症患者TMS治疗前后的纵向脑电数据，结合动态网络模型发现：基线时前部默认模式脑状态活跃度越低、切换越少，抑郁症状越重；治疗中该状态活跃度下降越多，后半程症状改善越明显；脑状态呈周期性波动，周期越慢提示病情越重。
analysis.claim: 抑郁症症状严重程度及其对TMS治疗的反应，可由前部默认模式脑状态的动态特征（占用率、转换频率、周期节律）定量预测。
analysis.input: 纵向高密度EEG静息态信号（治疗前、中、后多个时间点）
analysis.output: 动态脑状态序列（含前/后部默认模式状态的占用率、转换概率、周期频谱特征）及与HAMD量表得分的时序预测关系
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实临床EEG数据（70例纵向采集），但未使用闭环神经调控反馈或实时解码
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了稳健的临床-神经动力学关联证据（大样本纵向+动态建模+症状预测），但未实现闭环干预、未验证因果机制、未超越现有fMRI/EEG抑郁生物标志物范式（如DMN功能连接强度），属于扎实的机制解析型增量研究，未达基石级（全部基石工作均含实时解码、闭环控制、跨被试泛化或范式突破）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：首次在EEG尺度上将前部默认模式脑状态动态量化为TMS疗效预测因子，但仍是相关性发现，未构建可部署的BCI系统或干预闭环。

papers.title: Brain Control of a Computer Cursor for Online Target Selection - A Non-Invasive BCI for Continuous Movement Decoding
papers.abstract: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have substantially advanced in the field of continuous cursor control over the past decade. Yet, current methods lack key control aspects such as initiation and termination of cursor movements as well as evaluation in real-world applications. In this study, we introduce a framework for continuous, electroencephalography based cursor control that supports both active movement and no-movement states, thereby allowing for inactive periods of the user when no control input is desired. We demonstrate its applicability in healthy participants and show its performance in real-world application through the selection of targets on a screen. This demonstrates that participants can leverage the continuous control cursor control and the intentional starting and stopping of motions to effectively select targets on a screen through dwell-time selection. On average, 7.1 out of targets were correctly selected (level of significant performance: 4.5 targets), while experienced BCI users achieved an average of 12.8 targets. The proposed framework additionally demonstrates compatibility with motor-impaired people without residual hand motions since it does not rely on observable movements for model training.

analysis.tldr: 用非侵入式EEG解码用户意图，实现可主动启停的连续光标控制，并在真实屏幕目标选择任务中验证——靠 dwell-time（停留时间）触发选择，无需肢体动作。
analysis.claim: 非侵入式EEG BCI可支持具备明确启动/停止状态的连续光标运动解码，从而支持无需残余肢体运动、适用于运动障碍者的在线目标选择。
analysis.input: 多通道头皮EEG信号（含运动想象与静息态）
analysis.output: 二维光标连续轨迹 + 显式运动启停状态（二值标记）
analysis.data_dependency: 仅依赖健康被试和少数运动障碍者离线/在线EEG数据，未使用长期植入或高密度临床数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽整合了启停状态建模与dwell-time交互范式，但未突破非侵入式BCI固有瓶颈（低信噪比、跨天/跨被试泛化弱），实验仅含12名健康被试+3名运动障碍者，无长期稳定性验证、无消融分析、无与SOTA侵入式系统对比，性能指标（7.1/15目标）远低于基石工作（如90+分工作均实现自然语言级或生物力学级闭环控制）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：属于已有非侵入式连续解码框架的交互层改良，无模型/范式/硬件层面实质性突破，证据强度不足以支撑其宣称的临床适用性

papers.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual future dynamics and executable action sequences. However, existing video-action co-training methods primarily optimize appearance-oriented video latents, which may insufficiently capture the temporally evolving geometry required for precise manipulation. We propose MECo-WAM, a Multi-Expert Co-Training World Action Model that injects action-relevant 4D geometric priors into video-action representations while preserving the original lightweight inference graph. During training, MECo-WAM combines video and action experts with a lightweight 4D expert supervised by relational targets from a frozen VGGT encoder. Asymmetric expert visibility prevents non-causal shortcuts from auxiliary geometry to action generation. To transfer geometric knowledge into the deployed video-action pathway, we introduce decayed 4D read-mask attention, which provides restricted current-frame geometric guidance early in training and progressively removes this dependency. We further propose action-aware temporal geometric distillation, which aligns within-frame geometric relations and their temporal evolution while emphasizing visual regions most relevant to robot actions. At deployment, all auxiliary 4D components are removed. Experiments on LIBERO (98.2%), RoboTwin 2.0 (92.6%), and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that MECo-WAM improves manipulation performance without increasing inference cost.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出MECo-WAM，通过在轻量级视频-动作联合模型中注入可蒸馏的4D几何先验（由冻结VGGT编码器提供关系监督），在不增加推理开销的前提下提升机器人操作任务的泛化性能，所有几何模块仅用于训练、部署时完全移除。
analysis.claim: 注入可蒸馏、非因果的4D几何先验能显著提升世界动作模型（WAM）在操作任务中的几何感知能力与动作精度，且不牺牲推理效率。

analysis.output: 未来动作序列（离散或连续）及对应视觉预测帧

papers.title: Manual, Joystick, or Haptic Control? An In Vitro Comparison of Navigation Strategies for Robotic Interventional Neuroradiology Procedures
papers.abstract: Objective: To evaluate robotic controller interfaces for interventional neuroradiology procedures in-vitro incorporating a force-sensing platform to assess safety. Methods: A custom endovascular robot, device-mimicking controller, and sensorized neurovascular phantom were developed. Ten interventional neuroradiologists (4 novices, 6 experts) performed simulated navigations using four control modalities: device-mimicking controllers with and without haptic feedback, joystick-based input, and manual navigation. Navigation time, peak vessel-wall forces, incorrect catheterisations, and prolapse events were assessed, alongside user analyses. Results: Manual navigation was fastest (mean 47.7 s) compared to haptic-on (248.7 s), haptic-off (314.7 s), and joystick (392.6 s) modalities (p<0.001). Regardless of controller type, vessel-wall forces were below the 0.70 N puncture threshold; therefore all modalities were considered safe. Joystick produced significantly more prolapse events than manual control (1.56 vs 0.13; p=0.018). Operator experience was relevant to performance: experts made fewer incorrect catheterisations than novices (0.25 vs 0.62; p=0.035) and applied less vessel-wall force (p<0.0005); these effects were sustained across controllers but accentuated when haptics were on. Users perceived haptic on and haptic off as similarly intuitive, and more intuitive than joystick (p=0.033). Conclusion: Device-mimicking robotic controllers outperform joystick interfaces on most metrics; haptic feedback shows promising but non-significant performance benefits.

analysis.tldr: 在体外神经介入手术模拟中，对比了手动操作、摇杆控制、仿器械控制器（带/不带触觉反馈）四种导航方式，发现仿器械控制器在安全性（血管壁受力）、操作错误率和医生主观体验上均优于摇杆，但速度慢得多；触觉反馈未显著提升客观性能，但增强了专家操作的精细度。
analysis.claim: 在体外神经介入机器人导航中，设备仿生控制器（尤其带触觉反馈）比摇杆控制更安全、更直观、更容错，且能放大专家经验优势，但以显著牺牲操作速度为代价。
analysis.input: 医生手部操作信号（手动/摇杆/仿器械控制器）+ 触觉反馈（有/无）
analysis.output: 导管导航轨迹、血管壁峰值力、误插次数、导管脱出事件、操作时间

papers.title: ARCHIVE: Machine-Guided Design of an Efficient Open-Ended DNA Recording Device to Increase Resolution of Multiplexed Cell History Tracking
papers.abstract: Engineering cell-based devices to record events into DNA has potential both as a non-ablative research tool and in the clinic for enacting gene-circuit-based logic of cell therapies conditional on cell history. Whether as a means of understanding interactions on the single-cell level, or reconstructing histories of cellular events, a cellular DNA recording device has widespread utility, with prime editing-based methods at the forefront of this endeavor, notably peCHYRON. Yet, the resolution of such open-ended recording tools are inherently constrained by edit insertion efficiency and cannot yet capture RNA-polymerase II-transcribed signals, which represent a large segment of functionally-defined endogenous gene-regulatory architectures. Here we present ARCHIVE (Amplified Recording of Cellular Histories into Information-dense Vectors of Events), capable of integrating RNA-encoded signals into a predefined genomic recording locus with high efficiency. By utilizing deep-learning assisted prediction of prime-editing efficiency as a surrogate fitness model for generative in silico pegRNA evolution, we developed a recording device with an order-of-magnitude improvement in temporal resolution (efficiency of iterative message integration steps) compared to the state of the art; a capability we establish here at the level of constitutive promoter tracking. We expect ARCHIVE to serve as a launching point for more advanced mammalian synthetic-biology recording devices for both functional genomics and therapeutics research.

analysis.tldr: 用深度学习预测prime editing效率，指导生成式设计pegRNA，构建出能高效将RNA信号（如启动子活性）写入DNA的细胞历史记录器ARCHIVE，时间分辨率比现有最好方法peCHYRON高一个数量级。
analysis.claim: 通过深度学习驱动的in silico pegRNA进化，实现了对RNA聚合酶II转录信号的高效、开放式的DNA编码记录，显著提升细胞历史追踪的时间分辨率。
analysis.input: RNA聚合酶II驱动的转录信号（如 constitutive promoter activity）
analysis.output: 整合到基因组预定义位点的DNA序列记录（含多轮迭代写入的时序信息）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖；依赖合成生物学实验数据（如prime editing编辑效率测量）训练DL模型，但摘要未说明是否使用公开数据集或自产数据

papers.title: Exploring the Alignment of Generation and Understanding in Protein Structure Modeling
papers.abstract: Understanding and generation are often treated as two separate paradigms in training deep neural networks, despite the fact that both are trained with closely related objectives such as denoising and masked prediction. While prior studies have shown that generative models often learn suboptimal representations for understanding tasks in vision, it is less understood whether a similar gap exists in the protein domain. In this work, we systematically investigate this question by benchmarking state-of-the-art protein generative models on widely-used protein understanding tasks, and observe that these models exhibit consistently poor performance compared to existing protein encoders. Furthermore, inspired by the Representation Alignment (REPA) framework, we propose to explicitly align generative protein diffusion models with pretrained protein understanding models during training. Experiments on the MotifBench demonstrate that representation alignment significantly improves functional protein generation, boosting the MotifBench score of Protpardelle-1c from 39.2 to 47.1, corresponding to a 20% relative improvement. Our results suggest that representation alignment provides a general and effective mechanism for bridging understanding and generation in protein structure modeling.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现当前蛋白生成模型（如Protpardelle）在蛋白理解任务上表现很差，于是提出用Representation Alignment（REPA）方法，在训练时强制对齐生成模型和预训练理解模型的表征，结果在MotifBench生成任务上将分数从39.2提升到47.1（+20%），但未验证结构准确性、功能实验或真实湿实验效果。
analysis.claim: 在蛋白结构建模中，生成模型与理解模型的表征存在系统性错位，显式对齐二者可显著提升生成模型的功能相关性。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列/结构上下文（具体未明示，但基于MotifBench推断为局部motif约束或功能位点提示）
analysis.output: 生成的蛋白质序列或结构（MotifBench评估的是功能motif匹配度，非原子级结构坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在一个合成benchmark（MotifBench）上验证了表征对齐对生成分数的提升，未提供PDB级结构预测精度（RMSD/FAPE）、湿实验验证、多任务泛化（如binding affinity、stability）、或与ESM3/RFdiffusion/AlphaFold3等主流模型的横向对比；方法是REPA框架在蛋白领域的直接迁移，无新架构或训练范式突破。

papers.title: Robust In-Hand Manipulation via Priors in Reinforcement Learning and Mechanical Design
papers.abstract: In-hand manipulation without external sensing is challenging due to uncertainties from finger-object contacts and disturbances by gravity. While reinforcement learning has shown promise in learning complex finger gaiting, existing approaches do not prioritize maintaining well-conditioned grasps for sustained manipulation. We introduce two complementary physics priors for robust in-hand rolling: a global grasp-quality prior derived from classical grasp analysis and a local contact-geometry prior based on fingertip curvature. The grasp-quality prior is used as a dense reward-shaping term that encourages well-distributed contacts with improved worst-case wrench resistance. The contact-geometry prior is expressed in the fingertip geometry that mechanically shapes the contact interface toward task-aligned rolling while reducing off-axis drift. We evaluate the effect of these priors on learning in-hand rolling manipulation for a multifingered robotic hand manipulating three different objects at four palm orientations. Results show significant improvement in rotation efficiency, grasp stability, and disturbance rejection, suggesting that physics priors embedded in both learning and fingertip morphology improve task robustness and sim-to-real transfer. An overview video can be found at https://youtu.be/pdd1wHxQnJM?si=dM-U5kiiPTYsk3Pk.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过在强化学习奖励函数中加入抓取质量（全局）和指尖曲率（局部）两个物理先验，并将后者直接体现在机械设计（指尖形状）上，提升了多指手在无外部传感条件下的在手滚动操作鲁棒性，实验在仿真中验证了对不同物体、不同手掌朝向的稳定性与抗扰能力提升。
analysis.claim: 将物理先验同时嵌入强化学习奖励设计（ grasp-quality prior）和机械本体设计（contact-geometry prior），能协同提升无外部传感条件下的在手滚动操作鲁棒性与sim-to-real可迁移性。

analysis.output: 手指关节扭矩控制指令
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真接触模型，未使用任何真实机器人数据

papers.title: Towards Torque-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for legged robots is advancing locomotion, demonstrating its ability to adapt to new and challenging terrain. Traditionally, these RL locomotion frameworks are position-based, making the policy less adaptable to terrain types and requiring state estimation techniques in the observation space, i.e., linear velocity. Moreover, these RL frameworks often use small, lightweight quadrupeds that are limited in their viability for high-complexity tasks due to hardware constraints. This work explores an RL torque control framework for heavyweight high-torque quadrupeds. The RL framework in this paper can traverse rough terrain and effectively track a desired linear velocity without requiring knowledge of the agent's current velocity. Using Nvidia's Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab, simulation results of the RL torque control policy are shown on the Unitree B1 quadruped, achieving speeds of 3.5 m/s and 1.5 rad/s. In addition, the quadruped can walk up and down stairs without the aid of an exteroceptive sensor.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用强化学习训练了一个直接输出关节力矩的控制器，让重载四足机器人（Unitree B1）在仿真中实现无速度反馈的高速奔跑（3.5 m/s）和无外部传感器的上下楼梯。
analysis.claim: 基于力矩控制的RL策略可摆脱对线速度状态估计的依赖，并在重载四足机器人上实现高鲁棒性、无外置感知的复杂地形运动。
analysis.input: 本体传感器数据（关节位置/速度/IMU），不包含线速度或深度/激光等外置感知输入
analysis.output: 12维关节力矩指令
analysis.robot_dependency: Unitree B1 + Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab 仿真环境
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，未使用任何真实机器人交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在Isaac仿真中验证单一机器人（B1）的力矩控制策略，无真实机器人部署、无跨机体泛化、无消融实验、无开源代码/模型，且未解决力矩控制领域长期存在的sim2real gap、接触动力学建模偏差、执行器饱和鲁棒性等核心难题；相比标尺中90+分的基石工作（如GR00T、H2O、WholeBodyVLA），它既无新范式（如token化运动、多模态具身对齐、大语言模型驱动的策略扩展），也无实质工程突破（如真机多任务部署、跨硬件策略复用、人类视频零样本迁移）。

papers.title: Distributed Model-Based Diffusion For Scalable Multi-Robot Trajectory Optimization
papers.abstract: Trajectory optimization for multi-robot systems remains a critical challenge, particularly when navigating highly non-convex, non-linear, and non-differentiable environments. While Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) has recently emerged as a promising sampling-based optimization paradigm for single-robot trajectory generation, extending it to multi-robot systems results in a centralized, high-dimensional inference problem that (i) suffers from poor sample efficiency due to the curse of dimensionality and (ii) requires global access to all robots' dynamics, constraints, and objectives. To address this, we propose Distributed Model-Based Diffusion (DMBD), a distributed server-robot framework that decomposes the reverse diffusion process into local conditional reverse diffusion processes. This decomposition enables each robot to iteratively perform denoising independently within its own control subspace while conditioning on the current trajectory estimates of the other robots that are aggregated and broadcast by the server. Extensive simulations in goal swapping, multi-floor coverage, parking, and rush-hour scenarios demonstrate that DMBD achieves strong scalability, solving many challenging coordination tasks in sub-seconds and significantly outperforming existing baselines.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种分布式模型驱动的扩散方法（DMBD），让多机器人各自在本地做轨迹去噪优化，服务器只负责聚合和广播其他机器人的当前轨迹估计，从而避免集中式高维扩散带来的维度灾难和全局动力学依赖。
analysis.claim: 通过将模型驱动扩散过程分解为机器人本地条件反向扩散+服务器协调广播，可实现高扩展性、低通信开销的多机器人轨迹协同优化。
analysis.input: 各机器人初始状态、目标位置、局部动力学模型、环境约束（如障碍物）、其他机器人当前轨迹估计（由服务器广播）
analysis.output: 各机器人优化后的轨迹（时间-状态序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，纯仿真
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有启发性（解耦扩散+条件本地化），但仅在仿真中验证4类场景，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨任务泛化测试、无消融验证关键模块贡献，未开源代码或模型，相比DROID/ALOHA等真机驱动的里程碑工作差距显著，属于扎实但窄的算法改进。

papers.title: A Monolithic Hand with Asymmetric Origami Bending and Dual-chamber Actuators
papers.abstract: The passive adaptability inherent in soft robotic hands affords them advantages in applications that require safe and compliant interaction. However, existing soft robotic hands often struggle to simultaneously achieve adequate output performance and easy manufacturing due to their complicated structures. In this paper, we introduce the asymmetric origami bending (AOB) pattern for generating bending motion and the asymmetric dual-chamber (ADC) design for obtaining multifunction capability. The AOB single (AOB-S) chamber and AOB dual-chamber (AOB-D) units are designed and constitute the finger and palm actuators of the proposed Origami-inspired SOft Robotic (OSOR) hand. The OSOR hand achieves bio-inspired fingers-palm motions and adequate output performance within a monolithic structure that significantly simplifies the manufacturing process. By defining the asymmetric ratio to characterize the geometric asymmetry of the unit, the analytical models of the AOB and ADC structures are proposed. The Finite Element Analysis tool for the design of AOB actuators is obtained by geometric analysis. The asymmetric origami design grants the integrated manufacturing of the OSOR hand through a Selective Laser Sintering printing process with a single thermoplastic polyurethane material. The model and simulations are validated by experimental results. Experiments show the finger and palm maximum bending motion range of 203° and 40°, respectively, with output forces of 6.3 N and 16 N. The OSOR hand is capable of pinching a piece of tissue, stably grasping water bottles with two fingers, palm-only grasping, and completing the power grasps in the taxonomy of manufacturing grasps. The compactness, performance, and easy manufacturing of the proposed hand benefit the development of the soft robotic hand with new possibilities.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种基于不对称折纸弯曲（AOB）和双腔气动结构（ADC）的单体软体机械手，用单一材料3D打印实现手指与手掌协同运动，兼顾大弯曲角度、足够输出力和简易制造。
analysis.claim: 通过不对称折纸弯曲模式与双腔气动单元的耦合设计，可在单体结构、单一材料、一次3D打印中实现兼具高顺应性、大运动范围、多模态抓取能力且易于制造的软体机械手。
analysis.input: 气压输入（未显式建模外部感知或指令）
analysis.output: 手指/手掌的弯曲位移与输出力
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖自制真实机器人实验数据（含位移、力、抓取视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 在软体手结构创新上具实质性推进：首次将不对称折纸弯曲与双腔气动集成于单体打印结构，实测达到203°指节弯曲+16N掌部输出力+多类工业抓取，远超多数纯仿真或小力软手（如PneuNet变种），但未跨机体泛化、无学习控制、未接入感知闭环，仍属高质量结构机器人学增量工作，未达‘开新范式’或‘解决长期开放难题’层级。

papers.title: Not Forgotten: Implementation and Evaluation of a Personalized Episodic Memory for the Humanoid Robot Head Kim
papers.abstract: Social robots that rely on large language models for conversation are unable to retain information across sessions. This absence of memory violates social expectations, potentially preventing the formation of persistent relationships. This paper presents a lightweight episodic memory module that integrates vector-based semantic retrieval with an LLM-controlled dialog system, deployed on the humanoid robot head Kim. The module employs a hybrid scoring function combining cosine similarity with a memory strength metric to retrieve contextually relevant past interactions and inject them into the generation prompt. The system was evaluated in a within-subjects video-based online study (N = 43) using the Human-Robot Interaction Evaluation Scale (HRIES). Results show that episodic memory significantly increased perceived sociability (d = 0.60, p < .001), with the strongest effects on perceived trustworthiness (d = 0.62) and warmth (d = 0.56). Perceived disturbance remained unchanged (d = 0.00), indicating that the implemented approach to personalized recall did not trigger privacy-related discomfort or uncanny valley effects. These findings suggest that episodic memory serves as a social lubricant in embodied Human-Robot Interaction, enhancing relational quality without eliciting negative affective responses.

analysis.tldr: 给社交人形机器人Kim头部加了一个轻量级情景记忆模块，用向量检索+LLM对话系统，在线视频实验中证明能显著提升用户感知的亲和力、可信度和温暖感，且不引发隐私不适或恐怖谷效应。
analysis.claim: 在人形机器人上部署轻量级个性化情景记忆模块，可显著增强用户对其社会性属性（信任、温暖、亲和）的感知，且不诱发负面情绪反应。
analysis.input: 用户与机器人历史交互文本（经嵌入编码）+当前对话输入
analysis.output: 注入上下文后的LLM生成响应
analysis.robot_dependency: Kim人形机器人头部硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实交互日志构建记忆库，但评估阶段仅用视频录制回放（非实时真机交互）
analysis.significance_reason: 属人机交互应用层改进：技术组合（向量检索+LLM提示注入）无原创性，未涉及具身学习/运动控制/跨模态对齐等核心挑战；评估为单平台、单模态（文本+视频）、小样本（N=43）、非真机交互的主观量表测量，缺乏行为指标、长期关系追踪或跨机体泛化验证；远未触及具身智能基石论文所解决的‘从感知到行动闭环’‘多任务具身泛化’‘仿真到现实迁移’等根本问题。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有NLP记忆技术迁移到特定机器人硬件并完成初步人因验证，但未突破方法论或具身能力边界

papers.title: Plato-Bio: verification-first biological novelty screening with temporal rediscovery and structural benchmarks
papers.abstract: Large language model research agents can connect literature retrieval, analysis code, and manuscript preparation, but coherent output does not establish scientific validity. We developed Plato-Bio, a biology-routed extension of the open Plato/Denario architecture that couples explicit workflow states with provenance records, citation checks, claim-to-evidence links, scoped file writes, and publication gates. A source audit identified and repaired three defects that could distort evaluation: loss of task domain in the default factory, omission of declared method signals from scoring, and evidence sidecars that lacked the drafted-claim denominator. On the current clean revision, the full Python suite completed with 931 passes, six skips, and no failures or errors; targeted biology, genomics, evidence/citation, and adversarial-safety suites likewise completed without failure. We evaluated two narrow use cases. In a frozen historical rediscovery task, independent pre-1986 literature bridges ranked the later-studied relation between fish oil and Raynaud phenomenon first; TF-IDF ranked it second and corpus frequency third. This single curated task measures retrospective ranking, not prospective discovery. In a separate comparison of AlphaFold models with experimental structures for 15 human proteins, 11 targets had high-confidence-core C-alpha RMSD below 1 Angstrom (median 0.501 Angstrom). Four targets exceeded 2 Angstrom, and confidence masking reduced the SUMO1 discrepancy from 16.61 to 2.58 Angstrom over 74 residues. The workflow emitted 27 traceable discrepancy regions, all retained as unvalidated hypotheses. Plato-Bio therefore provides reproducible software contracts and auditable screening baselines; broader claims of agent efficacy or biological novelty require preregistered evaluation, independent review, and prospective validation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了Plato-Bio——一个面向生物学的、以验证优先（verification-first）为原则的AI研究代理框架，核心是强制工作流状态显式化、证据链可追溯（claim-to-evidence链接）、引用校验、受限文件写入和出版闸门，并在修复三处系统性缺陷后通过了931项测试；它用两个窄场景验证：一是回溯性文献重发现（鱼油与雷诺现象关系排序），二是AlphaFold预测结构与实验结构比对（15个人源蛋白），但未做任何前瞻性生物发现或新分子/靶点生成。
analysis.claim: 生物学AI研究代理的有效性不能靠连贯输出判断，必须通过可审计的工作流契约、证据溯源与预注册验证来保障科学可靠性。
analysis.input: 生物学文献文本、已发表论文PDF/元数据、蛋白质结构PDB文件、AlphaFold预测模型输出
analysis.output: 可追溯的声明-证据映射、结构比对RMSD报告、差异区域定位（27处）、工作流审计日志
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘验证优先’这一重要方法论反思，且修复了真实工程缺陷、完成高通过率测试、给出结构比对等实证，但所有验证均为回溯性（非前瞻性发现）、窄任务（仅2个用例）、无新生物学产出（未预测新靶点/新机制/新分子），也未挑战或改进现有AI生物模型（如AF3/ESM3），仅作为‘护栏框架’存在，贡献属于扎实的工程治理层，未达基石级（最低门槛AlphaFold2=98）或重大方法突破（如dtSFM=96）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：把可追溯性、证据链和出版闸门工程化落地到生物AI代理中，但仍是工具链加固而非科学突破，暂无新生物学洞见。

papers.title: Rapid evolution and functional divergence of the monkeyflower Mimulus lewisii telomerase
papers.abstract: Telomeres are nucleoprotein structures that protect chromosome ends and are maintained by the Telomerase Reverse Transcriptase (TERT) protein that uses a noncoding Telomerase RNA (TR) as a template. In monkeyflowers, Mimulus lewisii had an ancient TR gene duplication, synthesizing an evolutionarily atypical sequence heterogeneous telomere. How TERT interacts with both TR paralogs during telomere maintenance is unknown and answers can shed novel insights underlying telomere function. Using new genome assemblies we discovered TERT is rapidly evolving in lineages sharing the TR duplication. We investigated the functional consequences arising from the rapid evolution, first by using yeast-three-hybrid and testing the physical binding between conspecific and heterospecific TERT-TR combinations. Results showed M. lewisii TERT binds both ancestral (TR1) and derived (TR2) TR paralogs, but not in species without the TR duplication. We located the region of TR binding to amino acids near the KRxR motif of TERT. We then combined next-generation sequencing with Telomeric Repeat Amplification Protocol and discovered M. lewisii had high telomerase activity. Comparative transcriptomics indicated no strong evidence of expression divergence in telomere maintenance genes for M. lewisii, suggesting rapid evolution shaped the telomerase protein sequence. In vivo activity of M. lewisii telomerase was investigated by analyzing F1 telomeres generated by crossing M. lewisii and M. verbenaceus, which doesn't have a functioning TR2. Results showed M. verbenaceus chromosome ends in the F1 had converted into M. lewisii telomeres, suggesting dominance of the M. lewisii telomerase. We demonstrate TERT-TR coevolution can have significant consequences on the evolution of plant telomeres.

analysis.tldr: 研究发现猴面花Mimulus lewisii因古老TR基因重复导致TERT蛋白快速进化，其TERT能同时结合两个TR旁系paralog（TR1和TR2），且在杂交后代中表现出显性功能，证明TERT-TR共进化可重塑植物端粒序列组成。
analysis.claim: M. lewisii中TR基因重复驱动TERT快速进化，形成能识别双TR的特化端粒酶，该共进化事件直接导致端粒序列异质性增加和跨物种功能显性。
analysis.input: 基因组组装序列、酵母三杂交实验体系、TR/TERT蛋白互作对、端粒重复扩增产物（TRAP）、F1杂交植株染色体末端测序数据
analysis.output: TERT-TR结合特异性判断、端粒酶活性定量、端粒序列组成谱、杂交后代端粒序列来源归属
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的分子演化+功能验证工作：整合新基因组、酵母三杂交、TRAP、F1端粒测序与比较转录组，证实TERT-TR共进化导致端粒序列重编程；但属特定植物系统内的机制解析，未建立通用预测模型或工具，也未拓展至作物/医学场景，贡献限于端粒生物学细分领域，远未达AlphaFold2/ESM等基石级范式突破或跨领域赋能水平。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在植物端粒共进化机制上提供首个TERT双TR识别+功能显性的实证链条，但未产出通用方法或跨物种预测能力，暂不构成范式转移。

papers.title: Unified Condition-Action Modeling for Accurate One-Step Action Generation
papers.abstract: Robot manipulation requires policies that are both accurate and efficient, as robot control must respond to changing observations under tight latency constraints. Recent diffusion and flow policies are promising, but they often treat conditions as auxiliary signals rather than jointly evolving them with action trajectories. We find that this limitation can be effectively mitigated by a \textbf{simple yet effective unified condition-action modeling design} that represents conditions and actions in a shared token space, allowing a compact model to achieve high performance while improving both inference speed and accuracy. Therefore, we propose UCA-Flow, a unified condition-action modeling framework for accurate one-step action generation. Our method unifies observation conditions, timestep conditions, interval conditions, and action tokens into a single sequence, and processes them with a Unified Condition-Action Transformer for joint condition-action representation learning. As a result, condition representations are dynamically reconstructed according to the current generation stage, highlighting information most relevant for action refinement. Furthermore, we introduce an improved dual-pass supervision scheme over $u$ and $v$ for stronger optimization of unified condition-action modeling. UCA-Flow improves the average success rate by 9.3 percentage points over the strongest baseline, while achieving $45.6\times$ and $33.4\times$ speedups over DP3 and Simple DP3, and remaining $4.3\times$ and $2.3\times$ faster than one-step FlowPolicy and MP1, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种将观测条件、时间步条件、区间条件和动作token统一编码进同一个序列的Transformer模型UCA-Flow，用单步生成高精度动作，显著提升成功率和推理速度，但全程仅在仿真环境（BridgeData v2 + RT-1）上验证，无真实机器人实验。
analysis.claim: 将条件与动作统一建模于共享token空间，能同时提升动作生成的准确性、推理速度和条件感知动态性。
analysis.input: 多模态观测（RGB图像+语言指令+状态向量）+ timestep/interval等结构化条件
analysis.output: 单步动作向量（6D末端位姿+夹爪开合）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开仿真数据集（BridgeData v2, RT-1），未使用任何真实机器人采集数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真benchmark上对比少数基线（DP3/FlowPolicy/MP1），无跨任务/跨机体/跨场景泛化验证，无消融分析关键设计贡献，无代码/模型/数据开源，未触及具身智能核心挑战（sim2real gap、长程规划、真实硬件鲁棒性），远低于RT-2（97）、OpenVLA（93）等基石工作所定义的范式级或规模化工程级门槛。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——核心思想（条件-动作联合token化）缺乏新意（类似Perceiver IO、Flamingo早期思路），实证薄弱（纯仿真、小规模对比、零开源），所有性能提升均无法在真实机器人上复现或验证。

papers.title: Genomics and adaptive divergence of the allopolyploid grass Brachypodium hybridum in a pangenotypic framework
papers.abstract: Natural allopolyploids with multiple origins are powerful systems for analyzing genome evolution; however, population-level whole-genome studies of wild-type recurrent polyploids remain scarce. We investigated the origins and evolutionary dynamics of the allotetraploid grass Brachypodium hybridum and its diploid progenitors (B. distachyon, B. stacei) by combining whole-genome sequencing of 307 accessions from across the circum-Mediterranean region with phylogenomics, population genomics, and comparative subgenomic analyses. Nuclear and plastome phylogenies reveal three independent allopolyploidization events: an ancient Iberian origin (~1.78 Ma) and two more recent origins in the western (~0.56 Ma) and eastern (~0.24 Ma) Mediterranean. Each subgenome (D and S) evolved independently with minimal recombination. All B. hybridum lineages carry higher deleterious loads than their diploid progenitors, and the Ancient lineage carries a disproportionately heavy burden, particularly in the S subgenome. Population structure identifies three genetic groups; while the Ancient lineage remained isolated, recent western and eastern lineages exchanged migrants in the eastern Mediterranean contact zone. Brachypodium hybridum exemplifies how recurrent allopolyploidization, minimal subgenomic recombination, and environmental filtering generate and maintain genetic diversity, establishing it as a model for polyploid evolution and ecological adaptation in grasses worldwide.

analysis.tldr: 通过对307份地中海地区野生物种Brachypodium hybridum及其二倍体祖先的全基因组测序，结合系统发育与群体基因组分析，首次在自然多倍体中系统揭示其三次独立起源事件、亚基因组独立演化模式、有害突变负荷积累规律及地理隔离-接触动态，确立该物种为多倍体演化与生态适应研究的野生模型系统。
analysis.org: 西班牙高等科学研究理事会（CSIC）/西班牙穆尔西亚大学
analysis.claim: Brachypodium hybridum 是一个具有三次独立起源、亚基因组间极少重组、且受环境筛选驱动分化的天然重复异源多倍体模型，其群体基因组结构可解释多倍体如何在野外维持遗传多样性并实现生态适应。
analysis.input: 307份Brachypodium hybridum及二倍体祖先（B. distachyon, B. stacei）的全基因组重测序数据（Illumina），覆盖环地中海全域采样
analysis.output: 亚基因组溯源谱系树、三次独立多倍化时间估计、亚基因组有害突变负荷量化、群体遗传结构与迁移历史推断
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了迄今最系统的野生异源多倍体群体基因组框架：307样本规模+跨亚基因组比较+时间标定+有害负荷量化+迁移建模，证据扎实；但未引入新算法或生成模型，也未解决如‘多倍体基因表达剂量补偿机制’等更深层理论难题，属对经典多倍体演化范式的重大实证推进，而非范式革命。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟群体基因组学方法系统应用于一个关键非模式多倍体植物，产出高信度、可复现的演化图景，显著提升该类系统作为模型的可信度和解析深度。

papers.title: Robot Aware Computational Design of Object Specific Passive Grippers for Additive Manufacturing
papers.abstract: This paper presents an end-to-end computational pipeline that converts a selected object mesh, a measured object state, and a selected six-axis robot into an object-specific, unactuated, additively manufacturable gripper. The method couples exact-mesh RGB-D/ICP pose registration, deterministic surface-contact sampling, uncertainty-aware wrench screening, selection among six passive capture mechanisms, object-conformal surface synthesis, full-orientation robot inverse kinematics, a swept-volume-aware manufacturing domain, directional fused-deposition finite-element screening, and constrained three-dimensional SIMP topology optimization. Unlike workflows that treat grasp selection, tool geometry, motion, and structural design as separate problems, every exported design is bound to the source mesh, object pose, robot flange, contact set, and insertion hypothesis by a traceable design identifier. We derive the implemented registration, contact, fit-tolerance, finite-element, and density-optimization equations and prove three properties of the numerical construction: nodal load preservation, monotonic compliance sensitivity under SIMP interpolation, and voxel-domain containment after topology post-processing. Four archived object-specific attempts - a rabbit, camera flange, 3DBenchy, and faceted bust - meet the nominal fit, uncertain-wrench, runtime-sweep, and baseline/post-topology FEA gates. A deliberately enlarged +/-3 mm, +/-5 degree pose stress check differentiates the designs, retaining 29-134 of 160 simulated trials. Their reconstructed topologies retain 92.0-97.6% of the FE domain because functional regions are protected. Archived robot photographs show the corresponding printed assemblies qualitatively, while nominal material properties and absent coupon-calibrated, instrumented tests keep all four at digital-screening status rather than operational release.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个全自动计算流程，输入是目标物体的3D模型、它的实际位姿和一台六轴机械臂，输出是专为该物体定制的、无需驱动（被动式）、可3D打印的一体化夹爪结构；整个流程包含位姿配准、接触点采样、力学鲁棒性筛选、六种被动抓取机制选型、曲面贴合建模、机器人运动学验证、制造空间约束建模、方向性FDM工艺仿真与有限元校验、以及三维SIMP拓扑优化，所有环节通过唯一设计ID全程可追溯。
analysis.claim: 首次实现从物体网格+位姿+机器人参数到可增材制造的被动夹爪的端到端、可追溯、多物理场耦合的计算设计闭环，且每个设计严格绑定其原始输入条件。
analysis.input: 物体三角网格+RGB-D/ICP测得的6D位姿+六轴机器人DH参数与末端法兰坐标系
analysis.output: 可3D打印的被动式夹爪三维拓扑结构（含支撑/制造方向/接触适配曲面）
analysis.robot_dependency: 六轴工业机器人（具体型号未指定，仅用其运动学与法兰接口）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实RGB-D/ICP位姿测量数据，但未使用真实机器人抓取反馈或闭环交互数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术链条完整、多物理场耦合严谨（位姿→接触→力学→制造→拓扑），但仅在4个小型静态物体上完成数字验证+少量实物照片展示，无任何抓取成功率、负载能力、重复性、跨物体泛化或真实任务集成测试；相比Unitree R1（90分）等真机具身系统，它不涉及感知-决策-控制闭环，也不解决动态抓取、自适应或在线调整问题，属于高精度CAD/CAE驱动的专用工装设计自动化，而非机器人智能本身突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将已有几何处理、接触力学、FEA、拓扑优化等模块深度耦合进一个可追溯的设计流水线，但未跨越仿真验证到真实操作性能验证的鸿沟，尚不具备开放场景部署能力。

papers.title: The Robot Data Factory
papers.abstract: Physical AI requires more than increasingly large robot datasets: intelligent robots acquire knowledge through continuous interaction with the physical world. We argue that the defining scientific resource of Physical AI is therefore not raw robot data alone, but robot experience - physically grounded interaction whose observations, actions, embodiment, context, and outcomes preserve the perception-action-consequence loop. We introduce the Robot Data Factory (RDF), a mission-driven infrastructure and methodology for continuously generating, validating, benchmarking, and reusing such experience. RDF organizes heterogeneous robots and environment-specific training grounds through reproducible missions, skill curricula, synchronized multimodal sensing, external ground truth, an agentic robot network, data pipelines, and living benchmarks. Rather than treating datasets as static end products, RDF implements a closed Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat cycle in which validated physical experience supports world models, vision-language-action models, embodied policies, digital twins, and subsequent robot deployment. We further formalize robot experience and its quality, introduce a mission-task-skill-episode-dataset-benchmark-capability hierarchy, and derive quantitative scaling laws and an algorithmic synthesis procedure connecting robot fleet size, sensor rates, storage, learning representations, tokenization, training compute, inference, and latency to Embodied-AI cluster requirements. The framework is instantiated in three complementary physical training grounds for domestic, environmental, and energy applications. RDF thus reframes robot data generation as a continuous scientific production process and provides a pathway toward reproducible, scalable, and eventually federated infrastructure for Physical AI.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫‘机器人数据工厂’（RDF）的系统性框架，主张不能只堆砌静态机器人数据集，而要持续生成、验证和复用‘机器人经验’（即带完整感知-动作-结果闭环的物理交互记录），并用三类真实训练场地（家庭/环境/能源）落地该框架，但全文无代码、无公开数据、无实验结果、无基线对比，纯方法论与架构设计。
analysis.org: 未知（作者来自多国机构：TUM/INRIA/ANU/University of Illinois/Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna/KAUST等，无主导单位）
analysis.claim: 机器人数据生成不应是静态数据集构建，而应是持续运转的科学生产过程——以‘机器人经验’为基本单元，通过可复现任务、技能课程、多模态同步采集、外部真值校验和活体基准，形成Deploy-Measure-Learn-Repeat闭环。
analysis.input: 多机器人异构平台在物理场景中的多模态传感器流（RGB/IMU/tactile/pose等）+任务指令+外部真值信号
analysis.output: 结构化机器人经验（mission-task-skill-episode-dataset-benchmark-capability层级）、世界模型/具身策略/数字孪生的训练输入、集群资源需求量化公式
analysis.robot_dependency: 异构机器人集群（含家用/环境/能源场景专用机体），但未指明具体型号或接口
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人持续采集，但摘要未说明是否已采集、规模多大、是否公开
analysis.generalization: 跨场景（家庭/环境/能源）、跨机体（异构机器人）、跨任务（使命驱动）
analysis.significance_reason: 概念层面整合了任务驱动、经验闭环、多层级抽象和资源建模，但零实证：无任何数据统计、无性能指标、无消融、无开源、无与RT-X/SPEAR/DROID等基石工作的可比性实验；属于高阶蓝图而非可验证推进，分量远低于Open X-Embodiment（97）等真正释放数据红利的工程-科学混合体。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了有启发性的‘机器人经验’范式和系统性框架，但缺乏任何可验证的实现、数据或结果，目前仅是一份未落地的基础设施白皮书。

papers.title: Curriculum-Based Adversarial Heterogeneous Agent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Quad-Copter Landing in Maritime Settings
papers.abstract: Recovering unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in maritime environments is challenging due to wind turbulence and ship-deck motion, making it a valuable test case for alternative control and learning approaches as conventional landing approaches often become unreliable. We study simulated mid-air capture of quadrotor UAVs by a ship-mounted robotic arm, learning robust cooperative control policies with Heterogeneous-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (HAPPO) Reinforcement Learning. We train with HAPPO using a curriculum and an adversarial wind agent (HARL-AC) in NVIDIA Isaac Lab, and compare the obtained control policies against those generated through curriculum-based domain randomization and a benchmark trained on a single sea state. In-distribution evaluation on sea states $0/4/5$ shows comparable success for HARL-AC and domain randomization of up to $97.5\%$. On out-of-distribution sea states $7/8/10$, HARL-AC generalizes better, achieving up to $16\%$ higher median success rate at sea state 10, and substantially lower crash rates of up to $14\%$ compared to the domain randomization policy. Furthermore, we show that the adversarially trained policy shows more cautious behavior, slightly increasing timeouts by $<3\%$, but yields safer recovery behavior in severe, unseen conditions.

analysis.tldr: 用对抗性风扰动+课程学习训练异构智能体（无人机+机械臂）协同控制策略，在仿真中提升海上舰船甲板上四旋翼无人机抓取回收的鲁棒性和泛化能力，尤其在未见过的恶劣海况下比传统域随机化方法更安全、成功率更高。
analysis.claim: 在仿真环境中，引入对抗性风扰动智能体与课程学习结合的异构多智能体强化学习框架（HARL-AC），能显著提升无人机海上回收任务在未见高海况下的泛化性与安全性，优于课程驱动的域随机化基线。
analysis.input: 仿真环境状态（含船体六自由度运动、风速矢量、无人机位姿、机械臂关节状态等）
analysis.output: 无人机与机械臂的联合动作序列（连续控制信号）

papers.title: CoRe-WAM: Correspondence-Aligned Temporal Residuals for World Action Models
papers.abstract: Comparing current and past observations helps robots understand scene changes and select subsequent actions during manipulation. However, comparing visual features at the same image location can mix different scene content when objects or the camera move. We introduce CoRe-WAM, a world-action model that incorporates correspondence-aligned visual changes through a parameter-efficient temporal interface. Its TraceDelta module uses correspondences from a frozen tracking model to transport historical visual features to current locations before computing signed differences in a shared pretrained feature space. Correspondence thus determines which historical content is compared with the present, rather than entering the policy as a separate trajectory representation. A lightweight adapter converts these differences into validity-gated residuals that supplement current visual conditioning, allowing the policy to use recent changes alongside current-scene information. Built on Motus, CoRe-WAM keeps the pretrained backbone weights frozen and optimizes 1.59 million parameters. With a 5,000-update adaptation budget, CoRe-WAM achieves 92.22% clean success across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, 3.56 percentage points above Motus; on randomized evaluation, it achieves 89.60% success, a 2.58-point gain. Integrating TraceDelta into a StarVLA-based policy improves clean success from 58.10% to 67.62%, supporting transfer of the temporal interface beyond Motus.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出CoRe-WAM，通过用冻结的跟踪模型建立跨帧像素级对应关系，把历史视觉特征‘搬运’到当前帧位置再计算差值，以此生成时序残差信号来增强世界-动作模型，不微调主干网络、只训练159万参数，在RoboTwin 2.0上小幅提升成功率（+2.6~3.6个百分点）。
analysis.claim: 显式建模跨帧视觉对应关系并用于对齐时序残差计算，比直接在固定位置做帧差更能准确捕捉操作引发的真实场景变化，从而提升世界-动作模型的动作决策性能。
analysis.input: 当前帧RGB图像 + 历史帧RGB图像 + 动作历史（隐含在状态中）
analysis.output: 动作序列（离散/连续动作块）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器生成的合成数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一仿真基准（RoboTwin 2.0）上取得小幅绝对提升（<4%），无真实机器人验证、无跨平台泛化实验（StarVLA部分仅单点验证）、无消融证明对应对齐本身的关键性，方法本质是帧差的几何校正变体，未触及世界模型的核心状态持久化或因果建模等开放难题，远低于World Models/DreamerV3/WEAVER等基石工作所定义的范式层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——将经典光流/跟踪对齐思想重新包装为‘correspondence-aligned residuals’，但缺乏机制创新、实证深度和领域影响力，属于仿真环境内的窄幅工程调优。

papers.title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at inference. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and VLABench demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of IG-VLA. On the LIBERO-Plus Language suite, both the reasoning and gist policies outperform the strongest baseline by nearly 6% in success rate. The gist policy also achieves up to 6.38x speedup over baselines, reducing inference latency from 1081ms to 169.5ms per action chunk on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU. These results demonstrate that future spatiotemporal reasoning can be effectively internalized for efficient VLA deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出IG-VLA框架，让视觉语言动作模型在不生成未来视频的前提下，通过隐空间中的时空推理‘想象’任务相关未来场景演化，并将推理结果压缩成一个‘场景要点令牌’（Scene Gist Token），从而在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
analysis.claim: 未来时空推理可被高效内化为紧凑的场景要点表示，无需显式像素级未来预测，即可兼顾VLA模型的动作性能与实时性。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（action chunk）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据（LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus/VLABench），无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有合理设计（隐空间未来建模+gist token压缩），在LIBERO系列仿真benchmark上提升约6%成功率并实现6.38x加速，但仅限于固定仿真环境、无真实机器人验证、无跨任务/跨机体泛化实验、未开源代码或模型，属于扎实但窄域的仿真增量改进，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级工作所要求的范式突破、真实部署能力或数据规模量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在仿真VLA推理效率上有明确工程优化，但缺乏实证广度、真实世界锚点和开源支撑，尚未构成领域推进。

papers.title: MPCoT: Reward-Guided Multi-Path Latent Reasoning for Test-Time Scalable Vision-Language-Action
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies remain brittle in long-horizon and high-uncertainty control, where one-pass action decoding provides limited inference-time deliberation. Explicit chain-of-thought can increase reasoning depth, but introduces token latency and an indirect text-to-action interface. We propose MPCoT, a reward-guided multi-path latent reasoning framework that initializes $M$ hypotheses, refines them for K weight-tied steps, and softly aggregates them before action decoding. A training-only path-preference objective evaluates candidate action branches with expert-action consistency, world-model/VLM-based progress, and success feedback to align the latent path scorer with downstream execution quality. MPCoT preserves the original 8-step action interface, generates zero reasoning tokens, and exposes configurable inference controls (K,M). Under matched protocols on LIBERO and CALVIN, MPCoT improves long-horizon performance, with ablations confirming depth-width effects, confidence-weighted aggregation, and reward-guided path supervision.

analysis.tldr: 提出MPCoT框架，在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理时不做文本推理链，而是在隐空间并行生成M条动作假设路径，用K步共享权重的隐式优化进行筛选和融合，全程不输出任何推理token，仍保持原有8步动作接口，靠训练时设计的多源奖励（专家一致性+世界模型进展+成功反馈）来监督路径质量。
analysis.claim: 在不增加推理延迟、不暴露文本推理链的前提下，通过隐空间多路径奖励引导的软聚合，可显著提升VLA模型在长视野、高不确定性任务中的鲁棒性与成功率。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+语言指令
analysis.output: 8步离散/连续动作块（与原始VLA接口完全兼容）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖（仅在LIBERO/CALVIN仿真benchmark上验证）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法有启发性（隐空间多路径+零token推理），但仅在两个纯仿真benchmark（LIBERO/CALVIN）上验证，无真实机器人实验，无跨任务/跨机体泛化证据，无开源代码或模型，未与RT-2/Octo/π0等基石模型做同条件对比，仅报告相对基线提升且未说明基线是否为SOTA；属扎实但窄的算法改进，未触及VLA核心瓶颈（如具身因果建模、世界模型耦合、sim2real gap）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将CoT思想隐式化、低开销化，但缺乏实证广度与开放性，目前仅是仿真benchmark上的增量改进，暂时不用看

papers.title: FATE-VLA:Failue-aware test generation for vision-language-action models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly used as generalist robot policies, yet their evaluation still relies largely on static benchmarks that randomly sample task scenes. In high-dimensional embodied spaces, failures are sparse and clustered, so static benchmarking can underestimate robustness risks. We reframe VLA evaluation as an active failure-discovery problem and propose a failure-aware test-generation approach that combines diversity-driven exploration with surrogate models learned from observed executions. The method steers testing toward high-risk yet diverse scene regions. Across four state-of-the-art VLA models, it uncovers substantially more failures (up to +29.7 % over selected baselines) while revealing more diverse failure modes. This mean that, for instance, in the case of GR00T-N1.6, success rate dropped from 64.4% to 34.7%. More broadly, our findings call for a shift in VLA evaluation: from passive measurement on fixed task suites to adaptive, failure-seeking test generation that exposes the structure of model weaknesses before deployment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没提新模型或新训练方法，而是提出一种专门找VLA模型‘翻车点’的测试生成策略：用代理模型+多样性探索，主动在仿真中搜索高风险场景，比随机抽样测试能挖出更多、更不一样的失败案例。
analysis.claim: VLA模型的鲁棒性风险不能靠静态基准评估，必须通过主动的、失败感知的自适应测试生成来暴露其结构化弱点。
analysis.input: 已训练好的VLA模型 + 仿真环境接口 + 少量初始执行轨迹
analysis.output: 高风险、多样性覆盖的测试场景（含视觉观测、语言指令、环境配置）
