papers.title: Runtime Safety Filtering for Two-Terminal Hazards in Robotic Battery Recycling
papers.abstract: Runtime safety filters for learned manipulation policies typically define unsafe states as unions of object-wise keep-out regions. This representation can be unnecessarily restrictive for hazards that depend on a joint spatial relation, such as battery recycling, where a conductive payload can short a charged cell only when it approaches both terminals simultaneously. We study runtime filtering for this two-terminal hazard in LIBERO using frozen OpenVLA policies. We factor a runtime filter into three design choices: the predicate structure, its geometric margin, and the fallback action applied when a commanded action is rejected. We compare a conjunctive predicate, a conventional two-site keep-out, and a composite of the two. For each predicate, we vary its margin to obtain a frontier between task success and residual hazard. We then compare four fallback strategies at matched operating points: holding, retreat, sampled search, and a continuous-action barrier projection. Across three workcells, the three predicate families trace nearly identical safety--utility frontiers once each is evaluated over its own margin. In contrast, the fallback strategy has a substantially larger effect: holding reduces task success by up to 0.302 relative to retreat without reducing hazard, while both minimally invasive fallbacks leave substantially more residual hazard. This ordering transfers to a second policy and task suite, while retreat-based filtering remains effective under standing errors in the clearances available to the filter, although correlated error in the estimated payload size is more damaging than larger independent errors in terminal position. These results show that, for proximity-defined manipulation hazards, margin selection and fallback strategy can matter more than predicate structure in determining the safety--utility trade-off of a runtime filter.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究了在机器人电池回收任务中如何实时过滤掉可能导致电池两极短路的危险动作，发现过滤器的安全-效用权衡主要取决于‘回退策略’（如后退 vs 暂停）和‘安全边距’大小，而不是逻辑谓词结构（比如用‘与’还是‘或’来定义危险区域）。

papers.title: Benchmarking Robots for Everyday Environments: From Lab Experiments to Real-World Operations
papers.abstract: This study introduces an interdisciplinary framework for benchmarking robots deployed in public environments, addressing the gap between traditional laboratory metrics and real-world benchmarking requirements. We evaluate three distinct robots across diverse use cases - outdoor park cleaning, pedestrian underpass cleaning, and interactive library assistance - each representing unique challenges in public daily life. Over a three-year benchmarking process (2023-2025) comprising seven benchmarking events, a consensus workshop and six on-site evaluations (two per use case), we utilized realistic indoor and outdoor test environments to assess not only technical performance but also the broader implications of deploying robots in unstructured, human-centric settings. An expert panel, spanning robotics, human-robot interaction, safety, and economics, systematically developed and refined an evaluation concept to analyze the transition from laboratory prototypes to operational systems. Our findings highlight critical factors for successful deployment, including task fulfillment, interaction quality, safety, and economic feasibility. This work provides actionable insights for researchers and practitioners aiming to bridge the gap between robotic innovation and real-world applicability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文不是提出新算法或机器人系统，而是设计了一套跨学科的评估框架，用三年时间在公园、地下通道、图书馆等真实公共场景中，对三款现成机器人做多轮实地评测，重点考察它们完成任务、与人交互、安全性和经济性等非纯技术指标。

papers.title: IMWM: Intuition Models Complement World Models for Latent Planning
papers.abstract: Planning with a learned latent world model is a promising route to control from raw pixels, but a strong world model alone is not enough. We show this experimentally: even with a perfect world model (operationalized by replacing the learned forward predictor with an idealized rollout of the true environment dynamics), a finite-budget sample-based planner still fails on some tasks, indicating that the bottleneck can lie in search rather than in world-model accuracy. Motivated by this gap, we propose IMWM (Intuition Model + World Model), which pairs the world model with an intuition model trained from demonstrations to recognize promising actions. The two models collaborate through three lightweight components: (i) Retrieval Initialization, which initializes the planner's action proposal from a retrieved demonstration; (ii) Hybrid Cost, which combines the intuition score with the world-model rollout cost; and (iii) a Reliability Gate, which adjusts how much the planner trusts intuition in each setting. Across four pixel-based goal-reaching tasks (Two-Room, Reacher, Push-T, and OGBench-Cube), IMWM has higher mean success than the world-model-only planner on all four, with the largest gains on Two-Room (99.2%, +11.5 percentage points) and OGBench-Cube (94.7%, +28.5 percentage points).

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现仅靠高精度世界模型做潜空间规划仍会失败，问题出在搜索策略上，于是提出用示范数据训练一个‘直觉模型’来辅助世界模型——通过检索初始化、混合代价函数和可靠性门控三机制协同提升像素输入下的目标导向任务成功率。

papers.title: GeoSem-WAM: Geometry- and Semantic-Aware World Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in embodied decision-making. However, whether their effectiveness stems from explicit future imagination during inference or representation learning induced by predictive training remains an open question. Emerging evidence suggests the primary advantage lies in learning robust latent representations rather than generating future observations at test time. Nevertheless, existing WAMs mainly rely on RGB-based future prediction, which provides limited structural and spatial understanding of complex environments. To address this, we propose a structured world modeling framework that enhances latent representations through geometric and semantic supervision. Alongside future RGB prediction, our model introduces two auxiliary prediction branches for future geometry and semantic representations, enabling it to jointly capture scene dynamics, spatial geometry, and semantic context within a unified latent space. Crucially, our approach preserves efficient inference by avoiding explicit future rollout or video generation at test time. Extensive experiments show that incorporating structured world supervision consistently improves action prediction accuracy, scene understanding, and robustness under challenging embodied scenarios, highlighting its potential for advancing scalable and efficient WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出GeoSem-WAM，通过在世界模型训练中额外加入未来几何结构（如深度/法向量）和语义分割的预测任务，来增强隐空间表征能力，但测试时仍只用隐状态做动作决策，不生成视频或 rollout，目标是让世界模型更懂空间和物体含义。

papers.title: Threading Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Model Inference in Low-Cost Smart Agricultural Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Action (VLA) models continue to face challenges such as slow inference speed and difficulty performing fine-grained motion adjustments, limiting their widespread adoption in industry. While the Real-Time Action Chunking (RTAC) algorithm has been proposed to address these bottlenecks, bridging the gap between the algorithm provided in pseudocode to a stable, real-world deployment on a low-cost robotic arm remains a challenge. In this work, we present a complete system-level implementation of RTAC tailored for a low-cost robotic manipulation system. We advance beyond the original high-level pseudocode by optimizing the threading implementation for the policy inference and control pipeline, reducing end-to-end latency and improving responsiveness without modifying the underlying policy. We evaluate this system on tasks involving the manipulation of agricultural produce, specifically garlic bulbs and walnuts. Experimental results demonstrate that our custom threading implementation significantly improves control stability and speed compared to the base implementation of RTAC.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没改模型，也没建新数据集或新任务，只是把已有的RTAC算法伪代码落地到一个便宜的农业机械臂上，重点优化了多线程调度（比如推理和控制线程的同步），让动作更稳更快。
analysis.claim: 通过系统级线程优化而非模型修改，可显著提升RTAC在低成本农业机械臂上的实时性与控制稳定性。

papers.title: Mesoscopic cortical activities associated with pupil-linked perceptions inferred via explainable machine learning
papers.abstract: Abstract Pupil dilation reflects arousal-related neural processes and is closely linked to sensory perception, attention, and cognitive state, but the mesoscopic cortical dynamics that accompany stimulus-evoked dilation remain unclear. Here, we combined simultaneous pupillometry and wide-field Ca²⁺ imaging in mice with explainable machine learning to identify cortical activity patterns predictive of pupil dilation. Cortical activity was recorded during hindpaw somatosensory stimulation, visual pattern change, and visual contextual stimulation using an visual oddball paradigm; spontaneous pupil dilation was additionally analyzed using a public resting-state dataset. To reduce multicollinearity in wide-field imaging signals, cortical activity was decomposed into independent components, which were used as inputs to recurrent neural network (RNN) decoders. Models reliably predicted sensory-evoked pupil dilation above shuffled-label controls when sessions with pre-existing pupil dilation were excluded, indicating that stimulus-evoked dilation was associated with distinct cortical activity patterns. Feature attribution using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and spatial back-mapping revealed condition-dependent cortical signatures. Activity around the retrosplenial cortex and higher-order visual areas contributed to predictions during somatosensory and visual pattern stimulation, whereas secondary motor cortex activity was prominent during visual contextual stimulation. Spontaneous pupil dilation required lower-frequency cortical signals for decoding, suggesting partly distinct dynamics from sensory-evoked dilation. These findings demonstrate that explainable machine learning can extract candidate cortical activity patterns associated with pupil-linked arousal from high-dimensional wide-field Ca²⁺ imaging data. Because feature importance does not establish causality, the identified regions provide hypothesis-generating targets for future circuit manipulation studies.

analysis.tldr: 用可解释机器学习（SHAP+RNN）分析小鼠宽场钙成像数据，找出与不同刺激诱发瞳孔扩张相关的皮层活动模式，发现不同任务下 retrosplenial cortex、高级视觉区和次级运动皮层等区域贡献不同，但未做因果验证，仅提供假设生成线索。
analysis.claim: 宽场钙成像中存在可被RNN解码的、条件依赖的皮层活动模式，特异性关联于感觉诱发和自发瞳孔扩张，且二者神经动力学特征不同。

analysis.output: 瞳孔扩张幅度/时程的预测值

papers.title: When Robots Sleep: Offline Skill Consolidation for Shared-Policy Robot Learning
papers.abstract: Robots that learn over long deployments must add new skills without losing the shared policy structure that makes earlier skills reusable. We study sequential robot skill learning, where previous trajectories and task losses may be unavailable, and the deployed policy must remain a single shared controller without task-specific heads, routing, or adapters. We identify skill-coupling collapse, a failure mode in which individual skill success remains non-trivial while reliability among related skills deteriorates. We propose Sleeping Robots, a wake-sleep framework that learns each new skill during wake and consolidates the shared policy offline during sleep using compact frozen skill memories: frozen critics with unordered state buffers for reinforcement learning and frozen actor snapshots with unordered observation buffers for imitation learning. During sleep, these memories define differentiable surrogate objectives whose gradients are combined through Nash bargaining, with adaptive anchoring and local excitability for stable consolidation. On Meta-World MT5, Sleeping Robots improves average success by 64 % and pairwise reliability by x 2.0 over the strongest non-oracle baseline, and on SurgicAI it improves average success and backward transfer relative to continual imitation baselines while remaining competitive on pairwise reliability.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种名为'Sleeping Robots'的离线技能巩固框架，让机器人在不保存原始轨迹和任务损失的前提下，持续学习新技能的同时维持单一共享策略，避免不同但相关的技能之间可靠性下降的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过冻结技能记忆（冻结critic/actor快照+无序状态/观测缓冲区）与基于Nash议价的梯度融合，在离线‘睡眠’阶段实现共享策略的稳定技能巩固，缓解技能耦合崩溃。

papers.title: Reward as An Agent for Embodied World Models
papers.abstract: While RL has become a promising tool for refining world models, existing methods largely rely on conservative rollouts near the training distribution, limiting exploration, behavioral diversity, and richer dynamic discovery. In this work, we challenge this conservative paradigm. We argue that the core limitation is not exploration itself, but the lack of reliable verification strategies to support broader exploration. Without reliable verification, expanded exploration becomes highly susceptible to reward hacking, where policies exploit imperfect rewards without achieving genuine improvement. To evaluate this motivation, we instantiate our method in embodied world models, where physical plausibility, and task completion provide a rigorous testbed for scalable RL under complex dynamics. On the verification side, we introduce Reward as an Agent, an agentic reward framework that actively evaluates generated behaviors to provide robust reward signals and mitigate reward hacking under distribution shifts. On the exploration side, we introduce Dynamic-Aware Rollout Diversification through DynDiff-GRPO, which explicitly expands action-space exploration to diversify trajectories, broaden state-action coverage, and encourage richer embodied behaviors beyond conservative rollout regimes. By unifying Reward as an Agent with DynDiff-GRPO, we enable RL on a more reliable reward foundation with substantially diversified sampling, effectively mitigating reward hacking while yielding significant accuracy gains across multiple open-source world models, thereby demonstrating that broader exploration can scale successfully when grounded in robust verification.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出‘Reward as an Agent’（RaaA）框架，用一个主动评估行为的智能体替代静态奖励函数，并配合DynDiff-GRPO策略扩大动作空间探索，从而在具身世界模型中缓解reward hacking、提升 rollout 多样性与动态发现能力。
analysis.claim: 可靠的奖励验证机制（而非单纯扩大探索）是实现可扩展、鲁棒的具身世界模型强化学习的关键前提。

analysis.output: 经RaaA评估后的可信奖励信号 + DynDiff-GRPO生成的多样化动作分布

papers.title: AutoSpeed: Annotation-Free Stage-Adaptive Motion Speed Learning for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Different stages of manipulation tasks exhibit varying levels of difficulty, suggesting stage-dependent motion speeds and temporal prediction horizons. However, existing IL-based visuomotor policies typically imitate the execution speed of expert demonstrations and operate with a fixed temporal prediction horizon, limiting flexibility and overall task throughput. In this paper, we introduce AutoSpeed, a model-agnostic learning framework that enables existing visuomotor policies to predict trajectories with stage-adaptive motion speeds, without requiring speed or stage annotations. We treat future trajectories at different speeds as candidate optimization targets, evaluate each candidate using a composite cost that trades off prediction error against prediction horizon, and optimize the policy toward the minimum-cost candidate. With a fixed-length action sequence, speed modulation adjusts the effective temporal prediction horizon: simple stages are executed faster with a longer prediction horizon, whereas complex stages are executed more slowly with a shorter prediction horizon. Specifically, we implement speed modulation in the frequency domain via the discrete cosine transform (DCT), which enables smooth, non-integer speed scaling and thus preserves motion continuity. Extensive evaluations show that AutoSpeed substantially reduces task execution time while also improving success rates. Under the AutoSpeed framework, the inferred motion speeds exhibit a strong correspondence with task stages.

analysis.tldr: 提出AutoSpeed框架，让现有视觉运动策略无需速度标注就能自动为操作任务不同阶段（如接近、抓取、放置）动态调整动作执行速度和预测时长，用DCT在频域实现平滑非整数倍速调节，从而缩短总耗时并提升成功率。
analysis.claim: 无需任何速度或阶段标注，即可使现有visuomotor策略自适应地为操作任务各阶段分配最优运动速度与对应预测时长，从而提升效率与成功率。

analysis.output: 动作序列（经频域DCT调速后的重采样轨迹）

papers.title: Evolutionarily labile pachytene piRNAs target an altered set of mRNAs in male hybrids of house mouse subspecies
papers.abstract: During male meiosis-I of placental mammals, ~30-nucleotide pachytene PIWI-interacting RNAs (piRNAs) are expressed to regulate genes required for sperm function. Pachytene piRNA genes evolve rapidly. Whether rapid evolutionary turnover of pachytene piRNAs is under positive selective pressure remains enigmatic. Here, we investigate the evolutionary rate of pachytene piRNA genes over a short evolutionary timescale using geographically isolated mouse subspecies. We demarcate the genes producing postnatal piRNAs in PWK/PhJ and CAST/EiJ. Comparative genomics reveals 16 subspecies-specific pachytene piRNA loci underscoring how labile pachytene piRNA genes are even during short evolutionary timescale. We report a highly abundant CAST/EiJ-specific pi17-CAST locus defying the notion that young pachytene piRNA genes do not produce abundant piRNAs. In fact, male hybrids from the reciprocal crossing C57BL/6J and CAST/EiJ produce pi17-CAST piRNAs almost exclusively from the CAST/EiJ allele suggesting that species-specific nucleotide variants are sufficient to turn a locus into piRNA source. Intriguingly, hybrid males with reduced fertility features retain distinct piRNA-mRNA pairs compared to parents. Our work reveals that rapidly evolving pachytene piRNAs can gain or lose targets in the hybrid males of closely related mammalian species.

analysis.tldr: 研究小鼠亚种杂交雄性中减数分裂期piRNA的快速进化现象，发现仅靠亚种间单核苷酸差异就能激活新的piRNA位点，并导致杂交个体中piRNA靶标mRNA集合发生显著重编程。
analysis.claim: 快速进化的pachytene piRNA基因在近缘哺乳动物杂交雄性中可迅速获得或丢失靶标mRNA，且单等位基因的核苷酸变异足以驱动新piRNA位点的转录激活。
analysis.input: 小鼠亚种（PWK/PhJ、CAST/EiJ、C57BL/6J）及其杂交后代的睾丸组织小RNA-seq与mRNA-seq数据
analysis.output: 亚种特异性piRNA位点图谱、piRNA-mRNA互作对（通过序列互补性与表达共变推断）、杂交背景下靶标重分配证据

analysis.significance_reason: 提供了近缘哺乳动物杂交中piRNA靶标重编程的首个实证证据，机制层面锚定到等位基因SNP级变异，实验设计严谨（双方向杂交+亲本对照+多组学整合），但限于小鼠模型、未验证功能因果性（如靶标敲除表型）、未构建预测模型或通用规则，属显著基础生物学贡献而非范式突破。

papers.title: From tiny to massive: exploring genome evolution in the model 1 grass genus Brachypodium
papers.abstract: Brachypodium is a powerful model system for investigating grass genome evolution, yet genomic resources remain concentrated in the three annual species, whereas perennial species are less sampled. Here, we present chromosome-level assemblies for two perennial species, Brachypodium mexicanum and B. arbuscula, which represent the earliest-diverging lineages of the genus and the earliest-diverging lineage of the core perennial clade, respectively. Synteny-based phylogenomics indicate that B. mexicanum is a meso-allotetraploid composed of two closely related but temporally distinct x=10 subgenomes, here designed as P and U, each carrying subgenome-specific chromosome rearrangements. We further show that the unusually large B. mexicanum genome, in contrast to the reduced genomes of most other Brachypodium species, is primarily due to transposable elements distributed across all chromosomal regions. By contrast, the diploid genome of the earliest-diverging core perennial, B. arbuscula, contains few transposable elements, whereas the most recent diverged diploid perennial B. sylvaticum shows evidence of a secondary TEs proliferation. Comparisons of lineage-specific and functionally enriched orthogroups among B. mexicanum, core perennial species and annual species suggest that ancestral hybridization between annual and perennial lineages may have contributed to the origin of allotetraploid B. mexicanum. These assemblies provide a framework for testing how polyploidy, descending dysploidy, transposable-element turnover, and life-history evolution jointly shaped genome architecture in Brachypodium.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为两个多年生早分化须芒草属植物（B. mexicanum 和 B. arbuscula）构建了染色体水平基因组，发现前者是近期形成的异源四倍体，其巨大基因组主要由全基因组散布的转座元件驱动，而后者作为核心多年生类群最早分支却保持小而干净的二倍体基因组，由此揭示须芒草属中多倍化、转座元件爆发与生活史演化协同塑造基因组结构的机制。
analysis.org: 美国能源部联合基因组研究所（JGI）/ USDA-ARS

papers.title: PlantNetX: A web-based transcriptomic resource integrating bulk and single-cell RNA-seq for plant functional genomics.
papers.abstract: Bulk RNA sequencing and single-cell RNA sequencing provide complementary information on tissue and cell-type-specific gene expression. Bulk RNA sequencing enables the construction of gene association networks that identify co-expressed genes involved in shared pathways, whereas single-cell RNA sequencing maps their expression to cell types. However, most platforms provide access to either bulk RNA sequencing or single-cell RNA sequencing analysis, making it difficult to connect tissue-level co-expression with cell-type-specific expression. PlantNetX was developed as a web-based platform that integrates both data types. Although PlantNetX currently focuses on rice (Oryza sativa) and includes 70 quality-controlled RNA sequencing datasets comprising 1,198 sequencing libraries, together with nine single-cell RNA sequencing datasets containing more than 580,000 cells, including recently released datasets not consistently represented in existing platforms, it was designed to incorporate additional plant species, datasets, and analytical tools. PlantNetX provides Mutual Rank-based co-expression analysis, global and tissue-specific gene association networks, interactive visualization, and cell-type-specific expression summaries. The platform was validated with published examples of plant cell-wall biosynthesis and root-hair growth and retrieved gene association and expression patterns. Under standardized testing conditions, PlantNetX had a shorter mean response time than the other databases assessed. PlantNetX will support research in plant cell-wall biosynthesis, pathway discovery, functional genomics, and crop improvement.

analysis.tldr: PlantNetX是一个面向植物功能基因组学的网页平台，整合了水稻的70个高质量批量RNA-seq数据集（1198个文库）和9个单细胞RNA-seq数据集（超58万个细胞），支持组织/细胞类型层级的共表达网络构建、互秩分析、交互式可视化和表达模式检索。
analysis.claim: PlantNetX首次在统一Web平台中系统整合水稻bulk与scRNA-seq数据，实现组织级共表达网络与细胞类型特异性表达的跨尺度关联分析。
analysis.input: 批量RNA-seq表达矩阵、单细胞RNA-seq表达矩阵（以水稻为主）
analysis.output: 互秩（Mutual Rank）共表达网络、全局/组织特异性基因关联网络、细胞类型表达热图与摘要
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量资源整合型工具平台，填补了植物领域bulk+scRNA-seq跨尺度分析的空白，但未提出新算法或模型，验证仅限于已知通路（细胞壁、根毛）的回溯性检索，无新生物学发现或机制推断，性能对比仅含响应时间，缺乏基准测试（如网络精度、注释一致性、下游任务泛化能力），且物种覆盖目前仅限水稻，扩展性停留在声明层面。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——是实用性强、组织良好的数据库+分析平台，但非方法论突破，也未驱动新生物学认知，属于领域内必要但常规的基础设施建设。

papers.title: MGMCL: Multi-Granularity Manifold Contrastive Learning With Neural ODEs for Cross-Subject EEG Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Cross-subject electroencephalogram (EEG)-based emotion recognition remains challenging due to substantial inter-individual variability and discrete formulation that overlooks affective continuity. Existing methods operate in Euclidean space and focus on marginal distribution alignment, failing to preserve the semantic structure of emotions across subjects. This article proposes MGMCL, reconceptualizing emotion recognition as learning continuous representations on symmetric positive definite (SPD) Riemannian manifolds. The frame?work introduces multi-granularity manifold contrastive learning at instance, emotion, and trajectory levels while preserving semantic ordering. Neural ordinary differential equations on manifolds model continuous emotion dynamics. Cross-subject generalization employs Gromov-Wasserstein manifold alignment. Weakly-supervised learning enables continuous valence-arousal-dominance prediction from discrete labels. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: 91.23% accuracy on SEED, 73.82% on SEED-IV, and 76.38% on DEAP, achieving consistent improvements of 1.89%, 1.66%, and 1.28% over previous best methods, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种在SPD黎曼流形上用神经ODE建模连续情绪动态、结合多粒度对比学习和Gromov-Wasserstein对齐的跨被试EEG情绪识别方法，声称在三个公开数据集上小幅超越SOTA。
analysis.claim: 在SPD黎曼流形上建模EEG情绪的连续动力学，并通过多粒度流形对比学习与Gromov-Wasserstein对齐实现更鲁棒的跨被试泛化。
analysis.input: 原始或预处理的多通道EEG信号（隐含协方差矩阵构造）
analysis.output: 连续维度的情绪预测（效价-唤醒-支配度VA-D）及离散情绪类别
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开离线EEG数据集（SEED/SEED-IV/DEAP），无真实在线采集或闭环交互
analysis.significance_reason: 虽引入黎曼几何与神经ODE建模情绪连续性，但未解决BCI核心瓶颈（如个体适配延迟、在线鲁棒性、低信噪比泛化），所有实验均为离线批处理、无实时验证、无跨设备/跨范式迁移、无临床人群验证；性能提升仅1–2个百分点，且未报告统计显著性或消融分析细节；远未触及脑机接口领域基石工作所要求的临床可用性、实时闭环或神经机制解释深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：将成熟技术（流形学习、对比学习、ODE）组合应用于EEG情绪识别，但缺乏神经接口层面的真实突破证据（如在线性能、个体免校准、生理可解释性）

papers.title: FUSE: Active Functional Affordance Grounding through Adaptive Semantic-Geometric Evidence Acquisition
papers.abstract: Embodied agents must often identify and interact with objects based on their function rather than their identity, requiring them to actively acquire observations that reveal discriminative functional evidence. Existing affordance grounding methods operate from fixed viewpoints and lack mechanisms for deciding where to look when functional cues are occluded or incomplete. We introduce Active Functional Affordance Grounding, a new task in which an agent sequentially explores a scene to identify and spatially ground an object satisfying a functional query. To address this problem, we propose FUSE, an adaptive semantic-geometric evidence acquisition framework that combines explicit uncertainty-driven exploration with a learned amortized planner to efficiently select informative viewpoints. We further introduce a Habitat-based benchmark for evaluating active functional grounding. Experiments show that FUSE achieves the highest observed non-oracle grounding performance while reducing computation by 1.33x relative to fully explicit exploration, and remains effective across multiple affordance knowledge sources.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FUSE框架，让具身智能体能主动移动视角去寻找并定位满足特定功能（如‘能切东西’）的物体，而不是被动等待固定视角输入，解决了功能线索被遮挡时无法有效识别的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过不确定性驱动的主动探索与学习型摊销规划器协同，可高效获取语义-几何联合证据，实现功能导向的、自适应的物体空间定位。
analysis.input: 自然语言功能查询（如‘能搅拌的物体’）+ 当前RGB-D观测 + 场景几何先验
analysis.output: 物体在3D空间中的边界框（即功能满足物体的空间位置）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 定义了‘主动功能可供性定位’这一新任务并构建了Habitat基准，但仅在仿真中验证、无真实硬件实验、未开源代码/模型、消融不充分（未对比主流VLA或affordance模型）、计算节省1.33x缺乏基线透明度；属于有启发性的任务级创新，但实证薄弱，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石级工作所要求的多任务真机泛化、大规模数据支撑与开源生态影响。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：任务定义清晰、框架设计合理，但实证局限于仿真、无开源、无跨机体/用户验证，属于扎实的模块级改进，非范式突破

papers.title: Interactions between human milk components and infant polygenic risk predict childhood atopy
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Although human milk (HM) confers important health benefits, how bioactive milk components (e.g., microbiota, oligosaccharides, and fatty acids) interact with infant genetics to influence childhood atopy remains poorly understood. Objective We investigated interactions between infant genomic susceptibility and exposure to maternal human milk components (HMCs) and assessed whether integrating these genetic and milk features improves prediction of childhood atopy. Methods Leveraging infant genomic and maternal HMC data from the CHILD Cohort Study, we conducted gene-milk interaction analysis using linear regression models that integrated polygenic risk scores (PRS) of nursing infants with multiple HMC types. Gradient-boosting machines (GBMs) were used to evaluate predictive performance of HMCs and infant PRS for childhood atopy. Results Childhood atopy was associated with interactions between infant genomics (e.g., PRS associated with atopy) and exposure to specific human milk microbes (e.g., Abiotrophia , P Bonf =0.005, β=0.29), as well as networks of co-occurring HMCs (e.g., a module containing Bifidobacterium longum , 2’-fucosyllactose, and eicosapentaenoic acid, P=0.009, β=-12.3). A GBM integrating HMCs and infant PRS achieved the highest predictive performance for childhood atopy with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.78, outperforming models based on individual HMC types or PRS alone (AUC range: 0.54-0.63). Conclusion Integration of maternal HMC exposures with infant genomics reveals interaction effects that contribute to prediction of childhood atopy. Understanding how early-life exposures such as HMCs impact the health of children differently depending on their genomic profiles may facilitate the development of personalized intervention strategies to reduce the burden of these health outcomes during childhood. Key messages Interactions between infant polygenic risk and exposure to human milk components are associated with childhood atopy. Networks of co-occurring human milk microbiota, oligosaccharides, and fatty acids may influence childhood atopy, with effects varying by infant genomic susceptibility. Integration of human milk components with infant genomics improves prediction of childhood atopy compared with individual milk components or genomics alone. Capsule Summary This study demonstrates that interactions between infant polygenic risk and maternal milk components improve prediction of childhood atopy, highlighting opportunities for personalized early-life prevention strategies.

analysis.tldr: 用加拿大CHILD队列数据，分析婴儿多基因风险评分（PRS）与母乳中微生物、寡糖、脂肪酸等成分的交互作用，发现特定基因-母乳组合（如Abiotrophia+高PRS、B. longum/2’FL/EPA模块+低PRS）显著关联儿童过敏性疾病，并用梯度提升模型将预测AUC从0.54–0.63提升至0.78。
analysis.claim: 婴儿多基因风险与母乳生物活性成分存在统计显著的交互效应，联合建模可实质性提升儿童过敏症的预测性能。
analysis.input: 婴儿全基因组SNP数据计算的多基因风险评分（PRS） + 母乳中微生物群（16S）、人乳寡糖（HMOs）、脂肪酸等定量测量值
analysis.output: 儿童期过敏症（atopy）的发生概率预测（二分类：有/无）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖CHILD队列真实采集的母乳生化与微生物检测数据及临床随访诊断数据
analysis.significance_reason: 首次在人群队列中系统验证母乳多组分与婴儿PRS的交互预测价值，实证扎实（多变量校正、多重检验校正、模块网络分析、GBM消融对比），但属观察性关联研究，未干预验证因果，且仅在一个队列（CHILD）上复现，未跨人群泛化，预测AUC=0.78属中等临床实用性水平，远未达机制解析或干预设计层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了高质量人群证据支持‘基因×母乳’交互假说，但仍是相关性发现，未突破因果推断或临床转化瓶颈。

papers.title: Capstan-driven Continuum Surgical Robot: Design, Modeling, and Perception
papers.abstract: Shape and force sensing have long been critical bottlenecks in the development of compact capstan-driven continuum surgical robots, primarily due to the difficulty of obtaining cable tension information within the confined capstan assembly. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents an integrated design-modeling-sensing approach based on the concept of actuation-perception co-design. A compliant element is introduced into the motor mounting bracket of the drive system, enabling micro-deformation under the cable reaction force and thereby allowing real-time cable tension measurement without occupying the compact capstan space. To address the modeling complexity arising from unconventional joint configurations introduced by the spatial cable routing strategy, a parallel computation framework based on a multibody short-thick-beam model is proposed, which captures shear effects in short beam segments and synergistic multi-cable interactions while achieving real-time performance. Building on this framework, stable shape and force sensing is achieved by incorporating a proximal multi-axis force/torque sensor as an additional measurement anchor. Following this design-modeling-sensing framework, capstan-driven continuum surgical robots with single- and dual-segment configurations are developed. Experimental results validate the proposed framework in both single- and dual-segment continuum robots, demonstrating real-time tip pose estimation together with contact force and location perception. By enabling cable tension feedback without compromising the compact capstan architecture, the proposed framework makes integrated perception feasible for capstan-driven continuum surgical robots.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一种新型卷筒驱动的连续体手术机器人，通过在电机支架中嵌入柔性元件来间接测量钢缆张力，避免了在狭小卷筒空间内直接布设传感器的难题，并结合多体短粗梁建模与近端六维力传感器，实现了实时末端位姿+接触力+接触位置联合感知。
analysis.claim: 通过执行-感知协同设计（actuation-perception co-design），在不牺牲卷筒驱动结构紧凑性的前提下，首次实现了紧凑型卷筒驱动连续体手术机器人的实时、稳定、集成化形状与力感知。
analysis.input: 电机编码器读数、近端六维力/扭矩传感器信号、柔性元件微变形（间接张力）
analysis.output: 末端三维位姿（位置+方向）、接触力矢量、接触点位置估计
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研单段/双段卷筒驱动连续体机器人硬件平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人平台采集的张力-变形标定数据、运动学-动力学同步实验数据
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了连续体手术机器人领域长期存在的‘紧凑卷筒结构下无法原位测张力’这一关键工程瓶颈，实机验证了单/双段构型下的实时形状+力联合感知，但未跨机体泛化、未开源代码/模型、未与主流基准（如dVRK、Smart Tissue Anastomosis Robot）对比，属显著工程突破而非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真突破——它不是概念包装，而是用精巧的机械-传感-建模协同设计，在真实硬件上攻克了一个被公认难解的工程死锁，但尚未扩展到多平台或多任务，也未开源，因此未达里程碑级。

papers.title: WAM-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for World Action Models
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) couple visual future prediction with robot action generation, but accelerated students can lose task capabilities during distillation and later encounter states that are poorly represented by offline data. We study whether on-policy distillation (OPD) can repair such a student without requiring sparse-reward reinforcement learning. We introduce WAM-OPD, a deployment-consistent post-training recipe for a video-first WAM. The student acts in the environment and therefore determines the history distribution. A frozen teacher labels those student histories with coherent video and action targets, while the student action branch is trained under its own generated video plan, as it is at deployment. Joint video and action losses update lightweight adapters in the shared backbone, together with an action flow-matching regularizer. In preliminary RoboTwin 2.0 studies on two tasks, the released one-video/one-action-step Flash-WAM improves from 0.0% to 58.3% success on HANDOVER MIC, and from 16.7% to 33.3% on PUT OBJECT CABINET. These task-specific results are an initial capability proof rather than evidence of broad or uniform generalization. They nevertheless suggest that dense teacher supervision on student-induced histories is a promising post-training interface for video-first WAMs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫WAM-OPD的在线策略蒸馏方法，让视频优先的世界动作模型（WAM）学生在真实交互中采集自身行为轨迹，再用冻结的教师模型为这些轨迹打视频+动作标签，并只微调轻量适配器，从而修复蒸馏后任务性能暴跌的问题。
analysis.claim: 对视频优先的世界动作模型，采用学生自主采样历史、教师在线标注、联合视频与动作损失+动作流匹配正则化的on-policy蒸馏，可显著恢复蒸馏导致的任务成功率下降，且无需稀疏奖励强化学习。
analysis.input: 视频帧序列+机器人当前状态（隐含于仿真环境历史）
analysis.output: 未来视频预测+下一步机器人动作
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器内在线交互数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在RoboTwin 2.0两个简单操作任务上验证（HANDOVER MIC/PUT OBJECT CABINET），无跨任务/跨机体/跨场景泛化证据，无消融实验，未开源代码或模型，所有提升均基于单一仿真平台内窄域修复，远未达到世界模型基石论文所要求的范式性、状态建模深度或持续学习能力，属于针对特定蒸馏退化现象的工程修补，非原理突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：实证极薄（2任务/sim-only/无消融/无开源），既未挑战世界模型的核心瓶颈（如持久状态、长程一致性、闭环演化），也未证明其方法可迁移到真实机器人或更复杂任务，目前仅为一个未充分验证的概念修补方案。

papers.title: Slow-Fast Brain-Computer Interfaces: Preventing Neuroadaptive Overfitting in AI-Mediated Neural Interfaces
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) from task-specific neural decoders into adaptive systems that complete language, smooth movement, regulate rehabilitation support and adjust stimulation. These capabilities can increase speed, fluency, usability and clinical reach, yet conventional performance metrics may overlook losses in intent fidelity, authorship, agency, therapeutic challenge and durable clinical benefit. I define neuroadaptive overfitting as a closed-loop failure mode in which an AI-mediated BCI becomes over-optimized to short-term proxies of success, including reduced effort, rapid acceptance, lower workload or smooth task completion, while drifting from the user's durable goals. I then propose Slow-Fast BCI, a framework for pacing AI assistance according to decoder evidence, uncertainty, contextual and clinical stakes, fatigue, and user- or clinician-defined goals. The framework distinguishes fast assistance when intent is clear and stakes are low, guarded assistance under uncertainty and slow assistance when misalignment could compromise safety, agency, authorship, motor learning or therapeutic value. Across communication, motor-control, neurorehabilitation and closed-loop neuromodulation applications, I outline corresponding safeguards and evaluation measures. This Perspective argues that AI-mediated BCIs should be evaluated not only by decoding accuracy and task performance, but also by how AI assistance is deployed: when systems act autonomously, seek confirmation, preserve user effort or return control to the user.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没有提出新算法、新硬件或新实验数据，而是针对AI增强型脑机接口中一个被忽视的风险——AI为追求短期性能指标（如响应快、用户省力）而偏离用户长期康复目标和神经可塑性需求——提出了‘慢-快BCI’概念框架，主张按解码置信度、临床风险、用户意图对齐度等维度动态调节AI介入强度。
analysis.claim: AI增强型BCI若仅优化短期任务性能指标，会导致神经适应性过拟合，损害用户意图保真度、自主权、运动学习和长期临床获益；应通过‘慢-快’节奏化辅助策略来约束AI介入时机与强度。
analysis.input: 解码置信度、不确定性估计、上下文信息、临床风险等级、用户疲劳状态、预设目标
analysis.output: AI辅助强度分级（快/守/慢）及对应行为策略（自动执行/请求确认/保留努力/交还控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实BCI数据依赖，纯概念性分析
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量观点性论述，识别出重要但未被量化的问题（神经适应性过拟合），但零实证支撑：无新模型、无数据验证、无仿真或真人实验、无代码/协议开源，也未在任一基石工作（如Brain2voice 2.0、handwriting BCI）上做延伸验证；其价值限于引发反思，而非推动技术边界。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出了有启发性的风险概念和分类框架，但无任何实证、实现或可复现组件，属于领域内重要的‘问题提醒’而非技术推进。

papers.title: From Multi-Modal Paths to Executable Trajectories: A Trajectory Planning Framework for 4WIS Robots
papers.abstract: Four-wheel independent steering (4WIS) mobile robots support multiple motion modes, offering high maneuverability in narrow and complex environments. However, existing planning methods often fail to fully exploit these capabilities, leading to suboptimal trajectory quality. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a multi-modal global trajectory planning framework that couples mode-augmented front-end search with mode-consistent segment-wise trajectory optimization. In the front-end stage, Hybrid A* is extended to a four-dimensional state space incorporating motion modes, while mode-switching-aware cost and heuristic functions embed mode decisions into the global search process. Multi-modal Reeds-Shepp curves and an intelligent terminal connection strategy are further designed to improve search efficiency. In the back-end stage, a segment-wise trajectory optimization framework based on an improved iterative safe corridor scheme is developed to convert discrete multi-modal paths into smooth, kinematically feasible trajectories with stationary mode transitions. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the best overall performance in safety, arrival time, terminal accuracy and computation time. Real-world experiments on a physical 4WIS robot further validate the practical effectiveness and executability of the generated trajectories, providing a flexible and high-performance solution for multi-modal mobile robot trajectory planning.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个专为四轮独立转向（4WIS）机器人设计的多模态轨迹规划框架，前端用扩展的Hybrid A*在含运动模式的四维空间搜索路径，后端用分段优化+改进的安全走廊生成平滑、可执行、模式切换稳定的轨迹，并在真实4WIS机器人上验证了安全性、精度和实时性。
analysis.claim: 通过显式建模运动模式并耦合模式感知搜索与模式一致的分段优化，可显著提升4WIS机器人在狭小复杂环境中的全局轨迹质量与真实可执行性。
analysis.input: 起点/终点位姿、障碍物地图、4WIS机器人运动学约束
analysis.output: 分段式、模式切换明确、满足运动学约束的可执行轨迹（位置+朝向+速度+转向角序列）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研4WIS移动机器人平台（未公开型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人标定与运动学参数，但路径规划本身不依赖真实运行数据（无学习，无数据驱动）
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实增量：首次系统性将运动模式显式嵌入Hybrid A*状态空间与Reeds-Shepp扩展，并实现端到端真机部署；但问题范畴窄（仅限4WIS结构）、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证、未开源代码模型、未与主流学习型规划器（如Diffusion Policy for motion planning）对比，远未达T-Rex/ALOHA级范式突破或通用性贡献。

papers.title: A Schema Bounded Language Model for Refining Robot Policies Without Destabilizing Local Learning
papers.abstract: This paper addresses navigation by composite heterogeneous robots in a decentralized system when policy reasoning and local control operate at different update levels. In a NetLogo--Python implementation, three robots share motion dynamics but use different LLM backends. Each robot independently combines a large language model (LLM) policy agent, an Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) bandit, and a Double Deep Q-Network (Double DQN) controller; no central LLM generates team actions. LLM inference is confined to round-level policy generation and refinement rather than tick-level action selection. The robots perform cross-LLM communication through a shared round summary containing policies, outcomes, and learning feedback. UCB performs refinement-mode selection, and the policy-conditioned Double DQN performs tick-level action selection from navigation variables, active policy parameters, and the LLM action prior. Each of the four configurations was evaluated over 30 rounds. In the fixed simulation, the complete configuration reached the goal in all 90 correlated robot--round records and achieved the lowest median completion time (42 ticks) and P90 (73.2 ticks); its median was 25.0--39.1\% lower than those of the other configurations. These observations provide descriptive, configuration-level evidence from the evaluated configurations.

analysis.tldr: 用三个异构机器人在NetLogo-Python混合仿真中测试了一种分层控制架构：LLM只在‘轮次’（round）级别生成和修正导航策略，不直接选动作；具体动作由Double DQN在‘时钟滴答’（tick）级执行，依赖LLM输出的策略先验；三机器人通过共享轮次摘要进行跨LLM协同；实验显示完整配置在90次运行中100%到达目标，且完成时间显著优于其他三种消融配置。
analysis.claim: 将LLM的作用严格限定在策略层面的轮次级修正（而非动作级决策），并耦合UCB选择机制与策略条件化Double DQN控制器，可在去中心化异构机器人系统中实现更稳定、更高效、不破坏局部学习的导航策略演化。
analysis.input: 轮次级任务目标+历史轮次摘要（含策略、结果、反馈）+当前导航变量（如位置、朝向、障碍物）
analysis.output: 轮次级策略更新指令 + tick级动作序列（离散转向/前进）
analysis.robot_dependency: NetLogo-Python自定义仿真器（非标准机器人平台，无真实机体映射）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，所有训练与评估均在固定仿真中完成
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一固定仿真环境、3种消融配置、30轮×3机器人=90次运行下验证；无真实硬件、无跨场景/跨机体泛化、无基线对比（如与纯DQN/纯LLM/传统多智能体算法对比）、无消融分析机制贡献（如UCB或策略先验各自作用未分离验证）；方法本质是已有组件（LLM+UCB+DQN）的浅层串联，未解决LLM策略不稳定性的根本机理问题；远低于RT-2等基石工作（94+）所要求的真机规模、多任务泛化、开源可复现、范式级解耦等任一维度。

papers.title: GIFT: Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning for Efficient Manipulation Policy Adaptation
papers.abstract: Compared with relying solely on initial observations and language instructions, predicting goal images with generative models as high-level visual guidance can significantly enhance the robustness of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, most existing foundation models have not systematically incorporated goal image conditioning due to the high computational training cost. To this end, we propose Goal-Injected Fine-Tuning (GIFT), a lightweight and efficient fine-tuning framework that seamlessly integrates generated goal images into multiple representative pretrained VLA models. Our approach introduces goal image features into observations via a zero-initialized convolution which progressively grows parameters from zero and prevents harmful noise from disrupting the pretrained policy during fine-tuning. As training proceeds, goal information is gradually incorporated, enabling efficient goal understanding without disrupting model stability. We further introduce a refined image editing method to generate semantically and visually consistent goal images from initial observations and task instructions. Experiments show that goal-aware VLA models achieve substantial performance gains across tasks: with only a single epoch of fine-tuning, GIFT outperforms the base model by 6.0% and 13.4% on two SIMPLER settings, and by 4.7% on LIBERO, demonstrating both efficiency and effectiveness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种轻量级微调方法GIFT，让已有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）大模型能接受生成的目标图像作为额外输入，从而提升操作任务的鲁棒性；它不重训整个模型，而是用零初始化卷积把目标图特征注入观测流，仅用1个训练周期就在多个仿真benchmark上小幅提点。
analysis.claim: 通过零初始化卷积注入生成的目标图像特征，可在单轮微调内高效增强预训练VLA模型对目标状态的理解能力，且不破坏原有策略稳定性。
analysis.input: 初始观测图像+语言指令+生成的目标图像
analysis.output: 动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖合成/仿真数据，无真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在SIMPLER/LIBERO等纯仿真benchmark上做单epoch微调，提升4.7–13.4%，无真实机器人验证、无跨机体/跨任务泛化实验、无消融分析目标图像生成质量影响、未开源代码或模型；相比RT-2（97）、π0（95）、Xiaomi-Robotics-1（94.8）等基石工作，它既未拓展VLA的架构范式，也未解决具身智能中长期存在的sim2real鸿沟或策略泛化瓶颈，属于窄口径的工程技巧改良。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真、无实机验证、无消融、无开源、提升幅度小且任务域狭窄，属于可复现但无实质推进的增量微调技巧

papers.title: Location-Independent Robot-Assisted Finishing Using Digital Twins and Extended Reality
papers.abstract: This paper presents a cyber-physical system (CPS) for location-independent programming, supervision, training, and teleoperation of a Robot-Assisted Finishing (RAF) system used to post-process metal additive-manufactured (AM) components. A digital twin (DT) built in Unity is delivered to the operator as a WebGL application that supports both desktop and immersive modes through WebXR-compatible devices. Moreover, it exchanges robot state and pose commands with a collaborative robot through a Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) broker. The DT enforces kinematic and collision constraints before a pose is released to the physical robot, and augments the virtual component with a color map of the surface topography that supports operator decisions on part repositioning or process termination. The architecture was validated on a specially designed physical RAF system. A steady-state joint synchronization error of 0.12 deg and a mean round-trip latency of 563 ms were measured, which is adequate for supervisory programming and intermittent teleoperation.

analysis.tldr: 用Unity构建了一个基于WebXR的数字孪生系统，让操作员能在任意地点通过网页浏览器远程监督、编程和间歇性操控一台金属增材制造件表面精加工机器人，数字孪生体实时校验运动学与碰撞，并叠加表面形貌热力图辅助决策。
analysis.claim: 通过轻量级WebXR数字孪生架构实现位置无关的机器人精加工远程人机协同，兼顾安全性（前置约束校验）与可访问性（免安装WebGL应用）。
analysis.input: WebXR设备输入（头显/手柄）+ 操作员交互指令 + 机器人实时状态反馈
analysis.output: 经约束验证的机器人位姿指令 + 表面形貌可视化热力图 + 远程监督决策信号
analysis.robot_dependency: UR协作机器人 + 自研RAF物理平台
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人实时状态流和少量标定数据，但未使用大规模真实操作日志或行为轨迹数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属工程集成型数字孪生应用：解决了远程访问轻量化（WebXR）和安全校验闭环问题，但无新算法、无跨任务泛化、无开源代码、未在标准平台（如UR5e+Franka通用基线）验证，性能指标（563ms延迟、0.12°同步误差）仅满足‘监督级’而非实时闭环控制要求，远未达DROID/ALOHA级的自主性、规模性与开源深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了WebXR数字孪生在特定精加工场景的落地闭环，但缺乏算法创新、泛化能力与开源支撑，属于垂直场景可用系统，非领域推进。

papers.title: Dense to MoE Adaptation for Compact Vision Language Action Policies
papers.abstract: Vision language action (VLA) policies continue to grow in parameter count, making deployment on resource-constrained robot platforms difficult. The central goal is to reduce the number of LLM-side parameters retained in the deployed policy while preserving downstream task performance. Our approach, AdaDE, adapts selected dense feed forward blocks into mixture of experts (MoE) layers and derives expert retention masks from router statistics during fine tuning. The Dense2MoE conversion preserves the original dense FFN function at initialization, so expert deactivation can start without a separate recovery stage. Instead of using a fixed shutdown rule, expert masks are updated dynamically from router usage statistics, with staged training and expert protection to avoid early collapse. With 40% of the LLM parameters deactivated, AdaDE retains 95.1% average success in LIBERO and 42.0% average success across all 50 RobotWin2.0 tasks. These results suggest that dense to MoE adaptation with dynamic expert deactivation is a practical direction for reducing active VLA model size without severe performance loss.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AdaDE方法，把视觉语言动作（VLA）策略中大模型的密集前馈层动态转为混合专家（MoE）结构，并在微调时根据路由器统计实时关闭低使用率专家，从而在删减40%大模型参数的情况下，仍保持LIBERO上95.1%的任务成功率和RobotWin2.0上42%的平均成功率。
analysis.claim: 通过动态专家掩码与初始化保函数的Dense2MoE转换，可在显著削减VLA模型参数量的同时，避免性能严重下降。
analysis.input: 多模态输入（视觉+语言），具体未说明但属标准VLA范式
analysis.output: 机器人动作序列/策略输出
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（仅报告LIBERO和RobotWin2.0仿真benchmark结果）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在仿真benchmark（LIBERO/RobotWin2.0）上验证压缩效果，无真实机器人实验、无跨机体/跨任务泛化分析、无消融验证关键设计（如 staged training/ expert protection 的必要性）、无开源代码或模型；相比RT-2（97）、DAM-VLA（96）等基石工作，它不解决VLA的核心能力瓶颈（如泛化、具身推理、世界建模），仅做模型压缩工程优化，且压缩收益（40%参数删减换42% RobotWin2.0成功率）实际偏低——RobotWin2.0基线本身成功率极低，42%并不反映强能力，而LIBERO高保留率因该benchmark过于简单且易过拟合。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：本质是MoE剪枝的变体应用，缺乏真实具身验证、可复现性与科学严谨性，所有结论均停留在仿真benchmark数字层面，未触及VLA领域核心挑战。

papers.title: Search-Based Metamorphic Testing of Vision-Language Models in Autonomous Underwater Robotic Software
papers.abstract: Our industry partner focuses on quality assurance for industrial systems across multiple domains, including maritime systems, such as overwater vessels and autonomous underwater robots (AURs). Despite the strong performance of vision-language models (VLMs) in scene understanding, image captioning, and object recognition, their use in AUR software operating in underwater environments is underexplored. Therefore, in this context, it is important to evaluate the quality of VLMs for integration into AUR software and, so, automated software testing tools are needed to assess their suitability and improve their dependability. To this end, we propose a search-based metamorphic testing approach (MetaVLM) that identifies a minimal set of transformations on underwater images to induce incorrect model predictions, thereby revealing VLM failures. We employ NSGA-II as a multi-objective search algorithm and evaluate it over open-source VLMs, BLIP and CLIP, against a random search baseline. Results demonstrate the strengths and limitations of each VLM in the context of AUR software systems. Based on the results, we derive lessons for software engineering practitioners and researchers working on quality assurance of VLM-based software systems.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用基于搜索的变异测试方法（MetaVLM）来检测视觉语言模型（VLM）在水下图像输入下的鲁棒性缺陷，通过自动寻找最小图像变换组合触发模型错误输出，从而评估BLIP和CLIP等开源VLM在自主水下机器人（AUR）软件中的适用性。
analysis.claim: 搜索驱动的变异测试能有效暴露VLM在水下环境中的隐性失效模式，为AUR软件中VLM的可信集成提供可量化的质量评估手段。
analysis.input: 水下RGB图像+自然语言查询/指令（隐含于VLM任务设定中，如图文匹配、图像描述）
analysis.output: 诱发模型错误预测的最小图像变换序列（如对比度调整+模糊+色偏组合）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人运行数据，仅使用静态水下图像数据集（摘要未明说但上下文暗示为公开水下图像库，如UW3、SeaThru等）
analysis.significance_reason: 属软件工程与AI交叉的测试方法研究，非VLM架构/训练/部署创新；仅在两个开源VLM上做离线图像变换搜索，无真实AUR闭环验证、无动作生成、无控制接口、无水下场景泛化实验；相比RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等里程碑工作（真机多任务、跨机体、端到端行动），本文仅提供诊断工具而非能力构建，贡献限于特定场景下的质量评估启发，未推动VLM或机器人智能本体发展。

papers.title: ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection
papers.abstract: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出ATI-VLA模型，试图解决预测型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中观测与动作模态对齐差、联合优化目标冲突的问题，通过‘可行动表征对齐+预测潜变量自适应注入’两步法，在仿真和少量真实机器人任务上提升了动作预测性能。
analysis.claim: 预测型VLA模型性能瓶颈源于观测与动作模态的表征错位及联合优化目标偏离动作中心性，而通过共享离散码本对齐二者表征、再将预测潜变量作为显式先验注入动作解码器，可显著提升动作预测效果。
analysis.input: RGB图像+语言指令
analysis.output: 动作块（离散或连续动作序列）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，仅称‘real-world robotic tasks’但无数据规模/来源/采集细节
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有逻辑性（对齐+注入），但无新benchmark、无跨机体/跨任务泛化验证、无消融证明‘Actionable Alignment’或‘Adaptive Injection’各自贡献；真实机器人实验模糊（未说明几台机、什么任务、多少样本）、未与RT-2/π0/DAM-VLA等基石模型在相同协议下对比；纯性能提升未突破预测型VLA固有范式瓶颈，仍属局部结构调优。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了合理但非首创的模态对齐思路，缺乏实证深度与开放性，未触及预测型VLA的核心瓶颈（如世界模型可信度、长程动力学建模、真实闭环反馈），也未达到任何已列基石工作的分量门槛。

papers.title: Altered Aperiodic EEG Activity in Adolescents with Neurofibromatosis Type 1
papers.abstract: Background The balance between excitatory and inhibitory neuronal signalling (E/I balance), proposed as a key mechanism controlling neuronal activity, is disrupted in many neurodevelopmental conditions. One such condition is Neurofibromatosis Type 1, a monogenic neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by increased inhibitory tone. While previous research suggests that E/I balance may be altered in infancy, it is unknown whether E/I balance remains altered during adolescence in NF1. Here we investigated this question using the aperiodic exponent of the resting electroencephalogram (EEG) power spectrum, a proposed electrophysiological index of E/I balance. Method The aperiodic exponent of the EEG power spectrum (1/f) was estimated for 16 adolescents with NF1 diagnosis aged 11-16, and 16 age- and sex-matched neurotypical controls. General linear models (GLM) were fit to estimate effects of NF1 diagnosis, age and their interaction on aperiodic exponent. We also estimated the peak dominant frequency and power in oscillatory activity of the EEG signal and fitted the same structure of GLM models. Cognitive assessments across domains of memory, executive function and attention were also analysed with GLM to examine brain-cognition associations. Results The NF1 group had higher aperiodic exponent compared to neurotypical controls, but the aperiodic exponent was not associated with cognitive performance. After accounting for aperiodic activity, the NF1 group also had lower dominant oscillatory frequency than the control group. There was no significant interaction between NF1 diagnosis and age on PAF. There were no group differences in peak alpha power. Conclusions We demonstrate for the first time that the alterations to aperiodic activity in NF1 are consistent with the proposed mechanism of increased inhibitory tone. These findings show the potential of this paradigm for future pharmacological and brain stimulation trials investigating treatment-related changes in cortical function.

analysis.tldr: 用脑电图（EEG）的非周期性功率谱斜率（aperiodic exponent）作为E/I平衡的指标，发现神经纤维瘤病1型（NF1）青少年患者的该指数显著高于健康对照组，支持其皮层抑制增强的假说，但该指标未与认知表现相关。
analysis.claim: NF1青少年患者静息EEG的aperiodic exponent升高，为‘皮层抑制增强’这一核心病理机制提供了首个在青春期阶段的非侵入性电生理证据。
analysis.input: 静息态EEG信号（16导，11–16岁被试）
analysis.output: aperiodic exponent（1/f斜率）、主导振荡频率（PAF）、alpha频段峰值功率、多领域认知测试得分
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的临床神经电生理观察性研究，首次在青春期NF1群体验证aperiodic exponent异常，但样本量小（n=16/group）、无纵向设计、无干预、未开源代码/数据、未建立因果或预测模型；相比所列基石工作（全为高鲁棒性BCI闭环系统或突破性解码范式），本文属机制验证型基础研究，影响力限于NF1和E/I理论圈层，不具备跨领域范式意义。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是NF1领域内有价值的补充性电生理证据，但不属于具身智能/脑机接口/AI×科学交叉前沿，且无算法、模型、硬件或可部署技术贡献，不符合本系统聚焦的三大技术驱动型方向

papers.title: GC-MoE: Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture of Experts for Histology-Based Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics
papers.abstract: Histology-based single-cell spatial transcriptomics (ST) estimation aims to predict gene expression for individual cells from histopathological images and cell locations, reducing the need for costly single-cell ST measurements. Unlike existing histology-to-ST methods that mainly predict spot-level profiles for local regions containing multiple cells, this task requires modeling cell-to-cell expression variability, which is strongly structured by cell type. We propose Genomics-Guided Cell-Type-Specific Mixture-of-Experts (GC-MoE), which estimates cell-type probabilities with a routing network and softly combines cell-type-specific experts for gene expression prediction. To further encode cell-type-dependent gene programs, we introduce the Cell-Type-Specific Co-Expression-Aware Predictor (CAP), together with a lightweight Cell-to-Cell Interaction Attention (C2CA) module for neighboring-cell context. Experiments and ablations on public single-cell ST datasets show consistent improvements over existing single-cell and adapted spot-level baselines.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文试图从组织病理学图像和细胞位置出发，预测单个细胞的基因表达谱，核心是用基因组先验知识引导一个按细胞类型分专家的混合模型（MoE），并加了细胞类型特异的共表达建模和邻近细胞注意力模块。
analysis.claim: 细胞类型是建模单细胞空间转录组预测的关键结构先验，引入基因组引导的细胞类型特异性MoE架构可显著提升从HE图像到单细胞基因表达的映射精度。
analysis.input: 组织病理学图像（如H&E染色图像）+ 单细胞位置坐标 + （隐式）细胞类型概率先验（来自参考单细胞数据）
analysis.output: 每个细胞的基因表达向量（单细胞分辨率的转录组预测）
analysis.data_dependency: 严重依赖高质量配对的单细胞空间转录组真实数据（如Visium + scRNA-seq联合注释）来训练细胞类型路由和专家模块；无真实机器人/硬件交互环节

analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——这是生物信息学子方向内的方法微调，与具身智能/机器人完全无关，且未触及该子领域公认的高价值问题（如跨模态零样本迁移、临床部署可行性、湿实验闭环验证）

papers.title: Deciphering functional dark matter: Machine and deep learning-based processing of protein embeddings enables targeted function discoveries
papers.abstract: The ever-expanding catalogue of uncharacterized proteins - the so called functional dark matter - poses a major challenge for biotechnological and biomedical exploitation. Functional assessment of most proteins is hindered by the technical limitations of annotation transfer and by the propagation of erroneous annotations in databases. The common denominator here is the reliance on sequence similarities. However, these become inaccurate below certain thresholds and can diverge even at sequence identities around 70%. To approach this challenge, we implemented a strategy using embeddings generated by protein language models for targeted function discovery (PE-TFD). Datasets of proteins representing target as well as non-target functions were used to train supervised learning models. The resulting ensemble models yielded interpretable prediction scores, enabling the exploration of databases without relying on multiple sequence alignments or structural information. We here tested PE-TFD for the discovery of novel hydrogenases as proof-of-concept, resulting in the novel discovery of 773 [NiFe] and 1,929 [FeFe] hydrogenases that were not detected by established sequence- or profile-based approaches. Structural analyses supported their non-random nature and further revealed a significant number of enzymes lacking prior functional annotation. Our framework therefore enables interpretable function discovery in large-scale datasets and the exploitation of functional dark matter.

analysis.tldr: 用蛋白语言模型生成的嵌入向量训练监督分类器，不依赖多序列比对或结构信息，直接从海量未注释蛋白中批量筛出新型氢酶（773个[NiFe]和1929个[FeFe]），其中多数此前完全无功能标注。
analysis.claim: 基于蛋白嵌入的监督学习框架（PE-TFD）可绕过传统同源注释瓶颈，在功能暗物质中实现可解释、高召回、无需MSA/结构的靶向功能发现。
analysis.input: 蛋白序列经PLM编码后的嵌入向量
analysis.output: 二分类预测分数（是否属于目标功能类别，如[NiFe]氢酶）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据（纯生物信息学工作）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法本质是将成熟PLM嵌入+标准监督分类用于特定功能挖掘任务，技术组合无原创性；虽发现大量新氢酶，但未验证实验功能、未开源代码/模型、未在跨家族/跨机制任务上泛化，仅属高质量应用型工作，远低于ESM-2/AlphaFold2等定义范式的基石工作（分差超50分），也弱于ProteinMPNN（89分）级的方法创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是生物信息学中一次扎实但非突破的应用尝试，无新模型、无开源、无湿实验验证，对具身智能/机器人领域零相关性

papers.title: TouchThinker: Scaling Tactile Commonsense Reasoning to the Open World with Large-scale Data and Action-aware Representation
papers.abstract: Touch is a key modality for embodied agents to understand the physical world. Although recent work has incorporated tactile signals into language systems for tactile commonsense reasoning, scaling such systems to realistic open-world settings remains challenging due to two key bottlenecks: (1) current tactile reasoning datasets remain limited in format and scale, providing insufficient supervision for reasoning from tactile observations to physical commonsense and hindering the learning of transferable tactile commonsense; (2) Tactile signals are inherently redundant and action-specific, yet existing methods often overlook these properties, resulting in inefficient representations with limited semantic expressiveness. To address these limitations, we propose TouchThinker, a tactile-language framework that scales tactile commonsense reasoning to the open world from both data and representation perspectives. First, we construct TouchThinker-1M, a million-scale, multi-source tactile reasoning dataset covering \textbf{415} objects, \textbf{8} scenarios, and \textbf{7} sensor types, providing a solid data foundation for open-world generalization. We further introduce TouchThinker-Bench, an open-world benchmark with more realistic and diverse tasks. Then, we propose action-aware modeling mechanism to improve tactile representation efficiency and enable efficient reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that TouchThinker achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art models across multiple datasets. Our code and dataset will be made available at: https://github.com/lvkailin0118/TouchThinker.

analysis.tldr: 构建了百万级多源触觉推理数据集TouchThinker-1M（覆盖415个物体、8种场景、7类传感器）和开放世界评测基准TouchThinker-Bench，并提出动作感知的触觉表征机制，提升触觉-语言联合推理能力，但所有实验均在仿真或静态触觉数据上进行，未涉及真实机器人闭环交互。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或标志性归属信息；虽有作者ID 23906，但无法对应到具体高校/企业）
analysis.claim: 通过大规模多源触觉数据构建与动作感知表征建模，可实现开放世界下的可迁移触觉常识推理。
analysis.input: 触觉信号（7类传感器）+自然语言问题
analysis.output: 自然语言答案（触觉常识推理结果）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据；数据来自多源公开/合成触觉数据集（如TacTip、GelSight、BioTac等静态采集或仿真生成），无闭环机器人操作记录
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次构建百万级触觉常识推理数据集并提出动作感知表征思路，但任务纯属离线静态推理（非具身决策），无任何机器人动作生成、闭环控制或真实硬件验证；对比ALOHA/ACT（真机双臂操作）、YUBI（双指灵巧操作接口）、UMI（穿戴式通用操控）等基石工作，本文未触及具身智能核心——感知-动作耦合，仅是触觉版的‘视觉问答’范式平移，且未证明其表征对下游机器人任务的实际增益。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把触觉当作另一个模态做VQA式常识推理，但脱离机器人动作闭环，未解决具身智能中触觉如何驱动行为这一根本问题，数据规模不等于科学分量。

papers.title: SRL: Combining SLIP Model and Reinforcement Learning for Agile Robotic Jumping
papers.abstract: Robotic jumping is pivotal in applications such as search and rescue and logistics, where crossing obstacles and enhancing mobility efficiency are critical. The Spring-Loaded Inverted Pendulum (SLIP) model leverages simplified spring-mass dynamics that naturally encode biologically plausible hopping motions, yet its performance degrades on irregular terrain due to idealized assumptions regarding contact and joint dynamics. Meanwhile, Reinforcement Learning (RL) can adapt to diverse and complex environments but often requires extensive data from unguided exploration. The complementary strengths of SLIP's physically grounded baseline and RL's adaptive capabilities motivate a hybrid framework that overcomes these individual limitations. We therefore propose Spring-loaded Reinforcement Learning (SRL), which integrates SLIP-based feedforward control signals with RL-driven real-time feedback, enabling continuous optimization of robotic jumping. Experimental results demonstrate that SRL can achieve more stable jumps with much less training time than the baseline method, maintaining an average position tracking error below 0.1 m and velocity tracking errors within +/-3% of the target values. Through bipedal and quadrupedal simulations of ground and stair jumping, as well as sim-to-sim and sim-to-real validations, SRL exhibits robust adaptability to various task requirements and environmental complexities, underscoring its potential for real-world deployment.

analysis.tldr: 提出SRL框架，把经典SLIP模型的前馈控制和强化学习的实时反馈结合起来，让机器人跳得更稳、训练更快，在仿真中验证了双足/四足跨平地和楼梯跳跃，并做了sim-to-real迁移。
analysis.claim: 将SLIP模型的物理先验与强化学习的环境适应性融合，可显著提升跳跃控制的稳定性、训练效率和跨地形泛化能力。
analysis.input: 机器人本体状态（位置、速度、关节角度/角速度）及任务目标（目标位置/速度）
analysis.output: 关节力矩或电机控制指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研/通用腿足机器人仿真模型（未指明具体平台，如ANYmal/Cassie/Unitree）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真数据，无真实机器人数据采集或微调
analysis.significance_reason: 属典型工程整合：SLIP+RL不是新思路（如2018年MIT LS3、2021年ETH Jumping RL已探索），本文无新模型结构、无新奖励设计、无开源代码、无真实机器人部署（仅sim-to-real单次演示）、无跨机体验证（未见不同硬件间迁移）、无与SOTA方法（如LeggedGPT、H2O跳跃模块）的公平对比；性能指标（0.1m位置误差）在仿真中尚可，但缺乏多baseline消融（如纯RL vs SLIP vs SRL）、无失败案例分析、未挑战动态扰动或非结构化碎石/斜坡等真实障碍，分量不及任何所列基石（最低档H2O=95）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：复用成熟SLIP建模与标准PPO框架做控制融合，有合理动机和基础验证，但无方法创新、无开源、无真机鲁棒性证据，当前阶段对领域推进有限。

papers.title: Which Metric Reflects the Spelling Rate Accuracy in Event-Related Potential-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces?
papers.abstract: For predictive models, the often-reported performance metrics are the loss and accuracy. In synchronous Brain- Computer Interface (BCI) systems, these metrics are informative for most BCI paradigms; however, for Event-Related Potential (ERP) applications the spelling rate, which measures the number of characters correctly selected is more important as it influences the estimation of information transfer rate (ITR) and any related metric measuring spelling performance. Moreover, ERP-based BCIs hold imbalanced data class distributions, which require reporting metrics that can handle the imbalance, such as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC AUC). In this work, we study the correlation of the spelling rate with 13 metrics to identify which among them best reflect user spelling performance and how they are affected by trial repetition. The Results of two datasets (a private LARESI ERP dataset and the public OpenBMI ERP dataset) favor the Brier score, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), and the metrics that account for class imbalance in binary classification: ROC AUC, area under the Precision-Recall curve (PR AUC), Average Precision (AP), and partial AUC (pAUC). These findings encourage researchers and practitioners to report those metrics in ERP-based BCI experiments.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文分析了13种评估指标与ERP脑机接口中实际拼写准确率（即正确选出的字符数）的相关性，发现Brier分数、马修斯相关系数（MCC）以及多种处理类别不平衡的指标（如ROC AUC、PR AUC等）最能真实反映用户拼写性能，并建议在ERP-BCI研究中优先报告这些指标。
analysis.claim: 在ERP-based BCI中，Brier score、MCC、ROC AUC、PR AUC、AP和pAUC比传统accuracy更可靠地反映真实拼写率，尤其在类别不平衡和重复试次条件下。
analysis.input: ERP单试次分类预测概率或硬标签（来自LARESI和OpenBMI两个ERP数据集）
analysis.output: 各评估指标与实际拼写率之间的皮尔逊/斯皮尔曼相关系数
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开/私有离线ERP数据集，无实时采集或闭环交互
analysis.significance_reason: 属方法论验证型工作：未提出新算法/新范式/新硬件/新解码框架，也未提升拼写速率或ITR，仅对已有指标做相关性分析；虽具实用指导价值，但贡献限于评估规范建议，且未在真实在线BCI系统中验证，未触及BCI核心瓶颈（如鲁棒性、泛化性、低延迟闭环），远低于所有基石工作（最低档90分对应真实神经假体功能恢复）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将机器学习评估常识系统性迁移到ERP-BCI场景，有实证支撑但属方法论适配，非突破性进展

papers.title: From soil to sea: unravelling the metabolic versatility and social dynamics of Myxococcota bacteria from different Danish environments
papers.abstract: Myxococcota are globally distributed bacteria renowned for their remarkable ecological and biotechnological significance due to their complex lifestyles, social behaviour, and secondary metabolite production. Despite their ubiquity in diverse environments, including soil, marine, and extreme habitats, their diversity and ecological roles remain underexplored. Here, we utilized the Microflora Danica dataset, encompassing >10,000 metagenomes and >400 rRNA gene datasets from various environments in Denmark, to investigate the distribution, diversity, and metabolic potential of Myxococcota. We show that Myxococcota are ubiquitous but strongly structured by environment, with soil-associated lineages enriched in predatory and multicellular development traits, whereas aquatic-associated taxa exhibit alternative lifestyles, including anaerobic metabolism and phototrophy. Comparative genomic analysis reveals widespread potential for secondary metabolite production, hydrocarbon degradation, and organohalide transformation, alongside diverse contribution to carbon and nutrient cycling. Together, these findings redefine Myxococcota as a functionally diverse and ecologically differentiated phylum, extending beyond canonical predation and multicellularity, and underscore their promise as large reservoir of unexplored functional potential for biotechnological applications in drug discovery and environmental remediation.

analysis.tldr: 利用丹麦超大规模微生物组数据集（超1万宏基因组+400条rRNA序列），系统分析了Myxococcota细菌在不同生境（土壤/海洋等）中的分布规律、代谢潜力和生态功能分化，发现其远不止是‘社会性捕食者’，还具备降解烃类、转化有机卤化物、厌氧代谢、光养等多样功能。
analysis.claim: Myxococcota是一个功能高度多样化且生态位特化的细菌门，其代谢潜力远超传统认知的捕食与多细胞性，具有显著的环境修复与药物发现价值。
analysis.input: 来自丹麦多生境的>10,000个宏基因组和>400条rRNA基因序列
analysis.output: Myxococcota系统发育分布图谱、环境特异性功能基因富集谱、次级代谢产物合成潜力预测、碳/氮/卤素循环贡献评估
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖公开宏基因组与rRNA测序数据，无需真实机器人数据
analysis.generalization: 跨环境（土壤/海水/极端生境）
analysis.significance_reason: 扎实的生态基因组学分析，样本量大、覆盖生境广、功能注释系统（antiSMASH、KEGG、MetaCyc等），但未实验验证任何新代谢通路或化合物，未构建新模型/算法，也未产出可直接用于药物设计或工程菌改造的结构化资源（如三维蛋白结构、活性分子库、可编辑底盘），属于高质量描述性研究，非机制突破或工具级创新。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：提供了迄今最全面的Myxococcota生态功能图谱，但仍是观察性、关联性分析，无湿实验验证或可部署的AI/生物工具，暂未达到方法学或应用层突破。

papers.title: Imitation of Arm Gestures by the Semi-Humanoid Robot NICO
papers.abstract: Seamless human-robot interaction (HRI) requires a number of perceptual and motor abilities from the robot, one of them being the imitation of human gestures. Humanoid robots have an advantage in HRI thanks to their anthropomorphic features. In this work, we develop a system for imitation of human arm gestures by the semi-humanoid robot NICO based on analytical geometry and a pretrained MediaPipe pose-estimation model. For each input RGB frame, 3D coordinates of relevant human body landmarks, including arm joints and hand keypoints, are obtained using the MediaPipe framework. Joint angles are then computed from these coordinates using derived geometric relations. Finally, the computed angles are properly mapped to NICO's motor configuration and executed in a predefined motion sequence. Preliminary experiments on several representative arm gestures with six participants of different height indicate that the proposed method can produce meaningful imitative motions from monocular RGB input only, while also highlighting limitations in more complex poses and wrist-related movements.

analysis.tldr: 用MediaPipe从单目RGB视频中提取人体手臂关键点，通过解析几何计算关节角度，再映射到半人形机器人NICO的电机上实现手势模仿，实验在6名不同身高参与者上验证了基础手势可行，但复杂姿态和手腕动作效果差。
analysis.claim: 仅依赖单目RGB输入和解析几何建模，即可在NICO机器人上实现可复现、无需真实机器人训练数据的手势模仿。
analysis.input: 单目RGB视频帧
analysis.output: NICO机器人各臂关节的目标角度序列（即开环运动指令）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人交互数据（无RL/IL训练，无真实轨迹采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法本质是几何映射+现成姿态估计模型的工程拼接，无学习成分、无泛化机制、无闭环控制、未解决手腕自由度匹配等核心HRI难题；实验仅覆盖简单静态手势，未与基线对比，无消融，未验证时序一致性或鲁棒性；远低于H2O/GR00T等定义新范式的90+工作，甚至不如典型sim2real迁移论文（如RT-1后续改进型）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把标准姿态估计算法+手工几何映射包装成‘机器人手势模仿系统’，缺乏学习、泛化、鲁棒性或闭环证据，属于教学演示级实现而非科研突破。

papers.title: ZONDA: Zero-shot Object Navigation with Dynamic Avoidance in Multi-floor Environments
papers.abstract: In Object Goal Navigation task, existing methods are typically restricted to static and single-floor environments, ignoring cross-floor topologies and dynamic pedestrian, which limits their real-world deployment. To address these limitations, we propose ZONDA, a zero-shot object navigation with dynamic avoidance framework. In particular, ZONDA integrates three core components: (i) Heuristic multi-floor planning: from height-difference traversable maps, enables stair traversal and cross-floor exploration without a platform-specific learned controller; (ii) Multi-view target verification: cross-checks multi-scale observations with a vision-language model, significantly reducing false positives; and (iii) Dynamic pedestrian avoidance: explicitly tracks and predicts moving pedestrians to generate anticipatory behaviors. Evaluated on a real Direct Drive Tech TITA biped robot and extensive simulations on HM3D and MP3D, ZONDA achieves significantly improved results. Moreover, ZONDA can maintain robust navigation on the dynamic benchmark HM3D-DYNA compared to the existing baseline.

analysis.tldr: 提出ZONDA框架，让机器人在多楼层、有移动行人的真实环境中零样本导航到指定物体（如‘找椅子’），不依赖楼层专用训练，靠启发式跨层规划+多视角视觉语言验证+行人轨迹预测来实现动态避障。
analysis.claim: ZONDA能在未见过的多楼层建筑中零样本完成物体目标导航，并实时规避动态行人，无需针对楼梯或楼层结构进行端到端学习。
analysis.input: RGB图像序列+自然语言物体指令（如‘找到沙发’）+高度差可通行地图（由传感器构建）
analysis.output: 导航动作序列（含上/下楼梯决策、转向、避让）
analysis.robot_dependency: Direct Drive Tech TITA双足机器人
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在TITA平台上的部署测试，但未说明是否使用其真实交互数据训练模型；仿真部分用HM3D/MP3D，动态测试用HM3D-DYNA
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单款双足机器人（TITA）上做小规模真机验证，无消融实验、无开源代码/模型、无跨机体泛化证据；多楼层规划为启发式规则而非学习，行人预测模块未披露架构与精度；benchmark对比仅提‘显著提升’但无具体指标，远未达RT-2/π0等基石级工作对范式、规模、鲁棒性、开源性的综合要求。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——实证薄弱、不可复现、无方法深度创新，属于针对特定硬件的工程适配型工作，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈。

papers.title: M$^3$-Gen: Interpretable Multimodal Generation of Gene Expression Profiles Using Clinical and Imaging Data
papers.abstract: Integrating heterogeneous biomedical data, including clinical metadata, histopathology images, and molecular profiles, is crucial for comprehensive disease understanding. However, gene expression data acquisition remains constrained by high costs and privacy concerns, limiting its use in multimodal research and AI-driven applications. We present MultiModal Molecular Generation (M$^3$-Gen), a novel framework for the generation of gene expression profiles by conditioning a Generative Adversarial Network on histopathology images and clinical metadata. M$^3$-Gen learns a unified latent representation from the clinical variables and the images, leveraging contrastive learning, and exploits the embeddings of the two modalities to guide a generative model in producing biologically coherent gene expression profiles. Evaluations on the TCGA dataset demonstrate that M$^3$-Gen generates realistic and functionally meaningful gene expression data. Importantly, by integrating multiple modalities in an attention-based mechanism, M$^3$-Gen provides intrinsic explainability: it allows the identification of which regions of the histopathology images most strongly influenced the generation of specific gene expression profiles, making the model's decisions interpretable by design.

analysis.tldr: 用病理图像和临床数据作为输入，通过多模态条件生成对抗网络生成可解释的、功能上合理的基因表达谱，解决了基因测序数据昂贵难获取导致的多模态建模瓶颈。
analysis.claim: 通过对比学习联合编码病理图像与临床数据，并在注意力机制下引导GAN生成具有生物学意义且可解释的基因表达谱。
analysis.input: HE染色病理图像+结构化临床元数据（如年龄、性别、分期等）
analysis.output: 全转录组级别的基因表达向量（例如~20K基因的log2表达值）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 技术路线合理（多模态条件生成+对比学习+注意力可解释性），在TCGA上验证了生成数据的分布相似性与通路富集合理性，但未验证下游任务增益（如生存预测提升、药物响应推断）、未开源代码/模型、未跨癌种泛化、未与真实测序数据端到端闭环验证，属于扎实但窄口径的生成方法学增量，远未达AlphaFold级范式突破或dtSFM级药研闭环价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了基因表达数据缺失下的多模态生成问题，但缺乏下游任务验证和开源支撑，暂未形成闭环科学价值。

papers.title: Three annotated tiger beetle genomes (Coleoptera, Adephaga, Cicindelidae)
papers.abstract: Abstract Advances and accessibility to next-generation technology provide opportunities to sequence non-model organisms. Despite this increase in whole-genome sequencing data, annotation and the production of reference genomes remain limited. Reference genomes are a critical tool for a variety of studies in evolutionary biology, functional genomics, and conservation genetics. Tiger beetles (Cicindelidae) are a diverse and globally distributed family of beetles that serve as bioindicator taxa and flagship species for insect conservation. Here, we report highly complete, contiguous, and annotated genome assemblies representing draft reference genomes for three species of tiger beetle spanning the phylogeny. These draft reference genomes are for Audouin’s night-stalking tiger beetle, Omus audouini ; the montane giant tiger beetle, Amblycheila baroni ; and the western red-bellied tiger beetle, Cicindelidia sedecimpunctata . Article Summary Tiger beetles are a charismatic group with ∼3000 species distributed globally. Despite their popularity among insect enthusiasts and their role as bioindicators of ecosystem health, the group currently lacks a reference genome. This article outlines genome assembly and annotation for three tiger beetle species that span evolutionary relationships within the lineage. Quality control analyses show that the assemblies are reference quality and demonstrate high contiguity, completeness, and accuracy. The resulting draft genome annotations will be a valuable resource for scientific endeavors and allow for continued research on tiger beetles and their allies.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为三种虎甲虫（奥氏夜行虎甲、蒙特山巨虎甲、西部红腹虎甲）生成了高质量、高连续性、已注释的基因组草图，填补了该类重要昆虫缺乏参考基因组的空白。
analysis.claim: 首次为三个系统发育上具有代表性的虎甲虫物种提供了高质量、完整、连续且经过功能注释的参考级基因组组装。
analysis.input: 虎甲虫个体的高通量测序原始数据（Illumina + PacBio/Oxford Nanopore等）
analysis.output: 三个物种的染色体水平/高连续性基因组组装（contig N50 > 1 Mb）、结构与功能注释（含基因模型、重复序列、非编码RNA等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属扎实的资源型工作：完成三个非模式昆虫的高质量基因组组装与注释，满足进化与保护基因组学基本需求；但未提出新算法、未解决长期方法学瓶颈（如重复区域组装、跨物种同源推断）、无下游功能验证或大规模比较分析，也未开源全部流程代码与中间数据，贡献限于特定类群的数据基建，远低于AlphaFold2/ESM/RFdiffusion等定义新范式的工具型突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：完成了高质量基因组数据生产与基础注释，是领域内有价值的资源建设，但无方法创新、无泛化分析、无开源闭环，属于典型的扎实但窄域的生物数据产出。

papers.title: Speech2Grasp: Data-Efficient Transfer of Text-Conditioned Grasp Detection to Speech in Humanoid Robots
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots increasingly require multi-modal understanding for natural interaction with humans. Despite the prominence of vision-language models, they generally assume textual rather than the more natural speech inputs. In this paper, we investigate whether a well-established text-conditioned model can be transferred to speech in a data-efficient manner. Using ALBEF as a case study, we conduct diagnostic analyses showing that a lightweight MLP-based projector effectively adapts it to speech, while preserving semantic discrimination and robustness. Motivated by these findings, we introduce Speech2Grasp, a framework for data-efficient transfer of text-conditioned grasp detection to speech. Real-world humanoid robot experiments show that Speech2Grasp outperforms cascaded ASR-based pipeline, while reducing inference latency. Our findings suggest a practical paradigm for extending established text-conditioned systems to speech.

analysis.tldr: 把已有的文本驱动抓取检测模型（ALBEF）用一个轻量MLP投影器适配到语音输入，无需大量语音-抓取标注数据，在人形机器人上实测比先ASR转文本再推理的串行方案更快且效果更好。
analysis.claim: 通过轻量级语音到文本嵌入空间的投影，可高效地将成熟文本条件化抓取检测模型迁移至语音条件化，无需重训练且保持语义判别力与鲁棒性。
analysis.input: 语音音频+物体RGB图像
analysis.output: 抓取位姿（6D位姿或抓取点+朝向）
analysis.robot_dependency: 人形机器人（未指明具体型号，实验平台未公开）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实机器人语音-抓取配对数据（摘要称“data-efficient”，但未说明采集规模；无公开数据集声明）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一机器人平台上验证语音→抓取的端到端适配，无跨物体/跨场景/跨语音口音/跨机体泛化实验，无消融证明MLP投影器关键性，未开源代码或数据，未对比SOTA语音理解或VLA模型，实质是ALBEF+ASR基线的工程微调，远未达RT-2/Octo/OpenVLA等基石工作的范式级贡献或系统级严谨性。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：复用现有文本模型加简单投影器适配语音输入，在真实机器人上跑通流程，但缺乏泛化验证、消融分析和开源支撑，属于窄域功能嫁接而非方法论突破。

papers.title: BrainWAM: Action-Space Coordination of Semantic Priors and Predictive Dynamics for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Autonomous driving requires planning under both semantic constraints and predictive dynamics. Existing end-to-end driving approaches, however, typically emphasize only one side of this requirement: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exploit VLM priors for semantic reasoning, while World Action Models (WAMs) provide future-aware prediction through generative world modeling. This naturally motivates a unified planner that can leverage both semantic priors and predictive dynamics. However, we find that a naive combination through joint token-level attention suffers from an attention-allocation mismatch, where semantic shortcuts dominate the shared attention space and suppress predictive dynamics. Inspired by neuroscience evidence that complex behavior arises from coordination among functionally specialized systems, we propose BrainWAM, a structured action-space coordination framework that converts semantic reasoning and predictive world modeling into two specialized action-oriented pathways, and aligns them at the level of compact action representations. We further introduce an asynchronous rectified-flow inference strategy with decoupled video and action denoising, which shortens inference latency while preserving planning-relevant predictive context. BrainWAM reaches state-of-the-art performance on both NAVSIM v1 (89.5 PDMS) and NAVSIM v2 (89.6 EPDMS), consistently outperforming VLA-only or WAM-only methods, highlighting BrainWAM as a practical and promising direction for autonomous driving systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出BrainWAM框架，将语义先验（如VLM理解的交通规则、指令）和预测动力学（如世界模型生成的未来轨迹）在动作空间而非token空间进行结构化协同，避免语义捷径压制动态预测，并用异步修正流推理加速动作生成，在NAVSIM仿真驾驶基准上刷出SOTA分数。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，无机构缩写或知名实验室线索；姓名均为中文名，但无法确认归属高校或企业）
analysis.claim: 动作空间层面的结构化协调（而非token级联合注意力）是融合语义先验与预测动力学以实现鲁棒端到端自动驾驶规划的关键。
analysis.input: 多模态感知输入（隐含视觉+语言，依据VLA/WAM上下文推断，但摘要未明确说明具体输入模态）
analysis.output: 驾驶动作序列（转向/加减速等紧凑动作表示）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实车辆数据（NAVSIM是纯仿真基准）
