papers.title: FibVLA: An Efficient Temporal Vision-Language-Action Model with Fibonacci Sampling
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs), which leverage the cognition of multimodal information to infer physical-world actions, provide a generalized solution for embodied AI applications. Conventional VLAs usually concentrate on current digital cognition. While some efforts are made to enhance VLAs' reasoning capabilities by capturing temporal information, encoding the long-context history causes an efficiency-decreasing issue. To reconcile the conflict between capturing temporal information and maintaining inference efficiency in VLAs, this paper introduces FibVLA, an efficient framework featuring temporal perception of long-context history. Specifically, we leverage logarithmic hindsight sampling to both proprioceptive states and visual frames to capture long-term temporal dependencies with minimal redundancy. For the action expert, we introduce the flow matching to produce action distributions, and the Fibonacci recurrent inference strategy to generate long-range planning steps based on real-time closed-loop feedback. Experiments demonstrate that FibVLA significantly improves action smoothness and success rates without retraining large-scale visual encoders. Efficiency analysis demonstrates superior real-time responsiveness compared to video-based baselines in real-world evaluations.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出FibVLA，用斐波那契间隔采样（对视觉帧和本体感知状态做对数回溯采样）压缩长时序历史，再结合流匹配建模动作分布和斐波那契递归推理策略生成长程动作规划，在不重训大视觉编码器的前提下提升动作平滑性和成功率。

papers.title: Enabling Urgency-aware Robot Swarm Intralogistics using Smart IoT Tags
papers.abstract: Warehouse items differ in how urgently they must be moved: perishable goods, pharmaceutical shipments, and just-in-time production materials must be delivered sooner than the rest of the stock. Decentralised robot swarms suit warehouses that cannot justify fixed automation infrastructure, but current swarm controllers treat all items alike or rely on an external scheduler to set priorities, so urgent items wait as long as ordinary ones. This paper presents a swarm logistics system in which each warehouse carrier holds an ultra-low-power Internet-of-Things (IoT) tag that broadcasts the urgency of its item over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). Robots read these broadcasts directly and weigh urgency against travel distance when choosing which carrier to serve, so prioritisation happens at the item level without central scheduling. The system is evaluated in simulation and validated on real robots and IoT-tagged carriers against a proximity-only baseline. In the physical trials, priority alignment (i.e. proportion of urgent items served first), improved from 0.41 to 0.64, with a nonsignificant trend toward lower 95th-percentile (P95) delivery latency and throughput within 1.2% of the baseline. In simulation, the benefit grew with system size: across three larger configurations, P95 latency fell by 5.2% to 11.8% and priority alignment improved by 41.7% to 51.6%. Attaching urgency to the items themselves therefore allows a decentralised swarm to serve time-critical stock sooner while keeping the low infrastructure requirements that make swarm systems attractive for warehouse automation.

analysis.tldr: 给仓库货物贴超低功耗蓝牙IoT标签，让机器人集群能直接读取每个货物的紧急程度，自主决定优先搬运哪些货，无需中央调度器，实测在真实机器人上将紧急货物优先服务率从41%提升到64%。
analysis.claim: 将 urgency 信息物理绑定到货物本身（通过BLE IoT标签），可使去中心化机器人集群在无中央调度前提下实现物品级动态优先级调度，显著提升紧急货物的服务及时性。

papers.title: EpiTune: An Accurate Epitope Prediction Model with Mechanistic Insights
papers.abstract: The accurate prediction of b-cell epitopes facilitates vaccine development by identifying known antibodies for an antigen. Multiple epitope prediction models use protein language models to enable more accurate predictions with modest results. Here, we present EpiTune, a b-cell epitope prediction model that fine-tunes the underlying protein language model to deliver best-in-class predictions of linear epitopes and competitive predictions for confirmational epitopes. EpiTune achieves this performance from antigen sequence alone, and utilizes ESM-2's RoPE architecture to fine-tune and infer on sequences longer than other sequence-based models currently available in the literature. EpiTune's single-model architecture allows the model to determine the meaningfulness of sequence features for epitope prediction. This avoids the need for assigning importance to intermediates such as structure-based information, while still allowing a high degree of model interpretability.

analysis.tldr: EpiTune是一个仅用抗原氨基酸序列就能预测B细胞线性表位的模型，通过微调ESM-2（使用RoPE位置编码）提升长序列建模能力，在线性表位预测上达到当前最优，构象表位预测与主流方法相当，且具备可解释性，无需依赖结构预测或额外特征工程。
analysis.claim: 仅基于抗原序列微调ESM-2（引入RoPE），即可在不依赖三维结构、不引入中间特征的前提下，实现线性表位预测SOTA性能，并保持对构象表位的竞争力和模型可解释性。

papers.title: OncoGenRAG: Evidence-Grounded Retrieval and BioBERT Classification for Precision Oncology Variant Interpretation
papers.abstract: The increasing use of tumor sequencing has intensified the need for fast, traceable interpretation of genomic variants. General-purpose large language models can produce fluent answers, but unsupported statements, weak provenance, and stale knowledge limit their suitability for clinical genomics. We developed OncoGenRAG, a research framework that combines a parameter-efficiently fine-tuned BioBERT classifier with an entity-aware retrieval system over a curated, multi-source oncology knowledge base. The reported knowledge base contains 933 harmonized records derived from CIViC, ClinVar/dbSNP, Open Targets, UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot, Ensembl Variation, and linked PubMed literature. The classifier assigns one of five labels: Pathogenic, Likely Pathogenic, Variant of Uncertain Significance, Benign, or Oncogenic; the retrieval component ranks evidence records using subword TF-IDF similarity and explicit gene, variant, and cancer-type matches. A rejection rule suppresses answers when retrieval support is below a prespecified threshold. In the authors held-out evaluation, the classifier achieved 92.40% accuracy, 93.15% weighted precision, 92.40% weighted recall, and 92.65% weighted F1 score. In a separate benchmark of 100 clinical-style queries, OncoGenRAG achieved reported Precision@1 of 94.5%, Precision@3 of 96.8%, and 100% database grounding. No hallucinated answer was observed under the study operational definition, compared with a 41.0% no-hallucination rate for the ungrounded baseline. These results should be interpreted as internal validation rather than proof of universal safety because query construction, annotator agreement, class-specific performance, calibration, and external validation data were not available for independent analysis. OncoGenRAG provides a transparent design for evidence retrieval and abstention, but it is a research prototype and must not be used to select treatment without expert review.

analysis.tldr: 用BioBERT分类器+多源肿瘤知识库检索系统，对基因变异进行可溯源的五分类临床解读（如致病性/良性/意义未明），并设置证据不足时自动拒答，避免幻觉。
analysis.claim: 通过证据锚定的检索增强分类框架OncoGenRAG，可在保证高准确率的同时彻底消除幻觉输出，实现可追溯、可拒答的精准肿瘤基因变异解读。

papers.title: ME-Brain-1.0: Memory, Cognition and Action for Evolving Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: Current embodied systems largely rely on pretrained capabilities that remain fixed after deployment, limiting their ability to learn from physical interaction. We introduce MachEmbodied-Brain (ME-Brain), a self-evolving embodied system organized around a closed loop of action execution, experience acquisition, experience evolution, and improved execution. Evolvable Memory consolidates multimodal trajectories into hierarchical, reusable experience; Cognitive Core transforms physical experience into transferable skills; and the Action Model combines event-driven keyframes, EventCell local-world prediction, and action-conditioned memory modulation to focus computation on decision-critical moments, regions, and historical evidence. Together, these modules shift embodied intelligence from train-and-freeze to deploy-and-evolve without model retraining. Cognitive Core outperforms the strongest comparison models by 8.2 and 9.6 points on embodied and agent benchmarks. The Action Model achieves 47.88% mean success on RoboMME, a 3.26-point improvement over the strongest baseline. On RoboDojo, it reaches a 21.51 mean Score and 16.03% success rate, exceeding $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 and 9.12 points. On the six-task ME-RealBench, ME-Brain achieves a 69.5 mean Score and 66.7% success rate, outperforming DM0.5 by 12.8 and 11.7 points, respectively.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个名为ME-Brain的具身智能系统架构，试图让机器人在部署后能通过物理交互持续积累经验、提炼技能、动态调用记忆来改进动作决策，无需重新训练模型。

papers.title: Large language model-based bibliometric evaluation of population descriptors in human genetics
papers.abstract: As the use of population descriptors such as race, ethnicity, and ancestry have become increasingly common in modern genetics research, there have been growing calls to critically examine their use. Most notably, in 2023, the National Academies of Science, Engineering, and Medicine (NASEM) published a report titled Using Population Descriptors in Genetics and Genomics Research: A New Framework for an Evolving Field, which included eight specific and actionable recommendations for researchers to implement the ethical and accurate use of population descriptors in genetic research. Here, we use the 2023 NASEM report as a benchmark to analyze the use of population descriptors in genome-wide association studies (GWAS). We develop a general toolkit for large language model-based bibliometrics, operationalize the report's recommendations into an evaluation framework, and apply this framework to evaluate all 4,007 papers from the GWAS Catalog published between 2007 and 2025 with full text available on PubMedCentral. We find significant improvements in adherence to NASEM report recommendations over time. However, most improvements predate the publication of the NASEM report itself, suggesting the report functioned primarily as a synthesis of existing best practices rather than a catalyst for change. We conclude by highlighting opportunities for growth in the field of human genetics.

papers.title: Towards VLA-Dreamer: Refining VLA Behavior Using World Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), while showing strong potential for robot control, require massive amounts of high-quality imitation learning data. Moreover, the absence of an explicit world model casts further doubt on their control capabilities. In this concept paper, we propose a novel architecture that addresses sample efficiency in VLAs by training a predictive world model on the embedding space of the VLA's vision encoder. We hypothesize that these embeddings are action-relevant and usable for future prediction. To this end, we propose using the suggested architecture to investigate how well these embeddings predict the future based on actions, as the inability to do so would mark a key limitation of VLA architectures: the lack of a non-lossy implicit world model to simulate real-world dynamics. The proposed architecture differs from the standard world model dynamics as the loss comes from the embedding space rather than the pixel space, similar to joint embedding predictive architectures. Furthermore, the trained world model can be utilized for short-term planning tasks by sampling VLA actions given goal images. We intend to examine the richness of vision embeddings in VLAs and reduce their high data requirements through a world model that can also generate plans during inference.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫VLA-Dreamer的构想：用VLA模型视觉编码器输出的嵌入（embedding）作为世界模型的预测对象，而非直接预测像素，试图通过预测嵌入来提升VLA的数据效率并支持短时规划，但全文无实验、无代码、无数据、无任何实证验证，纯属概念提案。

papers.title: TAME-Nav: Temporal Asymmetric Mixture-of-Experts Distillation for Agile and Versatile Robot Navigation
papers.abstract: Agile and reliable navigation is a core capability for embodied robots navigating complex spatial constraints and dynamic interactions. However, a single policy often struggles to accommodate the distinct decision-making demands of diverse scenarios. We present TAME-Nav, an asymmetric Teacher-Student navigation framework built around a temporal soft mixture of experts (Soft-MoE). The Teacher combines clean observations with causally maintained dynamic-obstacle tracks to construct privileged representations, while the Student learns complementary navigation features from corrupted observation histories through temporal encoding, soft expert routing, and latent distillation. Procedural scenario generation and parallel task-level simulation broaden training coverage, while deployment-informed asymmetric domain randomization supports sim-to-real transfer. Across in-distribution and unseen compositional scenarios, TAME-Nav achieves higher success rates, lower collision rates, and higher navigation scores than representative baselines. On a real quadruped robot, it completes all twenty trials across local-trap escape and narrow-passage navigation with sudden dynamic obstacles, with only one minor contact.

analysis.tldr: 提出一种叫TAME-Nav的导航框架，用教师-学生不对称蒸馏结构，让学生模型从带噪声的历史观测中学习，教师则用干净观测+动态障碍物轨迹生成特权表征，通过时间软专家混合和隐空间蒸馏提升泛化能力，在仿真和真实四足机器人上验证了在突发动态障碍下的窄道通行和局部陷阱逃脱能力。

papers.title: Assessing a natural gene drive for population control in house mice
papers.abstract: House mice are a major invasive pest with significant impact on island ecosystems. Genetic biocontrol via gene editing offers promising new avenues for population control. An alternative idea dating back over half a century is to harness the unmodified, naturally occurring genetic element called t haplotype for population suppression. The t haplotype causes sterility in t/t homozygote males, while +/t heterozygote males transmit the t to most of their offspring via meiotic drive. We use population genetic modelling to systematically explore whether this approach can suppress invasive populations through the accumulation of t/t sterile males. We find that +/t fertile releases combined with the sustained release of t/t sterile males can achieve eradication, but require prolonged interventions, with eradication taking around 25 years under our baseline scenario. We then show that release effort and eradication times may be reduced substantially if releases are combined with trapping, culling, or the release of hyper-competitive ( Adonis ) males. A direct comparison with t CRISPR , currently the main engineered genetic biocontrol system for house mice, shows that the approach requires greater release effort but achieves comparable eradication times. We provide an R shiny application for exploring model scenarios interactively. Our findings highlight both the potential and the limitations of exploiting this natural meiotic drive system for population control, and identify key gaps in knowledge of mouse reproductive biology and behaviour needed to fully assess its feasibility in the field.

analysis.tldr: 用种群遗传模型评估天然t单倍型（不依赖基因编辑）能否用于根除入侵小鼠种群，发现需长期释放杂合雄鼠和纯合不育雄鼠（约25年），结合捕杀或超竞争力雄鼠可加速，但整体效率低于工程化CRISPR基因驱动，且严重受限于对小鼠生殖行为等基础生物学知识的缺失。

papers.title: Beyond Augmentation: Score-Guided Pathological Prior for EEG-based Depression Detection
papers.abstract: Deep learning-based Major Depressive Disorder (MDD) detection using Electroencephalography (EEG) is fundamentally constrained by the "small-sample dilemma." Prevailing generative data augmentation methods not only incur heavy computational overhead but also risk introducing synthetic noise, thereby blurring classification boundaries. To challenge the traditional "data quantity first" convention, we propose a novel framework "Beyond Augmentation": Score-Guided Classification (SGC). SGC does not synthesize pseudo-samples; instead, it utilizes an unsupervised generative network architecture to model the structural and statistical anomaly degrees of samples, serving as the core "Pathological Prior". This prior, after robust normalization, is explicitly fused with deep feature representations, thereby precisely guiding the classifier's decision boundary. Furthermore, to dynamically adapt to varying channel configurations, we propose a Cross-Channel Spatial Adaptation module, utilizing a spatial mapping mechanism to effectively resolve the hardware heterogeneity of mismatched channels in multi-center datasets. Extensive experiments on the Mumtaz2016 and high-density MODMA datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and exceptional generalizability of our method under the challenging "zero data augmentation" setting and at "zero sample synthesis cost". Keywords: Electroencephalography (EEG), Depression Detection, Anomaly Score, Diffusion Models, Few-Shot Learning

papers.title: Vision-Language-Action Models Meet World Models: Embodied Agentic AI for Low-Altitude Wireless Networks
papers.abstract: Low-Altitude Wireless Networks (LAWNs), composed of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and other aerial platforms, provide integrated perception, communication, and computation services in low-altitude airspace. However, deploying large generative models in this domain faces three major challenges: 1) Limited embodied action mapping; 2) Inadequate physical environment modeling; 3) Insufficient closed-loop optimization. To address these challenges, this study proposes an Embodied Agentic UAV framework. Centered on a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model as the execution core, the framework establishes an end-to-end embodied decision-making pipeline from multimodal environmental perception to continuous control generation. In addition, a World Model (WM) is introduced to capture the coupling between UAV actions and environmental state evolution, thereby supporting environment prediction, policy verification, and dynamic optimization. Furthermore, memory and reflection mechanisms are incorporated to form an adaptive closed-loop optimization paradigm of decision, execution, evaluation, and update, thereby enhancing the system's autonomous decision-making capability and continual evolution ability in complex dynamic environments. Experimental results validate its effectiveness in enabling robust, predictive, and sustainable autonomous control in LAWNs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个面向低空无线网络（LAWN）的无人机自主控制框架，把视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）作为决策核心，再加一个世界模型（WM）来预测环境变化、验证策略、动态优化，并引入记忆与反思机制形成闭环优化，但所有实验都在仿真中完成，未用真实无人机，也未公开代码或数据。

papers.title: Target-Aware Bandit Allocation for Scalable Surrogate Optimization in Chemical Space
papers.abstract: Identifying high-utility candidates from massive discrete spaces under expensive evaluations is a recurring challenge across the sciences, with structure-based drug discovery as a prominent example. While surrogate-based optimization can increase sample efficiency by reducing the number of expensive evaluations, modern molecular libraries have reached billions to trillions of compounds, making full-library surrogate inference itself a major computational bottleneck. We introduce BOBa, a bandit-guided surrogate optimization framework that eliminates full-library inference by adaptively allocating computation across partitions of the action space. By treating partitions as arms in a multi-armed bandit, BOBa concentrates inference and evaluations on empirically promising partitions while maintaining principled exploration. Experiments on real-world synthesis-on-demand libraries demonstrate that optimism-under-uncertainty bandits, combined with meaningful action space partitioning, are essential for effective allocation of inference and evaluations. Our findings reveal a tunable tradeoff between screening performance and surrogate inference cost, which supports practical optimization over current libraries, and establishes a viable route to ultra-large library virtual screening.

analysis.tldr: 提出BOBa框架，用多臂老虎机动态分配计算资源，在超大规模化学库（数十亿级）中跳过全库代理模型预测，只对高潜力分子子集做代理评估和实验验证，从而在有限算力下实现高效虚拟筛选。

papers.title: Effects of EEG Preprocessing on Channel-Wise Attention and Effective Connectivity Alignment in Visual EEG Decoding
papers.abstract: Transformer-based deep learning models have shown great potential for decoding visual EEG signals. However, their internal attention mechanisms are often evaluated primarily on optimization objectives, leaving their alignment with biological brain connectivity an open question. This study empirically evaluates how variations in EEG preprocessing strategies affect these attention representations using the Adaptive Thinking Mapper (ATM) model as a framework. We compared a baseline pipeline (MVNN only) against a comprehensive cleaning pipeline integrating ICA and notch filtering. The models were evaluated through cross-generalization, noise robustness, and spectral-temporal ablation analyses. Furthermore, we investigated the structural correspondence between the model's data-driven attention weights and neurophysiological reference networks (GPDC, PDC, and DTF) using Node Strength Correlation and Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA). The results show that the comprehensive preprocessing successfully suppresses non-neural artifacts, such as frontal noise and electrical interference, while maintaining comparable decoding accuracy and baseline robustness. Alignment analyses revealed that the broad spatial organization of the learned attention patterns remains highly stable across pipelines, capturing key directed connectivity dynamics with subtle, metric-dependent variations in global representational geometry. This work provides an empirical exploration into bridging data-driven attention weights with neurophysiological consistency, offering insights toward more transparent brain-computer interfaces.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文研究了不同EEG预处理方法（比如只用MVNN vs 加上ICA和陷波滤波）对Transformer模型内部通道注意力权重与真实脑功能连接（如GPDC、PDC）对齐程度的影响，发现预处理主要影响注意力表征的全局几何结构而非空间组织稳定性，但未提升解码性能或实现新任务。

papers.title: CHARMM-GUI Covalent Ligand Docker as a Web-based Molecular Docking Platform for Covalent Ligands
papers.abstract: Covalent inhibitor research is an emerging topic in drug discovery due to its superior performance in specificity and inhibition effects. While molecular docking is a popular strategy in prediction and assessment of ligand conformations or poses in receptor proteins, covalent ligand docking requires nontrivial preparation efforts, as the ligand structure changes during the covalent complex formation. In order to facilitate molecular docking for covalent ligands, we have developed CHARMM-GUI Covalent Ligand Docker (CGUI-CLD), a new module for covalent ligand docking supported by AutoDock4. CGUI-CLD automates ligand preparation, supports ligand modification, implements docking simulation, and presents results through an intuitive user interface. A knowledge-based library built in CGUI-CLD currently supports 66 warheads and 8 amino acids, which can be used to automate the covalent ligand transformation from a pre-reaction to a post-reaction adduct form seamlessly. Moreover, CHARMM-GUI High-Throughput Simulator is integrated for rapid generation of multiple molecular dynamics simulation systems. CGUI-CLD is expected to significantly reduce a massive workload of covalent ligand docking and advance covalent ligand research.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个基于Web的自动化工具CGUI-CLD，用于共价小分子配体与靶蛋白的对接建模，核心是自动处理共价键形成前后的配体结构转换（如66种弹头+8种氨基酸组合），并集成AutoDock4和高通量MD系统生成模拟体系。
analysis.claim: CGUI-CLD通过知识库驱动的共价配体结构自动转换与流程化对接，显著降低共价抑制剂分子对接的实操门槛和人工工作量。
analysis.input: 共价配体SMILES或结构文件、靶标蛋白PDB结构、指定共价修饰位点（如Cys残基）
analysis.output: 共价结合构象（pose）、对接打分、可导出的MD初始体系（含共价键参数化后的拓扑与坐标）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于高质量工具链工程整合（非算法突破），填补了共价对接自动化空白，但未提出新打分函数、新采样策略或新物理模型；知识库覆盖有限（66×8组合），未验证对新型弹头/非天然氨基酸/变构位点的泛化能力；无头对头基准测试（如vs. CovDock、CovalentDock、iDOCK等），也未在真实药物发现项目中验证下游成功率提升。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将已有方法（AutoDock4、CHARMM参数化、MD初始化）封装为易用流程，但未推动共价对接的底层建模能力或预测精度边界。

papers.title: EA-Nav: Learning Safe Visual Navigation Policies with Embodiment Awareness
papers.abstract: Cross-embodiment navigation is a key challenge in embodied intelligence. Due to differences in embodiment, the same visual observation may imply different actions for different agents, making prediction ambiguous when relying solely on vision. Existing studies mainly rely on reinforcement learning, which requires large-scale interaction and careful reward design, making it difficult to support scalable pretraining and real-world adaptation. In contrast, imitation-learning-based approaches remain limited. To address these challenges, we propose an imitation-learning-based embodiment-aware navigation framework with a modular multi-stage design. In pretraining, we construct a cross-embodiment navigation dataset from Internet videos and introduce embodiment geometry as conditional tokens to reduce action ambiguity under the same observation. In fine-tuning, we design a multimodal information injection mechanism based on a decoupled architecture. Specifically, we design a trajectory augmentation strategy to generate high-risk samples, which are used to train spatial perception and risk-aware correction separately, thereby explicitly incorporating embodiment geometry for safe navigation. Experimental results show that the proposed method effectively improves navigation performance across different embodiment settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating embodiment geometry into embodied navigation.

analysis.tldr: 用互联网视频预训练一个能理解不同机器人身体结构（如轮式/腿式）如何影响视觉导航决策的模型，通过在输入中显式加入‘身体几何’条件令牌，并在微调时用轨迹增强生成高风险样本，分别训练空间感知和风险修正模块，提升跨形态机器人的安全导航泛化能力。
analysis.claim: 显式建模并注入‘embodiment geometry’作为条件信息，可有效缓解跨形态视觉导航中的动作歧义性，提升安全导航的泛化性。
analysis.input: RGB视频帧 + 机体几何参数（如关节自由度、底盘尺寸、运动学约束等抽象化条件令牌）
analysis.output: 安全导航动作序列（含避障、减速、转向等风险响应）
analysis.data_dependency: 零真实机器人数据依赖（全部来自互联网视频）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅基于互联网视频构建跨形态导航数据集并引入几何条件令牌，属合理但非首创性设计（类似思想见EmbodiedQA、VLN-BERT、RoboCLIP等早期工作）；无真实机器人验证、无消融证明几何令牌的必要性、无基线对比（尤其未与RT-1/RT-2/VLN Transformer等主流范式比较）、未开源代码或数据；‘安全’仅靠轨迹增强模拟，缺乏真实风险定义与量化评估。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装——提出‘embodiment awareness’术语并用几何令牌形式化，但无实证支撑其不可替代性，也未触及具身智能中运动学-感知耦合的核心难点，更像对已有模仿学习框架的轻量改装。

papers.title: Advanced EEG Source Models from the Perspective of FEM and Inverse Solutions
papers.abstract: In this study, we compare forward solutions computed with finite element methods in Zeffiro Interface and DUNEuro, using the different source models they provided. We compared two of the source models from DUNEuro, called Whitney basis and Local subtraction, and the divergence-conforming model of Zeffiro Interface. For source estimation, we applied sparsity-promoting standardized hierarchical adaptive L1 regression (SHAL1R), standardized Kalman filtering (SKF), classical sLORETA, and dipole scanning. Analyses include Earth Mover's Distance, depth bias scatter plots, and qualitative assessments of amplitude distribution and focality. Preliminary experiments with source interpolation for each method revealed that Local subtraction closely matches expectations for the local behavior of the lead field at various depths. The main results reveal that the success of an inverse method depends strongly on the compatibility between its assumptions about the focality of the source and the chosen source model, with point-source models performing best when paired with methods designed for such sources, i.e., sparsity-promoting methods and methods that scan for a single source. Moreover, source models that admit patch sources with a wide distribution are more sensitive to additional noise.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文比较了三种EEG源模型（Whitney基、局部减法、散度一致模型）在有限元前向计算中的表现，并测试了四种逆解方法（SHAL1R、SKF、sLORETA、偶极子扫描）对不同源模型的适配性，发现逆解效果高度依赖源模型与逆解假设的匹配程度，例如稀疏性方法需搭配点源模型。
analysis.claim: EEG逆问题的求解精度不取决于单一‘最优’源模型或逆解方法，而取决于源模型的数学特性（如是否支持点源/扩展源）与逆解方法先验假设（如稀疏性、局域性）之间的结构性兼容性。
analysis.input: 有限元网格+电导率分布+电极位置+EEG测量信号
analysis.output: 源空间激活估计（脑内电流密度分布）
analysis.data_dependency: 无真实神经数据依赖，全部基于仿真（有限元前向建模+合成源）
analysis.significance_reason: 属方法学验证型工作：仅在仿真环境下对比已有源模型与逆解组合，未引入新模型/新算法/新数据/新硬件，未解决临床或BCI落地中的任何实际瓶颈（如个体差异、噪声鲁棒性、实时性、跨被试泛化），也未提升解码性能指标（如通信速率、分类准确率），更未触及脑机接口核心范式突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——是EEG正逆问题领域内一次严谨但封闭的仿真对照实验，未提供可迁移的新工具、新结论或新性能边界，对当前高优先级BCI应用（如瘫痪者实时通信/运动控制）无直接推进。

papers.title: Method for modeling oviduct function and impact on embryonic development
papers.abstract: Direct experimental analysis of the mammalian oviduct is constrained by limited tissue access and the short lifespan of ex vivo preparations. Extracellular matrix-embedded three-dimensional epithelial organoids provide longer-term in vitro models. However, their inward-facing apical surface and the absence of supporting stromal cells limit physiological studies of the oviduct, including ciliary activity and maternal-embryonic interactions. Here, we provide a step-wise protocol detailing the generation of mouse and human oviductal assembloids in which epithelial cells form an outward-facing (apical-out) layer around a stromal core. Epithelial and stromal cells from adult mouse oviducts or human Fallopian tubes are isolated, expanded separately, and subsequently aggregated in a rotational culture system. The protocol also outlines morphological and immunostaining criteria for confirming cellular organization, whole-mount detection of external cilia, measurement of ciliary beat frequency, and co-culture of mouse assembloids with preimplantation embryos. Mouse and human assembloids retained epithelial and stromal identity and displayed cilia at the accessible outer surface. In a proof-of-concept experiment, embryos co-cultured with the assembloids developed to blastocysts at a rate similar to that of in vivo-derived blastocysts. This reductionist system provides a straightforward and tractable model to investigate oviduct physiology and embryo-maternal communication while allowing direct manipulation and observation of the epithelial interface.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文构建了一种新型的‘输卵管类器官组装体’（assembloid），让上皮细胞朝外生长、暴露可观察的纤毛，并加入基质细胞，从而支持胚胎共培养和实时研究母-胚互作，解决了传统类器官无法模拟输卵管生理界面的问题。
analysis.claim: 通过构建apical-out型输卵管上皮-基质组装体，首次实现了在体外长期、可操作、可观察地模拟输卵管上皮-胚胎互作的关键生理功能。
analysis.input: 小鼠或人输卵管上皮与基质细胞分离扩增后，在旋转培养系统中自组装
analysis.output: 具有外露纤毛、保留细胞身份、支持胚胎发育至囊胚期的三维输卵管类器官组装体
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量发育生物学工具创新：解决了输卵管类器官长期存在的apical面不可及、缺基质、难共培养三大瓶颈，实证了胚胎发育支持能力，但仅限小鼠+初步人源验证，未涉及高通量筛选、多组学表征或临床干预，影响力局限于生殖发育机制研究子领域，远未达AlphaFold2/ESM/RFDiffusion等跨学科范式级突破量级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：是生殖生物学中一个设计精巧、实证充分的体外模型升级，但非跨领域突破，暂不改变AI×生物主流技术路线

papers.title: Trained phages constrain evolutionary routes to antibiotic resistance in Escherichia coli
papers.abstract: Bacteriophages are major drivers of bacterial evolution and can impose strong selection on traits that mediate resistance and fitness. This creates the possibility of using phage to steer microbial adaptation toward predictable phenotypic outcomes. Yet bacterial populations often evolve phage resistance through diverse genetic routes, not all of which impose meaningful costs or trade-offs. Such evolutionary flexibility can allow bacteria to escape phage selection without acquiring the desired phenotype, limiting the reliability of phage-based evolutionary steering. Here, we develop a directed phage evolution strategy that eliminates cost-free resistance pathways, forcing bacteria into evolutionary trajectories that restore antibiotic susceptibility. We isolated two novel Microviridae phages (BLS2 and BLS5) that infect E. coli BL21 and found that bacteria evolved resistance through two distinct mechanisms: mutations in lipopolysaccharide (LPS) biosynthesis genes, which carried substantial fitness costs and conferred sensitivity to erythromycin, and loss-of-function mutations in yajC, which imposed no fitness penalty and maintained full antibiotic resistance. We show that YajC is a previously uncharacterised accessory receptor required for phage genome translocation across the inner membrane. We then used this mechanistic understanding to design a phage training regime that evolved phages capable of infecting yajC mutants, thereby closing this cost-free escape route. Bacteria challenged with trained phages were constrained to evolve LPS-based resistance, and were consequently resensitised to erythromycin. Our results demonstrate that directed phage evolution can reshape the fitness landscape of bacterial resistance, channelling adaptation along trajectories that carry predictable phenotypic costs – with broad implications for phage-mediated manipulation of microbial populations.

analysis.tldr: 研究人员通过定向进化噬菌体，堵住大肠杆菌逃避噬菌体选择时的低成本耐药路径（yajC突变），迫使其只能走高代价的LPS突变路径，从而恢复对红霉素的敏感性，实现了对细菌进化方向的可控引导。
analysis.claim: 定向进化的噬菌体可通过关闭低成本耐药逃逸路径，强制细菌沿携带可预测表型代价（如抗生素再敏感）的进化轨迹演化。
analysis.input: 大肠杆菌BL21菌株 + 两种新分离Microviridae噬菌体（BLS2/BLS5） + 抗生素（红霉素）
analysis.output: 细菌进化路径的选择（LPS突变 vs yajC突变）及对应的抗生素敏感性表型
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实：发现新受体yajC、构建双路径进化对比、设计并验证噬菌体训练闭环、在真实细菌种群中实现表型重定向；但仅限单一菌株（BL21）、单一抗生素（红霉素）、两类噬菌体，未扩展至临床菌株或多重耐药背景，也未验证体内有效性，属显著但非范式级贡献。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献——真突破（机制发现+闭环干预）但范围窄，尚未跨出模式菌株和单药场景，暂未达临床转化门槛

papers.title: Comparative genomics of abiotic stress response in Norway spruce and Scots pine
papers.abstract: Abstract Norway spruce ( Picea abies ) and Scots pine ( Pinus sylvestris ) are dominant boreal forest species with globally important contributions to carbon capture and storage and sustain an extensive forestry industry. Both species have adapted to cold and episodic drought, yet each occupies a distinct ecological niche. How conserved their stress responses are, which features are lineage-specific, and how far mechanisms known from herbaceous angiosperms apply, remain open questions of importance in the face of ongoing climate change. We profiled roots and needles of both species under drought and cold, combining differential expression with an orthology-aware comparative co-expression framework that places each gene on a conservation–divergence gradient. Differential expression was largely organ- and stress-specific, yet cross-species overlap at the orthogroup level was extensive and increased with stress intensity. Comparative co-expression recovered a further conserved regulatory backbone that per-timepoint differential expression did not resolve, enriched for abscisic-acid-centred signalling, oxidative and osmotic-stress responses and growth suppression, and containing canonical stress response transcription-factor families including NAC, WRKY and bZIP/ABF. The breadth of co-expression conservation for a gene was coupled to purifying selection on its coding sequence and to network connectivity. Additionally, segmental duplicates shared between the species were enriched among conserved drought circuits, whereas lineage-specific duplicates were enriched among genes lacking conserved co-expression. Regulatory conservation and genome architecture thus describe a single conservation–divergence axis, providing an evolution-anchored criterion that helps separate candidate core regulators (which are conserved, network-central and constrained) from reactive change that differential expression alone cannot resolve. Significance statement Cold and drought are recurring threats to boreal forests, yet how conifers coordinate their responses, and how much of that response is evolutionarily conserved, has been difficult to establish. Comparing Norway spruce and Scots pine, two species separated by a deep evolutionary divergence, we show that the genes whose co-expression is most broadly conserved between the species are also those under the strongest purifying selection on their protein-coding sequences. As these two species diverged so long ago, this conserved regulatory core stands out as an evolutionary signal that simple comparisons of differentially expressed genes fail to capture. The approach provides an evolution-anchored way to distinguish genes central to the stress response from lineage-specific or reactive change.

analysis.tldr: 通过比较挪威云杉和苏格兰松在干旱与低温胁迫下的根和针叶基因表达，结合正交群-aware共表达分析与进化约束（纯化选择）证据，识别出一个跨物种保守的、以ABA信号和NAC/WRKY/bZIP转录因子为核心的胁迫响应调控主干，并证明该主干基因兼具强序列约束、高网络连通性与重复基因类型特异性分布。
analysis.claim: 在深度分化的裸子植物中，胁迫响应的调控核心并非由差异表达基因直接揭示，而是需通过正交群水平的共表达保守性与编码序列纯化选择强度耦合分析才能可靠识别。
analysis.input: 挪威云杉和苏格兰松在干旱/冷胁迫下的根与针叶RNA-seq数据（含对照）
analysis.output: 按正交群划分的保守/分歧共表达模块、每个基因的保守性梯度评分、与纯化选择强度及网络中心性的关联图谱
analysis.data_dependency: 无机器人数据依赖
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了裸子植物胁迫响应研究首个基于正交群-共表达-进化约束三重锚定的分析框架，实证扎实（双物种×双器官×双胁迫×多时间点），发现可解释性强且具进化机制支撑；但未构建预测模型或生成工具，未开源代码/模型，未拓展至功能验证，故未达基石级（如AlphaFold2/ESM系列）的范式颠覆或通用能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将比较转录组、共表达网络与分子进化分析深度耦合，方法论整合严谨，但缺乏可复用计算模型或实验验证闭环，属于高质量系统生物学整合工作而非算法或范式突破。

papers.title: nf_xpatial: A Reproducible Framework for Standardized Preprocessing and Clustering of Xenium Data
papers.abstract: Recent advances in spatial transcriptomics have enabled the profiling of increasingly larger numbers of genes while retaining single-cell and subcellular resolution in situ. However, standardized bioinformatics workflows for analyzing these datasets have lagged behind, with existing pipelines focusing primarily on image processing and cell segmentation. To address this gap, we present nf_xpatial, a best-practices Nextflow pipeline for the downstream analysis of 10x Genomics Xenium data. The pipeline performs quality control, filtering, log and cell area normalization, multi-sample integration, and both expression-driven and spatially informed clustering across systematic parameter sweeps, allowing users to evaluate and compare clustering resolutions and spatial modeling parameters within a single reproducible run. Overall, nf_xpatial streamlines the processing of Xenium data from platform outputs to integrated single-cell and spatial clustering datasets, providing a standardized starting point from which biologists can fine-tune parameters and proceed to hypothesis-driven spatial analyses.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了一个叫nf_xpatial的Nextflow流程，专门用来标准化处理10x Xenium空间转录组数据，包括质控、归一化、多样本整合和多种参数组合下的表达/空间联合聚类，目标是解决该领域缺乏可复现、系统化下游分析流程的问题。
analysis.claim: nf_xpatial提供了首个面向Xenium平台、支持系统性参数扫描与空间-表达双模态聚类的可复现、标准化Nextflow分析框架。
analysis.input: 原始10x Xenium输出文件（含基因表达矩阵、坐标、细胞轮廓等）
analysis.output: 标准化后的表达矩阵、多分辨率聚类标签（含空间约束聚类结果）、参数扫描报告
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅依赖公开或用户提供的Xenium数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具链建设，但未提出新算法/模型/生物学发现；仅封装已有方法（如Seurat、SpatialDE风格聚类），无跨平台泛化（仅限Xenium），无新基准验证，未在独立生物问题上展示机制性洞见；显著优于纯文档式流程（如早期STARsolo指南），但远未达基石级——既非首次定义范式（如SpaceRanger早于它），也未解决长期开放难题（如空间去卷积、跨模态对齐）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：将现有生物信息学方法封装为可复现Nextflow流程，提升了Xenium数据分析的规范性，但未带来算法、生物学或范式层面的实质性突破。

papers.title: Rethinking Language's Role in Efficient VLA for Autonomous Vehicles: Toward Smarter, Trustworthy Driving
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are reshaping autonomous driving (AD) by unifying perception, reasoning, and control through language, enabling semantic grounding, interpretable decisions, and better long-tail generalization. But language is expensive onboard: latency and memory budgets are tight, and autoregressive decoding is inherently sequential. This work reframes the central question as when and where language should act at inference, since inference cost recurs at every deployed frame while training cost is paid once. We introduce the Language Residue taxonomy to organize methods by their inference-time use of language: train-time-only supervision (L1), latent non-textual reasoning (L2), conditional invocation (L3), and full per-frame generation (L4). We review representative methods and tag each across five deployment axes (latency, parameters, memory, FLOPs, tokens), analyzing them on major open- and closed-loop driving benchmarks (e.g., nuScenes, NAVSIM, Bench2Drive). We further trace how efficient methods from NLP/LLM are adapted in AD, identifying the constraints and motivations driving these adaptations. A continuously updated repository will be available at Github.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文没做新模型或实验，而是系统梳理了自动驾驶中视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型里语言模块在推理阶段的四种使用方式（L1–L4），按延迟、显存、FLOPs等五维指标对现有方法做归类分析，并指出语言不是越用越多越好，而应按部署约束精巧调度。
analysis.claim: 语言在VLA模型中的价值不在于全程参与推理，而在于根据车载部署约束（如延迟、内存）选择性、分层化地启用——这是提升自动驾驶VLA实际可用性的关键设计维度。
analysis.input: 已有的VLA模型架构与部署指标数据（nuScenes/NAVSIM/Bench2Drive等基准上的性能与开销）
analysis.output: 语言使用策略的分类法（Language Residue taxonomy：L1–L4）、五维开销标签、适配动因分析
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实车端数据，完全基于公开仿真/离线基准报告结果
analysis.significance_reason: 纯综述性分析，无新模型、无实证验证、无消融、无代码/模型开源（仅承诺未来建repo），未提出可复现的设计原则或量化优化方法；所有结论均基于他人已发表结果的二手归纳，且未挑战或修正任何既有基准结论。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——属于领域内技术现状的整理笔记，非研究进展，不具备方法论创新或实证支撑，对算法研发者无直接指导价值。

papers.title: BioIMA: a one-click desktop tool for standardized extraction of phenotypic traits from biological images
papers.abstract: Standardized extraction of quantitative phenotypes from images is increasingly important across plant biology, from ecological and evolutionary studies to genetics, breeding, and functional genomics. However, as large image datasets are increasingly used for trait analysis, many biologically relevant traits, including size, shape, color, and spatial patterning, are still measured manually or using fragmented semi-automated workflows. These limitations reduce throughput, reproducibility, and accessibility, especially for researchers without computational expertise. Here, we present BioIMA, an open-source desktop tool for rapid and standardized phenotyping from biological images. BioIMA integrates foundation model-based segmentation with automated trait computation, allowing users to extract quantitative measurements from images through an intuitive graphical interface and without model training. To validate its performance, we quantified a set of knot morphological traits in two Populus species, as these measurements are typically time-consuming to perform manually. Automatic measurements showed strong agreement with manual ImageJ-based measurements (R2 > 0.95), while reducing per-image processing time by approximately 75% (from ~15 s to ~4 s). BioIMA was further applied to diverse plant datasets, including Helianthus and Rhododendron images with varying morphologies and background conditions. Although developed for plant phenotyping, BioIMA may also be extended to other biological samples where region-based size, shape, or color traits are of interest. By combining accessibility and standardization in a lightweight local application, BioIMA provides a practical community resource for image-based phenotyping in ecological and evolutionary studies.

analysis.tldr: 开发了一个叫BioIMA的免训练、一键式桌面软件，用预训练基础模型自动分割生物图像并计算形态/颜色等表型性状，大幅提速且结果与人工测量高度一致（R²>0.95），主要验证于杨树结节，也试用于向日葵和杜鹃等植物。
analysis.claim: 无需编程或模型训练，仅通过图形界面即可在本地完成标准化、高通量、高复现性的生物图像表型性状提取。
analysis.input: 单张生物显微/宏观图像（如杨树茎切片、向日葵叶片）
analysis.output: 定量表型指标（如面积、周长、长宽比、颜色均值、空间分布熵等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量工具型工作：开源、实测多物种、有严谨人工对比（R²>0.95）和效率提升（75%），但未提出新模型架构、未解决底层科学难题（如跨模态对齐、小样本泛化、三维重建），也未进入基因型-表型关联建模等下游闭环，定位为成熟技术（foundation model + GUI封装）的领域适配落地，显著优于普通脚本工具，但远未达AlphaFold2级科学范式突破或ESM级通用基础模型层级。

papers.title: Mallea: Building, Steering, and Memorizing Worlds with Coding Agent
papers.abstract: Code world models represent world dynamics through explicit state and executable rules. We investigate how to coordinate object representations, behavioral revisions, and visual memory within this formulation. We present Mallea, a system for building, steering, and memorizing worlds from text. A coding agent infers object interaction requirements from the prompt and jointly plans object structure, properties, and rules, favoring compact representations that support those requirements. The world evolves under the planned rules; optional user actions steer it, while text requests can edit properties or extend capabilities with unaffected state preserved. Object texture memory retains reusable appearance only for whitebox-defined objects and adapts it as those objects change. The program advances world state, while a generative renderer combines current structure with remembered appearance. By organizing construction, intervention, and memory around the same objects, Mallea conditions subsequent observations on the latest state and compatible appearance. Project page: https://lxycopper.github.io/Mallea.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Mallea系统，用一个编程智能体从文本描述中自动生成可执行的‘代码世界模型’——即带状态、可运行规则、可编辑对象结构与属性、并记忆物体外观的程序化仿真环境，支持用户干预和渐进式扩展，但全程未在真实物理世界或机器人上部署，也未验证其对下游控制任务的实际效用。
analysis.claim: 通过将世界建模统一为可编程、可编辑、可记忆的代码化对象系统，能实现构建、交互引导与外观记忆的一致性联合建模，从而支持更可控、可演化的世界模拟。
analysis.input: 自然语言文本描述（含指令、编辑请求、场景设定）
analysis.output: 可执行Python程序（定义对象状态、规则、渲染接口）+ 渲染图像序列
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘代码即世界模型’的新视角，但无定量评估、无基线对比、无下游任务验证（如规划/控制/泛化测试），未证明其相比传统神经世界模型（如DreamerV3/Genie）在预测精度、长期一致性或控制性能上的优势；项目页仅展示定性demo，无代码、无数据、无消融，属强概念导向的原型探索。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了有启发性的代码化世界建模范式，但缺乏实证支撑、量化验证和可复现实现，尚未构成对现有世界模型范式的实质性推进。

papers.title: The Drosophila melanogaster Genetic Reference Panel, Version 3 (DGRP3)
papers.abstract: Drosophila melanogaster is a leading animal model for understanding basic genetic principles for biomedical research and for quantitative, population and evolutionary genetics and genomics. The D. melanogaster Genetic Reference Panel (DGRP) of ~200 inbred strains with full genome sequences is a publicly available resource for genome wide association (GWA) studies of quantitative traits, systems genetics, and population genomic analyses. However, the small size of the DGRP limits the power to map rare variants or variants with small effect sizes. Here, we describe the DGRP Version 3 (DGRP3), consisting of full genome sequences from 1,233 inbred lines, of which 1,037 are currently extant. The DGRP3 harbors extensive genetic diversity, with 8,760,339 molecular polymorphisms including single nucleotide polymorphisms, insertions, deletions, inversions, tandem duplications and complex rearrangements. We identified 80,894 damaging variants and 4,550 genes with at least one loss-of-function haplotype. We inferred 16 mitochondrial haplotype groups, determined the microbial composition, and quantified the numbers of sensory bristles for the DGRP3 lines. We performed GWA analyses for inbreeding depression, host control of microbiome composition, and numbers of sensory bristles, identifying novel candidate variants and genes for each. The accompanying online tool (flydgrp.org) implements state-of-the-art association mapping methods and provides results for users DGRP3 data.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发布了果蝇遗传参考面板第三版（DGRP3），包含1233个近交系的全基因组序列和大量表型数据，是一个供群体遗传学和全基因组关联分析使用的公共资源库。
analysis.claim: DGRP3显著扩大了果蝇遗传参考面板的规模与变异覆盖度，支持对罕见变异、小效应位点及复杂性状（如微生物组调控、感觉刚毛数）的高统计效力关联分析。
analysis.input: 果蝇近交系的全基因组序列、线粒体单倍型、微生物组组成、感觉刚毛数量等多模态表型数据
analysis.output: 全基因组关联分析结果（候选SNP/基因）、损伤性变异注释、功能缺失单倍型基因列表、在线查询工具接口
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属于高质量生物资源数据库升级（从200→1233株），提升了GWA统计效力并拓展了表型维度，但未提出新算法/模型/范式，也不涉及具身智能/机器人领域核心问题；其价值限于果蝇遗传学社区，与AlphaFold2等计算生物学里程碑完全不在同一量级，甚至弱于ESM-2/ProteinMPNN等方法学工作。

papers.title: Task-Relevant Representation Decoupling for Visual Reinforcement Learning Generalization
papers.abstract: Visual Reinforcement Learning (VRL) has achieved considerable success in solving control tasks. However, generalizing learned policies to new environments remains a major challenge, as agents often overfit to task-irrelevant features in the training environment. To solve this problem, we introduce the concept of decoupling observations into task-relevant and task-irrelevant representations. Building on this idea, we propose a self-supervised Task-Relevant Representation Decoupling (T2RD) algorithm for VRL. This algorithm consists of three components: task-relevant representation consistency, cross-reconstruction, and cross-dynamic prediction. The first two components achieve the decoupling of content and style features, but the resulting content representations are not necessarily task-relevant. To further refine task-relevant features from content representations, we design the third component that introduces dynamic prediction. T2RD achieves State-Of-The-Art (SOTA) generalization performance and sample efficiency in the DeepMind Control Suite and Robotic Manipulation tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种叫T2RD的自监督方法，试图把视觉输入里和任务有关的特征（比如物体位置、姿态）和无关的特征（比如背景颜色、光照）分开，从而让视觉强化学习策略在新环境中泛化得更好。
analysis.claim: 通过解耦视觉表征为任务相关与任务无关成分，并引入动态预测机制精炼任务相关表征，可显著提升视觉强化学习在未见环境中的泛化能力与样本效率。
analysis.input: RGB图像观测序列
analysis.output: 任务相关的紧凑表征（用于下游策略训练）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真环境（DMC、Robotic Manipulation）生成的合成数据
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有合理动机（解耦任务相关/无关特征），但在DMC和仿真机械臂任务上仅报告SOTA性能，无消融实验细节、无跨机体/跨用户验证、无真实硬件测试、无开源代码或模型，且未挑战更难的泛化基准（如X-Embodiment的跨平台迁移），实质推进有限，属窄域仿真内调优。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：纯仿真、无开源、无消融、无真实世界验证，仅在标准benchmark上宣称SOTA，缺乏可信实证支撑，无法判断是否真突破

papers.title: DBNN: Neural Spike Classification Using a Deep Binarized Neural Network
papers.abstract: Implantable brain-computer interfaces require on-node spike sorting to reduce telemetry bandwidth and power while maintaining reliable neural decoding. This paper presents a hardware-oriented deep binarized neural network (DBNN) spike-sorting system with two binarized hidden layers with 256 neurons and a fixed-point output layer to enable multiplier-free inference dominated by sign-controlled accumulation and bit-wise logic. The proposed classifier operates on compact 16-sample spike waveforms to reduce the implementation cost (16-256-256-3) and achieves a median classification accuracy of 98.7% on both synthetic and in-vivo datasets. An FPGA prototype on a Cyclone V device operates at 50 MHz and requires 528 cycles per spike, corresponding to a 0.01 ms compute latency, while consuming 828 ALMs and 1023 registers with zero DSP blocks. For ASIC feasibility, the DBNN is implemented using FreePDK45-based flow; synthesis in Synopsys Design Compiler indicates an estimated silicon area of 0.014 mm2 and an operating power of 122 nW at 20 kHz under a 1.1 V supply. These results demonstrate that the proposed DBNN spike sorter offers a favorable trade-off between accuracy and implementation cost, supporting low-power, implantable neural interfaces. Overall, the proposed DBNN spike sorter achieves high accuracy (98.7%) with extremely low hardware cost (0.014 mm2, 122 nW at 20 kHz) and multiplier-free operation, making it suitable for low-power, implantable neural interfaces. This paper introduces the first DBNN designed for real-time neural spike sorting, striking an excellent balance between input data size and network complexity.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一个二值化深度神经网络（DBNN）用于实时神经脉冲分类，输入是16个采样点的波形片段，输出是神经元类别，在合成和活体数据上达到98.7%准确率，硬件实现极低功耗（122nW）、极小面积（0.014mm²）、无需乘法器，专为植入式脑机接口边缘端部署优化。
analysis.claim: 首个面向实时神经脉冲分类的深度二值化神经网络（DBNN），在保持98.7%高精度的同时，实现完全乘法器-free、超低功耗（122 nW）、超小硅面积（0.014 mm²）的硬件可部署方案。
analysis.input: 16采样点的单通道神经脉冲波形片段
analysis.output: 神经元类别标签（3类）
analysis.data_dependency: 使用了合成数据集和in-vivo活体电生理数据（但未说明是否来自公开标准数据集，也未披露采集条件/动物种属/电极类型等关键元信息）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽首次将DBNN应用于 spike sorting 并达成高精度+超低功耗硬件指标，但未开源模型/代码/数据，未与主流方法（如Klusta、WaveClus、DeepSort、SpikeInterface基准）做公平对比，未报告跨电极/跨动物/跨session泛化能力，且硬件指标基于理想化ASIC流程估算（FreePDK45+Synopsys DC），缺乏流片验证或FPGA实测功耗/噪声鲁棒性/长期稳定性证据；相比基石工作（如handwriting/speech decoding类90+分），它解决的是前端信号处理子问题，非解码范式突破，属扎实但窄口径的工程优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在 spike sorting 的硬件加速方向做了有说服力的定点/二值化设计与FPGA/ASIC可行性验证，但缺乏开源、基线对比和跨场景实证，尚未构成方法论或临床级突破。

papers.title: Deformable State Estimation for Autonomous Surgical Tissue Retraction Under Partial Observability
papers.abstract: Surgical tissue retraction requires effective manipulation planning under partial and noisy perception. We study state estimation for deformable tissue retraction, where only sparse observations of the tissue surface are available at decision time. We propose a learned state estimator that reconstructs the full deformable mesh state from 40 noisy vertex observations. The estimator combines a multilayer perceptron with a low-dimensional PCA latent representation and is trained using geometry-aware regularization that encourages smooth and physically plausible deformations. We evaluate the approach in a 2D deformable sheet simulation using single-step and multi-step retraction planning. Results show that the learned estimator achieves 98.1% of oracle performance in multi-step retraction while supporting efficient inference. These results demonstrate that learned, geometry-regularized state estimation can support effective deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个学习型状态估计器，仅用40个带噪声的稀疏顶点观测，就能重建可变形组织的完整三维网格状态，用于手术中组织牵开任务，在2D仿真中实现了接近理想状态（98.1%）的多步规划性能。
analysis.claim: 几何正则化的学习型状态估计器能在稀疏、噪声、部分可观测条件下高保真重建可变形组织的完整物理状态，从而支撑有效的自主牵开规划。
analysis.input: 40个带噪声的组织表面顶点坐标（二维仿真中）
analysis.output: 完整可变形网格的顶点坐标（即隐含的连续形变场）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真生成数据，无真实机器人或手术数据
analysis.significance_reason: 问题有价值（手术中可变形组织状态估计），但工作完全停留在2D简化仿真，无真实传感器/机械臂/组织实验，无跨形变类型/跨几何拓扑泛化验证，未与任何基线方法（如卡尔曼滤波、物理模型+优化、其他学习方法）对比，仅报告oracle相对性能，缺乏消融和鲁棒性分析；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等基石工作（真机、多任务、强实证、开源、跨机体），它属于窄领域概念验证，尚未触及具身操作核心挑战。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了合理思路但缺乏实证深度和系统级验证，未脱离‘仿真玩具任务’范畴，暂不具备推动手术机器人实际落地的证据强度。

papers.title: Demonstration-Guided Humanoid Stand-Up on an Emulated Deformable Surface
papers.abstract: This paper presents a reference-guided reinforcement learning framework to generate stand-up motion for a 29-DOF Unitree G1 humanoid on deformable soft ground, using a human demonstration recorded on hard ground. The terrain compliance is modelled using solref and solimp parameters from MuJoCo's rigid body soft-contact model. The rewards consists of (i) reference motion tracking through residual joint-position control and (ii) explicit recovery objectives such as pelvis height, torso uprightness, and the final posture. First, the policy is trained with the specified rewards considering hard ground. Next, the terrain stiffness is lowered by updating solref and the nominal surface penetration zone is expanded using solimp. Subsequent training enables the policy to adapt to the delayed support force generation due to significant surface penetration during contact-intensive phases while preserving the original demonstration pattern. The learned policy successfully completes the fallen-to-standing task in simulation, reaching the targeted pelvis height and uprightness, with a maximum contact penetration of approximately 40 mm during the process. The proposed method is demonstrated on two stand-up sequences and successfully achieves the final recovery objective on both hard and soft ground. Ablation studies show that reference tracking alone is insufficient for successful stand-up, and that explicit recovery rewards are essential.

analysis.tldr: 用人在硬地上的站立示范作为参考，训练一个强化学习策略，让Unitree G1人形机器人能在模拟的软地面（可下陷40mm）上成功完成摔倒后站立任务，核心是通过调整MuJoCo接触参数模拟地面形变，并在奖励函数中同时加入动作跟踪和显式恢复目标（骨盆高度、躯干直立等）。
analysis.org: 印度理工学院坎普尔分校
analysis.claim: 仅靠人类示范动作跟踪不足以使人形机器人在显著形变的软地上完成站立，必须引入显式的物理恢复目标奖励才能实现鲁棒适应。
analysis.input: 初始倒地姿态 + 参考人类站立动作序列（关节角度轨迹）
analysis.output: 29维关节力矩控制指令序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用仿真中生成的人类示范（未说明来源，应为合成或运动捕捉预处理）
analysis.significance_reason: 问题有价值（软地形站立是具身智能难点），但方法属标准RL微调：仅修改MuJoCo接触参数+双奖励项，无新架构/新表示/新学习范式；验证仅限2个固定起始姿态的仿真序列，无跨机体/跨地形泛化，无真机实验，无开源证据；相比标尺中94+分的基石工作（如H2O、ω-0、GR00T N1等在统一表征、世界模型、零样本迁移、多模态协同上的实质性突破），本文属于窄场景、纯仿真、无开源的扎实但封闭的增量工程。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看——纯仿真小规模验证、无代码/数据、未触及泛化与部署瓶颈，对当前具身智能主流进展无实质推动。

papers.title: Unlocking Multimodal Protein Language Models at Inference Time
papers.abstract: Multimodal protein language models (pLMs) learn joint protein sequence-structure distributions, and their generation performance should also depend critically on inference-time sampling strategies. Yet prior work has focused more on model training than on how inference-time strategies behave. In this paper, we establish a three-stage investigation framework to empirically study the inference design space of multimodal pLMs across three representative pLMs and four fundamental tasks. We evaluate vanilla sampling, task-specific classifier-free guidance, and reward-guided beam search on multimodal pLMs, corresponding to controls over sampling distributions, per-step logits, and parallel trajectories. Throughout the complementary advancements centered on exploration-exploitation trade-off, we (1) reveal the suboptimality of default inference protocols and identify task-oriented sampling preferences; (2) observe substantial quantitative gains across tasks, consistently boosting the upper bound performance of multimodal pLMs without updating model parameters; (3) derive conclusions about base models that differ from prior consensus.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文系统测试了三种推理时采样策略（朴素采样、分类器自由引导、奖励引导束搜索）在三个多模态蛋白质语言模型上的表现，发现不改模型参数仅调推理方法就能显著提升生成性能，并指出不同任务偏好不同策略，推翻了部分已有共识。
analysis.claim: 多模态蛋白质语言模型的推理时采样策略设计对生成性能具有决定性影响，且存在任务特异性的最优策略，其增益可超越模型结构改进的边际收益。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列和/或结构上下文（如PDB坐标、残基距离图等）
analysis.output: 生成的蛋白质结构坐标或序列补全/突变建议
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（三模型+四任务+三策略对比+消融观察），但未开源代码/数据，未引入新模型/新数据/新任务，也未在真实湿实验验证，仅属高质量推理工程分析；相比ESM-2/ESMFold（95）、AlphaFold2（98）等基石工作，它不解决建模能力瓶颈，也不拓展生物学解释边界，属于对现有pLMs的‘使用说明书级’优化，分量相当于一篇强NeurIPS应用向论文，未达领域里程碑或范式级影响。

papers.title: MeshPriorDiT: Hierarchical Modeling for Action-Conditioned Cloth Dynamics
papers.abstract: Action-conditioned cloth dynamics prediction requires both locally plausible deformation and long-range coordination. Existing approaches largely follow two paradigms. Mesh-based GNNs capture local physical responses through material connectivity. However, their finite message-passing range limits coordination between topologically distant regions, while autoregressive rollouts tend to accumulate prediction errors. Transformer-based dynamics models capture long-range interactions through global attention, but often operate without explicit material connectivity and must learn local topological responses directly from data. We propose MeshPriorDiT, a hierarchical dynamics model that decomposes future cloth motion into a structured mesh prior and a generative residual. An action-conditioned mesh GNN first predicts multi-step vertex displacements, yielding a reference trajectory that respects material topology and grasp constraints. Conditioned on historical states, planned actions, and the mesh prior, a Residual DiT then uses conditional flow matching to jointly generate the residual motion not captured by the prior. The generated residual is further rescaled and decoded using material adjacency to coordinate corrections across neighboring vertices. We evaluate MeshPriorDiT on 15-step autoregressive rollouts across three cloth manipulation tasks. Averaged over the three tasks, MeshPriorDiT reduces average Global MSE by 43.42% relative to the GNN-Only baseline and by 75.03% relative to the DiT-DDPM baseline, while maintaining a favorable Edge-strain MSE comparable to that of GNN-Only.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种分层 Cloth 动力学预测模型 MeshPriorDiT，先用图神经网络生成符合布料拓扑和抓取约束的粗略运动轨迹（mesh prior），再用条件扩散 Transformer 生成并协调局部残差运动，显著降低多步预测误差。
analysis.claim: 通过显式解耦结构先验（基于物理连接性的 mesh GNN）与数据驱动残差（Residual DiT），可兼顾局部形变合理性与长程协调性，从而在动作驱动的布料动力学预测中实现更鲁棒、更准确的多步自回归 rollout。
analysis.input: 历史布料顶点状态 + 计划动作（如夹爪位姿变化）
analysis.output: 未来多步布料顶点位移序列（即 cloth dynamics 预测轨迹）
analysis.data_dependency: 完全依赖仿真器生成的数据（未提真实机器人采集）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法设计有清晰洞见（结构先验+残差生成），在仿真 cloth rollout 上取得明显指标提升，但仅限于单一模态（纯几何顶点预测）、无真实硬件验证、无跨布料/跨抓取器泛化实验、未开源代码/数据，且问题本身（cloth simulation prediction）属于长期存在的仿真建模子问题，远未达到基石工作所解决的‘具身闭环控制’或‘跨任务通用策略’层级。

papers.title: Constraint-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Static Shape Estimation of Co-Manipulative Continuum Robots
papers.abstract: Static shape estimation of co-manipulative continuum robots (CCRs) is challenging because the continuum arms and manipulated flexible object form a closed chain that must satisfy both static equilibrium and geometric loop-closure constraints. This paper presents a constraint-aware physics-informed neural network (PINN) for static shape estimation of a tendon-driven CCR modeled using the geometric variable strain formulation. The proposed method incorporates a projected static equilibrium residual and a configuration-level geometric residual to enforce the governing mechanics and closed-chain geometry. In simulation, the PINN is compared with a purely data-driven artificial neural network (ANN) under limited and noisy training data. With 140 samples and 50% label noise, the PINN reduces the relative configuration error, equilibrium residual, and closed-chain residual by 67.88%, 67.35%, and 88.06%, respectively. Using the full dataset, the PINN achieves 0.1597% relative configuration error with an inference time of 0.1773 ms, compared with 17.97 s for an iterative nonlinear solver. Experimental fine-tuning reduces the marker RMSE from 2.657 mm to 0.497 mm and increases R2 from -0.788 to 0.937. These results demonstrate accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient static shape estimation of closed-chain CCRs.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用物理信息神经网络（PINN）解决协作式连续体机器人抓取柔性物体时的静态形状估计问题，通过在损失函数中显式嵌入静力学平衡和几何闭环约束，显著提升了小样本、噪声数据下的估计精度和物理一致性。
analysis.claim: 引入约束感知的物理信息神经网络（PINN），能以极低计算开销、强物理一致性和高鲁棒性实现闭链式共操作连续体机器人的静态形状估计。
analysis.input: 腱驱动输入张力、末端位姿、物体接触点几何约束
analysis.output: 连续体臂+柔性物体的整体静态形变配置（即空间曲线参数化表示）
analysis.robot_dependency: tendon-driven co-manipulative continuum robot（仿真建模基于几何可变应变理论）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真生成的带噪声标签数据；实验部分仅用少量真实标记点（marker）做fine-tuning，未使用真实机器人闭环交互数据训练

papers.title: Enamel Palaeoproteomics Successfully Distinguishes between Denisovans and European Neandertals
papers.abstract: Abstract Ancient DNA (aDNA) has transformed the study of hominin relationships, but its preservation in ancient fossils is often limited. Enamel palaeoproteomics offers an alternative molecular approach for taxonomic analysis. In this study, we re-analyse published DDA mass spectrometry data 1 from the Denisovan-attributed Penghu 1 mandible (PXD054412) 2 and a Neandertal enamel specimen from Gruta de Oliveira, Portugal (PXD038154) 3 . Five AMBN peptides carrying the Valine-273 substitution (V273) were validated in the Penghu 1 enamel, three of which were independently detected in both DDA acquisitions. No V273-containing peptide signal was detected in the Neandertal dataset. Conversely, the ancestral Methionine-273 peptide REDPM[+16]AYG was detected exclusively in the Neandertal specimen. Extracted ion chromatograms, isotopic envelope confirmation, and MS2 fragmentation spectra, all support the reported peptide assignments. AMELY-specific peptides additionally support male sex assignment for both ancient individuals. Together, these results confirm the taxon-specific mutual exclusivity of AMBN V273 and M273 variants across Denisovan and Neandertal lineages, establishing AMBN M273V as a molecularly validated diagnostic marker for Denisovan identification from dental enamel. More broadly, targeted MS1 reanalysis of public proteomics datasets provides a scalable complement to ancient genomics for resolving hominin lineage identity and sex determination when DNA is not preserved.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文通过重新分析已公开的古代牙齿釉质蛋白质组质谱数据，发现AMBN蛋白第273位氨基酸（缬氨酸V vs 甲硫氨酸M）在丹尼索瓦人和欧洲尼安德特人中完全互斥，从而确立了一个不依赖古DNA、仅靠釉质蛋白即可可靠区分这两个人类近亲物种的分子标记。
analysis.claim: AMBN M273V位点是首个经多肽水平实验证实、可在古釉质中稳定检出、且在丹尼索瓦人与欧洲尼安德特人之间严格单态互斥的分子诊断标记。
analysis.input: 公开的DDA模式质谱原始数据（PXD054412和PXD038154）
analysis.output: AMBN V273/M273肽段的鉴定结果、性别判定（AMELY肽）、釉质种属归属结论

analysis.significance_reason: 首次在古蛋白层面完成跨标本、双技术重复（两次DDA采集）、多重质谱证据链（XIC+同位素包+MS2碎片）验证的种属特异性单氨基酸变异标记，填补了aDNA不可用场景下高置信度古人类分类的空白；虽未构建新模型或生成能力，但为古人类学提供了可立即落地的分子判据标准，证据强度远超同类古蛋白研究，接近领域内方法学标杆（如古DNA捕获探针设计）的严谨性，但影响范围限于人类演化细分方向，未达AlphaFold级范式变革。

papers.title: Lens species genome assemblies reveal evolutionarily fragile chromosomes associated with pericentric inversions
papers.abstract: The genus Lens is comprised of seven diploid species, including the cultivated crop Lentil, and six wild relatives often used in breeding programs for beneficial allele introgression. Lens species are proposed to exhibit considerable levels of genome structural variation both within and between species, which has implications for plant breeding and evolutionary genomics. Plant centromeres are key regions involved in chromosomal stability, where structural changes can be linked to meiotic abnormalities, resulting in inversions, translocations, and deletions of chromosomal segments. Fabeae centromeres are known to be diverse and do not fit the centromere drive model. The origins of this centromere diversity and the evolutionary trends remain unclear, but recent studies suggest that centromere structural variation plays a role in creating new sequence combinations that contribute to the unique centromere evolution patterns observed in legumes. We sequenced, assembled, and performed gene synteny analysis in the genomes of all seven Lens species using long-read sequencing technologies. We also located and characterized the centromeres in these genomes through ChIP-seq experiments to better understand their role in Lens chromosomal stability. Synteny analysis reveals that Lens genomes have undergone extensive rearrangements during evolution, with multiple translocations and inversions identified between species. Specific Lens chromosomes appear more susceptible to rearrangements over time. These same chromosomes also exhibit higher rates of rearrangement throughout Lens speciation. Fragile chromosomes are associated with the occurrence of pericentric inversions, likely disrupting stability. The diversity in satellite sequences in Lens centromeres likely results from structural changes accumulated throughout Lens evolution. These findings suggest that genome and centromere structure play significant roles in generating centromere diversity within this legume genus.

analysis.tldr: 对鹰嘴豆属全部7个物种进行长读长基因组测序组装和着丝粒定位，发现某些染色体在进化中反复发生臂间倒位，表现出结构脆弱性，且这种脆弱性与着丝粒区域卫星序列多样性积累相关。
analysis.org: 加拿大萨斯喀彻温大学

papers.title: Morphology and actuation as inductive biases in robotic hand manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic hands vary widely in anatomical fidelity and mechanical complexity, and these structural choices influence the coordination of joint motions and the difficulty of controlling the system. A unified framework is presented in which the kinematic and actuation stages are analysed separately and in composition, through the conditioning of the task Jacobian, the actuation matrix, and their product. It is applied to two hands representing opposing design philosophies, the Shadow Dexterous Hand and the Anatomically Correct, Biomechatronic Hand, along four morphological aspects: joint axis geometry, actuator-to-DOF ratio, coupling architecture, and authority distribution. All parameters are derived from the hands' canonical digital representations. Anatomical fidelity carries no uniform advantage: oblique axes improve thumb conditioning but leave the long fingers worse conditioned than the orthogonal-axis design, while the branching tendon network improves the effective control mapping at every long finger and worsens it significantly at the thumb, where actuator authority is concentrated on thumb opposition. Predictions derived from these metrics are evaluated against reinforcement learning experiments using PPO, DDPG+HER, and TQC+HER, across three different tasks.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用任务雅可比矩阵和驱动矩阵的条件数作为量化指标，系统分析了两种机械手（Shadow手和解剖学正确手）在关节轴几何、驱动-自由度比、耦合架构、执行器权限分布四个形态学维度上的差异，并用强化学习实验验证这些指标能否预测实际控制难度。
analysis.claim: 机器人手的形态学与驱动设计不是中性选择，而是强归纳偏置，其影响可通过任务雅可比与驱动矩阵的条件数严格量化，并能预测真实RL策略的学习难度与性能。
analysis.input: 手部CAD模型参数（关节轴方向、肌腱拓扑、执行器分配）、任务雅可比定义（任务空间映射）
analysis.output: 条件数指标（κ(J), κ(A), κ(JA)）、RL收敛速度/成功率预测值

analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据；所有分析基于CAD模型和仿真中的解析建模
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了有物理意义的形态学量化框架（条件数分解），但仅在两个手、三个任务、三种RL算法上做了验证，无真实硬件实验，无跨手泛化或消融对比，未开源代码/数据，无法复现或扩展；相比T-Rex/ALOHA等94+分工作，它不提供新策略、新数据、新硬件、新部署能力，仅是静态建模分析，属于窄域理论提示而非工程推进。

papers.title: Diffusion TV: Experiencing Diffusion Models through Tangible, Embodied Interaction
papers.abstract: Diffusion TV is an interactive AI art installation that offers a tangible and embodied experience of diffusion models through a modified CRT TV. By physically manipulating the TV's antenna, audiences control the clarity of AI-generated images and sounds, metaphorically enacting the denoising process that underlies diffusion-based generation. Using the tuning knob, participants switch between three channels featuring AI-generated animals from the Past (extinct species), Present (endangered species), and Future (speculative creatures), situating the interaction within a temporal and ecological narrative. Through continuous audiovisual feedback and physical interaction, Diffusion TV foregrounds the generative process over final outputs, allowing audiences to explore intermediate states as experiential material. Rather than providing explicit technical explanation, the work presents an alternative, embodied mode of explainable AI that invites exploratory engagement with and reflection on generative technologies.

analysis.tldr: 用一台改装的CRT电视作为交互界面，观众通过手动调节天线和旋钮来实时影响扩散模型生成图像和声音的清晰度与内容，把去噪过程变成可触摸、可感知的身体体验，并以‘过去-现在-未来’物种为叙事线索引导反思生成式AI与生态的关系。
analysis.claim: 具身化的物理交互（调天线/旋钮）能将扩散模型的隐式去噪过程转化为可感知、可探索的体验，从而提供一种非解释性但更直觉、更具反思性的可解释AI路径。

analysis.output: 实时变化的AI生成图像与声音（含噪声程度、物种类别）
analysis.data_dependency: none

papers.title: Structural basis of lipid-mediated self-regulation of Tissue Factor
papers.abstract: SUMMARY Tissue Factor (TF) is a tightly regulated transmembrane protein that maintains its encrypted state on the cell surface with an unknown conformation. Generation of TF conformational ensembles by the co-folding method using alphafold3 and boltz2 software revealed two mechanisms of TF self-regulation and corresponding conformational changes that were validated by Molecular Dynamics simulations. The first mechanism includes tilted and upright conformations of TF, whereas the second mechanism involves the spontaneous formation of TF oligomers, mostly dimers. The structural changes in TF responsible for both mechanisms were reversible and lipid-dependent. TF co-folding with phosphatidylserine resulted in approximately 90% of the TF extracellular domain in an upright conformation, enabling fast Factor VII (FVII) binding, while co-folding with phosphatidylcholine resulted in 60% of TF conformations tilted relative to the membrane surface and with a hidden FVII binding site. TF residues 210-219 (Linker Peptide) serve as a sensor that determines the TF conformation by interacting with the headgroups of phospholipids. TF self-association results in four types of homodimers with distinct relative orientations of extracellular domains and different accessibility of TF FVII binding sites. Approximately half of the dimers had accessible FVII binding sites, whereas in the remaining dimers, the FVII binding sites were partially or completely blocked. Co-folding of two TF sequences in the presence of cholesterol and phospholipids inhibited the dimerization and increased the number of TF monomers capable of FVII binding. These previously unknown TF conformations provide a structural basis for maintaining the encrypted and decrypted states of TF on the cell surface.

analysis.tldr: 用AlphaFold3+Boltz2共折叠模拟结合分子动力学验证，发现组织因子（TF）通过脂质依赖的构象倾斜/直立切换和可逆寡聚化两种新机制实现自我调控，揭示了其在细胞膜上‘加密’与‘解密’状态的结构基础。
analysis.claim: TF的加密/解密状态由脂质成分（磷脂酰丝氨酸/胆碱/胆固醇）直接调控，通过Linker肽段感知脂质头基，驱动可逆的单体构象切换与二聚化，从而动态控制FVII结合位点的暴露程度。
analysis.input: TF蛋白序列 + 脂质膜环境（磷脂酰丝氨酸/磷脂酰胆碱/胆固醇）
analysis.output: TF构象系综（单体倾斜/直立态、二聚体类型及FVII位点可及性状态）

papers.title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
papers.abstract: An enduring and richly elaborated dichotomy in cognitive neuroscience is that of human behavior control mechanisms, divided into habitual versus goal-directed. While existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal- directed behavior, habitual behavior has been largely overlooked, though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by studying multiple behavior control systems that jointly model goal-directed and habitual behaviors. We propose a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework which the Habitual Controller retrieves cue-triggered behaviors from personal- ized habit memory, while the Goal-directed Controller employs a context-aware world model to predict action consequences and estimate their values. The Arbiter dynamically balances the influence of both systems according to individual differ- ences and momentary internal states. To reconstruct diverse human-level behavior instructions in 3D environments, we further develop a keyframe-guided 3D mo- tion generation module. Through extensive evaluation methods, human studies, and ablations studies, experimental results demonstrate that human-likeness per- formance is significantly improved by our approach. The efficacy of our approach indicates the benefits of leveraging habitual behavior and multiple behavior con- trol system coordination for believable embodied human-like agents.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个模仿人类行为控制双系统（习惯性+目标导向）的生成式具身智能框架，用个性化习惯记忆和上下文感知世界模型分别驱动两类行为，再由仲裁器动态加权融合，并配上关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，目标是提升虚拟人/具身代理的行为拟真度。
analysis.claim: 人类级具身代理的真实性提升关键在于协同建模习惯性与目标导向双行为控制系统，而非仅优化单一目标导向策略。

analysis.output: 3D人体关键帧序列/动作轨迹

papers.title: Predicting Cognitive Tasks from Single-Channel EEG through Task-Semantic Alignment
papers.abstract: Studies of data scaling in electroencephalography (EEG) and related noninvasive recordings suggest that simple wearable devices could eventually reveal more about cognitive states. However, publicly available EEG data are difficult to combine. Different laboratories record different tasks, participants, and devices. Task-agnostic self-supervised learning can exploit such data, but representations learned only with EEG signals have not consistently produced feature representations that are directly effective for decoding the cognitive state. We therefore aimed to incorporate task information by embedding experimental instructions, stimuli and response demands in a common semantic space, and trained an EEG encoder to align signals from a single anterior--posterior differential channel with those task vectors. This framework supports zero-shot prediction without target-condition calibration and few-shot prediction using labeled samples. On a reserved ten-class evaluation, the highest observed zero-shot balanced accuracy was 30.13% (chance 10%). In a separate developmental few-shot experiment, balanced accuracy reached 34.47% using 16 labeled EEG examples per class from another participant, and 74.99% using examples from the test participant's own task recording. Our experiments suggest that training models on datasets with multiple tasks per participant appeared useful, whereas adding datasets containing only one or a few tasks sometimes reduced established performance despite broader task coverage. These exploratory results suggest that EEG datasets that repeat varied cognitive tasks and everyday activities within the same individuals across days, devices and independent studies would be particularly useful for training an EEG foundation model for predicting cognitive states.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文尝试用单通道EEG信号预测10种认知任务，方法是把任务描述（指令、刺激、反应要求）映射到语义空间，再让EEG特征与之对齐，实现零样本和少样本预测，但最高零样本准确率仅30.13%（随机水平10%），需同被试16样本/类才能达75%准确率。

papers.title: Physical AI: A Survey of Models, Learning, Systems, and Open Challenges
papers.abstract: Physical AI aims to enable intelligent systems to perceive, reason, act, and learn through interaction with the physical world. Unlike purely digital intelligence, physical agents must operate under partial observability, uncertain dynamics, embodiment constraints, and real-time requirements, while their actions continuously reshape the environment and subsequent observations. Recent advances in foundation models and robot learning have expanded the capabilities of physical agents, yet achieving reliable autonomy requires more than improvements in individual models. This survey presents a comprehensive, system-level review of Physical AI, organized around the closed-loop process of physical interaction. We examine the foundations and recent developments in task representations and memory, predictive and action-generating models, data and learning methods, embodiment and control, computing systems, evaluation, and safety. Beyond reviewing individual advances, we investigate how these components interact and collectively shape the capabilities and limitations of Physical AI systems. Building on this integrated perspective, we identify fundamental challenges in generalization, resource-efficient learning and execution, reliable state tracking, safety, recovery, and continual adaptation. We argue that advancing Physical AI requires moving beyond isolated model performance toward integrated systems capable of robust, efficient, safe, and autonomous physical interaction under changing real-world conditions.

analysis.tldr: 这是一篇综述论文，系统梳理了物理人工智能（Physical AI）的全栈构成要素——从任务表征、世界模型、学习方法、具身控制、硬件系统到评估与安全，并指出当前在泛化、状态跟踪、持续适应等系统级挑战上的根本瓶颈。
analysis.claim: Physical AI 的真正瓶颈不在单个模块（如模型或算法）的性能，而在各组件间的耦合失配与系统级鲁棒性缺失；推进需转向集成式、闭环驱动的系统工程范式。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Modeling and Control of Emergent Behaviors in Robot Swarms
papers.abstract: Robot swarms can exhibit coherent collective behaviors through local perception, limited communication and decentralized decision-making, yet modeling and controlling such emergence remains challenging when behaviors unfold over multiple phases. Here we introduce PhySwarm, a physics-informed micro--macro framework that represents multi-stage swarm emergence as physically constrained density-field evolution coupled to executable robot motion. At the macroscopic level, a multi-phase advection--diffusion--reaction model (Macro-ADR) describes phase-dependent swarm-density evolution through directed transport, diffusion-based spatial regulation and behavioral phase transitions. At the microscopic level, an equivalent deterministic motion model (Micro-EDM) realizes these mechanisms through potential-field advection, density-gradient compensation and rate- or event-gated phase switching. A neural-physics controller (NPC) maps local observations and temporal memory to bounded physical parameters, and is trained with a reinforcement learning--PINN objective that combines task rewards with macro-scale density residuals and micro-scale motion-consistency constraints. In several proof-of-concept swarm missions -- including trail-guided foraging, formation-reconfigurable navigation and role-adaptive search and rescue -- we demonstrate that PhySwarm can generate distinct multi-stage emergent behaviors within a unified physics-informed modeling framework. The learned density fields and physical parameters provide interpretable evidence of how advection, diffusion and reaction jointly regulate multi-stage swarm organization. These results establish a physics-informed route for learning, interpreting and controlling emergent behaviors in robot swarms.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个叫PhySwarm的物理信息框架，把机器人集群的多阶段涌现行为建模成密度场的物理演化过程（宏观）和单机势场运动（微观），用神经-物理控制器把传感器输入映射为可解释的物理参数，并在几个仿真任务中展示了可控、可解释的多阶段集群行为。
analysis.claim: 多阶段机器人集群的涌现行为可通过耦合宏观密度场物理演化与微观确定性运动建模，并以物理约束的神经控制器实现可解释、可控制的学习。

analysis.output: 有界物理参数（如势场强度、扩散率、相变阈值），进而生成机器人动作
