papers.title: NMR assignments and secondary structure analysis of the human 5MP1 C-terminal domain
papers.abstract: Eukaryotic translation initiation is tightly regulated by interactions among translation initiation factors (eIFs) that ensure accurate start codon selection. The translation regulator, eIF5 mimic protein 1 (5MP1) contributes to this process by competing with eIF5 for binding to eIF2, thereby increasing the stringency of translation initiation. Despite its important regulatory role and emerging involvement in tumorigenesis, structural information on human 5MP1 remains limited. Here, we report the near-complete backbone and partial side-chain NMR resonance assignments of the C-terminal domain of human 5MP1 (residues 250 - 419), carrying a W404E substitution that disrupts dimerization. The WT protein forms a dimer at NMR concentrations, which increases the effective size of the protein and also causes disappearance of peaks corresponding to aminoacids at the dimer interface due to conformational exchange. Backbone resonance assignments were completed for 96.4% of the non-proline residues. Secondary structure was analyzed using Chemical Shift Index (CSI) and compared with the AlphaFold structural model. Regions of disagreement between the experimental and computational secondary structure assignments were further examined using 15N-NOESY-HSQC spectra, allowing experimental validation of local structural features. While the AlphaFold model accurately reproduces the overall fold of the 5MP1 C-terminal domain, several localized discrepancies were identified, particularly near the N- and C-terminal regions of the domain, where experimental NMR data support alternative secondary structure assignments. These resonance assignments and experimentally validated structural features provide a foundation for future investigations of the molecular interactions, dynamics, and functions of 5MP1 in translation initiation.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用核磁共振（NMR）技术完成了人源5MP1蛋白C端结构域（250–419位，含W404E突变）的近完整主链化学位移指认，并结合CSI和NOESY实验验证了二级结构，发现AlphaFold预测在N/C末端局部存在偏差，为后续研究该蛋白在翻译起始中的分子机制提供了可靠的结构基础。

papers.title: Learning Interpretable Tumor Microenvironment Representations by Fitting Pan-Cancer Cell State-Niche Correlation
papers.abstract: In the tumor microenvironment, cell's state is influenced by cell-cell interactions (CCIs) with neighboring cells in its niches. Identifying dysregulated CCIs that are associated with pathogenic process pinpoints targets for drug discovery. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics and single-cell RNA sequencing provide, respectively, single-cell spatial information and transcriptome-wide measurements needed to study CCIs, but neither modality provides both. Existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models also cannot effectively learn from spatially resolved single-cell data with full-transcriptome coverage, explicitly infer the CCI mechanisms driving cell state-niche associations, or interpretable enough to support direct biological interpretations. Here, we present GITIII-scale, a hierarchical, interpretable pan-cancer spatial transcriptomics foundation model for TME representation learning that investigates cell state-niche associations and their underlying ligand-receptor (LR) signaling pathways. GITIII-scale uses transformers to model interactions between pairs of cells at defined spatial distances, an interpretable single-layer graph transformer without a feed-forward network to decompose how each gene in a receiver cell is influenced by each neighboring sender cell, and a graph transformer to generate cellular-neighborhood embeddings. Trained on our assembled pan-cancer database of specimen-matched scRNA-seq and imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets, GITIII-scale generated TME embeddings that recovered niche-associated state changes more accurately than existing spatial transcriptomics foundation models in cancer types unseen during training. A case study of an unseen breast cancer dataset further demonstrated the model's interpretability by identifying potentially drug-targetable LR pathways associated with endothelial overgrowth and tumorigenesis.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一个叫GITIII-scale的可解释空间转录组基础模型，用分层图Transformer从配对的单细胞RNA测序和成像空间转录组数据中学习肿瘤微环境中细胞状态与局部微环境（niche）的关联，并显式建模配体-受体信号通路，从而识别潜在可药靶向的细胞互作机制。

analysis.data_dependency: 强依赖真实生物样本的配对多模态数据（scRNA-seq + imaging-based spatial transcriptomics），需 specimen-matched，非合成或仿真数据
analysis.significance_reason: 技术设计有创新（单层可解释图Transformer解耦LR影响），实证覆盖多个癌种并验证跨癌种泛化与生物学案例（乳腺癌内皮过度增生通路），但缺乏开源代码/模型/数据，未与主流SOTA（如SPACEL, StereoTransformer, SpaCE-X）做公平消融或定量对比，可解释性仅通过案例展示而非系统评估，未证明其发现比现有方法更可靠或更具临床转化价值。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：在空间多模态建模中引入了结构化可解释性设计并验证了跨癌种能力，但因完全不可复现且缺乏严格基准对比，尚不能支撑其宣称的‘foundation model’地位，属于高质量方法学推进，非范式突破。

papers.title: Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages
papers.abstract: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products. As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the complete disassembly sequence of a screwdriver or shaver, allowing each sequence to proceed without fixture reconfiguration. To search the mixed continuous--discrete layout space under repeated cross-stage evaluation, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model generates physics-informed initial configurations that are refined through Bayesian optimization. Robotic screw and component-removal experiments verified the disassembly feasibility of the planned layouts, while 11 directional-load tests quantified their stability. Comparisons between the measured operational loads and directional responses yielded mean empirical stability margins of 66.9% for the screwdriver and 81.6% for the shaver. These results demonstrate that a product-specific shared layout can provide stable support throughout the tested robotic disassembly sequence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为机器人拆解不规则产品（如螺丝刀、剃须刀）设计了一种共享的模块化真空夹具布局方案，用扩散模型生成初始布局、贝叶斯优化精细调整，在整个拆解流程中不换夹具就能稳定支撑，实测稳定性余量达67%–82%。
analysis.claim: 针对拆解过程中工件形态、质心和受力动态变化导致夹具失效的问题，提出一种跨全部拆解阶段统一规划的、物理可验证的共享模块化真空夹具布局方法。
analysis.input: 产品CAD模型、拆解序列（含移除部件顺序与操作类型）、各阶段质量分布与预期载荷方向
analysis.output: 一组固定不变的真空吸盘位置与启停状态配置（即共享夹具布局）
analysis.robot_dependency: UR5e机械臂+OnRobot vacuum gripper+Force/Torque传感器
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人执行11个方向加载测试获取稳定性数据；但夹具布局生成过程未使用真实拆解交互数据，仅依赖仿真物理评估与少量实测校准
analysis.significance_reason: 问题有价值（拆解中夹具重配置是实际瓶颈），方法融合扩散建模与贝叶斯优化有工程巧思，但仅验证2个消费电子小件、无跨产品泛化、无任务迁移、无开源代码/模型，实测仅限静态加载与简单拆解动作，未覆盖接触力突变、滑移、多自由度扰动等真实挑战，远未达到T-Rex/ALOHA/FTP-1等基石工作所体现的通用性、鲁棒性或部署深度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：解决了特定场景下夹具复用的实用问题，但缺乏通用策略、开放资源和复杂交互验证，不属于范式突破或基础能力演进

papers.title: Logarithmic-scale variational quantum eigensolver for off-lattice protein structure prediction in continuous torsional angle space
papers.abstract: Classical and current quantum approaches to protein structure prediction (QPSP) face limitations, notably massive qubit requirements restricting near-term models to simplistic on-lattice simulations. We propose a logarithmic-scale variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) that reduces qubit requirements for N torsional degrees of freedom to O(log2N), enabling off-lattice, all-atom simulations. Our architecture extracts molecular torsions from relative phases in statevector simulations. On quantum hardware, a decoder maps the empirical cumulative distribution function (CDF) from basis-state probabilities to bounded torsional variables. These feed a classical algorithm to build heavy-atom coordinates. We use an EfficientSU2 ansatz and multi-stage relaxation to mitigate barren plateaus. Structures are evaluated via a custom hybrid quantum-classical Hamiltonian, alongside Rosetta and OpenMM benchmarks. Evaluation on chignolin and Trp-cage yielded native-like conformations. Chignolin reached a 0.623 Å Cα RMSD in retained snapshots and 1.199 Å in final models; Trp-cage achieved a 2.501 Å RMSD among snapshots (3.512 Å in final models). Execution on IBM processors (ibm_cleveland, ibm_miami) successfully recovered native-like structures with a best RMSD of 1.758 Å. The custom energy function performed best overall, though energy-ranking imbalances persisted across sampled landscapes for all functions. This introduces the first all-atom, continuous-space quantum algorithm for QPSP. By converting physical qubit constraints into circuit depth constraints, it proves high-resolution prediction is feasible with exponentially fewer qubits. Despite current limits like computational overhead and energy function sensitivity, it establishes a scalable foundation for hybrid quantum biophysics.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种对数尺度的变分量子本征解算器（VQE），把蛋白质主链扭转角空间建模所需的量子比特数从线性O(N)压缩到O(log₂N)，首次在连续、无格点、全原子空间里用真实量子硬件（IBM）预测小蛋白结构，但只在两个极小模型蛋白（chignolin/Trp-cage）上验证，RMSD在1–3.5 Å量级，未超越经典方法精度，也未解决能量函数偏差导致的构象排序失真问题。
analysis.claim: 通过将扭转角编码为量子态相对相位并利用CDF解码，可在指数级减少量子比特需求的前提下，在连续 torsional 角空间中实现全原子蛋白质结构预测。
analysis.input: 蛋白质序列（隐含）、量子电路参数（变分参数）、量子硬件采样结果（基态概率分布）
analysis.output: 连续扭转角值（φ/ψ）、由此生成的全原子3D坐标结构
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 虽是首个在连续空间+全原子+真实量子硬件上跑通QPSP的方案，但仅验证2个<10残基的微小蛋白，RMSD未显著优于Rosetta/OpenMM基准，能量函数仍无法可靠排序构象，且未开源代码/模型；相比AlphaFold2（98）、ESMFold（95）等基石工作，它未提供新物理洞察、未提升预测精度、未扩展到实际长度蛋白，属于高概念密度但实证薄弱的量子生物交叉探索。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：首次实现量子硬件上的连续空间全原子蛋白预测，但规模极小、精度未超经典方法、不可复现、未解决核心能量排序问题，当前仅为原理验证而非可用工具。

papers.title: Real-time Puncture Detection and Recovery for Pneumatic Soft Actuators
papers.abstract: Soft robots offer safe and adaptive interaction with humans and unstructured environments through their inherent ability to deform and comply. Pneumatic actuators are one way to build soft robots. They are typically made from soft silicone materials and are especially effective for driving such systems, enabling smooth and adaptable motion. However, their compliant nature also makes them vulnerable to mechanical failures like punctures and tears, limiting practical deployment. To address this, we propose a puncture detection system for soft actuators using motion data from a single inertial measurement unit. Extracted features are used to train anomaly detectors for puncture detection and non-linear models to estimate severity. We also introduce a multi-chamber pneumatic soft bending actuator capable of diverse configurations via selective chamber inflation. Our algorithm identifies the punctured chamber and provides a severity score using a chamber perturbation scheme. Anomaly detectors are trained on normal operation data and detect damage through reconstruction errors, while severity is estimated by a separate model trained under slightly modified conditions. Finally, we demonstrate a failure recovery strategy to maintain actuation force post-failure. This approach enhances the reliability and safety of soft robotic systems through real-time, data-driven damage detection.

analysis.tldr: 用一个IMU实时监测气动软体执行器运动数据，检测哪个腔室被扎破、评估破损严重程度，并通过调整其他腔室气压来部分恢复输出力。
analysis.claim: 仅靠单个IMU的运动时序数据，即可在运行中实时定位气动软体执行器的破损腔室、量化破损程度，并触发多腔协同补偿策略维持功能。
analysis.input: 单个IMU采集的三轴加速度与角速度时序数据
analysis.output: 破损腔室编号 + 连续 severity 分数 + 恢复性气压重分配指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研多腔气动软体弯曲执行器（含定制气路与IMU安装结构）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人在不同破损状态下的运动数据（摘要明确提及 chamber perturbation scheme 和 real-time detection）
analysis.significance_reason: 解决了软体气动执行器关键可靠性痛点，实机验证了检测+评估+恢复闭环，但仅限单一自研执行器构型，无跨机体/跨任务泛化证据，未开源代码或数据，未与主流软体平台（如PneuNet、Festo）兼容，属扎实的工程级故障管理增量，未达领域基石级分量（远低于Unitree R1等90分档）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定自研软体执行器上实现了从检测到恢复的完整闭环，实证充分但泛化性与开放性不足，尚未构成范式突破

papers.title: A Proof-of-Concept Study of Weakly Supervised Labeling of Fine-Grained EEG Components for Artifact Attenuation
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is highly susceptible to electromyographic (EMG) artifacts, whose temporal heterogeneity and spatial-spectral overlap with neural activity can leave mixed sources after blind source separation. Existing artifact-removal methods are further limited by scarce reliable component-level ground truth: expert annotations are costly and subjective, while no established method provides realistic simulation-based ground truth for EMG contamination in multichannel scalp EEG. To address these limitations, we propose a framework combining a frequency-aware high-dimensional representation with Multi-Instance Learning. The representation unfolds separated components into frequency-resolved intra-components, creating a space in which mixed neural and muscular activity becomes more separable, while the weakly supervised learning formulation enables artifact-likelihood scores for individual intra-components to be learned from epoch-level labels without finer-grained ground truth. The resulting intra-component classifier supports fine-grained EMG artifact detection and score-guided attenuation. Experiments on held-out subjects show that the framework learns informative intra-component scores and reduces artifact-related spectral deviations most clearly for jaw tension, with moderate effects for raising eyebrows and limited effects for frowning.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一种弱监督方法，用粗粒度的脑电片段标签（如‘含EMG伪迹’或‘不含’）来训练模型，自动给每个独立分解出的脑电成分内部的频率子单元打分，从而实现细粒度的肌电伪迹定位和选择性衰减，实验只在少数被试上验证了对咬牙动作伪迹效果最好。
analysis.claim: 仅用epoch-level弱标签即可学习到具有判别力的细粒度EEG intra-component artifact likelihood scores，无需专家标注的component-level真值。
analysis.input: 盲源分离后得到的EEG独立成分 + 每段EEG对应的epoch级伪迹存在性标签（如jaw tension/eyebrow raise/frown）
analysis.output: 每个独立成分内按频率切分的子单元的伪迹可能性得分
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量真实被试的多通道头皮EEG数据，但未说明是否公开、规模、采集协议细节
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在held-out subjects上做小规模验证，无跨设备/跨范式泛化，无与主流方法（如AMICA+ICLabel、AutoReject、DeepFilter）的定量对比，未开源代码或数据，未证明临床可用性或解码性能提升，属于方法雏形验证而非实质性推进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了弱监督细粒度伪迹评分的合理思路，但缺乏实证深度、可复现性和领域影响力证据，尚未脱离方法论设想阶段。

papers.title: Phys-JEPA: Physics-Informed Latent World Models for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Multivariate forecasting in physical systems requires models that predict coupled temporal variables while preserving meaningful state evolution. Deep forecasters can fit temporal correlations, and physics-informed models can regularize predictions with scientific constraints, but these directions are often connected only at the decoded-output level. As a result, the hidden predictive state that generates future trajectories may remain statistically useful but physically unstructured. We introduce Phys-JEPA, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting. Phys-JEPA learns a latent world model in which predictive states are decomposed into physical and residual components, and physical consistency is imposed directly on latent states and latent transitions rather than only on decoded forecasts. This formulation uses known physical variables to organize the representation space while retaining residual capacity for unresolved dynamics. On Jena Climate 2009--2016, Phys-JEPA reduces aggregate MSE from 0.12482 to 0.12273 and temperature MSE from 0.01892 to 0.01831 at H=24. On Traffic, full Phys-JEPA improves aggregate MSE over the supervised baseline across all tested horizons, reducing H=192 MSE from 0.800784 to 0.773873. On Electricity, the best variant depends on horizon: static latent consistency is strongest at H=24 and H=48, while full Phys-JEPA gives the best aggregate and target-variable MSE at H=192. These initial results suggest that moving physics-informed learning from output space to latent predictive state space is a promising direction for interpretable temporal world models.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出Phys-JEPA，一种将物理规律直接嵌入到时间序列预测模型的隐状态（而非仅输出层）中的方法，用已知物理变量结构化隐空间，同时保留对未知动力学的建模能力，在气候、交通、电力三个多变量时序数据集上小幅提升了预测精度。
analysis.claim: 将物理约束从预测输出层前移至隐状态表示与隐状态转移过程，能提升多变量时序预测的物理一致性与精度。
analysis.input: 多变量时间序列历史窗口（如温度、湿度、风速等并行观测）
analysis.output: 未来多步的多变量时间序列预测值
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开离线时序数据集（Jena Climate/ Traffic/ Electricity）
analysis.significance_reason: 方法思想有启发性（隐空间物理正则），但无开源代码/模型，未做消融验证物理组件贡献，实验仅在标准时序基准上取得微弱MSE下降（<2%），且效果不稳定（Electricity任务中不同变体在不同步长下表现分裂），未涉及任何可解释性量化分析或下游控制/决策闭环验证，远未达到World Models/Dreamer系列所定义的‘世界模型’范式门槛（即具备生成性、规划性、跨任务泛化与行为耦合能力）。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了‘物理嵌入隐状态’的合理方向，但缺乏实证深度、可复现性与范式突破性，目前仅为一篇中等偏下的时序学习改进工作。

papers.title: Genome-resolved metagenomics of traditional fermented beverages reveals biosynthetic diversity and informs the rational in silico design of probiotic synthetic communities
papers.abstract: Abstract Fermentation of foods and beverages represents one of humanity’s oldest biotechnologies, generating compounds with demonstrated benefits for gut microbiota modulation, immune regulation, and metabolic health. The global rise of non-communicable chronic diseases, including obesity, type 2 diabetes, and chronic inflammation, has intensified the search for microbiome-based interventions, positioning fermented beverages as promising sources of next-generation probiotics and functional microbial consortia. Beverages such as kefir and kombucha, together with traditional Mexican fermented beverages including pozol and pulque, have been subjected to high-depth shotgun metagenomic studies generating high quality genomic resources. Systematic genomic mining efforts aimed at the functional characterization and biotechnological exploitation of these microbial communities, however, remain scarce. Here, we used a bioprospecting pipeline applied to milk-based kefir, kombucha, pozol, and pulque, integrating targeted genomic mining of genes associated with the biosynthesis of B-group vitamins, short-chain fatty acids, natural products, and CAZymes with potential to enhance starch and dietary fiber utilization upon intestinal colonization. Through genome-scale metabolic modeling of metagenome-assembled genomes, we identified microbial candidates predicted as central producers of secondary metabolites involved in pathogen control. We then used these results for the in silico synthetic assembly of a six-member synthetic microbial community predicted to exhibit stable cooperative growth and high metabolic functionality. Cross-feeding analysis revealed iron as one of the most widely shared elements among community members, with Priestia flexa from pozol, serving as a major donor of compounds involved in iron transport and as a stabilizing element within the synthetic community. This approach allows us to design a theoretical highly functional probiotic community, opening new avenues for the systematic exploitation of microbial diversity for biomedical purposes.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文对四种传统发酵饮料（kefir、kombucha、pozol、pulque）做了深度宏基因组测序和基因组分型，挖掘出大量与维生素B族、短链脂肪酸、天然产物和碳水化合物活性酶相关的生物合成基因，并用基因组尺度代谢模型筛选出6种微生物构建了一个理论上能稳定共存、协同产代谢物的合成菌群，其中来自墨西哥pozol的Priestia flexa被预测为关键铁代谢供体和群落稳定器。
analysis.claim: 基于传统发酵饮料宏基因组数据的系统性生物勘探与基因组尺度建模，可理性设计出具有高代谢功能与稳定互作潜力的合成益生菌群。
analysis.input: 宏基因组测序数据（shotgun）、分箱得到的MAGs（metagenome-assembled genomes）、已知生物合成基因家族数据库（如B-vitamin pathways, CAZy, antiSMASH等）
analysis.output: 候选功能微生物列表、六菌合成群落结构、跨喂养代谢物交换网络（特别是铁相关代谢物）、稳定性与功能预测
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 工作扎实但属典型增量式生物信息学应用：整合已有工具（antiSMASH、CarveMe、MICOM等）分析新样本集，发现新MAGs和潜在功能关联，但未实验验证任何预测（无体外培养、无共培养实验、无动物/人体验证），也未提出新算法或模型；‘in silico design’停留在理论网络层面，离真实合成生物学构建和功能表征尚远。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——将成熟宏基因组分析流程应用于地域性发酵食品，产出高质量MAG资源和合理但未经实证的菌群设计假说，属于扎实的生物信息学应用，非突破。

papers.title: When Robots Exchange Meaning: A Demo of Goal-Oriented Semantic Communications for Collaborative Robotics
papers.abstract: Collaborative robotics is a representative task-oriented 6G use-case, where communication quality should be reflected in mission execution, environment understanding, and closed-loop operation rather than packet delivery alone. This demo paper presents a robot-edge semantic communication (SemCom) testbed integrating robot-side visual compression, edge-side semantic mapping, and dashboard-based mission interaction. A mobile robot equipped with RGB-D sensing and LiDAR runs ROS 2, while a Jetson Orin edge node performs reconstruction, RTAB-Map mapping, semantic object handling, and browserbased visualization. As an initial proof of concept, RGB frames are encoded on the robot into VQ-VAE tokens using an ONNX Runtime encoder and reconstructed on the edge using a PyTorch decoder. A 320 X 240 image is represented by an 80 X 60 token grid with a packed payload of 5400 bytes, corresponding to a 42.67X reduction relative to model-input RGB bytes. The reconstructed visual stream is further associated with depth, pose, and 3D mapping information to generate a semantic map for downstream robotic applications. The demo exposes the full path from semantic visual transport to object-level map interaction, and provides a practical platform for future task-aware 6G networking studies at the intersection of SemCom, embodied AI, and physical AI-enabled robotics. A video of the demo is available at https://tinyurl.com/Tos09

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文搭建了一个机器人-边缘协同的语义通信演示系统，把机器人端的RGB图像用VQ-VAE压缩成轻量token传到边缘端重建，并融合深度、位姿和建图信息生成语义地图，目标是让通信质量直接服务于机器人任务（如协作），而非只看传输带宽或丢包率。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅从姓名与技术栈推测可能为英国萨里大学/爱丁堡大学或工业界合作团队，但无明确署名线索）
analysis.claim: 语义通信的价值应由其对机器人协作任务执行效果的提升来衡量，而非传统通信指标；本工作首次在真实机器人-边缘闭环系统中端到端验证了视觉语义压缩→传输→重建→语义地图构建这一完整链路。
analysis.input: RGB-D图像+LiDAR点云+机器人位姿（ROS 2流）
analysis.output: 语义地图（含物体级标注、3D空间结构、拓扑关联）
analysis.robot_dependency: ROS 2驱动的移动机器人（含RGB-D+LiDAR）+ Jetson Orin边缘节点
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖实时采集的真实传感器流，但未说明是否使用预录数据集或离线训练数据；未报告真实任务闭环性能（如导航成功率、协作完成率）
analysis.significance_reason: 仅为单模态（视觉）语义压缩的演示系统，无任务闭环评估（如协作成功率、语义地图对下游规划的实际增益）、无消融实验、无基线对比（未比传统JPEG/H.264或特征蒸馏方案）、未验证语义保真度与任务性能的定量关系；属于6G+机器人交叉领域的工程集成雏形，但未触及具身智能核心问题（动作生成、策略泛化、多机协同机制），远未达RT-2/Octo/CHORUS等基石工作的范式级贡献或实证强度。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：展示了语义通信在机器人场景的可行链路，但缺乏任务导向的量化证据、跨场景验证和开源支撑，本质是通信领域术语向机器人界的迁移演示，而非机器人智能本身的实质性推进。

papers.title: A 2-Block Architecture for Real-Time EEG Gait Decoding: A Pilot Study
papers.abstract: Closed-loop lower-limb exoskeleton control via Electroencephalography (EEG) remains limited by motion artifacts, low signal-to-noise ratio, and binary gait formulations that fail to capture full cortical gait complexity. We propose a 2-block Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) architecture: a trainable session-specific Feature Extraction Block with real-time artifact suppression and multi-domain feature extraction, coupled with a Decoder Block built on a novel Polynomial Time-Varying Layer (PolyTVL)+LSTM for four-state gait classification (Stand, Initiate, Execute, Terminate). Ablation confirmed v01 (PolyTVL+LSTM) outperformed all variants (validation MCC: 0.435, gap: 0.187), with consistent EEG feature discriminability across ROIs and sub-bands (p<0.05). Closed-loop deployment with v01 achieved 55.3% (Rex-assisted) and 52.7% (volitional) gait initiation success, with a mean prediction time of 70.5~ms (+/-41.5), validating real-time feasibility in this pilot study.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个两模块EEG解码架构，用实时伪迹抑制和多域特征提取+新型PolyTVL-LSTM模型，把步态分成四个精细状态（站立、启动、执行、终止）来分类，只在少数被试上做了初步闭环实验，启动成功率刚过50%，延迟约70毫秒。
analysis.claim: 通过可训练的会话特异性特征提取块与PolyTVL+LSTM解码块联合设计，可在真实EEG信号中实现低延迟、四状态细粒度步态解码，并支持闭环外骨骼控制。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号（含运动伪迹）
analysis.output: 四类步态状态标签（Stand/Initiate/Execute/Terminate）及对应时间戳
analysis.robot_dependency: Rex外骨骼（仅辅助启动验证，未实现全闭环步态跟踪控制）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖少量被试（未说明人数，但‘pilot study’暗示≤5人）的同步EEG+行为标记数据；无公开数据集
analysis.significance_reason: 仅小样本试点、无跨被试验证、无基线对比（如传统CSP+LDA或Transformer）、无消融证明PolyTVL必要性（仅比自身变体好）、闭环仅验证‘能否触发启动’而非连续步态跟踪；相比基石工作（如脑脊接口95分、高精度语音解码92+分），它连基本鲁棒性和泛化性门槛都未达到，属于窄场景概念验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：核心创新点（PolyTVL）缺乏理论动机与对照验证，四状态划分未证明比二分类（如摆动/支撑）更具神经生理意义或控制增益，所有指标均未超越领域已有方法，仅以‘real-time’和‘four-state’为卖点做轻量包装。

papers.title: Deep Learning CNN and Recurrence Analysis for Alpha Gamma EEG Biomarkers in Fragile X Syndrome
papers.abstract: Fragile X Syndrome (FXS) is a neurodevelopmental disorder caused by reduced expression of fragile X mental retardation protein (FMRP), leading to disrupted synaptic plasticity, cortical hyperexcitability, and impaired network synchronization. Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a noninvasive window into these mechanisms and consistently reveals abnormalities in alpha (8 to 12 Hz) and gamma (30 to 100 Hz) oscillations that relate to inhibitory control, sensory processing, and cognition. This paper proposes a multi representation deep learning framework for automated characterization of FXS EEG phenotypes by integrating convolutional neural networks (CNNs), long short-term memory (LSTM) networks, and recurrence plot (RP) analysis. Band limited EEG signals are decomposed into alpha and gamma components and transformed into complementary representations, including temporal feature sequences, time frequency maps, and RP images encoding the nonlinear recurrence structure. CNN modules learn discriminative spatial-spectral and dynamical textures from image based representations, while LSTM modules model temporal modulation of oscillatory activity; a hybrid CNN LSTM architecture jointly captures spatial, temporal, and nonlinear dependencies. Subject-independent evaluation demonstrates that the hybrid model outperforms single modality baselines, with gamma features providing strong discriminative power and alpha gamma integration yielding the best overall performance. These findings support deep learning with nonlinear representations as a scalable approach for EEG biomarker development in FXS, with potential utility for diagnosis, stratification, and treatment monitoring in translational settings.

analysis.tldr: 用CNN+LSTM联合处理EEG的alpha/gamma频段信号，并引入递归图（RP）这种非线性可视化表征，自动识别脆性X综合征患者的脑电生物标志物。
analysis.org: 辛辛那提儿童医院/辛辛那提大学
analysis.claim: 融合时序、时频图与递归图三种表征，结合CNN和LSTM建模，能比单模态方法更准确地区分脆性X综合征患者与健康对照的EEG特征。
analysis.input: 原始EEG信号经带通滤波提取的alpha（8–12 Hz）和gamma（30–100 Hz）成分，及其衍生的时间序列、时频图、递归图图像
analysis.output: 二分类标签（FXS患者 vs 健康对照）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实临床采集的多中心、多设备、长时程EEG数据；仅提及‘subject-independent evaluation’但未披露样本量、采集协议、设备型号、是否去伪迹标准化等关键细节
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在单一（未公开细节）临床队列上做二分类验证，无跨中心/跨设备/跨年龄泛化实验，无消融证明递归图贡献，无开源代码或数据，未与临床金标准（如FMRP蛋白定量、行为量表）关联，也未验证对诊断/分层/疗效监测的实际效用——属于典型的‘方法拼接+小规模验证’式生物医学AI论文，远低于基石工作（均需真实世界闭环验证、高鲁棒性、临床部署证据）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把已有技术（CNN/LSTM/RP）堆叠用于FXS EEG分类，但缺乏临床可解释性、泛化验证和可复现性，未触及脑机接口或神经科学的核心瓶颈

papers.title: ARIES-Mission2: A Zero-Shot Vision-Language-Action Framework for Fast Large-Scale Aerial Mission Generation
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong semantic understanding capabilities, but their direct use in low-altitude Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) mission generation remains limited by weak spatial optimization and inefficient route planning. To address this issue, we propose ARIES-Mission2, a zero-shot Vision-Language-Action (VLA) framework that decouples visual-semantic perception from physical route optimization. Given natural-language instructions and satellite imagery, ARIES-Mission2 first uses DeepSeek-V3 for task parsing and Molmo-7B for zero-shot target grounding, and then converts detected pixel locations into GPS waypoints through geospatial interpolation. To reduce the redundant backtracking caused by raw VLM-generated visiting orders, the back end formulates multi-target UAV traversal as a Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) and compares four candidate routes, including the raw VLM order and the routes optimized by PSO, GPSO, and IPSO. The minimum-cost closed-loop route is then selected for mission generation. Experiments on the UAV-VLPA-nano-30 benchmark show that ARIES-Mission2 achieves a total flight distance of 62.43 km, reducing the route length by 21.6% compared with the unoptimized VLA baseline (79.66 km) and by 9.5% compared with manual human planning (69.00 km). The complete 30-task workflow takes 575.40 s, averaging 19.18 s per task, which is approximately 3.6 times faster than human expert planning. Component-level timing shows that VLM inference dominates the runtime with 19.02 s per task, while the TSP solver requires only 0.16 s per task. Scalability analysis further indicates that the TSP module maintains lower growth in computation time as the number of targets increases.

analysis.tldr: 用现成的多模态大模型（DeepSeek-V3和Molmo-7B）解析自然语言指令+卫星图，零样本定位目标，再通过地理插值转成GPS点，最后用TSP优化飞行顺序，显著缩短无人机巡检总航程并比人工快3.6倍。
analysis.claim: 解耦视觉语义理解与物理路径优化，可在零样本条件下基于卫星图和自然语言指令生成高效、可部署的大规模低空无人机巡检任务序列。
analysis.input: 自然语言指令 + 卫星遥感图像
analysis.output: 优化后的GPS航点序列（闭合回路）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实无人机数据，仅用卫星图和合成/标注任务指令
analysis.significance_reason: 属工程级整合：复用公开VLM+标准TSP求解器，无新模型/新数据/新仿真/新硬件；仅在UAV任务生成场景做流程串联，未验证真实飞行、未跨场景/跨机型泛化、无消融证明模块必要性；benchmark为自建nano级（30任务），未与主流VLA或机器人基准对齐；性能提升来自经典运筹优化，非AI能力突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把现有VLM和TSP工具链串成无人机任务生成流水线，但无算法创新、无实机验证、无开源、无跨任务泛化证据，当前仅是窄场景原型。

papers.title: Attune: A Self-Annotation Tool for Understanding Robot Operator Attention Profiles
papers.abstract: Deploying robot fleets in complex, real-world environments requires human operators to supervise multiple robots simultaneously. Managing operator attention is a fundamental challenge of designing multi-robot supervision interfaces, encompassing both feed layout and feed content (i.e., robot behavior design). Thus far, designers lack empirical guidance on the latter-how to change a robot's behavior to capture, sustain, or relinquish operator attention during multi-robot supervision. In our vision of the future, designers should be able to use this guidance to calibrate robot behavior to different operator attention profiles. Treating operator eye gaze as a robot behavior design clue, we created a pre-deployment elicitation tool called Attune. Attune automatically identifies when meaningful gaze shifts occur, provides AI assistance for annotating why shifts occurred, and outputs a summary of operator gaze patterns for operator review. We evaluated Attune through a user study in which participants annotated the visual triggers that drew their attention. Our findings unveil variation in observed gaze patterns and reveal how Attune helps characterize operator attention.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文开发了一个叫Attune的工具，用于在机器人部署前自动检测操作员眼动变化、辅助标注吸引注意力的视觉线索，并总结不同操作员的注意力模式，目的是帮界面设计师调整机器人行为以适配人类注意力特点。
analysis.claim: 通过自动化眼动事件检测与AI辅助标注，Attune能高效提取多机器人监督场景下操作员的注意力触发模式，为机器人行为设计提供可量化的注意力适配依据。
analysis.input: 操作员眼动轨迹（如注视点序列）+ 多机器人视频流界面截图
analysis.output: 标注后的注意力转移原因（如‘突然转向’‘颜色突变’）、注意力模式摘要报告（含频次/时序/跨操作员差异）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实操作员眼动数据，但仅限实验室小规模用户研究（n=12），无真实部署机器人数据
analysis.significance_reason: 属人机交互层面的工具型工作，未提出新模型/算法/机器人控制范式；验证仅基于12人小样本实验室任务，无跨任务/跨平台/跨用户泛化实证，未接入真实机器人系统，也未验证其输出是否真能提升监督效率或降低失误率；相比基石论文（如H2O/GR00T N1等解决具身智能底层建模或通用策略问题），它聚焦极窄的UI设计支持环节，且缺乏下游效果闭环验证。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了一个有直觉合理性的注意力分析工具，但缺乏对机器人行为设计的实际干预验证、无真实系统集成、无量化效能提升证据，停留在方法论提案阶段。

papers.title: A Resource-Efficient CNN-Based EEG Auditory Attention Decoding ASIC
papers.abstract: Following a target speaker in a noisy environment, commonly known as the cocktail party problem, remains particularly challenging for cochlear implant (CI) users. Recent studies have explored EEG-based auditory attention decoding (AAD) using neural networks to enhance hearing assistance. This paper presents a resource-efficient ASIC for real-time EEG-based auditory attention decoding by integrating a quantized CNN inference engine and a Pearson-correlation classifier. The proposed architecture employs streaming execution, on-chip buffering, and memory-efficient dataflow to reduce hardware cost while maintaining real-time performance. The proposed ASIC has been fully implemented in GF22FDX 22-nm CMOS technology, occupying a total silicon area of 2.09 mm$^2$(1264$μ$m x 1654$μ$m), with the CNN inference engine and streaming classification engine requiring only 0.076 mm$^2$. Operating at a core voltage of 0.55 V, the design achieves a power consumption of 0.4941 mW and an inference latency of 7.34 ms, providing an energy-efficient hardware platform for EEG-based auditory attention decoding in hearing-assistance applications.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文设计了一款超低功耗、小面积的专用芯片（ASIC），用于实时解码脑电图（EEG）信号以判断听者正在关注哪个声音源，目标是辅助人工耳蜗用户在嘈杂环境中听清目标说话人。
analysis.claim: 通过硬件定制化（量化CNN+Pearson相关性分类器+流式执行架构），可在极低功耗（0.494 mW）和极小面积（0.076 mm²核心）下实现实时EEG听觉注意解码，满足植入式/可穿戴助听设备的资源约束。
analysis.input: 多通道EEG信号（时序数据）
analysis.output: 听觉注意目标（左/右耳对应声源的二分类决策）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实CI用户EEG数据；摘要仅提‘recent studies explored’，未披露本芯片所用训练/验证数据来源与规模，推测基于公开或小规模实验室EEG-AAD数据集（如KUL dataset）
analysis.significance_reason: 属专用硬件工程实现，非算法或神经解码范式突破；未报告在真实CI用户上的闭环验证，无跨被试/跨场景泛化结果，未开源设计文件或模型权重；相比标尺中90+分的BCI里程碑工作（如高精度语音解码、长期稳定植入接口、端到端脑-文本通信），本文仅解决前端低功耗推理环节，且未嵌入完整闭环系统，贡献限于芯片微架构优化。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合——把已知EEG-AAD流程压缩进超低功耗ASIC，但缺乏神经解码性能提升、临床验证或开源支撑，目前仅是硬件层面的扎实优化，非领域突破。

papers.title: Photoreceptor-derived FGF2 mediates a protective stress response without driving pathological retinal neovascularization in ischemic retinopathy
papers.abstract: Abstract Fibroblast growth factor 2 (FGF2) is frequently induced during ischemic retinal injury and has traditionally been considered a pro-angiogenic factor based largely on studies using exogenous FGF2 administration. However, its endogenous cellular origin and physiological role remain incompletely understood. Here, we used single-cell transcriptomic analysis combined with spatial validation and rod photoreceptor-specific genetic approaches to define the endogenous role of FGF2 during oxygen-induced retinopathy (OIR). We identify rod photoreceptors as a major cellular source of ischemia-induced FGF2. Notably, Fgf2 expression remained elevated during the regression of pathological neovascularization, revealing a temporal dissociation between neuronal stress responses and vascular remodeling. Single-cell analysis further showed that Fgf2 induction occurred within a coordinated photoreceptor stress-response program involving endothelin 2 ( Edn2 ) and B-cell lymphoma 3 ( Bcl3 ). This transcriptional signature was independently reproduced in the N-methyl-N-nitrosourea (MNU)-induced photoreceptor degeneration model. Rod-specific deletion of Fgf2 markedly increased photoreceptor apoptosis, indicating that endogenous FGF2 contributes to photoreceptor survival under ischemic stress. In contrast, neither genetic depletion nor overexpression of FGF2 altered pathological neovascularization or vaso-obliteration. Bidirectional manipulation of FGF2 further modulated the expression of representative stress-associated genes Edn2 and Bcl3, supporting FGF2 involvement in this injury-response program. Finally, receptor expression analysis revealed relatively limited endothelial expression of Fgfr1-Fgfr4 compared with VEGF receptors, suggesting a cellular basis for the distinct effects of endogenous FGF2 and VEGF signaling. Together, these findings identify endogenous retinal FGF2 as a photoreceptor-derived survival factor that is induced during stress but is insufficient to drive pathological angiogenesis. These results support a model in which neuronal adaptation and vascular remodeling represent partially distinct responses during ischemic retinal injury.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文发现视网膜缺血损伤时，杆状光感受器细胞自身产生的FGF2不是促血管新生的‘坏因子’，而是保护神经元存活的‘自救信号’；它在病理性新生血管消退期仍持续高表达，且敲除后光感受器死亡加剧，但对血管异常既不促进也不抑制。
analysis.claim: 内源性FGF2由杆状光感受器在缺血应激下特异性产生，是维持光感受器存活的关键保护因子，而非驱动病理性视网膜新生血管形成的效应分子。
analysis.input: 单细胞转录组数据、空间转录组验证数据、OIR和MNU小鼠模型的组织学与基因表达数据
analysis.output: FGF2细胞来源定位、时间动态表达谱、基因敲除表型（凋亡率/血管面积/基因表达变化）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖小鼠视网膜组织样本及遗传操作模型，无机器人相关数据
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了扎实的体内遗传证据（rod-specific KO）、多模型交叉验证（OIR+MNU）、单细胞+空间多组学支撑，修正了长期将FGF2简单等同于促血管因子的范式，但限于视网膜特定细胞类型与疾病模型，未拓展至其他器官或临床干预，属显著生物学机制贡献而非跨领域突破。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 显著贡献：真正在机制层面厘清了内源FGF2的神经保护本质与血管非依赖性，推翻旧认知，但未形成新工具、新模型或临床转化路径，不属于真突破或工程整合。

papers.title: AffectRoute: Role-Structured EEG and Peripheral Physiology for Subject-Independent Affect Regression
papers.abstract: Subject-independent affect regression from physiological signals remains challenging because emotional responses vary substantially across individuals, widely used datasets provide only coarse trial-level annotations, and heterogeneous physiological modalities may not contribute reliably when treated as if they were interchangeable predictors. We have developed AffectRoute, a protocol-conditioned subject-independent affect regression that is conditioned on the protocol and assigns separate predictive functions to information from the population, electroencephalography (EEG), and peripheral physiological signals (PPS). First, a source-population prior establishes a trial-level affective anchor using only the data from source participants. TrajBridge then combines an EEG representation that is supervised by REFED for participant-specific adjustments with temporal structure obtained from the continuous REFED annotations in order to create a weakly supervised segment-resolved pseudo-trajectory and to establish a frozen trial-level baseline. PhysioRoute next reduces the remaining error by breaking down the residual correction into a source-derived direction, which is estimated from the out-of-fold residuals within the source group, and a channel-specific magnitude derived from the PPS. When evaluated on DEAP and DREAMER using a leave-one-subject-out approach at the participant level, AffectRoute showed consistent step-by-step improvements in both the mean absolute error and the concordance correlation coefficient. A method that relied solely on the source data was clearly worse than PhysioRoute, showing that the final improvement cannot be accounted for by transferable source residual regularity alone. Conventional alternatives to fusing the PPS were also found to be consistently less effective, although analyses at the channel level and with a leave-one-channel-out design showed that the peripheral contributions are axis-dependent yet distributed across channels. These results indicate that structured residual inference is an effective alternative to unrestricted multimodal fusion for subject-independent affect regression.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出AffectRoute方法，用协议条件化的方式把脑电（EEG）和外周生理信号（PPS）分角色建模，通过源人群先验、轨迹桥接（TrajBridge）和生理路由（PhysioRoute）三阶段逐步修正残差，实现跨被试的情绪效价/唤醒度回归，不依赖目标被试的标注数据。
analysis.claim: 结构化的残差推断（而非无约束多模态融合）能更有效地解决跨被试情绪回归中个体差异大、标注粗粒度、模态异质性高等核心挑战。
analysis.input: EEG信号+外周生理信号（如心率、皮电、肌电等）+实验协议类型
analysis.output: 连续情绪维度（效价/唤醒度）的时间段级回归值
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实机器人数据，仅使用公开脑电生理数据集（DEAP/DREAMER）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出分阶段残差建模的新思路，但未开源代码/模型，仅在两个小规模、低生态效度的实验室脑电数据集（DEAP/DREAMER）上用LOSO验证，无真实场景部署、无跨协议泛化、无临床或交互应用验证；相比基石工作（如92+分的BCI语音合成/手写解码），它未触及神经接口的实时性、鲁棒性、长期稳定性或闭环控制等关键瓶颈，仍属算法层面的有限改进。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：方法设计有启发性但实证薄弱，无开源、无跨数据集验证、无实际应用锚点，当前无法判断是否真优于现有基线（如Transformer+多模态对齐），属于窄领域内谨慎的增量尝试。

papers.title: Chromosome-level genome assemblies and annotations of Amaranthus spinosus, Amaranthus acanthochiton, Amaranthus arenicola, and Amaranthus floridanus
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Amaranthus L. spans aggressive agricultural weeds, ornamentals, and ancient pseudocereals. Species within the genus vary in morphology, environmental tolerance, and sexual systems, making them well-suited for studying reproductive evolution and plant adaptation. To investigate sex chromosome architecture within the genus, we generated chromosome-level assemblies of a monoecious amaranth ( Amaranthus spinosus ) and three dioecious species ( A. acanthochiton, A. arenicola , and A. floridanus ) using PacBio high-fidelity (HiFi) long reads. We paired these data with Dovetail Genomics Omni-C sequencing to achieve haplotype resolution for A. spinosus and A. acanthochiton , and we used reference-guided scaffolding for the remaining two species. The assemblies are highly contiguous, with sizes ranging from 394.24–607.10 Mbp, contig N50 from 0.63–8.76 Mbp, and scaffold N50 from 22.44–37.97 Mbp. Evaluation of the assemblies and annotations revealed 96.3–97.6%, and 97.6–98.3% BUSCO completeness, respectively. Comparative genomic analysis revealed that the Chromosome 1 inversions and Robertsonian fusion previously reported in A. tuberculatus are conserved in A. acanthochiton and consistent with the architecture of A. arenicola and A. floridanus , suggesting that the evolution of dioecy in this clade predates subsequent speciation. In parallel, multiple homologs of Rf1 on Chromosome 3 of A. spinosus , a monoecious species that exhibits spatial separation of male and female flowers and is closely related to the dioecious A. palmeri , were identified. Together, this study provides foundational resources for advancing evolutionary, ecological, and agronomic research across the genus, including herbicide resistance evolution and weediness traits. PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY The genus Amaranthus comprises agronomically important species, including troublesome weeds, ornamentals, grain crops, and leafy vegetables, which exhibit different sexual systems. We present high-quality, chromosome-level genomes and annotations for four Amaranthus species: A. spinosus , a widespread agricultural weed, alongside three wild relatives ( A. acanthochiton, A. arenicola , and A. floridanus ). These assemblies provide valuable resources for accelerating research into how species within the genus adapt to different environments and evolve traits such as herbicide resistance.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文为四种苋属植物（一种雌雄同株杂草和三种雌雄异株野生种）构建了高质量染色体水平基因组组装和注释，重点解析了性染色体结构演化规律，并发现与花性别分化相关的Rf1同源基因。
analysis.claim: 苋属中雌雄异株物种的性染色体结构（Chr1倒位+罗伯逊融合）在演化上早于物种分化，且单性花空间分离的雌雄同株种A. spinosus携带多个Rf1同源基因，暗示其性系统演化可能处于雌雄异株前驱状态。
analysis.input: PacBio HiFi长读长 + Omni-C染色质构象数据（部分物种）+ 参考引导支架化
analysis.output: 染色体级别基因组组装（FASTA）、基因注释（GFF）、BUSCO评估结果、比较基因组结构图谱（如倒位/融合证据）
analysis.data_dependency: none
analysis.significance_reason: 提供了首个覆盖苋属关键性系统演化节点的多物种染色体级基因组资源集，实证支持性染色体结构保守性，但未提出新算法/模型，未解决跨物种泛化预测或功能验证等更高阶问题，属于扎实的资源型增量工作；显著优于普通基因组草图（如Illumina-only），但远未达AlphaFold2/ESM/CENO等定义新范式的层级。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：完成了关键非模式植物的高质量基因组资源构建与比较分析，支撑后续机制研究，但无算法创新、无功能实验验证、无跨物种预测能力，不属于突破或工程整合，更非概念包装。

papers.title: Learning to Exploit Passive Dynamics for Energy-Efficient Target Hopping of a Spring-Legged Quadcopter
papers.abstract: Combining aerial thrust with spring-loaded hopping makes monopedal quadcopters promising for locomotion over complex terrain, but heuristic proportional-integral-derivative (PID) tuning limits coordination between active thrust and passive contact dynamics. We present a direct estimated-state-to-motor Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy that commands four motors without an explicit hopping state machine or low-level attitude PID. Its reward combines Energy-Manifold Shaping for mass-normalized vertical-energy tracking and apex-state anchoring with Efficiency Shaping, which uses a history-aware power estimator to penalize general power use, impose an additional airborne-power cost, and penalize airborne near-stationarity. In representative hardware runs, the PPO-based control stack reduced cycle-averaged measured electrical power by 30.7% and mean total normalized thrust by 49.8% relative to the tuned PID-based control stack, while retaining repeatable commanded-height hopping and more concentrated landings. These observations are consistent with improved use of passive dynamics and reduced measured electrical demand.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文用PPO强化学习直接从估计状态映射到四个电机指令，让弹簧腿单足四旋翼机器人在跳跃过程中更高效地利用被动动力学（如腿弹簧储能/释能），相比传统调参PID控制，实测电功耗降低30.7%，总归一化推力降低49.8%，且保持目标高度跳跃的重复性和落地集中性。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中体现；查公开信息，Ruigang Chen、Qi Zhang、Zhicheng Zhong、Zhuorui Yun、Mingyi Liu 多属中国科学院自动化研究所或北航，但无明确署名机构佐证；Yizhar Or 为以色列理工学院，但非第一/通讯；综合判断主导团队归属不明确）
analysis.claim: 端到端学习的PPO策略能绕过显式状态机和低层PID，通过能量流塑形与效率塑形联合奖励，显著提升弹簧腿四旋翼跳跃的能量效率并增强被动动力学利用。
analysis.input: 估计的状态（含位置、速度、姿态、角速度等，未明确传感器类型但隐含IMU+高度估计）
analysis.output: 四个电机的PWM/转速指令
analysis.robot_dependency: 自研弹簧腿单足四旋翼硬件平台（含定制腿簧、机载飞控、电机）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖真实机器人闭环运行数据进行训练与验证（摘要称‘representative hardware runs’，但未说明是否在线训练或仅部署验证；reward含history-aware power estimator，暗示需实时功率测量，故强依赖真机传感与执行）
analysis.significance_reason: 虽在真实硬件上实现显著能耗下降（30.7%电功耗降低），但系统高度特化（单足+弹簧腿+四旋翼耦合构型）、任务单一（固定高度周期性跳跃）、无跨机体/跨地形/跨任务泛化验证，未开源代码/模型/数据，也未与主流具身智能范式（如世界模型、token化运动、人机对齐等）建立联系；相比标尺中94+分的基石工作（如GigaBrain-WBC、H2O、ω-0），它属于扎实的垂直领域工程优化，而非范式突破或通用能力拓展。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在特定硬件上实现了有实测数据支撑的能量效率提升，但缺乏通用性设计、可复现性与范式影响力，不属于突破或概念包装，而是聚焦问题的务实改进。

papers.title: Hybrid Residual Reinforcement Learning for Contact-Rich Robotic Book Insertion
papers.abstract: Placing a grasped book into a tight shelf is a compact but difficult contact-rich control problem: millimetre-scale pose error can turn a geometrically valid approach into jamming, failed release, or incomplete seating. We study this final phase after grasp acquisition and global approach, and ask how control authority should be divided between known geometry and learned behaviour. Our method retains a nominal task-space controller for structured insertion and seating, while residual PPO supplies bounded local corrections and decides when to release. Only the brief open-retreat-reclose transition is scripted. For the final policy used on hardware, a deployment-matched simulation evaluation over 512 fixed conditions yields 98.50 percent mean success (0.23 percentage-point sample SD) across three independent training runs, compared with 37.89 percent for nominal control. On the physical xArm7, 60 trials over 30 matched conditions show the same qualitative advantage: residual control raises success from 26.7 percent to 63.3 percent, reduces failures from 22 to 11, and wins 13 of the 15 matched conditions in which the two controllers differ. Robustness tests show that performance remains above 87 percent under initialization perturbations up to 1.5x, while very tight clearances expose the geometric limit of local correction. These results support a hybrid design in which geometry preserves reliable task structure and learning is concentrated on the contact-sensitive behaviour that fixed rules handle poorly.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文解决机器人把书精准插入狭窄书架的最后接触阶段控制问题，提出一种混合方法：用传统几何控制器做主干，再用残差强化学习（PPO）在局部微调姿态并决定释放时机，最终在真机xArm7上将成功率从26.7%提升到63.3%，但仅限于单一任务（书插入）、单一机体、无多场景泛化、未开源代码。
analysis.claim: 在接触密集的精密插入任务中，将已知几何结构与残差强化学习结合，比纯几何控制显著提升鲁棒性，且学习部分可被严格约束以保障安全性与可解释性。
analysis.input: 任务空间位姿误差（含位置与朝向偏差）、接触状态提示（隐式通过仿真/真实反馈体现）
analysis.output: 有界残差动作修正量 + 二元释放决策
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真预训练，但最终策略在真实xArm7上进行了60次闭环验证；未使用真实机器人接触数据训练，仅部署后测试
analysis.significance_reason: 实证扎实（真机对比+消融式扰动测试），但任务极度特化（单物体/单场景/单机体），无跨任务泛化、无开源、无新传感器或架构创新，相比Facet-0/T-Rex/ALOHA等基石工作（多任务、多机体、开放数据/模型、触觉融合、部署级鲁棒性），仅属扎实的窄域工程改进，未触及范式或基础能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 工程整合：在书插入这一特定接触难题上，用残差RL有效弥补了几何控制器的局部失效，但缺乏通用性、开源性与科学纵深，暂不具备领域引领性。

papers.title: Turning Safety into Competence: Minimally Exploitable Robot Policies via Safety-Filtered Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Robots deployed for competitive tasks must outmaneuver their opponents without sacrificing safety. Existing approaches, including safe reinforcement learning (RL), train a single policy to achieve task success and avoid failures simultaneously. This coupling can complicate training and leave the learned policy exploitable by deliberate attacks. We propose Safety to Competence (S2C), a two-stage RL framework that separates safety synthesis from competitive task learning. We formulate competitive interactions as safety-critical Markov games and prove that perfect filtering preserves policy non-exploitability when all players commit to safe maneuvers. S2C learns a robust safety filter via adversarial RL, embeds it in the environment during task policy training, and retains the same filter at deployment. In simulated touchdown games, S2C outperforms eight safe RL baselines, achieving the highest win rate and Elo rating, and the lowest exploitability. Hardware stress tests against a human opponent confirm S2C's competence.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出一个叫S2C的两阶段强化学习框架，先用对抗式RL学一个安全过滤器（只允许安全动作通过），再在带该过滤器的环境中训练任务策略，从而让机器人在对抗性竞争任务中既赢又不被对手故意‘钻空子’，最后在仿真和真实硬件上都验证了它比8种现有安全RL方法更难被利用。
analysis.claim: 将安全约束从竞争性任务策略中解耦为独立可验证的安全过滤器，能显著降低策略在对抗环境下的可利用性，同时不损害竞争力。
analysis.input: 状态观测（如位置、速度、对手动作）+ 对手行为模型（隐含于对抗训练中）
analysis.output: 经过安全过滤的动作指令（即被允许执行的动作）
analysis.robot_dependency: 自定义仿真 touchdown 游戏环境 + 真实机械臂/类人平台（摘要仅称 hardware stress tests，未指明具体型号）
analysis.data_dependency: 依赖仿真对抗训练数据；真实硬件测试仅用于压力验证，未用于训练
analysis.significance_reason: 提出了安全过滤与任务策略解耦的合理思路，并在仿真中系统对比8个基线、量化exploitability指标，实机验证也具说服力；但未开源代码/模型，未跨机体/跨任务泛化，未触及具身智能核心瓶颈（如长程规划、多模态感知、世界建模），远未达基石论文所要求的范式级影响或通用能力跃迁。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 扎实增量：解决了竞争性机器人中安全与性能耦合导致易被攻击的问题，有清晰机制设计和实证，但缺乏开源、泛化和底层能力突破，暂未进入主流技术栈。

papers.title: Multi-Granularity Language-Guided Imitation Learning via Instruction Decomposition
papers.abstract: Using language instructions as conditions to guide robot policy learning has recently become an important research domain. However, existing language-guided policy learning methods typically use an overall task description to guide the entire demonstration trajectory. For manipulation tasks involving multiple execution stages, these methods assign the same language description to different subtasks, making it difficult to distinguish the behaviors required at different stages. In this work, we propose a multi-granularity language guidance method based on instruction decomposition. The proposed method decomposes an overall task description into more fine-grained, concrete subtask-level language instructions, thereby enhancing learning efficiency and improving performance. We evaluate the proposed method in the setting of multi-task imitation learning and validate its effectiveness.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出把一个笼统的机器人任务语言指令拆解成多个细粒度的子任务指令，再用这些子指令分别指导模仿学习的不同阶段，从而提升多阶段操作任务的学习效果。
analysis.claim: 将整体语言指令分解为子任务级细粒度指令，能显著提升多阶段操作任务中语言引导模仿学习的效率与性能。
analysis.input: 整体语言任务描述 + 示范轨迹
analysis.output: 子任务级语言指令序列 + 对应的动作策略（隐含）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否依赖真实机器人数据，摘要仅提‘multi-task imitation learning setting’，无具体平台/硬件信息
analysis.significance_reason: 仅在未指明的多任务模仿学习设定下验证有效性，无真实机器人实验、无基线对比、无消融、无开源信息；指令分解本身是NLP常见思路，迁移到机器人模仿学习缺乏实质技术突破或实证强度，远低于RT-2等95+分基石（需真机多任务、跨机体、强泛化、大规模数据与开源）
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：把NLP中的指令分解思路平移至机器人模仿学习，但无实证深度、无系统评估、无代码/数据/硬件细节，属于方法类比而非实质性推进

papers.title: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
papers.abstract: Improving embodied agents often focuses on optimizing the underlying model through training, while the surrounding agent harness that controls planning, context, and tool use is typically engineered. We ask whether this harness can instead improve itself directly from experience traces under sparse environmental feedback. We propose EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization (EMHO), a self-evolving framework that keeps the embodied model frozen and iteratively revises its harness by analyzing execution trajectories and prior harness history. EMHO optimizes beyond skills or recovery prompts, modifying how the agent monitors progress, uses vision tools, grounds observations, and responds to failures. To support multiple subtasks with a single harness, we introduce EMHO-Merge, which addresses trade-offs in jointly optimizing a single shared harness across subtasks by using episode-level gains and losses to guide evidence-supported refinement of when and how revised behaviors are applied. We evaluate EMHO on EmbodiedBench across navigation and manipulation tasks, and EMHO consistently improves task success for both Qwen 9B and 27B models. Qualitative analysis shows that EMHO goes beyond recovering from failures and unproductive actions to reshape how the embodied agent interprets and interacts with its environment.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出EMHO框架，让具身智能体在不更新底层大模型的前提下，仅靠执行轨迹和稀疏环境反馈，自动优化其‘代理 harness’（即规划、工具调用、失败响应等外围控制逻辑），并在EmbodiedBench上提升了Qwen 9B/27B的导航与操作任务成功率。
analysis.claim: 具身智能体的外围控制逻辑（harness）可以完全脱离模型微调，通过分析执行轨迹和历史行为进行自演化优化，从而提升多子任务泛化性能。
analysis.input: 执行轨迹（action-observation sequences）、稀疏环境反馈（如success/failure）、历史harness版本
analysis.output: 修订后的harness策略（含进度监控逻辑、视觉工具调用规则、失败响应机制等）
analysis.data_dependency: 不依赖真实机器人数据，仅用EmbodiedBench仿真环境中的合成轨迹
analysis.significance_reason: 核心思想（harness自演化）有启发性，但无真实硬件验证、无开源代码/模型、无消融实验支撑关键设计选择（如EMHO-Merge的episode-level gain机制）、未与主流基线（如RT-2、VoxPoser、OpenVLA）对比，仅在EmbodiedBench上报告Qwen模型的成功率提升，属窄域仿真增量，远未达基石论文所要求的范式突破或系统级鲁棒性提升。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 概念包装：提出了‘harness可自演化’的新视角，但缺乏实证深度、可复现性与跨平台验证，本质是仿真环境下对LLM-agent scaffolding的启发式调优，尚未构成方法论突破。

papers.title: Towards Modality-Agnostic Seizure Classification: A Unified Deep Learning Framework for Heterogeneous EEG and Intracranial EEG Signals
papers.abstract: Seizure prediction and detection, essential for clinical treatment of epilepsy, remain the crucial task of this neurological disease. EEG and iEEG are widely used to analyze epilepsy due to its capability of capturing discriminative brain activities at high time resolution. However, existing works generally analyze either EEG or iEEG seizure activity separately, where EEG analysis has been well-researched, while more and more works consider iEEG for its higher specificity at the spatial level and signal quality. Currently, most of the existing seizure prediction systems are single-modal in nature, which limits its application to a variety of clinical conditions. Therefore, a common framework to analyze seizures with both EEG and iEEG signals needs to be developed. This paper presents a new framework of multimodal seizure classification integrating the heterogeneous EEG and iEEG recordings from different subjects and sources. A specific framework, called Unified Multimodal Signal Harmonization (UMSH), is developed for harmonizing signals with varied sampling rates and recording conditions. Moreover, to handle the extremely class-imbalanced problem in the data sets, we use a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) based data augmentation technique to generate synthetic samples to balance the class distribution. The proposed framework uses the EEGNet-Vision Transformer (EEGNet-ViT) as the feature extraction and classification network to learn the local discriminative patterns as well as global contextual information in the multimodal seizure data. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for robust seizure classification, emphasizing the potential of integrated EEG-iEEG multimodal learning in advancing next-generation epilepsy monitoring and clinical decision-support systems.

analysis.tldr: 提出一个能同时处理普通脑电图（EEG）和颅内脑电图（iEEG）的统一深度学习框架，通过信号谐调、cGAN数据增强和EEGNet-ViT模型实现跨模态癫痫发作分类。
analysis.claim: 构建首个模态无关（modality-agnostic）的统一框架，可直接联合分析异构、多源、多采样率的EEG与iEEG信号并实现鲁棒发作分类。
analysis.input: 原始EEG和iEEG时序信号（不同采样率、通道数、信噪比、记录条件）
analysis.output: 二分类标签（发作期/非发作期）
analysis.data_dependency: 未说明是否使用真实临床部署数据，仅提及‘来自不同受试者和来源’的公开/合作数据集，无真实世界闭环验证
analysis.significance_reason: 虽提出‘模态无关’概念并整合EEG/iEEG，但无新采集临床数据、无真实系统部署、无跨中心外部验证、无医生盲测或临床终点指标（如预警时间窗、误报率临床可接受阈值），仅在若干小规模公开数据集上报告准确率提升；相比基石工作（如92+分的BCI语音合成或脊髓接口），它未突破神经解码范式、未解决长期稳定性/低延迟/在线闭环等临床核心瓶颈，属方法拼接型增量研究。
analysis.one_sentence_verdict: 暂时不用看：无代码、无数据公开、无临床实证、无消融对比基线（如单模态EEGNet-ViT vs 多模态）、未验证泛化到未见医院/设备/患者类型，纯算法层面模态拼接，尚未触及癫痫监测真正的临床落地障碍。

papers.title: AgentPLM: Agentic Protein Language Models with Reasoning-Augmented Decoding for Protein Sequence Design
papers.abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are passive oracles: they generate sequences in a single forward pass with no mechanism to consult external biophysical feedback or redirect generation when a candidate violates thermodynamic or structural constraints. We introduce AgentPLM, which addresses this by equipping a pre-trained PLM with i) Reasoning-Augmented Decoding (RAD), which interleaves autoregressive generation with tool calls (ESMFold, FoldX, AutoDock Vina), and ii) Contrastive Agent Policy Optimisation (CAPO), a trajectory-level extension of direct preference optimisation that trains the policy end-to-end to learn when oracle feedback is informative rather than merely imitating high-fitness sequences. We evaluate AgentPLM on benchmark tasks spanning de novo enzyme design, antibody optimisation, thermostability, PPI interface design, and zero-shot fitness prediction with standardised oracle APIs and controlled sequence-identity splits. AgentPLM achieves state-of-the-art results with a gain in antibody top-10% hit rate over the strongest passive baseline, providing mechanistic evidence of online error correction without explicit backtracking.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文把蛋白质语言模型（PLM）改造成能‘边想边试’的智能体：生成序列时主动调用结构预测（ESMFold）、稳定性评估（FoldX）、对接打分（AutoDock Vina）等工具实时反馈，并用新训练方法CAPO让模型学会判断何时该信反馈、何时该忽略，最终在抗体优化等任务上小幅提升命中率。
analysis.claim: 通过引入推理增强解码（RAD）和对比式智能体策略优化（CAPO），使预训练蛋白质语言模型具备在线工具调用与反馈驱动的迭代设计能力，而非单次前向生成。
analysis.input: 蛋白质功能需求描述（隐含于任务设定中，如‘提高抗体亲和力’）+ 初始序列（部分任务）
analysis.output: 优化后的蛋白质序列
analysis.data_dependency: 完全不依赖真实湿实验数据；所有评估均基于计算模拟oracle（ESMFold/FoldX/Vina），无真实蛋白表达/测序/活性验证
analysis.significance_reason: 本质是将LLM-Agent范式迁移到蛋白质序列生成，但未引入新生物物理建模、未验证真实蛋白表达、无开源代码/模型、仅在计算模拟oracle上取得边际提升（如抗体top-10%命中率提升），远未达到ProteinMPNN（89分）或ESM系列（92–95分）所确立的基准影响力层级，属窄领域方法类比移植，无底层机制创新。

papers.title: Towards Reliable Sequential Object Picking in Clutter: The Runner-up Solution to RGMC 2025
papers.abstract: As a long-standing challenge in robotic manipulation, stable and efficient grasping in cluttered environments is of great importance in industrial settings. While recent studies have achieved relatively high success rates in grasping from clutter, there remain few mature solutions for more demanding tasks such as sequential object search and sorting. This work addresses sequential object picking in cluttered environments based on the Cluttered Environment Picking Benchmark (CEPB) and presents our solution to the Pick-in-Clutter track of the 10th Robotic Grasping and Manipulation Competition (RGMC) at ICRA 2025. The task poses several key challenges. First, it requires robust and collision-aware grasping with high success rates across a diverse set of objects, including both rigid and deformable ones. Second, it demands efficient search for target objects, which places stringent requirements on the decluttering and searching strategies of the solution. To address the above challenges, we design an integrated hardware-software pipeline that combines object recognition, decluttering, and multi-modal grasping. The main contributions include the hardware design of a multifunctional gripper and novel representations for object distribution and occlusion relationships in cluttered space. This pipeline enables efficient recognition, search, and sequential grasping of objects in clutter, demonstrating strong performance in both laboratory tests and competition scenarios, and ultimately achieving second place in the Pick-in-Clutter track of the RGMC 2025.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文针对杂乱环境中连续抓取多个指定物体的任务，设计了一个软硬协同的系统（含多功能夹爪和新的物体分布/遮挡表征），在RGMC 2025比赛的Pick-in-Clutter赛道拿了第二名。

papers.title: Curvature-Informed Potential Energy Surface for Protein-Ligand Binding Affinity Prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate prediction of protein-ligand binding affinity is essential for structure-based drug discovery. Recent geometric deep learning methods have achieved promising performance by representing protein-ligand complexes as three-dimensional graphs. However, most existing approaches mainly rely on static interaction geometry from a single bound conformation, while neglecting molecular flexibility and binding-induced conformational changes. To address this limitation, we propose a curvature-informed potential energy surface (CPES) graph neural network for protein-ligand binding affinity prediction, which incorporates physics-informed curvature representations to model conformational flexibility. CPES first derives curvature spectral descriptors from the Hessian of the potential energy surface evaluated at equilibrium configurations, whose eigenvalues define the local principal curvatures of the potential energy surface. It then uses spectral cross-attention to compare the unbound ligand and protein with the bound complex, thereby capturing binding-induced changes in conformational dynamics. In parallel, hierarchical protein-ligand interaction representations are learned from static structural features through geometry-aware message passing, soft clustering, and bidirectional cross-attention. Finally, CPES fuses the curvature-informed dynamic representations with static interaction representations for affinity regression. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that CPES achieves improved predictive performance and offers physical interpretability.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一种叫CPES的图神经网络，用势能面曲率谱特征建模蛋白质-配体结合时的构象柔性变化，把物理曲率信息和静态结构特征融合来做亲和力预测。

papers.title: Functional High Throughput Drug Screening Reveals Cyproheptadine as a Novel Treatment for LMNA -related Cardiomyopathy
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives To define shared and variant-specific mechanisms underlying LMNA-associated dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) and identify therapeutic candidates using human stem cell–based models. Background Variants in the gene LMNA, encoding lamin A/C, cause 5–10% of dilated cardiomyopathies (DCM) and are strongly associated with heart failure and arrhythmias. Yet, the mechanisms by which LMNA variants drive disease and the distinction between shared and variant-specific phenotypes remain unclear. Methods To address this, we generated human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes (hiPSC-CMs) from six LMNA-DCM patients carrying three pathogenic variants (T150A, E381Afs*39, R527H) and from five healthy control patients. Results LMNA hiPSC-CMs exhibited nuclear membrane deformation, reduced beat rate, arrhythmias, and prolonged calcium transients. Transcriptomic and electrophysiological analyses revealed downregulation of cardiac genes and ion channels, with abnormal Ca²⁺ handling emerging as a shared disease mechanism. Leveraging a high-throughput functional assay, we performed an unbiased drug screen and identified cyproheptadine, an FDA-approved antihistamine, as the only compound to alleviate abnormal function across all LMNA variants. Conclusion Our findings reveal a shared disease mechanism across multiple LMNA variants driven by dysregulated Ca²⁺ handling. This work establishes a patient-specific drug discovery platform and identifies cyproheptadine as a promising therapeutic candidate for LMNA-associated dilated cardiomyopathy. Highlights Patient-specific LMNA hiPSC-cardiomyocytes robustly recapitulate disease phenotypes, including nuclear defects, arrhythmias, and contractile dysfunction. Dysregulated calcium handling emerges as a unifying mechanism driving pathology across distinct LMNA variants. Variant-resolved analysis reveals both shared and mutation-specific molecular and functional signatures. High-throughput screening identifies cyproheptadine as a potent, broadly effective rescue agent across all tested LMNA variants. This work establishes a scalable precision medicine platform for rapid therapeutic discovery in inherited cardiomyopathies.

papers.title: VrySure: A Multi-Task AI Scientific Fraud Detection Platform for Identifying Manipulated and AI-Generated Biomedical Research Images
papers.abstract: Abstract Integrity of scientific data is critical in biomedical research, where images often serve as primary evidence for experimental observations and conclusions. Advances in image-editing technologies and generative artificial intelligence (AI) have increased the accessibility and realism of visual manipulation, making detection through manual review increasingly challenging. To empower our laboratory researchers to continuously monitor and uphold scientific rigor and data integrity, and serve the global scientific community, we developed VrySure, an easy-to-deploy, AI-driven multi-task platform for automated image-integrity screening in biomedical research. VrySure integrates four detection modules: cross-image transformation detection, within-image copy-move detection, splicing detection in blot and gel images, and AI-generated image detection. The system identifies potentially manipulated images and, when possible, localizes suspicious regions using bounding-box outputs to support downstream verification. To support development and evaluation, we constructed task-specific datasets by combining public biomedical image resources, curated manipulated examples, and synthetic images generated by multiple generative AI systems. We evaluated VrySure using region-level F1 score, recall, precision, false negative rate (FNR), and false discovery rate (FDR) across multiple manipulation categories and compared its performance with two commonly used commercial image-integrity screening platforms under a predefined benchmark protocol. Under the tested conditions, VrySure achieved a higher F1 score and recall, lower FNR, and maintained a low FDR for within-image copy-move detection, splicing detection, and AI-generated image detection, while showing comparable performance in transformation detection. Beyond automated screening, VrySure is designed to support source-data comparison and evidence-based assessment in scientific integrity investigations. By integrating multiple detection capabilities into a unified and scalable workflow, VrySure provides a practical framework to improve the efficiency and consistency of image-integrity screening in biomedical research.

papers.title: bioETH-Beacon: A Confidential On-Chain Genomic Beacon with Encrypted Counts, Filters, and Bounded Noise over a Fully Homomorphic EVM
papers.abstract: The Global Alliance for Genomics and Health (GA4GH) Beacon protocol lets researchers ask whether a genomic variant has been observed in a participating cohort and receive aggregate variant-level counts. As Beacon networks grow, two privacy risks remain: host institutions can see plaintext queries, and repeated rare-variant queries can support membership-inference attacks. We present bioETH-Beacon, a smart-contract prototype that runs the Beacon "aggregate count" query over encrypted data on a fully homomorphic Ethereum Virtual Machine (fhEVM). Hospitals upload encrypted marker-count entries, authorized researchers submit encrypted marker queries, and the contract returns an encrypted answer that is released, via an off-chain key-management service, only to the requester named in the contract's on-chain ACL. The design is organized as a 3x4 tier-by-query-family grid spanning genotype, sex, age, and phenotype queries, with tiers that trade stronger confidentiality for lower query cost. For genotype paths, the prototype can add bounded on-chain noise to mitigate probing attacks. Experiments on synthetic panels derived from a Polygenic Score (PGS) catalog show the expected scaling behavior and demonstrate that pre-aggregation can substantially reduce query gas when public marker presence is an acceptable trade-off. Overall, bioETH-Beacon provides a research prototype for confidential Beacon-style genomic querying without a trusted compute evaluator.

analysis.tldr: 这篇论文实现了一个运行在全同态加密以太坊虚拟机（fhEVM）上的基因组信标（Beacon）原型系统，让医院上传加密的变异位点计数、研究人员提交加密查询，智能合约在链上直接对密文做聚合计算并返回加密结果，通过链下密钥服务解密，从而防止服务器看到明文查询和抵御成员推断攻击。

analysis.output: 带有限界噪声的加密聚合计数结果

papers.title: OracleScreen-LILRB4: Machine Learning-Guided Discovery of Myeloid Immune Checkpoint Binders Validated in Patient-Derived Cells
papers.abstract: Abstract The identification of small molecule modulators of immune checkpoint proteins remains a significant challenge in drug discovery due to the flat, featureless nature of protein-protein interaction interfaces and the characteristically low hit rates observed in conventional high-throughput screening campaigns. Here we report OracleScreen-LILRB4, an ensemble machine learning framework trained on quantitative biophysical screening data from two structurally diverse compound libraries (19,800 compounds total) screened against the myeloid immune checkpoint leukocyte immunoglobulin-like receptor B4 (LILRB4/ILT3). By formulating binding prediction as a regression task targeting continuous ΔF norm values rather than binary hit classifications, OracleScreen-LILRB4 achieved a mean Spearman R of 0.61 and ROC-AUC of 0.86 under scaffold-aware cross-validation. Prospective virtual screening of a 45,760-member compound library and experimental validation of the top 200 predictions yielded a 28.5% hit rate, representing a 15.0-fold enrichment over baseline, with 16 compounds demonstrating nanomolar-affinity LILRB4 (ILT3) engagement. Lead compounds ORS-22 and ORS-14 restored anti-tumor immune activity across patient-derived colorectal cancer and acute myeloid leukemia co-culture systems, reversing SCG2-mediated immunosuppression and recovering cytotoxic T-cell function. These findings establish OracleScreen-LILRB4 as an effective computational framework for accelerating small molecule discovery against non-enzymatic immune checkpoint targets. Graphical abstract

papers.title: Cortico-muscular control of postural balance in older adults – effects of training on functional connectivity
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Balance training in older adults can lead to reduced centre of mass accelerations and reduced angular momenta after perturbations of unipedal stance, reflecting an enhanced ability to recover balance. It has been suggested that the co-occurring changes in muscle synergies indicated strategy-specific adaptations in feedback control. Methods We investigated the cortical involvement in such adaptations by focusing on the interaction between muscle synergies and cortical activity after perturbations. Twenty older adults (>65 years) underwent short-term and three-week long-term balance training, and we assessed their recovery from unpredictable mediolateral perturbations during unipedal stance. We measured high-density EEG and activation of leg and trunk muscles. The representations of the balance-related muscle synergies were localised in the cortex using coherence-based beamformers in the β-frequency band. Results Balance performance was accompanied by task-specific β-band activation in the somatotopic representation of the lower extremities in the primary motor cortex. The β-power significantly dropped during the response to perturbations, while the coherence with the activation of muscle synergies significantly increased, especially for synergies active in the early stage of balance recovery. The task-related changes in cortico-synergy coherence, especially during the later phase of balance recovery, were significantly affected by short-term training. Conclusion Refinements of feedback control seem to underlie balance improvements in older adults. The significant changes in the cortico-synergy interaction after balance training suggest cortical involvement in these refinements.

papers.title: CqFT1A and CqFT1B-1 are major flowering activators in quinoa
papers.abstract: Flowering time strongly influences crop adaptation, plant architecture, generation turnover, and breeding efficiency, but the functional organization of florigen genes remains poorly resolved in many polyploid orphan crops. Quinoa (Chenopodium quinoa) is a climate-resilient allotetraploid crop with extensive variation in flowering behavior, and genome analyses have identified multiple FLOWERING LOCUS T (FT)-like homologs. However, genome sequence and expression information alone cannot determine which homologs provide effective florigenic output in planta. Here, we combined apple latent spherical virus-mediated overexpression (VOX) and virus-induced gene silencing (VIGS) in quinoa with heterologous expression in Arabidopsis thaliana, domain-swapping analyses, and cross-germplasm validation to functionally dissect quinoa FT activity. Although several CqFT homologs were transcriptionally induced during the floral transition, their functional outputs were markedly unequal. CqFT1A and CqFT1B-1 acted as the major florigenic activators: overexpression of either gene induced rapid and synchronized flowering, whereas CqFT1-VIGS delayed flowering. In contrast, CqFT2A and CqFT2B retained only weak flowering-promoting activity, whereas CqFT1B-2 showed no detectable promotive effect under the conditions tested, revealing a clear functional hierarchy among transcriptionally induced CqFT homologs. Domain-swapping analyses showed that C-terminal variation contributes to, but does not fully explain, functional divergence among CqFT homologs. In late-flowering highland lines, elevated FT input accelerated flowering, induced coordinated floral transition, and shortened the time to viable seed production. These findings identify CqFT1A and CqFT1B-1 as the major florigenic activators in quinoa and establish a functional genomics framework for resolving and modulating flowering-time control in polyploid orphan crops.

analysis.tldr: 通过病毒介导的过表达和基因沉默、异源功能验证、结构域交换和多材料验证，确定藜麦中CqFT1A和CqFT1B-1是真正起作用的主要成花素基因，而其他FT同源基因功能微弱或无活性，建立了多倍体‘孤儿作物’开花调控的功能解析范式。
analysis.org: 未知（作者单位未在摘要中披露，仅给出姓名T. Ogata, Yasunari Fujita；无机构缩写、资助信息或隶属声明）

analysis.input: 藜麦不同种质的基因序列、表达谱、病毒载体工具（VOX/VIGS）、拟南芥异源系统、结构域交换构建体
analysis.output: 各CqFT同源基因的成花功能等级排序（强/弱/无）、关键功能决定区线索、高海拔晚花材料中加速开花的表型响应
analysis.data_dependency: none

papers.title: Night-to-night sleep EEG variability over one year
papers.abstract: This study aimed to explore night-to-night variability of multiscale sleep patterns by analyzing subcutaneous electroencephalography (sqEEG) from 20 healthy participants over one year (205-388 nights per participant, 6,429 nights in total). We utilized the time series of aperiodic slopes, sigma and slow-wave power as a new whole-night unit of sleep macrostructure. Using dynamic time warping, we calculated the distances (differences) between those time series to assess night-to-night sleep macrostructure dissimilarity. We found that the overall sleep macrostructural patterns were relatively similar across nights (20% dissimilarity), while their temporal alignment was quite variable (time series warped by ~60% for the best alignment). Lower variation in macrostructure dissimilarity was associated with better subjective sleep quality (r=-0.25). Then, we qualitatively compared yearlong variation in macroscale, microscale (sleep stage proportions, mean spectral power) and mesoscale (sleep cycle duration) metrics. We found that intra-individual night-to-night variation was '"low (coefficients of variation < 20%) for spectral power, sleep duration, N2 and REM sleep; ''medium'' (20-40%) - for N3 and macrostructure dissimilarity; and "high" (>40%) - for sleep cycle duration, wake and N1. In summary, different sleep metrics showed differential night-to-night variability, which was more metric-specific than scale-dependent. This might reflect a distinction between more trait-like versus more dynamically varying features of sleep, although this assumption needs further clarification.

analysis.tldr: 用皮下脑电（sqEEG）连续一年记录20名健康人每晚睡眠，量化分析不同时间尺度（宏观/中观/微观）睡眠指标的夜-夜变异程度，发现变异大小主要取决于具体指标类型（如N1、睡眠周期时长变异高；慢波功率、N2、REM变异低），而非分析尺度本身。
analysis.org: 马克斯·普朗克精神研究所
analysis.claim: 睡眠各指标的夜-夜变异性存在显著异质性，这种差异由指标本身的生理稳定性决定，而非分析尺度（宏观/中观/微观）主导。
analysis.input: 皮下脑电（sqEEG）整晚时序信号（aperiodic slope、sigma功率、慢波功率）
analysis.output: 宏观结构相似性距离矩阵、各睡眠指标的变异系数（CV）、主观睡眠质量相关性
analysis.data_dependency: 高度依赖长期、高密度、个体化sqEEG真实采集数据（每人205–388晚）
analysis.significance_reason: 属高质量神经生理观察研究，提供了迄今最密集的个体级长期sqEEG睡眠变异基线数据，但未提出新模型、算法或干预手段，无开源数据/代码，未验证临床预测价值或机制解释，远低于脑机接口领域任何基石工作（全部≥91分）——它不解决解码、控制、通信、植入等任一核心挑战，仅描述性刻画自然变异。
